summary: No food handler certificates were on site, and the certified manager lacks allergen training; citation issued. Disposable cups were stored inside bulk dry ingredient containers, and the rear exit door is not rodent-proof. A rear handsink pipe was leaking into a bucket.

headline: Failed: about 30 live flies; no hot water
summary: About 30 live flies were on walls and ceilings in the coffee station and rear dishwashing area; more pest control service is needed. No certified manager was present while TCS foods were served. A hand sink had no hot water (61.1°F). Earlier violations remain uncorrected.

headline: Prep cooler door gasket needs repair
summary: On re-inspection, the left door gasket of the two-door prep cooler in the rear prep area on the 5th floor must be repaired so the door closes and seals properly.

headline: No food handler cards; uncorrected garbage violation
summary: No food handler cards were on site, and the pizza cooler has no thermometer. A previous violation was not fixed: the facility uses city garbage pickup but must contract a private waste hauler. Citation issued.

headline: Undated cooked food; rear door gap
summary: Cooked rice and egg roll filling held over 24 hours were not date-marked; citation issued. A 1/4-inch gap under the rear exit door must be sealed against pests. Handwashing signs and splashguards are missing, and the utility room is cluttered.

headline: Food in non-food-grade buckets; leaks
summary: Food was stored in white plastic buckets and smaller containers that were not food-grade. Floor drains in the rear dish area have debris and a slimy dark substance. Leaks were found at a one-compartment sink and a hand sink; several areas need deep cleaning.

headline: Failed: repeat violations; manager lacks allergen training
summary: A toilet room in the kitchen prep area is cluttered with storage items; its wash bowl and toilet water line must be capped and the room cleared. This violation from March 2025 was not corrected. A certified manager lacks allergen training; citation issued.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; raw meat discarded
summary: Chicken, ground beef and sausage were held above 41°F in the basement walk-in cooler (49.8°F, 46.2°F, 49.1°F). About 49 lb, worth about $300, was discarded. The cooler was tagged and must be repaired. No vomit cleanup kit was on site.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; no allergen training
summary: Bulk food containers holding beans and rice were not labeled and must be labeled. The sanitation manager has no allergen training, and the manager must provide proof.

headline: No manager on duty; produce held too warm
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while hamburgers, chicken and steak were served; citation issued. Tomatoes at 55.6°F and lettuce at 63.2°F in a prep ice bin were too warm; the manager discarded 7 lb (about $20). Sink pipes leak and floors need cleaning.

headline: Dish machine gauge fixed on site; undated shellstock
summary: Shellstock tags from late 2024 and early 2025 lack the date when the last shellstock is sold or served; citation issued. A low-temperature dish machine's wash gauge read 493, not a temperature. It was repaired on site and now reads 125°F.

headline: No certified manager on premises; hair restraint lapses
summary: No city-certified food service manager was on premises; citation issued. Two food handlers preparing food lacked hair restraints. Boxes were stored on soda crates, drains and the pizza oven were greasy, and the employee washroom door lacks a self-closing device.

headline: Failed: packaged paletas lack allergen labels
summary: Many sealed paletas (ice pops) lack proper allergen labels, and many contain nuts or other major allergens without listing ingredients. The manager must label all with allergens and ingredients or remove them from the premises. Citation issued.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: The person in charge lacks a Chicago food sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was present while TCS foods were served; citation issued. Several workers lacked hair restraints. A basement leak, uncovered bathroom trash, and dirty floor drains were noted.

headline: Front door gap; missing splashguards
summary: A gap of about 1/4 inch at the bottom of the front entrance door must be closed to prevent pest entry. Splashguards are needed at the front coffee prep area sinks. Backflow prevention devices must be installed at the ice and espresso machines.

headline: Failed: slimy ice maker; missing raw food warning
summary: A slimy brownish substance was found inside the ice maker and must be cleaned. The menu lacks a consumer advisory for raw or undercooked items such as soft-boiled egg ramen; a priority violation. Unlabeled containers, dirty fryers and a broken urinal were also noted.

headline: No hair restraint; utility sink missing
summary: A food handler prepared food without a proper hair restraint and must wear one at all times. The facility was licensed with a utility sink but none was available; the manager must provide one.

headline: No certificate holder on site during TCS prep
summary: No person with a City sanitation certificate was on premises while chicken and beef were handled; citation issued. The manager showed a 2024 class completion, not a city certificate. Missing prep-area cooler thermometer; greasy fryer; food stored on floor.

headline: Dish machines out of service; manager training
summary: Two low-temperature dish machines on the second floor and two high-temperature machines at the members-only coffee station are out of service and must be repaired or removed. A certified manager lacks proof of allergen training.

headline: Spoiled, moldy meat displayed for sale
summary: Numerous meat packages were spoiled and discolored with black, brown and green patches, and were on display for sale. Green and white mold spots were on sliced bacon. The manager was told to discard them; citation issued. Fly strips hang in the produce prep area.

headline: Failed: five dead cockroaches in sink
summary: Five dead cockroaches were found in the warewashing-area handwashing sink. No other pests were seen; pest control was ordered. The site has no waste removal service or dumpster. A handwashing sign was missing and a ceiling above a sink is damaged.

headline: Food handlers lack certificates; no hair restraints
summary: Food handlers in prep areas must wear hair restraints. Several food handlers had no food handler certificates, and the certified manager has no allergen training certificate. Beverage nozzles need cleaning; prep-area ceiling tiles, vents and light shields need attention.

headline: Dirty floors, drains, vents and grill filters
summary: Floors and floor drains need cleaning to remove spills and debris. Air vents in the prep area are dusty, and filters above the grills have debris. No pests or temperature problems were noted.

headline: Failed: poor handwashing; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: A food handler rinsed hands with water only, and no certified manager was present for the first half of the walkthrough; citation issued. The low-temperature dish machine had zero ppm sanitizer and must not be used until re-inspected. A rice cooker was stored on the floor.

headline: Dirty wiping cloths; cracked cutting boards
summary: Dirty wiping cloths were left on rear prep tables instead of being stored in sanitizer. Cutting boards have open seams and dark stains and must be refinished or replaced. Grease and oil were found on the stove surface.

headline: Excessive leak at sink; greasy hood filters
summary: A leak at the three-compartment sink pipe is excessive and must be repaired. Peeling paint on the ceiling in the front prep area must be repaired. Hood filters have a buildup of grease and must be cleaned.

headline: Grooved cutting board; clutter in basement
summary: A cutting board on the main salad line has deep grooves and dark stains and must be repaired or replaced. Unused equipment and unnecessary items in basement storage must be removed to prevent pest harborage. The fan by the utility sink needs cleaning.

headline: License number missing from door sides
summary: The license number must be displayed on both sides of the doors. The manager was instructed to add and maintain it.

headline: Ice machine build-up; missing hood filter
summary: Slight pink buildup was found in the upper portion of the ice machine and must be cleaned. One ventilation hood filter is missing and must be replaced; the remaining filters must be kept clean.

headline: Broken reach-in handle with sharp edge
summary: The left handle of a two-door reach-in cooler near the three-compartment sink is broken and has a sharp edge; it must be repaired. The employee toilet room in the rear has low lighting and needs brighter lights.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, missing training records
summary: Food handlers prepared TCS foods (foods that must stay hot or cold) with no city-certified food manager on site; citation issued. Vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies were missing. No training proof was shown for food handlers or allergens; seasonings were unlabeled.

headline: No certified manager present during food prep
summary: The person in charge lacks a city food manager certificate. No certified manager was on premises while sandwiches, fries and shakes were prepared; citation issued. Shake scoops were stored in standing water until the person in charge ran water. Gaskets are torn.

headline: Food splatters inside microwave
summary: Minor food splatters were found inside the microwave. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Expired food handler certificates on site
summary: On re-inspection, all food handler certificates on site had expired and must be replaced with valid ones. Debris is built up under the flat-top grill; cardboard on the floor in the rear prep area must be removed. The certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No certified food manager; no certificate posted
summary: No certified food service manager was on site, and no certificate was posted. The manager was told to obtain one. This is a priority violation under city code 7-38-012.

headline: Food stored on floor; unlabeled containers
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler, prep and storage areas; the manager must raise them at least six inches. Containers lacked food-name labels. The ice bin interior needs cleaning, and floors throughout are dusty.

headline: Eggs and cream cheese held too warm
summary: Eggs at 45°F, cream cheese at 56°F, bean bread and whipped topping at 51°F were held in prep coolers above the 41°F limit; citation issued. A two-door prep cooler reached only 50°F and must be repaired. Several handlers have expired food handler certificates.

headline: No drainboard at sink; damaged ceilings
summary: The three-compartment sink has no drainboard, so washed utensils cannot dry properly; a metal drainboard or drain rack was ordered. Damaged ceiling tiles in the toilet room and a damaged ceiling at the front of the store must be repaired.

headline: No employee health policy; no customer barrier
summary: No employee health policy was on premises; the manager must provide one covering illness reporting. Food prep and dishwashing areas lack a barrier from the sales floor and must be protected from customers. Food handlers who are not managers need training.

headline: No backflow device at utility sink
summary: No backflow device is installed at the utility sink as required; the manager must install one. Exterior surfaces of cooking equipment must be cleaned. All food handlers must obtain required food handler training.

headline: Certified managers lack allergen training
summary: Certified food managers are missing allergen awareness training. All certified managers must complete this training.

headline: Leak under three-compartment sink
summary: A leak was found from the center of the pipe underneath the three-compartment sink. The manager was instructed to repair the leak.

headline: Faulty sanitizer dispenser; unused cooler
summary: The sanitizer dispenser at the three-compartment sink is not working properly and must be repaired or replaced. An unused two-door cooler in the front prep area must either be repaired and maintained or removed from the premises.

headline: Rear door gap; cracked floors; dirty filters
summary: The rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom that must be sealed to keep pests out. Tabletops, prep stations, shelving and a reach-in freezer need cleaning. Floors need detail cleaning, and cracked floors with holes must be repaired.

headline: Failed: over 40 mouse droppings found
summary: More than 40 mouse droppings were scattered on the furnace room floor. The manager was told to call an exterminator and clean all areas; priority citation issued. Food debris, leaking pipes and missing hood filters and food-manager allergen training were also noted.

headline: No handwashing sign; milk crates used as shelves
summary: No handwashing sign was posted at the bar prep sink; the manager must provide one. Milk crates serve as shelving and must be replaced with shelving at least six inches off the floor. Grease, food debris and dirt were found on floors in several areas.

headline: Rear door gap; dirty gaskets; lights out
summary: A gap of at least 1/4 inch under the rear exit door needs a repaired door sweep. Gaskets on two reach-in coolers are damaged and dirty. Several lights are out in the prep area and hallway, and the certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Half-inch gap at front doors; no splashguard
summary: A 1/2-inch gap between the double front doors must be closed to rodent-proof the building. A splashguard is needed between a handwashing sink and a three-compartment sink at the rooftop bar. Both employee washroom doors lack self-closing devices.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; repeat violations
summary: No certified manager was on site while pizza was served; citation issued. Repeat violations from May 2025 were not corrected: a torn door seal, food debris inside reach-in coolers, a leaking sink, a missing toilet door closer, and dirty floors and fan vents.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged out of use
summary: The high-temperature dish machine could not reach the required 180°F final rinse (it reached 74°F) and is tagged out until repaired and re-inspected. Raw beef stored on the walk-in freezer floor must be raised six inches. Several items were soiled.

headline: Mold-like buildup on cheese cooler shelves
summary: A gap of about 1/4 inch at the front doors must be sealed. Stained cutting boards and rusted, chipped racks need replacing or repainting. The cheese cooler shelves have mold-like buildup. Water-stained ceiling tiles over grocery freezers must be replaced.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; blocked handsinks
summary: No certified manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. Both handwashing sinks were blocked with utensils and supplies. The pest control logbook had no 2026 service reports. Food handler training proof and manager allergen training are missing.

headline: Dirty floor drains; expired allergen certificate
summary: Floor drains and floors in corners, under equipment and around sinks in the prep and dishwashing areas have dirt and debris. Floor drains must be cleaned. The certified food manager's allergen training certificate has expired.

headline: Deli meat held at 86.4°F; no hot water
summary: Several packs of sliced deli meat, turkey and turkey ham were stored at 86.4°F in a reach-in cooler; the manager was told to discard them. Citation issued. Several washroom and utility sinks lack hot water, and one utility sink is not draining.

headline: Food on floor, unlabeled containers, rear door gap
summary: Food was stored on floors in the walk-in cooler, prep and storage areas; it must be raised six inches. Food containers lacked name labels. A 1/4-inch gap under the rear exit door must be sealed to keep pests out.

headline: Frozen food holding inadequate; no thermometer
summary: The facility lacks an adequate holding method for TCS frozen foods, a priority violation. No metal-stem thermometer was available for checking frozen food temperatures. Banners on the bicycle lack the required license number.

headline: No handwashing signs; allergen training missing
summary: Washrooms have no handwashing signs and must have them. The certified food manager has no allergen training certificate; the manager must complete training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; dirty shelves and floors
summary: No vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit was on site; the manager was told to obtain and maintain one. No citation was issued. Food shelves need detailed cleaning, the toilet needs a new flush handle, and floors throughout need cleaning.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; no allergen training
summary: No vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit or written procedures were on site. Handwashing sinks lack signs. A cutting board has open seams and dark stains. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks, and the food prep handsink drains slowly. The city food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Failed: about 1,000 mouse droppings throughout
summary: Re-inspection found an infestation of about 1,000 or more mouse droppings across the premises, including prep, sales, storage and basement areas. Two dead mice and a decayed one were found. Pest control service is required, and doors have gaps.

headline: No backflow devices at coffee machines
summary: The espresso machine and drip coffee machine have no backflow prevention devices. The manager must provide devices in locations where they can be serviced and maintained.

headline: Cook lacked hair restraint; cracked floors
summary: A male cook had no hair restraint or beard guard at the start of the inspection. The manager supplied both during the inspection. Cracked floor tiles by the fryers and sink hold standing water; repairs and water removal were ordered.

headline: No current food handler certificates on site
summary: On re-inspection, no current food handler certificates were on site. All employees must complete food handler training, and records must be kept on site at all times.

headline: Failed: dish machine lacks temperature gauge
summary: The warewashing machine has no temperature gauge for its wash and sanitizing cycles, so water temperatures cannot be checked. This was a priority violation, and a citation was issued.

headline: Toilet room trash lacks lids
summary: Receptacles in the women's toilet room have no lids. The manager was told to ensure covered receptacles are in the women's toilet room.

headline: Dead flies, spiders and ants on basement floor
summary: Dead flies, spiders and ants had built up across the basement floor; the manager must remove them to prevent pests. Damp wiping cloths were stored on an open glassware cooler at the bar, and knives were left between sinks and cold-holding equipment.

headline: Screen door openings; allergen training missing
summary: Openings in the rear screen door must be repaired to prevent pest entry. A certified food manager was observed without an allergen training certificate; management was told all certified managers must show proof.

headline: Water pipe above packaged food; grease spills
summary: A black water line pipe runs over packaged food and to-go containers in the basement and must be shielded or the food moved. Food splatter is inside microwaves, and grease spills are on the floor under the bar's three-compartment sink.

headline: No certified manager on duty; supplies missing
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were served; the manager arrived at 12:11 p.m. and a citation was issued. Hand sinks lacked soap and paper towels, though both were supplied during the inspection. A ladle was stored inside a pot of beans.

headline: Dirty coolers; ice in freezer; cluttered corners
summary: Pots and pans accumulated in the rear dish area must be cleaned and sanitized. A reach-in cooler door gasket is in poor repair. Ice has built up in a freezer, and rear prep coolers are dirty. Clutter in corners must be removed to prevent harborage.

headline: Eye-wash on handwashing sink; mold on wall
summary: The rear storage handwashing sink has an eye-wash setup on its faucet; the manager must remove it, keeping the sink for handwashing only. Black mold-like material is on the wall above the three-compartment sink and must be cleaned.

headline: Food handler without hair restraint
summary: A food handler prepared food without a hair restraint. The person in charge was told that all food handlers must wear one.

headline: Failed: clutter; uncorrected backflow and allergen issues
summary: Clutter, including old piping, is in the basement and must be cleaned and organized. From an April 2024 inspection, backflow devices at the ice and espresso machines were not installed, and a sanitation manager lacks allergen training; citation issued.

headline: No certified manager on site during chicken prep
summary: No person in charge was on site during the inspection. No certified food manager was present while chicken was prepared and served; citation issued. A manager arrived at the end. Sink stoppers do not work, and paint and wall base are peeling.

headline: No food handler training; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: Employees have no valid food handler training, and bulk containers in prep and storage areas are unlabeled. Food debris and grease are built up on equipment, shelves and floors. Propane tanks and unused items in storage must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Cardboard in fryers; small water leak
summary: Cardboard was used as a grease catch and to line nonfood-contact surfaces of the deep fryers. The manager must replace it with smooth, cleanable material. A small potable water leak was found at the water filtration system near the mop sink.

headline: Manager handled food with open forearm wounds
summary: A manager handling food and washing dishes had open wounds on his forearm and was restricted until bandaged; bandages were supplied during the inspection. Citation issued. No vomit cleanup procedure or supplies were on site. A cutting board is stained.

headline: Failed: customer handwashing sink intermittently fails
summary: A handwashing sink in one customer toilet room runs only periodically when a hand is waved at the sensor; the manager must ensure steady water flow. Priority citation issued. Heavy rust on deli cooler shelving must be repainted or replaced.

headline: Failed: rat droppings; no training certificates
summary: Ten rat droppings were found on the basement floor under wooden pallets. The manager must remove them by re-inspection and call pest control. No food handler training certificates were on the premises, and a garnish cooler door is loose.

headline: Inspection summary not posted; dish machine dirty
summary: The previous inspection summary was not posted, and an old passing summary was visible instead. A copy of today's summary was given and must be posted publicly; citation issued. The kitchen dish machine and deep fryers need cleaning inside and out.

headline: Open kitchen window; food on floor
summary: A kitchen prep window was open and must be kept closed and tight-fitting to prevent pests. Boxes of frozen pork and raw beef stored on floors must be raised six inches. Torn cooler gaskets and an unworking women's restroom sink were also noted.

headline: Greasy walls; debris and coffee beans on floors
summary: Juice and soda splatter had built up under the cafeteria dispenser and must be cleaned. Grease and splatter are on the wall next to the flat-top, and debris and coffee beans are on floors behind equipment. Floors need cleaning to prevent pests.

headline: Failed: about 15 mouse droppings, flies found
summary: About 10 small flies and 15 mouse droppings were found, mainly in the rear dishwashing area, under the mop sink and in the women's toilet room. Citation issued. A small gap at the front door needs rodent-proofing. One food handler lacked a hair restraint.

headline: Failed: dead rat found; no manager certificate
summary: A large dead rat was found under a cooler behind the cashier. No pest control logbook was available, and no valid city manager certificate was on site; citation issued. No vomit cleanup kit or employee health policy. Several older violations remain uncorrected.

headline: Unlabeled containers; leaking pipe; slime caulking
summary: Plastic food containers in prep and storage lacked labels. A pipe leaks under the three-compartment sink. Black slime-covered caulking behind the sink must be removed. Unnecessary equipment in the basement must be removed and items raised off the ground.

headline: Cold food discarded; sneeze guards needed
summary: TCS foods in a two-door refrigerator were above 41°F, including sliced pork at 46.9°F; about 61 pounds ($250) was discarded; citation issued. Buffet hot-holding units lack sneeze guards. A hand sink below 100°F was serviced on site.

headline: Beard guards and hair restraints needed
summary: Male food handlers with beards lacked beard guards, and a dishwasher's hair was not restrained. Floors throughout have dust and dirt buildup, including behind equipment and under shelving.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; missing handler certificates
summary: Bulk flour and sugar containers lacked common-name labels. Clutter was found behind prep tables and on the basement floor. No food handler certificates were on site. The person in charge was instructed to correct each.

headline: Exposed rodent bait on floor; allergen violation
summary: Exposed toxic bait was scattered across the floor and tracked into prep areas; all bait was removed on site and areas cleaned; citation issued. Torn cooler gaskets were noted. A repeat core violation: no allergen training for certified managers; citation issued.

headline: Bare-hand food contact; hand sink lacked supplies
summary: An employee used bare hands to place avocado on a ready-to-eat torta; citation issued. The bar hand sink had no soap, and two hand sinks lacked paper towels; the manager provided soap and towels on site. Previous core violations were not corrected.

headline: No prep cooler thermometer; summary not posted
summary: A prep cooler at the salad station had no thermometer; one must be provided. The current inspection summary was not posted for public view; the new summary was left and must be posted; citation issued.

headline: Ice machine and gaskets need cleaning; ceiling tiles missing
summary: Refrigerator gaskets and the inside of the ice machine need cleaning. Ceiling tiles are missing in the rear prep area. Floors and drains must be cleaned to avoid pest breeding. Employees must have food handler certificates or citations will follow.

headline: Ice machine dirty; wastewater overflowing
summary: The top of the ice machine is not clean and must be cleaned and sanitized. Wastewater from the three-compartment sink is not draining, and food debris overflows from a floor drain; priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Shellstock tags missing sale date
summary: Shellstock tags were missing the date the last shellfish from the batch would be sold. The manager must add it; priority foundation violation; citation issued.

headline: Missing health policy and vomit cleanup procedure
summary: No signed employee health policies or vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedures and supplies were on site. A hand dryer over the one-compartment sink must be moved. Missing floor tile, standing basement water, and a missing splash guard also need correction.

headline: Rust on cooler wall; greasy hood filters
summary: The back wall inside the walk-in cooler has rust spots and must be repaired to be smooth and cleanable. Hood filters have grease buildup and must be cleaned.

headline: Ice machine buildup; ripped gaskets; expired certificates
summary: Slight buildup was found inside the upper ice machine and must be cleaned. Ripped gaskets on prep-area coolers must be repaired or replaced. Accumulated food debris is inside unused coolers. Some food handler certificates have expired.

headline: Cold food above 41°F discarded; citation issued
summary: About 52 pounds (about $460) of TCS foods held above 41°F in an open cooler were discarded; citation issued. A display cooler read 55.4°F and was adjusted to 40.5°F on site. Gaskets, cutting boards, a door gap, and hood filters need attention.

headline: Wet wiping cloths; scoops stored in food
summary: Wet wiping cloths were on prep surfaces. Scoops were stored inside dry food containers, and plates were not inverted. Hand sinks in prep and bar areas lack waste receptacles. Ceiling exposure and vent dust were also noted.

headline: Door gap not rodent-proof
summary: The northeast double door has a half-inch opening at the bottom. It must be made rodent-proof to prevent pest entry.

headline: Two live roaches; manager eliminated them
summary: Two live cockroaches were found on a cabinet door; the manager eliminated them and cleaned the area on site. No other pest evidence was found. Priority violation; citation issued. Utensils and scoops were stored with handles touching bin contents.

headline: Soap and towels above sink; dusty hood filters
summary: Soap and paper towels were mounted above the three-compartment sink and must be removed. Hood filters are dusty and must be cleaned. Packaged foods in a prep cooler lacked labels; repeat core violation; priority violation.

headline: Unguarded beards; scoops in dry product; repeat violations
summary: Male food handlers with beards lacked beard guards. Scoops were stored inside dry product containers. Several repeat core violations were not corrected, including missing hand-wash signs and unlabeled containers; citation issued.

headline: Dead insects and food debris on equipment
summary: Heavy equipment in the prep area had dried food and dead insects built up inside and out; must be cleaned to prevent pest hiding places. Also missing thermometers in coolers, a broken hot water nozzle, and a dirty walk-in cooler floor.

headline: Dirty coolers and storage shelves
summary: The interior of coolers and storage shelves were not clean, and food debris was noted. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Pink buildup in ice machine; expired certificate
summary: Slight pink buildup was found inside the upper ice machine and must be cleaned. The front door threshold gap must be rodent-proofed. A cold water handle on a prep hand sink is stripped. One food handler certificate has expired.

headline: Active rodent burrows and trash outside
summary: Active rodent burrows were found around the dumpsters and rear area, with excessive trash and grease on the ground; priority foundation violation. The toilet room door lacks a self-closing device, and floors need grouting.

headline: Dirty ice chest and floors need detail cleaning
summary: The outside of the basement ice chest needs detail cleaning to prevent contamination of ice. The basement walk-in floor, the floor under the three-compartment sink, and the food area floor under equipment also need cleaning. Broken light covers must be replaced.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit cleanup plan
summary: No certified food manager was present during TCS food prep; citation issued. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedures or supplies were on site, and no metal-stem thermometer was available; citations issued. Food handler training records and allergen certificates were also missing.

headline: No hand sink in prep; no health policy
summary: No hand-wash sink is in the rear prep and dish area; one must be installed with hot and cold water, soap and towels. No signed employee health policies were found. Food managers lack allergen training, and a walk-in door gasket is worn.

headline: Expired food handler certificate
summary: A food handler on duty had an expired food handler certificate. The manager was instructed to renew it.

headline: Missing hand-wash signs; grease and wall openings
summary: Hand-wash signs were missing at several sinks and must be provided. Grease buildup was found behind cooking equipment, and the Pepsi cold-holding unit was dirty. Damaged wall bases and wall openings must be repaired.

headline: Salmon thawing on prep table; no thermometer
summary: Salmon was thawing on a prep table; the manager was told to thaw it under refrigeration, cold running water, or as part of cooking. A hot-holding unit lacked a working thermometer. Other issues included unlabeled bulk containers and a cracked lid.

headline: Dirty wiping cloths left on prep tables
summary: Dirty wiping cloths were found on prep tables and not stored properly. All cloths must be kept in sanitizing solution when not in use.

headline: No certified manager; no hot water
summary: No certified food manager was present during TCS food prep and service; citation issued. No hot water was available (75 to 92°F); it must be above 110°F at the three-compartment sink and above 100°F at hand sinks; citation issued. A food handler lacked a certificate.

headline: No certified manager; black slime on ice
summary: No certified food manager was on site when TCS foods were handled; citation issued. Ice in the bin was covered in black slime; citation issued. Also uncovered food containers, cardboard liners, a drain leak, uncovered waste receptacles, and a manager without allergen training.

headline: Dirty racks and greasy floors; training proof needed
summary: Utensil storage racks needed cleaning. Floors under the fryers had food, grease and dirt. A food handler lacked proof of food handler training, which must be provided.

headline: No certified manager; dirty restrooms and leaks
summary: No certified food manager was present during TCS food prep; citation issued. Milk crates were used as shelving, and restrooms were excessively dirty. A wall panel was held together with red tape, and a hand sink leaks. Food handlers need allergen certificates.

headline: Hand-wash signs missing; spoons in stagnant water
summary: Hand-wash signs were missing in café restrooms. A food handler with a long beard lacked a beard restraint. Spoons were kept in room-temperature stagnant water. The walk-in freezer has no lights. Each item was flagged for correction.

headline: Inadequate lighting in rear storage area
summary: Lighting in the rear storage area is inadequate. The manager was instructed to provide adequate lighting and maintain it.

headline: Front door gap; several sanitation lapses
summary: A half-inch gap at the front door sweep must be closed to keep pests out. Also found: no hair restraint, wiping cloths on prep tables, missing sink stoppers, freezer ice buildup, foil shelf liners, clutter, and damaged floor tiles and peeling paint.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food handling
summary: No valid certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods (kept hot or cold) were handled, prepared or served; citation issued. The interior of all coolers and freezers must be cleaned to remove spills and debris.

headline: No certified manager; no cold water at sink
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were handled; citation issued. No cold running water reached the three-compartment sink. A men's toilet was not flushing and was repaired on site. Gaps at doors and grease odors were also found.

headline: Foods not date-marked; priority citation issued
summary: Ready-to-eat TCS foods were not date-marked; priority foundation violation; citation issued. Grab-and-go items lacked labels. Wet wiping cloths were on prep surfaces, and a 1/4-inch gap exists at the front door. Damaged ceilings and floors need repair.

headline: Patio door gap; sink stoppers need repair
summary: A small opening at the bottom of the patio door must be rodent-proofed. Sink stoppers for the three-compartment sink cannot hold water. Fryer lower compartments had grease, and an allergen certificate was not on site.

headline: Dirty hood vents
summary: Vents in the hooded system were unclean. The manager was instructed to clean them and maintain them.

headline: No allergen training for manager on duty
summary: The manager on duty had no allergen training. The manager was instructed to obtain it.

headline: Greasy shelves and prep tables; broken tiles
summary: Prep tables and storage shelves throughout were not clean; grease and food debris were noted. Broken floor tiles in the kitchen must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Cooler too warm; TCS foods discarded
summary: Cooked pasta, apple, avocado sauce and aioli were held at 48.4 to 48.5°F in a pasta cooler; about 10 pounds ($100) was discarded; priority violation. The cooler must be repaired. A metal scoop was stored on the ice machine.

headline: Soda crates used for elevation; mop sink clutter
summary: Soda crates were used to elevate stored items; they must stop, and floors must stay accessible. Unnecessary items were stored in the utility mop sink and must be removed.

headline: Greasy kitchen hood filter
summary: The filter above the kitchen cooking equipment has grease and debris and must be cleaned.

headline: Repeat allergen violation; grease in kitchen
summary: Repeat core violation: no allergen training certificate for city food service managers; citation issued. Grease and food debris were found on fryers, ovens and walls. A cooler gasket is torn, and sinks and a backflow device leak. Light shields are broken.

headline: No sanitation manager certificate on premises
summary: The person in charge had no sanitation manager certificate; no city certificate was on premises while TCS foods were handled; citation issued. The sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Clean soda nozzles and floors under bars
summary: Soda gun nozzles at the bars need cleaning. The floor under the bars also needs cleaning.

headline: Excess feces and debris in poultry area
summary: Excessive feces and debris had built up on poultry cages and carts, plus coolers, equipment, sinks and shelving. The floors throughout also have excessive debris and feces and must be cleaned.

headline: Hand sink blocked; priority citation issued
summary: A rear prep hand sink was blocked by garbage, a broom and a dustpan, so it could not be used. Hand sinks must stay accessible at all times; priority foundation violation; citation issued.

headline: No food handler training for employees
summary: No food handler training was on site for employees. Training must be provided and records kept.

headline: Glove misuse; no vomit cleanup supplies
summary: No vomit or diarrhea cleanup supplies were on site; citation issued. Staff used the same gloves from raw eggs and pork to handle ready-to-eat food. A dishwasher washed a container at a hand sink; citation issued. Menu asterisk items cannot be ordered undercooked.

headline: Dust on walk-in cooler fan guards
summary: Dust had built up on the fan guards in the walk-in cooler. The manager was instructed to detail-clean and maintain them.

headline: Leaky pipes and unlabeled bulk containers
summary: Leaky pipes under the mop sink and three-compartment sink must be repaired. Some bulk containers were unlabeled. Floors in the walk-in and prep areas need cleaning, air vents need dust removed, and hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Missing hand-wash sign; rear door gap
summary: No hand-wash sign was near the women's washroom sink. The rear exit door has a gap that must be sealed against pests. Items in the walk-in are on the floor, floor drains are dirty, and food handler training proof was not provided.

headline: Faucet not working; loose sink; no ventilation
summary: A timed faucet in the first washroom is not working; water must run at least 15 seconds. A hand sink in the third washroom is loose, floor drains in prep have debris, and a washroom lacks mechanical ventilation. The manager must correct each.

headline: Artificial nails, jewelry, and rusted racks
summary: Employees had long artificial nails and were not wearing gloves while handling exposed food; citation issued. Unapproved jewelry was worn on hands during food work. Rusted storage racks in coolers must be repaired.

headline: Front doors have a 1/4-inch gap
summary: The front double doors have a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom threshold. The worn weather and rodent-proof strip must be replaced.

headline: Rear door gap and greasy cooking equipment
summary: A half-inch gap at the bottom of the rear door needs a new sweep. Also found: a wiping cloth left on the counter, grocery bags used for food storage in a freezer, greasy fryers and grill, a slow-draining hand sink, and holes in basement ceiling and floor.

headline: About 20 live flying insects; priority citation
summary: About 20 live small flying insects were found on walls and ceilings in the kitchen, dishwashing, bakery and washroom areas; additional pest control is needed; citation issued. A hand sink was blocked by bowls, and no inspection summary was posted; citation issued.

headline: Certified managers lack allergen training proof
summary: No allergen training certificates for certified food managers were on site. The manager was instructed to provide them.

headline: Damaged gasket and rusty can opener
summary: A cold-hold unit used for pancake mix has a damaged gasket. A can opener in the kitchen has heavy grime and rust. The interior of a cold-hold unit needs cleaning. The person in charge was instructed to repair and clean.

headline: No certified manager; hair restraint missing
summary: No certified food manager was on site and no certificate was posted while chicken and sausage were handled. The manager was instructed to obtain one. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint.

headline: Mouse droppings found; pest service needed
summary: About 40 mouse droppings were found in the rear telephone service area and under a hand sink; citation issued. Additional pest control is needed. A sticky fly trap above a hot-holding unit must be removed. A food handler lacked a certificate.

headline: Food handlers lacked hair restraints; core violation
summary: Food handlers were prepping food without hair restraints. Dust was on prep-area ceiling vents. A repeat core violation was found: a hand sink near a prep table lacks a splash guard; citation issued.

headline: Hand sink water too cool; priority violation
summary: Hand sink water in restrooms and the food prep area measured 84.6 to 94.3°F; minimum is 100°F; citation issued. Leaks under sinks, dirty walk-in floors, and debris in storage areas were also noted.

headline: Missing fried-egg advisory; no test strips
summary: The printed menu lacks a consumer advisory for the fried egg item. No chlorine test strips were on site. A utility mop sink is missing. Food in the reach-in cooler was unprotected, and a grease trap has rust.

headline: Dust on walk-in cooler fan covers
summary: Light dust covered the fan covers inside the walk-in cooler. The fans must be cleaned.

headline: Dusty fan guards in walk-in coolers
summary: Dust had built up on the fan guards inside the walk-in coolers. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Mouse and rat droppings found; citation issued
summary: About 100 mouse droppings were found in the kitchen and storage areas, plus 40 rat droppings in the basement; citation issued. Pest control service is required before reinspection. Also one-inch gaps under two entry doors and no employee health policy.

headline: Rat droppings found; rodent bait set improperly
summary: About 90 rat droppings found in prep areas, a hallway, stairs and a crawl space; citation issued. Staff set rodent bait in non-tamper-resistant stations; it must be removed. Also missing hand-washing signs and a dirty ice machine.

headline: Dish machine lacked chlorine; tagged do-not-use
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had zero ppm chlorine. The person in charge stopped use and tagged it do not use before inspection. Must contact CDPH before reuse. Also missing hand-wash signs and employee items stored over clean equipment.

headline: Restroom door not self-closing
summary: The toilet room door next to the kitchen does not self-close. A self-closing device must be installed.

headline: Food handlers lacked hair restraints
summary: Food handlers were prepping food without hair restraints. The person in charge was instructed that all food handlers must wear one.

headline: Two dead roaches found; ice bin not clean
summary: Two dead roaches were found under a booth. Staff must remove dead insects and monitor for new activity. The ice machine bin was not clean and must be cleaned. Dining floors under booths and cluttered storage areas also need attention.

headline: Ice machine exterior soiled; coving damaged
summary: Soiling had built up on the outside of the ice machine, and the manager was instructed to clean it. Base coving in the staff toilet room is missing and damaged; the manager was instructed to repair it.

headline: Water-damaged ceilings; missing backflow device
summary: Stored items must be raised off the floor throughout. A backflow device is missing on the wok line sprayer and utility mop sink. Water-damaged ceiling tiles, duct-taped baseboards, and no allergen proof were noted. Repeat violation: construction debris stored in basement; citation issued.

headline: Bare-hand contact; food stored in mechanical room
summary: A food handler used bare hands to assemble hamburgers for customers; about 5 pounds (about $50) was discarded; citation issued. Dry goods, spices, oil, knives, and equipment were stored in the mechanical room. A ceiling hole and standing water in the basement were noted.

headline: Missing food handler certificate; summary not posted
summary: One food handler lacked a food handler certificate. The previous inspection summary was not posted for public view; today's summary must be displayed at all times; citation issued. Soiled cardboard liners were on the prep floor.

headline: Expired food handler certificates
summary: Food handler certificates had expired. The manager was instructed to update them.

headline: Dried food debris under soda machine shelf
summary: Floors beneath the soda machine shelf in the rear storage area were soiled with dried food debris and other soil. The manager was instructed to clean the floors at adequate frequency.

headline: Ice machine upper section not cleaned
summary: The upper compartment of the ice machine was not cleaned and must be cleaned and sanitized. Serving plates on shelves were not inverted, risking dust. Milk crates used for shelving must be replaced, and a bar sink leaks.

headline: No certified manager; expired certificates
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while sandwiches were prepared; safe-serve certificates were expired; citation issued. No paper towels at the hand sink by the ice machine. A three-compartment sink pipe leaks, and washroom trash cans lack lids.

headline: Unlabeled containers; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Food storage containers lacked common-name labels. Single-use items were stored on the dining floor. Milk crates were used as shelving in prep and storage areas. Grease buildup was found on cooking equipment, walls, and floors.

headline: Ice machine debris; leaks; waste receptacle
summary: Debris was encrusted inside the ice machine and must be detail-cleaned. A splash guard is needed between a hand sink and the slicer. A faucet leaks, a washroom lacks a covered waste receptacle, and an unused display cooler must be removed.

headline: Storage and utensil handling issues noted
summary: A scoop handle was touching food in the flour bin, a mop was stored in water in its bucket, and some food containers lacked labels. Each was flagged for correction. Inspection passed.

headline: Live and dead roaches; ice machine heavily soiled
summary: About 5 live roaches were found in the basement and one in the cookline, plus dead roaches on the second floor; priority violation; citation issued. Ice machine drip plates were heavily soiled with pink and black slime. The three-compartment sink is too small for large pots.

headline: No employee health policy; no toilet partitions
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site; a template was left. Women's toilets had no partitions between them. Certified managers lacked allergen training certificates on site.

headline: Walk-in cooler at 55°F; missing hand-wash sign
summary: A hand-wash sign was missing at an exposed sink in the Ink Bar. An unused walk-in cooler held at 55°F and must be repaired, replaced, or put out of service. An unused high-temperature dish machine must be removed.

headline: Beard restraint missing; containers not inverted
summary: A food handler was not wearing a beard restraint. Food containers were not stored inverted on drying racks. Both must be corrected.

headline: No certified food manager during TCS food prep
summary: No certified food manager was on the premises while eggs, ham and other TCS foods (kept hot or cold) were prepared. A certified manager must be present. Dust was also found on prep-area ceiling tiles and vent covers.

headline: Wiping cloths and grease trap need attention
summary: Wiping cloths in all prep areas must be held in sanitizing solution between uses. Ice buildup on condenser pipes in the basement walk-in was repaired on request. Three-compartment sink drain stoppers do not work, and the grease trap is greasy and rusty.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No person in charge was present. No certified food manager (CFM) was on site while TCS foods (kept hot or cold) were handled; citation issued. Food and sauces were stored on the floor, knives were stored in crevices, and a hand sink leaks.

headline: Black mold-like buildup inside ice machine
summary: Ice machine interior had excessive black mold-like buildup; all ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned. Also paletas lacked a common name and ingredient list, onions were on the walk-in floor, clay cups need lead-safety proof, and a grill lacked ventilation.

headline: No hot water at butcher hand sink; citation issued
summary: The butcher-area hand sink lacked hot running water; priority violation; citation issued. Wood prep tables are damaged and unsealed, and leaking pipes need repair. Repeat core violations included food stored on the walk-in floor.

headline: Mouse droppings, dead mice, and maggots found
summary: About 125 or more mouse droppings were found on sales-floor shelves and storage areas, plus two dead mice, live flies, and a bucket of maggots. Pest control and cleaning are required; citation issued. Doors have gaps, and food was stored on the walk-in floor.

headline: Missing sink stoppers at both bars
summary: The three-compartment sinks at both bars need sink stoppers. Stoppers must be provided.

headline: Missing training proof; pest log gaps
summary: The person in charge lacked food safety training proof, and no city sanitation certificate was posted; citation issued. No food handler or allergen training records were on site. The pest logbook lacked 2025 and 2021 service reports; citation issued.

headline: Expired allergen training certificate for food managers
summary: An expired allergen training certificate was found. Current certificates must be provided for all City of Chicago certified food managers. Passed re-inspection.

headline: Cooler at 60°F; no health policy or cleanup kit
summary: The two-door cold holding unit ran at 60°F, too warm; repair or replace it. The facility also lacked an employee health policy, a vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit, a probe thermometer, and a sanitizer test kit. Handsinks lack signage.

headline: Broken restroom sink; gap at door; no dumpster contract
summary: The restroom washbowl sink was inoperable and must have hot and cold running water; priority violation. The rear door has a 1/4-inch gap. No dumpster or signed contract was on site. Restroom ventilation and light were not working.

headline: Food handlers lack certificates; manager lacks allergen proof
summary: Food handlers had no food handler certificates, and the certified food manager lacked an allergen certificate. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer, oversized pots did not fit the sink or dish machine, and mops were not hung to dry.

headline: Fly in bakery cabinet; no valid food handler certificates
summary: A fly was inside a bakery cabinet on two trays; about 8 pounds were discarded (about $50); citation issued. No valid City food sanitation certificates were shown for employees; citation issued. No metal stem thermometer was on site.

headline: Broken floor tiles; manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: Broken floor tiles in front of the stand-up cooler must be repaired to a smooth, easily cleanable surface. The certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate; training must be completed and the certificate kept on site.

headline: Short handwash time; unlabeled rice; door gap
summary: The men's restroom handsink did not run for the required 20 seconds; the employee was told to correct it. Rice storage container was unlabeled. The rear exit door has a 1/2-inch gap that must be sealed; door sweeps were recommended.

headline: Slow restroom sink drain; holes in wall
summary: The handwash sink in the north toilet room drains slowly and must be repaired. Small holes in the wall above the three-compartment sink must be sealed and maintained. Passed.

headline: Missing handwash signs on 18th-floor restrooms
summary: Handwash signage was missing in the 18th-floor men's and women's restrooms. The operator must provide and maintain signs. Passed.

headline: About 30 fruit flies in basement storage
summary: About 30 fruit flies were found in basement dry storage; citation issued. The operator must get rid of the flies and notify the pest control operator. Bulk foods were unlabeled and basement floors were not clean.

headline: No working metal thermometer; grime on walls
summary: No working metal stem thermometer was on site for food temperatures; citation issued. Food residue and spillage were on large equipment, and food debris and grime on prep and dish area walls. Damaged floor tile in the prep area and restroom.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; no backflow devices
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving in prep and storage; they must be replaced with shelving six inches off the floor. Backflow devices were missing at the ice and coffee drip machines; a prior core violation was not corrected. Citation issued.

headline: Greasy fryers, coolers, and floors need cleaning
summary: Fryer exteriors and cooking counters need detail cleaning. Coolers need interior cleaning, and reach-in freezers need defrosting. Floors along walls and corners and walls behind prep areas need cleaning to remove grease and splatter.

headline: Dish machine not reaching sanitizing temperature
summary: The conveyor dish machine's final rinse reached only 144.2°F; the machine was tagged, and this is a priority violation. Prepackaged salads and desserts lack labels with facility name, product, and ingredients. The floor drain under the dish machine was very unclean.

headline: Goat held too warm; no soap at rear handsink
summary: Cooked goat was stored and displayed at 73.1°F; about 20 pounds were discarded (about $50); citation issued. The rear handsink had no soap; citation issued. Bulk containers were unlabeled and uncovered, and food spills and debris were on cooking equipment.

headline: Over 30 live flies; fly strips over prep areas
summary: Over 30 live small and large flies were on walls, shelves, and storage containers; citation issued. Fly strips hanging over food prep areas must be replaced with approved insect control devices. A hand dryer above the utility sink must be removed. Sink stoppers are missing.

headline: Salmon thawed in sink water; hair restraints missing
summary: Wrapped salmon was thawing in a bucket of water in the three-compartment sink; it must thaw under refrigeration, a microwave, or cold running water. Food prep employees lacked hair restraints. Gaskets, cutting boards, and fryers need repair and cleaning.

headline: Prior core violation uncorrected; ice and clutter
summary: A core violation from a 2023 inspection was not corrected; citation issued. Frost and ice were near walk-in cooler and freezer fans. Coffee machines lack backflow devices, and nonfunctional equipment and clutter must be removed.

headline: No certified manager; food held too warm; no pest log
summary: No certified food manager was on premises while TCS foods were handled; citation issued. Eggs at 58.6°F, dressings, cheese, and lettuce were held too warm; about 24 pounds were discarded; citation issued. No pest control log or proof of service was found.

headline: Dead insects and food debris in rear prep
summary: Dead insects were on the floor of the utility room next to the toilet rooms; they must be removed, cleaned, and sanitized. Food debris on the rear prep floor under tables and behind cooling units must be removed and cleaned. Passed.

headline: Prep cooler too warm; scratched cutting boards
summary: Cheese sauce, chicken, tomatoes, and pastry in the prep-line cooler measured 48–52°F; about 15 pounds were discarded (about $50); citation issued. Cutting boards are severely scratched and must be resurfaced or replaced. Equipment too large for the sink.

headline: Damaged laminate flooring in prep areas
summary: Damaged laminate flooring in prep areas must be repaired to a smooth, easily cleanable surface and kept that way at all times. Passed.

headline: Raw wood shelves; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Raw wood shelves in the rear prep area must be sealed or painted. Milk crates used as shelving must be removed and replaced with shelves six inches off the floor. A covered receptacle is needed, and dry storage floor tiles need repair.

headline: Slow drain at dishwashing handsink
summary: The handwash sink in the dishwashing area drains slowly. The operator must repair and maintain it.

headline: No backflow device on ice machine; damaged coving
summary: No visible backflow prevention device was on the ice machine water line; one must be installed and maintained. Coving behind cooking equipment and the three-compartment sink is in disrepair. An old stove and unused items must be removed, and hood filters are missing.

headline: Food truck lacks vomit cleanup supplies, sinks fail
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies were on the truck. The hand sink was unusable from a broken water pipe, had no soap, and the three-compartment sink pipe broke. No metal thermometer, test kit, or hot water verified.

headline: Gaps at entrance doors; utensils stored unsafely
summary: Openings at the base of the front entrance and east patio doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Knives, forks, and spoons were stored lying down in bins; they must be stored handles up or covered. Passed re-inspection.

headline: Rusted storage racks in reach-in cooler
summary: Storage racks in the prep-area reach-in cooler were rusted. The person in charge must remove the rust and keep nonfood-contact surfaces smooth and cleanable. Passed.

headline: About 25 rodent droppings in rear storage
summary: About 25 rodent droppings were found in the rear storage area; rodents must be eliminated, areas cleaned and sanitized, and pest control contacted; priority violation. No written vomit and diarrhea procedure or supplies were on site.

headline: Raw wood shelves; rear yard clutter; allergen gap
summary: Raw wood shelves behind the front counter must be painted or sealed. Unnecessary items and construction materials in the rear yard must be removed to prevent pest harborage. The certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: Grease buildup on fryers and cooking equipment
summary: Grease had built up on the fry cutter, fryer cabinets, flat-top grill, and behind cooking equipment; it must be cleaned. The drain under the three-compartment sink had debris and grease, and walls and piping near the hood need cleaning.

headline: Dusty hood filters need cleaning
summary: Dusty filters on the ventilation hood must be cleaned and kept clean. Passed re-inspection.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; insect devices above prep
summary: Bulk dry ingredient containers were unlabeled and must be labeled with common names. Two electric insect control devices were on walls above food prep tables and must be moved. The ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine.

headline: Rodenticide scattered; food held too warm; no manager
summary: About 18 or more rodenticide packets were scattered on floors throughout the premises; citation issued. Dead water bugs were on floors in the basement and walk-in cooler. Milk, cream, and raw chicken held at 45–47°F were discarded (about $578).

headline: Employee skipped handwashing; sink lacked hot water
summary: An employee handled dirty dishes, then clean dishes, without washing hands; the manager corrected it on site, and a citation was issued. The handwash sink had no hot water until the employee turned on a valve. Household insecticide was stored near food.

headline: No inspection summary posted; grocery bags in freezer
summary: No inspection summary was posted for the public; citation issued. Grocery bags were used for food storage in the kitchen freezer and must be replaced with food-grade bags. Ice machine interior has build-up; floors need detail cleaning.

headline: Walk-in gasket gap; soiled shelves and floors
summary: The walk-in cooler gasket had a 4-inch gap at the bottom; it must be replaced. Shelving in both walk-in coolers and the prep area had soil buildup. Floors and walls throughout the facility were soiled and must be cleaned.

headline: Basement food containers need common-name labels
summary: Food storage containers in the basement dry storage room must be labeled with the common name of the food item. Passed.

headline: Beef, ham, cheese held too warm; dead insects
summary: Beef, ham, cheese, and deli meat in the front cook-line reach-in measured 49.8–52.4°F; all TCS items were discarded (about 5 pounds, $30); citation issued. Five dead insects were next to pest traps by the prep tables. Mops were stored in a bucket.

headline: No backflow device on rear utility sink
summary: The utility sink in the rear prep area has no backflow preventer device. The operator must install one so it can be located, serviced, and maintained. Passed.

headline: Beer on dishwashing floor; no allergen certificate
summary: Cases of beer were stacked on the floor in the dishwashing area and must be raised six inches. Grocery bags were used for freezer food, plates were not inverted, and a mop was stored in a bucket. The certified manager on duty lacked an allergen certificate.

headline: No certified manager while eggs prepared; allergen gap
summary: No certified manager was on site while eggs were prepared; citation issued. A repeat core violation was not corrected: certified managers lacked allergen training certificates. The summary report was not posted; a new one was left and citation issued.

headline: Food handler lacks training proof; storage clutter
summary: A food handler had no proof of training, and must complete an approved program. Floors along walls and behind the reach-in cooler and chest freezer need cleaning. Unnecessary articles must be removed from rear storage, and items raised six inches.

headline: No health policy; food on freezer floor
summary: No written employee health policy was on premises; priority violation. Boxes of food were stored on the walk-in freezer floor and must be raised six inches. Cardboard lining shelves under flour bags must be replaced.

headline: Rodent infestation; droppings found throughout
summary: About 18 rodent droppings were in the first-floor prep, dining room, basement dry storage, and ventilation ducts; citation issued. Droppings must be removed and sanitized, and rat pest control service is required. Prior violations were not corrected.

headline: Food debris on coolers, prep tables, and floors
summary: Food debris was on the interior and exterior of coolers, prep tables, and sinks. Floors under equipment, along walls, and in corners of the prep area had debris. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Dead roaches on floors; meat thawed in sink water
summary: Dead roaches were on the floor by cooking equipment in the rear prep area and in the first-floor women's restroom; they must be removed. Meat was thawing in standing water in the three-compartment sink, which is not allowed.

headline: No valid person in charge; candy stored on floor
summary: No person in charge held a valid Chicago food sanitation certificate; citation issued. A food handler lacked a hair restraint, wiping cloths were stored on sinks, and no sanitizer test kit was available. Candy and disposables were on the floor.

headline: No certified manager while chicken served
summary: No city-certified food service sanitation manager or valid certificate was on site while time/temperature control foods, including chicken, were prepared and served to the public; citation issued. A valid certificate must be on site whenever those foods are served.

headline: Stained ceiling tiles and a burned-out light bulb
summary: Stained ceiling tiles were in the front lobby and rear closet, and the front lobby light bulb was out. Tiles must be replaced and the bulb replaced. Passed.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: All food handlers had expired certificates, and certified managers' allergen training certificates were expired. Valid certificates must be provided. Rust was inside the ice machine and on shelves above the dish sink, and rear prep dust and grease need cleaning.

headline: Employee touched clean dishes without washing hands
summary: An employee loaded dirty dishes without gloves, then handled clean dishes without washing hands or gloves; citation issued. A basement handwash sink was blocked by buckets and milk crates; citation issued. Leaks and missing thermometers noted.

headline: Damaged thermometer; plastic cup used for ingredients
summary: The ambient air thermometer inside the walk-in cooler was damaged and must be replaced. A plastic cup was used to transfer dry ingredients in the rear prep area; handled utensils must be used. Cooking tongs were stored on the sprinkler system above the fryers.

headline: Cold foods too warm; discarded; no hand towels
summary: Cold TCS foods held at 49–72°F were discarded (about $85); cold holding must be 41°F or below, and a citation was issued. A handsink had no hand drying supplies. A cook lacked a beard guard. Ceilings and drains need repair.

headline: No hair restraints; floors under equipment dirty
summary: Employees preparing food had no hair restraints or protection; restraints must be worn at all times. Floors along wall bases and under equipment, including under the ice cream machine and at the floor drain, need cleaning.

headline: No soap or paper towels at handsink; restraints missing
summary: The rear prep handsink had no soap; management provided soap on site; citation issued. No paper towels were at the same sink and were provided on site. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, and the 3-compartment sink faucet leaked. Prior violations not corrected.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; rust on coolers
summary: Food handler certificates were expired, and the certified manager had no allergen certificate on site. Cardboard was under tables, cork board was on dough room shelving, and rust was inside bar beer glass coolers. All must be removed or replaced.

headline: No bodily fluid cleanup kit; coffee machine lacks backflow
summary: No bodily fluid cleanup kit was on site; one must be provided; priority foundation violation. No backflow prevention device was found on the coffee machine's water intake line.

headline: Unsafe glove use; hot water too cold at handsink
summary: A food handler repeatedly broke hygiene rules, touching a register and handling bagels, bacon, and a sandwich without washing hands or changing gloves; citation issued. The rear handsink measured 73.4°F and must reach 100°F. Health policies were missing.

headline: Blocked, cold handwash sink; exposed smoked salmon
summary: Rolling carts blocked a handwash sink; the manager moved them on site, and a citation was issued. That sink measured 80°F and must reach 100°F. Smoked salmon on display was unprotected; the manager removed it. Floors heavily soiled.

headline: Peeling paint, damaged tiles, missing light shield
summary: Peeling paint and openings were in the ceiling above hot water tanks in dry storage, and peeling paint was in prep and storage areas. Damaged floor tiles were in prep. A light shield was missing inside the serving-area walk-in cooler.

headline: Grease, debris, and missing allergen training
summary: Storage containers were unlabeled. Grease and food debris were on fryers, coolers, shelves, and floors, and debris was around the dumpster. No allergen training was on site, and managers must complete it and keep records.

headline: No health policy, cleanup procedure, or handwash soap
summary: No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure with spill kit was on premises. Handwash signs and soap were missing at prep sinks. No consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods was in the take-out menu, and no mop sink vacuum breaker.

headline: Coffee poured over handwash sink; dirty ice bin
summary: A food handler topped off coffee over a handwash sink, dripping coffee into it; citation issued. The ice bin had black dirt and scum over ice; citation issued. Certified manager on duty had no allergen training proof.

headline: No covered receptacle for sanitary napkins
summary: No covered waste receptacle was in the all-gender washroom dry storage area or the first-floor women's washroom. The operator must provide covered receptacles.

headline: Boxed food on floor; expired allergen certificate
summary: Boxed food was stored on the floor in the rear bakery prep area, and floors had food debris. One certified manager had an expired allergen certificate. A prior sink violation for food prep at the front coffee area was not corrected.

headline: No written employee health policy on site
summary: No written employee health policy was on site for all employees. The operator must provide one; priority foundation violation.

headline: Raw eggs stored above ready-to-eat cakes
summary: Raw eggs were stored above two ready-to-eat cakes in the basement cooler, and one cake had unknown particles on top. Management removed the eggs on site; citation issued. Cardboard, a leaking condenser pipe, and debris on floors were also noted.

headline: No health policy, pest service, or refrigeration on
summary: No employee health policy was on site. Refrigeration must be on for testing, including one reach-in and the produce cooler. No current pest control service was on record; service must be scheduled and the logbook updated. Floors under displays need cleaning.

headline: Flies and rat droppings; outdoor cooking
summary: About 20 small flies and 10 large flies were in the prep area, and 10 rat droppings were in an outside shed. All flies and droppings must be removed before re-inspection, and pest control is advised. Outdoor cooking equipment must be removed.

headline: Cook-chill process used without required variance
summary: Soups and sauces were prepared with a cook-chill method without a Chicago Department of Public Health variance; product was tagged and held. The process must stop until a variance is obtained; citation issued. A torn cooler gasket and ice in the freezer need correction.

headline: No employee health policy or allergen certificates
summary: No employee health policy was on the premises; one must be provided. No allergen training certificates were on premises for City of Chicago sanitation managers. Conditions apply.

headline: Missing thermometer in rear cooler
summary: The rear cooler has no thermometer. The operator must provide and maintain one.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; leaking pipe
summary: All food handler training certificates were expired and must be replaced. A pipe leaks under the bar-area prep sink. A splashguard is missing between the handwash and prep sink. A large section of floor tile is missing in the meat and deli area.

headline: No health policy; pest control logbook missing
summary: No written employee health policy was on premises. The person in charge could not provide a pest control logbook for the licensed pest control company; a complete logbook must be provided for review. Handwash signs were missing.

headline: Fish balls and dumplings stored in wrong containers
summary: Fish balls were stored in cardboard boxes in the cooler, and dumplings were in a plastic grocery bag in the freezer. Only food-grade bags and containers may be used. Debris, dirt, and dust on floors need detail cleaning.

headline: Rusty shelves; dirt on walls and floors
summary: Rusty storage shelves were in the rear walk-in cooler; the person in charge must remove the rust and keep surfaces smooth and cleanable. Dirt built up along walls and floors throughout the prep areas and must be detail cleaned.

headline: Wastewater backups, unlabeled foods, missing certificates
summary: Wastewater backed up onto the floor from a utility sink; citation issued. Self-serve foods in a dining-area cooler were unlabeled. No food handler or allergen certificates were shown.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods served
summary: No person in charge had verifiable food service manager training, and no valid certified manager was present while TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. Egg rolls were uncovered, and prior violations were not corrected.

headline: Single-use items stored under greywater pipe
summary: Wrapped cups, lids, and meal boxes were stored under a greywater pipe with no overhead protection and must be relocated. Floors under walk-in cooler shelving were soiled with dried food debris and liquid spills and must be cleaned.

headline: Mold-like buildup in ice machine and prep wall
summary: A mold-like substance was inside the ice machine (not for consumption); the person in charge was instructed to clean it. Rust and mold-like substance were on the wall over the three-compartment sink and handsink. Repair and maintain.

headline: No certified manager; rodent droppings found
summary: No certified manager was on site while deli meat was served. About 20 rodent droppings were found in the chip rack and rear storage. Missing: food-prep handwash sink, three-compartment sink, health policy, and food handler certificates.

headline: Overflowing dumpster; uncorrected prior violations
summary: The outside dumpster was overflowing with trash bags, and lids were open; citation issued. Wiping cloths were not in sanitizer, and squeeze bottles and shakers were unlabeled. Prior violations were not corrected, including missing allergen training for the food manager.

headline: Staff drinks near food; hair restraints; allergen gap
summary: Open staff drinks were on food container shelves. Food handlers lacked effective hair restraints, and no allergen training certificate was shown for food service managers. Staff were instructed to correct each issue.

headline: Live flies, missing raw food advisory, pesticide traps
summary: About 20 live small flies were on walls and ceiling of the food prep area; citation issued. Fly traps containing pesticides behind the bar were removed on site, and citation issued. No raw or undercooked food advisory was on the menu, and handwash signs were missing.

headline: Sink backs up wastewater; citation issued
summary: The three-compartment sink backed up wastewater into its compartments when drained; citation issued. Also grime on rear prep floor and a blown-out light in the hood.

headline: Grease in fryers; missing ceiling tiles; unused racks
summary: Grease had built up inside the deep fryers, debris was on top of the dish machine, and fan covers in customer-area coolers were dusty. Several ceiling tiles were missing in food prep areas. Unused metal racks must be removed from the stairwell.

headline: Dirty handsink with mold; clutter and dim cooler light
summary: Mixing bowls must be stored inverted. The kitchen entrance handsink was dirty with black mold, and the wall under the women's hand dryer was dirty. Unused equipment must be removed to prevent pest harborage. The walk-in cooler needs brighter light.

headline: No hot water in restroom; cold food too warm
summary: Employee restroom had no running hot water (71.8°F; must be 100°F); priority violation. Cheese, raw chicken, beef, and mayonnaise held at 48–55.1°F in two coolers; about 10 pounds discarded ($150). Coolers must be repaired and the door fitted with a self-closing device.

headline: No proof of food handler or allergen training
summary: No proof of food handler training was shown for all food handlers, and no proof of allergen training was shown for certified managers. Records must be provided and kept on site at all times. Passed re-inspection.

headline: Handwash sink blocked by boxes; citation issued
summary: The handwash sink at the front prep and service desk was blocked by boxes and a squeegee; citation issued, and it must stay accessible. The hot holding unit had no ambient air thermometer, and a light under the hood was blown out.

headline: Soup held over 24 hours lacked date labels
summary: House-made soup held over 24 hours lacked a date marking system; it was labeled during inspection with a use-by date no more than 7 days out; priority foundation violation. No allergen training was shown for certified food managers.

headline: No pest control logbook; ice machine lacks backflow
summary: No licensed pest control logbook was on the premises; priority foundation violation. No backflow device was located at the ice machine. The ice bin behind the bar needs a tight-fitting lid, and washroom doors need self-closing devices.

headline: Faucet and restroom fixtures need repair, cleaning
summary: Faucet at the three-compartment sink is in poor repair, and men's restroom fixtures were dirty. Both must be repaired and cleaned and kept that way. Passed.

headline: Food manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: One food manager did not have a food allergen training certificate. All City of Chicago certified food managers must have one. Passed.

headline: Black residue on caulking at sink
summary: Excessive black substance was on the caulking at the top base of the three-compartment sink. The substance must be removed and the caulking maintained.

headline: Gap at rear door; food stored on floor
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door must be sealed to keep pests out. Food containers on the walk-in cooler floor must be raised six inches. Ice bin, cooler gasket, and sink stoppers need attention. No allergen proof for managers.

headline: Food on floor; cardboard matting; soiled mop heads
summary: Food stored on the walk-in cooler floor must be raised six inches. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables and milk crates were used as shelving. Cardboard was used as floor mats, and soiled mop heads must be hung to prevent insect breeding.
