summary: Passed. Grease built up inside the fryer cabinet and on cooking equipment. Food and grease splatter covered prep and dish area walls, and debris was on floors. Dust sat on the bar vent, and filters above fryers had grease.

headline: Front door gap; grease and leaking faucets
summary: Passed. An opening at the base of the front entrance door must be sealed to keep pests out. Containers sit on milk crates near the cookline, and a chest freezer gasket is damaged. Heavy grease is on cooking equipment, and both 3-compartment faucets leak.

headline: Grimy handwash sinks; door gap; debris
summary: Passed. Handwash sinks had food and grime buildup and must be cleaned. A 1/4 inch gap at the front double doors must be closed to keep out pests. Prep and storage floors also need cleaning.

headline: Wiping cloths and utensils stored improperly
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were left on the counter instead of in sanitizing solution. Multi-use utensils sat in room-temperature standing water instead of hot water at least 135F. Dispensing scoops had debris on their handles.

headline: Pooled chicken blood in cooler; burned-out bulbs
summary: Passed. Pooled chicken blood and water on the walk-in cooler floor must be removed. Soiled wiping cloths were left on prep tables and must be kept in sanitizer. Dried food splatter, burned-out bulbs and missing allergen training proof were also noted.

headline: Dusty floor under prep cooler
summary: Passed. The floor under the prep and display cooler had excessive dust and debris. Staff were instructed to detail clean and maintain it.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on duty while rice and chicken soups were prepared and served, a priority violation with citation. The person in charge must hold a certificate by next inspection. Kitchen faucet and pipe leak; handwash sinks have low pressure.

headline: Cold food above safe temperature; 110 lbs discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Several cold foods were above the 41F limit, including beef, shredded lettuce, onions and chicken. Manager voluntarily discarded 110 lbs ($670). Mops were stored on the floor in dirty water. No certified manager has allergen training.

headline: Leaking drain; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. A drainpipe leaks at the 3-compartment sink and needs repair. The certified food manager has no allergen training; documentation must be provided.

headline: Outdoor bins and trash area need cleaning
summary: Passed. Soiled towels and aprons stored in bins outside the rear exit must be moved to prevent pest harborage. Outdoor receptacle area had trash, cardboard and dirt. Floors under and behind heavy equipment need detail cleaning.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; no certified manager
summary: Failed. Self-serve ice machine had black slime on ice-contact surfaces and the exterior; the ice is for human consumption, a priority citation. No certified manager was on site during TCS food prep. Paper towels were missing at a hand sink and corrected on site.

headline: Wiping cloths on tables; grease and dust
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables and must be kept in sanitizing solution when not in use. Dust covers washroom vents, dirt sits under cooking equipment, and hood filters have heavy grease.

headline: Food on freezer floor; water too cool for knife
summary: Passed. Food was stored on the walk-in freezer floor. Coolers in the basement sit under waste water lines and must be moved. A knife was kept in 111.2F water; minimum is 135F. A food handler lacked a hair restraint.

headline: Grease and debris in fryers, floors, vents
summary: Passed. Fryer interiors and prep cooler gaskets had food debris and grease. Floors and walls around equipment had dust and food buildup. Grease had accumulated on the ventilation above the griddle. Manager was told to clean.

headline: Rear door gap; beard restraints needed
summary: Passed. Rear door has about a 1/4 inch gap at the bottom and side and must be repaired. Food handlers with beards lacked restraints. The 3-compartment sink needs stoppers. Customer restroom is missing ceiling tiles.

headline: Hair restraints missing; several repairs needed
summary: Passed. All food handlers need effective hair restraints. Pest glue boards were damaged and must be replaced. Both 3-compartment sink faucets leak. Display case needs detail cleaning, and the hood vent needs repair.

headline: Menu lacks raw-food warning; cluttered storage
summary: Failed. The digital menu lacked the required asterisk or reminder for cooked-to-order burgers, a priority violation without citation. The southeast dry storage closet was cluttered; items must be removed and kept at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Food on floor; handwash sink needs splash guard
summary: Passed. A food container was on the floor under a prep table. A handwash sink near a prep table lacks a splash guard. Shelving under prep tables, the stove openings, and floors under cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Undisclosed raw burgers; duct-taped cooler handle
summary: Failed. The menu did not disclose raw or undercooked burgers and egg toppings, a priority violation. A walk-in cooler door handle is missing and was repaired with duct tape. Food handlers must show current certificates. Repeat spray foam violation.

headline: Excess pesticide; no hot water; failed
summary: Failed. Excessive white pesticide was spread across floors, walls and equipment in prep and storage areas; it must be removed (priority citation). Hand sinks had no hot water, restored at 11:15 AM during inspection. Door gaps and missing health policies were also cited.

headline: Over 80 mouse droppings found; failed
summary: Failed. Inspector counted over 80 mouse droppings across floors, shelves, prep coolers, outlets and equipment, plus several flying insects in the prep area. A prior pest violation was not corrected. Manager must call an exterminator and clean all areas.

headline: Dairy held too warm; 55 lbs discarded on site
summary: Passed with conditions. Yogurt, whipping cream and Lactaid milk were held between 45.5F and 55.9F, above the 41F limit. Manager discarded 55 lbs ($98) on site. A rear cold unit at 47.3F was tagged. Self-service parfaits lacked labels.

headline: Ice buildup in cooler; allergen training missing
summary: Passed. Heavy ice buildup inside the walk-in cooler must be corrected. The hot water knob on a rear handwash sink is hard to turn. One of two certified managers lacks allergen training.

headline: Rear door gap; broken floor panels
summary: Passed. The rear exit door has a 1/4 inch gap at the northeast corner and is not rodent-proof; it must be sealed. Broken floor panels in the rear office need repair. Allergen training proof for certified managers must be kept on site.

headline: Unsanitized utensils and out-of-service sink
summary: Failed. Main prep handwash sink was out of service. Utensils were rinsed without sanitizing (0.0 ppm), a priority citation. Employees lacked food handler training and the summary report was not posted. Wrong test kit was used.

headline: No certified manager on duty during food service
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge held a valid certificate, and no certified manager was on duty while chicken, hamburgers and fries were served; a priority citation. Ice bin needs cleaning, the rear walk-in is cluttered, and the manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Garbage spillage at dumpster; unlabeled pecans
summary: Failed. The outside dumpster area had garbage spillage and was not clean. This is a priority citation, and the area must be cleaned and maintained. A bulk pecan container lacked a label.

headline: No vomit policy; missing thermometers
summary: Passed with conditions. No written procedure for vomit and diarrhea clean-up was on premises, a priority violation without citation. Cold holding equipment lacks thermometers. Multiple collapsed ceiling panels in the rear need repair.

headline: Two live roaches found; failed inspection
summary: Failed. Inspector found 2 live cockroaches on the rear hallway wall, a priority citation. The operator must contact pest control and get rid of the roaches. The certified manager has no allergen training certificate.

headline: Dishwasher not sanitizing; tagged out of use
summary: Passed with conditions. The chlorine dishwasher showed 0 ppm after several tries, so it was tagged out and must not be used until repaired and cleared by the Chicago Department of Public Health (CDPH). Bulk containers are unlabeled. Torn gasket and water-damaged ceiling tiles need repair.

headline: No backsplash; floor damage; allergen training
summary: Passed. A backsplash is missing behind the dish area and food prep tables and must be installed. Rear storage and restroom floors have missing tiles. The food service manager has no allergy training certificate.

headline: No certified manager on site during food prep
summary: Passed with conditions. The person in charge lacked an original food service manager certificate on site while handling TCS foods, a priority citation. A certificate was posted in the office, but the certified manager was not on premises. Thermometers are needed in coolers and hot-hold units.

headline: Rust on shelving; washroom ventilation not working
summary: Passed. Rust on green shelving in two walk-in coolers must be removed. A hole in the ceiling above the 3-compartment sink needs smooth repair. Mechanical ventilation is not working in the men's, women's and employee washrooms. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No health policies; no allergen training
summary: Passed with conditions. No signed employee health policies were on site, a priority violation with citation. A prep table needs a barrier by the mop sink. Shelves have cardboard. Food manager lacks allergen training. Kids' chocolate milk is 140 calories; limit is 130.

headline: About 60 rodent droppings found; failed
summary: Failed. About 60 small rodent droppings were on floors in the office, storage, prep and furnace areas. Priority citation issued, and pest activity must be eliminated. The rear exit door is not rodent-proof, and cooler thermometers were missing.

headline: No certified manager or health policy on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No person with an original City food sanitation certificate was posted on site, and no employee health policy was present. Both are priority violations with citations. Ice machine had pink mineral buildup, and no allergen training certificates were on site.

headline: Clutter, grease, and torn freezer gasket
summary: Passed. Heavy clutter in the basement and dry storage could hide pests and must be removed. Hood, filters and pipes had heavy grease. A walk-in freezer gasket is torn. Serving plates and bowls must be stored upside down.

headline: Cardboard liners and washroom repairs needed
summary: Passed. Cardboard used as a liner on prep equipment and tables must be removed. Washroom has peeling paint near the door and missing ceiling tiles. Blown light bulbs in the ventilation system need replacing.

headline: Walk-in cooler mold and rust; weak hot water
summary: Failed. Walk-in cooler storage racks had food debris, mold and rust. The 3-compartment sink had only a trickle of hot water, not enough for peak demand. This priority violation was cited and repairs are required.

headline: About 15 live flying insects; failed
summary: Failed. About 15 live small flying insects were seen on walls, cupboards and stock boxes in food prep areas. This is a priority citation, and more pest control service is needed. No vomit or diarrhea clean-up supplies were on site.

headline: Handleless bowl used for scooping food
summary: Passed. A bowl without a handle was used to scoop food at the service prep coolers. Staff must use tongs, serving spoons or a ladle. Serving plates on buffet shelves must be stored upside down to prevent dust.

headline: No food handler training proof; upkeep issues
summary: Passed. Proof of food handler training is needed for required employees. Bulk flour container is unlabeled. Milk crates are used for storage, plastic is peeling from metal surfaces, and the floor drain under the 3-compartment sink is dirty.

headline: Chicken held at 58-60F; 35 lbs discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. The front prep cold unit held 35 lbs of chicken breast at 58-60F, above the 41F limit. Manager discarded all 35 lbs ($150), a priority citation. Grease and debris are on equipment and floors; soiled mop heads must be hung to dry.

headline: Mold-like buildup in ice machine; failed
summary: Failed. A mold-like substance inside the ice machine was dripping onto ice used for people to consume. Priority citation issued. Person in charge must discard all ice, sanitize the machine, and keep it clean.

headline: Beard restraint, wiping cloths, leaks noted
summary: Passed. An employee with a beard lacked a restraint. Wiping cloths must be kept in sanitizer between uses. The 3-compartment sink sprayer leaks, and water pools under a handwash sink. Additional allergen training certificates are needed.

headline: No handwash sink at dish area; 90-day grace
summary: Passed. No handwash sink was at the 3-compartment sink area; one with hot and cold water, soap, paper towels and signage must be installed within a 90-day grace period. Basement outside door needs a rodent-proof strip. Coolers, cooking equipment and restrooms need cleaning.

headline: No health policy or cleanup supplies; failed
summary: Failed. No employee health policy and no vomit or diarrhea clean-up supplies were on site, both priority violations. A chemical bottle was unlabeled. No thermometer or sanitizer test strips were present. Chipped clay pot and fryer grease also noted.

headline: No employee health policy; food handler training
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy was on premises, a priority violation. All food handlers must obtain required training. The 3-compartment sink lacks drain stoppers, the washroom door is not self-closing, and wall coving is missing.

headline: No health policy, food handler cards, allergen training
summary: Passed with conditions. No verifiable employee health policy was on site, and no food handler cards were available. Packaged cannoli and cheesecake sold to go lacked labels. Two hood lights are burned out and a cutting board is stained.

headline: Mouse droppings and live roaches found; failed
summary: Failed. About 30 mouse droppings were behind a freezer in dry storage, and 3 live cockroaches were by the grease trap under the 3-compartment sink. Additional pest control is needed. Frozen food was kept in plastic grocery bags.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: Passed with conditions. No original certified food manager was on site while handlers prepared TCS foods; priority citation. Person in charge lacked food safety training proof, and food handler certificates were expired. Excess ice must be removed from the walk-in freezer.

headline: Food held too warm; black slime in ice machine
summary: Failed. Two coolers held food too warm: chopped tomatoes at 53F, dairy sauces at 47.4F, leafy greens at 69.3F and eggs at 69F. All were discarded, and both coolers were tagged. Black slime inside the ice machine, a priority citation, was dripping onto ice.

headline: Mouse droppings found throughout; failed
summary: Failed. About 10-15, 10-15, and 15-20 mouse droppings were found near the ice machine, smoker machine, and ice-container shelving. Pest control service is required before return inspection. Food was stored on the cooler floor.

headline: Walk-in cooler at 51.9F; chicken discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. The walk-in cooler ran at 51.9F and was tagged out until it holds 41F or below. Three pans of cooked chicken at 50.1-54.4F were discarded (about 20 lbs, $100). Ice machine panel was dirty.

headline: Unlabeled containers; food on floor; door gap
summary: Passed. Food in containers without name labels was found in coolers and dry storage. Food containers on walk-in cooler and freezer floors must be raised six inches. A 1/4 inch gap beside the front door needs a tight seal to keep pests out.

headline: Large gap at side door; sealing ordered
summary: Passed. On re-inspection, a large gap at the bottom of the side door could let pests in. The manager was instructed to seal the door.

headline: Black slime in ice maker; ice must be removed
summary: Passed with conditions. Black slimy substance inside the ice maker was dripping into ice used for human consumption, a priority citation. The machine must be turned off, ice removed, and interior cleaned and sanitized. Bulk containers lack labels.

headline: Missing handwash sign; mop stored on floor
summary: Passed. The handwash sink in the dishwashing and prep area lacked a handwashing sign. A wet mop was stored on the utility area floor; staff were told to hang mops to dry.

headline: Prep-area handwash sink not usable; failed
summary: Failed. The handwashing sink in the food prep area is not accessible and is incomplete: it lacks a drain pipe and a hot water supply line. All handwashing sinks must be usable at all times. Stove, fryer, wok station and hood have heavy grease.

headline: No employee health policy or vomit plan
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy or training was on site, and no procedure existed for vomiting and diarrheal events; both are priority violations. Bar handwash sink needs a sign. Brick wall and baseboards need repair.

headline: No certified manager; pest records incomplete
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site while open, a priority citation. Pest control logbook was incomplete and lacked license information. Ice machine and ice crusher drains connect directly to the grease trap and need an air gap.

headline: Stained cutting board; allergen training proof
summary: Passed. A cutting board attached to a prep cooler had deep grooves and dark stains and must be restored or replaced. No proof of allergen training was shown for certified food service managers; records must be kept on site.

headline: No certified manager during seafood prep; failed
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was present while shrimp, fish and seafood were prepared, a priority citation. The person in charge arrived at 12:50 PM. The rear grease receptacle had heavy buildup, and staff must clean it to prevent possible rodent activity.

headline: Handwash sink re-inspection; no details given
summary: Re-inspection of handwashing sink supply and access. The inspector's notes list no specific problems or corrections.

headline: Clay cups lack lead-free documentation
summary: Passed. Clay or ceramic cups on premises had no documentation or stamp showing they are lead-free. The person in charge must remove them or provide documentation.

headline: No valid certified manager; food on floor
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge held a valid certificate, a priority citation; one must be on premises during all hours. Food containers were stored on the walk-in cooler floor. Cutting boards are stained and hood filters are missing.

headline: Greasy vent filters; wall hole; restroom bin
summary: Passed. Ventilation filters had grease buildup. Rear hall wall has a hole and peeling paint. Employee restroom lacks a covered trash receptacle. Person in charge was told to repair and maintain these.

headline: Cluttered rear storage room
summary: Passed. The rear storage room was cluttered with non-food items. Staff were instructed to declutter and maintain the area.

headline: Food on floor; door gap; failed reinspection
summary: Failed. Food and beverage containers were stored directly on floors in the rear storage area and walk-in cooler. A 1-inch gap under the front door could let pests in. Soap and paper towels were at food sinks. Pest log was incomplete.

headline: Mop sink lacks vacuum breaker
summary: Passed. The premises had no mop sink with a vacuum breaker, a backflow prevention device. The operator must provide one.

headline: Raw wood shelves and wall cracks noted
summary: Passed. Raw wood shelving in the rear food prep area must be sealed or replaced with a smooth, easy-to-clean surface. Cracks and crevices in walls throughout must be sealed and made smooth.

headline: Stained cutting boards, grease, outdoor clutter
summary: Passed. Stained cutting boards must be resurfaced or replaced. Heavy grease behind cooking equipment, cracked floor grout, and chipped basement ceiling paint need work. Outside, unused equipment and high weeds could harbor pests and must be removed.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food service
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods such as omelets, samosas and soups were prepared and served, a priority citation. The person in charge lacks a certificate. Prior violation for rusty, dirty walk-in cooler shelves was not corrected.

headline: No certified manager during milk service; failed
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site while milk was prepared and served; the manager arrived at 9:55 AM, a priority citation. Employees lacked hair restraints and food handler certificates. Repeat violations include missing sink stoppers and backflow devices.

headline: Rodent droppings near food coolers; failed
summary: Failed. About 20 rodent droppings were behind a display cooler holding yogurt drinks, sausages and eggs, and under a cart in the dishwashing area. Many dead flies were found. No pest control agreement or waste removal contract was on site.

headline: Ice machine buildup; wiping cloths not in sanitizer
summary: Passed. The ice machine interior had pinkish and black buildup. Damp wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer, and an ice scoop hung on an unclean wall. Walk-in racks, a can opener and prep floors, walls and ceiling had food and dirt buildup.

headline: Cooler interior debris; manager told to clean
summary: Passed. On re-inspection, the cooler interior had debris buildup. The manager was instructed to clean it.

headline: Cooler at 68F; food discarded; tagged out
summary: Passed with conditions. A front-line cooler ran at 68.0F, too warm for cold food. The person in charge discarded all cold food (TCS) from it before inspection. The cooler is tagged out of use until repaired. Steam table leg is missing.

headline: Missing grease trap at 3-compartment sink
summary: Passed. A grease trap was missing at the 3-compartment sink in the front prep area. The operator must provide one and maintain it.

headline: No health policy or vomit response plan
summary: Passed with conditions. No signed employee health policy, and no written procedure or supplies for vomit or diarrhea events; both are priority citations. Cardboard is used as shelf liner. Restroom lacks a covered trash receptacle.

headline: Food held too warm; handwash supplies missing
summary: Failed. Shrimp at 83.8F, steak at 57.2F and other cold foods were held too warm; 20 lbs ($1,250) discarded. A basement handwash sink lacked soap and paper towels, corrected on site. A cooler at 50F was serviced to 41F.

headline: Rodent droppings and low hot-holding; failed
summary: Failed. About 45 rodent droppings were found behind the oven, by the water heater and on a rear storage ledge. A hot-holding unit ran at 117-127.4F and must hold at least 135F. Undercooked egg items lacked the required warning.

headline: Improper thawing and food on floor; failed
summary: Failed. Packaged beef was thawing in a bin on the floor, an improper method. Four to five bins of food were stored on the walk-in cooler floor. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Repeat violation: black mold-like substance inside the ice machine was not corrected.

headline: Wiping cloths, liners, and missing baseboard
summary: Passed. Prep area wiping cloths must be kept in sanitizing solution between uses. Tin foil, cardboard and raw wood liners must be removed. Baseboard coving is missing in the food prep area, and washroom ventilation is not working.

headline: Door gaps could let pests in; passed
summary: Passed. Inspector found openings at entrance and exit doors, including gaps at sliding and double doors, that could let pests in. No pests were seen. Owner was told to seal all outer openings.

headline: No hair restraints; sprayer and hood buildup
summary: Passed. Employees preparing food lacked hair restraints. The 3-compartment sink sprayer hangs below the sink rim and needs a holder. Floors by walls and under the stove need cleaning. Exhaust hood, filters and pipes had dirt and grease.

headline: Rear door gap; dirty ice machine and fryers
summary: Passed. Rear door has a 1/2 inch gap underneath and is not pest-proof; a door sweep was ordered. Ice machine panel had a black substance, fryers had grease and dirt, and kitchen floors had food and grease.

headline: Wall holes; backflow leak; allergen training
summary: Passed. Small holes in office walls must be sealed. The backflow device on the utility sink leaks and needs repair. Employee restroom lacks a covered trash receptacle. Certified food manager has no allergen training certificate.

headline: Missing handwash sign; soiled cooler fans
summary: Passed. Customer restroom needs handwashing signage. Fan guards in the walk-in cooler had soil buildup. Cardboard boxes were used as floor mats under cooking equipment and must be replaced with smooth, easy-to-clean mats.

headline: Restroom receptacle and allergen training missing
summary: Passed. The all-gender washroom lacked a covered receptacle for sanitary napkin disposal. The certified food manager had no proof of allergen training and must obtain a certificate.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup procedure
summary: Passed with conditions. No signed employee health policy. No procedure or supplies for vomit or diarrhea cleanup. Also: basement door gap, no handwashing sign, no lidded trash can, basement debris, and no food allergen training.

headline: No food handler certificates; dirty rear prep
summary: Passed. No food handler certificates were on site; staff told to comply with state requirements. Several certified managers had expired certificates. Rear prep had food debris and dirt on floors, walls and corners, plus torn gaskets.

headline: Torn gasket on prep cooler
summary: Passed re-inspection. A torn rubber gasket was found inside the prep service cooler and on a two-door refrigerator door. Repair or replacement required.

headline: Chicken held at 51.4°F and thawed in standing water
summary: Passed with conditions. About 10 lbs of raw chicken held at 51.4°F, left overnight in standing water in a mop sink to thaw; discarded. Other thawing in standing water was improper. No food thermometer on site. Foam cups used as scoops.

headline: Walk-in at 63–65°F; dish machine tagged out
summary: Failed. Walk-in cooler measured 63.3–65.4°F and was tagged; pork chorizo at 54.6°F and eggs at 53.1°F discarded (about 30 lbs). High-temperature dish machine malfunctioning and tagged. No sanitizer test kit.

headline: Leaking handsink knob
summary: Passed. The base of the cold water knob at a hand sink was leaking. The operator must repair and maintain it.

headline: Live roach and flies; dead roaches found
summary: Failed. One live roach, eight small flies and two large flies were seen. Dead roaches on basement floor and roach droppings near a handsink light switch. Pest control recommended. Food probe thermometer was not working. Cutting board on floor.

headline: Rusty walk-in shelving; dusty hood
summary: Passed. Rusty shelving inside the walk-in cooler must be de-rusted and repainted with nontoxic paint. Walk-in floors and fan covers need cleaning. The hood above cooking equipment is dusty.

headline: Over 5 live roaches; cold foods above 41°F
summary: Failed. Over five live roaches on floor around grease trap, under the three-compartment sink and in rear prep. Cold foods at 44.9–49.8°F; about 15 lbs discarded. Service cooler at 54.6°F not to be used. No certified manager on duty.

headline: Handsink blocked by coffee urn; summary not posted
summary: Employee placed a coffee urn in an exposed handsink to dump coffee; told to stop and keep the sink accessible. Citation issued. Loose faucet needs repair. Previous inspection summary was not posted; new summary left for posting.

headline: Grease spills on outside oil tank
summary: Passed. Grease spills were found on the front of the outside oil tank. Staff must clean and maintain it.

headline: No hot water on site; no food thermometer
summary: Failed license inspection. No hot water on site; restroom handsink measured 76.3°F, below the required 100°F. Handsink by mop sink had no water. No metal stem thermometer. No health policy. Dirty, broken floors and ceilings.

headline: No certified manager on site; mold in ice machine
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site; one arrived at 11:18 AM, corrected on site. Moldlike substance found inside basement ice machine. Dish machine wash at 150°F, below the required 160°F. No verifiable employee health policy.

headline: About 50 flying insects; dish machine problems
summary: Failed. About 50 live small flying insects on walls and ceilings in bar, prep, dining and storage areas; more pest control needed. Low-temperature dish machine lacked sanitizer; high-temperature machine reached only 153.9°F. Cold foods at 46–60°F.

headline: No dish soap, sanitizer or food thermometer
summary: Failed license inspection. No dish detergent or sanitizer for dishwashing, and no metal stem thermometer for food temperatures. No handsink in dishwashing area and no hand soap in men's restroom. No health policy or vomit cleanup kit.

headline: No health policy, vomit procedure or handsink
summary: Failed license inspection. No employee health policy or training, and no procedure or kit for vomit or diarrhea events. No handsink in rear dishwashing area. No pest control logbook, sanitizer test strips, or handwashing signs.

headline: Cold foods above 41°F; cooler tagged out
summary: Eggs, tomatoes and rice were held above 41°F in a display cooler; about 10 lbs discarded. A rear prep reach-in cooler at 55.3°F was tagged and must not be used until reinspected. Citation issued. Upkeep issues also noted.

headline: About 500 rodent droppings; live flies found
summary: Failed. About 500 or more large rodent droppings found on floors, shelves and in boxes, plus about 45 live flies. Pest control service required. Also no hand drying at a toilet-room sink, no utility sink, and a broken window.

headline: No certified food manager on site while open
summary: No certified food manager was on site while open; citation issued. Uncovered food containers on prep table, missing sink stoppers, and a slow-draining handwashing sink were also found. Greasy fryer exterior and wet floors noted.

headline: Unlabeled toppings, no hair restraint, leaking sink
summary: Failed. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint while preparing food. Toppings were stored out of original containers without labels. A 1/4-inch gap at the front exit door needs sealing. Three-compartment sink leaks; citation issued.

headline: No hot water at liquor handsink; coolers tagged
summary: Failed. Liquor-area handsink had no hot water. Produce and pizza areas had no handsink. Three handsinks lacked paper towels. Dish machine at 94°F and hot dog cooler at 52°F tagged. Ice machine buildup; prior violations not corrected.

headline: No three-compartment sink or dish machine
summary: Failed license inspection. No three-compartment sink or commercial dish machine was on site. Manager must install one. Citation issued.

headline: Ice machine debris; missing splashguard
summary: Passed. Slight debris was on the ice machine's interior panel. A splashguard was missing between the handwashing sink and the three-compartment sink. Dust covered a walk-in cooler fan cover. Staff told to correct.

headline: No allergen training certificate on site
summary: Passed re-inspection. No allergen training certificate was on site for certified food managers. Inspector required that they be provided.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings found; exterminator required
summary: Failed. Over 100 mouse droppings were scattered in prep, storage, dishwashing and beverage areas. Manager told to call an exterminator and clean. Food stored on walk-in floor, unlabeled bulk containers, missing thermometers, and no allergen certificate. Citation issued.

headline: No pest control log; cooler lacks thermometer
summary: Failed. No pest control log was on premises; citation issued. A reach-in cooler had no thermometer. Restroom trash cans lacked lids.

headline: Ice machine residue; leaking faucet; uncorrected
summary: Failed. Residue found inside the ice machine. Spills and debris on floors inside walk-in coolers and in prep, storage and basement areas. Previous violations not corrected, including a leaking faucet; citation issued.

headline: No dish soap or sanitizer; corrected on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No dishwashing liquid or sanitizer was available; both were provided before inspection ended. Three-compartment sink reached only 104°F; person in charge adjusted the water heater. No health policy or vomit cleanup kit on site.

headline: Improper container storage; peeling restroom paint
summary: Passed. Food containers were not stored properly and must be stored inverted. Walls inside customer restrooms had peeling paint and must be repaired.

headline: Written procedure needed for slush machines
summary: Passed. A written procedure is needed for cleaning the slush machines, which are clean-in-place equipment. No garbage can was located on the MFP; one must be provided.

headline: Fryer exterior needs cleaning
summary: Passed license inspection. The exterior surface of the fryer needed cleaning. Staff must clean and maintain it.

headline: No food handler training proof; storage issues
summary: Passed license inspection, but no proof of food handler training for required employees. Also noted: unlabeled bulk foods, tin cans used as food containers, wiping cloths not in sanitizer, items on floor, and inoperable washroom ventilation.

headline: Beef held at 46.6°F under grill; discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Beef was held at 46.6°F in a cold holding unit under the grill; about 14 lbs discarded. Citation issued. Squirt bottles, storage containers and seasoning shakers in front prep were unlabeled.

headline: Grease, rust and dust need cleaning
summary: Passed. Grill table rust, fryer and grill exteriors, floors and walk-in fan covers need cleaning. Bulk containers and can opener blade at rear prep table also need cleaning. Cold water faucet knob at rear handsink must be replaced.

headline: Handsink blocked by pots; citation issued
summary: Passed with conditions. Dishroom handsink was filled with pots and containers; manager removed them on site. Handsinks must stay accessible for hand washing only. Citation issued. Ice scoop storage and oily floor under fryer also need attention.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; carry-out containers need storing
summary: Passed. Carry-out containers must be stored inverted to prevent contamination. A torn door gasket on a two-door stand-up cooler must be replaced. Kitchen shelves and cooler interiors need detail cleaning.

headline: No handsink in dish area; no training certificates
summary: Failed license inspection. No handwashing sink in dishwashing area and no food handler training certificates. No sanitation certificate posted. Overflowing trash at dumpster. Rear door needs a rodent-proof strip.

headline: Worn scrubbies; employee washroom needs cleaning
summary: Passed. Green scrubbies in use were worn and in poor condition and must be changed. The employee washroom needed cleaning.

headline: No pest control log on site
summary: Failed license inspection. No pest control log book with required documents was available to review. Must be provided and kept on site. Citation issued.

headline: Mouse droppings in dough proofs and ovens
summary: Failed. Mouse droppings found inside dough proofs, inside oven units, and on floors. All coolers and freezers, including walk-ins, were turned off. Rear door has a 1/4-inch gap. No valid sanitation certificate, health policy or food thermometer.

headline: No allergen training on site for certified manager
summary: Passed license inspection. No allergen training was on site for the certified food manager. The person in charge was instructed to obtain it.

headline: Missing walk-in thermometer and backflow device
summary: Passed license inspection. No ambient air thermometer inside the walk-in cooler. The ice machine in the rear prep area had no backflow prevention device. The all-gender toilet room had no lidded receptacle.

headline: Food handler without hair restraint; floor debris
summary: Passed. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint while preparing food. Debris was on floors along walls and corners in utility and storage areas. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door needs a tight seal.

headline: Rust on ice machine; freezer door ice buildup
summary: Passed re-inspection. Rust on the ice machine shield must be removed. An opening around the rear exit door knob must be sealed. Ice buildup on the walk-in freezer door and missing floor grout need fixing.

headline: About 100 flies found; handsinks blocked
summary: Failed. About 100 small flies found in mop sink room and staff washroom; pest control recommended. No valid sanitation certificate. Dish-area handsink used to store food and equipment. No paper towels or hair restraints. Citations issued.

headline: Handsink leaking and off; hot foods too cool
summary: Failed. Jerk chicken prep handsink was shut off due to a large leak; handlers told to use another sink. Hot foods held at 81–88°F, discarded (about 40 lbs). No stem thermometers or test strips. Greasy outdoor container overflowing; citation issued.

headline: Wastewater backing up onto prep floor; unvented oven
summary: Failed license inspection. Wastewater backed up from the grease trap onto the kitchen prep floor while draining the sink; must be repaired. A gas baking oven was not connected and unvented. Torn gasket, rusty racks and allergen training also needed.

headline: Missing paper towels; corrected on site
summary: Passed with conditions. Paper towels were missing at several handwashing sinks; staff provided them on site; citation issued. Also noted: missing handwashing signs, cold units without thermometers, unlabeled bulk containers, and a leaking basement drain.

headline: Floor drain cleaned on site
summary: Passed. The floor drain at the three-compartment sink needed cleaning. This was corrected on site during the inspection.

headline: Uncovered oils and spices; grease behind wok
summary: Passed. Bowls and containers of oils and spices were uncovered on prep tables. Food and dry goods were not elevated in rear dry storage. Grease buildup on pipes and the floor drain behind the wok needs cleaning.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Passed re-inspection. Several employees had expired food handler training, and all allergen certificates were expired. Coolers storing food lacked thermometers. Hood filters were greasy and a handsink had low water pressure.

headline: No certified food manager during food prep
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on duty while sandwiches and chopped vegetables were prepared and served; citation issued. Person in charge lacked a valid sanitation certificate. Clutter on furnace room floor and no handwashing sign noted.

headline: Substances in ice machines; uncovered tableware
summary: Passed. Minimal pink and black unknown substances were found on an ice machine panel and spout. Preset eating utensils and water glasses were uncovered; staff told to cover tableware and invert glassware.

headline: Cold foods at 44–49°F; cooler tagged
summary: Several cold foods were held at 44–49°F; manager discarded about $300 of food. A two-door cooler measured 47°F air temperature and was tagged. Aluminum foil wrapped around kitchen equipment must be removed.

headline: Ice machine rust; summary not visible to public
summary: Passed with conditions. Rust-colored substance found inside the ice machine. A food handler wore a reusable apron while handling trash; a new one was provided. The most recent inspection summary was not visible to the public; citation issued.

headline: Debris on floors, coolers and outside dumpster
summary: Passed re-inspection. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Debris found on coolers, freezers, shelving, and floors in prep, dishwashing, storage and washroom areas, and outside the dumpster. Stained ceiling tiles noted.

headline: Rear handsink and restroom ventilation not working
summary: Failed license inspection. The rear hand sink was not operational and must be repaired. Mechanical ventilation in the restrooms was not working and must be repaired.

headline: Missing fan guard; no backflow devices
summary: Passed re-inspection. A fan guard cover was missing inside a prep cooler. Equipment on the water line, including soda, tea and coffee machines, lacked visible backflow devices. Must be installed and maintained.

headline: Oversized equipment for sink; open holes in wall
summary: Passed. Equipment is too large for the three-compartment sink; a larger sink, smaller equipment, or an approved manual method is needed. Drink boxes stored on floor. Open holes in liquor room ceiling and wall. No allergen certification on site.

headline: Handsink blocked during food prep; corrected
summary: Failed. Kitchen prep handsink was blocked by a water jug and cleaning supplies while food was being prepared, and had no hand soap. Both corrected on site. No food handler certificates on premises. Leaking drainpipe and greasy hood also noted.

headline: Splashguard needed; washroom surfaces not cleanable
summary: Passed license inspection. A splash guard is needed beside the service sink to protect the three-compartment sink drainboard. Employee washroom floors and walls must be smooth, non-absorbent and easy to clean.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; no allergen training
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food handler training certificates were expired. No allergen training was on site for certified food managers. Current training records must be provided.

headline: Pet dog in store; sink and cooler repairs needed
summary: Passed with conditions. A non-service puppy was walking through food aisles; manager told not to allow it. Raw-meat sink had only one stopper. Basement walk-in drip pan not draining and a raw-meat room wall needs repair.

headline: Meat thawed improperly in sink water
summary: Passed. Meat was thawed sitting in standing water in a sink. Must thaw under running water at 70°F or below, under refrigeration, or as part of cooking. Wiping cloths, can opener, freezer surfaces and floor drains also need cleaning.

headline: Cold meat above safe temperature; cooler tagged
summary: Beef, chicken and pork held at 54.8–55.2°F in a prep cooler whose air reached 60°F. About 10 lbs discarded. Cooler tagged and not to be used until repaired. Citation issued. A washroom door lacked a self-closing device.

headline: Ice machine, filters and floors need cleaning
summary: Passed. Ice machine interior must be cleaned. A ceiling tile is missing above the walk-in freezer. Floor under pop crates needs cleaning and hood filters need grease removal. The certified manager has no allergen training.

headline: Employees without hair restraints; unlabeled containers
summary: Passed. Multiple food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Salt, sugar and flour containers were unlabeled. Boxed food stored on floor, scoops kept inside containers, and food debris on rear prep floors noted.

headline: No hot water at start; restored on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No hot running water at first; temperatures were 72.7–78.2°F. Hot water was restored before inspection ended, reaching 101.9–124.2°F. Also noted: boxes on floor, plastic-wrapped bread, and damaged floors.

headline: No certified food manager on duty during food service
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while food that needs temperature control was prepared and served. Safe-serve certificate was expired. No person in charge was present at inspection. Citation issued.

headline: Door gap and leaking sink faucet
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the cafeteria exit door sweep must be sealed to rodent-proof it. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks at the base and must be repaired.

headline: Shelving needed in walk-in; holes need sealing
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food storage shelves are needed in the walk-in cooler. Walls around the three-compartment sink must be sealed, and the hole in the mop closet repaired.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food containers found
summary: Passed. Bulk food containers, including flour and sugar, had no labels. Inspector required that they be labeled.

headline: Hot and cold foods unsafe; restroom water cold
summary: Failed. Cold foods held at 50–70°F and hot foods at 108–128°F, below 135°F; about 41 lbs discarded. Two prep coolers tagged and not to be used. Restroom handsink water only 65.5°F; citation issued.

headline: Leaking sink faucets; wet mops in buckets
summary: Passed re-inspection. Cardboard liner must be removed from the grease trap area. Old food residue on a can opener needs cleaning. Both faucets at the rear three-compartment sink leak. Wet mops should be hung to dry.

headline: Cold foods at 51–57°F; about $500 discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Packaged meats, cheeses and sour cream held at 51–57°F in grocery and prep coolers; about $500 discarded. Several coolers lacked thermometers. Deep-cut cutting boards and water-damaged ceiling tiles also noted. Citation issued.

headline: Missing sink stoppers and mop-water sink
summary: Passed license inspection. Three-compartment sinks lacked drain stoppers. No service sink was available for dirty mop water. Women's restroom needed a covered trash can. Allergen training certificate was not on site.

headline: Wiping cloths left out; floors need cleaning
summary: Passed re-inspection. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door must be sealed. Wiping cloths were left on prep tables and must be kept in sanitizing solution. Floors, walls and basement clutter need cleaning.

headline: Door gap; coolers, mixer and oven area dirty
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the rear interior door must be repaired to block pests. Reach-in cooler interiors need cleaning, the pizza rack and mixer are dirty, and the area between oven and wall needs cleaning.

headline: Rat droppings and two live cockroaches found
summary: Failed. Over 20 rat droppings on basement floor and five on shelves; two live cockroaches near the dish machine's grease trap. Removal, cleaning and pest treatment required. Food stored on floor; heavy grease on floors and fryers. Citation issued.

headline: Torn gasket and dirty floor under cooler
summary: Passed. A torn rubber gasket was found on a bottom refrigeration unit near the dishwashing area. Floors under the cooler in the front prep area need cleaning.

headline: Flying insects in basement; no certified manager
summary: Failed. About 20 live small flying insects were on walls and ceilings of basement prep and dishwashing areas; more pest control needed. No certified food manager on duty. No signed employee health policy. Handsinks lacked soap and paper towels.

headline: Chicken at 60.9°F; cooler at 61.5°F tagged
summary: Passed with conditions. Chicken held at 60.9°F in a reach-in cooler; manager told to discard. Cooler reached only 61.5°F, was tagged and must not be used until reinspected. Citation issued. Other upkeep items noted.

headline: Water-stained ceiling tiles in restroom
summary: Passed. Water-stained ceiling tiles were found in the women's toilet and conference room. Staff were told to replace them and maintain them.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; faucet repair needed
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign at the rear handsink. The hot water faucet at the basement utility sink was in poor repair. Staff told to fix both.

headline: Rodent droppings; uncooked rice in mop sink
summary: Failed. About 50 small rodent droppings found in rear hall and toilet area; carpeted floors need cleaning. Open bucket of uncooked rice stored in a sink labeled mop wastewater only; discarded. Citation issued.

headline: Faucet missing sprayer; dirt under equipment
summary: Passed. A three-compartment sink faucet was in poor repair with its sprayer missing. Dirt and debris were found under shelves, behind and under cooking equipment, and under the sink.

headline: Visors without hairnets; expired allergen training
summary: Passed with conditions. Two employees wore visors without hairnets while preparing food. Open soda cup on prep counter and unlabeled ice cream toppings noted. Certified manager's allergen training was expired, a repeat violation; citation issued.

headline: Grease and debris on equipment and floors
summary: Passed re-inspection. Soiled wiping cloths were stored on prep tables. Grease built up on cooking equipment, and debris and dust on coolers and shelving. Food debris and grease on floors under equipment, along walls and in corners.

headline: Rat droppings; bare-hand food contact
summary: Failed. Over 10 rat droppings in rear storage room with clutter and food on floor. Cook touched cooked bacon with bare hands; discarded. Several cold foods above 41°F, about 20 lbs discarded. Prep cooler repaired during inspection.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea clean-up supplies
summary: Passed with conditions. No clean-up supplies were on the premises for vomit or diarrhea events. Management was told to provide them.

headline: Wiping cloths improperly stored; rusty racks
summary: Passed re-inspection. Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizing solution when not in use. Rusty storage racks inside the walk-in cooler must be cleaned or replaced.

headline: Food handlers lack training certificates
summary: Passed re-inspection. Some food handlers lacked food handler training certificates. A certified food manager had no allergen training certificate. Also noted: unlabeled storage containers, a stained cutting board, and missing light shields.

headline: Employee belongings in dry storage; leaking faucet
summary: Passed. Employee personal belongings were stored with dry storage and must be moved to a designated area. A faucet at the three-compartment sink was leaking and needs repair.

headline: Unlabeled containers; hood needs cleaning
summary: Passed. Food storage containers in the rear walk-in cooler lacked labels. A splashguard was missing at a rear handsink. Exposed foam-like caulk and greasy hood filters also need attention.

headline: Food debris and items on floors in rear prep
summary: Passed. Soiled wiping cloth stored in walk-in cooler. Single-service items stored on floor near handsink. Food debris under shelving in walk-in. Clutter and items on floor in rear prep area. Staff told to correct and maintain.

headline: Cold foods at 44–50°F; food discarded
summary: Failed. Various cold foods were held at 44–50°F; about $350 of food discarded. Handsinks used to store items. No certificate on site while food was prepared. Dish machine lacked temperature indicator. No allergen training.

headline: No thermometer in shake cooler; hair restraint lacking
summary: Passed. A thermometer could not be found inside the shake ingredient (milk) cooler. A food handler lacked an effective hair or beard restraint. Both unisex toilet rooms had uncovered garbage receptacles.

headline: Unlabeled container; employee without certificate
summary: Passed. A flour or seasoning container in dry storage was unlabeled. Lightbulbs were out in the dishwashing and dry storage area. An employee handling food had no food handler certificate and was told to provide one.

headline: No hot water at restroom sink; corrected on site
summary: Failed. Restroom handsink had only cold water, even after two minutes. Hot water was restored to at least 100°F during inspection. Food stored on basement floor, kitchen food handlers lacked training, and hood filters were greasy. Citation issued.

headline: Cardboard liners; manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Cardboard was used as a liner on food prep equipment and tables and must be removed. A food service sanitation manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: No current pest control records; citation issued
summary: No proof of recent pest control was on site. The last service report was dated May 2023, and a citation was issued. A second-floor exit door had an unprotected gap. Debris built up behind the ice machine, and a bar sink was not draining.

headline: No certified manager at opening; overflowing dumpster
summary: No certified food manager was on site when time-sensitive foods were being prepared and stored, until about 9:15 a.m. A citation was issued. Dumpster lids did not close due to overflowing trash. Food handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Food handler certificates not on site
summary: Food handler certificates were not provided on site. The facility must provide them.

headline: Washrooms lack covered bins and ventilation
summary: Both all-gender washrooms lacked covered receptacles for sanitary products. Mechanical ventilation in both washrooms was not working and must be repaired or installed.

headline: Some food handler certificates expired
summary: Some food handler certificates had expired. The manager must renew them.

headline: Boxed food on floors; cardboard shelf liners
summary: Boxed food was on the floor throughout the prep area and must be elevated six inches. Cardboard was used as shelf liner and must be removed. Food debris was in a floor drain under the three-compartment sink.

headline: Many cold foods too warm; citation issued
summary: Many cold foods were above 41F, including eggs at 50F, milk at 48F, and steaks at 51F. Coolers measured 46F to 52F air. Citation issued. A torn cooler door gasket and no working mop sink were also noted.

headline: No food handler certificate; cardboard shelf liner
summary: No food handler training certificate was on site. Cardboard was used as shelf liner and must be removed. A front prep handwash sink drains slowly, and both washroom doors need self-closing devices.

headline: Dirty seafood prep floors; raw wood walls
summary: Floors in seafood prep areas were not clean and must be cleaned. Raw wood on walls in meat prep areas must be sealed.

headline: 60 lbs of soup held too warm to cool
summary: About 60 lbs of chicken gumbo and lemon cream soup measured 53.2F at the center in a walk-in cooler. The soup had been placed there a day earlier and was discarded, worth $70. Large deep tubs with tight lids were used for cooling.

headline: Hair restraints and debris cleaning needed
summary: Food handlers need effective hair restraints for longer hair. Single-use items in the customer area must be wrapped. Reach-in coolers, the unisex washroom, and floors need cleaning, and standing water must be eliminated.

headline: Restroom faucets shut off too quickly
summary: Push faucets in the restrooms did not stay on long enough for proper handwashing. The business must provide faucets that stay on.

headline: Greasy cooking equipment and hood filters
summary: Greasy sides and undersurfaces of cooking equipment were noted, along with greasy hood filters and dusty vents in the rear prep area. A dark buildup was found on a basement sink. Staff were told to clean all of these.

headline: Employee drinking in prep area; bowls used as scoops
summary: An employee drank from an uncovered beverage in the rear prep area. Multi-use bowls were used as scoops in food containers. Ice machine surfaces had flaking coating, and an empty egg carton was used as a holding surface.

headline: No certified manager; ice machine slime
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS items such as rice were prepared, and a citation was issued. A front beverage cooler thermometer used for milk was not working. Heavy black slime was inside the ice machine.

headline: No working handwash sink with hot water
summary: The dish room had no plumbed handwash sink, only a portable one with no hot or cold water. A front prep sink and coffee equipment were not connected to city water. Water measured 102F. Priority violations were issued.

headline: No certified person in charge; cool handwash water
summary: No person in charge with a valid certificate was on the premises. Handwash sink water measured 61F to 93F, below the required 100F. A sanitizer test kit was missing, and several sinks drained slowly. Citations issued.

headline: New sink lacks splash guards
summary: A new sink was installed next to the speed rack without splash guards. Splash guards must be installed on both sides to prevent contamination.

headline: Hot and cold foods unsafe; about $100 discarded
summary: Pull pork at 114F and cheese at 109F in a warming rack were too cool for hot holding. Cold service-cooler foods ran 44F to 56F. About 10 lbs, worth $100, were discarded. Coolers at 54F and 47.7F may not be used until 41F or below.

headline: No food handler training proof; damaged sushi board
summary: No food handler training proof was given for any employee, and certified managers lacked allergen training proof. The sushi cutting board had deep cuts and must be replaced. Torn door gaskets on a sushi cooler must be replaced.

headline: Dirty wiping cloths on prep tables
summary: Dirty wiping cloths were stored on front-area prep tables. They must be kept in sanitizing solution when not in use.

headline: No certified manager; TCS foods prepared
summary: No person in charge with a certified manager certificate was present. No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods such as pupusas and chicken tamales were prepared. A citation was issued. Handwash signage was missing, and the front door weatherstrip was broken.

headline: No person in charge or certified manager on site
summary: No person in charge and no certified food manager were on site, and no valid certificate was posted. There was no employee health policy and no vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit. No metal stem thermometer or male food handler training proof. Citations issued.

headline: Ice machine mineral buildup; dusty cooler fans
summary: Mineral buildup was found inside the ice machine and must be cleaned. Fans in the walk-in cooler were dusty and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: No certified manager on site; no handler certificate
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were stored, prepared, or served, and a citation was issued. Cardboard lined a prep table cooler. No employee on duty had a food handler certificate.

headline: Worn front door seal; managers lack allergen training
summary: The weather stripping at the bottom of the front door was worn and must be replaced to prevent pest entry. Two certified managers on duty lacked allergen training, and citations will follow if not corrected.

headline: No employee health policy; door and wall gaps
summary: No employee health policy was on site, a priority violation. The front door needed rodent-proofing, though no pests were noted. Also noted: stained cutting board, dirty cooler interiors, a missing backflow device location, and missing hood filters.

headline: Dead roach found; grease and holes
summary: Inspector found one dead roach near the utility sink and storage area; it was removed and the area sanitized. Grease covered cooking equipment, walls, and floors. Holes in walls near exits need sealing, and a freezer door needs repair.

headline: Missing ceiling tiles; food handler rules
summary: No ceiling tiles were installed above the food prep and dishwashing areas. The manager must provide and maintain them. The manager was also told to comply with food handler requirements.

headline: Food debris in cooler door gaskets
summary: Food debris had built up in the rubber door gaskets of front prep area coolers. The gaskets must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Unlabeled spices; mold-like buildup in walk-in
summary: Some food storage containers in a drawer, including cinnamon, bay leaves, and cumin, were not labeled. Storage racks inside the walk-in cooler and freezer had dried food debris and mold-like buildup.

headline: Dishwash handwash sink out of service
summary: The dishwashing area handwash sink did not work: hot and cold handles were disconnected and the water valve was off because of a wall leak. Repairs are required by reinspection. The Health Department placed the business on a 2-day work-around.

headline: Food on floor; dirty meat slicer
summary: A box of oranges was stored on the kitchen floor. The meat slicer was not clean behind the blade, and food debris was noted. The basement ice maker had no backflow prevention device.

headline: Missing handwash signs; burnt-out hood lights
summary: Handwash signage was missing in the front bar and first-floor restrooms. A plastic bowl was used as a scoop in dry storage. Several handwash sinks drain slowly, and two hood areas had dead light bulbs.

headline: Food stored under leaking pipes; missing stoppers
summary: Dry food was stored under wastewater pipes in the basement and must be moved or shielded. Three-compartment sink stoppers were missing, and a leak under the dishwashing sink needs repair. Raised racks are needed in the walk-in cooler.

headline: Cooked potatoes and spinach held too warm
summary: Cooked potatoes at 65.9F and spinach at 55.6F were left unrefrigerated on prep counters. About 10 lbs, worth $20, were discarded on site. Citation issued. Rust, exposed vent insulation, and dim cooler lighting were also noted.

headline: Utensil left in standing water
summary: A spoon in use was kept in standing water at room temperature. The business was told to follow the health code.

headline: Calcium buildup inside ice machine
summary: Calcium buildup was found inside the ice machine. The manager was instructed to clean it.

headline: No food handler training proof; greasy floors
summary: Grease, food debris, and dirt were on floors under cooking equipment, along walls, and in corners. No proof of food handler training was provided. No certified food manager with allergen training was on site. A mop was not stored to dry.

headline: Repeat violations uncorrected; ice machine debris
summary: Many violations from a June 2025 inspection were not corrected, including missing food handler training and expired allergen training. Encrusted debris was inside the ice machine. A second-floor washroom door lacked a self-closing device. Deadline: 7/2/2026.

headline: Unused cooler; no allergen training proof
summary: An unused cooler in basement dry storage must be removed or made operational to prevent pest harboring. No allergen training proof was provided for certified food managers.

headline: Food stored on floor; expired handler certificates
summary: Boxed food was stored on the floor in both basement walk-in coolers and must be raised at least six inches. Several food handlers had expired certificates. The ice machine bin was dirty, and food debris built up on equipment.

headline: Grease, dust, and dirty floors near equipment
summary: Cleaned dishes in the dish area were not inverted. A kitchen entry drain, the walk-in cooler floor, and cooking equipment sides needed detail cleaning. Floors under and around equipment had dust, dirt, and grease buildup.

headline: Chicken tenders held too warm; citation issued
summary: Chicken tenders measured 51.6F to 61.2F, above the 41F limit; 8 lbs worth $50 were discarded. Citations were issued. No barrier protected food from customers, and sanitizer test kits were missing.

headline: Cooler at 62F tagged out; no food handler training
summary: A two-door reach-in cooler was in poor repair at 62.0F and was tagged out. It must stay free of TCS foods until repaired. Food employees lacked food handler training, and a utility sink backflow device was in poor repair.

headline: No food handler certificates; grease and debris
summary: No food handler certificates were on site, and no food manager allergen certificate was shown. Grease and food debris built up on cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, and shelves. Floor debris was also found in storage areas.

headline: Mouse droppings and fruit flies; citation issued
summary: Twenty or more mouse droppings were found near the fuse box, and fruit flies were in the dishwashing area. Pest control was required before reinspection, and a citation was issued. The front door had a gap that needed sealing.

headline: Washroom door closer not working
summary: The self-closing device on the washroom door was not working properly. It must be repaired and maintained.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No certified food manager was on site while the restaurant was open. A 2023 certificate was shown by phone. A certified manager lacked allergen training. Citation issued.

headline: No soap or towels at sink; corrected on site
summary: Hand soap and paper towels were missing at the front kitchen handwash sink. The person in charge provided both on site, and a citation was issued. Frozen beef was thawing at room temperature, and certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Pork held above 41F; citation issued
summary: Pork held at 45.2F to 52F in the prep area was discarded, about 5 to 10 lbs worth $60. A citation was issued. Frozen meat was thawing improperly, and no allergen training was on site. Stained cutting boards were also noted.

headline: Aluminum foil lining food prep surfaces
summary: Aluminum foil was used as liner on food prep equipment and tables. The manager was instructed to remove it.

headline: Dirty floors and walls near hot water tank
summary: Floors and walls around the hot water tank in the rear dish area were dirty. They must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Wall openings under sink; grease and debris
summary: Grease spilled on the fryer exteriors, and food debris was on floors under cooking equipment. Three large openings in the wall under the three-compartment sink must be sealed to prevent pest entry.

headline: Milk-crate shelving; leaks and missing ceiling tiles
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving in prep and storage areas and must be replaced. The three-compartment sink leaked from drain pipes. Ceiling tiles were missing or stained, and a light shield was missing throughout.

headline: No food handler certificates; greasy walls and floors
summary: No food handler certificates were on site. Sliced cheese and mixed peppers near hot holding equipment were uncovered. A handwash sign and three sink stoppers were missing, and grease covered walls and floors under gyro equipment.

headline: Low pressure and slow drain at sinks
summary: The men's washroom handwash sink needs more water pressure. An exposed handwash sink in the front prep area drains slowly. Certified food managers must provide allergen training certificates.

headline: Flies and centipede found; citation issued
summary: Over 20 large flies, more than 10 small flies, and one centipede were found throughout the facility, including on a muffin in the display case. The manager discarded one muffin. A citation was issued.

headline: Uncovered ice cream; live plants above food
summary: Uncovered ice cream was stored in the walk-in freezer and must be covered. Live potted plants sat on a shelf above the ice cream freezer and must be removed. Openings at the base of exit doors were to be sealed; no pests were reported.

headline: Food on floor; grease and debris buildup
summary: Food was stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and must be elevated. A torn gasket was on a front prep cooler door. Grease and debris had built up on equipment, coolers, and shelves, and hood filters were dusty.

headline: Air-drying and live plant issues
summary: Deli cups were not air-dried after washing; all multi-use utensils must air-dry. A live plant was in the prep kitchen and must be kept away from food prep and clean utensils.

headline: Untrained employee; no public summary posted
summary: One employee worked without food handler training, and allergen certificates were not on site. A thermometer was missing from a refrigerator. The inspection summary was not posted for public view, a citation was issued.

headline: Food debris, drain repair, and upkeep issues
summary: Food debris and spills were found on the oven, prep tables, shelves, and holding units. A drainpipe under a handwash sink was in poor repair. Also noted: wall and ceiling damage, raw wood shelving, and dust.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: No person in charge was present during the inspection. No certified food manager was on duty while rice and chicken soups were prepared and served, and a citation was issued. Unlabeled food and cardboard shelf liners were also found.

headline: Greasy floors and fryers; missing signs
summary: Two handwash sinks lacked signs. Boxed food was stored on the basement floor. Fryer and oven sides were heavily greased. A spray sink handle was missing and was provided on site. Several restroom items needed fixing.

headline: Hot and cold foods discarded; citation issued
summary: Meatballs and red sauce at 110F to 130F in the front warmer were discarded, about 10 lbs. Cut tomatoes at 50.1F were also discarded. A citation was issued. The storage closet was cluttered, and floors under equipment were soiled.

headline: No certified manager; repeat violations uncorrected
summary: No certified manager was on site while hamburgers were prepared. No shellstock tags, food handler certificates, or metal stem thermometer were on site. Repeat hair-restraint and washroom trash violations from 2023 were not corrected. Citations issued.

headline: Food debris and spills on floors throughout
summary: Food debris and spills were found on floors throughout the facility. The manager was told to detail clean under all floors and in every corner, and to keep the area clean at all times.

headline: Missing light shields in walk-in cooler
summary: Light shields were missing for the lights in walk-in cooler #8. The manager was told to provide shields and maintain them.

headline: No hand soap, corrected on site; food on floor
summary: No hand soap was at the prep-area handwash sink; the manager provided soap on site, and a citation was issued. Food was stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and freezer. Aluminum foil liners and a non-self-closing washroom door were also noted.

headline: Missing backflow devices and door closers
summary: No backflow devices were found at the utility sink or ice machine. Washroom doors lacked self-closing devices. All certified food service managers must obtain required allergen training.

headline: No food handler training proof; unlabeled tamales
summary: No food handler training proof was provided, and a manager lacked allergen training proof. Tamales in coolers and freezers were unlabeled. Large pots did not fit the three-compartment sink, so a written washing procedure is needed.

headline: Stained cutting boards; unshielded light bulbs
summary: Cutting boards with open seams and dark stains must be refinished or replaced. Light bulbs next to the dishwasher lacked protective shielding; the manager was told to add it.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; managers lack allergen training
summary: Torn door gaskets were found on a two-door prep cooler, which also needs interior cleaning. A drain leak under a two-compartment sink must be repaired. Several certified managers lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Mobile vehicle lacks power, refrigeration, and water
summary: The vehicle had no power, and none of its cold holding or freezer units were running. No hot or cold water was available, and the handwash sink had no hand drying supplies. Lights were out and there was no garbage lid.

headline: Meat thawing improperly in sink
summary: Intestines were thawing improperly in a bowl inside the three-compartment sink. The business must thaw food under refrigeration or running water.

headline: Food on walk-in floor; clutter and torn gasket
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor inside the walk-in cooler and must be raised six inches. A three-door refrigerator had a torn gasket. Clutter and employee belongings were on food shelves.

headline: Food on floor; rusted racks and hood issues
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor in walk-in coolers and must be elevated. Rusted racks had dried debris, and a women's restroom sink had missing tiles. Hood filters were missing, and burned-out hood lights needed replacement.

headline: No paper towels; sink out; warm beef discarded
summary: The front handwash sink was out of service due to a leak, and the dish area sink had no paper towels; a citation was issued. Beef at 46F to 47.3F and steak at 52.8F were discarded during the inspection. Thawing and storage problems were also noted.

headline: Moldlike growth in ice machine; door openings
summary: Moldlike substance was found inside the basement ice machine and must be cleaned. Openings at entrance and exit doors were to be sealed; no pests were reported. A prep sink and an espresso backflow device were missing.

headline: Toilet room doors lack self-closing devices
summary: The toilet room doors had no self-closing devices. The business must install them.

headline: Over 60 flies; unapproved vacuum-sealed fish
summary: Over 60 small flies were found, with activity in the dining area and bar; a citation was issued. Dish machines sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine, corrected on site. Vacuum-sealed frozen fish, about 62 lbs worth $1,675, was discarded.

headline: No food handler training; several upkeep issues
summary: No food handler training proof was on site, and a food manager lacked allergen training. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. The front door had a gap, and debris built up in cabinets and prep coolers.

headline: Dusty serving plates and ceiling fans
summary: Serving plates on prep-area shelves were not stored properly and had dust buildup. Ceiling fans in the front and rear prep areas were dirty and dusty. The manager was told to invert the plates and clean the fans.

headline: Leaking handwash sink in rear dish area
summary: The handwash sink in the rear dish area leaked at the bottom of an elbow connection. The person in charge was told to repair it.

headline: Syrup residue on storage floor
summary: Syrup residue had built up on the floor in rear storage under the soda shelf. The person in charge was told to clean and maintain the area.

headline: Slow-draining sink and burnt-out prep lights
summary: An exposed handwash sink in the front prep area drains slowly and must be repaired. Dust was on a washroom vent, and burnt-out bulbs were in the rear food prep area. Allergen training certificates for certified managers are required.

headline: About 40 rat droppings; no certified manager
summary: About 40 rat droppings were found next to the walk-in cooler and dry storage, and pest control was judged inadequate. No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were handled. Prescription medication was kept on a kitchen shelf.

headline: No certified manager certificate or thermometer
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager certificate was on the premises. No calibrated metal stem food thermometer was available. Both were ordered and marked as priority violations.

headline: Missing signage, backflow device, and allergen certificates
summary: No handwash signage was posted at the front bar sink. The basement utility sink had no backflow device, and basement floor debris was found. No allergen training certificates were on site.

headline: Rat droppings found in dining and kitchen
summary: Inspector found 15 rat droppings in the dining area near the front door and 20 more behind cooking and hot holding equipment. Pest control was required, and a citation was issued. Standing water from a walk-in cooler leak also needs repair.

headline: Bulk food not labeled
summary: Bulk food items, such as flour and sugar, were not labeled. The manager must label them.

headline: Door openings to seal; leaking sink faucet
summary: Openings were found at the front entrance and side doors and must be sealed to prevent pest entry. A three-compartment sink faucet in the first-floor kitchen was leaking and must be repaired.

headline: Hot water too cool for handwashing
summary: Hot water could not hold temperature. The handwash sink reached 117F, then dropped to 76.4F. The three-compartment sink reached only 84.6F. Required temperatures are 100F for handwashing and 110F for the three-compartment sink.

headline: Cooler too warm; 248 lbs of food discarded
summary: Walk-in cooler air measured 66F, and the unit was tagged. Several TCS foods in a prep cooler were above 41F, including sliced cheddar at 55.6F. About 248 lbs, worth $499, were discarded. Handwash signs and allergen proof were also missing.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, weak hot water
summary: Food handlers prepared time-sensitive foods with no certified food manager until one arrived at 1:25 p.m. Hot water at a washroom sink was only a trickle. Allergen training proof was missing. Citations issued.

headline: Grease and food debris under equipment; mold caulking
summary: Floors throughout the facility were filled with food debris and grease, including under cooking equipment, the sink, and cold holding units. Caulking behind the three-compartment sink was filled with mold and must be cleaned or replaced.

headline: Unlabeled prepared foods; oven lacks hood
summary: Prepared foods such as potato salad and chicken inside the deli walk-in cooler were not labeled. An 11,000-watt electric oven in the deli prep area was not under an exhaust hood and needs approval.

headline: Missing cooler thermometers; ice machine damage
summary: Small reach-in coolers were missing thermometers. The ice machine had a missing upper panel cover and a cracked lower panel. Black caulking behind the three-compartment sink must be replaced.

headline: Missing backflow devices at mop sink, coffee
summary: No backflow prevention devices were found at the mop sink or coffee machine. They must be installed where they can be serviced.

headline: Chicken too warm; about 5 pounds discarded
summary: Chicken wings held at 50.1 degrees Fahrenheit in a cooler were discarded, about 5 pounds valued at about $60, a priority violation with a citation. TCS items must stay at or below 41 degrees. Torn drawer gaskets, a non-working three-compartment sink stopper, a slow handwash sink, and a burnt-out hood light were also noted.

headline: Ice buildup in walk-in freezer
summary: A block of ice buildup on the condenser inside the walk-in freezer must be removed. Debris along walls and corners in utility and storage areas must be cleaned.

headline: No city sanitation certificate; greasy floors
summary: No city sanitation certificate was on premises or posted, and a citation was issued; a certified manager must be on site during operating hours.
