Flour, cornstarch, and dry goods were not labeled. Soiled mop heads must be hung to prevent insect breeding. Grease and food debris cover kitchen floors and walls.

headline: Greasy fan and fryers; leaking sink faucet
summary: A greasy fan in the rear prep area must be removed to prevent dust contaminating food. Shelving and stove and fryer sides have grease buildup and must be cleaned. The three-compartment sink faucet is loose and leaking. The sink seal is coming loose from the wall. An expired allergen certificate was found.

headline: Exterior door gap; peeling freezer film
summary: Re-inspection found a 1/4-inch gap between the exterior bar-side door and its frame; the person in charge must repair it. A two-door freezer has peeling protective film that must be removed and the surface kept smooth and cleanable.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods prepared
summary: No city certified food manager was on premises while gravy, sour cream, and cheese were prepared, a priority violation. Bar gun holders have pink buildup. Dust has built up on the prep reach-in condenser. The three-compartment sink drains slowly.

headline: Dishes on floor and too large for sink
summary: Re-inspection found dishes stored on the floor and must be raised at least 6 inches. Wiping cloths were left on the counter and must be stored in sanitizer. Dishes too big for the three-compartment sink require a clean-in-place procedure.

headline: No health policy; no allergen training
summary: No signed employee health policy was on site, a priority violation. A gap at the bottom of the front entry door must be sealed to prevent insect entry. Grease must be cleaned from the oven and grill. Broken concrete around a floor drain, and loose hood caulking were also noted. One of two managers lacks allergen training.

headline: Gaps in exit door; food debris behind equipment
summary: Second-floor exit door sweep must be repaired to prevent pest entry. Food debris in cooling equipment, bar liquor wells, and sink basins must be removed to prevent pest harborage. A second-floor bar sink is not draining and must be repaired. Trash and food debris behind the ice machine and under heavy equipment must be removed.

headline: Food debris inside cold holding units
summary: Accumulated food debris is inside all cold holding equipment and must be cleaned. Grease and food debris under cooking equipment in the rear prep area must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager while food is served
summary: No certified food sanitation manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared, stored, or served, a citation was issued. Cutting boards are scratched and stained and must be replaced. Debris, trash, and dirty floors need cleaning. A mop was stored improperly, and vent lint must be cleaned. Unused equipment and clutter from a 2023 violation were not removed.

headline: Failed: cold food too warm; sinks lack water
summary: Walk-in freezer ambient air measured 34 degrees; cold-holding equipment is insufficient for the menu, a priority violation. The rear washroom sink had no hot or cold water, and the prep sink water measured 125 degrees; the engineer repaired both during inspection. Food is stored in unbarred consumer areas, and waste receptacles lack covers.

headline: Sink blocked; dishwasher not sanitizing
summary: A large freezer blocked the only handwashing sink in the main kitchen, a priority violation with a citation. The low-temperature dish machine had no chlorine sanitizer at final rinse, a priority violation. Clean glasses were on a soiled towel, and an ice scoop was placed on a dusty ice maker.

headline: Failed: food held too warm; discarded
summary: Alfredo sauce at 52.1 degrees and cooked chicken at 51.9 degrees were held in a tagged walk-in cooler. About 30 pounds, valued near $200, were discarded and denatured, a citation issued. The cooler air measured 54.1 degrees; it must not be used until repaired. A repeat violation, the rear prep handwashing sink with a disconnected pipe, was not corrected.

headline: No food handler training records; hole in wall
summary: Re-inspection found no covered trash container in the restroom for feminine products. A large hole in the wall near the basement stairs must be sealed. No food handler training certificates were on site, and staff were told to require training.

headline: No certified manager; cooler at 55 degrees
summary: No one on site held an original city certified food manager certificate while beef and chicken were served, a priority violation. The cooking line cooler was 55 degrees with no food inside and was tagged. The certified manager must show allergen training.

headline: Cold food unsafe; dish machine failing
summary: Pork in a prep refrigerator was 50.1 degrees; about 10 pounds were discarded, a citation was issued. Dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm, and the manager repaired it during the inspection to 50 ppm, a citation was issued. Three-compartment sink water measured 71 degrees, a citation was issued. Handwashing sink water measured 71 degrees, and a handwashing sink is needed at the dishwashing area. Milk crates are used as shelving.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; no beard restraint
summary: Handwashing signage is missing at front and rear prep sinks and must be installed. A food handler was not wearing a beard restraint and must wear one while preparing food.

headline: Torn screen door; items stored on floor
summary: The front dining area screen door has a ripped screen and must be repaired. Chest freezer top is covered in rust. Pots, pans, soda, and water are stored on the rear prep floor and must be raised at least six inches. Food debris and greasy hood filters also need cleaning.

headline: Loose gasket, ice buildup, leaking drain pipe
summary: Single-use utensils were not inverted, which can expose lip-contact surfaces. Freezer door gasket was loose with ice buildup inside. A drain pipe under the dishwashing handwash sink is leaking. Floor tiles, grout, and stained ceiling tiles also need repair.

headline: Dirt and debris on floor drains
summary: Dirt and debris are on floor drains in the rear food storage area and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: No sanitation certificate; no backflow devices
summary: No city sanitation manager was on premises while milk and cream were handled, a citation was issued. Espresso and drip coffee machines lack backflow prevention devices. Handwashing signage is missing at the front sink, and food handlers lack food handler certificates.

headline: Gap under rear door; torn gaskets
summary: A 1/4-inch gap under the rear exit door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. A prep cooler and refrigerator have torn door gaskets that must be replaced.

headline: Low hand-sink water temperature; open entrance
summary: Water at a restroom handwashing sink measured 91.2 degrees Fahrenheit; it must reach at least 100 degrees, a priority violation with a citation. An open gap was found in the front entrance doors and must be sealed. No grease trap was on the three-compartment sink, and covered trash receptacles and a mop drying rack are needed.

headline: Dusty cooler fan covers; cluttered storage
summary: Storage racks and fan covers inside the pre-packaged sandwich and salad cooler must be detail cleaned to remove dust. The rear storage closet needs to be organized and cleared of unnecessary items to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Rust on shelving; slow sink drains
summary: Rust was found on bakery shelving and must be replaced or repaired. The deli three-compartment sink is in poor repair and drains slowly in all compartments. Missing ceiling tiles in the upstairs holiday storage room must be replaced.

headline: Broken thermometers; rodent-proof door needed
summary: Broken or missing thermometers were found in coolers storing dairy, milk, dips, and fresh cheeses. A sliding door in the online pickup area is not rodent-proof. Dried food debris needs cleaning from cooler interiors, and food, trash, and shelving near the floor need removal.

headline: No certified manager; no food handler certificates
summary: No person in charge had a valid certified food manager certificate while eggs, beans, rice, and steak were being prepared, a priority violation with a citation. No food handler certificates were shown. Large ice machine, bar equipment, and basement shelving need cleaning and maintenance. Leaky sink faucets were noted.

headline: Dead roaches; food stored in mop sink
summary: Dead roaches were on a glue board behind a cooler and in a chest freezer gasket and must be removed. Frozen meat was stored in a mop sink and was moved. Other issues include unlabeled packaged foods, a missing backflow device, cooler gaskets, and missing food handler certificates.

headline: Rat droppings; blocked sinks; failed
summary: Approximately 50 to 65 rat droppings were found on the main level and in the basement food prep and dishwashing areas. Pest control is recommended, a citation was issued. Two handwashing sinks were blocked by stored items, a citation was issued. Black slimy buildup was found inside the basement ice machine, a citation was issued. Dishware was not properly sanitized.

headline: Serving window not screened; dirty floor
summary: The serving window is not properly screened, which is a possible entry point for pests and must be fixed. The floor is dirty and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Mold inside ice machine; washroom door issues
summary: Pink and black mold was found inside the ice machine, and ice must be destroyed and the machine cleaned and sanitized. A slow-draining handwashing sink in the women's washroom must be repaired. Both men's and women's washroom doors do not self-close and must be repaired.

headline: Unlabeled oil and sauce bottles
summary: Two bottles of oil and sauce in the kitchen prep area lacked labels. Staff must label items with the common name when they are out of their original container.

headline: No certified manager during food service
summary: No certified food manager was on site while beef and sauerkraut were served, a priority violation with a citation. The handwashing sink in the kitchen drains slowly and must be repaired. The summary report was not posted where customers can see it, and a citation was issued.

headline: Ice buildup, littered dumpster area, greasy hoods
summary: Heavy ice buildup on a walk-in freezer condenser must be removed. Litter surrounds the garbage compactor enclosure and must be cleaned. Both kitchen exhaust hoods and filters need detail cleaning to remove grease buildup.

headline: Shellstock tags and vacuum-packed fat undated
summary: Shellstock tags lacked the date the last shellfish was sold or served, a citation was issued. Three packages of vacuum-packed animal fat lacked a vacuum date and were discarded, a citation was issued. The high-temperature dish machine wash at 141.2 degrees is below the required 160 degrees, a citation was issued. An opening at the rear exit door must be sealed.

headline: Dirty equipment; repeat core violations uncorrected
summary: Residue and debris were found inside cold-hold units and on hot-hold equipment. Previous core violations were not corrected: a missing splashguard, a cracked and missing floor tile area, and heavy grease in the ventilation system. A citation was issued.

headline: Dirty microwave; slow sink corrected on site
summary: Food splatter was found inside the microwave, and a cutting board has deep grooves and stains that must be cleaned or replaced. A slow-draining kitchen handwashing sink was a repeat violation with a citation. A handyman replaced the drain pipe during the inspection, and the sink is now in good repair.

headline: Wall hole, greasy shelving, cardboard liners
summary: A hole in the lower rear wall must be repaired to prevent possible pest activity; no pests were observed. Shelving has grease and dust buildup. Cardboard lining the kitchen shelving must be removed as a possible insect harborage. Cooler and cooking equipment need detail cleaning.

headline: No certified manager while handling chicken
summary: The person in charge lacked a city certificate, and no certificate was posted or manager present while chicken was handled. A citation was issued. A certified manager must be on site at all times while TCS foods are prepared.

headline: Cold foods too warm; drawer cooler at 50 degrees
summary: Ham, burgers, cheese, and guacamole were held at improper cold temperatures, and 18 pounds were discarded. A drawer cooler at the prep area measured 501 degrees and must not be used until it holds 41 degrees or below, a citation was issued. Employees lacked hair restraints, and kitchen hood and filters have grease buildup.

headline: Leaking pipe inside walk-in cooler
summary: A leaking pipe inside the walk-in cooler must be repaired or replaced and kept in good condition.

headline: Hot water faucet stripped; cracked light shields
summary: A handwashing signage is needed behind the front bar. The bottom of the side entrance door must be rodent-proofed. Storage racks and a walk-in cooler have grease and white mold-like buildup. An ice bin lacks a lid. Cracked light shields above the kitchen prep area must be replaced.

headline: No food-safety certificate; no thermometer; no pest log
summary: No valid city food-service certificate was posted, and a citation was issued. No paper towels were at exposed handwashing sinks, a citation was issued. No food thermometer was on site, and a citation was issued. No pest control logbook was available, and a citation was issued. Food handler training and allergen training records were missing.

headline: No certified manager on duty; no citation posting
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while sandwiches, eggs, burritos, and soups were handled, and a citation was issued. No vomiting and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure was on site, and a citation was issued. Signed employee health policies were missing. The inspection summary was not posted for the public, and a citation was issued.

headline: No certified manager; no food handler training
summary: Food handlers prepared TCS foods without an original city certificate or certified manager on site, a citation was issued. No written employee health policy, a citation was issued. Thawing frozen chicken on a prep table was improper. Food containers were stored on the floor, and no proof of food handler or allergen training was on site.

headline: No paper towels; no thermometers
summary: Paper towels were not provided at the prep area and employee restroom handwashing sinks. No food temperature measuring device or probe thermometer was on site, and the front prep cooler is missing a thermometer. The three-compartment sink has a leaky faucet that cannot be shut off.

headline: No certified manager; food temperatures unsafe
summary: No certified food manager was on site while food was prepared, and a citation was issued; the manager arrived at 9:58 a.m. with a certificate. Cooked egg dishes were too cool when hot-held and too warm when cold-held; about 25 pounds were discarded. A hand sink was blocked and had no soap or paper towels at one station.

headline: Freezer drips; overloaded dumpster; leaking waste
summary: Heavy condensation dripped onto food in the freezer; 10 pounds of product were voluntarily discarded, a citation was issued. Dumpster overloaded and lid could not close; a citation was issued. A rolloff dumpster leaked liquid food waste, and employees cleaned the area immediately. Torn steamer gasket and floors need cleaning.

headline: No hot water; priority violation; citation issued
summary: No hot water was found at employee restroom sinks on the lower level and first-floor coffee station. Water measured 61.5 degrees. Building maintenance repaired it on the day of inspection, restoring hot water to 114.5 degrees. A citation was issued.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink; greasy walls
summary: The three-compartment sink in the rear prep area leaks from the middle basin and must be repaired. Grease buildup and dust were found on walls and storage racks and must be cleaned.

headline: Dead insects, food on floor, no hair restraints
summary: Dead insects were found on walls and floors under equipment and in corners in prep and storage areas. Food was stored on the floor and raw chicken was in grocery bags in a freezer. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Missing food handler training and a leaking sink faucet were also noted.

headline: Missing thermometers; slow drains; dirty floors
summary: Working thermometers are needed in two-door prep refrigerators in the rear food prep area. Working stoppers are needed at the basement bar three-compartment sink. A women's washroom sink drains slowly, and the basement bar sink needs more water pressure. Grease and dirt are on floors under cooking equipment, and peeling paint is in basement washrooms.

headline: No certified manager; pests and cleanliness issues
summary: No certified food manager was on site while pizza and salads were prepared; one arrived about an hour into the inspection. Front doors and windows were found open. Wet wiping cloths were left out, gaskets were torn, and mold-like growth was found behind a sprayer. Food handler certificates could not be verified.

headline: Rusty prep table; leaking faucet base
summary: No handwashing signs are near the basement sink and must be provided. Food storage containers lack labels when food is not in its original packaging. A rusty bottom of a prep table must be repainted. The faucet base at the basement sink leaks.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; no hot water
summary: No certified food manager was on site at the start of the inspection and arrived before the walk-through ended; a citation was issued. Doors are not rodent-proof at the bottom, and no recent pest control report was available, a citation was issued. Hot water measured 65.3 to 65.5 degrees, and a citation was issued. Cold holding units and floors need cleaning.

headline: Cold foods too warm; no certified manager
summary: No person in charge with a valid certificate was present, and no manager or posted certificate was on site while TCS food was served; a citation was issued. Diced tomatoes, Polish sausage, and hot dogs were held at 55.3, 54.9, and 49.5 degrees Fahrenheit and discarded. A prep cooler held 48.3 degrees, is tagged held for inspection, and must not be used until reinspected. No food handler training was available.

headline: Bulk flour and sugar unlabeled
summary: Bulk storage containers of flour and sugar lack labels. All bulk and working ingredient containers must be labeled with their contents.

headline: Improper thawing and screen gaps noted
summary: Prepared foods were thawed improperly on a prep table; proper thawing under refrigeration was reviewed. An inaccurate thermometer in a cooler must be replaced. Door screens must fit tightly. Wiping cloths must be kept in sanitizer, and stored items under the bar must be raised off the floor.

headline: Over 30 mouse droppings; pest activity
summary: Over 30 mouse droppings were found, including behind the boiler, under the three-compartment sink, and inside cooking fryers. This is a priority violation with a citation. Pest activity must be eliminated, and affected areas cleaned and sanitized. A pink mineral substance inside the ice machine also needs cleaning.

headline: No certified manager while burgers served
summary: No certified food manager was on site while burgers were prepared and served, a priority violation with a citation. A minor leak below the rear bar handsink must be repaired. An expired allergen training certificate was on site.

headline: Dirty can opener and cutting board
summary: A large can opener needs cleaning to remove debris from the blade. A cutting board has dark spots and deep grooves and must be corrected. The oven room handwashing sink leaks at the P-trap and must be repaired.

headline: Dusty bathroom ceiling fan covers
summary: Dust has built up on bathroom ceiling fan covers. They must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Failed re-inspection: no certified manager
summary: No valid certified manager was on duty while chicken and fish were prepared, a citation was issued. A food handler lacked hair restraint. Plastic shelves, bulk containers, and reach-in coolers need cleaning. A faucet neck leaks, and an unresolved dumpster violation requires detail cleaning and lids.

headline: Missing handwashing sinks; food on floor
summary: No handwashing sink, soap, or paper towels are at the basement prep table. The prep area lacks a handwashing sink. Food containers are stored on the floor in prep, storage, and walk-in areas and must be raised six inches. Serving plates and an ice scoop stored inside the ice machine must be corrected.

headline: Live roaches found; repeat violation
summary: Two live roaches were found in the basement and one in the doorway to the garbage area, a priority violation with a citation. Pest control service is recommended. A dirty cooler gasket and slow handwashing sink drainage were also noted. A repeat violation for unused equipment and clutter in the basement was not corrected, a citation was issued.

headline: Food grime, gaskets, and a drain pipe issue
summary: An insect-catching device was installed above the prep counter and must be moved to a non-food area. Gaskets throughout the facility have excessive food grime buildup. A cooler condenser pipe drains into a handwashing sink and must be moved to a proper drain.

headline: No sink signs; cold water handle stripped
summary: Handwashing signs are missing at the rear prep sink, and dry storage containers lack product names. Cardboard and aluminum linings must be removed. The cold water knob is stripped, and no covered receptacle is in the women's or employees' restrooms. Items on the floor must be raised, and food and grease debris must be cleaned.

headline: Failed re-inspection: health policy, leaks, pests
summary: No employee health policy or training was on site. Wastewater leaks near the grease box and behind the three-compartment sink, a priority violation. The front door bottom needs rodent-proofing. Missing hood filters and a backflow device not behind the ice machine were also noted, along with cleaning and repair items.

headline: Leaking faucet at three-compartment sink
summary: Re-inspection found a leak at the base of the three-compartment sink faucet. The person in charge must repair it and maintain it.

headline: Missing grout and dirty floor drains
summary: Re-inspection found missing grout between floor tiles in the rear prep and dishwashing areas, which must be regrouted for cleanability. Buildup inside floor drains under the three-compartment sink and high-temperature dish machine must be cleaned.

headline: Cracked light shields, greasy hood, faucet repair
summary: A cold water faucet handle on the rear three-compartment sink needs replacing. The hood vent system needs cleaning to remove some dripping grease. Cracked light shields in the rear prep area must be replaced.

headline: Ice scoop stored exposed
summary: The ice scoop was stored on the side of the ice machine with its food-contact surface exposed. Staff were instructed on proper storage between uses.

headline: No city sanitation certificate; dirty microwave
summary: No valid city sanitation certificate was on site, a priority violation with a citation. A certified manager and valid certificate must be on site whenever TCS foods are prepared. Food debris inside the microwave and a blown hood light were also noted.

headline: Missing handwash signs; unapproved insect device
summary: Handwashing signs are missing at the prep area sink. An unapproved insect control device hangs over the rear prep and cooling station and must be removed. Styrofoam plates and trays face up and must be inverted. Torn gaskets are on a two-door produce cooler. Food spills are at a reach-in freezer bottom. No food handler certificates could be verified.

headline: Cold food too warm; expired rice; no pest log
summary: Eggs at 66 degrees, cooked rice at 49 to 62 degrees, and potato samosas at 73 degrees were found in the walk-in cooler and prep area, a citation issued. Cooked rice prepared 5/28/24 was kept past the 7-day limit, a citation issued. The pest control logbook had only one report from the past year. Outside garbage and litter need cleanup, and food handler certificates were not provided.

headline: Greasy fryers; holes in walls
summary: Fryers need light cleaning to remove grease. Floors around and behind equipment must be cleaned. A hole in the front corner wall must be sealed, and an opening along the north wallbase in the back area must be sealed where needed. The exhaust system interior needs cleaning.

headline: Flies in bakery; hot water too cool; citations
summary: Approximately 15 small flies were crawling on the floor under the dough table, and about 10 were flying in the bakery and basement corner. Pest control service is needed. Hot water at handwashing sinks measured 68.7 to 81.5 degrees Fahrenheit, and was restored during inspection. Rotting ribs with white mold, about 20 pounds, were discarded.

headline: Cockroach activity throughout premises
summary: Dead cockroaches were found throughout the premises, in corners, behind heavy equipment, on walls and floors, and in the basement. Dead flying insects were also found in corners and the basement. Staff must remove them, detail clean, sanitize, and maintain the premises.

headline: Rust found; no prep sink; leaks and upkeep
summary: Rust-like substance found in a dipper well and drain. Staff were told to remove it and clean and sanitize. A leaking sink stopper must be repaired. The front prep area needs at least one prep sink. Wall, ceiling, and lighting upkeep also noted.

headline: No health policy or handwashing sink; no training
summary: No employee health policy was available, a priority violation. No handwashing sink exists in the rear prep and dishwashing area, and one must be installed. A metal stem thermometer is missing, a priority violation. Food handlers and certified managers lack food handler and allergen training. Bulk containers are unlabeled and hood filters are missing.

headline: No grease trap on three-compartment sink
summary: No grease trap is on site for the three-compartment sink. The manager must provide a grease trap or catch basin.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; not in use
summary: The dish machine was not sanitizing, measuring 0 ppm of chlorine, and was tagged and held for inspection by the Chicago Department of Public Health. Staff must wash dishes in the three-compartment sink until it is re-inspected. An electric insect control device above the prep table must be relocated.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and trash lids
summary: Handwashing signs are missing at exposed sinks in bars. Both women's restrooms lack a covered trash container. Grime and food debris were found on a wall-mounted potato slicer. Staff were told to fix each issue.

headline: No paper towels; no thermometer in cold unit
summary: Paper towels were not provided at handwashing sinks in the rear kitchen and employee washroom, a citation was issued. The person in charge supplied them during the inspection. The rear upright cold-holding unit lacks a thermometer. Clutter in the stairwell storage hall and a missing light bulb were also noted.

headline: Peeling ceiling paint; greasy hood
summary: Peeling paint on the ceiling in the rear food storage area must be repainted. Grease buildup on the ventilation hood and filters above cooking equipment must be cleaned.

headline: Hair restraints missing; broken stairs and floors
summary: Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Exposed brick is used as a stabilizer under prep tables and equipment and must be removed. The toilet room door does not close. Basement stairs are broken, and there are large holes and mold-like substance on basement walls. Cracked floor tiles and debris were also found.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; greasy equipment
summary: Large grey garbage cans hold sugar and flour without common-name labels and are not food-grade containers. Fan vents in the walk-in cooler are dusty. Grease and food debris cover equipment and shelving, which must be cleaned to prevent pests. Ceiling hole, floor debris, and burnt-out front lights were also noted.

headline: Unlabeled food containers; allergen certificate missing
summary: Items were stored outside original containers without product-name labels, and staff must label all foods and spices. A food service sanitation manager lacked an allergen training certificate and was told to obtain one.

headline: Missing thermometer; cracked light shield
summary: A thermometer is missing from the small cooler near the three-compartment sink and must be provided. A cracked light shield in the walk-in freezer must be replaced.

headline: No sanitation certificate; sink blocked
summary: No city sanitation certificate was on site, a citation was issued; a valid certificate must be on site whenever TCS foods are prepared. The kitchen prep handwashing sink was blocked by a table and buckets, a citation was issued. Ice machine, cold holding units, and prep tables need cleaning. Food handler certificates for new hires were missing.

headline: Greasy hood and pipes over cook line
summary: Re-inspection found a buildup of grease on the hood and on pipes coming out of the hood above the cook line. Staff were told to detail clean and keep the system in good condition.

headline: No covered trash cans in restroom
summary: The all-gender restroom has no covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. No waste receptacle was at the handwashing sink where paper towels are provided. Both must be provided.

headline: Failed re-inspection: dumpster lids missing
summary: Outside garbage dumpster lids are missing and must be replaced; this is a priority violation with a citation. Bulk spices lack labels. Ice scoops and bowls were misused, and a cutting board has deep stains and grooves. Grease, dirt, and food debris cover the fryers, grill, floors, and walls, and the three-compartment sink leaks. Missing sink stoppers and missing allergen training for a manager were also noted.

headline: Damaged floor tile; debris and buildup on floors
summary: Damaged floor tile in front of the left side of the dish machine must be repaired or replaced. Debris and black buildup on floors, in corners, along walls, under the dish machine, under cooking equipment, and in the bar must be cleaned.

headline: Repeat violations: no backflow device; no training
summary: Repeat core violations were not corrected from a 2023 report. The ice machine lacks a backflow prevention device. Food handlers lack training, and a certified manager has an expired allergen certificate. A torn cooler gasket and grease on the hood also need attention.

headline: Greasy used cooking oil container
summary: Grease buildup was found on the outside of the used cooking oil container in the rear garbage corral. Staff must detail clean and maintain it in good condition.

headline: Missing sink stoppers; no utility mop sink
summary: Three-compartment sink stoppers are missing and must be provided. No utility mop sink with hot and cold water and backflow prevention exists on the premises. Food debris and spills are on floors and surfaces, and the rear hood filters have dust.

headline: Door openings let pests in; expired allergen certificates
summary: Openings were found at the base and middle of the front entrance doors and at the base of the rear exit door; they must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Splashguards are missing at two handwashing sinks. Other issues include a leaking hot-water knob, stained or missing ceiling tiles, and expired allergen training certificates for several employees.

headline: No health policy; no vomit and diarrhea procedure
summary: No employee health policy was on site, a priority violation. No written procedure or adequate supplies existed for vomiting and diarrhea events, a priority violation. Both must be kept on site at all times.

headline: Over 60 mouse droppings found throughout
summary: Over 60 mouse droppings were found on floors, under shelves and near equipment. The manager was told to call an exterminator and clean all areas. A citation was issued. The certified manager lacked allergen training. Failed.

headline: Uncertified manager while preparing ready-to-eat food
summary: A food service manager without city certification was on site while sliced tomatoes, chicken and other ready-to-eat foods were prepared. A citation was issued. Heavy leak under the three-compartment sink and greasy hood systems also noted. Passed with conditions.

headline: No handsoap, paper towels or health policy
summary: No employee health policy was on site. There was no hand soap at some hand sinks and no paper towels at food prep hand sinks. Cigarette butts and an ashtray were found, so smoking was stopped. A citation was issued. Failed.

headline: No handwashing sign; food handler without hair restraint
summary: No handwashing sign was posted in the toilet room. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. The operator was instructed to correct both. Passed.

headline: Dish machine too cool; food handlers without hair restraints
summary: The high-temperature dish machine rinsed at 155.1F, but must reach 180F to sanitize. It was tagged and held for inspection, and a citation was issued. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Passed with conditions.

headline: Wastewater backed up onto floor; plumber fixed it
summary: Waste water backed up onto the floor from a floor drain when the three-compartment sink drained. A plumber fixed the problem during the inspection. A citation was issued. Milk crates used for storage and extra cardboard also noted. Passed with conditions.

headline: No backflow devices at mop sink and ice machine
summary: There were no backflow prevention devices at the mop sink faucet or the ice machine. Devices must be provided in a location where they can be serviced. Passed.

headline: No certified food manager during chicken prep
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken and other foods that must be kept hot or cold were being prepped. A citation was issued. Fryer, cooking equipment and prep tables had grease and debris. Passed with conditions.

headline: Long spoons left in room-temperature standing water
summary: In-use long spoons were kept in stagnant water at room temperature. Staff were told to store utensils according to the health code. Live potted plants were too close to clean utensils at the front service line. Passed.

headline: Food stored on floors; grease-coated hood
summary: Food containers were stored on floors in prep, storage and walk-in areas and must be raised six inches. Cardboard and foil lined shelves, which can hide pests. Heavy grease was on the hood and filters. Passed.

headline: Unlabeled bulk container; cracked deli cups
summary: A bulk food container and spray bottle at the cook line were not labeled. Deli cups were not air dried and some had cracked edges at the sink area. Passed.

headline: Dirty wet floors near cooking equipment
summary: Dirty and wet floors were found around the cooking equipment and must be cleaned and kept dry. Serving plates on shelves were not stored upside down. Vents above the dish machine were dusty. Passed.

headline: No test kit for bleach sanitizer
summary: There was no chemical test kit on site to measure the bleach sanitizer. A citation was issued. The three-compartment sink faucet leaked and splashed, and the walk-in cooler door handle needed repair. Failed.

headline: Slimy ice machine; about 30 flying insects
summary: Black slimy substance inside the ice machine dripped into ice, and a citation was issued. About 30 live small flying insects were on walls and a dish machine. The inspector noted improper pest control. Failed.

headline: Chicken thawed in standing water; hair restraints missing
summary: Chicken was thawing in a full compartment of standing water and must thaw under cool running water. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Cooler racks had rust and the walk-in floor was a trip hazard. Passed.

headline: Black slime dripping from ice machine into ice
summary: Excessive black slime built up inside an ice machine and dripped onto ice for people to eat. Ready-to-eat cooked foods were not date marked. Food was stored on the walk-in floor. Failed.

headline: No thermometer in cooler; food handlers uncertified
summary: A two-door prep cooler had no working thermometer. Several food handlers had no food handler certificate, and the certified manager lacked allergen training. Storage room floor needs cleaning near the grease interceptor. Passed.

headline: No backflow device at ice machine waterline
summary: No backflow prevention device was found at the ice machine waterline. One must be provided in a place where it can be serviced. Passed.

headline: No metal stem thermometer; dirty floors and walls
summary: No metal stem thermometer was on site to check food temperatures. Floors under equipment and walls around sinks had food, dirt and grease. A food handler had no certificate. Passed.

headline: Walls not clean in prep and dish areas
summary: Walls at the front prep area and in the rear storage and dishwashing area were not clean. The operator must clean walls throughout. Passed.

headline: Live cockroaches found near basement hand sink
summary: Three live cockroaches were seen on a wall in the basement food prep area near an exposed hand sink. More pest control service is needed. A citation was issued. Failed.

headline: Expired allergen training for one manager
summary: One of two certified managers had expired allergen training. Torn gaskets were found on a prep cooler, and the restroom needs a self-closing door device and handwashing signage. Passed.

headline: Sewage backed up at three-compartment sink
summary: Sewage backed up through the floor drain at the three-compartment sink when water was running. The operator was told to fix the plumbing. A citation was issued. Passed with conditions.

headline: No paper towels; grease spilling into alley
summary: No paper towels were at an employee washroom hand sink, and a citation was issued. A broken grease container was spilling grease into the alley. Grease and food debris were on fryers and cooking equipment. Failed.

headline: No certified manager on arrival; food too warm
summary: No certified food manager was on site when the inspector arrived. Foods that must be kept cold were held at 66F, and about 20 dollars of food was discarded. Dumpster lids were broken or would not close. A citation was issued. Failed.

headline: No handwashing signs; floors dirty near bar
summary: No handwashing signage was posted at the hand sink. Floors along walls and under equipment, especially at the front bar, had dirt, debris and grime. Passed.

headline: Sanitation manager has no allergen training
summary: A sanitation manager did not have allergen training. The operator must provide proof of training. Passed.

headline: Rusty, leaking grease trap under sink
summary: The grease trap under the three-compartment sink was rusted and leaking. The ice machine interior must be cleaned and sanitized. Restroom trash cans had no lids and the prep area vent cover was dirty. Passed.

headline: Dish machine at zero chlorine; tagged out
summary: The low-temperature dish machine had no chlorine in its final rinse, so it was tagged held for inspection and must not be used until repaired. No employee health policy verification was available. Passed with conditions.

headline: Mold-like substance inside kitchen ice machine
summary: A black and beige mold-like substance was found inside the large kitchen ice machine. The operator must clean and sanitize it to prevent ice contamination. An opening at a front door could let pests in. Failed.

headline: Cook line utensils stored in water too cool
summary: Cook line utensils were stored in water at 120.7F. Hot water storage must stay at 135F or higher, or utensils must be stored properly and washed every four hours. Passed.

headline: Rear shelves and restroom walls not cleanable
summary: Rear storage shelves and restroom walls were not smooth and easily cleanable. They must be restored and kept that way. Failed.

headline: No pest control logbook on premises
summary: No pest control logbook was on site. The manager must provide one from a licensed Illinois pest control operator. No pests were reported in these notes. Failed.

headline: Gaps under doors; food on walk-in freezer floor
summary: Gaps at the bottom of overhead and entrance doors could let pests in and must be sealed. Food was stored on the walk-in freezer floor and must be raised six inches. A thermometer was missing from the deli cooler. Passed.

headline: Dirty soda ice shoot; no hair restraints
summary: The plastic ice shoot on the soda dispenser was dirty and must be cleaned. All food handlers in the prep area must wear hair restraints. Plastic crates were used for elevation in the walk-in cooler. Passed.

headline: No certified manager or health policy on site
summary: No person in charge held a Chicago food sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was on site or had a posted certificate. No employee health policy was available. Failed.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site
summary: There was no vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on the premises to respond to accidents. Passed with conditions.

headline: Cooked chicken held too warm; cooler tagged out
summary: Cooked chicken was cooling improperly and the three-door cooler was at 68.8F, not 41F or below. Cooked chicken reached 96.6F. All food was discarded, and the cooler was tagged. A citation was issued. Passed with conditions.

headline: Unlabeled sink compartments; water-damaged ceiling tiles
summary: The three-compartment sink was not labeled for wash, rinse and sanitize. The restroom had no covered receptacle for sanitary products. Water-damaged ceiling tiles were found in the dining area and prep area. Passed.

headline: Food spills on rear prep floors need cleaning
summary: Floors in the rear prep area had food spills. The inspector told the operator to clean them and keep them clean. Passed.

headline: Food stored in grocery bags; grease buildup
summary: Some food in the walk-in freezer was stored in grocery bags and must use food-grade bags. Fryers, cooking equipment, walls and floors had heavy grease and food debris. Dish racks were unclean and vents need cleaning. Passed.

headline: Unlabeled squeeze bottles; missing sink stoppers
summary: Squeeze bottles in the front prep area were not labeled. Two sink stoppers were missing from the three-compartment sink. Floors throughout the facility need cleaning. The certified manager lacked allergen training. Passed.

headline: No employee health policy or vomit cleanup kit
summary: No written employee health policy and no vomiting and diarrhea cleanup kit were on site. A citation-level priority item. Cork shelf lining, a toilet room trash can without a cover, and dirty floors and hand sink also noted. Passed.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: A city food service sanitation manager did not have the required allergen training certificate. The inspector instructed the operator to meet the requirement. Passed.

headline: Rodent evidence and live roaches in dining room
summary: Evidence of rodent activity was found. About 3 live roaches and 1 dead roach were seen in the dining room. Additional pest control is needed. A citation was issued. Food was stored on floors. Failed.

headline: No certified food manager on duty during food prep
summary: No person in charge held a valid Chicago food sanitation certificate. No certified food manager was on duty while chicken, rice and steak were prepared and served. A citation was issued. Passed with conditions.

headline: Roaches and flies; raw chicken above ready-to-eat food
summary: Over 15 live roaches and over 20 flying insects were seen in prep and storage areas. Raw chicken was stored above yogurt. Several foods kept cold were too warm, and about 51 pounds were discarded. A citation was issued. Failed.

headline: Wiping cloths and equipment stored improperly
summary: Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizing solution when not in use. Multi-use equipment was not stored upside down. Staff were told to fix both. Passed.

headline: Wiping cloths left on cutting board
summary: Wiping cloths were stored improperly on a cutting board and must be kept in sanitizing solution when not in use. Light shields in the prep area were dusty. Passed.

headline: Hand sink blocked and used for dishes; citation
summary: The front prep hand sink was not accessible, and an employee was rinsing glassware inside it. Management was told it must be used only for handwashing. A citation was issued. Certified manager also lacks allergen training. Passed with conditions.

headline: Pink buildup in ice machines; leaking sink pipe
summary: Both basement ice machines had pink buildup inside and must be cleaned. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. A basement hand sink pipe was leaking and washrooms had no covered trash cans. Passed.

headline: Dishwasher broken; mold in ice machine; coolers too warm
summary: The warewashing unit was inoperable. Ice machine interior had black and brown mold-like substance and ice had to be discarded. Cooler drawers under the grill reached 80F. No certified manager certificate was on site. Failed.

headline: No certified manager while chicken prepared
summary: No city certified food manager was on site while chicken and rice were prepared, cooked and served. Thermometers were not visible in the facility. Butcher-area plastic cutting boards had dark grooves. Passed with conditions.

headline: No certified manager while milk and eggs handled
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while foods that must be kept hot or cold, such as milk and eggs, were handled and served. No sanitizer test strips were on site for the three-compartment sink. Passed with conditions.

headline: Cooling unit and bar surfaces need cleaning
summary: Internal surfaces of a cooling unit in the basement prep area and the bar had dried food debris and need cleaning. A toilet room door was not latching fully and needs adjustment. Passed.

headline: Dirty butcher area: grooved boards and walls
summary: Stained cutting boards with deep dark grooves were found in the meat butcher prep area. Walls were not coved, and walls and floors had food and dirt debris. The operator must clean, sanitize, and fix the surfaces. Passed.

headline: Pink slime inside rear ice machine
summary: A slight buildup of pink slime was found inside the ice machine in the rear of the facility. The operator must detail clean it and maintain it. Passed.

headline: Oysters mixed together; food discarded on site
summary: Oysters were mixed together in a prep cooler. Management discarded about 30 pounds, worth about 325 dollars, and was told to stop. Bar hand sink had no paper towels or handwashing sign. A citation was issued. Passed with conditions.

headline: Dusty floors under front soda bar
summary: Loose debris, dirt and dust had built up on the floor and drain under the front soda bar. The operator must detail clean and increase floor cleaning. Passed.

headline: Cooked chicken vacuum-packed without approved variance
summary: Cooked chicken was packaged in reduced-oxygen packaging without an approved city variance. About 15 pounds were discarded and the machine was tagged to stop use. A citation was issued. Passed with conditions.

headline: Dirty ice bin and peeling pizza-area ceiling paint
summary: The ice bin interior in the basement was dirty and must be cleaned. Ceiling paint in the front pizza prep area was cracked and peeling and must be repainted. Passed.

headline: Salsa and guacamole too warm; flying insects
summary: Salsa at 50 to 53F and guacamole at 51F were held too warm in a walk-in and a prep cooler, which was 50F. About 40 live small flying insects were on walls and ceilings of the first floor and basement. A citation was issued. Failed.

headline: No handwashing signs; certified manager untrained
summary: No handwashing signs were posted at hand sinks. Single-use lids were not stored upside down, and straws and cups were stored under a hand sink. The certified manager on duty had no allergen training. Passed.

headline: Soiled linens on hand sink; no training proof
summary: Soiled linens hung on a hand sink splash guard. Cardboard was used as shelf liner and plumber putty was used on pipes under a hand sink. No food handler or allergen training proof was provided. Passed.

headline: Half-inch gap under passenger side door
summary: A half-inch gap at the bottom of the passenger side door could let pests in. Management was told to seal all outer openings. Passed.

headline: Ceiling panels slimy and falling in restroom
summary: Several ceiling panels in the employee restroom were covered in slime and falling apart. Hood lights over the cook line did not work. Freezer gaskets were torn and there was no covered trash can in the restroom. Passed.

headline: Dry food stored under waste water pipes
summary: Dry storage food in the basement was stored under waste water pipes that could leak onto it. Food must be moved or a barrier installed. Passed.

headline: Ice machine calcium buildup; wood on wall
summary: Ice machine chute had calcium buildup and the reach-in cooler interior needs cleaning. A leaky drain pipe under the rinse sink needs repair. Milk crates were used as shelves and garbage area debris was found. Passed.

headline: About 15 live flying insects in food prep areas
summary: About 15 live small flying insects were on walls and stock boxes in food prep areas, the dining room and sandwich pickup area. Additional pest control is needed. A citation was issued. Failed.

headline: Pink substance in ice machine; no allergen training
summary: A small amount of light pink substance was found inside an ice machine and must be cleaned. No allergen training was on site for the city food managers. Passed.

headline: Missing allergen training; openings at rear doors
summary: Stained cutting boards were found in prep areas, and a rooftop restroom had no covered waste container. The certified manager lacked allergen training. Openings at rear doors and missing backflow devices on espresso machines were not corrected. Failed.

headline: Cooler too warm; no soap or paper towels at sinks
summary: A front prep cooler held an unsafe 49.1F. A rear cooler was not turned on and more cooling is needed. Soap and paper towels were missing at prep-area hand sinks, and no food handler or allergen training certificates were on site. Failed.

headline: Food stored on floor; greasy fryer and hood
summary: Plastic containers and boxes of food were stored on the floor throughout the premises and must be raised. Food containers were not labeled. Grease and debris were on fryers, grill, prep tables and walls. A one-compartment sink leg is broken. Passed.

headline: No health policy; no paper towels or training proof
summary: No written employee health policy or valid food handler certificates were on site. Hand sinks lacked paper towels and some lacked handwashing signs. Food handlers had no training certificates. Small gap at front door. Failed.

headline: Wrong sanitizer used in dish machine; corrected
summary: The low-temperature dish machine was using a wrong sanitizer at 0 ppm. Chlorine was installed on site and sanitized properly at 50 ppm before the inspection ended. A citation was issued. Other issues include no basement hand sink and no food handler training proof. Failed.

headline: Black substance on hand sink seal
summary: A black substance lined the seal on a hand sink next to a wire rack. The operator must remove it and recaulk the seal. Passed.

headline: Sink drains need detail cleaning
summary: Drains at the three-compartment sink, one-compartment sink and near the soda dispenser storage need detail cleaning. This is to prevent possible pest or insect activity. Passed.

headline: No valid food sanitation certificates for employees
summary: Employees did not have valid city food sanitation certificates, and a certified manager must be on premises at all times. A citation was issued. Torn cooler gasket, raw deli meat in grocery bags, and no food handler training records. Passed with conditions.

headline: Greasy dish machine and rusty cooler racks
summary: Dish machine interior had grease buildup. Walk-in cooler racks were rusty and a rear cooler door gasket was broken. Restroom handwashing sign missing. Floors need cleaning. Passed.

headline: Containers washed without sanitizer; corrected on site
summary: An employee washed food containers with only soap and water and did not set up the three-compartment sink or use sanitizer. After instruction, containers were properly washed and sanitized. A citation was issued. Passed with conditions.

headline: Old violations not fixed; food in open can
summary: Food was stored in an open original can and must go into food-grade containers. Peeling paint and exposed brick in the basement need repair. Earlier food handler and allergen training violations were not corrected. A citation was issued. Passed with conditions.

headline: Peeling paint and greasy stove vent
summary: Peeling paint was on a hall wall next to the chest freezer and must be repaired. The vent above the stove had excessive buildup and must be cleaned. Passed.

headline: Food handler not wearing hair restraint
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. The inspector instructed the employee to wear one. Passed.

headline: No certified manager while open and selling food
summary: No certified food manager was on site while the business was open and selling hot dogs and chicken. A citation was issued. A thermometer was missing from a cooler and debris and spills were found in several storage areas. Passed with conditions.

headline: Employee lacks food handler training certificate
summary: An employee had no food handler training certificate on site and must obtain one. Floor under a sink, a sticky door, and walls around sinks need cleaning. Passed.

headline: No drain board for three-compartment sink
summary: The three-compartment sink had no drain board. The operator was instructed to install one. Passed.

headline: Live and dead roaches found throughout dining area
summary: Three live roaches were crawling along a wall and under a hot water tank. Numerous dead roaches were found under the grease trap, at the register hand sink and in dining area soda cabinets. A citation was issued. Failed.

headline: Roaches not found; 20 flying insects and hot sink
summary: About 20 live small flying insects were on walls and ceiling of the food prep area. Hand sink water exceeded 120F and could not be controlled by users. A citation was issued for each. Failed.

headline: Leaking restroom hand sink; holes in wall
summary: Restroom hand sink valves leaked excessively from below the sink. The wall behind the sink had holes and peeling paint. Both must be repaired. Passed.

headline: Unlabeled containers; raw wood needs sealant
summary: Food storage containers were not labeled and packaged items on display lacked labels. Raw wood sliding door and shelving in the front storage closet must be sealed or painted. Passed.

headline: Dusty ceiling vents in women's restroom
summary: Ceiling vents in the women's restroom were dusty. Staff were told to clean and maintain them. No food safety problems were noted.

headline: Bowl too large for sink; manager lacks allergen training
summary: A mixing bowl is too large to fit in any 3-compartment sink. The manager was told to create a written clean-in-place procedure. A certified food manager has no food allergen training and was told to comply.

headline: Counter and floor debris
summary: Countertops and storage shelving must be cleaned to remove spills and debris. Floors need cleaning along wall bases and in corners to remove debris.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; no health policy
summary: Low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm, was tagged, and may not be used; the 3-compartment sink must be used instead. No employee health policy on site. No grease trap at the 3-compartment sinks.

headline: Hair restraint not worn in prep area
summary: A food handler in the food prep area was not wearing a hair restraint. Staff were instructed to provide and maintain one while in the prep area.

headline: Front door gap needs tight seal
summary: The front exit door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom. A tight-fitting seal is required at all outer openings to keep pests out.

headline: Missing refrigeration thermometers; scoop problems
summary: Refrigeration units lacked working thermometers. Cheese was scooped with to-go containers that have no handles; staff must use tongs, spoons or ladles. Restroom trash cans lacked lids, and all items were ordered corrected.

headline: Gaps in doors allow pest entry; leaking faucet
summary: Front door has a 1/2-inch gap and overhead doors have gaps over 1 inch at the bottom corners. Manager must seal all outer openings to prevent pest entry. Leaking hot faucet at 3-compartment sink; hand dryer not working.

headline: No manager certificate posted; no test strips
summary: No City of Chicago foodservice manager certificate was posted on site; citation issued. No thermometer in prep cooler. No chlorine test strips for low-temperature dish machine; citation issued. Cutting board deeply grooved and stained.

headline: Light shield missing; two managers lack allergen training
summary: A light fixture near cooking equipment needs a shield or shatterproof bulbs. Two certified food managers have no allergen training certificates and must complete training and keep certificates on site.

headline: Food bucket on floor; wet mops need hanging
summary: A bucket of food stored on the walk-in cooler floor must be elevated. Containers need labels. Grease and food debris must be cleaned from cooking equipment, coolers and freezers. A hook system is needed to hang wet mops.

headline: Ice machine residue; damaged cooler gasket
summary: Residue on the ice machine interior panel must be cleaned. The door gasket on the front prep cooler is damaged and must be repaired. Unisex staff washroom lacks a covered receptacle.

headline: Food containers not inverted; dirty floors
summary: Food containers were not stored inverted and must be stored that way. Floors at the 3-compartment sink area are not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Potatoes on floor; inoperable urinal; no allergen training
summary: Potatoes in a cardboard box on the floor by the 3-compartment sink must be stored 6 inches up. Urinal is inoperable and front hand sink leaks. Outdoor bin lid missing; citation issued. Repeat allergen training violation.

headline: Torn freezer gasket; water-damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Several wooden bowls and rubber spatulas are burnt, chipped or broken and must be replaced. Rear prep freezer has a torn door gasket and exposed insulation. Utility sink lacks a backflow device. Water-damaged ceiling tiles must be replaced.

headline: Four live roaches; hot food too cool
summary: Four live cockroaches were on the wall by the ice machine in the front prep area; pest control recommended and citation issued. Cooked chicken 120.2°F, pork 114.6°F and beef 123.2°F in hot holding unit; about 60 lbs discarded. No certified manager on premises.

headline: Live and dead roaches; no certified manager
summary: About 6 live roaches and dead roaches were found under a counter, under the sink, near the hallway storage unit, and in the unit. Roach droppings are on the wall by the electrical box. No certified manager was on site while beverages were prepared.

headline: Missing backflow devices; broken wall tiles
summary: Visible backflow devices must be installed for tea brewing and hot water dispensing equipment. Women's washroom needs a receptacle cover. Broken tiles in rear prep and dish area, a leaking floor drain, and peeling paint on the wall above the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Freezer food in thin plastic wrap; greasy hood
summary: Assorted freezer food was stored in thin plastic wrap; it must be kept in food-grade containers or bags. The exhaust hood had dirt and grease buildup and needs detail cleaning.

headline: Missing splash guard; rusty racks; backflow devices
summary: No splash guard at the kitchen prep hand sink; a washable one must be installed. Chipped paint and rust on wire racks in the 2-door cooler must be repaired. Backflow devices at the ice machine and mop sink must be relocated for service.

headline: Cooked chicken at 88.3°F; cooler too warm
summary: Cooked chicken at 88.3°F and cooked beef at 99.5°F in front prep cooler; about 20 lbs ($120) discarded. Thermometers missing in coolers. Rusted racks, ice buildup, and repeat core violations including ice machine dirt and grease.

headline: Gaps in doors; damaged cooler gaskets
summary: Openings at the base of dumpster-area doors and the front entrance door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Damaged gaskets on a small cold holding unit. No backflow device on utility sink; low cold water flow in a washroom; ventilation not working.

headline: Dish machine had no sanitizer; unlabeled chemical
summary: Dish machine showed 0 ppm final chlorine sanitizer; manager must provide 50 ppm and the machine was tagged. Unlabeled chemical bottle at 3-compartment sink; employee told to label it. Bar-area floors had soil and debris; a prior violation was not corrected.

headline: Prep cooler at 70°F; no food stored in it
summary: The two-door prep cooler behind the front counter had an air temperature of 70°F. No TCS foods were stored in it during inspection. It must be repaired and kept at 41°F or below.

headline: Foil and duct tape on shelves; leaking faucet
summary: Shelves are lined with foil and taped with duct tape, which can hide pests and must be removed. Leaking faucet at the 3-compartment sink. Stained ceiling tiles, unclean floors, and a missing light above the sink.

headline: Rat droppings found; no certified manager
summary: No person in charge with a City sanitation certificate was present while deli meats and cheese were prepared. About 30 rat droppings were found on the basement floor near the rear exit. Manager must remove them and call pest control.

headline: No food manager certificate; fish thawed in water
summary: No valid Chicago certified food manager certificate was on site while chicken and fish were prepared. Fish was thawed in pans of water. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, and two male handlers had no proof of training. Previous core violations were not corrected.

headline: Unsecured hot holding unit; food handler proof needed
summary: Hot holding unit was not secured and could move while the vehicle is in motion; management was instructed to secure it. All employees must show proof of food handler training.

headline: Scoop stored in ice; ice buildup in freezers
summary: An ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine on the ice; a scoop holder must be provided. Ice buildup in basement chest freezers must be defrosted and cleaned. Leaking pipe under the 2-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Ice machine buildup and ice left unprotected
summary: Ice machine interior had black and pink buildup dripping into ice used for eating. Ice was not protected in storage. The machine was cleaned during inspection. Food stored on basement floor and cooler gaskets were ripped.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen training proof
summary: A food handler had no proof of food handler training. The city food service sanitation manager had no proof of allergen training. Both were instructed to meet the requirements.

headline: Ice bin needs cleaning; leaking bar drainpipe
summary: Ice bin interior needs cleaning; staff must remove ice, clean and maintain it. Drainpipe leaks under the bar hand sink and must be repaired. Loose debris and dust on floors and corners. No proof of food handler training was shown.

headline: No certified manager during chicken prep
summary: No certified manager was on site while chicken and other TCS foods were prepared. Food handler cards were all expired. Also a cracked hot-water knob, no thermometers in coolers, no handwashing signs, and a rear door gap that is not rodent-proof.

headline: Hands not washed after glove changes; sink blocked
summary: Employees changed gloves without washing hands, wiped hands on aprons, and washed dishes without handwashing after glove changes. The prep sink was wrapped in a trash bag and posted by management. No citation was issued for the sink.

headline: No certified manager; hand sinks lack proper water
summary: No certified manager was present while hamburgers were prepared; citation issued. Two of three exposed hand sinks were too hot or could not dispense water. A dish-area hand sink had only sanitizer, not soap. Ice machine interior has heavy black slime.

headline: Exhaust hood not working; debris outside rear door
summary: The kitchen exhaust hood system is not working properly and must be repaired for adequate ventilation. Old furniture, construction debris and wooden pallets are stored outside the rear exit door, creating a possible pest harborage. Rust on prep area shelves.

headline: Large pots don't fit three-compartment sink
summary: Large pots are too big to fully immerse in the three-compartment sink. The facility must install a larger sink, use smaller equipment, or use an approved alternative manual warewashing method.

headline: Broken freezer linings; no food handler training proof
summary: Basement stored items must be off the floor, not on wooden pallets. Several box freezers have broken interior plastic exposing insulation. Open holes in basement ceiling must be sealed. No proof of food handler training was provided for required employees.

headline: Splash guards needed; cardboard mats; leaks
summary: Paper towel dispenser above the bar 3-compartment sink must be removed. Splash guards are needed at the front prep hand sink and the bar hand sink. Leaking condenser in walk-in cooler. Milk crates and cardboard are used as shelving or mats.

headline: Egg folds and Canadian bacon too warm
summary: Five lbs of egg folds at 44.6–51.8°F and one lb of Canadian bacon at 45°F were in a two-door reach-in cooler. Manager discarded about 6 lbs (about $15). A gap along the lower door gasket must be repaired; citation issued.

headline: Missing ceiling panels; coffee debris on floor
summary: Multiple ceiling panels are missing above the rear service sink and must be repaired. Accumulated coffee debris on the prep area floor must be cleaned.

headline: Hand soap and towel dispensers above sink
summary: Soap and paper towel dispensers are located above the 3-compartment sink. Those devices must be removed from that sink and maintained.

headline: Uncovered, unlabeled food; floor-stored food
summary: Food stored in containers in coolers and dry storage is unlabeled and food is stored uncovered. Food containers stored on floors in walk-in cooler and prep areas. Mold-like buildup along warewashing wall caulking. Previous core violations not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Ice machine door buildup; no allergen training
summary: Buildup on the ice machine door must be cleaned. Women's restroom had no covered receptacle for sanitary products. The certified manager on duty had no allergen training and must obtain it and keep a certificate on site.

headline: Leaking bar faucet; restroom cans lack lids
summary: Leaking faucet and U-joint pipe at bar hand sink must be repaired. Serving plates in basement were not inverted to prevent dust. Employee washrooms have garbage cans without lids; lidded cans are required in women's and unisex washrooms.

headline: Pink mineral buildup in ice machine; greasy grill
summary: Pink mineral substance inside the ice machine must be cleaned and maintained. Heavy grease under the kitchen grill must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Hands not washed between money and food handling
summary: Two female handlers handled money, then touched buns and sausage with gloves without washing hands. Sloppy joe measured 80.2–84.7°F, eggs 62.1°F, hamburgers 45.7–47.8°F. Products discarded. Front door gap; no hair restraints; repeat violations.

headline: Scoop handles in food; dirty walk-in shelves
summary: Scoop handles were in contact with food in dry storage bins and must be stored so handles do not touch food. Walk-in cooler shelves have dust and food buildup. Trash and debris behind the front chest freezer must be cleaned.

headline: Flies and a live roach found
summary: About 8–10 large flies were seen in the rear dishwashing and deep-frying areas, and one live roach under the deep fryer. Hot food on the front prep line was uncovered. Leak under the 3-compartment sink; citation issued for insect activity.

headline: No handwashing sign; allergen training missing
summary: No handwashing sign at the coffee station sink; one must be provided. Sanitation manager has no allergen training and must complete it.

headline: No person in charge or manager on site at start
summary: No person in charge was on site at inspection; they arrived about 9:15 AM. No certified food manager was present while ham and salmon were served; citation issued. The manager also arrived about 9:15 AM.

headline: Dusty fan; floor cleaning; allergen training needed
summary: Staff were told to clean the basement floor where beer kegs are stored and to remove dust from the men's washroom ceiling fan. City food service managers must obtain required allergen training.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; bar sink blocked
summary: Bar dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged for inspection. Bar hand sink was blocked by paper towels and items and had no soap. Also an unused basement dish machine with a broken panel and a urinal that does not flush.

headline: About 200 mouse droppings; hand sinks lack hot water
summary: Evidence of about 200 or more mouse droppings found across kitchen, storage, bar and electrical areas, plus two dead mice. Restroom hand sink water measured 57.4–57.9°F, not 100°F. Rear prep area has no hand sink. Front door gap allows rodents in.

headline: Cold food at 47.9–50.1°F; cooler at 60°F
summary: Chicken, beef, cut tomatoes and babaganoush in the 2-door prep cooler measured 47.9–50.1°F; about 10 lbs discarded. Cooler air measured 55.5–60°F and is tagged. Front hand sink was blocked by dirty pans and had no paper towels.

headline: Walk-in cooler lacks internal thermometer
summary: The walk-in cooler had no internal thermometer. The manager was instructed to place one inside.

headline: Greasy fryers and dirty floor drains
summary: Grease in the bottom of fryers and on fryer wheels must be cleaned. Floor drains in the kitchen and the floor under cooking equipment must be cleaned.

headline: Hair restraint missing; slow-draining hand sink
summary: An employee in the front food preparation area was not wearing a hair restraint while food was prepared. The exposed hand sink in the front prep area drains slowly and must be repaired.

headline: Refrigerator at 48.7°F; meat held too warm
summary: Meatballs at 47.2°F and sausage at 47.8°F were in the two-door refrigerator; about 4 lbs were discarded. The unit measured 48.7°F, is tagged held for inspection, and cannot be used until re-inspected. Storage containers lack labels.

headline: Hand-sink leak; broken light shields; training expired
summary: Water leaking from the drainpipe under the 3rd floor hand sink next to the walk-in cooler must be repaired. Two broken light shields in the 1st floor prep area. Two certified managers have expired allergen training certificates.

headline: Ice machine debris; plastic bags store frozen meat
summary: Slight debris encrusted inside the basement ice machine must be cleaned and serviced. Frozen meats were stored in plastic grocery bags in the walk-in freezer; staff must use food-grade bags or containers. Peeling plastic must be removed.

headline: 15 rodent droppings found; pest control recommended
summary: About 15 rodent droppings were found in the dry storage area behind the cooler and near bike storage in the basement. Manager was instructed to service affected areas; pest control recommended and citation issued. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Several TCS foods held too warm on prep shelf
summary: Chicken, eggs, cheese and grilled peppers on a prep shelf measured 45–74.3°F. The manager immediately discarded 28 lbs (about $230). Also unlabeled bulk containers, food stored on floors, dirty wiping cloths, and greasy exhaust hood.

headline: Unlabeled bulk; buildup in coolers and ice machine
summary: Bulk storage containers must be labeled and kept in good condition. Ice machine interior and walk-in and reach-in shelves need detail cleaning. Wiping cloths not kept in sanitizer; worn sponges and cutting boards need replacing.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; no hair restraint
summary: No handwashing sign or poster was near the exposed hand sink in the rear prep area; one must be provided. An employee was preparing and serving food without a hair restraint and must wear one at all times.

headline: No health policy or vomit kit; cooler too warm
summary: No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea kit was provided. Reach-in cooler interior measured 56°F and may not be used until re-inspected. No complete logbook on site. Chlorine test strips were used with quats sanitizer; correct strips required.

headline: Unlabeled bulk dry food; poor backflow device
summary: Bulk dry food containers in the rear dry storage room lack labels and must be labeled with the food's common name. The backflow device at the mop-room utility sink is in poor repair but working; it must be repaired or replaced.

headline: No sanitation certificate posted; trash lid missing
summary: No original City of Chicago food sanitation certificate was posted on site; citation issued. A trash can in the public toilet room has no lid and must be provided with one.

headline: Dead flies on windowsills; cluttered rear storage
summary: Dead flies were found on windowsills; staff were told to remove them. The rear storage area is cluttered, which creates a rodent harborage area. Plastered wall patches need painting, and floors need cleaning.

headline: Ice machine needs cleaning; torn lid gasket
summary: Upper interior sections of the ice machine need cleaning. The rubber door gasket on the ice machine lid is torn and must be replaced.

headline: Bar dish machine at 0 ppm; bar floors dirty
summary: Frontera bar low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and is tagged held for inspection. Bulk containers unlabeled; wiping cloths not kept in sanitizer; rust in walk-in freezer; bar floor has broken glass and debris.

headline: Lasagna, hamburgers, fish held too warm
summary: Lasagna at 48.4°F, hamburgers at 46.4°F and fish at 43.7°F were held in a cook-line prep cooler; about 20 lbs (about $60) discarded. A prep cooler under the grill at 48.9°F is tagged. One restroom toilet does not flush.

headline: Oysters lack tags; basement cooler at 48–53°F
summary: Raw oysters had no shellstock tag, and no date was recorded for the last item sold. TCS foods in the basement walk-in cooler were held at 48–53°F; about 150 lbs ($3,000) discarded. One certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Display cooler and prep cooler too warm
summary: TCS foods in the display cooler measured 48.6–50.4°F, including meatballs and cream cheese. Manager voluntarily discarded 15 lbs (about $250). Two-door prep cooler at 50°F is tagged and must not be used until re-inspected.

headline: Frozen meat thawed on counter; dirty reach-ins
summary: Frozen meat was thawed on the counter instead of under refrigeration or cold running water; staff must correct. Reach-in coolers, cooking equipment, utensils and hood need detail cleaning. Basement clutter must be removed and items raised off the floor.

headline: Cooler near customer path; holes in toilet room
summary: Prep cooler in the customer walk-through area near the ice machine must be locked to prevent customer contamination; manager instructed to lock it. Holes in floor and wall junctures in the toilet room must be sealed.

headline: Mineral buildup in ice machine; allergen certificate missing
summary: Slight mineral buildup inside the basement crushed ice machine must be cleaned and maintained. A certified food manager's allergen training certificate was missing; the facility was instructed to provide it.

headline: Chicken thawed in standing water; leaking pipe
summary: Chicken was thawing in standing water in a 3-compartment sink; staff must thaw in the refrigerator or under cold running water. Leak under a rear prep hand sink must be repaired. Missing handwashing signs and allergen training certificates.

headline: About 20 rodent droppings; front door gap
summary: About 20 rodent droppings were found in the customer area, food prep area, toilet rooms and heater closet. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the front door was found. No employee health policy or vomit/diarrhea clean-up kit was provided.

headline: Dusty washroom fans and oven vent
summary: Dust was found on washroom ceiling fans and inside the vent over the oven. Staff were instructed to clean them.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food
summary: A food server sliced tomatoes and handled them with bare hands for immediate consumption; manager was told to stop this. Low-temperature dish machine was at 0 ppm final rinse and in use. Cooked rice scoop stored in standing water; handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: No certified food manager on site on arrival
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager was on site on arrival while TCS foods were being prepared. Manager must keep a certified food manager on site at all times; citation issued.

headline: Droppings, live flies and cold hand-sink water found
summary: Re-inspection found about 25 or more rat droppings and about 75 live small flies in several areas, plus one live roach. Hand sink water measured 57.2°F; 100°F is required. Pest control service recommended.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep
summary: No person in charge with a valid City food manager certificate was present while beef, pork and dairy were prepared; citation issued. Pizza topping scoops were stored directly inside their containers.

headline: Employee belongings stored on food boxes
summary: Employee coats and bags were stored on food boxes. Staff were instructed to separate personal items from food storage.

headline: Raw meat at 49.9–53.2°F; dumpster overflowing
summary: Raw beef, raw pork and cooked beans held at 49.7–53.2°F in a two-door refrigerator; about 100 lbs ($1,000) voluntarily discarded. Dumpster overflowing with trash on the ground, which is a food source for pests; citation issued.

headline: Broken glass on patio bar floor
summary: Bulk food containers must be labeled with their common name. Items stored in the patio bar must be raised off the floor. The patio bar floor has broken glass and debris that must be cleaned.

headline: Dairy coolers and storage floors need cleaning
