headline: Missing handwash signs; loose handsink
summary: Passed. Handwash signage missing at front and side bar handsinks. Kitchen prep area handsink is not properly secured to the wall; business was told to repair and maintain it.

headline: Residue inside ice machine
summary: Passed. Residue found on interior surface of ice machine. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Failed: no thermometer; summary report not posted
summary: Failed. No metal stem thermometer to check hot and cold food temperatures; citation issued. Prep utensils stored in ice water at 40.1°F. Last summary report was not visible to the public; today's was posted during inspection. Cloth or cardboard shelf liners are not allowed.

headline: Food on floors, dirty dishes, leaking faucet
summary: Passed. Single-use items under three-compartment sink must be elevated. Milk crates may not be used for elevation. Dirty dishes left from prior days; kitchen garbage can and microwave very dirty. Leaking kitchen handsink faucet must be repaired.

headline: Missing certified manager; cold food held too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager on site when eggs were cooked; this was corrected on site when the manager arrived near the end. Cooler held chicken soup at 48.8°F, stewed beef at 46.4°F, and ground beef at 47.0°F; 15 lbs discarded.

headline: Missing sterno container holders
summary: Passed. Trays holding sterno containers in place are missing. The person in charge was instructed to replace and maintain the holders.

headline: Prep cooler too warm; allergen training missing
summary: Unused prep cooler measured 54.9°F. Business must repair or replace it and keep refrigerators at or below 41°F. Basement utility sink lacks a backflow preventer. Certified manager on duty lacks allergen training and must complete it.

headline: Failed: blank health policy, no pest service proof
summary: Failed. Only blank copies of the employee health policy were on site; signed copies are required. No vomiting and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure. No proof of pest control service, no sanitizer test strips, and no commercial dumpster.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep
summary: No person in charge had a valid sanitation certificate. No certified manager was on duty while chicken, pizza and other TCS foods were prepared, handled and served; citation issued. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Ice build-up in walk-in; leaking sink faucet
summary: Passed. Ice build-up inside walk-in freezer on floor and door shades; instructed to repair and maintain. Leaking faucet at base of three-compartment sink; instructed to repair.

headline: Milk crates, leaks, unused equipment, mop storage
summary: Passed. Milk crates used for elevation at walk-in cooler; staff told to use proper shelving. Minor leaks at handsinks and dishwashing area. Unused basement equipment must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Soiled mop heads must be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Failed: no water, soap, or food handler certificates
summary: Failed. No hot water, and no water at sinks or toilet at time of inspection. No soap, paper towels or handwash sign at handsinks. Premises under construction; surfaces need detail cleaning. All employees need food handler certificates.

headline: Greasy fryers, dirty floor drains, cutting boards
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces. Cutting boards with deep stains and open seams. Grease build-up under kitchen fryers. Food splatter on walls and dirty floor drains in upstairs kitchen need deep cleaning.

headline: Failed: slime in ice machine; no handler certificates
summary: Failed. Pink and black slime inside ice machine producing ice; citation issued. No grease trap connected to three-compartment sink. No food handler certificates on site. One of two certified managers has expired allergen training.

headline: Failed: rodent infestation, soup held too warm
summary: Failed. Rodent infestation with 300+ mouse droppings in basement prep and storage areas. Dead mouse in a food container, removed on site. Open bait on basement floor. Soup at 73.2°F and 77.5°F was discarded. Expired food handler and allergen certificates.

headline: Failed: no vomit spill kit or cleanup procedure
summary: Failed. No bodily fluid spill kit or cleanup procedure for vomiting or diarrhea events; citation issued. Ice machine top interior not clean. Hole in utility room ceiling. Mops not stored to dry. No proof of food handler training for any handler.

headline: Failed: uncorrected violations; peeling wallpaper
summary: Re-inspection failed. Walk-in cooler condenser drips into a hotel pan set on buckets. Restroom wallpaper peeling. Menu lacks disclosure for raw or undercooked items. Previous priority violations were not corrected in time; citation issued.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Certified food manager on duty had no allergen training certificate. Training must be completed and the certificate kept on site.

headline: No grease trap under three-compartment sink
summary: Inspector saw no grease trap on the three-compartment sink. The business was instructed to install one and keep it maintained.

headline: No employee health policy on site
summary: Conditional pass. No employee health policy was on site. A policy with a signed acknowledgment from each employee must be provided. The toilet room door must be self-closing; the business was told to install a device. No citation issued.

headline: Single-use items stored under unshielded sewer lines
summary: Single-use items were stored under sewer lines in the basement that are not shielded. The business must shield the lines or move the items. Calcium build-up was also found in the basement handwash sink basin.

headline: Greasy cooking equipment; mold in coolers
summary: Passed. Broken paper towel dispenser in washrooms (towels available). Heavy grease on fryers and stoves. Dust and debris in display coolers. Green and white mold-like build-up on dairy shelves and cheese cooler. Dumpster area dirty.

headline: No paper towels; hair restraints; dirty drains
summary: Passed with conditions. No paper towels at front bar handsink; citation issued. Multiple employees not wearing hair restraints. Dirty floor drains and greasy floors under cooking equipment. Dust on ceiling and wall vents in prep area.

headline: Unlabeled dry food; broken floor tiles
summary: Passed. Dry food must be labeled with its common name, such as sugar. Broken plastic floor tiles in front of tables and behind the front serving counter need repair or replacement.

headline: No certified manager; shrimp held too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. Person in charge lacked a City sanitation certificate, and none was posted. Marinated raw shrimp (1.5 lbs) held at 45-49°F in prep cooler; discarded and citation issued. Loose faucet at front handsink.

headline: Dirty hood filters; washrooms need lidded can
summary: Passed. Manager must provide and maintain a small garbage can with lid in unisex washrooms. Filters above flat-top grill are dirty and must be cleaned.

headline: Expired allergen training for food manager
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Food manager had expired allergen training. Documentation of completed training must be provided.

headline: Failed: no handsink; no barrier to public
summary: Failed. No handwashing sink in warewashing area, restroom or front prep area where nachos with cheese are served; priority violation. No physical barrier separates warewashing from areas accessible to the public.

headline: Failed: pest records incomplete, no allergen training
summary: Failed. Pest control log is incomplete; last service was 2/20/2023, but twice-yearly service is required. Reports from the last 12 months and the IDPH pest license number must be provided. No allergen training certificate; no food handler certificates for employees.

headline: Broken paper towel dispenser
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Paper towel holder broken at upstairs bar handsink. The business was instructed to repair it and keep the dispenser in good working order.

headline: Missing hand sink, unlabeled food, worn gear
summary: No handwashing sink at the front service counter; one with hot and cold water must be installed. Storage containers were unlabeled, a freezer gasket was worn, some food handler training was missing, and grease had built up.

headline: Ice scoop improperly stored
summary: An ice scoop was stored improperly. Management was instructed to store it properly and maintain that practice.

headline: No food safety training proof; ice machine mold
summary: The person in charge lacked food safety training proof, and no valid City certificate was posted. Ice machine interior had excessive black mold-like buildup; a citation was issued. No metal stem thermometer was on site.

headline: Food handler with beard lacks guard
summary: A male food handler had a beard and no beard guard. He was instructed to wear one.

headline: Mussels lacked tags; corrected on site
summary: Fresh mussels without shellstock tags were found. About 5 lbs ($20) were voluntarily discarded and corrected on site. Front doors had an opening to seal, the espresso machine needs a backflow device, and hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Worn cutting board; dusty vent
summary: A rear prep cutting board has deep blackened grooves and must be resurfaced or replaced. Cardboard was used as shelf liner in dry storage. A vent in the employee washroom is dusty and inoperable.

headline: Floor drains and floors need detail cleaning
summary: Kitchen floor drains need detail cleaning to prevent insect activity. Floors under and around cooking and non-cooking equipment have dirt, dust and food debris and need detail cleaning.

headline: Vacuum-sealed fish discarded; ventilation broken
summary: About 50 lbs of albacore, wagyu, akami and beef ($5,000) were voluntarily discarded. Vacuum sealing without an approved plan was tagged and not allowed. Shellstock tags lacked sale dates, and ventilation in all four washrooms was not working.

headline: Sushi rice process unapproved; food on floor
summary: No approved variance from the city health department was on site for sushi rice. The sushi lab report was expired. Food on the walk-in freezer floor must be raised 6 inches. Fryer exterior and oil container had grease.

headline: Front door gap; no food handler training proof
summary: An opening at the base of the front entrance door must be sealed. A splash guard is missing at the sanitizer compartment. No food handler training proof was provided, and one employee lacked allergen certification.

headline: Food prepared without certified manager
summary: Food handlers prepared TCS foods without an original City certificate or certified manager on site. Cooked pasta held at 61.9–63.8°F; about 10 lbs ($50) were discarded. Packaged cookies lacked proper labels.

headline: Mop sink lacks backflow device
summary: No backflow prevention device was found at the mop sink faucet. One must be provided where it can be located and serviced.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; no allergen certificate
summary: Door gaskets on the one-door and two-door prep coolers are ripped and must be replaced or repaired. One food manager lacked a food allergen training certificate.

headline: No health policy, cleanup kit, or pest log
summary: No written employee health policy, vomit cleanup supplies, pest control log or sanitizer test strips were on site. Handwashing sinks lacked soap, paper towels and signs. Food handlers lacked training certificates, and self-closing doors were needed.

headline: Paper towels added on site; food health gaps
summary: Two handwashing sinks had no paper towels; these were corrected on site. The ice machine drip plate was soiled with pink slime. Some food stored on floors, the sanitizer test device was missing, and certified managers lack allergen certification.

headline: No soap; two sinks lack hot water
summary: Employee bathrooms in the basement and bar had no soap. Two kitchen prep handwashing sinks had no hot water, measuring 88.2°F and 66.3°F. Management must provide soap, paper towels and hot and cold water.

headline: No certified person in charge or manager
summary: No person in charge held a valid City certificate, and no certified manager was present while TCS foods were prepared. Food handlers lacked training certificates. Leaks, dirty walls and floors, and uncorrected previous violations were noted.

headline: Re-inspection passes; ceiling hole leaks
summary: A hole in the ceiling let rainwater drip into a garbage can in the rear prep area; it must be sealed. Some dry containers are unlabeled. Cardboard was used as a floor liner, and a large hole in a utility room wall must be sealed.

headline: Grease on fryer and cooking equipment
summary: Grease must be cleaned from the exterior of the fryer and cooking equipment at the main prep line.

headline: Residue and debris inside cabinets
summary: Residue and debris were found inside cabinets in the front prep and counter area. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Re-inspection passes; ceiling tiles loose
summary: A splash guard is needed between the utility sink and the shelf of clean pots. Residue was found in a cooler gasket. Loose ceiling tiles in the rear storage hall must be repaired or replaced.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea spill kit
summary: No bodily fluid spill kit or cleanup procedure was available; a citation was issued. An ice scoop was stored on top of ice. Dry storage scoops were left inside containers, and food handlers lacked beard restraints.

headline: Dead insects and webs on windowsills
summary: Dead insects, spiders and webs were on windowsills throughout the facility and must be removed. Carpeted flooring must be replaced with smooth, cleanable floors. There is no service sink, and the toilet room needs ventilation.

headline: Dirty ice machines; water on floor
summary: Both ice machines were unclean, with black and pink residue inside. They must be cleaned in detail and maintained. Water on the floor near the three-compartment sink must be cleared to keep floors dry.

headline: Handler blew nose in gloves; flies in restrooms
summary: A food handler blew his nose while wearing gloves, then handled raw meat for a customer without washing; a citation was issued. About 25 live small flies and worm-like insects were in restroom floor drains.

headline: Food on floor; milk crates used for shelving
summary: Food was stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and must be raised 6 inches. Milk crates were used for elevation and must be replaced with proper shelving. Grease and debris covered equipment, and walls and floors need cleaning.

headline: Stained cutting board; floors need cleaning
summary: A large cutting board with open seams and dark stains must be refinished or replaced. Floors with dirt and food debris, especially near the pizza equipment, must be cleaned. Exhaust enclosure above the pizza maker has black debris.

headline: Improper scoop use in dry storage
summary: A plastic bowl was used as a scoop in dry food containers and must be replaced with a handled utensil. Knives were stored between coolers, and a scoop handle was left in food. A hand sink's water knob needs repair.

headline: Soap placed at food prep sink; sink buildup
summary: Hand soap was kept at the bar food prep sink and must be moved to handwashing sinks only. Calcium and debris built up in the three-compartment sink. An ice scoop was stored under a vent intake. Food handler and allergen training were expired.

headline: Live mouse and droppings; no hot water
summary: A live mouse and about 30 or more mouse droppings were found in several areas. Hot and cold water were out throughout the facility, and the three-compartment sink had no sanitizer. A pest control operator is required.

headline: Dish rinse too cool; cold food too warm
summary: Hand sinks had hot water above 120°F and no cold water. The dish machine final rinse was 130°F; it must exceed 180°F. Feta (45°F) and milk (49°F) were too warm. Churros were unprotected, and the dumpster had no lid.

headline: Front door unscreened; handler certificate missing
summary: The front entrance door was opened without adequate screening; all outer openings must be screened. One female food handler lacked a food handler certificate. New hires must obtain one within 30 days.

headline: Dirty floors in rear storage
summary: Floors in the rear storage area were not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Sushi prep sink leak; food on walk-in floor
summary: Water was leaking from a pipe under the sushi prep handwashing sink, into a bucket of dirty dishes. Containers and buckets of food were on the walk-in cooler floor. A handwashing sign was missing, and no allergen certificate was on site.

headline: Single-use boxes on floor; missing stoppers
summary: Boxes of single-service items were stored on the floor and must be raised 6 inches. Stoppers for the three-compartment sink are missing. The certified manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Mouse droppings and flies in food areas
summary: About 40 or more mouse droppings were found on front counter shelving, food shelves and under pallets in dry storage. About 15 or more live small flies were on packages and ceiling tiles. A pest control service is recommended.

headline: Slow-draining front prep hand sink
summary: The front food prep hand sink drains slowly, so water builds up when washing hands. The plumbing must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Unlabeled dry food; fryer grease
summary: Dry food containers must be labeled with their common name, such as sugar or flour. Grease inside the deep fryer cabinet must be cleaned.

headline: Food too warm; about 5 live roaches
summary: Pork, beef and steak in the prep cooler were held at 47–71°F; about 7 lbs ($50) were discarded. About 5 live roaches were found under the prep cooler, on a washroom door and under the sink. Pest control is needed.

headline: Sewage odor and cracked sewer main
summary: A rusted and cracked sewer main was observed, with sewage odor and presence throughout the basement. This is a priority violation.

headline: Person in charge lacks City certificate
summary: The person in charge lacked an original City sanitation manager certificate; a citation was issued. The front door had a 1/2-inch gap at the bottom. One bar sink's hot water knob is stripped, and no allergen training certificate was on site.

headline: No handwashing sink in dish room
summary: There is no handwashing sink in the rear dish room where the three-compartment sink is located. One must be installed with hot and cold water, soap and paper towels that drain properly.

headline: Cutting boards, can opener and leak need work
summary: A large can opener needs detail cleaning. Cutting boards must be cleaned or replaced if dark or deeply cut. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks. Floors under shelving need cleaning, and ceiling paint is peeling.

headline: Oyster tags undated; ice machine brown buildup
summary: Raw oyster shellfish tags lacked the date of the last sale. The ice machine interior had a brownish substance and no backflow device could be located. Fryers had minor debris, and floors had some debris.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; food handler certifications missing
summary: Bulk containers in prep and storage were not labeled. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables. Equipment was stored in a utility sink and must be re-washed. No backflow device was on the utility sink. Three food handlers lacked certifications.

headline: Ice machine mold; dumpster overflowing
summary: Black and pink mold was inside the ice machine; it must be cleaned, though no citation was issued. The outdoor dumpster was overflowing and its lid did not close; a citation was issued. Repeat violations included missing handwashing signs.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: A food service sanitation manager had no allergen training certificate on site. The manager was instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: No certified person in charge; no soap
summary: The person in charge lacked a City sanitation certificate, and none was posted. Two of three handwashing sinks had no soap. No written employee health policy or food handler training proof was available. Cardboard was used for shelving.

headline: Cook without hair restraint; freezer frosted
summary: A cook was not wearing a hair restraint. A chest freezer had heavy frost buildup. Management was told to ensure hair restraints are worn and to defrost the freezer.

headline: Gaps at dock doors; splash guard missing
summary: At a re-inspection, openings were found at the lower corners of dock doors in the trash compactor room; these must be sealed. A front prep handwashing sink lacked left and right splash guards.

headline: No hot water; fruit flies in bar
summary: Employee bathroom handwashing sinks had no hot water; temperatures were 74.5–80.4°F, and 100°F is required. About 10–20 live fruit flies were in the bar area. Pest control is recommended. A prep sink faucet leaks.

headline: No light bulbs above cooking equipment
summary: There were no light bulbs above the cooking equipment. They must be provided.

headline: Cleaning needed; slow-draining sink
summary: Drink dispenser nozzles, a can opener and cooking equipment need cleaning. Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizer. A front counter hand sink drains slowly. Floors under cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Pests, no soap, and food too warm
summary: No hand soap or paper towels were at front sinks. Eggs, milk, cheese and ham were held too warm and discarded. Five mouse droppings, over 20 rat droppings and two live cockroaches were found in basement and hallway areas. Two doors were propped open.

headline: Re-inspection passes; buckets on floor
summary: A gap at the left corner of the front door must be sealed to prevent insects. Plastic buckets of roasted coffee beans were on the prep floor and must be elevated. Ice buildup and debris need cleaning. Food handler training was missing or expired.

headline: No soap or hand drying; shellfish untagged
summary: No hand drying was at downstairs prep sinks, and no soap was at upstairs or downstairs sinks, only hand sanitizer. A plate of shellstock had no tag; about 2 lbs ($20) were discarded. Ice machine interior had black buildup.

headline: No handwashing signs; debris in walk-in
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at sinks in the front and rear prep areas. An electric insect control device was stored on top of a beverage machine and must be moved. Floors in the walk-in cooler and freezer had slight debris.

headline: Air-conditioner drains into utensil sink
summary: Air-conditioner drain hoses emptied into the three-compartment sink, a priority violation. Bulk salt and flour were unlabeled, a deli cup was used as a scoop, and a meat slicer was dirty. Standing water and a purse on a food shelf were noted.

headline: Missing ceiling tiles; hood filter missing
summary: Three ceiling tiles are missing in front of the rear mop sink. The hood above the oven needs detail cleaning and a missing filter must be provided.

headline: Cardboard boxes stored by toilet room
summary: Cardboard boxes were stored by the rear toilet room. They must be removed.

headline: Unlabeled spices; unused hot-holding unit
summary: Pre-packaged spices must be labeled with business name, address and ingredients. Stored items must be elevated, not on soda crates. An unused hot-holding unit at the front counter must be removed.

headline: Wine bar has no handwashing sink
summary: The rear wine bar has no handwashing sink; one with hot and cold running water must be installed. Temperature gauges on both dishwashing machines were inoperable and must be repaired. A vent cover had excessive dust.

headline: Ice buildup in serving line freezer
summary: Excess ice buildup was inside a reach-in freezer on the serving line and must be removed. A handwashing sign was missing; the manager posted one during the inspection. The person in charge's allergen training was expired.

headline: Food and supplies stored on floors
summary: Food and single-use items were stored on floors in the walk-in cooler, freezer and prep areas. Milk crates were used as shelving. A hot-holding unit had no working thermometer. Dirty slicers and shelves were also noted.

headline: Dim walk-in cooler; no allergen training
summary: The walk-in cooler had insufficient lighting and must be improved. No allergen training existed for City of Chicago food managers, and certificates must be kept on site.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; cold food too warm
summary: Black slime in the ice machine dripped onto ice cubes, and a citation was issued. Raw burger patties (46.6°F) and sliced tomatoes (46.4°F) were discarded, about 10 lbs. Mold-like buildup, damaged tiles and peeling paint were noted.

headline: Damaged cabinet sides in women's restroom
summary: The sides of sink cabinets in the women's restroom are damaged. They must be repaired so they are smooth and cleanable.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; unlabeled food
summary: A front prep handwashing sink lacked a handwashing sign. Food containers in front prep coolers were not labeled with their common name. Equipment handles and floors beneath equipment were soiled.

headline: No certified manager; trash and food outdoors
summary: The person in charge lacked a City certificate while TCS (time/temperature-controlled) foods were prepared. The prep sink had no soap or paper towels. Food, linens and to-go containers were stored outdoors on the patio. No food handler training proof was provided.

headline: Cracked sink; cold food too warm
summary: A rear toilet room sink basin is cracked and must be replaced. Eggs, sausage, chicken and cream cheese were held at 50–55°F; about 8.5 lbs ($39) were discarded. A cooler at 53.4°F was tagged; its air is now 42°F.

headline: Bare-hand contact, pests and unsafe food temperatures
summary: A worker touched taco toppings with bare hands; a citation was issued. Pastor was held at 75°F and tomatoes and milk at 47°F. About 25 small flies, live roaches and a dead rodent were found; some food was discarded.

headline: Glove stored in sink; basement flooding
summary: A metal mesh cutting glove was stored inside a handwashing sink. A green cutting board had deep grooves. Unused equipment must be removed from the basement to prevent pests, and pooling water was on basement floors.

headline: Food boxes on cooler floor; crates misused
summary: Food boxes were stored on the floor inside the walk-in cooler and must be stored 6 inches off the floor. Plastic soda crates and milk crates may not be used to raise items.

headline: Mop sink lacks backflow device
summary: No backflow prevention device was found at the mop sink faucet. One must be provided where it can be serviced.

headline: Dishwasher not sanitizing; repairs ordered
summary: The high-temperature dishwasher behind the bar was not working. Management must repair it and reach a final rinse above 180°F. Raw wood behind the bar must be sealed. A certified food manager lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Re-inspection passes; minor upkeep gaps
summary: A small gap between the front entrance doors must be sealed. Other items were upkeep: plumber's putty around sink drains, dust on a prep table, leaves and pallets in the outdoor enclosure, stained ceiling tiles, and dirty walls.

headline: Restrooms lack mechanical ventilation
summary: At a re-inspection, the employee, men's and women's bathrooms had no mechanical ventilation. The manager must provide ventilation for each bathroom.

headline: Ice machine slime; food not date-marked
summary: Black and brown slime in the ice machine dripped onto ice used for drinks; a citation was issued. Ready-to-eat foods held over 24 hours were not date-marked. Food handlers lacked hair restraints and quaternary sanitizer test strips.

headline: No cooler thermometer; unused equipment present
summary: No thermometer was inside the white reach-in prep cooler. Unused equipment, including a 2-door cooler, soda cooler and low-temperature dish machine, must be removed. Floors and walls near equipment need cleaning.

headline: Doors not rodent-proof; debris buildup
summary: At a complaint re-inspection, the dock and rear exit doors were not rodent-proof, though no pests were seen. Dried food residue was on racks and carts, and debris was under shelving and equipment. A manager lacked allergen proof.

headline: Cook without hair restraint; food in bags
summary: The person in charge was cooking without a hair restraint. Food was stored in plastic grocery bags in freezers. Cardboard was used as a freezer liner. Grease and food debris were on equipment and shelving.

headline: No basement handwashing sink; uncovered food
summary: The basement food prep area has no handwashing sink; one must be installed with hot and cold water, soap and towels. A personal drink was stored in the food refrigerator. Several coolers lacked thermometers. Food was uncovered.

headline: Chipping paint on walk-in cooler shelving
summary: Green shelving in the walk-in cooler has chipping paint and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: No certified food manager had allergen training. Anyone holding a City of Chicago food sanitation certificate must complete allergen training. Documentation must be provided.

headline: Leaking drain; water-stained ceiling tiles
summary: The left-side drain pipe of the three-compartment sink is leaking and must be repaired. Water-stained ceiling tiles above seating must be replaced. Grease and food buildup on the hood and filters must be cleaned, and burned-out light bulbs must be replaced.

headline: Freezer ice buildup; food handler certificates expired
summary: Excessive ice buildup was found inside reach-in prep freezers throughout the premises. A rear handwashing sink drains slowly. A bathroom lacks a covered receptacle. All food handler certificates were expired.

headline: Equipment on floor; slow-draining sink
summary: Multi-use equipment was stored improperly on the floor and must be elevated and inverted. A handwashing sink in the taqueria warewashing area drains slowly and must be repaired.

headline: Detail cleaning needed for coolers and floors
summary: Interiors of reach-in coolers and freezers and prep tables need detail cleaning. Floors under and around equipment need detail cleaning. Hood ventilation needs detail cleaning to remove grease and dust.

headline: Hot water far too cool at sinks
summary: Hot water measured only 90°F at hand sinks and the three-compartment sink. It must reach 110°F at the three-compartment sink and 100°F at other sinks. Food buildup, damaged cooler gaskets and cracked floor grout were also noted.

headline: Hot and cold food unsafe; flies and mice
summary: Ground beef at 111°F (135°F required) and turkey at 46.8°F were discarded. A deli cooler measured 45.6°F and was tagged. About 20 or more live small flies, 25 or more mouse droppings and rat droppings were found.

headline: Food stored below sewer lines; caulk torn
summary: Food service items and storage bins were stored below unprotected waste water and sewer lines in the basement dry storage. They must be shielded or moved. Torn and missing caulk at a hand sink must be repaired.

headline: Re-inspection passes; open bulk containers
summary: Bulk containers had missing or broken lids, and food was stored on the walk-in freezer floor. Soiled wiping cloths were on a prep table. Crates were used as shelving, and food debris and grease built up on equipment and floors.

headline: Cooler held meat and produce too warm
summary: Chicken, beef, dumplings and sweet potatoes in a prep cooler measured 48–55°F; the limit is 41°F or below. About 46 lbs ($416) were voluntarily discarded. The rear cooler's air temperature was 50°F and must be repaired.

headline: No certified food manager on site while open
summary: No certified food manager was present during operation. Shrimp (53.0°F), tomatoes (47.0°F), sausages (46.2°F) and melon were held above the 41°F limit; about 12 lbs discarded. Hot water failed at a hand sink.

headline: Hand sinks, unapproved equipment, and sewer lines
summary: Hand sinks lacked hot water and paper towels, and one was blocked. Vacuum-sealing machines were tagged and may not be used without approval. Food was stored under unprotected sewer lines. The garage door seal was torn.

headline: No certified manager; live roaches and flies
summary: No certified food manager was on site while open; a citation was issued. Three live roaches and about 5–8 small flies were inside cold-holding units and near dish and prep areas. Dead roaches were also found; pest control was recommended.

headline: Leaking faucet; greasy hood and floors
summary: Cooking equipment needs detail cleaning, and the three-compartment sink faucet leaks. Rear prep floors need detail cleaning of food buildup, flour and water, and regrouting and coving. The hood vent needs cleaning.

headline: Soiled mop heads not hung to dry
summary: Soiled mop heads were not stored properly. Management was instructed to hang them to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Dirty deli cooler; no handler training proof
summary: Re-inspection passes. Deli display cooler glass doors were very dirty, with green substance between panels. Walls are dirty, and an unused rear oven and deli slicer must be removed. Food handler training proof is missing.

headline: Re-inspection passes; door gaps and no stoppers
summary: Rear and basement exit doors have gaps of about 1/4 inch at the bottom and must be sealed. The three-compartment sink lacks stoppers and must be provided.

headline: Food on floors; hair restraints not worn
summary: Buckets of food stored on the floor inside walk-in cooler and freezer. Employees not wearing hair restraints. Wiping cloths stored on cooking equipment and prep tables. Rusty freezer shelving. Dust and peeling paint on ceilings.

headline: Employees eating at prep; several foods too warm
summary: Employees eating and drinking in the prep area; designated break area required. Rice at 122F and sausage at 116F. Cold foods at 41-61F; about 41 lbs ($135) discarded; citation issued. Service and dessert coolers too warm.

headline: Rusted shelves, detached dish machine, no cold water
summary: Rusted shelves covered with peeling foil and cardboard shelf liner. Low-temperature dish machine drainboard detached from the wall. No cold water at the bar dump sink, which is missing its faucet. Leaks at the bar sink and dish machine.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm sanitizer; repaired on site
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer; use stopped. Person in charge repaired it on site to 100 ppm; citation issued. Food stored on prep surface beside grill-area handwash sink; relocate or install a splash guard.

headline: Broken gaskets, rusted shelves, and expired certificate
summary: Two-door cooler in rear prep has broken gaskets and rusted shelving. Front prep handsink leaking. Water-stained ceiling tiles. Dust in vents above pizza prep. One food handler certificate expired; a manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Leaking sink faucet and food debris on floor
summary: Leak at the 3-compartment sink faucet. Spilled food debris on floors in the rear walk-in cooler. No allergen training on site for city food managers; manager told to complete it and keep the certificate on site.

headline: No thermometer in dessert cooler; expired allergen certificate
summary: No thermometer inside the dessert reach-in cooler; a working one must be provided. Food debris on sinks and shelves in prep and dish areas. Food allergen certificate expired and must be updated.

headline: Water-stained ceiling tiles and clutter
summary: Water-stained ceiling tiles in various store areas; replace where needed. Unnecessary items in an unused walk-in cooler and near the front entrance; remove and organize.

headline: Leaking 3-compartment sink faucet
summary: Leak at the base of the 3-compartment sink faucet in the main kitchen, even when not in use. Manager instructed to service it and keep it in good repair.

headline: Floors, walls, and vent need cleaning
summary: Floor behind the fryers needs cleaning. Walls around cooking equipment and prep tables need cleaning. Dust on a ceiling vent in the dining area must be removed.

headline: Cluttered mop room and expired allergen training
summary: Aluminum foil liners on storage shelves. Pots and pans not inverted. Mop sink room cluttered, a potential pest hiding place. Prior core violation for expired allergen training not corrected; citation issued.

headline: 25 rat droppings on prep area floor
summary: 25 rat droppings on the prep area floor along walls and corners; citation issued. Must be removed by reinspection, and pest control service is advised. Leaking 3-compartment sink faucet. Cluttered and soiled floors.

headline: Expired allergen training for food managers
summary: Certified food managers' allergen training certificates are expired. Manager instructed to obtain and maintain current certificates on site.

headline: Warm cold foods, over 10 live roaches
summary: Several TCS foods in service cooler at 44-58F; about 20 lbs ($100) discarded. Over 10 live roaches on the floor along wall bases in first-floor and basement prep areas. Pest control consult ordered. Prior core violations uncorrected.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers and washroom ventilation
summary: Unlabeled bulk containers in basement dry storage. Rusty, chipped shelving in walk-in cooler. No drainboard at dishwashing sink. Low hot water pressure at basement mop sink. Peeling paint behind dish storage. Washroom ventilation not working.

headline: Over 120 rodent droppings in multiple areas
summary: About 120 or more rodent droppings on shelving, prep tables, behind equipment, in basement toilet room, and inside cabinets; citation issued. Clean and pest control service required before reinspection. Dried food debris on equipment and bulk containers.

headline: Ice machine buildup and expired food handler card
summary: Slight buildup inside the second-floor ice machine must be cleaned. Peeling paint above the dish machine drainboard and dusty ceiling tiles in the second-floor prep area. One food handler certificate expired.

headline: Bare-hand contact with fries; corrected on site
summary: Employee touched French fries with bare hands; citation issued. Manager corrected this on site. No thermometers inside some refrigeration units; manager corrected on site. Torn gasket and moldy caulking noted.

headline: Dirty coolers and burned-out hood light
summary: Interiors of reach-in coolers, the freezer and the walk-in cooler need detail cleaning. A burned-out light bulb in the hood system must be replaced. Re-inspection passed.

headline: No handwashing signs and rough basement walls
summary: No handwashing signs at hand sinks; manager must provide them. Walls in basement storage are not smooth and easy to clean; must be repaired.

headline: Small flies found in wall gap behind bar
summary: Small flies were found living in an opening in the lower wall under the bar handwash sink. Manager told to smooth and seal surfaces to prevent pest harborage. Unlabeled squirt bottles and dirty hood filters noted.

headline: Cold-holding failures and no thermometers
summary: Shrimp at 48.2F and pork belly at 45.2F; about 20 lbs ($100) discarded; citation issued. No metal stem thermometer on site and no working thermometers in kitchen coolers. Missing handwashing signs and a leaking mop sink backflow device.

headline: No handwashing sign in employee restroom
summary: No handwashing sign in the employee restroom. Management must provide one.

headline: Food on floors and flour buildup
summary: Food stored on floors in basement walk-in cooler and freezer. Accumulated flour and food debris on prep tables, coolers and shelving. Food spills on floors in rear and basement prep areas. Employee personal items stored in prep areas.

headline: Wet mops, soiled cardboard, and greasy floors
summary: Wet mops stored in the prep area. Soiled cardboard used as floor mats and stored under the dish rack. Grease spills on the floor behind cooking equipment. Expired allergen training certificate on site.

headline: Debris on floors and ledges in storage areas
summary: Debris found on floors and along wall ledges and corners in utility and storage areas. Manager instructed to clean and maintain these areas. Complaint re-inspection.

headline: Hair restraint, cups on floor, and loose faucets
summary: Food handler not wearing a hair restraint. Disposable cups stored on the floor behind dining seats. Loose prep sink faucet. No backflow devices on ice machine and utility sink. Soiled mop heads not hung to dry.

headline: Gaps under exit door near restroom
summary: About 1/4-inch gaps at the bottom of an exit door near the toilet room entrance. No pests were noted. Manager instructed to repair.

headline: Food debris on equipment and floors
summary: Food debris on prep tables, slicers, fryers, coolers and freezers; manager instructed to clean all food and non-food contact surfaces. Debris on floors under equipment, along walls and in corners of prep and storage areas.

headline: Uncorrected core violations and rusted racks
summary: Prep area wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizer. Chipped paint and rust on walk-in wire racks. No self-closing washroom door. Prior uncorrected violations include no ice machine backflow device and no food handler or allergen training.

headline: Hand sink too hot; unlabeled containers
summary: Front prep handwash sink ran 135-140F because the cold water mix was not working; citation issued. Food containers lack labels. Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables. Greasy fryer oil filter unit. Two burnt-out bulbs on the prep line.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and worn cooler gasket
summary: Handwashing signage needed at the sink behind two bars. A reach-in cooler gasket in the rear storage area needs repair. Dust on walk-in condenser fan covers. Floors under the bar sink need cleaning.

headline: Raw wood shelf needs sealing
summary: Raw wood storage shelf near the dish area 3-compartment sink must be sealed or painted and maintained.

headline: Over 30 crawling insects throughout facility
summary: More than 30 crawling insects throughout the facility, including the rear dish area, drive-thru window and ceiling lights over prep areas; citation issued. No irreversible temperature indicator for the hot-water dish machine.

headline: No certified manager and numerous dead roaches
summary: No person in charge with valid certificate; no certified manager while cooked beef was prepared and served; citation issued. No pest control logbook. Numerous dead roaches in prep, storage and basement areas. No valid food handler training.

headline: Food on floors and no grease trap
summary: Food stored on basement floor, in walk-in cooler and in storage area; must be elevated. Scoops stored inside bulk containers. No grease trap at the first-floor 3-compartment sink. No lids on women's restroom garbage cans. Hood filters need cleaning; burnt-out hood light.

headline: No health policies and cold-holding failures
summary: No signed employee health policies; citation issued. About 19 lbs of ready-to-eat TCS foods at 45-50F discarded. Display unit at 57.8F tagged and held. No food handler training. No or expired allergen training. Summary report not posted.

headline: Brooms stored too close to ice buckets
summary: Brooms and dust pans were stored too close to ice buckets. Inspector instructed the staff to keep them apart.

headline: Blank health policy forms and missing pest log
summary: Blank copies of employee health policy on site; citation issued. No licensed pest control operator or pest logbook provided. No handwash sign in washroom. No covered trash receptacle in all-gender washroom. Entrance door lacks self-closing device.

headline: Stained cutting boards and missing sink stoppers
summary: Multi-use utensils not inverted during storage. Cutting boards heavily stained in the prep area. Missing proper stoppers for the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Dirty floors and missing cooler thermometers
summary: Loose debris, dirt and dust on floors and corners throughout the facility. No ambient air thermometers inside reach-in and display coolers. Inspector ordered more frequent floor cleaning, to be maintained at all times.

headline: Unlabeled oysters and many cold-holding failures
summary: Oysters stored without required shellstock tags; about 50 lbs ($358) voluntarily discarded. Many foods in display coolers at 45-67F; about 200 lbs ($400) discarded. Display cooler at 67.4F must not be used.

headline: Broken cooler thermometer and food spills
summary: Interior thermometer in the juice prep reach-in cooler is broken and must be replaced. Handwash sink caulk broken from the wall. Food spills on the floor throughout the prep area must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Over 50 mouse droppings; no hot water
summary: Over 50 mouse droppings in sales, storage and basement areas; citation issued and an exterminator required. No hot water (65.3F) on site; must provide 100F at handsink and 110F at 3-compartment sink. Damaged floor tiles.

headline: No handwashing sign and gap at rear door
summary: Front prep handwash sink lacks a handwashing sign. Gap over 1/4 inch at the bottom of the rear exit door; manager told to rodent-proof it. Food bins and buckets on the floor at the kitchen entrance. Loose vegetables in walk-in cooler.

headline: No certified manager during pork prep
summary: No certified manager on site from 10:15 to 10:38 AM while pork was prepared; citation issued. Handwash sink by fryers had no soap and was blocked. No production logs. Prior core violations uncorrected, including missing ceiling tiles.

headline: Food on walk-in freezer floor and ceiling damage
summary: Boxes of food stored on the walk-in freezer floor must be elevated. Rusty shelving outside the walk-in cooler. Large ceiling opening above the prep table and fallen plaster. Grease and dirt on floors and behind cooking equipment.

headline: Leaks under sinks and crates stored outside
summary: Complaint re-inspection: leaks under the utility sink and washroom handwash sink; repair required. Unused equipment and crates stored outside and in rear storage; remove them to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Health policy form and vehicle water inlet issues
summary: Signed employee health policy form was missing but was provided before inspection ended. Clean water inlet on the vehicle lacked protection; a lock box was installed on site. Garbage on vehicle had no lid.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies
summary: No procedure or supplies on site for cleaning vomit or diarrhea; citation issued. Employees prepared food without hair restraints. Missing handwashing signs in customer washrooms. Dusty light shields need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; dead roaches and sticky traps
summary: No city-certified food manager on site while open; citation issued. Dead roaches found in the butcher-area mop sink. Sticky traps in basement areas. Missing handwashing signs. Rust and debris on shelves.

headline: Cold-holding failures and missing thermometer
summary: Beef, chicken, tongue, chopped onion and jalapeno held at 44-49F; about 7 lbs ($30) discarded; citation issued. No thermometer inside the front cold-hold unit. Cracked ice machine door was repaired with tape and must be replaced.

headline: About 14 live roaches in prep area
summary: About 14 live roaches in the prep area, including near handwash sink, under cooking equipment and behind cold-hold unit; about 6 dead roaches. Citation issued; pest control required. Excess ice in freezers and damaged ice machine backflow device.

headline: No certified manager and about 20 live flies
summary: No city-certified food manager on premises while TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. About 20 live small flies on walls and ceilings in the smoothie prep area and dining room; citation issued. Dirty floors under ice maker.

headline: Broken floor tiles at front entrance
summary: Missing and broken floor tiles at the front entrance door. Must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food and dirty ice machine
summary: Bulk food containers need labels. Ice machine interior needs detail cleaning. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer. Worn cutting boards in the first-floor prep area. Slicer needs detail cleaning. Leaking 3-compartment faucet.

headline: Unlabeled food containers and grease buildup
summary: Food in containers in coolers, walk-in and dry storage lacks name labels. Splash guard needed between rear handsink and dish storage. Grease bin buildup. Grease, food debris and dirt on floors under equipment and in corners. Certified managers lack allergen proof.

headline: No sanitizer test kit available
summary: No chemical sanitizer test kit on site; citation issued. Manager must provide a kit to check sanitizer concentration. Dust buildup on prep-area ceiling tiles needs cleaning.

headline: Missing manager allergen training; faucet fixed
summary: Managers are missing allergen training; must provide it and keep verification on site. Inspector noted the faucet was repaired and a trash receptacle cover was provided.

headline: Unlabeled kiosk containers and food on floors
summary: Food storage containers without labels at food court kiosks. Food stored on floors in the walk-in cooler and prep and storage areas. Employees prepping without hair restraints. Milk crates used as shelving. Debris on warehouse floors.

headline: Certified managers lack allergen training
summary: Certified food managers have no allergen training certification. Management was told all food service managers must obtain it.

headline: Rusty brushes and leaking faucets
summary: Rusted steel wire grill cleaning brushes in the bakery must be replaced. Leaking faucets at the deli 3-compartment sink and juice prep handwash sink. Stiff knee pedals at the sushi handwash sink.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets and greasy hood
summary: Two-door reach-in cooler gaskets in the front prep area are ripped and must be repaired or replaced. Accumulated food and grease on ventilation hoods must be cleaned.

headline: Improper thawing method and unlabeled containers
summary: Food handler thawed frozen tripe in the 3-compartment prep sink, which is not an approved method; person in charge informed. Front cooler containers lack proper labels. Knives stored between wall and wire rack.

headline: No handwashing signs; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: No handwashing signs at sinks; must be provided. Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer; tagged and must not be used until reinspected; citation issued. Food stored on walk-in cooler floor. Leaking 3-compartment faucet. Debris under equipment.

headline: Ripped gaskets, leaking drain, and greasy walls
summary: Front prep two-door reach-in gaskets are ripped and must be replaced. Rear prep handwash sink drain pipe leaking. Grease, food debris and dirt on walls in all areas. Damaged floor tiles around the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Torn walk-in cooler door gasket
summary: Torn gasket on the walk-in cooler door must be repaired or replaced and maintained in good condition.

headline: Expired allergen training for managers
summary: Allergen training for certified food managers is expired. Management told to recertify and keep certificates on site.

headline: Front door not fully rodent-proofed
summary: Front exit door is not fully rodent-proofed. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom must be sealed.

headline: No food handler or allergen certificates on site
summary: Complaint re-inspection: no food handler training certificate and no allergen training certificates provided on site. Management instructed to provide them for all certified food service managers.

headline: Dirty deli slicer and washrooms
summary: Deli meat slicer not clean; must be cleaned more often between uses. Spills and debris on shelving and floors in deli, prep and bakery areas. Rear employee washrooms dirty; fixtures and floors must be cleaned.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food and overflowing dumpster
summary: Bulk food containers (rice, beans) have no labels. Outside dumpster area not clean; garbage spilling and overflowing; citation issued. Sanitation manager has no allergen training.

headline: Flour debris and missing manager allergen certificates
summary: Accumulated flour debris on the rear prep area floor. Multiple certified food managers lack allergen awareness training certificates. Person in charge instructed to provide and maintain them.

headline: Food on basement floor; dirty hood filters
summary: Food containers stored on the floor in the basement storage area. Wiping cloths stored inside the walk-in cooler. Ventilation hood and filters above cooking equipment need detail cleaning.

headline: Rodent droppings and failed sanitizer and coolers
summary: No person in charge with valid certificate. About 200 mouse droppings on floors in storage and prep areas; citation issued and pest control needed. Dish machine at 0 ppm sanitizer tagged. Cold-holding unit at 46.5F tagged. Hand sink water too cool; no soap.

headline: Plastic spoons and dirty meat slicer
summary: Plastic disposable spoons used in food production; proper scoops required. Meat slicer not clean around the blade housing; must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Open outdoor bins and food debris throughout
summary: Outdoor bins left open due to community use; a lock was recommended. Trash-littered outdoor enclosure. Mop not stored to dry. Hole in wall by the boilers. Food debris and spills throughout the facility. No allergen training.

headline: Loose hot water handle at prep handsink
summary: Hot water handle is loose at the prep area handwash sink outside the office. Must be repaired and maintained.

headline: No allergen training proof for food managers
summary: No certified food service manager with proof of allergen training on site. All certified managers instructed to obtain the certificate.

headline: No health policy or food handler training certificates
summary: License re-inspection: no employee health policy on site. No food handler training certificates on site. Management must provide them at all times.

headline: Live small flies and no handwashing signs
summary: About 30 or more live small flies on upper walls and ceilings in prep, dish, hallway and women's restroom areas; citation issued; pest control needed. No handwashing signs at bar sinks. Boxes on freezer floor. Food debris on floors.

headline: Over 100 small flies and mold in ice machine
summary: No verifiable employee health policy on site; citation issued. Over 100 small flies throughout the facility, including bar and dish room; citation issued. Black mold-like substance inside the ice machine. Handwash sinks at 69-92F. Dish machine corrected 7/19/2024.

headline: No hair restraints; clutter near restrooms
summary: Food handlers prepping food without hair restraints; person in charge told all handlers must wear one. Unused articles stored on the floor in the mop sink closet near restrooms; manager told to remove them to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Food debris in gaskets and dirty floors
summary: Food and dirt in gasket crevices on the front reach-in cooler. Trash receptacle in toilet room has no lid. Water-stained ceiling tiles in rear dish area. Food, dirt and grease on floors in front and rear prep areas.

headline: Cooked foods held over 24 hours without discard dates
summary: Cooked pork and shredded chicken held over 24 hours with no discard dates; citation issued. Also soiled wiping cloths on prep tables, milk crates used as shelving, a clogged prep sink, and a manager without allergen training.

headline: Dusty condenser fan cover and damaged wall
summary: Condenser fan cover in the rear walk-in cooler has dust that must be cleaned. The wall next to the mop sink in the dishwashing area is in poor repair and must be fixed.

headline: Bare-hand fries, cold-holding failures, no thermometer
summary: Food handler used bare hands to plate fries; citation issued and about 2 lbs ($5) discarded. Diced tomatoes, raw chicken and fried chicken held too warm; about 16 lbs ($188) discarded. Dish machine at 0 ppm sanitizer when not in use; no probe thermometer.

headline: Bare-hand contact, warm cold foods, and flies
summary: Employee touched lettuce and pickles bare-handed; citation issued. Ham at 47F, hamburgers at 51F and fish dip at 54F were too warm. About 50 live small flying insects in several areas. No pest control log.

headline: Torn gaskets and food handler certificate missing
summary: Torn door gaskets inside the rear two-door stand-up cooler must be replaced. One food handling employee lacks a food handler certificate; must show proof of training.

headline: Employees eating on cook line; missing training proof
summary: Employees eating on the cook line; owner removed their food. Frozen raw chicken stored on cardboard in rear prep. Cook line utensils in 67.8F water. No proof of food handler training or allergen training for managers.

headline: Poor hygiene, roaches, and cold-holding failures
summary: Food handler blew into a glove, put hand inside it, and began preparing food; citation issued. Two live roaches found, one on an employee's shirt. Chicken, pork and cream at 47.8-51F; about 38 lbs ($277) discarded. Cooler at 51F tagged.

headline: No certified manager; eggs held too warm
summary: No certified food manager while eggs and raw chicken were served. About 275 lbs of chicken eggs at 54-65F; discarded. Cooler at 54.6F tagged. Chicken carcasses lacked refrigeration. Floors soiled with feathers, blood and waste.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths and torn cooler gaskets
summary: Soiled wiping cloths stored on cutting boards and prep tables. Single-use trays stored face up. Torn gaskets on basement milk cooler. Dusty walk-in fan guards. Floors and drains need cleaning. Basement freezer has no lighting.

headline: No food sanitation manager during chicken prep
summary: No city-certified food sanitation manager on site while chicken was being prepped; citation issued. No splash guard at the prep area exposed hand sink. No allergen training certificate on site.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No certified food manager on site while TCS foods were served; citation issued. Two hand sinks used for ice and utensils, heavily soiled dish machine, a 3-compartment sink that floods, and uncorrected prior core violations.

headline: No health policy and no hot water at sink
summary: No written employee health policy; citation issued. No hot water (75.6F) at the front prep handwash sink; citation issued. Handwash sinks drain slowly. Dust on coolers and condenser. Stained and missing ceiling tiles.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; ice discarded
summary: Black slime built up inside the ice machine and was dripping into ice served to people. The ice was voluntarily discarded. Manager must clean the machine by the reinspection date.

headline: Gap at bottom of rear exit door
summary: Rear exit door has an approximately 1/4-inch gap at the bottom. Manager instructed to make the door tight-fitting across the bottom to prevent pest entry.

headline: Torn gaskets, dirty floor drain, and sealing gaps
summary: Replace torn gaskets on the two-door meat prep and prep coolers. Clean floor drain under the low-temperature dish machine. Seal opening above baseboard in the front dish area and top corner of the doorway between prep areas.

headline: Poor cooler gaskets and sink drain plugs missing
summary: Walk-in and display cooler door gaskets in poor repair. Large gap between rear handwash sink and wall needs sealing. Three-compartment sink missing drain plugs for two of three basins. Mop head stored on floor while drying.

headline: Live mice and rodent droppings found
summary: Two live mice near the basement water heater and about 30 mouse droppings in basement storage. Pest control service required. Also: no sneeze guard at front counter, no backflow device on espresso machine, leaks, wastewater, no dumpster contract.

headline: Unused equipment, missing certificates, dirty microwave
summary: Dry food in plastic must be labeled with its common name. Microwave interior has food splatters. Remove unused equipment from front area and kitchen. Additional food handler and allergen training certificates required on site.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep
summary: No city-certified food manager on site while beef and chicken were prepared; must be present at all times. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit, no food handler certificates, no allergen training. Mop stored improperly; two lights out.

headline: Missing condiment labels; couch in prep area
summary: Condiments in front prep area lack common-name labels. Wiping cloths improperly stored. Large couch and blankets in rear prep and warewashing area must be removed.

headline: Hair restraints, rusty racks, toilet trash lids
summary: Employee in prep area without hair restraint. Wiping cloth not stored in sanitizer. Rusty storage racks in walk-in and storage areas. Trash receptacles without lids in unisex toilet rooms. Food handler and allergen training proof missing.

headline: About 25 mouse droppings under front sinks
summary: About 25 mouse droppings under front sink cabinet; removal and sanitizing required; citation issued. Front handwash sink hot-water knob missing. Toilet room trash lacks a lid. No food handler certificates. Repeat violations for door and allergen certificates.

headline: Damaged floor tiles and missing grout
summary: Missing grout and damaged floor tiles in the prep area, dry storage room, and rear hall to the bathroom and dumpster. Must be repaired to create a smooth, cleanable surface.

headline: Thermometer broken; door gap allows pests
summary: Cooler thermometer broken; a working thermometer must be provided inside. Quarter-inch gap at front entrance door sweep must be rodent-proofed. Grease on hood filters. Food allergen training certificate expired.

headline: Repeat violation: about 80 mouse droppings
summary: Repeat violation: about 80 mouse droppings inside oven and behind cooking equipment, plus dozens more in dining room and basement. Pest control service needed. Also unlabeled bulk containers, missing hair restraints, greasy equipment.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; flies and rat droppings
summary: Low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged out until inspected. About 30 small live flies on walls and ceiling; 10 rat droppings by front-prep ice machine. Pest control required. Dirty floor drains and dust.

headline: Missing handwash sign; raw wood, plastic lining
summary: Missing handwashing sign at rear sink. Plastic lining under the flat-top grill must be removed. Raw wood beams and surfaces near rear sinks must be sealed and kept smooth and cleanable.

headline: No certified manager; vomit kit missing
summary: No city-certified food manager on premises. Vomit and diarrhea response items missing. Handwashing sink water 134.7–141.7°F, above the 120°F maximum. Opening in rear door and no barrier protecting ice storage from customers.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure; no health policy
summary: No employee health policy on site; one must be verified for each employee. No procedure for cleaning vomit or diarrhea, including chemicals and supplies. Instructed to have both on site. No citation issued today.

headline: No hot water; inaccessible hand sink; leak
summary: No hot water throughout the establishment; sink water 75–85°F. Plumbing issue corrected on site at 1:55 PM. Hand sink in food and ice cream prep area not accessible; large leak at pipe below it. Drink stirring spoons not kept under running water.

headline: Cold food too warm; handwashing sink misused
summary: Cooked beef, rice, beans, and sour cream held above safe cold temperatures; discarded. About 30 lbs undated food also discarded. Rice cooling at 169.3°F. Handwashing sink blocked and used for wiping cloths.

headline: No splash guard between sinks
summary: Only violation: no splash guard between the handwashing sink and the three-compartment sink. Must be provided. Passed.

headline: Cockroaches, rodent droppings, and flies found
summary: Two large live roaches; about 100 rodent droppings and about 65 live flies in prep and dining areas. Pest control required; citation issued. Dish machine at 0 ppm sanitizer, food on floors, no hand soap. Paper towels provided on site.

headline: Floors not clean by compactor areas
summary: Floors near the rear indoor compactor areas were not clean. Inspector instructed that they be cleaned.

headline: No vomit kit, sanitizer testing, or allergen training
summary: No procedure or kit for vomit and diarrhea, and no sanitizer test devices on site; citation issued. Dirty fryers, floors, walls, and ceilings. No covered trash receptacle in women's restroom. Summary report not posted for public view.

headline: Grease buildup, peeling paint, leaking faucet
summary: Grease and dirt under and behind cooking equipment and along basement wall bases must be cleaned. Peeling paint in employee washroom and basement. Leaking faucet base at three-compartment sink. Dust on washroom vents.

headline: No certified manager while preparing TCS foods
summary: No city-certified food manager on site while dairy, Italian beef, chili, and burgers were prepared; citation issued. Toilet room door not self-closing. No allergen training certificate for the certified manager.

headline: Pest gap at basement door; burnt-out bulbs
summary: Quarter-inch gap at bottom of rear basement exit door must be made tight-fitting to prevent pest entry. Damaged self-closing devices on both washroom doors. Burnt-out bulbs inside the two-door cooler.

headline: 30–50 rodent droppings; exposed bait
summary: About 30–50 rodent droppings throughout prep area, especially hot prep; pest control service required. Rodent bait left uncovered under stoves; citation issued. Dish machine sanitizer above 200 ppm, tagged out. Missing covered waste receptacle.

headline: Cold food above 41°F; uncovered cooked foods
summary: Two-door refrigerator held cooked rice at 54.6°F, salmon mixture 48.3°F, eggs 46.5–47.4°F, and milk 49.1°F; about 10 lbs and a gallon discarded. Cooked foods uncovered. Menu lacks undercooked-item asterisks. Repeat violations.

headline: Dead insects by drive-through; grease buildup
summary: Dead insects found by drive-through window and beverage dispenser; must be removed and area cleaned. Grease buildup on baked potato oven and behind fryer. Slow-draining hand sink and standing water near rear prep area.

headline: Repeat violation: ceilings not smooth or cleanable
summary: Repeat priority violation from 11-19-24 not corrected: front and rear prep ceilings show exposed pipes, vents, conduits, and spray foam. Must provide a smooth, cleanable ceiling. Citation issued.

headline: Dirty fryers, dust, and leaking faucet
summary: Interior bottoms of fryers and exteriors of fryers and grill need cleaning. Leak from faucet neck of three-compartment sink must be repaired. Heavy dust on washroom ceiling fan. Floors under and behind equipment need cleaning.

headline: Greasy outdoor container, food on floors, no thermometer
summary: Greasy outdoor grease container that can attract rodents (none seen). Food stored on cooler floors, no thermometer in front prep cooler, hair restraint not worn, unlabeled flour, no handwashing signs, allergen training proof missing. Citation issued.

headline: Ice machine debris; splash guard needed
summary: Slight debris encrusted inside ice machine; must be cleaned and serviced. Splash guard needed between handwash sink and slicer. Leaking faucet at rear prep sink. Unisex washroom has no covered waste receptacle. Broken cooler in hallway.

headline: Flies, no probe thermometer, no test strips
summary: About 5–8 flies in rear dish and prep area; instructed to eliminate. No probe thermometer for food temperatures, and no chlorine test strips for dish machine. No employee health policy or vomit kit. Rust on indoor grill rack.

headline: Ice buildup on cooler; two food handlers untrained
summary: Ice buildup on the back of a stand-up cooler must be removed. Dry storage floor cluttered; items must be elevated or removed. Two food handlers lacked training certificates; must be kept on premises.

headline: Pest entry gaps and leaking equipment
summary: Gaps under front entrance and garage doors leading to the dumpster could let pests in; sealing instructed. Leaking coffee machine backflow device and leaking faucets at three-compartment sink. Missing grout. No food handler training proof.

headline: Rat droppings, unsafe cold food, no manager
summary: About 25–30 rat droppings under sinks, cooking equipment, and shelves in prep areas. Raw pork, liver, eggs, shrimp, and beef held above 41°F; about 20 lbs discarded. Oysters lacked shellstock tags; about 13 lbs discarded. No certified manager on site.

headline: About 100 rodent droppings and live flies
summary: About 100 rodent droppings under cold and hot holding equipment and dry storage shelves. About 75 small and 5 large live flies in the food prep area. No certified manager, food handler certificates, health policy, or vomit kit.

headline: Overflowing dumpsters and piled trash outside
summary: Dumpsters overflowing with lids open, plus piles of trash, boxes, and grease behind the rear door. Priority violation; citation issued. Also trash and debris around dumpsters, encrusted grease receptacle, clutter, and greasy unused equipment.

headline: Lobby ice machine dirty; allergen training expired
summary: Lobby ice machine attached to drink dispenser has a light pink substance on its interior top surface; instructed to remove ice and clean all internal surfaces. Allergen training expired for all certified managers; must renew.

headline: Repeat allergen violation; ashtrays found
summary: Repeat core violation: no allergen training certificates for certified managers, uncorrected from 11/14/2023; citation issued. Two ashtrays behind bar; citation issued. Also missing handwash signage and leaking pipe under three-compartment sink.

headline: Repeat violation: menu lacks consumer advisory
summary: Repeat priority violation: menu listing undercooked items, including eggs, lacks the required consumer advisory; citation issued. Summary report not posted for public view. Torn gasket on walk-in cooler door.

headline: Food debris and spills throughout facility
summary: Food debris, spills, and grease found on floors and surfaces throughout the facility. Inspector instructed detail cleaning under shelving, dish area, prep tables, and cooking equipment, and increasing cleaning frequency.

headline: Cooked chicken cooled improperly
summary: Cooked chicken in the rear cooler was cooled improperly; inspector instructed leaving food uncovered during cooling. Old debris on meat slicer to be cleaned. Front door found open, closed during review. Missing ceiling tiles above serving line.

headline: Restroom door not self-closing; no allergen proof
summary: Unisex restroom door is not self-closing and needs a self-closing device. No allergen training verification on site; must obtain and maintain it.

headline: About 70 rodent droppings found
summary: About 70 small rodent droppings in employee room, dry storage, near bread racks, and in the office. Pest control and cleaning required. Rear door gap, uncovered restroom receptacle, cluttered refuse area, ceiling leak, and missing allergen training for one manager.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No certified food manager on site during inspection, a priority violation. Raw chicken bones thawed at room temperature. Missing handwashing signs, no thermometers in most cold units, cooler doors not closing, dirty fryers, standing water on prep floor.

headline: Items on walk-in floor; blown hood bulb
summary: Items stored on walk-in cooler floor must be kept at least 6 inches off the floor. Blown light bulb in hood above grill must be replaced.

headline: Inadequate refrigeration capacity in rear prep
summary: Rear prep area has inadequate refrigeration for cooking, cooling, and deliveries; only one cooler in the rear. Manager instructed to install more refrigeration units. Priority violation.

headline: One-inch door gap; missing restroom receptacle
summary: One-inch gap between side entrance doors must be made tight-fitting and rodent-proofed. One of two unisex toilet rooms lacks a covered receptacle; instructed to provide one.

headline: Rodent droppings and unsafe ice machine
summary: About 40 mouse droppings on floor of east storage room by walk-in cooler; more pest control needed. Ice machine interior has black and brown buildup. No thermometer for cold food. Dirty grease dumpster lid.

headline: Wiping cloths stored damp on counter
summary: In-use wiping cloths were stored damp on the front service counter instead of in sanitizer solution. Inspector instructed correct storage. This was the only violation noted.

headline: About 15 rat droppings found
summary: About 15 rat droppings along wall behind the hot water tank near the rear exit. Pest control service recommended; droppings must be removed. Also rusty shelving, torn cooler gaskets, damaged cutting board, and missing women's restroom ceiling panels.

headline: Worn weather stripping, dirty floors, leak
summary: Worn weather stripping at front revolving door needs repair to prevent pest entry. Floors and walls need detail cleaning. Heavy grease on fryers and flat-top. Leak at dishwasher backflow device. Dust on walk-in cooler fans.

headline: Undated TCS food discarded; food on floor
summary: Fried plantains and refried beans in cooler lacked date labels; about 15 lbs discarded. To-go flan and jello lacked labels. Jalapenos, onions, and chiles stored on floor. Cooler condensate draining onto floor.

headline: No health policy or vomit procedure
summary: No employee health policy or training on site, and no vomit and diarrhea procedure or kit. Three-compartment sink middle basin too small; drainboard and sink stoppers missing. Quarter-inch gap at front door. Staff restroom door not self-closing.

headline: Hot and cold food held at unsafe temperatures
summary: Meat sauce at 116°F in hot holding unit, below 135°F. Walk-in cooler held meatballs at 45°F, meat sauce 49–55°F, and marinara 44–48°F; cold food must be 41°F or below. No signed employee health policy on site.

headline: Unsafe chicken; roaches and flies found
summary: About 20–30 lbs chicken held at 50–70°F and discarded. Ice machine panel has black and pink slime dripping onto ice. About 10–15 small flies in rear prep and 5–10 live roaches in dish and furnace areas; pest control needed.

headline: About 30 live flies in basement stairwell
summary: About 30 live flies on wall and ceiling of the stairwell to the basement; areas must be cleaned and pest control called. Ice buildup in walk-in freezer, leaking faucets, dirty floors, and standing water in prep and dish areas.

headline: No pest control log; ashtray on toilet
summary: No pest control log book on premises; must have one from a licensed pest company with at least two inspections in the past year; citation issued. Ashtray with cigarette ash found on washroom toilet; clean indoor air citation issued.

headline: Manager lacks certificate; no hair restraints
summary: Person in charge has no city food manager certificate, and no certified manager was on site during TCS food prep. Walk-in cooler thermometer not working. Food handlers without hair restraints or training proof. Broken floor tiles.

headline: Cardboard liners; tongs stored improperly
summary: Tongs stored improperly on a paper plate at frontline. Cardboard used as liner on food prep equipment. Food storage containers in prep area lack labels. Broken door handles on two-door freezer.

headline: Flour buildup above ice machine
summary: Flour buildup on the upper wall vent above the ice machine must be cleaned.

headline: Minor gaps, leaks, and no food handler training
summary: Quarter-inch gap at side exit door must be sealed to keep pests out. Leaking three-compartment sink faucet and stained dishwashing-area ceiling tiles. No food handler training available for employees.

headline: No certified manager certificate posted
summary: Person in charge lacked a city sanitation certificate, and none was posted or provided for the manager on duty. Handwashing and three-compartment sinks drain slowly. Duct-taped hole at mop sink. No allergen training certificates.

headline: Front prep sink counter in poor repair
summary: Counter at front prep handwashing sink is in poor repair, with blackened, moldy caulking. Must be cleaned or replaced.

headline: Water-stained tiles, dirty floors, clutter
summary: Water-stained ceiling tiles in the rear, dirt and debris in front and rear floor corners, and clutter in the rear storage area. Inspector instructed the manager to replace tiles, clean floors, and clear clutter.

headline: Food handlers not wearing hair restraints
summary: Food handlers and employees in food prep areas were not wearing hair restraints. Inspector instructed them to wear restraints while in the prep area.

headline: Deli cooler thermometer missing and broken
summary: No visible thermometer inside the deli walk-in cooler, and the outside thermometer is not working. Torn juice bar cooler gaskets, stained cutting boards, low water pressure at juice bar sink, and unused coolers to remove.

headline: No sanitation certificate; roaches found
summary: No valid city food sanitation certificate; certified manager must be on premises. About 5 roaches above sink, under oven, and behind cooler, with more on rear floor. Quarter-inch gap at rear door. Uncovered food; milk crates used as shelving.

headline: Leak at three-compartment sink piping
summary: Leak from piping at the three-compartment sink in the dishwashing area. Instructed to repair and maintain.

headline: Hair restraints, rusty racks, dirty floors
summary: Not all prep-area employees wore hair restraints. Rusty walk-in cooler racks, dirty storage racks, charred hot holding unit, and water-stained ceiling tiles. Walk-in cooler floors dirty with blood and grease. Manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: Flour unlabeled; food stored on floor
summary: Bulk flour container in dry storage lacked a label. Food container stored on dry storage hallway floor must be raised 6 inches. Linens touched cooked noodles. Clean equipment stored near a handwashing sink without splash guard.

headline: Restroom needs cleaning; no allergen proof
summary: Employee toilet room needs detail cleaning. City-certified food manager has no allergen training certificate on hand; must obtain one.

headline: Quarter-inch door gap; damaged floor tiles
