summary: Quarter-inch gap at bottom of rear exit door near basement ice machine must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Damaged gaskets on two-door cooler. Greasy cooking equipment and shelving. Damaged floor tiles near basement ice machines.

headline: Fly trap, dirty ice machine, missing waste cans
summary: Fly sticky trap on wall by mop sink must be removed. Dirty ice machine interior, debris under fryers, and no waste receptacles at handwashing sinks. Used tissues on men's bathroom floor. No food handler or allergen certificates on site.

headline: Ice machine door won't close fully
summary: Rear-area ice machine door is in poor repair; hinge loose and door cannot fully close. Must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Expired certificates; managers lack allergen training
summary: Some employee food handler certificates have expired, and certified managers on duty lack allergen training certificates. Rusty, dirty walk-in cooler shelves must be cleaned, repainted, or replaced.

headline: No certified manager; unsafe ice machine
summary: No certified manager on site while pork was prepared. Ice machine interior had pink and black slime, and its ice is used for people; two batches must be discarded. No employee health policy. Summary report not posted.

headline: Stained cutting board; wet mop in hallway
summary: Cutting board at prep line has open seams and stains; must be refinished or replaced. Wet mop stored in bucket in hallway to basement; hang mops to dry.

headline: Raw beef stored over ready-to-eat food
summary: Raw beef stored above and on top of cooked and ready-to-eat foods; about 10 lbs discarded. About 20 dozen eggs left unrefrigerated at 70–73°F; discarded. Equipment washed in prep sink without sanitizer. No chlorine test strips.

headline: No certified manager; food stored on floors
summary: No person in charge and no city-certified sanitation holder on premises while handling chicken and fish; manager did not come in. Food, drinks, flour, and equipment stored on floors, including stairwell. Light shields missing.

headline: No health policy; food dated improperly
summary: No written employee health policy on premises. Cooked beef in walk-in cooler lacked expiration dates; about 20 lbs discarded. Manager immediately provided paper towels at a handwashing sink. Employees without hair restraints; rusty shelving.

headline: Wet wiping cloths; milk-crate shelving; dirty floors
summary: Wet wiping cloths on several prep surfaces must be stored in sanitizer. Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Loose debris and dust on walk-in cooler floors and corners.

headline: Low hot water; flies; no allergen training
summary: Hot water at most handwash sinks was 81–95°F; 100°F required, with one middle sink having no running water. About 25 or more live small flies on walls and ceiling tiles in dish and prep areas; pest control needed. Dirty fryers and floor drains.

headline: Screen door gaps; mops drying improperly
summary: Interior screen door has quarter-inch gaps at bottom, side, and top; must be repaired to prevent pest entry. Mops left damp on floor and in buckets; must hang to air dry to prevent fly breeding. Floors, drains, walls, and ceilings need detail cleaning.

headline: Splash guard, crates, and drain cleaning needed
summary: Splash guard needed at hand sink next to dump sink in first-floor bar. Crates used for food storage in walk-in cooler must be removed and rust cleaned from shelves. Floor drains need debris cleaned. Some food handler training expired.

headline: Food on walk-in floor; clutter in dry storage
summary: Food stored on the walk-in cooler floor must be kept 6 inches off the floor. Heavy clutter in dry storage food areas; remove unused items to prevent hiding places for pests.

headline: Missing handwash signs; items stored on floor
summary: Multiple handwashing sinks missing signs. Items stored on basement dry storage floor must be raised 6 inches. Water-damaged bottom shelf. Ice machine backflow leaking onto floor. Manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: No food handler certificates on site
summary: No food handler certificates were on site. Manager instructed to comply with the state food handler requirement.

headline: Unused basement restroom; hood not working
summary: Unused fourth restroom in basement must be marked out of order. Hood over rear prep oven does not turn on; must be repaired or replaced. No handwashing signage at bar sink.

headline: No certified manager; ice machine soiled
summary: No city-certified manager on site while handling chicken and eggs; citation issued. Women's restroom faucet cannot keep water flowing 15 seconds. Ice machine exterior and interior soiled. Food stored on walk-in freezer floor and under unshielded sewer lines.

headline: No certificate posted; no employee health policy
summary: No valid city food sanitation certificate posted for food employees. No written employee health policy on site. Soiled mop heads not hung to dry, risking insect breeding. Dust on walk-in condenser; debris around dumpster; no food handler certificates.

headline: Cutting boards stored too close to floor
summary: Cutting boards stored less than 6 inches off the floor on a pallet; must move to proper shelving. Cardboard lining the rear storage shelf must be removed and replaced with a smooth, non-porous surface.

headline: Six live roaches and 75+ mouse droppings
summary: Six live roaches at hand sink and under cooking equipment; 75 or more mouse droppings in rear storage and at service counter. Pest control recommended. Also: no raw-food advisory on menu, greasy equipment, expired allergen training.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; food on floors
summary: Large containers of seasonings, sugar, and similar foods lack labels in kitchen and bakery. Food stored on floor in bakery walk-in cooler and meat freezer must be raised 6 inches. Employee without hair restraint. Milk crates used as shelving.

headline: No certified manager; rat droppings; unsafe temperatures
summary: No certified food manager on duty while TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. About 20 rat droppings and live flies in basement, dry storage, and sales floor. Hot food at 87–124°F and cold watermelon at 66.4°F; discarded. Sinks at 0 ppm sanitizer.

headline: Manager lacks proof of allergen training
summary: The city-certified food manager on duty had no proof of allergen training on site. Inspector instructed the facility to provide proof for all city-certified food service managers. Passed.

headline: Food containers stored improperly; no allergen training
summary: Food containers were not stored inverted; must be stored inverted. Sanitation manager has no allergen training; instructed to provide it.

headline: Roach infestation; no vomit cleanup kit
summary: About 10 live cockroaches on a glue trap under the three-compartment sink and 5 on the front bar counter; pest control recommended. No vomit and diarrhea procedure or supplies. Food equipment in customer bar area, no barrier.

headline: Live roaches and mouse droppings found
summary: Three live roaches in kitchen and dishwashing areas and 30 mouse droppings on the floor under the bar. Pest control service and cleaning required. Cold water faucet handle in poor repair; leak from three-compartment sink.

headline: Ice scoop on ice; dim walk-in lighting
summary: Ice scoop stored on top of ice; must be kept in a clean holder. Grocery plastic bags used for food storage in the prep cooler; use food-grade bags. Inadequate walk-in cooler lighting; add lights.

headline: Pest log incomplete; manager lacks allergen proof
summary: Certified food manager has no valid allergen training certificate. Repeat violation: pest control log has only one inspection report from the past year; at least two are required. Citation issued.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; no mop sink
summary: Rear receiving door is not rodent-proof, with a half-inch gap at the bottom; must be fixed to prevent pest entry. No mop sink; one must be installed with hot and cold water and a backflow device. Missing handwash signage.

headline: Improper thawing; missing sink signs; door gap
summary: Sausages thawed in the three-compartment sink, an improper method. No handwashing signage at sinks. Small opening at the bottom of the rear exit door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Re-inspection, passed.

headline: Ice machine buildup; damaged cutting boards
summary: Ice machine interior needs cleaning. All cutting boards need replacing for dark spots and cuts. Reach-in cooler and freezer outer areas and floors need cleaning. Lights need shields or shatterproof bulbs.

headline: Failed: rat droppings and unsafe temperatures
summary: Failed. About 75 or more rat droppings in basement near hot water tank, table and mattress; pest control recommended. Cooked steak and chicken held too cool; about 35 lbs discarded. Cold foods at 46–58°F discarded; cooler tagged.

headline: Salad prep cooler too warm; tagged
summary: Front salad prep cooler at 50.1°F, above the 41°F limit; tagged and not to be used until it holds temperature. Wiping cloths left on prep tables. Rear walk-in shelving dirty; garbage can lid missing in employee washroom. Pass with conditions.

headline: No covered waste receptacles; belongings on shelves
summary: Unisex washrooms on the first floor, rear area and second floor lack covered waste receptacles. Employee belongings stored on food storage shelving and need a designated area. Canvass inspection, passed.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged out
summary: Low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm chemical and is tagged. It must not be used until reinspected by the Chicago Department of Public Health. Ice scoop left lying in ice, and debris on floors and in corners.

headline: Soap added on site; openings and damaged gaskets
summary: Handwashing sink lacked soap; soap provided before inspection ended. Missing handwashing signs. Openings around walk-up window must be sealed. Food stored on floors, damaged gaskets and freezer lid, and a leaking faucet. Passed with conditions.

headline: Missing thermometer; rusty racks; wall opening
summary: Re-inspection found no thermometer visible in walk-in cooler and rusty storage racks there. Crates used as shelving, no grease trap found for dish sink, and a wall opening by the washroom.

headline: Failed: unsafe hot and cold food temperatures
summary: Brown rice held at 112°F; 3 lbs discarded. Several cold foods held at 47–67°F; about 7 lbs fried shrimp and other items discarded ($200). Greasy filters above griddle. Certified manager lacks allergen training. Citation issued.

headline: No paper towels at prep handsink; fixed on site
summary: No paper towels at the prep-area handsink. Staff obtained paper towels during the inspection. Priority violation cited for handsink supplies. Short-form complaint, passed with conditions.

headline: No allergen certificates for certified managers
summary: No allergen certificates were provided for certified food managers. Management was told all certified food managers must show proof of allergen training. Canvass inspection, passed.

headline: Certified managers lack allergen training
summary: Certified food managers on duty had no allergen training certification. Management instructed that all food service managers must obtain it. Complaint re-inspection, passed.

headline: Raw foods held too warm; sewage backed up
summary: Raw pork, quail and whole ducks held at 59.9–68°F. About 210 lbs ($455) discarded; citation issued. Sewage backed up from floor drain at three-compartment sink; employees repaired it during inspection. Leaking pipe and cardboard on floors.

headline: Failed: no sanitizer; cold food discarded
summary: No quat (quaternary ammonium) sanitizer on site for the three-compartment sink; citation issued. Cold foods at 53–58°F in two-door prep cooler, about 39 lbs ($387) discarded, and cooler tagged. No food handler or allergen training for new manager.

headline: Prep shelf falling off basement wall
summary: Inspector saw a basement prep shelf falling off the wall and instructed staff to repair and maintain it. Canvass inspection, passed.

headline: Food handlers lack training certificates
summary: Several food handling employees lacked food handler training certificates. Management instructed that all food handling employees must show proof of food handler training. Re-inspection, passed.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; rear door opening
summary: No handwashing signage at multiple sinks. Opening at right corner at base of rear exit door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Leaking drainpipe at three-compartment sink rinse area and soap/sanitizer connection.

headline: Chicken held too cool; dead roaches found
summary: About 50 lbs of cooked chicken held at 109.5–116°F; person in charge discarded it. Dead cockroaches on floor in rear storage near hot water tank. Rusted freezer cover and greasy fryers noted.

headline: Greasy fryer cabinet interior
summary: Grease buildup found inside the fryer cabinet. Staff instructed to clean and maintain it. Canvass inspection, passed.

headline: Gap at front door; leaks; no allergen certificates
summary: Opening at base of front entrance door must be sealed to prevent pests. Leaking under three-compartment sink rinse compartment. Paper towel dispenser must move away from sanitizer side. Women's washroom door needs self-closing device.

headline: Soiled mop head not stored properly
summary: Soiled mop head was not stored properly. Manager instructed to hang mop heads to allow drying. License re-inspection, passed.

headline: Business license number missing from label
summary: Business license number not printed at least two inches tall on the lateral sides of the packaged food label. Must be provided. License re-inspection, passed.

headline: Leaking bar handsink; standing water; stained tiles
summary: Bar handwash sink pipe is leaking and must be repaired. Standing water around the grease trap under the dish sink; floor must be kept dry. Water-damaged ceiling tiles above chest freezers must be replaced. Canvass, passed.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; mop storage issue
summary: Milk crates used as shelving in prep, storage, walk-in cooler and freezer must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Mop not stored to dry. Debris on floor behind tortillas. Canvass, passed.

headline: Dead insects in men's restroom
summary: Dead insects found in the men's toilet room and must be removed. Grease trap exterior at the three-compartment sink needs cleaning. Complaint inspection, passed.

headline: Failed: no health policy; sewage and ice issues
summary: No employee health policy or vomit/diarrhea procedure on site. Black substance in ice machine water reservoir; ice used for consumption. Wastewater backed up from floor drain under three-compartment sink. Menu lacks cook-to-order advisory.

headline: No certified manager; no signed health policies
summary: No certified food manager on duty while fried chicken and rice were prepared; citation issued. No signed employee health policies. Gaps at front and rear doors, food on freezer floor, and a heavy leak in the men's restroom. Passed with conditions.

headline: Unused prep area; two employees need training
summary: Second prep area not in use, and unused cooking equipment improperly stored. Equipment must be removed or kept 6 inches off the floor. Two new employees need food handler training within 30 days of hire. Passed.

headline: Failed: rat droppings and poison on floor
summary: Failed. About 100 rat droppings found in basement on floor, ledges and under equipment; more pest control service needed. Rat poison blocks stored on floor instead of covered tamper-resistant bait stations. Citations issued.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; no allergen training
summary: Bar-area handwashing sinks lacked handwashing signage; manager must provide signs at all food-employee handsinks. The certified food manager on site had no food allergen training. Canvass inspection, passed.

headline: No handwashing signs; unlabeled food
summary: No handwashing signage at the handsink. No thermometer in hot-hold unit holding chicken. Wrapped muffins unlabeled. Refuse area had stored items, and boxes, coffee grounds and chips were stored on the prep floor. License inspection, passed.

headline: Fly activity at back door; utensil storage
summary: Back door needs insect-proofing to stop fly activity. Wiping cloths and knives not stored in sanitizing solution or holder. Discolored, pitted cutting boards. Prep tables, coolers and floors need detail cleaning. Passed.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings and flies found
summary: About 200 rodent droppings found by coolers, the service line and dining area. About 10 large flies in prep, dishwashing and side areas. Pest control required. Chicken thawed in water; hair restraints missing; rusted cooler racks.

headline: Service sink removed; must be replaced
summary: No service sink in the facility; the manager said it was removed. Manager instructed to replace the service sink. Re-inspection, passed.

headline: No health policy; no vomit cleanup procedure
summary: Pass with conditions. No employee health policy on site and no procedure for vomit or diarrhea cleanup; both priority violations, no citation issued. Refrigeration units lack thermometers. Certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Loose sink stopper; leaking dish sink faucet
summary: Mechanical stopper of the three-compartment sink in the dishwashing area is in poor repair. Faucet at the same sink is leaking. Both must be repaired and maintained. Canvass inspection, passed.

headline: Exposed utensils; mop on floor; vent dust
summary: Cake pans and bowls stored with food-contact surfaces exposed on a shelf; must be inverted or covered. Mop stored on utility closet floor and must dry between uses. Heavy dust on bathroom vent. Canvass, passed.

headline: Soap at dump sink; single-use items on floor
summary: Hand soap found at bar dump sink; handwashing sinks must have soap and towels. Single-use cup used as scoop in bulk storage, straws stored on the floor, and paper towels in toilet room. Stove grease and slow-draining handsink noted.

headline: Door gaps; food handler certificate missing
summary: Front and rear doors have half-inch gaps at the bottom and must be made tight-fitting and rodent-proofed. A female food handler on site lacked a food handler certificate. Re-inspection, passed.

headline: Rear door gap; food stored on floor
summary: A quarter-inch gap at the rear exit door must be sealed to keep pests out. Food containers stored on floor in walk-in cooler and dry storage. Raw beef in plastic bag. Missing sink stoppers and rusted prep table. Canvass, passed.

headline: No health policy; beards; door gap
summary: No employee health policy on site; citation issued. No paper towels in toilet room; citation issued. Half-inch gap between front entrance doors must be sealed. Male food handlers with beards lacked beard guards. Passed with conditions.

headline: Cardboard bowls stored face up
summary: Single-use cardboard bowls stored face up at the salad serving line. Must be inverted to protect from overhead contamination. Complaint inspection, passed.

headline: Re-inspection failed: grease, leaks, duct tape
summary: Grease and food debris on fryer oil unit and heavy equipment, instructed to clean to prevent pest harborage. Handsink pipe leaking in toilet room. Excess duct tape and water-stained ceiling tiles. Outdoor receptacle lacks lids.

headline: No certified manager during breakfast service
summary: No certified food manager on site while breakfast was prepared and served; citation consolidated with another license. No thermometer in a mini cooler, food handlers lacked hair restraints, and black buildup inside the ice machine. Passed with conditions.

headline: No backflow device at drip coffee machine
summary: No backflow prevention device found at the drip coffee machine waterline. Device must be provided where it can be located and serviced. Complaint inspection, passed.

headline: Failed: door gaps; live flies; uncorrected violation
summary: Failed. Front doors have a one-inch gap between them and a half-inch gap underneath. About 10 live small flies found, and about 75 live small flies at re-inspection. Previous violation not corrected; citation issued. Hole in bakery wall.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; 15 lbs discarded
summary: Cooked beef, marinating chicken, chicken wings, deli meats and eggs held at 48–52°F in a two-door cooler. About 15 lbs ($178) discarded; citation issued. Greasy grill, water-stained ceiling tiles, and cardboard on shelves.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup procedure
summary: No written employee health policy and no written procedure for vomit or diarrhea cleanup; both are priority violations. A handsink must be installed behind the bar. Missing liquor storage ceiling and inoperable washroom ventilation.

headline: Bare hand contact with ready-to-eat pork
summary: Food handler touched cooked pork for salad wrap with bare hands; gloves or tongs required. Citation issued. Two disinfectant spray bottles lacked common-name labels. Heavy dust on hood. Canvass, passed with conditions.

headline: Missing labels; cardboard used as shelving
summary: Dry storage containers lacked common-name labels, and cardboard boxes elevated food containers in the prep area. Staff instructed to label and use proper shelving. Canvass inspection, passed.

headline: Leaking new handsink; overhead pipes need repair
summary: Constant small leak at the faucet of a newly installed basement prep handsink must be repaired. Overhead pipes above the three-compartment sink and prep area have rough edges, seams and crevices. Re-inspection, passed.

headline: Missing faucet knob; food debris in prep
summary: Handsink missing its cold-water knob must be repaired. Food debris throughout the prep area, around the three-compartment sink and under the dishwasher must be cleaned. Dust on prep vent fan. Re-inspection, passed.

headline: Greasy floor under front cooking equipment
summary: Floor below cooking equipment in the front prep area heavily soiled with grease and black buildup. Manager instructed to detail clean the floor and keep it free of excessive buildup. Canvass, passed.

headline: Failed: low hot water; ice cream mix too warm
summary: Hallway bar hot water measured 70°F; hand sinks must reach at least 100°F. A service technician fixed it, and sinks now run 102–105°F. Vanilla ice cream mix at 44.1°F in display cooler. Citations issued.

headline: Rodent-proofing gap; unlabeled containers
summary: Rear basement exit door not fully rodent-proofed; quarter-inch gap must be sealed. Salt and pepper containers unlabeled. Food in plastic bags in basement freezers; milk crates used in walk-in freezer. Soiled mop heads not stored to dry. Passed.

headline: Failed: black and pink ice machine residue
summary: Large amounts of black substance at the ice chute and pink/orange residue on the ice machine shield. Ice must be removed and machine detail cleaned and sanitized. Citation issued. Dust on ceiling tiles and debris on prep floors; A/C vents cause dust buildup.

headline: Re-inspection: fryer grease and floor
summary: Grease buildup inside deep fryers and dust on food prep wire shelves must be cleaned. Grease on floor beneath cooking equipment must be cleaned. A food handler lacked a training certificate; management must show proof. Passed.

headline: Moldy wall caulking near dish area
summary: Blackened, moldy wall caulking at the three-compartment sink and dish machine area must be replaced and maintained. Re-inspection, passed.

headline: No written health policy; training proof missing
summary: No written employee health policy on site; a blank copy was given to the manager. No proof of food handler training. A certified food manager lacked allergen training. Stained ceiling tiles over the grill; washroom door needs self-closing device.

headline: Failed: pizza on floor; grease trap leaking
summary: Employee pizza stored over hot dog buns in steamer; discarded, and citation issued. Pizza box stored on floor. Grease trap leaked into rear area; prep paused while staff cleaned, and a new trap was brought in. Citation issued.

headline: Chicken covered tightly while cooling
summary: Chicken in walk-in cooler was covered tightly with plastic wrap while cooling; staff told to remove it. Multi-use bowl used as scoop in bulk storage. Missing handwashing signage and certificates for certified managers.

headline: Missing covered receptacle; uncertified handler
summary: Employee washroom lacked a covered waste receptacle. One food handler lacked a food handler certificate; management instructed to provide proof of training for all food handlers. Canvass inspection, passed.

headline: No covered trash receptacle in employee restroom
summary: No covered trash receptacle inside the unisex employee toilet room; facility instructed to provide one. Canvass inspection, passed.

headline: Dirty drying rack; slow drain; dusty vent
summary: Plates air-dried on a dirty rack above the three-compartment sink; utensils must be rewashed and rack cleaned. Men's room sink drains very slowly. Floors need cleaning and water removed. Walk-in cooler vent needs detail cleaning.

headline: Failed: missing labels; sink faucet too short
summary: Frozen desserts in display cooler lacked ingredient labels. Three-compartment sink faucet doesn't reach left or right basins; citation issued. Two-door freezer interior and prep table need cleaning. Men's restroom door not self-closing. Buckling floor in walk-in cooler.

headline: Failed: live cat in food storage area
summary: A live cat walked out of rear food storage, and an open can of cat food sat on the floor. Cat was removed but returned twice; animals are now not allowed except service animals. Tall weeds and outdoor clutter. Citation issued.

headline: Hair restraints missing; overflowing dining trash
summary: Several food handlers handling food without hair restraints. Garbage receptacles in dining area overflowing. Floors under and around storage racks and heavy equipment have food, dirt and debris. Complaint inspection, passed.

headline: Prepped food in customer-accessible cold unit
summary: Prepared service items stored in a cold hold unit in the dining room, accessible to customers. Must be removed or secured. Food debris inside a prep cooler; person in charge instructed to clean. Complaint inspection, passed.

headline: Front door gap; cooler and grill cleaning needed
summary: Front entrance door not fully rodent-proof; a quarter-inch gap at the bottom must be sealed. Refrigeration interiors, grill and fryer exteriors, and floors under equipment need cleaning. Several water-stained ceiling tiles. Canvass, passed.

headline: Failed: three-compartment sink backs up
summary: Water backed up into the first and third sink basins when the second basin drained. Repair required before re-inspection; citation issued. Spillage in single-door coolers in rear storage. Customer restroom door not self-closing.

headline: Dirty shelves, fan covers and washrooms
summary: Shelves, walk-in cooler fan covers and refrigeration interiors need cleaning. Washroom door lacks a self-closing device, toilets and sinks need cleaning, and floors in several areas need cleaning. Canvass, passed.

headline: No handwashing signs at hand sinks
summary: No handwashing signage found at hand sinks. Signage must be provided. Canvass inspection, passed.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Boxes of food stored on the walk-in cooler floor. Cardboard used as liner inside the freezer storing gyro meat. Expired food handler certificates found, and a certified food manager has an expired allergen training certificate. Canvass, passed.

headline: Food stored in handsink; black slime in ice
summary: Failed. Beef bones and eggs stored in the prep handsink; all food discarded. Dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged. Black slime in ice machine; ice must be discarded. Menu lacks raw-food advisory.

headline: Blocked handsinks; soap added on site
summary: Handsinks in both prep areas were blocked by a cooler, equipment and mop buckets; moved during inspection. No soap at front prep handsink, provided during inspection. Small bowls used as dispensing utensils in food. Certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Leaking dish sink; mop room cleanup needed
summary: Water leaking at base of the three-compartment dishwashing sink must be repaired. Utility mop sink room needs detail cleaning and reorganizing, with unneeded items removed due to potential pest harborage. Passed.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; uncertified handlers
summary: Failed. No Chicago certified food manager on site while fish, chicken and beef were prepared and served. Two employees lacked food handler certificates. Hair restraints missing; floor drains and freezer floor dirty; ceiling tiles water-stained.

headline: Food debris and spills on equipment and floors
summary: Food debris and spills on cabinets, cooking equipment, holding units, prep tables and shelving. Floors in prep, dishwashing and storage areas also soiled. Leaking drainpipe under tray room handsink must be repaired. Re-inspection, passed.

headline: Unsafe cold holding; food discarded; citation issued
summary: Several cold foods held at 45–53°F. Manager discarded about 600 lbs chicken, 100 lbs noodles, 25 lbs eggs and 30 lbs burger meat ($5,000). Walk-in cooler at 46°F. Sewage backed up onto prep floor.

headline: No service sink; several upkeep issues
summary: No service sink was installed, so staff must provide one for mop water. Also noted: no covered receptacle in the all-gender employee washroom, dust on floors and vents, and an unused coffee machine on the counter.

headline: Front door gap; greasy vent; slow sink drain
summary: Quarter-inch gap at front entrance door must be sealed to prevent pests. Slime and slow drain at front three-compartment sink; dirty walk-in freezer floor; no self-closing device on employee restroom door; heavy greasy vent. Complaint, passed.

headline: Failed: cold food too warm; no hair restraints
summary: Failed. Several cold foods in bakery cooler held at 44.8–67°F; about 33 lbs discarded, citation issued. Front food handlers lacked hair restraints. Sink lacked splashguard, and basement clutter needs proper shelving. Certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Unapproved packaging machine tagged
summary: Unapproved reduced-oxygen packaging machine on site, not in use. Tagged; must not be used until CDPH approval or removal. Food storage containers on walk-in cooler floor must be elevated 6 inches. Passed with conditions.

headline: No allergen training proof for food managers
summary: Re-inspection found no proof of allergen training or certificates for City of Chicago certified food managers. Facility must provide proof. Passed.

headline: Failed: no valid certificate; cooler at 65°F
summary: No valid city sanitation certificate on site and no person in charge with manager training. Marinated chicken and pork at 50–52°F; 8 lbs ($100) discarded. Outdoor walk-in cooler at 65°F tagged. No thermometer in walk-in cooler. Citations issued.

headline: Failed: old violations not corrected
summary: Prior violations still not corrected: no mechanical ventilation in toilet room, and no food allergen training for the food manager. Citation issued.

headline: Missing splashguard; leaking prep sink; wall hole
summary: Missing splashguard between bar handsink and three-compartment sink. Prep sink leaking in main prep area. Employee toilet room lacks a trash receptacle cover, and a wall hole and peeling paint near the handsink must be repaired. Canvass, passed.

headline: Failed: unapproved cucumber acidification
summary: Acidification of cucumbers in basement buckets without CDPH variance; about 40 lbs ($100) discarded. No working metal stem thermometer or irreversible thermometer. Walk-in freezer door frozen shut. Two employees lacked food handler training. Citation issued.

headline: Greasy floors; IDPH letter needed for training
summary: Accumulated grease debris on floors by the fryers must be cleaned. Facility runs internal food handler training but lacks the required approved letter from the Illinois Department of Public Health. Re-inspection, passed.

headline: No thermometer in egg cooler; dirty floor
summary: No thermometer inside the egg reach-in cooler; a working one must be provided. Dirt built up on the floor along north-side walls and must be cleaned and maintained. Canvass inspection, passed.

headline: Clean dishware stored at wash sink; dust found
summary: Clean pots and utensils stored on the wash side of the sink. All stored items must be off the floor. Dust on walk-in cooler vents, and duct tape used as sealant inside the walk-in cooler must be removed.

headline: Backflow device not located; sink leak
summary: Backflow prevention device not located at espresso machine; must be installed where it can be serviced. Leak at base of the three-compartment sink faucet must be repaired. License re-inspection, passed.

headline: Failed: missing health policy, sinks, and certificates
summary: No employee health policy, vomit cleanup procedure, prep-area handsink, food thermometer, or sanitizer test kit. Employees lacked food handler certificates, and managers lacked allergen training. No citation issued.

headline: Greasy grill and fryers
summary: Grease buildup under the grill, and on the outside and inside of cooking fryers. Must be cleaned and maintained. Canvass inspection, passed.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; food temperatures unsafe
summary: Failed. No certified manager posted during TCS food handling. Cooked rice at 87.6°F and broccoli at 111.4°F held too cool. Diced tomato and lettuce held too warm in refrigerator; a table-top refrigerator at 51.3°F was tagged. No dumpster.

headline: Re-inspection: gaps; missing tiles; no training
summary: Quarter-inch gap at the right exit door must be sealed to prevent pests. Equipment too large for sink lacks an alternate method, and no drainboard in rear kitchen. Missing washroom ceiling tiles and peeling rear ceiling. Employees lack food handler training. Passed.

headline: Complaint: dirty shelves and floors
summary: Walk-in cooler shelving has spills and debris and must be cleaned. Floors around, behind and under cooking equipment need cleaning, and the walk-in cooler floor too. Complaint inspection, passed.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; pest log missing
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on site while yogurt, cut melon and corn were prepared. Pest control log not maintained; last report dated 1/12/22. Overflowing outside dumpster; citation issued. Stained cutting boards; a food handler lacked a certificate.

headline: Failed: four live roaches found
summary: Failed. Four live roaches found throughout the facility, including the men's toilet room, near the three-compartment sink and prep area. Priority violation cited; manager told to service affected areas. Heavy grease and food debris on kitchen floors.

headline: Dead mouse on trap; grease and debris
summary: Dead mouse found on a trap in rear utility closet; removed at inspection. Damaged pot discarded. Grease on stove handles and sides; grease and spillage below stoves, and debris in utility closet behind water heater.

headline: Dish machine lacks sanitizer; live flies found
summary: No chlorine sanitizer detected at dish machine final rinse; must reach 100 ppm. Cooked ribs at 57F in walk-in cooler. About 20 live small flying insects and 4 house flies on walls, prep tables, and in prep and dish areas. Pest service needed. Citations issued.

headline: No certified manager; handsink water too hot
summary: No certified manager on site from 8:30 to 9 AM. Rear prep handsink water reached 136.2F, above the 100-120F range; repair required. Only one food handler card on site. Inspection summary not posted. Citations issued.

headline: Live roaches and over 25 mouse droppings
summary: Over 25 mouse droppings, especially in dry storage; live and dead roaches on glue boards; over 30 flying insects. Pest treatment and detail cleaning required. Also: propane tanks stored on site, mop sink lacks backflow device, grease on ground outside.

headline: Over 50 rat droppings; extermination ordered
summary: Over 50 rat droppings scattered along walls and under shelving in rear dry storage. Manager told to call an exterminator and clean and sanitize. Food stored on floor, soiled wiping cloths, debris, and food spills also noted. Citation issued.

headline: Rusty shelves; greasy ceiling; dirty fans
summary: Service prep cooler lids missing knobs. Rusty, dirty walk-in cooler shelves need detail cleaning and repainting or replacing. Dirt and food particles on ceiling at the grill; dusty ceiling fans in front and rear prep areas. Passed.

headline: Over 10 live roaches and flies; citation issued
summary: Over 10 live roaches, including in cold-holding gaskets, on the ice cream case, and on walls, plus flies in prep and dish areas. Dead roaches and flies also found. Pest control recommended on or after 9/9/2026. Citation issued.

headline: Utensils not inverted; broken floor tiles
summary: Multi-use utensils were not stored inverted; staff instructed to store them handle-up. Broken floor tiles near the three-compartment sink; repair instructed.

headline: Ice machine buildup; broken cutting board
summary: Basement ice machine had pink, black, and brown buildup on water reservoir, shield, and chute, which touches ice used for human consumption. Citation issued. Also: broken, grooved cutting board at pizza prep table; greasy compartments under fryers.

headline: Cooler at 59.6F; no vomit cleanup procedure
summary: Four-door cooler held at 59.6F; prep cooler tagged and cannot be used until re-inspected by the Chicago Department of Health. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or kit on site. No pest control logbook. No waste disposal contract on record.

headline: Fried chicken held too warm; smoking indoors
summary: Fried chicken measured 71.4F while stored on a rack; par-cooked foods must be refrigerated or properly hot held. About 10 pounds discarded ($15). No proof of food handler training. Smoking evidence indoors with cigarette butts in dish room handsink; citation issued.

headline: Dirty ice machine guard; leaking faucet
summary: Interior guard of ice machine has some dirt; person in charge told to detail clean. Shelving in rear dry storage lined with cardboard; boxed items on floor; leak at exposed warewashing handsink faucet; dirty floor in rear warewashing area.

headline: Prep cooler at 46.1F tagged; repair required
summary: One prep-line cooler held air at 46.1F, above 41F; no food was in it. Cooler tagged 'held for inspection' and must not be used until repaired. Also noted: torn gasket in stand-up cooler, missing light shield, and a food handler without a certificate.

headline: Flies found; no certified manager; cold water
summary: About 15 small flies near rear prep, dish area, bar, and sushi prep. No verifiable food sanitation certificate; certified manager must be on premises. Handsinks lacked soap and paper towels; hot water measured 66.8-78.9F, below 100F. Citations issued.

headline: Clutter in dry storage area near utility sink
summary: Clutter in rear dry storage near the utility sink. Staff instructed to remove unused articles and raise all items at least 6 inches off the floor to prevent pest harborage.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods prepared
summary: No person in charge with a certificate present; no certified food manager or valid documentation on site while deli sandwiches and pizzas were prepared and served. Citation issued. Grease trap under three-compartment sink improperly installed; must be corrected.

headline: Low hot water; greasy trap odor; dirty floors
summary: Low hot water pressure at the prep and dish area handsink; must be repaired. Grease trap has a foul odor and must be cleaned regularly. Bulk storage container exterior dirty. Clean reach-in coolers and freezer interiors. Rear storage floors and hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Dead roaches; blocked and unstocked handsinks
summary: Several dead roaches in prep area must be removed and cleaned. Dishwashing handsink blocked by soap and a container; bar handsink lacked soap; prep handsink lacked paper towels. Citation issued. Employee drinks not allowed in prep areas.

headline: No sanitation manager certificate posted
summary: No City of Chicago food sanitation manager's certificate posted on site; must be obtained with proof of receipt on site. No supplies for vomit or diarrhea cleanup on site. Rear floors have dirt and soda debris. Citations issued.

headline: No vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure
summary: No written procedures or supplies for vomit or diarrhea events; supplies must include sanitizer that eliminates norovirus. Ice scoop stored on wall with food-contact surface exposed. Milk crates used as shelving with tea on top. Food debris and spills on floors. Citation issued.

headline: Rusty racks, floor debris, expired allergen certificate
summary: Rust buildup on racks inside coolers; manager must repaint or replace them. Debris on floors around equipment in the bar. Certified food manager has an expired allergen certificate and must comply. Passed.

headline: Storage, labeling, and thermometer problems
summary: Food stored on basement walk-in floor must be raised 6 inches. In-use utensils stored improperly in prep area. Unlabeled food and condiment containers. No thermometers in upstairs refrigerators and freezers. Sticky fly trap in basement storage to be removed.

headline: No temperature devices on dish machine
summary: No warewashing machine temperature measuring devices on site for the high-temperature dish machine; must be obtained. Priority foundation violation noted.

headline: Cold TCS foods too warm; citation issued
summary: Cooked chicken at 55.9F, cooked beef and cheese at 48.6F, and cooked beans at 57.7F in two-door cooler. Manager voluntarily discarded about 6 pounds ($50). Citation issued. Exit doors have about 1/4-inch gaps. One food handler had an expired certificate.

headline: Unlabeled containers; food stored on floor
summary: Food stored in containers across coolers, walk-in, and dry storage lacked name labels. Some bulk containers uncovered; food containers on floors; scoops stored inside dry containers. Hole in ceiling around pipes; one food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Rusty shelves, milk crates, and ice buildup
summary: Rusty, dirty shelves in walk-in coolers; cutting boards with open seams and stains; torn walk-in cooler gasket. Milk crates used for elevation, which may hide pests; ice buildup in walk-in freezers; cracks in floors and walls. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Toilet room door not self-closing
summary: Employee toilet room door in the rear prep area does not self-close; a self-closing device must be installed and maintained. Passed license inspection.

headline: No allergen-trained certified manager on site
summary: No City of Chicago certified food service sanitation manager with allergen training was on site. Manager must provide documentation or a certificate. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Minor grease buildup inside fryers
summary: Minor grease buildup inside cooking fryers; staff instructed to clean and maintain. Passed canvass inspection.

headline: Cold foods too warm; about 45 pounds discarded
summary: Raw chicken, raw beef, hamburgers, and gyro sauce held at 47-54F, above the 41F limit. Manager voluntarily discarded about 45 pounds ($288). A front prep cooler at 57.3F was tagged and cannot be used until re-inspected. Grease in fryers also noted.

headline: Bar gun holders dirty; one hood filter missing
summary: Slight buildup inside bar gun holders; manager must clean them. One ventilation hood filter is missing above cooking equipment; a clean replacement must be provided.

headline: Restroom faucet lacks hot water
summary: One of two faucets at a men's restroom washbowl sink had no hot water. Repair or replacement instructed.

headline: Food on floor; rusty storage racks
summary: Boxed food stored on the floor in basement walk-in cooler must be raised six inches. Rusty storage racks must have rust removed and be kept smooth and cleanable. Passed canvass inspection.

headline: Blocked handsink; no hair restraints
summary: Front handsink was not accessible; deep fryer and product were stacked around it; citation issued. No handwashing signs at prep or toilet-room sinks. No thermometer in rear cooler. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Floor drain and floors dirty.

headline: Employee handled food unwashed; live flies found
summary: Employee wiped nose, touched beard, coughed on arms, then handled payments and ready-to-eat food without washing hands. Citation issued. About 60 live small flies throughout rear prep area and restrooms. Leaking ice machine hose also noted.

headline: Single-use items on floor; dirty floor drain
summary: Single-service articles stored on the floor in prep and storage areas; must be elevated. Floor drain under the three-compartment sink in the rear warewashing area is dirty; detail cleaning instructed.

headline: Restrooms lack covered trash receptacles
summary: Unisex and employee restrooms were missing covered receptacles; staff instructed to provide and maintain them. Passed license inspection.

headline: Unlabeled containers, crates, expired allergen certificate
summary: Food storage containers need common-name labels. Plastic soda and milk crates must not be used for elevation. Missing ceiling tile above hot water tank; hood and filters dusty and greasy. One certified manager has expired allergen training. Passed.

headline: Unlabeled to-go desserts; torn gaskets
summary: Cake and baklava sold to go in plastic containers had no labels; ingredients and contact information required. Torn gaskets throughout facility need repair or replacement. Employee restroom trash receptacle needs a cover.

headline: Wet mop, cardboard floor liners, greasy filters
summary: Wet mop stored in prep area; must be stored in mop bucket when not in use. Cardboard used as floor liner in prep area must be removed. Slight grease buildup on ventilation filters must be cleaned. Passed canvass inspection.

headline: No dish-area handsink; no food thermometer
summary: No handwashing sink accessible to the dishwashing area; one with hot and cold water, soap, and paper towels is required. No food temperature thermometer on site. No food handler certificates on site. License inspection failed.

headline: Unlabeled dry ingredients; floor debris
summary: Unlabeled container of dry ingredients in deli prep area; must be labeled with its common name. Slight debris on floors in bakery prep area and nearby office; cleaning instructed.

headline: Bulk food labels; wooden boxes and milk crates
summary: Bulk foods not in original containers must be labeled with the common name. Wooden boxes and milk crates must not be used to elevate stored items at the bar and dish area. Damaged caulking at cook-line handsink; replacement instructed.

headline: Door gaps found; no pests observed
summary: Openings at entrance and exit doors could let pests in; manager told to seal them. Women's washroom first stall lacked a covered sanitary-product receptacle. Ice buildup on bakery walk-in freezer condenser; removal instructed.

headline: Handwashing signs missing at several sinks
summary: No handwashing signs at exposed handsinks in the first-floor prep area and both washrooms. Signs must be provided. Passed canvass inspection.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; no drain board
summary: Handwashing sign needed at handsink and in washroom. Three-compartment sink needs a drain board or drying rack. Instructed to install and maintain both. Passed license inspection.

headline: Stained cutting boards; dirty drains; burnt bulbs
summary: Stained cutting boards in rear prep must be resurfaced or replaced. Dirty floor drains with debris in rear prep and dishwashing area; mop up water and keep floors dry. Burnt-out bulbs at front prep hood must be replaced.

headline: Unlabeled rice and spices; milk crates
summary: Bulk rice and spices lacked labels; contents name required. Milk crates used as shelving in prep and storage areas must be removed. Passed canvass inspection.

headline: No sanitizer on site; untrained food handler
summary: No sanitizer on site for cleaning food-contact surfaces; manager obtained it from another location during inspection. One food handler had no food handler training; manager told to provide certificates. Priority violation citation issued.

headline: Paper towels in restroom; greasy equipment
summary: Disposable paper towels stored in employee restroom; must be moved, with no single-service items stored in restrooms. Hot-holding unit and griddle exteriors greasy. Restroom handsink faucet leaks; repair required. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Dirty ice machine; freezer ice buildup
summary: Rear ice machine interior must be cleaned. Ice buildup in walk-in freezer, dirty floors under shelving, and dirty walk-in cooler floor. Walk-in cooler light is out and must be replaced. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen certificates
summary: One food handler lacked a food handler certificate. Certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate; training must be completed and certificate kept on site. Passed canvass inspection.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving
summary: Milk crates used as shelving in prep and storage areas must be removed; shelving should sit 6 inches off the floor. Grease, food debris, and dirt on floors under equipment and in corners. Dust on walk-in cooler fan. Passed re-inspection.

headline: Utensils stored in stagnant room-temperature water
summary: Spoons and utensils were kept in stagnant water at room temperature. Staff instructed to store in-use utensils according to the health code.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; thawing issue
summary: Rear exit door not rodent-proofed; must correct. Frozen chilies thawed on counter; TCS foods must be thawed under cold running water or refrigeration. Bulk items need clean labeled containers. Standing water on basement prep floor. Allergen certificate needed for manager.

headline: Cold food too warm; slime in ice machine
summary: Chicken at 46.8F, fish at 49.6F, and lamb at 48.0F held above 41F; about 8 pounds ($45) discarded. Heavy pink and black slime inside ice machine used for ice. No verifiable employee health policy. Inspection summary not posted. Citations issued.

headline: Handsink water shuts off too quickly
summary: Water at handsinks in family toilet rooms repeatedly turns on and off. Faucets must run for at least 15 seconds without being reactivated. Dust on walk-in cooler fans must be cleaned.

headline: Missing ice bin lids; torn gasket; uneven floor
summary: Ice bins in the ice cream area are missing lids; covers required. Torn gasket inside prep service cooler. Uneven floor inside basement walk-in cooler must be repaired. Re-inspection passed.

headline: No certified manager for 15 minutes
summary: No certified manager on site from 2:30 to 2:45 PM while chicken was prepared; citation issued. Frozen shrimp thawed in a container, which is not an approved method. Seasonings and rice lacked labels. Broken tiles, no sink stoppers, and no allergen training on site.

headline: No thermometers in two-door cold holding unit
summary: No ambient air thermometers inside the two-door cold holding unit in the prep area. Staff instructed to provide and maintain them. Passed.

headline: Dirty cooler shelves and ice cream freezer
summary: Bottom shelves inside reach-in coolers must be cleaned. Ice cream freezer interior must be defrosted and cleaned. Passed license inspection.

headline: 70-80 rodent droppings; open bait found
summary: About 70-80 rodent droppings in rear storage, kitchen storage, hot food area, and front check stands. Open bait along a backroom wall; only licensed pest technicians may place bait. Manager began cleanup. Citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; no hair restraints
summary: No person in charge held a valid Chicago food sanitation certificate, and no certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods such as steak and tacos were handled. Citation issued. Food handlers lacked hair restraints; handwashing sign missing.

headline: No certificate on site; no sanitizer test kit
summary: No person on site with an original City of Chicago food sanitation certificate posted; citation issued. Refrigerated retail-packaged foods lacked labels. No chemical sanitizing test kit. No food handler training certificates on site.

headline: No ice machine backflow device; grimy hood filters
summary: Cutting boards in front prep have deep grooves and dark stains. No backflow preventer connected to ice machine; installation required. Broken garbage can lid in women's restroom. Heavy grime on grill hood filters. One of two certified managers lacks allergen training.

headline: No thermometers in hot holding units
summary: No thermometers in hot holding units in the rear cooking area; thermometers required for all hot and cold holding units. Boxed food stored on floor in meat walk-in must be raised six inches. Accumulated food debris on rear cooking area floor.

headline: No certified manager on site for one hour
summary: No certified manager on site from 8:10 to 9:10 AM while deli meats and cheese were prepared; manager arrived at 8:10 AM. Citation issued. Food items and spices lack name labels; food stored in plastic grocery bags; mop heads stored improperly.

headline: Dirty equipment, rusty racks, uncovered cans
summary: Cooking equipment, walk-in cooler interior, and dish machine exterior not clean. Walk-in cooler racks rusty; must be repaired or replaced. Food containers not stored inverted on drying racks. Restroom trash cans lack covers; bar floors not clean.

headline: No certified manager or valid certificate on site
summary: No person in charge with foodservice manager training was present. No valid City of Chicago foodservice manager certificate was on site. Original certificate and certified manager must be on site at all times. Citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled salt, pepper, and oregano containers
summary: Salt, pepper, and oregano stored outside original containers had no labels; each must be labeled with its common name. Soiled mop heads were not hung to dry; hang them to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Food dated past 7-day limit; no advisory
summary: Various TCS foods in walk-in cooler dated beyond the 7-day maximum; citation issued. Brunch menu lacked a consumer advisory for raw or undercooked items; these must be marked with an asterisk or similar mark. Result: Fail.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit cleanup kit
summary: No certified manager on site. No vomit and diarrhea kit on site; kit with norovirus-effective sanitizer required. Handsink hot water measured 78.3F, below 100F; repair required. Only one food handler card on site. Citations issued.

headline: Utensil handles touch food; prior violations
summary: In-use utensil handles touched food in prep coolers; tongs stored between coolers. Mineral buildup in ice machine. Previous uncorrected violations include hair restraints, wiping cloths, cardboard liners, grease, and floors. Citation issued.

headline: Over 80 mouse droppings found; citation issued
summary: Over 80 mouse droppings on food storage shelves, floors, and in a men's restroom. Pest control service required before re-inspection next week. Also: 1/4-inch gap at rear exit door to seal; clutter and water-stained ceiling tiles. Citation issued.

headline: Bulk food labels; crates; heavy grease
summary: Bulk foods not in original containers need common-name labels. Plastic and wooden crates must not be used for elevation. Excessive grease on cooking equipment, floors, walls, and ceiling in the first-floor rear cook line. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Peeling plastic inside prep coolers
summary: Peeling plastic on metal prep coolers must be removed. Cardboard must not be used inside coolers or freezers. Passed.

headline: No certified food manager during food service
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods (foods that must be kept hot or cold, such as rice and chicken soup) were prepared and served. Slimy substance inside bar soda dispenser. Heavy grease in exhaust hood. Citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled bulk flour, sugar, and salt
summary: Bulk storage containers of flour, sugar, and salt had no labels. Person in charge instructed to label all bulk and working ingredient containers with their contents' name. Passed.

headline: Ice machine and rolling cart need cleaning
summary: Calcium buildup inside the ice machine and food debris on a rolling cart. Staff instructed to clean and maintain both. No other issues noted.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; no cleanup supplies
summary: Low-temperature dish machine measured 0 ppm chlorine and was not sanitizing; a technician on site said it now reads 50 ppm. Citation issued. No supplies for vomit or diarrhea cleanup. Fly ribbon trap to be removed. Damaged, rusty ceiling tiles and missing floor grout.

headline: Heavily stained, grooved meat prep cutting boards
summary: Cutting boards in the meat prep area are heavily stained with deep, dark grooves; must be cleaned and maintained at all times. Missing light shields above rear cooking equipment; shields required. Passed.

headline: Rear door gap, ice buildup, bulbs out
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the rear double door sweeps must be sealed to rodent-proof the doors. Ice buildup on walk-in cooler condenser must be removed. Ceiling light bulbs above the dish machine are not working.

headline: Dirty ice machine panel; dusty washroom fan
summary: Inside panel of the ice machine needs cleaning. Dust on washroom ceiling fan; staff instructed to clean it. Passed inspection.

headline: Splash guard, drain board, self-closing door
summary: Handsink next to deli prep table needs a splash guard. Three-compartment sink needs a drain board or wire shelf for air drying. Restroom door near prep area must be self-closing. Passed license inspection.

headline: Food debris on bar equipment, walls, and floor
summary: Food debris on exterior of coolers and sinks at the bar, plus on bar walls and floor. Must clean equipment, floors, and walls throughout the bar and maintain them.

headline: Food employees without hair restraints
summary: Food employees in the front prep area were not wearing hair restraints. Management told that all food employees preparing or serving food must wear them. Passed complaint inspection.

headline: No health policy, vomit procedure, or test strips
summary: No employee health policy or training on site, and no procedure for vomit and diarrhea events. No metal-stem thermometer and no sanitizing test strips for the three-compartment sink. Toilet room trash lacks a cover. Priority violations noted.

headline: Worn door seal and dirty freezer interior
summary: Front weather strip is slightly worn and could be a pest entry point; must be replaced. Interior of two-door reach-in freezer needs cleaning. Food service manager must obtain a food allergen certificate.

headline: Some food handler certificates expired
summary: Some food handler training certificates have expired; manager must update them. Passed.

headline: No employee health policy or vomit procedure
summary: No employee health policy on site; verification required for each employee. No procedure for cleaning up vomit and diarrhea. Rear exit door has about a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom; must be sealed. No one-compartment sink at coffee station. No citation issued.

headline: Grease and debris buildup; cleaning ordered
summary: Grease and food splatter on cooking and non-cooking equipment in prep area. Walk-in cooler shelving and floor have dirt and food debris. Private party room toilet lacks a covered receptacle. Cleaning instructed to prevent pests. Re-inspection passed.

headline: No basement handsink near ice machines
summary: No handwashing sink in basement near ice machines; one must be installed. Cooked pork stored in grocery bags in walk-in cooler; must use food-grade containers. Rusted and porous shelving, no utility sink, and mold-like residue in walk-in cooler also noted.

headline: No certified food manager during food prep
summary: No certified food manager or certificate on site while fish, chicken, and beef were prepared or served. Citation issued. Staff lacked hair restraints and food handler proof. Walk-in cooler floor rusty and dirty with inadequate light. Previous violations not corrected.

headline: Handsink blocked by water container; citation
summary: Front service line handsink near the bakery was blocked by a water container. Person in charge removed it on site; citation issued. Floor beneath the three-compartment sink and near the grease trap soiled with grease and dried food; cleaning instructed.

headline: Overflowing trash and dirty break room floor
summary: Trash receptacle in employee break room overflowing; remove excess trash and increase removal frequency. Break room floor not clean and has debris; cleaning instructed. Passed complaint inspection.

headline: Foil shelf liners, greasy fryers, debris
summary: Foil lines shelves over the three-compartment sink and glass dish storage; must be removed to prevent insect harborage. Grease in fryer oil filtering area; debris on walk-in cooler floor under shelving; no covered receptacle in rear restroom.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: Food service sanitation manager on site did not have a food allergen training certificate. Manager instructed to meet the requirement. Passed canvass inspection.

headline: Prior inspection summary not posted
summary: Summary from a 1/22/2021 inspection was not visible to the public. Today's summary was posted. Citation issued. Display cooler interior fan covers need detail cleaning to remove dust.

headline: Flies and rodent droppings; dead rodent in trap
summary: About 20 small flies in dish area, rodent droppings in washroom and entryway, and a dead rodent in a kitchen trap; pest control advised. No hot water at a handsink, restored on site. No metal-stem thermometer. Citation issued.

headline: Leaking sink faucet; unsealed wood; clutter
summary: Leaking faucet on the three-compartment sink must be fixed. Raw wood under that sink must be sealed. Storage room by the toilet room has clutter to be removed. Passed.

headline: No certified manager while chicken prepared
summary: No certified manager on site while TCS items such as chicken were prepared; citation issued. Slight leak at exposed rear prep handsink faucet. Hood filters over cook line had soot and grime; detail cleaning instructed.

headline: Dented threshold leaves gap at south door
summary: A dented metal threshold at the south entry door leaves a gap at the bottom. It must be repaired to prevent pests. The manager on duty lacked allergen training, and all City-certified managers must obtain it.

headline: Failed: rat droppings and flies found on site
summary: Failed. About 25 rat droppings were found around freezers and walls, plus 8 live small flying insects and 2 big flies. Sliced cheese and peppers near hot holding were uncovered. Three sink stoppers were missing, and no food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Cooler thermometer behind food; move to warmest spot
summary: The cooler thermometer was behind food containers. The inspector instructed the facility to mount it in the warmest part of the cooler, where it is easy to view.

headline: Missing hand-washing signs at both restaurants
summary: Both restaurants on the first and second floors lacked hand-washing signs at sinks in prep, dish and toilet areas. The facility must provide and maintain them.

headline: Certified manager arrived late; no paper towels
summary: No City certified manager was on site while TCS foods were prepped; a certified manager arrived at 11:10 AM. No paper towels were at a dishwash hand sink, which was corrected. Food was stored on the walk-in floor and must be raised six inches.

headline: Grease and debris under cooking equipment
summary: Heavy grease was on the sides of deep fryers in the rear prep area. Dirt and food debris were under and around cooking and refrigeration equipment. Grease was on the hood filters, and all areas must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: no raw-food advisory, no dish machine thermometer
summary: Failed. The menu lacked the consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods. No temperature gauge was on the high-temperature dish machine, and there was no sneeze guard at the coffee station. A rear door had a gap at the bottom. Slow drain and allergen training also required.

headline: Failed: no health policy; frozen pipes; no hot water
summary: Failed. No employee health policy and no vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit were on site. Test strips were inadequate, and bleach was used as sanitizer. Hot water was only 65F at the dish station, and wastewater could not drain due to frozen pipes.

headline: Mold-like buildup in ice machine; loose faucet
summary: Mold-like buildup was inside the rear ice machine, which is not used for human consumption, and must be cleaned. Cardboard and foil were on shelves, and a loose faucet handle was in the women's restroom. Baseboards were missing in the meat processing room.

headline: Door gap; garbage can and wall repairs
summary: A gap along the bottom of a double exit door must be made tight-fitting. A garbage can with a lid is required in the unisex toilet room. Holes above the mop sink and chipping paint in the rear storage area must be repaired.

headline: Ceiling tiles, hood lights and clutter need repair
summary: Unused equipment was cluttered next to the office. Ceiling tiles were missing or damaged in the front prep area, and hood system lights were burned out. The person in charge was instructed to repair and keep the area clutter-free.

headline: Failed: flies on donuts; dead roaches; uncovered food
summary: Failed. Four to five small flies were on donuts on display, and about 18 lbs worth $55 were discarded. Dead roaches and a dead large fly were found in the walk-in and near dry storage. Bagels and croissants were uncovered, and a cooler gasket was damaged.

headline: No covered receptacle in toilet room
summary: The toilet room lacked a covered receptacle for waste. The facility was instructed to provide one.

headline: Torn gasket; equipment not needed for operation stored
summary: A torn gasket on a cooler at the front service area must be replaced. Unused proofing machine and small grills were stored in the rear baking area and must be removed.

headline: Food and single-use items stored in bathroom
summary: Packaged chips were stored on shelves in the bathroom, and boxes of cups, lids and utensils were also stored there. The manager was told to move all items to proper storage. A one-compartment sink faucet was running lightly and must be serviced.

headline: Bulk containers unlabeled; food in grocery bags
summary: Some bulk storage containers were not labeled with product names. Food was stored in grocery bags in the walk-in cooler and freezer. Floors under cooking equipment, walls behind equipment and vent hoods needed cleaning. Food handler and allergen training were required.

headline: Front door gap; debris and openings in walls
summary: A 1/4-inch gap between the front entrance doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Food spills and debris were on sales-area display shelves and coolers. Openings were found around pipe fittings in walls and ceilings.

headline: Broken freezer gasket; grease on floor under cooking
summary: Items to fix included a broken gasket in a basement freezer, missing handles on hot-holding pot lids, and grease on the floor under cooking equipment. Missing hot and cold water at a basement sink and a ventilation requirement for the employee washroom were also noted.

headline: Multiple repairs; unlabeled containers; gaps at doors
summary: Thermometers were required inside several cold and hot holding units. Storage containers and bags needed labels and food-grade bags. Gaps along two doors must be made tight. Grease and debris were on floors, walls and shelves, and food handler and allergen training were required.

headline: Dirty ice machine and floors; small freezer leak
summary: The interior of the ice machine needed cleaning to remove buildup. The waste grease nozzle needed cleaning. A small leak in the walk-in freezer must be repaired. Floors throughout needed cleaning to remove food spills.

headline: Missing thermometer; manager lacked hair restraint
summary: The tall reach-in cooler for creamers had no internal thermometer. The manager on duty was bagging hash browns without an effective hair restraint. Dining room tables and chairs had food debris and spills.

headline: Unlabeled food containers; torn gaskets; greasy walls
summary: Food stored in coolers, the walk-in and dry storage lacked name labels. Torn gaskets were found on the prep cooler, and the handwashing sink lacked a sign. Grease buildup was on cooking equipment, walls and ceiling in the kitchen and prep areas.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; unclean utility floors
summary: All bulk food storage containers needed labels with the commodity name. Aluminum foil was on prep shelves, and the large can opener needed cleaning. Utility room floors had debris, and the ceiling above storage needed repair.

headline: Damaged gaskets; stored items on floor; stained ceiling tiles
summary: Several cooler gaskets were damaged and must be repaired. Soda bottles and bags were stored on the floor, and crates and pallets were used for elevation. Ceiling tiles were stained or missing. Three expired food handler certificates were found.

headline: Missing signs; no prep sink; water and light issues
summary: Handwashing signs were missing in the first and second floor bars. A prep/dump sink was missing from the second-floor bar and first-floor prep area. Cold water failed at the basement three-compartment sink, and three hood lights were out. Several wall and floor openings needed sealing.

headline: Door gap; sink stoppers broken; food debris on floor
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door sweep must be sealed to keep out rodents. Three-compartment sink stoppers did not work, and food debris covered the floor in the main prep and dish areas. No allergen training certificate was on site.

headline: Failed: door gap, freezer ice, prior violations unfixed
summary: Failed. A 1/4-inch gap under the front door must be sealed against pests. Reach-in freezers had ice buildup and food debris. Previous core violations were not corrected, including unlabeled sandwiches, food stored on floor, and missing stoppers and cleaning.

headline: Failed: ready-to-eat food not dated; no garbage lid
summary: Failed. Ready-to-eat food held over 24 hours in the walk-in cooler was not labeled with product name and use-by date. Serving plates were not inverted to prevent dust. A garbage container was missing its lid. Citations were issued for the date marking and garbage.

headline: No certificate posted; allergen training missing
summary: No person on site had an original City sanitation certificate posted, and a citation was issued. No allergen training certificate was on site for certified food managers.

headline: Broken urinals; debris in outdoor garbage area
summary: Both urinals in the first-floor men's room were not working and must be repaired or replaced. Debris had built up in the outdoor garbage area and must be corrected.

headline: Employees without food handler certificates; faucet leaks
summary: Employees were working without food handler certificates; management was told all must have them on site, with a 30-day grace period for new hires. Certified managers lacked allergen training. The three-compartment sink faucet and pipe leaked and must be repaired.

headline: Dirty wiping cloths left on prep tables
summary: Dirty wiping cloths were left on prep tables at the front and rear prep areas instead of being kept in sanitizing solution. The inspector instructed staff to store all cloths properly, especially when not in use.

headline: Greasy fryers and dirty walk-in shelving
summary: Wiping cloths were on prep surfaces and must be stored in sanitizing solution at the required strength. Storage racks inside coolers had food and dirt, and fryer exteriors had grease. Basement and first-floor corners, equipment bases and sinks had dirt and debris.

headline: Leaking sink drains and faucet in kitchen
summary: Water leaked from two drains and dripped from the faucet base of the three-compartment sink in the main kitchen. One exhaust hood filter was out of place. The facility was instructed to repair both and keep the hood filters installed correctly.

headline: Front door gap; peeling ceiling paint
summary: A 1/4-inch gap between front entrance doors must be sealed to be rodent-proof. Peeling ceiling paint patches above the pastry sales area must be removed.

headline: Missing hand-washing signs; water-stained ceiling tiles
summary: Hand-washing signs were missing at the bar and basement prep area. Water-stained ceiling tiles near the kitchen prep hand sink must be replaced.

headline: Food handler without hair restraint, corrected
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint while working. The food handler obtained one by the end of the inspection.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; expired allergen certificates
summary: Bulk storage containers were not labeled with product names. Fryer bottoms, cooking equipment exteriors and walk-in interiors needed cleaning. Ventilation hoods needed cleaning. Food service managers had expired allergen training certificates.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; grease and missing trap
summary: Failed. No City-certified food manager was on site on arrival, which led to a citation. No grease trap was at the three-compartment sink. The outside grease receptacle was heavily greasy, which can attract insects and rodents, and a citation was issued.

headline: Missing hand-washing signs in restroom and dish area
summary: Hand-washing signs were missing in the employee restroom and the rear dishwash and prep hand sink. The facility must install and maintain them.

headline: Leaking pipe; grill without ventilation; prior violations
summary: A leaky pipe under the rear hand sink must be repaired. A flat-top grill in the dining area lacked adequate ventilation. Garbage can lids were missing. Previous violations were not corrected, including food handler training and allergen certificates for managers.

headline: Door gap and floor debris; food on floor
summary: A gap of about 1/4 inch at the front entrance door must be sealed to prevent pests. Some food stock was stored on the floor in a storage closet. A broken soda cooler in the customer area should be removed. Floors under grocery shelves were dirty with litter.

headline: Missing covered waste bin; food debris in oven
summary: Food debris was inside the oven and under the stovetop, and grease was on prep tables. The employee washroom lacked a covered waste receptacle and a self-closing door device. Several food handlers lacked training certificates.

headline: Missing hand-washing signs; open potatoes near sink
summary: Several hand sinks in the main kitchen and bar lacked signs telling workers to wash hands. An open container of potatoes was stored next to a hand sink without splash protection; it was to be moved or shielded. Walls behind cooking equipment were heavily greasy.

headline: Gap at rear door; food stored on drying rack
summary: A gap greater than 1/4 inch at the rear exterior door must be repaired to keep pests out. Food was stored on a drying rack next to an exposed handwashing sink and must be relocated or shielded. Grease and dust were heavy on hood filters above the griddle.

headline: Leaking pipe under bar dish machine; dirty storage room
summary: A leaking pipe under the dish machine in the bar area must be repaired. Dirt and debris were found under shelving in the liquor storage room, and the facility was instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings, no certified manager, cross-contamination
summary: Failed. About 65 small rodent droppings were found in prep and dish areas. No City-certified manager was on site while raw meat was prepared. Raw chicken was stored near ready-to-eat food. Thermometers were missing, and the outside garbage was overflowing.

headline: Failed: exposed ceiling, open garbage attracting flies
summary: Failed. The prep area ceiling was open, exposing waste pipes over food prep. The front service window must close when the facility is closed. Outside garbage receptacles were open and exposed, attracting flies. Priority violations were recorded, but no citation issued.

headline: Failed: flies present; sink and sanitizer problems
summary: Failed. About 25 small live flies were found on dry goods, cooling units and near drains. No handsink was available in the basement prep or juicing area. The low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm. Dried food debris was on carts, wells and bottles.

headline: Failed: food held above safe temperatures, discarded
summary: Failed. Pizza prep cooler air was 41.0F, and ground pork, marinara and ham were 47.8 to 50.0F. About 10 lbs ($130) were discarded. The person in charge lacked a City certificate, and no certified manager was present for TCS foods. Thermometers were missing from several coolers.

headline: Failed: 80 live flies; food held at 52-57F
summary: Failed. About 80 live small flies were on walls in the prep area, rear hallway and walk-in cooler. Raw beef, pork, eggs and produce were held at 52-57F and discarded. A prep cooler at 55F was tagged and cannot be used until repaired. Citations were issued.

headline: No thermometers; floor disrepair in walk-in cooler
summary: No thermometers were visible in any cooler, and they must be placed in a visible spot. The walk-in cooler floor was damaged, with raw wood and missing sections that must be repaired. Excess dust was in the rear restroom.

headline: Items stored on floor; leaking faucet and slow drains
summary: Drinks and food boxes were stored on the floor under prep coolers and must be raised six inches. Front and rear hand sinks drained very slowly, and the bar hand sink had low hot water pressure. The three-compartment faucet leaked heavily.

headline: Prep cooler at 48F removed from service
summary: A front prep cooler held at 48F was tagged and must not be used until it holds 41F or below. Paper towels were stored in the employee restroom. A restroom sink faucet leaked, and grease was on the hot-holding unit and griddle.

headline: Spills and debris on floors
summary: Spilled liquids and food debris were found on the floors near the soda dispensers and inside the walk-in freezer. The facility was instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: No food handler training records; allergen missing
