summary: Cutting boards have open seams and dark stains and must be refinished or replaced. Both fryer cabinets had grease and food debris buildup; operator told to degrease, clean and maintain.

headline: Deli meat 6 days past date; citation
summary: Ready-to-eat deli meat was 6 days past its date mark; about 5 cakes and 3 lb yogurt discarded ($35); citation issued. Handwashing signs missing at sinks. Bulk containers lack labels. Torn cooler gaskets and greasy floors need attention.

headline: Dishwasher not sanitizing; tagged out of use
summary: Dishwasher could not sanitize; sanitizer measured 0 ppm. Unit tagged and must not be used until CDPH reinspects it. Plastic bowls stored in dry ingredient containers; tableware not inverted; dirty microwaves, fryers and stoves.

headline: Prep handwash sink drains slowly
summary: The handwashing sink in the prep area drains slowly. Manager instructed that it must drain quickly.

headline: Vacuum-packed meats without approved plan
summary: Vacuum-packed meats were stored without an approved food-safety (HACCP) plan. A plan is required before vacuum packing. One food handler lacked training; the certified manager lacked allergen training proof. Drywall hole needs repair.

headline: No certified manager on duty during prep
summary: No valid City certified manager was on duty while chicken, deli meats and chop steak were prepared, handled and served. Citation issued; operator told a certified manager must be on duty at all times.

headline: 10 live roaches under kitchen sink; failed
summary: Inspector saw 10 live roaches crawling on the wall and floor under the three-compartment sink. Area must be cleaned and pest control called. A food handler lacked a certificate; the certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Restroom needs covered feminine hygiene bins
summary: Women's restroom stalls need covered receptacles for feminine hygiene products. Operator must provide them.

headline: Debris under dish sink and front equipment
summary: Dirt and debris build-up under and around the three-compartment sink in the rear dish area, and beneath front food-service equipment. Operator instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Front sneeze guard too short
summary: Sneeze guard at the front service line is under 5 feet, so customers talk over open food when ordering. Inspector instructed the operator to extend it.

headline: No certified manager; handsink unusable; no thermometers
summary: No certified manager with a valid original certificate while slicing deli meat, cheese, and ground beef; citation issued. Rear dish handsink unusable: soapy water and soiled spatulas in basin; citation issued. No thermometers in coolers.

headline: Packaged cake slices lacked required labels
summary: Packaged cake slices in dessert display cooler were not properly labeled. Labels must show identity, net weight, ingredients, and business name and address.

headline: No employee health policy; allergen training gaps
summary: No employee health policy was on site; a priority violation was noted, but no citation was issued. Several certified managers lacked allergen training certificates. Also noted unused equipment, unfinished wood shelving, and a burnt-out light.

headline: 12 live roaches found; no certified manager
summary: 12 live roaches on rear prep wall. No certified manager on site while temperature-controlled foods were served. Butcher handsink blocked with knives; no soap or paper towels in restroom. Meat cured without required variance.

headline: No certified person in charge or health policy
summary: No person in charge with a valid city sanitation certificate; no employee health policy; no food handler or allergen training; no metal stem thermometer; no sanitizer test kit; no stoppers for the three-compartment sink. Cooking ventilation inoperable.

headline: Food on floors; torn gaskets; damaged floors
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor; milk crates and boxes served as shelves. Noted a torn gasket and broken doors on a prep cooler, a wood floor in rear prep with missing and broken panels, damaged toilet-room wall tiles, and clutter.

headline: Missing handwash signs; damaged drink machine panel
summary: Rear handwashing sink lacked signage telling food employees to wash hands. Drink-mix water cooler outer panel in poor repair, risking spills. Outdoor waste enclosure missing a fence or gate.

headline: Raw animal foods unmarked; openings allow entry
summary: Ceviche and tuna tostadas served raw lacked an asterisk advisory on the menu; priority violation, no citation. Openings at front and rear doors need sealing. Leaking faucets and drainpipes at dish sinks; missing floor tiles at shared stairwell door.

headline: Handwash signage needed in restroom
summary: Hand washing signage was needed at the rear restroom sink; inspector instructed the facility to obtain it.

headline: Rat droppings outside; hot water was off
summary: Rat droppings on items stored outside near garbage and rear door; must be removed; citation issued. Hot water was off; turned on during inspection, citation issued. No employee health policy, vomit kit, or allergen training.

headline: About 100 live roaches; no certified manager
summary: About 100 or more live roaches on freezers, mop sink, and floors; pest control service required. No certified manager on duty while foods that must be kept hot or cold were prepared. Pest logbook and food handler training missing.

headline: Multiple cold foods too warm; about 20 lbs discarded
summary: Six-door prep cooler held tzatziki (47.3°F), sour cream (47.7°F), sliced tomatoes (46.6°F), cheeses and mayo (49.1°F); about 20 lbs discarded. Cooler air 52.9°F; unit tagged. Also rusted and moldy shelves, stained cutting boards.

headline: Soap dispenser over prep sink; leaking drain
summary: Soap dispenser and hand dryer sat over the prep sink; inspector ordered removal so it isn't used as a handwash station. Leaking drain under handwash sink needs repair. Floors under cooking equipment and near grease trap need detail cleaning.

headline: No health policies; no food handler training
summary: No signed employee health policies, no food handler training for employees, and no allergen training for the food manager; citation issued for health policies. Also noted a leaky toilet, loose floor panels, damaged ceilings, and a burnt-out hood light.

headline: Dumpster lids still broken; repeat violation
summary: Dumpster lids still broken from an earlier report; a repeat priority violation, citation issued; replacement required before reinspection. Crates used as shelving in kitchen and storage must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: No food thermometer or sanitizer test kit
summary: No metal stem thermometer for checking food temperatures and no sanitizer test kit; citations issued for both. Wet wiping cloths were on prep surfaces, frozen chicken was in plastic grocery bags, and a toilet room receptacle lacked a cover.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; grease in hood filters
summary: Torn gaskets on multiple cold hold units; food debris and spillage inside them; can opener covered in food residue. Also: missing handwashing sign at bar sink, unlabeled bulk containers, ice machine lid buildup, and greasy hood filters.

headline: No dumpster; missing handwash sign; manager lacks allergen
summary: No commercial dumpster on premises for refuse; priority violation noted, no citation issued. Missing handwashing sign at front sink and missing splash guard between rear handsink and prep table. Certified manager on site lacks allergen certificate.

headline: Unlabeled drinks; repeat handsink violation uncorrected
summary: Unlabeled lassi bottles sold to go; must add ingredients and trace-back info. Repeat violation not corrected: rear prep handwash sink made inaccessible by a removed pipe; citation issued.

headline: Broken dumpster lids; food debris on kitchen floors
summary: Outside dumpster had broken lids; must be replaced for tight-fitting lids. Excessive food debris on kitchen floors under equipment and sinks; broken floor tiles. Deep clean and repair required.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; grease and leaks
summary: Rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap and must be rodent-proofed. Three-compartment sink leaks when drained (citation issued). Grease and food debris on equipment and coolers. No commercial dumpster; a commercial dumpster is required.

headline: Dust on cooking-area fan and ceiling
summary: Dust buildup on cooking-area fan and ceiling; manager instructed to clean all fans, light shields, and ceiling and wall vents.

headline: Ice bin interior needed cleaning
summary: The ice bin interior needed cleaning. Inspector instructed removal of ice, cleaning, and ongoing maintenance.

headline: No certified person in charge; minor fixes done
summary: No person in charge with a valid city sanitation certificate; citation issued. Men's restroom handsink had no paper towels, corrected on site. Front entrance door openings need sealing. Stained ceiling tiles and cracked grout also noted.

headline: No food handler training proof; improper storage
summary: No proof of food handler training for any food handlers; certificates must be provided. Scoops stored inside dry food containers; food stored in plastic grocery bags in refrigerator and freezer.

headline: Standing water in bar; corrected on site
summary: Standing water was found on the floor of the bar area. Inspector instructed removal and maintenance; the problem was corrected on site.

headline: Cold holding too warm; several required items missing
summary: Cold holding unit measured 59.7°F; hot holding cabinet was not hot enough at inspection. Missing on site: pest control logbook, vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit, employee health policy, sanitation certificate, and stem thermometer. No citations issued.

headline: Raw chicken at 49.3°F; cooler tagged
summary: 30 lbs raw chicken at 49.3°F in walk-in cooler; chicken discarded ($50); priority violation. Walk-in cooler air at 53.1°F; unit tagged and not to be used until repaired and the Chicago Department of Public Health is contacted.

headline: Missing food handler certificates; manager allergen gaps
summary: Four employees had missing or expired food handler training. Two of three certified managers lacked allergen training. Inspector required all to complete training and keep records on site.

headline: Deli sandwiches held too warm; no time-control records
summary: Turkey and cheese at 45.1°F and deli meat and cheese at 48.9°F were held too warm on a cold metal slab under a sneeze guard. No time-as-control logs or written procedure. Citation issued. Dish machine lacked a temperature indicator.

headline: Cooler at 50.1°F; no certified manager present
summary: No certified manager on duty while food that must be kept hot or cold was handled. Reach-in cooler at 50.1°F was placed on hold; 5 lbs raw ground beef at 48.9°F discarded. No employee health policy or food handler training.

headline: Expired chili found; deli cups used as scoops
summary: Two containers of on-site chili (10 lbs) past their use-by date of 1-26-26 in prep cooler; manager told not to hold such food over 7 days. Priority violation; food discarded. Deli cups used as scoops; cups not air-dried before stacking.

headline: Unlabeled prepared foods; no handler training proof
summary: Prepared foods held over 24 hours in walk-in cooler lacked date labels; foods discarded. Wastewater backs up from restroom floor drains when toilets flush. No food handler training proof; expired allergen certificate. Citation issued.

headline: Leaking faucet; cooking equipment needs cleaning
summary: Three-compartment sink faucet head was loose and leaking; repair required. Cooking equipment in rear food service area needs detail cleaning, and rear prep floors under and behind equipment need cleaning.

headline: Dishwashing handsink missing; no summary posted
summary: No handwash sink used only for handwashing in the dishwashing area; priority violation, citation issued. Handwash sign missing. Last inspection summary not posted for public; citation issued. Loud damaged bathroom fan; grease trap area heavily soiled.

headline: Ice machine buildup; no health policy
summary: Basement ice machine had black and pink buildup on dispenser parts and ice bin; ice is used for human consumption; cleaning ordered and citation issued. Also: no employee health policy, unlabeled cooked broccoli and chicken, and no allergen training proof.

headline: Hair restraints lacking; dirty lower shelves
summary: Some food handlers lacked adequate hair restraints such as caps or hairnets; instructed to provide for all. Dirt and debris on lower shelves of front prep units needs cleaning.

headline: Cockroaches on glue boards throughout premises
summary: Cockroaches found on glue boards throughout the premises, including in the kitchen under shelves, waiter station area, and upstairs storage room. Inspector required them removed from the premises.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; hair restraints not worn
summary: No vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit or written procedures; citation issued. No metal stem thermometer. Hair restraints not worn; one handler lacks a food handler certificate. Repeat violations uncorrected: cutting board, faucet leak, allergen training.

headline: Stained cutting boards; missing floor grout
summary: Stained cutting boards in food prep areas must be resurfaced or replaced. Missing grout on front main prep line floor tiles; needs repair so floors are smooth and cleanable.

headline: Rear door gap; leaking sink; repeat concrete issue
summary: Rear exterior door had a 1/4-inch gap on one side; must be repaired. Middle prep handsink leaks from pipe under basin. Customer restroom toilet covered in residue. Repeat violation: concrete behind mop sink in poor repair; citation issued.

headline: Non-potable piping over food items; hair restraint lapses
summary: Non-potable wastewater piping above coffee filters, gloves, and bottles was wrapped in fiberglass insulation instead of being properly enclosed. Two food handlers lacked hair restraints. Also noted grease, splatter, cluttered basement storage, and dust.

headline: About 60 mouse droppings; citation issued
summary: Approximately 60 mouse droppings were found in the prep area under shelving near the mop sink. Person in charge instructed to remove all droppings and sanitize the area. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Milk crate shelving; dusty basement floors
summary: Milk crates used as shelving throughout prep and storage; must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Basement storage floors had debris and dust buildup; detail cleaning required.

headline: Cold foods too warm; 15 rodent droppings
summary: Chicken 61.2°F, shrimp 60.7°F, bean sprouts 57.3°F, raw eggs 61.4°F were too warm in rear prep cooler; manager discarded them. About 15 large rodent droppings under basement stairwell. Citation issued. Also leaks and greasy vents.

headline: Wet cloths on counters; handwash sign needed
summary: Handwashing sign must be provided for dishwashing area handsink. Wet wiping cloths were stored on counters and prep tables in rear prep area; must be kept in sanitizer when not in use.

headline: Openings at entrance and garage door bases
summary: Openings at base of double entrance doors and along garage door base on southeast side of building need sealing to prevent pest entry.

headline: Unlabeled packaged cookies; milk crate shelving
summary: Packaged matcha cookies on display for customers were not labeled; manager must label all packaged items. Milk crates used as shelving in prep and storage areas; adequate shelving required.

headline: Dirty floors and loose cooler lid knots
summary: Floors under equipment, shelving, coolers, and along baseboards had dirt, grease, and debris. Prep cooler lid knots were loose or missing; repair ordered. Certified food managers on duty lacked allergen training certification.

headline: Blocked handsinks removed; summary not posted
summary: Handsinks blocked by a food cart and waste bin; removed on site; citation issued. Spinach thawed in warm, still water. Food containers on walk-in cooler floor. Food handler without effective hair restraint. Summary report not visible to public; citation issued.

headline: Dirty floors; no food handler proof; repeat allergen lapse
summary: Bulk containers need common-name labels. Excess dirt under ice machine, rear coolers, and around grease trap; missing floor tiles at utility sink. No food handler training proof. Repeat violation: manager's allergen training expired; citation issued.

headline: Wiping cloths unstored; leaks and grease buildup
summary: Wiping cloths stored on cooler tops, prep tables, and shelves instead of sanitizer. Also noted broken cooler handle, heavy grease on cooking equipment, ice-filled basement freezers, leaking faucets and handsinks, and water-damaged ceiling tiles.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets on two doors
summary: Gaskets on two doors of the front prep cooler were torn and hanging off. Manager instructed to service them and keep them in good repair.

headline: Door gaps, cloths, missing backflow device
summary: Rear delivery door has 1/4 to 1/2 inch gaps. Wiping cloths not kept in sanitizer in butcher and deli. Milk crates used as shelving; no backflow device on rear ice machine line. Employee personal items in food storage; food handler certificate needed.

headline: One food manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: One food manager lacked a food allergen training certificate. Inspector required all certified food managers to hold allergen training certificates.

headline: Dirty drink nozzles, storage cabinets, and floors
summary: Drink machine nozzles need cleaning to remove buildup. Storage cabinets and racks have food spills and splatters. Floors and floor drains have debris and buildup; cleaning required.

headline: Pork too warm; wine in restroom; milk crates
summary: Pork at 47.6°F to 50.5°F in food display cooler; 10 lbs discarded ($60); citation issued. Wine cases stored inside restroom must be relocated. Milk crates used as shelving. Food handler certificates missing; manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Single-use utensils stored near handsink
summary: Single-use utensils stored next to prep-area handsink and cleaning equipment in storage; manager instructed to remove them to protect from splash and contamination.

headline: No vomit kit, allergen certificates, or summary posting
summary: No vomit cleanup kit on site; citation issued. No allergen training certificates for certified managers. No summary posted from prior inspection; citation issued. Dish machine lacks temperature indicator; citation issued. Torn walk-in cooler gasket.

headline: Expired manager certificate; sink used for hand rinsing
summary: No valid certified food manager on site; posted certificate expired 04/10/2024; citation issued. A food handler rinsed hands in the three-compartment sink; citation issued. No thermometers in refrigeration units; clutter in rear prep closet.

headline: Ice bin buildup dripping onto ice; dirty microwaves
summary: Basement ice bin top interior had black, brown, pink, and yellow buildup dripping onto ice used for human consumption; ice removed, cleaned, and sanitized; citation issued. Microwaves in kitchen and basement need cleaning.

headline: Several handlers lack certificates; leaking drain
summary: Several food handlers lacked a valid food handler certificate; management instructed all must have one. Drain line of the exposed front prep handsink leaks; management must repair the source.

headline: Ice scoops stored improperly; multiple upkeep issues
summary: Ice scoops were stored inside an ice bin and on top of the basement ice machine; a clean container was required. Also noted rust, ice buildup, a slow-draining handsink, grease, dirt, damaged floors, and employee belongings in food storage.

headline: Hair restraints; milk crates; allergen training
summary: A food handler lacked a hair restraint while preparing food. Milk crates used for elevation in dishwashing area must be replaced with shelving. Grease and food debris on equipment and coolers; no food allergen training certificate.

headline: No sanitizer; handsink unconnected; wastewater on floor
summary: Front prep handsink not connected to water. No sanitizer, probe thermometer, or sanitizer test strips on site. No barrier between front prep and public. Three-compartment sink drains wastewater onto the floor. Priority violations noted.

headline: Handsink blocked by ice machine; repeat violations
summary: Front sushi prep handsink blocked from dishwashing area by an ice machine; citation issued. Needs splash guards; raw wood shelf liners need sealing; duct tape repairs must be replaced. Certified manager has no allergen training proof. Repeat violations cited.

headline: No prep handsink; no thermometers or drainboard
summary: No handsink at preparation areas, a priority violation with no citation. No hanging thermometers in two coolers. No drainboard for the three-compartment sink. Backflow device at mop sink not working. Walls and ceiling in basement food storage not smooth.

headline: Worn gaskets; greasy hood and floors
summary: Badly worn gaskets on a lower reach-in cooler need repair. Dirt and dust on walk-in shelves and fans; greasy cooking equipment, floors, and walls; hole in wall near utility sink; greasy hood filters and vents.

headline: Rear door gap; greasy fryer; dirty floors
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the center of the rear exit door must be sealed to avoid possible rodent entry. Grease on fryer exterior needs cleaning; floors under cooking equipment and behind a three-door cooler need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; unvariance'd cold smoking
summary: No certified food service manager on site while fish and deli meat were handled. Cold-smoked salmon and pink-salt curing need a variance; process discontinued. Unlabeled spray bottles; ice maker backflow device missing.

headline: Worn rear door seal; dusty vents; greasy filters
summary: Rear exit door had worn weather stripping; bottom must be sealed to block pest entry. Floors near three-compartment sink and grease trap need cleaning. Vents dusty, cooking filters greasy. Manager's allergen certificate expired.

headline: Moldlike substance in ice machine; food on floors
summary: Black moldlike substance on the shield of the south ice machine must be cleaned and sanitized to prevent ice contamination. Potatoes and boxes stored on floors; elevate all items 6 inches. Damaged walk-in freezer door gasket.

headline: Missing health policies; no allergen manager training
summary: Some signed employee health policies missing; priority violation with citation issued. No food allergen training for the food manager. Gap at wall base near prep cooler; items stored on floor in rear storage; food debris on floor in dish area.

headline: 75+ rat droppings; no hot water at sinks
summary: 75 or more rat droppings on basement floor; pest control service required. Rodent bait bags behind equipment; rear door gap. No hot water at sinks; no vomit cleanup kit; no soap at exposed sink; bathroom fan not working.

headline: Black slime in ice maker; greasy equipment
summary: Black slime inside ice maker dripping into ice used for human consumption; machine must be shut off, ice removed, and interior cleaned; citation issued. No thermometer in front cooler; grease buildup on equipment.

headline: Ice scoops in bins; torn gaskets; grooved board
summary: Ice scoops were stored directly in bar ice bins and must be removed. Torn gaskets on pizza-prep cooler doors and a grooved, stained cutting board. Also noted missing toilet-room lids, standing basement water, and a missing hood light bulb.

headline: Dirty refrigeration fans and heavy hood grease
summary: Dirty, dusty fans inside a two-door refrigeration unit need cleaning. Heavy dirt and grease on exhaust hood, pipes, conduits, and filters above cooking equipment require detail cleaning.

headline: About 40 rat droppings; cold foods too warm
summary: About 40 rat droppings found in basement T-shirt storage room. Cold foods in prep cooler too warm: tuna salad 44°F, chicken 48°F, Italian beef 49°F; cooler air 45°F. Citations issued. Also: leaking drain, opening behind file cabinets.

headline: Most food handlers lack training proof
summary: Most food handlers had no proof of food handler training; all without a City sanitation certificate must complete an approved program. Also: milk crates used as shelving, a basement wall hole, and unlabeled storage containers.

headline: Poor-repair sink; stained ceiling tiles
summary: Middle handsink in poor repair: cold water will not fully turn off. Sinks and toilet room need detail cleaning. Water-stained ceiling tiles in front and rear prep areas. Mop stored above dirty water in bucket; must hang to dry.

headline: Pork, shrimp, and fish held too warm
summary: Pork and shrimp in the walk-in cooler and fish in a cold hold unit were held too warm, up to 48.7°F. Manager voluntarily discarded 35 lbs (about $180). Also noted dirty wiping cloths, milk crates used as shelves, and food in grocery bags.

headline: Grease spills outside waste container; cardboard
summary: Outside waste grease container not maintained, with excessive grease spillage on the ground and container top; priority violation, citation issued. Excess cardboard boxes in rear must be removed.

headline: Wiping cloths left out; expired allergen certificate
summary: Wiping cloths were left on counters and prep tables instead of sanitizer. A reach-in freezer had thick ice buildup. The manager's allergen certificate had expired. Also noted dirty floors, greasy vent filters, and a mop stored in its bucket.

headline: Handsink too hot; sanitizer too weak
summary: Basement handsink water over 120°F, not controllable by user; citation issued. Boxes blocked that handsink. Sanitizer at 452 ppm (parts per million), below the 704–1875 ppm range; citation issued. Manager lacks allergen certificate; food handler proof missing.

headline: Bare hands on pastries; mouse droppings found
summary: Food handler touched ready-to-eat frosted pastries with bare hands; 1.2 lbs discarded; citation issued. About 40 mouse droppings on flour storage floor; citation issued; more pest control needed. Allergen training proof missing.

headline: Live roaches and rat droppings; repeat violation
summary: Repeat violation: 2 rat droppings in storage closet and 10 live cockroaches on shelves, inside microwave, and under three-compartment sink. More pest control needed. Heavy grease and food debris on cookers and coolers.

headline: Grease in fryer filter unit and prep area
summary: Inside of deep fryer oil filtering unit had grease and food debris buildup; clean and maintain. Grease and debris in rear food prep area must be cleaned. Broken floor tile in front prep area needs repair to be smooth.

headline: Steak held at 47°F; discarded
summary: Steak held at 47°F; cold food must be held at 41°F or below. Manager discarded 6 lbs ($35); priority violation and citation issued.

headline: Food worker without hair restraint; dirty areas
summary: A food employee was seen without a hair restraint. Trash and unused equipment were stored outside the rear exit. Walk-in cooler and prep-area floors and cabinet interiors needed cleaning; restroom receptacles lacked covers.

headline: No vomit response plan; door gap; raw wood
summary: No vomit or diarrhea response procedures or supplies; priority violation. A 1/4-inch door gap needs sealing. Also no handwash sign or covered receptacle in washroom; raw wood under front counter; missing ceiling tile.

headline: Meat boxes on floor; missing handwash signs
summary: Meat boxes were stored on the walk-in freezer floor and must be elevated at least 6 inches. Missing handwashing signage at kitchen sink. Light bulb needs replacing at main prep hood.

headline: Untrained food employees; no public summary posted
summary: Several food employees lacked food handler training, and one certified manager lacked allergen training; both were ordered corrected. Summary report was not posted for public view; citation issued. Torn cooler gaskets also noted.

headline: Handsinks blocked and unsupplied; food discarded
summary: Bar handwash sinks had no paper towels and strainers blocking them; basement handsink lacked soap. Ready-to-eat food held over 24 hours without a discard date was discarded. Food containers stored on floors; citations issued.

headline: No hair restraints; no food handler certificates
summary: Multiple food handlers prepped food without hair restraints. Multiple food handlers lacked food handler certificates; multiple certified managers lacked allergen certificates. Also: unfinished wood shelving, food debris, and missing floor tiles.

headline: No health policy; handler certificate and backflow gaps
summary: No signed employee health policies on site; priority violation, no citation. One food handler lacked a handler certificate; person in charge lacked allergen training. Also: no backflow device on utility sink; toilet room door not self-closing.

headline: Soiled ice machine interior; plastic wrap on table
summary: Ice machine interior had dust and soils; must be cleaned to prevent buildup. Soiled plastic wrap used to anchor a front prep table leg must be removed.

headline: Ceiling holes and leak; repeat fryer grease
summary: Holes in kitchen ceiling must be sealed; ceiling leak near kitchen handsink needs repair. Repeat violations from the 10/08/2025 inspection not corrected: grease under and around fryers. Citation issued.

headline: Sink water too cool; no quaternary test kit
summary: Three-compartment sink water measured 107.2°F; hot water restored on site (110.7°F). No test kit for quaternary ammonium sanitizer. Opening at dock door base must be sealed. Citation issued.

headline: Hanging handsink; rough spray foam
summary: Smoothie station handsink hanging from wall must be repaired. Spray foam used to close holes is not smooth; must be cut and smoothed so it is cleanable.

headline: Raw wood platters; dirty racks; slow sink
summary: Wooden boards used as food platters, with peeling raw wood, must be removed. Dirty dish racks stained with black slime. Patio bar handsink drains very slowly. Cracked floor tiles in dish room and missing ceiling tiles above ice machine.

headline: No sanitation certificate; no thermometer or sink water
summary: No City sanitation certificate was on site, and the person in charge was instructed to obtain one. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit. No hot water or soap at the three-compartment sink area, no stem thermometer, no test strips, and no water to that sink.

headline: Shrimp held at 77°F; sink and restroom access issues
summary: Shrimp was held at 77°F on the counter; the manager discarded 7 pounds (about $25), and a citation was issued. A knife and sponge were stored in a hand sink and were removed. The three-compartment sink did not reach 110°F and was restored. Restroom is accessed through food storage.

headline: Door gaps and restroom doors need repair
summary: Openings at the base of the front entrance doors and rear prep door must be sealed to prevent pests. Pans stored on the floor need shelving raised six inches. Two restroom doors must be fitted with self-closing devices.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and unverified dishwasher temperature
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at sinks used by food workers. Dish machine wash temperature could not be checked because the data plate was missing. Menu lacked a raw or undercooked food advisory, and buffets lacked barriers.

headline: No certified manager on arrival; cooler too warm
summary: No City certified food manager was on site on arrival, and a citation was issued. Deli top cooler measured 47°F ambient air; it was tagged and only non-TCS foods were stored in it. Filters above the griddle have dust buildup.

headline: No allergen training on site
summary: No allergen training was on site. The establishment was instructed to provide allergen training for all certified food managers.

headline: Worn cutting boards; dirty equipment and floors
summary: Large bulk containers must be cleaned and labeled with product names. Worn, dark cutting boards on the prep line need replacing. Prep tables, walk-in shelves and refrigeration units need cleaning, and floors throughout need cleaning.

headline: Floors and vent fans need detail cleaning
summary: The floor under equipment near the walls needs detail cleaning. Fan vents need detail cleaning. The inspector instructed the establishment to clean and maintain both.

headline: Improper thawing; dirty ice machine; rust on shelves
summary: Frozen beef was thawing improperly and must thaw overnight in the refrigerator or under cold running water. Ice machine interior had encrusted debris. Walk-in shelves are rusted. A hand sink leaks underneath, and the hand sink lacks signage.

headline: Employee cooked without hair restraint
summary: An employee prepared and cooked food without a hair restraint and must wear one when handling food. Grease buildup on top of the outside oil container must be cleaned. One certified food manager lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; leaking bar sink
summary: Handwashing signs are needed in both restrooms. The front bar hand sink leaks and needs repair. Floors behind the dish machine and reach-in cooler have food spills that must be cleaned.

headline: Unlabeled bulk sugar and flour; torn gaskets
summary: Bulk sugar and flour containers lacked common-name labels. Gaskets on the two-door cooler next to the dry storage room are torn and damaged. The person in charge was instructed to repair and label them.

headline: Rusty walk-in shelves and expired training certificates
summary: Chipped paint and rust on walk-in cooler wire shelves, food buildup around chicken prep cooler gaskets, and floor tiles needing regrout. Some food handler training certificates were expired; the manager must renew them.

headline: Damaged cutting boards and leaking sinks
summary: Cutting boards had open seams and stains. Milk crates were used as shelving. Hand sinks on the fifth floor were slow-draining and leaking, the grease trap was broken, and floor tiles and grout were missing.

headline: Hole in ceiling; damaged cutting board; gap at rear door
summary: Missing handwashing sign at the front prep hand sink. The front cooler lacked a thermometer; the manager provided one during inspection. The rear door has a gap over 1/4 inch and must be rodent-proofed. Ceiling hole and peeling paint in dry storage.

headline: About 20 live flying insects; bacon thawed on counter
summary: About 20 live small flying insects were found on walls and ceilings in the customer restroom and food prep and storage areas. More pest control service is needed. Frozen raw bacon was thawing at room temperature.

headline: Ceiling needs repair; openings must be sealed
summary: The ceiling in the rear dish and storage areas must be repaired and made smooth and easy to clean. Openings along the ceiling must be sealed.

headline: Unlabeled nuts and coconut; soiled mop head
summary: Almonds, pecans and coconuts were stored outside original containers without labels; each must be labeled. A soiled mop head was not stored properly and must be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Greasy fryers; dirty racks, floors and walls
summary: Front prep deep fryers had grease and dirt buildup. Storage racks in the walk-in and prep area had food, dirt and dust. The women's restroom hot-water faucet leaks at the base. Pitted floors, cracked wall tile, and greasy walls need repair.

headline: No certified manager on site; no health policy
summary: No City certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were held hot; a citation was issued. No employee health policy was on premises; a citation was issued. The rear side door is not rodent-proofed, and trash and debris lie around the dumpster.

headline: Dust inside light shields above prep tables
summary: Dust had built up inside the light shield covers above prep tables in the kitchen food preparation area. The establishment must clean and maintain them.

headline: Food containers stored on floor
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor in rear dry storage. Proper shelving raised six inches off the floor is required. Floors in that area must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: License number must be on truck sides
summary: The correct mobile food license number must be displayed on both lateral sides of the truck. The person in charge was instructed to correct it.

headline: No backflow device; floors and washroom ventilation
summary: No backflow device was found at the utility sink. Some floor-to-wall joints are not coved, and some floors, including the furnace room and in front of the two-door coolers, are not smooth and easy to clean. No ventilation fan in the washroom.

headline: Dishwasher not sanitizing; leaking hand sink
summary: Low-temperature dishwasher showed 0 ppm sanitizer at final rinse; a citation was issued. Dish room hand sink leaks and its faucet can't fully shut off. Missing handwashing signs, grease behind the cook line, and employee clothing on a utensil shelf.

headline: No certified manager; three-compartment sink backs up
summary: No person in charge had foodservice sanitation manager training, and no valid City sanitation certificate was on site; a citation was issued. Water backs up from the second basin into the third basin of the three-compartment sink, and a citation was issued.

headline: Missing splashguards; leaking backflow device
summary: No splash guard between the hand sink and three-compartment sink at the rear bar, and beer taps need protection. Cutting boards are pitted and stained. The mop sink backflow device leaks. The restroom exhaust fan does not work.

headline: Damaged baseboard and floor tile; debris in prep area
summary: Baseboard near the reach-in freezer and floor tile under the three-compartment sink are damaged and must be repaired. Debris is inside a light shield and on floors, corners and ledges in the prep area and must be cleaned.

headline: Dishwasher not sanitizing; ham thawed in container
summary: The low-temperature dishwasher showed 0 ppm sanitizer and must not be used until it reaches 50 ppm; maintenance was called and a citation was issued. Two large ham pieces were thawing in a container and were still frozen. Front prep sink lacks a splashguard.

headline: No written employee health policy
summary: No written employee health policy was on the premises. Management must provide a signed policy for each employee and keep it on file. This is a priority foundation violation.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate; no allergen training
summary: No valid City food service sanitation certificate was provided, and a citation was issued. Raw deli meat was stored in grocery bags. A freezer door gasket is torn. Floors and corners have dirt and dust. No food handler training proof was provided.

headline: Dust on shelving; leak at hand sink; no food handler training
summary: Dust and debris were on shelving behind the counter. A pipe leaks at the hand sink next to the three-compartment sink and must be repaired. Dust is on dining room vents. No food handler training was found, and employees must obtain it.

headline: Raw chicken glove drips onto cooked chicken
summary: A cook handled raw chicken with a gloved hand, so glove contents could drip onto freshly cooked chicken. The manager discarded 10 pounds; a citation was issued. A three-compartment sink drain was blocked, and the manager lacked allergen training.

headline: No health policy; no vomit cleanup kit; sink blocked
summary: No written employee health policy; a citation was issued. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or written procedure. Rear hand sink was blocked by items and lacked soap and paper towels; a citation was issued. No metal stem thermometer was on site.

headline: Wet mop stored in bucket; training certificates missing
summary: A wet mop was stored in a bucket and must be hung to dry. Food handler certificates could not be located for all food employees. Certificates must be provided and kept on site.

headline: Missing signs and thermometers; uncertified training gap
summary: No handwashing sign at the exposed hand sink, and no thermometers in reach-in coolers. Walk-in storage racks were rusted. One certified food manager lacked allergen training. The person in charge was told to fix each item.

headline: Missing signs and thermometers; greasy equipment
summary: No handwashing sign in the employee restroom and no air thermometer in cold holding units. Cooking equipment, especially the wok station, had food debris and grease. Floors throughout the front and rear were not clean.

headline: Chicken too warm; more than 15 flies in kitchen
summary: Chicken was held at 47°F, above the 41°F limit for cold food, and a citation was issued. More than 15 small flies were seen throughout the kitchen, including near coolers and the mop sink; a citation was issued.

headline: No handwashing signs at hand sinks
summary: No handwashing signs were posted at the hand sinks. The person in charge was instructed to provide and maintain signage.

headline: Residue and debris in coolers and prep areas
summary: A large rolling bin lacked a common-name label. Reach-in coolers, the rolling bin and dish area shelving had residue and food debris. A pipe under the hand sink near the ovens is leaking. Residue lies on the wall behind the three-compartment sink.

headline: Freezer interior dirty; buckling floor in walk-in
summary: Interior of the two-door freezer in the food prep area must be cleaned. The men's customer washroom door lacks a self-closing device. Floor is buckling between the seams of the second-floor walk-in cooler and must be repaired.

headline: No employee health policy; walk-in floors dirty
summary: No employee health policy was found on site, and the manager must provide one. No citation was issued. Floors inside the walk-in cooler were not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Wall opening; uncorrected prior violations
summary: A large opening on the wall behind the hand sink in the main kitchen must be repaired. Violations from October 2023 were not corrected, including water-damaged ceiling, cracked basement floor, open floor seams with food debris, and items not elevated in the rear maintenance room.

headline: Cluttered basement floor
summary: The basement floor was cluttered. Items must be raised off the floor or removed. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Milk crates, soiled mops and unused equipment
summary: Upper parts of the ice machine need cleaning. Milk crates must not be used for elevation. Soiled broom stored next to clean pans, and soiled mops were improperly stored. Unused equipment in the basement must be removed.

headline: No hot-holding thermometer; door gap at dining room
summary: No ambient air thermometer was inside the hot holding unit on the front service line. Two dry ingredient containers were unlabeled. An opening at the bottom of the dining room double door must be sealed to keep rodents out.

headline: Stained cutting boards; food stored in tin cans
summary: Cutting boards with open seams and dark stains must be refinished or replaced. Sardines and other foods were stored in tin cans inside the walk-in cooler and must be moved to approved food-grade containers. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Dirty walk-in storage racks
summary: Storage racks inside the walk-in cooler had dirt, dust, food and debris. The establishment must clean and maintain them. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Food handler training required
summary: All food handlers must obtain the required food handler training. The inspector gave this instruction during the re-inspection.

headline: Unlabeled food; no test strips; leaking sink
summary: Plastic containers of food on the front counter were unlabeled. No sanitizing test strips were on premises. A cooler door gasket is ripped, and prep coolers have accumulated food debris. The three-compartment sink leaks, and no allergen training certificates were found.

headline: Dead roaches found; hand sink blocked; labels missing
summary: Dead roaches were found on the floor and glue boards in the rear prep area, a repeat violation. A utensil was removed from a hand sink, and that sink lacked soap; a citation was issued. Cooked chicken and cream cheese lacked date labels and were discarded.

headline: No person in charge or certified manager at opening
summary: No person in charge was on site until about 11:10 AM, and no certified food manager was present while eggrolls and ham were prepared and served; a citation was issued. No soap at the coffee prep hand sink, which was refilled during inspection. Heavy grease and missing allergen certificates.

headline: Sink unusable; sanitizer levels too high and too low
summary: A hand sink drained water onto the floor and was unusable; maintenance serviced it. Dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer, restored before inspection ended. Three-compartment sink sanitizer measured about 2,258 ppm, above the 1,875 ppm label limit.

headline: Inspection summary not posted for customers
summary: No inspection report summary was posted in public view. Management was given a copy and instructed to post it. A citation was issued.

headline: Carnitas past discard date; ice buildup in freezer
summary: Two sheet pans of pork carnitas with a discard date of 3/6/26 were stored in the walk-in cooler; the manager discarded about 6 pounds ($50), and a citation was issued. Uncovered food in the walk-in freezer and ice buildup. An opening at the front entrance base must be sealed.

headline: Greasy fryers and dirty outdoor grease bin
summary: Tops of all deep fryers were encrusted with grease, burnt residue and food debris. The outdoor grease bin was dirty and must be cleaned to avoid pests and rodents. The manager lacks allergen training, and the ice machine was not cleaned as required in an earlier report.

headline: No certified manager on duty; sink leaks
summary: No person in charge held a valid sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was on duty while sandwiches, wraps and soups were served; a citation was issued. The front prep hand sink lacks signage. The dish prep hand sink leaks water onto the floor.

headline: Door gaps and broken washroom ventilation
summary: A 1/4-inch gap under and between the front entrance doors must be sealed to prevent pests. Washroom ventilation is not working; the manager was instructed to repair it. Re-inspection passed.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit cleanup supplies
summary: No valid City foodservice manager certificate was on site, and a citation was issued. No written employee health policy was on site, and a citation was issued. Cleanup supplies for vomit or diarrhea were not present. Torn cooler gasket and no backflow device at the rear mop sink.

headline: No health policy; no three-compartment sink
summary: No employee health policy was on the premises. Food preparation areas were not separated from customers, and a barrier is required. There is no three-compartment sink or mop sink backflow device, no outside dumpster, and basement clutter must be removed.

headline: No certified manager; mold inside ice machine
summary: No certified food sanitation manager or valid certificate was posted while TCS foods were prepared and served; a citation was issued. Black mold-like substance inside the ice machine was dripping onto ice; the ice was to be discarded, and a citation was issued.

headline: No certified manager at start; sanitation violations
summary: No certified food manager was on site at 3:10 PM start; the manager arrived at 3:18 PM, and a citation was issued. Ice machine chute had pink slime and black substance; ice was discarded. Pork sausage at 50.2°F and tomato sauce at 53.2°F were discarded, about $65 worth.

headline: No certified manager; no sanitizer or hot water
summary: No City certified manager was on site or had a valid certificate; a citation was issued. No cleaning agent or sanitizer was available for equipment, and no test kit was present. No three-compartment sink, no hot water at hand sinks, and the refrigerated display unit was off.

headline: Coolers and soda machine drain pan not clean
summary: Interior and exterior of coolers and the soda machine drain pan were not clean. The establishment must clean them.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: The certified food manager had no food allergen training. The manager was told to comply with the requirement.

headline: Milk too warm in produce cooler; discarded
summary: Milk was held at 45.7°F inside the produce walk-in cooler, although the air was 41.0°F. The manager voluntarily discarded about 80 pounds (about $125) of milk. Water-stained ceiling tiles and a non-working washroom light bulb need repair.

headline: Two hand sinks unusable; thawing and labeling problems
summary: Two hand sinks were unusable because they leaked when in use. Frozen empanadas were thawing in a plastic container in the dishwashing area. Sugar and spices lacked name labels. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables.

headline: Improper storage of wiping cloths and scoop
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on prep surfaces without sanitizing solution. An ice scoop behind the bar was not stored properly. Gun holder had pinkish buildup. A water-stained ceiling tile and dirty basement and prep floors need attention.

headline: No air thermometer; vehicle display and garbage issues
summary: No ambient air thermometer inside cold holding units. The vehicle displayed an incorrect plate number; the license number must be on both sides. No lidded garbage receptacle was on the vehicle.

headline: Missing food thermometers and cluttered storage
summary: Cooling units lacked thermometers for cold foods. Beverage equipment, prep tables and cabinets had heavy splatter and dried debris. Items on rear storage floors must be raised at least 6 inches.

headline: Food held too warm and too cold; many violations
summary: Empanadas measured 123.1°F and 125.2°F, below the 135°F hot-hold minimum, and milk was 52.0°F in the display cooler; citations issued. No working cold holding equipment. No pest control logbook, no thermometer, and a trickle of water at the three-compartment sink.

headline: No certified manager on site; no hot water at hand sink
summary: No City certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared and served; a citation was issued. The rear dish area hand sink had no hot water (59.6°F); a citation was issued. Rusty shelving and missing thermometers were also noted.

headline: Hair restraints needed; equipment needs detail cleaning
summary: Food handlers must wear effective hair restraints, including those with long hair. Counters, sinks, cabinets, and interiors of hot and cold holding units need detail cleaning. The rear hand sink drains very slowly.

headline: Cardboard liners; greasy equipment; dirty floors
summary: Cardboard was used as a floor liner in the prep area and must be removed. Cooking equipment and prep tables had grease and food debris. The toilet room needs a covered receptacle. Mop must be hung to dry, and debris lies around the dumpster.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; food stored on floor
summary: No handwashing sign at the hand sink; signs must be posted at all employee hand sinks. Food on the sales area floor must be raised six inches. Cardboard was removed from display coolers. Soiled carpet and unfinished floors must be replaced.

headline: Missing splashguards and dust buildup
summary: Hand sinks next to prep tables need splash guards. Clean pots were stored above a utility sink, and single-use articles were not inverted. Food debris and grease were found on prep tables and fryer cabinets. A soiled mop head was on the floor.

headline: Clutter on floor in rear storage
summary: Clutter was stored on the floor throughout the rear storage area. The manager was instructed to remove unused articles and equipment to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Leaking faucet; leaves in dumpster area
summary: A leak at the base of the left faucet on the three-compartment sink must be fixed. Excessive leaves in the rear dumpster area must be removed to prevent rodent harborage. The rear storage area is poorly lit.

headline: Dead roaches; greasy equipment and floor drains
summary: Several dead roaches were found throughout the facility and must be removed and cleaned. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer, and food was stored in plastic grocery bags. Grease and debris are on cooking equipment, coolers and the ice machine. No allergen training was on site.

headline: Electric bug zapper stored in food prep area
summary: An electric bug zapper was stored inside the food prep area and must be removed. The inspector reported no insects or droppings.

headline: Burnt-out light bulb in walk-in cooler
summary: A burnt-out light bulb is inside the walk-in cooler. The establishment must provide and maintain adequate lighting at all times. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; allergen training needed
summary: The one-door prep cooler behind the cash register lacked a thermometer. The manager provided one during inspection. Multiple certified managers on site had no completed allergen training; the manager was instructed to complete it.

headline: No employee health policy; grease and dirt buildup
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site; a citation was issued and a template left. Heavy dirt, grease and food debris covered walls and floors along the hot food line. Soiled mop heads must be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Missing ceiling tiles; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Missing ceiling tiles in the rear prep area must be replaced. The certified manager had no allergen training and must complete it.

headline: Undated shellstock tags; mold inside ice machine
summary: Shellstock tags from May to July 2024 lacked dates for when the last shellstock was sold or served; a citation was issued. Large rear ice machine had black mold-like spots. Water bottles and to-go containers were corrected on site. Espresso and coffee machines lack backflow devices.

headline: Ice machine buildup; door gaps and gaskets
summary: Ice machine lower interior has mineral buildup and needs detail cleaning. The bottom of the front entrance door must be rodent-proofed. A two-door cooler drawer gasket does not fully close. Ceiling and waterpipes above the prep area have dust.

headline: Dead mice on trap; corrected on site
summary: Dead mice were found on a sticky trap under the basement stairs. The inspector had the trap with dead mice removed from the facility before inspection ended, which corrected the issue on site.

headline: Large kettles and ice machine need cleaning
summary: Inspector found calcium buildup inside the ice machine and dust on filters above the griddle. Large kettles can't be moved to the dishwashing area, so the manager must provide a written clean-in-place procedure.

headline: About 50 mouse droppings; no pest control log
summary: About 50 mouse droppings were found in the rear dry storage, dish area and inside containers; a citation was issued. No current pest control logbook was on premises. Ice machine had a black mold-like substance, and cold holding units and fryer cabinets had grime.

headline: Insect control device over clean equipment
summary: A wall-mounted insect control device is above clean equipment at the two-compartment sink and must be relocated to prevent contamination. Condensate water pools on the floor from the steam table and ice machine and must be re-routed to a drain.

headline: Dust on walls, ceiling and vents
summary: Dust had built up on walls, ceiling, light shields and vents near the two-door refrigeration unit by the dishwashing area. The establishment was instructed to clean it.

headline: Rodent droppings; undated chicken; heavy buildup
summary: About 30 rodent droppings were found on the floor under the breading shelving and in the office, and a citation was issued. About 50 pounds of cooked chicken lacked discard labels; the person in charge discarded it (about $150). Shelving and cooling units were encrusted with grease and debris.

headline: Food stored on floor in deli cooler
summary: No handwashing signs in the employee break room. Food stored on the floor in the deli walk-in cooler must be raised off the floor. The women's washroom has no covered bin.

headline: Rodent droppings and flies found throughout
summary: About 25 small rodent droppings were found in several areas, including on an office desk. About 30 small live flies were seen in prep areas. A citation was issued. A grease trap is leaking onto the floor, and a hand sink had no running water.

headline: Cooked meats past discard date; several prior violations
summary: Cooked beef and pork past the 7-day discard date were offered. The person in charge discarded about 20 pounds (about $100). Earlier violations were not corrected, including knives stored behind the counter and missing food handler training. A citation was issued.

headline: Many cold foods held too warm; discarded
summary: Many cold foods, including ham, chicken, cheese and salads, were held at 47.5°F to 54.5°F, above the 41°F limit. The manager discarded about 30 pounds (about $150) on site; a citation was issued. Leaking drain pipes at the three-compartment sink and missing grout were also found.

headline: Bug light placed above food; damaged shelving
summary: A bug light was installed behind a food storage shelf and must be moved to prevent contamination. Shelving surface is damaged. Cold water was shut off at a prep sink and the manager was told to restore it. A backflow device is missing in the basement.

headline: Mouse droppings throughout; food held too warm
summary: About 45 or more mouse droppings were found throughout the facility, including on food carts and prep shelves; a citation was issued. Egg rolls and crab rangoon were held at room temperature, and about 17 pounds ($45) were discarded. No certified food manager was on site.

headline: Dust buildup on kitchen fan
summary: Dust had built up on a fan in the kitchen near the prep area. The establishment was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Front door gap; floors and vents need cleaning
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the front carry-out door must be sealed to prevent pests. Walk-in shelving needs cleaning to remove spillage. Floors under equipment and in the walk-in need cleaning, and the oven vent is dusty.

headline: Failed on re-inspection: flies, roaches, ice mold
summary: Failed on re-inspection. 75 or more live black flies in prep, storage and bar areas; 5 live cockroaches, including inside a handwash sink and dish rack. Ice machine had pink and black slime dripping onto ice (citation issued). Also missing thermometers and a rear door not rodent-proof.

headline: Passed; no thermometer, sink hose, leaks
summary: Passed. No thermometer in the 3-door refrigerator in the middle prep area. Sanitizer hose sits in sink compartments. Food handlers without hair restraints. Wiping cloths left on prep tables. Leaking front sink faucet. Dirty floors and several expired food handler certificates.

headline: Failed: no surface temperature indicator
summary: Failed. No irreversible temperature indicator for utensil surface temperature; only water test strips provided. Priority violation; no citation issued. Also no covered receptacles in single-person staff restrooms, and an outside receptacle with light debris.

headline: Failed: bare-hand contact, cold food, flies
summary: Failed. Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat fries (discarded). Cooked rice at 44.3F and lamb at 51.8F-53.2F; about 34 lbs discarded. About 15 or more live small flies in bar areas. Expired food handler training and many upkeep items.

headline: Failed: rodent bait found on meat slicer
summary: Failed. Open rodent bait was found in and on a meat slicer on a prep table shelf. The person in charge removed the bait, sanitized, and moved the slicer to basement storage (corrected). Also missing sink stoppers and water backing up at the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Conditions: dish machine 0 ppm; veal vacuum-packed without variance
summary: Passed with conditions. Dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged out (no citation). Reduced-oxygen packaging of cooked veal without a variance: about 20 lbs discarded and packaging machine removed (citation issued). Also a broken fryer door handle.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; rusty freezer racks
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Rusted and dirty storage racks in the store freezer. Surfaces must be smooth and easily cleanable. Operator instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Failed: 15 rat droppings found in basement
summary: Failed. About 15 rat droppings in basement (citation issued). Raw ahi tuna and salmon served with no menu raw-food notice; corrected on site, paper menus removed. Also front door gap, unlabeled rice containers, ceiling hole, and no sink splash guard.

headline: Passed; sticky fly traps, floor debris
summary: Passed. Sticky fly traps hung in the rear dish area. The person in charge was instructed to remove them and inform the pest control technician of the need for insect control. Debris on floors under shelving needs cleaning.

headline: Failed on re-inspection; no health policy on site
summary: Failed on re-inspection. No verifiable employee health policy on site (citation issued). Also no food thermometer, no waste disposal contract on record, no food handler certificates, no washroom ventilation, trash cans without lids, and dirty floors.

headline: Failed: rat droppings, no pest logbook, missing sinks
summary: Failed. About 15 rat droppings in basement; gaps at front and rear doors; no pest control logbook. Also missing front prep hand sink, no backflow device on hose sink, no lidded outdoor waste container, and no manager allergen certificate.

headline: Passed; splash guard and sealing needed
summary: Passed. The bar hand sink needs a splash guard on its right side. Raw wooden bar shelving must be sealed to be smooth and cleanable. Openings around mop sink piping must be sealed.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager on arrival
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager on site at arrival; one arrived about 30 minutes later (citation issued). Food stored on walk-in cooler floor, food peeled on the floor, and food handlers without hair restraints.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, raw beef placement
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on site (corrected). Raw beef stored above ready-to-eat beef (corrected). Also mold-like ice machine build-up, undated shellstock tags, no metal thermometer, no coffee machine backflow device, and missing soap and towels at sinks (corrected).

headline: Failed: about 50 rat droppings in basement
summary: Failed. About 50 rat droppings in rear basement storage (citation issued); more pest control needed. Also no employee health policy, undated food held over 24 hours, overflowing dumpster, no thermometer in cooler, and no hair restraints.

headline: Failed: no vomit cleanup procedure, pest logbook
summary: Failed. No written cleaning procedure or equipment for vomit or diarrhea events. No pest control logbook with required documents on site. Dirty basement liquor storage floors with items on the floor. No citation issued.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings, flies, ants, ice machine slime
summary: Failed. About 40 mouse droppings in rear storage, about 15 live small black flies; about 15 live ants at a kitchen threshold. Ice machine slime dripping onto ice. Also hole in wall, damaged ceiling tiles, and no manager allergen certificates.

headline: Passed; restroom door not self-closing
summary: Passed. The toilet room door does not close on its own. The inspector instructed the operator to make it self-closing and maintain it.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; debris, leaks, ceiling damage
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Food debris and spills on cooking equipment, prep tables, shelves, coolers and freezers. Leaking drainpipe under the front prep sink. Damaged, stained ceiling tiles and inadequate freezer lighting. Operator instructed to correct each.

headline: Passed; hair restraints, grease, dust
summary: Passed. Food handlers prepping without hair restraints. Wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces. Food in plastic grocery bags in cooler and freezer. Grease on cooking equipment, walls and floors. Dust on fans, light shields and vents. Operator instructed to correct each.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; broken fixtures, no prep sink
summary: Passed on re-inspection. No data plate on the high-temperature dish machine. A non-working toilet in the basement women's washroom and a non-working hand sink in the men's washroom. No prep/dump sink in the bamboo bar. Operator instructed to repair or install each.

headline: Passed; cooking equipment and floors need cleaning
summary: Passed. Sides of cooking equipment need cleaning. A 3-compartment sink in the ice cream area needs cleaning. Floors in corners and under equipment need cleaning to remove build-up. Operator instructed to clean and maintain each.

headline: Failed: basement drain leak, mold-like build-up
summary: Failed. Leaking basement drain pipe with black mold-like build-up on the floor. Repeat core violations not corrected (citation issued). Also gap at exterior screen door, greasy hood filters, expired food handler and allergen certificates, and unlabeled containers.

headline: Failed: food held too warm, live roaches
summary: Failed. Cooler at 50.5F; cooked potatoes, eggs and hummus held too warm; about 7 lbs discarded and cooler tagged out (citation issued). Also 4 live cockroaches (2 on rack, 2 in mop sink area; citation issued), no hair restraints, and no food handler certificates.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; no food handler certificates
summary: Passed on re-inspection. No food handler certificates were on the premises. The operator must show proof of food handler training for all food handling employees.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager while serving chicken
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid-certificate person in charge, and no certified manager on site while chicken was prepared and served (citation issued). Also fly strips in prep area, food on floor, worn cutting boards, and no food handler training.

headline: Passed; insect devices above clean equipment
summary: Passed. No pests reported. Insect control devices were installed directly above clean equipment and plumbing at the central bar. Plastic cups used as scoops in bulk dry food. Satellite kitchen hood filters missing. Operator instructed to correct each.

headline: Failed: improper thawing, expired training
summary: Failed. Frozen shrimp thawed improperly in a sink. Several expired food handler certificates; a certified manager lacks allergen training. Also food stored on floors, grocery bags in freezer, rusty racks with mold-like build-up, and missing sink stoppers.

headline: Failed on re-inspection: dumpster lid missing
summary: Failed on re-inspection. The outside dumpster is missing its lid. A priority violation from the 7-1-26 inspection was not corrected (citation issued). The operator must provide a fix.

headline: Passed; expired training certificates
summary: Passed. Expired food handler certificates on site and an expired allergen training certificate for the City certified manager. No hand-washing sign at the rear prep sink. The operator was instructed to meet these requirements.

headline: Failed: no valid manager certificate, dumpster lids
summary: Failed. No valid food manager certificate posted when TCS foods were handled (citation issued). Dumpster lids broken or holed (citation). Also unlabeled containers, scoops stored inside dry containers, ice and water dripping in walk-in freezer, and burnt-out bulbs.

headline: Passed; slow sink drain, restroom issues
summary: Passed. The prep area hand sink drains slowly. The unisex restroom has no covered receptacle, and its door is not self-closing. The inspector instructed the person in charge to repair and maintain each.

headline: Passed; worn cutting boards and dirty equipment
summary: Passed. Cutting boards with deep cuts or dark spots need replacing. The self-serve soda dispenser needs detail cleaning. Floors in the rear prep area need cleaning of food spills. Operator instructed to correct each.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager while prepping food
summary: Passed with conditions. No City certified food manager on premises while chicken and coleslaw were prepared (priority violation). A certified manager must be on premises whenever these foods are prepared.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; raw wood, floors
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Raw wood shelving behind the front counter must be sealed. Spills and debris on sills and shelves; dust on cooler bases. Unfinished and peeling floors in sales area. No ventilation fan in the washroom.

headline: Passed; rusted ice machine bolts and grime
summary: Passed. Rusted bolts inside the ice machine. Grime and syrup spillage in the soda machine cabinet. Build-up in a large floor drain near the fryers. The person in charge was instructed to repair or clean each.

headline: Failed: 50+ live flies, roach, ice machine slime
summary: Failed. About 50+ live flies in bakery, storage and dish areas, plus one live roach (citation issued). Ice machine slime (citation issued). Also medicines and first-aid items stored near food (removed during inspection), leaking pipes, expired allergen training.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; flying insects noted
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Flying insects were noted, and the operator was told to clean and sanitize affected areas. Floors along wall bases, under equipment and at the dirty floor drain need cleaning. Serving plates stored uninverted.

headline: Passed; upright plates, fryer grease, allergen training
summary: Passed. Plates in the kitchen stored upright rather than inverted. Heavy grease inside cooking fryers needs cleaning. One expired allergen training certificate on site; the operator must provide allergen training for all certified food managers.

headline: Failed: 60 mouse droppings, dish machine 0 ppm
summary: Failed. About 60 mouse droppings under dry storage racks, electrical room, chemical closet and bar shelf (citation issued). Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine; tagged and not to be used until repaired. Also dirty floors and improperly stored pots.

headline: Passed; leaking sanitizer backflow device
summary: Passed. The backflow device for the sanitizer dispenser was in poor repair and leaking at the base. Peeling paint on a basement dish area wall. The inspector instructed repairs for both.

headline: Passed; food stored on floor, allergen training missing
summary: Passed. Food stored on the walk-in freezer floor must be raised six inches. The certified food manager lacks allergen training, and the operator must provide it.

headline: Failed: 50+ mouse droppings, pest control needed
summary: Failed. 50 or more mouse droppings in washroom, behind furnace, and by pop storage (citation issued). Pest control needed before re-inspection next week. Also dirty fryers and floors under and behind cooking equipment.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager, labeling gaps
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager on site while deli meat and eggs were handled. Handwash sink blocked by salad spinner; no working food thermometer; unlabeled grab-and-go foods; damaged cooler gaskets; taped 3-compartment sink surface.

headline: Passed; mineral build-up in ice machine
summary: Passed. Pink mineral build-up inside the ice machine. The inspector instructed the operator to clean and maintain it.

headline: Passed; hair restraints and storage issues
summary: Passed. Food handlers not wearing hair restraints. Single-service articles not inverted in prep area. No stoppers for the 3-compartment sink. Food spills and debris on equipment, coolers and shelves. No covered receptacle in washroom.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk containers, utensil placement
summary: Passed. Some bulk containers are unlabeled. Utensil handles stored inside toppings. Single-service plates and trays not inverted in prep cooler. Certified manager lacks valid allergen training. Operator instructed to correct each.

headline: Passed; ice build-up and dirty floors
summary: Passed. Excessive ice build-up inside chest freezers must be removed and cleaned. Dirt and debris under the 3-compartment sink and behind refrigeration units. The employee washroom door lacks a self-closing device.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, cookies and milk served
summary: Failed. Person in charge lacks a City certified food manager certificate. No certified manager on premises and no certificate posted while cookies and milk were prepared and served (citation issued).

headline: Passed on re-inspection; dead roaches found
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Dead roaches on the floor under the three-compartment sink and near a cold holding unit; operator instructed to remove them. Greasy deep fryer exteriors and dirty floors in the rear prep area also need cleaning.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; rear door gap
summary: Passed on re-inspection. A 1/2-inch gap at the bottom of the rear exit door must be sealed to prevent rodent entry. The floor inside the walk-in cooler and freezer needs cleaning. All food handlers must obtain required training.

headline: Failed; no pest control logbook on site
summary: Failed. No current pest control logbook was on site, and a citation was issued. Also a loose washroom faucet, an overflowing outside dumpster with lids not closed, water-stained walls and ceiling tiles, and clutter.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; cleaning and training
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Interior door edges of the high-temperature dish machine need detail cleaning. Wine bar floor needs cleaning. No food handler training certificates provided for food handling employees.

headline: Conditions: no valid manager certificate posted
summary: Passed with conditions. Person in charge lacked a valid certified food manager certificate; none posted while TCS foods were prepared (citation issued). Manager arrived at 12:15 PM with one. No hot water at 1-compartment sink; loose hot-holding gasket.

headline: Failed: live roaches, flies, cold-held raw sausage
summary: Failed. 2 live cockroaches and about 35 small flies in pizza prep, dishwashing and dry storage areas (citation issued). Also no hand cleanser at prep sinks; about 20 lbs raw sausage held at 51-57F and discarded; cooler at 50F tagged out.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; couch in prep area
summary: Passed on re-inspection. A brown leather couch was stored in the food prep area next to cooking equipment under the hood. The operator was instructed to remove it.

headline: Failed: live roaches and mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. More than 10 live cockroaches and over 25 mouse droppings in prep, bar, storage and basement areas. About 25 dead roaches also found. Slow prep sink drain and non-self-closing restroom door noted. Citation issued; pest control recommended.

headline: Failed: sink backing up, no hand-wash signs
summary: Failed. Water backed up and drained slowly in the 3-compartment sink (citation issued). No hand-washing signs. Food spills and debris on coolers, freezers, sinks and shelves. Hand sink timer too short; damaged ceiling tiles; no manager allergen training.

headline: Passed; cutting board and training proof missing
summary: Passed. Cutting board on the cook-line prep cooler has deep cuts and stains. No proof of food handler certificates; new hires have 30 days to provide them. No proof of allergen training for certified food managers.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager, heavy grease and debris
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge with a valid sanitation certificate, and no certified manager on site while chicken was prepared and served (citation issued). Excessive grease and debris on equipment, coolers, shelves and floors; worn grout; missing allergen training.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager during food prep
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager on site while chicken and pork were prepped (citation issued). Also missing hand-washing signs, ready-to-eat foods not date-marked, food stored on floor, and no allergen training.

headline: Conditions: no vomit cleanup supplies, no posted summary
summary: Passed with conditions. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup supplies on site (citation issued). Packaged popcorn and oil improperly labeled; grease on rear prep walls; inadequate lighting in prep and dry storage; no inspection summary posted in public view (citation issued).

headline: Conditions: dish machine had no sanitizer
summary: Passed with conditions. Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine sanitizer (citation issued); a technician repaired it on site to 100 ppm. No certified manager on site while handling TCS foods, person in charge lacks certificate, and no allergen training.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; display case, cleaning, lighting
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Wood display case has no door handles. Baking pans, carts, display case interiors and buckets need cleaning. Dried food debris on prep floors. Inadequate lighting in rear prep, storage and front self-service areas.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; cutting boards, moldy caulk
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Stained cutting boards in prep and front bar areas. Prep tables, fryers, cooking equipment and walk-in shelves need cleaning. Blackened, moldy wall caulking at the dish machine must be replaced.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; door gaps, shelving issues
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Quarter-inch gaps at exit and main entrance doors must be sealed against pests. Food stored on floors in the walk-in cooler and prep area must be raised six inches. Milk crates used as shelving.

headline: Passed; hair restraint, cooler spills, floors
summary: Passed. A food handler without a hair restraint. Spills on the interior of the front prep two-door cooler. Basement storage floors need cleaning, and items stored on the floor must be elevated. Operator instructed to correct each.

headline: Passed; grease and dust under cooking units
summary: Passed. Grease, dust and dirt under and behind the six-burner cooking units. Dirty floor under dry storage shelving, possibly food debris. Dust on filters under an unused hood. Operator instructed to clean and maintain all.

headline: Passed; grime in cold holding gaskets, ceiling
summary: Passed. Grime and food debris in cold holding unit gaskets. No covered receptacle in the women's restroom. Severely water-damaged ceiling tiles in rear storage. Dust and debris on cooking-area surfaces. Operator instructed to correct each.

headline: Failed: carnitas held at 50F, dead mice found
