summary: Failed. Cooked carnitas stored at 48.8F-50F in the walk-in cooler; no time and temperature log; about 7 lbs discarded (citation issued). Also dead mice in storage and selling areas (repeat violation), milk crates for elevation, and cardboard floor matting.

headline: Failed: beef thawed at room temperature
summary: Failed. Frozen beef thawed at room temperature. No sanitizer test strips and a leaking 3-compartment sink (citations issued). Also stained cutting board, worn cooler gasket, dusty condensers, and no food handler certificate.

headline: Passed; fly strip hanging, cooler particles
summary: Passed. A fly strip hangs in the rear produce prep room and must be removed. Black particles on the top interior of the packaged dairy and egg cooler need cleaning. A leak under the rear meat prep 3-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; dust and floor debris
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Dust on the ceiling and vent above a sandwich and cake prep table. Dirt, debris and food buildup on floors under ovens, in the dish area, prep areas and barista station. Dust on barista shelving. Operator instructed to clean all.

headline: Passed; restroom faucets not working
summary: Passed. Faucets in the men's and women's restrooms are not working. Debris inside the rear ice machine. Two burnt-out bulbs in the cook-line hood. Operator instructed to repair or replace each.

headline: Passed; crates as shelving, clutter
summary: Passed. Crates used as shelving in the rear prep area. Clutter in rear prep and cooler areas. Food debris and spills on the prep area floor. The manager was instructed to provide shelving, organize, and clean.

headline: Conditions: chicken held at 48.5F, discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Chicken held at 48.5F in a prep cooler and walk-in cooler; about 10 lbs discarded (citation issued). A leak at the 3-compartment sink faucet must be repaired.

headline: Passed; dusty light shields
summary: Passed. Dust on light shields above the front counter. The inspector instructed the operator to clean them.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; door gap, toilet fan
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Rear door gap to be sealed; utensils not inverted; crates used for storage; toilet room door not self-closing; toilet room fan not working; pots too large for 3-compartment sink; no food handler training.

headline: Passed; soil and dust on kitchen walls
summary: Passed. Food soil and dust build-up on kitchen walls and ceilings. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; plastic cup scoops
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Single-use plastic cups used as scoops in food containers at the front service area. Heavily scored cutting boards along line coolers. Small leak at 3-compartment sink drain. Operator instructed to correct each.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; no sink drain plugs
summary: Passed on re-inspection. No drain plugs for the 3-compartment sink. The inspector instructed the manager to provide them.

headline: Failed: hand sink too hot, no barrier, no hot water
summary: Failed. Hand sink water at 130F (must be 100-120F). No barrier between food prep and customer ordering lines. No hot or cold water at basement 3-compartment sink. Also missing hand-washing signs, lidded trash, and ceiling tiles.

headline: Passed; missing signs, trash lid, allergen training
summary: Passed. No hand-washing signs at any hand sink. No lidded trash receptacle in the unisex restroom. No food allergen training certificate. The operator was instructed to provide and maintain each.

headline: Failed: flies in donut case, no manager
summary: Failed. 10-15 small flies in the donut display case over blueberry muffins and glazed donuts. No City certified food manager on site while chicken, pizza and taquitos were prepared and served; owner arrived after inspection.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; grease on oil container
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Heavy grease build-up on top of the outside oil container. The operator was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Passed; missing sink stoppers and signage
summary: Passed. No hand-washing signage at the rear dish sink. No air thermometer in the 7UP cooler. Three sink stoppers missing from the 3-compartment sink. Floors throughout need cleaning. Operator instructed to correct each.

headline: Passed; water-damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. Water-damaged ceiling tiles and cracked ceiling plaster. The person in charge was instructed to replace the tiles and repair the plaster.

headline: Passed; missing hand-washing sign at prep sink
summary: Passed. No hand-washing sign at the hand sink in the rear prep area. The inspector instructed the operator to provide one.

headline: Failed on re-inspection: rat droppings uncounted
summary: Failed on re-inspection. Rat droppings too numerous to count in basement storage, a repeat violation not corrected; more pest control service needed (citation issued). Also no rear door screen, no ice machine backflow device, and a leaking hand sink drain.

headline: Passed; signage, lids, mold-like build-up
summary: Passed. Hand sink behind the front bar needs signage. Unlabeled storage containers; ice bins need lids. Grease and white mold-like build-up on walk-in cooler racks. Debris under dumpster. Cracked light shields. Certified manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; rusty shelves, clutter
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Rusty, dirty shelves in basement walk-in coolers. Heavy clutter and unused equipment in basement storage. Floors and wall bases need cleaning. Heavy dirt and grease in exhaust hood and filters.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; cloths, scoops, walls
summary: Passed on re-inspection. No hand-washing signage in the unisex washroom. Wiping cloths stored on prep tables; ice scoops stored inside the ice machine; unlabeled bulk container; dirty walls; water-damaged ceiling tiles; heavy dust on a restroom vent.

headline: Failed on re-inspection: 3-sink water too cool
summary: Failed on re-inspection. Hot water at the 3-compartment sink measured 94-97.1F; it must stay at least 110F during operation (citation issued). Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, coolers and shelves. A manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; debris and grease
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Customer tableware stored without protection. Accumulated food and grease inside the fryer. Dirt and food debris on lower prep shelves and floors in both prep areas. Operator instructed to clean all.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; dust, slow drain, floor debris
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Dust on fan guards in the main walk-in cooler. Slow drainage at the women's restroom right hand sink. Food debris and black grease on floors under and behind equipment and along kitchen wall bases. Operator instructed to clean and repair.

headline: Passed; unlabeled spices, grease, soiled cloths
summary: Passed. Seasonings out of original containers lack labels. Soiled wiping cloths stored on prep tables. Ice build-up on a freezer. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment and coolers. Soiled mop heads not hung. Operator instructed to correct each.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bread, untrained dishwasher
summary: Passed. Bread sold to go lacked proper labels. One dishwasher lacks food handler training. The operator was instructed to label items with trace-back information and ingredients, and to complete training.

headline: Passed; ice build-up and floor spills
summary: Passed. Ice build-up inside the ice cream display freezer and walk-in freezer; must defrost and clean. Floors in the walk-in dairy cooler and rear storage need cleaning of spills and debris.

headline: Failed: no sanitation certificate, floor drain backup
summary: Failed. No City sanitation certificate on site while chicken, noodles, rice and beef were handled (citation issued). Clear water backed up from floor drain when front hand sink used (citation issued). Also dirty cooking equipment and floors; no allergen certificate.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager, thawing problems
summary: Passed with conditions. Person in charge lacks a Chicago food sanitation certificate. No certified manager on site while chicken, beef and rice were handled (citation issued). Pork thawed in sink water, dirty floors and hood filters, and no food handler certificates.

headline: Base coving missing in front sales area
summary: Base coving is missing in the front sales area. The manager was told to replace it.

headline: Dark residue in ice bin; food dates missing
summary: Black, brown and pink substance was found inside the full ice bin in the basement ice machine. Ice is used for drinks and food, so the ice must be removed and the bin cleaned. Many cooked foods in coolers were not date-marked, and a citation was issued.

headline: Frozen fish thawed at room temperature
summary: Frozen fish was thawing at room temperature and must be thawed under cold running water or refrigeration. Whisks and scoops were stored improperly between uses. Single-use cups and bowls were being reused. The men's restroom door is broken and does not lock. Prior violations from 2023 were not fixed.

headline: Wet wiping cloths and food in plastic grocery bags
summary: Wet wiping cloths were left on several prep surfaces and must be stored in sanitizing solution. Frozen foods were stored in plastic grocery bags in the freezer and must be in food-grade containers. Milk crates were used as shelving.

headline: Restroom lacks trash receptacle; hood light out
summary: The all-gender toilet room has no covered trash receptacle, and the person in charge was told to provide one. The outdoor grease container is covered in grease and needs cleaning. A burnt-out light bulb in the hood must be replaced.

headline: No vomit/diarrhea kit; dish machine rinse too cool
summary: No kit was on site for vomit and diarrhea events, and a citation was issued. A pizza prep hand sink was blocked, and the hot-water dish machine final rinse was only 155.1°F. The machine was tagged. Vacuum packaging ran without a required variance, and employees lacked food handler training.

headline: No certified manager on premises; no proof of training
summary: No City-certified sanitation manager was on premises, and a citation was issued. The all-gender employee washroom lacked a covered receptacle. No proof of food handler training was provided.

headline: Tools stored on food shelving units
summary: Tools were found stored on food storage shelving units. They must be removed from the food shelving.

headline: Dusty and dirty display cooler vents
summary: The vents at the display cooler were dusty and dirty. The manager was told to clean and maintain them.

headline: Food stored on floor in prep area
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor throughout the prep area. The manager was told to raise them at least six inches on shelving. Milk crates were also being used as shelving and must be replaced.

headline: No vomit/diarrhea kit; cold and hot units out of range
summary: No vomit and diarrhea procedure or clean-up kit was on the premises. A prep cooler and a hot-holding unit were out of range and tagged. A front door gap and a toilet room door that does not self-close must be fixed. Floor tiles are missing in the toilet room and near the rear door.

headline: Dead insects found; no certified manager; citation issued
summary: The person in charge lacked a City sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was present while rice and eggs were served. A cook used the same gloves for multiple tasks. Black slime was found on ice machine surfaces. Food was discarded because of missing dates. Dead insects were in a ceiling light shield.

headline: Dirty washroom floors and damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Washroom floors were dirty and need cleaning. Ceiling tiles and light shields were damaged throughout the premises and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: No proof of pest control service; sink leaking
summary: The manager could not show proof of at least two pest control services within the past year. The last report was dated January 7, 2025. A citation was issued. The three-compartment sink also leaks from its bottom pipes and must be serviced.

headline: No certified manager during pizza prep
summary: No City-certified food manager was on premises while pizza, a TCS food, was being prepared and served. A citation was issued. Other issues: no hand-washing sign at the pizza prep sink, torn cooler gaskets, heavy grease on walk-in shelving, and no food handler certificates.

headline: Dead roaches, unsafe water temps, and discarded seafood
summary: Dead roaches were found on the floor and inside a sushi prep hand sink. Hand sinks lacked soap, and water measured 55.6–74.8°F. Unlabeled oysters and dated lamb and steak were voluntarily discarded, valued at $92 and $449. Several earlier problems were corrected on site or on 3/29/2024.

headline: Hair restraints missing; greasy, dirty floors
summary: Female food handlers in the front prep area were not wearing hair restraints. Cooking equipment interiors had charred food and grease buildup. Floors were greasy and slippery, with debris in the corners. Walls around sinks and cooking equipment need detail cleaning.

headline: Raw meat spills and encrusted grease found
summary: Raw meat spilled from a shelf onto the walk-in cooler floor, and cooler floors and shelves were rusted. Fryers and equipment had encrusted grease and food debris. Hood filters were greasy. No food handler or allergen training records were on site.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: A City of Chicago certified manager was missing allergen training. The person was told to obtain training and keep verification on file.

headline: Black residue in ice machine; uncovered food
summary: The inside of the ice machine was soiled with black substance. Ice must be discarded, and the machine cleaned and sanitized. Food stored in containers lacked labels, and some food was left uncovered in the prep cooler. Expired food handler and allergen certificates were also noted.

headline: Truck missing license number; inlet needs cover
summary: The license number was not printed on the truck and must be printed on both sides in clear, large letters. The manager was told to add a cover over the fresh water inlet to prevent contamination.

headline: Dirty floors and missing allergen training
summary: Floors along the walls in the rear prep area were not clean and must be cleaned. A sanitation manager lacked allergen training and must be provided with it.

headline: Storage room door gap; leaking faucet
summary: An opening at the base of the rear storage room door must be sealed to prevent pests. Boxes and containers are on the floor and must be raised six inches. The three-compartment sink has no stoppers, a leaking faucet, and no grease trap. Floor tiles are missing.

headline: Cold cupcakes stored too warm; ceiling leak
summary: The front prep area refrigerator was too warm, at 62.7°F ambient air, with cream-cheese cupcakes inside. The food was moved to a rear cooler, and a citation was issued. Hand sinks lacked signage, and some food handlers lacked hair restraints. Stained ceiling tiles suggest a leak.

headline: No certified manager on site; dish machine too cool
summary: No City-certified food manager was present while cooked chicken was being prepared and served. The same gloved hands loaded dirty dishes and unloaded clean ones. The high-temperature dish machine did not reach 180°F and was tagged. No one on site had allergen training.

headline: No health policy; prior violations not corrected
summary: No verified written employee health policy was on site, and a citation was issued. Prior violations were not fixed: a missing light bulb over the hood and missing allergen training for certified managers, and a citation was issued. Moldy caulking and a dirty floor drain under the dish machine also need attention.

headline: No food handler training; equipment stored on floor
summary: Employees handling food had no food handler training. Multi-use equipment was stored on the floor, food was kept in grocery bags in the freezer, and a drain pipe under a sink was leaking. Openings in lower storage walls must be sealed.

headline: About 40 rat droppings found in basement
summary: The inspector found evidence of rodent activity, including about 40 rat droppings on the basement floor in the corners. The business was told to remove the activity, clean and sanitize affected areas, and contact pest control. This was a priority violation.

headline: Hot-holding unit unplugged; no health policy
summary: The large chicken hot-holding unit was off because it was plugged into the wrong outlet. Hot food must stay at 135°F or hotter. No written employee health policy or vomit/diarrhea procedure was on site, and both are priority violations.

headline: Dish machine sanitizing at 0 ppm chlorine
summary: The low-temperature dish machine was not sanitizing, with chlorine at 0 ppm. The business was told not to use it until it reached at least 50 ppm, and a citation was issued. Other issues: serving plates not inverted, broken glass at the sushi cooler door, and a leaking faucet.

headline: No sanitation certificate; no hot water on site
summary: No valid City of Chicago sanitation certificate was on site, and a citation was issued. The hot water tank was in poor repair and its water was shut off because of a leak, so there was no hot water. Cooking equipment, cooler interiors and floors need detail cleaning.

headline: No person in charge; certificate expired
summary: No person in charge was present, and no certified manager was on duty while TCS foods were served. The safe serve certificate on site has expired, and a citation was issued. Serving plates on shelves were not inverted. A slimy substance was found in the soda gun dispenser.

headline: Worn cooler door gaskets; grease behind sink
summary: Walk-in cooler door gaskets were in poor repair or missing in places. Floors and walls behind the three-compartment sink were heavily soiled with grease and food debris. Disposable paper towels were stored in a washroom, and the washroom ventilation was in poor repair.

headline: No certified manager; ice machine has mold and rust
summary: No City-certified manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared, and a citation was issued. Bare-handed contact with ready-to-eat foods was observed, and a citation was issued. Black mold, brown residue and rust were found inside the ice machine. Walk-in cooler measured 70.2°F. Multiple other issues need correction.

headline: Rear exit door has openings; dirty cooking equipment
summary: Openings along the bottom of the rear exit door must be sealed to keep pests out. A torn gasket on a meat freezer needs repair. Cutting boards have open seams and dark stains. Dirt and debris are inside cooking equipment, and vents in both washrooms are dusty.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving throughout
summary: Milk crates were being used as shelving in the prep and storage areas. They must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor so the floor can be cleaned.

headline: Floors and vents need detail cleaning
summary: Floors under and around equipment in several areas need detail cleaning to help prevent pests and insects. Ceiling tiles, light covers, air vents and the hood also have dust or grease buildup and must be cleaned.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; dirty floors and coolers
summary: Bulk food storage containers need labels. Bulk containers, reach-in cooler interiors, the deli slicer and shelving under cooking equipment need cleaning. Floors in the walk-in, under chip display shelving, and the prep area need cleaning.

headline: Hair restraints missing; knives stored under gyros unit
summary: Male food handlers were not wearing hair restraints, and knives were stored under gyros equipment. The toilet room had no hand-washing sign or lidded receptacle. Ceiling tiles were stained from a probable leak. No certified manager on site had allergen training.

headline: No hot water at west-side hand sink; citation
summary: The hand sink for the west-side food prep area had no hot water. Management must provide water above 100°F, and a citation was issued. A prep cooler has a torn gasket and exposed insulation. The certified manager lacked allergen training, and dish area lighting is inadequate.

headline: Over 100 live flies found; pest control needed
summary: About 100 or more live small flies were found on walls, ceilings, vent ducts, the rear hallway, the hot water tank area, and a toilet room. This was a prior priority violation not corrected, and a citation was issued. Pest control service is recommended. A gap in the front doors must be sealed.

headline: Wet mop stored next to hand sink
summary: A wet mop was stored in the rear prep area next to a hand sink. Staff were told to hang mops so they can dry when not in use.

headline: No pest control records or handwashing signs
summary: No pest control agreement or logbook was available for review. Handwashing signs were missing at sinks throughout. The owner was told to provide both. No citation was issued.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep; ice machine slime
summary: Food handlers prepared TCS foods without a certified manager or certificate on site, and a citation was issued. The self-serve dining-area ice machine had black slime dripping onto ice, plus rust. A backflow device is missing from a prep utility sink. No allergen training was found.

headline: No health policy verified; ventilation missing
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site, and no citation was issued. A template was left, and copies signed by employees must be kept on site. Unused equipment and unnecessary items in storage must be removed to prevent pests. No ventilation exists in the prep and washroom areas.

headline: Storage cabinets need cleaning; door not self-closing
summary: Inside storage cabinets in the front prep area must be cleaned of spills and debris. The employee washroom door does not self-close and must be fixed. A prior allergen training violation from 2023 was not corrected.

headline: No hair restraints; no handwashing sign at sink
summary: Multiple food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. No handwashing sign was posted at an exposed sink in the front prep area. Cutting boards have deep scratches and stains and must be replaced. Unfinished wood on shelving must be finished so it can be cleaned.

headline: No sanitation certificate posted or allergen training
summary: No City of Chicago sanitation manager certificate was posted, and a citation was issued. No allergen training certificates were found on site. All food sanitation managers must complete allergen training.

headline: No norovirus disinfectant; missing hand-wash signs
summary: No disinfectant effective against norovirus was on site, and the business must obtain and keep it on hand. No handwashing signs were posted at the front prep area sinks or the men's and women's restroom sinks.

headline: Dirty hood filter above cooking equipment
summary: The filter above the cooking equipment was dirty. The manager must clean and maintain it.

headline: No handwashing signs; restroom bins need lids
summary: No hand-washing signs were posted at sinks in the members area and the main kitchen. All three gender washrooms lacked covered receptacles for sanitary products. Both items must be fixed.

headline: Dish machine sanitizer fixed on site; citation issued
summary: The low-temperature dish machine was giving only about 10 ppm chlorine. The person in charge repaired it on site to 50 ppm at 120°F, and a citation was issued. Also noted: an employee drinking in the kitchen, a gap under the rear door, and uncovered takeout containers.

headline: No vomit/diarrhea supplies; license number missing
summary: No written procedure or adequate supplies were on site for vomit and diarrhea events. The person in charge was told to provide them, and this was a priority violation. The business license number was not printed on the sides of the mobile food vehicle.

headline: No certified manager while noodles and chicken served
summary: No City-certified manager with a valid original certificate was on site while noodles, pork, chicken and eggs were prepared and served, and a citation was issued. Shrimp, pork, chicken wings and beef were thawing in standing water. A rear exit door had a gap of at least 1/4 inch.

headline: Line cook handled raw chicken then bread bare-handed
summary: A line cook touched raw chicken, wiped soiled hands on a cloth, did not wash, then handled ready-to-eat bread without gloves. Both were priority violations and a citation was issued. Also noted: a gap larger than 1/4 inch at the rear alley door and unused items that could attract pests.

headline: Unlabeled refrigerated foods; scooping with containers
summary: Several food items inside refrigeration units were not labeled, including bulk containers. Single-use to-go containers without handles were used to scoop food at the service prep cooler. Tongs, spoons or ladles must be used instead.

headline: No certified manager; no inspection summary posted
summary: No person in charge held a valid City sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was on duty while TCS foods were prepared. A citation was issued. The inspection report summary was not posted for the public, and a citation was issued for this as well.

headline: Hot water too cool; sink stoppers missing
summary: Hot water measured 88.8–93.2°F at several sinks. Management must provide over 110°F at three-compartment sinks and at least 100°F at hand sinks, and a citation was issued. Sink stoppers are missing, and rust is on racks in the walk-in cooler.

headline: No written health policy; water too cool to wash
summary: No complete written employee health policy was on site, and a citation was issued. Hot water at the three-compartment and hand sinks measured only 66–95°F. Management was told to keep it above 110°F for dishes and 100°F for hands. Other issues: a metal bracelet worn while cooking and broken floor tiles.

headline: Dirt in prep area floor drains
summary: Accumulated dirt was found inside the prep area floor drains. The interior must be cleaned and kept maintained.

headline: Ice machine interior and wiping cloths need attention
summary: Inspector found the interior of the first-floor ice machine needs cleaning and wiping cloths left on bar counters. Also noted: a leaking bar hand sink faucet, lidless trash cans in a washroom, and floor and wall cleaning needed in several areas.

headline: Live cockroaches and rat droppings found
summary: Live cockroaches were seen under the bar counter, on a kitchen table, and inside a microwave. About 4 rat droppings were found on the basement floor near the chest freezer. A citation was issued, and additional pest control service is needed. Missing handwashing signs and grease were also noted.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; about $500 discarded
summary: Cheese, milk, sour cream and hot dogs were held at 48.7–56.2°F in a display cooler, and about 300 pounds valued at $500 were discarded. The display cooler measured 59.2°F and was tagged. A citation was issued for each. The front door has a 1/4-inch gap.

headline: Clean equipment and seal basement floor opening
summary: The dishwasher, fryer, coolers, prep tables and grease trap need exterior cleaning. Prep area walls and floors must be cleaned. A large opening in the basement floor must be sealed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Dead roaches on glue boards; damaged cooler lid
summary: Two glue boards with dead cockroaches stuck to them were found, and the business was told to remove and monitor them. A main prep cooler has a damaged lid and exposed insulation. A backflow device for the basement ice maker could not be found. Floor tiles are missing, and no allergen training certificate was on file.

headline: Low hot water pressure; no allergen training
summary: Hot water pressure at the three-compartment sink was very low. This is a priority violation, and a citation was issued. A splash guard is needed at the front hand sink, and the women's restroom lacks a covered sanitary receptacle. The certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Cooler too warm; food handlers did not wash hands
summary: A food handler cooked eggs and handled plates without washing hands after handling dirty dishes. TCS foods in a reach-in cooler were at 46.9°F and tagged. About 30 or more live small flies were seen in prep and dish areas, and pest control was recommended. Several citations were issued.

headline: Hair restraints missing; cutting boards and fryers dirty
summary: Food handlers in the kitchen were not wearing proper hair restraints. Cutting boards were stained and deeply cut. Encrusted grease and food debris were under the fryers. Hot water pressure was low at a prep sink. Certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Chicken and falafel too cool; discarded
summary: Cooked chicken at 130.6°F and falafel at 129.7°F were below the 135°F minimum and discarded, about 8 pounds. Hummus, sour cream and tomatoes at 47.9–49°F were also discarded. The high-temperature dish machine was tagged and taken out of use. Other issues included a 1/4-inch door gap.

headline: Mold-like seal and wall grease near three-compartment sink
summary: A mold-like substance was seen on the seal around the three-compartment sink. Walls near the sink and the hood were dirty with grease and dust. The inspector asked for cleaning to prevent possible insect activity. A brighter light bulb was also needed.

headline: Women's washroom lacks covered waste receptacle
summary: The women's washroom had no covered waste receptacle. Management was instructed to provide one.

headline: Unlabeled containers and missing splash guard
summary: Sugar and flour containers were not labeled. A splash guard is needed between a rear hand sink and a prep table. Soda cases were stored on the floor, and a mop was stored improperly. The employee cooler's thermometer is broken.

headline: Food handlers without hair restraints; dumpster overflowing
summary: Food handlers were prepping without hair restraints. A prep cooler gasket is torn, and milk and soda crates are used as shelving. Food debris is in reach-in coolers. The outdoor dumpster lids could not close, and a citation was issued.

headline: Dish machines at 0 ppm chlorine; repaired on site
summary: Two low-temperature dish machines were sanitizing at 0 ppm chlorine. They were repaired on site and reached 100 ppm before the inspection ended, and a citation was issued. Gauges on several machines were not working. Black mold-like substance was found on basement ice machines.

headline: Hand sinks blocked; boxed food stored on floor
summary: Hand sinks in the kitchen were blocked by sanitizer pails and bulk containers, which the person in charge removed during inspection. A paper towel shortage was also corrected. Boxed food was on walk-in and freezer floors and must be raised six inches.

headline: No certified food manager while TCS foods prepared
summary: No certified food manager was on the premises while TCS foods were being prepared. Management was told a certified manager must be present at all times TCS foods are prepared, and a citation was issued.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm chlorine; fish too warm
summary: The bar dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged. Fish at 54.5°F and 55.5°F in a sushi cooler was discarded, about 6 pounds worth about $220. A cooler was at 49.5°F and tagged. There was no vomit and diarrhea kit, and no handwashing signs in restrooms.

headline: Bowls used as scoops; bags reused for food
summary: Small bowls were being used as scoops in a beef container and an oil container. Single-use bags were reused to store rice noodles. A small dark stain was found inside the beverage ice machine and must be cleaned. One of two managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Expired sanitation certificate; debris under bar
summary: The sanitation certificate on site was expired, and a citation was issued. The person in charge was told to get a new certificate and keep it on site. Debris was also found under the bar area and must be cleaned.

headline: Three-compartment sink drains poorly; floods
summary: The three-compartment sink did not drain properly. When one compartment drained, the next one flooded. This was a priority violation, and a citation was issued. Damaged floor tiles in the rear dish area also need repair.

headline: Missing thermometers and water-damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Thermometers could not be found inside prep coolers and must be provided. A walk-in cooler handle is missing. The egg roll cooler exterior must be cleaned to prevent pest harborage. Food handlers lacked certificates, and a certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Food handlers not wearing beard restraints
summary: During this re-inspection, food handlers were not wearing beard restraints. They were told to wear them at all times while preparing food. No other issues were listed.

headline: No certified manager; drains and floors very dirty
summary: No certified food manager was on site while sausage pizza was prepared and served, and a citation was issued. Food residue was in cold-hold units, and drains were heavily soiled. Heavy grime was found in ceiling vents. Earlier floor and food handler training violations were not corrected.

headline: No certified manager on duty; food debris and dust
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were prepared and served, and a citation was issued. Paper towels were missing from a hand sink, and a food handler got one during the inspection. Clutter in a walk-in cooler could attract pests. Floors and vents need cleaning.

headline: Dozens of flies and mouse droppings found
summary: About 40 or more small flies and about 60 or more mouse droppings were found across storage, prep, dish and sales areas. A citation was issued, and pest control was recommended. The person in charge also lacked a certified manager on site.

headline: Dim walk-in lighting; no handwashing signs
summary: The walk-in cooler has inadequate lighting and dark spots on food shelves. A walk-in freezer light is burned out. Employee restrooms lack handwashing signs. The business was told to repair the lights, add more lighting, and post signs.

headline: No pest control logbook or service records
summary: The manager could not provide a pest control logbook or recent service reports, and a citation was issued. Equipment and store items were stored on the floor in a dry storage room. Mops were kept in water buckets, and clutter was found in storage.

headline: Cold foods at 45–48°F discarded; coolers too warm
summary: Several TCS foods were held at 45–48°F, and the manager discarded about $200 of food. Two coolers measured 51°F and 53°F and were tagged. A citation was issued for both. The manager was told all cold foods must be at 41°F or below.

headline: Frozen items thawed improperly; dirty equipment
summary: Frozen items must be thawed under cold running water or refrigeration. Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizing solution. Can openers, prep table legs and shelves, floor drains under prep sinks, and rear prep floors need detail cleaning, and vents need grease cleaned.

headline: Raw steak, fish held at 44–48°F; discarded
summary: TCS foods in the walk-in cooler were at 44–48°F, including raw steak, fish, sour cream and sliced tomatoes. About 20 pounds, valued at $300, were discarded. A citation was issued. Paper towels were missing at prep hand sinks and were provided during inspection.

headline: No certified manager; no food handler training proof
summary: No City-certified food manager was on premises, and a citation was issued. No food handler training proof was provided for any food handlers. Other issues: rusted shelving, a peeling freezer interior, oil boxes on the floor, cracks in the basement floor, and grease in the hood.

headline: Ceiling hole and greasy filters
summary: A hole in the ceiling next to the three-compartment sink must be sealed. Grease buildup was found on the filters above the griddle, and they must be cleaned.

headline: About 15 black flies found; wastewater dripping
summary: About 15 small black flies were noted near the rear prep area, utility sink, dry storage and dining area. A citation was issued, and pest control was recommended. Overhead wastewater pipe drips into the three-compartment sink, and that sink was told to stop being used until repaired.

headline: Missing hand-washing signs; food debris throughout
summary: No hand-washing sign was posted at a prep area hand sink. Bulk containers were not labeled. Food debris and dust were on equipment, coolers, and walls and floors. Stained ceiling tiles and missing baseboards also need repair.

headline: Prep coolers too warm; no health policy verified
summary: Two prep-area coolers measured 50.4°F and 52.3°F and were tagged for inspection. They must stay at or below 41°F. No verifiable employee health policy was on site, but no citation was issued. A certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: No certified manager while chicken prepared; citation
summary: No certified manager was on site while chicken and other TCS foods were prepared, and a citation was issued. An ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine. Black slime was found inside the air conditioner near the soda fountain. Two employees lacked food handler training.

headline: Stained cutting boards and cluttered rear yard
summary: Stained cutting boards were found in the first-floor and basement prep areas and need resurfacing or replacement. Outside the rear of the building, unused carts, tables, mixers and debris were stored. Ceiling vent covers in the kitchen had dust buildup.

headline: Cooler missing thermometer; leaking utility sink
summary: The two-drawer cooler under the flat-top grill had no thermometer, and the inspector asked for one. A utility sink in the storage room was leaking and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Expired food handler certificate; proof requested
summary: A food handler had an expired food handler certificate. The employee must show proof of training for all food handling staff and keep records on file.

headline: Air conditioner drain runs into prep sink
summary: An air conditioner condensate drain line discharges into a one-compartment sink in the rear prep area. The drain must be routed to proper disposal, such as a floor drain.

headline: About 20 live flies; expired training certificates
summary: About 20 small black live flies in the dishwashing area, dry storage, bar, clean glassware shelves and dining area near pre-rolled silverware. Fly activity must be eliminated and areas cleaned. Dried food debris under shelving. Expired food handler certificates.

headline: Cooler thermometer misplaced; front door gap
summary: A cooking thermometer was found inside the reach-in cooler; it was removed and a cold-holding thermometer provided on site. Front door has a 1/4 to 1/2 inch gap at the bottom; repair ordered. Ice and espresso machines lack backflow devices.

headline: Potatoes and rice cooled improperly
summary: Potatoes and rice cooled covered in a two-door cooler; the manager was told food must be uncovered during cooling. Cutting boards with dark stains and open seams in the rear prep area must be refinished or replaced.

headline: About 60 live flies; pest control needed
summary: About 60 or more live small flies on walls, ceilings, brooms, dustpans and in the garbage area, prep and dish areas. About 8-10 large flies also seen. Pest control service recommended. Door gap and debris in garbage area also noted.

headline: No valid manager certificate posted
summary: No valid City of Chicago certified food manager certificate was available or posted. No handwashing sign at sink near the three-compartment sink. Dried food debris on floors and behind heavy equipment must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Allergen training needed.

headline: No handwashing signs; no front prep sink
summary: No handwashing signs at sinks in the front prep and dishwashing/rear prep areas. A prep sink is required in the front prep area for water and waste. Ice buildup in freezer; missing grout and damaged walls need repair. A utility room light is not working.

headline: Cooler too warm; 50 lbs of food discarded
summary: Raw chicken (49.8F), cooked chicken (46.7F) and egg rolls (47.8F) held too warm in the rear two-door cooler; about 50 lbs ($250) discarded. The cooler (53.4F ambient) is tagged and may not store TCS foods until repaired. Handwashing signs missing.

headline: Dish sink not set up to sanitize; corrected
summary: Employee washed dishes without setting up the three-compartment sink to sanitize, with no sanitizer used. Manager had the sink set up with chlorine immediately. Food stored on floors in coolers; dirty wiping cloths; managers lack allergen training.

headline: Base cooler remains tagged; contact health dept
summary: The base cooler in the rear prep area remains tagged. The facility must contact the health department to have a health inspector remove the tag.

headline: Broken paper towel units; dirt and standing water
summary: Broken and rusted paper towel units in the meat prep and service areas must be replaced. Dirt, food debris and spillage under shelving and equipment, standing water between the fryers, and debris and ice in the grocery freezer must be cleaned to prevent pests.

headline: No certified manager; sink overflows; no soap
summary: No certified food manager on site while food was prepared and served. No employee health policy or vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit. Some handwash sinks lacked soap and towels. Three-compartment sink does not drain and overflows. Pest control logbook missing.

headline: Loose floor tiles; chipping ceiling paint
summary: Loose floor tiles on the sales floor and in rear prep and dishwashing areas must be repaired. Chipping paint on the ceiling in front and rear prep areas and the front service counter must be scraped.

headline: No certified manager; about 30 live flies
summary: No valid certified food manager on site while milk, quiche and tuna were prepared. About 30 small black live flies seen throughout the premises, including on food counters and display items. Pest control required. Handwashing sink was used to store milk pitchers.

headline: No person in charge; slimy ice machine; pests
summary: No person in charge present and no certified food manager while rice, chicken and soups were prepared. Ice machine interior heavily soiled with black and grey slime; ice is used for consumption. Dead insects and a trapped mouse in basement; food boxes on floor.

headline: Dish machine sanitizer at zero; repaired on site
summary: The low-temperature dish machine measured 0 ppm sanitizer. A licensed technician repaired it on site; final rinse measured 50 ppm. Priority violation, citation issued. In-use utensils sat in room-temperature water and the ice cream condensate hose drains into a handwashing sink.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; grease and burnt bulb
summary: Torn gaskets on salad prep cooler doors need repair or replacement. Grease, grime and food debris on the fryer and behind the ice machine need cleaning. A light bulb is missing in the hood above the cook line.

headline: Missing floor tile behind cooler
summary: A floor tile is missing behind the reach-in cooler in the rear prep area. The person in charge must repair it and keep the floor smooth and cleanable.

headline: Scoops in food bins; rust, grease, ice buildup
summary: Scoops left inside bulk food containers; wiping cloths stored on prep tables; buckets on the floor. Rusty shelving; excess ice in freezers; leaking faucet; grease and debris on cooking equipment and floors; personal belongings in food areas.

headline: Broken thermometer; syrup stored in restroom
summary: A two-door cooling unit near slushy machines has a broken thermometer; thermometers must be added inside all cooling units. Dessert in the display cooler lacks labels. Snow cone syrup cart was stored in a restroom near the toilet and must be moved.

headline: No lidded receptacle in all-gender washroom
summary: The all-gender washroom has no covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. A covered waste receptacle must be provided.

headline: No splash guard; gasket needs repair
summary: No splash guard at the handwashing sink on the prep line; one must be provided. The gasket on the two-door refrigerator and the front prep area freezer needs repair or replacement.

headline: Hot water too cool; leaks; grease buildup
summary: Hot water was too cool at hand sinks (72.5F-75.1F) and the three-compartment sink (80.5F). Water was restored to 100F and 110F during the inspection; a plumber was on site. Leaks at faucets and drains. Heavy grease and debris on floors and fryers.

headline: Sanitizing in bucket; no proper three-compartment sink
summary: Dishes were sanitized in a bucket after washing in a one-compartment sink. A three-compartment sink large enough for full submersion, or a commercial dishwasher, must be installed. Priority foundation violation; citation issued.

headline: Grease and encrusted buildup; re-inspection
summary: Re-inspection found the grease trap exterior, ovens, fryers and stoves with encrusted grease. Cooking-line shelves and food storage container exteriors need cleaning. Grease and food debris on floors under dry storage and equipment; wall behind cooking equipment greasy.

headline: Freezer off and tagged; storage lights unshielded
summary: The two-door freezer in the rear prep area was not working, is tagged and held, and may not be used until repaired and reinspected. Boxes and equipment stored on floor. Heavy grease under fryers and oven. Storage lights lack shielding.

headline: Ice scoop in ice bag; peeling shelf paint
summary: An ice scoop was stored inside a bag of ice in the freezer; staff were shown proper storage. Peeling paint on reach-in cooler shelves must be sealed. Multiple food handlers lack food handler training certificates and must comply.

headline: Live flies on walls; dirty walls; bulbs out
summary: About 20 live small flies on walls at the bar and 10 on walls in the first-floor dishwashing area. All fly activity must be removed by reinspection. Walls at the bar and dishwashing area are dirty; some ceiling bulbs are burned out.

headline: Freezer ice buildup; missing grout; clutter
summary: Excess debris and ice on the chest freezer must be removed and detail cleaned. Clutter stored on the floor in rear dry storage must be removed to prevent pests. Missing grout and damaged floor tiles in prep, storage and dish areas. Water-stained toilet room ceiling tiles.

headline: No soap at prep sink; rat droppings outside
summary: No soap at the handwashing sink on the main prep line; staff refilled it during the inspection. Rat droppings found outside near the dumpster area, along with crates and snow salt. The area must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Hot and cold foods out of temp; discarded
summary: Grilled onions at 109.9F were discarded (2 lbs). In the grill-area cooler, roasted tomatoes (52.1F), cream cheese (50.0F) and cut greens (46.0F) were discarded. Sauce covered while cooling. Foil and plastic wrap lining equipment surfaces.

headline: Dusty fan covers; leaking faucet; mops
summary: Dirt and dust on fan covers inside the bakery walk-in cooler must be cleaned. The hot water knob on the bakery 4-compartment sink leaks at its base. Mops are stored in buckets and must be hung up to air dry.

headline: Bulk food not labeled
summary: Bulk food such as flour and sugar was found without labels. The manager must label it.

headline: Mop sink next to prep table; hidden backflow
summary: A mop sink is installed next to the prep table in the basement prep kitchen; a barrier must be added between them. The backflow device for the basement ice maker could not be found and must be exposed.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; expired certificates
summary: A torn rubber gasket on the reach-in prep cooler C-1 door must be repaired. Some food handler certificates have expired and must be updated. Some allergen training certificates for City-certified food managers have also expired.

headline: No allergen training for city food manager
summary: No allergen training was on site for the City of Chicago food manager. Management was told all City food managers must complete allergen training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Lettuce past use-by date; allergen certs missing
summary: About 3 lbs of cut leafy lettuce were past their use-by date; both containers were discarded. Expanding spray foam at a baseboard and taped-over wall holes must be sealed. No allergen training proof for City-certified food managers.

headline: Grimy can opener; grease and dirt throughout
summary: A can opener caked with dirt and dark grime could contaminate food when opening cans. Heavy grease and food debris found on cooking equipment, floors and walls; hood filters dusty and greasy. Walk-in dry storage and cooler floors need detail cleaning.

headline: Cannoli shells in cardboard; certificates missing
summary: Cannoli shells were stored in cardboard boxes in the basement; a cleanable container is required. No covered trash receptacle in the basement employee washroom. Several food handlers lack food handler certificates and must show proof.

headline: Ice in walk-in freezer; grease; no trash lid
summary: Ice buildup on the walk-in freezer floor must be repaired. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment must be cleaned. The women's restroom has no covered waste receptacle. Debris around the dumpster and unused equipment in storage should be removed to prevent pests.

headline: No backflow devices at ice and soda machines
summary: No backflow prevention device was found at the ice machine or soda machine. The facility must provide them where they can be located and serviced.

headline: Fried chicken too cool; raw chicken in water
summary: Fried chicken on the service line was 115.0F, below the 135F hot-holding minimum; about 5 lbs ($35) discarded. Raw chicken tenders in standing water in the dishwashing sink (53.2F-56.0F) were discarded: 35 lbs ($150).

headline: Live roaches still on premises
summary: Live roaches still present: adults near office door, under wok line and on a sink drainboard; nymphs on hot-holding line, under cutting boards and in the water boiler. Wok line equipment heavily rusted. Pest control service receipt dated after today required.

headline: Cold raw meat too warm; dirty ice bin, floors
summary: Raw chicken, beef and shrimp held above the 41F safe limit in an upstairs prep cooler (50.2F, 49.8F, 47.4F). Manager discarded 20 lbs ($200). Also: dirty ice bin, unlabeled containers, food stored on floor, dusty floors.

headline: Chickpea salad cooling covered; foil used
summary: Cooked chickpea salad was cooling covered by a lid in the rear cooler; staff told to loosely cover or leave uncovered while cooling. Aluminum foil used as makeshift drip catches at a condensate pipe and cook-line hood; must be replaced.

headline: Hand washing in pot sink; mouse droppings
summary: An employee washed hands at the pot sink; the manager corrected it on site. Handwashing sinks were blocked by a mop bucket and a garbage box; both were removed on request. Over 20 mouse droppings in an air handler and over 40 in prep areas and stairs.

headline: No certified manager while open; many repeats
summary: No certified food manager was on site while open; the manager arrived at the end of the walk-through. No hand towels at sinks until staff bought some. Prior violations not corrected: unlabeled containers, missing splash guard, broken washroom door, dirty ceiling tiles and hood filters.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; basement ice area
summary: Some bulk food containers (flour, sugar) are unlabeled. Basement ice machine area walls and ceiling are not smooth or easy to clean and must be sealed or the machines moved. Floors at the ice machine area are not clean.

headline: Crates used for storage; items on floor
summary: Crates are used for storage in the front closet under the staircase; adequate shelving must be provided. Items on the floor in both bar areas and the front closet must be raised off the floor.

headline: Hand sink blocked; 33 lbs of food discarded
summary: A hand sink in the rear prep area was blocked by a strainer holding poached egg fluid. A two-door cold holding unit measured 50F; food including chorizo, pork sausage and lobster was too warm, and about 33 lbs ($155) was discarded. The unit is tagged and held for CDPH inspection.

headline: No lidded receptacles in gender-neutral restrooms
summary: Gender-neutral restrooms had no receptacles with lids for disposal of feminine products. They must be provided and maintained.

headline: Faucet used for equipment rinsing; pest gaps
summary: A handwashing sink faucet was used to rinse beverage equipment; the three-compartment sink must be used instead. Boxes stored on floor in utility closet. Ice machine lacks a backflow device. Damaged wall and grease and dust buildup also need attention.

headline: No employee health policy; back door gap
summary: No verifiable employee health policy on site; a template was left and copies must be kept on site. A small gap at the bottom of the back door must be repaired. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, coolers and shelves must be cleaned.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; no coolers or mop sink
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on premises. No coolers on premises; coolers must be provided and kept at 41F or below. No pest control logbook. No mop sink with hot and cold water; must be provided.

headline: Dust on washroom ceiling fan
summary: Dust was found on the ventilation fan on the washroom ceiling. Staff were instructed to clean it.

headline: No certified manager while handling beef
summary: No City of Chicago certified manager was on site while TCS foods such as beef and ham were handled, and no certificate was posted. Food handlers lack training. Ice machine panel has debris; deep freezer and fryer cabinets need detail cleaning.

headline: Dish machine at zero sanitizer; cooler too warm
summary: Dish machine final rinse measured 0 ppm chlorine; the machine is tagged and may not be used until repaired. Prep line cooler measured 57.0F; must be kept at 41F or colder. No covered restroom trash receptacle. No written employee health policy.

headline: Deeply stained cutting boards at prep coolers
summary: Cutting boards at the kitchen prep coolers have deep stains and cuts. They must be deep cleaned and restored by sanding and sealing, or replaced.

headline: Over 100 rat droppings; no hot water
summary: Over 100 rat droppings found in prep, dishwashing, dining and serving areas; exterminator required. Front handwashing sink had no hot water (51.6F); must provide at least 100F. Food handler lacked hair restraint; wall openings need sealing.

headline: Dish machine still not sanitizing; held
summary: The high-temperature dish machine is still not sanitizing properly. It remains tagged and held for inspection and may not be used. A handwashing sign is missing at the food prep sink. No citation was issued for the dish machine.

headline: Deeply cut cutting boards; grease on filters
summary: Cutting boards stored above the three-compartment sink at the sushi line have deep cuts and stains and must be restored or replaced. Grease buildup and dust on filters above the countertop fryer must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Vomit kit provided on site; garbage lid missing
summary: No vomit and diarrhea procedure or cleanup kit was on premises; a kit was provided before the inspection ended. A pest service report lacked vehicle info; an updated one was reviewed. A damaged three-compartment sink stopper and a garbage can on the vehicle lacking a lid were noted.

headline: No health policies; leaking sink; door gap
summary: No signed employee health policies or vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure on site. No frozen food equipment provided. Gap at the bottom of the front door could let in insects. Garden hose at mop sink needs a backflow device; a leaky faucet and missing drainboard noted.

headline: Unlabeled ingredients; greasy equipment
summary: Bulk dry ingredients were stored without labels. A kitchen cutting board has deep cuts and stains and must be repaired or replaced. Encrusted grease on all cooking equipment, a shelf with flour and debris, and heavy grease on floors and drains.

headline: No certified manager; milk crates; unlabeled
summary: No valid certified person in charge or food manager on duty while breads, baked goods and coffee were prepared. Milk crates used as storage. Some women's restrooms lack covered receptacles. Dumpster overflowing (employee cleaned it). Dry storage containers unlabeled; ice machine door missing.

headline: Raw beef at 57F; cooked rice at 54F
summary: Raw beef at 57F in the rear prep area and cooked rice at 54F in the rice cooker; cold foods must be held below 41F. Several food handlers lacked hair restraints. Ice scoop stored in chest freezer with ice; plastic cups used as sauce scoops.

headline: Roast beef at 51.2F; 5 lbs discarded
summary: A container of roast beef in the walk-in cooler measured 51.2F. The manager immediately discarded 5 lbs ($25). No proof of food handler training or allergen training was provided for food employees.

headline: Freezer ice buildup; leak; food debris
summary: Ice buildup inside the basement reach-in freezers must be removed and cleaned. Small leak at the rear prep handwashing sink must be repaired. Food debris and spills on floors and surfaces throughout the facility must be detail cleaned.

headline: No written employee health policy on site
summary: No written employee health policy was on site. The facility must establish one and keep verifiable signed copies for all food employees. No covered receptacle was in the washroom.

headline: Food held 24+ hours unlabeled; fly traps
summary: Cooked chicken and egg rolls held over 24 hours without discard dates; manager provided labels during inspection. Some dry goods and spices unlabeled. Scoops stored inside food containers. Fly traps hanging by hot water heater must be removed. Heavy grease on cooking equipment.

headline: Black dirt in ice machine; ice discarded
summary: Black dirt buildup inside the ice machine was dripping into the ice; all ice was voluntarily discarded. The interior must be cleaned by reinspection. Ripped gaskets on prep coolers; bar handwashing sink leaking; grease buildup on floor under fryers.

headline: Hair and clothing rules; mold, dust, ice buildup
summary: Food handlers must wear hair and beard restraints and clothing covering armpits and torso. Paint gallon used as shelf support; mold in caulk at dish sink; dusty vents; ice buildup in freezer; milk crates used as shelving; training proof needed.

headline: Over 100 live cockroaches; cold foods too warm
summary: Over 100 live cockroaches on floors, walls, equipment, cutting boards and in storage in basement prep and dish areas. Basement walk-in cooler at 46F; milk, eggs and dressings at 44F-47F. Dressings past 7-day date; pickled vegetables lack an approved plan.

headline: Food containers not inverted on drying racks
summary: Food containers were not stored properly on drying racks. They must be stored inverted.

headline: Microwave buildup; restroom door closer broken
summary: Buildup inside the microwave must be cleaned. The self-closing device on the restroom door is broken and must be repaired. Debris on the basement floor under the staircase must be organized.

headline: Mouse droppings; food too warm; staff eating
summary: Over 50 mouse droppings along wall bases and behind equipment in the prep area. Chicken at 45.5F-48.4F; 40 lbs ($70) discarded. Two-door unit at 49.6F may not be used until 41F or below. Employees eat and drink at prep area. Standing wastewater with odor in basement.

headline: No person in charge; cold foods too warm
summary: No person in charge present; only a photocopy of the City certificate was on site. Cheese, milk, eggs and other TCS foods at 44F-51.9F in service coolers; 118 lbs ($750) discarded. Service cooler at 51.4F may not be used until 41F or below.

headline: No certified manager while preparing TCS food
summary: No certified food manager was on the premises while cooked rice and chickpeas were prepared. Some prep coolers lack thermometers. Soiled interiors of coolers and freezers; ice buildup on walk-in condenser. Sink cold handle stripped; no covered trash in employee washroom.

headline: No hair restraints; slow drain; no ventilation
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. A slow-draining handwashing sink in the food prep area must be repaired. Dirt and debris along the wall by cooking equipment. No mechanical ventilation for the grills and panini press.

headline: Food debris on equipment and floors; litter
summary: Food debris on the interior and exterior of cooking equipment, holding units, shelving, coolers and freezers. Litter around the dumpster. Missing baseboards under the three-compartment sink and missing floor tiles near fryers. Food debris on floors under equipment and along walls.

headline: Torn gasket on bar cooler
summary: A torn rubber gasket was found inside the prep service cooler at the bar. It must be repaired or replaced.

headline: No handwashing signs; expired allergen training
summary: No handwashing signs at employee sinks. Single-service containers not inverted on front counter. Stained ceiling tiles; men's washroom fan not working. Not corrected: food handler on duty lacked training; manager's allergen certificate expired.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat plantains
summary: Employee touched fully cooked, ready-to-eat plantain with bare hands. Three lbs ($50) discarded. Staff must use gloves, tongs or utensils. Also: uncovered tableware, cutting boards deeply scratched, leaking drain, food debris on floors, and prior violations uncorrected.

headline: Rice at 129F; leaking copper pipe
summary: Rice held at 129F, below the required 135F hot-holding minimum; it was rapidly reheated to 165F. Mineral buildup inside the ice machine must be cleaned. A copper pipe above the three-compartment sink is leaking and must be repaired.

headline: Tuna, chicken and ham too warm; 9 lbs discarded
summary: Tuna (49.2F), diced chicken (47.8F) and ham (47.4F) held too warm in a kitchen prep cooler; manager discarded 9 lbs ($120). The cooler at 50.1F may not be used until reinspected. Wet wiping cloths and missing hair restraints noted.

headline: Meat thawed on counter; plastic bags as containers
summary: Meats were thawed on the kitchen prep table; they must thaw under refrigeration or cold running water. Clean pots stored above the utility sink. Plastic grocery bags used as food containers in freezer and cooler. Allergen training proof missing for one manager.

headline: Foil lining greasy equipment; clutter near washroom
summary: Tin foil used as a liner in greasy cooking equipment; not allowed. An unused refrigerator and cooler must be repaired or removed. Clutter and cardboard boxes in washroom and storage area must be removed to prevent rodent hiding spots.

headline: Certified food manager lacks allergen training
summary: No allergen training was on site for the City of Chicago food manager. Management was told all certified food managers must complete allergen certification and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Ice bins uncovered; grout missing
summary: Three ice bins in Boleo Bar had no lids or covers; lids are required to prevent contamination. Grout is missing between floor tiles in the front cook line of the Boleo prep area and must be replaced.

headline: No employee health policy or training on site
summary: No employee health policy or training was found on site. The facility must set up a health policy and training system and keep verifiable documents on site. Priority foundation violation.

headline: No health policy; sinks blocked; no paper towels
summary: No verifiable employee health policy on site; a template was left. Both exposed handwashing sinks were blocked: one with a light bulb, one with pots. No paper towels at the bar sink. Frozen fish was thawed on the prep table. Two food employees lack training.

headline: No metal stem thermometer; expired certificates
summary: No metal stem thermometer was on the premises; one must be provided to check food temperatures. Pots stored on floors of the walk-in cooler and freezer. Damaged gaskets, a cracked chest freezer lid, and a leaking sink faucet. Food handler certificates were expired.

headline: Rear door gap; torn gaskets; unlabeled bulk
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door sweep must be sealed to rodent-proof the door. Bulk containers in some prep areas are unlabeled. Torn cooler door gaskets must be repaired. Dust on cooler condensers; one food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Unlabeled containers; plastic bags; expired allergen cert
summary: Food storage containers lack labels. Food stored in plastic grocery bags in coolers and freezers. Water-stained ceiling tiles in the women's washroom. The certified food manager on duty had an expired allergen training certificate.

headline: Manager lacks valid certificate; debris under freezers
summary: A manager without a valid City of Chicago food manager certificate was on site while ice cream and cookies were prepared and served. A certified manager must be on site at all times. Dirt and food debris under freezers and shelving must be cleaned.

headline: Allergen training required for certified managers
summary: The manager was told all City-certified managers must obtain allergen training as required, or citations will follow. No other violations were listed in this report.

headline: About 75 mouse droppings; gaps; no pest log
summary: About 75 or more mouse droppings found under crates, along walls, in storage and liquor areas, and on sales-floor shelves near food. A gap at the front door bottom must be closed. No pest control logbook. Clutter and damaged walls also need attention.

headline: No certified manager on duty while preparing food
summary: No certified food manager was on site while tea drinks and sliced fruit were prepared. Food handlers prepped without hair restraints. Paper towels were missing at the front hand sink until staff got some. Soiled wiping cloths stored on prep tables.

headline: New ice machine lacks backflow device
summary: The newly installed ice machine in the rear prep area had no backflow device. It must be installed so it can be located, serviced and maintained.

headline: Pink substance in ice bin; no training proof
summary: Pink substance found inside the top of the ice machine bin; must clean and sanitize. Dirt and food debris on walk-in cooler floor, and dust on vent and light shields. No proof of food handler training for required employees.

headline: Flying insects found; no soap; food too warm
summary: About 35-40 live small flying insects in dishwashing, prep and basement storage areas; pest control recommended. Salsa at 59.4F and 57.4F was discarded (8 gallons). No hand soap at kitchen sink or customer bathroom.

headline: Passed; missing sign, unlabeled container, expired training
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign at the bar handsink. A bulk container in storage is unlabeled. Debris under bar equipment and in prep-area floor drains must be cleaned. The certified manager's allergen training is expired.

headline: Failed; sink backs up, bricks under drain pipes
summary: Failed. Three-compartment sink at the front bar backs up when the faucet runs; priority violation. Bricks and cardboard hold up drain pipes under a sink. An ice and espresso machine water line lacks a backflow device. A splash guard is needed by the handsink.

headline: Passed; stained boards, grease, chipped paint
summary: Passed. Cutting boards in rear prep have open seams and dark stains and must be refinished or replaced. Cooking equipment needs degreasing. Chipped paint in the kitchen and utility closet must be repainted. Reach-in gaskets need cleaning. A burned-out hood bulb must be replaced.

headline: Passed; grease and ice machine buildup
summary: Passed. Grease droplets under the deep fryer, slight buildup on the ice machine interior panel, and grease on the floor near the fryer must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Passed; unsecured equipment, dirty floors
summary: Passed. Hot and cold holding equipment was not properly secured, per city mobile food vendor and shared kitchen rule 7. Floors throughout have accumulated dirt and debris and must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing sign, leaking sink
summary: Passed. Front handsink near the small grill lacks a handwashing sign and leaks under the basin. The certified manager on duty had no allergen training certificate; training must be completed and kept on site.

headline: Passed; entrance gaps, grease, dust, flickering light
summary: Passed. Bottom of the front entrance and side door must be rodent-proofed. Dish machine interior, floor drain with grease and black mold-like buildup, walk-in floors, washroom vent dust, and a flickering light also need attention.

headline: Passed; one employee lacked food handler certificate
summary: Passed. One food employee had no food handler certificate. The manager was instructed to make sure all food employees hold certificates.

headline: Passed; missing hood filters, items outside
summary: Passed. Missing filters at the left end of the ventilation hood must be replaced. Shopping carts, a mop bucket, and cardboard stored outside by the rear door must be removed.

headline: Passed; prep coolers lack thermometers
summary: Passed. Two prep coolers opposite the walk-in coolers had no thermometers inside. The business was instructed to provide them.

headline: Passed; restroom door not self-closing
summary: Passed. The toilet room is too close to the prep kitchen and its door lacks a self-closing device. The business was instructed to install one.

headline: Passed; gap between front doors
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap between the front entry doors must be repaired and maintained to prevent pest entry.

headline: Conditions; hot foods too cool, 51 lbs discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Hot food items at dining area display tables measured 76-121.6F, below 135F. Manager discarded 51 lbs ($400); citation issued. No person in charge or certified manager on duty. Grease and dirt in the rear prep exhaust hood must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; grease inside fryer
summary: Passed. Grease was found inside the cooking fryer. The business must clean and maintain it.

headline: Failed; walk-in at 70F, no pest logbook
summary: Failed. Walk-in cooler measured 70F and must be repaired to 41F or below. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies on site. No pest control agreement or logbook available. Women's toilet room needs closed receptacles. No citations issued.

headline: Passed; missing signs, leaks, cracked tiles
summary: Passed. Missing handwash signs, wiping cloths left on prep tables, a dusty floor fan, a leaking 3-compartment sprayer, a loose rear handsink faucet, and cracked, missing floor tiles at the cooking line must be corrected.

headline: Conditions; handsink lacked soap and towels
summary: Pass with conditions. Front handsink in the prep area had no soap or paper towels; management supplied both during inspection; citation issued. Missing handwashing signs near that sink and in the unisex washroom. Dusty vent in the washroom.

headline: Passed; dish machine and wall debris
summary: Passed. Food debris and dirt built up on the exterior of the low-temperature dish machine and on the wall beside it. The business was instructed to detail clean and maintain these areas.

headline: Failed; 80-100 mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. Dead mouse on a trap under a potato chip shelf was removed on site. About 80-100 mouse droppings were found on the selling floor and in rear storage; citation issued. Pest control service required before re-inspection next week.

headline: Passed; front door gap and dirty equipment
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the front door must be repaired to block pests. Also noted a poor freezer gasket, spills inside reach-in units, and greasy hood filters.

headline: Conditions; cold soup too warm, discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Two containers of potato soup held at 49.5-58.1F in the walk-in cooler were corrected on site and discarded (15 lbs, $70); citation issued. Menu lacked an undercooked-food advisory, corrected on site. Dish racks on floor must be raised.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk containers, door gap
summary: Passed. Bulk flour and sugar containers lack labels and must be labeled with contents. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the rear exit door must be sealed tightly to prevent pests.

headline: Failed; slime-covered ice machine, fly trap over prep
summary: Failed. Ice machine in rear prep had pink and black slime dripping onto stored ice used for consumption; priority violation and citation issued. An electric fly trap hangs over a prep table and must be moved. Rusted racks, a leaking sink, and debris also noted.

headline: Passed; dish machine leak, floor cleaning
summary: Passed. Repair the water leak from the high-temperature conveyor dish machine in the basement. Clean floors under prep coolers and corners, clean debris-covered ceiling tiles in basement prep, and repair flooring under a prep cooler.

headline: Failed; over 30 rat droppings, no certified manager
summary: Failed. Over 30 rat droppings found in the kitchen, chip display area, and rear storage; citation issued and an exterminator was requested. No certified food sanitation manager on site while TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. Food stored on the floor.

headline: Passed; door gaps, leaking sink, damaged tiles
summary: Passed. Gaps between rear exit doors must be repaired to block pests. The front handsink knob leaks and must be repaired. Several ceiling tiles are damaged and must be replaced.

headline: Passed; grease, debris, unlabeled containers
summary: Passed. Food containers lack labels. Wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces must be kept in sanitizing solution. Foods in plastic grocery bags in coolers and freezers, grease buildup, floor debris, and a damaged chest freezer lid must be addressed.

headline: Conditions; cold foods above safe temperature
summary: Pass with conditions. Soup, Alfredo sauce, Caesar dressing, and cut tomatoes were held at 47-55F in prep coolers, above the 41F limit; citation issued. A torn freezer gasket, grease trap exterior, cooler racks, and floors also need cleaning.

headline: Conditions; no signed employee health policy
summary: Pass with conditions. No signed employee health policy acknowledgments on site. The business must provide a health policy with a signed acknowledgment from each employee.

headline: Failed; no pest log, no vomit cleanup procedure
summary: Failed. No pest control log; premises must be serviced by a licensed exterminator. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedures or supplies. No utility sink and no outside commercial dumpster. Missing handwashing sign and cooler thermometers.

headline: Conditions; no vomit cleanup kit on site
summary: Pass with conditions. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on premises; priority violation. Employee washroom door lacks a self-closing device. Raw wood floor behind the front counter needs tile; wall coving is missing; a ceiling tile in the washroom is missing.

headline: Conditions; unsafe food temperatures, discarded, corrected
summary: Pass with conditions. Raw fish, dumplings, and vegetables held at 66F in a cooler; cooked rice at 80F was left overnight. About $200 and 16 lbs discarded and corrected on site. Cooler tagged; citation issued. Also a leaking, clogged sink.

headline: Failed; cooler too warm, no hot water at sink
summary: Failed. Large display cooler held 50.9-58.3F; must be repaired to 41F or below. Washroom handsink had 50.5F water; at least 100F required. No employee health policy, and no procedures or supplies for vomit and diarrhea cleanup. All priority items.

headline: Conditions; no certified food manager on site
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while chicken, hamburgers, and sandwiches were prepared and served. Citation issued. A certified manager must be present whenever TCS foods are handled. Dish machine interior needs detail cleaning.

headline: Passed; food handler and manager training gaps
summary: Passed. Food debris and spills in floor corners must be detail cleaned. One food handler without training was on site; records must be provided. A certified food manager lacked allergen training and must be provided with it.

headline: Passed; door gap, hair restraint, damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the outer front door sweep must be rodent-proofed. One food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. Water-damaged ceiling tiles above the prep area must all be replaced.

headline: Passed; raw wood surfaces, allergen training needed
summary: Passed. Raw wood surfaces behind the bar must be painted or sealed. A backflow device at the utility mop sink must be installed where it can be serviced. Employees with city sanitation certificates need allergen training.

headline: Failed; no soap or towels at only working sink
summary: Failed. The only working handsink had no soap or paper towels; the manager supplied them during inspection. A prep handsink had its P-trap removed and a dish-area sink was clogged; staff told to use the rear sink. Citations issued. Hood needs more ventilation pull.

headline: Passed; signage, thermometers, shelving, cleaning
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs are needed at all handsinks. Thermometers must be visible in reach-in and walk-in coolers. Milk crates used as walk-in shelving must be replaced with raised shelves. Detail cleaning and reorganizing of several areas and the women's washroom.

headline: Conditions; hot food too cool, discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Pasta with hot dogs held at 118.5F in a hot-holding unit, below 135F. Manager discarded 4.5 lbs ($40); citation issued. Food stored on floors, plastic bags in freezers, and no proof of food handler training also noted.

headline: Conditions; no vomit kit, low sanitizer, citation
summary: Pass with conditions. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure on site; citation issued. Bar dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine; at least 100 ppm required (no citation). A repeat allergen training violation from August 2025 was not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Failed; over 100 rat droppings, toilets not flushing
summary: Failed. Over 100 rat droppings found in kitchen prep, basement stairway, and basement dry storage; priority citation issued. Both toilets clogged and not flushing, citation issued. No person in charge or certified manager on duty.

headline: Failed; no hot water, waste spill, overflowing trash
