summary: Multi-use utensils were not inverted during storage. Aluminum foil and cardboard lined storage shelves and must be removed. Ceiling tiles near the warewashing unit have excessive dust.

headline: Three-compartment sink malfunctioning; citation issued
summary: The three-compartment sink does not drain properly; water floods one compartment when another is drained, and a citation was issued. Soda nozzles at the bar had syrup buildup and were ordered cleaned.

headline: Cooler residue and leaking sink fixtures
summary: A black substance was found on shelving inside the rear reach-in cooler, and the drying rack above the three-compartment sink had debris. Leaks at the front hand sink and three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Repeat rodent droppings; no certified manager
summary: Earlier rodent violation not corrected: over 100 droppings were in the basement. Manager cleaned during inspection; notes record a later count of 15-20. Pest control recommended. Certified manager absent on arrival; a food handler lacked a certificate.

headline: Upkeep and labeling fixes; no pests found
summary: No pests were noted, but the dumpster roll-up door has a gap that must be closed tightly. Also required: food labeling, a bar-area thermometer, hand-washing signs, cleaning of grease and debris, and wall, floor and light repairs.

headline: Hair restraint missing; grease buildup on hood
summary: An employee lacked a hair restraint while food was prepared and served. Wiping cloths were left on prep tables, and grease covered cooking equipment, floors and hood filters. Unfinished wood shelving and a cardboard liner need fixing.

headline: Gap under rear door needs sealing
summary: A quarter-inch gap sits at the bottom of the rear exit door near the storage area. The operator must install a tight seal to block pest entry. No pests were noted.

headline: Food handler training certificates not on site
summary: No food handler training certificates were on site for review, and the inspector instructed staff to provide them. The re-inspection passed.

headline: Bulk ingredient container lacks label
summary: A bulk ingredient container was not labeled with its common name. The person in charge was told to label all bulk ingredient containers with common names.

headline: Ice bin needs cleaning
summary: The ice bin interior needed cleaning. Staff were told to remove the ice, clean the bin, and keep it clean at all times.

headline: No hair restraint; washroom fan broken
summary: A food handler was seen without a beard or hair restraint. Walls, floors and cooking equipment need cleaning, and the washroom ventilation fan is not working and must be repaired. A certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: No hot water and clogged front hand sink
summary: Front prep hand sink had no hot water (54.9F) and was clogged; 100F water required (citation). Rear hand sink lacked a sign. Crackers and condiments were stored under the front hand sink; pop cases were in the employee washroom.

headline: Prior violation not corrected; labels missing
summary: Bulk salt and sugar containers were unlabeled, and the walk-in cooler had a dark section. A prior violation for missing interior panels on prep cooler doors was not corrected.

headline: Items stored on floor; unsafe utensil storage
summary: Food containers and single-use boxes were stored on the floor in the second-floor storage area, and in-use utensils sat in stagnant water. Hot dishwasher lacked temperature test strips, and food handler certifications were not provided.

headline: Front door propped open; clutter; sign missing
summary: The front entrance door was propped open because the building has no air conditioning; it must be screened to keep pests out. No handwashing sign in the toilet room, and clutter should be removed and organized.

headline: Hand sink water too cold; sink blocked
summary: Hot water at the rear prep hand sink measured 63F; 100F required. That sink was blocked by a storage rack. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, and single-service items were stored on the floor.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: One certified food manager has no allergen training. Staff were instructed to provide allergen training for all certified food managers.

headline: Rear floors need cleaning
summary: Floors in the rear area need cleaning. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; held for inspection
summary: Dish machine's final rinse measured 0 ppm and is not sanitizing; it is tagged and must not be used until health department reinspection. Front hand sink lacks a handwashing sign.

headline: Cooler and water pressure issues resolved on site
summary: Walk-in cooler in rear prep area read 47.7F and was tagged; items were moved to the freezer. By the end, the cooler reached 40.1F and may be used. A water main break caused low pressure; water was restored by end of inspection.

headline: Mouse droppings found; no spill kit
summary: About 30 mouse droppings were found on equipment and under the utility sink, and openings at the rear exit door need sealing. No vomit and diarrhea spill kit or norovirus spray was on site. Only one of four cold-holding units held 41F.

headline: Cold foods too warm in prep cooler
summary: Cold foods in the one-door prep cooler were too warm: eggs at 60F, tuna salad 44-47F, cheeses and mayonnaise 47F, salsa 50F and sour cream 54F. Cold foods must be 41F or below; a citation was issued. Also an expired food handler certificate.

headline: No hot water at dish sink; gaps; stoppers missing
summary: The dish-area hand sink had no hot water (61.2F), and 100F is required (citation). A quarter-inch gap under the entrance door needs sealing. Single-service utensils were on the floor, and the three-compartment sink lacked stoppers and a test kit.

headline: Cold TCS foods too warm; food discarded
summary: Cold foods including ham, milk, turkey, tuna and cheese were held at 45.7-52.2F. Foods must be at 41F or below. Manager discarded 25 lbs ($150) of food. Rear door has openings that must be sealed; no pests were noted.

headline: Labeling and storage fixes; expired allergen training
summary: Instructed to label food storage containers with common names and clean and reorganize the rear storage area, keeping usable items 6 inches off the floor. The certified food manager's allergen training certificate had expired.

headline: Undated TCS foods in walk-in; uncovered freezer food
summary: Cooked pork, chicken and chicken egg rolls in the walk-in cooler lacked discard or use-by date labels (citation). Freezer food was uncovered. Milk crates used as shelves, dirty shelves and a leaking drain pipe under the three-compartment sink also noted.

headline: Grease buildup on kitchen hood filters
summary: Grease had built up on the kitchen hood ventilation filters. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain them. No other issues were listed.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit or paper towels
summary: No vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit or written procedure was on site (priority violation). The toilet room hand sink had no paper towels. The required no-smoking sign was not posted.

headline: Cardboard liners, milk crates, no training proof
summary: Cardboard liners were on prep equipment and milk crates were used as shelves; both must be removed. Front prep hand sink drains slowly. No food handler training records were available.

headline: Leaks, door gaps, debris, missing certificates
summary: Entry and exit doors have gaps that must be tight-fitting to keep insects out. Several leaks need repair, the dish machine needs de-liming, and debris along walls and floor drains needs cleaning. Food handler certificates were missing.

headline: Clutter in kitchen
summary: Clutter and unnecessary items were noted in the kitchen. Staff were instructed to remove them and keep the area clear.

headline: Food-contact items stored exposed; mop wet
summary: Pots and containers stored upright in rear dry storage had exposed food-contact surfaces and must be inverted or protected. A mop in a bucket by the cooler must air dry between uses.

headline: Dirt and grease buildup in kitchen corners
summary: Dirt and grease had built up in corners and along baseboards throughout the food prep area and under the three-compartment sink. Cleaning is required.

headline: Piping behind fryer is dirty
summary: The piping behind the fryer was dirty and must be cleaned to remove grease and debris.

headline: Floor and hood cleaning needed
summary: Floor behind the front reach-in cooler must be cleaned of debris. Dust on the light shield and ceiling above the dish area and debris in the fryer hood must also be removed.

headline: No certified manager; no soap; unapproved cakes
summary: No valid city-certified food manager was on site while food was prepared (citation). Hand sinks lacked soap and paper towels, and vomit/diarrhea cleanup supplies were missing. Cake slices and whole cakes from unapproved sources were discarded.

headline: No valid certified manager; dish machine at 0 ppm
summary: No person in charge with a valid city food-service sanitation certificate was on premises (priority citation). The low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine; it was corrected on site, tagged held for inspection. Boxes stored on freezer floor; no test kits.

headline: Unlabeled containers and dirty floors
summary: Food storage containers lacked common-name labels; wet wiping cloths sat on prep surfaces. No covered waste receptacle for sanitary napkins, and floors had loose debris, dirt and dust buildup. Instructed to correct and maintain.

headline: Rodent droppings found; 80+; pest control needed
summary: Over 80 mouse droppings were found on floors, under prep tables, behind the three-compartment sink and in the rear storage area. Pest control service is recommended before reinspection next week (citation). Bulk containers in pizza prep lacked labels.

headline: Knives stored improperly; corrected on site
summary: Knives were stored improperly behind a prep table; the manager corrected this on site. Other items: rust and torn gaskets, missing covered toilet-room trash can, litter at the compactor, and floor and hood cleaning.

headline: Multiple priority violations; ice machine slime
summary: Black slime dripped from the rear dish-area ice machine onto ice for consumers. Paper towels and hand soap were missing at some sinks, and a 2-door prep cooler was not working. Menu lacked the required raw-food advisory.

headline: Unsafe hot and cold foods discarded; certificates missing
summary: Quiche and croissants held at 79-83F in the bakery display, and whole milk at 48F in the walk-in cooler; the person in charge discarded both. Employee health policies and food handler certificates were missing. Hair restraints were not worn; salmon was thawed improperly.

headline: Splash guard, self-closing doors, trash cans needed
summary: A splash guard is needed around the prep counter hand sink. Washroom doors need self-closing devices, and unisex washrooms need small lidded trash cans. The ceiling fixture over prep must be sealed.

headline: Missing food handler certificates; ice machine dirty
summary: No record of a food handler certificate for kitchen staff was on file; all kitchen staff must obtain one. The ice machine interior had a gray film needing cleaning, and an ice scoop holder pooled water.

headline: Live roaches found; pest control required
summary: Two live roaches were seen crawling on a prep-area wall and on the floor under the ice machine, with several dead roaches on floors throughout. Pest control must service the premises on or after 7/17/25. Also leaking pipes at the three-compartment sink.

headline: Grease debris between cooking equipment
summary: Accumulated grease and debris was found between cooking equipment. Staff were instructed to clean it.

headline: Dirty slicer, freezers, and cluttered front area
summary: The deli meat slicer was dirty and must be detail cleaned and sanitized. Freezers must be defrosted and cleaned, reach-in coolers and shelving cleaned, and clutter in the front area removed.

headline: Bulk ingredients stored without labels
summary: Large containers of bulk ingredients were not in original packaging and lacked labels. The person in charge was told to label all bulk containers and keep them labeled.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; unit tagged
summary: Low-temperature dish machine measured 0 ppm chlorine, so it was not sanitizing; it is tagged and held and may not be used. Salt and sugar lacked labels, and an ice scoop was left on the machine.

headline: Splash guard needed; debris in cooler and ice machine
summary: A splash guard is needed at the hand sink beside the main prep counter. Debris must be cleaned from the beer reach-in cooler, the ice machine's interior panel, and the coffee area countertops.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; rodent-proofing gap
summary: Handwashing signs are missing in prep areas and washrooms. The front entrance door has a half-inch gap that must be made rodent-proof; no pests were noted. Also unlabeled containers, a rusted shelf, ice in freezer, and water-damaged ceiling tiles.

headline: No certified food service manager on site
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while chicken and beef were handled and served. These are TCS foods, which must be kept hot or cold. Manager was instructed to obtain one; priority violation cited.

headline: Employee toilet stall lacks a door
summary: The only stall in the men's employee restroom is missing its door. The manager must ensure all stalls self-close and lock. The manager said employees may use single-occupant restrooms in front of the building.

headline: Duct tape on pipe under sink
summary: Duct tape was wrapped around the pipe leading to the floor drain under the three-compartment sink. It must be removed and the surface kept smooth and cleanable.

headline: Handwashing sink misused; no food prep sink
summary: A food handler rinsed a coffee canister at the handwashing sink; that sink may be used only for handwashing (citation). No food prep sink at the coffee bar; sugar bulk container unlabeled; inadequate lighting over the three-compartment sink.

headline: No certified manager; hot water and soap missing
summary: No city-certified manager on site while chicken, a TCS food (kept hot or cold), was prepped. Restroom sink lacked hot water (64.5F), prep sink had no paper towels, bar sink had no soap, and no sanitizer test strips.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: A certified manager on duty had no allergen training. Staff were told to obtain the certificate and keep it on site.

headline: Food spills and debris throughout kitchen
summary: Food spills and debris were found on the interior and exterior of prep tables, shelving and coolers. Debris also lay on floors under equipment, along walls and in corners in prep, storage and dishwashing areas. Manager instructed to clean.

headline: Grime on shelves and mop-sink floor
summary: Grime and residue built up on shelving in the dry-storage glass cabinets. Debris and grime sat on the floor under the mop sink in the rear prep area. The person in charge was told to clean and maintain both.

headline: Re-inspection: food debris and missing certificates
summary: Food debris and spills were found in cooling equipment, and floors had debris. No food handler certificates were on site, and the manager lacked allergen training. Instructed to comply.

headline: Storage containers and toppings need labels
summary: Food storage containers and toppings above the prep cooler must be labeled with the common name of each food item and kept labeled.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; items on floor
summary: Handwashing signs are missing at the coffee station and rear prep sink. Wiping cloths were on prep tables, ice scoops sat on the ice machine, items were stored on the floor, and a washroom lacked a covered waste receptacle.

headline: Vacuum packaging without approved HACCP plan
summary: Vacuum packaging machine was on site without an approved food safety plan (HACCP) or health department variance. The plan and approval letter must be available on site for city review.

headline: Missing thermometers; unlabeled containers; debris
summary: Reach-in cooler in the prep area and basement standing coolers lacked thermometers. Flour, sugar and garbanzo bean containers were unlabeled. Debris and trash sat on floors along walls; a damaged ice bin lid and containers need replacing.

headline: Cold foods too warm; cooler restricted
summary: Salsa at 51.8F, salad dressings 50.1F, coleslaw 53F, yogurt 51F and sausage patties 44.3F were too warm. Manager voluntarily discarded 16 lbs ($125). Prep-area service cooler at 50.2F must not be used until it holds 41F or below.

headline: Passed on re-inspection: ice machine and cooler cleaning
summary: Ice machine interior needs detail cleaning. Cutting boards are needed at salad and pizza sections. Cooking equipment sides and reach-in cooler gaskets need detail cleaning. A leaking P-trap at a 1-compartment sink and an unisex toilet need a cover.

headline: Conditional pass: cooler at 52°F, unit tagged
summary: A 2-door cooler measured 52°F, above the 41°F limit. No food was inside. The unit was tagged and held for inspection until repaired. Prep area lighting is also inadequate.

headline: Passed: floors need cleaning
summary: Floors under the dishwashing machine and inside the walk-in cooler need cleaning, including along the wall base.

headline: Passed: missing handwashing signs and covered receptacle
summary: Employee restrooms are missing handwashing signs. The unisex staff restroom has no covered receptacle for feminine hygiene products. Peeling caulk above the cook kettle. The food sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Failed: rodent activity, about 50 mouse droppings
summary: About 50 mouse droppings on the kitchen floor, along a wall, on boxes, and on a desk. One dead small rodent found on a trap. Additional pest control service needed. Used charcoal and cluttered outdoor storage must be removed.

headline: Failed: no vomit cleanup kit, no pest log or service
summary: No procedures or kit for cleaning vomit or diarrhea on site. No pest control log book or service contract. No handwashing sink in the rear warewashing area. No food thermometer and no utility sink on site.

headline: Passed on re-inspection: walls and ceiling not smooth
summary: Walls and ceiling in the basement dry storage area are not smooth and easy to clean, and must be made so.

headline: Passed: no thermometer, hair restraints, food handler proof
summary: The rear right reach-in cooler has no thermometer. Employees in the prep area were not wearing hair restraints. Food handlers lack proof of required training. The certified manager has no allergen training certificate.

headline: Failed: no health policy, leaking pipe, sewage not draining
summary: No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site. A pipe leaks under the only handwashing sink. Wastewater does not drain properly from the MFP unit. No recent inspection summary posted.

headline: Passed on re-inspection: hot holding thermometer and cleanup
summary: Hot holding unit thermometer is broken and none is inside. Food not covered in coolers and prep areas. Worn cutting boards and grease buildup on equipment. No lighting in the rear storage area. Missing food handler and allergen training.

headline: Failed: hand sink doubles as dump sink
summary: A hand-washing sink was also being used as a dump sink, with a dump sink directly below it. The manager was told to use it only for handwashing and must remove the dump sink. Citation consolidated with a prior violation.

headline: Passed: incomplete food handler training proof
summary: Food handlers have incomplete proof of training; those without a City of Chicago sanitation certificate must complete an approved program. Rubber gasket on walk-in freezer door is broken. Rusty racks in walk-in cooler.

headline: Passed: loose hot water knob and broken hand sink
summary: A hand sink on the grill station is broken and must be repaired; staff must use the sink on the left until then. A loose hot water knob at a prep sink must be fixed. Cutting boards have open seams and deep stains.

headline: Passed: missing sink stoppers, cooler interiors dirty
summary: The 3-compartment sink is missing stoppers and must have working ones. Interiors of reach-in coolers need detail cleaning.

headline: Conditional pass: no health policy, no vomit cleanup procedure
summary: No employee health policy and no vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure on premises. Gap at the rear exit door sweep must be rodent-proofed. Missing stoppers for the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Conditional pass: no health policy, restroom upkeep
summary: No employee health policy was on site. The restroom door does not self-close, and the all-gender restroom has no toilet seat lid.

headline: Failed: moldy ice machine, leaks, gaps at doors
summary: Black mold-like buildup and rust inside the ice machine dripping onto ice; ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned. Gaps at two exterior doors. Leak at the 3-compartment sink. Damaged wooden baseboard creating a hole.

headline: Failed: dish machine too cool, flies and a roach
summary: Dish machine final rinse measured 155°F; 160°F is required, and the machine was tagged. More than 20 small flies found throughout, plus one live roach in the dish area. Floors and walls have debris and soil buildup.

headline: Passed: rear door gap, food handler without hair restraint
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door sweep must be sealed. One food handler lacked a hair restraint. A loose mop sink faucet must be tightened or repaired.

headline: Passed on re-inspection: thermometer, labels, hair restraints
summary: Walk-in cooler outer thermometer is not working and needs fixing or an interior thermometer. Unlabeled condiment bottles, food handlers without hair restraints, and rust on storage racks. Broken floor tiles in the rear prep area.

headline: Conditional pass: no city sanitation manager on site
summary: No City of Chicago food service sanitation manager or valid certificate was on site. A valid certificate must be on site at all times. A citation was issued.

headline: Failed: no hot water at hand sinks, long fingernails
summary: No hot water at any hand sink; water measured 86°F, and 100–120°F is required. Food employee and manager fingernails were about an inch long and were not trimmed.

headline: Passed on re-inspection: cutting boards and clutter
summary: Cutting boards in the kitchen have deep cuts and stains; they must be sanded and sealed or replaced. Northeast storage closet is cluttered and must be cleared to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Passed: food stored on floor, hole in basement ceiling
summary: Food containers stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler must be elevated six inches. Wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces. Hole in basement ceiling with water leaking through.

headline: Failed: over 60 mouse droppings, live mouse activity
summary: At re-inspection, over 60 mouse droppings were found in several areas, plus live mouse activity under a desk and shelving. A prior priority violation was not corrected. A licensed pest control service is required. The east restroom sink lacks cold water pressure.

headline: Failed: live cockroaches and flies, pest control needed
summary: Live cockroaches found in the bar, including one inside a bar hand sink. About 40 small flies in bar, dining, prep, and basement areas. Pest control service required. Soiled towels and mold-like buildup on a beer cooler.

headline: Passed: missing sink stoppers, broken fan
summary: The 3-compartment sink is missing stoppers on the left side. A washroom exhaust fan is broken. The certified manager has no allergen training certificate.

headline: Passed: ice cream machine gasket, freezer cleaning
summary: The gasket on the ice cream machine's reach-in cooling unit is broken and coming loose. The walk-in freezer floor and the area under and behind the ice cream station need detail cleaning to prevent pests.

headline: Conditional pass: no health policy, soap missing in restroom
summary: No signed employee health policy was on site. The men's restroom sink had no soap, and the manager locked the only extra restroom, leaving one single-person restroom open. The certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Failed: no hot water, hot food too cool
summary: Restroom hand sinks had no hot water, measured 67–68°F; 100–120°F is required. Chicken in a self-service case measured 90.2–109°F and was discarded, about 20 lbs ($100). Hot food must be held at 135°F or above.

headline: Conditional pass: food held too cool, cooler partly broken
summary: Meatballs held at 72°F and various cold foods at 49–55°F. Manager discarded about 13 lbs of turkey, roast beef, and cheese ($200). A 3-door cooler has one door at 53°F and is tagged. No certified manager on site.

headline: Passed: truck labeling, screens and cutting board
summary: The truck needs the license number on both sides in 2-inch or larger letters. Service windows need screens when not in use. A new large cutting board is needed at the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Passed: no covered receptacle in customer restroom
summary: The unisex customer restroom has no covered waste receptacle for feminine hygiene products. The operator must provide one.

headline: Conditional pass: cooked chicken held too cool
summary: Five lbs of cooked chicken held at 94.3°F on the grill top, below the 135°F minimum; discarded, about $20. Basement food prep sinks, shelves, and meat slicer need cleaning. Ice maker backflow device not located.

headline: Conditional pass: cleanup kit missing, buildup throughout
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies on site. Crates used for food storage must be removed. Food debris and dust buildup on shelves and equipment. Stained ceiling tiles and broken floor tiles near the rear door.

headline: Conditional pass: biryani rice and fish left too warm
summary: Biryani rice measured 77.9–78.6°F in the walk-in cooler and fish 79.8–80.1°F. About 40 lbs ($270) were discarded. Also missing handwashing signs, no thermometers in coolers, and food handlers lack training proof.

headline: Conditional pass: no certified manager, pest and cleanup gaps
summary: No manager with a valid City of Chicago food certificate was on site. No vomiting/diarrhea cleanup kit. Food stored on floors. A hand sink leaks from the hot water handle.

headline: Conditional pass: no employee health policy
summary: No employee health policy was on site. The manager was instructed to provide one.

headline: Passed on re-inspection: grease and floors cleaned
summary: At re-inspection, grease buildup inside the deep fryers, between ovens, and behind cooking equipment in the rear prep area must be cleaned. Floors behind and under the cooking equipment also need cleaning.

headline: Failed: pink buildup in ice machine, door gaps
summary: Slight pink buildup inside the ice machine. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door sweep. A reach-in cooler door gasket is not tight. Prior grease, debris, and dirt on floors in several areas were not corrected.

headline: Conditional pass: no handwashing soap at front prep
summary: No handwashing soap at the front prep area behind the registers; soap must always be provided. Debris and residue in all floor drains. The certified manager has no allergen training certificate on site.

headline: Passed: deep freezer ice buildup, missing lightshields
summary: Excessive ice in the deep freezer must be removed. Light shields are missing near the 3-compartment sink and must be provided.

headline: Passed: unlabeled containers, dirty walls
summary: Prep area bulk food containers are unlabeled. The women's restroom has no covered trash receptacle. Grease and food buildup on prep and dish area walls.

headline: Conditional pass: no certified manager while preparing milk
summary: No certified manager was on site while TCS items such as milk were being prepared. An employee holding a valid City of Chicago manager certificate must be on site at all times.

headline: Passed: hair restraint, cooler interior, food handler certificate
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. The interior of the reach-in cooler is not clean. A food handler has no food handling certificate.

headline: Passed: grease and food debris on floors
summary: Grease and food debris must be cleaned from the floors under the grill and in the food prep area.

headline: Conditional pass: chicken too warm, 25 lbs discarded
summary: Chicken inside the two-door refrigerator measured 50.1–52.5°F, above the 41°F limit. The manager voluntarily discarded about 25 lbs ($300) of food. A citation was issued.

headline: Failed: no hot water in rear restrooms
summary: Men's and women's rear restroom sinks had no hot water; measured 50°F, and at least 100°F is required. Priority violation cited. Also a damaged cooler lining, dust on a cooler fan, and no allergen training copy.

headline: Conditional pass: no certified manager on site
summary: No City of Chicago certified manager was on site while open and operating. Sanitizer dispenser and cord under the 3-compartment sink are leaking, creating a pool of water on the floor.

headline: Passed: restroom doors not self-closing
summary: The unisex restroom doors are not self-closing. The inspector instructed the operator to provide the correct door closers.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, sink not set up correctly
summary: No certified manager was on site while open; a copy was shown and an official manager arrived later. An employee washed dishes without setting up the 3-compartment sink; the manager corrected it on the spot. Sanitizer test strips were the wrong type.

headline: Failed: no vomit kit, no pest log, no waste contract
summary: No kit or procedure for cleaning vomit or diarrhea on site. No pest control logbook or contract. No record of a waste disposal contract. The 3-compartment sink drains slowly, and no utility sink was found on site.

headline: Passed: unused cooler cannot hold temperature
summary: A reach-in cooler at concession 116 could not hold 41°F or lower, with the room at 57°F. It must not be used until serviced. Stained cutting boards, greasy fryers, dirty floors, and dusty ceiling tiles were also noted. The CFM's allergen certificate expired.

headline: Failed: hot water too cool, no training proof
summary: Hot water at 4 of 7 toilet room sinks measured 69.2°F; it must be at least 100°F. Also no proof of food handler training, no posted inspection summary, cutting boards damaged, and food not properly labeled.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings, no certified manager, hand-washing lapse
summary: About 40 or more mouse droppings found on a pallet of cooking oil. No certified manager on duty while meat and chicken were handled. A worker handled his phone and food without washing hands. Many cleanliness and upkeep issues were also noted.

headline: Passed: ice scoop holder needs cleaning
summary: The ice scoop holder at the front service line was not clean. The inspector instructed staff to clean and maintain it.

headline: Conditional pass: steam table too cool, food discarded
summary: Refried beans, gravy, rice, and chicken soup held at 107.6–131.7°F in the steam table, below the 135°F minimum. All foods discarded. Steam table tagged and must not be used until repaired. Slow drain and ceiling pipe leak.

headline: Conditional pass: hot food left on counter, uncooled, no summary posted
summary: Cooked chicken, gravy, and fried chicken on the counter at 90.2–100°F with no temperature control; about 30 lbs ($100) discarded. Thawing at room temperature, no health policy, and no inspection summary posted. Many repairs listed.

headline: Failed: about 100 mouse droppings, no valid manager certificate
summary: About 100 mouse droppings found throughout the facility, including near the oven, under shelving, and inside the walk-in cooler. No valid City of Chicago manager certificate was on site. Pest control and cleaning are required.

headline: Failed: cold food too warm, handwashing water too cool
summary: Cold food held at 45.0–59.4°F, above the 41°F limit; manager discarded about 87 lbs ($415) of food on site. Handwashing sink water measured 70.5–70.9°F, below the required 100°F. Cooler at 54.5°F. Grout missing under a sink.

headline: Failed: no certificate, no thermometer or pest log
summary: No City of Chicago food sanitation certificate was posted. No metal probe thermometer, no sanitizer test strips for the 3-compartment sink, and no pest control log book were available. Four priority violations were cited.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings, no certified manager, thawing at room temperature
summary: About 40 mouse droppings found in the front and rear prep areas. No valid City of Chicago manager certificate on site. Food was thawed at room temperature. No food handler certificates were on site for employees.

headline: Failed: 30 fruit flies, unlabeled bulk containers
summary: Thirty fruit flies on walls by the mop sink; pest control is needed to eliminate them. Bulk flour, sugar, and other containers are unlabeled. Floors and drains by the mop sink are not clean.

headline: Failed: slimy buildup dripping from ice machine
summary: Black slimy substance inside the ice machine was dripping into ice used for drinks. Management was told to turn off the machine, discard ice, and clean and sanitize it. Front door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom.

headline: Passed: certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: The certified food manager has no allergen training certificate. Management was told any person with a City of Chicago sanitation certificate must comply with allergen training.

headline: Passed: entrance gap, trash and dust issues
summary: An opening at the base of the front entrance door must be sealed. No covered receptacle in the employee restroom. Cardboard and debris on the ground around the dumpster. Dust on walls and ceiling vents.

headline: Failed: roach infestation, dish machine too cool
summary: About 50 or more live roaches on cooking equipment and floors, plus about 40 small flies. Dish machine at 110°F, but 180°F is required; it was tagged. Cold food up to 65.7°F was discarded. Pest control needed.

headline: Passed: ice cream well frost, soda nozzle syrup
summary: Ice cream well has heavy frost buildup and must be defrosted. Ice machine interior has light calcium buildup. Soda nozzles have syrup buildup. Grease receptacle exterior needs cleaning.

headline: Failed: flies throughout, overflowing outside garbage
summary: About 26 small flies found in bar, dining, prep, and basement areas. Outside garbage receptacles are overflowing; they must be closed at all times. Black mold-like caulking above the 3-compartment sink. A rusted grease trap bottom.

headline: Passed: labeling, hair restraints and grease cleanup needed
summary: Unlabeled bulk dry ingredients, a food handler without a hair restraint, and wiping cloths left out on prep tables. Grease buildup at the fryer and hood filters. Certified managers lack allergen training proof.

headline: Failed: scalding hot water at prep sink, leaks
summary: Hot water at the prep area hand sink measured 158.4°F, above the 120°F maximum, and no cold water was provided. Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables. Leaks under a hand sink and at the 3-compartment sink. Stove not under hood.

headline: Passed on re-inspection: dead roaches, duck thawed in water
summary: Dead roaches on the floor near bulk dry ingredient containers in the rear prep area must be removed. A whole duck was thawed in a bowl of water in the service sink. Three sink stoppers are missing.

headline: Failed: rat droppings, trash, no certified manager
summary: Six rat droppings found on cardboard and debris behind paint cans, with a foul odor possibly from something dead. Access was limited by clutter. No certified manager on duty while TCS foods were handled. Outside grounds have a large amount of trash.

headline: Passed: broken hot water faucet, no allergen certificate
summary: A hot water faucet at the kitchen hand sink is broken and must be repaired. The sanitation manager has no food allergen training certificate.

headline: Passed: garbage vehicle lacks lid
summary: The garbage vehicle had no lid. The inspector instructed the operator to provide and maintain one.

headline: Failed: low-temperature dish machine lacks chemicals
summary: A low-temperature dish machine had no sanitizing chemicals, so it was not ready for inspection and must not be used until fixed and reinspected. No pest control log book on site. Soap dispenser broken at a hand sink.

headline: Passed: chickpeas cooled improperly, raw food in bags
summary: Chickpeas were cooled improperly; hot food must be uncovered to cool correctly. Raw lamb and vegetables were stored in single-use bags. No proof of allergen training for City of Chicago food managers on site.

headline: Passed on re-inspection: dust and damaged floor tiles
summary: Dust and debris on the washroom fan, window ledges, pallets, and floor ledges in sales and basement areas. Damaged floor tiles in sales and storage areas must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Conditional pass: cold food too warm, cooler failing
summary: Shrimp, beef, chicken, pork and tofu held at 47.8–54.3°F, above the 41°F limit; manager discarded about 5 lbs ($18). A 3-door prep cooler reads 54.1°F and stays tagged until repaired. Missing food handler and allergen training noted.

headline: Conditional pass: no certified manager while prepping chicken
summary: No City of Chicago certified manager was on site while chicken was being prepped. No food handler training proof for any employee. Milk crates used for shelving, which can hide pests. No allergen certificate on site.

headline: Failed: missing sinks, hot water too cool, gaps at doors
summary: No hand sink with hot and cold water at the front dining prep station, and a bar hand sink is not connected. Restroom hot water measured 89.6°F; 100°F is required. Gaps at doors allow insect entry. No health policy on site.

headline: Failed: live roaches in walls above dish sink
summary: Three live roaches were found in walls at the dish area above a 2-compartment sink. All roach activity must be removed by reinspection, and a pest control operator is advised. Debris on dish area walls.

headline: Passed on re-inspection: door gap, food debris
summary: Gap at bottom of the front entrance door must be sealed. Outside garbage area has old equipment and construction materials that could harbor pests. Food debris and spills throughout, and kitchen hood filters need detail cleaning.

headline: Conditional pass: no soap or paper towels at sinks
summary: No soap at the prep and dishwashing hand sink; corrected on site when the manager provided soap. No paper towels at the bar hand sink. Soiled wiping cloths on bar tables. The manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Failed: no certificate on vehicle, no pest log
summary: The person in charge had only a copy of the certificate on his phone, not the original on the vehicle. No employee health policies or pest control log book on the vehicle. Food handlers lack required training on the vehicle.

headline: Passed: raw wood shelving needs sealing
summary: Raw wood shelving in the rear warewashing dry storage area must be sealed or painted to be smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Conditional pass: no certified manager during food prep
summary: No City of Chicago certified manager was on site while breakfast sandwiches and eggs were being prepared and served. A certified manager arrived during the inspection at 11:15 AM. A citation was issued.

headline: Passed: broken men's room sink, floors dirty
summary: The right hand sink in the men's restroom does not produce water and must be repaired. Oversized rice bowl needs a written clean-in-place procedure. Aluminum foil on sushi prep equipment must be removed. Floors in liquor room need cleaning.

headline: Passed: small leak behind ice machine
summary: A small leak was found behind the ice machine and must be repaired.

headline: Passed: unlabeled grab-and-go wraps and sandwiches
summary: Prepackaged wraps and sandwiches lack required labels. Interior surfaces of deep fryers, ovens, woks, and reach-in coolers are soiled. Floors and drains under the main cook line are soiled.

headline: Passed: beer residue on bar floors
summary: Beer residue on the floors and corners at the front bar area. Staff must detail clean the floors and increase cleaning frequency.

headline: Failed: no manager certificate, no health policy, pest-free not shown
summary: No City of Chicago sanitation certificate and no written employee health policy on site. Sanitizer not detected at final rinse in both low-temperature dish machines. No test strips and no allergen training certificates. Previous inspection summary not posted.

headline: Failed: pink slime in ice machine, bees and ants
summary: Pink slimy buildup inside a large ice machine was dripping onto ice for people to consume. About 50 bees and 30–40 ants were found in prep areas and on the front counter. Food was stored in milk crates. Stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Passed: employee eating in kitchen, unused grill dirty
summary: An employee was eating in the kitchen and must eat in designated areas. An unused grill has heavy food and grease buildup and must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, cold food too warm, no soap
summary: No person in charge with a valid certificate on site. Chicken and pasta in the front prep cooler measured 53.4°F and 52.7°F; cold food must be 41°F or below. Hand sink lacked soap, which staff obtained during inspection. Missing consumer advisory.

headline: Passed: basement storage cluttered
summary: Basement storage area is cluttered and hard to clean. Items must be elevated six inches off the floor to avoid pest harborage.

headline: Failed: no pest log, no test strips, no dumpster
summary: No pest control logbook on premises. Gap at the rear exit door sweep. No sanitizing test strips on site. No outside dumpster or dumpster contract. No food handler certificates or allergen certificates on premises.

headline: Conditional pass: deli cooler too warm, 50 lbs discarded
summary: Chicken measured 48.0°F and milk 48.1°F in display coolers, above the 41°F limit. Manager voluntarily discarded about 50 lbs ($300). The deli cooler was tagged and must not be used until reinspected. Floors and walls need cleaning.

headline: Passed: floor debris and wet mop storage
summary: Dirt and food debris on floors in front prep areas under cooking equipment, and on walls behind the soda machine. A wet mop stored in a bucket must be hung to dry.

headline: Failed: no thermometer, sink pressure still low
summary: No ambient air thermometer inside cold holding units. Three-compartment sink water pressure still not compliant. Incorrect plate number on vehicle. Cold holding unit doors lack protection while moving. No lidded receptacle.

headline: Grab-and-go packaged food needs labels
summary: Prepackaged food in the front grab-and-go cooler needs labels showing the product and its ingredient list. No grease trap is installed at the three-compartment sink; one must be installed and maintained. This was a re-inspection with a pass result.

headline: Over 40 mouse droppings; doors not rodent-proofed
summary: Over 40 mouse droppings were on rear storage shelves and near potato chips. Cleaning and pest control service are required before reinspection, and a citation was issued. Two rear doors and the front door were not rodent-proofed; the owner began repairs during the inspection.

headline: Missing handwash signs; debris in prep area
summary: Restroom handsinks lack handwashing signage and must have it. Bulk sugar and flour containers are unlabeled. Grime is on the bottoms of prep tables, debris is in the prep floor corners, and blown hood light bulbs must be replaced.

headline: Exposed rodent traps; basement clutter
summary: Exposed snap rodent traps are under basement dry storage racks and must be enclosed to prevent contamination from fluids expelled when rodents are caught. Basement clutter and unused equipment must be removed, and items must be raised six inches off the ground.

headline: About 80 rodent droppings across facility
summary: About 80 large rodent droppings were found in dining room, bar, prep, dry storage, basement and office areas. Pest control service is recommended before reinspection, and a citation was issued. Thermometers were broken and food was stored on the floor.

headline: Ice scoop on stained towel; dirty fryers
summary: A damp wiping cloth was on the prep cooler, and an ice scoop sat on a stained paper towel atop the basement ice machine. Fryers and ovens are dirty inside, and the three-compartment sink's sanitizer side is clogged. Floors in several areas have dirt and debris.

headline: Dead water bugs in basement; openings at door
summary: Dead water bugs were found throughout the basement, and the facility must remove them. Openings at the base of the rear exit door must be sealed. A vent in the men's washroom was dusty, and one manager's allergen training had expired.

headline: About 21 live flying insects in several areas
summary: About 21 live small flying insects were on walls and ceilings in the coffee prep, dishwashing, rear prep and Sabroso prep areas. A prior priority violation was not corrected, and a citation was issued. This was a re-inspection with conditions.

headline: No health policy or food handler certificates
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site; a template was left and signed copies must be kept. Sushi was served without a sushi letter or pH test device. No food handler certificates were on site, and pantry areas on floors 30–32 lack prep sinks.

headline: Summary report not posted for customers
summary: The most recent inspection summary report was not posted where customers can see it. A citation was issued. The current report must be kept visible to the public at all times.

headline: No certified manager; about 170 rodent droppings
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site while pizza, burgers and beef were prepared. Handwash sinks lacked hot water. A cooler read 51°F and was tagged out. About 170 large rodent droppings were found; pest control was ordered.

headline: No health policy; expired allergen certificate
summary: No written employee health policy was on premises; a citation was issued. The front prep handsink in the basement needs more water pressure. A light shield over the dish machine is broken, and coffee station lighting is inadequate. A repeat core violation was noted.

headline: Black dirt in ice machine; all ice discarded
summary: Black dirt buildup inside the ice machine was dripping into ice used for human consumption. The manager must clean the interior and maintain it. All ice inside the machine was voluntarily discarded; this was a priority foundation violation.

headline: Utensils blocked handwash sink; plants overhead
summary: Utensils in the prep-area handwash sink blocked hand washing and were removed; a priority citation was issued. An additional handwash sink is needed in rear prep, or the swinging door must be removed. Live potted plants above prep must be removed.

headline: No drainboard; mop sink lacks backflow device
summary: The three-compartment sink has no drainboard for drying utensils and equipment. The mop sink has no backflow prevention device. Ceiling tiles are water-stained, and floors, shelves and walls are dirty. Mops must be hung for air drying.

headline: Food debris behind equipment; no training certificate
summary: Food debris was behind heavy equipment in front of the prep area and must be removed, cleaned and sanitized. A food employee was handling food without a training certificate and was told to provide one.

headline: No thermometers in walk-ins; washroom fans broken
summary: Walk-in coolers and freezers have no visible thermometers. Openings at the base of the revolving entrance door must be sealed against pests. Second-floor washroom doors lack self-closing devices, and their ventilation fans do not work.

headline: Over 50 rodent droppings; cold milk at 46°F
summary: More than 50 rodent droppings were found in the basement; pest service is required and a citation was issued. Milk and cream cheese were held at 46°F and discarded; a citation was issued. Restroom sinks reached only 85°F hot water.

headline: Loose metal thresholds at walk-in doors
summary: Metal thresholds at the walk-in cooler and walk-in freezer are in poor repair and must be reattached. Ceiling vents above the cooking ovens had dust and must be cleaned. This was a complaint inspection with a pass result.

headline: No certified manager while handling pastries
summary: No valid City-certified manager was on duty while milk-based coffee and pastries were handled; a citation was issued. The person in charge has no certificate. Rear prep floors need cleaning, and allergen training is required for all certified managers.

headline: Peeling prep table coating; cracked faucet
summary: A plastic coating on the bottom of a prep table is peeling and must be removed so the surface is smooth and cleanable. A bathroom faucet is cracked and damaged and must be replaced.

headline: Unlabeled packaged food and greasy fryer
summary: Packaged cheesecake and rice pudding lacked proper labels. Grease was found inside the fryer, a mop was not stored to dry, and vents were dusty. The person in charge was told to correct each item.

headline: No City-certified manager while handling cheese
summary: The person in charge had no City sanitation manager certificate. No certified manager was on premises while cheese and sausage were handled, and a citation was issued. The electric pizza oven is not under a hood and needs approval.

headline: No certified manager; prep sinks not hot enough
summary: No City-certified manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared; a citation was issued. Prep handsinks reached only 90.6°F and 79.7°F, so staff were told to use the washroom sink. No food handler proof, and a missing sign was a repeat violation.

headline: Gap under rear door; expired training certificates
summary: A light gap at the bottom of the rear exit door could allow rodent entry, so it must be sealed. An employee's food handler certificate and the allergen certificate were expired. One bulk container was unlabeled.

headline: Blocked handwash sink; missing soap and signs
summary: A front prep handwash sink was blocked by stored bowls and utensils, which were removed during the inspection. Other sinks lacked signs, and one had no soap until soap was provided before the end of the inspection.

headline: No certified manager; summary report not posted
summary: No certified food manager was on site with the original certificate while open; a citation was issued. No food handler certificates were on site. The previous summary report was not posted; a new one was given and posted, and a citation was issued.

headline: No written employee health policy on premises
summary: No written employee health policy was on the premises. The facility must provide a signed employee health policy for each employee and maintain it. This was a priority foundation violation; the result was pass with conditions.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site
summary: No kit or procedure for vomit or diarrhea cleanup was on site. A front prep handwash sink was off for repairs, and another lacked hand soap. Duct tape was used on a cooler, and a restroom door did not self-close.

headline: Heavily soiled floors under deep fryers
summary: Floors under deep fryers and other equipment along the main cook line are heavily soiled with grease and dried food debris. The manager was told to clean under equipment often enough to prevent buildup.

headline: Dirty ice machine interior; ice discarded
summary: The ice machine has excessive brown and black substance on its interior panel and chute, and the ice is used for human consumption. The ice must be disposed of, the machine cleaned and sanitized. A citation was issued.

headline: Missing handwash sinks in bar and prep areas
summary: No handwash sinks were found in the front bar or rear prep areas, and a citation was issued. About 2.5 lbs of oysters lacked the required 90-day shellfish tag; a citation was issued. Gaps at the rear door and unlabeled containers were also noted.

headline: Spills and food debris inside reach-in coolers
summary: Accumulated spills and food debris were found inside reach-in coolers in the prep area near cooking equipment. The inspector instructed the staff to detail clean and maintain them.

headline: No certified manager while lasagna prepared
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site while lasagna was prepared and served; a citation was issued. The person in charge lacked proof of food safety training. An employee drink was on a prep table, and a handsink drainpipe leaks.

headline: Missing handwash sign; dirty dish machine exterior
summary: The handsink in the meat preparation area has no handwashing signage and must have it. The exterior of the dish machine is not clean and must be cleaned. This was a complaint inspection with a pass result.

headline: Uncovered food and food stored on floor
summary: Uncovered food sits in a prep cooler by the grill and needs food-grade lids. Soda stored on the front floor must be raised six inches. Containers lack labels, the ice machine is covered with a garbage bag, and rust was found on the grease trap.

headline: Greasy stove and wok station; no food handler proof
summary: Grease and food buildup on the 2-burner stove and wok station must be cleaned. Several food handlers lacked food handler certificates. Management was told all food handlers must show proof of training.

headline: Yellow wiping cloths on prep surfaces
summary: Yellow wiping cloths were stored on several prep table surfaces. The facility was instructed to provide sanitizing buckets to hold wiping cloths in sanitizing solution between uses to prevent contamination.

headline: Knives stored on wall; expired allergen training
summary: A basement walk-in cooler has no ambient thermometer. An employee was in the prep area without a hair restraint. Multiple knives were stored on a wall between pipes near the flat-top grill and must be stored properly. The manager's allergen training had expired.

headline: Front doors not rodent or insect proofed
summary: The front two doors, inner and outer, are not rodent- or insect-proof and must be made so. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints, and a ladies' restroom trash can has no lid. Floors in corners, under equipment and in the walk-in need cleaning.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: A certified food manager has no current food allergen training. The manager was instructed to comply with the requirement.

headline: Standing water under cooking equipment
summary: Standing water was on the floor behind and under cooking equipment and must be removed. Dishwasher, cooler interiors, floor drains and vents need cleaning. Valid food handler certificates must be provided for all handlers.

headline: Shelving buildup and floor drain residue
summary: Buildup on shelving in the walk-in cooler must be cleaned. Residue on kitchen floor corners around the dish machine and heavy buildup in a large floor drain must be cleaned. This was a re-inspection with a pass result.

headline: Leaky drainpipe; kitchen floors need cleaning
summary: A leaky drainpipe under one kitchen compartment sink must be repaired. The floors along the walls and in all corners of the kitchen must be detail cleaned and maintained.

headline: Slimy ice machine; cold food discarded
summary: Black slime in the ice machine was dripping into ice used for people to eat. Raw chicken measured 44.2–45.7°F in a walk-in cooler, and about 78 lbs of food worth $520 was discarded. The cooler was tagged; a citation was issued.

headline: Holes in rear wall; food handler proof missing
summary: Holes in the rear wall by the rear door must be sealed and kept smooth and cleanable. A food handler on site had no proof of required training and must obtain a valid food handler certificate.

headline: Front door not closing fully
summary: The front door does not close completely and must be repaired and maintained. A pink film was forming on the upper interior panel of the ice maker and must be cleaned.

headline: Employee eating in food prep area
summary: An employee was eating in the food preparation area; eating must take place in a designated area outside it. Bowls and plastic containers at the serving line must be stored inverted.

headline: Hot dogs thawed on counter; knives stored improperly
summary: Frozen hot dogs were thawed on the countertop and must be thawed under refrigeration, cold running water or as part of cooking. Knives were stored between a prep table and cooler. Rusty shelves are lined with plastic and cardboard. No allergen training was found for a manager.

headline: Missing handwash sign; loose handsink
summary: The sink in the lower-level preparation area had no handwashing signage, which must be provided. A handsink was not fastened properly and must be repaired.

headline: About 60 mouse droppings; citation issued
summary: About 60 mouse droppings were found in several areas, including near the three-compartment sink and in rear storage. The person in charge must remove them, sanitize the areas and inform the pest control technician. A citation was issued.

headline: Clutter stored on basement floor
summary: Unused articles and equipment were stored on the floor of the basement storage area. This could attract pests. The manager was told to remove all unused items.

headline: Cardboard floor mats; greasy floors
summary: Cardboard used as floor mats in the dish and rear prep areas must be removed. Grease, food debris and dirt are on floors under equipment, along walls and in corners in prep, dishwashing and storage areas. The manager was told to clean them.

headline: Missing paper towels; cold food discarded
summary: Handwash sinks in the kitchen prep area, waiter station and bar had no paper towels; a citation was issued. Condensation dripped onto freezer food. Cold foods at 45–59.3°F were discarded, about 91 lbs worth $900, and a walk-in cooler measured 48.5°F and must not be used.

headline: Front door gap; no covered washroom trash
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the front entrance door sweep must be made rodent-proof. Washrooms have no covered trash receptacles, which must be provided. Dust on dishwash-area walls must be cleaned, and certified managers lack allergen certificates.

headline: Splash guards needed; peeling paint and grout
summary: Splash guards are needed between a handwash sink and countertop, and between a prep sink and the three-compartment sink. Floor grout in front food prep must be redone, and peeling paint on a rear prep wall must be repainted.

headline: Mouse droppings in dry storage; citation issued
summary: About 15 mouse droppings were under shelves in dry storage corners; pest control service was recommended and a citation was issued. The Patriot oven interior is heavily soiled with burned food. Restroom trash cans lack covers, and no food handler certificates were shown.

headline: Washroom fan broken; repair waiting on parts
summary: An inoperable washroom ventilation fan was found. The manager was told to repair it, and the repair is waiting on parts. The site has one other working washroom for five employees.

headline: Cold food up to 54°F; over 60 flies found
summary: Crab meat, bean sprouts, broccoli and sushi were held at 50.6–54.4°F; about 10 lbs worth $25 was discarded, and a citation was issued. Over 60 small flies were found, and licensed pest control must service the facility on or after 11/4/2026.

headline: Greasy fryers; food debris under equipment
summary: Grease buildup was on the inside and outside of the fryers and must be cleaned. Food debris was under all equipment, along walls and in corners of prep and storage areas. The manager was told to clean and maintain.

headline: No health policy; no vomit cleanup procedure
summary: No signed employee health policy and no cleanup procedure or supplies for vomit and diarrhea were on site. Outdoor rear yard clutter, including abandoned cars and a trailer, must be removed to prevent rodent harborage. A garbage can is needed in the unisex restroom.

headline: No health policy; ice machine heavily soiled
summary: No employee health policy or training was on site; a citation was issued. The ice machine interior is coated with black and gray slime dripping onto ice used for people to eat; a citation was issued. Scoop handles touch food in bins, and both certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Cold food up to 61°F discarded; citation issued
summary: Egg rolls, rice, beef, chicken and shrimp in the front reach-in cooler measured 50.9°F to 61.0°F. About $1,000 worth was discarded, and a citation was issued. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, and certified managers lack allergen training proof.

headline: Restroom trash receptacles lack covers
summary: Family and employee toilet rooms have no covered receptacles, and the inspector instructed the facility to provide them. No allergen training certificate was provided for managers, who must meet the requirement. This was a re-inspection with a pass result.

headline: Leaking drainpipe; dirt buildup throughout
summary: A drainpipe at the three-compartment sink in the rear prep area is leaking and must be repaired. Dirt and dust have built up on floors, walls and corners throughout the facility, and must be detail cleaned.

headline: Slow-draining sink; food debris behind sink
summary: The middle compartment of the three-compartment sink drains slowly and must drain quickly. Items under the staircase closet must be raised off the floor or removed. Food debris on the wall behind the three-compartment sink must be cleaned.

headline: Water-damaged ceiling tiles; no handler proof
summary: Water-damaged ceiling tiles at the exhaust hood must be replaced. No proof of food handler training or certificates was found for employees, who must provide it.

headline: Green slime in ice machine; raw beef thawed at room temperature
summary: A green substance inside the ice machine must be cleaned and sanitized. Raw beef was thawing at room temperature and must be thawed under cold running water or in a refrigerator. Scoops were stored in dry containers, and onions were stored on the floor.

headline: Frozen fish thawing in sink
summary: Frozen fish was thawing in the sink. The manager was instructed to thaw food under cool running water or inside a cooler.

headline: No certified manager; handsink blocked; food discarded
summary: No City-certified manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared; a citation was issued. A rear handsink was blocked by a food container and cleared during inspection. Grilled onions and peppers held below safe hot temperatures were discarded; a citation was issued.

headline: Restroom doors not self-closing; openings near fixtures
summary: Basement and first-floor washroom doors lack self-closing devices. Openings around plumbing and electrical fixtures in basement food prep and dry storage areas must be sealed.

headline: Food debris on equipment; no food handler training
summary: Food debris and spills are on beverage machines, shelving, coolers, cooking equipment and sinks. Clutter in prep and storage areas must be removed. Employees lack food handler training, and a citation was issued.

headline: Restroom missing handwashing sign
summary: The toilet room was missing handwashing signage. The inspector issued a handwash sign from the office and instructed the facility to provide and maintain one.

headline: Rusty walk-in shelving; dirty basement drain
summary: Rusty shelving in the walk-in coolers must be removed, repainted or resealed. A dirty basement floor drain at the grease trap must be cleaned. This was a canvass inspection with a pass result.

headline: Utensils in warm water; no food handler proof
summary: Cook-line utensils were stored in water at 87.8°F. Hot-water storage must stay at 135°F or higher, or utensils must be stored clean and washed every four hours. Stored items must be raised off floors, and tape was used to repair a blender.

headline: No health policy or food handler proof on site
summary: No written employee health policy was on site, and no proof of food handler training was shown for any food handlers. Allergen training proof was also missing for certified managers. Records must be kept on site. No citation was issued.

headline: No health policy; food held too warm; citation
summary: No written employee health policy was on site, and a citation was issued. Chicken wings measured 121°F in a food display cooler, and about 5 lbs worth $30 was discarded; a citation was issued. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door must be sealed.

headline: Handsink blocked by buckets; citation issued
summary: Large buckets blocked the front cold-prep handwash sink. The person in charge removed them during the inspection, and a citation was issued. Staff lacked hair restraints, wiping cloths sat on prep tables, and a washroom ventilation fan is inoperable.

headline: Dirty ice machine; broken mop sink backflow device
summary: The ice machine's interior top is not clean, and the ice is used for human consumption; it must be cleaned and sanitized. Dry food containers need common-name labels. Cutting boards are stained and cut, and the mop sink backflow device is broken.

headline: Gap at dumpster door; no food handler proof
summary: An opening at the base of the rear exit door to the dumpster area must be sealed. Aluminum foil shelf liners must be removed. The men's washroom door is not tight-fitting, and tape and cardboard cover walls and ceiling. No food handler proof was shown.

headline: No certified manager during food preparation
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while potatoes, pasta and turkey were prepared; a citation was issued. Restroom sink hot water reached only 87.1°F, below the required 100°F. Health policies and food handler training were also missing.

headline: Unlabeled containers; food and debris on floors
summary: Food storage containers lacked common-name labels. Open food boxes in the basement were dusty, and boxes, pots and plates were stored on the floor. Pallets are used as shelving, and a condensate line drains into a bucket instead of a floor drain.

headline: Held unit; ice machine interior needs cleaning
summary: The unit remains held for inspection. The ice machine interior needs detail cleaning, and new cutting boards are needed in the salad and pizza sections. A leak at a one-compartment sink P-trap and a missing employee restroom cover must be fixed.

headline: Uninverted single-use containers; no allergen training
summary: Single-service containers in the prep area were not inverted and must be inverted. Dust is on a washroom ventilation fan. A core violation from a prior report was not corrected: food managers have no allergen training, and a citation was issued.

headline: Raw wood shelving and soiled cardboard in cooler
summary: Raw wood shelving inside the walk-in cooler must be sealed to be smooth and cleanable. Soiled cardboard trays on chip display shelves and cardboard on walk-in cooler shelves must be removed and the trays replaced.

headline: No grease trap found; uncovered restroom trash
summary: The person in charge could not locate a grease trap, which must be provided and maintained. A unisex restroom garbage can has no cover. Black wall base is in disrepair, and ceiling paint in the hallway is peeling.

headline: Missing prep cooler thermometers; plastic wrap stoppers
summary: The ice machine's interior panel has slight residue that must be cleaned. Prep coolers are missing thermometers and must have them. Plastic wrap is used as stoppers at the three-compartment sink and must be replaced with proper stoppers.

headline: Raw beef stored over cabbage; food discarded
summary: Raw beef was stored directly on top of fresh cabbage and vegetables in a reach-in cooler; those foods were removed. Prepared foods lacked date labels and were discarded, and a citation was issued. Torn cooler gaskets and grease buildup were also noted.

headline: Manager certificate shown on phone only
summary: The person in charge had no physical City food service manager certificate and showed one on a phone. A citation was issued; an original physical copy is required. Grill, fryers, cooler interiors and fan guards need cleaning.

headline: No splash guard; restroom trash has no lid
summary: There is no splash guard between the handwash sink and the three-compartment sink. The restroom garbage can has no lid and must be replaced with one that has a lid.

headline: Unapproved pork belly drying; 12 lbs discarded
summary: Pork belly was hung to dry without an approved variance or food safety plan, at 68–70°F. About 12 lbs worth $68 was discarded; a citation was issued. An ice scoop and a tea container were stored inside the ice machine.

headline: Ice scoop buried in ice at drive-thru
summary: An in-use ice scoop was stored with its handle buried in ice in the drive-thru ice machine. The scoop must be relocated so handles stay outside the food. Dried food debris was also found inside the topping cooler.

headline: Utensil stored between cooler and steam table
summary: A utensil was stored between a reach-in cooler and a steam table, and the manager was told to store it in a clean, sanitized container. A small leak at the prep handsink, with a leaking hot water handle, must be corrected.

headline: Cold-hold units lack air thermometers
summary: Cold-hold units have no ambient air thermometers, and the person in charge must place them inside all cold-hold units. Items stored on the sales floor must be raised at least six inches off the floor.

headline: No certified manager while handling potatoes
summary: No City-certified manager was on site while potatoes and sausage were handled, and no certificate was posted; a citation was issued. The prep handsink was blocked by equipment and a mop bucket, both removed during inspection. Sour cream containers were reused for storage.

headline: Handsink water too hot; over 100 small flies
summary: Handsink water measured 147.7°F and 169.9°F, but the maximum is 120°F. Over 100 small flies were found throughout the facility; pest control was recommended and a citation was issued. Missing soap was corrected on site. No health policy or food handler proof was shown.

headline: Single-use trays on floor; no food handler training
summary: Disposable meat trays were stored on the floor and must be raised six inches. A utility sink in rear storage is clogged, and spills and debris are on floors. Dust is on display cases, coolers and freezers. No food handler training was found for employees.

headline: Rust on prep table; floors need deep cleaning
summary: Rust was found on a bottom shelf of a prep table where pizza boxes are stored. The inspector told the restaurant to restore a smooth, cleanable surface. Kitchen floor and baseboards need deep cleaning.

headline: Missing handwash signs; uncorrected prior violations
summary: Lower-level handsinks lack handwashing signage, and no splash guard is between the grease trap and ice machine. Food handlers lack training certificates. Prior violations were not corrected, including a missing mop sink backflow device and manager allergen training; a citation was issued.

headline: Hair restraints and trash lids needed
summary: Food handlers in the prep area were not wearing hair restraints. Preset tableware was not covered, and restroom trash receptacles lack closed lids. Floor drains and floors under cooking equipment need cleaning, and walk-in fan covers are dusty.

headline: Damaged gasket and stained ceiling tiles
summary: Damaged door gasket on a hot holding unit must be repaired. Buildup around soda and coffee machine nozzles and dispensing areas must be cleaned. Stained and damaged ceiling tiles in the cafeteria dishwashing area must be replaced.

headline: Unlabeled cakes and cookies; dirty floors and hood
summary: Sliced cakes and cookies in the display case lacked ingredient labels; labels required. Dirt and debris under shelving in the rear prep area. Hood filters had grease and dust buildup. Instructed to clean and maintain all areas.

headline: Toilet room door not self-closing; floor residue
summary: Toilet room door is not self-closing; a self-closing device must be installed. Residue buildup on the floor under the three-compartment sink must be cleaned.

headline: Missing hand-sink signs; leaking faucet
summary: Hand-washing signs missing at basement and kitchen prep sinks. Backflow device missing at basement utility sink. Loose faucet at employee restroom hand sink. Dirt and debris buildup on restroom exhaust vent.

headline: Door gap, grease buildup, and uncovered utensils
summary: Gap under the front door must be sealed to prevent insect entry. Wiping cloths must be kept in sanitizer. Preset glasses and silverware must be upright and uncovered. Grease and debris on equipment and floors, and a burnt-out hood light.

headline: Flour unlabeled; rear door gap; greasy hood
summary: Restroom hand sinks lacked handwashing signage. Flour in large pots was unlabeled. Rear exterior door is not tight-fitting on the sides and bottom. Food debris in cold-holding units. Hood system greasy with no filters. Allergen certificate expired.

headline: Sink blocked by rice; no certified manager
summary: No certified food manager on site while salmon and sushi rice were prepared and served; citation issued. Front hand sink was blocked by rice containers during prep until removed. No food handler training proof. Boxes stored on floors; clutter in basement.

headline: Deli meat held over 7 days; vacuum packing unapproved
summary: 10 lbs of deli meat in walk-in cooler had discard dates of 3-17-24 and 4-1-24; cold food may not be kept over 7 days. Vacuum packaging of food held over 48 hours had no variance; machine tagged and process must stop. Bulk flour and sugar unlabeled.

headline: Missing and stained ceiling tiles; clutter on floor
summary: Missing ceiling tile panels in rear prep and stained tiles in the prep area must be repaired or replaced. Clutter stored on the floor near the rear dish area must be removed to avoid hiding places for pests.

headline: Over 50 mouse droppings in dry storage
summary: Over 50 mouse droppings were on shelves under the front counter and on the floor in dry storage. Manager was instructed to call an exterminator and clean all areas; citation issued. Also noted: dust and food debris, and no backflow device on utility sink.

headline: No certified food manager during chicken service
summary: No person in charge and no City-certified food manager were on site while chicken was prepared and served. Citation issued. Plates were not stored upside down, a hand-washing sign was missing, and single-use items were stored on the floor.

headline: Food debris on front prep area floor
summary: Accumulated food debris was on the floor in the front prep area. Person in charge was instructed to detail clean the floors and maintain them.

headline: Mouse droppings and dead mouse in furnace room
summary: About 30 mouse droppings were on the floor and furnace base in the rear furnace room, plus a small dead mouse behind the furnace. Chest freezer with food was in a customer hallway; must be locked. Certified manager's allergen certificate expired.

headline: Worn door weather strip; floors need cleaning
summary: Weather strip on the left side of the exit door needs repair. Soap dispenser in the toilet room needs repair. Floors under rear shelving and under front service equipment need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods served
summary: No person in charge with a valid City sanitation certificate. No certified food manager on duty while chicken and steak were prepared and served; citation issued. Certified manager lacks allergen training; documentation must be provided.

headline: 80 lbs raw steak held at 48°F; no manager
summary: About 80 lbs of raw skirt steak at 48°F in a refrigerator was discarded ($820). No certified food manager on site while tacos and empanadas were served; citation issued. Food handler lacked a hair restraint. Staff toilet door not self-closing.

headline: Cooler interiors and floors need cleaning
summary: Prep cooler interiors must be cleaned to remove spills and debris. Floors under the three-compartment sink and inside the walk-in cooler and freezer need cleaning.

headline: Gaps in doorway and stained ceiling tile
summary: Large containers in dry storage were not stored upside down. Cooler gasket was repaired with tape and must be properly fixed. Large gaps at the rear storage doorway must be sealed. Stained ceiling tile near the cooler must be replaced.

headline: About 35 mouse droppings in rear storage
summary: About 35 mouse droppings in rear storage, behind chest freezers, on storage racks, and under shelves. Additional pest control service needed; priority citation issued. Also: unlabeled food containers, no splashguard by rice, floor drain leaking in bar.

headline: Bar dish machine not sanitizing; buildup
summary: Bar low-temperature dish machine sanitizing at 0 ppm chlorine; priority violation. Bar utensils must be washed, rinsed, and sanitized in the three-compartment sink meanwhile. Food buildup on dish machine drainboards and walls.

headline: License number missing from truck
summary: Business license number was not shown on the truck. Person in charge was instructed to print the license name on the side of the truck, at least 2 inches tall, in easily visible color and font.

headline: Missing hand-sink signs; broken thermometers
summary: Bar hand sinks lacked handwashing signage. Inoperable thermometers at the walk-in freezer and upright cooler. Bulk dry food unlabeled. Beard restraints missing; cardboard and plastic wrap on shelving; kitchen sink faucet leaking.

headline: Condensation dripped onto uncovered cooked chicken
summary: Condensation dripped onto uncovered cooked chicken in the refrigerator. Food was discarded; cooked food must be covered to prevent contamination; citation issued. Cardboard and debris clutter near the mop sink, rear storage, and chest freezers must be removed.

headline: Over 60 mouse droppings; pest service required
summary: Over 60 mouse droppings under the three-compartment sink, under a prep table, next to cooking equipment, and inside the furnace closet. Areas must be cleaned and pest control must service the premises before re-inspection. Priority citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; leaks; ice machine slime
summary: No certified manager or written employee health policy on site. Rear hand sink leaked, pooling water into the walk-in cooler; use stopped until repaired. Black slime in the ice machine dripped onto ice. Toilet overflowing.
