headline: Dish machine leaks onto floor during wash
summary: High-temperature dish machine is in poor repair and leaks directly onto the floor during the wash cycle; must be repaired or replaced. Floors beneath the front service line equipment are soiled with dried food debris and grease.

headline: Over 80 mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: Over 80 mouse droppings on shelves, inside fryer cabinets, around the water heater, and in the furnace room. Manager was told to call an exterminator. No valid sanitation certificate or person in charge on site. No food handler or allergen training; no hot water at rear hand sink.

headline: Cold foods held at 48-58°F; $3,000 discarded
summary: About 55 gallons of milk products at 53-58°F in a reach-in cooler. About 473 lbs of cold foods at 48-54.8°F in a display unit were discarded ($3,000). Walk-in and reach-in coolers at 55°F were tagged and held. Thermometers were missing.

headline: Food prepared without certified manager present
summary: TCS foods were prepared without an original City-certified food service manager or certificate on site; citation issued. Milk cooler lacks a thermometer. Food stored on dairy cooler floor and containers unlabeled. Grease, dust, and debris on floors and vents.

headline: About 28 rodent droppings found in prep area
summary: About 28 small rodent droppings were under the sinks and heavy equipment in the rear prep area, near the bait box. Pest activity must be eliminated; citation issued. Rear exit door is not rodent-proof. Storage and floor repairs also needed.

headline: Cardboard containers, damaged cutting board
summary: Cardboard containers must be stored upside down to protect from overhead contamination. A damaged, stained cutting board at the prep line must be replaced. Food residue and dust in walk-in cooler; grease and debris under cooking equipment.

headline: Many cold foods at 48-59°F; cooler replaced
summary: Cooked rice, soup, cheese, sauces, and other cold foods held at 48.6-59.4°F in a two-door reach-in cooler; about 21 lbs ($250) discarded. Unit tagged; owner provided a new cooler now at 39°F. Employees lacked beard and hair restraints. Rusty shelves.

headline: Drain flies in dining room and dish area
summary: About 30 drain flies on dining room walls, 20-30 inside the mop closet, and 15-20 at the dish area three-compartment sink. Pest control service recommended; priority citation issued. Also: unlabeled bulk items, wiping cloths on splash guards, dirty floors.

headline: Ice scoop stored in ice; wet mops in bucket
summary: Ice scoop was stored with its handle inside the ice; handle must be up and out of the food. Wet mops were stored in a bucket in the rear utility area; mops must hang to dry when not in use.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods prepared
summary: No valid City-certified food manager on duty while steak, chicken, and beans were prepared and served; citation issued. Cook lacked a food handler certificate; person in charge lacked allergen training certificate. Floors need cleaning; light shields missing.

headline: Wet wiping cloths on prep tables
summary: Wet wiping cloths were stored on top of prep tables and coolers; they must be stored in sanitizer when not in use. Metal top missing from the backflow device on the mop sink faucet. Ventilation fan in the first-floor washroom is not working.

headline: Rear door gaps; missing allergen proof
summary: Rear screened exit door has 1-inch gaps on the top, sides, and bottom; a tight seal is required. Stored items must be raised off floors. Floors dirty under pizza ovens and in walk-in coolers. No proof of allergen training for certified managers.

headline: Clutter in prep area; food spills in cooler
summary: Clutter in the kitchen prep and dishwashing area must be organized. Minor food spills inside a prep cooler and gaskets in the main prep area must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Grease and debris in bar; allergen training missing
summary: Dried food debris on bar walls, which must be cleaned to prevent pest harborage. Excessive grease and food debris on floors under fryers and bar equipment. Hood has grease, dust, and dirt buildup. Person in charge could not show allergen training.

headline: Employee beard unguarded; cooler lid soiled
summary: Employee with a long beard had no beard guard; one must be worn at all times when preparing food. Back lid of the service prep cooler had food debris and must be cleaned.

headline: Rear hand sink in poor repair; leaks found
summary: Rear prep hand sink is in poor repair and drains very slowly; staff were told to use the front sink 15 feet away. Food handler needs an effective hair restraint. Front cooler gaskets are worn and torn. Leaks at a three-compartment sink faucet and proofer oven.

headline: Blank employee health policy; no self-closing door
summary: Blank copies of the employee health policy were on site; signed copies must be kept. A 90-day grace period was given for priority violations. Washroom door has no self-closing device; one must be installed.

headline: Floors under prep table need cleaning
summary: Floors under the food prep table were in need of cleaning. Person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Small faucet leak; dusty ceiling vent
summary: Small leak at the faucet neck of the three-compartment sink in the dishwashing area; repair ordered. Light dust on the ceiling vent in the serving area; cleaning ordered.

headline: Gasket in poor repair; men's restroom sink leaks
summary: Gasket on a cold prep cooler is in poor repair; repair ordered. Leak at the bottom pipe of the men's restroom hand sink; repair ordered.

headline: Food stored on floor in storage areas
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor in storage areas. Manager was instructed to store food at least six inches off the floor on raised shelving to protect it from contamination.

headline: Salad cooler too warm; food discarded
summary: Cold foods in the prep salad cooler measured 46.9-49.9°F and must stay at 41°F or below. Manager voluntarily discarded about 15 lbs ($120). Cooler air reached 52.2°F; unit tagged and cannot be used until repaired and re-inspected.

headline: Food waste on ground; waste bins overflowing
summary: About 7-10 refuse bags of food waste were on the ground at the outdoor enclosure; outdoor receptacles overflowing with lids open. Both are priority violations; citation issued. Loose faucet at second-floor hand sink. Floor under three-compartment sink soiled.

headline: No consumer advisory; no pest control log
summary: Menu lacks a consumer advisory for raw or undercooked animal foods, such as sunny side eggs and steak. No pest control log book on site. No commercial garbage pickup for the new license; citations issued.

headline: Gaskets, cutting boards, and floors need cleaning
summary: Reach-in cooler gaskets need cleaning. Cutting boards need cleaning to remove food spills. Floors under fryers need cleaning to remove grease.

headline: No proof of food handler training found
summary: No proof of food handler training or certificates for all required employees; must be provided. Mops were improperly stored at the utility sink and must be stored upside down.

headline: About 40 small flies found throughout premises
summary: About 40 small flies were seen in the main prep area, rear prep and warewashing area, restroom, and closet with the boiler. Pest activity must be eliminated; pest control must be consulted before re-inspection. Citation issued.

headline: Mop sink beside dough mixer; scoop misuse
summary: Mop sink next to the large dough mixer needs a barrier installed. Disposable cups were used as scoops for sugar and salt; proper scoops required. Ceiling air conditioner condensation leaked near the dish area; repair ordered.

headline: Leaky pipe, unlabeled bulk containers, dirty floors
summary: Leaky pipe under the rear hand sink must be repaired. Ice machine drain must be moved to a floor drain. Some large bulk containers lack product names. Floors need cleaning along walls and in corners.

headline: No certified manager; chicken held at 51°F
summary: No certified food manager on site. Chicken wings at 51.0°F and legs and thighs at 48.7°F were in the refrigerator; about 15 lbs ($180) discarded. Raw beef and frozen chicken were thawing in standing water. Dumpster overflowing; citation issued.

headline: Trash under basement stairs; soiled toilet bowl
summary: Trash buildup on the basement floor under the stairs; instructed to clean and maintain. Fecal residue inside the toilet bowl in the food prep area toilet room; instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: No raw-food consumer advisory on menu
summary: Breakfast menu lacks a consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods, such as over-easy eggs; citation issued. Soda gun tube drains into the hand sink and must extend to the floor drain. Black mold-like spots on dish room ceiling.

headline: Several areas need detail cleaning
summary: Drink dispenser nozzles, storage shelves, hot holding and cooking equipment, toilet room, floors, and air vents all need detail cleaning. Instructed to clean and maintain all areas.

headline: Interior coolers and floors need cleaning
summary: Reach-in cooler interiors must be cleaned; ice cream freezer needs defrosting. Washroom fixtures need detail cleaning. Floors around the deli counter, washroom, and rear storage need cleaning. Holes in rear floor and wall base must be sealed.

headline: No certified manager; ice slime; no sanitizer test
summary: No City-certified food manager on site while eggs, milk, and shrimp were prepared; citation issued. Ice machine had black slime dripping onto ice. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit. No sanitizer test devices. Food handler and allergen training records missing.

headline: Employee drinks stored at prep table
summary: Employee drinks were stored at the rear prep table; a designated employee storage area must be provided. Loose and missing knots on the prep cooler lid need repair. Washroom garbage cans had no lids; lids are required.

headline: Bar dish machine sanitizer at 0 ppm
summary: Low-temperature bar dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine sanitizer, below the required 50-100 ppm. Machine must be repaired or replaced. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Cold foods at 52-56°F; prep cooler tagged
summary: Lentils, chicken, cheese, potatoes, and lamb held at 52.6-55.8°F; about $150 of food discarded. Prep cooler at 55.4°F tagged and must not be used. Cooked food in walk-in lacked discard dates. Both thermometers were off by 20 degrees.

headline: Stained cutting boards; missing floor tiles
summary: Cutting boards with open seams and dark stains in the rear prep area must be refinished or replaced. Missing and damaged floor tiles and grout in toilet rooms, prep areas, and walk-in coolers. Chipped paint on walls and ceilings; steel wall breaking.

headline: Walk-in cooler air at 55°F; no food inside
summary: Walk-in cooler air temperature measured 55.0°F; it must be 41.0°F or below. No cold foods were inside, so no citation was issued. Grease buildup on cooking equipment, walls, and shelves. Damaged floor tiles need repair and regrouting.

headline: Rat droppings, live roaches, and raw sewage found
summary: Over 60 rat droppings and 8 live roaches found, plus dead roaches and a dead mouse. Raw sewage was on the floor and in basement containers. Bulk food was unlabeled and uncovered. Prior rat problem was not corrected.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths; trays stored face up
summary: Soiled wiping cloths were on cutting boards and prep tables throughout the cook line. Plastic single-service trays were stored face up. Torn gaskets on a basement milk cooler; dust on walk-in cooler fan guards; no light in basement walk-in freezer.

headline: Missing thermometers; wiping cloths on prep tables
summary: Working thermometers needed in prep coolers. Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables instead of in sanitizer. Ice buildup inside the basement gelato freezer. Rust found on basement walk-in shelving and a prep table.

headline: Peeling pipe paint; dirty cooler gaskets
summary: Chipping, peeling paint on a pipe in the produce cooler must be removed and the surface restored. Gaskets and interior doors of reach-in coolers are unclean and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: No hair restraints; leaking sink faucet
summary: Employees preparing food without hair restraints or protection; must wear them at all times. Torn gasket on a two-door refrigerator at the rear bar storage. Leak at the base of the three-compartment sink faucet; repair ordered.

headline: Extra hand sink needed; tin cans used as scoops
summary: Additional hand sink required at the baking and frying station. Tin cans and old jugs used as food scoops; proper utensils must be obtained. No chlorine sanitizer test strips on site; priority violation.

headline: Pizza held at 70°F; no written time-control method
summary: Pizza was out of temperature control at 70°F. No written method recorded when food left temperature control. About 25 lbs ($350) disposed of voluntarily. Citation issued. Toilet rooms need tissue and cleaning, and a rear hall ceiling is leaking.

headline: Food on floor in walk-in freezer; utensils uninverted
summary: Food must be raised off the floor in the walk-in freezer. Multi-use utensils must be stored upside down on dish shelves. Damaged floor tiles in front of cooking equipment; debris under equipment; burnt-out hood light; allergen training needed.

headline: No certified manager while handling TCS food
summary: No City-certified sanitation manager on premises while chicken and beef were handled; citation issued. Food buildup on the soda machine ice chute. Floors along walls and corners in prep and dish areas have food and dirt buildup.

headline: Mold-like buildup inside cooling unit; greasy hood
summary: Green and gray mold-like buildup inside a two-door cooling unit must be removed, cleaned, and sanitized. Ventilation hood had dust, dirt, and heavy grease debris that must be cleaned.

headline: Walk-in freezer frozen shut; staff lack training
summary: Walk-in freezer door was frozen shut and must be repaired or replaced. Two employees lacked food handler training. All employees must complete training, and records must be kept on site.

headline: Rat droppings in attic and behind water heater
summary: About 15-20 rat droppings along the wall behind the hot water tank near the rear exit, and on attic floors and shelves. Rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap. Certified manager arrived at 9:05 AM; citation issued. Encrusted grease on the cook line.

headline: Undated cooked food; expired food handler card
summary: Cooked pasta and cooked chicken in the refrigerator lacked date marks; ready-to-eat food held over 24 hours must be dated. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables. Cardboard used as floor liner. One expired food handler certificate.

headline: No soap at basement sink; unlabeled bulk food
summary: Basement prep hand sink had no soap while food was being prepared. Cut deli meats in basement cooler lacked a discard date. Bulk salt and sugar were unlabeled. Ice scoop left in standing water; plastic cutting boards were stained and grooved.

headline: Grease on hood lines; greywater spilling on floor
summary: Heavy grease buildup along fire suppression lines in the main cook line hood system. Dish machine discharged excess greywater onto the warewashing floor, pooling near the utility sink. Must be repaired to drain properly.

headline: No backflow device at mop sink faucet
summary: No backflow prevention device was found at the mop sink faucet. One must be provided where it can be located and serviced.

headline: Mouse droppings, no soap, unsafe dish sanitizing
summary: Over 125 mouse droppings found on utensils, shelves, floors, and booth seats, plus live worm-like insects in a floor drain and small live flies in dining area. Dishes sanitized at 0 ppm. Cooler at 59.5°F. No soap or food handler training. Citations issued.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies; no hand soap
summary: No supplies for vomit or diarrhea cleanup, including sanitizer effective against norovirus. Citation issued. No soap at prep-area hand sinks. Person in charge lacked allergen training. Hood light bulbs were blown and filters were dirty.

headline: Pork held at 47-49°F; no paper towels at sink
summary: Pork at 49.2°F and 47.8°F was held in the display cooler and walk-in; 50 lbs ($400) discarded. Meat display cooler at 52.4°F tagged and not to be used until re-inspected. No paper towels at rear hand sink, supplied during inspection. Citation issued.

headline: Spoons kept in standing water; peeling paint
summary: In-use spoons were kept in standing water; they must be kept under running cold water or in a clean, dry container. Peeling paint on the wall behind the three-compartment sink must be removed and maintained.

headline: Raw chicken thawing at room temperature
summary: Raw chicken was thawing at room temperature in the three-compartment sink; approved thawing methods required, such as cold running water at 70°F or below. Several cold-holding units lack thermometers. Food stored on the floor in rear area; water dripping onto food in a cooler.

headline: Air conditioner drain runs into sink
summary: Air conditioner drain pipe emptied into the middle compartment of the three-compartment sink. Instructed to relocate the drain line onto a floor drain.

headline: 25-35 small flies found; pest contract missing
summary: About 25-35 small flies were seen near front prep, coffee station, dish area, and rear storage. No 2025 pest control reports shown; citation issued. Three-compartment sink stoppers missing. Floors damaged; sink leaking; grease and debris buildup.

headline: Vacuum-sealed fish without approved plan
summary: Vacuum-sealed fish and a vacuum packaging machine were found with no approved HACCP plan (a written food-safety plan) or variance. Machine and fish tagged; manager must submit the plan for review. Citation issued.

headline: Dirty grease trap; floors and filter need cleaning
summary: Grease trap under the first-floor three-compartment sink is dirty. Floors along walls and corners in prep, dish area, and basement walk-in freezer need cleaning. Filter above cooking equipment needs grease removed. Line cook lacked allergen training.

headline: Broken thermometer in dessert cooler
summary: Broken thermometer found in the dessert cooler. Person in charge was instructed to replace it.

headline: Washroom hand-sink water too cool; ice slime
summary: Hot water at washroom hand sinks measured 77.1-79.9°F; it must be at least 100°F. Plumbers were on site. Black slimy substance inside the ice machine dripped into ice; citation issued. Missing hair restraint and waste receptacle cover; unlabeled bulk containers.

headline: Unlabeled food containers; food stored on floor
summary: Food in containers in coolers, walk-in cooler, and dry storage lacked name labels. Food containers stored on the floor in walk-in cooler, prep, and storage areas must be raised six inches. Food debris and spills found throughout the facility.

headline: Slow drain, leaky pipe, and grease buildup
summary: Dish machine hand sink drains slowly and must be repaired. Leaky pipe at the three-compartment sink must be fixed. Grease and food debris buildup in several areas. Damaged floors, missing hood filter, and certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No valid certified manager while TCS food served
summary: Manager lacked a City sanitation certificate; no valid original certificate on premises while turkey sandwiches, pizza, and chicken were prepared. Citation issued. Dust and food debris under the coffee machine and soda dispenser.

headline: Splash guard needed; worn cutting boards
summary: Splash guard required between bar dump sink and hand sink. Worn and pitted cutting boards must be repaired or replaced. Reach-in cooler has worn gaskets; missing handles on holding units. Food debris in walk-in cooler and dish racks; missing ceiling tiles.

headline: Flies and a cockroach found; hand soap missing
summary: About 45 small and large flies were found throughout prep areas, plus one large adult cockroach near cooling units. Citation issued. Hand soap was missing at prep-area sinks; paper towels were provided on site. Food handler lacked hair restraint.

headline: Missing thermometer; base coving in poor repair
summary: Grill area drawer cooler lacks an internal thermometer. Base coving is missing or in poor repair behind equipment in the rear prep area. Wall and floor in poor repair behind the water boiler. Person in charge lacks allergen awareness training.

headline: Mineral buildup in ice machine; allergen certificates expired
summary: Mineral buildup found in the ice machine water reservoir; ice is used for consumption; must be cleaned and sanitized. Milk crates used for elevation; broken gasket on prep cooler. Debris under front counter. Allergen certificates expired 2-5-25.

headline: Raw chicken and cold foods held too warm
summary: About 30 lbs raw chicken at 49-50°F in walk-in cooler. Cooked pork ribs at 59-60°F and pizzas at 58-59°F in a reach-in cooler that was unplugged. Unsafe cold food was discarded (about 41 lbs). Dirty ice machine and greasy outside waste container.

headline: Certified managers need allergen training proof
summary: All City of Chicago certified food managers must have allergen training. Proof of training or certificates must be provided.

headline: Ice chute buildup; uncorrected prior violations
summary: The ice chute inside the ice machine had black and orange-reddish buildup. Ice must be removed and the interior washed and sanitized. Door handles, cooler and oven surfaces have food buildup. Prior violations from September 2023 were not corrected, including grease, peeling paint and expired allergen training.

headline: Turkey warm; many prepared foods lack date labels
summary: Turkey breast in the walk-in cooler measured 52.8°F; 15 lbs (about $100) were discarded. Many prepared TCS foods lacked 7-day date labels; 200 lbs (about $2,900) were discarded. Food was stored on the floor, and racks are rusted. Grease buildup needs cleaning.

headline: No service sink on site
summary: There is no service sink on site. The manager must provide one.

headline: No thermometer in produce cooler; ice buildup
summary: The produce walk-in cooler has no thermometer and one must be provided. Ice buildup on the meat walk-in cooler condenser must be removed. Debris on floors, walls and corners behind the baler must be cleaned.

headline: Food covered during cooling; no test strips
summary: Food was covered tightly while cooling in the walk-in cooler; it must be covered loosely. No sanitizer test strips were on site for the three-compartment sink, and its cold water faucet cannot be turned off. The front sneeze guard is too short, and walk-in lighting is inadequate.

headline: Grease trap spills; floor tiles in poor repair
summary: Togo boxes under the prep table must be inverted. Coolers and freezers need interior and exterior cleaning. Spills around the grease trap hose must be cleaned and checked for leaks. Floor tiles in front and rear prep and storage areas need repair. Filters and hood need grease removal.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; unit tagged
summary: The high-temperature dishwasher's final rinse measured 96°F instead of 180°F. It was repaired, tagged, and must be checked before use. Grease droplets are under the deep fryer, and ice machine panel has slight buildup.

headline: Rodent droppings; ice maker residue; sanitizer 0 ppm
summary: About 80 mouse droppings were under storage racks in the hallway dry storage area, and about 25 were behind a chest freezer. The ice maker had black slimy residue dripping into ice, so it was turned off and cleaned. The dish machine rinsed at 0 ppm, and cold food measured 44-48°F and was discarded.

headline: About 70 rodent droppings across premises
summary: About 70 small and large rodent droppings were found on shelves, floors, liquor cases and unopened liquor boxes. They must be removed and sanitized, and a pest control agreement must be on site. No written vomit/diarrhea procedure. Liquor boxes are stored on floors, and a large wall hole needs enclosing.

headline: No certified manager at start; gloves not changed
summary: No certified food manager was on site when TCS foods were stored and prepared at start; one arrived around 9:25 am and a citation was issued. A handler handled beef, then chicken, without changing gloves. Soda pops were stored on the floor, and cardboard was used as a liner.

headline: No certified manager while raw beef was cut
summary: No certified food manager was on site while raw beef was chopped and sliced; a citation was issued. Two hand sinks had no paper towels, and a restroom hand sink had no hand soap. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables, and floors had dried food and trash.

headline: Personal items stored with dry food
summary: Personal items were found mixed with dry storage. All personal items must be kept separate from food.

headline: Gaps in doors and worn gaskets need repair
summary: Front, patio and emergency doors have gaps and pin holes and must be made tight-fitting. A worn gasket is under the walk-in freezer door. Oven interiors, floors under prep tables, and a pitted concrete floor need attention. Food managers lack allergen training.

headline: Heavy leak under meat-room sink; cardboard liners
summary: A heavy leak from pipes under the first-floor meat-room hand sink must be repaired. Cardboard was used as a shelf liner in the basement walk-in cooler and must be replaced with a smooth, cleanable material. Food handlers need updated training certificates on site.

headline: Heavy grime on walls; allergen training missing
summary: Heavy buildup of dust, dirt, food debris and splatter was found on walls in the dish, prep and three-compartment sink areas. Walls and floors must be cleaned to prevent pest issues. The city-certified manager on duty lacks required allergen training.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; cooler held for inspection
summary: The low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged and held. A prep cooler holding food measured 65.7°F and was tagged until reinspected by the Chicago Department of Public Health. Several dead roaches were found and must be removed. The three-compartment sink leaks.

headline: Grease in fryers; no allergen training certificate
summary: Grease buildup was found inside the cooking fryers and must be cleaned. No allergen training certificate was on site, and all certified food managers must provide one.

headline: Overflowing dumpsters and food debris throughout
summary: Outside dumpsters were overflowing with trash and had loose lids; a citation was issued. Food debris and spills were found on equipment, shelves, and floors. Openings along baseboards in the rear prep area must be sealed, and a bulk container is unlabeled.

headline: About 60 mouse droppings; many repairs needed
summary: About 60 or more mouse droppings were in the fryer cabinet, on window ledges, and under paper and food storage shelves. They must be removed and areas sanitized, and pest control is recommended. Other items: a food handler without a hair restraint, a leaky faucet, and stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Soda drain tube in hand sink; rust in freezer
summary: A soda gun tube drains into a hand sink and must be extended to the floor drain. Gaskets on cold holding units need cleaning, and the rear walk-in freezer shelving has excessive rust. Coffee and debris are on the coffee station floor; an employee washroom vent is dusty.

headline: About 50 live fruit flies; clogged hand sink
summary: About 50 live fruit flies were found in the kitchen next to the soda machine. The prep hand sink was clogged with standing water. There is no food thermometer or sanitizer test strips. A wastewater drain empties into the salad prep sink. Soda syrup spills and dirt behind the soda machine.

headline: No certified manager during pasta prep; sink too cold
summary: No certified manager was on site while pasta and other TCS items were prepared. A toilet-room hand sink measured 64.8°F, below the required 100-120°F. Missing hand-washing signs, a short soap pump tube and a torn freezer gasket were also noted.

headline: About 27 live flies in grocery and prep areas
summary: About 12 large and 15 small live flies were seen on a produce display, near drains, and flying in the prep area near dishwashing. Management must add pest control service. Also: unlabeled frozen paletas, missing hair restraints, and dirty yogurt cooler shelves.

headline: Yogurt, fruit and wraps held above 41°F
summary: In the southwest food display, 14 containers of protein yogurt were at 63-65°F, mixed fruit at 51-54°F, and chicken tender wraps at 56-57°F. The manager discarded all of these, about $142 worth. A citation was issued.

headline: Missing food handler certificates; pitted cutting board
summary: Slight buildup is inside the upper part of the ice machine and must be cleaned. The pizza prep cooler's cutting board is pitted and stained and must be replaced. Bar gun holders need cleaning. Some food handler training certificates are missing and must be valid.

headline: Live roaches, rat droppings and flies found
summary: Two live cockroaches were on a wall by the bakery hand sink. About 10 rat droppings and about 30 small flies were found near the meat area. Staff must detail clean and add pest control service. Also: no metal-stem food thermometer, a gap under rear doors, and wastewater backing up in the sink.

headline: No certified manager on site; cleanup procedure missing
summary: No person in charge present. No certified food manager on duty while TCS foods (must be kept hot or cold) were prepared. No vomit/diarrhea cleanup procedure. Some food handlers lacked training proof. Clutter and freezer ice also noted.

headline: Cracked floor; employee belongings near food
summary: A crack on the floor by the prep-area hand sink must be repaired. Employee belongings were on a shelf with food in the kitchen prep area and must be moved to a designated area.

headline: Missing thermometer; standing water at dish area
summary: The front one-door soda cooler has no thermometer and one must be provided. Gaskets on the three-door pizza prep cooler are not tight-fitting. Standing water was found on the dishwashing area floor and must be kept dry and clean.

headline: No hand-washing signs at hand sinks
summary: No hand-washing signage was found at hand sinks. The business must provide it.

headline: Certified managers lack allergen training
summary: City-certified managers are missing allergen training. They must obtain it and keep verification on site.

headline: Dead bugs and clutter in utility room
summary: Several dead bugs were found on the utility room floor. The person in charge was told to remove them, sanitize the area, and keep it clean. Clutter and litter on the utility room floor must also be cleared.

headline: No certified manager; gaps, uncorrected postings
summary: No City certified food service manager was on premises; a citation was issued. Openings at the base of dumpster-area and front entrance doors must be sealed. Summary report was not posted, but was found and posted on site. Other issues include missing self-closing doors and backflow devices.

headline: Missing hand-washing sign; wiping cloths misplaced
summary: No hand-washing sign was near the front prep hand sink. The milk refrigerator in the coffee area needs a working thermometer. Oil and items on the floor in the rear prep area must be raised. Wiping cloths were left on tables and sinks, and the rear hand sink drains slowly.

headline: No health policy; dish and cooler failures
summary: No employee health policy was on site, and there was no vomit/diarrhea cleanup procedure. The low-temperature dishwasher was not sanitizing and was not to be used. A prep cooler held food at 60.6°F and was not to be used until 41°F or below. Wastewater backs up into a sink.

headline: No health policy, cleanup kit, or pest log
summary: No written employee health policy, vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit, or procedure was on site. No current pest control log book was found, and a licensed pest company must visit at least twice yearly. Also missing thermometers, posted training certificates, and food handler allergen proof.

headline: Expired handler certificates; worn freezer gasket
summary: Rubber gaskets on the two-door freezer are in poor repair at the bottom and must be fixed. Grease under the fryers must be cleaned. Food handler training certificates were expired; all food handlers must obtain valid ones.

headline: No vomit/diarrhea kit or procedure on site
summary: No kit or procedure for vomiting and diarrhea was on site. A one-page guide was left, and a kit with a norovirus-effective sanitizer must be kept on site. No allergen training certificates were on site; managers must complete the training and keep records.

headline: Pots and pans not inverted; dirty floors
summary: Pots and pans were not stored inverted and must be. Floors behind and under heavy equipment were not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager while soup and chicken served
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods, including soup and chicken, were prepared and served. Management must have a certified food manager on site at all times while TCS foods are prepared and served. A citation was issued.

headline: Gaps at doors must be sealed against pests
summary: Openings at the base of the dining-area double door, a stairwell exit door, and a dumpster-area door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Proof of allergen training is needed for employees holding certified food manager certificates.

headline: No certified manager; food not date-marked
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while sandwiches and fried eggs were prepared; a citation was issued. Ready-to-eat foods were not date-marked. Paper towels were missing at two hand sinks and were obtained during inspection. Dumpster lids were open with trash overflowing; the manager cleaned it.

headline: No certified manager while eggs cooked; unapproved vacuum packing
summary: No certified sanitation manager was on site when eggs were cooked; corrected on site when the manager arrived near the end of inspection, and a citation was issued. Vacuum-packed food was made without a variance; 15 lbs ($250) discarded. No chemical test kit; chest freezer has excess ice.

headline: Old violations uncorrected; milk crates for dishes
summary: Milk crates were used to store clean dishes and must be removed. Drains throughout the facility have residue. The certified manager lacks allergen training. Previous violations were not corrected: cutting boards with open seams, dust on walk-in fan guards, and grease in the dishwashing grease trap.

headline: Beverage dispensers need cleaning; waste cans
summary: Beverage dispensers have buildup and need cleaning. The restroom needs covered waste cans. Grout lines around the three-compartment sink need cleaning and regrouting.

headline: Personal items above food equipment; grease buildup
summary: Employee personal care items were stored directly above equipment and utensils in the front service area and must be moved. Grease and dried food were on non-food-contact surfaces of cooking and cold-holding equipment in the rear kitchen and must be cleaned.

headline: Filters above cooking equipment need cleaning
summary: Filters above the cooking equipment must be cleaned to remove grease and debris.

headline: Gaps under entry and exit doors need sealing
summary: A gap of about 1/4 inch was found under the front entry door, and the rear exit door has a gap on its left side. Management was instructed to seal both to help prevent pest and insect entry.

headline: Dirty ice machine, fryers and ovens; no allergen proof
summary: The small front bar ice machine has a blackish substance, the main ice bin lacks a cover, and an ice scoop was stored on the machine. Fryers, ovens, bar guns and reach-in areas need cleaning. Mops were not stored to dry, and the certified food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Restroom door needs self-closing device
summary: The washroom door must have a self-closing device, which must be kept in place.

headline: Disposable cup used as food scoop
summary: A disposable cup was being used as a food scoop. The staff was instructed to use a proper scoop.

headline: Chipped ceiling paint above dish and prep areas
summary: Chipped paint on the ceiling above the low-temperature dish machine and basement prep area must be scraped and repainted.

headline: Cold foods above 41°F; gloves not changed
summary: Cold TCS foods in service coolers measured 44-56°F, including rice, sausage, marinara and chicken. The manager voluntarily discarded 6 lbs. An employee did not change gloves between dirty and clean dishes, and a citation was issued. Managers also lack allergen training.

headline: No valid manager certificate; dead insects found
summary: The person in charge lacks a certified food manager certificate. Only a copy was posted while chicken and deli meats were handled. Dead insects were found in bakery and produce light shields. Also: door gaps, a slow sink drain, an unlabeled bakery container, and damaged walls and floors.

headline: Boxed food on floors; hair restraints needed
summary: Boxed food was stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and freezer and must be raised six inches. Several employees handled food without hair restraints. Food debris was on cold-holding equipment, and ceiling panels above the walk-in freezer are missing.

headline: No certified manager on site during food prep
summary: Food handlers prepared and handled TCS foods without the original City certificate or a certified manager on site. The person in charge must keep the certificate posted and a certified manager present during food prep and operating hours. Dirt under the rear hand sink and holes in dining ceiling panels were noted.

headline: Hot foods too cool; sticky rice left at room temp
summary: No employee health policy was on site. Hot TCS foods were held at 79-120°F, below the required 135°F; $100 of food was discarded. Sticky rice pastries were sold at room temperature (67°F); 250 lbs ($1,500) were discarded. Grease and debris are on filters above the oven.

headline: No certified manager while handling TCS foods
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while deli and fresh meat TCS foods were handled and sold. Management was told to obtain one. Bulk salt and sugar containers are unlabeled. A leak under the three-compartment sink needs repair.

headline: About 100 mouse droppings throughout store
summary: Evidence of about 100 or more mouse droppings was found on the sales floor, storage areas, electrical closet, and prep and dish areas. Droppings must be removed and the areas sanitized, and pest control service is recommended. Also a gap under the front door and an uncovered sanitizer test kit issue.

headline: Cold units lack thermometers; dusty ceiling vents
summary: Two cold holding units in the rear prep area have no ambient air thermometers. A dry ingredient container is unlabeled. Floors near cooking and dish equipment need deep cleaning and regrouting. Ceiling tiles and vent covers above prep tables have dust buildup.

headline: Unlabeled bulk flour and sugar containers
summary: Bulk flour and sugar containers were not labeled. The business was instructed to label them.

headline: Used water bottle found in ice; ice discarded
summary: A used plastic water bottle with liquid was found in an ice bin used for drinks. The bottle was removed and the manager discarded the ice; a citation was issued. Plastic grocery bags and crates are used for storage. A food handler training certificate was not on site.

headline: Cold foods held at 46-82°F; soap replaced on site
summary: Many cold TCS foods were held between 46.8°F and 81.5°F, including shrimp, eggs, sushi and cheesecake. The manager discarded about 100 lbs (about $400). The handwash soap dispenser was replaced on site. Uncovered food, missing hair restraints, and dumpster-area liquid waste were also noted.

headline: One-inch gap at side door; no handler certificates
summary: A one-inch gap between the side entrance doors must be closed and made rodent-proof. No food handler certificates were available for inspector review.

headline: No certified manager; flies and mold-like ice-machine residue
summary: No City certified food service manager was on premises. Mold-like substance was found inside basement ice machines, and ice had to be destroyed. Over 40 small flies were found in dish, basement and bar areas. Two low-temperature dish machines measured 0 ppm chlorine. No pest control log book.

headline: Non-manager employees need food handler training
summary: Employees who are not City-certified food service managers must obtain the required food handler training.

headline: Over 100 flies; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Over 100 small flies were found in the bar, under sinks and around coolers, with some in the basement and men's washroom. Flies must be eliminated and areas sanitized. The chlorine dish machine dispensed 0 ppm and was tagged and held. A prep cooler's air measured 45.3°F and was held.

headline: No certified manager while chili and beef served
summary: The person in charge did not have a City sanitation manager certificate at inspection start. No certified manager was on site while TCS chili and beef were prepared and served; the manager arrived at 2:45 pm. A gap of more than one inch at the rear alley exit door must be sealed.

headline: Missing hand-washing signs and splash guard
summary: The rear prep hand sink has no hand-washing sign and needs a splash guard next to the utensil rack. Rusted racks and foil shelf liners must be removed. Floors under equipment and corners are dirty, and the women's restroom needs a covered trash can.

headline: Standing water inside rear pizza cooler
summary: Standing water was found inside the rear pizza cooler. Management must clean it.

headline: Broken glass; mops stored in standing water
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables and must be kept in sanitizing solution. Broken glass and paper debris were under shelves behind the front bar. Mops were stored in standing water by the rear exit. A baseboard is missing behind the front bar.

headline: Torn door gaskets on prep and walk-in coolers
summary: Torn door gaskets, the rubber seals on doors, were found on the three-door prep cooler and the walk-in cooler door. Management was instructed to replace them and keep them maintained.

headline: No certified manager while chicken and gumbo prepared
summary: No valid City certified manager was on duty while TCS chicken, jambalaya and gumbo were prepared; a citation was issued. The basement ice machine chute needs cleaning. An opening under the front bar ice bin must be sealed. Floors need cleaning, and the manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No backflow device on ice machine; unused items
summary: The kitchen dishwashing-area ice machine has no backflow prevention device and must have one. An unused wooden door and unnecessary items in the wine storage and dishwashing room must be removed.

headline: TCS foods stored past 7-day use-by date
summary: Cold TCS foods, including cooked black beans, poblano peppers, salsa and burger sauces, were kept past the 7-day use-by date in prep and walk-in coolers. Management must date-mark and discard them. Some food handlers and the certified food manager lacked required training proof.

headline: Loose faucet and chipping paint
summary: The front prep hand sink has a loose faucet and must be repaired. Paint is chipping on the wall above the three-compartment sink and the wall must be replastered and maintained.

headline: No vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure
summary: No cleanup kit or procedure for vomiting and diarrhea was on premises during inspection. Staff must have the required equipment and procedure in place. This was a priority violation.

headline: No vomit/diarrhea cleanup policy; missing thermometer
summary: No written policy or cleanup supplies for vomiting and diarrhea events were on site. Management must provide and keep them available. Also noted: a missing thermometer in the front display cooler, broken floor tiles, wall holes, and a missing toilet-room light.

headline: Deeply cut cutting boards; soiled coolers
summary: Bulk food containers need commodity-name labels. Reach-in cooler interiors have food spills and need cleaning. Cutting boards with deep cuts and discoloration need replacement. A three-compartment sink faucet leaks, and fryer floors and cooking equipment need degreasing.

headline: Broken freezer gasket; greasy walls and equipment
summary: A broken rubber gasket and a rusted lid were found on the white chest freezer. Grease and food debris were on walls and equipment behind the cooking line, and grease was under cooking equipment. A three-compartment sink faucet leaks. Food containers need labels after transfer.

headline: Trash and food debris on floors and shelves
summary: Trash and food debris found on grocery and stock-area floors, behind a sink and grease trap, in the pharmacy, and inside the walk-in cooler and freezer. A thermometer is missing inside the walk-in cooler. Staff must clean and maintain these areas.

headline: Ready-to-eat foods not date-marked; expired certificates
summary: Ready-to-eat TCS foods, including cottage cheese, tuna, and sausage gravy, were not date-marked. The person in charge discarded about 25 lbs ($100), and a citation was issued. Bulk dry ingredients lack labels. Onions were stored under a waste pipe, and food handler certificates are expired.

headline: Ice machine buildup and old cutting boards
summary: The ice machine in Wabash Cafe had black buildup, and the manager was told to clean it. A previous violation was not fixed in time: deeply scratched, stained cutting boards in the 3rd-floor prep area must be replaced. All previous violations must be corrected.

headline: Dish machine under-temperature; cold foods too warm
summary: The high-temperature dish machine washed at 117°F and rinsed at 150°F; it must reach 150°F wash and 180°F rinse. The machine was tagged and held. Cold TCS foods at 48-57°F were discarded voluntarily by the person in charge. Floors and storage areas need cleaning.

headline: About 80 mouse droppings; cooler too warm
summary: About 80 mouse droppings were on the floor in the furnace room, a cluttered washroom and behind the ice maker. These must be cleaned and sanitized, and additional pest control is needed. The three-door prep cooler air measured 57.6°F and was tagged; about 15 lbs ($200) of food was discarded.

headline: Cheese, dairy and eggs held above 41°F
summary: Cheeses, buttermilk, hummus, cream, yogurt and eggs were held at 46-47°F in the produce walk-in cooler, though its air measured 41°F. About 275 lbs (about $700) were discarded. A reach-in gasket is ripped and freezer and prep cooler condensers need cleaning.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food
summary: A food handler sliced lettuce and put it into a tub with bare hands. The manager was told not to handle ready-to-eat foods with bare hands. The hand sink also drains slowly and must be repaired.

headline: Broken freezers and old violations not corrected
summary: Violations from a December 2023 report were not corrected. Chest freezers have taped, broken door liners exposing insulation and wiring; management must replace them. Floor tiles need repair, a food handler lacked a valid certificate, and office and storage areas are cluttered.

headline: No hand sink in dish area; many repairs
summary: No hand sink exists in the dishwashing area, and one with hot and cold water, soap and towels must be installed. Other items include a gap in the front entry door, unlabeled containers, no food handler training or manager allergen training, greasy fryers, and a loose wall panel.

headline: Black buildup in ice machine; expired training
summary: The ice machine interior had black buildup, and the manager was told to clean it. A hand sink is leaking into a bucket. Previous violations remain: food handler training certificates expired in 2022, and a certified food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Single-use items on floor; sugar spills
summary: Single-service items were stored on the hallway floor near the rear exit. The manager was told to elevate and invert them. Sugar was spilled in cabinets under the soda dispensing area and must be cleaned.

headline: Over 10 rat droppings behind dumpster
summary: Over 10 rat droppings were observed outside, behind the garbage dumpster. The area must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Torn walk-in gasket; damaged floor tiles
summary: A torn door gasket inside the walk-in cooler must be replaced. Missing and damaged floor tiles in front of the utility sink must be repaired to create a smooth, cleanable surface.

headline: Unlabeled flour; uncleared storage and burnt lights
summary: A flour container in the prep area is unlabeled. The women's washroom door is not self-closing. Unused equipment in the basement storage area must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Soiled mop heads were not hung to dry, and two prep line light bulbs are burnt out. The manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Dead roaches under sink; unlabeled food containers
summary: Dead roaches were found under the three-compartment sink and behind the grease trap in the warewashing area. They must be removed, and the area cleaned and sanitized. Food containers are unlabeled, bulk sugar is uncovered, and milk crates are used as shelves.

headline: No certified manager or handler certificates posted
summary: No City certified manager certificate was posted, and no current certificate was on site, while milk, cheese and yogurt were served. Food handler certificates for staff were missing. The grab-and-go cooler thermometer is not working, and packaged foods lack ingredient labels.

headline: No hot or cold water at dish sink, fixed on site
summary: The three-compartment sink's first basin had no hot or cold water. A facility plumber repaired it during the inspection. Also noted: broken and loose hand sink faucets, food debris and spills, a leaking soda machine, a broken wall and missing floor grout.

headline: Worn cutting boards and greasy cooking equipment
summary: Worn cutting boards must be replaced. Cooking equipment needs cleaning to remove grease buildup. Floors around cooking equipment need detail cleaning of food spills and grease.

headline: Food handler without effective hair restraint
summary: A food handler was seen without an effective hair restraint. Staff were instructed to provide a beard guard and keep it in use.

headline: Failed: no manager, flies, rodent droppings, residue
summary: No certified food manager or person in charge was on site while chicken was served. About 50 small flies were found in several areas. Pink and black residue was found inside the ice machine. Prior violations were not corrected. Citations issued.

headline: Reduced-oxygen packaging lacked variance; machine tagged
summary: Reduced-oxygen packaging was performed without a required variance or written food safety plan on site. The product and machine were tagged. Priority violation, citation issued. Debris and spillage were found under dry storage shelving.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings in prep cabinet and floor
summary: 25 mouse droppings were found inside an unused storage cabinet in the front prep station, and 15 more were scattered on the floor in the same corner. Citation issued. A bar hand sink has a leaking pipe, and several areas need cleaning.

headline: Wall hole and burned-out hood light
summary: A hole in the stairwell wall leading to basement storage must be sealed. A burned-out light bulb in the hood system must be replaced.

headline: Food stored on floor; debris throughout prep areas
summary: Food items including tortillas and rice were stored on the prep area floor and must be raised six inches. Food debris is on prep tables and equipment. Debris has built up on floors, walls, and corners in prep and storage areas.

headline: Bulk flour unlabeled; grease under fryers
summary: A bulk flour container must be labeled with its common name. Stored mixing bowls must be inverted. Waded paper was used to level a prep table and must be replaced. A large crack at the dish machine wall must be sealed, and grease under the fryers must be cleaned.

headline: Wiping cloths, plastic bags, and grease buildup
summary: Prep wiping cloths need a sanitizing container. Plastic grocery bags are used as food containers in coolers and freezers, and duct tape is used to repair coolers. Grease, food debris, and ice buildup were also noted, along with a dirty employee toilet.

headline: Labeling, gasket, and cleaning issues; no pests
summary: Shaker containers must be labeled when food is not in original packaging. Worn gaskets on a freezer and walk-in cooler must be repaired, and rust must be removed from shelving. Debris and grease were noted on carts, coolers, and cooking equipment. Stained ceiling tiles and a lobby wall hole need repair.

headline: Torn gasket, moldy caulking, and cover material issues
summary: A torn door gasket on a rear prep cooler must be replaced. Cloth towels, foil, and duct tape may not be used as shelf liners. Baseboard is separating from a wall, and moldy caulking at the rear three-compartment sink must be replaced. Food handler training proof is missing.

headline: Unused cooler removed; hood filters heavily soiled
summary: An unused tall boy cooler in rear storage must be removed. Hood filters over the cook line have heavy grime buildup and need detail cleaning. No allergen training certificate was on site.

headline: Beef broth too warm; 80 lbs discarded
summary: Two five-gallon containers of beef broth were stored in a cooler at 60.2F, well above the 41F limit. About 80 lbs, worth $100, were discarded. A citation was issued, and staff were told to cool TCS foods properly before storing them in coolers.

headline: No certified manager; several violations cited
summary: Food handlers prepared TCS foods without an original city food service certificate or certified manager on site. Citation issued. A spill kit lacked norovirus-effective sanitizer, and no paper towels were at the rear prep hand sink. Food handler training proof is missing.

headline: Expired allergen training; leaking drain under sink
summary: No handwashing sign at the prep hand sink. Plates were not inverted after sanitizing. A drainpipe under the three-compartment prep sink is leaking. Expired allergen training was found, and documentation must be provided.

headline: Handwashing signs missing at several sinks
summary: No handwashing signs were posted at hand sinks in the dishwashing, preparation, and bar areas. The operator was told to provide them.

headline: Failed: no hand sink at tea station; no thermometer
summary: No written employee health policy was on premises. The front tea station lacks a hand sink with hot and cold water. No thermometer was on site for TCS foods. No consumer advisory is posted for raw sushi. Several priority violations were found.

headline: Failed: no hot water at prep hand sink
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site, which is a priority violation with a citation. The prep hand sink measured 86.4F; it must be at least 100F. Grease and debris were found on cooking equipment, and a soiled mop head was not hung up.

headline: Peeling ceiling and wall paint
summary: Peeling paint on the ceiling above basement prep tables and on the wall in front of the ice machine must be repainted and maintained.

headline: Failed: no licensed pest control or pest logbook
summary: No Illinois-licensed pest control provider and no pest logbook were on site. The operator was told to obtain both. A loose washroom sink faucet also needs repair. No citation issued.

headline: Passed with several cleaning and equipment items
summary: No internal thermometer in the walk-in cooler. Debris was found on walk-in shelving, display cooler glass, a rear prep table, and the walk-in floor. Hood filters need cleaning, and mop hooks are needed.

headline: No valid manager certificate while serving TCS foods
summary: No valid city food service sanitation certificate was on site while chicken, tuna, and beef sandwiches were prepared and served to the public. Priority foundation violation, citation issued. The certificate must be on site at all times.

headline: Failed: coolers too warm; no health policy
summary: No employee health policies were on site. Stand-up reach-in cooler measured 48.3F and another reach-in 57.3F; both must be 41F or below. No pest control logbook was on site. The rear door has a hole, and the front window has no screen.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; ice machine backflow device
summary: A handwashing sign is missing at the bar hand sink and must be provided. The ice machine lacks backflow prevention and must have one installed and maintained.

headline: Leaking faucet; washroom doors need self-closing devices
summary: A water leak at the base of the faucet at the dishwashing three-compartment sink must be repaired. Both washroom doors need self-closing devices. The certified food manager's allergen training certificate is expired.

headline: Failed: roach carcass found; dish machine lacks indicator
summary: A roach carcass was found in basement storage, and the manager was told to remove all dead insects. The hot water dish machine lacks a required temperature indicator. Priority violation, citation issued.

headline: Failed: 50+ mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: No city certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were handled. Over 50 mouse droppings were found on several floors. Citation issued, and pest control must service the building before reinspection. No employee health policy was on site.

headline: Mold-like growth in both ice machines; no public summary
summary: Mold-like growth was found on interior contact surfaces of both ice machines and must be cleaned and sanitized. Priority violation with a citation. A cooler door gasket is torn, cutting boards are heavily scored, and food debris is on ceiling tiles. The inspection summary was not posted for public view.

headline: Torn gasket on rear prep refrigerator
summary: A torn rubber gasket on the two-door reach-in refrigerator in the rear prep area must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Unfinished drywall outside employee washrooms
summary: A section of unfinished drywall outside the second-floor employee washrooms must be painted or covered so it is smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Pasta covered while cooling; floor drains soiled
summary: Cooked pasta was covered tightly while cooling in a one-door cooler and must be stored loosely covered or uncovered. Floor drains under the ice machine, three-compartment sink, and dish machine have dried food and grease buildup.

headline: Failed: hand sinks blocked; no soap or towels
summary: A prep hand sink is blocked by a shelf, and a bar hand sink holds a cup and soda machine tubes. The prep sink lacks soap, and paper towels are missing at two hand sinks. The three-compartment sink leaks. Citations issued for hand sink issues.

headline: Mold-like substance found in all basement ice machines
summary: A pink, black, and orange mold-like substance was found on the shields of all three basement ice machines. Ice must be destroyed, and the machines cleaned and sanitized. Liquor is stored under unshielded sewer lines, and the dish machine lacks a data plate.

headline: No certified manager while handling TCS foods
summary: No certified food service manager and no posted certificate were on site while deli meat and milk were handled. The manager was told to obtain and post one. Priority foundation violation.

headline: Door gap; expired certificates and several repairs
summary: A 1/4-inch gap under the rear loading door must be repaired. Three-compartment sink stoppers do not close. Unused equipment is in storage rooms, and items must be six inches off the floor. Several hood lights are out and expired food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths; leaks and dust buildup
summary: Dirty wiping cloths were stored throughout the prep areas and must be kept in sanitizing solution. A sandwich cooler gasket is torn. Dishwashing sink caulking is dirty and a faucet leaks. Walk-in fan guards are dusty, and employee bags were stored on a prep table.

headline: Door gaps and leaking bar sink
summary: Front and rear door sweeps each have a 1/2-inch gap that must be closed to rodent-proof both doors. The middle compartment pipe of the rear bar three-compartment sink is leaking. Some food handler certificates have expired, and some allergen certificates are missing.

headline: Cooler thermometer in disrepair
summary: The thermometer on the outside of the rear sandwich reach-in cooler is in disrepair. The operator was told to repair and maintain it.

headline: Hot water and sanitizer issues fixed on site
summary: The first floor dish hand sink was below 100F. A service technician corrected it to 102-105F. The low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer, which the technician raised to 100 ppm. Citations issued. A steamer in rear prep is leaking.

headline: Milk crates used; grease buildup on grill
summary: Milk crates are used to store coffee mugs and creamer pitchers and should be replaced with smooth, easily cleaned containers. Excessive grease is on the flat top grill, and the salamander has grease and food debris. A hot water handle at a hand sink leaks.

headline: Dirty sinks, coolers, and floor grout issues
summary: The interior of all sinks and reach-in coolers in rear prep and the bar need detail cleaning. Dishwashing area floor tiles have low grout and must be regrouted. Food debris on walls and cluttered storage floors need attention. One food manager's allergen certificate is expired.

headline: Rear door gap; hole in restroom wall
summary: The rear exterior door has a 1/4-inch space at the bottom, and a door sweep must be installed. Spills and debris are inside cold hold units and on prep tables. A hole in the bathroom wall needs repair. No food handler certificates or allergen certificate were on site.

headline: Missing signage and cracked tiles; vent cleaning
summary: Handwashing signs are missing in the boys and girls washrooms near the cafeteria. Ambient air thermometers are missing in reach-in coolers with milk. Damaged floor tiles in dishwashing and cracked ceiling tiles in prep need repair. The kitchen exhaust vent needs cleaning.

headline: Three-compartment sink lacks drain board
summary: The three-compartment sink has no drain board. The operator was told to install one.

headline: Missing handwashing sign and hair restraints
summary: No handwashing sign at the prep hand sink. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. Grease buildup on the fryers needs cleaning. The floor under the reach-in freezer is unfinished, and a wall hole in the same area must be repaired.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings found; did not comply
summary: Mouse droppings were found in the rear prep area and restroom. The inspector counted 11 and noted more were too numerous to count. The operator did not comply within the re-inspection time frame. Staff were told to remove and sanitize, and call pest control.

headline: Failed: live roaches and over 50 trapped roaches
summary: Two live roaches were found in the dining room and kitchen. Over 50 trapped roaches and roach carcasses were found in kitchen areas, and staff were told to remove them. Priority citation issued. Grease buildup and a basement freezer door in disrepair were also noted.

headline: Rear door gap; dirty cooler fans and floors
summary: The rear exit has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom that must be fixed with a weather stripping. Fans inside the reach-in cooler are dirty. Floors in the front and rear prep areas need cleaning, and rear floors should be kept as dry as possible.

headline: Failed: uncorrected violation; dumpster missing lid
summary: A previous priority violation was not corrected. The outside dumpster is missing its lid, allowing pest access, and citations were issued. Floor drains are dirty and must be cleaned to prevent pest breeding. Air vent covers are dusty.

headline: Certified manager on duty lacks allergen training
summary: The city certified manager on duty did not have allergen training as required.

headline: Deeply cut cutting board; office clutter
summary: A cutting board with deep cuts and stains must be sanded and sealed or replaced. Excessive clutter in the office must be removed.

headline: Gaps and openings; heavy grease and debris
summary: The rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap, and basement ceiling openings were found. These must be sealed to prevent pests. Basement refrigerators have heavy food debris, and the cooking equipment and basement floors have grease buildup.

headline: Passed: allergen training missing for several managers
summary: Multiple certified food managers on site were missing allergen awareness training and certificates. The operator was told to provide the training and keep certificates on site for review at all times.

headline: Failed: flies persist; manager certificate missing
summary: The person in charge lacked a valid city certified food manager certificate while chicken and other foods were prepared and served. A prior violation was not corrected: about 70 small live flies were found on followup. Citation issued. Grease and debris also noted.

headline: Cold foods too warm; manager discarded $75 worth
summary: Cold TCS foods were held between 47.5F and 56.1F and must be 41F or below. The manager voluntarily discarded about 13 lbs worth $75. A front prep cooler at 48.7F was tagged, and citation issued. Openings at doors must be sealed.

headline: Floor debris and dusty hood vent
summary: A buildup of small debris was found on the floor under rear storage shelving and must be cleaned. The hood vent over the popcorn machines has dust buildup and needs cleaning.

headline: Cardboard used as floor mats; mops must dry
summary: Cardboard is being used as floor mats in the front prep area and must be replaced with non-absorbent, easily cleaned floor coverings. Mops must be hung to dry when not in use.

headline: No certified manager on site while preparing food
summary: No city certified food sanitation manager was on site while TCS foods like beef were prepped. Citation issued. No vomit and diarrhea kit or procedure was on site. Frozen meat was thawing in the prep area, and grease and debris were noted on equipment.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; cluttered basement
summary: Bulk flour and rice storage containers have no labels and must show contents. The basement storage area is cluttered and cannot be cleaned adequately. Items must be organized and raised at least six inches off the floor to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Food debris under three-compartment sink
summary: Food debris and dirt have built up on the floor under and around the three-compartment sink. The floor must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Failed: no hot water at restroom and mop sink
summary: The restroom washbowl sink and utility mop sink had no hot water. One reading was 41.2F. Hot water is available at the three-compartment sink and prep hand sinks. Priority violation. No food handler certificates were on site, and managers lack allergen training.

headline: Ice machine interior found not clean
summary: The top interior and interior shield plate of the ice machine were not clean. Staff were told to remove the ice, clean, sanitize, and maintain the machine.

headline: Dishwashing sink missing drain board and test strips
summary: The three-compartment dishwashing sink has no drain board, and no sanitizer test strips were on site. The operator was told to install a drain board and obtain test strips.

headline: Failed: live and dead roaches found
summary: A live American roach and dead roaches were found in rear prep and basement storage. Staff were told to clean and consult pest control. A 1/4-inch gap under the basement rear door needs sealing. No bodily fluid cleanup procedure was on site.

headline: Failed: no manager certificate; flies; cold food
summary: No manager certificate was posted or provided while chicken and beef were cooked and served. About 35 live small flies were found in prep, dining, and restroom areas. Lobster salad held at 56.8F was discarded. Slimy buildup was found in the ice machine. Citations issued.

headline: Hand soap missing at sink; labeling issues
summary: The front prep hand sink had no soap. Staff obtained soap during the inspection, and a citation was issued. A bar hand sink lacks a handwashing sign. Food storage containers lack common-name labels, and some food containers were on the walk-in freezer floor.

headline: Pizza cooler too warm; about 114 lbs discarded
summary: The pizza cooler held cold food above 41F, including grilled chicken at 55.6F and shredded cheese at 53.2F. Other cold foods were discarded, about 113.81 lbs worth $455. No written employee health policy was on site. Citation issued.

headline: Hot chicken held too cool; no paper towels
summary: About 5 lbs of diced chicken held at 109.2-110.3F in the steam table, which was low on water. All was discarded. No paper towels were at the dish hand sink. No food handler training proof or valid allergen certificate for the certified manager was on site.

headline: Failed: no manager; live roaches found
summary: No certified food manager or valid documentation was on site while sushi, rice, and soup were prepared. Two live cockroaches were found near the dishwashing area. Citation issued, and more pest control is needed. An ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine.

headline: Ice machine, wiping cloths, and floors need attention
summary: The ice machine interior needs detail cleaning. Wiping cloths must be kept in sanitizing solution. Bread pans were stored on the floor, a can opener needs cleaning, and rear storage floors need cleaning.

headline: Handwashing signage missing; devices above equipment
summary: Handwashing signs are missing at the front service counter hand sink and must be provided at all sinks. Insect control devices are above clean equipment and a hand sink, and must be relocated to avoid contamination.

headline: Failed: hand sinks lack water, soap, and drying
summary: The front bar has no hand sink with hot and cold water, and its hand sink lacks soap. The front prep hand sink lacks a hand drying device. These are priority violations, along with a missing mop sink and grease trap.

headline: No certified manager on duty during food prep
summary: No person in charge with a valid certificate was observed, and no certified food manager was on duty while chicken and steak were prepared and served. Citation issued. Dirt and debris are on the floor and drain under the soda station and in the basement.

headline: Restrooms lack covered trash receptacles
summary: No covered receptacle was present in the unisex restrooms. The person in charge must provide and maintain one.

headline: Failed: 3 live cockroaches in prep area
summary: Three live cockroaches were crawling on a prep and cooking area wall. Citation issued. Undercooked menu items had no asterisk or consumer advisory. The ice machine has calcium buildup, and several cleaning and repair items were noted.

headline: No handwashing signs and covered receptacles missing
summary: No proof of a signed employee health policy was on site. Handwashing signs are missing at prep sinks and the first toilet room. Toilet rooms lack covered receptacles for disposal of feminine products.

headline: Cooler lacks thermometer; sink stoppers missing
summary: A two-door low boy cooler in front prep has no thermometer. The three-compartment sink has no stoppers. An unused reach-in cooler in rear prep must be removed. No allergen training certificates were on site.

headline: Scoops stored in containers; floors need cleaning
summary: Scoops for salt, sugar, and similar containers were stored inside the containers and must be stored between uses. Loose debris and food spills are on floors and corners throughout the facility and need detail cleaning.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings, roaches, flies; no manager
summary: No city certified manager was on site while fish was prepared and served. Live roaches, about 75 small flies, about 10 large flies, and about 50 rodent droppings were found. Also no employee health policy, no vomit kit, and no inspection summary posted. Citations issued.

headline: Meat cooler too warm; about 200 lbs discarded
summary: Meat display cooler held foods between 45.0F and 48.8F, above the 41F limit. Around 200 lbs worth $1,000 were discarded. Cooler air measured 48.7F, and a citation was issued. Pork skins drying against a wall need a barrier. A cutting board has deep cuts.

headline: Soil buildup on rear floors, walls, and ceilings
summary: Floors, walls, and ceilings in the rear area have soil buildup. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Back door open; worn sponges and cutting boards
summary: A back door was found open and should stay closed to keep pests out. Worn and discolored sponges must be discontinued or changed often. Cutting boards with deep cuts must be replaced. Floors by the dish machine and hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Failed: flies found; no hand-drying at sinks
summary: No hand drying provision was at the prep and rear dish hand sinks. Priority citation issued. About 15-20 large and small flies were found in several food service areas. Chicken was stored on the walk-in cooler floor, and shelving inside the walk-in is badly rusting.

headline: Cleaning and ceiling tile repairs needed
summary: Cabinets behind the service counter and in the dining area need cleaning. Floors in the rear corners and around the grease trap need cleaning. Damaged ceiling tiles in the front dining area must be replaced.

headline: Employees eating at prep area; debris and clutter
summary: Employees were drinking and preparing food at the kitchen prep area and need a designated break area. A cutting board was stored on the floor. Dirty wiping cloths were on prep tables. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks, and storage areas have clutter that can hide pests.

headline: Minor debris on floors and under shelving
summary: Minor dirt and small debris were on the floor in corners and along walls under shelving and equipment. The operator was told to clean all areas.

headline: Serving plates stored upright; stained ceiling tiles
summary: Serving plates on prep-area shelves were not stored properly and must be inverted to prevent dust. Stained ceiling tiles in dry storage and the hot water room need repair. Dirt and grease buildup in the exhaust hood and filters need detail cleaning.

headline: Missing insulation and manager allergen training
summary: Cold lines in the walk-in cooler lack insulation and must be installed to prevent condensation. Small water spills occur when opening the three-compartment sink drains. The food service manager has no allergen training certificate.

headline: Refrigeration units lack thermometers
summary: Refrigeration units, including meat display coolers, have no thermometers inside to monitor ambient temperature. Operator was told to equip all units with working thermometers. An employee also lacks food handler training certification.

headline: No employee health policy; backflow device needed
summary: No employee health policy or training was found on site. This is a priority violation. The backflow device is not located behind the ice machine and must be installed where it can be serviced. The mop sink faucet also needs a backflow device.

headline: Ice maker debris; missing sink stoppers
summary: Debris is encrusted inside the ice maker and must be removed, detail cleaned, and serviced. The bar three-compartment sink is missing stoppers and needs three working stoppers. An allergen training certificate must be kept on site.

headline: Food buildup on walls; missing handler training
summary: Food buildup is on walls at the front prep cookline and must be cleaned. Some food handlers lack training certificates, and the manager was told all handlers must be certified with employee names on premises.

headline: Deli cups not air dried after washing
summary: Deli cups were not air dried after washing and stacking. Operator was told to air dry all multi-use utensils.

headline: Coffee, espresso, and ice machines lack backflow devices
summary: The newly installed coffee machine, espresso machine, and ice maker in the prep area have no backflow preventer. The operator was told to install devices that can be located, serviced, and maintained.

headline: Retail packaged foods missing label information
summary: Packaged bread, salad, and cookies offered for retail sale were missing required label information. The operator must add labels with the proper information.

headline: Toilet fill problem; grease under fryers
summary: A men's bathroom toilet tank does not always fill, though the toilet works after the handle is jiggled. Staff were told to service it. Grease and food debris are on floors below the deep fryers and need detail cleaning.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; dusty floors
summary: Milk crates are being used as shelving in prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. A men's restroom faucet handle is broken. Dirt and dust buildup on floors and corners must be cleaned.

headline: Hand sink blocked; sanitizer at 0 ppm
summary: The front prep hand sink was blocked by stored tomatoes and a beverage, which the manager removed. The dish sink had 0 ppm chlorine, and all dishes must be rewashed. Cooked beef cooling at 112.6F must be reheated and recooled. Citations issued.

headline: Cold water knobs faulty; floors need cleaning
summary: The cold water knob does not properly turn on at the hand sink, and the three-compartment sink in the meat prep area has no cold water knob. Dirt and debris on floors under the hot holding unit and in the meat walk-in need cleaning.

headline: Washroom doors and unfinished bricks
summary: Washroom doors are not self-closing and must have a self-closing device installed. Rough, unfinished brick walls in the second-floor washroom must be refinished so they are smooth and easily cleaned.

headline: Food splatter and new hire without food handler card
summary: Food splatter was on the wall near the three-compartment sink. A new hire had no food handler certificate on site. Staff were told to complete training within 90 days and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Failed: no hot water; mouse droppings and flies
summary: No hot water throughout facility; prep sinks measured 76-77F. Fried chicken at 83F and raw chicken at up to 67.8F were discarded. About 25-35 mouse droppings were in rear storage, and 6-10 big flies were in prep. Priority citations issued; no food handler certificates on site.

headline: Roasted corn held too warm; discarded on site
