summary: Roasted corn was held at 50.9F, above the 41F limit, and was voluntarily discarded on site, a citation was issued. The menu lacked a raw or undercooked food advisory. Openings at the entrance and garage door need sealing, and ceiling condensation dripped onto clean equipment.

headline: Sink drain debris and missing restroom trash cover
summary: Inspector saw slight debris buildup under the three-compartment sink and no covered receptacle in the women's employee restroom. Staff were told to clean and to provide one.

headline: Hot-holding warmers lack internal thermometers
summary: Upright hot-holding warmers were missing internal ambient air thermometers. The operator was told to add at least one visible thermometer to each unit used to hold food.

headline: Missing handwash signs and allergen certificate
summary: Employee handwashing signs were missing above hand sinks. The coffee area had no dump sink for waste water. No allergen training certificate was on site for certified food managers.

headline: Gap at entrance door; food on floor; no training
summary: A quarter-inch gap between front entrance doors needed sealing. Food was stored on floors in several areas, and packaged pastries lacked labels. A food handler lacked a hair restraint, and no food handler training was available for employees.

headline: Rat droppings and dead rat; unsafe cooler temperatures
summary: Over 100 rat droppings were found across kitchen and basement areas, and one dead rat was on a basement floor. Shrimp, eggs, and cooked chicken in a reach-in cooler were held at 45 to 48F and discarded. The cooler was tagged and must not be used until repaired.

headline: Cardboard used as shelf and floor liner
summary: Cardboard was used as a liner on shelving and on the floor under equipment in the dish area. Staff were instructed to remove it and use smooth, cleanable surfaces.

headline: Missing backflow device; burnt-out cooler bulb
summary: No backflow prevention device was at the utility mop sink. A burnt-out light bulb was inside the two-door stand-up cooler. Both were to be corrected.

headline: Toilet-room hand sink water too cold
summary: The hand sink in the toilet room was measured at 70F. Inspectors require at least 100F water at hand sinks. This priority violation resulted in a citation.

headline: Certified managers lack allergen training proof
summary: No allergen training certificates for certified food managers were on the premises. Management was instructed that each certified food manager must show proof.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; soiled mop heads
summary: The rear prep door was not fully rodent-proof and has a quarter-inch gap that must be sealed. Milk crates were used for storage at the walk-in cooler. Grease and debris were on equipment and shelves, and four to five light bulbs were burnt out.

headline: Storage box interiors need minor cleaning
summary: Interiors of ingredient storage boxes had small amounts of debris. The operator was told to clean them and keep them maintained.

headline: About five dead cockroaches; greasy stove
summary: About five dead cockroaches were found on shelving near the dish machine and under dry storage shelving. Several cold-holding units lacked thermometers. Stove and warewashing floors had grease and dried food. A summary report from 2023 was posted and cited.

headline: Reach-in coolers need cleaning; compartment sink dry
summary: Reach-in cooler interiors needed detail cleaning. One prep compartment sink had no running water because a pipe was reportedly broken inside the wall. Clutter and floor debris and dust were also noted.

headline: Broken gasket and grout needs repair
summary: A broken rubber gasket was on a two-door reach-in cooler in the kitchen. Floor tiles with deep seams in the dish area needed regrouting. Unused items in second-floor and basement storage needed to be removed.

headline: Cooler at 73.8F; no health policy; rodent gap
summary: A refrigerator held food at 73.8F, and a hot-holding unit was off. Both were tagged held for inspection. No employee health policy was provided, a priority citation. A small opening at the rear exit door needed rodent-proofing. A leaking pipe and no cooler thermometers were also noted.

headline: Cooking equipment and floor cleaning needed
summary: Exterior cooking equipment needed cleaning where needed. Floors and walls around and under cooking and kitchen equipment needed cleaning, and corners of the basement storage room floor needed cleaning.

headline: Re-inspection: missing health policy and trash service
summary: No signed employee health policy and no outside trash receptacle or contract were on site, both priority items. Also found: dried food debris on stored cooking equipment, a greasy receptacle, and a broken wall base.

headline: No certified manager on duty; cited
summary: No valid City of Chicago certified manager was on duty, a priority citation. Ambient thermometers were missing from reach-in and display coolers. Food containers were unlabeled, food stored on the walk-in freezer floor, and some food was uncovered. The three-compartment sink drain leaked.

headline: Ice machine buildup; scoop stored improperly
summary: A slight buildup was found inside the ice machine, and the ice scoop was stored on top of the machine. Food and dirt buildup was on the bar floor corner, and dust covered the hood filters. Staff were told to clean each item.

headline: Mouse droppings and insects; hot water missing
summary: Ten mouse droppings were found in an electrical panel and prep floor, and flying insects were in the dish area. The manager was told to call an exterminator. A dish machine was not operable, two coolers were not operable, and sinks had no hot water.

headline: Quarter-inch gap at front door bottom
summary: A quarter-inch gap at the bottom of the front door must be repaired to keep pests out. A freezer gasket was in poor repair and ice had built up inside it. Floors under soda syrup boxes and grill filters needed cleaning.

headline: Blocked hand sink; missing paper towels
summary: A dishwashing-area hand sink was blocked by a food container, mops, and supplies, and the manager removed them during inspection. Paper towels were missing at a front hand sink and employee restroom and were provided on site. Ice machine and caulking were also noted.

headline: Expired training certificates for all food staff
summary: All food handlers had expired food handler certificates, and the certified food manager's allergen certificate was expired. Also found: a torn cooler door gasket, a drain leak under the three-compartment sink, and a restroom door without a self-closing device.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; flying insects in prep
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were found across sales, storage, and prep areas, and numerous flying insects were in produce prep. The manager was told to call an exterminator and clean all areas. A citation was issued, and fly strips were removed.

headline: Loose baseboard and cracked tile
summary: A loose baseboard and cracked tile were found in the rear prep and dry storage area and along the wall by the three-compartment sink. The person in charge was told to repair them.

headline: Debris in cold units; water-damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Debris was found inside cold-hold units throughout the facility. Water-damaged ceiling tiles were noted in the sales and counter areas. Debris, clutter, and litter were found on floors and in corners of rear storage. The person in charge was told to correct each item.

headline: Dish racks on floor; torn cooler gaskets
summary: Dish racks sat on the floor in the dishwashing area and downstairs bar and must be raised at least six inches. Torn gaskets were found inside the in-room dining beverage cooler. The operator was instructed to repair them.

headline: Electric fly swatter near food prep table
summary: An electric fly swatter was placed near a food prep table. The inspector instructed staff to remove it.

headline: No certified manager on site; mold-like ice bin
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager was on site while food was prepared, a priority citation. Mold-like buildup was inside the ice bin, also cited. Prep area cooling units had no thermometers, and dry storage items were stored improperly behind black curtains.

headline: No covered trash in basement restroom
summary: The basement women's restroom had no covered trash receptacle, and the person in charge was told to provide one. Dirty floor drains were found by the ice machine and under the three-compartment sink in prep and warewashing areas.

headline: No certified sanitation certificate on site
summary: No person on site held a posted City of Chicago food sanitation certificate, a priority violation that was cited. The shared refuse area had boxes along the walls, a repeat violation that was not corrected and can harbor pests. No allergen certificate was on site.

headline: Stored items on floor; ice machine soiled
summary: Seating items, boxes, and equipment were stored on the basement floor. Cardboard lined reach-in coolers, and wood shelving behind the bar was not sealed. The ice machine was heavily soiled inside and must be detail-cleaned before use. Restroom issues included a missing door closer and missing vent covers.

headline: No health policy; fly trap over prep; cited
summary: No written employee health policy was on site, and a priority citation was issued. Staff completed the policy during inspection. An electric fly trap hangs over prep and dry storage and must be moved. Food was on the floor, and the freezer had excess ice.

headline: No hot water at hand sink; repeat violations
summary: The exposed rear hand sink had no hot water, measured at 72F. The plumber restored it to 100F during the inspection, and a citation was issued. No health policy, hand-sign, or thermometer was present. Earlier core violations were not corrected, including crates on the walk-in floor.

headline: Dish machine failed sanitizing; cooler temperatures high
summary: The chlorine dish machine measured 0 ppm and was tagged, with no dishes washed. A cooler held about 5 pounds of soy and tofu at 49.8 to 51.1F, and all food was discarded. The cooler was also tagged. No kitchen employee food handler certificate was on site.

headline: Soiled mop heads; no food handler certificates
summary: Soiled mop heads were not stored properly, and unused equipment was stored in the basement. No food handler certificates were on site. The food service sanitation manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: No employee health policy on site
summary: No employee health policy was on site at the time of inspection. The operator was told to have verified copies for each employee on site at all times. No citation was issued.

headline: Missing hand sink; sneeze guard and debris needed
summary: The rear prep and dish room had no hand sink, a priority citation. A sneeze guard was needed on the open bread display. Unused items and construction materials were in the basement, and the walk-in cooler wall was chipping.

headline: No certified manager; frozen chicken thawing improperly
summary: No certified food manager was on site while open, a priority citation. Frozen chicken wings were thawing at room temperature in a sink. The three-compartment sink leaked from a pipe and was cited. Several core violations from earlier were not corrected.

headline: Faucet in disrepair; kitchen hood bulb out
summary: A faucet in the women's receiving-area restroom was in disrepair and must be repaired. A light bulb at the kitchen ventilation hood was not working and must be replaced.

headline: Blocked hand sink cleared on site; cited
summary: A basement hand sink was blocked by crates and containers, and the person in charge removed them on site. A citation was issued. Also noted: a missing front-line cooler thermometer, a leaking utility sink hose, and missing base coving.

headline: Cold food at unsafe temperatures; citations issued
summary: Ham was at 52F, sour cream 61F, cooked rice 44F, and sausage 71F, all above the 41F limit. Management was told to discard the food. A prep cooler reached 60F. Several food handlers lacked training certificates, and a citation was issued.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; corrected on site
summary: The low-temperature dish machine measured 0 ppm chlorine. It was repaired and sanitizing at 50 ppm before the inspection ended, and a citation was issued. No pest control logbook was on premises, and one was delivered on site. Entrance door openings need sealing.

headline: Cigars and ash found; faucet sprays water
summary: Cigars and rolled cigarettes were found on a shelf, and ash was inside a cheese sauce container. This priority violation was cited. The three-compartment faucet sprayed water, and soda crates were used as shelving outside the walk-in cooler.

headline: Missing handwash sign; wet wiping cloths
summary: A handwash sign was missing at the beverage prep hand sink, and the operator was told to install one. Wet wiping cloths were left on several prep surfaces and must be stored in sanitizing solution.

headline: Slight buildup inside ice machine
summary: A slight buildup was found inside the upper portion of the ice machine. The manager was instructed to clean the interior and keep it maintained.

headline: About 15 dead ants; pest technician placed bait
summary: About 15 dead ants were found near drains in the rear warewashing area. The person in charge removed them and cleaned the area, and a pest technician on site placed bait. A leaking drainpipe at the three-compartment sink and expired food handler certificates were also noted.

headline: Rodent activity found again; no certified manager
summary: Rat droppings were found in the basement, under the grill, and on shelves, and mouse droppings were found across the first floor. No certified manager was on site while food was served. The manager was told to call pest control again.

headline: No certified food manager while TCS food prepared
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager was present while milk and sausage were prepared, a priority violation. Sinks had food and dirt buildup, and walls and ceiling tiles in the lower-level prep area had food debris.

headline: No certified manager during food service
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager was on site while ham, cheese, and cut fruit were prepared and served, a priority citation. The manager arrived about 75 minutes into the inspection. Wiping cloths were improperly stored, and a food handler lacked training.

headline: Ice chute build-up; food debris on floors
summary: The ice machine chute needed detail cleaning. Plateware at the hot line was not inverted, and wiping cloths were not in sanitizing solution. The front bar area had build-up on shelves, tables, corners, and floor drains.

headline: Mussels without shellstock tag discarded
summary: Mussels were held in a main-kitchen prep cooler without a shellstock tag. About 10 pounds, worth $50, were discarded and a citation was issued. Unlabeled spices and a dish machine door that would not fully close were also noted.

headline: Dead bugs in light shields; leaking sink faucet
summary: Light shields in the rear prep area held dead bugs, and staff were told to clean them. The rear two-compartment sink faucet base was leaking. Floors under equipment had food and debris, and the restroom fan was not working.

headline: Food containers not inverted; small hand-sink leak
summary: Food containers were not stored inverted, and staff were told to correct this. A small leak was found at a hand sink in the rear preparation area, and the inspector said it must be repaired.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies on site
summary: No supplies were on site for cleaning up vomiting or diarrhea events, a priority item. Handwash signs and a covered restroom receptacle were missing. Exposed brick walls and floor debris in the basement were also noted.

headline: High-temperature dish machine held for inspection
summary: The high-temperature dish machine's final rinse measured 150F and must reach 180F. It was tagged held for inspection and may not be used until repaired and re-inspected by the Chicago Department of Public Health.

headline: Floor drains, grill grease, and sink pipe leak
summary: Floor drains needed detail cleaning, and grease and food debris were under the front grill. A pipe behind the dish machine was leaking and was tagged red. Standing water and floor debris were noted.

headline: Multiple cleaning, storage, and training items
summary: Re-inspection noted a slow drain at a restroom hand sink, unlabeled containers, and utensils not inverted. Worn cutting boards, crates used for storage, and debris in fryers, floors, and walls also needed correction. No allergen training was provided.

headline: Single-use items not inverted; allergen training missing
summary: Single-use service items were not inverted to protect them from contamination. A certified manager had no allergen training. The manager was told to invert all items and provide training.

headline: Service coolers held food above safe temperatures
summary: Pasta, chicken, noodles, ravioli, and spinach in service coolers were measured between 45.5F and 55.4F. The manager voluntarily discarded 14 pounds of product. Serving plates on shelves also needed to be inverted.

headline: No certified manager; hand sink blocked
summary: No person in charge or certified food manager was on duty while TCS food was prepared and served, a priority citation. The dish-area hand sink was blocked by buckets and chemicals, and employees removed them immediately on site. Dirty wiping cloths were noted.

headline: Torn gasket on prep low-boy cooler
summary: The right-side rubber gasket on a two-door prep low-boy cooler was ripped. The operator must repair or replace it.

headline: No backflow devices at ice and coffee machines
summary: No backflow prevention devices were found at the ice machine, espresso machine, or drip coffee machines. The operator must provide them where they can be serviced.

headline: Dish rack on floor; food handler certificates unverified
summary: Slight dark residue was found inside the ice machine panel. A dish rack was on the floor under the dish machine and was to be raised six inches. Food handler certificates could not be verified on site.

headline: Over 30 mouse droppings; priority pest citation
summary: Over 30 mouse droppings were found in the rear storage area, 20 in the boiler room, and over 15 by cooking equipment. The operator was told to clean and sanitize and to contact licensed pest control. This priority violation resulted in a citation.

headline: Missing ceiling light cover above dish area
summary: One ceiling light bulb cover was missing above the dish area. The operator must provide a cover and keep it in place.

headline: Ice machine heavily soiled; several sink and food issues
summary: Ice machine surfaces were heavily soiled with black, slime-like buildup. Ice was discarded, the machine was cleaned on site, and use was voluntarily stopped. Raw beef was thawing at room temperature. A blocked handwash sink was cleared on site.

headline: No metal thermometers; no pest logbook
summary: No metal-stem food thermometers, pest control logbook, or sanitizing test strips were on premises, all priority items. Three-compartment sink stoppers were not working, and no allergen training certificate was on site.

headline: Missing thermometers, unlabeled food, and floor storage
summary: Reach-in and display coolers lacked ambient air thermometers, and food containers were unlabeled. Food was stored on floors in walk-in and storage areas. Plates were not inverted, and grease buildup was on cooking equipment and walls. Burned-out hood bulbs were noted.

headline: Hair restraints missing; cardboard shelf liners
summary: Food handlers in the prep area were not wearing hair restraints. Soiled linens were drying on a hand sink splash guard. Cardboard was used as shelf liner, and wood shelving was not sealed. Cloth curtains were very dirty.

headline: No bar hand sink; repeat violations; cited
summary: No hand sink was in the bar where drinks are poured, a priority item that was repeated. Cardboard, foil, and plastic covered storage surfaces. The ice machine had no backflow device. Several employees had expired or missing food handler training.

headline: Taped cooler gasket; greasy microwave and hood
summary: A two-door rear cooler's gasket was repaired with tape and must be replaced. The microwave needed detail cleaning, interiors of two coolers had food spillage, and hood filters had grease buildup.

headline: No pest control logbook on premises
summary: No pest control logbook from the current pest company was on site. Management was told to provide one with recent inspection reports. This was a priority violation, and a citation was issued. Staff were also told to clean a prep table shelf and grease on a wall.

headline: Pizza prep hand sink leaking from pedal
summary: The hot and cold water pedal on the pizza prep hand sink was leaking, and the floor was wet. The inspector required the pedal be repaired and the floor kept dry.

headline: Missing handwash sign at grill dish area
summary: A handwash sign was missing for the handwash sink in the grill and dishwashing area. The operator was told to provide one.

headline: Plastic cup used as ice scoop; freezer ice buildup
summary: A plastic cup was being used as an ice scoop, and the manager provided a proper scoop during the inspection. Excessive ice had built up on the walk-in freezer floor and compressor. Employee belongings in dry food storage were removed on site.

headline: No certified manager while beef and chicken prepared
summary: No certified food manager was on site while beef and chicken were prepared and served, a priority citation. The person in charge was told to keep one on site at all times. A water filter was removed from a hand sink used only for handwashing.

headline: Minor grease buildup inside fryers
summary: Minor grease buildup was found inside the fryers. Staff were told to clean and maintain them.

headline: No health policy; no food handler certificates
summary: No employee health policy was on site, and the person in charge was given a priority reminder. No backflow device was found on the utility sink. No food handler certificates were on site at the time of inspection.

headline: No cooler thermometers; leaking sink; unlabeled bins
summary: Cold-holding units lacked thermometers, and three sushi-area food bins were unlabeled. A prep cooler door would not stay closed. A bakery hand sink kept running after the pedal was released. Floors in prep and walk-in areas had grease, debris, and sticky liquid.

headline: No certified food manager on premises
summary: No City of Chicago certified food service manager was on premises, a priority violation that was cited. Single-use boxes were stored on the basement floor, and the women's washroom had no covered receptacle.

headline: Dead roaches in multiple areas; repeat violations
summary: Dead roaches were found on dry storage floors, behind the stove, inside a prep cooler, and under the POS unit. Earlier violations were not corrected, including dead roaches on stairs and grease and debris on equipment and walk-in floors. A citation was issued.

headline: Entrance door gap and hair restraint lapses
summary: A half-inch gap between front entrance doors was found, and the manager was told to seal it. Food handlers in the produce area were not wearing hair restraints. Display cooler interiors were dusty and soiled.

headline: Missing hand soap and towels at sink
summary: The rear prep and dish-area hand sink had no soap or paper towels, both priority items. A frozen chicken was thawing at room temperature in a prep sink. Walk-in walls and floors behind the grease trap were dirty.

headline: No certified manager for 25 minutes; leaking sink
summary: No certified manager was present from 2:05 to 2:30 PM while milk was being prepared, a priority citation. Unlabeled bulk foods and food stored in plastic bags were noted. The three-compartment sink leaked onto the floor and was cited.

headline: Handwashing lapses; overfilled recycling bin
summary: An employee washed hands without soap and was made to rewash on site. Another handled raw chicken and moved on without washing, then washed hands. An overfilled outside recycling bin could not close, and a priority citation was issued. A certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Hair restraints missing; minor sink leak
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution, and a minor leak was found at the rear three-compartment sink. A soiled mop head was not hung to dry.

headline: Cooking equipment and dish-area floor need cleaning
summary: Complaint inspection found cooking equipment with food spills that needed cleaning. The dish area floor had standing water that needed to be cleaned up.

headline: Rear door gap; grease and floor damage
summary: A gap at the bottom right corner of the rear door must be sealed to be tight-fitting. Grease and food debris were on prep tables and cooler shelving. Damaged ceiling and floor tiles, greasy walls, and standing water and debris in prep areas also needed correction.

headline: Rust on prep tables; washroom fan broken
summary: Several metal prep tables had rust on their bottom shelves that must be removed and sealed. The washroom mechanical ventilation was broken. The certified food manager's allergen certificate was expired.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; damaged floors
summary: Milk crates were being used as shelving and must be replaced with shelving raised six inches off the floor. Missing and damaged floor tiles, missing grout, and stained, water-swollen ceiling tiles were also noted.

headline: Front bar floor drains need detail cleaning
summary: Floor drains at the front bar needed detail cleaning to remove build-up. The operator was told to clean and maintain them.

headline: No thermometers in refrigeration; poor lighting
summary: No thermometers were found in refrigeration units. Lighting at the three-compartment sink in the kitchen was poor. The operator was told to add thermometers and replace bulbs.

headline: Stained cutting boards and damaged meat-prep floor
summary: Heavily stained cutting boards with deep grooves were in the produce area and needed replacing. The rear meat-prep floor was worn and missing a surface, which left standing water and debris.

headline: Re-inspection: plumbing corrected on site
summary: The backflow issue was corrected during the re-inspection. Unused chairs, pots, and pans stored in the basement were to be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Missing thermometer; hair restraint lapse
summary: The front prep milk cooler lacked a visible thermometer. An employee prepared food without a hair restraint. Vents were dusty, items were not elevated, and personal belongings were stored in food storage areas.

headline: Repeat violations not fixed; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: Re-inspection found a previous priority violation still not corrected: no covered restroom receptacle, no allergen certificate, and food debris around the wok station. A citation was issued. A quarter-inch gap at the garage door was also noted.

headline: Hand sink near ice bin needs splash guard
summary: A hand sink near the ice storage container had no splash guard to prevent contamination. The manager was instructed to install one.

headline: No hot water at sinks; no probe thermometer
summary: No hot water was available at the three-compartment sink and several hand sinks, which read 57 to 59F. A citation was issued, and the manager restored hot water before the inspection ended. No probe thermometer was on site, also cited. Leaks were noted.

headline: Cold handwash water, flies, openings, leaks
summary: Handwash sink water measured 77.6°F; at least 100°F is required, priority citation issued. About 15 small flies were near the dish machine. Openings at entrance doors need sealing. Bug lights hang over food areas. Deli sink faucets and grease trap leak or overflow.

headline: Splashguard needed; leaking drain; fan out
summary: A splashguard must go between the handwashing and three-compartment sinks. Stovetop, microwave, and grease trap need cleaning. The mop sink drain in the employee washroom leaks. The customer washroom ventilation fan does not work.

headline: Unlabeled bulk flour and sugar; broken coolers
summary: Bulk containers of flour, sugar, and others are unlabeled; labels with common name required. Expired sanitizer on the low-temperature dish machine. Grease on used-oil container in the alley. Microwave is dirty. Two broken basement coolers must be repaired or removed.

headline: Grease and debris under cooking equipment
summary: Grease and debris were found under cooking equipment in the food prep area. The operator must clean and maintain the area.

headline: Fryer grease buildup; missing food handler certificates
summary: Fryer interior had accumulated food and grease debris. Minor dirt was found behind cooking and refrigeration units. No food handler certificates or allergen training certificate were available for review.

headline: Front door gaps; food on floor; cleaning needed
summary: Gaps along the front entry door must be made tight-fitting. Food on the rear storage floor must be elevated; food crates must be eliminated. Greasy surfaces, floor debris, and dusty vents need cleaning. Damaged floor tiles need repair.

headline: Hands not washed between tasks; no certified manager
summary: A food handler cooked, washed dishes, and returned to cooking without washing hands; priority citation. No certified manager was present until 1:45 PM. No proof of person-in-charge training. No cold-food thermometer.

headline: No pest control logbook; damaged faucet; wall hole
summary: No current or previous pest control logbook; priority citation issued. Washroom faucet is damaged. Restroom lacks a covered receptacle. A large hole in the wall near the front basement stairs must be sealed. No food handler training certificates were on site.

headline: No certified manager on duty while cooking
summary: No certified food manager on duty while beef and noodles were prepared; priority citation issued. No certified person in charge. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. Loose debris and dust on floors throughout need detail cleaning.

headline: Wall holes, cracked toilet floor, door
summary: Large holes in the prep area wall near the toilet room and exit door must be enclosed to prevent pest entry. The toilet room floor is detached and cracked. The toilet room door is not self-closing and must be repaired.

headline: Repeat violations: grease, debris, no trash lid
summary: Previous violations were not corrected; priority citation issued. Clean the wok station and prep cooler interiors, grease and debris under cooking equipment, hood filters, and walls. Employee washroom lacks a covered waste receptacle.

headline: No soap, no basement handsink, damaged coolers
summary: No soap at the front prep handsink; the manager supplied it during inspection. Basement food prep had no handwashing sink; priority citation issued. Cooler gaskets are torn, a cooler door is broken, and a three-compartment sink does not work.

headline: Employee restroom trash receptacle lacks lid
summary: The rear employee washroom had a garbage receptacle without a lid. Trash cans with lids must be provided in all women's and unisex washrooms.

headline: Grease buildup, debris, and leaking faucet
summary: Grease and food debris were on the sides of cooking equipment. Debris was under walk-in cooler shelving. A leak was found at the base of the bar handsink faucet. Grease under fryers and debris in dish-area drains need cleaning.

headline: Cardboard boxes; missing food handler certificates
summary: Numerous cardboard boxes by the mop sink must be removed. No food handler training certificates were on site. No allergen training certificates for certified managers were on site. The operator must provide all of them.

headline: Manager present; dirty hood, ceilings, and bar
summary: Certified manager on site while food prepared; priority citation issued for lack of a certificate holder on site while open. Beverage racks used as shelving. Hood filters, grates, and bulbs are dirty. Peeling paint; a burned-out bar light bulb.

headline: Unwrapped straws improperly stored
summary: Unwrapped single-service beverage straws were stored improperly on the lower level at the ramen area. Food- or lip-contact single-service items must be wrapped or from an approved dispenser.

headline: Clutter, dirt, and food debris in storage
summary: Minor clutter by the rear hot water heater needs organizing. Dirt and food debris are behind the food storage racks and shelves in the rear storage area. Operator instructed to clean all of it.

headline: Dairy held too warm; dish machine 137°F
summary: Restroom handsinks measured 70.2–70.3°F, below the 100°F minimum. Milk, half-and-half, and cream held at 46.6–55.8°F; about 90 lbs discarded. Barista cooler at 49.6°F was tagged. Dish machine at 137°F; must be 150°F or higher. Menu notice added on site.

headline: Debris, wall openings, repeat training violation
summary: Debris found in cabinets under the grill and fryers, light shields, and floors. Openings along ceilings and baseboards need sealing. Carryout containers not inverted. Food handler training still missing from a prior violation; citation issued.

headline: Handwash signage needed; ice machine residue
summary: Handwashing signage needed at the prep-area handsink. A small amount of pink residue was found inside the ice machine. Operator instructed to schedule cleaning.

headline: Blocked handsinks; live cat in basement
summary: Handsinks were blocked by containers and cups; a front sink drained onto the floor. Chicken was thawing in a three-compartment sink. A live cat lay on equipment in basement storage; removal ordered, priority citation issued.

headline: Missing thermometer, unlabeled desserts, hair restraint
summary: No thermometer in the two-door reach-in cooler. Packaged desserts in the grab-and-go cooler lacked labels. One employee had no hair restraint. A cutting board is scratched, a cooler gasket is torn, and floor debris is under cooking equipment.

headline: No dessert cooler thermometer; leaking drain
summary: No thermometers in the dessert reach-in cooler in the rear prep area; they must be provided for all hot and cold holding equipment. A drain pipe leaks under the exposed handsink. Pizza dough debris covers the walk-in cooler floor.

headline: Rusted grease trap; mold in caulking
summary: The bottom of the grease trap is rusted throughout; it must be repaired or replaced. Caulking above the three-compartment sink is filled with black mold-like substance and must be removed.

headline: Missing handwash sign; cutting board; uncovered light
summary: No handwashing sign at the rear prep/dish handsink. A cutting board has heavy cuts and must be resurfaced or replaced. A wet mop was stored in a bucket by the handsink. A light in the prep area lacks its protective cover.

headline: Missing covered receptacles; certificates not found
summary: The women's employee restroom lacked covered receptacles. Food handler certificates could not be located or verified during inspection. Operator must provide them and keep them on site.

headline: Garbage receptacle without lid in restroom
summary: The employee unisex toilet room has a garbage receptacle without a lid. The operator must provide a lid.

headline: Leaking tea bar faucet; plates not inverted
summary: Plates were not inverted after sanitizing. The tea bar prep handsink faucet leaks. Unisex and bar restrooms lack covered receptacles for feminine products. A hood light bulb is burned out.

headline: Wiping cloths left out; deep cutting board grooves
summary: Wiping cloths were left on counters and prep stations rather than stored in sanitizing solution. A kitchen cutting board has deep grooves and must be resurfaced or replaced. Wet mops were not stored upright. Dusty vents in dish area and men's washroom.

headline: Cluttered prep areas; damaged floor tiles; grease
summary: No handwashing sign at the prep-area sink. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the front door. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, shelving, coolers, and freezers. Slow-draining handsink and leaking three-compartment faucet. Hood has grease buildup.

headline: Cooler at 47.7°F tagged; foil shelf liners
summary: A front coffee-area refrigeration unit held at 47.7°F; no cold foods were inside. It must hold 41°F or colder. Tagged and not to be used until repaired. Aluminum foil lines shelving. Mop sink lacks a backflow device; one cooler bulb burned out.

headline: Scratched cutting boards; cardboard shelf liners
summary: Multiple cutting boards in the rear prep area are deeply scratched and stained. Cardboard lines shelving and must be removed. Basement storage is cluttered, and items on the floor must be elevated.

headline: Pork and fish thawed at room temperature
summary: Pork and fish were thawing at room temperature in the dish/prep area and stored on the floor. Flour, sugar, and cornmeal lacked labels. Wet mops were left on floors. Management instructed to correct each item.

headline: Rear door gap; cutting boards; floors need cleaning
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door must be repaired to prevent pests. Cutting boards have deep grooves and stains. Basement walk-in and cooler floors need detail cleaning; dish area floors, walls, and hood filters also need cleaning.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; no allergen certificate
summary: The low-temperature dish machine was not sanitizing; chlorine measured 0 ppm. Repair required; priority violation and citation issued. Grease on the floor under cooking equipment must be cleaned. Certified manager lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: Slow drains, burnt-out bulbs, torn cooler gasket
summary: The three-compartment sink drains slowly; the grease trap needs cleaning. Two ceiling bulbs are burned out near the dish area and women's employee washroom. A cooler drawer gasket is torn.

headline: Declutter prep area; elevate stock items
summary: Detail clean and organize the food prep area. Remove unnecessary articles to reduce pest hiding spots. Elevate stock items at least six inches off the floor to make cleaning possible.

headline: Clean kitchen equipment area and washroom fan
summary: Clean walls and floors around, under, and behind kitchen equipment where needed. Clean the dusty washroom ceiling fan. Food handlers and managers must obtain the required training.

headline: Ice scoop stored inside ice machine
summary: An ice scoop was stored directly inside the ice machine. It must be stored outside the machine to avoid contamination.

headline: No vomit kit; leaking bar sink; date marking
summary: No kit or procedure for vomit or diarrhea; priority citation issued. A bar handsink leaks, bar three-compartment sinks are clogged, and a women's handsink lacks hot water. Ready-to-eat shrimp and sweet potatoes lacked date marks.

headline: Live flies in raw meat prep; insect traps
summary: About 3–5 large live flies flew in the raw meat/deli prep area, with other signs of pest activity. Insect trap strips and lights were in food prep areas. Handwashing signs and food handler certificates were missing. Pest citation issued.

headline: No proof of food handler or allergen training
summary: Heavy white dust in the employee washroom ventilation needs deep cleaning. No proof of food handler training for any food handler, and no proof of allergen training for certified managers. Records must be kept on site.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; improper utensils
summary: No handwashing sign at the rear dishwashing sink. Small plastic cups were used as dispensing utensils. Single-use utensils at the wait station were not inverted. Manager instructed to correct each item.

headline: About 30 live flying insects; no certified manager
summary: About 30 live small flying insects were on walls, ceilings, equipment, and stock in dish and dry storage areas; more pest service needed; priority citation. No valid sanitation certificate posted. No working thermometer in walk-in cooler. Excess garbage outside.

headline: No vomit kit; no paper towels; no thermometer
summary: No kit or procedure for vomit or diarrhea cleanup; priority violation, no citation. No paper towels at the exposed front handsink. No thermometer in the stand-up cooler. No mop sink on the premises. No covered trash in the washroom.

headline: Cold water, flies, roach, rat droppings found
summary: Hand sinks measured 53°F; 100°F is required; priority citation. About 75 or more live small flies, one live roach, and about 25 rat droppings were found. Raw meat sink lacked soap and hand drying. Food held at 47–56°F was discarded (about 18 lbs).

headline: Overflowing outdoor garbage; untrained employee
summary: The outdoor garbage receptacle was overflowing and could not close; priority citation issued. Dumpster must have tight-fitting lids. One employee lacks food handler training; certificates must be completed and kept on site.

headline: Loose sprayer above three-compartment sink
summary: A sprayer attachment hangs loose from the wall above the three-compartment sink. The person in charge was instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: Ice machine slimed; prep cooler too warm
summary: Ice machine interior was heavily soiled with black and grey slime dripping onto ice used for consumption; priority citation issued. A three-door prep cooler held 49.7°F, was tagged, and must not be used until repaired. A hand sink valve leaks.

headline: Storage closet items on floor
summary: Items stored on the floor in the storage closet must be elevated at least 6 inches to avoid hiding spots for pests. The operator must maintain this.

headline: Unlabeled prepackaged foods; dirty appliances
summary: Prepackaged foods such as hummus and sweets must show product name, ingredients, and business name and address. Microwave and food processor were dirty inside and out. Front display handsink was dirty.

headline: Drains, floors, and hood filters need cleaning
summary: Floor drains in the dish, bakery, and coffee areas need cleaning to prevent possible insect activity. The sushi cooler door gasket is badly worn. Floors under equipment and hood filters need detail cleaning.

headline: No vomit/diarrhea cleanup plan; repeat violation
summary: No written procedures or supplies for vomit or diarrhea cleanup; priority citation issued. A walk-in condenser drips into a container. Restroom wallpaper peels. Clutter stored on floor and over the rear sink; prior violation cited again.

headline: No certified manager; unapproved vacuum sealing
summary: No certified food manager on arrival; the manager came over 30 minutes later; citation issued. Vacuum-sealed beef had no approved HACCP plan or variance; beef and sealer tagged. No pest service proof for the past year; last log entry July 2024.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; stained cutting boards
summary: A torn door gasket inside the two-door prep cooler #1 must be replaced. Stained cutting boards in the rear prep and dishwashing area must be resurfaced or replaced.

headline: Plastic forks not inverted
summary: Plastic forks were not inverted in the food prep area or at the venue bar. Manager instructed to invert them and keep them that way.

headline: No health policy; mop sink in place of handsink
summary: No employee health policy, vomit/diarrhea procedure, or kit on site. A mop sink was installed instead of the required rear prep handwashing sink; priority violation. Also: broken freezer gasket, men's door not self-closing, broken floor tiles, no allergen certificates.

headline: Cold foods at 49–53°F; cooler tagged
summary: Pasta, pesto, mushrooms, and greens held at 49–53°F, above the 41°F limit. Prep cooler at 50°F was tagged. The manager discarded the food; citation issued. Vents are dusty, and lighting is dim in prep and hallway areas.

headline: Rat droppings in basement; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Rat droppings found throughout, including about 15 under the dish machine and 50–75 in the rear south basement. Pest service recommended; citation issued. Dish machine dispensed no sanitizer; tagged, not to be used until repaired. Food lacked date marks.

headline: Over 80 mouse droppings; multiple violations
summary: Over 80 mouse droppings found in the bakery, prep cooler, and utility closet; exterminator required; priority citation issued. Also: unlabeled bulk and dessert containers, food on floor, a door gap, no cooler lighting, and no splashguard.

headline: No health policy, vomit procedure, or pest log
summary: No employee health policy on site. No procedure for vomit or diarrhea cleanup. No pest control log on site; one must be kept. Unused boxes and construction materials must be cleared before reinspection. No citation issued.

headline: Employee toilet door must self-close
summary: The employee toilet room door must be self-closing. The operator must provide this to meet the requirement.

headline: No certified manager; sushi and cooler too warm
summary: No person in charge or certified manager during TCS food prep; priority citation issued. Sushi and cold items held at 46.4–69.9°F; 15 lbs ($120) discarded. Service cooler at 57.6°F and sushi cooler at 72.3°F must not be used. Staff eat and drink in prep areas.

headline: Unlabeled seasonings; no utility sink
summary: Seasonings were out of original containers without product name labels. No utility sink on site; one must be provided. Soiled mop heads were not stored properly and must be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Front handsink lacked hot water
summary: The front prep handwashing sink had no hot running water. It measured 72°F; the inspector required 100°F to 120°F. Priority violation cited.

headline: Ice maker under pipes; barrier needed
summary: The basement ice maker sits under a ceiling with pipes and conduits that might leak onto it. Operator must install a barrier to prevent ice contamination.

headline: Wiping cloths and mop stored improperly
summary: Wet wiping cloths were left on rear prep tables; they must be stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. A wet mop was stored improperly in the rear prep area and must be hung to dry.

headline: Grease buildup, cardboard flooring, unlabeled containers
summary: Handwashing sink in the toilet room needs signage. Dry ingredient containers in the front prep area are unlabeled. Toilet room door not self-closing. Grease buildup found by the fryer and three-compartment sink; cardboard on floor by fryer must go.

headline: Torn screen door; rusty shelves; broken ice lid
summary: Side screen door mesh is missing; main door must stay closed until replaced. Milk crates are used for elevation. Rusty shelves under prep tables must be replaced. The ice machine lid is broken. Peeling ceiling paint near side door.

headline: Rodent droppings found; no health policy
summary: About 50 rodent droppings in dry storage, 20 in the walk-in cooler, and about 10 each behind the hot-holding unit and in the utility closet. Pest control recommended; priority citation. No employee health policy; door gaps and no stove ventilation.

headline: No certified manager for dairy; storage cleanup
summary: No person with a City sanitation certificate on premises while handling dairy; priority citation issued. Current manager holds only a 2024 manager class completion certificate. Unisex bathroom lacks a covered trash can. Dry storage floor soiled; lighting inadequate.

headline: Missing handwash signs; dirty sinks and debris
summary: No handwashing signs at handsinks in both prep areas. Cardboard lines shelving and prep table shelves. Dust on cooler shelving at the serving line. Dirty handsinks in toilet rooms. Debris on walk-in freezer floor and drain.

headline: Re-inspection: grime, floor storage, dusty vents
summary: Cook-line cold unit gaskets had food grime. Items stored on the basement floor in bins must be at least six inches off the floor. Dust in a ceiling vent near the dish machine and in the basement restroom needs cleaning.

headline: No food handler certificates; dirt by water tank
summary: No proof of food handler certificates was shown for employees; certificates must be provided. Dirt and debris are on the floor around the rear water tank; the operator must clean and maintain the area.

headline: No certified manager on site; citation issued
summary: The person in charge has no certified food manager certificate, and none is on site while eggs, dairy, and sausage are prepared. Priority citation issued. The front ice bin has no cover. A three-compartment sink faucet keeps running when turned off.

headline: Unlabeled spices; scoops; minor sink leaks
summary: Spices out of original packaging were in unlabeled containers by the wok station. Plates were used to scoop food stored in containers. Minor leaks found at the rear handsink and both three-compartment sink faucets.

headline: No health policy, vomit procedure, or allergen training
summary: No employee health policy and no vomit/diarrhea cleanup procedure with spill kit. Sanitation manager has no allergen training. Two ice machines lack backflow prevention devices. The operator must provide each item.

headline: Unlabeled walnuts; soiled mop heads
summary: Walnuts were out of their original container and had no product name label. Operator must label all foods and spices. Soiled mop heads were not stored properly; they should be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Rice scoop in standing water; deli cups as scoops
summary: A rice scoop was kept in standing water at room temperature; it must be stored per code. Deli cups were used as scoops for bulk containers; proper scoops are required. The employee toilet door is not self-closing.

headline: No three-compartment sink in sushi prep area
summary: The rear sushi prep area has no three-compartment sink. Installation was scheduled for 9-1-25, per the notes. Priority foundation citation under 7-38-025 issued.

headline: No certified manager; no hot water; meatballs warm
summary: No certified food manager or knowledgeable person on site during cooking and serving. Hot water missing at multiple sinks (60.3–61.6°F). About 10 lbs of meatballs at 57°F discarded. Two-drawer cold unit not holding 41°F; tagged.

headline: No certified manager posted; several repairs needed
summary: No valid certified food manager certificate posted while cold and hot foods were handled; citation issued. Also noted: a gap under a boarded door, an employee without a hair restraint, low hot water pressure, burnt-out lights, and cleaning needs.

headline: Grease under fryers, oven, and grill
summary: Clean the bottom of the fryers and the surface under the grill. Clean the floor under the fryers and beside the oven to remove grease. Walls around and behind cooking equipment need cleaning where needed.

headline: Short handwash time, hair restraints, low pressure
summary: The front prep handwashing sink ran less than 15 seconds; it must run at least 15 seconds. Some café employees lacked hair restraints. Low water pressure at the front prep handwashing sink needs repair.

headline: Rear door gap; cooler gasket torn; debris
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door must be rodent-proofed. A cooler under the grill has a torn gasket. Food debris is inside the three-door bar cooler and on the storage room floor.

headline: About 25 flies; crab thawed in standing water
summary: About 25 small flies were seen in the rear prep/dish area; priority citation issued. A sticky fly trap hangs over a prep table, which is not allowed. Frozen crab was thawed in stagnant sink water. Floors, drains, and vents need cleaning.

headline: Hot water off; priority citation issued
summary: No hot water throughout the facility because the water heater was off; water measured 62.4°F. The owner turned it back on during inspection; hot water reached over 100°F about one hour later. Citation issued; hot water must be kept at all times.

headline: Rodent droppings and live flies; repeat violation
summary: About 25 rodent droppings were found in several areas. About 30 live flies rose to 70 at reinspection. A prior priority violation was not corrected; citations issued. Floors need cleaning, and walk-in freezer ice must be removed.

headline: Grease and grime; damaged ceiling panels
summary: Accumulated grease and food debris found on cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, freezers, and shelving. Dirty walls and floors in prep and warewashing areas. Multiple damaged ceiling panels in warewashing and toilet areas need repair.

headline: No certified manager certificate; restroom water too cool
summary: No original certified food manager certificate posted; citation issued. Restroom hot water fluctuated between 60–74°F; it must hold at least 100°F. Shelves and floors throughout the facility have soil and debris buildup.

headline: Missing covered receptacles in restrooms
summary: Several restrooms lack covered receptacles for sanitary napkins: the all-gender employee washroom, first-floor women's employee washroom, and a second-floor women's stall. Operator instructed to provide them.

headline: No certified manager; food held at unsafe temperatures
summary: No certified food manager on site on arrival; priority citation issued. Cooked burek held at 105–119°F, below the required 135°F; 5 lbs discarded. Cooked potatoes at 67°F; 12 lbs discarded. No HACCP records for smoking and curing meats.

headline: No certified manager; no prep sink
summary: No City-certified food manager on premises; priority violations cited. Restroom handwashing sink lacks signage. Opening at the base of the front entrance doors. Leaking stoppers under the three-compartment sink. No prep sink and no commercial dumpster.

headline: Black mold-like substance inside ice machine
summary: A panel inside the ice machine that touches ice was covered in a black mold-like substance. Ice is used for consumption. Priority citation issued. Wet wiping cloths were left on prep surfaces. Certified manager lacks allergen training; prior violation uncorrected.

headline: Food wrapped in thin plastic in freezers
summary: Food in freezers was wrapped in thin plastic film. Operator instructed to store all food in approved food-grade containers.

headline: No certified person in charge; no health policy
summary: No person in charge with a valid sanitation certificate, and no certificate posted. No employee health policy and no food handler or allergen training. Basement door gap, no covered restroom receptacles, no no-smoking signs.

headline: Mashed potatoes and greens too warm; discarded
summary: Mashed potatoes at 55.5°F and cooked greens with meat at 54.5°F, both dated 5/20, were discarded (about 25 lbs). Citation issued. Two-compartment sink drains slowly; ice machine drain has black slime; basement floor is wet in places.

headline: Droppings found again; repeat violation cited
summary: Droppings were found on shelves and under the front handsink, rising to 30–35 at reinspection. A prior priority violation was not corrected. Pest control service ordered. Coolers, cooking equipment, floors, and hood need detail cleaning.

headline: Hair restraints, leaking sink, unlabeled flour
summary: Two food handlers lacked hair restraints. A leak under the exposed handsink and an unlabeled flour container were found. Inspection summary was not posted; it was corrected on site. Priority citation issued.

headline: Cold foods held above safe temperature
summary: Passed with conditions. Food in the rear walk-in cooler was too warm, including 3 lbs of beans at 49.2F and diced chicken at 59.5F. The manager discarded 6 lbs, about $95 of food. Cold foods must stay at 41F or below.

headline: Hand sinks blocked; several repeat violations
summary: Failed. All three hand-washing sinks were blocked by stored items, which the manager removed. The sinks lacked hand-drying supplies, and paper towels were provided. Earlier violations were not fixed: no backflow device and two untrained food handlers.

headline: Passed; detail cleaning needed throughout
summary: Passed. Inspector asked for detail cleaning of the ice machine drain, fryer sides with grease buildup, floors under equipment along the walls, and dusty vent covers to prevent pests and contamination.

headline: Mouse droppings still found; failed re-inspection
summary: Failed. Mouse droppings were still found on shelving, a drink cooler and in the men's restroom. A pest control operator must service the premises. Cracked floors and ceilings went uncorrected; the rear door has a gap.

headline: Bare-hand contact, 0 ppm sanitizer, cold rice
summary: Failed. Bare hands touched ready-to-eat food; the product was discarded. Utensils were sanitized at 0.0 ppm. About 11 lbs of cooked rice held at 45.3-47.1F was discarded. Hands were washed in the dish sink. Also missing signed health policies.

headline: Passed; ceiling repair and allergen training needed
summary: Passed. Paint is chipping on the ceiling above the three-compartment sink and must be repaired. Hood vents are dusty and must be cleaned. Allergen training for certified food managers is incomplete.

headline: No hot water, no manager, no test kits
summary: Failed. No food was on site, but there was no hot running water, no certified person in charge, and coolers were not turned on. Missing: thermometer, sanitizer test kits, vomit cleanup kit, allergen training.

headline: Passed; floor drains and wall base need fixing
summary: Passed. Debris build-up under, around and along wall bases in the rear food prep area must be cleaned, including drains. A peeling wall base must be repaired or replaced.

headline: No certified manager; hand-washing lapses
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared, a citation issued. A food handler did not wash hands before putting on gloves. Also missing: food handler proof, allergen training, and labels on several containers.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies
summary: Passed with conditions. No written procedure or supplies were found for vomiting and diarrhea events, a priority violation. The rear dishwashing area needed cleaning, and items must be stored 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Passed; ceiling holes and handler certificates
summary: Passed. Holes in the ceiling above the basement low-temperature dish machine must be sealed and made smooth and cleanable. Food handler certificates must be provided for all food handlers and kept on site.

headline: Untagged oysters; 12 lbs discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Oysters stored in the walk-in cooler had no required identification tags. The manager discarded 12 lbs, worth $98, right away. Also: serving plates not stored inverted, and restrooms need trash cans with lids.

headline: Passed; signage, thermometers and storage fixes
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs are needed at all hand sinks, and thermometers are needed inside prep and reach-in coolers. Tomato sauce must move from an open can to food-grade storage. A loose faucet, an uncovered basement trash can, and clutter need attention.

headline: Passed; expired food handler certificates
summary: Passed. A small gap at the bottom of the rear screen door must be sealed to avoid rodent entry. Grease and dust need cleaning on the fryer, grill, floors and vents. Some food handler certificates were expired and must be renewed.

headline: Passed; signage, backflow, light shield
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs are missing at preparation areas. No backflow prevention device was found at the ice machine water line, and one must be installed where it can be serviced. Broken light shielding in a reach-in cooler must be replaced.

headline: Handled cash, then prepared food without washing
summary: Failed. A food employee exchanged cash with a customer, then prepared food without washing hands. The manager washed hands on the spot. The three-compartment sink floods when one basin drains and must be serviced. The certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Passed; slicer, oil spills and tap
summary: Passed. The meat slicer was not clean behind the blade. Oil spills were on the floor behind the deep fryer. A damaged tap with exposed threads near an open food prep table must be made smooth and cleanable.

headline: Warm ready-to-eat food; no manager on duty
summary: Passed with conditions. About 49.5 lbs of ready-to-eat foods held at 45-56F were discarded, and a reach-in cooler ran at 51.8F and was tagged. No certified manager was on duty. A food handler did not wash hands between tasks.

headline: Passed; improper thawing and unlabeled containers
summary: Passed. Improper thawing methods were used for temperature-controlled foods and must be corrected. Dry food containers were not labeled with common names. Two food handlers lacked food handler certificates.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing signs, floor storage
summary: Passed. No handwashing signs were posted near exposed hand sinks in the front bar and rear kitchen. Food items stored on the floor in the rear prep area must be raised six inches.

headline: Passed; labels, wiping cloths and cutting board
summary: Passed. Food storage containers need labels when food is not in its original container. Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables and must be kept in sanitizing solution. A cutting board on the main cook line has deep grooves and stains and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Passed; knife storage and floor cleaning
summary: Passed. Knives were stored between the prep cooler and prep table and need a knife rack or magnetic strip. Plastic soda and milk crates must not be used for shelving. Prep cooler interior and floors with dried food debris need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; no hot running water
summary: Failed. No city-certified manager was on premises, and there was no hot running water (82.4F to 87.6F). Ice machine had black moldlike substance and must be destroyed and cleaned. Also missing: employee health policy and food handler training proof.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged out
summary: Failed. A low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged out until repaired. Also: missing a quaternary ammonium test kit, and boxes stored on the dry storage floor.

headline: Warm food discarded; no certified manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions, but serious issues. No certified food manager was on site while open. An employee rinsed hands without soap, and two hand sinks were blocked. About 28 lbs of eggs, beef and shrimp held above 41F were discarded.

headline: Passed with conditions; health policy blank
summary: Passed with conditions. Employee health policy copies on site were blank, and signed copies must be kept on site. Basement lights lack protective shielding, and a basement wall has water damage and chipped paint.

headline: Passed; labels, sink caulking and training certificates
summary: Passed. Dry food in plastic containers needs common-name labels. Excess caulking around the three-compartment sink drain stoppers must be removed and replaced with food-grade material. Food handler training certificates were not on site for all employees.

headline: Passed; dining room ceiling leaks need repair
summary: Passed. Ceiling water leaks in the dining room must be repaired. The certified food manager lacks a valid allergen training certificate.

headline: Passed; ice machine rust and grease
summary: Passed. Rust is on the outside edge of the ice machine opening and must be cleaned to protect the ice. Also noted food debris inside a reach-in cooler, dirt and debris under and around a freezer, and grease buildup on the hood.

headline: Cardboard and foil liners; prior violations unresolved
summary: Passed with conditions. Cardboard and aluminum foil were used as liners and floor mats and must be removed. Dry food debris must be cleared from under shelving. A prior violation was not corrected: food handler training proof and allergen training renewal.

headline: Menu lacks raw-food asterisks; failed
summary: Failed. Menu items that are undercooked or raw, such as steak and burgers, were not starred, and a footnote stating they are served raw or cooked to order is required. The food service sanitation manager also lacks allergen training.

headline: Bare-hand contact, cold food, and cooler failures
summary: Failed. Food handler used bare hands on ready-to-eat meat. Cold foods held at 44-56F were discarded, including 3 gallons of milk and 18 eggs. Two coolers ran at 46F and 50F and were tagged. Staff restroom hot water reached 80F.

headline: Hot food held too cool; no employee health policy
summary: Failed. Hot holding units ran at 118F to 125F, below the required 135F. Also missing: an employee health policy, adequate sanitizer for vomit and diarrhea cleanup, correct sanitizer test strips, and a garbage can.

headline: Coolers too warm, dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Failed. Walk-in and prep coolers ran at 51-60F, and the low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine. Missing: certified person in charge, health policy, vomit cleanup supplies, food thermometer, pest logbook, and commercial dumpster.

headline: Hot water too cool; corrected on site
summary: Failed. Hot water ran 88-97.3F and was corrected on site before the inspection ended. A prior violation remained: a men's employee bowl ran at 81.2F. The coffee machine lacks a backflow device, and a urinal is broken.

headline: No certified manager during sandwich prep
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was present while sandwiches were being prepared and served, and a citation was issued. Also: greasy hood and filters, dirty prep tables and cooler interiors, and no food handler certificates provided.

headline: Blocked hand sinks, warm cooler, no training proof
summary: Passed with conditions, but serious issues: hand sinks blocked and missing soap and towels. A cook line cooler ran at 53.4F and food was discarded. Dishes were not sanitized, and food handler training proof was missing.

headline: Passed; fryer interiors need cleaning
summary: Passed. Inspector found debris and grease buildup inside the fryer units and asked the person in charge to clean and maintain them.

headline: Live roaches and mouse droppings; failed
summary: Failed. Three live roaches, about 10 mouse droppings, and dead roaches were found in food prep and service areas. Openings at the bottoms of the front and rear doors must be sealed, and the ice machine needs a backflow device.

headline: Passed; cutting boards and leaking sink
summary: Passed. Cutting boards have open seams and dark stains, and a can opener has dried food. Reach-in cooler interiors need detail cleaning. The three-compartment sink leaks at all basins, and clutter in rear storage must be removed.

headline: Passed; sink stoppers and food truck trash can
summary: Passed. The three-compartment sink needs stoppers for all compartments. The food truck must have a waste receptacle, and debris under the hot holding units and sink cabinet must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; restroom trash lid needed
summary: Passed. The third-floor women's restroom had no covered waste container. Management was told to provide covered receptacles in all women's washrooms.

headline: No certified manager on arrival; insect carcasses found
summary: Passed with conditions. No city-certified manager was on site at arrival, a priority violation. Sauce bottles stored in a hand-washing sink were removed. Insect carcasses were found in the grease trap room, and a lower-level cooler has rust.

headline: No person in charge or certified manager on duty
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge was present, and no certified food manager was on duty while pasta and dumplings were prepared and served, a citation issued. Certificates on site were expired. A two-door refrigerator gasket is torn.

headline: Unlabeled ready-to-eat food; citation issued
summary: Passed with conditions. Ready-to-eat food in the walk-in cooler and refrigerators lacked product names and use-by dates, a priority citation. Food was also stored in grocery bags and tin cans. Ice buildup in the walk-in cooler needs repair.

headline: Hand sink misused and blocked; no towels
summary: Passed with conditions. A hand-washing sink was blocked and used as a prep sink, and the prep kitchen sink had no paper towels. Wrapped deli sandwiches lacked a discard date and proper labels. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint.

headline: Cold unit at 69.3F tagged; failed
summary: Failed. A three-door cold holding unit ran at 69.3F and was tagged. Only one working two-door refrigerator was found, and more cold holding equipment is needed. Handwashing signs are missing, and restrooms lack covered receptacles.

headline: Passed; door gaps, leaks and grease cleanup
summary: Passed with many repairs. Gaps under the front and rear doors must be tightened to keep pests out. Heavy faucet leaks in both restrooms need repair. Also needed: grease and food debris cleanup, a damaged ceiling repair, and a hook for wet mops.

headline: No manager for 45 minutes; warm chicken discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager was on site from 8:15 to 9 AM while chicken was prepared. About 15 lbs of chicken held at 52.0-77.9F was discarded. A prep hand sink lacked hot water until fixed on site.

headline: Passed; minor leak and burnt-out bulb
summary: Passed. A slight leak was coming from the rear prep handwashing sink faucet, and one bathroom ceiling bulb was burnt out. Both must be repaired.

headline: No certified manager on site; dead roaches
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager was on site while chicken and other temperature-controlled foods were prepared, a citation issued. Dead roaches were found on the dry storage floor. Also: broken thermometers and no allergen training certificate.

headline: Overflowing dumpster; missing training proof
summary: Passed with conditions. The outside dumpster was overflowing with trash, a priority violation. Also: unlabeled food containers, uncovered restroom trash cans, a mop stored in a bucket, and no proof of food handler training.

headline: Dead roaches on light shields; repairs needed
summary: Passed on re-inspection, but light shields above prep areas were covered in dead roaches, which must be cleaned. Also needed: sealed raw wood shelves, repaired wall and floor tiles, replaced ceiling tiles, and resurfaced exposed foam caulk.

headline: About 60 mouse droppings; failed
summary: Failed. About 60 mouse droppings were found on the basement prep area floor, and additional pest control service is needed. A basement hand sink was blocked by a clothes washer, which the manager moved during inspection. Cutting boards are damaged.

headline: No health policy or food handler certificates
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy and no food handler certificates were on site. Certified managers also lack allergen training. Also noted a grooved cutting board, dusty condenser fans, unused basement equipment, and pooling liquid on floors.

headline: Rodent droppings and flies found; failed
summary: Failed. About 25 large rodent droppings were found in grocery aisles and under shelving, plus about 9 small flies. Pest control was recommended. Some cooler thermometers were broken or missing, and a pickup door is not rodent-proof.

headline: Dishmachine repaired; certified manager missing
summary: Passed with conditions. No original city-certified manager certificate was on site during food prep, a priority violation. The dishmachine final rinse was below the required 180F; a technician repaired it and it now reads 1801F as noted. Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced.

headline: Passed; ice machine and hood need cleaning
summary: Passed. Inspector asked for cleaning of slimy buildup in the ice machine compartment, grease in the hood above the dishwashing machine, and dirt on a women's restroom ceiling vent.

headline: Droppings found and warm food discarded; failed
summary: Failed. About 200-250 droppings were found in the basement and 30-40 at the rear prep pantry, and pest control service is required. Ready-to-eat ham, raw eggs and tomatoes held at 55-60F were discarded, about 30 lbs.

headline: Mouse droppings and flies found; failed
summary: Failed. About 25 to 35 mouse droppings were found across the facility, including food prep and storage areas. About 5 small flies and 4 to 5 ants were also seen. Pest control was recommended. Unlabeled containers and uncovered cakes were also noted.

headline: Over 20 small flies found; failed
summary: Failed. Over 20 small flies were seen in the basement bar, and pest control service was recommended. Also: no verifiable employee health policy, two basement hand sinks not working, missing handwashing signs, and the menu lacks raw-food asterisks.

headline: Passed; food stored on floor and clutter
summary: Passed. Food containers were stored on the floor in the rear storage and front cashier areas and must be raised six inches. Clutter near the three-compartment sink should be removed to prevent pest hiding spots.

headline: Passed; door gap and ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. A quarter-inch gap at the bottom of the front door needs new weather stripping to keep pests out. A dry storage container label is worn off. Ceiling tiles are missing or damaged, and the walk-in cooler interior needs cleaning.

headline: Passed; rusty storage racks need repair
summary: Passed. Storage racks throughout the facility have rust buildup. The manager was told to replace or repaint them.

headline: Passed; mostly cleaning and upkeep fixes
summary: Passed. Inspector asked for food labeling, dishmachine and wall cleaning, a repaired hot faucet, a self-closing restroom door, and sealed wall holes to prevent pest hiding spots. The certified food manager lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: No certified manager during food preparation
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid city-certified manager was on duty while eggs, chicken and grits were handled, prepared and served, a priority violation. The person in charge must obtain a certificate by the next inspection.

headline: Passed; missing cooler thermometer, pipe leak
summary: Passed. A stand-up reach-in cooler on the second floor has no thermometer and must have one. Dust is on prep cooler condensers, food buildup is on the dishmachine exterior, and a front prep handwashing sink pipe is leaking.

headline: Dead roaches found; leaks and grime
summary: Passed on re-inspection, but dead roaches were found on floors, walls and sink basins in rear areas. Thermometers are missing from refrigeration units. Severe leaks under the three-compartment sink caused standing water, and kitchen surfaces need deep cleaning.

headline: Failed re-inspection; repeat violation and food on floor
summary: Failed. A previous violation was not fixed: no quat sanitizer test kit on site, which must be corrected before re-inspection. Also: food stored on the floor, unlabeled containers, a broken walk-in cooler threshold, and no allergen-trained manager.

headline: Passed; fryer and steam table cleaning
summary: Passed. The oil compartment of the deep fryers held liquid and was not maintained. Grease and food were caked on steam table crevices under the hood. Both must be deep cleaned and maintained.

headline: Passed; rusty shelving and damaged floors
summary: Passed. Cooler shelving is rusting with chipped paint and must be repaired or replaced. Floors in the food prep and dishwashing areas need sealing, and wall sections near the three-compartment sink and ice machine need repair. Noted in a prior report.

headline: Passed; freezer ice and fryer area cleaning
summary: Passed. Inspector found a dirty interior in the rear prep cooler and ice buildup inside a two-door freezer that must be defrosted. Floors and walls around the deep fryers need cleaning of spills, debris and grease.

headline: Passed; drains need cleaning
summary: Passed. Thick buildup was found in the drains under the three-compartment sink and the dishwashing machine. The facility must clean and maintain them.

headline: About 40 live cockroaches; failed
summary: Failed. About 40 live cockroaches were found in and around the stove and deep fryer and on rear prep walls and floor. Additional pest control service is needed. Two certified managers also lack allergen training.

headline: Passed; oven, faucet leak, allergen training
summary: Passed. The oven's lower surface has dirt and charred debris to clean. The middle faucet handle on the three-compartment sink leaks from the base. The certified food manager lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: Passed; floor debris under shelving
summary: Passed. Debris and residue built up on floors under shelving and equipment. The person in charge was told to clean it.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing sign, dirty ice bin
summary: Passed. The front counter prep handwashing sink lacks a handwashing sign. The ice bin interior needs cleaning, and the ice must be removed while cleaning.

headline: Passed; labels, wiping cloths and freezer repairs
summary: Passed. Breading was in unlabeled clear containers, and soiled wiping cloths were left on counters. A torn chest freezer lid with exposed insulation must be repaired, and food debris was found by the bread warmer.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while temperature-controlled foods were prepared and served, a citation issued. The hot holding unit needs a thermometer, wiping cloths sat in dirty water, and the reach-in cooler is dirty.

headline: Missing thermometers and backflow device; upkeep issues
summary: Passed. No thermometers were inside cold-holding units, food was stored on the basement floor, and the basement ice machine had no backflow device. Clutter and grease on walls behind cooking equipment were also noted.

headline: Passed; basement cleanup and expired training
summary: Passed. The basement storage area must be cleaned and reorganized, and unused articles and equipment removed to prevent pest hiding spots. Some food handlers had expired training certificates, and one certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Passed; trash around dumpsters and grease bin
summary: Passed. Organic material and trash were scattered on the ground around the outside dumpsters. The grease receptacle was not clean and must be deep cleaned and sanitized.

headline: Passed; signage, splashguard and door fixes
summary: Passed. Hand-washing signage is missing near the dish area, and a splashguard is needed between the hand sink and the three-compartment sink. Crates and pallets are used as shelving and must be replaced, and the washroom door must self-close.

headline: Food stored on floor; dirty floors
