summary: Failed. About 25-30 mouse droppings and four live roaches were found across prep, storage and restroom areas, with roach droppings on equipment. No certified manager was on site. About 18 lbs of oysters lacking shellstock tags were discarded.

headline: No handwashing sign; no food handler proof
summary: Passed. The rear prep toilet room has no handwashing sign. Bulk rice was unlabeled, cutting boards had open seams and dark stains, and the toilet door does not self-close. No proof of food handler or allergen training was provided.

headline: No certified manager; no food handler certificates
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager or valid documentation was on site while chicken, lamb and rice were served, so a citation was issued. Ice machine debris, a torn cooler gasket and missing food handler certificates were also noted.

headline: Cleaning needed in kitchen and washroom
summary: Passed. Inspector ordered cleaning of cooking equipment, refrigeration interiors, walk-in shelving, floors, ceiling vents, light shields and floor drains. Staff must maintain these areas.

headline: About 35 live flies on sinks and bottles
summary: Failed. About 35 live small flying insects were found on sinks, liquor bottles and the beer tower in second-floor bars. Professional pest control is needed. Also missing a health policy and a consumer advisory for raw foods.

headline: Rear door doesn't fit tightly
summary: Passed on re-inspection. The rear exterior door does not fit tightly around its frame. The person in charge must repair it so it is tight-fitting.

headline: No certified manager; missing cold water, dumpster
summary: Failed. No certified manager with a valid certificate was on site. The prep handsink lacked cold running water. A large wall hole must be sealed to prevent pest entry, and no commercial dumpster was available. No citations were issued.

headline: Dead roaches in basement; several repairs needed
summary: Passed. Dead roaches were found on the basement storage floor near the water heater and furnace, and the manager must remove them. Also noted: damaged cooler gaskets, a leak under a sink, food debris, and openings in walls and ceilings to seal.

headline: No certified manager; food stored on floor
summary: Failed. No certified person in charge or manager with a posted certificate was present while hamburgers were prepared and served; a citation was issued. Food was stored on the floor, hamburger buns were uncovered, and drink cans were open on a prep table.

headline: About 50 mouse droppings in storage and restroom
summary: Failed. About 50 or more mouse droppings were found along walls, under shelving and a pallet in dry storage, and behind a toilet. A citation was issued and pest control was recommended. A gap at the rear door and a worn screen-door sweep must be fixed.

headline: Pizzas at 70-72°F on display without approved procedure
summary: Passed with conditions. Ten trays of cooked pizza on display measured 70-72°F. No approved written procedure or time logs were provided. About 50 lbs ($230) was discarded voluntarily. A citation was issued, and a dishwashing handsink faucet is loose.

headline: Milk and produce too warm; ice machine dirty
summary: Failed. Many items held at 44.8-53.8°F, above the 41°F limit, including milk, ham and cheese. About 53 lbs ($245) were discarded. Black and pink buildup inside the ice machine touched ice. A bar refrigerator was tagged.

headline: Cold foods at 54°F; cooler at 51°F tagged
summary: Passed with conditions. Food was held at 54°F; 41°F or below is required. The manager discarded whipped cream and whipped butter worth about $15. A one-door cooler measured 51°F and was tagged. Citations were issued.

headline: Low water pressure at dishwashing handsink
summary: Passed. The handwashing sink in the dishwashing area has low water pressure. It must be repaired and maintained.

headline: No certified manager; openings and no training proof
summary: Passed with conditions. No City-certified sanitation manager was on premises, which led to a citation. Openings at the dumpster dock door need sealing. A three-compartment sink faucet leaks, and no proof of food handler training was provided.

headline: Clay cups, foil shelf liners and stiff faucet
summary: Passed. Clay drinking cups and plates need proof of lead-safe status or removal. Aluminum foil was used on bar shelving and a prep cart and must be removed. A rear staff handsink faucet is hard to turn on and off.

headline: Cluttered storage; no food-prep sink
summary: Failed. The rear storage and furnace closet were cluttered, including a broken refrigerator and items on the floor, creating possible pest hiding places. A required food-preparation sink from a prior inspection is still missing. A citation was issued.

headline: Blender parts in standing water; live plants
summary: Passed. Blender parts were kept in standing water at room temperature. Live potted plants were stored in the prep kitchen. Staff were instructed to store both according to the health code.

headline: No certified manager on site while cooking
summary: Passed with conditions. No City-certified manager with a posted valid certificate was on site while rice, chicken, steak and noodles were prepared and served. A citation was issued. A broken floor base under the 3-compartment sink must be enclosed.

headline: No certified manager during sushi prep
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager on site was present while sushi rice, avocado, crab and salmon were prepared; a citation was issued. Food debris was excessive on rice cookers and under coolers, and two of three sink stoppers were missing.

headline: Over 50 mouse droppings found near food
summary: Failed. Over 50 mouse droppings were scattered on steam table shelves and around a water heater. An exterminator was ordered. The dumpster is missing two lids, and food was stored on floors. A citation was issued.

headline: Passed; cleaning needed and manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. Inspector asked for detail cleaning of a basement sink drain, black mold-like buildup behind the three-compartment sink, grease under the flattop grill and dusty hood vents. A new food service manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Milk crates used as shelves; heavy grime throughout
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Milk crates were used as shelving, a prep table bottom was rusted, and deep freezers and reach-ins were full of food debris. Floors and equipment had spills, grease and flour buildup; detailed cleaning was ordered.

headline: Grease buildup in dish and bar areas
summary: Passed. Buildup was found on floors, wall bases and corners in the dishwashing and bar areas. It was also under and around the three-compartment sink and high-temperature dish machine. Staff were instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: No certified manager; pest log incomplete
summary: The person in charge lacked a City certified food manager certificate. No certified food employee was on site while sandwiches and milk drinks were prepared; citation issued. The pest control logbook was missing 2024 and 2025 service reports; citation issued. Milk crates used for storage need replacing.

headline: Certified manager arrived late; entry gap found
summary: No person in charge with a valid City certificate was present; a certified manager arrived at 12:20 PM, which corrected the issue on site. Citation issued. An opening between the front double doors must be sealed to keep pests out. Splash guard and floor repairs also needed.

headline: No certified manager; no health policy
summary: No certified manager on duty while chicken was prepared; citation issued. No verifiable employee health policy signed by staff; citation issued. Heavy grease under the grill and in fryer cabinets; burnt-out hood bulbs. Prior violations included missing food handler proof and allergen certificate; citation issued.

headline: Damaged gasket; chipped floors; old equipment
summary: Damaged gasket on a prep cooler next to hot equipment must be repaired. Cutting boards with open seams and stains need refinishing or replacement. A dump sink drains slowly. Old equipment from a previous occupant must be removed; chipped floor paint needs repainting.

headline: Door gap; no training; prior advisory uncorrected
summary: A gap along the front entry door must be made tight to prevent rodent entry. No food handler training for employees and no allergen training for the food manager; citation issued. The menu still lacks a raw or undercooked food advisory from a prior report; citation issued.

headline: No food manager certificate posted
summary: No City food manager certificate was posted on the premises; citation issued. Slight buildup inside the ice machine must be cleaned. One food handler lacked a food handler training certificate.

headline: No certified food manager during TCS food prep
summary: No person in charge held a City sanitation certificate. No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods such as goat meat, soup, and tacos were prepared and served; citation issued. Two food handlers lacked food handler training.

headline: Tableware pre-set; beard guards and allergen training
summary: Tableware was pre-set on customer tables in the State and Lake restaurant; staff must protect it or set tables upon arrival. Male food handlers with beards lacked beard guards. A bar handsink cold-water knob did not work. The manager on duty lacked allergen training.

headline: No raw-food consumer advisory; dirty equipment
summary: Menu lacked a disclosure for undercooked or raw items such as burgers, eggs, and steak; citation issued. A packaged cake was unlabeled. Milk crates used as shelving, rusted prep table, stained cutting boards, and food-encrusted coolers and freezers all need cleaning or repair.

headline: Unlabeled packaged produce
summary: Some packaged produce, including mint and paan leaves, had no labels and must be labeled.

headline: Bare-hand food contact; expired certificate
summary: A food handler touched ready-to-eat deli ham and buns with bare hands and kept doing so after being asked to wear gloves; food discarded; citation issued. Two containers of cooked chicken at 50°F to 70°F were discarded; one pan at 119.3°F in hot holding was also discarded. No person on site held a valid City sanitation certificate.

headline: Handwashing sinks used for waste and filling
summary: Staff dumped liquid waste and filled containers at handwashing sinks; staff were told to use the prep sink. Citation issued. Raw calamari was thawing in room-temperature water. Plastic grocery bags stored cut vegetables, and a manager lacked allergen training.

headline: No high-temp thermometer; expired handler cards
summary: No high-temperature dish machine thermometer or heat strip was on site. Several food handler certificates had expired. The food service manager had no allergen certificate. A personal cleanliness item was also noted; no details provided.

headline: Ice machine buildup; no drainboard at dish sink
summary: Slight buildup inside the ice machine must be cleaned. The ice scoop was stored on top of the ice machine. The three-compartment dish sink has no drainboard. Clutter on floors near exit doors must be elevated or removed. A hood light bulb is out; managers lack allergen training certificates.

headline: About 20 live flying insects; sewage lines over food
summary: About 20 live small flying insects were found in prep, dining, storage, washroom, and bar areas; more pest control is needed. Citation issued. Packaged food was stored under sewage lines. Grease trap lid is missing screws and needs cleaning.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; no allergen training
summary: Handwashing sinks in the front prep and warewashing areas lack signs telling employees to wash hands; signs must be posted. A City-certified food manager lacked allergen awareness training and a certificate on site.

headline: No hot water at handwashing sinks
summary: Two sinks in the front prep area and the sink in the west washroom had no hot water. Management was instructed to provide water above 100°F at all handwashing sinks. Citation issued.

headline: Roaches and flies; moldy ice machine; food too warm
summary: A silver panel inside the ice machine touched ice with pink and black mold-like residue; citation issued. Cooked curry at 48.9°F and 55.1°F and garlic at 76.8°F; about 24 lbs discarded. Three live roaches in rear prep, two on basement freezers, and 25 to 35 small flies; citation issued.

headline: Ceiling light out above mop sink
summary: The ceiling light bulb above the mop sink is not working. A working bulb must be provided.

headline: Hot and cold foods out of temperature; discards
summary: Samosa and potato wraps measured under 70°F on the counter, and cooler items such as heavy cream and mayonnaise ran above 57°F. About 22 lbs total were discarded. Citation issued. Unlabeled prepared foods, no paper towels at sinks, and grease and dirt on floors and equipment.

headline: Flies behind bars and in dish area
summary: About 30 live small flying insects and 5 house flies were found on walls and ceilings behind bars, in the mezzanine prep area, and in the dishwashing area; citation issued and more pest control needed. No consumer advisory for raw or undercooked items on menus. Manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; cooking equipment dirty
summary: Bulk containers must be labeled to identify the product. Wiping cloths must be stored in clean sanitizing solution when not in use. Cooking equipment, reach-in and holding cabinet interiors, and floor corners need cleaning. Instructed to correct.

headline: Rusted storage racks; washroom door
summary: Chipped paint and rust on the wire storage racks in the walk-in cooler must be removed, then repainted or replaced. The washroom door needs a self-closing device installed.

headline: Unlabeled containers; ice scoop stored in machine
summary: Bulk dry ingredient containers were unlabeled in the side prep area. Two electric insect control devices hang above food prep tables and must be relocated. An ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine. Rust on lower prep table shelves and grease behind the grease trap need cleaning.

headline: Hair and beard restraints; storage and allergen training
summary: A food handler did not wear a hair or beard restraint. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer. Ceiling tiles and walls had dirt and food splatter; baseboards missing in rear storage. No certified food manager had allergen training.

headline: No food safety manager training; handlers unlisted
summary: The person in charge lacked proof of food safety management training and must provide it. Food handlers preparing TCS foods had no original City certificate posted on site; citation issued. Certified manager's original certificate must stay posted during food operations.

headline: Handsink disconnected; 55 flies; unsafe hot water
summary: A front prep handsink had no plumbing connected and water pooled onto the floor; hot water measured 69°F, below the 100°F minimum; citation issued. About 60 lbs of frozen chicken was thawing improperly. 55 live flies were found throughout the premises; citation issued.

headline: No paper towels; ice machine slime
summary: No paper towels at handwashing sinks; a cook could not dry hands; a manager was told not to prep food until towels were supplied; citation issued. Ice machine interior had black slime dripping into ice; cleaned by a technician on 7-5-2024. Water on floor and raw wood behind sink.

headline: Clutter that could hide pests; multiple citations
summary: Basement dry storage shelves lined with cardboard, which can hide pests. Food stored on floors in walk-in units. Grease buildup at the outside grease container drew a citation. The sanitation manager lacked allergen training, a repeat core violation, and a citation was issued.

headline: Dish machine not dispensing sanitizer; cooler too warm
summary: The low-temperature dish machine did not dispense sanitizer; tagged and not to be used until repaired. About 28 lbs of beef burgers held at 42.4°F to 48.2°F were discarded. The cooks line beef cooler ran at 44.6°F and was tagged. The menu lacks a raw or undercooked food disclosure.

headline: Dirty floor drains; damaged ceiling tiles; openings
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on top of coolers and ice scoops on the ice bin. Prep table bottoms are rusty. Floor drains and floors behind refrigeration units are dirty. Water-damaged ceiling tiles in the dining area need repair. Openings around pipes and near the rear exit must be sealed.

headline: No certified manager; ceiling hole; probe damaged
summary: No person in charge with City certified manager training was on site; citation issued. No food employee with certification was present while beverages and sandwiches were prepared; citation issued. A food handler lacked training. A metal probe thermometer is dented and bent. Large ceiling hole in basement closet.

headline: No health policy; leaks and poor lighting
summary: No employee health policy or training was on site; citation issued. Leaks from faucets and a 3-compartment sink, slow drains, and low water pressure at the dump sink were noted. Missing splash guard and handwashing signs. Heavy debris in drains; utility closet lights are low.

headline: Handwashing sign fixed on site
summary: A missing handwashing sign at the rear sink was corrected on site. Fryer bottoms, cooking equipment exteriors, and refrigerator interiors need grease removed. Floors and walls around equipment need cleaning.

headline: Food on floor; debris throughout facility
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor in rear storage and must be raised at least 6 inches. Loose debris, dirt, and dust built up on floors and corners throughout the facility; detail cleaning and more frequent cleaning required.

headline: Food handlers need hair restraints
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Staff were instructed to wear them.

headline: Rat droppings and eggs too warm
summary: About 60 rat droppings were found on the basement storage floor and near the rear exit door; extra pest control required; citation issued. Eggs at 48.2°F in the front prep cooler were discarded (10 lbs, $100). No metal stem thermometer on site. Grease spilled near the outdoor grease container.

headline: Standing water and debris behind grease trap
summary: Standing water and debris behind the grease trap must be cleaned and kept dry to prevent a pest breeding place. The reach-in cooler interior needs spill removal. The hood and filter above the front cooking equipment need grease and dust cleaned.

headline: Food on floors; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Food items stored on floors in prep, storage, and basement areas must be raised 6 inches. Milk crates used as shelving units in storage must be replaced with adequate shelving. Residue inside the ice machine must be cleaned.

headline: Prior violations uncorrected; cooler and sink issues
summary: Earlier priority violations were not corrected: grease near the fryer and hood, food debris on floors, and cutting boards with stains and open seams. These are now priority items; citation issued. Milk crates used as shelving; torn cooler gasket; 3-compartment sink stoppers missing; broken reach-in door.

headline: Employee changed tasks without washing hands
summary: An employee wearing gloves served customers, then returned to prep without changing gloves or washing hands; citation issued. Roast beef at 58.6°F, ham at 54.3°F, and turkey at 44°F in service coolers; about 10 lbs ($60) discarded.

headline: Gaps at front doors; no espresso barrier
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at both front doors must be rodent-proofed. The espresso machine at the front counter has no sneeze guard or protective barrier; a priority violation. Washrooms lack covered trash receptacles.

headline: Uneven floor with gaps behind counter
summary: The floor behind the counter is uneven and has gaps. The person in charge was instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: Greasy fryers; expired allergen certificate
summary: Tongs used for chicken were stored on the counter instead of in a clean bin. Fryer sides and interiors had thick grease. Walk-in cooler floor tiles held cloudy water and need regrouting. The person in charge's allergen training certificate expired.

headline: Milk crates; stained ceiling; no training proof
summary: Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. A can opener was encrusted with food debris. Stained ceiling tiles and damaged floor tiles need repair. No proof of food handler training and no certified manager with allergen training.

headline: No thermometers; no pest log; sink problems
summary: Only a blank employee health policy was on site; priority violation. No working food temperature device was available. No pest control logbook; priority violation. No dish area hand sink, no mop sink, and a three-compartment sink backs up. No commercial dumpster on site.

headline: Rodent droppings; no certified manager on site
summary: About 30 to 50 rodent droppings were found in the dishwashing and dry storage areas; citation issued and extra pest control required. No pest logbook; citation issued. No City-certified food sanitation manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared; citation issued.

headline: Broken soda cooler thermometer; door gap
summary: The thermometer in the two-door stand-up soda cooler is broken and must be replaced. A 1/4-inch gap at the front entrance door sweep must be sealed so the door is rodent-proof.

headline: Rodent droppings and mice; no health policy
summary: About 150 rodent droppings were found across several areas, including under dry storage shelves and behind refrigeration; citation issued. Two mice were trapped on a glue board in the mop sink closet. No employee health policy and no vomit cleanup procedure on site; citations issued. The inspection summary was not posted.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; expired allergen certificate
summary: The door gasket on the two-door sushi prep cooler is ripped and must be repaired. One food manager's food allergen training certificate has expired and must be updated.

headline: Missing food labels; no food handler training
summary: Food storage containers, bulk items, and pans must be labeled when not in original packaging. Cutting boards with deep grooves need repair. Food debris must be cleaned from shelves, counters, and coolers. Dust on walls and vents needs cleaning. No food handler training for employees.

headline: No valid certified food manager on site
summary: The person in charge had no City sanitation certificate, and no valid certificate was on site. A citation was issued. Also noted: plastic grocery bags used as food containers in freezers, a broken ice machine panel, and broken rice cooker handles.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food service
summary: No person in charge held a valid City certificate. No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. Employees lack food handler training; certified managers lack allergen training. Spills and debris on floors, drains, and equipment need cleaning.

headline: About 20 flies; no hand sink; prior violations
summary: About 20 large flies were found in the rear prep area. No handwashing sink in the front dining area where tortillas are hand-prepared. Prior violations for missing backflow device and ice machine drainage were not corrected; citation issued. Soiled rags, no food handler training on site.

headline: No certified manager on duty
summary: No valid City-certified food manager was on duty while chicken, ground beef, and cheese sauce were prepared and served; this must be provided. Ice built up inside deep freezers must be defrosted and cleaned. The cold-water knob at a hand sink is in poor repair; floors need cleaning.

headline: Cleaning, labeling, and cutting board issues
summary: Bulk food containers must be cleaned, covered, and labeled. Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizing solution. A worn cutting board in the pizza prep cooler needs replacing. Prep tables and shelves need detail cleaning. Floors, walls, and ceilings need dust and debris removed.

headline: Live roaches; food held too cold
summary: Live cockroaches were found in the deep fryer, near the rear dish machine, and behind dish racks on the second floor; more pest control needed; citation issued. Cold-held foods measured 45.1°F to 50°F; about 7 lbs ($85) discarded. Thermometers missing from refrigerators.

headline: No health policy; pizza held warm; no pest log
summary: No signed employee health policy was on site; citation issued. Two cooked pizzas sat at 72°F air temperature and were discarded; citation issued. No pest control logbook on site; citation issued. Also noted: sanitizer testing and dirty prep tables and floors.

headline: Ice buildup; tape repair on cooler door
summary: Excess ice on a pipe and condenser in the basement walk-in freezers must be repaired. Broken black tape used to repair a deli cooler door must not be used; the cooler needs a handle. Grease inside the deep fryers and floors behind equipment need cleaning. No food handler training certificate on site.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; cold food too warm
summary: The low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer; it was serviced during inspection. Scallops, mashed potatoes, and milk in the prep cooler measured 49.2°F to 51.5°F; about 8 lbs ($100) discarded. Citation issued. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; no hot water
summary: No vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit was on site; citation issued. The premises has no hot running water because gas is not connected; citation issued. Reach-in coolers, freezers, floors, and walls need cleaning of spills and debris.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies on site
summary: No cleanup supplies for vomit or diarrhea events were on the premises; management was instructed to provide them; citation issued. Prepackaged pastries, desserts, salads, and sandwiches in display coolers lacked ingredient labels.

headline: Grease buildup and hair restraint lapses
summary: Food handlers need effective hair restraints. Soda gun tubing needs reinstalling to stop water. Cooking equipment sides, floors, sinks, and hood vents need detail cleaning. Corrections were instructed, not confirmed on site.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; floor debris
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at the basement prep sink, basement restroom sink, and upstairs restrooms. Single-use items were stored on the basement floor and not inverted. Heavy debris, dirt, and dust built up on basement floors and corners.

headline: No original manager certificate; flies remain
summary: No original City food service manager certificate was on site; only a 2023 SERVSAFE certificate was shown; citation issued. Over 25 small flying insects and 3 large flies were found in prep areas, some landing on prep tables. Pest activity persisted from prior report; citation issued.

headline: Dish machine sanitizer at 0 ppm
summary: The in-use low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine. The sanitizer was replaced, the machine primed, and proper concentration achieved during inspection; citation issued. A torn gasket on a two-door cooler and dust on the rear prep ceiling need attention.

headline: Soiled restroom fixtures; allergen training
summary: The urinal and toilet in the front all-gender restroom were visibly soiled and need regular cleaning. No City-certified manager with allergen awareness training or certificate was on site.

headline: Handsink removed from dish area; gap found
summary: The handwashing sink in the dishwashing area was removed and must be reinstalled; citation issued. An opening between the front entrance doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. A leaking faucet at the three-compartment sink needs repair.

headline: Garlic mixture at 82°F; sink blocked
summary: A garlic-oil mixture sat at 82.1°F on the prep table and about 5 lbs was discarded; citation issued. The front handwashing sink was blocked by utensils, which were removed during inspection; citation issued. Utensils and cups were submerged in food. Missing chlorine test strips.

headline: Floors need cleaning
summary: Floors need cleaning in corners, behind and around tall refrigeration units, and inside the walk-in cooler. Staff were instructed to clean the floors.

headline: No certified manager while cooking chicken
summary: No City certified food manager was on site while TCS foods like chicken were prepared and served; citation issued. The rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap and is not rodent-proofed. Deep fryers have thick grease, and floors have dirt and debris. Prior violations include missing allergen certificate.

headline: Sewage pipes over food; missing food handler cards
summary: Several employees lacked food handler certificates on site. Prior core violations were not corrected: exposed sewage pipes above basement food storage and missing light shields and end caps in the prep area. Citation issued. Grease and soot also need cleaning.

headline: Crates used for storage; stained ceiling tiles
summary: Crates used for food storage in the prep and dish area must be replaced with smooth, cleanable shelving. Walk-in fan guards and prep shelving need dust and debris removed. Stained dining area ceiling tiles need repair. Table-top fryers lack a hood and need ventilation.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep
summary: No person in charge held a valid City certificate. No certified food manager was on duty while chicken, sandwiches, and soups were prepared and served; citation issued. No paper towels at the front prep sink; citation issued. Clutter on the walk-in baking cooler must be removed.

headline: Over 15 rat droppings; hand-washing lapses
summary: More than 15 rat droppings were found behind and under the east cooking equipment; citation issued. An employee handled ready-to-eat food without washing hands; food discarded. Soap missing or diluted, paper towels missing, and some cold and hot foods were out of temperature and discarded.

headline: Strong grease trap odor; hood buildup
summary: A strong, offensive odor came from the grease trap; it must be cleaned and maintained. Dirt and grease built up on the hood, pipes, and filters above cooking equipment and must be detail cleaned.

headline: Ice machine slime; 470 lbs food discarded; flies
summary: The dish area handsink had no water; restored to 102°F to 105°F; citation issued. Black slime was found in the ice machine; citation issued. Lobster, lamb, catfish, and chicken were out of temperature; about 470 lbs ($1,670) discarded. About 30 to 50 live small flying insects found; citation issued. Flying insect killer cans removed.

headline: Rat droppings on shelving and floor
summary: Six rat droppings were on the chip display shelving and 15 were scattered on the floor under the unused pizza prep area. Manager was instructed to remove them and detail clean; citation issued.

headline: Rear door needs rodent proofing
summary: The bottom of the rear screen door must be rodent-proofed. Plastic soda crates and milk crates used for elevation in storage and the walk-in must stop; use raised shelves 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Cooler too warm; hygiene and cleaning lapses
summary: A cold holding unit measured 54.5°F and was tagged; no food was stored in it at the time. The person in charge stirred rice without a hair restraint. Warewashing signs missing; dust and grease on walls and ceilings.

headline: No hand soap; no food thermometers
summary: No hand soap at the meat prep handsink; citation issued. No metal stem thermometer on site and no thermometers in cooling units; citation issued. Walk-in cooler floor had excessive food debris and water. Food handler training certificates needed.

headline: Missing signs and labels; clogged floor drains
summary: The front prep handwashing sink lacks employee handwashing signage. Bulk flour and sugar containers were unlabeled. Basement floor drains are heavily clogged with debris. Floor, walls, and pipes around the deep fryer are greasy. Basement lighting is insufficient; several fixtures are missing or in poor repair.

headline: No certified manager; dead roaches in basement
summary: No City-certified food manager with a valid original certificate was on site while chicken, eggs, chorizo, and milk were prepared and served; citation issued. Dead roaches were on the basement floor by the milk cooler and rolling cart; staff were told to clean. Thermometer inoperable.

headline: Cardboard liners and unlabeled storage in basement
summary: Thermometers must be visible in all coolers, including the walk-in. Containers in the kitchen and basement must be labeled. Food in basement storage must be 6 inches off the floor. Cardboard liners and grocery bags for food storage must stop. Dish machine interior and floors need cleaning.

headline: Grease trap not located during inspection
summary: The inspector could not locate a grease trap. The manager was instructed to install one or provide access to the grease trap in the building.

headline: Grease, leaks, and debris around equipment
summary: Heavy grease buildup on equipment around the griddle. A foot-pedal handwashing sink in the prep area leaks and must be repaired. Floors around cooking equipment have debris. An unused cooler must be repaired or removed.

headline: Missing thermometer; milk crates; unused items
summary: A cooling unit in the rear storage facility has no thermometer. Black milk crates used for shelving must be removed. The toilet room door does not close properly. Unused equipment stacked in basement storage must be removed to prevent pest hiding spaces.

headline: Dead water bugs found; grease near cooking line
summary: Dead water bugs were found along a basement walkway; staff were told to remove dead insects so they do not attract other insects. Reach-in cooler stains and rust need cleaning. Grease and dust under and beside cooking equipment, plus the floor and wall behind it, need cleaning.

headline: Cold food too warm; about 18 lbs discarded
summary: Several TCS foods (must stay at 41°F or below) measured 46.9°F to 51.4°F in the prep cooler, which ran at 55°F and was tagged. The manager voluntarily discarded about 18 lbs ($125). Citation issued. Handwashing signs and floor tiles also need attention.

headline: Over 100 live roaches; about 80 rodent droppings
summary: Over 100 live roaches were found in dining and kitchen areas, including on tables, in cooler gaskets, and in handwashing sinks. About 80 rodent droppings were found in kitchen and storage areas. Citation issued; pest control must be contacted. Certificate issues and no paper towels also cited.

headline: No person in charge; no certified manager
summary: No person in charge was present; priority violation, no citation. No certified food manager on duty while rice and chicken soups were prepared; citation issued. No vomit cleanup procedure; citation issued. Dishes were washed without sanitizer, corrected on site. Food unlabeled, stored on floors, and no hair restraints.

headline: No certified manager while serving sandwiches
summary: No person in charge and no certified food manager on duty while sandwiches and salads were served; citation issued. The person in charge must hold a City certificate by the next inspection. Employee drinks were stored with customer food in the same refrigerator; a separate area is required.

headline: Food on floor; torn cooler gasket
summary: Food items stored on the dry storage floor must be raised 6 inches. The rubber gasket on the two-door front prep cooler is torn and dirty and must be repaired. Grease and food debris built up on cooking equipment, prep tables, and coolers. Soiled mop heads must be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Broken sushi cooler gasket; deep-cut cutting boards
summary: The right side gasket on the sliding door of the sushi cooler is broken and must be repaired or replaced. Sushi prep cutting boards have deep cuts and stains around the edges; they must be restored or replaced.

headline: No certified manager on site; gasket taped
summary: The manager on site did not have a City food service manager certificate; citation issued. The gasket on the two-door sales-area cooler is broken and taped with duct tape; this repeat violation was not repaired and drew a citation.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; hood grease
summary: Milk crates used as shelving in the walk-in, front prep, and rear storage areas must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Grease and dust on the ventilation hood and filters must be cleaned.

headline: No vomit procedure; handsink blocked
summary: No written vomit or diarrhea cleaning procedure, and the kit was incomplete; citation issued. A kitchen handwashing sink was blocked by a table and bucket during cooking; the manager removed them; citation issued. Prior rear-door gap noted; torn cooler gaskets and grease spillage outside.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food containers
summary: Bulk food containers holding flour, breading, and similar items were not labeled and must be labeled.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; basement debris
summary: Food handlers on site had expired food handler certificates and must comply with requirements. Debris built up on the basement storage unit floor and must be cleaned.

headline: Raw meat above produce; ice machine slime
summary: Ready-to-eat lettuce, broccoli, and carrots were stored under raw bacon and raw eggs; all affected foods removed; citation issued. Pink and brown slime in the ice machine water reservoir and ice chute must be cleaned and sanitized; citation issued. No food handler training proof for employees.

headline: Beard restraints needed; milk crates as shelving
summary: Food handlers were not wearing beard restraints; must wear them when preparing food. Milk crates used as shelving throughout prep and storage areas must be replaced with shelving six inches off the floor.

headline: Food on floor in walk-in coolers; scoop handles
summary: Bins and buckets of food stored on floor in outside walk-in coolers must be elevated six inches. Scoops in dry storage and spice bins had handles touching food and must be stored out of contact.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure; missing signage
summary: Management could not provide a procedure for cleaning up vomiting and diarrhea; instructed to create one with needed supplies. No handwashing signage at any sink. No thermometers inside walk-in cooler.

headline: No sanitizer test kit; greasy fryer and steam table
summary: No sanitizer test strip kit on site to check three-compartment sink sanitizer strength; must keep one on site. Deep-fryer oil compartment has liquid and is not maintained. Steam table crevices under the hood have grease and encrusted food.

headline: About 40 live flying insects; prior violation uncorrected
summary: About 40 live small flying insects in both food prep areas, on walls, ceiling, shelves, and equipment. Previous priority violation not corrected; citation issued. Additional pest control needed. Missing floor tiles in front of three-compartment sink must be replaced.

headline: Milk and cooler too warm; cooler tagged
summary: Milk held at 49-50F in barista reach-in cooler; about 4 gallons voluntarily discarded. Cooler at 50F tagged and held by CDPH until reinspected. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or materials on site; citation issued.

headline: Unlocked freezers accessible to customers
summary: Three unlocked box freezers holding frozen empanadas were in a hallway toward washrooms, accessible to customers; must be protected from the public. Interior plastic door of tall reach-in freezer is damaged with exposed insulation.

headline: Sink leak and dim walk-in freezer
summary: Leaking faucet at rear dishwashing three-compartment sink must be repaired. Walk-in freezer has insufficient lighting; more light or a new bulb required.

headline: Dirty dumpster area; kitchen walls in poor repair
summary: Outside dumpster and grease container areas are unclean and surrounded by milk crates and old equipment; citation issued. Kitchen walls have small holes, chipping paint, and cracks that must be repaired.

headline: Rodent entry openings; kitchen repairs needed
summary: Outer openings, wall holes, and basement kitchen doors not rodent-proofed; must be patched to prevent rodent entry. Ice buckets stored on bar-area floor. Peeling kitchen ceiling paint and broken floor tiles need repair.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; sink leak; fry buildup
summary: Both door gaskets on two-door standing cooler are heavily torn and must be repaired or replaced. Leak at three-compartment sink faucet and slow-draining hand sink need service. Loose fries on floor under potato station must be removed.

headline: Wiping cloths on prep tables; leaks and floor repairs
summary: Dirty wet wiping cloths left on prep tables; must be stored in sanitizer when not in use. Stained cutting board in produce area needs replacing. Leaking drain under bakery sink and missing faucet handle in employee washroom must be repaired.

headline: Unlabeled containers; greasy floors
summary: Storage containers not labeled with product names; must be labeled and maintained. Floors around grease trap and cooking equipment need cleaning to remove spills, debris, and grease.

headline: Wall-base opening; washroom door not self-closing
summary: Opening along wall base and floor in prep area must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Washroom door must self-close. Floors need detail cleaning along walls and corners; dusty storage shelving needs cleaning.

headline: Uncovered kitchenware; raw wood and crates
summary: Kitchenware on tables in two club bars left uncovered. Raw wood wall in main prep area must be sealed. Soiled crates used for elevation must be replaced. Sticky liquor wells and soda gun buildup need cleaning.

headline: Dusty fan covers; floor and drain cleaning needed
summary: Rolling carts and walk-in fan guard covers need dust removed. Kitchen and bakery floors, drains, and walls need cleaning. Peeling bakery floor in front of the stove must be repaired.

headline: Greasy floors and water-damaged ceiling panels
summary: Accumulated dirt and grease on floors throughout rear prep areas must be detail cleaned. Multiple water-damaged ceiling panels above two-door freezer need repair.

headline: Raw wood counter; no utility sink
summary: Raw wood surface at front counter must be sealed to be smooth, non-porous, and cleanable. No service or utility sink on site; one must be provided for disposing of mop and cleaning water.

headline: Stained cutting boards; missing light shields
summary: Cutting boards in meat prep area are heavily stained with deep, dark grooves and must be cleaned and maintained. Missing light shields above cooking equipment in rear must be provided.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; unused equipment
summary: Torn gasket inside two-door reach-in cooler at cookline must be repaired. Unused cooling equipment in kitchen and basement must be removed to prevent clutter and pest harborage.

headline: Rear door gap and missing light shield
summary: Rear exit door must be pest-proofed along the bottom. Pots and pans should be stored inverted. A light shield is missing over a kitchen prep area light fixture.

headline: Pots on floor; cardboard floor mats; no certificates
summary: Pots and pans stored on floor in rear prep and in front of cooking equipment; must be elevated six inches. Cardboard used as floor mats must be replaced with smooth, cleanable covering. Food handler certificates could not be located.

headline: Cooked pasta held at 49-53F; citation issued
summary: About 4.5 lbs of bagged cooked pasta in refrigeration measured 49-53F; cold TCS foods must be held at 41F or below. Citation issued. Food handlers lacked effective hair restraints. Broken basement wall coving and clutter need addressing.

headline: No food thermometer; missing allergen training
summary: No metal stem thermometer on site for checking food temperatures; citation issued. Unused walk-in cooler holds excessive items that must be removed to prevent pest hiding spaces. Water-stained ceiling tiles. Manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Unlabeled spices; items on floors
summary: Dried spices at bar lack common-name labels. Plates, bowls, and pots stored right side up must be inverted. Boxes on stairway and items in boiler closet are on floor and must be removed or elevated six inches.

headline: Grease behind cooking line; sink leaks
summary: Grease and food debris on walls, utility connections, and equipment behind cooking line must be cleaned. Leaking faucet at three-compartment sink and leaking water line behind low-temperature dish machine need repair.

headline: Overflowing dumpster; expired food handler training
summary: Shared dumpster area has overflowing trash cans and bags stored on top; citation issued. Food storage containers lack labels. Expired food handler and allergen training certificates. Worn cooler gasket and rust in walk-in shelving.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; machine tagged out
summary: No sanitizer detected at low-temperature dish machine final rinse. Machine tagged and must not be used until reinspected. Signed employee health policy missing. Floor grout in rear storage and dish area needs repair.

headline: Floor storage, cardboard liners, trash lid
summary: Boxes and crates stored on floors in front display, prep, and dry storage areas must be raised six inches. Cardboard lining shelves in rear dry storage must be replaced with smooth, cleanable material. Employee bathroom trash can lacks a lid.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; no summary posted
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure on site; manager obtained a kit before inspection ended, but procedure and kit must stay on site. Citation issued. Inspection summary not posted for customers; citation issued.

headline: Raw wood washroom walls; cracked floor tiles
summary: Raw wood walls around toilet and hand dryer must be sealed to be smooth and cleanable. Dish room walls have coffee splatter and dirt. Cracked washroom floor tiles must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Rat and mouse droppings in basement
summary: Rat and mouse activity in basement with about 30-40 droppings along walls and in corners; citation issued. Boxes of menus with droppings must be discarded. Pest control service required. Bulk containers need labels and cleaning.

headline: Live cockroaches and about 50 rat droppings
summary: Three live cockroaches in food prep area and dead cockroaches in several spots. About 50 rat droppings in basement. Previous priority violation not corrected; additional pest control required. Food handler lacked certificate.

headline: Unlit walk-in freezer; expired handler certificate
summary: No light inside walk-in freezer; lighting must be provided and maintained. Food handler certificate on site was expired; a current certificate must be obtained and kept on site.

headline: Cooked food on walk-in floor; greasy fryers
summary: Cooked food items stored on floor inside walk-in cooler must be moved at least six inches up. Cooling units have dried food debris; fryer equipment has heavy grease. Excessive clutter in rear prep area; missing and water-stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Missing backflow devices on new equipment
summary: New ice machine, beverage mixer, and water dispenser lack backflow prevention devices. Inspector instructed installation so devices can be located, serviced, and maintained.

headline: Live cockroaches and about 200 mouse droppings
summary: 15 live cockroaches in food prep and dry storage, about 15 live flying insects, and approximately 200 mouse droppings found. Citation issued; additional pest control required. Roach-contaminated bags and cardboard must be discarded.

headline: Walk-in cooler leak from condenser
summary: Inspector observed a leak inside the walk-in cooler coming from the condenser unit. Repair and maintenance required.

headline: Repairs needed in employee cafeteria
summary: Damaged wall near low-temperature dish machine, damaged floor tiles around drains, and a stained ceiling tile in the employee cafeteria. Repairs ordered for cleanability.

headline: Door gaps and clutter; freezer light out
summary: Gaps under front and rear doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Also noted rusty shelves, crates used as shelving, dust and debris, clutter, missing ceiling tiles, and no light in walk-in freezer.

headline: Missing health policy, blocked sink, pest logbook gaps
summary: No employee health policy on premises. Ice machine blocks access to front sushi-area sink. Pest control logbook incomplete. Also missing handwashing sign, thermometer, prep sink, and consumer advisory for raw foods.

headline: No certified manager on duty; unlabeled containers
summary: No certified food manager on duty while chicken, hamburgers, and fries were prepared and served; citation issued. Basement food containers lack labels. Oil containers stored on walk-in cooler floor must be elevated.

headline: No manager certificate; dish machine at 0 ppm
summary: No original City sanitation certificate posted or documented; citation issued. Employee health policies not signed. Low-temperature dish machine, not in use, measured 0 ppm chlorine at final rinse; repair required. No food handler certificates on premises.

headline: No hot water in restroom; food debris found
summary: Customer and employee men's restroom had no hot water, measuring 70F; must provide at least 100F. Citation issued. Food debris found under cooking equipment and storage; must be cleaned and sanitized.

headline: Ice machine contamination; all ice discarded
summary: Pink slime and black dirt inside ice machines dripped into ice. All ice voluntarily discarded; machine interiors must be cleaned by reinspection. Also standing water behind cooking equipment and burned-out ceiling bulbs.

headline: Items stored on floors; elevate six inches
summary: Used equipment, boxed new equipment, and food service items stored on floor in second-floor dry storage. Single-service items on floor in rear dry storage. Manager instructed to elevate all items at least six inches.

headline: Storage room clutter
summary: Clutter found inside storage room. Must be cleaned and organized.

headline: Drink cup in prep area; core violations uncorrected
summary: Employee drink cup found on food prep counter. Cooked chicken, soup, and beef lacked date labels; corrected on site, citation issued. Uncorrected: front door in poor repair at bottom, washroom door not self-closing, unused storage equipment.

headline: Scoops in bins; gaskets; leaks repaired on site
summary: Scoops in flour and cornmeal bins had handles touching contents. Damaged gaskets on two coolers need repair. Basement sink drain leak and loose faucet handles were repaired on site. Employee restroom door not self-closing.

headline: Chicken and deli meat held at unsafe temps
summary: About 2 lbs chicken tenders held at 120-124F, below the 135F hot-hold standard; discarded. About 80 lbs deli meat at 48.7-51F discarded, $700 total. Missing or broken thermometers; unlabeled bulk containers; debris on warehouse floors.

headline: Debris on coolers; dish machine needs delime
summary: Debris must be cleaned from coolers, garbage can exteriors, oven, and cooking equipment pipes. Dish machine needs delime. Walk-in cooler walls and compressor vent need debris removed.

headline: Ice machine debris; no food handler certificates
summary: Debris encrusted inside ice machine must be removed and machine serviced. Blackened caulk above three-compartment sink must be replaced. No food handler certificates provided on premises; proof of training must be shown.

headline: Multiple priority violations; cooler and sink issues
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site. Women's restroom sink reached only 80F; must reach 100F. Reach-in drawer cooler at 48.6F. Probe thermometer read -22F at room temperature. No pest control logbook; no sanitizer test kit.

headline: Wall hole, dusty hood filters, expired allergen certificate
summary: Large hole in kitchen wall behind water heater must be sealed. Dusty filters at ventilation hood must be cleaned. One expired allergen training certificate for a certified food manager; current certificates must be provided.

headline: Raw wood shelving; bar equipment needs cleaning
summary: Raw wood shelving near service window must be sealed. Bar equipment on first and second floors needs cleaning to prevent pest harborage. Person in charge lacks allergen training certification.

headline: No certified manager; missing thermometers
summary: No certified food service manager present while chicken and deli foods were handled. No food probe thermometer, and no dish machine thermometer or heat strips on site. Hair restraint missing; knives and ice scoop misplaced.

headline: Food held too warm; roaches and mouse droppings
summary: Cooked beans in refrigerator measured 66.4F; manager voluntarily discarded 20 lbs. About 15-20 mouse droppings and one live plus 5-6 dead cockroaches found in dry storage. Pest service and housekeeping upgrade required.

headline: Pest logbook outdated; thawed beef in plastic bags
summary: Earlier pest violations were not corrected on time. Pest control logbook held only 2021 service records; citation issued. Thawed beef stored in plastic bags in cold holding. Cutting boards stained; two hood bulbs burned out.

headline: No certified manager while handling chicken
summary: Person in charge lacked City of Chicago sanitation manager certificate while staff handled TCS foods such as chicken and ham. Citation issued; certificate must be provided.

headline: Basement door opening; fryers and floors need cleaning
summary: A 1/4-inch opening at bottom of basement exit door must be sealed to prevent rodent entry. Fryer bottoms and exteriors need cleaning. Standing water on basement floor must be removed.

headline: Greasy outside oil container
summary: Top of outside oil container has grease stains and debris. Inspector required cleaning and maintenance.

headline: Rust on walk-in cooler shelving
summary: Buildup of rust on shelving inside the walk-in cooler. Person in charge instructed to remove rust and maintain the shelving.

headline: No health policy, vomit plan, or allergen certificates
summary: No employee health policy or training system on site; priority violation. No procedure or kit for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events. No allergen training certificates provided for certified food service managers.

headline: Hanging insect device to be removed
summary: A hanging insect control device was found in the rear prep area next to the two-door cooler. Inspector instructed the operator to remove it.

headline: Cold foods too warm; hood not working
summary: Several cold foods in display cooler measured 48.6-50.8F; 15 lbs ($250) discarded. Rear prep refrigerator at 48.6F must not be used until reinspected. Men's restroom hot water measured 67.3F; citation issued. Hood system not working.

headline: Garage equipment on floor; ice machine buildup
summary: Equipment stored on garage storage area floor must be at least six inches up. Calcium buildup inside upstairs ice machine must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Ice machine buildup; no food handler certificates
summary: Build-up inside sides of ice machine must be cleaned. Peeling windowsill paint and rough spray foam behind grease trap need repair. No food handler certificates on site; person in charge must direct training.

headline: 500+ rodent droppings, dead mouse, no hot water
summary: Inspector found 500 or more rodent droppings across kitchen and basement, plus a dead mouse and dead frog. Dish machine had zero sanitizer. No hot running water on premises. Pest control service required.

headline: Broken sink handle, dryer, tiles, light cover
summary: Women's restroom handwashing sink cold water handle is stripped. Men's hand dryer not working; paper towels used temporarily. Floor tiles in rear prep and dishwash areas need regrouting. Cracked light cover above three-compartment sink.

headline: Brisket too warm; overflowing garbage; sink leak
summary: Cooked brisket at 49.4F with no cooling log was discarded; citation issued. Outside garbage and grease containers overflowing; citation issued. Severe leak under kitchen three-compartment sink. Rear doors have 1/2-inch gaps at bottom.

headline: No food handler training proof; dirty dishwasher
summary: No proof of food handler training for employees. Dishwasher interior dirty with black slime. Scoop handles stored in food; tinfoil used as liner; unlabeled bulk foods; greasy floors under grease trap.

headline: Ice machine panel buildup; dirty CO2 closet floor
summary: Slight buildup on interior panel above ice in ice machine near walk-in cooler must be cleaned. Floors in carbon dioxide storage closet need cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled bulk foods; food stored on floor
summary: Bulk salt, sugar, and other containers lack labels in rear prep area. Boxed food on walk-in cooler and freezer floors must be elevated six inches. Cardboard and foil used as liners; rusty racks and floor spills need attention.

headline: Cooler thermometer in disrepair
summary: Ambient air thermometer for two-door reach-in cooler in rear prep area is in disrepair. Inspector instructed repair and maintenance.

headline: Grease and food debris throughout kitchen
summary: Accumulated grease and food debris on cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, freezers, and shelving. Food debris on floors in rear prep and under grill. Manager instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Rear ice machine dirty; door gaps and holes
summary: Rear ice machine must be deep cleaned before initial use. Gaps at front and rear doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Temporary barrier at chocolate tap needs a fixed guard. Grease trap screws missing; exposed utility lines; wall hole.

headline: Slow-warming handwashing sinks in prep area
summary: Two of three exposed handwashing sinks in rear prep area are slow to warm up. Inspector instructed repair or replacement and maintenance in good condition.

headline: Utility sink backflow; door and wall repairs
summary: No backflow device on utility sink; must install and maintain. Washroom door not self-closing. Lower wall at baseboard in furnace room needs sealing. Rocks and debris behind furnace must be removed.

headline: Missing labels, thermometers, food handler certificates
summary: Two front display coolers lack thermometers; no handwashing signage. Many containers and condiment bottles lack common-name labels. Food handler lacked hair restraint; employees on duty had no food handler certificates. Dirty ceiling vents and hood filters.

headline: Sink backs up with wastewater; no backflow devices
summary: Wastewater backs up from drain under the four-compartment sink; citation issued. Also grease in fryer cabinet, spots on two ice machines, broken cooler thermometer, leaking steamer, and no backflow devices on two water lines.

headline: Door gaps, no large-pot procedure, wall hole
summary: Front doors have a one-inch gap between them and a half-inch gap underneath; must be tight-fitting to prevent rodent entry. No written procedure for oversized pots. Hot holding shelves have debris; bakery wall has a large hole.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: Certified food manager did not have an allergen training certificate. Management instructed to show proof of allergen training for all certified food managers.

headline: Cardboard by rear door; no allergen certificates
summary: Numerous cardboard boxes stored by rear door must be removed. No allergen training certificates on site; must be provided for all certified food managers.

headline: No certified manager on duty; door gap
summary: No valid certified manager on duty while eggs and ham were handled and served; citation issued. Side exit door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom that must be repaired to prevent pest entry.

headline: No food manager certificate; mouse droppings found
summary: No valid certified food manager certificate posted. About 40 or more mouse droppings found in several areas. Front door gap allows rodent entry. No dumpster on site. Two vacuum packaging machines held pending approval.

headline: Overflowing dumpster; food stored on freezer floor
summary: Food containers stored on floor in walk-in freezer. Dumpster lids open with trash overflowing; citation issued. Food debris and spills throughout. Previous violations uncorrected: milk crate shelving, missing sink stoppers, damaged floor tiles.

headline: Stained cutting boards; greasy exhaust
summary: Cutting boards in hot foods prep area have open seams and dark stains and must be refinished or replaced. Dust and grease buildup in toilet room and hot foods exhaust ventilation need detail cleaning.

headline: Leaking ceiling; front door gap uncorrected
summary: Dining area ceiling tile has tarp and hose leaking water into a bucket. Previous core violation not corrected: front door has a 1/4-inch gap underneath, not proofed against rodents and insects. Citation issued.

headline: Leaking drainpipe under hand sink
summary: Leaking drainpipe under hand washing sink in front prep area. Manager instructed to repair and maintain.

headline: Repeat violations not corrected; no backflow
summary: Previous core violations from February 2024 not corrected. Rusted racks in 4-door cooler, no backflow prevention on ice maker and coffee maker, and two large ceiling holes in staff toilet room. Citation issued.

headline: Missing backflow devices; stained ceiling tiles
summary: New ice machine and utility sink in rear prep and dish area lack backflow prevention devices; instructed to install. Water-stained ceiling tiles in rear prep area must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Date marking errors; ready-to-eat food in raw area
summary: Packaged cooked food with 14-day shelf life held past the seven-day limit. Ready-to-eat packages lack labels. Poke and sashimi made in raw seafood butcher area, a high cross-contamination risk. Customers self-serve live crab.

headline: Summary not posted; ice machine cleaned on site
summary: Lower panel of ice machine cleaned on site during inspection. Floor under dishwashing sink and dishwasher and wall behind large ice machine need cleaning. No inspection summary posted in view of customers; citation issued.

headline: No food handler certificates on site
summary: No food handler certificates were on site at inspection. All employees must complete food handler training and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; expired allergen training
summary: No handwashing signage at sink behind bar. Debris under food prep table and behind basement ice machine; black-like substance on ice machine panel. Certified food manager's allergen training certificate is expired.

headline: Unapproved food discarded; over 100 rat droppings
summary: TCS foods without approved source, about 100 lbs ($1,800), discarded; no receipts provided. Over 100 rat droppings found in rear storage. Employee cutting raw chicken lacked food handler training. Citations issued.

headline: No certified manager; food stored on floors
summary: No certified food manager on duty while deli meat, chicken, and salads were prepared and served; citation issued. Food containers stored on floors in prep, storage, and freezers must be raised six inches. Basement clutter must be removed.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; foods too warm
summary: No certified food manager on duty; citation issued. Dish machine measured 0 ppm sanitizer and was tagged out. Pork, cheese, and beef held at 51.5-54.1F; 10 lbs discarded. Two prep coolers at 54F and 49F tagged. Inspection summary not posted.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; chlorine not connected
summary: Low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm sanitizer at final rinse; chlorine jug not connected. Manager instructed to provide proper concentration. Fly trap above prep area must stay away from food. Ice buildup on walk-in cooler unit.

headline: No hand soap; three-compartment sink backs up
summary: Second-floor prep and employee restroom handwashing sinks lacked hand soap; citation issued. Second-floor three-compartment sink drains slowly and backs up between basins; citation issued. Sink stoppers missing; soda machine drains into a food pan.

headline: Passed; basement ceiling and walls need cleaning
summary: Ceiling and walls of the basement food prep area must be cleaned, including the wall behind the pizza oven.

headline: Failed: live roaches and rat droppings found
summary: Four live roaches were under the main three-compartment sink pipes, and about 8-10 rat droppings were in the basement prep area. An employee touched a ready-to-eat tamale with bare hands, a priority violation. Previous rodent-proofing violations were not corrected.

headline: Passed; food buildup and a storage room light out
summary: Food buildup found inside a prep cooler door gasket and on bar gun holders, which must be cleaned. Storage room ceiling light bulbs were not working and must be replaced.

headline: Passed; knives stored unsafely, cooler door damaged
summary: In-use knives were stored between the wall and pipes in the meat prep area and must be kept on a clean, sanitized surface. Rear vegetable walk-in cooler door had missing panels. Drying mop heads were touching floors and walls.

headline: Failed: about 60 mouse droppings found
summary: About 60 mouse droppings were in the rear dry storage shelving and on the bar-area floor; priority violation with citation. Management must remove them and clean. Also noted: no handwashing signs, a leaking sink pipe, and an expired allergen certificate.

headline: Failed: 100+ live flies; repeat violation uncorrected
summary: About 100 or more live small flies were still flying in both dining areas, storage, hallway, toilet rooms, and dry storage; prior pest violation not corrected; priority violation with citation. Also: scoops left in containers, worn gaskets.

headline: Failed: basement handsinks broken; menu not marked
summary: Two basement handwashing sinks were not working; two other working sinks remain in each restroom. Handwashing signs were missing in first-floor and basement women's restrooms. Menu lacked asterisks and disclosure for raw or undercooked animal foods.

headline: Passed; manager's allergen certificate missing
summary: No allergen training certificate was on site for the certified manager. Person in charge was instructed to obtain allergen training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Failed: cold food too warm; overflowing dumpster
summary: Refried beans at 55.9F in the kitchen refrigerator; about 20 lbs (about $100) discarded. Outside dumpster overflowed with trash and boxes, a priority violation. Rear area had stored unnecessary items that could attract pests. Cook had no hair restraint.

headline: Passed; dust on cooking equipment and shelves
summary: Dust had built up on the sides of cooking and non-cooking equipment and on metal shelving next to the rear handwashing sink. Inspector instructed cleaning and maintenance.

headline: Passed; unlabeled containers, dirty walk-in freezer
summary: Food storage containers lacked labels with common food names. Walls and floors inside the walk-in freezer had food debris and ice, and must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: no paper towels; corrected on site
summary: No paper towels at bar and women's washroom handsinks; priority violation with citation. Manager provided towels before inspection ended. Menu lacked asterisks for undercooked or cooked-to-order animal foods. Opening at rear exit door base found.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing sign, dirty floors
summary: No handwashing sign was posted at the food prep handsink. Dirt and debris had built up under the three-compartment sink, around the grease trap, and between the ice machine and refrigeration units. Inspector instructed cleaning.

headline: Passed; no backflow device, poor equipment repair
summary: No backflow prevention device at the basement ice machine. Main kitchen three-compartment sink faucet was leaking. No handwashing signs at the left main cook-line sink. Cooler handles, lids, and latches were in poor repair.

headline: Passed; hair restraints needed; several cleaning items
summary: All food handlers needed hair restraints. Also noted: a balled-up wiping cloth at the sink, cardboard shelf liners, soda dispenser nozzles not clean, a toilet room needing a covered waste can and detail cleaning, and floor debris.

headline: Conditional; blocked handsink, food stored on floor
summary: Large pots blocked access to a handwashing sink, a priority violation with citation. Employee removed the pots during inspection. Food was stored on the floor in the dairy walk-in cooler. Torn gaskets, grease, and unfinished shelving also noted.

headline: Passed re-inspection; front door gap needs sealing
summary: Gap along the bottom of the front door must be made tight-fitting to prevent insect entry. Inspector noted the issue on re-inspection.

headline: Passed; missing food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Several food handlers lacked food handler certificates and must show proof. Certified food manager lacked allergen training certificate. Torn gasket inside a rear prep cooler door must be replaced.

headline: Passed; unused cooler running too warm (54.1F)
summary: An unused drawer cooler under the flat-top grill near the pizza station was at an improper 54.1F. Inspector instructed the operator to repair it or remove it from service.

headline: Conditional; cold-holding cooler held food too warm
summary: Inside a two-door prep cooler: cooked rice at 81F, cheese at 46F, cooked corn at 48F, black beans at 46F, and heavy cream at 48F, all above the 41F limit. Priority violation; citation issued. Ceiling tiles, light shields, and a missing shield also need attention.

headline: Failed: rat droppings, warm food, no manager
summary: About 15 rat droppings under the dish machine and cooking equipment, plus 25 small flies. Walk-in chicken, shrimp and crab rangoon held at 44.6-50.4F; 35 lbs discarded. Black slime dripped onto ice used for human consumption.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings in food prep areas
summary: About 30 or more mouse droppings found in the rear dry storage area, mop sink closet, electrical closet, and on freezer, prep table, and hot-holding equipment openings. About 15 small flies near the dishwasher. Pots of food were on the floor.

headline: Passed; missing drain lid, debris, clutter
summary: Floor drain in the main-floor women's toilet room was missing its lid and must be provided. Debris on the floor in the bar and around the griddle must be cleaned. Caulk around the three-compartment sink had black buildup. Storage room was cluttered.

headline: Food handler skipped handwashing after toilet use
summary: A food handler ate in the prep area, used the toilet, returned without washing hands, and put on gloves to make a customer sandwich. Priority violation; citation issued. Certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed; ice machine mineral buildup, cracked tiles
summary: Mineral buildup inside the ice machine must be cleaned and maintained. Two or three cracked floor tiles around the floor drain near the dish machine must be repaired.

headline: Passed; dead insects on traps, food on floor
summary: Dead insects were on glue boards in prep and basement areas and must be removed. Pastries were uncovered in the sales area, and food was stored on the floor of the walk-in cooler and freezer. Milk crates were used as shelves.

headline: Passed; worn cutting boards, certificates missing
summary: Service line cutting boards had deep cuts and discoloration and must be replaced. Several employees lacked food handler certificates. Certified sanitation holders must have allergen certificates. Minor debris under cabinets in the front prep area.

headline: Failed: warm food, 20+ flies, blocked handwash sinks
summary: Over 20 small flies were found throughout the facility, a priority violation. Food at 49-52F was discarded (7 gallons milk, 1 gallon egg whites). Two handwash sinks were blocked. Also no certified manager, health policy, or cleanup kit.

headline: Passed; debris buildup on kitchen floor
summary: Debris had built up on the floor throughout the kitchen. Inspector instructed the manager to clean and maintain the floor.

headline: Passed; dirty floors and corners throughout
summary: Loose debris, dirt, and dust had built up on floors and corners throughout the facility. Inspector instructed detail cleaning and more frequent floor cleaning.

headline: Passed; uncovered food containers and floor storage
summary: Bulk food containers were uncovered under a pizza prep table, and cooler covers and pizza boxes were stored on the floor. Dust, food debris, and spills were found. Certified manager lacked valid allergen training.

headline: Passed; worn cutting boards and greasy equipment
summary: Cutting boards had deep grooves and needed replacing. Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizer, cooking equipment had grease and charcoal residue, and floors and hood vents needed detail cleaning. Outdoor enclosure was in poor repair.

headline: Passed; towels touching eggs, sink too small
summary: Linens and paper towels touched hard-boiled eggs in the salad prep area, which is not allowed. Equipment is too large to fully fit the three-compartment sink; a larger sink or smaller equipment is needed. Fan guard and vent above the dish machine were dusty.

headline: Passed; door gap, crates, and floor debris
summary: Gap along the bottom of front entry doors must be made tight-fitting. Crates in the rear storage area must be replaced with shelving. Other items: no lidded trash can in restroom, chipped paint at menu board, debris in walk-in freezer and dry storage.

headline: Passed; rusty racks, missing sink stoppers
summary: Rusty metal storage racks in the basement prep area must be cleaned and repainted or replaced. Three working drain stoppers are needed for the three-compartment sink. Food debris in a prep cooler and basement walk-in cooler must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; exposed cooler insulation, greasy surfaces
summary: Exposed insulation inside the right door of a two-door prep cooler must be covered with a smooth, cleanable surface. Interior coolers and freezers, dish machine exterior, shelves, rolling cart, and grease trap need cleaning. Food debris and grease on dish area walls.

headline: Passed; stained cutting board, greasy equipment and vents
summary: Long cutting board at the cold prep station was badly stained with a deep bend and must be discarded. Reach-in coolers, rear prep table shelving, and cooking equipment need detail cleaning. Faucet leak at the three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Passed; floor repair, mop hooks, light bulb needed
summary: Damaged concrete floor in front of cooking equipment must be repaired or replaced. A hook system is needed to hang wet mops. A burnt-out light in the rear prep area must be replaced.

headline: Conditional; no health policy or illness cleanup plan
summary: No employee health policy or training was on site, a priority violation. No procedure or kit for vomiting and diarrhea events was on site; this is listed as a repeat violation from 11/28/2019.

headline: Conditional; no certified food manager present
summary: No city-certified food manager was on premises while milk-based coffee drinks and empanadas were prepared and served; priority violation with citation. Visible air thermometers needed in the cafe cooler and rear refrigerator. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Passed; loose cooler gasket, sticky cabinet spills
summary: Milk cooler under the coffee station had a loose door gasket that must be repaired or replaced. Syrup and ketchup spills were inside cabinets under the customer fountain drink station and must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; improper scoops and missing sink stoppers
summary: Bowls were submerged in dry storage and used as scoops. Inspector instructed use of proper dispensing utensils stored above food. Three-compartment sink was missing proper stoppers.

headline: Passed; raw wood, peeling floor paint, greasy equipment
summary: Raw wood was exposed in the basement and main kitchen and must be painted or sealed. Peeling paint on basement floors must be repainted or sealed. Food holding units, cooking equipment, and hood filters need detail cleaning.

headline: Failed: cooked carnitas held at 45F
summary: About 15 lbs of cooked carnitas at 45.0F were discarded; cold food must be 41F or below. Previous core violations were not corrected: unlabeled containers, worn cutting boards, dish rack debris, and a floor needing grout.

headline: Passed; missing thermometers, insect device placement
summary: Several cold-holding units lacked internal thermometers. Bulk dry containers were unlabeled. An insect control device was placed above clean equipment and food and must be moved. Utility sink had no backflow device.

headline: Conditional; no paper towels; inspection report not posted
summary: No paper towels at the dish-area handsink; priority violation with citation. Handler found a towel during inspection. Most recent inspection summary was not posted; a priority violation with citation. Three-compartment sink stoppers were missing.

headline: Conditional; no certified manager; standing water
summary: No certified food service manager on site while serving TCS foods such as chicken and beef; priority violation. Standing water was pooling under the dish machine in the bar area and must be eliminated.

headline: Conditional; no certified manager; sinks lacked towels
summary: Person in charge had no city sanitation certificate, and no certified food manager was on site while food was served. Paper towel dispensers at both handsinks did not work; an employee supplied towels during inspection. No current pest control report.

headline: Passed re-inspection; no food handler certificates on site
summary: Unused equipment and unnecessary articles in basement storage must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Soiled mop heads must be hung to prevent insect breeding. Employee washroom vents not working. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Passed; no handler certificate, leaks, ice buildup
summary: No food handler training certificate was on site. Ice scoop was stored in an open holder and must be kept in an enclosed clean container. Ice buildup around condenser units, leaking pipe behind ice machine, and leaking three-compartment sink faucet need repair.

headline: Passed; clutter in rear hallway must be cleared
summary: Clutter and unnecessary items in the rear hallway must be removed to prevent rodent harborage, meaning hiding places. Items must be elevated off the floor and the area reorganized.

headline: Passed; no food handler training; upkeep issues
