summary: The high-temperature dish machine final rinse read 153F, below the required 180F-194F; this is a priority violation. Toilets in both first-floor restrooms were clogged and not draining, and must be repaired. Failed.

headline: Dusty fans in seating area need cleaning
summary: Dusty and dirty fans on the ceiling and walls in the seating area need cleaning. No other issues were listed. Passed.

headline: Water leaking under three-compartment sink
summary: Water lines under the three-compartment sink are leaking and must be repaired. The inside of the floor drain under the sink also needs cleaning. Passed.

headline: No hand sink at bar; no pest control log book
summary: There is no handwashing sink at the front bar, and the business must provide one; a priority violation. No pest control log book was on site, and a citation was issued. The exterior of the ice machine and the basement floors need cleaning. Failed.

headline: No handwashing sign in restroom
summary: No handwashing sign was posted in the restroom. The person in charge was instructed to provide and maintain one. Passed.

headline: Hand sink lacks hot water; dirty exhaust hood
summary: The waiter station hand sink had no hot running water; it read 89.1F, and a priority citation was issued. Serving plates were not inverted, and the hand sink drains slowly. Heavy dirt and grease were in the exhaust hood, filters, and pipes above cooking equipment. Passed with conditions.

headline: Mouse droppings found; dead insects above sink
summary: About 25 mouse droppings were found on drink and bread shelves, windowsills, and behind the ATM, and a citation was issued. Additional pest control is needed. Dead insects were found on canned food shelves and a circuit breaker above the three-compartment sink. A restroom self-closing device is broken. Failed.

headline: No hand sink in new prep areas; leaking three-compartment sink
summary: The newly added rear prep area and the front sandwich prep area have no handwashing sink; a citation was issued, and hot and cold water must be provided. The three-compartment sink faucets and pipe are leaking. A rear fryer is not under the ventilation system. Failed.

headline: No certified manager on site while handling chicken and steak
summary: The person in charge lacked a city certified manager certificate, and no certificate was posted. No certified manager was on site while chicken and steak were handled, and a citation was issued. Dessert containers for self-service lacked labels. A three-compartment sink faucet handle is stripped. Passed with conditions.

headline: Foods held too warm; ~500 lbs discarded; live dog inside
summary: Cut melons, salad dressings, eggs, and other TCS foods were held at 44-48F, above the 41F limit, and about 500 lbs ($10,000) was discarded; a citation was issued. Cooling units ran at 46-48F. A customer brought a live dog in a stroller into the establishment, which is prohibited except for service animals. Passed.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: No procedure or spill kit was available for cleaning up vomit or diarrhea, and a citation was issued. The low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged, with a citation. A three-compartment sink handle is broken, and restroom doors are not self-closing. Passed with conditions.

headline: About 50 small flies in basement prep area
summary: About 50 small flies were on basement prep tables and surfaces, and a citation was issued. Pest control service is needed. Other findings include wiping cloths on tables, heavy leaking from an overhead pipe, water-damaged basement ceiling and walls, and an expired allergen training certificate. Failed.

headline: Rust in ice bin; no food handler training proof
summary: Rust was found on the top interior of the ice machine bin and must be removed. Grease and debris were under the fryers, and a drainpipe at the handwash sink was leaking. No proof of food handler training was on site for any handler. Passed.

headline: Blocked hand sink; food held without discard dates
summary: A hand sink in the rear prep area was blocked by a brush and containers, and a citation was issued. Hand sinks lacked soap and paper towels. Cooked beef and chicken held over 24 hours had no discard dates, and a citation was issued. Food was stored on prep-area floors and grease and debris were found on equipment. Passed with conditions.

headline: Many cleaning and storage items; food containers unlabeled
summary: Large food containers were unlabeled, and wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizer. Plates and utensils were not inverted, and several pieces of equipment, gaskets, and racks need cleaning or replacement. Grease and ice buildup was found in kitchen areas and the walk-in freezer, and floors have missing tiles. Passed.

headline: Bare-hand bread contact; dish machines not sanitizing
summary: A food handler touched ready-to-eat bread with bare hands, a priority citation. The low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine, and the high-temperature machine rinsed at 135F; both were tagged. Ten pounds of beef held at 46.8-47.4F were discarded. No food handler certificates were on site. Passed with conditions.

headline: No certified food manager on site while handling TCS foods
summary: The person in charge did not have a city certified food manager certificate. No certified food manager or posted certificate was on site while cookies and milk, both TCS foods, were prepared and served. A citation was issued. Passed with conditions.

headline: No front bar hand sink; no soap, towels, or food handler training
summary: There is no hand sink at the front bar; a priority citation was issued. Soap and paper towels were missing at prep-area hand sinks. No chemical test kit was on site, and no food handler or allergen training certificates were shown. Failed.

headline: No food allergen certification on site
summary: No food allergen certification was provided on site. All certified managers must obtain a valid food allergen certificate and keep it on site. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: No certified manager on arrival; dead roaches found
summary: No certified food manager was on site at arrival, and a citation was issued. Dead roaches were found on the floor under the rear dish machine and must be removed and the area sanitized. The outdoor bar ice bin was left uncovered, and shellfish tags lacked dates. Passed with conditions.

headline: Cold foods at 46-56F discarded; employee toilet lacks cold water
summary: Ham, tuna, turkey, eggs, chicken, and cheese were held in the front display cooler at 46.2-56.4F, above the 41F limit. About 30 lb ($100) was discarded and a citation was issued. The employee toilet room had no cold water, and a citation was issued. Passed with a citation (listed as Fail).

headline: Rat droppings in many areas; sink blocked; no health policy
summary: About 50 rat droppings were along the dining room sofa baseboard, with more behind the freezer, under sinks, and in storage. A citation was issued and all must be cleaned. A rear hand sink is blocked by a freezer and items, and no written health policy was on site. Front door has a 1/4-inch gap. Failed.

headline: Expired training certificates and storage issues found
summary: Inspector found a food handler with an expired certificate and a certified food manager with expired allergen training. Food was stored on the floor, a cutting board was stained, containers were unlabeled, and floors needed cleaning. Passed.

headline: Rust, peeling plastic, and moldy caulking
summary: Peeling plastic was inside a reach-in cooler, and rust was on the rear prep table shelving. Cardboard was used as a liner under the flat grill and on storage shelving, which is in poor repair. Blackened, moldy caulking at the three-compartment sink must be replaced. Passed.

headline: Overflowing dumpster; food debris and no allergen training
summary: An outside dumpster had trash overflowing and lids not closed, a citation was issued. Food debris, spills, and dirt were behind hot cooking equipment, behind the ice machine, and under the three-compartment sink. Multiple certified food managers lacked allergen training. Failed.

headline: Workers without hair restraints; cloths left on surfaces
summary: Several food handlers were prepping food without hair restraints. Wiping cloths were left lying on prep surfaces instead of being kept in sanitizing solution. Foil was used as a shelf liner. Passed.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; unapproved vacuum packing
summary: A low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged, with a citation. Vacuum-packed TCS foods were stored in the walk-in cooler without an approved plan, and the machine must not be used. The restroom sink had no water pressure; no paper towels were at bar hand sinks until a food handler obtained them. Failed.

headline: Expired pork belly found in walk-in cooler
summary: Cooked pork belly dated 7-7-25 was in the walk-in cooler past its seven-day limit and was discarded, about 7 lb ($20). A citation was issued. Passed with conditions.

headline: Pinto beans held too warm; hot water at sink too cool
summary: A container of cooked pinto beans was held at 44.4-48.8F, and about 15 lb ($50) was discarded; a citation was issued. The three-compartment sink water was 85.5F, below the required 110F, and a plumber was called; a citation was issued. Restroom lacks a covered receptacle, a self-closing door device, and handwashing signage. Passed with conditions.

headline: Cutting boards stained and deeply cut
summary: Some kitchen cutting boards had dark stains and deep cuts and must be refinished or replaced. A clean cutting board was stored on the back splash of the three-compartment sink and must not be. Passed.

headline: No covered trash receptacle; certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: The washroom has no covered waste receptacle, and management was instructed to provide one. The certified food manager did not have a valid allergen training certificate, and all certified managers must show proof. Passed.

headline: Blocked hand sinks fixed on site; several other issues
summary: A brewery hand sink was blocked by a beverage cart, and a rear prep hand sink faucet could not turn. Both were fixed during the inspection, with a citation for handwashing sinks. Paper towels were added to the brewery sink. Utensils sat in room-temperature water, and cold-holding lids and gaskets are in poor repair. Passed with conditions.

headline: Unlabeled food and food stored in grocery bags
summary: Assorted food items inside refrigerators were not labeled, including bulk containers. Food was also stored inside grocery bags in coolers and refrigeration units instead of approved food-grade containers. Passed.

headline: Food buildup and spills on floor behind yogurt machines
summary: Food buildup and spills were found on the floor in the room behind the yogurt machines and must be cleaned. No other issues were listed. Passed.

headline: Gap under front door; floors and walls dirty
summary: The front door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom that must be repaired to prevent pest entry. Interior shelving in the walk-in cooler, prep coolers, and reach-in freezer needs detail cleaning. Floors and walls in the prep area are dirty. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Kitchen and washroom need cleaning; expired certificates
summary: Kitchen prep tables, refrigeration, cooking equipment exteriors, and fryer bottoms need cleaning. The employee washroom toilet and sink need cleaning, and kitchen walls and floors are soiled. Several food handler certificates were expired. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Pots of food stored on walk-in cooler floor
summary: Pots of food were stored on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised six inches. Shelving was rusty, and grease and food debris were on equipment and shelves. Food debris was also under cooking equipment. The summary report was not posted, and a citation was issued. Passed with conditions.

headline: No handwashing sign; storage clutter; missing sink stoppers
summary: No handwashing sign was posted at the front prep area sink. The three-compartment sink lacks drain stoppers, and the utility sink in the rear lacks a backflow device. Items in the rear storage room are cluttered and on the floor. Passed.

headline: Sewer pipes above food prep; two handlers without hair restraints
summary: Black waste and non-potable water pipes are directly above basement food prep, and must be enclosed; a citation was issued. Two food handlers lacked hair restraints. Equipment and walls need cleaning, grease receptacle needs cleaning, and basement items must be elevated and organized. Lighting is inadequate in the basement pastry area. Failed.

headline: Ice scoops left exposed; boxes on freezer floor
summary: Ice scoops were stored with their food-contact surfaces exposed, and staff were shown how to store them. Boxes of food were on the walk-in freezer floor and must be raised six inches. Excessive ice buildup was on the freezer walls and ceiling. A hand sink sign is missing. Passed.

headline: No food handler training for any employee
summary: No food handler training was provided for any employee; this must be provided and maintained. Other items include a leaky front hand sink, boxed food stored on the walk-in freezer floor, and cardboard and crates used as shelf liners. Greasy and iced shelving, worn gaskets, and damaged wall base also need attention. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Hole in wall at front prep area; food handler certificates missing
summary: A hole was in the wall along piping at the front prep area and must be sealed to prevent pest entry; no pests were found. Employees were working without food handler certificates. Management was told all employees must have them on site, with a 30-day grace period for new hires. Passed.

headline: Missing health policies, blocked hand sink, ice machine buildup
summary: No signed employee health policies were provided. The bar hand sink was blocked by alcohol bottles, and had no soap or towels at the time. The ice machine had pink and brown buildup. No raw or undercooked food warning was on the menu. Dumpsters overflowed with open lids. Failed.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; heavy dirt along prep wall base
summary: A torn rubber gasket was on the door of a two-door refrigerator in the kitchen prep area and must be repaired or replaced. Heavy dirt, grime, and wet debris were along the wall base of the rear prep area, especially under the dish area. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Dead cockroaches in dish machine panel; fly strips to remove
summary: Dead cockroaches were found inside the electrical panel of the low-temperature dish machine and must be cleaned. Hanging fly strips must be removed from the food prep and dish area ceiling. Heavily stained cutting boards and an expired food handler certificate were also found. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Certified managers lack allergen training on site
summary: No allergen training was on site for city certified food managers. The business was instructed that all certified food managers must complete allergen training and keep the certificate on site. Passed.

headline: About 40 mouse droppings found; pest service needed
summary: Approximately 40 mouse droppings were found in several areas, including behind the ice machine and under the handwashing sink near the dishwasher, and a citation was issued. Additional pest control service is needed. Bulk flour and rice were unlabeled, and a splash guard was missing. Failed.

headline: Cooler thermometers not working; water-stained ceiling tiles
summary: The outer thermometers on the reach-in coolers do not work, and no internal thermometers are visible. Storage racks and gaskets had food and dirt. Water-stained ceiling tiles were in the waiting and prep areas, and floors under heavy equipment were dirty. Passed.

headline: Bar ice maker lacks backflow device
summary: A backflow prevention device could not be located for the bar ice maker, and the business was instructed to install one. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Expired training certificates; citation for missing summary report
summary: Employees and the food manager had expired training certificates. A citation was issued because no inspection summary had been posted for the public; a new one was posted during the visit. Also noted: unlabeled containers, a worn cooler gasket, rust, and debris. Passed with conditions.

headline: Main dish machine failed to sanitize; tagged and not to be used
summary: The main low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer after a full cycle, so it was tagged and must not be used until repaired and re-inspected. Staff were told to use the three-compartment sink. An air conditioning drain also empties into a sink basin, and a trash receptacle cover is missing. Passed with conditions.

headline: Chicken held at room temperature; ~8 lb discarded
summary: Roasterie chicken was measured at 72-81.1F in the prep area, far above the 41F limit; about 8 lb ($25) was discarded and a citation was issued. Chicken was also thawing at room temperature on the prep counter, which is not an approved method. No food handler certificates were on site. Passed with conditions.

headline: Ice buildup in deep freezer must be cleaned
summary: Inspector saw ice buildup inside the deep freezer. The freezer must be defrosted and cleaned. No other food safety problems were listed. Passed.

headline: Chicken thawed in standing water; no food handler training
summary: Raw chicken was thawing in standing water and the manager was instructed to thaw it correctly. No valid food handler training was on site, and the certified manager on duty had no allergen training. Missing outlet covers and stained ceiling tiles were noted. Passed with conditions.

headline: Uncovered cooked foods in refrigerator; expired food handler certificates
summary: Boiled potatoes, salmon croquettes, and sausages were uncovered in a two-door refrigerator and must be covered. One sink stopper was missing, and a microwave and cold-holding units had food splatters and debris. The ice machine has black buildup. Expired food handler certificates were on site. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: No certified manager while chicken wings prepared
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken wings were prepared and served, and a citation was issued. Certified food managers lacked allergen training certificates. Passed with conditions.

headline: Unused cooking equipment must be removed
summary: Unused cooking equipment must be removed from the premises. No other issues were listed. Passed.

headline: Food stored on floor; several workers lack food handler certificates
summary: Several food handlers had no food handler certificates. A certified food manager lacked allergen training. Food was stored on the dry storage floor, handwashing sinks lacked signs, and walk-in cooler shelving was rusty. Passed.

headline: Display cooler too warm; about 50 lb discarded
summary: TCS foods in the display cooler, including deli sandwiches, bacon, cheese, and yogurt, were at 47-53F, above the 41F limit. About 50 lb ($385) was discarded and a citation was issued. The cooler itself measured 51F. Passed with conditions.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; food in grocery bags; prior violation
summary: Bulk containers in the rear dry storage were unlabeled. Frozen meats were in plastic grocery bags in the freezer. The three-compartment sink has no drainboard, and cardboard was under rubber mats. A previous hood violation over the gas oven was not corrected; a citation was issued. Failed.

headline: Repeat allergen training violation not corrected
summary: A previous core violation was not corrected: certified food managers must show proof of allergen training. The business must correct it, and a citation was issued. Passed with conditions.

headline: License number missing from truck
summary: The license number was not printed on the truck. The person in charge was instructed to print the name on the side at least 2 inches tall. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; cold units too warm
summary: Cold foods such as cheese, milk, and butter were held at 53.0-63.2F, above the 41F limit; about 8 lb ($20) was discarded and a citation was issued. Two cold-holding units ran at 57.4-61.0F and were tagged. The menu raw-food advisory was corrected on site. A drainpipe leaks and a restroom sink is at 76.7F, below 100F. Passed with conditions.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies; dead roaches in dish room
summary: No vomit or diarrhea cleanup supplies were on site, and a citation was issued. Dead cockroaches were found on the dish room wall and must be cleaned and sanitized. Food handlers in the kitchen had no food handler certificates. Greasy buildup and dust on the ceiling need cleaning. Passed with conditions.

headline: Food service manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: A food service sanitation manager had no food allergen training certificate on site. The business was instructed to meet the requirement. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: About 20 mouse droppings; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: About 20 or more mouse droppings were in the oven, food prep, hot-holding, and toilet room areas, and a citation was issued; pest control was recommended. Cold foods, including eggs and corn beef hash, were held at 49-54F and about 18 lb ($165) was discarded. The low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine. A mold-like substance is inside the ice machine. Failed.

headline: Unlabeled containers and food in plastic grocery bags
summary: Food storage containers were unlabeled, and plates were not inverted after sanitizing. Food was stored in plastic grocery bags in freezers and coolers. A backflow preventer at the mop sink was broken off and must be repaired. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Soda mix on floor; ice buildup and damaged floors
summary: Soda dispenser mix was stored on the floor in the rear storage area and must be raised six inches. Food debris was found on coolers, freezers, and shelves. Ice buildup was in the walk-in freezer, and a drainpipe was missing under the prep sink. Floor tiles are damaged, and a handwashing sign is missing. Passed.

headline: Missing health policies; floor and wall repairs needed
summary: No signed employee health policies were on site. Missing items included a splash guard, a cabinet door, and a backflow device for the ice machine. An ice scoop was stored on a counter. Several broken floor tiles, loose wall base, and missing ceiling tiles need repair, and dust needs cleaning in the furnace room. Passed with conditions.

headline: Grill and panini press not under ventilation
summary: A flat top grill and panini press were not stored under the ventilation system when in use and must be. The city sanitation manager lacked allergen training and was instructed to provide it. Passed.

headline: About 80 mouse droppings; food past use-by date
summary: Failed. About 80 mouse droppings in chemical storage, furnace room, and behind bar dish machine; more pest control needed. No certified food manager on site. About 10 lbs of food past use-by date was discarded, worth $150.

headline: Grease and debris on cooking line floors
summary: Passed. Food debris and grease on floors under convection ovens and deep fryers. Troughs behind cooking equipment along prep line need cleaning. Floor under shelves in meat and dairy walk-in cooler needs cleaning.

headline: Droppings on storage shelves and under sink
summary: Failed. Droppings found: 5–8 on rear storage shelves, 10–12 on front storage shelves, and 20–25 under a front service-area handsink. Cooler and holding cabinet interiors, cooking equipment, floors, and hood also need cleaning.

headline: Food stored on walk-in freezer floors
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Food containers stored on the floor in walk-in freezers must be on raised shelving 6 inches off the floor. Certified food managers on duty lack allergen training.

headline: Missing backflow device at mop sink
summary: Passed on license re-inspection. No backflow prevention device at the mop sink faucet. One must be provided where it can be located and serviced.

headline: Meat thawing in plastic container; food on floors
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Frozen meat was thawing in a plastic container in the prep area; manager told to use an approved thawing method. Food stored on floors in walk-in cooler, freezer, and prep areas. Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables.

headline: No certified manager on site; handwashing problems
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while open. Two handwashing sinks had no paper towels; soap was missing at one sink until provided during inspection. Two sinks were blocked. Shelving and allergen certificates also need attention.

headline: Chicken held at 52.5°F; no certified manager
summary: Failed. About 20 lbs of raw chicken held at 52.5°F, above the 41°F limit, was discarded. No certified food manager on duty while food was served. Water backed up at three-compartment sink. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Walk-in coolers need visible thermometers
summary: Passed on license re-inspection. All walk-in coolers need visible thermometers. Manager must install and maintain them.

headline: Dish machine sanitizing at zero ppm
summary: Failed. Low-temperature dish machine's final sanitizing rinse measured 0 ppm chlorine; inspector lists 50–100 ppm as required. Machine not in use; manager told to repair it. Outside dumpster lids broken with large holes.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and cooler thermometers
summary: Passed with conditions on re-inspection. Handwashing signs missing at rear prep sinks; prep coolers lack air thermometers; storage bins unlabeled; wooden surface under dish machine; debris near freezer and fryers. Inspection summary was partly covered; a new one was posted.

headline: No valid certified manager certificate on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid original City of Chicago food service sanitation manager certificate on site or posted. Spices and oils stored outside packaging without labels. Cooking equipment and fryer interior need cleaning; basement clutter must be elevated 6 inches.

headline: Uncorrected violation; missing allergen training certificates
summary: Passed with conditions. A core violation from January 30, 2024 was not corrected. Certified food managers lack allergen training certificates on site. Floors need cleaning by the beverage area, syrup racks, dry storage, and fryers.

headline: Handwashing signs and hot water needed
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs required at all handsinks and washbowls in both washrooms. Metered washbowls need more water flow. Food prep sink has only cold water and must provide hot water. Women's washroom trash receptacle needs a cover.

headline: Sauces and chickpeas covered while cooling
summary: Passed. Prepared sauces and cooked chickpeas were covered with container lids while cooling in the walk-in cooler; manager told to store them loosely covered or uncovered. Milk crates and plastic pallets used under sink; floor beneath sink soiled.

headline: Rags touching oysters and lemons; pink slime in ice machine
summary: Passed. Rags in direct contact with oysters and lemons in the main kitchen. Plastic cups used as scoops for seasonings; tongs stored in standing water. Ice machine drip plate soiled with pink slime. Food handler and allergen certificates not on site.

headline: Food on freezer floor; wet deli cups stacked
summary: Passed with conditions. Food containers stored on the walk-in freezer floor; wet deli cups stacked without air drying, and manager told to re-wash and air-dry them. Refuse enclosure littered. Current inspection summary was not posted; one was provided.

headline: Live flies; food held at unsafe temperatures
summary: Failed. About 25 small live flies in prep areas, on beverage equipment, and near ovens. Hot foods held at 107–120°F, below required 135°F. About 2 gallons of creamers at 55–60°F, above 41°F, were discarded. No certified manager with valid certificate posted.

headline: Missing handwashing sign near cook line
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign at an exposed handwashing sink located near the cook line. Manager told to provide one.

headline: Buildup inside ice machine
summary: Passed. Buildup found on the upper portion of the ice machine. Manager told to clean the interior of the ice machine and keep it clean.

headline: No certified food manager during milk prep
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while milk, a food that must be kept hot or cold, was being prepared. Metal ice scoop stored improperly on top of the ice machine; manager told to provide a clean container.

headline: No temperature indicator on dish machines
summary: Failed. Hot-water sanitizing dish machines lacked an irreversible registering temperature indicator. Manager told to provide one and keep it readily accessible.

headline: Dead insects on fly traps; no certified manager on site
summary: Failed. Sticky fly traps with dead insects hung near a sink and aprons in rear prep; manager told to remove them. Certified manager arrived at 9:31 AM and left during inspection. Food handler certificates expired; no metal stem thermometer.

headline: Employee without hair restraint; fryers very dirty
summary: Passed. A male employee in the food prep area was not wearing a hair restraint. Fryers have thick buildup of dirt, grease, and food. Mop sink lacks a backflow device, and a three-compartment sink faucet leaks. Certified manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: Raw beef thawing in standing water
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Raw beef was thawing in still room-temperature water near the three-compartment sink. Utensils in still room-temperature water at the coffee station. Freezer gaskets in poor repair; one certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Salmon held at 48.7–53.9°F; no hot water
summary: Failed. Salmon in a prep cooler measured 48.7–53.9°F, above the 41°F limit; about 20 lbs discarded. Women's employee restroom handsink had no hot water (77.5°F). No sanitizer test devices, and no sushi rice lab letter or pH meter on site.

headline: No handwashing sink behind bar; rear door gap
summary: Passed with conditions. Must install a designated handwashing sink with hot and cold water, soap, and paper towels behind the bar. Rear exit door has a 1/2-inch gap. Leak under sink, floor holes, debris, and pooling liquid in basement also noted.

headline: No health policy; no food-prep-only sink
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy on site. Unfinished wood and torn plastic shelving found. No sink is used solely for food prep; only a handsink exists in the front bar area. Pink foam on wall by ice machine. Neither certified manager has allergen training.

headline: Opening in front entrance doors
summary: Passed on re-inspection. An opening runs from top to bottom in the middle of the front entrance outer double doors. Manager told to seal all outer openings to prevent pest entry.

headline: About 20 rat droppings in basement dish area
summary: Failed. Rodent activity found, including about 20 rat droppings in the basement dish area; pest control service needed. A certified manager arrived partway through without proof of a valid certificate. Hair restraints missing; sanitizer test kit provided late.

headline: Wall repairs and hood cleaning needed
summary: Passed on complaint re-inspection. Wall surfaces must be made smooth over the three-compartment sink, front cashier, and pit areas. Chipped concrete in rear prep, a loose freezer wall panel, and holes in brick walls need repair. Hood filters need debris removed.

headline: Numerous dead roaches found under cooler and sink
summary: Passed. Numerous dead roaches were found on the floor under a reach-in cooler and near a utility sink; manager told to remove them. Also noted: containers stored in utility sink, crates used as shelving, and wall cracks and openings.

headline: Dish machine gauge broken; sinks lack signs
summary: Failed. High-temperature dish machine gauge not working; corrected on site and tagged. No handwashing signs at first and second floor bars. Cold water not running at basement three-compartment sink; no prep sink in two areas.

headline: Dirty floors and walls; prevent insects
summary: Passed. Floors and walls with dirt, debris, or splatter behind the rear three-compartment sink, behind the wrap station, and under the front food service counter. Manager instructed to clean all areas to prevent insect activity.

headline: Blocked handsinks; no soap or paper towels
summary: Passed with conditions. Utensils stored in handsinks blocked access to washing. No paper towels at main prep sinks; no soap at two prep handsinks. Several TCS foods (foods that must be kept hot or cold) lacked discard dates. Fryer dirt and grease also noted.

headline: Wiping cloths improperly stored
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were improperly stored. Manager must store them in sanitizing solution when not in use.

headline: Damaged floor tiles; broken light shield
summary: Passed. Missing and damaged floor tiles in rear prep in front of cooking equipment; grout needed. Broken light shield in the dry storeroom must be replaced.

headline: No hot water; no commercial garbage pickup
summary: Failed. No hot water at prep handsink, washbowl, or three-compartment sink. No handwashing sink at front serving line. Garbage uses residential dumpsters with no commercial pickup. Food service manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Live birds flying in dining rooms; removed
summary: Passed with conditions. Ten small live birds flew in upstairs and downstairs dining areas; manager removed all birds by opening windows, then closed them. Soap and trash can lid were provided by end of inspection. Paper towels missing at several sinks.

headline: Food handler certificates required for staff
summary: Passed on re-inspection. All food handlers who are not City of Chicago food service managers must obtain a food handler training certificate.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; rusty shelving
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign near the front bar handsink. Wiping cloths on prep tables and ice scoops stored in the ice bin. Rusty walk-in shelving, leaking handsink faucet, water-damaged ceiling tiles, and burned-out bulbs also noted.

headline: 300+ mouse droppings; rodent infestation found
summary: Failed. Rodent infestation: 300 or more mouse droppings under sinks, cooking equipment, and storage areas. Clean and call pest control. No pest control logbook on site. Hot water never exceeded 93°F at any sink; minimum required is 100°F.

headline: Dirt buildup in floor drain
summary: Passed. Accumulated dirt was found inside the floor drain under the three-compartment sink. Manager must clean the drain and keep it maintained.

headline: Roaches found; vacuum-sealed food discarded
summary: Failed. Three roaches crawling on a wall and three-compartment sink; no certified food manager on premises. Vacuum-sealed food discarded ($700) without approved HACCP plan on site. Vacuum machine tagged. Cold-holding unit measured 46.6°F.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; slow bar sink
summary: Passed. Expired food handler training certificates for current employees. One certified manager lacks allergen training. Mineral buildup inside soda dispenser nozzles at the bar. Water drains very slowly at the bar handwashing sink.

headline: Wiping cloths improperly stored; dirty oven
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. Oven lower interior dirty with food and dirt. Trash receptacle in unisex restroom has no cover. Vents, ceiling tiles, and floors need cleaning.

headline: No valid certified manager; no health policy
summary: Passed with conditions. Person in charge lacks a valid certified food manager certificate, and no certified manager was on site while food was prepared and served. No employee health policy or food handler certificates shown. Handwashing signs missing.

headline: No handwashing signs; prior violation uncorrected
summary: Failed. No handwashing signs at sinks. Exhaust hood, wok stations, and tables are not clean. Floor beneath main cook line heavily soiled with grease and food debris; this core violation from December 9, 2024 was not corrected.

headline: Soiled apron near clean equipment
summary: Passed. Soiled apron hung on a storage rack next to clean multi-use equipment; manager told to store soiled linens properly. Rust on vents in the warewashing room. Loose hot water faucet handle at the three-compartment sink.

headline: Unlabeled containers; allergen training expired
summary: Passed. Basement dry storage containers (rice, onions, beans) must be labeled with food names. A clear bowl was used as a scoop for cauliflower in the cooks area prep cooler. Certified food manager has expired allergen training.

headline: Rat droppings found; no employee health policy
summary: Failed. Rat droppings found: about 5 under a dish room prep table, 5 to 10 along baseboards behind coolers, and 10 to 15 behind a glass-door cooler. Manager told to remove them and call pest control. No written employee health policy on site.

headline: Dirty fan vents; missing lid and light covers
summary: Passed. Missing lid on employee restroom receptacle. Dirt and debris under counters at coffee station. Light covers missing in rear food service area, though covers are on site. Dust on fan vents in rear prep and dish areas.

headline: Leaks under sinks; floors need detail cleaning
summary: Passed on complaint re-inspection. Leaks under the three-compartment sinks in the deli and produce areas. Walk-in cooler floors, areas under shelves, and back storage need detail cleaning. Soiled mop heads not hung to dry; debris along walls.

headline: Cold foods at 49.8–56.6°F; walk-in too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. About 58 lbs of cold foods, including turkey shawarma and chopped greens, held at 49.8–56.6°F in the walk-in cooler; discarded. Walk-in air measured 48.7°F; not to be used until it holds 41°F or below.

headline: Cooler thermometers missing; rust and leaks noted
summary: Passed. Cold-holding units lack air thermometers; prep cooler gaskets torn; rust on walk-in shelving holding seafood; faucet leaking, held with towel; toilet tank lid missing; water-damaged ceiling tiles; manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Front door gap; cluttered basement
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the front entrance door sweep must be closed to keep pests out. Basement floor is cluttered; manager must elevate all items off the floor or remove them.

headline: Food on floors; no thermometer in cooler
summary: Passed. No thermometer inside reach-in cooler under soft-serve machine. Food stored on floors in walk-in cooler and freezer must be elevated 6 inches. Food and grease buildup on equipment and floors. No waste receptacle at front handsink.

headline: Floors need cleaning in several areas
summary: Passed. Floors need cleaning to remove spills, debris, or grease in the walk-in cooler, under the three-compartment sink in the dishwashing area, and in the kitchen.

headline: Blocked handsink; expired certificates; prior violation
summary: Failed. Handsink next to pizza oven is blocked by metal shelves, has no paper towels, and has low water pressure. Expired food handler and allergen certificates. Prior violation (no covered trash can in restroom) remains uncorrected.

headline: Cold-holding units lack thermometers; basement sink unprotected
summary: Passed. Cold-holding units lack internal air thermometers. In the basement warewashing area, the three-compartment sink is not protected from overhead dust, no drying rack exists, and walls and floors are absorbent and not sealed.

headline: Unlabeled food; food uncovered; floors damaged
summary: Passed. Food stored unlabeled in coolers and dry storage. Bulk flour and sushi containers uncovered. Food debris and spills throughout prep areas. Missing floor grout and damaged tiles. Burned-out bulb in rear two-door refrigerator.

headline: Rodent droppings, dead mouse, and beef held too warm
summary: Failed. About 65 small rodent droppings scattered across storage room floor and a dead mouse found; gaps let pests in. 50 lbs cooked Italian beef at 66.8°F, above the 41°F limit, was discarded. No hand cleanser in toilet room.

headline: Leaking drainpipe; food handler proof missing
summary: Passed on complaint re-inspection. Drainpipe leaking under the rear dish area handsink must be repaired. No proof of food handler training on site for any food handlers.

headline: Purse on prep table; knives stored between coolers
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Open purse on a food prep table; in-use knives stored between coolers and a plastic cup in the ice bin. Food containers unlabeled. Grease buildup on cooking equipment, walls, and floors; leak at a dish machine sink.

headline: Handwashing sink without hot water
summary: Passed with conditions. Handwashing sink in the rear dough prep area had no hot water; temperature was 64°F. Manager must provide hot running water at least 100°F. Food debris found under heavy equipment throughout prep area.

headline: Stained cutting boards; grease in drains
summary: Passed. Cutting boards in the upstairs prep area have dark stains and open seams. Milk crates used for elevation near dough making. Drains under the dishwasher and three-compartment sink have grease and a brown substance.

headline: Rusty, chipped cooler shelving
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Chipped paint and rust on wire storage racks in the rear two-door cooler. Manager must remove rust and repaint or replace the shelves.

headline: No vomiting/diarrhea cleanup procedure; no health policy
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy on site and no procedure for cleaning vomit or diarrhea. Refrigeration units lack thermometers, and certified managers lack allergen training. Floor cracks and an unlit exhaust hood area also noted.

headline: No sneeze guard at self-serve hot food line
summary: Failed on re-inspection. Still no sneeze guard at the self-service hot food line to protect food from customers. Disposable cups used as scoops. Food handler certificates were expired.

headline: Mouse droppings in several areas; failed
summary: Failed on re-inspection. Mouse droppings: about 20 under pastry prep shelving, 40 to 50 at the server station counter, and 30 to 40 in basement dry storage and behind freezers. Soiled linens stored outdoors; torn cooler gaskets.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged out
summary: Passed with conditions. High-temperature dish machine sanitized dishes at only 170°F, and dish surface temperatures did not reach 160°F. Manager told to stop using it until re-inspected by the Chicago Department of Public Health. Machine tagged.

headline: Dirty sink basins; missing stoppers
summary: Passed. Sink basins throughout the facility are not clean and have debris. Three-compartment sink is missing stoppers. Missing and cracked floor tiles in prep area; dirt and debris along rear wall bases.

headline: Unlabeled sauces; summary not visible
summary: Passed with conditions. Soy sauce, lime juice, and hot sauce outside packaging lack labels. Ice scoop stored in ice bin. Plates and utensils stored facing up. Toilet room door in prep area lacks self-closing device. Inspection summary not posted visibly; a citation was issued.

headline: Torn gaskets; coolers need detail cleaning
summary: Passed on complaint re-inspection. Torn door gaskets on two-door prep coolers must be replaced. Interior of reach-in and walk-in coolers needs detail cleaning; gaskets in the two-door reach-in are encrusted with food debris.

headline: Foil and cardboard liners; plumber's putty repair
summary: Passed. Tin foil and cardboard used as shelf liners; oven heavily soiled. Plumber's putty used to repair three-compartment sink drains, which must be welded or replaced. Duct tape used for wiring repair; floor and ceiling issues noted.

headline: Grease buildup near basement grease container
summary: Passed with conditions. Heavy grease on the floor around the basement grease container, a priority citation. Rusty shelving in the basement walk-in cooler. Food debris and grease on floors behind grill and fryers.

headline: Sanitizer concentration above allowed level
summary: Passed with conditions. Sanitizer in the three-compartment sink far exceeded the 400 ppm limit; manager told to keep it within the manufacturer's 150–400 ppm range. Reused food containers were being used as multi-use containers.

headline: Cooking equipment bottom needs cleaning
summary: Passed. Bottom area and exterior surfaces of cooking equipment need cleaning. Floor under walk-in cooler shelves and under the fryer in the kitchen also need cleaning.

headline: Ice machine and equipment need cleaning
summary: Passed. Small amounts of buildup inside the ice machine. Exterior of cooking equipment has food spills. Floors under all equipment have food debris. Manager must clean and maintain these areas.

headline: Patio door gap; exposed silverware
summary: Passed with conditions. Gap between patio exit doors must be repaired. Silverware exposed on dining tables must be protected. Ceiling in rear pizza prep in poor repair; walk-in fan cover dusty. Expired food allergen certificates.

headline: Grocery bags used for meat and shrimp
summary: Passed. Grocery bags used to store meat and cover prepared shrimp; only food-grade bags allowed. Dried food debris in cooling units. Grease and debris pooled under heavy prep equipment. Duct tape holds wall base; burned-out prep light.

headline: Exposed foam caulk on walls and pipes
summary: Passed. Exposed foam-like caulk on walls and around pipes throughout the facility. Manager must resurface the areas to make them smooth and easily cleanable.

headline: No food handler certificates on site
summary: Passed on license re-inspection. No employees with food handler training certificates were on site. No utility sink on site, the washroom door is not self-closing, and a mop is drying improperly.

headline: Fish thawed in standing water; expired food handler card
summary: Passed. Fish was thawing sitting in a bucket of water. Manager told to thaw under cool running water, in a microwave, or in a cooler. Fryers greasy; toilet room ventilation not working; a food handler's certificate expired.

headline: No hot water at several sinks
summary: Passed with conditions. No hot water at multiple sinks, measured 52.7–53.1°F. Hot water under pressure must be provided at all handwashing, three-compartment, and utility sinks. Leaking utility sink faucet; damaged dry storage floor tiles; stained ceiling tiles.

headline: No pest control logbook; food debris on shelves
summary: Failed. No pest control logbook on premises; manager must provide one from a licensed Illinois pest control operator by re-inspection. Accumulated food debris on prep area shelves and inside sinks.

headline: Food stored in grocery bags in cooler
summary: Passed. Food was stored in grocery bags in the two-door cooler; manager told to use food-grade containers or bags. Floors around cooking equipment and under the three-compartment sink need cleaning.

headline: Dead roaches at handsink and in basement
summary: Passed. Dead roaches found at a prep area handsink and in basement storage; manager told to remove them, clean, and sanitize. Reach-in and walk-in coolers lack air thermometers. Ceiling holes, exposed caulk, and a burned-out dish area bulb noted.

headline: Rear door gap; leaks and wall openings
summary: Passed. Rear door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom right corner and must be made tight-fitting. Excessive dust on warewashing floor. Leaks under the three-compartment sink; wall openings and missing base; dirty walls.

headline: Unlabeled containers; splash guard needed
summary: Passed on license re-inspection. Dry ingredient containers not labeled with common food name. Bar handwashing sink needs a splash guard to protect silverware on the cooler. Bowls and containers not inverted in rear prep. Standing water in mop closet.

headline: Heavy grease and debris; stained ceiling tiles
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Accumulated grease and food debris on equipment, prep tables, and coolers. Heavily stained ceiling tiles in restrooms and rear storage. Heavy dust on hood filters and restroom vent. Soiled mop heads not hung to dry.

headline: Openings at revolving front door base
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Openings found at the base of the center of the revolving front entrance door. Manager told to seal all outer openings to prevent pest entry.

headline: No vomit/diarrhea procedure or kit
summary: Passed with conditions. No procedure or kit for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events. Splash guard needed between three-compartment sink and handsink. Staff washroom door not self-closing; holes in ceiling tiles above freezers.

headline: Torn gasket on rear refrigerator
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Torn door gasket inside the two-door refrigerator in the rear food storage area must be repaired.

headline: Missing trash lid; loose coving; dirty floors
summary: Passed. Lid missing on unisex washroom trash can. Wall coving under three-compartment sink is loose. Floors in rear dish area and front prep need cleaning along wall bases and corners; floor drains also need cleaning.

headline: Torn gaskets; missing backflow device
summary: Passed. Torn gaskets on basement walk-in cooler door and three-door prep cooler. No backflow prevention device on basement utility sink. One certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Food cooling covered; scoops touch food
summary: Passed. Food cooling in a cooler was covered with lid and foil; manager told to hold uncovered for proper cooling. Scoops with handles in contact with food in dry bins. Three handwashing sinks lack signs; leaks and unfinished wood shelving noted.

headline: Cardboard and foil used as shelf liners
summary: Passed. Cardboard boxes and aluminum foil used to line shelves under prep tables must be removed. Broken boxes on floors; standing water near mop sink; water- and mold-stained ceiling tiles need replacement.

headline: No certified manager while serving sandwiches, eggs
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge with a valid certificate. No certified food manager on duty while foods such as sandwiches and eggs were prepared and served. Milk crates used as shelving must be removed.

headline: Wiping cloths and knives improperly stored
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths on tabletops were not stored in sanitizing solution. Knives stored between wall and sink instead of a clean sanitized holder. Cooking equipment needs cleaning. Restroom wall hole and food spills on floors also noted.

headline: Failed: live roaches and rodent droppings found
summary: Failed. About 15 mouse droppings in rear storage closet. Live roaches under sink, on prep table, on walls, and in washroom; dead roaches on floors. No 2025 or 2026 pest service reports. Dumpster overflowing. Pest control service needed.

headline: Passed; boxed food on floor, dirty floors
summary: Passed. Boxed food stored on floor near rear utility closet; must be elevated six inches. Cardboard used as shelf and cooler liners. Dirt on floors, along walls, and in corners throughout the establishment.

headline: Passed; certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. Certified food manager on site has no allergen training certificate. Must obtain and maintain a valid allergen training certificate.

headline: Passed re-inspection; storage and labeling fixes
summary: Passed re-inspection. Employee personal care items stored above napkins and single-service plasticware. Bulk dry containers at coffee bar not labeled. Dry tea bags stored on closet floor. Water heater condensate not routed to floor drain.

headline: Passed; rear door gap and leaking sink
summary: Passed. 1/4-inch gap at rear exit door sweep must be fixed to rodent-proof the door. Grease and food debris inside mop sink. Three-compartment sink faucet leaking at base. Wall damaged beside hot water tank. One hood filter missing.

headline: Passed re-inspection; hot-holding unit lacks thermometer
summary: Passed re-inspection. Upright hot-holding unit in central kitchen lacks a digital gauge and internal air thermometer; must provide. Maintenance tools stored above clean plates. Heavy grease under cook line. Employee items stored in cold units.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager on site while tacos, chicken, pizza puffs, sliced tomato, and polish were prepared and served; priority citation issued. Food handler and allergen training certificates missing. Dried food debris on equipment.

headline: Passed; wiping cloths and floor drains need work
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. Floor drains must be detail cleaned to prevent a breeding place for pests.

headline: Failed: over 100 mouse droppings; contaminated snacks
summary: Failed. Over 100 mouse droppings on display shelves, floors, and under equipment. Chips and popcorn that were gnawed, torn, and contaminated with droppings were on sale; manager told to discard. Exterminator required. 1/4-inch gap at front door.

headline: Failed re-inspection; clogged sinks, greasy equipment
summary: Failed re-inspection. Front prep hand sink and three-compartment sink are clogged and not draining. Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables, cardboard liners, food in plastic bags, grooved cutting board, and heavy grease buildup.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; no food thermometer
summary: Failed. No certified manager on site, and no certified food employee while milk tea and ice cream were prepared. No probe thermometer. Plastic cup used as scoop in dry storage. Summary report not posted. Missing drain stoppers.

headline: Passed; utensil rack too close to mop sink
summary: Passed. Clean utensil rack is too close to mop sink. Inspector instructed installing a barrier to prevent contamination.

headline: Failed: no hot water at main kitchen hand sink
summary: Failed. Main kitchen hand sink had no hot or cold water; water line disconnected. Washroom hot water peaked at 82.2°F; at least 100°F required. Ice machine parts dirty, ceiling tile missing, and prior violations uncorrected.

headline: Passed with conditions; oysters lacked tags
summary: Passed with conditions. Hand sinks had no paper towels. Oysters in display cooler lacked required shellstock tags; manager voluntarily discarded 7 pounds. Food stored on floors and in tin cans; cardboard and milk crates used as shelving.

headline: Passed; dust on washroom ceiling vents
summary: Passed. Dust accumulation on ceiling vents inside unisex washrooms must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Passed with conditions; gumbo held at 47.6°F
summary: Passed with conditions. Gumbo inside walk-in cooler measured 47.6°F, above the 41°F limit; manager immediately discarded 5 pounds ($60). Storage containers lack common-name labels. Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced.

headline: Passed re-inspection; soiled mop heads
summary: Passed re-inspection. Soiled mop heads not properly stored; manager instructed to hang them to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Passed; restroom fan not working, allergen gap
summary: Passed. Ventilation fan in north washroom not operational; must repair or replace. Certified food manager lacks an allergen training certificate; proof of training required.

headline: Failed re-inspection: no hot water; live roaches
summary: Failed re-inspection. No hot water at any hand sink, utility sink, or three-compartment sink; priority violation. Three live roaches from prior report not eliminated; pest service required. Holes in walls and stained cutting boards.

headline: Passed re-inspection; missing thermometers, slow sink
summary: Passed re-inspection. Thermometers missing inside walk-in cooler and front prep cooling units; must locate and maintain. Rear prep hand sink drains slowly. Crates and unused equipment outside rear near receptacles must be removed.

headline: Passed; hair restraints and floors need cleaning
summary: Passed. Some employees on duty without hair restraints; must wear them at all times. Floors along wall bases and under equipment, especially at the bar, need cleaning, including floor drains.

headline: Passed; no food handler certificates on site
summary: Passed. No food handler certificates on site; all food handlers must take the course and keep records. Two-door cold holding units and display cooler lack ambient air thermometers. Gender-neutral restroom lacks lidded receptacle.

headline: Passed; torn cooler gasket, dusty vent
summary: Passed. Torn, loose gasket on deli cooler in front of grill must be repaired or replaced. Food debris on side of unused cooler near dough machine. Staff restroom ceiling vent covered in dust.

headline: Passed with conditions; spoiled meat discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Spoiled ground beef, deli meats, and hot dogs in cooler and offered for sale: discolored, foul-smelling, past expiration. About 20 pounds ($150) discarded and denatured. Excess freezer ice and clutter in rear storage.

headline: Passed; loose gasket, milk crates, dirty shelving
summary: Passed. Gasket on lower reach-in unit near meat slicer is coming loose; must repair. Dirt and small debris on lower shelving in front food area. Milk crates store items in deep freezer and walk-in; must be replaced with shelving.

headline: Failed: no hot-holding equipment or test kit
summary: Failed. Facility has no hot-holding equipment; priority violation. No chemical test kit for sanitizer or warewashing area. Drainboard needed for air-drying dishes in kitchen. No citation issued.

headline: Passed re-inspection; ice machine lacks backflow device
summary: Passed re-inspection. No backflow prevention device on ice machine waterline. A device must be provided where it can be located and serviced.

headline: Failed: dish machines and salsa held too warm
summary: Failed. Two hot-water dish machines sanitized at 105°F and 130°F; 160°F required. Dish machines tagged and not in use. Salsa with cut tomatoes held at 50°F; manager discarded 5 pounds. No temperature indicator for dish machines.

headline: Passed; damaged boards, missing door, leaks
summary: Passed. Large white cutting boards in rear pizza area have deep grooves and stains; replace. Dish area drains need detail cleaning. Pizza prep door missing. Dish machines need detail cleaning. Rear three-compartment sink faucet leaking.

headline: Passed; grime on cooler, trash, expired allergen
summary: Passed. Food debris and grime on small deli cooler; dry ingredient containers grimy on exteriors. Trash on exterior parking lot must be cleaned. Certified manager's allergen certificate expired; updated training required.

headline: Failed: no soap or paper towels at handsink
summary: Failed. Employee washroom hand sink lacked paper towels, soap, and handwashing sign; priority violation. Refrigeration inadequate for milk and eggs. Person in charge could not provide a complete pest control logbook. No covered waste receptacle in washroom.

headline: Passed re-inspection; front door opening, no grease trap
summary: Passed re-inspection. Opening between front entrance doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. No grease trap on three-compartment sink; must install. No covered receptacles in unisex washrooms. No mop drying rack.

headline: Passed; expired food handler certificates
summary: Passed. Expired food handler certificates found on premises. Operator instructed to obtain and maintain current certificates.

headline: Failed: door gap, open dumpsters, no food handler training
summary: Failed. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the rear exit door must be sealed. Dumpsters uncovered with grease spills; priority citation. Soiled wiping cloths, damaged cooler gaskets, missing ceiling tile, and no valid food handler training.

headline: Failed: cold foods held at 45 to 50°F
summary: Failed. Eggs at 45°F, cheese at 48°F, egg roll filling at 48°F, and chicken salad at 50°F in prep cooler; cold foods must be 41°F or below. Two food handlers lacked training. Washroom had no covered waste bin and no working fan.

headline: Passed re-inspection; floors and walls not smooth
summary: Passed re-inspection. Floors in office, washroom, and under three-compartment sink are not smooth and easily cleanable. Washroom and hallway walls likewise. Must restore smooth, cleanable surfaces and maintain them.

headline: Passed re-inspection; no food handler training
summary: Passed re-inspection. Employee has no food handler training certificate; must provide and keep on site. Person in charge has no allergen certificate. Restroom door lacks self-closing device.

headline: Passed; expired training certificates, shelf liners
summary: Passed. Expired food handler and allergen training certificates shown; renewal required every 3 years. Cutting board stored on sink backsplash. Cardboard and egg cartons used as shelf liners. Grease on floor drains under cooking equipment.

headline: Passed; milk crates, cardboard liners, ice buildup
summary: Passed. Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced with shelving six inches off the floor. Cardboard lining food prep equipment and tables must be removed. Excess ice in reach-in freezer. Leaking three-compartment sink faucet and bar rinser pipes.

headline: Failed: no certified staff; mice in prep and basement
summary: Failed. No one on site with a sanitation certificate while cooked rice and stew were handled; priority citation issued. About 30 to 40 mouse droppings in front prep and basement. Utensils in tubs need washing due to rodent contamination.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk containers, leaking sink
summary: Passed. Bulk containers of flour, seasonings, and breading lack labels. Spoiled wiping cloths stored on prep tables and chest freezers; must be kept in sanitizer at least 50 ppm. Leaking washroom hand sink and rear sink drainpipe.

headline: Failed: hand sinks had inadequate hot water
summary: Failed. Some hand sinks measured hot water between 77.7 and 80.1°F. Hot water must be restored to 100 to 110°F at all hand sinks. Priority violation.

headline: Passed with conditions; no valid manager certificate
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid certified manager certificate on site while milk, elote, and cut melons were handled; priority violation. No written employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit. Dust and food debris along walls.

headline: Failed: rat droppings in storage and pizza area
summary: Failed after complaint. About 30 rat droppings in rear storage behind the liquor cage and about 25 in the front pizza area under the counter. Removal and pest control service required. Coolers, shelving, and floors also need cleaning.

headline: Failed: rat infestation with about 150 droppings
summary: Failed. Rat infestation on both levels: about 150 droppings, plus about 45 live small flies. Open rodent bait found near food and on shelves. No valid sanitation certificate; no certified manager present. Hand sink blocked. More pest service needed.

headline: Passed; dirty ice bin guard, foil shelf liner
summary: Passed. Interior guard of ice machine bin has dirt; detail clean required. Foil used as shelf liner in rear must be removed. Dirt builds up along walls and in corners in prep, storage, and warewashing areas.

headline: Passed; beef tongue thawed at room temperature
summary: Passed. Frozen beef tongue thawed at room temperature at basement sink; must thaw under cold running water or refrigeration. Wiping cloths stored on counter. Raw beef and goat stored in large garbage cans in walk-in cooler.

headline: Passed with conditions; cold unit at 49°F
summary: Passed with conditions. A cold holding unit measured 49°F, above the 41°F limit for cold food. The manager lowered the temperature during inspection and said it reached 41°F by the end. All cold units must stay at 41°F or below.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager on duty
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food service manager on duty while TCS foods were stored, prepared, and served; priority citation issued. No thermometer in prep table cooler. Food stored in plastic bags; allergen training certificate missing.

headline: Passed re-inspection; damaged baseboards, unused equipment
summary: Passed re-inspection. Missing or damaged baseboard coving at front prep entrance must be repaired. Unused coolers and equipment, including nonworking soda dispensing system, must be removed or repaired to prevent pest harboring.

headline: Passed re-inspection; greasy fryers, clogged mop sink
summary: Passed re-inspection. Deep fryers have thick grease, dirt, and food buildup. Damaged or missing gaskets on front prep reach-in coolers. Mop sink clogged and not draining. An employee lacks proof of food handler training.

headline: Failed: no health policy, spill kit, or lower hand sink
summary: Failed. No employee health policy and no vomit spill kit. No hand sink in lower-level prep area. Missing handwashing signs and backflow devices at ice machine and mop sink. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training. Items must be provided.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; toilets soiled with feces
summary: Failed. Person in charge lacked a sanitation certificate. Certified manager arrived about 50 minutes after being called while TCS foods were being prepared. Employees ate in prep areas. Both toilets dirty with feces. Floors, shelving, and fryers dirty.

headline: Passed; rust, broken ceiling tile, dusty vents
summary: Passed. Basement hand sink splash guard has heavy rust; must clean, paint, or seal. Shelving above sandwich prep is greasy and dusty. Broken, missing, and moldy ceiling tile near prep and dish area. Dim basement cooler lighting.

headline: Failed: no person in charge; no certified staff
summary: Failed. No person in charge and no certified staff on site. Manager arrived about 40 minutes after a phone call while TCS foods were served. Restroom hot water only 88.8 to 89.4°F; 100°F required. Unauthorized person on cook line.

headline: Passed; heavy grease on equipment under hood
summary: Passed. Heavy equipment in prep area under ventilation hood has heavy grease deposits on exterior surfaces. Must remove, clean, and maintain.

headline: Passed; wall damage, clutter, cold unit repairs
summary: Passed. Tape used on deli cold-holding unit and broken handle on walk-in cooler door; must be repaired. Grime and food debris inside deli unit. Unused soiled ice machine in rear storage. Cracked floors and damaged wall coverings.

headline: Passed; food splatter and dust on walls
summary: Passed. Food splatter on wall behind prep hand sink. Dust and food debris along wall behind prep tables. Must clean where needed and maintain.

headline: Passed with conditions; no hand soap at sinks
summary: Passed with conditions. No hand soap at prep kitchen and employee restroom hand sinks; priority violation. Open coffee cup placed on cutting board in prep kitchen. Cheese shredder not cleaned properly after use.

headline: Passed; floors need cleaning along walls
summary: Passed. Floors throughout need cleaning along wall bases and in corners to remove spills and debris.

headline: Passed; rusty can opener; floor fixed on site
summary: Passed. Slight rust on can opener blade at prep table; must clean or replace. Floor under dry storage shelves was cleaned on site as instructed.

headline: Passed; broken weather strip, low cooler lighting
summary: Passed. Broken weather strip at entry door must be replaced to prevent pest activity. Dust in walk-in cooler vent. Floors under shelving and equipment have dirt and debris. Very low lighting in walk-in cooler.

headline: Passed with conditions; torn freezer gaskets
summary: Passed with conditions. Damaged or torn gaskets on two-door freezer near dish area hand sink must be repaired or replaced. Previous violation not corrected: no allergen certificate for food service manager; priority citation issued.

headline: Failed: mold-like buildup in ice chute
summary: Failed. Visible mold-like buildup in ice chute of beverage dispenser; priority citation issued. Employees with ineffective hair restraints. Prep shelving and mixer exteriors need cleaning. Large hole in rear prep wall near hand sink.

headline: Passed re-inspection; greasy equipment, clutter
summary: Passed re-inspection. Heavy cooking equipment, display coolers, carts, and shelving encrusted with grease and dried food debris. Unused refrigeration, crates, and unnecessary items stored near outside receptacle area must be removed.

headline: Passed; unlabeled containers, greasy kitchen
summary: Passed. Food storage containers lack common-name labels. Frozen food in plastic grocery bags in walk-in freezer must use food-grade containers. Grease buildup on cooking equipment, walls, floors, and shelving; dirt in corners.

headline: Passed; missing thermometer, broken light bulbs
summary: Passed. No thermometer found inside two-door cooler in front prep; must provide. Broken wall base at rear prep back door. Broken ceiling light bulbs in prep area. Two food handlers lack food handler training.

headline: Passed; unknown white powder and grease
summary: Passed. Unknown white powder along kitchen baseboards must be removed. Shelving under grill and fryer has excessive grease. Expanding spray foam at three-compartment sink must be smoothed to be cleanable.

headline: Passed; hair restraints and detail cleaning needed
summary: Passed. Food handlers must wear hair restraints, with long hair tied back. Large can opener, cooking equipment, and soda nozzles need detail cleaning. Floors in corners and along wall bases need detail cleaning.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings; bare-hand contact with food
summary: Failed. No certified manager on site while TCS foods were prepared. Food handler touched arugula with bare hands; product discarded. About 30 rodent droppings in prep, bar, and men's restroom. No test strips; no summary report posted.

headline: Failed: about 60 live small flies; no certified manager
summary: Failed after complaint. Person in charge had no valid sanitation certificate. About 60 live small flies found on walls, ceilings, racks, and conduits in kitchen and dish area; pest control recommended. Faucet leaking; dirty floors and walls.

headline: Passed; rear door gap, missing thermometers
summary: Passed. Gap at left corner of rear exit door must be tightened to prevent pest entry. Refrigeration at rear prep lacks visible thermometers. Employee without hair restraint in front prep. Dust on dining ceiling vent and fan.

headline: Passed; hair restraints and garbage area issues
summary: Passed. Food handlers not wearing effective hair restraints. Hand sink signs missing in prep and dish areas. Utility sink lacks backflow device. Trash on ground around dumpster. Loose baseboards in dish area; no mop-drying rack.

headline: Failed: no hot water at prep hand sink
summary: Failed. Prep area hand sink had no hot water; measured 61°F, must provide 100°F. Fly strips hung in prep and dish area; must be removed. Food stored on floor; utensils not inverted; food debris on equipment; damaged floors and walls.

headline: Passed; certified manager's allergen training expired
summary: Passed. Certified manager has an expired allergen training certificate. All certified managers must complete allergen training and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; no probe thermometer
summary: Failed. No certified food service manager on site while deli sandwiches and smoothies were handled; priority violation. No food probe thermometer. No temperature indicator for high-temperature dish machine. Food handler lacked certificate; hair restraints missing.

headline: Failed: no ice machine backflow; repeat clutter
summary: Failed. No backflow preventer on front prep ice machine. Cutting boards grooved and stained. Broken garbage can lid in women's restroom; grime on grill hood filters. One of two certified managers lacks allergen training. Repeat basement clutter violation.

headline: Passed re-inspection; torn gaskets, outdoor clutter
summary: Passed re-inspection. Torn door gaskets in front wait station must be replaced. Broken coolers, old buckets, construction debris, and unused sinks stored outside the rear door were flagged as possible pest harborage; removal ordered.

headline: Passed; floors, walls, and storage need fixing
summary: Passed. Food containers not stored inverted. Basement prep area floors not clean near grease trap and hot water tank. Chipping paint on walls at lower-level prep areas is not smooth or easy to clean; must repair.

headline: Passed re-inspection; debris on kitchen floors
summary: Passed re-inspection. Debris and soil built up on floors around equipment throughout kitchen. Manager instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Passed; openings in basement ceiling and door
summary: Passed. Multiple openings in basement ceiling under soda dispenser and at rear basement door, plus gap at door bottom; must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Soda splatter and dust under dispenser. Rust on walk-in cooler shelving.

headline: Passed; improper utensil storage, dusty walls
summary: Passed. Knives and spatulas stored between wall and pipe in front prep. Milk crates used for storage near rear sink. Unused items in rear storage must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Dust and food splatter on rear prep walls.

headline: Failed: 10 to 20 rodent droppings in basement
summary: Failed. About 10 to 20 rodent droppings throughout basement, especially near furnace; priority citation issued and more pest control required. Ready-to-eat foods not date-marked; food stored on floor; soiled wiping cloths; unused items in basement.

headline: Passed; missing signs, leaking sink, food debris
summary: Passed. Dish area hand sink lacks handwashing signage and is leaking; must repair. Food debris on floors in front and rear prep areas must be cleaned. Food handler certificates could not be verified; must be kept on site.

headline: Failed: over 100 mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: Failed. Over 100 mouse droppings in fryer cabinets, shelving, and floors in prep and storage; exterminator required. No certified manager on site while TCS foods were prepared and served. Missing hand sink signs; hair restraints not worn.

headline: Passed with conditions; no health policy or vomit kit
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy or training on site; priority violation. No procedure or kit for vomiting and diarrhea events; must develop and maintain. Documents must be kept on site.

headline: Failed: fly paper, unused items, repeat violations
summary: Failed. Fly paper hung in rear storage; pest technician to be informed. Paper goods stored in restroom. Cardboard shelf liners. Repeat violations: 1/4-inch gap under rear door, excess unused equipment, and drain residue. Citation issued.

headline: Failed: dish machine lacked sanitizer; live flies
summary: Failed. Front bar dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer, empty sanitizer container, and was tagged out; not to be used until reinspected. About 15 to 20 live flies in dining and bar areas; pest control needed. Dirty linen storage and cutting boards.

headline: Passed; food debris on prep shelves and coolers
summary: Passed. Accumulated food debris on prep area shelves and inside prep area coolers. Must clean equipment and maintain.

headline: Passed; condiments under sink, missing lid
summary: Passed. Condiments stored in cabinet under front prep hand sink; must be removed to prevent leakage. Dust and debris on shelves under prep coolers. Women's washroom receptacle missing lid.

headline: Failed re-inspection; repeat violations, kids' drink calories
summary: Failed re-inspection. Several prior violations not corrected: unlabeled shakers, worn freezer door gasket, greasy equipment and floors. Default children's chocolate milk lists 140 calories; must be 130 or less. Citation issued.

headline: Passed; no hair restraints, leaking faucet
summary: Passed. Food handlers prepping food without hair restraints. Leaky faucet at three-compartment sink must be repaired. Grease, food debris, and dirt on floors under cooking equipment and along walls in prep, dish, storage, and basement areas.

headline: Failed: about 50 mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. About 40 mouse droppings in dry storage room and 10 on the dining room host stand. Additional pest control service needed. Also frozen meat in plastic bag, leaking valve under sink, no working washroom fan, and greasy hood filters.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge with valid sanitation certificate. No certified manager on site with original certificate while TCS foods handled; priority violation. Manager lacks allergen training. Staff restroom lacks lidded feminine hygiene receptacle.

headline: Passed with conditions; handwashing lapses, food too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. Employees did not wash hands after contaminating them; one rinsed without soap. Raw chicken at 47.0 to 50.5°F and cooked ribs at 46 to 52°F; about 45 pounds ($235) discarded; priority citation issued.

headline: Passed; leaks in rear dish area
summary: Passed. Leaks at drain pipe, dish machine backflow device, and base of three-compartment sink in rear dish area; must repair. Dirt and items built up in far right corner of bar area; must clean.

headline: Passed; torn cooler gaskets, dirty floor drain
summary: Passed. Torn rubber gaskets on two-door reach-in cooler must be replaced. Hand sink and prep sink dirty; tinfoil used as shelf liner must stop. Floor drain under three-compartment sink dirty. Missing washroom floor tile and unnecessary basement items.

headline: Passed with conditions; about 100 mouse droppings
summary: Passed with conditions. Repeat violation: about 100 mouse droppings in basement office, storage, and prep tables; more pest control needed. Manager washed hands in bar warewashing sink. No oyster shellstock tags. Prep cooler at 48°F.

headline: Passed re-inspection; unlabeled containers, duct tape
summary: Passed re-inspection. Bulk dry food containers in rear pasta prep not labeled with common name. Duct tape on dish machine surfaces and string on drying racks must be removed. Dusty ceiling vent above utility sink.

headline: Failed: about 100 rat droppings in storage
summary: Failed. About 100 rat droppings on floor by rear storage exit door and throughout basement storage. Additional pest control recommended; citation issued. Cardboard shelf liners in walk-in cooler. Grease and food debris under cooking equipment.

headline: No certified manager; sanitizer at 0 ppm; rice too warm
