summary: A previously cited issue was not corrected: no written supplier statement confirms that sushi fish or seafood was frozen to the required time and temperature. The operator must provide it and keep it on site. Citation issued.

headline: Door gaps and missing food handler training
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the front door bottom and an unscreened open rear door could let pests in; both must be fixed. Employees lacked valid food handler training. Also noted: missing sink stoppers, missing wall tiles, and stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Pump connected to sewage pipe without air gap
summary: A water pump connected to the ice machine had no air gap and was directly connected to a sewage pipe under a handwashing sink. An air gap must be provided to prevent cross-contamination. Toilet room door is not self-closing, and there is no lid for the all-gender toilet.

headline: No certified food manager during TCS food prep
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager was on premises while milk, cheese, and other TCS foods were prepared. Accumulated food debris was inside reach-in coolers, and the washroom had no covered trash receptacle.

headline: Stained cutting boards; food in grocery bags
summary: Cutting boards had open seams and dark stains and must be refinished or replaced. Food items were stored in grocery bags inside a refrigeration unit and must use food-grade containers. The chicken prep room had excessively wet floors.

headline: Knife rack placed under bug light
summary: A knife rack was stored underneath a bug light in the basement prep area. The operator was instructed to relocate the bug light to prevent contamination of the knives.

headline: Boxed food stored under shelving; elevation ordered
summary: Boxed food was stored underneath storage shelves in the rear dry storage area. The person in charge was told to raise all food items six inches off the floor and keep them elevated.

headline: Front door gap; no utility sink
summary: A gap at the bottom of the front door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. The facility has no service or utility sink, so staff must provide for proper disposal of mop water.

headline: No hair restraint; food debris on equipment and floors
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. Food debris was on rolling carts, prep tables, and coolers. Food debris and spills were on floors under equipment, along walls, and in corners in prep areas.

headline: Refrigeration off; sanitizer and handwash sink missing
summary: Refrigeration for the facility, coolers, and walk-in cooler was not operating. The three-compartment sink drains poorly, holds standing wastewater, and has no sanitizer or test strips. Employee health policy, vomit cleanup procedures, and outside waste receptacles are also missing.

headline: Dirty wiping cloths left on prep tables
summary: Dirty wiping cloths were left on front prep tables instead of being stored in sanitizing solution. Staff were instructed to store wiping cloths in sanitizer, especially when not in use.

headline: Widespread unsafe cold food; 185 lbs discarded
summary: Many cold TCS foods were held at 48-68F, including on the self-service conveyor belt and some room-temperature shelves. About 185 lbs ($380) were discarded. The low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm and was tagged out of use.

headline: Duck at 52.3F discarded; sanitizer overconcentrated
summary: About 20 lbs of cooked duck at 52.3F was discarded ($150). Quat sanitizer at the three-compartment sink was far above 500 ppm while utensils were washed. Also noted: a slow-draining handsink, missing restroom handwashing signs, and unlabeled bulk containers.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets and leaking faucets
summary: The two-door prep cooler has torn gaskets that must be repaired. Faucet heads at the three-compartment sink and a handwashing sink in the dish and prep area were leaking.

headline: Cardboard boxes on dishwashing floor
summary: Broken-down cardboard boxes were on the floor in the dishwashing area. The operator was instructed to remove them and maintain the area.

headline: About 100 fruit flies; dish machine tagged out
summary: About 100 fruit flies were found in the dishwashing area. The conveyor dish machine's final rinse was 129F instead of 180F, so it was tagged and cannot be used until removed by CDPH. Grill hand sink has weak water pressure.

headline: Mouse droppings and dead mice; moldy food discarded
summary: About 30 mouse droppings were found on office and prep-area floors and along walls, and two dead mice were in a trap. Four moldy egg rolls (about 2 lbs) were discarded. Additional pest control service is needed. Citation issued.

headline: Live and dead roaches; no hot handwash water
summary: Two large live cockroaches crawled on dish machine parts, and 45 large dead cockroaches were on a glue board. No certified manager was on site while potatoes and salmon were prepared. Handsinks lacked hot water, and the dish machine rinsed at 150F, not 180F. Citations issued.

headline: No manager certificate, health policies, or handler certificates
summary: The person in charge had no City of Chicago food service manager certificate on site; citation issued. No employee health policies and no food handler certificates were on premises. The last inspection summary was not posted; citation issued.

headline: Flour unlabeled; hot water missing at sinks
summary: No hot or cold water was found on the premises, and hot water was missing at several sinks. A citation was issued. Also noted: unlabeled flour, cardboard on the walk-in cooler floor, and no allergen training certificate for staff, which was corrected on the spot.

headline: Pots not inverted; wall and ceiling damage
summary: Pots and pans were not stored upside down in the dish area. Sinks were not labeled for wash, rinse and sanitize steps. Large holes were found in a rear prep room wall, and some ceiling tiles were missing.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; freezer heavily iced
summary: The rear exit door has a gap of about 1/4 inch at the bottom and must be sealed to keep pests out. Also noted: heavy ice buildup in the ice cream freezer, milk crates used for elevation, and floors and areas needing cleaning.

headline: Cardboard used as shelf liners in kitchen
summary: Inspector saw cardboard being used as liners on kitchen shelves. The operator must remove it. This was the only issue noted.

headline: No certified manager; no soap at hand sinks
summary: No certified manager was on site at the time of inspection, and a citation was issued. Several hand sinks lacked soap or paper towels, also cited. Also noted: a repeat issue of a food handler without training, plus worn equipment and heavy grease buildup.

headline: placeholder
summary: placeholder

headline: No certified food manager on site while open
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager was present while food was prepared for customers. A citation was issued. Also found a 1/4 inch gap under the rear door, an uncovered employee restroom receptacle, a hole in the wall, and heavy dirt and debris under equipment.

headline: No certified food manager; ice machine unsafe
summary: No valid City of Chicago certified food manager was present while TCS foods such as deli meat and tuna were prepared. The ice machine had rust and black residue and was tagged; staff were told to stop using its ice. Floors and drains also need cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled bulk flour and sugar containers
summary: Passed. Bulk containers holding items such as flour and sugar had no labels in the kitchen prep area. Management must label bulk containers not kept in their original packaging.

headline: No certified manager; repeat violations uncorrected
summary: Failed. No city-certified manager was on premises while chicken and shrimp were prepared (citation issued). Repeat violations were not corrected: damaged cooler gaskets, a missing utility sink backflow device, washroom doors without self-closing devices, and a broken floor tile. New employees lacked food handler certificates.

headline: No certified manager; beef thawed in bus tub
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager was on site while chicken and other TCS items were prepared (citation issued). Beef was thawed in a bus tub; it must be thawed under cold running water inside a refrigerator. An ice machine had grime, and a cutting board was deeply grooved.

headline: Soiled ice machine; no consumer advisory
summary: Failed. The ice machine drop and drip plate had black debris. No consumer advisory appeared on the menu or online menu for undercooked or raw beef items. Prep-line coolers lacked thermometers, and plastic cups were used as seasoning scoops.

headline: Hair restraint missing; leaky pipe; dirty floors
summary: Passed. A food handler prepared food without a hair restraint. Also noted: a leaky pipe under the three-compartment sink, a washroom door without a self-closing device, dirty restroom fixtures, floors needing cleaning, and a damaged ceiling tile.

headline: Sink leaking; food stored on floor
summary: Failed re-inspection. The three-compartment sink leaked into a bucket (citation issued). Food was stored on the prep-area floor, an ice scoop lay on ice, containers were unlabeled, and grease and debris were on equipment. Restroom trash cans lacked lids.

headline: 40+ mouse droppings found throughout restaurant
summary: Failed. Inspector found 40 or more mouse droppings on floors, storage shelves, around equipment, in the bottom of a fryer, and on a windowsill. Pest control service was required before reinspection (citation issued).

headline: Crates used for storage in rear area
summary: Passed. Crates were used for storage in the rear storage area. Management was instructed to eliminate the crates and provide adequate shelving units.

headline: Wiping cloth hung on food equipment
summary: Passed. A wiping cloth was hung on food equipment to dry. The inspector instructed staff to keep it away from food equipment.

headline: Ice machines soiled; dish machine drain leaks
summary: Passed re-inspection. Ice machines on the first and second floors had dust, debris, and calcium buildup. A soap and sanitizer dispenser in the second-floor warewashing area was in poor repair. A high-temperature dish machine drain leaked when in use.

headline: Leaking sink and no allergen training
summary: Passed re-inspection. Dishes and pots were stored face-up, and dish racks were used to raise dry-storage food, which can hide pests. The three-compartment sink leaked, the staff restroom lacked a covered trash can, and no allergen training was shown.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; dirty surfaces
summary: Passed. Bulk containers of flour, starch, and similar items had no labels. Prep-area shelving and the exterior of the dish machine were not clean, and floors inside the dry storage room needed cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; hands not washed before handling food
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on duty while turkey, sausage, and ham sandwiches were prepared. A worker handled food without washing hands after touching a screen (citation issued). About 56 lbs of vacuum-packed mac and cheese was discarded.

headline: Side door gap; torn cooler gasket
summary: Passed. A gap at the side door needs a tight-fitting seal to keep pests out. A walk-in cooler has a torn door gasket, and floor tiles at the front door are missing or damaged. Management was instructed to repair them.

headline: Standing water, trash, leaking sink; repeat violations
summary: Failed. The walk-in freezer floor held trash and food debris, and rear dry storage had standing water and food scraps. A leaking pipe under a handwashing sink repeats a prior violation (citation issued). Loose cooler gaskets, a soiled mop, and employee items on food shelves were also noted.

headline: Cool handwash water fixed on site; no pest log
summary: Failed. The employee washroom had no hot water at 100°F or above; it measured 74.6°F. A plumber raised it to 102.3°F during inspection (citation issued). No pest control logbook was on site (citation). Food handlers lacked certificates, and ceiling tiles were broken or missing.

headline: Wiping cloth storage and milk crate use
summary: Passed re-inspection. Wiping cloths in prep areas must be stored in a sanitizer bucket between uses. Milk crates must not be used to elevate stored items.

headline: Leaking sinks, damaged floors, dirty equipment
summary: Passed re-inspection. The pantry ice bin needed cleaning, and cutting boards had open seams and stains. Missing and damaged floor tiles on the 7th and 8th floors need repair. Three-compartment sinks in pastry, main dish, and 8th-floor banquet areas leaked.

headline: Dish machine too cool; hand washing required
summary: Passed with conditions. The high-temperature dish machine reached only 158°F at final rinse; it must reach at least 180°F. Until repaired, utensils must be washed, rinsed, and sanitized by hand (priority violation). Food debris, dusty walls, a burned-out light, and expired allergen training were also noted.

headline: Ice machine debris; 1-inch door gap
summary: Passed. Inspector noted encrusted debris inside the ice machine, a gap of about 1 inch at the main entrance door that must be pest-proofed, and a torn cooler gasket. Basement storage was cluttered, some lights were burnt out, and a manager's allergen training had expired.

headline: Rear door openings and sink leak
summary: Passed. Openings at the bottom and base of the rear exit door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. A three-compartment sink drain pipe leaked, and the unisex washroom door lacked a self-closing device.

headline: Unlabeled bulk salt container
summary: Passed. A bulk container of salt was not labeled. The facility was instructed to label it.

headline: No certified manager during beef and nacho prep
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge or food employee with city certified manager training was on site while TCS foods such as nachos and beef were prepared (citation issued). A food employee had no food handler training, and the microwave interior had dried food debris.

headline: Restroom door lacks self-closing device
summary: Passed. The bathroom across from the dishwashing room did not have a self-closing door. The manager was instructed to install one.

headline: No sneeze guard; expired food handler certificates
summary: Failed. The self-service hot food line had no sneeze guard to protect food from customers (citation issued). Disposable cups were used as scoops instead of handled utensils. Food handler certificates were expired and must be updated and kept on site.

headline: About 30 rodent droppings in bar cabinet
summary: Failed. About 30 rodent droppings were found inside a cabinet at the bar handwashing sink; pest control was recommended (citation issued). Also: no vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies, no metal stem thermometer, no sanitizer test strips, and a 1/2-inch gap at the front and rear doors.

headline: Undated food discarded; dirty ice machine and fryers
summary: Passed with conditions. Cooked tamales, rice, ground beef, and corn lacked date marks (citation issued), and about 50 lbs ($100) was discarded. Also noted: a dirty ice machine interior and door, greasy fryers, a leaking sink handle, and no self-closing device on the customer washroom door.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; stained cutting board
summary: Passed. A handwashing sign was needed in the rear toilet room. A stained cutting board at the prep cooler must be cleaned or replaced. Rear storage floors needed cleaning, and no allergen training certificate was available for review.

headline: No valid certified manager during food service
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid city-certified food manager was on duty while baked chicken, pork chops, and pot roast were prepared and served (citation issued). Also noted: a leaking three-compartment sink faucet, dirty hood filters, and floors and shelves needing cleaning.

headline: Milk crate shelving, foil liner, missing tiles
summary: Passed. Milk crates were used as shelving throughout the premises and must be removed. Aluminum foil lined a prep table shelf. A cook-line handwashing sink had low hot water pressure, and ceiling tiles were missing above the walk-in door and soda dispensers.

headline: No approved plan for vacuum-packed meats
summary: Passed with conditions. A vacuum packaging machine was in use with raw and cooked meats stored in the walk-in cooler and freezer, but no city-approved HACCP (food safety) plan was on site (citation issued). Management must obtain approval before using the machine.

headline: Stoves lacked required ventilation
summary: Passed. Inspector found one-burner stoves in the rear prep area not under a ventilation system. They must be placed under ventilation or removed from the premises.

headline: No pest control logbook on site
summary: Failed. No pest control logbook was on site, and records must be kept (citation issued). A deep fryer with grease was left uncovered when not in use. Grease and debris had built up on floors under the fryer and dishwasher.

headline: Dirty ice machine, milk crates, clutter
summary: Passed. The ice machine interior needed cleaning and sanitizing. Milk crates were used as shelving and must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor. Unnecessary items were stored near the three-compartment sink.

headline: Two food handlers lack training proof
summary: Passed re-inspection. Two food handlers lacked proof of food handler training. A cutting board with brown spots must be replaced or cleaned, and no written procedure existed for cleaning the salsa dispenser.

headline: 30 rodent droppings; short ribs held at 108°F
summary: Failed. About 30 rodent droppings were found in the basement near water heaters, and pest service was required (citation issued). Short ribs were held at 108°F, below the 135°F minimum; 7 lbs ($30) were discarded. The dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged.

headline: Slow handsink drain; debris under equipment
summary: Passed. The rear prep handsink drained slowly and needs repair. Floor drains and floors under beverage equipment and prep table corners had organic debris and food buildup, which must be removed.

headline: Torn cooler door gasket
summary: Passed re-inspection. A stand-up two-door prep cooler had a ripped door rubber gasket that must be repaired or replaced.

headline: No certified manager; handwash water too cool
summary: Failed re-inspection. No person in charge held a city food sanitation certificate on site (citation issued). Handwashing sinks measured 75.6°F to 82.8°F; they must provide water of at least 100°F.

headline: Live flying insects found; pest log outdated
summary: Failed re-inspection. About 10 live small flying insects were found on walls and ceiling in the rear storage and retail display areas. A 1/2-inch gap at the front entrance doors was noted, and the pest control log had no reports from the past year.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink faucet
summary: Passed. Inspector observed a leaking faucet at the three-compartment sink used to wash and sanitize dishes. Management was instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: Cold foods too warm; no certified manager
summary: Failed. Milk, eggs, sausage, and cream held at 47°F to 50.7°F were discarded, about $1,000 worth. The walk-in cooler read 46.8°F with food inside, later falling to 39.6°F. No certified manager was on site, and hand sink signs were missing.

headline: Ice scoop misplaced; torn gasket; dirty dish machine
summary: Passed. An ice scoop was stored on top of the ice machine. The middle door gasket on a three-door prep cooler was ripped. Food buildup on the dish machine exterior and walls behind it needed cleaning.

headline: Boxed food on floors; debris buildup
summary: Passed re-inspection. Boxed food in the walk-in cooler and dry storage must be raised off the floor to prevent contamination. Debris must also be cleaned from walk-in cooler shelving and floor drains.

headline: Hair restraints missing; cups not air-dried
summary: Passed. Some food handlers were not wearing hair restraints, and deli cups were not air-dried after washing. Staff were instructed to comply with both requirements.

headline: Gap at rear door; sanitation and equipment issues
summary: Passed. Inspector noted a brownish substance inside the ice machine, missing thermometers in coolers, unlabeled dry storage containers, and a one-inch gap at the rear exit door. Food buried in walk-in freezer ice must be discarded when corrected.

headline: Dishwasher not sanitizing; unit tagged
summary: Passed with conditions. The low-temperature dishwasher measured 0 ppm (parts per million) chlorine; it must reach at least 50 ppm. It was tagged and must not be used until reinspected (citation issued). Food handlers also prepped without hair restraints.

headline: Utensils in 67.8°F water; missing thermometers
summary: Failed. In-use utensils were stored in water at 67.8°F, below the 135°F required for hot water storage. Sushi and prep coolers lacked thermometers, and there was no proof of food handler or allergen training. Repeat issues included ice buildup and employee items with food (citation issued).

headline: Cold-holding failures; cooler at 50°F tagged
summary: Passed with conditions. Rice at 70°F, chorizo at 70.5°F, and steak at 56.5°F were held above the safe limit, and the manager voluntarily discarded 4 lbs ($70). A two-door prep cooler reached 50°F and was tagged (citation issued). No handwashing sign was in the men's restroom.

headline: Missing thermometer; rusty freezer lid; ice buildup
summary: Passed re-inspection. Needed: a visible thermometer in a front refrigerator, items raised off the floor, a rusty chest freezer lid, excessive ice inside basement freezers, water-damaged ceiling tiles, and dirty floor drains. A certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Dirty ice bin, torn gasket, and floors
summary: Passed. Inspector found the ice bin interior dirty, a torn door gasket on a two-door prep cooler, and floors and corners needing cleaning throughout the premises. Management was told to repair and maintain them.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup plan
summary: Passed with conditions. No written procedure or supplies existed for responding to vomiting and diarrhea events. Management must provide a procedure and, at minimum, gloves, face masks, disposable mops, and a sanitizer that kills norovirus.

headline: Vomit and diarrhea cleanup items missing
summary: Passed with conditions. Items needed to respond to vomiting and diarrhea events were not on site (priority violation). Also noted: openings at the base of the front door, a leaking drainpipe under the three-compartment sink, no backflow device on the utility sink, and damaged floor tiles.

headline: Missing health policy; wrong menu advisory
summary: Failed. No verifiable employee health policy was on site (priority violation). Menus starred items such as pork chops as raw or undercooked, which is incorrect; the footnote must be corrected (priority violation). Basement storage needed organizing and cleaning, and allergen training was required.

headline: Cool handwash water fixed on site
summary: Passed. Women's washroom handsink hot water measured 74.3°F; it must be at least 100°F. A plumber adjusted it to 105°F during inspection (citation issued). Also noted: unlabeled containers, wet wiping cloths, improperly stored utensils and mop, and an expired allergen certificate.

headline: Door openings, leaks, crates, dirty floors
summary: Passed. Openings at the base of both front doors need sealing. Soda crates were used for storage. The three-compartment sink leaked and drained slowly. Missing or stained ceiling tiles, dirty floors, and non-cleanable walls in a dry storage room also need attention.

headline: Repeat grease buildup on hood; unlabeled containers
summary: Failed. A repeat violation from a prior inspection: the kitchen exhaust hood and filters had excessive grease buildup (citation issued). Bulk containers lacked labels, one certified manager lacked allergen training, and grease traps, the chest freezer, and prep coolers needed detail cleaning.

headline: Splash guard, beard restraints, floor cleaning needed
summary: Passed re-inspection. Required: a splash guard on the bar handwashing sink, beard restraints for food preparers with facial hair, protected preset tableware, elevated stored items in dry storage, missing baseboard coving, and cleaning of a dirty floor drain and debris-covered floors.

headline: Gap at front exit doors
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of two front exit doors must be closed with a tight-fitting seal to prevent pests from entering.

headline: Dirty floors and stained ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. Inspector found black buildup and food debris on floors under the cold holding line, along wall bases, and under two sinks. Stained ceiling tiles and dust on three ceiling vent covers also need cleaning or replacement.

headline: Cold-held meats above safe temperature
summary: Passed with conditions. Salmon, ground beef, and chicken in the meat prep cold unit measured 46.8°F to 49.3°F; cold food must be 41°F or below (citation issued). Deeply grooved cutting boards, grease buildup, and a minor sink leak were also noted.

headline: Pork thawed at room temperature; missing signage
summary: Passed. Raw pork was thawing at room temperature in an open container, which is not an approved method. Approved methods include refrigeration or running water at or below 70°F. Utensils sat in still room-temperature water, and handwashing signs were missing.

headline: Milk crates used for storage; dusty walls
summary: Passed. Milk crates were used for storage in the front and rear prep areas and must be replaced with easily cleaned shelving. Dust was found on walls above a handsink and a one-compartment sink.

headline: Gaps and holes allow pest entry
summary: Failed. The rear screen door was not rodent-proof. Holes near the basement walk-in and foam sealant over the kitchen ceiling must be sealed to prevent entry. Cracked floor tiles in prep and cooking areas repeat a prior violation, and the paper towel dispenser must move away from the prep table.

headline: No certified food manager during raw meat prep
summary: Failed to keep a certified food manager on site while raw chicken and raw beef were prepared and served (citation issued). Handwashing sinks were blocked by garbage and boxes, one sink leaked, and no allergen training was shown.

headline: Food on floor; leaking sink; greasy vents
summary: Passed. Buckets of food were stored on the floor in the rear storage area and must be raised. Wiping cloths were left on prep tables, a front chest freezer had excessive ice, and a rear sink faucet leaked. Floor tiles were cracked, and grease coated the hood vents.

headline: Dumpster lids still missing from prior visit
summary: Failed re-inspection. Two lids were still missing from the outside garbage dumpster, a repeat violation from a prior inspection. Management must replace them and keep the dumpster covered with tight-fitting lids (citation issued).

headline: Food stored on floors; missing handwash signage
summary: Passed. Food containers were stored on floors in the walk-in cooler, prep, and storage areas and must be raised at least six inches. Handwash signage was missing at the rear meat counter sink. Some food handlers lacked hair restraints, and vent filters had heavy grease.

headline: Ice machine calcium buildup; stained ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. The ice machine interior had calcium buildup. The outside grease receptacle had grease and debris buildup. Stained ceiling tiles above kitchen locker storage must be replaced.

headline: No certified manager; missing food handler training
summary: Passed with conditions. No city-certified manager was on site while pork, rice, and milk were handled, and no certificate was posted (citation issued). Food handlers lacked training. The ice machine panel was soiled, sink stoppers were missing, and a floor drain was dirty.

headline: Leaks, clutter, and expired food handler certificate
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer. Walk-in storage racks had food buildup, and a middle faucet leaked on the rear three-compartment sink. Broken floor tiles, storage clutter, dirty walk-in freezer corners, and a food handler with an expired certificate were also noted.

headline: Undated food; sewage pipe drains into handsink
summary: Passed with conditions. Ready-to-eat cooked breaded chicken and ribs held over 24 hours had no date marking (citation issued). A sewage pipe drained into a dishwashing-area handsink and must be rerouted. The inspection summary was not posted for the public.

headline: No certified manager; no food handler training
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge held a valid Chicago food sanitation certificate, and none was on site while pasta and yams were prepared (citation issued). Employees on duty had no food handler training. Rust was on prep table bottoms, and a drainpipe leaked.

headline: Missing dumpster lid; expired allergen training
summary: Failed. The outside garbage dumpster was missing its lid (citation issued). Duct tape was used to seal a cooler gasket, and a cutting board was heavily stained. Cardboard lined the main prep floor, and expired allergen training was a repeat violation.

headline: Over 30 mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: Failed. Over 30 mouse droppings were found in the boiler room, and pest control service was recommended. No certified sanitation person was present while meat, poultry, and fish were handled. No employee health policy, vomit cleanup plan, or sanitizer test strips were available.

headline: 300+ mouse droppings; rodent infestation found
summary: Failed. Inspector found 300 or more mouse droppings across the kitchen, bar, basement storage, and shelves. Management was instructed to clean all affected areas and have pest control service the establishment (citation issued). A basement floor drain has no cover.

headline: Food containers stored under sewer pipes
summary: Passed re-inspection. Single-service food containers were stored under sewer pipes in the second-floor storage room. They must be removed, or the pipes must be shielded against drips.

headline: Stained ceiling tiles in rear dish area
summary: Passed re-inspection. Stained ceiling tiles in the rear dish and dining area must be replaced.

headline: Rodent droppings removed; pest service done
summary: Passed re-inspection. Rodent droppings found earlier had been removed, and the areas were cleaned and sanitized. Pest control service was on site on 6/18/24. Dried food splatter on a menu holder and nearby equipment still needed cleaning.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: Failed re-inspection. No certified food manager was on duty while egg, sausage, and milk items were prepared and served (citation issued). Also noted: missing handwashing signs, expired food handler training for some employees, a leaking dump sink pipe, and a torn cooler gasket.

headline: Leaking handsink pipe; no allergen training
summary: Passed. The cooler behind the bar needed cleaning to remove spills. A leaking pipe under the first handsink behind the bar must be repaired. The certified manager on duty lacked allergen training and was instructed to obtain it.

headline: Employee lacked food handler certificate
summary: Passed re-inspection. One food handling employee did not have a food handler training certificate. Management was instructed that all food handlers must show proof of training.

headline: 12 rat droppings found; pest control needed
summary: Failed. Inspector found 12 rat droppings on the sales floor, in storage closets, in the rear storage area, in the office, and in the basement. They must be removed and the areas cleaned and sanitized; pest control service was recommended (citation issued).

headline: Unapproved-source packaged food; pest log outdated
summary: Failed. About 8 containers of taffy grapes from an unknown, unapproved source were found without an invoice, and the manager discarded them. About 30 prepackaged items lacked required labels. The pest control logbook had no 2026 service reports (citation issued).

headline: No signed employee health policy on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No signed employee health policy was on site; it must include a signed acknowledgment from each employee (priority violation). Handwashing signs are needed at all handwashing sinks, and the employee restroom needs a trash can with a lid.

headline: No certified manager; cooler fixed on site
summary: Failed. No city-certified foodservice manager was on premises (priority violation). A small two-door refrigerator at 80.4°F was corrected on site and tagged as held for inspection. Also noted: no prep sink, no commercial dumpster, missing handwashing signs, leaking sink stoppers, and gaps at the front entrance.

headline: Food debris inside cold holding units
summary: Passed re-inspection. Inspector found a buildup of food debris inside cold holding units. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: No food handler training certificates on site
summary: Passed. No food handler training certificates were on the premises. The manager was instructed to keep certificates with employee names on site.

headline: No certified manager; black slime in ice machine
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on site while food was handled, and no written employee health policy existed. Ice and slushy dispensers had black slime (citation issued). A rear staff sink was blocked and was cleared on site. Food handlers lacked proof of training.

headline: Refrigerated meats too warm; $510 discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Cooked chicken, deli turkey, prosciutto, and gyro meat in the refrigerator measured 47.1°F to 89°F. About $510 of food was discarded (citation issued). A refrigeration unit's air measured 66°F, and a deeply cut cutting board needs replacing.

headline: Unlabeled ingredients; improper ice scoop and cloth storage
summary: Passed. Dry ingredients lacked labels in the rear prep area. An ice scoop was stored on top of the ice machine, and wiping cloths were left on a prep table. The ice shield inside the ice machine had brown-like buildup.

headline: Food past 7-day limit; no approved vacuum plan
summary: Passed with conditions. Ready-to-eat sauces and dressings were stored beyond the 7-day use limit (citation issued). Vacuum-packed meats and sauces lacked an approved HACCP (food safety) plan. The high-temperature dish machine reached only 131°F; it needs 160°F. A food handler lacked training.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed re-inspection. The sanitation manager had no allergen training and must provide proof of it.

headline: Ice machine buildup; door gaps; missing stoppers
summary: Passed. Slight buildup inside the upper ice machine needs cleaning. A 1/4-inch gap at both front and rear exit door sweeps must be rodent-proofed. The three-compartment sink lacks stoppers, and the prep hood has grease and food debris.

headline: No certified manager; no pest control logbook
summary: Failed. The person in charge lacked an original city sanitation certificate, and no certified person was posted while pork, beef, chicken, and fish were handled (citation issued). No pest control logbook was on site (citation). Some food handlers had expired training, and sink stoppers were needed.

headline: Beard guards missing; minor debris
summary: Passed. Male food handlers with beards were not wearing beard guards. Minor debris was found on floors and walls under the three-compartment sink and dish machine. Management was instructed to correct both.

headline: Dirty surfaces, leaks, and no metal thermometer
summary: Passed, with very dirty floors, walls, prep tables, and cooking hood. Wiping cloths were left on sinks, no metal stem thermometer was on site, and several plumbing leaks and damaged ceiling and floor tiles need repair.

headline: No bar handwash sink; no vomit cleanup plan
summary: Failed. No handwashing sink was in the bar area (citation issued), and no vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies were available (citation). The front door sweep is broken and must be replaced. Boxes of frozen food sat on the walk-in freezer floor, and the dish machine gauge was not working.

headline: Repeat violations; missing handwash signs
summary: Failed. Prior core violations were not corrected, including water-damaged ceiling tiles, wall and pipe holes, a dirty floor drain, and unused coolers that must be removed to prevent pest harboring (citation issued). Also noted: no handwashing signs, a torn refrigerator gasket, and a slow-draining sink.

headline: Food stored on floors; multiple sanitation failures
summary: Failed. Food was stored on floors in the walk-in cooler and freezer, and food debris and spills were under equipment. Ice machine residue, missing handwashing signs, and no consumer advisory for raw or undercooked food were also noted.

headline: Dead mouse found in dry storage area
summary: A dead mouse was found in the rear dry storage area and must be removed, with the area sanitized. Also cardboard under prep tables, spills in a cold unit, grooved floors, and lights not working in dry storage and walk-in freezer.

headline: Leaking drainpipe; slow-draining prep handsink
summary: Drainpipe under a prep-area handsink near the upright freezer was leaking and must be repaired. Water drained slowly at the main prep handsink; unclogging was recommended. Passed.

headline: Loose front door seal; greasy hood and filters
summary: Front exterior door did not fit tightly at the bottom; weather stripping needed to keep pests out. Dry storage racks had dust and cobwebs. Washroom fixtures, prep walls, floors, and cooking hood and filters need cleaning. Passed.

headline: Food buildup in coolers and bar equipment
summary: Food buildup found inside bar gun holders, dish machine drainboard shelves, and prep-area reach-in coolers, plus dust on cooler condensers. Bar floor had food debris and spills. Employee washroom lacked a covered trash can. Passed.

headline: Oversized pots, low water pressure, greasy hood
summary: Large cooking pots did not fit the dish machine; a washing procedure must be provided or the pots removed. Hand sink in prep area had low water pressure. Hood, filters, and pipes had heavy grease and dirt. Serving plates were not inverted.

headline: Hot water faucet not working; ceiling hole
summary: Front-prep one-compartment sink used for drinks and smoothies had a non-working hot water faucet that must be fixed. A hole in the basement dry storage ceiling must be repaired. Passed re-inspection.

headline: Shellfish missing tags; 10 lbs discarded
summary: Mussels in basement walk-in cooler had no identification tags, as the code requires; manager voluntarily discarded 10 lbs. Certified food managers on duty lacked allergen training. Also greasy hood and filters, ice buildup in upright freezer, and plates not inverted.

headline: Unsafe cold food temperatures; live flying insects
summary: Tuna, chicken salad, egg salad and other foods at 50–61°F in prep cooler; about 23 lbs discarded. Cooler at 56°F is tagged and must not be used until repaired. About 25 live small flying insects found; pest control needed.

headline: Seal wall corner; clean greasy walls
summary: Re-inspection after suspected food poisoning passed. Wall and corner beside the hot water heater in the food prep area must be sealed. Greasy walls beneath the three-compartment sink and dish machine must be cleaned.

headline: Over 40 mouse droppings; dead mouse found
summary: Evidence of about 40 or more mouse droppings on counters, shelves, and floors, including in rear storage; a dead mouse was on a glueboard. Pest control service recommended. No pest control log. Damaged tiles and dirt also noted.

headline: Handwashing done in dish sink, not handsink
summary: A food handler washed hands in the three-compartment sink while switching between raw meat and the cooking station. Manager was told hands must be washed only in hand sinks. Priority foundation violation noted.

headline: Food on freezer floor; foil on shelves
summary: Food was stored on the floor of the walk-in freezer and must be elevated six inches. Aluminum foil on shelves above the front prep line must be removed so surfaces are smooth and cleanable. Passed.

headline: Broken restroom sink; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Left-hand sink in women's toilet room was not in working order and must be replaced. Certified food manager had no food allergen training. Passed.

headline: Utensil rack too close to mop sink
summary: Clean utensil rack was placed too close to the mop sink. Management was instructed to install a barrier to prevent contamination. Passed.

headline: Unlabeled bulk ingredients; food stored on floor
summary: Bulk sugar and salt containers lacked labels. Pots and boxed food sat on the walk-in cooler floor, and an ice scoop was stored on top of ice. Employee personal items were stored in the prep area. Pass with conditions.

headline: Plastic bags, milk crates, hair restraints
summary: Plastic grocery bags were used as food containers in coolers and freezers, and milk crates were used to elevate stored items. Food handlers must wear hair and beard restraints. Prep-area wiping cloths must be kept in sanitizer between uses. Passed re-inspection.

headline: Dirt and debris under prep-area counters
summary: Dirt and small debris built up in the food prep area under counters against walls. Instructed to clean and maintain. Passed.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods prepared
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods (kept hot or cold, like cheese and sausage) were prepared. Also ice machine calcium buildup, frozen food in plastic grocery bags, greasy grill hood, and expired allergen certificate.

headline: Door gap; certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: Rear exit door had a 1/4-inch gap that must be sealed. A utensil in rice had its handle touching the rice. Grease dust built up around griddle filters. Certified food manager had no food allergen training. Passed.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies; unlabeled lemonade
summary: No cleanup supplies on premises for vomit or diarrhea events; management must provide them. Prepackaged lemonade bottles in the grab-and-go cooler lacked required labels. Microwave needs cleaning. Pass with conditions.

headline: Low sink water; no food handler training
summary: Water at the three-compartment sink was low for hot and cold and must be repaired. No food handler training records were available. Crates must be replaced with shelving; damaged ceilings, walls, and floors need repair. Passed re-inspection.

headline: Greasy ventilation hood must be cleaned
summary: Food and grease buildup on the ventilation hood was found and must be cleaned and maintained. Passed re-inspection.

headline: Handsinks blocked by stacked containers
summary: Kitchen, rear dishroom, and outside-washroom handsinks were blocked by stacked containers; person in charge removed items on site. Cutting board attached to prep cooler had deep cuts and stains and must be restored or replaced. Citation issued.

headline: Washroom ventilation fan not working
summary: The washroom had no working ventilation fan. Management was instructed to install and maintain one. Passed.

headline: No drainboard at dish sink; wall not smooth
summary: The three-compartment sink in the rear prep area has no drainboard for drying dishes. Brick wall behind the hand sink and dish sink is not smooth and must be covered with an easily cleanable surface. Passed re-inspection.

headline: Unsafe cold holding temperatures; food discarded
summary: Shrimp at 52.5°F, eggs at 55°F, and chicken at 48°F in a prep cooler; manager discarded 15 lbs. Also no metal stem thermometer, scoop submerged in ice, no sanitizer test kit, unlabeled food, and dirty floors and hoods. Failed.

headline: Repeat violations uncorrected; leaks and dust found
summary: Previous violations were not corrected: grooved cutting board, leaking sink faucet, non-flushing toilet, no self-closing washroom door, and broken washroom ventilation. Also a dripping condensation line onto a floor and dusty ceiling vents.

headline: Sinks lack adequate hot water; one faucet broken
summary: Hot water measured about 65.5–65.8°F at the hand sinks and three-compartment sink; required is 100–120°F for hand sinks and above 110°F for the dish sink. Rear prep hand sink's cold-water fixture did not work. Failed.

headline: Freezer spills and dirty basement floors
summary: Rear reach-in freezer needed cleaning of spills and debris, and the exterior of basement bulk storage containers needed cleaning. Basement floors along wall bases behind dry storage shelving and around the grease trap also needed cleaning. Passed.

headline: Foil on pipe; water-damaged washroom ceilings
summary: Tin foil covered a pipe behind the kitchen prep table and must be removed, with the surface restored to smooth. Men's and women's washroom ceilings were water damaged and must be restored. Passed.

headline: Black buildup dripping onto ice; cool handsinks
summary: Ice machine had heavy black buildup dripping onto ice; ice must be removed and machine deep-cleaned. Restroom hot water was 61.5–73.6°F; adjusted to 104.5°F during inspection. No valid City sanitation certificate posted. No food handler training proof. Failed.

headline: Unlabeled food storage containers
summary: Food storage containers lacked labels showing the common name of the food. Management was instructed to provide labels. Passed inspection.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Bulk food containers (such as flour) had no labels and must be labeled. Sanitation manager had no food allergen training and must provide it. Passed.

headline: Brooms hung beside clean utensil rack
summary: Brooms and dustpans were hung next to the clean utensil rack. Management was instructed to install a barrier to protect utensils from contamination. Passed.

headline: Two cold units lack air thermometers
summary: Two cold-holding units in the rear food prep area had no ambient air thermometers. Person in charge was instructed to provide and maintain them. Passed re-inspection.

headline: Dirty cold-hold drawers; broken floor tile
summary: Cold-hold drawers and shelves in the taqueria area needed cleaning. A broken floor tile sits near the dairy cold-hold unit. Person in charge instructed to clean and repair. Passed re-inspection.

headline: No vomit kit; hand sink removed; summary unposted
summary: No vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit on premises. A handwashing sink was removed from the dishwashing area and must be replaced with hot and cold water, soap, and hand drying. Prior violations were not corrected; summary was not posted.

headline: Roaches, mouse droppings, and slimy ice maker
summary: About 15 live cockroaches inside an exposed alarm system and about 15 mouse droppings in dish and banquet areas; pest control recommended. Ice maker slime dripped into ice. Cooked beef at 45.1°F; dressings up to 60.8°F; 16 lbs discarded. Failed.

headline: Cardboard shelf liners, detached coving, unfinished wall
summary: Cardboard was reused as shelf liner and must not be reused; shelves must be smooth and cleanable. Coving in toilet room was detached, and a front prep wall was unfinished; both must be sealed and smooth. Passed re-inspection.

headline: No person in charge or certified manager present
summary: No person in charge was present, and no manager with a valid City food certificate was on site while coffee and sandwiches were prepared. Food stored on walk-in floors, ice built up in freezer, and 2-compartment sink faucet leaked.

headline: Missing sanitation certificate; no cold water at sink
summary: No person on site had an original City of Chicago sanitation certificate posted; one must be posted at all times. The three-compartment sink had no cold water and a minor leak underneath. Repairs required.

headline: No hot or cold water at three-compartment sink
summary: The three-compartment sink had no hot or cold water, a priority violation. Floor around equipment had grease buildup. A prior violation was not corrected: the sink faucet sputters on and off. Failed; no citation issued.

headline: Cooler at 45°F; restroom sink water too cool
summary: Unused two-drawer cooler under the grill measured 45°F and must be repaired or replaced. One of two men's restroom washbowls measured 75°F; must be 100–120°F. Bar handsink lacked handwashing signage. Passed.

headline: Ceiling panels damaged; cooler lacks thermometer
summary: Damaged, holed, and water-stained ceiling panels in rear prep area must be repaired. Bottled beverage cooler lacked a thermometer; rust on walk-in shelving and missing handwashing signage also noted. Two burnt-out bulbs under hood. Passed.

headline: Bare-hand food contact and rice held at 75°F
summary: Food handler touched ready-to-eat torta bun with bare hands; food discarded. Cooked rice held at 75°F was discarded (about 10 lbs). No certified manager on site while food was served. Cooked chicken lacked discard-date labels.

headline: Live flies and roaches; bakery food discarded
summary: About 15 live flies were in a bakery cabinet touching fresh bakery items; 10 lbs discarded. About 40 small flies and live roaches found in several areas, plus dead roaches. Pest control required. No valid City sanitation certificate. Failed.

headline: Missing thermometer; dusty display cooler shelves
summary: Pre-packaged sandwich display cooler needs a visible thermometer. Left-side shelves had dust and debris and must be detail cleaned. Passed.

headline: Greasy equipment and floors; ice machine backflow missing
summary: Grease and food debris buildup on cooking and hot/cold equipment, floors, and wall bases must be cleaned. Ice machine had no backflow device visible for servicing; one must be provided and maintained. Passed re-inspection.

headline: No hair restraint while slicing meat
summary: Employee sliced meat without a hair restraint; all food handlers must wear one while preparing food. Torn gasket inside a refrigerator and slow drainage at the dishwashing handsink must be repaired. Passed.

headline: No certified manager on site; ice bin uncovered
summary: No City of Chicago certified food service manager was on premises, a priority foundation violation with a citation. The eastside bar ice bin had no cover. A women's washroom handsink did not work and must be repaired.

headline: No vomit kit; no pest control license number
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was on site. The pest control license number was not available for verification. No utility sink was on site, and the restroom had no door. Citation issued for pest control records.

headline: Leaking pipe under sink; no hair restraint
summary: Water was leaking heavily from a pipe under the three-compartment sink into a pan and must be repaired. A food handler lacked a hair restraint in the prep area. Cardboard boxes on prep-area floor must be replaced with non-slip mats. Passed.

headline: About 80 rat droppings; prep cooler too warm
summary: About 40 rat droppings were behind the ice machine and about 40 behind the dishwasher; additional pest control needed. Prep cooler at 55°F was tagged; its cold-held food must be discarded. Also a 1/4-inch rear door gap. Failed.

headline: Dirty walk-in cooler floors
summary: Floors inside the walk-in cooler were dirty with spills and debris. Must be cleaned and maintained. Passed.

headline: No hot water at hand sinks; torn gaskets
summary: Hand sinks and bathroom sinks lacked hot running water; readings were 82–91°F at hand sinks and 58.5°F in bathroom. Target is about 100°F for hand sinks. Torn gaskets on cooler and refrigerator; foil lines shelves. Citation issued.

headline: Improper chicken thawing; cleaning and labeling needed
summary: Chicken was thawed improperly; thaw in refrigeration at 41°F or below, under running water, or in a microwave then cooked immediately. Greasy equipment, floors, hood, and walk-in racks need detail cleaning. Coolers need thermometers; containers need common-name labels.

headline: Raw wood shelving, damaged cooler gasket
summary: Raw wood shelving under a prep table must be sealed to be cleanable. A four-door reach-in cooler has a damaged door gasket. A utility sink faucet is in poor repair. Manager instructed to fix each item. Passed.

headline: Dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer; still used
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine (50–100 ppm required) and was tagged, but was in use at re-inspection. Several employees lacked food handler training, and no allergen training proof was on site. Cooler lacked thermometer. Citation issued.

headline: Grease buildup on equipment; food spills on walls
summary: Grease and food debris built up on fryers, shelving, prep tables, and coolers. Food was spilled on prep-area walls. Also damaged floor tiles, missing grout, and water under the beverage machine. Manager instructed to clean and repair.

headline: Gap at front door must be sealed
summary: A gap of about 2 by 3 inches at the bottom left of the front entry door must be sealed to keep pests out. No pests were reported. Passed inspection.

headline: Heavily soiled ice machine; prior violations uncorrected
summary: Ice machine interior heavily soiled with black and grey substance; ice is for human consumption. Prior violations uncorrected: scoops on ice bin, dirty floors, greasy walls. Bar cooler lacks thermometer; restroom trash lacks lid. Failed.

headline: Rodent droppings; no handsink at front counter
summary: About 10 rodent droppings in toilet room; pest control recommended. No handwashing sink at front counter selling beef, cheese and drinks; manager removed the food. Rear handsink lacked soap and towels. Smoking evidence found. Failed.

headline: Outside dumpster missing its lid
summary: Outside dumpster was found with a missing lid. Must be provided. Priority foundation violation; citation issued. Failed.

headline: Grime and debris under equipment and shelving
summary: Dirt and food debris under the meat slicer shelving, and grease and debris under and behind cooking equipment. Walk-in freezer floor was dirty under shelving. Also a very loose toilet-room faucet and dusty A/C vents. Passed.

headline: Mold-like buildup; missing sign, thermometers, backflow device
summary: Mold-like buildup on produce/dairy walk-in cooler racks must be cleaned. Also required: handwashing sign, reach-in thermometers, container labels, mop sink backflow preventer, and a written procedure for oversized pots.

headline: No hand-drying at hand sinks; overflowing garbage
summary: Neither hand sink had a way to dry hands; staff provided paper towels during inspection. A handwash sign was above the prep sink instead of the hand sink. Outside garbage area overflowed with exposed trash; lids would not close. Citation issued.

headline: No hand drying; no food handler certificates
summary: Staff restroom hand sink had no paper towels and a broken hand dryer; employee provided paper towels during inspection. No food handler certificates were on site. Prior allergen training violation not corrected for one certified manager. Citation issued.

headline: Missing cooler thermometers; uncovered, unlabeled food
summary: Reach-in coolers and freezers had no ambient air thermometers. Food storage containers lacked common-name labels. Food in prep table cooler, walk-in cooler, and freezer was uncovered. Passed.

headline: Ice bin needs cleaning; damaged floor tiles
summary: Ice bin interior needed cleaning. Bar hand sink faucet sprayed water sideways and must be repaired. Missing and damaged floor tiles throughout the facility must be repaired. Passed.

headline: Mold-like buildup in ice machine; water too hot
summary: Pink and black mold-like buildup inside basement ice machine. Handsink reached 158.9°F; max is 120°F. Missing vomit cleanup supplies, thermometer, and sanitizer test kit were corrected on site. Food on floors also noted. Failed.

headline: Leaking employee handsink; plumber arrived
summary: Employee washroom handsink leaked when in use and was inaccessible when cold water was off. Must be repaired or replaced. A plumber arrived on site to fix the leak during the inspection. Priority foundation violation.

headline: Food containers not stored properly
summary: Food containers were not stored properly. Must be stored inverted. Passed.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Food handler certificates were expired and the certified food manager's allergen training certificate had expired. Also dirty fryer interiors, stained counters, a rusty can opener, dirty floors, and a leaking three-compartment sink faucet. Passed.

headline: No food handler training proof; utensils uncovered
summary: No proof of food handler training was provided for any food handlers. Knives, forks, and spoons were stored uncovered on a prep-area table and must be covered or inverted. Debris and buildup under bar shelving and sinks must be cleaned. Passed.

headline: About 80 mouse droppings found throughout facility
summary: About 80 mouse droppings found in storage, washroom, sales floor, and near sink. Additional pest control needed. Also a 1/4-inch rear door gap and prior uncorrected violations, including a non-working cooler thermometer and items stored on floor. Failed.

headline: Split, nonfunctional sink drain stopper
summary: A drain stopper at the three-compartment sink was split and nonfunctional, in poor repair. Must be repaired or replaced, and plumbing maintained in good repair. Passed.

headline: Incomplete raw-food advisory; handler lacked certificate
summary: Menu boards lacked a complete raw or undercooked food advisory, which must link flagged foods to a warning about foodborne illness risk. Repackaged food on display was unlabeled. Torn gasket on 3-door prep cooler. One food handler lacked a certificate.

headline: Dish machine too cool; slime in ice machine
summary: Dish machine final rinse was 117.7°F (needs 180–192°F) and was tagged. Yellow and black slime found inside smoothie-bar ice machine. Chicken thawed in the sink and shrimp on the floor. Several employees lacked food handler training; summary not posted.

headline: Manager certificate missing; no handwashing signs
summary: Person in charge did not have an original City of Chicago sanitation manager's certificate on site; it must be on site and posted at all times. Rear and front prep-area hand sinks lacked handwashing signs. Citation issued.

headline: About 50 mouse droppings and live roach found
summary: About 50 mouse droppings behind refrigerator and freezer in dry storage; one live cockroach above a handsink; live insects in food prep. Additional pest control needed. Grease trap leaked at the three-compartment sink. No mop sink. Failed; citation issued.

headline: Dish machine sanitizer at 0 ppm; tagged
summary: Dish machine's final sanitizer concentration was 0 ppm; 50 ppm required. Machine was not in use and was tagged. Aluminum foil wrapped around shelving must be removed. Pass with conditions.

headline: No food handler or allergen training proof
summary: No proof of food handler or certified manager allergen training was provided. Outdoor storage had scattered boxes and crates; dishroom floors had clutter that must be shelved 6 inches off the floor. Washroom ceiling fan dusty.

headline: Debris under dry storage shelving
summary: Debris was found under shelving in the dry storage room. Person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain the area. Passed.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Food handler training certificates were expired and must be updated. One food allergen training certificate had expired. Kitchen walls had splatter and ceiling vents had dust. Passed.

headline: Foil liner on rear prep shelving
summary: Foil was used as a liner on shelving in the rear prep area. Person in charge must remove it and keep non-food-contact surfaces smooth and easily cleanable. Passed.

headline: Damaged gaskets; nonworking light over sink
summary: Damaged gaskets were found on a small cold-holding unit in the front prep area and on a refrigerator in the rear prep area. A light above the rear three-compartment sink was not working. Passed.

headline: Rat droppings found; sanitizer missing at dish machine
summary: About 200 rat droppings found on basement floor; additional pest control needed. Low-temperature dish machine had no sanitizer at final rinse. Also missing vomit cleanup supplies, employee health policy, and food handler certificates. Clutter and wall holes noted. Failed.

headline: No covered washroom trash; grimy wall and floor
summary: Employee washroom had no covered trash receptacle. Grime on wall behind the three-compartment sink and residue on floor near grease trap must be cleaned. Passed.

headline: Hot and cold food unsafe; dishes not sanitized
summary: Hot dogs held at 117°F (minimum 135°F). Prep cooler foods at 47–49°F (limit 41°F); chicken left at 70°F; cooler air 54°F. Dishes not sanitized after washing. One employee lacked food handler certificate. Failed.

headline: Walk-in cooler shelving not smooth; floors dirty
summary: Walk-in cooler shelving was not smooth and easily cleanable, and floors under and behind shelving needed cleaning. Shelves must be maintained. Passed.

headline: Mold-like substance inside ice machine
summary: Mold-like substance found along interior of ice machine; ice must be discarded and machine cleaned and sanitized. Scoop was stored in sugar; wiping cloths air-dried on clean equipment. Greasy hood vents and soiled floors also noted. Failed.

headline: Restroom handsink water only 74°F
summary: Water at the toilet room hand sink measured 74°F. Minimum must be 100°F or above through a mixing valve or combination faucet. Priority violation; citation issued. Failed.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; loose handsink faucets
summary: Torn gasket on two-door cooler on the cook line must be repaired. Loose faucets at exposed handsinks on the cook line and in meat cutting room must be repaired. Burnt-out bulb in cook-line hood must be replaced. Passed.

headline: Raw pork held at 68.7°F; dead flies found
summary: About 40 lbs of raw pork in the basement was at 68.7°F, above the 41°F limit. Person in charge discarded it. Dead flies were also found on front sales-floor window sills and floors and must be removed. Citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled food storage containers
summary: Food storage containers lacked labels showing the common name of the food. Management was instructed to provide labels. Passed.

headline: Deli meat, sour cream, eggs too warm
summary: About 10 lbs sliced deli meat, 4 lbs sour cream, and 4 cartons of eggs were at 48.9–53°F. Cooling unit at 50°F was tagged and must be repaired. No cooler thermometers; dried food debris in coolers. Pass with conditions.

headline: Missing handwashing signage; floor grout needed
summary: Hand sink in unisex restroom had no handwashing sign. Floor near the chest freezer in the rear prep and dish area needs grout to be in good repair. Passed.

headline: Uncovered food; leaking drainpipe under sink
summary: Food in walk-in cooler and prep area was uncovered; food-grade lids or covers required. Knives and tongs were left on cutting boards, and cutting boards had open seams and dark stains. A drainpipe leaked under the three-compartment sink. Passed.

headline: Handsink water too hot; soiled mop heads
summary: Hot water at front prep handsink measured 127.2°F during inspection; required range is 100–120°F. Soiled mop heads were not stored properly and must be hung to prevent insect breeding. Citation issued.

headline: Pink buildup inside ice machine
summary: Slight pink buildup was found in the upper portion of the ice machine. Manager must clean the interior and keep it maintained. Passed.

headline: Debris and trash buildup on floors, shelves
summary: Excessive debris and trash buildup on floors under, around, and along wall bases, and on display shelves throughout the premises, including rear storage. Must be cleaned.

headline: Spoons kept in room-temperature water
summary: Spoons kept in use in a cup of water at room temperature; instructed to follow code for utensil storage. Food handler without hair restraint. Inadequate lighting in basement walk-in cooler; additional lights required.

headline: Greasy cooking equipment; dusty floors
summary: Grease buildup on sides of cooking equipment. Dust, dirt, and debris on floor under and around cooking and non-cooking equipment. Manager instructed to clean and maintain all areas.

headline: Slow-draining handsink; dirty soda area
summary: Upper soda dispenser dirty; liquid spillage in cabinet beneath soda system. Very slow-draining handsink at kitchen entrance must be repaired. Dirty floor drains under three-compartment sink and behind ice machine. Spillage and debris behind dining soda system. Food handler training proof required.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; food stored on floor
summary: No cleanup procedure or supplies for vomit and diarrheal events on premises. Food stored on floor in walk-in cooler; soiled wiping cloths on prep tables; heavy grease on equipment; three-compartment sink faucet does not reach all three sinks; cardboard used as floor mat.

headline: Blender stored on dish machine; unsealed wood
summary: Alkaline machine and blender stored on top of high-temperature dish machine; must be relocated. Unsealed wood shelves, and dish machine raised on wood. No prep/dump sink in front prep area; missing backflow device on small ice machine. Several repairs needed to walls, lights, and ventilation.

headline: Rodent droppings in storage; dish machine too hot
summary: About 20 rodent droppings along walls in rear dry storage and 5 under equipment beside the bathroom. Pest control recommended. Also no thermometer in front cooler, dish machine final rinse above 180°F, and items stored on floor.

headline: Live flies found; citation issued
summary: About 15-20 live small flies in dishwashing area and basement. Pest control technician from Landmark was on site during inspection; citation issued. Also broken bulk container lid holding dried onion, food debris behind cooking equipment, and cluttered bar shelving.

headline: No certified manager during deli prep
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager on premises while deli sandwiches were prepared and served; citation issued. No handwashing signage at dishwashing area handsink.

headline: No health policies; restroom water too cool
summary: No signed employee health policies; citation issued. Hot water at men's restroom handsink measures 86.0°F; must be 100.0°F; citation issued. Wet mops must be hung to dry using a hook system.

headline: No handwashing soap; gap under back door
summary: No handwashing soap at any handsink; management provided soap during inspection; citation issued. Half-inch gap under rear exterior door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Missing thermometers in front and walk-in coolers. Employees without hair restraints. Non-managers lack food handler training.

headline: Employee items on supplies; beards; dusty fans
summary: Slight debris in ice machine interior and chute. Employee personal items stored on open boxes of single-service utensils and condiments. Food handlers with beards must wear beard restraints. Dust on walk-in cooler fans. Heavy dust and grease between cook line and pizza oven.

headline: 50 live flies; no valid certified manager
summary: No valid certified manager on duty while chicken and other TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. About 50 live small flies on walls, ceiling tiles, and shelving in rear dishwashing and storage area; citation issued. Multiple leaks at front handsink.

headline: No health policy or allergen training on site
summary: No verifiable employee health policy on site; template left and copies required. No handwashing signage at front cashier handsink. No covered trash receptacles in unisex toilet rooms. Grease buildup on hood filters. No allergen training on site for managers.

headline: Hard-to-pump soap dispenser at bar
summary: Soap dispenser at the exposed bar handwashing sink is hard to pump. Instructed to correct and maintain it in good condition.

headline: No certified food manager during TCS food service
summary: No certified food manager on site while time/temperature-control (TCS) foods such as beef and chicken were prepared and served; citation issued. Also a missing ceiling tile in the staff toilet room.

headline: Peeling paint near fan in staff toilet
summary: Paint peeling around mechanical fan in the first-floor staff toilet room. Instructed to repair and maintain.

headline: Wiping cloths in water; cutting boards and grease
summary: Wiping cloths stored in sanitizing buckets of water; must be stored in sanitizing solution between uses. Cutting boards with open seams and stains; microwave needs cleaning. Slight grease under fryers. Dust on vents and wooden ceiling in walk-in cooler.

headline: Ice machine slime; flies; grease overflow
summary: Black slime on ice machine ice chute and contact surfaces dripping into ice; citation issued. About 20-30 small flies around mop sink and water tank room; pest control recommended; citation issued. Overflowing outdoor grease container. Dirty bar sink. Missing ceiling tiles above ice machine.

headline: Ice machine slime; cooler food held too warm
summary: Black slime on ice-contact surfaces dripping into ice; citation issued. Front prep cooler at 50.7°F: roast beef 49.5°F, American cheese 48.5°F, hot dogs 46.4°F. Cooler tagged and must not be used until repaired. Food discarded. No food handler or allergen training proof.

headline: Fruit flies in basement; no certificate posted
summary: No valid certified food manager certificate posted while chicken was prepared and served; citation issued. About 20-30 live fruit flies in basement dish room; pest control recommended; citation issued. Dusty vent. Employee lacked food handler training certificate.

headline: Wet wiping cloths on food surfaces; reused bags
summary: Wet wiping cloths stored on steam tables, prep tables, and handsinks; must stay in sanitizing solution. Facility reusing single-use grocery bags for lettuce and vegetables; instructed to stop and use food-grade containers. Torn gaskets on three-door cooler.

headline: Fries held unrefrigerated at 68-74°F; discarded
summary: Par-cooked French fries on rolling rack held unrefrigerated at 68.0°F to 74.2°F, with no labels or dates; about 10 lb ($50) discarded; citation issued. Basement employee toilet room not fully enclosed. Prior uncorrected violation: no mechanical ventilation in basement toilet room.

headline: Re-inspection: certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: Certified manager has no allergen training. All certified managers must complete allergen training.

headline: No vomit kit or procedure; no utility sink
summary: No kit or procedure on site for vomit and diarrhea; instructed to keep one with norovirus-effective sanitizer. No handwashing signage at employee toilet handsink. No utility sink on site. No covered trash receptacle in employee toilet room.

headline: Staff eating at prep area; milk crates in use
summary: Employees eating and washing dishes at kitchen prep area; must designate a separate break area. Serving plates not inverted. Milk crates used for elevation must be replaced with proper shelving. Ice scoop stored inside ice machine. Heavy dirt and grease in hood, filters, and pipes.

headline: Prep cooler door does not close properly
summary: Door of one-door prep cooler below the drive-thru counter does not close properly. Instructed to repair the door gasket.

headline: Missing handwash signs; items stored on floor
summary: Missing handwashing signage at first-floor employee restrooms. Single-service articles stored on floor in storage areas; instructed to invert and elevate them. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Re-inspection: no handwash signs; one food card
summary: No handwashing signage inside restrooms; instructed to provide. Only one food handler card on site; all employees must complete food handler training and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Broken, stained ceiling tiles in dry storage
summary: Broken ceiling tile panels on north wall of rear dry storage. Inspector instructed replacement of broken and stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Certified managers lack allergen certificates
summary: Certified food managers on site have no food allergen training certificates. Instructed to obtain and maintain valid certificates.

headline: No certified manager; blocked, leaking handsinks
summary: No certified food manager on site or certificate posted while chicken and beef were handled and served. Hose blocks front prep handsink; excessive leak at bar handsink. Cooked food in walk-in cooler lacked date marks. No sanitizer test device for low-temperature dish machine.

headline: Knives stored improperly; missing sink stoppers
summary: Knives improperly stored between prep table and cooler. Three-compartment sink missing proper stoppers. Instructed to store knives properly and provide stoppers.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food; dirty shelves
summary: No certified food manager on site while chicken, hot dogs, and pizza were prepared and served; citation issued. Buildup of dirt and spills on shelves, under coffee and soda stations, and on walk-in cooler floors. Cluttered rear toilet room.

headline: Missing ice machine doors; sink stoppers gone
summary: Top and side doors missing from ice machine. Two sink stoppers missing for warewashing sink. No handwashing signage at front prep handsink. No ambient air thermometer inside front display refrigerator.

headline: Re-inspection: ice machine, splash guard, grime
summary: Small blacklike buildup inside ice machine panel; cleaning scheduled. No splash guard at dish-area handwashing sink. Food residue on walk-in shelving and fan guards. Missing trash can lid in women's restroom.

headline: Ice machine slime; dish machines under-sanitizing
summary: Black and pink slimy buildup inside ice machine dripping onto ice; citation issued. Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine; not to be used until fixed, and manager fixed it on site. High-temperature rinse measured 138.5°F, below 160°F; fixed on site.

headline: Stained cutting board; rust; missing coving
summary: Stained cutting board across from three-compartment sink. Unlabeled breading container. Clean-in-place slicers need a written washing procedure. Rust under three-compartment sink. Missing coving with about a one-inch gap under the sink. Some food handlers lack training proof.

headline: Duct tape on cooler; soiled cloths and mop heads
summary: Soiled wiping cloths stored on prep tables; instructed to store in sanitizing solution. Duct tape used as repair on two-door cooler; surface must be smooth and cleanable. No covered receptacles in unisex toilet room. Soiled mop head not hung. Stained ceiling tiles near water heater.

headline: Food held too warm; cooler and backflow issues
summary: Refrigerator food above 41°F: eggs at 53.7 and 50.7°F, cooked chicken 73.5°F, pad thai noodles 48.0°F, sticky rice 81.3°F; about 13 lb valued at $50; citation issued. Two-door cooler ambient air at 52.3°F. No backflow device at basement utility sink; leaks at basement sink.

headline: Re-inspection: door not rodent-proof; no thermometer
summary: Front entrance door not rodent-proof, with a half-inch opening at bottom; must be made rodent-proof. Front prep cooler needs a working thermometer. Chipping and peeling walls. Missing ceiling tile over walk-in cooler entrance. Remove cardboard matting inside walk-in cooler.

headline: Wiping cloths on prep surfaces; allergen proof missing
summary: Orange and white wiping cloths left on prep surfaces and cutting boards; must be held in sanitizer buckets between uses. Stained cutting board at prep cooler. No proof of allergen training for certified food managers; documentation must be kept on site.

headline: Floors not clean by rear compactor area
summary: Floors not clean by the rear indoor compactor area. Instructed to clean.

headline: No health policy; leaks and missing stoppers
summary: No written employee health policy on premises; signed copies required. Torn gasket on prep cooler. Missing sink stoppers for three-compartment sink. Greasy deep fryers. Constant water drip from unused exhaust hood. No mechanical ventilation in washroom. Missing light shields over dry storage freezers.

headline: License number missing from MFP labeling
summary: The business license number was not printed on the lateral sides of the MFP, at least 2 inches tall. Inspector instructed the operator to add it.

headline: Ice machine debris; torn gasket; expired allergen certificate
summary: Debris encrusted inside ice machine must be removed and the machine serviced. Torn door gasket on kitchen two-door cooler. Certified food manager has an expired allergen training certificate; must provide and maintain a valid one.

headline: Egg and sandwich items too warm; cooler tagged
summary: Egg frittata and breakfast sandwiches held at 50°F to 55°F in coffee-station cooler; about 30 lb ($100) discarded. Cooler at 50°F tagged by Chicago Department of Public Health; must not be used until it holds 41°F or below. Citation issued.

headline: Missing thermometers; holes in walls
summary: Working thermometers must be provided and maintained inside reach-in coolers. Debris on bottom shelf of two-door reach-in cooler must be cleaned. A few holes and openings in walls must be sealed.

headline: About 60 mouse droppings across facility
summary: About 60 mouse droppings throughout the facility, including dining-room restroom, floors near the front register, and basement closets and stairs; citation issued. Pest control recommended. Also no front prep handsink, missing handwashing signs, and greasy surfaces behind cooking equipment.

headline: Missing health, cleanup, and pest records
summary: No employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea cleanup policy or kit, calibrated food thermometer, pest control logbook, food handler certificates, or allergen certificates on premises. Salad reach-in cooler ambient air at 55.0°F; must be 41°F or below.

headline: Mold-like buildup inside walk-in cooler
summary: Mold-like buildup on walk-in cooler walls, ceiling, draft system hoses, and shelving where food is stored. Instructed to remove, clean, sanitize, and keep free of buildup.

headline: Ice buildup in rear deep freezer; hood filters
summary: Deep freezer in rear storage has ice buildup; must be defrosted and cleaned. Filters above cooking equipment must be cleaned to remove debris.

headline: About 60 rodent droppings in prep areas
