headline: Failed: no certified manager; health policies missing
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while fried chicken, fish and slaw were served; a citation was issued. Missing signed health policies and no vomit cleanup procedure. A gap under the front door could let insects in. Hair restraint not worn.

headline: Re-inspection: rusted racks; plastic bags used
summary: Rusted storage racks in the walk-in cooler must be cleaned or replaced. Food was stored in plastic grocery bags in the freezer. A covered sanitary receptacle is needed in the all-gender restroom. A manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Failed: 3 roaches; food held too cool
summary: Three adult roaches were found inside a two-door reach-in cooler between the gasket and the hinge. Broth and pasta were held at 45.6F to 61F; about 20 lbs was discarded. Paper towels were stored above a cutting board.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; leaking pipe
summary: A hand sink in the main prep area had no handwashing signage. Bulk dry food containers on the rear storage shelf were unlabeled. Clean equipment stored under a dehumidifier needed protection, and a leaking unused pipe needed repair or removal.

headline: Consumer advisory added on site
summary: Menu lacked a disclosure about items served raw or undercooked; the disclosure was added to the menu before inspection ended. Covered receptacles were provided on site in the restroom. Other needs: a splash guard, ice bin lid, grease trap access, and allergen proof.

headline: Wet wiping cloths and scoops stored improperly
summary: Multiple wet wiping cloths were stored on prep tables throughout the kitchen. Scoops had handles in contact with food or ice. A prep cooler lid was bent, a hand sink faucet was loose, and an expired allergen training certificate was noted.

headline: Damaged flooring and missing grout
summary: Damaged flooring was observed in the dish room, and the rear prep area was missing grout. Repairs must create a smooth, cleanable surface and be maintained at all times. The re-inspection passed.

headline: Food stored on floor; cooking equipment needs cleaning
summary: All food and containers must be raised off the floor in the walk-in cooler and rear dry storage. Ice machine interior, cooking equipment, hood vents and floors at the front prep line need detail cleaning. Cutting boards need replacement when worn.

headline: Beard restraint needed; walk-in threshold repair
summary: A food handler with a beard was not wearing a beard restraint. Ice melter bags must be elevated off the floor. Walk-in cooler and freezer thresholds were in poor repair and held with duct tape. An old ice machine must be removed.

headline: Missing thermometer; two untrained food handlers
summary: Two employees lacked food handler training, and two coolers had no thermometers. A bulk flour container was unlabeled, and a hood bulb was burnt out. Summary report was missing; a new one was left for posting.

headline: Broken tile, hole in basement ceiling
summary: Broken floor tile was found at the stairs to the basement. A hole was noted in the basement storage ceiling near the staff toilet. The inspector instructed repair, sealing and maintenance. The restaurant passed.

headline: Ice machine not clean; foil used as liner
summary: The top interior of the ice machine was not clean and was ordered cleaned. Aluminum foil was used as a shelf and equipment liner in the kitchen and must be removed for non-porous, smooth liners.

headline: Steady leak under bar hand sink
summary: A steady leak was found at the pipe under the exposed hand sink in the bar. The staff was instructed to repair or replace it and keep it in good condition. The restaurant passed.

headline: Chicken stored in old sauce container
summary: Chicken was stored in an old tzatziki sauce container. Staff must store food only in food-grade, reusable containers. A torn gasket on a three-door prep cooler must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Food handler lacks required certificate
summary: A food handler on site did not meet food handler requirements. Other issues: dirty walk-in shelving and fan covers, a leak under the three-compartment sink, and floor drains and corners needing cleaning.

headline: Failed: preset tableware; expired certificates
summary: Preset knives and forks in the dining room were not protected from contamination. Covered receptacles were needed in basement washrooms. Expired food handler and allergen certificates were shown, and damaged ceiling tiles were noted.

headline: Handwashing signs and labels needed
summary: Handwashing signs must be provided at all hand sinks: prep, dishwashing and washrooms. Food storage containers identified with common names like flour and sugar must be labeled. The restaurant passed.

headline: Tin foil used on oven backsplash; open wall gaps
summary: Tin foil or tape was used as a shield on the oven backsplash and must be replaced with a smooth, cleanable surface. Open holes and cracks above the dish machine and clean utensils in the basement must be sealed.

headline: No certified manager; food date marks expired
summary: No valid city food sanitation certificate was present while raw chicken was cooked and served. Prepared pork and garlic paste with expired dates (2023-2024) were discarded, and other prepared foods lacked date labels. Utensils were stored in stagnant water.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was on the premises; a priority violation was issued. A 1-inch gap under the front door and exposed light around the rear door were noted. Wall gaps, holes and missing backflow device also cited.

headline: Dirty unused cooking equipment; sink floor grime
summary: Residue and grime were found on unused cooking equipment and cold holding units; the person in charge was told to clean or remove them. Residue was also found on the floor under the three-compartment sink in the rear storage area.

headline: Re-inspection: openings to seal; no allergen proof
summary: Openings in the wall behind the low-temperature dish machine and the exposed hand sink corner must be sealed. No allergen training certificates were provided on site for certified managers, who must show proof.

headline: Front door 1/2-inch gap; no service sink
summary: The front entrance door had a 1/2-inch gap and must be made rodent-proof. The premises had no service sink or mop sink and one must be installed. Outer openings were not protected.

headline: Failed: rodent infestation throughout premises
summary: About 150 mouse droppings were found on ledges and in a cabinet drawer; dead cockroaches were on walls. Additional pest control is needed. Grease, dirt and spiderwebs were also cited, and prior core violations were not corrected.

headline: Re-inspection: no certified manager; wiping cloths
summary: No city-certified manager was on site while pizzas, pasta and chicken salad were prepared; a citation was issued. Wiping cloths were stored on a prep table. Heavy ceiling vent dust and a torn gasket on a three-door cooler were also cited.

headline: Broken self-service coffee machines
summary: Two self-service coffee machines at the rear of the kiosk did not work. The operator was told to repair them or remove them from the premises. The kiosk passed.

headline: Bulk containers unlabeled; equipment needs cleaning
summary: Bulk food items lacked labels with the commodity name. Ice machine interior, mixer, can openers, cooking equipment, floors and hood vents needed detail cleaning. Wiping cloths were to be stored in sanitizer.

headline: Failed: food held too cool; no pest logbook
summary: Cooked rice was held at 111F, below the required 135F; the manager discarded it. A hand sink was being used as a dump sink. No pest control logbook was available after a company change. A 6-inch hole in the basement foundation was noted.

headline: Cardboard liner used under walk-in shelving
summary: Cardboard was used as a liner under walk-in cooler shelving and on shelves below grease containers; it must be removed or replaced with a smooth, cleanable material. Missing ceiling tiles above the walk-in entrance must be replaced.

headline: Failed: no pest control logbook on site
summary: No pest control logbook was available during inspection; a priority citation was issued. Also required: repair of a holed sink-cabinet door that could let pests in, loose wall coving, dusty hood filters, and two out-of-service lights.

headline: Gap under front entry door
summary: A 1/4-inch gap was found under the front entry door and must be sealed to prevent pests. Other needs: a leaking toilet-room drain, a leaking three-compartment sink faucet, a missing trash lid, and dirt under equipment.

headline: Hand sink water too cool; basement leak
summary: The hand sink in the dish prep area measured 74F, below the 100F required; it was cited as a priority violation. Also cited: the ice machine interior, the microwave and a basement wall leak needed cleaning or repair.

headline: No employee health policies; food handler training missing
summary: No signed employee health policies were on site, and a citation was issued. Food handler training and food allergen training for managers were missing. Food must be raised off the floor in the rear storage area, and grease must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: vacuum packing without plan; sink flooding
summary: A vacuum packaging machine was on site with no HACCP plan or variance; it was tagged and must not be used until approved. The three-compartment sink floods when one compartment drains and must be fixed.

headline: Debris under grill and fryers
summary: Debris was found under the grill and flat top on the hot line, and grease and food debris were under the deep fryers. Staff was told to clean these areas to prevent possible pests and insects. The restaurant passed.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings found throughout
summary: Inspector found 50 or more mouse droppings behind freezers, by a sink, under a prep table and on a window ledge. A pest control visit was required before reinspection. Also cited: no valid manager certificate and a food handler who did not wash hands before gloving.

headline: Restroom fixtures need regular cleaning
summary: Restroom plumbing fixtures such as sinks, toilets and urinals must be cleaned and maintained as often as needed to keep them clean. The restaurant passed.

headline: Restroom door not self-closing
summary: The restroom door was not self-closing. The person in charge was instructed to install a self-closing device and maintain it.

headline: Rust on shelves; wall holes and peeling paint
summary: Rust was found on shelves of the three-door reach-in cooler in the prep area and must be cleaned or replaced. A large hole in the wall under the dish machine and peeling paint near the ice machine must be repaired. Spilled liquid under the bar needed cleaning.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings and multiple violations
summary: About 40 or more mouse droppings were found under lockers, on storage shelves and in the electrical closet. No certified manager certificate, no soap or towels at sinks, and no sanitizer test kit were also cited. A citation was issued.

headline: Front door gap could let pests in
summary: The bottom of the front door was in poor repair, with a 1/4-inch gap. The inspector required repair to prevent a possible entry point for pests. No pests were observed.

headline: Fly strip hung in prep area; missing signs
summary: A fly strip was hanging in the rear food prep area and must be removed. Also required: a handwashing sign, a self-closing restroom door, and valid food handler certificates, since some were expired.

headline: Re-inspection: no certified manager; no allergen proof
summary: No city food sanitation certificate was posted, and a certified manager must be present whenever TCS foods are prepared or served. No allergen training certificates were provided. Pizza oven and prep tables need cleaning.

headline: Food on freezer floor; grease in fryer cabinets
summary: Food was stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer and must be raised 6 inches. Grease and debris built up in the fryer cabinets, and a caulking needed cleaning. Toilet room door and a missing lightswitch cover were also noted.

headline: Gaps at door; missing health policies
summary: Front double doors had a gap in the center and the rear door had a gap at the bottom; both must be tight-fitting. Signed employee health policies were missing. A walk-in gasket was worn, and a sink faucet was leaking.

headline: Fan guard missing in walk-in cooler
summary: A fan guard was missing inside the walk-in cooler. The establishment must provide one. The restaurant passed.

headline: Dish machine sanitizer at 0 ppm; no summary posted
summary: The dish machine measured 0 ppm final chlorine sanitizer; it must provide at least 50 ppm. A priority citation was issued. Also noted: a leaking three-compartment sink faucet, floor debris and no posted summary report.

headline: Failed: over 300 mouse droppings; live mouse seen
summary: Over 300 mouse droppings were found throughout the store, and gnawed dry-food bags were seen. A live mouse ran under a freezer. Milk was held at 52.1F to 52.7F, above 41F, and was discarded. No pest log was provided.

headline: Failed: more than 15 small flies throughout facility
summary: More than 15 small flies were seen in the bar, rear kitchen, warewashing area, downstairs prep area and dining room. The manager was instructed to service affected areas. A cutting board with heavy stains and deep scratches was a prior violation not corrected.

headline: Failed: flies found; no certified manager on site
summary: About 25 to 30 live small flying insects were seen in several areas. No certified manager was on site while beef and eggs were prepared; the manager arrived 45 minutes later. No licensed pest control operator was in use, and a prior floor and wall cleaning issue remained.

headline: Mold-like substance in ice machine; food too warm
summary: A panel in the ice machine touched ice with black mold-like substance; the staff burned the ice and cleaned the machine on site. Cooler food ran 46.8F to 56.7F; about 10 lbs was discarded. Cardboard and foil were used as liners.

headline: Food handlers lack certificates; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Food handlers had no food handler certificates. The certified food manager on site had no allergen training certificate. Also noted: no handwashing sign in the restroom, a hair restraint not worn, wiping cloths on coolers, and a leaking sink.

headline: No employee health policy; no vomit cleanup kit
summary: No written employee health policy was on premises, and a citation was issued. There was no vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies. Food handler certificates were not provided, and a previous allergen violation was not corrected.

headline: Re-inspection: broken door handle; unnecessary items
summary: A missing or broken door handle was found on a two-door reach-in cooler on the cook line and must be replaced. All unnecessary items in the basement must be removed to prevent pest harboring.

headline: Door gap, cleaning needed, manager lacks allergen training
summary: Inspector saw a 1/4-inch gap under the front door, a possible pest entry point, and required weather stripping. Also required cleaning of the coffee-machine counter, refrigerators, basement freezer and floors under the service counter. Certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Failed: hot water 78F; eyewash at hand sink
summary: Hot water at two restroom sinks measured 78F; it must be at least 100F; a citation was issued. An eyewash station was attached to a hand sink and must be removed. Two out-of-order dish machines must be repaired or removed.

headline: Rust and mold found; no covered trash receptacles
summary: A can opener on a prep table had grime and rust. Dark mold-like substance was found on the floor under the bar three-compartment sink. Restrooms lacked covered receptacles. Hot water tank area debris also needed cleaning.

headline: Failed: no hot water; no pest control log
summary: Hand sink water in the washroom measured 55.7F; at least 100F is required. No pest control logbook was available. No utility sink, grease trap or self-closing washroom door was present, and baseboards near the pizza oven were missing.

headline: No city sanitation certificate on site
summary: The person in charge had no city sanitation certificate, and no certified person was posted while dairy foods were handled. No sanitizing test strips were available for the three-compartment sink, and oversized buckets did not fit it.

headline: No city-certified manager on site
summary: No valid city food service manager certificate was on site during the inspection while sliced ham and kraut were being handled. Items were stored on floors in dry storage and the walk-in cooler. A water-damaged ceiling tile needs repair.

headline: No paper towels at two hand sinks
summary: Paper towels were missing at the hand sinks in the deli prep and seafood prep areas. The food handler obtained paper towels during the inspection. Both were cited as priority foundation violations.

headline: Failed: 100+ mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were found in the basement storage area, behind the counter and in other areas. No certified sanitation manager was on site. An exterminator was required, and the ventilation above cooking equipment was not working.

headline: Shrimp held too cool; freezer ice buildup
summary: Shrimp fatija in the hot-holding unit was 112.4F, below 135F; about 15 oz was discarded. Interior of reach-in coolers and walk-in freezer needed detail cleaning. A priority violation for no allergen training proof was also issued.

headline: Ice machine calcium buildup; cutting board stained
summary: Early calcium-like buildup was seen on the outer gray area of the ice machine. A large cutting board was stained with deep grooves and must be replaced. Dirt and food debris in prep and cooking areas could attract pests.

headline: Ice machine residue; small sink leaks
summary: Inspector saw slight residue inside the ice machine and required cleaning. Small leaks at the levers under the three-compartment sink were also noted for repair. The restaurant passed.

headline: Slow-draining employee hand sink
summary: The hand sink in the unisex employee washroom drained slowly. The business must repair and maintain it. The restaurant passed.

headline: Re-inspection: flies and roaches found
summary: Over 30 live small flies and several live roaches were found in the basement dish room, prep area, washrooms and cooler gaskets. Pest activity must be eliminated and additional pest control service is required. A scoop was stored on food.

headline: Re-inspection: no food manager certificate; no training proof
summary: No valid city food sanitation manager certificate was provided for staff working while TCS foods were prepared or served. Food handler and allergen training proof was not shown. Cooler food stored in plastic grocery bags was also noted.

headline: Failed: no hot water; slime in ice machine
summary: Hand sinks in the prep area and washrooms measured 70.4F to 74.4F; at least 100F is required. Black slime was found inside the ice machine, dripping into ice used for consumption; the machine must be cleaned. A dish machine at 0 ppm was tagged.

headline: Expired allergen certificate; gasket in poor repair
summary: An expired food allergen training certificate was found, and a priority citation was issued. The gasket inside the prep cooler is in poor repair and must be repaired. All city food managers must obtain and keep valid allergen certificates.

headline: Cooler thermometer in disrepair; backflow missing
summary: The thermometer in the two-door cooler in the front prep area was in disrepair and must be replaced. A backflow prevention device could not be located at the ice machine and must be installed and accessible.

headline: Re-inspection: rusted wire racks in cooler
summary: Chipped paint and rust were observed on the wire storage racks in the walk-in cooler. The racks must be repainted or replaced, and the chipped paint and rust removed. The re-inspection passed.

headline: Dead bugs found on cutting board and baseboard
summary: Dead bugs were found on a cutting board in the prep area and a baseboard in dry storage; they must be removed. Raw wood displayed produce must be sealed. A leaking pipe in the washroom utility closet needs repair.

headline: Pantry floor needed cleaning; corrected on site
summary: Inspector instructed the staff to clean the kitchen pantry floor under the shelves. The problem was corrected on site during the inspection. No other violations were noted.

headline: Unlabeled bulk bins; milk crates used as shelves
summary: Bulk storage containers for rice and beans had no labels. A bowl was used as a scoop for dry storage and was stored inside the container. Milk crates were used as shelving and must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Front door not rodent-proof; fan broken
summary: The front door of the establishment was not rodent-proof and must be made so. Construction debris in the rear storage room must be removed. The restroom ventilation fan was inoperable. The license passed.

headline: Light shields missing in prep area
summary: Light shields were missing from lights in the prep area. The establishment must provide shields and maintain them. The license passed.

headline: No person in charge on site until 10 AM
summary: No person in charge was on site at inspection, and no certified food manager was present while eggs and milk were prepared and served. The person in charge arrived at 10 AM. A loose splash guard at a hand sink must be sealed.

headline: Failed: mouse activity in many areas
summary: Mouse activity was observed along wall bases, window sills, shelving, boxes and in the rear storage area. Management was told to call pest control and clean. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit was on site, and the carpet under sales shelves needed removal.

headline: Failed: live roaches in reach-in cooler; food too warm
summary: About 6 live roaches were found inside a three-door reach-in cooler at the hinges and gaskets. Hot foods such as chicken at 100.4F and rice at 92.3F-101.8F were below 135F; about 50 lbs was discarded. No vomit cleanup kit or soap at a sink.

headline: No certified manager; no hot water on site
summary: No city-certified manager was on site while milk and cheesecake were handled, and a citation was issued. No hot running water was on site; hand sinks measured 62F to 64F. Hot water must be provided at 100F to 120F.

headline: Re-inspection: food stored on floor and crates
summary: Boxes were stored on the floor in the basement and food items on milk crates in the walk-in cooler. Shelving must lift items at least 6 inches off the floor. A leaking three-compartment sink faucet must be repaired. One employee lacked allergen training.

headline: No certified manager; advisory missing; old items
summary: No city-certified manager was on site while omelets, beef samosa and chicken were prepared; a citation was issued. The menu lacked the raw or undercooked food advisory. Food stored on the walk-in floor and rusty shelves were prior violations not corrected.

headline: Foil and metal tape on equipment; greasy floors
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Aluminum foil lined nonfood-contact surfaces on the wok line and hot-holding equipment and must be removed. Metal tape on a wall behind the rice cooker must be removed. Greasy floors and a soiled utility faucet need cleaning.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; no allergen training
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Customer and employee restrooms need handwashing signs. City food managers have no allergen training, and certificates must be kept on site.

headline: Hair restraints missing; food debris in coolers
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Employees in food prep lacked hair restraints. Ice scoops were stored on top of the ice machine. Coolers, freezers, storage racks, and floors had food, dirt and debris, and walls and ceilings were dusty.

headline: No employee health policy; no allergen training
summary: License inspection passed with conditions. No employee health policy or training records were on site. The customer washroom needed handwashing signs, and coolers needed thermometers. A certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Walk-in cooler at 47F; no pest control log
summary: License inspection failed. The walk-in cooler measured 47F and must be repaired. Missing items include an employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure, stem thermometer, test strips, and pest control log. Restroom doors were not self-closing.

headline: Prep cooler at 65F tagged; no certified manager
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. No person in charge with a city food manager certificate was on site while TCS foods were prepared. A two-door prep cooler at 65F was tagged and held. Bulk flour and sugar lacked labels.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; manager training gap
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Black slime was found inside the ice machine and must be detail cleaned. A rear bar handwash sink faucet leaks slightly. The basement employee restroom needs a covered trash can. One of two managers lacks allergen training.

headline: Hot foods too cool; sanitizer at zero
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. Ready-to-eat cooked foods were below 135F: crab rangoon 64.3F, breaded chicken 70.4F, egg rolls 77.6F-117.6F. About 12 lbs ($110) was discarded. Sanitizer read 0.0 ppm at the three-compartment sink; manager was instructed on setup.

headline: Cold foods 48-53F discarded; dead insects on floor
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. Cold TCS foods at 48-53F were discarded (about $115). Chicken was thawed in the three-compartment sink. Dead insects were on the seating-area floor. Hand-drying supplies were missing; paper towels were provided during inspection.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving
summary: License inspection passed. Milk crates were used as shelving in prep and storage areas. They must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Unlabeled seasonings; clutter; no allergen training
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Bulk dry seasonings at the cookline lacked labels. Clutter filled kitchen closets, the boiler room and garage. No proof of food handler or allergen training was on site.

headline: Light grease and dust on cooking equipment
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Light grease and dust were on the sides of cooking and noncooking equipment. Staff must clean and maintain them.

headline: No food handler training proof; no hair restraints
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. No proof of food handler training was on site, and it must be kept on site at all times. Trash and debris were around the dumpsters.

headline: Rat droppings found; no city sanitation certificate
summary: Complaint inspection failed. 35 rat droppings were found in the tool storage room and under the dish rack. No city sanitation certificate was on premises during TCS food handling. Food handlers had no training.

headline: Rodent droppings found in basement
summary: Canvass inspection failed. About 10 to 15 rodent droppings were behind the basement water heater. The manager was told to remove them, sanitize the area, and call pest control. Ice scoop and spoons were stored improperly.

headline: Mop sink lacks backflow device; training proof missing
summary: Complaint inspection passed. No backflow prevention device was at the utility mop sink; one must be installed where it can be serviced. No food handler certificates were on premises, and the certified manager lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Expired deli meat discarded; no certified manager
summary: Complaint inspection failed. Over 80 lbs of expired deli meats (dated July-December 2023) in a prep cooler were discarded ($500). No city-certified manager was on site while beef was prepped. Hand soap and paper towels were missing at sinks.

headline: Splashguard needed at handsink
summary: Canvass inspection passed. A splashguard is required between the handwashing sink and countertop in the food prep and grill area to reduce contamination.

headline: About 100 live flies; pest activity found
summary: Canvass inspection failed. About 100 live small flies were on walls, cardboard boxes, and flying in the rear food prep and dry storage areas. Staff were told to remove their own fly devices, and pest control was recommended.

headline: Food frozen in grocery bags
summary: Canvass inspection passed. A small amount of food was frozen in grocery bags. Staff were told to stop and use only food-grade containers.

headline: Food in grocery bag; splash guard still missing
summary: Complaint inspection failed. Food was in a plastic grocery bag in the employee refrigerator. A bar hand-sink splash guard from a prior violation is still missing. Also an open ceiling, a burned-out bulb, and no allergen certificate were noted.

headline: Rat droppings found in basement; no certified manager
summary: Canvass inspection failed. About 50 rat droppings were under basement stairs where dry storage is kept; more pest control is needed. Black slime dripped from the basement ice machine onto stored ice. No certified manager was on site.

headline: Unlabeled bakery bulk containers; greasy fryers
summary: Short-form complaint inspection passed. Bulk containers in the bakery lacked labels. Staff were told to clean fryers, cooking equipment, prep tables, walk-in shelves, and vents. A bakery handsink drains slowly and must be corrected.

headline: Cooler at 54F; no hot water at sinks
summary: Re-inspection failed. The reach-in cooler was at 54F and must stay at 41F or below. The three-compartment sink and hand sink lacked hot water (hand sink 93F). A leak behind the three-compartment sink needs repair.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; hair restraints needed
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Large bulk food containers need labels. Some food handlers with long hair lacked restraints. A chemical system leaked at the mop sink; floors at the dish machine and counter had spills; floor drains need cleaning.

headline: Greasy fryer filter; grime near oven
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. The deep fryer oil filter unit had grease and food debris. Cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, freezers and shelves had buildup. Heavy grime was on walls near the oven and under the fryers.

headline: Two dead roaches found under cooking hood
summary: License inspection passed. Two dead roaches were on the floor under wok equipment and must be removed. Freezers and food were stored under wastewater pipes in the basement. Two bulbs were out; handwash signage was missing.

headline: Ice scoops on counter; hair restraint missing
summary: Canvass inspection passed. An employee serving food had no hair restraint, and ice scoops sat on the front counter. A leaky handsink pipe, uncovered restroom waste bin, and cluttered furnace room need attention. The certified manager lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Buns on floor; greasy fryer and grill
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Cartons of buns must be elevated at least six inches off the floor to prevent contamination. Grease build-up on the pressure fryer and grill beside the meat cooler must be detail cleaned.

headline: Handsink can't fully shut off; dusty fan
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The handwashing sink at the far end of the cook line is in poor repair and can't fully shut off water, though it works. Dust covers the ceiling fan and tiles above warewashing.

headline: Expired allergen training certificate
summary: Canvass inspection passed. One food allergen training certificate had expired and must be renewed.

headline: Prep handsinks lack hot water; 84-91F
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. Hand sinks in the prep area had no hot running water; temperatures measured 84.2F and 91F. Staff must provide hot and cold water at all handwashing sinks. A torn gasket on a basement walk-in freezer must be repaired.

headline: Dishes not sanitized; food stored on floors
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. A worker washed equipment with soap and water only, and the third sink basin had no sanitizer; a citation was issued. It was fixed after instruction. Chicken was thawed in standing water.

headline: Over 40 mouse droppings in basement storage
summary: Canvass inspection failed. Over 40 mouse droppings were found in basement storage, on floors, shelves and bulk containers. The manager was told to call an exterminator and clean the area. Uncorrected earlier violations include missing cooler thermometers and a leaking faucet.

headline: Greasy floors under equipment and corners
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Grease had built up on the floor under cooking equipment, along walls, and in corners of the prep area. Staff must clean floors under all equipment and in all corners.

headline: About 20 live flying insects; no certified manager
summary: Complaint re-inspection failed. About 20 live flying insects were on walls and ceiling in the rear dishwashing area, and an earlier violation remains. Pest control service is needed. No certified manager was on site during TCS food prep.

headline: Rear door gap; expired food handler certificates
summary: Complaint inspection failed. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door sweep must be sealed to rodent-proof the door. Some food handler certificates had expired. Stained ceiling tiles from a prior core violation were not corrected.

headline: Uncovered ice and food on floors
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Ice in the bar and bulk containers in prep were uncovered; food sat on walk-in and storage floors. Walk-in freezer had ice buildup, and a drainpipe under the three-compartment sink leaked.

headline: Missing handwash signs; broken entry wall
summary: License inspection passed. Handwashing signs were missing at hand sinks. Restroom doors were not self-closing. A broken, crumbling wall at the front entrance must be enclosed to prevent pest entry. Wall-floor gaps, clutter, and missing bulbs also need fixing.

headline: Dish machine drain leaks during use
summary: License inspection passed. The high-temperature dish machine drain leaked at the bar area while in use, though it worked with its air gap backflow device. Repair or replacement was ordered to stop the leak.

headline: About 50 live flying insects; no certified manager
summary: Re-inspection failed. About 50 live small flying insects were in basement prep, dish and storage areas and behind the bars. No certified food manager was present during hamburger and salad prep and service. Additional pest control is needed.

headline: Unlabeled containers; dirty ice bin and reach-ins
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Ice bin interior, reach-in cooler interiors, and mechanical vents needed cleaning. Storage containers lacked labels, and dirty wiping cloths sat on prep tables. Cardboard liners were on food prep equipment and must be removed.

headline: Ants on candy shelf; pest control log outdated
summary: Complaint re-inspection failed. About 30-40 ants were crawling on a candy shelf. Manager was told to contact pest control. The pest control logbook was not current; the last date was 2019. No hand-drying supplies were on site.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Milk crates were used as shelving in prep and storage areas. They must be removed and replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor for cleaning access.

headline: No food handler certificates; no health policy
summary: License inspection failed. No food handler training certificates were available, and no written employee health policy was on site. Handwashing signs, a raw-food consumer advisory, and light bulb covers were also missing.

headline: Floor-stored food; leaking drain under sink
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Boxed food on the walk-in freezer floor must be raised six inches. A soap dispenser above the warewashing sink must be removed, and a small leak under that sink must be repaired. Staff belongings sat on prep surfaces.

headline: Two managers lack allergen training; old violations remain
summary: Canvass inspection failed. Two certified managers lacked allergen training certificates. Previously cited items remain uncorrected: missing handwashing sign, soap and towels at dump sink that must be removed, and no ice machine backflow device. Ice machine interior needs cleaning.

headline: Basement toilet and handsink not working
summary: Canvass inspection failed. The basement men's handsink and women's toilet were not working. The bamboo bar had no prep sink. The menu lacked a raw or undercooked food advisory, and allergen training proof was missing.

headline: Dirty unused coolers; some lights not working
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Interiors of unused reach-in coolers in the prep area were not clean and must be cleaned. Some ceiling bulbs above the Starbucks-area dish station were not working and must be replaced.

headline: Missing prep cooler thermometers; burnt-out hood light
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Prep coolers lacked equipment thermometers, and one ventilation hood light was burnt out. Both must be fixed.

headline: Food on floors; torn gaskets; expired allergen training
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Food boxes, onions and canned goods were stored on floors in the walk-in freezer, walk-in cooler and basement storage. A cooler's gaskets were torn. Employee bathroom needs a lidded trash can.

headline: Broken men's washroom part needs repair
summary: Re-inspection passed. A broken part in the men's washroom must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Dirty shelving and cooler floors
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Shelving inside the walk-in cooler was not clean. Floors inside the dairy, juicing and produce coolers were also not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Missing rear door sweep; cracked baseboard
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The rear exit door was missing its door sweep, which must be replaced to seal the door and prevent pest entry. A cracked baseboard behind the employee toilet room door needs repair.

headline: Ice bin lacks splash guard; allergen training missing
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The bar ice bin next to the handsink lacked protection and needs a splash guard. A basement three-compartment sink wasn't sealed to the wall and must be protected from spills. A certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Sanitizer test kit missing; most staff lack training
summary: Complaint inspection passed with conditions. Only two of nine employees had food handler training. A sanitizer test kit was delivered before inspection ended. A service sink must be installed.

headline: No cleanup kit, stem thermometer, or health policy
summary: Complaint inspection passed. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit was on site. No stem thermometer was available. Employee health policy must be on site at all times. The unisex restroom needs a covered waste receptacle.

headline: Mouse droppings and live flies; no pest log
summary: Complaint inspection failed. About 30 or more mouse droppings were found in rear storage, plus live small and large flies in dish and storage areas. Pest control service was recommended. Also missing sanitizer test kit and handwashing signs.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; dirty cooler gaskets
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Bulk dry goods (chiles) in the basement lacked labels, and food residue was in a cold-holding unit's gaskets in the front prep area. Manager was told to label containers and clean the unit.

headline: No certified manager on duty during TCS food prep
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. No person in charge was present. A certified manager was not on duty while TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. Ceiling fans were dusty, and managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Copy posted instead of original manager certificate
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. The on-duty certified manager's posted certificate was a copy. The original city food service sanitation certificate must be posted at all times.

headline: Missing handwashing sign and allergen training
summary: License re-inspection passed. No handwashing sign was at the front hand sink. Unused articles and equipment in the basement storage area should be removed to prevent pest harborage. Certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Missing test strips and food handler certificates
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. Dish machine test strips were missing; the manager bought chlorine test strips before inspection ended. Kitchen and bar staff lacked food handler certificates, and the food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: No certified manager on site during TCS prep
summary: Pass with conditions. The person in charge lacked a city sanitation certificate. No certified manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared. No health policy or food handler training proof was present. Some items were stored on floors.

headline: No hot water; missing soap; rear door gap
summary: License inspection failed. No hot water was found: sinks ranged from 83.5F to 90.3F, below required levels. Hand soap was missing at the prep sink. The rear door has a 1/4-inch gap that must be sealed to keep rodents out.

headline: Deep grooves on cutting board
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. A cutting board had deep grooves and must be repaired or replaced to be in good repair.

headline: Greasy floors under and behind cooking equipment
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Grease and dirt were on the floor under, around and behind cooking equipment. The floor must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Unlabeled rice container; expired allergen certificate
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The bulk rice container in the prep area must be labeled. A food handler needed required food handler training, and an allergen training certificate had expired.

headline: Stained cutting boards; missing food handler proof
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Stained cutting boards in the rear prep and dish area must be resurfaced or replaced. One food handler lacked a training certificate; management must show proof for all handlers.

headline: 80 lbs of cold food above 41F discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Cold TCS foods, including sliced cheese at 62F and roast beef at 46F, were above 41F. About 80 lbs, worth $500, was discarded. Missing food handler and allergen training proof was an uncorrected core violation.

headline: Bare-hand food handling; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Canvass inspection failed. A food handler chopped raw onions for guacamole, a ready-to-eat item; onions were discarded and a citation issued. The front bar dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer and was tagged. Outside grease waste area was not maintained.

headline: Food handlers lack certificates; inadequate prep lighting
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Food handlers had no certificates. The 3-compartment sink faucet leaked at its base, and the rear wall by the exit door has a large crack. Prep area lighting was inadequate. Hood filters were dusty.

headline: Fly traps above utensils; missing food handler certificates
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Fly traps were placed above clean utensils and must be kept away from open food and utensils. Employee food was stored beside customer food and must be separated. Several food handlers lacked certificates.

headline: Cold foods held at 49-52F; discarded
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. TCS foods were held at 49F-52F and must be kept at 41F or below. The manager discarded 1 lb sliced potatoes, 1/4 lb cooked Brussels sprouts, and 1/8 lb cut leafy greens. Manager's allergen training expired.

headline: Knives on drainboard; items on floor; dusty vents
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Knives were stored on the drainboard and need a proper holder. Some single-use items sat on the floor in rear storage. Washroom vents were dusty and water-damaged ceiling tiles sit above a prep table.

headline: Mouse droppings; no certified manager on site
summary: Complaint inspection failed. Over 30 mouse droppings were on front counter shelves; an exterminator was required. No certified food manager was on site while beef was prepared and served. Food handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: No accessible handsink in dish area; priority violation
summary: License inspection failed. The dish area lacked a convenient handwashing sink with hot and cold water, soap, and towels. The utility sink had no backflow device. A chest freezer sat on cardboard, and the microwave interior had food residue.

headline: No valid manager certificate; food handler proof missing
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed with conditions. No valid city food service sanitation certificate was posted for food employees; citation issued. No food handler certificates were on site. Food debris was on equipment and prep tables.

headline: Leaking sink faucet; greasy floors under fryers
summary: Canvass inspection passed. A two-door cooler gasket was loose and must be resealed. The three-compartment sink's left faucet leaked constantly. Floors under fryers and the sink's floor drain need cleaning, and vents need dusting.

headline: Loose handsink handle at bar area
summary: Canvass inspection passed. A handsink handle at the bar area was loose and must be repaired.

headline: Cold foods above 41F; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Canvass inspection failed. Cold TCS foods at 45F-49.6F were discarded; a prep cooler at 48.1F was tagged. The low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0.0 ppm and was tagged. No valid certified manager certificate was posted.

headline: Handsinks lack hot water; uncovered pastries discarded
summary: Canvass inspection failed. Handsinks in employee washrooms had no hot water (70.4F-77.0F), and two hand sinks had broken faucets with no water. About 8 lbs of uncovered pastries were discarded, valued at $300.

headline: Unlabeled flour and cornmeal; dirty wiping cloths
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Flour and cornmeal storage containers must show the common food name. Dirty wiping cloths were on prep tables and as liners. A two-door reach-in had torn gaskets, and pipes under a dish-area handsink leaked.

headline: Debris on ledges; damaged floor tiles
summary: License re-inspection passed. Debris was on window ledges and shelving units. Damaged floor tiles in sales and storage areas must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Cold foods above 41F; 15 lbs discarded
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. Chicken, cheese and eggs in service coolers were above safe cold temperatures, up to 51.9F. About 15 lbs, worth $50, was discarded. A prep-area cooler at 48.6F must not be used until it reaches 41F.

headline: Open dumpsters and overflowing trash bags
summary: Complaint inspection passed with conditions. Outside dumpster lids were wide open and trash bags were overflowing. Staff must keep lids closed and garbage contained so rodents cannot feed. Priority foundation violation noted.

headline: Leaking sinks; dirty floor drain and ceiling tiles
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The one-compartment sink in the rear leaked heavily from its base and sprayed water onto the floor. The three-compartment sink also leaked. Water-stained ceiling tiles above the toilet room door must be replaced.

headline: Plastic covering in walk-in; water-damaged tiles
summary: License inspection passed. Plastic shipping covering was on the walk-in cooler's interior and exterior and must be removed. Water-damaged, brown-stained ceiling tiles in the restroom must be replaced.

headline: Expired manager certificate; bartender handled garnish barehanded
summary: Complaint inspection failed. An expired manager certificate was posted; no valid one was on site. A bartender sliced limes with bare hands touching drink garnish; citation issued. Pink residue was found inside drink dispenser guns.

headline: Broken unused warmer near handsink
summary: Complaint inspection passed. A broken, unused warmer sat in the rear prep area near an exposed handsink. It must be repaired or removed.

headline: Dead roaches found; raw-food advisory missing
summary: Canvass inspection failed. Dead roaches were on the basement floor. Hand soap was missing at two handsinks. The menu lacked a raw or undercooked food advisory. No supplier statement confirmed sushi fish was frozen.

headline: Allergen training missing; rust in ice machine
summary: Canvass inspection failed. Staff toilet door was not self-closing, and a covered receptacle was missing in the women's restroom. Prior core violations remain: rust inside the ice machine and missing allergen training for certified managers.

headline: 30 lbs pork at 80.3F; discarded
summary: Complaint inspection failed. About 30 lbs of partially cooked pork rinds hung under the exhaust hood at 80.3F and were discarded. An expired certificate of analysis was found, and pork hung on frayed steel wire, which was removed.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; cluttered storage room
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Prep-area bulk containers lacked labels and must be labeled with contents. The basement storage room was cluttered, and items must be removed or raised off the floor.

headline: Display cooler failed; 75 lbs of food discarded
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. Deli meats, chicken and cheese in the front display cooler reached 46.7F-76.4F. About 75 lbs ($200) was discarded. The cooler, unable to hold 41F, is tagged out until a CDPH inspector rechecks it.

headline: No food handler certificates; hair restraints missing
summary: Canvass inspection passed. No food handler certificates were available, and the certified manager on duty lacked allergen training. Some staff in prep lacked hair restraints. Fryer interiors, freezer lower surfaces, and floor drains were dirty.

headline: Employee ate at prep table; moldy wood shelves
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. An employee ate and drank at a rear prep table. Moldy, water-damaged wood shelves by the bar must be removed. Prep-area wood floor is warping, and cooler interiors need cleaning.

headline: Dusty condenser; sink hot-water pedal stuck
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Dust built up on the first-floor walk-in cooler condenser and must be cleaned. The prep-area handwash sink by the three-compartment sink has a stuck hot-water pedal that must be repaired.

headline: Missing handwash signs and door closers
summary: License inspection passed. No handwashing signs were in toilet rooms or at sinks. Toilet room doors lacked self-closing devices. The women's toilet room needs a lidded trash receptacle.

headline: Tamale masa stored in printed plastic bags
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Prepared tamale masa was stored in printed plastic bags. Staff must use only food-grade plastic bags or containers. Hood filters had dust and grease build-up that must be cleaned.

headline: Mouse droppings under unused hot holding unit
summary: About 30–35 mouse droppings under unused hot holding unit; pest control needed; citation issued. Three handsinks lacked paper towels; manager provided them. Peeling paint in walk-in cooler and food handler certificates missing.

headline: Re-inspection: splash guard and cooler curtain
summary: Re-inspection passed. Splash guard needed on left basin of specialty cheese prep sink. Torn or missing cooler door curtain in walk-in must be replaced.

headline: No original sanitation certificate on site
summary: No person on site with an original City of Chicago sanitation certificate posted while TCS foods were handled. Citation issued. Toilet room door needs self-closing device. Dumpster area has leaves and debris.

headline: Rust in ice machine; clutter in neighboring space
summary: Rust on top interior of ice machine must be removed. Excessive trash in neighboring vacant space. Hole in office baseboard and hole at bottom of office restroom door must be sealed. Complaint re-inspection passed.

headline: Freezer floor debris and spills
summary: Food debris and spills on freezer floor. Person in charge instructed to increase cleaning frequency. This is the only item noted; inspection passed.

headline: Cold foods too warm; 15 lbs discarded
summary: Dressing cooler held turkey, ham, tuna, cheese, and other cold foods at 45.9°F, though cooler air was 41°F. Foods discarded, 15 lbs valued at $320. Light bulb end caps missing above meat slicer.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; citation issued
summary: Black slime inside ice machine was dripping into ice used for drinks. Citation issued; interior must be cleaned and sanitized. Food containers need common-name labels. Wiping cloth buckets needed at prep tables.

headline: Cold foods too warm; 135 lbs discarded
summary: Cooked beans, rice, and beef held above 41°F; 135 lbs discarded, valued at $250. Food on floors in walk-in and freezer. Foods held over 24 hours lacked discard dates. Torn cooler gasket; no paper towels at a handsink. Citation issued.

headline: No handwashing signs; cardboard on shelves
summary: No handwashing signs at restroom handsinks. Cardboard on prep area shelves must be removed. Women's restroom needs a covered waste receptacle. Dust on prep area ceiling vents needs cleaning.

headline: Moldy food, roaches, rat carcass; several citations
summary: Moldy chorizo and sausage in walk-in cooler discarded. Cooler at 49°F; chicken and beef too warm. Over 50 dead roaches, about 5 live roaches, and a decomposing rat found. Hand soap added on site; paper towels were missing.

headline: Low hot water; slimy ice machine; degreaser in sink
summary: Waitstaff handsink reached only 69°F hot water; 100°F required. Black and pink slime inside ice machine. Degreaser was hooked to dish sink chemicals; manager removed it. Citations issued for each violation.

headline: No food handler or allergen certificates on site
summary: No food handler training certificates on the premises. Manager must show approved food safety program proof or individual certificates. Certified managers also lack allergen training certificates on site.

headline: Hair restraint issue corrected on site
summary: Food handler was not wearing a hair restraint; corrected on site. Freezer interior, exterior of cooking equipment, fryer bottoms, and floors and walls around equipment need cleaning.

headline: Incomplete ingredient labels; restroom doors
summary: Ice cream and pie labels were incomplete; full ingredient labels required on all prepackaged foods. Customer and employee restroom doors lack self-closing devices. Inspection passed.

headline: Dust and grease buildup under equipment
summary: Dirt, dust, and debris under shelving and equipment in front and rear areas must be cleaned to prevent pests. Grease and dust under hood system need cleaning. No pests were found.

headline: Mouse droppings; undercooked food disclosure missing
summary: About 10 mouse droppings found; pest control service recommended. Undercooked animal-derived menu items lack asterisk and menu disclosure. Missing splash guard. Cardboard liner on prep table. No food handler training proof provided.

headline: Re-inspection: rice cooling, thermometers, door
summary: Bulk yellow rice was cooled at room temperature; food temperature was still acceptable. Missing air thermometers in walk-in and coolers. Front entrance has an opening; two sink stoppers missing; restroom door closer damaged.

headline: About 50 live roaches and mouse droppings
summary: About 50 live roaches and over 100 mouse droppings found in prep and dish areas. Beef at 56.8°F and other cold foods too warm; 13 lbs discarded. Cooler not maintaining proper temperature and must be repaired. Pest control required.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training proof
summary: A City of Chicago certified food manager has no allergen training certificate on file. Operator instructed to obtain it. This is the only item noted; inspection passed.

headline: Basement openings and clogged floor drains
summary: Openings in the basement could let pests in and must be sealed. Upstairs cooling unit beside handsink not working; repair or remove it. Standing water at drying rack. Floor drains clogged with food debris. Soda dispenser and cooler areas dirty.

headline: Cardboard trays and rusted fan guards
summary: Cardboard single-use trays stored facing up at cookline end must be inverted. Rusted fan guards in walk-in cooler must be cleaned. Inspection passed.

headline: No test strips for high-temp dish machine
summary: No test strips to check the 160°F final rinse on the high-temp dish machine. Citation issued. Outside dumpster missing lid; restroom trash receptacles lack lids. Slow drain in upstairs restroom sink and clutter in storage room.

headline: New cold prep area lacks handwashing sink
summary: New cold prep and cold plate area has no handwashing sink. A sink with hot and cold running water, soap, and towels must be installed. Priority foundation violation. Inspection failed.

headline: Front door gap and dirty floors
summary: Front double doors have a 1/4-inch gap and must be rodent-proofed. Dirt and debris under reach-in coolers, in corners, and under heavy equipment. Clutter in side storage area. No pests were found.

headline: Dirty unused restroom; manager allergen training
summary: Unused upstairs toilet room covered in dirt and grime; must be cleaned and marked out of order. One certified manager lacks allergen training. Records must be kept on site.

headline: Debris in deep freezer; floors need cleaning
summary: Debris on the sides and bottom of the deep freezer must be cleaned. Floors along wall bases and in corners need cleaning, including under the self-serve pop station. No pests noted.

headline: No paper towels at handsinks; allergen training
summary: No paper towels at front prep, kitchen prep, or handsinks. Food handler obtained towels during inspection. Priority citation issued. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: No certified manager; blocked handsinks; old food
summary: No City certified manager on site while TCS foods were prepped; manager arrived 1:25 PM. Handsinks blocked by a pot and dish rack. Cooked wings and cheese curd kept past discard dates; 23 lbs discarded, valued at $320.

headline: Ice bin buildup; leaking 3-compartment faucet
summary: Mineral buildup in ice bin; cleaning needed. Grease and food debris behind cooking line and inside reach-ins, including dried blood. 3-compartment faucet base is leaking heavily. Aluminum foil used as shelf liner; wiping cloth buckets needed.

headline: No certified manager; no thermometer
summary: No certified food service manager on site while chicken and soup were handled. No thermometer in main prep refrigerator. Salt container unlabeled. Wall behind rear prep table not smooth. Manager needs allergen training certificate.

headline: Restroom handsink not working; allergen training
summary: Metered handsink in women's customer restroom not working; a new battery or repair is needed. No allergen training for certified food managers; certificates must be kept on site.

headline: No certified manager; expired and undated foods
summary: No certified food service manager on site while beef and chicken were handled. Vacuum-packed fish dated 2023 and other sealed foods lacked discard dates. HACCP plan not followed; $200 of food discarded.

headline: Live roaches, rat and mouse droppings; citation
summary: 6–8 live roaches in basement; 20 rat droppings in basement; 40+ mouse droppings in kitchen prep area and inside hot holding unit. Pest control required before reinspection next week. Grocery bags used for food storage. Priority citation issued.

headline: Sushi and shrimp held too warm
summary: Sushi at 46–57°F and shrimp at 46°F inside prep coolers. Management instructed to keep all cold TCS foods at 41°F or below. Citation issued. Passed with conditions.

headline: Re-inspection: thermometer, hair restraints, cloths
summary: Re-inspection passed with corrections required. No visible working thermometer in front prep cooler. Employees not wearing hair restraints. Wiping cloths stored on prep tables instead of in sanitizer.

headline: Cracked light shields in prep area
summary: Cracked light shields in the food prep area must be replaced. This is the only item noted in this inspection.

headline: Tomatoes too warm; leaking drain pipe
summary: Diced tomatoes at 49°F were discarded, 2 lbs valued at $10. Leaking drain pipe on rinse sink next to dish machine must be repaired. Non-working walk-in freezer light. Passed with conditions.

headline: Menu lacks undercooked food disclosure
summary: Menu lacks required reminder statement for undercooked food. No backflow prevention device found on ice machine waterline; device must be installed where it can be serviced. No citation issued for the menu item.

headline: Re-inspection: wet mop hanging system needed
summary: Re-inspection passed. The only item noted: a hook system is needed to hang wet mops to dry.

headline: No certified manager during egg prep
summary: No certified manager on site while eggs were prepared; citation issued. An employee holding a valid certificate must be on site at all times. No handwashing signage at exposed handsink on service line.

headline: Food labels and debris under coolers
summary: Food storage containers need labels when food is not in the original package. Dirt and food debris under and around refrigeration units in rear storage area must be cleaned. Inspection passed.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure; no cooler thermometer
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure with spill kit found. No hanging thermometer inside reach-in cooler. Both must be provided. No citation issued for the cleanup procedure.

headline: Blocked handsink and wastewater backup
summary: Handwashing sink next to prep and stove was blocked by a water jar and serving tongs. Wastewater backs up from the 3-compartment sink. Food stored on floors and unlabeled. Citations issued. Several general upkeep issues.

headline: Re-inspection: expired food and allergen certificates
summary: Re-inspection passed. Basement dish area needs handwashing sign. Expired food handler and allergen training certificates must be replaced with current ones for current employees and managers.

headline: Moldy ice machine; cold food too warm
summary: Black mold-like substance inside large ice machine; ice destroyed and machine cleaned. Cold foods at 48.9–57.8°F discarded, 28 lbs, valued at $243. Leaking handsink and 3-compartment faucets. No prep sink in small bar.

headline: Missing thermometers, wiping cloths, rear door gap
summary: Thermometers missing in produce and 3-door cooler. Rear exit door gap is over 1/4 inch. Soiled wiping cloths left on prep tables. Torn freezer gaskets. Four food employees lack food handler certificates.

headline: Rear door gap; greasy fryer compartment
summary: Rear door has a 1/4-inch gap; door sweep required. Encrusted grease under fryer must be deep cleaned. Kitchen handsink drains slowly and its cold-water handle is hard to turn. Inspection passed.

headline: Hole in wall; no food handler certificates
summary: Hole in wall under the 3-compartment sink must be covered. No food handler certificates on premises. All food handlers must be certified with employee names on file.

headline: No certified manager; 80+ rat droppings
summary: No certified manager on site during food prep. Over 80 rat droppings in prep, dish, and storage areas; exterminator needed. Chicken at 56.2°F; coolers at 53–60°F, tagged and held. Hair restraints missing; toilet not flushing.

headline: No certified manager at start; home food discarded
summary: No certified manager on duty at start of inspection; manager arrived about 9:15 AM. Home-prepared turkey chili and chicken soup were found and discarded. Missing thermometer and sanitizer test strips. One employee has no food handler certificate.

headline: Handsink water too hot; light shields missing
summary: Restroom and prep handsinks measured 138–156°F, but 100–120°F is required. Exposed prep sink had cold water only. Missing light shields above prep area and in front of ice machine. Repeat violation; citation issued.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; flies; unsafe cooling
summary: Dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine; tagged, citation issued. 16 lbs shrimp tempura at 60.2°F discarded, valued at $100. 20 fruit flies and 5 house flies by dishwashing area. Bulk food unlabeled; hair restraints missing.

headline: Missing sanitizer, vomit kit, hot water, thermometer
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup equipment, no chlorine or quat sanitizer, and no metal stem thermometer on site. Front prep handsink not connected to plumbing. Leaking 3-compartment sink. Outdoor waste receptacle missing. Priority violations.

headline: Leak under customer-area handsink
summary: Pipe leaks under the exposed handsink in the customer service area. Operator instructed to repair the leak. This is the only item noted; inspection passed.

headline: Hair restraint missing; dirty floors and dumpster
summary: Food handler not wearing a hair restraint. Items stored on pop crates instead of shelves. Coffee station counter dirty. Trash and debris around outside dumpster. Floors dirty in corners and under storage racks and heavy equipment.

headline: Re-inspection: remove old equipment, clean vent
summary: Re-inspection passed. Old, unused equipment and supplies in rear must be removed. Dirt and debris buildup on restroom exhaust vent must be cleaned.

headline: Re-inspection: signage, floors, allergen training
summary: Re-inspection passed. No handwashing sign at dishwashing handsink. Floors in dry storage not clean and have food debris. Sanitation manager has no allergen training.

headline: Re-inspection: front door opening, splash guard
summary: Re-inspection passed. Opening at base of front entrance door must be sealed. Left splash guard needed on prep handsink. Hole in ceiling above front prep handsink must be repaired.

headline: Re-inspection: rear door gap, food elevation
summary: Re-inspection passed. Gap in right corner of rear door must be made tight-fitting. Walk-in cooler food must be elevated six inches off the floor.

headline: Rodent droppings, no certified manager, warm cooler
summary: No certified food manager on duty. About 50 mouse and 20 rat droppings found; more pest control needed. Prep cooler at 55°F; 10 lbs of food discarded. Hand soap and paper towels were missing; soap and towels were added during inspection.

headline: Re-inspection: pitted cutting boards
summary: Re-inspection passed. Cutting board surfaces are pitted and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Water inlet unprotected; lock provided on site
summary: Fresh water inlet door could not lock, so the inlet was not protected. Manager provided a lock before the inspection ended. Priority violation issued. Passed with conditions.

headline: Re-inspection: boards, thermometers, labels, pests
summary: Stained cutting boards with dark grooves must be replaced. Some coolers lack thermometers. Basement dry storage containers unlabeled. Front windows lack protection against pests. Some handlers and sanitation managers lack training certificates.

headline: Cheese too warm; door gasket torn
summary: Cheese at 45°F in prep cooler, though cooler air was 36°F. 25 lbs cheese discarded, valued at $75. Rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap. Cold drinks cooler door gasket is torn. Passed with conditions.

headline: Greasy fryers and floors need cleaning
summary: Exterior of fryers, wok area, and garbage containers need cleaning. Floors and walls under and behind kitchen equipment and inside walk-in cooler need cleaning. Unused items in storage should be removed. No pests noted.

headline: No certified manager; food on floors; flies
summary: No valid certified person in charge while food was prepared. Fly strips hung in prep area. Food stored on floors. Missing food handler training. Ice machine residue, oversized equipment, no test kit, and an overflowing dumpster were also noted.

headline: Leaking faucet; cracked light covers
summary: 3-compartment sink faucet leaks at base and must be repaired. Two cracked light bulb covers above dish area must be replaced. One expired food allergen training certificate must be updated. Passed.

headline: Food on floors; milk crates as shelves
summary: Food containers stored on the floor of the walk-in cooler. Milk crates used as shelving in prep and storage areas. Loose debris, dirt, and dust on floors and in corners. Food must be raised six inches; floor cleaning must increase.

headline: Clean the two-door freezer interior
summary: The interior of the 2-door freezer must be cleaned. This is the only item noted. Inspection passed.

headline: Vomit kit, handsinks, and cold food issues
summary: Vomit and diarrhea kit lacked sanitizer effective against norovirus; citation issued. Basement handsink lacked hot water and was fixed during inspection. Handsink used as dish sink. Cold foods at 46–49°F discarded, 15 lbs.

headline: Missing thermometer; loose faucet; dusty equipment
summary: No thermometer in lower reach-in beside freezer. Loose faucet in secondary restroom must be repaired. Light dust and debris under and around front food service equipment must be cleaned. Inspection passed.

headline: Water and fire damage; burned ceiling tiles
summary: Water and fire damage to paper goods, shelving, freezers, and refrigerator. Black soot inside ice machine. Smoky, burned, and missing ceiling tiles; water dripping into serving area. Dirty washroom vent. No allergen certificates posted.

headline: Front door gap, missing certificates, pot sizing issue
summary: Open gap at bottom of front door lets pests in. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer. Large pots do not fit the 3-compartment sink. Expired food handler certificates found. Women's restroom ventilation not working; dusty ceiling above cook line.

headline: Dirty kitchen walls, floors, and hood edges
summary: Kitchen walls have dirt and dried food splatter. Floor under and behind dishwasher and equipment needs cleaning. Grease buildup on hood edges needs cleaning. Cleaning instructed to prevent pests. Inspection passed.

headline: Dead insects in furnace room; cups used as scoops
summary: Dead insects in furnace room to be removed and kept clean. Cups used as scoops in bulk dry storage must be replaced with handled utensils. Ceramic cups need lead-safe documentation or must be removed.

headline: Dirty hood filters; hole below dish machine
summary: Hood filters on lower level are dirty. Restroom door bottom is rotten. Large hole in wall below dish machine must be covered to prevent pest harborage. Complaint inspection passed.

headline: Non-cleanable ceiling; grease container problems
summary: Ceiling above two walk-in coolers is not smooth or cleanable. Grease container lid is ill-fitting and in poor repair. Grease container causes odor and must be moved to the alley. Inspection passed.

headline: Repeat fly violation; hair restraints; clutter
summary: Prior report noted about 50 small flies, not corrected; now a priority violation. Ice bin not clean. Plastic bags used as sink stoppers. Deep cuts in cutting boards. Basement clutter and grease under fryers. Hair restraints missing.

headline: Mouse droppings and dead mice in dining cabinet
summary: About 20 mouse droppings and three dead mice inside a dining room cabinet between fountain machines; pest control recommended; citation issued. Openings at both entrance doors. Stacked buns on freezer floor.

headline: Repairs needed: door gap, leaks, dirty surfaces
summary: Rear door has gaps and a broken freezer hinge. Broken hand dryer and soap dispenser, leaky faucet, and leaky toilet need repair. Dumpster area and walls, ceilings, and floors need cleaning. No pests recorded.

headline: Front door gap; hood lights out; expired certificate
summary: Quarter-inch gap between front double doors and sweeps must be sealed. Ventilation hood light bulbs not working. Cracked ceiling light covers above prep area. Food allergen training certificate has expired.

headline: Mouse droppings; egg rolls held too warm
summary: About 50 mouse droppings in dry storage and under the 3-compartment sink; pest control recommended. Back door has a one-inch gap. 20 lbs of egg rolls at 54.4°F left on counter; discarded, valued at $30.

headline: Dishwasher not sanitizing; tagged out of use
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had no sanitizer at final rinse. Unit tagged and must not be used until repaired and re-inspected. Citation issued. Dirt and debris under prep tables and dishwashing area need cleaning.

headline: Missing signs, labels, dust, and poor lighting
summary: Handwashing sign missing near front prep sink. Food storage containers need labels. Dust and dirt on floor drains in prep and dish areas. Inadequate lighting in rear prep and dish areas. No pests noted.

headline: Dead and live roaches; additional pest control needed
summary: Several dead roaches in glue traps, ledges, and inside the oven. Two live roaches seen in the middle of the kitchen. Pest control service needed; citation issued. Also: greasy fryers, slow handsink drain, and dirty floors.

headline: Over 20 rat droppings; summary report not posted
summary: Over 20 rat droppings found throughout, including near the front door and rear corner. Must remove evidence and sanitize; citation issued. Missing ceiling tile. Public summary report from 2021 not posted; citation issued.

headline: Re-inspection failed: shelving, cleaning, training
summary: Milk crates used as shelving. Spills and debris on coolers, freezers, and floors. No food handler or allergen training. Earlier violations not corrected: menu advisory and dish machine test kit still missing. Citation issued.

headline: Rusty basement prep table
summary: Basement prep table near sink has rust. Person in charge must remove rust and keep surface smooth and cleanable. This is the only item noted; inspection passed.

headline: Rear door gap; cluttered basement; dirty equipment
summary: Quarter-inch gap at rear exit door sweep must be rodent-proofed. Ice machine buildup, bar gun holders, fryer interior, and cooler exteriors need cleaning. Basement cluttered; one prep area light bulb out.

headline: 3-compartment sink missing stoppers
summary: The 3-compartment sink has no stoppers, which are needed for proper utensil washing. Operator instructed to obtain them. This is the only item noted.

headline: Drink nozzles and cooking equipment need cleaning
summary: Drink nozzles need detail cleaning. Sides of cooking equipment need cleaning. Restrooms need detail cleaning. Unnecessary clutter in rear area must be removed. Short complaint inspection passed.

headline: Handsinks lack hot water; leaking drain
summary: Restroom and raw chicken room handsinks lacked hot water; readings were 69–70°F, but 100°F is required. Missing handwashing signs in unisex restroom. Meat department 3-compartment sink leaks from its drain pipe. Citation issued.

headline: Restroom sinks lack hot water; dead flies
summary: Customer restroom sinks had no hot water; temperatures ranged 72.9–90.4°F, but 100°F is required. Very low water pressure. Employees in prep area without hair restraints. Dead small flies and dirt on rear prep ceiling.

headline: Re-inspection: door gap, gasket, backflow device
summary: Re-inspection: opening at base of rear door to dumpster area must be sealed. Damaged gasket on cold holding unit. No backflow device found on utility sink. Peeling paint and uneven wall near handsink must be repaired.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving in cooler
summary: Milk crates are being used as shelves in the walk-in cooler. Operator instructed to use proper shelving and maintain it. This is the only item noted; inspection passed.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food handling
summary: No valid certified manager on duty while chicken, eggs, and hamburgers were handled. Citation issued; more will follow if repeated. Dishwashing handsink leaks at faucet base. Floors in prep and walk-in cooler dirty.

headline: Unlabeled dry goods and greasy fryer area
summary: Rice, flour, and spices stored in unlabeled containers by the wok station. Cutting boards have open seams and dark stains. Grease buildup inside fryer cabinet and on cooking equipment. Corrective instructions given. No pests or temperature problems noted.

headline: Menu disclosure and repeat violations
summary: Menu lacks full undercooked food advisory. Wiping cloths stored on sinks and prep tables. Water-damaged ceiling tiles and ice buildup in prep freezer. Repeat violations: unsealed wood counter, peeling paint, dirty floors, weak rear light. Missing training.

headline: Pasta drained in utility sink; training missing
summary: Pasta drained in utility sink meant for wastewater only. Missing handwashing sign in front restroom. Single-use items stored on floor. No hair restraint and no valid food handler training. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Live dog inside; door gaps; broken surfaces
summary: Customer with a live dog inside; management did not address it; citation issued. Gaps at entry and rear doors need sealing. Repackaged food on display unlabeled. Broken floor, wall, and ceiling areas. Food handler training missing.

headline: Passed with conditions; no health policy; missing covers
summary: Passed with conditions. No verifiable employee health policy was on site. Loose cooler gasket, loose toilet room sink base, and no lidded trash in the unisex restroom were noted. A certified manager had no allergen training certificate.

headline: Passed; leaking drainpipe and heavy grease
summary: Passed. A drainpipe leaks under the bar three-compartment sink. Grease, food debris, and dirt were found on floors and walls in prep, dish, and storage areas. A 1/4-inch gap under the rear exit door must be sealed to keep pests out.

headline: Passed with conditions; no health policy or spill kit
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy was on site, and no vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit or written procedure was available. Thermometers are needed inside all reach-in coolers.

headline: Passed re-inspection; expired food handler certificates
summary: Passed re-inspection. Employees in the food prep area were not wearing hair restraints. Food handler and allergen certificates on site were expired and must be renewed. Also noted: a broken stopper, a missing trash lid, and wall openings.

headline: Mouse droppings found; no hand sink in prep area
summary: Inspector found about 20-30 mouse droppings at the cashier station, washroom, and dish area. The cook line has no hand sink with hot and cold water, soap, and towels. Also noted: a dirty stove, damaged walls and floors, and items stored on the floor.

headline: Passed; no backflow device; no covered trash can
