summary: Passed. No backflow prevention device was present for the rear prep area ice machine. The women's restroom needs a covered trash receptacle. A certified food service manager lacked allergen awareness training.

headline: Passed; no allergen certificate posted
summary: Passed. No hand-wash signage was posted at the meat prep hand sink. Food was stored on the walk-in cooler floor, and cardboard was used as floor matting in the bakery. A broken faucet at the sandwich prep hand sink must be replaced.

headline: Failed; about 50 live flies; syrup spill
summary: Failed. About 50 live small flies were found in the basement washroom, hallway, server station, and first floor washroom. Additional pest control service was required. Also noted: torn cooler gasket, low water pressure and slow drain, spilled syrup, and a burnt-out hood light.

headline: Passed with conditions; ice machine slime; no certified manager
summary: Passed with conditions. No Chicago-certified manager was on site while milk, eggs, and sausage were prepared. Ice machine had black slime dripping onto ice; the manager must clean it. Also noted: wet wiping cloths, sticky floors, missing ceiling tiles, and no allergen proof.

headline: Failed; no pest control logbook on site
summary: Failed. No pest control logbook was on the premises, and the manager must provide one by the reinspection date. Also noted: ice machine buildup, no covered trash cans in washrooms, and dirty floors under the soda machine and sink.

headline: Failed; cold food too warm; 30 lbs discarded
summary: Failed. Hot dogs, luncheon meat, and milk in the front prep cold holding unit measured 60-60.3F. About 30 lbs ($500) was discarded. The display cooler at 60F must not be used until reinspected. No chemical test kit for sanitizer was available.

headline: Passed with conditions; cooler too warm; gaps
summary: Passed with conditions. A small two-door refrigerator in the front prep area measured 49.1F and was tagged held for inspection. Openings at dock doors and an exit door need sealing, and missing hand-wash signs were noted.

headline: Passed with conditions; no person in charge or certified manager
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge was present during the inspection. No certified food manager was on duty while sandwiches and chicken were prepared and served. A citation was issued.

headline: Passed; cardboard lining and cutting boards
summary: Passed. Cardboard boxes were used to line cart shelves and must be removed. Cutting boards with open seams and dark stains must be refinished or replaced. A burned-out light above the front counter needs replacing.

headline: Failed; no food handler or allergen proof on file
summary: Failed. No proof of food handler training or allergen training was available for required employees and certified managers. Also noted: missing floor tiles, leaking hand sink, boxed food stored on floors, a missing hood filter, and no internal thermometer in the cooler.

headline: Failed; no certified manager during ready-to-eat food prep
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on duty while ready-to-eat TCS foods were prepared. No food handler training was shown. Hand sink lacked cold water. Missing labels, gaps in door, and trash on the ground were also noted.

headline: Passed; grease and debris near cooking equipment
summary: Passed. Grease and debris were found on floors under and around cooking equipment, and the grease trap was dirty. The bar counter needs cleaning, and the vent and filters above cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Passed; improper thawing of frozen chicken
summary: Passed. Frozen chicken was thawed improperly; staff were told to thaw it overnight in refrigeration or under cold running water. Frozen meat must be stored in food-grade bags or containers. Peeling paint hung from the ceiling near the rear prep table.

headline: Passed with conditions; hot food below safe temperature
summary: Passed with conditions. Sirloin steak measured 120-126F on the hot holding table, and cooked chicken measured 122-131F; the required minimum is 135F. About 5 lbs ($15) was discarded voluntarily. A citation was issued.

headline: Passed; dirty surfaces and cutting boards need cleaning
summary: Passed inspection. Inspector asked for deeply grooved cutting boards to be replaced or replaned, mold-like buildup in walk-in cooler shelving to be cleaned, and soda machine residue and grime on floors to be cleaned.

headline: Passed; ice scoops stored in ice machine
summary: Passed. Ice scoops were stored inside the ice machine and must be kept in a clean container. Some items were stored on the floor in the rear food storage area and must be elevated. Dust on ceiling vents and grout repair are needed.

headline: Passed; no hand-wash signs; hood not working
summary: Passed. No hand-washing signs were posted at the prep sink. Sink compartments were not labeled. Toilet doors are not self-closing, the walk-in cooler light is insufficient, and the hood was not operating. No allergen certificate was on site.

headline: Failed; missing thermometer, labels, and allergen proof
summary: Failed. Cooler lacked a working thermometer, storage containers were unlabeled, and an employee was not wearing a hair restraint. No allergen training proof was shown. Also noted: clutter that could attract rodents, dusty vents, and a missing backflow device on the espresso machine.

headline: Passed; missing hand-washing sign and clutter
summary: Passed. No hand-washing sign was posted by the bar sink. The employee restroom needs a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. Equipment and unused items on storage room floors and by the back door must be elevated or removed.

headline: Passed; no splash guard at coffee hand sink
summary: Passed. No splash guard was present at the hand sink by the front coffee station. The facility was told to install a durable splash guard.

headline: Failed; no employee health policy; food not dated
summary: Failed. No employee health policy or training was found on site, and a citation was issued. Ready-to-eat foods stored over 24 hours were not dated; about 50 lbs ($250) was discarded. Missing consumer advisory on raw foods, expired food handler certificates, and grease buildup were also noted.

headline: Passed with conditions; no vomit cleanup kit or procedure
summary: Passed with conditions. No bodily fluid spill kit or written cleanup procedure was on site, and a citation was issued. Single-service boxes were stored on the floor. Heavy grease and ice buildup in freezer and fryers need cleaning.

headline: Failed; rodent droppings and entry gap at door
summary: Failed. At least 20 rodent droppings were found in the rear dishwashing area and on shelves behind the front counter. Front entrance door was not fully rodent-proofed on the right side. Shelves and walk-in floors need cleaning.

headline: Passed; uncovered thermometer needed in milk fridge
summary: Passed. A visible, working thermometer is needed in the upright milk refrigerator in the rear dining area and must be maintained.

headline: Passed; leaking faucet and rusted grease trap
summary: Passed. A three-compartment sink faucet leaks, and the kitchen grease trap is rusted and leaking. Cutting boards have dark stains and deep cuts. Ice buildup in a basement freezer and an expired allergen certificate were also noted.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager; no allergen proof
summary: Passed with conditions. No Chicago-certified food manager was on site while chicken, eggs, and milk were prepared. No food handler training certificate was shown, and a prior allergen violation was not corrected. Citation issued.

headline: Passed re-inspection; missing sign and ceiling tile
summary: Passed re-inspection. Hand-wash signage was missing at hand sinks. Multi-use utensils and plates were not inverted during storage. A missing ceiling tile near the basement ice machine must be replaced.

headline: Passed; front door gap and dead insects on floor
summary: Passed. A gap about 1/4 inch under the front door was found, and the facility was told to cover it to prevent pests. Dust, debris, and dead insects were noted on the floor by the refrigerator, which needs detail cleaning.

headline: Passed; exposed wiring and broken stove stored
summary: Passed. The women's washroom door lacks a self-closing device. An opening in the wall with exposed electrical wiring near the exhaust hood must be sealed. An unused broken stove stored near the side door must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Passed; dusty cooler and food-debris hood
summary: Passed. Dust had built up inside the kimchi cooler around the fan and must be cleaned. Accumulated food debris on the ventilation hood must also be cleaned.

headline: Failed; about 50 mouse droppings behind bar
summary: Failed. About 50 mouse droppings were found around the bar perimeter, behind equipment, and in corners. No hand sink was available in the rear prep area used for breakfast foods. Ice machine components were rusted, and grease trap overflowed onto the floor.

headline: Passed; unshielded waste pipes and foil shelf liners
summary: Passed. Overhead waste pipes in the basement food storage area were not shielded and must be enclosed. Foil was used as shelf liner and must be removed. A hand sink in the warewashing area drains slowly and needs repair.

headline: Failed; no certified person in charge; no vomit kit
summary: Failed. No person in charge held a valid Chicago food sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was on site while ground beef was prepared and served. Cleanup supplies were missing. Also noted: a 1/4-inch gap under the front door, no sanitizer test kit, and missing thermometers.

headline: Failed; no certified food manager on site
summary: Failed. No Chicago-certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared and served. Staff lacked hair restraints. Allergen certificate was expired. Core violations from a prior report were not corrected, including grease buildup and unlabeled containers.

headline: Passed re-inspection; rusty shelving and hood grease
summary: Passed re-inspection. Chipped paint and rust were found on wire shelving in the walk-in cooler and must be repainted or replaced. Kitchen exhaust hood and filters need detail cleaning to remove grease.

headline: Passed; leaking faucet and missing hand-wash signs
summary: Passed. Hand-washing signs were missing at the front coffee hand sink. A leaking faucet was found at the rear three-compartment sink. Non-functioning microwave and ice cream freezer needed repair or removal. Drink nozzles had soil on them.

headline: Passed re-inspection; grease, debris, and open wall holes
summary: Passed re-inspection. Grease spills were on the exterior of fryers, and food debris was on floors under cooking equipment. Three large openings under the three-compartment sink must be sealed to keep pests out. Several burnt-out hood lights and a missing light cover were noted.

headline: Passed; caulking and drain line need fixing
summary: Passed. Worn caulking between the three-compartment sink and wall must be replaced. A hot water machine drain line was emptying into a hand sink and must be rerouted to a floor drain.

headline: Passed; ice buildup in basement freezers
summary: Passed. Ice had built up in basement box freezers and must be defrosted. A slight leak at the three-compartment sink faucet and low water pressure in the customer restroom sink need correction. Food debris in the microwave and dust on vents were noted.

headline: Failed; no sanitizer; customers entering prep area
summary: Failed. No chemical sanitizer was on the premises, and sanitizer must be available at all hours. Two reach-in units held food at 61.7-66.4F; these were tagged held for inspection and corrected on site. No barrier kept customers out of the food prep area.

headline: Failed; dead cockroaches; no pest control logbook
summary: Failed. Six dead cockroaches were found on the upper shelf in the dining area and must be removed. No pest control logbook with service reports was maintained. Frozen beef was thawed on a prep table, and grease and debris buildup needed cleaning.

headline: Passed; no certified manager has allergen training
summary: Passed re-inspection. No certified food manager had allergen training at the visit. Staff were told to complete the training, and the facility must provide proof of it.

headline: Passed; no hot holding thermometer; floors dirty
summary: Passed. The hot holding unit had no thermometer. A wall opening under the three-compartment sink and damaged coving around the washroom vanity need repair. Floors under and behind equipment were unclean.

headline: Passed; 1/2-inch gap at entrance door
summary: Passed. A 1/2-inch opening under the entrance door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Hand-washing signs were missing, a thermometer was needed in the milk cooler, and a torn cooler gasket and excessive freezer ice were noted.

headline: Failed re-inspection; no certified manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No Chicago-certified manager was present at the first visit while TCS foods were served; the manager arrived about 20 minutes later. Door gap, greasy floors, food-splattered walls, and a manager lacking allergen training were noted.

headline: Passed; food stored on floor; sign installed
summary: Passed. Food containers were stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer and must be elevated at least six inches. A missing hand-wash sign at the front kitchen sink was installed by the manager during inspection.

headline: Passed; hair restraints not worn; ice bin dirty
summary: Passed. Several food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Ice bin guard had dirt and must be detail cleaned. Rusted storage racks in walk-in cooler and freezer and food debris on walk-in floors were noted.

headline: Failed; dishwasher final rinse too hot; live dog inside
summary: Failed. The high-temperature dishwasher final rinse measured 205F; it must be 180-194F. A customer with a live dog entered and ordered; the employee did not ask the required service-animal question, and the customer left. Dishwasher residue also noted.

headline: Passed; wet wiping cloths left on prep tables
summary: Passed. Wet wiping cloths were stored on prep tables. Staff were told to keep them in sanitizer when not in use. The top of the outside grease dumpster must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; hand-washing sign missing
summary: Passed. No hand-washing sign was posted at the hand sink. The facility was told to post one and keep it in place.

headline: Dishwasher glove misuse; cold food above safe temperature
summary: Dishwasher touched his hair with gloves on, then handled clean utensils without washing hands. Prep cooler held cold food at 45-57F; food above 41F was discarded (about 16.5 lbs). Hand sinks lacked soap and dryers at times.

headline: Passed; gas stoves lack proper ventilation
summary: Passed. Three one-burner gas stoves in the front prep area are not under a ventilation hood, and four in the rear have no proper commercial ventilation. Each must be fully ventilated or removed from the premises.

headline: Failed; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Failed. Milk crates were used as shelving in prep areas and coolers and must be replaced with proper shelving at least 6 inches off the floor. Broken ceiling tiles were noted. Prior core violations were not corrected, including unlabeled bulk containers and greasy fryers.

headline: Dishwasher not sanitizing; use stopped until fixed
summary: Passed with conditions. The low-temperature dishwasher had no chlorine sanitizer (0 ppm; 50 ppm required). Staff were told not to use it until fixed; the manager called maintenance right away. Milk crates and torn cooler gasket also noted.

headline: Passed; missing hand-wash sign and leaking sink
summary: Passed. No hand-washing sign was posted at the sandwich line hand sink, and no splash guard was installed there. A slow-draining and leaking drain pipe at the rear dish hand sink must be repaired.

headline: Failed re-inspection; hot water too cool at sinks
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were prepared, and the manager lacked a certificate. Hand sinks measured 69-94F; hot water must reach 100F. Food boxes on the freezer floor, worn gaskets, and missing light cover were also noted.

headline: Passed; milk crates used for storage; training needed
summary: Passed. Milk crates were used for elevating stored items and must be replaced with raised shelves. Staff washrooms lacked self-closing doors. Additional food handler and allergen training certificates are required on site.

headline: Passed re-inspection; missing covered trash can
summary: Passed re-inspection. The unisex employee washroom had no covered waste receptacle. The facility must provide one and keep it maintained.

headline: Failed; unsafe cold food, rodent droppings, and flies
summary: Failed. Potato salad was at 56-62F and eggs and milk at 50F; the manager discarded food voluntarily. About 40 large rodent droppings and about 15 large live flies were found, plus flies in the toilet room and office. Rear door has a gap.

headline: Failed; dirty ice machine dripping onto ice
summary: Failed. Black dirt buildup inside the ice machine was dripping into ice for human use; all ice was discarded voluntarily. Food debris on the dish machine, and grease and food buildup on walls, also need cleaning.

headline: Passed re-inspection; grime on equipment
summary: Passed re-inspection. A large can opener needed detail cleaning. Prep table wheels had buildup and needed cleaning. A sticky pop gun at the front bar was noted for cleaning.

headline: Passed; no covered sanitary napkin bin
summary: Passed. The all-gender washroom had no covered receptacle for sanitary napkins and must provide one. A sanitation manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No Chicago-certified food manager was on site while pizza, pasta, and chicken were prepared and served. A citation was issued, and a certified manager must be present whenever TCS foods are prepared.

headline: Passed; gap at back door and leaking drainpipe
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap was found at the bottom of the rear exit door and must be sealed to keep pests out. A drainpipe under the basement hand sink leaks. The all-gender washroom needs a lidded receptacle for sanitary napkins.

headline: Passed; missing covered receptacle; expired certificates
summary: Passed. Soap dispenser was mounted over the two-compartment sink and must be moved. Expired food handler and allergen certificates were shown for some employees. Damaged basement ceiling tiles, peeling paint, and missing light shields were noted.

headline: Passed re-inspection; openings at back doors
summary: Passed re-inspection. Openings at the base of the double rear exit doors must be sealed to prevent pests. The rooftop dish machine lacks a data plate, and backflow devices must be installed on espresso machines.

headline: Passed; water dripping from ceiling pipes
summary: Passed. Water was dripping from pipes above the dishwashing area. Management was told to repair the source of the leak.

headline: Passed; missing ceiling tiles in lower prep area
summary: Passed. Missing ceiling tiles were found in the lower-level prep area and must be replaced.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager on premises
summary: Passed with conditions. No Chicago-certified food manager was on premises while TCS foods such as goat and chicken were prepared. No food handler or allergen training certificates were on premises. Bar sink drain leaks, and the hood and filters are greasy.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk containers and dirty hood
summary: Passed. Bulk containers of rice, tea, and sugar in the rear dry storage area had no labels. Plates in the front prep area were not inverted. The hood and filters above cooking equipment need detail cleaning.

headline: Passed; no splash guard at prep hand sink
summary: Passed. No splash guard was installed at the prep area hand sink. The facility must install and maintain one.

headline: Failed; about 200-250 rodent droppings found
summary: Failed. About 200-250 small rodent droppings were found in the stockroom, under shelving, and in the front window area, and the inspector saw pest infestation. Prior violation not corrected. Also noted: missing thermometers, dirty restrooms, and trash under shelving.

headline: No employee health policy; food handler certificates missing
summary: No verified employee health policy was available, so staff may not know to report illness. Some food handlers lacked training certificates, and one certified manager lacked allergen training. Also noted: rusty shelving, grocery bags used for food storage, and repeat violations from a prior inspection.

headline: Passed; no hot water at one women's hand sink
summary: Passed. The women's restroom hand sink had no hot water; staff were told to use another sink until it is fixed. Unisex restroom needs a covered receptacle, and dust under counters and soda machine must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; pork thawed in sink; missing thermometers
summary: Passed. Pork was thawed improperly in the three-compartment sink; staff were told to thaw it under refrigeration or fully submerged in running water. Thermometers were needed in cooling units, and water-stained ceiling and peeling wall paint were noted.

headline: Passed; dusty shelving behind register
summary: Passed. Dust had built up on shelving behind the register where condiments are stored. Staff were told to detail clean the shelving.

headline: Passed; front door gap and dirty surfaces
summary: Passed. The front exterior door does not seal at the bottom and needs weather stripping to block pests. Dusty, cobwebbed dry storage shelving, dirty washroom fixtures, and grease on walls and hood were noted.

headline: Failed re-inspection; no valid manager certificate
summary: Failed re-inspection. No valid Chicago food service sanitation certificate was on site, and a citation was issued. Door has a 1/4-inch gap; ice machine interior had black slime and no backflow device could be found. Cold holding units had food residue.

headline: Failed; about 75 mouse droppings and training gaps
summary: Failed. About 75 or more mouse droppings were found in prep, storage, and toilet areas. Pest service was recommended. No signed employee health policy, no sanitizer test kit, and no food handler or allergen training proof were available.

headline: Passed; greasy floor and manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. Heavy grease was on the floor under the fryers in the front cook line. One certified manager lacked allergen training and must complete it and keep records on site.

headline: Passed re-inspection; damaged floor tiles and chipped paint
summary: Passed re-inspection. Damaged floor tiles and missing grout in the dish room must be repaired. Chipped paint on the dish area ceiling must be resurfaced and repainted to be smooth and cleanable.

headline: Failed; droppings, flies, and no pest control proof
summary: Failed. About 30-40 droppings were found in the rear storage area and 40-50 in the walk-in cooler, plus 10-12 small flies. No pest control proof or logbook was on site. No soap or paper towels in the toilet room. Raw chicken was spoiled and discarded.

headline: Passed; frozen meat on cooling rack moved to cooler
summary: Passed. Frozen meat was stored at room temperature on a cooling rack; the manager moved it to a cooler. Moldy wall caulking at the three-compartment sink must be replaced, and unnecessary items in the basement must be removed.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk containers and leaks
summary: Passed. Bulk containers in the kitchen were unlabeled, and grocery bags were used in coolers and freezers. A pipe under the one-compartment sink leaks, and the hot water faucet at the three-compartment sink leaks. Storage room is cluttered.

headline: Passed; leaking drain and missing ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. A leaking drainpipe was found under the three-compartment sink and must be repaired. Missing grout and ceiling tiles were noted. Food debris and spills on floors in walk-in freezer and storage areas need cleaning.

headline: Passed re-inspection; cardboard, rugs, and no mop sink
summary: Passed re-inspection. Frozen chicken wings were thawed at room temperature. Broken cardboard boxes, rugs, and wall panels were used in the facility. No mop sink was on site, and the front entrance door was left open during inspection.

headline: Passed; ice bin missing covers
summary: Passed. The ice bin at the bar was missing covers, and the facility was told to provide covers because a customer seating area is across from it.

headline: Passed; dirty floors and boxes stored on floor
summary: Passed. Dirt and food debris were found on floors and walls behind equipment and in corners. Cardboard boxes and crates were stored on the floor in the rear storage area and must be elevated 6 inches.

headline: Passed re-inspection; missing thermometers and grime
summary: Passed re-inspection. Reach-in coolers, freezers, and walk-in coolers lacked visible thermometers. Hood dust, kitchen floor debris, unused equipment, and open ceiling tiles were noted. Ceiling tile problem was corrected on site.

headline: Passed; seafood market fixes needed
summary: Passed. Hand-washing signs were missing, and the walk-in cooler had no shelving. Missing stoppers and a leaking faucet at the three-compartment sink, plus no drainboard, were noted. Other issues included ice buildup in the freezer, a missing toilet trash receptacle, and missing baseboards.

headline: Failed; 60+ mouse droppings in basement
summary: Failed. More than 60 mouse droppings were on the basement electrical panel room floor, and 40 or more were near the hot water tank. Pest control service was required before reinspection. Also noted: holes in wall, ceiling leak, and missing floor drain cover.

headline: Passed; unlabeled squeeze bottles
summary: Passed. Squeeze bottles in the front prep area and service counter had no labels. Staff were told to label them and keep them labeled.

headline: Passed; uncovered beverage removed; gap at screen door
summary: Passed. An employee's uncovered drink was in the food prep area and was removed by the manager. Rear screened door has open 1/4-inch gaps and must be sealed. Wiping cloths and stored pots must be kept off the floor and in sanitizer.

headline: Failed; water tank leaking near electrical lines
summary: Failed. Running water was insufficient at the hand sink and three-compartment sink for food operations. A water tank was leaking onto the floor near electrical lines. Floors had grease and food debris, and food handler training records were missing.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager; no health policy
summary: Passed with conditions. No Chicago-certified manager was on site while sliced deli meat was served. Two food handlers lacked signed employee health policies. No allergen training proof was shown for the certified manager.

headline: Ice machine buildup; no backflow device at mop sink
summary: Slight buildup inside upper ice machine. Pink buildup inside bar gun holder. No backflow prevention device at mop sink. Ceiling light bulbs out above the chest freezer in prep area.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; no manager certificate
summary: Person in charge lacks a City of Chicago food service manager certificate. Over 100 mouse droppings in the register, cooking, rear kitchen and basement areas. Orkin pest service required before reinspection next week. Citation issued.

headline: Leaking bar sink and missing backflow device
summary: Bar three-compartment sink faucet leaks at the base. Ice machine water line lacks a visible backflow prevention device. A ventilation hood light bulb is out. Manager must repair these.

headline: Re-inspection: low water pressure, allergen gap
summary: Re-inspection passed. Extremely low cold water pressure at kitchen hand sink must be increased. Cracked caulking at that sink must be replaced. Basement storage needs unused items removed and food items elevated. Allergen certificates required.

headline: No hair restraints; food in grocery bags
summary: Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints. Food stored in grocery bags in coolers. Missing or damaged floor tiles in staff toilet, prep and dish areas. Certified manager lacks allergen training proof.

headline: Missing hand-wash signs; improper storage
summary: No hand-washing signs at front bar sinks or restrooms. Bulk containers unlabeled. Wiping cloths stored on prep tables and ice scoops stored on the ice machine instead of in clean containers.

headline: No health policy on site; tin foil liner
summary: No employee health policy or training on site (priority violation). Tin foil used as cooking equipment liner. No backflow device on basement ice machine. Wall caulking at three-compartment sink must be replaced.

headline: Leaking sinks, knives stored on wall
summary: Hand-wash signage needed at rear sink. Knives stored on wall by three-compartment sink; a knife holder is needed. Leaking drains at two hand sinks and the three-compartment sink. Floors need detail cleaning. Manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Hand-washing violation; sinks lacked hot water
summary: Food handler washed and dried hands while wearing gloves; citation issued. Second- and third-floor restroom sinks had 48°F and 55°F water; maintenance restored third-floor hot water on site. Missing hair restraints and thermometer.

headline: No hot water at several sinks; citation issued
summary: Several sinks had 78–91°F water; hot water of 100–120°F under city pressure required at all sinks. Brick openings, peeling paint, and damaged dining floor tiles. Previous core violations include door gaps, wall holes, and chipping floors.

headline: Re-inspection: rear door gap; no certificates
summary: Re-inspection passed. Rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap that must be sealed. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Expired food handler certificates; person in charge lacks valid allergen training. Leaking hand sink and dirty floor drains.

headline: Hair not restrained; poor scrubbing pads
summary: Long hair must be restrained in a bun or hairnet. Worn-out green scrubbing pads must be discarded and replaced frequently.

headline: Unlabeled dry goods; torn cooler gasket
summary: Dry goods in the rear lacked labels after removal from original packaging. Torn door gasket on the two-door produce cooler must be replaced.

headline: Complaint: many equipment cleaning orders
summary: Instructed to clean many surfaces: bulk containers, refrigeration units, mixers, ice machine interior and scoop, grease trap area, fryers, kitchen walls and floors under cooking equipment.

headline: Re-inspection: splash guard, leak, debris
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food in plastic containers in basement needs labels. Splash guard needed between front hand sink and counter. Broken gaskets on three-door cooler. Leaking three-compartment sink faucet. Debris near garbage area.

headline: Ice build-up in walk-in; trash under shelving
summary: Splash guard needed between the three-compartment sink and prep hand sink. Excess ice buildup inside walk-in cooler on product, shelves and floor. Trash and debris under shelves, in hot water tank room, and at the ice machine floor drain.

headline: Wiping cloths, rust, floors, and training gaps
summary: No hand-washing signage at designated sinks. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer. Rusty can opener and rear prep tables. Pitted floors, damaged ceiling tiles, and no toilet room ventilation. No food handler proof; manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Ice machine buildup; soiled floor water
summary: Ice machine door had buildup and was in disrepair. Black buildup and standing soiled water on the floor around the ice machine. Instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Cold food held too warm; $70 discarded
summary: Several TCS foods held at 44–74°F, above the 41°F limit. Manager discarded about 4 lbs sausage, 4 lbs burger meat and 7 lbs chicken, valued at $70. Priority citation issued.

headline: Re-inspection passed; slow drain, dirty walls
summary: Re-inspection passed. Slow drain at the bar one-compartment sink needs repair. Walls and floors behind the bar, under equipment, and in a dishwashing corner need cleaning.

headline: No health policy; holes above walk-in coolers
summary: No written employee health policy on premises (priority violation, no citation). No covered trash receptacle in the all-gender restroom. No commercial dumpster on site. Holes in ceiling panels above three walk-in coolers.

headline: Re-inspection passed; many repairs listed
summary: Re-inspection passed. Needed: hand-wash signs, more hot water pressure at hand sinks, ice machine backflow device, floor and wall repairs, burnt-out lights, damaged lids, and allergen training for food managers.

headline: About 70 rat droppings; no pest control log
summary: About 70 rat droppings in basement and about 40 in kitchen; pest control must eliminate activity. No current pest control logbook or service reports. Citation issued. Wet wiping cloths, greasy floors, and dusty vents.

headline: Dish machine too cool; signage and tools fixed
summary: Small high-temperature dish machine could not reach 180°F rinse water; tagged out of order and citation issued. Also missing hand-wash signs, coolers lacking thermometers, plastic bowl used as a flour scoop, greasy oven.

headline: Over 40 mouse droppings; hand sink problems
summary: Over 40 mouse droppings under shelves, under the front counter, and in the ice machine cabinet. Citation issued. Also a bearded employee without restraint, slow-warming hot water at a hand sink, a leaking drain, and worn gaskets.

headline: Flies found; unlabeled spices; food on floor
summary: About 30 live small flies in bar and fruit prep areas; pest control recommended; citation issued. Spices and foods in steel containers without labels. Food stored on walk-in floor. Greasy equipment and soiled mop heads.

headline: No certified manager; food held too warm
summary: No certified manager during TCS food preparation and service. Hamburgers, raw chicken, hot dogs and cheese held at 58.4–60.2°F; about 33 lbs ($158) discarded. Front prep cooler at 61.7–67.1°F tagged. Missing thermometer and hair restraints.

headline: Rusty walk-in shelving; greasy hood
summary: Rust on walk-in cooler shelving must be removed or shelving replaced. Water-stained ceiling tiles near prep doorway. Grease buildup on hood vents and filters must be cleaned.

headline: Greasy hood filters need cleaning
summary: Slight grease and grime on the hood filters over the cook line. Instructed to clean and maintain them in good condition.

headline: No certified manager; fruit flies and rat droppings
summary: No certified food manager present while ground beef pies were prepared. About 100 live fruit flies and about 15 rat droppings found in prep areas. Pest control needed. Also rusty shelves, broken pastry case glass, and a food handler without certificate.

headline: No certified manager; freezer too warm, food tossed
summary: No certified food manager on site while TCS foods were served; one arrived about 30 minutes later. Deep freezer ran at 86.7°F; salsa and ceviche were too warm and discarded. Freezer tagged; allergen training also required.

headline: Re-inspection: missing thermometers; dirty cooler
summary: Re-inspection passed. Cooling and hot-hold units lacked thermometers. Sink stoppers needed. Three-door cooler has dirt and mold-like stains. Carpet in rear prep area. Cluttered prep areas and food debris on cooking equipment.

headline: Ice dispenser slime; undated ready-to-eat food
summary: Ice dispenser had black, brown and pink buildup; ice removed and surfaces cleaned; citation issued. Ready-to-eat TCS foods lacked date labels; about 50 lbs ($75) discarded. Leaking hand sink drainpipe. Clutter in prep office.

headline: Gap under exit door; stained dish racks
summary: Approximately 1/4-inch gap under the prep-area exit door must be repaired to be tight-fitting. Heavily stained and worn dish racks must be replaced. Missing stoppers for three-compartment sink.

headline: Over 100 flies and 40 mouse droppings found
summary: Over 100 small flies and over 40 mouse droppings on the sales floor and in dry storage; licensed pest control required. Cold food held at 66.9°F; about 10 lbs ($55) discarded on site. Missing health policy, vomit supplies, and food handler certificates.

headline: Cold food too warm; 100 lbs discarded
summary: Salmon, chicken, pasta and beef in prep cooler held at 51.9–54.6°F, above the 41°F limit. About 100 lbs and $200 of product discarded. Cooler at 55.1°F is tagged and cannot be used until reinspected.

headline: Dirty ice machines; labeling and repair gaps
summary: Upper parts of three basement ice machines need cleaning. Tortilla bins and to-go cake containers lack labels. Ice scoops stored inside food. Taped freezer gasket. Damaged floors, missing wall tile, food splatter. No allergen training proof.

headline: Raw egg menu disclosure corrected on site
summary: Menu lacked asterisk disclosure for raw or undercooked fried eggs; corrected on site before inspection ended. Openings at patio door bases and rear exit. Foil liners, mold-like ice machine spots, and two managers lacking allergen training proof.

headline: Re-inspection: exposed ice; missing grout
summary: Re-inspection passed. Exposed ice in first- and second-floor bin must be covered. Missing grout between floor tiles near cook line and dishwashing area must be replaced.

headline: Labeling and crate issues; dirty equipment
summary: Squeeze bottles and pitchers need labels. Crates used for storage must be removed. Fryer cabinets, ice machine panel, and floors need cleaning. Broken floor tile at rear door. Cardboard used as wall panel.

headline: Re-inspection: no employee health policy
summary: No employee health policy on site. Management must verify health status for each employee at all times (priority violation). Toilet room door lacks a self-closing device, which must be installed.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; no manager allergen training
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings in rear storage, washroom and around water heater; exterminator required; citation issued. Food on walk-in floors; no hair restraints; greasy surfaces; no covered waste bin; no manager allergen training.

headline: Seal openings to reduce pest hiding spots
summary: Seal openings and seams in food prep and dishwashing area walls to eliminate pest hiding spots. Seal loose baseboard behind chest freezer.

headline: Grease trap missing from sink
summary: Grease trap is missing from the three-compartment sink. Must be reinstalled and maintained.

headline: Re-inspection: soda crates used for elevation
summary: Re-inspection passed. Soda crates must not be used to elevate stored items. Floors must stay accessible for cleaning and monitoring at all times.

headline: Dish machine sanitizer empty; fixed on site
summary: Dish machine measured 0 ppm sanitizer because its sanitizer bottle was empty. The manager connected adequate sanitizer during the visit. Priority citation issued.

headline: Storage and equipment issues; no ice machine backflow
summary: Food stored on floors and in crates; utensils and scoops stored improperly. Worn gaskets, rusty shelves, and debris on fryers and shelving. No backflow device on ice machine. Food handlers lack training; slow hand sink drain.

headline: Re-inspection passed; thermometers, gaskets needed
summary: Re-inspection passed. Cooling units lacked thermometers. Torn gaskets and heavy grease found. Splashguard needed by three-compartment sink. Food handlers lacked proof of training; managers need allergen training.

headline: Re-inspection: no hair restraints at coffee station
summary: Re-inspection passed. All food handlers in the front coffee station area were not wearing hair restraints while food was being prepared and served.

headline: Over 50 rodent droppings; rear door gap
summary: Over 50 rodent droppings on the floor by dry products and under equipment. Pest control return recommended before reinspection. Also a 1/2-inch gap under the rear door and no dumpster lids. Citation issued.

headline: Re-inspection passed; stained cutting boards
summary: Re-inspection passed. Stained cutting boards in the main kitchen prep and cooking areas must be resurfaced or replaced.

headline: Grocery bags in cooler; broken kitchen tiles
summary: Grocery bags used for food storage in reach-in cooler; food-grade bags required. Loose and broken kitchen floor tiles. Detail-clean floors and walls behind cooking equipment. One employee lacks a valid food handler certificate.

headline: No food thermometer; sink floods; repeat restroom issue
summary: No metal-stem food thermometer for checking hot and cold TCS (food that must be kept hot or cold) foods. Three-compartment sink floods when drained. Three restrooms lack covered receptacles, a repeat violation. Citations issued.

headline: Re-inspection fails: health policy, repeat sink issue
summary: No signed employee health policies (citation issued). Gap under rear door, worn gaskets, worn cutting boards, stained ceiling tiles, and no food handler training. Repeat violation: three-compartment sink faucet too short; citation issued.

headline: No sanitation certificate on premises
summary: No City food service sanitation certificate while handling TCS foods; manager showed training proof but no valid certificate. Citation issued. Scoop handles in ice bins, boxes on floor, and leaking hot water pipes.

headline: No soap or towels at bar sinks; food not dated
summary: Bar hand sinks lacked soap and paper towels; citations issued. Ice machine linings not cleaned. Ready-to-eat foods in walk-in cooler lacked labels. Dirty wiping cloths and serving plates improperly stored. Basement clutter needs removal.

headline: Missing thermometers; food debris on equipment
summary: Refrigerators lack thermometers. A splash guard is needed by the hot-holding units. Food debris on an unused cooler, shelving and microwave. No designed ceiling over the rear prep area.

headline: Re-inspection passed; missing hand-wash signs
summary: Re-inspection passed. Front bar hand sink lacks hand-washing signs. Food stored in plastic grocery bags in a freezer, plastic wrap used as shelf liner, dirty light covers, dusty vent and broken floor tiles.

headline: Equipment stored near exit; stained ceiling
summary: Extra cooking equipment by rear exit must be cleaned and stored six inches off the ground and away from walls. Stained ceiling tiles in kitchen prep area. Wall leading to rear exit in disrepair.

headline: Chicken too cool; 50 rodent droppings found
summary: Four rotisserie chickens at 100–120°F, below the 135°F hot-holding minimum; discarded. Chorizo and sausage at 52°F in a cooler, tagged. About 50 rodent droppings and a dead mouse found. Pest control required.

headline: Re-inspection: unlabeled containers, floor storage
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food storage containers without common-name labels. Food containers stored on the floor in prep and storage areas must be raised at least six inches.

headline: Unlabeled containers; no covered women's bin
summary: Food storage containers not labeled when food is not in original container. Women's restroom has no covered bin.

headline: Missing sushi sink signage; dirty cooler
summary: No hand-washing signage at the sushi-area hand sink. Interior of reach-in cooler is not clean.

headline: Re-inspection passed; no certificates on site
summary: Re-inspection passed, but no food handler certificates and no allergen training certificates were on site. All food employees must complete training and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Ice machine debris; rusty racks; dim walk-in
summary: No hand-washing signage at bars. Encrusted debris inside the ice machine. Rusty wire racks in walk-in cooler. Ice bin lacks a tight-fitting lid. Walk-in cooler lighting is dim and must be brightened.

headline: No hand sink at prep; no food handler training
summary: No hand sink in preparation areas; a large pot sink replaced it. Must install hand sink with hot and cold water. Spray foam above the three-compartment sink must be removed. Some food handlers lack required training. Citation issued.

headline: Peeling shelves; greasy exhaust hood
summary: Wooden kitchen storage shelves are in poor repair with peeling debris and must be repaired or replaced. Kitchen exhaust hood and filters need detail cleaning to remove grease buildup.

headline: Missing health policy, cleanup kit, supplies
summary: No written employee health policy, no vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure, no soap or paper towels at bar hand sink, and no chemical sanitizer or test kit. No licensed pest control operator.

headline: Hair restraints and wiping cloths; dirty ice machine
summary: Food prep employees not wearing hair restraints. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer. Ice machine interior stained and dirty. Dirty floors under heavy equipment, dirty kitchen walls, and dusty men's restroom vent.

headline: Display refrigerator too warm; unit tagged
summary: Display refrigerator measured 46.8°F; cold-holding units must reach 41°F or below. Unit tagged; do not use it until reinspected by the Chicago Department of Public Health (CDPH).

headline: Flies found; repeat cleanliness violations
summary: About 30 live flies on walls and ceilings in coffee and dishwashing areas; additional pest control needed; citation issued. Repeat violations: dirty cooler interior, floor debris, unworkable washroom vents, and no food handler proof.

headline: Unlabeled bulk salt container
summary: Bulk salt container is not labeled. Instructed to label it and keep it labeled.

headline: Refrigerator lacks required thermometer
summary: Re-inspection passed. The refrigerator has no equipment thermometer inside. Manager must provide one.

headline: Staff eating and drinking at prep area
summary: Employees ate and drank in the kitchen prep area; a designated break area is required. A spoon used inside a coleslaw container. Serving plates stored uninverted. Tin cans used for food storage. Greasy hood and floors need cleaning.

headline: Hands not washed; sink blocked by belongings
summary: Food handler scratched bare arms and returned to prep without washing hands; citation issued. Hand sink in rear prep was blocked by boxes and belongings, cleared during inspection; citation issued. Coffee debris on floors.

headline: Over 50 live roaches; hot water too cool
summary: Over 50 live roaches in dining, prep, dish and restroom areas, plus dead roaches under equipment. Hand sink water at 86.5°F, below the 100°F minimum. Residential insecticide stored near syrup. Expired tuna and chicken liver discarded.

headline: Employee restroom lacks covered trash can
summary: The unisex employee restroom has no covered trash receptacle. Inspector instructed the facility to provide and maintain one.

headline: Re-inspection: gap under rear door, labels
summary: Re-inspection passed. Shaker and squeeze bottles need labels when food is not in original packaging. Gap under rear door must be made tight-fitting. Dust on ceiling vent above front prep area.

headline: Ice machine chute black buildup; allergen gap
summary: Ice machine chute and nearby surfaces had excessive black buildup; ice discarded, machine cleaned and sanitized; citation issued. Also a broken cooler hinge, stained and broken ceiling tiles, and no allergen training certificate for the food manager.

headline: Re-inspection: lids, splash guards, leaks needed
summary: Re-inspection passed. Needed: lid for basement ice bin, splash guard at basement hand sink, covers for utensils in expo window, sink stoppers, leaking faucets and drain, damaged floor tiles, and allergen training proof.

headline: Half-inch gap at front door
summary: Half-inch gap at the front door. Instructed to seal it to keep pests out.

headline: Live cockroaches and flies; many gaps found
summary: Two live cockroaches and several dead ones under the three-compartment sink; over 25 live small flies in dishwashing and basement. Pest control recommended. Also missing health policies, unlabeled containers, leaks, and missing food handler certificates.

headline: Wiping cloths improperly stored; greasy can opener
summary: Three-compartment sink wash hose must be shortened to rest above the fill line. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer. Large can opener has food and dirt buildup. Stained walls behind dish machine.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup plan; dead insects
summary: No employee health policy or training on site, and no procedure or kit for vomit and diarrhea events. Dead insects in a kitchen corner. Open seam at sink and rusty shelves. Priority citations for health policy and cleanup plan.

headline: About 50 mouse droppings found; pest service advised
summary: About 50 mouse droppings behind the bar and in the HVAC closet. Management told to clean all droppings; additional pest control recommended. Also torn cooler gasket and dirty fryers, floors and walls. Citation issued.

headline: Dish machine lacked sanitizer; tagged out
summary: No sanitizer detected in the final rinse of the low-temperature dish machine. Machine tagged and must not be used until repaired and reinspected. Also items stored on floors, milk crates used, and a missing thermometer in a cooler.

headline: Repeat violations: no food handler certificates
summary: Food stored in grocery bags in refrigeration units must use approved containers. Repeat core violation: no food handler certificates on site. No previous inspection summary posted. Citations issued.

headline: Opening by mop sink; dirty floors
summary: Opening left of the mop sink must be sealed to keep insects out. Dirt and grease under kitchen equipment and in the basement walk-in cooler. Loose wall edge near the mop sink must be sealed.

headline: Re-inspection: unlabeled food, no training proof
summary: Re-inspection passed. Grab-and-go items such as watermelon and trail mix lacked full labels. Deeply cut cutting boards need replacing. Clutter near the walk-in cooler. No proof of food handler training for any employee.

headline: Hot food too cool; 20+ mouse droppings
summary: Chicken and corn tamales held at 86.3°F and 75.9°F, below the 135°F hot-food minimum; about 35 lbs and $70 discarded. Over 20 mouse droppings in basement storage. Exterminator called. Citations issued.

headline: Mold-like buildup in AC drain line
summary: Hand sink in washroom lacks hand-washing signage. Cooking equipment surfaces are dusty. Air conditioning condensate line has mold-like buildup. Greasy ceiling tiles near the hood must be repaired and sealed.

headline: Repeat core violations: rust, debris, wet floors
summary: Food containers stored on walk-in cooler floor. Food debris under cooler handles and in can opener holder. Repeat violations: rust on prep table shelves, greasy fryer interiors, damaged floor tiles, and debris-filled floor drains. Citation issued.

headline: No hot water at bar sink; no toilet
summary: Salad prep station and east restroom lack exposed hand sinks. Main bar hand sink has no hot water. East restroom has no toilet. Service bar lacks a dump sink. Priority violations for sinks; no citations issued.

headline: Re-inspection: cut produce needs labels
summary: Re-inspection passed. Cut fruits and vegetables on display, prepared in-house, must be labeled.

headline: Re-inspection: raw beef thawed at room temperature
summary: Re-inspection passed. Deep pan of raw beef thawed at room temperature; must use a cooler or cold running water. Food on floors, a food handler without hair restraint, wiping cloths on equipment, no sink stoppers, and floors needing deep cleaning.

headline: Re-inspection passed; loose faucet, dirty floors
summary: Re-inspection passed. Second-floor kitchenette hand sink faucet is loose and hard to turn; repair needed. Floor under the three-compartment sink and dish machine has dried food debris.

headline: Basement thermometers missing; floors dirty
summary: No visible thermometers in basement refrigerators. Spilled food in bottom microwave near prep cooler. Spilled food and dirt on basement floors. Food handler certificates could not be verified; no allergen training proof for managers.

headline: Employees lack food handler certificates
summary: Employees on site had no food handler certificates; new employees have 30 days to obtain them. Certified managers lack allergen training certificates. Dirty and dusty ceiling fans above the dish area.

headline: Grease under fryers; clutter in staff hall
summary: Light grease under kitchen fryers must be cleaned. Clutter and unused, broken cooking equipment and boxes on the floor in rear staff hall must be removed. Floors under cooking equipment need deep cleaning.

headline: Foil liners and torn cooler gasket
summary: Aluminum foil used as a shelf liner at the bar. Torn door gasket on a three-door cooler. Stove, oven, fryers, prep coolers and tables need detail cleaning. Grease buildup on hood filters.

headline: Floors need cleaning in several areas
summary: Floors need cleaning inside the walk-in cooler, around the cooking equipment, and in the dishwashing area. This was a passing inspection with this issue noted.

headline: Missing thermometers, labels, and food handler certificates
summary: Hot holding unit for prepackaged pizza slices lacked an air thermometer. Squirt bottles were unlabeled. Sink stoppers were missing. Ice machine needed cleaning. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; dirty coolers
summary: Several food handler certificates were expired. Multi-use utensils were stored on the side of coolers and cooking equipment. Storage racks and cooler surfaces had food and debris. Floor drains and floors need thorough cleaning.

headline: About 100 small flies; unclean floors and drains
summary: Approximately 100 small flies were found throughout the facility, a priority violation. Floors under and around the ice machine, dish machine, and cooking equipment were unclean, and several floor drains needed detailed cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled packaged foods; rear door gap
summary: Packaged cookies, cake slices, and banana pudding were not properly labeled. Rear exit door had about a half-inch gap at the bottom and was not rodent-proof. Cutting boards in the rear prep area had open seams and stains.

headline: Uncovered single-use utensils; torn freezer gasket
summary: Single-use spoons, knives, and forks were left uncovered on a shelf near cooking equipment. A towel was used as a shelf liner near the fryer. A chest freezer gasket was damaged. Damaged ceiling tiles and a rough wall need repair.

headline: Leaking stopper; spills on equipment and floors
summary: Leaking stopper under the first compartment of the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Food spills and debris were on beverage machines, coolers, and shelving. Floors under equipment, along walls, and in corners need cleaning.

headline: Food on floor; mops stored wet
summary: Bins and boxes of food were stored on the walk-in cooler floor; the manager raised them during inspection. Standing freezer shelves were soiled with food debris. Mops were stored on the floor and in buckets and must be hung to dry. Paper towel dispenser was broken.

headline: Handwashing lapse; refrigerator at 54°F, tagged
summary: Employee did not wash hands when needed, and wiped a prep table with the same cloth used to prepare an order. Employee washed hands after being notified; citation issued. Refrigerator at 54.0°F was tagged held and must stay at 41°F or below.

headline: Hot water too cool at dish sink; citation issued
summary: Dish sink water was 104°F and must reach 110°F. Hot water was restored within 10 minutes after the building engineer fixed an upstairs sink. Restroom faucet ran for only 5 seconds, and staff must make sure it runs long enough.

headline: Missing stem thermometer; glue boards need replacing
summary: No stem thermometer was in reach-in coolers. Glue boards had dust and debris and needed replacing. Interior of the ice machine chute needed cleaning. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer. Allergen certificate was needed for sanitation certificate holders.

headline: No certified person in charge; potatoes held too cool
summary: No valid city sanitation certificate was posted or on site (citation). Cooked potatoes were held at 103.4°F, below the required 135°F, and were discarded (citation). No metal stem thermometer was on site. Food handlers lacked effective hair restraints.

headline: No certified manager; no summary posted; damaged grease trap
summary: No certified manager was on site during the initial inspection while TCS foods were prepared; the manager arrived about an hour later (citation). Damaged grease trap with a hole. No summary report posted (citation). Ice scoop stored improperly.

headline: Dusty restroom fans; wet mop in bucket
summary: Heavy dust covered the restroom fan guards and must be cleaned. Floors under the three-compartment sink, prep sink, and walk-in cooler shelving need cleaning. A wet mop was stored in a bucket and must be hung to dry.

headline: Dirty walk-in beer cooler and greasy filters
summary: Interior of the walk-in beer cooler had debris on walls and spills on the floor. Filters above cooking equipment needed cleaning to remove grease.

headline: Uncertified manager on site; rear door gap
summary: Food service manager on site lacked a valid city certification while beef, chicken, and rice were prepared (citation). Rear exit door had worn weather stripping and a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom, which must be repaired to prevent pests.

headline: No running water at sinks; residue in ice machine
summary: No running water was at the handwashing, three-compartment, and utility sinks (citation). Residue was on the ice machine interior. Gaps at front and rear doors and wall openings in the crawl space must be sealed. Missing ceiling tiles and no manager allergen training.

headline: Sink stoppers not working; standing water in deli
summary: Stoppers for the meat department three-compartment sink were not working and must be provided. Standing water and liquid were on the deli prep area floor under and around cooking equipment. Floor must be kept dry and clean.

headline: Damaged ceiling tiles; expired manager allergen training
summary: Damaged ceiling tiles and dusty vent covers in the front dining area must be cleaned and maintained. The certified manager's allergen training certificate had expired and must be renewed and kept on hand.

headline: Walk-in cooler at 65.5°F; tagged
summary: Walk-in cooler measured 65.5°F and must be kept at 41°F or below. No TCS food was inside during inspection. Unit was tagged and held for inspection. Food splatter was found on walls, curtains, and under the hood.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings and over 20 rat droppings were found in storage and sales areas, and a citation was issued. No certified manager was on site while raw meat was prepared and served. No food handler training was present. Dumpster area was not maintained.

headline: Rusty metal racks in walk-in cooler
summary: Rusty metal racks inside the walk-in cooler must be repainted or replaced. This is a reinspection, and no other issues were listed.

headline: Dish machine lacked sanitizer; rat droppings found
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer and was tagged held (citation). Ice machine interior had black and gray slime dripping onto ice for consumption (citation). About 15 rat droppings were found in the basement near the ice machine.

headline: Torn gasket on sushi prep cooler
summary: A torn gasket was found on the inside of a one-door prep cooler in the sushi prep area. The inspector instructed the facility to repair or replace it and keep it in good condition.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; loose sink fixtures
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving in prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Can opener blade tip was broken. Handwashing sink and paper towel dispenser in the butcher area were loose.

headline: 60 rat droppings and flying insects; no cleanup plan
summary: Over 60 rat droppings were found in the furnace room, sales area, and unused meat prep area. Numerous flying insects were in sales and storage areas. Citation issued. No vomit cleanup procedure or supplies were present, and a leaking drainpipe needs repair.

headline: Rear door gap; dirty walls behind dish machine
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door sweep must be fixed so the door is rodent-proof. Dirt and food buildup were on walls around and behind the dish machine, and the manager must clean them.

headline: Leaking pipe under handwashing sink
summary: Worn sealant was found between the rear prep handwashing sink and wall, and must be sealed. A leaking pipe under the sink must be repaired. Restroom door was not self-closing and must be fixed.

headline: No handwashing signs; wiping cloths on equipment
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at the basement food prep sink and basement employee washroom sink. Wiping cloths were stored on top of the dishwashing machine and prep tables. Items on basement floors must be elevated.

headline: Floor debris in walk-in coolers
summary: Debris had built up on the floors in the walk-in coolers and throughout the facility. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain the area.

headline: Loose cooler door; no self-closing restroom door
summary: Left door of a two-door prep cooler was in poor repair and must be adjusted. Employee restroom door did not have a self-closing device and must have one installed.

headline: No covered trash cans; one manager lacks allergen training
summary: Both all-gender restrooms lacked covered trash receptacles. One certified food service manager did not have an allergen awareness training certificate at the time of inspection.

headline: Backflow devices missing at ice machine
summary: Backflow prevention devices or an air gap were not present at the ice machine, so it cannot be serviced and maintained. Restroom door was not kept closed when not in use, and it must remain closed except during cleaning.

headline: Faucet leak and food debris under cooking equipment
summary: Handwashing sink faucet near the kitchen entrance was leaking and must be repaired. Soil and debris were found on the walk-in cooler fan guards. Food debris was found on floors under the cooking equipment in the cooks area.

headline: Wiping cloths on counters; dirty cutting board
summary: Wiping cloths were left on counters and metal shelving in the rear prep area. A chef knife sat between the wall and prep table. A cutting board was badly stained with deep grooves. Floor drains and vent covers need cleaning.

headline: Employee drink in freezer; cracked floors
summary: An open employee drink was placed in a prep freezer and must be kept away. An unlabeled bottle was in the prep area. A walk-in cooler door gasket was in poor repair, and deep floor cracks at the bar and kitchen trap dirt.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies; no sanitizer test kit
summary: Inadequate supplies for cleaning up vomit or diarrhea were on site, and a citation was issued. Bulk dry ingredients near the walk-in cooler lacked labels. No chemical test kit was available to measure sanitizer concentration, and a citation was issued.

headline: Expired certificates; soiled linens; greasy walls
summary: No proof of food handler training was provided for all required employees. Soiled linens hung on sink splash guards. Torn cooler gaskets and peeling paper liners were found. Bulk containers lacked labels, and a prior core violation was not corrected.

headline: No certified manager; bearded worker; rusty racks
summary: No person in charge had a certified manager certificate, and no certified manager was on site while TCS foods were served (citation). A food handler had a full beard and a dishwasher lacked a hair restraint. Walk-in cooler racks were rusty.

headline: Expired allergen training certificates
summary: Expired allergen training certificates were found for certified food managers. Current certificates must be provided for all certified food managers.

headline: Three dish machines not working; restroom sink broken
summary: Three of four low-temperature dish machines at bars throughout the facility were not working properly, and all three had out-of-order signs. One of eight women's restroom sinks did not work. A manager had expired allergen training.

headline: No certified manager; cleanup supplies missing
summary: No person in charge held a valid certificate, and no certified manager was on duty while TCS foods were prepared (citations issued). Vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies were missing. Single-use items were stored on the floor.

headline: Missing food handler training; rear door not rodent-proof
summary: Several food handlers lacked required food handler training. Restroom handwashing signs were missing. Rear exit door was not rodent-proof, and its door sweep was in poor repair. Hair restraints were corrected on site during the inspection.

headline: Leaking handwashing sink faucet
summary: Three-compartment sink in rear prep and handwashing sink faucet in the prep area were leaking. The facility was instructed to repair and maintain them. This was a reinspection.

headline: Gaps at door; cardboard misuse; damaged cutting board
summary: An open one-inch gap at the back screened door must be sealed. Cardboard was used as a cleaning agent container, shelf liner, and rubber mat base. A cooks line cutting board was damaged by fire. Basement hole and debris need fixing.

headline: Leaking faucet and dirty storage room floor
summary: Three-compartment sink faucet was leaking and must be repaired. Debris and dirt were found along the wall bases in the storage room. Inspector instructed the facility to clean and maintain it.

headline: Food stored on floor and inside furnace room
summary: Food items were stored inside the furnace room and on the floor in prep and walk-in areas, and were uncovered. Greasy coolers, fryers, and shelving need cleaning. Leaking faucet on the three-compartment sink. A food handler lacked a hair restraint.

headline: Plates stored upright; should be inverted
summary: Plates in the kitchen were stored upright. Inspector instructed the facility to store plates and utensils inverted to protect them from contamination.

headline: No certified manager; cardboard shelf liner
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while beef and chicken were handled and served, a priority violation. Cardboard was lining walk-in cooler shelves under food containers and must be removed.

headline: Unapproved cheese found; no certified manager
summary: Unapproved-source cheese was for sale; manager discarded it during the inspection. Dry cheese was left at room temperature and was condemned. No certified manager was present during TCS food prep. Packaged cookies lacked allergen labels. Sticky fly trap was over a prep table.

headline: Coolers too warm; unapproved portable sink
summary: Seafood prep cooler measured 46.9°F, produce cooler 50°F, and a display cooler had a broken motor. All were tagged held (priority). An unapproved portable sink was in the meat cooler, tagged and not to be used. Leaks from the dish machine must be repaired.

headline: Rodent droppings and gnats; no cleanup kit
summary: Over 60 rodent droppings were found in storage, dishwashing, and prep areas, and over 80 gnats were found in prep and storage areas (citation). A pest control service must be scheduled before reinspection. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was on premises.

headline: No certified person in charge; no metal thermometer
summary: No person in charge with a valid certificate was on premises. A certified manager arrived at 11:20 AM; corrected on site (citation). No metal stem thermometer was present until delivered before inspection ended, corrected on site (citation). Boxes stored on floors.

headline: No vomit cleanup plan; no stem thermometer
summary: No procedure or kit for vomiting and diarrhea events was in place, a priority violation. No stem thermometer was on site to check TCS food temperatures at delivery. Milk crates and cardboard were used for storage and shelf liners. Broken floor tiles need replacing.

headline: Shrimp ceviche too warm; about $375 discarded
summary: About 50 lbs of shrimp ceviche at 49-52°F and 25 lbs of cooked pork feet at 50°F were held too warm; the person in charge voluntarily discarded them, a total of $375. Food handler drank from a canned drink without a lid. Cooler thermometers were broken or missing.

headline: Unlabeled rice container; missing allergen certificates
summary: Some food storage containers, including one holding white rice, needed proper labels. Shelves under the cash register area needed cleaning. Two certified food managers lacked allergen training certificates.

headline: Missing thermometers; cardboard and tape used
summary: Internal thermometers were missing from sushi prep and small coolers. Utensils were stored in 61.3°F water. Torn gaskets and tape were used inside coolers. Cardboard was used as shelving and as a liner. Basement handwashing sink was missing, a prior violation.

headline: Food handler and allergen training proof missing
summary: Three of six food handlers lacked proof of food handler training. Food service sanitation managers on site lacked allergen training certificates. The facility was instructed to meet these requirements. This was a reinspection.

headline: Broken sanitizer dispenser and dirty basement area
summary: Sanitizer dispenser at the three-compartment sink did not work, and a basement cooler door fell off. Heavy food debris on the slicer and dirt on the basement floor. No allergen training certificates on site. Basement handwashing sink lacked a sign.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; missing light shield
summary: A torn door gasket inside a one-door prep cooler must be replaced. A light fixture in the food prep area needs a shield. This was a reinspection.

headline: Food debris around cooking equipment
summary: Food debris was found around the cooking equipment. The facility was instructed to clean and maintain the area. No other issues were listed.

headline: Dish machine too cool at 103.8°F; tagged held
summary: Low-temperature dish machine wash water measured 103.8°F, below the required 120°F. Machine was tagged held for inspection. Rear storage floors had trash and debris under shelving. A large hole in the wall behind the beverage system needs repair.

headline: Dust on walls; dirty floor by ice machine
summary: Walls and ceilings in the kitchen, rear prep area, and women's restroom stall had dust buildup and must be cleaned. Floor in the corner by the kitchen ice machine needs cleaning.

headline: About 60 mouse and 5 rat droppings found
summary: About 60 mouse droppings and 5 rat droppings were found in several areas, including an oven and behind cooking equipment, and a citation was issued. Hot meats were stored in the walk-in cooler without proper cooling. No ambient thermometers were present.

headline: No paper towels at handwashing sinks; corrected
summary: No paper towels were at handwashing sinks on the first floor, basement prep area, and basement restroom. Manager put paper towels out immediately, corrected on site (citation). Ice machine lining was not cleaned, and food containers were stored on the floor.

headline: No certified manager; mislabeled grab-and-go salads
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while chicken and deli foods were handled and served, a priority violation. Packaged grab-and-go salads had improper food labels. The manager was instructed to obtain certification and label packaged foods correctly.

headline: No certified manager; hood broken; doors open
summary: No certified food manager was on site while open; an expired certificate was shown (citation). Front and rear doors were open, and must stay closed to be rodent-proof. Ventilation hood was not working, causing smoke and fumes. No food handler certificates were present.

headline: Unlabeled containers; dusty floors
summary: Food storage containers without labels containing the common name of foods were found. Loose debris and dust were on floors and corners throughout. Foam-like caulk was exposed on walls and around restroom pipes and must be resurfaced.

headline: No prep sink in first-floor bar
summary: The first-floor bar had no prep and dump sink. A prep sink is required in any preparation area for food prep, water access, and liquid waste disposal. The facility must install one. This was a reinspection.

headline: No hot water on site; greasy cooking equipment
summary: No hot water was available at the time of inspection and must be corrected. All cooking equipment needed cleaning to remove grease. Floor corners and filters also need cleaning, and a leak at the three-compartment sink faucet must be repaired.

headline: Unlabeled containers and improper wiping cloth storage
summary: Dry storage containers were not labeled with their common name. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. A plastic liner on a rear prep table must be removed.

headline: No written health policy; missing backflow device
summary: No written employee health policy was on the premises, and the person in charge was instructed to keep one. No backflow prevention device on the ice machine or service sink. Holes around pipes in the electrical room need sealing.

headline: Worn gaskets; greasy equipment; food handler training gaps
summary: Worn door gaskets on prep and reach-in coolers and a chest freezer lid in poor repair. Grease and food debris on steam table, fryer, and ice machine. Bread bags reused for cooked foods. Missing and expired food handler and allergen training.

headline: Ice machine buildup, clutter, and dark hood bulbs
summary: Small ice machine in the rear area had buildup inside and must be cleaned. Clutter near the three-compartment sink must be cleared. Light bulbs were not working in the hood system and must be replaced.

headline: Low hot water pressure and leaky faucet
summary: Hot water at the rear dishwashing area handwashing sink had low pressure. The three-compartment sink faucet was leaking. Inspector instructed the facility to repair and maintain both.

headline: Broken floor tiles in walk-in coolers
summary: Broken floor tiles were found in the walk-in coolers behind the butcher area. The person in charge was instructed to repair them so the floor is smooth and easily cleanable. This was a reinspection.

headline: Uncovered drink in bar; no food handler certificates
summary: A bar employee drank from an uncovered glass and stored it on top of a cooler, and must consume beverages only in designated areas. Certificates for food handlers could not be verified on site. Allergen training proof for city food managers was not available.

headline: Missing thermometers, ceiling leak, damaged floor
summary: Some coolers lacked thermometers. Water dripped from the ceiling above the rear prep area. A prior violation for damaged, missing floor tiles at the meat prep sink was not corrected and must be fixed by reinspection.

headline: Missing health policies, no soap, low hot water
summary: Some signed employee health policies were missing; citation issued. No soap at two prep and dishwashing handwashing sinks during inspection, though soap was supplied during the visit. Restroom hot water measured 89.1°F; 100.0°F is required.

headline: No backflow device; mop storage problem
summary: No backflow device on the rear utility sink. Staff restroom lacked a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. A mop was stored in a position that kept it from drying, which can encourage pests.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; citation issued
summary: Black slime was dripping from the ice machine into ice for customers. Inspector ordered cleaning and sanitizing and issued a citation. Also noted: a basement ice machine leak, a rusty can opener, milk crates used for food storage, and missing food handler proof.

headline: Flies found in deli area; drain backup citation
summary: Found 20 or more flies in the deli and bakery area; ordered pest service from Ecolab, and a citation was issued. Wastewater backed up from a produce prep floor drain, and a citation was issued. Door sweep needs repair.

headline: Missing light bulb and shield in walk-in cooler
summary: A light bulb and shield were missing in the walk-in cooler. The facility was instructed to replace them and maintain the lighting.

headline: Rear door gap; greasy floor behind fryers
summary: Rear door had approximately a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom, between, and at the top, and must be repaired so it is tight fitting and protected. Excessive grease behind the fryers in the prep area must be removed.

headline: Missing sink stoppers and standing water in bakery
summary: Three-compartment sink was missing proper stoppers. Floor tiles were missing around the bakery handwashing sink, causing standing water. Facility must replace the tiles so the surface is smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Food stored on floor; leaking drainpipe
summary: Food items were stored on the floor in prep, walk-in cooler, and walk-in freezer and must be elevated 6 inches. Single-service articles were not inverted. Leaking drainpipe under the front prep handwashing sink must be repaired.

headline: No certified manager; cold foods held too warm
summary: No certified manager was on site while rice and beans were prepared and served (citation). Cold TCS foods in a prep cooler were 48.6-61.3°F; about 50 lbs were discarded. Two coolers were tagged. No food handler or allergen training was available.

headline: No certified manager; no handwashing sign at juice bar
summary: No person in charge held a city sanitation certificate, and no city sanitation manager was on premises while TCS foods were handled (citation). Handwashing sink at the juice bar lacked a sign.

headline: Over 1,000 mouse droppings; pest infestation
summary: Over 1,000 mouse droppings were found in corners, storage, and prep areas, a citation issued. No pest control log book was present. Rear exterior door has a 1-inch gap. No vomit cleanup procedure was in place, and mold-like substance was on a chemical storage room wall.

headline: No certified manager while chicken served
summary: No certified manager was on duty while chicken was prepared and served, a citation was issued. Hanging fly strips were removed from walls. Rusted shelves, greasy equipment, and wall gaps need repair. Prior core violations including allergen training were not corrected.

headline: Missing ceiling tiles; dirty ventilation hood
summary: Missing and water-stained ceiling tiles above the pizza prep cold hold unit must be repaired. Ventilation hood in front prep area had dust, dirt, and grease buildup. No food handler or allergen training certificates were on site.
