headline: Allergen training proof missing for managers
summary: No proof of allergen training was on site for city food managers. Management was instructed that all city food managers must complete allergen training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Ice machine buildup, leaking faucet, stained ceiling tiles
summary: Ice machine had blackish buildup inside. Manager had employees clean it during inspection; the machine was not in use. Also noted: stained cutting boards, a leaking handwashing sink faucet near the griddle, and several stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Dishwasher lacked sanitizer; no health policy
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had no sanitizer at the final rinse, so it was tagged held and staff were told to use the three-compartment sink. No employee health policy was on the premises. Peeling paint near a rear cooler must be repainted.

headline: Gaps under doors; blown light bulbs
summary: Garage door and entrance door had openings at the bottom and must be rodent-proofed. Blown out light bulbs under the ventilation hood must be replaced.

headline: No certified manager; restroom hot water too low
summary: No certified manager was on site while beef, chicken, and pork were prepared and served, and a citation was issued. Upstairs restroom hot water measured 80-82°F; 100°F is required. Torn gaskets on basement prep coolers and a light without a shield were noted.

headline: No certified manager 8:15-9 AM; food too warm
summary: No certified manager was on site from 8:15 to 9:00 AM while chicken was prepared (citation). Chicken mixed with beef measured 50.8°F and eggs 70.4°F; about 5 lbs were discarded. Two employees lacked food handler certificates.

headline: Loose wall coving near cooking area
summary: Lower wall coving was coming loose from the wall left of the flat top in the cooking area. Inspector instructed the facility to seal it to prevent possible insect feeding and harborage.

headline: No certified manager until 2:43 PM
summary: No city certified food service manager was on the premises. A certified manager arrived at 2:43 PM and the issue was corrected on site (citation). Handwashing signs were missing at the front prep sink. Plastic film was wrapped around a prep table leg.

headline: Unlabeled containers; wet wiping cloths
summary: Food storage containers holding flour, sugar, and corn meal were not labeled in the front prep area. Wet wiping cloths were left on the counter. Staff must keep wiping cloths stored in proper sanitizing solution when not in use.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: Sanitation manager has no allergen training. Must be provided. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Unsafe food temperatures; about 40 flies found
summary: Gyro meat on spit held at 129.2°F (135°F minimum); about 15 lbs discarded. Diced chicken at 84.2°F discarded. About 40 or more live small flies around the premises, including on pizza boxes and walls.

headline: No certified manager during initial inspection
summary: Person in charge lacked a sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was present at first inspection while TCS foods were served. Manager arrived 45 minutes later. No health policy, no test strips, dirty prep-area floors, and repeated core violations.

headline: Certified managers lack allergen training
summary: Certified food managers have no allergen training. Management instructed to obtain training and keep certificates on site.

headline: Low water pressure at basement sink
summary: Low water pressure at the basement employee restroom washbowl sink; repair required. Microwave in rear prep area has food debris and grime inside; detail cleaning required. Pass.

headline: Front door gap; no hair restraints
summary: Half-inch gap between front entrance doors must be sealed. Food handlers in produce prep not wearing hair restraints. Single-service items stored on bakery floor must be raised. No hot water at customer men's restroom faucet. Dust and spills on display coolers.

headline: Dust falling onto food; garbage overflowing
summary: Ceiling vents cleaned without protecting food; dust fell onto food storage and equipment, and a tarp is required. Wire shelf above beans and rice hot-hold station could drop items. Garbage piled above dumpster rim with lids open. No handwashing signs in employee restrooms.

headline: Cool handwash water; chicken held at 47.1°F
summary: Handwashing water measured 65.5-83.3°F; minimum 100°F required; citation issued. Chicken held at 47.1°F was discarded. Mold-like buildup inside ice machines must be cleaned. Leaking sink, non-working handsink, and no covered receptacles.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; ice machine buildup
summary: Low-temperature dish machine at 0 ppm chlorine was tagged and cannot be used until reinspected. Black buildup on ice machine in direct contact with ice; ice must be removed. No health policy, hand soap, or vomit cleanup kit.

headline: Cold food too warm; yogurt made without approved plan
summary: Cooked chicken held at 44.6-45.5°F (limit 41°F); about 15 lbs discarded. Yogurt made on site without the required approved food-safety plan; about 15 gallons discarded. Also leaks, rusted shelves, and stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Mouse droppings and flies found throughout
summary: About 50 or more mouse droppings in furnace room and rear food storage. About 10 or more live small and large flies in prep, dishwashing, and toilet areas. No pest logbook, no signed health policies, and no food handler or allergen training.

headline: No pest control service report on site
summary: No pest control service report on site. Facility must contract a licensed exterminator who provides insect and vermin services at least twice a year. Illinois license certificate must be provided. Citation issued.

headline: Dusty ice machine; greasy floor near trap
summary: Rear ice machine interior mildly soiled with dried dust debris. Floor around grease trap under two-compartment sink is soiled with dried food, grease, and other soil. Corrections instructed; no citation.

headline: No hot water in customer men's restroom
summary: No hot water at customer men's restroom sink (74.8°F); must reach 100°F. Another restroom is available. Leaking three-compartment sink base, dirty floor drains, missing floor tiles, and non-working restroom ventilation. Citation issued.

headline: About 50 small flies; no raw-food disclosure
summary: About 50 small flies found in the facility; elimination and pest service on or after 10/20/2025 recommended. Menu lacked raw-food disclosure, corrected on site. Employee washroom lacked soap, corrected on site. Missing light shield in basement salad station.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and backflow device
summary: No handwashing signs in two all-gender restrooms. No backflow device at mop sink. No lidded waste containers in restrooms or waste receptacles at kitchen hand sinks. Exposed ceilings, clutter, stained tile, and dusty exhaust fans.

headline: Dust and debris buildup; damaged wall covering
summary: Debris and possible frozen spillage on walk-in freezer floor. Heavy dust on cooking equipment and in corners of rear storage. Wall covering missing at rear utility sink, exposing the wall; repair needed to prevent pest and insect entry.

headline: No soap or paper towels at prep handsink
summary: Front prep area hand sink had no hand soap and no paper towels. Both instructed to be provided. Pass with conditions.

headline: Unlabeled bulk bins; torn cooler gaskets
summary: Large food storage bins have no labels. One reach-in cooler has heavily torn gaskets. Basement dry storage floor soiled with food debris and dust. Damaged floor tiles and missing baseboard. Greasy exhaust hood and non-working bathroom fan.

headline: Rear door gap; torn freezer gasket
summary: Rear exit door is not fully rodent-proofed; a quarter-inch gap at the bottom must be sealed. Torn gasket on deep freezer door must be repaired or replaced. No pests were noted.

headline: Gap in doors; food handler training expired
summary: Gap in center of street-side double doors must be made tight-fitting to prevent insect entry. Food debris on shelving and sink. Chipping paint, damaged wall base, and debris under cooler. Some food handler training is expired or missing.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedures; no restroom fan
summary: No procedures or supplies for vomiting or diarrheal events. Washroom lacks covered waste receptacle, has dirty toilet and washbowl, and has no mechanical ventilation fan. Pass with conditions.

headline: Gap at south exit door; damaged light shield
summary: A quarter-inch gap at the bottom corner of the south exit door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Damaged light shield inside walk-in cooler must be replaced. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Leaks and grime at warewashing area
summary: Black, moldy caulking at warewashing unit. Leak under the unit and a slow-draining hand sink. Floor drains have excessive organic debris. Cracked light shields in warewashing area. Repairs and cleaning required.

headline: 35-45 droppings found along walls
summary: About 35-45 droppings along wall bases under sinks in rear and middle areas. Manager told to clean all areas and contact pest control. Also wiping cloths not kept in sanitizer, dirty cutting boards and cooking equipment, and greasy floors and hood vents.

headline: Cold foods too warm; service cooler at 69.3°F
summary: Ready foods held at 48.9-62.9°F in service coolers (41°F limit); about 13 lbs ($85) voluntarily discarded. Prep-area service cooler at 69.3°F must not be used until it holds 41°F or below. Citations issued.

headline: No hot water at restroom hand sink
summary: Women's restroom hand sink had no hot water (65.5°F). The person in charge turned up the hot water during the inspection, and it reached 101°F. Hot water of at least 100°F must be kept at all times.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; unlabeled toppings
summary: Missing handwashing sign at front prep hand sink. Condiments and toppings lack common-name labels. Missing cover for toilet room receptacle. Food handlers lack required training; must be obtained and verified on site.

headline: No raw-food advisory; food handlers lack certificates
summary: No consumer advisory or reminder on menu for raw or undercooked foods; required wording instructed. No temperature indicator for high-temperature dish machine. Chest freezer, reach-ins, stove, and hood need cleaning. Several food handlers lack certificates.

headline: Ceiling leak above dish area
summary: Water leaking from the ceiling at the dishwashing area. Dusty kitchen fans and stained ceiling tiles need cleaning or replacing. Serving plates on prep shelves were not stored properly and must be inverted.

headline: Unsafe hot and cold holding; no sanitizer
summary: No valid sanitation certificate on site while TCS foods were served. Dishes washed without sanitizer. Meat pastries held at 107.7-121.1°F (135°F required); cooked chicken 116.2°F; goat 101.4°F. All discarded. Beans cooled too slowly and discarded.

headline: Grease buildup; damaged cooler gaskets
summary: Damaged gaskets on reach-in coolers must be replaced. Heavy grease and food debris on fryer cabinets, cooking equipment, shelving, and prep tables. Missing and damaged basement floor tiles; stained ceiling tiles. Unused items in storage to be removed.

headline: No employee health policy; allergen training missing
summary: No employee health policy or training on site. Stained cutting board, backflow device not accessible at mop sink, loose and cracked floor tiles, and inadequate kitchen lighting. Certified manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Food prepared without hair restraints
summary: Employees in prep area preparing food without hair restraints or protection. Instructed to wear hair restraints or protection at all times.

headline: No raw-food advisory; food handler lacks certificate
summary: No menu reminder that sushi and sashimi are served raw. A food handler had no food handler certificate. Floors behind and under equipment in kitchen were not clean.

headline: Blocked hand sinks; samosas held too cool
summary: Front hand sink was blocked by a cup, Vaseline, and cosmetic bag; rear sink held fries and bags. Items removed during inspection. Samosa at 69.8°F (135°F required) discarded. No probe thermometer, no hand-sink towels, and no food handler or allergen training.

headline: Dust on oven; leaks at several sinks
summary: Dust and grease on bakery prep oven must be cleaned. Leaks at butcher hand sink faucet and pipes under the produce three-compartment sink and bakery hand sink; repair required. Pass.

headline: Splash guard needed; trash near compactor
summary: No splash guard between hand sink and drying surface at meat and seafood department three-compartment sink; must be installed. Indoor compactor access not maintained, with trash and debris on the floor.

headline: Rust on cooler shelves
summary: Rust buildup on two-door cooler shelves near the front. Person in charge instructed to remove rust or replace shelves.

headline: No food handler proof; excess ice and dust
summary: No proof of food handler training for required employees. Employee preparing and serving food without a hair restraint. Excess ice in chest freezer, dusty light shields, and clutter in basement storage. Previous core violations not corrected.

headline: Dirty floors, slow drain, wiping cloth storage
summary: Remove soap dispenser from one-compartment prep sink. Inaccurate thermometer in sauce cooler. Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizer, and soiled cloths were hung on shelving. Slow-draining hand sink; dirty floors and washrooms; water-damaged ceiling tiles.

headline: Dust on walk-in condenser; missing bulb cover
summary: Dust buildup on rear of walk-in cooler condenser must be cleaned. One ceiling light above prep area is missing a bulb cover. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Dirty cutting board, equipment, and floors
summary: Large cutting board needs detail cleaning or replacement to remove dark markings. Sides of cooking equipment need spills removed. Prep and front bar floors need debris removed. Ceiling tiles dusty; air conditioning vents cause dust buildup on walls and ceiling.

headline: Rat droppings found behind oven
summary: Evidence of rats: 20 rat droppings behind a large oven in the rear kitchen. Must notify pest control and remove droppings. Also interiors of coolers and ovens, floors, and outside grease area not clean. No food handler certificates.

headline: 100+ rat droppings; cold foods too warm
summary: About 100 or more rat droppings near fruit cooler, in basement boxes, and throughout storage. Dead rat found; 3-5 live large flies near prep. Ham loaves at 46.4-47.8°F; about 80 lbs ($225) discarded. No health policy, pest logbook, or probe thermometer.

headline: Unshielded sewer lines above food storage
summary: Overhead sewer lines in basement dry storage are not shielded; must be encased to catch drips. Dirty floors with litter under storage racks. Burnt-out light bulbs must be replaced. Pass.

headline: Wiping cloths and sink repairs needed
summary: Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. Women's restroom washbowl needs recaulking. Prep-area hand sink must be repaired so it stops running. Floor drains and walk-in freezer floor have food and debris. One food handler's certificate expired.

headline: No health policy; sewer pipes over dishwashing room
summary: No written employee health policy on premises. Wastewater pipes over basement dishwashing room need a barrier against leaks. Missing self-closing restroom doors, covered receptacle, raised shelving, and moldy caulking. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No basement hand sink; missing certificates
summary: No hand sink in basement dishwashing prep area. No air thermometers inside refrigerators. Outside dumpster overflowing with lids not closed. No food handler certificates on site. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Ice machine dirty; ice discarded
summary: Black dirt buildup inside upper ice machine; ice inside was voluntarily discarded. Also no thermometer in one-door prep cooler, cluttered basement sink, leaking faucet, slow-draining hand sink, and one food handler without training certificate.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; greasy equipment
summary: Handwashing signs needed at all hand sinks. Wiping cloths not kept in sanitizer. Cutting boards need cleaning or replacing. Shelves, tables, cooking equipment, and floors need detail cleaning. Faucet must be replaced. Allergen certificate needed.

headline: No certified manager; no food handler certificates
summary: No City of Chicago certified manager on site. No certificate posted or present. Prep-area hand sink will not drain; plumber arrived during inspection. Reach-in cooler interiors and floors need cleaning. Non-sanitation-certificate staff lack food handler certificates.

headline: Uncovered ingredient bowls; damaged wall base
summary: About 6-10 small bowls of oils and seasonings left uncovered in rear prep area; must be covered. Damaged wall base behind grease trap has food debris inside; must be repaired. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Deeply grooved cutting board; leaking sink divider
summary: Cutting board with deep, dark grooves and heavy stains must be replaced. Three-compartment sink has a gap at the divider, letting water pass between basins. Repair required; plumber's putty is not allowed.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; stripped faucet
summary: Food storage containers with unreadable labels must be relabeled with common names (flour, semolina, salt). Stripped hot handle at one rear dish sink must be repaired. Basement prep and storage floors need cleaning along walls and corners.

headline: Rear door needs rodent-proofing
summary: Rear exit door must be rodent-proofed; correction required. Outside garbage enclosure area needs maintenance. No pests were observed during this inspection.

headline: Live small flies found in dish areas
summary: About 20 live small flies on walls at dish machine room and 10 at pot-wash sink area. Fly activity must be removed by reinspection date; pest control operator advised. Dust on cooler condenser and food debris on dish-area shelves.

headline: No paper towels at prep sinks
summary: No paper towels at hand sinks in two prep areas; supplied by the end of the inspection, and a citation was issued. Bulk beans and rice lack labels. Prep-area sinks not clean. No backflow device at ice machine waterline.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; cold foods too warm
summary: Dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine (50 ppm minimum) and was tagged. Foods held at 45-48°F; about 4 lbs sweet potatoes and a quarter gallon of ranch discarded. Cooler at 48°F removed. Ice machine has pink-black buildup.

headline: Hair restraint missing; rust and grease found
summary: Food handler not wearing a hair restraint; instructed to wear one. No internal thermometer in front reach-in cooler. Rusty storage racks, greasy fryers, dirty walls and floors, and water-stained ceiling tiles.

headline: No certified manager on site; multiple violations
summary: No valid sanitation certificate posted, and no person in charge with a certified manager certificate present. No employee health policy. Some hand sinks lacked soap and paper towels. High-temperature dish machine not operating. Overflowing dumpsters and missing food handler certificates.

headline: Water-damaged ceiling and wall; no handwashing sign
summary: No handwashing sign at basement employee sink. Water-damaged ceiling above rear dishwashing area and water-damaged wall behind basement water tanks must be repaired. Dirt and debris on floor behind tanks must be cleaned.

headline: Cold foods at 68-73°F; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Prep cooler was not turned on; chicken, pork, clams, cooked beef, and more held at 68-72.8°F. About 20 lbs ($277) discarded. Low-temperature dish machine at 0 ppm chlorine, tagged. Fryers uncovered; prior cutting board and cleaning violations not corrected.

headline: Chocolate milk exceeds default calorie limit
summary: Default beverage for children's meals listed as chocolate milk at 140 calories; must be 130 calories or less. Complaint re-inspection passed.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies; dish machines missing
summary: No cleanup supplies for vomiting or diarrheal events; must be provided. Three low-temperature dish machines not installed. No covered waste receptacles in restrooms; unfinished drywall; poor lighting where dishes are washed; certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Women's restroom ventilation not working
summary: Mechanical ventilation is not working in the women's restroom. Repair and maintenance required.

headline: Greasy equipment; restroom needs fixes
summary: Food debris and grease on cooking equipment, coolers, and shelves. Damaged reach-in gasket. Basement restroom lacks covered receptacle, self-closing door, and mechanical ventilation. No waste receptacles at prep hand sinks.

headline: Unlabeled dry ingredients; water on floors
summary: Some dry ingredient containers in rear dim sum prep area are unlabeled. Substantial water on floors in rear prep and dishwashing area. Three blown-out lights in walk-in freezer. Certified manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Sous vide equipment tagged; allergen training expired
summary: Vacuum packing and sous vide equipment recently bought, not in use, and tagged until approved procedures are provided to the health department. Ice machine interior has residue. Certified manager's allergen training has expired.

headline: Floor debris around equipment
summary: Floors around equipment had debris buildup. Manager instructed to clean. This was the only issue noted.

headline: Slimy drain and torn refrigerator gasket
summary: Slimy substance on milk frosty machine drain. Torn gasket on rear prep refrigerator. Food stored in grocery bags inside refrigeration units. Heavy clutter on shelves and floors that could hide pests. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Raw meats stored above ready-to-eat foods
summary: Raw beef stored above chicken broth; raw chicken stored above ready-to-eat tomatoes, mushrooms, and goat cheese. About 10 lbs ($100) voluntarily discarded. Also a cooler door that won't close tightly, foil on prep shelf, and a slow-draining bar sink.

headline: No certified manager; sink water too cool
summary: No certified food manager on site while TCS foods were prepared and served. Men's restroom hand sink water at 64°F; minimum 100°F required. Torn chest freezer gasket and two missing ceiling panels in dry storage.

headline: Cutting boards with open seams and stains
summary: Cutting boards in rear prep area have open seams and dark stains. Must be refinished or replaced. Complaint re-inspection passed.

headline: Unlabeled bulk foods; dirty floors
summary: Bulk food items must be labeled with product name. Floors under three-compartment sink need debris removed along wall base. Pass.

headline: No hair restraint; ice machine residue
summary: Food handler without hair restraint. Pinkish substance inside ice machine must be cleaned and sanitized. No handwashing sign at front prep sink. Backflow device not located on ice machine. Clutter in dry storage.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving
summary: Milk crates used as shelving throughout prep and storage areas. Must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor to allow cleaning. Complaint inspection passed.

headline: No health policy; dish machine at 0 ppm
summary: No employee health policy verification. No hot running water at washroom hand sink (100°F minimum required). Low-temperature dish machine at 0 ppm chlorine must be fixed. Incomplete pest logbook. Worn cutting board, storage racks, and no drain stoppers at three-compartment sink.

headline: No paper towels; sink water at 89°F
summary: No paper towels at production hand sink and employee restroom; fixed immediately. Employee hand sinks had no hot or cold running water (89°F); maintenance called. Broken cooler knobs, ice buildup in walk-in freezer, and dirty exhaust hood.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; live dog inside
summary: Low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine (50-100 ppm required); citation issued. A dog was walking inside the food establishment and must be removed. Overflowing dumpster and improperly stored mops also noted.

headline: Raw wooden backsplash must be sealed
summary: Raw wooden backsplash of the utility service sink must be painted or sealed so it is smooth, cleanable, and non-absorbent. Complaint re-inspection passed.

headline: Torn gasket; leaking prep sink faucet
summary: Torn rubber gasket on two-door reach-in cooler at rear dry and prep area. Leaking faucet at kitchen prep three-compartment sink. Repair and maintenance required. Pass.

headline: No health policies; mesh curtain as screen door
summary: No verified employee health policies on site. Mesh curtain used at rear kitchen exit has an open 3-inch gap. Three-compartment sink repaired with plumber's putty, which is prohibited. Debris and grease in several areas. Mops stored outside.

headline: Missing food handler training; sinks need repair
summary: Employees lack food handler training. Restroom hand sink faucets must stay on for 20 seconds; slow drains at men's and bar sinks. Grease and debris on fryer, shelves, and walk-in; burnt-out lights; dirty hood filters.

headline: Unlabeled flour and rice bins; missing signage
summary: Bulk flour and rice containers lack labels. Missing handwashing sign at front prep sink. Unisex restroom lacks covered waste receptacle. Dust and food debris on floors in storage and warewashing areas; hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Splash guard needed at hand sink
summary: A splash guard must be installed at the hand sink next to the three-compartment sink drain board. No food allergen training for food managers; must be provided and maintained.

headline: Ice machine debris; greasy exhaust filters
summary: Slight debris encrusted inside ice machine; must be removed and the machine detail cleaned. Bulk containers in rear storage room are unlabeled. Kitchen exhaust hood filters have grease buildup that must be cleaned.

headline: Inoperable hand sink; crates used for storage
summary: Additional hand sink in prep area is not operable; must be repaired. Crates used for food storage in walk-in and rear storage must be replaced with shelving. Food debris on floor between ice machine and cooler.

headline: No metal-stem thermometer; freezer ice buildup
summary: No metal-stem thermometer on site to check internal temperature of delivered foods; citation issued. Excessive ice buildup on shelves and doors of rear freezer must be removed and the freezer detail cleaned.

headline: Wiping cloths improperly stored; stained cutting board
summary: Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizing solution when not in use. Prep-line cutting board is heavily stained with deep grooves. Excessive ice buildup on walk-in freezer condenser must be removed.

headline: Dirty dish area floors; allergen training missing
summary: Floors behind and around dish machine and on second-floor prep area need cleaning. Certified manager on duty still lacks allergen training from a prior report; instructed to obtain it. Pass with conditions.

headline: Cooler at 57°F; no hot water at hand sink
summary: Front pizza cooler at 57.1°F, holding TCS food; cooler tagged. Raw hamburgers at 48.7°F; about 7 lbs discarded. No hot water at two hand sinks (about 81.5°F). No health policy, food handler proof, or posted inspection summary.

headline: Unsafe cold and hot holding; food discarded
summary: Cooked turkey at 116.1°F (135°F required). Cooked chicken at 50.2-74.4°F; all discarded. Plastic tub used as a scoop in bulk storage; tumbler with peeling paint discarded from use. Poor walls and no ventilation in employee washrooms. Citation issued.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: Food service sanitation manager lacks a food allergen training certificate. Instructed to meet the requirement. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Eggs left out at 66.2°F; flies found
summary: Five dozen eggs left on counter at 66.2°F; discarded (about $20). About 20-30 flies in basement mop area, dish area, and rear dining room. Last pest service receipt dated 12-28-25. Unlabeled bulk containers and standing wastewater.

headline: Dirty floors and greasy hood vent
summary: Floors under and around equipment have food spills and buildup. Hood vent above cooking equipment needs cleaning. All food handlers need food handler certificates. Instructed to obtain and maintain.

headline: Boxed food on floor; dirty warewashing floors
summary: Boxed food stored on floor in rear dry storage must be raised six inches on shelving. Dirt buildup on floors, along walls, and in corners in rear warewashing area must be cleaned. Pass.

headline: No certified manager during food service
summary: No person in charge present, and no certified food manager while TCS foods (rice, sushi, soups) were prepared and served. Employees drinking and preparing food at prep area. Sushi lab letter dated 2019 expired.

headline: Hair restraint missing; dirty floors and dumpster
summary: Food handler not wearing a hair restraint while preparing TCS foods. Outside dumpster area has trash and debris. Floors under storage racks, crates, sinks, and equipment have food, dirt, and debris buildup.

headline: Food handler certificates needed for all staff
summary: All employees need food handler certificates. Certificate holder needs allergen certificate. Instructed to obtain and maintain both. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Items on cooler floor; dusty fans
summary: Passed. Beverage items stored on the floor of the beverage walk-in must be elevated. Dust on fan covers in the rear walk-in and on the employee washroom vent. Floor under milk items in the rear walk-in needs cleaning.

headline: Employee lacked hair restraint; storage on floor
summary: Passed. An employee prepared and served food without a hair restraint. Items stored on the floor in rear food storage. Ice buildup in a chest freezer; dust in light shields; a burned-out kitchen light bulb must be replaced.

headline: No certified manager; many serious violations
summary: Failed. No City certified food manager certificate on site. Leftover food from the previous operator, with unknown sources, must be discarded. Several coolers not working; no vomit cleanup kit; no pest control logbook; no test strips.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink faucet
summary: Passed. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks from the center area; repair ordered. Shelves, floors, and walls around equipment need cleaning. Light shields and the walk-in cooler floor need cleaning. A water-stained ceiling tile to replace.

headline: Chicken thawed in pot; leaky pipe; dirty equipment
summary: Passed. Frozen chicken was thawing in a large pot; instructed to thaw inside the cooler or under cool running water. Dirty cooking equipment exterior and coolers. Leaky pipe under the rear prep hand sink. Person in charge lacks allergen training.

headline: Milk at 45°F; no employee health policy
summary: Failed. No written employee health policy on the premises; priority violation. Milk at 45°F and walk-in cooler air at 45°F; citations issued. Raw wood shelves, no sanitizer test strips, dirty prep coolers, and no covered waste receptacle.

headline: Torn cooler gasket and broken curtain
summary: Passed. The walk-in cooler has a torn door gasket and the walk-in freezer has a broken plastic curtain. Instructed to replace both and keep them maintained.

headline: Grease and debris throughout prep and storage
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Damaged gaskets on the chicken prep cooler. Grease and debris inside fryer cabinets, coolers, freezers, and shelving. Grease spills on walls and floors in the prep area. Debris around outside dumpsters.

headline: Broken thermometer, torn gasket, dirty cooler
summary: Passed. Rear hand sink has no handwashing sign. Outer thermometer broken and rubber gasket torn on a two-door cooler. Dirty lower surfaces of reach-in units. Floors, walls, and ceiling tiles need cleaning; a light shield is missing.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; missing bins
summary: Passed. Milk crates used as shelving in prep and storage areas must be replaced with shelving six inches off the floor. The women's restroom had no covered receptacle for feminine hygiene products.

headline: Wood pallet storage; poor lighting; sink repairs
summary: Passed. A wood pallet used for storage is not cleanable and plastic crates are used in the walk-in. Three-compartment sink welded area not smooth. Broken caulking at rear hand sink. Walk-in cooler and freezer very dark.

headline: Cold food held too warm; hand sink too cool
summary: Pass with conditions. Cold TCS foods held at 46.0-60.4°F, including butter, half and half, and sliced tomato; manager discarded them (valued at $2); citation issued. Women's washroom hand sink measured 82.2°F; must reach 100°F. No handwashing sign at bar sink.

headline: Dirty fixtures, floors, and freezer interior
summary: Passed. Debris inside an unused ice cream freezer and the deli meat slicer must be removed. Washroom fixtures are dirty. Floors behind fryers, along wall bases, and in corners need cleaning; food splatter on the wall behind prep tables.

headline: Gap under front door; boxes on floor
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap under the front entrance door must be closed to make the door rodent-proof. Food boxes on the floor in rear storage; wiping cloths on prep tables; rusty shelving; broken cooler gasket; missing ceiling tiles.

headline: Flour stored in garbage cans; clutter
summary: Passed. Flour stored in two garbage cans; food-grade containers required. Items on old egg cartons in the walk-in must be raised six inches. Aluminum foil removed from stove area. Clutter near the exit door and a non-working cooler to remove.

headline: No certified manager for 20 minutes during service
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified manager from 2:30 to 2:50 PM while chicken and beef were prepared and served; priority violation, citation issued. Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables; torn freezer gasket; some food handlers lack training.

headline: Shellfish tag dates missing; rear door gap
summary: Failed. No handwashing signs at bar and busing-area sinks. Shellstock tags lacked the date the last shellfish was sold or served; priority citation issued. Opening at the base of the rear door to the alley must be sealed. Dish sink water measured 105.6°F.

headline: No written employee health policy on premises
summary: Pass with conditions. No written employee health policy on the premises. Management was instructed to provide a signed employee health policy for each employee. A priority violation was noted; no citation issued.

headline: Sprayer hangs below sink rim
summary: Passed. The sprayer at the three-compartment sink hangs below the rim of the sink. The operator was instructed to add a device that holds the sprayer above the water rim.

headline: Rust under prep tables needs repair
summary: Passed. Rust has built up on the bottoms of the prep tables in the front area. The person in charge was instructed to repair and keep the surfaces rust-free.

headline: Food in tin cans; ice buildup; greasy container
summary: Pass with conditions. Food inside refrigeration stored in tin cans; must use approved food-grade containers. Ice buildup in basement chest freezer; slow-draining hand sink. Thick grease around the outside grease container; priority citation issued.

headline: Expired certificates; leaking three-compartment faucet
summary: Passed. Some food handler certificates were expired, and the certified food manager's allergen training certificate was expired; both must be renewed. Right faucet on the three-compartment sink leaks at the base. Dirty floors and rusty can opener.

headline: Ready-to-eat pork at 50.7°F; discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. 15 lbs of ready-to-eat pork in a two-door refrigerator measured 50.7°F; cold food must be 41°F or below. Manager voluntarily discarded it (valued at $60); citation issued. Food debris and grease inside a fryer cabinet.

headline: Flies and bees around open garbage; beard lapses
summary: Failed. Alley garbage containers overflowing with the lid open; bees and flies flew in and out. Citation issued. Employees with beards lacked beard restraints; milk crates used for elevation; cracked light shield; debris under low-temperature dish machine.

headline: Pest log lacked 2025 receipts; no backflow device
summary: Pass with conditions. The pest control logbook had no 2025 service receipts; the person in charge added them during inspection; citation issued. Utility sink has no backflow device. Heavy dried food debris under the beverage shelf. Allergen training not corrected from a prior inspection.

headline: Missing splash guard; clutter near dumpster
summary: Passed on re-inspection. No splash guard between the hand sink and drying rack in the kitchen. Unused equipment, umbrellas, and discarded boxes against the dumpster-area wall; instructed to remove them to prevent pests.

headline: Live flies found in basement prep area
summary: Failed. About 15 small black live flies in the basement prep area, on walls, boxes, a sink faucet, and cooler exteriors. Pest control service required; priority citation issued. Ice machine panels have black mold-like buildup dripping onto ice.

headline: Cold-held meats too warm; food discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Turkey at 45.9°F and pork sausage at 44.5-46.7°F in a prep cooler; cold food must be 41°F or below. About 8 lbs (valued at $45) discarded; citation issued. Full previous summary report was not posted.

headline: Dirty floors; water leak at dish area
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Food debris and dirt under cooking equipment, along walls, and in corners in prep and dish areas. Water leaking from a valve onto the dish area floor; dirty floor drains. Serving plates on prep shelves not inverted.

headline: About 60 live flying insects; no certified manager
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on site while TCS food was prepared; citation issued. About 60 live small flying insects on walls in front and prep areas and the rear dish area; extra pest control needed. Citation issued.

headline: Blocked hand sink; no towels; ice machine debris
summary: Pass with conditions. The food prep area hand sink was blocked by multi-use containers and lids; priority citation issued. No paper towels or hand drying device at that sink. Slight debris inside the ice machine. Spilled fruit debris in basement coolers.

headline: 20-30 mouse droppings; pest control needed
summary: Failed. About 20-30 mouse droppings along wall bases behind reach-in coolers, in the furnace area, and under shelves. Cleaning and pest control ordered; priority citation issued. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer; slow hand sink; mop sink not connected.

headline: Hot food too cool; dish machine sanitizer missing
summary: Failed. No City certified food manager present. Hot food at 100-112°F must be held at 135°F or above. Low-temperature dish machine had no sanitizer; tagged out of use until reinspected. Cold food bar lacks a protective barrier.

headline: Broken cooler, no sink stopper, greasy walls
summary: Passed. An unused three-door cooler in the rear prep area does not work; repair or remove it. No sink stopper for the three-compartment sink. Heavy grease and dirt on walls in the rear prep and dish area; grease on the cook-line hood.

headline: Cold food too warm; 20 lbs discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Meatballs at 50°F in a refrigerator; broccoli cheddar soup and sliced cheese at 48-49°F. Food must be held at 41°F or below. About 20 lbs (valued at $100) discarded. Refrigerator air measured 47°F; citation issued.

headline: Soap, towels, and hot water problems; citations issued
summary: Pass with conditions. Hand sinks lacked soap and paper towels; staff supplied them during inspection. A hand sink measured 70°F; a technician then brought sinks to 102-105°F. Milk crates used as shelving; no sanitizer test kit.

headline: Certified manager missing allergen training
summary: Passed. The City of Chicago certified manager is missing allergen training. The operator was instructed to obtain it and keep verification on site.

headline: No health policy; cold food and sewage backups
summary: Failed. No employee health policy and no vomit/diarrhea cleanup procedure; priority citations. Chicken and pasta at 55-69°F; 25 lbs (valued at $350) discarded. Two prep coolers at 53-57°F, not to be used. Wastewater backs up into floor drains.

headline: Front door gap; leaking sprayer; ceiling repairs
summary: Passed. A gap in the lower center of the front double doors must be made tight-fitting. Rust on walk-in shelving; grease and debris on fryer cabinets; leaking three-compartment sprayer; stained and missing ceiling tiles; one manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Rear door gap; warped dishwashing floor
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Rear exit door has about a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom; instructed to pest-proof it. Warped and loose flooring in the rear dishwashing area must be repaired to a smooth, cleanable surface.

headline: Ice machine debris; hair restraint lapse corrected
summary: Passed. Encrusted debris inside the rear large ice machine must be removed and the unit serviced. Two male managers in the prep area had no hair restraints; corrected during inspection. Hand sink drain leak to repair.

headline: Rodent droppings in meat area; hand sinks blocked
summary: Failed. About 5-10 rodent droppings in the meat department; pest control service ordered and citation issued. Meat-area hand sink had no soap or paper towels and was blocked by a knife. Food stored on floor.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; damaged cooler floor
summary: Passed. No handwashing signs in the men's or women's restrooms. Walk-in cooler floor is badly damaged and torn. Water-damaged dining room ceiling tiles. Person in charge instructed to provide signs and make repairs.

headline: Grease under fryers; floors need cleaning
summary: Passed. Grease at the bottom of the fryers must be removed; exterior of cooking equipment needs cleaning. Floors under and around equipment, inside the walk-in, and in the washroom need cleaning. New food handlers and managers need training.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; faucet leak
summary: Passed. Expired food handler training certificates found; staff must obtain valid ones. Leak at a three-compartment sink faucet to be repaired. Cooking equipment and an ice machine panel need cleaning.

headline: Hand sink blocked by boxes; citation issued
summary: Pass with conditions. Rear dish area hand sink was blocked by cardboard boxes; citation issued. Also no handwashing signs, torn cooler gaskets, dirt on floors and walls, and no public summary posted. A new summary was left for posting.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen training
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign at the front prep sink. Bulk containers unlabeled; food stored on walk-in floor. No food handler training for some employees; certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; peeling cooler paint
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign in the restroom; no sink signage on the three-compartment sink. Non-food-grade totes used for food. Build-up on walk-in and freezer shelving; peeling paint on walk-in door and floor; residue on ceiling tiles near smokers.

headline: Front prep hand sink not draining; water on floor
summary: Failed on re-inspection. The front prep area hand sink is not draining, and water is leaking onto the kitchen floor. The manager was instructed to repair and maintain the hand sinks; a priority foundation violation was noted.

headline: Gaps and holes to outside need sealing
summary: Failed. About a 1-inch gap around the driver and passenger doors, plus open holes to the outside near the rear door, water heater, and between the grill and prep cooler. Owner ordered all sealed and rodent-proofed.

headline: No certified manager; sanitation records missing
summary: Failed. No person in charge held a valid certificate, and no certified manager was on duty while TCS food was served; citation issued. No employee health policy, no vomit cleanup kit, no pest control logbook, and no sanitizer test kit.

headline: Seal bakery floor beneath ovens
summary: Passed. The bakery floor beneath the ovens and around the patched diamond-plate areas must be sealed.

headline: Rear door gap; missing food handler training proof
summary: Passed. A gap under the rear exit door could let pests in. No proof of food handler training for any food handler. Milk crates used as shelving, grease buildup, and a moldy-looking ceiling tile over a prep table. Repairs ordered.

headline: Storage, labeling, and food handler training gaps
summary: Passed. Ice scoop left exposed on the drink station. Unlabeled food in zip-lock bags in a two-door refrigerator; wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces; utensils not inverted above the grill. Milk crates used as shelving. No food handler training proof.

headline: Raw burgers too warm; food discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Raw burgers at 54.4°F and Swiss cheese at 49.3°F in a 4-door cooler; manager voluntarily discarded 12 lbs (valued at $50). Cold TCS food must be at 41°F or below; citation issued. Gap under patio door; torn cooler gaskets.

headline: Gap at rear door; compressor drain leak
summary: Passed. A gap at the bottom of the rear service-area door, left of the walk-in cooler, must be sealed to prevent insects. A reach-in refrigerator has exposed siding and a cooler needs a gasket. Leak in the walk-in compressor drain line.

headline: Walk-in cooler at 60°F; no health policy
summary: Failed. The walk-in cooler air temperature is 60°F and is not holding proper cold temperature; must be repaired to 41°F or colder; priority violation. No written employee health policy on premises; priority violation. Three washroom doors lack self-closing devices.

headline: No certified manager; pest log still missing
summary: Failed on re-inspection. No certified food manager on site while deli meat and chicken were handled and served; priority violation. Prior pest control violation not corrected: no pest control logbook or proof of service.

headline: Residue inside cold-hold units; greasy filters
summary: Passed. Residue has built up inside all cold-hold units in the front prep area. Grease on hood filters. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain both.

headline: Broken thermometer in lettuce prep cooler
summary: Passed. The cooling unit in the lettuce prep area has a broken thermometer. The operator was instructed to replace it and keep it maintained.

headline: Clean walk-in cooler floor under shelving
summary: Passed. The floor inside the walk-in cooler, underneath the shelving, must be cleaned to remove spills and debris.

headline: No certified manager on site; no food handler training
summary: Pass with conditions. No person in charge held a valid Chicago food sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was on site when potentially hazardous (TCS) food was served; citation issued. No food handler training available.

headline: Ceiling condensate drain runs into sink
summary: Pass with conditions. A condensate drain line from the ceiling empties into the three-compartment sink basin. Management was instructed to reroute it to a mop sink or another drain not used for food preparation or dishwashing; priority violation noted.

headline: Wastewater backs up into floor; sink leaks
summary: Failed. Wastewater backed up from a floor drain with dirt, grease, and food particles when the three-compartment sink drained; priority citation issued. Dishwasher drain empties into the sink. Repairs and rerouting ordered.

headline: Unprotected fresh water inlet; corrected on site
summary: Pass with conditions. The fresh water inlet was not protected. The manager provided adequate protection during the inspection. The inlet must be kept protected at all times; priority violation noted.

headline: Hand sink blocked by pans; open windows
summary: Pass with conditions. The kitchen hand sink was not accessible; pans were stored inside it. No citation issued. Dining-area windows are open without screens. Water-stained ceiling tiles in the women's restroom. Dirty storage closet floor. A food handler lacks a certificate.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure; no ice machine backflow
summary: Pass with conditions. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or spill kit on site; must be provided. No backflow prevention device at the ice machine water line; must be installed where it can be serviced.

headline: Sanitizer failures corrected on site; cold food too warm
summary: Pass with conditions. Two dish machines were not sanitizing; both were corrected on site. Omelette station items at 58°F were discarded; cold food must stay at 41°F or below. Priority citations issued.

headline: Slow hand sink and leaking faucets
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Prep area hand sink drains slowly and its cold faucet handle is loose. Three-compartment sink faucet leaks and is wrapped in plastic. Proper stoppers missing; plastic wrap used instead.

headline: No certified manager; no food handler certificates
summary: Pass with conditions. No City certified food sanitation manager on site while TCS food such as chicken was prepared; priority citation issued. No food handler certificates or allergen training on site. Torn cooler gasket.

headline: Paper cups used as stoppers; leaky water filter
summary: Passed. The ice scoop holder cannot be removed; instructed to clean it as needed. Paper cups used to hold water at the three-compartment sink; proper sink stoppers required. Leaky water filter above the food prep area to be repaired.

headline: Employee lacked hair restraint in prep area
summary: Passed on re-inspection. An employee in the food prep area had no hair restraint. The manager was instructed to provide hair restraints for all employees in the food prep area.

headline: About 30 dead moth flies in basement storage
summary: Passed. About 30 dead moth flies on the floor of the basement dry storage room. Food and utensils stored under unshielded sewer and wastewater lines. Trash can lid missing; cooler gaskets not sealing.

headline: No handwashing signs; no food handler training proof
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign near the front bar sink. No proof of food handler training for any food handler. Ice machine needs cleaning, grease under cooking equipment, and unlabeled food containers.

headline: Deli cups not air-dried; dim basement cooler
summary: Passed. Deli cups were not air-dried properly after washing and must air-dry before stacking. The basement walk-in cooler has inadequate light; additional lights required.

headline: Ice buildup, damaged gaskets, and floor tiles
summary: Pass with conditions. Ice buildup inside the walk-in freezer and damaged freezer door gaskets. The facility has submitted a variance request to the health department for outside bathrooms. Damaged floor tiles near the entrance; utility sink lacks a seal.

headline: Pest gaps, missing pest log, sewage backup
summary: Failed. No written employee health policy; priority violation. Rear west door gap larger than 1/4 inch; no pest control logbook; priority citation issued. Low-temperature dish machine backs up wastewater into a sink. Bathrooms lack self-closing doors and covered trash cans.

headline: Missing signage and labels; allergen training gap
summary: Passed. No handwashing signage at the lower-level prep sink. Food containers, including cocoa and sugar, are unlabeled. The sanitation manager lacks allergen training. Items must be provided.

headline: Expired allergen certificate; storage issues
summary: Passed. A certified food manager has an expired allergen training certificate. Thermometers needed inside all coolers. Some food containers unlabeled; ice scoop stored on top of ice; raw wood at the service counter; clutter in storage areas.

headline: Dirty ice machines; ice discarded; door gaps
summary: Failed. Black dirt buildup inside ice machines dripped into ice; all ice voluntarily discarded; priority citation issued. 1/4-inch gaps at both front entrance doors must be rodent-proofed. No food handler training certificates on premises.

headline: Hair restraints missing; food debris on equipment
summary: Passed. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. A soiled wiping cloth hung on a hand sink splashguard. Food debris on the shake mixer, slicer, prep tables, and coolers. Dust and grease on hood filters; bulk container unlabeled.

headline: Small grease spill under fryers and grill
summary: Passed. A small amount of grease on the floor under the fryers and grill. The operator was instructed to clean where needed.

headline: Labeling and storage issues; no pests reported
summary: Passed. Dry food in plastic containers needs labels with common names. Single-use containers must be inverted on shelves. Encrusted can opener blade, grease in the deep fryer, and grease under cooking equipment. Women's washroom receptacles need covers.

headline: Clutter, unlabeled items; expired allergen training
summary: Passed. A bowl without a handle was used to scoop food in a reach-in freezer. Plates not inverted and clutter in the basement prep area. Food on the floor. Certified managers' allergen training certificate expired.

headline: Ice machine and floors need cleaning
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Brownish substance inside the ice machine must be cleaned and sanitized. Excessive dirt and grease under cooking equipment, grease on vents, and dust in dry storage closets. Cleaning ordered.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; clutter
summary: Passed. Milk crates used as shelving in the produce walk-in must be replaced with shelving at least six inches off the floor. Boxes and chemical bottles on break room floor; clutter in produce storage where staff keep personal belongings.

headline: Brown grime in hand sink basin
summary: Passed. Brown grime has built up in the basin of a hand sink near the espresso machine. The operator was instructed to detail clean and maintain it.

headline: Hand sink too hot; leaks; gaps in door and walls
summary: Failed. Hand sink near the laundry machine measured 129.5°F, above the 120°F maximum; citation issued. No thermometer in the McCafe cooler. 1/4-inch gap at the rear receiving door; food spills and debris in floor drains and cooler areas; openings in walls.

headline: Detail cleaning needed in cooler and cooking areas
summary: Passed. The walk-in cooler floor needs detail cleaning of dirt and food debris. Grease, dirt, and debris under and beside cooking equipment must be cleaned to prevent pests. Floors near the coffee station and pizza oven need cleaning; dust near a rear vent.

headline: No food handler certificates on premises
summary: Passed. No food handler certificates were on the premises. Management was instructed that all food handling employees must provide a food handler training certificate.

headline: Ice scoop stored on ice; leaky sink faucet
summary: Passed. Ice scoop stored on top of the ice machine must go in a clean container. Leaky faucet base at the three-compartment sink must be repaired. No covered waste receptacle in the employee washroom; dirt behind refrigeration and dust in vents.

headline: Certified manager missing allergen training certificate
summary: Passed on re-inspection. The certified food manager is missing a food allergen training certificate. All City certified managers must have allergen training certificates.

headline: Soap and towels above sink; dusty hood filters
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Soap and paper towels mounted on the wall above the three-compartment sink must be removed. Dusty filters at the ventilation hood in the rear prep and dish area must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Leaking pipe under men's restroom sink
summary: Passed. Black plastic bowls on the line shelf were stored faced up and must be inverted. Food debris between gaskets of reach-in prep coolers. Leaking pipe under the men's restroom hand sink to be repaired.

headline: Milk crates as shelving; missing backflow device
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Milk crates used as shelving in prep and storage must be replaced with raised shelving. Food-encrusted storage racks; dirty reach-in coolers; utility sink lacks a backflow device; food debris and spills throughout.

headline: Repeat backflow violation not corrected
summary: Failed on re-inspection. A prior priority violation was not corrected in time: the basement hose has no backflow prevention device. The manager was instructed to provide one; citation issued.

headline: Debris on walk-in and dry storage floors
summary: Passed. Debris on the walk-in cooler floor and on the floor of the rear dry storage area. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain both areas.

headline: No soap at hand sink; damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Pass with conditions. No soap at an exposed hand sink in the rear prep area; management supplied soap during inspection; citation issued. Slow-draining hand sink; dirty floor drains; unused two-door cooler to remove; damaged ceiling tiles.

headline: No certified manager on arrival; hot water too cool
summary: Failed. No City certified manager on site on arrival; citation issued. An employee dumped coffee into the kitchen hand sink. Men's restroom hot water reached only 72°F (minimum 100°F). Cream cheese at 62°F discarded (6 lbs, $15).

headline: Greasy fryers; leaking three-compartment drain
summary: Passed. Grease and possible food debris on the sides of two deep fryers. Leaking drain pipe under the three-compartment sink wash basin. Grease buildup on the floor around cooking equipment. Repairs and cleaning instructed.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods prepared
summary: No valid city-certified manager was on duty while chicken, eggs, and grits were prepared and served. Citation issued. Reach-in coolers, the freezer, floors, and the cooking-area filter all need cleaning.

headline: Dirty ice machine; leaking cooler and sink
summary: Ice machine compartments not clean; ice is for human consumption and must be cleaned and sanitized. Walk-in condenser is leaking with ice buildup, the three-compartment faucet base is corroded, and only two of four managers have allergen certificates.

headline: Small flies found; no hot water
summary: About 20 small flies were found throughout, including bars and the kitchen near the dish area; manager told to reduce them. Citation issued. No hot water anywhere (maximum 67°F). Plumber arrived to service the water heater.

headline: No certified person in charge; citation issued
summary: Person in charge lacked a valid city sanitation certificate; citation issued. The front food prep area has no handwashing sink, and the dish-area sink is blocked. Outside garbage and grease containers were excessively dirty; citation issued.

headline: Dirty dry storage; missing grout and tiles
summary: Fifth-floor dry storage has dirt buildup on the floor, racks, and shelves. Prep floor tiles are missing grout. Dish and prep area ceiling tiles are missing or damaged, and dry storage floor paint is peeling.

headline: Rodent droppings; cold foods too warm; citations
summary: About 100 rodent droppings under sinks, the customer counter, the water heater, and in the toilet room, plus live flies in prep areas. Walk-in cooler at 57°F was tagged and held. Cold TCS foods were discarded. No employee health policy.

headline: Re-inspection: rust and worn cutting boards
summary: Rust must be removed from the exterior of the grease trap at the three-compartment sink. Worn, grooved cutting boards on top of prep coolers must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Soiled ice machine cleaned on site
summary: Ice machine interior was soiled with visible red residue. Staff discarded the ice and cleaned and sanitized it on site. Juice dispenser splashes, a mop drying against a wall, and floor debris were also noted.

headline: Clutter near cooler and toilet rooms
summary: Clutter in the breaker area next to the walk-in cooler and near second-floor toilet rooms. Staff told to remove unnecessary items to prevent pest harborage.

headline: No handwashing sinks in restrooms or bar
summary: No handwashing sinks in restrooms or the bar; instructed to install them. No consumer advisory on the menu for undercooked or raw foods; instructed to add one.

headline: Raw meat over produce; cooling and dish failures
summary: Raw eggs, chicken, and beef were stored above produce and prepared food; manager removed all affected foods. Large containers of hot stew and soup cooled improperly; some discarded. Dishes washed without sanitizer. No certified manager on site.

headline: Raw eggs too warm; discarded; citation issued
summary: Raw eggs measured 63.6°F to 70.3°F in the rear prep cold-hold unit. About 3 pounds ($40) were discarded. Citation issued. Also: bowls and pans not inverted, stained cutting boards, and leaking backflow devices in the dish area.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; no pest log
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and was not to be used until fixed; maintenance was called. A steak vacuum-packed without a HACCP plan or variance was discarded. No pest control log on site. Citation issued.

headline: No health policies or food handler training
summary: No signed employee health policies, food handler training, or food manager allergen training. Citations issued. A summary report was not displayed; a new one was given. Also: hole in wall, stained ceiling tile, and floor debris.

headline: Floors need cleaning around stove and cooler
summary: Floors around the stove and inside the walk-in cooler must be cleaned, with spills and debris removed.

headline: Trays on floor; deep grooves; light out
summary: Multi-use trays on the rear floor must be raised 6 inches. Cutting boards with deep, dark grooves must be removed or repaired. Toilet room light is out and must be replaced.

headline: Dirty fryers, floors, and cutting board
summary: Rusty can opener, a deep-grooved, stained cutting board, and greasy deep fryers need cleaning. Cooler and freezer interiors have spills. Cracked bar and prep floors need repair; floor drains are heavily soiled.

headline: Fryers need cleaning; wall openings and doors
summary: Interior of deep fryers must be cleaned. Both restroom doors lack self-closing devices; management instructed to install them. Openings in walls behind the three-compartment sink must be sealed.

headline: Re-inspection: no certified manager allergen training
summary: No certified food manager with allergen training was on site. Documentation must be provided.

headline: Re-inspection: washroom door and trash can
summary: The washroom door is not self-closing; manager instructed to repair it. The unisex toilet room lacks covered receptacles; manager instructed to provide them.

headline: Unlabeled containers and desserts; dirty floors
summary: Large bulk containers and desserts for sale are unlabeled. Cutting boards have deep, dark grooves. Floor tiles are missing or damaged, and floors under fryers and coolers are sticky and need detail cleaning. Manager needs allergen training.

headline: Sink pipe leak; missing allergen certificate
summary: A leak from the pipe under the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Grease on fryer bottoms and a can opener with buildup need cleaning. Dusty ceiling vents need cleaning. Person in charge lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: No certified manager during food prep; citation
summary: Person in charge lacked a city sanitation certificate, and no certified food manager was present while TCS foods were prepared and served. Citation issued. Also: missing hair restraint, leaking sink faucet, and several prior violations uncorrected.

headline: Dirty mop water and floors behind freezers
summary: Standing wastewater was in the mop bucket and must be discarded after cleaning. Floors behind deep freezers in rear storage need debris removed. Ceiling vents and light shields need dust removed.

headline: Dust and debris buildup throughout facility
summary: Debris and residue on the low-temperature dish machine, dust on cooler fans, and food debris on floors in garage storage, around the dish machine, soda closet, and basement. Management told to clean and maintain.

headline: No certified manager on site; citation issued
summary: No city-certified food manager was on site while pork and ham were prepared and served. Citation issued. Also: torn cooler gasket, no ventilation over the grill, a food handler without certificate, and a prior allergen violation uncorrected.

headline: Dishwasher not sanitizing; pests found
summary: Dishwasher had 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged until it sanitizes. Dead bugs were in the three-compartment sink basins. Opening at the rear exit door must be rodent-proofed. Deep fryer left uncovered and not in service.

headline: Hand soap missing; expired allergen certificates
summary: Front and rear handsinks had no hand soap; a food handler supplied it during inspection; citation issued. Fly traps above cold units were not from a pest control company. Missing splash guard, leaking drainpipe, and expired certificates.

headline: No certified manager; ice machine buildup
summary: No certified food manager on premises while TCS foods were prepared and served. Citation issued. Ice machine had black buildup, dish racks and milk were on the floor, a pizza-station sink was inoperable, and no sanitizer test kit was available.

headline: Women's toilet cleaned on site
summary: The women's washroom toilet needed cleaning and was corrected on site. Floors around and behind heavy kitchen and storage equipment need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; missing health policy
summary: Person in charge lacked a valid city manager certificate or proof of enrollment. No certified manager on site during TCS food service. No employee health policy provided. Citations issued for these violations.

headline: Pet dog inside; door sweep and storage issues
summary: A customer's pet dog was inside; only service animals are allowed. Manager said staff never ask; signage given and citation issued. Damaged rear door sweep must be repaired. Soda syrup boxes were stored in the electrical closet.

headline: Sinks not connected to water; no health policy
summary: No employee health policy. Two handsinks and two dump sinks at both bars are not connected to water (priority violation). Backflow devices are missing at two ice machines and a coffee machine. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Handwashing sinks blocked; food on floor
summary: Handwashing sinks blocked by bottles, funnels, and pitchers in the bar, and a drainpipe missing under the dish area sink; citation issued. Food stored on prep floor, residue in ice machine, leaking faucet, and food debris under equipment.

headline: Hair restraints needed; wooden sink support
summary: Food handlers in the prep area lacked adequate hair and beard restraints. A wooden plank supporting three-compartment sink plumbing must be replaced with smooth, cleanable material. Walk-in cooler lighting is too dim.

headline: Pink residue inside ice machine panel
summary: A small amount of pink residue was found on the interior panel of the ice machine. Staff were instructed to schedule cleaning and maintenance.

headline: Food manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: One food manager lacked a food allergen training certificate. All city-certified food managers must have allergen training certificates.

headline: Grease under grill; missing allergen records
summary: Slight grease and debris under the tabletop grill, and dirty floors under the sink and fryer, need cleaning. No certified food manager on duty had allergen training records on site.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: The certified manager on duty lacked the required allergen training. Management was instructed to provide and maintain it.

headline: Packaging tape on drains; loose faucet handle
summary: Floor drains in the front prep area are covered with non-cleanable packaging tape and must be cleaned. The women's washroom faucet handle is loose. One food employee lacked food handler training.

headline: Flies in dish room and dining area; citation
summary: About 25-30 small flies were in the dish room and 15-20 in the dining area near soda dispensers. Pest control services instructed; citation issued. Grease on the hot holding unit and a cluttered janitor closet were also noted.

headline: Re-inspection: heavy grime needs detail cleaning
summary: Re-inspection passed, but many areas need detail cleaning: cooler door tracks, cooking equipment, plumbing fixtures, floors, and hood vents. All cutting boards must be replaced. Toilet room needs a lidded trash can.

headline: Missing signs, labels, and sink repairs
summary: No handwashing signs at the front bar and basement prep sinks. Bulk food containers are unlabeled. Rusty shelving in the basement walk-in cooler must be repainted or replaced. Front bar handwashing sink drains slowly and must be repaired.

headline: Cardboard and milk crates used as shelving
summary: Cardboard lines shelves in dry storage, and milk crates are used for elevation. Staff told to remove them to prevent pest hiding places. Also noted: walk-in freezer ice buildup, rusty bakery racks, and dirty bathroom ceiling tiles.

headline: Worn cutting board and dirty facility areas
summary: The last cutting board on the prep table is worn with deep cuts and must be replaced. Toilet rooms need detail cleaning, debris is on the ground by the garbage container, and walk-in freezer and cooler floors need cleaning.

headline: Missing thermometer and sink stoppers
summary: The small refrigerator in the beverage prep area lacks a visible, working thermometer. The three-compartment dishwashing sink is missing stoppers. Cabinet interiors behind the beverage prep area need detail cleaning.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup kit
summary: No employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure, or spill kit was found. Missing handwashing sign, hanging thermometers for two reach-in coolers, and a backflow device at the ice machine waterline. All must be provided.

headline: Greasy cooking equipment; dirty ceiling and floors
summary: Grease and food debris on all cooking equipment. No handwashing sign at kitchen sink. Floor drains, water-damaged restroom ceiling tiles, dusty prep ceiling, and greasy hood filters must be cleaned or repaired.

headline: No verifiable certified manager; citation issued
summary: Food handlers prepared TCS foods without a verifiable original city certificate on site. Certificate must stay posted, and a certified manager must be present during TCS food operations. Citation issued. Also: peeling paint on floors and hood.

headline: Dirty deli slicer; facility repairs needed
summary: The deli meat slicer was not clean; manager told to clean and sanitize more often. Floors and walls in the rear liquor and compactor area need cleaning. Ceiling tiles and light shields in the second-floor lunch room are damaged.

headline: Deeply cut cutting board needs replacing
summary: The cutting board at the kitchen line deli cooler has deep cuts and stains. It must be cleaned and sanitized, then restored or replaced.

headline: Floors need cleaning; training reminder
summary: Floors around cooking equipment have spills or debris and need cleaning. Manager was instructed to comply with food handler training requirements.

headline: No hair restraints; dirty cutting boards and floors
summary: Food handlers in the prep area lacked hair restraints. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer. Cutting boards are grooved and stained. Storage racks are dusty, and floors under cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Pink substance in ice bin; cooler gasket broken
summary: Pink substance on the ice bin and ice machine panel must be cleaned and sanitized; ice is for human consumption. Splash guards are needed near the handwashing sink and ice bin. Broken cooler gasket and greasy utility connections noted.

headline: Rodent droppings found; citation issued
summary: About 30 droppings along the wall in the hallway to the rear restroom and 20 under the front food counter. Pest control service required before re-inspection; citation issued. Cardboard liners, a missing splash guard, and greasy grease traps also noted.

headline: Missing backflow device at mop sink
summary: No backflow prevention device on the mop sink faucet; management instructed to install one. Floor under the three-compartment sink needs cleaning.

headline: Vacuum packaging without required HACCP plan
summary: Vacuum packaging machine was on site without a HACCP plan (food safety plan) for this location. Manager showed approval from another location and was told to apply. An approved variance is needed before vacuum packaging TCS foods.

headline: Sushi area contamination risks; dead bugs found
summary: Sushi sink lacks a handwashing sign, and a paper towel holder sits above clean plates. Plants above the sushi line and food storage are a contamination source. Dead bugs in sink basins. Outside grease bins heavily buildup; citation issued.

headline: Slow sink; managers lack allergen certificates
summary: The handsink outside the front bar drains slowly and must be repaired. Multiple food service managers lacked allergen awareness training certificates. Person in charge was told to make sure they obtain and keep certificates on site.

headline: Utensil stored with food; milk crates used
summary: A utensil was stored in a container with food in the cold-hold display case; person in charge told to keep between-use utensils in sanitizer. Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced with 6-inch shelving. Hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Missing thermometers; tiles and floors need repair
summary: Reach-in coolers lack visible thermometers and need detail cleaning. Missing floor grout, damaged stair tiles, missing dining and dish area ceiling tiles, and dirty floor under cooking equipment must be repaired or cleaned.

headline: Invalid certificate corrected; mold-like buildup
summary: Person in charge showed an invalid sanitation certificate; a valid one was delivered before inspection ended; citation issued. Black and pink mold-like substance inside the basement ice machine. Uncovered utensils were covered on site. Opening at front door base must be sealed.

headline: Re-inspection: front door gap; greasy fryers
summary: A gap along the bottom of the front door must be made tight-fitting. Grease and food debris in fryer cabinets and wheel bases must be cleaned. Damaged concrete floor in front of the fryer cabinets needs repair.

headline: Temporary repairs and storage clutter
summary: Duct tape used to repair sushi cooler and sink piping, and a torn cooler gasket. Raw wood shelving, wall and floor cracks, a dirty oven, and greasy pipes need attention. Unused items must be removed and stored items elevated.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; chipped paint
summary: Milk crates serve as shelving in prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Chipped kitchen and storage closet walls must be repainted to be smooth and cleanable.

headline: No hand soap at front sink; priority violation
summary: No hand soap at the front kitchen handwashing sink; instructed to provide it (priority violation). No handwashing signs in restrooms. Knives wedged against cooler edge, food debris behind ice maker, and dust near rear vents.

headline: Flies in trash and food areas; citation issued
summary: About 30 small and large flies were found, including on indoor trash, the floor, and the food slicer. Pest control consultation needed; citation issued. Raw meat spills and rust in walk-in cooler, greasy fryers, and no proof of food handler or allergen training.

headline: No service sink on site
summary: No service sink was on site. The manager was instructed to install one.

headline: No sanitizer for dishes; repeat violation
summary: No sanitizer on site for the three-compartment dish sink; priority violation, citation issued. Repeat violation: two missing splash guards at the kitchen handwashing sink were not corrected. Torn cooler gasket and grill on rear patio.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; repaired on site
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and was not sanitizing. An Ecolab technician repaired it before the inspection ended. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Rodent droppings found; no vomit kit
summary: Over 10 mouse droppings behind store shelving, about 20 in the furnace room, and about 100 rat droppings in the basement. Pest control recommended. No vomit and diarrhea procedure or kit. No service sink or toilet room ventilation.

headline: No certified manager; discarded cold foods
summary: No certified manager on site while TCS foods were served, and no sanitation certificate was posted. No written employee health policy. Coleslaw and sauces held above 41°F were discarded. Citation issued.

headline: Re-inspection: unlabeled containers, sink valves
summary: Small clear containers above prep coolers lack labels. Ice machine interior needs cleaning, with slight black buildup. Handwashing sinks cannot fully shut off; valves below must be repaired so knobs control water flow.

headline: Mouse droppings throughout; pest service needed
summary: At least 75 mouse droppings were found by the ice freezer, under display shelves, at the service counter, and on pallets in rear storage. Pest control service recommended; citation issued. Also noted: cluttered storage, defrosting needed, and burnt-out lights.

headline: Hair restraints missing; a worker untrained
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Single-use items stored on floors must be raised six inches. Debris was found on basement storage floors. One employee lacks food handler training.

headline: Re-inspection: no food handler training proof
summary: Re-inspection passed, but no food handler training proof or certificates were on site. Food employees without certified manager training must have food handler training and keep certificates on site.

headline: No vomit kit, no hot water, overflowing dumpster
summary: No vomit and diarrhea kit, as city code requires. No hot water on the premises. Outside dumpster area overflowing with large debris. Damaged walls, dirty floors, and a toilet room without working ventilation.

headline: Greasy hood and light fixtures above ovens
summary: Heavy grease and dust are on the ventilation hood and light fixtures above pizza ovens. Manager instructed to clean the hood and maintain adequate ventilation to prevent buildup.

headline: Re-inspection: drinks in prep area; labels
