summary: Employee bottled drinks were uncapped on prep counters and stored in a food cooler; a separate storage place is required. Labels are missing on frosting and chocolate items. Wiping cloths are improperly stored, and the walk-in has ice buildup.

headline: Earlier violations uncorrected; citation issued
summary: Violations from a 12/8/23 inspection were not corrected: fryer filled with excess grease, slow-draining bar three-compartment sink, and cracked food prep floor tile. Citation issued.

headline: Re-inspection: torn prep cooler gasket
summary: Re-inspection passed. The torn door gasket inside the two-door prep cooler under the meat counter must be replaced.

headline: Dirty rear storage floors; dusty vents
summary: Rear storage floors need cleaning, and miscellaneous items must be elevated at least 6 inches off the floor. Vents above prep tables have excessive dirt and dust buildup and must be cleaned.

headline: Handwashing sink blocked; corrected on site
summary: The only rear handwashing sink was blocked by a speed rack and shelving. Manager removed the items on site; citation issued. Also: onions stored under soiled paper bags, missing hair restraints, and rice on dry storage floors.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit or written procedure
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or written procedures were on site; management instructed to provide them. Citation issued. Also: torn gasket on a three-door reach-in cooler and a missing light shield in the dishwashing area.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; wet mop stored in bucket
summary: Torn gaskets on the inside of the taco cooler and tall two-door cooler must be repaired. A wet mop was stored in the mop bucket in the rear dishwashing area; manager told to hang mops to dry.

headline: Greasy floor drains; mops stored on floor
summary: Heavy food debris and grease are in floor drains in the oven, prep, and dishwashing areas and must be cleaned. Mops are stored on the floor in the mop sink area; manager told to dry them so they do not soil floors and walls.

headline: Signage, thermometers, and cleaning needed
summary: Handwashing signage missing in the dining area; thermometers needed inside all coolers. Chest freezer is heavily iced, grill is greasy, a cold faucet handle is stripped, and one certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Over 30 flying insects; citation issued
summary: Over 30 flying insects were on walls, shelves, ceiling, and equipment in the bar and dining area. Premises must be treated after consulting a pest control company. Citation issued. A cutting board and leaking faucet from a prior visit were not fixed.

headline: Summary not posted; food handler training gap
summary: One food employee worked without food handler training; all employees must complete it and keep records on site. No inspection summary was posted for public view; a new one was left. Citation issued.

headline: Roaches and flies found; sausage discarded
summary: Sausages held at 49°F, above the 41°F limit; manager discarded 10 pounds. More than 20 small flies, one live roach, and over 20 roach carcasses were found. Handwashing sinks lacked towels and one was blocked. Citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled to-go desserts; expired training
summary: Desserts sold to go in clamshells lacked labels; they must list ingredients and contact information. Walk-in cooler door gasket is torn, a used oil container is greasy, and four food handlers have expired training.

headline: Re-inspection: grease near ice machine
summary: Grease and food debris on cooking equipment across from the ice machine must be cleaned. An unused cooler with grease buildup must be cleaned or removed to prevent pests. Certified manager must obtain allergen certificate.

headline: Door gap and missing covered trash can
summary: A half-inch gap under the front door must be rodent-proofed. The women's washroom lacks a covered trash can. Dirt and food debris on the pizza prep area floor need cleaning.

headline: Rear sink lacks nearby handwashing sink
summary: A rear three-compartment sink has no handwashing sink nearby. Manager must remove it or install a handwashing sink in the rear. Priority violation, no citation issued. No service sink on site.

headline: Missing handwashing sign at prep sink
summary: The handwashing sign is missing at the front kitchen prep sink. Management was instructed to install and maintain it.

headline: No manager certificate; citation issued
summary: Person in charge lacked proof of food safety manager training. Food handlers prepared TCS foods without an original city certificate or certified manager on site. Citation issued. Also: no test strips for the dish machine and no handwashing sign.

headline: Handwashing signage and rodent-proofing needed
summary: Handwashing signage needed at the sink behind the front bar. The bottom of the front entrance door must be rodent-proofed. Unneeded ceiling tiles, wooden panels, and boxes must be removed from the rear dining area. Certified manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: No certified manager; no hot water; sewage backup
summary: Person in charge lacked a certified manager certificate, and none was on site. No hot water on premises (65°F). Hand sink leaks and wastewater backs up from the three-compartment sink floor drain. Citations issued.

headline: Unlabeled foods and greasy prep areas
summary: Items removed from original containers were unlabeled; manager told to label foods and spices. Soiled mop heads must be hung to prevent insect breeding. Grease and debris under cooking equipment, dusty fan, and two burnt-out bulbs also noted.

headline: Re-inspection passed; several fixes requested
summary: Re-inspection passed. Items to correct: paper towel dispenser above warewashing sink, no thermometer in prep refrigerator, rusty refrigerator shelves, freezer food debris, no covered toilet-room trash can, and a broken vent fan.

headline: Ice machine, pooled water, and missing food handler proof
summary: Ice machine interior needed cleaning. Water pooled on floors, and a bar sink leaked into a bucket. No proof of food handler training was shown for any employee. A previous core violation was not corrected, and citations were issued.

headline: Dishmachine not sanitizing; citation issued
summary: The low-temperature dishwashing machine had 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged held for inspection. Staff were told to use the three-compartment sink until it was repaired. A citation was issued. Floors, drain covers, aluminum shelf liners, and a dirty hood also need attention.

headline: No chemical test strip kit; citation issued
summary: The site had a pH test strip kit but no chemical test strip kit to check sanitizer strength. A citation was issued. An unlabeled bulk dry-ingredient container and a restroom door that doesn't self-close also need fixing.

headline: Dirty cooler shelves and leaking sink faucet
summary: The pizza-station prep cooler interior and walk-in cooler shelving were dirty. A three-compartment sink faucet leaked, and a men's restroom fixture needed cleaning. Floors and a hood needed cleaning. Result: pass.

headline: Missing food handler training; worn gaskets
summary: A new employee had no food handler training. Worn gaskets were on a two-door prep cooler, and grill and walk-in shelving needed cleaning. Unlabeled squeeze bottles and shakers and clutter on the second floor also needed attention. Result: pass.

headline: Dish machine sanitizing failed; repaired on site
summary: A large dish machine could not reach 180 F for sanitizing rinses. A technician repaired it on site, and it reached 187 F. A citation was issued. Cooked chicken was covered while cooling, and cooking equipment surfaces had food debris.

headline: Re-inspection: drain leak under prep sink fixed
summary: Re-inspection found a drain line leak under the two-compartment prep sink. Management was told to repair the source. Result: pass.

headline: No certified manager during TCS prep; multiple citations
summary: No certified food service manager or sanitation certificate was on site while soups, rice, chicken, and beef were prepared. A citation was issued. Produce was stored on the floor, and no hand soap or paper towels were available at a sink, which was corrected. Other issues also noted.

headline: Dirty floor drains in rear facility
summary: All floor drains in the rear facility need cleaning. The manager was told to clean and maintain them. Result: pass.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; unlabeled bulk container
summary: Some food handler certificates had expired. One bulk container in the prep area was not labeled. The manager was told to update certificates and label all bulk containers. Result: pass.

headline: Unlabeled bulk salt and sugar containers
summary: Bulk storage containers of salt and sugar were not labeled. Scoops were stored inside dry storage containers, and dust had built up on the ventilation system near the hand sink. Result: pass.

headline: Outdated license number on food truck
summary: The license number on the side of the mobile food unit was outdated. The manager was told to provide and maintain the updated license number. Result: pass.

headline: Missing hand-wash sign; stained restroom ceiling tiles
summary: No hand-washing signs were posted at designated sinks. Water-stained ceiling tiles were in the toilet room. The manager was told to add signs and replace the tiles. Result: pass.

headline: Re-inspection: wiping cloths and ice scoops stored improperly
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables, and ice scoops were stored on top of the ice machine. The washroom lacked a covered waste receptacle, and a broken floor tile was at the three-compartment sink. Result: pass.

headline: Re-inspection: no dump sink in bar
summary: Re-inspection found no dump sink in the service bar. The manager was told to install one in accordance with rules. Result: pass.

headline: Food debris and grime behind equipment
summary: Food debris was inside cold-hold units on the front cook line. Grime and debris built up behind prep-area equipment, freezers and coolers. The person in charge was told to clean. Result: pass.

headline: Wet mop stored in bucket
summary: A wet mop was stored in a bucket in the rear storage room. The manager was told to hang mops to dry when not in use. Result: pass.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; dirty ice machine panel
summary: Bulk containers of salt and flour were not labeled. A gray film was found inside the ice maker panel and the fountain soda dispensers. The manager was told to label and clean. Result: pass.

headline: Cooler interior needs detail cleaning
summary: The interior of a two-door stand-up cooler in the rear storage room needed detail cleaning, with spilled debris noted. Result: pass.

headline: Unlabeled cooked foods; food stored on floor; citation
summary: Cooked pork, chicken, beans and beef held over 24 hours had no date labels, and a citation was issued. Food was stored on the floor, and wiping cloths, knives and a mop were stored improperly. The microwave was dirty, and an allergen certificate was missing.

headline: Gap under door; grout needed under cooking area
summary: Re-inspection found a gap along the bottom of the front south entry door that must be made tight-fitting. Floors under and around the cooking equipment and grill need grout. Result: pass.

headline: Missing hand-washing sign and minor repairs
summary: Re-inspection found no hand-washing sign at the bar hand sink. Other items were a torn cooler door gasket, stained cutting boards, and dim lighting in the basement walk-in cooler. The manager was told to fix each one.

headline: Missing restroom hand-wash sign; dusty vent
summary: No hand-washing sign was posted in the restroom. A cold-hold unit had a torn gasket, the restroom lacked a lidded trash can, and the ceiling vent was covered in thick dust. Result: pass.

headline: Live birds in cages removed; citation issued
summary: Two cages with 12 live birds were found in the rear restroom area. The manager was told to remove them, and a citation was issued. Flour, grease, dead insects, and dirt built up on cooking equipment and shelving.

headline: Missing hand-wash sign; no lidded waste can
summary: The unisex restroom needed a hand-washing sign and a covered waste can. Floors needed debris removed and unnecessary clutter cleared. Result: pass.

headline: Damaged freezer gaskets; re-inspection pass
summary: Re-inspection found damaged gaskets on both doors of a two-door freezer in the rear prep area. The person in charge was told to repair or replace them. Result: pass.

headline: No certified manager during TCS prep; citation
summary: No certified food sanitation manager was on site while raw seafood and other TCS foods were prepared and served, and a citation was issued. A 1/4-inch gap under the front door could allow pests in. Leaks and cluttered storage also need attention.

headline: Hair restraints; improperly stored utensils; plates
summary: Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints. In-use utensils were stored inside food containers or on prep surfaces, and plates were not inverted. A hold-unit handle was broken. Result: pass.

headline: Rusted walk-in shelving and dirty ice machine interior
summary: Rusted shelving racks were found in the walk-in coolers, and the ice machine interior had calcium buildup. The manager was told to repaint or replace the racks and clean the ice machine. This was a re-inspection.

headline: Re-inspection: stained cutting boards and burnt bulb
summary: Re-inspection found stained cutting boards with open seams and milk crates on the prep-area floor. Old and broken equipment was throughout the facility. A burnt-out bulb was above the grill and fryer. Result: pass.

headline: Unlabeled containers; food stored on basement floor
summary: Food containers in the basement storage area were stored on the floor. Containers lacked common-name labels, and no thermometers were in reach-in cooler units. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, and a knife was stored on a prep surface. Result: pass.

headline: Sticky traps with dead bugs; citation issued
summary: Sticky traps filled with dead bugs were on the ceilings above butcher prep tables and fish tanks. A citation was issued for lacking a certified food manager on site. Open food bins, wiping cloths on a paper-towel rack, and cardboard boxes on the floor were also noted.

headline: Heavy grease on fryers; torn prep table covering
summary: Re-inspection found fryer tops and sides heavily covered in grease and food debris. A prep table had a torn plastic covering that needed to be removed. The manager was told to detail-clean the equipment.

headline: Soda stored under sewer line; pipe leaks
summary: Soda pallets were stored under a sewer line in the basement. Small water drips came from pipes under the three-compartment sinks. Cracked tiles were in the walk-in freezer. Result: pass.

headline: Gaps, missing washroom door closers, and clutter
summary: A 1/4-inch gap was found at the bottom of the front entrance door. Gender washroom doors were not self-closing, and the front prep sink lacked a waste receptacle. Stained and damaged ceiling and floor tiles, and clutter in the hallway, also need fixing. Result: pass.

headline: Rat droppings, flies and sink issues; citations
summary: About 50 or more rat droppings were found on floors, and 40 or more small flies were flying and on ceiling tiles. A citation was issued for pest activity and for a hand sink with no drain. Improper dishwashing and food storage on the floor were also cited.

headline: No hand soap, cold water problems, and ice machine slime
summary: Hand soap was missing at a prep hand sink, and hot water measured only 78.6 to 80.0 F in washrooms; the required minimum is 100 F. Black slime was found in the ice machine. Citations were issued. Several other issues were corrected or need repair.

headline: Spills, ice buildup and damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Spills were found in a dairy reach-in cooler, and the ice cream display freezer had ice buildup that must be defrosted. Damaged and missing ceiling tiles were found in the storage and selling areas. Result: pass.

headline: Expired allergen training; greasy fryers
summary: Some grease was at the bottom of the fryers. Floors under storage shelves and the dish machine needed cleaning to remove standing water. Allergen training certificates for food service managers were expired. Result: pass.

headline: Dirty floors and cluttered office
summary: Dirt and litter were found on the floors along the walls and corners. The office floor was cluttered. The manager was told to detail-clean the premises and remove or raise items off the office floor.

headline: Food stored on floor; grease buildup; no food handler certificates
summary: Food was stored on the prep-area floor; the manager was told to raise it six inches. Grease and food debris were found on equipment and shelving. No food handler certificates were on site. Other items: a washroom door that doesn't self-close and dirty walls and floors.

headline: Unlabeled dry ingredients; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Dry ingredient containers were not labeled with the common name. Milk crates were used as elevation for stored items, and cardboard was used as a shelf liner in the reach-in freezer. Debris was under coolers and around the grease trap. Additional allergen certificates were required.

headline: Utensils and plates not stored properly
summary: Scoops were stored inside dry storage containers. Plates and utensils were not inverted. Dirt and debris had built up on the washroom and dishwashing area vents. Result: pass.

headline: Slime in ice maker; citation issued
summary: Black slime was found inside the ice maker, dripping onto ice used for people to eat, and a citation was issued. Other issues included torn cooler gaskets, a leaking sink faucet, food debris, burnt-out lights, and no food handler certificates on site. The certified manager's allergen training had expired.

headline: No raw food advisory on menu; citation issued
summary: The menu did not disclose raw or undercooked foods, as required. No approved allergen certificate was available. Previous violations were not corrected, including rusted racks and bathroom doors that don't self-close. A citation was issued.

headline: No food handler training proof; dirty floors
summary: No proof of training was shown for food handlers, and a certified manager lacked allergen awareness training. Grease, food debris, and dirt were on floors under cooking equipment and in corners. Plates should be stored inverted, and a mop needed hanging to dry.

headline: No valid manager certificate posted; citation
summary: The person in charge lacked a valid certified food manager certificate, and no valid certificate was posted during TCS food prep. A citation was issued. Front prep hand sink had no hand-drying device, and the dish prep sink had no soap at the time of inspection; soap and towels were provided.

headline: About 30 mouse droppings in dining area
summary: About 30 mouse droppings were found inside a dining-room bench seat. The person in charge was told to remove them, sanitize the area, and contact pest control. A citation was issued. Grease and food debris were also found on kitchen and bar surfaces.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets and greasy ventilation hood
summary: Some prep-area reach-in cooler door gaskets were ripped. Food buildup was on walls behind the three-compartment sink, and the ventilation hood had grease buildup. Result: pass.

headline: Food stored on floor; citation for certificate
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and freezer. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, and a hand sink faucet leaked. A citation was issued for two managers without allergen training. Result: pass with conditions.

headline: Re-inspection: greasy fryer and shelf
summary: Re-inspection found grease buildup inside the fryer cabinet and on a lower shelf under a hot-holding unit. The manager was told to clean. Result: pass.

headline: Rodent droppings and flies; pest service required
summary: About 40 large rodent droppings were found in basement prep and storage areas, the liquor office, and the bar. About 15 live small flies were seen in the bar and dining area. Pest control service is required, and a citation was issued.

headline: Rat droppings found; multiple citations issued
summary: About 30 or more rat droppings were found near a sump pump. Citations were issued for missing employee health policy, no clean-up kit for vomiting or diarrhea, and no food handler or allergen training. Shellfish tags lacked dates, and a backflow device was missing.

headline: Improper food storage; dead insects; citations
summary: Raw beef and pork were stored above uncovered food, and this was corrected on site by rearranging items. A citation was issued for missing date marks on cooked foods held over 24 hours. Sticky traps with dead insects were found, as well as dead insects on the floor.

headline: Unlabeled desserts; missing allergen certificate
summary: Prepackaged desserts at the front counter had no labels. The manager was told to label them with business name, address, ingredients and allergens. A food handler had a beard without a beard guard, and the sanitation manager lacked an allergen certificate copy. Result: pass.

headline: Roaches, flies and rat droppings; unsafe food temperatures
summary: About 40 or more live roaches, about 100 live small flies, and about 30 rat droppings were found. Cooked foods held at unsafe temperatures were discarded. No certified food manager certificate was posted, and there were no signed employee health policies or food handler training. Citations issued.

headline: Three-compartment sink backs up; citation issued
summary: Wastewater backs up in the three-compartment sink, affecting the other basins. A citation was issued. A cracked hot water handle at a hand sink and broken, cracked floor tiles in the serving area also need repair.

headline: Mouse droppings in trailer; citation issued
summary: Over 20 mouse droppings were found on pallets and shelving in the dry food storage trailer. A citation was issued. The manager was told to call an exterminator and clean. Food was stored in a utility sink, and garbage area grease spills and debris were noted.

headline: Trash under dumpster should be removed
summary: Small trash items and pieces of clothing were on the ground under the far-left dumpster. The manager was told to remove them. Result: pass.

headline: Re-inspection: rusty shelves and broken glass
summary: Rusty shelves were found in the rear food prep area, and broken glass was in two pastry display cabinets. A large mixing bowl was too big for the three-compartment sink. Light bulbs lacked protective shields. Result: pass.

headline: Three-compartment sink stopper not holding water
summary: The three-compartment sink stopper did not hold water, which affects proper washing and sanitizing. The meat slicer was not clean behind the blade, with food debris noted. Result: pass.

headline: Rusty shelves, toilet room needs repairs
summary: Rusty shelves were found in a front reach-in cooler. The employee toilet room had no covered trash can, a fan that wasn't working, and damaged ceiling panels. Gaps around pipes above a hood also need sealing.

headline: Unlabeled sink compartments and leaking faucet
summary: The three-compartment sink lacked labels for its wash, rinse and sanitize compartments. A faucet leaked at the same sink. The person in charge was told to label the compartments and repair the leak.

headline: No cold water at hand sinks; citation issued
summary: Both hand sinks had no cold water, with stripped cold handles. A citation was issued. Menu failed to disclose raw or undercooked items such as eggs. Food storage, cleanliness, and hair restraint issues were also noted.

headline: No certified manager; sink access and health policy issues
summary: TCS food was prepared without a certified manager on site, and a citation was issued. Missing employee health policy, a blocked hand sink, and unhealthy hot water also were cited. Rear prep area had cutting boards with stains and open seams; plus missing training records and uncorrected core violations.

headline: Front door not rodent proof; repeated violations
summary: The front entrance door was not rodent proof, with a half-inch opening at the bottom. Walls had chipping plaster and peeling paint, and the ceiling was missing a tile. Soda crates were used as shelving, and a previous priority violation was not corrected. Citations issued.

headline: No certified manager on site; corrected on site
summary: No certified food service manager was on premises. The manager arrived at 9:43 AM, and this was corrected on site. A high-temperature dish machine had error messages and was tagged held for inspection. No food handler training certificates were provided. Citation issued.

headline: Dirty ice bin; citation issued
summary: Black, brown and pink buildup was on the top inside of an ice bin used for drinks, dripping onto ice. A citation was issued. Cutting boards had deep stains, floors under fryers had grease, and no food handler or allergen records were on site. A broken ceiling tile showed a leak.

headline: Gap under rear door; soiled floors
summary: A gap greater than 1/4 inch was found under the rear kitchen door to the parking garage. Floors beneath shelving, the three-compartment sink, and the utility closet were soiled with dried food debris and grease. Result: pass.

headline: No certified manager during TCS prep; multiple citations
summary: No certified food sanitation manager was on site while chicken and milk were prepped. Citations were issued for no employee health policy, no vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit, no food thermometer, and no pest control logbook. Food was stored on the floor.

headline: Cilantro blocked hand sink; citation issued
summary: Cilantro was placed in an exposed hand-washing sink in the hot food prep room, making it inaccessible. A citation was issued. Bulk rice bins were unlabeled, wet wiping cloths were on prep tables, and light fixtures were out in the exhaust hood and walk-in dairy cooler.

headline: Old yogurt containers used for sauces
summary: Old yogurt containers were in the walk-in freezer and used to store sauces and dips. The manager was told to use only food-grade, reusable containers. Result: pass.

headline: Missing hand-wash signs; unsanitized wiping cloths
summary: Hand-washing signs were missing in the restrooms. Wiping cloths were stored on top of prep coolers and not in sanitizing solution. Restrooms had no covered waste bins and a broken vent, and no food handler or allergen training records were provided.

headline: Re-inspection: no food handler or allergen certificates
summary: Re-inspection found minor debris on prep-area floors. No food handler certificate or allergen training certificate was shown for inspector review. The manager was told to meet these requirements. Result: pass.

headline: Greasy hot-hold unit; debris under equipment
summary: Grease buildup was on the side of a hot-hold unit. Debris and possible food debris were on the floor under the hot-hold and prep table. The manager was told to clean to prevent pests. Result: pass.

headline: Loose cooler gaskets; expired food handler certificates
summary: Loose gaskets were found on a two-door cooler in the kitchen. Expired food handler certificates were on premises, and the manager was told to renew them. Result: pass.

headline: Ice buildup in freezer; mop and sink cleaning
summary: Ice buildup was found throughout the reach-in walk-in freezer, covering shelves and ice cream products. Debris and buildup were found in sinks and on sales-floor shelving, and mops were drying in a sink, which could breed pests. Result: pass.

headline: No certified food manager on site; missing handwashing sinks
summary: No certified food manager was on site at arrival, and the one who arrived had an expired certificate. A hand sink was missing from the upstairs prep area where dough was being prepared. A dishwasher sanitizer reading of 0 ppm was repaired during inspection. Citations were issued.

headline: Hair restraint missing; ice scoop and ceilings
summary: One food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. A metal ice scoop was stored on top of the ice machine. Water-stained ceiling tiles above prep tables need replacement, and the basement floor was cluttered.

headline: Stained cutting board; greasy cooking equipment
summary: A long cutting board on the hot food line had deep stains and grooves and needed replacing. Cooking equipment sides had grease buildup and food spills. Result: pass.

headline: Sink backup and stained ceiling tiles; citation
summary: Water backed up from the third basin into the second basin of the basement three-compartment sink, and a citation was issued. A utility sink backflow device was leaking. Ceiling tiles were stained, and a fan and light shield were missing.

headline: Unsafe cold-holding temperatures; food discarded
summary: Chicken at 50.3 F and cooked noodles at 49.6 F were too warm for cold holding. The manager discarded 15 lbs of product right away. Food was stored on floors, grease built up on cooking equipment, and a citation was issued.

headline: Staff without hair restraints; storage needed
summary: Employees were preparing and serving food without hair restraints. Dust was on washroom ceiling vents, and personal belongings were stored in food prep and storage areas. Result: pass.

headline: No working metal thermometer; citation issued
summary: No working metal stem thermometer was on site, and a citation was issued. Employee water bottles were on a prep counter and stored in a food cooler. Food labels were missing on frosting and chocolate items, and wiping cloths were stored improperly. Excess ice was on the walk-in floor.

headline: Food debris on dish machine; greasy floors
summary: Food debris was on top of the dish machine, and grease was on the floor under cooking equipment. Soiled ceiling tiles and grease on the wall behind cooking equipment also needed cleaning. Result: pass.

headline: Employee without hair restraint; washroom fan broken
summary: A food handler had no beard or hair restraint. Floors and walls around sinks and walk-in units needed cleaning, and standing water was in the walk-in cooler. The washroom ventilation fan was not working. Result: pass.

headline: Wiping cloths and dusty fan covers
summary: Wiping cloths were improperly stored and should be kept in sanitizing solution when not in use. Dust was on the fan covers in the walk-in cooler. Result: pass.

headline: Missing hand-wash sign and splash guards
summary: No hand-washing sign was posted at the hand sink behind the front register area. No splash guards were at the hand sink near the dishwashing area. The manager was told to provide both. Result: pass.

headline: No hand sink in front prep; citation issued
summary: The new front food prep area had no hand sink. A citation was issued. Cold-hold food at 45.5 to 52.1 F was discarded. Expired allergen training, missing labels, and a leaking faucet were also found, and the sink was corrected on site.

headline: Slow drain and leak under sink
summary: A slow drain and a small leak were found in the piping under the hand sink in the dishwashing area. The manager was told to repair. Result: pass.

headline: Peeling plastic and light shields missing
summary: Peeling plastic was on metal surfaces next to the dishwashing sink and should be removed. Light shields or end caps were missing from kitchen prep area ceiling fixtures. Result: pass.

headline: Dirty ice machine guard; rusty shelves
summary: The interior guard of the ice machine had dirt. Cardboard was used as a liner in the walk-in cooler, and rust was on shelves. The person in charge was told to clean and remove rust. Result: pass.

headline: Dirty floors around cooking equipment
summary: Floors around cooking equipment and inside the bottom cabinets at the bar dining area needed cleaning. Result: pass.

headline: Dusty restroom vents
summary: Fan vents in restrooms had dust buildup. The manager was told to clean and maintain them. Result: pass.

headline: Clean floors under shelves and dusty oven vent
summary: The floors under rear storage shelves needed cleaning where needed. Dust was in the vent above the front prep oven. Result: pass.

headline: Rodent droppings in basement; re-inspection pass
summary: Re-inspection found about 20 to 50 rodent droppings on basement floors and storage shelves. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables, and a dumpster area had debris. Grease and food debris were also present. Result: pass.

headline: Worn front door weather stripping
summary: Worn weather stripping was found on the front doors. The manager was told to replace it to prevent pest entry points. Result: pass.

headline: Re-inspection: missing thermometer and dirty areas
summary: Re-inspection found no thermometer in the hot-holding unit behind the front counter. Bulk containers were unlabeled, and grease and debris were found on equipment and walls. Clutter and damaged walls also needed attention. No allergen training was on site for the manager. Result: pass.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food; citation issued
summary: No person in charge with a valid certificate was on site while TCS food was prepared and served, and a citation was issued. Hand sink had no hot water (73.2 F), and a 1/4-inch gap under an exit door could allow pests in. Food was stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler.

headline: Dead insects in boiler room
summary: Dead insects were found in the boiler room behind the prep area. The manager was told to remove them, detail-clean, sanitize, and maintain the area. Result: pass.

headline: Food held too warm; flies and dead flies near food
summary: Failed. Chicken, eggs, beef, salsa, cheese and other foods held 52-62°F; 35 lbs discarded. Reach-in prep cooler at 55.6°F must not be used until reinspected. Dead flies on cold unit; electric fly trap over prep table; dog food on prep equipment.

headline: No certified manager while meatballs were served
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid sanitation certificate or certified manager on site while meatballs (140.2°F) were prepared and served; citation issued. Single-service cups stored under sink; dust on coolers; leaking three-compartment faucet.

headline: No thermometer in hot unit; stained cutting boards
summary: Passed re-inspection. No thermometer inside hot-holding unit at front service counter. Stained cutting boards on sandwich cooler and rear prep table must be resurfaced or replaced. Certified food manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Sanitation manager lacked allergen training certificate
summary: Passed. Inspector found the food service sanitation manager without a food allergen training certificate and told the facility to meet the requirement.

headline: Food residue in cooler; hood filters dusty
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food debris and residue inside sliding two-door cooler and on cold-hold gaskets. Excessive dust and grease on hood filters. Person in charge instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Black mold on wall behind three-compartment sink
summary: Passed. Black mold-like substance on the wall behind the three-compartment sink. Person in charge instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Rear door gap; no hair restraints; leaking faucet
summary: Passed. Rear door has a 1/2-inch gap at corners. Employees in prep area lacked hair restraints. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer. Three-compartment faucet leaks. Mop sink lacks backflow device. Managers lack allergen certificates.

headline: Food held up to 70°F; sewage leak; no soap
summary: Failed. Food at 49-70°F in reach-in, walk-in and prep coolers; about 90 lbs discarded. Handsinks lacked hand soap. Sewage pipe leaking in basement; no commercial dumpster; floors cracked; citation issued.

headline: Restroom door not self-closing; no handler certification
summary: Passed. Restroom door is not tight-fitting or self-closing. No food handler certification provided on site; all food employees must obtain a valid certification and keep it on site.

headline: Yogurt and milk too warm; sausage hung at room temperature
summary: Passed with conditions. Yogurt, milk and smoothies in display cooler at 49-53°F, above the 41°F limit. About 50 lbs of Mexican sausage at 70°F hung in butcher prep area without an approved process. Cooler at 50°F must be repaired. Foods discarded.

headline: Torn gasket; inadequate lighting; no handler training
summary: Passed. Torn gasket on right door of two-door prep cooler. Grease on prep table, stove and walls. Inadequate lighting in food prep and dishwashing areas. No food handler training certificates provided; management instructed to provide them.

headline: No certificate posted; cooler door detached
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid food sanitation certificate posted; a certified food manager must be present while TCS foods are prepared and served; citation issued. Left door of 3-door prep cooler does not stay attached when opened; interior needs cleaning.

headline: Handsinks lack hot water, soap, and towels
summary: Failed. Women's washroom handsink at 90.5°F and server station sinks at 66-73°F; 100°F minimum required. Prep and server handsinks lacked hand soap and paper towels. Bar handsink not flowing; women's washroom sink handle broken; citation issued.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; dead mouse on glue board
summary: Failed. Over 100 mouse droppings on ledges, floors and inside a water heater pan; dead mouse on glue board; exterminator and cleaning required. Gap under rear door; fly strip in prep area; leaking faucets; damaged floors.

headline: Leaking backflow device; allergen certificates missing
summary: Passed re-inspection. Backflow prevention device above utility sink leaks when its faucet runs and must be repaired. Two city food service sanitation managers lack allergen awareness training certificates.

headline: No manager on site; food too warm; undated food
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge or certified food manager on site; beef patties at 45.3°F, 5 lbs discarded. Beef and chorizo lacked date marks. Fryer full of excess grease; cracked floor tile; cluttered storage rooms.

headline: Over 80 mouse droppings; no valid certified manager
summary: Failed. Over 80 mouse droppings on floors and shelves in prep and basement areas; exterminator required. No valid certified manager on site, and no food handler or allergen training available. Gaps under exit doors.

headline: Certified manager absent; handsinks lacked hot water
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager present while beef at 172°F was prepared and served; citation issued. No signed employee health policy. Handsinks lacked hot water and one had low pressure.

headline: No health policy; three-compartment sink leaks
summary: Failed. No verifiable employee health policy on site; template left for management. Three-compartment sink leaks when drained; citation issued. No handwashing signs at basement handsink and washroom; no allergen training for certified managers.

headline: Wiping cloths not in sanitizer; spills on cooking gear
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. Cooking equipment has food spills that must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager during hot dog service
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid food manager certificate and no certified manager on site while hot dogs and pepperoni pizza were served; citation issued. No written employee health policy or inspection summary posted. Prep handsink lacked paper towels, supplied during inspection.

headline: Missing faucet handle; no food handler training
summary: Passed. Missing cold water handle on prep-area handsink. Debris under equipment and in corners of prep and storage areas. Grease buildup inside ventilation hood. Employees handling food lack food handler training.

headline: Dirty floors, missing ceiling tile, grease buildup
summary: Passed. Dirt and debris under and behind deep fryers; missing ceiling tile in food prep area; dust and grease inside light shields and ceiling; floor in rear dishwashing area needs regrouting.

headline: Cardboard and foil liners; leaking handsink
summary: Passed. Cardboard used as liner in reach-in freezer and under floor mats; foil on shelving above stove. Rear handsink leaking from bottom corner. No covered waste receptacle in unisex employee washroom.

headline: Damaged floor tiles, missing ceiling tiles, dark lights
summary: Passed. Damaged floor tiles throughout, including under the three-compartment sink. Missing ceiling tiles above walk-in cooler. Several non-working lights in rear and front prep areas. Repairs ordered.

headline: 10 roaches found; handsink lacked water
summary: Failed. No hot or cold water at handsink between cook line and three-compartment sink until the manager restored it during inspection; citation issued. About 10 roaches found at kitchen door, walk-in cooler, dry storage and under sink. Food handler and allergen proof missing.

headline: Prep cooler too warm; about 50 lbs food discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Prep cooler at 52°F; salmon, cream cheese, deli meat and sliced cheese at 49-52°F, above the 41°F limit. About 50 lbs discarded, valued at $500. Citations issued for cold holding and cooler temperature.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; washroom door not self-closing
summary: Passed with conditions. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on premises. Washroom door lacks a self-closing device. Wall under three-compartment sink not coved; two holes in hallway expose plumbing. Managers must obtain allergen training.

headline: No sanitation certificate; grease dumpster overflowing
summary: Failed. No City of Chicago sanitation certificate posted; no written employee health policy. Grease dumpster filled and overflowing with garbage, lid removed, with litter around dumpsters. Prior food handler and allergen violations not corrected.

headline: Expired handler certificates; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. Expired food handler certificates. Certified food manager has no allergen training certificate. Dishwashing handsink lacks a handwashing sign. Storage closets cluttered; floors under heavy equipment dirty; can opener caked with food.

headline: Soiled equipment, water-damaged ceiling, missing allergen training
summary: Passed re-inspection. Rust, grease and dried food debris on hot-holding well, pizza oven, fryers and line coolers. Ceiling above rear three-compartment sink is water damaged and cracked. Heavy grease and dust in hood system. Manager missing allergen training.

headline: Quarter-inch gap under rear door
summary: Passed. Rear exterior door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom. Person in charge instructed to repair it and maintain it.

headline: Handwash water at 137°F; grease, rust and leaks
summary: Failed. Employee washroom handsink water reached 137°F; 120°F maximum required; citation issued. Containers stored on basement prep table under a stained sewer line; milk crates used for elevation; leaking pipe in basement.

headline: No employee health policy or vomit cleanup procedure
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy and no vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure with spill kit. No thermometer inside two coolers. No backflow prevention device at mop sink faucet.

headline: No handwashing signs; washrooms lack covered bins
summary: Passed. No handwashing signs at any handsink in the facility, including both all-gender washrooms. Both all-gender washrooms lack covered receptacles for sanitary products. Manager instructed to post signs and provide receptacles.

headline: More than 15 small flies; food handler proof missing
summary: Failed. More than 15 small flies throughout the facility, including dining room, dry storage, dish, prep and bar areas; citation issued. Several food handlers had no proof of food handler training.

headline: Leaking ceiling near toilet rooms
summary: Passed re-inspection. Ceiling in rear hall to toilet rooms is leaking water and breaking apart. Leak must be repaired, and the ceiling resurfaced and repainted so it is sealed, smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Black slime dripping from bar ice machine
summary: Failed. No valid sanitation certificate on site, and no certified manager with sanitation training. Bar ice machine had black slime dripping onto ice; citation issued. Dumpster lids open from overflowing trash. No allergen training.

headline: No food handler certificates for new staff
summary: Passed. No food handler training certificates on site. Management instructed to obtain them and keep them on site for review for new staff.

headline: Improper dishwashing; cold food above 41°F
summary: Passed with conditions. Dishes washed without setting up the three-compartment sink to wash, rinse and sanitize; manager corrected it immediately. Raw chicken at 55-70°F, shrimp and tomatoes too warm; about 59 lbs discarded. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Doors not rodent-proof; sign corrected on site
summary: Passed. Handwashing sign was missing in washroom and was corrected on site. Front and rear exit doors are not completely rodent-proof and must be made so.

headline: Slicer buildup; sink stoppers broken; grease trap unverified
summary: Passed re-inspection. Blade buildup on slicer; utensils stored in water between uses; three-compartment sink stoppers not working; grease interceptor unverified; all-gender washroom door not self-closing; damaged floor; stove not under hood.

headline: Home ventilation over fryers; no handler training
summary: Passed re-inspection. Home-style ventilation over fryers, grill and pizza oven must be replaced with a ducted commercial system. No food handler training for new employees. Couch in food storage area must be separated.

headline: Over 50 fruit flies; missing food handler proof
summary: Failed. Over 50 small fruit flies on sinks and walls in front bar, main kitchen and basement dish areas; citation issued; more pest control needed. Also missing handwashing signs, no food handler training proof, and leaking faucets.

headline: Two dogs found inside food facility
summary: Passed with conditions. Two non-service dogs were inside the facility and were removed during the inspection; citation issued. No thermometers inside two prep coolers; one of two irreversible thermometers not working. Managers need allergen training.

headline: Sauce containers on walk-in floor; no allergen proof
summary: Passed. Sauce containers stored on the floor of the walk-in cooler; must be elevated at least six inches. No proof of allergen training on site for city certified food manager.

headline: Undersanitized dish machine; improperly cooled chicken discarded
summary: Failed. Bar high-temperature dish machine final rinse at 160°F, below the 180°F minimum; machine tagged and not to be used. About 20 lbs whole chicken cooled improperly and discarded. Cooked chicken held at 111.9°F in hot buffet; discarded.

headline: Broken cooler; food removed; rear door gap
summary: Passed with conditions. Large three-door prep cooler not working; manager removed all TCS food before the inspector arrived and the unit was tagged. Rear door gap over 1/4 inch; backflow device cap missing; clutter in front closet.

headline: No prep handwashing sink; no health policy
summary: Failed. No handwashing sink with hot and cold water, soap and towels in rear prep and dish area. No signed employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea cleanup items. No dumpster contract; cluttered rear yard.

headline: Cold food held too warm; over 30 small flies
summary: Failed. Cooked vegetables, pureed vegetables, chicken, sliced tomatoes and cooked meat at 47-59°F, above the 41°F limit; about 40 lbs discarded. Over 30 small flies in prep, dish and storage areas; citation issued.

headline: Gap under entrance door; holes in walls
summary: Passed. Quarter-inch gap at bottom of front entrance door; tight-fitting seal required at outer openings. Missing backflow device at mop sink; unused equipment on site; holes in walls; mops not stored to dry; missing light shield.

headline: No certified manager; raw steak in non-mechanical cooler
summary: Failed. No valid certified food manager on duty while TCS foods were prepared, handled and served. Raw steak held in a non-mechanical cooler. Mobile food truck lacked hot or cold running water at the three-compartment and hand sinks. Citations issued.

headline: Ice machine door, slow drain, no mop rack
summary: Passed. Ice machine door in poor repair. Exposed handsink in rear prep area drains slowly. Greasy fryers and stove exterior. No mop rack for wet mops and brooms. No allergen training certificates for city food service managers.

headline: Unlabeled containers; wet mop; floor debris
summary: Passed. Three or four bulk containers unlabeled in rear prep area. Wet mop not hung to dry. Debris on floors behind baking equipment and prep tables. Clutter on floor by condiment rack.

headline: Dusty fan; one manager needs allergen training
summary: Passed re-inspection. Dust on ventilation fan in women's washroom must be cleaned. One food service manager needs to obtain the required food allergen training certificate.

headline: No employee health policy or training on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy or training on site; facility must set up a system with verifiable documents kept on site. Mechanical ventilation required in all four washrooms.

headline: No certified manager while hot milk was steamed
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food service manager or certificate on site while TCS foods (foods that must be kept hot or cold), such as steamed milk, were being handled and served. Manager instructed to obtain one.

headline: No handwashing sign; torn cooler gasket
summary: Passed re-inspection. No handwashing sign at exposed handsink in front coffee prep area. Torn gasket on two-door prep cooler must be repaired or replaced. Unused freezer in rear prep area must be removed.

headline: Over 40 rat droppings in food truck
summary: Failed. About 40 or more rat droppings on the floor among clutter in the front cab of the food truck; droppings must be removed and area sanitized, pest control recommended. Gaps under doors, floor hole, and wastewater leaking onto street.

headline: Dust on walk-in cooler shelving and hood vent
summary: Passed. Dust and buildup on metal shelving and plastic in the walk-in cooler. Dust under the hood vent unit could contaminate food and surfaces below. Manager instructed to clean and maintain all of it.

headline: Employee ate while handling food; hygiene violations
summary: Passed with conditions. Employee ate in prep area while wearing one glove, then put on the second to serve food; citation issued. Another handler ate while wearing gloves. Prep and dish workers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Greasy fryer and kitchen floors need cleaning
summary: Passed. Fryer exterior and bottom need cleaning; floors under cooking and other kitchen equipment need cleaning. Some city food service managers lack required food allergen training and must obtain it.

headline: Debris on floors behind equipment
summary: Passed. Debris on floors behind equipment. Person in charge instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Vacuum packing without approved plan; machine held
summary: Passed with conditions. Vacuum-packing machine found without approved variance or HACCP plan; machine tagged and held by Chicago Department of Public Health; citation issued. Menu lacks undercooked-food advisory; sewer lines not shielded over food.

headline: Greasy cooking equipment and dirty floors
summary: Passed. Sides of cooking equipment need grease removed. Floors in main prep area and under the dish machine need buildup removed. Debris on front bar floors; floor drains need cleaning. Hood vents need grease and dust removed.

headline: Grime on cold unit holding chicken near fryers
summary: Passed. Buildup on gaskets and inside the front prep cold-hold unit where chicken is held near fryers; person in charge told to clean. Ceiling tiles near the hood are covered in residue and must be replaced.

headline: About 40 live flying insects; washroom fan broken
summary: Failed re-inspection. About 40 live small flying insects on walls, ceiling, shelves and equipment in both food prep areas. Prior violation not corrected; more pest control needed. Washroom ventilation fan not working.

headline: Overflowing dumpsters, no waste contract, cardboard liners
summary: Failed. Outside dumpsters overflowing with trash; manager told to keep trash inside receptacles away from insects and rodents. No waste disposal contract on record. Cardboard shelf liners in coolers ordered removed. Toilet room lacked covered receptacle.

headline: No handwashing sign; stove top not clean
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign at hand sink in front bar area, and top of stove not clean. Both must be corrected.

headline: Cooler too warm; food packaged without variance
summary: Failed. Turkey at 46.9°F, cut greens 50°F, roast beef 64.5°F, eggs 49°F and mozzarella 52°F in main line cooler; about 10 lbs discarded. Steak and chicken vacuum-packed without city-approved variance; equipment tagged.

headline: No self-closing washroom doors; no handler certificate
summary: Passed re-inspection. Washroom doors lack self-closing devices. No food handler training certificate provided on site. Management instructed to provide both.

headline: Live flies in prep area; leaking pipe; no health policy
summary: Failed. About 13 live black flies in rear prep area, on cooling units and in toilet room; pest control required. Also no signed employee health policy, no metal-stem food thermometer, leaking pipe under prep handsink, and toilet door not self-closing.

headline: Calcium in ice machine; allergen training missing
summary: Passed. Calcium buildup inside ice machine must be cleaned. Light grease on outside grease receptacle. A certified food manager has no food allergen training and must comply.

headline: Dirty floor drains; expired allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Dirt and debris inside floor drains, in floor corners, under heavy equipment and around sinks in prep and dishwashing areas. Certified food manager's allergen training certificate expired; a current one must be obtained.

headline: Clutter and unused chairs in basement
summary: Passed. Clutter and unused chairs and tables in the basement. Unused items must be discarded, the area organized, and it must be kept that way.

headline: Moldy caulking; water-damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Passed re-inspection. Blackened, moldy caulking at dish machine handsink must be replaced. Water-damaged ceiling tiles in liquor storage and rear hallway must be replaced. Certified managers need valid allergen training proof.

headline: Gaps at doors; clutter; no food handler certificates
summary: Passed re-inspection. Openings at rear garage door and front entrance must be sealed; rear storage doors must stay closed. Women's washroom door not self-closing. Cluttered storage with unused refrigerator. No food handler certificates provided.

headline: One-inch gap under front door; leaking faucet
summary: Passed re-inspection. One-inch gap at bottom of front entrance door; threshold must be raised and a longer door sweep installed. Leaking three-compartment faucet; walk-in cooler door in poor repair.

headline: Over 40 fruit flies; expired manager certificate
summary: Failed. Over 40 fruit flies on walls in rear storage, washroom and dishwashing/prep areas; elimination ordered and pest control advised. Certified manager certificate expired; no food handler training shown; inspection summary not posted.

headline: Food debris on shelves and floors; wall base detached
summary: Passed re-inspection. Dried debris on prep shelving; food debris on floors in prep area, behind heavy equipment and under shelving. Wall base detached near three-compartment sink. Items stored on floors must be removed and raised.

headline: About 30 live flies; ice machine buildup
summary: Failed. About 30 small live flies in bar, pastry prep, basement storage and dishwashing areas; pest control and elimination required. Black and pink buildup inside ice machine dripping onto ice; citation issued. Grease on fryer floors.

headline: No covered sanitary bin; dirty storeroom floors
summary: Passed. No covered receptacle for sanitary napkins in employee washroom. Loose debris, dirt and dust on floors and corners in rear storeroom; detail cleaning and more frequent cleaning required.

headline: Gap under side door; leaking dish machine
summary: Passed. Side exit door to hallway common area is not rodent-proof, with about a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom; gaps must be sealed. Leakage at the bottom of the high-temperature dish machine must be repaired.

headline: Cracked basement floor; expired food handler certificates
summary: Failed. Large cracks in basement floor near chest freezers; basement cluttered along south wall, so items must be off the floor. Some food handler certificates expired. One food manager lacks allergen certificate; a prior violation was not corrected.

headline: Three-compartment sink missing faucet; soiled surfaces
summary: Failed. Three-compartment sink missing a faucet on the right side. Counters and shelving in prep and storage areas soiled with food debris. Floors and walls in prep, dish and storage areas have soil buildup.

headline: No certified manager during service; missing food handler proof
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager on premises while tamales, sausages and chicken were prepared and served; citation issued. Only one of three food employees had a verifiable food handler certificate. Torn gaskets on reach-in cooler.

headline: Greasy equipment; soiled wipes and mop heads
summary: Passed re-inspection. Soiled wiping cloths stored on prep tables. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, coolers and shelving; floors behind cooking equipment; black substance on wall; mop heads not hung to dry.

headline: 11 or more live roaches; pest control required
summary: Failed re-inspection. Still about 11 or more live roaches crawling in crevices and on floors in prep and cooking areas. Pest control service required on or after 7/28/26. Heavy grease and food debris throughout; rust on walk-in shelving.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; mouse droppings throughout
summary: Failed. Beef, chicken, shrimp, pork and eggs in walk-in cooler at 49.7-51.1°F, above 41°F; about 15 lbs discarded. Prep cooler at 65°F. About 30 mouse droppings found in several areas plus a dead mouse; more pest control needed.

headline: Frozen chicken thawed in sink; manager instructed
summary: Passed. Frozen chicken was thawing improperly in the three-compartment sink; manager instructed to thaw under cool running water or inside a cooler. Prep cooler interior needs cleaning; water-damaged ceiling tile above rear freezer.

headline: No hand soap at outside washrooms; leaking faucet
summary: Passed with conditions. No hand soap at both washrooms outside the Golden Diner facility; priority violation. Exposed handsink faucet leaking and must be repaired.

headline: Meatballs and soup too cool; no certificate on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid City of Chicago sanitation certificate on site. Meatballs at 117.6°F and broccoli soup at 68°F in hot-holding unit, below the 135°F minimum; 10 lbs discarded. Citation issued.

headline: Food stored on floor in shared freezer
summary: Passed. Food bins, vegetable boxes and other items stored on the floor of the shared basement walk-in freezer; must be raised at least 6 inches. Calcium buildup in basement ice machine; grease under fryer; food debris in dishwashing area.

headline: No certified manager during chicken and steak service
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager on the premises while chicken, rice, beans and steak were prepared and served; citation issued. A prior allergen training violation was not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Gap at bottom of front door
summary: Passed. Small opening at the bottom of the front passenger door must be repaired to prevent a possible entry point for pests.

headline: Food stored outside; worn cutting boards; debris
summary: Passed with conditions. Food handlers cut peppers and stored dough outside near walk-in cooler; no handwashing sign at front prep sink; worn cutting boards; mop not drying properly; food debris and spills throughout the facility.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; no written health policy
summary: Passed with conditions. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies on site; no written employee health policy; no handwashing signs; no drainboard at three-compartment sink; clutter in basement food storage; certified manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: Eggs held too warm; no paper towels
summary: Failed. Raw cracked eggs held at 47.7°F, above the 41°F limit; about 10 lbs discarded. No paper towels at employee washroom handsink, corrected on site. Leaking sanitizer compartment and faucet; two employees lack allergen training.

headline: Door gap, scoop in ice bin, foil shelf liner
summary: Passed. Quarter-inch gap at front entrance door must be sealed and made rodent-proof. Scoop stored inside ice bin between uses; aluminum foil used as shelf liner; backflow device on ice machine could not be located.

headline: Uncovered food, floor storage, no hair restraints
summary: Passed. Quarter-inch gap under entrance door needs sealing. Uncovered food in coolers, food stored on the walk-in floor, workers without hair restraints, and scoops stored improperly. No food handler training proof; no allergen-trained manager on duty.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; gaps at doors
summary: Failed. No procedures or supplies for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events; citation issued. Doors have 1/4-inch gaps needing sealing. Stock stored on floors and near walls; soiled mop heads stored in utility sink; dust on displays.

headline: Damaged backflow device; mop storage
summary: Passed. Damaged backflow device at dry storage utility sink must be repaired. Scoops stored inside dry-goods containers. Mop must be mounted so it can air-dry, not left in a position where it cannot dry.

headline: Missing thermometers, lids, and door closers
summary: Passed. Thermometers needed inside all three prep-area cooling units. Unisex restrooms need covered garbage cans, and toilet room doors must self-close. General upkeep items only.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food and dusty plates
summary: Passed. Bulk basement food containers lacked labels with contents name. Serving plates and bowls stored upright collect dust. Large pots did not fit the 3-compartment sink. Clutter in rear storage could hide pests. Heavy grease on hood and filters.

headline: Improper storage; untrained food handler
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths stored on prep counter instead of sanitizing solution. Food stored in grocery bags in freezer. Plastic lining on prep tables. A male food handler in meat/deli prep lacked food handler training.

headline: Torn gaskets, expired handler certificates
summary: Passed. Torn cooler gaskets, broken door handle taped, and dirty bulk containers. Non-working restroom ventilation. All food handler certificates expired; food managers lack allergen proof. Cloth towels used as liners.

headline: Drain leaks under sinks; cleaning needed
summary: Passed. Drain line leaks under exposed bakery prep hand sink and produce cutting room 3-compartment sink must be repaired. Deli dishwashing rack floor, baseboards, walls, and ceiling tiles need cleaning.

headline: Ice machine mold, flies, and missing pest records
summary: Mold-like growth inside ice machine; management told to clean it. About 30 small flying insects and 15 house flies in food prep and bar areas; more pest service needed. No pest control reports from the last 12 months in log.

headline: No food handler training proof on site
summary: Passed. No proof of food handler training or certificates for required employees; must be provided.

headline: Missing and broken tiles in dry storage
summary: Passed. Missing and broken floor tiles in rear dry storage area need repair; person in charge instructed to maintain.

headline: No health policy; no vomit kit; vent unconnected
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy on site; priority violation. No vomiting and diarrhea kit on premises. Stove ventilation system not yet connected to power; must be connected. All food handlers must obtain required training.

headline: Slow-draining front hand sink
summary: Passed. Front prep area hand sink pipe drains slowly. Manager must maintain the sink.

headline: Missing sign, soiled cloths, no stoppers
summary: Passed. No hand-washing sign at front hand sink. Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables. Single-service items stored on floor. No splashguard or 3-compartment sink stoppers. Peeling paint on cooler shelves. Food handlers lack required training.

headline: Food handler lacks training certificate
summary: Passed. One food handler lacked a food handler training certificate. Must show proof of training and maintain records as required.

headline: Hand sinks blocked; paper towels missing
summary: Passed with conditions. Rear hand sink blocked by sauce packets and avocado containers; front sink had no paper towels. Both cited as priority violations. Floors along walls and under equipment, especially at rear, need cleaning.

headline: Spills, dirty surfaces, expired allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Cold holding unit interiors need spills wiped. Prep tables, walls, and floors around prep and serving areas need cleaning. The city-certified manager's allergen training certificate has expired and must be kept current.

headline: Flies, unsealed doors, and no food handler training
summary: Failed re-inspection. Over 50 live small flies in bar, dining, and hallway areas, plus crawling in dirty floor drains; pest control recommended. Restroom hot water only about 91°F, below 100°F required. Signed health policy and food handler training missing.

headline: No certified manager while handling deli meat
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food service manager on site while deli meat and other TCS foods were handled; priority violation. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Two food handlers lacked required food handler certificates.

headline: Heavy buildup on walk-in cooler shelves
summary: Passed. Heavy black dust and encrusted food debris on walk-in cooler shelves; manager instructed to detail clean and maintain shelves.

headline: Missing hand-wash signs, rust, slow drain
summary: Passed. Basement washrooms lack hand-washing signs. Rusty shelving in walk-in cooler needs repainting or replacing; ice buildup in coffee-area freezer; slow-draining employee hand sink; dirty liquor room floor; unlabeled storage containers.

headline: Cold hand-sink water; pizza left at 70°F
summary: Failed. Hot water at front prep sink was 68.3°F, and bathroom sink water 28.9°F; must reach 100°F; priority citation. Pizza out of temperature control at 70°F with no written time-as-control procedure; citation issued. Food handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Black mold-like substance in small ice machine
summary: Passed. Black mold-like substance on interior back wall of small ice machine in hostess area. Ice must be discarded; machine cleaned and sanitized. Debris in corners and under sinks and dish machine; floors under dry storage shelves need cleaning.

headline: Cool hand-sink water; leaking faucets
summary: Failed. Hand sink water at 81.1°F in second-floor locker room; must be at least 100°F; priority citation. Openings at revolving door base need sealing. Both dish sink faucets leak. Bar hand sink lacks splash guards.

headline: No allergen training records on site
summary: Passed. No allergen training documentation was on site at inspection. Certified food managers must complete allergen training and keep records on site at all times.

headline: No certified manager with allergen training
summary: Passed. No certified food manager on site with food allergen training at inspection. Manager instructed to comply with requirements.

headline: Dusty deli vents
summary: Passed. Vents in deli prep area had excessive dust buildup; must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Shrimp thawed in standing water
summary: Passed. Shrimp thawed in standing cold water; must thaw under running water, refrigeration, or as part of cooking. Food handler ate in prep area. Two male handlers lacked training and beard restraints; floor under hand sink needs repair.

headline: Bar drinks made without hand sink
summary: Passed with conditions. Employee prepared bar drinks in basement with no exposed handwashing sink; citation issued. Food prep cannot happen without an exposed hand sink. Also repair self-closing washroom door; clean floor behind bar.

headline: Over 60 mouse droppings; live roaches
summary: Failed. Over 60 mouse droppings along walls and near shelving in rear storage; live roaches on paper towels and in prep areas. Manager told to call an exterminator; priority citation issued. Also missing thermometers and unlabeled bulk containers.

headline: Lentil soup held too warm; discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. About 50 lbs lentil soup held at 52.1°F in walk-in cooler in large covered pot; placed there a day earlier. Priority violation; soup discarded (valued at $100). Walk-in cooler lighting inadequate.

headline: Rodent droppings and live cockroaches found
summary: Failed. About 25 mouse droppings under rear dry storage racks; 1 live cockroach by dishmachine and 2 inside can opener housing; about 20 small flies in dishwashing and bar areas. More pest control needed. Rear door gap must be sealed.

headline: Ice machine buildup dripping onto ice
summary: Failed. Basement ice machine had black, brown, and pink buildup dripping onto ice used for human consumption. Management told to remove ice, deep clean, sanitize, and maintain. Also no hand-washing signs, no food handler training proof, stained cutting boards.

headline: Rat droppings found; thermometer missing
summary: Failed. About 35 rat droppings on utility room floor and about 10 under dish machine. Additional pest control needed; priority citation. Meat cooler lacks thermometer. Prior core violations not corrected, including debris in coolers and dirty floor drains.

headline: Ice machine debris; no pest control log
summary: Failed. Slight debris encrusted inside ice machine; must be removed, detail cleaned, and serviced. No licensed pest control log book on premises; priority citation issued. Torn gasket on prep cooler. Previous core violation (allergen certificates) not corrected.

headline: Allergen training proof missing for managers
summary: Passed. Proof of allergen training or certificates was not provided for all City of Chicago certified food managers.

headline: Cold foods above 41°F; cooler too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. Macaroni and cheese at 51°F and pancake batter at 50.5°F in cooler; 20 lbs discarded ($100). Prep cooler at 60°F must not be used until reinspected. Hand sinks lacked soap and towels at first; supplied during inspection.

headline: Rust and grease around cooking equipment
summary: Passed. Rusted metal trim in dry storage and rust on walk-in cooler door panel need repair or removal. Grease under and behind cooking equipment, dirty storage shelves, and walls and floors around equipment need cleaning.

headline: Holes in walls could let in rodents
summary: Passed. Multiple holes and openings in walls at second- and fourth-floor prep areas. Instructed to seal them to prevent rodent entry.

headline: Bean and rice bags stored on floor
summary: Passed. Bean and rice bags stored on floor in storage area; must be elevated at least six inches. Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints; manager instructed.

headline: Dish machine missing required data plate
summary: Passed. Low-temperature dish machine lacked an easy-to-read manufacturer data plate showing its design and operating specifications. Management told to provide one.

headline: Rat droppings across kitchen and basement
summary: Failed re-inspection. Rat droppings: about 20 under dish machine and 3-compartment sink, 5 behind wok line, 10 in rear dry storage, and 20–30 throughout basement. Rat pest service recommended; priority citation issued. Cooler gaskets torn.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit kit
summary: Failed. Person in charge and manager lacked City food service manager certification; a certified manager must be present whenever open. No vomiting/diarrhea kit, consumer advisory, food thermometers, or pest control log book on site. No citations issued.

headline: Overflowing dumpsters and unlabeled flour
summary: Failed. Outside dumpsters overflowing with trash, preventing lids from closing; priority citation issued. Flour containers and hot sauce lack labels. Wet floor in chicken/fish walk-in cooler; two burnt-out lights at hood.

headline: Ice machine slime and over 50 flies
summary: Failed. Thick black slimy substance inside ice machine dripping onto ice; management told not to use it until cleaned. Over 50 flying insects on walls, shelves, and equipment in food prep and bar areas; pest company consult ordered. Backed-up prep sink.

headline: Unlabeled cold-hold foods; dirty floor
summary: Passed. Food in cold-hold units lacked labels after removal from original packaging. Food debris and dirt on floor behind service door and near hand sink. Certified food service manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Undercooked menu items; leaks; rusted shelves
summary: Failed. Sunny-side up eggs, smoked salmon, and burgers on menu without required consumer advisory; prior core violation not corrected; citation issued. Also no cold water at bar dump sink, leaks at 3-compartment sink and dish machine.

headline: Wall hole; coffee buildup near ice machine
summary: Passed. Small hole in wall across from rear hand sink must be sealed to prevent pests or insects. Coffee grounds and beans built up under counters and around ice machine in front service area; cleaning required.

headline: No soap at prep-area hand sink
summary: Passed with conditions. Hand sink in preparation area had no soap; citation issued. Soap was provided by the end of the inspection.

headline: Raw wood shelves; no covered sanitary bin
summary: Passed. Raw wood shelving in front and rear storage must be sealed or painted to be smooth and cleanable. Women's washroom had no covered receptacle for sanitary napkins; one must be provided.

headline: Leaking faucet at rear sink
summary: Passed. Leaking faucet base at rear 3-compartment sink must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Cold foods too warm in prep cooler
summary: Passed with conditions. Potato salad at 50°F, cheese 47–54°F, and ranch at 49°F held too warm in 3-door prep cooler, which ran at 48°F air temperature. Cold TCS foods must be kept at 41°F or below; citation issued.

headline: Dish machine gauge fixed during inspection
summary: Passed with conditions. Dish machine temperature gauge was inaccurate and was repaired during inspection; citation issued. Women's employee restroom trash receptacle lacked a lid; grout missing near rear prep sink.

headline: Over 20 live flies; no cold water at sink
summary: Failed. Over 20 small live flies throughout establishment; priority citation. Affected areas must be cleaned and sanitized. No cold water at 3-compartment dishwashing sink; must be repaired. Dusty floors and cracked tiles near slushie machine.

headline: No health policy; no bar hand sink
summary: Failed. No employee health policy on premises. No handwashing sink behind bar, no handwashing signs, no barrier at carry-out serving area, and outer doors not rodent-proofed. Priority violations.

headline: Linens touching produce; torn cooler gaskets
summary: Passed. Linens stored in direct contact with broccoli and asparagus in a prep cooler; must be removed. Torn gaskets on sushi-area freezer and refrigerator. Cardboard used as floor mats; no drain stoppers at 3-compartment sink.

headline: No food handler training; expired allergen
summary: Passed. No food handler training proof for all employees; expired allergen training for food managers. Burnt-out pizza oven hood light; debris in oven, fryer cabinets, walk-in cooler, and can opener blade. Squeeze bottles and shakers need labels.

headline: Pastries held too warm without time controls
summary: Passed with conditions. Prepackaged breads and pastries held at 70–78.6°F without time stamps or approved procedure; about 35 lbs ($280) discarded. TCS foods must stay at 135°F or 41°F unless approved. Only 1 of 7 employees had a food handler certificate.

headline: To-go desserts unlabeled; no allergen records
summary: Passed. Desserts sold to go lacked proper labels; must show trace-back information and ingredients. No allergen training certificates on site; certified managers must complete training and keep records on site.

headline: Pushcart labeling; unsecured hot food
summary: Failed. Pushcart needs license number and DBA at least 2 inches tall on both sides. Secure container required for cold beverages. Hot-food heaters (sternos) not secure while in motion; priority violation, no citation issued.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; repeat violation
summary: Passed with conditions. Milk crates used as shelving in bakery freezer and coolers must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor. Slow hand sink drain and burnt-out lights. Uncovered restroom bin from prior inspection was corrected on site.

headline: Cardboard boxes in front area
summary: Passed. Numerous cardboard boxes in the front area must be removed from the premises.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; leaky faucet
summary: Passed. Thermometer missing inside a prep cooling unit. Three-compartment sink faucet neck leaks. Unused cooling equipment clutters front prep area. Certified manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; food on floor
summary: Passed with conditions. Low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm while in use; told not to use until 50 ppm; citation issued. Employees replaced sanitizer during inspection; retest read 100 ppm. Food boxes stored on basement floor; grease buildup on fryer.

headline: Leaking kitchen hand sink faucet
summary: Passed. Kitchen hand sink faucet leaks; must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Coffee debris; lidless trash cans
summary: Passed. Coffee grounds and debris built up on shelves behind coffee machine and near bagged coffee. Both unisex bathrooms have trash cans without lids; lids must be provided.

headline: Dirty dishes left overnight; no training proof
summary: Passed. Dirty dishes with food debris left in the 3-compartment sink from the previous night; must not be left. Floor drain under sink holds food debris. No food handler training proof for required employees; bulk containers need labels.

headline: No certified manager; pest log missing
