summary: Failed. Person in charge lacked City sanitation certificate; no certified manager on site while coffee and milk were prepared and served. No employee health policy, vomiting/diarrhea procedure or kit, or pest control log book. Sanitizer test strips missing.

headline: No hand-wash signs; slow bar drain
summary: Passed. No handwashing signage at bar hand sink. Torn gasket on rear prep freezer door. Bar 3-compartment sink drains slowly. Dust on vent above low-temperature dish machine and grease on cook-line hood filters need detail cleaning.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; no vomit procedure
summary: Passed with conditions. Low-temperature dish machine sanitizing at 0 ppm; tagged and held, may not be used. Also missing employee health policy, written vomit/diarrhea procedure and supplies, handwashing signs, and covered toilet room receptacles.

headline: Basement cleanup and storage organization needed
summary: Passed. Detail clean basement coolers, drip trays, soda nozzles, and cooking equipment sides. Organize basement water heater room and remove unneeded items to avoid pest hiding places; raise stored items 6 inches off floor. Dust on vents.

headline: Rear door gap; greasy fryers and walls
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at rear exit door must be sealed to prevent rodent entry. Splash guard needed at front hand sink. Fryers, cooking equipment, floors, walls, and dining-area fan and vents need cleaning. New food handlers must get training.

headline: Leaks, door closers, and ice buildup
summary: Re-inspection passed. Leaking pipe and excess ice in walk-in freezer, leaking dish machine, and staff restroom doors that do not self-close. Repairs ordered; general upkeep issues.

headline: Gap under door; food off floor; greasy coolers
summary: Passed. Gap along bottom of rear door must be made tight-fitting. Food in walk-in cooler and freezer, and paper goods in storage shed, must be raised off the floor. Heavy grease on coolers, fryers, and shelving must be cleaned.

headline: Flies in sweet shop; shellstock tag dates missing
summary: Failed. About 60 small flies in sweet shop and seafood display areas; priority citation. Pest control recommended on or after 4/11/2024. Shellstock tags lacked the date last shellstock was sold. Mop sink not draining; stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Moldy caulking and greasy floors
summary: Passed. Blackened, moldy wall caulking at dishwashing area must be replaced. Stained cutting boards to be resurfaced or replaced. Walls behind dish machine and ceiling tiles need cleaning. Grease and debris under and around stove.

headline: Soda and ice machine buildup; dirty kitchen
summary: Passed. Heavy syrup and soil under soda dispenser units, calcium buildup inside ice machine, and soil and debris on kitchen floors and walls. Management told to clean and maintain.

headline: Ice machine lacks backflow prevention device
summary: Passed. Ice machine was not connected to water line at inspection. Manager must provide and keep visible a backflow prevention device for the ice machine.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Certified manager on site had no allergen training certificate. Person in charge must obtain it and keep it on site for review.

headline: Hair restraints missing; dirty floors
summary: Passed. Food handlers behind front counter lacked hair restraints. Floors in dishwashing area and basement, including under sinks, corners, and shelves, need cleaning.

headline: Debris along floors and wall bases
summary: Passed. Floors need cleaning along wall bases and in corners behind equipment to remove debris.

headline: Unlabeled food containers; dirty wiping cloths
summary: Passed. Oatmeal and bread crumbs stored out of original containers without labels. Soiled wiping cloths stored on prep tables. Kitchen, prep, and dry storage floors need detail cleaning.

headline: Goat thawed in standing water
summary: Passed. TCS goat thawed in standing water in 3-compartment sink; must thaw under cold running water, microwave, or cooler. Fly strips hung in food prep area must be removed. Grooved, stained cutting boards and ceiling hole need attention.

headline: No certified manager; cooler at 63.2°F
summary: Passed with conditions. No manager with valid City certificate on site while duck and chicken prepared; citation issued. Front prep cooler at 63.2°F tagged; must not be used until it holds 41°F or below. Expired food handler certificates.

headline: No certified manager; mold; pests found
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on site while TCS foods were served. Mold-like substance inside ice machine. About 40 live small flying insects and 7 live house flies in food prep, dishwashing, and restroom areas. Vomit cleanup supplies missing.

headline: Fried rice too warm; employees eating in prep
summary: Passed with conditions. Fried rice in walk-in cooler at 50.5–53.2°F and liquid eggs at 45.4°F; about 15 lbs discarded ($30). Employees ate and drank at prep area; a designated area was ordered. Food stored on freezer floors.

headline: Damaged floor tiles and chipped wall paint
summary: Passed. Missing and damaged floor tiles in dry storage, rear exit, and walk-in cooler must be repaired. Chipped wall paint near rear exit and utility sink must be resurfaced and repainted for easy cleaning.

headline: Worn freezer gasket; kids' drink calorie limit
summary: Passed. Walk-in freezer bottom door gasket is worn and must be repaired or replaced. A kids' menu default drink was offered that exceeds the required limit of 130 calories or less.

headline: Incomplete allergen training for managers
summary: Passed. Allergen training was incomplete. All certified food managers must complete allergen training.

headline: Live pottery planets; broken dish room tiles
summary: Passed. Inspector wrote 'live pottery planets' in roastery section; removal ordered. Broken floor tiles in dish room must be replaced.

headline: No certified manager; dish machine under-sanitizing
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid certified food manager while TCS foods were prepared. Dish machine sanitizer read 10 ppm; corrected on site to 100 ppm and tag removed. Sliced tomatoes at 51.8°F discarded. Food left uncovered; no hair restraints.

headline: Missing hand-wash signs; leaking drainpipe
summary: Passed. Multiple sinks used by food employees lack handwashing signage, including employee washrooms. Leaking drainpipe under prep-area hand sink near cookline must be repaired.

headline: Dishwashing without sanitizer; machine at 0 ppm
summary: Passed with conditions. Employee washed dishes without sanitizer; manager immediately set up sink with chlorine. Low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm; told not to use until 50 ppm, and maintenance called. Overloaded dumpsters; citation issued.

headline: Rust and grease in cooler and fryers
summary: Passed. Rust on walk-in cooler storage racks, and food and dirt on those racks. Food, grease, and dirt built up inside deep fryers and pipes behind them. Expired food handler certificate; certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No food handler certificates; cooler debris
summary: Passed. No food handler certificates on site for food handler employees. Food debris built up on bottom of multi-door reach-in cooler. Restroom lacks covered receptacle for sanitary products.

headline: Missing hand-wash signs; trash in kitchen
summary: Passed. No handwashing signage at front and rear prep sinks. Unlabeled fish and chicken dry-ingredient containers; two bulk containers uncovered. Five garbage bags and cardboard piled in rear prep area and freezer. Greasy hood; damaged toilet-room door closer.

headline: Cold foods held 51–67°F; cooler too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. Cold TCS foods held at 51.3–66.7°F, including turkey, ham, and mayo; about 7 lbs discarded. Three-door cold holding unit at 63.9°F tagged. Faucet on hand sink used to rinse equipment must be removed.

headline: Ice buildup on freezer condenser; dusty ceiling
summary: Passed. Ice buildup on rear of walk-in freezer condenser must be removed. Dust and food buildup on prep area ceiling tiles and walls must be cleaned.

headline: No handwashing sign in washroom
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign in washroom. Signs must be posted at all sinks used by food employees; instructed to provide.

headline: Chicken held at 49–52°F; discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. About 60 lbs of chicken held at 49–52°F, above 41°F limit; person in charge discarded it voluntarily ($200). Citation issued. Also a leaking rear hand sink pipe and no allergen training certificate on site.

headline: No bar hand sink; unsafe dish machine
summary: Failed. No exposed handwashing sink in first-floor bar. Basement dish machine read 0 ppm sanitizer; corrected on site and held. Opening at front door base must be sealed. No prep sink in first-floor prep area. Holes in walls and ceilings.

headline: Missing drain stoppers and handwashing signs
summary: License inspection passed. Handwashing signs provided on site during inspection. Three drain stoppers missing from three-compartment sink. Wall covering beside that sink needs finishing; ceiling vent covers needed in two restrooms.

headline: Mineral buildup under seafood display coolers
summary: Re-inspection passed. Dirty mineral buildup under all seafood display coolers; must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Front door gap, burned-out bulbs, greasy dish machine
summary: Passed. Half-inch gap between front entrance doors; must be rodent-proofed. Food buildup on dish machine exterior must be cleaned. Burned-out ceiling bulbs above dish room must be replaced.

headline: Missing thermometer and labels; dim light
summary: Re-inspection passed. No metal-stem thermometer on site. Seasonings and condiments unlabeled. Soda and water stored on floor. Soiled mop in dishwashing area. Light in utility sink closet extremely dim and near burnout.

headline: Over 100 mice droppings; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Result: Fail. Over 100 mouse droppings in prep area, behind coolers, in utility storage, and on equipment bases; exterminator required. Low-temperature dish machine at 0 ppm, tagged and held. Also open drink cups on prep table and bulk lids in handwash sink.

headline: No food handler training proof on record
summary: Complaint inspection passed. No proof of food handler training for any food handler. Manager instructed to provide and maintain these records at all times.

headline: Dog inside facility; overflowing trash
summary: Pass with conditions. Prohibited animal (dog) inside facility; instructed to remove it; citation issued. Women's restroom receptacle overflowing with a strong odor. Dumpster lids not closed due to trash overflow; citation issued. Food stored on floor.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food service
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager on site or certificate posted during TCS food prep and service; citation issued. Also no hair restraint, unlabeled containers, cloths on prep tables, floor-stored items, greasy walls, and missing training proof.

headline: Door gap, leaking faucet, torn gasket
summary: Passed. Gap of about 1/4 inch at bottom of rear exterior door must be repaired to a tight fit. Also ice machine door buildup, torn prep cooler gasket, leaking three-compartment sink faucet, and uncovered restroom receptacle.

headline: Missing thermometer; leaking condenser; dusty vent
summary: License re-inspection passed. Prep cooler lacks a thermometer. Condenser leaking, causing liquid buildup inside cooler bottom. Dust on light shields around prep area vent must be cleaned.

headline: No mop sink; wastewater dumped in alley
summary: Re-inspection passed. No mop sink on site; manager says employees discard mop water in the alley. A mop sink was present during licensing; instructed to install one.

headline: Cheese held too warm; towels catching grease
summary: Pass with conditions. Shredded cheese and cheese sauce at 45.3–46.2°F; about 10 lbs ($70) discarded; citation issued. Towels used behind salamander to catch drippings; told to stop, a fire hazard. Pots drying upright; clutter on floor.

headline: Dead gnats in basement; restroom door and vent issues
summary: Passed. About 80 dead gnats on basement floor along walls; must be removed and area cleaned. Restroom door opening to kitchen is not self-latching. Dusty vent above utility sink. No mechanical ventilation in employee washroom. Certified managers lacked allergen awareness certificates.

headline: Missing handwash signs; food debris on equipment
summary: Short-form complaint passed. No handwashing signs at staff washroom sinks. Bulk seasoning unlabeled. Milk crates used as shelving. Food debris on cooking equipment, fryers, and deli, bakery, and produce surfaces. Leaks at sprayer, backflow device, and toilet.

headline: Certified manager absent at first; cooler too warm
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified manager or original certificate on site at first; both arrived during inspection; citation issued. Front cooler at 49.0°F tagged and not to be used. Single-use bowls used as scoops; utensils stored in 85°F water.

headline: Ice scoop stored in ice; dirty machine, drains
summary: Passed. Small buildup inside ice machine. Ice scoop stored in ice machine and fountain ice bin. Worn cutting board with deep cuts. Greasy hot holding table and fryer shelves; drains with debris and foam; dusty air vents.

headline: Mop sink removed; manager must provide one
summary: Re-inspection passed. No mop sink on site because it was removed. Manager instructed to provide a mop sink with hot and cold running water.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; leaking handle
summary: Passed with conditions. Low-temperature dish machine in bar had 0 ppm chlorine sanitizer; tagged and held for inspection. Also no handwashing signs, torn cooler gasket, grooved cutting boards, leaking hot-water handle, and greasy hood.

headline: Greasy cardboard liners; torn cooler gaskets
summary: Passed. Greasy cardboard liners on shelving; torn gaskets on two-door cooler near ice cream machine; leaky faucet neck on three-compartment sink; burned-out bulbs; expired food handler certificates.

headline: Raw wood shelving; washroom door not self-closing
summary: Passed. Raw wood storage shelves in front prep area must be painted or sealed. Washroom door is not self-closing; must install a self-closing device.

headline: Overfilled outdoor bins; ruined lids
summary: Pass with conditions. Three outdoor waste receptacles overfilled so lids could not close, leaving waste accessible to rodents and other pests. Pickup arranged on site; citation issued. Also foil-lined grease siphon hose and perforated wall plate.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training proof
summary: Pass with conditions. Repeat violation: certified food manager had no proof of allergen training, not corrected since December 17, 2024 report; citation issued.

headline: Door openings, drain leak, buildup throughout
summary: Passed. Openings at rear exit and hallway doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Leaking drainpipe in dish area. Debris around compactor, cluttered storage room, and buildup in floor drains, freezer ice, and vent covers.

headline: Rat droppings found; hot water inadequate; food discarded
summary: Result: Fail. About 20 rat droppings found under sink, behind freezer, and under lockers; more pest control needed. Improperly dated ready-to-eat foods (about 100 lbs) discarded. Hot water only 47.9–49.8°F; plumber repaired it during inspection.

headline: Live ants found; sink backs up; no signs
summary: Result: Fail. About 25 live ants in dining area, dry storage corners, and near three-compartment sink; pest control required; citation issued. Front prep double handwash sink backs up when used; use alternative sink until repaired.

headline: Live flies near ice machine; no hot water
summary: Result: Fail. About 22 small and large live flies around ice machine, rolling carts, boxes, and hot water tank; citation issued. No hot water at three-compartment sink or prep handwash sinks, with temperatures 63–72°F. Restroom handwash sink lacked paper towels.

headline: Insect control devices above beverages; cleaning needed
summary: Re-inspection passed. Digital insect control devices stored above beverage area must be moved away from food-contact surfaces. Sauce shelf, walls, floors, and area behind dish machine need cleaning. Certified manager lacked allergen certificate on site.

headline: Missing hand soap and paper towels; no labels
summary: Pass with conditions. Prep handwash sink had no hand soap or paper towels; food handler obtained them during inspection; citation issued. Also unlabeled flour and sugar bulk bins, wet wiping cloths, and food handlers without training proof.

headline: Prep handwash sink drains slowly
summary: Passed. Prep area handwash sink pipe drains slowly; manager instructed that the pipe must drain quickly.

headline: Over 15 flies; missing food handler proof
summary: Result: Fail. More than 15 flies found on service line, in dish area, store floor, and office; citation issued. Manager told to service all affected areas. Food handler had no proof of food handler training.

headline: No hot water; missing soap and paper towels
summary: Result: Fail. Handwash sink by walk-in cooler at 74.2°F; women's restroom handwash sink has no running water. Soap and paper towels missing; soap corrected on site; citation issued. Soiled mop heads not stored properly.

headline: Pop crates as shelving; dusty, cluttered areas
summary: Re-inspection passed. Pop crates used as shelving. Dust and debris on display racks, coolers, freezers, and counters. Excessive clutter must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Walls, floors, and ceiling vents need cleaning.

headline: 15–20 live flies; repeat violations
summary: Result: Fail. About 15–20 live large and small flies in dish area and basement; pest control recommended; citation issued. Torn refrigerator gasket. Prior violations not corrected: rough wooden cutting boards, rusty shelving, taped freezer handle, and unneeded basement items.

headline: Improper thawing; severe handwashing sink leak
summary: Result: Fail. Frozen food found in three-compartment sink rinse basin with no running water. Food handler lacked hair restraint. Severe leak at front handwash sink; manager placed a container under it. Also rusty prep tables and dirty holding units.

headline: Prep tables need cleaning near mop sink
summary: Re-inspection passed. Prep tables in food prep area need cleaning, especially near the mop sink and under the grill.

headline: Improper utensil storage; mop stored incorrectly
summary: Passed. Scoops stored inside food container. Plates and glassware not inverted after sanitizing. Mop stored improperly; must be hung with mophead upright between uses.

headline: Person in charge lacked posted sanitation certificate
summary: Pass with conditions. Person in charge had no valid city food service sanitation certificate posted for public view; citation issued. Also no covered restroom receptacle, no self-closing restroom door in prep area, floors needing regrout, and dusty vents.

headline: Dish machine too cool; sushi rice records missing
summary: Result: Fail. High-temperature dish machine reached only 151.7°F, below the required minimum; citation issued. Sushi rice held without time-as-control records; about 1 lb discarded. Production logs missing. Slight black slime inside ice machine.

headline: Warm handwash water, weak sanitizer, warm beef
summary: Result: Fail. Employee restroom handwash sink water at 72°F; must be at least 100°F. Dish machine sanitizer at 10 ppm, below the 50–100 ppm required; serviced during inspection; citation issued. 10 lbs of beef at 70.4°F discarded.

headline: Unlabeled containers; chicken in plastic bags
summary: Passed. Storage containers without labels showing common food names. Frozen chicken stored in plastic grocery bags in the freezer; management instructed to use food-grade bags and containers only.

headline: Dishes washed without sanitizing; corrected after instruction
summary: Passed with conditions. Employee washed pots and utensils with soap and water only; sink not set up and no sanitizer used. Corrected after instruction. Also food on cooler floor, submerged dispensing containers, unventilated stoves, and manager missing allergen training.

headline: Display cooler too warm; 40 lbs discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Display cooler at 55°F; lunchmeat 50.0°F, milk 50.5°F, eggs 52.5°F. Manager voluntarily discarded 40 lbs ($2,000). Cooler tagged and held for CDPH re-inspection. Grease buildup on equipment and surrounding areas.

headline: Cold foods too warm; handwashing and dishwashing lapses
summary: Passed with conditions. Several cold-held (TCS) foods reached up to 86.3°F; 10 lbs discarded. Basement handwashing sink clogged, no soap. Dish machine sanitizer at 0 ppm. Employee washed hands while wearing gloves and returned to prep without changing them.

headline: No variance logs on site; records missing
summary: Result: Fail. No logs on site for the approved Chicago Department of Public Health (CDPH) variance. Manager told to keep thermometer calibration, temperature, refrigeration, and other variance-required records on site at all times; citation issued.

headline: Cold foods held at 44–57°F; coolers too warm
summary: Pass with conditions. TCS foods held at 44–57°F. Yogurt, sliced tomatoes, sausage, and chicken discarded ($75). Two coolers at 44°F and 45°F tagged; citation issued.

headline: Food splatters in cold units; drain grime
summary: Re-inspection passed. Cold-holding units had food splatters inside; kitchen floor drains had debris and grime. Manager has no allergen certificate on site and was instructed to obtain and keep one there.

headline: Improper plate storage, torn gasket, greasy hood
summary: Re-inspection passed. Serving plates on kitchen shelves must be inverted to prevent dust. Torn rubber gasket on prep cooler. Floors along walls and under equipment need cleaning. Heavy dirt and grease in hood, filters, and pipes.

headline: No certified manager; dead mouse; no hot water
summary: Result: Fail. No certified manager from 8:15 to 8:50 AM while eggs and milk were prepared and served. Dead mouse under water heater. Employee restroom handwash sink had no hot water (66.5°F). Walk-in freezer at 69.2°F; prep cooler tagged.

headline: Torn screens, rusted racks, large bakery leak
summary: Re-inspection passed. Kitchen window mesh had large gaps, making fly entry possible; tight-fitting screens required. Large leak under bakery handwash sink. Milk crates used for elevation and rough cutting boards must be replaced. Rust and floor repairs noted.

headline: Ripped cooler gaskets and greasy hood filters
summary: Result: Fail. Several rear prep cooler door gaskets ripped; must be repaired or replaced. Food debris inside coolers. Hood filters above griddle caked with grease and debris, a previous violation from 12/23/25 not corrected.

headline: Black slime in ice machine, dripping into ice
summary: Result: Fail. Black slimy substance dripped from ice machine interior into ice used for human consumption. Manager told to shut off machine, remove ice, and have it cleaned and sanitized. Also rusty shelving, stained cutting board, unlidded restroom bin, water-stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Unlabeled containers; torn gasket; greasy surfaces
summary: Passed. Foods and spices outside original containers lack labels. Torn gasket on prep-area cooler door must be repaired or replaced. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, freezers, and shelving.

headline: 25 small flies; no hand-sink paper towel
summary: Result: Fail. About 25 small flies near dish machine and bar handwash sink; citation issued and pest control consultation advised. Bar handwash sink had no paper towel; one was obtained during inspection. Missing floor grout and broken tiles in prep area.

headline: Live roach infestation; food held at wrong temperatures
summary: Result: Fail. About 15–20 live roaches throughout prep and dish areas, plus flies; pest control recommended; citation issued. Fried chicken at 89.0°F at room temperature. Fish, catfish, and shrimp at 48.1–53.8°F. No hot water at some handwash sinks.

headline: No self-closing restroom door; trash outside
summary: License inspection passed. Restroom door needs a self-closing device. Shoes, broken glass, and debris on the ground by the outside dumpster must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Blocked handwash sink; food stored near cleaners
summary: Result: Fail. Main prep kitchen handwash sink obstructed by stored pans. Chopped cabbage stored at mop sink under cleaning chemicals; discarded. Sauce station lacked adequate sneeze guard; customers speak over open food containers.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit cleanup kit
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified manager on site while hot dogs prepared; citation issued. No vomit and diarrhea kit or procedure; one-pager left. No sanitizer test devices. Three employees lacked food handler training.

headline: No running water at three-compartment sink
summary: Result: Fail. No running water at three-compartment sink in dish area; no hot or cold handles installed. Repair required; priority violation and citation issued. Missing allergen training certificates for certified food managers.

headline: Chicken thawing in prep sink; ice scoop misplaced
summary: Passed. Bags of chicken in rear prep sink were thawing; manager was advised of approved methods (under cold running water or in refrigeration). Chicken measured 34.1°F. Ice scoop stored inside ice machine; holder required.

headline: No hot water; missing soap, towels, health policy
summary: Result: Fail. No hot running water on premises; must provide above 110°F at three-compartment sinks and above 100°F at handwash sinks. No hand soap or paper towels at prep or restroom sinks. No written employee health policy; food handlers lacked training proof.

headline: Hidden coffee backflow device; dim cooler lighting
summary: Passed. Backflow prevention device for coffee maker could not be located; instructed to expose it. Beverage walk-in cooler lighting inadequate; instructed to provide better lighting.

headline: About 30 mouse droppings; rodent activity found
summary: Result: Fail. Rodent activity in storage and utility closets: about 30 mouse droppings on floor and behind water heater. Additional pest control needed; citation issued. Shattered pastry cabinet glass must be replaced. Certified manager lacked allergen certificate.

headline: Expired allergen training for certified manager
summary: Re-inspection passed. Certified food manager's allergen training certificate was expired. Manager instructed to provide allergen training for all certified food managers.

headline: Rusted can opener and loose cooler hardware
summary: Passed. Heavily rusted can opener must be replaced. Loose hinge on reach-in cooler and sliding cooler door need repair. Cardboard covering greasy grease-trap door must be replaced with a smooth, cleanable surface. Customer restroom air vent dusty and blocked.

headline: Dead ants on basement stairs; missing labels
summary: Re-inspection passed. Dead ants on stair landing to basement; instructed to remove and clean. Squirt bottles and dry ingredients unlabeled. Pink and black buildup in ice machine above ice. Certified manager lacked allergen certificate.

headline: No mop sink; milk crates used for storage
summary: License inspection passed. No mop sink on premises; manager must provide one with hot and cold running water. Milk crates used to elevate stored items must stop. Staff restroom needs a self-closing door and mechanical ventilation.

headline: Utensils uncovered, boxes on floor, no bins
summary: Re-inspection passed. Forks, knives, and spoons stored in containers without covers or inversion. Boxes on dry storage floor must be elevated six inches. Northwest women's restroom lacks covered receptacles.

headline: Original manager certificate absent; facility upkeep issues
summary: Result: Fail. Person in charge lacked the original city certificate during TCS food prep; only a ServSafe copy was shown. A 2x3-inch hole under the bar sink must be sealed against pests. Broken garbage lids and dirty kitchen floors also noted.

headline: Front door gap; dirty drain; greasy hood
summary: Passed. About 1/4-inch gap under front door with weather strip missing; must be repaired to prevent possible pest activity. Drain under three-compartment sink has heavy dirt and slimy substance. Greasy hood filters and system.

headline: Live roaches and mouse droppings; no certificate
summary: Result: Fail. About 20 live roaches in prep table crevice; about 20 mouse droppings in dry storage; dead roaches throughout prep area. No valid sanitation certificate or certified manager during TCS food prep; citation issued.

headline: Wet wiping cloths, exposed ice scoop, missing sign
summary: Re-inspection passed. Wet wiping cloths on several prep surfaces; must be stored in sanitizing solution between uses. Ice scoop stored on ice bin with food-contact surface exposed. No handwashing sign at upstairs bar sink.

headline: Missing handwash signs; restroom trash lacks cover
summary: Passed. Handwashing signage missing at handwash sinks. Restroom trash receptacle missing a cover. Manager instructed to obtain signage and cover and maintain them.

headline: Greasy fryers, leaky handwash sink, dirty floors
summary: Passed. Fryer interiors greasy and dirty. Leak at handwash sink by chef's office. Floor drains, corners, and equipment in prep and dish areas have grease and debris. Ceiling tile above three-compartment sink in poor repair. CFM allergen certificate expired.

headline: Mouse droppings found; manager certificate missing
summary: Result: Fail. About 5–10 mouse droppings on prep tables and near grease trap; pest control required. No certified food manager with original certificate on site; no employee health policy. Handwash soap and probe thermometer missing.

headline: Leaking three-compartment faucet; damaged floor tile
summary: Passed. Leaks at top and base of three-compartment sink faucet. Damaged floor tile in front of walk-in cooler. Dirt buildup on floor drain, floor around grease trap, vents, and food splatter on wall.

headline: No valid food handler training; storage issues
summary: Passed. No valid food handler training for employees, and no valid allergen training for certified managers. Single-service items stored on basement floor; milk crates used as shelving; stained ceiling tiles and unfinished storage walls.

headline: Roaches in lockers and locker room
summary: Result: Fail. About 10 live roaches in employee lockers and on locker room floor, plus dead roaches throughout. Pest control recommended; citation issued 12/10/25. Also unlidded ice bin, leaking ice machine drain, missing splash guards and grout.

headline: Low hot water; very unclean floors
summary: Pass with conditions. Hot water measured 67°F at start; restored to 110°F during inspection and must stay at 110–120°F. Leak under front service handwash sink. Floors under and behind heavy equipment very unclean; reach-in cooler interiors need cleaning.

headline: Cold foods too warm; handwash sink lacked hot water
summary: Result: Fail. Salad cooler held cooked chicken at 80.1°F and pork at 53.2–56.2°F; about 12 lbs discarded. Rear prep cooler tagged, not to be used. Handwash sink turned off with no hot water; repair notified. No employee health policy.

headline: Mouse and rat droppings; cold food too warm
summary: Result: Fail. About 100 or more mouse and rat droppings on dish shelves, service counter, floors, and basement; pest control recommended. Raw chicken 69.8°F, cooked chicken 70.0°F, eggs 48.2°F; refrigerator 51.4°F. No pest control log.

headline: No certificate posted; mold-like ice machine panel
summary: Pass with conditions. No valid city sanitation certificate posted while coffee with milk and cream was prepared; citation issued. No written employee health policy. Black pink mold-like substance on ice machine panel touching ice; citation issued.

headline: No certified manager certificate posted during service
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified manager certificate posted while pizza and chicken wings were prepared; manager arrived at 2:05 PM with certificate; citation issued. Sauce bottles unlabeled; to-go containers stored on floor.

headline: Door gap, raw wood shelving, dirty ice machine
summary: Passed. Top of front doors not tight-fitting; must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Raw wood shelving in walk-in cooler must be smooth and easily cleanable. Ice machine interior dirty; must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Leaking utility sink; stained ceilings; missing fan
summary: Re-inspection passed. Utility sink backflow leaking; must be repaired. Heavily stained basement prep ceiling tiles must be replaced. Missing fan and fan cover on utility sink; missing light shield in basement prep area.

headline: No health policy, vomit kit, or exposed handsinks
summary: Result: Fail. No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit on premises. No exposed handwash sinks in prep areas; no test strips; no self-closing restroom doors or waste receptacles. Food handlers must obtain required training.

headline: Missing hand sign; rust on cooler shelves
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign at front prep sink. Cardboard on dry storage shelf, rust on cooler shelves, and items on dry storage floor must be six inches up. Grease and dust on ventilation filters.

headline: Food stored on floor; soiled mop heads
summary: Passed. Food items stored on floor in walk-in cooler; must be elevated six inches. Soiled mop heads not properly stored; must be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food service
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager present while TCS foods (ice cream, hot dogs) were prepared and served; citation issued. Storage cabinets, small reach-in cooler, freezer interiors, and floors need cleaning.

headline: Trash bin in restroom lacks lid
summary: Re-inspection passed. Unisex restroom trash receptacle has no lid. Manager instructed to provide one and maintain it.

headline: Door gap, backflow leaks, missing tiles
summary: Passed. Gap of about 1/4 inch at bottom of rear warehouse door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Backflow leaks at utility and dish sinks. Foil lining on prep equipment. Missing ceiling tile, damaged floor tiles, and burned-out restroom light.

headline: No certified manager; raw steak handled without washing
summary: Result: Fail. No certified food manager on arrival while TCS foods were prepared; manager arrived about 1 hour later. Employee touched raw steak then tortilla without washing hands; hands washed, gloves changed, tortilla discarded. Three-compartment sink floods between drains.

headline: Brooms and dust pans too close to clean glass
summary: Passed. Brooms and dust pans kept too close to clean glass; instructed to keep them away.

headline: Leaking sink pipe, worn gasket, floor debris
summary: Re-inspection passed. Leaky pipe at middle of three-compartment sink must be repaired or replaced. Worn gasket on bar prep cooler door must be repaired or replaced. Gaps under bar counter must be sealed; floor debris must be cleaned.

headline: Heavy grease under dish equipment; dirty floors
summary: Passed. Heavy grease and soil on top of grease trap under dishwashing equipment; detail cleaning required. Spilled food debris on floors under dishwashing equipment and dirt in rear utility room.

headline: Restroom door lacks self-closing device
summary: License inspection passed. Toilet room door has no self-closing device; instructed to install one.

headline: Loose restroom faucet; ice machine door gaps
summary: Passed. Customer restroom faucet handle extremely loose; must be tightened or repaired. Rear dish area ice machine door in poor repair with gaps. Fryer interiors greasy and dirty. Walk-in cooler lighting too dim.

headline: Low-pressure handwash sink; wall needs cleaning
summary: Passed. One of four handwash sinks, in the women's restroom, has low water pressure and must be repaired. Black substance on wall under dish machine must be cleaned.

headline: Cooling units not working; ice buildup; clutter
summary: Passed. One cooling unit in rear prep and two in kitchen not working; must be repaired to hold 41°F or below, or removed. Excess ice in walk-in freezer, unlabeled dry ingredient containers, deeply cut cutting boards, and cluttered basement.

headline: Floor drains and floors need cleaning
summary: Re-inspection passed. Floor drains had residue and debris. Floors near dish machine, rear dry storage rack, and under bar area had residue, litter, and buildup. Manager instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Mouse droppings; expired food handler certificates
summary: Result: Fail. About 20 mouse droppings found in facility and at rear; pest control recommended; citation issued. Pink and black mold-like substance inside ice machine. Expired food handler certificates posted; no allergen certificates for employees.

headline: Cold food too warm; soap added on site
summary: Beef at 53.2°F and chicken at 55.8°F in a prep cooler were discarded (10 lbs). Hand soap was missing and added on site. Soiled wiping cloths, cardboard floor liner, greasy fryer filter, and no allergen training on site.

headline: Live fruit flies found; repeat violations
summary: Over 30 live fruit flies near the staff door and over 10 in rear food storage. Pink residue in ice machine. Earlier violations were not corrected, including food stored on floors. Citation issued.

headline: No backflow device; no dedicated prep sink
summary: Basement ice machine lacks a backflow prevention device. Front bar has no sink for food prep and waste water; staff dump liquid into a bucket. Bathroom door does not self-close, floors have debris, and a manager's allergen training expired.

headline: Live and dead roaches; cooler too warm
summary: One live roach at cook line and multiple dead roaches, including inside ice machine. Ice machine has heavy black and pink slime; cited. Egg rolls, chicken, beef and shrimp at 46-52°F in a prep cooler were discarded; cooler tagged. Summary not posted.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving
summary: Milk crates are used as shelving throughout prep and storage areas. They must be removed and replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Hand sink blocked; door gap; no food handler card
summary: Kitchen hand sink was blocked by a table and utensil containers while cooks were working; manager removed them on site. Priority foundation violation. Rear door gap, dirty fryer, and a food handler without certificate.

headline: Sticky floor; slow sink; burnt-out bulbs
summary: Sticky buildup on the floor of an unused bar near a patio exit. A slow-draining hand sink in the main bar. Burnt-out bulbs in the basement restroom and over hoods. One of two managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Food prepared under exhaust; outdated training
summary: Raw salmon and cucumber were prepared under a ventilation exhaust; staff told to stop. A large absorbent wooden bowl for sushi rice must be replaced. Some food handlers and a certified manager had expired training.

headline: Rodent droppings; no paper towels
summary: About 20-30 mouse droppings in storage closet and rear prep area; rodent activity evident; more pest control needed. Hand sinks lack paper towels, and one sink was blocked by a bucket. Three-compartment sink backs up and leaks. Citation issued.

headline: Greasy fryers; no allergen training
summary: Stained and deeply cut cutting boards in kitchen prep. Encrusted grease and food debris under all fryers. Low hot water pressure at rear prep sink. Certified managers have no allergen training; documentation must be kept on site.

headline: Utensils not inverted; greasy hood
summary: Multi-use utensils were not stored upside down. Ventilation hood and filters had excessive grease buildup. Staff instructed to clean and maintain. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Food residue in cold holds; wall hole
summary: Food residue inside and outside cold-hold units must be cleaned. Holes in the yellow-painted wall between front and rear prep must be repaired to prevent pest harborage. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Torn liners on fridge and ice machine
summary: Torn protective plastic lining on a small fridge and the ice machine must be removed for a smooth, cleanable surface. One of three managers lacked proof of allergen training.

headline: Greasy fryers and hood; new staff untrained
summary: Unlabeled large containers in walk-in cooler; labels with discard date required. Grease splatter on fryers and hood filters to be cleaned. New employees without food handler certificates must complete training.

headline: No certified manager; live roaches found
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site while chicken and pork were cooked and prepared. About 12 live cockroaches were found under the three-compartment sink. Citation issued. Greasy equipment and dirty walk-in shelves also noted.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths; clutter; floor debris
summary: Soiled wiping cloths stored throughout prep; must be kept in sanitizer at least 50 ppm. Toilet fixtures need cleaning. Excess clutter on unused equipment and shelving, a pest hiding spot. Dried food debris on prep and storage floors.

headline: Cold food too warm; over 50 mouse droppings
summary: Cheese sauce, sausage and ham held above 41°F were discarded (about 20 lbs). A prep cooler at 49.1°F was tagged. Over 50 mouse droppings were found in the utility room, under equipment and in dry storage. Citation issued.

headline: Meat thawed in standing water; fly strips
summary: Packaged meat was thawing in a pan of water instead of an approved method. Several fly strips were hanging in the rear prep area; they must be removed and pest control used. Wiping cloths and cutting boards need correct care.

headline: Hands not washed between raw and ready-to-eat
summary: Workers handled raw burger patties with bare hands, then touched utensil and equipment handles used for ready-to-eat foods without washing. Touched dishes were resanitized. Women's restroom hot water reached 83°F, then dropped to 76°F; citation issued.

headline: Broken toilet; public summary not posted
summary: One of four men's toilets was not working. An unused high-temperature dish machine was tagged 'do not use.' The inspection summary was not posted for public view; inspector left one and instructed posting. Citation issued.

headline: Rear door gap; slow drain; food debris
summary: Rear exterior door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom and must be made tight-fitting. Women's restroom hand sink drains slowly. Food debris on carpet in rear dry storage. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Drain pipe runs into bar hand sink
summary: A drainage pipe runs into the hand sink at the rear bar. It must be rerouted to a dump sink or floor drain, or covered. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Food debris under equipment; must clean
summary: Inspector found food debris under grill equipment, cooling units and registers in the prep area. Staff must remove food, grease and trash and keep the area clean.

headline: No hand sink at drink area; no training
summary: No hand-washing sink in front of the drink prep area; must install one or move drinks and ice. No backflow device on ice machine. No food handler or allergen training. Front door gap, cluttered prep area and loose floor tiles.

headline: Greasy pizza oven hood; debris on floors
summary: Debris on floors throughout rear prep area. Excessive grease on the hood and filters above the pizza oven must be cleaned. Certified foodservice manager had no allergen training.

headline: Missing signs; items stored on floor
summary: Hand-wash signs missing at front prep and coffee sinks. Food stored on floor in walk-in cooler; wiping cloths on prep tables. Rusty shelving, ice buildup in freezer, greasy cooking equipment and leaking faucet. Espresso machine lacks backflow device.

headline: No hand-wash signs; overloaded dumpster; leaks
summary: Hand-wash signs were missing. Ice machine lining not cleaned. A three-compartment sink has a leaking faucet, leaking pipe and poor stopper. Dumpster overloaded so lid would not close; citation issued. Managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Fryer grease; empty cans in prep area
summary: Minor grease buildup inside fryers must be cleaned. Several empty metal cans are in the prep area and must be removed.

headline: Fan blocked hand sink; roaches under sink
summary: A fan on top of the main-kitchen hand sink blocked access. No hand soap at that sink. Eight cockroaches under the three-compartment sink; house flies in rear storage; back door left wide open. Priority foundation violation.

headline: Missing hand-wash signs; food on floor; failed
summary: No hand-wash signs in restrooms. Buckets of food stored on walk-in floor. Employees not wearing hair restraints. Missing ceiling tiles, broken floor tiles and peeling paint. Leaking three-compartment sink and missing restroom trash lid. Citation issued.

headline: No covered trash cans; holes in walls
summary: Single-person restrooms had no covered waste containers. Holes were found in the wall near the garage exit and in a cylinder-shaped wall in the rear prep area. Manager was instructed to seal them.

headline: Hand-wash signs missing; no cooler thermometer
summary: Hand-wash signs missing near kitchen food prep sink. Working thermometer needed in a tall prep cooler. Employee prepared and served food without a hair restraint. Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables and shelving.

headline: Flies found; dish machine too cool
summary: High-temperature dish machine reached only 156°F; must display above 160°F. About 25 small flying insects and 7 house flies found in dining, deli and basement prep areas; more pest control needed. Garbage around outside dumpster.

headline: Wrong test strips; summary not posted
summary: Test strips on site were for quat and pool use, not chlorine sanitizer used for dishes. Cold holds lacked air thermometers. Food debris on a cooler ledge. Prior inspection summary was not posted; new one posted during inspection. Citation issued.

headline: Missing hand-wash signs; no waste bin
summary: Hand-wash signs missing at sinks in food prep areas and toilet room. Dry storage containers unlabeled. Employee toilet room lacks a covered receptacle. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Greasy fryers; standing mop water corrected
summary: Grease found on fryer exteriors, bottoms and electrical panels; must be cleaned. Standing wastewater in a mop bucket was corrected on site. Washroom door needs a self-closing device; floors and walls need cleaning.

headline: Mold on dairy shelving; greasy hot-food area
summary: Broken paper towel dispensers in all washrooms (towels available). Green and white mold-like buildup on dairy shelving and a dairy display cooler. Dust and food debris in display coolers. Heavy grease near fryers and floor drains.

headline: Torn gasket on prep cooler
summary: A torn door gasket was found inside a two-door prep cooler. Staff were instructed to replace it.

headline: Dirt and debris in several areas
summary: Dirt and debris found on a light shield above the front prep area, on the walk-in cooler floor by the wall base, and in washroom and sink-area floor drains. Must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Unlabeled bins, dirty coolers and floors
summary: No hand-washing sign at the dim sum prep sink. Food storage bins are unlabeled. Discolored cutting boards, coolers, microwaves and fryers need deep cleaning. Employee restroom is dirty and floors are damaged or dirty.

headline: Unlabeled food; milk crates used as shelves
summary: Food stored in coolers, walk-in and dry storage was not labeled after leaving its original packaging. Tongs were stored on a milk crate. Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced with shelves 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Pests found; cooler too warm; slime in ice
summary: About 50 live small flying insects and 4 house flies in bar, basement prep and ice areas; more pest control needed. Black slime in ice machine. Sushi cooler and walk-in too warm; about 35 lbs discarded. Prior violations uncorrected. Citation issued.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: A City-certified foodservice manager had no allergen training. Manager must obtain it and provide proof.

headline: Droppings throughout; many food safety gaps
summary: Over 50-60 droppings found on floors throughout the facility; manager told to call an exterminator. Also missing food thermometer, sanitizer test strips, hand soap, paper towels, food handler certificates and a vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit.

headline: Icemaker slime; no soap or towels at sinks
summary: Thick black slimy substance in the ice machine dripped onto ice; manager told not to use it until cleaned. No soap or paper towels at some hand sinks; dish machine at 0 ppm sanitizer, not in use. Citation issued.

headline: No certified manager while cooking TCS foods
summary: No person in charge with a City certified manager certificate on site. No staff with certificate while chicken and mac and cheese were prepared. Priority foundation violation; citation issued. Base coving soiled.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths; leaking grease trap
summary: Unlabeled bulk containers; soiled wiping cloths on prep tables; grease trap leaking near washroom; grease on walls, ceilings and floors in prep, storage and dish areas; unused items and hood grease need removal. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Dish sanitizing skipped; food temps; live pests
summary: Dishes washed without sanitizer setup; manager corrected on site with chlorine. Hot-holding and cold-holding items had improper temperatures; about 51 lbs ($650) discarded. Rear exit doors are not rodent proof. Citation issued.

headline: Restroom door and dusty vent
summary: Washroom door lacks a self-closing device. Dust on the washroom ceiling vent cover. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Jewelry worn and hair restraints missing
summary: Several food handlers wore dangling bracelets, rings and necklaces while preparing food, and some lacked hair restraints. Dirty floor drains under sinks and soda machines were also noted. Employee jackets hung in dry storage.

headline: No hand-wash signs; no trash at sink
summary: No hand-wash signs at the men's and accessible restrooms. No waste receptacle for paper towels at the kitchen hand sink. Base coving missing where walls meet floors in the rear dry storage closet.

headline: Only one public restroom for 45 seats
summary: Forty-five seats were set up, but only one restroom is accessible to customers. Must cut seating to 30 or add an accessible restroom with hand-washing. Priority foundation violation. Result: Fail.

headline: No sanitation manager; missing backflow devices
summary: No City sanitation manager or person in charge with certificate while milk and eggs were handled. Managers lack allergen training. Two ice machines lack backflow devices; customer restroom doors do not self-close. Citation issued.

headline: Rear door gap; repeat violations uncorrected
summary: Rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap and is not rodent or insect proof. Tongs stored on a container; fryer exteriors greasy. Earlier violations were not corrected, including a hole in the men's restroom wall and missing allergen training. Citation issued.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup procedure
summary: No employee health policy on site and no procedure for cleaning up vomit or diarrhea. Also missing hand-washing sign, a bathroom door that does not self-close, and a toilet with no working ventilation. No citation issued.

headline: Two coolers out of service; door fell off
summary: Four-door drink cooler at the main bar was off, awaiting repair. A four-door prep cooler was tagged and must not be used until it holds 41°F or below and is reinspected. Two dead lights were replaced on site.

headline: Fryer and wall splatter need cleaning
summary: Interior bottom of a kitchen fryer must be cleaned, along with the area around woks. Walls around the three-compartment sink and floor behind the deep freezer have splatter, and floor under the fryers needs cleaning.

headline: Cold food too warm; no hair restraints
summary: Beef at 50.2°F and chicken at 49.8°F in the front display cooler; 20 lbs discarded. Food handlers prepping without hair restraints. Milk crates used as shelving; cutting boards damaged; outside dumpster missing lids. Citation issued.

headline: Missing thermometers; food stored on floors
summary: Thermometers missing at the deli meal and salad case and the hot holding cabinet. Boxed and plastic food containers stored on floors in bakery and walk-in areas must be raised. Worn cutting boards and crates used for storage.

headline: Glove misuse; grease under grill
summary: Food handlers did not use food-grade gloves when handling ready-to-eat foods; all handlers must be trained. Grease and food debris under the flattop grill. Previous raw-food consumer advisory violation not corrected. Result: Fail.

headline: Hand-washing signs missing
summary: Hand-washing signs were missing at hand sinks used by employees. Manager was instructed to post them at all employee sinks.

headline: Hair restraints missing; dirty coolers and drains
summary: Employees in the food prep area were not wearing hair restraints. Also noted dirty cooler interiors, a dirty cotton candy machine, dirty floor drains, a messy dumpster area and water-stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Cooler at 48°F; thermometers and cleaning needed
summary: A reach-in cooler in poor repair measured 48°F and held dirty pans. Manager must fix it before storing TCS foods (foods that must be kept cold). Other coolers lack thermometers; bulk containers and wiping cloths need correct handling.

headline: Restroom door not self-closing; no ventilation
summary: Toilet room door was not self-closing. Employee restroom in the rear has no mechanical ventilation. Person in charge must provide both.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training
summary: The food service sanitation manager had no food allergen training certificate. Staff were instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: Lobster too warm; discarded; no thermometers
summary: Roasted lobster in a prep-line cooler measured 46.8-48.4°F and about 4 lbs ($280) was discarded. Coolers lack thermometers. Cloth towels used to dry plates. Moldy caulking and a restroom with no covered waste bin.

headline: Food stored on floor; worn gaskets
summary: Baskets and boxes of food stored on the floor in the coffee prep area must be raised to prevent cross-contamination. Worn door gaskets on several prep coolers and a loose ice machine panel must be repaired.

headline: Missing sink stoppers; greasy cooler
summary: The three-compartment sink is missing stoppers. Excess food debris is on cooler gaskets and interior surfaces. Rust on shelving and food debris between grill and drawers must be cleaned.

headline: Missing signs, broken handles, items misplaced
summary: Hand-wash signs missing in restrooms and bar. Ambient thermometer missing in a display cooler. Wiping cloths and utensils stored improperly on prep surfaces. Plates not inverted. Broken door handles on holding units.

headline: About 50 flies found; failed inspection
summary: About 50 small live flies in dining area, dish area, prep walls and walk-in cooler door. Professional pest control must be consulted before reinspection. Also: greasy cooking equipment, a leaking drainpipe, and missing ceiling tiles. Citation issued.

headline: Milk crates used as shelves; grimy floors
summary: Thermometers needed inside two sushi prep coolers. Milk crates used as shelving in several areas must be replaced. Floor drains, mop area, grease walls and ceiling vents need detail cleaning to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Dirty storage, cutting boards and cooler interiors
summary: Linen and utensil storage needs detailed cleaning. Worn cutting boards must be replaced. Cooking equipment, reach-in cooler interiors, can opener and hood filters need cleaning. Floor drains and wall bases need cleaning.

headline: Shrimp thawed at room temperature
summary: Shrimp was thawing at room temperature in prep and must instead be thawed under cold running water or in refrigeration. Cold holds lack thermometers. Torn gaskets, rusty seafood shelving, a leaking faucet, and water-damaged ceiling tiles.

headline: No hot water at several hand sinks
summary: Employee and customer restroom hand sinks had water at 70-82°F; required minimum is 100°F. Dish machine lacks surface temperature test strips. Mold-like buildup in dairy cooler racks; dusty hood needs detailed cleaning. Citation issued.

headline: Cracked cooler and improperly repaired ceiling
summary: A small reach-in cooler had cracks and gaps in its interior panels. Ceiling panels near the exterior door were improperly repaired with large gaps. Both must be fixed.

headline: Standing water under self-serve pop machine
summary: Standing water found under the self-serve pop machine, a possible leak. Source must be found and repaired. Floors need cleaning around the pop machine and along the wall under the three-compartment sink.

headline: Clutter in storage; one worker lacks certificate
summary: Rear storage room needs organizing and removal of unnecessary items to prevent pest harborage; mops and brooms must be raised off the floor. One food handler lacked a food handler certificate.

headline: No hand-washing sign at sandwich prep sink
summary: No hand-washing sign was posted at the hand sink in the sandwich preparation area. A sign must be provided.

headline: Missing splash guards and signs; condenser leak
summary: Hand-wash signs missing in bar, prep and employee washroom. Several splash guards missing on hand sinks. Walk-in condenser leaking onto floor under shelving. Ice bins lack covers. Some sinks and two toilets lack water pressure or function.

headline: Peeling paint, scratched boards, restroom ceiling hole
summary: Peeling paint on cooler shelving. Deeply scratched and stained cutting boards in rear prep. Hole in women's restroom ceiling. Food debris on floor under all cooking equipment must be cleaned.

headline: Live cockroaches, cat, and missing soap
summary: About 100 live cockroaches found on prep tables, in electrical boxes, in a cooler and on basement floors; about 50 flying insects. A live cat was in the basement. No soap or paper towels at some sinks; hot water missing at sinks. Citation issued.

headline: Missing hot-water knob; fixed on site
summary: A hand sink was missing its hot-water knob on arrival. The manager replaced it on site and hot water now works. Torn door gaskets on two prep coolers must be replaced.

headline: Door gap, holes, mold and stained ceilings
summary: Front door gap must be made tight-fitting. A cooler has a worn gasket and moldy racks. Holes in storage doors, stained ceiling tiles, missing flooring and a non-working restroom vent must be repaired.

headline: Multiple TCS foods too warm; cooler at 49°F
summary: Turkey, chicken, corn salad, eggs and cheese in service coolers were above 41°F, and about 10 lbs ($200) was discarded. A prep-area display cooler at 49°F was cited and cannot be used until it holds 41°F. Torn gasket also noted.

headline: Dirty freezer base and floors; no allergen training
summary: Food debris on base of a reach-in freezer. Dirt and debris under shelving, around the three-compartment sink, and under the meat slicer. Greasy hood filters. An employee lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: No certified manager; no food handler certificates
summary: Person in charge had no City certified manager certificate, and none was on site while eggs, beef and other TCS foods were served. Previous violations remain: door gap, dirt, clutter and missing food handler certificates. Citation issued.

headline: Employee drinks stored with customer food
summary: Employee drinks stored in the same refrigerator as customer food; a separate area is required. Serving plates on shelves not inverted. Floors along walls and under equipment need cleaning, and heavy dust on kitchen vents.

headline: Mouse droppings; hand sink blocked by plates
summary: Front prep hand sink was filled with plates and inaccessible. About 15 mouse droppings found in prep, basement stairs and around the ice machine. More pest control needed. Grease and food debris under cooking equipment. Citation issued.

headline: Splash guard needed at front hand sink
summary: A splash guard is needed at the front service hand sink by the espresso machine, which holds small service dishes. Staff were instructed to provide one.

headline: Fly trap over prep table; garbage placement
summary: A fly trap was placed above a food prep table; inspector instructed staff to remove it. An open garbage receptacle was placed next to the clean utensil rack; staff must keep it away.

headline: Food on walk-in floor; leaking faucet
summary: Food stored on the walk-in cooler floor must be elevated 6 inches. Excess debris behind cooking equipment. Three-compartment sink faucet leaking. Restroom waste containers lack lids; doors and switch covers grimy.

headline: No dish machine sanitizer; machine tagged
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had no sanitizer and no chemical reading. It is tagged and cannot be used until the Chicago Department of Public Health reinspects. Also: heavy buildup inside the machine, a door gap, and soiled wiping cloths.

headline: Bussing tub blocking hand sink
summary: A bussing tub was placed in the front prep hand-wash sink, blocking access. Staff must keep all hand sinks free of obstructions. Priority foundation violation.

headline: Worn gasket and leaking pipe under sink
summary: Worn gasket on a prep cooler and a leaking pipe under the front hand sink, which was repaired on site. Stained floors and walls by the dish sink, food debris under racks, and poor lighting near the walk-in and rear door.

headline: Torn gaskets on coolers
summary: Torn gaskets on a two-door cooler in the rear prep area and on cold-hold units at soup prep. Staff must repair and maintain them. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Meat stored on walk-in floor; rusty shelving
summary: Container of meat was stored on the walk-in floor and must be properly stored. Foil lining on shelves; rusty shelving in basement storage. Leaking faucet at three-compartment sink. Basement restroom lacks hand-wash signs and lidded trash.

headline: Over 1,000 mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: No City-certified food manager on site. Over 1,000 mouse droppings found in prep, storage and basement areas; priority violation. Eggs at 53.6-62.4°F and a prep cooler at 56.4°F; about 30 lbs discarded. No pest logbook. Citation issued.

headline: One men's urinal not working
summary: One of two urinals in the men's restroom was not working. Instructed to repair or replace it and keep plumbing in good condition.

headline: No food handler training; debris around dumpsters
summary: No food handler training was available; all food handlers must provide it. Certified manager lacks allergen training. Three-compartment sink has a loose handle and leaking faucet. Debris around dumpsters and inside the furnace room.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged out
summary: Low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer and is tagged out until the health department reinspects. Also noted: ice machine residue, missing hand-washing signs and food spills in coolers.

headline: Basement door gap; missing ceiling tiles
summary: An open 1-inch gap under the basement doorway to the neighbor's basement must be sealed to prevent pests. Ceiling tiles above the walk-in are missing, and there is a hole in the basement ceiling. Staff belongings are on dry storage racks.

headline: No certified manager; no hot handwash water
summary: No certified food manager was on site while raw chicken and fish were handled. Handwashing sink had no hot water (72-76°F). Frozen beef was thawed improperly. No pest control logbook. No employee health policy or vomit/diarrhea cleanup plan.

headline: No pest logbook; missing handwash sinks
summary: No exposed handwashing sink in rear dishwashing or front service area; one must be installed under city water pressure (priority). The person in charge had no complete pest control logbook. Leaking faucets and no mop sink were found.

headline: Flies found in bar; sink not working
summary: About 10 small flies were in the bar area; the manager must service all pest-affected areas (citation). The main kitchen 3-compartment sink does not drain properly; one compartment fills when another drains.

headline: Loose freezer gasket and basement upkeep
summary: A freezer door gasket near the fryers was loose. Light dust was on walk-in cooler fan covers, a hole was in the basement wall, and the basement floor had debris. Inspector asked for repairs and cleaning. Result: Pass.

headline: Unlabeled containers; food stored under pipes
summary: Three unlabeled food containers were under the prep tables. Potatoes and onions were stored on the floor under handwash sink pipes. Plates were not inverted, and food debris and spilled liquid are on walk-in cooler floors. Result: Pass (re-inspection).

headline: Unsafe food temperatures; no soap at sink
summary: Two pounds of ground beef at 73.5°F were in the front prep area; the manager discarded 3 lbs. Prep handsink lacked soap until staff got some during inspection. Single-service items were stored on the floor.

headline: Plastic bags and duct tape used as repairs
summary: Plastic grocery bags and cardboard boxes are used as food containers in chest freezers. Use washable containers or food-grade bags. Duct tape repairs on a freezer door and under a handwash sink must be replaced with smooth, cleanable material.

headline: No hair restraint; manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: An employee prepared and served food without a hair restraint. Items inside the walk-in freezer were not elevated off the floor. Dust was on a restroom ceiling vent. The certified food manager has no allergen certificate.

headline: Basement clutter could attract rodents
summary: Inspector found clutter and unnecessary items in the basement that could give rodents places to hide. The clutter must be removed. Result: Pass.

headline: Meat thawed in sink; worn door stripping
summary: Frozen meat was thawing in a pot in the sink; it must thaw in the cooler or under cold running water. Worn front door stripping may let pests in. The 3-compartment faucet leaks, and walk-in floors are dirty.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; leaking faucet
summary: Milk crates are used as shelving in the walk-in cooler and must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. The 2-compartment kitchen sink faucet handles leak. Result: Pass.

headline: Plastic bowl used as scoop; basement clutter
summary: A plastic bowl was used as a scoop in a sauce container in the walk-in cooler; use a handled utensil instead. Utensils were stored in standing water at the hot holding area. Clutter is under the basement stairwell.

headline: Male handler lacks beard guard
summary: A male food handler with a beard was not wearing a beard guard. A beard guard must be provided. Result: Pass.

headline: Mouse droppings and cold food above 41°F
summary: About 100 mice droppings were found in the kitchen, along walls, and at the front serving area; clean and sanitize (citation). Shrimp at 60-80°F and rice at 45.6°F were discarded. Cutting boards are stained, and a faucet leaks.

headline: Over 40 mice droppings under front counter
summary: Over 40 mice droppings were scattered in a box of tiles under the front counter. Manager must call an exterminator and clean all areas. Food was stored on the floor, and a food handler lacked a hair restraint.

headline: Dirty floors throughout facility
summary: Floors throughout the facility are dirty and must be cleaned and maintained. Result: Pass (re-inspection).

headline: No splash guard; containers not inverted
summary: No splash guard was between the ice machine and mop sink. Food containers were not stored inverted. Result: Pass.

headline: Raw wood shelving; broken washbowl
summary: Raw wood shelving at the main bar 3-compartment sink must be replaced with non-absorbent material. A women's restroom washbowl is broken and leaking. Unnecessary items in far south basement storage must be removed to prevent pest harboring.

headline: Missing handwash signs; plates not inverted
summary: Handwashing signs are missing at all restrooms and prep handsinks. Bulk flour and sugar are not labeled. Plates were not inverted after sanitizing and air drying. Result: Pass.

headline: Dirty ice machine; burned-out lights
summary: The ice machine exterior and display cooler doors have food debris. Restroom fixtures need cleaning, and bulbs above the deli prep area are burned out. Food handler certificates and the person in charge's allergen certificate are needed.

headline: Raw chicken held at unsafe temperatures
summary: Prep counter held 40 lbs raw chicken wings at 52.9°F and 40 lbs raw chicken legs at 59.9°F. About 80 lbs (about $168) was discarded. Also: front door not sealed at bottom, and a cook lacked a hair restraint.

headline: No sanitation certificate posted; mold in ice machines
summary: No Chicago food sanitation certificate was posted (citation). Mold-like growth was inside both ice machines (citation). No sanitizer was detected at the dish machine final rinse. No pest control logbook was on premises (citation).

headline: Ready-to-eat food stored past 7-day limit
summary: Cooked pasta, soup, gravy and salad dressings were in prep coolers past the 7-day use-by date (citation). Cooler door gaskets are torn. A salad prep sink leaks, and the previous inspection summary was not posted (citation).

headline: Leaking handwash sink; no commercial dumpster
summary: The rear prep handwashing sink leaks during use and is not usable. The premises uses residential garbage cans instead of a commercial dumpster. Management was instructed to get a commercial dumpster.

headline: Worn handwash sign; unlabeled bulk food
summary: The handwashing sign is worn with half missing and must be replaced. Large bulk food items need commodity-name labels. The large can opener needs cleaning. Reach-in coolers, freezers, prep tables, shelves and floors need detail cleaning. Result: Pass.

headline: No food safety training proof; no vomit kit
summary: Person in charge lacked proof of food safety training. TCS food was prepared without a certified manager on site. No supplies for vomit or diarrhea cleanup. Menu lacked raw-food disclosure. Wiping cloths and utensils improperly stored.

headline: Dish machine final rinse too cool
summary: The high-temperature dish machine final rinse measured 172°F; it must be above 180°F (priority). One food handler lacked a valid food handler training certificate.

headline: Floors under stove need cleaning
summary: Floors under the cooking stove and the floor drain in the kitchen prep area must be cleaned and maintained. Result: Pass.

headline: Grime on grease trap
summary: Grime and debris built up on the outside of the grease trap under the 3-compartment sink. The person in charge was told to clean and maintain it. Result: Pass.

headline: Mice droppings on floor under cooking equipment
summary: Floors under and around cooking and freezing equipment had food, dirt and mice droppings. Walls and vents in prep areas were dirty. Fryer interior had thick grease. The 3-compartment faucet leaks, and ceiling tiles are water-stained.

headline: No certified food manager on premises
summary: No certified food service manager was on premises (priority citation). Disposable towels were missing at a prep handsink and were provided on site. Food handlers lacked training proof, and the 3-compartment drainpipe leaks.

headline: Food debris on shelves; dirty floor drains
summary: Food debris and spills were on walk-in cooler shelves. The wall caulking at the 3-compartment sink is blackened and moldy. Grease and debris are under cooking equipment, and floor drains in the rear washing area are dirty. Result: Pass.

headline: Sink water at 70°F; no vomit kit
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure was available. Handsink water is 70°F; the minimum is 100°F. High-temperature dish machine utensils reached 147°F; they must reach 160°F. No test indicators were provided.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; no trash lid
summary: Food handler certificates are expired. A male handler lacked a hair restraint, and wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer. The staff restroom trash has no lid. Floors and dish area vents need cleaning. Manager's allergen certificate expired.

headline: Food debris in handwash cabinet
summary: Food debris and spills were on shelves in the cabinet under the wait server handwash sink. Shelves must be cleaned and maintained. Result: Pass.

headline: No hand soap at sink; priority citation
summary: No hand soap was at the rear warewashing handwash sink. The person in charge brought soap from outside during inspection. The walk-in cooler light is too dim and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: No paper towels; wastewater drains between compartments
summary: No paper towels were at the handwash sinks; they were provided on site before inspection ended. The 3-compartment sink drains wastewater into other compartments (priority). Squeeze bottles lack labels, and cardboard lines the freezer shelves.

headline: Prep cooler at 50.5°F; food discarded
summary: Prep line cooler was at 50.5°F, and held chicken, cheese and other TCS food at 45-49°F. About 10 lbs ($300) of food was discarded. The cooler is tagged and must not be used until repaired. The ice machine has debris.

headline: Ice machine buildup; flies found
summary: Two ice machines had pinkish-black buildup inside (citation). About 10 small flies were in the bar and server station. An eye wash station was removed from a handwash sink on site. The menu lacked reminder symbols for raw food.

headline: Ice contaminated with black and pink slime
summary: Ice machine interior and ice bin had excessive black and pink slime dripping into ice used for drinks (priority citation). Menu lacked the cook-to-order notice and asterisk. Dry food was unlabeled, and the 3-compartment faucet runs continuously.

headline: Cold food above 41°F; no health policy
summary: Raw shrimp at 49°F in a cooler reading 39°F; cooked beef at 51°F and pork at 48°F on the prep table; all were to be discarded. No employee health policy on premises (priority). A cleaver was corrected on site.

headline: Unlabeled flour and sugar containers
summary: Bulk flour and sugar containers have no labels. The person in charge must label all bulk and working ingredient containers with the contents' name. Result: Pass.

headline: Clogged handsink repaired during inspection
summary: The prep handwash sink was not usable; its hot water was off and it was clogged. Management repaired it during inspection (citation). A cook lacked a hair restraint. Prep cooler gaskets are torn and taped, and a valid allergen certificate is missing.

headline: Over 70 mouse droppings found
summary: Over 70 mouse droppings were behind an ice cream freezer, in rear storage, dishwashing area, and on the chip and sugar shelves. Pest control service is required before reinspection (priority citation). The front door has a 1/4 inch gap.

headline: Ice machine residue; no raw food advisory
summary: Residue was found inside the ice machine. The menu had no consumer advisory for raw or undercooked food (priority). Food was stored on the walk-in freezer floor. The 3-compartment faucet leaks, and some walls and floor tiles are damaged.

headline: Excess black buildup at sink caulking
summary: Excessive black substance was found on the caulking at the base of the 3-compartment sink. Staff were told to remove it and keep the caulking clean. Result: Pass.

headline: No inspection summary posted
summary: Display cooler interiors need detail cleaning. No inspection summary was posted on premises; the manager was given a copy and told to post it (citation).

headline: No paper towels; food not date marked
summary: No paper towels were at the employee restroom handsink. Ready-to-eat TCS food in the fridge was not date marked. Food was stored on the prep floor, and equipment had grease. A minor leak was at the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Expired food handler training; boxed food on floor
summary: Food handler training is expired or missing for employees. Boxed food must be off the floor. Core violations from a prior report were not fixed, including unlabeled containers, worn gaskets, rust, debris, stained ceiling tiles and leaky faucets.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings found
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were on floors, between equipment, on washcloths, and in basement storage and utility areas. Manager must call an exterminator and clean and sanitize. Also: open drink cup near cilantro.

headline: Oyster bar dish machine too cool; tagged
summary: The oyster bar high-temperature dish machine's final rinse was only 150°F; it must reach 180°F. The machine is tagged by CDPH and cannot be used until repaired and reinspected. A light above it is burned out.

headline: Prep coolers not working; no sink water
summary: Prep coolers are not working; all cold holding units must maintain 41°F or below. There was no water for the handwash sink or 3-compartment sink. Running water must be provided.

headline: Dishes stored over utility sink; rusty shelves
summary: Clean pots and utensils were stored above the utility service sink and must be protected from contamination. Soiled wiping cloths must be in sanitizer. Shelving is rusty, milk crates are used, and cardboard is used as floor matting.

headline: Dirty ice machine; detached wall base
summary: The ice machine was a little dirty. Cooling units need thermometers, and rusted interior shelving is in units near the ice machine. Wall base is detached in prep areas and must be reattached to prevent pest harborage. Result: Pass.

headline: Unlabeled flour and rice; leaking sink
summary: Flour and rice containers in the rear were not labeled. Reach-in gaskets are damaged, and debris is under the coolers and freezers. The dishwashing handsink leaks, and the feminine hygiene waste container has no cover.

headline: 40-50 flying insects found; sinks obstructed
summary: About 40-50 small flying insects were found in bar, warewashing, stairwell and prep areas; pest control is required (priority). Sinks blocked by equipment were cleared on site, and missing soap was provided on site.

headline: Food debris and greasy hood need cleaning
summary: Food debris was found under the reach-in cooler, and the hood ventilation had dust and grease. Staff were instructed to clean and maintain both. Result: Pass.

headline: Ice machine calcium buildup; damaged tiles
