summary: Calcium-like buildup was inside the ice machine. A gasket on an upright cooler is loose, and food residue is on rear storage shelves. Ceiling tiles in the prep area are water-damaged, and filters have grease.

headline: Leaking drain pipes; mold-like ceiling tile
summary: Drain pipes leak under the front handwash sink and the rear 3-compartment sink. A ceiling tile in front of the utility closet has a mold-like buildup. Dirt and debris are on the rear office floor. No allergen certificate was on site.

headline: Debris and broken board behind hot water tank
summary: Debris and pieces of broken wall board were on the floor behind the hot water tank in the side storage area. The floor must be cleaned and kept free of buildup. Result: Pass (re-inspection).

headline: No employee health policy; no vomit cleanup plan
summary: No verification that food employees know to report illness (priority). No vomit and diarrhea procedure or cleanup kit. Coolers lack working thermometers. Basement door bottom needs rodent-proofing; a wall opening and missing baseboard need repair.

headline: Gap at front door; debris behind sink
summary: A 1/4 inch gap at the front entrance door sweep must be closed to keep out pests. Food debris was found on the wall behind the 3-compartment sink. One food manager's allergen certificate has expired. Result: Pass.

headline: Items on bar floor; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Items were stored on the floor in the dining room bar near the kitchen and must be raised six inches. A drain under a prep table has buildup. The enrolled manager on site has no allergen training. Result: Pass.

headline: Over 20 live flies found; pest control needed
summary: Over 20 small live flies were on the wall behind the front prep area, and 5 were in the rear dishwashing area. Staff must clean and sanitize; licensed pest control is recommended. No test strips for dish machine temperature.

headline: Splashguard needed; manager lacks allergen training
summary: A splashguard is needed between the exposed handwash sink and the 3-compartment sink. The certified food manager has no allergen training certificate. Result: Pass.

headline: Broken floor around kitchen drains
summary: The floor around the floor drains in the kitchen prep area is broken. It must be repaired so the surface is smooth and easy to clean. Result: Pass.

headline: Over 30 mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: Over 30 mice droppings were on the floor in the rear furnace room; an exterminator is required (citation). No valid food sanitation manager was on site when chicken was prepared and served (citation). Food was stored on the prep floor.

headline: Missing and damaged floor tiles
summary: Floor tiles are missing and damaged in the rear prep kitchen in front of the handsink. They must be repaired to create a smooth, cleanable surface. Result: Pass.

headline: Handwash sink water only 50-55°F
summary: Hot water at the front prep handsink reached only 50-55°F; the minimum is 100°F. Staff were told hair restraints are required. The ice machine cover is missing, the utility sink valve leaks, and floors and drains are dirty.

headline: No food handler certificate on site
summary: No food handler certificate was on site; all handlers must take the course and keep records. A fork and cooking utensil were not inverted on the drying rack. Microwave had crumbs, and rear storage floor had debris.

headline: About 8 dead roaches under sink
summary: About 8 or more dead roaches were on the floor under the two-compartment sink in the second-floor prep area. They must be removed and the area sanitized. Also: an opening at the rear exit door and food stored on the walk-in floor.

headline: Leaking faucet; opening at vent base
summary: The 3-compartment sink faucet leaks and is loose. The prep cooler interior must be cleaned. An opening in the dishwashing floor at a vent base must be sealed to block pests. The hood and filter are dirty.

headline: No sneeze guard for pastries; no hood
summary: Pastries were displayed at customer face level with no sneeze guard (priority citation). Scoops were stored inside dry containers, and milk crates are used as shelving. The facility is smoky with no ventilation hood.

headline: Food on walk-in floor; no handler certificates
summary: Food was stored on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised six inches. A cutting board is deeply grooved, and a drainpipe leaks under the rear prep handsink. No food handler certificates were on site. Result: Pass (re-inspection).

headline: Unlabeled flour and sugar containers
summary: Food containers with no labels, such as flour and sugar, were found. Containers must be labeled. Result: Pass.

headline: No food handler training certificate
summary: No food handler training certificate was found for food handlers. Certificates must be obtained. Result: Pass (re-inspection).

headline: Unlabeled spices; no food handler certificates
summary: Spices were in unlabeled containers. Food was in plastic grocery bags inside freezers. Grease and debris were on cooking equipment and coolers. No food handler certificates were on site; training must be completed.

headline: No hair restraints; floor drains dirty
summary: Male and female food handlers in prep areas had no hair restraints. An ice scoop was on the counter. The 3-compartment sink base leaks, and the front handsink by the mop sink does not work. Floor drains and corners are dirty.

headline: 15 fruit flies found near dish machine
summary: Fifteen fruit flies were on walls by the dish machine area (citation). The manager must notify the pest control operator and get rid of the fruit flies.

headline: Worn gaskets and dirty slicer and hood
summary: A gap under the center prep exit door must be sealed. Worn door gaskets are on the front prep cooler, rear freezer and a reach-in cooler. Debris is on the meat slicer, coolers and ice dispenser, and the hood and filters are dirty. Result: Pass (re-inspection).

headline: Small leak at 3-compartment sink faucet
summary: A small leak was found at the faucet head while water runs at the 3-compartment sink. The leak must be repaired. Result: Pass.

headline: Opening at base of dock door
summary: An opening was found at the base of the dock door in the dumpster area. All outer openings must be sealed to prevent pests. Result: Pass.

headline: Unlabeled food containers and debris found
summary: Food in unlabeled containers was found in coolers, the walk-in cooler and dry storage. A reach-in cooler had excess ice and debris, floors had spills, and missing ceiling tiles were covered with cardboard.

headline: No thermometer in cooler; items on floor
summary: No thermometer was found in the upright cooler holding fish, shrimp and sauces. Plates were stored upright on prep tables. Cooling unit interiors had spills and dried food. Storage room items on the floor must be raised 6 inches.

headline: No certified manager; food over time limit
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken was prepared and served (citation). Two handsinks lacked hand towels, corrected on site. The low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm and was tagged; 57 lbs ($260) of food was discarded.

headline: Condensation drain near handwash sink
summary: A condensation line drains into the handwash sink at the rear dish area. It must be moved away from the sink. Basement food storage needs smooth walls and ceiling. Result: Pass.

headline: Live flies, rat droppings, rotting cauliflower
summary: About 5 rat droppings were under the 3-compartment sink; 5 large and 10 small live flies were in prep. Pest control was recommended (citation). Moldy cauliflower was discarded. Windows are unscreened, and dumpsters overflow.

headline: No certified manager while beef and duck served
summary: No certified food manager was on site while beef and duck were prepared and served (citation). Plates and bowls were facing up in the prep area. The rear mop sink has no floor drain for disposing of mop water.

headline: Disposable containers used as scoops
summary: Handleless to-go containers were used to scoop food from a dry storage container; provide tongs, spoons or ladles. Serving plates on shelves were not inverted. The prep cooler lid has loose knots, and basement restroom trash has no lids.

headline: Missing handwash signs and worn labels
summary: No handwashing signs at restroom sinks. Fly strips hung from prep-area ceiling tiles. Rear door had a 1/4 to 1/2 inch gap. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer, and a bearded worker had no beard restraint.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: No person in charge held a valid certificate, and no certified manager was on duty while smoothies and chicken tacos were prepared (citation). A prep table blocked a handsink. Hair restraints were missing, and the manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Clean prep tables, shelves and walls
summary: Prep tables, wok station, stainless shelves and steam table need cleaning. Walls in the food prep and dishwashing areas also need cleaning. Result: Pass (re-inspection).

headline: Manager lacks allergen training; grime found
summary: The certified food manager has no food allergen training. The ice machine has calcium buildup, racks have dust and debris, and walls beside the fryers have grease. Manager was told to clean and comply. Result: Pass.

headline: No certified manager; raw wood shelving
summary: The person in charge lacks a certified food manager certificate, and none was on duty while smoothies and fruit drinks were prepared (citation). The front handwash sink lacks a sign and splashguard. Raw wood shelving and a faucet leak need repair.

headline: Cold food too warm; handwash sinks unusable
summary: Sausage at 46°F and meat sauce at 58°F were inside the walk-in cooler; cold food must stay at 41°F or below. Two exposed handwashing sinks were unusable or overflowing. Basement boxes were on the floor.

headline: Mop not stored to air-dry
summary: A mop was stored in a position that does not let it dry properly, which can create pest hiding spots. It must be stored mounted so it can air-dry. Result: Pass.

headline: Unlabeled bulk ingredients; stairway clutter
summary: Bulk dry ingredients are unlabeled in basement and kitchen. The handsink next to the dish rack lacks a splashguard. Cutting boards are deeply stained, and clutter is at the stairway and in the garage.

headline: No food thermometer; scoop left in water
summary: No food probe thermometer was available (citation). An ice cream scoop was kept in standing water at room temperature. Knives were wedged between prep coolers, and the 3-compartment sink drain leaks heavily; it has no sink stoppers.

headline: Over 50 rat droppings found in kitchen
summary: Over 50 rat droppings were on shelves, pallets, containers and floors in rear prep and storage areas. Manager must call an exterminator and clean and sanitize. Fly strips were above uncovered breading, and bulk containers were unlabeled.

headline: No handwashing sink in meat prep area
summary: No handwashing sink in the front meat prep area, a priority violation with citation. Packaged foods at the register lacked labels. A cutting board had dark stains and deep grooves.

headline: Mold on beer cooler shelves; clutter
summary: Mold was found on beer cooler storage shelves behind the northwest bar. Bottled beer must be removed, and the shelves deep cleaned and sanitized. Clutter is in an unused seating area, under rear storage racks, and under basement steps.

headline: Live flies, cold food too warm, hand-washing lapse
summary: About 50 or more live small flies were found in several areas. Cold food held at 49 to 58°F, above the 41°F limit; about 19 lbs discarded. A dishwasher handled clean dishes without washing hands. Hot water at two sinks was too cool.

headline: Door gaps; rust; grease and debris; missing backflow devices
summary: Gaps at the front, patio and bottom doors must be sealed. Walk-in shelving has rust, and fryers and stove have grease and debris. The coffee machine and ice machine lack backflow devices. Floor debris and mold were also noted.

headline: Rust, spills, missing backflow device, upkeep issues
summary: Display meat cooler had rust and food and blood spills. Mop sink has no backflow device. Toilet room door does not self-close. Rear door area is cluttered, floors are dirty, and a food handler lacks proof of training.

headline: Broken toilet handle; no covered trash or self-closing door
summary: The toilet handle is broken and must be repaired. The washroom has no covered waste receptacle and no self-closing door device. Management was instructed to provide each.

headline: Broken base coving; sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: Base coving is broken at the rear next to the walk-in cooler and must be repaired. The sanitation manager has no allergen training and must obtain it.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; hood needs cleaning
summary: Milk crates are used as shelving in prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor. The ventilation hood and filters need cleaning. A food service manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Handsink water too cool; corrected on site
summary: Hot water measured 74.7°F in the washroom and 75°F at the dishroom handsink, below the required 100°F. The person in charge adjusted it on site; it then measured 109 to 123°F. Citation issued. Unlabeled bulk seasonings also noted.

headline: Rear door gap; no hair restraints; expired allergen certificate
summary: The rear door has a 1/4-inch gap underneath and is not rodent or insect proof. Food handlers in the prep area were not wearing hair restraints. Floors under heavy equipment are dirty, and a manager's allergen certificate expired in 2024.

headline: Grease spills under main prep line
summary: Grease spills on the floors under cooking equipment at the main prep line must be cleaned and kept clean.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; leaking sink; greasy hood
summary: Some bulk containers are unlabeled. The 3-compartment sink leaks at the faucet base and must be repaired. Standing water is on the dining room floor around the handwash sink. Grease has built up on the hood and filters.

headline: Cold foods above 41°F; 40 lbs discarded
summary: TCS foods in the kitchen cold unit were too warm: hamburgers about 48°F, steak 47.8°F, cracked eggs 47.4°F, ham 53.1°F. The manager discarded 40 lbs, about $300; citation issued. A handsink pipe leaks and handwashing signage is missing.

headline: No backflow device on ice machine
summary: No backflow prevention device is on the ice machine water line in the rear area. One must be installed so it can be located, serviced and maintained.

headline: Hot handwash sink, undersized sink, heavy grease
summary: Handwash sink water reached 126°F, above the 100 to 120°F range. The 3-compartment sink is too small for onion containers. Earlier priority violations were not corrected, and a citation was issued. Floors have heavy grease and debris.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food handling
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while chicken and beef were handled and served. This is a priority foundation violation. Disposable bowls were used to scoop bulk food and must be replaced with proper scoops.

headline: Gaps at front entrance doors
summary: Openings at the base and middle of the front entrance double doors could allow pests to enter. The inspector instructed the business to seal all outer openings to prevent pest entry.

headline: No dump sink; leaking pipes; wall tarp
summary: The bar area lacks a dump sink, so the handsink is used for liquid waste. Pipes leak at the 3-compartment sink and warewashing unit. A plastic tarp on a basement wall leaves gaps that could harbor rodents and must be removed.

headline: Cold foods too warm; 26 lbs discarded
summary: TCS foods in the prep cold unit were too warm: pork 72.2°F, beans with cheese 72.8°F, and cheese 55.4°F. The manager discarded 26 lbs, about $150; citation issued. Also missing handwashing signs and unlabeled bulk containers.

headline: No sanitation certificate; no health policy or vomit kit
summary: No City of Chicago food sanitation certificate was presented; only a 2025 ServSafe certificate was shown. No employee health policy and no vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit were on site. Washroom doors lack self-closing devices.

headline: No health policy; no utility sink; no training
summary: No employee health policy was available. A food handler lacked a hair restraint, and equipment was stored on the floor. There is no utility sink, grease interceptor, or covered trash can. Previous handwashing sink violation not corrected.

headline: Damaged freezer lids; dirty hood
summary: Several deep freezer lids are in poor repair. The top of the prep service cooler needs detail cleaning, and the deep freezer needs defrosting. The hood above the cooking equipment is dirty and must be detail cleaned.

headline: Leaky drain under 3-compartment sink
summary: A leaky drain pipe under the 3-compartment sink must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Hood light needs shield
summary: A light bulb at the ventilation hood has no protective shield. A light shield cover must be provided.

headline: Two coolers too warm; manager allergen training expired
summary: Two coolers measured 44°F and 50°F ambient air. No food was in them, and they were tagged. Dish machines lack an irreversible temperature indicator. A certified manager's food allergen training has expired.

headline: No certified manager; no health policy; no pest log
summary: No person in charge with a valid sanitation certificate, and no certificate on site. No employee health policy, no vomit cleanup policy or supplies, no hand sink at the serving line, no raw-food consumer advisory, and no pest control log.

headline: Missing handwash signs, hair restraints, leaking pipe
summary: Two male managers handled food without hair restraints. Handwashing signs were missing at two prep-area sinks. A pipe leaks under a handwash sink in the B-DAP prep area. Trash receptacles are missing at handwash sinks.

headline: No certified manager while pizza and cheese prepared
summary: No certified food manager was on site while pizzas and nacho cheese were prepared and served, a priority violation with citation. A rear prep sink had no paper towels, and food debris was on cooler interiors. Training proof was missing.

headline: No grease container; holes in basement wall
summary: There is no outside receptacle for used grease. Holes in the basement wall behind shelving must be repaired and made smooth and easy to clean. This complaint re-inspection passed.

headline: Food on floor; no training; overdue violations
summary: Food was on the floor in the walk-in cooler and rear storage. The ice machine has residue, and some equipment is too large for the 3-compartment sink. Food handlers lack training. Earlier violations, including overflowing dumpster and torn gasket, were not corrected.

headline: No metal thermometer, pest log, or sanitizer test kit
summary: No metal-stem thermometer for food temperatures; no pest control logbook with valid license and reports; no chemical kit to test sanitizer; no service sink in the rear prep area. Walls near the sink and restroom are damaged. No manager allergen training.

headline: Many cold foods too warm; 18 lbs discarded
summary: Eggs, cooked meats, rice, cheese and other TCS foods measured 47 to 55°F, above 41°F. Three coolers ran at 47 to 60°F and were tagged. Staff discarded 18 lbs valued at $316; citation issued. Some food handler certificates are expired.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; cold pasta too warm; corrected on site
summary: The cafeteria low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm; it was repaired on site and then sanitized at 100 ppm. Cold pasta at 48.4°F was discarded (4 lbs, $6); citation issued. Dumpster area has liquid waste, and drink machines lack backflow devices.

headline: Mobile unit lacks health policy, sanitizer, thermometer
summary: The food truck had no employee health policy, no written vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies, no chemical sanitizer for the food-contact surfaces, no metal-stem thermometer, and no test strips for the sanitizing sink.

headline: Dead rodents and droppings; no manager certificate
summary: Three dead rodents were found in utility, boiler and cleaning areas, and about 15 rodent droppings in the rear utility closet. Citation issued. A certified manager was not on site during TCS food preparation until after 1 PM.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; torn cooler gaskets
summary: The dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine. Staff must wash, rinse and sanitize in the 3-compartment sink until it is fixed. Prep cooler gaskets under the grill are torn. Dust is on walls and ceiling tiles, and one ceiling light is burned out.

headline: Cutting boards damaged; charcoal and clutter outside
summary: Cutting boards had deep cuts and stains. About 10 crates of used charcoal were on the ground near the dumpster. The enclosed rear area had clutter, and two unused large units in the prep area must be repaired, replaced, or removed.

headline: Unfinished shelving; grease trap not located
summary: Unfinished wood shelving in the front prep area must be finished so it is smooth and easy to clean. The grease trap could not be located and must be made accessible for cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; sink blocked; sanitizer at 0 ppm
summary: No certified manager was on duty while TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. A handsink was blocked and lacked soap. Multi-use utensils were sanitized at 0 ppm; citation issued. No pest log, gaps under doors, and food on the walk-in freezer floor.

headline: Food on floors; debris; no food handler training
summary: Food was stored on the floor in prep and storage areas. Food debris was on cooking equipment, coolers, and mixers. Single-service utensils were not inverted, and employees have no food handler training. Baseboards are loose and items are stored in a utility sink.

headline: Prep line cooler missing thermometer
summary: The 4-door prep line cooler in the kitchen had no thermometer inside. The inspector instructed the business to provide and maintain a visible, accurate, working thermometer inside the cooler.

headline: Raw-food advisory given after meal; ceiling damage
summary: The consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods is shown only after the meal, not before. The business must provide it before serving. The ice machine needs cleaning, and missing ceiling tiles and basement ceiling holes need repair.

headline: Onions in cardboard box; dirty cabinets and restrooms
summary: Onions were stored in a large cardboard box. Storage cabinets had food debris, and the front prep handsink drains very slowly. The restrooms need a covered waste can and detail cleaning, and rear floors need cleaning.

headline: Slime in ice machine; no dishroom handsink
summary: Black and brown slime was found on ice-contact surfaces inside the ice machine and must be removed and sanitized. The dishroom has no handsink with hot and cold water. No vomit cleanup policy. Outdoor stored items must be removed.

headline: Live roaches above prep handsink; ice machine buildup
summary: Two live roaches were on the wall above the prep area handsink. Roach activity must be removed by reinspection, and a pest operator was advised. Pink buildup is in the ice machine and chute, and grease is on the hood.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: No certified food manager was present while yogurt and coffee with milk were prepared and served, a priority violation with citation. Also missing vomit cleanup supplies, a probe thermometer, and food handler certificates for several employees.

headline: No valid manager certificate on site
summary: Food handlers prepared TCS foods without a valid original City manager certificate on site; a receipt for reciprocity was shown. Citation issued. Clutter throughout the facility and no allergen training proof for certified managers.

headline: Cold chicken and pork too warm; no health policy
summary: No written employee health policy was on the truck. Chicken at 57°F and pork at 47°F were in the 2-door prep cooler. Cold TCS foods, which must be kept hot or cold for safety, must stay at 41°F or below. Priority violations.

headline: Black buildup in ice machine; ice discarded
summary: Black mold-like buildup inside the ice machine was dripping onto ice used for consumption. The person in charge discarded the ice and cleaned the machine during inspection; citation issued. Walk-in shelving also had rust and food residue.

headline: Handsink blocked; corrected on site
summary: A handwash sink was blocked by disposable coffee cups. The manager removed the cups on site. Citation issued. Also needed: ice machine interior cleaning, thermometers in prep and reach-in coolers, and floor cleaning in the front prep area.

headline: Scratched cutting boards; allergen training missing
summary: Multiple cutting boards with deep scratches and stains in the rear prep area must be resurfaced or replaced. One certified food service manager lacks an allergen awareness training certificate.

headline: Health policies lack employee signatures; grease buildup
summary: Employee health policies on site had no signatures; citation issued. The rear exit door is rusted and not tight-fitting. The mop sink lacks a backflow device. Vents are dusty, the exhaust hood has heavy grease, and walk-in cooler lighting is dim.

headline: Cracked floor tile in front of dish machine
summary: A cracked floor tile in front of the dish machine must be repaired.

headline: Wet mops and cleaning supplies near food
summary: Wet mops in the utility sink should be hung to dry to deter insect breeding. Cleaning supplies, mop buckets and rug racks should be stored in the service area away from food items.

headline: Unlabeled self-serve foods; no food handler certificates
summary: Self-serve potato salad, pasta salad, coleslaw and peppers in a dining area cooler were unlabeled. No food handler certificates were provided. The dining-area cooler had no visible thermometer. Entry and rear door openings must be sealed.

headline: Floor debris; overdue ventilation and allergen training
summary: Debris on floors along walls and corners in prep and storage areas. Earlier violations were not corrected: no mechanical ventilation in the toilet room, and the food manager lacks allergen training. Citation issued.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup policy
summary: No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea cleanup policy was on the premises. The mop sink has no visible backflow device, the restroom has no covered trash can, and the storage room floor is cluttered. Priority violations.

headline: Foil liner; unsecured sink; missing backflow devices
summary: Foil lines the table under basement coolers and must be removed. The men's washroom handsink is not secured, and the ice machine and basement utility sink lack backflow devices. Ceiling openings, peeling paint and mop heads on the floor were also noted.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure
summary: There is no written cleaning procedure or required equipment for vomit or diarrhea events. The business must provide them. This is a priority foundation violation.

headline: Unlabeled bulk foods, dirty facility, missing training proof
summary: Bulk flour, sugar and other containers lacked labels. Knives and scoops were stored improperly. Food debris and spills were found throughout. Food handlers had no training proof, and the manager had no allergen training proof.

headline: No prep cooler thermometers; door gaps; cleaning needs
summary: Main prep line coolers have no thermometers. A front door gap could let insects in. Cutting boards are grooved, cooler gaskets are loose, and the ice machine has rusty screws. Grease, ice and debris build-up need cleaning.

headline: Stained cutting boards and ceiling tiles
summary: Cutting boards have deep scratches and stains and must be resurfaced or replaced. Ceiling tiles with stains must be replaced.

headline: Missing thermometers; freezer ice; dusty vents
summary: Several coolers lack thermometers. The rear reach-in freezer has ice buildup and must be defrosted. A washroom garbage can lid is missing. Air vent covers and ceiling tiles in the prep area need dust removal.

headline: No certified manager; no health policy; sinks lack supplies
summary: No certified manager was on site while tomato sauce and other TCS items were prepared; citation issued. No verifiable employee health policy. Several handsinks lacked soap, paper towels, or signage. Bulk flour was unlabeled and cooler gaskets are torn.

headline: Over 40 mouse droppings under display shelves
summary: Over 40 mouse droppings were under aisle display shelves, and over 20 each behind and under cereal, bread, nut and candy shelves; citation issued. Weekly licensed pest control is recommended. Milk crates were used for elevation and wall holes need sealing.

headline: Leaking grease trap; slow drain; no food handler certificates
summary: The basement three-compartment sink drains slowly and backs up between compartments. A leaking grease trap sends wastewater onto the prep floor. No food handler certificates were on site. No citations were issued for drain and trap issues.

headline: No food thermometer; food stored on floor
summary: No food temperature probe thermometer was on site, a priority violation with citation. Bulk dry food containers were stored on the floor, milk crates were used to elevate equipment, and the ice machine's outer surfaces were dusty.

headline: Grime on surfaces; low dipper well flow
summary: Tables, cooler interiors, hot holding equipment and freezers have built-up grime and food debris. Dipper well water flow is low. Basement floor tile near a drain is damaged, cardboard is on a restroom wall, and a front prep light is out.

headline: Dust above ice machine ceiling
summary: Dust has built up on the ceiling above the ice machine and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: No manager certificate posted; no soap at sink
summary: No City-certified food manager certificate was posted; citation issued. The prep line handsink had no soap while food was prepared. Staff placed new soap at the sink during inspection, and a handwashing citation was issued.

headline: Improper fish thawing; restroom door and training gaps
summary: Frozen fish was thawed improperly in a 2-compartment sink, and management was instructed on approved thawing methods. The washroom door must self-close. Food handlers lack training proof, and no allergen training certificate was found.

headline: Damaged floors; food debris; mop heads not hung
summary: Food debris and grease are on prep, cooking and storage equipment. Floor tiles are missing or damaged, baseboards have gaps, and grout is missing. Single-service articles are on the floor, and mop heads are improperly stored.

headline: Ice scoop left on ice; floor debris under prep
summary: An ice scoop was lying on top of the ice; the manager must store it handle-up. Significant flour and food debris is on the floor under and around the chicken prep area and must be cleaned. Re-inspection passed.

headline: No barrier at espresso machines; rear door not rodent-proof
summary: No protective barrier separates espresso machines from customers at the front counter, a priority violation. The rear exit door is not rodent-proof, and an opening along the wall by the rear door must be sealed.

headline: Food on floor in walk-in cooler
summary: Food items were stored on the floor in the rear walk-in cooler. The inspector instructed the person in charge to keep all food elevated at least six inches from the floor.

headline: About 20 mouse droppings; additional pest service needed
summary: About 20 mouse droppings were found on the rear storage and office floors. Additional pest control service is needed; citation issued. Also found cutting boards with deep cuts, greasy stove and fryers, outdoor trash, clutter, and an office wall hole.

headline: Broken restroom door knob; training certificates
summary: The women's washroom door knob is broken and must be repaired. Floor and sink drains must be detail cleaned to prevent pest breeding. Food handlers must keep training certificates on site, or citations will follow.

headline: Broken gaskets; dusty and missing vent covers
summary: Two small tabletop coolers in the front prep area have broken gaskets that must be replaced. A vent cover is missing in the dining room, and the vent above the entry door is covered in dust and grime.

headline: Menu lacks raw-food advisory; missing labels, backflow devices
summary: Asterisked animal-origin menu items did not disclose they are served cooked to order or contain raw ingredients. Flour in basement storage is unlabeled. The ice and coffee machines lack backflow prevention devices. No citation was issued.

headline: Hair restraints, broken freezer doors, storage clutter
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. All chest freezer doors are broken. The 3-compartment sink lacks a drainboard and stoppers. Rear storage has clutter, including old paper and unrelated food material.

headline: No soap; blocked handsink; food held over 24 hours
summary: Front prep handsink had no hand soap. Dishwashing handsink was blocked by a basket and utensils; citation issued. Cooked pork, chicken, ham and soup were held over 24 hours without discard dates; citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled salt; employee food stored with customer food
summary: A bulk salt container was not labeled. Employees' personal food was stored with customers' food. The inspector instructed the business to label the container and separate the food.

headline: Ice buildup in freezers; no covered waste cans
summary: No handwashing signs in the rear unisex washroom. Rear chest freezers have excessive ice buildup. Both unisex washrooms lack covered waste receptacles. An unused deep fryer in rear storage must be removed.

headline: No manager; missing soap and towels; no date marks
summary: No certified manager during TCS food handling. Main prep sink lacked soap and paper towels. Dishes were washed without sanitizing. Cooked food held over 24 hours had no discard date. A cooler is missing interior covers, and kitchen staff lack food handler certificates.

headline: Flies, sanitizer failure, spoiled corned beef, hand-washing lapses
summary: A dishwasher repeatedly handled clean dishes without washing hands or changing gloves. A dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm; it was corrected on site to 100 ppm. About 15 lbs of cooked corned beef at 52°F was discarded. About 30 or more live flies were found.

headline: Rear doors not fully sealed; certificate violation
summary: Rear doors were open and the interior screen door is not sealed on the sides and top. Repair or keep doors closed to prevent pests. A previous violation was not corrected: certificate holders lack allergen certificates; more citations will follow.

headline: Two urinals not working
summary: Two urinals in the washroom are not operational and must be repaired.

headline: Unlabeled granola; sewage pipes above food
summary: Packaged granola had no label; the manager was instructed to provide one. Exposed sewage pipes above basement food storage must be encased or the food moved. Food was stored in grocery bags and light fixtures lack shields.

headline: Wet wiping cloths; torn cooler gasket
summary: Wet wiping cloths were left on several prep surfaces and must be stored in sanitizing solution between uses. A torn door gasket inside the two-door prep cooler must be replaced.

headline: Over 50 mouse droppings; several violations
summary: Over 50 mouse droppings were found along prep area walls and corners, 20 in rear storage, and 15 in a washroom. Priority citation issued, and licensed pest control is recommended. Also missing thermometers and unlabeled containers.

headline: Missing thermometers; food on freezer floor
summary: Small coolers and cooler drawers lack thermometers. Ice cream containers on the walk-in freezer floor must be raised 6 inches. The dumpster is missing lids and exposing refuse; citation issued.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; rusty tables; broken tile
summary: No handwashing signs or posters near sinks in the washrooms. Prep tables have rust on their bottoms. A broken floor tile in front of cooking equipment on the second floor must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Mouse droppings; no soap; expired allergen certificates
summary: About 30 mouse droppings were under storage shelves in the rear dry storage area; citation issued. Rear handsinks lacked soap and were restocked on site. Food was on the walk-in cooler floor, and managers' allergen certificates had expired.

headline: No hot water at bar sinks; food on floor
summary: Handwash sinks at the East Beach Bar had no hot water (75.3°F); citation issued. Food and single-service articles are stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and storage areas. Peeling paint and damaged light shields were also noted.

headline: Foil liners; dirty cooler; missing backflow device
summary: Foil lines the cooking units in the rear food area and must be removed to prevent insect harboring. Two-door reach-in cooler has dirt and food debris. The staff toilet room utility sink lacks a backflow device. Hood has dust and grease.

headline: Sewage backup in restroom and leaking pipes
summary: Waste water and sewage backed up from a men's restroom urinal into an adjacent mop sink. This is a priority violation, and the supervisor was notified. Mop sink and bar handwash sink pipes are leaking, and dishmachine and cooler surfaces had food debris.

headline: Food truck lacks enough refrigeration
summary: The food truck has only one small refrigerator, which cannot maintain service needs. Travel Cambros are used instead of an electric hot-holding unit. Adequate cold storage and hot holding must be provided. Priority violation.

headline: Handsinks lack supplies; dish machine off
summary: Prep and restroom handsinks lacked paper towels, soap, and signage. The end-of-line prep sink needs hot water at 100 to 120°F. The high-temp dish machine was off, and a handsink leaks. No pest logbook was on site.

headline: Leaking drain; no sanitary napkin receptacles
summary: A minor leak at the three-compartment drain pipe near rear storage must be repaired. There is no covered receptacle for sanitary napkins in the all-gender washroom on the first floor or the women's employee restroom on the second floor.

headline: Cool handwash water; food on floor
summary: Deli prep handsink water measured 63°F and was restored to 110°F during inspection; citation issued. Food containers are on the floor in the walk-in cooler and prep areas. A leaking overhead refrigeration unit and burnt-out bulbs also need repair.

headline: No certified manager; 60-80 mouse droppings found
summary: No certified food manager was on site while open. About 60-80 mouse droppings were found throughout the facility, and pest control was recommended. Also noted: a dish machine not sanitizing (repaired on site), no hot water at a hand sink, and unsafe hot and cold holding temperatures.

headline: Ice buildup, torn gasket, dusty vents, drains dirty
summary: A torn gasket was found on a three-door prep cooler and rusty basement shelving needs repainting. Excessive ice was found in basement chest freezers. The unisex washroom has no covered waste receptacle. Floor drains are dirty and dust covers vents and light shields.

headline: No illness procedures or supplies; sink too small
summary: No employee health policy, no vomit and diarrhea procedures or supplies, and no handwashing signs were found. The three-compartment sink is too small for the largest pan; a citation was issued. No test kit for sanitizer was available.

headline: No backflow device at mop sink faucet
summary: No backflow prevention device was found at the mop sink faucet; one must be installed where it can be serviced. Basement food storage walls and ceiling were not smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Uncertified person in charge; slimy ice machine
summary: The person in charge had no city sanitation certificate, and no valid certificate was posted. Ice machine interior had black and white slime dripping into ice; a citation was issued. Also noted: no pest control log, food stored in unenclosed outdoor units, and missing training records.

headline: Wall cleaning needed in prep and dish areas
summary: Walls in the prep and dish washing areas must be cleaned to remove food splatters.

headline: Suspension sign removed; earlier access denied
summary: The license suspension sign posted on 04/08/2024 was found moved by 04/10/2024; a citation was issued. The earlier complaint inspection was denied, and the license was suspended under city code.

headline: Washroom fan broken; microwave needs cleaning
summary: The washroom ventilation fan is not working and must be repaired or replaced. The microwave in the front food prep area also needs cleaning.

headline: Dust and cracks noted; no food-safety issues
summary: Inspector found dust and debris on cooler and freezer bases and storage shelves, plus cracks in walls and ceilings in the storage and washroom areas. Manager was told to clean and repair.

headline: Greasy fryer interior and dirty floors
summary: The inside of the fryer had grease, food, and dirt. Also noted: a leak at the three-compartment sink faucet, a restroom door that is not self-closing, and dirt and debris on floors under and around heavy equipment.

headline: About 20 ants found; pest control needed
summary: About 20 ants were found on the dining room floor; pest control service is needed and a citation was issued. Also noted: food containers stored on freezer floors, interior of walk-in coolers needing cleaning, a leaking hand sink, and no backflow device at the utility sink.

headline: No valid manager certificate; photocopy not accepted
summary: No original, valid city food sanitation manager certificate was posted while cooked rice and beef were prepared and served. The manager showed a photocopy, which is not allowed; a citation was issued. Also noted: oversized pots and grease on vents.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No certified food manager was present while yogurt, cut melon, and corn were being prepared and served; a citation was issued. Also noted: an overflowing dumpster with the lid open, a leaking sink faucet, stained cutting boards, and unlabeled bulk containers.

headline: Personal items on food shelf; poor cooler lighting
summary: Walk-in cooler lighting was inadequate. Employee personal items were stored on a food container shelf and must be moved. The food service manager had no allergen training certificate.

headline: Insect trap above clean dishes; uncovered trash
summary: An insect control device was installed above clean dishes and utensils at the three-compartment sink and must be relocated. Restroom waste receptacles were uncovered. Dusty floor beneath the ice cream freezer and cracked floor tiles need repair.

headline: No certified manager on site; food handler proof missing
summary: No city-certified manager was on site while pizza and chicken were prepared and served; a citation was issued. Proof of food handler training was still not provided for all food handlers, a repeat core violation.

headline: No certified manager; milk stored too warm
summary: No certified food manager was present while empanadas were prepared and served; a citation was issued. Milk and alternative milks in the prep cooler measured 44-47F, and the cooler air measured 50F. Both hand sinks were blocked by pans and no vomit cleanup supplies were available.

headline: Soup cooled improperly; scoops in stagnant water
summary: Soup was cooling covered in the walk-in cooler; the manager removed the lids during inspection. Scoops were stored in stagnant water next to the rice cooker. Also noted: ice buildup on boxes under freezer vents, foil and plastic liners, heavy debris, and missing food handler training proof for one employee.

headline: Handwashing signs and sanitizer buckets needed
summary: Handwashing signs were needed at prep area hand sinks. Wiping cloths must be stored in clean sanitizer when not in use. Cutting boards with deep cuts must be replaced, and the trash can in the unisex washroom needs a lid.

headline: Stocks and sauce too warm; discarded
summary: Lobster stock at 51.8F, vegetable stock at 55.2F, and sauce at 55.8F were held in the walk-in cooler; all were discarded, about 20 pounds, and a citation was issued. Also noted: deep-grooved cutting boards, rust on a ceiling vent, and a cracked light shield.

headline: No handwashing sign at front prep sink
summary: No handwashing sign was posted at the hand sink in the front prep area. Manager must provide signs at all handwashing sinks used by employees.

headline: Dirty walls and floor drains in kitchen
summary: Food debris and dirt covered walls in the dish and prep areas, and food and dirt built up inside prep area floor drains. These must be cleaned.

headline: No raw-food consumer advisory; no test strips
summary: Menu had no consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods such as eggs; the operator was instructed to add asterisk notes and a warning statement. No chemical test strips for sanitizer were on site at the three-compartment sink.

headline: Soiled cloths and heavy grease buildup
summary: Soiled wiping cloths were stored on prep tables instead of sanitizer. Milk crates are used as shelves and must be replaced. Heavy grease, dirt, and food splatter covered walls, floors, and equipment, and a light in the hot-holding area is burnt out.

headline: Dish machine had no sanitizer; corrected on site
summary: The dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer because its sanitizer bottle was empty; the manager hooked up adequate sanitizer on site. Cold foods at 44-50F were discarded, about $70 worth. Two coolers at 50F and 45F were serviced by a technician.

headline: Splashguard needed; several leaks to repair
summary: A splashguard must be installed between the exposed handwashing sink and the prep sink in the pizza area. Drain leaks, a missing self-closing washroom door, gaps around the washroom door frame, and missing baseboards also need repair. Walls and grease trap exterior need cleaning.

headline: Missing health policy and vomit cleanup kit
summary: No employee health policy and no vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit were on site. Also noted: a 1/4-inch gap at a side door, missing backflow devices at the utility sink and ice machine, and food handler and allergen training required.

headline: Missing sink stoppers; leaks, holes, and broken tiles
summary: Three-compartment sink stoppers were missing in all three compartments. Also noted: a hole in the wall and broken floor tiles in the pot-and-pan room, leaking hand sinks, peeling caulk, and a dirty deep freezer in the employee cafeteria.

headline: Clean ice machines; kitchen floors and walls need work
summary: Both ice machine interiors must be cleaned and sanitized. Kitchen floors, floor drains, walls, and piping need cleaning to remove dust and debris. The city-certified manager has no allergen training.

headline: Crates used as shelves; mop sink needed
summary: Crates were being used for elevation; proper cleanable shelving 6 inches off the floor is required. A mop sink with backflow device, hot and cold water, and waste disposal must be provided. A small lidded trash can is needed in the washroom.

headline: Foil lining on grill must be removed
summary: Aluminum foil lined the grill. Inspector instructed the operator to remove the foil so the surface is smooth and easy to clean.

headline: About 30 mouse droppings found in prep area
summary: About 30 mouse droppings were found in the rear prep area and dry food storage room along the wall base. Pest control service is recommended and a priority violation was issued. Also noted: restroom push faucets that do not stay on, utensils not air-dried, and no sink stoppers.

headline: Live small flies found on walls
summary: About 20 live small flies were found on walls at the bakery prep area and 10 at the kitchen dishwashing area; all must be removed by reinspection, and pest control was advised. Some hand sinks lacked soap but were stocked on request. Floor drains at dishwash areas also need cleaning.

headline: Fryer greasy; food handler lacks certificate
summary: The fryer interior had accumulated grease and must be cleaned. The front counter hand sink's cold handle was not working and must be repaired. One food handler had no food handler certificate on site.

headline: No hair restraints; wiping cloths improperly stored
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints in the prep area. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer when not in use, and a smaller ice scoop was not stored properly. Floors under equipment and walls behind cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Splash guard needed; training certificates missing
summary: A splash guard is needed between the handwashing sink and the clean utensil shelf. An additional food handler training certificate must be on site, and no allergen training certificates were provided for certified managers.

headline: Three-compartment sink leaks; grease and debris buildup
summary: The three-compartment sink leaked waste water when drained; a priority citation was issued. Grease and food debris covered cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, and shelves. Also noted: dirt under the sink, cardboard on the prep line floor, and a burnt-out bulb.

headline: Over 30 mouse droppings; no certified manager present
summary: Over 30 mouse droppings were scattered under the dishwashing area hand sink. No person in charge or valid food sanitation certificate was present; a citation was issued. Also noted: hot water at only 74.6F, food stored on the floor, and a 1/2-inch door gap.

headline: Timed faucets and missing sinks signs; pest entry gap
summary: Timed washroom faucets were not working properly; water must run at least 15 seconds. Also noted: missing handwashing signs, a 1/4-inch door gap, milk crates used as shelves, missing sink stoppers, and spills and grease on cooking equipment and floors.

headline: Produce cooler and oven floor need cleaning
summary: The bottom shelf inside the produce cooler must be cleaned to remove debris. Floors underneath the confection oven need cleaning to remove spills.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: Food handlers prepared time-and-temperature control foods without a certified manager or original certificate on site; a citation was issued. The person in charge had no proof of food safety management training. The walk-in cooler has low lighting.

headline: No certified person in charge present
summary: No person in charge with a valid city sanitation certificate was present during operating hours; a citation was issued. A damaged walk-in freezer door gasket must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Beer cooler spills; debris under shelving
summary: Spilled liquid on the beer cooler floor near the kegs must be cleaned. The seal along the three-compartment sink wall is missing. Dirt and debris under rear shelving near a nonworking pizza oven must be cleaned to prevent insect harborage.

headline: Cheese, sausage, bacon too warm; discarded
summary: Cheese, sausage, and bacon held between 44.0F and 44.8F were discarded, about 5 pounds worth $100; a citation was issued. Also noted: ice buildup inside the walk-in freezer and dirt in the floor drain by the walk-in freezer.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: The food service manager had no allergen training certificate. The inspector instructed the manager to obtain one.

headline: Menu warning added on site; handwashing and door issues
summary: Menu lacked a raw or undercooked food warning; corrected on site before inspection ended. Also noted: no handwashing signs, an unsealed door gap that could let pests in, a loose washroom door, and dusty fan covers.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; unit held
summary: The low-temperature dish machine measured 0 ppm sanitizer during inspection; it was tagged and held, and a citation was issued. Also noted: a food employee without a hair restraint, uncovered restroom receptacles, trash and unused equipment outside the rear door, and dirty floors and cabinets.

headline: Cold-held foods too warm; about 25 lb discarded
summary: Chicken, beef, ham, eggs, and vegetables in a front prep cold holding unit measured 47-61F; about 25 pounds were discarded. The refrigerator at 50F was tagged and held. Also noted: stained ceiling tiles, damaged floor tiles, and unlabeled chili containers.

headline: Rusty cooler racks; calcium in ice machine
summary: Interior racks in a large cooler near the kitchen entrance had rust buildup and must be repainted or replaced. The ice machine had calcium buildup inside and must be cleaned.

headline: Bare-hand food contact; unsafe food temperatures
summary: A food handler touched ready-to-eat food with bare hands and used the one-compartment prep sink for handwashing; citations issued. Several cold foods measured 46-62F and about 40 pounds were discarded. Hot water measured 147.9F, above the 120F maximum.

headline: Rat droppings found; pest control advised
summary: Inspector found 20 rat droppings on the basement floor near the hot water tank and 10 more inside a cardboard box on a shelf. Droppings must be removed by reinspection, and pest control service is advised. Also noted: standing water, ice buildup, and no food handler certificates.

headline: Ice scoop stored on floor; minor leaks
summary: Ice machine interior was slightly soiled with dust. An ice scoop was stored in sanitizer on the basement floor and must be moved to a clean, dry surface. A condensate hose was slightly leaking, and grease and dust built up near the hood.

headline: Grimy restrooms; food debris under shelving
summary: Plumbing fixtures in all toilet rooms were filled with grime and must be cleaned. An unisex restroom had a garbage receptacle without a cover. Floors behind and under shelving had excessive food debris.

headline: Missing splashguards; worn cutting board; slow drain
summary: Kitchen and dish room hand sinks lack splashguards. A worn cutting board with deep cuts and stains at the front prep area must be replaced. The three-compartment sink drains slowly and must be restored.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure; no mop sink
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure was on premises. No mop sink with hot and cold running water is installed, and the washroom has no mechanical ventilation. The manager must correct each item.

headline: No handwashing signs; sewer line above freezer
summary: No handwashing signs were posted at any sink. A sewer line above the basement chest freezer must be shielded or the freezer moved. The high-temperature dish machine lacks a temperature indicator, a citation was issued, and two basement mop sinks lack backflow devices.

headline: Low hot water and slimy ice machines; partly corrected
summary: Hot water at the prep hand sink measured 63F and the employee washroom sink 72F; a service technician brought them to 102-105F on site. Ice machines on two floors had black and pink slime dripping onto ice; the engineer cleaned one during inspection. A 19th-floor sink leaks.

headline: Pizza cooler food too warm; discarded
summary: Roasted tomatoes, mushrooms, bacon, chicken, and bruschetta in the pizza cooler measured 49-52F, above the 41F limit; about 5 pounds were discarded. The cooler's ambient air measured 40F. Burnt-out bulbs above the three-compartment sink need replacing.

headline: Sushi prep exposed to customers; seating removed
summary: Sushi was being prepared at a front bar with no protection from customer contamination. The person in charge removed all bar seating during this time. No citation was issued. Gaps at the wall base and storage space behind a curtain need covering.

headline: Repeat violations uncorrected; grease buildup throughout
summary: Previous priority violations were not corrected: heavy grease and food debris on walls, floors, equipment, and drains; microwave and freezer dirty; no allergen training. Also noted: no walk-in cooler thermometer, a leaking faucet, a hose without backflow protection, and no summary posted.

headline: Missing thermometers; no food handler certificates
summary: Broken or missing thermometers were found inside cooling units throughout prep areas. Also noted: deep-cut cutting boards, grease near hot-holding equipment, missing ceiling attachments, chipped paint, a large floor hole, inadequate basement lighting, and no food handler training certificates.

headline: No employee health policy; no backflow devices
summary: No employee health policy or training was on site; a citation was issued. No vomit and diarrhea procedure or kit was available. Front doors have a 1/4-inch gap. Backflow devices are missing at three ice machine water lines and the bar and kitchen areas, and women's washroom lacks receptacles.

headline: Food stored on floor; several upkeep issues
summary: Buckets of food on the walk-in cooler floor must be raised onto shelving. Also noted: unlabeled squeeze bottles, crowded or rusty storage, grime on equipment, damaged floor tiles, stained ceiling tiles, and a washroom door without a self-closing device.

headline: Debris under ice machine; burned-out bulbs
summary: Food debris, spills, and dirt buildup were on the floor under the ice machine and must be cleaned at all times. Burned-out light bulbs in the prep area need replacing.

headline: Open drink in prep area; no hair restraints
summary: An employee was seen drinking from an open cup in the prep area; closed-lid containers are required. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Bus tubs were too large for the three-compartment sink. Stained ceiling tiles in the washroom need replacing.

headline: Eggs and sausage too warm; discarded
summary: Eggs at 60.7F and sausage at 57.4F in the rear prep cold holding unit were discarded by the manager, about $29 in value; a citation was issued. Also noted: a deteriorating basement sink faucet base, damaged ceiling and floor tiles, and a greasy hood system.

headline: No certified manager on site; dead roaches found
summary: No certified food manager was present while open; a citation was issued. Dead roaches were found in a basement mop sink, and sticky traps were found on basement floors and walls. Also noted: no vomit kit, no food probe thermometer, and no hand-drying supplies.

headline: No certified manager; unsafe cold-held foods discarded
summary: No valid city sanitation manager was on site while time-controlled foods were served; the manager arrived at 2:30 p.m. and a citation was issued. Eggs, sausage, and cheese in a prep cooler measured 49-52F; about 90 pounds were discarded. The cooler was tagged and held.

headline: Repeat violations: door gap, damaged gasket, boxes on floor
summary: Repeat core violations were not corrected: an opening at the entrance door base, a damaged refrigerator gasket, and boxes on the floor near cold holding units. A damaged wall by the rear prep door was also noted, and a citation was issued. A splashguard is needed between the sinks.

headline: Certified manager missing allergen training
summary: The city-certified manager was missing allergen training. The operator was instructed to obtain it and keep verification on site.

headline: No person in charge or certified manager present
summary: No person in charge was present during inspection. No certified food manager was on duty while time-controlled foods were prepared and served; a citation was issued. The person in charge must have a certificate by the next inspection.

headline: Live dog found inside; removed on site
summary: A manager was found with a live dog inside the food establishment, which is not allowed; a citation was issued. The manager removed the dog during inspection. Also noted: no handwashing sign, stained cutting board, cardboard liners, and clutter in the rear prep area.

headline: Cold foods too warm; cooler at 56F held
summary: Cold foods held between 48.0F and 53.2F, including BBQ sauce, ham, and caramel cake, were discarded, about 20 pounds worth $215; a citation was issued. A refrigerator at 56F was tagged and held. Also noted: no allergen training proof and no mechanical ventilation in the washroom.

headline: No hot water throughout; sinks at 85-88F
summary: No hot water was available throughout the establishment; sinks measured 85F to 88F. Hand sinks must reach 100-120F and the three-compartment sink 110F or higher; a citation was issued.

headline: Cold food at 60F discarded; cooler held
summary: Cold pasta, cheese, and salads in the prep cooler measured 59.8-61.2F; about 100 pounds were discarded and a citation issued. The rear prep cooler at 58.2F was tagged and held. Also noted: turkey thawed in standing water, no employee health policy, and no food handler training.

headline: Grooved cutting boards; floors need deep cleaning
summary: Two cutting boards at the produce station have deep grooves and must be replaced. Soda dispenser needs detail cleaning, walk-in freezer floor and cooling unit need cleaning, a restroom fan hangs loose, and basement and stair floors need deep cleaning.

headline: No hot water; three-compartment sink not working
summary: No hot water was available at any sink; readings were 69.9F to 74.8F, and the three-compartment sink was 73F. The sink faucet could not be shut off; a citation was issued. Also noted: food stored on floors, moldy caulking, a ceiling leak, and cracked storage bins.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; no manager certificate posted
summary: The low-temperature dish machine measured 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged and held; a citation was issued. No city manager certificate was posted. Oysters from three batches were mixed and shellstock tags were missing; about 10 pounds were discarded.

headline: Rusty chipped storage racks in walk-in
summary: Wire storage racks in the walk-in cooler had chipped paint and rust. The operator must remove the rust and repaint or replace the shelves.

headline: Raw meat thawed in standing water; food on floor
summary: Raw ground beef and chicken were thawed in standing water in the three-compartment sink. Onions and chicken breading were stored on the rear floor, and sugar and coffee were stored under a leaking-risk sink. Also noted: missing handwashing sign and unused single-use items not inverted.

headline: Dirty floors under coolers; unused butcher cooler
summary: Floors under coolers had dirt and debris and must be cleaned, along with floors throughout the store. A butcher cooler at the counter is no longer in service and must be repaired or removed.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training proof
summary: The certified food manager had no proof of allergen training certificate on site. Manager was instructed to obtain the certificate.

headline: Food stored on floor and uncovered; training proof missing
summary: Food containers were unlabeled, stored on the walk-in floor, or uncovered in freezers and prep coolers. Also noted: reach-in coolers without thermometers, wet wiping cloths, utensils stored in food, milk crates used as shelves, a leaking sink faucet, and missing food handler training and allergen training proof.

headline: Missing handwashing sign and thermometer; manager fixed thermometer
summary: No handwashing sign at the washroom sink, and no thermometer in the front salad-dressing refrigerator. The manager corrected the thermometer issue during inspection. The restroom also lacked a covered waste container.

headline: Food thawed at room temperature; milk crates used
summary: Spinach puffs, a time-and-temperature control food, were thawed at room temperature in the main kitchen. Manager was told to use approved methods. Milk crates were used throughout storage areas and need replacing with proper shelving. The ice machine exterior was soiled.

headline: Unlabeled teas; dirty kitchen floors and walls
summary: Teas in the beverage cooler were unlabeled and need a business name, address, and ingredients. A seasoning rack had dust buildup, the grease receptacle needed cleaning, and kitchen floors and walls were not clean.

headline: No allergen training proof for certified managers
summary: No proof of allergen training was available for certified food managers. Documentation must be provided.

headline: PIC has no valid certificate; photocopy only
summary: The person in charge had no valid Chicago certified food manager certificate; only a photocopy was on site, and a citation was issued. The PIC's allergen training certificate was expired. Also noted: leaking rear hand sink and three-compartment sink faucet, and grooved cutting boards.

headline: Cold-water knob broken; no allergen training
summary: The cold-water knob on the handwashing sink near the toilet room does not work and must be repaired. Dining area ceiling tiles above the hot pot area are water-stained. Basement storage lighting is inadequate, and no allergen training certificate was on site.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; unsafe cold-holding temperatures
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were found on shelves, floors, and behind equipment; a dead mouse was on a glue board, and flying insects were present. A cooler at 47.8F was held and chicken at 51.6F was discarded. No certified manager or certificate was present.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen training records
summary: One employee had no food handler training, and no allergen training records were on site for managers. Also noted: no handwashing sign in the women's restroom, a urinal that does not flush, and garbage and debris on the boiler room floor.

headline: Rodent droppings found; no manager certificate posted
summary: About 10 rodent droppings were found by the grease trap and about 15 in the furnace room; pest control was recommended and a citation issued. No valid sanitation manager certificate was posted. Also noted: a gap at the rear door, outdoor grills and charcoal inside, and a blood spill in the freezer.

headline: Ice machine interior and floors need cleaning
summary: The inner lining of the ice machine was not cleaned and must be cleaned and sanitized. Floors along wall bases and under equipment, especially at the three-compartment sink and syrup dispensers, need cleaning.

headline: Food debris, leaks, litter, and clutter throughout
summary: Food debris and spills were found on coolers, freezers, prep tables, shelving, and pallets. Also noted: soiled cardboard, a leaking sink faucet, unclean restroom fixtures, litter around dumpsters, and unused items stored where pests could hide.

headline: Moldy ice machines; no catering sneeze guards
summary: Black moldlike substance was found on the upper interiors of two large ice machines on B2 and B3; cleaning was ordered. Also noted: no portable sneeze guards for catering buffets, damaged floor tiles and grout, ice buildup in two walk-in freezers, and two certified managers without allergen training.

headline: Two large wall holes must be sealed
summary: Two large holes in the wall near the boiler area must be properly sealed to prevent entry points for pests. No pests were reported in this inspection.

headline: Low hand-sink water temperature; moldy ice machines
summary: Hand sink water measured 72.6F, below the required 100F; a citation was issued. Black moldlike substance was found inside both large ice machines. Also noted: raw-food advisory missing from menu, boxes and potatoes stored on floors, damaged freezer gasket, and a leaking sink.

headline: Repeat uncorrected door gap; ashtrays found
summary: A 1/2-inch gap at the rear exit door sweep was a repeat violation not corrected from a prior inspection. Ashtrays and cigarette butts were found on the rear patio and basement floor. Also noted: missing handwashing signs, torn cooler gaskets, and a missing trash receptacle.

headline: No hot water at three-compartment sink
summary: The three-compartment sink had no hot water; readings of 104-106F at other sinks were below the 110F required for dishwashing. No pest control logbook was available and no garbage hauler contract was on record.

headline: Cooler at 60F; no vomit cleanup kit
summary: A three-door cooler measured 60F ambient air, above the 41F limit; it was tagged as a priority violation. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was on site. Also noted: greasy fryers and griddle, debris on floors, and unused equipment stored in the facility.

headline: Torn gasket, rusty freezer racks, lighting issues
summary: Torn door gasket on the kitchen 2 prep cooler. Rust on wire storage racks in the walk-in freezer. Kitchen exhaust hood and filters need detail cleaning of grease. Burnt-out light bulbs above the dry storage area.

headline: Rear door gap; wiping cloths and scoops misplaced
summary: A half-inch opening at the bottom of the rear exit door must be closed to prevent pest entry. Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables and ice scoops on the ice machine. Items on the floor in display area must be raised.

headline: Restroom lacks exhaust vent; no allergen training
summary: Restroom has no exhaust vent; one must be provided. The sanitation manager has no allergen training; it must be provided.

headline: Dirt on floors and corners in prep areas
summary: Dirt build-up on floors along walls and in corners in prep and dishwashing areas. The person in charge was instructed to clean all floors and maintain them.

headline: Uncovered baked goods; ice machine build-up
summary: Speed rack of baked goods in the hallway was not covered; ready-to-eat food must be protected. Slight build-up inside ice machine near the rear toilet room; ice must be removed, then cleaned and sanitized.

headline: No certified manager on site; cold foods too warm
summary: No certified food manager on site during food prep. Chicken, eggs, cole slaw and batters held at 44-52°F; about 2.5 lbs discarded on site. Hair restraints missing. Stained cutting boards, greasy areas and clutter also noted.

headline: Missing handwashing signs at two sinks
summary: No handwashing signs at the bar handwashing sink or the handwashing sink on the coffee and tea line. Staff instructed to provide and maintain signs.

headline: Grease and debris in kitchen and walk-in
summary: Walk-in cooler and freezer floors have debris, dirt and ice build-up. Deep fryer sides have heavy grease; area under grill and flat top has dirt. Women's toilet room lacks covered receptacles. Food splatter and grease behind cooking equipment.

headline: Pink build-up in ice machine; allergen training gap
summary: Slight pink build-up inside the ice machine; staff told to clean it. One of two certified managers has no allergen training. All must complete it and keep records on site.

headline: Dirty fryers, floors, filters; unused cooler
summary: Fryers soiled inside and floors around the griddle have debris and soil. Filters above the griddle have dust and grease build-up. Unused cooler in basement; manager told to discard unused equipment.

headline: Peeling ceiling paint above prep table
summary: Peeling ceiling paint above the prep table in the first-floor rear prep area must be removed.

headline: Dead flies in window frames; door gaps
summary: Dead insects and flies found in window frames throughout the facility; must be removed and sanitized. Doors to exterior garbage area and aquaponics room have 1/4-inch gaps and must be closed. Rust at ice machine opening.

headline: Unlabeled containers and packaged display items
summary: Food storage containers need labels when food is not in its original package. Packaged display items such as popsicles, desserts, cut fruit and sandwiches need proper labels. Rust on grease trap lid. Ice machine needs a visible backflow device.

headline: Cold foods at 48-51°F; coolers not holding temperature
summary: Chicken, steak, milk and ground beef inside prep and dairy coolers held at 48-51°F; coolers must hold 41°F or below. About 30 lbs ($150) discarded. Both coolers must be repaired. Ice build-up inside a cooler must be removed.

headline: Glove misuse; dish sanitizer not working
summary: Staff wore the same gloves handling dirty dishes and then ready-to-eat grill food. Dish sanitizer read 0.0 ppm (parts per million), so dishes were not sanitized. A blocked hand sink was cleared on site. Other issues include leaks, no hand towels and a rear door gap.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate on premises
summary: Person in charge lacks a city food sanitation certificate. No valid certificate posted or certified person on site while the business is open. Priority violation issued.

headline: Women's restroom trash can missing
summary: A trash receptacle is missing in the women's toilet room. Staff instructed to provide a new can with a lid in the first stall.

headline: No handwashing sink in dishwashing area
summary: No handwashing sink where coffee equipment is washed; one must be installed. Dishwashing drainboard too small for daily use. No grease trap at the three-compartment sink; one must be installed. Staff serving open drinks need food handler proof.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; base coving gaps
summary: Handwashing sinks in the kitchen and bar lack signs telling employees to wash hands. Base coving missing along floor-wall joints in kitchen. A certified food manager lacks allergen awareness training and certificate on site.

headline: Hair restraints missing; floors need cleaning
summary: All food handlers must wear hair restraints at all times. Coffee syrup storage racks need cleaning. Leak at mop sink area must be corrected. Floors throughout need detail cleaning to remove food spills and build-up.

headline: Clean utensils over dirty sink; greasy shelving
summary: Clean utensils hung for storage above the dirty wash basin of the three-compartment sink; must be stored properly. Grease and food debris on shelving under small gas stoves. Soiled mop heads must be stored inverted to dry. Floors have grease and debris.

headline: Rear door gap; missing food handler certificates
summary: Rear exit door is not fully rodent-proof; a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom must be sealed. Cardboard used as shelf liner in prep cooler. Grease and debris on equipment. No food handler or allergen certificates on premises.

headline: Food on floor; knives and cups need fixing
summary: Food containers on the walk-in cooler floor must be raised six inches onto shelving. Knives were stored between a prep table and cooler. Ceramic cups must be shown lead-safe with records, or removed from the premises.

headline: Shellfish tags missing dates; leaking sink
summary: No 90-day shellfish tags with last sold or served date written; must be provided and maintained. Leaky water line at a first-floor dish area hand sink. Crates used for food storage, items stored on basement floor, and burnt-out or cracked lights.

headline: Hole in wall base at serving counter
summary: Wall base at the end of the front serving counter is in poor repair. The hole must be sealed.

headline: Dirty build-up in lobby floor sink
summary: Black, brown and green build-up and debris in the floor sink between the fountain drink and tea dispenser in the lobby. Staff instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Hair restraints missing; personal items in food area
summary: Staff prepared and served food without hair restraints; they must be worn at all times during food prep. Wiping cloths stored on prep tables. Dirty refrigerator interiors, broken floor tiles, and personal belongings stored in food prep and storage areas.

headline: Deli chicken and ham held too warm
summary: Deli chicken and ham in the walk-in cooler held at 44.2-45.5°F, above the 41°F limit; about 6 lbs ($108) discarded. Walk-in cooler air measured 41°F. Dust on cooler condensers in prep area must be cleaned.

headline: Wet wiping cloths left on prep surfaces
summary: Wet wiping cloths stored on prep counters, tables and the main cookline. Staff told to keep them in sanitizing solution when not in use.

headline: Cardboard and foil liners; open wall gap
summary: Cardboard lines a shelving unit near the rear dishwashing sink, and cardboard and foil line prep table shelves. All must be removed to prevent insect harborage. An open gap about one inch behind the men's restroom toilet must be sealed.

headline: Plants over food areas; cups not air-dried
summary: Live potted plants placed above bar prep area, ice bins and dishwashing area; remove them from above these areas. Deli cups were not air-dried after washing; multi-use utensils must be air-dried.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate posted on site
summary: No valid city sanitation certificate posted; certificate holder must be on site while temperature-controlled foods are prepared and served. No signed employee health policy. Milk cooler lacks a thermometer. No covered waste receptacle in women's washroom. No food handler certificates.

headline: Handwashing sink lacks splash guard
summary: Handwashing sink near dish and prep areas has no splash guard. Manager instructed to install one to prevent splash contamination.

headline: No hair restraints; dish machine pipe leaks
summary: Food handlers in the food prep area lacked hair restraints. Pipe leaking under the dish machine must be fixed. Dirt, food and debris on floors and around heavy equipment, sinks and dish machine. Ceiling tiles with stains and food splatter.

headline: Pink build-up in ice machine; light covers missing
summary: Slight pink build-up inside upper ice machine; must be cleaned. Missing ceiling light bulb covers above the three-compartment sink must be provided. One food manager lacks a food allergen training certificate.

headline: Unlabeled dry containers; rusty shelves
summary: Dry storage containers must be labeled with product names. Rust on walk-in cooler shelves must be removed or the shelves replaced.

headline: No certified manager; live cockroaches found
summary: No certified food manager on premises while steak, shrimp and fish were prepared. Three live cockroaches found beside the mop sink in rear prep; removal and extra pest control recommended. Dish machine rinse read 0 ppm. Desserts lacked labels.

headline: Cold foods too warm; unit must not be used
summary: Beef at 48.6°F, eggs at 46.8°F and pasta at 48.7°F in a cold-hold unit; about 15 lbs ($250) discarded on site. The four-door cold-holding unit (44.5-48.6°F) must not be used until reinspected by the Chicago Department of Public Health.

headline: Front door gaps; spills under pop machine
summary: Front door is not tight-fitting, with gaps on the side and bottom. Weather stripping must be provided to block pest entry points. Cabinet below the self-serve pop machine has spills and debris that must be cleaned.

headline: Damaged cutting board; leaking sink faucet
summary: Cutting board at the prep cooler has dark stains and deep grooves; it must be refinished or replaced. Leak at the faucet of the three-compartment sink in the dishwashing area must be repaired.

headline: Missing thermometer, foil liners, damaged ceilings
