summary: Thermometer could not be found in a middle prep cooler. Foil lines prep shelving and grill equipment. Torn baseboards, missing ceiling tiles in rear storage, and ceiling above the large stove need repair.

headline: Twelve small flies in kitchen and storage
summary: Twelve small flies found in kitchen, dish room and dry storage; manager told to reduce them. Also: rusty dish room shelving, a certified food manager lacks allergen training, and previous violations not fixed, including a missing handwashing sign and drain stoppers.

headline: No hot water until plumber replaced tank
summary: No hot water reached any plumbing fixtures. A plumber replaced the hot water tank before inspection, and hot water was restored at inspection time. Also: coolers lack air thermometers, clean equipment is stored on the floor.

headline: Cooked chicken held at 115-120°F
summary: About 10 lbs of cooked chicken held at 115-120°F in a hot holding unit; hot food must be held at 135°F or above. Discarded, about $32 worth. Dust on vent above three-compartment sink. Food debris under cooking equipment and on produce area floors.

headline: No certified manager; about 50 live flies
summary: No person in charge with a valid city sanitation certificate. No certified manager on site while rice was prepared and served. About 50 live small flies in dish, mop sink and prep areas. Food handler certificates missing. Prior violations not corrected.

headline: Soiled ice machine; submerged foam cups
summary: Ice machine interior panel slightly soiled; clean and sanitize. A fly strip in the prep area must be removed and replaced with proper insect control devices. Foam cups submerged in dry storage containers; use utensils to handle.

headline: No certified manager; rat droppings found
summary: No certified food manager or person in charge with food safety knowledge on site while fish and chicken were prepared. About 25 rat droppings in basement water heater closet. Both prep handwashing sinks were blocked. Living quarters in basement must be removed.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; no food handler training
summary: No handwashing sign at the front handwashing sink in the prep area. Kitchen staff restroom lacks a covered receptacle. Debris around the outside dumpster. Lights flicker in prep area. No food handler training; certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Toilet overflow, leak, missing handwashing signs
summary: No handwashing signs near front and rear prep sinks. Vegetable cooler needs a thermometer. Unisex toilet overflowed; another toilet is available. Slow pipe leak under rear sink. Crumbling basement brick walls and holes must be sealed.

headline: Rear door opening; dusty vents; missing allergen certificate
summary: Rear south door has a 1/2-inch opening at the bottom and must be made rodent-proof. Heavy dust on ceiling vents in both washrooms must be cleaned. One certified manager lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: Unlabeled containers; no food handler certificates
summary: Food storage containers are not labeled and must be when food is not in its original package. Dirt and debris in rear floor drains. Excess dust on dishwashing area vents. Food handler training certificates not provided.

headline: Blocked hand sink; hot rice held too cool
summary: Rear prep hand sink was blocked by a garbage bin and boxes and must stay accessible. Two pounds of white rice held at 101.6-113.6°F, below the 135°F required; about $7 discarded. Heavy food debris on floors.

headline: Mouse droppings on prep shelves and floor
summary: About 20 mouse droppings on prep shelves near the steam table and 10 on the prep floor along walls and corners. All must be removed by reinspection. Food debris on shelves and floor, plus a leaking prep sink drain.

headline: Cleaning needed on stovetop, dish machine, shelves
summary: Clean the stovetop, the front face of the low-temperature dish machine, and storage shelves in the rear food prep area.

headline: Wooden shelving, faucet, water-damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Raw wooden shelving at the front display cooler must be painted or sealed. Restroom hand-sink faucet is in poor repair and must be replaced. Water-damaged ceiling tiles in the rear coffee prep area and hallway must be replaced.

headline: Clean cooking equipment, floors, drains
summary: Exterior of cooking equipment needs cleaning to remove build-up. Interior of hot holding unit in front serving area needs cleaning. Floors and floor drains in kitchen and serving area need cleaning under and around equipment.

headline: No certified manager; fly in fish; no soap
summary: No valid certificate holder on site while fish, chicken, beef and dairy were handled; the certified manager arrived later without a certificate. A large fly was found floating in fish in a refrigerator; about 2 lbs discarded. Handsinks lacked soap until obtained.

headline: No allergen training certificate on site
summary: No allergen training certificate on site. Allergen training must be provided for all certified food managers.

headline: Detail cleaning needed for floors and equipment
summary: Floor drains, sides of cooking equipment, and floors under and around cooking and other equipment need detail cleaning. Dirt, dust and small debris noted. Staff instructed to clean all areas.

headline: No vomiting/diarrhea cleanup procedure or kit
summary: No written procedure or supplies for responding to vomiting and diarrhea. Must provide a plan and kit with gloves, face masks, disposable mops and a sanitizer effective against norovirus (a stomach virus).

headline: Heavy grease and dirt in fryers and hood
summary: Heavy grease inside the electrical unit of the deep fryers, and food particles in the service cooler. Floor drains throughout need detail cleaning. Heavy dirt and grease in the exhaust hood, filters and pipes above cooking equipment.

headline: Food in grocery bags; grease and ice build-up
summary: Front bar handwashing sink lacks signs. Ice scoops are stored on a table; food in grocery bags must move to food-grade containers. Chest freezers have excess ice. Grease and damaged tiles behind cooking equipment; hood needs cleaning.

headline: Standing water in three-compartment sink
summary: Standing water found in the northwest corner of the three-compartment sink. Staff instructed to identify the source and repair it.

headline: No vomit cleanup policy; low hot water
summary: No cleanup procedure for vomiting or diarrhea. First restroom hand sink hot water reached only 73°F; must reach 100°F. Missing sink stoppers and leaking faucet. No consumer warning for raw or undercooked food. Holes in walls need sealing.

headline: Missing thermometer; damaged gaskets; taped restroom door
summary: Pizza ingredient cooler has no thermometer. Three-door cooler gaskets are damaged and hanging. Cold-hold units need detail cleaning inside and out. Restroom door near walk-in area is held with duct tape; restroom floor in poor repair.

headline: Stained cutting board; missing coving
summary: Stained cutting board with dark grooves behind the deli counter must be refinished or replaced. Coving missing under the three-compartment sink and a hole along the wall-floor junction must be replaced and sealed.

headline: Handwashing sinks lacked soap; raw fish disclosure missing
summary: Handwashing sinks in the dish room and front bar lacked hand soap. The dish room sink also lacked drying supplies, corrected on site. Raw fish on the menu has no required consumer warning. Pink substance in ice machine.

headline: About 100 mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: No certified food manager on site while food handlers prepared and handled temperature-controlled foods. About 100 mouse droppings found in kitchen, prep, break room and lobby areas. About 150 lbs ($1,750) discarded for missing date labels.

headline: No certified manager; food stored on floor
summary: No person in charge with a valid city sanitation certificate. No certified manager on site while TCS food was prepared; temperature-controlled food must be prepared under a certified manager. Food stored on walk-in floor. Hair restraints missing; no allergen training.

headline: Dish machine too cool; about 50 live flies
summary: Dish machine temperature indicator read 148°F; sanitizing requires 160°F, so the machine must be repaired. About 50 live small flying insects on walls, ceilings and water lines above prep, dish and bar areas. Excess garbage around outside dumpster.

headline: Rodent droppings found; no certified manager
summary: About 40-50 rodent droppings in hot tank and furnace area; droppings must be removed and extra pest control obtained. No certified manager on site while chicken was prepared. No paper towels at sinks; no food thermometer on site.

headline: Wet wiping cloths; ice scoop stored in ice
summary: Ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine with its handle touching ice; staff instructed how to store it. Wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces must be kept in sanitizing solution. Water-stained ceiling tiles; milk crates used as basement shelving.

headline: Employees eating and drinking at prep area
summary: Employees were drinking and preparing food at the kitchen prep area. Management must provide a separate designated place to eat and drink. Dirty, dusty ceiling fans at the rear need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager on site during re-inspection
summary: No certified food manager on site during re-inspection while chicken, salads and shrimp were prepared and served. Frozen meat in a plastic grocery bag. Heavy grease on hood and filters and on the wall behind cooking equipment. Manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No running water at toilet-room sinks
summary: Handwashing sinks in both toilet rooms lack running hot and cold water. Hot water must reach 100-120°F. One handsink has no drain pipes and must be connected. No citation issued.

headline: Exposed metal microwave; leaking pipes
summary: Splash guard needed between prep table and handwashing sink. The microwave interior has exposed metal through holes on top and must be replaced at once. Prep sink drains slowly, and pipes under an open cooler are leaking.

headline: Hot faucet at 127°F; faulty women's faucet
summary: A men's washroom faucet reached 127°F; the minimum must be 100°F. A women's washroom faucet at the far right is not turning on or functioning properly. Dust on ceiling vents above prep and dish areas must be cleaned.

headline: No hair restraints; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints; all must wear them. Milk crates used as shelving in prep and storage areas must be replaced with shelving at least six inches off the floor.

headline: Dish machine tagged out; sanitizer too weak
summary: Low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm (parts per million) sanitizer and was not in use. Machine is tagged and must not be used until it holds at least 50 ppm and is reinspected. Rice and sugar containers are unlabeled; mops stored in standing water.

headline: Live cockroach and flies; pest control required
summary: A live cockroach was seen crawling in a spill kit in rear prep. About 7 small flies in front prep and 5 large black flies in a restroom, hallway and rear prep. Pest control service required. Also: no test strips, no three-compartment sink, no grease trap found.

headline: About 20 small flies; activity at bar
summary: About 20 small flies found in the facility, including the bar. Activity must be eliminated and affected areas cleaned; pest control service recommended. Also: missing bar sink splash guard, rusty walk-in shelves, and bar sink water at 102.6°F.

headline: No cold water at basement sink; lights out
summary: Knives and spoons stored handles-down on basement shelving; they must be inverted or covered. No cold water at basement utility sink; must be restored. Non-working lights in one restroom and two basement hood lights need repair.

headline: Ice build-up in cooler; floor debris
summary: Ice build-up in the rear of the two-door prep cooler must be repaired and maintained. Debris on floors under all equipment, along walls and in corners in prep and storage areas must be cleaned.

headline: Washrooms lack covered trash receptacles
summary: No covered trash receptacles inside either washroom. Both washrooms must be provided with covered trash receptacles and kept that way.

headline: Cardboard boxes stacked in rear
summary: Cardboard boxes stacked in the rear must be removed from the premises.

headline: Greasy equipment, dirty floors, expired allergen training
summary: Dirt inside ice machine guard. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, prep tables and shelving. Floors under equipment and in corners are dirty. One certified manager's allergen training certificate has expired.

headline: Eggs held too warm; raw chicken uncovered
summary: Pooled eggs held at 48.9-51.8°F; corrected on site when the manager discarded about 3 lbs ($50). Raw chicken uncovered and on the walk-in floor. A leaking condenser dripped onto food. Gap at the base of the rear exit door must be sealed.

headline: About 50 live flies; no raw food warning
summary: About 50 live small flying insects on walls, ceilings and equipment in prep, dish, dry storage and bar areas; more pest control needed. Menu lacks the required consumer warning about raw or undercooked foods.

headline: Fly activity; back door needs insect proofing
summary: Fly activity noted; the back door must be made insect-proof. Also: wiping cloths not stored in sanitizing solution, knives not in holder, discolored cutting boards, detail cleaning needed on prep tables and coolers, and floor food spills.

headline: No backflow devices on ice, coffee machines
summary: No backflow prevention device found on water lines to the ice machine and coffee machine; external devices must be installed. Floors under and behind equipment are dirty and must be cleaned.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and thermometers
summary: Restrooms lacked handwashing signs. Several cold-holding coolers lacked internal air thermometers. Dish machine gauges were dirty and hard to read. Cooler lids are damaged, and the outdoor grease bin needs cleaning.

headline: Cracked rear doorway; front screen adequate
summary: Front entrance door has an adequate screen to prevent pests; keep it closed or screened. Cracks and uneven surfaces along the rear doorway must be sealed and made smooth.

headline: No covered waste bin; damaged ceiling; clutter
summary: No covered waste receptacles in the unisex washroom. Damaged ceiling tiles and a large ceiling opening must be sealed or repaired. Heavy dust on washroom vents. Basement clutter must be removed to prevent rodent hiding places.

headline: Missing ceiling tiles in dining area
summary: Missing or damaged ceiling tiles in the dining area near the front door must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Dishwasher lacked hair restraint and food handler card
summary: An employee washed dishes in the food prep area without a hair restraint. That employee lacked a food handler certificate. A certified manager lacked an allergen training certificate. Restroom waste bin uncovered; grease needs cleaning.

headline: Plates not inverted; dim basement prep lighting
summary: Plates were not inverted after sanitizing and air drying; staff told to invert them. Basement prep area lighting is too dim; staff told to increase light intensity and maintain it.

headline: Uncovered bagels; items stored on floor
summary: Red substance found on the ice machine interior panel; to be cleaned. Bagels uncovered in front prep area must be covered. Single-service items stored on the floor must be raised. Food spills and debris on cooler surfaces and floors.

headline: Reused bags; milk crates storing food
summary: Single-use bags were reused to store food in a reach-in cooler; reuse is not allowed. Milk crates used to store dry food inside a prep cooler must be removed in favor of easy-to-clean storage bins.

headline: Food debris and damaged ceiling tiles found
summary: Food, dirt and debris found under storage shelves at front and rear. Missing and water-stained ceiling tiles throughout the store. Staff instructed to clean floors and replace tiles.

headline: Unlabeled food; no food handler certificates
summary: Foods and spices outside original containers must be labeled with common names. Torn cooler gasket; slow handwashing sink drain. Floor drains and floors need cleaning. Burnt-out lights. No food handler or allergen training records on site.

headline: Cold food up to 70F; repeat violation
summary: Various TCS foods were held at 45-70F, and the manager discarded cream and milk. A door cooler ran at 50F and was tagged. No consumer advisory was on the lunch menu. Food managers still lack allergen certification, a repeat violation.

headline: Torn gasket; slow sink; burnt-out hood bulb
summary: A torn gasket was found on a prep cooler near the sauce station. The dump sink at the main bar drains very slowly. One hood light bulb is burnt out, and grease and grime are on hood filters.

headline: Restroom sinks lack hot water and signs
summary: Toilet room handwashing sinks in both restrooms did not have enough hot water, which must reach at least 100F; this is a priority violation. No handwashing signs were posted in the toilet rooms.

headline: Unlabeled ready-to-eat foods; repeat violations
summary: Ready-to-eat beef, pork and chorizo in the prep cooler had no labels or discard dates; a citation was issued. Repeat core violations were not corrected: hair restraints, wiping cloths, rusty shelving and broken tiles.

headline: Coffee area debris; toilet lid missing
summary: Coffee beans and grounds under the coffee station need detail cleaning. The staff toilet lid is missing and must be provided. The floor under shelving in the rear storage area needs cleaning.

headline: Crates used for dish storage; sink stoppers missing
summary: Crates used as dish storage must be replaced with durable, cleanable containers. The 3-compartment sink has no drain stoppers, and paper towels are used instead. Floors and fan guards need cleaning, and food handler certificates were not on site.

headline: Cold food held at 46-50F; citation issued
summary: Chicken, pork, beef and beans were held at 46-50F, and about 30 pounds were discarded worth $200. The walk-in cooler ran at 45F and a technician repaired it. A 2nd-floor men's toilet is clogged; a repeat lock violation was cited.

headline: No backflow device at mop sink
summary: No backflow prevention device was found at the mop sink faucet. One must be installed where it can be located and serviced.

headline: Beef and chicken held too warm; 45 pounds lost
summary: Beef at 48.2F and chicken at 50-57.8F were held in the prep cold unit. Manager discarded and denatured 45 pounds of food worth $90, and a citation was issued. Frozen meat was thawing in the prep area, and a cooler gasket is torn.

headline: Gap at exterior doors; rusty shelving
summary: A 1/4-inch gap between exterior double doors must be sealed. Rust on walk-in cooler shelving must be removed. An employee's food handler certificate was expired and needs renewing.

headline: Gap under rear door; soiled towels
summary: A 1/2-inch gap at the bottom of the rear exterior door must be repaired. Soiled towels hung on handsink faucets, and residue built up inside cold-holding units. Restroom trash was overflowing, and walls and tiles need repair.

headline: No valid food manager certificate; food stored badly
summary: The person in charge had no valid food service manager certificate; a citation was issued. Noodles were stored under a sink and food sat on the walk-in floor. Hair restraints were fixed on site.

headline: No manager on site; hands not washed before gloves
summary: No certified manager was on site while food was prepared. A food handler put on gloves without washing hands, handled money, then prepared food. Staff lacked food handler certificates, and a citation was issued.

headline: No certificate posted; hand sinks lacked water
summary: No valid food service certificate was posted, and a citation was issued. Food handlers were preparing food without a certified manager present. Hand sinks lacked soap, paper towels and hot water; water was restored on site. A high-temperature dish machine was tagged out.

headline: Over 50 flies; cold food too warm
summary: More than 50 flies were found throughout the facility, including the kitchen, doughnut display and bar; pest control was recommended. Several foods were at 46-52F, and about $2,000 of food was discarded. Four coolers ran at 50-59F.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; two workers lack training
summary: A torn walk-in cooler door gasket and a leaking 3-compartment sink faucet need repair. Oven and fryer cabinets have grease and food debris. Two food employees lack food handler training, and one manager's allergen training has expired.

headline: Wiping cloths stored damp; food handler untrained
summary: Wiping cloths were stored damp outside sanitizer solution on a prep sink ledge and prep tables. A food employee in the kitchen lacked food handler training and a certificate on site.

headline: No sink stoppers on 3-compartment sink
summary: No sink stoppers were on site for the 3-compartment sink. The operator must obtain them to wash and sanitize utensils properly.

headline: Re-inspection: clutter, uneven floor, leak stain
summary: Clutter in a closet and the boiler room must be removed. Raw wood under a mini fridge must be removed and the floor repaired. Lobby walls are not smooth or cleanable, and stained ceiling tiles above the laundry entrance point to a leak.

headline: Sink leak contaminated the next sink
summary: A heavy leak let water from one sink compartment flow into the adjacent sink. The manager sealed the leak on site. Wastewater also flooded when one compartment drained, and the manager cleaned the grease trap. Citations issued.

headline: Expired allergen certificates for managers
summary: Expired allergen training certificates for certified food managers were found on site. Valid allergen training must be provided for all certified food managers.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; cluttered shelves
summary: Bulk containers of flour and rice were found without labels. Pots on racks were not stored inverted. Clutter, including aprons on shelving units, must be removed.

headline: Cardboard freezer liner; torn gaskets
summary: Cardboard was used as a liner in the reach-in freezer and must be replaced with a smooth, cleanable material. Torn gaskets on the prep cooler must be repaired. A wet mop was stored in a bucket and must be hung to dry.

headline: Unlabeled salt and sugar; soiled mop heads
summary: Salt and sugar stored outside original containers were not labeled. An ice scoop was left lying on machines in the bar and basement and must be stored handle up. Soiled mop heads must be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Clutter in upper-floor storage; re-inspection passed
summary: Clutter was found in the upper-floor storage area. The manager was instructed to declutter and remove unnecessary items. The complaint re-inspection passed.

headline: Re-inspection: fryers need grease removal
summary: The exterior and bottom of the fryers must be cleaned to remove grease. The re-inspection passed.

headline: No allergen certificate; sink signage missing
summary: A certified food service manager had no allergen awareness training certificate on site. A paper towel dispenser above the bar 3-compartment sink must be removed, and handwashing signs are missing at the bar and front prep sinks.

headline: No certified manager; sanitizer test kit missing
summary: No certified food service manager was on the premises. The facility lacked a quat sanitizer test kit and a temperature indicator for dishes, and a citation was issued for the test kit. Single-use items sit on the basement floor.

headline: No certified manager while food prepared
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager was on the premises while sandwiches, soup and wraps were prepared and served; a citation was issued. The dish-area handwashing sink drains slowly.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; hotel door gaps
summary: The low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm, which must be at least 50 ppm. Women's customer restroom hot water is 87-90F, not 100F. Gaps at hotel entry doors, open garbage lids and food-allergen training gaps were noted.

headline: Beard in prep area; grease and foil under stove
summary: An employee with a beard was in the prep area and must wear a beard restraint. Aluminum foil under the four-burner stove must be removed. Oven spillage and dirty floor drain water need cleaning. A broken wall and missing tile near the mop sink must be repaired.

headline: Over 25 mouse droppings; citation issued
summary: Over 25 mouse droppings were on the floor by the rear prep and dry storage area; a citation was issued. Floors must be detail cleaned, pest control must treat the premises, and holes must be sealed. A sink splashguard is missing.

headline: No health policy; hot water too cool
summary: No employee health policy, no vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure, and no metal stem thermometer were on site. Hot water measured 68.5F at the 3-compartment sink and 71.4F at the handwashing sink, below required levels.

headline: Missing sushi rice records; door not rodent-proof
summary: No sushi rice letter on site, a required record. The rear exit door had a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom that must be sealed. Unused equipment in storage was ordered removed.

headline: Re-inspection: signs missing; dirty floors and ceilings
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at 20th-floor sinks and restroom sinks. A brownish substance in the ice machine was cleaned on instruction. Floors and ceilings in food areas have dirt and debris, and wiping cloths were stored on a cutting board.

headline: No health policy; drains and storage need cleaning
summary: No written employee health policy was on the premises. Floor drains, the microwave and prep cooler interiors need detail cleaning. Clutter in the mop sink room must be cleared, and no food handler certificates were provided.

headline: Small flies; untagged vacuum packing
summary: About 25 small flies were seen near the basement dish machine, 3-compartment sink and bar; a citation was issued. Vacuum packing without a required variance was halted. About 80 pounds of product was discarded. Shellfish tags lack sale dates.

headline: No employee health policy on premises
summary: No employee health policy was on the premises. The person in charge must provide documentation that employees must report illnesses that can spread through food. Food handlers must obtain required food handler training.

headline: Re-inspection: duct tape, cardboard, and leaks
summary: Duct tape was used for repairs on sushi cooler doors and counters, and cardboard shelf liners must be removed. A tall reach-in cooler has dirty shelving. A leak is under the 3-compartment sink, and ceiling tiles are water damaged.

headline: Damaged wall tiles and peeling paint
summary: Damaged and missing wall tiles under the 3-compartment sink in the rear prep area must be repaired. Peeling paint on the rear dishwashing wall must be repainted.

headline: Dusty vent and dirty cooler shelf
summary: The bottom shelf inside the employee cafe prep cooler needs cleaning. Dust must be removed from the air vent above the prep table. The certified manager on duty has allergen training, which must be maintained.

headline: Mouse droppings and dead mouse; pest service needed
summary: Re-inspection found about 75 or more mouse droppings in the prep, dry storage and basement areas, plus a dead mouse. The prior priority violation was not corrected. The premises must be cleaned and a pest control operator must service them; a citation was issued.

headline: Re-inspection: torn gaskets; sagging ceiling tiles
summary: Torn door gaskets on the 2-door prep cooler next to the ice machine must be replaced. Coolers, freezers, the dish machine and other food prep areas need cleaning. Sagging ceiling tiles in the food prep area must be cleaned or replaced.

headline: Re-inspection: some managers lack allergen certificates
summary: Some certified food managers do not have food allergen training certificates. All certified managers must have them.

headline: Broken hot water knob; dirty floors
summary: The hot water knob on the rear handwashing sink needs repair. Dirt and debris are built up under equipment, shelving and counters. Those areas must be cleaned to prevent pests.

headline: No thermometers in basement refrigerators
summary: No air thermometers were inside the basement refrigerators, and the operator must provide easily readable ones. Food debris and spills were found on cooking equipment, holding units and shelving.

headline: Front door not rodent-proof; leaking faucet
summary: The front door is not rodent-proofed. Bulk containers in rear storage need labels, and wiping cloths must be stored in cleaning solution. The 3-compartment faucet leaks, and floors and cooking equipment need detail cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; untrained cooks; leaks
summary: No certified food manager or qualified person in charge was on site; the manager arrived at 10:52 AM, and a citation was issued. Restrooms lacked hand drying supplies at the start. Openings near the furnace pipe, leaking sinks and a sinking ceiling were found.

headline: No certificate posted; no hot water at sink
summary: No valid food sanitation certificate was posted, and a citation was issued. The washroom handwashing sink had no hot water, and a citation was issued. No handwashing sink is in the dish area, and a food handler lacked training.

headline: No certified manager while TCS food prepared
summary: No person in charge was present at inspection. A certified manager with the original certificate was not present while TCS foods such as soups and pork were prepared and served; a citation was issued. Employees drank in the bar area.

headline: 100+ mouse droppings; pest service required
summary: Rodent activity was found, with 100 or more mouse droppings in cooking, sink, washroom and service areas. The facility must clean and have a pest control company service before re-inspection; a citation was issued. Wall holes need sealing.

headline: No hot water at restroom sinks; no pest log
summary: Both restroom handwashing sinks had no running hot water, measuring 85.8F; hot water must reach 100F, a priority violation. No pest control logbook from a licensed Illinois pest control company was on premises.

headline: Re-inspection: leaking faucet; no food training
summary: The 3-compartment sink faucet is leaking, and light switch covers are missing. No food handler training was available on site. A food manager's allergen training was not provided, a repeat violation that was cited.

headline: Re-inspection: soap added, utensils to invert
summary: No soap was at the front prep handwashing sink, but soap was provided before the inspection ended. Utensils were not stored inverted, a sink stopper was missing, and the ice machine backflow device could not be found.

headline: Missing health policy and pest logs; ice slime
summary: No written employee health policy, vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure, or pest control log was on site. Black and pink slime was found in the ice machine reservoir and chute, and a citation was issued. The bar has no handwashing-only sink.

headline: Grease in fryer; expired allergen certificates
summary: Grease was found at the bottom of the fryer, and the fryer and stove exteriors need cleaning. The floor under cooking equipment needs cleaning. Expired allergen training certificates were noted for city food managers.

headline: Cold TCS foods at 45-55F; about 20 lbs lost
summary: Beans, rice, pork chorizo and beef were held at 45.6-55.4F in the prep cooler. Management discarded about 20 pounds worth $150, and a citation was issued. Missing handwashing signage, a torn cooler gasket and no self-closing door were also noted.

headline: Re-inspection: uncovered fryer; hood not working
summary: The deep fryer, filled with oil, was left uncovered while not in use. The floors behind cooking equipment and under the grease trap were not clean. The ventilation hood was not working, and food handler and allergen training were not on site.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; dim basement cooler
summary: Bulk sugar and salt containers were not labeled. The basement walk-in cooler cooling line lacks insulation, and the operator was instructed to install it to prevent condensation. The basement walk-in cooler has inadequate lighting.

headline: Re-inspection: stoppers and ceiling tiles
summary: The 3-compartment sink stoppers are not working and must be repaired or provided. Missing ceiling tiles above the mop sink must be replaced.

headline: Re-inspection: labeling, storage and cleaning needed
summary: An insect zapper hanging over the rear prep area must be replaced with a proper fly light. Containers and repackaged desserts need labels, and food must be off the floor. Grease and debris need cleaning, and managers lack allergen training.

headline: Sausage curing without required variance
summary: In-house sausage made with the curing agent sodium nitrite had no required variance. Production was stopped and 15 pounds of pork sausage were tagged for condemnation. A mop bucket sat near clean pans, and live plants were in the prep area.

headline: Re-inspection: rusted racks in cooler
summary: Rusted storage racks in the walk-in cooler and on the grease trap top must be refinished or replaced so surfaces are smooth and cleanable. The re-inspection passed.

headline: Hole in wall coving in dish area
summary: A hole was found in the wall coving in the dishwashing area. The operator was instructed to seal the hole and maintain it.

headline: Leaks at sinks; slow-draining handsink
summary: The soap dispenser cover in the employee break area is damaged. Ice buildup and loose food pieces are on a freezer shelf. A 1-compartment prep sink and a break-area handsink leak, and a handsink next to the dish machine drains slowly.

headline: Hot and cold foods held at unsafe temperatures
summary: Pizza slices were at 125F in the hot unit, and chicken, pork, sausage, cheese and sour cream were 44-55F in the prep cooler. Hot food must stay above 135F and cold food at 41F or below. Citation issued.

headline: Leak under dump sink in main bar
summary: A pipe under the dump sink in the main bar is leaking. The operator was instructed to repair it and maintain it.

headline: Hood grease buildup; restroom door not self-closing
summary: Grease had built up on the ventilation hood, which must be cleaned. The restroom door does not self-close, and a plastic floor base is missing under the prep handwashing sink. No allergen certificate was on premises.

headline: Brownish residue in soda gun holders
summary: A minor brownish substance was found inside the soda gun holders. Staff were instructed to clean and sanitize them. No other issues were noted.

headline: Rusty grease trap; dirty floor drains
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer when not in use. The grease trap under the 3-compartment sink is rusty and chipped. Floor drains and floors under sinks and equipment have buildup of food and dirt.

headline: Beef at 47F; dumpster lid won't close
summary: Beef was held at 47F; the manager discarded 10 pounds worth $55, and a priority citation was issued. The outside dumpster would not close fully and was overfilled. Lids must be tight-fitting at all times.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; rust; dim lighting
summary: A torn door gasket on the 6-door prep cooler and rust on a storage rack both need repair. The basement walk-in cooler has dim lighting. Basement storage needs cleaning to prevent pest harborage, and a manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Stained cutting board; no self-closing door
summary: A heavily stained, scored cutting board must be resurfaced or replaced. The employee restroom door has no self-closing device. Walls and corners need sealing, and broken floor tiles near the grease trap must be replaced.

headline: Dusty fan; toilet tank cover; missing trash lid
summary: Dust on the floor fan needs cleaning. The toilet tank cover is in poor repair, and the employee restroom trash receptacle is missing its cover. Repairs were ordered.

headline: Several sinks leaking; dumpster lid missing
summary: The produce prep hand sink leaks heavily, and the 3-compartment sink backflow device sprays water. Another sink drains slowly, and one of three dumpster lids is missing. Dry storage and the walk-in freezer have heavy debris, and several lights are out.

headline: Dirty ice machine and cooking equipment
summary: The ice machine interior needs cleaning to remove buildup. The large can opener, cooking equipment and storage shelves need cleaning. Standing water and broken tiles around the 3-compartment sink must be corrected.

headline: Meat too warm; one live cockroach found
summary: Steak at 56F and pork at 57F were held in the rear refrigerator, which ran at 58F. About 15 pounds of food worth $100 was discarded. One live cockroach was trapped on a glue board at the bar and must be removed.

headline: Re-inspection: dead bugs in sink; door gap
summary: Dead bugs were found in the three-compartment sink basins and must be removed and sanitized before use. An opening at the bottom of the rear exit door must be rodent-proofed. The deep fryer was left uncovered while not in use.

headline: Backflow device not located; low water pressure
summary: The backflow prevention device on the coffee machine could not be located and must be installed where it can be serviced. Cold water pressure is low at the handwashing sink near the high-temperature dish machine. The women's restroom needs a covered receptacle.

headline: Food on floor; no backflow device; ceiling holes
summary: Food items were stored on the floor in rear dry storage and must be raised six inches. The utility sink has no backflow prevention device. Multiple holes in the front ceiling panels must be repaired.

headline: Cooler at 50F; sliced tomatoes too warm
summary: Sliced tomatoes were at 48F, and 2 pounds were discarded. The cold-holding cooler ran at 50F and cannot be used until re-inspected by CDPH; a citation was issued. Cooler interiors and fryers need cleaning.

headline: Torn cooler gasket and dusty restroom vents
summary: Inspector saw a torn rubber gasket inside the salad-prep cooler and dust buildup on restroom vents. The operator was told to repair the gasket and clean the vents.

headline: Blocked hand sink; no food thermometer
summary: The front prep hand sink was blocked by portion cups and tortillas, and the person in charge removed them. No food thermometer was available on site, and a citation was issued. Wiping cloths and an ice scoop were stored improperly.

headline: No city certificate; sink backs up
summary: No valid City of Chicago food service sanitation certificate was available for the person in charge; a citation was issued. Water backs up from the first to the second basin of the 3-compartment sink and must be repaired before re-inspection.

headline: Re-inspection: debris outside, clutter on freezer
summary: Debris on the ground by the dumpster area must be removed. A broken baseboard beside the grease box must be replaced. Clutter on top of the walk-in freezer must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Boxes and clutter in washrooms
summary: Excess boxes and clutter on the washroom floor must be removed. The side stockroom floor next to the washroom needs cleaning.

headline: Live dog inside; citation issued
summary: A customer brought a live dog inside, and management did not address it during the inspection. Live animals are not allowed, and a citation was issued. Stained cutting boards and cluttered basement storage also need fixing.

headline: Sink stoppers missing; wastewater backing up
summary: Wastewater backed up from a drain under heating equipment onto the prep floor; the building plumber corrected it, and a citation was issued. Three-compartment sink stoppers are missing, and rust and grime are present.

headline: Plates not inverted; torn freezer gasket
summary: Serving plates on kitchen prep shelves were not stored inverted, which allows dust to build up. The upright freezer in the kitchen prep area has a torn rubber door gasket that must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Re-inspection: no food handler training on site
summary: No food handler training was on site for food handlers. The operator must provide it for all food handlers.

headline: Milk-crate shelving; repeat leaking sinks
summary: Milk crates used as dry-storage shelving must be replaced with shelving at least six inches off the floor. Damaged wall tiles near sinks need repair. Repeat core violations: the 3-compartment sink leaks from two basins and a bar faucet sprays; a citation was issued.

headline: Cluttered yard, dirty floors, missing allergen proof
summary: Crates were piled in an enclosed outdoor area, which must be cleared to prevent pest harborage. Toilet room, deli prep and stockroom floors and walls need deep cleaning. Managers lacked proof of allergen training.

headline: Re-inspection: burnt bulbs; untrained employee
summary: Three hood bulbs over the cook line are burnt out. One employee lacks food handler training, which must be completed. The unisex employee restroom has no covered trash receptacle, and the operator was instructed to provide one.

headline: No health policy; walk-in cooler too warm
summary: No employee health policy or training was on site. The walk-in cooler ran at 44-50F and must be repaired to 41F or below. A backflow device was missing, and a screen door had broken mesh.

headline: Wiping cloths on tables; slow sink; peeling paint
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables instead of in sanitizer, and utensils were stored in a chips container. A basement handwashing sink drains slowly. Peeling paint and openings above the 3-compartment sink must be repaired and sealed.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; dirty mops and dust
summary: Bulk containers were unlabeled, and a food handler lacked a hair restraint. Soiled mop heads were stored on the floor and must be hung to dry to prevent insect breeding. Debris, dust and ceiling vents need cleaning.

headline: Cold food too warm; over 15 flies found
summary: Food held at 47F; the manager discarded 5 pounds of beef and cherry tomatoes. More than 15 small flies were found in the bar, kitchen and employee storage, and a citation was issued. Floors need cleaning.

headline: Hot and cold foods out of temperature
summary: Cooked chicken at 108.9F and sauces at 117-123F were in the hot-holding unit, below the required 135F. Cold cooked spaghetti was at 51.9F. Yogurt drinks lacked allergen labels, and no inspection summary was posted. Citations issued.

headline: Chicken and rice at 49F; refrigerator at 50F
summary: Cooked chicken and rice were held at 49F, and the person in charge discarded 10 pounds of food. The rear prep refrigerator ran at 50F, was repaired on site to 41F, and a citation was issued. Debris and trash were on the floor under tables.

headline: Foil shelf lining; stained ceiling tiles
summary: Foil was used to line shelves, and cardboard boxes must be removed to prevent pest hiding places. Stained ceiling tiles in the kitchen prep and dining areas need cleaning and repair. Dusty ceiling vents in the dining area need cleaning.

headline: Food on walk-in freezer floor; repairs needed
summary: Food items stored on floor in walk-in freezer; must be elevated six inches. Openings, cracks, and chipping paint along walls; floor tiles need grouting. Floors and floor drains in prep area need cleaning.

headline: Wiping cloths not in sanitizer; worn gaskets
summary: Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. Worn door gaskets on 2-door drink prep cooler must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Missing food labels in front display cooler
summary: Ready-to-eat food inside front display cooler lacked labels; labels must be provided and maintained.

headline: No manager certificate; walk-in cooler at 54.3F
summary: No valid food service manager certificate or allergen training certificate on site. Walk-in cooler air measured 54.3F; cold foods must stay at 41F or lower. Also: no sanitizer test strips, hot water reached 104F at three-compartment sink, dirty surfaces.

headline: Debris in unused steam table and cooler
summary: Food debris and dust built up inside and outside an unused steam table and inside an unused pizza cooler. Must clean. One allergen training certificate expired and one missing for certified food managers.

headline: Gap at rear door; food on freezer floor
summary: Rear exit door by walk-in cooler had a 1/4-inch gap around its perimeter; must be repaired with proper materials. Food stored on freezer floor; elevate six inches. Storage room by ice machine is cluttered; remove unnecessary items.

headline: Food handlers without hair restraints
summary: Food handlers were observed in the prep area without hair restraints. Manager instructed that all food handlers must wear effective hair restraints.

headline: Undated ready-to-eat chicken; product discarded
summary: Ready-to-eat chicken lacked date marking. Manager immediately and voluntarily disposed of 20 lbs worth $150 of product; no citation. Cutting boards stained and open-seamed. Grease in hood. Excess ice and debris in chest freezer.

headline: Dirty floors and peeling wall paint
summary: Floors throughout need detail cleaning to remove debris and buildup. Walls in various areas need scraping and painting to remove peeling paint. Instructed to correct and maintain.

headline: Dead roaches near traps; missing thermometers
summary: About 10 dead cockroaches on the floor around pest traps in rear storage; must be removed and the area cleaned. Several cold-holding units lacked thermometers. Single-use items stored in restroom; sink lacked distinct rinse; loose handwash sink.

headline: Yogurt made without approved plan or variance
summary: Yogurt made on-site without required HACCP plan (a food safety plan) or variance; must use commercial yogurt until approved. About 10 lbs ($40) discarded; citation issued. Also: missing splashguard, stained cutting boards, cardboard shelf liners.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; general cleaning
summary: No handwashing sign at one hand sink; corrected on site. Instructed to clean can opener blade, prep table bottoms, freezer interior, fryers, and walls and floors under equipment. Food handlers and managers must obtain allergen training.

headline: No handwashing sign; dishmachine exterior dirty
summary: Hand sink at meat preparation areas lacked handwashing signage; must be provided. Exterior of dishmachine is not clean; must be cleaned.

headline: Unsafe handling, warm food, no certified manager on duty
summary: No certified manager on duty until 11:15 a.m.; citation issued. Food handlers wiped boards with soiled cloths, then handled bread, bacon and eggs with the same gloves. Sanitizer measured 0 ppm. Ready-to-eat foods held at 49.5-70.3F discarded.

headline: Ineffective hairnets; heavy food debris in prep areas
summary: Employees in meat and deli prep wore ineffective hairnets. Tables and equipment in bakery, prepared foods and basement need cleaning. Floors and walls in many areas need cleaning. Ventilation hoods have grease and dust.

headline: Food containers on floor; expired training
summary: Food containers stored on floor under shelves and prep tables must be elevated. Worn cooler gasket and tape must be removed. Food debris in wok drip tray and coolers; damaged floor tiles. Expired food handler and allergen training for employees and managers.

headline: No certified manager; half-inch door gap
summary: No certified food manager (CFM) on site while TCS foods (foods that must be kept hot or cold), including almond milk and smoothies, were handled; priority citation. Half-inch gap at front door bottom. A food handler lacked hair restraint.

headline: Restroom sink too cold; no summary posted
summary: Restroom handsink maximum water temperature was 70.6F; must provide 100-120F water. Priority violation; citation issued. No inspection summary posted for public view; new summary left, and citation issued.

headline: No certified manager on site during food prep
summary: No certified manager on site while chicken was prepared; citation issued. Both rear-kitchen cooks lacked food handler training. No allergen training certificates on site. Cutting boards were grooved and stained.

headline: No certified manager; mussels uncovered for self-serve
summary: No certified food manager was on site while lamb and kimchi were prepared and served; citation issued. Uncovered ready-to-eat mussels for self-serve had no utensil; employee provided one during inspection. Food handler and allergen certificates were missing or expired.

headline: No allergen training proof for managers
summary: No proof of allergen training for food service sanitation managers. Accumulated debris under dry storage shelves; instructed to clean and sanitize.

headline: Cooler thermometers missing; uncovered lard
summary: Both reach-in hot dog coolers in main prep line lacked internal air thermometers. Uncovered lard container near deep fryers exposed to splash; instructed to relocate or cover. Clean linens stored on floor; must be 6 inches up.

headline: No proof of food handler training
summary: Food handlers on site had no proof they met food handler requirements; must obtain and keep current proof. Dirt and debris on lower cabinet surfaces under the handwashing sink and beverage station; instructed to clean.

headline: Food prep area floor needs cleaning
summary: Floor of the food prep area must be cleaned. This was the only violation noted.

headline: Failed: about 40 mouse droppings found
summary: About 40 or more mouse droppings found on floors and shelving, including near the sales-floor ice freezer. Areas must be cleaned and sanitized; pest control service recommended. Also: no dumpster contract, broken freezer handle, crates used for storage.

headline: Rodent droppings; no manager; no health policy
summary: About 50 mouse droppings on rear storage room floor; additional pest control needed. No certified food manager on site; citation issued. No employee health policy, vomit cleanup procedure, or food handler certificates on premises.

headline: Heavy freezer ice; clutter in liquor room
summary: Several basement freezer chests have heavy ice build-up; manager instructed to defrost. Light grease on outside grease receptacle. Clutter and boxes on floor in basement liquor room. Certified food manager lacks allergen training; instructed to comply.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; leaking sink faucet
summary: Rubber door gaskets on prep-area reach-in coolers under the grill are ripped and must be repaired or replaced. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks at its base and must be repaired.

headline: 25 live flies in bar area
summary: About 25 live flies scattered on walls under the bar counter; must remove and detail clean area; call pest control. Priority citation issued. Also: standing water and leaking pipe under dishwashing machine; floors need cleaning.

headline: Uncorrected dishmachine gauge; priority citation
summary: Previous priority violation from 4/13/26 report not corrected: inoperable temperature gauge on warewashing (dishwashing) machine; citation issued. Also: allergen training missing for posted managers; toilet room trash receptacles lack covers.

headline: Flies and black slime in ice machine
summary: About 25 small flies in prep, waiting, and upstairs seating areas; citation issued. Black slime in prep-area ice machine dripping onto stored ice; cleaning required. No vomit/diarrhea cleanup procedure; no food handler training proof.

headline: No certified manager; no backflow device
summary: No certified food manager (CFM) was on site while pork and chicken were handled; citation issued. Ice machine water line lacks a backflow prevention device. Sanitation manager has no allergen training.

headline: Plastic jugs used as utensils; discontinued
summary: Plastic jugs with narrow openings were used as multi-use utensils; instructed to discontinue.

headline: No CFM certificate; no outside dumpster
summary: No Chicago certified food manager (CFM) certificate on site; instructed to obtain it or proof of enrollment; no citation. No outside dumpster or dumpster contract; must obtain and maintain one; no citation.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat tacos
summary: Food handler added toppings to tacos with bare hands; instructed to wash hands and use gloves. Priority violation. Bricks hold up shelving in reach-in cooler. Customer washroom garbage can lacks lid; vent heavily dusty. Cook lacks food handler training.

headline: Handsink blocked; lunchmeat held at 50.1F
summary: Rear prep handsink was blocked by utensils and a container; citation issued. Lunchmeat held at 50.1F; 15 lbs ($150) discarded; citation issued. Milk crates used as shelving. Plumber repaired water backing up at three-compartment sink during inspection.

headline: Mouse droppings, cooler at 67.8F, no cleanup kit
summary: Mouse droppings found in washroom, bottom of hot water tank, and inside fryer; priority violation. Two-door refrigeration unit at 67.8F; must be 41F or below. No employee health policy and no vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit on site.

headline: Female food handlers lacked hair restraints
summary: Female food handlers were observed without proper hair restraints; instructed to provide them at all times. No covered receptacle inside the toilet room; instructed to provide one.

headline: Peeling paint in deli cooler; ice build-up
summary: Peeling paint inside front deli cooler must be scraped and removed; area kept smooth and cleanable. Ice build-up on shelves and floor in walk-in freezer; manager instructed to keep area clear.

headline: No sink for liquid waste disposal
summary: No sink was used for dumping liquid waste at the front beverage prep area. Manager instructed to install at least one compartment sink for water and liquid waste disposal.

headline: Food on floors; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Food stored on floor inside walk-in cooler and freezer; must be elevated six inches. Milk crates used as shelving. No waste receptacle at basement prep handsink. Missing handwashing sign at second-floor pantry sink. Manager instructed to correct each.

headline: Chicken held too warm; blocked handsink
summary: About 20 lbs chicken at 56.2-62.6F discarded (about $30); cold foods must stay at 41F or below; citation issued. Handsink blocked by wiping cloth; citation issued. Food pot stored on walk-in floor.

headline: Missing handwashing sign and waste can lid
summary: Handwashing signage must be posted in employee restroom. Waste can with lid needed in unisex employee restroom for feminine hygiene products.

headline: Missing vomit kit and bar handwashing sink
summary: No vomit/diarrhea cleanup items on premises; priority violation. No exposed handwashing sink in bar. Openings at entrance and rear doors. No backflow device at utility sink, no grease trap. Doors not self-closing; no covered receptacles.

headline: Soil buildup on floor behind equipment
summary: Soil buildup observed on the floor behind equipment. Manager instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Rusty walk-in shelves; allergen proof missing
summary: Rusty shelving holds chicken and other cold-held foods in walk-in; must repaint or replace. Previous violations not corrected, including damaged baseboard and no allergen training proof; citation issued. Also: slow hand sink, cracked floors.

headline: Salad prep foods too warm; cooler unplugged
summary: Pasta, chickpeas, sliced tomatoes, and blue cheese held at 60-64F in salad prep cooler; about 20 lbs ($100) discarded. Cooler was not plugged in; it was turned on and reached proper temperature during inspection. Citation issued.

headline: Food debris and litter on floors
summary: Food debris and litter found on the floor behind cold-hold units in the front dining area and in the rear dry storage area. Person in charge instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: No handwashing sign at front sink
summary: Exposed handwashing sink in front prep area lacked signage; instructed to provide.

headline: Rodent droppings; unsafe food temperatures; dishmachine tagged
summary: About 20 mouse and 15 rat droppings found in basement areas; pest control needed. Display cooler food at 46.6-48.6F: 29 lbs ($550) discarded. Dishmachine at bar sanitizing at 0 ppm; tagged out of use. Prep cooler at 48.9F also tagged.

headline: Damaged floor tiles and dirty floor drain
summary: Damaged or missing floor tiles in north kitchen must be replaced. Dirty floor drain and screened cover under hand sink must be cleaned. Items in rear storage must be elevated off floor.

headline: Slow sink drain; grime near dock toilet
summary: Slow-draining sink in cooking room must be repaired. Grime buildup on toilet fixture in dock area and substance accumulation on wall behind toilet. Dust on dock bathroom vent. Instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Encrusted grease in fryers and floors
summary: Clean encrusted grease inside deep fryers and encrusted food debris and grease on cook line floor under prep coolers and steam table. Missing floor grout under three-compartment sink and near fryer; management instructed to regrout.

headline: No running water, refrigeration, or sinks on site
summary: No exposed handwashing sinks, no running hot or cold water, no mechanical refrigeration, no three-compartment sink, and no grease trap were observed. Priority violations; no citations issued. Coolers must be kept at 41F or below.

headline: Manager lacked original city certificate on site
summary: Manager lacked the original City certificate while chicken, beef and salad were served; citation issued. Food boxes stored on floor, water-stained ceiling tiles, greasy floors, and holes in kitchen floor noted.

headline: Prep freezer frost; greasy hood filters
summary: Reach-in freezer in rear prep area must be cleaned and defrosted. Filters above cooking equipment must be cleaned to remove debris and grease.

headline: No norovirus spill kit; no backflow device
summary: No vomit and diarrhea spill kit with norovirus-effective spray on premises; instructed to provide; priority violation, no citation. No backflow device on utility sink faucet. Washroom door not self-closing. Unused equipment in rear storage.

headline: No certified manager; dishmachine at 0 ppm
summary: No certified manager on premises while milk and eggs were handled; citation issued. Low-temperature dishmachine showed 0 ppm chlorine; tagged and not to be used until repaired. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Person in charge has no manager certificate.

headline: Live roaches; unsafe cold-holding temperatures; no manager
summary: Food items including ham, pork, turkey, chicken, and eggs were held at 45.3-70.1F; about 20 lbs ($400) discarded; citation issued. Three live roaches crawled on shelves in dishwashing area; pest control recommended. No certified manager present.

headline: Dead roaches in cabinets under steam tables
summary: Dead roaches and debris found in cabinets under steam tables; must be removed and detail cleaned. Floors and walls throughout need cleaning, especially in pop syrup storage. Women's restroom ventilation not working; hood and filter need cleaning.

headline: Food handlers lacked hair restraints
summary: Food handlers were prepping food without hair restraints; instructed that all must wear one. A leaking faucet at the three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Cool handwash water; salmon held at 51.4F
summary: Handwashing sinks read 95-95.7F; repaired on site to over 100F. Salmon held at 51.4F; 7 lbs ($167) discarded; citation issued. Also: damaged dishmachine data plate, ice build-up in two walk-in freezers, food debris in produce hallway.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No certified food service manager on site or certificate posted while chicken and beef were handled; instructed to obtain one. Priority violation.

headline: Eggs held at 50.5F; discarded
summary: Eggs held at 50.5F; cold-held foods must be kept at 41F or below. Manager discarded about 10 lbs ($22). Also: chocolate spills in refrigerator, dirty floors under shelf and three-compartment sink. Priority citation issued.

headline: Failed: no customer barrier; restroom door
summary: No barriers found between customers and employees at the front of the premises, a priority violation; no citation issued. Restroom door was not self-closing. Both items must be corrected.

headline: Food debris on hot line shelving; slow drain
summary: Shelving under hot-line grills and prep tables has food debris; must clean and sanitize. Slow-draining handsink in front prep area must be repaired. Floors under equipment, dish area and walk-in corners need cleaning. Person in charge (PIC) lacks allergen training.

headline: Sewage backing up on front prep floor drain
summary: Waste water backed up from the front prep floor drain when hand and prep sinks ran. Manager immediately called a plumber; priority citation issued. Also: food containers on floors, ice build-up in walk-in freezer, leaking pipe under three-compartment sink.

headline: Missing hair restraint; missing training proof
summary: A cook prepared food without an effective hair restraint. No proof of food handler or allergen training was shown. Also noted: unlabeled bulk foods, dirty cooler interiors, ice machine cleaning, torn door gaskets, rust, and items stored on floors.

headline: Inspection summary not posted; citation issued
summary: Summary report from October 2021 was not posted for public view; instructed to post the recent summary at all times. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: No certified manager on duty; citation issued
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while sandwiches and pastries were prepared and served; citation issued. Single-use items stored on prep-area floor must be elevated. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Cutting boards stained; no allergen proof
summary: Cutting boards in rear prep area had open seams and dark stains; must be refinished or replaced. Certified food manager had no proof of allergen training; instructed to obtain certificate.

headline: No certified manager; several citations issued
summary: No person in charge had a City food manager certificate; citation issued. Bulk flour and sugar containers were uncovered and unlabeled. No employee health policy on premises. Standing water, damaged walls and dirty vents were noted.

headline: No allergen training for sanitation manager
summary: Complaint type: suspected food poisoning. No allergen training was found for the sanitation manager; must be provided.

headline: Certified manager lacked allergen training proof
summary: Certified food manager had no proof of allergen training; all City certified managers must provide proof.

headline: Broken floor tile and missing ceiling panels
summary: Broken black floor tile by dining-area window around a floor vent must be repaired. Missing parts of two ceiling panels above main entrance; must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Clutter in rear storage area
summary: Clutter observed in rear storage area. Manager instructed to remove unnecessary items or organize the area.

headline: Crumbling concrete in basement mechanical room
summary: Concrete in basement mechanical room and storage area is crumbling with holes; instructed to repair and maintain.

headline: Open anchovies corrected on site
summary: Open can of anchovies in walk-in cooler was corrected on site by moving it to a labeled container. A fly strip over the three-compartment sink was moved on site. Vents above fryers need cleaning.

headline: Warm cold-held foods; 23 lbs discarded
summary: Sliced tomatoes, deli meats, chicken, cheese and dressings held at 58.4-72.6F; about 23 lbs ($300) discarded; citation issued. Two rear coolers at 69.2F and 72.5F were reset to 39.4-40.4F during inspection. Leaking prep sink; broken floor tile.

headline: Live flies; no certified manager; food too cool
summary: About 15 or more live small flies in dishwashing and mop sink areas; pest control recommended. No certified manager on duty while food was served; citation issued. Hot-held food was below 135F (69.1-130.8F); about 15 lbs ($90) discarded.

headline: Improper thawing; no hair restraints
summary: Frozen chicken and dogs sat in sink water; frozen Italian beef sat out. Manager instructed on approved thawing. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. One employee had no food handler certificate. Hood and floors need cleaning.

headline: Walk-in storage racks with debris, mold, rust
summary: Storage racks in walk-in cooler had food debris, mold, and rust; surfaces must be smooth and easy to clean. Instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Failed: gaps at doors, open dumpster, expired training
summary: Rear screen doors had 1/4-inch gaps. Dumpster area lacked lids; a priority citation was issued. Allergen training certificates were expired. Other issues: unlabeled dry food, rusty shelves, grease under grill and fryer, items on floor.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No certified food manager on site while deli meat was handled; instructed to obtain one. Priority violation.

headline: Entrance door gap; leaking drain under sink
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the entrance door needs a tight seal to keep pests out. Drainpipe leaked under the rear handwashing sink, which also drains slowly. Employee toilet room lacks a covered receptacle.

headline: Unsafe hot and cold holding temperatures
summary: Chicken wings at 108.1F left at room temperature by grill; about 13 lbs ($89) discarded. Pork ribs at 63.5-68.0F in cold unit; about 20 lbs ($195) discarded. Cooked foods lacked date marks. No food handler certificates; sink not draining.

headline: Hand rinsing, blocked handsink, warm cold-held food
summary: Food handler rinsed hands in the three-compartment sink; citation issued. A handwashing sink was blocked by a prep table. Sliced tomatoes, lettuce and cheese held above 41F; about 35 lbs ($130) discarded, citation issued. Raw chicken thawed at room temperature.

headline: Restroom out of service; water shut off
summary: One of five single-service toilet rooms was not operating; water had been shut off to it. Manager instructed to restore the toilet room.

headline: Undated food held over 24 hours; citation
summary: Ready-to-eat deli meat, fish, chicken and other foods held over 24 hours lacked date marks; citation issued. Expired food handler certificates for all employees. Gap at rear door and containers stored on floors.

headline: Missing cold-holding thermometers and handwashing signs
summary: Missing handwashing signage at an exposed sink. No thermometers in cold-holding equipment in front prep. Single-service items stored on floor. Unfinished wood shelves, cluttered basement, holes in walls. Person in charge instructed to correct each.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets at doughnut counter
summary: Torn rubber gaskets on the service cooler door at the doughnut counter and on the dairy walk-in cooler; instructed to repair or replace.

headline: Packaged food at register lacked labels
summary: Packaged food at register lacked required labels; labels must show food name, business name and address, net quantity, and ingredients. Cutting board has stains and deep grooves; must be cleaned.

headline: No backflow device on ice machine line
summary: No backflow prevention device at ice machine water line; must provide and make visible. Cracked ceiling light cover above three-compartment sink must be replaced.

headline: Food on floors, milk crates, unlabeled containers
summary: Food stored on basement and sales-floor floors; must be raised six inches. Oil, garlic, and spices lacked labels. Milk crates used as shelving throughout. Stained cutting boards and heavy grime in meat cooler tracks.

headline: Uncorrected core violations; ceiling openings
summary: Front door had a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom; repair required. Sandwich-line cutting boards are deeply grooved. Ceiling openings in several areas. Prior core violations not corrected: toilet room receptacle and broken wall tiles; citation issued.

headline: Dust, grease, and dirt buildup throughout
summary: Light dust and grease on cooking and non-cooking equipment. Dirt and small debris in wall and floor corners of the front food area and dish area. Heavy dust on the front entrance vent. Manager instructed to clean all.

headline: Missing sanitizer test kit; corrected on site
summary: No test kit to measure quaternary ammonium sanitizer; kit was delivered during inspection and corrected on site; citation issued. Food debris on floor under cold-holding equipment. Two managers had expired or no allergen training proof.

headline: Damaged shelving and dirty floor by drain
summary: Black shelving under hot-hold units has damaged surfaces that must be repaired to be smooth and cleanable. Build-up on the floor around the three-compartment sink drain. Person in charge instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Failed: boxed food on floor; slow drains
summary: Boxed food was stored on the floor in basement and first floor. Hand sinks drained slowly and dripped. Previous core violations were not corrected, including unlabeled containers, wiping cloths, and worn gaskets; citation issued.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; dirty ice machine guard
summary: Multiple food items stored on floor in rear walk-in cooler; must be elevated six inches. Dirty floor drains under sinks. One certified food manager lacked allergen training certificate on site. Torn gasket on 3-door reach-in cooler.

headline: Unlabeled bakery containers; slow hand sink
summary: Bulk containers in the bakery area were unlabeled and must show the product name. Fryers, cooking equipment, prep tables and walk-in shelves need cleaning. A slow-draining hand sink in the bakery serving area must be corrected.

headline: Mushrooms thawing on counter; dirty cloths
summary: Frozen mushrooms were thawing on a prep table; approved thawing methods were discussed. Dirty wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer, and serving plates were not inverted. Low water pressure and a leaking pipe at a rear hand sink. Managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Dirty soda machine and floors; insect risk
summary: Soda dispenser had dirt and spillage underneath and on its front. Floors under rear shelving and the beverage unit had dirt and grime. Inspector instructed cleaning to prevent possible insect harboring. No insects were reported.

headline: Dirty plumbing fixtures; floors under shelving
summary: Plumbing fixtures in the restroom needed cleaning. Floors throughout the rear prep area under shelving units needed removal of dried food debris.

headline: Raw beef thawing at room temperature
summary: Raw beef was thawing in still water at room temperature near the 3-compartment sink; approved thawing methods were required. Utensils were left in room-temperature water at the coffee station. No sanitizer test kit; citation issued.

headline: Only ventilation item noted; no problems
summary: The only item noted was ventilation and lighting, and no specific problems or comments were recorded.

headline: Leaking hot-water faucet at hand sink
summary: The hot-water faucet at the hand-washing sink by the ice machine was leaking. It must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Cluttered mop closet; missing grill filters
summary: The mop sink closet was full of trash and stacked items. The rear closet floor had debris, loose rocks and drywall. The exhaust hood above the grill is missing multiple filters on the left side and one on the right.

headline: Smoker and vacuum packer ordered out of use
summary: Smoker and vacuum-packing machine tagged held for inspection, and must not be used until a written food safety plan (HACCP) and city variance are approved. About 20,000 lbs of smoked meats, valued at $30,000, held; citation issued.

headline: Worn front door seal; dirty floors
summary: Weather stripping at the bottom of the front door is in poor repair and must be replaced to prevent pest entry. Reach-in cooler and freezer interiors need cleaning. A cook lacked food handler training.

headline: Leaky faucet and loose water knob
summary: A leaky faucet at the three-compartment sink and a loose hot and cold water knob in the rear unisex restroom were noted. Staff were instructed to repair both.

headline: Black mold in ice machine; peeling paint
summary: Excessive black mold-like buildup covered all interior parts of the ice machine used for ice for human consumption. Ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned and sanitized; citation issued. Also peeling paint near a chest freezer.

headline: Cutting board, coolers and sink need cleaning
summary: The cutting board, refrigeration units and 3-compartment sink need cleaning, as do areas under cooking equipment. Floors under and around kitchen equipment, and kitchen walls and ceiling vents, also need cleaning.

headline: Ice machine buildup; gaps at front doors
summary: Buildup was found inside the upper portion of the ice machine and must be cleaned. The front double doors have 1/2-inch gaps and must be rodent-proofed. Some bulk containers in the lower prep area are unlabeled. Lower freezer lights are out.

headline: Hand sink blocked by eggs; food too warm
summary: Kitchen hand sink was blocked by 7 eggs and rubber gloves, which the manager removed; citation issued. Potatoes and beef balls in the walk-in cooler measured 47.8F to 49F, too warm. About 18 lbs, valued at $840, was discarded.

headline: Clutter by walk-in cooler; loose baseboard
summary: Excessive clutter by the walk-in cooler must be removed, and stock raised 6 inches off the floor for cleaning and pest monitoring. A loose baseboard by the walk-in coolers must be sealed to prevent pest entry.

headline: Mouse droppings in walk-in; missing supplies
summary: About 10 to 15 mouse droppings were on the floor inside the storage walk-in cooler; citation not issued. Large openings at the front and rear doors must be rodent-proofed. Missing sink cleaning agent, test strips, and a food thermometer.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure; food on floor
summary: No procedures or supplies for vomiting and diarrhea cleanup; citation issued. Food stored on floors in walk-in cooler and freezer. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Heavy grease and food debris on equipment, walls and floors.

headline: Ice machine soiled with black substance
summary: Ice machine interior had a black substance; ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned and sanitized; citation issued. Also: unlabeled containers, food stored on walk-in floors, wet wiping cloths, utensils stored inside food containers, and a broken hot-holding handle.

headline: Food stored on walk-in cooler floor
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor inside the walk-in cooler and must be placed on raised shelving 6 inches off the floor. Shelves in the service prep cooler had old food debris and crumbs. Dusty vents also need cleaning.

headline: Moldy caulk and hood debris to address
summary: Molded caulking around the rear hand sink must be removed. Debris buildup on the exhaust hood and filters above cooking equipment must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager; gaps and food handler training missing
summary: No person in charge with a valid city sanitation certificate, and no certified manager on site while hot or cold foods were prepared; citation issued. A gap under the front doors could let pests in. Leaking valves and missing ceiling tiles also noted.

headline: Men's restroom and floors need cleaning
summary: Floors and fixtures in the men's washroom must be cleaned and maintained. Floors throughout the facility need cleaning to remove spills, debris and grease.

headline: Dirty cooler interior; hole under sink
summary: The interior of a two-door cooling unit in rear storage needs cleaning to remove food debris. A hole in the wall corner under the 3-compartment sink must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Grease and food debris were found under equipment and shelving.

headline: Open ingredients need sealed, labeled containers
summary: Open food ingredients must be stored in sealed containers marked with the commodity name. Supplies stored on shelving accessible to customers need a barrier. A 3-compartment sink P-trap is leaking, and the mop storage area is cluttered.

headline: Grimy sink and missing backflow device
summary: Grime built up in the middle compartment of the 3-compartment sink must be cleaned. No backflow prevention device on the ice machine water line in the dining area; one must be installed. A food handler training certificate must be on site.

headline: Wiping cloths not in sanitizer; cooler spills
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in clean sanitizing solution when not in use and must be corrected. A large can opener needs cleaning to remove buildup. The interior of a rear reach-in cooler had food spills.

headline: To-go containers stored uncovered near sushi
summary: To-go containers along the sushi prep line were stored uncovered and not inverted. Staff were told to cover or invert them when not protected from overhead contamination.

headline: Cooler without thermometer; unused equipment stored
summary: Upright cooler holding fresh salsa, milk and sour cream had no thermometer; one must be provided. Unused equipment stored in the rear of the facility must be removed.

headline: No allergen training for certified managers
summary: No valid allergen certificates or training were on site for city-certified food managers, and they must be provided. A splash guard must be installed at the rear prep hand sink between the sink and prep table.

headline: Leaking hand sink; missing thermometers
summary: No thermometers were inside cooling units. Food employees lacked hair restraints. An exposed hand sink in the rear prep area leaks heavily onto the floor. Heavy food grease and trash on floors, and burned-out ceiling lights, were noted.

headline: Hand sink lacked soap and paper towels
summary: Front beverage prep hand sink had no soap and no paper towels; both must be kept at all hand sinks at all times. Citation issued. Also: a broken cooler thermometer, rusty storage racks, a dirty floor, and missing ceiling tiles.

headline: No certified manager on duty; rear door gap
summary: No manager with a valid city certificate was on duty while pizza and milk were served; citation issued. The rear door needs new weatherstrip to be rodent-proofed. Floors, cooler interiors and a leaking faucet also need attention.

headline: Gaps at cooler door; no food handler training
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the door to the outside walk-in cooler and freezer must be sealed. Food was stored on floors in the cooler, freezer and basement. Unused items were stored outside. No food handler training for employees.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; small sink leaks
