summary: Large rice and sugar containers in the rear prep area were not labeled with their common names. Large pots and bowls were not inverted, and shelving and fryer cabinet had grease. Small leaks at hand sinks and a damaged walk-in floor were noted.

headline: Greasy cooking area; cracked floor tiles
summary: Grease buildup was found on cooking equipment, walls, floors and shelving in kitchen and prep areas; staff were instructed to degrease, clean and sanitize. Prep area floor tiles are in poor repair with low grout and must be repaired and regrouted.

headline: Rear door gap; torn gaskets; leaking drain
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the rear exit door must be sealed. Torn gaskets were found inside prep coolers, and reach-in cooler interiors need detail cleaning. A drainpipe under the staff hand sink is leaking. Food debris and spills were on floors and surfaces.

headline: Unlabeled dry goods; ice machine residue
summary: Rice, flour, salt and sugar were out of original containers without labels, and all must be labeled. An ice scoop was lying on ice in the bar. The walk-in cardboard liner must be removed, and residue inside the ice machine must be cleaned.

headline: Dumpster door openings; no restroom ventilation
summary: Openings at the base of the double exit doors in the dumpster area must be sealed to prevent pests. Mop drying in a bucket needs a drying rack. No mechanical ventilation is installed in the washroom, and one must be added.

headline: Missing paper towels at bar hand sinks
summary: Basement bar, basement prep and upstairs bar hand sinks had no paper towels or other hand-drying method; citation issued. The manager provided paper towels during the inspection. Food containers on walk-in floors and a rusted storage rack were also noted.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; no test kit
summary: Low-temperature dish machine was sanitizing at 0 ppm chlorine. It was corrected on site and tagged held for inspection; citation issued. No chlorine test kit, no menu disclosure for undercooked animal foods, and no food handler training proof.

headline: Cooked beans lacked date labels; expired certificates
summary: Three large tubs of cooked beans in the walk-in cooler had no prep or discard date; about 20 lbs, valued at $25, were discarded. Some food handlers had expired food handler certificates and were told to obtain current ones.

headline: Rear hand sink had no running water
summary: Rear hand-washing sink had no running water because the hot and cold handles were broken or missing; citation issued. Also noted: equipment not inverted, single-use items stored on floor, a broken cooler handle, and a leaking drainpipe.

headline: No proof of food handler or allergen training
summary: No proof of food handler training for any staff, and no allergen training proof for certified food managers. Records must be provided. Also noted: dust on kitchen walls and ceilings, and dirty cooler interiors that need deep cleaning.

headline: Bare-hand handling of cooked chicken
summary: A certified manager pulled cooked chicken off a skewer with bare hands; about 5 lbs, valued at $25, was discarded; citation issued. Repeat violations for food debris in prep coolers and dirty floors were not corrected from 10/11/2023; citation issued.

headline: No valid manager certificate while TCS foods served
summary: No valid city sanitation manager certificate was on site while steak, chicken and rice were served; citation issued. Pots and pans were not inverted. Food debris was on bulk container lids, and the prep cooler gaskets had food residue.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; no rear hand sink
summary: No bodily fluid spill kit or cleanup procedure for vomiting and diarrhea events; citation issued. No hand sink in the rear dish prep area; citation issued. No service sink, two 3-compartment sinks lack grease traps, and an employee toilet door is not self-closing.

headline: Mouse droppings and live flies in prep area
summary: About 30 mouse droppings were on the bottom shelf of a prep table and about 10 on a washroom floor, with about 10 live flies in the prep area. Affected areas must be detail cleaned and pest control called; citation issued.

headline: Food on floor; stained cutting boards
summary: Food containers were stored on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised 6 inches. Cutting boards with open seams and dark stains need refinishing or replacement. The rear prep hand sink hot-water lever is in disrepair and must be repaired.

headline: Mouse droppings; no hot water; cooler too warm
summary: About 15 mouse droppings were on the floor of the rear office and furnace room; cleanup and pest control are needed. No hot water on premises; citation issued. A 3-door cooler measured 73.1F and must be at 41F or colder.

headline: Leaking faucets and floors need cleaning
summary: Leaking faucets at the deli hand sink, the 3-compartment sink, and the walk-in produce prep cooler must be repaired. Floors in the rear storage areas and inside the walk-in prep cooler need cleaning. A front restroom ceiling tile needs repair.

headline: Small flies in prep area; food handlers untrained
summary: About 15 small flies were on walls and flying around the rear food prep area; cleaning and pest control were required; citation issued. Two female food handlers lacked proof of food handler training. A cutting board had brown spots.

headline: Live roaches found at front service counter
summary: About 5 live roaches were crawling on excessive debris and coffee beans at the front counter, with several dead nearby; pest control service was recommended. Potatoes and chicken wraps held at 54.9F to 55.4F were discarded; citation issued.

headline: Cooler interiors and floors need cleaning
summary: Interiors of reach-in coolers must be cleaned to remove spills and debris. Floors throughout the prep and dish areas need cleaning to remove spills and debris.

headline: Rodent droppings and live roaches found
summary: About 140 mouse droppings were on the floor of the rear storage area, and 15 live roaches were in rear dry storage; additional pest control is needed; citation issued. A black mold-like substance inside the ice machine touched ice; citation issued.

headline: Improper sink setup; food stored on floor
summary: The 3-compartment sink was not set up for proper washing, rinsing and sanitizing; citation issued. Food was stored on the walk-in cooler floor. A hand-wash dispenser was placed above the 3-compartment sink, and a grease trap was rusty.

headline: No health policy; missing food handler training
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site, and a template was left; no citation issued. Soap and paper towels at a 1-compartment sink must be removed. Exposed hand sinks lack signage. Torn cooler gaskets, burnt-out hood lights, and one employee without training.

headline: Sprayer and vent issues; dusty air vents
summary: Aerator is spraying water at the front bar hand sink and must be repaired. The light cover over the rear 3-compartment sink needs repair. Air vent covers in the food prep area need a detailed cleaning because of dust buildup.

headline: Cooler door not sealing; floors and ceilings damaged
summary: A two-door reach-in cooler door was not closing properly; the gasket must be replaced to keep food cold. Oven interiors had encrusted grease. Broken floor tiles, stained ceiling tiles, and broken equipment stored in the basement were also noted.

headline: Grease behind equipment; dirty floors
summary: The back of cooking equipment had dust and grease buildup and cannot be moved, so staff were told to find a way to clean behind it. Dirt and debris were under shelving in the beer, produce, bakery and deli areas. One deli walk-in light is out.

headline: Food debris and spills throughout facility
summary: Food debris and spills were found on floors, along walls and in corners throughout the facility. Staff must detail clean under shelving, prep and dish areas, around the dish machine, and around cooking equipment.

headline: Shellfish tags not kept for 90 days
summary: Shellfish tags for oysters and mussels were only kept back 60 days. Management must keep all shellstock tags on site for 90 days; citation issued.

headline: Certified manager lacked allergen training
summary: A certified manager on duty had no allergen training. Employees holding city food manager certificates must complete allergen training and keep records on site at all times.

headline: No city sanitation certificate; vacuum packer held
summary: No city sanitation certificate was on the premises or posted; citation issued. A vacuum packing machine has no HACCP plan or approval and was tagged held for inspection. Boxes and equipment were on the dry storage floor. A light in the hood is out.

headline: No allergen training on site for managers
summary: No allergen training was on site for any City of Chicago food managers. Management was told all of them must complete allergen training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Flies and live bird found; shellfish tag missing
summary: About 40 or more live small flies in the bar area and basement, and a live bird flying inside the bar area. Pest control service was recommended; citation issued. A 90-day shellfish tag for mussels was missing; citation issued.

headline: Spoons in room-temperature water; cardboard used
summary: Large spoons were kept in room-temperature water, and staff were told to follow the health code for utensil storage. Cardboard was used to cover a prep table; staff were told not to use cardboard on food-contact surfaces.

headline: Mop sink faucet lacks backflow device
summary: The mop sink faucet has no backflow prevention device. One must be provided in a location where it can be serviced and accessed.

headline: Mouse droppings found; no manager on site
summary: About 100 mouse droppings were found in the basement under storage racks, on pallets and in containers. Additional pest control is needed; citation issued. No certified manager until 2:10 PM, after an 11 AM opening; vomit cleanup supplies were also missing.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods served
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while chicken, hummus and other foods that must be kept hot or cold were handled and served. The inspector noted this as a priority violation.

headline: Sink blocked by cookware; low water pressure
summary: An exposed hand sink in the 11th-floor lounge was blocked by utensils and cookware; citation issued. Both sinks in the female employee locker room have low water pressure. Food debris is on the wall-mounted potato cutter, and one light is burnt out in the walk-in dairy cooler.

headline: Serving tray in hand sink; food stored on floor
summary: Serving tray was stored inside a hand-washing sink, blocking access; citation issued. Raw meat and other food bins were stored on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised 6 inches. Also: missing sink stopper and greasy equipment.

headline: Vacuum packing without approved HACCP plan
summary: No city-approved HACCP plan, a written food safety plan, for vacuum packaging turkey, chicken and sausage; one must be obtained before packaging. Citation issued. Several food handlers lacked training certificates, and a certified manager lacked allergen proof.

headline: Single-use items not inverted; mop head stored wet
summary: Single-use articles in the prep area were not inverted and must be inverted to protect from contamination. The 3-compartment sink has no stoppers. A mop head was stored in soiled water and must be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Mold-like substance dripping onto ice
summary: Black and gray mold-like substance inside the ice machine was dripping onto ice used for human consumption. Ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned and sanitized; citation issued. A smoothie-station hand sink is hanging from the wall.

headline: Food stored on floors; cluttered storage; grease
summary: Bags of food in the rear hallway must be moved, and food containers must be raised off floors. A walk-in cooler door gasket is worn. Excessive grease and debris were on cooking equipment, shelving, walls and floors. Men's restroom ventilation isn't working.

headline: Black slime in ice maker; no allergen training
summary: Black slimy substance inside the ice maker was dripping into ice used for people. Management must turn off the machine, remove ice, and clean and sanitize it; citation issued. Also: unlabeled bulk containers and a certified manager without allergen training.

headline: Missing waste containers; hole near cooler
summary: No waste receptacle at hand-washing sinks in the front service area and rear warewashing area; one must be provided at each sink if paper towels are used. A small hole between the walk-in cooler and the rear wall base must be repaired or sealed.

headline: Single-use cups used as scoops; raw beef issue
summary: Single-use plastic cups were used as scoops in dry and cold-holding containers and must be replaced with multi-use utensils. Raw beef was stored under condensation drips in the walk-in cooler and must be moved. A slicer in poor repair had glove boxes on its food-contact surfaces.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; wooden wall
summary: No handwashing signs were above the hand sinks in the front prep area. A wooden wall in the women's bathroom next to the toilet is not smooth or cleanable and must be resurfaced.

headline: Scoops in ingredients; expired manager certificate
summary: Scoops and cups were stored inside ingredient containers and must be removed and sanitized. A cold-holding unit on the prep line has a damaged gasket. Water damage is on the wall behind the ice machine. A certified manager's allergen certificate was expired.

headline: Cardboard floor liner; grease and floor debris
summary: Cardboard was used as a floor liner in the rear cooking area and must be removed. Grease and food debris were on cooking equipment, prep tables and coolers in the rear cooking and bakery areas. Floors in all prep areas need cleaning.

headline: Empty ice machine interior not clean
summary: The interior of the empty ice machine was not clean. Staff were instructed to clean and sanitize all interior surfaces.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; wood used for elevation
summary: Torn and missing rubber door gaskets on two cooler units on the cook line must be replaced. Raw wooden blocks were used under a kitchen freezer and a wheel is missing. A hole under a women's hand dryer must be sealed.

headline: Minor cleaning and labeling issues found
summary: Minor issues only. The kitchen ice machine interior needs minor cleaning. A bulk flour container had no label and must show its common name. Dust on the kitchen ventilation hood must be cleaned.

headline: No sanitation manager certificate; no hand soap
summary: The person in charge lacked a sanitation manager certificate while chicken and milk were handled; citation issued. The hand sink near coffee prep had no soap or dispenser; soap was supplied by the end of the inspection, and a citation was issued.

headline: Weak hot water; meat slicer not cleaned
summary: Hot water pressure at the women's restroom hand sink is weak and must be corrected under city pressure. The meat slicer was not cleaned behind the blade, and food debris was noted in the blade housing.

headline: No certified manager while food served
summary: No person in charge with a valid certificate, and no city food manager on duty while foods were prepared and served; citation issued. Food containers stored on the walk-in cooler floor. Greasy equipment and walls, a hole at the stove, and missing allergen certificates.

headline: Rat droppings and unsafe cold holding
summary: Over 15 rat droppings were found along the rear hallway wall; citation issued. Meat sauce, lasagna and shelled eggs were held at 46F to 52F, and a refrigerator measured 49F. About 20 lbs, valued at $200, was discarded. Mussels lacked a shellstock tag.

headline: Knives and ice scoop stored improperly
summary: Knives were stored between the wall and 3-compartment sink and between the prep cooler and prep table; they must be cleaned and stored properly. An ice scoop was stored in an ice container in the chest freezer. A bathroom door is not self-closing.

headline: Unsafe cold-holding temperatures; no certified manager
summary: Shrimp, chicken and fries in service coolers measured 60.9F, 50.7F and 58F, too warm; about 4 lbs discarded and citation issued. No certified manager on duty while food was served. A prep cooler at 63.5F was taken out of use.

headline: No certified manager while hamburgers prepared
summary: No certified manager was on site while hamburgers and other hot or cold foods were prepared; citation issued. Wastewater backs up from the 3-compartment sink into adjacent compartments; citation issued. Also missing handwashing signs and burnt-out bulbs.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; dish machine data plate
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at hand sinks in the bar, rear prep and dish areas. The high-temperature dish machine had no data plate. A covered receptacle was missing in the women's washroom.

headline: Utensils blocking hand sinks; no sink stoppers
summary: Spoons and kettles were placed in the front and rear hand-washing sinks, blocking their use. Staff were told to keep sinks free of utensils. A condensation line drips into a bucket above the ice maker, and the 3-compartment sink has no stoppers.

headline: Greasy pipes and floors near fryers
summary: Pipes along the wall behind the fryers need cleaning to remove grease. Floors under the fryers and under the table next to the small dish machine also need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; old violations uncorrected
summary: No city food service manager was on premises, and the person in charge lacked a valid certificate; citation issued. Violations from February 2024 were not corrected. Greasy fryers and floors, food handlers without proof of training, and employees without hair restraints.

headline: No certified manager; no food handler certificate
summary: The person in charge lacked a city sanitation certificate, and no valid certificate was posted or provided for the manager on duty; citation issued. No food handler training certificate was on site. A splash guard from a 2019 violation is still missing.

headline: Mouse droppings throughout kitchen; rodent activity
summary: Mouse droppings were found near the walk-in cooler, on rolling carts, behind the dish area, near ice machines and upstairs. Pest control is needed before reinspection; citation issued. A 1.5-inch gap at the center door and heavy trash outside the grease unit were also noted.

headline: Floors around cooking equipment need cleaning
summary: Floors around cooking equipment need cleaning to remove spills, debris and grease.

headline: No employee health policy; rear door gap
summary: No employee health policy was on site; citation issued. The rear exit door is missing a sweep, leaving gaps over 1/4 inch. Food boxes and vegetables were on floors, and scoop handles were touching food. One of three managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Beard restraint missing; uncorrected grease, spills
summary: Food handler lacked a beard restraint. Previous violations not corrected: greasy cooking equipment, slow-draining hand sink, and syrup spills on basement floor; citation issued. Dust on soda lines in basement.

headline: Dirty dish gauges; allergen training missing
summary: High-temperature dish machine temperature gauges are soiled, hard to read and in poor repair. Basement ice machine exterior and floor drain soiled. Certified managers lack allergen training certificates on site.

headline: Unlabeled food, greasy equipment, clutter
summary: Food in coolers, walk-in and dry storage not labeled with food name. Greasy cooking and cold-holding equipment and dirty floors. Excess clutter in storage areas must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Utility sink lacks backflow device.

headline: Dirty ice machine tubes; torn gaskets
summary: Plastic tubes inside ice machines are not clean and must be cleaned or replaced. Some bulk containers in prep area unlabeled. Several prep cooler and walk-in door gaskets torn; must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Worn rear door seal; low washroom pressure
summary: Worn weather stripping on rear exit door could let pests in; must be replaced. Washroom water pressure slightly low; must be repaired.

headline: Employee eating in kitchen; grocery bag storage
summary: Employee observed eating in kitchen; eating and drinking allowed only in designated areas. Frozen chicken stored in plastic grocery bags; food-grade bags only. Cardboard floor mats, milk-crate shelving and missing sink stoppers also cited.

headline: Food debris on floors; missing vent cover
summary: Heavy food debris on floors in rear and front prep areas, behind all equipment. Missing mechanical ventilation cover in dishwashing area ceiling. Loose kick plate screws on prep-area door.

headline: Loose hand sink handles; dirty floors
summary: Hand sink handles loose and faucet splatters, making handwashing harder; must be corrected. Floors under three-compartment sink and around soda dispenser need cleaning.

headline: Three-compartment sink backs up
summary: Water backs up into the first and third basins when the second basin drains. Manager told to repair before re-inspection; citation issued. Loose debris and dust under soda machine also needs cleaning.

headline: No hot water; grease and debris on floors
summary: No hot water on premises; sink water measured 57–59°F. Handwashing needs at least 100°F and dishwashing 110°F; citation issued. Grease, food debris and dirt on floors under equipment and along walls in prep, dish and storage areas.

headline: Three-compartment sink floods; foil-wrapped equipment
summary: Three-compartment sink floods when one compartment drains; citation issued. Equipment wrapped in foil; cooler missing kick plates. Food splatter and debris on walls and floors throughout facility.

headline: Hand sink too cold; broken dish machine gauge
summary: Rear prep hand sink at 55.2°F; must be 100–120°F; citation issued. Broken rinse gauge on high-temperature dish machine; citation issued. Missing handwash sign at bar sink; broken soap dispenser; greasy hood filters.

headline: Cleaning needed in meat department and coolers
summary: Clean shelves inside walk-in meat cooler and cutting boards in meat department. Remove trash and debris under meat counter. Dust on walk-in fan covers and dirty plastic curtains need cleaning.

headline: Sanitizer at 0 ppm; foods too warm
summary: Bar dish machine sanitizer measured 0 ppm (50 ppm required); tagged. Rice at 66.2°F and beans at 66.1°F (135°F required). Cold chicken and tomatoes at 54.2–55.7°F. About 10 lb discarded. No certified manager during food prep; ice machine has black mold-like substance.

headline: Greasy equipment; loose floors; rust remains
summary: Rust on walk-in cooler shelves must be removed. Grease and food debris on grill, fryers, shelving, ice machine and other equipment; dish machine must be delimed. Loose floors, peeling concrete and broken glass need repair or cleaning.

headline: Warm spinach discarded; dead insects on sills
summary: Ready-to-eat spinach at 47.8°F was discarded (about $10). Dead insects on dining-area window sills must be cleaned. Previous food and washroom storage violations not corrected. Leaky sink waterline; employee chewing gum in prep area.

headline: 30 small flies; uncorrected fly violation
summary: 30 small flies at dishwashing area; pest control operator must be notified and flies eliminated. Prior fly violation not corrected; citation issued. Stove, floor drains, and floors under cooking equipment also need cleaning.

headline: Cold foods too warm; vacuum-sealing tagged
summary: Shrimp, lettuce salad and tomatoes held at 48–49.1°F (41°F required); manager discarded 15 lb on site. Vacuum-sealed foods lacked required approval; machine and 75 lb of packaged food tagged. Gaps at two outer doors.

headline: Rat droppings outside dumpster area
summary: Rat droppings found around outside dumpster area; cleanup required. Rust peeling inside microwave. Certified food manager lacks allergen training, a repeat violation from 2023; citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; warm cold foods discarded
summary: No certified food manager on duty while food was prepared. Cold foods too warm: hot dogs 50.5°F, cream 60.3°F; manager discarded 4 lb on site. Gap under rear door. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; replace
summary: Milk crates used as shelving throughout prep and storage areas. Must be replaced with shelving at least six inches off the floor.

headline: No sanitizer test strips; torn cooler gaskets
summary: No sanitizer test strips on site to check the three-compartment sink; citation issued. Torn door gaskets on prep cooler. Grease buildup on conveyor oven and floor under fryer.

headline: Dirty floor in rear storage room
summary: Complaint passed. Rear storage room floor is not clean and has excessive dirt and debris. Must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Water-damaged ceiling tiles in dining, prep
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Several water-damaged ceiling tiles in front dining area and above walk-in cooler in rear prep. Must be repaired or replaced.

headline: No basement hand sink; allergen proof missing
summary: No hand sink in basement rear prep area; installation ordered. Rust on three walk-in freezer shelves. No temperature indicator for high-temperature dish machine. Garbage carts dirty outside. No allergen training proof for employees with city certificates.

headline: No certified manager; hand sink blocked
summary: No certified food service manager on site while ground beef was handled and served. Boxes blocked a hand sink in food prep. Three-compartment sink lacks drain board and stoppers.

headline: No certificate posted; rear door gaps
summary: No original City of Chicago food sanitation certificate posted; citation issued. No pest control logbook; service required at least twice yearly. Large gaps under two rear doors need rodent-proof strips. No allergen training certificate on site.

headline: Leaky pipe under sink; repair required
summary: Leaky pipe found under the one-compartment sink. Must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Live roaches found; thermometers missing
summary: Two live cockroaches on wall under front service counter; additional pest control needed. Gap at bottom of rear kitchen door. Missing thermometers in prep line cooler and salsa refrigerator. Bulk spice containers unlabeled.

headline: Cutting board with deep grooves
summary: Cutting board has deep, dark grooves and stains; must be sanded or replaced.

headline: Freezer ice buildup; clutter in rear storage
summary: Excess ice at bottom of rear two-door freezer must be defrosted and cleaned. Clutter in rear storage area must be elevated and organized.

headline: Unlabeled birria; cardboard on floor
summary: Birria meat in two-door reach-in cooler lacked a label. Cardboard on floor in front of coolers must be removed to prevent pest hiding spots. Greasy prep table and steam table spills; person in charge lacks allergen training.

headline: Sleeves required; greasy equipment, dirty floors
summary: Shirts with sleeves are needed in prep area. Worn sponges must be replaced. Cooking equipment has grease and food spills to remove. Floors throughout prep area need detail cleaning.

headline: Food debris in coolers; dirty floors
summary: Accumulated food debris inside prep coolers; must be cleaned. Washroom floor and hot water tank room floor have food and dirt buildup that must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager; open cups; no hair restraints
summary: No certified food manager or certificate posted while deli, eggs and soup were handled; citation issued. Employee open cups on prep tables. Staff restrooms lack handwashing signs. Food handlers need effective hair restraints.

headline: 25–30 live flies; ice machine slime; no manager
summary: About 25–30 live small flies in second-floor bar and dishroom; pest control recommended. Ice machine has black and pink slimy buildup dripping onto ice. Dish machine rinse 142.4°F, tagged. Wild rice held at 131.4°F (135°F required). No certified manager on site.

headline: Clutter, slow sink, no washroom ventilation
summary: Excess ice inside basement meat freezer must be removed. Exposed hand sink behind meat counter drains slowly. Clutter and unused stove must be removed to prevent rodent hiding spots. Basement employee washroom lacks ventilation.

headline: 40 rodent droppings; shrimp held too warm
summary: About 40 rodent droppings in front checkout area and behind ice machine; extra pest control needed. Fried shrimp held at 57.5°F; about 2 lb discarded. One employee lacks food handler training.

headline: Clutter by rear exit; allergen training missing
summary: Clutter stored on floor near rear exit to trash. Unused items must be removed to prevent pest hiding spots. Food service sanitation manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Soiled cloths; uninverted items; sink stoppers
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Soiled wiping cloths stored on prep table; must be kept in sanitizing solution. Single-use items not inverted. Three-compartment sink has inadequate stoppers.

headline: Hand sinks shut off; wastewater backs up
summary: Rear dish-area hand sink inoperable; front prep hand sink shut off; citation issued. Gray wastewater backs up from floor drain onto prep floor; citation issued. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No certified manager; no employee health policy
summary: No person in charge present at inspection. No city sanitation certificate on premises while chicken and deli meat were handled; citation issued. No employee health policy; citation issued. Previous allergen training violation not corrected. Clutter and greasy hoods noted.

headline: Dish machine tagged; sink water backs up
summary: High-temperature dish machine did not reach 180°F final rinse; tagged and not to be used until reinspected. Wastewater backs up at three-compartment sink. Backflow device leaks; milk crates used as shelving; last inspection report not posted.

headline: Dead insects in furnace closet; small leak
summary: Dead insects found in furnace closet; affected area must be cleaned. Small leak under prep-area hand sink must be repaired. Peeling ceiling paint above prep storage shelves must be removed.

headline: Rear exit doors need rodent-proofing
summary: Bottom of both rear exit doors must be rodent-proofed to prevent pest entry.

headline: Mouse droppings; candy handled bare-handed
summary: Mouse activity with 20–25 droppings in hot food section; small flies at front counter and rear prep. Candy handled bare-handed and placed in a used cookie box; discarded. No soap or paper towels at rear prep sink. Citations issued.

headline: No certified manager; ice machine residue
summary: No certified food manager on premises while deli meat and pasta salad were prepared and served. Citation issued. Dark residue found inside ice machine panel; must be cleaned and sanitized.

headline: Expired allergen training for manager
summary: Certified manager's allergen training has expired. Must be renewed and maintained, or citations will follow.

headline: Outside lid still missing; debris; no thermometer
summary: Previous violation for missing outside receptacle lid not corrected; citation issued. Trash and food debris on floors in grocery, stock area, pharmacy, and inside walk-in cooler and freezer. Walk-in cooler lacks thermometer.

headline: Four large roaches; no pest control log
summary: Four large roaches on prep table, floor and wall; two small flies in dining room and kitchen; two dead roaches in freezer. Pest control logbook missing. No person with posted city sanitation certificate. Sinks lack soap, paper towels and signs.

headline: Cooler thermometers needed; re-inspection passed
summary: Re-inspection passed. Properly working thermometers must be placed inside all cooling units and kept working.

headline: Missing self-closing doors; stained ceiling tile
summary: Toilet room door, front entrance and rear exit lack self-closing devices. Stained ceiling tile above hat and candy stand near register must be replaced to monitor active leaks.

headline: Week-old deli food discarded; toilet out of order
summary: Deli meats, quiche, sautéed vegetables and cut fruit stored over 7 days; about 20 lb discarded ($100); citation issued. Hot water trickles at prep hand sink. Toilet not flushing; citation issued. No valid sanitation certificate posted.

headline: Spoons buried in food; backflow cap missing
summary: Spoons stored with handles buried in food in front service line cooler; handles must stay above food. Backflow device at rear utility sink is missing its bell cap; must be repaired.

headline: No certified manager; raw chicken too warm
summary: No person in charge or certified food manager with valid certificate on site while chicken, rice and beans were prepared. 15 lb raw chicken at 70.5°F discarded ($150). Hand sink water 71°F (100°F required). Citations issued.

headline: Wastewater in basement; citation issued
summary: Wastewater flooding basement dry storage from damaged sump pump; citation issued. Ice scoop stored inside ice machine. Heavy ice buildup in walk-in cooler. Dirt and grease under stove; dusty ceiling fans in kitchen prep.

headline: Missing handwashing sign at prep sink
summary: Employee handwashing signage must be provided at hand sink in front prep area.

headline: Torn rear door strip; minor leaks
summary: Rodent-proof strip torn at bottom of rear door; must be repaired. Minor leak from pipe under left side of three-compartment sink, and minor leak from rear ceiling. Must be repaired.

headline: Grocery bags holding food; faucet leaks
summary: Grocery bags were used to store food; manager told to use only food-grade bags. Three-compartment sink faucet leaks when water runs; manager instructed to repair it.

headline: Uncovered food, foil, missing labels
summary: Food in coolers and hot holding left uncovered; some wrapped in aluminum foil. Utensils stored inside food containers. Containers lack labels. Hood and filters greasy. Manager's allergen training certificate not posted.

headline: Dead roaches found; leaking hand sink drain
summary: Dead roaches found in bar prep area behind beer cooler, in utility room and under dry storage rack; staff told to remove and clean. Leaking drainpipe under prep hand sink. Food containers unlabeled.

headline: No certified manager; flies; no cleanup plan
summary: About 25 flying insects on walls in food prep and dishwashing areas; additional pest control needed. No certified manager on site while chicken and beef were prepared. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup plan or supplies. Citations issued.

headline: No certified manager; dirty floors
summary: No valid certified food manager on duty while foods that must be kept hot or cold (TCS), such as smoothies with fresh fruit, were handled and served; citation issued. Floors need cleaning, especially along wall bases and corners.

headline: Coffee milk cooler lacks thermometer
summary: Cooler used to store milk for coffee service has no thermometer inside; must be provided.

headline: Sushi rice too cool; certificate not posted
summary: Sushi rice held at 80°F (135°F required); 5 lb discarded, worth $30; citation issued. No person on site with an original City of Chicago food sanitation certificate posted; citation issued.

headline: Missing floor tiles under grease trap
summary: Re-inspection passed. Floor tiles under grease trap are missing and broken. Smooth, easily cleanable floors must be provided.

headline: Greasy fryers; food handler lacks certificate
summary: Thick grease and dirt inside fryers and on cooler and freezer exteriors. Walk-in cooler floor is a trip hazard. Food handler on site had no certificate; managers need allergen proof. Tongs stored on oven handle; mop left in dirty water.

headline: No allergen training; damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Re-inspection passed. Person in charge had no allergen training evidence on site and must obtain it. Damaged ceiling tiles above dining room soda machines must be replaced.

headline: Food on floor; wood baskets must be removed
summary: Food stored on floor in basement walk-in freezer and dry storage. Wood dough baskets were stained and splintered; must be removed. Cardboard used as shelf liner. Expired allergen training for one manager.

headline: No health policy; no cleanup supplies; wall holes
summary: No signed employee health policies on site; no vomit and diarrhea procedure or supplies; no sanitizer test strips at three-compartment sink. Holes in walls must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Garbage removal contract not on site.

headline: No allergen training certificate on site
summary: No allergen training on site for city-certified food managers. Managers must complete training and keep certificates on site.

headline: Manager lacks certificate; rear door gap
summary: Person in charge has no City of Chicago food sanitation manager certificate, and none is posted; citation issued. Rear door has a one-inch gap at bottom corner that must be rodent-proofed. No food handler certificates available.

headline: No health policy; missing handwash sinks
summary: No employee health policy or training on site. No hand sink at grill or dish room. No food handler or allergen training certificates on site. Dish machine lacks a temperature indicator; several repairs also required.

headline: 60+ live flies, roaches; hand sink too cool
summary: Over 60 live small flies and 4 live roaches in prep, dish and storage areas; pest control recommended. Hand sink water only 77–85°F (100°F required). Dish machine rinse 124°F; unit tagged, staff told to use 3-compartment sink.

headline: No manager present; allergen training lacking
summary: No person in charge present at inspection. No certified food manager with city certificate on duty; citation issued. Serving plates stored upright, loose cooler lid knobs, and managers lack allergen training.

headline: Stained cutting board; greasy cooking equipment
summary: Large front cutting board has dark stains and deep grooves; must be repaired or replaced. Sides of cooking equipment and area under grills need deep cleaning of grease and dark buildup.

headline: Ice machine mold-like residue; no cleanup kit
summary: Ice machine panel touching ice had black mold-like substance; manager told staff to remove ice and clean. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site; citation issued. Cardboard shelf liners, leaking three-compartment sink and dirty floors.

headline: Basement utility sink lacks backflow device
summary: Basement utility sink has no backflow prevention device; must be provided and maintained.

headline: Overflowing outside garbage; failed inspection
summary: Outside garbage receptacle was overflowing. Closed, tight-fitting lids must be kept on at all times. Citation issued.

headline: Damaged floor tiles in several areas
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Damaged floor tiles found in coffee prep, dining, rear prep and dishwashing areas. Manager instructed to replace all damaged tiles.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings and flies found
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings under storage racks in second-floor dry storage. Over 100 live small flies in bar and kitchen; live roaches too. Prep cooler 44°F and walk-in 45°F (41°F required). Pest control needed.

headline: Green ice machine residue; missing cleanup supplies
summary: Green substance inside ice machine; ice must be destroyed and machine cleaned. Vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies missing. Opening at base of rear door must be sealed. Only one food handler certificate provided; two employees lack allergen proof.

headline: Dead roaches; eggs held too warm; discarded
summary: About 15 dozen eggs held at 50.1–53°F; about 20 lb discarded ($95). Basement cold unit at 53.8°F tagged; citation issued. Dead roaches on wall and floor near basement ice machine. Cardboard under floor mats.

headline: Dirty equipment; standing water; filters dirty
summary: Wiping cloths must be kept in sanitizing solution when not in use. Large can opener and rear prep cooking equipment need buildup removed. Basement floors cluttered; rear dish area has standing water. Ventilation filters need cleaning.

headline: Containers not stored inverted on racks
summary: Food containers found improperly stored on drying racks. Must be stored inverted.

headline: Mouse droppings in dry storage and prep
summary: About 50 mouse droppings along walls in dry storage room, 15 near mop sink and 8 on prep table shelf by hand sink. Pest control recommended; citation issued. No chemical test kit for sanitizer.

headline: Expired allergen training certificate
summary: Re-inspection passed. Employee with a city food sanitation certificate had an expired allergen training certificate. Valid proof must be provided for all such employees.

headline: Utensils in room-temp water; grease buildup
summary: In-use utensils stored in still, room-temperature water at wok and rice cooker areas; must use water at 135°F or higher or dry surfaces. Rear hand sink lacks handwash sign. Heavy grease under wok line.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; hair restraint lapse
summary: No thermometer in fresh meat display cooler. Food handlers in produce cutting area lacked proper hair restraints for waist-length hair. Dust and food debris under shelving on sales floors need cleaning.

headline: Expired certificate; missing thermometers
summary: Person in charge's city sanitation certificate expired 7-31-2023; citation issued. Three coolers lack thermometers. Expired food handler certificates. No certified manager has allergen training. Unused equipment must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Dish machine tagged; no employee health policy
summary: High-temperature dish machine malfunctioning; tagged and not to be used until repaired. No written employee health policy on premises. 1/4-inch gap at bottom of rear storage door. Missing backflow devices at coffee machine.

headline: Six live roaches; no certified manager
summary: Six live roaches near low-temperature dish machine in basement dish room; citation issued. No certified manager on site from 11:20am to 12:35pm while chicken was prepared. Washroom sinks at 71.9°F and 74.1°F (100–120°F required).

headline: Torn cooler gasket; milk crates; holes in walls
summary: No splash guard between hand sink and serving table at grill concession. Torn walk-in gasket and ice buildup in pantry freezer. Milk crates used for shelving must be replaced to prevent pest hiding spots. Holes in floor and wall need repair.

headline: Dirty sheet trays with food crumbs
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Sheet trays in storage had food crumbs on the bottom. Must be washed, rinsed and sanitized.

headline: Missing handwashing sign in oven room
summary: Handwashing signage must be provided for the hand sink in the oven prep room.

headline: Food and supplies stored on floor
summary: Food items stored on floor in prep and storage areas. Single-use items stored on floor in bar and storage areas. Damaged shelving in dry storage must be replaced. All items must be raised six inches off the floor.

headline: Single-use items not inverted
summary: Single-service articles were not inverted; manager instructed to invert them to prevent contamination.

headline: Bar sink lacks hot water
summary: Re-inspection passed. Bar sink had no hot running water. Manager must provide hot running water.

headline: Dead insects under sinks; hood needs cleaning
summary: Dead insects on floor under hand sink and three-compartment sink in rear prep area; staff told to remove, clean and sanitize. Hood and filters above cooking equipment also need cleaning.

headline: Missing handwash signage; leaking toilet valve
summary: No handwash signage in guest and employee bathroom. No covered receptacle in women's restroom. Leaking flush valve on men's restroom toilet must be repaired.

headline: Overflowing outdoor garbage; uncorrected violation
summary: Outdoor waste bins overflowed with garbage and grease; a prior violation was not corrected and a citation was issued. Gaps under rear doors need sealing. Also: milk crates for shelving, and plumbing repaired with plastic wrap.

headline: Dead insects on floors; food in wrong containers
summary: Dead insects were found on floors in both boiler rooms and an unused dining area and must be removed. Food containers were stored on floors, and salsa, chicken, and soup were in non-food-grade containers. Also: leaking drainpipe.

headline: Missing handsink and improper beef thawing
summary: The added dish and prep area lacks a handwashing sink. Frozen beef was thawed improperly in a basin near the walk-in cooler. A 1/4-inch rear door gap must be sealed. Also: food stored on floors, no approved grease trap.

headline: Live roaches and many flies found
summary: About 60 or more live small flies and 4 live roaches were found in prep, dish, and storage areas; citation issued. Several dead roaches were under the dish machine. Also: crates used for food storage and worn cutting boards.

headline: Empty paper towel dispenser, corrected on site
summary: Paper towel dispenser at the dish-area handsink was empty; corrected on site with citation. No proof of food handler training was provided. Also: missing handwashing sign, teas and syrups stored under a handsink, and a front door opening.

headline: Bare-hand food contact; about 100 flies found
summary: A food handler touched about 3 lbs of ready-to-eat bacon with bare hands; discarded and cited. About 100 or more live small flies were on walls and ceilings in prep and dish areas. Several foods were held at unsafe temperatures.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; clutter in dish area
summary: The display cooler needs a thermometer to monitor air temperature. Kitchenware and unnecessary items stored on shelves in the rear dishwashing area must be organized and removed.

headline: No certified manager while food was prepared
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while rice and chicken soup were prepared and served; citation issued. Person in charge must hold a certificate by next inspection. Dish-area handsink had no paper towels, and managers lack allergen training.

headline: No pest control log; prior violation uncorrected
summary: No pest control log book with required records was on site; this repeat priority violation from May 2024 was not corrected, and a citation was issued. Also: a damaged service counter cabinet door, dust under the counter, and items stored on the floor.

headline: Restroom lacks covered sanitary napkin bin
summary: The women's washroom has no covered receptacle for sanitary napkin disposal. The inspector ordered a covered waste receptacle be provided. No food safety problems were listed.

headline: Unused equipment in basement storage
summary: Unused equipment and unnecessary articles were stored in the basement. The manager was instructed to remove them to prevent pest harborage. No pests were noted.

headline: Mop drying improperly stored
summary: A mop was stored and dried improperly in the mop sink area. The inspector required upright or mounted storage that allows air-drying and prevents soiling and pest harboring. No pests were observed.

headline: Unsafe food temperatures; chemicals stored above food
summary: Chicken held at 132F, below the 135F hot-holding limit. Cold foods too warm, including ranch at 68F. Expired foods kept past 7 days; chemicals stored above lettuce and cilantro. Citations issued. Also unlabeled dry foods and dirty wiping cloths.

headline: Food handler training proof missing; drains dirty
summary: No proof of food handler training was provided for employees without a City of Chicago sanitation certificate. A certified manager lacked allergen training. Dirt and debris were in floor drains throughout, and dust covered a vent above the mop sink.

headline: Leaking drainpipes at three-compartment sink
summary: Drainpipes for the rinse and sanitizer compartments of the three-compartment sink were leaking. The operator was instructed to repair them.

headline: About 40 live flying insects in food areas
summary: About 40 live small flying insects were found at the bar, food prep area, and basement storage; citation issued and more pest control is needed. No soap at the bar handsink; several food handlers lacked certificates.

headline: Bar handsink lacks splash guard; debris found
summary: The bar handsink had no splash guard to prevent contamination; a barrier must be provided. Debris was found under drying mats for glassware in the prep area and liquor well; it must be cleaned.

headline: Over 1,000 mouse droppings; live roach found
summary: Over 1,000 mouse droppings and a live roach were found throughout the facility; citation issued. Cold foods reached 76F; about 100 lbs ($200) discarded. Also: a dead roach on a cutting board and black buildup inside the ice machine.

headline: Dirty drains at dish unit and basement sinks
summary: The chemical drain line on the warewashing unit had excessive organic matter and a black substance. Floor drains for the warewashing unit and basement sinks had excessive debris. Detail cleaning and maintenance were ordered.

headline: Bowl used as scoop; no food handler proof
summary: A bowl was used as a scoop in a bean container in the walk-in cooler; the inspector ordered it removed. No proof of food handler training was provided. Also: unlabeled seasoning containers, improperly stored wiping cloths, and no thermometer in the display cooler.

headline: Outdated foods discarded; unprotected open buffets
summary: Unlabeled and expired ready-to-eat foods were discarded. Two open buffets lacked sneeze guards, one outdoors; all food was removed. Handsinks were used as dump sinks, and paper towels were missing; citations issued. Missing employee health policies.

headline: Missing handwash signs; dirty bar floors
summary: Two front bar handwashing sinks lacked signage; the manager must install and maintain it. Loose debris, dirt, and dust had built up on floors and in corners of the front bar and must be cleaned more often.

headline: Uncorrected core violations; no mop sink
summary: Previous core violations were not corrected: no splash guard between the hand sink and cooler, and no mop sink on site. Grease spills on floors under cooking equipment must be cleaned. Citation issued.

headline: Horchata in reused vinegar bottle; expired training
summary: Horchata was stored in a reused vinegar bottle inside a reach-in cooler; proper food-grade containers are required. Food handler and allergen training were missing or expired for some staff. Also: burnt-out lights and string used as a lid handle.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site
summary: No equipment was on site for vomit and diarrhea cleanup, a priority violation. The front food prep area needs a prep sink with hot and cold water. An employee lacks food handler proof. Also: raw wood shelving, peeling sink plastic, and damaged ceiling tiles.

headline: Food handler certificates not verified on site
summary: The inspector could not locate or verify food handler certificates during inspection; they must be provided and kept on site. The coffee station handwashing sink drains slowly and needs repair.

headline: Missing food handler training for all employees
summary: Food handler training was not provided for all employees and must be provided and maintained. A leaking furnace water connector dripped onto the basement floor. Also: food equipment stored on chairs, a missing restroom garbage lid, and dust on walls, ceilings, and vents.

headline: Ice bin needs cleaning; ice scoop misplaced
summary: The ice bin interior needed cleaning. An ice scoop was stored with its handle in the ice. Food containers in coolers and dry storage lacked name labels. The washroom had no handwashing sign, and no allergen training was on site.

headline: No employee health policy; dim basement lighting
summary: No written employee health policy was on site; this is a priority violation, and a signed policy is required for each employee. The backflow device at the basement ice machine must be relocated for service. Dim lighting at the basement sink must be fixed.

headline: Front door gap must be rodent-proofed
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the front entrance door sweep must be sealed so the door is rodent-proof. No pests were noted.

headline: No food handler certificates on site
summary: No food handler certificates were on site; the manager was told to comply. The rear side exit door has a 1/4-inch gap that must be sealed to keep pests out. Soiled mop heads must be hung to prevent insect breeding. Food containers need labels.

headline: Ice machine interior dirty; restroom door not self-closing
summary: The empty ice machine interior was not clean; the inspector ordered cleaning and sanitizing of all interior surfaces. The north washroom door has no self-closing device, which must be provided and maintained.

headline: Missing beverage prep sink; exit door gap
summary: The beverage station has no prep sink, which is required in any food prep area. An opening at the rear exit door must be sealed. An employee lacks allergen training proof. Also: a leaking faucet, faded dish machine data plate, and mops drying in a utility sink.

headline: Rear door gap; missing sink supplies and policies
summary: Rear side door has a gap and must be made rodent-proof. Hand soap and paper towels were missing at sinks; provided during inspection. Also: no employee health policy, no vomit/diarrhea cleanup supplies, no handwashing signs, and missing thermometers.

headline: Sushi held too warm; non-service dogs inside
summary: Sushi and other cold foods were 44.1-57.2F, above the 41F limit; 35 lbs ($300) discarded. A sushi display cooler at 49.1F must not be used until repaired. Non-service dogs were inside and must be removed; citation issued.

headline: Soiled mop heads not properly stored
summary: Soiled mop heads were not stored properly. The manager was told to hang them to prevent insect breeding. No other issues were listed.

headline: Panini press and grill lack ventilation
summary: A panini press and flat-top grill lack adequate mechanical ventilation. The operator must provide ventilation or remove the cooking equipment.

headline: No grease trap at three-compartment sink
summary: The three-compartment sink has no grease trap; the operator must provide one and make it known. The office floor is littered under shelves and along corners and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: No certified manager while serving food
summary: The person in charge lacked a City certified manager certificate while preparing and serving hot dogs, chili, and hamburgers; citation issued. Food handlers must have certificates on site. A leaky faucet on the rear prep two-compartment sink needs repair.

headline: Window AC gap; rusty sink and dim light
summary: An opening around a rear window air conditioner must be sealed to keep pests out. Also: rust on a sink grease trap, ceramic cups needing lead-safety records, a slow-draining sink compartment, and a non-working light.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies
summary: No procedures or supplies were on site for vomit and diarrhea cleanup; priority violation. Also: no handwashing sign at washroom sink, no backflow device on utility sink, and no mechanical ventilation in the washroom.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; unsafe food temperatures
summary: Chlorine dish machine dispensed no sanitizer (0 ppm); tagged, so use the three-compartment sink until repaired. Cooked potatoes cooled too slowly and must be reheated to 165F. Sausage held at 103.6F was discarded; citations issued.

headline: Employee washed hands in dish sink
summary: An employee washed hands in the three-compartment sink, which is not allowed; citation issued. A previous violation was not corrected: an employee worked without a food handler certificate. Also: peeling cooler lining, moldy caulking, and items stored on floors.

headline: Dish area floor debris; hood filters greasy
summary: Debris, dirt, and items on the floor around equipment in the rear dish area must be cleaned and decluttered to prevent pest harboring. Hood ventilation filters in the rear food service area had dust and grease buildup.

headline: Handwashing signs missing at two sinks
summary: Two of three handwashing sinks in the prep and dish areas lacked handwashing signage. The inspector instructed the operator to post signs at all handwashing sinks. No other issues were listed.

headline: No food temperature thermometer; no health policy
summary: No food temperature measuring device was on site, and no verifiable employee health policy was available. The City sanitation certificate was not posted. No allergen training was on site. Debris was found around the dumpster.

headline: 60-80 mouse droppings found across kitchen
summary: About 60-80 mouse droppings were found across food prep, storage, and restroom areas; citation issued. Sticky traps held dead mice and roaches. No pest control logbook was on site. Also: dirty floors, cooking equipment, and missing thermometers.

headline: Dirty floors and washroom; unused freezer
summary: Floors and shelving are dirty, especially along wall bases and under pallets. An unused ice cream freezer holds standing water and debris and must be cleaned or removed. The washroom needs a lidded garbage can, a self-closing door, and cleaning.

headline: No valid City-certified manager on site
summary: No manager with a valid City of Chicago certificate was on site; citation issued. The required inspection summary was not posted for the public. Single-service boxes sat on the basement floor, and counters had debris and coffee buildup.

headline: Bed in food storage; previous violations uncorrected
summary: A bed in rear food storage must be removed; no sleeping quarters are allowed. The hot water tank in rear storage leaks and must be repaired. No food handler or allergen certificates were on site. Previous violations were not corrected; citation issued.

headline: No hot running water; refrigerator too warm
summary: No hot running water on premises; the three-compartment sink measured 104.5F, below the 110F requirement. A two-door refrigerator at 45.1F was tagged and corrected on site. Also: no customer barrier to prep area, no metal stem thermometer, and missing allergen training.

headline: Grocery cooler running too warm at 72.4F
summary: The grocery-area 5-door cooler measured 72.4F air temperature and must be repaired to hold 41F or colder. No thermometers were inside refrigeration units. Also: non-self-closing washroom door and materials stored outside rear exit door.

headline: Unlabeled bulk foods; cup used as sugar scoop
summary: Dry foods sold in plastic bags lacked labels. A plastic cup was used as a scoop in bulk sugar; use a handled utensil. Worn cutting board on the grill must be replaced. Plastic wrap and cardboard covered surfaces.

headline: Deli cups not air-dried after washing
summary: Deli cups were not air-dried after washing. The operator was told to air-dry all utensils after washing. No other issues were noted.

headline: Food in plastic grocery bags; sink stoppers missing
summary: Food was stored in plastic grocery bags in the freezer and a cold holding unit; food-grade containers are required. Three-compartment sink stoppers are missing or not working. Toilet room exhaust vents need detail cleaning.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink faucet
summary: The three-compartment sink has a leaking handle and faucet. The manager was instructed to repair and maintain it. No other issues were noted.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; sink stoppers missing
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and must be repaired before use. Until fixed, dishes must be washed, rinsed, and sanitized in the three-compartment sink. Stoppers for the three-compartment sink are missing and must be provided.

headline: Handwashing sinks blocked by pans and utensils
summary: Both prep-area handwashing sinks were blocked with pans and utensils, a priority violation. The front prep station lacks a sneeze guard where customers sit across from open food. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints.

headline: Cold beef and ham too warm; 10 lbs discarded
summary: Cold beef and ham measured 46.8-50.4F, above the 41F limit; about 10 lbs ($200) was discarded and cited. No chlorine test kit was on site; cited. Also: beverage station lacks a prep sink; menu lacks raw-food advisory.

headline: Broken glass and debris on bar floor
summary: Food debris and broken glass were on the floor throughout the bar behind equipment and must be removed. A burned-out bulb in basement storage must be replaced.

headline: Ashtrays and open drinks in food areas
summary: Ashtrays with cigarette butts were found on a shelf near cereal above a prep table and in a washroom; citation issued. An employee drank from an open cup in the rear prep area. Also: unlabeled bulk containers and greasy equipment.

headline: Hot holding box lacks thermometer; no sink stopper
summary: The hot holding box has no thermometer, and the three-compartment sink has no stopper. The operator was instructed to provide both.

headline: Dead flies on floor; several repairs needed
summary: Dead flies were found on the floor in a prep area corner and must be removed and cleaned. Food storage containers lacked labels. Also: tape used to fix a leaking drainpipe, damaged walls and duckboards, and a dirty hood.

headline: About 30 mouse droppings found; manager arrived late
summary: About 30 mouse droppings were found, including near a two-door refrigerator; pest control was recommended and a citation issued. The manager was absent but arrived at 10:10 AM, corrected on site. Dish machine at 0 ppm chlorine was tagged.

headline: Dusty ceiling light covers in prep area
summary: Dust had built up on ceiling light covers in the prep area. The operator must clean and maintain them. No food safety violations were listed.

headline: Grease spills in fryers; dusty hood
summary: Minor grease spills were inside the fryers and must be cleaned. Minor dust buildup was on the ventilation hood and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Rodent droppings found; cooling units not working
summary: Rodent droppings found: about 8 small and 2 large near the walk-in cooler and dry storage. Three-door cooler and walk-in cooler not working; units tagged and held. Front hand sink lacked hot water. Person in charge lacked a valid manager certificate.

headline: No food handler training for any employees
summary: No food handler training was available for employees; manager must provide it. Food was stored on floors in prep and dish areas and must be raised. Grease and debris built up on equipment, walls, floors, and inside the hood.

headline: Cold food held too warm; 60 lbs discarded
summary: Pastry and beef in a cold-holding unit measured 48.9-52F, above the 41F limit. About 60 lbs of food ($300) was discarded; a reach-in cooler at 52.3F was tagged. Also: missing handwashing signage and unlabeled rice and flour containers.

headline: Over 100 rodent droppings; unsafe food temperatures
summary: Over 100 rodent droppings were found across concession and bar areas; citation issued. Food was held at unsafe temperatures, including cold foods up to 54F and reheated pasta and pork at 135-145F. 170 lbs ($1,200) discarded. A 67F pizza cooler was tagged.

headline: Food debris on all floors; unlabeled containers
summary: Excessive food debris was found on all floors behind cooking equipment and must be cleaned. Cornmeal and flour lacked labels, and an ice scoop was left lying on ice in the bar. The scoop handle must be stored upward.

headline: Cook lacks beard restraint; wiping cloth issues
summary: A cook with a beard had no beard or hair restraint; restraints are required for all food handlers. Used linens were on cutting boards, and sanitizing buckets are needed at prep tables. Also: unlabeled containers, leaking faucet, non-self-closing basement door.

headline: Raw beef held too warm; discarded on site
summary: Raw beef in the rear cooler measured 60.4-64.6F, above the 41F limit. About 65 lbs was discarded on site with a citation. An employee had no food handler training. Also: a water filter on a handwashing faucet, unlabeled bulk containers, and an improperly stored knife.

headline: About 30 rat droppings found in rear storage
summary: About 30 rat droppings were found in the rear storage room; citation issued. A half-inch gap under the rear door must be sealed. Also: no soap at a handsink, food residue in cold units, and no manager allergen certificate.

headline: Bed and personal items found behind counter
summary: A bed was found behind the cooler and front counter, with employee personal items on shelves behind the counter. These must be removed from the premises. Rust on walk-in cooler wire racks must be removed.

headline: Undated deli sandwiches; dead bugs on ceiling traps
summary: Honey turkey and ham sub sandwiches in a self-serve cooler were not date-marked and had no food log; citation issued. Dead bugs were on sticky traps across the ceilings. Also: frozen chitterlings sat at room temperature; sink stoppers missing.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; allergen training missing
summary: Milk crates are used as shelving throughout prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving raised 6 inches off the floor. A food service sanitation manager lacked an allergen training certificate and was told to obtain one.

headline: Soiled ice machine and cooler floor debris
summary: The interior of the rear ice machine was soiled. Floors beneath walk-in cooler shelving had dried food debris. Employee drinks were stored above clean linens and single-use items; a separate designated area is required.

headline: Worn door weather strip; leaking hand sink
summary: The front door weather strip is worn and must be replaced to prevent possible pest entry; no gap was found underneath. The rear hand sink leaks at the base of the hot water knob and must be repaired.

headline: Greasy cooking equipment and soiled walls
summary: Exteriors of deep fryers and the griddle had grease and dust buildup in the main kitchen. Walls behind cooking equipment and beneath the bar's three-compartment sink were soiled. Regular cleaning and maintenance were ordered.

headline: 20+ rodent droppings found in dishwashing area
summary: Over 20 rodent droppings were under a storage shelf in the dishwashing area; priority violation with citation. Gnats were near a floor drain. The rear exit door is not rodent-proof. Also no employee health policy or cleanup kit on site.

headline: No hot water at toilet-room handsink; clutter
summary: Front and rear exit doors have 1/4-inch gaps that must be rodent-proofed. The toilet-room handsink had no hot water and must provide at least 100F; priority violation. Heavy equipment and prep tables were soiled; rear storage was cluttered.

headline: Cold foods too warm; dead insects found
summary: Dumplings at 72F, sushi at 70.5-71F, and chicken at 52F were held at unsafe temperatures; 15 lbs ($250) discarded, citation issued. Entire cooler lacked date marks. Dead insects were on floors. Also: greasy floors, leaking drainpipe, and missing handwashing signs.

headline: Debris in floor drains and under equipment
summary: Debris was found inside floor drains, on floors under all equipment, along walls, and in corners in prep and storage areas. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain these areas.

headline: No certified food manager on site while open
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager was on site while open; citation issued. No food handler certificate was on site. Also: a missing handwashing sign, sink stoppers in poor repair, and dirty floors and microwaves.

headline: Aluminum foil on rear storage shelf
summary: Aluminum foil covered a rear storage shelf. The operator must remove it so the surface stays smooth and easy to clean. No other issues were listed.

headline: Gap under exit door; leaking bar sink faucet
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the single exit door must be adjusted or replaced to prevent pest entry. The four-compartment bar sink leaks at the right faucet. A handwashing sign is needed at the rear prep one-compartment sink.

headline: Cleaning needed for coolers, floors, and walls
summary: Coolers and freezer interiors need cleaning to remove spills or debris. Floors along walls and in corners of waitress stations, dish room, and kitchen need cleaning. Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizer. The manager was told allergen training is required.

headline: No certified manager during ready-food prep
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while ready-to-eat foods such as deli meats and tomatoes were being prepared; citation issued. The person in charge lacks a manager certificate. Employees lacked food handler proof; manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Beef held at 54.8F; discarded on site
summary: Beef stored in the prep and dish area measured 54.8F, above the 41F limit. The operator discarded it during inspection; citation issued. Allergen training was missing, a repeat violation. Excess debris was around the dumpster.

headline: 25 mouse droppings behind freezers
summary: 25 mouse droppings were found behind rear deep freezers; citation issued and pest control service is needed. A previous allergen training violation for a manager was not corrected. Floors and walk-in cooler need cleaning; the freezer needs defrosting.

headline: Outdated foods discarded; repeat violations
summary: Prepared TCS foods in the walk-in cooler had no date labels; all were discarded and cited. Prior violations for dirty floors and grease were not corrected; citation issued. Also: a cook needs a beard restraint, wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer, and floor tiles are damaged.

headline: Boxed food on floor; debris in bakery
summary: Boxed food items were on the floor in the rear dairy walk-in cooler and must be raised six inches. Food debris was on the bakery prep area floor and must be cleaned.

headline: Improper utensil and cloth storage; allergen gap
summary: Wet wiping cloths were left on prep tables and coolers, and an ice cream scoop sat in standing water; management was instructed to correct both. Also: a missing self-closing restroom door, a missing light shield, and a manager without allergen certificate.

headline: Dead roaches under equipment; signage corrected on site
summary: Dead roaches were seen under equipment, as the complaint described; the inspector ordered removal. Missing handwashing signage was corrected on site. Also: an unclean can opener blade, no self-closing washroom door, and missing or water-stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Leaking sink faucet; dirty floor drains
summary: The three-compartment sink faucet was leaking and must be repaired. Floor drains had rust, dirt, and debris buildup and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Cut produce needs labels; leaking sink pipe
summary: Cut fruit and vegetables prepared in-house and displayed for sale must be labeled. A leaky pipe at the far right basin of the three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager was on site; manager must be present at all times. Openings at both entrance outer doors must be sealed to keep pests out. Rust inside the ice machine: ice must be destroyed and the machine cleaned and sanitized.

headline: Missing ceiling tiles above mop sink
summary: Ceiling tiles are missing in the rear area above the mop sink. The operator was instructed to replace them. No other issues were noted.

headline: Dead insects found; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Dead insects were found beside the ice machine. The low-temperature dish machine was not dispensing sanitizer; it was tagged and cited, and the three-compartment sink must be used. Also: large faucet leak, damaged gaskets and floor tiles.

headline: Rusted walk-in cooler racks
summary: Walk-in cooler racks were rusted. The manager was instructed to repaint or replace them.

headline: Outdoor grease container not maintained; citation issued
summary: The outside grease container had thick grease around and on top of it, and a citation was issued. Food stored in plastic containers lacked common-name labels. A hot-holding pot lid knob was missing, and a wall hole behind a sink needs sealing.

headline: No manager on site; eggs above 41F; no logbook
summary: No certified food manager with the original certificate was on site while open, and a citation was issued. Eggs were left on the floor at 77.9F, and 93 eggs worth $35 were discarded. No pest control logbook was on site, and a citation was issued. The front door has a gap at the bottom.

headline: Food on walk-in floor; items under unshielded sewer lines
summary: Crates of food and buttercream were stored on the walk-in cooler floor and must be elevated six inches. Food equipment and utensils were stored under unshielded wastewater lines in the basement. Only one allergen training certificate was shown for multiple certified managers.

headline: Pink slime in ice machine; no food handler certificates
summary: A pink substance was found inside the ice machine's ice bin, and that ice is used for drinks. Staff were told to clean and sanitize the unit. Missing items include food handler and allergen training certificates, and a cutting board was stored on a sink backsplash.

headline: No sanitizer test strips; leaking prep sink drain
summary: No chlorine test strips were on site to check sanitizer strength at the three-compartment sink, and a citation was issued. A drain line under the prep sink leaks and must be repaired. The walk-in freezer needs a working light.

headline: General cleaning needed to prevent pests
summary: The rear hand sink area needs cleaning, with dust on metal shelves and dirt and debris under and around equipment along the walls. The operator was instructed to clean all areas to prevent pest or insect activity.

headline: About 15 dead cockroaches found in basement
summary: About 15 dead cockroaches were found under basement shelves, and the manager was told to remove them and keep the area clear. Soup was thawing at room temperature. Repeat violations were not corrected, including a leaking three-compartment sink drain and a cluttered basement, and a citation was issued.

headline: About 50 mouse droppings in dry storage area
summary: No valid food service manager certificate was on site while beef and chicken were handled and served. About 50 mouse droppings were found in the dry food storage room and near the hot water heater, and pest control was recommended. Milk crates were used as shelving, and floors need repair.

headline: Re-inspection: cleaning orders for ice machine and fryer
summary: Re-inspection found several cleaning items. The ice machine panel needs cleaning, and the fryer, grill, prep coolers, and cabinet under the fryer need grease and droppings removed. Restroom vents and hood vents also need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; black mold in ice machine
summary: No certified manager or sanitation certificate was on site during TCS food prep, and a citation was issued. Also cited: no written employee health policy, and black mold in the ice machine used for drinks, which was discarded and cleaned. Staff lacked hair restraints.

headline: Frozen chicken thawed improperly; clutter; grease
summary: Frozen chicken was thawing in the food prep area, and staff were told to thaw TCS foods only under running water, in a refrigerator, or in a microwave. Cardboard was used as a cooler liner, and grease covers cooking equipment. Clutter was found in the front prep area, and mop heads need proper storage.

headline: Reduced-oxygen packaging without approval; food discarded
summary: Food was packaged using reduced-oxygen methods without an approved variance from the City. Staff stopped the process, and the person in charge voluntarily discarded about 20 pounds of TCS food. A citation was issued. Also noted: a condensate hose draining onto the floor and heavy grease under fryers.

headline: Cooked chicken too cool; about 10 live flies
summary: About 15 pounds of cooked chicken held at 120-122F in a front hot-holding unit, below the required 135F. The chicken was discarded, and a citation was issued. A hot-holding unit ran at 96-126F and was tagged. About 10 live large flies were flying around the prep area, and a citation was issued.

headline: Dead flies found inside ice machine and ice
summary: Small dead flies were found inside the ice machine and on the ice, which is used for drinks. Staff were told to discard all ice and clean and sanitize the machine, and a citation was issued. Dry storage containers lacked labels, and certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Hot seafood below 135F; cold salads above 41F
summary: A hot-holding display unit was turned off and held seafood at 80-86F, and about $520 of food was discarded. Egg salad at 51F and crab salad at 53F were also discarded, worth about $100. Prepackaged foods lacked ingredient labels, and a male food handler lacked a beard guard.

headline: No thermometer in prep cooler
summary: No thermometer was present inside the prep cooler opposite the exposed handwashing sink in the rear prep area. The operator was instructed to provide one.

headline: Missing splash guards at server-alley sink
summary: The handwashing sink in the server's alley had no left or right splash guards. The operator was instructed to install them to prevent contamination of equipment.

headline: Loose cooler gasket; debris behind tortillas
summary: A walk-in cooler door gasket in the meat department is loose and must be repaired. Debris was found on the floor behind tortillas stored in front of the butcher display. The person in charge was told to clean it.

headline: Bread stored under sink; no food handler proof
summary: Bread was stored directly under a handwashing sink, which is not allowed. Rust was found inside the tall cooler, and cardboard was used as shelf lining. The west washroom has very low cold-water pressure, and no food handler proof or manager allergen training was on site.

headline: Leaking sink valves; dirty floors and walls
summary: A leak was found at the valves under the sanitizing compartment of the three-compartment sink. Floors in corners, under racks, and inside walk-in coolers and freezers have food and dirt buildup. Walls around sinks and equipment have food stains.

headline: Broken sink drainpipe; missing backflow device
summary: The three-compartment sink drainpipe is in poor repair, and a citation was issued. The utility sink faucet leaks and has no backflow device. Boxes were stored on a crate, and the employee restroom door does not self-close. Food debris was found on microwaves and prep tables.

headline: Floor grout gaps; manager lacks allergen training
