summary: The floors under the deep fryers, dishwashing area, and front service window have openings and need regrouting. A microwave had food splatters. The certified food manager on site did not have allergen training records.

headline: No certified manager on site; citation issued
summary: No certified food manager was on site, and no original certificate was present. A citation was issued. Hot food on the front prep line was uncovered, a cabinet under the beverage dispenser was dirty, and a leak under the three-compartment sink needs repair.

headline: Freezer ice buildup and dusty restroom vent
summary: Chest freezers had excessive ice buildup inside. The toilet room vent had dirt and dust buildup. Staff were instructed to remove the ice, clean the freezers, and clean the vent.

headline: No certified manager on premises; citation issued
summary: No person in charge held a valid City food sanitation certificate, and a citation was issued. The operator must have one on premises during all hours of operation. An opening at the base of the front entrance doors must be sealed. Floor buildup and missing allergen training were also noted.

headline: Steak above 41F; shrimp lacked date label
summary: Steak at 46.4F and tomatoes at 50.5F were held in the prep cooler above 41F, and about 4 pounds worth $50 were discarded. Ready-to-eat shrimp held over 24 hours lacked a date label, and a citation was issued. Heavy grease and food debris covered cooking equipment and floors.

headline: Broken cooler door; missing handwashing sign
summary: The left door on a two-door prep cooler is broken and must be repaired, which was a repeat violation from 2023. A handwashing sign was missing at the front prep sink. The women's restroom also lacks a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

headline: Clutter in basement storage area
summary: Unnecessary items were stored in the basement storage area. The operator was instructed to remove them to reduce clutter.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; three managers lack allergen training
summary: Handwashing signs are missing at the basement prep sink and staff restroom sink. Rust was found on prep table bottoms, and the basement employee restroom lacks a covered waste receptacle. Three certified managers did not have allergen training.

headline: Greasy floors and dusty fans, vents
summary: Grease, food debris, and dirt covered the floors under cooking equipment and along walls and corners in prep, dishwashing, storage, and basement areas. Dust covered the walk-in cooler fan, light shields, and ceiling and wall vents.

headline: New food handlers lacked training proof; missing signage
summary: New food handlers had no proof of food handler training. Handwashing signs are needed at two restroom sinks and the bar sink. Rusty racks and a rusty grease box lid need repair, and a certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Cooked chicken at 83.4F; no soap at prep sink
summary: About 20 pounds of cooked chicken were held at 83.4F in a hot-holding unit that was not turned on. The chicken was discarded, worth $70, and a priority violation was noted. The main prep kitchen hand sink had no soap, and an ice maker lacked a backflow device.

headline: No certified manager during hot dog service
summary: No City food sanitation manager or valid certificate was on site while hot dogs were being prepared and served, and a citation was issued. No metal-stem food thermometer was on site, and a citation was also issued.

headline: Hot and cold foods at unsafe temps; 360+ lbs discarded
summary: Chicken and pork were left at room temperature, and boiled eggs were held at 79F. About 360 pounds were discarded. Eight ducks in the walk-in were at 48-55F, and a drying unit held ducks at 55.4F without an approved plan, leading to about 200 pounds discarded. Also noted: a drain line connection that overflows.

headline: Mouse droppings found near prep kitchen
summary: About 15 mouse droppings were found in a furnace closet next to the prep kitchen. Pest control was judged inadequate. The operator was told to eliminate rodent activity, and a pest control service was recommended. Priority violation 7-38-020(A).

headline: Food stored on floor; missing signs and labels
summary: Food and non-food items must be stored at least six inches off the floor. Handwashing signs are needed at two sinks. Storage containers need common-name labels, and coolers need visible thermometers. Raw wood shelves should be sealed or painted.

headline: Rat droppings found around produce and liquor
summary: About 40 rat droppings were found under wooden pallets holding produce and fruit, and about 25 more were in the liquor cabinet in the rear stock room. Management was told to remove them, and additional pest control is needed. A citation was issued. A gap in the third-floor automatic doors also needs repair.

headline: No certified manager during beef prep; one arrived
summary: No City certified food manager was on site while beef and other TCS foods were being prepared. A citation was issued. A certified manager arrived at 3:10 PM. Also noted: unlabeled rice, soiled wiping cloths on prep tables, and grease on equipment.

headline: Cold foods above 41F discarded; citation issued
summary: Cold TCS foods were held above 41F, including beef and cooked rice. The manager discarded about 16 pounds, worth $75, and a citation was issued. Also noted: a missing splash guard, grease and debris on equipment, and debris on floors.

headline: Insect trap with dead insects stored above prep table
summary: A sticky insect control device filled with dead insects was stored above a food prep table and must be moved. Dry ingredients and squirt bottles lacked labels. Utensils were not inverted, the deep fryer was left uncovered and filled with grease, and a light bulb under the hood is out.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; loose faucet
summary: A two-door prep cooler has a torn interior gasket that must be repaired or replaced. A faucet at the server-area handwashing sink is loose and needs repair.

headline: No commercial dumpster; grease and old equipment
summary: The facility uses residential trash cans instead of a commercial dumpster, and a citation was issued. Cutting boards have open seams and dark stains. Milk crates are on the prep floor, grease covers cooking equipment and walls, and a light above the grill is burned out.

headline: Cold TCS foods above 41F; cooler tagged, not in use
summary: Fish, chicken, tomatoes, beans, feta, and greens in the kitchen prep cooler were held at 45.5-51.1F, above the 41F limit. About 6 pounds worth $50 were discarded, and a citation was issued. The cooler was tagged and must not be used until repaired. Hair restraints and handwashing signs were also needed.

headline: Debris under sink; allergen training not on site
summary: Dirt and small debris built up in wall corners and under the three-compartment sink area, and staff were instructed to clean it. Not all certified food managers had allergen training available on site.

headline: Food in plastic bags; no handler certificates on site
summary: Food was stored in plastic grocery bags inside coolers and freezers and must be moved to approved food-grade containers. Soiled mop heads were not stored properly. No food handler certificates were on site, and staff were told to comply with the requirement.

headline: No employee health policy; no food handler certificates
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site, and a template was left. Food handler certificates were not on site, so all employees must complete training. Also noted: no covered trash can in the restroom, water-stained ceilings, and mop heads not properly stored.

headline: Rodent device upside down; clutter, holes, no lid
summary: A rodent device was placed upside down on the floor of the liquor storage closet and must be placed right side up. Other items include an unfinished basement ceiling above the refrigerator, no splash guard at the bar sink, no covered receptacle in the women's restroom, and clutter and holes in the basement.

headline: Cooked foods lacked discard dates; no paper towels
summary: Several cooked foods (potatoes, pork, chicken) held over a day in the walk-in cooler had no discard date; a priority violation was noted. The first-floor kitchen hand sink lacked paper towels. Fly traps hung above food and clean utensils must be removed.

headline: Disposable spoons and loose strainer wires
summary: Disposable spoons were used in food production, and food strainers had loose wires. The operator was instructed to use proper utensils.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training
summary: The sanitation manager on site had no allergen training. The operator was instructed to provide it.

headline: Paletas mislabeled; missing splashguard and drainboard
summary: Packaged paletas lacked a common name and full ingredient list. A splashguard is missing between the hand sink and the three-compartment sink, and a drainboard is missing at the warewashing area. The restroom door does not self-close.

headline: About 100 live flies; no certified manager on duty
summary: No certified food manager was on duty, and no certificate was posted while TCS foods were prepared and served. About 100 or more live small flies were found throughout the premises, and a citation was issued. A pest control operator was recommended. A broken thermometer and damaged surfaces were also noted.

headline: Damaged cooler gaskets and burned-out lights
summary: Some prep cooler door gaskets were damaged or not tight-fitting and must be repaired or replaced. Ceiling light bulbs above the rear prep area by the walk-in cooler were burned out and must be replaced.

headline: Multiple cold foods above 41F; 35 lbs discarded
summary: Several TCS foods in the front prep cooler were held above 41F, including steak at 53.2F, shrimp at 50.1F, and raw beef at 54.1F. The manager voluntarily discarded about 35 pounds worth $222, and a citation was issued. Leaks, damaged floor tiles, and ceiling damage also need repair.

headline: Soap dispenser over sink; damaged ice cream freezers
summary: A soap dispenser was installed above a one-compartment sink and must be moved to avoid contaminating food or equipment. Three ice cream freezers have peeling interior surfaces that expose insulation. Rust was found near the freezer sliding doors.

headline: Repeat violations: dirty equipment, floors, clutter
summary: A disposable bowl was stored inside bulk dry storage bins, and clean tableware was not inverted. Prior core violations were not corrected, including dirty freezers, grease on cooking equipment, debris on floors, and cobwebs and clutter. A citation was issued.

headline: Food on floor; unlabeled salt and sugar
summary: Food was stored on the floor in the prep area, and salt and sugar were kept out of original containers without labels. Soiled wiping cloths were left on prep tables. Unused equipment and unnecessary articles in the basement storage area must be removed to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: Grease buildup, unlabeled containers, cardboard shelving
summary: Items out of original containers were unlabeled. Cardboard was used as shelf liner, and grease and food debris covered cooking equipment, coolers, and freezers. Floors along walls and corners had debris, mop storage was improper, and a water-stained ceiling tile needs replacing.

headline: Unlabeled food containers; no allergen training
summary: Food storage containers did not show the common name of the food. No certified food manager on site had allergen training, and staff were instructed to provide a certificate.

headline: Dirty coolers, standing water, clutter blocking sink
summary: The bottoms of cold holding units and a large reach-in freezer need cleaning. Standing water was found under the ramp to the walk-in freezer, and floors need cleaning. Clutter in the utility closet was blocking a sink and must be removed.

headline: Employee without food handler certificate
summary: A food handling employee did not have a food handler certificate. Management was instructed that all food handling employees must show proof of training.

headline: Several issues corrected during inspection
summary: No thermometer was in the three-door prep cooler, and the manager provided one during the inspection. Scoop handles were touching bulk flour, and equipment was stored below unprotected sewer lines. Plates were inverted during the visit, and an employee cleaned the microwave. A faucet at the spray sink drips.

headline: Gap at dock door base; damaged tile by dish machine
summary: An opening at the base of the left dock door in the dumpster area must be sealed to prevent pests. Grout is missing and a tile is damaged near the high-temperature dish machine. No pests were found during this visit.

headline: No certified manager on site; corrected on arrival
summary: No City certified food service manager was on premises, but one arrived at 10:35 AM, which corrected the issue. A citation was issued. Hand sinks in the prep area ran at 128.5-138.8F, above the 120F maximum. A cold holding unit was at 60.4F and was tagged.

headline: Workers handled ready-to-eat sandwiches with bare hands
summary: Employees picked up ready-to-eat sandwiches with bare hands before plating. Staff were told to use gloves, and a citation was issued. The sandwich was rapidly heated to 165F. Cardboard was used as shelving, and certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: About 20 live flies in food prep area
summary: About 20 live small flies were flying around the food prep area, landing on walls and cabinets. The operator was instructed to eliminate them, clean affected areas, and contact pest control. A priority citation was issued. A covered receptacle is also missing in the women's toilet room.

headline: Overloaded trash with missing lid; dirty floors
summary: The outside garbage container was missing its lid and overloaded, creating a possible food source for pests, and a citation was issued. Cracked floor tiles and damaged ceiling tiles were found in the rear area. Coolers, counters, floors, drains, and light shields need cleaning.

headline: Rat droppings throughout; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Rat droppings were found across the premises, including about 50 behind the kitchen cooler and fryer and more in the basement. The basement ice machine had black slime dripping into the ice. The dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine, was tagged, and must not be used until repaired.

headline: No food handler certificate for kitchen staff
summary: Kitchen staff had no food handler certificate. Also noted: a missing thermometer in the prep cooler, a missing cover for the small ice maker, and broken floor tiles in the walk-in cooler.

headline: Over 35 flies in multiple food prep areas
summary: Over 25 small flies and over 10 large flies were found in the facility, including in the bakery, pizza and deli prep area, and meat and seafood prep area. The operator was told to eliminate them and clean affected areas, and pest control was recommended. A priority citation was issued.

headline: Slow-draining three-compartment sink; citation issued
summary: The three-compartment sink drains slowly and must be kept in proper working order. The manager was told to repair it, and a priority citation was issued.

headline: Dish machine too cool; chicken stock held warm
summary: The conveyor dish machine's final rinse was 164F, below the required 180-195F, and a priority violation was noted. About 20 pounds of chicken stock at 62.4F, held in the walk-in a day, was discarded. The stock was also cooled in a large container, and staff were told to split it into smaller ones.

headline: Food stored on floor; no food handler training
summary: Food was stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and storage areas and must be elevated six inches. No food handler training was available, and a certified manager had no allergen certificate on site. Stained ceiling tiles and clutter were also noted.

headline: Ground beef and meatballs above 41F; discarded
summary: Ground beef and meatballs in a cooler at the cookline were held between 48.5F and 52F, above the 41F limit. About 9 pounds, worth $32, were voluntarily discarded, and a citation was issued. The cooler was unplugged and restarted, and it now reads 37F.

headline: Prepared foods held 24+ hours without date labels
summary: Chicken, beef, beans, and house-made sauces prepared on site were held over 24 hours without date labels. The person in charge voluntarily discarded the food, and a citation was issued. Heavy equipment needs cleaning, and a large hole in the rear prep wall must be repaired.

headline: Grease under fryers; cutting boards with deep cuts
summary: Cutting boards at the salad station and cook line have deep cuts and stains and must be restored or replaced. Grease and food debris were found under all kitchen fryers. Floors under booths had dry food debris, and a floor drain near the ice machine needs cleaning.

headline: Gap at rear door bottom; cardboard shelf liners
summary: The rear exit door had a gap at the bottom that must be sealed to keep pests out. Walk-in cooler wire racks were rusted, and cardboard boxes were used to line shelves. Grease buildup was on the wok and deep fryer, and a broken unused chest freezer must be removed.

headline: Dead mouse found on sticky trap; removed on site
summary: A dead mouse was found on a sticky trap next to the cheese prep area. The trap was removed and the area was cleaned and sanitized on site. Pest control was recommended to replace the trap. Milk crates are used as shelving, and a prep sink faucet leaks.

headline: Repeat violations: hair restraints, leak, no allergen training
summary: Prior core violations were not corrected: food prep workers lacked hair restraints, a rear sink cold-water knob leaked, and toilet room trash cans had no lids. Certified managers lacked allergen training, and a citation was issued. Also missing: handwashing signs.

headline: Cold steak, vegetables above 41F; cooler tagged
summary: Steak at 53.1F and sliced vegetables at 52.9F were held in the front prep cooler above the 41F limit, and a citation was issued. The reach-in prep cooler was at 54F and was tagged for repair. Menu lacked a raw or undercooked food advisory, and food handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Personal items above ice machine; floor tiles cracked
summary: Employee personal care items were stored on a shelf above the ice machine and must be moved. Single-use items were on the floor in the rear kitchen. Grease and dust covered fryers, a three-compartment sink drain plug leaks, and floor tiles are loose or cracked.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; food stored in plastic bags
summary: A prep cooler has a torn gasket. Food was stored inside plastic grocery bags in coolers and the prep area and must be moved to approved food-grade containers. A certified food manager had an expired allergen training certificate.

headline: No valid manager certificate; dish machine lacks indicator
summary: No valid certified food manager certificate was posted while pizza and sandwiches were prepared and served, and a citation was issued. The dish machines lacked a temperature indicator, and a citation was issued. The cold water handle on a sink is broken, and ceiling tiles need replacing. No allergen training was shown.

headline: Live flies in prep areas; no certified manager
summary: No certified food manager was on site while eggs, dairy, and sausage were prepared and served, and a citation was issued. A food handler removed gloves and put on new ones without washing hands, which was also cited. About 20 small live flies and 2 large flies were found in the toilet room and prep areas.

headline: Heavy grease in exhaust hood; no allergen training
summary: The exhaust hood, filters, and pipes above cooking equipment had heavy dirt and grease buildup. A torn gasket was found on a prep service cooler. Certified food managers on duty lacked allergen training certification.

headline: No certified manager; hand sink blocked; no soap
summary: The person in charge had no valid City sanitation certificate, and no certified person was on site, so a citation was issued. The kitchen hand sink was blocked by a food cart and was cleared. It had no soap and very low cold-water pressure. Food handler proof was missing for all employees.

headline: Unlabeled containers; open milk cans; no allergen cert
summary: Thermometers are needed inside reach-in and prep coolers. Storage containers of sugar, salt, and seasoning need common-name labels. Open condensed and evaporated milk cans must be moved to food-grade containers. A certified manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: Sinks lacked soap and towels; dish machine broken
summary: No City certified food manager or certificate was on site. Several handwashing sinks lacked paper towels or soap, and two toilet-room sinks had no faucets. The dish machine was not working, and there was no thermometer, pest logbook, or dumpster. No citations were issued.

headline: Bare-hand contact with sushi rice; citation issued
summary: An employee made a sushi roll and grabbed sushi rice from the hot holding unit with bare hands. A priority citation was issued. Also noted: no consumer advisory on the menu for raw or undercooked foods, no temperature indicator on the dish machine, a leaking drain line, and an employee without a food handler certificate.

headline: No certified manager during cabbage prep; citation issued
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS food (cabbage at 187.7F) was prepared and served; a citation was issued. Food was stored on the prep-area floor, bulk containers were unlabeled, and there was no allergen training. Also noted: dust, a leaking faucet, and a washroom door that does not self-close.

headline: Dirty soda nozzles, toilet, and floors
summary: Self-serve soda machine nozzles need cleaning. A leak was found at the employee washroom basin. The customer toilet, washroom floors, and rear storage floors all need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; front prep sink lacks water
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while deli meat and chicken were handled and served. The front prep hand sink had no hot or cold water because of a leak, so it was shut off. Deli cups were not air-dried after washing.

headline: Items stored on walk-in cooler floor
summary: Items were found on the floor of the walk-in cooler. The person in charge was instructed to store all items at least six inches off the floor and keep them there.

headline: Deli salami held above 41F; discarded
summary: About 10 pounds of sliced salami were held at 51.3-57.5F in the front prep cooler, which is above the 41F limit. The food was discarded, worth $70, and a priority citation was issued. Food prep staff also lacked food handler certificates.

headline: Employee lacked food handler certificate
summary: A food handling employee did not have a food handler certificate. Management was instructed that all food handlers must show proof of training.

headline: Gnawed rice bag discarded; unlabeled food and storage issues
summary: A bag of rice on the display rack was found gnawed into, and about 15 pounds of food was discarded, with a priority citation issued. Bulk food and tofu lacked labels. Food was stored on floors, and milk and soda crates were used as shelving.

headline: Multiple cold foods above 41F; cooler told not to use
summary: Several TCS foods in service coolers were above 41F, including potatoes at 53.1F and hummus at 47F. About 6 pounds worth $150 were discarded, and a citation was issued. A prep-area cooler at 51.6F was ordered out of use until it reaches 41F. Trash dumpster lid was not closing.

headline: Heavy grease in hood; torn cooler gasket
summary: The exhaust hood, filters, and pipes above cooking equipment have heavy grease and dirt buildup. A torn gasket was found on prep service coolers. Floors along the walls and under equipment, especially at the dish area, need cleaning.

headline: Mold on storage wall; no food handler training
summary: Mold was found on the wall in the rear storage area next to the cooler and must be removed. Stained ceiling tiles, dust on walls, ceilings, and vents, and a damaged entry wall need repair. Staff had no food handler training on record.

headline: No certified person in charge; corrections made on site
summary: No person in charge holds a valid City sanitation certificate, and one must be present during all operating hours. Eye-wash attachments were removed from hand sinks and washroom sink water was repaired on site to 106 to 108°F.

headline: Ice scoop stored on top of ice machine
summary: An ice scoop was stored improperly on top of the ice machine. Management must provide a clean container for the scoop.

headline: Residue on slushy dispenser
summary: Residue has built up on the bottom of the slushy dispensing station. The person in charge was told to clean and maintain it.

headline: Person in charge lacks required food manager certificate
summary: The person in charge has no City of Chicago food service manager certificate and was told to obtain one. Also: grease on the fryer and prep table, dirty floors under and behind equipment, and dust on the washroom vent.

headline: No hot water per city code
summary: No hot water was found. Hand-washing and three-compartment sinks measured 74.2 to 75.4°F; the city requires 100 to 110°F. A citation was issued and the owner must provide and maintain hot water.

headline: Leaking hand sink; no sink at front service line
summary: A prep-area hand sink leaks when used. The front hot food serving line has no handwashing sink, which must be installed with hot and cold water, soap and towels. Bulk ingredients lack labels.

headline: No handwashing sink; no utility sink or restroom receptacle
summary: No handwashing sink is near the rear three-compartment sink, which must be installed with hot and cold water, soap and hand drying. No utility sink exists for mop water. The restroom lacks a covered receptacle and mechanical ventilation.

headline: Knives stored in walls; cardboard, rust and repeat violations
summary: Knives are stored between walls and equipment, and multi-use utensils must be inverted. Cardboard and rust are in the walk-in and prep table. Previous violations, including missing food handler training, are uncorrected.

headline: Dead roaches found; openings in doors
summary: Two dead roaches were in an unused men's locker, which must be cleaned. An opening in the lunchroom exit doors must be sealed. Containers stored on the utility room floor must be raised six inches.

headline: Stock on freezer floor; missing hair restraint
summary: Stock is on the walk-in freezer floor and must be raised six inches. A male food handler in meat prep had no hair restraint. A loose faucet is at the men's restroom hand sink.

headline: No certified manager present while handling food
summary: The person in charge has no City of Chicago sanitation certificate. Neither posted certified manager was present while chicken and deli meat were handled. A certified person arrived at the end of the inspection.

headline: No certified manager; cold food and date-marking violations
summary: No certified manager was on site while beef brisket was served. Cold food in the prep cooler was 54 to 57°F. Some foods were past their 7-day use-by date. Missing hand soap and paper towels, a hair restraint issue, and no allergen certificates.

headline: Blank health policy forms; no vomit cleanup kit
summary: Employee health policy forms on site are blank. No bodily fluid spill kit or cleanup procedure exists. Restrooms lack handwashing signs, and the mop sink lacks a backflow device. Rusted racks, a slow-draining sink and a grease trap lid with a hole were noted.

headline: Raw wood ceiling and poor restroom ventilation
summary: The basement employee restroom has an exposed raw wood ceiling that must be sealed. Ventilation in the customer restrooms is in poor repair and must be fixed.

headline: No thermometers in walk-in cooler or hot unit
summary: No thermometer is inside the walk-in cooler, and the hot-holding unit has no internal thermometer. Both must be installed and maintained so food temperatures can be checked.

headline: Around 75 flies found; expired food discarded
summary: About 75 small flies were found at a coffee bar, the dish area and bars; pest control service is required. TCS foods past their use-by date were discarded. No soap was at a basement prep sink until refilled. Allergen certificate missing.

headline: No certified food manager during chicken and beef prep
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken and beef (foods that must be kept hot or cold) were being prepared and served. Management was told a certified manager must be present at all times.

headline: Mold on ice machine; several repairs needed
summary: Pink and beige mold was found on the ice machine shield on the second floor and was ordered cleaned and sanitized. Also: a slow-draining sink, a missing self-closing door device, grease leaking in the basement, and no allergen training proof.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; serviced on site
summary: The low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine; 50 ppm is required. It was not to be used until reinspected. A technician serviced it during inspection and it read 100 ppm. Containers lack labels, and food is stored on the walk-in freezer floor.

headline: Rodent droppings found; pest control needed
summary: About 20 mouse droppings were in the furnace room and about 10 under dry storage racks. Additional pest control is needed. No written employee health policy, a gap at the rear exit door, and an allergen certificate missing from earlier inspections.

headline: Unlabeled pecans; food on cooler floor
summary: Pecans and spices outside original containers lack product-name labels. Food was stored on the walk-in cooler floor. Soiled wiping cloths were left on prep tables and must be stored in sanitizing solution.

headline: About 150 mouse droppings; cockroach found
summary: About 150 mouse droppings were found in the basement, dry storage and under the front counter. One live cockroach was on the grease trap. Additional pest control is needed. Floor cracks and food prep walls and floors need cleaning.

headline: Paper towels added during inspection; many repairs
summary: Paper towels were missing at the rear hand sink and were provided during inspection. Ice scoops are stored in food containers, and foil is on cooking equipment. Floors and ceilings need repair, and plumbing needs backflow and pressure fixes.

headline: Door gap, equipment under stairs, basement clutter
summary: A gap larger than 1/4 inch is at the bottom of the rear kitchen exterior door. Clean equipment is stored under the basement stairwell. Basement storage has heavy clutter. Owner must correct all three.

headline: Improper storage of plates and mops; allergen certificate missing
summary: Small plates were stored improperly in the food prep area, and mops were stored improperly in the utility room with clutter. No allergen training certificate was posted for the certified food manager on duty.

headline: Sink floods; hot food too cool; cigarettes found
summary: The front prep handwashing sink floods when turned on and cannot be used. Rice, potatoes and stuffed peppers in the hot unit were below 135°F; about 18 lbs was discarded. An ashtray and cigarettes were in the prep area.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; blender does not fit sink
summary: No handwashing sign is at the rear food prep handwashing sink. A large blender does not fit in the three-compartment sink, so a clean-in-place procedure is required.

headline: Milk crates, leaking faucet and dusty restrooms
summary: Milk crates are used as shelving in the walk-in cooler and dry storage. A faucet leaks in the men's employee restroom. Walls and floors in both restrooms have dust. Hood system above the grill has excessive grease.

headline: Unlabeled food, milk crates and sink repairs
summary: Dry storage food containers lack labels. Milk crates are used as shelving, and a mop sink needs a backflow device. A hand sink drains slowly. Debris is under the dumpster, and one food handler lacks training proof.

headline: Food handler and allergen training needed
summary: The manager was instructed to comply with state food handler training requirements. The manager was also told all certified managers must have allergen training.

headline: No sanitizer test strips; uncovered waste container
summary: No quaternary ammonium sanitizer test strips were available at the three-compartment sink while sanitizer was in use. The all-gender employee washroom waste container lacks a cover. Dust is on a utility sink vent.

headline: Cluttered closet beside walk-in cooler
summary: A closet next to the walk-in cooler has clutter and unnecessary items. Items not in use must be removed, and remaining items raised at least six inches off the floor to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Cold food too warm; food discarded; missing allergen training
summary: Cooked chicken, pork belly, shrimp and tofu in the display cooler were 46.6 to 50.8°F; 15 lbs discarded. Vacuum-sealed foods lacked required logs; 150 lbs discarded. Prep cooler at 50.6°F was tagged. Manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Flying insects in unused washroom; plumbing and clutter
summary: About 20 to 30 flying insects were in an unused washroom and storage closet. Pest control is required. Single-service items were stored under a sink drain, wiping cloths were damp, and fixtures are in poor repair.

headline: Food and cooler temperatures unsafe; food discarded
summary: Cold food was held at 46 to 48°F; it must be 41°F or below. About $500 of food was discarded. The walk-in cooler air measured 47°F and was tagged. Restroom sinks reached only 80 to 90°F.

headline: Scoops touching food; damaged ceiling; missing allergen certificates
summary: Scoop handles touch food in dry storage bins. A restroom trash can lacks a lid. The floor under the dish machine is heavily soiled. Ceiling above the basement grease trap is damaged, exposing pipes. Two of three managers lack allergen certificates.

headline: No visible thermometers; rust and grease buildup
summary: Reach-in coolers at the cook line have no visible thermometers. The cook-line hand sink needs a splash guard and has slow drainage. Rusted shelving, foil shelf liner, and grease and food debris on equipment need cleaning.

headline: Food handlers lack training certificates; small sink leak
summary: A small leak at the three-compartment sink faucet must be repaired. Food handlers on site had no food handler training certificates and must provide them.

headline: Pink slime build-up in ice machine
summary: A slight build-up of pink slime was found inside the ice machine. The owner was instructed to detail clean it and keep it in good condition.

headline: Rust, grease, peeling paint and ceiling holes
summary: Rust on walk-in shelving and a worn cooler door gasket. Milk crates are used as shelving. Grease is on the fryer, grill and oven. Floor tiles are damaged, paint is peeling, basement ceiling has holes, and trash cans lack lids.

headline: Personal items stored near chemicals; Styrofoam in drinks
summary: Employee shoes were stored in a saw cabinet, and medication was on a rear table. Styrofoam cups were fully submerged in beverage containers. Unfinished raw wood walls in a new storage area must be sealed.

headline: Certified manager absent; corrected on site
summary: No City of Chicago certified food service manager was on premises. A manager arrived at 2:07 PM, correcting the problem during inspection. Leaking utility sink faucet and toilet need repair; cardboard and grease are in the alley.

headline: Milk crates, raw wood shelf and cooler cleaning
summary: Milk crates are used for storage. A raw wood shelf must be sealed, and a prep cooler gasket has food debris. Floor under the grease trap and hot water tank needs drying and debris removal.

headline: Missing floor drain cover
summary: The utility service sink is missing its floor drain cover. It must be replaced.

headline: No certified manager on duty; rats outside property
summary: No certified manager with an original certificate was present while chicken and pizza were prepared. Rats were seen outside the property, though none inside. Unfinished wood shelves, milk crates, cardboard and clutter need correction.

headline: Restroom trash lid and loose wall bases
summary: The customer restroom trash can has no lid and must be provided with one. Wall bases are missing or loose throughout prep and dining areas and must be repaired.

headline: No certified manager; no allergen certificates
summary: No certified manager with an original certificate was on site while burgers, chicken, steak and Italian beef were prepared. No allergen certificates were on site for certified managers. Yard area and basement are cluttered, with items on floors.

headline: Black buildup on shelving by kegs
summary: Black buildup is on green shelving next to the kegs in the walk-in cooler. It must be removed.

headline: Rusty walk-in racks; splash guard needed
summary: Walk-in cooler storage racks are rusty. The hand sink by the pot storage racks needs a splash guard. Floor corners, the area under the dish machine, and cooking equipment have food, dirt and debris.

headline: Utensils touching food; single-use items reused
summary: Utensil handles touch food in dry storage bins. Single-use items are reused in freezers. A prep cooler and ice machine have torn gaskets. A standing freezer has heavy food debris, and the walk-in ceiling has dust.

headline: Menu disclosure fixed on site; opening near exit door
summary: The menu lacked a raw or undercooked food disclosure and was corrected on site before the inspection ended. An opening at the base of a stairwell exit door must be sealed. Liquor is stored on milk crates, and backflow devices leak.

headline: Greasy fryers and leaking sink; allergen training needed
summary: Fryer interiors need grease removed. The exposed hand sink leaks at the pipe. The washroom door is not self-closing, and floors and walls under equipment need cleaning. New managers must obtain allergen training.

headline: Garage door gap; food and equipment stored on floor
summary: A gap larger than 1/4 inch is at the bottom of the rear garage exit door. Food, equipment and single-service items are stored on floors. Scoop handles touch food, cardboard lines the floor, and half of the storage room lights are out.

headline: Repeat violations; foil, cardboard and damaged equipment
summary: A rear door gap must be repaired. Foil and cardboard are on grill and prep tables, and cutting boards are worn. Cooler handles and gaskets are damaged. Previous 2024 violations are uncorrected, and a certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; cooler had been off
summary: Black slime was found inside the ice machine and the soda ice chute. Upper prep cooler was turned off; food at 55 to 57°F was discarded. The cooler was turned back on and regained temperature. Utility faucet leaks.

headline: No allergen training certificate; toilet build-up
summary: The certified manager had no allergen training certificate on site and was told to obtain one and keep it available. Build-up was also found on the bottom of a toilet, and the person in charge was told to clean it.

headline: No thermometer in prep cooler; disposable spoons used
summary: No thermometer is in the front prep cooler. Disposable spoons are used in food production, and the operator was told to use durable utensils.

headline: Leaking faucet handle and three-compartment sink
summary: The cold water faucet handle at the bar hand sink is in poor repair. A pipe leaks from the center compartment of the three-compartment sink behind the bar. Both must be repaired.

headline: Cracked ice machine lid
summary: The ice machine lid is cracked on the interior. The manager must repair or replace it.

headline: Uncovered trash and freezer floor debris
summary: Full waste receptacles were stored uncovered near the rear door. The walk-in freezer floor has dried food debris and soils that must be cleaned.

headline: Dirty floors, fan covers and leaking bar sink
summary: Areas under the flat tops, floors in the deli and produce walk-ins, the dairy walk-in, and the bakery need detail cleaning. Fan covers need cleaning. The bar entrance hand sink sprays water from the faucet base.

headline: Restroom signage, door, cover and ventilation
summary: No handwashing sign is in the restroom. The unisex restroom door is not self-closing, and no covered receptacle is present. No mechanical ventilation is in the restroom. All must be corrected.

headline: No food handler training proof on site
summary: No proof of food handler training was provided for food employees on site. The operator must provide it and keep certificates available for review.

headline: Missing hand-dryer supply, door gap, sink and surface repairs
summary: No hand-drying supplies at a meat-area handwashing sink. Rear double door has a gap of about 1/4 inch at the bottom. Also: stained cutting board, rusted shelving, milk crates used as shelves, leaking and slow-draining sinks, floor hole, missing wall coving.

headline: Handwashing sinks too cold; no employee health policy
summary: Handwashing sinks measured 79.9 to 80.1°F, below the required 100°F. A plumber was on site working on it. Also: no written employee health policy, unlabeled rice container, dirty ceiling tiles, and no allergen certificates posted.

headline: No working ventilation in employee washroom
summary: The employee washroom has no working mechanical ventilation. Management was instructed to install a fan.

headline: Raw foods stored above ready-to-eat foods
summary: Raw salmon was stored above cooked shrimp, and raw eggs above ready-to-eat vegetables. Uncovered raw seafood sat next to tofu. Records lack a supplier frozen-fish statement and an updated sushi rice lab report; no pH meter was on site.

headline: Live cockroaches found near food prep areas
summary: Four live cockroaches were on a refrigerator door and three were in the mop sink near the rear prep three-compartment sink. Additional pest control was recommended. Also: dirty ice machine guard, greasy equipment, and an expired allergen certificate.

headline: No paper towels or soap at dish sink
summary: No paper towels were at the dishwashing handwashing sink. Soap and paper towels must be provided at all handwashing sinks. A citation was issued.

headline: Ice maker and freezer placement needs correction
summary: An ice maker under open basement stairs and a freezer under a sewer line need protection or relocation. The ice maker has a gray film inside. Backflow devices are missing, and deli cups must be air-dried.

headline: Current summary report not posted
summary: The most recent inspection summary report was not posted; an outdated 2024 report was displayed. Two recent inspections failed. The manager was given a new report and told to keep it posted.

headline: Manager hand-washing violation; hair restraints; allergen certificate
summary: The owner washed hands in the three-compartment sink, a citable violation. A rear handwashing sink is blocked by dish soap and utensils, and signage is missing. Several food handlers lack hair restraints and training certificates.

headline: Water-stained ceiling, peeling paint and dusty fan
summary: A water-stained ceiling tile and peeling paint near the three-compartment sink need repair. Dust is on the washroom fan. Floors under the meat cooler, inside the walk-in cooler and behind produce storage need cleaning.

headline: Wiping cloths and scoops improperly stored; earlier ice machine issue
summary: Wiping cloths were left on prep tables instead of sanitizer. Scoops were stored in dry food containers. Plastic bags hold food in chest freezers. Pink buildup was found inside the ice machine, previously cited and still uncorrected.

headline: Dock door openings; ceiling and ice problems
summary: Openings around dock doors and front entrances must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Ceiling tiles are stained or missing. Ice buildup is in the walk-in cooler and freezer. Previous violations are uncorrected.

headline: Paper towels at utility sink; door and training issues
summary: Paper towels and handwashing signs at a utility sink not used for handwashing must be removed. A restroom door is not self-closing. Food employees lack food handler training, and certificates are not on site.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; leak under sink
summary: Black slimy substance was found in the ice machine water parts and dripped into ice used by people. Management was told to shut it off, clean and sanitize it. A drain under the three-compartment sink is leaking.

headline: Backflow, leaking faucet and greasy floors under fryers
summary: The mop sink has no backflow device. The three-compartment sink drainboard is not attached and its faucet base leaks. Washroom door closer is detached. Thick grease, food and dirt are under and around fryers.

headline: Leaking drain pipe and faulty restroom vent
summary: A drain pipe under the three-compartment sink is leaking, and the customer restroom vent is not venting properly. The owner was told to repair and maintain both.

headline: Food handlers without hair restraints
summary: Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints, and all must wear them. Single-service items were stored on the storage floor and not inverted. Dusty, dirty air vents are in prep areas.

headline: Greasy equipment, leaking sink and debris outside
summary: Cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers and shelves have grease and food debris. The three-compartment sink leaks slightly. Debris surrounds the dumpster. Soiled mop heads and unused equipment must be stored properly to prevent pests.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; burnt-out lights; expired certificate
summary: No handwashing sign at the front prep hand sink. Several light bulbs are burnt out in the rear prep area. The certified food manager's allergen training certificate is expired.

headline: No current pest control logbook provided
summary: No up-to-date pest control logbook or recent service reports were provided; only 2018 and 2019 records were shown. Hot water does not run properly at the three-compartment sink. The women's restroom lacks a covered trash can.

headline: Over 80 mouse droppings; food held too warm
summary: Over 80 mouse droppings were found in prep, storage and selling areas, including under the three-compartment sink. Cooked chicken, rice and chile were held at 44.5 to 46°F and discarded. Ice machine interior is dirty.

headline: Milk held too warm; tagged for disposal
summary: Multiple gallons of milk were held at 45.7 to 48.9°F, above the 41°F limit. About $214 of milk was tagged for return to the company. Earlier violations, including dirty floors and stained ceiling tiles, remain uncorrected.

headline: Thawing, storage and cleanliness problems; no training proof
summary: Raw meat was thawed on a prep table. Grocery bags were used as food containers in coolers, and soiled mops were stored on the rear walkway. Unused equipment on the patio should be removed. No food handler training proof on site.

headline: Food debris on floors
summary: Food debris is on the floor behind the cold drink cooler near the register and in the rear prep area near the storage room. The floors must be detail cleaned.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies; wall openings
summary: No cleanup supplies for vomiting or diarrhea events were on site. Walls around the mop sink room and openings in the rear prep area must be sealed. One light bulb in rear prep is out.

headline: Greasy cooking equipment and floors
summary: Grease has built up on cooking equipment in the front prep area. The equipment must be detail cleaned, and floors under and behind it must also be detail cleaned.

headline: Unlabeled salt; wastewater pipe over prep table
summary: A salt container in the main kitchen is unlabeled. A wastewater pipe runs above a prep table and must be enclosed or fitted with a barrier. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint.

headline: Restroom door not self-closing; allergen certificate missing
summary: The men's restroom door is not self-closing and must be fitted with a device. A food service sanitation manager lacks a food allergen training certificate.

headline: Labeling, splash guard and leak repairs needed
summary: Squeeze bottles and other food containers need common-name labels. A bar hand sink needs a splash guard. The ice machine water filter leaks heavily, food splatter is on walls, and hood lights are burnt out.

headline: Ice machine lacks backflow prevention device
summary: The ice machine water line connected to the three-compartment sink has no backflow device. The person in charge was instructed to install one to prevent possible contamination.

headline: Trash can without lid; hole in kitchen wall
summary: The unisex staff restroom trash can has no lid and must be provided with one. A large hole in the kitchen prep wall near the microwaves must be sealed.

headline: No city food manager certificate on site
summary: No City of Chicago food service manager certificate is on site. The manager must show proof of enrollment or a valid certificate. The manager was also told to meet food handler and allergen training requirements or citations will follow.

headline: Cutting board with deep grooves
summary: A cutting board has deep, dark grooves. It must be replaced and maintained.

headline: No health policy; broken cooler tagged; no backflow device
summary: No employee health policy is on the premises. The reach-in prep cooler is not working and was tagged; the Food Protection Division must be notified after repair. The mop sink faucet lacks a backflow device.

headline: Stained, grooved cutting boards
summary: Cutting boards in the rear prep area have open seams and dark stains. They must be refinished or replaced and kept in good condition.

headline: No certified manager; cooked chicken too warm; discarded
summary: No certified manager certificate was posted, and none was on duty while cooked chicken, gyros and fish were handled. Cooked chicken at 50.7°F was discarded. No food handler training and no thermometer for the prep cooler were found.

headline: No certified manager; black slime inside ice machine
summary: No certified manager was on duty while Italian beef was prepared. Heavy black slime was found inside the ice machine used for ice people eat. Repeat violation: managers lack allergen training certificates.

headline: No certified manager on site; cleaning items
summary: No city-certified food manager was on site while pizza, salad and meatballs were prepared and served; a citation was issued. Unisex restrooms lacked handwashing signs, wiping cloths were left on prep tables, and a can opener had food residue.

headline: Cleaning needed for equipment, floors and drains
summary: The facility was instructed to clean cooking and other equipment where needed, and to clean floors and floor drains where needed. No other violations were listed.

headline: Dirty coolers and washroom; damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Cooler shelving and the washroom need detail cleaning. Walk-in cooler floor and ceiling tiles are in poor repair. Stock must be raised six inches off the floor. Manager was told all food handlers need food handler certificates or citations will follow.

headline: Uncertified manager; leaks uncorrected; missing pest log
summary: The person in charge lacked a City of Chicago food manager certificate, and it was not on site. A prior violation remained: drain line and valve leaks under sinks. Pest control logbook was missing, and food employees lacked handler certifications.

headline: Damaged walls; mops improperly stored; allergen gap
summary: Large holes and crumbling drywall were found under the three-compartment sink, in the hallway and in the restroom. Restroom fixtures need cleaning. Mops must be hung to dry to prevent pest harborage. Managers lack allergen training certificates.

headline: Employee food stored with customer food
summary: Employee food was stored in the same refrigeration unit as customer food; a designated employee storage area is required. A refrigeration door gasket was torn. Clutter and unused cardboard in the rear dishwashing area should be removed.

headline: Date stickers left on washed containers
summary: Date stickers were not removed from food containers during washing. Staff were instructed to remove them. No other violations were listed.

headline: Ice maker backflow device not located
summary: The backflow prevention device for the ice maker could not be found and must be exposed or installed where it can be seen. The walk-in cooler had inadequate lighting and needs more lights.

headline: Grime, dust, grease, and items on floor
summary: Cold holding units had food debris and grime inside and out, and shelving had food buildup. Items were stored on floors in the rear kitchen and front bar. Air vents are coated with dust, hood filters have grease, and tape was used on a pipe.

headline: Missing health policy, cleanup kit, and signs
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site, and no vomit and diarrhea procedure or kit was available. Handwashing signs were missing at upstairs prep and washroom sinks. No allergen training certificates were on site for certified food managers. No citations were issued for the first two.

headline: Food held too warm; dish machine gauge reads 0°F
summary: Walk-in cooler held TCS foods at 44.9-49.9°F, above the 41°F limit, and 40 pounds were voluntarily discarded. Prep-area cooler at 45.6°F must not be used until it holds 41°F. No certified manager was on duty; a dish machine gauge read 0°F.

headline: Labeling, storage and backflow issues; no pests
summary: Food storage containers need common-name labels. Milk crates were used for elevation and must be replaced with shelving six inches off the floor. The backflow device behind the ice machine must be made accessible. Other repairs: stripped faucet handle, damaged wall, dirty freezer floor.

headline: About 40 live flies; hot food below safe temp
summary: About 40 small live flies were flying through sushi and main prep areas; pest control is required. Hot foods held at 70-101°F, below the required 135°F, were discarded. Torn cooler gaskets and heavy grease and debris were also noted.

headline: Missing cleanup kit, thermometer, and test strips
summary: The vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit was not proper, and no metal stem thermometer for hot and cold TCS foods was on site. No test strips were available to measure chemical sanitizer. Citations were issued.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and several repairs needed
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at several sinks. Single-use boxes sat on the floor, the three-compartment sink had rust, and the ice machine's backflow device could not be verified. Holes, cracked caulk, a damaged wall and a stained ceiling need repair.

headline: No certified manager; black slime in ice machines
summary: No city-certified food manager certificate was posted on site. Black slime was found inside both ice machines. Some restrooms lacked soap and paper towels, oyster shellstock tags were missing, and raw or undercooked menu items lacked a consumer advisory.

headline: Mop sink needs contamination barrier
summary: A mop sink was installed next to another mop sink. The facility was instructed to install a barrier to prevent contamination.

headline: Cold foods too warm; 10 pounds discarded
summary: Sliced tomatoes, sour cream and steak in the front cooler were held at 48-50°F, above the 41°F limit. The person in charge discarded about 10 pounds ($100). Cooked rice was in a non-food-grade bag, which must be replaced.

headline: Soiled floors and missing storage light
summary: Flooring below the ice bin and next to the three-compartment sink in the front bar was soiled and needs detailed cleaning. A light was missing in a basement dry storage closet and must be replaced.

headline: Employee items stored on food shelves
summary: Employees' personal items were stored on food shelves. Staff were instructed to keep them away from food. No other violations were listed.

headline: Grease buildup on equipment and hood
summary: Grease had built up on the sides of and behind equipment, and on hood filters above the wok line. Staff were instructed to clean and maintain both.

headline: Rodent contamination on utensils; several cleanliness gaps
summary: Utensils stored in tubs were contaminated by rodents and must be removed, washed, rinsed and sanitized. Also: some coolers lack thermometers, wiping cloths were left on counters without sanitizer, prep surfaces need deep cleaning, and basement and dining clutter must be removed.

headline: No certified manager; many handwashing and safety gaps
summary: No city-certified manager was on site while chicken and beef were handled. Handwashing cleanser, paper towels and signs were missing. A front door gap over one inch needs rodent-proofing. No vomit cleanup kit, metal thermometer or test strips were on site.

headline: Dumpster area debris; rear door openings
summary: Openings in the middle and base of the rear exit double doors must be sealed to prevent pests. Debris and liquid were on the enclosed dumpster area floor. An unused rooftop grill must be removed. One food service manager lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Blocked hand sink, no paper towels, allergen gap
summary: A first-floor prep hand sink was blocked by utensils and had no paper towels. Dairy containers with chips and stains were used as utensils. A basement light lacked a shield, and the food service manager had no allergen training certificate.

headline: Cooler at 48.5°F tagged; floors heavily soiled
summary: A reach-in cooler held at 48.5°F was tagged and must not be used until it holds 41°F and is reinspected. A bar hand sink lacked a sign, one dump sink lacked a faucet, and heavy food debris covered floors and areas behind basement ice machines.

headline: No certified manager; flies and food on floor
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared. More than 25 small flies were seen near the slicer. Food containers were stored on floors, milk crates were used as shelving, and heavy grease and ice buildup was present.

headline: Dish machines not sanitizing; no food handler certificates
summary: Two low-temperature dish machines read 0 ppm chlorine and were tagged held for inspection; a technician was called. The ice machine interior had encrusted debris. No food handler certificates were on site, and the certified food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Uncovered salsa; unlabeled packaged items
summary: Packaged items lacked labels with ingredients and business name. Open salsa containers in the walk-in cooler were uncovered, and plastic cups were used to dispense salsa. The rear washroom door lacked a self-closing device, and hand sinks lacked waste receptacles.

headline: No certificate; no summary; sanitizer too weak
summary: No original city sanitation certificate was posted or on site. Chlorine in the low-temperature dish machine measured 10 ppm; the minimum is 50 ppm. Uncorrected violations include no barrier between the customer hallway and kitchen, no allergen training, and no posted inspection summary.

headline: Gap under entrance door; torn cooler gaskets
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the front entrance door must be sealed tightly to keep pests out. A torn door gasket on a prep cooler and a refrigerator must be replaced.

headline: New dish machine installed, not yet in use
summary: A brand-new dish machine was installed on site but is not in use. If used, it must be a commercial unit installed properly. No other violations were listed.

headline: Door openings need sealing; washroom closer broken
summary: Openings at the base of the rear exit door and on both sides of the dock door must be sealed to prevent pests. The unisex employee washroom door's self-closing device was not working and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Cold food too warm; shellfish tags missing
summary: Several foods that must stay cold (TCS) were held at 48-52°F; the manager discarded about $30 of food. A display cooler at 46°F was tagged. Shellfish tags were missing for clams and oysters. Ice machine interior has a repeat mineral buildup violation.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; expired beef discarded
summary: The low-temperature dish machine at the bar read 0 ppm chlorine and must be corrected. Beef and gravy past the 7-day limit, valued at $70, were discarded. Empty juice jugs were reused as utensils, and a leak at the dishwashing sink must be repaired.

headline: Basement pipe leak; expired allergen training
summary: A leak was found in the basement from pipes above the sump pump and must be repaired. The certified food manager had expired allergen training, and the manager was instructed to comply.

headline: Missing thermometer, labels, and floor storage
summary: A thermometer is needed inside the cooling unit used for thawing. Bulk containers in the prep area were unlabeled. Milk crates and floor storage in the rear area need proper shelving six inches off the floor. Cooling units need debris removed.

headline: Drain cover missing; slow sink; cracked tiles
summary: A floor drain by the rear hand sink lacks a cover. A cutting board has dark stains, and the main prep hand sink drains very slowly. Cracked floor tiles in several areas and chipping paint in the toilet room must be repaired.

headline: Restroom door lacks self-closing device
summary: The restroom door did not have a self-closing device. The person in charge was instructed to install and maintain one.

headline: Missing restroom signs and covers; cleaning needed
summary: A handwashing sink lacked a sign and the unisex restroom lacked a covered receptacle. The restroom door was not self-closing. Dust was on a cooler's compressor, soiled mop heads were not hung up, and floors had debris along walls.

headline: Rust, paper lining, and missing sink stoppers
summary: Excessive rust was found on top of the grease interceptor. Paper lining surrounded the steam table and must be removed. The three-compartment sink was missing proper stoppers.

headline: Packaged foods unlabeled; no food handler certificates
summary: Self-service packaged drinks and snacks lacked the manufacturer's name and place. In-house chickpea salad lacked a net quantity and business name. No food handler training certificates were provided.

headline: Cleaning and storage fixes; no pests
summary: The ice bin interior needed cleaning. Plates and bowls were not inverted, and cutting boards had open seams and stains. The staff all-gender restroom lacked a covered sanitary-napkin receptacle. Prep-area floor corners had debris and dust.

headline: Hand sink lacks hot water; backflow uncorrected
summary: The rear prep hand sink had a stripped hot-water handle and produced no hot water; it needs repair. A prior violation remains: the backflow prevention device on the food prep ice machine has not been located.

headline: Inspection summary not posted for public
summary: The previous inspection summary was not posted where customers could see it. Management received today's summary and was told to post it in view of customers. A citation was issued.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: No city-certified food manager was on site, and no certificate was posted, while TCS foods such as caramelized ground beef and salads were prepared and served. A citation was issued. Water-damaged and broken ceiling tiles must be replaced.

headline: Ice buildup and dirty caulking
summary: Excessive ice had built up around the walk-in freezer door perimeter and must be removed. Black substance on caulking at a rear prep handwash sink must be removed, or the caulk replaced.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; health policy missing
summary: The low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine, far below the 50 ppm minimum, and was tagged out. No written employee health policy was on site. Handwashing signs, pest control logbook records, and labels were missing; hood filters were greasy.

headline: Rodent droppings found in seven areas
summary: Droppings were found in seven areas, about 10 to 30 at each, including storage, produce and meat entry. Pest control service was required. Clybourn revolving doors still had base openings from a prior violation. Loose floor panels and worn shelving also need repair.

headline: Missing thermometer, torn gasket, burnt-out light
summary: The two-door prep cooler in the hallway had no thermometer. A storage-room refrigerator had a torn door gasket. One ceiling light bulb in the men's restroom was burnt out. Each item was to be fixed.

headline: Sink leak and detail-cleaning needs
summary: A leak at the bottom of the rear three-compartment sink must be repaired. Detail cleaning is needed for that sink's drain, the walk-in cooler floor under shelving, and dusty air-conditioning fan units throughout the facility.

headline: Plastic utensils stored with incorrect orientation
summary: Plastic utensils were stored incorrectly. Staff were instructed to store them with handles facing out to prevent contamination. No other violations were listed.

headline: License suspension sign was covered; since removed
summary: Brown paper and a handwritten note covered the posted license suspension sign on both doors. The paper was removed during reinspection. A citation was issued for concealing the sign.

headline: Rat droppings, open poison, and handwashing failures
summary: About 75 or more rat droppings and about 8 open rodenticide poison items were found in basement and storage areas; the manager removed the poison. Employees handled food without washing hands. No certified manager was on duty during food prep.

headline: Raw fish stored over ready-to-eat food; sinks blocked
summary: Raw fish was stored above fresh vegetables and cooked shrimp; all were removed. About 10 lbs of raw sushi fish held at 45.7-48.6°F were discarded and the cooler tagged. Both hand sinks were blocked or in use for other tasks. No certified manager was present at first.

headline: Dish machine too cool; vacuum-packed food tagged
summary: Dish machine final rinse reached only 150°F, below the required 160°F; a technician was called. Vacuum-packed foods were kept without the required approved plan, and about 10 lbs of ham, 8 lbs of chicken and other items were tagged. A customer's pet dog was inside.

headline: No food manager certificate; rear door gap
summary: No city food manager certificate was on site while TCS foods such as pizza and pasta were handled; a citation was issued. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door sweep must be sealed to keep rodents out.

headline: Missing signs, leaking sink, restroom door issue
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at the washroom and at front and rear prep sinks. A utility sink was backflowing and leaking. The unisex restroom door was not self-closing, and a covered sanitary-napkin receptacle was missing. Ceiling tiles were damaged.

headline: Hot food below 135°F; no food handler certificates
summary: Cooked chicken held at 109.3-130.8°F and rice at 128°F in the hot holding unit were below the required 135°F; cabbage on the counter was at 96.8°F. A citation was issued. No food handler certificates were on site, and seasonings lacked labels.

headline: Grease, loose gaskets, and peeling paint
summary: Cooler doors had loose gaskets. Food debris and grease covered cooking equipment, coolers and prep tables. Walls and ceilings in the prep area had debris and spills, and peeling paint and damaged floor tiles must be repaired.

headline: Food stored on floor; hair restraints not worn
summary: Boxed food was stored on the bakery freezer floor, and several food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Scoops were stored inside dry-goods containers. Cardboard shelf liners, a missing covered trash can, and dirty walk-in floors also need fixing.

headline: Food handlers untrained; grease on floors
summary: Some food handlers lacked food handler training. The three-compartment sink had no drain plugs, and grease and debris had built up on floors around equipment. Staff were instructed to provide plugs and clean.

headline: Raw meat stored over ready-to-eat food; all removed
summary: Raw beef, pork and chicken were stored over bean sprouts, cooked chicken, egg rolls and broccoli. All of the stored foods were removed, and a priority citation was issued. Dirty freezer and cooler interiors, a slow hand sink and water-damaged ceiling tiles were also noted.

headline: Missing signs, labels, hair restraints; allergen gap
summary: Restroom handwashing signs were missing. An employee prepared and served food without a hair restraint. Some containers lacked labels, and rusty walk-in shelving and dusty vents need attention. A repeat violation: a certified food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Improper thawing; ice scoop stored in machine
summary: Frozen cheese pies were thawed on a counter; thawing must happen in refrigeration or under running lukewarm water. An ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine. A rear sink lacked a handwashing sign, and boxes on the prep floor need elevating.

headline: No certified manager; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: No certified manager was on duty while chicken and clams were prepared. A low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged. Water backed up in the three-compartment sink. Grease, dirt, unlabeled containers and a cluttered hallway were also noted.

headline: Unlabeled food storage containers
summary: Food storage containers lacked labels showing the common name of the food. The facility was instructed to provide labels. No other violations were listed.

headline: About 200 rat droppings under dining booths
summary: About 200 rat droppings were found under booths in the dining area, a repeat problem from a prior violation. More pest control service is needed. The front entrance door must be rodent-proofed, and a slow-draining hand sink needs repair.

headline: Missing allergen certificate for one manager
summary: One certified food manager had no allergen training certificate. The facility must provide proof of current allergen training for all certified food managers.

headline: Missing health policy and cleanup kit
summary: No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit was on the premises. A thermometer is needed for the prep-area refrigeration unit. Food handlers must obtain the required food handler training.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; burnt-out light
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at hand sinks in the prep area and washrooms. Light bulbs above the three-compartment dishwashing sink were burnt out, and adequate lighting must be maintained.

headline: Coolers off; no pest service; hot water too cool
summary: A two-door reach-in cooler and a walk-in cooler were not turned on and must hold 41°F or below. Hot water in both washrooms measured 86.5°F, below the 100°F minimum. No pest control logbook or service was on site, and no vomit cleanup procedure existed.

headline: No certified manager; uncorrected violations
summary: No city-certified food manager was on premises; a citation was issued. A prior violation was not corrected: debris and litter under hot and cold holding units. A faucet leak was patched with tape. Walk-in freezer floor, deli cabinets and hood filters need cleaning and repair.

headline: Wiping cloths and restroom trash need fixing
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables instead of in sanitizing solution. A unisex restroom lacked a covered receptacle, and restroom trash cans were filled with soiled paper towels and other refuse.

headline: Cold foods too warm; 85 pounds discarded
summary: Soups, cut tomatoes, steak and sour cream were held above 41°F, some up to 59.3°F; about 85 pounds were discarded. A refrigerator at 65.6°F was tagged. Shrimp was thawed at room temperature, and the front door needs rodent-proofing.

headline: Water-stained and damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Water-stained, missing and holed ceiling tiles were found in the front grocery, rear prep and storage areas. Staff were told to replace them and keep them maintained.

headline: Expired certificates, missing hair restraint, dirty areas
summary: A food handler had an expired certificate, and the CFM lacked allergen certification. A male food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. Also noted: unlabeled bulk container, greasy fryers, dirty racks, walls and floor drains, and a missing light shield.

headline: Several coolers off; no pest log; no certificates
summary: Several coolers were not turned on and must hold 41°F or below. No pest control logbook, employee health policy, vomit cleanup supplies, paper towels or sanitizer test strips were on site. Dumpster use needs a contract or landlord approval; food handler certificates are missing.

headline: Wet wiping cloths; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Wet wiping cloths were on several prep surfaces and must be kept in sanitizing solution between uses. Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced with shelving six inches off the floor.

headline: Black grime in drain under soda dispenser
summary: Black grime had built up in the drain under the fountain drink dispenser by the drive-thru window. Staff were instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: No valid certificate; flies can enter kitchen
summary: No valid city sanitation certificate was held by the person in charge or posted. The rear kitchen screen door had a 1/2-inch gap and large openings letting flies in. Food handler training proof was missing, and prior violations remain.

headline: Fruit flies found; dumpster lid missing
summary: About 30 fruit flies were on walls in the rear dishwashing area, and a pest control operator must be contacted. An outside dumpster was missing its lid. Citations were issued for both.

headline: No proof of allergen training
summary: No proof of ANSI-approved (American National Standards Institute) allergen training was provided. The facility must provide and maintain it.

headline: No hot water at restroom sink; debris throughout
summary: The women's restroom handwashing sink had no running water; at least 100°F water is required. Ice had built up in the walk-in freezer. Debris was found in breakroom cabinets and along walls in several areas, and some restrooms lacked covered receptacles.

headline: Cleaning needed; washroom garbage lid missing
summary: Shelving in the walk-in and reach-in coolers needs cleaning to remove spills and debris. The unisex employee washroom garbage can lid is missing. Floor corners, light shields and air vent covers need cleaning.

headline: Prepared foods past 7-day limit; allergen training gap
summary: Ready-to-eat foods such as salsa, grilled onions and bean dip were kept past the 7-day use-by date in prep and walk-in coolers; a citation was issued. A certified food manager (CFM) lacked allergen training, a repeat violation. Ceiling tiles were dusty.

headline: Floors in prep and kitchen need cleaning
summary: Floors in the prep and kitchen areas need cleaning to remove spills and debris. No other violations were listed.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; spills and debris found
summary: A sliding-door reach-in cooler had no thermometer, and operable thermometers are required for all coolers. Food spills and debris were found inside reach-in freezers and on floors in prep, storage and basement areas.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen certificates
summary: No food handler certificate was provided. Two employees with city certificates had expired allergen training. Containers were stored on floors and crates and need shelving six inches up. A leaking faucet and stained ceiling tiles were also noted.

headline: Large pots need written washing procedure
summary: Large cooking pots could not be submerged in the three-compartment sink. The facility must provide a written washing, rinsing and sanitizing procedure. The certified food manager's allergen training certificate was expired.

headline: Unapproved food buckets; leaking sinks
summary: Sauces and vegetable prep were stored in plastic buckets from hardware stores and a former soap container; food-grade containers are required. Rusted walk-in racks, missing sink stoppers, and leaking faucets at the utility and three-compartment sinks were also noted.

headline: Broom hanger too close to utensils
summary: A broom hanger was too close to the clean utensil rack. Staff were instructed to install a barrier. No other violations were listed.

headline: Hair restraints not worn; dusty ceiling tiles
summary: Employees in the food prep and dishwashing area were not wearing hair restraints. Ceiling tiles in the front prep area had dirt and dust buildup and need cleaning.

headline: Restroom doors and wall hole need repair
summary: Washroom doors were not self-closing. A hole in a closet wall near the bar must be sealed and coved. Raw wood serving-window shelves need sealing. Food handlers and the certified food manager must obtain required training.

headline: No employee health policy; mop sink drain dirty
summary: No employee health policy was found on the premises, and a citation was issued. The floor drain at the mop sink was not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Refrigerator lacks air thermometer
summary: The mechanical refrigerator had no ambient air thermometer. The facility was instructed to provide and maintain one.

headline: Over 30 flies in garbage; garbage stored near drinks
summary: More than 30 small flies were inside garbage cans where coffee grounds are discarded, and some flew out of a counter hole. Flies were also on a pop machine, and garbage containers were stored inside the coffee and pop machine cabinet. Dead bees and a leaking faucet were noted.

headline: Pork held at 50.4°F; corrected on site
summary: Cold pork held at 50.4°F, above the 41°F limit, was corrected on site: the manager discarded 20 pounds (about $63). A citation was issued. A handwashing sign was missing at the prep sink, gaskets were damaged, and one employee's allergen certificate was expired.

headline: Cleaning needed in coolers, freezers and floors
summary: Reach-in coolers and freezers need interior cleaning to remove spills and debris. Floors around equipment and along wall bases need cleaning. No other violations were listed.

headline: Unlabeled spices; equipment too large for sink
summary: A stained cutting board with dark grooves needs replacing, and spices lacked labels. Bowls and plates in a hallway were not inverted. Large equipment does not fit the three-compartment sink, so a written procedure is required. The rear ice machine's backflow device could not be located.

headline: Front door gap; no utility sink
summary: The front entrance door has a half-inch gap at the bottom and must be made rodent-proof. No utility sink was on site, and no covered receptacle was in the toilet room. Toilet room handsink lacks signage.

headline: Unlabeled shakers; leaking handsink pipe
