summary: Squirt bottles and seasoning shakers in the rear prep area must be labeled. A leaking pipe under the bar handsink must be repaired. Floors under the dishwasher and cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Hair restraints missing; expired food handler certificates
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Employee toilets need cleaning, and the women's restroom trash is overflowing. Floors under equipment have food and debris. All food handler certificates were expired.

headline: About 10 live roaches; pest control required
summary: About 10 live roaches were found in the dining area and rear hallway. Pest control is required before re-inspection. Also: a leaking freezer, food spills inside it, dirty floors, and missing tiles and baseboards.

headline: Missing signage; uncovered food in walk-in
summary: Handwashing signage is missing in restrooms and the bar. Food containers lack labels, food in the walk-in is uncovered, and utensils are stored improperly. Cutting boards are stained, and grease and dust need cleaning.

headline: Cleaning needed; food handlers lack training
summary: Areas around the wok station and bottoms of prep tables need cleaning. Some ceiling tiles are water-stained, and vents need cleaning. Some food handlers lack required training, and a manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Loose faucet; no covered trash; allergen training
summary: A men's restroom sink faucet is loose and must be repaired. Women's restrooms lack covered trash receptacles. A certified manager on duty had no allergen training.

headline: Deeply grooved cutting boards; broken restroom handle
summary: Two long cutting boards at the sandwich prep stations have deep grooves and must be replaced. The women's restroom door handle is broken and taped. The floor near the CO2 tanks needs detail cleaning, and a fan vent is dusty.

headline: Dirty ice machine; loose faucet handle
summary: The ice machine interior needs cleaning; ice must be removed first. A loose cold-water handle at the prep area handsink must be repaired.

headline: Rear door gap; unused construction materials
summary: A gap at the bottom of the rear entrance doors must be closed so the door fits tightly and blocks pests. Unused construction materials must be removed from the premises.

headline: Crates used for storage; missing food handler training
summary: Crates were used for food storage in the walk-in cooler and must be replaced with proper shelving. Food handlers were missing required training certificates.

headline: Missing signage and thermometer; allergen training
summary: The front handsink lacks handwashing signage. The 2-door reach-in cooler is missing an internal thermometer. The outdoor waste lid hinge is damaged, and a certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Inadequate hot water; citation issued
summary: Hot water was too cool throughout: 3-compartment sink 78F (needs 110F), prep handsinks 80F, toilet handsink 48F (needs 100F). Citation issued. A beard guard was missing and the employee toilet lacked a covered receptacle.

headline: Items stored on basement floor; overfilled dumpsters
summary: Single-use items and soiled wet linens were stored on the basement floor and must be raised at least six inches. Outdoor dumpsters were overfilled, which is a priority violation. Staff flattened garbage so the lids could close.

headline: Sink blocked; cooked rice held too warm; insects
summary: A prep handsink was blocked by plastic containers and was not usable; this was corrected on site. Biryani rice held at 78.3F was discarded. Glue boards with dead insects were removed. Missing employee health policy and food handler training.

headline: Broken thermometer; hair restraint and water pressure issues
summary: The basement refrigerator thermometer is not working. Food handlers in the prep area were not wearing hair restraints. Customer restroom water pressure is low, and the restroom vent is dusty.

headline: Dirty floors, walls, and grease under fryers
summary: Slight grease buildup under fryers. Floors, walls, and ceilings in the kitchen, dish room, employee washroom, and storage area need deep cleaning. Unused equipment and clutter were noted.

headline: No thermometer in refrigeration unit
summary: The refrigeration unit at the front prep area has no thermometer and one must be installed. A one-compartment sink is required in any food prep area and must be installed.

headline: About 25 live flying insects; expired food dates
summary: About 25 live small flying insects were on walls in prep, storage, and dishwashing areas, and more pest service is needed. Several TCS foods were held past the 7-day use-by limit and must be discarded. The manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Handwashing signage; holes in walls and floors
summary: Handwashing signage must be provided at the toilet room sink. Large holes between the wall and floor in the office, restroom, and utility sink area must be sealed to prevent entry.

headline: Wet mop left in bucket
summary: A wet mop was stored in a bucket in the rear prep area. Staff must hang mops when not in use so they can dry.

headline: Unisex bathroom lacks covered trash can
summary: One unisex bathroom did not have a covered trash can. The manager was instructed to provide covered cans for all unisex and female bathrooms.

headline: No backflow device; clutter in basement
summary: No backflow prevention device was found at the utility sink, and it must be installed. Unnecessary items in the basement must be removed, and the walk-in cooler floor, fan covers, and ceiling need cleaning.

headline: No handsinks in prep areas; unapproved food
summary: No exposed handsinks were in food prep or service areas, which is a priority violation. Food sold from an unapproved source with incomplete labels. Boxes stored on the floor and one handler lacked training.

headline: Tongs not stored properly; missing food handler certificate
summary: Tongs used for pizza slices were not stored properly and must be kept in a clean bin. The food handler on site had no certificate and must obtain a valid one.

headline: Leaks and missing certificates
summary: Interiors of the microwave, deep fryer, and prep coolers need cleaning. Leaks at the customer restroom faucet and a drain line above the prep doorway must be repaired. A food handler lacked a certificate, and the manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Food stored on floor; leaking faucet
summary: Food was stored on the floor in prep and dish areas and must be raised six inches. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks and must be repaired. Baseboards are missing, and wall-base openings need repair.

headline: No recent pest service report; citation issued
summary: No recent pest control service report was on site. The pest log's last inspection is dated 2/24/23. Exposed insulation on a prep cooler and frozen meat in plastic grocery bags were also noted.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; unit tagged
summary: The low-temperature dish machine was not sanitizing and was tagged; it must not be used until serviced. No test strips were available. Greasy floors and vents, raw wood surfaces, and a new manager lacked allergen training.

headline: No certified manager; syrup and debris buildup
summary: No person in charge or certified manager was on site while meatballs and deli meat were handled; citation issued. Also noted a missing baseboard and syrup and food debris under the syrup racks.

headline: No covered receptacle in women's restroom
summary: The women's restroom has no covered receptacle. The person in charge must provide and maintain one.

headline: Unlabeled food storage containers
summary: Some food storage containers were not labeled with their common names, such as flour, rice, and salt. The staff must label them.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; ice scoop storage
summary: Handwashing signs are missing in restrooms. Ice scoops were stored inside the ice bin and must be kept in a clean container. The 3-compartment sink has no drainboard, and dirt was found behind a freezer.

headline: Grease buildup; dumpster debris; allergen training
summary: Cooking equipment and prep tables have grease and food debris. Debris surrounds the dumpster, and floors under cooking equipment need cleaning. Soiled mop heads must be hung. A manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Grease buildup and dirty floors; milk crates
summary: Milk crates were used for elevation; the manager was told to stop, to avoid pest hiding spots. Grease and food debris were found on cooking equipment, coolers, walls, and floors. Cleaning was instructed.

headline: Stained cutting boards and missing allergen certificate
summary: Cutting boards have open seams and dark stains. Foil covers equipment, tables have rust and grime, and restrooms lack covered receptacles. Burned-out hood bulbs and missing allergen certificate were also noted.

headline: Dead roaches; manager lacked ID; cooler too warm
summary: Dead roaches were found throughout, and about 4 live roaches and 10 small flies were seen; the manager killed three roaches. About 20 lbs of fish, shrimp, and chicken held at 48-51F was discarded. A cooler at 54F was tagged, and the certified manager had no ID.

headline: Missing signage; torn walk-in gasket
summary: An exposed handwashing sink near the locker room lacks signage. Soap and paper towels at an unused sink must be removed. The walk-in cooler's torn door gasket must be repaired or replaced.

headline: No certified manager; cooler at 56.6F tagged
summary: The person in charge lacked a sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was present while chicken was handled. A condiment cooler at 56.6F was tagged and held. A handsink drains slowly and floors need cleaning.

headline: Equipment and walls not clean
summary: Many items were not clean, including prep coolers, freezers, stoves, shelves, and handsinks. Heavy debris was found on floors in the rear stairwell and basement, and food buildup was found on walls.

headline: Untrained food handlers; leaking faucet
summary: Food handlers lacked training certificates, and certified managers lacked allergen training. The 3-compartment sink faucet leaks during use, a wooden block supports a sink leg, and base coving is detached in the booth.

headline: Entrance door gaps and bun stacks on floor
summary: Openings at the base of both outer entrance doors could let pests in; sealing was instructed. Buns were stored on a freezer floor and must be raised six inches. Damaged door heater strip and ice buildup also noted.

headline: Leaking faucet at prep sink
summary: A small leak at the faucet neck of the one-compartment sink in the front prep area must be repaired.

headline: Dirty deli slicers; holes in garbage area wall
summary: Deli meat slicers were dirty and must be cleaned between uses. Two holes in the garbage area wall lead outside and must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Several floor areas need cleaning.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; damaged floors
summary: Foil was used as a liner on equipment and must be removed. Milk crates are used as shelving and must be replaced. Floor tiles and grout are missing or broken, and a hood bulb is burned out.

headline: Cracks and crevices along walls
summary: Cracks and crevices were found along walls in rear storage, the men's bar restroom, and the banquet area restroom. The manager was instructed to seal them.

headline: No sanitation certificate; no certified manager
summary: The person in charge had no sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was on site while pork and chicken were handled. A citation was issued, and the manager must provide a valid certificate.

headline: Pest infestation: roaches, mice, flies
summary: Over 20 live cockroaches, over 100 mouse droppings behind prep coolers, and over 100 live small flies were found, plus dead roaches. All evidence must be removed and areas sanitized. Also noted: grease, food debris, and a manager without allergen training.

headline: Missing signage; dishware not inverted
summary: Handwashing signage is missing at the sink next to the three-compartment sink. Clean dishware was not inverted, and the women's restroom lacks a receptacle with a lid.

headline: Loose cooler panel; prep coolers need cleaning
summary: A basement walk-in cooler side panel is coming loose and must be repaired. The sides of the prep coolers need detail cleaning.

headline: Low hot water; dish machines not sanitizing
summary: Handsink hot water was 64-70F and was fixed on site to 102-105F. Three low-temperature dish machines had 0 ppm sanitizer and were tagged. Ice bins need cleaning, and a splashguard is missing. Milk crates are used as shelving.

headline: Open front door; fruit on floor; leaking faucet
summary: The front entry door was open and was closed by staff during inspection. An unapproved insect control device was removed. Boxes of fruit on the deli floor must be raised six inches. The 3-compartment faucet runs continuously.

headline: Door gaps let pests in; restroom issues
summary: Front and rear doors have gaps that are not rodent- or insect-proof. The women's restroom needs a covered trash can, rear prep area floor tiles are missing, and restroom ventilation is not connected.

headline: Slime in ice machine; ventilation not working
summary: Black and brown slime was dripping into the ice from the ice machine reservoir. It was cleaned and sanitized during inspection. Restroom ventilation is not working. The manager lacked allergen training, and a rear door's weather strip is damaged.

headline: No sanitation manager; soap missing; grease
summary: No city sanitation manager was on site while milk and turkey were prepared; citation issued. The dish room handsink lacked soap, and a rear handsink was blocked and leaking. The sanitizer test strips were missing, and grease and debris need cleaning.

headline: Ice scoop stored on dusty ice maker
summary: An ice scoop was stored on top of a dusty ice maker. The staff was instructed to keep it in a clean holder.

headline: Crab thawed in standing water; untidy storage
summary: Two packages of crab meat were thawing in a bowl of water in the meat department. The ice scoop was stored on Styrofoam atop the ice machine. Fryers have grease buildup, storage is cluttered, and floors and drains need cleaning.

headline: Cold dairy held too warm; hot water restored
summary: Milk and dairy held at 46.4-55.8F were discarded, about 20 lbs. A two-door cold unit at 52F was tagged. Hot water was missing and was restored on site to 133.5F. Food handler and allergen certificates were expired or missing.

headline: Mouse droppings and small flies found
summary: About 7 mouse droppings were on the floor in the sandwich and bread prep corner, and about 8 small flies were on a drain near the dishwasher. Droppings must be removed, and additional pest service is needed. Other issues include a stripped hot water handle.

headline: Rodent droppings found; citation issued
summary: About 40 rodent droppings were found under the chip storage racks and on a prep table shelf. All must be removed and the area sanitized. Citation issued. Also noted: a missing cooler handle, a leaking sink, and repeat violations for food on floors and debris.

headline: Repeat violations: leak and expired certificates
summary: Two previous core violations were not corrected. A leaking pipe under the warewashing hand sink needs repair. Multiple food handlers had expired certificates. Both must be corrected by the re-inspection date.

headline: Missing test strips; unsafe storage and repairs
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer, and rice utensils were kept in 75.9F water. No test strips were available for the sink. Food was stored in plastic bags, the cold water handle is broken, and rust and water damage need repair.

headline: Employee drinking in food area; missing labels
summary: An employee drank from an uncovered container in the kitchen. The 3-door beverage cooler has no thermometer. Bulk dry containers are unlabeled, and single-service items are stored on the basement floor.

headline: Ice machine door buildup; re-inspection passed
summary: The ice machine door in the front prep area had excessive buildup. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain it. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Damaged tile and restroom wall
summary: Damaged tile was found in the rear area, and a restroom wall near the soap dispenser is damaged. The person in charge was told to repair both areas.

headline: Small flies found; pest control recommended
summary: About 10 small dark winged flies were in the demo kitchen, and small flies were on walls, boxes, the sink, and the ice machine. The sink must be cleaned and sanitized, and pest control was recommended. Citation issued.

headline: Chips stored on floor; poor cooler lighting
summary: Three large boxes of chips were stored on the floor and were moved at least six inches up. Breadknives were stored in sanitizer. Floor tiles are missing, debris is under the sink, and walk-in lighting is poor.

headline: Live roaches and mouse droppings found
summary: Three live roaches were on the wall behind the three-compartment sink, and more than 10 mouse droppings were found near the counter and cold unit. No certified manager was present while TCS foods were prepared. Cold foods were discarded.

headline: Handwashing sinks lack soap and drying supplies
summary: A rear handsink had no soap, and no hand drying supplies were at any sink. Signage was missing, and boxes blocked one sink. Citation issued for handwashing. Also noted: a toilet door not self-closing, mold-like ceiling tiles, and a greasy fryer.

headline: Restroom door lacks self-closing device
summary: The restroom door has no self-closing device and must be fitted with one. The prep area ceiling is water-damaged and must be replaced.

headline: Wiping cloths left out; leaking handsink
summary: Wiping cloths were left on counters and must be stored in sanitizer when not in use. The ice machine interior must be cleaned. A handsink next to the line leaks at the faucet base.

headline: Knife stored improperly; raw wood shelving
summary: A knife was stored between a prep table and cooler instead of in a knife rack. Raw wood shelving at the front counter must be sealed so it can be cleaned.

headline: Missing and detached coving in prep area
summary: Coving is detached or missing in several places in the food prep area. It must be repaired or replaced to create a smooth, cleanable surface.

headline: Hot water too cool; no health policy; repeat notice
summary: No written employee health policy was on the premises, which is a priority violation. The rear dishwashing handsink water was 85.4F; it must be 100F, and a 2-day notice was given. Rear receiving doors are not rodent-proof, and washrooms lack ventilation.

headline: Greasy, dusty hood filters
summary: Hood filters above the griddle had grease and dust buildup. The manager was instructed to clean them.

headline: Mold in produce cooler; mechanical ventilation not working
summary: Blackened, moldy walls and ceiling in the produce walk-in must be cleaned and sanitized. Also noted: missing signage, thermometers, and labels, ice scoops stored on the ice machine, slow handsink drain, and dusty vents.

headline: No certified manager; no health policy or spill kit
summary: No person in charge with a valid certificate was on duty while fresh-cut salads were prepared. No employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit, or sanitizer test kit was present. Gaps at doors and no food handler certificates.

headline: No walk-in thermometer; openings near furnace
summary: The walk-in cooler has no thermometer and one must be installed. Openings around a furnace pipe and a wall hole were noted and must be sealed. Grease and debris buildup, a leaking drain pipe, and no food handler certificate were also noted.

headline: No food service manager certificate; citation
summary: No valid food service manager certificate was on site, and a citation was issued. Ice buildup is in a small chest freezer and must be cleared. The 3-compartment sink faucet leaks. An expired allergen certificate is a repeat violation.

headline: Live plants in food area; wet mops
summary: Live pottery plants were stored in the food production area. Staff must keep them away from open food and clean utensils. Wet mops must be hung to dry.

headline: Food debris in reach-in cooler bottom
summary: Food debris must be cleaned from the bottom of a two-door reach-in cooler on the line.

headline: Food handlers need required training
summary: All food handlers must obtain the required food handler training.

headline: Cold foods too warm; about $400 discarded
summary: Many cold TCS foods were too warm, including salmon at 50.5F and eggs at 56F. About 35 lbs was discarded. The prep and display coolers were at 52.4F and 49F and must not be used until they reach 41F or below.

headline: No sanitation manager; repeat door gap
summary: No person in charge or certified sanitation manager was on site, and no certificate was posted; citation issued. No test kit was available for the high-temperature dish machine. A side exit door gap from a prior inspection was not corrected, and the inspection summary was not posted.

headline: Leaking handsink drains; no covered trash
summary: Drain pipes under the prep and dish area handsinks are leaking and must be repaired. The customer restroom has no covered trash can. One food allergen training certificate has expired.

headline: Food debris on equipment; no food handler certificates
summary: Food debris and flour buildup were found on equipment and tables. Boxes and debris were on the basement floor, restroom ceiling vents were dusty, and no food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Raw meat above produce; prep cooler too warm
summary: Raw chicken was stored above open leafy greens; raw steak was stored beside cilantro and cucumbers. A prep cooler held cold food at up to 60.1F and was at 66.6F; it was tagged out. About 16 lbs was discarded.

headline: Suspension sign removed; citation issued
summary: The license suspension sign posted on 9/9/22 was removed. Removing a suspension sign is prohibited, and a citation was issued.

headline: Failed: no hand soap, unsafe food temperatures
summary: Hand sink lacked soap; soap was obtained during inspection. Curry sauce cooled too slowly and cold display items were too warm (raw eggs 56.0F). About 18 lbs of food was discarded. Clean and dirty dishware were mixed.

headline: Missing splashguard; leak and dirty basement
summary: A splashguard is missing between a handwash sink and utility sink in the rear. Ice has built up on a cooler condenser, the handwash sink leaks, and the basement floor needs cleaning.

headline: Food debris on rear hallway walls
summary: Food debris was found on the walls of the rear hallway. The manager must clean and maintain them.

headline: No certified manager during egg and sandwich prep
summary: The person in charge had no proof of food safety management training. No person in charge with a valid certificate was present while eggs and sandwiches were prepared; citation issued. No certified manager had allergen training.

headline: Cardboard used as equipment liner
summary: Cardboard was used as a liner under equipment. The inspector instructed the staff to remove it. Surfaces must be smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Unlabeled food; sink plumbing backs up
summary: Food containers in coolers and dry storage lacked name labels. Water backs up at the smoothie bar two-compartment sink when the handsink runs; both sinks were tagged and a citation was issued. The dumpster lids were open and the certified manager lacked allergen proof.

headline: Faucets, rear door gap, and greasy floors
summary: Restroom faucets run only about 1 second and must run at least 15 seconds. Chicken was covered tightly while cooling. A rear door gap was open to pests. Mini cups are used as scoops, and a rusty sifter must be replaced.

headline: Cooling units dirty; clutter and food on floors
summary: Interior and exterior surfaces of prep cooling units need cleaning. The refuse area has excessive clutter. Items are stored on walk-in and prep floors. Some food handlers lack training and one manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen training; grease buildup
summary: Food handlers lacked food handler training, and the manager lacked allergen training. Also noted: no hair restraints, a missing dump sink, food debris on the slicer and prep equipment, damaged wall bases, and dirty hood filters.

headline: Greasy fryers and floors; broken tiles
summary: Interiors of deep fryers and the grease trap need cleaning. Grease on the floor under the fryers and in front of the 3-compartment sink must be cleaned. Broken floor tiles and chipped paint near the mop sink need repair.

headline: No sanitation manager; mouse droppings found
summary: About 45-50 mouse droppings were found in rear storage and a front prep corner. No rodent activity was seen at re-inspection, but there was no pest logbook or updated pest service. No certified manager or employee health policy was on site.

headline: Live roaches and mouse droppings; citation issued
summary: About 15 live cockroaches were in a food prep floor drain, and about 50 mouse droppings were behind a dry storage refrigerator. Dead roaches were also found. Additional pest service is needed. Ice machine debris and stained cutting boards were also noted.

headline: Grease trap and floors need cleaning
summary: Exterior of grease trap at 3-compartment sink must be cleaned. Floors along wall bases and under equipment, especially at 3-compartment sink, need cleaning. Dusty, dirty display counter shelves with popcorn must be cleaned.

headline: Food on floors; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Food containers stored on floor in walk-in cooler, prep and storage must be raised six inches. Single-service articles must be inverted and off floor. Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced. Clutter on second-floor storage must be removed.

headline: Food on floors; greasy equipment; clutter
summary: Food items stored on floor in walk-in cooler and freezer must be elevated six inches. Ice machine residue must be cleaned. Pop crates used as shelving must be replaced; excessive clutter must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Improper mop storage and missing food handler proof
summary: Mops not stored to air-dry; must be mounted. Employee washroom doors not self-closing; must install devices. Foam-like caulk on walls and pipes must be made smooth and cleanable. Covered receptacle missing in all-gender washrooms. Food handler training proof is missing.

headline: Food handlers lacked hair restraints
summary: Food handlers working at the front service counter were not wearing proper hair restraints. Management must provide and maintain them.

headline: Expired food handler certificates on site
summary: Expired food handler certificates were on site; manager must ensure all certificates are current.

headline: 10+ roaches near steamer; pest control needed
summary: Found 10 or more roaches on wall next to large steamer and two roaches under the three-compartment sink. Pest control service required before next week. Proof of food handler training is needed for all handlers.

headline: No certified manager; sinks lacked soap and towels
summary: No certified food manager on duty during time/temperature-controlled (TCS) food prep; citation issued. Hand sinks lacked soap and paper towels, supplied during inspection. Water backs up at 3-compartment sink. Dead insects found in grime build-up; food stored on floor.

headline: Expired allergen certificates; unlabeled bulk food
summary: Expired allergen training certificates were on site; current certificates must be provided for all certified food managers. Bulk breadcrumbs at pizza prep station are unlabeled and must be labeled. Men's restroom door next to dining room must be self-closing.

headline: License number missing from ice cream truck
summary: License number is missing from both sides of the ice cream truck and must be provided and maintained. Bent window screen must be repaired to prevent possible pest entry.

headline: Raw food advisory missing; food handlers lack certificates
summary: Menu lacks consumer advisory for raw or undercooked items like sunny-side-up eggs and beef sandwich. Must add the required advisory sentence (priority violation). Dishes washed in 2-compartment sink; 3-compartment sink must be repaired and used. Several employees lack food handler certificates.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; missing cooler insulation
summary: Unlabeled bulk food, such as sugar and salt, must be labeled. Ice scoops tethered with chain must be untethered for washing. Deli cups must be air-dried after washing. Walk-in cooler lacks insulation around cooling lines and must be installed.

headline: No food prep sink at front coffee area
summary: Front prep area where coffee and tea are made has no sink for food preparation; one must be installed and maintained.

headline: Missing thermometer, handwashing signs, covered trash
summary: No thermometer inside milk cooler at coffee bar; must be provided. One toilet room lacks handwashing signage. Both unisex restrooms lack covered trash receptacles. Grooved, stained cutting boards must be repaired or replaced. Grease on hood filters must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager; dish machine tagged out
summary: Food handlers prepared time/temperature-controlled (TCS) foods without certified food manager or certificate on site; citation issued. High-temperature dish machine did not reach 180°F and was tagged; do not use until reinspected. Fifth-floor hand sink lacked hot water; corrected during inspection.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths; grease and food buildup
summary: Soiled wiping cloths left on prep tables must be stored in sanitizer at 50 parts per million. Cooked food in cooler stored in grocery bags; food-grade bags required. Grease and mold-like buildup on equipment must be removed. Cooler lacks thermometer.

headline: Greasy fryer surfaces need cleaning
summary: Fryer surfaces have food, grease and dirt buildup. Management must clean and maintain the fryers.

headline: Incomplete vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit and procedure
summary: Vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was incomplete; only a disinfectant spray bottle was on site. A written cleanup procedure with equipment list must be provided. Mop was not stored to air-dry; must be mounted.

headline: Dirty floors, drains, and cabinets; allergen certificate missing
summary: Floor drains, corners, and areas under racks and heavy equipment have food and dirt; must be cleaned. Lower cabinets under beverage station need cleaning. Certified food manager (CFM) must obtain allergen training certificate.

headline: Unlabeled flour and rice containers; clutter
summary: Bulk flour and rice storage containers have no labels; all bulk and working ingredient containers must be labeled. Basement storage cluttered and inaccessible for cleaning; must organize, remove unnecessary items and raise all items six inches off floor.

headline: Improper storage, burnt-out light, allergen training needed
summary: Ice scoops on top of ice bin must be stored in a clean container. Serving plates on shelving must be inverted. Employee restrooms need covered waste receptacles. Food prep light bulb is burnt out. Managers must show allergen training certificates.

headline: No certified manager on duty during food prep
summary: No valid certified manager on duty while time/temperature-controlled (TCS) foods such as chicken were prepared, handled and served; manager must be on site at all times. Ice machine chute must be cleaned. Dry storage shelving and counters need cleaning.

headline: Utensils in standing water; damaged floors
summary: Utensils in use were kept in standing water at room temperature; must be kept under running cold water or in a clean dry container. Floor in front of one-compartment prep sink is damaged and must be repaired.

headline: No certified food manager during food prep
summary: No City-certified food manager was on premises while time/temperature-controlled (TCS) foods like cooked beef and cheese were prepared; one must be present. Calcium buildup on both soda ice machines must be cleaned.

headline: Over 40 small flies; no certified food manager
summary: No City-certified food manager on premises. Over 40 small flies found in dishwashing area, basement hallway and bars. Flies must be eliminated; pest control recommended. Bar dish machine had no chlorine sanitizer and was tagged. Handwashing signs missing.

headline: 3-door prep cooler at 52°F with eggs, hamburgers
summary: Cooler air measured 52°F while holding eggs and hamburgers; violation remains. Must be repaired and kept at or below 41°F.

headline: Dirty fryers, cooking equipment, flour containers
summary: Bottom of fryers, exterior of cooking equipment, and containers holding flour for chicken must be cleaned where needed.

headline: Unlabeled rice container; entrance door opening
summary: Large white container of rice in prep area is unlabeled; all food containers must be labeled with common name. Opening in middle of front entrance doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Allergen training proof missing for one employee.

headline: No employee health policy or training on site
summary: No employee health policy or training was on site; must establish one with verifiable documents. Basement shelves and wall above sink must be smooth, cleanable, and non-absorbent. Basement washroom is cluttered and must be cleared. Kitchen light needs protective shield.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen training certificates
summary: Missing food handler training certificates and allergen training. Also needed: thermometers in coolers, ice machine and dish machine cleaned, three drain stoppers for sinks, and floors cleaned under coolers and freezers.

headline: Ice buildup, outside debris, and missing allergen certificate
summary: Two-door reach-in freezer at cooking line has ice buildup and must be defrosted. Leaves and debris under and behind dumpster must be cleaned. Certified food manager lacks allergen training certificate; management instructed to comply.

headline: Live flying insects behind bar; no certificate posted
summary: About 20 live flying insects behind and around the bar; more pest control is needed. No certified food manager present while time/temperature-controlled (TCS) foods were prepared or served. Ice machine has mold-like growth. Dish machine reached only 154°F; needs 160°F.

headline: Clutter in basement storage; rodent hiding risk
summary: Clutter and unnecessary items in basement non-food storage must be removed to prevent rodent hiding spots.

headline: Leaking sinks and ceiling openings
summary: Water leaks under exposed food-prep hand sink and in women's washroom must be repaired. Several openings in drywall ceiling above food prep areas must be sealed. Grease on wall behind cooking equipment and exterior of grease trap must be cleaned.

headline: Pest control logbook missing; prior violation uncorrected
summary: No pest control logbook was available, and previous report #2608090 was not corrected in time. Food stored on floor in dry storage must be raised six inches. Also needed: handwashing signs, thermometers in coolers, a utility sink, and a self-closing washroom door.

headline: Gaps under exterior doors; dirty floor drain
summary: 1/2-inch gaps under exterior doors on first and second floors must be repaired to be tight-fitting. Utility room floor drain has dirt, grime and debris; must be cleaned. All-gender restroom lacks covered receptacle in stall. Certified manager needs allergen training.

headline: No employee health policy; shelving missing
summary: No employee health policy was available; must obtain signed acknowledgment of duty to report illness transmissible through food. No shelving in prep, storage and walk-in cooler; must provide. No backflow device on utility sink; must provide and maintain. No waste receptacles at handwashing sinks.

headline: No covered receptacle for feminine hygiene products
summary: Unisex staff toilet room has no covered receptacle for feminine hygiene products; management must provide and maintain one.

headline: Milk crate shelving, clutter, and facility repairs
summary: Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced. Clutter in broken equipment must be removed to deter pests. Also: grease on floors, damaged cutting boards, missing floor tiles, 4x5 wall hole, leaking hot water line, rusty dish machine shielding.

headline: Dirty ice machine dripping onto ice
summary: Black dirt buildup inside soda ice machine dripped onto ice; all ice discarded and machine must be cleaned by reinspection. Food debris on dish drainboards must be cleaned. Floor tiles at dish machine area need repair and grout.

headline: Wiping cloths, leaking faucet, floor hazards
summary: Wiping cloths stored on hand sinks and prep tables must be kept in sanitizing solution at required strength. Dirty storage racks and cooler bottoms need cleaning. Sink faucet base leaks. Walk-in cooler floor is a trip hazard.

headline: Food on floor; loose dust and debris
summary: Food items stored on floor in rear storage must be raised six inches. Loose debris, dirt and dust build-up on floors and corners throughout the facility must be detail-cleaned more often.

headline: Heavy grease and food debris throughout kitchen
summary: Grease buildup on cooking equipment, walls, floors and shelving in kitchen and prep areas must be degreased, cleaned and sanitized. Food debris and spills on floors and surfaces must be detail-cleaned under shelving, prep coolers, prep tables and fryers.

headline: Dusty vents; no allergen certificates for managers
summary: Dust built up on washroom vents must be cleaned and maintained. No proof of allergen training or certificates for any certified food managers; must be provided and maintained.

headline: No food handler training; no allergen training
summary: No food handler training for employees and no allergen training for food manager must be provided. No backflow devices on both ice machines must be provided. Calcium buildup in dish machine must be cleaned; bar chest freezer must be defrosted.

headline: Gap between floor and baseboard in washroom
summary: Gap between floor and baseboard in southwest washroom, west wall near toilet, must be repaired and maintained.

headline: No handwashing signs at prep sinks
summary: No handwashing signage at hand sinks in preparation areas. Must be provided.

headline: No handwashing signs; unlabeled bulk; light shields broken
summary: No handwashing signage at exposed sinks in bars and first-floor prep area; signage must be provided. Some bulk containers in basement dry storage unlabeled; must label with common name. Covered trash receptacles missing in unisex restrooms.

headline: No front handwashing sink; boxed food on floor
summary: Front prep area has no handwashing sink; one must be installed with hot and cold water, soap and towels. Boxed food must be raised off floor in walk-in cooler and dry storage. Basement 3-compartment sink has no cold running water.

headline: Debris on cooking equipment; items stored on floor
summary: Re-inspection passed. Debris built up on grill and table-top oven must be cleaned. Items on the floor in rear storage and hallway must be raised off the floor and kept away from walls.

headline: Fly strip hanging; door openings; bulk unlabeled
summary: Fly strip hanging in rear prep area must be removed. Openings along rear exit door frame must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Pots stored on floor must be re-washed and raised. Missing floor tiles and grease buildup need repair.

headline: No covered receptacle in washroom
summary: Washroom has no covered receptacle for waste; management must provide one.

headline: Front door gap; absorbent walls and missing coving
summary: 1/4-inch gap at bottom of front door must be fixed to be tight-fitting and rodent-proof. Rear area drywall is absorbent and must be finished smooth and cleanable. Rear storage and toilet room walls need coving (curved wall-base seal).

headline: Cluttered, cracked basement floor; expired certificates
summary: Basement floor by south wall is cluttered; items must be elevated or removed. Large cracks in basement floor by chest freezers must be repaired. Some food handler certificates have expired; update them. One food manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; 3-compartment sink floods
summary: Dish machine showed 0 ppm (parts per million) final sanitizer and must reach at least 50 ppm; not in use during inspection (priority violation, no citation issued). Three-compartment sink not working: draining one compartment makes another flood. Must be serviced.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; ceiling tiles damaged
summary: Milk crates may not be used; approved shelving required. Dust on produce cooler and deli vents must be cleaned. Dirt and debris under 2nd-floor shelving and in produce cooler must be cleaned. Missing and water-damaged ceiling tiles must be replaced.

headline: Missing thermometers, backflow device, and lighting
summary: Basement stand-up freezers lack a thermometer. No backflow prevention device found for basement ice maker; must be installed. Basement walk-in cooler lighting is inadequate and must be improved.

headline: Overflowing dumpsters and unlabeled walnuts
summary: Outside dumpsters overflow with trash preventing lids closing; trash must be kept inside receptacles so pests cannot reach it. Walnuts out of original packaging lack labels. Minor leak at 3-compartment sink; soiled mop heads must be hung to dry.

headline: Mold-like buildup in ice machine; ice discarded
summary: Mold-like buildup inside ice machine dripped onto ice for human consumption. All ice must be discarded; machine must be cleaned and sanitized. No handwashing sign at basement sink. Grease on bottoms of shelves in dry storage must be cleaned.

headline: Missing thermometer and backflow device; trash overflow
summary: Mini fridge at coffee line lacks a thermometer. Coffee station has no backflow device. Bulk items near the 3-compartment sink are unlabeled. Outside trash lids won't close due to overflow. Cookware drying right-side up and restrooms lack covered receptacles.

headline: No thermometers in coolers; inadequate lighting
summary: Thermometers could not be found inside cooling units; must be provided. Lighting throughout prep area is inadequate; bulbs must be replaced and lighting increased, including 2-door cooler in front prep.

headline: Dish machine not installed; prep cooler not working
summary: High-temperature dish machine not yet installed; final rinse must reach 180°F once installed (priority violation). One of two line prep coolers not operational; must be repaired below 41°F. Certified food manager lacks allergen training certificate; must show proof.

headline: Food on cooler floor; improper wiping cloth storage
summary: Food containers on walk-in cooler floor must be raised 6 inches on proper shelving. Wiping cloths left on counter must be kept in sanitizing solution when not in use. Aluminum foil on prep cooler shelves must be removed for cleaning and airflow.

headline: Ice machine residue and low hot water pressure
summary: Black-like buildup inside 24th-floor ice machine; schedule cleaning. Very low hot water pressure at basement prep hand sink must be repaired. Dish racks stored on floor under dish machine must be raised. Clutter near hot equipment must be cleared.

headline: Raw wood and unfinished floors behind counter
summary: Raw wood surfaces behind front counter must be sealed. Unfinished floors and surfaces there must be repaired or replaced and maintained.

headline: Upright equipment, plastic coating, basement clutter
summary: Equipment stored upright must be inverted to prevent cross-contamination. Plastic coating on basement 3-compartment sink must be removed. Clutter and unused equipment in basement must be removed to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: Mouse droppings, live roaches, unsafe cold holding
summary: About 400 mouse droppings and live roaches found throughout. Food held above 41°F was discarded (about 50 lbs). Cooked duck was handled with bare hands. Mop sink overflowed with sewage. Handwashing sinks lacked soap and towels.

headline: Missing handwashing sign and sink stoppers
summary: Handwashing sign missing at rear meat prep sink. Three-compartment sink needs stoppers. Hose on kitchen hand sink faucet must be repaired. Grease on outside oil tank must be cleaned. Dusty fans in seafood walk-in cooler must be cleaned.

headline: Dumpsters list wrong address
summary: Dumpsters on site show an incorrect address; person in charge must correct it.

headline: Broken hot-water knob; no thermometers
summary: Prep-area hand sink has a broken hot-water knob that won't shut off; must be repaired. No metal-stem (probe) thermometer on site; must obtain. High-temperature dish machine lacks a permanent heat-indicator thermometer; must be obtained.

headline: About 20 small flies throughout; cool handwashing water
summary: About 20 small flies found in prep, dishwashing, front storage and bar areas. Pest control recommended on or after 10/3/2025. Several handwashing sinks run 72.3-95.5°F; must reach at least 100°F. Three certified food managers lack allergen training.

headline: Uncovered sugar container near handwashing sink
summary: Container of sugar near handwashing sink was uncovered; keep covered to avoid contamination.

headline: Basement freezer at 70°F; repairs needed
summary: Basement walk-in freezer measured 70°F air temperature; must be repaired and kept below 0°F. Also: clean deep fryer, grill, prep tables, light shields, ceiling tiles; regrout and seal wall corners and holes; replace several burnt-out lights.

headline: No sanitizer at 3-compartment sink; food on floors
summary: 3-compartment sink was set up without sanitizer solution; citation issued. Employees drank at the prep area; a separate break area must be provided. Food containers on floor must be raised 6 inches. Cloth lining meat slicer must be removed.

headline: Items on floor in storage; dirty mop sink
summary: Single-use items in rear storage and walk-in cooler must be raised off floor. Dirt and food debris under rear storage shelving must be cleaned. Dirt and debris inside utility mop sink in rear storage must be cleaned.

headline: Missing sink stoppers, greasy alley, expired certificates
summary: No stoppers for prep-area 3-compartment sink; working stoppers must be provided. Grease and food spills on alley floor and grease container exterior must be cleaned by reinspection. Food handler certificates have expired and must be updated.

headline: Food debris in hot holding unit and on floor
summary: Food debris inside hot holding unit must be cleaned. Food debris on floor in front prep area near drive-thru must be cleaned.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; corrected on site
summary: Low-temperature dish machine in bar read 0 ppm chlorine and wasn't sanitizing; citation issued. New chlorine sanitizer jug was provided during inspection; it now reads 100 ppm. Dish racks stored on floor under utensil shelving must be elevated.

headline: No rear handwashing sink; no food handler certificates
summary: Rear prep area has no handwashing sink; a citation was issued. Dishwashing at the 3-compartment sink lacked basins set up; manager corrected it on site. Bulk containers unlabeled; three sink stoppers needed. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Leaking bar sink, pink residue, no trash lids
summary: Bar hand sink leaks heavily from P-trap (drain bend); must be fixed. First bar gun holder has pink buildup on its bottom; must be cleaned. Unisex restroom trash receptacles lack lids; must be provided with covers.

headline: About 30 small flies; food pots on cooler floor
summary: About 30 small flies were seen near the dish machine, above three-compartment sink and coffee station. Pots of food on walk-in cooler floor must be raised six inches. Rusty shelving, greasy surfaces, and food debris under cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Broken walk-in cooler handle
summary: Walk-in cooler handle is broken and must be replaced and maintained.

headline: Missing food manager certificate; restroom fixtures faulty
summary: Original City of Chicago food manager certificate was not on site; manager must provide it. Women's restroom handwashing sink water runs too briefly for proper handwashing. Another women's sink does not turn on. Men's toilet does not flush properly.

headline: Cooked egg rolls cross-contaminated with raw chicken
summary: Cooked egg rolls were stored in a cardboard box previously used for raw chicken; citation issued. Consumer advisory reminder missing from menu. Bug zapper stored in food prep area must be removed. Ashtray with cigarette ashes found in basement restroom.

headline: Door gap, leaking pipe, and dusty ceiling
summary: Thermometer needed in hot holding unit. A 1/4-inch gap between front doors must be sealed to block pest entry. Leaky pipe under dishwashing-area hand sink must be repaired. Also: dirty soda gun holder, dusty ceiling vents, floors wet around sinks.

headline: Dead roaches throughout; doors not tight-fitting
summary: Dead roaches found throughout the facility on boxes, floors and cold-holding equipment. Must be removed and sanitized. Rear and front exterior doors not tight-fitting; gap at front door bottom must be repaired. Broken toilet seat must be replaced.

headline: Leaking sprayer; damaged ceiling and floor tiles
summary: 3-compartment sink sprayer leaks heavily when turned on; must be fixed. Water-stained ceiling tiles, damaged or missing floor tiles, and missing wall base near front handwashing sink must be replaced. Vents in toilet room are dusty and must be cleaned.

headline: Employee without food handler training on site
summary: Food handling employee present without food handler training or certificate; must provide training and keep certificates on site at all times. Three-compartment sink drain leaks; must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces; dirty floors
summary: Wet wiping cloths left on several prep surfaces must be stored in sanitizing solution between uses. Loose debris, dirt and dust on floors and corners throughout the facility must be detail-cleaned more often.

headline: No certified manager; slime in ice machine
summary: No certified food manager on duty during food prep; citation issued. Self-serve ice machine has black slime dripping onto ice; must be cleaned and sanitized. Salmon and steak in cooler held too warm; 15 lbs discarded.

headline: Non-rodent-proof back door; floors and grease
summary: Back door to outside receptacle area isn't rodent-proof; barrier must be installed on middle door where rust is present. Grease receptacle exterior has grease and food debris and must be cleaned. Floors need cleaning and items raised six inches.

headline: Ice buildup in walk-in freezer; debris on floors
summary: Ice buildup on ceiling and floor of walk-in freezer must be removed and repaired. Debris on floors in meat department, freezers, coolers and grocery back room must be cleaned. Standing water in two back-room drains must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager for 30 minutes; dead roaches
summary: No certified manager was on site from 8:30 to 9:00 AM while chicken and eggs were prepared and served. Dead roaches found in dry storage must be removed and sanitized. Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables must be stored in sanitizer.

headline: No certified manager; unapproved food found
summary: No certified food manager on duty while time/temperature-controlled (TCS) foods were prepared, handled or served; citation issued. Unlabeled food from unapproved source found; about 5 lbs ($100) discarded. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Menu raw-food advisory added during inspection.

headline: Missing covered trash receptacle; food handler training
summary: Women's restroom lacks covered trash receptacle; one must be provided. Several employees lack food handler training; all employees must complete training and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Residue in ice machine; no milk cooler thermometer
summary: Lobby ice machine interior has black, pink and brown substance on ice-contact surfaces; ice used for human consumption. Ice must be removed, deep-cleaned and sanitized; citation issued. Upright milk refrigerator in rear dining area lacks visible working thermometer.

headline: Leaking sink faucets; restroom needs cleaning
summary: Leaks at base of three-compartment sink faucet and one-compartment sink, plus a very loose faucet head in the toilet room, must be repaired. Restroom sink and toilet need detail cleaning.

headline: Floors under kitchen equipment dirty
summary: Floors behind and under kitchen equipment are not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: No certified food manager; no employee health policy
summary: No certified food manager on site while time/temperature-controlled (TCS) foods were served; citation issued. No employee health policy. Coffee-area handwashing sink blocked by utensils, with no paper towels. No sanitizer test kit. Milk cooler lacks thermometer.

headline: Ice machine buildup; no thermometer; slow drain
summary: Slight ice buildup inside ice machine must be detail cleaned and maintained. Refrigerator near ice coffee area storing milk has no thermometer; one must be provided. Slow-draining center compartment of 3-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Cold foods above 41°F; prep cooler tagged
summary: Chopped chicken, black beans and sliced tomatoes measured 48–49°F and were discarded, about 20 pounds worth $300. A prep cooler's air read 46.8°F and was tagged, not to be used until repaired.

headline: Dishwasher leak; cardboard shelf liners
summary: A leak at the top of the dishwasher must be repaired. Cardboard lines shelves in rear storage and must be replaced with smooth, cleanable shelving. Also noted residue on the washing machine, grease trap lid debris, and dusty ceiling vents.

headline: Dead bugs on glue traps; greasy areas
summary: Multiple dead bugs were on glue traps in rear food prep and dish areas and must be removed. The sausage machine, reach-in units, and floors under fryers and walk-in shelving need detail cleaning. Standing water was noted near the ice machine.

headline: No certified manager; no sanitizer test kit
summary: No valid certified food manager certificate was provided, and no certified manager was present while food was handled; citation issued. Food was stored on the floor at the rear. No sanitizer test kit was available, and some employees lacked food handler training.

headline: Cooked beans held too warm; discarded
summary: Cooked beans held overnight in the walk-in cooler measured 51.3°F, above the cold-holding limit. Management was told to cool hot foods within required time and hold them at 41°F or lower. About $10 of beans were discarded.

headline: No certified sanitation manager on site
summary: The person in charge had no City of Chicago sanitation certificate, and no sanitation manager was present while milk and eggs were handled; citation issued. The manager had no allergen training. The dish machine exterior needs cleaning.

headline: No allergen training; clutter and grease noted
summary: The food manager has no food allergen training, which must be provided and maintained. Also noted grease in fryer cabinets and unnecessary items, including a smoker and unused equipment, in the rear yard and prep areas.

headline: Utensils not inverted; foil shelf liners
summary: Multi-use utensils were not stored inverted, and aluminum foil lined the storage shelves. Management was instructed to invert utensils and remove the foil so surfaces stay smooth and cleanable.

headline: No written employee health policy on premises
summary: No written employee health policy was on the premises, a priority item. Also cited: no drain board at the three-compartment sink, a misplaced ice machine backflow device, non-self-closing washroom doors, and no covered waste bin.

headline: Food on floor; utensils unprotected; cleaning needed
summary: Stock and food supplies were stored on the floor, and knives and utensils on shelves were not protected. Wiping cloths were not in sanitizer, and handwashing signs were missing. Rusty shelves may hold only non-food items; equipment and hoods need cleaning.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: The certified food manager did not have an allergen training certificate and must show proof. The top of the dishwasher and the inside of a two-door prep cooler also need cleaning.

headline: Quarter-inch door gap; floor needs cleaning
summary: A gap of about 1/4 inch at the bottom of the front entry door could allow pests in. Management must close it. The floor under and behind equipment in the front food area needs detail cleaning.

headline: Damaged cooler gasket; dirty prep floor
summary: A cooler door gasket was damaged and must be replaced. Floors along the wall base of the rear prep area had food debris and need cleaning.

headline: Live mouse and cockroaches; dish machine held
summary: One live mouse and over 10 mouse droppings were found in the kitchen prep area, plus 4 live cockroaches behind the dish machine. The dish machine's final rinse read 134°F and is tagged not to be used. No certified food manager was on site.

headline: Greasy fryer and cooler interiors need cleaning
summary: Grease on the inside and outside of the deep fryer needs detail cleaning, as do cooler interiors. A damaged ceiling tile near the women's washroom must be replaced, and kitchen hood filters need grease removed.

headline: Over 70 rat droppings; no hot water; no manager
summary: Over 70 rat droppings were found in dining, cashier and basement areas. Raw eggs were held at 50.5–52.7°F and a refrigerator at 50.4°F. Hot water was restored during inspection. No certified manager was on premises; citations issued.

headline: Expired food handler certificates
summary: Some food handlers had expired food handler certificates. The manager was instructed to update them.

headline: Leaking sink drain and faucet need repair
summary: A leak was found at the three-compartment sink drain trap. The hand sink faucet across from the ice machine also needs repair. Management was instructed to correct and maintain both plumbing items.

headline: Restroom door not self-closing
summary: The toilet room door was not self-closing. Management was instructed to provide a self-closing device.

headline: Door gap, missing backflow device, dirty floors
summary: A small gap under the front entry door could allow pests in; it must be sealed. The rear utility sink lacked a backflow prevention device. Floors under prep tables and the three-compartment sink had dirt and debris buildup.

headline: Wiping cloths unstored; rusty racks; leaking faucet
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution. Rusty storage racks in walk-in and prep coolers and food buildup on fryers and racks need attention. A leak at the three-compartment sink faucet must be fixed.

headline: Unlabeled food containers; greasy floors
summary: Food containers in the walk-in cooler and dry storage lacked name labels. The toilet-room hand sink had no handwashing sign. A mop was not hung to dry, and floors along walls and under wok equipment need detail cleaning.

headline: Food stored on floor under cooking equipment
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor under and around cooking equipment beneath the hood. Food debris and encrusted grease were found on the microwave area and equipment. The new certified food manager has no allergen training certificate on file.

headline: Chicken stored on floor; door gap; dumpster trash
summary: Several boxes of chicken were stored on the walk-in cooler floor, risking cross-contamination. Cold-holding units lacked thermometers, and the front door bottom gap must be sealed. Trash and a missing dumpster lid from a prior violation remain.

headline: No hot water at sinks; unlabeled foods
summary: The three-compartment sink and hand sinks had no hot running water, reading about 63 to 65°F. Management must provide about 100°F at hand sinks and 110°F at the three-compartment sink. A faucet leak from a prior report was not fixed; citation issued.

headline: Food debris in coolers; expired handler certificates
summary: Food debris was on interior surfaces of all coolers and freezers. Floors and walls in the prep area were dirty, and employees' personal items were stored there. Multiple food handlers had expired certificates.

headline: Salad cold-holding failures; cooler tagged
summary: Tomato-cucumber salad, mixed vegetable salad and prepared sauce were above safe cold temperatures and were discarded. The salad line cooler read 55.0°F and was tagged out of use. An employee's uncovered drink was moved and equipment was sanitized on site.

headline: Door gap, missing thermometers, damaged ceilings
summary: Cooling units must have thermometers. The rear door had at least a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom, so doors must be rodent-proofed. Ceilings in the toilet room and waiting area are damaged, and food-debris buckets in the backyard need removal.

headline: No certified manager on duty; no health policies
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while food was handled, and no signed employee health policies were present; citations issued. No inspection summary was posted. Also noted a slow drain and missing grout under cooking equipment.

headline: Leaking drainpipe; greasy walls and dust
summary: A drainpipe under the rear warewashing hand sink was leaking and must be repaired. Excess grease, dirt and spills were found on walls, pipes, and behind cooking equipment. Fans, light shields and vents had dust buildup.

headline: Raw meats above safe temperature; 32 lbs discarded
summary: Raw marinated beef skewers at 51.5°F and raw marinated chicken at 55.6°F were above the 41°F limit; about 32 pounds were discarded. Raw chicken was thawed in standing water, raw beef was stored on the floor, and some staff lacked hair restraints.

headline: Incomplete allergen certificate; door closer needed
summary: The allergen training certificate on file was incomplete. The employee restroom door must be self-closing. Also noted minimal buildup inside the ice machine, a dusty vent cover, and floor drains and freezer floors to clean.

headline: Hot water at 102°F; cooling method inadequate
summary: Hot water at the three-compartment sink measured 102°F, below the 110°F minimum; citation issued. Pacaya was cooled in an inadequate way, since food must stay uncovered while cooling if protected from contamination. Unlabeled containers and a foil liner were also noted.

headline: Manager lacked proper city food service license
summary: A manager on duty did not have a proper City of Chicago food service manager license while eggs, milk and sausage were prepared and served; citation issued. Dirt and food debris were found along the front counter, under equipment, and on vents.

headline: No certified manager; hot foods below 135°F
summary: No certified food manager was on site while food was handled. Steam-table steak, chicken and onions measured 112–121°F, below 135°F; citation issued. Also cited: an inoperable dish machine temperature gauge and missing beard restraints.

headline: Cold foods at 48–51°F; 19 lbs discarded
summary: Chicken tenders, wings, arugula salad, butter and cheese were held at 48–51°F in a sauté reach-in cooler. They were discarded, about 19 pounds worth $142. A certified manager had an expired allergen training certificate.

headline: Food spills and debris on floors
summary: Food spills and debris were on floors in the rear storage and dishwashing area, under shelving racks. Management was instructed to remove them and maintain clean floors.

headline: No signed employee health policy; weak sink water
summary: No signed employee health policies were on file, a priority item. The hand sink had low hot and cold water pressure and must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Food debris in rear storage coolers
summary: Food debris was on the bottom of reach-in coolers and freezers in the rear storage area and must be cleaned.

headline: Equipment too large for three-compartment sink
summary: Some equipment is too large to fully immerse in the three-compartment sink. The facility must install a larger sink, use smaller equipment, or use a health-department-approved manual method.

headline: Wiping cloths unstored; cleaning needed
summary: Wiping cloths must be kept in sanitizing solution when not in use. Cutting boards were needed, heating equipment needed food spills removed, and floors under and around shelves needed cleaning.

headline: Food stored on floor; open cup on prep table
summary: Food was stored on the floor in the basement walk-in cooler and freezer, and an open coffee cup sat on a prep table. A plastic cup was used for salsa. Also cited: dirty prep surfaces, no covered waste bin, damaged walls, and floor debris.

headline: Employees eating and drinking in prep area
summary: Employees were drinking and eating in the kitchen prep area. Management must provide a separate break area. An ice scoop was stored inside the ice, and floors around equipment and floor drains had grease and food debris.

headline: Food stored low; floors and ice bin need cleaning
summary: Food items must be elevated at least six inches off the floor in the rear. The ice bin interior needs cleaning, tape is on a hand sink drainpipe in main prep, and debris and dust cover floors and corners throughout.

headline: Hot food on display below safe temperature
summary: Rice and chicken dishes on dining-area display tables measured about 75°F to 97°F, below the 135°F minimum. The manager discarded 25 pounds. Employees were also eating and drinking in the prep area.

headline: Over 50 trapped roaches; live roaches again
summary: Over 50 trapped roaches and carcasses were found in kitchen and dining areas. During re-inspection, 6 live cockroaches were seen in prep, dish and storage areas. A prior pest violation was not corrected; citation issued. A 1/4-inch rear exit gap was also noted.

headline: Debris throughout; no covered sanitary bin
summary: Debris was found on floors and surfaces throughout the facility. Management must detail-clean under shelving and increase cleaning. The employee washroom lacked a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

headline: Hot food below 135°F; 45 lbs discarded
summary: Cooked chicken at 110°F, rice at 82°F and taco beef at 79.3°F sat on a turned-off hot-holding unit. Hot food must stay at 135°F or above. The manager discarded 45 pounds. Floor storage and upkeep items were also noted.

headline: Food stored in grocery bags in coolers
summary: Assorted food items were stored inside grocery bags in coolers and refrigeration units. Management was instructed to move all food into approved food-grade containers.

headline: Food handler and allergen training required
summary: The manager was instructed to comply with food handler training requirements for all kitchen and food-handling staff. City-certified managers must provide and keep their allergen training current.

headline: Over 30 live flies; unapproved packaging
summary: Over 30 live flies were seen in prep and dining areas. Reduced-oxygen packaging was used without an approved plan; the equipment was tagged and about 10 pounds of food were discarded. An unapproved food trailer outside must be removed. Citations issued.

headline: Sauces covered while cooling; greasy ceiling
summary: Red and white sauces were covered with tight plastic lids while cooling in the walk-in cooler. Management must store them loosely covered or uncovered while cooling. Heavy grease and dust were on ceiling and walls by the pizza oven hood.

headline: Mold in ice machine; oysters missing tag
summary: Pink and black mold-like buildup inside the ice machine was dripping onto stored ice. The manager was told to discard the ice and clean the machine. Fresh oysters lacked a required shellstock tag; 20 pounds were discarded. Citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; bare-hand contact; expired food
summary: No certified food manager was present while food was prepared and served. An employee handled ready-to-eat food with bare hands. Some ready-to-eat foods were past their 7-day use-by date. Several employees lacked food handler certificates.

headline: Hand sink water too cool; citation issued
summary: Hot water at handwashing sinks in the cookline and cafe station measured 78.6–85.8°F; at least 100°F is required. Citation issued. Dish racks stored on the floor must be raised at least six inches.

headline: Stained, cut cutting boards need replacing
summary: Stained and deeply cut cutting boards were on drying racks in the dish area. Management must deep clean and restore them to a smooth surface or replace them.

headline: Three-compartment sink leaking from drain
summary: The three-compartment sink was leaking from the third basin drain. Management was instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: Leaking faucets; splash risk near clean items
summary: Clean equipment on a rack was exposed to splashes from the hand sink, so a splash guard is required. The hand sink and three-compartment sink faucets were leaking but still working. Customer washroom ventilation was not functioning.

headline: Black caulking and cracked fryer-area tiles
summary: Excessive black substance was on caulking above the two- and three-compartment sinks and on the toilet room door exterior. Cracked floor tiles in front of the fryers must be replaced so surfaces are smooth and cleanable.

headline: Leaky sink pipe; dirty meat coolers and floors
summary: A leaky pipe under the three-compartment sink in the kiosk must be repaired. Meat display cooler interiors need cleaning, and the slicer needs cleaning between uses. Floors and walls in prep and storage areas need detail cleaning.

headline: Missing handwash sign; torn refrigerator gasket
summary: The bar's handwashing sink had no signage and must have it. A refrigerator had torn gaskets inside and needs repair.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; cloths unstored
summary: Wiping cloths were on prep tables and in a container without sanitizer. Milk crates were used for elevation, which can hide pests, so proper shelving is required. Cutting boards with open seams and stains must be replaced or refinished.

headline: Open food in freezer; coolers need cleaning
summary: A few food items in the freezer were open and exposed and must be stored in food-grade containers or bags. Cooler interiors had spills or debris, and two deep freezers need defrosting and cleaning.

headline: About 50 live flying insects; repeat violation
summary: About 50 live small flying insects were seen on walls and ceilings in first-floor and basement prep, storage and bar areas. A prior pest violation was not corrected, so more pest control is needed; citation issued. A hanging fly strip was also noted.

headline: No certified manager; cooler at 59.2°F
summary: No person in charge or certified food manager was present while food was prepared and served. A prep cooler read 59.2°F and must not be used until it holds 41°F or below. Food was stored on the walk-in floor, and a rear door had a quarter-inch gap.

headline: Missing handwashing sign at bar sink
summary: The exposed handwashing sink in the bar had no handwashing signage. Management was instructed to provide it. This was the only item cited.

headline: Missing handwash signs; door gaps
summary: No handwashing signs were posted at the hand sinks, and they must be provided. The front entrance and exit door sweeps had 1/4-inch gaps, which must be rodent-proofed.

headline: Floor debris and missing ceiling tiles
summary: Floors under the three-compartment sink and throughout rear dry storage need detail cleaning. Missing ceiling tiles in the rear dry storage and dishwashing area must be reattached.

headline: No training proof for staff or managers
summary: No proof of food handler training was provided for employees, and neither certified manager had allergen training proof. A newly installed rear screen door has a half-inch gap at the bottom that needs a rodent-proof strip.

headline: Chicken on floor; door gap; leaking plumbing
summary: Boxes of chicken were on the floor in rear prep and must be elevated six inches. A half-inch gap under the north rear door must be sealed, and a hanging fly strip removed. Leaking faucets and drainpipe also need repair.

headline: Two food handlers lacked training certificates
summary: Two food handlers had no food handler training certificates at inspection, and management must provide valid ones. Stained, damaged ceilings and missing floor tiles in the front prep area also need smooth repairs.

headline: No covered waste bin in employee washroom
summary: The employee washroom had no covered waste receptacle. Management was instructed to provide one.

headline: Food handler lacked required training
summary: One food handler on duty had no food handler training. Management must complete training and keep records on site. A soap dispenser not attached to the wall must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Blue cheese dressing held at 45°F
summary: House-made blue cheese dressing was stored at 45°F, above the 41°F limit for cold foods. The manager was told to keep cold foods at 41°F or below. Rusted racks in walk-in coolers and calcium buildup inside the ice machine were also noted.

headline: Wiping cloths unstored; door not self-closing
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on food prep tables instead of in sanitizing solution. The employee restroom door was not self-closing, and a self-closing device must be installed.

headline: Hand sink water at 163.4°F; citation issued
summary: Handwashing sink water in the cookline area reached 163.4°F; hand sinks must not exceed 120°F. Citation issued. Also cited: milk crates used in the freezer, a leaking utility sink backflow device, dusty ceiling vents, and foil wall liner behind cooking equipment.

headline: Storage rack must be elevated
summary: A storage rack in the dish and storage area was not elevated. Management was instructed to elevate racks at least six inches off the floor to protect food from contamination.

headline: Missing restroom sign; plants above food
summary: The employee restroom had no handwashing sign; management was told to provide one. Live potted plants were placed above the food production area and must be removed.

headline: Sanitizer at 0 ppm, corrected on site
summary: Sanitizer in the three-compartment sink measured 0 ppm. The manager was told the proper levels, the sink was emptied and refilled, and it now reads 700 ppm. Damaged floor tiles and missing grout in dry storage need repair.

headline: Expired food handler training for three staff
summary: Three employees had expired food handler training, and two certified managers lacked allergen training; records must be kept on site. Also noted torn cooler gaskets, a non-working washroom sink, and dusty ceiling panels.

headline: Quarter-inch gap under rear exit door
summary: A quarter-inch gap at the bottom of the rear exit door could allow pests in. A tight-fitting seal is required at all outer openings.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing at final rinse
summary: The bar-area low-temperature dish machine was not sanitizing at final rinse, measuring 0 ppm chlorine, and had no sanitizer jug attached. Management must provide proper sanitizer concentration. Deli cups used as bulk scoops must be replaced.

headline: Improper thawing; unlabeled food containers
summary: Frozen egg rolls were thawing in a plastic container on the prep area. Management was told to thaw food under cold running water, in the refrigerator, or in the microwave. Rice and peanuts lacked labels, and floor corners need cleaning.

headline: Missing prep cooler thermometer; damaged gasket
summary: The prep cooler had no operable thermometer and a damaged door gasket. Stained ceiling tiles in the prep area and grease inside the vent hood also need repair and cleaning.

headline: No certified manager on site; cooler at 55.0°F
summary: No certified food manager was on site during food prep. A kitchen-line cooler read 55.0°F; it was tagged out of use and held no food. Soap and paper towels were missing at one sink but were provided during inspection.

headline: Over 1,000 mouse droppings; salsas too warm
summary: Over 1,000 mouse droppings were found on shelves, floors and behind equipment in several areas. Salsa verde at 54.2°F and salsa roja at 52.8°F were above the 41°F limit, and about 1 pound was discarded. Citation issued.

headline: Greasy fryers and dirty coolers; dim lighting
summary: Fryers and reach-in coolers and freezers had food, grease and dirt buildup. Water-stained ceiling tiles, dusty walls and floors around cooking equipment, and hood filters need attention. Dim lighting in prep and storage areas must be improved.

headline: About 90 rodent droppings found in store
summary: About 25 large and 65 small rodent droppings were found on floors, shelves and behind pallets in several storage areas. Management must remove them, sanitize, and eliminate pest activity; citation issued. Missing wall base and damaged ceiling tiles also noted.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; food debris on floors
summary: Torn gaskets were found inside a two-door reach-in cooler and must be repaired. Food debris on floors between cooking equipment must be cleaned.

headline: Food containers stored on cooler floor
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler. Management was instructed to elevate them at least six inches on raised shelving to prevent contamination.

headline: No hot water at sinks during inspection
summary: Hot water was unavailable at the three-compartment sink and hand sinks in the front and rear suite pantries. Portable handwashing sinks were provided, and dishes were moved to a low pantry for washing. No citation was issued.

headline: Rat droppings found; toxic fly traps over food
summary: About 10 rat droppings were found in the dry storage hallway, and toxic fly traps hung over prep tables. Management must eliminate pests, clean affected areas, and contact pest control. No vomit or diarrhea clean-up supplies were on site.

headline: Over 100 rat droppings; live insects breeding
summary: Over 100 rat droppings were found in the bar and basement, along with about 20 live small flying insects breeding in leak tubs. Additional pest control is needed; citation issued. Prior floor holes and pooling water remain uncorrected.

headline: Fried eggs at 85.5°F; overflowing dumpster
summary: Fried eggs in the front prep cooler measured 85.5°F, above the 41°F limit; about 4 pounds were discarded. The outside dumpster was overflowing, with garbage bags on the ground that can attract rodents and pests. Hair restraints were missing.

headline: Cooler at 49°F; no sanitizer; door gap
