summary: A prep cooler held only 49°F and must be repaired. The three-compartment sink had no sanitizer or test strips on site. Dead insects were found on food prep floors, and a 1-inch side-door gap must be sealed. Sewage backed up from a floor drain.

headline: No food thermometer; missing hair restraints
summary: No probe thermometer was available to check food temperatures, a priority item with a citation. Two food handlers worked in prep without hair restraints. Leaks were found under the handwashing sink and three-compartment sink, and squirt bottles were unlabeled.

headline: No pest control log book on premises
summary: No pest control log book was on the premises. A licensed pest control company must provide at least two pest inspections a year, with reports kept in the log book. A current log book and reports must be provided.

headline: Door gap could admit pests; several repairs
summary: A half-inch gap under the front entrance doors could allow pest entry, so the manager was told to seal it. Also noted a leaking three-compartment sink, debris in coolers, unused equipment to remove, and missing light and ventilation.

headline: Unlabeled containers; reused single-use tubs
summary: Dry storage containers and spices lacked common-name labels. Single-service butter containers were being reused for food storage and must stop. Also noted an ice scoop stored on the ice machine, greasy fryer wheels, and a misdirected beverage drain.

headline: No certified manager; thawing and cleaning issues
summary: No City-certified food manager was on premises while food was prepared and served; citation issued. Frozen duck was thawed in still water, and expired food handler certificates were found. Heavy grease was in the fryer hood, and floors and walls need cleaning.

headline: Missing handwash sign; greasy filters; leaking gaskets
summary: Missing handwashing sign at second-level bar used for private events. Debris in drain under kitchen sink. Torn gaskets on cold holding units. Unused equipment used as extra prep space, a possible pest harborage. Grease on hood filters.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink; dirty storage areas
summary: Cutting boards with dark open seams need repair. Interior shelving of coolers and freezer is dirty. Multiple leaks at the three-compartment sink faucet and sprayer. Floors, storage shelving and nearby walls need detail cleaning. Passed.

headline: No thermometers in coolers; floor debris
summary: No ambient air thermometers inside reach-in and display coolers. Loose debris, dirt and dust buildup on floors and corners throughout. Must detail clean and increase floor cleaning. Passed inspection.

headline: Unlabeled bulk items; greasy cook line; expired certificates
summary: Bulk kitchen items unlabeled. Stained cutting boards with deep cuts. Heavy grease along cook line walls and under fryers; exposed brick needs sealing; hood filters dirty. Expired allergen training certificates. Passed re-inspection.

headline: 20-inch ceiling hole; clutter; burnt-out bulbs
summary: Approximately 20-inch hole in back storage room ceiling must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Clutter in store and back storage; stock must be 6 inches off floor. Two light fixtures have burnt-out bulbs. Restroom lacks covered sanitary napkin receptacle.

headline: 80 rodent droppings; no certified manager on site
summary: About 80 large and small rodent droppings under three-compartment sink and along walls in prep and storage areas. Citation issued; remove, clean, and call pest control. Also no certified manager while TCS foods served; hair restraint lapses; past summary not posted.

headline: Food held over 24 hours not date-marked
summary: Ready-to-eat TCS foods (black beans, chicken, rice, tuna) held over 24 hours without date marks. Citation issued. Torn cooler gasket. Unused coffee equipment, milk crates and broken light shields in prep area could harbor pests.

headline: Debris on prep area floor
summary: Prep area floors need cleaning to remove debris. Passed inspection.

headline: Mouse droppings and live ants found
summary: About 15 mouse droppings on floors and shelves in several areas, plus 3 live ants on dry goods shelves and dining floor. Citation issued; remove droppings, eliminate ants, sanitize. Also food in grocery bags and an employee without a hair restraint.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: Food service sanitation manager does not have a food allergen training certificate. Instructed to meet the requirement. Passed license inspection.

headline: Black flies found; wastewater dripping into sink
summary: About 15 small black flies near rear prep, dish, dry storage and dining areas. Citation issued; consult pest control. Overhead pipe drips wastewater into three-compartment sink, which is tagged and must not be used. Rusty faucets and soap dispenser.

headline: Missing handwash signs; dishwasher tagged
summary: Both first- and second-floor restaurants lack handwashing signs. High-temperature dishwasher in second-floor bar was not set up for inspection; tagged and must not be used until inspected by CDPH (Chicago Department of Public Health).

headline: Unlabeled food; missing ice bin covers; greasy hood
summary: Food in refrigerators not labeled, including bulk containers. Missing ice bin covers at front bar. Serving plates stored upright, collecting dust. Sticky spills and debris in prep cooler. Dirt and grease on hood, filters and pipes. Passed.

headline: Worn door sweep; cutting boards and leaks
summary: Worn door sweep on rear exit leaves a 1/4-inch gap, so the door is not rodent or insect proof. Scoop lying in tortilla chips. Dark grooves in cutting boards, leak at three-compartment sink faucet, peeling ceiling above freezer. Passed.

headline: Employees eating in prep area; dish machine overflow
summary: Employees drinking and eating at prep area; some preparing food without hair restraints. Plates not inverted. Foil lining shelves that can hide pests. Dish machine with clogged drain overflowed dirty water onto floor; citation issued. Passed with conditions.

headline: No hot or cold running water in bar area
summary: Liquor consumption area has no hot and cold running water under city pressure. Hand, dish and dump sinks must be installed with hot and cold water. Failed license inspection.

headline: Photocopied manager certificate; short handwash time
summary: Only a photocopy of the food manager certificate was posted while TCS foods (foods that must be kept hot or cold) were prepared. Customer restroom handwash sink ran under 15 seconds. Door gaps of 1/4 inch allow rodent entry. Citation issued.

headline: Missing handwash signs upstairs
summary: Handwashing signs must be provided at upstairs handwash sinks in prep and dishwashing areas. Passed inspection.

headline: Greasy hood, fryers, and cooking equipment
summary: Wiping cloths stored on top of prep coolers. Grease buildup on hood, filters, fryers and sides of cooking equipment. Dirt and debris on rear storage shelving. Grease encrusted on floor under cooking equipment. Passed inspection.

headline: Food residue in cold units; holes in wall
summary: Food residue on interior and exterior of all cold-holding units. Holes in wall between front and rear prep areas must be repaired to prevent pest harborage. No food handler certificates on site. Passed re-inspection.

headline: Leaking faucet knobs; coffee machine lacks backflow device
summary: Leaking faucet knobs at the exposed handsink in rear dishwashing area; instructed to repair. Coffee machine on front serving counter has no visible backflow device; instructed to install one. Passed license inspection.

headline: Cold food above safe temperature; food discarded
summary: Chicken (46.1 and 49°F), turkey (49.2°F), ham (45.5°F) and cheese (46.9°F) held above 41°F in cooler. Manager discarded 10 pounds worth $100 on the spot. Citation issued. Floor drains need cleaning.

headline: No certified food manager during food service
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager on site while potatoes, sandwiches and chicken were prepared and served. Citation issued. Front door was open during inspection. Food handler certificates could not be verified.

headline: No hair restraint; utensils and rust found
summary: Cook without hair restraint in prep area. Scraper and knife stored between prep table and wall. Chipped paint and rust on cooler shelves. Dirty floors in rear storage closet. Manager told to fix these items. Passed inspection.

headline: Mold-like substance inside basement ice machine
summary: Black and pink mold-like substance on upper interior parts of large basement ice machine. Ice must be destroyed and the machine cleaned and sanitized to prevent contamination. Passed re-inspection.

headline: Improperly stored knives; many prior violations
summary: Knives stored between rear sinks. Food spilled inside deli display cooler. Previously uncorrected: food-encrusted baking sheets outdoors, cleaning chemicals on soda crates, missing wall panel, employee belongings in food storage, no food handler proof, expired manager allergen certificate.

headline: No handwash sign at handsink
summary: No handwashing sign at the handwash sink. Instructed to add one. Passed inspection.

headline: Missing thermometers, unlabeled containers, dirty equipment
summary: Thermometers missing from reach-in and prep coolers. Bulk containers unlabeled. Food handler lacked hair restraint. Single-service items not inverted and stored on floor. Greasy fryers, missing sink stoppers, damaged cooler gaskets. Passed re-inspection.

headline: Missing faucet knob; restroom fan not working
summary: Hot water faucet knob missing at the three-compartment sink. Floors under equipment need cleaning. Unneeded items in storage closet. Washroom ventilation fan not working and must be repaired. Fryer bottoms need cleaning. Passed inspection.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; no hair restraints
summary: Bulk flour and sugar containers are unlabeled. Food handlers prepped food without hair restraints. Reach-in cooler interiors need detail cleaning. Food debris and spills on floors throughout. Passed inspection.

headline: Slow drain; expired manager allergen certificate
summary: Handsink in rear dish and prep area drains slowly; person in charge told to repair. Certified manager's allergen training certificate on site has expired; must renew and keep a copy on site. Passed inspection.

headline: Personal items in prep area; dirty storage floor
summary: Employee personal care items stored in prep area; must be kept in a designated area. Debris and dirt on floor in rear storage area. Passed inspection.

headline: Gap at rear exit door; dirty floors
summary: Small gap at bottom of rear exit door, which could let insects in; pest control technician noted it too. Floor under kitchen corner shelving and deep fryers has dirt, grease and debris; must be cleaned. Passed inspection.

headline: Mouse droppings in dry storage; citation issued
summary: About 40 mouse droppings found in dry storage rooms, in corners and under shelving. Owner told to remove them, clean, and call pest control. Citation issued. Large dry storage room also has no lighting.

headline: Loose faucet handle in men's restroom
summary: Loose faucet handle at men's restroom washbowl sink. Instructed to repair and maintain. Passed inspection.

headline: Slimy ice machines; food held too warm, discarded
summary: Ice machines had black slimy buildup. Cold TCS foods held at 49-54°F; manager discarded about $220 of food. One cooler at 54°F tagged. Vacuum packaging machine tagged; no approved food safety (HACCP) plan. Citation issued.

headline: Food containers not stored inverted
summary: Food containers not stored properly; must be stored inverted. Passed inspection.

headline: No working refrigeration; no pest control log
summary: No working cold-holding refrigeration on the premises; no citation issued. No pest control log book on the premises. Handwash sink lacks signage. No drainboard at three-compartment sink for dried dishes. Failed license inspection.

headline: Cardboard shelf liners by stove; cracked wall
summary: Cardboard boxes used to line shelves by the cooking stove, which can hide pests; must be removed. Cracked wall edging at rear entrance patched with duct tape; instructed to repair. Passed inspection.

headline: Mold-like buildup in bar nozzles; missing splash guards
summary: Buildup inside nozzle holders at first-floor bar; instructed to clean and sanitize. Opening in front entrance doors must be sealed. Missing splash guards on bar handwash sinks. Cups stored on hallway floor. Damaged beer cooler floor. Dusty vents. Passed.

headline: Missing handwash sign; leaks; scoop on ice machine
summary: Hand sink in hibachi prep area has no handwashing sign. Ice scoop stored on top of ice machine. Leak under rear three-compartment sink. Spider webs on wok hood filters and a blown-out light in walk-in freezer. Passed.

headline: Missing health policy; clogged sink fixed on site
summary: No signed form showing food employees know to report illnesses. Three-compartment sink was completely clogged; employee repaired it during inspection (corrected on site). Citation issued. Ice machine has calcium buildup; floors need cleaning.

headline: Food in grocery bags; sink and plumbing leaks
summary: Food kept in grocery bags inside coolers, ice scoop on shelves, knives stored on wall. Water leaking from three-compartment sink pipe and bar handwash sink. Unfinished floors under sinks. Employee toilet has no working ventilation.

headline: Blocked handsink; hair restraints; dirty equipment
summary: Fruit room handsink blocked by boxes; once cleared, it was in poor repair and its P-trap was missing. Ice machine interior needs cleaning. Hair restraints required in service areas. Worn cutting boards, damaged deli window, greasy equipment. Failed.

headline: Boxed food on floor; greasy fryers; dim lights
summary: Boxed food and single-service items stored on floor in dry storage closet; must be 6 inches off floor. Fryer doors have torn plastic covers. Flour buildup on prep table. Two exhaust lights out. One employee lacks food handler training. Passed.

headline: About 60 rat droppings; no pest control log
summary: About 60 rat droppings on basement floor near ice machine, under liquor shelves, and in a stage closet. Citation issued; manager told to remove them all. No pest control log book. Wet wiping cloths on prep tables. Missing food handler and manager allergen certificates.

headline: Hair restraints, grease, and soiled linens
summary: Hair restraints must be worn in prep area. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer; soiled towels on floor. Heavy grease on cooking equipment and floors. Restroom needs detail cleaning; hood vent needs maintenance. Some handlers lack required certificates.

headline: No certified manager; sink stoppers missing
summary: No city-certified manager on site while chicken, sausage and pizza were handled. Three-compartment sink missing proper stoppers. Urinal in disrepair and wrapped in plastic in men's restroom. Citation issued. Pass with conditions.

headline: Single-service cartons reused for grease
summary: Employees reused single-service cartons to absorb grease from fried food; instructed to stop. Encrusted grease on griddle and wok line. Slow-draining prep handwash sink and low water pressure at employee sink. Ceiling tiles above dish machine soiled.

headline: Food handler lacked hair restraint
summary: Food handler preparing salads without a hair restraint. Must wear an effective hair restraint when preparing food. Passed inspection.

headline: Mineral buildup in self-serve ice machine
summary: Beginning of mineral buildup on the interior nozzle of the self-serve ice machine in the dining area. Instructed to clean, sanitize, and maintain the unit. Passed inspection.

headline: About 30 flies; no manager; food too warm
summary: About 30 small flies throughout the facility; citation issued; eliminate flies. Door openings must be sealed. No certified manager on site until 10:09 AM (corrected on site). Cold food at 50.1-55.6°F discarded, valued at $100. Mold on ice machines. Failed.

headline: Debris in handwash sink; food on floor; no summary posted
summary: Spoon and food debris, including chickpeas, inside a handwash sink, which may be used only for handwashing. Food bins stored directly on floor; cardboard used as dry storage shelving. No manager with allergen training. Citation issued.

headline: Leaks at bar handwash sink and water tank
summary: Leak from a pinhole in front of the second-floor bar handwash sink faucet. Leak on basement floor near the hot water tank. Repair instructed. Passed re-inspection.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup procedure
summary: No written employee health policy or procedure for cleaning up vomit and diarrhea. Food on display in prep area not protected from customers. Certified managers must obtain allergen training. No citation issued. Failed license inspection.

headline: No person in charge or certified manager present
summary: No person in charge or city-certified manager on site while TCS foods were prepared and served. Restroom handwash sink water measured 52.3°F; must reach 100°F. Handwash signs missing. Food and foil containers stored on floor. Citation issued.

headline: Worn wood shelving; slow drain; greasy walls
summary: Wooden shelves by three-compartment sink and near dining door in poor repair. Slow-draining rear handsink. Grease on walls next to cooking equipment. Non-working washroom vent. Some food handlers lack training proof; some managers lack allergen certificates. Passed with conditions.

headline: No certified manager; no thermometer; no training proof
summary: Food prepared and served without a certified food manager on site. No metal-stem thermometer or chlorine test kit. No food handler training proof. Milk crates used as shelving. Broken basement sink faucet and burnt-out lights. Citation issued.

headline: No health policy, vomit kit, or cooler thermometer
summary: No employee health policy on premises. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit. No thermometer in reach-in cooler. Restroom doors lack self-closing devices; restroom trash cans lack lids. No citation issued. Pass with conditions.

headline: 15 live cockroaches in dish machine control box
summary: About 15 live cockroaches on and inside the electrical control box of the basement dish machine. Additional pest control service needed. Citation issued. Also greasy fryers and dish machine, and holes in dishwashing area walls to seal.

headline: No certified manager; handsinks blocked
summary: No city-certified manager on site while eggs and protein shakes were handled; certificate not posted. Prep and warewashing handsinks blocked by equipment and lacked soap. Missing refrigeration thermometer. Citations issued. Pass with conditions.

headline: Ice buildup in freezer; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Heavy ice buildup on nonfood-contact surfaces of the walk-in freezer and two-door reach-in cooler. Person in charge lacks allergen awareness training; must provide it and keep certificates on site. Passed inspection.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; drains and walls need work
summary: Torn gaskets on walk-in cooler and reach-in units. Drains need detail cleaning to prevent insect activity. Grease and food debris inside and under deep fryers. Peeling paint and mold-like buildup on dish area wall. Hood filters greasy. Passed.

headline: Grease under cooking equipment; allergen gap
summary: Grease on floor beneath cooking equipment must be cleaned. Certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate; management told all managers must show proof. Passed re-inspection.

headline: Food stored under unshielded sewer lines
summary: Food service items stored beneath unshielded wastewater and sewer lines in basement dry storage. Loose faucet handle at small front-dining sink. Grease and food debris under fryers. Personal items stored on equipment and bowls on rear racks. Missing allergen proof.

headline: Food on floors; dirty prep areas; prior violations
summary: Food stored on floors; single-use utensils not inverted; dust and debris in prep and storage areas; damaged light shield. Earlier violations uncorrected: no splash guard, worn cooler gasket, rust, no manager allergen training. Citation issued.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Some food handler training certificates were expired. Allergen training certificates were missing or expired for certified food managers. Must provide current certificates for all staff and managers. Passed re-inspection.

headline: No handwash signs; leaks; broken ventilation
summary: No handwashing signs near handwash sinks in prep areas and both washrooms. Leaking faucet base at rear three-compartment sink. Previously uncorrected: inoperable ventilation in south washroom. Citation issued. Failed inspection.

headline: Menu lacks undercooked food advisory; many issues
summary: Menu lacked a consumer advisory for raw or undercooked steak and egg dishes. Cardboard and plastic wrap used as liners; food debris in freezer. Water-damaged ceiling tiles and moldy caulking. Previous violations uncorrected. Citation issued.

headline: Dispenser placement; dirty ice machine; no training proof
summary: Paper towel dispenser must move closer to handwash sink, not above the clean dish rack. Ice machine interior dirty. Splash guard needed beside handwash sink. No proof of food handler training. Passed re-inspection.

headline: Food debris under dish machine and fryers
summary: Food debris on floors under the low-temperature dish machine and deep fryers in rear prep area. Multiple certified food managers lack allergen awareness certificates. Passed inspection.

headline: No hair restraints; damaged floor tiles; dirty mops
summary: Food handlers in prep area without hair restraints. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer. Grooved cutting boards. Damaged floor tiles and wall panel. Mops stored in buckets of dirty water. Passed inspection.

headline: No employee health policy; handsink unusable
summary: No written employee health policy on premises. Basement dishwashing handwash sink not accessible and had no hot water. Two low-temperature dishwashers malfunctioning and tagged. Leaking drain under three-compartment sink. Kitchen hood filters missing. Failed.

headline: Standing water on floors; food handlers lack certificates
summary: Wiping cloths stored on prep table. Ice buildup, food and dirt under cooler and freezer. Standing water, dirt and debris on basement and first floor; source must be found and fixed. Food handlers have no food handler certificates.

headline: Unlabeled flour; no barrier at mop sink
summary: Bulk flour container not labeled. No barrier between mop sink and clean utensil rack, risking contamination from mop water. Employees' personal items stored in prep kitchen. Passed inspection.

headline: No hair restraint; dim basement storage lighting
summary: Employee without hair restraint in kitchen food prep area while food was prepared and served. Inadequate lighting in basement food storage room; must be improved and maintained. Passed re-inspection.

headline: No certified manager; boxed food on floor
summary: No certified food manager on premises while chicken, beef and eggs prepared and served (citation issued). Handsink lacked paper towels; food handler restocked them during inspection. Missing metal-stem thermometer. Boxed food on floor. Previous violations uncorrected: no lids on restroom trash.

headline: Foil liners under prep tables; missing backflow device
summary: Foil used as liner under prep tables, which must be smooth and easy to clean. Utility sink in rear has no backflow prevention device. Person in charge told to fix both. Passed inspection.

headline: Food on floors; no allergen training; door gaps
summary: Food containers stored on floors in walk-in freezer and prep areas. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training certificate. Earlier uncorrected violation: gaps at front double doors allow pest entry. Missing handwash sign at prep sink. Citation issued.

headline: Storage and cleaning issues; expired allergen certificate
summary: Wiping cloths not kept in sanitizer; scoops not stored handle-up; utensils not inverted; new cutting board needed; spills in spice cooler. Floors under mop sink and storage rack dirty. One manager's allergen certificate expired. Passed.

headline: Greasy fryer bottoms and kitchen floor
summary: Bottom of fryers needs cleaning to remove grease. Grease on floor under fryers along kitchen back wall must be cleaned. Passed inspection.

headline: Gap at exit door; leaking faucet; damaged floor tiles
summary: 1/4-inch gap at bottom corner of west exit door, which allows pest entry. Leaking faucet on three-compartment sink. Missing grout on prep area floor tiles. Missing and damaged baseboards along prep area walls. Passed re-inspection.

headline: Mouse droppings in cooler and garage door area
summary: About 15 mouse droppings found under cooler shelving and along the garage door wall. Owner told to remove them and recommended pest control. Citation issued. Also dirty toilets, uncovered trash cans, and food debris under shelving.

headline: Unfinished wood shelving in storage
summary: Unfinished wood shelving in rear food and dry storage must be replaced with non-porous, easily cleaned wood. Passed license inspection.

headline: Mouse droppings and live flies; no manager on duty
summary: About 20 mouse droppings on walk-in cooler floor and 15-20 live flies in dish area and hallway. Citation issued; remove droppings and call pest control. No certified manager on duty while chicken and fish handled. Missing ceiling tiles. Failed.

headline: Prep cooler too warm; unit tagged out
summary: Prep cooler measured 54°F; it must stay at 41°F or below. Unit tagged and may not be used. Serving window screen has a hole. Cardboard used as shelf liner; fryer grease; peeling paint in cooler. Passed with conditions.

headline: Scoop handles in food; flour spills; leaking drain
summary: Scoop handles touching rice and flour in dry storage bins. Large cutting board broken in half. Bar handwash sink drain leaking. Floor cluttered in bar. Rice and flour spilled in storage closet. Grease buildup on hood. Missing allergen certificates.

headline: Black slime in ice maker dripping into ice
summary: Black slimy substance on interior water parts of ice maker, dripping into ice used for drinks. Machine must be turned off, ice removed, and interior cleaned. Also missing backflow device on coffee dispenser. Citation issued.

headline: Gap at side door; litter on floor
summary: Damage at bottom of exterior side door creates a 1/4-inch gap. Litter and debris on floor near hot water tank and three-compartment sink. Person in charge told to repair and clean. Passed license inspection.

headline: No handwash signs; gaps; trash and water on floors
summary: No handwashing signs at sinks. Rear storage door not rodent-proof, with a 1/4-inch gap. Seasoned chicken stored in grocery bag in cooler. Mold-like spores and rust inside two-door unit. Floors with trash and pooling water. Passed re-inspection.

headline: Missing handwash signs; unlabeled bulk; dirty cooler
summary: Missing handwashing signage at prep sinks. Bulk flour and sugar unlabeled. Ice cream scoopers stored in standing water. Interior of storage cooler and main kitchen floors not clean. Passed.

headline: Cracked cooler floor tiles; prior violation uncorrected
summary: Spilled build-up inside the cabinet holding the lobby soda machine. Cracked floor tiles in walk-in cooler. Violation from 2/23/24 still not corrected. Citation issued. Failed inspection.

headline: Rat droppings in basement and kitchen closet
summary: About 100 rat droppings in basement areas used by the restaurant and 20 in the kitchen closet. Owner told to clean all areas and have pest control service before next week. Citation issued. Also expired food handler and allergen certificates.

headline: New restroom lacks handwash signage
summary: New toilet room has no handwashing signage. Shelving and floor under the front service area need detail cleaning to prevent possible pest or insect activity. Passed inspection.

headline: Cockroaches on glueboards; repeat violations
summary: Dead and live cockroaches on multiple glueboards in prep area and basement. Repeat finding: 15 live cockroaches on walls, floor, equipment and cutting boards. Open food containers uncovered. Citation issued. Also no food handler training proof.

headline: Greasy fryers and cooking equipment need cleaning
summary: Fryers and other cooking equipment have grease and dust needing detail cleaning. Floors under cooking equipment need degreasing. Walls and kitchen and restroom ceiling vents need cleaning. Passed inspection.

headline: No cooler thermometers; grout and clutter issues
summary: Cold-holding units lack ambient air thermometers. Dishwashing area floor tiles missing grout. Clutter in rear area where cooking oil tanks are stored. Passed re-inspection.

headline: Hair restraints and signage corrected on site
summary: Missing handwashing signs were posted and hair restraint lapses corrected on site. Fryer bottoms need cleaning. Utility sink lacks a backflow device. Food handlers must obtain required training. Passed inspection.

headline: Rat droppings on prep area floor
summary: About 20 rat droppings on prep area floor under and around equipment and in corners. Manager must remove all by re-inspection; pest control service advised. Priority violation. Earlier violations uncorrected, including unlabeled containers and dust buildup.

headline: Grab-and-go sandwiches lack full labels
summary: Packaged grab-and-go sandwiches and salads not labeled with all ingredients and weight. Instructed to label properly. Passed inspection.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; hot water too cool
summary: Person in charge lacked the original city certificate while time- and temperature-controlled (TCS) foods were prepared; citation issued. Hand sinks measured 84.6°F and 90.2°F; hand-washing water must be at least 100°F.

headline: Failed: no manager on duty; roach evidence
summary: No certified food manager on duty while TCS foods were prepared and served; manager arrived 11:40 a.m. Cooked beef at 54.3°F and sour cream at 50°F were discarded. Live and dead roaches found; pest service recommended.

headline: Passed re-inspection; allergen certificates missing
summary: No allergen training certificates were on site. Employees holding city food service manager certificates must complete allergen training and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Passed; unlabeled seasonings and stained cutting boards
summary: Pre-packaged seasonings lack ingredient, net weight, and manufacturer labels. Heavily stained deli cutting boards must be resurfaced or replaced. An unused oven must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Failed: 40+ live flies near walk-in cooler
summary: About 40 or more live small flies on walk-in cooler and freezer exterior walls, plus 4–6 large flies around the premises. Pest service recommended. No signed employee health policies; worn gaskets and burnt-out hood light also noted.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings and no pest service
summary: About 17 large rodent droppings on a windowsill and under a display cooler. No pest control agreement or logbook was on site. Also missing health policies, handwashing signs, and thermometers; leaks and dirty equipment noted.

headline: Soiled gloves reused across tasks; citation issued
summary: Soiled single-use gloves were reused for multiple tasks and stored in French fry and raw chicken containers used by several workers. A cook put clean gloves over dirty ones without washing hands. A certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed re-inspection; food on floor, missing training
summary: An employee drank from an open container near the cook line; a designated eating area must be provided. Food stored on floors and open dry goods need protection. Food handlers lacked training certificates; some plumbing needs repair.

headline: Passed with conditions; dish machine too hot
summary: Dish machine final rinse measured 204°F (normal range 180–194°F); must not be used until final rinse reaches at least 180°F. Citation issued. Leaking hand sink faucet and low water pressure must be repaired.

headline: Passed; no covered waste receptacle in restroom
summary: The washroom lacks a covered waste receptacle; management was instructed to provide one.

headline: Passed; thick ice in freezer, dirty floors
summary: Thick ice buildup inside the front reach-in freezer must be removed and cleaned. Floors under heavy equipment have dirt and debris and must be cleaned.

headline: Passed re-inspection; signage and ice cover needed
summary: Handwashing signs must be posted at upstairs restroom sinks. Ice in the bar's ice bin was uncovered and must be covered to protect it from contamination.

headline: Passed; utensils stored in mechanical rooms
summary: Pots, pans, and dishes stored in mechanical rooms must be moved. Wooden boxes used as shelves and aluminum foil liners must be removed. Caulking and peeling ceiling tile paint need repair.

headline: Passed; food handler lacks training certificate
summary: A food handler had no food handler training certificate. Proof must be provided.

headline: Passed; hair restraints and wiping cloths needed
summary: Food handlers prepped without hair restraints. Wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces must be stored in sanitizer. Frozen chicken in plastic grocery bags must move to food-grade bags. Storage containers lack labels; floors need cleaning.

headline: Passed; torn gasket, dirty floors, slow sink drain
summary: Torn door gasket on the front 4-door prep cooler. Slow-draining hand sink in front prep. Restroom door is not self-closing. Dusty ceiling vents, water-damaged tiles, greasy floors, and dirty floor drains need attention.

headline: Failed: no hot water at sinks; undated food
summary: Hot water tank not working; sinks measured 43.7–44.6°F; citation issued. Shredded mozzarella and chopped chicken without date labels were discarded. Cardboard boxes used as containers and a food handler lacking training proof also noted.

headline: Passed; employee without hair restraint
summary: An employee in the food prep area wasn't wearing a hair restraint. The manager was instructed to provide restraints for all food prep employees.

headline: Failed: chicken too warm; sink floods
summary: Chicken held at 120°F; hot food must be held at 135°F or above. About 5 lbs ($15) discarded. The three-compartment sink floods when one basin drains; citation issued. Repeat violations include a certified manager without allergen training.

headline: Passed; wet wiping cloths left on prep tables
summary: Several wet wiping cloths were stored on prep tables and cutting boards. Management was instructed to store them in sanitizer when not in use.

headline: Passed re-inspection; grease and debris buildup
summary: Wiping cloths must be kept in sanitizer between uses; cardboard shelf liners must be removed. Meat slicer, fryer oil filter, and equipment had grease and debris. Floors, walls, and corners need detail cleaning, and liquid pooling must be cleaned.

headline: Pass with conditions; expired food, unsafe surfaces
summary: TCS food past its disposition (use-by) date was found in the walk-in cooler; citation issued. Plates weren't inverted; stained cutting boards; food debris on floors and equipment; certified managers lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Passed; missing light shields over sink
summary: Light fixtures above the three-compartment sink lack shields. The operator was instructed to provide them.

headline: Passed re-inspection; uncovered food, sink leak
summary: Hot food on the front prep line must be kept covered. The cabinet under the beverage dispenser must be cleaned. A leak under the three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Passed; greasy equipment, floors, and vent leak
summary: Soda nozzles need detail cleaning. Walk-in freezer kick plate is loose, letting water and food debris collect. Cooking equipment is greasy; floors and drains need detail cleaning. Air conditioner condensation leaks from a side vent.

headline: Passed; soil and debris near dish area
summary: Soil and debris buildup near the rear dish washing area. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Cold food too warm; about 126 lbs discarded
summary: Walk-in cooler measured 48.9°F; lentils, chicken curry, yogurt, and raw chicken were held at 48.9–57.7°F. About 126 lbs ($400) discarded; cooler tagged until it reaches 41°F. Also missing hair restraints and handwashing signs.

headline: Cooler door gaskets torn; allergen certificates expired
summary: Some prep-area cooler door gaskets are torn and don't seal tightly; the manager must repair or replace them. Food allergen training certificates have expired and must be updated.

headline: Passed; brick wall in prep area
summary: The wall behind the prep area is brick. Prep area walls must be smooth and easily cleanable.

headline: Passed; gap at rear door and cleaning needed
summary: A 1/4-inch gap under the rear exit door must be sealed to keep rodents out. The three-compartment sink stopper, a men's restroom floor drain cover, and peeling ceiling paint above the prep area also need fixing.

headline: Failed: undated prepared food; repeat violations
summary: Cooked soups, beef, and chicken wings from the day before lacked date labels; citation issued. Handwashing signs missing. Cheese was scooped with a disposable cup. Rusty shelving and damaged gaskets were prior violations left uncorrected.

headline: Passed; missing signs, labels, and bag reuse
summary: A handwashing sign is needed at the front prep sink. Sugar, flour, and cornmeal containers must be labeled. Single-use grocery bags were reused in freezers and must be replaced with food-grade containers. Cardboard liners also noted.

headline: Grease buildup and expired allergen certificate
summary: Basement ingredient containers are unlabeled. Some employees lacked hair restraints. Wiping cloths and an ice scoop were not stored properly. Fryers, coolers, and hood filters are heavily greasy. Food allergen certificate has expired.

headline: Re-inspection passed; allergen certificates missing
summary: No allergen training certificates were on site. Employees holding city food service manager certificates must complete allergen training and keep records on site.

headline: Failed: dairy and deli foods held too warm
summary: Half-and-half, milk, and turkey ham were held at 53–55°F in a reach-in cooler; about 15 lbs were discarded. The cooler, at 54°F, was tagged and held for health department inspection until repaired.

headline: Passed re-inspection; grease, dirt, and burnt light
summary: Sugar and other food items were out of original containers without labels. Deep fryer oil filter had grease and debris; floors and walls had heavy buildup; one light bulb was burnt out.

headline: Passed re-inspection; missing thermometer and dust
summary: No ambient air thermometer was in the cold-holding units. Greasy fryer crevices, dried spills in a cold unit, and dusty vents in the dish and restroom areas must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; torn gasket on line cooler
summary: A torn gasket on the two-door cooler on the line must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Passed; no specific issues described
summary: Inspection notes list only the ventilation and lighting category; no specific problems are described.

headline: Passed; grease on hood filters
summary: Grease buildup on the hood system filters must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; no person in charge
summary: No person in charge was present at inspection. No certified manager with the original city certificate was on site while TCS foods (chicken, pasta, pizza) were prepared and served; citation issued. Prior sanitizer test strip violation was not corrected.

headline: Failed: live roach, flies, missing sign
summary: A live roach was seen in the bar area, and over 15 small flying insects near license frames; pest control and a citation were required. Also missing handwashing sign, soiled ice machines, damaged ceiling tile, and garbage under soda machines.

headline: Failed: no employee health policy; repeat violations
summary: No employee health policy on site; citation issued. Repeat violations not fixed from prior visit: grooved cutting board, untrained food handler. Also missing handwashing signs, heavy ice in freezers, burnt-out hood lights, dusty vents.

headline: Passed with conditions; repeat training violations
summary: Rear prep cooler lacked a thermometer; bulk rice and beans unlabeled. Repeat violations: two food handlers untrained, managers lacked allergen proof; citation issued. Inspection summary wasn't posted; a new one was left.

headline: Failed: unsafe food temperatures, dirty equipment
summary: Rice (125°F), lamb (108.3°F), and curry (59.1°F) were held at unsafe temperatures; yogurt and raw chicken were too warm in cold storage. All discarded. Undated prepared foods and dirty equipment also noted.

headline: Pass with conditions; no certified manager on duty
summary: No valid certified manager on duty while hamburgers were handled, prepared, and served; citation issued. Ice machine interior and lip need cleaning. Basement ceiling has water damage and holes that must be repaired.

headline: Failed: no vomit cleanup kit or pest service
summary: No cleanup kit for vomit and diarrhea, and no sanitizer proven to kill norovirus; kit must be provided. No current pest control service; a licensed company is required. No citation issued.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; dish machine unsanitary
summary: No certified food manager present while eggs, chicken, beef, and potatoes were prepared and served; citation issued. Bar dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged out of use. Menu lacked raw-food warnings.

headline: Failed: rat droppings in basement
summary: About 35 rat droppings on the basement floor. Additional pest control is needed; a citation was issued. A large gap at the north side door must be sealed. Rusty shelves and wiping cloths left on prep tables also noted.

headline: Failed: black slime in ice machine
summary: Black slime inside the ice machine dripped into ice used for people to eat or drink; the machine must be cleaned and sanitized. A splash guard, sink stoppers, and a grease trap were also required.

headline: Passed; license number and cleaning issues
summary: License number must appear on both sides of the truck. Floors and hood filters need detail cleaning to remove grease and buildup.

headline: Failed: black slime in ice machine; ice discarded
summary: Black dirt and slime built up inside the ice machine, dripping into ice used for drinks; all ice was discarded and the machine must be cleaned. A 1/4-inch gap at the front door sweep must be sealed.

headline: Failed: slimy ice machine; unsafe beef thawing
summary: Ice machine heavily soiled with black and grey slime dripping onto ice; citation issued. Beef thawed in a sink at room temperature. Also missing handwashing sign, no thermometer in cooler, and leaking hand sink.

headline: Failed: repeat violations, unlabeled bulk food
summary: Bulk food containers need product-name labels. Repeat violations: torn cooler gasket, backflow device not at utility sink, missing light shield. Also missing floor drain cover, moldy walls, and food handler training proof.

headline: Failed: gaps, food on floor, damaged cooler doors
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at a second-floor window must be sealed to prevent pests. Food stored on the walk-in freezer floor must be raised six inches. Damaged cooler doors and gaskets, grease buildup, and a loose sink faucet also need repair.

headline: Passed with conditions; no employee health policy
summary: No verifiable original city sanitation certificate posted; citation issued. No employee health policy on site; citation issued. Grime in front prep cabinets, rear storage floor, and floor drains must be cleaned.

headline: Hot dogs too cool; soap missing; citation issued
summary: Hot dogs measured 123–131°F in a hot-holding unit, below safe levels, and were discarded. A hand sink lacked soap, and ice scoops sat on the counter. Three-compartment sink basins were soiled and a steamer leaks water.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure; door gap
summary: No written procedure for vomit and diarrhea cleanup; one must be provided. The front entrance door has a 1/4-inch gap and must be rodent-proofed. Stained chip boxes and clutter in the rear and basement must be removed.

headline: Back door left open; missing food handler certificates
summary: Rear exit door stayed cracked open with no screen to keep out rodents. Food handler and allergen certificates were not on site. Also unlabeled squirt bottles, two missing sink stoppers, bowls used to transfer food, and a burnt-out light.

headline: Passed; torn meat cooler gasket, leaky faucet
summary: Torn door gasket on the two-door meat cooler in front of the food prep area must be repaired or replaced. The two-compartment sink in the rear prep area has a leaking faucet base.

headline: Passed; ice buildup on condenser; floors need cleaning
summary: Ice buildup on the walk-in cooler condenser must be defrosted and maintained. Floors under walk-in cooler racks and display shelving need cleaning.

headline: Passed; no covered waste bins in restrooms
summary: Upstairs single-person restrooms lacked covered waste receptacles; the manager was instructed to provide them.

headline: Failed: no health policy; sinks lack soap and signs
summary: No employee health policy; no food handler training; no allergen training for certified manager. Handwashing signs missing at several sinks, no soap at rear sink, and no thermometer for the high-temperature dish machine.

headline: Passed; missing hand signs and backflow devices
summary: Hand sinks lack handwashing signs; they must be provided. Espresso, drip coffee, and ice machines lack backflow prevention devices; these must be installed where they can be serviced.

headline: Coolers running too warm; damaged gaskets, tiles
summary: Two prep-area coolers measured 46.9°F and 46.2°F; they must be repaired and kept at 41°F or below. Torn reach-in door gaskets and cracked, bubbling floor tiles in the dish room must also be fixed.

headline: Failed: live roach, no hot water, dead roaches
summary: Live roach crawling in prep and serving areas; exterminator needed and citation issued. Dead roaches on glue boards. No hot water at west washroom sink. Damaged cooler gaskets, missing food handler training, and missing manager allergen training also noted.

headline: Failed: roaches; no soap or towels at sink
summary: About 6 live roaches scattered in the main dish area; rodent droppings must be eliminated. Cookline hand sink lacked soap and paper towels, supplied by manager. Dish-area hand sink leaks. Waffle batter at 51.2°F discarded.

headline: Failed: deli food held too warm; flies present
summary: Deli display held foods at 45–48°F; about 144 lbs ($1,161) discarded, citation issued. About 20 or more live large flies near the trash compactor. No vomit cleanup procedure; restroom lacked handwashing signs.

headline: Failed: flies, rust, worn gaskets, leaks
summary: About 40 or more live small flies on walls and ceilings in bar and dining areas; pest service recommended; citation issued. Also rusty walk-in shelves, worn gaskets, grease buildup, leaks, and damaged floors and walls.

headline: Passed re-inspection; sink leak and repairs
summary: A leak under the three-compartment sink drains into a bucket and must be repaired. The third basin's drain was patched with putty, which must be removed and replaced with a metal weld repair.

headline: Passed; handwashing sign, dust, toilet bin needed
summary: A handwashing sign is needed at the bakery dish sink. Dust on walk-in freezer fan guards must be cleaned. Upstairs women's restroom needs a covered waste receptacle.

headline: Passed re-inspection; unlabeled containers, floor debris
summary: Food storage containers lacked common-name labels. Loose debris, dirt, and dust on floors and corners throughout must be detail cleaned and kept clean at all times.

headline: Cold food too warm; about 50 lbs discarded
summary: Cooked pasta at 47°F and raw and cooked chicken wings and breast at 45–47°F were in the walk-in cooler; they must be held at 41°F or below. About 50 lbs ($250) discarded. Hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Passed; no allergen certificate for certified manager
summary: The certified manager's allergen training certificate was not on site. The person in charge was instructed to obtain it and keep it on site.

headline: Passed; ice machine and sink leaks need repair
summary: Bulk foods need product-name labels. The ice machine interior and storage shelves need cleaning, and there are leaks at the three-compartment sink's P-trap and faucet.

headline: Unsafe hot-holding temperatures; no certified manager initially
summary: No certified food manager on site for the first 65 minutes of food prep; citation issued. Cooked chicken at 121.8°F and rice at 125.6°F were held too cool for safety; all discarded. Hair restraints and wiping-cloth storage also required.

headline: Passed re-inspection; no food handler training
summary: Employees lacked food handler training; must provide and maintain it. Some food handlers weren't wearing hair restraints. A door gap must be sealed; rust, crates, and dust need correcting; a floor hole must be sealed.

headline: Passed; torn gasket, expired allergen certificates
summary: Torn door gasket inside the front three-door prep line cooler must be replaced. Excess dust on sandwich cooler fan covers should be cleaned. Some expired allergen training certificates were on premises.

headline: Passed; ice machine lining and clutter
summary: The inner ice machine lining was not cleaned. Heavy clutter, unused equipment, and dirty basement floors must be removed and cleaned to avoid pest hiding places; seal cracks in walls.

headline: No certified manager on site; citation issued
summary: Chicken, rice, and mac and cheese were prepared and served without a certified manager holding a valid original certificate present. Heavy grease on equipment and wheels must be cleaned; the shared storage area needs organizing.

headline: Passed re-inspection; no thermometers, leaking faucet
summary: Visible, working thermometers are needed in all refrigeration units. The leaking faucet base at the three-compartment sink in the rear dish area must be repaired.

headline: Passed with conditions; milk held at 50°F
summary: Foods that must be kept cold were held at 50°F. The manager discarded 2 gallons of milk and 1/4 pound of housemade salsa (about $25). A priority violation citation was issued.

headline: Passed; expired allergen certificate
summary: The allergen certificate on site had expired. The person in charge was instructed to keep current allergen training and its certificate.

headline: Passed; ice buildup and dust need cleaning
summary: Serving plates on kitchen shelves must be inverted to prevent dust. The chest freezer has ice buildup to defrost. Rusty dry-storage shelves and food in grocery bags need correcting; floors need cleaning.

headline: Passed re-inspection; loose sink, splatter, damaged tiles
summary: A loose hand sink on the wall in the rear dish/prep area must be repaired. Utensils on shelves must be inverted. Food splatter on walls and damaged or stained floor and ceiling tiles need cleaning or repair.

headline: Failed: live flies found in basement prep area
summary: About 10 live house flies and 30 small flying insects were on walls and ceiling of the basement prep and dish area. Additional pest control service is needed; a citation was issued. Also cracked floor and missing covered trash can.

headline: Passed; torn refrigerator gasket
summary: A refrigerator door has a torn gasket that must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Passed re-inspection; spillage inside soda cabinet
summary: Spillage buildup inside the cabinet where the soda machine sits in the lobby must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; handwashing sign needed in prep room
summary: A handwashing sign must be provided for the sink in the oven prep room.

headline: Pass with conditions; dish machine fixed on site
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine; a technician repaired it on site to 100 ppm. 10 lbs of cooked chicken wings at 90°F were discarded, with no cooling logs. Menu advisory was corrected.

headline: Passed; ice scoop and milk crates
summary: The ice machine bin needs cleaning. Food handlers must wear hair restraints. The ice scoop must be held in a clean container. Milk crates can't be used for elevation; no personal belongings in prep or storage areas.

headline: No certified manager; multiple unsafe temperatures
summary: No certified food manager on site while ribs, carnitas, rice, and beans were prepared; citation issued. Rice at 115°F, eggs and chicken at 55–65°F, and a cooler at 62°F were unsafe. 210 lbs of pork skin left outside the rear door was discarded.

headline: Passed re-inspection; aluminum foil on shelving
summary: Aluminum foil was wrapped around shelving; the manager was instructed to remove it.

headline: Failed: no handwashing sink in new prep area
summary: No handwashing sink in the rear extended prep area; one must be installed with hot and cold water, soap, and towels. A door gap, torn cooler gasket, missing backflow device, and non-self-closing washroom door also required fixing.

headline: Failed: no sanitation certificate; unsafe egg storage
summary: No valid city sanitation certificate on site. Raw eggs held at 66.2°F were discarded. A rear hand sink was blocked and a front hand sink was used for dishes. Two dish machines are tagged out of use.

headline: Passed; grease, dust, and sink faucet need attention
summary: The large can opener needs cleaning. Grease and food spills beside the fryer need cleaning. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks and must be repaired or replaced. Dust around air vents needs removal.

headline: Failed: repeat floor-cleaning violation
summary: Previous core violation not corrected: floors along wall bases and under equipment must be cleaned, especially behind cooking equipment and in the dish area. Citation issued.

headline: Passed re-inspection; rusty shelves, leaky faucet
summary: Rusty walk-in freezer and cooler shelving must be replaced. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks and must be repaired. The non-food prep hand sink needs repair or removal.

headline: Passed; grill residue and vent cleaning needed
summary: Residue under the grill needs cleaning. Hood vents need cleaning. All food handlers must obtain the required food handler training.

headline: Passed; beverages stored in restroom; improper storage
summary: Beverages were stored on the floor of the basement restroom and must be removed. Soiled wiping cloths were left on prep tables; sandwich trays were stored improperly and must be inverted.

headline: No certified manager; repeat violations uncorrected
summary: No certified food manager was on site while deli sandwiches were prepared (citation). Stained cutting boards and torn gaskets need repair. Repeat violations from 2023 were not fixed, including rusty racks and a missing covered trash can.

headline: Unlabeled containers; fryer and floor need cleaning
summary: Four storage containers had no common name and must be labeled with food-grade storage only. The deep fryer has grease and food debris. The three-compartment sink sprayer leaks. Dirt and food debris are on floors under equipment.

headline: Dirty ice machine; ice discarded
summary: Black dirt buildup inside the ice machine was dripping into ice used for drinks (citation). All ice in the machine was voluntarily discarded. The interior must be cleaned before reinspection.

headline: No employee health policy; no pest control proof
summary: No written employee health policy was on site (priority violation). No pest control contract or logbook was provided, and gaps at the front and rear exit doors need sealing. No handwashing sign; restroom door is not self-closing; no dumpster documentation.

headline: Door gaps must be sealed
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the top of the rear exit door and at the bottom of the front door must be sealed with a tight-fitting seal to block pests.

headline: No certified manager on site; repeat violations
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken was prepared (citation). No employee health policy was on site (citation). Repeat violations from 2023 were not corrected, including missing food handler and allergen training certificates (citation).

headline: Hand sinks lacked hot water and supplies; cold food discarded
summary: Raw beef at 47°F and other food at 44–52°F were too warm; about 50 lbs was discarded. Bar sink water was 65°F, below the 100°F minimum. Some hand sinks had no soap or paper towels; soap was restocked. No employee health policy on site.

headline: Rat droppings and live flies found in basement
summary: Over 30 rat droppings and over 30 live flies were found in the basement (citation). Staff must remove them and call pest control. Also noted: foil and rusty surfaces on shelves, dirty cooler handles, missing sink stoppers, and greasy hood filters.

headline: Inspection summary not posted; ceiling tiles dirty
summary: Last inspection summary was not posted for public view, so a citation was issued. Manager received a copy and was told to post it. Ceiling tiles in the rear food prep area need cleaning.

headline: Moldy meat on display; no certified manager on site
summary: Moldy meat was displayed for sale and was ordered discarded (citation). No certified food manager was on site while meat was prepared (citation). Hand sink problems included a blocked, leaking sink and missing signs. No food handler training was shown.

headline: Door gap, greasy surfaces, and worn gaskets
summary: A gap at the bottom of the front double doors must be made tight-fitting. Worn gaskets on a freezer and prep cooler need repair. Grease and food debris must be cleaned from several surfaces, and walls and ceilings need attention.

headline: Dish machine tagged; 20+ live flies found
summary: The bar dish machine read 0 ppm sanitizer; it was tagged and cannot be used until repaired and reinspected (citation). Over 20 live small flies were found in the dishwashing area (citation). Wet wiping cloths, torn gaskets, and food debris were also found.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; plastic wrap on sink drain
summary: A reach-in cooler by the grill is missing an internal thermometer. Plastic wrap is holding a prep sink drain in place and must be removed. Also noted: a poorly sealed drive-thru hand sink and soiled cooler and floor areas.

headline: Dish racks on floor; low restroom water pressure
summary: Dish racks were stored on the floor next to the dish machine and must be raised at least six inches. Low water pressure was found at the women's restroom hand sinks.

headline: Greasy hood filters; ice machine lacks backflow device
summary: Grease and food debris are on the ventilation hood and filters and must be cleaned. The ice machine water line has no visible backflow prevention device and one must be provided.

headline: No allergen training certificates for managers
summary: No allergen training certificates were available for certified food managers. Managers must provide them.

headline: Shellfish tags incomplete; mold on ice machines
summary: Shellfish tags from April–June 2024 lack the date the last shellfish was sold or served (citation). Mold-like substances were found on two ice machines near the dish machine and must be cleaned. Covered trash cans are missing in employee washrooms.

headline: Missing handwashing sign and container labels
summary: No handwashing sign at the rear bar sink. Bulk flour and sugar containers had no labels. No backflow prevention device was found at the ice machine water line and must be provided.

headline: Unlabeled containers; ice machine needs cleaning
summary: Food containers must show the name of the commodity. Ice machine interior needs cleaning. Spoons and a knife were stored between the sink and dish machine, and a few cutting boards need cleaning. Floor in front bar area needs cleaning.

headline: Furnace room floor needs cleaning
summary: The furnace room floor needs cleaning to remove dust and debris.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; ice bin needs cleaning
summary: Handwashing signs are missing at all restroom and prep area hand sinks. The ice bin interior needs cleaning. The manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Food debris on prep area floor
summary: Coffee beans and other food debris were found on the floor throughout the prep area. Staff must detail clean the floors.

headline: Door gap and leaking sink pipe
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the rear side door must be repaired to block pests. A pipe under the rear sink is leaking. Walk-in cooler fans are dusty, and the ceiling and vents need cleaning. One employee has an expired food handler certificate.

headline: Missing health policy and cleanup procedure at first
summary: No written employee health policy was on site at first; one was printed and signed during the inspection. No vomit cleanup procedure was on site; a kit was ordered and verified. No dumpster was on site, though a signed contract was shown. No allergen training.

headline: Missing raw food warning; no dish machine test strips
summary: Menus did not include the consumer advisory for raw or undercooked animal foods, including electronic menus (citation). The high-temperature dish machine had no test strips to check final rinse temperature. Grease is built up on hood filters.

headline: Mold-like specks on ice machine
summary: Pink and brown mold-like specks were found on the ice machine shield and must be cleaned. The floor in front of a cold unit is damaged. Restrooms lack working or installed mechanical ventilation.

headline: Cooked foods held at unsafe temperatures; discarded
summary: About 5 lbs of cooked beef and grilled vegetables were at 80–90°F and were discarded (citation). Sliced gyro and cooked chicken were at 60–62°F and must be 41°F or below. Salad bin was stored on the floor, and rear lighting is inadequate.

headline: Some staff lacked hair restraints and beard guards
summary: Some employees were not wearing hair restraints or beard guards. Staff were instructed to provide them for all employees.

headline: No certified manager on duty; food stored on floor
summary: No person in charge with a valid certificate was present, and no certified food manager was on duty while food was prepared and served (citation). Food containers were stored on the floor. Several restroom lights were burned out.

headline: Improper serving utensil and several repairs needed
summary: A saucer was being used to serve cooked rice; staff were told to use long-handled utensils. Also noted: a damaged cooler gasket, water and debris on floors, cracks in washroom and hallway walls and ceilings, and a non-working basement washroom fan.

headline: Missing cooler thermometers; door gap found
summary: Cold holding coolers lack thermometers and must be equipped with working ones. An about 1/4-inch gap under the front door must be sealed. Missing floor covering at the entrance must be replaced.

headline: About 20 live flying insects near bar
summary: About 20 live small flying insects were found on walls under the bar, with more flies behind the bar (citation). More pest control service is needed. Basement clutter must be removed to eliminate pest hiding spots.

headline: Missing ceiling tiles in prep area
summary: Ceiling tiles are missing in the prep area and must be replaced.

headline: Clutter, missing trash cover, no allergen certificate
summary: Women's restroom has no covered trash receptacle. The basement has excessive clutter that must be removed and organized. The manager lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: Ceiling holes; manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: Holes are in the ceiling above the three-compartment sink and outside the employee restroom and must be sealed. A certified food manager lacked allergen awareness training and certificate.

headline: Tongs in standing water; no allergen certificate
summary: Tongs in use were kept in standing water at room temperature; staff were told to store them properly. The food service manager has no allergen training certificate.

headline: Sink backs up with wastewater; syrup spill
summary: Wastewater backs up from the middle compartment of the three-compartment sink into the first, and the person in charge was told to repair it (citation). Syrup spilled inside the cabinet under the soda machine needs cleaning.

headline: No food handler or allergen training recorded
summary: No food handler training or allergen training was available for employees or managers. Also noted: residue inside the ice machine, soiled wiping cloths, leaking faucet handles, missing grout, and food debris on floors.

headline: Mislabeled packaged food; repeat violations uncorrected
summary: Packaged cookies, scones, and pastries lacked required labels (citation). Ice bin and cooler interiors need cleaning. Repeat violations were not fixed, including a leaking sink faucet and a missing backflow device on the ice machine (citation). No food handler proof was shown.

headline: No employee health policy or training on site
summary: No employee health policy or health training was on site (citation). Brick walls in food storage areas must be sealed to be smooth and cleanable. The floor around the grease tank also needs attention.

headline: Repeat storage violations; food handler proof missing
summary: Single-use cups and utensils were stored in an employee restroom, and personal items were stored on food boxes; these repeat violations were not corrected (citation). Soda ice chute needs cleaning. No food handler training proof was provided.

headline: Potatoes held above 41°F; no food handler certificate
summary: Blanched potatoes at 46–50°F sat on a prep table with no cooking log; about 10 lbs was discarded (citation). Pastries lacked allergen labels and sanitizer test strips were missing. No food handler certificate was provided. The previous summary was not posted until replaced.

headline: About 20 small flies in dishwashing area
summary: About 20 small flies were found in the main kitchen dishwashing area (citation). Staff must eliminate them and clean affected areas. Also noted: utensils stored handles-down, buildup on floors and walls, and burnt-out bulbs in a freezer and cooler.

headline: Hand sinks blocked by equipment; moved during inspection
summary: Two hand sinks were blocked by equipment. The equipment was moved during the inspection (citation). Also noted: no splash partition between a beverage hand sink and an ice bin, a gap under a supply-closet door, and dirty hood filters.

headline: Live and dead roaches found throughout
summary: Dead roaches were found on floors in several areas, and about 5 live roaches were found in the main prep area and under a sink (citation). Chicken and shrimp were stored on the floor below a sink. Staff must consult pest control.

headline: Meat cooler too warm and tagged; food discarded
summary: The walk-in meat cooler's air reached 55.1°F, and raw meat was held at 47.5–58.3°F. About 91 lbs was discarded and the cooler was tagged until repaired and reinspected (citation). A hand sink inside the cooler had 85°F water.

headline: Dumpster area spillage; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Consumer advisory reminders inside the menu were not written properly and must be corrected. Outside dumpster area had garbage spillage (citation). A sanitation manager has no allergen training.

headline: Mineral buildup inside ice machine
summary: Mineral buildup was found inside the ice machine and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Roaches and flies found; no certified manager
summary: No certified food manager was on premises (citation). Live roaches, about 40 small flies, and about 3 large flies were found (citation). A hand sink in dishwashing was 66.2°F, below the 100°F minimum. Ice machines have mold-like buildup.

headline: Fryer and floor under cooking equipment need cleaning
summary: The first-floor kitchen fryer needs additional cleaning at the bottom. Grease and other matter must be cleaned from floors under cooking equipment.

headline: New prep area has no handwashing sink
summary: A new food prep area lacks a dedicated handwashing sink, which must be installed (citation). An ice machine sits beside a mop sink without a splash guard and lacks a backflow device. Repeat violations from 2024 were not corrected.

headline: Undated foods, broken hand sink, door gap
summary: Several ready-to-eat cold foods lacked discard date labels; about 19 lbs was discarded during inspection (citation). A basement hand sink is broken and was unusable. Hand sinks lacked drying towels or soap. The revolving door has gaps.

headline: Door gap and unsealed wood under freezer
summary: An open 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the front entrance door needs a rodent-proof strip. Raw wood supports under the box freezer must be sealed. Uneven spray foam at the utility mop sink must be smoothed.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; no food handler certificates
summary: A torn rubber gasket on a cooler door must be repaired or replaced. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Rodent bait in food area; cold food too warm
summary: Open rodent bait was found in the food prep area; it was removed during the inspection (citation). Several cold foods were held above 41°F, and about 25 lbs was discarded. Mussels lacked shellfish tags, and sanitizer read 0 ppm until fixed during inspection.

headline: About 125 rodent droppings; undated food
summary: About 125 small rodent droppings were found in grocery shelving, the utility closet, and storage areas (citation). Candy and other food were stored in a utility closet. Several prepared foods lacked date labels and were discarded. No metal stem thermometer was on site.

headline: Broken faucet and grease buildup in prep areas
summary: A two-compartment sink faucet is broken and must be repaired. A bar hand sink drains slowly. Grease, food debris, and dirt are on floors and walls in prep, dish, and storage areas and must be cleaned.

headline: Floors and floor drains need cleaning
summary: Floors along wall bases and in corners need cleaning throughout the facility. Floor drains also need cleaning.

headline: No certificate posted; no food thermometer; slow sink
summary: No valid City food sanitation certificate was posted for food employees (citation). No food thermometer was on site. Three-compartment sink drains slowly and backs up (citation). Food in a self-serve cooler lacked ingredient labels. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: No hot water, soap, or certified manager on site
summary: No valid certificate for a certified manager was posted (citation). Several sinks had no hot water, and some hand sinks lacked soap; soap was obtained during the inspection. No employee health policy, vomit cleanup procedure, pest log, or dumpster contract was provided.

headline: No food handler certificates; labels and bulbs
summary: Food storage containers lacked labels with their common name. Wet wiping cloths were on prep surfaces and must be stored in sanitizer. Burned-out hood bulbs must be replaced. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: No backflow device on ice machine; dirty floors
summary: The ice machine has no backflow prevention device; one must be provided. The employee restroom needs a covered trash can. A floor drain and walls need cleaning. One certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Cardboard shelf liner; unused equipment stored
summary: Cardboard was used as a liner on dry storage shelves and must be removed. Unused equipment was stored in the dry storage area and should be removed to prevent pest hiding spots.

headline: Cracked light shield in prep area
summary: A cracked light shield above a storage shelf in the food prep area must be replaced.

headline: Leaking hand sink pedal; expired allergen certificates
summary: The hand-washing pedal at the drive-thru sink is leaking and must be fixed. Restroom wash basins have no hand-washing signs. Walls near sinks and cooking equipment have spills and dirt. Certified managers have expired allergen certificates.

headline: Brooms stored next to clean utensils
summary: Brooms were stored beside the clean utensil rack. The inspector told staff to keep them apart to prevent contamination.

headline: Live cockroach found; no certified manager present
summary: No certified food manager with a valid certificate was on site while rice, chicken, fish, and tomatoes were prepared (citation). One large live cockroach was found by the soda station and must be eliminated (citation). Wet wiping cloths and food debris were also found.

headline: No hot water at dish sink; dish machines not working
summary: No hot or cold water was available at the dish room hand sink, and there is no hand sink at the cooks' line (citation). Both dish machines were not working or set up with chemicals. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure was on site. Outside waste was overflowing.

headline: Food handler certificates not verified
summary: Food handler certificates could not be found or verified for food employees; they must be provided and kept on site. Spilled food was found in a freezer, and ceiling tiles are missing in the bathroom area.

headline: No valid certificate posted; ice machine residue
summary: No valid City food sanitation certificate was posted (citation). Residue was found on the ice machine door and must be cleaned. Items were stored on the floor in the upstairs storage room.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure on site
summary: No written procedure or kit for cleaning up vomit or diarrhea was on site (citation). Restroom needs a covered trash can and a self-closing door. A soiled mop head was not hung up to dry.

headline: Rusted cooler racks
summary: Rusted racks inside coolers must be recoated or replaced.

headline: Items on floor in second-floor bar
summary: Stored items throughout the second-floor bar must be raised off the floor.

headline: Undated foods; food stored in grocery bags
summary: Ready-to-eat cooked rice and sausage in a refrigerator were not date marked (citation). Food was stored in plastic grocery bags in a cooler. Ice machine residue and debris along walls in utility and storage areas need cleaning.

headline: Wet wiping cloths; food debris on floors
summary: Wet wiping cloths were stored on counters and must be kept in sanitizer solution. Food residue is under reach-in coolers and on floors. Food debris is also splattered on the wall behind the soda machine rack.

headline: No certified manager; no hot water at hand sink
summary: No valid certified food manager certificate was posted while eggs, salmon, and potatoes were prepared (citation). A prep area hand sink had 71°F water and must provide at least 100°F (citation). A cold water handle is broken. No food handler training proof was on site.

headline: Missing shellfish tags; grease trap leaking
summary: Shellfish tags were missing for April and May; only recent tags were on site (citation). Wastewater leaked from the bakery grease trap when drained, and the manager was told to service it (citation).

headline: Slime in ice machine; milk too warm; flies
summary: Brown and pink slime was found inside an ice machine used for drinks (citation). Milk was held at 46°F and about 1.5 gallons was discarded. More than 20 small flies were found throughout the facility (citation). Heavy clutter is in the basement.

headline: Roaches found; dish machine not sanitizing; hands unwashed
summary: Two live roaches and several dead ones were found under a hot water tank (citation). A dishwasher handled clean dishes without washing hands. The dish machine read 0 ppm sanitizer and was tagged; the manager repaired it during inspection to 100 ppm.

headline: Dish machine not connected; cooler at 54°F tagged
summary: The dish machine is not hooked up, so dishes cannot be properly sanitized; the manager said the equipment is on order. A storage cooler held food at 54°F, above the 41°F limit, and was tagged. Also noted: an unlocked food cooler and a slimy ice machine.

headline: Labeling, storage, and repair issues; no pests
summary: Bulk containers need labels and utensils need to be stored properly. Grease and debris need cleaning from the grill and fryer cabinets. Several repairs are needed, including chipping paint, a cracked walk-in floor, damaged floor tile, and a hole in the lobby wall.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; flying insects found
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were found in a soda machine, the wait station, dining area, and on shelves and ledges (citation). Numerous flying insects were in prep, dish, and storage areas. Staff must call an exterminator and clean all affected areas.

headline: Mouse droppings found; food held too warm
summary: About 60 mouse droppings were found throughout the facility, plus small flies (citation). Eggs, milk, chicken, and pork were held above 41°F; about 100 lbs was discarded. A hand sink was blocked by bread racks and equipment. No certified manager was on site while open.

headline: No certified manager; hand sink blocked
summary: No certified food manager was on site while food was prepared and served (citation). A dish-area hand sink was blocked by a large cooler; the manager moved it during the inspection (citation). Fly traps were hanging in the kitchen and dry storage.

headline: Leaking hand sink pipe; allergen training still missing
summary: A loose, leaking pipe under the dishwashing area hand sink must be repaired. A repeat violation for missing allergen training was not corrected from a prior inspection, and a citation was issued.

headline: Cleaning and plumbing repairs needed; expired allergen certificates
summary: A rear hand sink drains slowly and a 3-compartment sink faucet is in poor repair. Cooler interiors, spice containers, and floors around cooking equipment and inside the walk-in need cleaning. Manager allergen certificates have expired.

headline: Mold-like buildup on ice machine door
summary: A black mold-like substance was found on the ice machine door and must be cleaned. Missing wall tiles behind the three-compartment sink need repair.

headline: No food handler certificates on site
summary: No food handler certificates were on site. Staff must show proof of training and keep it on site.

headline: Employees eating at prep area; dish machine too hot
summary: Employees were drinking and eating at the food prep area; a designated break area must be provided (citation). Dish machine final rinse read 200°F, outside the 180–194°F range, and was not to be used until fixed. Plates and dusty fans also need attention.

headline: Unlabeled storage containers; cardboard shelf liner
