summary: Food storage containers were not labeled with their common name and must be. Cardboard lining was on a storage shelf in the rear prep area and must be removed.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; mop sink lacks backflow
summary: Bulk containers in the rear prep area had no labels and must be labeled with the food name. A mop sink in the basement has no backflow prevention device and one must be provided.

headline: Leaking drainpipe under basement hand sink
summary: No handwashing sign was at the basement hand sink; the manager provided one during the inspection. A drainpipe under that same hand sink is leaking and must be repaired.

headline: Dish machine tagged; employee nose-touching seen
summary: The bakery dish machine rinsed at 154°F, below the required 180°F; it was tagged and cannot be used until reinspected (citation). An employee was seen blowing and touching their nose in prep; they were told to wash hands. Leaks and greasy fryers were also noted.

headline: No valid certificate posted; uncovered food; no hair restraints
summary: No valid City food sanitation certificate was posted while food that must stay hot or cold was stored (citation). Food in coolers was uncovered, workers prepped without hair restraints, and kitchen ceiling paint is peeling. No food handler training proof.

headline: No allergen training certificates for managers
summary: No allergen training certificates were provided for certified food managers. Management must show proof of allergen training.

headline: Wet mop stored against wall
summary: A wet mop was stored against the wall. It must be placed so it can air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies.

headline: Grease and dirt buildup; restroom repairs needed
summary: Deep fryer openings have grease buildup, and the beer cooler floor and pizza reach-in have dirt and food debris. Cooking equipment and walls have dust and grease. A women's restroom faucet is loose and it has no covered trash can.

headline: Live flies and pesticides stored near food
summary: About 100 live small flies were found in the basement prep area and about 50 in the dining and juicing area (citation). Insect spray cans were stored near food; the manager removed them during the inspection. Black plastic bags covered food-holding units.

headline: Leaking drain pipe; grease and clutter
summary: Ice bin needs cleaning and fryers need degreasing. A drain pipe under the front bar sink is leaking and must be repaired. Unnecessary items are stored behind the dough machine, in a hot water heater closet, and in dry storage.

headline: Slight buildup inside ice machine
summary: Slight buildup was found inside the upper portion of the ice machine. Staff must clean its interior.

headline: No handwashing sink in produce prep
summary: Re-inspection failed. No handwashing sink where ready-to-eat foods are packaged in produce prep. A sink with hot and cold water, soap and towels must be installed. Gap at rear delivery door. Torn gaskets on walk-in cooler.

headline: Scoops handles in food; torn cooler gaskets
summary: Passed. Scoops stored with handles touching food in bins and bowls. Gaskets on two reach-in coolers heavily torn. Freezer shelves soiled with spills. Three of four light fixtures in south dry storage not working. Expired allergen certificates for managers.

headline: Ice machines touch dirty ice; food unlabeled
summary: Black and brown substance on ice machines touches ice used for drinks; citation issued. Cooked pasta, lobster, crawfish and dip lacked date labels; about 80 lbs ($300) discarded. Greasy cooking equipment, uncovered chips and no covered restroom bin.

headline: No hot water at two-compartment sink
summary: Passed. No hot running water at two-compartment sink; must be repaired. Epoxy flooring under steam table in poor repair. Grease, standing water and floor debris near ice machine, fryers and dish-area drain. Cracked light shield in dish area.

headline: No handwashing sink by cooking; pest entry gap
summary: No handwashing sink near cooking equipment in rear prep; priority violation. Opening at base of double exit doors. Ice machine lacks backflow device. Pink and black moldlike substance on small ice machine shield. Holes in walls and missing vent cover.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: No certified food manager on site while TCS (temperature-controlled) foods were prepared and served; must be present at all times. Person in charge lacks certificate. Food stored on floors in coolers and freezers. Chipping ceiling paint and broken plexiglass.

headline: No soap at dish-area hand sink; citation
summary: No soap at handwashing sink by dish area; citation issued. Unlabeled food inside refrigerators. Dirty wiping cloths left on prep tables. Floors under equipment and along walls need detail cleaning. Ventilation units have dust and dirt.

headline: Loose faucet at employee toilet sink
summary: Passed. Loose faucet at the washbowl in the employee toilet room. Must be repaired or replaced and kept in good condition.

headline: Overflowing outside dumpster; re-inspection failed
summary: Outside dumpster overflowing with trash and above its rim. Outside garbage area not maintained. Must remove trash, bags and grease from the container. No citation issued.

headline: Broken faucet handle and leaking drain
summary: Passed. Stripped hot-water faucet handle at rear prep hand sink must be repaired. Leaky drain pipe under front prep hand sink must be fixed. Floors along walls, corners and under racks in rear storage need cleaning.

headline: Food handlers without hair restraints
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food handlers were prepping food without hair restraints. Person in charge was instructed that all food handlers must wear a hair restraint.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; scoops stored in food
summary: Passed. Bulk containers in rear food storage lack labels and must show common names. Wiping cloths on front prep tables must be stored in sanitizing solution. Scoops stored inside bulk containers. Dust on vent above utility sink. Personal belongings in food areas.

headline: Two employees lack food handler training
summary: Passed. Two employees had no food handler training. All employees must complete training and keep records on site. No allergen training on site; certified managers must complete it and keep records.

headline: Banquet hall not operating; duct tape repair
summary: No food service during inspection because the banquet hall was not open. Facility said a certified manager will be present during events serving food. Two-compartment faucet repaired with duct tape, which is not allowed; surface must be smooth and cleanable.

headline: Small flies and rat droppings in prep areas
summary: About 12 or more small flies and about 5 rat droppings found near the freezer, under a prep table and under the serving counter. Droppings must be removed and areas cleaned. Missing soap and hand-drying supplies were noted. Citation issued.

headline: Utensils not stored upside down; passed
summary: Passed. Multi-use utensils were not inverted during storage. Staff were instructed to store them handle-up.

headline: Broken thermometer; worn gaskets and floor
summary: Re-inspection passed. Broken thermometer in cold-brew holding unit must be replaced. Worn walk-in cooler gasket and pitted cutting board need repair. Dust on shelving and microwave. Floor grout and a missing wall panel need repair.

headline: Dirty cans, walls and hood filters
summary: Passed. Canned food has light debris buildup that must be cleaned. Walls near the kitchen fire extinguisher have soil and debris. Hood filters above the griddle have grease and dirt buildup.

headline: Trash can without lid; dirty rear floors
summary: Passed. Left unisex restroom trash receptacle has no lid; a lid must be provided. Rear floors have dirt and debris that must be cleaned.

headline: Soiled beverage nozzles and drain debris
summary: Passed. Beverage machine nozzles were soiled with syrup buildup and need detail cleaning. Black substance on caulking at the three-compartment sink. Floor drain had excessive debris to remove.

headline: Openings in front doors; dusty floors
summary: Re-inspection passed. Front entrance doors have openings in the middle; they must be rodent-proofed and maintained. Floors under all shelves have dust and debris that must be cleaned.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; dirty coolers
summary: Passed. Handwashing signage missing at toilet-room sinks. Rubber gaskets of coolers and exterior of broaster have food debris. Light out in storage area.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; torn gasket
summary: Passed. Handwashing signage must be provided in unisex lobby restrooms. Torn gasket on the bottom of a food reach-in cooler must be repaired.

headline: No hot water at employee restroom sinks
summary: Both gender-neutral restroom handwashing sinks had no hot water, measuring 73.0°F to 80.2°F. Hot water must reach at least 100°F. Citation issued. Dessert and shake cooler has a torn gasket to repair.

headline: Prep shelves, freezer and grease need cleaning
summary: Passed. Bottom shelves of prep tables and interior of the chest freezer need cleaning. Grease on food prep area walls must be cleaned.

headline: No health policy or food handler certificates
summary: No employee health policy on site; priority violation, no citation. No food handler certificates on site. Rice stored outside labeled containers. Plastic grocery bags used in freezer. Unused equipment in storage. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Storage and cleaning issues in basement
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths stored on prep tables. Basement items must be off the floor. Plastic grocery bags used for food in basement freezer. Clutter needs removal. Some light bulbs out. Food handler and allergen training proof missing.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; milk crates
summary: Passed. Bulk containers in rear storage lack labels and must show common food names. Milk crates used as shelving inside walk-in cooler must be replaced. No receptacles at prep-area hand sinks.

headline: Dirty cabinet at beverage station; passed
summary: Passed. The cabinet in the front beverage station needs cleaning. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: No sanitizer; raw meat above ready-to-eat food
summary: No sanitizer on premises; owner bought bleach across the street. Raw meat stored above ready-to-eat buns and rice; owner removed it. About 10 lbs of cooked rice held over 24 hours without a date label; discarded. Pest control report missing. Citations issued.

headline: Unlabeled sugar; greasy equipment; dumpster debris
summary: Re-inspection passed. Sugar stored outside its original container without a product name; must be labeled. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, coolers and shelving. Debris around dumpster. Upstairs floors and areas under shelving need detail cleaning.

headline: Dish machine too cool; manager lacks allergen training
summary: High-temperature dish machine water at 151°F; sanitizing rinse must be at least 180°F. Machine tagged and not to be used until CDPH inspects it. Manager on duty lacks allergen training certificate; prior violation uncorrected. Citation issued.

headline: Hot water too low; citation issued
summary: Hot water measured 98°F throughout the facility. Hot water was restored before inspection ended. Hot water must reach 100°F at hand sinks and 110°F at other sinks. Citation issued.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: Passed. The certified food manager did not have an allergen training certificate. Management was instructed that all certified food managers must show proof of training.

headline: Gap at front door; cardboard shelf liner
summary: Passed. Gap along bottom of front entry door must be sealed for a tight fit. Splash guard needed at hand sink next to meat slicer. Cardboard shelf liners in rear storage must be removed. Build-up on soda machine ice dispenser needs cleaning.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; wet mops stored
summary: Passed. Handwashing signage missing at dishwashing area hand sink. Wet mops stored in utility sink and mop buckets; mops must be hung to dry when not in use.

headline: Dish machine too cool; employee lacks training
summary: Dish machine reached only 150.1°F; it must reach 160°F to sanitize dishes. Machine tagged and held; repair or replacement ordered. Required thermometer missing. Men's restroom lacks handwashing sign. One employee has no food handler training.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; inspection passed
summary: Passed on re-inspection. No handwashing signs or posters near sinks in the front bar and sushi prep areas. Signs must be provided and kept up.

headline: Ice machine debris and standing water
summary: Re-inspection passed. Debris buildup inside ice machine must be cleaned. No backflow device visible on ice machine; must be provided. Standing water behind ice machine, washer, hand sink and three-compartment sink. Floor drains need debris removed.

headline: Openings in rear walls; no food handler training
summary: Passed. Openings along outer rear door and in walls and ceilings of rear storage must be sealed. Damaged floor and ceiling tiles in prep and dish areas. No food handler training available; must be provided for all employees.

headline: Undercooked menu items unmarked; fixed on site
summary: Animal-derived foods that can be served undercooked had no asterisk or menu disclosure. Corrected on site: asterisks and menu disclosure added. Beverage faucet drains into hand sink; must be removed. Expired food handler and allergen certificates.

headline: Cockroaches found; food held without discard dates
summary: Refrigerated TCS foods held over 24 hours without discard dates: about 15 lbs rice, 20 lbs chicken, 15 lbs beef, 16 lbs shrimp, about $400 value, discarded. Two dead cockroaches between wall and freezer. Sushi rice lab letter expired. Citation issued.

headline: Leaking faucets; greasy exhaust hood
summary: Passed. Leak at the base of the three-compartment faucets must be repaired. Dirt and grease buildup on the exhaust hood, filters and pipes above cooking equipment needs detail cleaning.

headline: Walk-in floor dirt; leaking drain pipe
summary: Passed. Walk-in cooler floor has dirt and food debris under shelving and along walls. Greasy cooking equipment and a leaking drain pipe on three-compartment sink. Staff restroom lacks covered receptacle.

headline: Slow-draining rear hand sink
summary: Passed. Rear area hand sink drain is slow-draining but functional. Plumbing must be repaired or replaced to allow adequate drainage, and all fixtures maintained in good repair.

headline: Fly trap above sink; to be removed
summary: Passed. Fly trap mounted above the three-compartment sink. Person in charge was instructed to remove it.

headline: No written employee health policy on premises
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. No written employee health policy on premises. A signed health policy for each employee must be provided and kept. Priority foundation violation.

headline: Gaps in exterior door and wall holes
summary: Passed. Exterior door has 1/4-inch gaps on its sides and must fit tightly. Three-compartment sink lacks wash, rinse and sanitize labels. Multiple holes in rear prep walls. Debris in walk-in cooler. Food handler certificates expired.

headline: 50 lbs ready-to-eat food discarded
summary: Cooked chicken, beef, pork, noodles and pickled vegetables held over 24 hours in reach-in cooler without date labels; manager discarded 50 lbs ($100). Food stored on floor; grocery bags used in coolers. Debris around outdoor dumpster. Citation issued.

headline: Blocked hand sink and slime inside ice machine
summary: Rear prep hand sink blocked by utensils. Black and pink slime dripped from ice machine onto ice. Dead insects, grease and dirt buildup on equipment. Milk crates used as shelving. Trash spilled outside. Food manager's allergen training expired.

headline: Broken towel sensor; dusty vents
summary: Passed. Automatic paper towel dispenser sensor at hand sink near office does not work and must be repaired. Dust and dirt on vents above utility sink and women's restroom. No allergen training certificates on site.

headline: Minor leak at hand sink faucet
summary: Passed. Minor leak at the handwashing sink faucet must be repaired.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; leaking faucets
summary: Passed. Handwashing signage must be provided at the dishwashing area sink. Torn gasket on two-door refrigerator in rear storage. Leaking three-compartment faucet in rear dishwashing area must be repaired.

headline: Blocked hand sink; chips stored on floor
summary: Front prep hand sink was blocked by containers; must be kept clear for handwashing only. Citation issued. Chips stored on floor, tongs resting on sliced tomatoes, and open juice in customer cooler. Missing ceiling tiles. Prior violations not corrected.

headline: Rust on shelves; missing sink stoppers
summary: Passed. Rust on lower prep and storage table shelves must be removed. Three-compartment sink is missing proper stoppers. Food debris and splashes on walls near rear hand sink. Certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: No certified manager; cooler doors detached
summary: No City of Chicago food service manager or certificate on premises; priority violation. No employee health policies on premises. Three-door cooler doors not attached properly and could come off. Food handler and allergen training required.

headline: Milk crates still used as shelving
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Milk crates still used for elevation in dry storage, which can hide pests. Shelving must be provided, and food must be stored 6 inches from the wall. Cutting boards with open seams and stains must be fixed or replaced.

headline: Unplugged cooler tagged; no health policy
summary: Passed with conditions. Unplugged two-door cooler in rear prep tagged and held; not to be used until it holds at least 41°F and CDPH reinspects. No written employee health policy. Hot water dispenser lacks backflow device. Heavy leak from hand sink drain.

headline: Gap at rear door; certificates not verified
summary: Re-inspection passed. A 1/2-inch gap at the bottom of rear exit door, leading to dumpsters and alley, must be sealed. Food handler certificates could not be located or verified for all food employees.

headline: Food in plastic bags; cardboard shelf liners
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food stored in plastic grocery bags inside coolers must move to approved food-grade containers. Torn gasket on prep cooler. Cardboard shelf liners must be removed. Unused storage-area equipment should be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Pest device above open food; sealing needed
summary: Re-inspection passed. Insect control device is installed directly above open food prep surface; must be relocated to prevent contamination. Several sinks and plumbing fixtures are not sealed to walls, allowing seepage behind equipment.

headline: Cold foods too warm; about 5 lbs discarded
summary: Chicken at 49.0°F, cheese at 62.0°F, lettuce at 47.7°F, tomatoes at 49.2°F and sour cream at 61.4°F, all above the 41°F limit. About 5 lbs ($20) discarded. Citation issued. Also uncovered food, a missing hair restraint and improper wiping cloth storage.

headline: Cooler temperatures too warm; food discarded
summary: Service cooler food too warm: cheese 50°F, pasta 51°F, shredded lettuce 48.1°F, pertuda 46.1°F; 4 lbs discarded. Prep cooler by the grill at 48°F, not to be used until repaired. Employees lacked hair restraints. Citation issued.

headline: No certified manager on site; prior violations
summary: No valid certified person in charge or food sanitation manager on site while TCS foods prepared and served; citation issued. Prior violations uncorrected: hair restraints, expired food handler certificates, and inspection summary not posted for customers.

headline: Mouse droppings behind ice machine
summary: About 20 mouse droppings behind the ice machine and 10 under a dry storage rack; must be removed and detail cleaned. Front doors have 1/4-inch gaps. Food and grease in cooking equipment. Leaks at three-compartment faucet. Citation issued.

headline: No hot water at hand sinks; two-day workaround
summary: No running hot water at front coffee-station hand sink (50.0°F) or dish-area hand sink. Both must reach at least 100°F by re-inspection. CDPH placed the establishment on a two-day workaround. Priority violation.

headline: Menu lacks raw food warning; thermometer missing
summary: Menu does not warn customers about raw or undercooked foods such as ceviche and eggs; priority violation. Missing thermometer in front refrigerator. Food stored on floor under sink. Rusty freezer lid and ice buildup inside basement freezers.

headline: Food truck grease and unused refrigerator
summary: Dirt and grease on sides of cooking equipment must be cleaned. Dirt and debris inside light shield covers at the rear of the food truck. Unused upright refrigerator must be repaired or removed.

headline: Rodent droppings; hot food held too cool
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings found in storage, under shelves, by the sink and near the washroom. Hot foods held below 135°F: macaroni 98°F, jerk chicken 101°F, oxtails 88.9°F, rice 87°F. 23 lbs discarded. Citation issued; pest control recommended.

headline: Foul grease trap odor; greasy fryer cabinets
summary: Passed. Foul odor from floor grease trap must be cleaned. Grease buildup in fryer cabinets, rolling cart and grill table. Plastic ware must be stored upright. Hood filters and lobby light shields need cleaning. One rear storage light is burnt out.

headline: No certified manager during food service; flies
summary: No certified food manager on site when TCS foods were prepared and served; manager arrived about 40 minutes later. Seven small flies found in kitchen near the three-compartment sink; citation issued. Debris around outside garbage. No allergen training for certified manager.

headline: Ice machine residue; leaking sink
summary: Re-inspection passed. Residue inside ice machines in several areas must be cleaned. Leak at two-compartment sink in fish prep on third floor. Dirt, food and debris on floors, under heavy equipment and around sinks.

headline: No health policy or pest control log
summary: No signed employee health policies on premises; citation issued. No pest control log book on premises. Standing waste water in mop bucket. Cooler, prep, floor, wall and restroom cleaning needed. Loose wall coving in rear storage.

headline: No certified manager; ice machine black substance
summary: No valid food service sanitation manager on site while TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. Ice machine interior had excessive black substance; ice must be discarded and machine cleaned. Uncovered food and food stored on floor.

headline: Knives, leaks and missing filter; inspection passed
summary: Passed. Knives stored between coolers and on prep table. Single-use cups stored on floor. Slow-draining hand sink and leaking spray sink faucet. Women's restroom lacks covered trash can. Exhaust system missing a filter. Manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No certified manager certificate posted
summary: No City of Chicago food service manager certificate posted on site. A certified employee must be on site at all times. Citation issued. Re-inspection passed with conditions.

headline: Chipped paint in toilet and prep rooms
summary: Passed. Chipped paint on walls in toilet rooms, front and rear prep, and rear storage areas. Areas must be resurfaced and repainted so walls are sealed, smooth and cleanable.

headline: Live cockroaches and rodent droppings found
summary: About 3 live cockroaches under ice machine and about 9 rodent droppings in rear areas. Outside dumpster missing a lid. Container used as scoop in chicken. Prior violations uncorrected, including unlabeled spices, greasy equipment and dirty floors. Citation issued.

headline: Missing health policy; burned-out dining lights
summary: Re-inspection passed with no employee health policy on site; must be provided. Wall base and tile in poor repair under the sink. Multiple burned-out bulbs in the dining ceiling. Certified food manager must obtain allergen training. No citation issued.

headline: Dirty ice bin; food stored on walk-in floor
summary: Passed. Ice bin interior needs cleaning; remove ice, clean and maintain. Food containers stored on walk-in cooler floor must be elevated six inches. Loose dust and debris in corners, especially behind hot cooking equipment.

headline: Unlabeled milkshake toppings; leaking drain
summary: Passed. Bulk milkshake topping containers have no labels; all bulk and working ingredient containers must show contents. Drainpipe leaks under hand sink next to shake machines and must be repaired.

headline: Torn screen door; missing food handler proof
summary: No valid food handler certificates for required employees on site. No allergen training proof for certified food manager. Torn screen door with open holes. Frozen fries thawing improperly on shelves. Milk crates and foil used as shelf liners.

headline: Cardboard freezer liner; torn gaskets
summary: Passed. Cardboard used as a liner in reach-in freezer must be removed or replaced with smooth, cleanable material. Torn gaskets inside prep cooler must be repaired. Wet mop stored in bucket must be hung to dry.

headline: Meat stored in plastic grocery bags
summary: Passed. Some meats were held inside plastic grocery bags in the freezer. Manager must use only food-grade bags or containers for meat and food.

headline: Spills in coolers and storage floors
summary: Passed. Spills inside front coolers and on the countertop must be cleaned. Rear storage floors around tanks and under shelving need cleaning to remove spills.

headline: Food handlers lack training; sink supplies
summary: Passed with conditions. Several food employees lacked food handler training or certificates on site; must be provided. Soap, towels and signage at sinks not designated for handwashing must be removed. Several cold-holding units missing thermometers.

headline: 25–30 mouse droppings found; citation issued
summary: About 25–30 mouse droppings found under shelving in dry storage, on floor in salad prep, and around dishwashing equipment. Must be removed and sanitized. Citation issued. Ice scoop handle touched ice; two food handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Broken hot-water handle; citation issued
summary: Hand sink in food prep/dish area has broken hot-water knob; hot water unavailable as required for handwashing. Priority violation; citation issued. Tape on three-compartment faucet must be removed and repaired. Floors need cleaning in rear storage, walk-in and freezer.

headline: Hand sink blocked; cold food too warm
summary: Front prep hand sink blocked by delivery bin and boxes; citation issued. Diced tomato and pico de gallo held at 46.1°F and 48.6°F; discarded. Cooler air at 41.9°F. Milk crates used as shelving, leaking faucets and dusty fans need attention.

headline: Ice buildup in freezer; leaking sink
summary: No handwashing signs near front prep sink. Excessive ice buildup inside basement empanada freezer. Leaking faucet base at three-compartment sink. No covered waste receptacle in unisex employee washroom. Prior violations uncorrected: dirty basement floor, expired allergen certificate.

headline: Cardboard on hood; greasy fryer cabinet
summary: Passed. Several pieces of cardboard taped to the ventilation hood must be removed. Grease buildup inside the fryer cabinet needs cleaning. Dirt and food debris throughout the rear dish area.

headline: Missing signs; knives and waste receptacle
summary: Passed. No handwashing signage in employee washrooms. Knives stored improperly on prep surfaces. No waste receptacle at handwashing sinks with paper towels. Dust on overhead ventilation throughout. Refrigerator lacks an air thermometer.

headline: Possible pest entry points; dirty bakery
summary: Missing weather stripping at front entrance door. Opening on rear dock door platform is a possible pest entry point. Three-compartment sink in produce prep leaks. Dust, dirt and food debris on bakery and produce cooler surfaces need cleaning.

headline: Rear door not fully rodent-proofed; grease
summary: Re-inspection passed. Rear exit door must be sealed at its 1/4-inch gap at the bottom. Cutting board on main cook line has deep grooves and dark stains. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, coolers, freezers and shelving.

headline: No health policy; no backflow device
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure on premises. No handwashing signage at prep sinks. Mop sink faucet lacks backflow device. Burnt-out light in walk-in cooler. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Public-access cooler and hair restraint issues
summary: Passed. A food cooler in the dining room is accessible to customers and must be removed or locked. Thermometer missing from a small cooler. Bulk containers need product names. Broken cabinet under hand sink. Food handlers need hair restraints.

headline: Leaking tubing; slime on sink caulk
summary: Passed. Slight leak from tubing in cabinet under iced tea machine must be repaired. Black slime buildup on caulk and edges of the three-compartment sink must be removed, cleaned and re-caulked.

headline: Fly tape in dish area; dirty cold-hold units
summary: Passed. Fly tape found in rear dish area; person in charge to remove it and request pest control place an insect control device. Cold-holding units have food debris and residue that must be cleaned.

headline: Openings at front doors; damaged cabinet bases
summary: Passed. Missing handwashing signage at front prep sink. Openings in middle and base of front double doors must be sealed; no pests were found. Damaged cabinet bases and missing floor grout need repair. Two employees lack allergen training proof.

headline: Employee lacks food handler certificate
summary: Food handler without a valid certificate; management told all food handlers must show proof. Certified food manager lacks allergen training certificate. Prior violations uncorrected: raw wood, missing coving, clutter near garbage area and missing hood filters. Citation issued.

headline: Food handler without hair restraint
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. All food handlers must wear hair restraints.

headline: Restroom partition and door closer missing
summary: No partition between the utility sink and washbowl sink in restroom; one must be provided to prevent contamination. Restroom door lacks a self-closing device.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No certified food service manager was on site and no certificate was posted while temperature-controlled foods (steaming milk) were handled and served. Management instructed to obtain one. Priority violation.

headline: No certified manager while handling meat
summary: No certified food service manager on site while chicken and beef were handled and served. Person in charge was instructed to obtain one; priority violation noted.

headline: Food handler without hair restraint
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint and the facility must provide one.

headline: Clay cups need lead-safety documentation
summary: Ceramic or clay drinking cups must be lead-free or lead-safe with documents kept on site, or removed. Vegetables in walk-in cooler were stored in black crates instead of proper containers; manager instructed to correct.

headline: Black slime in both ice machines
summary: Heavy black slime inside both basement ice machines making ice for people; priority citation issued. One employee lacks food handler training; no allergen training on site. Women's restroom lacks handwashing sign; a urinal doesn't flush.

headline: Rear door handle missing; cleaning needed
summary: Rear door handle is missing and must be provided so the door closes properly and keeps pests out. Milk crates used for stock must be replaced with shelving. Cabinets, floors, drains and walls need detail cleaning; loose wall base needs repair.

headline: Meatballs too cool; slimy ice maker
summary: Cooked meatballs measured 79.8–88.8F in hot holding unit (must be 135F+); about 3 lbs discarded. Black slime inside ice maker dripping into ice. No certified food manager present; beef thawed improperly; hand sink lacks handwashing sign.

headline: Kids' default drink over calorie limit
summary: Kids' menu default beverage, chocolate milk at 150 calories, must be under 130 calories. Counter underside needs repair; food debris on counters and cashier shelving must be cleaned; walk-in drain line needs extension to floor drain.

headline: Expired handler certificate; greasy fryers
summary: Greasy fryer bottoms need cleaning. One food handler had an expired training certificate and must get a valid one. All certified managers must obtain required allergen training.

headline: Plumbing leaks and missing backflow device
summary: Mop sink lacks a backflow prevention device. Three-compartment sink faucet leaks heavily and needs repair. Water-stained and damaged ceiling tiles, damaged floor tiles, and a hole in the floor by the front handwashing sink were also noted.

headline: Rat droppings; raw meat above ready foods
summary: Rat droppings in several areas, including about 20 under dish machine and 20 to 30 in basement; pest service recommended. Raw meat and eggs stored above ready-to-eat foods and removed. No certified manager on site initially.

headline: Warm meat discarded; no dish sanitizer
summary: About 22 lbs chicken and beef in reduced-oxygen packaging were held too warm (chicken 48.3F, beef 46.2F) and discarded; no October temperature logs. Dishes washed without sanitizer, must rewash. Black slime dripped from ice machine into ice.

headline: Wall openings, damaged tiles, dusty coolers
summary: Openings in walls, ceilings and along baseboards in sales, storage and basement must be sealed. Damaged floor tiles at front counter must be replaced. Dust on coolers and shelving, and dirty floors under rear sinks and racks, need cleaning.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: Food service sanitation manager had no allergen training certificate. Manager instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: Slime in ice machine; food on floor
summary: Pink and black slime built up inside ice machine along the ice plate; priority citation issued. Uncut lettuce and tomatoes stored directly on walk-in cooler floor; must be 6 inches up. Cleaning tools scattered, making pest checks difficult.

headline: No certified manager; cooler too warm
summary: No certified food manager on site while chicken, beef, pork and fish were prepared and served; person in charge lacks certificate. Walk-in cooler measured 51.8F and was tagged held. No employee health policy or vomit/diarrhea cleanup plan found. Citations issued.

headline: Floor storage, leaking sinks, missing tiles
summary: Boxes and equipment stored on rear dry storage floor and a crate in dishwashing area; elevate 6 inches. Drain leaks at two handsinks; hot water to small storage room handsink was off and must be restored. Missing floor tiles in liquor storage.

headline: Repeat violations from 2024 uncorrected
summary: Violations from 3/29/24 inspection remain uncorrected, including raw wood around utility sink that must be sealed. Core violations also not corrected. Citation issued; manager instructed to comply.

headline: Door gaps and loose toilet-room sink
summary: Small gap between front entry doors and a quarter-inch gap at bottom of back exit door must be sealed to prevent pests. Sink in rear toilet room is coming loose from the wall and must be sealed.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; greasy equipment
summary: No cleanup kit or procedure for vomit or diarrhea events; citation issued. Dumpster lid missing. Heavy grease on fryers, grill and broiler; dirty refrigerator interiors; leak under dish sink; food debris on walls; certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No certified food manager during food service
summary: No certified food manager was present while temperature-controlled foods (breakfast sandwiches, milk) were prepared and served. Citation issued; management told one must always be present. Also torn cooler gaskets and a loose sink faucet.

headline: No written employee health policy
summary: No written employee health policy was on premises. Management must provide a signed policy for each employee and maintain it; priority violation.

headline: No certified food manager while open
summary: No certified food manager was on site while the restaurant was open and operating; citation issued. Food handlers lacked hair restraints in prep areas, and certified managers have no allergen training certificate on site.

headline: Live flies near pastries; no certified manager
summary: About 25 live small flying insects near pastries and equipment in front prep area and dining walls. No certified food manager while smoked salmon and milk drinks were served. Dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and no sanitizer test kit.

headline: Grease buildup in kitchen and prep
summary: Grease buildup found on cooking equipment, walls, surrounding floors and shelving in kitchen and prep areas. Manager instructed to degrease, clean and sanitize.

headline: Walk-in cooler at 90F; no health policy
summary: Walk-in cooler measured 90.0F; must be repaired and kept at 41F or colder. No written employee health policy on premises. Also: missing ice bin covers, washroom ventilation not working, and certified manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Handwash water too cold; fixed on site
summary: Women's restroom handwashing sink water measured 68F; hot water must be at least 100F. Citation issued. Sink was serviced during inspection and now reaches 100F.

headline: Warm potatoes discarded; dish machine tagged out
summary: Cooked potatoes at 48.6–58.3F discarded. High-temperature dish machine final rinse reached only 115.7F; tagged out of use. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure. Handsinks lacked paper towels, supplied during inspection.

headline: No certified manager; no handwashing soap
summary: Person in charge lacked a valid certified food manager certificate while rice, beans, steak and pork were prepared; citation issued. No handwashing soap at rear prep sink, also cited. No food handler certificates for any employee.

headline: Drain backup; handwash water too hot
summary: Waste water backs up from floor drain under dish sink; staff told to stop washing dishes there until a plumber fixes it. Hand sink water hit 130.2F; required range is 100–120F, citation issued. Soiled mop heads improperly stored.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit cleanup kit
summary: No certified food manager on site while coffee drinks with milk and cream were made and served; citation issued. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit or written procedures. Sanitizer test kit missing; ice bin uncovered; wet mop left in hallway.

headline: Leaking faucets, milk crates, missing signs
summary: Loose faucet handles leak at three sinks; a bakery handsink drains slowly. Milk crates used as shelving in produce cooler must be replaced; freezer door gasket damaged. Missing handwashing sign, missing cooler thermometer, and debris along walls also noted.

headline: No handwashing signs in restrooms
summary: Employee restrooms had no handwashing signs. Manager instructed to post them.

headline: Walk-in too warm; 75 lbs deli meat discarded
summary: About 75 lbs sliced deli meat in walk-in cooler measured 49–57F; discarded. Walk-in air at 57F while holding chicken, tuna and deli meat; cooler tagged and must be repaired to 41F or below. Beverage dispenser leak and dusty prep vents.

headline: Damaged floor tiles; ice bin needs cleaning
summary: Ice bin interior needed cleaning. Missing floor grout and damaged floor tiles in butcher shop, rear dish, rear prep and warehouse must be repaired. Certified food manager has no allergen training proof.

headline: Dish machine dispensing no sanitizer; tagged
summary: Chlorine dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer after several tries; tagged and not to be used until repaired and reinspected. Use the three-compartment sink instead; citation issued. Slow-draining bar handsink and leaking dish sink faucet also need repair.

headline: Rodent droppings; cooler too warm; food discarded
summary: About 20–25 large rodent droppings found under equipment, the three-compartment sink and along a wall; extra pest service needed. Rear cooler at 55.4F; about 35 lbs of food discarded and cooler tagged out of use. Gap at rear screen door.

headline: Dirty utensils; no food handler certificates
summary: All utensils needed detail cleaning and sanitizing before use; wiping cloths left on prep tables. No food handler training certificates found. Ceiling leak in front of walk-in freezer must be repaired; coolers and surfaces need detail cleaning.

headline: Cook lacks training; prior violations uncorrected
summary: Cook lacks food handler training proof; managers lack allergen training proof. Prior violations not corrected: missing handwashing signs, peeling ceiling paint, wall holes; citation issued. Unscreened outdoor kitchen window needs mesh screen.

headline: Floor tiles need regrouting
summary: Floor tiles by the three-compartment sink have low grout and must be regrouted and maintained.

headline: Clogged handwashing sink; grease and debris
summary: Dish-area handwashing sink clogged and not draining; priority citation issued. Also grease and food debris in fryer oil filter, under a prep cooler, and on floors along walls in utility and storage areas.

headline: Mop sink backflow device in poor repair
summary: Backflow prevention device on the mop sink is in poor repair and must be repaired and maintained.

headline: No food handler training; no health policy
summary: No food handler training for any employees, no employee health policy, and no vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure or kit on site; citations issued. Manager lacks allergen training. Coffee and espresso machines lack backflow devices.

headline: No hair restraint; missing handler training
summary: Food handler preparing food without a hair restraint. No proof of food handler training for 1/2 food employees; certificates must be kept on site.

headline: Dish machine not reaching sanitizing temperature
summary: High-temperature dish machine did not reach 180F in final rinse for sanitizing. Machine was not in use during inspection; priority violation noted with no citation issued.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged out
summary: High-temperature dish machine final rinse reached only 120F with no chemical sanitizer, while in use. Machine tagged as not allowed to use until repaired and the city health department contacted. Deli cups used as scoops; dust on walk-in cooler fan covers.

headline: Dirty cooler racks; wet cooler floor
summary: Racks in shared walk-in cooler had food debris and must be cleaned. Floor of walk-in cooler had standing water and must be kept clean and dry.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training proof
summary: City of Chicago food service manager had no proof of allergen training on site. Must provide proof for all city-certified managers.

headline: Unlabeled containers; soiled wiping cloths
summary: Bulk containers of flour, seasonings and chicken breading were unlabeled; common names required. Spoiled wiping cloths were stored on prep tables and chest freezers between uses; must be kept in sanitizing solution.

headline: Restroom door closer and wall repairs
summary: Restroom door must have a self-closing device. Damaged wall outside the toilet room and at the mop sink must be repaired or replaced. Both are building upkeep items.

headline: Fly strips in prep area; certificate issues
summary: Fly strips hung in rear food prep area must be removed. Employee lacked hair restraint; a food handler lacks proof of training; certified managers have expired allergen certificates. Cutting board needs replacing; toilet room trash lacks lid.

headline: Unsealed rear door; holes open to pests
summary: Rear exit door not sealed all around; must seal to block pests. Holes in floor under waiting-area benches and a rear storage wall must be sealed. Also leaking pipe under the three-compartment sink, dirty fryer filter, and freezer ice buildup.

headline: Ice machine connected to sink without backflow
summary: Ice machine water line is connected to the three-compartment sink, and no backflow prevention device was present. Person in charge must provide one to prevent possible contamination.

headline: Handwashing signs added; ice machine backflow missing
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at prep and bar handsinks and were provided during inspection. Ice machine water line has no backflow prevention device; one must be installed where it can be serviced.

headline: Cracked floor tiles; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Basement prep area floor tiles are cracked and missing and must be repaired for a cleanable surface. Certified food manager has no allergen training; all certified managers must complete it.

headline: Front doors not rodent-proof; ceiling falling
summary: Front double doors have a gap and are not rodent-proof; it must be enclosed. Ceiling peels and falls to the floor. Large hole in rear room floor needs enclosing. No outside trash bin in place; proof of trash-removal contract required.

headline: Door gaps, beer drain in sink, torn gasket
summary: Kitchen and basement storage doors have bottom gaps that must be sealed against pests. Beer drain line empties into a sink and must be rerouted to a floor drain. Also torn cooler gasket and missing handwashing signs.

headline: Cold foods too warm; refrigerator out of use
summary: Beef at 53F, fish at 51F and chicken at 50F in upright refrigerator were too warm; 10 lbs discarded. Unit must not be used until reinspected by the city. Uncovered food, wet wiping cloths and ice buildup also noted.

headline: Rear door gap; missing backflow device
summary: Rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap at bottom and must be rodent-proofed. Backflow device on bar ice machine could not be located. Toilet rooms lack a covered receptacle; basement is cluttered and must be cleared and items raised 6 inches.

headline: Cooler too warm; about 30 lbs discarded
summary: Eggs (45.1F), sausage (48.1F) and beef (50.2F) in rear line cooler were too warm; about 30 lbs discarded. Rear line and front reach-in coolers tagged; cooler in poor repair. Also knife stored between equipment, foil liners, dirty floor tile gaps.

headline: Bare-hand food contact; warm cooler food discarded
summary: Food handler touched ready-to-eat muffins bare-handed; discarded. Shrimp dumplings (56.4F) and raw trout (49–51.1F) in reach-in cooler too warm; about 5 lbs discarded. About 25 cigarette butts found in basement; citation issued.

headline: Broken dining room floor tiles
summary: Several broken floor tiles in dining room and hallway to kitchen must be replaced and regrouted. Shelves below kitchen prep table need cleaning.

headline: Wet cloths on tables; icy, dirty floors
summary: Wet wiping cloths left on prep tables and cooks line; must be kept in sanitizing solution. Excess ice on walk-in freezer floor and food debris on prep and cook line floors must be cleaned.

headline: No vomit cleanup plan; door gaps and holes
summary: No written procedures or supplies for vomit and diarrhea cleanup; priority violation, no citation. Quarter-inch gaps at rear and front doors must be sealed against pests, and holes around pipes and walls need sealing. Utility sink lacks backflow device.

headline: No posted manager certificate; missing thermometers
summary: No valid City of Chicago food service sanitation manager certificate was posted on site; citation issued. Reach-in and display coolers lack air thermometers. Cardboard on floors and crates used as shelving need removal.

headline: Menu gap corrected on site; shelving issues
summary: Menu lacked asterisks marking cook-to-order animal foods; corrected on site. Containers and crates used as elevation in upstairs and downstairs walk-in coolers must be replaced with shelving. Also no covered trash in washroom, basement clutter, dusty condenser fans.

headline: Menu lacks raw food consumer advisory
summary: Menu had a reminder footnote but no asterisks marking raw or undercooked animal-based items such as salmon and burgers. Both disclosure and reminder must be provided; no citation issued.

headline: Freezer floor debris; dusty cooking equipment
summary: Walk-in freezer floor had debris and possible frozen spills; dust on cooking equipment; rear storage corners dusty. Utility sink wall covering missing, leaving an opening pests could use. Staff told to clean and repair.

headline: Utility sink lacks backflow device
summary: Utility sink in rear storage area has no backflow prevention device. Management instructed to install and maintain one.

headline: Personal food stored in coolers; labeling gaps
summary: Personal food stored in walk-in cooler, prep cooler and rear storage; employees need a designated area. Reach-in and display coolers lack air thermometers. Unlabeled containers, uninverted plates and cardboard liner in rear cooler also noted.

headline: Oversized pots need written washing procedure
summary: No handwashing signage at preparation areas; must be provided. Pots too large for three-compartment sink; a written procedure for washing and sanitizing them is required, including wash temperatures, sanitizer strength and wastewater disposal.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; expired handler training
summary: Torn gaskets on coolers throughout the facility must be repaired or replaced. Three food employees had expired food handler training; records must be kept on site.

headline: Rice reheated too slowly; cook lacks training
summary: About 5 lbs of prior-day cooked rice were reheating slowly at 100.7F in a hot holding cooker; discarded, citation issued. Cook lacks food handler training proof. Wok line floor grease from a prior inspection still uncorrected; handsink leaks.

headline: No certified manager on duty during food prep
summary: Person in charge lacked a certified food manager certificate, and no certified manager was on duty while chicken, rice, beans and steak were prepared; citation issued. Also no backflow device on ice machine, worn cooler gaskets and stained cutting boards.

headline: Door gap, mold-like buildup, burnt-out lights
summary: Quarter-inch gap at bottom of front doors; seal to prevent pests. Mold-like buildup on walk-in cooler racks must be cleaned. Also needs splash guard, rusted racks, stained cutting boards and a replaced burnt-out bulb.

headline: Expired prepared foods discarded; training records missing
summary: Prepared foods past their dates (cooked beans, tomato soup, lobster dressing) were discarded; priority citation issued. Dish machine lacked a temperature indicator. No food handler training proof for an employee; no allergen training proof for managers.

headline: Wall splatters and blown hood bulbs
summary: Splatters on prep-area wall near chest freezer must be cleaned. Blown light bulbs in hood system must be replaced.

headline: Slimy ice machine; no manager present
summary: Thick black and pink slime dripping into ice machine's ice. Cooked rice held over 24 hours unlabeled; 10 lbs discarded. No person in charge or certified food manager present during food service. Citations issued.

headline: Floor cleaning and beverage leak
summary: Floors behind slushy machine and beverage dispenser near drive-thru need cleaning, with slight debris along wall bases. A leak from plastic cords near beverage dispenser by rear exit must be repaired.

headline: Food handler certificates not verifiable
summary: Food handler certificates could not be located or verified on site; must be provided and kept there. Food debris on rear prep shelving, grease traps, baking prep floors and walk-in cooler interior must be cleaned; hood has dust.

headline: Unsealed wood in beverage storage
summary: Multiple wooden fixtures and pillars in rear beverage storage area are unsealed; must be sealed to be smooth and easily cleanable.

headline: Expired food handler certificates for multiple employees
summary: Multiple employees had expired food handler certificates; records must be updated. Cutting boards with open seams and stains in rear prep must be refinished or replaced. Greasy, rusty shelving and an improperly stored wet wiping cloth also noted.

headline: Pest control records missing
summary: Pest control logbook not kept on site. Last recorded pest service by Ecolab was 8/23, with no other proof within a year. Facility must keep a licensed exterminator contract providing service at least twice yearly; citation issued.

headline: Hand sinks lacked soap and paper towels
summary: Hand sinks lacked paper towels and soap; management supplied both during inspection. Citation issued. Also: no thermometers in two coolers, torn cooler gaskets from a prior inspection still unrepaired, and slow-draining hand sinks.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; food stored on floor
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings found on floors, display shelves, cardboard boxes and along walls and corners in prep, storage, washroom and sales areas; exterminator required; citation issued. Food stored on floor; no sanitizer test kit.

headline: Employees eating at prep area; food on floor
summary: Employees drank and ate at the prep area; a designated break area is required. Food containers on floors in prep, storage and walk-in cooler must be raised 6 inches. Also a torn cooler gasket, leaking faucet and cracked wall.

headline: Clean utensils near trash; dirty drain
summary: Clean customer utensils placed beside trash receptacle; must be removed or protected. Cake spatulas stored between piping and wall; floor drain left of 3-compartment sink has dirt buildup to clean.

headline: Grease and dirt buildup in multiple areas
summary: Walk-in cooler racks and floors need detail cleaning. Grease, food debris and dirt found under cooking equipment, along walls and in corners of prep, dishwashing and storage areas. Dust on cooler fan, light shields and vents; told to clean.

headline: Uncovered food in prep cooler
summary: Food item stored uncovered in prep cooler; a cover or lid must be provided. All-gender washrooms also lack a covered waste receptacle.

headline: Cooked chicken and potatoes stored too warm
summary: About 6 lbs cooked chicken (73.5F) and 10 lbs potatoes (73F) stored on front counter were too warm; owner discarded 16 lbs. Initial temperatures not recorded. Also needs splash guard, cooler gasket repair, rust repair and grease cleanup.

headline: Door opening; espresso machine backflow missing
summary: Opening at base of front double doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. No backflow prevention device found on espresso machine. Dust buildup on hood filters; manager told to clean.

headline: Food stored on floor; greasy fryer area
summary: Boxed food stored on floor near rear exit door; must be raised 6 inches. Food debris on walk-in freezer floor and grease under deep fryers in rear prep area must be cleaned. Certified food manager lacks allergen awareness training.

headline: No employee health policy on site
summary: No employee health policy or training found on site; must be set up with documents kept on site. Priority violation. Also a 1/4-inch gap under the front door and a staff washroom door lacking a self-closing device.

headline: No certified manager; dish machine tagged out
summary: Person in charge lacked original certificate while preparing food; citation issued. High-temperature dish machine failed 180F final rinse and was tagged; use the three-compartment sink. Floor drains backed up with clear water until a plumber cleared them.

headline: Live flies and beetles; no certified manager
summary: About 40–50 live black flies in chicken prep area, on sauce boxes, and in rear prep and storage; about 35 black beetles under dish sink. No certified food manager with proof on site; no signed employee health policies.

headline: Dusty ceiling tiles above oven
summary: Ceiling tiles above the oven in rear kitchen are soiled with dust and debris. Manager instructed to clean ceilings and facilities regularly to prevent buildup.

headline: No hair restraints; dripping sink sprayer
summary: Food handlers in prep area were not wearing hair restraints. Sprayer on three-compartment sink drips heavily and must be fixed. Cracked lower surface of basement refrigerator must be fixed or replaced; mop not stored hanging.

headline: Cracked cheese container in walk-in
summary: Cracked, damaged plastic container holding shredded cheese in walk-in cooler must be replaced.

headline: No thermometer; unlabeled food; pushcart unmarked
summary: No metal-stem thermometer was available. Food items had no labels and were not individually wrapped. The pushcart lacked a license number and business name, which must be at least two inches tall on its lateral sides.

headline: Passed; cooler lids, backflow cap, restroom bin
summary: Passed re-inspection. Pizza-line cooler lids were detached from hinges and did not seal; the utility sink backflow device was missing its cap but works; the women's restroom lacked a covered sanitary-product bin.

headline: To-go containers not inverted; grease spills
summary: Passed. To-go containers at the sushi bar must be stored inverted. Minor grease spills on the floor under the grill must be cleaned. One certified manager's allergen training certificate was missing.

headline: Food on floor; torn gasket; water-damaged ceiling
summary: Passed. Boxed food on the floor near the rear stove must be raised six inches. Soiled wiping cloths were left on prep tables and must be kept in sanitizer. A torn refrigerator gasket, food debris in cold-holding equipment, and water-damaged ceiling panels.

headline: No certified manager; no HACCP plan for vacuum packing
summary: No certified food manager on site while handling TCS foods; cited. No approved HACCP plan or variance for vacuum packaging or sous vide; the machine is tagged and not to be used. Orange film inside the ice machine; food handler lacked hair restraint; no allergen certificate.

headline: Sink seals broken; no food handler certificate
summary: Passed. A food handler had no certificate on site. The certified manager lacked allergen training. Three-compartment sink seals were broken and leaking. Water-damaged dining-room ceiling tiles, rust on the grease trap, and foil on tables.

headline: Dried debris under grill and in basement
summary: Passed. Prep-table shelves need cleaning. Dried food debris under the flat-top grill. Basement prep floors have dried debris around bakery equipment, freezers and carts; removal ordered to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Hand-washing lapses, unsafe temperatures, dish machine failed
summary: Dishwasher handled dirty, then clean, dishes without washing hands; an employee washed during inspection. Dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm; technician repaired it to 100 ppm. Hot-held meatballs (100°F), potatoes (118.9°F) and coleslaw (49.2°F) discarded. Many upkeep issues.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food; expired training
summary: The person in charge has no certified food manager certificate. No certified manager or posted certificate while Italian beef, turkey and meatballs were handled; cited. No hand sink in main prep or ice cream prep; gap at front door; expired food handler training.

headline: Missing hand-wash signs; greasy fryers; dirty floors
summary: Passed. No hand-washing signs at two front bar sinks. Cardboard used as shelf liners, grease on deep fryers, and dirty floors along prep-area walls. Unused freezers and a slicer stored in the basement should be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: No certified manager; handler skipped handwashing
summary: No certified food service manager or posted certificate while beef and chicken were handled and served; instructed to obtain one. A food handler wiped a floor spill, changed gloves and returned to food production without washing hands; priority violation.

headline: Items above dish sink; plastic bags in coolers
summary: Passed. Clean utensils and pots were stored above the dirty dish sink and must be moved. Plastic grocery bags used as food containers in coolers; cardboard under the microwave; ice buildup; unused broken grill to be removed; personal belongings in prep area.

headline: Missing hand-wash signs; no hair restraints
summary: Passed. No hand-washing signs in three washrooms. Employees were not wearing hair restraints while preparing food. No covered waste receptacle in the employee washroom. Dirt on walls, openings around ceiling pipes, and a missing light shield.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; roach spray stored
summary: The low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine; 50 ppm is required. Unit tagged, not to be used until reinspected; cited. Roach fogger and ant spray stored in rear prep; must be removed. Missing hand soap and paper towels; no health policy; no training proof.

headline: No pest logbook; backflow devices and utility sink missing
summary: No pest control logbook was available, as city code requires. Backflow devices were not located at the ice machine. A new establishment had no utility sink; one with hot and cold water and a backflow device must be installed. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No valid manager certificate; unlabeled chemical
summary: No valid food sanitation manager certificate was on site or posted; cited. A chemical in an unlabeled spray bottle by the three-compartment sink; label added during inspection; cited. Mislabeled dry storage containers; drainboard needed; prior summary not posted.

headline: Hard-to-read dish machine gauge; ice buildup
summary: Passed. The water-temperature gauge at the pot and pan dish machine is hard to read and must be repaired or replaced. Ice buildup on the wall under the condenser in the walk-in freezer must be removed.

headline: Employee restroom lacks covered trash receptacle
summary: Passed. The rear employee toilet room had no covered trash receptacle. The person in charge was instructed to provide one.

headline: Restroom hot water too cool; sleeping quarters on site
summary: Restroom hand-sink hot water reached only 56°F; 100°F is required; cited. Dishes stored on the floor. A room opening to the dining room had a mattress, pillows and belongings; sleeping quarters are prohibited. Cited.

headline: Food stored on floor; hair restraints missing
summary: Passed. Food containers were stored on the floor in the rear storage area and must be raised at least six inches. Food handlers were prepping food without hair restraints; the manager was told to require them.

headline: No food handler or allergen training certificates
summary: Passed. No food handler training certificates were on site and must be provided. No allergen training certificates for certified food managers. The toilet room was cluttered with equipment, shoes and mops.

headline: Employee restroom lacks covered sanitary bin
summary: Passed. The employee washroom had no covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. The facility was instructed to provide one.

headline: Rear door gap needs repair
summary: Passed re-inspection. The rear door had about 1/4-inch gaps at the top and bottom, so it was not protected against pests. It must be repaired so it fits tightly.

headline: Ice machine black residue; food stored uncovered
summary: Black substance inside the ice machine; ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned and sanitized; cited. Food stored uncovered in freezer and coolers and on floors; foil used as food covers; scoops stored inside containers; mops improperly stored; no covered receptacle in employee washroom.

headline: Loose mop sink corners; dirty drain and floors
summary: Passed re-inspection. Loose corners around the mop sink wall must be repaired. The floor drain in the front food prep area must be cleaned, along with the floor under the two-compartment sink and ice machine.

headline: Person in charge and manager certificates missing
summary: The person in charge lacked a City of Chicago food service sanitation certificate. No certified food service manager was on site while soups, tofu, salmon and chicken were prepared and served; cited.

headline: Manager allergen training certificate expired
summary: Passed. The certified manager's allergen training certificate had expired. The manager was instructed to get updated training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: No certified manager 8:15–9:05 a.m.; summary not posted
summary: No certified manager was on site from 8:15 to 9:05 a.m. while chicken and beef were prepared and served; cited. A manager lacked allergen training. The prior inspection summary was not posted for public view; cited.

headline: Cold food at 59–69°F; cooler at 68°F tagged
summary: Cold foods held at 59–69°F in a two-door refrigerator, including prosciutto (67°F), salsas (68–69°F), and cooked steak and chicken; about $150 discarded. The unit was tagged and must be repaired. Broken glass and coffee spills on the second floor.

headline: No signed health policies; entry door gaps
summary: Passed with conditions. No signed employee health policies on site; these must be provided and kept. A gap along the bottom and sides of the revolving entry door in the north kitchen must be repaired so it fits tightly.

headline: Missing mini-fridge thermometer; unlabeled bottles
summary: Passed re-inspection. No ambient air thermometer inside the mini refrigerator in the front prep area. Squirt bottles and a bulk butter container were unlabeled and must be labeled.

headline: Dirty ice machine interior; freezer ice buildup
summary: Black substance on the ice machine interior and chute; ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned and sanitized; cited. Pizza freezer interior had excessive ice buildup that must be removed.

headline: No certified manager during chicken; thawing unsafe
summary: No certified food manager on premises while chicken (140°F) was prepared and served; cited. Frozen meat was thawed in the prep sink improperly and must be thawed under cold running water. Gap between garbage-area doors; a backflow device leaks under the sink.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; no allergen certificates
summary: Passed. Prep-area bulk containers were unlabeled and must be labeled. Litter on the basement floor under shelving must be cleaned. No allergen training certificates on premises for certified food managers.

headline: Missing hand-wash signs; broken floor tile
summary: Passed re-inspection. No hand-washing signs in the dining-area restrooms; signs must be provided and maintained. Broken and missing floor tile near the three-compartment sink must be repaired to be smooth and cleanable.

headline: Syrup buildup; leaking three-compartment faucet
summary: Passed. Syrup built up under the soda dispenser; the three-compartment sink faucet leaks and keeps running when shut off; repair ordered. The certified manager has no allergen training.

headline: Certified managers lack allergen training proof
summary: Passed. No proof of allergen training was available for certified food managers. This was the only item noted.

headline: Cold-holding unit residue; no restroom receptacle
summary: Passed. Residue built up inside the cold-holding unit. The unisex restroom had no covered receptacle. An opening in the wall under the three-compartment sink must be closed and repaired. Vent near the furnace greasy.

headline: Raw meat at unsafe temperatures; many violations
summary: Raw beef at 60.3°F and raw chicken at 69.8°F sat in sink water; cooked and raw proteins at 58–69°F; about 45 lbs (about $388) discarded; cited. Thawing in standing water; raw meat stored on floor; no hair restraints; prior violations uncorrected.

headline: Condenser ice buildup; cluttered storage; dirty hood
summary: Passed. Ice buildup on walk-in cooler condensers must be removed. The first-floor storage room is cluttered; items must be raised off the floor or removed. Food debris and dust on the ventilation hood and filters must be cleaned.

headline: Broken freezer seal, dirty racks, greasy floors
summary: Passed. A reach-in freezer was held shut with a knife; its gasket was torn and the interior broken, exposing insulation; repair ordered. Also food-encrusted cooler racks, cardboard liners, a broken restroom receptacle lid, and greasy floors.

headline: Broken freezer gasket needs repair
summary: Passed. The two-door reach-in freezer in the kitchen has a broken rubber gasket and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Dirty floors; summary report not posted properly
summary: Passed with conditions. Floors under carbon dioxide tanks had black residue; food debris on the walk-in cooler floor; deep cleaning ordered. An old inspection report was posted over the summary; the new summary was posted and must stay visible. Cited.

headline: Ice scoop left in standing water; rough wall
summary: Passed. An ice cream scoop was held in standing water at room temperature and must be stored per code. The wall behind the prep table and griddle is unfinished cinder block and needs a smooth, cleanable surface.

headline: Dirty floors and drains around cooking equipment
summary: Passed. Floors around cooking equipment must be cleaned to remove spills and debris. Floor drains must be cleaned where needed to remove organic matter.

headline: No certified manager during hamburgers and shrimp
summary: No certified food manager with a certificate was on site while hamburgers and shrimp were prepared and served; cited. Unlabeled bulk dry-storage containers; employees without hair restraints; foil lining refrigerator shelves; dirty floors and clutter.

headline: No certified manager while ground beef served
summary: No certified manager or posted certificate was present while ground beef (150.9°F) was prepared and served; cited. Missing hand sink in deli prep; a 1/4-inch door gap; no stoppers; milk crates used as shelves; no hair restraints or food handler training.

headline: Missing hand-wash signs; greasy kitchen; no backflow
summary: Passed. Missing hand-wash signage at kitchen prep sink. Frozen foods stored in plastic grocery bags; cardboard used as liners; grease on cooking equipment, walls, floors and shelves. Mop sink faucet lacks a backflow prevention device.

headline: No health policy, vomit kit, or training records
summary: No verifiable employee health policy, no vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit, and no food handler or allergen training records were on site. Grease trap leaked wastewater onto the food prep floor; repair ordered. Soiled mop heads and a burnt-out basement light.

headline: No vomit/diarrhea cleanup supplies; dumpster open
summary: No supplies for vomit or diarrhea cleanup, which must include a norovirus-effective sanitizer; cited. Outdoor dumpster lid was open with trash bags on the ground; cited. Soda crates used as freezer shelves; damaged floor tiles in the dry storage dish area.

headline: Grease, debris, expired food handler training
summary: Passed. Repair the damaged walk-in cooler door gasket. Clean grease and food debris from hot holding, fryers, cooler shelves and floors. Replace missing ceiling tiles and loose wall panels. Some employees have expired food handler training.

headline: Rear door not sealed; dirty dry-storage floors
summary: Passed. The rear exit door does not seal at the bottom and needs better weather stripping to prevent pests from entering. Floors along the walls and in corners of the dry storage rooms need cleaning to remove spills and debris.

headline: Dusty hood filters on second floor
summary: Passed. Dust on hood filters above the second-floor cookline must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Additional hand sink needed; trash behind equipment
summary: Front food prep area needs an additional hand sink; priority violation, no citation. Trash and food debris behind the ice maker and three-compartment sink must be cleaned. Employees' purses were stored on top of food containers and must be moved.

headline: Cold food unsafe; walk-in cooler tagged out
summary: Several cold foods in the small prep walk-in cooler measured 48.7–54°F, above the 41°F limit. About 85 lbs (about $1,000) discarded on site. The cooler ran at 56°F, so it was tagged and must not be used until repaired and reinspected.

headline: No soap at front and rear hand sinks
summary: Hand sinks in front and rear prep areas had no soap; cited. Floors along walls and under cooking equipment were greasy and littered with debris; cleaning ordered.

headline: Rusty walk-in shelving; restroom door needs closer
summary: Passed re-inspection. Rusty food storage shelving inside the walk-in cooler must be repainted or replaced. The unisex restroom needs a self-closing door device.

headline: Grimy floor drain under sink
summary: Passed re-inspection. Grime built up in the floor drain under the one-compartment sink. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Live pet dog inside food establishment
summary: A live pet dog was inside the establishment; only service animals are allowed. The customer with the dog left during inspection. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Food on floor; greasy equipment; items not inverted
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food stored on the floor in prep and walk-in areas must be raised six inches. Single-use items not inverted; damaged prep-cooler door gasket; food debris and grease on woks, fryers, prep tables and coolers. No valid allergen training for a certified manager.

headline: Front door not rodent-proof; deep-cut cutting boards
summary: Passed. The front door is not rodent-proof and needs a tight seal. Utensils stored between the wall and reach-in cooler; cutting boards deeply cut; leaking hand-sink faucet; food spills on shelves and floors; dusty air vents.

headline: No pH testing for sushi rice; hair restraints missing
summary: No proof of pH testing or testing tools for sushi rice, a cited priority violation. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Soiled linens were drying on a sink splash guard. Also a missing ceiling tile, dirty floors, and an uncorrected prior food-handler certificate violation.

headline: Front hand sink blocked; no cooler thermometer
summary: The front cashier/prep hand sink was covered with a plastic bag and unusable; cited. No thermometer in the three-door cooler. Onions stored on the walk-in floor; heavy grime on shelves; missing baseboard; a light out over the hood; employee restroom door not self-closing.

headline: Worker handled cup without washing hands
summary: A food handler took orders, swept the floor, then handled a customer's cup without washing hands; cited. No hand dryer at the rear prep sink; paper towels were present. Dumpster overflowing with bags, lids open; cited. Greasy floors and walls.

headline: No cooler thermometer; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: Passed. No thermometer in the rear reach-in cooler. Some bulk containers in rear storage were unlabeled. Ice scoop and tongs rested on ice and limes; must be stored with handles up. Leaking faucet on the rear three-compartment sink.

headline: Damaged prep-cooler gaskets; debris; stained ceiling
summary: Passed. Damaged gaskets on prep coolers must be repaired or replaced; food debris and spills inside the gaskets must be cleaned. Stained ceiling tiles in prep and storage areas must be replaced. No food handler training available for employees.

headline: Items on floor; dusty vents; stained ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. Single-use items were not inverted and were stored on the basement floor. Ice buildup inside a smoothie-prep refrigerator. Dust on washroom vents; debris along walls in prep and basement; stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Deli meats undated; front door gap; rust
summary: Rewrapped deli meats, ham, turkey and souse lacked date marks; cited. A 1/4-inch gap on the front door; single-use items not inverted; rust on meat-cooler shelves; no stoppers for rear sink; insufficient hot water at multiple sinks; cited.

headline: Broken drywall under counter needs repair
summary: Passed. Broken drywall under a counter area must be repaired so the surface is smooth and easily cleanable.

headline: Unlabeled dry containers; training gaps
summary: Passed. White bulk dry-storage containers lacked product-name labels. One of two food handlers lacked a food handler certificate; new hires must be certified within 30 days. The manager had no allergen training certificate.

headline: Rat droppings found; no certified manager on duty
summary: Over 10 rat droppings were found under shelving near the two-compartment sink at the rear; cited. Detailed cleaning and pest treatment ordered. No certified manager with a current certificate was on duty while sandwiches, chicken and pizza were prepared; cited.

headline: Three-compartment sink not usable; soiled shelves
summary: The three-compartment sink used to wash dishes was not fully working: one faucet missing, the other cannot fill one compartment. Cited. Bakery shelves heavily soiled; hand-sink faucet in salad prep very loose.

headline: Leaks, torn freezer gasket, improper storage
summary: Passed. Employee medicine bottles were stored improperly; a torn gasket on a walk-in freezer door; a leak under the front three-compartment sink; cracked floor tiles trapping water; maintenance tools stored on the ice machine.

headline: Dirty microwaves, freezers and hood; leaking bar sink
summary: Passed. Torn cooler door gasket. Microwaves, freezers, cooler exteriors and hood filters are dirty with grease and food. Bar hand sink leaks; women's restroom sink has low cold-water pressure. Floors, including bar floor drains, need deep cleaning.

headline: Cooler at 78°F; cold food at 52°F discarded
summary: Cheese and burger patties held at 52°F; about 10 lbs of patties and 6 lbs of cheese (about $30) discarded; cited. Cooler ambient air at 78°F; cooler tagged, cited. Copper pipe above the three-compartment sink leaks; mineral buildup inside the ice machine.

headline: Ice machine lacks visible backflow device
summary: Passed. The ice machine water line had no visible backflow prevention device; the manager must install one. The women's restroom had no covered trash receptacle.

headline: Blocked hand sink; cardboard, floors, leaking faucet
summary: A rear hand sink was blocked by cardboard stored inside it; the employee removed it during inspection; cited. Boxed food stored on the walk-in cooler floor, cardboard shelf liners, a leaking three-compartment sink faucet, and dirty floors.

headline: Items on office floor; raw wood under wok line
summary: Passed. Stored items in the office must be raised off the floor for cleaning. Raw wood used to raise equipment on the wok line must be replaced with smooth, cleanable material. The hood above the wok line has excessive dripping grease.

headline: No valid manager certificate; no three-compartment sink
