summary: The person in charge lacked a valid original food manager certificate; must be posted on site. The toilet-room hand sink lacked signage. The facility lacks a three-compartment sink for washing, rinsing and sanitizing utensils; priority violation.

headline: Bar hand sink disconnected; rear dish area lacks sink
summary: No hand sink was accessible to the rear dish area; an additional hand sink with hot and cold water must be installed at the front line. Bar hand sink was disconnected during repairs; cited. Spices in unlabeled containers.

headline: Flies, cold food at 46–52°F, sink failures
summary: More than 20 flies were found, including in the kitchen, dry storage and dish areas; pest service recommended; cited. Cold food held at 46–52°F; about $200 of product discarded. Five coolers ran at 46–52°F; cited. Three-compartment sink floods.

headline: Duct tape on cooler; discolored cutting board
summary: Passed. The bottom of the rear walk-in cooler was taped with duct tape; repair required. A cutting board in the prep cooler is discolored and must be cleaned or replaced. Floors along walls and under equipment need cleaning.

headline: Tomatoes and cottage cheese at 50°F discarded
summary: Sliced tomatoes and cottage cheese were held at 50°F; the manager discarded the entire lunch line. A cooler in the employee cafeteria ran at 46°F; a technician serviced it on site; cited.

headline: No certified manager; flies; no pest logbook
summary: No certified food manager on premises; cited. About 45 small flies were found, including in the dish area and beverage station; cited. No pest control logbook. No food handler training proof for any handler; no allergen certificate; mold-like substance inside the ice machine.

headline: No certified manager; no hot water at sinks
summary: No valid food manager certificate was on site while Italian beef and sandwiches were prepared; cited. The three-compartment sink and hand sinks had no hot running water; cited. No food handler certificates, no licensed pest service or logbook.

headline: Manager certificate not posted; labeling issues
summary: No certified food manager certificate was posted for customers; cited. Hand-washing sign missing at the front prep sink. Bulk food containers unlabeled, single-use items stored on the floor, and a dirty floor drain under the three-compartment sink.

headline: Missing menu disclosure, fixed on site; gaps
summary: Menu lacked a disclosure that animal foods marked with an asterisk are served cooked to order; corrected on site. Openings at the base of two exit doors and dining-area glass doors must be sealed. Backflow devices missing on several utility sinks, the coffee machine and the ice machine.

headline: Hot and cold holding failures; no hot water
summary: No certified manager during hot dog prep; cited. Chicken and pizza in hot holding at 118.9–125.3°F; about $13 discarded. Grab-and-go cooler at 51°F held yogurt and chicken at 51.6–56.7°F; about $1,000 discarded. No hot water facility-wide; cited.

headline: No health policy; ice machine mold; dead thermometer
summary: No employee health policy on site. Black mold-like substance inside the ice machine, which is used for drinks. The probe thermometer had dead batteries. No sanitizer test strips on site. The certified manager lacks allergen training; pest logbook lacks license number.

headline: Dirty chip shelves and cooler floors; ceiling tile
summary: Passed. Bottom chip display shelves need detailed cleaning. Walk-in cooler walls around the fans are dusty. Floors under cooler shelving and chip display are dirty. The ceiling tile above the walk-in cooler is in poor repair and must be replaced.

headline: Manager certificate shown only as phone photo
summary: Manager certificate was shown as a cell-phone photo; the original must be on site. Restroom had no hot water and hand sinks lacked hot water; cited. No probe thermometer, no sanitizer test strips, incomplete pest log, rusted walk-in shelves, and no dumpster on site.

headline: Cooked pasta over-covered while cooling
summary: Passed. Cooked pasta was tightly covered in plastic wrap while cooling in the walk-in cooler; it must be loosely covered while cooling. The dipper-well faucet at the front counter has low pressure and needs repair.

headline: Employee restroom lacks covered trash receptacle
summary: Passed. The employee toilet room had no covered receptacle. The facility was instructed to provide one.

headline: Rough counter, leaks, missing ceiling panels
summary: Passed. Counter by the display cooler is rough and unsealed with exposed plywood. Hand-sink leak; one faucet handle at the three-compartment sink does not fully work. Wall panel pulling away; missing ceiling panels; wall missing over utility sink.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep
summary: No person in charge was present. No certified food manager was on duty while rice and chicken soups were prepared and served; cited. Cardboard used on shelves, grease in the fryer, a leaking three-compartment sink, and dirty floors.

headline: Calcium buildup inside ice machine
summary: Passed. Calcium buildup on the interior of the ice machine. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Live roaches still active across kitchen
summary: Live roach activity remains: an adult on the wok, an adult on the wall by the walk-in, an adult on the dining-area ceiling, and a nymph on the floor under the three-compartment sink. Cited. Must eliminate roaches and provide a new pest service receipt.

headline: Live roaches found; pest records incomplete
summary: Live roaches were seen on a lobby wall and on the floor under a service table; cited. Pest logbook lacked service reports and was outdated. Also unlabeled bulk ingredients, manager allergen training proof missing, and clutter.

headline: Grease trap overflows; expired food handler training
summary: Grease trap in the meat room backs up and overflows when the hand sink or three-compartment sink runs; priority violation; cited. Multiple employees have expired food handler training. Leaking pipe in basement ceiling, missing hand-wash signs, and greasy cooking-oil container.

headline: Passed re-inspection; labeling and clutter fixes ordered
summary: Passed re-inspection. Bulk flour and breadcrumbs were unlabeled; the women's restroom lacked a covered sanitary-product bin; cardboard clutter in a kitchen corner needed removal to prevent pest hiding spots.

headline: No handsink for bar; no dump sink
summary: Drinks served to customers in the 2nd-floor mezzanine have no handsink; one with soap and towels must be installed. No dump sink for liquid waste on the 2nd floor; must be installed.

headline: Live plants over food prep area
summary: Live pottery plants were placed above the food prep area and must be moved away from open food and clean utensils.

headline: Garlic butter held at 79F; corrected on site
summary: Garlic butter, a cold TCS food that must stay at 41F or below, was at 79F. Manager discarded 5 lbs ($35) and it was corrected on site; citation issued.

headline: Dirty ice machine, freezer floor, and hood
summary: Ice machine interior had slight build-up, the walk-in freezer floor had food buildup under shelves, and the vent hood had food and dust. One food handler's certificate had expired; the manager must update it.

headline: Roaches found; hot food below safe temperature
summary: About 10+ live roaches under and behind coolers and a freezer, plus dead roaches and a wall opening. Hot foods at 98.1F and 119-121F were below the 135F minimum; about 4.5 lbs discarded. Citation issued; pest service recommended.

headline: Rust, leaks, and damaged cooler handle
summary: Rust on walk-in cooler shelves, a damaged reach-in handle, and leaky three-compartment sink faucets need repair. Steam-table shelving and freezer floors need debris cleaned. Also: no hook for wet mops; children's default drink must be 130 calories or less.

headline: Electrical closet clutter; detail clean
summary: Electrical storage closet needs detail cleaning and removal of unnecessary items such as plastic debris, to reduce potential pest hiding spots.

headline: Slimy ice machine parts touching ice
summary: Ice machine components were heavily soiled with black and gray slime, touching and dripping onto ice used for human consumption. Manager instructed to clean and sanitize; citation issued. Also: a leaking faucet at a prep-area sink.

headline: No certified manager; no food handler certificates
summary: No certified food manager on site while chicken, beef, beans, and rice were prepared and served; citation issued. Also: no food handler certificates or allergen-training proof, no cooler thermometers, and greasy equipment and hood.

headline: Items on floors; unlabeled cooked foods; drain grime
summary: Cooked foods in walk-in cooler stored without common-name labels. Items on freezer and cooler floors must be raised six inches to prevent contamination. Heavy grime in floor drain under three-compartment sink and dirt under shelving need cleaning.

headline: Clutter in kitchen, stairway, and basement
summary: Clutter on kitchen tables and counters, stairway, and basement closets must be removed. Kept items must go on smooth, cleanable shelving at least 6 inches off the ground.

headline: No raw-food advisory on menu; expired allergen training
summary: Menu lacked the required consumer advisory about raw or undercooked foods; citation issued. Certified food manager's allergen training certificate was expired; must comply with current certification.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; scoops stored inside
summary: Bulk containers of brown sugar and chiles were unlabeled, and dry-storage scoops were kept inside their containers. Staff were told to label all bulk ingredients and store utensils between uses.

headline: Wiping cloths, grime, and filters need attention
summary: Wiping cloths must be stored in a sanitizer bucket between uses to prevent cross-contamination. Ice scoop must be kept out of the ice bin. Heavy grime on cooking equipment and hood, plus grease and dust on hood filters, must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager; no soap at handsink
summary: No certified manager on site while steak, rice, and eggs were served; citation issued. No soap at the prep handsink (also cited), provided during inspection. Kitchen lighting near prep area must be brightened.

headline: No vomit/diarrhea procedure or supplies
summary: No written procedure or adequate supplies for vomit or diarrhea cleanup; a kit with norovirus-effective sanitizer must be on site at all times. Citation issued. Also: boxed food on floor, torn gasket, rusty racks, dirty prep walls.

headline: Dish machine too cool to sanitize; tagged
summary: High-temperature dish machine final rinse was 129F, below the 165F minimum; tagged; citation issued. Use only the three-compartment sink for sanitizing until repaired. Also: ice scoop handle in ice, food stored under unshielded sewer lines, and a leaking hand sink.

headline: No sanitation manager; hair restraints missing
summary: No City sanitation manager on premises while TCS foods (must be kept hot or cold) were handled; citation issued. Also: no hair restraints, dirty floors in prep areas, and the sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Expired prepared food discarded (80 lbs)
summary: Ground beef, chicken, curry, and chickpeas prepared 4/26/2024 were past use-by date in the walk-in cooler. Manager discarded about 80 lbs ($700) and must track daily; TCS food may not be kept over 7 days.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training
summary: The manager did not have required allergen training. Staff must provide it and keep proof on site at all times.

headline: Coolers too warm; health policy and kits missing
summary: Two prep coolers held 52.6-70.3F (limit 41F); tagged, not to be used until reinspected. Also missing: employee health policy, vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit, food thermometer, sanitizer test devices, and allergen training.

headline: Dust and food debris on ventilation hood
summary: Accumulated food debris and dust on the ventilation hood must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: No certified manager; no consumer egg advisory
summary: Person in charge lacked certificate. No certified manager on site while TCS foods (must be kept hot or cold) were prepared; citation issued. Menu lacks raw/undercooked egg advisory. No hair restraints, wiping cloths on tables, dirty floors and walls.

headline: Drains, prep tables, floors need detail cleaning
summary: Food prep drains and prep-table sides need detail cleaning. Floors under equipment and in corners need cleaning to prevent pest or insect activity. Also: a leaking bar sink faucet, a missing covered receptacle downstairs, and two burnt-out hood lights.

headline: Women's restroom door closer not working
summary: The self-closing device on the women's restroom door was not working. The operator was instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: Open drink on pizza prep table; grease spills
summary: An open drink cup sat on the pizza prep table and must be stored in a designated area away from food prep. Grease spills on the outside oil tank container must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Towel on utensils; mop head near clean dishes
summary: Blender parts were drying on a cloth towel at the three-compartment sink, which is not allowed. A mop head hangs too close to clean utensils; a barrier must be installed.

headline: Unlabeled flour and salt containers
summary: Bulk containers of flour and salt were unlabeled; all food removed from original packaging must be labeled with its name.

headline: Drain line into bar handsinks; missing grout
summary: A counter drain line emptied into the bar's northside handsinks and must be relocated. Missing grout between floor tiles under the three-compartment sink must be replaced for cleaning.

headline: Rear door gap, missing prep sink, clutter
summary: Rear exit door has a 2-inch gap at the bottom and must be sealed to keep out pests. A one-compartment prep sink must be installed for rinsing and dumping. Unnecessary stored items in hallway, office, patio, and walkway must be removed.

headline: Mold-like buildup on cooler racks
summary: Mold-like buildup found on wire racks in the cooler, and dust on filters in the rear cooking area. Certified manager lacks allergen training and must obtain it and keep it on site.

headline: Unlabeled flour, rice, cornstarch; dusty wall
summary: Flour, rice, and cornstarch were stored without labels; labels must be provided. Dust and debris were found on the back wall behind unused refrigeration equipment and must be cleaned.

headline: Raw crab, shrimp, sprouts held too warm
summary: Raw crab and shrimp at 50F and bean sprouts at 55F, above the 41F limit for cold foods. Person in charge discarded about 2 lbs crab, 1 lb shrimp, and 3 lbs sprouts ($50 value); citation issued.

headline: Live and dead cockroaches; no certified manager
summary: Over 7 live cockroaches in basement prep, plus 5 in the fryers and over 100 dead ones; citation issued. Pork and cantaloupe held at 56.8-57.7F, above the 41F cold limit; about 30 lbs discarded. Also: heavy grease and dirty racks.

headline: Clutter near storage; rusty sink fixtures
summary: Clutter on the rear storage floor was ordered removed to prevent pest hiding spots. Rusted faucets on the rear dish-area hand sink and three-compartment sink, and a heavily rusted soap dispenser, need repair or replacement.

headline: No original food sanitation certificate posted
summary: No original City food sanitation certificate posted on site; a citation was issued. Personal drink found on prep cutting board, which must be stored away from food-prep areas.

headline: Ice machine debris; equipment stored on floor
summary: Slight debris in the ice machine panel must be cleaned and maintained. Multi-use equipment stored on the floor must be raised 6 inches and stored upside down.

headline: Gloves not changed between tasks; grease buildup
summary: Employee washed hands with gloves on, then kept preparing food without changing them; citation issued. Also: employees ate and drank in prep areas, thick grease around the outside grease container, and heavy grease in the exhaust hood.

headline: Drinking without lid; unlabeled bulk; grease buildup
summary: Employee drank from an uncovered glass in prep area; a lid is required. Basement bulk containers lacked labels. Debris on shelving and dried grease on grill and prep tables flagged as a pest hiding-spot risk. Manager must obtain allergen training.

headline: Debris in coolers; grime on basement toilets
summary: Debris built up inside coolers, slight calcium buildup inside the basement ice machine, and soil on toilets in the basement restrooms. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain all three.

headline: Blocked handsinks, slimy ice maker, flying insects
summary: Prep-area handsinks blocked by carts and boxes; manager removed them. Black slime in 2nd-floor ice maker drips into ice. About 25 and 20 flying insects found in two prep areas; citation issued. Sushi cooler at 50F tagged.

headline: Cleaning needed; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Cleaning needed on microwave interiors, dish machine top, soda nozzles, shelves, and prep-area walls. Certified food manager had no allergen training certificate; management was told to show proof.

headline: Unreadable labels; mold-like cooler buildup
summary: Food storage containers had unreadable labels and must be labeled with common names. Mold-like buildup and dust inside a two-door cooler need detail cleaning; water-stained ceiling tiles above the hood need replacing; rear storage floors need cleaning.

headline: Bare hands on food; broken dumpster lids
summary: Food handler touched cut peppers bare-handed; food discarded, citation issued. Also: food stored on basement cooler floor, unlabeled containers, missing upstairs thermometers, a sticky fly trap, and dumpsters with broken lids (cited).

headline: No certified manager; no vomit kit or training
summary: No City-certified manager on premises, and vomit/diarrhea response items were missing; citations issued. Also: a window air-conditioner gap, no food handler training proof, rust on sink grease trap, and ceramic cups needing lead-safety records.

headline: Dead insects on floors need removal
summary: Dead insects were found on the floor in the main prep area and basement. Staff must remove them, detail clean, sanitize, and maintain.

headline: No paper towels in employee restroom
summary: Employee restroom had no paper towels or other hand-drying means; staff were instructed to provide them.

headline: Missing thermometer in front prep cooler
summary: A visible, working thermometer is needed in the three-door front prep cooler; the operator must provide and maintain it.

headline: Pizza boxes on floor; ceiling dust
summary: Pizza boxes stored on the prep-area floor must be raised six inches off the floor. Second-floor light shields, vents, and ceiling tiles need dust removal, and floors need litter cleaned.

headline: Heavy clutter; damaged floor tiles
summary: Heavy clutter on shelves and in back and storage areas must be removed to prevent hiding places for pests; housekeeping must be upgraded. Damaged and missing floor tiles and concrete in prep and dishwashing areas must be repaired.

headline: Unlabeled dry ingredients; floors need cleaning
summary: Dry ingredients in storage containers were unlabeled and need common food names. Utensils were not inverted. Floors in prep and front service areas, especially under a wire rack and service counter, need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; wastewater backing up
summary: No City-certified manager on site while deli meat and soup were handled; citation issued. Wastewater backs up from a floor drain and grease trap; duct tape on trap must be removed. Restroom handwash basins dirty.

headline: Grease, debris, and repeat violations
summary: Storage containers unlabeled; grease on cooking equipment; debris on rear floor drains; broken floor tiles. Repeat violations from 2024 uncorrected, including dirty ice machine and missing allergen proof. Citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled flour and breading; peeling ceiling tile
summary: Flour and breading stored outside original packaging were unlabeled and must be labeled. Peeling ceiling tile above food prep areas must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Sanitizer dispenser broken; dish, ice machines down
summary: Sanitizer dispenser on the three-compartment sink was broken; manager must repair it and pour sanitizer by hand until fixed. Dish machine and ice machine not working; repair or remove. Heavy soil on dish room floor; dust in griddle filters.

headline: Soap dispenser and pest device over sink
summary: Hand soap dispenser over the three-compartment sink must move to the handsink area. A pest control device over the three-compartment sink must be removed or relocated. Manager must provide a drainboard and install a grease trap as required.

headline: Handsink leak; ice machine dust; drain debris
summary: Leak at prep-area handsink must be repaired. Mild dust behind ice machine panel must be cleaned and sanitized. Two-compartment sink floor drain has debris and must be cleaned.

headline: Food stored on floor; scoops handled improperly
summary: Boxes of food and canned goods were on floors in rear storage, basement, and walk-in freezer and must be raised 6 inches. Scoops in dry storage bins had handles touching food. Also: missing handwashing sign, no covered waste bin.

headline: Greasy fryers and dusty vents need cleaning
summary: Fryers need grease removed; wiping cloths must stay in sanitizing solution. Also: can opener, cooking equipment, worn cooler shelves, and dusty vents need cleaning; storage must be 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Backflow device not found on ice machine
summary: Inspector could not locate a backflow prevention device on the ice machine. The operator must install and maintain one.

headline: Raw wood shelves in walk-in cooler
summary: Raw wood shelves in the walk-in cooler must be painted and sealed.

headline: Leaky bar sink, missing food handler training proof
summary: Leaking faucet on the bar three-compartment sink. No covered sanitary-product receptacle in the all-gender restroom. No proof of food handler training. Staff were told to fix each item.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit kit; handsink issues
summary: No certified manager while TCS foods (must be kept hot or cold) were handled. Also: no vomit/diarrhea kit or cleanup plan, no soap or towels at prep handsink, and a dish machine with 0 ppm sanitizer, now tagged.

headline: Cold foods at 48F; discarded; cooler tagged
summary: Various cold TCS foods (must be kept at 41F or below) were held at 48F. Manager discarded about 4 lbs yogurt, 8 lbs salad, 10 lbs chicken sandwiches, and other food ($200); citation issued. Open display cooler ran 41-48F; tagged.

headline: Ice machine build-up; hair restraints needed
summary: Ice machine interior needs build-up removed. All food handlers need hair restraints. Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizer; worn cutting boards must be replaced. Mop sink faucet leaks. Sanitation certificate holders need allergen certificates.

headline: Food out of temperature; no health policy
summary: Half chicken at 87.2F (hot food must be 135F or higher) and several cold dishes at 48-53.9F were discarded. Cooler too warm at 57.7F; tagged. No written employee health policy; citation issued. Front hand sink was blocked; manager cleared it.

headline: Past-date cooked meat; missing handsinks
summary: Cooked meat from April 2024 was past use-by in walk-in cooler; 30 lbs discarded (about $100). Missing handsinks in fifth-floor pastry kitchen and third-floor dish area. Also: unlabeled bulk containers, no hair restraints, and utensils left in stagnant water.

headline: Unlabeled desserts; new employee untrained
summary: Prepackaged desserts on display lacked proper labels; manager was instructed. A new employee had no food handler training, and no food allergen training was on file for the food manager. Operator must provide and maintain both.

headline: No certified manager; repeat violations found
summary: No certified food manager on site while TCS foods (must be kept hot or cold) were served; citation issued. Earlier issues not fixed: no dish-machine test kit or thermometer, and a 1/4-inch gap under the side exit door.

headline: Gap under front door; bulbs out above cooking
summary: Gap under front entrance door must be sealed to keep out pests. Also needed: a covered restroom waste bin, pallets removed from walk-in freezer, a drainboard at the three-compartment sink, repainting, and three replacement bulbs above cooking equipment.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets and a burnt-out light
summary: Torn gaskets on salad and protein prep coolers must be repaired or replaced. One burnt-out hood light over the cook line needs replacing. Handwashing signage at the bar dump sink must be removed.

headline: Mouse droppings, dead mice, and roaches found
summary: About 80 mouse droppings in prep, storage, and front areas; three dead mice and roaches on sticky traps. Pest control suggested; citation issued. Also: 20 lbs cooked beef at 73.9F and 30 lbs cold food over 41F discarded; handsink blocked.

headline: Detail cleaning needed on equipment and floors
summary: Inspector asked for detail cleaning of shelving, prep table legs, microwaves, a walk-in cooler, and front prep floors and walls near the hot holders. No pests noted.

headline: Paleta labels incomplete; onions on floor
summary: Packaged paletas lacked a common name and full ingredient list; labeling must be provided. Bags of onions on the walk-in cooler floor must be raised 6 inches. Clay drinking cups need lead-safety records or removal.

headline: Paper towel dispenser in poor repair
summary: The paper towel dispenser above the kitchen hand sink is in poor repair and must be repaired and maintained.

headline: No certified manager; moldy ice machines
summary: No City-certified food service manager on premises; citation issued. Black and beige mold-like substance found inside ice machines, which were ordered cleaned. Also: gaps around entry doors, a broken sink, and dusty ceilings and condenser covers.

headline: Buckled floor under reach-in refrigerator
summary: Buckled flooring under a one-door refrigerator next to the steam table must be repaired and sealed so it can be cleaned.

headline: Handwashing signage missing at all sinks
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at hand sinks throughout the premises. The operator must provide and maintain them.

headline: Chipped paint and torn gasket in cooler
summary: Chipped paint and rust on walk-in cooler wire shelves must be removed, and shelves repainted or replaced. Torn door gasket on the two-door stand-up cooler must be replaced.

headline: Washroom door closer in poor repair
summary: Self-closing device on washroom door is in poor repair and must be repaired. A City-certified food service manager lacked allergen training; instructed to comply or citations will follow.

headline: No vomit kit; rear door gap; missing signs
summary: No vomit/diarrhea procedures or supplies; manager must provide them. A 1/4-inch gap at rear emergency door must be sealed. Also: missing handwashing signs, damaged freezer gasket, slow-draining sink, and no trash bins at prep handsinks.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; cleaning needed
summary: Bulk containers were unlabeled. Staff were told to clean hot-holding units, fryer bottoms, prep tables, walls, and floor drains, and remove standing water under the three-compartment sink. Managers without allergen training must obtain it.

headline: Hand sink water too hot for washing
summary: Main prep hand sink water measured 124F, too hot to wash hands properly, and only one hot handle could not be mixed with cold. Manager told to provide water between 100-120F. Also: oil spills and food debris behind cook line and drive-through.

headline: Dirty coolers, washrooms, floors, and hood
summary: Coolers, freezer, equipment exteriors, and counters need detail cleaning. Washroom fixtures, floors, and walls are dirty; kitchen floors and walls need food and grease removed. Hood and filters need grease removal.

headline: Uncovered toppings above prep areas
summary: Dog toppings and smoothie ingredients sat uncovered on counters in front and rear prep areas. Staff were told to cover them to prevent overhead contamination.

headline: Cold foods at 44-50F; cooler too warm
summary: Cold TCS foods (must be kept at 41F or below) were held at 44-50F; about $400 of food discarded. Walk-in cooler ran 46F, rear half 42F; cooler tagged. Portable handsink at prep station must connect to city water. Citations issued.

headline: Dish machine buildup; summary report hidden
summary: Some food handlers lacked hair restraints; corrected on site. Heavy buildup inside the high-temp dish machine led to a priority citation. Rusty prep-table bottoms need repair. Inspection summary was hidden from public view; corrected on site, citation issued.

headline: Hand sinks lack soap, towels, and warm water
summary: No employee health policy; no vomit/diarrhea cleanup procedure; no hand sink at dish area. Toilet-room hand sinks lacked soap and towels; water at 77-90F, below the 100F minimum. Also: no door self-closers, no toilet-room waste lid.

headline: No certified manager; fish thawing improperly
summary: No certified manager on site while fish and shrimp were served; citation issued. Also: fish thawing in standing water, no hair restraints, no food handler training, unlabeled bulk containers, and no allergen training.

headline: Fryer grease buildup; trash can needed
summary: Minor grease buildup inside the cooking fryer must be cleaned and maintained. Unisex restroom needs a trash can with a lid.

headline: Dusty vent in front prep area
summary: Vent in the front prep area had dirt and dust buildup; staff were instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: No certified manager; water backs up at sinks
summary: No certified food manager present while TCS foods (must be kept hot or cold) were handled; citation issued. Water backs up into sink basins when draining, to be repaired. Also: no food handler training proof, no allergen training, and greasy floors.

headline: Cold food too warm; flies and rodent droppings
summary: About 60 lbs fish and chicken at 49-51F and cole slaw at 50F, above the 41F limit; discarded, citation issued. Also about 30 small live flies and 13 rodent droppings in rear prep and toilet room; pest control contact ordered.

headline: No handwashing sink in rear prep area
summary: A previously cited handwashing sink is still missing from the rear prep and dishwashing area, uncorrected since the 12/17/2024 inspection. It must be installed. No citation issued this visit.

headline: Handwashing signs missing throughout facility
summary: No handwashing signs at hand sinks throughout the facility. The person in charge was told to provide and maintain them.

headline: Holes in dishwashing area; grease in hood
summary: Multiple holes and openings in the floor, wall base, and ceiling of the dishwashing area must be sealed. Stained ceiling tile must be cleaned or replaced. Heavy dirt and grease in the exhaust hood, filters, and pipes need detail cleaning.

headline: Dishwasher reused gloves; soup cooled improperly
summary: Dishwasher handled dirty then clean dishes without changing gloves; clean dishes must be rewashed; citation issued. Soup cooled improperly at 123.1F; corrected on site by reheating and recooling. Also: oven grease and garbage area need cleaning.

headline: Ready-to-eat food lacked discard dates
summary: Cooked chicken wings, chili, and tomato sauce held over 24 hours without discard dates; manager discarded about $50 worth. Citation issued. Also: dusty heating and cooling vents near utility closet.

headline: No certified manager; cardboard liners, grease
summary: No original City food sanitation certificate posted; a certified manager must be on site whenever TCS foods (kept hot or cold) are prepared or served. Citation issued. Also: cardboard liners, grease-dirty floors, and basement openings to seal.

headline: Missing fan covers; leaking sink
summary: Fan covers missing in rear meat prep area must be provided. Three-compartment sink has a minor leak below the rinse compartment; must be repaired.

headline: Failed re-inspection: no vomit kit or sanitizer
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or sanitizer on site. Three-compartment sink floods when one side drains. No dumpster service under operator name. No certified manager with allergen training on site.

headline: Food residue on can opener; allergen training
summary: Food residue built up on the can opener in the prep area; instructed to clean it. No proof of allergen training on site for the city food manager; must complete training and keep certificate.

headline: No certified manager; no hot water at sinks
summary: No certified manager or posted certificate while pork, fish, and chicken pizza were prepared and served. No hot water at pizza prep sink (75.2F) or women's restroom. Ice scoops stored on top of ice machine; employees without hair restraints; ventilation not working.

headline: Dirty cold units; missing covered trash cans
summary: Re-inspection found food debris and spills inside cold units. Restrooms lacked covered receptacles. Items stored on utility closet floor. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: No certified manager; employee bare-hand handling
summary: No certified manager on site while open. Employee handled hamburger buns bare-handed; about 3 lbs discarded. Hand sinks lacked signs, drying towels, and soap at times. No thermometers in cold units; allergen certificate missing.

headline: Dry food stored under wastewater pipes
summary: Dry storage food items stored under wastewater pipes in basement. Must move them or install a barrier to prevent contamination from leaks.

headline: Cooler too warm; flies throughout establishment
summary: Walk-in cooler held eggs at 46F, dressing at 46F, cooked pasta at 46F, cheese at 47F; cooler air read 50F. About 75 live small flying insects and 5 house flies throughout; citation issued. Pest control needed.

headline: Cold food held too warm; sanitizer fixed
summary: Cold foods including rice, eggs, and cheese held at 47.8-57.4F; discarded. Dish machine at 0 ppm, repaired and rechecked at 100 ppm on 11/6/2025. Menu disclosures and a refrigerator at 58.5F were also corrected by 11/6.

headline: No health policy; food stored under sewer line
summary: No employee health policy on site. Dry storage containers unlabeled. Shelving, prep tables, and pots stored under a basement sewer line; must be removed. No written procedure for cleaning dough mixers.

headline: Flies throughout bar and prep; dish machines fail
summary: About 25 small black live flies in bar, server station, prep, dry storage, and toilet room; citation issued. High-temperature dish machine rinse at 130F, low-temperature machine at 0 ppm sanitizer; both tagged. Hair restraints missing.

headline: Hair restraints; boxes on floor; broken tiles
summary: Multiple food employees not wearing hair restraints. Single-service items stored on floor behind the bar must be raised. Broken floor tiles in front of the three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Dead cockroaches; missing hand sinks; no health policy
summary: Three dead cockroaches in rear dish area; manager must remove and sanitize. No hand sinks at front bar, basement prep, or dish area. No verifiable health policy or vomit kit. Leaking drain under three-compartment sink.

headline: Live plants above open food; signs missing
summary: Live plants placed above open food must be kept away. No handwashing signs in employee restroom; instructed to post.

headline: No health policy, no vomit kit, untrained staff
summary: No verifiable employee health policy on site; no kit or procedure for vomit and diarrhea cleanup; three food employees lacked food handler training; no allergen training certificates. Covered trash receptacle missing from restroom.

headline: Slimy ice machine panel cleaned on site
summary: Inside of ice machine panel was unclean with a slimy substance; employee cleaned it on site and manager called the service company. Unlabeled bulk container corrected on site. Fryer exterior and hood vents need cleaning.

headline: Cook touched food after soiled wiping cloth
summary: Cook touched a soiled wiping cloth, then handled ready-to-eat food without washing hands or changing gloves. Priority violation; citation issued. Prior uncorrected items included unlabeled desserts, rear door opening, torn gasket, and damaged floor tiles.

headline: Holes and unfinished walls in employee washroom
summary: Holes in the washroom wall beside the hand sink and at wall base must be sealed. Washroom walls and ceiling need repainting. Food handlers must obtain required food handler training.

headline: Greasy soda dispenser and dirty ice machine lip
summary: Splatter built up under the soda dispenser. Ice machine outside lip has rust and grey buildup. Cooking equipment sides have grease. Floor in catering coffee area has dirt, spillage, and debris. Instructed to clean all.

headline: Unlabeled packaged food; leaks and damaged tiles
summary: Packaged guacamole for sale had no labels. Food stored on walk-in cooler floor. Leaking drainpipe under meat prep handwashing sink; damaged wall tiles; dusty ceiling. Prior unfixed issues: 1/4-inch rear door gap and leaking pipe under sink.

headline: Heavily soiled basement floor by grease trap
summary: Re-inspection found the floor around the grease trap in the basement storage area heavily soiled with loose debris and trash. Manager instructed to detail clean and keep the area clear.

headline: Cardboard shelf liners; leaking faucets
summary: Cardboard boxes used as shelf liners in walk-in cooler; must be removed. Leaking faucets at hand sink and three-compartment sink must be repaired. Floors along walls and under cooking equipment need detail cleaning.

headline: Greasy equipment, floors, and grinder buildup
summary: Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, coolers, freezers, and walls and floors along the hot line. Meat grinder has food buildup. Wiping cloths left on prep tables; food containers need proper labels.

headline: No certified manager during rice service
summary: No certified food manager present while TCS foods such as rice at 156F were prepared and served. Management told a certified manager must be present at all times.

headline: No vomit procedure; no pest control log
summary: No vomit and diarrhea procedure or supplies on site. No pest control log book from a licensed company. Missing backflow device at mop sink; no self-closing restroom door; burned-out bulbs; clutter; debris under grocery racks.

headline: Cold units lack thermometers; doors not rodent-proof
summary: Most cold holding units lack air thermometers, including buffet mini coolers. Exit doors in dining area, prep area, bar, and food court are not rodent-proof at the bottom; must be made rodent-proof.

headline: Low restroom water pressure; hair restraints
summary: Water pressure in both customer restrooms extremely low; instructed to increase it. Employees in prep areas were not wearing hair restraints; instructed to wear them at all times.

headline: Condensate water dripping on basement floor
summary: Building condensate line in basement drips onto floor near floor drain. Must repair or re-route the line so water goes directly to disposal. Employee drinks and personal items stored on shelf above clean equipment and hand sink.

headline: Ice machine residue, rusty racks, upkeep issues
summary: Pinkish substance inside ice machine; wiping cloths and ice scoop stored improperly; rust on walk-in cooler racks; water-stained ceiling tiles; dirty floors. Instructed to clean and repair.

headline: Unsafe hot-held food; no certified manager
summary: No certified manager while TCS foods were prepared and served; sanitation certificates expired. Hot-held potatoes, fish, pork chops below safe temperatures; 36 lbs discarded. Freezer condensation dripped on food; 10 lbs discarded.

headline: Front door gap; no food handler proof
summary: Opening at base of front entrance door must be sealed. Missing splash guard at prep hand sink. Paint cans on utility closet floor. Ice buildup in walk-in freezer. Mop left drying in sink. No proof of food handler training for any food handlers.

headline: Dish machine sanitizer fixed during inspection
summary: Low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm sanitizer during use; citation issued. Manager replaced sanitizer solution and machine then read 50 ppm, so use may continue. Utensils stored improperly; leaking faucet; greasy floor under wok and stove.

headline: Unlabeled flour and sugar; no allergen training
summary: Food containers such as flour and sugar have no labels; must be provided. Sanitation manager has no allergen training; must be provided.

headline: No certified manager for ham and turkey
summary: No certified food manager while ham and turkey were prepared and served. No paper towels or soap at restroom sinks, fixed on site. No metal-stem thermometer. Pest control log outdated, last entries 2020. Ceiling vents dusty.

headline: Menu raw food disclosure added on site
summary: Menu lacked disclosure that asterisked animal foods are served raw or cooked to order; added on site. Splashes and spills under bar equipment and sinks. Food debris at base of walls in small basement dry storage.

headline: Over 75 mouse droppings found in kitchen
summary: Over 75 mouse droppings in kitchen hallway, prep area, basement stairs, and behind the deep fryer. Failed. Pest control recommended. Also a leaking pipe, missing thermometers, soiled linens, and a damaged cooler.

headline: Grease and food debris under sinks and floors
summary: Spilled food and soil on the bottom of reach-in freezers and thawing coolers. Grease and debris on floors between salad coolers, under the three-compartment sink, behind grease trap, and throughout chicken prep area. Instructed to detail clean.

headline: Over 80 mouse droppings in basement
summary: Rodent activity: 80 or more mouse droppings on basement floor under storage shelves and in subpump room. Citation issued. Pest control service required before reinspection next week; last service January 5, 2026. Cooler gaskets worn.

headline: Missing handwashing signs in basement restrooms
summary: Handwashing signs missing in basement restrooms. Instructed to provide and maintain them.

headline: No certified manager; sanitizer and oyster problems
summary: No certified food manager on site until 10:15am, corrected. Dish machine sanitizer read 0 ppm, repaired on site to 100 ppm. Oysters lacked tags and were discarded. Ice machine shields had moldlike substance. Some hand sinks ran lukewarm.

headline: 20-40 rodent droppings in furnace room
summary: About 20-40 rodent droppings in furnace room and around water heater; citation issued. Additional pest control required. Torn freezer door gasket. Grease on cooking equipment, coolers, and freezers. Debris on floors in utility and storage areas.

headline: Missing thermometers; raw meat in grocery bags
summary: Thermometers needed inside cooling units in front and rear prep areas. Raw meat stored in grocery bags inside a cooling unit must move to food-grade containers. Cardboard liners on shelving must be removed.

headline: No person in charge; no certified manager on site
summary: No person in charge with valid Chicago certificate. No certified manager on site or posted certificate while TCS food was prepared and served. Rear reach-in cooler lacks thermometer. A food handler lacked hair restraint.

headline: No certified manager; several corrected on site
summary: No certified food manager on premises. Handwash sink water at 87.3F, repaired on site. Mussels without tags discarded. Dish machine at 0 ppm sanitizer, repaired on site. Unapproved vacuum-sealed foods tagged. Entrance door gaps found.

headline: No certified manager during chicken service
summary: No valid City-certified food manager or certificate on site while chicken was being served and sold; citation issued. A 1/4-inch gap under the entrance door was also found; instructed to keep doors tight-fitting.

headline: No raw egg disclosure on menu; food debris
summary: Menu lacks consumer advisory for raw or undercooked eggs; must be provided. Cold-water knob missing from hand sink. Food debris throughout prep area, around three-compartment sink, and under dishwasher. Dust on vent fan.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit kit or thermometer
summary: No certified manager while chicken was prepped; no vomit and diarrhea kit. Prep sink water turned off and blocked by sprayer. No food thermometer. No pest service report on site. Food on basement floors; cardboard and foil liners.

headline: Unapproved-source frozen treats discarded
summary: Fruit bars and ice cream bars from an unapproved source found in service freezer, unlabeled and unsealed; no proof of source. Discarded on site. Handwashing sign missing. Wiping cloths air-dried above clean equipment; scoops stored in water.

headline: Worn door gaskets on three-door cooler
summary: Worn door gaskets on the three-door reach-in cooler must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Packaged paletas lack ingredient and allergen labels
summary: Many sealed paletas lack ingredient labels and allergen information, including nuts. Must label all with allergens and ingredients or remove them. Rear door has about 1/4-inch gaps at top and bottom; must be repaired.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; untagged bulk containers
summary: No handwashing sign at front sushi prep sink. Bulk containers in rear lack labels. Employee lacked hair restraint. Washcloths must be stored in sanitizing solution. Dust on ceiling vents in washrooms.

headline: Rat infestation with over 250 droppings
summary: Over 250 rat droppings throughout kitchen and basement; licensed pest control required. Kitchen hand sink blocked by ice machine; several sinks lack soap and towels. Undated cooked rice and egg bread discarded. Pest log missing.

headline: Hair restraints missing; greasy floors and freezers
summary: Employees in food prep area not wearing hair restraints while handling food. Can opener has food and dirt buildup. Thick ice buildup in both chest freezers. Floors in prep, storage, and bar areas have food, dirt, and debris.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; debris under sink
summary: Re-inspection found no handwashing signs at lower-level restroom sinks. Debris on floor, wall bases, and corners in the lower-level prep area, including under and beside the three-compartment sink.

headline: Blocked hand sink, slime in ice machine
summary: Hand sink blocked by a table, cleared right away. Missing soap and paper towels at bar and kitchen sinks, fixed on site. Ice machine has thick black slime; ice machine ordered off. Service coolers held food at 46-52F; 15 lbs discarded.

headline: Standing water and dirty floors in dish area
summary: Splashguard needed between exposed hand sink and stove. Regrout dishwashing floor tiles with standing water and seal wall gaps behind cook line. Clean and keep floor dry under cooking equipment, along corners, and under coolers.

headline: Ice machine reservoir dirty; training needed
summary: Inside of ice machine water reservoir (top and bin) not clean. Ice is used for human consumption; must clean, sanitize, and maintain. Employees without city sanitation certificates must obtain and post food handler training certificates.

headline: Food spills at soda syrup area
summary: Food debris and spills on floors at the soda syrup dispensing area. Instructed to increase cleaning frequency and maintain.

headline: Rodent droppings and flies throughout facility
summary: About 10 large and 30 small rodent droppings in basement storage. About 50 flies in meat, basement, prep, and bakery display areas. Citation issued; pest activity must be eliminated. Hair restraints missing; toilet door not self-closing.

headline: No health policy; food stored under sewer pipes
summary: No written employee health policy on premises. Dry food stored under basement wastewater pipes; must move it or add a barrier. Employees with city certificates must complete allergen training and keep certificate on site.

headline: Freezer ice buildup; storage area clutter
summary: Reach-in freezer in kitchen has heavy ice buildup; instructed to defrost. Rear storage room and rear outside area need cleaning and clutter removal, and unused cooking equipment must be removed.

headline: Worn cutting boards and greasy kitchen equipment
summary: Worn cutting boards to replace. Cooking equipment, cooler and freezer interiors, floors, walls, and hood need detail cleaning. Grease trap has foul odor; instructed to clean regularly.

headline: No certified manager; wrong certificate shown
summary: No certified sanitation manager on site while beef and tuna were prepped and served. Person in charge showed a photo of another person's certificate. Soiled mop heads not stored properly. Food handler working without certificates.

headline: No allergen training; missing handwashing sign
summary: No allergen training on site for city food managers; must complete training and keep certificate on site. Handwashing sign missing at the room service wait-area hand sink.

headline: Missing or expired allergen training certificates
summary: Allergen training certificates for city-certified food managers were missing or expired. Instructed to provide current certificates for all certified managers.

headline: Flies and rodent droppings; prior violations unfixed
summary: Large numbers of house and fruit flies in dish and basement areas. About 40 rodent droppings in basement, rear prep, and kitchen prep areas. Prior violations not corrected: cutting boards, gaskets, greasy equipment, leaking faucet, no food handler or allergen certificates.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure or reach-in thermometers
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or spill kit on site; must provide. No thermometers inside reach-in coolers; must provide.

headline: Worn cutting board, loose sink, leaking faucet
summary: Re-inspection found a worn, deeply grooved cutting board in the prep area, a loose hand sink, and a leaking three-compartment sink faucet. Manager instructed to replace and repair.

headline: Garlic bread stored on cardboard; cleaning needed
summary: Garlic bread stored against cardboard behind the cook line; use only cleanable containers or line box with plastic. Clean outside of storage containers, shelves, prep tables, equipment, floors, and walls.

headline: Wet mops and dirty floors need attention
summary: Wet mops must be hung to dry properly after use. Floors in rear storage area and under walk-in cooler shelving must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager; food held too cool
summary: No certified manager while pizza and wings were prepared and served. Hot dogs and taquitos held at 96-100F, too low; about 10 lbs discarded. Front prep sink lacks soap. No cold water at three-compartment sink; pink mineral buildup in ice dispensers.

headline: Rusty shelves and grease box need repainting
summary: Rusty metal prep shelves in the kitchen must be repainted or replaced. Rusty metal grease box under the three-compartment sink must be repainted.

headline: No certified manager; hand sinks lack hot water
summary: No certified manager on site while chicken was prepped. Bar hand sink blocked by lemons, ice, and straws. Employee bathroom sinks at 58-61F; prep sink at 123.2F. Three-compartment sink leaks. Ham held at 52-54F; discarded.

headline: Dusty vents and light fixture in prep area
summary: Vent covers and a light fixture in the front prep area are dusty. Must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Ice buildup in cold unit; stained ceiling tiles
summary: Ice buildup inside an eastside cold holding unit in front prep area. Stained ceiling tiles on sales floor and damaged washroom floor tiles must be replaced. Cardboard floor liners must be removed.

headline: Front door gaps; dusty air vents
summary: Front doors in poor repair with gaps at bottom from worn weather stripping; must be replaced to keep pests out. Air vents in prep and rear storage areas are dusty and must be cleaned.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; leaking drain
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings on floors in beverage, prep, and storage areas; citation issued; exterminator required. Food on cooler and freezer floors; leaking drainpipe under prep sink; greasy cooking equipment; soiled wiping cloths.

headline: Food on floors; missing handwashing and trash signage
summary: Boxed food on floors of both walk-in coolers; must raise six inches. Missing handwashing sign at front bar sink. No covered trash receptacle in women's restroom. Cardboard liners in cooler; broken basement floor tiles.

headline: No person in charge; raw meat too warm
summary: No person in charge on site and no certified food manager while tacos and burritos were made. Raw meat at 50F and cooked chicken and potatoes at 48-49F in prep cooler; about 20 lbs discarded. No soap at main prep sink; leaking pipe under three-compartment sink.

headline: Raw ground beef too warm; 87 lbs discarded
summary: Raw ground beef packaged at 47.4-48.7F in walk-in cooler; must be 41F or below. About 87 lbs ($115) discarded. Rear roll door has gaps at bottom. Handwashing sign missing; leaks at three hand sinks.

headline: No health policy; cold foods above safe limit
summary: No written employee health policy. Kitchen hand sink has no hot water (58.3F). Sliced sausage, sauce, and bacon held above 41F; discarded. Menu lacks raw egg disclosure. Missing sink stoppers, rust, leaking sprayer, and damaged ceiling tiles.

headline: Allergen training missing for managers
summary: Allergen training missing for city-certified managers. Must obtain training and verification on site.

headline: No allergen training certificate for manager
summary: Re-inspection found no allergen awareness training certificate for the city food service manager. Instructed to provide proof for all employees with city sanitation certificates.

headline: Untagged mussels and undated cooked beans
summary: Mussels stored without shellstock tags. Cooked beans held over 24 hours without disposition dates. Steaks served undercooked without consumer advisory. Food stored on floor and outside by back door; leak under sink; clutter.

headline: Bare-hand fry handling; eggs held too cool
summary: Employee with painted nails scooped fries without gloves; manager had them glove up during inspection. Cooked eggs held at 115.3F and 110.3F, below safe hot-holding temperatures; discarded. Raw eggs at 54F also discarded.

headline: Soiled wipe cloths on prep tables
summary: Soiled wiping cloths on third floor prep tables; must be stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. Soil on walk-in veggie cooler fan guards. Trash cans in women's restroom need lids.

headline: Items on basement floors; torn cooler gasket
summary: Single-use items stored on basement floors must be raised off the floor. Torn gasket on cooks-line cooler. Raw wood shelving under grill must be sealed. No proof of food handler training for required employees.

headline: Rear door gap and greasy exhaust hood
summary: Rear exit door has an approximately 2-inch gap at the bottom right corner; instructed to make it tight-fitting to prevent pest entry. Kitchen exhaust hood and filters need detail cleaning for grease buildup.

headline: Mouse droppings; no hot water at prep sink
summary: Over 75 mouse droppings in kitchen hallway, basement stairs, and behind deep fryer. No hot water at dish-prep hand sink. Pizza prep cooler at 55.4F, tagged out. Missing thermometers, soiled linens, and leaking pipe under dishwasher.

headline: No hand sink in rear dishwashing area
summary: No hand sink in the rear dishwashing area. Must provide a hand sink with hot and cold running water.

headline: Missing wall coving; blocked grease trap access
summary: Wall coving missing in furnace closet and basement storage. Items not belonging to the owner were blocking the grease trap; instructed to clear access. Food handlers and managers must complete required training.

headline: Dirty freezer, floors, and drains; training gap
summary: Reach-in freezer interior dirty. Floors and drains under sink and cooking equipment need cleaning, and rear storage area is dirty. Certified manager lacked allergen training; citation issued.

headline: Food debris on floor near donut display
summary: Food debris found on floor by the donut display. Inspector instructed staff to clean it.

headline: No certified manager; food held too warm
summary: No certified food manager while raw and cooked meats were served. Fried rice at 101F, beef at 90.3F, eggs at 80.6F held too warm; about 50 lbs discarded. No written health policy, missing sink stoppers, leaks, and food handlers lacked training.

headline: No person in charge; moldy corn; cold dressings
summary: No person in charge on site; no certified manager; no health policy; no vomit kit. Moldy corn on the cob discarded. Ranch and blue cheese dressings at 66F; prep cooler at 66F tagged and held. Missing food handler and allergen certificates.

headline: Food debris throughout; no food handler certificates
summary: Food stored on dry storage floor must be raised six inches. Debris on prep tables, coolers, freezers, and shelves. Covered receptacle missing from unisex toilet room. Debris around dumpster and walls. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Torn gasket on prep line cooler
summary: Torn door gasket inside the four-door prep line cooler. Instructed to replace it and maintain.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; front door gap
summary: Handwashing signs needed at front and rear hand sinks and in employee toilet room. Front entrance door has a 1/4-inch gap at bottom; must be made tight-fitting and rodent-proof.

headline: Worn three-door cooler lids; slow drain
summary: Lids on the three-door line cooler are in poor repair, with large gaps at corners that cannot be sealed or cleaned. Hand sink drain in cook line is slow but working; repair or replace it.

headline: Dusty fan and greasy equipment needing cleaning
summary: Kitchen entrance fan dusty. Drains, dish machine, three-compartment sink, shelving, and cooking equipment need detail cleaning, which the inspector said would prevent possible contamination and insect activity.

headline: No certified manager during chicken pie prep
summary: No certified food manager on premises while chicken pie was prepared. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, coolers, and shelving; dirty floors and walls. Three-compartment sink faucet leaking; no allergen certificate on site.

headline: Chest freezer ice buildup; floor-wall gap
summary: The chest freezer interior had ice buildup and food debris and must be defrosted and cleaned. A gap between the floor and wall in the dishwashing area needs baseboard installation, including around the mop sink.

headline: Unlabeled bulk foods; exposed light wiring
summary: Bulk food containers, including flour, sugar and beans, had no labels and must be labeled. A light fixture in the tool storage area had exposed wiring and needs repair.

headline: Multiple cleaning, labeling and repair items
summary: Re-inspection found unlabeled bulk food, no splashguard at a 1-compartment sink, scoops left in bulk containers, worn cutting boards, food debris on equipment and walk-in floors, and a cracked light shield. Repairs are needed.

headline: Missing sink stoppers; greasy vent hood
summary: The dish 3-compartment sink was missing two stoppers; additional working stoppers are required. Grease buildup on the ventilation hood must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Allergen training missing; flat boxes outside
summary: Flat cardboard boxes were on top of the outside dumpster and must be removed. The certified food manager on duty lacked allergen training, a repeat violation from May 2023 that was not corrected. Citation issued.

headline: No city sanitation manager; summary not posted
summary: Person in charge lacked a City sanitation certificate; no certified manager was on site for TCS food prep. Food handlers lacked training proof, and no allergen certificate was available. The inspection summary was not posted. Food boxes were stored on floors.

headline: No paper towels at sink; fixed on site
summary: The rear hand sink had no paper towels; corrected on site when staff stocked them during the inspection. Citation issued. Employee food was stored in the same cooler as customer food. Floors along walls and under equipment need cleaning.

headline: Missing hand sign; boxes on basement floor
summary: No handwashing sign at the front bar sink. Beverage boxes and bulk food were stored on the basement floor. Prior uncorrected violations: cracked freezer lid, separating baseboard coving, and no allergen training proof. Citation issued.

headline: Shrimp held too warm; 10 lbs discarded
summary: Shrimp in the meat prep cold holding unit was 48.0-50.7°F; the manager discarded and denatured 10 lbs ($100). Torn freezer gasket, ice buildup in the meat walk-in freezer, grease and food debris on equipment, and milk crates used for shelving. Debris around the dumpster.

headline: Expired handler certificates; hole in wall
summary: Expired food handler certificates were found; employees must obtain valid ones. A hole in the lower east wall must be sealed and missing wall coving replaced. Fryer bottom, floor under cooking equipment and basement corners need cleaning.

headline: No person in charge; managers lack allergen training
summary: No person in charge was on site at inspection. No certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods such as rice and chicken soup were prepared and served; citation issued. Serving plates on kitchen shelves were not inverted. Managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Faucet touching water in basin; door closer broken
summary: The ice cream scoop sink faucet was touching the water in the basin; the person in charge was instructed to repair it to prevent contamination. The toilet room door self-closing device was not functional and needs repair.

headline: Clutter near restroom and sinks
summary: Clutter was found near the rear restroom and the three-compartment and utility sinks. Unused articles and equipment must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Live roaches found; no certified food manager
summary: Three live roaches were on a sandwich cooler, near a coffee machine and at a dining-area condiment station; three live small flies were also seen. No certified food manager was on duty until 9:46 AM. An employee handled food without washing hands.

headline: No certified manager while steaming milk
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while TCS food, such as steamed milk, was handled and served. A food handler lacked food handler certification. The operator was instructed to obtain both.

headline: Ice machine debris; low hot water pressure
summary: Debris encrusted inside the ice machine needs detail cleaning and servicing. No thermometer in the grab-and-go soup and salad cooler in the customer area. Low hot water pressure at a handwashing sink. Floors in the additional bar were dirty with syrup spills.

headline: Rat droppings, warm coolers; 153 lbs discarded
summary: More than 50 rat droppings were found in basement storage, with some in prep areas. Cold food held at 53.6-63.2°F; walk-in and reach-in coolers at 61.9°F and 62.2°F. 153 lbs of TCS food disposed, worth about $1,500. Coolers were tagged and held.

headline: Missing hand sink; three-compartment sink floods
summary: The food service line with a cooler and microwave has no handwashing sink; the manager must install one. The 3-compartment sink drains poorly, so one compartment floods another and must be serviced. A certified food manager lacked allergen training. Citations issued.

headline: Food and debris on floors and surfaces
summary: Re-inspection found food stored on floors in prep and storage areas, single-use items on the basement floor, and food debris on sinks, prep tables and cooking equipment. Floors under equipment also had debris.

headline: 150 mouse droppings found throughout facility
summary: About 150 mouse droppings were found behind tables and buckets, at an exterior apartment doorway and throughout the basement. Bulk flour and sugar lacked labels, and no food handler certificates were on site. Citation issued.

headline: Dead roaches found in basement
summary: Several dead roaches were found under the basement utility sink and must be removed and cleaned. A torn freezer door gasket was also noted, and unused equipment in basement storage should be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Cracked scoop and cutting boards on floor
summary: A cracked scoop used on the flat-top grill must be replaced. Two cutting boards were leaning on the floor and must be washed, sanitized and stored properly. Foil on shelves under the rear prep table must be removed.

headline: Grease buildup, cardboard liner, slow sink
summary: Greasy, dusty storage rack above the prep table and dried grease on cooking equipment need detail cleaning. Remove the cardboard liner. The slow-draining 3-compartment sink needs repair. No allergen training certificate on site.

headline: Cluttered and dirty floors; equipment needs cleaning
summary: Prep tables, microwave interior and refrigerator shelves need cleaning. Excess clutter in the front and prep areas must be removed. Floors behind the service counter and under grocery racks had litter and debris.

headline: Loose sink knob fixed; no food handler certificate
summary: A loose hot water knob at a handwashing sink was tightened and repaired during the inspection. No food handler certificate was on site for an employee; management must show valid proof of training and keep certificates on site.

headline: Prior violations uncorrected; citation issued
summary: Violations from the April 2024 inspection were not corrected: no splashguard between the rear hand sink and 3-compartment sink, a torn refrigerator door gasket, and a leaking front prep hand sink faucet. Citation issued.

headline: No date marks; covered hot food cooling
summary: Packaged TCS food in the grab-and-go cooler had no discard dates. Hot food was covered during cooling, and no sanitizer test strip was available for the 3-compartment sink. The food manager had no allergen certificate.

headline: Rust on walk-in shelving; peeling ceiling paint
summary: Rust was found on the wire storage rack inside the walk-in cooler and must be removed, then repainted or replaced. Peeling paint on the ceiling above the janitor's closet must be repaired to a smooth, cleanable surface.

headline: No hot water at north-end sinks
summary: Sinks at the north end had no hot running water, reading 68.0-70.0°F. Staff were told to use south-end facilities until the plumbing is repaired to 100-120°F. Two handwashing sinks lacked signage. Citation issued.

headline: Rust and chipped paint on walk-in shelving
summary: Chipped paint and rust on wire storage racks in the walk-in cooler must be removed, and the shelves repainted or replaced. Fountain drink nozzles and drip pan need detail cleaning. A food handler lacked a certificate; proof of training must be shown.

headline: Missing backflow devices and grease trap
summary: Inspector found no backflow prevention devices on the new coffee and espresso machines, utility sink and ice machine, and no approved grease trap on the 3-compartment sink. A ceiling hole above the rear prep area and service window must be sealed.

headline: No food handler training proof for employees
summary: No proof of food handler training or certificates for employees was available on site. The operator must provide them.

headline: Ice machine panel damaged; repair needed
summary: The interior panel of the ice machine is in poor repair and has an opening. The operator must repair it so it is smooth, even and easily cleanable.

headline: Nozzles in still sanitizer; dusty fan covers
summary: Soda dispenser nozzles and cleaning utensils sat in still, room-temperature sanitizer between uses; they must be kept on a dry, clean surface. Fan covers in the beer walk-in cooler at the outdoor bar were dusty and need cleaning.

headline: No certified food manager; no employee health policy
summary: Person in charge lacked a certified food manager certificate, and no certified manager was on duty while TCS foods were prepared. No signed employee health policies; no food handler training; no test kit for the 3-compartment sink. Citations issued.

headline: No city sanitation manager while handling TCS food
summary: No City of Chicago food sanitation manager was on site while chicken and other TCS foods were being prepped. The front hand sink was blocked by a bag of creamer. Soiled mop heads were not stored properly. Citation issued.

headline: No splash guard at rear prep sink; rusty shelving
summary: No splash guard is in place at the rear prep hand sink; one must be installed to prevent possible contamination. Walk-in cooler shelving has excessive rust and must be replaced with smooth, easily cleanable shelving.

headline: No chemical sanitizers; repeat violations
summary: No chemical sanitizer on site for equipment and utensils; citation issued. Repeat violations not fixed: 1/4-inch gap at the front door, wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer, worn cutting boards, and no backflow device on the rear mop sink.

headline: Cooling units off at 84°F; no cleanup kit
summary: Cold holding and freezer units were off, and one unit read 84°F; the refrigerator must reach 41°F or below. No vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit or probe thermometer. Rear exit door has openings, and the garbage container overflowed. Rear storage area lacked light.

headline: Mouse droppings found on counter and floor
summary: About 10 mouse droppings were on the counter behind the pizza warmer, and about 20 on the floor under rear dry storage shelves. No handwashing signage; multiple food handlers lacked hair restraints. Priority foundation violation for rodent activity.

headline: Food handler skipped handwashing; dumpster overflowing
summary: A food handler washed dishes in the rear prep area, then began preparing food without washing hands; priority violation with citation issued. The outside dumpster was overflowing with trash, with lids open and trash above the rim.

headline: Nacho chips stored in cardboard boxes
summary: Nacho chips were stored in cardboard boxes. The operator was instructed to use proper containers and utensils.

headline: About 50 live flying insects; prior violation uncorrected
summary: About 50 live small flying insects were on walls and ceilings of both food prep areas. A prior pest violation from September 2025 was not corrected, and more pest control service is needed. Missing ceiling tiles also noted.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; floor debris
summary: Several food handler certificates had expired and must be renewed. The meat grinder had meat debris built up inside and needs cleaning. Debris on floors along walls and in corners of utility and storage areas must be cleaned.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food, boxes on floor, utensil issues
summary: Unlabeled bulk food, food boxes on walk-in floors, a cup used as a scoop, and cardboard knife covers were found. Fryers, prep tables, floors and walls have heavy grease and debris buildup. Toilet room receptacles were uncovered.

headline: Flies, unsafe food temperatures, some fixes made
summary: Over 40 small flies were seen in dishwashing, storage and bar areas; pest control was recommended. Cold food at 49.1-66.4°F, chicken at 130.6°F, and vacuum-packed food lacking approval were discarded. Hand dryer and paper towels fixed on site.

headline: Tofu stored on garbage can; floors need cleaning
summary: A tofu container was stored on top of an open garbage can near cooking equipment; an employee moved it to a nearby table on site. The rear exit door has an opening at the bottom that must be sealed. Floors under cooking equipment and the floor drain need cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled bulk foods; leaking pipe, pooled water
summary: Bulk foods such as salt need common-name labels. A cook lacked an effective hair restraint. Soiled linens in the outdoor walkway need sealed containers. A basement pipe leaks into a bucket and needs repair; floor water must be removed.

headline: No splash guard at rear prep hand sink
summary: No splash guard was between the exposed hand sink and the prep table in the rear prep area. The person in charge was instructed to install a washable splashguard and maintain it.

headline: Sanitizer at 0 ppm; cold food too warm
summary: Dish machine sanitizer read 0 ppm; the manager replaced the solution on site. Various cold foods were held at 44-46°F; about $50 of food was discarded. A prep cooler at 46°F had been tagged earlier with no documented removal; a technician serviced it.

headline: Live flies found; doors not screened or sealed
summary: About 2 live large flies were in the front bar and about 2 in the food prep area; citation issued. The side door was open without a screen, and the front door had a 1-inch gap at the bottom.

headline: Truck lacks license number and trash can
summary: The truck's license number was not printed on its sides; it must be at least 2 inches tall. The truck had no trash can. The hood system was not adequately pulling air and needs repair.

headline: Roach infestation: 15 or more live roaches
summary: About 15 or more live roaches were seen on prep-area floors, walls and pipe crevices, some coming from under cold units. Roach droppings were found under the three-compartment sink, plus dead roaches throughout. A cooler held at 54.5°F.

headline: No pest control logbook or allergen training
summary: No pest control logbook or proof of pest service on site, including the company's state business license number. The certified manager lacks allergen training; the operator must obtain it and keep verification on site. Priority foundation violation.

headline: Splash guard needed; crates, wall and floor damage
summary: The front hand sink needs a splash guard next to the meat slicer, or the slicer must be removed. Crates used for food storage near the 3-compartment sink must be removed. A hole in the lobby wall and a damaged floor tile need repair.

headline: Lettuce touching linens; no sanitizer test kit
summary: Lettuce in the prep cooler was in direct contact with linens. No chemical test kit was on site for the bleach sanitizer; citation issued. Mold-like residue was on caulking around the 3-compartment sink, and the front prep hand sink pipe leaks.

headline: No handwashing sign; wiping cloths on tables
summary: No handwashing sign near the rear dishwashing hand sink. Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables; a tall cooler had a torn gasket; the front ice cream freezer had ice buildup; washroom sinks drain slowly; dirt, grease and dust need cleaning.

headline: Ice buildup in upstairs walk-in cooler
summary: Slight ice buildup was seen on the ceiling and pipes of the upstairs walk-in cooler. The operator was instructed to correct it and keep it in good condition.

headline: Repeat violations: consumer advisory, summary posting
summary: The consumer advisory violation from April 2025 was not corrected in time and is now a priority violation with citation. The most recent inspection summary from March 2025 was not posted; an older May 2024 summary was. Floor grout, damaged tiles and a leaking sink also need repair.

headline: No high-temperature dish machine thermometer or strips
summary: The high-temperature dish machine had no irreversible thermometer and no heat strips on site. The operator was instructed to obtain them. Recorded as a priority foundation violation under rule 7-38-005.

headline: Food handler proof missing; repeat violation
summary: Food handlers lacked proof of food handler training. A City food sanitation manager on duty lacked required allergen training, a repeat violation from March 2023 that was not corrected. Citation issued.

headline: Leak under sink; no hood filters installed
summary: A small leak at the pipe under the 3-compartment sink must be repaired. Items were stored on the floor in the front counter and prep areas, and unnecessary items were in the restroom. No filters in the hood system; the certified manager has no allergen certificate on site.

headline: Cardboard shelf liners; prep area floor debris
summary: Cardboard was used as a liner on walk-in cooler storage shelves and must be removed. Accumulated food debris throughout the prep area needs cleaning.

headline: No valid sanitation manager certificate on site
summary: The person in charge lacked food service sanitation manager training, and no valid original City sanitation manager certificate was on site during TCS food prep. A grease trap was leaking at a pipe and seeping liquid. Citations issued.

headline: No certified food manager on site; repeat violations
summary: Person in charge (PIC) lacked a City sanitation certificate; no certified food manager was on site during TCS food prep and service. Previously uncorrected violations: front door not rodent-proofed, and no allergen training certificate. Citation issued.

headline: No city certified manager while TCS food prepared
summary: Person in charge lacked a City sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was on site while TCS foods were served. Clean utensils hung above a dirty wash basin. The front hand sink drains extremely slowly. Another location's summary was posted here; citation issued.

headline: Cooked chicken at 101°F; 10 lbs discarded
summary: Cooked chicken in a 2-door cooler was 101°F; the manager discarded 10 lbs ($126). Food boxes stored on walk-in floors, employees without hair restraints, and a greasy outside grease container, a food source for rodents. Citation issued.

headline: No cooler thermometer; no food handler proof
summary: No visible thermometer in the walk-in cooler, and no proof of food handler training for any food handler. Rags and buckets were stored on the floor, and ceiling and floor tiles were damaged.

headline: No certified manager; dish machine at 0 ppm
summary: No City food sanitation manager was on site while eggs, milk and turkey were prepared; citation issued. The low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged and held. Some workers lacked hair restraints and food handler certificates.

headline: No food handler training certificates for employees
summary: No food handler training certificates for employees handling food; the operator must obtain and maintain valid certificates. Fryers had grease, food and dirt buildup; a 3-compartment sink faucet leaks; the mop sink lacks a backflow device; front and rear ceiling tiles are damaged.

headline: No certified manager; dish machine not sanitizing
