summary: No certified food manager was on duty while salads, chicken and beans were prepared; citation issued. The low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine and was not to be used until fixed. Dirty wiping cloths and a torn gasket were also noted.

headline: Unlabeled chocolate sauce; missing light cover
summary: A container believed to hold chocolate sauce had no label and must be labeled when food is removed from its original container. The employee washroom light bulb cover is missing and the vent is dirty.

headline: Heavy mineral buildup inside dish machine
summary: Heavy mineral buildup was found on the interior of the dish machine. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Thermometers not within easy reach
summary: Thermometers in reach-in refrigerators were not placed where they are easy to read, which is needed to monitor temperatures below 41°F. Liquor room storage shelves are raw wood and must be made smooth and cleanable.

headline: Repeat allergen training violation; citation issued
summary: The certified food manager's allergen training certificate was expired. This repeat violation from report 2620140 (dated 7/7/2025) was not corrected, and a citation was issued.

headline: Taped refrigerator door; damaged ceilings, clutter
summary: A refrigerator door was held closed with tape and must be replaced. Damaged ceiling tiles, broken floor tiles and clutter need repair or removal. Stock must be 6 inches off the floor. Certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Uncovered food and styrofoam trays
summary: Rice and sugar were in uncovered containers in the hallway to the kitchen; food must be covered. Single-use styrofoam trays faced up on the prep table and must be inverted. Handwashing signage is needed at the kitchen prep sink.

headline: Openings, damaged floors and missing allergen certificate
summary: Openings into ceilings and peeling walls in the food prep and basement dry storage areas must be sealed and repainted. Missing and damaged floor tiles, a missing ceiling tile, and greasy floors and equipment need repair and cleaning. The certified manager lacked an allergen certificate.

headline: No person in charge; bare-hand food contact
summary: No person in charge or certified food manager on duty while TCS food was prepared. An employee handled ready-to-eat food with bare hands while touching a computer and her hair; citation issued. Cold foods at 48-56°F; 10 lbs discarded.

headline: Meat in grocery bag; cleaning needed
summary: Some meat in the basement deep freezer was stored in a grocery bag; food must be stored only in food-grade bags. Clean fryer bottoms, equipment exteriors, bulk and garbage containers, and the floors and walls around equipment. Label bulk containers.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; leaks fixed on site
summary: Bar dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine until the manager changed the sanitizer bottle; it now reaches 100 ppm. A severe leak under the bar sink and a backed-up kitchen floor drain were fixed on site. Unneeded items must be removed to prevent pest harboring.

headline: No certified manager 11:10-11:45 AM during tuna prep
summary: No certified manager on site from 11:10 to 11:45 AM while tuna and other TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. No food handler certificates or allergen training were on site. An employee lacked a hair restraint. Debris, grease and ice buildup in several areas.

headline: Rodent activity: 80 to 100 mouse droppings
summary: 80 to 100 mouse droppings were found in the rear area, washroom, dishwashing area, under the front counter and inside the lobby soda machine cabinet. The front door is not fully rodent-proofed. Pest control service and cleaning are required before reinspection.

headline: Cold food too warm; 40 lbs discarded
summary: Cold TCS foods held at 45.5-77.5°F, including raw eggs; 40 lbs ($250) discarded. Two cold holding units read 47.5-52.2°F; one was replaced, and the new unit read 30.2°F at the 10/8/2025 reinspection. Handwashing signs were missing; boxes were stored on the floor.

headline: Ice machine slimed; no employee health policy
summary: The ice machine interior was heavily soiled with black, pink and grey slime, and its ice is used for human consumption. No employee health policy or training was on site. Knives were stored between prep table crevices. Citation issued.

headline: Expired food handler cards; loose faucet
summary: Several employees had expired food handler cards; all must complete training and keep records on site. A loose faucet at an exposed hand sink near the pizza station must be repaired. A hood light is burnt out, and dust is near walk-in cooler fans.

headline: Missing cleanup kit, pest logbook, thermometer
summary: No vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit or policy, no stem thermometer, and no pest control service or logbook on site. Rear exit door has a large bottom gap. No mop sink; coving needed in storage room, washroom and under furnace.

headline: Mineral buildup inside basement ice machine
summary: Minor mineral buildup inside the basement ice machine must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Barehanded ready-to-eat meat handling; citation issued
summary: A male employee handled ready-to-eat meat with bare hands while sitting barefoot on the front prep counter, as shown on posted video. Citation issued. A hair covering was added on site; sanitized equipment was moved out of the women's washroom.

headline: Duct-taped gaskets; debris on hand sink faucet
summary: Torn door gaskets on a 3-door prep cooler were sealed with duct tape; the tape must be removed and the gaskets replaced. Excess debris on the faucet handles of an exposed prep-area hand sink must be cleaned.

headline: Clutter, improperly stored mops, missing allergen training
summary: Unused items and equipment at the rear of the facility must be removed. Mops were not stored properly after use. A certified food manager lacked documented allergen training.

headline: Live cockroaches found in food and dining areas
summary: About 5 live cockroaches were seen in food prep and customer dining areas, with dead insects behind a 2-door refrigerator and on basement floors. A food handler lacked proof of training. Citation issued for pest activity.

headline: Unclean front service floors under equipment
summary: Floors under and behind front service equipment were unclean. The operator was instructed to clean floors and floor drains. No insects were noted.

headline: Cold food held too warm; 32 lbs discarded
summary: Cold TCS foods such as pork, bacon and pico de gallo were held at 50.7-69.6°F, above the 41°F limit. The manager voluntarily discarded 32 pounds valued at $280 on site. Citation issued. Menu lacked the required raw or undercooked food disclosure (no citation).

headline: Cold food held too warm; 22 lbs discarded
summary: Diced tomatoes, sausage, shrimp, hot dogs and other cold foods held at 48.9-52.1°F; about 22 lbs ($187) discarded. A small prep cooler read 52.0°F and was tagged. Grocery bags were used as food covers. Some workers lacked hair restraints.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea procedure or supplies
summary: No procedures or supplies were in place for vomiting and diarrhea events; the manager was instructed to provide and maintain them. A leaking drainpipe under the rear hand sink needs repair. Soiled cardboard trays on chip shelves and clutter in the rear storage area.

headline: Door gaps, missing training and allergen certificates
summary: Door gaps must be sealed against insects. Missing or expired food handler training, and missing manager allergen training, were noted. Rust, a damaged cooler-area ceiling and torn booth seats also need repair.

headline: No vomit procedure; summary not posted
summary: No written vomit/diarrhea procedure or adequate supplies on site. The ice machine's backflow device could not be located. Food and dirt debris in the prep area. Food handler certificates were not available for review. The latest inspection summary was not posted; citation issued.

headline: Pizza prep cooler doors misaligned
summary: The doors of the pizza prep cooler are not aligned, making them hard to close properly. The operator was instructed to repair and maintain them.

headline: No health policy, sanitizer or cleaning agent
summary: No proof of an employee health policy. No sanitizer or cleaning agent for the 3-compartment sink, and no soap or hand drying at a hand sink. Two refrigerators lack thermometers, and there is no probe thermometer. Rear doors lack screens. Vehicle lacks hot water.

headline: Passed with conditions: food too warm, cooler tagged
summary: Sausage patties at 58.4°F and chicken croissants at 59.5°F held in sandwich cooler; about $50 discarded. Main sandwich cooler at 62.4°F is tagged and off-limits until the city health department removes the tag.

headline: Passed: large wall hole, debris in dry storage corners
summary: Large open hole in wall near cooking equipment must be repaired and kept smooth and cleanable. Debris and grime in corners of dry storage areas must be cleaned.

headline: Passed with conditions: blocked hand sink, open food
summary: Hand sink in main prep area blocked by trays and pans; must stay free of obstructions. Open food containers placed outside sneeze guard protection at front service lines. Food handler without hair restraint. Employee food placed next to customer food.

headline: Passed with conditions: expired allergen certificates
summary: No written employee health policy on premises; must provide signed copies. Expired allergen training certificates; citation issued. No hand washing signs at front and second-floor bar sinks. Ice scoops stored on ice bin; burnt-out light above sink.

headline: Passed with conditions: roach carcasses, indoor smoking
summary: Roach carcasses found throughout basement; manager told to remove them. A person was smoking inside on arrival, and the ashtray was hidden under a counter. Operator refused to let the inspector examine further.

headline: Failed: dog on site; blocked sinks; food on floor
summary: Prohibited dog was on site and removed during inspection. Hand sinks blocked by containers and used to wash cutting boards; paper towels were missing. Walk-in condenser dripping into pan on buckets. Food stored on floor; prior violations uncorrected.

headline: Passed: wiping cloths, dirty equipment, broken tiles
summary: Wiping cloths must be kept in clean sanitizing solution. Large can opener, sides of cooking equipment, and basement wall bases need cleaning. Broken floor tiles in prep area need replacing.

headline: Passed with conditions: eggs at 46°F, dead insects
summary: Shell eggs held at 46°F in prep cooler; must stay at 41°F or below; citation issued. Dead insects on floors of prep, bar, and dry storage areas; to be removed. Grease trap exterior, walls, and floor need cleaning.

headline: Passed: no thermometer in cooler, no hair restraint
summary: No visible working thermometer in front two-door prep cooler; must provide. Employee not wearing hair restraint while serving food. Rusty table bottoms in basement prep area; dusty vents and greasy hood above cooking equipment.

headline: Passed: spilled soda, tape on pipes, food debris
summary: Soda caddy spillage must be cleaned. Tape wrapped around floor drain pipes of hand sink and three-compartment sink must be removed, and overhead trim repaired. Excess food debris under and along wall bases, including walk-in cooler, must be cleaned.

headline: Passed: unused ice machine, fryer lacks ventilation
summary: Unused, non-working small ice machine on site must be removed. Fryer lacks commercial ventilation; must be ventilated properly or removed from the premises.

headline: Failed: sausage held too cool; cold food too warm
summary: About 5 pounds of sausage patties held at 117–120.2°F, below the 135°F hot-holding standard; discarded. Chorizo at 55°F and diced tomatoes at 60°F also discarded. No food thermometer on site. Egg items on menu lack required raw-food advisory.

headline: Failed: no handwashing sink, thermometer, or handler certificates
summary: No handwashing sink in facility; one must be installed. No food thermometer on site, and no food handler certificates on site. Milk crates used as shelving; soiled mop heads, dusty vents, and missing ceiling covers noted.

headline: Passed with conditions: produce and chicken held too warm
summary: Shredded lettuce, tomatoes and chicken wings held at 52–57°F, above the 41°F limit; about 8 pounds discarded. Also crates used for storage, unlabeled containers, missing handwashing sign, and a loose walk-in cooler door panel.

headline: Passed: mop not stored to dry, pest risk
summary: Mop stored in a position that does not let it dry, which risks pest harborage. Must be hung so it air-dries without soiling.

headline: Passed with conditions: cold foods held too warm, unit tagged
summary: Fish, milk, cheese, bacon, and other cold foods held at 45.7–58.3°F; about 30 pounds ($250) discarded. Small cold-holding unit tagged at 48.9°F. Gap under rear exit door; leaking hand sink drain; damaged floor tiles. Expired allergen certificate.

headline: Passed with conditions: no vomit cleanup kit or procedure
summary: No vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit or written procedure on site. Must be provided and kept on site at all times. Priority foundation violation.

headline: Passed: lead-safety check for clay cups, leaks
summary: Ceramic cups on site must have lead-free documentation or be removed. Leaks under three-compartment sink and bar hand sink. Dirty sinks at east bar; no light where ice machine is located; rusty shelves under prep tables; missing hand-washing sign.

headline: Passed: blackened moldy walker-in area, upkeep problems
summary: Blackened, moldy walls and ceiling in produce walk-in cooler. Ice scoops stored on top of ice machine; unlabeled storage containers; no working thermometer in meat and seafood areas. Food debris in floor drains. Several repairs needed.

headline: Passed with conditions: expired manager allergen training
summary: Previous high-priority violation not corrected: certified food manager has no current allergen training. Current allergen training certificates must be provided for all certified food managers. Citation issued.

headline: Failed: raw chicken held too warm, 200 pounds discarded
summary: Raw chicken held at 44.8°F inside walk-in cooler; must be 41°F or below. About 200 pounds, worth $1,000, discarded voluntarily. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Passed: leaking washroom sink drain, damaged light shields
summary: Leaking drainpipe under washroom hand sink must be repaired. Damaged light shields in rear prep and dishwashing area must be replaced.

headline: Passed: hole in dock door, items on floor, leaks
summary: Hole at base of dock door in dumpster area must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Single-use bags stored in washroom; food items stored on floor under prep table. Leaking three-compartment faucet; missing wall and vent covers.

headline: Passed: product on floor, milk crates, leaking faucet
summary: Some products stored on floor and milk crates; needs proper storage rack that allows monitoring and cleaning underneath. Slight leak at three-compartment sink faucet. Dusty air vent in prep area; debris in basement corners and along wall bases.

headline: Passed with conditions: no certified manager on duty
summary: No certified food manager with valid certificate on duty while cold and hot foods were stored, prepared, or served; citation issued. No employee health policy on site. Also missing hair restraint, lidless trash can, loose cooler gasket, dirty vents.

headline: Passed with conditions: employees eat at prep area
summary: Employees ate and drank at prep area; hands not washed or gloves changed between tasks; citation issued. Hot-holding beef (130.8°F) and ham (121°F) below 135°F; discarded. Gap at side door; food stored on floor.

headline: Passed: hole in closet floor, clutter, greasy equipment
summary: Small hole between wall and floor of walk-in closet must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Closet has built-up items to remove. Greasy cooking equipment and possible food splatter on kitchen walls need cleaning.

headline: Failed: flying insects, no certified manager, unsafe ice
summary: About 50 live small flying insects on walls, ceilings and equipment. No certified food manager on site. Black slime dripping from ice machine into ice. Cooked beef held at 53.7–55.5°F; about $300 of food discarded.

headline: Passed: boxes on floor, greasy fryer area
summary: Happy Meal boxes stored on floor in rear storage and drive-thru window; must be stored at least 6 inches off floor. Beverage equipment has syrup and dried debris. Grease on floor under heavy fryers must be removed.

headline: Passed: hole in walk-in cooler floor, dirty walls
summary: Hole in walk-in cooler floor must be repaired. Walls, ceiling, and fan covers inside cooler need cleaning. Floors along wall bases and corners need cleaning to remove spills, debris, and grease.

headline: Passed: trash can in restroom lacks lid
summary: Trash receptacle in unisex toilet room has no cover or lid. Must provide one with a lid and maintain it.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings throughout; no dumpster contract
summary: About 60 mouse droppings on floors of rear storage area under pallets; pallets must be moved and area cleaned. Additional pest control needed. No commercial dumpster contract; must provide one. Ice machine not clean. Northeast exit not rodent-proof.

headline: Failed: no handwashing sink in drink prep area
summary: No handwashing sink in front drink prep area; must be provided. Priority foundation violation.

headline: Passed with conditions: glove change lapse, food discarded
summary: Dishwasher handled dirty dishes, then clean ones, without changing gloves or washing hands; dishes were rewashed. Cooked chicken (83.6°F) and beef patties (111.3°F) held in hot-holding unit, not reheated; discarded. Plastic cup used as scoop in cut fruit.

headline: Passed: no hairnets; cooler gasket and clutter
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hairnets or restraints; must provide. Torn cooler gasket, ice buildup in walk-in freezer, clutter in basement, and dirt around baseboards throughout. Repairs and cleaning required.

headline: Passed: missing handwashing signs, slow sink drain
summary: Single-use items stored on the floor in prep area; manager told to raise them six inches. Handwashing signs missing at bar sinks. Kitchen handwashing sink drains slowly. Debris under bar equipment to be cleaned.

headline: Passed: dirty gaskets, damaged wall, expired training
summary: Gaskets on cold-hold unit doors in front prep area need cleaning. Wall behind mop sink is damaged and must be sealed. Certified manager's allergen training certificate has expired; updated training must be obtained and kept on site.

headline: Failed: no sanitizer; mobile unit water inlet unlocked
summary: No adequate sanitizer on mobile food unit; must be provided at all times. Fresh water inlet door could not open and lock properly; manager said the key was at home. Business license number not printed on sides at least two inches high.

headline: Failed: over 100 mouse droppings throughout kitchen
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings found throughout kitchen prep area, including along walls, on a grease trap, and under sinks. Expired food handler and allergen training certificates. Grease spills by grease trap and cooking equipment.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings under counter and sink
summary: Still about 20 mouse droppings under front counter, front shelving, and under hand sink at reinspection. Manager removed them during inspection. Facility extremely dirty, with food and grime on floors throughout. Citation issued.

headline: Passed: unlabeled food, dirty cloths, greasy hood
summary: Unlabeled food in coolers and freezers; some stored in grocery bags. Dirty wiping cloths left on prep tables. Dirty kitchen floors, unshielded burnt-out basement bulb, and grease in exhaust hood and filters.

headline: Passed: porous pestle, rusty shelving, unsealed wood
summary: Porous stone pestle and mortar must be removed. Tinfoil liners, rusty shelving, raw wood shelving and baseboards need sealing or replacing. Scooter stored in front dry food area. Bulk rice needs labels; cracked floors need sealing.

headline: Passed: no sushi cooler thermometer; fly traps hung
summary: No thermometer inside sushi prep cooler; management told to provide one in all coolers. Hanging fly traps in food prep area must be removed. Fryer and grease trap need cleaning; hood and filters greasy. Light shield needed.

headline: Food workers without hair restraints
summary: Food employees were preparing food without hair restraints. Management was told all food handlers must wear hair restraints while preparing food.

headline: Passed with conditions: no health policy, hood not working
summary: No written employee health policy on premises. Ventilation hood not working. Ice scoops stored inside ice machines; rear sink lacks drainboard; washrooms lack covered waste receptacles. Openings above prep cooler need sealing; floor drains dusty.

headline: Passed with conditions: no certified manager, sinks blocked
summary: No certified manager on site while foods that must be kept hot or cold were prepared; citation issued. Bar sink blocked by beverage cart and lacked soap; corrected on site, along with missing paper towels. Wiping cloths left in sanitizer-free water.

headline: Passed: unlabeled rice, flour, sugar; dirty cooler shelves
summary: Bulk rice, flour, and sugar containers have no labels and must be labeled. Shelving inside reach-in cooler is not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Passed with conditions: no food handler training
summary: No employees had food handler training; they must obtain it. Certified manager's allergen training certificate expired; manager told to renew or citations will follow. Previous violations not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Passed: rear door gaps, broken cooler door
summary: Rear alley door has multiple gaps larger than 1/4 inch that must be pest-proofed. Three-door prep cooler's left door is broken from its hinges and drags on the floor. Mop sink heavily soiled; unused coolers stored in front dining area.

headline: Passed: greasy corners, holes in walls, no allergen training
summary: Grease, food spills, and dirt in corners throughout facility, especially behind hot cooking equipment and under three-compartment sink; must detail clean. Holes in walls, floors, and ceilings must be repaired. Certified manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Passed: gap under front door, missing sink stopper
summary: Front door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom that must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Only one stopper for the three-compartment sink; no covered washroom receptacle; and an inoperable washroom ventilation fan.

headline: Failed: no hot water throughout establishment
summary: No hot water throughout establishment. Hand sink water measured 88.5°F and 87.5°F; must be at least 100°F. No backflow device at utility sink; must be provided. No citation issued.

headline: Passed: dirty floors behind ice machine
summary: Floors behind the ice machine need cleaning; staff instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Passed: dead insects on glue traps, greasy equipment
summary: Dead insects on some glue traps under rear dishwashing sink. Walk-in freezer gasket damaged and hanging. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment and floors; hood and filters dusty and greasy. Staff told to clean to prevent pests.

headline: Passed: dusty, greasy kitchen cabinets
summary: Loose debris, dirt, and dust in kitchen cabinets. Staff told to detail clean and increase cabinet cleaning; must be kept clean at all times.

headline: Failed: 158 pounds cheese held too warm
summary: About 158 pounds of cheese, worth $1,000, held at 50°F on prep table though labeled to refrigerate; discarded. No handwashing sink in booth, no three-compartment sink, and no employee health policy. Citations issued.

headline: Passed: pink ice machine buildup, burned-out light
summary: Slight pink buildup inside upper portion of ice machine must be cleaned. Food buildup on dish machine drainboards and dusty cooler condensers need cleaning. Burned-out ceiling bulb above dish machine must be replaced.

headline: Passed with conditions: hummus held too warm, mold in ice
summary: Hummus held at 50–53.4°F in cook-area cooler; about 5 pounds ($100) discarded. Black mold-like substance behind ice machine panel dripping into ice. Hand sink lacked soap (provided during inspection) and was blocked by a hose.

headline: Passed: soap at food prep sink, clutter by warewashing
summary: Soap was at the one-compartment food prep sink; must be removed and kept only at handwashing sinks. Ice machine interior dusty. Equipment containers and cleaning supplies clutter the rear warewashing area and must be relocated.

headline: Passed: rust on vents, worn grout in warewashing area
summary: Rust on vents and ceiling tile frames in warewashing area must be removed. Worn grout lines around floor tiles must be regrouted.

headline: Passed with conditions: no original sanitation certificate
summary: No original City sanitation certificate while handling sausage and eggs; a scanned copy was shown. Hand sink blocked by trays was cleared during inspection. Food stored on walk-in cooler floor; leaks at faucets; no covered trash can in employee bathroom.

headline: Failed: hand sinks lack hot water; flies and roaches
summary: Two hand sinks reached only 46°F hot water (100°F required). Dish machines rinsed at 149°F (160°F required) and were tagged. Cold foods held at 48–54°F discarded (~$150). Over 50 small flies and 2 live roaches found.

headline: Passed: front doors not rodent-proof
summary: Front double doors are not rodent-proof, with about 1/2-inch opening between bottom doors; must be sealed. Food storage containers must be labeled when not in original packaging.

headline: Passed with conditions: no soap, paper towels, or sign
summary: No hand-washing sign at bathroom sink; soap missing at dishwashing sink and bathroom; no paper towels at bathroom sink. Priority violation; citation issued. Also unlabeled refrigerated food, cardboard shelf liners, and an ice scoop stored inside ice machine.

headline: Passed: no employee health policy or vomit cleanup kit
summary: No written employee health policy on site; must be established with signed copies. No written procedures or supplies for vomiting or diarrhea cleanup. Clutter by freezer; dust along bar wall bases.

headline: Passed: pink buildup in ice machine, greasy hood
summary: Slight pink buildup inside ice machine; instructed to detail clean. Food debris and grime on floor around cook line and fryer. Grease on hood and filters above cook line. One of two certified managers lacks allergen training.

headline: Passed: food on floor, no manager allergen training
summary: Food items stored on floor in prep area; must be elevated six inches. Self-closing device in poor repair; no covered waste receptacle in washroom; damaged light shields; certified managers have no allergen training.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings, undated food, discards
summary: About 40 mouse droppings along storage area walls; additional pest control service needed. Ready-to-eat foods lacked date marks; about 15 pounds ($90) discarded. Hanging fly traps above food in hot holding area must be removed.

headline: Passed: torn door gasket on prep cooler
summary: Torn gasket on the left door of the three-door prep cooler must be replaced. This is the only issue noted.

headline: Passed with conditions: no food manager certificate posted
summary: No original City of Chicago food manager certificate posted on site; manager told to keep one on site and posted at all times. Heavy ice buildup inside walk-in freezer must be cleaned.

headline: Passed: two thermometers not working
summary: Two thermometers in rear storage room do not work; must repair or remove from premises.

headline: Failed: infestation of 50+ live roaches
summary: 50+ live roaches at front counter and bread cooler; 100+ small flies throughout, including washing area and toilet room. Pest control service required. No certified food manager on duty during food prep; manager arrived at 12:40 p.m.

headline: Passed: missing handwashing signs, unlabeled containers
summary: No handwashing signs near sink in second-floor bar area; must provide and maintain. Food storage containers must be labeled when food is not in original container.

headline: Passed with conditions: hand sink water only 74.5°F
summary: Front prep hand sink had hot water of only 74.5°F; minimum at all hand sinks must be 100°F. Citation issued. Also unlabeled bulk containers, food on floor, dirty wiping cloths, and heavy grease on hood and filters.

headline: Passed: debris under shelves, broken paper towel units
summary: Dirt, food debris, spills, and standing water under shelving and equipment in produce, grocery, bakery, and freezer areas, and between deep fryers. Staff told to clean to prevent pests. Broken, rusted paper towel units in meat areas need replacing.

headline: Failed: no sanitation certificate; ice machine mold
summary: No valid original City sanitation manager certificate on site while oatmeal and ham were served. Pink and black mold-like substance inside ice machine dripping onto ice; ice to be discarded and machine cleaned. Shelving build-up, floor residue, large floor drain with heavy buildup.

headline: Passed with conditions: no soap, corrected on site
summary: No soap at a bakery prep handwashing sink; soap was provided during inspection. Unlabeled salt and sugar, food boxes stored on freezer floor, wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces, and scoops left inside containers. Dirty walk-in floors.

headline: Passed with conditions: warm walk-in, empty sanitizer
summary: Marmalades held at 50.2–51.8°F and milk at 65.4°F in walk-in cooler; about 175 pounds ($809) discarded. Walk-in measured 57.3°F and must not be used until 41°F or below. Empty sanitizer container was refilled on site.

headline: Passed: certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: Certified food manager on duty had no allergen training; certificate expired. Management told all food service managers must have allergen training certification.

headline: Passed: missing hand sign, uncovered cold food
summary: No handwashing sign at 15th-floor pantry sink; must provide. Cold food displayed uncovered; must be covered. Single-use articles stored on floor; must be raised six inches. Walk-in freezer ice buildup; damaged cooler gaskets; milk crates used as shelving.

headline: Passed: single-use utensils stored unsafely for self-service
summary: Single-use utensils for customer self-service were stored improperly. Staff must store them with handles facing out to prevent contamination.

headline: Failed: old violations uncorrected, cold unit handle missing
summary: Missing handle on cold-hold unit in rear prep area. Previous high-priority violations not corrected: plates not stored inverted, peeling baseboard under sink, and hole in wall behind chest freezer.

headline: Failed: employees skipped handwashing before handling food
summary: Drive-thru employees put on gloves and grabbed a bagel from hot-holding unit without washing hands; must wash after every possible contamination. Soap dispensers stolen from women's restroom. Shredded lettuce at 57.2–60.3°F discarded.

headline: Failed: dirty fryer, walls, and hood; old violations
summary: Previous priority violations from 2024 uncorrected: grease and debris on fryers, coolers, prep tables, and wok station; food debris on walls; greasy hood and filters. Worn cooler gaskets and wiping cloths not kept in sanitizer.

headline: Passed: foam cups used as scoops
summary: Foam cups were used as scoops for bulk food containers; staff instructed to use proper scoops.

headline: Passed: plastic curtains, dim walk-in lighting
summary: Food covered with plastic wrap while cooling in walk-in; staff told to leave it loosely covered or uncovered if protected. Walk-in curtains in poor repair, partly replaced with garbage bags. Walk-in lighting too dim.

headline: Passed: dirty slicer, walk-in floors, water-damaged tiles
summary: Deli meat slicer has old food debris; must be detail-cleaned and sanitized between uses. Walk-in cooler floors need cleaning of spills and debris. Water-damaged ceiling tiles in display and rear storage areas must be replaced.

headline: Passed: uncovered flour, plastic lining grill shelves
summary: Flour and other dry food containers not in use were left without adequate covers. Plastic wrap used to line shelves in grill area; must be removed for smooth, cleanable surfaces.

headline: Passed: uncovered bread, missing hair restraints
summary: Bread bins left uncovered in food prep area; must be covered to protect from overhead contamination. Food employees preparing sandwiches without hair restraints; instructed to provide them.

headline: Passed: ice machine residue, sealant and caulking issues
summary: Ice machine interior has residue; must be cleaned. Sealant at splashguard and front hand sink in disrepair. Black and pink substance on caulking and walls around three-compartment sink. Excess debris under beverage station floor drain.

headline: Passed with conditions: no certificate posted, open window
summary: No valid City sanitation manager certificate posted. Window left open without adequate screen, and side door has a 1/2-inch gap; must be pest-proofed. Fryer interior greasy; three-compartment sink runs continuously. Missing wall coving in basement.

headline: Passed with conditions: no health policy, sink issues
summary: No signed employee health policy or vomit/diarrhea cleanup procedure. Gap under front door allows insect entry. Also missing drainboard, leaky faucet, hose needing backflow device, meat slicer debris, and missing wall tiles.

headline: Failed: ice machine slime, no certificate, trash outside
summary: Person in charge had no City sanitation certificate; none was posted or provided. Black slime inside ice machine dripping into ice. Trash piled outside; dumpster lid bent with a hole. Leaks under sink and in freezer.

headline: Failed: dead roaches on site; dirty hood and floors
summary: Dead roaches found near rear exit, on clean pan cart, and under three-compartment sink. No allergen training on site for certified manager. Previous violations not corrected: leaky pipe, dirty coolers, floors, walls, and hood.

headline: Failed: no health policy, leaking hand sink, no covered receptacles
summary: No verifiable employee health policy on site; template left, signed copies must be kept on site. Basement bar hand sink leaks when used, making it inaccessible. Women's restrooms lack covered receptacles. Unused equipment in basement storage.

headline: Passed: gaps at rear door, uncovered freezer food
summary: Gaps around side and bottom of rear exterior door must be sealed to keep pests out. Uncovered food in freezer; cardboard used on table bottoms and equipment tops. No allergen training for person in charge with manager certificate.

headline: Passed: bulk flour, sugar, salt unlabeled
summary: No labels on bulk storage containers of flour, sugar, and salt. All bulk and working ingredient containers must be labeled with the contents' name.

headline: Passed: unlabeled bulk containers, food debris in rear
summary: Bulk containers throughout prep and storage lack labels. Upright cooler outside walk-in cooler is missing its door handle, with food and duct tape residue. Rear prep and dishwashing areas need cleaning to prevent pest feeding; window ledges and floor drains have debris.

headline: Passed with conditions: no employee health policy
summary: No employee health policy on site; must keep verification for each employee on site at all times. No citation issued today.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings; no health policy or certificates
summary: About 60 mouse droppings in prep area and hallway; must clean and sanitize. No employee health policy or vomiting/diarrhea procedure. No sanitizer test strips. No food handler or allergen training certificates on site.

headline: Floors under shelves and equipment need cleaning
summary: Floors under shelves, other kitchen equipment, and corner areas must be cleaned.

headline: No thermometers, rust, and drain overflow
summary: Small reach-in and prep coolers lack thermometers. Food boxes are on the walk-in freezer floor. The 3-compartment sink floor drain backs up and overflows with a strong foul odor; a citation was issued. Weather stripping at the rear door is in poor repair.

headline: Ice buildup, leaks, peeling paint, missing training proof
summary: Wiping cloths were left on prep tables and sinks. Cooking equipment has grease and dirt. Excess ice is inside a freezer. A slow leak is under a rear hand sink. The person in charge lacked food handler training proof.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets and black slime buildup
summary: Torn gaskets are on the meat and outdoor vegetable walk-in cooler doors. Black slime is on the condenser pipe in the meat cooler ceiling. A used cooking oil container outside is greasy. An unused vacuum packaging device must be removed.

headline: Torn cooler gasket and slight sink leak
summary: A torn gasket on the basement walk-in cooler used for proteins must be repaired. A slight leak is under the basement 3-compartment sink. The certified manager on duty lacked allergen training. Soap dispensers must be removed from non-hand sinks.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; goat meat too cool
summary: A low-temperature dish machine measured 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged; it may not be used until reinspected. Two pans of goat meat held at 117F and 113F, below the 135F minimum; about $50 was discarded. No food handler training proof.

headline: Ice bin interior needs cleaning
summary: The ice bin interior needs cleaning. Ice must be removed, the bin cleaned, and the area maintained.

headline: No certified manager; missing health policy
summary: No certified food manager was on site while macaroni, cabbage, and gravy were handled. No written employee health policy. Coke cooler lacks a thermometer. A previous inspection summary was not posted for the public.

headline: Flies, missing hand sinks, no certified manager
summary: About 20 live small flies in the dish area. Dish-area hand sink missing; a prep hand sink wouldn't run. Drink-station hot water only 61F (100F required). No certified food manager on site while hot food was held.

headline: Food on floor, grease buildup, no allergen proof
summary: Food containers were stored on the walk-in cooler floor, and frozen food was in plastic grocery bags. Grease is built up on cooking equipment, walls, and floors. The food service manager lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: Pest control records missing updated report
summary: The pest control logbook lacks an updated service report. The latest report provided was dated October 14, 2024. All required pest control records must be kept on site.

headline: Leaks, grease trap odor, greasy smoker
summary: A P-trap leaks at the 1-compartment sink and the hot water handle leaks. The grease trap needs cleaning to remove odor. Hot holding cabinets, smoker legs, fryers, and the floor under the smoker need cleaning.

headline: No covered bin for sanitary napkins
summary: The employee washroom had no covered receptacle for sanitary napkin disposal. A covered waste receptacle must be provided.

headline: Missing health policy and food handler training
summary: No written employee health policy or food handler training certificates were on site; a 90-day grace period was given for the health policy. No physical barrier separates the dish area from customers. Sink lacks a grease trap and a sanitizer test kit.

headline: Dead insects and cobwebs in small bars
summary: Dead insects and cobwebs were found on glassware, liquor bottles, and cooling units throughout the small bars and must be removed. Two-door cooling units in the main kitchen have dried food debris and spills inside.

headline: Cold food too warm; no hand-wash signs
summary: Cold food was held at 45-50F, above the 41F limit; about $20 of noodles and dumplings was discarded. A cold-holding unit at 50.4F was tagged and held. No hand-washing signs are at sinks. One manager lacks allergen training proof.

headline: Oysters lacked tags; roaches found throughout
summary: Oysters had no shellstock tags; the manager discarded 5 lbs ($15). Various cold foods were held at 50F and discarded ($20). About 5 live roaches were found in toilet rooms, storage, kitchen, and bar, with roach carcasses throughout. A 1/2-inch gap at a rear door needs sealing.

headline: Mouse droppings in storage and basement
summary: About 25-30 mouse droppings are in the rear food storage area, and 30-40 more along basement walls. Management must clean, call pest control, and provide proof of service. Rusty shelving and greasy hood filters were also noted.

headline: No hand-washing signs at prep areas
summary: No hand-washing signage was found at food preparation areas. Signs must be posted.

headline: Floors need cleaning in several areas
summary: Floors need cleaning in the walk-in cooler, between the two-door cooler and oven in front prep, and in the rear area under storage shelves.

headline: Grease, mold, and missing ceiling tile
summary: Fryer exteriors are greasy. Grease drips from the alley exhaust hood and pools on the ground; a citation was issued. Mold-like caulking is at the dish machine, a ceiling tile is missing, and food handlers need training proof.

headline: Hair restraint, entrance gap, storage problems
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. A 1/4-inch gap between front entrance doors needs sealing. Single-service items must be elevated and inverted. Sink stoppers are missing and a washroom fan does not work.

headline: Broken cooler thermometer
summary: A broken thermometer inside the cooler closest to the cashier must be repaired or replaced. No other issues were listed.

headline: Toilet room garbage uncovered; door won't close
summary: A garbage can in the toilet room had no cover. The toilet room door is not self-closing. A mop sink splash guard must be smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Prep cooler too warm; missing signs
summary: A prep cooler measured 71F ambient air with no food inside; it is tagged and may not be used. It must be kept at 41F or below. Missing hand-washing sign in the toilet room. Unused hot-holding unit and hot dog warmer should be removed.

headline: Hot water too cool at sinks and dish area
summary: Inspector noted no hot water throughout the establishment. Hand sinks measured 86.5F to 88.5F, and the 3-compartment sink 95.7F. Hand sinks need at least 100F and the dish sink 110F. Citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; raw wood surfaces
summary: The person in charge lacked a certified manager certificate. No certified manager was on site while protein shakes and pies were handled. Raw wood surfaces in the front prep area must be sealed or painted to be non-porous.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; torn cooler gaskets
summary: Dish machine sanitizing measured 0 ppm chlorine and 125F at final rinse; it must reach 50-100 ppm or 180F. Cooler door gaskets are torn. Dusty ceiling tiles over prep. One allergen training certificate expired.

headline: Dead flies, fly trap placement, rear door gap
summary: Excessive dead flies on a cold-holding unit and prep tables must be removed. An electric fly trap over the front and rear prep areas must be moved. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear door needs sealing. Missing sink stoppers and unlabeled containers were also noted.

headline: Live flying insects; no health policy
summary: About 30 live small flying insects were on stock boxes and prep-area walls; pest control service is needed. No written employee health policy was on premises. No food handler certificates were provided. No inspection summary was posted.

headline: No thermometer in cold unit; torn gasket
summary: The rear cold-holding unit has no thermometer. A front prep cold unit has a torn gasket. Spillage and debris are built up inside cold-holding units throughout the facility. Ventilation filters have grease buildup.

headline: Dirty equipment, missing thermometers, expired certificate
summary: No metal stem thermometers on site for food temperatures. Prep-area staff lacked hair restraints. Fryer, cooking equipment, and coolers were heavily soiled. Two prep-area lights are out. A food handler's certificate expired.

headline: Stained cutting boards; missing certificates
summary: Stained cutting boards in the food prep area need resurfacing or replacement. A hand sink faucet base leaks. Hood filters have grease buildup. No food handler certificates are on premises, and the certified manager lacks an allergen certificate.

headline: Small trash can and kitchen floor debris
summary: The washroom needs a small garbage can with a lid. Kitchen floors need cleaning to remove debris.

headline: Food debris on equipment and floors
summary: Food debris is built up on cooking equipment, holding units, shelving, prep tables, steam tables, coolers, and freezers. Debris is also on floors under equipment and in corners of prep, storage, and basement areas.

headline: Ice machine buildup and loose cold handle
summary: Mineral buildup inside the bar ice machine must be cleaned. Plates and bowls stored facing up must be inverted. A wrench is attached where the cold-water handle should be at the prep sink. Chipping paint on bar floors must be repaired.

headline: No certified manager; cold food held too warm
summary: No certified food manager was on site at opening; the manager arrived about 9:40 AM. Pork and ground beef held at 57F and 55.3F; about $32 discarded. Unlabeled containers, leaking faucets, and broken floor tiles were noted.

headline: Hair restraints, leaks, dirty washroom
summary: Two employees in food prep were without hair restraints. The 3-compartment sink faucet leaks. The customer washroom is dirty and lacks a lidded garbage can. The outside garbage area must be cleaned to avoid a pest food source.

headline: Unlocked outdoor coolers; cutting boards
summary: The rear outdoor walk-in cooler and freezer lack locks or security measures on doors. A cutting board has deep, dark grooves. Unused equipment and clutter in the rear outdoor area must be removed.

headline: 50 lbs food discarded; no date labels
summary: Ready-to-eat food stored over 24 hours had no date labels. The manager discarded 50 lbs (about $200). Food handlers lack training proof. Prior report violations were not corrected, including handwashing signs, unlabeled containers, and missing allergen certificate.

headline: Torn screen door; hand sink drain repair
summary: The rear screen door has mesh and frame gaps that pests could reach; it must be repaired or replaced. Stove surfaces are greasy. The kitchen hand sink drain has a minor leak and drains slowly.

headline: No valid certified manager on site
summary: The person in charge lacked food safety training proof. Food handlers prepared temperature-controlled food without a valid certified manager on site. Hair restraints are missing. Ice buildup and cardboard were removed during the inspection.

headline: No hot or cold water at 3-compartment sink
summary: The 3-compartment sink had no hot or cold running water; repair is required. The pest control logbook lacks vehicle service reports. No employee health policy was on site.

headline: Roaches, no certified manager, improper thawing
summary: About 15 live cockroaches behind the 3-compartment sink. Frozen shrimp thawed in standing water. No certified food manager on site while temperature-controlled food was handled. No food thermometer or sanitizer test strips.

headline: No written health policy; torn cooler gasket
summary: No written employee health policy is on the premises. A signed policy must be provided for each employee. A torn door gasket is inside the bar cooler. Kitchen exhaust hood filters are missing.

headline: Live cockroaches in rear storage room
summary: Live cockroaches were found around the water heater in the rear storage room. Pest control service is recommended. Shelves throughout the facility and in the walk-in cooler had food debris and dirt.

headline: Broken thermometers and leaking sink
summary: Broken air thermometers in cooling units throughout the store must be fixed. Curbside cooling units have dried food debris. The 3-compartment sink faucet leaks. Produce cooler and bakery floors need cleaning.

headline: Torn gasket; unused equipment still on premises
summary: A torn door gasket on the 3-door prep cooler must be replaced. Unused equipment outside washrooms and in dry storage must be removed. A prior core violation for unused equipment behind the dish area was not corrected.

headline: Hair restraint, dirty coolers, stripped cold tap
summary: One food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. Food buildup is inside reach-in prep coolers around doors and hinges. The washroom hand sink cold-water handle is stripped and must be repaired.

headline: Over 40 live flies; pest control needed
summary: Over 40 small live flies are in the ceiling of the rear dish and prep area. The flies must be removed and pest control called. An interior screen door is not sealed. The fry cutter is dirty and a faucet leaks.

headline: Missing thermometers, yard clutter, poor lighting
summary: Cooling units holding cold deli meat, sour cream, and other cold foods lack working thermometers. The outside yard has excessive stored equipment, trash, and couches. Rear storage area lighting is inadequate.

headline: No food handler certificate for dishwasher
summary: A female dishwasher had no food handler certificate. Dry storage and spice containers lacked product-name labels. The food service manager on site lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: Hot food held too cool; mold-like shelves
summary: Potatoes, chicken, and deep-dish pizza held at 104-124F in a warming rack; 135F or above is required. The manager discarded 12 lbs ($239). Rear walk-in cooler shelves have a mold-like substance and need cleaning.

headline: Leaky pipe and broken door closer
summary: A leaky pipe under the bar's 3-compartment sink must be repaired. The self-closing device on the employee washroom door is in poor repair.

headline: Food debris buildup and a loose vent
summary: Food debris is built up under toaster shelving, in the walk-in cooler, and on the soda dispenser. A loose vent over the rear utility sink needs repair. Soup warmer area floor and walls need cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled containers and food stored on floor
summary: Food and spices lacked product-name labels after being moved from original containers. Basement food must be raised six inches off the floor. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables. Ice machine and cooler buildup need cleaning.

headline: Rust, milk crates, leaks, broken floor tiles
summary: Rusty prep table bottom must be repainted or replaced. Tape used as floor repair must be removed. Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced. A 3-compartment faucet base leaks, a refrigerator gasket is damaged, and floor tiles are broken.

headline: Rust, torn curtain, and missing allergen proof
summary: Rusty shelving in the coleslaw cooler and walk-in cooler must be replaced or cleaned. A torn plastic curtain and exposed insulation on pipes need fixing. Bicycles may not be stored in dry storage. No allergen training proof for certified managers.

headline: Manager lacked certificate; floor debris
summary: The manager on site lacked a valid City of Chicago food service manager license while pastries and dairy were prepared and served. The front service area floor has dirt, dust, and food debris under the counter and equipment.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; storage fixes needed
summary: Stored items must be raised off floors. Raw wooden crates and cloth towels may not be used as supports or liners. Ice bins need lids. Bar hand sink has low water pressure. Several food handlers have expired certificates.

headline: Expired food handler certificates on site
summary: Re-inspection found expired food handler training certificates on site. Valid certificates must be provided.

headline: No certified manager; cold food too warm
summary: No certified food manager certificate was posted while food was prepared and served. Cold food was held at 44-48F, above the 41F limit; about $120 of meat and chicken was discarded. Rusted walk-in racks from a prior report remain.

headline: About 100 mouse droppings found on premises
summary: About 100 mouse droppings were found in dry storage, the liquor room, the break room, and a computer closet. Management must clean them and get more pest control service. A 1/2-inch gap between floor and wall must be sealed.

headline: Blocked hand sink, no towels, repeat allergen violation
summary: A front prep hand sink was blocked by a metal pan while staff served customers, and it had no paper towels. Wiping cloths were improperly stored. A cutting board is deeply grooved. Allergen certificates are still missing from a prior report.

headline: Low water pressure; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: The employee bathroom and customer hand sinks need better water pressure. Large bulk food containers in the basement prep area need proper labels.

headline: Torn gasket on two-door milk cooler
summary: A torn door gasket inside the two-door milk cooler must be replaced.

headline: Stored items must be off floors
summary: All stored items throughout the facility, including cases of soda, must be elevated from the floor so floors can be cleaned and monitored.

headline: No certified manager; dish machine at 0 ppm
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken was prepared and served. The low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm and was tagged. Paper towels and soap were missing from hand sinks, and were obtained during the inspection. Pest log has only 2021 reports.

headline: Missing signs; food stored on floors
summary: No handwashing signage is at the exposed bar hand sink. Boxed food is stored on basement freezer and cooler floors, and cardboard lines shelves. Cutting boards are deeply scratched. Grease and food debris are on equipment and floors.

headline: Hair restraints, leaks, and burnt-out hood bulbs
summary: Food handlers in prep areas were not wearing hair restraints. Wiping cloths were stored on prep surfaces. The 3-compartment sink faucet leaks from the hot water knob. Hood bulbs are blown and filters are dirty.

headline: No manager on site; no health policy
summary: No person in charge or valid certified food manager was on site while coffee and pastries were handled. No completed employee health policy. The hand sink lacks a handwashing sign. The 3-compartment sink faucet leaks, and mops are stored in water.

headline: Food residue in cooler and debris under ice machine
summary: Food residue is in the bottom of a two-door cooler next to the ice machine. Food and debris are under the ice machine. The person in charge lacks allergen training and must get a certificate.

headline: Spills, slow drain, and burned-out lights
summary: Spills under the beverage station need cleaning. The front prep hand sink drains slowly and must be repaired. Burned-out light bulbs in the dining area and coffee prep area must be replaced.

headline: Milk crates used as storage shelving
summary: Milk crates are used as shelving in the storage area and must be removed. Replacement shelving must sit at least 6 inches off the floor to allow cleaning.

headline: Dead insects along dining room walls
summary: About 30 to 40 dead insects, including ants and house flies, were along walls in the front eating area. Utensils in the steam table were stored in water below 135F. The floor drain under the 3-compartment sink was heavily soiled.

headline: Minor leak under dish area sink
summary: A minor leak is at the drain pipe below the 3-compartment sink next to the dish machine. The leak must be repaired.

headline: No food handler certificates on site
summary: No food handler certificates were on site for staff who handle food. All certified food managers must show proof of allergen training.

headline: Door gap, leaks, and missing training certificates
summary: A 1/4-inch gap between front doors could let pests in; weather stripping is required. Standing water and a leaking pipe near the prep area must be fixed. Only 2 employees had food handler training.

headline: No hand-wash signs; leaks; greasy equipment
summary: No handwashing signs are at any hand sink. The front hand sink leaks profusely, and the rear 3-compartment faucet leaks. Cut fruit in the display cooler is unlabeled. Deep fryers, coolers, freezers, and walls need detail cleaning.

headline: Thermometer needed; foil liners; leaking faucet
summary: A visible, working thermometer is needed in the rear 2-door prep cooler. Aluminum foil lining shelving and cooking equipment must be removed. Rusty prep table bottom must be repainted or replaced. A 3-compartment sink faucet base leaks.

headline: Gap over one inch at screen door
summary: Re-inspection found a gap of over one inch at the bottom of a side screen door, a possible pest entry point. The manager was told to seal all outer openings on the door.

headline: No mop sink on premises
summary: The premises has no mop sink with hot and cold running water. The manager was instructed to provide one. No other issues were listed.

headline: Live roaches found; restroom water too cool
summary: Six live roaches were crawling near the prep cooler, ice cream freezer, and walls, with several dead roaches under the tea machine. Staff restroom hand sinks measured 77F and 83.3F; 100F is required.

headline: Splash guard needed at dump sink
summary: A splash guard must be installed on the left side of the one-compartment dump sink, between the sinks and stored clean glassware.

headline: No discharge from eyes, nose, or mouth
summary: The only item recorded for this inspection was no discharge from eyes, nose, or mouth. No comments or violations were noted.

headline: Expired allergen certificates; ice machine buildup
summary: Both certified food managers had expired allergen training certificates; current certificates must be provided. Mineral buildup inside the ice machine must be cleaned.

headline: Hot water too cool; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Unisex restroom hand sinks measured 93.4F; 100F is required. Low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm. No signed employee health policies. Walk-in gaskets are broken, shelves rusted, and debris needs cleaning.

headline: Employee clothing stored with food containers
summary: Employee clothing was placed on a shelf with food containers. Staff were instructed to store clothing separately. No other violations were listed.

headline: Holes in basement allow possible pest entry
summary: Multiple holes and openings in basement ceilings, walls, behind walk-in coolers, around pipes, and under stairs could let pests in. All openings must be sealed.

headline: Blocked hand sinks, leaks, dirty floors
summary: Basement fruit prep and bakery hand sinks were blocked by wiping cloths and a brush. The 3-compartment sink leaks. Heavy food debris is in the walk-in fish cooler. Several exhaust hood and dairy cooler lights are out.

headline: Flour buildup in front storage cabinet
summary: The interior of the front storage cabinet needs cleaning to remove flour buildup.

headline: Dirty fryers, floors, and stained ceiling tiles
summary: Fryers and reach-in coolers have food, dirt, and grease inside and outside. Trash surrounds the dumpster. Floor corners and areas under cooking equipment are dirty. Water-stained dining-area ceiling tiles need replacing.

headline: Over 50 mouse droppings in food areas
summary: Over 30 mouse droppings were behind the front counter, and over 20 along walls and corners in the rear prep and dishwashing area. Management must remove and sanitize them and call licensed pest control. Mold-like buildup is in the walk-in cooler.

headline: Quarter-inch gap at front door
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the front entrance door sweep must be sealed to rodent-proof the door. No pests were noted in this inspection.

headline: Greasy fryers and debris under equipment
summary: Fryers have grease buildup inside and outside. Food debris is under all equipment, along walls, and in corners of prep and storage areas and must be cleaned.

headline: Hair restraint needed; worn cooler gasket
summary: A food handler must wear a hair restraint. The worn door gasket on the 3-door prep cooler on the serving line must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Ice machine buildup; no allergen training
summary: Calcium buildup inside the ice machine must be cleaned. No certified food manager with food allergen training was on site.

headline: No manager; food held at unsafe temperatures
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken and falafel were prepared. Cooked rice was held at 124F (135F required). Falafel at 48F and raw beef at 52F were above the 41F limit. About $220 of food was discarded.

headline: Dish machine too cool; repaired on site
summary: The high-temperature dish machine final rinse measured 120F; it must be at least 180F. Corrected on site: the machine was repaired and sanitized at 184F. The menu lacked a raw-food advisory, which was added on site. Revolving door base openings and leaking faucets need fixing.

headline: Damaged cutting boards, charcoal, and clutter
summary: Cutting boards with deep cuts and stains must be restored or replaced. About 10 crates of used charcoal are on the ground near the dumpster. Scrap materials and an unused cooler and ice machine need removal or repair.

headline: Washroom door not self-closing; stained ceiling tiles
summary: Dining area washroom door has no self-closing device; must be installed. Water-stained ceiling tiles in the dining and kitchen areas must be replaced where needed.

headline: No certified manager; cold food and cooler too warm
summary: No original sanitation certificate posted and no certified manager during TCS food prep. Eggs, beef, chicken, shrimp, and tofu at 44–53°F in prep coolers. Dish machine has no sanitizer in final rinse. No vomit cleanup supplies. Citations issued.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; unapproved food processing
summary: Dish machine final rinse reached 148.2°F, below 180°F; use stopped until repaired. Vacuum-packed foods lacked required approval; about 600 lbs held, 350 lbs discarded. Uncovered pastries on display. Some handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Greasy floor under fryers; dirt behind ice machine
summary: Grease buildup on the floor under deep fryers in the rear prep area. Dirt behind the ice machine and storage racks. Person in charge instructed to clean these floor areas.

headline: Over 100 rat and mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: Over 100 rat droppings and over 100 mouse droppings found across prep, storage, and basement areas, not corrected from an earlier report. Exterminator must be called. No certified person in charge or manager present during TCS food prep.

headline: Employee touched ready-to-eat food with bare hands
summary: Employee touched ready-to-eat shredded lettuce and wrapped burritos with bare hands. Employee was told to discard the food, wash hands, and wear gloves. Staff instructed that bare-hand contact is not allowed. Priority violation.

headline: Ceiling tile must be reattached
summary: Ceiling tile above the three-compartment sink must be reattached.

headline: Chlorine too strong; more than 10 small flies
summary: Dish machine final chlorine was 200 ppm, above the 100 ppm maximum; a technician arrived to service it. More than 10 small flies in the bar area. Floors around kitchen equipment have debris and soil. Citation issued.

headline: Live flies in food prep area; dumpster problems
summary: About 3 large and 5 small live flies flew around the food prep area. Outside dumpster lids were open, with flies, garbage, and food debris on the ground. Citation issued; pest control service recommended. Minor floor dirt noted.

headline: Missing signs and thermometers; repeat violations
summary: No handwashing signs at sinks. Coolers lack thermometers; bulk containers unlabeled; ice scoop stored inside ice machine. Food handlers and manager lack required training certificates. Earlier core violations not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Broken backflow device; ceiling needs repair
summary: Broken backflow device on the utility sink faucet must be replaced. Ceiling above the basement freezer and bulk containers needs a smooth, cleanable surface; exposed insulation noted. One certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No thermometer in walk-in; water-stained ceiling tiles
summary: No working thermometer inside the walk-in cooler; must be provided and maintained. Several water-stained ceiling tiles in the rear prep area must be replaced.

headline: Loose splash guard; greasy floors and drains
summary: Loose splash guard at the handwash sink by the pizza oven. Food debris and dark buildup in kitchen drains, heavy at the dish machine. Leaking faucet at the breakfast hot line handwash sink. Greasy hood filters and floors.

headline: Breakfast sandwich cooler too warm
summary: Breakfast sandwich prep cooler held at 58.7°F. Person in charge discarded TCS food stored inside and stopped using the cooler; cooler tagged and must be repaired or replaced. Sandwich prep sink faucet leaks; ice cream sink drains slowly.

headline: Cold food held too warm; about 310 lbs discarded
summary: Cold food was held at 45.3–60.6°F, above the 41°F limit. Manager voluntarily discarded about 310 lbs ($777) on site. Also unlabeled containers, dirty cooler interior, duct tape on equipment, and dusty vents.

headline: Broken thermometer; dirty dish machine and tables
summary: Broken thermometer in the rear reach-in cooler. Out-of-order dish machine is dirty with food debris. Dining room tables and waste containers overflow with debris. No proof of food handler or allergen training.

headline: Sticky fly traps removed; greasy floors
summary: Sticky fly trap rolls above the rear prep and dish area were removed by the manager during inspection. Floors have grease and dried food under cooking equipment and need cleaning. Expired food handler and allergen certificates.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; about 200 mouse droppings
summary: Low-temperature dish machine sanitizing at 0 ppm; tagged and not to be used until reinspected. About 200 mouse droppings on floors in storage, kitchen, dishwashing, and bar prep areas. Pest control service needed. Citation issued.

headline: Missing or expired food handler training
summary: Several food handlers lacked valid food handler training or certificates; management told to show proof. Grease, dust, and food debris on walls and ceilings of food prep and storage areas must be cleaned.

headline: About 70 mouse droppings found throughout facility
summary: About 70 mouse droppings were found scattered through the facility, including rear dry storage behind a freezer and fridge. Person in charge told to remove them and sanitize. Citation issued. Expired food handler and allergen certificates.

headline: No service sink installed
summary: Facility has no service sink. Manager instructed to install one.

headline: Walk-in cooler lighting inadequate
summary: Lighting in the walk-in cooler is inadequate. Management instructed to provide more light output.

headline: Soiled mop heads and dirty floor drains
summary: Soiled mop heads were stored improperly and must be hung to prevent insect breeding. Dirty floor drains under the three-compartment sink must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: No covered trash cans in restrooms
summary: Both unisex single-occupancy restrooms on the 8th floor lack covered trash cans. Management instructed to provide them.

headline: Soda fountain drain line goes to hand sink
summary: Drain line from the fountain nozzle holder drains into the bar handwash sink; must be moved to a floor drain. Missing grout between floor tiles in the dishwashing and prep areas must be repaired.

headline: Mouse droppings and live flies; cross-contamination
summary: About 40 mouse droppings in overflow storage and 25 live small flies in dish and prep areas. Barley stored under thawing hams was discarded. Food handler ate in prep area. Food stored on floor in freezer. Expired allergen training. Citation issued.

headline: Restroom door not self-closing; dirty floors
summary: Restroom washroom fixtures must be cleaned and maintained. Washroom door in the food prep area is not self-closing. Water-stained ceiling tiles in the front selling area must be replaced. Walk-in cooler, rear storage, and chip rack floors need cleaning.

headline: Worn sink stoppers; interiors need cleaning
summary: Three-compartment sink stoppers are in poor repair and must be replaced. Interior of all coolers and freezers must be cleaned. Grease and debris in hood filters must be cleaned.

headline: Dish machine too cool to sanitize; hand washing used
summary: Dish machine sanitizing rinse reached only 133.0°F, below the 180°F minimum; use stopped until repaired. Dishes rewashed by hand. Missing cooler thermometers, single-use bowl used as a scoop, and greasy cook line.

headline: No cold water at front prep handsink
summary: Prep handwash sink had no cold running water; hot water was at the required temperature. Uncovered silverware in the dining area, missing splash guard at the bar sink, and splattered bar equipment.

headline: About 50 mouse droppings; service needed
summary: About 50 mouse droppings on the floor under storage shelves and the front counter. Pest control service required before reinspection; citation issued. Some bulk containers unlabeled; wiping cloths not kept in sanitizer.

headline: Unlabeled containers; rusty racks; dirty cooler areas
summary: No handwashing signs at rear prep sinks. White bulk ingredient containers unlabeled. Rusty storage racks in the walk-in cooler. Dirty can opener, ice machine exterior, and floor drains. Food manager's allergen training certificate expired.

headline: Sprouts grown without required approved plan
summary: Broccoli sprouts were grown, seeded, and dried on site without an approved HACCP plan or variance. Manager disposed of sprouts and seeds, about 400 grams ($44). Certified manager lacks allergen training. Citation issued.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure
summary: No bodily fluid spill kit and no cleanup procedure for vomiting and diarrhea events. Must provide both and keep them on site. Employee restroom and prep area handwashing sinks lack signs.

headline: Hair and beard restraints missing; allergen training gap
summary: Food handlers worked without hair restraints, and a male handler lacked a beard restraint. Certified manager is missing allergen training certificate.

headline: Handwash sink water too cool
summary: Handwashing sink in the first-floor women's restroom measured 85.2°F and 85.6°F, below the required 100°F. Citation issued.

headline: Gap under rear door; missing coving in prep area
summary: A quarter-inch gap under the rear door by the toilet rooms must be sealed so the door is rodent-proof. Coving is detached and missing in various areas of the food prep area and must be replaced.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; dusty floors throughout
summary: Handwashing signs missing in both restrooms. Single-use items stored on the floor must be raised off the floor. Loose debris, dirt, and dust on floors and corners throughout the facility; must detail clean more often.

headline: No certified manager during milk handling
summary: No certified food manager on premises while milk, a TCS food, was prepared. No handwashing sign at prep sink; food handler lacked hair restraint. Three-compartment sink drains slowly; ice machine lacks a visible backflow device.

headline: Restroom self-closing door inadequate
summary: Self-closing mechanism on the unisex restroom door near the prep area is inadequate and must be provided and maintained. Missing or damaged wall base in wine cellar must be sealed to prevent pest entry.

headline: Restroom exhaust fan not working
summary: Restroom exhaust fan was not operating. Must be repaired.

headline: Leaking pipe; sink unlabeled; soiled knives stored
summary: Leaking pipe in the basement must be repaired. Three-compartment sink lacks wash, rinse, and sanitize labels. Soiled knives stored between tables. Staff restroom door not self-closing; damaged rear wall and sink ledge.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; unit tagged
summary: Low-temperature dish machine was not sanitizing; sanitizer measured 0 ppm. Staff must use the three-compartment sink until the machine is repaired and reinspected. Unit tagged. Citation issued.

headline: Dirty cook equipment, floors, and vent
summary: Buildup around rubber gaskets, worn scrub pads, dirty can opener, and cooking equipment with food spills. Floors near the dish machine and hot line need cleaning. Dusty vent above the wait station. All items must be corrected and maintained.

headline: No hot water at front handwash sink
summary: Handwash sink behind the front counter measured 80.0°F; must reach at least 100°F by the next inspection. Two-door prep cooler under the microwave has ripped door gaskets that must be replaced.

headline: Rat droppings and live roaches found; citation issued
summary: About 25 or more rat droppings near the three-compartment sink and in the furnace room, plus 2 live roaches on a prep cooler. Droppings must be removed and pest control serviced. Also no signed health policy and no allergen training.

headline: Unlabeled desserts; damaged dumpster lid
summary: Grab-and-go desserts at the front counter lack labels with business name, address, and ingredients. Dumpster lid is damaged and cannot close; earlier violation not corrected. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; food handler certificate missing
summary: No certified food manager on site and no certificate posted while soup and deli foods were handled. One employee lacks a food handler certificate. Cooler thermometers kept in back of coolers; must move to the warmest part.

headline: No vomit procedure; no utility sink for mop water
summary: Person in charge could not provide a vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies. Facility has no utility sink for mop water and no backflow device. Cardboard shelf liners, uncovered restroom trash, and no restroom ventilation.

headline: Grease spills outside and dripping water inside
summary: Heavy grease spills on the outside oil tank lid and on the floor under cooking equipment. Water from a condensation unit drips into a bucket inside the walk-in cooler and must be drained to an approved drain.

headline: Rodent droppings found; dumpster overflowing
summary: About 40 small rodent droppings on the floor of rear storage and under chip racks in front. Outside dumpster lids not closed due to overflowing trash. Citation issued. Clutter in the furnace closet and debris on floors.

headline: Rusty shelving; greasy floor under cooking equipment
summary: Rusty storage shelving and bottoms of prep tables in the rear prep and dishwashing area must be repainted, replaced, and maintained. Grease and dirt buildup on the floor under and around cooking equipment must be cleaned.

headline: No thermometer, pest logbook, or handwashing signs
summary: No temperature measuring device on site, a priority violation. No pest control logbook with service reports. Handwashing signs missing in restrooms and the bar. Restroom has no covered waste receptacle. Ceiling above ice machine unfinished.

headline: Fish in contact with ice in coolers
summary: Fish was in direct contact with ice in two coolers. Management told not to store ice in contact with food. Wet wiping cloths stored throughout the front prep area; they must be kept in sanitizing solution.

headline: Food residue inside rear prep cooler
summary: Interior of the two-door cold-holding unit in the rear prep area had accumulated food residue. Person in charge instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Cold seafood too warm; sushi cooler at 51.2°F
summary: Cold seafood in the front prep unit reached 49.1–51.2°F; manager discarded 3 lbs ($200). Sushi display cooler at 51.2°F must not be used until reinspected. Three-compartment sink in disrepair and leaking. Citation issued.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; burned-out hood bulb
summary: Restroom washbowls lack handwashing signs. Light bulb by the ventilation hood is burned out. Both items must be corrected and maintained. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Missing floor tiles; dim dishwashing area
summary: Missing floor tiles in the dishwashing area and food debris inside a floor drain between fryer and oven. Grease on hood filters. Restroom lacks a covered sanitary receptacle. Dishwashing area is dimly lit.

headline: Torn gasket; dirty reach-in interiors
summary: Torn door gasket on a bar reach-in refrigerator must be replaced. Interiors of all reach-in refrigerators and freezers had food debris and spills and must be cleaned.

headline: Live roach and rodent droppings; cold food too warm
summary: One live roach near the dish machine and hot holding unit. About 10 mouse and 15 rat droppings plus bird feathers in banquet storage. About 90 lbs of cold food at 46.7–58.7°F discarded. Dish machine sanitizing at 0 ppm, tagged.

headline: Flies in prep area; black buildup in ice machine
summary: About 5 large and 10 small flies flying in the rear prep and dry storage area. Ice machine interior has excessive black substance. Cardboard used as floor liner in the meat cooler. Cutting boards grooved and stained; clutter by exit.

headline: No certified manager; dead insects in light shield
summary: No person in charge with a valid certificate, and no certified manager on site while TCS food was prepared and served. No chemical test kit for sanitizer. Dead insects found inside a light shield in the prep area.

headline: Missing consumer advisory; no chlorine test strips
summary: Menu lacks required advisory for undercooked foods; cook-to-order wording needed. Splash guard missing between prep table and sink. No chlorine test strips. Mop sink lacks a backflow device. Allergen training certificates needed. Citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; food servers lack certificates
summary: Bulk rice and sugar containers are unlabeled and must be labeled. Food servers had no food handler certificates. Previous core violation: food manager has no allergen training certificate; citation issued.

headline: Worn floor grout in prep area
summary: Worn grout lines throughout the prep area in front of the wok line must be regrouted so the surface is smooth and cleanable. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Overflowing dumpster; rear storage clutter
summary: Outside dumpster overflowing with garbage and debris, lids open, trash on the ground. Earlier priority violation not corrected; citation issued. Clutter in rear storage blocks cleaning and pest monitoring; clear aisles needed.
