headline: Missing and torn ceiling tiles in storage room
summary: Missing and torn ceiling tiles inside the storage room must be replaced.

headline: Door not rodent-proof; restroom upkeep issues
summary: Front entrance door has a half-inch gap at the bottom and is not rodent-proof. Restrooms lack handwashing signs, self-closing doors, and covered waste containers. Unnecessary items in the basement must be removed.

headline: No person in charge; expired certificates; leaks
summary: No person in charge present during inspection. Certified manager certificate expired. No pest control logbook on site. Three-compartment sink leaks; no sanitizer test strips. Employees worked without or with expired food handler certificates. Clutter on shelves.

headline: Exhaust hood exterior not clean
summary: Exterior of the exhaust hood was found not clean. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Ice buildup in freezer; damaged floor grout and shields
summary: Ice buildup inside a reach-in freezer must be removed. Grout under the grill, beverage station, and dish area needs repair. Cracked light shields in prep and dish areas must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Basement prep table and plastic wall lining removed
summary: Prep table in the basement must be removed from the basement. Plastic lining on basement walls must be removed so walls are smooth, even, and cleanable.

headline: No certified manager on site during food prep
summary: Food handlers prepared time-and-temperature foods without an original certificate or certified manager on site. Many upkeep issues: dirty microwave and coolers, missing floor sections, leaking sink, burned-out bulbs. Summary not posted.

headline: No cooler thermometer; greasy hood and filters
summary: Dessert reach-in cooler has no thermometer. Three-compartment sink stoppers do not work. Ventilation hood and filters have grease and food buildup. No food handler certificates on premises; all handlers must be certified.

headline: Dirty ice chute; mold-like buildup in walk-in
summary: Plastic ice chute on the soda dispenser is dirty and must be cleaned. Mold-like buildup on walk-in cooler storage racks. Leaking faucet at the three-compartment sink. Dusty ceiling vent over the food prep area.

headline: Dirty floors under equipment and in mop room
summary: Floors are unclean under and behind all cooking and refrigeration equipment, around the hot water heater, and in the mop room. Floors must be cleaned, sanitized, and maintained.

headline: Torn freezer gasket; expired allergen training
summary: Torn gasket on the kitchen chest freezer must be repaired. Expired allergen training certificate for certified food managers. Earlier core violation not corrected; citation issued.

headline: No covered receptacle in employee restroom
summary: Employee restroom has no covered waste receptacle for sanitary napkins. Management instructed to provide one.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies; allergen training missing
summary: No supplies or procedures for vomiting and diarrhea events; manager instructed to provide them. Dust on the washroom ventilation fan. Certified managers lack valid allergen training.

headline: Duct-taped bin, oversized pots, no training proof
summary: Plastic bus tub repaired with duct tape and must be replaced. Oversized pizza sauce bin and pot do not fit the sink and must be removed. Expanding foam used as sealant under the sink. No proof of food handler training on site.

headline: Peeling paint behind sink; poor dishwashing lighting
summary: Wall behind the three-compartment sink has peeling paint and must be repaired. Dishwashing areas have poor lighting that must be improved.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure; no hot water at mop sink
summary: No cleanup procedure or supplies for vomit and diarrhea events. Gap under front door, no hot water at mop sink, and no lid on restroom trash can. Damaged floor tile at entry; items stored on floor at service counter and rear storage.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; no vomit policy
summary: Low-temperature dish machine at the bar sanitized at 0 ppm; tagged and not to be used until reinspected. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup policy. Food containers unlabeled; knives stored under the sushi counter. Citation issued.

headline: No certified food manager on duty during food prep
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while cold and hot food was being prepared and served. Person in charge lacked a valid certificate. Inspection summary not posted. Manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Over 30 mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: Over 30 mouse droppings scattered on the floor and in corners of the rear dish area; exterminator must be called and the area cleaned. No person in charge with a valid certificate, and no certified manager on site while TCS food was prepared.

headline: Rat droppings and openings let pests in
summary: About 15 rat droppings in the basement. Openings into the floor of the rear furnace room and under the front door must be closed. Employee cooked without a hair restraint. Greasy fryers, missing sink stoppers, and grease on hood filters.

headline: Cool handwash sinks; missing pest service records
summary: One handwash sink at 71.6°F; another has no hot or cold water. All must provide 100–120°F water. No proof of food handler training. Pest control reports did not cover the second-floor prep area or lobby kiosk. Citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit cleanup kit
summary: No certified manager present while eggs, noodles, rice, and chicken were prepared and served. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit. Water leaking at hand sink and dish machine pipes. Dirt and food spills in front and rear areas. No allergen training.

headline: No certified manager; sewage backup from floor drains
summary: No certified manager on site while handling TCS foods, and no employee health policy. Black sewage backed up from restroom floor drains; plumber repaired it during inspection. Fryer cabinets missing doors and greasy; citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; raw steak prepared
summary: Person in charge lacks a certified food manager certificate. Only a copy was displayed while raw steak was cut and packaged; citation issued. Outside dumpster area overflowing with trash. Broken floor and damaged wall trim in coolers and prep areas.

headline: Tableware not inverted; damaged wall tiles
summary: Forks and plates were stored uninverted under the server station. Damaged tiles on the wall behind the ice machine must be repaired so the surface is smooth and cleanable.

headline: Raw wood and leaking faucet at bar sink
summary: Raw, unsealed wood under the bar handwash sink must be sealed. Leaking, loose faucet at the bar handwash sink must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Cold food too warm; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Cold food held at 48.1–59.5°F; manager discarded about $100 of food. Dish machine sanitizing at 0 ppm, corrected on site. Hand sinks at 60.4–93.2°F, below 100°F. No written employee health policy or vomit cleanup procedure.

headline: Live and dead roaches; food adulterated and discarded
summary: Live roaches in a prep cooler holding uncovered raw beef and tofu; about 10 lbs discarded. Three live roaches and many dead roaches in rear prep and front server areas. Cold food at 46–54°F. Ice machine has black buildup.

headline: Food on floor; missing handwashing signs; training gaps
summary: No handwashing signs at sinks. Food stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler; multi-use trays on floor under sink. Missing or expired food handler training. Ice machine residue and food debris under equipment.

headline: No certified manager; no handwashing signs
summary: No certified food manager on premises while rice and beans were handled. Frozen pork stored in a dish soap bucket; 25 lbs ($225) discarded. No handwashing signs, food handler certificates, or allergen certificate. Earlier summary not posted.

headline: No food handler certificates; raw food warning missing
summary: No food handler certificates on site. Menu lacks required warning that eggs, steak, and burgers may be served raw or undercooked. Earlier priority violations were not fixed on time. Coolers have debris and spills. Citation issued.

headline: Dish machine fixed on site; food stored on floor
summary: Low-temperature dish machine was at 0 ppm sanitizer; manager serviced it to 100 ppm during inspection. Food containers stored on the floor in walk-in and prep areas and single-service items not inverted. Greasy waste area outside, cleaned during inspection.

headline: Water-stained ceiling tiles in front of store
summary: Water-stained ceiling tiles in front of the store must be replaced and maintained.

headline: Raw brick wall near entry needs sealing
summary: Raw brick wall in the entry door area must be painted or sealed so it is smooth and cleanable.

headline: Dirty floors under equipment and wall corners
summary: Floor under and around equipment in front service area, plus wall corners, need detailed cleaning. Management instructed to clean all areas.

headline: Black mold-like caulking; debris under wire racks
summary: Excessive black mold-like substance on caulking at front handsink and three-compartment sink; must be removed or caulking replaced. Excessive debris under wire racks in walk-in cooler; detail clean.

headline: Dirty ice machine edge and microwave; broken door
summary: Spillage on ice machine edge, and buildup inside microwave and toaster oven. Broken sliding door at utility sink. Cluttered utility room and dirty floors in rear dish and prep area.

headline: No hot water at sink; ice machine slime; citations issued
summary: Rear prep sink had no hot water. Heavy black slime found inside ice machine used for ice. Leaking pipe under three-compartment sink, restroom trash lid missing, blocked rear exit, dirty microwaves. Two citations issued.

headline: Hair restraints missing; sanitation manager lacked allergen training
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints; they were put on before the inspection ended. Sanitation manager had no allergen training certificate and must provide one.

headline: Expired allergen training; wet mop in mop sink
summary: Some city food managers have expired allergen training. They must recertify and keep certificates on site. Wet mop stored in mop sink; must be hung to dry.

headline: Rear door gap; dusty ceiling vents
summary: A 1/4-inch opening at the lower left of the rear exit door must be sealed. Floors under heavy equipment in drive-thru need cleaning. Light dust on ceiling vents in both washrooms.

headline: Sanitation manager lacked allergen training certificate
summary: Sanitation manager on site had no food allergen training certificate. Inspector instructed the restaurant to meet the requirement. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Missing self-closing doors; syrup and food spills
summary: Bathroom doors at front bar and employee restroom lack self-closing devices. Syrup spilled under shelves in attic storage. Heavy food buildup and spilled water under front bar sink and main kitchen cooler.

headline: No cooler thermometer; expired manager allergen training
summary: No thermometer in one-door refrigeration unit under prep table. Certified food manager had expired allergen training certificate. Must complete training and keep certificate on site.

headline: Dead insects, gaps at doors, no raw-food notice; failed
summary: Failed. No consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods on menu; posted before the report. Dead insects on basement floor and a 1/2-inch gap at patio doors. Greasy fryer, oven and grill; broken baseboard and floor tiles.

headline: Unlabeled food containers; greasy kitchen floors
summary: Food storage containers lack common-name labels. Loose debris and grease buildup on kitchen floors, drains and corners. Management instructed to detail clean and increase cleaning frequency.

headline: No written employee health policy on premises
summary: No written employee health policy on the premises. Must provide a signed policy for each employee and keep it on file. Priority foundation violation. Conditional pass.

headline: Blocked handsink, flies and warm beans; citation
summary: Only kitchen handsink is blocked by a two-door freezer. Cooked beans at 57F; 10 lbs discarded. More than 20 small flies found throughout the facility; citation issued. Pink calcium buildup in both ice machines.

headline: No thermometer in cold unit; stored on floor
summary: No visible thermometer in three-door cold holding unit for milk, eggs and cheese. Beverages and shelving stored on floor, damaged gaskets, debris, and a leaking drain. Dog feces behind the building; stained ceiling tiles.

headline: No certificate posted; blocked handsinks; citation
summary: Certificate not posted on site. Certified manager arrived around 12:30 PM and must be present with TCS foods. Two handsinks blocked, by a container and a bin. Spices unlabeled, food on floor, and greasy equipment noted.

headline: Damaged cooler gaskets, leaking basement sink, stained tiles
summary: Damaged gaskets on all four drawers of a cold holding unit. Basement handwashing sink leaks from shutoff knobs. Also stained ceiling tiles, cracked floor tiles, a missing floor cover, a non-working light and greasy hood.

headline: Dirt and debris under equipment and at floor drain
summary: Dirt and small debris along walls under and around cooking and non-cooking equipment. Dirty floor drain at front host stand. Instructed to clean to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; greasy dish machine and hood
summary: Ripped gasket on a south two-door prep cooler must be repaired. Food debris on dish machine exterior and shelves. Black dirt and debris on walls and floor in dish room. Greasy ventilation hood must be cleaned.

headline: Peeling plastic on ice bin lids; duct tape on shelving
summary: Peeling plastic on lids of ice bins could contaminate ice; must be removed. Duct tape on metal shelving and a ceiling hole above plastic cup storage must be sealed. Missing light shields; soiled mop heads not stored inverted.

headline: Missing sink stopper; grease trap propped on can
summary: Missing stopper for three-compartment sink; at least three are required. Grease trap propped on a metal can must sit flush with the floor. Dust and grease on hood filters.

headline: Unlabeled paletas and missing hair restraints
summary: Paletas in grocery freezer lacked labels. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Shelving inside yogurt coolers needs cleaning. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Soap dispenser above warewash sink; storage outside
summary: Hand soap and paper towel dispenser mounted above three-compartment sink in warewashing area. Must be removed so staff wash hands only at handwashing sinks. Unused tables, chairs and wood stored in backyard; remove to prevent pests.

headline: Food handler without hair restraint; dirty floors
summary: Food handler not wearing a hair restraint. Food debris on floors under all cooking equipment in rear prep area. Employee personal items stored in prep area; orderly storage required.

headline: No valid manager certificate on site; citation
summary: No valid original city sanitation certificate on site. It must be on site in addition to a certified manager. Cardboard on prep table to be removed. Spills on cooler, grease on walls and hood filters.

headline: No sanitation manager while prepping chicken; citation
summary: No city sanitation manager on site while chicken and other TCS foods were prepared. Certificate must be posted. Milk crates used for shelving in dry storage. Prior violations: missing food handler and allergen certificates.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; unlabeled flour and spices
summary: Washroom handwashing sink lacks a sign. Flour and seasoning kept out of original containers without product name labels. Cooler interiors need detail cleaning. Soiled mop heads not stored properly.

headline: Rat droppings, moths and larvae in food; failed
summary: Failed. 20 rat droppings in food prep area and dry storage; more pest control needed. Live moths and larvae in sugar and rice containers, food discarded. Frozen chicken in grocery bags. No employee health policy. Citations issued.

headline: No certified manager while cooking TCS food; cold hot water
summary: No certified food manager with valid certificate while TCS foods were prepared. Hot water at three-compartment sinks only 64-72F; citation issued. No thermometers in cooling units. No allergen training on site.

headline: Gap at rear door; no handwashing sign; no waste bins
summary: 1/4-inch gap at bottom of rear exit door must be sealed. No handwashing sign at rear handsink. Single-use items stored on floor and under sink. No waste receptacles at handsinks; floor drains need cleaning.

headline: Slight ice machine buildup; door gap
summary: Slight buildup inside upper portion of ice machine; must be cleaned. Emergency front entrance door sweep has a 1/4-inch gap; door must be made rodent proof. Passed.

headline: Food handlers lack certificates; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Several food handlers lacked food handler certificates. Certified food manager had no allergen training certificate. Management instructed to provide proof for all. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Handwashing sign needed; bulk containers unlabeled
summary: Handwashing sign needed in prep area. All bulk food containers need commodity name labels. Interior of reach-in coolers and walk-in shelving need cleaning of food spills.

headline: Dishmachine too cool; live roaches; failed
summary: Failed. Dishmachine final sanitizing rinse 140F, below required 180F; tagged held. Two live cockroaches found near freezer and in mop closet. Citations issued. Water leak, torn gaskets and stained cutting boards.

headline: No certified manager on site during milk handling
summary: No certified food manager was on site while milk and other TCS foods were handled. A certified manager must be on site at all times. Priority citation issued.

headline: Prep sink lacks soap, towels and water pressure
summary: Prep area handwashing sink had no paper towels or hand-drying supplies, no soap, and weak water pressure. Wall behind prep area not smooth. Conditional pass.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; scoops stored in toppings
summary: Rear warewashing handsink lacked a handwashing sign. Scoops for bowl toppings were stored inside the containers. No certified manager with allergen training; documentation must be provided.

headline: Dough bin and food wrap stored between walls
summary: Clean dough bin and single-use food wrap roll wedged between walls in the rear storage hallway. Must be relocated so utensils are stored outside prohibited areas. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Roaches, no handsink water, unsafe hot and cold food
summary: Failed. At least 10 live roaches in cracks at service counter, dish area and under hot holding unit. Rear handsink lacked running water; front handsink blocked. Hot food at 71.1F and cold steak at 47.7F discarded.

headline: Black mold-like spots in walk-in units
summary: Black mold-like spots found on walls and doors of walk-in cooler and walk-in freezer. Buildup must be removed and kept clean. Passed.

headline: Grab-and-go sandwiches lack labels
summary: Prepackaged sandwiches and grab-and-go items in the display cooler had no labels. Management must add ingredient labels, net contents, and manufacturer name and address.

headline: No posted manager certificate; summary not posted
summary: No posted valid manager certificate; manager must also be present. Thermometers missing from coolers. No food handler or allergen training certificates on site. Debris under heavy equipment. Last inspection summary not posted; citation issued.

headline: Paper towels in restroom; backflow cap missing
summary: Unwrapped paper towel rolls stored on shelf in employee toilet room; must be moved. Utility sink backflow device is missing its cap, though it still works. Plumbing must be kept in good repair.

headline: Ice machine residue; ice bin uncovered
summary: Light pink residue in ice machine corner; cleaning must be scheduled. Ice bin in bar uncovered; cover required. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Mouse droppings and rodent activity; citation issued
summary: Failed. Mouse droppings under three-compartment sink, behind cooking equipment, under prep tables, near freezer and in rear storage. Pest control service needed before next week's reinspection. Citation issued.

headline: Food on floors and uncovered; broken dumpster lids; citation
summary: Failed. Food stored on floor and uncovered in walk-in, prep, dish and storage areas. Unlabeled containers, utensils left on surfaces, and broken dumpster lids; citation issued. Dirty floors and vents noted.

headline: No current pest control logbook; failed
summary: No current pest control logbook on premises. A licensed pest company must inspect at least twice a year, with reports kept in the logbook. Priority citation issued. Dust on toilet room vents.

headline: Unlabeled bulk container; dirty walk-in and hood
summary: Bulk dry storage container not labeled with product name. Walk-in cooler walls, shelving and floors need detail cleaning. Floors in rear prep and front area need cleaning, and hood is greasy.

headline: Food stored on walk-in floor; pots not inverted
summary: Food stored on floor in walk-in cooler; must be raised six inches on shelving. Multi-use utensils and pots not stored inverted. Passed with instructions to correct both.

headline: Oysters mixed together; about $1,000 discarded
summary: Oysters of different species, certification numbers, harvest dates and growing areas stored together in walk-in cooler. About 30 lbs (about $1,000) voluntarily discarded. Citation issued. Cutting boards grooved and stained.

headline: Coolers too warm; no health policy; failed
summary: Failed. Pastry display cooler at 47.9F and one-door refrigeration unit at 60F; must be 41F or colder. Priority violation. No written employee health policy, no backflow device at mop sink, and no grease interceptor.

headline: Chicken held past discard date; 20 lbs thrown out
summary: Chicken wings held past 7-day discard date; about 20 lbs ($100) voluntarily discarded. No city manager certificate posted. Two of four employees lack food handler training; no allergen certificates on site. Hood filters dusty; some lights burnt out.

headline: Pest control records incomplete; citation issued
summary: Pest control logbook incomplete. Last licensed exterminator report is dated 6-25-2024, with none after. Licensed pest service is required at least twice a year. Priority citation issued. No pests reported.

headline: Front door not rodent proof; greasy fryer equipment
summary: Front door not rodent proof; must be made tight-fitting. Shelving for fryer baskets and fry containers needs detail cleaning to remove grease. Floor corners around mop sink greasy.

headline: No certified person in charge; corrected on site
summary: No person in charge with valid city sanitation certificate during operation. Manager arrived at 12:20 PM and corrected it on site. Previous violation not corrected; citation issued. Missing test kit was delivered before inspection ended.

headline: Unlabeled sinks, peeling basement paint, dead light
summary: Damaged gasket on a two-door cold unit. Upstairs and downstairs three-compartment sinks not labeled for wash, rinse and sanitize. Peeling paint above basement sink. Blown light bulb in hood system.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; no liquid-waste sink at coffee area
summary: Torn door gaskets on a two-door stand-up cooler must be replaced. The front coffee preparation area had no sink for dumping liquid waste; a compartment sink must be available there. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Broken cooler cover; leaking dish sink drain
summary: Cold holding unit in rear prep has a broken cover. Reach-in cooler interiors need detail cleaning. Three-compartment sink in dish area leaks from middle basin drain pipe.

headline: Leaking handsink pipe and low water pressure
summary: Leak under handwashing sink next to three-compartment sink. Low water pressure at bar handwashing sink. Both must be repaired. Restrooms need mechanical ventilation.

headline: Handsinks blocked; greasy grill area; raw brick walls
summary: Handsinks in both prep areas blocked by equipment and a table; must stay accessible; citation issued. Wiping cloths on prep table. Excessive grease under flat-top grill. Raw brick in toilet room must be sealed.

headline: Ice machine tube drips into sink; debris on floor
summary: Tube from ice machine dripping into three-compartment sink; must be removed so it drains to the floor. Debris on floor beside sliding refrigerator and under the three-compartment sink.

headline: Dusty ceiling fans and debris on floors
summary: Dust buildup on dining area ceiling fans. Debris on floors in prep and storage areas. Manager instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: No sanitizer in dish machine; cooked beans too warm
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had no chlorine sanitizer in final rinse while in use. Cooked beans in walk-in cooler at 47F; cold food must be 41F or below. One certified manager lacked allergen training certificate. Citations issued.

headline: Raw-food notice added on site; handsink too cool
summary: Menu lacked a raw or undercooked food disclosure; it was added on site before the inspection ended. Men's washroom left handsink at 79.3F, below the required 100F; repair required. Covered bin lid missing in women's restroom.

headline: Hot water too cool; dumpsters overflowing; failed
summary: Hot water too cool at several sinks; restored to required temperatures by inspection end. Outside dumpsters overflowing with garbage. Most recent inspection summary not posted for the public. Citations issued.

headline: No signed employee health policies on site
summary: No signed employee health policy agreements on site for food and conditional employees. Priority citation issued. Thermometer missing from dairy display cooler. Items stored on floor in rear storage area.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; grooved cutting board; greasy oil container
summary: Torn gasket on two-door prep cooler must be repaired or replaced. Cutting board in rear prep area has deep grooves and dark stains. Grease buildup on used cooking oil container in rear alley.

headline: Hooking system needed for wet mops
summary: Wet mops must be hung from buckets on the second floor. A hooking system is required to hang them.

headline: Utensils stored above handsink; cracked caulking
summary: Clean utensils and inverted pots stored above or beside rear prep handsink and floor drain; must be moved. Clean mixing bowls must be inverted. Cloth towels and parchment liners not allowed on shelves. Cracked caulking in employee washbasin.

headline: Dirty kitchen equipment, floors and walls
summary: Prep tables, refrigeration, wok station, cooking equipment exteriors and fryer bottoms need cleaning. Kitchen walls and floors, walk-in coolers and basement storage need cleaning. Employee washroom toilet and sink need cleaning.

headline: Single-use items not inverted; raw wood surfaces
summary: Single-use articles not inverted in prep area; must be inverted to protect from contamination. Raw wood on floor and shelving behind front counter must be sealed to be smooth and cleanable. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; no allergen training; dirty kitchen
summary: Bulk food such as sugar and flour not labeled. Coolers, cooking equipment, shelving and prep tables must be detail-cleaned. Food prep floors not clean. Sanitation manager has no allergen training.

headline: Raw chicken over ready-to-eat food; 90 lbs discarded
summary: Raw chicken stored over ready-to-eat potatoes and with tomatoes. Cold foods held at 50-66F; manager discarded about 90 lbs ($400). Lamb thawing under prep table. Missing food handler proof; citation issued.

headline: Damaged ceiling tiles in rear storage
summary: Damaged ceiling tiles in rear storage room. Manager instructed to replace them. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Sink-to-grease-trap leak; expired allergen certificate
summary: Leak from pipe connecting three-compartment sink to grease trap must be repaired. Allergen training certificate on site is expired; updated training must be obtained and kept on site. Re-inspection passed.

headline: No handwashing signs; bathroom sink lacks water
summary: No handwashing signage at prep and serving area handsink. Right washbowl in women's and staff restroom has no running water. Inspector instructed the restaurant to provide and maintain both.

headline: Sanitation manager has no allergen training
summary: City of Chicago sanitation manager has no allergen training. Proof of training must be provided.

headline: Unused chairs and tables in basement
summary: Clutter and unused chairs and tables in the basement. Items not used must be discarded, the area organized, and kept that way.

headline: No city manager certificate posted; utensils not inverted
summary: Person in charge lacks a city food manager certificate, and none is posted or on site. Original certificate must be posted and a certified manager present when TCS foods are handled. Multi-use utensils not inverted. Citation issued.

headline: Grease and grime on floors, walls and fryer cabinets
summary: Grease, food debris and grime on prep area floors and walls, and inside fryer cabinets. Grease on hood filters and on the used cooking oil container. Passed with instructions to clean.

headline: Unlabeled bulk flour and sugar; ice scoop misplaced
summary: Bulk flour and sugar containers unlabeled. Wet wiping cloths left on prep surfaces; ice scoop stored directly in ice. Milk crates used as shelving. Sanitation manager lacked proof of allergen training.

headline: Food splatter in walk-in; dirty lower shelving
summary: Food splatter on right wall of walk-in cooler in rear prep area. Lower shelving had dirt and spillage. Instructed to remove items, clean, sanitize and maintain. Passed.

headline: Broken, cracked floor tiles near rear door
summary: Broken and cracked floor tiles near the rear exterior door. Person in charge must repair and maintain. Re-inspection passed.

headline: 25 rodent droppings and live rat seen; failed
summary: Failed. 25 rodent droppings in basement and live rat activity observed on site. No current manager certificate posted. Cold food at 46F; some tomatoes and turkey discarded. Large gap at side door and heavy basement clutter.

headline: Handsink had no hot water; rodent openings at doors
summary: Handsink had no hot water (62.1F) until a plumber repaired it; 105F during inspection. Openings at bottom of front and rear receiving doors let rodents in. Wiping cloths on prep tables; dust and dirty drains. Citation issued.

headline: Torn freezer door gasket in food prep area
summary: Torn door gasket on a two-door stand-up freezer in the food prep area. Inspector instructed replacement and upkeep. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Knife stored by prep sink; dirty exhaust hood
summary: Knife stored between prep table and prep sink; must be kept in a rack or cabinet. Dirt and grease in exhaust hood, filters and pipes above cooking equipment.

headline: Clutter on floor near toilet and basement
summary: Clutter stored on floor in back area near toilet room and basement. Manager instructed to remove unused articles to prevent pest harborage. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Inspection summary not posted for public
summary: Previous inspection summary was not posted for public view. A new summary was left on site and management was instructed to post it. Priority citation issued.

headline: No health policy or vomit kit; rear door gap
summary: No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site. Rear door has a 1/4-inch gap and is not rodent or insect proof. Also a trash can without a lid, dirty floors, and three outdoor grills to remove.

headline: Leaking backflow device; no sanitary napkin bin
summary: Front prep dump sink backflow device leaking; must be repaired. Women's restroom lacks covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. Missing and water-damaged ceiling tiles. Loose food debris on floors throughout facility.

headline: 30 mouse droppings found; failed; citation
summary: Failed. 30 mouse droppings on garage storage shelves and floor. Area must be cleaned and pest control recommended before reinspection. Garage door gap over 1/4 inch. Torn plastic inside ice machine. Citation issued.

headline: Handwashing signs missing; floors dusty and debris-filled
summary: Handwashing signs missing at front prep and bar handsinks. Loose debris, dirt and dust on floors throughout. Inspector ordered signs installed and floors cleaned more often. Passed.

headline: Unlabeled condiments fixed on site; live plants above freezer
summary: Unlabeled condiment containers were labeled before the inspection ended. Live potted plants on shelf above ice cream freezer must be removed to prevent contamination. Drinks stored on floor; foil lining in freezer.

headline: Beef held at 46.8F; 25 lbs discarded
summary: Beef at 46.8F in back prep area. Manager immediately and voluntarily discarded 25 lbs (about $300) of product. Priority citation issued. Food stored in grocery bags, water dripping in walk-in cooler, and no allergen-trained certified manager.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; cooler tagged out
summary: Cold food held above 41F: pork at 54.2F, cheese at 50.8F. Pizza prep cooler at 54.5F is tagged out and cannot be used until reinspected. Food stored on floor, greasy fryer parts also noted.

headline: Improper food scoops; open wall holes; dirty floors
summary: Food scoops without handles stored inside foods; must use handled scoops stored outside foods. Shelving under cook line dirty. Open holes and cracks in front prep sink cabinet and washroom walls must be sealed. Kitchen floors dirty.

headline: Greasy exhaust hood and torn cooler gasket; citation
summary: Heavy grease and dirt in exhaust hood, filters and pipes above cooking equipment. Dusty fans inside a refrigeration unit. Earlier torn cooler gasket violation not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; greasy kitchen floors
summary: Milk crates used for elevation in kitchen; must use raised shelving six inches off the floor. Detail-clean coolers, shelves and sinks. Greasy floors under cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Sneeze guard too short; customers reach over food
summary: Sneeze guard at front service line too short. Customers reached over it and talked above open food. Manager must add a shield or extend the guard to keep saliva off food.

headline: No certified manager; no health policy
summary: No certified manager on site while TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. No written employee health policy; no food handler training proof. Pest control log missing; last report dated 2021. Hair restraint missing. Missing wall panel and ceiling tile above walk-in.

headline: Moldy ice machine; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Black and pink mold inside large ice machine dripping onto ice for people to eat. Low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine, not sanitizing; tagged and held. Also dirty floors, walls, hood filters, and dust-covered vents. Citations issued.

headline: Expired allergen training
summary: Expired allergen training observed. All certified managers must provide valid allergen training. Re-inspection, passed.

headline: Mold caulking; items on floors; raw wood
summary: Moldy caulking at kitchen hand sink and three-compartment sink. Duct tape and cardboard repairs not allowed. Items on floors must be elevated. Raw wood by ice machine must be removed. Water-damaged ceiling tiles and dirty floors.

headline: Repeat hand sink violation; rust and leaks
summary: Repeat violations: rear hand sink improperly connected, causing splashing; ice machine lacks visible backflow device. Also leaky three-compartment faucets, rusty walk-in shelving, damaged cooler handle, damaged wall base, and no wet mop hanging system.

headline: Tortillas in grocery bag; wet mops
summary: Corn tortillas stored in a grocery bag in front refrigerator; told to use food-grade bags or containers. Wet mops in dishwashing/prep area; told to hang them to dry.

headline: Signage, door gap, and sink leaks cited
summary: Missing handwashing signage in right all-gender washroom. Opening at base of front entrance doors must be sealed. Three-compartment sink stoppers leak. No prep sink in prep area; one must be installed.

headline: Missing sink stopper; ice machine residue
summary: Serving utensils not inverted in rear prep/dish area; one sink stopper missing. Slight pink residue inside ice machine. Dried grease droplets above rear prep stove; instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; dirty floors
summary: No handwashing signage in first-floor women's toilet room. Cutting boards with open seams and dark stains in seafood prep. Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced. Food debris and dirt under equipment, along walls, and in corners.

headline: No hot water at prep sink; sewage pooling
summary: Hot water measured 64.0°F in food court restroom, and no hot water at street taco prep sink. Prep area closed until maintenance repaired it and it reopened. Pastry three-compartment sink drains poorly, water pooling on floor. Citations issued.

headline: No certified manager at start; missing handler certificates
summary: No certified person in charge or food employee present at start; manager arrived later with valid certificate; citation issued. Prep sinks lacked paper towels, supplied during inspection. Pasta covered while cooling. Cooks lacked food handler certificates, a repeat violation.

headline: Bolognese held at 59.5°F; tightly covered cooling
summary: Twenty pounds of Bolognese sauce found at 59.5°F in walk-in cooler, placed a day earlier; discarded, valued at $50. Cooling in tightly covered containers; told to loosen covers. Prep cooler missing thermometer; ice maker lacks visible backflow device.

headline: Foil liner on cooking equipment; broken cooler handle
summary: Aluminum foil used as liner on cooking and frying equipment; staff told to remove it so surfaces stay smooth and cleanable. Broken left door handle on tall two-door cooler in rear prep area; instructed to repair.

headline: Debris under prep tables, floors, and sinks
summary: Shelf under prep table next to noodle boiler has debris build-up. Slight debris on floors under dish machine chemicals, throughout basement, and around front prep tables. Walls and pipes under three-compartment sink need cleaning. Re-inspection, passed.

headline: Mold in ice machine; dish machines at 0 ppm
summary: Black mold-like substance inside ice machine; citation issued. Two dish machines read 0 ppm chlorine; tagged, repaired on site. Six whole ducks left at room temperature; about 210 lb discarded. Complaint inspection, failed.

headline: Gaps at exit door; hood lights out
summary: Gap at bottom and side of Wells Street exit door; must be sealed to prevent pest activity. All light bulbs under hood out; lighting must be provided for cleaning.

headline: Overflowing dumpsters; greasy container lid
summary: Two outside dumpsters overflow with bags and cardboard and cannot close, so pests cannot be kept out; citation issued. Grease buildup on top of grease container lid. Dusty gray-black buildup on floors between cooking equipment.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep
summary: No valid certified manager on duty while short ribs, oxtails, and mac and cheese were prepared and served; citation issued. Bulk storage container exteriors need cleaning, floors along walls need cleaning, and hoods need grease removal.

headline: Condensation dripping; clothing on food shelves
summary: Condensation dripping into bucket in walk-in cooler; must be drained outside the cooler. Employee clothing hung on food shelves in rear storage; keep away from food.

headline: Missing sink stoppers; greasy hood
summary: Three-compartment sink has no stoppers; working stoppers must be provided. Grease and food buildup on ventilation hood; must be cleaned.

headline: Leaking deli hand sink; broken light shield
summary: Leaking hand sink in deli/meat area by hot holding; must be repaired. Rusty food transport carts must be cleaned or replaced. Broken light shield in meat department stock walk-in cooler must be repaired.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep
summary: No original certified food manager certificate on site while TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. No written vomit or diarrhea procedures or supplies. Cheesecake slices in display cooler lacked labels and allergen info. Allergen training missing.

headline: Improper plate storage; milk crates used
summary: Serving plates on shelves in kitchen and dining areas not stored properly; staff told to invert them to prevent dust. Milk crates used for elevation in walk-in cooler and bars; must stop, use proper shelving, and store food six inches from walls.

headline: Dirty equipment exteriors; slow rear sink drain
summary: Exterior of some cooking equipment, walk-in storage racks holding chicken, and hot holding units need cleaning. Rear exposed hand sink in cooking area drains slowly; must be corrected. Clean wall behind prep counter and floors around and under equipment.

headline: Multiple employees lack food handler training
summary: Multiple employees lack food handler training; must complete it and keep records on site. No thermometer inside dessert station cooler. Trash receptacle missing in basement toilet room. Hood filters dusty; ice machine has debris.

headline: Leak by water heater tanks
summary: Leak in rear area by water heater tanks. Instructed to correct and maintain. Re-inspection, passed.

headline: Food stored on floor; employees eating in prep
summary: Employees eating in prep area; need designated break area. Bulk containers uncovered; food stored on floors in cooler and freezer must be elevated six inches. Dispensing utensil handle left on ice. Greasy equipment and debris-covered floors.

headline: Gaps at entrance doors; torn cooler gasket
summary: Quarter-inch gap at front entrance door sweeps; must rodent-proof doors. Torn cooler gasket, slight ice machine buildup, and hood lights out. Hand sink drain leaks. No covered trash can in washroom.

headline: No certified manager while prepping chicken
summary: No City of Chicago food sanitation manager on site while TCS foods like chicken were prepared. Manager must be present at all times, and a valid certificate must be posted in plain view. Citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; handwashing sink unusable
summary: No person in charge with certified manager certificate; no certified manager on site while TCS pizzas and chicken were prepared; citation issued. Pizza-oven hand sink inaccessible; water shut off, drain leaking. Previous violations uncorrected: leaky faucet and hot water pedal.

headline: No certified manager and no handwashing soap
summary: No certified food manager on duty; no soap at prep and meat-department handwashing sinks. Also: employee drinks in prep area; inoperable thermometer; unlabeled seasonings; greasy grinder and fryer filter; handler certificates not posted.

headline: Missing raw or undercooked food advisory
summary: Menu lacks consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods. Management must identify those items and add the required sentence before the reminder statement. Priority foundation violation, 7-38-005.

headline: Shipping plastic, damaged walls, items on floor
summary: Equipment still wrapped in shipping plastic; must be removed. Basement drywall has gaps; baseboard missing in basement prep. Items on floor in tool room; elevate to prevent pest harborage. Upstairs hood light missing.

headline: Front door gaps; freezer ice; dirty filter
summary: Openings at front door corners could let pests in; must be sealed. Front display freezer has ice buildup to defrost and clean. Walk-in cooler floors need spill and debris cleaning. Dirty filter above fryer. Certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Gap at rear door; no mop sink backflow device
summary: Quarter-inch gap at rear exit door sweep; must be rodent-proofed. No backflow prevention device at mop sink; must be provided and made visible. Food and grease buildup on ventilation hood and filters; must be cleaned.

headline: Dust and debris along walls and under equipment
summary: Build-up of dust, dirt, and debris under dishwashing areas along walls, and under and around deep freezer and reach-in cooler in front service area. Staff instructed to clean all areas.

headline: Thermometer placement and grab-and-go labeling
summary: Prep cooler thermometer kept at back of cooler; staff told to place it in the warmest part. Grab-and-go containers lacked full ingredient labels; proper labeling required.

headline: Minor leaks and dusty floors
summary: Minor leak at faucet of three-compartment sinks in butcher walk-in and prepared foods/deli prep area; must be repaired. Dust on walls and minor dirt on floors in food prep and rear storage; must be cleaned.

headline: No employee health policy; food handler training
summary: No employee health policy on premises. Person in charge must provide documentation that employees must report illness transmissible through food. All food handlers must obtain required food handler training.

headline: Repeat floor and vent cleaning violations
summary: Repeat violations not corrected: floors under and behind kitchen equipment need detail cleaning; hood vents need cleaning. Also no handwashing signage, unlabeled food bins, damaged floor tiles, discolored cutting boards, dirty cold holding units, and clutter under counters.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; cold tomatoes unsafe
summary: Dish machines read 0 ppm chlorine; now reading 50 ppm per Ecolab, citation issued. Diced tomatoes at 60-62°F in hot dog stand; cold unit was not turned on. About 2 lb discarded. Bar hand sinks 63°F, toilet rooms 79°F. No employee health policy.

headline: No paper towels; food stored on floor
summary: No paper towels at prep-area hand sink; citation issued. Food stored on floor in prep area and freezer must be elevated. Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables. Food debris on coolers, freezers, cutting boards, sinks, and prep tables.

headline: Milk crates used for elevation
summary: Milk crates must not be used to elevate stored items. Staff told to stop.

headline: Gasket buildup, rust, greasy filters
summary: Build-up inside door gaskets of cold-holding units must be cleaned. Rust on bottoms of prep tables must be repaired. Grease on hood-system filters must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager; handwashing gaps
summary: No valid certified manager on duty while deli meats, sandwiches, and soups were prepared and served; citation issued. Hand sink lacked soap and paper towels; both supplied during inspection. Staff without hair restraints; leaky sink faucet.

headline: Detail cleaning needed in several areas
summary: Inspector asked for detail cleaning of fan covers above produce prep tables, spillage and debris in the walk-in dairy cooler, and floors under shelving throughout the facility, excluding meat processing.

headline: Repeat grease, debris, and mold violations
summary: Repeat violations not corrected: deep fryer, microwave, and floor-drain cleaning required; citation issued. Blackened, moldy caulking at three-compartment sink. Dirty floors and water-damaged ceiling tiles. No food handler or allergen training proof.

headline: Hand sink lacks soap; sink backs up
summary: Basement prep hand sink had no soap; staff supplied it during inspection. Employee washed dishes without sanitizing; corrected on site. Three-compartment sink backs up; repair required. Missing stoppers, excess ice in walk-in freezer, and missing floor tiles.

headline: Expired certificate; no certified manager present
summary: Person in charge lacks valid certified food manager certificate; certification expired. No certified manager on premises while TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. Torn cooler gaskets and cardboard used as floor mats.

headline: Dirty ice machines; several TCS foods too warm
summary: Black dirt inside 2nd-floor and basement ice machines; all ice discarded. Deli prep cooler held dressing, crab mix, feta, and ricotta at 44.1-48°F; 20 lb discarded. Cooler itself at 48°F; must be repaired.

headline: Missing signage and leaking sink pipe
summary: No handwashing signage at bar hand sink; must be provided. Leaking pipe under bar three-compartment sink pooled water; must be repaired. Women's toilet receptacles lack lids. Gap under sink must be sealed. Dirty floors, ceiling vents, and grease under hood.

headline: Dish machine and buffet temperature violations
summary: High-temp dish machine final rinse 156.7°F, below 180°F; tagged and held. Buffet eggs at 114.6°F, potatoes 104.8°F, sliced melon 62.8°F, turkey 63.9°F; told to discard. Uncovered cold foods; handwashing signage missing.

headline: Raw wood, grease trap, ceiling tile
summary: Raw wood surfaces in front prep must be sealed or painted to be cleanable. Grease trap or interceptor must be installed under three-compartment sink. Broken ceiling tile above rear prep table must be replaced.

headline: Leaking hand sink; new manager lacks training
summary: Hand sink leaks onto floor; management placed a bucket underneath. Must be repaired as a hand-washing source. Three-compartment sink drain and hot water knob leak. Grease and debris under cooking equipment; clean to prevent pests. New manager lacks allergen training; must obtain.

headline: Basement clutter and spilled soda syrup
summary: Unnecessary items stored in basement must be removed; other items must be elevated and organized. Spilled soda syrup in basement must be cleaned. Re-inspection, passed.

headline: Drinks on prep tables; ice machine dirty
summary: Food handlers' bottled water and drinks on prep tables; told to store them in designated areas. Interior of ice machine not clean; instructed to remove, clean and maintain.

headline: No hand drying; warewash machine out of use
summary: No paper towels or hand-drying device at handwashing sink for about a month; reusable towels now used instead. Warewashing machine lacks temperature gauge and dispenser verification; tagged and held. Use three-compartment sink for all dishes.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink faucet
summary: Base of three-compartment sink faucet leaks and is in poor repair; must be repaired. Debris in floor drain under sink; must be cleaned to prevent pest breeding.

headline: Dirt under cooking equipment
summary: Dirt on floor under cooking equipment in rear prep area. Person in charge must detail clean the floor and maintain it.

headline: Dirty deli slicer; filters above cooking
summary: Deli meat slicer must be cleaned, sanitized, and have food debris removed between uses. Filters above cooking equipment are dirty; must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Floors under grill and along walls need cleaning
summary: Inspector told staff to clean and maintain floors along the wall base and underneath cooking equipment, especially by the grill. Complaint inspection, passed.

headline: No certified manager; slime in ice machine
summary: No certified food manager on duty while TCS foods were prepared and served. Black-and-pink slime inside ice machine dripping onto ice. Gap under front door; no pest control log. Frozen desserts kept in freezer outside rear door.

headline: Trash and grease on disposal area ground
summary: Trash, grease and boxes on ground in disposal area; corrected on site. Citation issued for vermin and insect control. Advised to enclose fence behind dumpsters. Greasy floors under fryers and oven need cleaning.

headline: Missing signage, thermometers, and wall gap
summary: Handwashing signage needed at front and rear prep sinks. Thermometers must be visible inside front-prep reach-in and walk-in coolers. Opening between wall and floor in rear prep/dish area must be sealed.

headline: Unlabeled containers; backflow device missing
summary: Some food containers lacked common-name labels. Food boxes in rear storage must be stored six inches off floor. Loose faucet at employee washroom sink; backflow device behind ice machine must be installed so it can be serviced.

headline: Food on floors; wet cloths; milk-crate shelving
summary: Food containers stored on floors in cooler, prep and storage areas; must be elevated. Wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces. Milk crates used as shelving; flour and rice bins unlabeled. Staff lacked hair restraints. Spills and debris throughout facility.

headline: Rat droppings found; no certified manager
summary: Thirty or more rat droppings on floor under cooking equipment and behind basement stored items; pest control required before reinspection; citation issued. Person in charge and manager lack certificates. No sanitizer test strips on site.

headline: Pest activity: about 20 small flies
summary: About 20 small flies seen near dish machine; pest control consultation required, citation issued. Certified manager absent while TCS foods were held and handled. Person in charge lacked food safety training proof. Standing water and food debris on floors.

headline: No health policy; sink water too cool
summary: No employee health policy or training on site; signed policy required for each employee. No vomit or diarrhea procedure or supplies; required. Three-compartment sink hot water only 100°F; needs 110°F minimum; priority violation. Missing handwashing signage and cooler thermometers.

headline: Self-serve condiments and produce unprotected
summary: Self-serve station lacked sneeze guards or covers; condiments, fruit, and cooked vegetables exposed to possible contamination. Priority violation; citation issued. Floor drain at three-compartment sink in dish area needs cleaning.

headline: Missing handler certificates; minor upkeep issues
summary: No food handler certificates on site; records must be kept there. Ice scoop stored on ice machine, to be stored properly. Crumbs on shelves under prep tables; floors under cooking equipment need cleaning. Stair hole to dry storage must be sealed.

headline: Dish machine too weak; no manager at arrival
summary: No certified manager on site at arrival; manager arrived about one hour later. Dish machine sanitizer at 10 ppm, below 50 ppm minimum; tagged. Black slime inside ice machine. Ceiling tile missing near ice machine.

headline: Walk-in ice buildup; missing allergen certificates
summary: Excess ice at walk-in cooler condenser; must be removed. Prep hand sink by fryers has stripped hot water handle; must be repaired. Allergen training certificates still not provided on site for certified managers.

headline: No certificate, health policy, or cleanup kit
summary: No original certificate posted, no employee health policy, and no vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure; citations issued. Dish machine sanitizer at 0 ppm; no test kit or metal thermometer. Bar hand sink has no running water. Report not posted.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; cardboard shelf liners
summary: Torn gasket on pizza cooler in rear prep must be repaired. Cardboard used as liners on food storage shelves must be removed. Minor grease spills outside oil tank; clean.

headline: No food handler proof; quarter-inch exit gap
summary: No proof of food handler training or allergen training for certificate holders. Quarter-inch gap at patio exit door; install a door sweep. Ice machine interior unclean; rusted walk-in shelves; hole under hand sink covered by plywood; dirty floors; poor lighting.

headline: Unlabeled food storage containers
summary: Food storage containers lacked labels with common food names. Staff instructed to provide labels.

headline: No certified manager; unsafe cold food temps
summary: No certified manager on premises; corrected on site when one arrived before inspection ended. Cold TCS foods, including milk, yogurt and eggs, held at 46-63.3°F; 965 lb, valued at $8,100, voluntarily discarded. Two coolers too warm; tagged.

headline: Stained cutting boards; broken floor tiles
summary: All cutting boards stained with deep cuts; must be replaced. Broken or missing floor tiles in several prep and storage areas; standing puddles must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Clutter in dining and bar areas; elevate items.

headline: Hair restraints and wiping cloth storage
summary: Food handlers without hair restraints; must wear them. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer; ice scoop stored on ice bin; mop not hung to dry. Men's washbowl needs recaulking; women's toilet ventilation not working; dirty floors and walls around sinks and equipment.

headline: Inaccessible toilet-room sink; drain into sink
summary: Hand sink in toilet room not accessible; ceiling drain pipe empties into it and must be rerouted to an approved drain; priority citation. Cooked chicken wings held at 77°F on counter; about 10 lb discarded. Containers washed without sanitizing; citation issued. Heavy dust on hood filters.

headline: No hot water at salad bar hand sink
summary: Hand sink at salad bar prep area had no hot water; measured 61°F. Must provide at least 100°F water. A second hand sink nearby is available for staff. Priority violation.

headline: Wet wiping cloth left on cutting board
summary: Wet wiping cloth stored on cutting board in rear slicing area; staff told to keep it in sanitizing solution when not in use. Toilet room trash cans must have lids.

headline: No food handler training proof
summary: No proof of food handler training for any food handlers. Staff must provide and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Hand sink access, soap, and towels lacking
summary: Main prep hand sink blocked by a bucket; front prep sink lacks soap and hand drying. Pizzas on display at 65-82°F without time control; cooler at 68°F, tagged. Cheese at 60°F and spinach at 56°F discarded. No food thermometer. Allergen training missing.

headline: Bed and personal items behind counter
summary: Bed and employee personal items stored behind cooler and front counter; must be removed. Rust on walk-in wire racks. Repeat violations include stained cutting board, grease on equipment, worn floor grout, and a gas stove lacking ventilation; citation issued.

headline: Water-damaged ceiling tiles; greasy hood
summary: Wiping cloths stored on prep tables; must be kept in sanitizing solution. Dirt in light shields above prep tables. Water-damaged ceiling tiles in rear prep. Grease on ventilation hood and filters.

headline: Unapproved reduced-oxygen packaging; food discarded
summary: Reduced-oxygen packaging of TCS foods without city variance; must stop until approved. About 20 lb (about $50) discarded. Condensate hose drains onto floor at central bar; must be relocated. Hood heavily soiled with grease.

headline: Unlabeled sugar container
summary: Sugar kept out of its original container without a product-name label. Staff told to label all foods and spices removed from original containers.

headline: About 55 live flies in basement food storage
summary: Approximately 55 live small flies on walls and ceiling of basement food storage area; citation issued. Additional pest control service needed. Rusty basement walk-in shelving; dust on vents. Prior violation uncorrected: no dedicated prep sink; waste dumped in bucket.

headline: Peeling ceiling paint on basement staircase
summary: Paint peeling from ceiling on staircase leading to basement prep. Must be repaired and maintained to prevent contamination. Re-inspection, passed.

headline: Cooked chickens cooled under dusty fan
summary: Cooked chickens at 144.5°F stored under a dusty industrial fan; juice pooling on floor. Staff told to remove the fan and use proper containers. Also: stained cutting board, greasy equipment and floors, and a gas stove without ventilation.

headline: No backflow device; missing floor tile
summary: No backflow device at utility sink; must be provided and maintained. Clutter in rear storage rooms must be organized and unnecessary items removed. Missing floor tile leading to rear storage must be replaced. Raw wood storage floors must be sealed.

headline: Customer dog in dining area; oil buildup
summary: Customer pet dog found in dining area; only service animals allowed, citation issued. No metal stem thermometer on site; to be provided. Oil buildup behind fryers and on prep-area floor. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: No certified manager; cooked chicken too cool
summary: No certified manager with valid certificate on site while chicken, fish, and mashed potatoes were prepared; citation issued. About 6 lb cooked chicken at 104.5-123°F discarded; hot food must be held at 135°F or above. Thermometers missing from cooling units.

headline: Warm cannoli cream; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Cannoli cream filling held at 60°F; no temperature logs kept; manager discarded 10 lb. Third-floor bar dish machine read 0 ppm sanitizer; it was not in use and a technician arrived to service it. Citations issued.

headline: Dusty ceiling vents
summary: Dust on ceiling vent in washroom and on other vents in prep area. Staff instructed to clean to remove dust.

headline: No employee health policy or vomit cleanup plan
summary: No employee health policy on site. Vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit and procedures were missing; provided by inspection's end. Sanitizer test kit also provided by end. Also: no allergen training, torn cooler gaskets, slow sink drain, unlabeled bins.

headline: Repeat violations: food on freezer floor, grease
summary: Previous core violations not corrected: food on walk-in freezer floor, torn freezer gasket, grime and grease on cold units and equipment, items on rear storage floor, and greasy hoods. Styrofoam items stored in bulk containers; citation issued.

headline: Dirty floors; food debris in cold holding
summary: Hand soap at three-compartment sink must be removed; handwashing only at designated sinks. Food debris inside all cold-holding units. Dirt on floors, along walls, and in corners in prep, warewashing, and storage areas.

headline: Mold-like build-up on storage closet light
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Green slime was found on the glass light cover in the storage closet. One of three certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: No backflow device at mop sink
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. No backflow prevention device was at the mop sink. The operator must provide one in an accessible location.

headline: Restroom ventilation not working
summary: License inspection passed. Mechanical ventilation in the restroom did not work. The person in charge was told to repair it.

headline: Washroom door not self-closing
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The washroom door had no self-closing device. Management was told to install one.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and food handler training
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Handwashing signs were missing and the basement restroom door was not self-closing. Food handlers lacked certificates, and a certified manager had no current allergen training. Mold-like build-up was in some coolers.

headline: Light dust under equipment; passed
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Light dust was found under and behind equipment in the front and rear service areas. Staff were told to clean and maintain.

headline: Photocopy of food manager certificate posted
summary: Passed with conditions. A photocopy of the City food manager certificate was posted instead of the original. A citation was issued. The restroom door also had no self-closing device.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; hair restraint not worn
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Handwashing signs were missing in the rear bar. A thermometer was needed in the milk cooler. A food handler wore no hair restraint, and ice scoops were stored in the ice bin.

headline: Greasy kitchen hood and filters
summary: License re-inspection passed. The kitchen exhaust hood and filters had heavy grease build-up. The operator was told to detail clean them.

headline: Food handler without hair restraint
summary: Complaint inspection passed. A food handler was preparing food without a hair restraint. Mops were not stored for air drying, and floors under heavy equipment had food, grease and debris. Staff were told to correct each item.

headline: Restroom without covered bin; no food handler certificates
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The women's restroom had no covered waste receptacle. Clutter filled the dish area. Food handler certificates could not be verified, and no proof of allergen training was on site for managers.

headline: Sanitizer missing at dish sink; no health policy
summary: Complaint inspection passed with conditions. The three-compartment sink had no sanitizer, and a handwashing sink was used for rinsing utensils. No health policy or food handler proof was on site. A summary report was not posted, and a citation was issued.

headline: Dead roaches on counter shelving
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Dead roaches were found on counter shelving near paper bags. Staff must remove them and sanitize the area. Pest control service is recommended. Grease and food debris also need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; food and debris on floors
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. No certified manager was on site while ground beef and hamburgers were prepared. A citation was issued. Fly strips hung over prep areas. Food was on floors and debris covered equipment. Some food was discarded.

headline: Uncooked food in non-food-grade containers
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Uncooked food was stored in non-food-grade containers in reach-in coolers. Pipe holes in basement walls and ceilings were noted as possible pest entry points. Leaks, grease and lights out were also noted.

headline: Missing hair restraint and food handler training
summary: Re-inspection passed. A food handler had no hair restraint, wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer, debris and standing water sat under the three-compartment sink drain, and one employee lacked food handler training.

headline: Can opener blade needs cleaning
summary: Canvass inspection passed. A large can opener had build-up at the blade. The operator was told to clean it.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit kit or food handler certificates
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. No City-certified manager was on premises while chicken and rice were prepared. No vomit kit was on site. No food handler or allergen certificates were on site. A citation was issued.

headline: Missing handwashing signs in bar
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Handwashing signs were missing at the bar-area handwashing sinks. The manager was told to post them.

headline: Dirty kitchen floors and cold-hold units
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Plates and platters were not inverted. Food debris built up in cold-hold gaskets and freezer interiors. Grime and food debris were on kitchen floors and in corners.

headline: Leak under front hand sink
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. A valve leaked under the front-prep handwashing sink. The operator was told to repair it.

headline: Broken cooler handle and damaged backflow device
summary: Complaint inspection passed. A broken door handle on a prep-kitchen cooler, a damaged side plate in a cold-holding unit, and a damaged backflow preventer at the mop sink were found. Repairs were ordered.

headline: Restroom door and ventilation issues
summary: License re-inspection passed. The employee all-gender washroom door was not self-closing and its exhaust fan did not work. Stained ceiling tiles were found on the sales floor, and no mop drying rack was installed.

headline: Cluttered basement floor; damaged ceiling light cover
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The basement storage room floor was cluttered and items must be raised or removed. A cracked ceiling light cover above the basement prep table must be replaced.

headline: Basement openings that may let pests in
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Multiple basement openings were found in ceilings, around pipes and in walls, and must be sealed to prevent pests. Food debris and dirt were on shelving and equipment, and the kitchen door frame was missing a part.

headline: Walk-in cooler and freezer running too warm
summary: License inspection failed. The walk-in cooler measured 52.5F and the reach-in freezer 57.6F. Cold food must stay at 41F or below. The manager was told to repair the equipment.

headline: Storage, labeling and pest device problems; passed
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Personal items were stored above clean knives, bulk containers were unlabeled, a pest control device hung above clean single-service items, wiping cloths sat in soap without sanitizer, and closets were cluttered. Staff were told to fix each item.

headline: Two food handlers without training proof
summary: Canvass inspection passed. No proof of food handler training was found for one male and one female food handler. They must provide proof at all times.

headline: No certified food manager during TCS food prep
summary: Passed with conditions. No City-certified food manager was on site while milk and other TCS foods (foods that must stay hot or cold) were prepared and served. A citation was issued. A slow drain at the three-compartment sink was also noted.

headline: Improper storage, labeling and freezer ice build-up
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Food was stored on the freezer floor, containers lacked food names, wet wiping cloths and scoops were stored improperly, and excess ice covered the walk-in freezer floor. The mop was not drying properly.

headline: Hot water too cool; cooler at 60.2F
summary: Canvass inspection failed. Employee cafeteria sink water measured 62.6F, below the required 100F, and was corrected by a technician during inspection. Dish machine sanitizer read 0 ppm. A reach-in cooler at 60.2F must not be used until reinspected. The three-compartment sink backed up.

headline: No certified manager; no paper towels or hair restraints
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. No certified manager was on duty while chicken, hamburgers and raw oysters were handled. Paper towels were missing at a hand sink and were obtained during inspection. Food handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Cooked chicken at 87.7F; discarded
summary: Complaint inspection passed with conditions. Cooked chicken was on the counter at 87.7F with no active temperature control. The manager discarded 20 lbs. A citation was issued. A microwave, hand sink and exhaust filters were greasy.

headline: String used as shelf brackets; mop heads
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. String was used as brackets for dish room shelving and must be replaced with smooth, cleanable material. Soiled mop heads must be stored upside down at the mop sink.

headline: Stained cutting boards; damaged floor tiles
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Cutting boards had open seams and stains and must be refinished or replaced. Floor grout was missing and tiles were damaged in prep and restroom areas.

headline: No valid City food manager certificate on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid City of Chicago sanitation manager certificate was on site, and no certified manager was present while beef and steak were prepared. A citation was issued. A scoop was improperly stored, and no food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Raw meat stored on floor in walk-in
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Boxes of raw meat were on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised at least 6 inches. Foil was used as a shelf liner, and shelving had dust and food residue.

headline: Damaged cooler door; no allergen proof
summary: Canvass inspection passed. A cook-line cooler door had damaged insulation and a missing handle. Damaged baseboard coving was in the basement beer cooler. No allergen training proof was on site for the certified managers.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; no hair restraint
summary: Complaint inspection passed with conditions. Bulk rice and flour containers had no labels. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. Handwashing signs were missing, and a citation was issued for no paper towels, which were provided by inspection end.

headline: Cooler lacks thermometer; food stored with linens
summary: Canvass inspection failed. A sauce cooler lacked an internal air thermometer. Clean linens were stored in contact with dry chiles. Equipment and single-service cups were on the floor, drain plugs were in poor repair, and trash was in the rear area.

headline: No raw food advisory; single-service items on floor
summary: Canvass inspection failed. No consumer advisory was posted for raw or undercooked foods. Single-service items were not inverted and were stored on the floor. A citation was issued.

headline: Expired date-marked prepared foods
summary: Short-form complaint inspection passed with conditions. Prepared TCS foods such as salsas and dressings were not date-marked, and some were kept beyond the 7-day limit. A citation was issued. Serving plates were stored upright.

headline: Dried food debris in coolers and floors
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Cooler interiors held deli meat, tomatoes and fruit with dried food debris. Floors behind cooling units had dried food debris. The operator was told to clean.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; debris under equipment
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. A two-door cooler in the rear prep had torn gaskets. Cooling units had spilled food debris inside. Food debris was under heavy equipment and in hallway storage racks, which can harbor pests.

headline: Residue in keg coolers; debris in dry storage
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Keg coolers in the bar had residue inside. Dry storage had debris under shelving. The operator was told to clean both.

headline: Unlabeled flour and food-safety storage issues; passed
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Flour was unlabeled but was corrected on site before the inspection ended. Ice bins lacked lids, a scoop rested in flour, knives and forks were uncovered, and the employee restroom had no lidded trash can.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; food stored on floor
summary: Canvass inspection passed. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was on site, so one was ordered. Food, bottles and cans were stored on the floor and must be raised 6 inches.

headline: Shrimp thawed under partial water flow
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Frozen shrimp was thawing under running water that did not fully submerge it. The operator was told to thaw under running water so loose particles drain away. The second-floor dish hood cover was bent and soiled.

headline: Missing ceiling tiles in storage area
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Ceiling tile panels were missing in the side storage area, and some tiles were stained. The operator was told to replace them.

headline: No allergen training for food manager
summary: License re-inspection passed. The food manager had no food allergen training. The facility must provide and maintain it.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed with conditions. No certified manager with a valid certificate was on site while ground beef and nacho cheese were prepared. A citation was issued. No written employee health policy was on site.

headline: Over 80 mouse droppings; eggs thawing at sink
summary: Complaint inspection failed. Over 80 mouse droppings were found in the cooler compressor and under storage shelves. Eggs were thawing under running water at a handwashing sink. The manager was told to call an exterminator, clean, and sanitize. Citations were issued.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink faucet
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The three-compartment sink faucet leaked. Reach-in cooler interiors had food build-up, and floors needed cleaning of food spills.

headline: Hot and cold food held at unsafe temperatures
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. About 40 lbs of cooked chicken at 72.5F to 76.7F and cut lettuce at 53.4F were discarded. Splash guards, drain repairs and a cracked floor also need attention.

headline: Single-service items on floor; leaking drainpipe
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Single-service items were stored on the rear storage floor and must be raised 6 inches. No backflow device was on the utility sink, and a drainpipe under the three-compartment sink leaked.

headline: Gaps in rear and entry doors; sink trap in poor repair
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. A one-inch gap at the rear door and a half-inch gap at the front door need sealing to keep rodents out. A basement handwashing sink trap was in poor repair. Basement walls lacked cove.

headline: Lamb held at 50 to 52.2F; discarded
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. About 3 lbs of lamb in the cold-holding unit measured 50 to 52.2F. The manager discarded it. Cold TCS food must be kept at 41F or below. A citation was issued.

headline: No food handler training; sushi rice variance missing
summary: Canvass re-inspection failed. No food handler training was provided for employees. A prior priority violation was not corrected: no variance was obtained for room-temperature sushi rice. A citation was issued.

headline: Dirty cutting boards and grease on cooking equipment
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Cutting boards had deep grooves and needed cleaning or replacing. Cooking equipment had grease and charcoal residue. Floors, hood vents and wiping cloth storage also needed correction.

headline: No hot water at sinks; dirty ice machine
summary: Complaint inspection passed. The premises operated with no hot water at hand sinks, mop sink and three-compartment sink. This is a priority citation. Trash outside may attract pests, and walls and ceiling have holes.

headline: Missing backflow devices on new equipment
summary: License inspection passed. The new water dispenser, iced tea unit and ice machine in the prep area had no backflow preventers. The operator was told to install them.

headline: Slime inside coffee bar ice maker
summary: Canvass inspection passed. A slight slime build-up was found inside the ice maker at the coffee bar. The operator was told to clean it.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food and missing allergen training
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Inspector found bulk flour, sugar and other food not labeled, and a City sanitation manager without allergen training. The owner was told to correct both.

headline: Mold-like substance dripping into ice
summary: Complaint inspection passed with conditions. A mold-like substance on the ice machine panel was dripping into ice used for drinks. The manager discarded the ice and cleaned and sanitized the machine during inspection. Heavy grease and dust were also found.

headline: Gap under front door; food on floor
summary: Canvass inspection passed. A 2-inch gap at the bottom of the front exit door must be sealed to prevent pests. Food containers were on the floor and must be elevated. Bulk containers lacked labels, and food was stored in plastic grocery bags.
