headline: Missing handwashing sign and covered trash
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The rear dish-area handwashing sink had no handwashing sign. The employee restroom had no covered trash can. A hood light was burned out.

headline: Mobile food vehicle missing garbage can; dirty floor
summary: License inspection passed. The mobile food vehicle had no garbage can, and grease debris was on the ceiling screen. Dirt covered the vehicle floor. The operator was told to provide a garbage can and clean.

headline: Dirty fryers, shelves, and floors
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Fryer interiors, prep tables and cooling units needed cleaning. Rusted walk-in shelves needed replacing. Floors, drains and ceiling vents also needed cleaning.

headline: Standing water under sinks; three bulbs out
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Standing water and dirt were under the three-compartment sink and dish machine, which can attract insects. Three light bulbs were out above the high-temperature dish machine. Staff were told to clean and replace them.

headline: No soap and no sanitizer test strip
summary: Canvass inspection failed. No soap was at the dish machine handwashing sink, and no sanitizer test strip was on site. Both are priority violations and citations were issued.

headline: Food handler without training; no hand sink signage
summary: Canvass inspection passed. One food handler had no food handler training. The handwashing sink by the walk-in cooler had no handwashing signage.

headline: Rodent droppings found; pest service needed
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. About 15 rodent droppings were under the kitchen fryer and about 10 under the dish rack. The person in charge cleaned the areas. Additional pest control service is needed. A citation was issued.

headline: Food from unapproved source; no mop sink
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. Tamales and tacos in the freezer came from an unapproved source with no receipt, which is a priority violation. The refrigerator for meat and milk had no thermometer, and no mop sink was on site.

headline: Rodent droppings, roaches, and cold food at 49-103F
summary: Canvass inspection failed. Over 70 rodent droppings and about 35 live flies were found. Dead roaches were on counters. About 50 lbs of chicken at 103F and other cold food were discarded. Several sinks lacked soap and towels.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; cleaning and repairs ordered
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Bulk containers had no labels, including salt, sugar and flour. Staff were told to detail-clean many surfaces, clear basement storage to prevent pest harborage, repair ceiling and wall damage, and clean the hood.

headline: Unlabeled basement containers; cooler gaskets torn
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Multiple basement containers lacked common names. Two-door cooler gaskets were badly worn and handles were missing, exposing sharp edges. Clutter at the stair landing could harbor pests.

headline: No hot water at men's restroom sinks
summary: Complaint inspection failed. Men's employee handwashing sinks had no hot water. Water measured 90.5F, below the required 100F. This is a priority violation, and a citation was issued.

headline: Unlabeled food and cluttered shelves
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Refrigerated foods lacked labels, and food was kept in grocery bags and tin ccans. A three-compartment sink faucet leaked. Clutter on shelves could hide pests.

headline: No certified manager; cold food 50.5F
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. No certified manager was on duty while TCS foods were prepared. Pizzas at 50.5F were discarded. The front prep cooler at 50.1F is tagged and must not be used until reinspected.

headline: No calibrated food thermometer on site
summary: Canvass inspection failed. No calibrated metal-stem food thermometer was on the premises. A thermometer must be provided by the re-inspection date. A priority violation was issued.

headline: No certified manager; no sanitizer; no backflow
summary: License inspection failed. No certified food service manager certificate and no vomit cleanup kit were on site. Sanitizer was unavailable for dishwashing. A hot-water knob at a bar sink was broken. The ice maker was dirty, had no backflow device, and no allergen certificate was on site.

headline: No certified manager; flying insects; no health policy
summary: Complaint inspection failed. No valid food sanitation certificate was posted, and no written health policy was on site. About 30 live small flying insects were found in the rear storage and retail display areas. Pest control is required. Pest logs were not maintained.

headline: Gap under rear door; wastewater leaking
summary: License inspection passed with conditions. The rear door had a half-inch gap that must be sealed to keep rodents out. Wastewater tank leaked badly, but the manager adjusted the valves and wastewater was draining properly by the end.

headline: Unlabeled packaged food; no food handler training
summary: License inspection passed. Packaged salsa and peppers for sale lacked required labels. No food handler training was found for employees. The washroom had no operable exhaust fan, and equipment too large for the sink was not sanitized.

headline: Men's restroom and storage floor cleaning needed
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Men's restroom fixtures needed cleaning. Rear storage floors needed cleaning along wall bases and corners to remove spills and debris.

headline: No service sink on site
summary: Short-form complaint inspection passed. No service sink was on site. The operator must install one with hot and cold water and a backflow prevention device.

headline: Ice scoop in ice; mop stored in bucket
summary: Canvass inspection passed. An ice scoop lay in ice inside the ice machine. A prep cooler cutting board had deep grooves. The reach-in freezer had food spills, and the mop was stored in its bucket instead of hanging to dry.

headline: Sink not running water; repeated code issues
summary: Canvass re-inspection failed. One of three men's restroom handwashing sinks had no running water. The three-compartment faucet kept running with both knobs closed. Cracked floor tiles and missing coving were carried over from a prior violation.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; leaking sink
summary: Complaint inspection passed with conditions. A high-temperature dish machine's final rinse read 113F, below the required 165F. It was tagged and must not be used until repaired. A thermometer was provided during inspection.

headline: Standing liquid in cooler and basement
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Standing liquid was in an unused reach-in cooler at the rear bar and on the basement floor. Two ceiling light bulbs above the prep area were burned out.

headline: Dust on vents above prep areas; basement freezer dirty
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Plates were stored face-up under air vents, which can collect dust. The basement walk-in had dirt and standing water. A basement freezer area had dirt, and a women's restroom sink leaked.

headline: Convection oven lacks ventilation
summary: License re-inspection passed. A large convection oven drawing 22.4 kilowatts had no ventilation above it. The manager was told to install ventilation.

headline: Missing door handle and baseboard; allergen training
summary: Canvass inspection passed. A cook-line freezer had a missing door handle and exposed insulation. Baseboard coving was missing at the utility sink and ice machine. Both pending City-certified managers need allergen training.

headline: Ice machine soiled; cup on food-prep table
summary: Canvass inspection failed. An ice machine was soiled with pink residue and was ordered out of use until cleaned and sanitized. An employee's uncovered drink cup sat beside food. Personal care items were above food.

headline: Expired allergen training for one manager
summary: Canvass inspection passed. One certified food manager's allergen training had expired. The manager must renew it and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Missing handwashing sign and food-safety storage fixes
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. The bar handwashing sink had no handwashing sign. Dry seasoning containers lacked labels, plastic cups were used as scoops, and pans were stored on the floor, which must be at least 6 inches up.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; dusty vents
summary: Complaint inspection passed. The sandwich-station cooler needed a visible, working thermometer. Dust had built up in ceiling vents, and a light shield was broken near the walk-in cooler.

headline: Mold-like caulking; ice chute debris
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The ice machine chute had debris. Excessive black mold-like caulking was found at the three-compartment sink. Staff were told to clean and replace the caulking.

headline: Damaged floor tiles and dusty ceiling vents
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed with conditions. Floor tiles were damaged in the dry storage and dish room and must be repaired to be smooth and cleanable. Ceiling vents in the prep, dish and restroom areas were dirty.

headline: No employee health policy; no trash contract
summary: Canvass re-inspection failed. No written employee health policy was on site. Hot water was not available at the three-compartment sink, and only a trickle of water flowed. Trash bags were inside with no commercial dumpster. Citations were issued.

headline: Hot water too cool; many upkeep and certificate problems
summary: Washroom sink reached only 85.3F; handwashing sinks must reach 100F. Also: bulk foods not labeled, expired food handler certificates, no allergen proof, and a damaged freezer lid. Citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled containers; no hair restraints
summary: Re-inspection passed. Dry ingredient containers and squeeze bottles unlabeled. Uncovered pizza dough proofing. Some food handlers lack hair restraints. Lidless restroom bin. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Unshielded waste pipes; damaged cutting boards
summary: Overhead waste pipes in basement food storage are not shielded and must be enclosed. Cutting boards have deep scratches and stains. Missing ceiling panels above walk-in cooler need repair.

headline: Flying insects; no paper towels; uncovered bulk
summary: Numerous flying insects in prep and dish areas, landing on tables and condiments; exterminator required. No paper towels at handwashing sinks; citation issued. Uncovered bulk containers, broken stoppers, and fan not working.

headline: Mice droppings, flies, and hot and cold food problems
summary: About 75 or more mouse droppings, a dead mouse, and about 30 live flies found in storage, furnace room, and by onions. Steak held at 121.6F to 129.2F and lettuce at 47.1F; discarded. No certified manager or health policy. Citations issued.

headline: No food handler certificates on premises
summary: No food handler certificates were on the premises. Manager was instructed that all food handlers must be certified, with employee names on file.

headline: Sanitizer at zero; citation issued
summary: Low-temperature dishwasher on second floor bar measured 0 ppm sanitizer. Manager replaced empty sanitizer bottle during inspection. Citation issued. Outdoor bar sink needs handwashing signage.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; dust and dirt
summary: Missing thermometer inside a milk cooler in the rear prep area. Dust on light shield above food storage shelf and dirt on the floor between refrigeration units. Must clean and maintain.

headline: Gaps in doors; damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Quarter-inch gaps at both front and rear exit door sweeps must be sealed to rodent-proof. Missing stoppers at both three-compartment sinks. Water-damaged ceiling tiles. Covered trash cans missing. One manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Missing prep sink in pantry area
summary: No prep sink in the 30th-32nd floor pantry areas. Business was told to provide one.

headline: Unapproved vacuum packing; expired allergen certificate
summary: Vacuum packing machine used without a CDPH-approved HACCP plan (a food safety plan); about 1,000 lbs of food held for inspection. Hair restraint missing. Expired allergen certificate for a manager. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Open food containers in public hallway
summary: Open containers of bulk rice, oil, and food in hallway near restrooms must be removed or sealed. Cooler with prepared food must use locks. Raw wood bracket, cloth-lined shelving, plastic tape on floor drain, and ceiling needs repair.

headline: Rat droppings and pink slime in ice machine
summary: About 50 rat droppings found in utility closet near restrooms. Pink slime in ice machine; ice must be discarded. Food debris inside cold-hold units. No food handler certificates on site. Citations issued.

headline: Thermometer placed out of view
summary: Refrigerator thermometer placed behind food containers; instructed to move it to the warmest part of the unit where it is easy to view.

headline: No allergen training certificate
summary: No allergen training certificate on site. Business was told to obtain one.

headline: Grease spills under cooking equipment
summary: Grease spills on floors under and behind cooking equipment. Business must clean and maintain.

headline: Cooler at 60F; no food inside
summary: A two-door cooler measured 60F and was tagged held for inspection; no food was inside. Ice machine has debris. Frozen food in plastic bags. Repair and cleaning required. Allergen certificate missing from prior violation; not corrected.

headline: Thermometer hard to view; rough wall
summary: Cooler thermometer placed at rear and hard to see; move to an easy-to-view spot. Rough brick wall with food stains behind front prep line must be replaced with smooth, easy-to-clean surface.

headline: Ceiling above prep area needs smoothing
summary: Business was instructed to provide and maintain a smooth, easily cleanable ceiling above the food prep area.

headline: Dirty walk-in cooler and faulty bathroom door
summary: Walk-in cooler ceiling, walls, fan cover, and basement ice machine interior need cleaning. Men's restroom self-closing door not working. Debris and spills along storage walls. Chipping paint and drywall near dishwashing area.

headline: Dirty refrigeration units and missing ceiling tiles
summary: Wiping cloths on prep tables; ice scoops stored in ice machine; dirt inside refrigeration units; slow sink drain; missing ceiling tiles; clutter that could harbor rodents; dust in restroom and floor debris.

headline: No certified person in charge; food too warm
summary: No certified person in charge until 3:05 p.m.; citation issued. Raw chicken stored above ready-to-eat food, corrected on site. Cold TCS foods at 53.2F to 70.5F; about 40 lbs ($300) discarded. Grease and food debris in cold units.

headline: Open drink cup in prep area; ice machine residue
summary: Open drink cup in prep area; told to store away from food. Pink residue inside ice machine must be cleaned. One expired allergen training certificate; current certificates required for all certified managers.

headline: Untrained employees; burnt-out lights; broken fridge
summary: Three employees lack food handler training. Manager lacks allergen training. Broken unused refrigerator; cracked floor tiles; burnt-out lights in storage and restroom hallway; dusty restroom ceilings.

headline: Cold foods too warm; food discarded
summary: Cold TCS foods held between 45.5F and 56.7F, including chicken, fish, milk, and eggs. Manager discarded about 180 lbs (valued at $950). Walk-in cooler measured 49.8F; tagged. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Missing thermometers; food not labeled
summary: Re-inspection passed. Missing thermometers in cooling unit with milk, eggs, and sour cream and in walk-in coolers. Unlabeled breading and seasonings. Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables. Grocery bags used for food. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Missing ceiling tiles; grease under fryers
summary: Re-inspection passed. Thermometers needed in walk-in coolers. Sweet potato equipment has debris. Missing ceiling tiles above walk-in cooler area. Grease and debris pooled under fryers must be removed.

headline: Loose ice machine hinge; slow drain
summary: Ice machine upper door is loose from its hinge and must be reattached. Gap at front door sweep must be fixed. Shelves under warmers need cleaning. Middle sink compartment drains slowly.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Handwashing sign missing at basement prep sink; inspector told the business to provide and maintain it. Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Sanitation manager lacked allergen training; told to meet the requirement.

headline: Sticky stairs and pooling water
summary: Re-inspection passed. Sticky substance on staircase and pooling water along walls in rear prep and dish areas must be removed and kept dry to prevent insects.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; no food guard
summary: Re-inspection passed. Bulk flour and sugar unlabeled. No food guard between drying rack and mop sink in pizza prep area. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Dead insects in light shields; leaks and drains
summary: Re-inspection passed. Dead insects in light shields throughout must be cleaned. Missing handwashing sign in toilet room; slow drain at prep sink; rust and cardboard on walk-in shelving; damaged cooler panels and gaskets.

headline: Grease buildup under fryers in prep area
summary: Grease and food debris built up under heavy fryer equipment throughout the prep area. Business instructed to remove the buildup and keep the area clean.

headline: No certified manager; pest records lapsed
summary: No certified person in charge or food employee on site while pizza, salad, and sandwiches prepared. Pest control service ceased; last report January 2025. Priority violations; citation issued.

headline: Live flies found; hot water too cool; no training
summary: About 50 or more live small flies found in basement prep and dish areas and other spots. Hand sink water reached only 79F, below 100F. No employee health policy or food handler training. Pest control recommended. Citations issued.

headline: No hot running water; citation issued
summary: No hot running water on premises; three-compartment sink at 75.2F. Hot water must be 100F at hand sinks and 110F at the sink. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Cold hot-water; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Handwashing sinks reached only 61F to 86F, below the 100F minimum. High-temperature dish machine not sanitizing; tagged and cannot be used. Final rinse gauge broken. Citations issued.

headline: Sink used as dump sink; food too warm
summary: Bar handwashing sink used as dump sink with dirty glassware and ice; citation issued. Kale, romaine, and diced eggs at customer cold line were too warm and discarded. Ice scoop stored improperly. Eye wash connected to a handwashing faucet.

headline: Broken sink stoppers; backflow device missing
summary: Broken sink stoppers for dish three-compartment sink must be fixed. No backflow prevention device at utility mop sink; must be installed where it can be serviced.

headline: Dirty freezer, coolers, and floors
summary: Re-inspection passed. Pots not inverted; tortilla chips in plastic totes; stained cutting boards; dirty deep freezer and walk-in and reach-in coolers. Food debris and spills on floors and equipment. Detail cleaning required.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods served
summary: No valid City sanitation manager certificate on site while TCS foods, such as quiche, were being served. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Cardboard and rust in walk-in cooler
summary: Re-inspection failed. Cardboard and crates used for food storage must be removed, rust cleaned, and proper shelving provided. Walk-in cooler floors, walls, and hood also need cleaning. Repeat priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Damaged gaskets; missing toilet bin lid
summary: Damaged gaskets on prep cooler; women's restroom lacks a covered receptacle; gap at base of utility room baseboards must be sealed.

headline: Cold foods too warm; leaking faucet; no paper towels
summary: Walk-in cooler foods, including ham at 47.4F and mushrooms at 55F, were too warm; manager discarded 51 lbs. Bathroom sink had no paper towels. Leak at three-compartment sink. Citations issued.

headline: Dishes not sanitized; food too warm
summary: Dishes washed and rinsed without sanitizing; employee was shown how to sanitize; citation issued. Prep cooler at 51.4F, tagged; onions only, no food affected. Wiping cloth on sink splash guard. Cardboard on floors.

headline: Thawing and unlabeled sugar; soiled cloths
summary: Re-inspection passed. Frozen empanada was thawing in a plastic container in the dish area; management told to thaw TCS foods properly. Sugar in unlabeled containers, and soiled wiping cloths left on prep tables.

headline: Ice machine with slime; no ice discarded
summary: Ice machine had black and pink slime build-up over ice used for people to eat. Ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned and sanitized. Priority violation; citation issued. Also: broken dumpster lids and missing allergen certificate.

headline: Leaking condensate line; no backflow device
summary: Leaking condensate line at a cooler at the kitchen entrance; manager told to repair. No backflow device on the ice machine. Bathroom doors not self-closing. Mop left in wet bucket. Corrective instructions given.

headline: Sink blocked by stored items
summary: Handwashing sink in food prep was not accessible; a utensil and milk carton were stored in it. Must stay accessible at all times. Priority violation; citation issued. Also: unlabeled bulk containers and dirty floors.

headline: Worn grout creating standing water
summary: Worn grout around floor tiles causes standing water and debris. Business was told to regrout and maintain.

headline: No certified manager while TCS food prepared
summary: No certified food manager on site while TCS foods were being prepared and served. Priority violation; citation issued. Also: mold-like buildup in beer cooler, unlabeled food handler training, and no allergen certificate.

headline: Missing thermometer in large cooler
summary: Large 9-door cooler holding milk and eggs lacks an internal thermometer; one must be provided. Gummy bears removed from original packaging were missing required labels.

headline: No employee health policy; no vomit kit
summary: Missing employee health policy and vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit; priority violations. Handwashing signs added on site. Half-inch opening at front door must be sealed. Damaged floor and ceiling tiles and light shield need replacing.

headline: Greasy equipment and dirty hood
summary: Raw wood on fry cutter must be painted or stained. Grease on cooking equipment, floors under equipment, hood, filters, and air vents needs detail cleaning.

headline: Mouse droppings and ants; multiple repairs needed
summary: About 75 or more mouse droppings found on storage racks, floors, and near cooking and dish areas. About 30 live ants found by a prep table. Droppings must be removed and areas sanitized. Pest control and many repairs needed. Citation issued.

headline: Gaps in outer doors; no hair restraints
summary: Openings at outer doors and damaged rear screen need sealing to prevent pests. Shrimp, dessert, and condiments uncovered. Hair restraints missing. Knives and spoons stored in water. Boxes on floors; no allergen certificate. Failed re-inspection.

headline: Items on basement floor
summary: Unused items on basement floor should be removed, and the rest stored off the floor to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Cold-hold unit exteriors need cleaning
summary: Re-inspection passed. Business was instructed to clean the exterior, especially handles and bottom panels, of all cold-hold units.

headline: Rusty metal racks in walk-in cooler
summary: Business was told to clean, repaint, or replace rusty metal racks inside the walk-in cooler.

headline: Dirty ice machine and floor drain
summary: Interior of ice machine compartments and bin not clean; ice used for consumption. Mineral buildup outside ice machine. Excess grime at floor drain. Broken floor tiles under three-compartment sink must be replaced.

headline: Leaking pump; drainboard missing
summary: Cutting board grooves must be repaired or replaced. Drainboard needed above three-compartment sink for air-drying. Leaky pump under sink must be repaired.

headline: Gaps at entrance doors; leaking sink
summary: Quarter-inch gap at front entrance double-door sweeps must be sealed. Three-compartment sink faucet leaking at base. One food manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Residue inside ice machine hinge
summary: White residue on the inside door hinge of the ice machine; person in charge instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Broken sink; no thermometer for dish machines
summary: Handwashing sink in pastry prep is inoperable; priority violation. Dish racks on floor must be raised six inches. Torn gaskets on beverage cooler. Dish machines need an irreversible temperature device; priority violation.

headline: Refrigerator too warm, holding raw chicken
summary: Standing refrigerator measured 50F inside and was holding raw chicken and other TCS foods. Cold holding must be 41F or below. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Cooler too warm; no pest service records
summary: Large display cooler measured 47F, above the 41F limit; priority violation. No pest control service report or contract on site, only a book with a certificate. Priority violation; the manager was told to get records.

headline: Boxes on floor; crates and dirty surfaces
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food boxes on floor in walk-in freezer and front prep must be raised six inches. Soiled wiping cloths. Crates in walk-in cooler must be replaced with shelving. Grease, cutting boards, and dirty walls need attention.

headline: Rat droppings; dish sink water too cold; citation
summary: About 15 to 20 rat droppings under the patio server station; citation issued. Dish-area handwashing sink reached only 93.2F and dropped to 39.2F while the dishwasher ran; a plumber fixed it. Patio sink has no water. Other repairs needed.

headline: Build-up on ice machines and cooler gaskets
summary: Nozzles, ice machines, cutting boards, cooler gaskets, and cooler interiors need detail cleaning. Ice utensils must be stored in a clean, sanitized container. Wall at front prep area needs detail cleaning.

headline: Raw hamburgers too warm; discarded
summary: Raw hamburgers in front prep sandwich area measured 49.2F; manager discarded about 12 lbs ($60). Priority violation; citation issued. Also: missing handwashing signs, cracked floor tiles, and greasy hood.

headline: No certified manager; food too warm; citations
summary: No person in charge with valid certificate on duty while TCS foods were prepared and served. Walk-in cooler at 50.1F; prep cooler tagged. Chicken and turkey at 49.1F and 49.5F discarded. Food handler training missing.

headline: Dirty vent hood and filters
summary: Vent hood and filters above cooking equipment in the prep area need cleaning. Business instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Unlabeled ingredients; debris outside
summary: Dry ingredients and oils lacking labels on prep table and shelves must be labeled with common names. Scrap wood and debris along exterior wall must be removed and cleaned.

headline: No allergen training for sanitation manager
summary: Sanitation manager has no allergen training. Business must provide proof.

headline: Litter and dust in storage and cooler
summary: Litter found on basement storage floor and dried leaves outside by the rear exit. Storage racks in walk-in cooler have dust buildup. Business instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Crates used for storage; leaks; clutter
summary: Crates used for elevation throughout prep area must be removed. Missing backflow device on rear utility sink; leaky faucet neck. Missing wall base and clutter. Allergen certificate missing for manager.

headline: Labels, utensils, and fryer placement
summary: Re-inspection passed. Squeeze bottles and shakers need labels. Multi-use utensils must be inverted on shelves. Pots too large for the three-compartment sink. Fryer must be placed under the hood.

headline: Employee drink and soiled cloth
summary: Open employee drink cups placed above prep table; told to keep them away. Soiled wiping cloth on prep table; told to keep it in a sanitizing bucket.

headline: No handwashing sink near dish area
summary: No handwashing sink by the rear dish area; must install one with hot and cold water, soap, and towels. No sneeze guard between order and serving lines. No splash guard at front prep sink. Priority violations.

headline: Rust, film, and floor corrosion
summary: No visible thermometers in small cold-holding units in prep areas. Openings at front entrance door base need sealing. Rust on walk-in shelving, plastic film on prep surfaces, corroded walk-in floor, and mop drying on floor.

headline: Gap under side door
summary: No pests found. Side door has an approximately 1/4 inch gap at the bottom, and the business was told to repair it so it fits tightly.

headline: Wiping cloths, dirt, and a missing sink
summary: Wiping cloths left on prep tables; excessive dirt and food debris in several areas; water-damaged ceiling tiles; restroom ventilation not working. No allergen certificates. No front bar handwashing sink. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Ice machine residue; wiping cloths stored badly
summary: Ice machine interior has residue; business instructed to detail clean and maintain. Wiping cloths improperly stored; must be kept in sanitizing solution when not in use.

headline: Worn gasket and dirty floors
summary: Worn gasket on a reach-in cooler affecting cold holding; repair needed. Dump sink faucet leaks. Floors in storage, dish, cooler, and food service areas have dirt and debris under shelving and equipment. Clean to prevent pests.

headline: Unlabeled containers; gaps and damaged doors
summary: Re-inspection passed. Unlabeled containers, crates used as supports, missing backflow device on ice machine, damaged ceiling tiles, floor tiles, and wall bases, dirt under cooler lines, and no food handler training for one employee.

headline: Fryer grease and debris
summary: Minor grease inside fryers must be cleaned. Cardboard boxes stacked near dish area and food debris on floors by prep lines must be removed and cleaned.

headline: Food on floor in cooler and freezer
summary: Food stored on the floor in walk-in cooler and freezer; food in plastic grocery bags inside freezer. Flour and food debris on equipment and shelves. Two food handlers lack required food handler proof. Manager told to correct.

headline: Grease and dirt on floors; dusty fans
summary: Grease, food debris, and dirt on floors under cooking equipment, along walls, and in corners of prep, dish, and storage areas. Dust on walk-in cooler fan, light shields, and vents must be cleaned.

headline: Dish machine rinse readings do not match
summary: Dish machine digital gauge read 200F, but a thermometer measured 160F at the plate. Machine not in use. Low hot water pressure at front grill; ice buildup on freezer door; water inside cooler light shields.

headline: Food on floor; foil liners
summary: Boxed food stored on walk-in freezer floor must be raised six inches. Aluminum foil lining prep surfaces must be removed. Damaged and missing floor tiles in front of three-compartment sink need repair.

headline: No hot water; food discarded; allergen certificates
summary: No hot running water throughout. Sinks measured 67F to 75F, below required 100F for handwashing and 110F for dishwashing. Half-hour shutdown; hot water restored later. No allergen certificates on site.

headline: Sticky counters and greasy outdoor receptacle
summary: Employee drink left uncovered on condiment counter; told to cover it. Sticky, spilled interior of condiment counter and soda dispenser to be cleaned. Outside grease receptacle has grease and food debris. Allergen training required.

headline: No food handler training proof
summary: No proof of food handler training. Business must provide proof of ANSI-approved training for all food handlers.

headline: Loose faucet; items on floor
summary: Loose washbowl handle in women's restroom. Items stored on dry storage floor must be elevated six inches. Floor drains in rear prep and bar areas have build-up.

headline: Trash outside; wall repairs; no allergen proof
summary: Trash and organic debris outside basement door. Wall under three-compartment sink needs repair; holes need plugging. Unused beverage cooler should be cleared. No allergen training proof for certified managers.

headline: Entry door gaps; leaking drain pipes
summary: Quarter-inch gaps at the bottom of front revolving doors; sealing needed to block pests. Water leaks under both handwashing sinks; repair required. No handwashing signs in washrooms.

headline: Eggs held at 55F; discarded
summary: Eggs in the prep area held at 55F, too warm for cold holding; instructed to discard and hold at 41F or below. Priority violation; citation issued. Also: unlabeled containers and an improperly stored mop.

headline: Spilled bird food; cleaning needed
summary: Spilled bird food on sales shelf must be cleaned where needed. Deli prep area floor drains need cleaning.

headline: Peeling floor paint in prep area
summary: Floor paint peeling in the front prep area. Business was told to repair it to a smooth, cleanable surface and maintain it.

headline: Dairy too warm; citation issued
summary: Half-and-half at 49.6F and milk at 49.1F stored in walk-in cooler; about 33 lbs ($195) discarded. Walk-in cooler measured 48.0F. Priority violations; citations issued.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; chicken discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Chicken in the walk-in cooler measured 46.9°F to 50.3°F, above the 41°F limit. About 100 pounds were discarded. The cooler air measured 50.5°F; it was tagged and held and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Passed; gasket buildup, expired food handler training
summary: Passed re-inspection. Buildup was found in cold-holding unit gaskets and debris behind a freezer in rear storage. Food handler training on site had expired, and staff were told to renew it.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was on site. The facility must provide all necessary supplies at all times, and a citation was issued.

headline: Passed; broken ice machine door panel
summary: Passed. The ice machine's door panel was broken and must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Passed; grease trap debris, missing restroom cover
summary: Passed re-inspection. Excessive grease and food debris were around the grease trap in the third-floor prep and dish area and must be cleaned. The fifth-floor women's restroom lacked a covered waste receptacle.

headline: Failed: over 10 live roaches, leaking sink
summary: Failed. Over 10 live roaches were found on walls and floors in the kitchen and bar; pest control was advised. A basement sink leaks, causing mold. The rear exit door has a gap.

headline: Failed: no health policy, cleanup kit, or waste contract
summary: Failed. No verifiable employee health policy was on site. No kit or procedure for vomit and diarrhea incidents was present, and no record of a waste disposal contract was found. The inspector left a template for the policy.

headline: Passed; certified manager lacks allergen training proof
summary: Passed re-inspection. A certified food service manager had no proof of allergen training. All certified managers must provide proof.

headline: Passed; foil used as shelf liner
summary: Passed. Foil was used as a liner on front prep shelving. The person in charge was instructed to remove it and keep surfaces smooth and cleanable.

headline: Incomplete vomit cleanup kit; food stored improperly
summary: Passed with conditions. The vomit and diarrhea spill kit was incomplete, missing items such as goggles and spray disinfectant. Food containers were not stored properly on shelving. A citation was issued for the kit.

headline: Failed; unsafe restroom water temperatures, no training proof
summary: Failed re-inspection. Restroom handwashing sinks measured 145°F and 149°F, above the 120°F maximum. This prior priority violation was not corrected. No proof of food handler training was shown.

headline: Passed; torn cooler gaskets, low hot water pressure
summary: Passed. Torn gaskets were found inside the sushi prep reach-in cooler and must be repaired. The three-compartment sink in dishwashing has low hot water pressure, which the facility was told to repair.

headline: Failed: 40 mouse droppings, no certified manager
summary: Failed. About 40 mouse droppings were on the front bar floor. No certified food manager was on duty while chicken and pork were prepared and served. Food was stored on floors, and a handsink lacked soap.

headline: Passed; missing signage, dirty can opener and cooler
summary: Passed. The rear prep handwashing sink lacked a sign. A handheld can opener was in poor repair and heavily soiled, and the large deli cooler's interior was dirty. A drying mop was stored against a wall.

headline: Passed; door gap and missing hair restraints
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap between the front entrance doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints, which are required.

headline: Passed; insect control device removed during inspection
summary: Passed. An insect control device hung by a prep table. Only pest control operators should set these devices. The manager removed it during the inspection.

headline: Freezer ice dripped onto food; 5 pounds discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Ice buildup dripped onto food in a freezer; the manager discarded 5 pounds worth $200. Ice in other walk-in freezers, missing sink stoppers, rusty meat cooler shelves, and dirty floors and ceiling tiles also need attention.

headline: Passed; buildup on floors and closet corners
summary: Passed. Buildup was on floors, along wall bases, and in corners of the closet with the utility sink. Staff were instructed to clean these areas.

headline: Passed; dirty walk-in cooler floor and drain
summary: Passed. Dirt and food debris had built up on walk-in cooler floors and under storage shelves. A floor drain under the one-compartment sink in the rear prep area was also dirty and must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: repeat violations, ice machine not clean
summary: Failed. Several core violations from a 2023 inspection remained uncorrected, including milk crates used for elevation and debris under prep tables. The top inside of the ice machine was not clean, and food handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Failed: no manager, unsafe hot-held food
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site at arrival. Steak held at 130°F and beans at 120°F, below the 135°F minimum; 6 pounds of steak and 3 pounds of beans were discarded. Sanitizer test strips were missing, and a prior sink leak was not fixed.

headline: Passed; ice machine stains, missing backflow device
summary: Passed. A stained cutting board with dark grooves must be cleaned or replaced, and brown spots inside the ice machine need cleaning. The ice machine's backflow device could not be located, and electric burners and oven lack ventilation.

headline: Passed; food on floor, allergen training missing
summary: Passed. Food items were stored on the floor in the rear prep area and must be raised six inches. The certified manager had no valid allergen training, which is required.

headline: Passed; sprayer faucet handle needs adjusting
summary: Passed. The faucet handle on the three-compartment sink sprayer needs adjusting. The inspector instructed staff to correct it and keep it working.

headline: Failed: five live roaches, dirty kitchen, expired training
summary: Failed. Five live roaches were found around the rear prep handsink and walls; all activity must be gone by reinspection, and pest control service is advised. Grease and debris covered much of the kitchen. Food handler certificates had expired.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, mold in ice machine
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site while open. Black mold-like substance was inside the ice machine used for drinks. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, and a prior rear-door gap was not corrected.

headline: Blocked handsinks, unsafe holding temps, missing soap
summary: Passed with conditions. Handsinks were blocked, and one was used to rinse utensils; soap and towels were missing. About 50 pounds of food held above 41°F was discarded. A three-compartment sink faucet leaks.

headline: No certified manager; hands not washed, chicken thawed in sink
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while shrimp, beef, and chicken were handled. A worker touched their face and body without washing hands, and chicken was thawing in a sink. Food handlers also lacked certificates.

headline: No certified food manager while handling high-risk foods
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while sausage, beef, and cheese were handled, and no valid certificate was posted. A citation was issued.

headline: Passed; dirty warewashing room floor and drain
summary: Passed. The warewashing room floor and floor drain had food and debris and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Passed; dirt, clutter, and missing handwash sign
summary: Passed. The rear prep handwashing sink lacked a sign. Dirt covered floors, walls, and corners in prep, dish, and storage areas. The rear storage room was cluttered, with items on the floor that need to be raised.

headline: Passed; signage, utensil, and cleanliness issues
summary: Passed. A handwashing sink near the walk-in cooler had no sign. Single-service utensils were not inverted in the front serving area, and spills and debris were on the rear storage floor. Manager was told to correct these.

headline: Passed; missing signs, faucets, and door gap
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs were missing at prep-area sinks. Timed faucets in two restrooms were not working properly and must run for at least 15 seconds. The rear prep door has a small bottom opening and must be rodent-proofed.

headline: Passed; greasy fryer floor and dusty hood
summary: Passed. The floor under the fryers needs grease removed. Dust was on the restroom ceiling vent fan, the floor drain under the three-compartment sink needs cleaning, and the hood above cooking equipment has dust.

headline: Staff eating at prep area; no sanitizer test strips
summary: Passed with conditions. Employees drank and prepared food at the prep area and need a designated break area. No sanitizer test strip kit was on site, and a citation was issued. Hood filters and pipes have heavy grease buildup.

headline: Failed: no soap, food held past 7 days
summary: Failed. The main cook-line handsink had no soap, provided only at the end. Prepared foods, including pico de gallo, were held past the 7-day limit; about 15 pounds were discarded. No metal stem thermometer was on site.

headline: Passed re-inspection; gaps, leaks, missing training
summary: Passed re-inspection. A half-inch gap under the front doors must be rodent-proofed. Leaks under the three-compartment sink need repair, and the grease trap needs cleaning. Several food handlers lacked certificates.

headline: Passed; missing thermometers, dirty floors, no certificate
summary: Passed re-inspection. Display coolers lacked air thermometers, and no food handler training certificate was posted. A mop sat in a bucket, floors were dirty, old equipment remained, and there was no proof of allergen training.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk containers, freezer ice buildup
summary: Passed. Several bulk storage containers lacked labels. The walk-in freezer has ice buildup around the condenser that must be defrosted. The baseboard behind cooking equipment and fryer hood filters are also dirty.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate on site; no splashguard
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge had a valid City of Chicago sanitation certificate on site, and a citation was issued. A splashguard is needed between the bar's handsink and three-compartment sink.

headline: Passed; ice machine cleaning and storage issues
summary: Passed. Upper parts of the ice machine need cleaning. Utensils were stored on a concession handsink splashguard, and milk crates were used to elevate items. Employee belongings were in the food prep area.

headline: Passed; improper thawing, sink leaks, cleaning needed
summary: Passed. Chitterlings were thawing in a dish tub instead of approved methods. Gaps at the front and rear doors need sealing. The three-compartment sink leaks at the faucet and sprayer, and floors, cooking equipment, and hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Passed; wet mop stored in utility area
summary: Passed. A wet mop was stored in the utility area and must be hung to dry when not in use.

headline: Passed; dirty equipment, slow sink, greasy floors
summary: Passed. Interiors of cooking and refrigeration equipment need cleaning. A toilet room handsink drains slowly and must be repaired. Floors throughout the facility have accumulated food, grease, and dirt.

headline: Failed: incomplete pest logbook, grease dripping over food
summary: Failed. The pest control logbook was missing all service reports, and a citation was issued. Hood grease was dripping onto cooking surfaces and exposed food. An employee restroom sink has a one-inch gap at the wall.

headline: Passed; spills and damaged light shield
summary: Passed. The cabinet under the ice bin and soda dispenser has spills that must be cleaned. A light shield in the rear dishwashing area is in poor repair and must be replaced.

headline: Passed; freezer film and cooler gasket
summary: Passed. Protective film remained on a single-door freezer in rear prep and must be removed. The walk-in cooler door gasket is in disrepair and needs repair.

headline: Passed; torn freezer lid, basement clutter
summary: Passed. Serving plates on kitchen shelves need to be inverted, and a chest freezer lid is torn. Basement shelves, floors, and storage areas are cluttered and must be cleared to prevent hiding places for pests.

headline: Passed; no grease trap at three-compartment sink
summary: Passed. The three-compartment sink has no grease trap. The manager must provide one.

headline: Passed; leaking handsink and sprayer issues
summary: Passed. Serving plates on kitchen shelves were not inverted. The kitchen prep handsink leaks at the bottom pipe and drains slowly. The three-compartment sink sprayer hangs below the rim and needs a holder.

headline: Passed; no food handler certificate on site
summary: Passed re-inspection. A soiled mop head was not stored properly and must be hung to prevent insect breeding. No food handler certificate was on site, and the manager was told to comply.

headline: Failed: 10 live roaches and no training proof
summary: Failed re-inspection. Ten live roaches were found in broken wall base, mop hook holes, and storage areas, plus dead ones. Front doors have gaps, food sits on freezer floors, and food handler training proof is missing.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, no sanitizer test strips
summary: Failed. No certified food manager or valid documentation was on site while chicken quesadillas and smoothies were prepared and served. There were no sanitizer test strips, and one food handler lacked a certificate. Basement storage needs cleaning.

headline: Passed; cups used as sugar scoops, storage clutter
summary: Passed. Disposable cups were used to dispense sugar and creamer; the manager was told to provide long-handled dispensing utensils. Clutter in the rear storage area also needs to be organized.

headline: Passed; unlabeled flour container
summary: Passed. A container of flour or seasoning in dry storage had no label. The inspector instructed staff to add one.

headline: Passed; no training proof, stained ceiling tiles
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food handlers had no proof of food handler training, and certified managers had no proof of allergen training. Missing and stained ceiling tiles above the prep and cook line must be replaced.

headline: Failed: about 60 live flies, sink running continuously
summary: Failed. About 25 live small flies were in the basement near the dish machine, and about 35 were on drink lines and walls at the bar. A repeat violation for a three-compartment sink that runs continuously remains unfixed.

headline: Failed: ice scoops stored in ice; repeat violations
summary: Failed. Ice scoops were stored inside a bucket of ice in a freezer, and the freezer had heavy ice buildup. A certified manager lacked allergen training. Prior violations for missing handwashing signs and a non-self-closing restroom door were not corrected.

headline: Passed; leak under sink, raw wood in cooler
summary: Passed. A leak was found under a basement prep handsink and must be repaired. Raw wood on the floor inside the walk-in cooler base must be sealed so it is non-porous and easily cleanable.

headline: Passed; torn freezer gasket, allergen training gaps
summary: Passed re-inspection. A walk-in freezer door has a torn gasket that must be repaired. Two of three certified food managers lacked allergen training and must complete it and keep records on site.

headline: No certified manager on site while preparing beef
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid certified food manager certificate was posted, and no certified manager was on site while beef was prepared and served. A citation was issued. The front door does not close properly, and restroom receptacles need lids.

headline: Passed; unlabeled food, damaged cutting boards, dirty vents
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food in refrigerators lacked labels, and some was stored in tin cans. Cutting boards have open seams, a large hole, and dark stains that must be replaced. Floors and vents need detail cleaning.

headline: Passed; manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: Passed. A certified food service sanitation manager did not have an allergen training certificate. The inspector instructed the facility to meet this requirement.

headline: Passed; unlabeled containers, food on freezer floor
summary: Passed. Granola and chocolate were in containers without product-name labels. Food was stored on the freezer floor and must be raised six inches. Soiled mop heads were not hung to dry, which can attract insects.

headline: Passed; greasy fryer, allergen training missing
summary: Passed re-inspection. Grease built up on the fryer doors and bottom compartment and must be cleaned. No certified food manager had allergen training, and documentation must be provided.

headline: Passed; certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed re-inspection. A certified food manager did not have allergen training. The manager was instructed to comply with the requirement.

headline: Dead roaches found; cold units lack thermometers
summary: Passed re-inspection. Dead roaches were found on a flour container, under the three-compartment sink drainboard, and in a dining-area closet. A small wall opening with a dead roach needs sealing. Walk-in floors had food debris and animal blood.

headline: Passed; missing thermometers, labels, and stoppers
summary: Passed. Two display coolers lacked air thermometers, and food storage containers were unlabeled. Food handlers prepped without hair restraints, scoops were stored in food containers, and the three-compartment sink lacked two stoppers.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies were on site to respond to incidents. Staff were instructed to keep supplies on hand at all times. A citation was issued.

headline: Passed; cleaning, slow drain, drywall hole
summary: Passed. Interiors of prep coolers, prep tables, food containers, the stove, and grill need cleaning. A front prep handsink drains slowly, a small drywall hole needs repair, and food debris and grease are on prep and dishwashing walls.

headline: Failed: no pest control logbook on premises
summary: Failed re-inspection. No pest control logbook was on the premises. The manager must provide a logbook from a licensed Illinois pest control operator and keep it on site at all times.

headline: Passed; stained customer-area ceiling tiles
summary: Passed re-inspection. A few stained ceiling tiles in the customer area must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Passed; grease under fryers needs cleaning
summary: Passed. Grease and food debris were under the fryer, and staff were told to clean it. Fryer exteriors, a garbage container exterior, bulk storage container tops, and floors under the fryers and wok area also need cleaning.

headline: Failed; outdoor bar not rodent-proofed
summary: Failed. The outdoor bar was not properly enclosed to prevent contamination. The inspector instructed the owner to rodent-proof it.

headline: Passed; missing signage, floor debris, storage clutter
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs were needed at sinks, and a cooler thermometer could not be located. Coffee debris was on rear prep floors, and unneeded items were stored on floors, which can create pest hiding places.

headline: Passed; broken floor tiles, peeling ceiling paint
summary: Passed re-inspection. Broken floor tiles in the rear prep area in front of refrigeration units must be repaired. Peeling paint on ceiling panels near the rear exit must be repainted.

headline: Failed: 100+ rodent droppings, dead rats, raw chicken warm
summary: Failed. About 100 or more mouse and rat droppings and two dead rats were found, plus loose rodenticide bait on the sales floor near food. Raw chicken held at 46.4–47.1°F; about 15 pounds discarded. Food handler training was missing.

headline: Passed; missing cooler thermometers, hair restraints
summary: Passed. Reach-in and display coolers had no air thermometers. Food handlers prepped without hair restraints. The basement utility sink lacks a backflow device, and food debris and spills were found throughout the facility.

headline: Failed: dish machine not sanitizing, food too warm
summary: Failed. The low-temperature dish machine at the bar sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine; it was tagged and must not be used until reinspected. Prep cooler food measured 45.8–50.8°F, and 6 pounds were discarded. A prep handsink also lacked soap.

headline: Passed; worn cutting board, dirty floors and shelves
summary: Passed. A prep table cutting board has deep, dark grooves and must be replaced. Dried soda splatter under the dispenser needs cleaning. The pizza dough room floor, debris behind the ovens, and pan shelving also need cleaning.

headline: Passed; worn cooler gasket, stained cutting boards
summary: Passed re-inspection. The walk-in cooler door has a worn gasket that must be repaired or replaced. Worn and stained cutting boards also need repair or replacement.

headline: Passed with conditions; no cooler thermometer, summary not posted
summary: Passed with conditions. No thermometer was inside the dairy walk-in cooler. The prior inspection summary was not posted for public view; management was given today's summary to post, and a citation was issued.

headline: Deli cooler too warm; flies found; no certified manager
summary: Passed with conditions. Deli meat and cheese held at 46-48°F, above the 41°F limit; about 40 pounds were discarded. Three dead house flies were in the deli cooler, and a fly strip hung over meat prep.

headline: No certified manager on duty while serving food
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge was present, and no certified food manager was on duty while high-risk foods were served. Serving plates were not inverted, shelving is porous wood, and kitchen floors are cracked and dirty.

headline: Passed; leaking sink faucet and cleaning issues
summary: Passed. The three-compartment sink faucet base leaks, and the employee restroom door lacks a self-closing device. Vents are dusty, floors under prep tables have grease, and dishwashing walls have peeling paint.

headline: Failed: no hot water at handsink, gaps, soda on floor
summary: Failed. The rear handsink had no hot water, measuring 66.7°F; it must be at least 100°F. Soda stored on the floor, mold in a cooler, a 1/4-inch gap under the front door, and no waste disposal contract on record were also found.

headline: Passed; food debris in third-floor dry storage
summary: Passed. Food debris covered floors and surfaces throughout third-floor dry storage. The inspector instructed the facility to detail clean under all shelving and keep the area clean at all times.

headline: Passed; food stored under sewer pipe
summary: Passed. Dry storage items were kept under a sewer pipe in the basement prep area and must be removed. Cardboard was used as a floor liner by the cooking equipment, and the fryer and pipes behind it need cleaning.

headline: Passed; loose door, taped cooler, debris
summary: Passed. A basement exterior door is not tight-fitting. Electrical tape was on a small cold-hold door and needs a proper gasket. Food debris and water were under a three-door cooler, and crates and boxes were on the basement floor.

headline: Passed; hair restraint, grease, and boxes issues
summary: Passed. A food employee chopped peppers without a hair restraint, which is required. Grease spilled at the outside oil tank, and cardboard boxes were stacked by the rear door. These must be cleaned or removed.

headline: Failed; handsink water too cold, repeat violation
summary: Failed. Hot water at the prep handsink measured 68°F; hand sinks must reach at least 100°F. A floor drain had heavy buildup that can attract pests. A prior rust-damaged faucet was not repaired.

headline: Failed: no hot or cold water, no health policy
summary: Failed. Missing employee health policy, vomit cleanup kit, and pest control logbook. The utility sink has no hot water and the prep handsink has no cold water. Overflowing garbage and holes exposing pipes were also found.

headline: Passed; food on linens, reused containers, soiled gaskets
summary: Passed re-inspection. Cooked sausage and bacon were stored directly on linens, and in-use utensils sat in water at the server area. Sour cream containers were reused for takeout, and cold-hold gaskets were soiled. Some wall tiles are missing.

headline: Failed: 60+ rat droppings, no certificate, no health policy
summary: Failed. About 60 or more rat droppings were found in several areas, and pest control service is recommended. No certified manager certificate was posted, and no signed employee health policies were on site. Food handler training was missing.

headline: Passed; no proof of food handler training
summary: Passed re-inspection. No proof of food handler training or certificates was on site for employees. The facility must provide these records and keep them on site.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; cold food too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. The low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine and is tagged, not to be used. Walk-in beef and chicken measured 55.2–67.8°F; 30 pounds were discarded. Heavy grease and food buildup was also found.

headline: Passed; knife storage and cutting board issues
summary: Passed. Knives were stored between prep coolers, a prep cooler door gasket is torn, and sandwich-line cutting boards have deep grooves and dark stains. Dust was on the ceiling above the front prep area. Staff were told to fix these.

headline: Failed: 60 rodent droppings, live flies, no manager
summary: Failed. Found about 60 large rodent droppings in several areas and 10 live flies near the three-compartment sink. No certified food manager was on site while hot dogs and pizza puffs were prepared.

headline: Passed; door gap, blown bulbs, missing stoppers
summary: Passed re-inspection. A garage door near dishwashing has an opening that must be rodent-proofed. Utensils were not inverted, two sink stoppers were missing, and burnt-out bulbs in prep areas and under the hood need replacing.

headline: Failed: 30-50 rodent droppings in dry storage
summary: Failed. About 30 to 50 rodent droppings were in a corner of dry storage. Additional pest control service is required, and a citation was issued. A cooler gasket is torn, and grease and debris cover cooking equipment and shelves.

headline: Dishes not sanitized; hot food too cool; corrected
summary: An employee washed containers without sanitizing; corrected after instruction; citation issued. Steam table food was too cool: soup at 113F and meatballs at 121F, about 10 lbs discarded. Double entry doors have gaps. Single-use items were stored under a sink.

headline: Hot food too cool; ready food lacks date marks
summary: Cooked pork, chicken, and vegetables in a hot holding unit measured 86F to 118F, below the required 135F; citation issued. Ready-to-eat foods in coolers were not date marked. Sushi bar cooler air was 57F. No allergen training was on site.

headline: Hand-washing lapse; manager lacks hair restraint
summary: A food handler moved dirty trays, then touched clean trays without washing hands; the manager corrected it; citation issued. The manager had no hair restraint in prep. Washrooms lack hand-washing signs. Milk cooler spills and front floors need cleaning.

headline: Food debris and spills at bar
summary: Food debris, paper, and spills are along the bar floor and wall. The owner was instructed to deep clean and increase cleaning frequency.

headline: Rusty shelving, dirty coolers, and damaged floors
summary: A shelf unit under the dishwashing table is severely rusted and has holes. Interiors of prep coolers and the rear restroom need cleaning. The restroom door is not self-closing. Floors have food buildup and damaged grout and tile.

headline: Cardboard used as shelf liner
summary: Cardboard was used as a shelf liner in rear dry storage. It must be removed and shelving kept smooth and cleanable.

headline: Failed: no manager; cooler at 55F tagged
summary: Failed inspection. No certified food manager was on duty while food was prepared; citation issued. A front cooler at 55F was tagged and held for inspection. Cold foods at 48F were discarded. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Food boxes on floors; missing hand-wash signs
summary: Food boxes are stored on floors in the basement walk-in and the rear prep area and must be raised to prevent cross-contamination. Gaps are under two doors. Hand-wash signs are missing. Crates are used for storage, and an allergen certificate is expired.

headline: Failed: mold in ice machine; pork at 63F
summary: Failed inspection. Black mold-like substance inside the ice machine dripped onto stored ice; ice discarded; citation issued. About 10 lbs of ground pork at 63F were discarded. Pork was thawing at room temperature, and bulk flour is unlabeled. Kitchen corners have cardboard clutter.

headline: Failed: about 60 rat droppings in basement
summary: Failed inspection. About 60 rat droppings were found under the basement stairs in the electric room. Rat activity must be eliminated and pest control is recommended. Walk-in coolers lack thermometers, and second-floor restroom ventilation does not work.

headline: Heavy spills in cooler; food handler proof missing
summary: The interior of a two-door cook line cooler had excessive food spills and must be cleaned. Dust is on a ceiling vent above the three-compartment sink, and floors around the hot water tank are dirty. Proof of food handler training is required for all employees.

headline: Failed: black mold-like buildup in ice machine
summary: Failed inspection. Black mold-like buildup in the ice machine dripped onto ice for customers. Ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned; citation issued. Walk-in cooler shelves are rusty. Restroom sink valves leak heavily, and the wall behind the sink is damaged.

headline: Floor drains need cleaning; allergen certificates
summary: Floor drains under the dish machine and by the basement ice machine need cleaning. Certified food managers must obtain required allergen training certificates.

headline: Ice scoop stored in ice; allergen training missing
summary: An ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine, on the ice. It must be removed and a holder provided. Certified food managers on duty lack allergen training certificates.

headline: Hard-to-turn hot water knob at hand sink
summary: The hot water knob at the front hand sink is very hard to turn. The owner was instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: Complaint: grease on cooking equipment and hood
summary: Grease and food debris built up on cooking equipment and must be detail cleaned. Coving at the front counter needs repair. Hood filters are clogged with grease and must be cleaned.

headline: Garbage corral debris; repeat allergen violation
summary: Food debris is on the ground in the enclosed outside garbage area; cleaning is needed to avoid attracting pests. The hood above rear cooking equipment needs dust removed. Repeat allergen training violation; citation issued.

headline: Gaps in exterior door; leak at sink
summary: An exterior door has a 1/4-inch gap on the side and bottom and must be repaired. Napkins were uncovered near the sink. Cold-holding units have food residue. The upstairs bar sink leaks, and the women's restroom lacks a covered receptacle.

headline: Complaint: no certified manager on duty
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while food was prepared and served; citation issued. No allergen training certificate was shown. Containers across from a two-door cooler are unlabeled. The front door has a gap and a ceiling tile is missing.

headline: Soiled mop heads not stored properly
summary: Soiled mop heads were not stored properly. The manager was told to hang them to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Failed: dirty ice machine; missing test strips
summary: Failed inspection. The ice machine's inside panel is rusty and slimy; ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned; citation issued. A side door has a 1/4-inch gap. A fryer leaks grease onto the floor. Sanitizer test strips are missing.

headline: Failed: about 15 live flying insects found
summary: Failed inspection. About 15 live small flying insects were on walls, ceilings, and stock boxes in prep, dish, and storage areas. More pest control is needed. Prior violations were not fixed: the high-temperature dish machine has no temperature indicators.

headline: Minor grease in fryers
summary: The fryer interiors have minor grease buildup and must be cleaned.

headline: Cloths and utensils stored improperly
summary: Soiled wiping cloths were left on prep tables. Multi-use utensils were stored in the dipper well. Single-use items were on the prep floor. Food spills and dust are throughout, and the women's washroom lacks a covered receptacle. No food handler training was shown.

headline: Failed: no manager, roach, and cold wash water
summary: Failed inspection. No valid certified food manager was on site while chicken was served; corrected when the manager arrived. About 10 flies and one live roach were seen; pest control recommended. Handwashing sink water was 76 to 85F, and dish wash water was 91F.

headline: Food residue in prep coolers and grill gaps
summary: Food residue and spills are inside reach-in prep coolers at the cooks station and must be cleaned. Food debris between the flat-top grills must be removed.

headline: Raw eggs above ready-to-eat meats; no manager
summary: No certified food manager on site while food was prepared. Two open flats of raw eggs were stored above ready-to-eat meats; the employee removed them. About 20 lbs of cooked wings and 50 lbs of cheese had no dates and were discarded.

headline: Grocery bags in freezer; expired training certificates
summary: Grocery bags were used in the freezer for some food; food-grade bags are required. Cooler shelves, fryers, and prep tables need cleaning. Ceiling tiles and vents are dusty. Some food handler certificates have expired.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; multiple leaking faucets
summary: Bulk food containers in the basement are not labeled. Reach-in coolers lack thermometers. Wiping cloths need sanitizing buckets. Faucets leak in the meat, cooking, and taqueria areas. Ceilings have peeling paint and vents are dusty.

headline: Wet wiping cloths; torn freezer gasket
summary: Wet wiping cloths were on shelves and prep tables and must be stored in sanitizing solution. A torn gasket on the chest freezer in the rear storage room must be repaired.

headline: No certified manager on site; citation issued
summary: No certified food manager or sanitation certificate was on site while food was prepared and served; citation issued. Gaps under front and rear doors let in pests. Summary report was not posted. Rust, dirty floor drains, and a vent over the oven also need correction.

headline: Ice machine interior needs cleaning
summary: The interior sides of the ice machine must be cleaned and kept clean.

headline: Hot water too low for dish machines; repaired
summary: Hot water dropped to 94F at dish machines and sinks, below the required 110F to 120F. A technician repaired a faulty water heater; citation issued. Basement freezer has heavy frost. Gaskets are soiled, and bar floor needs cleaning.

headline: Deli cups not air dried after washing
summary: Deli cups were not air dried after washing and stacking. Staff were instructed to air dry all reusable utensils after washing.

headline: Failed: about 12 live roaches found
summary: Failed inspection. About 12 or more live roaches were found on a cold-holding unit, on floors, and inside a prep cooler. About 5 to 7 small flies were near onions. Pest control is recommended; citation issued. Fly strips hang from ceilings.

headline: Missing hand-wash sign; foil and rock gaps
summary: No hand-washing sign at the sink behind the front prep area. A splash guard is needed beside the rear prep sink. Aluminum foil lines prep tables. Gaps in basement rock wall must be sealed. Mops and brooms must be raised off the floor.

headline: No thermometers in coolers; mop sink lacks backflow device
summary: Front reach-in coolers have no internal thermometers. The rear mop sink has no backflow prevention device. The rear three-compartment sink leaks at the faucet base.

headline: Failed: flying insects; no certified manager
summary: Failed inspection. No valid certified food manager on site while food was served; citation issued. Numerous flying insects landed on food-prep surfaces; an exterminator was ordered. Employee smoked indoors; citation issued. Bar sinks had no hot water.

headline: Complaint: no hot running water anywhere
summary: No hot running water throughout the establishment. Hand sink water measured 58.9 to 79.1F and the three-compartment sink 74.8F. Required minimums are about 100F for hand sinks and 110F for dish sinks. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Uncovered flour; broken restroom washbasin
summary: A flour-like ingredient is stored uncovered at the cooking area and must be covered. The women's restroom washbasin does not work, and the hot water knob at the cooking line hand sink leaks. Restroom vents and floors under equipment are dirty.

headline: Preset tableware uncovered; cooler exteriors dirty
summary: Preset tableware on dining tables was not covered, wrapped, or inverted and must be. The exterior of the walk-in cooler and freezer, including door handles, has excessive debris.

headline: Cardboard food containers in walk-in cooler
summary: Cardboard boxes were used as food containers in the walk-in cooler; washable containers are required. Floors under the fryers and in the walk-in cooler are dirty. Walls near the window have grease. Unneeded items in the rear hallway must be removed.

headline: Missing beard covers, backflow device, and clutter
summary: Food worker had no beard restraint. No backflow prevention device was found at the ice machine water line; one must be provided. Clutter at broom storage must be cleaned and organized.

headline: Missing sink stoppers; slow hand sink drain
summary: The basement three-compartment sink has no stoppers and must have them. The rear hand sink drains slowly and must be repaired.

headline: Allergy awareness signage needed
summary: The manager was notified to post allergy awareness signage.

headline: Wrong license number; grease under equipment
summary: The unit shows the wrong license number on its sides and must be corrected. Grease and dirt are under the hot holding units, under the three-compartment sink, and on the ground under refrigeration units.

headline: Dirty ice machine lining; cooler gaskets torn
summary: The ice machine lining in the rear prep area is dirty and must be removed and cleaned to prevent ice contamination. A cooler gasket needs repair. Coolers have food debris, rust is on the ice machine exterior, and walls and floors need repair and cleaning.

headline: Gaskets, floor drains, and clutter need fixing
summary: Torn reach-in cooler gaskets must be replaced. Floor drains in the front, bar, and basement need covers. Basement storage has unnecessary items. Floors need detail cleaning, and dish and prep rooms lack coving. Food handlers need certificates.

headline: Food handler lacks training; equipment on floor
summary: Multi-use trays and pots were stored on the floor in the rear. A food handler in the meat and deli area had no food handler training. The certified manager lacks allergen training. Records must be kept on site.

headline: Food on floor; debris; damaged baseboards
summary: Food was stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and freezer; items must be raised six inches. Food debris is on cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, and freezers. The washroom lacks a covered waste container. Baseboards are damaged.

headline: Leaking faucet; restroom and floors need cleaning
summary: The three-compartment sink faucet leaks and must be repaired. Coolers and freezers need working thermometers. Dry storage shelves and the prep station need spill cleanup. Customer restroom fixtures and floors need cleaning, and walls and ceilings are dusty.

headline: Unlabeled containers; food on floor; no hair restraints
summary: Storage containers lack labels with common food names. Food is stored on the prep floor and must be raised six inches. A food handler prepped without a hair restraint. Washroom exhaust vent has dirt buildup.

headline: Food on floors; uncovered food; plastic bags
summary: Food containers were on the floor in the walk-in cooler, prep, and storage areas and must be raised six inches. Freezer and prep food is uncovered. Food is stored in plastic grocery bags in the freezer. Water-damaged ceiling tiles and a greasy hood need attention.

headline: No hand-drying towels at hand sink; citation
summary: The rear prep hand sink had no paper towels. They were provided by the end of inspection; citation issued. Rust is on a prep table bottom and a can opener, and must be removed.

headline: Torn gasket; restroom doors and trash lids
summary: The expo cooler door gasket is torn and must be repaired or replaced. A sink drain leaked and was repaired during the inspection. Lower-level restrooms need self-closing doors and lidded trash cans; a lidded can was provided during inspection.

headline: Milk crates as shelving; drain slow; no training proof
summary: Milk crates are used as shelving in prep, storage, walk-in, and basement areas. They must be replaced with shelving raised six inches. The front prep hand sink drains slowly. No food handler training proof was on site.

headline: Dusty vents; some training certificates expired
summary: Some kitchen ceiling vents and light fixtures are dusty and must be cleaned. Some food handler training certificates have expired; employees must obtain valid certificates.

headline: Food containers stored improperly on drying racks
summary: Food containers were not stored upside down on drying racks. They must be stored inverted to keep them clean.

headline: Complaint: no thermometer, debris in mop sink
summary: No air thermometer inside the hot holding units. A small opening at the bottom of the front door must be sealed. Food debris is in the mop sink, and rear prep floors, especially under the deep fryers, need cleaning.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure
summary: No bodily fluid spill kit or cleanup procedure was on site; instructed to provide one. Citation issued. Food was stored on the floor, cardboard was used as shelf liner, and a drain pipe under the sink leaks. No food handler training proof was shown.

headline: Failed: dirty ice dispenser; broken garbage lid
summary: Failed inspection. The fountain ice dispenser is not clean and must be disassembled and sanitized. An outdoor garbage lid is broken and cannot close; citation issued. Ice buildup in the ice cream freezer and clutter in storage must be addressed.

headline: Missing splash guard, covered bin, and waste can
summary: No splash guard sits between the utility sink and the hand sink outside the employee restroom. The employee restroom has no covered receptacle. No waste receptacle is at the paper towel hand sink. The owner was instructed to provide each.

headline: Bare hands on ready-to-eat food; food too warm
summary: A cook handled breakfast buns and toppings with bare hands; the manager asked for handwashing and gloves; citation issued. Cooked potatoes at 93F were discarded, and no temperature logs were kept. Ice machine interior is dirty and a ceiling tile is missing.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; food near walls
summary: Milk crates were used for elevation in the kitchen, dishwashing, and dry storage areas. They are not allowed because they hide pests. Appropriate shelving is required. Food must be stored six inches from walls.

headline: Failed: rat droppings; no manager on site
summary: Failed inspection. No certified food manager with an original certificate was on site; citation issued. About 15 rat droppings were found near the mop sink, behind a refrigerator, and in the ventilation closet. Front entrance doors are not rodent-proof.

headline: No sink stoppers for warewashing sinks
summary: No sink stoppers were on site during the inspection. The owner was instructed to provide them.

headline: Sushi cold foods too warm; about 80 lbs discarded
summary: Sushi bar coolers held chicken, fish, and sushi rice above 41F; tuna reached 55.2F and sushi rice 76.2F. About 80 lbs (worth $600) were discarded. Cooler air temperatures were 49 to 57F. Cutting boards have deep cuts; storage clutter must be cleared.

headline: Unlabeled salt and sugar; food stored on floor
summary: Bulk salt and sugar containers lack labels. Food containers and boxes were stored on the floor in the rear storage area and must be raised six inches. Scoops were stored inside containers. A kitchen light bulb is burned out.

headline: Bar has no prep sink; restroom stall out of use
