summary: The bar has no prep sink for food preparation, which is required. One women's restroom toilet is covered and unusable; three others work. Some restroom receptacles lack covers, and debris surrounds the dumpster and rear storage floors.

headline: Broken freezer gasket; no training certificates
summary: A broken freezer gasket in the kitchen prep area must be replaced. A cutting board has stains and deep cuts. Certificates showing food handler training were not on site for all employees. No allergen certificate was on the premises.

headline: Dirty floor drains and grease trap area
summary: Floor drains in the bar area need cleaning. The floor around the grease trap in the rear kitchen also needs cleaning.

headline: Coffee machine tagged; cleaning instructions needed
summary: The self-serve coffee machine needs written cleaning instructions. It has been tagged by the city health department (CDPH) and must not be used until cleared.

headline: Dirty ice machine interior; cutting boards worn
summary: The ice machine interior needs detail cleaning. Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizing solution, and knives need a holder. Cutting boards with deep cuts must be replaced. The soda dispenser and floors also need cleaning.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies on site
summary: A vomit and diarrhea procedure was on site, but no cleanup supplies were. The facility must provide gloves, masks, disposable mops, and disinfectant effective against norovirus. Priority violation; manager instructed to provide.

headline: No health policy; allergen training violation repeated
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site; citation issued. Sushi was offered without required sushi rice documentation. No food handler certificates were on site. Allergen training from a previous inspection was not corrected; summary not posted.

headline: Cold foods too warm; cooler failed
summary: Cold foods in service coolers ranged from 44.9F to 59.3F. About 11 lbs (worth $490) were discarded. A prep cooler at 56F may not be used until it holds 41F or below. A torn gasket and dirty floors also need attention.

headline: Sink stoppers worn; cooler debris; floors
summary: Sink stoppers are in poor repair and must be replaced. Reach-in cooler and freezer interiors have spills and debris; cardboard must be removed from a two-door cooler. Floors need cleaning. An opening by the rear exit must be sealed.

headline: Faulty thermometers; low hot water in restroom
summary: Calcium buildup is in the basement ice machine and must be cleaned. Thermometers inside prep coolers are not working and must be replaced. The first customer restroom hand sink has low hot water pressure.

headline: Milk crates used in walk-in; wall openings
summary: Milk crates are used for elevation in walk-in coolers and must be replaced with approved shelving. Openings in the wall behind rear food storage shelving must be sealed. Floor under the shelving is dirty, and vents in the employee restroom are dusty.

headline: Gap under front door; holes in storage area
summary: A gap under the front door must be made tight-fitting to keep insects out. Several small holes in rear storage must be sealed. Window trim and basement staircase need repair. Articles on the basement floor must be elevated or organized.

headline: Failed: no hot water at restroom sink
summary: Failed inspection. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies. Restroom hand sink has no hot water and no hand-washing sign. Gaps under several doors, and the mop sink and restroom ventilation must be fixed.

headline: Failed: no manager, mold in ice machine
summary: Failed inspection. No certified food manager on site while milk, eggs, hummus, and quinoa were prepared. Black and pink mold-like buildup dripped into ice. Self-serve milk and cream were at 50 to 53F and discarded. Duct tape repairs and dirty coolers also noted.

headline: Failed: about 5 live roaches under sink
summary: Failed inspection. About 5 live roaches were found under the three-compartment sink; pest control advised; citation issued. Food handlers prepped without hair restraints. Wet cloths were left out, and a sink faucet leaks.

headline: Missing thermometers and cooler door handle
summary: Thermometers were missing from a walk-in cooler and several display coolers holding food that must stay cold. A walk-in cooler door handle is missing and the splash guard by the hand sink is too short. The certified food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Complaint: leaking pipe; restroom door not closing
summary: A leaking pipe under the front hand sink must be repaired. The restroom door is not self-closing and the restroom has no garbage can. Floors need cleaning along walls and in corners. Bottom shelves of reach-in coolers need cleaning.

headline: No food handler certificates; hood needs cleaning
summary: No food handler certificates were on the premises. Proof of training is required for all food handling employees. The kitchen exhaust hood and filters need detail cleaning to remove dust and grease.

headline: Prep cooler too warm; food discarded
summary: The two-door prep cooler reached 63.5F. Food held up to 64.2F was discarded, about 19.5 lbs ($73), and the unit was tagged. Units must hold 41F or below. A rear door has a gap, and a front sink faucet leaks.

headline: Garbage on vehicle lacks lids
summary: Garbage on the vehicle had no lids. The owner was instructed to provide and keep lidded garbage containers.

headline: Complaint: no hot water at prep hand sink
summary: The prep area hand sink had water at only 95.5F, below the required 100F. Priority violation. Frozen meat was thawing in the prep area; it must thaw under refrigeration or cold running water.

headline: Employee rinsed hands only; citation issued
summary: An employee in the room service station only rinsed and dried hands without soap, which is a priority violation; citation issued. The lobby bar sink lacked paper towels, which the manager supplied. Wet wiping cloths, stained cutting boards, and a leaking pipe were also found.

headline: Food handler training needed or citations follow
summary: Some employees lack food handler training. The manager was told to comply or citations will follow.

headline: Unlabeled ingredients and dirty fans
summary: Flour, seasonings, and sugar were kept in containers without labels. Ice scoops were stored on counters instead of in clean containers. Fans over prep and bar areas had grease and dust. Only one of two allergen training certificates was on site.

headline: Unlabeled containers; restroom lacks lidded bin
summary: Food storage containers lack labels showing the common name of the food. The employee restroom has no covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. The owner was instructed to provide both.

headline: Complaint: food too warm in coolers; discarded
summary: Many cold foods in service coolers were above 41F, including hamburgers (up to 55F), milk (51F), and chicken (59F). The manager discarded 80 lbs of food right away. A prep cooler at 55F may not be used until it holds 41F or below.

headline: Greasy foil under grill; training records missing
summary: Heavy grease, grime, and food debris built up on foil under the grill. Several employees lack food handler training. No allergen training certificates were on site.

headline: Doors not rodent-proof; floors need cleaning
summary: Several doors, including the garbage exit, garage-style event room door, and entry doors to prep and dish areas, are not rodent-proof. Floors behind the ice machine and metal carts need cleaning. New certified food managers must get allergen training.

headline: Failed: bare-hand food contact; black ice substance
summary: Failed inspection. A food handler plated tomatoes and cheese with bare hands; citation issued. A black substance dripped onto ice from the machine; the ice was discarded and the machine cleaned. Menu lacks an advisory for undercooked eggs. No metal-stem thermometer was on site.

headline: Uncovered tableware; one employee lacks allergen training
summary: Preset tableware on dining tables was uncovered and must be covered to prevent contamination. One employee with a sanitation certificate lacks allergen training. Proof is required for all such employees.

headline: Failed: rat droppings and warm beverage cooler
summary: Failed inspection. About 50 rat droppings were in the furnace closet and about 10 fruit flies were found; droppings must be removed and more pest control is needed. The beverage cooler was at 70F and tagged. No written employee health policy was on site.

headline: Single-use items stored under handwashing sink
summary: Cups, plastic utensils and food packaging were stored under the front handwashing sink drain and in an unused restroom. Wiping cloths were stored damp outside sanitizer. Some fixtures are in poor repair and the rear enclosure is cluttered.

headline: Unmonitored free drink samples; cooler thermometers missing
summary: Open, uncovered free drink samples were self-served without monitoring; staff moved them away from customers during inspection and a citation was issued. Several coolers lacked thermometers. A backflow device was blocked by chemicals.

headline: No health policy, vomit kit, or food handler certificates
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site; a template was left. No vomit and diarrhea kit or procedure was present, and no food handler certificates were on site. The unisex washroom lacks a covered bin.

headline: No certified manager; sink blocked by boxes
summary: No certified manager was on site while eggs were prepared; a citation was issued. A rear prep handwashing sink was blocked by boxes and lacked paper towels; also cited. No allergen training and no public summary were posted.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; food stored on floor
summary: The low-temperature dish machine at the first-floor bar read 0 ppm sanitizer and is tagged; it must not be used until reinspected. Food containers were stored on storage area floors and must be raised six inches.

headline: Greasy floors under heavy equipment
summary: Grease has built up on the floor under and behind fryers, the dishwasher and hot-hold units, and along walls and in corners in prep and dish areas. The facility must clean all floors under equipment.

headline: Cold turkey and ham too warm; low hot water
summary: Turkey at 48.1°F and ham at 47.1°F were stored too warm in the walk-in cooler; about 20 pounds were discarded and a citation was issued. The prep handwashing sink water was only 70°F. Handlers lacked hair restraints and food debris is widespread.

headline: Hair restraint lapses and expired food handler card
summary: Multiple food employees were not wearing hair restraints, and one food handler had an expired certificate. The ice machine guard had dirt, cookies and desserts lacked required labels, and coffee debris was on the floor.

headline: No City sanitation certificate on site
summary: The person in charge had no City food service manager certificate on the premises; a citation was issued. Bakery basement floors, drains, carts and walk-in areas need cleaning. All City-certified managers must obtain allergen training.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: The sanitation manager has no allergen training and must obtain it.

headline: Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. The ceiling in the girls' restroom is damaged and has openings; it must be repaired and sealed.

headline: Pest gap, missing hair restraint, worn gaskets
summary: A gap along the bottom of the rear door must be made tight-fitting. A food handler had no hair restraint and shoes were stored under a prep table. Worn gaskets, grease buildup, and missing food handler training are also noted; a citation was issued.

headline: Black build-up in ice machine; fish stored on ice
summary: Black build-up is on the interior panel of the ice machine used for drinks; a citation was issued. Fish and shrimp were in contact with ice in the walk-in cooler. Aluminum foil lines a prep table shelf, and the upstairs bar floors are dirty.

headline: No certified manager on site while open
summary: No certified food manager was on site while the restaurant was open; a citation was issued. Dry ingredient containers were unlabeled, and flour containers were uncovered while chicken was being floured. Sink stoppers are missing; clutter found under sink and prep table.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure
summary: No procedure or supplies for cleaning up vomit and diarrhea, including norovirus-effective products. Ice machine interior had slight debris. Ceramic cups need lead-safety documentation or removal. Allergen training missing for certified managers.

headline: Missing thermometers; mold on cooler walls
summary: Display coolers holding deli sandwiches, fresh chicken and smoked meat need thermometers. The walk-in cooler walls have mold-like spots. Cooking equipment has debris, and trash and items are stored on floors under storage shelving.

headline: Handwashing sinks lacked towels and soap
summary: Handwashing sinks in prep and dishwashing areas lacked paper towels and cleanser. Pots were stored on the floor and cardboard was used as floor mats. No test kit for the bleach sanitizer; food handler certificates could not be verified.

headline: No certified manager; food storage and handling issues
summary: No person in charge or sanitation-certified person was present while chicken and seafood were handled; a citation was issued. Food and boxes are stored on floors, scoop handles touch food, and multiple food handlers lack certificates. Prior violations were not corrected.

headline: Grimy floor sink in lobby
summary: Black, brown and green buildup and debris were found in the lobby floor sink between the fountain drink and tea dispensers. The facility was instructed to clean it.

headline: Unlabeled toppings; uncovered sample spoons
summary: Small ice cream topping containers are unlabeled. Wooden sample spoons were stored uncovered. A draining rack above the three-compartment sink is in poor repair. A 2022 summary report was not posted for public view; a citation was issued.

headline: Mineral buildup; continuously leaking sink faucet
summary: White mineral buildup is inside the ice machine and the three-compartment sink. The sink faucet leaks continuously and its stoppers do not seal. The ice machine top cover is held on with Velcro tape.

headline: No certified manager at start; ice machine slime
summary: No certified manager was on site when the inspection began while TCS food was handled; the manager arrived about 2:35 PM and a citation was issued. The basement ice machine had black and pink slime dripping onto ice; citation issued and ice must be discarded.

headline: Rodent droppings found; rear door gap
summary: About 40 mouse droppings were on the floor of the rear hot water tank area; a citation was issued and more pest control is needed. The rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom. Also unlabeled bulk containers and grocery bags used for food storage.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; restroom lacks trash can
summary: Walk-in cooler and two-door cooler gaskets are torn in the rear prep area and must be repaired or replaced. The employee restroom has no covered trash receptacle; the facility was told to provide one.

headline: No certified manager while chicken prepared
summary: No certified manager was on site while chicken was prepared; a citation was issued. The meat-cutting handwashing sink lacks signage, the cook-line hood is greasy, and several food handler cards were expired. No public summary was posted.

headline: Debris in corners; greasy hood filters
summary: Debris has built up in the corners of the dish and dry storage areas. Grease has built up on the hood system filters. The person in charge was told to clean and maintain both.

headline: Grease and debris throughout meat department
summary: Soiled wiping cloths were stored on meat prep tables. The grinder and fryer oil filter have food buildup, and cardboard is used as a liner. Walls and floors near the hot line have heavy grease and dirt; mop heads must be hung.

headline: Broken hot-water handle at three-compartment sink
summary: The hot-water handle at the three-compartment sink is broken; management was told to repair it, and dishes must be sanitized in the dishmachine until fixed. A citation was issued. Other issues include a 1/4-inch door gap and a leaking hand sink drain.

headline: 30 live flies near onions; no health policy
summary: About 30 live small flies were in a box of onions and around the three-compartment sink, and one large fly was in the dining area. Pest control was recommended. No employee health policy was on site, and a freezer gasket was taped.

headline: Rear door gap; hair restraint lapse
summary: The rear door has a 1/2-inch gap underneath and must be rodent- and insect-proofed. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint in the prep area. Trash receptacles in both unisex toilet rooms lack lids.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: The sanitation manager on the premises has no allergen training and must provide proof.

headline: Person in charge has only a photocopy certificate
summary: The person in charge has only a photocopy of the City food manager certificate. A valid original certificate must be kept on the premises; a priority foundation violation was noted.

headline: No employee health policy or vomit cleanup kit
summary: No employee health policy and no vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit were on the premises; both are required. The basement washroom door lacks a self-closing device. All food handlers must obtain required food handler training.

headline: Leaking faucet; greasy floors and cluttered basement
summary: The two-compartment prep sink faucet leaks at its base. Heavy grease, food debris and trash are on the floor under the cook line and fryers. The basement storage area is disorganized and holds equipment covered in trash.

headline: Dead flies on prep floors and counters
summary: Dead flies were found on prep floors, behind cabinets and equipment, and on counters; staff were told to remove and sanitize them. No valid certificate was posted for public view. Items are stored on the closet floor.

headline: Food handlers lacked hair restraints; milk crates used
summary: Food handlers preparing food were not wearing hair restraints. Milk crates are used as shelving in prep and storage areas. Loose debris, dirt and dust build up on floors and corners throughout the facility.

headline: Cold food held too warm; product discarded
summary: Cold food held at 47–51°F, above the 41°F limit; manager discarded about $250 of yogurt, cheese, sour cream and lettuce. A cooler fluctuated 44–48°F but was restored before inspection ended. Kitchen floors had debris and soil.

headline: Loose cooler gaskets; greasy fryer bottoms
summary: Rubber gaskets on the two-door cooler in the rear prep area are loose and must be reattached or replaced to keep cold air in. Clean the bottoms of fryers where greasy and clean floor corners around equipment.

headline: Sewage odor; missing allergen and food handler certificates
summary: A strong sewage odor comes from the floor grease trap in the dish and prep area. No allergen training or food handler certificates were on site. A backflow device is missing at the ice machine; milk crates are used for elevation.

headline: Employee restroom door lacks self-closer
summary: The employee washroom door near the kitchen has no self-closing device; the facility was instructed to install one.

headline: No employee health policy; leaking faucet
summary: No employee health policy was on the premises, a priority foundation violation. The person in charge must provide documentation that employees must report illnesses. The three-compartment sink faucet sprayer leaks.

headline: No certified manager on site; several violations
summary: No person in charge or certified food manager was on site while beef and eggs were prepared. No employee health policy, food handler proof, allergen training or pest control log. Also unstored ice scoops and burnt-out lights.

headline: Ice scoop left out; leaking hot-water handle
summary: The ice scoop must be stored in a clean container between uses. The hot-water handle of the handwashing sink by the ice machine leaks and needs repair.

headline: Missing hair restraints and training records
summary: Food handlers in the meat department lacked hair restraints. No proof of food handler training was found for any food handler, and certified managers had no allergen training.

headline: Missing sink stoppers; greasy grease trap
summary: Three sink stoppers are missing. The grease trap and connecting pipe next to the warewashing sink are encrusted with grease. The women's toilet lacks lidded waste receptacles.

headline: Slow mop sink; restrooms need deep cleaning
summary: The mop sink drains slowly. Men's and women's restrooms need detail cleaning to remove buildup, and floors throughout need debris removed.

headline: Food containers not stored inverted; dirty coolers
summary: Food containers were not stored inverted. Coolers, shelving and tables were not clean. Walls in basement food storage are not smooth and easy to clean, and floors in prep areas and behind equipment need cleaning.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate; raw beef stored above food
summary: No valid City sanitation certificate was on the premises. Raw beef and eggs were stored above ready-to-eat foods in coolers; those foods were removed and proper food protection was reviewed on site. Also torn gaskets and peeling plastic.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat pizza
summary: A food handler seasoned a cooked pizza with bare hands; 6 pounds were discarded and a citation was issued. Sanitizer read 0 ppm at the warewashing sink; the employee added chlorine and rewashed dishes on site. Date marking missing on several foods.

headline: Rodent droppings near dish machine; no certified manager
summary: About 40 rodent droppings were found around the low-temperature dish machine; a citation was issued. No certified manager was on site while eggs and milk were prepared; also cited. A male food handler lacked a certificate.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Multiple food handlers had expired food handler certificates, and a certified manager's allergen awareness training had expired. A handwashing sink in the rear prep area lacked signage. The person in charge was told to fix both.

headline: No allergen training; exhaust hood not working
summary: No handwashing signage at the restroom sink, and no backflow device at the espresso machine waterline. The exhaust hood over the six-burner stove is not operating; a hood must be provided or the stove removed. The sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Employee without food handler training
summary: A food employee on site had no food handler training or certificate. Floors beneath the three-compartment sink and in the dry storage hallway were soiled with grease and dried food debris.

headline: Unlabeled salt; rear door gap; cardboard liners
summary: Salt and spices were stored in unlabeled containers out of their original packaging. The rear building door is not rodent-proof, with a gap of about 1/4 inch at the bottom. Cardboard is used as shelf liner and must be removed.

headline: Live and dead cockroaches throughout establishment
summary: Over 7 live cockroaches were found at the bar, first-floor prep and basement prep, plus several dead roaches on floors and glueboards. A prior priority violation was not corrected; a citation was issued. Pests must be eliminated and areas cleaned.

headline: Doors not rodent-proof; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: Front entrance double doors have a 1/2-inch gap at the bottom and must be made rodent-proof. Bulk food containers need common-name labels. Aluminum foil lines a cooler, and grease and debris are on the floor under cooking equipment.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof
summary: The rear door has 1/2-inch gaps at the left and right corners and is not rodent- or insect-proof. The facility must make it so.

headline: Black slime around sink; burnt-out bulbs
summary: Black slime is on the caulk around the three-compartment sink. The deep fryer oil filter unit is greasy and cooking equipment has grease and debris. Two bulbs are burnt out in the rear prep area; no proof of allergen training was provided.

headline: No certified manager; only two trained handlers
summary: No certified manager was on site; a citation was issued. The exposed prep-area handwashing sink lacks signage. Only two employees have food handler training, and no public summary was posted.

headline: Rodent droppings and live roach; ice machine debris
summary: About 50 rodent droppings were found in cluttered basement storage and one live cockroach behind the kitchen handsink; a citation was issued and more pest control is needed. The ice machine has debris and the high-temperature dishmachine lacks test strips.

headline: Chicken held too warm; discarded on site
summary: About 10 pounds of chicken breast was held at 50.5–61.5°F in the front prep cooler, above the 41°F limit. The manager discarded and denatured it; a citation was issued. Also no handwashing signage and cardboard used as liner.

headline: Knife rack too close to handwashing sink
summary: A knife rack is installed right next to the handwashing sink in the bakery service area. Install a splash guard or move the rack to prevent contamination.

headline: Live roaches and mouse droppings; priority violation
summary: Live cockroaches and about 45 mouse droppings were found in prep and grocery areas; a prior pest violation was not corrected. Additional pest control is needed; a citation was issued. Other issues include an unprotected exhaust fan and missing signage.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; leaking sink drain
summary: Handwashing signage is missing at several sinks. The three-compartment sink drain plumbing leaks. The all-gender restroom lacks a covered sanitary waste receptacle, and a walk-in cooler light fixture is in poor repair.

headline: Missing ceiling tiles; debris under shelving
summary: Ceiling tiles are missing and unattached throughout the facility. Food debris is on the walk-in cooler floor under shelving; the facility was told to clean it.

headline: 30 live flies; no hot water; expired certificates
summary: About 30 live flies were found near the mop sink, on walls and racks, and swarming the drain; a citation was issued. Hot water was below code at several sinks, also cited. The rear door has a gap, and food handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: No backflow device on service sink
summary: The rear service sink has no visible backflow prevention device. One must be installed and maintained.

headline: Dusty vents and dirty floors in storage
summary: Floors under storage shelves in the rear storage area need cleaning. Dust is on the ceiling vents in both washrooms; the facility was told to clean them.

headline: No certified manager while serving raw meats
summary: No certified food manager or valid documents were on the premises while deli and raw meats were handled and served; a citation was issued. A meat-prep handwashing sink was blocked by boxes and was cleared during inspection. A rear door gap and a plumbing leak were also found.

headline: Person in charge lacks certificate; no certified manager
summary: The person in charge lacks a City sanitation certificate. No certified manager was on duty while ground beef and cheese sauce were handled; a citation was issued. An employee on site lacks food handler training.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; beef thawed improperly
summary: The low-temperature dish machine was not sanitizing (0 ppm) and is tagged; it must not be used until reinspected. Beef was thawed in a prep sink. Other issues include soiled wiping cloths, missing signage, and no allergen training for the manager.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure
summary: Management could not provide a procedure for cleaning up vomit and diarrhea, including the needed chemicals and supplies. The facility was instructed to create one. No citation was issued.

headline: Mold-like growth in ice machine; old TCS foods
summary: Mold-like growth was found inside the ice machine. Multiple TCS foods were stored past the 7-day use-by date and must be discarded. The menu lacked the required raw or undercooked steak advisory; priority violations were noted.

headline: No sanitizer testing; dumpster overflowing
summary: No chemical sanitizer test devices were on site; a citation was issued. The outdoor dumpster overflows with bags piled in the alley hallway; also cited. A freezer gasket is torn and floor tiles are cracked.

headline: Meat bin on floor; missing food handler certificates
summary: A bin of cooked meat was on the kitchen floor; a food employee raised it during inspection. The dishwashing area handwashing sink lacks signage. Food handler certificates could not be found and must be kept on site.

headline: No dish-room handwashing sink; thawing problem
summary: There is no handwashing sink in the dish room. A tub of frozen calamari was thawed at room temperature. An ice scoop sat on ice, the ice makers have no visible backflow device, and grout is missing and the fish cooler is poorly lit.

headline: Rear door sweep gap
summary: The rear exit door sweep has a 1/2-inch gap and must be made rodent-proof.

headline: Chicken left out; steak thawed in standing water
summary: Fried chicken was left at room temperature when the inspector arrived; it was reheated to 165°F during inspection, and a citation was issued. Two packages of steak were thawed in standing water at 66–68°F; about 18 pounds were discarded.

headline: Missing ceiling tile above dish machine
summary: A ceiling tile panel is missing above the dish machine in the kitchen dishwashing area. The facility was told to replace it.

headline: Unlabeled dry ingredients; washroom door lacks closer
summary: Several dry ingredients were in unlabeled storage containers on the shelf. The employee washroom door lacks a self-closing device; management was instructed to install one.

headline: Dirty ice machine; wiping cloths on counter
summary: The left interior wall of the ice machine is not clean. Wiping cloths were left on the front prep counter instead of in sanitizer. Frozen vegetables are stored in plastic totes; a citation was issued for overflowing dumpster lids.

headline: Rear door gap; allergen training missing
summary: Rear door has about a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom, a possible pest entry point; a rodent-proof strip must be installed. No pests were reported. Allergen training certificates are missing for certified food managers.

headline: No certified manager; chicken held too warm
summary: No certified food sanitation manager was on site while chicken was prepared; a citation was issued. Chicken held at 45–47.9°F was discarded (15 lbs). Other issues: no paper towels at sinks, a slow-draining three-compartment sink, no food handler certificates.

headline: Food debris on floors; leaking rear sink
summary: Bulk containers in the rear kitchen are unlabeled. Tongs rest on breadsticks and a plastic cup is used as a dispenser. The rear hand sink drainpipe and mixing valve are leaking, and floors and ceiling vents need cleaning.

headline: Low hot water at hand sink; missing thermometer
summary: Hot water at the prep-area handwashing sink reached only 91°F; plumbers adjusted it to 100°F during inspection. A touchless sink stopped too quickly. No metal-stem thermometer was on site at first, and no drainboards were at the three-compartment sink.

headline: Worn cutting board and damaged cooler gaskets
summary: A heavily worn, uneven cutting board was found. Basement walk-in cooler door gaskets are damaged. Cloths and cardboard are used to raise cutting boards in the front prep area; these must be removed.

headline: Rodent droppings and live roach; no pest service
summary: Over 20 rodent droppings were found in the display cooler area, washroom and storage, and a live roach crawled on a prep handwashing sink faucet. Manager must call an exterminator and clean; a citation was issued. No vomit cleanup procedure, and no manager allergen training.

headline: Gaps at rear doors; leaking faucet
summary: Gaps between rear exit doors must be repaired to prevent pests from entering. The front hand sink knob leaks. Several ceiling tiles are damaged.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; cold food too warm
summary: Black slime in the self-serve ice machine drips onto ice for customers; a citation was issued. Cooked chicken was held at 56.7–58.2°F and was discarded. The certified manager lacks allergen training; prior violations remain uncorrected.

headline: Shellstock tags undated; menu asterisk added on site
summary: Shellstock tags from early 2025 lacked the date the last shellstock was sold or served; a citation was issued. A missing raw-food asterisk on the menu was added on site. Other issues include a rear door opening, a leaking faucet and dead lights.

headline: Restroom ventilation fans not working
summary: The ventilation fans in both washrooms were not operating. Management was instructed to repair or replace them.

headline: Improper ice scoop storage and dirty toilets
summary: An ice scoop was stored on top of the ice machine. A plastic lemon container was in poor repair, both washroom toilet bowls were dirty, and liquid pooled on the floor under a beverage machine.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen proof
summary: Proof of food handler training is required for all required employees, and proof of allergen training is required for certified managers. The utility service sink needs a drain cover.

headline: No pest control proof; several gaps let pests in
summary: No proof of pest control service, and gaps at several outer doors and grease trap openings. Also no vomit cleanup kit, no dish-room handwashing sink, no dishmachine temperature gauge, no backflow device on coffee lines, and no commercial dumpster.

headline: Dead insects across several areas
summary: Dead insects were on glueboards and floors in the beverage prep area, behind coolers and freezers, under the three-compartment sink, in basement storage and in the furnace room; management was told to remove them. Fryer doors need grease cleaned.

headline: Food too warm; unapproved vacuum-seal and smoking
summary: Watermelon held at 68°F was discarded, and vacuum-sealed meats lacked dates. Vacuum-sealing and smoking were done without an approved HACCP plan; about 45 pounds were discarded and the machines were tagged. A cooler above 50°F was repaired during inspection.

headline: Cluttered storage floor must be cleared
summary: On re-inspection, the storage room floor was still cluttered. Items must be raised off the floor or removed.

headline: No allergen training for manager on duty
summary: No allergen training certificate was on site for the certified manager on duty. Debris was found on the rear mechanical room floor and the person in charge was told to clean it.

headline: Worn cooler gasket and leaking faucet
summary: A worn gasket on the meat cooler and a leaking faucet handle at a service-area handwashing sink were found. The facility was instructed to repair both.

headline: Missing thermometers and worn freezer panel
summary: Some small refrigerators had no thermometers. Walk-in freezer door interior panel is in poor repair. Fryers, the floor under cooking equipment and the drive-thru floor drain need cleaning, and a floor tile is missing.

headline: Fail: slime in ice machine; ice discarded
summary: Failed. Black dirt and slime inside the ice machine were dripping into ice used by customers. Management voluntarily discarded the ice. The machine's interior must be cleaned by the reinspection date. A washroom hand sink faucet is loose.

headline: Chicken too warm; hand sinks lacked hot water
summary: Passed with conditions. Ten pounds of chicken in the front prep cooler were held at 47.8F; 9 lbs were discarded. Several hand sinks had no hot water and were restored above 102F during inspection. Food was stored on walk-in freezer floor.

headline: Pass; paper cups used as bulk scoops
summary: Passed. Paper cups were being used as scoops for a bulk food container. Staff must use proper scoops.

headline: Fail: hand sink and dish sink water too cool
summary: Failed. The hand sink and three-compartment sink at the front bar and prep area had hot water at only 80F and 87F. The manager must restore it to 100F. Chicken was stored in printed plastic bags in the walk-in; only food-grade bags are allowed.

headline: Pass; no mop sink, allergen training missing
summary: Passed. There is no service sink for cleaning mops and disposing of mop water. Some floors in front and rear prep areas are uneven. Coving is missing or loose in the rear prep area. The sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Pass; damaged cutting boards, sink areas
summary: Passed. Cutting boards have deep grooves and stains and must be refinished or replaced. The counter under the prep-area hand sink has water damage, and that hand sink has cracked caulking.

headline: Pass with conditions; no health policy on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No written employee health policy was on the premises; a signed policy is required for each employee. A hot water dispenser connected to plumbing lacked a backflow prevention device. Missing baseboards and a wall gap were also noted.

headline: Fail: cooler at 50.2F; no health policy
summary: Failed. A mini cooler in the rear prep area ran at 50.2F and must be repaired to 41F or below. No proof of an employee health policy was on site. The dish machine lacks temperature test devices, and the service agreement address is wrong.

headline: Pass; PIC lacks allergen training
summary: Passed re-inspection. The person in charge lacked allergen training and certificate on site. Wiping cloths were air-drying on food prep surfaces and above clean equipment, and paper towels were stored in the toilet room. These must be corrected.

headline: Pass; uncovered fryers and cleaning issues
summary: Passed. Deep fryers with cooking oil were not covered when not in use. A gap at the bottom of the exit door must be sealed. Also missing handwashing sign, debris on shelves, rusty grill rack, dirty floors, and chemicals not elevated in the mop closet.

headline: Pass; sink signage and cleaning issues
summary: Passed. The 25th-floor coffee bar handwashing sink lacks signage reminding staff to wash hands. The ice machine bounce plate is flaking and pitted. Floors under steamers and ovens are greasy, and floor drains have food debris.

headline: Pass; expired food handler training
summary: Passed. Employees' food handler training had expired and must be renewed, with certificates kept on site. Dishes and cooking equipment stored on the floor in the dishwashing area must be elevated to prevent contamination.

headline: Fail: leaking sink, grease, no allergen training
summary: Failed. A leak at the three-compartment sink is a repeat violation and must be repaired. Grease and food debris cover cooking equipment, coolers, and shelving. A cutting board has deep grooves. No allergen training on site, and a handwashing sign is missing.

headline: Pass; grease, debris, and damaged floors
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food debris and dust are on cooking equipment, prep tables, and shelving. Floor tile grout is missing, and baseboards are damaged in prep, dishwashing, serving, and food court areas.

headline: Pass; missing handwashing signs, upkeep issues
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs are missing in customer and employee washrooms. Also clutter and an unused cooler in rear storage, dirt under cooking equipment, peeling paint, inadequate lighting, and a non-working employee washroom vent.

headline: Pass; mop sink lacks backflow preventer
summary: Passed. The rear mop sink faucet has no visible backflow preventer. The manager must provide one.

headline: Pass; food stored on cooler floor
summary: Passed. Food was stored on the floor of the walk-in cooler and must be kept at least 6 inches off the floor. Basement shelving is rusted and must be replaced or repainted. Missing ceiling tiles near the walk-in cooler must be replaced.

headline: Pass; pest openings and items on floor
summary: Passed with many issues. Gaps at the front and rear doors must be sealed against pests. Pallets and wood are used for elevation, and items are stored on floors. There is no service sink, and cooler door gaskets are damaged.

headline: Pass; holes in dishwashing area walls
summary: Passed. Holes in the walls at the lower-level dishwashing area by the dish machine must be sealed.

headline: Pass with conditions; certificate not posted
summary: Passed with conditions. No original City of Chicago food service certificate was on site; it must be posted, and the person in charge must hold one by the next inspection. Food containers stored on the walk-in cooler floor must be raised 6 inches.

headline: Pass; managers lack allergen training
summary: Passed. Multiple certified food service managers lack allergen awareness training certificates. A hand sink in the front prep area drains slowly, and floor drains under the fountain machines are dirty.

headline: Pass; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. The certified manager on site has no allergen training. Also missing a restroom handwashing sign, a torn cooler gasket, residue in coolers, basement clutter on the floor, and voids in the front prep flooring.

headline: Pass; dirty floors, poor walk-in lighting
summary: Passed. Floor drains, corners, and areas under equipment have dirt and debris. Walls around the three-compartment sink are dirty and stained. Mops are not hung to dry, rear hallway floor tiles are broken, and the walk-in cooler has inadequate lighting.

headline: Pass; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. The food service sanitation manager does not have the required allergen training certificate. The men's restroom door does not self-close and must be fitted with a self-closing device.

headline: Fail: repeat grease and floor violations
summary: Failed. Repeat violations from June 2025 remain: heavy grease and food debris on cooking equipment and fryer cabinets, dirty floors and walls, and detached baseboards trapping debris. A water filter on a hand sink faucet must be removed.

headline: No certified manager on premises
summary: Passed with conditions. No City of Chicago certified manager was on premises; a citation was issued. Also an unlabeled bulk ingredient, pots not inverted, a broken wall tile, fly paper in prep and the restroom, and no food handler certificates on site.

headline: Fail: open rat bait; overflowing dumpster
summary: Failed. Open rat bait pellets were in the rear dish area; the manager disposed of them. The outside dumpster overflowed with lids open, a priority violation. A torn walk-in cooler gasket and missing floor tiles near the utility sink were also noted.

headline: Fail: live flies and rodent droppings found
summary: Failed. About 13 small live flies were in the prep and dish area and flying through the dining room. About 20 large rodent droppings were on liquor shelving and in supply storage. Cold foods at 47F to 50F were discarded, and a cooler was tagged.

headline: Fail: no certified manager; no pest logbook
summary: Failed. No person in charge was assigned, and no certified manager was on site while eggs and milk were prepared and served. The pest logbook was not up to date. Prep and storage corners need cleaning, and there is no hood vent for smoke and odors.

headline: Pass; milk crates still used as shelving
summary: Passed re-inspection. Milk crates are still used as shelving in prep and storage areas. They must be removed and replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Pass; cleaning needed in several food areas
summary: Passed re-inspection. Equipment in deli, bakery, butcher, seafood, and produce prep areas needs cleaning. Floors under and around equipment and storage, plus walk-in units and freezers, need attention. Dusty walk-in fan covers also need cleaning.

headline: Pass; front door gap, no drainboard
summary: Passed. A 1-inch by 1-inch gap at the left side of the front door must be sealed to keep pests out. The three-compartment sink has no drainboard for drying dishes; management was told to install one.

headline: Fail: cold foods too warm; cooler tagged
summary: Failed. Cold foods held at 45.7F to 57.2F, including eggs and milk; about 8.7 lbs were discarded. A prep cooler at 47.1F was tagged. Repeat violations include unlabeled containers, a missing hair restraint, and grease and debris buildup.

headline: Pass; scoop storage, leaks, and lights
summary: Passed. In-use ice scoops were stored with handles in ice. There is a detergent leak at the high-heat dish machine, a dripping hot water handle at the three-compartment sink, two of three lights are out, and employee items are on packaged food.

headline: Pass; scoops, floor storage, dirty equipment
summary: Passed. A thermometer was missing from a small cooler; the manager provided one during inspection. Scoop handles touched food and ice. Equipment and pots were stored on floors, and several units and floors are soiled.

headline: Pass; splash guards missing at two sinks
summary: Passed re-inspection. Handwashing sinks at the grill line sauté station and the second-floor bar lack right-side splash guards. These must be installed to prevent contamination of food, equipment, and prep areas.

headline: Dish machine tagged; cold foods discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. The low-temperature dish machine had zero sanitizer while in use; it was tagged and must not be used until it holds at least 50 ppm and is rechecked. Cheese, eggs, and deli meat at 51F to 52F were discarded. A cooler at 53.2F was also tagged.

headline: Pass; medicine in prep area, door gap
summary: Passed. Over-the-counter medicine was stored on a prep-area shelf. Fly traps in the food prep area must be moved. A side door has a 1/4-inch gap to seal. Also broken floor tiles, a dirty walk-in freezer floor, and non-working restroom ventilation.

headline: Fail: repeat violations, no food handler training
summary: Failed. Repeat violations from 2024 are uncorrected, including food stored on walk-in floors, wiping cloths on cutting boards, and grease buildup. Employees lack food handler training, and the manager lacks allergen training. Dead insects were found in light shields.

headline: Fail: hand sink water too cool
summary: Failed. Hand sinks at the bar and in washrooms ran only 91F to 97F and must reach at least 100F. Plumbers were on site. Also missing handwashing signs and a covered waste receptacle in the women's washroom, plus greasy hood filters.

headline: Fail: no certified manager; unsourced food
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on site while chicken and pot roast were handled. About 10 lbs of cooked meat with no proof of source was discarded. Also missing sanitizer test device, ice machine backflow device, and allergen training.

headline: Fail: hot and cold food too warm
summary: Failed. Pizza slices held at 88F, below the 135F minimum for hot food. Italian beef, cheese, and cooked beans at 44F to 46F in coolers, above 41F. No hot water in washrooms. The previous inspection summary was not posted. Citations issued.

headline: Pass; ice buildup and food debris in freezer
summary: Passed. Excessive ice buildup covers cooling equipment and shelves in the bakery walk-in freezer. Spilled food debris and loose food items were on the freezer floor. Management was instructed to clean and maintain the area.

headline: Fail: 3-5 live roaches in dish, prep areas
summary: Failed. About 3 to 5 live roaches were in the dish and prep areas; pest elimination and a pest control service are recommended. Only a photocopy of the certificate was posted. Frozen meat was thawed in a plastic container. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Fail: 10-20 rodent droppings in prep area
summary: Failed. About 10 to 20 rodent droppings were found throughout the rear prep and dishwashing area. Droppings must be removed and more pest control service obtained. Hand soap was missing and was corrected on site. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: No certified manager during chicken prep
summary: Passed with conditions. No verifiable City of Chicago certified food manager was on site while chicken was prepared and served. A light bulb and shield are missing in the rear prep area.

headline: Fail: 15 mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: Failed. Fifteen mouse droppings were found along walls in the rear dry storage area. Droppings must be removed and the pest operator notified. The person in charge has no City of Chicago sanitation certificate, and none was posted. Dry storage floors and floor drain need cleaning.

headline: Pass; food debris in cooler, dirty floors
summary: Passed. Spilled food debris was inside a reach-in cooler under the prep line. Floors throughout the front prep and rear dishwashing areas must be cleaned.

headline: Dish machine tagged; no certified manager
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid certified manager was on site while shrimp and deli meat were handled. A low-temperature dish machine in the small bar had zero sanitizer and was tagged. Do not use it until it holds at least 50 ppm and is rechecked.

headline: Ham handled on soiled table; discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Deli ham was opened and handled on a soiled prep table with debris and scouring pads. About 5 lbs of ham and lettuce were discarded. Also a leak under a hand sink and dirty deli equipment and floors.

headline: Fail: about 25 live flying insects in prep
summary: Failed. About 25 live small flying insects were on walls and ceilings in first-floor and basement food prep areas. Additional pest control service is needed. A hanging fly strip was in basement prep and must be removed; food debris is on a refrigerator.

headline: Tuna held too warm; about 15 lbs discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Prepackaged tuna steaks in the rear prep cooler were held at 53.6F to 56.1F, above the 41F safe limit. Management discarded about 15 lbs (about $300). A citation was issued.

headline: Dairy held too warm; gloves not changed
summary: Passed with conditions. Dairy in the front prep cooler reached 50.6F; about 15 lbs were discarded. Employees did not wash hands or change gloves when needed. Low water pressure at a rear hand sink, a gap under the front door, and an unlidded sump pump.

headline: Pass; expired manager allergen training
summary: Passed. The counter under the microwave has food debris and must be cleaned. The certified manager's allergen training had expired; new training must be obtained and verification kept on site.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; food discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. The walk-in cooler ran at 52.7F and is tagged; it must not be used until rechecked. Cold foods at 55.8F to 60.2F were discarded. Food stored on floors, and food handler and manager training is missing.

headline: Fail: staff did not wash hands between tasks
summary: Failed. Food handlers moved from cooked food to ready-to-eat food and dirty dishes without washing hands. No consumer advisory on the menu for raw or undercooked eggs. A gap under the rear door and loose caulking at the cooking hood were also noted.

headline: Pass; no allergen training proof
summary: Passed. No proof of allergen training or certificates was provided for City of Chicago certified food managers, and it must be provided. Also a torn door gasket on the salad cooler and a hole in the rear kitchen ceiling.

headline: Pass; door gaps and grease buildup
summary: Passed. Gaps along the bottom and top of entry and exit doors must be sealed. Damaged cooler and freezer door gaskets need repair. Grease and food debris are on several equipment areas, with dead insects in light shields and holes in the mop sink wall.

headline: Pass; expired manager allergen training
summary: Passed. Food handler certificates could not be located, and the certified manager's allergen training had expired. Also soiled wiping cloths on prep tables, a greasy can opener, soiled walk-in shelving, and dirty floors near the three-compartment sink.

headline: No valid sanitation manager certificate on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge had sanitation manager training, and no valid certificate was on site while eggs and bacon were prepared and served. A citation was issued. Grime is inside cold-hold units and on floors under equipment.

headline: Pass; front doors not rodent-proof
summary: Passed re-inspection. The middle of the front entrance doors is not sealed or rodent-proof and must be fixed. The refrigerator interior needs cleaning, and the toilet room lacks a handwashing sign.

headline: Pass; dirty deli slicers, missing thermometers
summary: Passed. Deli meat slicers need cleaning and sanitizing. Working thermometers must be placed in all walk-in and reach-in coolers. A rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap, a leaky pipe is under the three-compartment sink, and ceiling tiles are water-damaged.

headline: Pass; rear door gap, missing splashguard
summary: Passed. The rear door has an approximate 1/4-inch gap around the frame and must be repaired to keep pests out. A splashguard is missing between the hand sink and three-compartment sink, and the pizza cooler lid lacks a handle.

headline: Pass; restroom needs sign and lidded can
summary: Passed. The toilet room needs a handwashing sign and a covered waste receptacle. The manager was instructed to provide both.

headline: Pass; utility sink lacks backflow device
summary: Passed. The utility sink has no backflow device. The manager must provide and maintain one.

headline: Overflowing customer toilet repaired on site
summary: Passed with conditions. The unisex customer toilet was overflowing with fecal matter and smelled strongly; a plumber repaired it before inspection ended. Also missing sushi cooler thermometer, items on floors, water-damaged ceiling tiles, and dirty light shields.

headline: Pass; floor storage and general upkeep issues
summary: Passed re-inspection. Equipment stored on basement floors must be raised at least 6 inches. Raw wood must be sealed. Upkeep problems include missing ceiling covers, baseboards, light covers, and exposed wall studs.

headline: Pass; personal food in customer cooler
summary: Passed. Personal food items were stored inside a reach-in cooler in the rear prep area and must be removed. Food debris covers floors in prep and warewashing areas, and grease has built up on hood filters.

headline: Pass; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. The food service manager lacked allergen training certification. A rusted, broken splash guard is at a hand sink, debris is in lower cabinets, and basement and prep floors have dirt and food debris.

headline: Pass; ice machine residue, utensils not inverted
summary: Passed. The interior of the ice machine has slight residue and must be cleaned. Multi-use utensils were not inverted during storage and must be.

headline: Pass; hole in walk-in cooler floor
summary: Passed re-inspection. A hole in the walk-in cooler floor was causing water to pool. The person in charge was told to repair it so the surface is smooth and cleanable.

headline: No certified manager; no health policy
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid City of Chicago food service sanitation manager certificate was on site while chicken was prepared and served. No employee health policy was found on site.

headline: Cold foods too warm; no hot water at first
summary: Passed with conditions. Many cold foods were held at 46.2F to 85.1F; about 400 lbs ($2,000) were discarded. The walk-in cooler at 53.3F was tagged. Hot water was missing and was restored before inspection ended. Rust and peeling paint were also cited.

headline: Fail: over 100 rat droppings, eggs too warm
summary: Failed. About 100 or more rat droppings were found in first-floor storage and basement; pest control service is required. About 30 dozen raw eggs at 66.0F were discarded. Hot water at a prep sink was restored during inspection. No employee food handler training.

headline: Pass; greasy fryers and floors
summary: Passed. Fryers have grease on exterior and interior surfaces, and floors under them need cleaning. The two-door freezer interior needs cleaning, and the floor under the three-compartment sink and dish machine needs cleaning. One certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Pass; restrooms need covered trash cans
summary: Passed. Restrooms must be provided with covered receptacles, such as trash cans with lids.

headline: Pass; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Passed. Milk crates are used as shelving throughout prep and storage areas. They must be removed and replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor to allow cleaning.

headline: No certified manager during chicken prep
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager was present while chicken, pork, and beef were prepared and served. Food handler certificates could not be verified, and managers lacked allergen training proof. Wet wiping cloths and dirty floors were also noted.

headline: Food handler skipped hand washing before prep
summary: Passed with conditions. A food handler washed pots and a whisk, then peeled a cucumber without washing hands. A citation was issued and staff must wash hands after every possible contamination. Also debris on walk-in fan guards and no backflow device on ice machine.

headline: Pass; employee food stored with customer food
summary: Passed. Employee drinks and food were stored in the same refrigerator as customer food. Management must provide a separate, designated area for employee food.

headline: Pass; ice machine and vents need cleaning
summary: Passed. The interior of the ice machine must be cleaned and maintained. Floors around cooking equipment wheels need grease and debris removed, and dusty filters above cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Fail: no certified manager on duty
summary: Failed. No certified person in charge or manager was on duty while chicken, coleslaw, and fries were prepared and served. Food was stored on floors and containers were unlabeled. The outside dumpster has broken, missing lids, and allergen training is still missing.

headline: Pass; greasy equipment, vents need cleaning
summary: Passed re-inspection. Prep tables, refrigeration and freezer units, steam table, fryers, stove, and grill need cleaning to remove grease. Hood vents need cleaning. All food service managers must obtain required allergen training.

headline: Fail: unknown source of paletas, ice cream
summary: Failed. The source of paletas and hand-packed ice cream offered for sale is unknown. Documentation from an approved, licensed wholesaler is required. Paletas must be fully sealed and properly labeled. This is a priority violation.

headline: Pass with conditions; unapproved vacuum packager
summary: Passed with conditions. A vacuum packaging machine was used for meat and salsas without approval; it was tagged and must not be used until approved. Knives were rinsed in the mop sink and stored improperly. No employee health policy on site.

headline: Pass with conditions; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed with conditions. The manager on site lacked allergen training, a repeat violation. Food on the walk-in freezer floor must be raised 6 inches. Bulk containers are unlabeled, pop crates are used as shelving, and a freezer gasket is damaged.

headline: Prep cooler too warm; dead roaches found
summary: Passed with conditions. Prep cooler air was 55.2F; foods reached 56.4F to 63.1F and were discarded. The cooler is tagged and must not be used until repaired. Dead insects and roaches under and behind coolers must be removed.

headline: Fail: no hair restraints; greasy outdoor spill
summary: Failed. Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints. A handwashing sign is missing at a coffee bar sink. Grease spilled outside near the grease container was cited. Basement prep area floors and corners have debris and dust.

headline: Fail: no certified manager, many violations
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on duty while sandwiches and hot dogs were prepared. No food handler certificates, employee health policy, or vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit. Prep hand sink lacked soap and towels, corrected on site. Pest logbook missing.

headline: Pass; short sneeze guards, unlabeled bulk bins
summary: Passed. Sneeze guards at self-service stations are too short to protect open food. A fly trap above the main kitchen meat slicer must be relocated. Bulk salt and sugar are unlabeled, and cups are used as scoops.

headline: Fail: slime inside ice machine, dripping into ice
summary: Failed. Black slimy substance inside the ice machine was dripping into ice for customers. Management must turn off the machine, remove ice, and clean it. Repeat violations include an exit door opening and missing allergen training proof.

headline: Pass; food handler certificates missing
summary: Passed. Food handler training certificates were missing and must be provided.

headline: Pass; one employee lacks food handler training
summary: Passed re-inspection. One employee lacked food handler training. All food employees must complete training and keep records on site.

headline: Fail: over 60 mouse droppings in dining area
summary: Failed. Over 60 mouse droppings were found in the front dining area, rear storage, prep, and beverage areas. Dead insects and roaches were on a glue board. The manager must call an exterminator and clean all affected areas.

headline: Fail: live flies found in food prep area
summary: Failed. About 5 large and 10 small live flies were flying in the food prep area; pest control was recommended. The dumpster was overflowing. Hot water at the three-compartment sink reached only 100F; corrected on site to 110F.

headline: Pass; greasy hood vent filters
summary: Passed. Hood vent filters have grease buildup and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Pass; ice machine interior not cleaned
summary: Passed re-inspection. The inner lining of the ice machine was not cleaned and must be cleaned and sanitized. Ice buildup inside basement chest freezers must be defrosted. Clutter in basement dry storage should be removed to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: Fail: no dish machine temperature device
summary: Failed. The high-temperature dish machine lacked a device to check utensil temperature. Mold and mildew were inside front reach-in coolers. Single-service items were stored on prep-area floors, soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables, and the certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Fail: blocked hand sink; grease throughout
summary: Failed. The prep area hand sink was blocked with cleaning supplies and not draining; a citation was issued. Single-use items are not inverted, and a drainpipe under the three-compartment sink is leaking. Grease and debris are on equipment, floors, and ceiling vents.

headline: Pass; missing splashguard, employee items
summary: Passed. A washable splashguard must be installed between the front hand sink and prep table. Employee belongings were stored on shelves beside food in the rear prep area and need a designated storage spot.

headline: No certified manager; dish sink water backs up
summary: No valid original city certificate on site; no certified manager while meatballs and deli meat were prepared; citation issued. Water backs up from the second sink basin into the third at the three-compartment sink; repair needed.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; unlabeled bulk foods
summary: No handwashing signage at bar sink or server station sink; instructed to provide. Bulk flour, salt and sugar containers unlabeled. Ice scoop stored with handle in ice; instructed on proper storage. No covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

headline: About 35 live flying insects found
summary: About 35 live small flying insects on walls and ceiling of washrooms, food prep and dining areas. Additional pest control service required. Also grease on ovens and an uncorrected overflowing grease dumpster.

headline: Missing food handler training; broken cooler door
summary: No proof of food handler training for employees. Broken glass on a reach-in cooler door must be replaced. Also peeling shelf paper, large floor divots, dirty areas, uncorrected dumpster problems, and no allergen training for managers.

headline: Missing handwash sign; litter around dumpsters
summary: No handwashing sign at rear sink. Single-service cup lids not inverted; articles stored under handsink. No covered receptacle in employee washroom. Litter and debris around dumpsters in outside garbage area.

headline: Loose debris and dust on floors
summary: Loose debris, dirt and dust build-up on floors and corners throughout the facility. Instructed to detail clean and increase floor cleaning frequency; must be maintained at all times.

headline: Missing grout and broken floor tiles
summary: Missing floor grout and damaged, broken floor tiles in prep area. Instructed to repair them to create a smooth, easily cleanable surface and maintain it at all times.

headline: Dish machine rinse at 120°F; below safe level
summary: High-temperature dish machine final rinse reached only 120°F; required minimum is 180°F; priority violation. Manager must wash and sanitize utensils in three-compartment sink meanwhile. Dust on walls and ceiling tiles; no allergen certificates for managers.

headline: Paper towels too close to sink; backflow needed
summary: Paper towel dispenser above the three-compartment sink to be removed; handsinks for handwashing only. No backflow device on front ice machine. Cardboard shelf liner, greasy cooking equipment, and dirty floors under cooking equipment.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; cooler thermometer added
summary: No handwashing sign at sink by popcorn machine; manager provided one. Prep cooler lacked a thermometer; manager provided one during inspection. Slow-draining men's sink, greasy floors, and dusty exhaust filters need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager 8:30–9:30 AM
summary: No original certified manager from 8:30 to 9:30 AM while chicken and beef were prepared and served; citation issued. Beans and rice unlabeled; food on walk-in floor; three-compartment sink leaking, with wastewater collected by a bus pan.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm sanitizer; machine tagged
summary: Low-temperature dish machine sanitizing at 0 ppm chlorine; tagged and not to be used until at least 50 ppm; citation issued. Dirty wiping cloths; stained cutting boards; heavy grease in hood; no food handler proof; prior core violation uncorrected.

headline: No certified manager; no working refrigeration
summary: No person in charge with valid certificate, and no certified manager while food was prepared. No working cold-holding equipment; dishwasher final rinse below 180°F, technician repairing. No pest logbook or food handler certificates.

headline: Missing sneeze guard at front service area
summary: No permanent sneeze guard at front service area, where food is assembled in front of customers. Manager instructed to install one mounted to the front prep area.

headline: Utensils in standing water; restraint missing
summary: Brooms and dust pans stored too close to prep table and clean utensils. Food handler with long beard lacked a restraint. Utensils stored in standing room-temperature water; deli cups not air dried. Instructed to correct each item.

headline: Utensils on floor; no sink stoppers
summary: Single-service utensils stored on floor behind front counter; manager instructed to elevate and invert them. No stoppers for three-compartment sink; manager instructed to provide adequate stoppers and maintain them.

headline: Unlabeled salt and sugar; dirty floors
summary: Bulk salt and sugar containers have no labels; person in charge instructed to label all bulk containers. Loose debris, dirt and dust on floors and corners throughout; instructed to detail clean and increase floor cleaning.

headline: Debris in ice machine; dim cooler light
summary: Slight debris encrusted inside the ice machine; instructed to detail clean and service it. Interior of bar coolers needs detail cleaning. Broken unused freezer in kitchen must be removed. Dim walk-in cooler light; greasy hood filters.

headline: Construction debris must be removed
summary: Construction debris must be removed from floors and walls and kept clean. No other issues were listed in this re-inspection.

headline: Three burnt-out light bulbs over cook line
summary: Three burnt-out light bulbs in hoods over the cook line. Instructed to repair or replace them and maintain adequate lighting. No other issues noted.

headline: Pinkish substance on soda machine ice slot
summary: Slight brownish-pinkish substance on the soda machine ice slot in customer area; instructed to clean and sanitize. Minor dirt on rear dishwashing floors; clean under refrigeration units and dry storage shelves.

headline: Missing handwash signs; no hair restraints
summary: Missing handwashing signage in employee restrooms at front check-out area. Food handlers prepping food without hair restraints; person in charge instructed that all handlers must wear one. Grease spills at rear deli fryers to clean.

headline: Food debris inside coolers and freezers
summary: Food debris found on the bottom of reach-in coolers and freezers. Manager instructed to remove it and keep equipment clean. No other issues noted.

headline: Expired handler certificates; dirty ice bin
summary: Ice bin interior needs cleaning. Wet wiping cloths on prep surface; in-use utensils stored inside food containers; food containers without common-name labels; expired food handler certificates. Instructed to correct each item.

headline: Over 5 live house flies; no certified manager
summary: Over 5 live house flies around dishwashing area; elimination required; citation issued. No certified manager while hummus and chicken were prepared. No paper towels at handsinks, no metal stem thermometer, cardboard liner in walk-in cooler.

headline: Expired food handler training; leaking drains
summary: Bulk containers unlabeled; food uncovered in walk-in cooler and reach-in freezer; single-service utensils not inverted. Leaking drainpipes under handsinks in rear prep and washroom. Expired food handler training; no valid allergen training.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; debris near dumpsters
summary: No handwashing signs at exposed sinks on the main cook line and bar. Non-working chest freezer in basement must be repaired, replaced or removed. Small debris around dumpsters in rear alley.

headline: Mouse droppings and flies found; repeat issues
summary: About 40 mouse droppings near buckets, furnace and dry storage; about 25 live small and large flies on walls, boxes and throughout. Pest service recommended. Water leaking from walk-in compressor; no signed employee health policy.

headline: Grease and debris on equipment and coolers
summary: Grease and food debris found inside the deep fryer oil filtering unit and on interior and exterior surfaces of cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers and freezers. Manager instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Handsink at 86°F; dish machine wash too cool
summary: Handwashing sink in dish area measured 86°F, below 100°F; citation issued. High-temperature dish machine wash at 132°F; corrected on site by converting it to low-temperature with 50 ppm chlorine. Mold-like buildup in ice machines; no splash guards.

headline: Small door gap; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Small opening at bottom of front entrance door needs a tight seal. Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced with shelving six inches off the floor. Missing handwashing signs, no air thermometer in lettuce cooler, dusty cooler fans.

headline: Rat droppings found; no certified manager
summary: About 30 rat droppings in cluttered basement storage under the staircase; detail cleaning and pest control recommended; citation issued. No certified manager while burgers and gyros prepared. Leaking drain pipe; wastewater backing up.

headline: Fly strips in prep area; food on floor
summary: Fly strips hanging in prep area; manager instructed to remove them. Food stored on floor in prep area; food spills and debris throughout. Peeling paint and wall openings; soiled mop heads stored on the floor.

headline: Rodent droppings and roach found on site
summary: About 30 rodent droppings on a toilet room shelf, one small cockroach under a handsink, and about two large flies in customer and prep areas. Pest control recommended. Dumpster area unmaintained; a new hire lacks a food handler card.

headline: Cooling units need cleaning; sink pipe leaks
summary: Heavy cooling units in first-floor prep need food residue removed. Basement handsink leaks from pipe under basin onto prep floor; repair required. Hood grease and dust in prep areas. Only one of four certified managers has allergen training.

headline: Certified manager now on site; corrected
summary: Earlier lack of a certified manager was corrected: manager with City of Chicago certificate was on site during re-inspection.

headline: Walk-in gasket and basement clutter
summary: Walk-in cooler door gasket in disrepair; person in charge instructed to repair it. Clutter and debris in basement, to be organized to prevent pest harborage. Restroom lacks working mechanical ventilation. No pests observed.

headline: Foil shelf liners; greasy hood; allergen gap
summary: Foil lining shelves near the three-compartment sink and walk-in cooler must be removed. Broken self-closing device on kitchen toilet door. Clutter and out-of-date items near sink. Grease on hood and filters. New manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No hot water; no hand towels at prep sink
summary: No hot water throughout the premises while food was being prepared. Prep handsink water at 60°F and dish sink at 55.8°F; citation issued. No hand drying towels at front prep sink. Missing thermometers and food handler certificates.

headline: Dishwasher lacks training; repeat allergen issue
summary: Dishwasher had no food handler training; all employees must complete it and keep records on site. Repeat core violation from June 2023: sanitation manager still lacks allergen training; citation issued.

headline: No vomit kit; no food handler certificates
summary: No kit or procedure for vomit and diarrhea events on site; citation issued. Food stored on floors; soiled wiping cloths; cardboard and foil shelf liners; torn cooler gasket; heavy grease and food splatter on walls and floors. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Black mold dripping from ice machine
summary: Black mold-like substance on the interior panel of the ice machine was dripping onto ice used for consumption. Instructed to dump the ice, clean, sanitize and maintain. Citation issued.

headline: Cream cheese held too warm; discarded
summary: Cooler air measured 48°F with cream cheese inside; manager told to hold cold foods at 41°F or below. About 1/4 pound discarded and cooler tagged. Equipment wrapped in foil; manager told to remove it.

headline: Gaps in rear screen door; rust and leaks
summary: Rear screen door has a 1/2-inch gap at the bottom and openings at top and sides; tight seal required. Splash guards missing; rusty prep table shelf; inoperable employee toilet; water-damaged ceiling tiles; no food handler proof.

headline: No valid city certificate while handling TCS foods
summary: Person in charge lacked proof of food safety training; showed a photo of certificate. No valid original city certificate on site while food handlers prepared TCS foods; citation issued. No employee has proof of allergen training.

headline: No covered receptacle; door not self-closing
summary: Washroom lacks a covered waste receptacle; management instructed to provide one. Washroom door lacks a self-closing device; management instructed to install one. No other issues noted.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup kit
summary: No verifiable employee health policy and no vomit or diarrhea procedure or kit on site; template left; no citation issued. Missing handwashing signs, uncovered trash in employee toilet room, missing ceiling panels in prep areas, and dusty vent.

headline: Rear door gaps; reach-in cooler spills
summary: Rear exit doors have 1/4-inch gaps at bottom; repair needed to prevent pest entry. Reach-in cooler interior has spills and debris on shelves and walls. Employee washroom door is not self-closing.

headline: Pink buildup in ice machine; food stored on floor
summary: Excessive pink substance inside ice machine panel dripping onto ice; citation issued. Food stored on floors in cooler and freezer; wiping cloths improperly stored; three-compartment sink leaking heavily. No food handler training certificate posted.

headline: Missing vomit kit; washroom and light shield issues
summary: Items needed for vomit and diarrhea cleanup were not on premises; priority violation. Employee washroom door not self-closing. Outdoor dumpster sits on dirt and rocks. Missing light shields and no mop drying rack.

headline: Meat slicer blade back side dirty
summary: Back side of the meat slicer blade had food debris. Instructed to clean and maintain. No other issues noted.

headline: Handwashing sink too cold; corrected on site
summary: Five faucets at women's washroom sink measured 47.5°F, below the required 100°F. Corrected on site to 100.6°F before inspection ended; citation issued. Large particles in floor drain under the three-compartment sink to be cleaned.

headline: Slight buildup inside ice machine
summary: Slight build-up inside the upper portion of the ice machine. Manager instructed to clean the interior and maintain it. No other issues noted.

headline: Hot steak and pork below safe temperature
summary: Cooked steak at 114.5°F and pork at 120.9°F in hot holding unit, below the required 135°F. Manager discarded about 20 lbs ($250). Open energy drinks stored with meat; cutting boards scratched; ceiling panels missing.

headline: Unlabeled bulk container; excess clutter
summary: Bulk container unlabeled in prep area; manager instructed to label with the common name of the food. Excessive clutter in prep and storage areas; manager instructed to remove unused articles and organize.

headline: Handsink water above 120°F; cardboard shelf liner
summary: Dishwashing handsink above 120°F because the cold-water knob is stripped; repair required; citation issued. Cardboard reused as shelf liner; grease on floor around cooking equipment; basement clutter; unlabeled spices and oils.

headline: Walk-in freezer gasket broken; ice buildup
summary: Dry food containers at rear storage need common-name labels. Excess ice around walk-in freezer door; broken gasket inside must be repaired or replaced. Milk crates used for elevation; grease inside cooking equipment; dishmachine leaks.

headline: Over 30 small flying insects found
