summary: Over 30 small black flying insects in coffee prep and dish area; facility must eliminate them; citation issued. No food handler certification on site. Prior core violation not corrected: no grease trap connected to the three-compartment sink.

headline: Flies found; food held too warm; no manager
summary: About 50 small and 25 large live flies in prep, dish, storage and walk-in areas; pest service recommended. Walk-in cooler at 64.4°F; raw shrimp, cole slaw and tartar sauce discarded (about 24 lbs). No certified manager on duty.

headline: Thermometer needed in shared walk-in cooler
summary: Thermometer to be provided inside the common walk-in cooler. Food boxes stored on floor in common walk-in freezer. Leaves and debris under dumpster; loose women's faucet handle; missing floor baseboard; storage rooms need organizing.

headline: Walk-in cooler at 59°F; leaks; open dumpsters
summary: Walk-in cooler at 59°F with no TCS food inside; tagged and not to be used until repaired. Gap at rear exit door, sticky fly trap rolls above prep area, water leaks at drain pipes, and open dumpster lids with litter.

headline: About 40 live small flies found
summary: About 40 live small flies on ceiling and walls of front prep and rear utility mop sink areas; additional pest control needed; citation issued. A 1/2-inch opening at the revolving door must be sealed. Wiping cloths on prep tables.

headline: Corrected on site; floors and vents cleaned
summary: Hole in basement wall behind a storage shelf to be sealed. Grease on fryer bottom and cooking equipment wheels; dusty dish area ceiling vents; floors under cooking equipment and basement corners. Several items corrected on site.

headline: Overflowing dumpster; corrected before close
summary: Outside dumpster had overflowing garbage and lids wide open; citation issued. Manager compacted garbage and closed the lids before the end of inspection.

headline: Frozen food thawed at room temperature
summary: Frozen TCS food observed thawing at room temperature; instructed to thaw under cold running water not exceeding 70°F. Accumulated food and grease under grill and in fryers; dirt under equipment; unused equipment to be cleaned or removed.

headline: Rear door needs rodent proofing
summary: Rear door needs rodent proofing; weatherstrip to be replaced. Interior of reach-in cooler and hot holding unit dirty with food spills. Leak at three-compartment sink faucet; floors need detail cleaning of sticky substances.

headline: No valid PIC certificate; food too warm and discarded
summary: Person in charge lacked a valid certificate; priority violation. Hot foods held at 52–63°F and cooked rice at 45.3°F, eggs at 56.1°F; all discarded. Prep sink blocked by garbage can. Undated prepared foods; dirty equipment; water-damaged ceiling tiles.

headline: Pepsi cooler at 50.2°F; food discarded, tagged
summary: Rear upright cooler at 50.2°F; person in charge discarded TCS food and tagged the cooler. Re-inspection needed after repair. Missing thermometers in prep and sauce coolers; knives stored between equipment; greasy knife rack.

headline: No covered receptacle in women's restroom
summary: No covered receptacle for sanitary napkins in the women's toilet room. Instructed to provide a covered waste receptacle. No other issues noted in this inspection.

headline: Mineral buildup in ice machine; pipe leak
summary: Mineral buildup inside the ice machine; manager instructed to clean and maintain. Copper pipe above the three-compartment sink is leaking; manager instructed to repair it.

headline: Dirty cabinets and coolers; expired handler cards
summary: Clean inside storage cabinets behind self-serve stations, coffee shop ice machine interior, walk-in cooler walls and floors, and prep station floors. A few food handler certificates had expired and must be renewed.

headline: Hot food below 135°F; about 60 lbs discarded
summary: No certified manager while TCS foods prepared; citation issued. Hot holding unit held chicken, fish, pork and beef at 109.5–121.6°F; about 60 lbs ($300) discarded; unit tagged. Walk-in items lacked date labels; raw meat thawed in cold sink water.

headline: Gaps at doors; hair restraints; dirty racks
summary: Gap along bottom of garbage and garage doors must be made tight-fitting. Several food handlers lacked hair restraints. Heavily soiled dish racks; stained ceiling tiles; burnt-out hood light; no food handler or allergen training.

headline: Rust on ice machine; soiled linens near food
summary: Basement ice machine has rust; both ice machines need cleaning. Soiled linens overflowing next to ready-to-eat food. Cups used as scoops; dishwasher and slicer dirty; pallets and rolled rugs in basement need removal.

headline: Mouse droppings infestation; no certified manager
summary: Infestation of about 300 or more mouse droppings in storage, basement, toilet and prep areas. Food handlers touched food without washing hands; sanitizer read 0.0 ppm. No certified manager posted; no test kit or food handler training.

headline: No handwashing signs; putty around drains
summary: No handwashing signs at front and rear prep sinks; manager instructed to post them. Plumber's putty around drains inside the three-compartment sink must be removed. No allergen awareness training available for certified managers.

headline: Unused cooling unit in storage area
summary: Unused compact cooling unit stored in rear storage area. Instructed to remove unnecessary items and organize the storage area. No other issues noted.

headline: About 20 small flies; no pest logbook
summary: About 20 small flies in bar area near sinks; elimination and pest service recommended. No pest control logbook kept on premises. Also missing raw-food menu advisory, splash guards, backflow device, covered receptacles, and food handler training.

headline: Ceramic ware lacks lead documentation; tagged
summary: Ceramic and stone plates, mugs and bowls used for food lack lead-free documentation; removed and tagged; priority violation. Backflow device leaking in utility sink; ice machine and espresso backflow devices not located. Unsealed drains and clutter.

headline: No certified manager while soup prepared
summary: No certified food manager present while soup at 165°F was prepared and served; citation issued. Pest control logbook not maintained and lacked pest inspection reports. Deep fryer and bread cooler need cleaning; greasy hood and filters.

headline: Ice machine debris; worn caulk above sink
summary: Debris encrusted inside the ice machine; instructed to detail clean and have it serviced. Worn, loose caulk above the dishwashing three-compartment sink must be replaced.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; no pest logbook
summary: Rear exit door not fully rodent-proof; 1/4-inch gap at bottom must be sealed. No pest control logbook available on site. Washroom door not self-closing; no covered receptacles in toilet rooms; no waste disposal contract records.

headline: No certified manager; bare-hand food contact
summary: No certified manager until 9:30 AM while TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. Employee touched ready-to-eat food with bare hands; discarded. Staff ate and chewed gum on the line; a handler handled food after touching a hat without handwashing.

headline: Food stored on floor; no test strips until fixed
summary: Packaged food and drinks stored on dry closet floor; wet wiping cloths stored without sanitizer. No sanitizer test strips on site, but person in charge provided them; corrected on site. Chef's knife with missing tip; mop heads drying against walls.

headline: No hand cleanser; leaking sink pipe
summary: No hand cleanser at handsinks; priority violation, no citation issued. Physical barrier required between food prep and customer seating. Leaking pipe under three-compartment sink, broken floor tile, dirty walk-in cooler vent, and allergen training needed for managers.

headline: Unlabeled dry storage containers; slow sink drain
summary: Food in dry storage containers lacked name labels; manager instructed to label them. Washroom hand sink drains slowly; manager instructed to repair and maintain. No pests noted.

headline: Unlabeled food; expired certificates; leaks
summary: Food stored unlabeled in coolers and dry storage. Food containers on the warewashing floor; must be elevated six inches. 1/4-inch gap at rear exit door needs sealing. Expired food handler and allergen certificates; leaking faucets.

headline: Cooksline fridge too warm; smoking inside
summary: Cooksline refrigerator held catfish at 48.9°F and other items at 44–45°F; about 15 lbs ($150) discarded; citation issued. Smoking evidence in men's washroom; citation issued. Wiping cloths left on prep tables; hole in women's stall wall.

headline: No hot-holding thermometers; overhead door gap
summary: No operable thermometer inside hot holding units; manager to provide them. 1/2-inch gap at bottom left of rear overhead door; manager to seal. Soiled wiping cloths stored on prep tables; store in sanitizing solution.

headline: Slow-draining toilets; uncovered receptacle
summary: Women's restroom toilets drain slowly during inspection; instructed to repair. Uncovered receptacle in unisex employee restroom; instructed to provide a covered one. Handwashing signage needed at all hand sinks.

headline: Food buildup on cutting board and prep walls
summary: Cutting board needs cleaning or replacing to remove food buildup. Sides of prep tables and rear prep area walls have food splatters. Manager instructed to clean and maintain. No pests noted.

headline: About 20 live flies in rear prep area
summary: About 20 live small flies on walls of the rear prep area; must be removed by reinspection; pest control advised. Food and grease buildup on the floor around fryer and cooking equipment. A ceiling light cover is missing above the dish area.

headline: No certified manager; eggs at room temperature
summary: No certified food manager on site while open; citation issued. About 270 eggs at 69.6–71.6°F discarded. Undated cooked chicken and hot dogs; about 26 lbs discarded. Unlabeled seasonings and a slow handwashing sink drain.

headline: No sanitation manager while TCS foods handled
summary: No city sanitation manager on premises while chicken, eggs and other TCS foods were handled; citation issued. Person in charge lacks manager certificate and allergen training. Floors behind and under heavy equipment not clean.

headline: Plates stored facing up
summary: Clean plates and bowls stored facing up in the kitchen. Instructed to store them inverted to prevent contamination. No other issues noted.

headline: Over 30 mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: Over 30 mouse droppings at base of shelving in rear storage; citation issued. No certified manager with valid certificate during TCS food preparation. Hot water at 129.5°F and 130.9°F; no soap or towels at dish sink; cracked floor tiles.

headline: Cleaning needed for ice machine and equipment
summary: Ice machine interior, cooking and refrigeration exteriors, fryer bottoms and walk-in shelves need cleaning. Washroom fixtures need detail cleaning. Floors under equipment need cleaning. Managers must obtain allergen training.

headline: Hair restraints missing; cooler door broken
summary: Two food servers lacked hair restraints. Wiping cloths stored on the stove; instructed to keep them in sanitizer. Cooler door is shattered and covered with taped cardboard; repair required. Greasy hood filters and missing light shields noted.

headline: Hair restraints needed; drink nozzles dirty
summary: All food handlers must wear hair restraints. Large can opener blade, drink dispenser nozzles and bar pop guns need detail cleaning. Floors need cleaning to remove food and drink spills.

headline: No person in charge or certified manager on site
summary: No person in charge on site at inspection; arrived about 9:40 AM. No certified food manager while chicken and tamales were prepared and served. No sanitizer test kit and no food handler training on site.

headline: Dead insects in light shields; no allergen certificate
summary: Light shields above the rear storage area have dead insects and need cleaning. Missing handwashing signs, mold-like buildup in a soda gun holder, and no approved allergen training certificate on site. Passed.

headline: Bar sink blocked; warewasher temperature too low
summary: Bar handsink is blocked by glasses and straws, with food debris inside; no soap or towels noted. Warewashing machine gauge read 88F for final rinse, below requirement; citation issued. Bowl with no handle used to scoop food.

headline: No thermometers in coolers; missing signs
summary: No thermometers inside walk-in and prep coolers; must be provided. Handwashing signs missing at bar and lounge sinks. Automatic paper towel dispenser batteries not working. Cutting boards have deep grooves and stains. Allergen training certificates not on site.

headline: No certified manager; rodent droppings and flies
summary: No certified food manager (CFM) on site during food prep. About 500 lbs of TCS foods held at 52-65F were discarded. About 60 rodent droppings and about 30 live flies found. Handwashing sinks lacked soap and paper towels.

headline: Insect control devices over prep tables
summary: Electrical insect control devices are mounted on walls above food prep tables and must be relocated. Open shortening filter sheets stored on a toilet room floor. Splash guard needed at prep handsink. Handwashing sign missing in a restroom.

headline: 30+ mouse droppings; no hot water
summary: About 30 or more mouse droppings in the rear prep area, on shelves, and on canned goods; pest control recommended. No hot water on site; water measured 69-74F. Three food handlers lacked hair restraints. Citation issued.

headline: Opening in rear door; leaks and ice buildup
summary: An opening at the lower corner of the rear exit door must be sealed to keep pests out. Single-use items were stored under a sink, a cold holding unit had ice buildup, and faucets at two sinks leaked.

headline: Missing sign; cold water knob not working
summary: Basement employee restroom sink lacks a handwashing sign. No written cleaning procedure for paleta and ice cream makers. Cold water knob does not work at the basement food prep handsink. Passed with these items to correct.

headline: Rodent droppings; food thawed in standing water
summary: About 20 rodent droppings in the food prep utility closet and about 5 in a toilet room. TCS foods were thawing in standing water in the 3-compartment sink. Also: unlabeled grab-and-go desserts and only one manager with allergen training.

headline: Peeling paint; utility sink needs repair
summary: Basement utility sink needs repair. Chipped paint and breaking wall base in basement dry storage. Peeling paint on concrete floor in the basement dish and prep area must be repaired to be cleanable. Passed.

headline: Cold deli food above 41F; 40 lbs discarded
summary: TCS foods in a reach-in cooler measured 53.8-61.2F; about 40 lbs (about $500) discarded. Cooler at 58.8F was tagged. Rear storage shelving, sinks, and floors not clean. Citation issued; passed with conditions.

headline: No hair restraint; sink leak; debris under equipment
summary: An employee in the prep area had no hair restraint. A leak under the middle compartment of the 3-compartment sink must be fixed. Floor drains and floors under heavy equipment have food and dirt debris. Passed.

headline: Core violations repeated; fryers need cleaning
summary: Fryers, grill, and potato dicer need cleaning; floors under and around equipment must be cleaned. Repeat core violations: food handlers lack required training and food managers lack allergen training. Citation issued.

headline: Deli meat held at 49-55F; food discarded
summary: About 55 lbs of deli meat in a basement cooler was held at 49-55F; TCS foods were discarded (about $100). Outdoor garbage bags overflowing with lids open; citation issued. Certified food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Mouse droppings still found; pest service needed
summary: Rodent activity still observed on the first floor and in the basement, with 60-80 mouse droppings. Pest control service required before re-inspection. Also: equipment, shelves, floors, and wall and floor holes need cleaning and sealing.

headline: Two dogs in grocery area
summary: Two dogs were seen in the grocery area. Live animals are not allowed in retail food establishments. Citation issued. Also: a small amount of pink residue on the soda machine ice dispenser that must be cleaned.

headline: Front door gap; burned-out hood bulb
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the front entrance door sweeps must be sealed to keep pests out. A ventilation hood bulb is burned out. Food manager lacks allergen training. Backflow device at utility mop sink must be located by re-inspection.

headline: No thermometer in reach-in cooler
summary: A 3-door reach-in cooler in the main prep area has no internal air thermometer. At least one must be provided where TCS foods are held cold. Passed.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; floors damaged
summary: Handwashing signs missing at prep, dish, and bar sinks. Food and clean pots stored on the floor; wiping cloths on a prep table. Rust on prep tables; food debris on equipment. Toilet room lacks covered receptacle. Re-inspection; passed.

headline: Live flies found; pest service recommended
summary: About 14 or more live small flies on counters, ceiling, and flying around. Pest control service recommended; citation issued. Also: no food handler training, no public summary report posted, missing hair restraint, and cleaning and repair items.

headline: No vomit clean-up kit; restroom door issue
summary: No vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit on premises; one must be obtained. Restroom door lacks a self-closing device. All food handlers must obtain required food handler training.

headline: Rice cooker on floor; repeat rust and stains
summary: Rice cooker was stored on the floor while cooking in the rear pastry prep area. Missing sink stopper; grease and debris on cooking and cold holding units. Repeat violations: rust in walk-in cooler and water-stained ceiling tiles; citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled bins; splatter and flour on floors
summary: Unlabeled bins of sugar, salt, and flour were under a rear prep table. Cutting boards have deep scratches and stains. Employee toilet room is cluttered. Food splatter on a wall and accumulated flour on the rear prep floor. Passed.

headline: Frozen fries thawing on counter; cardboard shelving
summary: Multiple bags of frozen fries were thawing at room temperature on a prep table and must be thawed under refrigeration. Pots and pans were stored on the floor, cardboard lined shelves, and a 3-door cooler gasket is torn. Passed.

headline: Water not hot enough; dishwasher failed
summary: Hot water measured 68.8-72.8F at several handsinks; it must be at least 100F. High-temperature dishwasher did not reach 180F final rinse; a technician arrived to repair it. Also: no employee health policy and grease buildup.

headline: Restroom door not self-closing
summary: Kitchen toilet room door does not self-close; a self-closing device must be installed. Passed.

headline: Dead cockroaches; heavy grease buildup
summary: Several dead cockroaches on the basement floor require detail cleaning. Incomplete vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit and procedure. Heavy grease and food debris on equipment and walls; soiled wiping cloths; cardboard floor liner. Citation issued.

headline: Detail cleaning needed; cutting boards grooved
summary: Beer cooler and cooking equipment sides need detail cleaning. Second-floor cutting boards are deeply grooved and stained. Leak at 3-compartment sink faucet base. Handsign missing at a bar sink. Floors under equipment need cleaning to prevent pests.

headline: No light in walk-in cooler
summary: No light inside the walk-in cooler. An oven thermometer is stored in the cooler and freezer; a refrigerator thermometer must be provided. Outdoor garbage lid has a hole. Complaint re-inspection; passed.

headline: No certified manager; food on floor; rust
summary: No valid Chicago food sanitation manager on site while cooked beef was served. Raw beef stored above cooked pork and raw fish next to cooked vegetables. Food stored on floor; rust on ice machine. Dumpster lids missing; citation issued.

headline: Milk crates used as prep area shelving
summary: Milk crates are used as shelving in the prep area. They must be removed and replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Passed.

headline: Greasy hood vents; restroom needs cleaning
summary: Vents above cooking equipment have grease buildup. The toilet bowl needs cleaning, the restroom door lacks a self-closing device, and there is no covered trash receptacle. Items on the floor must be raised 6 inches.

headline: Mouse droppings; hands washed in wrong sinks
summary: Two food handlers washed hands in non-handwashing sinks; must use designated handsinks. About 50 mouse droppings found across the facility. Low-temperature dishwasher had 0 ppm sanitizer; solution was replaced and unit corrected on site.

headline: No test kit for quaternary sanitizer
summary: No quaternary ammonium test kit on premises to measure sanitizer strength in mg/L. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; unused cooler
summary: Torn gasket inside a two-door cooler near rear dishwashing must be repaired or replaced. An unused standing cooler in the rear prep area must be repaired or removed. Passed.

headline: Over 100 rat droppings; open rodent bait
summary: Over 100 rat droppings found throughout, plus a live roach by a meat slicer. Open rodent bait sat on the floor by the dishwashing area. Management must consult a pest control company. Repeat violation; also a torn gasket and grease buildup.

headline: Worn door sweeps; no self-closing doors
summary: Worn door sweeps on the rear exit doors must be replaced to avoid rodent entry. Fryer bottom and area under burners need cleaning. Washroom doors lack self-closing devices. Passed.

headline: No certified manager or certificate on site
summary: No valid sanitation certificate or certified manager on site while food was prepared or served. Also: unlabeled sugar container, no barrier between food prep and the public restroom hall, loose insulation in ice machine, and drain buildup.

headline: Water-stained ceiling tiles; allergen certificate missing
summary: Floors under and around heavy equipment have dirt and debris. Mop not stored to air-dry. Water-stained ceiling tiles in the front prep and dining area must be replaced. Certified food manager lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: Stock on floor; cutting boards need replacing
summary: Stock was on the floor in the back room and must be kept 6 inches up. Long hair must be secured. Discolored cutting boards, greasy equipment sides, and dirty floors under shelving noted. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: No certified manager; debris and leaking faucets
summary: No Chicago food sanitation manager on site while TCS food was prepared and served. Food debris and spills on equipment and coolers. Leaking faucets at utility, 3-compartment, and handsinks. Spills and debris on floors in prep, storage, and dish areas.

headline: No handwashing signs; no grease trap
summary: No handwashing signage at designated handsinks. The 3-compartment sink has no grease trap and one must be provided and maintained. Passed.

headline: Food stored on floor; shared kitchen license issue
summary: Food containers stored directly on the floor in the walk-in cooler and warewashing areas must be raised 6 inches. Floors under deep fryers heavily soiled. Space leased to another business without a required shared kitchen license.

headline: No certified manager; warm sausage; sink lacks water
summary: No city-certified food manager on site while chicken was prepared. Italian sausage at 57F sat in a dispenser with no time-limit procedure; 15 lbs discarded. Bar sink lacked soap; towels were corrected on site. Dish-area handsink had no running water.

headline: Remove stored items from rear patio
summary: Unused equipment, wooden pallets, and milk crates on the rear patio leading to the garbage area must be removed. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Pink residue in ice machine; buckets as trash
summary: Small pink residue inside the rear ice machine panel. Single-use bags were reused to store duck meat. Buckets without lids used as trash cans in the women's restroom. Grease and soiled floors in front prep and rear dish areas. Passed.

headline: Walls not cleanable; no mop sink backflow device
summary: Basement dry storage walls and ceiling are not smooth or easy to clean. Repeat core violation from a 2023 inspection: no backflow prevention device on the mop sink. Citation issued. Failed.

headline: Cold foods too warm; expired allergen certificate
summary: Eggs, cheese, beef, cut tomatoes, and other TCS foods were held at 47-59F in coolers. Two prep coolers ran at 48-50F. The certified food manager's allergen training certificate has expired. Citation issued.

headline: Hot food too cool; handsink fixed on site
summary: Potatoes in hot holding unit measured 117-120F, below 135F; 5 lbs discarded. Handsink water at 60F was corrected on site to 102-105F. Broken paper towel dispensers, no splash guard, and dusty floors under equipment.

headline: Cold foods too warm; customer dog inside
summary: Eggs, hamburgers, chicken, and other TCS foods were held at 44-51F in prep coolers, which ran 48-50F. A customer's pet dog was inside; only service animals are allowed. Citation issued. Also: wet cloths left on coolers.

headline: Grime in unused cold unit; leaking handsink
summary: Grime and food residue inside an unused cold hold unit must be cleaned. Leak at the bottom of the butcher-area handsink must be repaired. Passed.

headline: Moldy cakes; no certified manager on site
summary: No person in charge or certified food manager on site while food was served. Moldy packaged cakes in the display case were discarded. Also: missing food handler training, uncovered food, unlabeled cold food, and dirty floors with cigarette butts.

headline: Toilet room door not self-closing; allergen training
summary: Toilet room door nearest the dining area must have a self-closing device. No allergen training certificate on site for certified food managers; they must provide it. Passed with conditions.

headline: Cold foods too warm; about 100 lbs discarded
summary: Cheese, chicken, salsa, and lengua were held at 47.8-65.1F. About 100 lbs (about $500) discarded. The cooler under the grill was tagged and must not be used until it holds 41F or below.

headline: Broken restroom ventilation fan
summary: The men's restroom ventilation fan needs repair or replacement. Complaint re-inspection; passed.

headline: Plastic and mesh liners; rust; drain slime
summary: Plastic liner on the ice machine and mesh liners on prep shelving must be removed. Rust under prep tables; raw wood under the counter must be sealed. Ice machine drain line has black slime. No backflow device on coffee or ice machine. Passed.

headline: Pastries held too warm; discarded
summary: Ham, cheese, and spinach pastries in the front display case were held at 61.7-63.8F and discarded. Also: unlabeled bulk foods, tape used to repair a mixer stand, peeling plastic, and moldy caulking at a utility sink.

headline: Grease interceptor not located
summary: Unable to locate the grease interceptor for the 3-compartment sink. One must be located or installed and maintained. Passed.

headline: Restroom receptacle missing lid
summary: No covered receptacle in the washroom. Manager instructed to provide one. License re-inspection; passed.

headline: Restroom ceiling hole; doors lack self-closers
summary: Rear restroom doors have no self-closing devices. The restroom ceiling has a hole where a vent or light cover should be. The person in charge was instructed to fix both.

headline: Damaged walk-in door; allergen training missing
summary: Exterior walk-in cooler door is damaged and must be repaired. Dust on shelving and fan guard; ice buildup in walk-in freezer shelving. Repeat core violation: no allergen training for food managers; citation issued.

headline: No signed health policies; allergen training missing
summary: No signed employee health policies. Gap under rear door must be sealed. Worn gasket on rear cooler and no sink stoppers. Garbage can in restroom has no lid. No food allergen training for the food manager. Passed with conditions.

headline: Employee belongings stored with seasonings
summary: Employee shoes and clothes were stored on the same shelving as seasoning bulk containers and must be separated. Bulk containers in rear storage unlabeled. Fans in walk-in cooler need cleaning; items on floor near freezer. Re-inspection; passed.

headline: 100+ live flies; pest service recommended
summary: About 100 or more live small flies on walls, ceilings, ducts, and in several areas including food storage and toilet rooms. Pest control service recommended; citation issued. Also: a door gap, worn cutting board, and grease buildup.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; no chlorine kit
summary: Milk crates are used as shelving in prep and storage areas; they must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. No chlorine test kit available for sanitizer. Missing and damaged ceiling tiles in storage and utility sink areas.

headline: Unlabeled bulk sugar container
summary: A bulk sugar container was not labeled. The operator was instructed to label it and maintain labels. Passed.

headline: Bare hands on food; mouse droppings found
summary: Employees touched ready-to-eat food and bread off the grill with bare hands; citation issued. About 100 mouse droppings in rear storage and prep rooms, plus about 30 in an office. Pest control service recommended. Open drinks in prep area.

headline: Missing handwashing sign in employee restroom
summary: The only item noted was a missing handwashing sign at the employee restroom sink. The manager was instructed to provide one.

headline: Slow toilet leak; door not self-closing
summary: Slow leak around the base of a toilet must be repaired. Bathroom door lacks a self-closing device and one must be installed. Passed.

headline: Expired allergen training certificate
summary: A certified food manager's allergen training certificate has expired. All certified food managers must have current allergen training certificates. Passed.

headline: Excess food debris; loose faucet; no manager allergen certificate
summary: Refrigeration units in rear prep have excessive dried food debris; floor drains hold trash. Loose faucet neck at front handsink. Inadequate lighting in rear prep area. No allergen training certificates for certified food managers. Re-inspection; passed.

headline: Walk-in cooler at 50F; splash guard needed
summary: Walk-in cooler air temperature was 50F; all coolers must hold 41F or below. Priority violation; no citation. Handsink near ice storage has no splash guard. Failed.

headline: Basement door gap; sink needs drainboard
summary: Basement door threshold needs a tight seal to keep pests out. Three-compartment sink needs an attached drainboard or overhead rack. Peeling plastic on metal shelving must be removed.

headline: Bulk food containers unlabeled
summary: Bulk food containers had no labels. The manager was instructed to provide labels. Passed.

headline: Unlabeled rice container; broken restroom lock
summary: Rice container at the sushi prep area had no label and must be labeled with its common name. Staff restroom door lock is broken and must be repaired. Passed.

headline: No employee health policy; thermometers missing
summary: No written employee health policy on premises; a signed policy is required. Refrigeration units lack thermometers. Wet mops need a hanging system. Unused construction materials stored in the rear must be removed.

headline: Sink leaks; repeat allergen training violation
summary: Leaks at the 3-compartment sink faucet and underneath, with pipe covered in tape; must be properly repaired. Prior core violations not corrected: no allergen training certificates for certified food managers. Citations continue until compliance.

headline: No hair restraints; dusty exhaust hood
summary: Employees preparing food had no hair restraints. Serving plates were not inverted. Rear prep restroom door is not self-closing. Dirt and grease in exhaust hood, filters, and pipes; dusty ceiling vents in prep area. Passed.

headline: Handsink unusable; restrooms lack hot water
summary: Exposed food prep handsink was not accessible; plastic trays were stored inside it. Restrooms had no hot water above 100F. Also: broken floor tiles, ceiling openings, and a greasy vent hood. Failed re-inspection.

headline: Dirty cooler condenser
summary: The condenser of the prep area two-door cooler along the cookline is not clean and must be cleaned and maintained. Passed.

headline: Food debris in freezer; leaky faucets
summary: Freezer used to store nacho cheese and hot peppers had excessive dried food debris. Pressure cookers had debris on exterior surfaces. Leaky faucets at the 3-compartment and handsinks. Burned-out bulbs in rear storage. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: No vomit kit; low water pressure; no signage
summary: No vomit and diarrhea procedure or clean-up kit on premises. No proof of employee health policy. Handsink lacks signage and women's restroom sink has low pressure. Cold holding units need thermometers. Outdoor grease trap lid damaged.

headline: Weak water pressure at prep handsink
summary: Weak water pressure was found at the prep area handwashing sink. The operator was instructed to provide adequate pressure under city supply. This was the only item noted. Passed.

headline: No certified manager; raw eggs over cooked food
summary: No certified food manager or valid sanitation certificate on site. Raw eggs stored above cooked chicken; cooked foods lacked dates and were discarded. Pigeon droppings on rear kitchen threshold. No health policy or food handler training for employees.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; cardboard on floor
summary: No handwashing signs at prep and bar handsinks. Cardboard boxes and bulk containers stored on the floor in rear storage. Repeat core violation: no food allergen training certificates for food managers; citation issued.

headline: Expired manager certificate; open doors
summary: Person in charge had an expired copy of a city food sanitation manager certificate. Front entrance doors open without adequate mesh screens. Chef lacked a hair restraint. Menu asterisks marking raw or undercooked items must be removed. Citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; sink waste spills on floor
summary: No city-certified food manager on site while TCS foods were prepared. Waste water spilled from a floor drain when the 3-compartment sink drained; a plumber fixed it during the inspection. Also: soiled mop heads and no proof of allergen training.

headline: Fly strips and dead insects found
summary: Fly strips hang in the rear dish area, and dead insects are inside light shields there. Stained ceiling tiles, spills, and trash on floors. Missing handwashing signs and two sink stoppers. Clutter must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: No sanitizer or water on vehicle
summary: No cleaning agent or sanitizer for the 3-compartment sink; no hot or cold running water on vehicle; no lidded garbage receptacle. No pest control logbook and no vomit clean-up kit. Failed re-inspection.

headline: Bare hands on shredded carrots
summary: A food handler touched ready-to-eat shredded carrots with bare hands; citation issued. Food in coolers and dry storage lacks name labels. Cutting boards have stains and open seams. A torn gasket and a mop not positioned to dry were noted.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; rusted shelves
summary: Bulk containers in rear dry storage lack labels. A food handler in the prep area lacked a hair restraint. Chipped paint and rust on shelves under prep tables; stained cutting boards. Passed.

headline: Shellstock tags lack sale dates
summary: Multiple shellstock tags from early 2024 lack a date when the last shellstock was sold or served. Preset knives and forks on dining tables were exposed; they must be protected. Citation issued; passed with conditions.

headline: No certified manager during meat service
summary: No city-certified food manager (CFM) on site while ground beef and Italian beef were prepared and served. Also: no self-closing device on staff restroom door, a restroom door without a handle, and heavy dirt and dust under equipment.

headline: Eye wash station on handsink
summary: An eye washing station is attached to the rotisserie prep handsink and must be removed. Short form complaint; passed.

headline: No cold water at sink; no inspection summary posted
summary: No cold running water at the rear 3-compartment sink; citation issued. Food handlers lacked training certificates; one manager lacks allergen training. No inspection summary report posted. Ice scoop stored inside the ice machine. Failed.

headline: No certified manager; overflowing dumpster
summary: No person in charge or certified food manager on site while beef was prepared and served. Dumpster overflowing with loose lids. Food and drink stored on floor. Mop heads were stored on the floor; mops must hang to dry.

headline: Single-use bowl used as scoop; no backflow device
summary: A single-use bowl was used as a scoop for tortilla chips and must be replaced with a handled utensil. No backflow prevention device at the rear large ice machine; one must be installed. Passed.

headline: Handwashing in 3-compartment sink; no toilet tissue
summary: A food handler used the 3-compartment sink to wash hands; only handsinks may be used. Citation issued. Employee washroom had no toilet tissue. Food on crates in walk-in cooler; dripping water onto mop bucket from A/C. Passed with conditions.

headline: No food handler training; hair restraints missing
summary: No employee health policy. No food handler training for employees, and food handlers did not wear hair restraints. Certified manager lacks allergen training. Walk-in freezer has ice buildup and a door that does not close properly.

headline: Stained cutting boards; grease on equipment
summary: Stained cutting boards in front, rear, and bar prep areas. Grease buildup in deep fryers and on sides of hot equipment. Dirty floors with litter under the ice machine area. Hood filters need detail cleaning. Short form complaint; passed.

headline: Hot-holding units lack thermometers; standing water
summary: Re-inspection found two hot-holding units in the to-go area without thermometers. Items sat on a closet floor, wall and floor gaps need sealing, and standing water was found in the walk-in cooler.

headline: No hot water at handwash sink; dead insects
summary: A handwashing sink had no hot running water during the inspection. Dead insects, spiders, and webs were on windowsills. Carpeted flooring must be replaced with smooth, cleanable floors, and the facility has no service sink.

headline: Damaged cooler gaskets; no food handler proof
summary: Several cold-holding units have damaged gaskets and must be repaired. A splash guard is missing at the three-compartment sink. No food handler training or allergen awareness proof was shown, and both restrooms lack covered receptacles.

headline: No covered waste receptacle in employee restroom
summary: Complaint re-inspection found no covered waste receptacle in the unisex employee washroom. One must be provided and maintained.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; greasy fryers and hood
summary: Re-inspection found torn gaskets on three coolers, grease inside the deep fryer doors, and dust and grease on the back wall and hood. Management was instructed to replace the gaskets and clean the equipment.

headline: Clean floor drains to prevent pests
summary: Floor drains in the bar and rear dishwashing area must be cleaned to prevent pests from breeding there.

headline: Rust in walk-in freezer; no light shields
summary: Follow-up inspection after a suspected food poisoning report found rust on walk-in freezer walls. The meat walk-in cooler light fixture has no shield or shatterproof bulb. Both were ordered fixed.

headline: Food handlers lack training certificates
summary: Several food handlers did not have valid food handler certificates. The certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate. Management was told all employees and managers must show proof of training.

headline: Menu asterisk fixed on site; signs missing
summary: Corrected on site: the menu was updated with an asterisk and disclosure for undercooked animal-derived foods, and no citation was issued. Handwashing signs are missing, and splash guards are needed. Milk crates were used for elevation.

headline: Worker coughed then cut onions without washing
summary: A food handler coughed into his hands and went back to cutting onions without washing, and a citation was issued. Hands were washed during the inspection. Sanitizer was over the 200 ppm limit, and food was stored on the walk-in freezer floor.

headline: No backflow device; dumpster overflowing
summary: The utility sink has no backflow device and must have one installed. The outdoor dumpster is overloaded and can't close, which can attract pests. No citation was issued.

headline: Dirty ice bin; no thermometers in coolers
summary: The ice bin interior needs cleaning, and reach-in coolers in the prep area lack thermometers. Unused equipment in the rear prep closet must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Loose faucet; water-stained bathroom ceiling tile
summary: The faucet at the rear prep handwashing sink needs tightening. A bathroom ceiling tile with water stains must be replaced.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate; repeat violations
summary: No valid City of Chicago food sanitation certificate was provided, and a citation was issued. Core violations from a prior inspection were not corrected, including items stored on the floor. No current inspection summary report was posted.

headline: About 40 fruit flies; rice held too cool
summary: About 40 live fruit flies were found throughout prep and dining areas, and a citation was issued. Five pounds of rice held at 81.1°F was discarded. Handwashing signs are missing, and rust, residue, and peeling paint need repair.

headline: No certified manager on duty; rat droppings found
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while meat and poultry were prepared, and a citation was issued. A worker handled bread without washing hands. About 50 or more rat droppings were found in the basement.

headline: No certified manager; sink and dish problems
summary: No certified manager was on site while cooked rice, hummus, and chicken were held, and a citation was noted. The handwashing sink for one kitchen lacked soap. Dishes were not sanitized after rinsing, and sanitizer test strips were missing.

headline: Walk-in freezer iced over; broken cooler gaskets
summary: The rear walk-in freezer had heavy ice buildup, with ice covering the floor, and must be defrosted and cleaned. Two sliding doors on the meat cooler have broken gaskets. An unused two-door cooler should be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Grease and food buildup on equipment and floors
summary: Complaint inspection found food spill buildup on freezer shelves, grease on cooking and hot-holding equipment, and greasy floors and hood filters. A handwashing sink faucet leaks. Staff were told to clean and repair.

headline: Clutter in rear storage blocks cleaning
summary: Re-inspection found clutter in the rear storage room. Aisles must be widened so pallets and equipment can be cleaned and pests can be monitored.

headline: Person in charge lacks sanitation certificate
summary: The person in charge did not have a City sanitation certificate, and no valid certificate was posted, which led to a citation. Black slime dripped from the ice machine into ice, and a citation was issued. Grease, debris, and training gaps were also noted.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training; labels missing
summary: The certified manager lacked proof of allergen training. Packaged TCS foods such as sandwiches and salads lacked ingredient labels, a repeat violation from a prior inspection, and a citation was issued.

headline: Greasy cooking equipment and floors
summary: A knife was stuck between a wall and a conduit pipe and was removed. Freezer and cooler gaskets need cleaning or replacement. Cooking equipment, floors, and hood vents have grease and food buildup and must be detail cleaned.

headline: Gaps, crates, and worn floors need repair
summary: Re-inspection found a gap under the front door, crates used for food storage, and unlabeled squeeze bottles. Floor and wall tiles are missing or damaged, paint is chipping, and unused pallets and garbage bags are outside.

headline: Stained ceiling tiles; no stove ventilation
summary: Re-inspection found water-stained ceiling tiles and an unused old refrigerator. A stove in the rear prep area lacks mechanical ventilation, and the employee restroom has inadequate lighting.

headline: Damaged ceiling tiles; dirty hood and restroom
summary: Damaged and missing ceiling tiles are throughout the prep area and must be replaced. The hood and filters above the pizza oven need grease and dust removed. The restroom is dirty, and the manager lacks allergen training proof.

headline: Splash guard and debris needed
summary: A splash guard is needed between the handwashing sink and food shelf in the front prep area, with a smooth, cleanable surface. Debris behind cooking equipment must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Knife stored unsafely; dirty equipment
summary: A knife was stored between a reach-in cooler and a prep table and must be washed, sanitized, and stored properly. A large can opener and the interior of reach-in coolers need cleaning.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; no backflow device
summary: Complaint inspection found no handwashing signs at preparation-area sinks. A mop sink faucet has no backflow prevention device, and clutter in the front prep area must be removed.

headline: Caulking and ceiling tiles need repair
summary: The food prep handwashing sink needs recaulking, and water-stained ceiling tiles in the rear must be replaced. Floor corners and equipment areas need cleaning, and hood filters must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Washroom door closer broken; storage area dirty
summary: The washroom door's self-closing device is in poor repair, and washroom fixtures need detail cleaning. Storage area floors have spills and debris, and walls are dusty. All must be fixed and maintained.

headline: Beef and chicken held too warm; food discarded
summary: Beef at 74.5°F and chicken at 51.4°F were in a hot-holding unit, below the required 135°F. About 5 pounds was discarded, and a citation was issued. Frozen beef was thawed in the hot-holding unit. The person in charge lacks allergen training.

headline: Raw wood shelving; dusty storage area
summary: Raw wood used for shelving in storage must be sealed so it can be cleaned. Dust and debris under shelving on the sales floor must be cleaned.

headline: No employee health policy on site
summary: No employee health policy was on site, and staff were told to keep verified signed copies available. A bathroom ventilation unit does not work, and grease and dirt have built up in the exhaust hood and filters.

headline: No garbage contract or covered trash can
summary: No covered trash receptacle is in the unisex employee restroom. No dumpster or garbage contract was on site, which is a priority violation with no citation. An unused reach-in cooler at the rear measured 62.1°F.

headline: Chemicals dispensing into food prep sink
summary: Unmarked chemicals were stored above a food prep sink and dispensing into it. They were removed during the inspection, and a citation was issued. A chemical dispenser must be removed from the sink, and a service sink must be reinstalled.

headline: Ready-to-eat foods lacked date labels; rodent strip torn
summary: Ready-to-eat foods in the walk-in cooler were not date-marked, and a citation was issued. A rodent-proof strip at the rear door is torn. Food stored in grocery bags and a missing ceiling panel were also noted.

headline: Cooler door taped shut; leaking sink faucet
summary: Inspector found a display cooler door held together with duct tape and a three-compartment sink faucet leaking when run. The manager was told to repair both.

headline: Widespread rodent droppings and flies found
summary: Inspection found about 10 large and 30 small rodent droppings in the basement, and about 50 flies throughout the store. Meats were stored in trash bags, and a handwashing sink lacked hot water. A citation was issued.

headline: Hair restraints missing; ice machine debris
summary: Employees in the food prep area were not wearing hair restraints. Debris is encrusted inside the ice machine and must be removed. Stained cutting boards, dusty walls, and cluttered mop areas were also noted, and some handlers lack training proof.

headline: Hair restraints missing; oven charred inside
summary: An employee in the food prep area was not wearing a hair restraint. The top oven has charred grease inside. A handwashing sink did not turn on properly, floors and drains need cleaning, and the food manager lacks allergen training proof.

headline: No certified manager posted; food not labeled
summary: No certified food manager with a posted certificate was on site while chicken and sauces were being prepared, and a citation was issued. Cold TCS foods held over 24 hours were not labeled, and a citation was also issued. Cutting boards are stained and grooved.

headline: Cooler too warm; food discarded; mussels lacked tags
summary: The first-floor walk-in cooler measured 61.8°F and was tagged to stay out of use until repaired. About 70 pounds of TCS food was discarded. Mussels lacked shellstock tags, and ready-to-eat foods were not date-marked.

headline: Cooked rice held too long; no hand towels
summary: Several bags of cooked rice were held in a prep cooler for 12 days, beyond the 7-day limit, and a citation was noted. The employee restroom had no paper towels or hand-drying supplies.

headline: Dust on ceiling; panini presses need ventilation
summary: Re-inspection found accumulated dust on the ceiling in several areas that must be cleaned. Two panini presses are in use without mechanical ventilation and must be provided with it.

headline: Ready-to-eat foods not date-marked; gap in door
summary: Ready-to-eat TCS foods held over 24 hours were not date-marked, and a citation was issued. A rear door has a 1/4-inch gap, and an electric insect control device must be moved away from food prep. Storage racks had mold-like buildup and the cooler light is dim.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; jewelry worn
summary: Several TCS foods were held above 41°F, including pork at 49°F and cheese at 45-47°F, and a citation was issued. Three prep coolers measured 50°F. Workers were wearing bracelets and a watch while preparing pasta.

headline: Hair restraints lacking; three workers untrained
summary: At least two employees in food handling areas did not wear effective hair restraints. Three kitchen employees had no food handler training at the time of inspection. Management was told to ensure training within 30 days of hire.

headline: Jewelry worn while cooking; holes in ceiling
summary: A food handler wore dangling bracelets and necklaces while preparing food. Holes in the ceiling above the three-compartment sink and damaged ceiling panels in the prep area must be repaired. Basement storage was cluttered.

headline: Shrimp and octopus thawed at room temperature
summary: Frozen shrimp and octopus were thawed at room temperature on a prep table, which is not an approved method. Low hot-water pressure at a handwashing sink, a wet mop in the hallway, and missing allergen training were also noted.

headline: No vomit cleanup plan; no pest service records
summary: The license inspection found no written vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure, no pest control service records, and no mop sink. Refrigeration was not operating properly, and there is no covered outdoor waste receptacle.

headline: Over 50 mouse droppings in front counter
summary: Over 50 mouse droppings were found under electrical wiring in the front counter area. A citation was issued, and an exterminator was requested. Unlabeled containers, damaged gaskets, and ice buildup were also noted.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: Complaint inspection found the certified manager on site had no allergen training. The person in charge was told to get the training and keep the certificate on site at all times.

headline: Cold foods too warm; walk-in cooler too warm
summary: Many cold foods were held between 46 and 59.9°F, above the required 41°F. The walk-in cooler measured 47.8°F. Corrected on site: the manager discarded about 200 pounds of food ($400). A citation was issued.

headline: Dirty coolers, drains, and loose wall panel
summary: Lower reach-in coolers need detail cleaning, and grime is built up at a rear dishwashing drain. Walk-in floors under shelving are dirty, and cooking equipment sides have grease. Duckboards and a wall near the dish machine are loose.

headline: Rusty shelves; water too cool at bar sink
summary: Re-inspection found no left splash guard on the bar handwashing sink and rust on shelving in both walk-in coolers. Water at the bar three-compartment sink measured 100.3°F, which is below the required temperature, and a citation was issued.

headline: Cold water handles and foot pedal need repair
summary: Re-inspection found a cold water handle at the three-compartment sink and a cold water foot pedal at a handwashing sink that must be repaired. Floors and walls in shared kitchens need cleaning, and damaged ceiling tiles must be replaced.

headline: No certified manager; cold foods too warm
summary: No certified food manager was present while sausage was prepared and served, and a citation was issued. Cold foods were held too warm, marinara sauce was past its 7-day limit, and a sanitizer supply was missing. A dog was brought in and asked to leave.

headline: Missing signs, thermometers, and allergen certificate
summary: Complaint inspection found no handwashing signs in restrooms and no thermometer in prep coolers. Spoons sat in standing water, and some cooler gaskets and insulation were damaged. The manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Unlabeled containers and reused single-use tubs
summary: Dry storage containers lacked common-name labels. Equipment was stored on the floor and must be raised six inches. Single-use butter containers were being reused for food storage, which is prohibited.

headline: Mold-like buildup inside ice machine
summary: Pink and white mold-like buildup inside the ice machine was dripping onto ice used for drinks. The manager was told to clean it and discard all ice in the bin, and a citation was issued. Gaskets and vents also need repair and cleaning.

headline: Rusty shelving; cardboard stored near cooler
summary: Rusty surfaces under a food prep table in the rear dishwashing and prep area must be cleaned, sanitized, and resurfaced. Cardboard boxes were stored beside a two-door cold holding unit and must be removed.

headline: Duct-taped walk-in gasket; greasy fryers
summary: Re-inspection found a walk-in cooler door gasket repaired with duct tape and must be properly repaired. Fryer cabinets, the floor under the cook line, and hood filters have heavy grease and debris buildup.

headline: Black dirt in ice machine; ice discarded
summary: Black dirt built up inside the ice machine and dripped into ice. The manager was told to clean it, and all ice in the machine was voluntarily thrown out. Basement floor and ceiling tiles need repair.

headline: Rat droppings, live roaches, and flies found
summary: Inspection found about 40-50 rat droppings in the basement, 5-6 live roaches near dirty containers, and 10-15 live flies over standing water. Dirty wiping cloths had flies around them. A citation was issued for pest activity.

headline: No certified manager during taco preparation
summary: No certified food sanitation manager was on site when tacos were being made, and a citation was issued. Corrected on site: the certified manager arrived near the end of the inspection. The manager also lacked allergen training proof.

headline: No certified manager; ice machine slime not fixed
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while fish was handled, and a citation was issued. A prior citation for black slime dripping from the ice machine was not corrected. Gaps at the front door and moldy caulking were also noted.

headline: Over 100 rat droppings; handwashing sink blocked
summary: Re-inspection found over 100 rat droppings in prep, dishwashing, storage, and outdoor food storage areas, and a citation was issued. A handwashing sink was blocked by utensils, a front door has a 1-inch gap, and toilet paper was missing.

headline: Handwash water too hot; dirty floors
summary: Handwashing sinks in the women's and men's restrooms measured 145°F and 149°F, above the 120°F maximum, and a citation was issued. No food handler training proof was provided. A torn gasket, stained ceiling tiles, and greasy floors were also noted.

headline: Pest control devices above clean equipment
summary: Pest control devices were placed directly above clean equipment in the rear storage area and must be moved. Open glove boxes sat beside deep fryers, exposed to splashes. A drain plug in the three-compartment sink is in poor repair.

headline: Handwash water too cool; flies found
summary: Corrected on site: a handwashing sink measured 93.6°F and was adjusted to 106.5°F. About 30 small flies were found in the facility, and a citation was issued. Several leaks and openings in exterior doors also need repair.

headline: Food debris in coolers and on floors
summary: Food debris built up inside cooling units and on basement and prep area floors. Clutter in basement and rear storage areas must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Hood filters have dust and grease buildup.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; AC drain in sink
summary: Bulk dry food containers in the rear kitchen were not labeled with the food's common name. An air conditioner condensate line drains into a handwashing sink and must be rerouted to a floor drain.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; forks not inverted
summary: Bulk food containers in the prep area were not labeled with the food's common name. Single-use forks in the wait station were not inverted to protect them from contamination. The manager was told to fix both.

headline: Splash guard and sink stoppers needed
summary: Re-inspection found a splash guard is needed between the serving counter and clean utensils at the front handwashing sink. Missing stoppers for the three-compartment sink must be provided, and grease trap location must be confirmed.

headline: Dozens of live flies; gaps under doors
summary: About 35 or more live small flies and 8-10 large flies were found in prep, dishwashing, bar, and restroom areas, and a citation was issued. Door gaps, leaky toilets, broken floors, and expired allergen training were also noted.

headline: Unlabeled seasonings; ceiling buildup above cook line
summary: Bulk seeds and dry seasonings in the kitchen prep area lacked common-name labels. The basement mop sink faucet leaks and must be repaired. Heavy black residue and dust are on ceiling tiles above the cook line.

headline: Mold-like buildup in ice machine; flies found
summary: Mold-like buildup in the ice machine was dripping onto ice, and a citation was issued. About 40 live flies were found in bars, drains, and seating areas, and a citation was issued. The low-temperature dishwasher gauge is broken, and the person in charge lacks allergen training.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; worn cutting boards
summary: Large bulk food containers must be labeled with the name of the food. Worn, discolored cutting boards with cuts must be replaced, and a large can opener in the deli prep area needs detail cleaning.

headline: Wall and ceiling openings need sealing
summary: Two openings were found in the wall above the hot water tank and in the rear prep ceiling above the toilet room. Both must be enclosed to prevent pest entry.

headline: Dishmachine too cool; about 20 flies found
summary: The high-temperature dish machine reached only 148°F, below the required 160°F. About 20 live small flying insects were found in bar, prep, and dishwashing areas, and a citation was issued. The employee restroom door lacks a self-closing device.

headline: No handwashing sink in serving area
summary: No handwashing sink is in the front serving station, and a citation is needed for the cooling method for prepared TCS foods. Packaged cookies on display lack labels, and some equipment is too large for the three-compartment sink.

headline: No hot water at restroom sink; sewage leak
summary: A men's restroom handwashing sink had no hot water and was at 83.5°F, then restored to 104.2°F. Wastewater spilled onto a prep floor, and a sewage interceptor was opened during food service. A plumber fixed the leak and a citation was issued.

headline: Greasy fryers and dirty outdoor grease bin
summary: Re-inspection found deep fryer tops coated with grease and burnt food debris. The outdoor grease receptacle was dirty and could attract pests, and floor crumbs were noted near the lobby. A manager lacked allergen training.

headline: No certified manager while handling meat
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while sausage and beef were handled. Disposable cups were used as bulk food scoops, and a leaking drain pipe sits under the three-compartment sink.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; no thermometers
summary: Complaint inspection found no handwashing signs in several basement and main-floor restrooms. Reach-in display coolers lack ambient air thermometers. Staff were told to provide both.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; no mop sink
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure was on site, and a citation was issued. No mop sink is on site, and one must be installed. Chipping paint in the toilet room must be repainted.

headline: Dust buildup; some handlers lack training
summary: Dust has built up on ceiling tiles and vents above the dishwashing three-compartment sink and must be cleaned. Some food handlers lacked training certificates, and the food manager lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Wiping cloths stored unsafely; training proof missing
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on top of food prep tables instead of in sanitizer. No proof of food handler training was shown, and certified managers lacked allergen training certificates.

headline: Ice machine slime; flies and food held too warm
summary: Black slime was inside the ice machine, and a citation was issued. Tomatoes and potatoes were held above 41°F and were discarded. About 15-20 small flies were found in the basement prep area, and a citation was issued.

headline: No sanitation certificate posted; leaks noted
summary: No original City of Chicago sanitation certificate was posted, and a citation was issued. Core violations from a prior inspection were not corrected, including missing food handler and allergen training records. Leaks, dirty toilets, and poor lighting also noted.

headline: Hot water missing at restroom sink; cooler too warm
summary: The employee restroom handwashing sink had no hot water and was at 77.5°F. The two coolers were at 72.2°F, and duct tape was used on a refrigerator. The restroom door is not self-closing, and no waste contract record was found.

headline: Missing thermometers; cooks without hair restraints
summary: Working thermometers must be provided for all coolers. Cooks lacked proper hair restraints, and food was stored in open number 10 cans in the cooler. Cooler and freezer interiors and floors under equipment need cleaning.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; unused items stored
summary: No handwashing sign was posted at the basement prep handwashing sink. Unused equipment and unnecessary items in basement storage must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Food stored on floor; hose in thawing beef
summary: Re-inspection found food stored on the basement floor and a green hose submerged in thawing beef in the three-compartment sink. Workers lacked hair restraints, a cold unit lacked a thermometer, and outer storage containers were unclean.

headline: About 20 rat droppings; no sanitation certificate
summary: About 20 rat droppings were found in the rear prep area, and a citation was issued. No valid sanitation certificate was posted, and a handwashing sink lacked soap and towels at first. Core violations were not corrected, and no summary report was posted.

headline: Tape used on vent; gap; unused ice machines
summary: Tape was used as a repair on a bathroom ceiling vent. A 1/4-inch gap under rear shelving must be sealed. Two unused ice machines must be repaired or removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Hair restraints missing; ice scoops stored in bin
summary: Employees were not wearing hair restraints while food was served. Ice scoops were stored inside the ice bin. A leaking eyewash station faucet, floor debris, missing ceiling tiles, and dust were also noted.

headline: Ice machine black buildup; greasy cooking area
summary: A black substance built up in the kitchen ice machine and dripped onto ice, and a citation was issued. Walk-in cooler shelves and compressor also had black residue. Cutting boards are cut and stained, and a slow drain must be repaired.

headline: 47 lbs chicken held too warm
summary: Chicken in the deli prep area was at 51-54F, and 47 lbs was discarded worth $90; a citation was issued. Chicken was also thawing in the three-compartment sink. The sink leaks, and a women's restroom sink does not reach 92.5F. Floor debris was found in several areas.

headline: Live roaches found on prep area floor
summary: Two live roaches were on the prep area floor. The manager must remove all roach activity by re-inspection, and the inspector advised calling a pest control operator. Dead roaches were in a bait box on the floor. A ceiling tile above the prep area is missing.

headline: Greasy equipment, dusty hood, dirty floors
summary: Cooking equipment, reach-in cooler interiors, and floors had food spills and buildup. Hood vents had dust and grease. The can opener blade needs cleaning or replacing. Staff were told to clean and maintain all of these.

headline: Repeat violations; no backflow device
summary: A repeat violation from April 2025 was not corrected: no backflow device on the rear prep utility sink, and no allergen training certificates were on site. A citation was issued. The cashier-area sink drain also leaks, and no summary was posted for public view; a citation was issued.

headline: Milk crate shelving; damaged rear prep floor
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving throughout the prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor. The deep freezer needs cleaning. The rear prep floor is damaged and must be repaired.

headline: Hot water too hot; slime dripping into ice
summary: Handwashing sink water reached 123.6-124F, above the 120F limit; a citation was issued. Black slime was dripping from the ice machine into ice; a citation was issued. A repeat violation from February 2024 was not corrected, and no lights were in rear storage.

headline: No certified manager; dish machine lacked sanitizer
summary: No person in charge was present, and no certified manager was on site while chicken and eggs were handled; the manager arrived by the end. The low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer and was tagged out. Hand-washing signs and a vomit cleanup kit were also missing.

headline: Employee drinks in prep; cardboard liner
summary: Open employee drinks are not allowed in prep or dry storage areas; a designated area is required. Cardboard was used as a liner in the walk-in cooler and must be removed. A handwash sink in the cake prep area leaks and must be repaired.

headline: Dirty cold-holding units and rear prep area
summary: Cold-holding equipment and shelves under prep tables need cleaning. The rear prep and dishwashing area walls and floors also need cleaning. Staff were instructed to clean and maintain these areas.

headline: Raw-food asterisks on non-raw items
summary: Menu asterisks marked items that cannot be ordered raw or undercooked, such as octopus tacos and fried calamari. Staff were told to remove them. The fryer had grease debris inside, and the ice machine backflow device could not be located.

headline: Wiping cloths and allergen training lacking
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution when not in use; staff were told to correct this. The certified manager was missing allergen training and was told to get it and keep verification on site.

headline: Food handler certificates not verified
summary: Food handler certificates for all food employees could not be found or verified during the inspection. Staff must provide and keep them on site. No allergen training proof was found for city food managers.

headline: Duct-taped cooler gasket, dusty AC vents
summary: A two-door reach-in cooler had duct tape holding its gasket in place; staff were told to replace it. Raw wood wall bases in the service and storage areas need paint or stain. AC vents in the rear prep area had heavy dust buildup.

headline: Unlabeled containers, improper food storage
summary: Coffee station containers had no common-name labels. Food containers were on the floor in the walk-in freezer. A scoop was stored inside a baking soda container. Plastic bags were used for food storage, and the public washroom trash can had no cover. Allergen training proof was missing.

headline: No food thermometer; no allergen training proof
summary: No metal stem thermometer was on site to check internal food temperatures; this is a priority violation and a citation was issued. Also noted: no splashguard at the front prep sink, deep cuts on cutting boards, a leaking drain pipe, and no allergen training proof.

headline: Missing grease traps and washroom door
summary: Grease traps must be installed at both three-compartment sinks, and the men's washroom needs a door. A box freezer lid is broken with exposed insulation. Floors under the front bar are dirty. Stored items must be elevated, and an employee washroom has a water-damaged ceiling tile.

headline: Debris in coolers; no restroom trash cover
summary: Debris was found inside several coolers, including prep coolers and the walk-in freezer. Staff must clean the interior and exterior. The women's restroom had no covered receptacle.

headline: No health policy, cleanup procedure, certificates
summary: No employee health policy was on site, and no vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure was available; a citation was not issued. Bathroom doors were not self-closing. No food handler certificates were on site; new hires have a 30-day grace period.

headline: Storage clutter; washroom ventilation not working
summary: Staff were told to detail clean and organize the rear storage room and remove a broken chest freezer to avoid potential pest hiding places. Mechanical ventilation inside the washroom was not working and must be repaired.

headline: Missing hot-hold thermometers; debris scattered
summary: Hot-holding cabinets had no thermometers; the person in charge was told to provide and maintain them. Food debris was on the bottoms of prep tables. Debris, trash, and unused small wares were scattered under tables and along walls.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink faucet
summary: The three-compartment sink faucet in the first-floor prep area leaks at the base. The facility must repair it and keep it maintained.

headline: Cold-holding violations; no handwashing signs
summary: Fried chicken at 65.1F and raw chicken at 55.6F were in a cold-holding unit, which must be kept at 41F or below. A food handler was seen quickly putting TCS food into that unit. Also noted: missing handwashing signs, unlabeled containers, an uncovered ice bin, and greasy floors.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No one on site held a current City of Chicago certified food manager certificate. No original certificate was posted while chicken and shrimp were being cooked. This is a priority violation.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers, wiping cloth storage
summary: Bulk food containers must be labeled with their commodity name. Wiping cloths must be stored in clean sanitizing solution between uses. Staff were instructed to correct and maintain both.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food containers
summary: Bulk containers holding flour, beans, and other foods had no labels. The facility must label them.

headline: Service coolers too warm; food discarded
summary: Eggs, yogurt, chicken sandwiches, and quiche in service coolers were at 43.6-47.7F; 14 lbs was discarded worth $30, and a citation was issued. A prep-area service cooler at 45.7F must not be used until it maintains 41F or below. Coffee grounds were on the floor.

headline: Rice held at 105F; fish thawed in bucket
summary: A 20 lb pot of cooked rice was held at 105.4F on the counter and was discarded, worth about $200. Frozen fish was thawing in cold water in a bucket on the counter. Ice cream station lacks a handwash sink, a priority violation. A chipped wall needs repair.

headline: Slime inside ice machine dripping into ice
summary: Slime buildup inside the ice machine was dripping into ice used for consumption. All ice in the machine was voluntarily discarded. The manager must clean the interior before re-inspection.

headline: About 125 live flies; repeat violation uncorrected
summary: About 125 or more live small flies were found in the sales floor, front prep area, and storage. This repeats a September 2026 violation that was not corrected; a citation was issued and pest service was recommended. Other items: overflowing trash cans, grime, and missing food handler training.

headline: Missing barrier; floor drains need cleaning
summary: A barrier was missing alongside the rear drain board and handsink and must be installed to prevent contamination. Large baking equipment needs a written cleaning procedure. Floor drains under the dish machine and in the front prep area need cleaning.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer, ice buildup
summary: The front prep cooler had no thermometer, and staff were told to provide one. Ice buildup was also found on the prep cooler; staff were told to remove it and maintain the unit.

headline: No working refrigeration; no soap; no CFM
summary: No working refrigeration was on site, and no certified manager was present; both are priority violations. Some sinks lacked soap, paper towels, and signage. Other items: no thermometer, no test strips, no sanitation procedure or kit, heavy grime, and an employee smoking indoors.

headline: Large hole in faucet; peeling paint
summary: The three-compartment sink faucet had a large hole and must be repaired or replaced. Peeling paint was found on kitchen and bathroom walls and must be repaired to a smooth, cleanable surface.

headline: Carnitas held too cool; 15 lbs discarded
summary: Pork carnitas on the prep counter read 112.6-126.3F and was held below the 135F minimum. About 15 lbs, worth about $200, was discarded; a citation was issued. Other items: a missing consumer advisory, an oversized pot, a light shield, and missing certificates.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while deli meat, milk, and other TCS foods were handled and served. This is a priority violation. Staff were instructed to get a certified manager.

headline: Unsafe cooler temperatures; food discarded
summary: The two-door prep cooler held about 75 lbs of TCS foods at unsafe temperatures; all were discarded. The cooler reached 59.3F, was tagged, and must not be used until repaired. Black slime was found in the ice machine, and cooked foods were cooling improperly.

headline: No certified manager; repeat violations uncorrected
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared and served; a citation was issued. Hand-restraint, gasket, and freezer lid problems from a prior report were not corrected. Also noted: unlabeled bulk foods, items on floors, soiled mops, and missing food handler training.

headline: Rodent droppings, live flies and ants found
summary: Over 100 mouse and rat droppings were found in many areas, including dry storage, walk-in shelving, and a seating booth. Also found: 4-6 live large flies and about 25 live ants. A citation was issued. Other items: missing food handler training and low water pressure at handsinks.

headline: Live roaches and over 50 flies found
summary: Two live roaches were in the kitchen, and more than 50 small flies were found throughout the establishment. Staff were told to service all pest-affected areas. A citation was issued. Food debris was around kitchen equipment, and water pooled around the dish machine.

headline: Greasy grill, rusted ice machine drain pipe
summary: Non-food-contact parts of the kitchen grill, including rear pipes and utility connections, were soiled with grease and dust. The front bar ice machine's condensate drain pipe was rusted and hard to clean; staff were told to replace it.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; missing thermometers
summary: The rear door is not rodent-proof and needs a barrier to keep pests out. The walk-in and reach-in coolers have no thermometers. The rear utility sink needs a backflow prevention device.

headline: Some food handler certificates expired
summary: Some employees' food handler certificates were expired. Staff were instructed to provide current certificates for all employees.

headline: Leaking backflow valve at utility sink
summary: The backflow valve at the utility sink leaked when water ran. Staff were told to repair it. Light dust was also seen on a few ceiling vents, and staff were told to clean them.

headline: Unlabeled containers, torn gaskets, dust
summary: Bulk containers under the front service area had no labels. Torn gaskets were found inside refrigeration units in the prep area. The dish machine needs cleaning, and floors and drains need detail cleaning. Dust on the baking oven hood and a food handler without a certificate were also noted.

headline: Rust, damaged gasket, wall gaps, dark hood
summary: Heavily rusted shelves and prep tables must be cleaned or replaced. A cooler gasket was torn or missing. Unfinished wood panels, a hole in a wall, and gaps around restroom vents need repair. One hood light was not working.

headline: Food on floors; no hair restraints
summary: Food items were stored on the floor behind the counter and in prep and storage areas; staff were told to elevate them. Drinks were stored in a washroom and must be removed. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Sinks, shelves, and coolers had food spills.

headline: No certified manager; handwashing lapses
