summary: No certified manager was on site while TCS foods were served; a citation was issued. Some employees washed hands improperly and re-washed on site. Handwashing sinks were blocked and cleared during inspection. Also noted: paper towels, missing thermometers, no pest log, and a non-working vent.

headline: Unlabeled items; wiping cloths on surfaces
summary: Items in cold-holding units and the walk-in cooler lacked common-name labels. Wiping cloths were left on several prep surfaces and must be stored in sanitizing solution between uses.

headline: About 50 rat droppings found in basement
summary: About 50 rat droppings were found in the basement under stored tables. The person in charge removed them and cleaned the area during inspection. More pest control service is needed, and a citation was issued. The rear door has a 1/4 inch gap.

headline: Leaking faucets; nonworking washroom vents
summary: Several faucets leak, including the rear handwash sink and the three-compartment sink. A front handsink drains slowly. A large unused cold holding unit in a hallway must be removed. Ventilation in both washrooms is not working.

headline: Mouse droppings found in rear storage
summary: Inspector saw 25 mouse droppings scattered on the floor and shelving in the rear storage area. Staff were told to remove them and detail clean. Also needed: shelf and prep-area cleaning, floor cleaning, and replacing a damaged kitchen ceiling tile.

headline: Missing handwashing sign, thermometer
summary: Staff were told to post a handwashing sign at the front prep and bar handsink, and to provide a thermometer visible inside the kitchen prep cooler. The customer restroom trash receptacle must have a cover.

headline: No waste contract; debris and no allergen training
summary: No record of a waste disposal contract or commercial dumpster was found; a priority citation was issued. Debris was found on floors and along walls. Soiled mop heads, a dirty deli slicer, and missing hand-washing signs were also noted. Certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Cutting boards worn; drain and pipe issues
summary: Most kitchen cutting boards had dark stains and deep cuts and must be refinished or replaced. Milk crates must not be used for storage. Repairs needed: a broken condenser pipe wrap, a slow-draining bar sink, a missing ice machine backflow device, and broken grout.

headline: Heavily soiled floors and drains
summary: Floors and floor drains under front prep-area sinks and shelves were heavily soiled with dried food debris. Staff were told to clean the floors, drains, and related areas.

headline: No vacuum-packing records; food discarded
summary: No records were kept on site for vacuum packaging, as required by the approved variance. About 5 lbs of vacuum-packed miso salmon, worth about $20, was discarded; a citation was issued. A basement light was burned out, and no allergen training was on site.

headline: Missing handwashing sign at prep sink
summary: The kitchen prep sink had no handwashing sign. Staff were instructed to provide and maintain one.

headline: No certified manager; no hair restraints
summary: The person in charge lacked a certified food manager certificate, and no certified manager was on duty while TCS foods were prepared; a citation was issued. Employee health policies were not signed. Other items: hair restraints, leaking pipe, grease buildup, and a missing summary report (citation).

headline: Missing freezer thermometers; uncovered flour
summary: Four freezers lacked ambient air thermometers, and staff were instructed to provide them. Bulk flour containers for fish and chicken were uncovered and must have food-grade lids. Single-use to-go containers were stored improperly, and cardboard was on the prep floor.

headline: Live roaches and rat found in prep area
summary: Re-inspection found about 5 live roaches and 1 live rat in the rear prep and dishwashing area. This repeats a violation from July 2024 that was not corrected. Dead roaches were also found on floors. Pest control service was recommended; a citation was issued.

headline: Tin cans and grocery bags used for storage
summary: Tin cans and grocery bags were used for food storage. Staff were instructed to use proper utensils and containers.

headline: Dirty ice machine, greasy fryer compartment
summary: Re-inspection found the ice machine interior not clean; staff were told to remove ice, clean, and sanitize it. Excessive grease and food debris were found under the kitchen fryer. Heavy clutter was also noted in the west storage hall.

headline: Meat slicer dirty; missing signage
summary: The meat slicer was not cleaned behind the blade, and food debris was found; staff were told to clean and maintain it. Hand-washing signs were missing from employee restrooms. No allergen training certificates were on site for certified managers.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; hole in walls
summary: No handwashing sign was in the washroom; staff were instructed to post one. A hole was found behind the register microwave. On re-inspection, holes were also found at the base of the HVAC wall and the rear exit wall; staff were told to repair them.

headline: Ice machine buildup; dusty condensers
summary: Pink buildup was found in the upper ice machine and must be cleaned. Dust covered prep-area reach-in cooler condensers. The bar dump sink faucet leaks. Some certified managers lacked allergen training certificates.

headline: Unsafe hot and cold holding; no sink
summary: Rice was held at 119F and sausage at 130F; both were discarded. Cold foods were held at 46-55F and discarded. Two coolers ran at 52F and 56F and were tagged. No handwashing sink was in the coffee prep area; a citation was issued.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep
summary: Food handlers prepared milk and sandwiches with eggs, meat, and cheese without a certified manager on site; a citation was issued. The person in charge lacked food safety training proof. Boxes were on the basement floor, and the high-temperature dish machine leaked.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure
summary: No written procedure or adequate supplies were on site for responding to vomit and diarrhea events. Staff were instructed to provide these at all times. This is a priority violation.

headline: Unprotected ingredient; rusted shelving
summary: A working ingredient was left unprotected on a prep table and must be stored in a covered, labeled container. Rusted prep table shelving needs resurfacing. Basement storage had excess clutter. Two food handlers lacked certificates, and the certified manager needs allergen training.

headline: Torn prep cooler gasket; greasy equipment
summary: Re-inspection found a torn gasket inside a four-door prep cooler. Deep fryers, storage racks, prep tables, and a microwave need cleaning. Grease was on the outside of the grease container, walls, and hood filters. Most food handlers had expired certificates; no allergen training was on site.

headline: Shrimp held at 55F; 5 lbs discarded
summary: About 10 lbs of shrimp in a two-door cooler was at 55F, and 5 lbs was discarded worth $50; a citation was issued. The cooler gasket is in poor repair and a restroom sink leaks. Core violations from June 2025 were not corrected, including missing food handler training and allergen training.

headline: Dirty floors; allergen training missing
summary: Floors under the front prep steam tables need cleaning and must be kept clean and dry. Certified food managers on duty lacked allergen training certificates, and staff were instructed to obtain them.

headline: Missing handwashing sign at rear prep sink
summary: The exposed handwashing sink in the rear prep area had no handwashing sign. The person in charge was instructed to post signs at all handwashing sinks used by food employees.

headline: Water-damaged, peeling paint in basement
summary: Water-damaged ceilings with chipping paint were found in the basement prep area. Staff were told to resurface and repaint the chipped areas so walls are sealed, smooth, and cleanable.

headline: Pots too large for three-compartment sink
summary: Pots were too large to submerge in the three-compartment sink. Staff must remove them, use a larger sink, or write an alternative cleaning procedure for large equipment.

headline: Uncorrected violations; food stored on floor
summary: Violations from April 2026 were not corrected: unlabeled bulk containers, encrusted debris on containers and cold holding units, and dirty floors and walls. Cut potatoes were stored on the floor, bulk ingredients were uncovered, and handwashing signage and a cooler thermometer were missing.

headline: No paper towels; dog roaming facility
summary: No paper towels were at a prep-area hand sink, and a citation was issued; a food handler got one during inspection. A dog was roaming the facility. Staff were told to remove it, but it was not removed before the customer left. A citation was issued.

headline: Food debris, duct-taped freezer, milk crates
summary: Duct tape was used to repair a chest freezer, and milk crates were used for elevation; staff were told to stop to avoid pest hiding spots. Food debris was found on cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, and shelves. A torn cooler gasket and a non-self-closing washroom door were also noted.

headline: Door gap and hair restraint lapses
summary: Side door has about a 1/2 inch gap and must be made tight-fitting. Some food handlers lacked hair nets or caps, and a male handler had a beard without a guard. One handler lacked a food handler certificate. The utility basin needs adequate hot and cold water.

headline: Missing menu advisory, labels, backflow device
summary: No raw or undercooked food consumer advisory was on the menu; no citation was issued. Repackaged desserts need labels. The ice machine has no visible backflow device. Other items: unlabeled desserts, unsealed raw wood shelving, and a hole in a wall.

headline: Untrained staff; no public summary posted
summary: One employee lacked food handler training, and the manager on duty lacked allergen training. The inspection summary was not posted for public view; a new one was left and a citation issued. Staff were told to fix these and keep records on site.

headline: Pest log missing; overflowing dumpster, leaks
summary: No maintained pest control log was on site; this is a priority violation and a citation was issued. The dumpster was overflowing and the grease container lid was loose, also a citation. Other items: a leaking sink, a missing backflow device, dirty floors, and an employee without food handler training.

headline: No soda cooler thermometer; bulbs out
summary: The soda reach-in cooler by the front door had no thermometer; staff must provide a working one. Two ceiling light bulbs in the prep area were not working and must be replaced.

headline: Plastic bags for meat; rusted racks
summary: Plastic grocery bags were used to store frozen meat, and staff were instructed to use food-grade bags or containers. Walk-in cooler wire racks had heavy rust and must be repainted or replaced. Stove, oven, and light shields need cleaning. No valid food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Rear doors not rodent-proof; facility gaps
summary: Rear doors to the stairwell and alley have gaps over 1/4 inch and must be rodent-proofed. Several pieces of equipment and a utility sink lack backflow devices. Bathrooms need covered trash cans and self-closing doors. Missing baseboards and floor drain covers were also noted.

headline: Openings in doors; missing grout
summary: Openings at the base of the rear exit doors and in the front entrance doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Missing grout between floor tiles in the rear prep area must be replaced.

headline: No certified manager; sinks unstocked; dish machine 0 ppm
summary: No valid certificate was posted for the manager on duty; a citation was issued. Several handsinks had no paper towels, and one was blocked. The low-temperature dish machine had no sanitizer; it was tagged, then fixed on site to 100 ppm. Slime was dripping from the ice machine into ice.

headline: Over 40 mouse droppings found
summary: Over 40 mouse droppings were found on the floor, a pallet, and a bulk container in the rear storage area. The manager was told to call an exterminator and clean. A citation was issued. Other items: a damaged cooler gasket, oversized equipment, washroom fans not working, and no allergen training.

headline: Cooler too warm; food discarded; door gaps
summary: Chicken, cheese, veggie burgers, and beef were held at unsafe temperatures and discarded; a citation was issued. The cooler reached 55.4F and was repaired on site. The rear screen door has large gaps and torn mesh; it must be sealed. Certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: No licensed pest control or pest log
summary: No licensed pest control service and no pest log book were found; this is a priority violation. Also noted: no handwashing sign in men's restroom, unlabeled bulk containers, paper cups used as scoops, and missing food handler certificates.

headline: Black mold-like substance in ice machine
summary: A black mold-like substance inside the ice machine was dripping onto ice used for human consumption. Staff were told to discard the ice, clean and sanitize the machine, and maintain it. A citation was issued. Cooler exteriors in the rear prep area also had buildup.

headline: Inspection summary not posted for public
summary: The previous inspection summary was not displayed for public viewing. The manager was told to post it, and a citation was issued.

headline: Unlabeled containers, broken gaskets, leaks
summary: Dry food containers need common-name labels. A two-door reach-in cooler has a broken gasket. Plastic grocery bags and cardboard are not allowed as food containers in chest freezers. Grease is in the fryer, and the three-compartment sink faucet is leaking.

headline: Floors and drains need cleaning
summary: Staff were told to clean the floors by the fryers in the kitchen and the floor drains at sinks where needed.

headline: Missing ice machine backflow device
summary: The ice machine water line has no backflow prevention device, and one must be installed and visible. The first-floor prep handsink drains slowly and must be fixed. Floor tiles around the dishwashing area need regrouting.

headline: Hole in wall above utility sink
summary: A hole was found in the wall above the utility sink. The manager was instructed to patch it. This was a license re-inspection, and the facility passed.

headline: Dirty ice machine dripping into ice
summary: Black dirt buildup inside the right ice machine was dripping into ice used for drinks. The ice was voluntarily discarded. Staff must clean the machine before re-inspection. Dishmachine drain boards, leaking dishwash sink pipes, and walls by the mop sink also need attention.

headline: Missing hair restraint; dusty areas
summary: A food handler at the front counter was not wearing a hair restraint. Staff were told all food handlers must wear one. Dust was on a walk-in cooler fan cover, and floors under equipment and sinks need detail cleaning. Air vents need dusting.

headline: Employee phone on prep cooler
summary: An employee cellphone was on top of the prep cooler. Staff were instructed to keep personal items in a designated area away from food.

headline: Restroom receptacle needs cover
summary: The second-floor all-gender washroom had no covered receptacle for sanitary products. Staff were instructed to provide one.

headline: 150–200 mouse droppings; garage door gap
summary: Over 150 to 200 mouse droppings found in storage areas, shelves and employee bathrooms; citation issued. Garage door gap larger than 1/4 inch. Boxes and cans on floors, cardboard shelf liners, and two missing handles at the three-compartment sink.

headline: Buffet food unlabeled; wet mops on floor
summary: Buffet food items had no labels identifying their names. Wet mops stored on the floor in the dish room must be stored inverted.

headline: No food handler certificates on site
summary: No food handler certificates were on site. New employees have 30 days from hire to obtain proof of food handler training.

headline: No certified manager; cold foods too warm
summary: No city-certified manager on duty while TCS foods were prepared. Raw kimchi, cheeses and dressings held 46.9°F to 50.5°F; about 191 lb discarded. A 2-door prep cooler ran at 48.2°F and must be repaired. Dust buildup on condensers.

headline: No window screen; damaged rear door screen
summary: No screen at the front service window; rear exit door has a hole and its screen is separating from the frame. Steam table must be fixed to the table so it does not move in transit.

headline: Food handlers without hair restraints
summary: Food handlers were prepping food without hair restraints. Person in charge was instructed that all food handlers must wear one.

headline: Handsoap dispenser over dump sink; dirty floors
summary: Handsoap dispenser mounted over the dump sink in the front prep area must be removed. Cutting boards have deep scratches and stains and must be resurfaced or replaced. Accumulated dirt on prep-area floors needs detail cleaning.

headline: Door gaps; mold-like buildup; expired allergen cert
summary: Gaps about 1/4 inch at the bottoms of front and rear doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Bar cooler needs detail cleaning, walk-in storage racks show mold-like buildup, and the storage closet needs clearing. Certified manager's allergen certificate expired.

headline: Two live birds inside; no certified manager
summary: Two live birds found inside the restaurant; manager instructed to call pest control to remove them; citation issued. No certified food manager on premises while pork was prepared and served. Previous inspection summary was not posted for public view.

headline: Dirty ice machine and greasy kitchen surfaces
summary: Ice machine interior and dispenser top dirty; wiping cloths stored on a cutting board; greasy fryer areas and vent filters; missing handwash sign; no proof of allergen training for certified managers. Corrections ordered.

headline: No barrier between food prep and public area
summary: No barrier between food prep and an area open to the public; a door or gate must be installed (priority violation). Food debris in cold hold units, unused equipment in a restroom, and residue in a floor drain.

headline: Debris on floors; unused items to remove
summary: Debris on floors under all equipment, along walls and in corners in prep, storage and basement areas. Unused articles and equipment in an unused ice machine and coolers must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Expired fruit bowls and dumplings discarded
summary: Ready-to-eat fruit bowls and pork dumplings in a display cooler were past their 08/09/2025 expiration date; manager discarded them and citation issued. Food debris and spills in storage and warewashing areas. Burned-out bulb in a 3-door refrigerator.

headline: Overflowing dumpsters; earlier violation not fixed
summary: Dumpsters overflowing with trash, preventing lids from closing. Trash must be stored inside receptacles so insects and rodents cannot reach it. Earlier violation from 11/26/25 was not corrected on time; citation issued.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; 200 lb discarded
summary: Rear walk-in cooler could not hold 41°F; ambient air measured 49°F. About 200 lb of cold TCS foods at 45.5°F to 49.8°F discarded (about $2,000); citation issued. Also an expired allergen certificate and dirty restrooms. A fly strip was removed.

headline: About 75 live flies; standing wastewater bucket
summary: About 75 or more live small flies found in display case, prep, dish areas and near a bucket of standing wastewater under the front counter. Pest control recommended on or after 7/07/26; citation issued. Also no food handler training.

headline: No certified manager on site; mops near utensils
summary: No certified food service manager on site and no certificate posted; staff instructed to obtain one (priority violation). Brooms and mops were stored next to the clean utensil rack and must be moved away.

headline: Milk crates used; uncovered grease buckets
summary: Milk crates used for elevation. Food debris inside a cooler and cabinets. Uncovered buckets of old grease and meat casings in meat prep must be discarded daily. A leaking hot water tank damaged nearby wood floors. Slow-draining handsink.

headline: Cut melon held too warm; discarded
summary: Cut watermelon (55.2°F to 57.6°F) and cut cantaloupe (46.8°F) held above 41°F. About 35 lb discarded; citation issued. Corrected on site: missing temperature indicator delivered. Also milk crates used for elevation and damaged floor tiles.

headline: Food residue on shelves; low lighting
summary: Aluminum foil used on shelving must be removed. Food residue on shelving and inside coolers. Food debris on floors in bar, storage and kitchen areas. Items stored on the walk-in freezer floor. Low lighting in the walk-in cooler and burned-out bulbs in women's restroom.

headline: No certified manager at first; water bugs found
summary: No certified manager on premises at first; one arrived at 12:50 PM. Low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 10 ppm chlorine and was repaired on site to 100 ppm. Dead water bugs throughout the basement; openings at rear door. Expired allergen training; citation issued.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; unit tagged
summary: Low-temperature dish machine measured 0 ppm chlorine, so it was not sanitizing. Unit tagged and held and may not be used until inspected. Also interior ice machine buildup, two of eight dumpsters without lids, and an expired allergen certificate.

headline: Bar handwash sink misused; citation issued
summary: Bar handwash sink used as a dump sink with beverage waste; citation issued. Hand towels were missing there (provided during inspection). Also a leaking pipe, employee belongings in a prep sink, and no lids on restroom trash cans.

headline: Cooked beef and chicken left at unsafe temps
summary: About 12 lb cooked beef at 81.4°F and 10 lb grilled chicken at 80°F sat on a rear prep table. Person in charge discarded them. Cold food must be held at 41°F or below. Citation issued. Certified managers told to get allergen training.

headline: Restroom ventilation not working
summary: Mechanical ventilation was not working in the women's restroom. It must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Cooler at 69.2°F held; many safety items missing
summary: Prep cooler at 69.2°F tagged and held until rechecked. No certified manager on duty, no food handler training certificates, no employee health policy, and no hand soap or paper towels at sinks. Sanitizer test strips missing.

headline: No waste bins at handsinks; unused equipment
summary: Waste receptacles must be provided at handwash sinks. Unused equipment must be removed from the premises.

headline: One ceiling light bulb out above oven
summary: One ceiling light bulb above the oven in the prep area was not working. Manager must replace it with a working bulb.

headline: No service sink; no food handler training proof
summary: No food handler training or allergen training proof provided for staff. No service sink installed. Debris under the sink and cooking equipment, a wall gap near the handsink, and a gender washroom door that does not self-close.

headline: Slime in ice machines; no allergen certificates
summary: Black and pink slime found inside ice machines in the basement and first floor; ice removed and machines cleaned (citation). No handwash signs. Broken sensor at a second-floor sink. Heavy slime on the dish machine hood. Three ashtrays with cigarette butts on balcony (citation).

headline: No certificate posted; summary report missing
summary: No person with a city sanitation certificate posted on site; citation issued. No food handler training certificates on site. Previous inspection summary not posted for public view; citation issued.

headline: Hair restraints missing; leaky sink sprayer
summary: Several food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Leaky sprayer and faucet at the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Calcium buildup inside the ice machine. First restroom handsink faucet does not stay on long enough. Unused equipment and damaged floor tiles.

headline: Food debris and damaged wall bases
summary: Food debris along back walls of prep areas. Damaged wall bases and floorboards behind the three-compartment sink and by the ice machine must be repaired to prevent pest entry. Damaged ceiling tile in a basement office.

headline: Inadequate cooler shelving; unused equipment
summary: Inadequate shelving in walk-in and reach-in coolers. No waste receptacles at handwash sinks. Unused equipment outside and in basement storage must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Live roaches found; date-marking violations
summary: About 4 live roaches came from a wall hole under a dishwashing handsink; two dead roaches taped to handwash signage and another in caulking. Pulled pork and undated brisket discarded (about 6 lb); citation issued. Allergen proof missing.

headline: Broken dumpster lids; no food handler records
summary: Outside dumpster has broken lids; citation issued. Food containers stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and storage areas. Debris and dust buildup on floors throughout. No food handler certificates could be located for all handlers; repeat violation.

headline: 500+ rodent droppings; dead rats; open poison
summary: About 500 or more rat and mouse droppings throughout, nine dead rats on glue boards, and a rodent-chewed ramen package on display (discarded). Open rodent poison scattered on floors. No pest control logbook and no vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure.

headline: Unlabeled fruit cups; slot machines in prep area
summary: Fresh fruit cups in a display cooler were unlabeled and must be labeled. Slot machines in the rear food prep area must be removed. Uncovered toilet room trash, no self-closing toilet door, and no ventilation above the TurboChef oven.

headline: Cooler too warm; milk and ham discarded
summary: Pepsi cooler held milk at 56.8°F, ham at 57.8°F and other cold foods above 41°F. About 10 lb discarded; cooler tagged and held. Citation issued. Also no handwash sign, a slow-draining sink, and missing ceiling tiles above a walk-in cooler.

headline: Manager chewed gum in prep; ham too warm
summary: Manager chewing gum behind the food prep counter. Ham held at 48°F; 1/8 lb discarded and citation issued. Sanitizer dispenser at the three-compartment sink does not work, so the manager used packets. Previous leak at that sink was not repaired; citation issued.

headline: Missing handwash supplies, thermometer, test kit
summary: No paper towels or soap at handsinks in dish and meat prep areas; citation issued. No metal stem thermometer or chemical sanitizer test kit on site; citations issued. Cardboard boxes piled near dish area. Expired food handler training certificates.

headline: Dirty men's restroom; floors need cleaning
summary: Fixtures and floors in the men's restroom were dirty. Floors in the rear dry storage area, the dish area under the three-compartment sink, and a floor drain need cleaning.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink; hood filters dirty
summary: Three-compartment sink leaks from pipes and drain and must be fixed. No covered receptacle in the all-gender employee washroom. Buildup on the filters of both hoods above cooking equipment in the rear prep area.

headline: Over 60 mouse droppings; pest service required
summary: Over 60 mouse droppings found in prep, dishwashing and dry storage areas. Licensed pest control must service the facility on or after 11/13/2026. Citation issued. Also items on floors, cardboard shelf liners, and holes in walls.

headline: Employee drinks in prep area; bowls used as scoops
summary: Employee drank from an uncovered beverage in food prep. Bowls used as scoops in food containers. A 2-compartment sink was used for warewashing; staff moved items to a 3-compartment sink and re-cleaned them on site. Citation issued.

headline: About 30 mouse droppings; more pest service needed
summary: About 30 mouse droppings found in basement dry storage, bakery and under sinks and racks. Additional pest control service required; citation issued. Also food containers on floors, milk crates used as shelving, a leaking drain pipe, and a broken dairy thermometer.

headline: Re-inspection passed; door gap and bleach storage
summary: Re-inspection passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the front door must be sealed to be rodent proof. Bottles of bleach stored on the ground near the soda dispenser must be raised at least 6 inches.

headline: No certified manager certificate posted; debris
summary: No person on site with an original city food sanitation certificate posted; citation issued. Food debris on interior and exterior cooler and freezer surfaces. Debris on floors along walls and corners throughout the facility.

headline: Dried debris in cabinets; prep area dim
summary: Dried food debris inside cabinets holding supplements and ingredients in the front prep area. Floors in prep area need cleaning beside the cooling unit. Inadequate lighting at the back of the prep area near storage.

headline: No certificate posted; missing ceiling tiles
summary: No city food manager certificate posted on premises; citation issued. No covered trash receptacle in the washroom. Two ceiling tiles missing above the front service counter. Accumulated food buildup on the ventilation hood must be cleaned.

headline: Dirty ice machine; no food handler certificates
summary: Ice machine interior needs detail cleaning. Deli and popcorn cooking equipment has grease and food buildup. Leak at a three-compartment sink faucet. No food handler certificates for any employee; allergen certificates also needed.

headline: No hot water at restroom handsinks; citation
summary: Restroom handsinks had no hot water; water measured 60°F, but must be kept at 100°F. Citation issued. Also cardboard and foil on the bottoms of prep tables, and water-stained, damaged ceiling tiles in a prep-area restroom.

headline: Hot chicken and pork held below 135°F
summary: Chicken al pastor, shredded pork and seasoned chicken measured 120°F to 124°F; hot food must be at 135°F or above. About $75 of food discarded; citation issued. No certified manager on site while chicken was prepared and served. PIC lacks allergen training.

headline: Greasy fryers and electrical panels
summary: Grease on the exterior surfaces of the fryers and in the bottom areas of some fryers. Grease also on the electrical panels behind the fryers. Staff were instructed to clean these areas.

headline: Ice machine interiors and cooler condensers dusty
summary: Slight buildup inside the upper portions of some ice machines; manager must clean them. Dust buildup on condensers of some prep-area reach-in coolers; manager must clean all of them.

headline: No manager present; dish room lacks handsink
summary: No person in charge present, and no city sanitation certificate on site while food was handled. An employee handled soiled equipment, then handled food without washing hands. Dish room had no plumbed handwash sink; no test kit or pest log book.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods served
summary: No city-certified food manager on site while chicken, burgers and nachos were prepared and served; citation issued. Heavy food debris and dust buildup on walk-in cooler shelves. Food debris and soil under the prep and three-compartment sinks.

headline: Greasy fryers; food debris under equipment
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. Deep fryers in the front prep area had grease and dirt buildup. Floor drains and corners under heavy equipment had food and charred debris. Certified manager had no allergen certificate.

headline: Utensil handles touch food; mineral buildup
summary: In-use utensil handles were in contact with food in prep coolers, and tongs were stored between coolers. Staff must store handles away from food and store utensils in a clean area. Mineral buildup inside the ice machine's upper compartment needs cleaning.

headline: Entry door gap sealed; buns stored on floor
summary: An opening at the base of the east front entrance door must be sealed. Racks of buns stored on the walk-in freezer floor must be raised to at least six inches. Damaged exterior wall was repaired on site before the inspection ended.

headline: Washroom door needs self-closing device
summary: Washroom door lacks a self-closing device. Management was instructed to install one.

headline: Rodent droppings; untagged shellfish; cold foods
summary: Ten rodent droppings in dry storage; citation issued. Clams and mussels had no shellstock tags; manager discarded 8 clams and 8 lb mussels (citation). Cold foods at 45°F to 47°F discarded. Also a leaking three-compartment sink and a ceiling hole leaking water.

headline: Steam table food below safe hot-holding temps
summary: Steam table potatoes, shrimp, crab legs, broccoli and corn measured 44.6°F to 54.7°F; hot food must stay at 135°F or above. About 14.5 lb discarded; citation issued. Also food stored on a freezer floor and no signed employee health policies.

headline: Hot and cold foods out of range; no certified manager
summary: No certified manager on site while TCS foods were handled until one arrived at 11:15 AM; citation issued. Potatoes 111.6°F, corn 122.2°F; lamb chops 48.2°F and fried chicken 76.1°F. Foods discarded. Missing date marks and food handler proof.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths; torn freezer gasket
summary: Soiled wiping cloths stored on prep tables must be kept in sanitizing solution. Foil used as a liner in the dish area must be removed. Torn, dirty gasket on a prep freezer. Dirt under storage shelving and dust in washroom vents. Expired allergen training.

headline: No sink stoppers; ceramic cups need lead check
summary: No stoppers at three-compartment sinks. Ceramic or clay drinking cups on site need documentation showing they are lead-safe or must be removed. No grease trap on the bar's three-compartment sink.

headline: Seafood stored against linens; allergen training missing
summary: Scallops and fish stored in direct contact with linens; linens must be removed from food containers. No covered waste receptacle in a unisex employee restroom. No allergen training certificates on site for city food managers.

headline: Holes in walls and floors to be sealed
summary: Re-inspection found holes in the liquor storage room walls and floor. Gaps also at the rear exit and in washrooms where wall base and floor are unsealed. Inspector ordered all openings sealed.

headline: No hair restraints; charcoal buildup on equipment
summary: Food handlers needed hair restraints in the prep area. Cutting boards with deep cuts must be replaced. Cooking equipment has charcoal buildup needing detail cleaning. A leak at the three-compartment sink faucet and hood filters need deep cleaning.

headline: Many cold foods too warm; units tagged
summary: Many TCS foods held above 41°F, including chorizo at 54.5°F and sour cream at 56.1°F; about 16 lb ($138) discarded; citation issued. Two cold units at 53.4°F and 49.6°F tagged. Also food on the floor and no handwash sign.

headline: Dirty shelves, rust, and loose faucet
summary: Dirt and dust on shelving in the rear storage area where onions and sauces are kept. Splatter under the slushy station and grease under the flattop need cleaning to prevent insects. Rusted walk-in cooler shelves and a loose faucet at a toilet room handsink.

headline: Dirty deli slicer; no hair restraint in prep
summary: Deli meat slicer needs cleaning to remove food debris. A food handler in the prep area was not wearing a hair restraint. Floors need cleaning along wall bases and behind equipment to remove spills and debris.

headline: Water-damaged ceiling tiles; food handler untrained
summary: Shelving cover next to cooking equipment is dirty and in poor repair. Water-damaged ceiling tiles need replacing. Floors need cleaning along wall bases. A food handler on duty lacked food handler training. Manager allergen certificate expired.

headline: Wiping cloths on cutting board; dirty fryers
summary: Wiping cloths sat on a cutting board and must be stored in sanitizing solution. Walk-in cooler floor and fryer interiors need detail cleaning. A leaking backflow device needs repair. Hood filters and a large return air vent are dusty.

headline: Missing floor tiles in walk-in cooler; milk crates
summary: Ice bin interior needs cleaning. Milk crates used as shelving in prep and storage areas must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor. No covered receptacle for sanitary napkins in the women's employee restroom. Missing, damaged floor tiles in walk-in cooler 7.

headline: Missing backflow device at ice machine
summary: Handwash cleanser dispenser at the three-compartment sink must be removed; it belongs only at handwash sinks. Interior ice machine panel slightly soiled. Missing backflow prevention device at the ice machine must be installed.

headline: Equipment too large for three-compartment sink
summary: Equipment in use is too large to fully immerse in the three-compartment sink. Facility must install a larger sink, use smaller equipment, or use a health-department-approved alternative manual warewashing method.

headline: Sewage backing up from sink floor drain
summary: Wastewater backs up from the floor drain under the three-compartment sink when the sink drains; repair required and citation issued. Aluminum foil lining storage shelves must be removed and replaced with smooth, cleanable surfaces.

headline: Re-inspection passed; floor debris and clutter
summary: Re-inspection passed. Inspector ordered a smooth barrier by a hand sink near cups and beverage tools, removal of dried food debris from floors, and clutter cleared from a second-floor storage closet, with items raised 6 inches off the floor.

headline: No backflow device; no grease trap
summary: No backflow prevention device on the water dispenser line in the prep area. No grease trap installed on the three-compartment sink. Non-working lights in the seating area must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Milk and creamers too warm; cooler tagged
summary: Whole milk, creamers, almond and oat milk stored at 55°F to 58°F in a cooling unit; discarded. Cooler at 50°F tagged and held; citation issued. Also food handlers without training certificates, no allergen training for the manager, and clutter on basement floors.

headline: No valid manager; hot water only 55–57°F
summary: Person in charge lacked a valid city certificate, and no certified manager was on site while yogurt was served (citation issued). Hot water reached only 55°F to 57°F at sinks; citation issued. No employee health policy, no pest log book, and no food handler training records.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables; damaged gasket
summary: Soiled wiping cloths stored on prep tables instead of in sanitizing solution. Damaged gasket on a prep cooler door needs repair. A washroom toilet needs cleaning.

headline: No sanitizer test kit; citation issued
summary: No chemical test kit for measuring sanitizer or warewashing; citation issued. Ice bin interior needs cleaning. Chipped paint on rear prep walls must be resurfaced and repainted so they are smooth and cleanable.

headline: Walk-in coolers off during repairs; failed
summary: Walk-in and reach-in coolers were off and under repair during inspection. Inspector required them to hold 41°F or lower. No citation issued. Also a restroom door that does not self-close and heavy outdoor debris.

headline: Greasy floors behind cooking equipment
summary: Floors with accumulated food, dirt and grease debris behind the cooking equipment. Staff were instructed to clean and sanitize them.

headline: Greasy cooking equipment; leaking faucet
summary: Wiping cloths stored on prep tables and items stored on the floor. Excess ice in seafood freezer. Leaking faucet at the three-compartment sink. Grease and food debris under and around cooking equipment. Burned-out bulb and no food handler training proof.

headline: Jewelry worn; glove contact with ready-to-eat food
summary: Food handlers wore arm jewelry while preparing food; all jewelry except a plain wedding band must be removed. A slash-resistant chain glove touched ready-to-eat food and must be covered with a single-use glove. Heavy grease and dried debris under ovens.

headline: Damaged staff restroom wall; blown hood bulb
summary: Damaged wall near a window in the staff women's restroom must be repaired so it is smooth and cleanable. A blown light bulb in the hood system must be replaced.

headline: Mop sink near food shelves needs barrier
summary: Mop sink located next to food container shelves. Staff were instructed to install a barrier to prevent splashing onto food.

headline: Live roaches and mouse and rat droppings found
summary: About 4 live roaches found behind test strip packets in basement dishwashing area; about 80 mouse droppings and 10 rat droppings in kitchen, prep and storage areas. Citation issued. Also uncovered food on floors and unattended, a pipe leaking under a sink.

headline: No certified manager certificate posted on site
summary: Original city food service manager certificate not posted while open; citation issued. No handwash signage at the front prep sink. No splash guard at a rear prep handsink. Missing sink stopper. No lidded trash receptacle in the employee restroom.

headline: Mops drying improperly; old coolers; core violation
summary: Mops not drying properly, which can attract pests. Two old refrigerators or coolers not in use must be removed. Previous core violation of no covered waste receptacle in the employee washroom was not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Food stored on floor; greasy hood and walls
summary: Food containers and buckets stored on the floor under shelving. Broken refrigerator gasket, milk crates used for shelving, and tinfoil used as a cooking-equipment liner. Excess ice in chest freezers. Grease on hood filters and walls.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; rusted racks
summary: Milk crates used as shelving at the to-go pickup area must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor. Rusted walk-in cooler racks need to be smooth and cleanable. Stoppers needed for the basement three-compartment sink.

headline: Unlabeled flour; greasy cooking equipment
summary: Bulk flour containers have no labels. Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints. Cardboard used as a liner on the oven top. Grease buildup on cooking equipment, walls, surrounding floors and shelving in kitchen and prep areas.

headline: Quiche and croissants held unrefrigerated; discarded
summary: Quiche and stuffed croissants on the front counter were not refrigerated and measured 48.2°F to 69.8°F. About 10 lb discarded; citation issued. Also water pooling in basement storage, holes in basement ceiling, and milk crates used for shelving.

headline: No handwash signs; hole around air duct
summary: No handwashing signage at handsinks. Hole in the upper wall around an air duct must be closed to prevent pest harborage. No allergen training for the manager.

headline: Clutter stored on floor; grease on hood filters
summary: Clutter near shelving in rear dry storage; items must be kept at least six inches off the floor. A tile is missing near the three-compartment sink. Excessive grease buildup on hood filters.

headline: Earlier core violations not corrected; citation
summary: Previous core violations from January were not corrected. Men's restroom faucet was dirty and ceiling paint was peeling; both were ordered cleaned or fixed. Citation issued.

headline: Pass: missing handwashing sign; allergen gap
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign at the rear prep sink; one must be posted. A certified food service sanitation manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: Pass: toilet room ventilation not working
summary: Passed. Mechanical ventilation in both toilet rooms is not working and must be fixed and maintained.

headline: Voided certificate; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Person in charge showed a voided copy of the certified manager certificate; original must be posted. Low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine during inspection. No employee health policy, no allergen training, and no backflow device found on basement ice machine.

headline: No certified manager at start; citation issued
summary: No certified manager on site at start while food that must be kept hot or cold was prepared, stored, and served; manager arrived near end. Citation issued. Wiping cloth and utensils stored improperly; mops drying improperly; no food handler training proof.

headline: Pass: leaky faucet and garbage buckets
summary: Passed. Leaky faucet at the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Buckets used for garbage must be replaced with proper garbage cans. Grease must be cleaned from hood filters. Plastic ware with handles must be stored upright.

headline: Pass: room-temperature thawing, raw chicken on floor
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Two boxes of shrimp thawed at room temperature on a dish-area drainboard; a bin of raw chicken sat on the walk-in cooler floor. Also missing handwashing signs, greasy equipment, and cluttered storage.

headline: Pass: hair restraint and scoop lapses noted
summary: Passed. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint, and disposable cups were used as food scoops. Staff were told to wear restraints and use proper scoops.

headline: Unlabeled containers, worn gasket, ice buildup
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Bulk, shaker, and squeeze-bottle containers must be labeled. Worn walk-in cooler gasket must be replaced; plastic grocery bags used for freezer food must be food-grade. Ice buildup on walk-in freezer floor must be removed.

headline: No certified food manager; citation issued
summary: No valid city food sanitation certificate was posted, and no certified person was on site while ice cream and other food that must be kept hot or cold was served. Citation issued. Prior repeat violations, including a torn cooler gasket, were not corrected.

headline: No certified manager on duty; smoking ashtray
summary: No certified food manager with valid certificate on duty while food that must be kept hot or cold was stored, prepared, and served; citation issued. Also no sanitizer test strips, no food handler certificates, unlabeled chicken and fish mix, and an ashtray with cigarette butts; citation issued.

headline: Repeat violations: milk crates, grime, missing sign
summary: No hand-washing sign near the rear dish sink. Working thermometer needed in egg display cooler. Stored items must be off floors; water-damaged ceiling tiles need replacing. Repeat violations from 2022, including milk crates and debris in walk-in cooler, not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Pass: spills in prep cooler, debris in dining
summary: Passed after complaint. Prep cooler interior must be cleaned of spills. Dining area floors and window seal need cleaning to remove debris.

headline: Wooden platters, slime on racks, damaged floors
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Wooden boards with raw wood sides used as platters must be removed. Dish racks stained with black slime must be cleaned or replaced. Slow drain at patio bar hand sink; cracked dish-room floor tiles; hole in mop sink wall; missing ceiling tiles.

headline: Pass: dish racks on floor, utensil in food
summary: Passed. Dish racks stored on the floor under the dish machine must be raised at least six inches. A scoop was stored with its handle inside food and must be stored handle up.

headline: Pass: damaged cooler gaskets
summary: Passed. Damaged gaskets inside the dairy and coffee prep cooler must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Pass: leaking drain pipes at sinks
summary: Passed after a suspected food poisoning complaint. Drain pipes leak under the middle compartment of the dish-area three-compartment sink and at the bar hand-washing sink; both must be repaired.

headline: Slow-draining sink backs up; citation issued
summary: Three-compartment sink drains slowly, and water backs up into other compartments; citation issued and drain service ordered. Also an unlabeled flour container, a manager without allergen training, dirty floors, soiled mop heads, and two burnt-out bulbs.

headline: No certified manager on site; citation issued
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager was on site while cheese, grilled onions, sliced tomatoes, and hamburgers were prepared and served; citation issued. A certified manager must be present at all times food is prepared and served.

headline: Pass: food on floors, unlabeled containers
summary: Passed. Food containers stored on floors and unlabeled containers need fixing. Utensils were stored inside food containers. Cutting boards have open seams and stains; stove and fryer areas need grease cleaned. Manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Pass: clutter on shelving must be moved
summary: Passed. Inspector found clutter on shelving units, including backpacks, and required that the items be relocated.

headline: No certified manager; unsafe thawing; citation
summary: No certified food manager on site while open; citation issued. Frozen meats were thawing at room temperature, and packets sat in standing water. Food stored on floors; two food handlers lacked hair restraints. Repeat October 2025 violations, including oversized pots and dirty floors, not corrected.

headline: No certified manager on site; training gaps
summary: No Chicago food sanitation manager was on site while food that must be kept hot or cold was prepared and served; citation issued. Food stored on floors, food handlers lacked hair restraints, and no valid food handler training was on site. Repeat violations not corrected.

headline: Pass: scoops stored in food; oversize pot
summary: Passed. Scoops in rice and sugar were stored with handles in food; handles must face up. Large pot too big for the three-compartment sink; written clean-in-place procedure required.

headline: Dumpster lacks lids; repeat violation cited
summary: Dumpster at the rear has no lids; prior violation from June 2025 not corrected; citation issued. Rear exit door has a half-inch gap at the bottom that must be sealed to prevent rodent entry. Food handlers must obtain training; walk-in cooler and freezer floors need cleaning.

headline: Pass: food on floor, flour debris, burnt bulb
summary: Passed. Boxed food stored on basement dry storage floor must be raised six inches. Accumulated flour and food debris on the prep floor needs cleaning. Burned-out bulb near the hooded vent must be replaced.

headline: Pass: brick wall in prep area must be sealed
summary: Passed. A brick wall behind the bar and into the front prep area must be sealed. Food prep surfaces must be smooth and easy to clean.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies; citation issued
summary: No supplies were on site to clean up vomit or diarrhea; management was told to provide them. Citation issued. Floors under retail shelves, in rear storage, and in the men's washroom need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; no hot water at sinks
summary: No valid person in charge or certified manager on site when eggs, hamburgers, and chicken were prepared and served; citation issued. Men's and women's washroom sinks had no hot water (70.2°F and 69.1°F). Food handlers lacked hair restraints; debris throughout.

headline: Pass: dusty bar vents
summary: Passed. Vents in the bar have dust buildup; they must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Pass: expired training proof; washroom door
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Expired food handler training proof was provided; valid certificates required. All-gender washroom door must be self-closing. Wet mop stored on floor; a drying rack is required.

headline: Pass: uncovered carrots, dirty shelf
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Sheet tray of carrots on a speed rack in rear prep was uncovered; food must be covered. Shelf under food prep table needs cleaning.

headline: Menu disclosure missing; stained tiles, floor buildup
summary: Menu lacked the asterisk and disclosure that cooked-to-order animal foods, such as hamburgers, may be served undercooked; ordered added, no citation. Also stained basement ceiling tiles and black buildup on floors, wall bases, and equipment.

headline: Hand soap and paper towels missing; citation
summary: Hand sink at the bar and prep area lacked soap and paper towels; staff obtained them during inspection; citation issued. No licensed pest control contract; citation issued. Shellfish tags lacked required dates; citation issued. Menu lacked raw-food disclosures.

headline: Pass: missing signs, grease, wall openings
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs missing behind the bar, in toilet rooms, and in the basement. Grease built up behind rear cooking equipment, and basement cold-hold unit is dirty. Damaged wall base and wall openings near sinks must be repaired.

headline: No food handler certificate; allergen training missing
summary: A food handler had no training certificate. A certified food manager lacked allergen training, a repeat violation from October 2023; citation issued. Proof must be provided.

headline: Pass: milk crates and upkeep issues
summary: Passed. Milk crates used for storage must be replaced with proper shelving, and food must sit six inches from walls. Also peeling paint behind a hand sink and a burnt-out light in the employee washroom.

headline: Pass: broken gaskets, grime, trash lid missing
summary: Passed after re-inspection. Broken walk-in cooler door gaskets in kitchen and pizza area; rust and grime on can opener; trash can without lid in employee bathroom; grease along walls; damaged light shield.

headline: Pass: floor cleaning and allergen training
summary: Passed. Floor under and around kitchen equipment needs cleaning. One certified manager lacks required allergen training.

headline: Pass: torn screen door, no training proof
summary: Screen door is torn with a 3-inch gap at the bottom; must be tight-fitting to keep pests out. Food stored on floors, dirty coolers, a grooved wooden knife holder, and no food handler training proof were also noted.

headline: Pass: holes, grease and debris need attention
summary: No pests seen. Two holes under a baking prep table must be sealed. Potatoes stored in milk crates must move to easy-to-clean storage. Also needed: cleaning of basement freezer floor, greasy fryer and stove sides, and dusty vents.

headline: Pass: no proof of food handler training
summary: Passed after re-inspection. No proof of food handler training was provided for any food handler. Training records must be kept on site at all times.

headline: No health policy, cleanup kit, or certificates
summary: No signed employee health policy, no vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit, and no food handler certificates were on site. Each must be provided and kept on site.

headline: Pass: uncovered ice and torn cooler gasket
summary: Passed. Ice in the smoothie station must be covered to prevent contamination. Torn gasket inside the beverage refrigerator must be repaired.

headline: No employee health policy; sink and sign issues
summary: No written employee health policy on premises; signed policy required for each employee. Also missing handwashing signs and splashguard at bar sink, leaking kitchen sink faucet, no mop sink with hot and cold water, and water-stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Pass: missing sign, broken dryer, unused cooler
summary: Passed. Women's restroom lacks a handwashing sign. Hand dryer by the men's restroom doesn't work. Unused roll-top cooler behind the espresso machine must be repaired, maintained, or removed.

headline: No hand sink in food prep area
summary: No hand-washing sink in the kitchen food prep area; one must be installed in an easy-to-reach spot. Only blank employee health policy copies were on site; signed copies are required. No citation issued.

headline: Pass: food on floors, grease, unsafe storage
summary: Passed. Employees drink and prepare food in the kitchen prep area; a designated break area is required. Food containers on floors need raised shelving. Food stored in tin cans and grocery bags; cutting boards damaged; heavy grease on hood and filters.

headline: Pass: food handler certificates must be on site
summary: Passed. Food employees who are not certified managers must complete a food handler course and keep certificates on site.

headline: Dish machine wash too cool; citation issued
summary: Low-temperature dish machine wash solution measured 100°F; must be at least 120°F; citation issued. Aluminum foil and cardboard used as shelf and floor liners must be removed. Grease trap could not be verified; must be installed where accessible.

headline: Repeat menu disclosure violation; no training proof
summary: Food handlers did not wear effective hair restraints. Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizing solution. No proof of food handler training. Repeat menu violation from March 2024 not fixed: menu doesn't disclose raw or undercooked foods; citation issued.

headline: Cold fruit held too warm; food discarded
summary: Cantaloupe and honeydew chunks held at 48.4°F; cold food must stay at 41°F or below. Manager discarded about 4 pounds on site; citation issued. Missing menu disclosure for undercooked food was added on site. Upkeep: leaks and a door.

headline: Unlabeled food, floor debris, slow-draining sinks
summary: Passed. Food stored unlabeled in coolers and dry storage, and food containers on floors in walk-in cooler and prep area. Wiping cloths and knives stored improperly. Three bar sinks drain slowly; grease, debris, and damaged floors need attention.

headline: No certified manager on premises; citation
summary: No Chicago certified food manager on premises while burgers, hot dogs, fries, and shakes were prepared and served; citation issued. Restroom needs a trash can with a lid; debris and bottle caps on floors in rear storage and dishwashing areas.

headline: Pass: leaking sink pipe, standing water
summary: Passed. One-compartment sink pipe leaks and must be repaired. Standing water on the prep-area floor under the sink and cooler must be kept dry and clean.

headline: Rat droppings and moldy ice machine; citation
summary: About 20 rat droppings found across the sales floor, between coolers, and in rear storage near the ice machine; citation issued. Black mold-like substance inside the ice machine dripped onto ice; ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned. Open fly strips also seen.

headline: Pass: beard guard and shelf barrier needed
summary: Passed. A food handler was not wearing a beard restraint. Wire shelves above an open food station need a barrier to keep objects from falling onto food.

headline: Pass: missing mop sink, backflow, allergen training
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Missing service sink for mop water with hot and cold water; missing backflow device on ice machine; certified managers lack allergen training. Owner must install, obtain training, and keep verification on site.

headline: Pass: slow-draining prep handsink
summary: Passed. Hand-washing sink at the main prep line drains slowly after extended use; it must be serviced and maintained.

headline: Pass: milk crates and no food handler certificates
summary: Milk crates used as shelving must be removed. Soiled mop heads must hang to prevent insect breeding. No food handler certificates were on site; employees must complete training and keep records.

headline: Expired allergen certificate; repeat violation cited
summary: Certified food manager has an expired allergen certificate, a repeat violation from December 2023; citation issued. Torn door gasket in two-door cooler; frozen food in plastic grocery bags; water leaks at three-compartment sink faucet.

headline: Pass: leaking hand sink needs repair
summary: Passed. A drain line leaks at an exposed hand-washing sink next to the taco prep area. Inspector required repair and maintenance.

headline: Dish machine wash water too cool; citation
summary: High-temperature dish machine wash water measured 130°F; must be at least 150°F. Citation issued to operator. No temperature indicator for utensil surfaces; manager told to provide one.

headline: Pass: basement cleaning and clutter removal
summary: Passed after re-inspection. Basement storage floors along walls need additional cleaning, and unnecessary items must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Pass: damaged ceiling above prep table
summary: Passed. Damaged ceiling above the prep table must be repaired and kept smooth and cleanable.

headline: Mouse droppings found; no certified manager
summary: 100 or more mouse droppings found on grease trap, floors, and food storage areas. Rib tips and macaroni held at 105.6°F to 114.1°F, below 135°F; about 85 pounds discarded. Certified manager arrived at 2:16 p.m. Multiple citations issued; no pest control log.

headline: Mold in ice machine; no hand drying; citation
summary: Thick black and green mold-like buildup inside ice machine dripping onto ice; citation issued. Rear prep hand sink had no hand-drying supplies; citation issued. Also missing handles on a two-door freezer, dried food debris on floors, and a missing ceiling tile.

headline: Pass: grease and debris in fryers and oven
summary: Passed after complaint re-inspection. Accumulated grease and food debris inside fryer cabinets, and the oven and stove interiors were not clean. Equipment must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Undated food discarded; staff hygiene lapses
summary: Ready-to-eat food held over 24 hours was not labeled with name and use-by date; manager discarded 65 pounds (about $45) and citation issued. Staff prepared food without hair restraints or beard guards and ate and drank at prep areas. Employee belongings were on food shelves.

headline: 35 rodent droppings and too-hot handsink water
summary: About 35 small rodent droppings on floors under the three-compartment sink and in basement shelving; pest control required, citation issued. Hand-sink water measured 145°F; maximum is 120°F; citation issued. Food handlers also lacked certificates.

headline: Pass: greasy cooking equipment, dusty hood
summary: Passed. Greasy sides of cooking equipment need cleaning to prevent pest activity. Floor drain under dish-area shelving needs detailed cleaning. Hood vents and filters are dusty.

headline: Food out of temperature; citations issued
summary: Meatballs held at 116.6°F, below 135°F; sliced tomatoes, lettuce, cucumber, and peppers held at 53.8°F, above 41°F. Manager discarded 3 pounds and 15 pounds. Cold-holding unit must not be used until Chicago Department of Public Health reinspects it. Citations issued.

headline: 20 or more live roaches found; citation issued
summary: About 20 or more live roaches in cracks at front and side service counters, a dish-area wall panel, and under a hot-holding unit; pest control recommended; citation issued. Gaps under kitchen doors and missing filters also need attention.

headline: Cold sink water, no health policy, no training
summary: Hand-washing sink water measured 65.6°F and 66.2°F; it must be at least 100°F. No employee health policy or food handler training on site. Ice chute showed mineral buildup. Also a front door gap, duct tape repairs, and no thermometer in the hot-holding unit.

headline: Grease trap not found; several upkeep issues
summary: Grease trap could not be located and must be found or installed. Cold-holding unit interiors need cleaning, sealant around a hand sink is torn and moldy, and items on the walk-in freezer floor must be raised six inches.

headline: Rat droppings near furnace; citation issued
summary: About 10 rat droppings found on the floor, under and behind the furnace, and inside it; citation issued. Pest control service recommended. Food containers need labels, and no food handler training was on site.

headline: Pass: mop sink hole, damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Passed after complaint re-inspection. Mop sink with a large hole must be replaced. Missing ceiling tiles above electrical boxes and stained tiles above pots and pans must be replaced. No allergen training proof for certified managers.

headline: Pass: unlabeled rice bins and freezer bags
summary: Passed. Bulk rice containers must be labeled with product name and have lids. Plastic grocery bags used for freezer food must be replaced with food-grade bags or containers. Peeling plastic on equipment must be removed.

headline: Slimy ice machine, no hair restraints, allergen gap
summary: Black slime found inside the ice machine's water parts. Machine was ordered turned off, ice removed, and interior cleaned and sanitized. Employees in food prep lacked hair restraints. A certified food manager lacked allergen training. Citation issued.

headline: Pass: stairway door must be rodent-proof
summary: Passed. The door at the top of stairs leading to a separate business must be rodent-proof and kept in good repair.

headline: Pass: drains, hood grease, expired allergen certificates
summary: Passed. Food buildup inside some floor drains must be cleaned. Grease dripping from the ventilation hood must be cleaned. Some certified manager allergen certificates have expired.

headline: Pass: utensils in standing water; insulation damaged
summary: Passed. Spatulas and spoons kept in stagnant room-temperature water at the front prep line must be stored per health code. Damaged insulation around the walk-in cooler cooling line must be replaced.

headline: Incomplete pest control logbook; citation issued
summary: Pest control logbook was incomplete and out of date, with no service reports from 2023 or 2024; citation issued. Small reach-in cooler has cracks and gaps in its walls; ceiling panels near the exterior door are improperly repaired with large gaps.

headline: Refrigerator too warm; 75 lbs of food discarded
summary: Many refrigerated foods were above 41°F, including fish at 68.5°F and chicken at 57.6°F. Manager discarded about 75 pounds ($1,050). Unit cannot be used until Chicago Department of Public Health reinspects it. Citation issued; outdoor dumpster lids were open.

headline: Pass: damaged floor tiles and chipped paint
summary: Passed. Missing and damaged floor tiles in dry storage must be repaired to a smooth, cleanable surface. Chipped paint on rear prep and dish-area walls must be repainted.

headline: Dead ant in food and flies; citation issued
summary: A dead ant was found in cooked pasta in a prep cooler; food discarded and citation issued. About 30 small flies were seen near the front bar; pest control consultation required, citation issued. Also no food handler training proof and wet wiping cloths.

headline: Live flies and bare-hand food handling; citation
summary: More than 15 live small flies on bar shelves and bottles, plus 2 large house flies in basement; citation issued. Food handlers touched ready-to-eat food with bare hands. Ice machine had mold-like buildup. Low-temperature dishwasher had no sanitizer and was tagged out.

headline: Hot water too cool; corrected during inspection
summary: Hand-sink water measured 75.6°F and 76°F; minimum is 100°F. Management raised the heater temperature during inspection; sinks then reached 106.7°F and 105.3°F, corrected on site. Leaking faucet and missing backflow device also cited.

headline: Pass: torn gaskets, greasy hood, cardboard mats
summary: Passed. Torn gaskets inside three-door prep cooler must be repaired. Grease buildup in the hood over the cookline must be cleaned. Spilled food debris on kitchen floors. Cardboard floor mats in rear prep must be replaced with smooth, cleanable coverings.

headline: Sprayer on handwash sink; citation issued
summary: Water sprayer was connected to a hand-washing sink, which may only be used for hand washing; citation issued and sprayer must be removed. Heavy basement clutter must be cleared to avoid pest harborage. Certified manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: Leaking pipe, uncovered food, repeat violations
summary: Pipe under the main kitchen sink leaks heavily onto the floor. Food was left uncovered and stored on floors; no hair restraints; no food handler certificates on site. Earlier repeat violations, including damaged floors and dim lights, were not fixed. Citation issued.

headline: Pass: missing signs, uninverted utensils
summary: Passed after re-inspection. Hand-washing signs missing at rear and front prep sinks and toilet room. Plastic spoons and forks not inverted in front service area. One sink stopper missing from warewashing sink.

headline: Pass: doors open, hood not working
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Front and rear doors were open and must stay closed to be rodent-proof. Ventilation hood in front prep not working; facility smoky with strong cooking fumes. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Live roaches and flies found; citation issued
summary: About three or more live roaches seen on the bar drainboard, dining room wall, and basement; 30 or more small live flies in bar, dining, basement, and prep areas. Pest operator arrived during inspection; citation issued. Gaps and damaged floors also need repair.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup kit; leaks
summary: No signed employee health policy and no vomit and diarrhea clean-up procedure or supplies on site. Leaky pipes at both prep and dish-area hand sinks. No probe thermometer for food temperatures. Freezer at 0°F needed for frozen menu items.

headline: Pass: missing handwashing sign; beard guards
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign at the front prep sink. Male food handlers with beards lacked beard guards.

headline: Live cockroaches and flies found; citation issued
summary: Two live cockroaches crawled near the front prep area. About 25 large live black flies were in rear prep and seating areas, and 30 small ones were inside cabinets. Pest control recommended; citation issued. Sticky buildup and debris also noted.

headline: Over 50 mouse droppings; citation issued
summary: Over 50 mouse droppings on basement floor and wall ledge; citation issued. Droppings must be removed and pest control contacted. Rear and basement exit doors have quarter-inch gaps. Carpeted floor mats in front of walk-in cooler must be removed.

headline: Dish machine sanitizer too weak; machine tagged
summary: Dish machine's chlorine sanitizer was too weak; minimum of 50 ppm (parts per million) required at all times. Citation issued; Chicago Department of Public Health tagged the machine. Three-compartment sink in use. Also dirty cold-hold drawers, pots not stored upside down, and food splatter on walls.

headline: Pass: coolers, toilet, and floors need cleaning
summary: Passed. Interiors of reach-in pop coolers, the toilet facility, and floors throughout need cleaning to remove debris.

headline: No employee health policy on site
summary: No employee health policy was on site; signed policies are required for each employee. Rear receiving door has a half-inch gap at the bottom that must be repaired to keep pests out. Two washrooms need covered waste containers.

headline: No certified manager; rodent droppings found
summary: No certified food manager was present while TCS foods were prepared. Soup at 50F, expired ready-to-eat foods, and inaccurate thermometers were cited. About 50 mouse droppings and 10 rat droppings were found in the basement, and a dead mouse was present. Pest control needed.

headline: Sewage backup at sink; no health policy
summary: Waste water backed up into the three-compartment sink. No written employee health policy or vomit/diarrhea procedure was on site. A rear door has a 1/4 inch gap. Priority violations were cited. Trash and litter were outside the rear door.

headline: Missing splashguard; allergen proof lacking
summary: A splashguard is missing at the front prep handwash sink and must be installed. Cutting boards with deep cuts must be restored or replaced. No proof of allergen training was on site for certified food managers.

headline: Cold food up to 69F; mouse droppings found
summary: About 138 lbs of cold deli food at 46-69F was discarded, about $400. Over 100 mouse droppings were found on prep tables, shelves, and floors. A dead mouse was in a glue board. Pest control service recommended. Missing employee health policy and food handler training. Citations issued.

headline: No certified manager; food in plastic bags
summary: No certified manager was on duty while chicken and other TCS items were prepared, a priority violation with citation. Food was stored on the walk-in freezer floor and in plastic bags. Accumulated grease and debris on equipment and debris on walk-in floors need cleaning.

headline: Stained cutting boards; grocery bags in freezer
summary: A heavily stained cutting board needs replacement. Grocery bags were used for food in the freezer, and crates were used in the walk-in cooler. A black substance on the wall behind the dishwasher needs removal. Light shields are cracked or missing.

headline: Dead waterbugs in basement; restroom issues
summary: Dead waterbugs were found throughout the basement and must be removed and cleaned. Handwashing signage was missing, and cooler and freezer thermometers were missing. Boxes and pallets on floors, mold and spills in coolers, and no working restroom ventilation were cited.

headline: Missing towel; ice machine mineral buildup
summary: Paper towels were missing at a produce handsink but were supplied when requested. Signage is needed at sinks. Mineral buildup in the ice machine must be cleaned. The high-temp dishmachine lacked a temperature indicator and was then verified at 160F. Leaking pipes need repair.

headline: Broken freezer handle; greasy, worn surfaces
summary: A broken freezer door handle exposes a sharp edge and must be repaired. A stained cutting board must be replaced and shelves lined with foil removed. Grease buildup on cooking equipment and a brick wall needs cleaning.

headline: Stained cutting board; dust on equipment
summary: A large cutting board at the salad prep had deep grooves and stains and must be shaved or replaced. Sides of cooking and non-cooking equipment need detail cleaning from dust.

headline: Dust and food spills on prep equipment
summary: Dust had built up on prep area coolers and condensers, and food spills were on prep shelves. Equipment must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Raw steaks held too long; door gap; more issues
summary: About 4 lbs of reduced-oxygen packaged steaks were held over 48 hours without approval and discarded. Machine tagged. Other issues: a 1/2 inch gap under the rear door, overflowing garbage and grease, and missing menu raw-food advisories. Allergen training was not in place.

headline: Inadequate lighting in food prep areas
summary: Both food prep areas need adequate lighting. The inspector required this during re-inspection.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; deli cup as scoop
summary: Bulk containers including flour, salt, and starch lacked labels. A deli cup was used as a scoop and must be replaced with proper scoops.

headline: Animal intestine at 46F discarded
summary: Cooked diced animal intestine at 45.8-46F was discarded, about 5 lbs, a priority violation with citation. Food was stored in sour cream containers without labels. Plastic grocery bags and milk crates were used. Grease buildup and cracked caulking need attention.

headline: Unlabeled prepackaged foods; citation for posting
summary: Prepackaged salads, desserts, and sandwiches lacked proper labels. Liquor and wine boxes stored in the washroom must be removed. The prior inspection summary was not posted for public view; a copy was given and a citation issued.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep
summary: Food handlers prepared TCS foods without a certified food manager or certificate on site. A citation was issued. Floor of walk-in coolers must be detail cleaned.

headline: Uncovered walls and cracked floor tiles
summary: Walls behind a refrigerator and soup unit are not covered. Floors near the three-compartment sink need regrouting, and some floor tiles are cracked. Surfaces must be made smooth and easily cleanable.

headline: No certified manager; turkey left too warm
summary: No certified food manager was on site while deli, chicken, and eggs were handled. 24 lbs of sliced turkey stayed at 54-68F during thawing and was discarded. Ice maker interior, a wall hole, dirty floor under dishmachine, and missing restroom ventilation need attention.

headline: Cooked food at 64F discarded
summary: About 3 lbs cooked fish and 2 lbs cooked chicken held at 64.3F were discarded, valued at $20. Priority violation. Grab-and-go salads and sandwiches need weight labels. Walk-in freezer needs more lighting.

headline: Unlabeled desserts; sink needed for juices
summary: Packaged desserts in the prep cooler were not properly labeled. The front prep area needs a food-prep sink for freshly squeezed juices. Both items were re-inspected.

headline: Backflow device not located; raw wood shelf
summary: The backflow preventer at the mop sink must be installed so it can be serviced. A clogged three-compartment sink must be repaired or removed. Raw wood storage shelves need sealing or painting.

headline: Grease and dust cleaning needed
summary: Grill and fryer bottoms, walk-in fan covers, bulk containers, and can opener blade need cleaning. A cold water faucet knob at the rear prep sink is in poor repair. Light shields and floors need cleaning.

headline: Entry gaps sealed; utensils exposed on tables
summary: Gaps at the revolving entry door and at a side door need sealing to prevent pest entry. Exposed knives and forks on dining tables must be wrapped, covered, or inverted.

headline: Grease and debris on counters and floors
summary: Counters, prep stations, and shelving under cooking equipment need cleaning of spills, debris, and grease. Coolers and freezers need interior cleaning. Floors throughout need detail cleaning, especially along walls and corners.

headline: Walk-in shelving and standing water
summary: Walk-in cooler shelving must be cleaned to remove spills and debris. Standing water and grease in the prep area must be addressed by grouting floors to prevent potential pest breeding.

headline: Dead roaches found; food at 52F discarded
summary: Cold foods at 50-52F were discarded, about 20 lbs, a priority violation with citation. A two-door cooler at 52F was tagged. Dead roaches were on the floor and near the three-compartment sink and grease trap. Leaking drain pipe and cardboard shelf liners need fixing.

headline: Missing handwashing signage; cutting board worn
summary: Handwashing signage is missing at toilet room sinks and the rear prep and dish handsink. A cutting board in the rear prep area has deep grooves and dark stains and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Rodent droppings and live roaches found
summary: About 60 mouse droppings and live roaches were found across several areas. Cold TCS food at up to 66F was discarded; a prep cooler was tagged and must not be used. A dishmachine had 0 ppm sanitizer. Priority violations; citations issued. Pest control service is needed.

headline: Boxes stored on basement floor
