summary: Multiple boxes were on the floor in the basement liquor room. Management was instructed to keep all items off the floor.

headline: Wiping cloths air-dry; base coving needed
summary: Wiping cloths were balled in a bowl and must be air-dried when not in use. Base coving is needed in the rear storage area. Unnecessary items in the rear area must be removed before opening.

headline: No certified manager on site; hair restraints missing
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager was on site while raw chicken and coleslaw were handled, a priority violation with citation. Food handlers lacked hair restraints and food handler training certificates. Items must be provided.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; hair restraint missing
summary: Bulk food containers lacked labels and must be labeled with the food name. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. A gasket on a reach-in cooler is torn. Food debris was found on cooler and freezer interiors.

headline: Dead insects found; freezer ice buildup
summary: Dead insects were seen on the mop closet floor and near freezers. Inspector ordered removal, detail cleaning, and sanitizing. Excess ice in reach-in freezers must be removed. Floor tiles are missing or damaged in prep areas, and unused equipment must go to prevent pests.

headline: Damaged cooler gaskets and missing light shield
summary: A prep cooler had damaged door gaskets, and a display cooler had ice buildup. A light shield above the walk-in cooler is missing and must be provided.

headline: Cold water hazard; cold food discarded
summary: Employee restroom hand sinks measured 67F; hot water was fixed on site to 102-105F. Cold food at 60.5F was discarded, a priority violation with citation. Hand sink lacked soap, which was obtained during inspection. Milk crates must be replaced with shelving.

headline: Hot food too cool; flies and gaps found
summary: About 7 lbs of hot-held food at 57-122F was discarded, citation issued. Around 25 small flies and 5-7 large flies were found in prep and dining areas, and a pest control operator was recommended. Front door gaps and missing food handler and allergen training were noted.

headline: No certified manager; no hot water at sinks
summary: No certified food manager was on site or certificate posted while chicken and fish were handled, a priority violation. Men's restroom hand sinks had 56F water and must reach 100-120F. No heat strips for the high-temperature dishmachine.

headline: No cold water at front handsink
summary: The front handwashing sink had no cold running water and must be provided and maintained. Unused equipment and single-use articles in front and rear storage areas must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Missing thermometers; rust, grease, and faucet
summary: Thermometers must be visible inside all kitchen coolers. Rusty prep shelves need repainting. Hood grease buildup needs cleaning. A hot water faucet handle at a compartment sink needs repair.

headline: Missing thermometer; dumpster lids damaged
summary: A thermometer was missing inside a prep cooler and must be provided. A torn drawer cooler gasket must be repaired or replaced. Two of six dumpster lids in the alley are in poor repair.

headline: No certified manager; basement floors dirty
summary: No person in charge with a valid Chicago sanitation certificate was present, and no certified food manager was on duty while chicken, steak, and pork were handled. Citation issued. Basement storage floors had debris and dust needing detail cleaning.

headline: Sanitizer test strips missing; jugs used
summary: Large plastic jugs with narrow openings were used as multi-use utensils and should be replaced with washable tools. No sanitizer test strips were on site, a priority violation.

headline: Ice bin needs cleaning
summary: The ice bin interior needed cleaning. Staff were instructed to remove ice, clean, and maintain it at all times.

headline: Food on floor; expired allergen training
summary: Food items were stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and must be elevated six inches. Rusted racks, cardboard shelf liners, and food debris in cooling equipment must be fixed. Inoperative restroom ventilation fans need repair. One manager's allergen training was expired.

headline: Flying insects; sausages and eggs too warm
summary: Over 20 flying insects were on walls, shelves, and equipment at the bar and must be cleaned. Sausages at 120.7F and cold eggs at 56F were discarded. No temperature log was on site. Missing paper towels and metal thermometer were also cited.

headline: Floor cleaning and sealing needed
summary: Grocery shared walk-in freezer floor needs cleaning. Bakery floor beneath ovens and around patched areas needs sealing. Both are general upkeep items.

headline: No certified manager; food at 50F
summary: No certified manager was on duty while food was being prepared. About 50 lbs of chicken at 50F was discarded; a refrigerator at 49.5F was tagged. Food handler training and allergen training were missing. Priority violations with citations.

headline: Grab-and-go labels; torn gasket; clutter
summary: Grab-and-go prepackaged foods must show business name, address, ingredients, and allergen warnings. A torn gasket on a reach-in cooler must be replaced. Milk crates must not be used for shelving. A self-closing door is needed on the employee restroom. Items under the stairwell must be removed.

headline: Walk-in freezer floor and wall needs repair
summary: The walk-in freezer floor needs detail cleaning. A wall covering on the right side is coming loose and must be repaired. Front deep fryer floor and rear floor need cleaning, and all hoods need detail cleaning. No allergen training certificate was on site.

headline: Sewage backup in restroom; corrected on site
summary: A restroom toilet overflowed, and sewage backed up from a floor drain into the lobby. This is a priority violation with citation. The plumber corrected the issue on site. Low hand sink water pressure must be repaired.

headline: Rust, milk crates, and hole in ceiling
summary: Dry rice and beans sat on the floor and must be elevated. Milk crates and aluminum foil lining are not allowed and must be removed. A leaking handsink in the basement must be repaired, and a ceiling hole sealed.

headline: Bearded food handlers without beard guards
summary: Male food handlers were seen with beards and without beard guards. Management was instructed to provide them.

headline: Crates, debris, and items on floor need removal
summary: Crates used for storage on the sales floor and rear area must be replaced with adequate shelving. Debris must be cleaned from several coolers and display shelves. Items on rear floors must be elevated and hood filters cleaned.

headline: Leaking pipe under sink; cleaning needed
summary: A leak under the third compartment of the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Unnecessary items near the rear exit door should be removed. Floors under cooking equipment and the walk-in cooler need cleaning, and hood vents need cleaning.

headline: Torn refrigerator door gasket
summary: A torn rubber gasket on a refrigerator door must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Floor under sink needs cleaning
summary: The floor under the three-compartment sink had buildup and needed cleaning. The inspector instructed the staff to clean and maintain it.

headline: No certified manager for 40 lbs chicken
summary: No certified manager was on site from 11 AM to 11:40 AM while TCS foods were prepared. About 40 lbs of grilled chicken at 50.8F was discarded. Missing employee health policy, food handler certificates, and allergen training were cited. Pest-related clutter needs removal.

headline: Foil and tape lined shelving; poor lighting
summary: Shelving in prep areas was lined with foil and tape and must be removed and resurfaced. Floors in the front prep area need cleaning. Lighting in the beverage area must be increased. An allergen training certificate was missing.

headline: Truck food handler lacked certificate
summary: The food handler on the truck at inspection did not have a food handler training certificate. The employee was instructed to obtain one.

headline: Hot water too cold; eggs too warm
summary: Hot water at two handsinks measured about 70-73F and was corrected by a technician to 102-105F. Eggs at 73.8F were discarded. The quats sanitizer measured 0 ppm and was emptied. A citation was issued for the sink and the hot-water violation.

headline: Water frozen; no health policy or thermometer
summary: No water was on site because it was frozen, so hot and cold water temperature could not be checked. Employee health policy and a probe thermometer were missing. Must return once water is available.

headline: Handwashing sink required; floor baseboard needed
summary: The front prep area needs a handwashing sink with hot and cold water, soap, and hand drying, or the prep area door must be permanently removed. This is a priority violation. Floor baseboard around the rear prep area must also be installed.

headline: Standing water above grease trap
summary: Standing water was found above the grease trap in the basement. It must be cleaned and maintained. This was re-inspected.

headline: Dead roaches in trap; grease and rice
summary: A sticky trap filled with dead roaches was found in the basement dry storage, and traps must be replaced to track activity. Rice was stored without a cover under the dishwashing drainboard and must be relocated. Grease and black substance on the ice machine need cleaning.

headline: Front door gap; crates and rust issues
summary: A gap at the bottom of the front entry door must be sealed. Bulk bins lack labels, plastic ware needs proper storage, and rust and crates in the walk-in cooler need fixing. Grill, prep table, and hood debris must be cleaned, and stained ceiling tiles replaced.

headline: Unlabeled spices; front door needs screening
summary: Spices outside original packaging lacked labels. The front entrance doors were open without screening to prevent pests, and staff must add screening or keep doors closed. Black substance in the ice machine must be cleaned. A clean-in-place procedure is required.

headline: Previous core violations uncorrected; allergen training
summary: Earlier core violations were not corrected: plastic liners under cutting boards, rust on shelves, black caulking, a missing light shield, and missing allergen training for certified managers. A citation was issued for the allergen training violation.

headline: Front door gaps; washroom vent missing
summary: Openings around the front door must be sealed to prevent pests. Washroom door self-closing device needs repair and washroom has no ventilation. Both must be provided and maintained.

headline: Missing vomit kit; no backflow device
summary: Necessary supplies for responding to vomit and diarrhea events were missing and must be kept on site. Handwashing signage, a backflow device, and damaged floor tiles were noted. Moldlike substance was found inside the ice machine and must be cleaned.

headline: Rodent infestation; 150 droppings found
summary: About 150 rodent droppings were found throughout dining, prep, basement, and restroom areas, and in ventilation ducts. Rodenticide was left in open food storage and basement areas. Management must remove droppings and arrange rat control. Priority violations with citations.

headline: Handwash sink disconnected; food at 109F
summary: A rear prep handwash sink was not accessible due to a disconnected pipe, a citation issued. Sausage pizza at 109F was discarded. Several cold TCS foods at 59-63F were discarded, and two coolers were tagged and must not be used until reinspected.

headline: No vomit/diarrhea procedure; flawed front door
summary: No written procedure or supplies were on site for vomit and diarrhea events, a priority foundation violation with citation. Other issues: no handwashing sign, a front door without screening, a male handler without hair restraint, dirty fryers and floors, and food on the floor. Food handlers lacked training proof.

headline: Greasy cooking equipment and floors
summary: Grease and food splatter on sides of cooking equipment must be cleaned to prevent pests and insects. Reach-in cooler floors and doors have food debris, and floors under cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: No allergen training certificates on site
summary: No allergen training certificates were available at inspection. All employees holding city food service manager certificates must complete allergen training and keep records on site.

headline: Missing signage and thermometers
summary: Handwashing signage is needed at the restroom handwash sink. Ambient air thermometers are needed inside reach-in freezers. A covered waste receptacle is needed in the restroom.

headline: About 30 mouse droppings; pest control advised
summary: About 30 mouse droppings were found on floors and shelves in storage, near the front entrance, and in a walk-in cooler used for equipment. Manager was instructed to clean them. Pest control is recommended. Priority violation with citation. A food handler lacked a certificate.

headline: No certified manager; 40 flying insects
summary: No certified food manager was present while TCS foods were prepared. About 40 live small flying insects were found on walls and sinks, a priority violation with citation. Hand soap and towels were missing, leaking pipes and missing ceiling tiles were found, and food handler certificates were absent.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; pest control required
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were found on floors under sinks, prep tables, and shelving, and in the fryer cabinet. A dead mouse on a glue board was removed on site. Manager was told to clean and arrange pest control service before reinspection. Priority violation with citation.

headline: No food handler certificates; allergen training
summary: No food handler certificates were on site and must be provided. A sanitation manager lacked allergen training. Management was instructed to comply.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; pest control needed
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were found on floors in the rear storage area and basement. Manager was instructed to remove all droppings, clean and sanitize, and contact pest control. Priority violation with citation. Freezer ice and mold on sink caulk also need cleaning.

headline: Expired food; flies; untrained food handlers
summary: Soup, chili, and ranch past the 7-day limit were found, citation issued. Brunch menu lacked raw or undercooked food advisories. About 25 live small flying insects were on walls and ceilings in several areas, a priority violation with citation. Several employees lacked food handler certificates.

headline: Sinks blocked; cheese unlabeled and unapproved
summary: Front and rear handwashing sinks were blocked and not accessible, a priority violation with citation. About 60 lbs of cheese in a display cooler had no label or receipt. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Floors and walls need cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled food; food stored on floor
summary: Food inside refrigeration units lacked labels. Food containers were stored on the floor in prep, storage, and the walk-in freezer and must be raised six inches. Serving plates need inverting. Cluttered cabinets must be cleaned to remove pest hiding places.

headline: Missing thermometer; knives wedged on tables
summary: A prep cooler was missing a thermometer and must be provided. Knives were wedged between two prep tables and must be kept in a knife holder.

headline: Milk crates used; allergen training missing
summary: Milk crates were used for elevation in the walk-in cooler and must be replaced with shelving. Floors in prep areas need detail cleaning, and ceiling vent dust must be cleaned. Allergen awareness certificates were not on site.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; food stored on floor
summary: Bulk flour and sugar containers lacked labels and must be labeled. Food containers were stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and prep areas and must be raised at least six inches. Re-inspection found these issues.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; food at 48-50F
summary: Low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm and was tagged and held by CDPH. Carnitas, beef, and chicken at 48-50F were discarded, about 30 lbs. Food lacked discard dates. Missing light shields and allergen training.

headline: Ice bin needed cleaning; no allergen proof
summary: The ice bin interior needed cleaning and was instructed to be cleaned. The certified food manager had no proof of allergen training on site. All certified managers were instructed to get this certificate.

headline: Dirty cutting board; restroom sink not running
summary: A stained cutting board with deep grooves must be resurfaced or replaced. One of three handsinks in the men's restroom had no running water.

headline: Missing thermometer, labels, and food handler card
summary: A refrigerator lacked a thermometer, and condiment containers lacked labels. Single-use plates were stored improperly and soda crates sat on the floor. Plastic bags held frozen food. Cluttered storage and broken ceiling tiles need attention. An employee lacked a food handler certificate.

headline: Cutting boards damaged; allergen training expired
summary: Cutting boards in the rear prep area have deep scratches and stains and must be replaced or resurfaced. Low hot water pressure in the women's restroom needs repair. Debris and pools of water under cooking equipment must be cleaned. Expired allergen training for managers was not corrected from a prior inspection.

headline: Eggs and milk at up to 92F discarded
summary: Cold TCS foods, including eggs and milk, were at 51-92F and about 15 lbs were discarded, a priority violation with citation. About 13 flies were found. Two dogs were in the dining area, which is prohibited, and a citation was issued. Repeat core violations.

headline: Hand-washing, raw meat, and pest report issues
summary: A cook washed hands in the three-compartment sink and handled raw beef then ready-to-eat buns without changing gloves. Raw beef and eggs were stored above ready-to-eat food. No current pest control report was on site. Priority violations with citations issued.

headline: Expired cooked food discarded; leaking sink
summary: Cooked food lacked proper date labels; about 5 lbs of cooked pork over seven days was discarded. Utensils were stored above the sink and a leak under the sink needs repair. Basement items must be raised off the floor. Missing ceiling tiles and grease need attention.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; repaired on site
summary: The chlorine dish machine showed 0 ppm, too low to sanitize dishes. The manager was told to provide at least 50 ppm. A technician arrived to repair it. Priority violation with citation.

headline: Dirty walk-in floors; no handler proof
summary: Floors inside walk-in coolers had dirt, grease, and debris and must be cleaned. No food handler training proof was available for required employees.

headline: Pest control logs incomplete; citation issued
summary: The pest control log book was incomplete, with no 2024 service reports and the latest from December 2023. Pest control reports for 2024 and 2025 must be provided and kept on site. Paper towels stored on lockers must be relocated. Priority violation with citation.

headline: No certified manager; allergen training missing
summary: No certified manager was on site while chicken, beef, pork, and fish were prepared, a priority violation with citation. The person in charge lacked a sanitation certificate. No approved allergen training certificate was available.

headline: Food stored on floor; leaks and rust
summary: Food items were stored on floors in the walk-in cooler, front display, and rear storage. Milk crates must not be used for shelving. Frozen food in plastic bags must use food-grade bags. A freezer has excess ice and leaking pipes and faucets need repair.

headline: No handwash signs; leaking sink pipe
summary: No handwashing sign was posted at the smoker's handwash sink, and a pipe under the three-compartment sink leaks. Also: unattached metal panels above that sink, dirty floors and walls, and toilet-room bowls needing recaulking.

headline: Debris and boxes under shelving
summary: Food debris, loose cardboard, and empty boxes were under rear food storage shelves and beneath a two-door cooler. The manager was instructed to clean and keep the area free of debris.

headline: Greasy wall above prep table; closet debris
summary: A kitchen wall above the prep table had heavy grease buildup, and debris was on closet floors. The facility was instructed to clean and maintain both areas.

headline: Summary not posted; cooler cleaning ordered
summary: No inspection summary was posted for the public, and a citation was issued. The interiors of three display coolers must be detail cleaned and maintained.

headline: No certified person during food handling
summary: No one on site held a City of Chicago sanitation certificate while TCS (time/temperature-controlled) foods, such as deli meat, chicken, and whipped cream, were handled; citation issued. Also: unlabeled bulk containers, no hair restraints, and dirty hood vents.

headline: Chicken wings held at improper temperatures
summary: About 11 lbs of cooked chicken wings were held at 123.9–134.1°F and discarded. No electronic temperature logs were available. Also: an inaccurate fish cooler thermometer, rusty shelving, cardboard under equipment, and damaged floor tiles.

headline: Dead insects by drive-through beverage area
summary: Dead insects were found by the drive-through window and beverage dispenser and must be removed and cleaned. Also noted: a greasy baked-potato oven and fryer area, a slow-draining rear prep hand sink, standing water, and greasy floors.

headline: Smoky kitchen; grill outside hood; floor storage
summary: Items stored on the floor in rear dry storage must be kept at least 6 inches up. Ventilation was inadequate: a small flat-top grill sat outside the hood, causing a smoky atmosphere. All cooking equipment must be under the hood.

headline: Dusty cooler condenser; loose sink
summary: Dust had built up on the six-door prep cooler condenser under the grill and must be cleaned. The three-compartment sink in the dish area is loose from the wall and must be reattached.

headline: Missing floor grout; burned-out hood light
summary: Missing grout in the rear prep floor near the deep fryer must be repaired for a smooth, cleanable surface. A burned-out light bulb in the deep fryer hood must be replaced.

headline: Milk crates used for elevation; provide shelving
summary: Milk crates were used to elevate items in the kitchen, dishwashing, and dry storage areas. They must be replaced with appropriate shelving, and food must be stored six inches from the wall.

headline: Re-inspection: floors, lighting, training records
summary: An opening in a dining-area storage closet floor needs sealing. Floors in walk-in coolers, the vent closet, and under cooking equipment need cleaning. The dining-area walk-in cooler has no light. New employees lacked food handler certificates.

headline: Menu lacks raw-food advisory; expired certificate
summary: The menu lacked the consumer advisory and reminder about raw or undercooked foods; paper and digital menus must include it. Cutting boards were stored on the floor, and a food handler had an expired certificate.

headline: Dry storage floors need cleaning
summary: Floors in the dry storage room needed debris removed along wall bases and in corners. The facility was instructed to clean them.

headline: No freezer and no vomit cleanup kit
summary: No freezer was on site for frozen foods; one must be provided and kept at 0°F. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was present. Also: a missing handwash sign, toilet-sink leak, dirty reach-in coolers, and gaps in walls and floors.

headline: No handwash sink; unsafe foods discarded
summary: No handwashing sink was in the rear prep and dishwashing area. Cooked chicken at 49.8°F and two raw chickens at 110–115°F were discarded (about 36 lbs, $120). Prepared foods lacked date labels; about 50 lbs ($130) was discarded.

headline: Unsafe food temperatures led to large discards
summary: Fried chicken wings (98–107°F) and leg quarters (68–70°F) were held at room temperature; about 350 lbs ($650) was discarded. Cold foods at 46.7–55°F, including fish, led to about 1,850 lbs ($3,750) being discarded. A handwash sink was blocked.

headline: Shelves, containers, and coolers need cleaning
summary: Plastic storage shelves in the walk-in cooler, bulk container exteriors, and reach-in cooler interiors need cleaning to remove spills or debris. A leak at the three-compartment sink faucet must be repaired.

headline: Ice machine slime; prep cooler tagged
summary: A black slimy substance was on interior ice-maker parts and dripped into ice used for people to consume; the machine must be shut off and cleaned. Citation issued. A four-door prep cooler at 47°F is tagged and may not be used until repaired.

headline: No health policy; door gaps and leaking drains
summary: No written employee health policy was on the premises; a signed policy for each employee is required. Gaps at the bottom of front entrance doors need sealing. Drain pipes leak under the kitchen and bar three-compartment sinks.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; dairy discarded
summary: Sixty pounds of milk and creamer at 54.4°F were discarded (valued at $60). Walk-in cooler air measured 52.4°F. The cooler is tagged out until the Chicago Department of Public Health approves tag removal.

headline: Toilet door and wall holes need fixing
summary: The unisex toilet room door is not self-closing and needs a self-closing device. Holes in the wall above an HVAC vent and above the ovens must be sealed.

headline: Re-inspection: greasy fryer unit; dirty floors
summary: Grease and food debris had built up inside the deep fryer oil-filtering unit. Debris was on the bottom of the three-door prep cooler and on floors in utility and storage areas. The facility was instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: No vomit-cleanup procedure or kit
summary: No written procedure or supplies existed for vomit and diarrhea cleanup. Minimum needs include gloves, face masks, disposable mops, and norovirus-effective sanitizer. Also: missing backflow device, covered waste receptacle, and cluttered storage.

headline: Handwash sink obstructed; dish machine unsanitized
summary: A cook-line handwashing sink was blocked and used to store utensils; the person in charge cleared it on site. A low-temperature dish machine in the bar had 0 ppm chlorine and is tagged out. Also: sausage covered with plastic wrap while cooling.

headline: Food on floor; utensils and stoppers improper
summary: Food was stored on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised 6 inches. Multi-use utensils were not stored upside down. Plastic wrap was used as stoppers for the three-compartment sink; proper stoppers are required.

headline: No health policy or training; citation issued
summary: No signed employee health policy, food handler training, or allergen training was on site. The menu still lacked a raw or undercooked food advisory; citation issued. A gap under the front entry door needs sealing against rodents.

headline: Broken ice maker; no food handler certificate
summary: Broken ice maker equipment on the floor near the front entrance must be removed. The exhaust hood above the ovens needs detail cleaning. A food handler lacked a certificate; proof of training is required for all food handlers.

headline: Re-inspection: dishes not inverted; cleaning needed
summary: Plates, pans, and bowls in the main prep area were not inverted after sanitizing and air drying. Interiors of cold-holding units, freezers, ovens, and deep fryers need detail cleaning. Floors, walls, and grease traps also need cleaning.

headline: Gasket, grease, and ice repairs ordered
summary: A damaged gasket on a small cold-holding unit near the front prep entrance must be repaired or replaced. Grease on the fryer cabinet beside the flat-top grill and ice buildup at the walk-in freezer door must be removed.

headline: Seafood held too warm; shellfish tag missing
summary: Oysters, fish, squid, and shrimp were held at 54–55°F; the manager voluntarily discarded them. An oyster container lacked its required shellstock tag. Cooked beans and marinated tongue lacked date marks. The certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Uncovered meat; crate shelving; expired training
summary: Uncovered meat was in the rear chest freezer, and crates were used as shelving in prep, storage, and sales areas. Also noted: grooved cutting boards, food spills on coolers, dusty vents, missing stairway tiles, and expired food handler training.

headline: No certified food manager during food prep
summary: No valid city-certified food manager was on site while fish, soup, and sliced tomatoes were being prepared; citation issued. An outside trash receptacle lacked a tight-fitting lid, and dried food debris covered shelves, prep areas, and floors.

headline: Mouse infestation persists; 150+ droppings
summary: Still an infestation: about 150 or more mouse droppings were found, including in the liquor area, rear hallway, an unused walk-in cooler, rear prep, and basement. Areas must be cleaned and sanitized; a pest control operator must service the premises.

headline: Door gap, leaking faucet, floor storage
summary: The rear exterior door has a half-inch gap at the bottom and must be made tight-fitting. A prep cooler had spills and debris, the three-compartment faucet leaks, and front counter items must be kept 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Dirty floors, drains, and walls
summary: Floor drains, floor corners, areas under storage racks and heavy equipment, and sinks were dirty. Walls around sinks, coolers, and cooking equipment had food, stains, and dirt. Instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Toilet ceiling mold; dusty fans; storage clutter
summary: Dust had built up on walk-in cooler fans. The customer toilet room lacked a covered receptacle and had a stained, molding ceiling tile. An open wall under an employee sink needed repair, and rear storage was cluttered and dirty.

headline: No certified manager; vacuum packing halted
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while TCS (time/temperature-controlled) foods were prepared and served. Vacuum packing was stopped; about 8 lbs of pastrami and turkey were tagged and held. Some handwash sinks lacked soap and paper towels.

headline: Bed behind counter; missing training certificates
summary: A roll-away bed behind the front counter must be removed; sleeping quarters must be separate from the restaurant. A food handler lacked a certificate, and the certified food manager (CFM) lacked allergen training. Also: cluttered storage.

headline: No city-certified manager on duty
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager was on duty. Managers held ServSafe certificates from 2023, but a City of Chicago certificate is required; citation issued. Also: an incomplete vomit and diarrhea kit, a dripping sink, and dirty floors and drains.

headline: Torn cooler door gasket to replace
summary: The two-door prep cooler under the meat counter has a torn door gasket that must be replaced.

headline: Handwash sink blocked; food stored on floor
summary: A handwashing sink near the dish area was blocked with lids and must be cleared; citation issued. Carrots, eggs, and sauce were stored on the walk-in cooler floor. Also: missing sink stoppers, unlabeled seasonings, greasy hood vents, and a ceiling hole.

headline: No employee health policy or training on site
summary: No employee health policy or training was on site. The facility must set up a health policy and training system and keep verifiable documents on site. Priority violation.

headline: Re-inspection: floor storage; personal items
summary: Cases of drinks and other food were stored on the rear office floor and must be raised 6 inches. Cardboard lined the area under the drink syrup holder. Personal items and bags hung on dry storage shelves beside food.

headline: Dish machine lacks sanitizer; tagged out
summary: The low-temperature dish machine in the bar has no chemical sanitizer and may not be used until repaired. No chlorine test kit was on site. Also missing: vomit-cleanup disinfectant effective against norovirus, bar handwash signs, and a recycling dumpster lid.

headline: No certified manager; freezers left unlocked
summary: The person in charge lacked a city sanitation certificate, and none was on site while food was prepared; citation issued. Unlocked freezers held frozen empanadas in a hallway accessible to customers. No current pest control report was available.

headline: Missing food handler training certificates
summary: Employees lacked food handler training certificates; the manager must provide proof and require training within 30 days for new hires. Also: unlabeled containers, rusty meat-cooler racks, greasy handsinks and shelves, and an uncovered employee trash can.

headline: No thermometer in walk-in; multiple repairs needed
summary: The walk-in cooler lacked a working thermometer. Also noted: unlabeled containers, wiping cloths on prep tables, a broken freezer gasket, duct tape repairs, plastic grocery bags used as food containers, rusty shelving, and a leaking faucet.

headline: Re-inspection: floors and repairs needed
summary: Loose baseboard tiles and a broken area under the bakery counter need repair. Floors under and around the ice machine, by the mop sink, and by the three-compartment sink need cleaning. An additional food handler certificate is required.

headline: Leaky faucet, mold-like buildup, training proof missing
summary: A three-compartment sink faucet leaked. Rust and a black mold-like substance were found on the ceiling and caulking above that sink. Proof of allergen training was missing for multiple employees holding city sanitation certificates.

headline: Walk-in floor regrouting; dirty floor drains
summary: This suspected food poisoning inspection noted only facility upkeep: walk-in cooler floors need regrouting, and floor drains held dirt, food, and debris.

headline: Raw meat above produce; flies; warm food
summary: Raw meat was stored above and near produce and ready-to-eat foods; the manager moved it. Several foods held at 47–60°F were discarded (about $200). A cooler at 54°F is tagged. More than 15 small flies were found throughout the facility.

headline: Pickled and canned goods tagged; no HACCP plan
summary: No HACCP (food-safety control) plan or variance (state approval) was on site for pickling, canning, acidifying, or fermenting. About 4,004 lbs ($35,000) of product was tagged and must not be sold or eaten. Citation issued.

headline: No city-certified manager during food service
summary: The person in charge lacked a City of Chicago food manager certificate, and no certified manager was on site while rice, steak, and chicken were prepared and served; citation issued. Also: serving trays stored face-up and damaged freezer gaskets.

headline: Prep cooler gaskets need cleaning
summary: Gaskets on the flip-top prep cooler need cleaning. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain them. No other issues were listed.

headline: No health policy; no dish-area handwash sink
summary: No written employee health policies were on site. No handwashing sink was available in the dish area; one must be provided with hot and cold water, soap, and paper towels. Also: more cooler thermometers, a self-closing restroom door, and manager allergen training.

headline: No certified manager; no food handler records
summary: The person in charge lacked a valid city sanitation certificate while chicken was prepared and served; citation issued. No written vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or kit was on site, and food handler training proof was missing.

headline: Dish machine lacks temperature gauge
summary: The high-temperature dish machine has no temperature measuring device; one must be obtained. The employee restroom door also lacks a self-closing device.

headline: No current pest control reports; no thermometers
summary: The pest control logbook's last report is from January 2024; no current reports were available, so a citation was issued. The reach-in refrigerator and freezer lacked air thermometers. Also: unneeded equipment and a dirty washroom exhaust vent.

headline: Handwash signs missing; corrected on site
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at exposed sinks and in the washroom; they were corrected on site. Also noted: no thermometers in refrigeration units, unlabeled seasoning and flour containers, and a washroom door without a self-closing device.

headline: Milk too warm; repeat violations found
summary: Milk held at 52°F was discarded (valued at $3). Previous violations were not corrected: food on the walk-in freezer floor, foil around a grease trap, and debris. Also: cardboard shelving, a scratched cutting board, a leaking faucet.

headline: Chicken too warm; about 60 lbs discarded
summary: Chicken in the prep cooler measured 48.1–52.1°F; about 60 lbs ($200) was discarded. No sanitizer test devices were on site. A certified manager lacked allergen training. The inspection summary was not posted for public view.

headline: No employee health policy; cold foods too warm
summary: No written employee health policy was on the premises. Eggs at 47°F and cheese at 48–50°F were in the two-door prep cooler; cold foods must be kept at 41°F or below. The certified food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Cleaning, leak repair, and lighting needed
summary: Stoves, fryers, prep tables, a chest freezer, and walk-in racks need cleaning. Also required: fixing a 3-compartment sink leak, repainting chipped and unpainted walls, cleaning dish-area walls, and adding light inside the walk-in cooler.

headline: Door gap; unlabeled bulk bins; dirty fryers
summary: Large bulk ingredient containers were unlabeled. The rear exit door has a half-inch gap underneath. Also: an improperly stored ice scoop, scratched cutting boards, a black substance in the ice machine, greasy fryers, and a leaking rear hand sink.

headline: Expired training certificates; damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Preset knives and forks on dining tables were exposed and must be covered, wrapped, inverted, or cleaned before reuse. Basement washrooms lacked covered receptacles. Also: missing grout, damaged ceiling tiles, and expired food handler and allergen training.

headline: Prep cooler too warm; cold foods unsafe
summary: Chicken measured 46°F, hummus 45°F, roasted corn 46°F, and black beans 59°F in the two-door prep cooler, whose air reached 46°F. Cold foods must stay at 41°F or below. The cooler must be repaired; the bar sink needs cleaning.

headline: Scratched boards; two managers lack allergen training
summary: Multiple cutting boards in the rear prep area were deeply scratched and stained. Food debris and grease were behind cooking equipment in the front prep area. Basement storage had clutter and items on the floor. Two certified managers lacked allergen certificates.

headline: About 30 rat droppings; more pest service needed
summary: About 30 rat droppings were on the floor of a cluttered basement storage room and behind chest freezers. Additional pest control service is needed; citation issued. Also: no cheese cooler thermometer and missing sink stoppers.

headline: Menu says lamb; beef used in samosas
summary: The menu described keema samosa as lamb and peas, but the person in charge said beef is used. The menu must list the correct ingredients. Also: unlabeled bulk seasoning, cups used as sink stoppers, and a deeply cut cutting board.

headline: Certified manager absent; corrected on site
summary: No City of Chicago certified manager was on premises; this was corrected on site when one arrived at 11:05 a.m. Citation issued. Also: black moldlike substance inside the ice machine, an exit door opening, and a leaking three-compartment sink.

headline: Rusty deli cooler racks need cleaning
summary: Racks in the deli walk-in cooler had rust and debris buildup. The facility was instructed to clean and repaint or replace them.

headline: No pest service records; no food handler training
summary: No pest control receipt, logbook, or contract was available. No proof of employee health policy, cleanup kit, soap, or hand drying was found at sinks, and a restroom sink had no hot water. No food handler training records were shown.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving throughout prep and storage areas. The manager must remove them and provide shelving at least 6 inches off the floor, with floor access for cleaning.

headline: Vomit cleanup supplies missing; repairs needed
summary: Items needed to clean up vomiting and diarrhea were not on site; priority violation. Also: a gap at the front door base, no backflow device at the utility sink, a dirt-and-rock dumpster surface, washroom wall holes, and greasy hood filters.

headline: Food on floors; 2023 repeat violation not fixed
summary: Boxes, onions, and canned goods were stored on floors in the walk-in freezer, walk-in cooler, and basement. A broken pizza cooler lid from 2023 remains uncorrected; citation issued. Also: greasy stove and fryers, and expired allergen training.

headline: Rust under prep table; allergen training missing
summary: Plastic lining covers rust on a prep table's bottom shelf; remove it and make the surface smooth. Also: missing covered toilet-room receptacle, toilet door not self-closing, cluttered storage closet, and certified managers lacking allergen training.

headline: Unsafe food temps and live flies found
summary: About 35 small live black flies were in seating and storage areas, the employee restroom, and near beverage nozzles. Cold foods held at 49–72°F, including macaroni salad and sliced watermelon, were discarded. Pest control service is required.

headline: Mouse droppings, live cat, and low hot-food temps
summary: Over 30 mouse droppings were near a chip display, and a live cat was in basement dry storage. Tamales (98.8–113.8°F) and carnitas (114.6–118°F) were below the required 135°F; the manager was told to discard them.

headline: Handwashing lapses and no sanitizer detected
summary: A worker touched cheese, then placed it on cooked steak without washing hands. Another handled ready-to-eat sandwiches with the same gloves. Sanitizer measured 0.0 ppm (parts per million), and hand sinks lacked hand-drying devices.

headline: Re-inspection: leaks and expired allergen training
summary: An opening at the rear exit door must be sealed. Sinks have leaking faucets and a sprayer, and the outside grease container is greasy. A stove burner sits outside the vent hood. Allergen training was missing or expired.

headline: No backflow device; repeat violations not fixed
summary: The utility sink in the rear warewashing area lacks a backflow prevention device. Repeat violations were not fixed: rust on refrigerator shelves and missing manager allergen training; citation issued. Also: basement clutter and dirty floors.

headline: Broken gaskets; milk crates; expired training
summary: A broken gasket in two-door reach-in coolers must be repaired. Milk crates may not be used to elevate stored items. The floor under the handwash sink must stay dry, and the pump storage room floor needs cleaning. Allergen certificates were expired.

headline: No food handler certificates on premises
summary: No food handler certificates were on premises; all food handlers must be certified and named. Also: a pitted cutting board to replace, excessive ice in the rear walk-in freezer, and no covered trash receptacle in the washroom.

headline: Unlabeled bulk foods; floor storage found
summary: Bulk sugar, salt, and spices lacked labels. Boxed food and single-use items were stored on the floor in the rear prep area. Cutting boards were deeply scratched, cooler interiors had food debris, and floors and walls were dirty.

headline: Dirty, standing water at grease container
summary: Heavy dirt and standing water covered the ground around and under the outside grease container. The manager was instructed to detail clean and maintain the area.

headline: No soap; repeat training violations found
summary: No soap at the dishwasher's hand sink; citation issued. Also: serving plates not inverted, torn gaskets, cardboard shelf liners, and wall-base holes. Repeat violations not fixed: missing food handler and allergen training certificates.

headline: Missing handwashing signs in restrooms
summary: Restrooms were missing handwashing signs. The facility was instructed to post them.

headline: No certified food manager while food served
summary: No certified food service manager was on site, and no certificate was posted, while chicken and beef were handled and served. The manager was instructed to obtain one. Brooms hung too close to the clean utensil rack; a barrier must be installed.

headline: Uncovered fries; greasy fryers; splattered walls
summary: Boiled French fries were left uncovered at the rear and must be covered when unattended. One food handler lacked a hair restraint. Soap dispenser covers need repair. Fryer interiors were greasy, and walls and floors had liquid splatters.

headline: Debris on prep area floors
summary: Dirt and debris were on the floors in various areas of the food prep area. The facility was instructed to clean and sanitize them.

headline: Bare-hand bread handling; milk too warm
summary: A worker sliced and bagged bread while touching it with bare hands. Produce boxes blocked a handwash sink. Milk at 52.4°F was discarded; the coffee-station cooler at 52.5°F is tagged out until repaired.

headline: 100+ rat droppings and dead mouse found
summary: About 100 or more rat droppings were on the first-floor warehouse floor, and a dead mouse was present. An opening under the garbage-area door needs rodent-proofing. Self-service cooler items lacked labels; cutting boards were cut and discolored.

headline: Cardboard shelving; worn freezer gasket
summary: Cardboard was used as shelving in the walk-in cooler, freezer, and under prep tables and must be replaced with smooth, cleanable shelving. The walk-in freezer has a worn gasket. Dust and food debris lined walls behind the three-compartment sink.

headline: Peeling paint and worn walk-in door
summary: Paint is peeling on the kitchen doorway and a rear dish room windowsill. The wooden walk-in cooler door is in poor repair. Repairs to a smooth, easy-to-clean surface were ordered.

headline: Roaches, cat waste, and blocked handwash sink
summary: Dead roaches and possible roach eggs were in the prep area. Cat food and cat litter filled with feces were found on site; live animals are not allowed where food is prepared. A handwash sink was blocked by pots.

headline: Cold display foods too warm; 44 lbs discarded
summary: Open cold display foods ranged from 48.7–56.7°F, including turkey bologna, milk, yogurt, and cut watermelon; about 44 lbs ($192) was discarded. The display unit, at 58.6°F, is tagged 'held for inspection.' Citation issued.

headline: Hand sink lacked paper towels; slicer dirty
summary: No paper towels were at the pizza-station hand sink. Also: a food handler without a hair restraint, no cover on the bar ice bin, a dirty meat slicer, no high-temperature dish machine temperature indicator, and a dusty walk-in fan cover.

headline: Re-inspection: unlabeled containers; ceiling tiles
summary: Food containers not in original packaging must be labeled. Water-damaged ceiling tiles above rear prep tables need repair. Dirt and debris under food storage shelving and inside walk-in coolers must be cleaned.

headline: Oversized pots can't be washed; repeat violations
summary: Oversized pots cannot be submerged in the three-compartment sink; they must be removed, a larger sink provided, or an approved written cleaning procedure supplied. Repeat violations were not fixed, including unlabeled bulk containers; citation issued.

headline: No hot water at three-compartment sink
summary: No hot water at the three-compartment sink; must be provided at all times; citation issued. Brownish substance inside the ice machine must be cleaned. Floors have excessive dirt and grease under cooking equipment, and dust and dirt inside dry storage closets.

headline: No certified manager on site; missing stopper
summary: No certified food manager with the original certificate on site while open; citation issued. Cold holding units with TCS foods lack ambient air thermometers. Food handler without hair restraint, missing sink stopper, no covered restroom receptacle, and debris under the floor mat.

headline: No certified manager; blocked handsink; no soap
summary: No certified manager certificate posted while TCS foods were served; citation issued. Prep handsink was blocked by a strainer and food stand, removed during inspection. No soap at serving-line sink, no handwash sign, no employee health policies, and no food handler training.

headline: Handwashing lapses; flies and rat droppings
summary: Food handler touched the coffee machine spout with a wipe without washing hands; citation issued. About 25 or more small flies found, and over 40 rat droppings in dry storage; pest control recommended. Also no hand dryer, hot water at 92.3°F, and no shellfish tag records.

headline: Openings at entry doors; rust and foil on shelves
summary: Openings in the middle of the front entrance double doors must be sealed to prevent pests. Aluminum foil on a prep table shelf and rust on shelving near the coffee station. Drain lines from fountain and beer dispenser drain into the bar handwash sinks; must be relocated.

headline: Over 20 rat droppings; citation issued
summary: Over 20 rat droppings on the floor in rear storage; manager told to call an exterminator and clean. Burrows and openings found outside. Also no handwashing signs, food handlers without hair restraints, and grease and debris buildup on equipment.

headline: Missing floor tiles under prep equipment
summary: Missing floor tiles and broken cement under equipment in the prep area. Surface must be smooth, cleanable, and non-absorbent.

headline: No certified manager; raw meats at 52°F
summary: No certified food service manager or sanitation certificate posted while TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. Raw burgers and chicken in the basement walk-in held at 49.9-52.7°F; about 90 lbs ($316) discarded; citation issued. Also no handwash signs and no covered toilet room receptacle.

headline: No certified manager; no health policies
summary: No certified food manager on duty during TCS food prep; citation issued. No signed employee health policies. No soap at toilet room hand sink; employee supplied soap during inspection. Also food debris, debris on floors and drains, and no food handler training.

headline: Cold foods above 41°F; 46 lbs discarded
summary: Cold TCS foods held at 46.2-52.0°F, above the 41°F limit; corrected on site, and manager discarded 46 lbs ($675). Two-drawer cooler under grill at 53.4°F was tagged and held. Openings at outer doors, boxes and pans on floor, and an exposed ice bin.

headline: Grease, debris, and dust throughout
summary: Soiled wiping cloths stored on prep tables; single-service items not inverted or stored on the floor. Milk crates used as shelving. Grease, food debris, and dirt on floors under equipment and in corners. Dust on fans and vents, and a mold-like wall in the basement.

headline: Plates, pots, and pans not inverted
summary: Exposed plates, pots, and pans were not inverted after sanitizing and air drying. Staff were told to invert them after sanitizing and air drying.

headline: No health policy; no food handler certificates
summary: No employee health policy on site; citation issued. Employees worked without food handler certificates. Hand sink in the kitchen prep area was not accessible. Food containers on the walk-in floor, unlabeled bulk food, dirty wiping cloths, and knives stored improperly.

headline: No certified manager; no food handler certificates
summary: No person in charge with a valid sanitation certificate; no certified manager on duty while chicken and pizza were prepared; citation issued. No food handler certificates on site. Food handler without a hair restraint; no covered receptacle for sanitary products.

headline: Missing cold water handle; no restroom receptacle
summary: Missing cold water handle on the women's restroom handsink must be replaced. No covered receptacle in the women's restroom. Food and liquid spills on the floor near coffee and ice machines, and a missing ceiling tile.

headline: No current pest report; missing sink stoppers
summary: Pest control logbook lacks an up-to-date service report for the current year; citation issued. Facility missing two sink stoppers for the three-compartment sink and no handwash sign. Spills, debris, and trash on floors and in microwaves.

headline: Cold foods too warm; about 60 lbs discarded
summary: Refrigerated TCS foods were too warm: Philly steak at 56.6°F, cabbage and carrots at 67.1°F, chicken at 98.4°F. Manager discarded about 60 lbs ($600); citation issued. Two-door cooler ambient air at 69.7°F; must not be used until reinspected.

headline: No covered waste bins in washrooms
summary: Unisex washrooms had no covered waste receptacles. Facility must provide and maintain covered receptacles.

headline: No hot water at hand sinks; expired test kit
summary: No hot running water at hand sinks or the three-compartment sink; hot water was restored during the inspection at 12:25 PM. Citation issued. Wet, expired sanitizer test kit; wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer; stained ceiling tile.

headline: Clean food prep walls and ceiling tiles
summary: Walls of the food prep area must be cleaned, and stained ceiling tiles in the food prep area must also be cleaned.

headline: Candy on floor; ice machine residue; citation issued
summary: Candy stored on the floor behind the front counter; residue inside the ice machine; grease and debris on cooking equipment. No backflow device on utility sink. Missing hand-washing sign, sink stoppers, and drainboard; wall and ceiling openings. Citation issued.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; heavy hood grease
summary: Torn rubber gasket inside the prep service cooler drawer must be repaired or replaced. Heavy dirt and grease on the exhaust hood, filters, and pipes must be cleaned. Slow drain with dirt at kitchen floor drains. Missing light shield in rear prep.

headline: No food handler training proof; cardboard liner
summary: No proof of food handler training for any food handler; must be provided. Ice scoop stored inside the ice bin. No ambient air thermometer in the front display cooler. Cardboard used as liner on dish area floor; wiping cloths and sour cream and mayonnaise containers unlabeled.

headline: Walk-in cooler at 66.2°F; prep cooler tagged
summary: Walk-in cooler at 66.2°F, above the 41°F limit; manager must repair it. Prep cooler is tagged and held and must not be used until reinspected by the health department. No citation issued. A food handler lacked a hair restraint.

headline: Dirty dispensers, drain, and restroom
summary: Creamer and sugar dispenser nozzles need detail cleaning to remove buildup. Floor drain and grease trap need cleaning. Toilet room needs detail cleaning. Floors throughout need cleaning to remove food spills and debris.

headline: Cool handsinks; cold foods discarded
summary: Handwash sinks at 78.8-81.1°F; must be at least 100°F; citation issued. Cold TCS foods in the salad line cooler measured 49.5-60.1°F; about 40 lbs ($800) discarded. Cooler air at 35.7°F. Rusted racks, mold stains above the dish sink, dim cooler lighting, and an expired allergen certificate.

headline: Dirty meat cooler; no thermometer in cooler
summary: Excessive dried food debris inside meat display cooler slides and prep table shelves must be cleaned. Clutter around the garbage area must be cleared to prevent pests. Water-stained ceiling tiles, inadequate prep lighting, and no thermometer in the hot dog cooler.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; leaking unused pipe
summary: Bulk dry food containers on the rear storage shelf are not labeled with the common name. Clean equipment stored under a dehumidifier risks contamination. Unused soda pipe leaking into a bucket must be repaired or removed.

headline: No hot water at hand sink; citation issued
summary: Hand sink had no hot running water because the hot water was turned off; citation issued. Also a leaking hand sink faucet and pipe under the three-compartment sink, cracked floor tiles, dirty floors, and damaged cutting boards.

headline: Floors need cleaning under equipment
summary: Floors along wall bases and under equipment in the dish and prep areas need cleaning and maintenance.

headline: Food debris on prep floors; dirty drains
summary: Food debris on floors throughout the prep area. Floor drains underneath the three-compartment sink in the rear warewashing area are dirty. Person in charge told to detail clean floors and drains.

headline: Damaged cutting boards; food in grocery bags
summary: Two discolored cutting boards with deep cuts in the front prep area must be replaced. Assorted food items were stored in grocery bags inside coolers, freezers, and refrigerators; must use approved food-grade containers or bags.

headline: Open sticky fly trap; grease and gasket cleaning
summary: Open sticky fly trap found in rear hallway; person in charge told to request an insect control device from a licensed technician. Also debris at ice machine door, microwave residue, fryer cabinet grease, dirty prep cooler gaskets, and ceramic cups needing lead-free documentation.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Multiple food handlers have expired food handler certificates, and the certified food service manager has an expired allergen certificate. Boxed food was stored on the floor near the rear exit and must be raised six inches. Foil lining shelves and grease on floors behind cooking equipment.

headline: Ice machine buildup; leaking handsink pipe
summary: Pink buildup inside the upper ice machine must be cleaned. Food spills on shelves and sink exteriors. Rear prep handsink pipe leaking and must be repaired. Bar floor littered behind coolers, and rear prep area floors and walls need cleaning.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: Certified food manager has no food allergen training. Also rusted racks in bar coolers, a large kettle needing a written clean-in-place procedure, and no covered receptacle in the women's restroom.

headline: Missing raw-food advisory; reused containers
summary: Menus lacked the consumer advisory for undercooked or raw breakfast items; manager instructed to add it. Also a brownish substance on the ice machine, wiping cloths not kept in sanitizer, reused single-use containers, food debris, and food stored on the floor.

headline: No handwashing sign at prep sink
summary: No handwashing sign at the hand sink in the prep area. Manager instructed to provide one.

headline: Hair restraint missing; dirty coolers and floors
summary: Food handler not wearing a hair restraint. Can opener had food and dirt buildup. A walk-in cooler rack is missing a leg, and bathroom caulk is cracking. Coolers and floors need cleaning, the three-compartment sink faucet leaks, and cardboard is used as a trash can.

headline: Ice scoop on machine; greasy fryers; expired certificate
summary: Ice scoop stored on top of the ice machine; must be washed, rinsed, sanitized, and stored handle-up or in a clean bin. Deep fryers have grease and dirt inside and must be cleaned. Allergen certificate expired; manager must provide a current one.

headline: Leak under three-compartment sink
summary: A leak under the rinse basin of the three-compartment sink must be repaired and maintained.

headline: No food handler certificate; worn gaskets
summary: No food handler certificate was presented for review. Gaskets on the small prep cooler door are in poor repair and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Spills in cold hold units; filters need cleaning
summary: Spillage and buildup inside all cold hold units must be cleaned. Excessive buildup on hood filters must also be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Door gaps; plates not inverted; mops not drying
summary: About 1/4-inch gap along the front entrance and rear exit doors; a tight-fitting seal is required to prevent pests. Plates, pots, and pans throughout were not inverted after sanitizing. Mops must be stored in a mounted position to air-dry and avoid pest harborage.

headline: Unnecessary items stored in basement
summary: Unnecessary restaurant equipment stored in the basement. Unneeded items must be removed, and remaining items stored at least 6 inches off the ground and away from walls for cleaning and pest control.

headline: Door gaps; damaged cooler doors; no bar prep sink
summary: Opening at base of front entrance and basement doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Damaged ice machine lid gaskets and exposed insulation in a cold holding unit. No prep or dump sink in the bar. Dusty hood and ceiling vent.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; cold holding failures
summary: Black slime inside ice machine used for raw sushimi; citation issued. Prep coolers held chicken, fish, and hamburgers at 45-46.8°F, above the 41°F limit; about 15 lbs ($105) discarded. Two coolers tagged and held. Only one certified manager has allergen training.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; no washroom fan
summary: Ripped rubber door gaskets on the 4-door prep reach-in cooler must be repaired. Employee washroom has no working mechanical ventilation or fan; manager must provide one.

headline: No employee health policy; door not rodent-proof
summary: No verifiable employee health policy on site; template left and manager instructed. Front exit door not rodent-proof; a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom must be sealed. Washroom door not self-closing. Soiled mop heads not hung to dry.

headline: Worn cutting boards; crates; loose flooring
summary: Worn and discolored cutting boards must be repaired or replaced. Crates used for food storage in the walk-in cooler and freezer must be removed. Debris on the ice machine, bar cabinet, and fryer bases. Loose flooring in the walk-in cooler and a cracked light shield.

headline: No signed employee health policies
summary: No signed employee health policies were on the premises. Management must provide and maintain them. Priority foundation violation.

headline: Hand sinks too cool; no pest service records
summary: No valid sanitation manager certificate posted; citation issued. Handwash sinks at 78-81°F, but at least 100°F is required; citation issued. No current pest control logbook or reports; citation issued. Also no vomit cleanup procedure, no test kit, and no food handler training proof.

headline: Missing handwash signs; no allergen certificates
summary: No handwashing signs in customer restrooms. Certified food managers lack allergen training certificates. Lower surfaces of prep tables are rusted, the three-compartment sink faucet leaks, and mops are stored in buckets instead of hung to dry.

headline: Expired-date TCS foods discarded; citation issued
summary: Cut avocado, cooked chicken, sliced tomatoes, and other TCS foods past their discard date (03/25/25) were in the deli cooler. Manager discarded about 10 lbs ($33); citation issued. Also no handwash sign, a deeply cut cutting board, and greasy floor under a sink.

headline: Dead roaches in storage; rusted racks
summary: Dead cockroaches found in rear storage; must be removed and the area cleaned and sanitized. Rusted storage racks in the reach-in cooler must be made smooth and cleanable. Loose debris, dirt, and dust on floors throughout; cleaning frequency must increase.

headline: No hot water at hand sink; citation issued
summary: Rear hand sink had no hot water (57.4°F); manager told to provide 100-120°F water, citation issued. Also a leak under the ice machine, grease and food debris on equipment, low water pressure, a leaking drain, a missing waste lid, and soiled floors.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit cleanup supplies
summary: Food handlers prepared TCS foods without a certified manager certificate on site; citation issued. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup supplies were on site. Also black milk crates, scrap materials in storage, and no food employee with allergen training.

headline: Leaking sink pipe; food handler lacks training
summary: Excessive leak at the bottom pipe of the first sink compartment must be repaired. Hole in rear wall caused by an exterior door handle. Food handler without training certificate; certified manager's allergen certificate has expired.

headline: Unlabeled containers; no food handler certificates
summary: Food items out of original containers lacked name labels. No food handler certificates were on site. Food service sanitation manager lacks an allergen training certificate. Soiled mop heads were not hung to dry.

headline: Live flies found; handsink was blocked
summary: About 15 live small flies on walls and ceilings in coffee prep and dining areas; more pest control needed, citation issued. Front handsink was blocked by stored soiled utensils, which the manager removed. Also rust, torn gaskets, a leak, and a 1/4-inch door gap.

headline: Sink stoppers missing; food kept in plastic bags
summary: Three-compartment sink stoppers are missing and a hot water faucet handle is broken. Food is kept in plastic grocery bags and unlabeled containers. Sanitation manager lacks a posted allergen certificate. Repeat: no splash guard by handwash sink; citation issued.

headline: Soda stored on floor; walk-in cooler has no lights
summary: Soda pop stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and rear area; must be raised at least six inches. Also no self-closing employee washroom door, old and broken items, and no lights in the walk-in cooler.

headline: Corners and floors need cleaning
summary: Floors in corner areas, and around and behind equipment, must be cleaned where needed.

headline: Doors not rodent-proof; no handwash sign
summary: Front and rear doors are not rodent-proof and must be made so to prevent pest entry. No handwashing sign at washbowl. Slow-draining toilet room sink, carpet throughout the facility, and wall openings near the rear exit and mop sink.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm sanitizer; repeat violations
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine; machine tagged and held, citation issued. Repeat violations: only one food handler certificate on site, and one of three certified managers lacks allergen training. Also torn gaskets, stained cutting boards, and grime on the dish machine.

headline: Hair restraints missing; expired food handler certificates
summary: Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints; wet wiping cloths were left on prep surfaces. Food handler certificates were expired and the certified manager lacks allergen training. Milk crates used as shelving; no hand-wash signs.

headline: Uncovered restroom receptacle; no allergen certificate
summary: Certified food manager lacks an allergen training certificate. Toilet room receptacle must have a cover. Large mixing bowl too big for the three-compartment sink requires a written washing procedure. Handwashing signage missing at prep and washroom sinks.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; fruit flies found
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine; machine tagged by the health department and cannot be used until reinspection. About 100 small fruit flies in dining, storage, and restroom areas; citation issued. Also a seeping toilet and grime in drains.

headline: About 60 rodent droppings; citation-level issue
summary: About 60 small rodent droppings in rear storage, prep, and grocery areas, including near glue traps. Manager told to clean and sanitize; activity must be eliminated. Also a missing thermometer, dirty display cooler, missing wall base, and no food handler certificates.

headline: Burned-out lights over dish sink; no restroom sign
summary: No handwashing sign in the basement men's restroom. Pink buildup inside the ice machine must be cleaned. Ceiling bulbs above the three-compartment sink are not working. Grease buildup on the hood. Expired food allergen certificate.

headline: No employee health policies; cold holding failures
summary: No signed employee health policies; citation issued. About 20 lbs of unlabeled cooked meats were stored in coolers and voluntarily discarded. Missing thermometer, duct-taped freezer equipment, and prior core violations for grease and floors not corrected.

headline: Slushy machine dirty; greasy fryer area
summary: Slushy machine was not clean and must be deep cleaned before use. Encrusted grease under and behind the fryers must be deep cleaned and sanitized. Broken ceiling tile above toilet and grease on floors under grease-collecting equipment.

headline: Holes in basement walls
summary: Holes in basement storage area walls on north and west sides. Holes must be sealed.

headline: Over 20 small flies throughout facility
summary: Over 20 small flies found throughout the facility, including the bar area, dry storage, and kitchen. Manager instructed to minimize small fly activity; priority foundation violation.

headline: Unused cups and clutter in basement
summary: Clutter and unused to-go cups and lids were stored on the basement storage floor. Manager must remove unused items to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Torn freezer gasket; soiled mop heads
summary: Torn rubber gasket on the rear prep freezer door must be repaired or replaced. A soiled mop head was not stored properly; manager told to hang mop heads to prevent insect breeding.

headline: No health policy; freezer at 72°F
summary: No written employee health policy on premises. Two-door freezer in rear prep is at 72°F and must be repaired. No utility sink with hot and cold water; no self-closing washroom door. No vomit cleanup supplies. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen training records
summary: No valid food handler certificates shown, and no allergen training on site. Also a torn cooler gasket, a deeply grooved and stained cutting board, heavy dirt in several coolers, and burned-out bulbs. Management told to fix.

headline: Raw chicken at 55.4°F; citation issued
summary: Raw chicken thighs in prep area at 55.4°F, above the safe limit; manager discarded 50 lbs ($80), citation issued. No valid certified manager on duty during TCS food prep. No soap at rear dish sink, provided during inspection. No food handler certificates; hole above mop sink.

headline: Mold-like substance inside walk-in cooler
summary: Walk-in cooler walls, ceiling, and shelving were not clean and had a mold-like substance; citation issued. Interior cooler surfaces must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Rat and mouse droppings in basement
summary: At least 50 rat droppings and 15 mouse droppings in the basement and near the cooler and sink; priority citation issued and pest control recommended before reinspection. Also a missing rear door sweep, large holes in the basement floor, and a missing exhaust filter.

headline: Unapproved-source cake discarded; citation issued
summary: Unlabeled chocolate cake slices from an unapproved source, with no invoice; about 9 lbs ($40) discarded, citation issued. Also no ambient air thermometers in holding units and water leaking through the handsink splash guard.

headline: No thermometers; boxed food on floor
summary: Hot holding equipment in the front service area had no thermometer. Boxed food was stored on the floor in the rear prep area and must be raised six inches. Also rust on refrigerator racks, a slow-draining sink, and a hole in the ceiling above piping.

headline: Rear exit door gap must be repaired
summary: Rear exit door near the basement stairwell has about a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom corner and is not protected. Must be repaired to be tight-fitting and properly protected.

headline: Cold foods too warm; about 375 lbs discarded
summary: Chicken and pork soup, pig feet, chicken thighs, cheese, rice, and about 70 eggs held above 41°F. Walk-in cooler measured 53.0°F and refrigerator 45.0°F; about 375 lbs ($618) discarded; citation issued. Debris on a window sill in the front prep area.

headline: No certified manager; no thermometers
summary: No certified food service manager on site, and no certificate posted, while hot TCS foods were handled; priority violation. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit and no food thermometer on site. Trash and damaged food containers in the three-compartment sink.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure; no three-compartment sink
summary: No procedure for vomit and diarrhea events on site; citation issued. Facility lacks a three-compartment sink and was cooking Italian beef and nachos; told to stop cooking until a sink is installed. No sanitizer test kit; a ceiling tile is missing.

headline: Over 30 mouse droppings; citation issued
summary: Over 30 mouse droppings on the floor under flower storage shelving and behind the fridge in the closet room. All droppings must be removed and affected areas cleaned and sanitized; citation issued. Minor pipe leak under the three-compartment sink.

headline: No certified manager posted; sink and surface problems
summary: Person in charge lacked proof of food safety training, and no city sanitation certificate was posted; citation issued. Also no splash guard at front handsink, a stained cutting board, leaks, a hole in a wall, and no proof of food handler training.

headline: Sink leak into bucket; items must be raised
summary: Leak under the three-compartment sink drains into a bucket; must be repaired. Basement stored items must be raised off the floor and unneeded items removed to prevent pest harborage. Also a missing ceiling tile and a missing light shield.

headline: Food handler training proof missing
summary: No food handler certificates or proof of food handler training shown for employees. Must provide for all employees.

headline: Dead roaches throughout; no certified manager
summary: Dead roaches found throughout the facility; must be removed and areas sanitized. No certified manager posted during TCS food prep; citation issued. Also a base cold-holding display that reads inaccurately, grease buildup, a ceiling leak, and a hole in a wall.

headline: Cutting boards, gaskets, and cleaning needed
summary: Reach-in coolers need thermometers, and bulk containers need labels. Wiping cloths and knives were stored in coolers. New cutting boards and cooler gaskets needed. Hot food equipment, drains, and hood vents need detail cleaning. Hot water handle hard to turn.

headline: Ice cream freezer utensils not fully submerged
summary: Utensils for the ice cream freezer were not fully submerged in running water between uses. Staff were told to keep them fully submerged in running water.

headline: Loose gasket; dim restroom light
summary: Loose gasket on the pizza topping cold hold unit must be repaired. Bottom interior of the two-door freezer needs cleaning. Women's restroom lighting is low and must be increased.

headline: Front door gap; no hot water in restroom
summary: A 1/2-inch gap between front entrance doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. No hot water at men's restroom sink. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, single-service items were stored on the floor, and display coolers and bakery areas need cleaning.

headline: About 10 live roaches; citation issued
summary: At least 10 live roaches on floors and inside hot-holding cabinets and counter units; pest control recommended, citation issued. Also food debris at an unused soda station, missing splash guard, leaking stopper, rust, grease, and no food handler training.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; no handwash signs
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or spill kit; citation issued. No handwashing signs at prep and bar sinks. Sinks, steam table, bar, and prep tables need cleaning, and prep area floors are not clean.

headline: Food handler without certificate
summary: One food handler lacked a food handler certificate. Management was told all food handlers must show proof of food handler training.

headline: Flies and rodent droppings; no certified manager
summary: About 50 live small flies and about 35 rodent droppings in prep and storage areas; pest control required, citation issued. Food handlers prepared TCS foods without a certified manager on site. Also no paper towels, no thermometers, and mold behind a sink.

headline: Food on walk-in freezer floor; milk crates
summary: Food containers were stored on the walk-in freezer floor and must be raised six inches. Milk crates were used as shelving, and bar cutting boards have open seams and stains. Missing floor tiles and exposed caulk need repair. Fans and vents are dusty. Short-form complaint passed.

headline: Hot holding unit thermometer missing; hood not working
summary: No thermometer was inside the hot holding unit at the front counter. The kitchen exhaust hood system is not working properly and must be repaired. Complaint inspection passed.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea supplies or procedure
summary: The facility had no adequate supplies or procedure on site for responding to vomiting or diarrhea events. Staff were instructed to provide them. License inspection passed.

headline: Pest logbook incomplete; allergen training missing
summary: The pest service receipt lacked the IDPH license number and certified technician verification. The pest logbook must be complete. Certified managers have no valid allergen training, a core violation from 2023 not yet corrected. Citation issued. Canvass failed.

headline: Walk-in soiled; ice buildup; trash can without lid
summary: Pots and empty containers were on the floor near the rear exit and must be elevated. Ice buildup in the walk-in and freezer was excessive. The unisex bathroom trash can has no lid. The walk-in floor was heavily soiled with spillage and food debris. Canvass passed.

headline: Mushroom and bone marrow held too warm
summary: Cooked mushroom at 52.2–54°F and bone marrow at 46–48°F were held in the front prep cold unit. The manager discarded 6 lbs (about $150). All cold TCS food must be held at 41°F or below. Citation issued. Canvass passed with conditions.

headline: Liquor on floors; heavily soiled basement
summary: Liquor and items were stored on the floor in the walk-in and basement and must be elevated. Milk crates, rusty shelving, and ice buildup in a basement freezer were noted. Floors, ceiling tiles and openings need repair and cleaning to prevent pest harborage. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; about 20 lbs discarded
summary: Chicken at 60.9°F, salsas near 50°F, chorizo and potatoes at 46.6°F, and jalapenos at 50.9°F were held too warm. All were discarded (about $100). Citation issued. A torn cooler gasket and greasy fryer exterior were also noted.

headline: No vomit kit; macaroni and cheese at 53°F
summary: No bodily fluid spill kit or clean-up procedure was on site; one must be developed and kept on site. Macaroni and cheese at 53.2°F was discarded (about $75).
