A torn cooler gasket and clutter under the 3-compartment sink were noted. Food truck license numbers are missing. Passed with conditions.

headline: No person in charge present; no certified manager
summary: No person in charge was present during inspection. No certified food manager with the original certificate was on duty while potatoes and chicken were prepared and served; a citation was issued. Employee food was stored with customer food. Canvass passed with conditions.

headline: Badly grooved cutting board must be replaced
summary: A cutting board on the restaurant side has deep grooves and dents and must be replaced to prevent cross-contamination. Food debris was found on the floor under and in the door gaskets of lower reach-in coolers on the cooking side. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: Handler used phone, then handled lettuce
summary: A food handler wearing earbuds and using a phone immediately grabbed lettuce to build a sandwich. The lettuce was discarded and hands were washed on site. A citation was issued. Several cold foods without date labels were discarded; no hand drying at a toilet-room sink was noted.

headline: No certified manager while steaming milk
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while milk was being steamed, a TCS food. The facility was instructed to obtain one; a citation was issued. Weak hot water at restroom sinks and a damaged cooler gasket were also noted. Canvass passed with conditions.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; fly trap placement
summary: The bar's low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer at final rinse; the manager was told to correct it. A fly trap hangs above clean utensils and must be moved. Deli cups were not air-dried, and staff restrooms lack hand-wash signs. Canvass passed with conditions.

headline: Ice buildup on walk-in freezer floor
summary: Ice buildup was on the floor inside the walk-in freezer. It must be removed, cleaned and maintained. Short-form complaint inspection passed.

headline: Walk-in cooler at 46–51°F; 206 lbs discarded
summary: Cooked chicken, pasta, rice, chili, salami and other TCS foods in the walk-in were held at 46–51°F. The manager voluntarily discarded 206 lbs (about $650). Undated foods were also found, and a citation issued. Canvass passed with conditions.

headline: Repeat core violations not corrected
summary: A core violation from an April 2024 inspection was not corrected. A small leak under the 3-compartment sink must be repaired, and second-floor storage floors must be cleaned. Priority citation issued. Canvass failed.

headline: Ice scoop on towel; ice maker film
summary: An ice scoop was placed on a cloth towel atop the ice maker; staff were told not to store it there. An orange film was on the upper interior panel of the ice maker and must be cleaned. The walk-in cooler lighting is inadequate. Canvass passed.

headline: Mouse droppings; no certified person on site
summary: About 50–75 mouse droppings were found along baseboards and shelving in several areas. No current pest service report was on file. No city-certified person was on site while raw meat was cut and raw fish was scaled. Failed; citations issued.

headline: About 15 rodent droppings in food prep area
summary: About 15 rodent droppings were found under dry storage shelves in the food prep area. The facility was told to eliminate activity, clean and sanitize, and contact pest control. A citation was issued. A food handler lacked a hair restraint and a men's restroom wall has a hole. Canvass failed.

headline: Missing hand-wash signage; grease under grill
summary: The pizza prep hand sink lacks hand-wash signage. Grease under the grill and spills inside the microwave and vegetable cooler need detail cleaning. Dusty ceiling fans were noted. Unused broken equipment in dry storage must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Canvass passed.

headline: No certified manager; no pest log book
summary: No certified food manager was present while TCS foods were prepared and served; a citation was issued. No signed employee health policy and no pest control log book were provided. Several food handlers lacked training certificates, and no summary report was posted. Canvass failed.

headline: No vomit policy, no pest logbook
summary: No written vomit and diarrhea policy was on site. No pest control agreement or logbook was provided, and no garbage contract was in place. Broken floor tiles, crumbling walls, and a missing toilet room light were noted. No citation issued. Failed.

headline: Restroom hand sink water too hot; food debris
summary: Hot water at the men's and women's restroom hand sinks measured 134.7°F and 132.8°F, above the 120°F maximum. The manager was told to keep it at 100–120°F; a citation was issued. Food debris was found on equipment, floors and inside drains. Canvass failed.

headline: Doors open; noodles cooled covered; reused bags
summary: Noodles were cooled covered in the reach-in cooler, which is inadequate. Front and back doors were open and must be closed to prevent pest entry. Single-use bags were reused for greens. A food handler lacked a certificate and managers lacked allergen training. Canvass passed.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; boxes on walk-in floor
summary: Sugar and flour were in clear containers without labels. Food boxes were stored on the walk-in floor and must be raised six inches. Cardboard was used as shelf liner, and grease had built up inside the fryer cabinet. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: Wiping cloths left on prep tables
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables instead of in sanitizing solution. Grease and food debris were found on equipment, coolers and walls. The 3-compartment sink hot water handle is broken. Re-inspection passed with conditions.

headline: Past-date tuna salad and roast beef discarded
summary: About 3 lbs of tuna salad being served and 10 lbs of roast beef were past their use-by dates and were discarded; a citation was issued. A dirty ice chute, a dirty toilet bowl, moldy caulk and food spillage in the walk-in were also noted. Canvass passed with conditions.

headline: Rat droppings and live rat found
summary: Open rodent bait was on the floor under the cook line stove. Rat droppings were found behind cook-line equipment, a cooler and the cashier freezer. A live rat was trapped during re-inspection. Failed, with other door gaps and dirty floors also noted.

headline: Slow-draining bar sink; dirty outdoor area
summary: The soda gun holder in the front bar must be cleaned to prevent pest harborage. The slow-draining bar hand sink must be repaired. The rear outside area under the staircase must be cleaned. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: Open drink cups near food containers
summary: Employees' open drink cups were placed on the food container shelf. The facility was instructed to keep them away from food. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: Low hot water; pastries held too cold
summary: Hand sinks had inadequate hot water; the manager raised the tank temperature and corrected it on site. Stuffed pastries in a grocery display were held at 75–94°F; all were discarded and a citation was issued. Canvass passed with conditions.

headline: Loose wall base tile by banquet bar sink
summary: Wall base tile to the right of the banquet bar hand sink is broken and coming loose. It must be repaired to prevent insect harborage. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: Unlabeled storage; knives stored behind sink
summary: Rice, sugar and salt in rear storage were not labeled. Knives were stored behind the 3-compartment sink, and coconut milk was left in an open can. Milk crates were used as shelving. Dust, dirty floors and an unlabeled cooler were also noted. Complaint inspection passed.

headline: Milk crates used as dry-storage shelving
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving throughout the dry storage areas. They must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor to allow floor cleaning. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: Dead insects in utility sink
summary: Dead insects were on and in the utility sink in the rear toilet room and must be removed. Heavy dust was on cooking equipment, and loose duckboards could harbor insects. A slow drain and very low dish-area lighting were also noted. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: Three drain stoppers needed for sink
summary: Three working drain stoppers are needed for the 3-compartment sink in the meat prep and dishwashing area. Canvass re-inspection passed.

headline: Debris in walk-in; grease under fryers
summary: Small debris and dirt were in the corners of the walk-in cooler floor under the shelving. Grease had built up under the deep fryers. Staff were instructed to clean and maintain both areas. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: No vomit procedure; no metal thermometer
summary: No written vomit and diarrhea procedure or adequate supplies were on site; a citation was issued. No metal stem thermometer or sanitizer test strips were on site. A 1/2-inch gap at the entrance door, a missing covered toilet-room receptacle, and a faulty cold water knob were noted. Complaint failed.

headline: Live roaches on rear prep wall
summary: Live roaches were crawling on the wall in the rear prep area and near the utility sink. The manager was told to call an exterminator and clean and sanitize. Food was uncovered and stored on the walk-in floor. Pots too large for the sink and a leaking drain were noted. Failed; citation issued.

headline: Open rodent traps; ice machine buildup
summary: About 14 open rodent bait traps were in dry storage rooms and must be replaced with covered, tamper-resistant bait stations; a citation was issued. Brown buildup inside the ice machine must be cleaned. Previous core violations were not corrected, including thermometers, door seals and floor cleaning. Failed.

headline: Leaking hand sink base behind bar
summary: Inspector saw a leak at the base of the hand sink behind the bar. It must be repaired and maintained. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: Food under condensation drip; freezer ice
summary: Food on shelves was stored beneath a condensation drip in the bakery walk-in cooler; staff were told to relocate it. Heavy ice and dust buildup in basement walk-in freezers must be cleaned. Short-form complaint inspection passed.

headline: Chicken and deli meat held at 47–65°F
summary: About 30 lbs of cooked chicken and deli meat were held at 47.4–64.5°F after overnight room-temperature thawing. The manager was told to hold food at 41°F or lower; about $150 was discarded. Frozen deli meat was thawed on the counter. Passed with conditions.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; ice used for drinks
summary: Black slime buildup in the front prep ice machine dripped onto ice used for consumption. The facility must clean, sanitize and maintain it; a citation was issued. Undercooked-food advisory was missing from the menu, and dead insects were on basement floors. Canvass failed.

headline: No certified food manager during deli prep
summary: No city-certified food manager with a valid original certificate was on site while deli sandwiches, soup and omelets were prepared; a citation was issued. The north entrance door was propped open. All certificate holders must obtain allergen training. Canvass passed with conditions.

headline: Cold foods at 45–56°F; about 11 lbs discarded
summary: Chicken, rice, ground beef, steak and shrimp were held at 44.9–56.3°F and discarded (about $100); a citation was issued. Staff had no vomit cleanup procedure or food handler or allergen training. A dumpster overflowed, and a kids' drink exceeded 130 calories.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; leaking faucet
summary: Torn gaskets inside a two-door produce cooler in the rear dishwashing area must be repaired. A loose, leaking faucet at the 3-compartment sink and a slow-draining sushi prep hand sink need repair. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: No certified manager; unsafe food temperatures
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were cooked and served. Hot foods (about 18 lbs) and cold chicken were held too warm and discarded. The hand sink was blocked and lacked soap and towels. Failed; citations issued.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: A certified food manager had no food allergen training and was instructed to comply with the requirement. Canvass re-inspection passed.

headline: Al pastor, chorizo and fish held too warm
summary: Al pastor at 48.6°F, chorizo at 56.7°F and fish at 60.3°F were held in the cold unit; the manager discarded 15 lbs (about $300). Frozen food was thawed in buckets, which does not meet thawing rules. Food debris and spills were on floors and surfaces. Passed with conditions; citation issued.

headline: Door gaps let in pests; damaged freezer hinges
summary: Gaps along the bottom and sides of front, rear, side and patio doors must be made tight-fitting. Damaged hinges on the ice cream freezer and holes in basement wall bases need repair. Broken concrete at the grease trap was also noted. Complaint re-inspection passed.

headline: Ice machine residue; spills; wall openings
summary: Residue was on the inside of the ice machine and must be cleaned. Single-service articles were not inverted in the serving area. Spills and debris were on beverage machines and prep tables. A loose faucet, wall openings, and missing floor drain covers need repair. Complaint re-inspection passed.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths; damaged waiting room ceiling
summary: Soiled wiping cloths were found on prep tables; the manager was told to store them in sanitizer between uses. The waiting room ceiling is damaged and has an opening over the front register. Light shields are missing or cracked. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Dead insects in light shields; mold-like buildup
summary: Light shields above the first-floor kitchen contain dead insects and must be cleaned. Black mold-like buildup under the bar sink floor drain must be detail cleaned. Basement beer cooler floors and corners also need cleaning. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: Unlabeled bulk flour and sugar containers
summary: A bulk food container with no labels was found, such as flour or sugar. It must be labeled. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: Cold foods at 46–50°F; about 70 lbs discarded
summary: Raw beef, tuna, turkey, ham, cheese, yogurt and chicken were held at 46.5–50°F. About 70 lbs (around $800) was discarded on site; a citation was issued. A rear cooler at 49°F was tagged and must not be used. Canvass passed with conditions.

headline: No written employee health policy on site
summary: No written employee health policy was on the premises; signed policies are required for each employee. Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables instead of in sanitizer. Ventilation in the employee and customer washroom is not working and must be repaired. Re-inspection passed with conditions.

headline: No certified manager on site while open
summary: No certified manager was on site while the facility was open and operating; a citation was issued. Two employees lacked food handler training. The exposed hand sink next to the pizza oven lacks signage. No summary report from the prior inspection was posted. Canvass passed with conditions.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods served
summary: No city-certified food manager was on site while rice, soup and pork were prepared and served; a citation was issued. A food handler had an expired certificate. Sink stoppers are missing from the 3-compartment sink. Canvass passed with conditions.

headline: Insect zapper near sink; food stored on floor
summary: An electronic insect zapper near the 3-compartment sink must be removed; only approved insect control devices are allowed. Avocados stored on the prep floor must be raised. Food handler training is missing. Passed.

headline: About 70 live flies found; leaking pipe
summary: About 50 live small flies were seen in storage and dish areas, and 20 at the front prep area. The manager must remove all fly activity by reinspection, and pest control service is advised. Food debris and a leaking dipper well pipe were also found. Failed.

headline: Hand sink missing near customer grill; failed
summary: A customer-area flat-top grill has no hand sink nearby; the grill must be removed or a sink provided; a citation was issued. Dishwashing area lacks hand drying, and stained cutting boards with dark grooves were found. Cold food at 47.8–52°F was discarded. Complaint failed.

headline: Inspection summary not posted for public
summary: The previous inspection summary was not posted and could not be located; a copy was given and management was told to post it. A citation was issued. Loose tile and gaps near the meat-room hand sink need sealing, and the dairy walk-in floor needs cleaning. Passed with conditions.

headline: Unused items cluttering back prep floors
summary: Unused items were cluttering the floors in the back prep and storage area. All items must be elevated for cleaning, and unnecessary items must be removed. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: No consumer advisory; clogged hand sink fixed
summary: Menus lacked the required consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods. There was no thermometer in the reach-in or standing coolers. A clogged prep-area hand sink was repaired by a plumber on site, which corrected it. A citation was issued. Canvass failed.

headline: Exposed foam caulk on walls
summary: Exposed foam-like caulk on walls and around pipes must be resurfaced to a smooth, easy-to-clean surface. License inspection passed.

headline: Cooked rice at 82°F; not reheated
summary: Cooked rice at 82°F in a warmer was placed in the rice cooker from the fridge without reheating. Food must be reheated to 165°F before hot holding. About 7 lbs (around $40) was discarded voluntarily; a citation was issued. Canvass passed with conditions.

headline: No health policy, no vomit kit, no test strips
summary: No written employee health policy was on premises. No vomit cleanup procedure or supplies were available. The rear dish room lacks a hand sink, and there are no sanitizer test strips or dish machine temperature indicators. Failed; no citations issued.

headline: No certified manager during chicken and beef prep
summary: No city-certified food manager was present while chicken and beef were prepared and served. Management was told one must always be present; a citation was issued. Greasy fryers, a torn cooler gasket, and greasy walls were also noted. Re-inspection passed with conditions.

headline: Food on floor; ceiling holes; dirty floors
summary: Boxed food was stored on the floor across from the 3-compartment sink and must be raised six inches. Food debris was inside prep tables and coolers. Multiple ceiling holes and dirt on floors and walls around the slushie machine must be fixed and cleaned. Complaint inspection passed.

headline: Rust on food prep table shelf
summary: Rust has built up on the bottom storage shelf of a food prep table. The manager was instructed to repaint or replace the shelving. Canvass re-inspection passed.

headline: Manager lacks city food manager certification
summary: The manager on duty lacks the City of Chicago food service manager certification and must hold it while serving TCS foods such as guacamole, chicken and beef. Rust on the ice machine edge, a soiled reach-in cooler, and a dirty floor behind the fryers were noted. Canvass passed with conditions.

headline: No valid city food sanitation certificate on site
summary: No person on site had a valid City of Chicago food sanitation certificate posted; one must be present at all times. A citation was issued. Large stacks of food trays and racks were stored outside by the rear door and must be removed. Canvass passed with conditions.

headline: No original city manager certificate on site
summary: No certified food manager with the original City of Chicago certificate was on site; only a national certificate was found. Hand sinks in dishwashing and prep areas were blocked. The posted summary was outdated; a new one was posted. Passed with conditions; citations issued.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; manager allergen training missing
summary: The certified food manager lacks a valid allergen training certificate and must show proof. A torn gasket on the left door of the 2-door prep cooler must be replaced. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: Greasy ventilation hood; handler lacks certificate
summary: Excessive grease was on the ventilation hood and filters; management was instructed to clean them. One food handler lacked a food handler training certificate; management was told all handlers must show proof. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Hand sink blocked by bucket; cold food warm
summary: A bucket blocking the front prep hand sink was removed during the inspection; hand-wash signs are missing. Cold beans at 46.7–46.9°F were discarded (about $35). An employee drank from an open cup, and a citation was issued. Complaint failed.

headline: Ice machine heavily soiled; no manager allergen training
summary: The rear ice machine had thick black, brown and pink buildup dripping onto ice used for drinks. Ice must be removed and the machine deep cleaned and sanitized. Hand-wash signs are missing. Passed with conditions; citation issued.

headline: No certified manager while ground beef served
summary: No person in charge or certified food manager with a valid certificate was on site while ground beef was prepared and served. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, and single-service items were not inverted. Doors have a 1/4-inch gap, and no food handler training was available. Failed.

headline: No certified manager; bare-hand contact with tacos
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while tacos, pizza and calzones were prepared. A handler touched ready-to-eat tacos bare-handed. Paper towels were missing at the kitchen hand sink. No food handler certificates were on site. Passed with conditions.

headline: No certified manager; steak touched bare-handed
summary: No person in charge had a valid certificate, and no certified manager was on duty while chicken, steak and sushi were prepared. A handler touched ready-to-eat steak bare-handed. The dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm and was tagged. A cooler at 50.1°F was tagged. Failed.

headline: Insect carcasses found behind coolers
summary: Milk held at 46°F was discarded (about $5); a citation was issued. Insect carcasses were found behind coolers and must be removed. No bodily fluid clean-up kit was on site. A food handler lacked food handler training. Complaint passed with conditions.

headline: Food manager lacks allergen training
summary: The food manager has no food allergen training certificate. All city-certified managers must have one. License inspection passed.

headline: Handler used phone while touching fruit
summary: A food handler used a personal phone while handling ready-to-eat fruit with gloves on, without changing gloves or washing hands. No certified food manager was on site while yogurt and smoothies were handled; a citation was issued. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Passed with conditions.

headline: Hand sink at 172°F; sanitizer at 0 ppm
summary: A bar hand sink ran 172°F water with no cold water; it should be 100–120°F. The prep-area low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer; it was ordered out of use and a citation issued. Cooked rice was in a grocery bag. Failed.

headline: Leaking hand sink in rear prep area
summary: The exposed hand sink in the rear prep area leaks from its bottom and must be repaired. The vent near the ice machine needs cleaning. No valid food allergen training certificates were found for city-certified managers. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: Dirty walk-in floors; water-stained ceiling tiles
summary: Floors inside the walk-in cooler are dirty and must be cleaned. Water-stained ceiling tiles in the rear prep area must be replaced. Allergen certificates were not obtained after a 2023 core violation, and a citation was issued. Canvass passed with conditions.

headline: Spillage on kitchen floors and walls
summary: Spillage was found on floors and walls throughout the kitchen. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain these areas. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: Flying insects and unsealed rear door
summary: About 20 live small flying insects were seen on walls, ceiling and boxes in rear food storage. Additional pest control service is needed. The rear door to the dumpsters is not pest-proofed. Food debris, a cluttered hallway, and missing allergen training for four managers were also noted. Failed.

headline: No vomit procedure; no employee health verification
summary: No employee health verification or vomit and diarrhea procedure or kit was available; these are required. The entrance door needs rodent-proofing, holes around pipes under the 3-compartment sink need sealing, and storage items must be 6 inches off the floor. Passed with conditions.

headline: No health policy or vomit kit; restroom partitions missing
summary: No employee health policy and no vomit and diarrhea kit were on site. The two fire-escape doors are not rodent-proof. Restroom partitions are missing, ceiling tiles are missing, and food handlers and the manager lack required training. License inspection failed.

headline: Dishes washed in prep sink; failed inspection
summary: Dishes were washed by hand in a one-compartment prep sink with soap and scrub sponges; all dishwashing must be done in the machine. A citation was issued. The dish machine lacks a temperature indicator, and a counter is cracked. Also a leaking sink and an invalid food handler certificate. Failed.

headline: Rear door gaps; multiple upkeep repairs needed
summary: Openings at the rear door's lower corners must be sealed to prevent pest entry; no pests were seen. Beverages were stored on floors, a utility sink lacked a drainpipe, and some restroom doors were not self-closing. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: About 100 or more mouse droppings were found in prep, bar, furnace and storage areas, plus 10 or more live small flies and one dead roach. These must be removed and areas sanitized; pest control is recommended. No certified manager certificate, health policies, or probe thermometer was found. Failed.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Several employees' food handler certificates have expired and must be updated. The food service manager has no allergen training certificate and was told to obtain one. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Cook-line hand sink blocked; now accessible
summary: A cook-line hand sink was blocked by a wheeled prep table; the manager moved it so the sink is now accessible, a citation was issued. The ice machine interior needs cleaning, a spray nozzle hangs in wash water, and milk crates are used as shelving. Canvass passed with conditions.

headline: Wiping cloths unstored; glove misuse noted
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer when not in use. A food handler wore gloves while touching the garbage can and was told to change gloves. A faucet leak, dirty floors and damaged ceiling were also noted. Complaint re-inspection passed.

headline: Hose attached to faucet without backflow device
summary: A hose is connected to a faucet beside the 3-compartment sink and needs a backflow preventer. A storage bin lid is broken, a grease box lid is rusty, and sink drain stoppers are missing. A light shield above the rear prep area must be replaced. Canvass passed.

headline: Broken cold water handle at hand sink
summary: The cold water handle at the exposed pizza prep hand sink needs repair. Canvass re-inspection passed.

headline: Women's restroom lacks covered personal-item receptacle
summary: The women's restroom had no covered receptacle for personal items. The operator must provide and maintain one. This was the only issue noted in this re-inspection.

headline: No certified manager; too-cool handwash water
summary: No city-certified foodservice manager was on premises. Handwash water measured 78.4F, below the 100F minimum. The low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 10 ppm chlorine and was repaired on site. No food handler training was provided.

headline: Missing deli thermometer and beard restraint
summary: No thermometer was provided for the large deli display cold unit. A food handler was working without a beard restraint. The operator was instructed to provide and maintain both.

headline: Dish sanitizing too cool; test kit missing
summary: Utensils were sanitized at 150F; 160F is required. The dish machine's sanitizing rinse gauge read 0 and was not working. Milk crates were used for elevation, and no sanitizer test kit was on site. A citation was issued.

headline: No employee health policy or vomit cleanup kit
summary: No employee health policy and no vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure were on site. The mop sink lacks a backflow device, the walk-in freezer is cluttered, and the toilet room has no mechanical ventilation. Reach-in cooler lower surface had debris.

headline: Scrap materials and clutter near storage areas
summary: Scrap materials were noted along a storage room wall and in a closet by the basement sink. Staff were told to remove unneeded items and store kept items on non-porous shelving at least 6 inches off the ground.

headline: Grease buildup and missing ceiling tile
summary: Grease buildup was found on kitchen equipment and shelves. Debris was on the floor behind the bar, and a ceiling tile near the front bar is missing. The person in charge was instructed to clean and repair.

headline: Rusted racks, missing cooler handle, floor damage
summary: Rusted storage racks, a missing walk-in cooler door handle, and foil used as a prep-equipment liner were noted. The utility sink lacks a backflow device, and no commercial dumpster contract was on file. Floor tiles are damaged and unstable.

headline: Dead insects, food debris, and missing allergen certificate
summary: Multiple dead insects were found under the front counter near slushy machines, and food debris built up in pizza ovens and a microwave. A new manager had no allergen training certificate on site. Staff were told to clean.

headline: Missing hand soap; unsafe cold-holding temperatures
summary: Hand soap was missing at two handwashing sinks. Chicken (49F), ground beef (45F), cheese, and other cold foods were above 41F in prep coolers; pizza prep cooler air measured 50F. Several prior violations were not corrected.

headline: Water-damaged ceiling tile and repeat violations
summary: A brown water-damaged ceiling tile in the front prep area must be repaired. Previous violations were not corrected: a rear exit door gap of at least 1/4 inch, dried food residue in a cooler and freezer, and a flickering walk-in cooler light.

headline: No handwashing signs at prep sinks
summary: No handwashing signage was posted at handsinks in preparation areas. The operator must provide signs. This was the only issue listed in this re-inspection.

headline: Broken wall brick and grease debris on floors
summary: Broken wall brick and a large gap between wall and base were found by the rear prep 3-compartment sink. Floors in prep and storage had food and grease debris under large equipment. The operator was told to enclose and clean.

headline: About 20 small flies found throughout facility
summary: About 20 small flies were seen in both bars, the kitchen, toilets, and dish room. Rusted shelving and a dirty dish machine interior were noted. A chemical dish machine's wash water measured 109F, below the 120F minimum, and was tagged.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; missing handwashing signs
summary: No vomit and diarrhea procedure or cleanup supplies were on site. Handwashing signage was missing. An unknown toxic material was used to seal the clean water tank. Ammonium chloride was found with no sanitizer test strips. License number missing on both doors.

headline: Leaking faucet; dirty floors under equipment
summary: A 1-compartment sink by the walk-in cooler leaks at the faucet. Floors along wall bases and under equipment, especially at the dish area, need cleaning and maintenance.

headline: Damaged freezer lid; expired food handler certificates
summary: Damaged chest freezer lids and cold-holding drawer gaskets need repair. Food residue is in gaskets of prep coolers. Cardboard under floor mats must be removed. Expired food handler certificates were provided; valid ones are required.

headline: Rat droppings found; raw chorizo at room temperature
summary: About 15 rat droppings were found in the vestibule around dry storage. About 20 lbs of raw chorizo hung at 58.5F room temperature and was discarded by the manager. Debris was found in the deli ham slicer and grease under an oven.

headline: Trash under basement stairs; toilet bowl residue
summary: Trash had built up on the floor under the basement stairs. Residue was found inside the toilet bowl in the food prep area toilet room. The operator was instructed to clean and maintain both.

headline: Missing thermometers and holes in ceiling
summary: No thermometers were placed in the walk-in cooler or three-door refrigerator. Boxed food was on the walk-in freezer floor. Multiple holes in ceiling panels above the drying rack need sealing. A certified manager lacked allergen training certificate.

headline: Missing handwashing sign and encrusted grease
summary: The handwashing sink at the main cook line had no signage. Encrusted grease was found on griddles, the stove, and surrounding walls. Exposed concrete and sealant foam below the dish machine are not easily cleanable. A walk-in cooler fan is in poor repair.

headline: Raw chicken thawing at room temperature
summary: Raw chicken in original packaging was thawing at room temperature; staff were told to use approved methods such as refrigeration. Paper towel rolls were stored in a restroom, and greasy floors under the main cook line need cleaning.

headline: Dirty cooler interior and missing light bulb
summary: The interior surfaces of a 2-door reach-in cooler need detail cleaning. A missing light bulb inside the reach-in cooler must be replaced.

headline: Missing signs, milk-crate shelving, leaking pipe
summary: No handwashing signage in the women's restroom. Milk crates were used instead of proper shelving in a 2-door reach-in cooler. An ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine. A pipe under the hot water tank leaks, and a ceiling tile above rear storage is missing.

headline: Recaulk toilet room washbowl
summary: The top surface of the toilet room washbowl needs recaulking. The operator was instructed to recaulk and maintain it. This was the only issue noted in this re-inspection.

headline: Rear door gap and dusty cooler condensers
summary: A 1/2-inch gap at the rear exit door sweep must be rodent-proofed. Dust on prep cooler condensers and ceiling tiles above prep must be cleaned. The men's washroom sink drains slowly, and some food handler certificates have expired.

headline: Spoiled chicken and out-of-temperature deli cooler
summary: Spoiled raw chicken was discarded. Deli cooler items were 46-51F and were discarded; the cooler later reached 36.4F. Soap was supplied at a prep sink on site. A 1-inch gap under the front door and an incomplete pest log were noted.

headline: Cold foods 45-49F; three coolers too warm
summary: Cold foods held at 45-49F were discarded (7 lbs eggs, 5 lbs kimchi, 2 lbs tofu, $200). Three coolers measured 45-47F; one was restored and two were tagged. Expired food handler certificates and a manager lacking allergen training were noted.

headline: Missing cleanup kit, thermometer, and pest logbook
summary: No vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit, stem thermometer, or pest control logbook was on site. Also: no handsink in washroom, no outside garbage container, a leaking faucet, and floors and walls needing detail cleaning.

headline: Slow-draining three-compartment sink
summary: The three-compartment sink drains slowly. The operator was instructed to repair it and maintain it at all times.

headline: Missing signs, unlabeled containers, uncovered food
summary: No handwashing signs at rear and front sinks. Containers lacked labels, and a 2-door cooler held uncovered food. Splashguards were missing. Plastic bags, foil, and milk crates were misused for storage.

headline: Missing handwashing sign and dusty light shields
summary: No handwashing sign was posted at a front coffee-prep handwashing sink. Dust was on light shields and ceiling tiles, and light shields were missing in first-floor prep and basement storage. The manager was told to fix these.

headline: Boxes of food stored on the floor
summary: Boxes of food were stored on the floor in the rear storage area near the rear exit. The manager was instructed to elevate them at least 6 inches on raised shelving to prevent contamination.

headline: Employee without hair restraint
summary: An employee in the food prep area had no hair restraint. Management was instructed to provide restraints for all food prep employees. This was the only issue noted.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; rear door gap
summary: Expired food handler certificates must be replaced. A 1/2-inch gap at the rear door must be sealed to prevent rodent entry. Bulk containers need labels. Ice machine interior, light shields, and ceiling vents need cleaning.

headline: No allergen training on site
summary: No allergen training records were on site. Staff holding certified food manager certificates must complete allergen training and keep records on site at all times. This was the only issue noted.

headline: No soap or paper towels; sink used as dump sink
summary: No soap at the rear prep handsink and no paper towels at two sinks. The front prep handsink was used as a dump sink. The menu did not warn about raw or undercooked items like eggs. Grease waste and debris outside were also cited.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; employees eating in prep
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were scattered in the rear storage area. Employees were eating in the prep area, and food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Food was stored on walk-in floors, bulk containers lacked lids, and cutting boards were stained.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure; door and vent issues
summary: No procedure for cleaning up vomit or diarrhea was on the premises; management was told to provide one. Also noted: washroom door not self-closing, soiled mop heads stored improperly, peeling ceiling paint, and a dusty washroom vent.

headline: Front door not rodent-proof; garbage lid missing
summary: The front entrance door had an opening at the bottom that must be sealed. A women's restroom garbage lid is missing. An opening behind the hot water tank must be sealed, and floors under cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Raw poultry thawed in warm water; labeling issues
summary: Raw poultry was thawing in warm water at the 3-compartment sink; staff were told to thaw only under cold running water. Deli cooler thermometers were inaccurate, grab-and-go labels were incomplete, and certified managers lacked allergen certificates.

headline: Over 100 rat droppings found in basement storage
summary: Over 100 rat droppings were in basement dry food storage, and over 20 more were outside by the dumpster. A handsink was blocked by a water pitcher and was not accessible. The ice machine lacks a backflow device. A citation was issued.

headline: Cutting board, toilet door, and missing certificates
summary: A cutting board in poor repair must be refinished or replaced. Second-floor toilet room doors must be self-closing. Food handlers lacked certificates, and a certified food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Cheese cooler too warm; 59 lbs discarded
summary: Cheese cooler held mozzarella at 45.7F, gorgonzola 46F, provolone 46.8F, muenster 48.7F. About 59 lbs ($709) was discarded and the cooler was tagged. Used gloves were stored near food.

headline: Lamb stored on floor; dirty floors
summary: A leg of lamb was stored on the floor in the exterior walk-in cooler and must be elevated at least 6 inches. Loose debris, dirt, and dust built up on floors and corners throughout the facility and must be cleaned more often.

headline: Roof leaks over food prep; standing water
summary: Water was actively leaking from ceilings in the front prep area and rear hallway; bins and bowls were catching water. The manager said the roof needs repair. The operator must prevent cross-contamination, clean surfaces, and remove standing water.

headline: Waffle irons soiled with food debris
summary: Non-food-contact surfaces of waffle irons in the front prep area had dried food debris and soil. Staff were instructed to clean them at an adequate frequency.

headline: No thermometer in walk-in cooler
summary: No thermometer was in the walk-in cooler. The operator was instructed to provide one to accurately monitor cooler air temperature.

headline: Dirty basement upright freezer interior
summary: Dirt and debris were found inside the upright tall freezer in the basement. The operator must clean and maintain it.

headline: Dish machine too cool; cold foods over 41F
summary: The high-temperature dish machine sanitized at 140F; staff must use the 3-compartment sink. Potatoes, buttermilk, soup, rice, and birria were above 41F and discarded. Walk-in cooler air read 55.9F and was placed on hold.

headline: No certified person in charge; no health policy
summary: The person in charge had no Chicago food sanitation certificate, and none was posted. Also noted: no written employee health policy, no metal-stem thermometer, undated prepared foods (discarded), and no outdoor food-waste receptacle.

headline: No certified manager; debris and poor lighting
summary: No certified food manager was on site while beans, eggs, and potatoes were prepared and served. Food debris was found under prep tables and fryers, floor drains were full, and rear storage lighting was inadequate.

headline: Cold-holding failures; 17 lbs discarded
summary: Cooked cauliflower, potatoes, and sprouts were held at 51.8-56F in a prep cooler whose air measured 53.8F. The foods were voluntarily discarded (17 lbs, $250). Dust on coolers, damaged ceiling tiles, and a non-working light were also noted.

headline: Food in plastic totes; grease and dusty vents
summary: Food was stored in plastic totes in cold units and freezers; food-grade bags and containers are required. Grease buildup was on cooking equipment, walls, floors, and shelves. Dust was on fans, light shields, and vents.

headline: Entry door gap and dirty prep areas
summary: A small gap at the front entry door must be sealed. Cutting boards, cabinets under the drink dispenser and handsink, the toilet room, and floors under prep tables and the 3-compartment sink need cleaning.

headline: No certificate posted; no dish temperature indicator
summary: No City of Chicago sanitation certificate was posted, and a certified manager must be present while temperature-controlled foods are prepared. Dish machine lacked a temperature indicator. Walk-in cooler had no light. Dish machine top needs cleaning.

headline: Broken thermometer, loose caulk, and food spills
summary: A juice-prep reach-in cooler's interior thermometer is broken and must be replaced. Caulk at the juice-prep handwash sink is broken, and food spills cover the floor throughout the prep area.

headline: Missing sink stoppers and non-cleanable wall
summary: Three-compartment sink stoppers must be provided. The wall and floor under the three-compartment sink are cement that is not easily cleanable and must be replaced with a smooth surface.

headline: About 60 rodent droppings; no vomit cleanup plan
summary: About 20 rodent droppings each were found under the customer counter, behind the oven, and under dry storage shelves. No written vomit/diarrhea procedure or supplies were on site. Handler certificates were unavailable; no inspection summary was posted.

headline: Dust in dining area light shield
summary: Dust was found inside the light shield in the dining area. Staff were instructed to clean it.

headline: Improper storage, cracked boards, and leaking sinks
summary: Pots were not inverted after sanitizing. Crates were used for produce and utensils, and cutting boards had open seams and stains. Cardboard was used as equipment liners. All three-compartment sinks leaked at the faucet; repairs were required.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; torn gasket
summary: A torn door gasket on the meat walk-in cooler must be replaced. Several food handler certificates had expired and must be updated. This was a re-inspection and it passed.

headline: Grease, food debris, and standing water in kitchen
summary: Greasy sides of cooking equipment, food debris, and standing water were on floors in food prep and dishwashing areas. A loose men's toilet faucet needs repair. Grease had built up on top of the trash-area grease container.

headline: Missing soap; wash-rinse-sanitize setup not used
summary: No soap at exposed sinks in the warewashing area and employee toilet room; soap was refilled during inspection. Dishes were washed without setting up the sink to sanitize; this was corrected immediately. Greasy surfaces and floor debris also noted.

headline: No certified manager; 100+ mouse droppings
summary: No person in charge with a valid certificate was on site while temperature-controlled foods were prepared. Over 100 mouse droppings were in basement storage. No food handler training was available; ventilation hood doesn't work.

headline: No certified manager while eggs prepared
summary: No certified manager was on site while eggs and other temperature-controlled foods were prepared. No vomit kit, metal-stem thermometer, or sanitizer test strips were found. A non-service dog was inside and later removed.

headline: Dirty cutting boards, leaks, and wet dish room
summary: Cutting boards had dark stains and deep cuts. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer between uses. Duct tape was used on a deli cooler door. Leaks, a slow drain, and dish room debris and water were also noted.

headline: Food handler without beard restraint
summary: A male food handler was working without a beard restraint. He was instructed to wear one and keep it on. No other issues were noted.

headline: Rat and mouse droppings; sink lacks hot water
summary: About 6 rat droppings and over 100 mouse droppings were found on storage shelves, carts, prep surfaces, and in the walk-in cooler. Restroom handsink water measured 74F, below 100F. Ice machines had pink and black mold.

headline: Overflowing dumpsters and multiple upkeep issues
summary: Overflowing outside dumpsters were flagged as rodent harborage and a food source; a citation was issued. Other issues: no handwashing signs, low water pressure at a handsink, stained cutting boards, rust, mold near a sink, and missing food handler certificates.

headline: Rat droppings found; 250 lbs of food discarded
summary: Display cooler chicken measured 48.6-56.8F and beef 60.2F; manager discarded 250 lbs ($20,050). About 15 rat droppings were on the floor near dishwashing. Shrimp was thawed in standing water. Pest control was recommended.

headline: No certified manager; discarded ribs; no pest log
summary: No certified food manager was on site while cooked and raw ribs were in cold holding. About 26 lbs ($235) was discarded for missing date marks. No vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit or pest control logbook was on site.

headline: No certified manager while chicken prepared
summary: No certified manager was on duty while chicken and other temperature-controlled foods were prepared. No handwashing signs were in restrooms or at the bar sink. Black slime was found inside the basement ice machine used for ice; it must be removed and cleaned.

headline: Dirty cabinet interiors
summary: Cabinet interiors were not clean and had food debris and dirt. The operator was instructed to clean and maintain them. This was the only issue noted.

headline: Rear door gap and missing sink stoppers
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door must be sealed. Three-compartment sink stoppers are missing. Grease buildup on cooking equipment and floors, no backflow device on the utility sink, water-stained ceiling tiles, and excessive exhaust grease were noted.

headline: 30+ mouse droppings in storage and hallway
summary: About 30 or more mouse droppings were found on outlets, shelves, and floors in rear storage and the hallway. The area must be cleaned and pest control recommended. Also: stained ceiling tiles, damaged floors and walls, and missing food container labels.

headline: No running water at only handwashing sink
summary: The only handwashing sink in the rear prep area had no running water when hot and cold knobs were turned on. Water under pressure must reach all fixtures. A citation was issued as a priority violation.

headline: No paper towels; food handler training missing
summary: No paper towels at two exposed handwashing sinks or the basement toilet room; a citation was issued. A dishwasher had no food handler training. Repeat core violations were not corrected, including allergen training and splashguard issues.

headline: No self-closing washroom door
summary: The washroom door has no self-closing device, which must be installed. Staff were also told to clean the bottom of the hot holding unit in the front area and the corner floor in the rear kitchen.

headline: No handwashing signs in employee restrooms
summary: Inspector found no handwashing signs in the employee restrooms. This was the only issue noted during the inspection.

headline: Grease and flour debris on equipment and floors
summary: Accumulated grease and food debris were on cooking equipment, coolers, freezers, and shelving. Flour and food debris were on floors throughout prep areas, the warewashing area, walk-in cooler, and freezer. The person in charge was instructed to clean.

headline: Unresolved slow-draining three-compartment sink
summary: A previous priority violation was not corrected within the required time. The three-compartment sink drains slowly in the floor and right compartment. The manager was told to address it, and it was cited as a priority violation.

headline: Live cockroaches and flying insects found
summary: Two live cockroaches and about 50 small flying insects were found in bakery, meat, and produce prep areas, and restrooms; more pest control service is needed. Missing ingredient labels on prepackaged foods also noted.

headline: Cool water, mouse droppings, and flies found
summary: Hot water measured about 75F at sinks; 100F is required, and was restored during inspection. About 30+ mouse droppings, 3-5 live flies, and 10+ small flies were found in kitchen and bar areas.

headline: Missing labels, milk-crate shelving, and sink stoppers
summary: Stored food in the walk-in cooler, freezer, and coolers lacked name labels. Milk crates and cardboard were used as shelving, and 3-compartment sink stoppers were missing. A ceiling tile in rear dry storage is missing. Hand-washing signs were also missing.

headline: Front door gap; ice scoops stored on machine
summary: The front entrance door has about a 1/2-inch opening between doors and is not rodent-proof; it must be tightened. Ice scoops were stored on top of the ice machine. Dirt and dust on rear floor drains must be cleaned.

headline: Missing food handler training; worn gaskets
summary: No food handler training was provided for all employees; it must be provided and maintained. Also noted: a gap under the rear door, worn cutting boards and cooler gaskets, and stained ceiling tiles that need repair.

headline: Openings at front door wall base
summary: Openings along the wall base at the front door area must be sealed to prevent entry points for pests.

headline: Grease, dirt, and peeling paint in kitchen
summary: Heavy grease on deep fryer openings; dirt and debris in walk-in and reach-in coolers; grease and dust near the pizza oven and cooking equipment; peeling paint over the pizza oven and three-compartment sink.

headline: Missing hair restraints; leaking sink pipe
summary: Some employees preparing food in the prep area had no hair restraints or protection. Serving plates on kitchen shelves were not inverted, and a pipe at the bottom of the dish-area handwash sink is leaking.

headline: Floor drain buildup under three-compartment sink
summary: Build-up was found in a floor drain in the rear area under the three-compartment sink. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain it. This was a complaint inspection and it passed.

headline: Missing food handler training and floor repairs
summary: No food handler training was provided for employees; it must be provided and maintained. Also noted: broken sink stopper handle, damaged walk-in freezer floor, missing grout by the ice machine, and black slime in floor drains.

headline: Employee restroom door not self-closing
summary: The employee washroom door is not self-closing. A self-closing device must be installed and maintained. This was the only issue noted.

headline: No handwashing sign; exposed brick toilet wall
summary: No handwashing sign was at the exposed hand sink in the front dispensing area. Exposed brick walls in one of three toilet rooms must be covered and sealed to be smooth and cleanable.

headline: Grease buildup, outdoor spill, and dusty fans
summary: A grease spill was found near the outside grease container; the manager cleaned it during inspection. Grease buildup, food debris, and dust on fans and vents were noted. Plastic grocery bags held food in the freezer. A manager lacked allergen training.

headline: About 200 mouse droppings; no vomit cleanup kit
summary: About 200 mouse droppings were found throughout the store, including on shelves and near food items. Front and exit doors are not rodent-proof. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure or kit was on site. Pest control was recommended.

headline: Wet wiping cloths and food debris on floors
summary: Wet wiping cloths were left on prep surfaces; they must be stored in sanitizer between uses. A leaky three-compartment sink faucet and food debris and spills on floors and equipment were noted. Cleaning frequency must increase.

headline: Food and floor debris; re-inspection passed
summary: Food debris was found inside the sliding-door cooler at the front cook line. Debris was also on the floor near the Coke cooler in the front prep area. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain both.

headline: Food equipment stored in washroom; missing grout
summary: Two metal carts and a prep table were stored in the customer washroom and must be removed. Also: no covered waste container in employee washroom, missing floor grout, a food handler without a certificate, and an expired manager allergen certificate.

headline: No certified manager; mouse droppings and roaches
summary: No person in charge or certified food manager was on site while temperature-controlled foods were prepared. Over 20 mouse droppings and 2 live roaches were found in kitchen prep and 2nd-floor dry storage.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep and service
summary: No certified food manager on premises while TCS foods such as steak and eggs were prepared and served; priority citation issued. Cups and plates stored in a handwashing sink; removed on site. Pots of food on the walk-in cooler floor. Wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces.

headline: Dust and construction debris contaminated food
summary: Unlabeled container of sidewalk ice remover near the rear exit; priority citation issued. Construction work created dust that contaminated open griddle cake batter, beverages, and prep surfaces. Contaminated food discarded; construction must not resume during business hours. Leaking hand sink and missing ceiling tiles.

headline: Live flies, unsafe cold food, hand sink problems
summary: About 75 live small flies in basement prep area. Cold-held food at 49–66°F discarded (about $400). Hand sinks lacked hot water and hand-drying supplies. Juice kept in a toxic-material container was discarded. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Gaps under door; grocery bags used for food storage
summary: Gap at the bottom of the dim sum kitchen's outer door must be rodent-proofed. Grocery bags used for food storage in walk-in coolers and freezers; food-grade bags must be used. One three-door cooler has poor gaskets. Employee washroom door lacks self-closing device.

headline: No certified manager; no hot water; cooler clutter
summary: No certified manager on site from 8:15 to 8:40 AM while chicken was prepared; citation issued. No hot water throughout; sinks measured 74.7–80.5°F, below 100°F for hand sinks and 110°F for the three-compartment sink. Citation issued. Food stored on the walk-in cooler floor.

headline: Damaged walls; food debris; poor lighting
summary: Wall near the prep area entrance has pictures and signage in disrepair. Dried food debris on basement prep and bar floors and behind shelving. Storage behind black doors needs cleaning and organizing. Inadequate lighting in basement prep, dish, and storage areas.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; dirty drains and ventilation
summary: Bulk ingredient containers in the rear prep area unlabeled; must be labeled. Food, dirt, and debris in floor drains and under heavy equipment in the basement and first floor. Ventilation panels above cooking equipment greasy. Certified manager's allergen training certificate expired.

headline: No food handler training; leaking hot water faucet
summary: No food handler training for the employee on site; manager must train all employees who handle food. Hot water faucet leaks at the front prep hand sink. Dust on the employee washroom fan, ceiling vents, and light shields must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager; missing thermometer and pest log
summary: No City-certified food service manager on premises; priority citation issued. No metal-stem thermometer. Pest control log book is incomplete, with the latest records from 2021 and 2022. Unlabeled squeeze bottles. Utility sink lacks a backflow device.

headline: Single-use items stored in toilet room; expired certificates
summary: Coffee liners, napkins, and gloves used for food preparation were stored in a toilet room; these must be stored elsewhere. Food handlers had expired food handler certifications. Manager instructed to ensure updated certificates for all food employees.

headline: Slight black slime inside ice machine
summary: Slight black slime build-up was found inside the ice machine. The inspector instructed the operator to detail clean it and maintain it in good condition.

headline: Rat droppings, flies, and no certified manager
summary: No valid City sanitation certificate on site while TCS foods were prepared. Steak held at 81.1°F; about 3 pounds discarded. About 10 rat droppings in basement; about 20 flies in dining room; fly paper throughout. Dumpster overflowing; priority citations issued.

headline: Food handler lacks certificate; dirty basement floor
summary: One food handler had no food handler certificate. Management must require proof of training for all food handlers. Basement floor needs cleaning, especially under the pallets.

headline: Rat droppings in basement; no pest log; cold food
summary: About 65 rat droppings in the basement behind storage shelving and along walls; must be cleaned and pest control contacted. No current pest control log book. Chicken at 49.1°F and eggs at 65.3°F in the front prep cooler; about 5 pounds ($75) discarded.

headline: Dish machine tagged; residential oven not allowed
summary: High-temperature dish machine missing parts; tagged and held for Chicago Department of Public Health reinspection. Residential oven in the prep area tagged and may not be used. No irreversible thermometer on site. Stove has no ventilation connection.

headline: One employee lacks food handler training
summary: One of three employees has no food handler training. All food employees must complete it and keep records on site at all times. Torn gasket inside a two-door cooler in the rear prep area must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; leaking drain
summary: No thermometer inside the two-door service line cooler; one must be provided. Left compartment drain pipe leaks at the two-compartment sink. Cracked light cover above the dishwashing three-compartment sink must be replaced.

headline: Hair restraints lacking; cooler dirty; sink leak
summary: Employees without proper hair restraints in the food prep area. Interior bottom shelf of the reach-in cooler dirty. Leak under the hand sink. Floor drain and wall bases in the work area need detail cleaning.

headline: Dead insects, dust, clutter, and broken floor tiles
summary: Dust, dead insects, and dirt build-up on cooking equipment, ingredient containers, and racks. Unused articles stored on the rear floor must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Broken dish-area floor tiles must be repaired to a smooth, cleanable surface.

headline: Dirty floors; food handler lacks certificate
summary: Floors still need cleaning to remove dirt, coffee beans, and debris. A male food handler had no food handler certificate and must obtain a valid one.

headline: No certified manager; expired certificates
summary: No valid City certificate holder on site while TCS foods were held and handled; priority citation issued. Digital thermometer not working. Expired food handler certificates. No proof of allergen training for certified managers. Unlabeled sauces; greasy receptacle lid.

headline: Food on floors; rust; missing light shields
summary: Food stored on floors in prep and dry storage areas must be raised six inches. Rust on walk-in cooler shelving. Cardboard and foil used as shelf liners. Dirt under equipment and dust on ceiling vents. Multiple missing light shields in dry storage. One manager has an expired allergen certificate.

headline: No certified manager; sanitizer at 0 ppm; flies
summary: No certified food manager certificate posted or present while TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. Utensils sanitized at 0.0 ppm; citation issued. About 25 or more live small flies on walls and in a restroom floor drain; pest control recommended on or after 4/25/25.

headline: Side exit not rodent-proof; food stored under pipes
summary: Side exit door is not rodent-proof. Food, equipment, and single-use items stored under exposed basement piping must be moved or piping enclosed. One of three food handlers lacked a hair restraint. Some food handler certificates missing; manager allergen training expired.

headline: Handwashing and food temperature issues, mostly corrected
summary: Paper towels and handwashing signs were missing; both corrected on site. Restroom hand sink measured 53.6°F and was repaired to 101.8°F on site. Sliced tomatoes at 49.8°F were discarded. Menu raw-food advisory added on site. Flour bins unlabeled.

headline: Missing food handler certificates; cutting board worn
summary: Food handlers had no proof of food handler training certificates; each employee must have one. Cutting board with deep seams on the prep cooler must be refinished or replaced. Leaves and debris under and around the dumpster must be cleaned.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; foil liners used
summary: Multiple expired food handler certificates were on site. No allergen awareness certificates on site. Foil used as liners on rear prep surfaces. Torn cooler gasket and grime behind cooking equipment must be addressed.

headline: No certified manager; cooler at 60°F; no hot water
summary: No certified manager on site while open; manager had only a copy of certificate. Prep cooler at 60°F; tomatoes, milk, and cheese at 55–60°F; about 23 pounds (about $188) discarded. No hot water; restored on site. Wastewater backs up into dishwashing and prep areas.

headline: Basement floors dirty and cluttered
summary: Basement floors were not clean. Basement was cluttered with old equipment and other items. Must be cleaned and organized.

headline: Heavily stained cutting board must be replaced
summary: Cutting board with deep, dark grooves and heavy stains in the front prep area. Must be replaced, and all cutting boards must be kept in good condition at all times.

headline: No covered waste bin; washroom doors lack closers
summary: No covered waste receptacle in the basement washroom; management instructed to provide one. Washroom doors have no self-closing devices; management instructed to install them.

headline: Food residue in cold-hold unit gaskets
summary: Slight food residue was found in the gaskets of a cold-hold unit in the front prep area. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain the unit.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; dirty cooler racks
summary: Bulk sugar and flour containers in the basement prep area are unlabeled; common names must be added. Dairy walk-in cooler racks have encrusted dirt and build-up that must be detail cleaned. Unused metal equipment outside the rear door must be removed.

headline: No certified manager; equipment and wall repairs
summary: No City-certified food manager on premises; priority citation issued. Squeeze bottles and jerk sauce unlabeled. Rust and damaged gaskets on prep table and two-door refrigerator. No commercial dumpster; refuse area is gravel. Stained or missing ceiling tiles and holes in walls.

headline: No certified person in charge; cold unit at 45.5°F
summary: No person in charge with a valid Chicago food sanitation certificate; no certified manager present while tacos and tortas were prepared. Front cold-holding unit at 45.5°F; about 9 pounds discarded. Unit may not be used until reinspected by CDPH. No proof of food handler training.

headline: Hot shrimp too cool; raw fish too warm; discarded
summary: Fried shrimp at 77.5–109.3°F on the front prep counter, below the required 135°F. Raw salmon at 60.6°F and tuna at 52.3°F, above 41°F. Person in charge discarded all out-of-temperature food. Bulk containers unlabeled; plates stored uncovered.

headline: Black slime drips onto ice; citation issued
summary: Black slime build-up in the ice bin was dripping onto ice cubes stored below. Priority foundation violation; citation issued. Must clean, sanitize, and maintain. Slow-draining hand sink in the kitchen hall needs repair.

headline: No food handler certificate; no pest control logbook
summary: No food handler certificate on site. No pest control logbook on site, a repeat violation; the logbook must contain the latest visit record and the pest control license number. Also: utensil not inverted, dirty microwave, debris under rear shelving.

headline: Employee without hair restraint; vent dust
summary: An employee in the prep area had no hair net or cap; a hair restraint is required at all times in the food prep area. Heavy dirt and dust buildup on vents at the prep area must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep
summary: No City-certified food manager present while TCS foods such as chicken, goat, and rice were prepared and served; citation issued. Back door found open; must be kept closed. Food handler certificates could not be located. Food spills inside cooling units.

headline: Goat held too warm; corrected on site
summary: Cooked goat held at 47.5°F in the walk-in cooler; corrected on site and voluntarily discarded; priority citation issued. Food stored on prep area floor. Soiled wiping cloths. Grocery bags used in freezer. Excessive smoke inside the restaurant; ventilation must be improved.

headline: Debris in ice chute; black caulk at sink
summary: Slight debris inside the ice machine chute must be cleaned. Excessive black substance in the caulking at the top of the three-compartment sink base must be removed or replaced.

headline: Missing ceiling panel; personal items in prep area
summary: Missing ceiling panel above the three-compartment sink must be replaced. Employee clothing and bags stored in the kitchen prep area; they must be kept in designated areas.

headline: Mouse droppings found in basement and kitchen
summary: Mouse droppings found on the basement floor, inside a basement storage room, on a shelf, and on the kitchen floor near the large mixer. Priority pest violation; pest control service recommended before next week's reinspection. Basement hand sink needed for slicer.

headline: No certified manager; no training proof for staff
summary: Person in charge lacks proof of food safety management training. No original City certificate or certified manager present while TCS foods such as milk, turkey, ham, and cheese were prepared; priority citation issued. No proof of food handler or allergen training.

headline: Clean floors, equipment, and hood vents
summary: Clean floors under, around, and behind equipment in the closet, dishwashing area, and cooking area. Clean the vents in the hood system above cooking equipment.

headline: Beard guard, scoop storage, and floor storage issues
summary: A male food handler with a beard lacked a beard guard. Scoops stored inside cold-holding food, and plates were used to scoop food. Washroom lacked a covered receptacle. Soda and tortillas stored directly on the ground must be raised 6 inches.

headline: Leaking grease trap and sanitizer sink piping
summary: Grease trap in poor repair and leaking onto the rear dishwashing floor; priority citation issued. Three-compartment sink piping leaking near the sanitizer basin. Trash and food debris on floors under cooling and shelving units in front prep and dishwashing areas.

headline: Rodent droppings in kitchen and basement; cold food unsafe
summary: About 50 mouse droppings in kitchen prep storage and about 100 in basement dry storage and paper room. Chicken salad at 50.5°F and hummus at 46.9°F; about 4 pounds (about $39) discarded. Door gap noted. Pest control service recommended.

headline: Scoops on ice machines; grease, rust, and tile damage
summary: Ice scoops stored on top of basement ice machines must be kept in a clean container. Milk crates used for shelving in the walk-in cooler. Excessive grease in cooking equipment and hood. Cracked floor tiles, missing wall tile, and unworking washroom ventilation.

headline: Cooked corn and coleslaw held too warm
summary: Cooked corn at 48°F and coleslaw at 46°F were held above the required 41°F. Manager discarded about 1 pound of each (about $20). Citation issued for a priority cold-holding violation.

headline: Food on floors; grease; unlabeled containers
summary: Food containers stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler, prep, and storage areas must be raised six inches. Unlabeled food containers. Grease build-up on cooking equipment, walls, and shelving. No covered sanitary napkin receptacle in the all-gender washroom.

headline: Door gap, reused bags, and debris
summary: Gap along the bottom of the front door must be closed. Bread bags reused for shrimp in the chest freezer; food-grade bags required. Cardboard on service counter shelving. Food and ice build-up in freezers. Chipping paint and damaged ceiling need repair.

headline: Suspension sign removed by unauthorized person
summary: A license suspension sign was removed from the front door by someone not authorized to do so. The person in charge was instructed not to cover, deface, or remove signage. Priority citation issued.

headline: Flies found; mold in ice machine; shellstock records
summary: About 40 small flies in third-floor dishwashing, prep, storage, and bar storage; pest control required on or after 5/28/2025. Black and beige mold inside the ice machine; ice must be destroyed. Shellstock tags lack last-sold dates. Raw animal foods lacked consumer advisory; corrected on site.

headline: Mouse infestation; cracked floors; core violation
summary: About 200 or more mouse droppings on shelves and floors near food, pet food, baby items, and registers. Dead mouse on a glue board and a live mouse between bags of dog food. Droppings must be removed and pest control service scheduled on or after 6/5/25. Cracked floors and ceilings not corrected.

headline: Hair restraint lacking; cardboard liners; grease
summary: A food handler had no effective hair restraint. Cardboard used as liners in cooling units, carts, and shelving must be removed. Encrusted grease near fryers and debris in a two-door cooler. Floor drains with pooled grease must be cleaned regularly.

headline: Missing backflow devices on coffee and ice machines
summary: No backflow prevention devices were found at the espresso machine, ice machine, or pour coffee machine. Devices must be installed where they can be located and serviced.

headline: Ice machine door buildup; trash on dry storage floor
summary: Build-up on the ice machine door; the person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain it. Debris and trash on the dry storage room floor under shelving must be cleaned at all times.

headline: No certified manager during pizza prep; several violations
summary: No City-certified food manager present while TCS foods such as pizza at 136°F were prepared or served. Sanitizer test strips missing. Washroom door lacks self-closing device. Food handler lacked certificate. Ashtray with cigarette butts found in the food prep area.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; thermometer not working; holes in walls
summary: Bulk dry food containers unlabeled. Utensils not inverted. Dish machine's irreversible thermometer not registering utensil temperature; priority citation issued. Holes in lower basement walls. Certified managers lack allergen training certificates. Previous inspection summary not posted; citation issued.

headline: Cooler too warm; about 70 pounds of food discarded
summary: Eggs, guacamole, broccoli, lettuce, tomatoes, and liquid eggs at 45–52.4°F in the four-door cooler. About 70 pounds (about $203) voluntarily discarded. Cooler at 49°F and must not be used until it holds 41°F or below. Plate and sink leaks; dirty floors and drains.

headline: Insect zapper near dry storage; removal ordered
summary: An insect zapper was found in the front area next to dry storage. The manager was instructed to remove it. No insects or pests were recorded during this complaint inspection.

headline: Dumpster-area door gaps; damaged gasket
summary: Openings at the base of both dumpster-area exit doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Damaged gasket on a one-door cold-holding unit. No covered receptacle in the women's washroom. Rust and rough ceilings in walk-in cooler and freezer; missing wall tiles.

headline: Hood filters need cleaning
summary: Filters at the cooking equipment hood must be cleaned. Inspector instructed the operator to maintain them.

headline: Cooler floor cleaning and allergen training needed
summary: Floor in a corner of the walk-in cooler must be cleaned. All City of Chicago food service managers must obtain required food allergen training. No critical food-safety problems were listed.

headline: Rear dock gaps; leaking and slow hand sinks
summary: Rear dock doors have 1/4-inch gaps at the bottom; better weatherstripping required to prevent pest entry. Beef-prep hand sink drains slowly. Chicken-prep hand sink has a leaking pipe underneath. Repairs required.

headline: No thermometers inside cold-holding units
summary: No ambient air thermometers inside cold-holding units in the front and rear prep areas. Must be provided and maintained. Floors in the far-right seating room are not smooth and easily cleanable.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; dust buildup; ice scoop storage
summary: No handwashing signs near sinks in employee and customer washrooms. Ice scoop stored on top of the ice bin must be kept in a clean container. Dust on a ceiling vent in the service area and walls behind ice machines.

headline: Chipped ceiling paint above prep area
summary: Chipped paint on the ceiling above the first-floor food prep area. Management was instructed to scrape and repaint the affected section.

headline: Cold-held beef and tomatoes too warm; citation
summary: Cooked Italian beef at 62.6°F and sliced tomatoes at 47.3°F in a cooks-line cold-holding unit; all discarded. Priority citation issued. Utility sink covered by shelving and out of use. No proof of food handler or allergen training for employees or managers.

headline: Cleaning needed on equipment, fans, and hood vents
summary: Cleaning needed inside the ice machine panel, on fryer and grill exteriors, inside prep coolers under fryers, on washroom fans, and in hood vents. Inspector instructed the person in charge to clean and maintain these items.

headline: No hot water; cold food discarded; cardboard liners
summary: No hot running water at employee sinks; washroom water 87.5–90.5°F and bread-oven hand sink 73.2°F, but 100°F is required. Meat prep cooler held chicken at 51.2°F and beef at 47.4°F; 65 pounds (about $200) discarded. Cardboard and milk crates used. Dirty floor drains.

headline: No health policy; no vomit and diarrhea procedure
summary: No written employee health policy on site; priority citation issued. No written cleaning procedure or equipment for vomit or diarrhea events. Items under rear sinks must be elevated. Grease, dust, and grime on cook line, coolers, and walls. Expired allergen training.

headline: Blocked hand sink; no soap; insect devices over food
summary: Rear warewashing hand sink blocked by an empty bucket; removed on site. Soap cartridge removed; provided on site. Insect control devices installed above drinks and clean equipment must be moved. Equipment stored on the walk-in cooler floor. Heavily soiled can opener.

headline: Unlabeled food; milk crates; rust on racks
summary: Food handlers lacked proof of food handler training; approved training must be completed. No approved allergen training certificate found. Unlabeled rice, sugar, and salt in basement. Plastic soda and milk crates used for shelving; rusty racks in walk-in cooler and freezer.

headline: Live roaches, mouse droppings, and failed dishwasher
summary: About 10 live roaches and 8 mouse droppings found, including around cooking equipment and basement floor. Sticky traps full of dead flies. No certified manager on site. Low-temperature dishwasher tagged with 0 ppm sanitizer. Eggs at 76°F discarded.

headline: Rust on walk-in cooler wire racks
summary: Rust found on wire storage racks inside the walk-in cooler. Rust must be removed, and shelves repainted or replaced.

headline: No thermometer; unlabeled bulk food; faucet leaks
summary: No food probe thermometer on site. Bulk salt and flour containers unlabeled. Three-compartment sink faucet in poor repair; hot water cannot be shut off. Dusty fan covers and loose floor tiles in walk-in cooler. Inadequate lighting; manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Slow-draining sink; peeling paint; clutter
summary: Exposed hand sink in the front prep area drains slowly and must be repaired. Peeling paint behind bulk storage and inside the women's washroom. Clutter on the second-floor storage area could attract rodents. Dirty floors under shelving and in the walk-in cooler.

headline: Hands not washed; live flies throughout prep and dining
