summary: Food handler cut a bagel with a knife after putting on gloves without washing hands; priority citation issued. About 100 or more live small flies on walls, ceilings, glass doors, and in the front prep and dining areas. Pest control service recommended on or after 1/12/26.

headline: No certified manager; cold food unsafe; cooler tagged
summary: No City sanitation manager certificate while handling TCS foods like roast beef and turkey. Reach-in cooler held tuna, cheese, roast beef, and other foods at 51.8–56.3°F. About 62 pounds (about $700) discarded and cooler tagged. Handwashing signs missing.

headline: Dusty fan; dirty floors; training required
summary: Dust on the washroom ceiling fan. Floors around and behind some kitchen equipment need cleaning. All food handlers must obtain required food handler training. All city-certified food service managers must obtain required food allergen training.

headline: No thermometers for high-temperature dishwashing
summary: No temperature measuring devices were available for high-temperature dishwashing. The manager was instructed to obtain them. Priority foundation violation noted; conditional pass.

headline: Kitchen exhaust hood not working
summary: Kitchen exhaust hood ventilation was not working. Must be repaired, and adequate ventilation maintained at all times.

headline: Splashguard, sealing, and door closer needed
summary: Splashguard must be installed on the left side of the exposed rear prep hand sink. Raw wood steps between prep areas must be sealed or painted. Washroom door lacks a self-closing device. Gaps between wall and vinyl baseboard in rear prep area must be resealed.

headline: Filters, nozzles, and hot-holding units need cleaning
summary: Filtering equipment, drink dispenser nozzles, and hot-holding equipment need detail cleaning to remove build-up and grease. Leak at the three-compartment sink faucets. Unnecessary articles in rear storage must be removed or moved off the floor.

headline: Rat droppings, dead rat, and live roach found again
summary: Still found rat droppings inside the fryer cabinet, one live roach at the rear prep counter, and a dead rat in the motor of an unused reach-in cooler. Areas must be cleaned and sanitized. Pest control service required on or after 4/14/25. Rear door gap noted.

headline: No certified manager while preparing food; citation
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager on site while preparing hot dogs, wings, and pizza. Priority citation issued. Oven and equipment have dried food debris. Damaged ceiling tiles and food stored on the floor in the rear area must be fixed.

headline: Labeling, storage, and upkeep fixes required
summary: Food storage containers need labels. Scoops stored in ready-to-eat dry goods. Sanitizer hoses hang into sink water and must be shortened. Food manager allergen training missing. Also required: floor, wall, and faucet repairs and cleaning.

headline: Too few washrooms; unlabeled containers; repeat violations
summary: Only one public washroom, but liquor service requires two. Restaurant must follow its washroom variance, add a washroom, or limit seating to 30 or fewer. Also found unlabeled bulk containers, a loose ice machine door, and previous core violations not corrected.

headline: No certified manager; eggs and melon too warm
summary: No City-certified manager present while TCS foods were prepared; certificate must be posted; priority citation issued. Eggs at 64.3°F and cut melon at 50.4°F; about 10 pounds ($175) discarded. Food handlers without hair restraints. Missing stoppers at the three-compartment sink.

headline: Unlabeled cheese, food on floor, grease buildup
summary: Cheese kept in an unlabeled container. Food stored on the walk-in freezer floor must be raised 6 inches. Wiping cloths left on prep tables. Cardboard and milk crates used as liners. Grease and residue on cooking equipment, the ice machine, and mop heads.

headline: Widespread rodent droppings; dead mice in traps
summary: About 100 or more small and large rodent droppings found across the grocery, warehouse, storage, and liquor areas. Two dead mice in bait boxes near the waste receptacle. Rodent activity must be eliminated. Also missing thermometers and water-damaged ceiling tiles.

headline: Wiping cloths, duct tape, leaks, and wet floors
summary: Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizer between uses. Duct tape used on a display cooler door is not allowed. Leaking faucet at the scrape sink. Pizza prep hand sink drains slowly. Debris along walls and excess water on the main dishroom floor.

headline: Floors need cleaning near fryers and coffee station
summary: Floors need cleaning around the fryers and along the wall base behind the coffee station.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea kit or procedure
summary: No kit or procedure on site for responding to vomit and diarrhea events. Must maintain both, including a sanitizer rated effective against norovirus. Priority violation noted without citation. Cracked light shield in the rear prep ceiling must be repaired.

headline: Unlabeled rice and sugar; soiled mop head
summary: Rice and sugar stored out of original containers without labels. Soiled mop head not properly stored; mop heads must be hung to prevent insect breeding. No allergen training on site; certified managers must complete training and keep records.

headline: Equipment too large for sink; greasy floors
summary: Some equipment is too large to fully immerse in the three-compartment sink. Facility must use a larger sink, smaller equipment, or an approved manual method. Cookline caster wheels heavily soiled with grease. Nonfunctional equipment stored in basement.

headline: Dead roaches found near cooler and counter
summary: Three dead roaches on the right side of a Coke cooler in the serving line area, and one dead roach under the counter where register tape and napkins are stored. Openings at the front entrance doors must be sealed. Dark buildup on walk-in and sink floors.

headline: Improper knife storage; front door gap
summary: Cook line knives stored improperly between coolers; a knife holder is required. A 1/4 to 1/2 inch gap under the front door needs repair. Men's restroom urinal and sink drain slowly. More food handler training required.

headline: Unused equipment and hole in ceiling
summary: Unused equipment and construction materials in rear, basement, and outdoor walkway must be removed to prevent pest hiding places. A hole in the ceiling and around electrical piping in the rear storage room must be sealed. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Gap under back door; hair restraints lacking
summary: Gap under the back porch door must be repaired to be tight-fitting. Some food handlers lacked hair restraints. Front counter floor is damaged and uneven. Multiple items stored on floor must be six inches up. Complaint inspection passed.

headline: Expired certificates; hair restraint corrected on site
summary: Food handlers prepped without hair restraints; one was given a hat during the inspection, correcting it. Frozen food was in plastic grocery bags. Expired food handler certificates and an expired allergen certificate for a certified manager.

headline: Missing health policies and expired training
summary: Several signed employee health policies missing; citation issued. Also: expired food handler certificates, no manager allergen training, no interior prep cooler thermometer, and a kids' meal default chocolate milk at 140 calories (limit 130).

headline: Hands not washed; food from unapproved source
summary: Food handlers touched faces, phones, and screens, then prepared food without washing hands; citation issued. Baked goods from an unapproved source with inadequate invoice were discarded, about 10 lbs ($80).

headline: No ambient air thermometers in walk-in coolers
summary: Walk-in coolers had no thermometers showing air temperature inside. Inspector instructed the business to provide conspicuous, easily readable thermometers inside all refrigerator units. Complaint re-inspection passed.

headline: Stained cutting boards and greasy drains
summary: Cutting boards with open seams and dark stains must be refinished or replaced. Grease and debris in drains under the three-compartment and espresso dump sinks. Stained ceiling tiles, food splatter on walls, and dust on vent fan need cleaning.

headline: Mouse droppings found; expired spaghetti discarded
summary: About 30–40 mouse droppings were found in several areas, such as behind the freezer and under the three-compartment sink. Ten containers of spaghetti past the seven-day limit were discarded (about 8 lbs, $45). Pest control recommended.

headline: 75+ live flies and rodent droppings found
summary: About 75 or more small live flies across prep, sandwich, and basement areas, plus about 16 rodent droppings under a sausage machine. Pest control service instructed; citation issued. Outside dumpster overflowing with lid open. Re-inspection failed.

headline: Floors behind bar need cleaning
summary: Floors behind the bar must be cleaned and maintained. Canvass inspection passed. No pests were recorded.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer and restroom lid
summary: No thermometer was placed in the bottled beverage reach-in cooler at the front; thermometers must be provided for all hot and cold holding equipment. The all-gender restroom trash receptacle also needs a lid. License inspection passed.

headline: Greasy grills and piping under equipment
summary: Heavy grill equipment in prep area needs cleaning. Grease and food debris on piping underneath equipment must be removed. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: No certified person in charge; 30+ small flies
summary: No person in charge with a City of Chicago sanitation certificate was on site; citation issued. Over 30 small flies found in bar, storerooms, pastry prep, and dishwashing areas. Pest control recommended. Dust was also on ceiling above prep areas.

headline: Utensils stored over sink; missing allergen proof
summary: Clean hanging utensils stored above the three-compartment sink basin is not allowed. Peeling plastic on prep sink to be removed; debris on floors under shelving. No allergen training proof for certified food managers.

headline: No food handler training proof for employees
summary: Re-inspection found no proof of food handler training or certificates for all required employees. Business must provide proof. Canvass re-inspection passed. No pests were recorded.

headline: Expired allergen certificate; missing air thermometers
summary: Several coolers lacked thermometers showing inside air temperature; manager instructed to add them. Certified food manager had an expired food allergen certification and was told to comply. License inspection passed.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; no restroom ventilation
summary: Two-door milk cooler in rear utility room has torn interior gaskets to repair. Dirt and coffee debris under cooling equipment, prep tables, and coffee brewers must be cleaned. Customer restrooms have no mechanical ventilation; must be provided. Complaint passed.

headline: Live fruit flies and sewage leak found
summary: About 10–15 live fruit flies found near mop sink and rear area; pest control recommended. Broken drain under the three-compartment sink leaked wastewater. Management instructed to repair it so dishes can be washed and sanitized. Citation issued.

headline: Roaches, rodent droppings, and dish machine issue
summary: Four large brown roaches on the dish machine and wall; about 100 rodent droppings behind cooking equipment, racks, and freezers. Pest control required before re-inspection. Dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged out of use.

headline: Previous violations uncorrected; bar floor dirty
summary: Previous priority violation from a May 2026 report was still not corrected. Floor around the bar area was not being cleaned. Manager instructed to address it; citation issued. Re-inspection failed.

headline: Greasy vent hood and grill backsplash
summary: Vent hood and grill backsplash had grease and debris over the stove and grill; instructed to clean. No allergen training certificates on site for employees holding certified food manager certificates. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Sink leak, missing food handler and allergen proof
summary: Water leak at the sink stopper under the dish three-compartment sink. Water-stained dining room ceiling tile to be replaced. One or more food handlers lacked training certificate proof; certified food manager (CFM) lacked allergen training proof. Re-inspection passed.

headline: No certified food manager during food service
summary: No valid certified food manager (CFM) on site while burgers, chicken, and fries were prepared and served; citation issued. Also: a handsink detaching from the wall, food debris on floors, unverified food handler certificates, and no manager allergen proof.

headline: No allergen training documentation
summary: No certified food manager with allergen training was on site. Inspector instructed certificate holders to complete training. Documentation must be provided. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Leaking sink faucets and dirty cooler shelving
summary: Three-compartment sink faucets were leaking, shelving inside the rear walk-in cooler was dirty, and a garbage can lid was missing in the employee restroom. Repairs and cleaning were required. No pests were recorded.

headline: Vacuum-packed foods lacked required safety plan
summary: Vacuum-packed meats, fish, foie gras, and pate stored without a city-approved HACCP (food safety control) plan; citation issued. Also: a leak under a three-compartment sink stopper, dirty wall and fryer floor, and dim dish area lighting.

headline: Rusted racks, foil wrapping, dirty grease bin
summary: Rusted racks in the basement walk-in cooler and kitchen near the dish area must be repaired or repainted. Aluminum foil wrapped around equipment must be removed. Outdoor grease receptacle had light buildup and needed cleaning. Inspection passed.

headline: Wiping cloths, leaking cooler, greasy kitchen
summary: Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizing solution. A walk-in prepared-food cooler condenser is leaking water. Hot kitchen equipment, shelves, and floors need detail cleaning; restroom sinks drain slowly; hood filters greasy. Re-inspection passed.

headline: No thermometer; no food handler or allergen proof
summary: Three-door cooler in the rear had no visible thermometer and excessive food residue at bottom. No food handler certificates located; no allergen training proof for City food managers. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: No splashguard; garbage cans without lids
summary: No washable splashguard between exposed hand sink and prep table near cooking stove; must be installed. Restroom garbage receptacles had no lids in women's and unisex restrooms; instructed to provide lidded cans. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Handsink too cool; vinegar rice unverified
summary: Handwashing sink near sushi rice prep reached only 82°F; must reach 100°F minimum (citation issued). Vinegar added to sushi rice without a lab pH letter or on-site pH meter; 5 lbs ($5) discarded. Broken drain stoppers in downstairs three-compartment sink.

headline: Missing sink stoppers, leaks, greasy equipment
summary: Missing stoppers for dish sink and a leak under the three-compartment sink. Grease and dirt on fryers, broiler, grill, and refrigerator interiors; cutting board stained and grooved. Unlabeled spice container and bowls used as scoops. Manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: No proof of food handler training
summary: No proof of food handler training for any food handlers on site. Inspector instructed the business to provide and keep training records at all times. License inspection passed.

headline: Raw wood shelving and cardboard in cooler
summary: Raw wood shelving inside walk-in cooler must be sealed to be smooth and cleanable. Soiled cardboard trays on chip display shelves and cardboard on cooler shelves must be removed and replaced. Short form complaint passed.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers and improper storage
summary: Ice scoop stored on top of ice in bin; knives stored improperly on prep table. Bulk flour and rice containers unlabeled and must be labeled. No proof of food handler training for all food handlers; must provide. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Dishwashing set up improperly; no probe thermometer
summary: An employee washed dishes without a three-compartment sink set up; it was set up after notice and a citation was issued. No probe thermometer for checking food temperatures; one must be provided. Sugar bin in coffee aisle to be relocated.

headline: Flies in prep area; repeat violations, pest entry
summary: About 60 small flies were seen in the rear prep area; citation issued and pest control recommended. Also: gaps at the front entrance and back exit doors allow pest entry, and prior violations were not corrected.

headline: Missing posted certificate and training proof
summary: No valid food service sanitation certificate posted for employees; citation issued. Also: no food handler or allergen training certificates on site, washroom door not self-closing, and soiled mop heads not stored properly. Re-inspection passed with conditions.

headline: Ice buildup and grime in walk-in freezer
summary: Ice buildup inside walk-in freezer must be removed; unused two-door cooler has food buildup; sinks have food debris; grease trap has rust. Walls, floors, and hood filters with dust and debris need cleaning. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: Dead roaches found; refrigerator too warm
summary: Dead roaches on floors and walls throughout, plus roach droppings in foam under the three-compartment sink; must be removed and areas sanitized. Dishwashing-area refrigerator at 46.7°F was tagged out; another unit must be used.

headline: Missing thermometers; door opening; uncovered rice
summary: Cold holding units in rear prep lack thermometers showing air temperature. Small opening in front entrance door must be rodent-proofed. Frozen food in grocery bags in rear freezers; two bulk rice containers uncovered in basement. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Exposed insulation and wall gaps
summary: Exposed insulation on the walk-in freezer ceiling and cooler back wall must be covered with a smooth, cleanable surface. Wall gaps behind the steam table must be sealed. Several items need cleaning, including the deep fryer interior.

headline: Gap under front door; food debris near dumpster
summary: A quarter-inch gap under the front door must be sealed to keep rodents out. Dumpster area had food debris (donuts, bagels) on the ground; citation issued. Bleach bottles stored on the floor must be raised six inches.

headline: Leaking sink drains and greasy hoods
summary: Handwash sink drain pipes in prep and dish areas are leaking; must be repaired. Food and grease buildup on hoods and filters must be cleaned. Pink buildup inside ice machine must be cleaned. One food handler certificate expired; must be updated.

headline: Food containers not stored inverted; no allergen training
summary: Food containers were not stored inverted; they must be stored that way. Certified sanitation manager had no allergen training; must provide. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: Ice machine buildup; previous violations uncorrected
summary: Calcium buildup in the ice machine and its plastic tubes must be cleaned or tubes replaced. Previous core violations not corrected: no food handler training certificate on site and no allergen certificates for food managers.

headline: Stained cutting boards and dirty floors
summary: Serving plates on kitchen shelves must be inverted to prevent dust buildup. Cutting boards with open seams and dark stains must be refinished or replaced. Floors along walls and under equipment, plus walk-in shelves, need cleaning. Hood grease needs detail cleaning.

headline: Grease, ice buildup, and leaking faucet found
summary: Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, ice buildup in freezers, and a leaking three-compartment sink faucet were noted. Handwashing signs were missing. Basement clutter was flagged as a rodent hiding risk. No pests were recorded.

headline: Eggs over produce; pizzas held too cool
summary: Raw eggs were stored above vegetables and prepared foods; the cook removed them. About 10 lbs of pizza, held at 81–83°F with no logs, were discarded. A bowl was washed in a handsink with a soiled towel.

headline: Walk-in cooler food too warm; product discarded
summary: Cold-held foods in the walk-in cooler measured about 45–47°F, above the 41°F-or-below requirement. Manager voluntarily discarded 47 lbs ($285) of product; citation issued. Other items: missing splashguard, ice scoop stored in ice, cardboard shelf liners.

headline: Debris in ice machine; unused equipment stored
summary: Debris encrusted inside ice machine must be removed. Blackened caulk above the three-compartment sink must be removed. Unused mixer and broken chest freezer in basement and outside must be removed to prevent pest hiding. Kitchen ceiling dirty and peeling.

headline: Ice drain into sink; unlabeled, uncovered food
summary: Ice machine drain line still empties into rear three-compartment sink (not corrected from 2024 report); plastic wrap used as sink stoppers. Also: uncovered food in coolers, unlabeled containers, grocery-bag food storage, and clutter. Citation issued.

headline: Bed found in storage; hot water tank leaks
summary: A bed was found in rear storage area beside a refrigerator and food; living quarters are not allowed, so it must be removed. Hot water tank leaks must be repaired. No food handler or allergen training certificates on site.

headline: Meatballs held too cool; no valid certificate
summary: Person in charge (PIC) lacked a valid City food service sanitation certificate; citation issued. Meatballs in hot holding measured 120.7°F; they were reheated on site to 165°F or higher. Also: no cooler thermometer, dirty floors, and no allergen proof.

headline: Ice buildup, unlabeled containers, leaking dish machine
summary: Dry food containers need common-name labels. Walk-in freezer has ice buildup and a broken gasket; milk crates were used to elevate food, which is not allowed. Dish machine leaks; excess water under sink and dish machine. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Expired allergen certificate; damaged wall
summary: Cold-hold unit door gaskets in front prep need cleaning. Wall behind mop sink is damaged and must be sealed and made smooth and cleanable. Certified manager's allergen training certificate was expired; must obtain update. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: No certified manager on site; corrected on site
summary: No certified food service manager on premises at first; one arrived at 10:40 AM, correcting it on site (citation issued). Ice machine has black and pink buildup inside; sanitizer test kit was missing, then delivered before inspection ended.

headline: Food handlers have no certificates
summary: Food handlers were working without food handling certificates. Must provide. Short form complaint passed.

headline: Knife rack debris; slow bar hand sink drain
summary: Exterior of the knife rack had debris buildup and needed cleaning. The bar's exposed hand sink drains slowly and must be repaired and maintained. No pests were recorded.

headline: Certificate copy only; no health policy
summary: Only a copy of the sanitation certificate was first shown; original provided by inspection's end. Missing: employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea procedure and supplies, metal stem thermometer (provided by end), and license number on unit sides.

headline: Broken faucet knob; rust on shelves
summary: Cutting board used for fish has open seams and stains; must be refinished or replaced. Rust on shelves in walk-in coolers. Butcher-area handsink has a broken hot-water knob; two other sinks available. Floors, drains, fan covers need cleaning.

headline: Missing prep sink at bar area
summary: Bar area is missing a prep/dump sink. Must install one in the same area with hot and cold running water under city pressure and maintain it. Canvass inspection passed. No pests were recorded.

headline: No certified manager; door openings found
summary: No City-certified food service sanitation manager on premises; citation issued. Openings in middle of front double doors and at base of rear doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Liquor boxes stored on floor must be elevated six inches.

headline: Dirty shelves, washrooms, and floors
summary: Rear storage shelves and ice cream freezer interior are dirty. Washroom fixtures and floors need cleaning. Floors under chip racks, in dish area, and rear storage are dirty; drains must be cleaned to prevent pest breeding.

headline: Food stored on floor; greasy equipment; repeat violations
summary: Boxed food stored on walk-in floors and wiping cloths left on prep tables. Frozen food kept in plastic grocery bags. Earlier core violations were not corrected. Clutter could create rodent hiding places. No pests were recorded.

headline: Tuna and chicken too warm; food discarded
summary: Tuna and chicken in the prep area measured 48°F, above the 41°F-or-below limit. Person in charge (PIC) discarded 2 lbs ($40) voluntarily; citation issued. Also noted: sink and floor drain residue, and an expired allergen certificate for the manager.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; food on floor
summary: Bulk flour, sugar, and salt containers were not labeled; must be labeled with contents name. Food containers stored on floor in prep and storage areas must be elevated at least six inches. Complaint re-inspection passed.

headline: Over 200 mouse droppings and other serious issues
summary: Over 200 mouse droppings on shelves, counters, and floors, plus over 5 flying insects. Sausages held at 81.1°F were discarded. Sewage leak under three-compartment sink; no hot water at a handsink. Pest control log incomplete.

headline: Some employees lacked hair restraints
summary: Some employees were working without hair restraints. Staff were instructed to wear hair restraints at all times. Canvass inspection passed. No pests were recorded.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training proof
summary: Inspection passed, but a manager had no proof of allergen training. Inspector required allergen training for all City of Chicago food service managers.

headline: Handsink stacked over dump sink; re-inspection failed
summary: Server-station handwashing sink is also used as a dump sink, with another dump sink directly below. Management wrapped it; inspector required removing the dump sink and using the sink only for handwashing. Priority violation; no citation issued.

headline: Liquor on floor; restroom ventilation not working
summary: Liquor was stored on the floor; inspector required shelving six inches up to prevent pest hiding places. Also noted: low water flow at restroom handsinks, no backflow device on the bar ice machine, and non-working restroom ventilation.

headline: Dirty washrooms and burnt-out light
summary: Washroom floors and fixtures are dirty and must be cleaned. Light burnt out in middle prep area under the hood above the ovens; must be replaced. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No verifiable certified food manager (CFM) was on site while eggs, milk, and chicken were prepared and served; citation issued. Passed with conditions.

headline: No food handler training; restroom trash lid missing
summary: Inspector observed no food handler training for employees and no lidded garbage can in staff restrooms. Both must be provided and maintained. No pests were recorded.

headline: Gap under rear door could let in rodents
summary: Inspector found a gap along the bottom of the exterior rear door. It must be made tight-fitting to prevent rodent entry. This license re-inspection passed. No pests were recorded.

headline: Greasy floors, hood, and dusty vents
summary: Floors under equipment, along walls, and in corners had grease, food debris, and dirt. Hood had excessive grease spilled from it. Dust on a walk-in cooler fan, light shields, and vents. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Ice buildup, leaks, rust, and greasy equipment
summary: Walk-in cooler condenser has ice buildup and leaking pipes; no food under it. Rusty, hard-to-clean shelves; broken gaskets; milk crates and cardboard used for elevation and lining. Grease, leaking faucets, broken tiles, and a waste pipe above the ice machine need attention.

headline: Clutter stored on floor in storage closet
summary: Clutter stored on the floor in the rear storage closet. Manager instructed to remove unused articles and equipment to prevent pest hiding places. Canvass inspection passed. No pests were recorded.

headline: Soiled mop heads not stored properly
summary: Soiled mop heads were not stored properly. The manager was instructed to hang them to prevent insect breeding. No pests were recorded. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: No certified manager during hot/cold food prep
summary: No person in charge with a City of Chicago food manager certificate was on site while bacon, sausage, and cut tomatoes were prepared; citation issued. Canvass inspection passed with conditions.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No certified food service manager on site while pizza and chicken were handled and served; instructed to obtain one. Priority violation noted. Condensation line drains into rear handwashing sink; must be moved. Basement food storage needs smooth walls and ceiling.

headline: No food handler certificates on site
summary: Re-inspection passed, but no food handler training certificates were on site. Inspector instructed all employees to complete food handler training and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food
summary: Food handler touched ready-to-eat avocado and radish with bare hands while serving; foods discarded during inspection, citation issued. Also: no gloves used, overflowing dumpsters with lids that won't close, a puddle by the stove, and missing certificates.

headline: Missing thermometer, splash guard; no training
summary: Hot holding unit's display is unclear; internal thermometer required. Splash guard needed between three- and one-compartment sinks. Missing pop cooler door handle; oversized pots don't fit three-compartment sink. No food handler or allergen training provided.

headline: Openings in door and worn cutting board
summary: Small openings in front door frame must be sealed to prevent insect entry. Food stored in plastic grocery bags in reach-in freezer; worn cutting board. Chest freezer needs defrosting. Poor-repair walls and ceiling need fixing.

headline: No certified manager during food prep and service
summary: No certified food manager or posted certificate while ice cream, milk, and other foods were prepared and served; citation issued. Leaking pipe under the chocolate prep area's handwashing sink must be repaired.

headline: No certified food manager on premises
summary: No certified food service manager on site; citation issued. Animal-derived foods that can be served undercooked had no required asterisk advisory. Openings at front and rear doors allow pest entry; front door was propped open.

headline: Missing handwash signs; hair restraint lacking
summary: Handwashing signs were missing in first-floor employee restrooms; the manager installed signs during inspection. A food employee was preparing food without a hair restraint and was instructed to wear one. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: Ice machine, drink nozzles, and floors need cleaning
summary: Ice machine interior has buildup and drink nozzles need cleaning. Floors need cleaning to remove standing water and food debris. All food handlers need hair restraints. Canvass inspection passed. No pests were recorded.

headline: Cooling chicken too warm; 20 lbs discarded
summary: Cooling chicken measured 89°F; logs showed it was made 2 hours and 50 minutes earlier. Manager was told food must cool from 135°F to 70°F within two hours; 20 lbs ($100) discarded; citation issued. Ice machine has mineral buildup.

headline: Grease buildup, torn gasket, rainwater in basement
summary: Torn gasket on prep cooler and reach-in unit. Grease buildup on equipment, walls, floors, and shelves; dust and debris on floors. Rainwater came through basement bricks near the water heater and must be sealed. Re-inspection passed.

headline: No certified food manager; low handwash water temperature
summary: No certified food manager on site while beef and hummus were prepared and served; citation issued. Men's restroom handsink water measured 64°F, below the required 100°F minimum; citation issued. Also no sanitizer test kit on site.

headline: Exposed wastewater pipes above food prep
summary: Waste water piping above the front food prep area is unprotected from contamination; ceiling or encasement required (priority violation). Also: a prep sink must be installed, construction materials cleared from a hallway closet, and manager allergen proof provided.

headline: Water gushing from dish machine pipe
summary: Water was gushing from under the cap of a pipe at the back of the dish machine; must be repaired and maintained. Dirt, dust, and food debris on sides of non-cooking equipment must be cleaned to prevent possible pest hiding places.

headline: Unused equipment to remove; general upkeep issues
summary: Unused equipment in rear storage to be removed to prevent pest hiding places. General upkeep: rust in freezer baskets, dirty shelves and floors, damaged floor tile, stained ceiling tiles, cobwebs, and dust on a vent. License inspection passed.

headline: Prep refrigerator too warm; tagged out
summary: Prep refrigeration unit measured 71°F, above the 41°F-or-below standard; unit tagged until repaired. No food was in it during inspection. Dust debris on floors from recent construction must be cleaned. No citation issued.

headline: Drains and floors need detail cleaning
summary: Drains need detail cleaning to prevent insect activity. Walk-in cooler floors under shelving, bar floor under equipment, and rear kitchen air vents with dust need cleaning. New manager had no allergen training on site. Complaint passed.

headline: Dishwasher not sanitizing; held out of use
summary: Dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm chemical level; it is tagged and held until repaired (citation issued). Ice machine interior, worn door weather stripping, dirty equipment, floors, walls, and hood filters also need cleaning or repair.

headline: Grease, debris, and a large wall hole
summary: Cooking equipment sides had grease and food debris. Walk-in freezer floor had debris and frozen food. A large hole was found in the rear prep wall and must be repaired to help keep pests out. Dirt was found under front food service equipment.

headline: No soap; cold unit at 58.5F tagged
summary: Rear prep handwash sinks had no soap and a citation was issued. Ice machine panel had black and pink mold-like substance that touched ice, and a citation was issued. Cold holding unit at 58.5F was tagged. Wiping cloths and the three-compartment faucet need attention.

headline: Pest control log not kept up to date
summary: Pest control log was not maintained. Last pest service entry was dated 6/11/25. Management told at least two pest service visits per year are required. Citation issued. Ice scoop was stored on top of the ice machine.

headline: Fryer vents cleaned on site
summary: Vents above the fryers in the WAZ station were dirty and were cleaned on site during the inspection.

headline: No certified manager while serving TCS foods
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while chicken and pizza were handled and served. Management was instructed to obtain one. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint.

headline: Missing floor grout in bar
summary: Floor tiles in the bar area are missing grout. The manager was instructed to re-grout the tiles as needed.

headline: Serving plates not inverted on shelves
summary: Serving plates stored on shelves in the kitchen prep area were not inverted. Staff were instructed to invert them to prevent dust buildup.

headline: No hot water in washrooms; fixed during inspection
summary: Four washrooms had no hot running water, with temperatures of 50.2F to 72.0F. By the end of inspection, water reached a minimum of 100F. Citation issued. Ice machine interior had encrusted debris and pots were not stored inverted.

headline: Heavy grime on equipment; summary report blocked
summary: Microwave interior, oven, and front shelves were heavily soiled with food debris and spills. The inspection summary was blocked by another sign, so it was not fully visible to the public. A new summary was provided. Citation issued.

headline: Grime on equipment, walls, and floors
summary: Grime built up on equipment throughout the facility. Food spills and grime covered walls and floors in the entire prep area. Person in charge was instructed to detail clean.

headline: Macaroni and cheese held too cool; discarded
summary: About 12 lbs of macaroni and cheese was held at 103.6F to 129F in hot holding units. All was discarded and hot-holding rules were reviewed. Missing waste receptacles at handwash sinks and milk crates used for shelving.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; wall damage
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving in prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor. Reach-in cooler interiors need cleaning. A 2x2 hole in a dry storage wall and peeling paint also need repair.

headline: No certified manager; pest log not maintained
summary: Person in charge had no city certified food manager certificate. No certified manager was on site while corn, melon, yogurt, and ice cream were prepared. Pest log was not maintained; last pest report was dated 2/15/25. Citations issued.

headline: Grease, debris, and torn freezer gasket
summary: Grease and food debris were on the exterior of cooking equipment and prep tables. Debris was on floors along walls and corners. A torn gasket was on the second-floor walk-in freezer. Staff were instructed to clean and replace gaskets as needed.

headline: Prep cooler not working; no window screen
summary: Prep cooler was not working and must be repaired to hold 41F or lower. The truck lacks a license number on its sides. No screen was found on the serving window, and one must be provided and maintained.

headline: No certified manager while serving TCS foods
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while deli meats and chicken were handled and served. Management was instructed to obtain one. Walk-in cooler had inadequate lighting and dark areas for food storage.

headline: Ice machine needs cleaning; mop sink leak
summary: Ice machine interior needed cleaning and ice had to be removed. Reach-in cooler gaskets were in poor repair. A mop sink leak and drain lines needed correction. Serving line floors and walls, fryer hood, and air vents needed cleaning. No allergen certificate was on site.

headline: Exposed insulation and dust in prep area
summary: Exposed insulation was found above the ovens in the prep area. Dust had built up on walls, ceilings, and duct equipment in the same area. Manager was instructed to repair and clean.

headline: Ice machine door and hood filter buildup
summary: Light buildup was on the ice machine door. Grill hood filters had buildup. A food handler on site lacked a food handler certificate and must obtain one.

headline: Only one valid food handler training available
summary: Only one valid food handler training certificate was available for all employees. The manager was instructed to provide training for all employees.

headline: Missing handwashing signs in men's restroom
summary: Men's restroom was missing handwashing signs. The inspector instructed the facility to post them.

headline: Dead insects in basement; damaged boards and shelves
summary: Dead insects were on the basement floor and must be removed and the area detail cleaned. Cutting boards with open seams and stains need refinishing or replacement. Raw wood shelves in produce prep must be sealed. A hole in a basement wall near hot food prep needs repair.

headline: Leaking cooler line; missing handler training
summary: Walk-in cooler condenser line was leaking into a large container and must be repaired and drained properly. A large cutting board was heavily stained with deep grooves. Food handler training is missing for employees.

headline: Certified manager missing allergen training
summary: The city certified manager is missing allergen training. The manager must obtain it and keep proof on site.

headline: No certified manager while handling TCS foods
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while fish and beef were handled. Management was instructed to obtain a certified food service manager.

headline: Ribs thawed in sink; leaking handsink
summary: Ribs were thawing in a compartment of water in the three-compartment sink. Staff were told to thaw under cold running water. Handwash sink leaked from the P-trap. Staff in prep area lacked hair restraints. Cutting boards and fryers needed cleaning.

headline: Missing handler training; ice and clutter
summary: Food handlers on site lacked food handler training and must obtain it. Personal care items were stored with single-service articles. Excess ice was in an upright freezer, and papers were cluttering shelves. A cutting board was stained and grooved.

headline: No certified manager; no sanitizer test strips
summary: No city certified food manager was on premises while sausage and cheese were prepared. Citation issued. No sanitizing test strips were on site. A three-door prep cooler had ripped gaskets. Light bulbs were out above the dish area and inside the walk-in cooler.

headline: Ice machine buildup; expired allergen training
summary: Light calcium buildup was found inside the ice machine and must be cleaned. Certified food managers had expired allergen training and must renew it.

headline: Grime buildup near rear exterior door
summary: Grime had built up in the rear area near the exterior door. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain the area.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; cold lamb too warm
summary: Dish machine in use had 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged held for inspection. Cooked lamb shanks held at 51.4F to 54.7F were discarded (about 20 lbs, $100). Citation issued. A rear handwash sink was blocked and no paper towels were provided.

headline: Broken floor tiles; missing allergen certificate
summary: Broken floor tiles at the front prep tables must be repaired or replaced. One certified food service manager did not have an allergen training certificate and must provide proof at all times.

headline: Dish machines not sanitizing; tagged on site
summary: Third-floor low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine. Wash gauges on two bar dish machines showed an error. All were corrected on site and tagged held for inspection. Menu lacked raw or undercooked food advisory. Front door has gaps.

headline: No certified manager on site at start
summary: No certified food sanitation manager was on site when food handling began. A manager arrived about 8:55 AM with a valid certificate. Citation issued. Also noted missing handwashing signs, missing thermometers, and dusty vents.

headline: 60-65 flying insects; more pest control needed
summary: About 60-65 flying insects were seen on walls, ceiling, and cardboard boxes in the rear food storage and dishwashing area. Additional pest control service is needed. Citation issued.

headline: Heavy grease and dust on hood and vents
summary: Heavy dust and grease built up on the ventilation hood and filters above cooking equipment. Dust also built up on ceiling vents and walls throughout the premises. Must be cleaned and maintained at all times.

headline: Leaking backflow device; missing ceiling tiles
summary: Backflow device above the utility sink was leaking and must be repaired. Ceiling tiles are missing over several areas. Damaged floor tile was in front of a tagged cold holding unit. Two managers lacked allergen proof. Base coving near the utility sink was missing.

headline: Sandwich cooler too warm; unit tagged
summary: Sandwich station cooler held eggs, sausage, bacon, and other items at 46F to 47F, and about 20 lbs (about $150) was discarded. Cooler air measured 45.5F, and the unit was tagged and must not be used until reinspected. Cutting board had deep cuts.

headline: Boxes stored on floor; wall holes
summary: Boxes and beverage cases were stored on floors in the basement, liquor storage, and walk-in cooler and must be elevated six inches. Loose faucet at three-compartment sink in Westside bar. Washroom doors were not self-closing. Holes in the wall above the utility sink.

headline: Missing handler training; prep sink faucet removed
summary: Missing food handler training for employees on site. The faucet was removed from the prep sink and must be repaired. Missing handwash signage at the front sink.

headline: Ice machine mold; no certified manager
summary: Person in charge lacked a certified food manager certificate, and none was on site while TCS foods were prepared. Ice machine had thick black and pink buildup dripping onto packaged ice. Unit tagged. Citations issued. A food handler lacked training proof.

headline: Boxes on ground outside back door
summary: Boxes were on the ground at the rear exterior by the back door. Staff were instructed to clean the area and remove the boxes.

headline: Food handlers lacked beard restraints
summary: Food handlers were not wearing beard restraints. Staff must wear them at all times when preparing food.

headline: Soiled floor drain; heavy dust and debris
summary: Floor drain under the bar three-compartment sink was lined with soiled plastic and zip ties and must be cleaned. A backflow device cap in poor repair was noted. Floors under sinks and the dish machine had heavy dried food and dust debris.

headline: Beef held too warm; 35 pounds discarded
summary: Two containers of beef in the prep area were held at 64.9F, above the 41F limit. Person in charge discarded 35 lbs (about $150). Citation issued. Paint was bubbled above a doorway and two ceiling tiles had water stains.

headline: One dead cockroach found near dish machine
summary: One dead cockroach was found on a wall near the dish machine. The employee removed it during the inspection. Grease spills were noted outside near the oil tank, and personal cups were stored in the prep area.

headline: No certified manager; moldy ice machine
summary: No certified food manager was on site while open. Citation issued. Black mold-like buildup was found inside the ice machine and on ice for human consumption and must be cleaned and sanitized. A food handler lacked a hair restraint.

headline: Open can storage; dirty coolers and debris
summary: Condensed milk was stored in an open original can and must be moved to a food-grade container. Interior surfaces of all kitchen coolers and freezers need detail cleaning. Leaves and debris were under and around the outside dumpster.

headline: Five food handlers lacked training proof; no spill kit
summary: No vomit and diarrhea spill kit or written procedure was on site. Five food handlers had no proof of food handler training. Also noted a gap at an entrance door base, a damaged cooler gasket, and missing backflow devices on coffee and espresso machines.

headline: Water-stained restroom ceiling tile
summary: Water-stained ceiling tile was found in the women's restroom. The person in charge was instructed to repair it.

headline: Several handlers lacked certificates; ceiling openings
summary: Several food handlers did not have a food handler certificate on the premises and must show proof of training. Small openings and chipped paint were found in the ceiling above the rear prep and dish areas and must be sealed and repainted.

headline: Hood light bulbs out over fryer
summary: Both light bulbs in the hood over the fryer area in the front coffee bar were not working. They must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Dead flies, door gap, and food on floor
summary: Dead flies were on the women's washroom floor. A 1/4-inch gap was found under the front entrance doors and must be sealed. Food was stored on the floor in walk-in coolers and freezer. Washrooms have no ventilation.

headline: Clogged drain bypasses grease trap
summary: Clog under the three-compartment sink caused a leak that bypassed the grease trap and drained to a nearby floor drain. The clog must be removed. Tools and personal items were stored next to food and must be moved away.

headline: No food handler training proof for any employee
summary: No proof of food handler training or certificates was provided for any employees, including bus staff. The facility was instructed to provide them.

headline: Cardboard shelf liner in dry storage
summary: Cardboard was used as a shelf liner in the rear dry storage area. The manager must remove it and provide a smooth, easily cleaned, non-absorbent surface.

headline: Cold food too warm; cooler tagged; citation
summary: Cooked rice was held at 50F and 10 lbs was discarded. A cooler at the top of the stairs had air temperature of 50F and was tagged. Handwash sink water reached only 78F, below the required 100F. Outside receptacles overflowing.

headline: Unclean ice machines; no hair restraints
summary: Top interior and exterior of both basement ice machines were not clean and must be cleaned and sanitized. Food servers in the kitchen lacked hair restraints. Cutting boards were stained and grooved. A hole in the kitchen ceiling was found.

headline: Mold in ice machine; citation issued
summary: Pink mold-like substance dripped from the inside of the ice machine onto ice for human consumption. Ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned and sanitized. Citation issued. Rear three-door cooler had a torn gasket, and tape was used to repair a deli cooler lid.

headline: Restroom fan broken; manager lacks allergen proof
summary: A ventilation fan in one restroom was not working and must be repaired or replaced. The certified manager did not have an allergen training certificate and must provide proof.

headline: No certified manager; slimy ice maker
summary: No person in charge with a certified manager certificate was present, and no certified manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared. Citation issued. Black slimy substance dripped from the ice maker into ice for humans. Expired food handler certificate and no allergen training.

headline: Uncovered flour, soiled cloths, dusty equipment
summary: Flour bulk container was not covered near a handwash sink. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables. Single-service items were not inverted. Coolers, freezers, and equipment had dust and spills. Utility sink lacked a backflow device.

headline: No valid food sanitation certificate on site
summary: No valid city food sanitation certificate was provided for employees on site. A certified manager must be on premises at all times. Citation issued.

headline: Door gaps, no screen, and no handler training
summary: Gaps under front and rear doors and no screen on the basement door could allow insects in. Damaged cooler door parts, grease, and chipping paint need attention. Racks must be raised to prevent rodent harborage. No food handler training was provided.

headline: No certified manager on duty
summary: No valid city certified manager was on duty or on site while TCS foods were handled and prepared. Citation issued. Ice machine water line was draining into the three-compartment sink and must drain to a floor drain. Air vent cover over the prep counter was dirty.

headline: Uncorrected 2022 violation; no handler training
summary: Flour and salt containers were not labeled. Dust and grease built up on filters by the pizza oven. A core violation from 2022 was not corrected. All employees lacked food handler training. Citation issued.

headline: No food handler certificates or health policy on site
summary: No verifiable employee health policy and no food handler certificates were on site. No allergen training was on site. The manager bought a food thermometer during the inspection. Cutting board and cooler gasket need repair.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure; front door gap
summary: No written vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure was posted or available on site. The front door was not rodent-proof. Outdoor refuse area had trash and construction debris. Wall and floor gaps and broken light bulbs were also noted.

headline: Uncorrected violations; no backflow devices on ice machines
summary: Sanitation managers had no allergen training certificates. Previous priority violations from 3/27/25 were not corrected. Two ice machines lacked backflow prevention devices. Citation issued.

headline: Exit doors not rodent-proof; ice machine buildup
summary: Exit doors in the venue bar were not rodent-proof at the bottom. Black buildup was in the basement ice machine. Gender-neutral restrooms lacked lidded receptacles. Certified manager lacked allergen training proof. Handwash signage and prep cooler thermometers were also missing.

headline: No certified manager; overflowing dumpster
summary: No person in charge with a valid city sanitation certificate was present. No certified manager was on duty while food was prepared and served. Citation issued. Food boxes and single-service items were stored on floors. Overflowing dumpster lids could not close. Citation issued.

headline: Cooked and raw meat held too warm; discarded
summary: Cooked roast beef at 110.8F to 115.9F and raw chicken at 50.7F were stored in the walk-in cooler. No time and temperature log was provided. About 35 lbs was discarded. Broken thermometer and several earlier violations not corrected. Citation issued.

headline: No handler certificates; summary report not posted
summary: Food items in refrigerators were stored in grocery bags and must be moved to food-grade containers. Food handler certificates were not on site, a previous core violation not corrected. Previous inspection summary was not posted. A new summary was given.

headline: Equipment too large for three-compartment sink
summary: Some equipment cannot fully fit in the three-compartment sink. Facility must install a larger sink, use smaller equipment, or use an approved manual warewashing method.

headline: Slow-draining handsink in front prep
summary: Handsink in the front prep area drains slowly and must be repaired. The person in charge was instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: Worn cooler door gaskets need replacing
summary: Worn door gaskets on a two-door reach-in cooler must be repaired or replaced. No other issues were listed in this re-inspection.

headline: One live roach; food stored on floor
summary: One live roach was seen at the front counter near the ice cream freezer. Citation issued and pest control was advised. Food containers and single-service items were stored on the basement floor and must be raised six inches.

headline: Glass washer attachments removed; allergen proof missing
summary: Nonfunctioning glass washer attachments on handwash sinks in both bars were removed and the holes sealed. One city certified manager had no proof of allergen training and must provide it.

headline: No sanitizer test kit; kit provided on site
summary: No chemical test kit for sanitizer was on site, and a citation was issued. A test kit was provided at the end of the inspection. Table bottoms had buildup. Walk-in cooler floors in the rear prep area had food debris.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; unit tagged
summary: Dish machine was not installed to properly sanitize dishes and was tagged for inspection. A plumber must be contacted. No washable splashguard exists between the hot food prep sink and cooler. Food debris and spills were found throughout.

headline: Earlier violations not fixed; no handler certificates
summary: Heavy debris was found in the bar and on the cook line floor. Previous violations were not corrected, including frost buildup on coolers and grease and dust on hoods. No food handler certificates were on site. Citation issued.

headline: Missing thermometers, splash guard, and labels
summary: Some prep coolers need internal thermometers. A splash guard is needed between sinks. Food containers need labels. Crates used for paper goods must be replaced. Debris must be cleaned from shelving and coolers. Mop heads must be removed from the mop sink.

headline: Sausage thawed improperly; several upkeep issues
summary: Person in charge was thawing sausage links at the cookline. Told to thaw under running water or inside the cooler. Also noted a rusted freezer door, a cutting board with deep cuts, and a bathroom exhaust fan not working. No allergen training for the certified manager.

headline: Leaking dish machine; damaged walls and ceilings
summary: Dish machine door was not closing properly and leaked onto the floor. Broken basement freezers, one with exposed insulation, must be removed or repaired. Wall caulking, missing coving, tape used as electrical covering, and damaged ceiling were also noted.

headline: Ice machine buildup; floor drain soil
summary: Calcium buildup was found inside the ice machine, and the manager was instructed to clean it. Soil buildup was found inside the floor drain under the three-compartment sink.

headline: Grease buildup; worn floors and walls
summary: Grease and food debris built up on many surfaces, including the dish machine, which must be delimed. Floor debris along walls must be cleaned. Loose floor in walk-in freezer, missing wall bases, and peeling painted concrete floors must be repaired.

headline: No certificate posted; no sanitizer test kit
summary: No valid city food sanitation certificate was posted on site. Citation issued. A fusion sink on the second-floor bar is not accepted and must be replaced. No test kit for sanitizer was on site, and a citation was issued. Basement floor tiles are damaged.

headline: Unapproved insect device removed; bags reused
summary: An unapproved insect control device was hanging above the prep area and must be removed. Single-service bags were being reused to store produce in the walk-in cooler. Lighting in the walk-in cooler was insufficient.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; cold food too warm
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were found in sales, dishwashing, beverage, and meat areas. A licensed pest control company was required. Chorizo held at 58.6F was discarded on site (about 50 lbs, $150). Citation issued.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; no allergen proof
summary: Handwashing sinks in the rear food prep and front service counter lacked signs. The dough proofer needed cleaning. The certified food manager was on site but had no proof of allergen training.

headline: About 15 live flying insects in prep area
summary: About 15 live small flying insects were on the walls of the front food prep area. Additional pest control service is needed. Citation issued. A food handler without a food handler certificate was also noted.

headline: Leaking drain; condensation drips onto freezer
summary: Dish area handwash sink drain was leaking and must be repaired. Ceiling condensation was dripping onto the chest freezer. Women's washroom lacked a covered trash receptacle. Food allergen training certificate has expired and must be updated.

headline: Ice bin dirty; food stored on floor
summary: Ice bin interior needed cleaning and must be kept clean. Food containers were stored on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised six inches. Cardboard and milk crates were used as shelving and must be removed.

headline: Water-damaged ceiling tiles; greasy hood filters
summary: Several water-damaged ceiling tiles in the dish machine room must be replaced. Grease had built up on the ventilation hood filters and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Low handsink pressure; floor drain debris
summary: Low water pressure at the handwash sink must be repaired. Debris was found inside floor drains and on the floor under equipment, along walls, and in corners in the prep area. Manager was instructed to clean.

headline: No hot water; no certificates posted
summary: No city sanitation certificate was posted while food was prepared. Citation issued. Hot water was not available throughout the premises. Three-compartment sink water measured 70F and must be above 110F. No food handler or allergen certificates were on site.

headline: Leaking sinks and dirty slicer
summary: Deli meat slicer was dirty and must be cleaned more often. Leaks were found at the front three-compartment sink faucet and rear sink pipe. Walk-in cooler walls were dusty and washroom floors were dirty. Filters above the grill need cleaning.

headline: Improper storage; rust on hood filters
summary: Wiping cloths were stored improperly on prep surfaces. Exposed utensils were stored in a bin in the dish area. A mop was stored improperly. Exposed brick walls and ceiling, basement clutter, rusted hood filters, and missing light shields were noted.

headline: Exit door gaps; hair restraints; trash lids
summary: Middle exit screen door was not rodent or insect proof, with 1/4 to 1/2 inch gaps. Food and dish staff lacked hair restraints. Women's and unisex restroom trash cans had no lids. A coving tile was missing in the women's restroom.

headline: No health policy, spill kit, thermometer, or certificates
summary: No employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea kit, or food thermometer was on site. No food handler certificates were on site. Restroom door was not self-closing and trash had no lids. Soiled mop heads were not stored properly.

headline: Bare-hand food contact, black slime in ice machine
summary: Complaint inspection failed. A food handler touched ready-to-eat bread, bacon, and a fried egg with bare hands, a priority violation. Black slime was dripping into ice. Cooked rice (55.5°F), pork, and chicken were held too warm and were discarded.

headline: Plastic tape on ice machine; grease drip on hood
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Plastic tape repairing the non-food-contact interior of the ice machine was not easy to clean and must be removed. The ventilation hood had grease drip buildup along fire suppression lines that must be cleaned.

headline: Minor floor debris noted during complaint visit
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Inspector noted minor accumulated debris on floors throughout the facility and instructed staff to clean.

headline: Food stored on floor; slow hand sink drain
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Food containers were stored on the floor next to the walk-in cooler and must be elevated at least 6 inches. A food handler wore a stained top and must wear clean clothing. The pizza prep hand sink drained slowly.

headline: Dish machine failed to sanitize; tagged out of use
summary: Passed with conditions. The high-temperature dish machine did not properly sanitize after several tries. Final rinse read 156.5°F, and the external temperature display was not working. The machine is tagged and must not be used until repaired. Staff must use the three-compartment sink. Also noted: hair restraints not worn and a slimy substance inside the dish machine.

headline: Hand sink water too cold; small flies found
summary: Complaint inspection failed. Handwashing sinks measured 68.5-91.8°F, below the required 100°F. Shellstock tags lacked sale or serve dates. Cold TCS foods were held at 45-52°F and discarded. About 40 small flies were found, and the sushi cooler was tagged.

headline: Leaking and slow-draining hand sinks; allergen proof missing
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Hand-washing sinks behind the main bar and small bar had a leaking drain and a slow drain. Management was told to repair them. The certified food manager (CFM) had no allergen training certificate.

headline: Rodent droppings and missing HACCP logbooks
summary: Canvass inspection failed. About 50 rodent droppings were found throughout the basement, a priority violation. No logbooks showed compliance with the approved HACCP plan (a written food safety plan). A prior core violation for a missing backflow device at the mop sink was not corrected.

headline: Hand sinks too cold and missing soap and towels
summary: Complaint inspection failed. Hand sinks at the front prep area measured 52°F, below the required 100°F, a priority violation. Several hand sinks throughout the establishment had no soap or paper towels, also a priority violation. A citation was issued.

headline: No certified manager on site during food service
summary: Short form complaint passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while chicken wings and beef were prepared, handled, and served, a priority violation. Water-stained ceiling tiles above the dish sink must be replaced.

headline: Written procedure needed for ice cream machine
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. A written procedure is needed for washing, rinsing, and sanitizing the ice cream machine. The manager was instructed to provide one.

headline: No certified manager and no employee health policy
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. No City of Chicago certified manager with a valid original certificate was on site while milk and ice cream were prepared and served, a priority violation. No written employee health policy was on site, also a priority violation.

headline: Ice machine and cooler condenser buildup
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Slight buildup was inside the ice machine and must be cleaned and maintained. Ice buildup on the prep-area one-door cooler condenser must be removed.

headline: No pizza warmer thermometer; peeling freezer wall
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The pizza warmer had no thermometer to measure air temperature inside. Peeling plastic covered walk-in freezer stainless walls, which must be removed.

headline: No city-certified manager; sink and dish machine issues
summary: Passed with conditions. No City of Chicago certified manager was on site during TCS food service, a priority violation. Hot water was missing at both restroom hand sinks and was restored by the end of inspection. The low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer and was tagged out of use. Door gap also noted.

headline: More than 20 small flies found throughout facility
summary: Canvass inspection failed. Over 20 small flies were seen in restrooms, the front bar, basement dry storage, and the cold kitchen. The manager was told to reduce the fly population. A three-compartment sink also did not drain properly and was to be serviced.

headline: No certified manager present during food prep
summary: Passed with conditions. Food handlers prepared TCS foods without an original City of Chicago certified manager on site. No citation was issued. The rear exit door had a 1/2-inch gap that must be rodent-proofed. The women's restroom had no covered trash receptacle.

headline: Mouse droppings found; no vomit cleanup kit on site
summary: License inspection failed. About 30 mouse droppings were found under the serving counter, in a restroom, storage room, and office. Also noted: no vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit, a front door not fully rodent-proofed, and items stored outside the dumpster area.

headline: Expired food handler certificates
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Several food handler certificates had expired. The manager was instructed to update them.

headline: Missing signage and trash cover; lightbulb out
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. The women's employee restroom had no hand-washing signage and an uncovered trash can. Wiping cloths were improperly stored. Cookware was not inverted, ice buildup was on the freezer condenser, and a grill light bulb was out.

headline: Mouse droppings found; leaking faucet and no test kit
summary: Canvass inspection failed. About 15 mouse droppings were found near a machine and behind DJ equipment. Pallets and cardboard were used for storage and shelf lining. No quaternary ammonium test kit was on site. A leaking three-compartment sink faucet and missing trash cover were also noted.

headline: Labels, cutting boards, racks, and floors need work
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Inspector found worn ingredient labels, stained and grooved cutting boards, rusty walk-in racks, a leaking faucet base, and heavy grease and food buildup on floors, walls, and hood filters.

headline: Hand-washing lapses; no hand sink in new prep area
summary: Canvass inspection failed. A dishwasher handled dirty dishes and then clean dishes without washing hands, a priority violation. A new cold prep area had no hand sink. A gap was at the garbage door, and food handlers lacked hair restraints. No food handler or allergen training was on site.

headline: Ice machine residue and worn equipment covers noted
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Inspector found debris inside the ice machine, loose and bolt-less cooler top covers, rusted floor drains, dusty ceiling tiles, and a missing light shield. Staff were told to clean, repair, and maintain.

headline: Expired certificates and leaking sinks; floors dirty
summary: Canvass inspection failed. Rear prep floors had dirt and debris. Hot water handle, three-compartment faucet, and rear hand-sink drainpipe were leaking from a prior report. Food handler certificates were expired, a priority violation.

headline: Missing allergen certificates and sink stoppers
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The new certified food manager had no allergen training certificate on site. The three-compartment sink needs proper stoppers. A cooler item needs a common-name label.

headline: Unlabeled food, dirty racks, and damaged walls
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Bulk containers lacked labels, and pre-packaged baked foods had incomplete labels. Stained dish racks, a dirty dish machine, and food debris in coolers and freezers were noted. Several walls, tiles, and caulking need repair. Staff must wear hair restraints and food handler records are missing.

headline: Unsafe cold holding and missing shellfish tags
summary: Canvass inspection failed. Several TCS foods were held at 46-52°F, above the 41°F limit. About $560 of seafood and tofu was discarded. Oysters and mussels had no shellstock tags. The server station had no nearby hand sink, and walk-in freezer boxes were on the floor.

headline: Dirty coolers, sinks, grills, and floors
summary: Short form complaint inspection passed. Interiors of reach-in coolers, sinks, tables, and grills were not clean. Floors in the main kitchen and bar areas were not clean. Items must be cleaned.

headline: No sink signage, trash cover, or allergen certificate
summary: License inspection passed. No signage marked the three-compartment sink's wash, rinse, and sanitize steps. The restroom had no covered trash can. Hood filters had grease buildup. The certified manager had no allergen certificate on site.

headline: Cooler gaskets damaged; food spills under cooler
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Gaskets inside the dessert shake cooler were in disrepair and must be repaired. Food spills under the chicken thawing cooler must be cleaned.

headline: Cooked rice cooling covered; thermometer bent
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Cooked rice was cooling covered in the walk-in cooler and must be loosely covered or uncovered while cooling. Bulk rice containers were unlabeled. A bent, dented metal probe thermometer must be replaced.

headline: Food debris under pizza oven and dish equipment
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Food debris was on floors along walls under the pizza oven and dishwashing equipment and must be cleaned. Dust was on fan guards in both customer restrooms.

headline: Worn cutting boards and greasy equipment
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Worn cutting boards must be replaced. Walk-in cooler shelves, cooking equipment, and ingredient buckets had heavy buildup. Floors in front and rear prep areas needed detail cleaning. The hood vent needed grease removal to prevent drips onto food.

headline: Dish racks stored on floor; low hot water pressure
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Dish racks were stored on the floor under the dishwasher and must be raised. A basement hand sink had very low hot water pressure and must be repaired. Clutter was near hot cooking equipment.

headline: Thermometers missing in reach-in coolers; dirty floors
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Several one-door reach-in coolers were missing internal thermometers. Outdoor waste bin lids were cracked or missing parts. Floors under equipment in the dry storage and drive-thru areas were soiled.

headline: Debris outside dumpster; mop drying improperly
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Debris and trash were outside the dumpster and the area must be maintained. A mop was drying improperly and must be dried correctly. Corrected on site.

headline: Dead insects on basement floors; clutter to remove
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Basement floors had dirt, debris, and dead insects near the rear exit. Unnecessary items must be removed to prevent pest harboring. Water-damaged ceiling tiles and a damaged wall needed repair. No food handler training proof was on site.

headline: Hair restraints, leaks, and dusty vents noted
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Bakery employees were not wearing hair restraints, and a milk cooler lacked a working thermometer. A faucet base leaked at the prep sink. Dirt and dust were on floor drains and vents, and the juicing area needed more lighting.

headline: Black slime in self-serve ice machine
summary: Passed with conditions. The self-serve ice machine in the dining area had black slime buildup contaminating ice. A priority violation was cited, and the machine must be cleaned, sanitized, and maintained. Also noted: unlabeled bulk containers, a torn cooler gasket, and damaged floor tiles.

headline: Sink leak and phone on cutting board, corrected
summary: Canvass inspection passed. A small amount of pink residue was in the kitchen ice machine. The three-compartment sink faucet leaked. An employee's cell phone was on a cutting board in the food prep area and was removed on site.

headline: No employee health policy or backflow device
summary: License inspection passed with conditions. No employee health policy was on site, which is required. A backflow prevention device (keeps dirty water from flowing back into clean supply) was missing at the mop sink faucet. The employee restroom door did not self-close.

headline: No health policy, cleanup kit, or allergen certificate
summary: Complaint inspection failed. No employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit, or allergen certificate was on site. Cold foods in the walk-in cooler measured 45-57°F and were discarded, about 50 pounds. No hand towels were at the dish-area sink, and a rear door needed rodent-proofing.

headline: Raw wood and damaged floor tiles behind counter
summary: License inspection passed. Raw wood surfaces behind the front counter must be sealed to be smooth and easily cleaned. Missing and damaged floor tiles behind the front counter must be replaced.

headline: No paper towels at prep-area hand sink
summary: Canvass inspection failed. No paper towels were at an exposed hand-washing sink in the prep area, and paper towels must be kept there at all times. Also noted: a leaking three-compartment sink, grease on cooking equipment, no covered waste bin in the women's restroom, and unused items that could attract pests.

headline: Core violations uncorrected; no working thermometer
summary: Complaint inspection failed. Uncorrected prior violations included no working thermometer in a hot holding cabinet and grease and food debris on cabinets, a convection oven, and prep tables. Broken floor tiles under the deep fryers must be replaced. A priority citation was issued.

headline: Mouse droppings found in several areas
summary: Complaint inspection failed. About 60 mouse droppings were found: 10 under the front prep hand sink, 10 on a beverage station shelf, and 40 in the side storage area. Droppings must be removed and areas sanitized, and pest control was recommended.

headline: Cluttered closet and no allergen proof for managers
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Clutter in the sounds closet and shared back stairway must be removed. Floors in the sump pump closet need cleaning. No proof of allergen training was on site for certified food managers.

headline: Wiping cloths and cooler gaskets need cleaning
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Wiping cloths were not stored properly and must be kept in sanitizing solution. Reach-in cooler and freezer interiors, lower surfaces, and gaskets had dirt and debris. Toilet room and floors need cleaning, and the rear hood was dirty.

headline: Uncovered trash cans in restrooms
summary: License inspection passed. Trash receptacles in restrooms had no covers. Covers must be provided and maintained.

headline: Unscreened openings and missing food handler proof
summary: Canvass inspection failed. A kitchen window was missing its screen and a kitchen door was propped open with a torn curtain, which must be fixed. Cardboard was used for cut orange containers and as floor matting. No food handler or allergen training proof was on site.

headline: Rodent droppings found; no certified manager on site
summary: Canvass inspection failed. About 45 mouse and 20 rat droppings were found on floors, shelving, food prep tables, and food containers. No certified food manager was on site with the original certificate, a priority violation. Pest control was recommended.

headline: Worn gaskets, grease buildup, and damaged floors
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Worn cooler door gaskets, a damaged fan guard, and missing hot holding lid handles must be fixed. Grease and food debris buildup on cooking equipment and coolers must be cleaned. Floor tiles and a dry storage door need repair. Hood filters are missing.

headline: Dirt and debris under store shelving
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Food debris, dust, and excess items were under shelving on the selling floor and must be cleaned where needed.

headline: Dirty equipment, floors, and damaged walls and lighting
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Cooling units, liquor wells, and prep tables had dried food debris. Second-floor prep floors had food and grease buildup. Chipped paint was noted in the bar. Lighting was inadequate in the first-floor bar, and burned-out bulbs were to be replaced.

headline: Dirty walk-in cooler and missing thermometers
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Thermometers must be added inside the reach-in display cooler. The walk-in cooler floors, walls, and shelving were dirty. Floors in the prep and dishwashing areas needed cleaning. A splash guard was missing at the meat counter hand sink.

headline: Wet wiping cloths and cooks area floors need cleaning
summary: Short form complaint inspection passed. Wet wiping cloths were stored on rear prep counters and must be kept in sanitizing solution when not in use. Food debris must be removed from floors under and between cooking equipment.

headline: Cold foods held at 45-54°F; cooler too warm
