summary: Passed with conditions. Deli meat, cheese, eggs, and other TCS foods were held at 45-54°F, above the 41°F limit. About 40 pounds ($200) were discarded. The stand-up cooler air read 50°F. A priority citation was issued. Also noted: a faucet leak and greasy floors.

headline: Only managers have food handler training
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Only certified managers had food handler training. All employees must complete food handler training and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Debris on floors; washroom lacks ventilation fan
summary: License inspection passed. Debris was on floors in sales and storage areas and must be cleaned. The washroom had no mechanical ventilation and a fan must be installed.

headline: Staff hand-washing and dishwashing failures; sink missing
summary: Canvass inspection failed. Employees ate in food areas, washed hands improperly, and rinsed dishes without a sanitizing setup. No hand-washing sink was in the first-floor packaging prep area, so that area must stop prep until one is installed and approved. Time-only food holding was not approved; about 25 pounds were discarded. Door gaps were also noted.

headline: Gas stove lacks ventilation; freezer ice buildup
summary: Canvass inspection passed. A gas stove in the rear dishwashing area had no ventilation and must be vented or removed. An ice cream display freezer had ice buildup that must be defrosted and cleaned. Food handler training rules were to be followed.

headline: Unlabeled containers and food stored on stairs
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Food storage containers had no common-name labels. Food was stored on stairs to the upstairs office and must be raised 6 inches off the floor. A burned-out walk-in cooler bulb and missing allergen certificate were noted.

headline: Leak under three-compartment sink corrected
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. A drain line leak under the right compartment of the three-compartment sink in the dishwashing area needed repair.

headline: Unlabeled food, worn cutting boards, and fryer filter grease
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Foods and spices out of original containers were unlabeled and must show common names. A kitchen cutting board had deep grooves and stains. Grease and food debris buildup was in the deep fryer oil filtering unit.

headline: Hand sink blocked by ice and beer
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. The rear bar hand sink was not accessible; it was filled with ice and bottled beer, a priority violation. Milk crates were used as shelving in storage and must be replaced with 6-inch-high shelving.

headline: No certified manager; multiple leaks at sink
summary: Complaint inspection passed with conditions. No valid City of Chicago certified manager was on duty while TCS foods were prepared and served, a priority violation. The three-compartment sink had multiple leaks. Floors around equipment must be cleaned and kept dry.

headline: Wiping cloths improperly stored and training missing
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Orange wiping cloths were on a cutting board by the deli cooler and must be stored in sanitizing solution. A backflow device for the lobby drink dispenser could not be located. No food handler training proof was on site.

headline: Knives stored between prep tables; grease buildup
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Knives were stored between prep tables and must be kept clean and stored properly. Grease and small food debris under cooking equipment in the rear food area must be cleaned to prevent pests.

headline: Hand-washing signs missing throughout establishment
summary: License inspection passed. No hand-washing signs were posted at any hand sinks throughout the establishment, and signs must be provided.

headline: Three-compartment sink stoppers not working
summary: License inspection passed. Stoppers at the three-compartment sink were not working and must be provided and kept working at all times. Dirt and food debris were on the floor around the water tank in the rear and must be cleaned.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Milk crates were used as shelving in prep and storage areas. They must be removed and replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen training certificates
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Some employees lacked food handler training, and some food managers lacked allergen training. Stained ceiling tiles in the prep area must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Missing hand-wash signs and wood blocks under coffee machine
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Bar and kitchen hand sinks lacked hand-washing signs. Porous wood blocks were used under the front bar coffee machine and must be replaced. Dried food debris was on the wall and floor under the kitchen three-compartment sink.

headline: Raw wood under hand sink behind bar
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Raw wood under the hand sink behind the bar must be painted or sealed so it is smooth, non-absorbent, and easy to clean.

headline: Missing backflow device; cleaning and repairs needed
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. No backflow device was visible on the ice machine. A mop sink was clogged with standing water. Grease buildup was on steam tables, prep tables, and floors. Some walls and floor tiles need repair, and no food handler training was on site.

headline: Coleslaw held above safe temperature; cooler tagged
summary: Passed with conditions. Coleslaw measured 47.1-48.7°F and the cooler air read 46.6°F, above the required 41°F for TCS foods (foods that must stay cold or hot). About 4 pounds were discarded. The cooler is tagged and must not be used until repaired.

headline: Unlabeled bulk dry ingredients and basement clutter
summary: License inspection passed. Bulk dry ingredients stored at the front prep table had no labels and must show common names. Unnecessary items on the basement floor were to be removed, and kept items must sit on proper shelving at least 6 inches off the ground.

headline: Walk-in cooler thermometer needed
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The manager was instructed to provide and maintain a working thermometer inside the walk-in cooler to monitor temperature.

headline: Multiple violations: no certified manager, sanitizer at zero
summary: Complaint inspection failed. No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were handled. Hand-washing sinks lacked soap and were used for prep. The main-kitchen dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer. Also noted: no probe thermometer and no food handler training certificates.

headline: Missing employee health policy and food handler training
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy was on site, which is a priority violation. The person in charge (PIC) must provide documentation that employees will report illnesses that can spread through food. Food handlers were told to obtain required food handler training.

headline: No cleanup kit; smoking and incomplete pest log
summary: License inspection failed. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure was on site. The pest control logbook was incomplete, with the last service in 2022. An employee was smoking an e-cigarette indoors, and an ashtray with a cigarette butt was in storage.

headline: Missing hand-washing signs and dirty sinks
summary: Canvass inspection passed. No hand-washing signs were posted at the bar sinks and bakery. Sinks at the bar and main kitchen were not clean. Debris buildup was on floors throughout, and the dish machine had no irreversible temperature indicator, a priority violation.

headline: Deli cooler at 50.9°F; tagged out of use
summary: Passed with conditions. The front deli cooler measured 50.9°F, above the required 41°F, a priority violation. The cooler was tagged by the health department, and an alternative cold holding unit is available. A women's restroom ceiling tile above the sink was damaged.

headline: Hand sink misused; cold food held at unsafe temperatures
summary: Canvass inspection failed. A rear hand sink was used for prep and was inaccessible. About 40 pounds of pasta at 86°F and about 150 pounds of cold TCS foods at 50-63°F were discarded. Two prep coolers and a storage cooler were tagged and held. Door, splashguard, and lighting issues also noted.

headline: No health policy, missing soap, and dirty wiping cloths
summary: Complaint inspection failed. No employee health policy was on site. Hand sinks lacked soap or paper towels, and no current pest control logbook was on site. Dirty wet towels and sour cream containers used for food storage were also noted.

headline: Items on floor and leaking faucet base
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Items stored on the floor in the front display area must be kept 6 inches off the floor. Milk crates were used inside the walk-in meat cooler. A leaking faucet base and dirty floor drains and cooler floors were also noted.

headline: Raw shellfish thawed at room temperature
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Raw shellfish was thawing at room temperature at the three-compartment sink and must be thawed using approved methods. An insect control device was installed above clean equipment and must be moved. Cutting boards were stored in a toilet room.

headline: Cutting boards damaged; no food handler proof
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Kitchen cutting boards had deep cuts and stains and must be sanded and sealed or replaced. No proof of food handler or allergen training was on site for any food handler.

headline: Dirty floors, rusty walk-in shelves, and missing allergen certificate
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Unfinished wood shelving near the hot holding unit and rusty shelving in the walk-in cooler must be fixed. Floor corners in prep areas were dirty. One certified food service manager lacked allergen awareness training.

headline: No hand-wash sign; cutting boards cut and stained
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The meat cutting room hand sink needed hand-washing signage. The dairy cooler's air thermometer was damaged. Cutting boards had open seams and cuts in the deli and meat areas. A ceiling tile above produce prep was missing.

headline: About 40 live small flies in food prep areas
summary: Short form complaint inspection failed. About 40 live small flies were on walls, ceilings, and food equipment in the rear deli and meat prep areas. Additional pest control service is needed. Walls, ceilings, and equipment must be detail-cleaned.

headline: Garbage cans need lids in restrooms
summary: License inspection passed. Both unisex restrooms must have lids on garbage cans.

headline: Residue under reach-in cooler
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Residue was on the bottom of a two-door reach-in cooler. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Women's restroom needs covered receptacle
summary: Canvass inspection passed. No covered receptacle was in the women's restroom. The person in charge was instructed to provide one.

headline: About 50 mouse droppings found near rear exit
summary: Canvass inspection failed. About 50 mouse droppings were on the floor under cluttered items near the rear exit. Sushi hand sink was blocked by a bucket of noodles, which the manager removed on site. Additional pest control service is needed.

headline: Dead mouse in trap and several food-safety fixes
summary: Canvass inspection passed. A dead mouse was found in a trap at the rear, which was to be removed. Also noted: stained cutting boards, milk crates and cardboard used as shelving or containers, rusty walk-in shelves, and a missing wall tile above the cooking hood.

headline: Dirty vents and grease at grill hood
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. No hand-washing sign was in the public restroom. A wiping cloth was stored on a prep table. Overhead vents in dishwashing, prep, and dry storage were dirty, and grease was at the grill and fryer hood. Allergen certificates were not corrected from a prior report, so a citation was issued.

headline: No certified manager on site; wiping cloths left out
summary: Passed with conditions. No City of Chicago certified food manager was present while TCS foods were prepared and served, a priority violation. Wet wiping cloths were on counters and prep tables. No allergen training was on site for certified food managers.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. The person in charge had no City of Chicago sanitation certificate. No certified manager was present while TCS foods such as ice cream and yogurt were prepared and served, a priority violation. A cooler had black mold-like buildup.

headline: No certified food manager during meat service
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while chicken and beef were handled and served. Deli container was not air dried after washing. An air conditioner's condensation line was too close to a prep table.

headline: Leaking sink pipe; rust, grease, and floor damage
summary: A leaking pipe under the three-compartment sink in front prep must be repaired. Also build-up inside a prep cooler door, rust on a rear prep table, cracked and missing floor tile in the rear kitchen, and excessive grease on an unused hood.

headline: Single-use items on floor; milk crate shelving
summary: Single-service articles were not inverted in the service area and were stored on the basement floor. Milk crates are used as shelving throughout prep and storage. Loose debris and dust are on floors and corners.

headline: Rusty walk-in shelves; leaking utility faucet
summary: Shelves inside the walk-in cooler are rusty and must be replaced. The cold water faucet at the utility sink leaks when running. Can opener blade, fryer bottoms, ceiling vents, and floors need cleaning.

headline: Rat droppings; no certified manager on duty
summary: Over 20 rat droppings were found near the prep oven and about 20 in the furnace room; an exterminator was advised and a citation issued. No certified manager was on duty while tacos and wraps were prepared. Shrimp at 48.5F was discarded.

headline: Food debris in prep coolers and sinks
summary: Accumulated food debris was found inside reach-in prep coolers and inside prep area sinks. Equipment must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Steak held above 41F; no pest service records
summary: Steak at 55.0F in a prep cooler was discarded. No 2025 pest control reports were on file; the last report was dated 10/1/24. Food was stored in plastic grocery bags, and handler and allergen training proof was missing.

headline: Wiping cloths and single-use items not protected
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution, and single-service articles were not inverted in the prep area. Also greasy cooking equipment, a P-trap leak, spills on the floor, propane tanks in the furnace room, and a missing light shield.

headline: Dirty floor drains and light shields
summary: Dirt buildup was found inside floor drains in the production and rear dishwashing areas. Dust and dirt were also inside the light shield covers above cooking equipment in the main kitchen. Both must be cleaned.

headline: Leaking sink drain and missing washroom ventilation
summary: Drainpipe under the rinse compartment of the three-compartment sink is leaking. Handwashing signs are missing, and the all-gender washroom lacks ventilation and a covered receptacle. Non-working hood ventilation was also noted.

headline: Restroom door and receptacle needed
summary: The restroom door has no self-closing device, and no covered receptacle is provided for female hygiene products. The person in charge must provide and maintain both.

headline: Receiving door gap and several repairs
summary: Rear receiving door has a 1/2 inch gap at the bottom and must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Also torn cooler door gaskets, missing sink stoppers, stained cutting boards, a slow-draining sink, a leaking faucet, and water-damaged ceiling tiles.

headline: Basement rainwater pooling and hood buildup
summary: Rainwater seepage was pooling in the basement and must be stopped. Both unisex washrooms had uncovered waste receptacles for sanitary products. Grease and dust buildup was found near the main kitchen hood.

headline: Cooler drain into hand sink; missing hair restraint
summary: A walk-in cooler drain line empties into the front hand-washing sink and must be rerouted to a floor drain. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Fryers are greasy, the rear hand sink leaks heavily, and several ceiling tiles need repair.

headline: Food stored on floors; many repairs needed
summary: Food containers were stored directly on floors in prep, storage, and freezers. Also foil on shelving, rust on prep tables, cutting boards with open seams, a missing backflow device, leaking faucets and drains, and damaged floors.

headline: Torn freezer gaskets; sink access items
summary: Soap dispenser and paper towels mounted above three meat-prep sinks must be removed. Torn gaskets on a freezer holding packaged vegetables and tamales must be sealed. Condensation at the produce cooler and empty milk crates also need attention.

headline: Cooler drain pooling water on kitchen floor
summary: Walk-in cooler drain line was emptying onto the floor under the prep sink, with water pooling. Instructed to extend the line into a floor drain. Floor in front of drive-thru prep area also needs cleaning.

headline: New hire lacks food handler training certificate
summary: A new hire food employee was on site without a food handler training certificate. The person in charge was instructed to direct them to obtain training. Rust on walk-in metal shelving also needs removal and painting.

headline: Handwashing failure; cooked and cold food temperatures
summary: A food handler began cutting meat with gloves on, without washing hands; a citation was issued. Cooked steak at 130.1F and pork at 58.1F were below the 135F hot-holding minimum. Lettuce and tomato were above 41F; about 13 lbs and 16 lbs were discarded.

headline: Expired allergen certificate; greasy kitchen areas
summary: A manager's food allergen training certificate has expired. Also a loose freezer door gasket, greasy fryers and hood vents, and dirty walls and floors. Instructed that all food handlers must obtain required training.

headline: About 20 rodent droppings in dry storage
summary: About 20 rodent droppings on second-floor dry storage shelves; pest control recommended and a citation issued. Brunch menu lacked raw or undercooked egg warnings. A toilet bowl cover was cracked.

headline: No certified manager on duty; dirty ice machine
summary: No valid certified manager was on duty while TCS foods were prepared and served, and no certificate was posted. A citation was issued. The ice machine interior was not clean, pipes above food prep need covering, and floors need repair.

headline: No certified manager while hot dogs prepared
summary: No certified manager was on site while TCS items such as hot dogs were prepared. A citation was issued. Debris and grime were also found on the floor of the rear store room.

headline: Food on floors; utensils stored in food
summary: Food was stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and prep areas. In-use utensils were stored inside food containers. Also no air thermometers in coolers, a leaking three-compartment faucet, and loose dust and debris on floors.

headline: No vomit response plan; no pest logbook
summary: No written procedure or supplies for vomit and diarrhea events were on site. No licensed pest control logbook was available, and a citation was issued. The washroom door lacks a self-closing device, and floor tiles are missing in the rear storage area.

headline: Front entrance door gap at bottom
summary: Front entrance door has a 1/2 inch gap at the bottom. Instructed to make the door tight-fitting and rodent-proof. No pests were observed.

headline: Dusty ceiling vents throughout premises
summary: Dust has built up on ceiling ventilation vents throughout the premises. They must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: No raw food warning; no handler training
summary: The menu lacks a consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods. No food handler training was available for employees. Single-service items were stored on the second-floor floor, and the bar hand sink drainpipe leaks.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No certified food service manager was on site, and no certificate was posted while chicken and sausage were handled and served. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Wiping cloths were hung above the sink to dry.

headline: No hair restraints; wiping cloths left on tables
summary: Employees were not wearing hair restraints during food preparation and service. Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables. A torn refrigerator door gasket, missing floor grout, and inadequate basement lighting also need attention.

headline: Boxes stored on floor near furnace
summary: Boxes were stored on the floor in the rear area near the furnace. Person in charge must keep all items at least six inches off the floor at all times.

headline: Handwashing sink access lacking; several gaps
summary: No easily accessible handwashing sink in the main kitchen prep or bakery area. No food prep sink in the beverage area, missing backflow devices, exposed food-contact bowls, and some expired food handler certificates.

headline: Pink mineral buildup in soda ice dispenser
summary: Slight pink mineral buildup was found inside the ice dispenser at the soda machine station. It must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Food debris in walk-in and spill in chemical room
summary: Second-floor walk-in cooler floor had food debris and spillage under shelving. A possible chemical spill was on the floor of the second-floor chemical storage room. Both areas must be cleaned.

headline: Live flies and milk held above safe temperature
summary: About 40 or more live small flies were found in the second-floor bar area. Milk and half-and-half in a room-service cooler were held at up to 48.2F, above the 41F limit. Milk was discarded and the cooler was tagged.

headline: Missing backflow device; leaking sinks
summary: No backflow prevention device was found on the rear prep utility sink. The three-compartment sink faucet in the dish area leaks, and the bar hand sink has leaking drainpipes. All must be repaired or replaced.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit or pest logbook
summary: No vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit or written procedures were on site. No pest control logbook with current reports was available. There is no metal stem thermometer for food temperatures, and rear dry storage containers must be labeled.

headline: About 60 mouse droppings in basement prep
summary: About 60 mouse droppings were found in the basement prep area, behind prep tables, near the tool cabinet, and beside dry ingredient bins. Staff must remove them, sanitize, and inform pest control; a citation was issued. Grease and broken floor tile were also noted.

headline: No handwashing signs at sinks
summary: No handwashing signs were posted at the handwashing sinks. The manager was instructed to provide them.

headline: About 75 live flying insects in food areas
summary: About 75 live small flying insects were found on walls and ceilings across first-floor and basement prep, dry storage, dishwashing, and the stairwell. More pest control is needed and a citation was issued. A basement dish machine also leaks.

headline: Washroom fan not working; greasy equipment
summary: Grill and steam table exteriors were greasy, and pipes behind cooking equipment had grease buildup. The washroom ventilation fan was not working and must be repaired.

headline: No employee health policy; no manager allergen training
summary: No signed employee health policies were on file, and food managers lack allergen training. Also a worn walk-in cooler door gasket, missing hood filters, and no lidded garbage can in the unisex toilet room.

headline: Rear door opening; expired manager allergen certificate
summary: An opening at the base of the rear exit door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. The certified manager's allergen training certificate has expired. Also non-food items stored on the floor, non-working hood lights, and greasy filters.

headline: No certified manager; cold food and ice mold
summary: No person in charge or certified food manager was on site while deli meat, potato salad, and tuna were served. Tuna at 56F, chicken at 50 to 55F, and pasta at 59F were discarded. The ice chute had black and pink mold-like residue.

headline: Front door gap and milk crate shelving
summary: Main front door has a 1/4 to 1/2 inch gap at the bottom; repair to reduce pest entry. Milk crates must not be used to elevate stored items. No pests were found.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: The city certified manager is missing allergen training. Staff must obtain the training and keep verification on site.

headline: Missing splash guard and covered trash cans
summary: No splash guard between an exposed hand sink and the three-compartment sink drainboard in the hot food prep area. Both all-gender toilet rooms lacked covered trash receptacles.

headline: Washroom drainage, fan, and fixture problems
summary: Hot water tank drain ends above the washroom hand sink and must be rerouted to a mop sink or floor drain. The washroom lacks a working fan, a self-closing door device, and a covered trash receptacle. Refrigeration units need thermometers.

headline: Rear overhead door gap; missing handwash signs
summary: Rear overhead door has about a 1/4 inch gap at the bottom corner and must be made tight-fitting. Handwashing signage is missing at the rear prep sink.

headline: Walk-in cooling line insulation in poor repair
summary: Insulation around the cooling line in the walk-in cooler is in poor repair. It must be fixed to prevent condensation drips.

headline: Food debris under flat-top grill
summary: Food debris had accumulated under the flat-top grill. Instructed to clean and maintain the area.

headline: Rat droppings; undated prepared foods discarded
summary: Rat droppings found: about 50 at the front counter, 20 under the rear rack, and 5 under the rear prep table. Pest control was recommended and a citation issued. Undated cooked foods were discarded. No employee health policy was on site.

headline: Utensils in water; knives improperly stored
summary: Cooking utensils were stored in water, which must be at least 135F. Knives were stored between a cold holding unit and the wall. Milk crates are used as shelving, and reach-in coolers need detail cleaning.

headline: Unapproved painted clay cups at bar
summary: Painted clay cups used at the bar for cocktail preparation and service lacked an NSF stamp. Instructed to use only food-grade containers for all food and beverages.

headline: Previous ice machine violation not corrected
summary: The ice machine near the coffee bar still has black buildup inside its chute, a violation from a previous report that was not corrected. The manager was instructed to address all previous core violations.

headline: Deli salads above 41F; 35 lbs discarded
summary: Pasta, tuna, shrimp, seafood, and quinoa salads were held at 45.1 to 47.1F in the deli cooler; about 35 lbs discarded. The outside dumpster lid is broken and a citation was issued. Also trash on floors and a hallway light out.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; wall holes; no allergen training
summary: The walk-in cooler in prep lacks a thermometer. The certified manager has no allergen training. Holes in walls behind the three-compartment sink and in the dish area must be sealed to prevent pest harborage. Slow drain and dust also noted.

headline: Splash guard and floor cleaning needed
summary: The deli hand sink needs a splash guard next to the chicken prep area. Floors need detail cleaning under shelving, along walls, under deep fryers with grease buildup, and in several other areas. Fan vents in the meat production area also need cleaning.

headline: Improper food storage and missing thermometers
summary: Food stored in plastic grocery bags in freezer and cooler, and utensils left inside food containers. Wet wiping cloths were on prep surfaces, containers were unlabeled, and reach-in coolers lacked air thermometers.

headline: No certified manager; summary report not posted
summary: No person in charge held a valid city sanitation certificate. An old inspection summary was not posted, but was reprinted and posted on site. An ice machine leak and openings at a dock door also need repair.

headline: Loose wall panel; hood buildup
summary: A loose wall panel outside the toilet rooms must be repaired or replaced. Excessive buildup on the hood and cooking equipment filters must be cleaned.

headline: Buffet foods above 41F; no certified manager
summary: Buffet items were held at 50.1 to 66.3F, including hummus at 66.3F; 8 lbs discarded. No certified manager was on duty and no temperature logs were available. An employee did not change gloves before handling clean dishes. Citations issued.

headline: Dish machine tagged; handwashing water too hot
summary: High-temperature dish machine final rinse was 154.2F, below 180F; it is tagged and must not be used until reinspected. Handwashing sink water reached up to 147.7F, above the 120F maximum. Doors are not rodent-proof and the outside dumpster is overflowing.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food containers in pastry prep
summary: Bulk food containers in the pastry prep area were not labeled. All bulk containers must be labeled with their common name.

headline: Previous violations not corrected; several repairs
summary: Previously cited floor tile and grease problems were not corrected; a citation was issued. Milk crates are used as shelving, tape is used as a floor repair, and a refrigerator gasket is damaged. A sink faucet leaks and dust has built up.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and backflow device
summary: No handwashing signage was found at the restroom. The reach-in cooler interiors were not clean, and the mop sink faucet has no backflow prevention device. Floors behind and under heavy equipment were not clean.

headline: Ice machine mold; no certified food manager
summary: No certified food manager was on site while egg and chicken sandwiches were prepared. The ice machine interior had excessive black mold-like substance while ice was in use; ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned. No food handler training proof.

headline: No posted sanitation certificate; no handler training proof
summary: No valid city sanitation certificate was posted; it must be posted with the certified manager when TCS foods are stored. A citation was issued. No proof of food handler training was on hand. A slow-draining dump sink also needs repair.

headline: 80 mouse droppings and live flies found
summary: Six large live flies and 80 mouse droppings were found in the toilet room, around cooking equipment, sinks, and coolers. A current pest service report must be provided. No sanitizer test strips or metal stem thermometer were on site.

headline: Chicken in plastic totes; no thermometers
summary: Chicken in a cooler and frozen chicken in freezers were stored in plastic storage totes; food-grade bags or containers are required. Display and prep coolers lacked air thermometers. Wet wiping cloths and a leaking dish-area faucet were also noted.

headline: Mold-like substance in ice machine; freezer floor storage
summary: Black mold-like substance was found inside the ice machine; the ice is not used for human consumption. Items were stored on the walk-in freezer floor and must be kept at least six inches off the floor.

headline: Handsinks blocked or missing soap; no test strips
summary: The hand sink in front prep had no soap, and the rear dishwashing hand sink was blocked by stored items. Both citations were issued. No sanitizer test strips were available at the three-compartment sink. A prior allergen training violation was not corrected.

headline: Restroom lacks ventilation and allergen training
summary: The certified manager had no allergen training; the certificate must be obtained and kept on site. The restroom lacks mechanical ventilation and a self-closing door device.

headline: Food handler lacked hair restraint and training proof
summary: A male food handler prepared and served food without a hair restraint. Another food handler had no proof of food handler training. Also a non-working freezer light, a flickering prep light, and dirty floors and cabinets.

headline: Scoop handles in food; greasy fryer area
summary: Scoops in dry storage bins were stored with handles touching food and must be stored properly between uses. Heavy water buildup was found inside the ice machine. Both bathrooms lacked covered trash cans, and grease built up behind the fryer and oven.

headline: No raw-food warning on menu; old report unposted
summary: Menus lacked a consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods; those items must be marked with an asterisk and linked to a reminder. The previous inspection summary was not posted, and a citation was issued. Dishmachine and sink leaks also noted.

headline: Expired deli meats and raw eggs over lettuce
summary: Turkey, ham, roast beef, and cheese dated 12/5/23 were discarded, about 10 lbs. Raw eggs were stored touching ready-to-eat lettuce; the lettuce was discarded. The high-temperature dish machine is inoperable and tagged.

headline: Revolving door gaps and food buildup
summary: Half-inch gaps at revolving door sweeps must be made rodent-proof. Food buildup inside reach-in coolers and on prep and dishwashing area walls must be cleaned.

headline: Live flies and cold food above safe temperature
summary: About 50 to 75 live small flying insects were found, about 60 near the rear utility sink. Cut melon, greens, tuna, milk, and a chicken sandwich were held above 41F; about 100 lbs were discarded. Blocked sinks were cleared on site.

headline: Dirty floors in dry storage, walk-in, and prep
summary: Floors and base boards in rear dry storage need detail cleaning. The walk-in cooler floor also needs detail cleaning. Dirt and small debris were found under equipment along the walls in the rear food prep area.

headline: Missing sink signs and broken washroom fan
summary: No signage on the three-compartment sink (wash, rinse, sanitize). Washroom mechanical ventilation was not working. Person in charge told to provide signage and repair the fan.

headline: Certified manager's allergen training expired
summary: The certified manager on duty had an expired allergen training certificate. The inspector required that it be maintained, or citations would follow.

headline: Foil-covered pork and paper towels over food
summary: Pork cutlets were wrapped in foil while cooling; instructed to store them uncovered or loosely covered. A paper towel dispenser was mounted above exposed food. Also a ceiling water leak, soiled wiping cloths, and a missing toilet receptacle.

headline: Pink residue inside ice machine
summary: A slight accumulation of pink substance was found behind the ice chute inside the ice machine. It must be cleaned, sanitized, and maintained. Calcium buildup was also found on the ice machine lid.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies on premises
summary: No cleanup supplies for vomit or diarrhea events were on site; management was instructed to provide them. The washroom also lacked a covered waste receptacle and a self-closing door device.

headline: Dish machine rinse too cool; tagged out
summary: The high-temperature dish machine in the first-floor bar reached only a 162F final rinse, below the 180 to 192F required. It was tagged and held for inspection, and a citation was issued. Two toilet rooms lacked covered trash cans.

headline: Food debris on dish and prep area floors
summary: Food debris was on the floor beside equipment in the dish and prep area. Instructed to detail clean and increase floor cleaning frequency, and to maintain this at all times.

headline: Hair restraints missing; hood filters greasy
summary: Some food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. The three-compartment sink has no stoppers, food debris is on the walls around it, and grease and food debris are on the ventilation hood filters.

headline: Food handlers lack certificates; CFM lacks allergen training
summary: Food handlers on site had no food handler certificates, and the certified food manager had no allergen training certificate. Also missing handwashing signs, a leaking faucet, an uncovered trash can, and dirty floors.

headline: Rat droppings, live roaches, and unsafe dishwasher
summary: About 20 rat droppings and three live roaches were found in rear storage; more pest control is needed. Dishwasher sanitizer measured 0 ppm; the unit was tagged and may not be used until reinspected. Cold foods were held above 41F; 19 lbs discarded.

headline: Black mold-like buildup on dish machine
summary: Black mold-like buildup was found on the dish machine, and calcium buildup inside the ice machine. Also missing handwashing signs, gaps at front and side doors, and dust in the beer cooler fan area.

headline: Over 200 mouse droppings; coolers off; no hot water
summary: Over 200 mouse droppings on the selling floor, near the three-compartment sink, and in storage, plus a dead mouse. Refrigeration and freezer units were off, and sinks had no hot running water. Pest control service was required.

headline: No covered trash can in women's washroom
summary: The women's washroom has no covered trash receptacle. One must be provided.

headline: Food held above safe temperatures; cheese sauce misplaced
summary: Cold cheese sauce was placed directly into a hot holding unit; food must be reheated to 165F first. French fries at 67.6F and pizza at 70F were out of temperature control, and about 5 lbs of fries were discarded. Citations issued.

headline: Ice bucket stored on floor
summary: An ice bucket was stored on the floor. The inspector instructed that it be kept off the floor.

headline: Fly trap over prep table must be moved
summary: An electric fly trap hangs directly above a food prep table, a direct violation that must be corrected by relocating it. Also a missing backflow device, a leaking three-compartment sink, rusty racks, and dirty cooler interiors.

headline: Cooler gasket, clutter, and dirty floors
summary: One reach-in cooler needs a rubber gasket to reduce snow buildup. Toilet fixtures need cleaning, unnecessary clutter must be removed outside, and walk-in cooler and freezer floors need cleaning.

headline: Cold deli meats above 41F; 14.5 lbs discarded
summary: Turkey, ham, roast beef, steak, and teriyaki chicken were held at 46.4 to 49.1F; about 14.5 lbs discarded. A prior violation for missing food handler training was not corrected, and a citation was issued. Standing water and a missing splash guard were also noted.

headline: Front door gap and broken meat cooler door
summary: Front exit door has a 1/4 inch gap at the bottom and must be sealed to prevent pest entry. The meat display cooler door is broken and must be repaired or replaced. Floors and corners need detail cleaning.

headline: Basement clutter to remove
summary: Clutter was found in the basement, including stacks of items, ladders, wood, pipes, and debris in the furnace room. Staff must remove unnecessary items and keep floor areas clear to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: Passed; door gaps, broken restroom sink
summary: Passed. Exit doors have gaps of at least 1/4 inch and must be rodent-proofed. A third handwash sink in the women's restroom is inoperable. Bar handsinks need splash guards, and container bar floors pool water and debris.

headline: No certified food manager during food prep
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site while ground beef, pasta, chicken, and beans were prepared; the manager arrived at 12:11 p.m. Citation issued. Person in charge lacks a certificate. Door gaps allowing insect entry remain unfixed.

headline: Passed; rust in ice machine and cooler shelves
summary: Passed. Rust was found on reach-in cooler shelving and inside the ice machine; replacement or deep cleaning was required. Clutter, including a Christmas tree, in banquet walk-in storage must be cleared to prevent pest harboring. Openings around a basement trap door need sealing.

headline: Passed; damaged floors, rusty ceilings, dust buildup
summary: Passed. Several areas have missing or damaged floor tiles, and rusty ceiling tiles were found in the main dish room. Chipped walk-in cooler paint, a bent stainless wall panel, and dust on fans, light shields, and vents need attention.

headline: Passed; staff without hair restraints in prep
summary: Passed. Several food handlers worked in prep areas without hair restraints; management must require them while preparing food. The top of the convection oven in the first-floor prep area needs cleaning.

headline: Passed; wall gaps and missing allergen training
summary: Passed. Gaps of 1/4 to 1/2 inch at floor and wall junctions in the rear utility sink area must be repaired. The restroom has no mechanical ventilation. A certified manager lacks allergen awareness training.

headline: Failed; about 15 live flies in prep area
summary: Failed. About 15 live small flies were found in the rear food prep area near the utility sink; pest control was recommended and cleaning ordered. Front and rear doors were open without mesh screens. Walk-in foods lacked common-name labels.

headline: Passed; missing thermometers, rear door gap
summary: Passed. No thermometers were inside the chicken hot-holding unit or the dessert reach-in cooler. A 1/2-inch gap at the rear exit door sweeps must be sealed to keep pests out.

headline: Passed; floor drains need cleaning
summary: Passed. The inspector told staff to clean and maintain all floor drains in the prep area.

headline: Passed; no backflow device at ice machine
summary: Passed. No backflow prevention device was found on the ice machine waterline. One must be installed where it can be located and serviced.

headline: Failed; unsafe cold food temperatures, cooler tagged
summary: Failed. Shrimp, chicken, beef, and pork were held at 52.4–60.4°F; cold food must stay at 41°F or below. About 7 lbs discarded. The three-door prep cooler, at 60.8°F, is tagged. No employee food handler training was shown.

headline: Passed; slow drain and loose faucet
summary: Passed. A basement prep handwash sink drains slowly and has a loose faucet; the inspector instructed staff to correct and maintain it.

headline: Passed; cardboard food containers, excess freezer ice
summary: Passed. Cardboard boxes were used as food containers in coolers, freezers, and on the cook line; washable containers are required. Excess ice build-up in a basement freezer must be removed. Chipping wall plaster near the utility sink needs repair.

headline: Failed; over 100 rat droppings found
summary: Failed. Over 100 rat droppings were found in prep and storage areas, including inside fryer cabinets. Manager must call an exterminator and clean. Employees lack food handler training, and the manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Passed; missing cooler lids, damaged cutting boards
summary: Passed. Two low-boy coolers on the main prep line are missing covers over their top portion. Two cutting boards have deep grooves and dark stains. Both the coolers and boards must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Failed; over 100 mouse and rat droppings, dead rats
summary: Failed. Over 100 mouse and rat droppings and two dead, decayed rats were found in storage, the toilet room, and the basement. Pest control service recommended. No signed employee health policies or food handler training were shown.

headline: Failed; about 100 mouse droppings, repeat violation
summary: Failed. Repeat violation: about 100 mouse droppings were found in dry storage, around the grease trap, and behind cooking equipment. Management must clean and remove droppings; additional pest control service is needed. Dirty fryers and floors also noted.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager, no soap
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager was on site while chicken and other high-risk foods were prepared and served. Bar handwash sink lacked soap and paper towels. Food was stored on the walk-in floor, and no allergen training proof was on site.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge with a valid certificate was present, and no certified manager was on site while ground beef was prepared and served. Coolers lacked thermometers, and food was stored on floors. A 1/4-inch gap under the front door needs sealing.

headline: Passed; residue, grease, and debris need cleaning
summary: Passed. Residue was found on shelving in the walk-in meat cooler. Food debris sat on top of deep freezers in rear storage. Grease coated walls and floors in the front food area, and heavy debris was near the rear exit. All need cleaning.

headline: Passed; door gap and peeling ceiling paint
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the storage room's rear exit door sweep must be rodent-proofed. Peeling ceiling paint above the dish machine must be removed.

headline: Passed; sink leak and missing splashguard
summary: Passed. A three-compartment sink leaks from the drain line and must be repaired. A splashguard is required between the handwash sink and the three-compartment sink. Chipped paint and walls near the mop sink need repair.

headline: Passed; rodent droppings in fryers and floors
summary: Passed. Rodent droppings were found inside fryers and on floors, drains, and under equipment in the walk-in cooler and cooking areas; cleaning ordered. A food handler lacked a certificate, and a worker lacked a hair restraint.

headline: Failed; 594 lbs of cold food discarded
summary: Failed. About 594 lbs (valued at $1,800) of cold foods held at 48.5–51.9°F were discarded. The produce cooler ran at 50.5°F. No certified manager was on site while food was prepared; 3-compartment sink wastewater overflowed.

headline: Failed; no valid certified manager posted
summary: Failed. No valid manager certificate was posted while food was prepared and served. The vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was inadequate, and a dumpster had overflowing trash with lids open. Food was stored on walk-in floors.

headline: Passed; unlabeled containers and leaking sink
summary: Passed. Dry food and spice containers lacked labels, and old bouillon containers were reused for food. Cardboard and duct-taped liners covered rusty shelves. The three-compartment sink faucet and pipe leak; the rear door is in disrepair.

headline: Passed; ham thawed on pizza oven; dirty cooler
summary: Passed. A frozen bag of diced ham sat on the pizza oven's lower rack; it must be thawed under refrigeration or running water. Also: heavy grease and debris in cooler, drains, and floors; burned-out bulbs; restroom trash without a lid.

headline: Passed; no food handler certificates, no allergen training
summary: Passed. Food handlers on site had no food handler certificates, and certified managers lacked allergen training. Staff in prep areas lacked hair restraints; fly strips hung in rear prep; fryers were dirty; a 3-compartment sink faucet leaked.

headline: Passed; rear exit door needs rodent-proofing
summary: Passed. The bottom of the rear exit door must be rodent-proofed to keep pests out.

headline: Passed; dry storage needs smooth walls and ceiling
summary: Passed. The dry food storage room has cement walls and no smooth, cleanable ceiling, with exposed plumbing and ventilation ducts. Inspector required smooth, cleanable, non-porous walls and a smooth ceiling above all shelving.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager posted
summary: Passed with conditions. No food sanitation certificate was posted while soups, salads, and cooked rice were prepared and served; a certified manager must be on site. Also missing: handwash sign and prep-cooler thermometer. Milk crates used for storage.

headline: Failed; food handler training missing or expired
summary: Failed. Food handler training was missing or expired for employees. Coffee bean buckets sat on the prep-area floor and must be elevated. Staff lacked hair restraints; food debris built up on prep tables and coolers; a front door has a gap.

headline: Passed; no thermometer, staff without hair restraints
summary: Passed. The two-door prep cooler needs a visible, working thermometer. Employees preparing food lacked hair restraints. Dirty ice machine interior, unlabeled food containers, items stored on basement floors, and dirty dish-area walls also need attention.

headline: Passed; food debris and spills throughout
summary: Passed. Food debris and spills covered floors and surfaces throughout the facility. Reach-in cooler interiors and the ventilation hood and filters need detail cleaning and ongoing maintenance.

headline: Passed with conditions; low hot water at handsinks
summary: Passed with conditions. Hot water at the front and rear handwash sinks was too low (84.7°F and 87.7°F); restored to 100–110°F during inspection. Paper towel holders were empty at both sinks; filled during inspection. Both are priority violations.

headline: Passed; air conditioner drain tubes in sink
summary: Passed. Air conditioner drain tubes run into the first compartment of the three-compartment sink; inspector ordered them rerouted to a floor drain. Also: handwash sink needs a splash guard, a vent cover is missing, and floors need cleaning.

headline: Passed; unlabeled containers and cardboard use
summary: Passed. Bulk containers lacked common-name labels, such as chiles and hibiscus. Cardboard was used on cooler floors and shelves, which is hard to clean. Water-stained ceiling tiles in dry storage need repair.

headline: Passed; hole in bar floor around pipes
summary: Passed. A hole in the bar-area floor surrounds pipes. The inspector required sealing and maintenance.

headline: Passed with conditions; repeat training violations
summary: Passed with conditions. Repeat violations: four food handlers lacked food handler certificates, and a manager's allergen certificate was expired. An ice bin at the coffee station needs a lid; cooking equipment needs cleaning.

headline: Passed; no food handler certificates posted
summary: Passed. Food handlers had no training certificates posted. Also noted: no handwashing sign at dish sink, unlabeled condiment bottles, a worker without a hair restraint, and improperly stored wiping cloths and plates. A hood light was out.

headline: Passed; hair restraints, leaks, grease, standing water
summary: Passed. Starbucks food handlers were not wearing hair restraints; inspector required them at all times. Grease and food debris were found on hot-holding and prep surfaces. Leaking handwash sink pipe, slow drain, and standing water on floors also noted.

headline: Passed with conditions; cooler too warm, still tagged
summary: Passed with conditions. The three-door prep cooler held food at 54.1°F; cold food must stay at 41°F or below. It was already tagged and stays tagged until repaired. Food handlers lack training, and the manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Passed; clutter in rear prep area
summary: Passed. Clutter and unnecessary items were stored in the rear prep and dishwashing area. Staff must remove unneeded equipment, detail clean the area, and store remaining items on shelving six inches off the floor.

headline: Passed with conditions; sink used for storage
summary: Passed with conditions. Milk frothing pitchers were stored in a handwash sink, which must stay accessible for handwashing; removed during inspection and citation issued. Employee drinks were in the dairy cooler, and food debris covered prep-area floors.

headline: Passed; non-manager food handlers need training
summary: Passed. Food handlers who are not City-certified food service managers must obtain the required food handler training.

headline: Passed; fryers and containers need cleaning
summary: Passed. Fryer interiors and exteriors, bulk storage containers, garbage containers, and dish machine racks needed cleaning. The inspector instructed staff to clean and maintain them, or replace them if needed.

headline: Passed; unlabeled dry storage, knives misplaced
summary: Passed. Dry storage containers lacked common-name labels. Knives were stored between the wall and a prep table; they must be kept on a knife rack or a clean surface.

headline: Passed; holes in three-compartment sink faucet pipe
summary: Passed. Two holes were found in the pipe of the faucet at the three-compartment sink. The inspector required repair and ongoing maintenance.

headline: Passed; food debris inside walk-in cooler
summary: Passed. An excessive amount of food debris was on the floor inside the gas station walk-in cooler; it must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Failed; no certified manager on arrival
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site at arrival; one came about 20 minutes later. Bleach and glass cleaner stored next to dried pasta were moved on site. Three-compartment sink floods between compartments; prior violations not fixed.

headline: Passed; loose faucet and wall panel
summary: Passed. The three-compartment sink faucet neck is loose and must be repaired. A wall panel across from the sink is loose and must be tightened.

headline: Passed; damaged cutting board, loose faucet
summary: Passed. A front prep cutting board is deeply scratched and gouged and must be resurfaced or replaced. A first-floor bathroom handwash sink faucet is extremely loose, and a kitchen handwash sink has a large caulking gap.

headline: Passed; missing sink stopper
summary: Passed. The facility was missing one sink stopper; the inspector required one to be provided and maintained.

headline: Passed; leaks and missing backflow device
summary: Passed. A backflow device on a prep one-compartment sink faucet leaks, and the hot-water connection under a prep handwash sink lacks a serviceable backflow device. Also noted: basement wall leak and expired food handler certificates.

headline: Failed; no health policy or vomit-cleanup kit
summary: Failed. No verifiable employee health policy was on site. No procedure or kit for cleaning up vomit or diarrhea, and no sanitizer test devices. Coffee bar lacks a handwash sink; restrooms lack paper towels and signs.

headline: Passed; missing sink signage, no cooler thermometer
summary: Passed. The front prep handwash sink has no handwashing sign. A cooler holding desserts in the front service area has no air thermometer. Bulk dry ingredient containers were left uncovered when not in use; staff must cover them.

headline: Passed; employee restroom trash lacks lid
summary: Passed. The employee restroom trash receptacle has no lid. The inspector required a lid and ongoing maintenance.

headline: Passed; dust on vents
summary: Passed. Dust had built up on ceiling and wall vents in prep and storage areas; the inspector required cleaning and maintenance.

headline: Passed with conditions; bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food
summary: Passed with conditions. An employee who had not washed hands handled ready-to-eat food with bare hands; two spring rolls were discarded. Handwashing and gloves were then observed. Also noted: slow-draining three-compartment sink, greasy floors, and broken caulking.

headline: Passed; leaking drain, expired handler certificate
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the double doors must be rodent-proofed. Torn door gaskets in sushi and rear prep areas need repair. The bar handwash sink drain leaks, and one food handler certificate is expired.

headline: Passed; ice machine needs cleaning
summary: Passed. A brownish substance was found inside the ice machine and must be cleaned and sanitized. The front door was open without screening; the manager closed it during inspection. A written cleaning procedure is needed for equipment too large for the sink.

headline: Passed with conditions; blocked handwash sink, no towels
summary: Passed with conditions. A handwash sink by the pizza station was blocked by a bowl and sponge, and the sink by the pizza oven had no paper towels. Both are priority violations with a citation. Shelves under food carts were dirty.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing signs, duct-taped pipes
summary: Passed. Handwash sinks in the front and rear bar areas lacked signs telling staff to wash hands. Two unused floor pipe connections were covered with duct tape; staff must remove the tape and keep fixtures cleanable.

headline: Passed with conditions; cold food too warm, discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Cold foods held at 46–53.6°F were discarded (about 10 lbs). A cold holding unit at 47.8°F was repaired and reached 38°F before the inspection ended. Some managers lack allergen training proof.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing signs, ice scoop misplaced
summary: Passed. Toilet room handwash sinks lacked handwashing signs. The ice scoop was stored on top of the ice machine. The three-compartment sink has no metal drainboard, and floors need cleaning in corners and under equipment.

headline: Failed; no health policy, sink backs up
summary: Failed. No employee health policy or training was on site. The three-compartment sink backs up, with wastewater flowing from one compartment into another. Also: leaking drain pipes, a backflow device hard to reach, gaps in the door, and damaged tiles.

headline: Failed; no certified manager, blocked handwash sink
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on premises until 12:20 p.m.; corrected on site. A middle prep area handwash sink was blocked by a plastic bag. Food debris was found throughout, plus a black mold-like substance under the oven.

headline: Passed; one manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. One of two certified managers has no allergen training; records must be kept on site. A torn gasket inside the rear prep walk-in cooler must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Failed; rodent droppings and flies in prep area
summary: Failed. About 50 rodent droppings and about 3 live large flies were found in the food prep area and toilet room. The person in charge had only an expired certificate. Cooked foods held over 24 hours lacked discard-date labels.

headline: Passed; expired allergen certificate for manager
summary: Passed. The certified food manager's allergen certificate is expired and must be replaced with valid proof. Also noted: food splatter on kitchen walls, water-damaged men's room ceiling tiles, and damaged baseboard coving.

headline: Failed; training proof missing, prior violation unfixed
summary: Failed. Food handlers lacked proof of food handler training, and certified managers lacked allergen training. A prior violation was not fixed: one stove burner is not under ventilation. Crates stored on freezer floors; ice buildup on condenser lines.

headline: Passed; dirty bus tubs and sauce racks
summary: Passed. Busing tubs and racks for sauce bottles were not clean and had food debris. The inspector instructed staff to clean and maintain them.

headline: Failed; no certified manager for 40 minutes
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on site for 40 minutes while chicken was prepared and served. A grease trap leaked wastewater onto the prep floor. A handsink lacked soap and towels, corrected on site. No food thermometer was on site.

headline: Failed; unsafe cold food temps, no health policy
summary: Failed. Cold foods held at 48–78.6°F; about 17 lbs discarded on site. Wontons and pork stored atop an open garbage can; about 5 lbs discarded. No verifiable employee health policy on site, and no proof of food handler training.

headline: Failed; no soap or towels at basement sink
summary: Failed. The basement handwash sink lacked soap and paper towels. Also: no food thermometer, no chlorine test strips for the bar dish machine, and two of three toilet rooms share access through the handwash area; two washrooms are required.

headline: Passed; broken backflow device at mop sink
summary: Passed. The mop sink faucet's backflow device is broken and must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Failed; no certified manager; cat on premises
summary: Failed. No certified manager or person in charge was on site while ham, cheese, corn, and sliced fruit were prepared. A cat, cat food, and a litter box with feces were in the basement; the cat was removed during inspection.

headline: Passed with conditions; repeat trash-cover violation
summary: Passed with conditions. Repeat violation: no covered receptacles in the unisex toilet room; citation issued. Dish area had food debris and a grey-black substance on the wall. Grease coated cooking equipment; drains and kitchen floors held debris and flour.

headline: Passed; rear doors have gaps over one inch
summary: Passed. The rear double doors are not rodent-proof, with gaps over one inch at the bottom, between the doors, and on top. Floor tiles in the prep and butcher customer area are in poor repair and must be replaced.

headline: Failed; no soap, dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Failed. Several handwash sinks lacked soap and paper towels, and one prep area had no handwash sink. A low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm sanitizer and was not used; manager called for maintenance. Certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Passed; no backflow device on new sink
summary: Passed. The newly installed utility sink in the rear prep area has no backflow prevention device; one must be installed where it can be serviced. The employee washroom lacks a covered receptacle for sanitary products.

headline: Passed; door gaps and dirty equipment
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door's bottom and corner must be sealed to keep pests out. Food debris was on slicers and prep tables; dust on coolers, freezers, and shelves; rust under meat-prep tables.

headline: Passed; cardboard shelving in liquor room
summary: Passed. Cardboard was used as shelving in the liquor room. The manager must use nonabsorbent, easy-to-clean material instead.

headline: Passed; dirty ice machine, dripping handsink
summary: Passed. The upper inside of the ice machine needs cleaning. A handsink near the cooking equipment has a constant drip and must be repaired. Floors under and around equipment, and sink floor drains, need cleaning.

headline: Passed; loose handle and nonworking cooler
summary: Passed. The hot water handle at the front prep handwash sink is loose and must be tightened. A nonworking cooler must be removed, or cleaned and kept dry for proper storage.

headline: Passed; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. A certified manager has no proof of allergen training. Also: an employee lacked a hair restraint in prep, wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer, and fryer interiors were greasy and dirty.

headline: Failed; no allergen training, prior violations uncorrected
summary: Failed. Food was stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and near the freezer, risking cross-contamination. Managers lack allergen training. Several violations from a 2024 inspection were not corrected, including unlabeled squeeze bottles and worn gaskets.

headline: Passed; cooler needs air thermometer
summary: Passed. The front counter Pepsi cooler must have a thermometer that measures its ambient air temperature.

headline: Passed with conditions; unsafe food temps, blocked sinks
summary: Passed with conditions. Chicken at 61.6°F and beef at 60.5°F were too warm; cold food must stay at 41°F or below. About 40 lbs discarded on site. Handwash sinks were blocked and lacked soap and towels; these were corrected on site.

headline: Passed; exposed sewage pipes over dry storage
summary: Passed. Exposed sewage pipes above dry food storage hung over disposable serveware; the pipes must be encased or the serveware moved. Broken glass and black rice were found on floors and must be cleaned. Unlabeled prepackaged food also noted.

headline: Passed; sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. The sanitation manager has no allergen training. The inspector stated that it must be provided.

headline: Passed with conditions; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Passed with conditions. The low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine; it must read at least 100 ppm. It was not in use, and no citation was issued. No allergen training certificate was on site for certified managers.

headline: Passed with conditions; broken soap dispenser at handsink
summary: Passed with conditions. The automatic soap dispenser at a handwash sink was broken, so proper handwashing was not possible during inspection; repair ordered and citation issued. Beverage equipment in the front prep area had dried food debris and sticky surfaces.

headline: Passed; greasy fryers and dusty vents
summary: Passed. Fryer bottoms had grease, and a can opener blade, a rusty prep table bottom, and wok-station surfaces needed cleaning. Floors, walls, ceiling vents, and the walk-in compressor fan had dust or splatter; hood vents also need cleaning.

headline: Passed; no food handler certificates on premises
summary: Passed. No food handler certificates were on the premises. Grocery bags were used in a reach-in freezer and must be replaced with food-grade bags or containers. Also: rotted wood shelving, an unused cooler, and a greasy exhaust hood.

headline: Passed; ice scoop stored improperly
summary: Passed. The ice scoop was stored in an open wire rack and touched the outside of the ice machine. It must be stored in a protected manner.

headline: Failed; rodent droppings and no health policy
summary: Failed. About 30 rodent droppings were found on heater ledges, around the water heater, and under the three-compartment sink; pest control recommended. No employee health policy was on site; a food handler lacked training proof. Menu lacked raw-food advisory.

headline: Failed; unsafe cold-holding temps, cooler tagged
summary: Failed. Eggs, sausages, cheeses, and other cold foods were held at 49.5°F to 58.2°F; cold food must be 41°F or below. About 22 lbs discarded. The prep cooler, at 55.3°F, is tagged and must not be used until re-inspected.

headline: Passed; dirty drains, worn cooler gasket
summary: Passed. Floor drains in the rear dish, bakery, and coffee areas need cleaning to prevent insects. A worn gasket on the sushi-area low reach-in cooler must be repaired or replaced. Floors and hood filters also need cleaning.

headline: Failed; coolers switched off, no certified manager
summary: Failed. Reach-in and prep coolers were off; they must hold 41°F or below. No valid manager certificate was posted. Dish machine sanitizer read 0 ppm. No employee health policy and no handwash sink at the dish area.

headline: Conditional: hand-washing lapse, no food handler training
summary: Pass with conditions. An employee handled bread and chicken without washing hands after using a phone and other contact. No food handler training for employees, no signed employee health policies, no allergen training, and no posted summary report.

headline: Passed re-inspection; thermometer and restroom waste can
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Ambient air thermometer must be placed inside the dessert refrigerator. Women's restroom needs a covered waste receptacle for feminine hygiene products.

headline: Conditional: no certified manager for 75 minutes
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager on site for 75 minutes (timed) while TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. Dishes washed but not sanitized. Food employees lacked food handler training. Cut bananas and plantains stored uncovered on floor.

headline: Failed: no sanitizer on site; warm food discarded
summary: Failed. No chemical sanitizer was available; an employee was sent to buy chlorine. Two ready-to-eat foods held above 41°F (47.6°F and 48.9°F); about 10 lbs discarded. Prep cooler tagged. Previous major violations were not corrected.

headline: Passed re-inspection; leak under handsink
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Leak from pipe under the exposed kitchen handsink must be repaired. Operator was instructed to clean the fryer bottom, equipment exteriors, refrigeration and freezer units, prep tables, and ice machine panel.

headline: Passed; rear door gap, leaking pipe
summary: Passed. A 1/4 inch gap at the rear exit door sweep must be fixed so the door is rodent-proof. Food buildup on dish machine exteriors. Pipe leaking under the first-floor dish machine drainboard must be repaired.

headline: Failed: dead roaches, no handsink, no training
summary: Failed. Numerous dead roaches were on glue boards in prep and sales areas. No handwashing sink in rear prep. No food handler training available, no employee health policy, and no procedures for vomiting or diarrhea cleanup. Many upkeep issues noted.

headline: Passed; unclean bar ice machine, unlabeled seasonings
summary: Passed. Bar ice machine was not clean; ice must be removed and surfaces cleaned and sanitized. Dry seasonings in unlabeled bags. No splash guard between bar handsink and sanitizing sink. Trash under outside dumpster. Clutter in bar storage closet.

headline: Passed; toilet room needs detail cleaning
summary: Passed. Toilet and toilet room need detail cleaning. Clutter in side prep area. Dirt, debris, and dust under heavy equipment and on sales area ceiling tiles. Water-stained ceiling tiles above beverage coolers must be replaced.

headline: Passed; residue in keg cooler
summary: Passed. Residue build-up found in the cold hold unit where kegs are kept. Person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain the unit.

headline: Failed: cool handsinks, small flies found
summary: Failed. Handsink water measured 82.8-94.6°F; at least 100°F is required. Sinks were repaired on site to 102.0-111.2°F. About 10 small flies were found in rear prep; pest control service recommended. Towels and foil used as liners.

headline: Passed; door gap, leaking sinks, no allergen certificate
summary: Passed. A gap in the middle of the front entry doors must be repaired to prevent pests. Front handsink sprays water when turned on, and the rear 3-compartment sink faucet leaks. Manager has no allergen training certificate on site.

headline: Passed; screen door not pest-proof
summary: Passed. Rear screen door is not rodent or insect proof and must be made so if opened for air. Wiping cloths stored improperly. Rusty storage racks in reach-in coolers. Water-stained and damaged ceilings; dirty basement and first-floor floors.

headline: Failed: no soap or paper towels at handsink
summary: Failed. Bar handsink had no hand soap; a food handler obtained soap during inspection. No paper towels at bar and rear prep handsinks; obtained during inspection. Citations issued. No consumer advisory signage posted. Cutting boards have deep grooves.

headline: Failed: no hot handwashing water; handsink blocked
summary: Failed. Hot water at toilet-room handsinks measured 71.1°F and 70.2°F; 100°F required. Other sinks not operable, and prep handsink clogged with water shut off. Citation issued. Also noted leaks, debris, and burnt-out hood light.

headline: Conditional: handsink blocked, octopus held too warm
summary: Pass with conditions. Bar handsinks lacked soap and paper towels. Kitchen prep handsink was blocked and used to store a spatula; manager removed items on site. Low-temperature dish machine rinse at 0 ppm chlorine, tagged. Cooked octopus at 46.7-51.1°F; about 4 lbs discarded.

headline: Passed; missing sink stoppers, rusty shelves
summary: Passed. The 3-compartment sink has no stoppers and must be provided with them. Rusty and dirty shelves inside the meat and sushi walk-in cooler must be cleaned and repainted with food-grade paint or replaced.

headline: Passed; greasy hood vent
summary: Passed. Dust and debris buildup on the ventilation hood above cooking and frying equipment must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; dead insects on storage floors
summary: Passed. Dead insects were found on floors throughout dry and liquor storage; they must be removed and the area cleaned. Interior of two-door cooler holding kegs and drinks must be cleaned to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Failed: missing handwashing sink in service line
summary: Failed. Food service line with cooler and microwave has no handwashing sink; a hot holding unit in the new seating area must be removed or a handwashing sink installed. Certified food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Passed; ice machine buildup, expired certificates
summary: Passed. Slight buildup inside the ice machine must be cleaned. Ice buildup on walk-in freezer condenser must be removed. Expired food handler certificates were on premises and must be updated. Peeling ceiling paint in basement restroom.

headline: Passed re-inspection; greasy floors and corners
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Dirt, grease, and food spills in corners throughout the premises. Floors throughout the prep area are covered in grease. Operator instructed to clean behind and under heavy equipment and storage racks, and detail clean.

headline: Failed: unsafe shrimp thawing, corrected on site
summary: Failed. Frozen shrimp was thawed in standing water near the prep sink, which is not an approved method. Chef corrected the violation during inspection. Unlabeled containers and food stored on walk-in cooler floor also noted.

headline: Conditional: no certified food manager on site
summary: Pass with conditions. No City of Chicago certified food manager was on site while foods that must be kept cold (hamburgers, eggs) were prepared and served. Citation issued. Unlabeled gravy container, food stored on floor, minor leak.

headline: Failed: flying insects on food prep surfaces
summary: Failed. Numerous flying insects landed on cutting boards, prep tables, holding units, and sinks; manager told to call an exterminator and clean. Food uncovered in coolers and prep areas. No food handler training available; no allergen training for managers.

headline: Failed: unlabeled display foods, no chlorine test kit
summary: Failed. Self-service prepackaged foods in display (kefir, elixirs, vegan ice creams) were unlabeled. No chlorine test kit on site. Covered waste receptacle missing in employee restroom; no mop drying rack; no proof of food handler training.

headline: Passed; torn gasket, no backflow device
summary: Passed. Torn refrigerator door gasket must be replaced. No backflow prevention device on the ice machine. Unused convection oven in storage. Grease and food debris on back wall where fryers are stored.

headline: Passed; torn gasket and stained boards
summary: Passed. Torn door gasket inside prep line cooler #1 must be replaced. Stained cutting boards on prep line coolers must be resurfaced or replaced. Build-up on fountain drink nozzles. Water leak under the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Passed re-inspection; rodent droppings on menu boxes
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Open boxes of menus in the basement had rodent droppings; inspector instructed that all contaminated boxes be discarded. Also noted grease, debris, and unlabeled bulk containers.

headline: Failed: no food handler training; poor handsinks
summary: Failed on re-inspection. Low hot and cold water pressure at men's rear restroom handsinks; water does not shut off at women's rear handsinks. No food handler training for employees. Repeat core violations not corrected, including excessive grime, clutter, and a dirty hood.

headline: Conditional: no valid certified manager certificate
summary: Pass with conditions. Person in charge lacked a valid original certified food manager certificate while TCS foods (pizza, sausage, vegetables, garlic) were prepared and served; citation issued. Missing cooler thermometers, dirty basement slicer, clutter, and two uncertified handlers.

headline: Failed: meats held too warm; ice machine spots
summary: Failed. Pizza prep cooler held ground beef, sausage, pepperoni, and bacon at 45.8-53.0°F (41°F or below required). About 19 lbs discarded. Black spots inside ice machine touching ice. Unlabeled containers, wiping cloths, and broken ceiling tiles noted.

headline: Passed; gap at rear exit door
summary: Passed. A 1/4 inch gap at the top of the rear exit door must be sealed with a tight-fitting seal at all outer openings to prevent pest entry.

headline: Passed; dirty prep area and cutting boards
summary: Passed. Cutting boards have deep grooves and stains. Women's restroom trash lacks a lid. Rear prep walls, ceiling tiles, and vents have dirt and food splatters. Floor drains and floors under heavy equipment are dirty. Certified managers lack allergen certificates.

headline: Passed; floor drains and dust buildup
summary: Passed. Cutting boards have open seams and dark stains. Floor drains under sinks have excessive food debris. Mop must be stored in a position that allows drying to prevent pest harborage. Loose debris and dust on floors and under equipment.

headline: Passed re-inspection; unlabeled ingredients, buckets
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Dry ingredients at prep tables and cook line lacked labels. A food handler lacked proper hair restraints. Food was stored in home improvement store buckets in walk-in cooler; only food-grade containers are allowed.

headline: Passed; leaking faucet, slow-draining sink
summary: Passed. Leaking faucet at the 3-compartment sink and slow-draining front prep handsink must be repaired. One of two all-gender restrooms lacks a lidded waste can for feminine hygiene products.

headline: Passed; gap under front doors
summary: Passed. A gap along the bottom of the front entry and exit doors must be fixed so the doors are tight-fitting to prevent insect entry.

headline: Conditional: no vomit/diarrhea cleanup procedures
summary: Pass with conditions. No procedures or supplies for responding to vomiting and diarrhea events; citation issued. Bulk containers unlabeled. Leaking faucet on front 3-compartment sink. Dust and debris on vents and ceilings; damaged floor tiles and missing fan cover.

headline: Failed: no handwashing sink in prep area
summary: Failed. No verifiable employee health policy on site. No handwashing sink in coffee and prep area where food is prepared and served. No handwashing signs. Unused equipment and clutter in storage. No ventilation in washrooms. Food service sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Passed re-inspection; slow sink, rodent harborage risk
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Exposed handsink in pizza prep drains slowly. Dirt and debris in basement walk-in coolers and freezers. Clutter and cardboard in basement storage must be removed to prevent rodent harborage. Women's restroom ventilation not working.

headline: Passed; no utility sink, washroom needs fixes
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign at washroom sink. No utility sink on site; one must be installed with hot and cold water and a backflow device. Washroom door lacks a self-closing device, is missing baseboards, and exposed brick walls must be sealed.

headline: Failed: dish machine lacks temperature measuring device
summary: Failed. A high-temperature dish machine was on site with no irreversible measuring device (a device that permanently records temperature). Operator was instructed to provide one. Priority foundation violation issued.

headline: Passed; mold-like buildup in basement cooler
