summary: Passed. White mold-like buildup on storage racks in basement walk-in cooler must be cleaned. Slow-draining handsink and bar sink. Women's restroom door must be self-closing. Boiler room floors and rear outside area need cleaning.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings found in several areas
summary: Failed. Inspector counted about 35 mouse droppings: 15 under the steam table, 10 near the walk-in freezer, and 10 in the office. Operator must clean and call pest control. Dirty coolers, floors, fryer filters, and clutter also noted.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; live roaches, flies
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on duty while TCS foods (foods that must be kept hot or cold) were prepared; manager arrived at 9:36 a.m. Five live roaches, several dead roaches, and 20+ live small flies found. Pest control recommended.

headline: Failed: about 40 mouse droppings in storage
summary: Failed. About 40 mouse droppings were scattered in rear storage near cold hold units and furnace; operator must remove them and clean and sanitize the area. Citation issued. Debris and buildup under prep tables and food debris on floors.

headline: Passed; dead flies found, training records missing
summary: Passed. Dead small flies were stuck to the wall beside the dishwasher and must be removed and cleaned. No proof of food handler training was shown for any food handler; records must be kept on site at all times.

headline: Passed; dust, debris, and grease buildup
summary: Passed. Three prep cooling units lack thermometers. Food debris and spills under booth cushions. Dust and debris in employee restroom and second-floor dry storage. Grease on filters above fryers. All items to be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Failed: 80+ mouse droppings under prep table
summary: Failed. 80 or more mouse droppings found on the bottom of a prep table and inside a fryer cabinet. Operator must clean and have pest control service before reinspection next week. Citation issued. Greasy fryers and allergen training also noted.

headline: Conditional: raw meat stored in grocery bags
summary: Pass with conditions. Raw meat was stored in grocery bags in upright freezer. Ready-to-eat deli meat not date marked. Food uncovered in refrigerator. Cutting boards have open seams and stains; coolers and freezers have food debris and spills; slow-draining handsink.

headline: Passed; license number missing on banners; leaky faucet
summary: Passed. License number was not printed on the sides of the bicycle banners; it must be at least 2 inches tall. Faucet on a handsink leaks and must be corrected.

headline: Passed re-inspection; heavy grease and debris
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Heavy equipment in front prep has heavy grease and food debris, especially between cooling units and the grill. Interiors of cooling units had spills. Floors need cleaning to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Conditional: no certified food manager present
summary: Pass with conditions. No person in charge held a valid Chicago food sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was on site or certificate posted while TCS foods were prepared and served. Citation issued. Slow-draining handsink, missing light switch cover.

headline: Passed; rear door gap and restroom issues
summary: Passed. Rear exterior door has a 1/4 inch gap and must be repaired. No partition between mop sink and restroom handsink. Restroom door is not self-closing and must be fitted with a self-closing device.

headline: Passed; clutter in rear storage rooms
summary: Passed. Rear storage rooms contain clutter, including containers and construction debris. Manager was instructed to remove unnecessary items and organize the areas.

headline: Passed; cardboard liner on prep table
summary: Passed. Cardboard was used as a liner on a prep table and must be removed; food contact surfaces must be smooth and easy to clean. Excess flour and debris on prep tables. Stained ceiling tiles and smoke buildup on prep area walls.

headline: Passed; trash and food debris under dumpsters
summary: Passed. Trash and food debris were found on the ground under the dumpsters. Operator was instructed to clean and maintain the area to prevent pest activity.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; fish held too warm
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on site while open and operating; citation issued. Two containers of perch and catfish held at 48.9-53.3°F (41°F or below required); about 20 lbs discarded. Probe thermometer does not work. Two handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Conditional: broken coolers tagged, not in use
summary: Pass with conditions. A line cooler and walk-in cooler were in poor repair and not working; no cold food was stored in them. Inspector tagged them; repair or replacement and contact with Chicago Department of Public Health (CDPH) required before use. Gaskets and sink leaks noted.

headline: Passed; two dead baby mice removed on site
summary: Passed. Two dead baby mice were found on glue boards in the furnace closet; removed and discarded on site. Dust on ceiling vents, dirty floors and walls, and grease on hood vents noted; some areas were corrected on site.

headline: Failed: menu lacks raw-food advisory; no allergen training
summary: Failed. Menu had only a footnote reminder and no disclosure for raw or undercooked animal items; citation issued. Unlabeled flour and sugar containers, food stored on chairs, uninverted utensils, a small leak, and kitchen exhaust grime. Repeat allergen training violation.

headline: Passed; leaky sink and dead cooler light
summary: Passed. Cabinet under beverage station has dirt and debris. Rear one-compartment sink leaks at faucet base. Clutter near toilet room. Light bulbs inside walk-in cooler and freezer are burnt out and must be replaced.

headline: Passed re-inspection; water-damaged ceiling tile
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Opening into the ceiling and water-damaged ceiling tile above the kitchen prep ventilation hood must be sealed and the tile repaired or replaced.

headline: Passed; all food workers have required training
summary: Passed. Inspector found all food employees have food handler training. Manager was reminded that all food handlers must follow Illinois Department of Public Health (IDPH) requirements.

headline: Passed; food handler certificates not on site
summary: Passed. No food handler certificates were on site at the time of inspection. Certificates must be kept on site at all times; new hires have a 30-day grace period.

headline: Passed; freezer chest lid damaged
summary: Passed. Freezer chest lid is in poor repair with pieces missing. Manager was instructed to replace the lid.

headline: Failed: unlabeled mussels; dish machine held
summary: Failed. Mussels in cooler had no shellfish tag; they were voluntarily discarded (8 lbs, $38). Shellfish tags lacked the date when the last shellfish is sold or served. Low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 10 ppm chlorine and was tagged on hold.

headline: Failed: menu lacks raw-food advisory; missing certificate
summary: Failed. Menu did not identify foods that can be ordered raw or undercooked; management must add the required advisory sentence. A food handler lacked a food handler certificate; all handlers must show proof of training.

headline: Failed: handsink missing hot water knob
summary: Failed. Hot water knob missing at exposed first-floor kitchen handsink; sink must deliver hot water at 100-120°F. Citation issued. No sushi rice letter or pH meter on site. No allergen training certificates on site.

headline: Passed; loose handsink faucet
summary: Passed. A handsink faucet near the dish machine area is loose and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Failed: over 50 live flies in basement storage
summary: Failed. Over 50 small live flies were on walls and ceiling in basement storage; operator must remove, clean, and sanitize, and contact licensed pest control. Citation issued. Plastic crates used for elevation, moldy racks, slow-draining sink.

headline: Passed re-inspection; old droppings, dirty surfaces
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Floors had thick buildup of food, old droppings, dirt, and debris. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Knives were stored beside the 3-compartment sink. Cutting board has dark stains and deep grooves.

headline: Failed: no customer barrier, open entrance gap
summary: Failed. No barrier kept customers out of the front prep area (priority violation). Small opening between front entrance doors. No handwashing signs. Leaves and wooden pallets in outdoor enclosure, which must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Other cleaning issues noted.

headline: Passed re-inspection; restroom door and waste can
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Bathroom door must be self-closing. Unisex toilet room needs a covered waste can. Employees without a City sanitation certificate must have food handler certificates, and certificate holders must have allergen certificates.

headline: Passed; salad bowl stored in salad
summary: Passed. A salad mixing bowl was stored inside the salad and must be kept on a clean surface between uses. Excess black caulking at the warewashing unit base, and a cracked light shield near the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Passed re-inspection; door gaps and grimy utensils
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Rear and front doors are not tight-fitting; a 1/4 inch gap is at the front door bottom. Cooking utensils were stored with food grime and debris, and cold-hold gaskets had buildup.

headline: Passed re-inspection; food residue, peeling paint
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Food residue build-up in refrigerator and back of dish area must be cleaned. Wall between kitchen and front prep has damaged and peeling paint that must be repaired.

headline: Passed; no valid food handler certificates on site
summary: Passed. Food handlers were on site with no food handler certificates; certificates on site were expired. Also noted greasy fryers, a leaking cold water knob on the 3-compartment sink, and a ventilation hood with grease, dirt, and dust buildup.

headline: Passed re-inspection; stained ceiling tile
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Operator was instructed to clean the bottoms of hot holding units, prep tables, and the inside of refrigeration and freezer units. Water-stained ceiling tile in men's restroom to be replaced.

headline: Failed: no handwash soap, unlabeled cheesecakes
summary: Failed. No soap at handsinks in prep/dishwashing and front serving areas; citation issued. Cheesecakes in cooler were missing food labels. Two servers lacked hair restraints. Wiping cloths stored improperly. Cooler door broken and covered with cardboard.

headline: Passed re-inspection; rusty shelving, broken light shield
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Rusty food storage shelving inside walk-in cooler must be repainted or replaced. Broken light shield cover above the rear 3-compartment sink must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Passed; ice buckets hung from basement pipes
summary: Passed. Ice buckets were hanging from exposed basement pipes next to the ice machine used for consumption. Buckets must not hang from ceiling pipes and must be stored so contaminants cannot fall in.

headline: Conditional: missing health policy, training certificates
summary: Pass with conditions. No written employee health policy on premises. No thermometer in front milk refrigerator. Leak at dish sink faucet. No covered waste receptacle in unisex restroom. One food handler lacked a certificate; a certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Conditional: no valid manager certificate; handsink blocked
summary: Pass with conditions. No valid city sanitation manager certificate on site while soup and beef were prepared; citation issued. No paper towels at bar handsinks. Front prep handsink blocked and filled with a container; citation combined. No allergen training certificates.

headline: Passed; door gap and worn concrete
summary: Passed. A 1/4 inch gap at front entry doors on Wells Street must be sealed. Cutting boards have deep grooves and stains. Large cracks and worn concrete at the front entry and other areas must be sealed to prevent food and pest buildup.

headline: Passed; floors need detail cleaning
summary: Passed. Floors need detail cleaning along wall bases and in corners to remove spills, debris, and grease, especially around cooking equipment.

headline: Passed; hair restraints and cleaning needed
summary: Passed. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint; all handlers must wear effective ones. Food spills and debris found on equipment, prep tables, coolers, and floors. Only one stopper for the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Conditional: loose faucet knob, no test strip
summary: Pass with conditions. Loose hot water knob at dish room handsink must be repaired. Ice scoops were drying on a towel; they must rest on a non-absorbent surface. No sanitizer test strip at the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Failed: 40+ mouse droppings in many areas
summary: Failed. Approximately 40 or more mouse droppings found, including near cold holding units, under food shelves, and where tamale corn husks are stored. Food containers were stored on the floor. Prior inspection summary report was not posted; new one posted.

headline: Failed: over 1,000 mouse droppings found
summary: Failed on re-inspection. Inspector recorded over 1,000 mouse droppings in dry storage, kitchen, prep, dining, and hallway areas; pest control consultation recommended. No employee health policy shown; chicken not date marked. Repeat violations for training noted.

headline: Passed; several fixes needed, including allergen certificates
summary: Passed. Handwashing signage needed at all handsinks. Rear door shared with next-door business must be rodent-proofed. Three drain stoppers needed for the 3-compartment sink. Toilet room doors must be self-closing. Two certified managers lack allergen certificates.

headline: Conditional: cooler too warm; food discarded, repaired
summary: Pass with conditions. Prep cooler measured 62.1°F air; TCS foods (must be kept cold) held at 47.8-56.4°F. About 22 lbs discarded. Cooler was repaired by end of inspection. No vomiting and diarrhea procedure; vomit kit provided.

headline: Passed; scoops stored in food, wet mop in bucket
summary: Passed. Scoops for the ice machine and flour bin were stored with handles inside food; handles must be up and out of food. A wet mop was stored in a bucket and must be hung to dry. City food managers lack allergen training.

headline: Passed; cooling and cups guidance
summary: Passed. Food was covered tightly during cooling; instructed to cover loosely or uncover. Stained deli cups were used as multi-use utensils; instructed to discard them after use.

headline: Passed re-inspection; missing floor tiles
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Rear floor is missing tiles, and wood is being used as a substitute. Manager was instructed to replace the missing floor tiles so the floor is easy to clean.

headline: Failed: raw chicken thawing in handsink
summary: Failed. Raw chicken was thawing in standing water inside a handsink, and the sink was not accessible for use; citations issued. Raw ground beef was thawing at room temperature. No pest control log book. No covered waste receptacle or self-closing door in employee washroom.

headline: Passed; grease buildup and expired certificates
summary: Passed. Food debris and grease buildup on cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, freezers, and shelving must be cleaned. Expired food handler certificates and expired allergen training certificates for managers were found.

headline: Failed: about 5 live flies in bakery prep
summary: Failed. About 5 live large flies were flying around the bakery prep area; operator must eliminate them, clean, and contact pest control. Citation issued. Grease debris on floors by fryers. Internal food handler training lacks an approved IDPH letter.

headline: Failed: no food handler certificates; sink drainage
summary: Failed. Both kitchen handsinks lacked paper towels; manager stocked them during inspection; citation issued. Black buildup inside ice machine. Three-compartment sink drains poorly, flooding between compartments. Repeat violations: no food handler certificates on site.

headline: No certified manager while pizza was served
summary: No valid certified food manager certificate or manager was on site while pizza and dairy foods were prepared and served, and a citation was issued. Reach-in cooler thermometers were hard to see, and floors and cabinets were dirty.

headline: Ice machine buildup, leaks, dirty floors
summary: Ice machine chute had calcium buildup. Also noted: poorly attached wood on grill wall, a leaky drain under a rinse sink, debris around the dumpster, dirty floors, and milk crates used as shelves.

headline: Pests, slimy ice machine, failed dishwasher
summary: About 40 live small flying insects were seen in the basement mop sink area, and more pest control is needed. Black slime dripped from the ice machine's interior into ice, so it was ordered shut off and cleaned. Bar dishwasher showed 0 ppm chlorine.

headline: One dead cockroach under bar sink
summary: One dead cockroach was found under the bar three-compartment sink. The employee corrected this on site by removing it.

headline: No certified manager during food preparation
summary: No person in charge had a valid City of Chicago certificate. Staff prepared tacos and tortas that must be kept hot or cold without a certified manager on site, and a citation was issued. Food handlers also lacked hair restraints.

headline: Door gaps, dirty vents, storage clutter
summary: Rear and front doors had about 1/4-inch gaps at the bottom, which must be repaired. Walk-in cooler fan vents need detail cleaning, and storage behind the walk-in freezer was cluttered. Floor corners under shelving and the dishwashing station were dirty.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and open floor holes
summary: Restroom handwashing sinks had no handwashing signs. Open holes in the bar-area floor near the warewashing machine and a storage closet floor and wall needed repair.

headline: Unsafe hot and cold food temps; no manager
summary: No certified food manager was on site while foods were served. Hot chicken (103.6F) and beans (114.6-125.6F) in the steam table were too cool and were reheated. Cold foods at 45.6-50.1F were discarded, and a cooler at 51.8F was tagged.

headline: Unlabeled spices, leaking faucet, missing certificate
summary: Spice containers on a rear shelf had no labels. A water leak at the base of the rear prep and dishwashing sink faucet was to be repaired. One food handler had no food handler certificate and must show proof of training.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup procedure
summary: No employee health policy or written procedure for vomit or diarrhea cleanup was on site, and supplies were inadequate. The toilet room lacked a covered receptacle, and no allergen certificates were provided for managers.

headline: Sticky juice nozzles, greasy equipment, dirty floors
summary: Orange juice machine nozzles had splatter buildup, and cooking equipment sides had heavy grease. Floors in dishwashing, prep and coffee areas had dirt, dust and food debris that must be cleaned to prevent pests.

headline: Missing sign, slow drain, expired training
summary: A rear dishwashing hand sink needed a handwashing sign and a slow drain repaired. Prep and storage shelves had dried food debris and grease. Some food handlers had expired training certificates and must complete an approved food handler program.

headline: No vomit or diarrhea cleanup supplies
summary: No clean-up supplies for vomit or diarrhea events were on the premises, and a citation was issued. Management was instructed to provide them. The microwave interior also needed cleaning.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged
summary: The low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine, was not sanitizing, and was tagged; a citation was issued. Ice machine interior was dirty, male food handlers lacked beard restraints, and wiping cloths were stored improperly.

headline: Crates as shelves; broken handle; no training proof
summary: Crates were used for elevation throughout prep, dish and bar areas and must be replaced with smooth, cleanable shelving. The front prep hand sink's cold water handle was inoperable. No food handler training proof was on site.

headline: Leaky faucet necks; unfinished garage-door wall
summary: A hand sink faucet neck in front prep and a three-compartment sink faucet in rear prep leaked; tape was removed and repairs required. Unfinished wall behind garage doors needs finishing and a wall base to close a gap. Thermometers were missing from front and rear prep cooling units.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving throughout storage areas. They must be removed and replaced with shelving at least six inches off the floor for cleaning access.

headline: Standing water around basement sump pump
summary: Standing water was on the basement floor around the sump pump. The manager must keep the basement floor dry and clean at all times.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; cooler drain misrouted
summary: The handwashing sink in the serving area had no handwashing sign, and a cooler drain line emptied into that sink. The manager was told to add signs at all employee handwashing sinks and connect the drain line to a floor drain.

headline: Missing thermometers, unsafe scooper, damaged gasket
summary: Thermometers were missing inside the salsa cooling units. Styrofoam cups were used as scoopers for sugar; staff were told to provide a proper handled utensil. A two-door cooler had a damaged gasket, and floors behind a freezer had excess food debris.

headline: Dirty coolers, freezers, and floors
summary: The interiors of coolers and freezers must be cleaned to remove debris. Prep area floors along wall bases and corners need cleaning, and basement storage floors under crates and along walls also need cleaning.

headline: Inspection summary not posted; greasy floors
summary: No inspection summary was posted for public view, so a citation was issued; management was told to post the copy given. Grill, fryers, and prep tables need cleaning, and a basement employee restroom fan was not working.

headline: Raw wood and unfinished drywall in prep
summary: Raw wood surfaces in the food prep area must be sealed so they are smooth and cleanable. Unfinished drywall in the prep area must be finished to be non-porous and easy to clean.

headline: Wiping cloth left on cutting board
summary: A green wiping cloth was found on the smoothie prep cooler cutting board. Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizing buckets between uses.

headline: Cardboard used as floor matting
summary: Cardboard must not be used as matting on floors in the rear storage closet. No other issues were listed.

headline: Grimy equipment, dirty floors, faulty faucet
summary: Bulk containers needed cleaning and labels. Cooking equipment and prep tables had food spills and buildup. The faucet needs replacing, and a sprayer is needed for washing large pots. Floors throughout need detail cleaning.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: No handwashing sign was posted at the bar area. Expired food handler certificates were on premises, and the certified manager's allergen training had expired. Staff must show proof of training and keep certificates on site.

headline: No certified manager during food service
summary: Failed. Person in charge lacked a certificate, and no certified manager was on site while soups, meatballs and sandwiches were prepared. Dry storage items were on floors, and ceiling tiles were missing or water-damaged. Front coolers lacked a working thermometer.

headline: Mineral buildup in ice machine; peeling paint
summary: Basement ice machine had mineral buildup and must be cleaned. Peeling wall paint by the prep line cooler must be repaired. Hood dust must be cleaned, and a hood light must be replaced. An expired allergen certificate was noted.

headline: Dirty ice machine, loose faucet, greasy floors
summary: The ice machine's interior chute and the dough mixer were not clean and must be cleaned and sanitized. The three-compartment sink faucet neck was loose and leaking. Walk-in cooler walls had black substance, and floors needed cleaning.

headline: Dirty ice machine, leaks, rusted shelving
summary: Inspector required cleaning the ice machine interior, cleaning and repairing rusted walk-in shelving, fixing leaks at the 3-compartment sink and dishwasher, and providing a lidded trash can in a restroom. Certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Expired food handler certificates
summary: Expired food handler certificates were on site. The manager was instructed to comply with food handler requirements.

headline: No pest service report; no certified manager
summary: Failed. No current pest control service report was on site; a service contract was present, and a citation was issued. No valid certificate was posted while hot and cold foods were prepared. Food handlers were told to wear effective hair restraints.

headline: Cracked washroom sink counter
summary: A crack in the washroom sink counter must be repaired so it is smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Thermometers, dirty cold unit, dusty light shield
summary: Working thermometers must be provided and maintained inside coolers. The interior of a reach-in cold holding unit must be cleaned of spills or debris, and the dining area light shield needs cleaning.

headline: Stained cutting boards and leaking drain
summary: Dark stained cutting boards were found in the juice prep and deli areas and must be resurfaced or replaced. A drain line leaked under the bakery hand sink, and grill-area equipment and the bakery walk-in floor needed cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers, torn gasket, greasy filters
summary: Bulk containers of beans and hibiscus in the basement dry storage had no labels or common names. A torn gasket on a two-door cooler by the grill needed repair, and filters in the rear ventilation system were covered in grease.

headline: Certified manager must complete allergen training
summary: The certified manager on duty must comply with allergen training requirements or citations will follow. No other issues were listed.

headline: Ice machine debris; knives stored improperly
summary: The ice machine's interior panel had slight debris buildup and needed cleaning. Knives were stored between the prep table and prep cooler and must be stored properly between uses.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate posted
summary: No valid City of Chicago food sanitation certificate was posted, so a certified food manager must be present whenever foods that must stay hot or cold are prepared or served. No allergen training certificate was on site.

headline: Live roaches, rats, and droppings found
summary: Failed. Roaches and rats were too numerous to count, with droppings in prep and dry storage. Live roaches and flies were in flour, rice and sugar. Cold foods held too warm were discarded. No certified manager was present.

headline: No certified manager; blocked sink; dish machine failed
summary: Failed. No valid sanitation manager certificate was on site. A front drink-prep hand sink was blocked and operable only from the bottom valve. A low-temperature dish machine was not sanitizing (0 ppm) and was tagged. Previous violations were not corrected.

headline: No sanitation certificate; missing signs
summary: No City of Chicago sanitation certificate was found while foods that must be kept hot or cold were handled. Rear prep handwashing sinks lacked signs, one food handler lacked training, and pots were not stored upside down.

headline: Unlabeled food, improperly stored cloths
summary: Food removed from original containers was not labeled, and wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer. Milk crates were used as shelving, a three-compartment sink faucet leaked, floor tiles were broken, and no allergen training certificates were on site.

headline: Ice scoop in ice bin; worn cutting board
summary: An ice scoop was stored in the ice machine and fountain drink ice bin; it must be removed. A cutting board had deep cuts and must be replaced. Also needed: cleaning of drains, floors, and vents.

headline: Severe sink leak, rodent gap, missing training
summary: A rear food prep handwash sink pipe leaked severely into a bucket and must be repaired. Rear exit door was not rodent-proof, and an insect control device was stored above cabbage and carrots. No allergen training certificate was on site.

headline: Live flies found; no cooler thermometers
summary: Failed. About 40 live small flies were in the basement outside the beer walk-in cooler, and must be removed before reinspection. No thermometers were inside bar and beer coolers. A hand sink's cold water line was loose.

headline: Repeat violations: gaskets, cutting boards, debris
summary: Failed. Earlier violations were not corrected: worn gaskets on two refrigerators and a reach-in cooler, cutting boards with deep seams and stains, and food debris on walls and floors upstairs. A missing light-switch cover along basement stairs needs repair.

headline: Missing sink stoppers, rusty racks, caulk issues
summary: A spider web was over the women's restroom and needed removal. The three-compartment sink lacked stoppers, walk-in cooler racks were rusted, foil was on equipment and walls, and exposed foam caulk and chipped wall paint needed resurfacing.

headline: No employee health policy; loose cooler doors
summary: No employee health policy was on premises; a priority violation was noted. Three-door cooler doors were not attached properly and could come off when opened. Food handlers and managers must obtain required training.

headline: No food handler or allergen training found
summary: No valid food handler or allergen training was available. Also noted: peeling shelving paint above the three-compartment sink, openings in the floor and damaged baseboards, dust buildup, and a dirty microwave and stove.

headline: Broken faucet knob, leak, and dirty restrooms
summary: A utility sink cold water knob was broken and a rear prep hand sink leaked. Toilets needed cleaning, floors and storage shelves needed deep cleaning, and some ceiling tile was missing. An expired allergen certificate was also noted.

headline: Missing backflow devices at sink and hose bibs
summary: Backflow prevention devices were not located at the utility mop sink or basement hose bibs. They must be installed where they can be serviced and maintained.

headline: Greasy cook line, no service sink, missing signs
summary: Failed. Encrusted grease covered cooking equipment on the main cook line, and the hand sink there lacked signage. No service sink for dirty mop water was on site, a repeat violation that was cited.

headline: Deep fryer interior needs cleaning
summary: The inspector required cleaning the inside of the deep fryer. No other issues were listed in this inspection.

headline: Hair restraint missing; ice scoops improperly stored
summary: An employee in the front prep area was not wearing a hair restraint. Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables instead of sanitizer, and ice scoops were stored on top of the basement ice machine.

headline: No covered trash can; no allergen certificate
summary: The toilet room had no covered receptacle, and no allergen training certificate was provided for the food service sanitation manager. Management was told to provide both.

headline: Stripped hot water handle on sink
summary: The hot water handle on the smaller three-compartment sink was stripped. The sink must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Unsafe faucet attachment; no food handler certificates
summary: A filtered-water faucet on the handwashing sink line must be removed; use the three-compartment sink instead. No food handler certificates were provided for any handlers, and the employee restroom door was not self-closing.

headline: Damaged gaskets, basement clutter, wall hole
summary: Damaged gaskets were on a cold holding unit near the cook line and a three-door cooler. Basement corner clutter must be cleared and elevated six inches. A hole in the lower basement wall near hot water tanks needs repair, and a handwashing sink splash guard must be reattached.

headline: Leaky sink pipe and missing food handler training
summary: Storage containers were unlabeled, utensils were not inverted, and plastic ware was not stored upright. Grease built up on the fryer, oven and grill. A three-compartment sink pipe leaked, and one employee lacked food handler training.

headline: No allergen training certificates on site
summary: No allergen training certificates were on site. All certified food managers must provide allergen training.

headline: Greasy fryers, dirty vents, no self-closing doors
summary: Fryer exteriors and interiors needed grease removed. Washroom doors lacked self-closing devices, and vents above the fryers needed cleaning.

headline: Missing splash guard and certificates
summary: A splash guard was missing between the rear prep hand sink and prep table. Dust covered walk-in cooler fan covers, food debris was on rear prep shelves, and floors under cooking equipment had grease. Some food handlers and managers lacked certificates.

headline: Rusty cooler racks and grooved cutting boards
summary: Storage racks inside reach-in and walk-in coolers were rusty and must be rust-free and smooth. Cutting boards with deep, dark grooves and stains must be sanded or replaced.

headline: Dirty ice machine, reach-in coolers, and faucet
summary: Ice machine and reach-in cooler interiors had buildup. The three-compartment sink faucet needs repair so its nozzle reaches the third compartment. Outside garbage area and front prep floors need cleaning.

headline: Live roaches, flies, and hot water failures
summary: Failed. Live cockroaches were found in multiple areas, including about 25 in the first-floor pastry area. About 75 small flies were throughout the facility. Hand sinks lacked hot water, and a dish machine was not to be used until repaired.

headline: No proof of manager allergen training
summary: The facility could not show allergen awareness training for three certified food service sanitation managers. The inspector required valid allergen training for all employees holding City of Chicago food service sanitation certificates.

headline: Summary not posted; no mop hanging system
summary: No previous inspection summary was visible to the public, so a new one was given to post and a citation was issued. Wet mops on the second floor need a hook system for hanging, and shaker containers must be labeled.

headline: Eggs held above safe cold temperature
summary: Eggs in the kitchen cold unit were at 52.9F and 54.9F, above the 41F limit. About 40 eggs were discarded, and a citation was issued. Staff were advised to store fewer eggs and not overfill containers.

headline: Dead mouse and flies found; no thermometers
summary: A dead mouse was on a glue trap outside the seafood walk-in cooler, and five fly ribbons covered with dead flies hung above meat department display coolers. Many cooling units lacked thermometers, and ceiling tiles were water damaged.

headline: Handwashing lapses, missing health policy, screen gap
summary: Failed. No employee health policy was on site, and an employee did not wash hands before gloving and handling food; a citation was issued. The prep hand sink was blocked. A side screen door mesh is missing.

headline: Kitchen vents above cooking equipment need cleaning
summary: The inspector required cleaning the ventilation vents above the kitchen cooking equipment. No other issues were listed in this re-inspection.

headline: Grease and food spills throughout prep area
summary: A cutting board had dark areas. Cooking equipment, reach-in cooler interiors, floors, walls and ceilings had grease, food spills or splatter. Staff were told to detail clean and maintain all areas.

headline: Rear door gap, dirty drains, broken faucet
summary: A 1/4-inch gap under the rear exit door must be sealed to prevent pests. Drains in the rear prep area had heavy buildup, and beverage cooler floor needed cleaning. Toilet room sink faucet was broken and loose.

headline: Moldy ice machine, warm foods, no test kit
summary: Black mold-like substance was on the ice machine walls and shield; ice was destroyed and the machine cleaned. Cold foods were held at 46.6-57.7F; about 20 lbs were discarded. No chlorine test kit was on site.

headline: Rat droppings and overflowing trash found
summary: Failed. Rat droppings were found near an uncovered waste oil container, and a dead rat hung from a cart in the garbage area. Dumpster lids would not close. A citation was issued, and the manager lacked a posted certificate.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food, floor storage, grime
summary: Failed. Bulk containers were unlabeled and food sat on floors in prep, storage, cooler and freezer areas. Food debris and spills on equipment and coolers. Some employees lacked food handler training, and the manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Numerous dead roaches on glueboards
summary: Numerous dead roaches were on glueboards in prep and basement storage. Food was on floors in prep and basement areas and must be raised six inches. Ice machine residue, unlabeled bulk containers, and a damaged cooler gasket were also noted.

headline: Uncovered salsa, grime, and drain debris
summary: Bulk prepared salsa was left uncovered, so the inspector told staff to cover all prepared food. Black grime was found in the salsa cooler, a restroom lacked a covered trash can, and a floor drain had food debris.

headline: Hair restraints, dirty nozzles, leaks, dirty floors
summary: Hair restraints must be worn at all times and long ponytails pinned. Drink nozzles needed buildup removed. A rear three-compartment sink faucet leaked, floor drains needed buildup removed, and floors needed food spills cleaned.

headline: Food on floor, worn sponges, dirty nozzles
summary: Some stock was on the floor in the rear prep area and must be off the floor. Worn sponges at the sink must be changed often. Cutting boards needed cleaning of food spills, and soda nozzles needed buildup removed.

headline: Food held over 24 hours without date
summary: Ready-to-eat foods that must be kept cold were held over 24 hours without a discard date. Staff discarded them immediately, and a citation was issued. Unlabeled food in coolers, poor storage of plates and bowls, and a leaking faucet were noted.

headline: Prep cooler too warm; cold foods discarded
summary: A prep cooler held at 57.2F was tagged and must not be used until repaired and reinspected. Chicken, hamburgers, steak and hot dogs at 54-57F were discarded. Ice machine interior was soiled. Food stored on walk-in freezer floor.

headline: Lettuce too warm; expired food handler certificate
summary: Shredded lettuce was held at 46F, above the 41F limit. The manager discarded 7 pounds valued at $15, and a citation was issued. One food employee had an expired food handler certificate.

headline: Rear door gap, dead insects, greasy floors
summary: Rear door had a 1/2 inch gap at the bottom, which must be sealed and rodent-proofed. Dead insects were found around the hot water heater, and food prep floors had grease and debris, including under the three-compartment sink and fryers.

headline: No certified manager; no soap; dish machine failed
summary: No certified manager was on site while hamburgers were prepared. Bar sink lacked soap; rear sinks lacked paper towels. Dish machine reached 154.8F, below 160F, and was tagged. Cooler held eggs and yogurt at 50-52F; 7 pounds discarded.

headline: Unlabeled bottled juices and smoothies
summary: Bottled juices and smoothies were not labeled properly. The inspector instructed staff to label them as the health code requires.

headline: No person in charge or certified manager present
summary: No person in charge was present, and no certified food manager was on duty while rice and chicken soups were prepared and served; a citation was issued. Food was stored in grocery bags, and to-go containers were used as scoops.

headline: Dirty basement cooler interior; leaking faucet
summary: The interior of the basement two-door cooler must be cleaned and maintained. The three-compartment sink faucet in the basement leaked and must be repaired. Food handlers must follow Illinois Department of Public Health food handler rules.

headline: No allergen training; torn cooler gasket
summary: Failed. No certified food manager had allergen training, and documentation must be provided. A two-door cooler had a torn gasket on its left door, not corrected from the 7/9/25 inspection.

headline: Missing thermometer; unlabeled bulk; leaking drain
summary: Cold holding unit at the prep line had no thermometer, and bulk containers in the rear lacked labels. Front main doors had 1/4-inch gaps at the bottom center. A dishwashing sink drain leaked, and stained cutting boards needed replacement.

headline: Incomplete pest records and no hot water
summary: Failed. Pest control logbook was missing required information, including a service ticket with the pest control license number. No hot water was on site; a toilet room handwashing sink measured 63.4F. Hot running water must be provided at all handwashing sinks.

headline: Entry door gap, unlabeled containers, grime
summary: A gap in the double entry doors must be sealed to keep insects out. Squeeze bottles and other containers need labels. Also needed: a dump-sink splash guard, and cleaning of the hood, filters, floors and soda ice dispenser.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit cleanup supplies
summary: Failed. No person in charge held a valid certificate, and no certified manager was on site while hamburgers were prepared and served. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup supplies or chemical test kit were available. Food was stored on floors.

headline: Damaged cooler strips and dirty trash area
summary: Damaged plastic strips on several reach-in cooler doors must be replaced. The women's restroom had no covered receptacle. Debris surrounded the dumpsters, and sinks, shelves and a walk-in freezer section needed cleaning or ice removal.

headline: No certified manager during food preparation
summary: No person in charge or food employee with City of Chicago certified manager training or certificate was on site while protein, dairy and fried foods were prepared, and a citation was issued. A worker dried utensils with a linen.

headline: Food debris behind fryers and in storage
summary: Rear dry storage closet and pipes behind the deep fryers had food debris buildup. Staff were told to detail clean and maintain them.

headline: Missing signs, dirty ice machine, no allergen training
summary: Handwashing signs and splash guards were missing at kitchen and bar sinks. The ice machine interior had buildup. Food handler training and manager allergen training were missing. Staff toilet lacked a lidded garbage can.

headline: Grocery bags holding food; spills in cooler
summary: Passed. Grocery bags used to store food in the steam table; manager must use proper food storage bags or containers. Food spills and debris inside rear cooler and mixers; dust on display cooler bases.

headline: Torn cooler door gasket
summary: Passed. Torn gasket on the door of the basement walk-in cooler, which mainly stores beer. Manager must repair or replace it.

headline: Ice machine not clean; no training proof
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Top interior of ice machine not clean; must remove ice and clean and sanitize. Hole in rear utility room ceiling must be sealed. Mops stored where they cannot dry, risking pest hiding places. No proof of food handler training.

headline: Wiping cloths on prep table; damaged cutting boards
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths left on prep table top; must be stored in sanitizing solution between uses. Cutting boards at cook line prep coolers have deep stains and cuts; must be resurfaced or replaced.

headline: Broken thermometer; rusty rack in hot dog cooler
summary: Passed. Broken thermometer and rusty rack inside cooler used for hot dogs. Cracked and bowed wood paneling at customer-area front counter; must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Missing health policy and handwashing sign
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy on site; manager must provide a signed policy for each employee. No handwashing sign at front prep sink. Dirt on ceiling light covers. Certified food manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Leaking banquet cooler; loose faucet
summary: Passed. Ice scoop stored in open wire rack touching wall. Plastic lining on exterior of warewashing unit in coffee prep. Leak in 6th-floor banquet walk-in cooler causing standing water. Loose faucet at coffee-prep handwash sink.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; no date marks
summary: Failed; citations issued. No certified food manager on duty while TCS foods (must be kept hot or cold) were prepared and served. Utensils sanitized at 0.0 ppm. Ready-to-eat foods held over 24 hours lacked date marks. No probe thermometer, pest control log, or food handler training.

headline: Failed: overflowing dumpsters; no backflow device
summary: Failed; citation issued. Outside dumpsters overflowing with trash and boxes; lids must be kept tight to prevent pest harborage. Backflow prevention device missing at ice machine. Stained cutting boards in kitchen prep area.

headline: Soap and towels missing; certificates absent
summary: Passed with conditions; citations issued. Soap missing at several handwashing sinks, and a sink was blocked by stored items; soap was refilled and towels provided on site. Prepared TCS foods lacked date labels. No food handler certificate on site. Dirty floors and drains.

headline: Failed: no food thermometer, repeat violations
summary: Failed; citation issued. No metal-stem thermometer to check hot and cold food. Utensil stored in water at 73.7°F. Uncorrected prior violations: food handler without hair restraint, fruit spillage in cooler, employee belongings in food prep area.

headline: Grocery bags used for freezer food storage
summary: Passed. Grocery bags used for food storage in the freezer; instructed to use food-grade bags.

headline: Failed: no current pest control log
summary: Failed; citation issued. No current pest control log on site; the last report was dated 9/24. A licensed pest technician must service the facility before reinspection. Drain buildup under bar three-compartment sink.

headline: No valid certified manager or food handler training
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. No person in charge with a valid city sanitation certificate, and none posted. No valid food handler training for employees. Minor leak at bar handwashing sink drainpipe. Washrooms lack covered receptacles.

headline: Failed: about 25 live flying insects
summary: Failed; citation issued. About 25 live small flying insects under the 3-compartment sink and on equipment in front prep. More pest control service needed. Front hand sink water was off until manager turned it on. Missing soap, paper towels, and food handler certificates.

headline: Failed: no vomit cleanup kit, outdated pest log
summary: Failed. No bodily fluid cleanup kit on site. No up-to-date pest control logbook on site. Leak from a ventilation unit near the rear wall of the liquor storage area; manager must repair it.

headline: Steak held at 58.1°F; no cleanup supplies
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. Twenty pounds of steak held at 58.1°F in rear prep; cold TCS foods must be 41°F or below. Manager discarded about 30 pounds, $300. No adequate vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies. Milk crates used as shelving.

headline: Inadequate hot water; certificate not posted
summary: Passed with conditions; citations issued. Hot water measured 48–68°F at 3-compartment and hand sinks while open to the public; must be at least 100°F for hand sinks and 110°F for 3-compartment sink. No valid certificate posted. Latest inspection summary not visible to public.

headline: Raw meat in cardboard; dishes not drying properly
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Cut raw vegetables stored in plastic grocery bags and raw meat in a cardboard box. No drainboards or drying racks for washed dishes. Sinks, freezers, prep tables, and shelves need cleaning.

headline: Failed: slimy residue dripping into ice
summary: Failed; citation issued. Black slimy substance inside ice maker was dripping into ice used for human consumption. Manager must turn off the machine, remove ice, and clean and sanitize it. Chipped, rusty racks in walk-in cooler; moldy caulking at 3-compartment sink.

headline: No handwashing signs at any sink
summary: Passed on re-inspection. No handwashing signs at any hand sink or in toilet rooms. Manager must provide them.

headline: Manager must obtain allergen training certificate
summary: Passed. The City of Chicago food service manager must obtain the required food allergen training certificate.

headline: No handwashing signs; no food handler certificate
summary: Passed. No handwashing signage at hand sinks throughout. Inadequate partition between hand sink and cutting boards in meat area. No covered receptacle in restroom. A food handler had no certificate on site.

headline: Ice machine buildup; dusty cooler condensers
summary: Passed. Slight buildup inside upper portion of ice machine must be cleaned. Dust on rear of walk-in cooler condensers must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: multiple food temperature violations
summary: Failed; citations issued. Walk-in cooler at 48.2°F and front prep cooler at 62.6°F, both tagged held. Sliced tomato at 51.8–56.1°F and chili at 78.6°F; about 30 pounds discarded. Chicken breast held hot at 113.2–130.3°F. No certified food manager until 3:40 p.m.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving throughout
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Milk crates used as shelving throughout prep and storage areas; must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Cracked light shield in walk-in freezer must be replaced.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings in three areas
summary: Failed; citation issued. About 30 rodent droppings each in a produce storage closet, the prepared foods area, and the bakery prep area. Dock exit doors have a 1/2-inch gap. Uncovered pastries removed on site. Dish machine final rinse gauge not working.

headline: No hair restraint; milk crates as shelving
summary: Passed. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. Milk crates were used as shelving in the rear prep area; manager must provide proper shelving.

headline: Ice scoop stored in ice; broken equipment
summary: Passed. Ice scoop stored inside the ice; must be kept in a clean container or with handle out of the ice. Out-of-order equipment must be repaired or removed to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: No employee health policy found
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy found; it must be provided. No citation issued.

headline: Residue in cold units, hot equipment exteriors
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Residue and debris inside cold-holding units and on exteriors of hot-holding equipment. Person in charge must clean and maintain them.

headline: No health policy; missing ceiling tiles
summary: Passed with conditions; no citation. No employee health policy on premises. Backflow preventer must be installed at rear storage mop sink. Missing ceiling tiles above kitchen refrigeration units. Clutter in rear storage room.

headline: Debris under prep tables and coolers
summary: Passed. Dirt and food debris under front prep tables and cooling units must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings and unsafe hot food
summary: Failed; citations issued. Thirty or more mouse droppings on ledges, floors, shelves, and in a tool closet. Gyros at 81.3°F and taco meat at 131.7°F, below 135°F; about 30 pounds discarded. No certified food manager on duty. Dishes not sanitized.

headline: Hair restraints missing; floors greasy
summary: Passed. Some food handlers lacked proper hair restraints. Minor leak under 3-compartment sink. Floors with food, grease, and dirt under and behind equipment. No Illinois Department of Public Health (IDPH) approval letter for in-house food handler training.

headline: Missing or broken cooler thermometers
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Missing or broken thermometers inside cooling units throughout the facility. Facility must provide and maintain them.

headline: Missing thermometer, labels, backflow device
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Mini refrigerator at coffee line had no thermometer. Bulk items near 3-compartment sink lacked labels. Cookware on drying rack not inverted. No backflow device on coffee station water lines.

headline: Failed: over 20 rat droppings, no hot water
summary: Failed; citations issued. Over 20 rat droppings scattered on basement storage floor; manager told to call an exterminator. No hot water (64.2°F) at handwashing, 3-compartment, and utility sinks. Ready-to-eat foods not date-marked. Half-inch gap at door. Washroom fan not working, repeat violation.

headline: Freezer handle broken; grease trap needs cleaning
summary: Passed. Broken handle on kitchen chest freezer. Top of grease trap under 3-compartment sink needs cleaning. Floors under cooking equipment and along walls need cleaning.

headline: Door gap, standing water, dirty floors
summary: Passed. About 1/4-inch gap at bottom of parking-lot entry door; must be sealed. Dust and standing water under equipment on front counters. Floors in rear storage and front service area need detail cleaning.

headline: No health policy; inspection summary not posted
summary: Passed with conditions; citations issued. No employee health policy on premises. No food handler certificates available. Prior inspection summary was not posted; found in a folder. Grease and dirt around equipment; ice machine interior needs cleaning. No allergen training.

headline: Dead roaches in freezers; food on floor
summary: Passed. Dead roaches found inside a freezer in the main prep area and in a basement freezer gasket. Noodles and food stored on floor. Open food bowls stored in a van in the alley. Openings in walls and floor could harbor pests.

headline: No food handler training proof; labeling issues
summary: Passed on re-inspection. No ambient thermometer in front-line display cooler. Containers lack common-name labels. Scoop bowl used inside bean container in walk-in. Improper wiping cloth storage. No proof of food handler training.

headline: Open personal drinks; no training proof
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Open personal drinks found in retail coolers; must use a separate designated cooler for staff food and drinks. No proof of food handler training on site.

headline: Glove reused after wiping; food discarded
summary: Passed with conditions; citations issued. Food handler did not wash hands, then wiped equipment with a cloth while wearing gloves and handled English muffins with the same gloves; about 2 pounds ($5) discarded. No certified food manager with certificate on site while open until a second manager arrived.

headline: Seafood cooler lacks thermometer; rear door gap
summary: Passed. No operational internal thermometer in seafood display cooler. Half-inch gap and torn stripping at rear delivery door. Stored items not elevated off floors. No proof of state approval for in-house food handler and allergen training.

headline: Blocked hand sink; prep cooler too warm
summary: Passed with conditions; citations issued. Rear hand sink in dish area blocked by metal plates and had no soap. Liquid egg at 50.6°F and Canadian bacon at 48.9°F discarded. Two-drawer prep cooler at 49.1°F, tagged held. Food handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Wooden pallets in walk-in; greasy prep floor
summary: Passed. Wooden pallets used in basement walk-in to hold buckets; must be removed and replaced with proper elevated storage. Grease, dirt, and debris under and behind non-cooking equipment in food prep area; instructed to clean.

headline: Failed: live cockroaches; no hand towels
summary: Failed; citations issued. About 2 live cockroaches crawling on wall by 3-compartment sink. No hand-drying provision at front and rear prep handwashing sinks; manager provided paper towels during inspection.

headline: No health policy; leaks and broken tiles
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. No employee health policy or training on site. Leaking condenser pipe in walk-in cooler; ice on freezer condenser pipes. Grease trap must be sealed; small fluid leak. Broken floor tiles in middle walk-in cooler.

headline: Failed: brisket cooked outdoors in smoker
summary: Failed; citation issued. Brisket was cooked outside in a smoker; no food may be cooked outside without prior approval. Several toilet stalls and the women's restroom lacked covered receptacles. No allergen-trained certified food manager on site.

headline: Milk crates used to elevate stored items
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Milk crates were still used to elevate stored items; they must be removed.

headline: Cracked water inlet cover; greasy fryer
summary: Passed. Cracked door on fresh water inlet must be replaced and inlet covered properly. Food and grease debris inside fryer and between fryer and stove top; instructed to clean.

headline: No food handler training for employees
summary: Passed on re-inspection. No food handler training shown for employees. Facility must provide and maintain it.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, pest logbook missing
summary: Failed. No valid city sanitation manager certificate on site. Dish machine final rinse was 169°F; it must reach 180°F. No pest control logbook or signed service agreement. Missing vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies and procedure, employee health policy, and allergen training.

headline: No handwashing sign; manager without hair restraint
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign at kitchen hand sink. Certified food manager lacked hair restraint. Basement storage refrigerator interior not clean. No backflow prevention device at mop/utility sink faucet. Dirty vents in staff washroom.

headline: Failed: cold food held too warm
summary: Failed; citation issued. Cold TCS foods (must be kept cold) held at 49–63°F. Manager discarded about 1/8 pound chicken, 2 pounds cream cheese spread, and 1 pound tuna, about $40. Black buildup in soda machine ice chute; mineral buildup in dining room ice machine.

headline: Walk-in cooler held chicken too warm
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. Chicken wings in walk-in cold holding unit measured 45.6–47.4°F; cold TCS foods must be 41°F or below. Manager discarded 15 pounds, about $60 of food.

headline: Water on floor behind fryers
summary: Passed. Water on floor under and behind fryers and cooking equipment; floors must be kept clean and dry.

headline: Mold-like substance in bar ice machine
summary: Passed. Small bar ice machine had beige and black mold-like substance on its shield; manager must clean and sanitize it. Second-floor accessible women's washroom lacked a covered sanitary receptacle.

headline: Walk-in cooler at 60°F; tagged held
summary: Passed. Walk-in cooler measured 60°F during inspection, with non-TCS foods inside. Unit tagged and held for inspection; no citation issued. Unused equipment in prep area must be cleaned.

headline: No employee health policy; damaged floors
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. No employee health policy or training on site. Soap and paper towels missing at rear prep sink; staff supplied them during inspection. Heavily damaged floor tiles create a hole in front prep area. Manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Beef thawed improperly; uncovered food
summary: Passed. Frozen beef sat in a sink without running water, which is not an approved thawing method. Food in coolers and freezers left uncovered. Light dirt and grease on outdoor grease container; floors and corners need detail cleaning.

headline: Peeling insulation above food in freezer
summary: Passed. Peeling pipe insulation above stored food in walk-in freezer must be removed or replaced. Splash guard needed at handwash sink. Milk crates used for elevation. Missing floor drain cover; soiled mop heads not stored inverted.

headline: Failed: prep cooler too warm, tagged
summary: Failed; citations issued. Prep cooler held at 59.2°F; it is tagged and must not be used until health department reinspection. Food stored on walk-in cooler and freezer floors. Overflowing outdoor dumpsters. Heavy grease and debris on equipment and walls.

headline: Failed: about 40 flies in prep areas
summary: Failed; citation issued. About 40 large and small flies throughout front and rear prep areas. Person in charge must inform pest control that additional service is needed.

headline: No thermometer in hot-holding unit
summary: Passed. No ambient air thermometer inside rear hot-holding unit where the high-temperature dish machine is stored. Slight food buildup on outside of tilt skillet; must be cleaned.

headline: Dead bugs found; grime and missing signage
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Dead bugs built up on an electrical box by the rear exit. Grime inside cold-holding units and on prep tables. Opening in wall under dishwasher could let pests in. Missing handwashing signs and sink stoppers; no allergen certificate.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; hot cheese without handsink
summary: Failed; citations issued. No certified food manager on site while nacho cheese at 149.3°F was held hot. No hand sink was available there, so the manager stopped nacho sales until moved. No food handler certificates; no vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit.

headline: Failed: no certified manager on site
summary: Failed; citations issued. No certified food manager on site while open. Leak under sushi-prep handwashing sink dripping into a bucket of dirty dishes. Food buckets stored on walk-in floor. Prior violations uncorrected, including pinkish residue in ice machine.

headline: Unlabeled sanitizer bottles; missing grout
summary: Passed. Spray sanitizer bottles not labeled; must be labeled and maintained. Missing grout on kitchen and dish area floor tiles; must be grouted.

headline: Failed: raw food above ready-to-eat; sink problems
summary: Failed; citations issued. Raw steak and raw eggs stored above ready-to-eat salsa, tomatoes, lettuce, and onions. Two handwashing sinks inaccessible or missing pipes; one had no soap. Menu lacks consumer advisory for undercooked food.

headline: Damaged cooler gaskets; no walk-in light
summary: Passed. Damaged door gaskets on two-door reach-in cooler in front prep area. No light inside walk-in cooler; manager must add adequate lighting.

headline: Pizza cooler too warm; food discarded
summary: Passed with conditions; citations issued. Pizza prep cooler held sausage at 44.4°F, pepperoni at 51.9°F, and mozzarella at 47.3°F; foods discarded. Cooler tagged and must not be used until repaired and reinspected. No proof of food handler training.

headline: Damaged cutting boards, milk crates, cracked tiles
summary: Passed. Cutting boards in rear prep have open seams and dark stains. Milk crates used as shelving; must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Missing and damaged floor tiles; grout needed in dish and prep areas.

headline: Ice machine interior needed cleaning
summary: Passed. Top interior of the ice machine needed cleaning. Staff must remove ice, clean and sanitize, and maintain it.

headline: Produce on floor; no food handler training
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Produce boxes stored on floor in rear prep. Employee without hair restraint. Wiping cloths left on prep tables. No food handler training certificates for employees. Also leaky faucet, cracked floor tiles, and greasy hood vents.

headline: Grease buildup under cooking equipment
summary: Passed. Grease buildup under cooking equipment. Manager must clean floors under all equipment.

headline: Clutter in storage; items on floor
summary: Passed. Clutter in rear storage area and office. Manager must remove or organize it and keep items at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Hair restraints missing; ice scoop misplaced
summary: Passed. Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints. Ice scoop stored directly on top of ice in freezer. Mop stored in a way that does not dry properly and can attract pests.

headline: No food handler training; leaking handsink
summary: Passed. No food handler training for employees. Leak under front handwashing sink. Multi-use pans stored under paper towel dispenser near hand sink. Food debris on prep tables; debris in floor drains and under equipment.

headline: Latest inspection summary not posted
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. Rusted shelving racks in walk-in cooler must be repainted or replaced. Most recent inspection summary was not posted; manager posted an older one, then switched to the current report during inspection.

headline: Failed: slimy residue in ice maker
summary: Failed; citation issued. Black slimy substance inside ice maker was dripping into ice used for human consumption. Manager told to turn off the machine, remove ice, and clean and sanitize it. Gap at bottom of front door. Repeat: no allergen-trained certified food manager.

headline: Dusty light shields; dirty kitchen floors
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Dust on some kitchen light shields needs cleaning. Floors in corners and under and behind equipment need cleaning.

headline: Debris and grease; hole behind cooler
summary: Passed. Food debris inside a reach-in cooler and its tracks; grease and food debris on cooking equipment sides. Hole in piping wall behind cooler could allow pests in. Buildup of materials, greasy floors, and dusty vents also noted.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; greasy equipment
summary: Passed. Some food handlers had expired food handler training certificates. Grease and dust on cooking equipment, walls, and hood vents. Holes in basement concrete floor around sewer drain. Worn cooler door gaskets.

headline: Grease and debris on front prep floors
summary: Passed. Grease and food debris on floors and in corners throughout front prep area; manager must clean and maintain.

headline: Failed: spoiled milk; cooler at 50°F
summary: Failed; citations issued. Employee touched ready-to-eat pita bread with bare hands; gloves required. Milk was curdling and was discarded. Ricotta at 44°F discarded; server cooler at 50°F. Three-compartment sink floods when drained; rusted racks; cracked ceiling tiles.

headline: Clean biscuit cooler and convection ovens
summary: Passed. Inspector required cleaning of the interior of the 3-door biscuit prep cooler and the convection ovens beside it.

headline: Wet mops must hang to dry
summary: Passed. Wet mops must be hung to dry when not in use in the utility area.

headline: Grease dripping from hood vent
summary: Passed. Cardboard on shelves must be removed. Sides of cooking equipment greasy; rear floors have food spills and buildup; hood vent has grease dripping. Staff instructed to clean.

headline: Packaged foods missing labels; debris under dish machine
summary: Passed. Prepackaged TCS foods and desserts for sale at front lacked required labels, such as business address and ingredients. Debris inside fryers and under the high-temperature dish machine; manager told to clean.

headline: Loose cabinet door on slush machine
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Left side cabinet door on Slurpee machine is loose; must be reattached and maintained.

headline: Splash guard missing; certificates not verified
summary: Passed. Small amount of pink residue inside first-floor kitchen ice machine. Hand sink lacks a splash guard, and food is prepped right next to it. Food handler certificates could not be verified; no allergen training proof for managers.

headline: Beef thawed in standing water; floor storage
summary: Passed. Ground beef was thawing in standing water in a sink; manager told to thaw under running water, refrigeration, or as part of cooking. Food stored on floor, open drink cups on prep table, food spills and grease buildup.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; chicken at 112–120°F
summary: Failed; citations issued. No certified food manager on site while chicken was prepared and served. Chicken in a hot-holding unit that was off measured 112–120°F; 10–15 pounds discarded. Chicken cooked on outdoor grill. Food prep sinks had no hot water.

headline: No certified manager on site during food prep
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. No certified food manager on site while TCS foods were prepared and served. Food handler without hair restraint. Fork handle lying on salsa in prep cooler. Missing handwashing sign, leaking utility sink faucet, and mop head stored on floor.

headline: No food handler training proof; damaged gaskets
summary: Passed on re-inspection. No proof of food handler training for any food handler on site. One employee with a city sanitation certificate lacked allergen training proof. Damaged gaskets on both doors of rear two-door freezer.

headline: Beards uncovered; ice scoops stored in ice
summary: Passed. Cooks had beards without beard restraints. Wiping cloths stored on prep tables. Ice scoops stored inside ice bin. Boxed single-service items on basement floor; manager must elevate them 6 inches.

headline: Floor debris and damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. Floors behind deep freezers and along wall bases in rear and side prep area need debris removed. A few damaged ceiling tiles in the rear must be replaced.

headline: Rusted shelves, dirty ice bin, leaks, broken floor
summary: Basement ice bin needs cleaning. Rusted prep table shelves were ordered replaced by the person in charge during inspection. Stained, deeply cut cutting boards. Sink stopper doesn't hold water; leak at three-compartment sink; broken bar floor.

headline: Rear doors not rodent-proofed; no food handler training
summary: Rear exit doors were wide open without screens and not rodent-proofed; instructed to correct. Grocery bags used for food storage in coolers and freezers. Basement water valve leaks under dish machine. Some employees lack food handler training.

headline: Over 30 rat droppings in basement; citation issued
summary: Over 30 rat droppings on basement floor by hot water tank; instructed to remove them, clean and sanitize the area, and contact pest control; citation issued. Rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom. Rust on prep table.

headline: Minor sink leak; missing food handler certificates
summary: Minor leak at three-compartment sink. No covered bin in unisex washroom. Soiled mop heads not hung to dry. No food handler certificates on site; manager told to meet IDPH requirement. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Dry storage floor debris; hole in wall
summary: Clean mixing bowls must be stored inverted. Dry food storage closet floor has debris; all items must be elevated. Hole in wall under kitchen hand sink, stuffed with paper, must be properly sealed.

headline: Two live roaches found; cold foods too warm
summary: Two live roaches found at rear near hand sink; citation issued; treatment by pest control required. Eggs at 49.4F, turkey at 45.6F and avocado spread at 47.5F in service coolers; 29 lbs discarded. Prep cooler at 58.3F; citation issued.

headline: Items stored on floor in front counter area
summary: Items were stored on the floor in the front counter area. Person in charge instructed to organize and keep all items at least six inches off the floor.

headline: No consumer advisory; sanitizer strips mismatched
summary: No consumer advisory for raw or undercooked food on the menu. No license number on both sides of truck. About 2-inch gap at bottom of rear exit door. Sanitizer and test strips don't match. Leak from gray water tank.

headline: No hand soap or paper towels at bar sink
summary: No hand soap and no paper towels at bar hand sink; citation issued. Prep area hand sink leaked and was inaccessible; citation issued. Food stored on prep area floor; milk crates used for elevation; debris around dumpster and on utility floors.

headline: Dish machine lacked sanitizer; raw food advisory missing
summary: Low-temperature dish machine final rinse had 0 ppm chlorine; machine tagged held for inspection and must not be used until repaired; citation issued. Menus lacked the consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods. Expired food handler and allergen certificates.

headline: Faucet leaks; washroom missing cover and self-closer
summary: Leaks at faucets of exposed hand sink and three-compartment sink; instructed to repair. Toilet bowl cover missing in employee washroom. Washroom door lacks self-closing device. Fan, floors under shelves, walk-in cooler and drain need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep
summary: Food handlers prepared TCS foods without the original City certificate and certified manager on site; citation issued. Food handlers lacked hair restraints; one wore a dangling bracelet. Basement storage room cluttered with items on floor.

headline: Washroom trash cans lack lids
summary: Washrooms had garbage receptacles without lids. Operator instructed to provide trash cans with lids at all women's and unisex washrooms.

headline: Debris inside ice machine; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: Slight debris encrusted inside ice machine; must be removed and the machine detail cleaned. Bulk containers in rear storage rack lack labels. Burnt-out light bulb at kitchen exhaust hood must be replaced.

headline: Rusty shelving; broken gasket; leaking faucet
summary: Rusty, dirty shelving in walk-in coolers and basement must be cleaned, repainted or replaced. Broken gasket in cake refrigerator. Milk crates must not be used to elevate items. Leaking faucet base at three-compartment sink. Dust on vents; dirt under cooking equipment.

headline: Leak below three-compartment sink; incomplete allergen certificates
summary: Leak at bottom of pipe below three-compartment sink in dish area must be repaired. Allergen training certificates are incomplete; must be provided for all certified food managers.

headline: No certified manager during milkshake and ice cream prep
summary: No City certified food manager on site while milkshakes, smoothies and ice cream were prepared and served; citation issued. Rear hand sink lacked soap and paper towels, supplied during inspection. Excess ice in chest freezers; clutter and items on floors.

headline: Water-damaged ceiling tiles in dining room
summary: Some water-damaged ceiling tiles were noted in the dining room. Instructed to replace them.

headline: Worn cutting boards; food debris; burnt-out light
summary: Worn and pitted cutting boards must be repaired or replaced. Rust on grease trap at three-compartment sink; crates in walk-in cooler must be removed. Excess food debris on cooking equipment, coolers and dish racks. Cardboard on floors; holes in wall; burnt-out dish area light.

headline: Dish machine sanitizer at 0 ppm; onions held warm
summary: Low-temperature dish machine at main kitchen not sanitizing; 0 ppm chlorine at final rinse; machine was running on empty sanitizer container. 2 lbs of cooked sliced onions at 62.2F discarded, valued at $5. Knife wedged between coolers.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies; shrimp held too warm
summary: No supplies to clean up vomit or diarrhea; citation issued. Ice machine interior had black and pink mold-like substance dripping onto ice; citation issued. Dish machine sanitizer at 0 ppm, corrected on site. About 2 lbs of shrimp at 50F discarded.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure
summary: No vomit and diarrhea spill kit or written response procedure found. Also: no air thermometers in reach-in coolers, water cases stored on floor, uncovered washroom trash can, improperly stored mop.

headline: Debris under shelving and in corners
summary: Debris buildup underneath shelving and in corners throughout the area. Manager instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Foil liners used on prep surfaces; no backflow device
summary: Aluminum foil used as liner on food prep equipment and tables; instructed to remove it. No backflow device at utility sink; manager instructed to provide and maintain one.

headline: Gap under dining room exterior door
summary: A gap at the bottom of the exterior door off the dining room area was noted. Person in charge instructed to repair and maintain it to prevent pest entry.

headline: Eight live roaches and over 15 flies found
summary: More than 15 small flies and 8 live roaches found throughout facility, including under the three-compartment sink and behind refrigeration; citation issued. Previous pest violation not corrected. Grease and soil build-up on equipment, walls and floors.

headline: Sticky floors and spillage; corrected on site
summary: Spillage at bottom of refrigeration unit near manager's desk in dishwashing area; instructed to clean. Sticky floors in prep and dishwashing areas were cleaned during the inspection and corrected on site.

headline: Bare-hand contact with bread; food held at unsafe temperatures
summary: Employees touched ready-to-eat bread with bare hands at wait station; manager must use tongs, tissue or gloves; citation issued. Sausage at 104.1F in hot holding unit and cooked potatoes at 52.3F; both to be discarded. Food on floors in coolers and freezers.

headline: No pest log; no cooler thermometers; hood broken
summary: No current pest control log book on premises; licensed pest company must provide at least two inspections yearly. No air thermometers in reach-in or display coolers. Torn prep cooler gasket; kitchen prep ventilation hood inoperable; no sanitizer test kit.

headline: Unnecessary wooden stand in dining room
summary: A large wooden stand was noted in the dining room. The inspector instructed its removal because it is unrelated to the premises and unnecessary.

headline: Food handler without hair restraint; no training
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint; all food handlers must wear effective restraints. One employee had no food handler training; all employees must provide it.

headline: No certified manager while preparing TCS foods
summary: Person in charge lacked Chicago food service certificate; no certified manager on site while potatoes and shrimp were prepared. Food handler certificate expired. Prior violations uncorrected, including unlabeled bulk containers and dirty fryers. Citation issued.

headline: No sanitation certificate while handling TCS foods
summary: Person in charge lacked a City sanitation manager certificate, and none was on premises while staff handled chicken and deli meat. Citation issued. Basement storage floors not clean. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: 100 lbs of empanadas discarded for low temperature
summary: Time-as-control records were inadequate. About 100 lbs of empanadas held at 64-73F were discarded, valued at $350; citation issued. Manager lacked hair restraint; cold water knob at hand sink won't turn on properly; basement clutter.

headline: No health policy; no allergen training; food on floor
