summary: No verifiable employee health policy on site; template left and citation issued. Sugar kept outside its original container without a product name label. Food stored on basement floor. Soiled mop heads not hung. Certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Worn glue boards; utensils and single-serve items need care
summary: Glue boards are worn and dusty and need replacing. Utensils must be inverted to prevent contamination from dust. Single-serve articles need wrapping or individual dispensing. No pests were noted.

headline: No food handler certificates on site
summary: Inspector saw no food handler certificates on site. Manager instructed that all food employees complete food handler training and keep records on site at all times.

headline: No health policy; no customer barrier; poor hot water
summary: No written employee health policy on premises. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies. Food and equipment in hallway used by customers lack a protective barrier. Inadequate hot water throughout; hand sinks must reach 100F and three-compartment sink 110F.

headline: Deli cups used as scoops; sink stoppers missing
summary: Deli cups used as scoops for bulk food containers; instructed to use proper scoops. Three-compartment sink stoppers don't hold water. No food handler certificates on site; instructed to obtain them.

headline: No valid certified manager; no prep hand sink
summary: No valid City certified manager or sanitation certificate posted; citation issued. No hand sink in prep and dish area. No vomit and diarrhea procedure or supplies. Rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap. Washroom door not self-closing. No dumpster service or proof.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; gap under entrance door
summary: Bulk containers in rear kitchen prep areas lack labels; common names must be provided. Quarter-inch gap at bottom of front south entrance door; must be made tight-fitting to prevent pest entry. Stained cutting boards and dusty fan covers.

headline: Chicken prep cooler and wet mops need attention
summary: Inside of the chicken prep cooler in the front prep area must be detail cleaned. Wet mops must be hung to dry when not in use.

headline: Low hot water pressure; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: Bulk flour, cornmeal and similar containers need labels with product names. Low hot water pressure at prep, toilet room and utility sinks. No self-closing device on toilet room door. Floor under sinks and by hot water tank cleaned on site.

headline: Tongs hung on display case; dirty floors and walls
summary: Tongs hung on display case handle; must be stored in a clean container. Stains and dust in basement and first-floor corners; walls by meat-prep hand sink dirty. Water-stained ceiling tiles and blown walk-in cooler bulb need replacing.

headline: Ready-to-eat foods held over 24 hours without date
summary: Cooked macaroni, shrimp gravy, boiled eggs and dressing held over 24 hours without a discard date; citation issued. Icing, cake mix and fruit fillings stored on floor. Food debris in coolers and grease in hood filters. Manager lacked allergen proof.

headline: No hot water in restrooms; over 20 flies found
summary: No hot water in men's toilet rooms; maximum 72F; citation issued. Dish machine final rinse 138F instead of 160F; citation issued. Several cold foods at 44-48F discarded. More than 20 small flies in kitchen, dining room and bar. No pest control logbook. Butane fuel stored in cooler.

headline: Overgrown shrubs and clutter in rear yard
summary: Overgrown shrubs and clutter around the fence in the rear yard were noted. Must cut back and maintain the area.

headline: Items on floor near walk-in freezer; damaged floors
summary: Buckets and boxes stored on floor near walk-in freezer; must be kept six inches off the floor. Damaged grout and missing tile near walk-in coolers and mop sink. Certified manager lacked allergen certificate on site.

headline: Ice machine debris; rusty racks; ventilation not working
summary: Debris encrusted inside ice machine must be removed and the machine detail cleaned. Chipped paint and rust on walk-in cooler wire racks. Washroom ventilation not working; burnt-out walk-in cooler light; broken unused ice machine must be repaired or removed.

headline: Loose faucet; no covered garbage receptacle
summary: Loose faucet on front prep hand sink must be repaired. Previous core violation not corrected: unisex toilet rooms lacked a covered garbage receptacle; citation issued.

headline: No chlorine test kit; outdoor clutter
summary: No test kit matching the chlorine sanitizer at the three-compartment sink; QAC strips presented did not match; citation issued. Unused equipment and clutter in rear outdoor area and storage room; instructed to remove to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Unlabeled packaged cookies and bulk containers
summary: Packaged cookies on front counter were not properly labeled; bulk containers in rear storage unlabeled. No splash guards at front hand sinks. Damaged cooler gaskets and baseboards. No food handler training or certified manager allergen training.

headline: Missing hand sign; damaged cooler handles; no food handler certificates
summary: Missing handwashing signage in women's toilet room. Two hand sinks need splash guards. Broken cooler handles with sharp edges. Dust on walk-in cooler vents; grease on hood edges; two hood lights missing. Food workers lacked handler certificates; manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: Plastic bags for frozen meat; rust; no food handler certificates
summary: Plastic grocery bags used to store frozen meats; must use food-grade storage. Heavy rust on walk-in cooler racks. Deep fryer, prep tables, ovens and hot holding units need cleaning. No valid food handler certificates; certified manager lacks allergen certificate. Prior violations uncorrected.

headline: Hand sink leak corrected; dusty fan covers
summary: Leak at bottom of exposed front prep hand sink; repair instructed and corrected on site. Dust on walk-in cooler fan covers in the rear of pizza prep area; instructed to clean.

headline: Damaged wall behind mop sink; expired allergen certificates
summary: Wall behind mop sink in closet has damage and holes; must be repaired and kept smooth and cleanable. Allergen certificates on site are expired; must be renewed and kept on site.

headline: Single-use cup used as scoop; no drain stoppers
summary: Plastic single-use cup used as scoop in dry storage; instructed to replace with a multi-use utensil. Stainless cabinet interior in front prep soiled with rust. No drain stoppers on site for the three-compartment sink; instructed to provide them.

headline: No employee health policy; no thermometer; ice machine slime
summary: No employee health policy on site. Basement dish hand sink water measured 128.2F; must be kept at 100-120F. No food temperature measuring device; citation issued. Pink slime inside ice machine dripping onto ice; must be cleaned and sanitized.

headline: Open gaps in basement walls and ceiling
summary: Multiple wide-open gaps in basement walls and ceilings; instructed to seal them to prevent possible pest activity. Clean utensils stored between wall and dishwasher edge. Leaking kitchen hand sink faucet; no covered trash in basement employee toilet room.

headline: Items stored on basement floor
summary: Items were stored on the floor in the basement storage area. Person in charge instructed to keep all items at least six inches off the floor.

headline: Missing thermometer; food handler without hair restraint
summary: Thermometer inside a refrigeration unit could not be located; instructed to provide one. A food handler lacked an effective hair restraint. Slicing and meat processing equipment had dried food debris on exterior surfaces; instructed to clean.

headline: Bulk food unlabeled; cracked cooking line floor tiles
summary: Bulk flour, sugar and other food were not labeled; labels must be provided. Cracked and broken floor tiles on cooking line and in front of dish machine must be restored to a smooth, cleanable condition.

headline: Food handlers without hair restraints; milk crates used
summary: Food handlers prepping food without hair restraints; instructed that all must wear one. Milk crates used as storage containers at front bar; instructed to remove them and use proper containers.

headline: Dirty cooking equipment and dish area floors
summary: Cooking equipment needs cleaning to remove food spills. Floors throughout the dish area need cleaning to remove standing water and food spills.

headline: Cold foods held at 45-49F; cooler at 54F
summary: Cold TCS foods held at 45.1-48.7F; about 20 lbs discarded, valued at $100; citation issued. Three-door cold holding unit at 54.1F tagged held for inspection. Cases of water and bleach stored on floor; sanitation manager lacks allergen proof.

headline: Cold foods above 41F; service cooler at 67F
summary: Mozzarella at 52F, sliced tomatoes at 64F and lettuce at 63F held improperly in service coolers; 10 lbs disposed, valued at $75. Kitchen prep service cooler measured 67F; manager called for maintenance. Leaking faucet; employee with long beard lacked beard guard.

headline: No certified manager; no hot water at sinks
summary: No City of Chicago certified manager certificate on site. No handwashing sink in warewashing area. Toilet room sink water measured 76.5F, below required hot water. Exposed water and sewer lines above prep area; raw wood storage shelves.

headline: No certified manager; no soap; sink wastewater backs up
summary: No City certified food manager on site; citation issued. Two of three hand sinks had no soap; manager bought soap. All three hand sinks lacked paper towels; manager supplied them. Three-compartment sink wastewater backs up and floods; must be serviced.

headline: No backflow device at utility sink; wall openings
summary: No backflow device at the furnace-area utility sink; must be installed. Openings between wall and floor near kitchen storage shelf and utility closet must be sealed. Food handlers must obtain required food handler training.

headline: Dirty fryer interiors; damaged floors; uncertified handler
summary: Deep fryer interiors need cleaning. Several floor spots in rear storage not smooth or easily cleanable; management instructed to repair. A food handler lacked a valid food handler certificate; management instructed to show proof.

headline: Ice scoops stored in stagnant water; torn gasket
summary: Ice cream scoops were stored in stagnant water; must be kept in potable flowing water. Torn gasket on sliding door cooler. Large cracks in dining area tile must be repaired.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; no backflow devices
summary: No handwashing signage at the dishwashing area hand sink; must be provided. No backflow prevention devices at coffee and water machines; must be provided where they can be located and serviced.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training; no public summary posted
summary: Certified manager on duty lacked allergen training; all such managers must complete it and keep records on site. Previous inspection summary was not posted for public view; new summary left and citation issued.

headline: Mussels lacked tags; unapproved vacuum packing
summary: Mussels in basement walk-in cooler had no identification tags; manager discarded 10 lbs, valued at $30. Vacuum packaging without a variance or HACCP plan was discontinued; about 10 lbs of chicken wings held for inspection; citation issued. Stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Sushi station items left unsafely; dish machine lacked thermometer
summary: Staff drink, wiping cloth and knives left on prep surfaces; ice scoop on dusty ice maker. Dish machine had no temperature device; manager obtained heat strips during inspection. Dusty vent and dim walk-in cooler lighting noted.

headline: Hair restraints missing; no food handler training
summary: Food handlers did not wear effective hair restraints, including beard restraints. No proof of food handler training or certificates on site for all required employees.

headline: Missing sink stoppers and mop hangers
summary: Missing sink stoppers for the three-compartment sink; instructed to obtain them. No mop hangers; instructed to install them.

headline: Thick grease under grill; lights out at prep line
summary: Thick grease build-up under cooking grill must be cleaned. Two lights out and one flickering at meat and deli prep line. No allergen training on site; certified food manager instructed to obtain it.

headline: Gap under rear door; cleaning needed in prep areas
summary: Rear exit door has a gap at the bottom and must be repaired to prevent pest entry. Cutting board behind deli counter and band saw inside cooler need cleaning. Floors, walls and walk-in cooler fans and shelves need cleaning.

headline: Cutting boards damaged; milk crates in use
summary: Two cutting boards have open seams and dark stains; must be replaced or refinished. Milk crates used for bread storage and elevation; appropriate storage required. Floors dirty near dish area, ice machine and walk-in cooler. Poor lighting in coffee prep area.

headline: Over 10 flies found; sanitizer at 0 ppm; sink backs up
summary: No manager with original City certificate on site; citation issued. More than 10 small flies in dish, office, service and dining areas; citation issued. Dish machine final sanitizer at 0 ppm; technician called. Three-compartment sink backs up; plumber called. One-compartment sink leaking from bottom pipes.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; dirty cooking hood
summary: Bulk storage containers were not labeled; manager told to label each with its product name. Hood above cooking equipment was dirty and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Fish thawed in packaging; rodent devices need replacing
summary: Prepackaged fish was thawing in its original packaging; manager told to thaw properly. Spices in open cloth bags need sealable labeled containers. Worn glue boards and rodent boxes need replacing; front door not rodent-proof. Leak at hand sink.

headline: Aprons stored with clean pizza pans; allergen certificate missing
summary: Aprons hung on shelves where clean pizza pans were stored; must be kept in a designated area. Previous core violation not corrected: certified food service manager lacked an allergen training certificate; citation issued.

headline: Restroom hot water below required 100F
summary: Staff toilet room hot water measured 68.9F; hand sinks must reach at least 100F. Espresso machine drain line empties into a hand sink in Starbucks prep area; must be rerouted. Citation issued; violations combined.

headline: Peeling paint behind dish machine; dim cooler
summary: Peeling paint on wall behind dish machine must be removed and maintained. Inadequate lighting in walk-in cooler; instructed to add lights.

headline: Prep sink lacked towels; rice held over 24 hours
summary: Prep area hand sink had no hand drying supplies; person in charge provided paper towels; citation issued. About 10 lbs cooked mango sticky rice and 4 lbs cooked rice held without discard labels; discarded; citation issued. Uncovered preset silverware.

headline: Prep sink used for soap and towels; missing signs
summary: Prep sink had hand soap and paper towels; these must be removed and the sink used only for food preparation. Missing handwashing signs in washrooms. Missing sink stoppers at front bar sink; rusted prep table bottom; grease and debris inside cooking equipment.

headline: No handwashing signs; low water pressure at sinks
summary: No handwashing signs at washroom sinks. Low water pressure at second and third sinks in women's washroom, and one sink not operable. Missing and damaged baseboards in dry storage. Certified managers must provide valid allergen training.

headline: No certified manager at initial inspection; food discarded
summary: No certified manager on site at initial inspection; manager arrived 30 minutes later. Men's washroom hot water reached only 82.9F; citation issued. About 15 lbs of unlabeled TCS foods discarded. Prior violations uncorrected, including missing food handler certificates.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink faucet
summary: A faucet at the three-compartment sink in the dishwashing area is leaking. Instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: Frozen meat thawing in prep; coolers have debris
summary: Frozen meat was thawing in the food prep area; manager told to thaw under cold running water, in a refrigerator, or in a microwave as part of continuous cooking. Food debris on coolers and freezers. Debris on floors and corners; no handwashing signage.

headline: No health policy; missing hand sink and cleanup supplies
summary: No employee health policy available. No handwashing sink in rear dish area. No handwashing sign at prep sink. No vomit and diarrhea procedures or supplies. No metal stem thermometer, no backflow device, and no covered washroom receptacle. Trash and debris around dumpster.

headline: Raw sausage held at 48.6F; beard restraints needed
summary: Raw pork sausage patties held at 48.6F in prep cold unit; manager discarded 5 lbs, valued at $40; citation issued. Food handlers not wearing beard restraints. Reach-in cooler interiors need detail cleaning.

headline: No sanitizer test strips; dirty meat slicer
summary: No sanitizer test strips on site for the three-compartment sink solution; manager instructed to obtain them. Meat slicer not clean behind the blade and had food debris; instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Kitchen corner floors cleaned on site
summary: Floors in kitchen corner areas needed cleaning. The issue was corrected on site.

headline: No paper towels or soap at hand sinks; ice machine slime
summary: No paper towels or hand soap at food prep hand sinks; citations issued. Ice machine in prep area had black slime dripping onto ice used for consumption; citation issued. Broken outdoor dumpster lids, trash on ground, and grease trap not located.

headline: Pink residue in ice machine; dusty ice scoop
summary: Small amount of pink residue in ice machine corner panel; manager told to schedule cleaning. Ice scoop stored on dusty top of ice machine; must be kept in a clean spot or inside the machine with handle out of the ice.

headline: Basement deep freezers need defrosting
summary: Basement deep freezers must be defrosted and cleaned to remove ice build-up and debris.

headline: Prepackaged desserts and salads not labeled
summary: Prepackaged desserts and salads in the display cooler were not properly labeled. Manager instructed to label all foods with ingredients, net contents, and manufacturer name and address.

headline: No certified manager while ready-to-eat food served
summary: The person on site lacked a City food service manager certification while pico de gallo and other ready-to-eat items were served; citation issued. Cutting boards need replacing, and cooler floors, freezer handles, and floors under equipment need detail cleaning.

headline: Eight live cockroaches; no certified manager
summary: Eight live cockroaches were in a rear freezer door gasket; pest control was recommended. No certified manager was on site. Raw beef, chicken, and pork held at 49–51°F were discarded; a display cooler at 49.6°F was tagged.

headline: Hair restraint lapse; damaged wall panels
summary: A food handler in the main prep kitchen was not wearing a hair restraint and was instructed to wear one. Wall covering panels in the dish area are in poor repair and must be fixed, with easy-to-clean flooring provided.

headline: Live roaches and mouse droppings found
summary: Two live roaches were on the hot plating line, and 80 or more mouse droppings were on floors. Pest control is needed before reinspection. A cooler at 53°F was emptied and must not be used until repaired.

headline: Light fryer grease and dusty vents
summary: A light amount of grease at the bottom of the fryers must be cleaned. Dust was on ceiling vents in the front serving area. Staff were instructed to clean floors under and behind kitchen equipment where needed.

headline: No certified manager; no food handler certificates
summary: No certified manager was on site while eggs and milk were handled, and the person in charge lacked a certificate; citations issued. Also missing: employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea supplies, a metal-stem thermometer, and food handler certificates.

headline: Leaking drainpipe, cracked tiles, littered refuse area
summary: A drainpipe leaks under the 3-compartment sink and must be repaired. The refuse area was littered with unnecessary items. Damaged, stained, and cracked floor and ceiling tiles were found, plus dirty rear prep corners and missing light shields.

headline: Door not rodent-proof; missing handwash signage
summary: The front entrance door and order window barriers are not rodent-proof at the bottom and must be sealed. Handwashing signage is missing at the dishwashing sink. Also a non-self-closing door, a missing splash guard, and food debris behind a cooler.

headline: Restroom doors, wall hole, and counter repairs needed
summary: Both restroom doors were not self-closing; a self-closing device must be installed and maintained. A hole in the wall behind the 3-compartment sink must be sealed. Exposed wood at the front counter needs panel covering.

headline: Missing backflow devices; previous violation uncorrected
summary: The ice machine, syrup dispenser, and two hot water machines lacked backflow prevention devices, a previous uncorrected violation; citation issued. Also a dirty crate, slow-draining handwash sink, and syrup spills under units.

headline: Stained ceiling tiles and cluttered storage
summary: Water-stained ceiling tiles in the front and rear need replacing. Rear storage is cluttered and disorganized. Dirt and debris under heavy equipment and in corners of front and rear areas need cleaning.

headline: Milk crates still used; greasy floors; missing tiles
summary: Milk crates must not be used for elevating stored items. Floors behind the deep fryer and near the two-door cooler have blackened grease along the baseboard. The walk-in cooler has missing floor tiles. No allergen training proof for certified managers.

headline: Rat droppings and live flies found on premises
summary: About 5 rat droppings under the 3-compartment sink and 15 or more live flies were found; pest control service recommended. Also no hair restraints, soiled aprons, and a previous pest-entry opening not corrected.

headline: Some items corrected; missing ceilings and training
summary: One surface item was marked corrected. Still needed: a covered restroom trash receptacle, repair of missing rear ceilings, hanging of soiled mop heads, and allergen training for certified managers.

headline: Live roaches, ants, and flies; no certified manager
summary: About 5 live roaches, 40 live ants, and 25 small flies were found. No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods (foods that must be kept hot or cold), such as chicken and milk, were prepared. Also missing handwashing signs and labels on bulk food.

headline: Wall holes, raw wood, and exposed ceiling noted
summary: Raw wood surfaces near and behind the front counter need sealing or painting. Holes in front and rear prep walls must be sealed, and the exposed ceiling above the prep area needs covering so it is smooth and cleanable.

headline: Rear door gap and missing beard guard
summary: The rear exit door has a 1/2 inch gap at the bottom and must be made tight-fitting and rodent-proof. A food handler with a beard lacked a beard guard. Minor debris near the rear water heater was to be cleaned.

headline: Greasy ventilation hood and filters
summary: Food and grease buildup was found on the ventilation hood and filters. The manager was instructed to clean them.

headline: Floor buildup and taped-over floor drains
summary: Debris and black buildup under equipment and along wall bases in the front prep area must be cleaned. Tape covered floor drains in the hostess station and behind the sushi station; smooth, cleanable covers are required.

headline: No food handler training; no hair restraint
summary: No food handler training was provided for employees, and a handler was without a hair restraint. Food debris and spills coated cooking equipment and coolers, and the ice machine had residue. Managers also lacked allergen training.

headline: Raw meat labels missing; torn walk-in gasket
summary: Raw packaged meats in the display cooler must be labeled with safe handling instructions. Raw wood basement shelves need sealing, a walk-in cooler door gasket is torn, a mop sink lacks a backflow device location, and floors under grocery shelves need cleaning.

headline: Missing thermometer, splash guard, and shelving
summary: A thermometer is needed for the hot holding unit, and a splash guard is needed beside the 3-compartment sink. Roasted coffee beans must be removed from a hallway, crates must be replaced with shelving, and debris must be cleaned.

headline: No hot water at basement handwash sinks
summary: Basement employee handwashing sinks had no hot water, measuring 64.9°F; they must reach at least 100°F. The establishment was placed on a 2-day workaround by the Chicago Department of Public Health. Also a 1/4-inch door gap and littered restroom floors.

headline: Beef held too warm; 9 lbs discarded
summary: 15 lbs of beef held at 47–56°F in the front prep cooler; 9 lbs discarded. Soiled wiping cloths, milk crates used for shelving, a cutting board with deep grooves, and grease buildup were also found. The food service sanitation manager lacks an allergen certificate.

headline: No dishmachine test strips; leaking hand sink
summary: No high-temperature test strips or dishwasher thermometer were on site. Bulk containers were unlabeled. A front prep hand sink's cold handle was stripped, a grill hand sink drain leaked, and the certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Unapproved sanitizer used in 3-compartment sink
summary: A non-food-contact sanitizer (256 Century Q) was connected to the 3-compartment sink, and it is not compatible with test strips on site. The operator was instructed to use an approved sanitizer; citation issued. Also a leaking water heater and missing ceiling tiles.

headline: Missing health policies; door gaps and labels
summary: No signed employee health policies were on site. Food storage containers need common-name labels. Gaps along the center double front doors and north exit door must be sealed. A basement staff restroom garbage can lacked a lid.

headline: No certified manager; washroom water not hot enough
summary: No certified food manager was on site while food was prepared, and the person in charge lacked food safety management training; citation issued. Washroom sink hot water measured 71–75°F, below the required 100°F. Dumpsters overflowing; citation issued.

headline: Milk crates, leaks, and missing training proof
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving, and cardboard lined basement storage racks. A torn prep cooler gasket, clutter that could harbor pests, a leaking dish sink, and missing food handler training proof were also noted.

headline: Grocery bags used for freezer food storage
summary: Multi-use utensils were not stored handle-up. Grocery bags were used to store food in the deep freezer, and plastic lining covered the exterior of the ice machine. The operator was instructed to correct each item.

headline: Food stored on floor; foil and cardboard liners
summary: Pots of food were stored on the floor under walk-in cooler shelves and must be raised six inches. Foil and cardboard were used on prep surfaces and shelves, a restroom door was not self-closing, and basement storage had unused items.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; food stored on floor
summary: No pests were found, but the front door has a 1/2 inch gap that must be sealed. Food was stored on the floor, staff worked without hair restraints, and all food handler certificates were expired. Allergen training also expired.

headline: Ice buildup, greasy hoods, and grime noted
summary: Ice had built up on prep coolers opposite the cook line and in the pizza prep station; the operator was told to defrost them. Food debris, dirt, and grime behind fryers and on the dish machine, plus grease and dust on hoods, need detail cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled dry containers; greasy equipment and walls
summary: Dry food containers such as flour and sugar must be labeled with common names. Grease and food debris were found at equipment utility connections, wheels, and behind the cooking line. No allergen training certificates were provided for certified managers.

headline: Ceiling tile and fan cover repairs needed
summary: Some ceiling tiles were missing and others water-stained; a washroom vent fan cover is missing. Walls, floors, shelves, window sill, and utility sink need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager during chicken service
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken was prepared and served; citation issued. Handwashing signage was missing at prep and dishwashing sinks. Black bowls were not inverted, and debris was behind cooking equipment.

headline: Cooked chicken and spinach held too warm
summary: Cooked chicken at 51.9°F and cooked spinach at 53°F, both cooked the day before, were in the walk-in cooler. 18 lbs (about $175) was discarded. Bulk storage containers in the basement were unlabeled, and staff were instructed on cooling methods.

headline: Overflowing dumpster; open drinks in prep areas
summary: The dumpster overflowed, preventing the lid from closing; trash must be kept inside receptacles to keep pests out; citation issued. Open drinks are prohibited in prep and dry storage areas. Also cardboard lining in the walk-in and a leaking faucet.

headline: Live roaches, mouse droppings, and warm cooked food
summary: Eight live roaches were on a wall at the front service station, and 20 mouse droppings were on a rear storage desk; pest activity must be removed before reinspection. Cooked foods at 50–51°F were discarded; the cooler needs repair.

headline: Dock door opening; no food handler training proof
summary: An opening at the lower left corner of the right dock door in the dumpster area must be sealed. No food handler training proof was provided for any food handler; the operator was instructed to provide it.

headline: Missing handwash signs; no handler certificates on site
summary: No handwashing signage at the bar hand sink or washrooms. A leak at the kitchen 3-compartment sink faucet and dish machine must be repaired. No food handler certificates were on site; new hires have 30 days.

headline: Dead roaches; eggs and tomatoes held too warm
summary: Dead roaches were on top of the ice machine and behind a scoop; they must be removed and the area cleaned. Liquid egg at 53.4–58.6°F and diced tomato at 50.8°F were held too warm; 31 lbs discarded.

headline: Improper cloth storage and porous stone mortar
summary: Wiping cloths on prep tables must sit in sanitizing solution between uses. Soiled linens hung on a hand sink splash guard, and cloth towels lined bar shelves. A porous stone mortar must be removed. Wall coving and soiled mop heads also need attention.

headline: Rice dispensed without nearby handwash sink
summary: Rice was dispensed where no handwashing sink was nearby; priority violation. Three-compartment sink water backed up; citation issued. Customer restroom was accessible through food storage; curtains were not acceptable, and durable barriers are required.

headline: Failing ceiling beams and debris on kitchen floors
summary: Ceiling-tile support beams in the dish room must be repaired, and kitchen floors had food debris. Standing water sat in front of the dish machine, and the person in charge lacked an allergen certificate.

headline: Cold foods held above 41°F; 125 lbs discarded
summary: Many cold foods, including ham, chicken, and mozzarella, were held at 48–60°F in a prep cooler, which itself read 57°F. About 125 lbs, worth $230, was discarded. Sheet trays with food crumbs need cleaning.

headline: No employee health policy; missing signs and lids
summary: No employee health policy was on the premises. Handwashing signs were missing at exposed sinks, and both all-gender restrooms lacked covered trash receptacles. The person in charge was instructed to correct each item. No citation issued.

headline: Food wrapped in plastic wrap in coolers
summary: Assorted food items in freezers and refrigeration units were wrapped only in plastic wrap. The operator must store all food in approved food-grade containers or bags.

headline: Dirty ice machines, floors, and vents
summary: Ice machine interior panels, floors under cooking equipment and ice machines, and some floor drains need cleaning. Heavy dust was on ceiling vents above the ice machine area, and hood vents need cleaning. The person in charge needs allergen training.

headline: Unlabeled bulk seasonings on prep table
summary: Bulk seasonings sat in unlabeled containers on the kitchen prep table. The operator was instructed to label items removed from original containers with their common name. This re-inspection passed.

headline: Many mouse droppings found; pest service needed
summary: About 70 mouse droppings in the basement storage and HVAC closet, plus about 30 more in dishwashing, prep, and dry storage areas. Additional pest control service is needed. An employee also lacked a valid food handler certificate.

headline: Leaking truck drain valves; rug mats in prep area
summary: Both exterior waste water drain valves on the truck's right side leaked and must be repaired. Rug-like mats on the truck prep-area floor must be removed; floor coverings must be smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Exposed drywall in basement prep area
summary: An unfinished wall with exposed drywall next to the basement toilet room in the prep area must be given an easily cleanable finished surface.

headline: Missing sanitizer; sink water too cool
summary: No sanitizer was on site, and basement sink hot water reached only 92°F, below the required 110°F. Also missing: test strips, vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies, an employee health policy, and a handwashing sink at the drink station.

headline: Grease on convection oven exteriors
summary: Grease buildup on the exterior of convection ovens in the prepared foods kitchen must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager; employees lack training
summary: No certified manager was on site while chicken was prepared 10:15–10:40 AM; citation issued. No verifiable employee health policy was on site. Three employees lacked food handler training. A torn cooler gasket was also noted.

headline: Rat and mouse droppings; cold foods above 41°F
summary: About 100 rat and 100 mouse droppings were found in several areas; more pest control is needed. Several cold foods were held above 41°F, including chicken at 44°F, and two coolers ran too warm.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; food debris on equipment
summary: Some large bulk containers were unlabeled. Cooking equipment exteriors and walk-in cooler shelves had food debris, floor drains needed cleaning, and a faucet at the 3-compartment sink leaked. Hood filters were dirty.

headline: Beard restraints, plastic liners, and ice buildup
summary: Two male employees lacked beard restraints. Ice chute debris, plastic lining on prep cooler doors, excess ice in ice cream freezers, and missing toilet room receptacle covers were noted. All need correction.

headline: Dead German roaches; sewage lines over food
summary: Dead German roaches were found throughout the basement and kitchen prep areas. The operator was told to remove them and replace monitor traps. Sewage lines over food and single-use items must be shielded; floor damage and cluttered storage also noted.

headline: Food handler lacked hair restraint
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. The employee was instructed to wear one. No other issues were listed.

headline: Front door gap must be sealed
summary: A gap along the bottom right corner of the front man door and revolving door must be made tight-fitting to prevent insect entry.

headline: Missing handwashing signs at several sinks
summary: No handwashing signage was found at the main kitchen, bar, and lower-level preparation hand sinks. Signage must be provided.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: The food service sanitation manager did not have a food allergen training certificate. The operator was instructed to meet this requirement.

headline: Foods held over 24 hours without discard date
summary: Ready-to-eat TCS foods held over 24 hours had no discard date; the manager had them discarded immediately. Mayonnaise made with raw eggs had no consumer advisory. Food was stored on the floor, and prepackaged foods lacked labels.

headline: No certified manager during wings and fries service
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager was present while wings and fries, foods that must be kept hot or cold (TCS), were prepared and served. Citation issued. A cook worked without a hair restraint.

headline: Live roaches found; no certified manager on site
summary: About 5 live roaches on prep walls and the ice machine, with removal required by reinspection. No certified food manager was on site while chicken, rice, and fish were handled. Also torn cooler gaskets, a leaking drain, and grease buildup.

headline: Prep coolers too warm; citation issued
summary: Ham at 48°F, corned beef hash at 45°F, raw bacon at 51°F, cheese, and pasta salad at 54°F were held in prep coolers. Three coolers ran at 54–60°F and must be repaired; citation issued.

headline: Greasy fryer and microwave interiors
summary: Food splatters inside microwaves and grease inside the cooking fryer must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: No certified manager on site during rice service
summary: No person in charge held a valid City sanitation certificate, and no sanitation manager was on site when rice at 172.9°F was prepared and served; citation issued. Bulk containers unlabeled, a leaking drainpipe, and litter outside.

headline: Missing handwash signs; cooler lids added on site
summary: No handwashing signage was posted at hand sinks. A preparation cooler had no lids, a priority violation with no citation issued. Lids were provided by the end of the inspection.

headline: Items on floors; grease in hood filters
summary: Boxes, soda crates, and water bottles were stored on floors or crates in several areas and must be raised at least six inches. Floor drains had heavy buildup, and hood filters above ovens had grease.

headline: Leaking pipe under warewashing unit
summary: A leak at the pipe under the warewashing unit must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Unlabeled containers; ice machine issues
summary: Large dry storage containers and small condiment containers, including nuts, lacked common-name labels. The ice machine had a plastic exterior lining and no locatable backflow device. A loose wall base behind the toilet needs repair.

headline: No certified manager; handlers skipped handwashing
summary: No certified food manager was on site during prep of chicken, eggs, and mac and cheese; citation issued. Handlers put on gloves and hairnets without washing hands. A 1/4-inch gap under the rear prep door needs sealing.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; grocery bags for food
summary: No handwashing sign at the basement prep sink. A basement storage chest freezer door is in poor repair with exposed insulation. Grocery bags were used for food storage in the walk-in cooler; food-grade bags are required.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies or procedure
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies were on site; priority violation, no citation issued. No commercial dumpster contract, a small gap at the front door, and an unshielded light in the lobby were also noted.

headline: Leaks, uncovered washroom trash, stained ceiling tiles
summary: Leaks were found at the dishwashing hand sink and under the small 3-compartment sink; both must be repaired. The women's washroom garbage can had no cover. Water-stained ceiling tiles should be replaced where needed. Fryer exteriors need cleaning.

headline: Mouse droppings found; food held too warm
summary: About 70 mouse droppings were on the floor around the second-floor prep room; more pest control is needed. Beef barbacoa held at 47.6–50.5°F in a display cooler was discarded, about 10 lbs. Food also sat on floors.

headline: Certified managers lack allergen training
summary: No allergen training was observed for certified food managers. The operator was instructed to provide allergen training for all certified food managers.

headline: No certified manager during meat preparation and service
summary: The person in charge lacked a City certificate, and no certified manager was on site while steak, chicken, and lamb were prepared and served; citation issued. Missing thermometers and splash guard, plus storage clutter, also noted.

headline: Improper glove use; raw food over ready-to-eat
summary: An employee handled raw steak, then ready-to-eat ham and cheese with the same gloves without handwashing; food was discarded. Raw eggs and beef were stored over ready-to-eat food. Walk-in cooler at 48.9°F was later adjusted to 36°F; about 50 lbs of food discarded.

headline: Rusted walk-in racks and dusty vents
summary: Rusted storage racks in the walk-in cooler must be repaired so surfaces are smooth and easily cleanable. Dust must be cleaned from prep-area ceiling vents.

headline: Slimy ice machine interior; citation issued
summary: The basement ice machine interior was heavily soiled with black and gray slime dripping onto ice used for human consumption; citation issued. Also food stored on freezer floor, no cooler thermometer, and no handwashing signage.

headline: No certified manager during breakfast food prep
summary: The person in charge lacked a City manager certificate. No certified manager was on site while breakfast sandwiches, milk, and eggs were prepared; citation issued. Employees lacked hair restraints. An open dumpster lid was closed during inspection.

headline: Unused beverage cooler running at 83.5°F
summary: An unused beverage cooler at the rear service bar held an ambient temperature of 83.5°F. The operator must repair it or remove it from the premises.

headline: Foil shelf liners, dirty handles, missing sink stoppers
summary: Aluminum foil covered rusty bottom shelves in prep areas; the foil must be removed and surfaces made smooth. Cooler handles had debris, the 3-compartment sink lacked stoppers, prep floor had excess debris, and hood filters had grease.

headline: Utensils stored in food; no handler training proof
summary: In-use utensils were stored inside food containers and coolers. Cardboard lined prep surfaces, a broken outside dumpster lid (citation issued), and no covered restroom trash can were noted. No food handler training proof was provided.

headline: No certified manager; employees missing training
summary: No certified manager was on site or posted while beef and chicken were prepared; citation issued. The person in charge lacked a certificate. Employees lacked food handler and allergen training; bulk containers were unlabeled.

headline: Handwash water too cool; no health policy
summary: No signed employee health policy and no vomit or diarrhea cleanup supplies were on site. Hand sink water measured 71.6°F, and the basement dishwashing hand sink lacked cold water; hot water must reach 100°F. Front door gaps need sealing.

headline: Prep coolers too warm; 18 lbs discarded
summary: Raw ground beef at 49.2°F, shredded cheese at 49.8°F, and sliced tomatoes at 47.4°F were held in prep coolers; 18 lbs were discarded. Three coolers ran at 49.5–55.4°F and cannot be used until reinspected. A food trailer sink has no water.

headline: Mold-like substance in ice machine; citation issued
summary: Pink and black mold-like substance inside the ice machine was dripping onto ice; ice was to be discarded and the machine cleaned. Citation issued. Also a rear door gap, torn cooler gaskets, and missing handwashing signage.

headline: No certified manager; handler skipped handwashing
summary: No certified manager was on duty while tuna, calamari, and tofu were prepared and served; citation issued. A handler swept the floor, then handled food without washing hands. Many cold foods were above 41°F; about 36 lbs discarded.

headline: Items must be 6 inches off floor
summary: Food and non-food items in the basement storage area and liquor/wine walk-in cooler must be stored six inches off the floor, with no milk crates. Handwashing signage and thermometers inside all coolers were also required.

headline: No certified manager; no paper towels at sink
summary: Food handlers prepared hot or cold foods without a certified manager or original certificate on site; citation issued. A prep-area hand sink had no paper towels; one was obtained during inspection.

headline: No certified manager during hamburger and chicken prep
summary: No City of Chicago food sanitation manager was on site, and no certificate was posted, while hamburgers and chicken were prepped and cooked. Citation issued. A men's washroom sink valve is leaking and must be repaired.

headline: No current pest control service; no certificate posted
summary: The person in charge lacked a valid City sanitation certificate, and none was posted; citation issued. No current pest control service report existed, as the manager said service was canceled; citation issued. Food handler certificates were not provided.

headline: Tomatoes, brisket, and chorizo too warm
summary: Tomatoes at 56.2°F, brisket at 54°F, and chorizo at 55°F were held in a prep cooler and discarded, about 5 lbs. Coolers lacked air thermometers, food containers lacked labels, and knives sat on a prep table.

headline: Bucket blocking handwash sink; overflowing dumpster
summary: A bucket was inside the front prep handwash sink and was removed by the manager; citation issued. The outside dumpster was overflowing, preventing the lid from closing; citation issued. No chlorine test kit was available.

headline: No handwash signs; items on floor; dirty freezer
summary: No handwashing signs were near the employee washroom sink. Single-use items were not elevated off the floor in several areas. A small freezer had excess ice, and the employee washroom was cluttered and dirty. A bulb was burned out in rear storage.

headline: Fryers and floors need cleaning
summary: Grease and debris on fryer bottoms and floors under and around some kitchen equipment need cleaning. Passed.

headline: Fly strips in prep; no handler certificates
summary: Fly strips hung in the food prep area; remove them and let pest control install devices. Rear prep hand sink leaks underneath. Also: no food handler certificates and no allergen certificate for the certified food manager.

headline: Sewage not draining properly; grills slimy
summary: Sink wastewater was not draining properly because a pipe was missing. The manager attached a hose during inspection, and drainage was working by the end. Two flat-top grills had a slimy substance and were ordered cleaned and sanitized.

headline: Loose gaskets; allergen certificate missing
summary: Loose, damaged gaskets on cold-hold units and food residue in gaskets must be repaired and cleaned. The certified manager on duty lacked an allergen training certificate on site.

headline: Ice buildup in walk-in freezer
summary: Ice buildup along floors, ceiling, and near fans in the rear storage walk-in freezer must be cleaned. Unisex restrooms lacked covered waste receptacles for sanitary products.

headline: Broken thermometers; gap in front door
summary: Broken thermometers inside the 2-door prep cooler must be replaced. A gap in the center of the double front door must be sealed to prevent insect entry. Debris must be cleaned from the ice machine, soda dispenser ice area, and counters.

headline: Mouse droppings and mold in ice machine
summary: Black mold, brown substance, and rust inside the ice machine must be removed and sanitized. About 20 mouse droppings near bottled water racks must be cleaned up and mouse activity eliminated. Salt containers were unlabeled.

headline: Unlabeled salt; deli cups not air-dried
summary: A bulk salt container lacked a label and must be labeled. Deli cups were stacked without air drying after washing; all reusable utensils must be air-dried.

headline: No vomit clean-up kit; baseboard missing
summary: No clean-up kit for vomit or diarrhea events was on site; management instructed to provide one. Missing baseboard near the mop sink must be replaced, and openings along walls and corners sealed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Grease and food debris; dirty drains
summary: Accumulated grease and food debris on cooking equipment, prep tables, and coolers; food debris in drains under the three-compartment sink; debris under the dish machine against the wall. All must be cleaned.

headline: Doors not rodent-proof; sink leak
summary: Front and rear dish-area doors are not rodent-proof at the bottom and must be made so. Leak under the three-compartment sink; no sink stoppers; opening behind the sink wall must be sealed. Hand sink behind the bar lacked signage.

headline: Unused cooking equipment; dirty washroom vents
summary: Unused cooking equipment near the entrance, rear storage, and basement must be removed. Mop stored improperly in the kitchen; dirty washroom vents need cleaning.

headline: Debris outside dumpster; unfinished floors
summary: Debris around the outside garbage dumpster must be cleaned. Unused articles and equipment in outside and rear storage must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Unfinished floors behind the front counter need repair.

headline: Hand sinks lack hot water; cold unit tagged
summary: Grill prep and restroom hand sinks had no hot water (70–77°F); handlers told to use nearby pasta prep sink until fixed. Cold unit at 55°F was tagged. Dish machine final rinse gauge inaccurate; repair needed.

headline: Restaurant offered food for live dogs online
summary: Website listed a dog menu with food from the kitchen, including chicken breast and hamburger patty. Staff may not prepare or serve food to live animals. The operator removed the dog menu during the inspection.

headline: Water leak under three-compartment sink
summary: Water leaked from a drainpipe under the three-compartment sink in the basement prep and dishwashing area. Repair required.

headline: Dirty floors, fryers, and ice machine
summary: Ice machine interior needed cleaning. Wiping cloths must be kept in sanitizing solution when not in use. Fryers and cooking equipment need greasy buildup removed; floors throughout need detail cleaning; restrooms need cleaning.

headline: Cutting board grooves; raw wood door
summary: A large cutting board in rear prep had dark grooves and must be sanitized, with grooves removed. A raw wood door in the walk-in cooler is prohibited and must be painted or sealed.

headline: Plastic bowls in dry ingredients; grease buildup
summary: Disposable plastic bowls were stored inside dry-ingredient containers; use handled utensils instead. Tableware was not inverted above prep coolers. Raw wood shelving must be sealed. Microwaves, fryers, and stoves need cleaning.

headline: Deeply cut cutting boards; clutter
summary: Cutting boards above the three-compartment sink and at the meat prep table had deep cuts and stains and must be resealed or replaced. Excess clutter in the dish room and rear storage must be removed; items must sit 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Outdated time labels; food discarded
summary: Sliced cheese and french fries kept only by time, not temperature, had outdated labels dated 8/21. Foods were discarded and new accurate labels added on site. Also: small leak in a basement drinking-water pipe needs repair.

headline: Mouse droppings and uncorrected prior violations
summary: About 25 mouse droppings were found in dry storage, the office, and behind racks; more pest control needed. Food on floors and unlabeled containers also noted. Prior core violations, including flypaper and grime, were not corrected.

headline: Roaches found; no certified manager on site
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken was prepared and served. About 3 live roaches were found, plus about 15 dead roaches in many areas, including near food storage and the fryer. Pest control recommended; allergen training missing.

headline: Flies in office, prep, and hallway
summary: About 7–10 live large flies flew in the office, rear hallway, and food prep area; about 10 live small flies were on office shelves. Eliminate flies, clean affected areas, and contact pest control. Citation issued.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No certified food manager was on site while food was served; one must always be present. Also: missing handwashing signs, a rear door gap, a leaking sink, and no lidded bin for sanitary products.

headline: Ice machine debris and peeling walk-in walls
summary: Slight debris was encrusted inside the ice machine; it must be removed and the machine serviced. Backflow prevention devices were not located at ice machines and must be installed. Peeling metal in the walk-in cooler must be repaired.

headline: No grease trap; drainboard too small
summary: Facility has no grease trap at the three-compartment sink and must install one. Drainboard must be large enough for all soiled and cleaned items. Staff serving open drinks must show food handler training proof, kept on site.

headline: Broken floor tiles need replacing
summary: Broken floor tiles in the rear prep and dish room must be replaced; they are not easily cleanable. This is the only item noted.

headline: Ice machine interior not clean
summary: Top inside of the ice machine was not clean. Ice must be removed, and the surface cleaned and sanitized.

headline: No certified manager during deli service
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while deli meat, a food that must be kept hot or cold, was handled and served. Also: broken sink stopper on the three-compartment sink and no lights in the walk-in freezer.

headline: Roaches found in prep area; handwashing blocked
summary: About 6 live roaches were found in the main prep area. A bar hand sink was blocked, and the front prep sink lacked soap and towels, supplied during inspection. Mussels lacked required shellfish tags; manager discarded 10 lbs. Pest control ordered.

headline: No certified manager; food held too warm
summary: No certified food manager was on site while open. Eggs on the floor at 54.9°F and potato salad at 59.5°F were discarded, about $100 of food. Sticky traps held dead roaches. Ice machine had black mold-like buildup; several employees lacked hair restraints.

headline: Torn gasket and broken tiles; greasy hood
summary: Torn door gasket inside the 2-door prep cooler must be replaced. Broken floor tiles behind the front bar must be replaced. Grease on the ventilation hood and filters above cooking equipment must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager; hot food below 135°F
summary: No certified food manager was on site while food that must be kept hot or cold was handled. Cooked pork at 110.4°F and sushi rice at 94.3°F were below the 135°F minimum and discarded.

headline: Cold food too warm; hand sink inaccessible
summary: Chicken, pork, sausage, beef short ribs, and croquetas at 44–46°F in the prep cooler must be 41°F or below. Hand sink by the back door was inaccessible. Repeat violations, including missing food handler and allergen proof, were not corrected.

headline: Torn door sweep; scoop handles in food
summary: Rear alley door had a torn sweep with a gap over 1/4 inch and must be pest-proofed. Scoop handles were in basement dry-storage food. No sanitizer test kit was available, and the three-compartment sink leaked heavily.

headline: Cold food too warm; dish machine failed
summary: Chicken and salsa held at 49–50°F; about 90 lbs discarded. A reach-in cooler at 53°F was tagged. Dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm and tagged. Hand sink was blocked; hot water only 74.7°F.

headline: Ice machine interior needs cleaning
summary: Interior of the ice machine had minimal buildup and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: No food sanitation certificate posted
summary: No City of Chicago food sanitation certificate was posted; a certified food manager must be present with an original certificate whenever food is prepared or served. Also: unlabeled prepackaged and bulk foods, and several employees without hair restraints.

headline: Cold food at 54–59°F; discarded
summary: Cooked greens, sweet potatoes, pork chops, chicken, and ham hocks in a reach-in cooler were 53.8–59.1°F; about 60 lbs ($500) discarded. Cooler at 58.1°F tagged; must not be used until re-inspected.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; no allergen training
summary: Bulk flour, sugar, spices, and other food were not labeled and must be. The sanitation manager had no allergen training.

headline: Greasy outdoor container; leaks; peeling paint
summary: Outside grease container had heavy grease and garbage on the ground, a food source for rodents and pests; citation issued. Also: leaking faucet, slow drain, peeling paint, dirty walls and vents, and cluttered patio.

headline: Mouse droppings on basement floor
summary: About 60 mouse droppings were scattered on the basement floor along walls and under shelving. Remove, clean, sanitize, and contact pest control. Also: unlocked dining-room prep cooler, missing handwashing sign, and no allergen certificate for the manager on duty.

headline: Wet wiping cloths and exposed pots
summary: Wet wiping cloths were stored on a prep table instead of in sanitizer. Pots and pans were on the front shelf with food-contact surfaces exposed; they must be inverted or protected. Mineral buildup inside the basement ice machine lid must be cleaned.

headline: Leak under sink; allergen certificate missing
summary: Leak under the one-compartment sink in the rear dish area must be repaired. Wall with dried beverage spill and floor debris by the hot holding unit need cleaning. No certified food manager with an allergen training certificate was on site.

headline: No handwashing signs; no public summary
summary: Exposed handwashing sinks in all three bars lacked signage; must be provided. Summary report from a prior inspection was not posted; a new one was left and must be posted for public view. Citation issued.

headline: Condensation pipe dripping into bucket
summary: A condensation pipe in a 2-door refrigerator was dripping into a bucket. It must be rerouted into an approved drain.

headline: Dirty basement floors; clogged drains
summary: Basement floors need cleaning. A floor drain near the old walk-in cooler must be cleaned to prevent a pest breeding site. A kitchen floor drain by the hand sink was filled with food and debris.

headline: No handwashing signs; ice machine debris
summary: Hand sink behind the bar lacked handwashing signage. Debris encrusted inside the ice maker must be removed. No sink for dumping liquid waste at the bar; a minimum one-compartment sink must be installed.

headline: Broken thermometers; wall gaps; cluttered refuse area
summary: Broken ambient air thermometer in the upright cooler and a bent probe food thermometer must be repaired or replaced. Outdoor refuse enclosure was cluttered. Walk-in cooler wall panels had gaps that could let pests in.

headline: Walk-in freezer thermometer not working
summary: Thermometer in the walk-in freezer is not operable and must be repaired. Croutons, condiments, and single-use items stored under the front hand sink must be removed to prevent leakage contamination. Handwashing sign missing; certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: The food service sanitation manager did not have an allergen training certificate on site. Instructed to meet the requirement. No other issues noted.

headline: Missing allergen certificate; rusty racks
summary: A certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate. Also: handwashing signage needed behind the bar; ice machine buildup; rusty racks in the beer cooler; dusty condenser fan cover; dirty floors in basement and bars.

headline: No certified manager; no health policy
summary: Person in charge had no City of Chicago sanitation certificate during food service. About 10 lbs of reduced-oxygen packaged pastrami and turkey lacking labels, dates, and times were discarded. Also: no written employee health policy or food handler certificates.

headline: No hand sink near main cooking area
summary: No handwashing sink was convenient and accessible to the main cooking area; one with hot and cold water must be installed. High-temperature dish machine needs a waterproof thermometer or test strips to verify 160°F at the plate surface.

headline: No health policy, kit, or food handler certificates
summary: No employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit, or food handler certificates were on site. Front food prep area lacked an accessible handwashing sink. No pest control logbook was available. Pests were not observed.

headline: Thermometers missing; knives stored between equipment
summary: Two coolers lacked internal air thermometers. A pest control device hung above the clean-equipment side of the sink and must be moved. Knives were stored between equipment and walls; knife rack exterior was soiled.

headline: Greasy wall, insulation, and floors
summary: Basement walk-in cooler floors need cleaning. Grease on the wall at the cook line grill must be cleaned. Cotton-like insulation next to the hot water tank must be removed so the wall is smooth and cleanable.

headline: Missing thermometers; no sanitizer test kit
summary: Several coolers lacked working thermometers; no metal-stem food thermometer or sanitizer test kit was on site. Old yogurt and sour cream containers were used for food storage. A food handler lacked a certificate, a repeat violation. Report summary not posted.

headline: Heavy grease in second-floor hood
summary: Heavy dirt and grease were found inside the exhaust hood, filters, and pipes above cooking equipment in the second-floor kitchen. Instructed to clean and maintain. No other issues noted.

headline: No pest control service records since 2023
summary: Only one pest control report, from August 2023; none for 2024 or 2025. Must hire a licensed pest control service twice yearly and keep a logbook. No handwashing sign at the rear prep sink.

headline: Employees eating and drinking at prep
summary: Employees were drinking and eating at the kitchen prep area; a designated break area must be provided. Milk crates were used for elevation at the front and rear; use proper shelving and store food 6 inches from walls.

headline: Vacuum-packed meats lacked required approvals
summary: Vacuum-sealed cured and smoked meats and a vacuum packaging machine were found without an approved HACCP plan (a written food-safety plan) or the required variance (city permission). Foods and machine were tagged; manager must provide both.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; allergen proof
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at sinks in customer restrooms and the service station. A city-certified food manager had no proof of allergen training on site.

headline: Bare hands touched ready-to-eat food
summary: Food handler used bare hands to add onions and cilantro to a bowl handed to a server. Those ingredients were discarded and the server given a new bowl on site. Dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm; repaired on site.

headline: Black caulking above sink
summary: Excessive black substance on caulking above the three-compartment sink in the rear prep area must be removed, and the caulking maintained.

headline: Ice machine drain in hand sink
summary: Ice machine drain line was draining into the hand sink and must be rerouted. Dust on vents and ceiling tiles in the front prep area must be cleaned.

headline: Frozen boxes on floor; greasy station
summary: Boxes of frozen product on the basement walk-in freezer floor must be raised at least 6 inches. Dirt buildup under the slushy and beverage stations and debris under equipment in the front and rear must be cleaned.

headline: Leaks, missing ceiling tiles, wall gaps
summary: A leak at the first-floor three-compartment sink must be repaired. Missing kitchen ceiling tiles must be replaced. Gaps between the second-floor kitchen wall base and floor must be sealed to prevent pest entry points.

headline: Hand sink blocked; no food handler training
summary: Front hand sink was blocked and had a broken hot-water handle. Uncovered food was stored on walk-in cooler floors. No food handler training for employees; no menu advisory for raw or undercooked food. Repeat violations: unlabeled containers, leaks.

headline: Leaks under sinks; dirty floors
summary: Leaks under the second-floor three-compartment sink and first-floor dishwasher must be repaired. Floors and walls in prep and dish areas need cleaning. Both grease traps must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Food handler certificates missing on site
summary: Several food handlers lacked certificates, and allergen training certificates were not on site. Also: torn cooler gasket, two missing sink stoppers, unused vacuum packaging equipment, and dirty hood and slicer.

headline: No cooler thermometers; no summary posted
summary: No ambient air thermometers inside walk-in coolers; readable thermometers must be provided in all refrigerated units. Inspection summary from an earlier inspection was not posted; copy given and must be posted for public view. Citation issued.

headline: Scoop stored in sugar; greasy hood vents
summary: Wiping cloths air-dried on clean equipment, and a scoop was stored in sugar. Soil on equipment, floors under cooking equipment, and heavily greased hood vents were ordered cleaned. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Frozen meat stored in plastic grocery bags
summary: Passed. Frozen meats were stored in plastic grocery bags; food-grade bags or containers are required. Other items: stained cutting boards, rust on cooler shelves, grease and peeling paint, dirty floors, and a missing light shield.

headline: Dirty coolers, drains, fryers, and hood
summary: Lower reach-in coolers, drains, garbage cans, deep fryers, and grill area need detail cleaning. Leaks at the Ecolab device line, the three-compartment sink bottom drain, and a hand sink must be repaired. Floors and bar drains need cleaning.

headline: Pink ice machine residue dripping onto ice
summary: Pink discoloration inside the ice machine was dripping onto ice for consumption; panel must be cleaned, sanitized, or replaced. An employee with long hair lacked a proper hair restraint around exposed food. Earlier storage-room clutter violation not corrected.

headline: Greasy fryers; toilet room needs cleaning
summary: Wiping cloths must be stored in clean sanitizing solution when not in use. Fryers need greasy buildup removed. Toilet room, outdoor garbage area, and floors with food spills need cleaning.

headline: No employee health policy; improper thawing
summary: No employee health policy or training was on site; citation issued. Menus lacked a raw or undercooked food advisory. Frozen fish and shrimp were thawed improperly. No sushi rice pH meter, log, or lab letter. Food handlers lacked certificates.

headline: Missing health policy and vomit cleanup kit
summary: No employee health policy was on premises; employees must report illnesses that can spread through food. No vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit was on site. Toilet room door not self-closing. Food handlers must obtain required training.

headline: Meat dropped on floor, returned to bowl
summary: Employee picked up meat dropped on the floor, returned it to the bowl, and put it in a mechanical cutter. Manager told to discard the fallen and contaminated meat. Also: cooked chicken held over 24 hours lacked a date mark.

headline: Ice scoop stored in dirty container
summary: An ice scoop was stored in a container that was not clean and sanitized; it must be kept clean. Ice buildup inside a large deep freezer must be defrosted and cleaned.

headline: Torn gaskets, dirty fryers, chipped paint
summary: Torn door gaskets inside a 2-door prep cooler must be replaced. Deep fryers in the prep kitchen need cleaning. Chipped paint on service kitchen walls must be scraped and repainted.

headline: No food handler training proof on site
summary: Food handler drank from an open cup in the prep area. Rear door sweep broken, leaving a 1-inch gap. No food handler training proof; certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Live roaches under shelf above sink
summary: Four live roaches were found under a shelf above the three-compartment sink. Pest control service required. Also noted: dead roaches and grease on floors, cardboard shelf liners, unlabeled bulk containers, a greasy grease trap, and a dirty exhaust hood.

headline: Mineral buildup in ice machine; dirty walls
summary: Slight mineral buildup inside the ice machine must be cleaned and maintained. Dirty wall above the three-compartment sink and food spills on floors in the rear dish and prep area must be cleaned.

headline: Black slime in ice maker; roaches found
summary: Black slimy substance inside the ice maker dripped into ice for human consumption; machine must be turned off, ice removed, and cleaned. Two live cockroaches were found near the employee washroom water heater; more pest control needed.

headline: No vomit clean-up procedure on premises
summary: No vomit and diarrhea clean-up procedure or kit was on premises. Some coolers lacked thermometers. Three-compartment sink lacked stoppers; mop sink had no backflow device. Women's washroom lacks a covered trash container.

headline: Donut display with food debris
summary: Inside of the donut display had excessive food debris buildup. It must be cleaned to prevent pest harborage, meaning places pests can hide.

headline: Handwashing lapses; rat droppings throughout
summary: Employees did not wash hands between tasks, such as after raw meat; they washed when told. Over 60 rat droppings were found on floors and near cold units. Egg rolls at 82.4°F and 74.3°F were discarded (about 20 lbs).

headline: Mouse droppings and live flies found
summary: Over 25 live small flies, over 30 mouse droppings at the front counter, and over 20 in the kitchen prep area. Remove and clean affected areas; contact licensed pest control. Also: pooled water under sink, mops on floor.

headline: Mouse droppings; food temperatures unsafe
summary: Catfish at 101.5°F (needs 135°F+) and oxtails at 53.6°F (needs 41°F or below) were discarded. About 60 or more mouse droppings were found on cooler ledges and must be removed. No probe thermometer; no food handler or allergen training.

headline: Dirty floors and walls; no allergen certificates
summary: Floor littered under the front counter in the prep area, and food and grease buildup on the wall behind the fryer, must be cleaned. Food managers lack allergen training certificates; required.

headline: Mold-like spots in ice machine
summary: Black mold-like spots inside a beverage-station ice machine must be cleaned to prevent ice contamination. Menu lacked a raw or undercooked food advisory, corrected on site. Also: gaps at dumpster-area doors and a leaking three-compartment sink.

headline: Labeling and wastewater pipes over storage
summary: Display cookies must be labeled with business name, address, ingredients, and allergen warnings. Dry goods stored under basement wastewater pipes must be moved or shielded. Previous summary not posted; citation issued.

headline: Hand sink blocked; water temperature too high
summary: Main cook-line hand sink could not stay under 130°F; must be repaired to a maximum of 120°F. Sink was blocked by a mixer and crates, cleared during inspection. Also: ground beef covered while cooling, unlabeled bulk containers, and some managers lacking allergen training.

headline: Food handler certificates missing; sink backs up
summary: Three-compartment sink drains backed up into the middle compartment. Floors under equipment and shelving had dirt and food debris. Food handler certificates could not be located on site, and no allergen training proof was found.

headline: Dish machines not dispensing sanitizer
summary: Three low-temperature dish machines were not dispensing sanitizer (0 ppm chlorine). All three were tagged and held for inspection by the Chicago Department of Public Health.

headline: Gaps, leaks, slow drain, no health policy
summary: No signed employee health policies. Gaps under the front revolving door and man door must be sealed against insects. Leaky pipes and faucets, a slow hand-sink drain, and missing handwashing signs need fixing.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; cooler failed
summary: Failed. Over 100 mouse droppings across front and middle prep, dish, and basement areas; priority citation; call an exterminator and clean all areas. Prep cooler at 53.1°F tagged and held. No consumer advisory on brunch menu for raw or undercooked food.

headline: Missing thermometers, unlabeled seasonings, dirty floors
summary: Passed. Reach-in coolers lack thermometers; bulk seasonings unlabeled. Food on floors and milk crates used as shelving must be fixed. Floors under cooking equipment have heavy grease; stained ceiling tiles suggest a leak; holes in walls need repair.

headline: Greasy equipment, leaking cooler pipe, broken tiles
summary: Passed. Heavy grease on cooking equipment and dust on cooler shelves must be cleaned. A cooler fan pipe leaks; product must be moved away and the leak repaired. Also noted: broken wall tiles, a torn bag over the hot line, and missing lights.

headline: Employee food stored with customer food
summary: Passed. Employee personal food was stored next to customer food in the walk-in cooler. It must be separated.

headline: Hand sink blocked by sanitizer bucket; cited
summary: Passed. Front prep hand sink blocked by a sanitizer bucket and wiping cloths; priority citation. Food containers unlabeled and uncovered in rear prep and cooling units. Plates not inverted. Rusted racks above prep table; exhaust vents dusty.

headline: Milk crates and clutter stored throughout
summary: Passed. Milk crates, boxes, and unnecessary items stored throughout the facility must be removed. Floors throughout prep areas need cleaning.

headline: Door gap, overflowing dumpster; failed
summary: Failed. Side exit door has a 1/4-inch gap; must be repaired to block pests. Outside dumpster overflowing; lid must stay closed (priority citation). Foil on kitchen shelving, dirty walk-in shelves, and dirty floors also noted.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup kit
summary: License passed with conditions. No employee health policy and no vomiting or diarrhea procedures or supplies; both priority. Three-compartment sink lacks adequate stoppers; manager told to provide them.

headline: Rodent bait in food area; removed on site
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. Open rodent bait found on food storage shelves and near condiments in the garage; priority violation, citation issued. The facility removed the rodent bait during the inspection.

headline: No health policy; leaks; dead insects in light
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. No signed employee health policy and no vomiting or diarrhea cleanup procedure or items; both priority. Dead insects in lobby light shield; leaking pipes at two hand sinks; no allergen training for food manager.

headline: About 15 flies found; failed
summary: Failed. About 15 small flies found: 5 in dish area, 3 in toilet room, 4 in food prep. Manager told to minimize flies; pest control recommended (priority citation). Outside garbage lid warped and cannot close; tight-fitting lid required (priority citation).

headline: Torn cooler door gasket
summary: Passed. Right-side door gasket on the two-door prep reach-in cooler is ripped or torn and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: No certified manager on premises; cited
summary: Passed with conditions. No City certified foodservice manager on premises; priority citation; one must be present at all times. Cold water turned off at three-compartment sink. Employee washroom has no covered receptacle and is used as storage.

headline: Food on floor; leaking sink faucet
summary: Passed. Food stored on the walk-in cooler floor must be raised off the floor. Food debris on cooking equipment needs cleaning. Faucet at the three-compartment sink leaks and must be repaired. Floors and walls under the sink need cleaning.

headline: Blocked hand sinks; phone on cutting board
summary: Passed with conditions. Hand sinks blocked by sanitizer buckets and linens; priority citation; person in charge removed them during inspection. Some hand sinks lacked soap and paper towels. Employee drink uncovered; phone on cutting board; boxes on basement floor.

headline: About 50 rat droppings; no certified manager
summary: Complaint failed. About 50 rat droppings under basement staircase and in a cluttered room; priority citation. No certified manager on site while rice and chicken were prepared; priority citation. Black slime in ice maker dripping into ice. Hand sink not accessible.

headline: Non-service dogs inside; priority citation
summary: Short complaint inspection passed with conditions. Non-service dogs were brought inside, which is not allowed; priority citation issued. Food containers on floors in prep, storage, and walk-in must be raised 6 inches. Serving plates must be inverted.

headline: Stained ceiling tiles; doors need rodent-proofing
summary: Re-inspection passed. Dry and liquid containers unlabeled. Insect control device stored above a food prep area, which is not allowed. Entrance doors need rodent-proofing. Hot water knob missing at three-compartment sink; two light bulbs out; ceiling tiles stained.

headline: Bug catchers over prep area must go
summary: Re-inspection passed. Plastic bug catchers hanging over the rear prep area must be removed to prevent contamination. Food in grocery bags in the freezer needs food-grade storage bags. Mop drying in utility sink needs a drying rack.

headline: No certified manager while food prepared; failed
summary: Complaint re-inspection failed. No certified manager on site while deli sandwiches and other TCS foods were prepared; priority citation. Food handlers lacked training proof. Prior violations uncorrected, including missing mop sink and grease trap. Deadline stated: April 23, 2026.

headline: Greasy fryers and floors; stained cutting boards
summary: Re-inspection passed. Stained cutting boards must be resurfaced or replaced. Rusted, chipped wire racks in walk-in must be repainted or replaced. Heavy grease on fryers and cooking equipment; dirty floors around ice machine; hood filters dusty.

headline: No health reporting policy or vomit cleanup plan
summary: Priority: no verified employee illness-reporting policy and no vomiting or diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies. No allergen training certificate. Upkeep: missing cooler thermometers, unlabeled containers, cracked lids, slow hand sink, debris outside.

headline: Weak hand sink water; scoops in standing water
