summary: Passed. Hand sink has weak hot water pressure; must be supplied at city pressure. Ice cream scoops kept in stagnant room-temperature water; a dipper well with cold running water must be installed for the open tub ice cream.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup supplies
summary: License passed with conditions. No employee health policy and no vomiting or diarrhea cleanup procedures or supplies; both priority. No food handler training for employees. Manager lacks allergen training. Leaking drain pipe and missing sink stoppers also noted.

headline: Frozen meat thawing in prep area
summary: Re-inspection passed. Frozen meat was thawing in the food prep area. Management told to thaw TCS foods under cold running water, in the refrigerator, or in the microwave as part of continuous cooking.

headline: Ice machine and hood need cleaning
summary: Passed. Slight calcium buildup inside the ice machine must be cleaned. Food and grease buildup on the ventilation hood and filters must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Dusty vents and greasy walls
summary: Re-inspection passed. Dust on ceiling vents above prep tables, coolers, and inside both washrooms must be cleaned. Dirt and food debris are caked on walls in the rear food prep area. Must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: No hand sink in prep area; failed
summary: License failed. No hand sink in front prep and kitchen area; one must be installed and be easily accessible (priority). No self-closing washroom door. Grime in floor drain of three-compartment sink. Brooms and mops stored inside mop sink.

headline: Repeat violations uncorrected; citation issued
summary: Failed. Prior violations not corrected: unlabeled containers, broken cooler gasket, black plastic bags used for food, leaking faucet, dirty basement floor. Also missing handwashing signs, greasy hood, no lids on toilet-room sinks, dusty vents.

headline: Rodent-proof rear door; ice machine buildup
summary: Canvass passed. Rear exit door needs rodent-proofing. Ice machine interior needs cleaning; ice scoop was stored inside the ice. Single-service containers must be inverted. Prep hand sink drains slowly; floors behind freezers and hood vent need cleaning.

headline: Non-working toilets, lights, and hood filters
summary: License re-inspection passed. Non-working toilets in women's washroom, a urinal in men's, and a prep sink in kitchen 7. Leaking drain pipe at three-compartment sink. Hood lights out in zones 1 to 5; greasy hood filters; ventilation not working in men's washroom.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; no cooler thermometer
summary: Passed. Handwashing signage missing at sinks throughout the facility. No internal air thermometer in the 1-door upright cheese cooler. Heavy grease on hood-adjacent walls and fire suppression piping; hood filters in poor repair. Manager's allergen training expired.

headline: No certified manager while chicken prepared; failed
summary: Re-inspection failed. No certified manager on site while chicken was prepared; priority citation. Repeat violations uncorrected: no metal stem thermometer, no sanitizer test devices, no public summary posted (citation). Old yogurt and sour cream tubs used for food storage.

headline: Frozen chicken thawed in water; hair restraint
summary: Passed. Frozen chicken was thawing in a pan of water; staff must thaw TCS (temperature-controlled for safety) foods in the cooler or under cool running water. A manager/cook was without a hair restraint.

headline: No hot water; droppings found; failed
summary: License failed. No certified manager on duty; no employee health policy; no vomit cleanup kit; no sanitizer test strips. About 10 to 15 droppings in storage and boiler room. Hot water absent: sinks read 64.5 to 66.5°F; handwashing sink must reach 100°F.

headline: Two live roaches on walls; failed
summary: Failed. Two live roaches found on walls in the prep area. Manager must remove roach activity by reinspection; pest control advised. Priority citation. Also ripped prep cooler gaskets, ice buildup on milk cooler condenser, and one food manager without allergen training.

headline: No cooler thermometer; dusty vents
summary: Canvass passed. No thermometer found in two-door cold-hold unit in prep area; one must be provided. Refuse and recyclables must be removed often enough to prevent pests. Dust and dirt in ceiling vents above prep must be cleaned. Food handler certificates must be provided.

headline: No handwashing signs in locker rooms
summary: Passed. No handwashing signage inside men's or women's employee locker rooms; must be provided.

headline: Cold food too warm; discarded; cited
summary: Passed with conditions. About 20 lbs chicken, 20 cooked pork, 20 lbs tofu, and other cold foods were at 62 to 80°F; the person in charge discarded them (about $400). Priority citation. Undated prepared food stored over 24 hours. Black mold in sink basins.

headline: Rusted shelves; peeling paint; no allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Rust and food debris on walk-in cooler and freezer shelving must be removed or replaced. Residue on floors under the bar needs detail cleaning. Peeling paint near mop sink and washroom must be repaired. Manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: Repeat pest violation; over 40 flies
summary: Complaint re-inspection failed. Earlier priority violation not corrected: more than 40 small flies seen throughout the facility, including office, storage, prep, and dining areas. Manager told to address pests; priority citation issued.

headline: Aprons on floor; deeply cut cutting boards
summary: Complaint passed. Clean aprons and wiping cloths stored on the floor. Cutting boards in meat and pizza areas have deep cuts and stains. Floors in meat cooler, produce cooler, and bakery need cleaning along baseboards.

headline: Fish too warm in cooler; tagged; cited
summary: Passed with conditions. Fish at 48.1°F and 50.0°F inside sushi prep cooler; about 10 lbs ($100) discarded. Cooler ambient 52.1°F; tagged and cited. Broken cooler thermometer, torn gasket, several expired food handler cards, and expired manager allergen training.

headline: No allergen training for certified manager
summary: Re-inspection passed. No certified food manager had allergen training. Staff with city sanitation certificates were told to complete training. Documentation must be provided.

headline: No allergen certificates; prior violation unfixed
summary: Passed with conditions. A prior violation was not corrected: no allergen training certificates for certified food managers on site. Citation issued; certificates must be provided. Basement storage racks are cluttered with tools and must be organized.

headline: Knife not sanitized; food handler cited
summary: Failed. Sanitizer read 0 ppm; a food handler washed a knife without proper wash, rinse, and sanitize steps. Manager instructed on sink setup; citation issued. Repeat violations uncorrected: leaky pipe, unlabeled squeeze bottles, no allergen training.

headline: No sink at lobby bar
summary: Passed. The third-floor lobby bar has no sink for getting water or discarding liquid waste. One must be installed.

headline: Leaking rear hand sink valve
summary: Complaint passed. Hot water valve at the rear hand sink in the rear prep area is leaking; must be repaired.

headline: Bar sink blocked; ice machine has black mold
summary: Passed with conditions. Main bar hand sink blocked by a food strainer; priority citation. Second bar ice machine has black slime and mold above ice used for drinks; must clean and sanitize; priority citation. Food stored on floor; plates not inverted.

headline: Gap between wall and sink
summary: Passed. A gap between the wall and the three-compartment sink must be sealed and maintained.

headline: No service sink; no washroom ventilation
summary: License passed. Facility has no service sink for disposing dirty mop water; one must be provided. Rear toilet room has no mechanical ventilation; it must be installed and maintained.

headline: Missing thermometers and manager allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Thermometers must be visible inside all coolers. Floor corners in the prep and dishwashing area need cleaning. A certified food manager lacks an allergen training certificate; management told to comply.

headline: Four live roaches found; failed
summary: Failed. About 4 live roaches found in the rear prep and dish machine area. Management told to clean and arrange additional pest control service. Priority citation issued. Missing ceiling tiles in prep and walk-in areas and a broken coved tile also noted.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; no mop sink
summary: Torn rubber gasket on a two-door prep cooler must be repaired. No mop sink was found, so one must be installed for dirty mop water. Excess dust on washroom vents must be cleaned. Upkeep issues only.

headline: Utensils stored exposed; heavy ice buildup
summary: Passed. Spoons and spatulas were stored exposed with handles up; manager told to store utensils inverted. Heavy ice buildup in a reach-in cooler drip tray and on two wine cooler shelves must be removed.

headline: Back door cracked open; wet mops in buckets
summary: Passed. Back door was cracked open; doors must stay closed and tight-fitting to prevent pests. Wet mops stored in buckets must be hung to dry. Food handler certificates could not be located for all employees; must be kept on site.

headline: Front doors leak gaps; pest entry risk
summary: Passed. Front doors are not tight-fitting at the bottom and between them; weather stripping must be provided to block pest entry. Loose hot water knob on three-compartment sink must be repaired. Walk-in corners need cleaning.

headline: Boxed food on floor; cooler gaskets torn
summary: Passed. Boxed food on the rear prep floor must be elevated six inches. Ice machine guard is dirty and must be cleaned. Two-door refrigerator gaskets are torn and must be repaired. Basement clutter must be organized.

headline: Cardboard boxes in employee restroom
summary: Passed. Cardboard boxes stored in the employee toilet room must be removed.

headline: Three dead roaches found; food on floor
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Three dead roaches found under the three-compartment sink and behind the water heater. Manager told to detail clean and remove all pest evidence. Boxes of food and drinks on the floor must be raised 6 inches.

headline: Grease, slow sink, and no allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Grease on prep table next to fryers; hand sink beside the three-compartment sink drains slowly; clutter near kitchen; women's restroom ventilation not working. No allergen certificate on site; staff told to complete training.

headline: Greasy cooking fryer interior
summary: Passed. Minor grease buildup inside the cooking fryer must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Rat droppings; no hand sink; failed
summary: Complaint failed. Rat droppings on the floor near the dish machine in rear storage; priority citation; call an exterminator and clean. No handwashing sink in rear dishwashing area (priority citation). Dish machine not operable and no three-compartment sink.

headline: Dessert labels missing allergen information
summary: Passed with conditions. Packaged desserts lacked proper labels and allergen information; priority citation. Ice bin and deep fryer interior need cleaning.

headline: High-temperature dish machine out of order
summary: Passed. High-temperature dish machine marked out of order and not in use. It must be repaired or replaced to reach 160°F minimum, or removed. Grease and grime on walls under the dish machine need cleaning.

headline: Boxed food on floor; allergen training missing
summary: Passed. Boxed food stored on walk-in cooler floor must be elevated six inches. Food debris inside cold-holding equipment must be cleaned. Spills and debris on front prep floors need detail cleaning. One certified food manager lacks an allergen awareness certificate.

headline: About 80 mouse droppings; failed
summary: Failed. About 80 mouse droppings found in a utility closet, along prayer room door tracks, behind the front counter, and under dry storage racks. Management told to clean and arrange more pest control. Priority citation. Mop sink lacks a backflow device.

headline: No handwashing signs; holes in floor
summary: Passed. No handwashing signs at restroom hand sinks; must be provided. Open holes in bar floor near warewashing machine, plus storage closet floor and wall, must be repaired.

headline: No health policy or grease trap; failed
summary: Failed. No employee health policy available; must be provided. Three-compartment sink has no grease trap. Clean water tank is larger than gray water tank; gray water tank must be 50% larger than the storage tank (priority).

headline: No handwashing signs; milk crates as shelving
summary: Passed. No handwashing signage at prep hand sinks or washroom. Milk crates used as shelving in prep and storage must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Clutter on rear storage floor removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Hand sink blocked; expired food; cited
summary: Basement hand sink was blocked by pots; cited, and an employee removed them during inspection. Numerous packaged flan cakes were past their 3/19/2025 expiration date; cited. Fly strips over the bakery prep area were removed on site. Ice buildup and dust also noted.

headline: Food handler training missing for all staff
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food handler training is missing for all employees; must be provided and maintained. Also noted: crates used for food storage, ice scoop left in ice bin, unlabeled squeeze bottles, chipping paint, and dust on vents and ceilings.

headline: Mold-like buildup in walk-in; no food handler card
summary: Passed. Mold-like buildup on walk-in cooler racks must be detail cleaned. Dust on ceiling tiles above the prep line cooler needs cleaning. Burnt-out bulbs over rear dish sink. One food handler lacks a certificate; a manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Fly trap over prep table must be moved
summary: Complaint passed. Hanging fly trap is directly over the prep table and clean dish rack and must be relocated. Torn milk cooler gasket must be replaced. Reach-in cooler interiors need cleaning. Restroom hand sink leaks and has a loose faucet.

headline: Hand sink not connected; citation issued
summary: Complaint passed with conditions. Kitchen prep hand sink has no hot or cold water connection; priority citation. Food containers stored on walk-in floor must be raised 6 inches. Food kept in tin cans; ice scoop left on ice bin; hood and pipes greasy.

headline: Soda nozzle and ice chute need cleaning
summary: Passed. Soda nozzle and ice chute need cleaning to remove buildup. Worn, dark cutting boards with deep cuts must be replaced. Floors and floor drains need cleaning to remove buildup.

headline: Bar sink blocked; cooler food too warm; failed
summary: Failed. Bar hand sink covered in plastic and disconnected; cited. Dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine; tagged. Chicken, hamburgers, salmon, and steak held at 44.7 to 48.1°F in cooler; about 20 lbs discarded. Prep cooler at 46.5°F; tagged and cited.

headline: Dishwasher not sanitizing; tagged, do not use
summary: Low-temperature dishwasher read 0 ppm chlorine and was not sanitizing. Staff told not to use it until reinspected; unit tagged. Priority violation, no citation. Black buildup inside the ice machine also needs cleaning.

headline: Cluttered area around rear hand sink
summary: Passed. Clutter around the rear hand wash sink must be organized and maintained.

headline: Ice machine, microwave, and cooler need cleaning
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Ice machine interior has buildup, microwave interior needs detail cleaning, and walk-in cooler shelves have food spills. Knives must be stored in a clean, sanitized container, not between equipment. Faucet leaks at the three-compartment sink.

headline: Rusted racks; burnt-out prep lights
summary: Re-inspection passed. Chipped paint and rust on walk-in wire racks must be removed and repainted or replaced. Unused equipment in basement storage must be removed. Burnt-out bulbs in kitchen prep and dish area must be replaced.

headline: Mouse droppings found; pest control required
summary: Failed. About 33 mouse droppings found: 10 on a push cart, 15 on pot shelving, 8 on the floor near reach-in coolers. Must detail clean affected areas and call pest control. Priority citation issued. Dirty shelving and floors also noted.

headline: No manager certificate posted; cited
summary: Passed with conditions. No City food manager certificate posted on site; priority citation. Bar hand sink lacks handwashing signage. No allergen training certificates on site; certified managers must complete training and keep records on site.

headline: Washroom hot water too cool; failed
summary: Failed. Hot water at all three washroom sinks reached only 96.2 to 97.8°F and fluctuated; must reach at least 100°F (priority). Two holes in the hallway wall for electrical access must be sealed. Certified manager needs allergen training.

headline: Prep cooler food too warm; failed
summary: Failed. Roast beef 48°F, eggs 51°F, and cole slaw 49°F in prep cooler; about 10 lbs ($100) voluntarily discarded; no citation. Food stored on floors throughout; 1/4-inch gap under front door; missing and damaged floor tiles; sink plumbing leaks.

headline: Hand sink too cool; corrected on site
summary: Passed with conditions. Hand sink hot water measured 80°F; must be at least 100°F. Manager corrected it to 99°F during inspection; priority citation issued. Standing dirty water near sinks and soiled cardboard on deli shelves also noted.

headline: Unlabeled sugar; wiping cloths on prep
summary: Complaint passed. No air thermometer in 1-door reach-in cooler; one was provided during inspection. Bulk sugar container unlabeled; label provided during inspection. Wet wiping cloths and milk crates used as shelving were removed. Faucet leaks at three-compartment sink.

headline: Pest openings; ice bins lack lids
summary: Re-inspection passed. Opening at base of rear exit door must be sealed. Ice bins in the first-floor bar have no lids. Rust on basement shelving must be removed. Employee washroom needs a covered receptacle; floor under the sink must be repaired.

headline: Dirty ice machine; unlabeled salt; ceiling hole
summary: Passed. Ice machine bin and guard in rear prep are dirty and must be detail cleaned. Salt in an unlabeled plastic container on prep table must be labeled. Greasy cooking equipment and flour debris on floors. Ceiling hole above hot water tank must be sealed.

headline: Gap between front doors; rodent-proof
summary: Re-inspection passed. A 1/2-inch gap between the front entrance doors was found. Management told to rodent-proof all outer openings.

headline: Rear door gaps; repeat violations; failed
summary: Failed. 1/4-inch gaps on rear exit door must be sealed. Soda crates and pallets used as shelving. Core violations uncorrected from September 2025: no backflow device at utility mop sink; dust on washroom vents; damaged wall tiles; opening in prep wall; manager lacks allergen training (citation issued).

headline: Missing food handler certificates on site
summary: No food handler certificates were on site; proof must be kept there at all times. Also missing thermometers in cold-holding units, unlabeled containers, a cutting board stored on the floor, and a dirty floor by the refrigerator.

headline: Food manager's allergen certificate expired
summary: License passed. One food manager has an expired food allergen training certificate and must renew it.

headline: About 30 live flies; pest control needed; failed
summary: Failed. About 30 live small flies on walls, ceiling, and racks in an unused walk-in used for dry storage; priority citation; more pest control needed. Packaged desserts unlabeled. Torn gasket; no hair restraint; raw wood shelves; no self-closing washroom door.

headline: No certified manager while food prepared; cited
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed with conditions. No certified manager on duty while TCS foods such as hamburgers and tacos were prepared; priority citation. Food buckets on walk-in and freezer floors must be elevated. Wiping cloths and handles need fixing.

headline: Food and equipment stored in mechanical room
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Dry food and deep freezer stored in the mechanical room; must be moved. A food handler lacked a beard restraint. Pots not inverted during storage. Stained, grooved cutting boards must be replaced.

headline: Leaking sink base; splattered ceilings
summary: Passed. Leak at base of one-compartment sink in baking area must be repaired. Food splatter on ceiling coverings over the cafe food line must be cleaned or replaced. Floor under cafe equipment needs cleaning.

headline: No hand sink in prep area; failed
summary: Failed. No operable hand sink in the front service and prep area where meals are packaged and coffee made; must install a stocked sink with hot and cold water (priority citation). Hand sink handles in rear prep area must be repaired. Plates not inverted.

headline: Missing hand sink; prior violation uncorrected
summary: Failed. Front food prep area needs an additional hand sink, ordered after the April 2024 inspection and still not installed. Priority foundation violation for failure to correct.

headline: Cooking equipment and shelves need detail cleaning
summary: Passed. Grease and debris on cooking equipment and dry storage shelving must be detail cleaned. Wall base in poor repair throughout prep areas. Floors, floor drains, walls, and ceilings also need detail cleaning.

headline: Fail: slime in ice machine; no pest logbook
summary: Result: Fail. Pink and black slime dripping from rear ice machine onto ice used for consumption; citation issued. No current pest control logbook. No proof of food handler or allergen training. Stained cutting boards and greasy fryer compartment.

headline: Fail: missing thermometer; plastic wrap on sink
summary: Result: Fail. Reach-in cooler by grill missing internal thermometer. Plastic wrap holds prep sink drain in place. Loose drain plumbing, unsealed drive-thru sink, greasy cooler interior, and dirty floors. Outside trash lid open; citation issued.

headline: No manager while chicken served; broken doors
summary: Result: Pass with conditions. No valid City sanitation manager certificate on site while chicken was prepared and served; citation issued. Three-compartment sink faucet missing. Three broken Roosevelt entrance doors won't stay closed unless locked.

headline: Splash guard and sealing needed
summary: Result: Pass (license re-inspection). Install a splash guard on right side of bar handwashing sink. Raw wooden shelving at bar must be sealed. Openings and cracks around piping at mop sink must be sealed.

headline: Re-inspection: door gap; duct tape repairs
summary: Result: Pass (re-inspection). 1/4-inch gap at bottom of front entrance doors must be repaired to minimize pest entry. Duct tape repairs on cabinet doors must be replaced. Broken counter under coffee units. No food handler certificate provided.

headline: Food handler certificates not verified
summary: Result: Pass. Food handler certificates could not be located for all food employees; must provide and keep on site. No proof of allergen training for City food managers. Floors near grease trap and walk-in entry need cleaning.

headline: Fail: no paper towels; slime in ice maker
summary: Result: Fail. No paper towels at three handwashing sinks. Basement employee-restroom sinks at 84.1–87.0°F, below 100°F. Black slime in ice maker dripping into ice; ordered cleaned. Stained cutting boards and moldy caulking. Citations issued.

headline: Knife stored between cooler and prep table
summary: Result: Pass (short complaint). Knife stored between reach-in cooler and prep table; must wash, sanitize and store in clean container. Large can opener needs cleaning. Reach-in cooler interior has food spills.

headline: Sticky cabinets; dirty enclosed bins
summary: Result: Pass. Cabinets near hot holding units are sticky and need cleaning. Enclosed cafeteria bins have excess dried food debris and spills inside. Instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Fail: over 60 rat droppings in basement
summary: Result: Fail. Over 60 rat droppings on basement floor and along walls; manager must call an exterminator and clean. Gaps in basement walls and under overhead door. Fly strip above prep table; ice scoop handle inside ice. Citation issued.

headline: Re-inspection: clutter removal and cleaning
summary: Result: Pass (re-inspection). Clean bottom prep shelf, and clean floors and walls under sink and behind bar. Remove clutter from basement storage to eliminate pest hiding spots. One food handler lacked training certificate.

headline: Tableware not inverted; debris on floors
summary: Result: Pass. Preset tableware not inverted; manager told to invert. Unisex washroom near kitchen has no covered receptacle. Debris on floors under equipment, along walls and in corners of prep and storage areas.

headline: Plates not inverted; leaking drain pipe
summary: Result: Pass (short complaint). Plates were not inverted after sanitizing and air drying. Drain pipe leaking under 3-compartment sink in prep area. Instructed to repair.

headline: Ice buildup in ice cream freezers
summary: Result: Pass. Ice buildup noted inside ice cream display freezers. Instructed to defrost, clean and maintain.

headline: Re-inspection: slow drain, storage and ceiling
summary: Result: Pass (re-inspection). Slow-draining men's restroom handsink needs repair. Items stored on floor in rear storage must be kept six inches up. Ceiling near vent has water damage and peeling; must repair.

headline: Hot dogs at 80°F; prep cooler too warm
summary: Result: Pass with conditions. Hot dogs at 80°F in prep cooler; other cold items at 44–80°F. Prep cooler air at 81°F. About 15 lbs discarded ($125). Citation issued. Heavy grease buildup on outside oil container.

headline: Napkins under handwashing sink; urinal broken
summary: Result: Pass. Napkins and to-go boxes stored under front handwashing sink were relocated. Cardboard shelf liner and milk crate used for storage. Men's urinal and toilet not working. Employee belongings on prep table were hung up on site.

headline: Greasy fryer; low hot water pressure
summary: Result: Pass (complaint). Fryer interior has grease buildup. Hot water pressure at 3-compartment sink is low. Floors under sinks and coolers have food and debris. Water-stained ceiling tiles. Restroom ventilation not working.

headline: Fail: mouse droppings found throughout
summary: Result: Fail (re-inspection). Over 50 mouse droppings found throughout, including rear prep area and basement. Pest control recommended. Also an opening at entrance door, food buildup, dirty floors and walls, greasy hood filters, and two expired food handler certificates.

headline: Dishroom dirt and missing cooler compressor cover
summary: Result: Pass. Reach-in coolers in rear prep and dishroom are missing compressor covers. Dishroom floors, walls and ceiling tiles have excess food debris and dust. Reach-in coolers are encrusted with food debris. Dishroom vent dusty.

headline: Fail: no manager; flies and rat droppings
summary: Result: Fail. No certified manager while TCS foods were prepared; manager arrived at 10:27 a.m. Hot and cold holding units out of range; about 69 and 41 lbs discarded. About 40 small flies, 10 large flies, one live roach, dead mouse and 100+ rat droppings. Citation issued.

headline: Floors need cleaning; new staff lack training
summary: Result: Pass. Floors under and around kitchen equipment need cleaning. Food handlers must obtain required food handler training; employees on site said they were new.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; utensils misplaced
summary: Result: Pass. Front handwashing sink lacked signage. Handwashing aids placed on non-handwashing sink. Knives stored between cooler and countertop; plastic to-go containers on floor. Thin plastic strainer and dirty microwave.

headline: No written procedure for large equipment
summary: Result: Pass. No written procedure for washing, rinsing and sanitizing large equipment, such as the large dough mixer. Management instructed to provide one.

headline: Missing bathroom lids; floor and wall openings
summary: Result: Pass (complaint). Bathroom garbage cans missing lids. Storage area floors and corners need cleaning. Stock must be raised six inches off floor. Openings along wall base in waiting area must be sealed to block pest entry.

headline: Fail: missing certificates, logbook and supplies
summary: Result: Fail. No original City manager certificate, allergen training, pest control logbook, sanitizer test strips or metal stem thermometer. No handwashing signs or paper towels at kitchen sink. Uncovered washroom receptacles. No verifiable dumpster service.

headline: Warewashing machine tagged; hand-wash instead
summary: Result: Pass with conditions. Warewashing machine lacks temperature gauges and a way to verify detergent and sanitizer dispensing. Machine tagged and held. All utensil washing must be done in the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: Result: Pass. Food service sanitation manager did not have a food allergen training certificate. Instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: Fail: small flies; expired food handler certificate
summary: Result: Fail. About 20 small live flies in washroom; pest control recommended. Metal stem thermometer not working. Only an expired food handler certificate provided. Opening at base of front entrance door. Citation issued.

headline: Complaint pass: front door not rodent-proofed
summary: Result: Pass (complaint). Front door is not rodent-proofed; must correct. Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizing solution. Large can opener and cooking equipment need cleaning; floors under front bar need cleaning.

headline: Pork and rice too warm in prep cooler
summary: Result: Pass with conditions. Pork at 48.2–53.5°F and cooked rice at 46.4–50.9°F in front prep cooler; cold food must stay at 41°F or below. Manager discarded about 40 lbs ($200). Citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; no health policy copies
summary: Result: Pass with conditions. No person in charge with valid certificate and no certified manager while chicken, hamburgers and fries were handled; citations issued. No employee health policy on site and no food handler certificates. Ice bin needs cleaning.

headline: Storage and utensil handling corrections needed
summary: Result: Pass. Food storage containers must be labeled when food is not in original packaging. Wiping cloths on front prep tables must be kept in sanitizing solution. Ice scoops stored on top of ice machine must go in a clean container.

headline: Cold food held too warm; no cleanup kit
summary: Result: Pass with conditions. Milk at 75.4°F and whipped cream at 75.8°F in front prep cooler; 16 lbs discarded. Two-door prep cooler at 75.5°F tagged out of use. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site. Citations issued.

headline: Re-inspection: clean dish machine and microwave
summary: Result: Pass (re-inspection). Clean top of dish machine and interior of microwave. Clean food debris on wall above 3-compartment sink in food prep area.

headline: Fail: flying insects; no certified manager
summary: Result: Fail. Numerous flying insects in prep, serving and dishwashing areas; exterminator required. No valid certified manager or person in charge. Prep sinks had 68.7°F water and serving sink lacked soap. Overflowing dumpsters. Citations issued.

headline: Greasy cook line; staff lack food handler training
summary: Result: Pass. Grease and food debris on floors along cook line. One hood light bulb missing. Multiple food employees lack current food handler training, and one certified manager lacks current allergen training. Records must be kept on site.

headline: Fail: no manager certificate; 1,600 lbs discarded
summary: Result: Fail. No valid City sanitation manager certificate while chicken was prepared and served; citation issued. Chicken wings at 47–73.4°F in coolers; about 1,600 lbs discarded. Prior core violations uncorrected, including no running water at one handwashing sink.

headline: Complaint pass: unlabeled spices; grease debris
summary: Result: Pass (complaint). Spices kept out of original packaging by wok station must be labeled. Food and grease debris in prep cooler, under wok station and 3-compartment sink. Dirt under dry storage shelves. Instructed to clean and sanitize.

headline: No certified manager while serving chicken
summary: Result: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager on site and no certificate posted while chicken and hot dogs were handled and served. Management instructed to obtain one. Citation for foundation violation noted.

headline: Fail: juice machine debris; cold food too warm
summary: Result: Fail (complaint). Heavy food debris inside juice machine. Food held at 45–48°F; 9 lbs pico de gallo and 8 hard-boiled eggs discarded. Produce prep room air at 45°F. Citations issued; manager placed cooler work order.

headline: Greasy surfaces; cracked storage lid
summary: Result: Pass (complaint). Cracked lid on rice storage container. Grease and food debris on containers, shelves, soda drip tray and prep tables. Grout missing in front of fryers; items on electrical closet floor; burnt-out chicken hot-holding light.

headline: Fail: repeat core violations uncorrected
summary: Result: Fail. Violations from prior report not corrected: no backflow device at coffee machine water lines, and worn grout on prep floors. Also raw wood door frame and water-stained ceiling tiles. Must correct by report date. Citation issued.

headline: Re-inspection: mold, damage and clutter
summary: Result: Pass (complaint re-inspection). Worn gaskets on protein prep cooler and missing sink stoppers. Damaged ceiling above condiment station and mold in basement and beer cooler ceilings. Items on basement floor. Cracked light shield; food manager training missing.

headline: Cold food too warm; food discarded
summary: Result: Pass with conditions. Shrimp at 48.9°F, chicken at 50.1°F and pasta at up to 48.1°F in prep cooler; must stay below 41°F. About $80 of food discarded. Citation issued. Also dirty cooler interiors and leaky dish machine drain.

headline: Pork, chorizo and salsa too warm in coolers
summary: Result: Pass with conditions. Pork at 70°F, chorizo at 69°F and salsa at 53°F in prep coolers; cold food must stay at 41°F or below. Citation issued. No working thermometer in 4-drawer cooler. Food handler lacked certificate.

headline: Pizza boxes on floor; dusty vents
summary: Result: Pass (re-inspection). Pizza boxes stored on prep area floor; manager told to raise six inches. Dust buildup on ceiling vents and tiles in prep area. Instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: No manager on arrival; hot water too cool
summary: Result: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager on site when inspection began; manager arrived about 30 minutes later. Hot water reached only 88°F; restored before inspection ended. Cardboard used as basement shelving. Citation issued.

headline: Crackers stored on serving-area floor
summary: Result: Pass. Box of crackers stored on floor in serving area. Manager instructed to raise all food items six inches off the floor.

headline: No certified food manager during food prep
summary: Result: Pass with conditions. No City-certified food manager (CFM) was present while cut melons, smoothies and protein shakes were prepared and served. Citation issued. Handwashing sink in prep area drains slowly.

headline: No certified manager; hair restraints missing
summary: Result: Pass with conditions. Person in charge and staff lacked Chicago certified food manager certificate while chicken, beef and fish were prepared; citation issued. Prep staff lacked hair restraints. Wiping cloths and ice scoops improperly stored. Dirty floor drains.

headline: Fail: no valid manager certificate on site
summary: Result: Fail. Person in charge had no City sanitation certificate, and none was posted or shown for the manager on duty. Ice machine interior had black and pink slime dripping into ice; ordered cleaned. No allergen training certificates provided.

headline: Fail: ice machine debris; overflowing dumpster
summary: Result: Fail (complaint). Debris encrusted inside ice maker; ice scoop stored on ice. Unlabeled desserts. Dumpster overflowing and lids cannot close, risking rodent harborage. Food debris and spills on floors. Missing hood filters. Citation issued.

headline: Complaint pass: hole in cooler floor
summary: Result: Pass. 5-inch hole in bottom corner of walk-in cooler floor must be repaired. Interiors of reach-in coolers, freezer and walk-in cooler need detail cleaning. Burned-out bulb in hood system.

headline: Ice machine needs cleaning; oil area greasy
summary: Result: Pass (complaint). Ice machine interior needs cleaning to remove buildup. Wiping cloths must be kept in sanitizing solution. Dark cutting boards need replacing. Oil storage area needs grease cleanup. Restroom needs covered receptacle.

headline: Handwashing sinks blocked or missing paper towels
summary: Result: Pass with conditions. Kitchen handwashing sink had no paper towels. Prep kitchen handwashing sink was blocked by utensils, knives and cutting boards; manager told to keep it clear. Three-compartment sink lacks drainboards.

headline: Openings, no backflow device, leaks
summary: Result: Pass (license re-inspection). Openings in drive-thru and rear exit doors must be sealed. No backflow device found on ice machine. Utility sink has no hot or cold water pressure. Leaks at 3-compartment sink. Missing grease traps and vent cover.

headline: Complaint pass: containers not inverted
summary: Result: Pass (complaint). Food containers not stored inverted. Food splatter above juice machine and dirty basement floors need cleaning.

headline: Missing backflow device; leaking water line
summary: Result: Pass. Rear prep handsink splashes water on floor. No visible backflow device on ice machine. Leaking water line under 3-compartment sink; toilet lid missing. Damaged wall tiles and peeling paint. No food handler training for employees.

headline: Damaged cooler wall bases need repair
summary: Result: Pass (complaint re-inspection). Damaged wall bases on the outside of the beer walk-in cooler and inside the food walk-in cooler must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Two ovens not under exhaust hood
summary: Result: Pass (re-inspection). An electric oven on the lower level and an electric bread oven on the first floor are not under an exhaust hood. Must move them under a hood or notify the Department of Buildings for approval.

headline: No valid manager certificate posted
summary: Result: Pass with conditions. No valid City food sanitation or foodservice manager certificate was posted on site or shown. Instructed to obtain one. Citation issued for foundation violation 7-38-012.

headline: Food in grocery bags; grease and floor damage
summary: Result: Pass. Food stored in grocery bags in coolers and freezers; must use food-grade containers. Grease buildup, dirty microwave, rusted racks, milk crates used as shelves, broken floor and missing ceiling tiles. Two hood lights out.

headline: Fail: no employee health policy on site
summary: Result: Fail. No signed employee health policy on site. No metal stem thermometer for cold food. Slushie machine and warmers had no warewashing facilities on site. Equipment must be removed or proper washing added. Citations issued.

headline: Knife rack beside handwashing sink
summary: Result: Pass (short complaint). Knife rack beside bakery handwashing sink needs splash guard or relocation. Basement utility sink cracked and missing backflow cover. Deli sink hot water faucet hard to turn off; must repair.

headline: Cooler at 70.5°F tagged; backflow device missing
summary: Result: Pass with conditions. Rear prep cooler at 70.5°F with no food inside; tagged and not to be used until repaired. Backflow device missing at ice maker. Leak under front 3-compartment sink. Unlabeled bulk containers and stained cutting boards.

headline: Fail: overflowing dumpsters; damaged floors
summary: Result: Fail (short complaint). Outside dumpsters overflowing with trash and loose lids; priority violation. Missing handwashing signs; damaged baseboards and floor tiles. Hood has severe dust and charcoal buildup. Prior core violations uncorrected.

headline: Fail: fruit flies; dumpster open and overflowing
summary: Result: Fail (complaint). About 20–25 fruit flies in rear prep and storage; 10–12 flies in washroom near cleaning tools. Manager told to detail clean and call pest control. Dumpster and grease container open and overflowing. Citation issued.

headline: Employees eating and drinking at prep area
summary: Result: Pass. Employees drinking and eating in kitchen prep area; management must provide a designated break area. Water dripping from heating unit has created a mold-like substance on wall; must repair and clean.

headline: Dish machine out of order and tagged
summary: Result: Pass with conditions. Low-temperature dish machine was out of order and tagged; facility is awaiting replacement and has other sufficient warewashing equipment. Insect control device placed above open food prep; must be relocated. Sinks not sealed to walls.

headline: Fail: no sushi rice test method on site
summary: Result: Fail (re-inspection). No lab letter or pH meter on site to test sushi rice. No sanitizer test devices. Citation issued. Debris on floors in dish and storage areas; no allergen training on site.

headline: Missing thermometer; door gap
summary: Result: Pass. No thermometer in small refrigeration unit in kitchen prep area. Rear exit door has about a 1/4-inch gap at bottom that must be sealed. Greasy floors, microwave and stove need cleaning. Two kitchen exhaust filters missing.

headline: Handwashing sink blocked; chips on floor
summary: Result: Pass with conditions. Dish area handwashing sink was blocked by a bowl of vegetables; employee removed it during inspection. Chip boxes on floor, bread knives in sanitizer water, missing floor tiles and poor cooler lighting. Citation issued.

headline: Fail-level: cheese, lettuce and walk-in too warm
summary: Result: Pass with conditions. Cheese at 45°F and romaine at 47°F; walk-in cooler air at 49°F. Cold food must stay at 41°F or below. About 10 lbs of food discarded voluntarily ($20). Citation issued.

headline: Stained cutting boards; plumbing leaks
summary: Result: Pass. Stained, worn cutting boards in basement produce prep room. Excess dust on walk-in cooler fans and condensers. Water leaks at 3-compartment sink faucet and at hand sink drain pipe. Ceiling vents need dust removal.

headline: Slow drain at kitchen handsink
summary: Result: Pass. Slow drain at kitchen handwashing sink. Instructed to repair and maintain.

headline: No certified manager during food service
summary: Result: Pass with conditions. No person in charge present at inspection. No certified food manager with certificate on duty while rice and chicken soup were prepared and served. Food stored on walk-in floor; leaking faucet; expired allergen certificates.

headline: Fail: small flies found throughout facility
summary: Result: Fail. Over 40 small flies found on walls and ceilings, including washrooms, bars and basement storage near the ice machine; pest control recommended. Handwashing sink water was too cool but was repaired on site. Entry doors have gaps.

headline: Cutting board grooved; leaking sink faucet
summary: Result: Pass. Cutting board by pizza ovens has deep grooves and stains. Walk-in cooler storage racks have food and dirt. Leaking 3-compartment sink faucet, broken floor and wall tiles, and an open-top trash can in restroom.

headline: Fail: rat droppings; no health policy
summary: Result: Fail. Over 15 rat droppings at rear prep area. No employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea plan or kit, or allergen certificates. Missing handwashing sink in front and rear prep areas. Middle sink not draining; broken floor tiles.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; food on floor
summary: Result: Pass (complaint). No handwashing signs at front bar or rear prep sinks. Food containers on basement walk-in cooler floor must be raised. Wiping cloths stored in water; scoops in flour; rust and broken cooler gasket.

headline: Re-inspection: litter, drains and allergen training
summary: Result: Pass (complaint re-inspection). Litter and garbage around dumpsters in trash corral. Build-up in bar and kitchen floor drains. No allergen training for certified manager on site; must obtain and keep certificate on site.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure; general upkeep issues
summary: Result: Pass with conditions. No written procedure or supplies for vomit and diarrhea cleanup. Also raw wood brackets and wall need sealing, milk crates used as shelving, dusty vent, peeling paint and missing ceiling tiles.

headline: Re-inspection: no certified manager while serving
summary: Result: Pass with conditions. Person in charge lacked valid certificate; no certified food manager on site while food was prepared and served. Citation issued. Dirty soda ice shoot; leaks under 3-compartment and rear prep sinks; cracked stair tiles.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; unit tagged
summary: Result: Pass with conditions (complaint). Low-temperature dish machine measured 0 ppm chlorine sanitizer; minimum is 50 ppm. Unit tagged. Staff must wash, rinse and sanitize in the three-compartment sink until reinspected. Citation issued.

headline: Fail: no vomit procedure or pest contract
summary: Result: Fail. No written vomit and diarrhea procedure or cleanup supplies. No proof of pest control contract or trash service on site. Coolers lacked thermometers; no mop sink; washroom sink lacked signage, soap and towels.

headline: Re-inspection: cooling units and hood cleaning
summary: Result: Pass (re-inspection). Cooling units on first floor prep need food residue removed. Leak from pipe under basement prep handsink. Hood vents on first floor and basement need grease and dust removed. One of four manager certificate holders had allergen training.

headline: Re-inspection: no allergen training certificates
summary: Result: Pass (re-inspection). No food allergen training certificates on premises. All City certified food managers must have a food allergen training certificate.

headline: Re-inspection: greasy deep fryers
summary: Result: Pass (re-inspection). Interior of deep fryers has encrusted grease. Must clean.

headline: Plastic cooler liners; stained cutting boards
summary: Result: Pass. Plastic lining inside cooler doors in main prep area must be removed so surfaces are smooth and cleanable. Heavily stained and grooved cutting boards must be replaced.

headline: No hot water; debris under equipment
summary: Result: Pass with conditions. No hot water throughout facility: handwashing sinks at 79°F and 3-compartment sinks at 97°F. Manager restored hot water before inspection ended. Citation issued. Debris under kitchen equipment must be cleaned.

headline: Re-inspection: spices need labels
summary: Result: Pass (re-inspection). Spices kept out of original packaging in the food prep area must be labeled.

headline: Leaking 3-compartment sink faucet
summary: Result: Pass. Leak at 3-compartment sink faucet. Instructed to repair and maintain.

headline: Fail: eggs and chicken too warm in cooler
summary: Result: Fail. Eggs at 46°F and chicken at 47°F in the 2-door prep cooler; cold food must stay at 41°F or below. Citation issued. Also expired food handler certificate, reused foil trays, torn gasket and uncorrected prior violations.

headline: Walk-in cooler floor needs repair
summary: Result: Pass. Walk-in cooler floor must be repaired so it is smooth and easily cleanable.

headline: Calcium buildup inside ice machine
summary: Result: Pass. Calcium buildup on interior of ice machine. Instructed manager to clean.

headline: Fail: no paper towels, dishwasher not sanitizing
summary: Result: Fail. Paper towels were missing at a rear handwashing sink; management supplied them during inspection. High-temperature dishwasher not reaching 180°F; tagged out of use until repaired and rechecked. Also leaking faucet and missing ceiling tiles.

headline: Cardboard shelf liners; slow hand sink
summary: Result: Pass. Cardboard lines shelves in walk-in cooler and bar holding containers; manager told to use smooth, non-absorbent material. Hand sink near reach-in freezer in front grill area drains slowly; manager told to repair.

headline: Re-inspection: door gaps and debris buildup
summary: Result: Pass with conditions. Gaps at double entry doors and exit door must be closed for tight fit. Internal thermometers needed for both hot holding units. Debris and ice buildup in coolers, walls and floors; clean hood filters.

headline: Food handler without certificate; fountain needs cleaning
summary: Result: Pass. A food handler had no food handler certificate; manager must show proof of training for all food handlers. Buildup found inside fountain drink nozzles and drain; instructed to detail clean.

headline: Missing spill kit; loose faucet; no backflow device
summary: No kit or procedure for vomiting and diarrhea cleanups; must provide. Loose faucet handle at hand sink must be repaired. No backflow prevention device at mop sink faucet; must provide and keep serviceable.

headline: No certified manager; three-compartment sink leaks
summary: No valid City of Chicago certified manager was on duty while chicken and ground beef were prepared and served. The person in charge lacks a city sanitation certificate. Multiple leaks at the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Floor cleaning is needed along the walls.

headline: Drain line; grout missing from floor tiles
summary: A drain line from the fountain nozzle holder drains into the bar handwashing sink and must be moved to a floor drain. Missing grout between floor tiles in dish and prep areas must be fixed for cleanability.

headline: Unlabeled seasonings; grease and mop heads need attention
summary: Seasonings were stored out of original containers without product-name labels. Restrooms lacked covered waste receptacles. Grease was on the dumpster-area floor. Soiled mop heads must be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Litter on sales floor
summary: Litter was on the sales floor in corners near the machines. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Patio cooler needs lock; rusted basement shelves
summary: A storage cooler on the patio must have a lock to prevent non-employee contamination. Rusted shelving in the basement walk-in cooler must be repainted or replaced.

headline: No food handler certificates; cardboard shelf liners
summary: No food handler certificates were on site, and all employees must complete training. Cardboard was used as shelf liner in coolers. Unused equipment in rear storage must be removed. A dairy walk-in cooler door gasket is torn.

headline: No health policy; backflow and leak issues
summary: No written employee health policy was on premises. A backflow device is missing at the mop sink. A drain pipe under the three-compartment sink leaks. Stained cutting boards and unused equipment must be removed. Dusty vent covers in washrooms need cleaning.

headline: Handwash sink water too hot; dish machine leaks
summary: A front service area handwashing sink could not keep water below 130°F. Water must be between 100°F and 120°F; citation issued. Dish machine greywater discharges onto the warewashing floor and pools. Heavy grease is along the hood fire suppression lines.

headline: Gaps under doors; sprayer and grease trap leak
summary: Gaps at the bottom of the front and rear doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. The three-compartment sink sprayer is in poor repair. A leak is around the grease trap and must be repaired.

headline: No soap at handwash sink; corrected on site
summary: A handwashing soap dispenser was not dispensing soap. Staff replaced its batteries, and soap was provided before the inspection ended, so this was corrected on site. Citation issued. Also a leaking three-compartment sink faucet and grease buildup.

headline: Live roaches found; no certified manager on duty
summary: 10 live roaches and several dead ones were found in walls and storage areas. No certified food manager was on duty while food was served. Hot food was too cool. About 43 pounds of cold food was discarded. Hot water at a toilet sink was 58.5°F.

headline: Dish machine repaired during inspection; no citation
summary: The low-temperature dish machine was not sanitizing at the required 100 parts per million chlorine. It was not in use and was repaired during the inspection, so no citation was issued. Dirty walk-in and liquor room ceilings and dirty floor mats behind the second bar.

headline: Leaking pipe; dirty floors under cooking equipment
summary: A leaky pipe is under the front handwashing sink and must be repaired. Floors under and behind cooking equipment need detail cleaning for spills, debris, and grease. The floor drain under the three-compartment sink also needs cleaning.

headline: Knives wedged between coolers; dusty fan covers
summary: Knives in use were wedged between two coolers and must be kept on a clean surface. Disposable cups were used as scoops and must be replaced with proper utensils. Dusty walk-in cooler fan covers must be cleaned.

headline: Expired fried eggs and hash browns; discarded
summary: Fried eggs and hash browns past their use-by dates were still being used in the refrigerator. The manager discarded them. Citation issued. A half-gallon of milk was on the walk-in cooler floor. Food handler certificates were not on site.

headline: Torn cooler door gasket
summary: A torn door gasket on the upright two-door cooler next to the steam table must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Person in charge lacked valid food manager certificate
summary: The person in charge did not have a valid City of Chicago food sanitation manager certificate. Staff placed an insect control device, which only pest control may do. The ice machine air gap is inadequate. Walls, floors, and tiles need repair and cleaning. Standing water is under a sink.

headline: No certified manager during cheese and sausage prep
summary: No person in charge or certified food manager was on site while cheese and sausage were prepared and served. Citation issued. Two employees made pizzas without hair restraints. Torn baseboards need sealing and repair.

headline: Food residue on floor by hot water tanks
summary: Excessive residue and food debris are on the floor in the cabinet where hot water tanks are located. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Employee served food after coughing, without washing hands
summary: An employee coughed on their hands, then picked up plated food to serve a customer without washing or gloves. Citation issued. Several cold foods were held too warm, including kimchi at 82.4°F; 17 pounds discarded. Several dead roaches were found on the basement floor.

headline: Missing restroom handwashing signs; buckets in sink
summary: Restrooms lack handwashing signs and must have them posted. Three plastic buckets were placed in the three-compartment sink and must be removed so the sink can be used.

headline: No certified manager for two hours; no kit
summary: No certified food manager was on site at the 8:20 AM start; one arrived at 9:58 AM. Citation issued. No vomiting and diarrhea cleanup kit was on site. Cardboard lined the prep cooler shelves. The dumpster was overloaded and could not close.

headline: Torn freezer gaskets; food splatter on walls
summary: Torn gaskets are at the bottom of a two-door savory freezer in the rear storage area and must be repaired. Red food splatter is on the walls near the two-door oven and must be cleaned.

headline: Raw chicken held at 53°F in standing water
summary: Raw chicken was held at 53°F inside a walk-in cooler, in a bucket of standing water. About 10 pounds, worth $100, was discarded. Citation issued. Proof of food handler training certificates is still missing from a prior inspection; citation issued.

headline: Failed: no soap or towels; expired food handler cards
summary: No soap or paper towels at handwashing sinks while food was prepared; citation issued. Sticky fly traps and a 1/4-inch gap at the rear door. Previous core violations not corrected: food handler certificates were expired and no allergen training was on record for the certified manager.

headline: No food handler certificates; no sanitizer test kit
summary: Employees working on site had no City of Chicago food sanitation certificate. A certified manager must be on premises whenever food is prepared or served. Citation issued. No quaternary sanitizer test kit was available. Citation issued.

headline: Roach and rat infestation; no certified manager
summary: About 50 or more live roaches, about 60 rat droppings, and small flies were found, mostly in the basement. No certified food manager was on site. Dishwasher sanitizer measured 0 parts per million and was tagged out. Handwashing sinks lacked towels and soap.

headline: Failed: food too warm; ice machine slime
summary: Several cold foods were held above 41°F and discarded. Mussel shellfish tags were missing and discarded by the manager. Black and pink slime built up inside the ice machine and dripped onto ice. Citations issued. Dumpster was overloaded.

headline: Missing allergen training; spills under cabinets
summary: Certified manager on duty had no allergen training. Single-service containers were not inverted. Ice buildup is in the walk-in freezer. Spills and debris are under the beverage area cabinets and holding units. A women's washroom toilet tank cover is missing.

headline: No verified health policy; hot water too cool
summary: No verified written employee health policy is on site. Blank, unsigned policies were provided. Hot water in the women's washroom reached only 79.5°F; 100°F is required at all handwashing sinks. Citation issued. Cold foods at 47–55°F in the front cooler were discarded.

headline: Leaking sink and gaps in front door
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the front entrance door must be sealed to prevent pests. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks. The staff washroom lacks a handwashing sign. Certified managers have no valid allergen training.

headline: Failed: no bar handwashing sink; thermometer missing
summary: The bar area with the three-compartment sink has no handwashing sink and one must be installed; priority violation. The dessert refrigerator needs an ambient air thermometer. The women's restroom lacks a covered waste receptacle.

headline: Rear kitchen door not fully rodent-proof
summary: The rear kitchen exit door must be fully rodent-proofed by sealing a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom. A torn gasket on a bar cooler door must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Failed: no proper three-compartment dish sink
summary: No three-compartment sink for manual dishwashing was on site, and a low-temperature dish machine was too small. Priority citation issued. Also: holes in furnace closet walls, detached basement cooler wall panels, rusted shelves, and untreated bar wood.

headline: Wall hole and dusty hood filter noted
summary: A small hole in the furnace room wall must be sealed to prevent possible pest entry. The filter above cooking equipment must be cleaned of dust and debris.

headline: Loose fly strip; wiping cloths not stored properly
summary: A fly strip hung above the three-compartment sink must be removed and not hung in food prep areas. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer. A prep cooler door is off its hinge, fryers are greasy, and the three-compartment sink water runs when turned off.

headline: No certified manager; no spill kit or health policy
summary: No City of Chicago certified person was on site during ice cream preparation; citation issued. No employee health policies, no vomiting and diarrhea spill kit, and no current pest logbook. Previous violations were not corrected, including unlabeled bulk containers and a leak under a prep sink.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: The sanitation manager has no allergen training on record. The business must provide it.

headline: Failed: slime in ice machine; bulk containers unlabeled
summary: Black slime on the ice machine water parts dripped into ice used by customers. Staff must turn off the machine, remove ice, and clean it. Citation issued. Bulk containers in the rear were unlabeled, and walk-in cooler racks are rusted.

headline: Non-draining mop sink; dusty ceiling; leaking fan
summary: A mop sink in second-floor dry storage does not drain. Several ceiling tiles are dusty, stained, or missing. A walk-in cooler condenser fan leaks. Floor drains need cleaning and some vent covers are dusty.

headline: Unlabeled containers; food on floor; uncovered food
summary: Food items were stored in unlabeled containers and must have common-name labels. Containers were stored on the floor and must be raised six inches. Scoops were stored in food containers. Food was kept in plastic grocery bags. Ceiling tiles have grease and debris.

headline: Torn refrigeration door gasket
summary: A torn rubber gasket on a refrigeration unit door must be repaired.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; cooler not working
summary: Washrooms lack handwashing signs. The front line cooler needs a working thermometer. Mechanical refrigeration in both unisex washrooms is not working. Also: dirty milk cooler interior, dirty floors, cluttered storage, and a manager without allergen training.

headline: Failed: dish machine too cool; mold on ice machine
summary: High-temperature dish machine final rinse was 154°F; it must reach 180°F. Machine was tagged out. Black mold-like substance is on the ice machine surface used for ice. Frozen shrimp, chicken, and other items were stored on the walk-in freezer floor.

headline: Minor backup at three-compartment sink
summary: Water backs up slightly into another compartment when one is drained. The business was instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: Failed: overflowing dumpsters; wet wiping cloths
summary: Outside dumpsters overflowed with garbage on the ground, a food source for rodents and pests; citation issued. Wet wiping cloths were on prep surfaces. Damaged gaskets, rusty prep table bottoms, and leaking three-compartment sink faucets. No allergen training proof for the manager.

headline: 40+ mouse droppings found; citation issued
summary: About 40 or more mouse droppings were found throughout the facility, including in the toilet room, behind the refrigerator, near cooking equipment, and in the dining area. Citation issued. Spices were uncovered. The manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; unlabeled sugar
summary: Handwashing signs are missing at kitchen and basement sinks. Bulk sugar containers are not labeled. A 1/4-inch gap at a pickup window must be sealed. A first-floor men's restroom faucet needs repair. Second-floor storage clutter must be removed.

headline: Failed: no hot water; cold food too warm
summary: Hot water in the toilet room sink reached only 77°F; a technician restored hot water during the inspection. Cold foods at 46–47°F were discarded, including 15 pounds of beef. Citation issued. The three-compartment sink floods when drained.

headline: Dirt in sushi area corners
summary: Dirt residue has built up in the corners of the sushi area. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Not ready: no pest service, no certified manager
summary: The business has no licensed pest control operator and a pest logbook is required. No valid certified manager certificate was posted. No employee health policy was on site. Missing raw-food consumer advisory. Rusted and moldy cooler racks; the dish machine lacks test strips.

headline: No towels at sink; PIC supplied them during inspection
summary: No disposable paper towels were available at the rear warewashing handwashing sink. The person in charge provided them during the inspection. Citation issued. The outdoor waste receptacle lid is cracked and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Greasy fryers and floors under cooking equipment
summary: The exterior of the fryers needs cleaning to remove grease. Floors under cooking equipment and walls around it need cleaning.

headline: 75+ live flies, roaches found; citations issued
summary: 75 or more live flies and five large live roaches were found in prep, bar, and dish areas. No certified food manager was on site. Four dish machines sanitized at 0 parts per million and were tagged. About 300 pounds of vacuum-packed food lacked an approved plan and was discarded.

headline: Failed: no handwash supplies; sanitizer at zero
summary: Handwashing sinks had a bucket blocking one prep-area sink, and lacked soap and paper towels. Men's room sinks had water at 68–70.5°F. The bar dish machine sanitized at 0 parts per million and was tagged. Cold foods at 50.2°F were discarded. Citations issued.

headline: Missing cold-holding thermometers; allergen training gap
summary: Several cold-holding units lacked internal air thermometers; each must have one that is visible. A City of Chicago certified food manager had no allergen awareness training or certificate on site.

headline: Ice buildup on cooler; cluttered basement
summary: Ice buildup is on the back of the walk-in cooler condenser and must be removed. The basement floor along the east wall is cluttered and must be cleared. A prior violation was not corrected: an employee handled food without a hair restraint.

headline: No certified manager; no food handler certificates
summary: No certified food manager with a valid certificate was on site while open; citation issued. Doors were open and need to be closed for rodent proofing. The front ventilation hood was not working, causing smoke and fumes. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Failed: porta-potties lack handwashing; wall gaps
summary: Several portable toilets outside the women's washroom have no handwashing facilities. The women's washroom is locked because of plumbing issues. Priority violation. Gaps are in wall panels next to the deep fryer, and spider webs are on the ceiling above food equipment.

headline: No certified manager on duty; no pest log
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while cold and hot foods were prepared. No vomiting and diarrhea cleanup kit was on site. Ready-to-eat foods in a cooler were not date marked. No pest control logbook was available. Food handler certificates were missing.

headline: Deli cups not air dried; disposable cups used as scoop
summary: Deli cups were not air dried after washing, and cloth towels were used in drying. Disposable cups were being used as a food scoop. The business was instructed to air dry utensils and use proper scoops.

headline: Unlabeled bulk beans and rice
summary: Bulk containers of beans and rice were not labeled. The business was instructed to label them.

headline: Manager lacks food sanitation certificate; citation issued
summary: The person in charge has no certified food manager certificate and must provide one. Citation issued. Also: grease in the deep fryer, dirty floors under cooking equipment, and an unshielded kitchen light.

headline: Missing food handler training; dirty premises
summary: Food handler training certificates were missing and must be kept on site. Allergen training proof was also not available. Equipment has food splatter, grease and debris. Cleaning was ordered to prevent pest food sources and hiding places.

headline: Leaking handwashing sink; dirty cook area
summary: A handwashing sink next to the stove leaks from its bottom drain pipe and must be repaired. The cook area behind the line needs detail cleaning. Hood filters need cleaning of dust buildup.

headline: About 20 live flies; no certified manager on site
summary: About 20 small and large live black flies were found throughout prep, cashier, storage, and walk-in cooler areas. No certified food manager was on site while food was served. Prep sinks lacked hand soap and towels. Citations issued.

headline: Cardboard liner; leaky ceiling; high-pressure faucet
summary: Cardboard lines shelves in the two-door walk-in cooler and must be replaced with a smooth, cleanable surface. The three-compartment sink faucet shoots water at high pressure and needs repair. Water leaks from the basement dry storage ceiling.

headline: Unlabeled containers; dried food debris throughout
summary: Bulk storage containers in the basement prep area are unlabeled and need common-name labels. Dried food debris is on prep tables, heavy equipment, blenders, and a basement ledge. Floors throughout prep and storage areas need debris removed.

headline: Slow-draining sinks; damaged ceiling panels
summary: Handwashing sinks in the rear warewashing and prep area drain slowly. Rusted storage racks are in a reach-in cooler. Several ceiling panels are damaged. The person in charge was instructed to repair and maintain.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ice cream cone; citation
summary: An employee touched an ice cream cone with a bare hand and was about to hand it to a customer. About one pound, worth $3, was discarded. Citation issued. Another food handler had no hair restraint. Floors need cleaning, and mops were not hung up.

headline: Unlabeled ready-to-eat foods; leaking sink faucet
summary: Prepared, pre-packaged ready-to-eat foods in the to-go cooler were not labeled. Labels must show product name, ingredients, business name and address. Leaking faucet at the west three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Soiled mop stored in bucket
summary: A soiled mop was stored inside a bucket. Staff were instructed to hand-dry it to prevent a pest breeding site.

headline: Unlabeled popcorn kernel container; residue
summary: A large white container of kernels was not labeled with its common name. Residue was on the cold-hold unit door and the popcorn container exterior. Debris was on the floor under shelving and equipment.

headline: Unscreened front windows; dirty racks and fans
summary: Front windows were removed and have no screens to block insects and pests; the business must keep them in or provide screens. Storage racks and fan covers in the walk-in cooler are dirty. A three-compartment sink faucet leaks. Food handlers lack certificates.

headline: Failed: no recent pest control service records
summary: No evidence of at least two licensed pest control services in the past year was found; latest report was dated March 26, 2024. Citation issued. Wastewater backed up from the three-compartment sink floor drain. The manager cleaned the grease trap and restored drainage before the inspection ended.

headline: Failed: cardboard liner; leaking sink faucets
summary: Cardboard was used as a liner on top of the grease trap in the rear dish area and must be removed. No test strips for the high-temperature dish machine; instructed to provide them. Both faucets at the three-compartment sink leak. Wet mops are stored in buckets.

headline: No certified manager; raw fish advisory missing
summary: No certified food manager was present while poke bowls and hot dogs were prepared and served; citation issued. Poke bowls with raw salmon and tuna lacked a raw or undercooked consumer advisory on the menu board and online menu.

headline: Cardboard lining shelves; remove to deter pests
summary: Cardboard boxes were used to line shelves. The business was instructed to remove them to prevent hiding places for pests. No pests were observed.

headline: Leaking drain pipe; broken sink leg; dusty ice machine
summary: Ice machine interior has dust buildup on a non-food surface. One leg of the three-compartment sink is detached. The condensate drain at the utility sink leaks onto the wall. Walk-in cooler floors under shelving are soiled and must be cleaned.

headline: Unlabeled bulk salt; missing net weight labels
summary: Bulk salt containers were not labeled. Packaged food labels were missing net weight. The business was instructed to label and maintain them.

headline: Cold food too warm; coolers tagged out
summary: Cold foods including pork, chicken, shrimp, and eggs were held at 53.2°F to 62.1°F and discarded. A prep cooler at 60.2°F and a walk-in cooler at 53.1°F are tagged and cannot be used until reinspected. Dead insects and dirt were on the floors.

headline: Failed: no paper towels; waste oil; training proof
summary: Paper towels were missing at the prep and bar handwashing sinks. Bar sink was blocked by a strainer. Open containers of waste fryer oil were piled outside. Outside debris was present. No food handler training proof and no allergen training for the manager. High-temperature dish machine lacks a temperature indicator.

headline: Floor debris; wall openings near wok station
summary: Floors under hood equipment have burnt debris and need cleaning. Openings at the wall base by the wok station must be sealed to prevent pest harborage. Food handlers must take the food handler course and keep records on site.

headline: Toilet door not self-closing; burned-out hood light
summary: The toilet room door must have a self-closing device. Excess unused equipment outside by the dumpster must be removed. The light on the left side of the ventilation hood must be replaced.

headline: Hanging fly traps; freezer needs defrosting
summary: Hanging fly traps must be removed from the rear food prep and dish area. The interior of the chest freezer must be cleaned and defrosted.

headline: Greasy cooking equipment; outdoor enclosure needs repair
summary: Grease buildup is on the back, sides, and tops of cooking equipment and must be cleaned. The outdoor garbage enclosure needs repair. Floor corners and drains need cleaning.

headline: Hole near grill; chipping paint in prep area
summary: A hole in the wall near the grill must be repaired or replaced. Chipping paint in the prep area must be scraped to a smooth, cleanable surface. Debris on hood cooking filters must be cleaned.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; dirty equipment and floors
summary: Handwashing sign is missing near the front prep sink. The 2-door milk cooler needs a thermometer. Outdoor bar items are not elevated. Several areas need cleaning, including dirty ceilings, dirty floors, and a dishwasher exterior. Peeling paint is above the ice machine.

headline: Handwashing sink lacks cold water pressure
summary: The rear handwashing sink had no cold water pressure, low hot water pressure, slow drainage, and a leaking drain pipe. A utility sink lacks a backflow device. Boxes stored on the floor must be raised at least six inches.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; food held at 66°F
summary: No certified manager was on site while beef at 140.9°F was prepared and served. Beef and chicken at 66.3°F in a broken cooler must be discarded. No vomiting and diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies; citation issued. Employees lack food handler training.

headline: Failed: no health policy or vomiting spill kit
summary: No employee health policy was on site. Citation issued. No vomiting and diarrhea spill kit or cleanup procedure was present; citation issued. Employee hand sinks had water at 72°F, below the required 100°F. No current pest control logbook was on premises.

headline: Uncovered washroom waste bin; soiled floors
summary: The rear washroom waste receptacle was uncovered and must stay covered. Floors behind the front counter and in rear storage were soiled with debris and need cleaning.

headline: About 80 lbs expired cooked chicken; discard ordered
summary: About 80 pounds of cooked chicken with an expiration date of 8/4/24 was in the walk-in cooler. The business has been closed since 7/29/25, and the food must be discarded. Priority violation. Food was uncovered; grease, grime and debris were throughout.

headline: Failed: coolers off; no hot or cold water at sink
summary: The walk-in cooler and sushi cooler were not turned on. The three-compartment sink has no hot or cold water. No employee health policy was on site. Raw-food consumer advisory is missing. No backflow device at the ice machine. No allergen training for sanitation manager.

headline: Damaged wall with opening behind toilet
summary: The wall behind the toilet inside the women's washroom is in poor repair and has an opening. It must be fixed.

headline: Soap dispenser at sink; several equipment repairs
summary: A soap dispenser is at the three-compartment sink, which is for warewashing only, and must be removed. Two prep coolers lack internal air thermometers. Bulk containers above a handwashing sink are unlabeled. Utensils were stored in standing water, and a cooler gasket is torn.

headline: Failed: front door gap; washroom fans not working
summary: A half-inch gap between the front entrance doors must be rodent-proofed. A core violation from a prior inspection was not corrected: washroom ventilation fans are not operating. Citation issued.

headline: Holes in basement prep ceiling
summary: The basement prep area ceiling has holes above the dish area. The business was instructed to seal them.

headline: Worn cutting boards; bar floor needs grout
summary: Worn and pitted cutting boards must be repaired or replaced. The bar area floor must be regrouted.

headline: Several lights out in rear prep
summary: Passed. A couple of lights in the rear food prep area are out and must be replaced and maintained.

headline: Pizza at 67F; no running water at sinks
summary: Pizza toppings at 67-68F sat on a speed rack with no time records or written procedure. Seven lbs were discarded. Soup and other ready-to-eat foods lacked correct dates. Two automatic handwashing sinks had no running water.

headline: Unlabeled containers; grease-covered floors
summary: Re-inspection passed. Several flour, sugar and cornmeal containers lacked labels. Cutting boards had open seams and stains. Grease, debris and dirt covered floors under equipment and in corners, and exposed foam caulk needs smoothing.

headline: No certified manager; raw meat stored over produce
summary: No certified manager was on site during TCS food prep. Raw meat and eggs stored over produce were removed by the manager. Improper cooling and cold holding led to discards and a tagged cooler. A dish sink lacked sanitizer.

headline: 40+ mouse droppings found; pest control required
summary: More than 40 mouse droppings were found near cooking equipment, the rear washroom and the front counter. Pest control is required before reinspection next week. The rear exit door also needs rodent-proofing.

headline: Unlabeled containers; wiping cloths not sanitized
summary: Passed. Bulk food containers lacked proper labels. Wiping cloths on prep tables were not stored in sanitizer. Plastic grocery bags were used for food storage in the walk-in freezer and must be replaced with food-grade bags.

headline: No hair restraints; ice scoops stored in ice
