summary: Passed. Employees were preparing and serving food without hair restraints. Wiping cloths sat on prep tables, and ice scoops were stored inside the ice machine. Water-damaged ceiling tiles and burnt-out bulbs need repair.

headline: 40 rodent droppings in prep area
summary: About 40 small rodent droppings were found in the prep area, on rolling carts, behind the ice machine and vending machines, and near hot and cold units. They must be removed and areas sanitized. An outside bin has damaged lids.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; leaks; dirty floors
summary: Passed. Multiple food handlers had expired food handler certificates that must be renewed. A leak at the base of the three-compartment faucet needs repair, and coffee debris on prep floors needs cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; health policies missing
summary: No certified food manager was on site or posted. Signed employee health policies, a vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure, a metal probe thermometer and sanitizer test strips were missing. Bar handsink needs signage and a wall base was missing.

headline: Unlabeled seasonings; rusted freezers; clutter
summary: Passed. Dry seasonings were in unlabeled containers. Rear chest freezers are rusted and corroded. The kitchen turbo oven has encrusted debris, and stacked boxes on the dry storage closet floor must be moved to shelving.

headline: Greasy fryers; no allergen training certificates
summary: Passed. Heavy grease built up inside cooking fryers and must be cleaned. Kitchen prep floors need cleaning. No allergen training certificates for certified food managers were present.

headline: Rear door gap; grease trap missing
summary: Passed. Rear doors to the parking and dumpster area have a quarter-inch gap at the bottom that must be repaired to prevent pests. The facility could not locate a grease trap for dish machine wastewater and must locate or install one.

headline: No employee health policy; front door gap
summary: Passed with conditions. No written employee health policy was on site, and signed policies are required for each employee. The front double doors have a half-inch gap at the bottom that must be sealed. Ceiling vents need dust cleaning.

headline: Cooler at 54F; no certified manager present
summary: Chicken, eggs and cheese were held at 54F in a two-door prep cooler, which measured 54F inside. No certified food manager was present, and no food handler certificates were provided. A metal thermometer was missing.

headline: Manager absent until 1:15 PM; fixes made
summary: No certified person in charge was present until 1:15 PM. Hot rice at 122.2F and cold salmon and tuna at 45-46.4F were discarded. A thermometer was delivered and the summary report posted on site. Dogs in the facility were not confirmed as service animals.

headline: About 35 live flying insects found in storage
summary: About 35 live small flying insects were found on walls, shelves and boxes in rear storage. An overflowing dumpster and trash on the ground were noted. No certified manager was on site during food service.

headline: Dead roach and fly found; no health policy
summary: Passed with conditions. A dead roach was found on a handsink and a dead fly on a prep table in the food prep area, and both must be removed. No signed employee health policy was shown, and managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Greasy equipment, dirty floors, damaged boards
summary: Re-inspection passed. Wiping cloths were not held in sanitizer. Cutting boards were stained and deeply cut. Heavy grease covered cooking equipment and fryer compartments, and floors and detached baseboards need deep cleaning.

headline: Grease buildup, burnt-out bulbs, no covered trash
summary: Passed. The employee toilet room lacks a covered trash receptacle. Grease covers the used cooking oil container in the alley. Grease and debris are under the fryer and stove and inside microwaves. Several bulbs and a restroom vent need attention.

headline: Dust, grease and damaged surfaces in kitchen
summary: Passed. Refrigeration units and a microwave had food debris and dust. The employee bathroom lacks a covered waste receptacle. A cracked handsink wall panel, corroded walk-in step, cracked tile and foam sealant need repair. Hood filters are greasy.

headline: Dead insects in washroom cabinet; dirty floors
summary: Passed. Dead insects were found in a washroom cabinet under the handsink and must be removed and cleaned. Loose debris, dirt and dust were found on floors and corners throughout the facility.

headline: Handwash sinks shut off too quickly
summary: Re-inspection passed. Toilet-room handwashing sinks did not stay on for at least 15 seconds and must be adjusted. Ice was removed from the walk-in freezer, and grease and debris on food prep floors needed cleaning.

headline: No certified manager posted; ice scoop misstored
summary: No certified food manager was posted on site. An ice scoop was stored inside the ice maker. Food handler certificates repeat a prior violation. Allergen training records were missing, and dispensers need new batteries.

headline: Over 200 mouse droppings found; roach seen
summary: Over 200 mouse droppings were found in many food areas, including inside the deep fryer, in rice storage and in the walk-in cooler. One roach was seen in the dining room. Additional pest control service is needed.

headline: Cold food at 45-57F; 71 lbs discarded
summary: Many cold foods were held above 41F, including raw beef at 53.1F and cut fish up to 57.4F. About 71.5 lbs ($1,000) was discarded. Three prep coolers are tagged. No certified manager was on duty, and health policies were missing.

headline: Broken toilets, sink, lights and ventilation
summary: Re-inspection passed with several repairs. Three women's toilets and a men's urinal do not work, and a prep sink is out of service. Hood and washroom lights are out, and grease covers hood filters and cooking equipment.

headline: 200+ flies and a live roach found
summary: Over 200 small flies were in the bar, and 50-100 were in basement storage and the three-compartment area. One live roach was seen at a basement threshold. Pest control must eliminate flies and roaches. Raw chicken was stored over ready-to-eat foods, and a cooler at 49.2F is tagged.

headline: Food on floors; openings in walls and ceilings
summary: Passed. Food was stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and freezer and must be raised six inches. Openings in walls and ceilings must be sealed. Milk crates, excess crates and unused equipment must be removed.

headline: Holes in basement walls; no allergen certificates
summary: Re-inspection passed. Heavy grease spills were inside fryers and must be cleaned. Holes in a basement closet wall and a large ceiling opening must be sealed to block pests. No allergen training certificates were on site.

headline: Expired allergen training on site
summary: Passed. Allergen training documentation on site was expired. The operator was instructed to update the records and keep them current.

headline: No certified manager; handsink used for dishes
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager was on site while hamburgers were prepared. The 16th floor lounge handsink was filled with soap and water for dishwashing and must stay open for handwashing. Signage is missing.

headline: Greasy equipment gaps and dusty hood
summary: Passed. Grease and dirt were found between cooking and cooling equipment at the downstairs cook line. Dust covers the top interior of the upstairs ventilation hood. Both need cleaning.

headline: Leaking faucet; expired allergen training
summary: Passed. A faucet at the three-compartment sink leaks and must be repaired. Allergen training for city food managers has expired, and the management was told to complete it and keep certificates on site.

headline: Food buildup in sinks; wall cover missing
summary: Passed. Food buildup was found inside the three-compartment sink and dishwashing handsink and must be cleaned. A wall cover near the three-compartment sink is missing and needs repair.

headline: Cardboard liners and slow-draining handsink
summary: Passed. Cardboard lined a rear cold-holding unit near rice cookers, and plastic wrap tied equipment at the mop sink. Both must be removed. The front handwashing sink drains slowly and needs repair.

headline: No hair restraints; milk crates and chipped paint
summary: Passed. Food handlers were prepping food without hair restraints, which must be worn. Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Chipped wall paint near the dish handsink needs repainting.

headline: No food handler certificates; no hair restraints
summary: Passed. Food handlers had no food handler certificates and were not wearing hair restraints in prep areas. Also noted: rusty walk-in cooler racks, stained and dusty ceiling tiles, floor debris and clutter in the rear area.

headline: Cold chicken and lunchmeat held near 50F
summary: Chicken wings at 50.2F and lunchmeat at 50.8F were held in the kitchen cold unit, but cold food must stay at 41F or below. A manager discarded 12 lbs worth $100. The ice bin interior also needed cleaning.

headline: Dead insects found; fly trap over prep table
summary: Dead insects were found in the dish and bar areas and must be removed. An electric fly trap hangs directly above a rear prep table and must be moved. No valid city sanitation certificate was posted, and a certified manager must be on site.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup plan
summary: Passed with conditions. No written, signed employee health policy was on site. No written policy or supplies for vomiting and diarrhea incidents were available. Handwashing signs were missing at handsinks.

headline: Plastic crates used for storage; greasy wall
summary: Passed re-inspection. Plastic crates were used to elevate stored items and must stop. Grease on a basement wall next to the hanging grease trap must be cleaned.

headline: Duct-taped cooler door; leaks and wiping cloths
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer between uses. Cutting boards were stained and cut, and duct tape repairs a deli cooler door. A scrape sink faucet leaks, and dishroom debris and standing water were noted.

headline: Dirty soda nozzles and greasy hood filters
summary: Passed. Soda machine nozzles were not clean. Grease has built up on the ventilation hood filters and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Milk held at 52F; 10 lbs discarded
summary: Bottled milk was held at 52F in a refrigeration unit, above the 41F limit. The manager discarded 10 lbs of milk worth $25. A utility sink faucet with a hose lacks a backflow prevention device.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; no grease traps
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs are missing at handsinks throughout, including bar and restroom sinks. Upstairs and downstairs bar three-compartment sinks lack grease traps, and the women's restroom needs a covered receptacle.

headline: Mold-like buildup in walk-in; debris on floors
summary: Passed. Walk-in cooler walls had black mold-like buildup and dirt. Seasoning shelves held dried food debris. Equipment was stored before air drying, and floors in the rear prep and walk-in coolers need cleaning to prevent pests.

headline: Unlabeled dry storage; trays facing up
summary: Passed. Dry food storage containers must be labeled with common names. Trays stored face-up at serving lines must be inverted.

headline: No food handler training proof; unlabeled containers
summary: Passed with conditions. Food containers lacked labels with common food names. No proof of food handler training was provided for any food handler. A food service manager lacked allergen training, a repeat violation.

headline: Missing handwash signs; food on freezer floor
summary: Re-inspection passed. Bar handwashing sinks lack signage. Boxes of food sat on the walk-in freezer floor and must be elevated. Crates in the walk-in must be replaced with shelving. Ice machine and juice machine interiors need cleaning.

headline: 50+ mouse droppings found in bar, basement
summary: Over 20 mouse droppings were found along walls and corners in the front service area and bar, and 30 more in basement storage. Management must remove and sanitize them and is advised to contact licensed pest control. Food was stored under exposed sewage pipes.

headline: Chicken held too warm; dumpsters overflowing
summary: Chicken at 48.0-52.7F on the three-compartment sink was voluntarily discarded. Overflowing dumpsters must be kept closed with trash inside receptacles. Food handlers lacked certificates, frozen catfish sat on the floor, and open drinks were in prep areas.

headline: Slimy dish machine drain; greasy cooking equipment
summary: Passed. The dish machine drain had heavy slimy buildup, and the machine interior had calcium buildup. Ice machine door grooves held dust and crumbs. A cutting board with deep grooves must be replaced, and A/C vents need cleaning.

headline: Cooked foods 48-54F; prep cooler tagged
summary: Cooked chicken, beef and bean sprouts were held at 48-54F in a prep cooler, and about 15 lbs were discarded. The cooler, at 53.6F, is tagged until repaired and reinspected by CDPH. Dry containers are unlabeled and grease buildup was noted.

headline: 15 live flies; dish machine too cool
summary: About 15 live small flying insects were found in the rear prep area and behind the bar, and pest control is needed. The high-temperature dish machine final rinse was 140F and must reach 180F. A barback prep area has no handsink.

headline: No employee health policy; basement items low
summary: Passed with conditions. No written employee health policy was on premises, and signed policies are required for each employee. Basement storage items must be elevated, and debris on the rear north basement floor must be cleaned.

headline: No employee health policy or vomit procedure
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy verification was available. No procedure or supplies were in place for responding to vomiting and diarrhea events, which must be provided.

headline: Washroom lacks mechanical ventilation
summary: Re-inspection passed with one issue. The washroom has no mechanical ventilation. The manager was instructed to provide it.

headline: Unsafe food temperatures; two coolers tagged
summary: Hot sausage at 106.9F and cold foods at 44-47F were held unsafely, and cooked potatoes were at 67.7F. Spinach was discarded after raw eggs and beef were stored above it. Two coolers are tagged. Basement handwash water reached only 90.7F.

headline: Expired allergen training; freezer ice buildup
summary: Passed with conditions. Sink stoppers at the three-compartment sink are in poor repair. Ice buildup in a reach-in freezer must be cleared, and black substance on 2-door cooler shelving must be cleaned. Expired allergen training is a repeat violation.

headline: Chicken at 86-110F; no handwashing between tasks
summary: Three trays of fried chicken sat at 86.0-109.5F, and about 15 lbs were discarded. A food handler wiped a station, then prepared a sandwich without washing hands or changing gloves. The ice machine interior has black buildup.

headline: Missing handwash signs; unused equipment stored
summary: Passed. Bar handwashing sinks lacked signs telling employees to wash hands. Clean linens were stored on the basement floor. Nonfunctional second-floor ovens, fryers and cold-holding equipment must be removed. Basement walk-in floor had spills.

headline: Grease buildup; no food handler training
summary: Failed complaint inspection. Grease and food debris were found on cooking equipment, coolers and under equipment. Employees had no food handler training. A bulk container was unlabeled, and the summary report was not posted.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; fixed on site
summary: The dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer and was repaired on site to 50 ppm. The second-floor bar handsink had no soap until staff obtained some during inspection. A one-inch gap at the front door must be sealed to prevent pest entry.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged out
summary: Passed with conditions. The low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine at final rinse and is tagged as not allowed to be used. A bulk salt container lacked a label, and a food handler wasn't wearing a hair restraint.

headline: Food thawing improperly; deli slicer dirty
summary: Frozen chicken and beef were thawing in a sink and on a drain board. The manager was told to thaw under cool running water or in the cooler. The deli slicer had food debris, and prep-area walls had splatter.

headline: No food handler training proof; wall repairs needed
summary: Passed re-inspection. No proof of food handler training was provided. Also noted: torn cooler gasket, milk crates used as shelving, stained cutting boards, a wall hole, damaged floor tiles, uncovered garbage cans and burnt-out lights.

headline: Flies, handwashing and temperature failures
summary: About 25 or more live small flies were found in the bar, basement and mop sink area. Food handlers did not wash hands between tasks, and handsinks were blocked. Stew at 89.6F and cooked beans at 45F were discarded. Gloves were used improperly.

headline: Rear door gap and dusty walls
summary: Passed. A quarter-inch gap under the rear alley door must be closed to block pests. The employee restroom lacks a covered waste receptacle, and dust has built up on kitchen prep walls.

headline: Rusted shelving in front reach-in cooler
summary: Passed. Shelving inside the reach-in cooler on the front service line is rusted. The manager was told to repaint or replace the rusted racks.

headline: Managers lack allergen training; plates unprotected
summary: Passed. Serving plates on kitchen prep shelves were not inverted to prevent dust. Certified managers on duty had no allergen training or expired certificates, and management was told to comply.

headline: Grocery bags in coolers; moldy walk-in racks
summary: Passed re-inspection. Grocery bags must not be used for food storage in freezers and coolers. Moldlike buildup on walk-in cooler racks needs cleaning. Rear garbage area needs detail cleaning, and a manager lacked current allergen training.

headline: Ice machine slime found; sinks lack soap and towels
summary: Black and pink slime was found inside the ice machine, dripping onto ice. A prep-area handwashing sink had no soap or paper towels and was nearly clogged. Shrimp was thawing improperly, and the rear door is not fully rodent-proof. The inspection summary was not posted.

headline: Pink buildup in ice maker; no allergen training
summary: Passed. Pink mold-like buildup was found inside the basement ice maker, which is not used for human consumption. A walk-in gasket is loose, a restroom faucet is corroded, and the manager on duty lacked allergen training.

headline: Dish machine missing required data plate
summary: Passed. The high-temperature dish machine has no data plate showing its required washing, rinsing and sanitizing temperatures and other specifications.

headline: Raw meats at 49-55F; expired food discarded
summary: Raw chicken and several meats were held at 49-55F in a prep cooler, which measured 50F inside. About 30 lbs was discarded. Expired cooked pork tamales and refried beans, dated 2024, were also discarded.

headline: Water-damaged wall and dusty restroom vent
summary: Passed. The rear employee restroom has water damage to the wall and baseboard behind the toilet, which must be repaired. The ceiling vent is covered in dust and needs cleaning.

headline: Unfinished wood counter must be sealed
summary: Re-inspection passed. The front counter and rear half wall are unfinished wood. The manager was told to seal them and provide a smooth, easily cleaned surface.

headline: Five live cockroaches found; pest control needed
summary: Five live cockroaches were found: one under the rear dish machine, three near the rear water heater closet and one at the front bar. Additional pest control is needed. Ice machine debris was noted, and the previous summary was not displayed.

headline: Raw food stored over ready-to-eat items
summary: Raw chicken and raw eggs were stored above cooked and ready-to-eat foods, and the manager removed all foods. Prepared foods lacked seven-day date labels and were discarded. The health policy and vomit cleanup procedure were missing.

headline: Flies throughout; bare-hand contact with pizza
summary: More than 20 small and large flies were found in the bar, kitchen, rear prep and dry storage. A worker pushed pizza with bare hands, and a handsink had no soap. Cold foods held at 44-50F were discarded, worth about $600.

headline: Pizza station cooler too warm; food discarded
summary: Several cold foods were above 41F, including diced chicken at 53.4-58.6F. About 20 lbs were voluntarily discarded. The unit reads 53.6F and cannot be used until reinspected by CDPH. Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced.

headline: Raw chicken and eggs left at room temperature
summary: Raw chicken thighs were thawing in standing water at 75.9-77.9F. Other raw chicken and about 40 eggs were held at 69-80F. About 34 lbs ($195) was discarded. Improper thawing and a missing probe thermometer were also cited.

headline: Food held too warm; dish machine fixed on site
summary: Cold food held at 48-61F led to about 34 lbs discarded. The dish machine sanitizing rinse was too cool and was repaired on site to 188F. A cold-holding unit was turned on and corrected on site. Shellstock tags lacked dates.

headline: Dusty condenser; food buildup near dish machine
summary: Passed. Dust has built up on the rear of the walk-in cooler condenser and must be cleaned. Food buildup on walls around and behind the dish machine, and on its exterior, also needs cleaning.

headline: Meats held too warm; coolers tagged out
summary: Passed with conditions. Ground beef at 52.3F, chicken at 53.6F and other cold meats were above the 41F limit. About 50 lbs were ordered discarded. Two prep coolers are tagged and cannot be used until reinspected by CDPH.

headline: Dead gnats and hanging insect device found
summary: Passed. Multiple dead gnats were found in corners under dry storage shelving and must be removed. A hanging insect control device in dry storage must be taken down. Grease and debris behind fryers need cleaning.

headline: Drinks stored in washroom; no allergen training
summary: Passed. Cases of pop were stored inside the employee washroom and must be removed. Spills and debris were under a prep cooler, the three-compartment sink faucet leaks, and the manager on duty lacked allergen training.

headline: Pink ice machine buildup; leaking sink drain
summary: Passed. Pink buildup was found inside the ice machine and must be cleaned. A one-compartment sink drain leaks, the women's washroom lacks a covered trash can, rear storage is cluttered, and a walk-in cooler bulb is out.

headline: Rear door gap, ice buildup, greasy hood
summary: Re-inspection passed. The rear exit door has a quarter-inch gap at the bottom that must be sealed to block pests. Ice buildup in the freezers and a torn gasket need repair. Heavy grease is in the exhaust hood, and ceilings need cleaning.

headline: No vomit cleanup plan; burned-out bulbs
summary: Passed with conditions. No procedure or supplies for vomit and diarrhea cleanup were on site. The utility mop sink lacks a backflow prevention device, the washroom door lacks a self-closing device, and some light bulbs are burned out.

headline: Hard-to-pump soap; greasy hood filters
summary: Passed. The soap pump at the front prep handwashing sink is hard to pump and needs repair or replacement. Grease and grime built up on hood filters over the grill must be cleaned.

headline: Ice bin interior needed cleaning
summary: Re-inspection passed. The ice bin interior needed cleaning. Management was told to remove the ice, clean the bin and keep it clean at all times.

headline: Black slime found inside ice machine
summary: Black slime buildup was found on the top interior of the ice machine. The ice is used for human consumption. A citation was issued under the food-contact surface rules.

headline: Missing food handler training; stained cutting boards
summary: Passed. Food handlers were missing food handler training and must obtain it. The ice machine interior had slight debris, cutting boards were heavily stained, foil lined plates, and the ice machine lacked a backflow device.

headline: No certified food service manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food service manager was on site while beef, chicken and rice were handled and served. Management was instructed to obtain one.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink faucet
summary: Passed. A faucet at the three-compartment sink is leaking and must be repaired and maintained.

headline: No certified manager; cooler too warm
summary: No certified food manager was on site while sausage was prepared; the manager arrived at 10:00 AM. Eggs and sausage at 49-52F were discarded, about 20 lbs. A reach-in cooler at 53F is tagged until CDPH reinspects it.

headline: Loose faucet; allergen training missing
summary: Re-inspection passed. A washbasin faucet in the men's toilet room is loose and must be repaired. The women's toilet room lacks a covered trash receptacle. A certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: No manager on site; display cooler at 82.6F
summary: No person in charge was present. The display cooler measured 82.6F and must not be used until it holds 41F or below. Missing items include the city certificate, food handler certificates, health policy, thermometer and pest log.

headline: 40+ mouse droppings in furnace room and office
summary: About 40 or more mouse droppings were found behind the furnace, on floors, on a wall outlet, and in the office. Droppings must be removed and areas sanitized, and a pest control service is recommended. Also missing: a signed health policy and a large enough 3-compartment sink.

headline: Ice cream cooler dirty; facility clutter
summary: The interior surfaces of the ice cream cooler are not clean and must be cleaned and maintained. There is clutter throughout the facility, construction material in a back room, and unused old equipment that must be removed.

headline: Door gaps and leaking sink on re-inspection
summary: Re-inspection found quarter-inch gaps at two exterior doors that must be sealed. Walk-in cooler shelves have rust. The bottom pipe of the 3-compartment sink leaks, and a damaged baseboard has left a hole in the wall.

headline: Unsafe hot and cold food temperatures discarded
summary: Pork ribs at 114.5°F and rice at 120.4°F were in the hot-holding unit, and about 15 lbs were discarded. Cut greens at 46.6–54.6°F and turkey at 47.0°F were in cold holding, and about 20 lbs were discarded. An employee drank from a covered container at a prep station.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; leaking faucets
summary: Re-inspection found leaking faucets at the rear handsink and the 3-compartment sink, both needing repair. Black buildup is on the outside of the grease container. Food handlers had expired certificates, and valid ones must be provided.

headline: Ice machine interior must be cleaned
summary: The interior of the ice machine must be cleaned.

headline: Rear door gap and missing restroom receptacle
summary: The rear exit door must be sealed at its 1/4-inch bottom gap to be fully rodent-proof. The employee restroom lacks a covered waste receptacle. The opening behind the 3-compartment sink needs repair, and the restroom fan does not work.

headline: No certified manager during food prep; training gaps
summary: No valid certified food manager was on site while temperature-controlled food was prepared, and a citation was issued. Food handlers lacked hair restraints and training. Door gaps, dirt, grease, and missing allergen training were also noted.

headline: Splash guards needed; wiping cloths on prep
summary: The kitchen handsink needs splash guards on both sides, or stored items must be removed from the area. Wiping cloths are on prep tables. Rusty walk-in shelving, dirt under the dishwasher, and water-damaged basement tiles need attention.

headline: Beans on floor; food encrusted on equipment
summary: Re-inspection found no ambient thermometers in hot-holding units, and buckets of beans were stored on the floor. The dough machine and microwaves are dirty. Floor tiles are missing or damaged in the rear prep area, and the certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Dish machine too cool; tagged out
summary: The high-temperature dish machine could not reach a 180°F rinse. The person in charge removed it from use before inspection and showed a repair work order. The machine is tagged and must be checked before reuse. Priority violation; no citation issued.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; unit tagged out
summary: The low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine, so it was tagged, held, and may not be used. Citations were issued for the health policy and dish machine. The metal thermometer is broken, and allergen training is missing.

headline: Cold-held foods too warm; discarded
summary: Sliced tomatoes at 48.6–50.8°F, smoked salmon at 46.3°F, and boiled eggs at 46.7°F were in the front cold-holding unit. About 7 lbs ($65) were voluntarily discarded, and a citation was issued. Aluminum foil liners, grease, missing ceiling tiles, and a broken access lid were noted.

headline: No certified manager; no food handler training
summary: No person in charge with a valid certificate was present, and no valid certificate was posted. The menu lacks a raw-food consumer advisory. The facility has no prep tables or shelving on site, and the ice machine lacks a backflow device. Employees lack food handler training.

headline: Basement door gap; milk crates; wall damage
summary: A gap of about 1 inch at the basement door base must be sealed. Cutting boards have open seams and stains, and milk crates are used for elevation. Basement storage is cluttered, a basement wall is missing, and a restroom ceiling has a hole.

headline: Mouse droppings and unsafe hot food temperatures
summary: Over 40 mouse droppings were found under pallets in rear storage, and the rear receiving door is not rodent-proof. Ten hot foods were below the safe 135°F minimum, some as low as 96.6°F. About 64 lbs were discarded. Citation issued.

headline: Greasy fryer cabinets; missing drain covers
summary: Knives were stored between a prep table and cooler. Fryer cabinets have heavy grease buildup. Floor drain covers are missing in storage, a pizza prep outlet cover is missing, and the floor behind the cook line has food debris and grease.

headline: Leaking handsink drain; stoppers not working
summary: The front prep handwashing sink drain pipe is leaking, and the 3-compartment sink stoppers do not work. Both must be repaired. Wall tiles are missing or damaged on the north wall of the front prep area, and shelves along the cook line have food debris.

headline: No hot water; water heater being replaced
summary: The premises had no hot water because the water heater was broken; water measured 67.5°F. A citation was issued. A hot water tank was installed during the inspection. The handwashing sink lacks signage, and floors behind heavy equipment need cleaning.

headline: Truck license number needed; floors need cleaning
summary: The truck must display a license number at least 2 inches tall on both sides. Floors need cleaning to remove debris. The manager was instructed to comply with the allergen training requirement or citations will follow.

headline: No certified manager while food was handled
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken, soup, and dairy were handled, and a citation was issued. The person in charge lacks a certificate. Missing items include a vomit cleanup procedure, food handler training proof, and a posted inspection summary.

headline: Unapproved reduced-oxygen packaging; dog entered
summary: Reduced-oxygen packaging was done without the required variance or documentation. About 15 lbs ($350) of product was discarded, the unit was tagged, and a citation was issued. A prohibited dog entered and was removed. Food handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Slime in ice machine; sink faucet leaks
summary: Black and pink slime built up inside the ice machine used to make ice for customers, and a citation was issued. The ice must be removed and the machine cleaned and sanitized. The 3-compartment sink faucet leaks and needs repair.

headline: Low water pressure and leaking grease trap
summary: The 3-compartment sink has low water pressure and must be increased. The grease trap is leaking onto the floor and must be repaired. Rear dry storage clutter must be removed to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: Greasy fryers and damaged restroom walls
summary: Fryer exteriors and walk-in cooler shelves need grease and food particles removed. Women's restrooms lack covered receptacles. Men's restroom has loose wall tile and a hole that must be sealed. Floors under cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Dead flies in prep cooler; greasy walls
summary: Re-inspection found dead flies and debris in the top of a prep cooler, and an insect control device was hung over food prep. A bucket of rice was in the mop sink, and cutting boards were stored on the floor. Walls and floors have heavy grease, and the manager's allergen certificate has expired.

headline: Cooler cleaning and worn gasket need repair
summary: The ice machine opening needs detail cleaning. The walk-in cooler ceiling and fan covers have heavy dust. A worn gasket on the three-door prep cooler must be replaced to keep food cold. Floors and equipment sides need cleaning.

headline: Summary report not posted publicly
summary: The most recent inspection summary report was not posted in public view. It must be visible at all times, and a citation was issued.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer and storage problems
summary: A beverage cooler used for sauces has no internal thermometer. Clean linens were stored with dry chiles, and clean equipment and cups were stored on the floor. The outdoor waste area is cluttered, and grease is behind the cook line.

headline: No certified manager on site during food prep
summary: No certified food sanitation manager was on site while temperature-controlled foods were prepared, and a citation was issued. A 2-inch gap is at the entry door. Reach-in coolers have food debris, and hood filters are greasy.

headline: Working thermometers and hair restraints needed
summary: Working thermometers must be provided and maintained inside all coolers. Cooks lacked proper hair restraints. Food stored in #10 cans inside a cooler must be moved to food-grade containers. The certified food service manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Raw meat in open garbage can; expired certificates
summary: Raw meat in a metal pan was stored inside an open garbage can in the prep area. An employee discarded about 5 lbs ($10), and a citation was issued. Food handler training certificates on site are expired, and current ones must be provided.

headline: Mold on ice machines; food stored on floor
summary: Re-inspection found a black mold-like substance on the shields of both kitchen ice machines, which must be cleaned and sanitized. Potatoes and boxes are stored on floors. A walk-in freezer door gasket is damaged, and the menu lacks a raw-food disclosure.

headline: No grease trap; truck lacks license number
summary: There is no grease trap. The facility must install one at the 3-compartment sink and maintain it. The truck has no license number and must display one on both sides.

headline: Unlabeled flour; door gaps; oven vent
summary: Re-inspection found flour in an unlabeled plastic bin. Gaps of 1/2 inch are under the front and rear doors. Shelving is rusty, floor drains are dirty, and the rear kitchen oven is not under a ventilation vent.

headline: Food employees lack hair restraints
summary: Food employees in the front and rear prep areas were not wearing hair restraints, and management must provide them. A wet mop was stored in the utility sink and must be hung to dry.

headline: Missing soap and paper towels; door gap
summary: The women's restroom has a poor-repair mechanical hand dryer and no paper towels, and a citation was issued. A handsink lacked soap. The rear exit door has a gap of about 1/4 inch at the bottom and is not rodent-proof.

headline: Food contamination risks and greasy cooking line
summary: An employee scooped food with a bowl that has no handle. Dirty knives were stored in the knife rack, and cloth towels were used as shelf liners. Cooking line walls and equipment are greasy, and freezers have excess ice.

headline: No food handler training certificates on premises
summary: Re-inspection found no food handler training certificates on the premises. The manager was instructed that all food handlers must have them.

headline: Dead roaches under coolers; unlabeled containers
summary: Dead insects and roaches under and behind coolers in the front and rear prep areas must be removed. Storage containers need labels, and a stained cutting board needs refinishing. The dumpster area is cluttered, and one food handler lacks training proof.

headline: No certified manager, health policy, or advisory
summary: No person in charge with a valid certificate was present, and no certified manager was on site. The facility has no employee health policy, vomit cleanup procedure, or raw-food consumer advisory on the menu. A certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Holes in walls and stained walk-in cooler floor
summary: A deli case door is missing a small section of rubber gasket. The women's employee restroom has large holes in the wall. The dairy walk-in cooler is heavily stained and has an uneven floor that must be repaired.

headline: Unlabeled sugar and damaged cooler gasket
summary: A large white container of sugar is not labeled with its ingredient name. The gasket on the three-door prep cooler is damaged and must be repaired or replaced. Uneven tile near a compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Pink mold in ice machine; beef too warm
summary: A pink mold-like substance inside the ice machine was dripping onto drink ice; ice was discarded and the machine cleaned, with a citation. About 15 lbs of beef held at 56.7°F were discarded, with a citation. A large wall hole and missing ceiling tiles need repair.

headline: Greasy cooking equipment and drink nozzles
summary: Drink nozzles need detail cleaning to remove buildup. Cooking equipment needs grease removed, and floors under the equipment need cleaning. The inspector instructed the facility to maintain cleaning at all times.

headline: No certified manager posted during food prep
summary: The person in charge lacks a certified food manager certificate, and none was posted while temperature-controlled foods were handled. The menu lacks a raw-food consumer advisory. The ice machine has a pink substance, and basement debris must be cleared.

headline: Rodent droppings found; deli meat too warm
summary: About 30 rodent droppings were found in front and rear areas. Pest control was recommended, and a citation was issued. Deli meat at 56°F was discarded, and the reach-in cooler at 56°F was tagged. No certified manager was present during food service.

headline: Storage room clutter and wall openings to fix
summary: Re-inspection found excess clutter on the storage room floor and openings in the walls. Both conditions can create pest hiding places and must be corrected. No pests are recorded in these notes.

headline: Plastic bags in freezer; no food handler training
summary: Plastic grocery bags are used for food storage in the reach-in freezer, and food-grade bags are required. Grease and debris must be cleaned from the grill, steam table, prep coolers, and hood. Employees lack food handler training.

headline: Expired allergen certificate; restroom signs missing
summary: The certified food manager's allergen training certificate has expired. The south-end restrooms lack handwashing signs and self-closing door devices. A stained cutting board needs replacing, and water-stained ceiling tiles need replacing.

headline: Bulk food containers must be labeled
summary: The inspector instructed that bulk food containers, such as rice and beans, must be labeled with their names.

headline: Missing hot-holding thermometer; dusty vents
summary: A hot-holding unit used on weekends has no thermometer. Knives are stored between a prep table and wall. The toilet room door is not self-closing, and stained ceiling tiles and dusty vents need attention.

headline: Truck license number missing; surfaces need cleaning
summary: The truck must show its license number at least 2 inches tall on both sides. Prep surfaces, storage shelves, floors, and the hood vent need detail cleaning to remove buildup.

headline: No current food handler certificates on site
summary: No current food handler certificates were on site. Employees must complete training and keep records on site. A thermometer in the 4-door cooler is broken, and a steady leak under a front handwashing sink needs repair.

headline: No handsink in dish area; no soap or towels
summary: There is no handwashing sink in the dishwashing area, and no handsink had soap, paper towels, or signs. No employee health policy or vomit cleanup procedure was on site. Coolers lack thermometers, and doors have gaps.

headline: Pest infestation with 500+ rodent droppings
summary: Over 20 live cockroaches, over 500 mouse droppings, and over 100 live flies were found throughout the premises. Pest control service is required, and a citation was issued. The three-door prep cooler held food at 46.3–49.5°F, and about 50 lbs were discarded.

headline: Rodent droppings found; cold foods too warm
summary: Twenty rodent droppings were found in the storage area, and a citation was issued. Several cold foods were held at 47–52°F, and about $100 of food was discarded. The deli cooler at 54°F was tagged. No certified manager was on site.

headline: No covered restroom receptacle; damaged wall
summary: The restroom has no covered receptacle, and one must be provided and maintained. The hallway wall near the exterior door has missing paint and damage that needs repair.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; greasy ice machine
summary: A handwashing sign is required at the sink by the 4-compartment sink. An employee must wear an effective hair restraint. Milk crates may not be used to elevate items. The ice machine exterior has mineral buildup, and caulking is broken.

headline: Blocked handsinks removed on site
summary: Front and rear prep handsinks were blocked by equipment and utensils. The person in charge removed the obstructions during the inspection, and a citation was issued. The front handsink lacks signage, and floors, shelves, and a ceiling tile need attention.

headline: Dirty coolers; no food handler certificates
summary: Loose debris, dirt, and food-liquid spills are inside the front coolers. Cleaning must increase, and the coolers must be maintained at all times. No food handler certificates were on site, and the manager was told to meet the state requirement.

headline: No certified manager; food handlers untrained
summary: The person in charge lacks a valid certificate. No certified manager was on site while beef, chicken, and beans were served, and a citation was issued. Frozen blood is under the reach-in freezer. Male food handlers lack training, and allergen training is missing.

headline: Certified manager lacks required allergen training
summary: The certified food manager on site did not have required allergen training. The inspector told management to comply or citations will follow.

headline: Doors not pest-proof; washroom opens to kitchen
summary: The front entrance and rear side exit doors have gaps and are not rodent-proof. The unisex washroom opens into a kitchen prep area without a barrier. The handsink lacks signs, the employee washroom door is not self-closing, and wall openings need sealing.

headline: Stained cutting board and broken washroom fan
summary: A heavily stained, scored cutting board in the meat prep area must be resurfaced or replaced. The washroom ventilation fan is not working. Grease is on walls and hood filters, and cooking equipment must be stored under the hood.

headline: No allergen training for certified managers
summary: No allergen training was on site for City of Chicago food managers. Management was instructed that all certified food managers must complete allergen training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: No certified manager during egg and milk prep
summary: No valid certified food manager was on premises while eggs and milk were prepared, and a citation was issued. The person in charge lacks a valid certificate. The rear door was cracked open, the front prep handsink drains slowly, and an employee restroom handsink is pulling from the wall.

headline: Rat droppings and dead rat found on site
summary: Rat droppings were found on the basement stairs to the first-floor kitchen, and pest control service is recommended. A dead rat was found in a trap in the north kitchen and must be removed. The main dish area has no handsink, and paper towel dispensers are not working.

headline: Dust in vent above dish machine
summary: Dust in the vent system above the dish machine must be cleaned.

headline: Exposed pipes and ceiling must be cleanable
summary: Ventilation, piping, and utility lines are exposed above the front prep area. The inspector instructed the facility to install a smooth, easily cleanable ceiling there and to avoid exposed lines that block cleaning.

headline: Dirt under equipment; standing water in rear
summary: The front food area floor has dirt and food debris under and around equipment. The rear floor has standing water under the one-compartment sink. Paint is fading near the fire extinguisher, and air vents over prep have heavy dust.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: Re-inspection found that the certified food manager has no food allergen certificate. The manager was instructed to comply with the requirement.

headline: 60+ mouse droppings and live cat in storage
summary: Over 60 mouse droppings were found under a potato chip shelf and in rear storage near dry ingredients. Pest control service is required, and a citation was issued. A live cat was found in the food storage area and was corrected on site. The person in charge lacks allergen training.

headline: No certified manager present; no chlorine test kit
summary: No person in charge with a valid certificate was on the premises, and a citation was issued. No chlorine test kit was on site. Outdoor dumpsters are overflowing and cannot close, so trash must be made inaccessible to pests. Cooler gaskets are damaged.

headline: No handwashing signs; washroom door not self-closing
summary: There are no handwashing signs at the sinks. The washroom door lacks a self-closing device, and there is no covered waste receptacle in the washroom. Ceiling tiles are missing in prep, and basement storage walls must be sealed.

headline: Wiping cloths on sinks; rusty shelves
summary: Wiping cloths are stored on top of the 3-compartment sink and prep tables. Items in the walk-in freezer and washroom must be elevated. Shelves in walk-in and service coolers are rusty, and the 3-compartment sink faucet base leaks.

headline: Leaking sink faucet; no restroom trash cover
summary: The 3-compartment sink faucet leaks at its base, and the middle and left stoppers do not work. The customer washroom has no covered trash receptacle. The floor drain under the 2-compartment sink has dirt buildup.

headline: Food held without dates; no sanitizer test kit
summary: Ready-to-eat foods held over 24 hours had no discard dates, and a citation was issued. There is no sanitizer test kit, and handwashing signs are missing. Items are stored on the floor, and cooking equipment and walls are dirty.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets and crumbling brick doorway
summary: A small cold-hold unit for pizza ingredients has broken, torn gaskets. Cardboard on prep table bottoms must be removed. The brick doorway to rear storage is crumbling with open holes and must be repaired and sealed.

headline: Cardboard floor liners; soiled mop heads
summary: Cardboard is used as a floor liner in rear prep and storage areas and must be removed. Soiled mop heads were not stored properly and must be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and unlabeled salt
summary: The employee restroom has no handwashing signs. Bulk salt is not labeled. Deli cups were not air dried after washing, and multi-use utensils must be air dried.

headline: Dead cockroaches found; torn cooler gaskets
summary: Re-inspection found 10, 3, and 2 dead cockroaches in three areas of the pancake cafe, and detail cleaning is required. The two-door cooler has torn gaskets and greasy hinges. The 3-compartment sink handle is missing and leaks.

headline: Unlabeled cold foods; missing food handler training
summary: About 50 lbs of cooked chicken, 40 lbs of ground beef, and 40 lbs of pasta were stored without discard-date labels. A citation was issued. Food handlers lack training certificates, allergen certificates are missing, and floors need cleaning.

headline: 40+ live flies; no certified manager until noon
summary: No certified manager was on duty while temperature-controlled foods were prepared, and the manager arrived at noon. A citation was issued. Over 40 live small flies were found in bar, dining, restroom, and basement areas. Standing water is on the basement floor, and ceiling water drips above the dish machine.

headline: Dish machine lacks temperature indicators
summary: The high-temperature dish machine has no temperature indicators, and a citation was issued. The shared kitchen needs cleaning: the 2-door prep cooler interior, prep sink, convection oven, and cook-line tables. Grease is on walls, and floors need cleaning.

headline: No covered restroom receptacle
summary: The women's restroom has no covered receptacle for sanitary product disposal. The person in charge was instructed to provide one.

headline: Food debris on shelves, coolers, and hood
summary: Accumulated food debris is on prep shelves, the handwash sink exterior, and inside and outside the coolers. Floors along walls, corners, and under the sink and cooking equipment need detail cleaning. The hood and filters have grease and debris.

headline: Hair restraints needed; damaged cooler gaskets
summary: Employees in the rear prep area must wear hair restraints. A two-door cooler in rear storage needs damaged gaskets repaired. A wet mop was stored in its bucket and must be hung to dry.

headline: Broken thermometer and beverage dispenser leak
summary: A broken thermometer inside the walk-in cooler must be replaced. Water from a leaking beverage dispenser has pooled inside a dining area cabinet and must be repaired. Vents above sandwich prep have heavy dust and dirt.

headline: No certified manager; freezer drips onto food
summary: No certified manager was on site while rice and chicken were prepared, and a citation was issued. Condensation dripped from the freezer onto food, which was discarded, and a citation was issued. No soap was at the kitchen handsink, and food containers are on the walk-in floor.

headline: Pink mold-like substance in ice machine
summary: A pink mold-like substance inside the ice machine was dripping onto ice for consumers. The ice was discarded and a citation was issued. Rust is under the chemical table, furnace room is cluttered, and the certified manager has no allergen training.

headline: No handwashing sink in rear prep area
summary: The rear prep area with the 3-compartment sink has no handwashing sink. Management was instructed to install one. A priority foundation violation was issued.

headline: Slimy ice machine dripping onto ice
summary: A brown slimy substance inside the ice machine was dripping onto ice for customers. It must be removed, cleaned, and sanitized. Cutting boards have open seams and stains, hood filters are greasy, and a light shield is broken.

headline: Breading buildup and leaking basement sink pipe
summary: Fish breading has built up inside the front cold-holding unit and must be cleaned. A pipe under the basement handwashing sink leaks heavily during use and must be repaired. The certified food manager has no allergen training certificate on site.

headline: Pink residue in ice machine; cardboard floor mats
summary: A light pink residue inside the rear ice machine must be cleaned. Cardboard used as floor mats in the rear prep area must be removed and replaced with cleanable covering. Floors in prep areas and the walk-in cooler need cleaning.

headline: No valid certified manager during milk handling
summary: The person in charge lacked a valid certificate, and no certified manager was on site while milk was handled. Citations were issued. The high-temperature dish machine has no temperature indicators, and two male food handlers lack training proof.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site
summary: No kit or procedure for vomit and diarrhea events was on site. The facility must keep a kit with norovirus-effective sanitizer at all times. No citation was issued. The restroom has no door or self-closing door.

headline: 50+ mouse droppings in fryer; citation issued
summary: Over 50 mouse droppings were found inside a cooking fryer. All pest evidence must be eliminated, and affected areas cleaned and sanitized; a citation was issued. A dead cockroach under the rear handsink was removed on site. The allergen training certificate has expired.

headline: Dusty bottom display shelves
summary: The bottom display shelves are dusty and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Missing handwashing signs, thermometers, and leaks
summary: Several handwashing sinks lack signage. Some cold-holding units lack internal thermometers. Multi-use scoops are used in dry storage, an open cooler by a handsink lacks splash protection, and basement sink plumbing leaks.

headline: Passed; wooden shelf under prep table
summary: Passed. A wooden platform used as a shelf under the food prep table in the rear dishwashing area must be made smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Passed; uncovered ice bin, leaking sink
summary: Passed. The ice bin in the front prep area was uncovered and must have a lid. A sink leaked under its scrape compartment. One employee had an expired allergen training certificate.

headline: Passed; missing thermometer, unlabeled desserts
summary: Passed. A visible, working thermometer must be placed inside the sandwich prep cooler. Packaged desserts lacked proper labels. The walk-in cooler had dim lighting, and a light shield was missing in the bread display case. Floors and storage areas needed detail cleaning.

headline: Failed: about 40 live flies, dirty dumpster lids
summary: Failed. About 40 or more live small flies were on bags of flour, inside the mop sink, and on walls in the dining area. Dumpster lids were missing. A prep cooler door did not close tightly, and grease and debris were built up. Prior core violations were not corrected.

headline: Passed; leaking mop sink, no lidded trash
summary: Passed. The mop sink drain pipe was leaking and needs repair. The washroom had no covered trash receptacle. Food buildup on the ventilation hood must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, unsafe cold food, flies
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site. Cold foods were held at 46-48°F and discarded. The walk-in cooler ran at 46°F. About 20 small flies and 1 live roach were found in the prep area.

headline: Failed: cold food unsafe, cooler failing, 90 lb discarded
summary: Failed. Front-line cooler held TCS foods at 47.8-55.3°F, and about 90 lb (roughly $200) was discarded on site. The cooler ran at 56°F and was in poor repair; its use must stop until repaired. Floors under the soda machine were soiled.

headline: Failed: no manager, moldy ice machine, unsafe cold food
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on premises. The ice machine and rinse compartments had mold-like substance. Cold foods held at 45.7-70.5°F were discarded (8 lb). Paper towels, toilet tissue, and food handler certificates were missing or corrected on site, and several lights and ceiling tiles were out.

headline: Passed re-inspection; no food handler proof
summary: Passed re-inspection. Plastic covering inside the walk-in freezer around wiring and water lines was peeling and must be replaced. No proof of food handler training or certificates was provided for employees preparing food.

headline: Passed re-inspection; wall opening, worn shelving, dirty floors
summary: Passed re-inspection. A damaged, open wall at the meat-area entry must be sealed to prevent pests. Worn pressed-wood shelving, a loose sliding door, loose freezer floor panels, and dirty floors and cooking equipment were also noted.

headline: Failed: spiders, centipede, no health policy
summary: Failed. About 10 spiders and a centipede were found in the rear food storage area and toilet rooms, and live insect activity was noted. No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies were on site. Dry containers were unlabeled.

headline: Passed; missing hand-wash signs, freezer ice buildup
summary: Passed. Hand-wash signage was missing at both prep hand sinks and in the washroom. Reach-in freezers had excess debris and ice buildup that must be removed. Loose debris and dust were on floors and corners.

headline: Passed; leaking 3-compartment sink faucet
summary: Passed. The 3-compartment sink faucet neck was leaking. The operator was told to repair it and keep it in good condition.

headline: Passed with conditions; unlabeled food discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Packaged fruit, gooseberries, and pineapple lacked labels. About 4 lb was discarded on site. An asterisk for raw or undercooked items was added to the menu on site. Boxes were on the bar floor, and a sink stopper leaked.

headline: Passed with conditions; no manager certificate posted
summary: Passed with conditions. The person in charge had no city sanitation certificate, and none was posted. The dry storage floor drain was not clean. A citation was issued for the missing certificate.

headline: Passed; missing hand-wash sign, wet wiping cloths
summary: Passed. The employee restroom lacked a hand-washing sign. Wet wiping cloths sat on several prep surfaces and must be stored in sanitizer. A circular hole in the rear storage wall needed repair.

headline: Failed: no health policy, cold freezer, no pest logs
summary: Failed. No health policy or vomit kit was on site, and hand sinks lacked soap and paper towels. The walk-in freezer ran at 84.2°F, and the prep cooler was tagged. Pest control logs and contract were missing. Hot water was too low at hand sinks.

headline: Failed: cold food too warm, about 75 live flying insects
summary: Failed. Milk at 46°F, marinara at 50°F, prime rib at 51°F, and other cold TCS foods were held above 41°F, with a citation issued. About 75 live small flying insects were on walls and ceilings in prep, dishwashing, dry storage, and behind the liquor bar. Pest control service is needed.

headline: Passed; sanitizer at 0 ppm, rust, debris
summary: Passed. Wiping-cloth sanitizer measured 0 ppm chlorine and must be at least 50 ppm. Ice machine parts sat uncovered on the floor. Rust was on burger-grill surfaces, and the backflow device was in poor repair. Floor debris under computer equipment needed cleaning.

headline: Failed: no prep hand sink, missing signs and soap
summary: Failed. The front prep area had no hand sink; a one-compartment prep sink was used instead and must be rerouted. Hand soap, paper towels, and signage were missing. The front cooler lacked a thermometer, and two certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed; rear door gap, dirty floors, no training proof
summary: Passed. A half-inch gap under the rear door by the mop sink must be rodent- and insect-proofed. Gaskets were in poor repair, and floors, vents, and walls were dirty. Clutter and damaged floor tiles were noted. Food handlers lacked proof of training.

headline: Failed: live flies, expired allergen certificate
summary: Failed. About 30 live small flies were on walls in the prep and dishwashing areas, and pest control service was advised. Also: no thermometer in the dessert cooler, food debris on sinks and shelves, and an expired allergen training certificate.

headline: Passed with conditions; cold food discarded, cooler tagged
summary: Passed with conditions. Prep cooler held steak at 55°F, shrimp at 60.2°F, octopus at 63°F, scallops at 66°F, and crab at 58.4°F. About 30 lb was discarded. The cooler, at 60°F, was tagged and held. Thermometers were missing from a cooler.

headline: Failed: no backflow device, untrained staff
summary: Failed. No backflow prevention device was found at the ice machine water line. One food handler had no food handler training, and the sanitation manager had no allergen training.

headline: Passed; fly trap over prep, leaking faucet
summary: Passed. A fly trap strip was placed between the 3-compartment sink and prep table and must be moved away from food prep. A splashguard was missing. A microwave, flour totes, fryer compartments, and floor drain needed cleaning, and a hand-sink faucet leaked.

headline: Failed: food unsafe, no manager, flies, no training
summary: Failed. Food was prepared without a certified manager on site. Cold foods ran 45.8-50.5°F; 15 lb was discarded. About 25 small flies were near the beer garden door. Hand sinks lacked soap, towels, or hot water, and no health policy or proof of training was on file.

headline: Passed; food stored on freezer floor
summary: Passed. Food containers were stored on the floor of the walk-in freezer and must be raised at least six inches. Various food items were in plastic grocery bags and must be moved to food-grade containers.

headline: Passed re-inspection; greasy surfaces and plumbing repairs
summary: Passed re-inspection. Wet wiping cloths sat on prep tables, and grease and food debris were found on equipment and floors. A broken water handle and a sink leak needed repair. Unused items in basement storage needed removal.

headline: Passed re-inspection; dirty wiping cloths, stained boards
summary: Passed re-inspection. Dirty wiping cloths on front and rear prep tables were not stored in sanitizer. Cutting boards had open seams and dark stains and must be refinished or replaced.

headline: Passed; food on floor, greasy equipment
summary: Passed. Food containers were stored on floors in prep and storage areas and must be raised six inches. Hair restraints were needed, and cooking equipment, coolers, and pastry cases needed detail cleaning. Mops must be air-dried, and unnecessary items removed.

headline: Passed with conditions; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Passed with conditions. Barrels of beer blocked a hand sink, which must stay accessible. The low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine. It was tagged and may not be used until inspected. Food containers lacked labels.

headline: Failed: live roaches near food service areas
summary: Failed. About 5-10 live roaches were found near the rear hand sink, and 10-15 under shelving where serving dishes are stored. Pest control with proof of service is required by the July 2, 2026 re-inspection.

headline: Failed: no soap or towels at sinks, expired certificate
summary: Failed. Hand soap and paper towels were missing from prep-area hand sinks and the washroom. No chlorine test strips were available for the 3-compartment sink. A food handler's certificate was expired. Allergen training from a prior report was still not corrected.

headline: Passed; clutter on shelving
summary: Passed. Tools, paint, and other clutter were stored on shelving units. The operator must remove them.

headline: Passed; fly trap near prep, hygiene lapses
summary: Passed. A fly trap was mounted near a food prep table and needed to stay away from open food. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. Spoons sat in stagnant water, and a knife was wedged between coolers.

headline: Passed; no freezer thermometer, leaking pipe
summary: Passed. A thermometer must be placed inside the front-entrance reach-in freezer where deli meat is stored. A pipe under the prep hand sink leaked and needed repair.

headline: Passed; hair restraints not worn, spills
summary: Passed. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Spills and debris were on coolers, freezers, and prep tables. The front hand sink lacked a hand-washing sign, and a basement washroom fan did not work.

headline: Passed; missing hand-wash signs and food handler training
summary: Passed. The cook-line hand sink lacked signage. Soil and debris were under dough-area counters, and a storage closet light was too dim. Three employees lacked food handler training.

headline: Passed; food debris and missing allergen training
summary: Passed. Food debris was found in the bottom of serving-line reach-in coolers and on floors. Certified food managers had no allergen training on site, and the operator was told they must complete it.

headline: Passed; cardboard shelving, unrepaired leak
summary: Passed. Cardboard lining the rear shelving must be removed to prevent insect harborage. A broken floor at the double side door and dusty shelving needed repair. A leak at the 3-compartment sink faucet was a prior core violation not corrected.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager, no health policy
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager was present while milk was prepared and served. No verifiable employee health policy was on site, and some food employees lacked hair restraints. Dumpster debris, soiled mop heads, and a dirty coffee roaster vent needed attention.

headline: Passed; dish machine leak, missing ceiling tile
summary: Passed. A small leak was found at the high-temperature dish machine drain. A ceiling tile was missing above the family washroom, and a large gap between floor and wall was in the electrical closet.

headline: Failed: hand-sink water too hot, grease buildup
summary: Failed. The exposed hand sink next to the bar dump sink measured 137.8°F, above the 120°F limit, and had no cold water. Grease covered cooking equipment and walls. Three burned-out hood bulbs and a dusty dish-area vent needed attention.

headline: Passed with conditions; no soap or towels, oysters untagged
summary: Passed with conditions. Paper towels and soap were missing at hand sinks until requested. About 45 oysters lacked a shellstock tag and were discarded. Other issues included a rusty prep base, holes in walls, and weeds and debris behind garbage.

headline: Passed; heavy soil in dish area
summary: Passed. Walls and floors in the dish area had heavy soil and debris buildup. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain the area.

headline: Passed; torn gasket on refrigerator
summary: Passed. A torn rubber gasket was found inside the door of a two-door refrigeration unit in the kitchen prep area. The operator must repair or replace it.

headline: Passed; dirty reach-in cooler interiors
summary: Passed. The interiors of reach-in coolers needed cleaning. The operator was instructed to detail clean them.

headline: Passed re-inspection; soda crate used as shelf
summary: Passed re-inspection. A plastic soda crate was used for elevation in the walk-in cooler and must not be used. One certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: Passed re-inspection; unlabeled items, rust, damaged baseboards
summary: Passed re-inspection. Packaged pasta and salads in the display cooler were not labeled. Rust was on a table in the rear prep and dish area and must be removed. Baseboards in rear storage and dish areas were damaged or missing.

headline: Passed; covered meatloaf cooling, foil on drip pans
summary: Passed. Cooked meatloaf was covered in plastic wrap while cooling and must be partly covered or uncovered. Aluminum foil lined drip pans on cooking equipment and must be removed. Cold-holding compressors were dusty, and a floor drain had food debris.

headline: Passed; leaking sink, no garbage lids, dirty coolers
summary: Passed. A basement hand sink leaked and must be repaired. The women's washroom garbage cans had no lids. Coolers and freezers needed detail cleaning, and floors around cooking equipment needed cleaning. A ceiling in the basement rear showed a black substance.

headline: Passed; wiping cloths on counter, deep cutting board
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were left on the coffee station counter and must be kept in sanitizer. A cutting board at the front prep station had deep cuts and needed repair or replacement.

headline: Passed with conditions; no manager during prep, hand sinks blocked
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager was present from 2:20 to 2:45 PM while chicken was prepared. Hand sinks in the bar and sushi areas were blocked, and the men's room lacked paper towels. Thawing in a plastic container and food in plastic bags were noted. Soil and grease were found throughout.

headline: Passed; greasy hood filters
summary: Passed. All hood ventilation filters had a buildup of grease. The operator must clean them to prevent contamination of food and food-contact surfaces below.

headline: Passed re-inspection; worn gaskets and cutting boards
summary: Passed re-inspection. Worn door gaskets on the walk-in freezer and a prep cooler must be repaired or replaced. Cutting boards on both front-line prep coolers had worn surfaces and deep grooves.

headline: Failed: no original manager certificate, poison above sink
summary: Failed. Only a photocopy of the manager's city certificate was provided, with no original posted. Pool shock chemical was stored above the 3-compartment sink. No employee health policy, coffee machine cleaning procedure, or backflow device was found, and no food handler certificates were provided.

headline: Failed: moldy ice machine, greasy cooking floors
summary: Failed. The ice machine used for ice was unclean, with black mildew-like substance. A 2-door cooler ran at 53°F and was tagged; it held no food. Floors under the cooking area had excessive grease. The ice machine backflow device could not be located, and mops need hanging.

headline: Passed with conditions; dish sanitizing skipped, blocked sink
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager was on site while TCS foods were handled. Utensils were blocking the prep hand sink. Dishes were washed without sanitizing, and the sanitize compartment was empty. Drinks were left above prep tables, and bulk containers lacked labels.

headline: Passed re-inspection; no air thermometers, broken knob
summary: Passed re-inspection. Two coolers lacked air thermometers. Unlabeled squirt bottles were noted. Four sticky traps were improperly placed above food prep and shelves of food. A hot-water knob needed a screwdriver to operate, and vent filters were dusty.

headline: Passed re-inspection; rodent-proofing gaps found
summary: Passed re-inspection. Half-inch gaps were found at the basement doorway and rear exit door, and management was told to rodent-proof all outer openings. Standing water sat between floor tiles, light shields were missing, and certified managers lacked valid allergen training.

headline: Passed; no covered trash can in restroom
summary: Passed. The downstairs employee restroom had no covered trash can. The operator was told to provide one.

headline: Failed: pest control records incomplete
summary: Failed. The pest control log lacked required information, and no pest control contract was on file. The paper towel dispenser was jammed. An unapproved water system description was noted, though no citation was issued.

headline: Passed re-inspection; entry gap, no backflow devices
summary: Passed re-inspection. An opening at the base of the front entrance door must be sealed to prevent pests. Two cold-holding unit door gaskets were damaged. Backflow devices could not be located on the utility sink or ice machine. Mops were drying in a bucket.

headline: Passed; dirty walk-in cooler and grease hood
summary: Passed. The walk-in cooler floor and shelves had dirt and food debris. Door dirt, lining at the grill and microwave station, and greasy hood filters over the wok station needed cleaning.

headline: Passed; personal items on prep table
summary: Passed. Cell phones and keys were stored on the front prep table. The manager was told to remove personal items from the prep area.

headline: Passed; missing and damaged floor tiles
summary: Passed. Several floor tiles were missing or damaged in the rear prep area. The operator must repair them to create a smooth, easy-to-clean surface.

headline: Passed; rusty shelving, opening in wall
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were stored on top of the 3-compartment sink. Items under that sink must be raised off the floor. Milk crates were used for elevation in the walk-in cooler, and rusty shelving and an unsealed wall opening needed attention.

headline: Passed re-inspection; rusty shelving, dirty surfaces
summary: Passed re-inspection. Wire shelving in the walk-in cooler was heavily rusted and must be repainted or replaced. Storage containers, prep coolers, the wok station, and prep tables had grease and food buildup. Wall openings for pipes must be sealed.

headline: Passed with conditions; no paper towels, untagged fly trap
summary: Passed with conditions. Paper towels were missing at a cold-prep hand sink. A fly trap was placed above clean dishes and must be moved. A soiled hose sat by clean dishes, and a food handler lacked a hair restraint. Bulk containers lacked labels and a cooler thermometer was missing.

headline: Passed; unlabeled containers and slow drain
summary: Passed. Dry storage containers lacked labels, and the 3-compartment sink drained slowly. The operator was told to label containers and repair the sink.

headline: Passed; rodent gap and missing light bulbs
summary: Passed. Bulk containers in the prep area lacked labels. A half-inch gap at the revolving door must be rodent-proofed. A cooler door gasket was loose, several ceiling bulbs were burned out, and some hood filters were missing.

headline: Failed: coolers off, no health policy, no hand sink
summary: Failed. No certified manager certificate, employee health policy, or vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure was on premises. The prep area had no hand sink. All coolers and freezers were off, and there was no pest logbook or thermometer for the dish machine. Mop sink lacked a backflow device.

headline: Passed re-inspection; trash lid and light shield needed
summary: Passed re-inspection. The toilet room must have a garbage can with a lid. The prep area must have a light shield with end caps.

headline: Failed: moldy ice machine, foods held over 24 hours
summary: Failed. The basement ice machine had black slime, and the ice is used for consumption. Ready-to-eat TCS foods were held more than 24 hours without proper date marking. Also: no hand-wash signs, no hair restraint, ice scoops stored inside the ice machine, and many repair items.

headline: Passed; greasy stove, damaged cutting boards
summary: Passed. Grease had built up on the sides of the stove and fryer. Cutting surfaces had stains and deep grooves. The operator must clean and repair or replace them.

headline: Failed: hole in faucet, peeling paint, prior violations
summary: Failed. The 3-compartment sink faucet had a large hole and needed repair or replacement. Paint was peeling on kitchen and bathroom walls. Prior core violations were not corrected: peeling paint and food debris on cooler shelving, dirty floors, and dirty hood filters.

headline: Passed; uncovered scoops and wall gap
summary: Passed. Scoops were stored uncovered on steam tables. A large opening under the 3-compartment sink needed enclosing to prevent pest entry. Food debris behind cooling units needed cleaning. Allergen training was required for certified managers.

headline: Passed re-inspection; no food handler certificates on site
summary: Passed re-inspection. Wet wiping cloths were on prep surfaces. Food debris and spills were found throughout the facility. No food handler certificates were on site, and a line cook lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed; missing drainboard, certificates, ventilation
summary: Passed. The 3-compartment sink had no drainboard. The men's restroom had no ventilation. Kitchen staff lacked food handler certificates, and the food service manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed; missing thermometers, wall gap
summary: Passed. Thermometers inside cooling units were broken or missing and must be replaced. A gap of at least a quarter inch between the floor and a wall in rear storage must be enclosed.

headline: Passed re-inspection; leaks, chipping ceiling, one allergen cert missing
summary: Passed re-inspection. Items were stored on floors. Water leaked from a 3-compartment sink stopper. A grease container was dirty, and ceiling and pipe finishes were chipped. Dust and debris needed cleaning. One employee lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed re-inspection; storage and upkeep problems
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food and equipment were stored on floors, soiled wiping cloths sat on sinks, and oversized pots had no alternative washing method. Dirty surfaces, clutter, and broken ceiling, floor, and outlet covers were also noted. The manager was told to correct each item.

headline: Failed: 70°F hand sink, dead bugs, uncovered food
summary: Failed. The hand sink measured 70°F, below the required 100°F, and a citation was issued. Dead bugs were on the dry storage floor and must be removed. Food was uncovered in coolers. Grease and debris were in the fryer cabinet, and floors and walls had grime and spills.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, no training proof
summary: Failed. No certified person in charge was on the premises. The high-temperature dish machine sanitized at 170°F, and it was repaired on site to 180°F. No chlorine test kit or proof of food handler or allergen training was provided.

headline: Passed; missing hand-wash signs and cleaning items
summary: Passed. Hand-wash signage was missing at a rear sink. Shelves had slight debris, the ice machine lacked a backflow device, and the garbage lid, wall bases, and walk-in cooler floor needed cleaning.

headline: Passed; untrained food handlers, torn gasket
summary: Passed. A torn gasket on a 2-door prep cooler must be replaced. Mezzanine storage floor tiles needed repair. Several food handlers lacked food handler certificates, and the certified manager lacked a valid allergen certificate.

headline: Passed; food debris and personal items stored
summary: Passed. Food debris was on floors in the front and rear prep areas. Employee personal items were stored on shelving in the rear prep area. The person in charge was told to clean and provide a separate storage space.

headline: Passed re-inspection; lighting, storage, allergen training
