summary: Passed re-inspection. Dried debris was found inside cooling units and prep shelving. Basement items were stored on floors. Lighting was inadequate in the front prep area. Only one of two certified managers had allergen training.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager during prep
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge held a valid certificate, and no certified manager was on duty while chicken, pizza, and fries were prepared. Milk crates were used as shelving, and floors and corners had grease. Burned-out bulbs were replaced on site.

headline: Failed: no manager on site, no vomit kit, no training
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on premises until 2:00 PM, when one arrived and this was corrected on site. No vomit and diarrhea spill kit was present, and no test kit was available for the dish machine. Prior core violations were not corrected: no food handler training and no allergen certificate.

headline: Passed; hand-wash sign, cracked tile, burnt bulbs
summary: Passed. A hand-wash sign was needed at the front prep sink. Single-service to-go containers were not inverted. A cracked wall tile, dusty vents, and burnt-out light bulbs above cooking equipment needed attention.

headline: Passed; leaking hot-water handle at sink
summary: Passed. The hot-water handle on the 3-compartment sink leaked during use. The manager was instructed to repair it.

headline: Passed re-inspection; standing water from leaky pipe
summary: Passed re-inspection. Standing water was found under the dishwashing machine where a leaky pipe was observed. The operator must repair the pipe and maintain the area.

headline: Failed: food held too warm, no paper towels
summary: Failed. Eggs at 73.2°F, pepperoni at 49.5°F, and ham near 50°F were held too warm (cold foods must stay at 41°F or below). About 7 lb was discarded. Paper towels were missing at hand sinks until staff obtained them. A cooler repaired on site dropped to 40.2°F.

headline: Passed; greasy hood, dusty vent, dirty floors
summary: Passed. A large can opener needed cleaning to remove buildup. Rear prep floors had food spills and buildup. Hood vents had grease buildup, and the air vent above the 3-compartment sink had dust.

headline: Failed: over 100 mouse droppings, dead mouse
summary: Failed. Approximately 100 or more mouse droppings were found on and under food, paper, and chemical shelves, in cooler areas, and in storage. A dead mouse was behind a display case. Droppings must be removed and a pest control service is recommended.

headline: Passed re-inspection; missing hot-water knob
summary: Passed re-inspection. The front hand sink was missing its hot-water knob. The manager was told to replace it and maintain it.

headline: Passed; floor drain buildup
summary: Passed. Buildup was found in the floor drain in the kitchen prep area. The person in charge was told to clean and maintain it.

headline: Failed: live roaches, no health or cleanup policy
summary: Failed. Two live roaches were found on the premises. No employee health policy, no vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure with spill kit, and no allergen training for the sanitation manager were on site.

headline: Passed; debris in walk-in coolers, damaged wall
summary: Passed. Debris was on racks, fan guards, and a meat slicer in the deli and dairy cooler areas. Dust was on vents, ice was on the walk-in freezer floor, and walls and hood filters needed cleaning. A damaged wall and a hole in the dairy cooler must be repaired.

headline: No certified food manager during food service
summary: No person in charge with a valid city food sanitation certificate, and no certified food manager on duty while chicken, sandwiches and fries were prepared and served. Milk crates used as shelving; grease, food debris and dirt on floors, walls and corners.

headline: Hair restraint missing; prior violations uncorrected
summary: Food handler not wearing hair restraint while preparing food. Soiled wiping cloths stored on prep tables; soiled mop heads not stored to prevent insect breeding. Prior core violation not corrected: no food prep sink at front coffee bar.

headline: No health policy; restroom missing items
summary: No written employee health policy on premises; signed policy needed for each employee. Employee washroom lacks a covered waste receptacle and a self-closing door; management instructed to provide both.

headline: No certified food manager during stew service
summary: No person in charge with valid certificate, and no food sanitation manager on site when stew at 154.5F was prepared and served. Unlabeled food containers in coolers. Gaps at front entrance and basement doors. Unused coolers hold clutter. No allergen training for certified managers.

headline: Torn cooler gasket and ceiling hole noted
summary: Serving plates on kitchen shelves were not inverted, which allows dust buildup. A torn rubber gasket on a two-door kitchen refrigerator needs repair. A hole in the bathroom ceiling must be repaired.

headline: No backflow devices at ice and espresso machines
summary: No backflow prevention devices found at the ice machine and espresso machine. Must provide them in locations where they can be serviced.

headline: No covered trash receptacle in women's restroom
summary: Women's washroom had no covered trash receptacle; one must be provided.

headline: Sewage backing up from floor drain at sink
summary: Wastewater with black debris and a foul smell backed up from a floor drain when the three-compartment sink drained. Ordered repaired so water drains properly. Ice machine interior panel had slight debris buildup.

headline: No certified manager; no dish machine thermometer
summary: No certified food manager on site and no certificate posted while steaming milk. High-temperature dish machine lacked temperature measuring devices. Live potted plants above food prep and handwash sink must be removed.

headline: Rodent droppings, dead mouse, and live flies
summary: Dead mouse on a trap in the furnace closet was removed on site. Found 40+ rodent droppings under the utility sink, in the furnace closet and under the front counter, plus live flies in kitchen and dish area. Pest control recommended before reinspection.

headline: Repeat violations: drain stoppers, allergen certificate
summary: Repeat core violations from prior report: missing three-compartment sink drain stoppers and no allergen training certificate. Also: no handwashing sign at bar sink, hood over rear prep oven does not turn on, and unused basement restroom needs out-of-order signage.

headline: Missing handwashing signage; coffee grounds on floor
summary: Handwashing signage needed at a handsink. Floor needs cleaning of coffee grounds and beans.

headline: Utensils not inverted; greasy caster wheels
summary: Eating utensils, plates and bowls not inverted after sanitizing; manager instructed to invert them. Caster wheels under reach-in freezer and deep fryers encrusted with grease and food debris; cleaning frequency to be increased.

headline: No vomiting/diarrhea response plan; report not posted
summary: No written plan or supplies for vomit and diarrhea cleanup; required kit includes gloves, masks, disposable mops and norovirus-effective sanitizer. Previous inspection summary was not posted for the public; today's is now displayed. Cooler racks need dust cleaning.

headline: No certified food manager on site during prep
summary: No certified food manager on site while pork and chicken were being prepped. Hand soap and paper towels missing at several handsinks. Ribs (47.8F) and chicken (49.7F) discarded; walk-in cooler 53.4F, prep cooler 57F, which was tagged.

headline: Hood light not working in front prep
summary: Re-inspection passed. One nonworking hood light in the front prep area must be replaced or repaired for adequate light.

headline: Hair restraints, bulbs, and certificate issues
summary: Food handlers not wearing hair restraints; prep area shelves have food debris; two light bulbs out above prep area; one food handler lacked a food handler certificate.

headline: Brown buildup inside ice machine
summary: Re-inspection passed. Slight brown buildup on the interior panel above the ice inside the ice machine. Must clean, sanitize and maintain.

headline: Greasy fryer cabinets, sink stoppers, cracked floor tiles
summary: Re-inspection passed. Heavy grease inside fryer cabinets, improper plastic sink stoppers, cracked floor tiles with worn grout at the cooking line, and a two-burner stove not under a ventilation hood. Each item was ordered corrected.

headline: No certified manager during pizza service
summary: No certified food manager on site while pizza was prepared and served. Handwashing sign missing at dish-area sink; two broken wall tiles near packaged flour; dusty hood filters. Citation issued.

headline: No covered receptacle; cluttered storage closet
summary: No covered receptacle in female staff restroom. Storage closet across from office is excessively cluttered; items must be organized and kept at least six inches from the floor.

headline: Foil liner on prep surfaces; basement clutter
summary: Foil used as a liner on prep surfaces in the rear prep area must be removed; nonfood-contact surfaces must stay smooth and cleanable. Basement storage cluttered and blocking access; items must be kept off the floor.

headline: Exposed backflow device missing; medicine stored near food
summary: No exposed backflow prevention device for the ice maker; must be exposed. Employee medicine stored on food shelves; must be kept in a designated area away from food storage.

headline: Rodent droppings, no hand soap, unsafe food temperatures
summary: About 60 small rodent droppings found on prep tables, boxes and floors. Hot food held at 75-95F and cold food at 60-85F; food discarded. No hand cleanser at handsinks. Pest control required. Hair restraints and grease buildup also noted.

headline: Low sanitizer and hot water; cold food discarded
summary: Student-run flex kitchen dish sink sanitizing at 0 ppm; instructor drained and reset it. Handsink hot water at 84.1F and restroom sinks at 56F, which needs 100F. About 69.5 lbs cold food discarded. Leaks, loose splash guards and debris also cited.

headline: Dirty rusty shelving; damaged floor tiles
summary: Re-inspection passed. Walk-in cooler shelving dirty and rusty; must clean and remove rust. Missing and damaged floor tiles and grout across front prep cook line must be repaired.

headline: Live cockroaches found in ice machine
summary: Inspector saw 2 live cockroaches crawling inside the ice machine, plus dead roaches near it and the water heater. Ice machine ordered out of use until cleaned and pests eliminated; pest control recommended. Brown residue inside ice machine also noted.

headline: No signed health policies; broken lobby window
summary: No signed employee health policies were on site; must be provided. A broken lobby window must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Raw wood shelf and crowded storage room
summary: Raw wood shelf in rear storage room must be sealed or painted. Rear storage room must be reorganized; usable items kept six inches off the floor.

headline: Slime in upstairs ice machine; wet wiping cloths
summary: Pink and black slime buildup on top interior of upstairs ice machine; priority violation and citation. Several wet wiping cloths stored on floors and counters. Torn freezer gasket, slow sink drain, and floor debris under the ice machine and in the bar.

headline: Grease on ovens; no self-closing restroom doors
summary: Re-inspection passed. Grease buildup on ovens, nearby shelves and a hot holding unit needed cleaning. Restroom doors lacked self-closing devices; management instructed to install them.

headline: Milk and cream left out at room temperature
summary: Two pitchers of whole milk (48F) and half-and-half (50F) left out at room temperature in the cafe dining area; about 7 lbs discarded. Pans not inverted in second-floor bar and grill prep area.

headline: No metal thermometers; hair restraints needed
summary: No metal-stem thermometers for internal temperatures were on site. Food handlers not wearing hair restraints. Walk-in cooler storage racks dirty and cardboard present; floors warped and damaged; light shield missing; some staff lack food handler training.

headline: Low hot water pressure at prep handsink
summary: Low hot water pressure at a handsink in the prep area. Management was instructed to repair it.

headline: Missing cooler thermometers; grime on handsinks
summary: No thermometers in two one-door reach-in coolers; working ones must be provided. Food and grime buildup around prep and washroom handsink handles must be cleaned. Small holes in wall above label table must be sealed.

headline: Live cockroach infestation; cold food too warm
summary: About 50 live cockroaches seen across food prep, dining, dry storage and dish areas; pest control required. Cold foods at 44-52F in prep coolers, and a prep cooler at 55F. No paper towels at a dish-area handsink. Pest log had no service reports in a year.

headline: Spider web, missing sink stoppers, chipped paint
summary: Spider web over women's restroom to be removed. Three-compartment sink stoppers missing for all compartments. Rusted walk-in storage racks; foil on equipment and walk-in walls must be removed. Chipped paint and exposed caulk need repair.

headline: Repeat rat droppings; missing certificates
summary: Previous rat droppings not corrected: 7 along dish area walls, 15 under coolers, 80 in seating booths. No sanitation manager certificate posted; food handler and allergen certificates missing. No handsink by front food counter. Cluttered, dirty floors and equipment.

headline: Rodent droppings, too-warm gumbo and raw fish
summary: About 70 rodent droppings found under fryers, in the basement, and in storage areas. Gumbo at 100.6F and raw fish at 60.1F discarded. Men's restroom handsink hot water at 85.1F was corrected on site. Allergen certificate still missing from prior inspection.

headline: No employee health policy; broken sink stopper
summary: No verifiable employee health policy on site; template left and signed copies must be kept. Center stopper of three-compartment sink does not work. No covered trash receptacle in upstairs toilet room. No allergen training certificates on site.

headline: Dishes stored under handsink; cardboard used
summary: Clean dishes stored under a handwash sink; preset tableware must be covered. Cardboard used as food containers, shelf matting and splash guards; peeling plastic on rear cooler; dirty floor drain under three-compartment sink.

headline: Gas oven not under hood
summary: Gas oven was not under a ventilation hood. Management must relocate or remove it.

headline: Dirty air ducts and loose wall base noted
summary: Black substance on dining area air ducts and dust and grease on kitchen vents must be detail cleaned. Loose wall base behind cooking equipment had food debris and must be repaired. Dish area floors, walls and drains need detail cleaning.

headline: No hot water at employee handsink; plumber fixed
summary: Employee washroom handsink measured 86.3F, below the required 100F; plumber restored hot water during inspection. Ice scoops stored improperly on containers and in ice bin. Rusty walk-in shelving; ice buildup; leaking faucet; peeling paint noted.

headline: Front prep cooler missing thermometer
summary: Prep cooler at the front counter had no thermometer. Management was instructed to provide one in its warmest part.

headline: Hair restraints, dirty display cases, restroom door
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food handlers handled meat without hair restraints. Meat cooler and bakery display cases had dried food debris. Restroom lacked a self-closing door. Each item was ordered corrected.

headline: No health policy; allergen training missing
summary: No verifiable employee health policy on site; a blank template was left. One of two certified managers on duty lacked allergen training. Unnecessary hose on sanitizer dispenser above mop sink. Menu items served raw or undercooked lacked required consumer advisory.

headline: 15-20 dead insects on basement floor
summary: About 15-20 dead insects, including crickets, flies and centipedes, on basement perimeter floor; removal and cleaning instructed. In-use utensils stored in room-temperature sanitizer; floor under three-compartment sink soiled; grease drip above cooking equipment.

headline: No employee health policy; vehicle wastewater issue
summary: No employee health policy on site; must be provided. Half-inch gap at rear exit and passenger window needs rodent-proofing. Mobile food vehicle's wastewater tank failed to convey properly; repaired during inspection.

headline: Torn cooler gasket repair needed
summary: Re-inspection passed. Torn gasket on the bottom of a three-door reach-in cooler in the rear prep area must be repaired.

headline: Hair restraints, dusty vents, stained ceiling tiles
summary: Food handlers not wearing proper hair restraints. Dust on washroom ceiling fan, dirty floor corners and furnace closet, and water-stained ceiling tiles to be replaced. All food handlers must obtain required training.

headline: Walk-in temperature display not working
summary: External temperature display for walk-in cooler and freezer not functioning; internal thermometer showed proper cold temperature under 41F. Water-stained ceiling tiles, chipped paint, a 4-inch wall hole, and missing grout on prep floors noted.

headline: Ice machine cleaning and hair restraints needed
summary: Re-inspection passed. Ice machine interior needs detail cleaning. Service staff must tie long hair and wear hair restraints. Cutting boards worn and discolored; delicatessen window handle missing; equipment and floors need detail cleaning.

headline: 125+ live roaches throughout premises
summary: Infestation of 125+ live roaches throughout, plus 60+ live small flies. Pest control required on or after 8/24/26. Dish machines at 0 ppm sanitizer, repaired on site. Cold foods at 45.3-60F discarded.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; pots not inverted
summary: Two handsinks in the bar and dish areas lacked handwashing signage. Some pots and containers not stored inverted.

headline: Leaky sink, grease, and missing restroom signs
summary: Re-inspection passed. Leaky middle compartment of three-compartment sink must be repaired. Poor-repair restroom handsink and missing handwashing signs noted. Grease and debris on cooler, equipment and floors; cracked tiles; burnt-out hood light.

headline: Food on floor; missing food handler training
summary: Food stored on walk-in freezer floor must be elevated six inches. Also noted: stacked plates not inverted, torn freezer gasket, missing stoppers for three-compartment sink, unused grill outdoors, and a cook without required food handler training.

headline: Live roaches on dish machine wall and piping
summary: Live roaches crawling on wall and piping beside the dish machine. Area must be removed and detail cleaned; pest control service required. Priority citation issued. Deep freezers need defrosting; floors and walls around cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Glove change and handwashing violation observed
summary: Employee moved between prep areas wearing gloves, wiped a pan, then scooped ham without washing hands or changing gloves. No certified manager on site while beef, chicken and omelets were prepared. No paper towels at handsinks; heavy clutter in dry storage.

headline: Vomit cleanup supplies missing; backflow devices absent
summary: Items needed for the written vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure were not on site. Opening at rear exit door base. Missing splash guards at two handsinks. No backflow devices on fountain, coffee and ice machine water lines.

headline: No certified manager; handwashing at wrong sink
summary: No certified food manager on duty while pasta, chicken and deli foods were prepared and served. Employees washed hands at a one-compartment sink instead of a handsink. Very low handsink water pressure; cracked dish area floor; employee belongings stored with food.

headline: Gap under garage door needs sealing
summary: Re-inspection passed. A gap along the bottom of the garage and man-door frame must be repaired or replaced with a tight-fitting seal.

headline: No certified manager on duty; shellfish tag missing
summary: No certified food manager on duty while chicken, lamb and beef were prepared and served. Chicken at 75.5F (30 lbs) discarded. Oyster shellstock tag missing; 20 lbs discarded. Soap and paper towels missing at handsinks, some supplied during inspection.

headline: Ice machine soiled; cold food discarded
summary: Ice machine drop plate and interior had pink residue; ice use stopped, ice discarded, and surfaces ordered cleaned. Lasagna at 50.7F, grilled onions at 72.5F and raw beef patties at 48.7F; about 20 lbs discarded.

headline: Dish machine not reaching sanitizing temperature
summary: Hot-water dish machine's final utensil surface temperature was 148F; sanitizing requires 160F. Machine was tagged and a priority citation issued. Light debris buildup on bar-area floor also noted.

headline: No health policy; cooler temperature too high
summary: No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea plan on site. Middle prep cooler ran 50-55.1F; must be 41F or below. Missing paper towels, chlorine test strips and allergen training certificates. Bar handsink must be relocated.

headline: No certified food manager during sandwich service
summary: No person in charge or food employee with a valid city-certified food manager certificate was on site while sandwiches, salads and soups were prepared and served. Also noted: worn cooler gaskets, a toilet spraying excess water, and a damaged sprinkler cover.

headline: Reach-in coolers, shelves, and fryers need cleaning
summary: Reach-in cooler interiors, storage shelves and cooking equipment need detail cleaning. Wiping cloths not kept in sanitizing solution; utensil stored between cooler and wall; soiled linens need a sealed container. Leak at three-compartment faucet.

headline: Faucet repair and food discard dates needed
summary: Handwash sink faucet in poor repair; hot-water knob hard to turn. Cooked beef and chicken held over 24 hours in front prep cooler had no discard date; priority violation.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; dirty ice machine and surfaces
summary: Passed. Large bulk food containers in rear storage need commodity-name labels. Ice machine interior needs detail cleaning, as do large cutting boards, prep tables, storage shelves, and floors and grout throughout the prep areas.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure; restroom issues
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure with spill kit found; must be provided. Restrooms lack handwashing signage, self-closing doors, and a lower-level exhaust vent.

headline: No certified manager; missing paper towels
summary: No certified food manager on site while chicken, soup, rice and pizza were handled. No paper towels at bakery and produce prep handsinks. Also noted: stained cutting boards, improperly stored wiping cloths, and a water leak under the meat handsink.

headline: Ice machine slime; cold food discarded
summary: Black and pink slime buildup inside ice machine used for human consumption; ice removed, detail cleaning and sanitizing ordered. Walk-in cooler held fried rice, chicken and beef at 45.3-46.2F; about 25 lbs discarded. Two of three employees lacked food handler training (repeat violation).

headline: Rusty grease trap top and cluttered storage
summary: Top of the grease trap under the front three-compartment sink had excessive rust and must be restored to a smooth surface. Bent lids on outdoor recycling bins need replacing. Storage closet clutter must be cleared, with kept items 6 inches off the ground.

headline: Floor debris and soil buildup in kitchen
summary: Floors throughout the kitchen, including under the three-compartment sink and coolers at the rear, had debris and soil buildup. Manager instructed to clean.

headline: Moldy ham found and discarded
summary: Diced ham with white and green mold in a cook-line cooler was discarded. Sausage at 43F and chili at 51.9-53F discarded (about 30 lbs). Cutting boards deeply cut and stained; seasonings in unlabeled containers; broken ceiling tile noted.

headline: Slow drain; no covered restroom receptacle
summary: Slow drainage at the rear restroom handsink; to be repaired. Unisex employee washroom lacked a covered waste receptacle for feminine hygiene products; one must be provided.

headline: Missing basement handsink; storage problems found
summary: No exposed handsink in the basement prep and dish area; one must be installed. Clean equipment stored under unshielded sewer lines must be moved. Large bags of rice stored on floor; six-inch shelving required. No citation issued for the handsink.

headline: Towels fixed on site; door gap, storage issues
summary: No paper towels at an employee handsink, corrected on site. Opening at front door base must be sealed. Soda stored in washroom, cardboard shelf liners, and items on floors must be moved. Damaged washroom floor tiles and stained ceiling noted.

headline: 300+ live flies and rat droppings found
summary: Over 300 live small flies throughout, and over 50 rat droppings in basement dish room and rear storage. Sour cream and other cold foods at 60-65F; about 100 lbs discarded. No food handler training certificates, health policy, or chemical test kit on site.

headline: Small flies and a live roach found
summary: More than 15 small flies and one live cockroach seen throughout the facility. Manager instructed to service all pest-affected areas. Priority citation issued.

headline: Consumer advisory added to all menus
summary: Re-inspection passed. Consumer advisory disclosure for raw or undercooked food was added to all menus, corrected during inspection.

headline: Leaking drain, low hot water, no drainboard
summary: No drainboard for three-compartment sink in kitchen; manager told to provide one for air drying. Leaking drain under handwash sink and low hot water pressure at three-compartment sink. Openings in walls to seal; grease on hood filters; no allergen training for certified managers.

headline: Over 60 small flies; soap added on site
summary: Over 60 small flies seen in basement and first floor; pest control recommended on or after 10/21/2024. Handwashing soap missing in basement dish area, corrected on site. Steak menu lacked undercooked-food asterisk; corrected before inspection ended.

headline: Milk crates and cardboard used as shelving
summary: Re-inspection passed. Items must be elevated off the floor, and milk crates and cardboard must not be used as shelving or liners. Cook-line exterior equipment has grease and food debris; soiled mop heads drying on the rear stairwell.

headline: Missing hair restraints; several cleaning items
summary: Food handlers lacked hair or beard restraints. Floor fan in front prep area very dusty; black buildup on caulking at three-compartment sink; floor drain beneath that sink had debris. All must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food handler certificates expired and must be renewed. Allergen training for the certified manager also expired. Cold holding unit interior dirty; rear dry storage wall has peeling paint needing repair.

headline: Floor storage, leaking stopper, chipping ceiling
summary: Re-inspection passed. Bottles and containers on floors need shelving six inches up. Leaking three-compartment sink stopper, chipping basement ceiling, stained pipe, and dusty, debris-filled floors and walls noted. One employee lacked allergen training certificate.

headline: Fly traps installed; dish machine indicator needed
summary: Fly traps were installed above the food prep area; manager instructed to remove them. Knives wedged between prep coolers must be kept in a clean place. High-temperature dish machine needs an irreversible temperature indicator; priority foundation violation.

headline: Microwave, handsink leak, hood filters
summary: Food debris inside microwave must be cleaned. Pipe leaking at front handsink needs repair. Grease buildup on hood filters must be cleaned.

headline: Heavy ice in freezer; hot dog steamer dirty
summary: Heavy ice buildup inside box freezer needs defrosting. Dirt and grime inside hot dog steamer need detail cleaning. No allergen training certificates on site for employees holding food manager certificates.

headline: Raw meat in plastic grocery bags in freezer
summary: Raw meats were stored inside plastic grocery bags in the freezer. Manager must use food-grade plastic bags only to store meats.

headline: Clogged handsink and multiple cleaning issues
summary: Handsink in main food prep area clogged and not draining; priority violation, repaired by return visit on 2/25/25. Wiping cloths stored on tables; items on floor; dust on vents; dirty drains; employee belongings in food areas; manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No certified food manager during cooking and serving
summary: No certified food manager on site while chicken and creamy sauces were cooked and served. Ice machine interior and ice bin not clean; ice used for consumption. Food handler training certificate missing. Outside refuse area had debris and spills.

headline: Missing thermometers in all coolers
summary: No thermometers were found in any coolers. Management was instructed to provide them.

headline: Over 100 rat droppings; gaps let pests in
summary: Over 100 rat droppings found in parking-garage dry storage, where food and single-use items were stored. Open garage doors and gaps allow pest entry. Pest control recommended on or after 5/13/2025. Rusty shelving, dirty hood filters and missing grout also noted.

headline: Rodent droppings, gnats, and cold food discarded
summary: About 40 rodent droppings on the floor in the rear dish room and under a handsink; about 20 gnats in prep and dish areas. Pest control service needed. About 190 lbs of cold food discarded. No metal-stem thermometer on site.

headline: Low water pressure at bathroom handsinks
summary: Both bathroom handsinks had low water pressure. Management must repair and maintain adequate pressure.

headline: Missing hot water handle at dish sink
summary: Re-inspection passed. The hot water handle on the dishwashing area three-compartment sink was missing; management must provide one.

headline: Food handler not wearing hair restraint
summary: A food handler was not wearing an effective hair restraint while preparing food. Must wear one when preparing food.

headline: Unused ice machine; greasy oil container
summary: Unused ice machine near the POS system must be put into service or removed from the premises. Slight grease buildup on the outside of the used cooking oil container in the rear yard must be cleaned.

headline: Ice machine buildup; damaged restroom wall
summary: Buildup inside the ice machine; person in charge must detail clean it. A damaged wall in the restroom around the sink must be repaired.

headline: No signed health policy; no vomit cleanup supplies
summary: No signed employee health policy on the premises (priority violation). No vomit or diarrhea cleanup supplies on the premises; management must provide them. A missing wall tile next to the front service line must be installed.

headline: Fail: live flying insects; undated food discarded
summary: About 30 live small flying insects on walls and ceiling tiles in rear prep and dishwashing areas; citation issued and pest service needed. Cooked lamb and sauces held over 24 hours were not date-marked; about 8 lbs ($70) discarded.

headline: Re-inspection: expired food handler certificates
summary: Re-inspection found expired food handler certificates for employees on site. Manager must ensure all food handlers obtain and keep current training and proof.

headline: Re-inspection: food handler without hair restraint
summary: Re-inspection found a female food handler without a proper hair restraint, such as a cap or hair net. The employee was instructed to wear one.

headline: Leaking handsink repaired on site
summary: A leak and slow drain at the front prep handwash sink were repaired by an employee during inspection, and the sink now drains properly. Women's and unisex restrooms lack lidded trash cans, and certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Cleaning needed; water-stained ceiling tiles
summary: Cooking equipment exteriors, fryer bottoms, prep tables, and inside refrigeration units need cleaning. Floors under and around equipment and spillage in the walk-in cooler need cleaning. Water-stained ceiling tiles should be replaced where needed.

headline: Dirty wiping cloths; heavy hood grease
summary: Dirty wiping cloths on front and rear prep tables were not stored in sanitizing solution. Heavy dirt and grease inside and on edges of the exhaust hood, filters, and pipes or conduits; detail cleaning required.

headline: Chicken thawed improperly; expired allergen training
summary: Chicken was being thawed improperly; it must thaw overnight in the walk-in cooler or under cold running water. A knife was stored on the handle at the bottom of the deep fryer, and the certified manager's allergen training certificate was expired.

headline: Debris on equipment; no food handler training
summary: Debris on cooking equipment, shelving, coolers, and freezers; leaking drainpipe under the three-compartment sink; damaged floor tiles. Employees have no food handler training available, and the certified manager has no allergen training.

headline: Slow-draining mop sink; sprayer leaks
summary: The mop sink drains slowly and must be repaired and maintained. Leaks were also noted at the three-compartment sink sprayer.

headline: Dirty floors and floor drains throughout
summary: Floors and floor drains are dirty throughout the premises; they must be detail cleaned and kept free of spills and debris, including floors inside the walk-in cooler.

headline: Condenser leak contaminated ready-to-eat shrimp and crab
summary: A refrigerator condenser leaked onto ready-to-eat crab meat, ready-to-eat shrimp, and raw shrimp. The manager discarded the foods during inspection; condenser must be repaired. Citation issued. Dirt on produce prep area floor also noted.

headline: Unapproved meat smoking; about 200 lbs held
summary: An employee smoked meat without an approved HACCP plan (a required food-safety process plan) or variance. About 200 lbs of smoked pork (about $900) were tagged and held, and smoking must stop until approved. Food debris on basement floors.

headline: Fail: unlabeled packaged foods; allergen info missing
summary: Packaged bakery and retail foods lacked ingredient labels or manufacturer name and address, and lacked allergen information; priority violation and citation issued. Interior of sushi cooler, shelving, microwave, and fryers need cleaning; mold on wall behind dish machine.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen training
summary: Some food handler certificates were expired, and city food managers' allergen training had expired. Management must show valid food handler training proof and recertify managers' allergen training, keeping certificates on site.

headline: Black mold-like buildup inside ice machine
summary: Black mold-like buildup inside the ice machine (ice not for human use); person in charge must clean it. Three-compartment sink lacks labels, food residue in cold-hold gaskets, a leak under a rear handsink, and missing basement baseboards and wall covers.

headline: Fail: 40 mouse droppings; no backflow device
summary: Evidence of mice: 40 droppings along front walls and by the three-compartment sink; citation issued. Pest control operator must be notified and droppings removed. No backflow prevention device at the mop sink faucet.

headline: Grease and food debris on equipment and floors
summary: Grease and food debris on interior and exterior of cooking equipment, prep tables, holding units, coolers, and the freezer. Grease and debris on floors under all equipment and in corners of prep, storage, and dishwashing areas. Manager instructed to clean.

headline: Clutter under basement stairs; dusty vents
summary: Clutter under basement stairs must be cleared to prevent pest harborage. Floor under and around equipment in the rear prep area needs detail cleaning. Dust covers all vents in the rear food prep and service area.

headline: Loose door sweep; leaking drains; spills outside
summary: Residue inside the ice machine and a loose door sweep between front entrance doors. Spills and debris on cooking equipment, coolers, and freezers; leaking drainpipes under handwash sinks and the meat prep three-compartment sink; debris around grease dumpster.

headline: Fail: sanitizer too concentrated; broken gauge
summary: Lactic acid sanitizer at the three-compartment sink measured about 2258 ppm, above the 1875 ppm maximum on the label; a technician serviced the facility. Front dish machine's temperature measuring device is broken; citation issued.

headline: Fail: dirty ice machine; overflowing dumpsters
summary: Top inside of the ice machine was not clean; ice must be removed, and interior surfaces cleaned and sanitized. Both outside dumpsters had lids that could not close due to overflowing trash; citation issued. Floors under dry storage racks and near the ice machine need cleaning.

headline: Complaint: storage, dirty floors, damaged facilities
summary: Soft drink boxes stored on the floor and wiping cloths left on dry food containers. Dirt and debris in dishwashing area and produce cooler, wet and broken dishwashing room floor, blackened caulking, and a broken light shield.

headline: Re-inspection: handsink and drain repairs
summary: Must provide a metered handsink in the prep area that runs for at least 20 seconds without reactivation. Handsink beside the three-compartment sink drains slowly. Dried food splatter on walls must be cleaned to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Numerous dead roaches on glue boards
summary: Re-inspection found numerous dead roaches on glue boards and equipment in prep and bar areas; manager must remove them. Employees have no food handler training. Grease and food debris on fryers and coolers, and loose faucet and missing outlet covers.

headline: Re-inspection: no splashguards; washroom lacks lidded bin
summary: Re-inspection found no splashguards between handsinks and three-compartment sinks; these must be installed and maintained. The women's washroom lacks a waste receptacle with a lid and must be provided.

headline: Greasy fryers; food debris in cooler; allergen gap
summary: Food debris at the base of a two-door reach-in cooler, heavy grease and debris on a deep fryer and wok, and a loose front handsink faucet. Dirty floors and walls near the three-compartment sink; dusty walk-in fan. No allergen training certificate for the certified manager.

headline: No vomit kit; gap under front door
summary: Required vomit and diarrhea cleanup equipment is missing on site (priority violation). The front entrance door has a 1/4 inch open gap at the bottom that needs a tight seal. No proof of food handler training for employees.

headline: No health policy or vomit kit; missing backflow
summary: No employee health policy on site (priority violation). No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure on site. No visible backflow preventer on the mop sink faucet. Certified food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Re-inspection: no backflow; floor grease and tile
summary: No backflow device at the basement utility sink and a leak at the base of the basement three-compartment sink faucet. Encrusted grease on floors by the cook station; cracked and broken floor tiles; clutter in basement storage. Grease and dust on hood vents.

headline: Missing signage, thermometers, and allergen training
summary: Main cook line handwash sink is missing signage. Cold holding units lack internal thermometers. Rear prep handsink drain is in poor repair and drains slowly. Several certified managers lack allergen awareness training certificates.

headline: Basement three-compartment sink drains slowly
summary: The three-compartment sink in the basement drains slowly. The person in charge must repair and maintain it.

headline: Fail: about 60 mouse droppings in basement
summary: About 60 mouse droppings on the basement storage floor under shelves; citation issued and additional pest control needed. Also noted: missing handwash signage, unlabeled food containers, torn cooler door gaskets, and greasy equipment and walls.

headline: Complaint: no certified manager; no vomit cleanup kit
summary: No one on site held a city food service manager certificate while TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site. Holes in walls under the three-compartment sink and near the pastry freezer must be sealed; allergen training required.

headline: Cleaning needed; food handler lacks training
summary: Cleaning needed on pizza oven top, low-temp dish machine, prep tables, shelves, sinks, and grease trap exterior. Walls, bar floor spills, and grease under fryers need cleaning. A food handler lacks a valid food handler training certificate.

headline: Fail: seven live roaches; unsafe food temperatures
summary: Seven live roaches found throughout the facility, including on walls, in a soap dispenser, and on a light switch; citation issued. Dish machine sanitizer was 0 ppm and was repaired on site. Chicken at 90°F and cold foods at 46–73°F discarded; unapproved yogurt.

headline: Missing thermometer; encrusted grease on equipment
summary: Missing thermometer in prep cooler. Encrusted grease and debris on legs, wheels, and piping of cooking equipment, including fryers and grill. Slow-draining prep handsink, syrup spills on basement floor, and an improperly stored ice scoop.

headline: No covered sanitary napkin disposal
summary: No covered receptacle for disposal of sanitary napkins in the women's washroom. A covered waste receptacle must be provided.

headline: Fly traps and ice scoop holder need changes
summary: Fly traps are mounted above clean utensils; instructed to keep them away from open food and clean utensils. Ice scoop kept in an unclean holder with gray water at the bottom; instructed to keep it on a clean surface.

headline: Re-inspection: rusty racks; missing allergen certificate
summary: Rust found on wire storage racks in the walk-in cooler; must be removed and shelves repainted or replaced. No allergen training certificate on site; employees with city sanitation certificates must complete training and keep proof on site.

headline: Unlabeled flour; bread under waste lines
summary: Bulk flour container must be labeled with its common name. Bread boxes must not be stored under waste lines in basement dry storage; stored items must be elevated and away from walls. Dirt behind the large ice machine and excess flour on its door need cleaning.

headline: No employee health policy on site
summary: No employee health policy was on site; one must be provided at all times (priority violation). The business license number on the sides of the MFP was not at least 2 inches tall, and it must be corrected.

headline: Unlabeled salt; missing backflow device
summary: Bulk salt container is not labeled and must be labeled. No backflow prevention device could be found for the front coffee maker; one must be installed.

headline: Poor lighting and damaged spray hose
summary: Insufficient lighting in second-floor produce and prep walk-in coolers and the first-floor walk-in freezer. Dried food debris on the warewashing disposal chute, and a worn spray hose must be replaced with an easy-to-clean fixture.

headline: No certified manager while burgers and milk served
summary: No city certified food manager with a valid original certificate was on site while hamburgers and milk were being prepared and served; citation issued. Accumulated grease and food debris on prep floors and under cooking equipment need detail cleaning.

headline: Broken soap dispenser and loose paper towel holder
summary: Broken soap dispenser at the front handwash sink and a loose paper towel holder at the rear handwash sink; both must be repaired or replaced. Slight food debris inside the microwave needs cleaning.

headline: Fail: mouse droppings; no cleanup kit; door gap
summary: About 20 or more mouse droppings under a restroom vanity and by the three-compartment sink; citation issued. No pest control log, no vomit and diarrhea cleanup policy or kit, a gap under the front door, and dust, chipping paint, and broken floor tiles.

headline: Re-inspection: milk crates as shelving; produce debris
summary: Milk crates used as shelving near the liquor case must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor. Food debris and spills under wooden pallets in the produce area require detail cleaning.

headline: Fail: no valid manager certificate; live flies
summary: Person in charge lacked a valid city sanitation manager certificate; citation issued. About 25 live small flies were flying behind the bar and on walls; pest control was recommended and a citation issued. No hand-wash sign or toilet room lid.

headline: License number missing; no rear door screen
summary: Business license number missing from the vehicle's driver side; must be provided. No screen on the rear exit door; one must be provided and maintained.

headline: Complaint: unlabeled food; dead insects; dust
summary: Food stored in coolers and dry storage lacks name labels after removal from packaging. Scoops stored inside sauce containers. Flour, grease, dead insects, and dirt buildup on cooking equipment, racks, and shelves; dust on walk-in fan, light shields, and vents.

headline: Fail: moldy ice machine dripping onto ice
summary: Black mold-like buildup inside the ice machine was dripping onto ice for human consumption. Person in charge must discard the ice and clean and sanitize the machine; citation issued. Also noted: leaking handsink, food debris behind a freezer, and expired food handler training.

headline: Debris and soil under equipment and POS area
summary: Debris and soil buildup on the floor under equipment and in the POS area. Manager instructed to clean.

headline: Complaint: handleless plastic cups used as scoops
summary: Single-use plastic cups without handles were used as scoops for dry food in the hot holding and deli prep area. The facility must replace them with scoops that have handles.

headline: Complaint: frozen chicken thawed in pot
summary: A package of frozen chicken was thawing in a pot; instructed to thaw under cold running water or in a reach-in cooler. Glue boards are dirty or water-damaged, cutting boards are worn, and spills under the hot holding unit and on prep floors need cleaning.

headline: Boxes on floor; milk crates used for shelving
summary: Boxed items in dry storage must be raised off the floor, and milk crates may not be used to elevate them. Black slime and debris inside the dish room conveyor; cardboard shelf liner in dish room. Washrooms offering feminine products need covered receptacles.

headline: Complaint: dirty dish machines; moldy caulking
summary: Excess food debris and dirt in the kitchen and bar dish machines; must be cleaned and sanitized. Moldy caulking and food spills at the three-compartment sink. A mop stored in a bucket must be placed so it can air dry. Grease heavy on hood and filters.

headline: Cold display food too warm; about $60 discarded
summary: Chicken at 47.6°F and egg rolls at 48.5°F in the food display cooler, above the 41°F safe limit. Manager voluntarily discarded about 10 lbs; citation issued. Food handlers prepped without hair restraints, and wiping cloths were wet on prep surfaces.

headline: Missing handwash signs; dirty floors; water damage
summary: Handwash signs or posters missing at bistro and bar sinks. Paper towels and soap were missing at times and were provided during inspection; citation issued. Wiping cloths stored on cooking equipment, dirty floors, dusty vents, and water-damaged ceiling tiles.

headline: Re-inspection: door gap; sink, ceiling, floor repairs
summary: A 1/4 inch gap at the rear exit door needs a tight seal to keep pests out. Three-compartment sink stopper not working, faucet hard to operate, and utility sink leaks. Ceiling and floor tiles in poor repair; food debris and spills throughout.

headline: Re-inspection: dusty ice machine; allergen training
summary: The front service area ice machine's interior surfaces (bounce plate) are soiled with dust and debris and must be cleaned. The person in charge is missing allergen awareness training and certificate; all certified managers must be trained.

headline: Fail: over 100 mouse droppings found
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings in dry storage and inside lower cabinets; citation issued and pest control service recommended. Openings at front and rear doors must be sealed. Soda crates used for elevation, cardboard shelf liners, and rust on walk-in cooler shelves.

headline: Food debris, cardboard under fryer, standing water
summary: Food debris on the cookline floor, cardboard under the kitchen fryer, grease on the wall behind cooking equipment, and standing water under a hot holding unit. Instructed to clean all areas and keep floors clean and dry.

headline: Fail: no vomit kit; food not date-marked
summary: No vomit and diarrhea spill kit or cleanup procedure; citation issued. Ready-to-eat chicken and ham in walk-in cooler not date-marked; citation issued. Also noted: ice scoop stored on ice, knives misplaced, unlabeled bulk flour and rice, broken dumpster lids, and no food handler training proof.

headline: Fail: handwash water too cold; pest entry openings
summary: Handwash sinks in women's washroom reached only 70–72°F; must provide at least 100°F (priority violation). Signs missing in both employee washrooms; only one cold holding unit; openings at prep and storage doors allow pests; no covered sanitary waste bin.

headline: Suspected food poisoning: hygiene and cold food lapses
summary: Handler touched ready-to-eat tortilla by hand (about 2.8 lbs discarded). Handwash sink blocked, no soap or hand drying at prep sink, and cold-held foods at 46–52°F were discarded. Dish machine final rinse was 147°F; 180°F required. Citations issued.

headline: No person in charge or certified manager during food prep
summary: No person in charge was present, and no certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods (foods that must be kept hot or cold) were prepared and served; citation issued. Also noted: no restroom handwashing signs, no hair restraints, and leaking sinks.

headline: No certified person in charge; TCS foods handled
summary: Person in charge lacks a city sanitation certificate, and the manager on site lacks the original certificate; citation issued. A certified person with the original certificate must be present while beef, chicken, soup, and chili are handled. Handwash sign missing and mold-like buildup in walk-in cooler racks.

headline: Front door gap lets pests in
summary: Half of the front entrance door is not rodent-proof, with a 1/4 inch gap at the bottom. The door must be made rodent-proof and tight-fitting.

headline: Fail: mouse droppings; gaps at rear exit door
summary: About 60 mouse droppings in the rear storage area, employee bathroom, kitchen walls, and under shelves; citation issued and more pest control needed. Two 2x2 inch gaps at rear exit door. Uncovered raw and cooked chicken; dirty wiping cloths; rusty bowls; prior core violations not corrected.

headline: Missing thermometer; no splashguards; unlabeled bulk
summary: Residue inside the ice machine, no thermometer in the taqueria hot holding unit, and unlabeled bulk tamale containers. No splashguard between sink and prep table; plastic sink stoppers and deeply grooved cutting boards. Single-service items not inverted.

headline: Re-inspection: food handler and allergen certificates missing
summary: Several food handlers lack food handler certificates; management must show proof of training for all. Certified food managers lack allergen training certificates and must show proof.

headline: Fail: no certified manager while sushi made
summary: No certified manager on site while sushi and other TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. Sushi rice pH test expired (last tested 10/21/2019); a new test or working pH meter is required. Floor grime under cook line and grease on hood also noted.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate posted or on duty
summary: No valid city sanitation certificate posted and no certified manager on duty; one must be on site while chicken and bean and rice are prepared and served. Citation issued. Dirty shelving, floors, damaged prep ceiling tiles, and burnt-out hood lights.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; fryer not under hood
summary: Bulk food containers, such as flour and sugar, are not labeled and must be labeled. A deep fryer is not under the hood and must be placed under it.

headline: Doors not rodent-proof; grease outside attracts pests
summary: Side and rear exit doors are not rodent-proof; door sweeps must be replaced to prevent pest entry. Leak at the three-compartment sink hot water nozzle. Grease receptacle exterior has grease and food debris. Wall base detached behind grill; exhaust hood filters missing.

headline: Missing thermometers; improper cloth storage
summary: Missing thermometers in front prep coolers, wiping cloths stored improperly on a counter, plastic lining and rust found on equipment and shelves, and a dusty walk-in cooler ceiling. Certified managers also lack allergen training.

headline: Dish machine lacks sanitizer; handwash signs missing
summary: No sanitizer detected at final rinse of the low-temperature dish machine; it is tagged held for inspection until repaired to 100 ppm chlorine. Handwash signs missing. Ice scoops stored on ice bin, rusty shelving, and dirt under the three-compartment sink.

headline: Fail: prior violations uncorrected; dirty dish machine
summary: Prior core violations not corrected: cookies on display lack required labels, employees lack effective hair restraints, and dish machine top is extremely dirty. Floor drains and floors dirty. The certified manager has no allergen training certificate; citation issued.

headline: No certified manager at start of inspection
summary: No certified sanitation manager on site at start of inspection while TCS foods were stored and prepared; manager arrived about 2:40 PM. Citation issued. Food containers unlabeled and uncovered; utensil stored inside container; exposed ceiling and missing light shield in women's washroom.

headline: Fail: no health policy; one refrigeration unit only
summary: Original city certified food manager certificate not posted; no employee health policy. Only one refrigeration unit (two required). No metal stem thermometer, sanitizer test strips, or paper towels at handsink. Hot water measured 49.9°F; must be at least 110°F.

headline: Food on prep floor; dirty shelves and freezers
summary: Butter stored on prep area floor must be raised six inches. Styrofoam cups used as scoops in dry storage; cutting board deeply grooved and stained. Shelves, microwave, freezers, and floors need detail cleaning, and handwash sink signage and dry storage labels are missing.

headline: No valid certified manager while TCS foods served
summary: No valid city sanitation manager certificate was on site while sliced melon, beef, and nacho cheese were being served; citation issued. The original certificate and a certified manager must be on site at all times.

headline: Raw chicken and steak too warm; about 30 lbs lost
summary: Raw chicken at 49°F and raw steak at 48°F in the walk-in cooler; must be 41°F or below. Food discarded, about 30 lbs ($300); walk-in cooler air at 49°F; citation issued. Slow-draining bar handsink and grease spills behind fryers.

headline: Re-inspection: unlabeled food; greasy equipment
summary: Food removed from original containers without labels; food on walk-in cooler floor must be raised six inches. Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables, plastic grocery bags used for food, and a damaged cooler gasket. Grease and food debris on equipment; heavy grime on walls and floors.

headline: Soda machine cabinet spill; cracked drain
summary: Spillage in the cabinet under the soda machine must be cleaned. Cracks around the drain under the three-compartment sink let water seep onto the floor; repair required.

headline: Shrimp thawing improperly; wiping cloths stored loose
summary: A pan of shrimp sat in water and was not thawing properly; staff must thaw under cool running water, in the microwave, or in a cooler. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer, and cardboard was reused as cooking-equipment liners.

headline: Re-inspection: thermometers, hair restraints, expired allergen
summary: Ambient air thermometers missing from cold holding units. Meat pot and sprouts stored on floor; scoop stored on a chair; food handlers without hair restraints; tableware not inverted; black buildup inside ice machine; burnt residue under grill and stoves; expired manager allergen certificate.

headline: Manager's allergen training expired
summary: Soap, paper towels, and signage were kept at the prep sink next to the handwash sink; these must be kept only at handwash sinks. The manager on duty has expired allergen training; all certified managers must complete it and keep records on site.

headline: Chip containers stacked unprotected; corrected on site
summary: Tortilla chip containers stacked without protection; manager corrected this on site by adding wax paper. No written procedure for washing large pots that do not fit in sinks. Brownish substance on the ice machine panel must be cleaned.

headline: Rodent droppings found; no handwash sink behind bar
summary: Rodent droppings found on floors behind the bar and by the DJ booth; a licensed pest control company must service the premises. Rear and front doors are not rodent-proof. No vomit cleanup kit, no sink behind bar, no backflow device, and no test strips; citation issued.

headline: Re-inspection: deep fryer interiors need cleaning
summary: Re-inspection requires cleaning the interior of the deep fryers in the first-floor food prep area.

headline: Fail: over 100 mouse droppings; live roaches
summary: Re-inspection found over 100 mouse droppings throughout the premises, including near stored food and in cabinets, plus two live roaches. Pest activity must be eliminated; citation issued. Grime and debris on coolers, freezers, prep tables, and floors.

headline: Dead insects near restroom and basement corners
summary: Dead crawling insects found in the rear near the restroom and in basement corners; instructed to remove, detail clean, and sanitize. Ice bin needed cleaning, plates were not inverted, a mop was not drying properly, and a restroom floor vent is broken.

headline: Dusty ceiling vent and light shields
summary: Dust buildup on the ceiling vent in the unisex employee washroom, and dust and dirt on ceiling light shields above food storage shelving in the rear storage area. Must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Small sink leak; coving and wall finishing needed
summary: Small leak at the three-compartment sink P-trap must be corrected. Coving is needed at the front bar sink area, and drywall at the front bar wall must be finished and sealed.

headline: Re-inspection: utility sink required
summary: Re-inspection requires installing a utility service sink with hot and cold running water that drains properly.

headline: Re-inspection: basement scoop, tile, and trash issues
summary: Ice scoop in the basement stored on equipment must go in a clean container. Top of low-temp dish machine needs cleaning; stopper lever at basement sink needs repair. Broken floor tile, wall openings, and trash on basement electrical room floor.

headline: Failed; about 25 small flies; repeat violations
summary: Failed. About 25 small flies on walls behind coffee station and 3-compartment sink, and on a freezer lid; citation issued; additional pest control recommended. Food debris, clutter, and items on floor. Prior violations not corrected: food debris in reach-in coolers and no covered trash receptacle.

headline: Passed; dirty floors; no food handler proof
summary: Passed. Floors in storage and mop sink closet have dirt and debris. Food handler on site has no proof of food handler certificate; must obtain and keep a valid certificate.

headline: Passed re-inspection; utensil and gasket issues
summary: Passed. Shallow bowl used as dispensing utensil in cooked beans; long-handled utensils required. Damaged door gaskets on taqueria prep cooler. Openings in basement storage ceiling must be repaired.

headline: Passed; dim lighting behind bar sink
summary: Passed. Lighting behind the bar, where glasses are washed at the 3-compartment sink, is inadequate. Additional lighting must be provided.

headline: Passed; missing thermometer and grime
summary: Passed. Working thermometer required in walk-in cooler. Debris in reach-in freezer and spills on walk-in floor must be cleaned. Floor and piping behind fryer dirty with grease. Hood and filters above front cooking area need grease removed.

headline: No signed employee health policies on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No signed employee health policies on site for food or conditional employees; must be provided and kept on site. Toilet room door is not self-closing. No citation issued.

headline: Passed re-inspection; grease and wall gaps
summary: Passed. Grease and food debris on equipment wheel bases and legs, wok station, noodle mixer, and fryer cabinet. Gap along wall at front counter, small hole in lower wall near hot water tank, and grease buildup on floors and drains.

headline: No certified manager while beans and rice served
summary: Pass with conditions. Person in charge had no City certificate while beans and rice were cooked and served; manager arrived about 12:05 PM; citation issued. Also pink debris in ice machine, utensils in stagnant water, equipment too large for sink, basement leak, unused items.

headline: Failed; overflowing dumpster and food debris
summary: Failed. Food debris on coolers, shelving, and cooking equipment. No covered waste receptacle in washroom. Dumpster overflowing with loose lids; citation issued. Prior violations not corrected: mop sink not connected to water, no ventilation hood over grills, no food handler training.

headline: Passed; stained boards and ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. Cutting boards with dark stains and deep cuts must be refinished or replaced. Rough wooden shelving in lower cabinets must be painted or sealed. Replace caulking and stained ceiling tiles with black slime; repaint peeling paint.

headline: Failed; no certified manager during food prep
summary: Failed. No City-certified food manager on site while ground beef was prepared; manager arrived about 25 minutes after inspection began; citation issued. Also unlabeled bulk oats, chia, and flaxseed, food debris and spills, and no food handler training proof.

headline: Passed re-inspection; leaks, hole, and clutter
summary: Passed. Leaking drainpipe under frontline handwash sink. Old ice machine drain drains into bar handwash sink. No waste sink at bar. Large hole in wall above frontline; chipped paint above grill and fryer. Clutter and broken, unused equipment; missing light shield.

headline: Passed re-inspection; grease on cooking equipment
summary: Passed. Accumulated grease and food debris on interior and exterior of cooking equipment must be cleaned. Floor around equipment has grease buildup and must be cleaned at all times.

headline: Passed re-inspection; signage, gasket, dirty floors
summary: Passed. No handwashing signage at front prep sink. Dirty ice machine guard. Torn gasket on rear prep 2-door refrigerator. Cardboard lining on dry storage shelves must be removed. Dirt and food debris on floors in prep, warewashing, and dry storage areas.

headline: Cold food too warm; no hot running water
summary: Pass with conditions. Cooked chicken, goat, milk, and butter held at 50-61F in a reach-in cooler; must be 41F or below. About 35 lbs ($600) voluntarily discarded. Cooler tagged by CDPH. No running hot water at sinks; water 65-67F.

headline: Failed; moldy ice machine; hot and cold food unsafe
summary: Failed. Black mold-like substance inside ice machine; ice destroyed and machine cleaned. Beef held at 96.0-124.0F; cold foods at 46.6-58.0F; food discarded. Overflowing dumpster with bags and cardboard, citation issued. Cracks and holes in basement floor; no food handler training proof.

headline: Hot food below safe temperature; 35 lbs discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Hot food held too cool: fried chicken 124.0-128.2F and bourbon chicken 99-110F on serving line; baked chicken 121.8F and fish 122.9F in holding unit. Must be 135F or above. About 35 lbs ($120) discarded. Inaccurate thermometers, leaking pipe, dirty floors.

headline: Passed; unlabeled containers and debris
summary: Passed. Food storage containers lack labels with common food names. Debris along walls and in corners of utility and storage areas must be cleaned. Food service sanitation manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Passed; no covered waste receptacle
summary: Passed. No covered waste receptacle in unisex washroom in private room and customer washrooms. Broken floor tiles in basement walk-in cooler and under prep sink. Burnt-out light bulbs above prep coolers must be replaced.

headline: Passed; backflow device needed on ice machine
summary: Passed. Backflow prevention device must be installed on the ice machine. Unused equipment and unnecessary articles in rear storage must be removed. Exhaust fan in washroom not working and must be provided.

headline: Passed with conditions; 50 lbs of beans discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Cooked pinto beans at 48.9F in walk-in cooler; about 50 lbs ($100) voluntarily discarded; citation issued. Women's washroom faucet must run 15 seconds. Gap of about 1/4 inch at rear door. Stained cutting boards. Leak under rear handwash sink.

headline: Passed; mop stored improperly
summary: Passed. Mop was stored improperly. Mop must be stored upside down when not in use.

headline: Passed; slow drain and grimy floors
summary: Passed. Slow-draining handwash sink in women's restroom. Dirt, dust, and debris on floors in corners and under and behind equipment must be cleaned.

headline: Cold food and coolers too warm; tagged
summary: Pass with conditions. Milk, mozzarella, pork fat, and eggs held at 45-47.1F; 27 lbs ($92) discarded. Two reach-in coolers at 47-48.6F, tagged; repaired 2/21/24 to 39-40.2F and untagged. Milk crates used for elevation; light shield needed by dish room.

headline: Failed complaint inspection; grease and prior violations
summary: Failed. Prior violations from 1/23/24 were not corrected: grease and debris on fryers, shelves, microwave, floors, and walls. Citation issued. Also no covered waste receptacle in employee washroom and grease on hood and filters.

headline: Passed; cardboard floors and greasy hood
summary: Passed. Serving plates on prep shelves not inverted. Cardboard and boxes lining kitchen prep floors must be removed. Dirt and grease on exhaust hood, filters, and pipes. Employee belongings stored on shelves with food near ice machine.

headline: Failed; over 100 mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. Evidence of rodent activity: over 20 mouse droppings in lounge, kitchen, and furnace room, 15-20 near walk-in motor, and over 30 along kitchen walls and under dry storage racks. Citation issued. Also gaps and a hole at doors, a leak, and no covered receptacle.

headline: Failed; 50 rat droppings in basement
summary: Failed. Mold-like growth on ice machine interior surfaces was cleaned and sanitized. About 50 rat droppings on basement storage and chemical storage room floors; more pest control service needed; citation issued. Clutter contributing to pest harborage; two lights out.

headline: Failed; hot food held too cool; 15 lbs discarded
summary: Failed. Hot food held at 79.0-116.8F, including beef, pork at 107.8F, and chicken at 87.4F; must be 135F or above. About 15 lbs ($500) discarded; citation issued. Openings at rear exit door, boxes on floor, and no food handler or allergen training proof.

headline: Passed re-inspection; boxed food on floor
summary: Passed. Boxed food items on floor throughout the rear bakery prep area must be raised 6 inches on shelving. One certified food manager has an expired allergen awareness certificate and must renew it.

headline: No certified person on site; citation issued
summary: Pass with conditions. No person on site with an original City of Chicago food sanitation certificate posted. A certified manager must be on site at all times; citation issued.

headline: Passed; dirty ice scoop holder
summary: Passed. Ice scoop holder is not clean at the bottom and must be cleaned.

headline: Passed re-inspection; ice machine and grime
summary: Passed. Ice machine interior panel not clean; rusty wire racks in prep coolers; plastic lining on rolling cart. Grime and debris noted in a small cooler, handsink faucet handles, greasy trap top, and wire racks in all first-floor prep coolers.

headline: Failed; about 20 small flies in dish area
summary: Failed. About 20 small flies near the dish machine and fly activity under counters; citation issued; pest control service recommended. Damaged gaskets on two-door refrigerator by the sink. Aluminum foil used as shelf liner above oven must be removed.

headline: Passed re-inspection; training certificates needed
summary: Passed. No proof of food handler certificates; new hires have 30 days to show proof of training and must keep it on site. No proof of allergen training for certified food managers.

headline: Passed re-inspection; front door gap
summary: Passed. Front entrance door has a 1/2-inch gap at the bottom. Must be made tight-fitting and rodent-proofed.

headline: Failed; repeat violations, debris, water heater drain
summary: Failed. Grime and food debris on floors under meat-area tables. Prior violations not corrected: 1/4-inch gap at front door, rust on walk-in shelving, grooved cutting boards, and water heater line draining into kitchen handsink; citation issued.

headline: Passed; food debris in prep reach-in coolers
summary: Passed. Accumulated food debris inside prep area reach-in coolers and on cooler door hinges must be cleaned.

headline: No spill kit or cleanup procedure on site
summary: Pass with conditions. No bodily fluid spill kit or vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure on site; facility must keep both on site at all times; citation issued. Food service sanitation manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Failed; 15 rat droppings near rear door
summary: Failed. Rear screen door damaged and missing screen; hole at base of rear threshold. 15 rat droppings in the uncovered base of an air handling unit near the rear exit; citation issued. Food bins and flour on floor; utensils on soiled shelves; no covered trash.

headline: Failed; no certified manager; hand washing lapse
summary: Failed. No City-certified food manager on site while open; citation issued. Employee wiped eye, put on glove, and began preparing food without washing hands; citation issued. Tofu stored on open garbage can, moved on site. Opening at rear door bottom.

headline: Passed re-inspection; damaged rear door sweep
summary: Passed. Lower door sweep on rear exit door is damaged and must be replaced to rodent-proof the facility. Wiping cloth stored inside rear dishwashing handsink. Slight debris on rear dishwashing and prep floors.

headline: No valid allergen training for managers
summary: Passed. Inspector found no valid allergen training available. All certified managers must provide valid allergen training.

headline: Failed; 100-150 rodent droppings, out-of-temp sausage
summary: Failed. About 100-150 rodent droppings in several storage and kitchen areas; a trapped dead rodent behind cooling units; a hole in the wall; citations issued. Sausages at 50.9F; 90 lbs ($300) discarded. Raw chicken thawed at room temperature; no paper towels at restroom sink.

headline: Passed; rear door not rodent-proof
summary: Passed. Rear exit door is not rodent-proof, with about a 1/2-inch gap at the side. Must be made tight-fitting to prevent pest entry.

headline: Passed; freezer debris and dishroom puddles
summary: Passed. Spilled food debris at bottom of two-door freezers in pastry station must be cleaned. Wet mop stored in bucket; hang mops after use. Debris and puddles on dishwashing room floors under equipment and shelving must be cleaned.

headline: Passed re-inspection; torn cooler gasket
summary: Passed. Torn gasket on door of 2-door cooler in prep area must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Failed; ice machine slime; handwashing lapse
summary: Failed. Employee handled clean dishes without washing hands after handling dirty dishes; manager corrected; citation issued. Black-brown slime inside ice machine reservoir; ice not protected; citation issued. Broken bakery baseboard and tiles; grime under and around ice machine.

headline: Failed; no vomit cleanup kit; no public summary
summary: Failed. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure on site; citation issued. No covered waste receptacle in restrooms. Trash and crates on ground in outdoor receptacle area. Mop improperly stored. Hole in wall below rear restroom sink. Summary not posted for public; citation issued.

headline: Passed; missing handwash signs and door
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs missing at three hand sinks. One of four basement bathrooms lacks a self-closing door. Non-functional overhead light in basement prep area must be replaced and additional lighting provided.

headline: Passed; no hair restraints; greasy fryers
summary: Passed. Employees in prep area not wearing hair restraints. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizing solution. Ice scoop improperly stored in bar. Cutting boards grooved and stained. Heavy grease and dirt on fryers and cooking equipment; leak under 3-compartment sink.

headline: Cold food too warm; prep cooler tagged
summary: Pass with conditions. Prep cooler food held above 41F: vegan burgers 57.3F, tofu 58.6F, sliced and diced tomatoes 59.8-60.2F; instructed to discard. Prep cooler at 54.1F tagged; must not be used until reinspected. Spills, dirt, wall openings, and soiled mop heads on floor.

headline: Passed; spills, residue, and grease buildup
summary: Passed. Spillage in dining area cabinet. Residue on soda machine and ice machine cover. Oil residue behind cooler, equipment, and 3-compartment sink. Dust and grease on ventilation covers in food prep area must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; leaking walk-in freezer condenser
summary: Passed. Walk-in freezer condenser unit is leaking and creating ice buildup; must be repaired and maintained. Food areas around cooking equipment need cleaning to remove spills, debris, and grease.

headline: Passed; ice machine, tiles, unlabeled bulk foods
summary: Passed. Ice machine upper interior needs cleaning. Bulk foods not in original containers must be labeled. Food debris in cooler and on can openers. Loose sink faucet propped by a bowl. Water-damaged and missing ceiling tiles; pooling liquid on basement floor; no manager allergen training proof.

headline: Failed; sink backup corrected on site; lids open
summary: Failed. Three-compartment sink slow draining; water backed up between compartments. Manager called repair technician and the issue was corrected during inspection; citation issued. Outside garbage receptacle lids not tight-fitting; citation issued.

headline: Pass with conditions; food held too warm; eating in prep
summary: Pass with conditions. Service cooler foods above 41F: eggs 55.2F, hollandaise 45.9F, tamales 45.5F, potatoes 46.8F; 4 lbs ($50) voluntarily discarded. Employees eating and drinking in prep area. Prep table at rear lacks handwash sink, soap, and towels.

headline: Passed re-inspection; plumbing, floors, ceilings
summary: Passed. Low water pressure at restroom handsinks; water does not shut off at women's rear restroom sink. Leaky faucets at 1- and 3-compartment sinks. Thermometers required in all refrigerators. Missing and damaged floor and ceiling tiles, holes in walls, and no food handler training.

headline: Failed; shellstock tags, cold food, no certificate
summary: Failed. No original City food sanitation certificate posted; citation issued. Shellstock without tags; 2 lbs discarded. Cold food held at 49.8-55.6F; about 6 lbs discarded. Vacuum-packed beef and vegetables had no discard date. About 25 lbs discarded. Menu lacks undercooked-food advisory.

headline: Spilled beverage debris in beer cooler
summary: Passed. Spilled beverage debris at the bottom of the beer storage cooler must be cleaned.

headline: Unlabeled tofu; missing sink stoppers
summary: Passed re-inspection. Unlabeled on-site tofu in lobby refrigerator; label must list ingredients, allergens, and source. Two sink stoppers missing. Grout missing under the 3-compartment sink. Empty boxes stored in dining area and basement.

headline: Passed; cleaning and loose tiles
summary: Passed. Clean the interior and storage rack of the 1-door freezer, dry storage floor, and grease on wall behind fryers. Loose baseboard tiles and missing wall tiles need replacing. Missing grout where water pools must be filled.

headline: Food stored on cooler floor; no thermometers
summary: Passed. Food stored on walk-in cooler floor; shelving must be at least 6 inches off the floor. Working thermometers required inside cooling units. Dried debris on microwave, dusty storage racks, and a display cooler holding deli meat need cleaning.

headline: Passed re-inspection; unlabeled containers, no certificates
summary: Passed. Storage containers in rear prep area not labeled with common name. Deep fryer grease left uncovered after closing. To-go containers and utensils not inverted. No food handler training certificates on site; must be kept on site.

headline: Passed re-inspection; rust on cooler floors
summary: Passed. Rust on the floor in walk-in cooler and walk-in freezer must be removed.

headline: Failed; no city food certificates, cold handsink
summary: Failed. No valid City of Chicago food sanitation certificate for employees; citation issued. Hot foods prep handsink had no hot water; citation issued. Also unlabeled stored food, food stored on floors, stained cutting boards, and no proof of food handler training.

headline: Failed; no hot water on premises
summary: Failed. No hot water on premises at inspection; must restore 100-110F at all sinks; priority violation issued. Ice machine door in front prep area had excessive buildup and must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; items must be raised off floor
summary: Passed. Food and non-food items must be stored 6 inches off the floor in the rear storage and dishwashing area for easier cleaning and to prevent contamination.

headline: Failed; no certified manager; 30 rodent droppings
summary: Failed. No City-certified food manager on premises while TCS foods prepared and served; citation issued. About 30 rodent droppings in basement; pest control serviced 8/27/2024; citation issued. Restroom hot water 80-83F; shrimp at 53.2F discarded. Prep cooler at 55F tagged.
