headline: Failed; no 2025 pest reports; grease buildup
summary: Failed. Pest control reports on file end in 1/9/2024; no 2025 service reports; citation issued. Grease buildup on cooking equipment, walls, floors, and shelving in prep area. Interior of reach-in coolers and dish area floors need cleaning.

headline: Failed; roaches, unsafe soup, sink violations
summary: Failed. About 20 dead roaches throughout facility. Soup on steam table at 110.5F; about 4 lbs ($25) discarded. Rear handwash sink lacks paper towels, soap, and signage; citations issued. Leaking pipe, slow drain, and grease in microwave and fryers. Prior violations not corrected.

headline: Passed; multiple door gaps, dirty areas
summary: Passed. Gaps of about 1/4 inch at front and rear entry doors; rear door must be replaced to be tight-fitting and prevent insect entry. Loose faucet at front prep sink. Dirt, dust, and debris under the 3-compartment sink, behind the ice machine, and at CO2 tanks.

headline: Failed; no vomit spill kit, pest log lapsed
summary: Failed. No vomit and diarrhea spill kit or written cleanup procedure on site; citation issued. Pest control log not kept; last pest service report dated 11/19/2022; citation issued. Also a torn milk cooler gasket and no self-closing washroom door.

headline: Failed; no certified manager; no hot water
summary: Failed. Person in charge lacks City certified manager certificate; no certified manager on site while eggs and sausage handled; citation issued. Employee toilet sink water reached only 68.9F; must be 100-120F; citation issued. Torn cooler gaskets; cracked floor tiles cause standing water.

headline: Passed; freezer shelf and floor cleaning
summary: Passed. Clean spills and debris from the inside bottom shelf of the 3-door freezer. Floors along wall bases and in corners need debris removed.

headline: Passed; greasy fryer, loose tile, expired certificate
summary: Passed. Exterior and bottom of fryer and grill need cleaning. Loose floor tile behind cooking equipment must be replaced. Grease on lower wall and floor under equipment must be removed. Certified manager's allergen certificate expired.

headline: Passed; raw wood shelves and wall
summary: Passed. Raw wood shelves in basement dry storage must be painted or sealed. Stained cutting boards in kitchen prep area must be resurfaced or replaced. Wall behind 2-door prep cooler must be finished to a smooth, cleanable surface.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food handling
summary: Pass with conditions. No City-certified manager on site at start while TCS foods were stored, prepared, and served; manager arrived about 9:15 AM; citation issued. Ceramic mugs not lead-free and must be removed. Exhaust fan in women's washroom not working.

headline: Passed; grease, broken tiles, missing light caps
summary: Passed. Clean the bottom shelf of the 2-door prep cooler, the rear prep floor, and grease on the wall behind the grill. Replace broken floor tiles behind the front counter. Missing light fixture end caps in dish area must be installed.

headline: No certified manager while rice and sushi made
summary: Pass with conditions. No person in charge or certified food manager on site while rice and sushi were prepared; citation issued. Frozen noodles and crab rangoon thawed improperly. Unlabeled rice and flour; milk crates used for elevation; expired food handler certificates; manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Failed; no handwashing sink by dish area
summary: Failed. No handwashing sink in the rear warewashing area where the 3-compartment sink is located. Must install a handwash sink with hot and cold running water. Priority foundation violation; citation issued.

headline: Passed re-inspection; no utility sink
summary: Passed. No accessible utility service sink; front prep handsink being used for dishes and mop water. Raw wood floors and missing tiles in the front prep and rear kitchen areas. Missing and water-damaged ceiling tiles at rear dish area.

headline: Failed; slime in ice machine; repeat violations
summary: Failed. Yellow and black slime in ice machine used for ice; ice removed and machine cleaned; citation issued. Two freezers covered in ice. Slow-draining handwash sink. Prior violations not corrected: no backflow device at utility sink, no covered trash receptacle, untrained employee, expired allergen certificates.

headline: Failed; rough walls, debris, repeat violations
summary: Failed. Rough, uneven wall and baseboard in side storage near hot water tank, with gaps; broken wallboard and debris on floor. Paper towel dispenser lever broken in women's restroom. Prior violations not corrected: no splashguard at sink, ice buildup in upright freezer; citation issued.

headline: Passed re-inspection; missing restroom signage
summary: Passed. No handwashing signage in shared men's and women's restrooms. Food debris and residue on counters under equipment. Grease buildup on hood filters must be cleaned.

headline: Failed; no vomit cleanup supplies; pest service lacking
summary: Failed. Vomit and diarrhea cleanup policy copied from CDPH website, with no supplies on site. No licensed pest control operator; no pest logbook. Gap at bottom of rear door, dumpster lids open, mop sink not connected to water, and no food handler training records.

headline: Failed; no certificate posted; live roaches
summary: Failed. No valid City sanitation certificate posted; citation issued. No soap or paper towels at handsinks; citations issued. Several live roaches throughout dish room and prep area; citation issued. Slow-draining three-compartment sink; citation issued. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Failed; 40 live flies on prep walls
summary: Failed. About 40 live small flies on walls in prep area must be removed by re-inspection; citation issued. Pest control operator advised. Torn gaskets on prep area cooler doors and stained, pitted cutting boards must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Passed with conditions; no food handler records
summary: Pass with conditions. Plastic and towels lining storage shelves and carts; rust on prep table shelves; leak under rear handwash sink. Allergen training missing for City-certified managers. Prior violation not corrected: no food handler certificates on site; citation issued.

headline: Missing light shields in walk-in freezer
summary: Passed. Light shields are missing in the walk-in freezer and must be provided and maintained.

headline: Untrained employees; expired manager allergen training
summary: Passed. Slight pink slime build-up inside ice machine must be cleaned. Several employees lack food handler training. One of two certified managers has expired allergen training. Records must be kept on site.

headline: Passed; rusty grease trap and debris
summary: Passed. Rusty surface on top of grease trap must be removed. Excessive debris accumulated on the wall behind and under the 3-compartment sink, near attached piping; must be cleaned.

headline: Passed re-inspection; opening near ceiling light
summary: Passed. Large opening around ceiling light fixture near the kitchen prep entrance must be repaired to a smooth, cleanable surface. A food handler had an expired food handler training certificate.

headline: Expired food handler certificates for several staff
summary: Passed. Multiple food handling employees have expired food handler certificates. Person in charge instructed to renew them to comply with IDPH requirements.

headline: Passed; greasy equipment and dusty floors
summary: Passed. Rear handsink slowly draining. Plates not inverted; dirty microwave. Flour stored in non-food-grade totes. Grease, flour, and dust buildup on cooking equipment and shelving. Loose debris on floors; food debris and spills under shelving and in fryers; chipped utility closet paint.

headline: Passed re-inspection; utensils and freezer ice
summary: Passed. Styrofoam cup and bowl used as dispensing utensils. Ice scoop handle lying on ice. Large pots stored on rear prep floor. Damaged gaskets on liquor cooler and reach-in cooler; ice buildup in chest freezers. Missing grout and ceiling tiles; no manager allergen training.

headline: Passed; boxes on floor, missing ceiling panels
summary: Passed. Boxed food on floor in walk-in cooler, freezer, and rear prep area must be raised 6 inches. Aluminum foil used as shelf liner. Torn freezer gasket. Grease and debris on cooking equipment, coolers, and floors. Missing ceiling panels above walk-in freezer.

headline: Failed; gaps, dead insects, and dumpster trash
summary: Failed. Gaps under front and rear doors; dead insects on light shields throughout. Worn walk-in cooler gasket; crates used for storage; food debris on walk-in cooler floor and drains. Outside dumpster area piled with trash, boxes, and tires. Citation issued.

headline: Passed re-inspection; door gap and peeling paint
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap between the front entrance middle doors must be closed so the doors are rodent-proof. Peeling ceiling paint patches above pastry sales must be removed.

headline: Passed; low sink water pressure
summary: Passed. Low water pressure at front handwash sink must be repaired. Dirt and dust on floor drains and ceiling vents in unisex washrooms must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; allergen training missing on site
summary: Passed. A leaking pipe under the three-compartment sink must be repaired. No allergen training was on site during the inspection; the operator must obtain verification and keep it on site at all times.

headline: Conditional; 40 lbs soup at 57.9°F discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager certificate on site (priority). About 40 lbs of soup held in walk-in cooler at 57.9°F was discarded, valued at $100 (priority). Ice maker interior had an orange film.

headline: Passed; black residue and loose cooler door
summary: Passed. Black residue was found on walk-in cooler shelves and on the floor around the utility sink and closet. The walk-in cooler door does not close tightly, which the inspector linked to proper cold holding temperatures; repair ordered.

headline: Passed; leaks, worn floor, no toilet vent
summary: Passed. Pipe leaking under the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Warewashing floor is worn and uneven, holding water and debris. Food staff toilet rooms lack mechanical ventilation. All instructed to fix.

headline: Passed; gap under front door needs sealing
summary: Passed. A 1-inch gap under the front door is not rodent-proof, and management was told to rodent-proof all outer openings. Floor under retail storage shelving also needs cleaning.

headline: Passed; missing cooler thermometers, no handler training
summary: Passed. Working thermometers must be provided inside all coolers. An employee on duty lacked food handler training, and citations will follow if not provided. Floor under a front prep storage rack needs cleaning.

headline: Conditional; food stored in washroom; allergen training missing
summary: Pass with conditions. Seasoning and soda were stored inside a washroom, and single-service items too; these must be removed. Soiled wiping cloths sat on prep tables. Certified managers still lack allergen training from a prior report (priority citation).

headline: Conditional; no certified manager, no health policy
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager on duty while fried chicken, hamburgers and beef were handled (citation). No signed employee health policies (citation). Food handler training is required for all employees. Front door gap and weeds need attention.

headline: Conditional; suspension sign removed
summary: Pass with conditions. A license suspension sign was removed from the front door by an unauthorized person on 8/25/25. The person in charge was told not to cover, deface, or remove signs. A citation was issued.

headline: Failed; rodent infestation, 300+ mouse droppings
summary: Failed. Rodent infestation: 300+ mouse droppings under equipment and shelves (priority citation). Dead rodents found by cooking equipment and the rear door were removed on site. A large wall hole needs sealing.

headline: Passed; no health policy or training proof
summary: Passed. No written employee health policy was on site (priority violation). Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced. No proof of food handler training was shown.

headline: Passed; no valid food handler or allergen certificates
summary: Passed. No valid food handler certificates were on the premises. No valid allergen training certificates were shown for certified food managers. Management was told to show valid proof of both.

headline: Passed; missing ceiling tiles downstairs
summary: Passed. Missing ceiling tiles were noted in the downstairs prep area. The operator was told to replace them and keep them maintained.

headline: Failed; uncorrected violations, no food handler certificates
summary: Failed. Prepackaged desserts and salads in the display cooler lacked proper labels. Previous violations were not corrected: floor tiles under cooking equipment need regrouting, and several food handlers lack certificates (priority citation issued).

headline: Passed; greasy ovens, leaking sink, dirty floors
summary: Passed. Oven interiors had charred material and grease, and the three-compartment sink's cold-water knob leaked. Dirt and debris were found on floors under and around cooking equipment. Staff were told to clean and repair.

headline: Failed; improper thawing, food on floor
summary: Failed. Frozen fish was thawing improperly in a sink, and food was stored on the walk-in cooler floor. Also a broken dumpster lid (priority citation), missing sink stoppers, cardboard floor mats, and no manager with allergen training.

headline: Conditional; 16 dozen eggs at 87.6°F discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Eggs held at 87.6°F in the rear dry storage area were discarded: 16 dozen, valued at $119 (priority citation). Chicken thawed on the floor, and food handlers lacked hair and beard restraints.

headline: Passed; unlabeled containers and soiled cloths
summary: Passed. Unlabeled bulk containers, soiled wiping cloths left on prep tables, and grease in the fryer oil filter unit and on cooking equipment and coolers. A soiled mop head was to be hung up to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Passed; certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. A City-certified food manager did not have allergen training. The operator was instructed to provide and maintain it.

headline: Failed; no rapid reheating equipment for catering
summary: Failed. No equipment was on site for rapid reheating of catered foods that must be kept hot or cold. Manager was instructed to provide adequate equipment; this is a priority violation.

headline: Conditional; no certified manager while cooking
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager on duty while gyros, hamburgers and tacos were prepared (priority citation), and the person in charge lacks a certificate. Food boxes sit on walk-in freezer floor; crates and rust also need fixing.

headline: Failed; about 15 live flying insects found
summary: Failed. About 15 live small flying insects were found in first-floor and basement prep areas; more pest control needed, with a citation. Also a worker handled ready-to-eat green onions with bare hands, and vacuum packaging lacked an approved plan.

headline: Failed; 30 mouse droppings found in storage
summary: Failed. About 30 mouse droppings were found under shelves and along walls in the dry storage room and prayer room (priority citation). Cookie boxes were stored on the floor. Earlier door gap and vent violations remain uncorrected.

headline: Passed; torn refrigerator door gasket
summary: Passed. A torn, damaged rubber gasket on a refrigerator door in the rear prep area must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Passed; no food handler certificates for three
summary: Passed. Three food handlers lacked food handler certificates, and a manager lacked allergen training. Prepackaged desserts were unlabeled, and the ice machine's backflow device could not be located. Raw brick behind the utility sink must be sealed.

headline: Conditional; no vomit cleanup procedure
summary: Pass with conditions. No employee health policy on site, and no procedure for cleaning up vomiting or diarrhea (both priority; no citation). Also a leaking three-compartment sink pipe and missing backflow devices and splashguard.

headline: Passed; unlabeled flour, manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. Flour in an unlabeled plastic bin, and one certified food manager lacked allergen training. Also a torn walk-in cooler gasket, no covered trash can in women's restroom, grease under cooking equipment, and dirty floor drains.

headline: Failed; sink backs up, no health policy
summary: Failed. No written employee health policy was on premises (priority). Wastewater backs up at the kitchen three-compartment sink (priority). Also no backflow device on the utility mop sink, non-self-closing washroom doors, and managers without allergen certificates.

headline: Passed; food stored on floor, faucet repair
summary: Passed. Food containers and boxes stored on the floor in the rear prep and outside storage areas. Also a poor-repair faucet, dirty freezer interior, greasy hood, and litter outside.

headline: Passed; no health policy, training proof or spill kit
summary: Passed. Employee health policy copies were blank. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure or spill kit was on site (priority). A hood was not working, no food handler training proof was shown, and no certified manager had allergen training.

headline: Passed; cleaning needed on equipment and floors
summary: Passed. Inspector asked for cleaning of fryer and cooler exteriors, fryer bottom, walk-in cooler shelves and prep tables. Floors under cooking equipment and behind the deep freezer also need cleaning.

headline: Passed; dirty ice dispenser, microwave, floor
summary: Passed. The fountain drink ice dispenser was not clean and must be disassembled, cleaned and sanitized. Microwave interior had food debris and melted plastic, and the floor under the three-compartment sink needed cleaning.

headline: Passed; faucet spraying water outward
summary: Passed. Water was spraying outward from a faucet. The operator was instructed to repair it and keep it maintained.

headline: Passed; grime in drains, cold units, and vents
summary: Passed. Food residue and spills were found inside cold-hold units throughout. Drains had excessive debris and grime, and ceiling vents had heavy grime and dust. The person in charge was told to clean and maintain.

headline: Failed; overflowing dumpster, uncorrected training violations
summary: Failed. Dumpster overflowing with trash, lid open; grease container encrusted and mixed with debris (priority citation). Food boxes stored on floors and soiled wiping cloths were found. Prior food handler and allergen training violations remain uncorrected.

headline: Conditional; ready foods lacked date marks
summary: Pass with conditions. Cooked chicken, soups and beef held over 24 hours were not date-marked (priority, citation). Uncovered containers, food on the floor, a missing cold-water knob, and an expired manager allergen certificate also noted.

headline: Passed; widespread grease, dust, and cleaning needs
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths must sit in sanitizing solution when not in use. Cutting boards, cooking equipment, sinks, shelves, toilet room, cabinets and ventilation need detail cleaning. Floors need regrouting and tile replacement.

headline: Passed; missing handwash sign, peeling top loader
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign was at the handwashing sink in the deli meat prep area. The top loader's interior surface is peeling and must be replaced or repaired.

headline: Passed; personal items on slicer, no allergen cert
summary: Passed. Employee personal items were stored on top of the food slicer and must be moved. Foil was on a prep-area shelf, a kitchen receptacle had peeling paint, and the person in charge lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed; unlabeled containers and wet cloths
summary: Passed. Inspector found unlabeled food storage containers and wet wiping cloths left on prep surfaces, both to be corrected. Also a small leak under the three-compartment sink and water-stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Failed; no vomit cleanup supplies, uncorrected violation
summary: Failed. No cleanup supplies were on site for vomit or diarrhea events (priority). One walk-in cooler lacked a working thermometer, and a prior priority violation for missing dish-machine temperature indicators was not corrected (citation issued).

headline: Conditional; no health policy, handsink issues
summary: Pass with conditions. No signed employee health policies (priority). Handwashing signs missing, and hand sink faucets must stay on longer. Door gaps could let insects in, and window, conduit and floor gaps need sealing.

headline: Passed; rusty cooler shelves
summary: Passed. Shelves inside a reach-in cooler at the front service line were rusty and must be replaced.

headline: Passed; torn cooler door gasket
summary: Passed. A torn, damaged rubber gasket on a front prep cooler door must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Failed; no hot water, food held too warm
summary: Failed. No hot water throughout the facility; water peaked at 106°F (priority citation). Foods needing cold storage were held at 47–67°F, and a cooler at 69°F was tagged and food discarded. Also no handwash sink in rear prep.

headline: Failed; handsinks blocked, cold or no hot water
summary: Failed. A handwashing sink in the cheese prep area was blocked by pans (priority citation). Hot water at some hand sinks measured as low as 64.4°F; 100°F is required. Food stored on floors and in crates, and many other repairs needed.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk food, plastic bags in freezer
summary: Passed. Bulk food containers lacked labels, and plastic grocery bags held food in the box freezer. Also a non-working washbowl, missing utility-sink faucet, torn cooler gaskets, and grease under the cook line.

headline: Failed; cooked food at 84–92°F, no soap
summary: Failed. Three containers of cooked food sat at 84–91.7°F with no time/temperature log; about 50 lbs ($400) discarded (priority citation). Soap container not set up at handwashing sinks, so staff could not use soap (priority citation).

headline: Passed; two managers lack allergen training
summary: Passed. Two of three City-certified food managers lacked allergen training. Management was told all certified food managers must complete it and keep certificates on site.

headline: Passed; restroom door, boxes outside dumpster
summary: Passed. Customer restroom door must be fitted with a self-closing device. Cardboard boxes stored outside by the dumpster area must be moved inside receptacles.

headline: Conditional; no certified manager during food prep
summary: Pass with conditions. Food handlers prepared foods that must be kept hot or cold without a City-certified food manager on site (priority citation). Food storage containers lacked labels, and backsplash at the stove/grill needed cleaning.

headline: Passed; unlabeled squeeze bottles and containers
summary: Passed. Squeeze bottles and small containers lacked the common name of the food. Staff were told all food and condiments not in original containers must be labeled.

headline: Passed; rust and grease cleaning needed
summary: Passed. Rust on the bottoms of some prep tables must be removed or the tables replaced. Walk-in shelves, fryer, cooking equipment, floors, walls and ceiling vents also need cleaning.

headline: Failed; reach-in cooler too warm at 49.1°F
summary: Failed. Stand-up reach-in cooler was not maintained, with ambient air at 49.1°F; it must be 41.0°F or below (priority violation). Ventilation hood lights were also not working and must be replaced.

headline: Failed; no barrier between prep and customers
summary: Failed. No barrier separated employee food preparation areas from customers. This is a priority violation, and a barrier must be provided. No citation issued.

headline: Failed; no handwashing sink in prep area
summary: Failed. No handwashing sink for employees in the northside outer prep area (priority violation); one must be installed. Rust in the large ice machine bin and black debris in a cooler also need cleaning.

headline: Failed; no pest control logbook, no thermometer
summary: Failed. No pest control logbook on premises (priority). No metal-stem thermometer for hot and cold food. Dirt built up under equipment and along walls, and a manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Conditional; no certified manager, sink blocked
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager on duty while hot or cold-held foods were prepared; citation issued. Hand sink was blocked, cleared on site. Ice scoop stored in ice machine; faucet leaking.

headline: Failed; handsink blocked, cold foods too warm
summary: Failed. Rear prep handwashing sink was blocked by tables; the manager removed the table on site (priority citation). Beef, shrimp and chicken held at 62.5–64.4°F were discarded ($250), and the walk-in cooler at 65.4°F was tagged.

headline: Conditional; no certified manager, corrected on site
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager was on premises (priority citation), but one arrived at 10:45 a.m. and it was corrected on site. Also unlabeled rice, an espresso backflow device not located, and no allergen training.

headline: Failed; 80 mouse droppings behind freezers
summary: Failed. Mouse droppings: 80 behind freezers and by the hot water tank room; 40 by the front toilet room (priority citation). Rear door has a half-inch gap underneath. Thick grease in the fish fryer and a leaking faucet.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing signs, no backflow device
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs were missing in the main food prep and meat prep areas. No backflow prevention device was found at the ice machine near produce prep; one must be provided where it can be serviced.

headline: Passed; improper scoops and freezer ice buildup
summary: Passed. Disposable to-go containers without handles were used as scoops inside a refrigerator; staff were told to use tongs, spoons or ladles. Heavy ice in an upright freezer must be defrosted, and floors need cleaning.

headline: Passed; slight leak at three-compartment sink
summary: Passed. A slight leak was found on the three-compartment sink piping. The operator was told to repair it and keep it in good condition.

headline: Passed; raw chicken thawed in standing water
summary: Passed. Raw chicken thawed in standing water in sinks; staff were instructed to use running cold water. Also unlabeled dry ingredient bins, and no allergen certificate for the manager. Floors and shelves also need cleaning.

headline: Failed; wastewater drain fault, holes, leaks
summary: Failed inspection. Wastewater tank would not drain by gravity; an operator pushed a screwdriver into the inlet to move a thick substance. Small holes to outside found by water heater. Water-heater leak and grill-area food debris also noted.

headline: Failed; about 30 mouse droppings, pest control needed
summary: Failed. Approximately 30 mouse droppings were found under food shelving and dishwashing area; priority citation, and additional pest control service is needed. Doors have a half-inch gap that must be rodent-proofed. Also no written employee health policy.

headline: Passed; door gaps need rodent-proofing
summary: Passed. Front and rear doors had quarter-inch gaps at the sweeps and must be made rodent-proof. A walk-in cooler door gasket is ripped, and food debris is on the dish machine exterior. Dishwash-area floor grout is low.

headline: Conditional; no certified manager, ice used as coolant
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager on site while chicken and beef were handled; priority violation. Ice used as coolant for fruit cups was removed. Cardboard shelf covers in the walk-in cooler must be removed.

headline: Conditional; no written employee health policy
summary: Pass with conditions. No written employee health policy was on the premises, a priority violation with a citation. Management was told to have a signed policy for each employee.

headline: Passed; expired and missing allergen certificates
summary: Passed. Buildup inside the left compartment of the three-compartment sink must be cleaned. One food allergen certificate has expired, and one food manager has none. All certified managers must hold valid allergen training.

headline: Passed; no food handler training posted
summary: Passed. Vents in staff restrooms, food prep and near the three-compartment sink had dust, lint or grease and must be cleaned. No food handler training certification was posted, and managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk ingredients, peeling paint
summary: Passed. Large bulk ingredient containers lacked common-name labels. Also a torn cooler gasket, food debris inside cold-hold units, water-damaged ceiling tiles in the basement, and peeling paint in the walk-in and hallway.

headline: Conditional; no manager, improper thawing
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified manager was present while chicken was prepared; citation issued. Turkey legs thawing at room temperature were corrected on site, as were missing hair restraints. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Passed; washroom door and floor drain repairs
summary: Passed. The second-floor women's washroom lacks a working self-closing door device. The floor around a basement dish area floor drain under the three-compartment sink needs repair.

headline: Failed; greasy outdoor bin, missing handwash signs
summary: Failed. Outdoor grease container was greasy, a food source for rodents and pests, and a citation was issued. Also missing handwashing signs, wiping cloths stored on prep tables, and a certified manager with expired allergen training. Previous violations were not fixed.

headline: Failed; black slime in ice machine
summary: Failed. Heavy black slime was found inside the ice machine used for ice, a priority violation with a citation. Multiple employees lacked food handler training. Also needed: cutting board repair, cooler cleaning, and three hood bulbs replaced.

headline: Failed; cooler at 53°F, no hot handwash water
summary: Failed. Reach-in cooler held at 53°F; chicken thawing and eggs at 47°F. Cooler tagged and held (priority citation). Vacuum-packed chicken lacked a required food safety plan (HACCP). Women's restroom sink had no hot water (76°F).

headline: Failed; no pest control logbook on premises
summary: Failed. No pest control logbook from a licensed Illinois pest control operator was on the premises; a priority violation. Storage room and office floors are cluttered and items must be raised off the floor.

headline: Passed; food cooling covered too tightly
summary: Passed. Pasta, tuna salad and soups that must be kept hot or cold were tightly covered while cooling. Staff were told to cover them loosely or leave them uncovered if protected from overhead contamination. A soiled mop was stored on the floor.

headline: Conditional; rice held at 51°F, dishes not sanitized
summary: Pass with conditions. Cooked rice held at 51°F is above the 41°F limit; manager discarded 5 pounds (priority citation). Dishes were washed and rinsed but not sanitized; the manager had the employee sanitize them (citation issued).

headline: Conditional; undated salads discarded, no training proof
summary: Pass with conditions. Ready-to-eat chicken and chopped salads were not date-marked; about 22 pounds ($125) discarded (priority citation). No proof of food handler training was on site, and the inspection summary was not posted (priority violation).

headline: Passed; weak water pressure at prep handsink
summary: Passed. Weak hot and cold water pressure was found at the prep area handwashing sink. The operator was told to provide adequate city water pressure.

headline: Passed; missing thermometers, unlabeled containers
summary: Passed. Coolers need visible, accurate thermometers, and storage containers need common-name labels. Open condensed milk can must move to food-grade container. One certified manager's allergen training has expired.

headline: Passed; unlabeled squeeze bottle
summary: Passed. A squeeze bottle on a dishwashing-area shelf had no label. Inspector instructed staff to label it and keep it labeled.

headline: Failed; 20+ mouse droppings in basement storage
summary: Failed. Over 20 mouse droppings along basement walls and corners, and over 15 in rear storage (priority citation). Licensed pest control is recommended. Also missing handwashing sign, no cooler thermometers, and lasagna label lacks ingredients.

headline: Passed; faucet leak and slow handsink drain
summary: Passed. A faucet at the three-compartment sink leaked, and the rear prep hand sink drained slowly. Repairs were instructed.

headline: Failed re-inspection; no food handler training proof
summary: Failed re-inspection. No proof of food handler training for employees (priority violation). Hair restraints missing; employee belongings stored on dry food shelving; milk crates used as shelves. Floor drain cover missing; floors and ceilings need repair.

headline: Passed; greasy oven interior
summary: Passed. Interior of a rear-prep oven was encrusted with grease and food debris, and staff were told to clean and maintain it.

headline: Passed; no food handler certificates on site
summary: Passed. Meats held in plastic grocery bags in a freezer; food-grade bags only. No food handler certificates on premises. Also food debris on prep areas, a missing washroom trash lid, and greasy hood filters.

headline: Failed; 2 live roaches under prep table
summary: Failed. Two live roaches were found under a prep table, and 10 small flies on walls by the rear exit. Priority citation issued; pest control must be notified. Also unlabeled bulk containers and a manager without allergen training.

headline: Passed; grime under sinks, greasy hood filters
summary: Passed. Inspector found grime built up on floors beneath sinks and equipment, and hood filters covered in grease and dust. The person in charge was told to clean and maintain both.

headline: Failed; no certificate posted, sink backs up
summary: Failed. No original City food sanitation certificate posted (priority, citation). Wastewater backs up in the bar lounge's three-compartment sink. Pink buildup found inside an ice machine. Also a drain pipe feeds into a handwash sink.

headline: Failed; cold foods too warm, discarded
summary: Failed. Cole slaw, gizzards, livers and shrimp were held at 48–54°F in the walk-in cooler; about 39.8 pounds ($200) discarded. Walk-in air 55.4°F; unit tagged on hold. No food handler training or signed health policies provided.

headline: Passed; storage under unshielded sewer lines
summary: Passed. Liquor and single-service articles were stored under unshielded sewer lines in the basement closet. Low water pressure at the main cook-line handwash sink and a dirty floor drain under the scrape sink also need repair.

headline: Conditional; bare-hand contact, foods held too warm
summary: Pass with conditions. A food handler touched ready-to-eat leafy greens with bare hands (priority citation). Cooked beans, omelet ingredients, ham and steak were held at 45–69°F; about 15 pounds ($75) discarded (citation).

headline: Passed; rear door gaps, expired handler certificate
summary: Passed. The rear exit door by the dock doors has quarter- to half-inch gaps and is not rodent- or insect-proof. An employee's food handler certificate had expired and must be renewed.

headline: Passed; broken tile, grease on hood filters
summary: Passed. A broken wall tile with a hole in the dish area must be repaired or replaced. Debris under dish area equipment shelving needs cleaning, and heavy grease on filters above the grill and stove must be cleared.

headline: Passed; basement sticky traps, missing handwash sign
summary: Passed. Men's restroom lacked a handwashing sign. Sticky traps for flying insects were in the basement; staff were told to consult pest control on trap use. Also buildup on an ice machine door and rust on prep tables.

headline: Passed; missing handwash signs, leaking pipe
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs were missing at toilet room sinks, and piping at the warewashing unit was leaking. The operator was told to provide signs and repair the leak.

headline: No handwash signage at basement bar sink
summary: Exposed handwashing sink in the basement bar, referred to as 'The Drifter,' had no handwashing signage. Management instructed to provide it.

headline: Rodent droppings and dead mouse found; no vomit kit
summary: About 60 rodent droppings on pet aisle shelves and 40 along a wall in rear storage. Dead mouse on an open trap. Food and droppings on storage racks. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure or kit. Citation issued for rodent activity.

headline: No certified food manager; hand sink issues; citation
summary: Person in charge lacked a certified food manager certificate, and none was on duty while TCS foods were handled; citation issued. Hand drying devices missing at two sinks. Serving-line sink blocked by a wire rack. Repeat violations for food handler training and a gap at the rear door.

headline: Cooler at 48.7F; food discarded and cooler tagged
summary: Service cooler air measured 48.7F; coleslaw, milk, and ranch measured at 49F to 52F. About 8 lbs of food discarded. Refrigeration repair called during inspection; cooler tagged and must not be used until repaired. Torn gasket and certified manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: Slimy buildup in ice machine; unapproved vacuum packing
summary: Black slimy substance inside the ice machine was dripping into ice used for drinks. Machine turned off, ice removed, and interior cleaned and sanitized as instructed. Vacuum packaging of cooked foods without an approved HACCP plan; citation issued. Water leaks at sink faucet and stopper.

headline: Hot and cold foods out of temperature; discarded
summary: Plantain dumplings at 114.9F and fried chicken at 116.4F, below the 135F minimum; 9 lbs discarded. Cold foods in reach-in at 48.9F to 59.8F; 15 lbs discarded. Rear cooler at 50F must not be used until reinspected. Floors, walls, and ceilings damaged.

headline: Food on floors, freezer residue, no restroom signage
summary: No handwash signage in the women's restroom. Food residue and buildup inside freezers. Broken lid on restroom trash receptacle. Food boxes and bags on floor in storage hallway; must be raised six inches. Hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Missing handwash signs, pests-prone storage, leaks
summary: No handwashing sign at the dish area sink. Raw wood surfaces and crates used as shelving. Food debris and grease on fryers, slicers, and coolers. Leaking valve under a handwash sink and missing backflow device. Unused items to be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Black buildup in drain by 3-compartment sink
summary: Drain near the 3-compartment sink had a buildup of a black substance. Staff instructed to clean and maintain it. Re-inspection on a complaint; result was pass.

headline: Unlabeled containers; utensils stored in food
summary: Food storage containers lacked labels for salt, mayonnaise, butter, and sour cream. Utensils stored inside food in the prep area. A food handler prepared food without gloves. Staff instructed to correct each item.

headline: Open drink on prep table; food stored on floor
summary: Open beverage found on a prep table; employees to use closed-lid containers. Food stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler; items must be raised six inches. Styrofoam cup used to dip beverage from a bulk container. Damaged cooler gasket. No valid allergen training.

headline: Soiled cloths, cardboard liners, and pest-prone clutter
summary: Soiled wiping cloths stored on prep tables; instructed to keep them in sanitizing solution. Cardboard used as floor liners and food stored in plastic grocery bags in coolers. Heavy grease and debris on equipment and floors. Unused basement equipment must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Mops by utensil rack; missing sanitizer test strip
summary: Mops and brooms hung next to the clean utensil rack in the rear kitchen; must be kept away. No sanitizer test strip on site for the low-temperature dish machine; instructed to obtain one. Priority violation noted.

headline: Staff without hair restraints; damaged ceiling and floor tiles
summary: Employees preparing and serving food without hair restraints. Wiping cloths stored on prep tables. Water-damaged ceiling tiles in rear prep area and missing floor tiles under cooking equipment. Personal belongings stored in basement dry storage.

headline: No soap, paper towels, or thermometer; fish thawed in water
summary: Hand soap missing at prep and restroom sinks; paper towels and hand dryers missing at all handwash sinks. Frozen fish thawed in standing water, corrected to proper thawing instructions. No food thermometer on site. Broken sink stoppers on the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Dirty floor drains and floor near dish machine
summary: Basement floor drains at the dish machine need detail cleaning, as does the floor area there. Unisex restrooms lack a covered trash receptacle. Management instructed to clean and provide the receptacle.

headline: Food handler without hair restraint; dusty air screen
summary: A food handler was preparing food without a hair restraint. Management instructed that all food handlers must wear one. Heavy dust buildup on the air intake screen in the dry storage area. Management instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Live roaches on floor; pest control and citation
summary: More than five live roaches on the floor around a chest freezer in the dish area. Detail clean, sanitize, and consult pest control. Citation issued. Also dirty hood and filters, unlabeled plates not inverted, and large pots that do not fit the dish machine.

headline: Damaged ceiling tiles, grime, and wall hole
summary: Damaged ceiling tiles in the second-floor women's restroom and near the high-temperature dish machine. Excessive grime under the dish machine. Large hole in the wall outside the second-floor women's restroom. Person in charge instructed to repair and clean.

headline: Bread in garbage bags; no training proof; repeat violation
summary: Bread stored in plastic garbage bags in basement chest freezers; food-grade containers required. Freezer interior soiled with blood. Unused chest freezer in basement must be removed. No food handler training proof. Repeat allergen training violation.

headline: Non-working washroom ventilation; leaking drain
summary: Mechanical ventilation not working in all four washrooms on the first floor and basement; must be repaired. Drainpipe leaking under a handwash sink in the prep area. Ice bins in the bar have no covers. Missing covered receptacle in a first-floor washroom.

headline: No hand soap or paper towels at handwash sink
summary: Handwash sink next to the 3-compartment sink had no hand soap and no paper towels or hand dryer. Citation issued. Also a manager without a hair restraint, stained cutting boards, greasy floors, and no covered waste receptacle in the unisex washroom.

headline: Flying insects in prep area; manager told to call exterminator
summary: Numerous flying insects seen in the rear prep area. Manager told to call an exterminator and clean all areas. Also food debris on prep tables, single-use items not inverted, no toilet tissue in men's room, and last inspection summary not posted.

headline: Rodent droppings, live flies, and unsafe food temperatures
summary: About 50 rodent droppings in rear hallway, 50 under the register, and 20 under a sink; about 10 live flies. Pizza held at 80F to 82F; cold foods at 49F to 53F; discarded during the inspection. Several handwash sinks lacked towels or did not run. Citations issued.

headline: No certified food manager on site while cooking
summary: No certified foodservice manager on site while TCS foods such as rice, steak, and chicken were being prepared and served. Citation issued. Also dirt on the walk-in cooler door and on prep area walls. Management instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Food stored under stairwell; linens on floor
summary: Tortilla chips stored directly beneath a stairwell; instructed to relocate. Clean linens stored on the floor in second-story storage; must be raised six inches. Debris and grease under grill fixtures. No allergen training certificate on site for a certified food manager.

headline: Peeling paint and debris on cooler shelving
summary: Food debris and peeling paint on shelving inside the two-door cooler; must be detail cleaned and repainted. Floors along wall bases and corners need detail cleaning. Filters above the cooking equipment must be cleaned.

headline: Live flies in storage rooms; citation issued
summary: 35 live flies on walls, ceiling, and boxes in the rear pop syrup room and 25 in the paper goods room. Management instructed to remove flies, detail clean, and call pest control; citation issued. Also a ceiling hole in the dining utility closet.

headline: Rodent droppings found; slime in ice machine; citation
summary: About 60 mouse droppings in rear storage behind the chest freezer and under shelves. Additional pest control needed; citation issued. Black slime buildup in kitchen ice machine dripping onto ice. No food handler certificates or allergen training on site.

headline: No hot water at prep handwash sink; citation
summary: Handwash sink in the east prep area had no hot running water; measured at 68F, but it must be 100F. Repair instructed; citation issued. Employees told to use the handwash sink in the other prep area until fixed.

headline: Raw wood shelving and uncovered employee trash
summary: Three raw wood shelves in rear prep and storage must be sealed or painted to be cleanable and nonabsorbent. Unisex employee bathroom lacked a covered trash can. Management instructed to provide it.

headline: No certified food manager on premises; citation issued
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager on premises; priority violation with citation. Opening by side exit door must be sealed to prevent pests. Employee washroom door not self-closing. Repeat violation for an unused ice machine that must be removed.

headline: Portable sink, missing test kit, and washroom issues
summary: Portable handwash sink in rear prep has no variance; must be replaced with a fixed sink. No exposed handwash sink in front prep. No chlorine test kit, no service sink, and no food handler certificates. Employee washroom door is not self-closing and has no covered receptacle.

headline: Mops in water bucket; burnt-out lights
summary: Mops stored in a bucket of water in the rear dry storage area; must be stored properly between uses. Light bulbs out with no shielding in rear dry storage and an employee washroom. Management instructed to replace and maintain.

headline: Restroom signage, trash receptacle, and ceiling issues
summary: No handwashing sign in the unisex employee washroom. No covered waste receptacle in the unisex washroom. Peeling paint in liquor storage rooms. Large opening in washroom ceiling around a vent must be sealed. Dirt and debris under liquor shelving.

headline: Ice machine slime, cold food, and missing summary
summary: Black and pink slime inside the ice machine dripping onto ice; owner cleaned it during the inspection. Dish machine rinse had zero chlorine; technician fixed it on site to 100 PPM. Cold foods at 44.4F to 66.7F; 87 lbs discarded. Previous inspection summary not posted.

headline: No certified person in charge; fish thawed in sink
summary: No person in charge with a valid certificate; no sanitation manager on site or posted certificate; citation issued. Fish thawed in standing water in a prep sink; must thaw under refrigeration, cold running water, or during cooking. Food stored on floors in prep and storage.

headline: Cracked ice bin lid and sink drainage leak
summary: Cracked lid on the frappe ice bin was taped; the owner was told to replace it. Chemical drain lines under the 3-compartment sink leaked water onto the floor from pressure and air-gap contact. Owner instructed to repair so water drains properly.

headline: Repeat trash violation; no food handler certificates
summary: Wiping cloths not in sanitizing solution. Storage shelves, rear cabinet, cooking equipment, and rear floors need cleaning. No food handler certificates on site. Repeat violation: outside waste container was open and overflowing; citation issued.

headline: Missing handwash sign and unlabeled flour bins
summary: Missing handwash sign at a prep sink. Bulk flour storage containers not labeled. Grease, debris, and dirt on floors under equipment and in corners. Dust on fans and vents. Food service sanitation manager lacked allergen training certificate.

headline: Washing solution too cold at three-compartment sink
summary: Dish washing solution at the 3-compartment sink was dispensed at 65F. Manager instructed to dispense it at a minimum of 110F. Priority foundation violation noted.

headline: Soap and towels at dump sink; floor debris
summary: Soap, paper towels, and handwash signage must be removed from the one-compartment dump sink in the front prep area. Floors throughout the basement keg walk-in cooler have dirt and debris and must be cleaned.

headline: Multiple food handlers lacked certificates
summary: Multiple food handling employees did not have food handler certificates on site during inspection. Person in charge instructed to comply with Illinois food handler requirements and keep records.

headline: Sewage backing up onto prep floor; citation issued
summary: Waste water backing up from the cook-line floor drain onto the prep floor when a sink is used; open floor drain under the three-compartment sink not draining. Citation issued. Also excessive grease in the exterior grease trap, a broken cooler handle, and no allergen training for managers.

headline: Live and dead roaches found; pest control recommended
summary: Eight live roaches crawling in openings and crevices near the soda cabinet, plus several dead roaches on floors and inside cabinets. Dead roaches must be removed. Pest control service recommended on or after 4/30/26. Also worn cutting boards and grease buildup.

headline: Gap under garage door; low hot water pressure
summary: Gaps larger than a quarter inch along the garage door bottom seal in the rear trash area must be serviced. Four-drawer prep cooler lacks an air thermometer. Low hot water pressure at a middle bar handsink. Wet mops stacked on top of each other.

headline: No certified food manager on site for TCS foods
summary: No certified food manager with an original City of Chicago certificate on site while TCS foods such as ham, turkey, and cheese were prepared and served. Citation issued. Instructed to ensure all managers hold original certificates. Rusted racks in walk-in cooler.

headline: Slow deli sink drain; cooler thermometer placement
summary: Handwash sink at the deli station drains slowly; plumbing to be repaired. Cooler thermometers were kept in the coldest part of coolers and must be moved to the warmest part.

headline: Several food handlers lack certificates
summary: Several food handling employees did not have a food handler certificate. Management instructed that all food handling employees must show valid proof of food handler training.

headline: Milk and soda crates used for food storage
summary: Milk and soda crates must not be used for food storage in the rear storage area. Storage shelves must be used, placed six inches off the floor for easy cleaning.

headline: No paper towels at four sinks; dish machine temps off
summary: No paper towels at four handwash sinks; citation issued. Dish machine temperature gauges disagree: one reads 170F but internal gauge 165F; another reads 184F but internal 150F. Manager called repair service immediately. Food containers on floors in coolers.

headline: No proof of food handler training
summary: No proof of ANSI-approved food handler training on site. Proof must be provided for all food handlers.

headline: Missing handwash signs; food on floor in freezer
summary: Missing handwash signs at two prep sinks in the main kitchen. Food storage containers without labels. Food containers on the floor in the walk-in freezer. Food items stored in plastic grocery bags in the freezer; food-grade bags required.

headline: Display cooler food too warm; 69 lbs discarded
summary: Packaged cold foods in the display cooler measured 45.5F to 56.4F. Manager voluntarily discarded 69 lbs. Citation issued. Employee food stored with customer food; short ladles used; ice buildup; unfinished wood shelves; rusty shelves; leaking sink faucet; trash near dumpster.

headline: No health policy, signs, or trash receptacles
summary: No employee health policy on site. No handwashing signs at the sinks. No covered receptacle in the toilet room. No garbage can in the food prep area. Management instructed to provide each item.

headline: Pink mold on ice machine; openings and lights out
summary: Pink mold-like substance on the shield of a large basement ice machine; instructed to clean and sanitize. Exposed knife and fork on dining tables must be covered or wrapped. Storage items on floor; leaking faucet; openings near mop sink; two hood lights out.

headline: Food on floors, unlabeled bins, repeat violations
summary: Food stored on the floor in walk-in cooler and freezer. Unlabeled bulk containers and soiled wiping cloths on prep tables. No stoppers for the three-compartment sink and no running water at the utility sink. Repeat violations for hair restraints and allergen training; citation issued.

headline: Black flies and rat droppings; no certified manager
summary: About 5 to 8 black flies near the dough table, sink, and dining area. About 25 rat droppings under the two-door refrigerator. Additional pest control needed; citation issued. No certified manager on site while chicken and beef were served; manager arrived about 70 minutes later.

headline: Wastewater backing up from floor drain; citation
summary: Wastewater backed up from the rear food prep floor drain when the three-compartment sink drained. Management instructed to repair; citation issued. Heavy clutter throughout the kitchen must be cleared.

headline: Gaps under doors; food stored on floor upstairs
summary: Gaps at bottom of front and rear doors and top of front exit door; doors must be tight-fitting to prevent insect entry. Food trays stored on the floor on the second floor. Soiled cutting boards, drip pan debris, and food debris under equipment and in coolers.

headline: Missing backflow device; basement dust and debris
summary: No backflow prevention device on the coffee machine next to the handwash sink and three-compartment sink in the rear prep area. Heavy dust and construction debris in basement storage corners.

headline: Chicken held at 45F; expired food handler certificate
summary: Chicken measured at 45F in the two-door prep cooler; cold food must be kept at 41F or below. Priority violation and citation issued. Food handler with an expired certificate and certified food manager with expired allergen training. Fryer interiors had grease buildup.

headline: Food handler on duty lacked training
summary: A food handler on duty did not have food handler training. All employees must complete training and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Rodent droppings found; food too warm, dish machine tagged
summary: About 25 mouse droppings at corners and behind coolers; additional pest control needed; citation issued. Walk-in and dessert cooler foods at 44.6F to 50F; about 50 lbs discarded. Low-temperature dish machine had zero chlorine and was tagged. No metal stem thermometer; citation issued.

headline: Unsafe holding temperatures; ice discarded
summary: Black dirt buildup inside ice machine dripping into ice; all ice was discarded. Chicken and fish stock held at 102F and 105F, below the 135F minimum. Multiple cold foods held at 45F to 52F; 19 lbs discarded. Coolers were too warm; floor drains need cleaning.

headline: No pest control service or logbook provided
summary: No pest control service records or log book provided. Management instructed to obtain a licensed pest control service with a log book.

headline: Missing handwash signs; toilet room door issues
summary: No handwashing signs at the toilet room and rear three-compartment sinks. Toilet room trash receptacle has no lid. Toilet room door is not self-closing. Management instructed to correct each item.

headline: Mops stored wet in bucket; missing light shield
summary: Mops, brooms, and dust pans not stored properly; wet mops left sitting in a bucket. Ceiling light fixture in the main kitchen is missing a shield. Management instructed to correct both.

headline: Thermometers, door seal, and cleaning needed
summary: Instructed to provide visible thermometers inside all coolers and to rodent-proof the bottom of the front entrance door. Interiors of coolers need detail cleaning. Trash bin in restroom needs a lid. Floors in basement storage need cleaning. Non-working light bulb in a cooler.

headline: Food handler lacked certificate; allergen training expired
summary: One food handler did not have a food handler certificate. Allergen training certificates for food managers have expired. Manager instructed to have all food handlers certified and update allergen training.

headline: No thermometer in hot sandwich cabinet
summary: No thermometer inside the hot holding cabinet for hot sandwiches; management instructed to provide one. Outside of the soda fountain dispenser and inside of the ice chute need cleaning.

headline: No health policy, thermometer, or training proof
summary: No written employee health policy on site. No metal stem thermometer to check food temperatures. No stoppers at two of three sink compartments. Holes in walls and ceiling; dirty washroom. No proof of food handler or allergen training for managers.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; two coolers tagged out
summary: Walk-in cooler measured 50F and must be repaired to 41F or below. Two other walk-in coolers tagged and must be inspected before use. Overflowing dumpster with open lids; citation not issued. Ice scoop on the ice machine and pipe leak.

headline: No hair restraints, missing ceiling panels, no certificates
summary: Multiple food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Missing ceiling panels in the rear prep area. No food handler certificates on site. Person in charge instructed to correct each item.

headline: Unlabeled rice, food on floor, grease, no allergen training
summary: Rice stored in a non-food-grade container and not labeled. Food containers on the floor in walk-in cooler and freezer. Wiping towels left on counters; ice scoop laid on ice. Grease and debris in fryer and cooking equipment. Allergen training on site had expired.

headline: Rice scoop misplaced; dirty shelves and cooler damage
summary: Rice scoop stored in the rice hot-holding unit with its handle in the rice. Cooler lid in poor repair with exposed insulation. Rusty, dirty shelving and excessive stove debris. Leaking dish-area sink nozzle. Cardboard used as floor matting. Dirty hood filters; no food handler proof for an employee.

headline: No certified food manager; sanitizing steps lacking
summary: No person in charge or food employee with City of Chicago certified food manager training on site while TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. Sanitizing without a separate rinse at the 3-compartment sink. Leaking drain plug; temporary plug in use.

headline: Grease buildup inside fryer cabinets
summary: Slight grease buildup found inside the fryer cabinets. Staff instructed to clean and maintain in good condition.

headline: Drive-thru floors need cleaning
summary: Floors in the front drive-thru area need cleaning between and behind equipment to remove spills and debris.

headline: Labeling, hair restraints, and cleaning needed
summary: Handwash signs needed at all sinks. Prepackaged foods must be labeled and dated. Food handlers must wear hair restraints. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizing solution. Cutting boards, cooking equipment, and floors need cleaning; leak at the three-compartment sink faucet.

headline: No health policy, drains backing up; citation issued
summary: No signed employee health policies; citation issued. No hand drying device at a toilet room sink. Three-compartment sink floor drain backed up with foul odor; citation issued. Slow drains, missing cooler thermometers, worn gaskets, and food debris throughout.

headline: Quarter-inch gap at rear exit door
summary: A quarter-inch gap at the bottom of the rear exit door. Manager instructed to seal all outer door openings to prevent pest entry.

headline: Black, pink, and brown buildup in basement ice machine
summary: Basement ice machine had a buildup of black, pink, and brown substance dripping onto ice used for human consumption. Staff instructed to remove the ice, deep clean, sanitize, and maintain. Citation issued.

headline: Large opening under entrance door; floor tile damage
summary: Large opening at the bottom of the double front entrance door, which must be made rodent-proof. Missing handwash signs and unlabeled storage containers. Wiping cloths left on prep tables. Grease, debris, and dust in several areas; damaged floor tiles in bakery and carnitas areas.

headline: No health policy, no vomit kit; citation issued
summary: No signed employee health policies; citation issued. No clean-up items for vomiting or diarrhea events. Hand sinks lacked hand drying devices. Cooked chicken wings (about 60 lbs) held at 56.4F to 84.7F. Multiple raw seafood and chicken items at 45.5F to 53.1F; about 40 lbs discarded.

headline: No city sanitation manager on premises
summary: Person in charge had no City of Chicago sanitation manager certificate. No sanitation manager on the premises while TCS foods were handled; citation issued. Food containers were not stored inverted.

headline: About 100 rat droppings; no certified person in charge
summary: About 100 rat droppings in meat and fish areas, under prep tables, on shelving, and in the walk-in cooler. Last pest service was December 3, 2025. Pest control needed before re-inspection. Person in charge lacked a sanitation certificate while TCS foods were served; citation issued.

headline: Greasy fryers and dusty washroom fans
summary: Interior bottom and wheels of the fryers need grease removal. Floor under cooking equipment to be cleaned where needed. Washroom ventilation fans need dust removal where needed.

headline: Torn garage door seal; sewer lines over food storage
summary: Garage door bottom seal torn with holes over an inch; must be repaired to be rodent-proof. Food and equipment stored under unshielded sewer and wastewater lines in the crawl space. Rusted freezer lid and water-damaged ceiling. Repairs instructed.

headline: Unlabeled food storage containers
summary: Food storage containers without labels showing the common names of foods. Management instructed to provide labels.

headline: Food stored on floors; no food handler certificates
summary: Food containers stored on floors in walk-in cooler, prep, and storage areas. Single-service articles not inverted and stored on the floor. Grease buildup on cooking equipment, walls, and shelves. Dust on fans and vents. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Unlabeled rice bins; food debris in sinks and coolers
summary: Some bulk rice containers in the prep area were not labeled. Accumulated food debris inside and outside the three-compartment sink and all coolers. Management must clean and label as instructed.

headline: Live flies in prep and dining areas; citation issued
summary: About 13 small live black flies on walls, ceilings, and equipment in prep and dish areas and flying in the dining room. Pest control recommended; citation issued. Handwash sinks lacked drying towels and soap; person in charge supplied them. Two of four toilets broken and covered with bags.

headline: Grease trap leaking; plumber fixed on site
summary: Grease trap leaked when the three-compartment sink drained. Plumber arrived during the inspection to correct the problem; citation issued. Residue inside the ice machine. Soiled mop heads must be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Rat droppings in furnace room and under mop sink
summary: About 20 rat droppings in corners of the side furnace room and under the rear mop sink. Additional pest control service needed; citation issued. Wiping cloths not held in sanitizing solution. Fryer grease and cluttered rear storage must be cleaned and removed.

headline: Beans too warm; salsas packed without approval
summary: Cooked beans measured 67F to 70F; manager discarded about 20 lbs. Salsas packed with reduced-oxygen machines without CDPH approval or HACCP plan; salsa discarded, machines tagged and held; citation issued. Garbage cans used to store tripe; food-grade containers required.

headline: Cooler gaskets torn; trash under ice machine
summary: Cooked eggs covered in a reach-in cooler while cooling; must be uncovered to cool properly. Torn gaskets on a four-door cooler and two freezers must be repaired. Loose prep sink faucet. Food debris and trash under the main kitchen ice machine.

headline: Plates and bowls not inverted; grease on oil tank
summary: Plates and bowls facing up in the kitchen and sushi prep area must be stored inverted. Grease buildup on top of the outside oil tank must be cleaned. Items in the employee toilet and mop sink area need to be organized.

headline: Missing handwash signs and hair restraints
summary: Handwash signs missing near sinks in front and rear prep areas. Employees preparing food without hair restraints. Wiping cloths stored on prep tables and the dish machine; must be kept in sanitizing solution.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; manager without allergen training
summary: Rubber door gaskets on the one-door and two-door prep coolers were ripped and must be replaced or repaired. One food manager did not have an allergen training certificate on site.

headline: No restroom handwash sink; no thermometers
summary: Failed. No handwashing sink was inside the restroom, and no stem thermometer was on site. Two reach-in coolers lacked hanging thermometers. The mop sink faucet has no backflow prevention device. No citations issued; corrections must be provided.

headline: Ice machine missing exterior cover
summary: Passed on reinspection. The ice machine is missing its exterior cover, which must be replaced and maintained.

headline: No certified manager on duty; no pest control log
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on duty while chicken, pizza and fries were prepared and served. No employee health policy and no current pest control logbook were on site. Handwash sink lacked paper towels; citations issued.

headline: About 60 live flies and 45 rodent droppings
summary: Failed. About 60 small live black flies were on prep surfaces, walk-in storage and grocery items. About 45 rodent droppings were scattered in grocery shelves, rear storage, the toilet room and near registers.

headline: No test strips; no thermometer in milk cooler
summary: Failed. No thermometer inside the milk cooler. No sanitizer test strips were on hand for the three-compartment sink, and the high-temperature dish machine had no temperature indicators. Both are priority violations.

headline: Cracked ceiling tiles above basement dish area
summary: Passed on reinspection. Cracked and chipping ceiling tiles above the basement dish area must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Bare-hand tomato cutting; raw eggs warm; flies
summary: Failed. Tomatoes were cut with bare hands and discarded. Raw eggs at 55.6–58.8°F were discarded. About 15–20 flies were on ceilings, walls and boxes in basement and dry storage. Hot water was missing at sinks until restored during inspection.

headline: Clean dishware under stairwell; leaking faucets
summary: Passed. Clean beverage glasses were stored beneath a stairwell near warewashing, and clean plates and bowls sat uncovered by the charcoal grill. Walk-in cooler door gaskets are in poor repair. Warewashing faucets and a dish machine chemical dispenser leak.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings found throughout
summary: Failed. Over 100 mice droppings were found in deep freezers, on shelves, pallets and floors of rear storage, and around the dish-area water heater. Manager instructed to call an exterminator and clean all areas; citation issued.

headline: Mold-like residue dripping onto ice; wastewater backup
summary: Failed. Black mold-like substance inside the ice machine was dripping onto ice for human consumption; ice to be discarded. Wastewater backed up onto the floor from a floor drain during sink use; plumber arrived during inspection. Citations issued.

headline: Fly traps over prep area; peeling ceiling paint
summary: Passed. Sticky fly trap rolls were hanging above the prep and dishwashing area and were to be removed. Stained cutting boards need resurfacing or replacement. Peeling paint debris was seen on the ceiling above the beverage cooler.

headline: Food on walk-in floors; no food handler training proof
summary: Pass with conditions. Food containers were stored directly on floors in the walk-in cooler and freezer. Dumpster lids did not close due to overflowing trash; citation issued. No proof of food handler training was provided for all food handlers.

headline: No signed employee health policies on file
summary: Pass with conditions. No signed employee health policies were on hand; this is a priority foundation violation. Broken walk-in cooler and freezer door gaskets, rust on shelving, and grease and broken glass on floors also need repair or cleaning.

headline: No raw-food advisory on menus; broken dumpster lids
summary: Failed. Electronic menus lack a consumer advisory for raw or undercooked animal foods, such as raw oysters; priority violation, no citation. Outside dumpster has broken lids; citation issued. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Pork, shrimp and fish held above safe temperature
summary: Pass with conditions. Pork (48.4–48.7°F), shrimp (48.2°F) and fish (47.1°F) were above the 41°F safe limit. Manager discarded 35 lbs ($180). Dirty wiping cloths, milk crates used as shelving, and food in grocery bags also noted.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies; door gaps
summary: Pass with conditions. No procedures or supplies were in place for vomit and diarrhea cleanups; a priority foundation violation. A 1/4-inch gap at the front entrance doors must be sealed. Also: no utility sink backflow device and an inoperable washroom fan.

headline: Front door gap; leaking sink; dirty floors
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the front entry door must be repaired to prevent pests. All cutting boards need replacement. The one-compartment sink has a loose, leaking faucet, and floors throughout need detail cleaning.

headline: Bar drain leak; heavy grease on vent filters
summary: Passed. The front/main bar drain pipe leaks when the sink is in use and must be serviced. Second-floor bar hand sink drains slowly. Overhead vent filters above the main cooking area are covered with heavy grease and dust.

headline: Two burned-out ceiling light bulbs
summary: Passed. Two burned-out ceiling light bulbs, to the right of the front entrance, must be replaced and maintained.

headline: Vents above cooking need cleaning
summary: Passed. Washroom doors lack self-closing devices and must be fitted with them. Vents above cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: No health policy or pest control records
summary: Failed. No employee health policies were on premises; no pest control logbook or signed contract was available. Both are priority foundation violations. Basement washroom door isn't self-closing; certified managers need allergen training.

headline: Dirty ice bin; plastic bags and milk crates used
summary: Passed. The ice bin interior needs cleaning. Frozen food was in plastic grocery bags in basement chest freezers; only food-grade storage bags and containers are allowed. Milk crates are used as shelving and must be replaced.

headline: Food residue inside rear cold-hold unit
summary: Passed. Food residue was on the bottom interior of a cold-hold unit in the rear prep area and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Coolers need thermometers; unlabeled containers
summary: Passed. Thermometers must be visible inside all coolers. Food storage containers need common-name labels. Coconut milk must move from an open can to food-grade storage. Milk crates and cardboard liners must not be used; basement storage floors need cleaning.

headline: Greasy fryers, dirty floors, hood needs cleaning
summary: Passed. Grease must be cleaned from the inside bottom of the fryers. Floors under, around and behind cooking and other equipment in the kitchen and storage area need cleaning. Hood system needs cleaning; scheduled for this Wednesday.

headline: Fried chicken held below 135°F; discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Fried chicken in the hot-holding unit measured 119–123°F; hot food must be at least 135°F. Manager discarded 5 lbs ($50); citation issued. Grease buildup on equipment and floors, and stained ceiling tiles, also noted.

headline: No certified manager; no food thermometer
summary: Failed. No certified food manager (CFM) was on site while open and operating; citation issued. No probe thermometer was available for checking food temperatures. Rear door opening, floor openings and a wall hole near the mop sink must be sealed.

headline: No certified food manager on site while serving chicken
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager (CFM) was on site while chicken was prepared and served; citation issued. Rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap. Deep fryers have thick grease, food and dirt buildup.

headline: Unlabeled food in walk-in cooler
summary: Passed on reinspection. Assorted food items in the walk-in cooler were not labeled with product names. Bulk containers must also be labeled.

headline: Handwash sink water too hot; citation issued
summary: Pass with conditions. Hot water at the dishwashing area handwash sink measured 123.2–125.0°F. Hand sinks must run hot and cold water at 100–120°F; engineering lowered it to 110–115°F. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Broken cooler glass and floor holes
summary: Passed on reinspection. Glass is broken on a freezer door and two cold-holding unit doors. Soap buckets and soda crates sit on the retail floor. Floor holes, cracked tiles, a leaking three-compartment sink faucet and an opening between front doors also need fixing.

headline: Expired allergen certificates; rear door gaps
summary: Passed. Half-inch gaps at both rear exit door sweeps must be rodent-proofed. Expired allergen training certificates for certified food managers must be updated. Three-compartment sink stoppers and a rooftop handwash sink's cold handle also need repair.

headline: Soiled shelving and floors throughout
summary: Passed on reinspection. Shelving and floors throughout the facility have soil and debris buildup and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Unlabeled containers; greasy equipment and gasket
summary: Passed on reinspection. Food and spices in containers lacked product name labels. A torn, dirty gasket on the front prep cooler needs repair or replacement. Grease and food debris were found on cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, freezers and shelving.

headline: More than 40 live roaches found throughout facility
summary: Failed. Roach infestation: more than 40 live roaches found throughout, including inside coolers, on spice rack shelves, and on basement floors and walls. Manager instructed to service all affected areas. Citation issued. Cooler gaskets also need cleaning.

headline: Entrance gaps; no allergen training for two staff
summary: Passed. Openings at the front entrance door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Food containers were on the walk-in cooler floor or milk crates. Two employees lacked allergen training proof, and faucets at the three-compartment and front prep handwash sinks leak.

headline: Water leak at ice machine; dirty bar floors and drains
summary: Passed. Water leaking from the west ice machine's supply line must be repaired. Floors with litter, syrup-splashed bar walls and dirty floor drains at all three bars need cleaning. Also a loose milk cooler gasket and dusty ceiling vents.

headline: Food boxes on floor; dirty cloth on cutting board
summary: Passed on reinspection. Numerous food boxes were stacked on the floor by the rear door and must be stored at least six inches off the floor. A dirty wiping cloth was on a cutting board. Minor leak under the 3-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Lights out; CFM lacks allergen training certificate
summary: Passed on reinspection. Shelves are needed in the walk-in cooler, and the deep fryer interior needs cleaning. Several lights were out in food prep and storage areas. The certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: Food supplies stored below wastewater lines
summary: Passed. Single-service items, food equipment and linens were stored on shelves directly below wastewater lines in the basement storage area. They must be moved or shielded from possible drips and contamination.

headline: Grease spills outside; water bottles on prep table
summary: Passed. Grease spills were on top of the outside oil tank container and must be cleaned. Personal water bottles were stored on a rear prep table and must be kept in a designated area away from food and clean equipment.

headline: No three-compartment sink stoppers; greasy wall
summary: Passed. The three-compartment sink has no stoppers; at least two are required. Grease buildup on the wall and floor behind the sink must be cleaned. Uneven drywall behind the washroom toilet must be repaired.

headline: Chicken and coleslaw held above 41°F; discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Chicken and coleslaw were held at 44.5–45.0°F in the pantry reach-in cooler; they must be 41°F or below. All out-of-temperature food was discarded (11 lbs, $12). Also: ice machine buildup, torn cooler gaskets, dusty condensers.

headline: Stained ceiling tiles; burnt-out hood light
summary: Passed. Handwashing signage on the three-compartment sink must be removed. The women's restroom trash can needs a lid. Stained ceiling tiles near rear dining restrooms need repair, and one hood light is burnt out.

headline: Dish machine tagged out; batter covered while cooling
summary: Pass with conditions. Low-temperature dish machine was not sanitizing; tagged out until repaired and rechecked by Chicago Department of Public Health (CDPH). Batter was tightly covered while cooling. Handwash sink lacked paper towels at inspection.

headline: Debris inside ice machine must be cleaned
summary: Passed on reinspection. Slight encrusted debris was found inside the ice machine. It must be removed, detail cleaned, serviced and maintained.

headline: Employees eating and drinking at prep area
