summary: Passed. Employees were seen drinking and preparing food at the prep area, and some lacked hair restraints. Also noted: unlabeled food in coolers, a torn cooler gasket, stained cutting boards, and greasy walls and floors.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; allergen proof missing
summary: Passed on reinspection. Food handler certificates were expired for all food handlers, and multiple employees lacked allergen training proof. Also: no covered receptacle in employee washroom, grease buildup in fryer prep area, and missing floor grout.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies; no allergen proof
summary: Passed. Vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies were inadequate; sanitizer must eliminate norovirus. No citation issued. Coolers lack thermometers, toilet doors are not self-closing, and certified manager lacks allergen proof.

headline: Expired or missing food handler training
summary: Passed. Some employees have expired or missing food handler training; records must be provided. Also noted: food debris in cold-holding unit drawers, worn cutting boards, ceiling splatter above oven, and standing water in dish area and basement.

headline: Missing handwash sink; no pest control records
summary: Failed. Dish area has no handwashing sink, a priority violation; citation issued. New menu lacks a consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods like steaks and burgers. No current pest control service report was available; last dated July 2025.

headline: Wiping cloths left on equipment; sink draining slowly
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were stored on top of prep and cooking equipment instead of in sanitizing solution. A handwashing sink in the food prep area drains slowly. Washroom ventilation is inoperable, and grease covers vents and filters above cooking equipment.

headline: Missing cooler handle; loose sink seal
summary: Passed. A handle is missing on a two-door cooling unit at the hot line and must be repaired. The seal at the salad station's three-compartment sink is loose and must be sealed to the wall to prevent insect harborage.

headline: Leaky sink stopper; countertop gaps
summary: Passed. The stopper handle on the far-left three-compartment sink leaks and must be repaired or replaced. Gaps on the inner sides of the front bar prep countertop must be sealed.

headline: No certified manager; sink blocked; dish machine tagged
summary: Failed. No certified food manager (CFM) on site while eggs, sausage and milk were served. Prep handsink blocked. Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer and was tagged out. No written employee health policy; report not posted.

headline: No employee health policies; no food handler training
summary: Pass with conditions. No signed employee health policies or food handler training records were on hand; a citation was issued for the health policy. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Door gaps and an ice machine missing a backflow device noted.

headline: Mislabeled cake slices; rainwater through basement walls
summary: Passed on reinspection. Packaged cake slices lacked full labels, including ingredients and net weight. Cardboard was used as liner on prep equipment. Basement storage walls let rainwater through; they must be repaired and sealed.

headline: Unlabeled sugar bin; trash on dry storage floor
summary: Passed on reinspection. A large bin of sugar was not labeled with its common name. Food debris and trash were on the floor under a wire storage rack in rear dry storage. Both must be corrected and maintained.

headline: No allergen certificate on site; worn cutting boards
summary: Passed. No allergen certificate was on site for City of Chicago sanitation certificate holders. Cutting boards are worn with deep cuts and discoloration and must be replaced. Gaskets need cleaning; sponges must be in good condition.

headline: Broken walk-in cooler floor; cluttered basement
summary: Passed. The walk-in cooler floor is broken and lifting, and the basement threshold is lifting; both must be repaired. Basement floor is cluttered and must be cleared or elevated. A hole or crack in basement ceiling must be sealed.

headline: Food on floors; greasy floors; littered refuse area
summary: Passed. Food containers were stored on floors in the walk-in cooler, prep and storage areas and must be elevated six inches. The refuse enclosure is littered with unnecessary items. Grease, food debris and dust were noted on floors, walls and fans.

headline: Leaks at bar sinks; greasy fryers; stained tile
summary: Passed. Leaks under the bar's three-compartment and handwash sinks must be repaired. Stained tile above a refrigerator indicates a leak; a kitchen baseboard hole needs sealing. Stained cutting boards, rusted cooler racks and encrusted fryer grease also noted.

headline: Cooked chicken stored in used food boxes
summary: Passed. Cooked chicken and fried foods were stored in used food boxes; food-grade containers are required. Bowls and cups were used as scoops in bulk containers. Worn cutting boards and dirty floors and equipment also noted.

headline: Missing allergen certificate; floor tiles missing
summary: Passed on reinspection. No allergen training certificate for the certified manager was on site; it must be obtained and kept on site. Missing floor tiles and an uncovered restroom receptacle also need repair.

headline: Fly strips in prep; food debris and grease
summary: Passed. Fly strips were hanging in rear prep and dish areas and must be removed. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, and single-service items were stored on the floor. Food debris, grease and spills were found on equipment, shelves and floors.

headline: Expired food handler certificate; ice machine needs cleaning
summary: Passed. One employee had an expired food handler certificate, and current certificates are required for all required staff. Upper interior of the ice machine needs cleaning. Certified food managers must show proof of allergen training.

headline: No certified manager; cold food too warm; sinks blocked
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on site. Cold foods including raw chicken, fish and cheese were above 41°F; 150 lbs ($300) discarded. Walk-in cooler at 58.4°F is tagged out. Handwash sinks were blocked and food was on the floor.

headline: No splash guard; foil wrapped on equipment
summary: Passed on reinspection. The handwash sink on the cook prep line has no splash guard and needs one to prevent splash contamination. Aluminum foil wrapped around equipment must be removed.

headline: Sink leaks; greasy fryers and dirty coolers
summary: Passed on reinspection. Leaks were found at the three-compartment sink behind the bar and the dim sum prep handsink, and a cold water faucet handle needs repair. Fryer exteriors, walk-in shelves and floors under cooking equipment need cleaning. Loose tile and wall hole in men's washroom.

headline: Utensils in 73.6°F water; knife stored improperly
summary: Passed. Cook-line utensils sat in 73.6°F water; hot water must be 135°F minimum, or utensils cleaned and sanitized every four hours. A knife was stored between prep tables. Wiping cloths out of sanitizer and greasy equipment also noted.

headline: Missing handwashing sign and cooler thermometers
summary: Passed. A handwashing sign is needed in the employee washroom. Two of three reach-in coolers need thermometers. Coving is needed along wall bases in the rear area.

headline: About 30 live small flies found in facility
summary: Failed. About 20 live small flies were on walls in rear storage and 10 on walls outside walk-in coolers. All fly activity must be removed by reinspection. Also: food buildup on sinks and shelves, and dirty walls and floor drains.

headline: Uncovered food and expired allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Food in coolers and refrigerators was uncovered and needs lids or covers. Food was stored in plastic grocery bags, and utensils were stored improperly in prep areas. The certified manager's allergen training certificate has expired.

headline: More than 20 flies; dish machines not sanitizing
summary: Failed. More than 20 small flies were found throughout the kitchen, employee toilet room and bar; citation issued. Two low-temperature dish machines had 0 ppm chlorine. One machine's wash water reached only 104°F and was tagged.

headline: Food stored on floor; freezers and floors dirty
summary: Passed. Food containers were stored on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised at least six inches. Reach-in freezers had excess debris and ice buildup. Grease, food debris and spills were found on floors, walls and under equipment.

headline: Eggs at 54–55°F in sandwich prep cooler
summary: Pass with conditions. Shell eggs (55°F) and liquid eggs (54°F) were in a sandwich prep cooler with 50°F air. Cold foods must stay at 41°F or below; citation issued. Floor under 3-compartment sink needs cleaning; washroom tiles broken.

headline: Dish machine reached only 149°F; lighting inadequate
summary: Pass with conditions. The high-temperature conveyor dish machine reached only 149°F; it must reach 160°F, per a priority violation. Lighting in food prep areas was inadequate and must be improved.

headline: No certified manager; no hand soap at sink
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while chicken, beef, pork and soup were prepared and served; citation issued. Hand soap was missing at the prep sink but was corrected on site. Front door bottom needs rodent-proofing.

headline: Holes in rear storage wall
summary: Passed on reinspection. Holes in walls in the rear storage area must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Manager lacked allergen training certificate
summary: Passed on reinspection. The food service sanitation manager did not have an allergen training certificate. Instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: Dead roaches in basement; outdoor trash piled
summary: Passed on reinspection. Dead roaches were found on floors and planks near the basement deep freezer chest and must be removed. Outdoor garbage area had trash piles near receptacles; instructed to maintain it to prevent pests. Microwave splatter also noted.

headline: Equipment on floor; ice machine residue; meat spills
summary: Passed. Tortillas were stored on the restaurant floor, and multi-use equipment on the floor must be rewashed, rinsed and sanitized. Meat spills and debris were inside the rear walk-in cooler. Ice machine residue and missing 3-compartment sink stoppers also noted.

headline: No certified manager during egg cooking; ice dripping
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on site while eggs were cooked; corrected on site when manager arrived at inspection's end. Ice machine had slimy buildup dripping onto ice. Handwash sinks lacked soap and paper towels; citations issued.

headline: Espresso machine lacks backflow device
summary: Passed on reinspection. Slight buildup inside the ice maker's lower compartment must be detail cleaned. The espresso machine has no backflow prevention device that could be located, and one must be provided.

headline: Lentil soup held at 59°F in walk-in cooler
summary: Pass with conditions. A large pot of lentil soup cooked yesterday was at 59°F in the walk-in cooler. Cold foods needing temperature control (TCS) must stay at 41°F or below; citation issued. Also: torn gasket, sink leak and splattered walls.

headline: New manager lacks allergen training; dirty floors
summary: Passed. A new certified food manager lacked allergen training certification and must provide it on site. Debris and possible food sat behind the upright coolers. Shelving, floors and walls near the small freezer had food splatter and grease.

headline: Walk-in freezer light out; floor spills
summary: Passed. The walk-in freezer ceiling light is not working and must be replaced. Dirt and spills on the storage room floor under the chemicals shelf must be cleaned.

headline: No evidence of allergen training found
summary: Passed. No evidence of allergen training was found during inspection. The person in charge (PIC) was instructed to obtain and maintain it.

headline: Raw pork thawing at room temperature
summary: Passed. Raw pork rib tips were thawing at room temperature near the stairs (34.5°F reading) and must move to refrigeration or an approved thawing method. Personal care items were stored above dry food. Unlabeled bulk containers also noted.

headline: About 15 live flies near donut display
summary: Failed. About 15 live small flies were around the donut display and on walls and ceiling of the front food prep and dining area. The side entrance door has a one-inch gap. No food handler certificates were available for review; citation issued.

headline: Dirty floors throughout; floor mats stored on floor
summary: Passed. Loose debris, dirt and dust built up on floors and corners throughout the facility and need detail cleaning. Rolled-up floor mats were stored on the floor in a customer seating corner and must be removed.

headline: Stored items on floors; plastic grocery bags in freezers
summary: Passed on reinspection. All stored items must be raised off floors. Plastic grocery bags are not allowed as food containers in freezers and coolers. A broken self-closing device on the employee washroom door must be repaired.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. Bulk containers lacked common ingredient names. An item was stored on the floor in dry storage. City sanitation managers lacked allergen training certificates.

headline: Wall base repair; walls and door need cleaning
summary: Passed. A wall base near the walk-in cooler needs repair. Walls around the utility sink, behind the trash bin by the handwash sink, and the toilet room door need cleaning and debris removal.

headline: No certified manager; handwashing sinks blocked
summary: Failed. No person in charge with a valid city sanitation certificate, and no certified manager on site while foods needing temperature control (TCS) were served. Handwash sinks were blocked and lacked soap and towels. Summary report not visible to customers.

headline: Door gaps; grill not under exhaust hood
summary: Passed. Gaps between the front doors and along the base of both outer doors must be sealed to prevent pests. The gas flat-top grill must be moved fully under the exhaust hood. A backflow device is needed on the utility sink.

headline: Grease and floor debris on food truck
summary: Passed. Grease buildup near deep fryers and between cooling and steam table equipment must be cleaned. Dried food debris on floors must be removed. A garbage receptacle is required. License number must be shown on the truck's sides.

headline: No certified manager; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager (CFM) on site while chicken and beef were handled. Bar dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine at final rinse while in use. Meat slicer dirty behind blade; no splash guard at handwash sink.

headline: Menus lack raw food consumer advisory
summary: Failed. Menus did not disclose raw or undercooked foods and no consumer advisory was included; priority violation. Ice maker interior has encrusted debris. Also missing 3-compartment sink stoppers, unlabeled bulk containers, and a manager without allergen training.

headline: No food handler certificates; prior allergen violation uncorrected
summary: Pass with conditions. No food handler certificates were on site. A prior allergen training violation was not corrected. Wet wiping cloths sat on prep surfaces, some handlers lacked beard restraints, and frozen food was in plastic grocery bags.

headline: Manager lacked certificate; ice machine not clean
summary: Passed with conditions. Person in charge lacked a City sanitation certificate, and no valid original certificate was provided for the manager on duty; cited. Ice machine interior and bin were not clean. Debris behind a rear storage shelf needs cleaning.

headline: Passed; greasy equipment, cardboard floor mats
summary: Passed. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment in the front prep area must be cleaned. Cardboard under floor mats in prep areas must be removed and replaced with smooth, non-absorbent, cleanable surfaces.

headline: No certified manager; dish sink water too cool
summary: Failed. No certified food service sanitation manager on premises; cited. Three-compartment sink water measured 102.4°F, below the required 110°F; cited. Overflowing dumpster that cannot close could let pests in. No proof of food handler training.

headline: Chicken and beef too warm; food discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Chicken at 46.8°F and beef at 50.4°F were in a cold holding unit; manager voluntarily discarded about 5 lb. Also: discolored cutting boards, food stored in grocery bags, a burned-out light, and missing allergen training documentation.

headline: Missing health policy and vomit cleanup supplies
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy on site; cited. Vomit and diarrhea kit missing supplies; cited. Also: pink mineral buildup inside the ice machine, cracked basement ceiling above prep table, and no allergen training certificate.

headline: Passed; health policy and bowl washing needed
summary: Passed with conditions. No written employee health policy on premises; a signed policy for each employee is required. A large mixing bowl does not fit in the three-compartment sink; alternative washing procedures must be provided.

headline: Duct tape used on freezers and wall
summary: Passed. Duct tape was used on basement chest freezers and on the wall above the three-compartment sink. The person in charge must remove the tape and repair with smooth, easily cleanable material.

headline: Passed; hole above mop sink
summary: Passed. A hole in the wall above the mop sink must be sealed and maintained.

headline: Manager lacked valid certificate; floors dirty
summary: Passed with conditions. Manager on duty lacked a valid City food sanitation certificate while TCS foods were prepared and served; cited. Floors around, under and behind cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Passed; cleaning, clutter, and door closer
summary: Passed. Reach-in cooler interiors need cleaning of spills. The restroom needs a self-closing door device. Floors and walls need cleaning of food splatter, and clutter in prep and service areas should be removed.

headline: Hair restraint lapses; allergen training missing
summary: Passed with conditions. Food preparers lacked effective hair restraints. Allergen training is missing and the prior summary was not posted; both cited. Also: fly zapper stored above to-go condiments, milk crates and cardboard used for shelving and flooring.

headline: Passed; drinking in prep area, unsanitized cloths
summary: Passed. An employee drank from a covered beverage while preparing food; personal care items were stored above a food prep surface. Wiping cloths were kept in water without sanitizer. Also: no cooler thermometer, dirty equipment exteriors.

headline: Pink slime in ice machine; broken dumpster lids
summary: Failed. Ice machine interior had pink slime; ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned; cited. Dumpster had broken lids; cited. Also: ice scoop stored on ice, uncovered food in coolers, missing labels, and improper knife and wiping cloth storage.

headline: Multiple foods held at unsafe temperatures
summary: Failed. Macaroni and cheese held at 129°F, below the 135°F hot-hold requirement. Potato salad at 60°F, cheese at 49°F and mayo at 57°F in a prep cooler. Cooked chicken held past the 7-day limit. All cited.

headline: Passed; microwave interior needs cleaning
summary: Passed. The inside of the microwave oven had dirt and food particles. Staff were instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Passed; missing sink stoppers
summary: Re-inspection passed. Missing stoppers at the front bar's three-compartment sink must be provided and maintained.

headline: Clogged handwash sink fixed on site; door gap
summary: Passed with conditions. Fruit-prep handwash sink was clogged and full of wastewater; a plumber repaired it on site; cited. Rear double doors have a 1/4-inch gap to seal. Also: leaking faucets, slow-draining sink, floor gap, stained cutting board, rust on shelving.

headline: Passed; no cooler thermometers; greasy equipment
summary: Passed. Reach-in prep coolers at the cook line lacked visible thermometers. Cutting boards have open seams and stains. Grease on fryers and ovens, food debris on floors and drains, and faceup single-use items need correction.

headline: Passed; ice buildup and greasy hood
summary: Passed. Ice buildup inside the walk-in and reach-in freezers must be defrosted and cleaned. Floors and walls need cleaning, a floor drain needs deep cleaning, and the hood and filters need grease removed.

headline: Re-inspection passed; allergen training missing
summary: Re-inspection passed. Certified food managers lacked allergen training certificates. Management was instructed to comply with current training requirements.

headline: Re-inspection passed; allergen training missing
summary: Re-inspection passed. No certified food manager with food allergen training was on site. The manager was instructed to comply with the requirement.

headline: Re-inspection passed; food on floor, dirty coolers
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food containers on the walk-in floor must be raised six inches. Reach-in coolers and freezers have heavy food debris. Restroom trash cans need lids. Also: dust on ice machine lip, greasy hood filters, missing light shield, clutter.

headline: Passed; health policy and training missing
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy on site. Some employees worked without food handler certificates, and certified managers lacked allergen training. Documents must be kept on site at all times.

headline: Re-inspection passed; door gaps need sealing
summary: Re-inspection passed. An opening beside the side exit door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. The employee all-gender washroom door must be tight-fitting and self-closing.

headline: Passed; ice buildup in bar freezer
summary: Passed. No handwash signage at the bar sink. Heavy ice buildup in the first-floor bar freezer must be defrosted. A loose soap dispenser needs repair, and an unused vacuum packager in the basement must be removed.

headline: Re-inspection passed; expired training certificates
summary: Re-inspection passed. Expired food handler training certificates were found on site, and an expired allergen training certificate was also found. Current certificates must be provided for all food handlers and certified managers.

headline: No certified manager on site; rear door gap
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager on site while open; cited. The rear exit door has small openings at the bottom that must be sealed to keep rodents out.

headline: Passed; torn walk-in cooler gasket
summary: Passed. A torn door gasket inside the walk-in cooler was found and must be replaced.

headline: No employee health policy; rear door gap
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy on premises; one must be provided. A 1/4-inch gap under the rear exit door must be sealed to keep rodents out. The three-compartment sink lacks working stoppers.

headline: Passed; labels, cardboard, grease, self-closing door
summary: Passed. Large flour and other containers need common-name labels. Cardboard lining shelves under cooking units must be removed. Grease and debris under the flat-top, inside a reach-in cooler, and floor dirt need cleaning. Basement restroom door needs a self-closing device.

headline: Passed; ice machine buildup, floor debris
summary: Passed. Minor pink mineral buildup inside the rear ice machine must be cleaned. Food debris on floors under prep tables must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager on site; insect carcasses found
summary: Passed with conditions. No City certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared and served; cited. Insect carcasses were found on the ground under various equipment; manager was instructed to remove them.

headline: No valid manager; unapproved cake; no pest log
summary: Failed. No valid certified food manager posted while TCS foods were prepared; cited. Nine containers of cake slices from an unapproved source were discarded; cited. No current pest control logbook; cited. Heavy grease under fryers and floors also need cleaning.

headline: Handwash sink lacked cold water; no health policy
summary: Failed. Handwash sink had no cold running water, so employees could not wash hands; cited. No employee health policy or training on site. Some food handlers lacked certificates. Also: open chipotle can, unlabeled containers, missing sink stoppers, faulty washroom door closers.

headline: About 40 live flies in food prep areas
summary: Failed re-inspection. About 40 live small flies were flying around the front and rear food prep areas; pest control recommended; cited. Also: a male food handler with a beard lacked a beard guard, dust in toaster oven, no covered trash in women's restroom.

headline: Passed; manager missing allergen training
summary: Passed. The certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate; training must be completed and the certificate kept on site. Also: raw wood shelves to seal, two missing ceiling tiles in women's washroom, dusty vent covers.

headline: No original certificate on site; equipment dirty
summary: Passed with conditions. No original sanitation certificate on site while TCS foods were handled; cited. Ice machine interior, breading table, cooking equipment, walk-in shelves and floors need detail cleaning. Allergen certificates are also needed.

headline: No vomit kit; basement hot water too cool
summary: Failed. No vomit and diarrhea kit or procedure on site; cited. Basement hot water measured 72.5–75.3°F at handwash and three-compartment sinks, below the required 100°F and 110°F; cited. Upstairs sinks were within range.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; food discarded, cooler tagged
summary: Passed with conditions. Basement walk-in cooler ran at 59.9°F; raw meats, eggs and cheeses were above 41°F. Manager discarded about 115 lb of food. Cooler is tagged and cannot be used until repaired. Also: slow sinks, grease buildup.

headline: Flies on lemons; open rodent bait stations
summary: Passed with conditions. About 4 small flies were on cut limes and lemons at the bar; about 3 lb discarded; cited. Open rodent bait stations were in food prep, including near an open cooler; cited. Rear door not rodent-proof. Food left uncovered in coolers.

headline: Passed; missing backflow device and door closer
summary: Passed with conditions. The utility sink near the rear restroom lacks a backflow prevention device. The restroom door is not self-closing and needs a self-closing mechanism.

headline: Rat droppings, open rodent bait, unsafe food storage
summary: Failed. About 15 rat droppings in garage dry storage; open rodent bait near condiments; cited. Dish machine sanitizing at 10 ppm and tagged. Raw eggs stored over strawberries; about 80 lb of food held over 7 days discarded. Handwash sink lacked hand cleanser.

headline: Passed; hair restraint lapse corrected on site
summary: Passed. An employee without an effective hair restraint was corrected on site. Deli paper stored beside a handwash sink was ordered removed. Employee belongings must not be kept in the rear dry storage room.

headline: No certified manager; handwash sink blocked
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on site while TCS foods were prepared; cited. Prep handwash sink was blocked by containers and frozen meat. No soap or paper towels at sinks; improper thawing; overflowing dumpster cited; no food handler training proof.

headline: Passed; ice buildup and debris to clean
summary: Passed. Ice buildup in the walk-in freezer must be removed. Debris in breakroom cabinets, no covered receptacle in the women's washroom, and floor debris along walls and corners need cleaning.

headline: Cooler too warm; no certified manager on site
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on site while TCS foods were prepared; cited. Diced tomatoes at 49.5°F and 52.1°F in a cooler running at 51.1°F; food discarded and cooler tagged. No written employee health policy; no food handler or allergen training proof.

headline: Live roaches and rat droppings still found
summary: Failed re-inspection. Live roach activity continued in the basement, including near the dish machine, chemical buckets and grease trap. Rat droppings were under basement shelving; dead roaches also found. Pest control recommended. Also: grime in oven, openings in walls.

headline: Passed; vomit clean-up items missing
summary: Passed. No vomit and diarrhea clean-up items were on premises; manager instructed to keep them per policy. Also: slight buildup inside the upper ice machine, dust on walk-in cooler condenser, and debris inside bar coolers need cleaning.

headline: Mouse droppings and 200+ live flies found
summary: Failed. About 40 mouse droppings were under the meat slicer, and 200 or more live small flies were throughout the premises; pest control recommended; cited. Prior violations not fixed: cardboard on shelving, worn cutting boards, greasy cooking and cooler equipment.

headline: No handwash sink in beverage prep area
summary: Failed re-inspection. Open beverage prep area has no handwash sink with hot and cold water, soap and towels; cited. Dish machine sanitizer gauge not working; cited. Also: ice machine leaking into bin, food debris in coolers and freezers, unlabeled squeeze bottles, burned-out hood lights.

headline: About 100 rodent droppings; no certificate posted
summary: Failed. About 100 rodent droppings found throughout the kitchen and bar, along walls and under and behind coolers and equipment; cited. No original certificate on site. No service sink. Floors in disrepair with holes that must be closed.

headline: Over 200 rodent droppings; no handwash sinks
summary: Failed. Over 200 rodent droppings under basement stairs must be removed and areas sanitized. Juice bar and rear warewashing area lack handwashing sinks. No vomit/diarrhea clean-up kit or pest control log. Freezer sits under wastewater pipes.

headline: Passed; missing signs and bulk labels
summary: Passed. Handwash sinks in preparation areas lack signage. Bulk food such as flour and sugar must be labeled.

headline: More than 100 mouse droppings found throughout
summary: Failed. More than 100 mouse droppings found at the front counter, cooking area, rear prep, customer washroom and basement; cited. Pest control service required before re-inspection. Also: greasy fryer bottoms and holes in basement storage wall.

headline: Cold food above 41°F; black slime in ice machine
summary: Failed. Prep cooler at 45.9°F, tagged and not to be used; chicken, yogurt and eggs held above 41°F; about 15 lb discarded. Black slime found inside ice machine dripping into ice; cited. Dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer. Overflowing dumpsters cited.

headline: Handwash sinks blocked, lacked soap and hot water
summary: Failed. An exposed handwash sink was blocked by a jacket, shoes and containers; cited. Prep sink lacked soap, paper towels and hot water (74.5–86.4°F; 100°F required). No verifiable employee health policy; cited. Ready-to-eat food lacked date marks.

headline: Passed; restroom trash can lacks lid
summary: Passed. The customer washroom had no covered trash receptacle. One must be provided.

headline: Mold-like residue in ice machines; passed
summary: Re-inspection passed. Mold-like residue was found inside two ice machines and must be cleaned and sanitized. Also: non-working men's restroom sink, missing covered receptacles, non-working restroom lights, and manager allergen training missing.

headline: Passed; mostly storage and building upkeep
summary: Passed. Equipment on the basement floor must be raised at least 6 inches. Both unisex restrooms need covered trash cans. Also: unfinished brick and raw wood to seal, missing baseboards and light covers, exposed wall studs, and non-working lights.

headline: Passed; door gaps and dirty floor drains
summary: Passed. Both outer double doors have 1/4-inch gaps under the door sweeps that must be sealed to rodent-proof them. Food and dirt buildup inside prep area floor drains must be cleaned.

headline: About 40 rat droppings in basement
summary: Failed. About 40 rat droppings found on the basement floor along walls and corners. All must be removed by re-inspection; cited. Also: standing water by the north wall and cluttered storage that must be raised off the floor.

headline: No hot water at handwash sinks; dish machine tagged
summary: Failed. High-temperature dish machine was not sanitizing and is tagged; staff must use the three-compartment sink. Handwash sinks had no hot water under city pressure; cited. Dirty floor drains in the meat department.

headline: Seven live cockroaches found on re-inspection
summary: Failed re-inspection. Seven live cockroaches were found in kitchen, dish and ice machine areas after a prior pest violation was not corrected; cited. Additional pest control service is needed. Also: heavy grease buildup and debris on equipment.

headline: No certified manager on site; prior violations unfixed
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on site while open; cited. Prior violations not corrected: ice machine interior and food handler training. Also: greasy fryer tops, dirty outdoor grease bin, floor debris, and manager lacked allergen training.

headline: No valid certified manager while serving food
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid certified food manager was on duty while TCS ready-to-eat foods were prepared and served; cited. Also: an employee lacked food handler training, the front sink drains slowly, the restroom is dirty, and ceiling tiles are damaged.

headline: Passed; manager missing allergen training
summary: Passed. The City-certified manager lacked allergen training. Staff were instructed to obtain the training and keep verification on site.

headline: Re-inspection passed; labeling and cleaning issues
summary: Re-inspection passed. Bulk food containers need labels. Only one sink stopper for the three-compartment sink. Food spills and debris inside and outside coolers, freezers and cooking equipment must be cleaned. Excessive clutter must be removed.

headline: Prep cooler too warm; no pest control log
summary: Failed. Prep cooler measured 50°F; must be 41°F or below; cited. No pest control log book on site; cited. Original sanitation certificate not posted. Also: no metal stem thermometer, minor leak under hand sink, restroom door not self-closing.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; handwash water too hot
summary: Failed. High-temperature dish machine final rinse measured 80.2°F and was not sanitizing; machine tagged and cannot be used until re-inspected; cited. Rear handwash sink water was 122.5°F, above the 100–120°F range. Food debris in coolers and freezers.

headline: Small flies and live roach found on re-inspection
summary: Failed re-inspection. More than 25 small flies were throughout the facility and one live roach was found; prior pest violation not corrected; cited. Also: heavy clutter that can harbor pests, and missing ceiling tiles including in the basement dish area.

headline: Passed; items stored on floor, missing ceiling panels
summary: Passed. Single-service articles were not inverted and were stored on the floor in storage areas; they must be inverted and elevated. Missing ceiling tile panels in the bar storage area need repair or replacement.

headline: Passed; door gap and ice chute residue
summary: Passed. Slight residue at the edges of the soda dispenser ice chute needs regular cleaning. A gap larger than 1/4 inch under the Lincoln Avenue entrance door must be repaired to keep pests out.

headline: Passed; signage, torn gasket, alley debris
summary: Passed. Handwash sink in the first-floor prep area lacks signage. Torn gasket on the basement dough cooler must be repaired. Debris in the alley near dumpsters must be removed, and oil under the flat-top grill cleaned.

headline: Passed; soda splatter buildup near dispenser
summary: Passed. Soda splatter had built up under the soda dispenser area. Staff were instructed to clean and maintain the area to prevent possible contamination.

headline: Passed; crates used for elevation, floor drain mold
summary: Passed. Soda and milk crates used for elevation must be replaced with proper shelving. The floor drain under the soda dispenser has black mold-like buildup to clean. New employees have 30 days to obtain food handler training.

headline: No hot water; entrance doors have gaps
summary: Failed. No hot running water under city pressure; cited. Handwash sink must reach 100°F and three-compartment sink 110°F. Double entrance doors have a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom. No backflow device found on the ice machine.

headline: Passed; grease buildup, leaks, damaged floors
summary: Re-inspection passed. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, shelving, coolers and freezers must be cleaned. Leaking hose in rear storage and missing drainpipe under utility sink need repair. Missing grout and damaged floor tiles need fixing.

headline: Passed; employee lacked food handler training
summary: Passed. One employee without a food handler training certificate was found. Management was instructed that all food handlers must show proof of training.

headline: Passed; door gap, missing self-closing doors
summary: Passed. An opening at the base of the rear exit door must be sealed. Four restroom doors need self-closing devices. Three exterior grease traps could not be verified. Also: plumber's putty, plastic film, no mop drying rack, nonworking glass washers.

headline: Leaky handwash sink; hair restraint lapses; failed
summary: Failed. A leaky handwash sink at the serving line sent wastewater onto the prep floor; cited. Food handlers were not wearing hairnets or restraints. Also noted: no handwash signage, ice buildup in walk-in freezer, torn cooler gasket, dirty floors, clutter.

headline: Passed; hair restraint and storage lapses
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints while handling food. Also: prepackaged desserts unlabeled, TCS foods not in food-grade bags in a reach-in cooler, mops not hung up, and inadequate lighting in rear prep.

headline: Re-inspection passed; thermometers and cleaning needed
summary: Re-inspection passed. Thermometers must be visible in prep and reach-in coolers and rear storage. Also: dispenser cabinets and exteriors, dusty walk-in ceiling, dirty floors, debris around the garbage enclosure, and clutter need cleaning.

headline: No handwash soap; no vomit kit; no pest log
summary: Failed. Handwash sink had no soap or signage; cited. No vomit and diarrhea procedure or clean-up kit on premises. Probe thermometer did not turn on. No pest control logbook. Food vehicle lacked an MVP license number and lidded garbage.

headline: Passed; leaking sinks and unlabeled containers
summary: Passed. Leaking piping at the front and rear handwash sinks must be repaired. An ice scoop was left with its handle in the ice; sugar and flour containers need labels. Also noted: spilled beverage residue under a cooler and wet mops stored in buckets.

headline: No certified manager on site; failed
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while open; cited. Also: a women's restroom sink faucet needs repair, and a burned-out light bulb under the hood must be replaced.

headline: No certified manager on site; failed complaint
summary: Failed. No certified food manager with the original certificate was on site while open; a phone photo of the certificate was not accepted; cited. Also: no probe thermometer (cited), no handwash signage, missing sink stoppers, dirty mop sink and floors.

headline: Mouse droppings, live flies, unsafe food temperatures
summary: Failed. About 45 mouse droppings and 10–20 small flies found; pest control recommended; cited. Eggs at room temperature (48–70°F) and shrimp at 49–50°F; about 15 lb discarded. Low-temp dish machine at 0 ppm sanitizer. No certified manager on site.

headline: Passed; door gaps and dirty floors
summary: Passed. Gaps under front entrance doors measure 1 inch, 1/2 inch and 1/4 inch and must be sealed to prevent pests. Rear storage and sink-area floors have dirt, and loose, broken wall tile in the rear toilet room needs repair.

headline: Passed; missing ceiling tiles in dry storage
summary: Passed. Missing ceiling tiles in the rear dry storage must be replaced with a sealed, smooth, easily cleanable ceiling in prep areas.

headline: Passed; walk-in cooler floors need cleaning
summary: Passed. Floors inside the walk-in cooler need cleaning.

headline: Re-inspection passed; sink pressure and wall hole
summary: Re-inspection passed. One compartment sink had no cold water pressure and must be restored. A backflow device must be installed on the ice machine. Also: stained and missing dry storage ceiling tiles, and a large hole in a dry storage wall.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; raw chicken at 70.1°F
summary: Failed. Walk-in cooler ran at 69.5°F; about 30 lb of raw chicken measured 70.1°F. Cooler tagged and cannot be used until CDPH re-inspection; cited. Also: no sanitizer test kit, greasy floors, unlabeled bulk ingredients, torn gasket.

headline: Passed; torn cooler gasket, damaged floor tiles
summary: Passed. A torn door gasket inside the walk-in cooler must be replaced. Missing and damaged floor tiles in front of the utility sink must be repaired.

headline: No consumer advisory; scoops stored improperly
summary: Failed. No consumer advisory on the menu for raw or undercooked foods; cited. Scoops were stored in a dry food container. Clutter and cardboard in restroom and storage could harbor rodents. Also: missing handwash signage, unused appliances, dirty floors, no restroom ventilation.

headline: Dirty kitchen, leaking cooler, unprotected tableware
summary: Passed with conditions. Preset dining tableware must be protected from contamination. Walk-in cooler condenser leaks and has a missing fan; walk-in and hood lights not working. Grease and food debris, peeling wall with black slime, and cracked floors need repair and cleaning.

headline: No handwash soap; cooler at 70°F; no pest log
summary: Failed. Several handwash sinks had no soap or paper towels; prep cooler measured 70.2°F. Ice machine interior was dirty and ice scoop was stored inside it. No pest control log or license number; cited. Back door has a gap.

headline: Re-inspection passed; storage and upkeep issues
summary: Re-inspection passed. Boxed food on the basement floor must be raised six inches. Also: torn cooler and refrigerator gaskets, food debris inside coolers and freezers, damaged restroom ceiling panels, and basement clutter.

headline: Re-inspection passed; hood cleaning, bulbs
summary: Re-inspection passed. Ventilation hood and filters above cooking equipment need detailed cleaning. Several burned-out hood light bulbs must be replaced.

headline: Re-inspection passed; many cleaning and repair items
summary: Re-inspection passed. Gap under the front door must be sealed; chicken stored on the walk-in floor must move to shelving. Also: missing cooler thermometers, unlabeled shakers, worn gaskets, grease and ice buildup, damaged wall bases, and dim lighting.

headline: Cool handwash water, warm bacon, damaged dumpster lids
summary: Failed. Handwash sinks measured 86.9–90.3°F, below 100°F; cited. Cooked bacon held at 108.9°F, below 135°F; about 1 lb discarded; cited. Overflowing dumpster with damaged lids could let pests in. Expired food handler certificates.

headline: Food debris in front prep cooler
summary: Accumulated food debris was inside a two-door reach-in cooler in the front prep area. The interior must be cleaned and maintained. The inspection passed.

headline: Cleaning and repair needs; no pests reported
summary: Repairs and cleaning are needed: a broken freezer door held with tape, a leaking sink faucet, greasy cooking equipment, syrup buildup under bar machines, and dusty vents and hood filters. Deep cleaning was requested to prevent pests.

headline: Deli cups stacked while wet
summary: Deli cups were stacked while still wet after washing. The inspector instructed staff to air dry all reusable utensils before storing them. The inspection passed.

headline: Dirty ice machine; cutting boards on floor
summary: The ice machine interior was not clean and must be detail cleaned and sanitized. Cutting boards were stored on the floor and must be raised six inches. Buffet plates were not inverted, and the oven spill tray had grease and debris.

headline: Sanitizer at 0 ppm; corrected on site
summary: Sanitizer at the three-compartment sink measured 0 ppm, too weak to sanitize dishes. Staff corrected it on site, reaching 1875 ppm after a repair. A bug light above the rear dump sink must be moved to prevent contamination, and ceiling dust needs cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; repeat violations uncorrected
summary: No person in charge with a valid certificate was on site, and no certified food manager was present while food was prepared. Earlier violations, a leaking pipe at the chemical hose and a faulty washroom door closer, were not corrected.

headline: Food debris in deli cooler; closet debris
summary: Food debris was inside a deli prep cooler, and debris was on the floor of a furnace closet at the rear of the prep area. The person in charge was told to clean both areas. The inspection passed.

headline: Dirty corners and cracked prep-area floor tiles
summary: Corners throughout the premises, especially behind hot cooking equipment and cold-holding units, need cleaning. Cracked and damaged floor tiles in the prep area must be repaired to create a smooth, cleanable surface. The inspection passed.

headline: Repeat violations: no allergen training, restroom cover
summary: Two violations from a 2023 inspection were still not corrected: managers lacked allergen training, and the unisex restroom had no covered receptacle for feminine products. A citation was issued.

headline: Dead roach found; soap missing, corrected on site
summary: One dead roach was found in a basement room and removed before the inspection ended. A first-floor bar handsink lacked soap, which was provided on site. Knives and spatulas were kept in stagnant water and must be stored dry.

headline: Tape on ice machine shield; rusty, dirty shelves
summary: Tape was on the shield of the large ice machine and must be removed to prevent ice contamination. Rust was on shelving in the left walk-in cooler, and lower shelves in the right walk-in needed cleaning. Sanitation managers lacked proof of allergen training.

headline: No certified manager on site while food served
summary: No city-certified food manager was on site, and no certificate was posted, while chicken, meatballs and deli sandwiches were prepared and served. A front prep handsink drained slowly. Dust was on washroom floor drains and rear vents, and staff belongings were in the prep area.

headline: Uncovered fryer grease; floors need cleaning
summary: The deep fryer was not covered while not in use, and staff were told to cover it to prevent contamination. Grease was on the floor under the fryer, and debris was under the dish machine drainboard. The re-inspection passed.

headline: Drinks on prep table; hair restraint; labels
summary: Open employee drink cups sat on a prep table and must be kept away. Grab-and-go sandwich and salad labels were not on the containers. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Insect control traps on the kitchen ceiling must be removed.

headline: Handsink water too brief; ceiling tiles missing
summary: Metered handwashing sinks in the upstairs and downstairs guest washrooms did not run water for the required 15 seconds. Missing and detached ceiling tiles were above the dish machine and prep tables and must be reattached or replaced.

headline: Handsink cold water and door gap issues
summary: The rear prep handwashing sink could not run cold water and must be repaired. The front entrance door was not rodent-proof at the bottom. Other items: missing sink stoppers, a dirty grill, dirty floors and wall bases, and a burnt-out light.

headline: Bar floor debris and standing water
summary: The bar floor had food debris under the counter and standing water. The manager must clean the floor and keep the bar floor dry. The inspection passed.

headline: Numerous flying insects on food-contact surfaces
summary: Numerous flying insects were landing on slicers, prep tables, condiments and sinks in prep, dish and storage areas. Food was stored in a washroom and under sinks, and chips were on the floor. An exterminator was required.

headline: No certified manager; handwashing and ceiling leak problems
summary: No certified food manager was on site while food was prepared. An employee washed hands at a dish machine sprayer. Bar handsink lacked hot water; rear prep area had no handsink. Heavy ceiling leak over dining room.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training; minor cleaning
summary: The manager on duty had no food allergen training certificate and was told to obtain one. The restroom door's self-closing device was not connected. A small amount of grease was at the fryer bottom, and the floor behind deep freezers needed sweeping.

headline: No certified manager; handsink lacked hot water
summary: No person in charge was present, and no certified manager was on site while pizza and hot dogs were prepared. The hand sink had no hot water and a broken hot faucet. Cardboard boxes on shelves should be removed to avoid pest hiding places.

headline: Kids' milk exceeds calorie limit; debris buildup
summary: Kids' default chocolate milk at 150 calories exceeds the 130-calorie limit and must be changed. Food debris built up on counters, cashier shelves and floors. A counter underside was in poor repair, and the walk-in drain line pooled water.

headline: Many critical violations; flies and missing training
summary: No signed employee health policy and no vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure were on site. Paper towels were missing at sinks. Over 20 live small flies were found. No food handler or allergen training was shown, and no sanitizer test kit was present.

headline: 150+ mouse droppings in kitchen and basement
summary: More than 150 mouse droppings were on floors and storage shelves in the kitchen and basement. Pest control service was required before next week's re-inspection. A rear exit door had a 1-inch gap underneath. Food handler and allergen training were also required.

headline: Debris near grease trap and walk-in fans
summary: Floors around the grease trap under the three-compartment sink and fan covers inside the walk-in cooler had debris and must be cleaned. The inspection passed.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: No person in charge or food employee with certified manager training was on site while cut greens, cut melon and warewashing were underway. A boys' third-floor restroom faucet ran only about one second. A bent probe thermometer and a leaky sink drain were noted.

headline: Repeat violations; stained ceiling tiles and grime
summary: A prior priority violation for floor cleaning was not corrected. Stained, greasy and missing ceiling tiles were above the pizza ovens, and coolers and freezers were dirty inside. The walk-in cooler curtain is torn. Clutter on the rear walkway must be removed to prevent rodent harboring.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; handsink blocked
summary: Cold foods were above the required 41°F, including 35 lbs of tripe at 54.1°F and al pastor at 59.4°F. The person in charge voluntarily discarded them. A handsink was blocked and used for storage.

headline: Ashtray indoors violates clean air ordinance
summary: An ashtray with cigarette ashes was in the manager's office, violating Chicago's Clean Indoor Air Ordinance; a citation was issued. Fryers and dry storage containers need cleaning, and a washroom door lacks a self-closing device.

headline: About 55 mouse droppings; dish machines unsafe
summary: About 55 mouse droppings were found on food prep surfaces, floors and behind the bar. No certified food manager was on site. Two low-temperature dish machines had 0 ppm sanitizer and were tagged; they must not be used until they sanitize and are reinspected.

headline: Cooler at 54°F; no health policy or cleanup kit
summary: A reach-in cooler measured 54°F and must be kept at 41°F or below. No employee health policy and no vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure or kit were on site. The stem thermometer was in poor condition, and the water system had no drain valve.

headline: No certified manager; repeat violations
summary: No certified food manager was on site while tuna and soup were being prepared and served. The person in charge had no sanitation certificate. Earlier violations were not corrected: no handwashing sign and cups stored under the soap dispenser.

headline: Gloves not changed; no soap at handsink
summary: An employee prepping vegetables handled the walk-in cooler and doors in the same gloves, without changing gloves or washing hands. The front prep handsink had no soap. Citations were issued, and management reviewed the handwashing policy.

headline: Staff did not wash hands between tasks
summary: Food handlers did not wash hands when changing tasks, including register workers who prepared food while wearing gloves. Cooked pork held over 24 hours without a date, about 14 lbs, was discarded. A citation was issued.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies on site
summary: No cleanup supplies were on site for vomit or diarrhea events, a priority violation; management was instructed to provide them. A hole in the ceiling drywall at the rear prep doorway must be sealed.

headline: No certificate posted; door gaps
summary: No valid city-certified food manager certificate was posted while food that must stay hot or cold was prepared; a citation was issued. Front and rear exit doors had 1/4-inch gaps, and openings in the bar wall base need sealing to keep pests out.

headline: Undated deli meat on display; food stored on floors
summary: Unlabeled, undated deli meat (turkey, chicken, ham) was on display for service; the manager was ordered to discard it. Food was stored on floors in walk-in coolers and freezers and must be raised six inches.

headline: Food on floors; missing labels; damaged walls
summary: Food containers were stored on floors in prep, storage and walk-in areas, and containers lacked food-name labels. Milk crates were used as shelves, and three-compartment sink stoppers were missing. Walls and ceilings had holes and water damage. The re-inspection passed.

headline: Dirty cooler shelving; missing trash lid
summary: Shelving inside the rear walk-in cooler was dirty and must be cleaned. A garbage can lid was missing in the rear employee washroom. Floors along wall bases and corners need cleaning. The re-inspection passed.

headline: Raw fish stored above cooked food; corrected on site
summary: Raw fish was stored above an open pan of cooked potatoes in a cooler. The potatoes were moved to a walk-in freezer and the raw fish to the bottom shelf, corrected on site. Unlabeled containers, an open screen door, a leaking faucet, and dirty floors were also noted.

headline: Dust on kitchen ceiling vents
summary: Dust was on kitchen ceiling vents and tiles. The inspector instructed staff to clean it. The inspection passed.

headline: 60-80 mouse droppings in rear storage
summary: About 60 to 80 mouse droppings were found in the rear storage area along walls, on pallets, and in the electrical room. Staff must clean, call pest control, and show proof of service by the June 10 return inspection. Restroom and hood lighting repairs are also required.

headline: Food handlers lacked hair or beard restraints
summary: Food handlers worked without hair nets or restraints and without beard restraints. Food storage containers lacked common-name labels, and scoops were stored inside containers. A freezer door handle was loose, and the employee washroom lacked a covered receptacle.

headline: About 75 mouse droppings in dog food and storage
summary: About 35 mouse droppings were on shelves displaying dog food, and 40 more were on the floor of the rear storage area. Pest control service was required. Front doors did not fit tightly, allowing pest entry, and washrooms need a lidded trash can.

headline: Repeat violations: no backflow device, no allergen training
summary: Repeat violations were not fixed: the basement utility sink lacked a backflow prevention device, and a certified manager lacked allergen training. Basement storage needs detail cleaning and clutter removal; mops must be raised six inches.

headline: No employee health policy; washroom fans broken
summary: No employee health policy was on the premises. Front entrance doors had a 1/4-inch gap that must be rodent-proofed. Ceiling fans in both washrooms were not working, and one certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Hair restraint missing; no food handler proof
summary: An employee prepared and served food without a hair restraint. Wiping cloths were left on prep tables instead of sanitizing solution. No proof of food handler training was shown. Basement storage had clutter, and the front prep sink lacked a waste receptacle.

headline: Food handler lacked certificate; handsink signage missing
summary: A food handler lacked a food handler certificate, and proof must be shown. A front sushi-prep handsink had no handwashing sign. Stained cutting boards need resurfacing or replacing, and an unused chest freezer must be removed to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: Over 50 rat droppings and flies found
summary: Over 50 rat droppings were in a parking-garage storage area used for single-use items, plus about 30 small flies in storage and prep. No person in charge with a valid certificate was on site. Handsink water measured 61.2°F, below the 100°F minimum.

headline: Large gap in rear door; food debris in units
summary: The rear exit door had a large gap at the outside handle, big enough for insects and small rodents, and must be repaired. Food debris and splatter were inside a reach-in freezer and cooling unit. The rear prep floor had debris under and behind equipment.

headline: Handsinks too cold; no soap or toilet tissue
summary: Handwashing sinks in both toilet rooms ran 70-76°F; the minimum is 100°F. One sink had no soap and a toilet room had no toilet tissue; staff provided them during inspection. Ice scoops were stored in ice bins, and napkins were on the floor.

headline: Cold water restored order; training proof missing
summary: Cold water to a dishwashing area handsink was shut off, and staff must restore it. Both all-gender washrooms lacked covered receptacles for sanitary products. No proof of food handler training was provided. The re-inspection passed.

headline: Food prepared without certified manager; ice machine pink
summary: Food handlers prepared foods that must stay hot or cold (TCS) without a certified food manager on site. The person in charge lacked food safety training. Pink buildup was in the ice machine, and the women's restroom lacked a covered receptacle, a repeat violation.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; no certified manager
summary: Black, mold-like slime was inside the ice machine and dripped onto ice used for drinks. The person in charge had no valid sanitation certificate and no allergen training. A sugar bin was unlabeled, and trash was on the dry storage floor.

headline: Missing backflow devices; basement surfaces need repair
summary: A mop/service sink in the rear and the ice machine water intake line lacked backflow prevention devices, which must be installed. Basement floors and ceiling were not smooth and easily cleanable and must be restored.

headline: No certified manager; improper thawing; drainage
summary: No certified food manager was on site while seafood, cooked potatoes and broccoli were prepared. Sausage was thawed in stagnant water on a sink drainboard. Wastewater from the three-compartment sink spilled onto the floor. No vomit cleanup supplies or procedure were on site.

headline: Stained cutting board; slicer needs cleaning
summary: A stained cutting board with dark grooves was in the produce prep area, and the deli meat slicer's plastic area needed detail cleaning. Staff must clean and sanitize or replace the board. The inspection passed.

headline: Rat droppings and flies found; handsink blocked
summary: About 10 rat droppings were under a shelf in the rear warehouse, and 16 small flies were in the mop sink closet and sandwich prep area. A rear handwashing sink was blocked by a hot box, which was moved during inspection. Dry ingredient containers were unlabeled.

headline: Drains and dish area floor need cleaning
summary: Floor drains under the rear three-compartment sink and front one-compartment sink need detail cleaning. The floor under shelving in the rear dish area also needs detail cleaning. The inspection passed.

headline: No soap or hand drying at handsinks
summary: Handwashing sinks in first-floor prep areas had no soap. No sinks in the first-floor, warewashing or basement prep areas had hand drying. Repeat violations for dirty prep tables, fryers, floors and hood grease were not corrected.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure; no pest contractor
summary: The written vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure was incomplete, and supplies lacked sanitizer that kills norovirus. No metal stem thermometer was on site. No licensed pest control operator was contracted; service must occur at least twice a year.

headline: Vomit cleanup supplies missing; rust and dirt noted
summary: Supplies needed to clean up vomit or diarrhea were not on site, a priority violation. Rust was on shelves in a cold holding unit, and the outdoor dumpster pad was dirt and rock instead of concrete or asphalt.

headline: Small flies found; no pest control logbook
summary: About 20 small flies were seen near the mop sink and a walk-in cooler door. No current pest control logbook was on site. No proof of food handler or allergen training was shown. Walk-in cooler floors were rusted.

headline: No certified manager; expired ready-to-eat foods
summary: No certified food manager was on site while beef and chicken were handled. Refrigerated ready-to-eat foods past their use-by dates from February and March 2024, including cooked chicken and tripe, were discarded, about 20 pounds.

headline: 30+ mouse droppings found, including prep table
summary: Over 30 mouse droppings were on the floor under the furnace, on the rear prep table, and by the hot water tank. Staff must clean these areas and notify pest control. Unlabeled bulk containers and a leaking faucet were also noted.

headline: Peeling caulking and leaking sink faucet
summary: Caulking around the three-compartment sink in the dish area was dirty and peeling, and the faucet leaked. Staff must clean or replace the caulking and repair the leak. The inspection passed.

headline: Cooked chicken cooled on floor in dirty box
summary: Cooked chicken was cooling in a dirty cardboard box, previously used for produce, on the floor by an ajar rear door. About 30 pounds was discarded. Wiping cloths were on prep tables, and grease and debris were under fryers.

headline: Grease and dirt buildup in several areas
summary: Grease, food debris and dirt were on floors under equipment, along walls and in corners in prep, dish, storage and basement areas. Dust covered a walk-in cooler fan, light shields and vents. The manager was told to clean all of them.

headline: Chicken held at room temperature; no health policy
summary: Cooked chicken held on top of a cooler at 98.8-112.3°F was discarded, about 33 pounds. No written employee health policy was on premises, and no hair restraints were in use. Earlier violations, including items stored on the floor, were not corrected.

headline: Sanitizer too strong at three-compartment sink
summary: Quat sanitizer at the three-compartment sink exceeded the manufacturer's recommended 200-400 ppm. The manager was told to dilute it with water and test it before use. A citation was issued.

headline: Leaking handsink; food debris behind grill
summary: The handwashing sink beside the three-compartment sink leaked from a pipe below and dripped on the floor. Corn debris and spills were behind the grill and shelves. The baseboard had holes and gaps and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: 75+ flies, rodent droppings, warm cold-holding food
summary: About 75 or more live small flies and about 16 small rodent droppings were found in prep areas. The handsink had no hot water (74.1°F). Cold foods at 49-51°F were discarded, and a display cooler at 50.1°F was tagged. The outdoor trash lid stayed open.

headline: No certified manager or food handler certificates
summary: No valid food manager certificate was on site while food was prepared, and no food handler certificates were shown. Restroom handwashing signs were missing. A basement exterior door did not fit tightly, and debris was on the basement floor.

headline: Calcium buildup on ice machine door
summary: Calcium buildup was found on the inside of the ice machine door. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain it. The re-inspection passed.

headline: Items stored on floor; toilet receptacle uncovered
summary: Items were stored on the floor inside an unused walk-in cooler; staff must raise them at least 6 inches. A toilet-room receptacle lacked a cover, and staff must provide and maintain one.

headline: Drinking fountain at handsink; missing ceiling tiles
summary: A breakroom handwashing sink also served a drinking fountain, and the sink must be used only for handwashing. Milk crates were used to elevate meat-prep items. Ceiling tiles were missing or damaged, and liquid pooled under the bakery sink.

headline: Cooler ran warm; handwashing supplies misplaced
summary: An empty two-door cooler in the rear prep area measured 46.5°F; the inspector required repair so coolers stay at or below 41°F. A paper towel dispenser was at a non-handwashing sink and must be moved to a handwashing sink.

headline: Walk-in cooler at 70°F; no dumpster service
summary: The walk-in cooler measured 70.0°F air temperature and must stay at 41°F or colder. No written employee health policy was on site. The high-temperature dishmachine lacked surface temperature test strips, and no commercial dumpster service was on the premises.

headline: Clutter in rear storage areas
summary: Clutter, including tools, was found in rear storage areas. Staff must clean and organize these areas. The inspection passed.

headline: Cold foods held at 46-61°F; cooler too warm
summary: Cold foods were held at 46 to 61°F, above the required 41°F. The manager discarded spinach, shredded lettuce and sliced cucumber. A cooler measured 58°F air temperature, and a technician came to service it during the inspection.

headline: Repeat: no food handler training proof
summary: Food handler training was still not provided for employees, a repeat violation with a citation. The food manager had no allergen training. A toilet-room handsink drained slowly, food containers were unlabeled, and floors had grease and debris.

headline: Calcium buildup in ice machine; no allergen training
summary: Excessive calcium buildup was inside an ice machine lid in the second-floor drink storage area and must be cleaned. Certified manager certificates were present, but the managers had no allergen training.

headline: Slow sink drain and dirty walk-in floor
summary: The three-compartment sink drained slowly and must be repaired. The walk-in cooler floor had food debris and needed cleaning. The inspection passed.

headline: Grease buildup; stained cutting boards; basement repairs
summary: Cutting boards in the rear prep area had open seams and dark stains. Grease coated cooking equipment, walls, floors and shelves. The basement had broken stairs, an 8-inch hole in a utility sink wall, and clutter. A walk-in cooler light shield was missing.

headline: Missing vomit cleanup kit; handsink blocked
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure was on site, a priority violation. A handsink was blocked by a prep table, which was moved during inspection. Missing thermometer and sanitizer test kit were being bought during inspection.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; allergen training missing
summary: Three of four food handler certificates were expired, and two of three certified food managers had no proof of allergen training. Wet mops were stored in a hallway and prep area and must be hung to dry. The inspection passed.

headline: Food debris in coolers; clutter outside
summary: Refrigeration unit interiors in the first-floor prep area had dried food debris and must be cleaned and sanitized. Chest freezers, kegs, furniture and other items on the back porch and yard must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Unlabeled storage containers; loose ice machine door
summary: Small bulk storage containers were unlabeled and must be labeled. The ice machine door had a loose screw and must be tightened. The re-inspection passed.

headline: Hole near produce cooler; leaks; greasy surfaces
summary: A hole around a sprinkler above the produce walk-in cooler needs sealing to keep pests out. Leaks under a dump sink and at a sanitizer dispenser need repair. Grease covered shelves, cooking equipment and hood filters, and floors and vents were dirty.

headline: Burned-out bulbs; ice on cooler condenser
summary: Ice buildup was on the beer walk-in cooler condenser line and must be removed. Burned-out ceiling bulbs above the dish machine and pizza prep table must be replaced.

headline: Rusted, chipped storage racks in walk-in coolers
summary: Wire storage racks in the walk-in coolers had chipped paint and rust. Staff must remove the rust and repaint or replace the shelves. The re-inspection passed.

headline: Several coolers not working; flies found
summary: Several coolers were not working and must hold 41°F or below. Some coolers lacked thermometers. About 20 small flies and 3 large flies were found throughout. A three-compartment sink had no faucet, and water hookups used non-cleanable fixtures.

headline: Greasy fryer wheels; dusty floors and walls
summary: Deep fryer wheels were encrusted with grease and must be cleaned. Floors and walls were dusty and must be cleaned and maintained. The inspection passed.

headline: About 20 large rodent droppings found
summary: About 20 large rodent droppings were found under the front DJ booth, behind the stove, in a back bar closet, and in basement storage. Food was stored under a leaking compressor in a walk-in cooler. Additional pest control was recommended.

headline: No certified manager; no employee health policy
summary: No valid city-certified food manager certificate was on site while chicken was prepared and served to the public. No employee health policy was on site, and the manager must provide a signed acknowledgment. Both citations were issued.

headline: Dirty prep-area floor and drain
summary: The floor and floor drain in the prep area needed cleaning. The manager was told to clean and maintain them. The inspection passed.

headline: No certified manager; black mold in ice machine
summary: No certified food manager was on the premises. Black, moldlike buildup was inside the ice machine, and the ice must be destroyed and the machine cleaned. Shellstock tags lacked dates. A raw-food menu disclosure was added on site.

headline: Gap in rear toilet room wall
summary: A small gap in the wall of the rear toilet room must be sealed to keep pests out. The inspector did not note any pests. The inspection passed.

headline: Ready-to-eat food lacked discard dates; citation
summary: Ready-to-eat food made on site and held over 24 hours in a display cooler had no use-by dates. All such items must be labeled with name and date. Ice buildup was in the walk-in freezer, and meat cooler shelves were rusty and dirty.

headline: No employee health policy; no allergen training
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit was present, and a leaking pipe ran along the basement wall. Certified managers lacked allergen training certificates. License inspection passed with conditions.

headline: Small flies throughout facility; citation issued
summary: Inspector counted about 30 small flies across the facility, including near the rear exit, utility sink, and food ordering area. A pest control service was recommended and a priority citation was issued. Re-inspection failed. Missing handwashing signs were also noted.

headline: Missing raw food disclosure; leaking sinks
summary: The menu lacked a disclosure about raw or undercooked animal-derived foods such as huevos rancheros. Openings at the rear exit door, leaking sink faucets, and damaged refrigerator gaskets were noted. Fly strips were hanging above the juice bar. Re-inspection failed.

headline: Food storage under pipes; missing allergen training
summary: Seasonings and dried spices were stored in carts under basement plumbing lines and must be moved. Refrigeration units had torn gaskets and dried food spills. Rear yard and basement clutter could harbor pests. The person in charge lacked allergen training. Inspection passed.

headline: No proof of food handler training
summary: No proof of food handler training was on site for any food handlers. The operator was instructed to provide and keep records on site at all times. Inspection passed.

headline: Mouse droppings and gaps at doors
summary: Quarter-inch gaps at the entrance and exit doors allow pest entry and must be sealed. Food debris and grease were found on cooking equipment, toilets did not flush properly, and food handlers lacked training. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Unlabeled containers and food stored on floor
summary: Food storage containers lacked labels, and food was stored on the floor. Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizing solution, plates were not inverted, and a women's restroom had no lidded trash can. This was a re-inspection and it passed.

headline: About 75 mouse droppings; no paper towels
summary: About 75 mouse droppings were in the dry bulk storage room, with 10 to 15 more in the rear hallway, and a citation was issued. Kitchen handwashing sink had no paper towels. Thawing at room temperature, plastic bags and tin cans used for storage, and missing food handler training records were also found. Complaint inspection failed.

headline: Prep sink inoperable, plumber fixed it on site
summary: The prep area handwashing sink did not work, but a plumber repaired it during inspection. The low-temperature dishwashing unit showed zero sanitizer and was tagged out of use until re-inspected. Torn cooler gasket and lead-risk ceramic cups were also noted.

headline: Missing backflow device and leaking drain
summary: The mop sink had no visible backflow prevention device, and the prep area handwashing sink drain was leaking. There was no covered trash can in the washroom, and gaps around sink pipes needed sealing. License inspection passed.

headline: Mouse droppings and hygiene problems
summary: About 30 or more mouse droppings were in the chemical storage closet. Employees handled food without changing gloves or washing hands. Employee health policies were not signed, and soap was missing at a handwashing sink. Inspection failed.

headline: Food thawing in standing water; no training proof
summary: Food was thawing in stagnant water in a sink. Food in coolers and prep areas was uncovered, food handlers lacked beard restraints, and there was no proof of food handler training. Complaint inspection passed.

headline: Warm chicken and inadequate hot water
summary: A toilet-room sink had hot water at 66.5 degrees, below the required 100 degrees, and a toilet did not flush. Rotisserie chicken deli meat was held at 52 degrees and thawed at room temperature, and it was discarded. Manager lacked a city sanitation certificate. Inspection failed.

headline: Rodent droppings found; citation issued
summary: Inspector found about 30 rodent droppings on dry storage shelves and behind freezers in food prep, about 30 in the utility closet, and about 5 in the toilet room. A priority citation was issued. Re-inspection failed.

headline: Grease and food debris on salamander
summary: Grease and food debris built up on the salamander cooking equipment in the kitchen and prep area. The operator was told to degrease, clean, and sanitize it. Inspection passed.

headline: Missing date labels; overflowing dumpsters
summary: Cooked chicken, rice, and soup in reach-in coolers lacked date labels. Dumpsters overflowed and could not close, and no food handler certificates were on site. Spices were unlabeled and food was stored in plastic bags. Inspection failed.

headline: Exposed sewer pipe near food and glassware
summary: An exposed sewer pipe ran next to the filtered water station in the prep area and behind the bar, beside glassware. Items must be removed or the pipe protected. The sanitation manager lacked allergen training. Inspection passed.

headline: Peeling paint and ice buildup in freezer
summary: Shelving inside a two-door cooler had food debris and peeling paint. Ice buildup was found in a rear deep freezer. The washroom door's self-closing device was in poor repair, and floors needed detail cleaning. Inspection passed.

headline: Sewage overflow and missing employee health policy
summary: A grease trap overflowed onto the floor of a food truck, with a foul odor from the sink, which is a priority violation. Employees had no signed health policies, food handler training, or allergen training. A door gap and worn gaskets were also noted. Inspection failed.

headline: About 50-60 mouse droppings found; citation issued
summary: Inspectors found 50 to 60 mouse droppings in the first-floor prep area and basement, including on storage shelves and pallets. A priority citation was issued. Large bulk food containers were unlabeled, and equipment and floors needed detail cleaning. Inspection failed.

headline: No certified manager; unsafe cold food; citation issued
summary: No certified food manager was present while meat and pasta were prepared. Raw chicken, fish, shrimp, and other cold foods measured 50 to 65 degrees and were discarded. Cooling units also ran too warm, and one was repaired on site. No handwashing soap or towels were available. Inspection failed.

headline: Cardboard boxes near sink
summary: Numerous cardboard boxes were stored near the three-compartment sink. The operator must remove unnecessary items from the premises. Inspection passed.

headline: Low hot water pressure; missing handwashing signs
summary: The basement men's restroom lacked handwashing signs. Hot water pressure was low at the meat room handwashing sink and three-compartment sink. A cooler fan plumbing was leaking from the ceiling. Complaint inspection passed.

headline: Grease leak under fryer; toilet room lids needed
summary: Grease leaked under the deli fryer and needed cleaning. A drain pipe under a prep sink needed repair, and women's restroom receptacles needed covers. Floor tiles, baseboards, and drains had mold-like buildup. Short-form complaint inspection passed.
