headline: No metal stem thermometer on site
summary: No metal stem thermometer was on site to check internal temperatures of cooked, delivered, and served TCS foods. A priority citation was issued. Inspection failed.

headline: Torn gaskets and rusty shelving; dirty floors
summary: The three-door cooler had torn gaskets repaired with tape, and the three-compartment sink lacked stoppers. Rusty shelving, peeling ice machine plastic, and dirty floors were found. Soiled mop heads were not stored inverted. Inspection passed.

headline: Rat droppings and dead rat in basement
summary: About 50 or more rat droppings, a dead decayed rat, and standing water were found in the basement. Yard clutter could harbor rodents. Missing employee health policy, cleanup procedures, and damaged bins were also noted. Re-inspection failed.

headline: No soap or paper towels at handwashing sinks
summary: The bar handwashing sink had no paper towels, and the kitchen sink had no soap. Staff added soap right away during inspection. Both were cited as priority violations. Heavy grease and dirt were found inside the exhaust hood and filters. Passed with conditions.

headline: No certified manager while serving chicken
summary: No valid city food sanitation manager certificate was on site while chicken was being prepared and served. A priority citation was issued. Passed with conditions.

headline: No handwashing signs; sanitation manager lacked allergen training
summary: Handwashing sinks in the main kitchen had no signs. Food containers were not stored inverted. The sanitation manager had no allergen training. Inspection passed.

headline: Employee restroom door not self-closing
summary: The employee toilet room door beside the prep area does not close on its own. The operator was told to install a self-closing device and keep it working. Inspection passed.

headline: Broken freezer panels; dirty vent cover
summary: Several basement freezers had broken plastic and exposed insulation that must be repaired. Peeling plastic was on a reach-in cooler door, and a washroom vent cover was dusty. Some light shield end caps were missing. Inspection passed.

headline: Loose service window metal and unsecured refrigerator
summary: Inspector saw a metal piece hanging from the left side of the service window and an unsecured white refrigerator. The operator was told to repair and secure both. Inspection passed.

headline: Damaged rear door and floor tiles
summary: The rear exit door had a worn bottom that must be repaired to block pest entry. Shelves and prep areas had spills, the three-compartment sink faucet was in poor repair, and garbage can lids were missing. Floors and walls needed cleaning and repair. Inspection passed.

headline: Food stored on floor; dirty prep area
summary: Boxed food was stored on the floor near the three-compartment sink. Debris and grease were found along walls, floors, and corners in the rear prep area, and a floor drain was dirty. Cutting boards had deep scratches. Inspection passed.

headline: No certified manager; pest and door gaps
summary: No certified food manager was on site during inspection. Inspectors also found a missing thermometer, a front door gap that allows pests, a broken ice machine door, and missing food handler training records. Re-inspection failed.

headline: Stained cutting board with open seams
summary: A cutting board in the front prep area had open seams and dark stains. It must be refinished or replaced. Inspection passed.

headline: Hair restraints; fryer and floor grease
summary: Some food handlers were not wearing hair restraints, which was corrected on site. Fryers, floors under fryers, and the hood vents needed cleaning. Restroom doors lacked self-closing devices. Inspection passed.

headline: No certified manager while cooking rice and chicken
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods like rice and chicken were being prepared. The ice machine interior had buildup, pest control records were missing or out of date, and the ventilation hood needed cleaning. Inspection failed.

headline: Food at 64-68 degrees; food discarded
summary: Sausages, eggs, and cheese in the front prep cooler measured 64 to 68 degrees and were discarded by the manager, about 15 pounds. Employee bathroom and rear sink faucets leaked. A food handler certificate had expired. Complaint inspection passed with conditions.

headline: Loose cooler gasket; grease on hood filters
summary: A reach-in prep cooler had a loose rubber gasket that must be repaired or replaced. Grease had built up on the filters above the stove and must be cleaned. Inspection passed.

headline: No employee health policy or vomit cleanup kit
summary: There was no employee health policy, training, or vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or kit on site. A quarter-inch gap at the front door, missing self-closing washroom doors, and uncovered waste bins were also noted. License inspection passed with conditions.

headline: Worn front door seal; dirty fixtures
summary: The front door had worn weather stripping at the bottom that must be replaced to prevent pest entry. An ice cream freezer had ice buildup, and washroom fixtures were dirty. Complaint re-inspection passed.

headline: Dirty ice machine; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Large amounts of black and pink buildup were inside the ice machine, and all ice had to be discarded. The dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer and was tagged out of use. Cutting boards were worn and hood vents needed cleaning. Inspection failed.

headline: Cardboard used to line floors
summary: Cardboard boxes were used to line the floors. The operator must remove them, clean, and maintain the floors. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Food debris inside cooling equipment
summary: Food debris was found on the inside surfaces of cooling equipment and under cooking equipment in the rear prep area. Basement storage had clutter and items on the floor. Complaint inspection passed.

headline: Water-damaged ceiling tiles; no restroom ventilation
summary: Sales floor ceiling tiles had water damage and must be replaced. The restroom had no mechanical ventilation and must have it installed. License inspection passed.

headline: Soiled cutting boards, dirty coolers, and ceilings
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution, and cutting boards had stains and deep grooves. Cooler exteriors and gaskets had dirt and food buildup. Walls, ceilings, floors, and light shields were dirty or missing. Inspection passed.

headline: Revolving entry door missing door sweep
summary: Inspector saw the revolving entry door missing a door sweep and told the person in charge to install one to keep pests out. No pests were observed. Inspection passed.

headline: License number missing from vehicle
summary: A food vehicle had no license number on the other sides. The operator must display the license number on both sides. License inspection passed.

headline: Gaps at doors and dirty storage areas
summary: Front entry and exit doors must be tight-fitting on all sides to keep pests out. Articles on floors, debris under display shelves, and stained ceiling tiles were also noted. Complaint inspection passed.

headline: Rusty racks; moldy caulking; missing ceiling tile
summary: Wire storage racks in the walk-in cooler had chipped paint and rust. The three-compartment sink lacked a stopper, and blackened, moldy caulking was present. A ceiling tile near the walk-in cooler was missing. License inspection passed.

headline: No health policy, vomit kit, or dumpster contract
summary: No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies were on site. The restaurant also lacked a commercial dumpster or a contract, and its cooking equipment could not safely cook TCS foods. Chemical sanitizer test strips did not match the bleach on site. Inspection failed.

headline: Front door gap and food stored on floor
summary: A front door had a quarter-inch gap that must be sealed to keep pests out. Food containers were stored on the floor, and cardboard was used as liners. Dead insects and dust were found on equipment and shelves. Inspection passed.

headline: No certified manager; food held at unsafe temperatures
summary: No person in charge was present, and no certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were prepared. Pizza, chicken, and pasta in the hot holding unit measured 113 to 127 degrees and were discarded. Handwashing sink had no soap. Passed with conditions.

headline: Hot and cold foods unsafe; food discarded
summary: Hamburger and chicken on the stove measured 119 to 120 degrees, below the safe hot-holding level, and pancake mix and cheese on a shelf measured 47 to 52 degrees. The manager voluntarily discarded about 19 pounds. A warewashing thermometer read 165 degrees, not 170. Passed with conditions.

headline: No certified food manager on site; hair restraints
summary: No certified food manager with the original city certificate was on site while the restaurant was open. Two employees in the prep area were not wearing hair restraints. Re-inspection passed with conditions.

headline: Cold food at unsafe temperatures; citation issued
summary: Cooked rice was at 81 degrees and cooked chicken at 49 to 61 degrees, all above the 41-degree safe limit. About 96 pounds of food was discarded. The six-door cooler was tagged. A dumpster lid could not close, and a manager lacked allergen training. Inspection failed.

headline: Raw wood surface at customer counter
summary: A raw wood surface was found at the front customer service counter. The operator was instructed to seal it. Inspection passed.

headline: Wipe cloths touching produce; no allergen training
summary: Wiping cloths were stored in direct contact with zucchini and radishes in the walk-in cooler. One of two prep-area handwashing sinks was in disrepair. Floor drains needed cleaning, and no allergen training proof was provided. Inspection passed.

headline: Missing floor tile, grout, and food storage issues
summary: Bulk flour was not labeled, and wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizing solution. Items were stored on floors and milk crates were used for shelving. Floors had pooling liquid and missing tiles, and certified managers lacked allergen training proof. Complaint inspection passed.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths and milk-crate shelving
summary: Soiled wiping cloths were stored on prep tables instead of sanitizing solution. Single-use utensils were not inverted, milk crates were used as shelving, and some ceiling tiles were missing or stained. Inspection passed.

headline: Dirty ice machine, coolers, and cutting boards
summary: Inspectors found buildup inside the ice machine, food spills in reach-in coolers, and dirty floors under prep tables. Cutting boards had dark spots or deep cuts. Some food handlers lacked hair nets. Inspection passed.

headline: Missing food handler certificates; crates used as shelves
summary: Several food handlers lacked food handler certificates. Metal storage racks inside the walk-in cooler had white mold-like buildup, milk crates were used for shelving, and kitchen floors had food debris and grease. Inspection passed.

headline: Cold salad at unsafe temperatures; discarded
summary: Shredded lettuce at 45 degrees and spinach at 46 to 49 degrees were held on the cold line and in the walk-in cooler. About 20 pounds was discarded. Missing thermometer, unlabeled squeeze bottles, and no food handler or allergen training for a new employee were also noted. Passed with conditions.

headline: Food on floor; no hair restraints; debris
summary: Food items were stored on the walk-in cooler floor, and food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Soiled wiping cloths were stored on prep tables. Cooking equipment, shelves, and the floors had debris, and peeling paint and openings in walls were noted. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Cold foods well above safe temperature; citation
summary: Eggs, chicken, pork, and other cold foods in the walk-in cooler and salad cooler measured 44 to 58 degrees, above the 41-degree limit. The salad cooler itself measured 47 degrees. A priority citation was issued, and management was told to fix the cooler. Passed with conditions.

headline: Rusted racks, raw wood, and wall damage
summary: Storage racks were rusted, and raw wood surfaces were found near the front counter. Cutting boards had dark stains, and food debris built up in outdoor coolers. Walls had missing tiles and damaged floors, and holes were found in kitchen walls. Re-inspection failed.

headline: Unlabeled cooked foods; 120 pounds discarded
summary: Cooked pasta, lasagna, and sausage in a two-door refrigerator were not date-labeled. The person in charge discarded about 120 pounds. Ice machine interior was dirty, and cloths were stored on cooked pasta. Passed with conditions.

headline: Chest freezer accessible to customers
summary: A chest freezer with food was stored in a hallway accessible to customers. The person in charge was told to lock it to prevent contamination. A certified manager's allergen certificate had expired and must be renewed. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Floors need cleaning; no allergen training
summary: Floors needed cleaning to remove spills and debris. The certified manager on duty had no allergen training and was instructed to complete it. Inspection passed.

headline: Missing handwashing sink; cold unit too warm
summary: The front juicing and food prep area had no handwashing sink. A sushi cold-holding unit measured 48 degrees, above the 41-degree limit, and the hot-holding line equipment was not on site to check. License inspection failed.

headline: Shellstock tags undated; cooked beef stored above lettuce
summary: Shellstock tags lacked dates, and raw ground beef was stored above ready-to-eat lettuce in the walk-in cooler. The beef was moved on site. A door had openings that allow pests in. Passed with conditions.

headline: Plastic cups used as scoops; filters poorly kept
summary: Single-use plastic cups were used as scoops in bulk dry food containers. Styrofoam and cardboard to-go containers were stored uncovered. Some vent filters were damaged or improperly installed, and several certified managers had expired allergen training. Inspection passed.

headline: Unlabeled baked goods; leaking drain
summary: Grab-and-go cookies lacked required food labels. The basement warewashing sink drain was leaking, and condensate lines were not properly drained. Floors under the front cook line had dried food and grease. Inspection passed.

headline: Restroom needs cleaning and cover
summary: The toilet room needed detail cleaning, and the unisex restroom needed a covered waste can. Construction materials were stored in the customer service area and must be removed. License re-inspection passed.

headline: Food debris on equipment; hole in dish wall
summary: Reach-in coolers had encrusted food debris, and cooking equipment had grease. Floors had dust and debris, and two holes were found in the dish area wall. An ice machine was leaking, and the summary report was not posted. Re-inspection passed with conditions.

headline: No hot water at restroom handwashing sinks
summary: Restroom handwashing sinks had no hot water, measuring 65 degrees. Hot water must reach at least 100 degrees. A restroom sink drains slowly, items are stored on the floor, and the kitchen ceiling has water damage and a hole. Inspection failed.

headline: Rust on wire racks in cooler
summary: Rust was found on wire racks inside a three-door reach-in cooler in the prep area. The operator was instructed to repaint or replace them. Inspection passed.

headline: Gap under kitchen door; missing training records
summary: A one-inch gap under the kitchen door, which leads to an upstairs apartment, must be sealed. Missing food handler and allergen training records were noted for employees and the certified manager. Broken floor tiles, water-damaged ceilings, and an inoperable basement restroom fan were also noted. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Over 40 rodent droppings; hot water failures
summary: Over 40 rodent droppings were found under the three-compartment sink and front service counter, and a priority citation was issued. Hot water measured 40 to 47 degrees at several sinks, below the required minimum. A plumber repaired the issue, reaching 104 to 114 degrees. Inspection failed.

headline: No covered waste can; no allergen training
summary: There was no covered waste receptacle in the washroom. The certified manager had no allergen training. License inspection passed.

headline: Dirty fryers; no trash can; food handler training gaps
summary: The deep fryers needed cleaning inside and out. The basement employee restroom had no covered trash can. Grease and debris were on the ceiling and walls behind the dish sink. Several food handlers lacked certificates. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Rat droppings found throughout premises
summary: Inspector counted over 250 rat droppings throughout the premises, including on food shelves, baking sheets, and near cooking equipment. A priority citation was issued. Missing soap and towels at a sink, a broken grease bin lid, and missing food handler certificates were also noted. Inspection failed.

headline: Missing sink stopper and dim cooler lighting
summary: Debris was found inside the ice maker and under the ice machine, and the three-compartment sink was missing a stopper. Walk-in cooler lights were dim. Food handler and allergen training records were not on site, and these issues were not corrected from the last inspection.

headline: No certified manager certificate; coffee service issue
summary: A certified food manager had no city food sanitation certificate. Self-serve coffee with dairy was set up without a city certificate. Hand signs, a drainboard, and cleaning under heavy equipment were also needed. Repeat missing covered trash can and training records. Inspection failed.

headline: Leaking faucet and no food handler proof
summary: A three-compartment sink faucet was leaking. Single-use items were stored under a handwashing sink, dust was on the bread oven vent, and proof of food handler training and allergen training was missing. Inspection passed.

headline: Cooler too warm; food discarded
summary: A two-door cooler held food at 52 to 55 degrees, well above the 41-degree safe limit. About 23 pounds of food was discarded. The cooler was tagged and held for inspection. Minor cleaning and debris issues were also noted. Passed with conditions.

headline: No certified manager; unsafe food temperatures found
summary: No certified food manager was on site while food was prepared, and the person in charge lacked a certificate. Cooked beef and rice were held hot at unsafe temperatures. Cold foods were also too warm and discarded. Inspection failed.

headline: Missing thermometer and dirty walk-in cooler
summary: No thermometer was visible in the walk-in cooler, and an ice scoop was stored on top of the ice machine. Rusty racks, crates used as shelving, and a missing ceiling tile were noted. Food was stored on the walk-in freezer floor. Inspection failed.

headline: Gaps at front doors; dim kitchen lights
summary: Gaps at the bottom of the front doors must be fixed with proper weather stripping to block pests. Kitchen floors and drains need cleaning, and flickering, dim kitchen lights must be repaired. Complaint inspection passed.

headline: Hair restraint, sink faucet, and training issues
summary: A food handler in the prep area was not wearing a hair restraint, and the three-compartment sink faucet runs continuously. The floor drain was dirty. A food handler had no training certificate. Inspection passed.

headline: Foil used as shelf liner; no allergen proof
summary: A small amount of calcium buildup was in the ice machine. Aluminum foil lined shelves in the prep area and basement freezers. No proof of allergen training was found for city food managers. Inspection passed.

headline: Ice machine debris; no hot holding thermometer
summary: Debris was encrusted inside the ice maker, and a chicken hot-holding unit had no visible thermometer. A broken splash guard and a leaking drain pipe were also noted. An electric fly trap hung above the produce area and was to be removed. Complaint inspection passed.

headline: Expired allergen training certificate
summary: An allergen training certificate for certified food managers had expired. Operators were told to provide current training. Inspection passed.

headline: Cooler at 60 degrees; tagged for inspection
summary: A two-door cooler measured 60 degrees, but no food was stored in it, so no citation was issued. The unit was tagged and held for inspection. Rusted shelving, a leaking faucet, and peeling ceiling paint were also noted. Passed with conditions.

headline: Walk-in cooler gasket torn; slow sink drain
summary: A walk-in cooler door gasket was torn and must be replaced. A utility sink drained slowly and needed unclogging. Cutting boards were stained, and walk-in cooler interiors, cooking equipment, and ventilation needed cleaning. Passed with conditions.

headline: Expired allergen training for all managers
summary: All certified food managers had expired allergen training certificates. The operator was instructed to complete the training and keep records on site at all times. Inspection passed.

headline: Flies and mouse droppings; citation issued
summary: About 100 small live flies were found in several areas, including the dining area and near kitchen equipment. Over 50 mouse droppings were under the three-compartment sink and in fryer cabinets. A priority citation was issued. Missing norovirus-effective cleanup kit and cluttered shelves also noted. Complaint inspection failed.

headline: Ice scoops stored on machine; missing trash cans
summary: Ice scoops were stored uncovered on top of the ice machine. Clean equipment was stored under a drainboard, and a stained cutting board needed replacement. Trash receptacles were missing at several handwashing sinks. Complaint inspection passed.

headline: About 55 rodent droppings found throughout
summary: About 55 small rodent droppings were scattered across rear dish and storage areas, prep area and under the front counter. Pest control service is required; droppings must be removed and areas cleaned and sanitized. Citation issued. Allergen training was missing.

headline: Greasy fryers and one manager lacks allergen training
summary: Both deep fryers had heavy grease on sides, wheels and casters. The second women's bathroom had no covered trash receptacle. Two mops were stored in filled buckets and must air dry. One certified manager lacked allergen training proof.

headline: No food handler training; crates and cardboard used
summary: No food handler training was on file for employees. Crates were used for food storage and cardboard lined shelves. Ice machines lacked a visible backflow device. Grease and debris, and hood filters with buildup, also need cleaning.

headline: Gap in exit doors; sealing ordered
summary: Inspector saw an opening between the outer exit double doors, low on the east and west sides. No pests were found. Operator was told to seal all outer openings to keep pests out.

headline: Sewage backup, unsafe food temperatures, no manager
summary: Sewage backed up at a sushi-bar floor drain while a hand sink ran. TCS foods sat at 60-65F; about 20 lbs discarded. No person in charge or certified manager was on site initially. Bar hand sink had no hot water.

headline: Missing handwashing sign and hair restraint
summary: Handwashing signage was missing in the rear prep area. A food handler prepared food without a hair restraint, and the employee washroom had no covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

headline: No hot water at sinks; repeat violations uncorrected
summary: No hot running water was at prep-area hand sinks, the washroom sink or the three-compartment sink; it was restored at 2:47 p.m. Citation issued. Food sat in plastic grocery bags in the freezer, and repeat violations from an August 2024 report went uncorrected.

headline: Peeling paint, grease buildup, no covered trash
summary: Women's washroom had no covered trash receptacle. Peeling paint was on basement prep ceiling tiles, food buildup was on dishwashing walls, and grease and debris were on first-floor hood filters. All must be fixed and maintained.

headline: Greasy fryer wheels and dirty walls
summary: Fryer wheels had excessive grease buildup. Lower walls and wall bases throughout the premises had food debris and dirt. These must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: No certified food manager during TCS food service
summary: No certified food manager (CFM) was on site while chicken, hummus and other TCS foods were handled and served; operator was told to get one. Walk-in cooler lighting was too dim and must be improved.

headline: Leaky bar sink faucet; dusty restroom fan
summary: A three-compartment sink faucet at the bar area was leaking and must be repaired. Dust had built up on a fan in the employee restrooms and must be cleaned.

headline: Cooling beef wrapped tight; allergen training missing
summary: Cooked ground beef was covered tightly with plastic wrap while cooling. Operator was told to leave TCS foods loosely covered while cooling. Also noted: unlabeled dry containers, loose cooler doors, and several certified food managers missing allergen training certificates.

headline: Dead roaches and spider webs in prep areas
summary: Dead roaches and spider webs were in prep areas and must be removed. Also noted a food-encrusted can opener, rusted cooler rack, and basement ceiling holes from a leaking pipe. A manager's allergen training certificate had expired.

headline: Rodent droppings and roach found; hand sinks blocked
summary: About 50 mouse droppings at the front cashier and 50 rat droppings in rear storage, plus a live roach in the kitchen. Hand sinks were blocked or lacked soap and towels. About 10 lbs of undated cooked rice and noodles discarded.

headline: Overhead exhaust light not working
summary: The light in the overhead exhaust system on the right side did not work and could not be turned on. The manager must repair or replace it and provide adequate lighting in the prep area.

headline: No certified manager and no hot water
summary: No certified food manager was present while food was prepared and served; citation issued. Three-compartment and washroom sinks had no hot water, also cited. No pest control log, no employee health policy, and a 1-inch gap at the front door were noted.

headline: No written employee health policy on site
summary: No written employee health policy was on site. Staff must have a policy and signed reporting agreement kept on site for all food employees. This was a serious (priority foundation) violation; no citation was issued.

headline: Freezer doors not sealing; freezer burn noted
summary: Four of 16 freezer doors had ice at the base, so they did not seal tightly. Freezer burn was found on food packaging, shelves and doors. Operator must provide tight-fitting doors to protect food from temperature problems.

headline: Cold-holding cooler at 46.2F; meats discarded
summary: Pork, ham, beef and chicken in a 1-door prep cooler were above 41F, about 30 lbs were discarded, and the cooler was taken out of use and tagged. Citation issued. Coolers lacked internal thermometers; food stood on the walk-in floor.

headline: Raw wood paneling needs sealing or removal
summary: Raw wood paneling behind coolers and beside the basement stairs must be sealed on both sides or removed, so surfaces are smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Kitchen hand sink lacks splash guards
summary: The kitchen handwashing sink, near cooking equipment, had no splash guards on its back, left and right sides. Operator must install them.

headline: Rear door gap; no coffee machine backflow device
summary: A gap along the bottom of the rear door must be made tight fitting. The coffee machine had no backflow device. Damaged flooring under the fryers needs repair. Grease, food debris and ceiling splatter in basement need cleaning.

headline: Hair restraint missing; unlabeled bulk food, slow drains
summary: A food worker was not wearing a hair restraint and was told to wear one. Bulk containers of salt and sugar were unlabeled. Front hand sinks drained slowly and must be repaired.

headline: Rear door gap, heavy sink leak, freezer ice
summary: Rear door had a 1/4 inch gap at the bottom and must be sealed. The three-compartment sink was loose and heavily leaking. Excess ice was in the freezer, and a missing wall base exposed an unfinished wall with a hole.

headline: Several employees lack food handler training
summary: Several employees had no food handler training, and records must be kept on site. The walk-in cooler had no working thermometer inside. Certified managers on duty still lacked allergen training, a repeat violation; citation issued.

headline: Food on floors; plastic bags; heavy grease buildup
summary: Food containers on floors in several areas must be raised six inches. Cold-holding foods were stored in plastic thank-you bags, not food-grade bags. Heavy grease and food debris were on cooking equipment, walls and floors.

headline: To-go pudding unlabeled; missing backflow and trash lid
summary: Tembleque (coconut pudding) sold to go had no labels; items sold to go must list ingredients and trace-back information. A utility sink lacked a backflow device, and a restroom lacked a covered trash can.

headline: Plastic wrap in cooler; loose sink handle
summary: Plastic shipping wrap was on a cold-holding unit and must be removed and sanitized. A hot water handle at a hand sink was loose, and a burned-out light bulb above the grill needed replacing.

headline: Cooler at 60.5F tagged out of use
summary: A two-door cooler in the main prep area held at 60.5F; it was tagged held for inspection and must not be used until it holds 41F or below and is reinspected. A handwashing sign was missing.

headline: Dusty ceiling vents need cleaning
summary: Inspector saw dust on ceiling vents and instructed staff to clean them where needed.

headline: Coffee maker lacks visible backflow device
summary: Inspector could not locate a backflow prevention device for the coffee maker in the main kitchen and instructed that it be exposed. A light shield was missing from a kitchen ceiling fixture and must be installed.

headline: Beard restraint missing; greasy fryers and milk crates
summary: A cook with a beard was not wearing a beard restraint. Restraints must be provided for all food handlers with beards. Milk crates were used for storage elevation. Grease and food debris were on fryers and behind the cooking line.

headline: Door gaps, leaking sink, washroom door not closing
summary: Front and rear exit doors had 1/4 inch gaps and must be rodent-proofed. No pests were recorded. The three-compartment sink leaks at the faucet base. The washroom door does not fully self-close and must.

headline: Wet wiping cloths left on beverage counters
summary: Wet wiping cloths were left on counters in the beverage area and must be stored in proper sanitizing solution when not in use. Single-service cardboard trays at the prep line must be inverted.

headline: No certified food manager present during food prep
summary: No certified food manager (CFM) was on site while milk and other TCS foods (must be kept hot or cold) were prepared and served. Management was told a CFM must always be present. Citation issued.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; must be removed
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving throughout the prep and storage areas. They must be removed and replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor so the floor can be cleaned.

headline: Candy boxes on floor; soiled wiping cloths
summary: Boxes of candy were stored on the floor behind the front counter and must be elevated 6 inches. Soiled wiping cloths were stored on sinks and prep tables. Washroom door did not close properly, and ceiling and floor tiles need repair.

headline: No certified manager on site; citation issued
summary: No valid City certified food manager certificate was on site, and the person in charge had no foodservice manager training; citation issued. Ice machine door had residue, drive-thru cold-hold units had spills, and the women's restroom lacked a covered receptacle.

headline: No handwashing sink in middle prep line
summary: The middle prep and cook line had no handwashing sink; one must be installed (priority violation). The three-compartment sink was repaired with plumber's putty, which is not allowed. Manager lacks allergen training certificate. Floor grease and open wall also noted.

headline: Warm cooler, slimy ice machine, flies found
summary: About 30 live small flies were in the basement dry storage. Prep cooler held cut tomatoes and cheese at 52.6-60F; about 6 lbs discarded and the cooler tagged. Black slime was in the ice machine dripping into ice.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; damaged floor tiles
summary: Bulk containers in basement storage were not labeled and must show the common name of the food. Damaged floor tiles in prep, dish washing and basement areas must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Food stored on floors; no hair restraints
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor in prep, storage and walk-in areas and must be raised 6 inches. Employees preparing food lacked hair restraints. Bulk containers in basement were unlabeled; hood and filters had heavy grease.

headline: Grease and debris; uncorrected prior violations
summary: Grease and food debris built up on fryers, coolers, prep tables and carts. Prior violations were not corrected, including floor and wall grease, missing floor grout and a non-smooth wood partition. Citation issued.

headline: Live flies found; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: About 40 or more live small flies were on ceilings and beams in dish, beverage and bar areas; pest control recommended, citation issued. Low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm and was tagged. Shellfish tags were missing last sold dates.

headline: No dish machine thermometer; hose lacks backflow device
summary: Inspector found no temperature measuring device for the high-temperature dish machine; operator was told to get one. A hose on the three-compartment sink lacked a backflow prevention device and must stay exposed. No citation issued.

headline: No cleanup supplies for vomit; old issues uncorrected
summary: No supplies were available to clean up vomiting or diarrhea events, a priority violation with citation. Prior violations were not fixed on time, including foil liners, grease buildup, dirty floors and broken floor tiles.

headline: Coolers lack working thermometers; dirty racks, gaskets
summary: Outer thermometers on walk-in and reach-in coolers did not work, and no internal thermometer was placed inside. Racks and gaskets had food and dirt. Water-stained ceiling tiles and dirty floors under heavy equipment also need attention.

headline: Rear door gaps, food in grocery bags, leaks
summary: Rear screen door had 1/2 to 1 inch gaps underneath and must be rodent and insect proofed. Food was stored in grocery bags. Male food handlers lacked hair restraints. Leaks were under the front hand sink and 3-compartment sink.

headline: About 15 live flying insects in food areas
summary: Inspector saw about 15 live small flying insects on walls, ceilings and stock boxes in food prep, the manager's office, dining room and dry storage. More pest control service is needed. Citation issued.

headline: Manager lacked valid city sanitation certificate
summary: The person in charge did not hold a City of Chicago sanitation certificate, and no valid original certificate was on site for the manager on duty; citation issued. Milk crates were used for shelf elevation, and a hand-sink faucet leaked.

headline: Utensils left uncovered on dining tables
summary: Multi-use utensils on dining room tables were not properly stored or covered. The manager must cover them on the tables.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; splash guards needed
summary: A dairy cooler in the rear storage hallway had no internal thermometer; one must be provided. Splash guards must be installed at the bar dump sink and kitchen utility sink to protect food from splashes.

headline: Pot too large for sink; procedure needed
summary: A pot was too large to fit in the three-compartment sink. The operator must provide a written alternative washing and sanitizing procedure or remove the pot.

headline: No sanitizer test kit; chicken in grocery bags
summary: No chemical test kit was available for sanitizer; priority violation, citation issued. Chicken was stored in plastic grocery bags in the walk-in cooler and deep freezer. A food handler lacked training certificate.

headline: Live flies, warm cooler, no certified manager
summary: About 15 or more live small flies were in beverage and dining areas; pest control was recommended. A prep cooler held food at 51.7F and was tagged on hold. No certified food manager was on duty; citation issued.

headline: Extra hand sink needed; knives in standing water
summary: An additional hand sink must be installed in the second-floor food smoking room. Knives were kept in standing water at the prep table and must be stored according to health code.

headline: Rear doors gap; no warewashing procedure
summary: Rear double exit doors had a 1/4 inch gap and must be made tight fitting. No written procedure existed for washing large equipment manually, and the three-compartment sink lacked stoppers.

headline: Fryer grease spills; sink pipe dripping
summary: Minor grease spills were inside the fryers and must be cleaned. Water was dripping from the pipe below the left compartment of the three-compartment sink in the dish area and must be repaired.

headline: Walk-in freezer seal and ice buildup
summary: The walk-in freezer seal was in poor repair and must be fixed to prevent ice buildup. Ice had built up on shelves and products and must be defrosted and cleaned. Floors in beef prep coolers needed cleaning.

headline: Sink leak; unhung mops; standing water on floors
summary: A leak was under the far-right compartment of the three-compartment sink. Mops were not hung to dry and must be hung to prevent pest activity. Dish room, basement and main kitchen floors had standing water, and bar floors were dirty.

headline: No service sink; non-working cooler stored outside
summary: No service sink with hot and cold water was on site and must be installed. The employee bathroom door did not self-close. A nonworking cold-holding unit was stored outside near refuse, and the floor around the grease trap was not smooth.

headline: Blocked hand sink, dirty wiping cloths, freezer ice
summary: A hand sink by the ice machine was blocked with prep utensils; the manager had staff clear it right away, and a citation was issued. Dirty wiping cloths were on prep tables. Heavy ice buildup was in the walk-in freezer.

headline: Soil buildup on kitchen floor
summary: Soil had built up on the floor throughout the kitchen. Manager was told to ensure floors are cleaned and maintained.

headline: Stained walls in food prep area
summary: Walls in the food prep area had stains and must be cleaned.

headline: Sink stopper and washroom ventilation need repair
summary: The middle sink stopper in the warewashing area did not work properly and must be repaired. The washroom ventilation was not working and must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Ice scoop stored in machine; floor grout damaged
summary: An ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine; a clean container must be provided. Floor grout at the dishwashing area was low and in poor repair and must be regrouted.

headline: Cold foods held at 60-73F; cooler at 68F
summary: Several cold foods were held at 60-73F, and the manager discarded about $300 of chicken, beef, milk and eggs; citation issued. A cooler was at 68F and tagged. A freezer chest with food was stored outside.

headline: Flies, unsafe cold food temps, untagged oysters
summary: About 30 small flies were in the facility; pest control recommended. Cold TCS foods held at 46.8-81.0F were discarded on site, as were untagged oysters. High-temperature dish machine ran at 142F. Expired food handler and allergen training noted.

headline: Floor food boxes, compressor leak, heavy clutter
summary: Food boxes were stored on the walk-in cooler floor. An active leak from the walk-in compressor reached the floor. Clutter in rear storage could harbor rodents. Ice machine lacks backflow device; a manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Repeat debris violation uncorrected; unlabeled containers
summary: Debris on floors throughout the kitchen, walk-in coolers, freezers and basement was a repeat violation not corrected from a November 2024 report. Prep bulk containers were unlabeled, and deli sink stoppers did not work. Manager must correct all by reinspection.

headline: Fryers dirty; minor sink leak; handwashing sign missing
summary: The employee toilet room had no handwashing sign and must have one. Fryer interiors had food and grease debris. A minor leak at the bottom of the three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; unlabeled bulk food; leaks
summary: No handwashing signs were at prep-area hand sinks. Bulk food such as flour and sugar was unlabeled. Also noted a small leak at a hand sink, a dirty storage cooler interior and dirty floors in the main kitchen. Items must be fixed.

headline: Repeat violations uncorrected: allergen training, gaskets, lids
summary: Repeat violations from two past inspections were not corrected. Managers still lacked allergen training, a refrigeration door gasket was torn, and washroom trash cans had no lids. Operator was told to correct them; citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled containers, stacked chip bowls, toilet room issues
summary: Brownish substance on the ice machine panel needs cleaning and sanitizing. Some dry storage containers lacked labels. Chip bowls were stacked with bottoms touching the chips. Employee toilet room lacked a self-closing door and a covered trash can.

headline: Dish machine tagged; sanitizing at 0 ppm
summary: A low-temperature dish machine in the dish area was not sanitizing; it read 0 ppm. It is tagged and must not be used until it sanitizes at least 50 ppm. Citation issued.

headline: No food handler or allergen training on hand
summary: No food handler training was provided, and no allergen training was available; all employees handling food must have food handler training. Ventilation above cooking equipment was not working, and the three-compartment sink had no stoppers.

headline: No handwashing sink; no food handler training
summary: The prep and dishwashing area had no handwashing sink, and a sanitizer test kit was missing; citations were issued for both. Staff had no food handler training. The front door had a 1/4 inch gap.

headline: Ice on cooler pipes; cluttered refuse area
summary: Ice had built up on mechanical pipes inside a display cooler, and reach-in and display cooler interiors needed cleaning. The refuse area was littered with furniture and trash. Inspector recommended locking or moving the dumpster and more frequent pickup.

headline: Leak under dishwashing hand sink
summary: A leak was found under the hand sink in the dishwashing area. It must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Unlabeled bulk foods; dirty floors; soiled mop
summary: Bulk foods not in original containers were unlabeled and must show the common name. Floors under and around the ice machine were dirty. A soiled mop was stored in a bucket and must be stored inverted at the utility mop sink.

headline: Mouse and rat droppings; live flies found
summary: About 60 or more mouse droppings were found, along with 2 rat droppings and 3 live large flies behind the service counter; pest control service needed. Entry door had a gap, dumpster lids would not close; no pest control log.

headline: Low hot water pressure; corrected on site
summary: Hot water pressure at the meat and seafood area hand sink was low. Management raised the pressure during the inspection, correcting it on site; operator was told to repair and maintain it.

headline: No certified manager; unsafe rice and bean temperatures
summary: No certified food manager was present while TCS foods (must be kept hot or cold) were served; citation issued. Cooked rice and beans at 65.8F were discarded. Soap and paper towels were missing; corrected on site. Fish was thawed improperly.

headline: Wiping cloths left out; no cooler thermometer
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables and sinks instead of in sanitizing solution. A 1-door prep cooler had no working thermometer. Also noted grease inside cooking equipment and a large open hole in the basement ceiling.

headline: Dead mouse found in basement
summary: A dead mouse was on the basement floor near the water heater and must be removed, with the area cleaned and sanitized. Bulk flour container was unlabeled. Other issues: fryer grease, floor debris, and unused items that could harbor pests.

headline: Live roaches throughout kitchen and sushi areas
summary: Inspector saw live roaches in many spots, including about 4-5 at a hand-sink soap dispenser, 5-10 near the fire suppression system and 5-10 at a wall hole. Citation issued. Cutting board, equipment and floors also need cleaning.

headline: Food stored under exposed sewer lines; ceiling damage
summary: Equipment and utensils were stored under unshielded wastewater and sewer lines in the basement; food items and storage bins must be shielded or moved. The basement storage ceiling was heavily damaged and water-stained and must be repaired.

headline: Improper thawing; cardboard liner and grease found
summary: Frozen meat was thawing in a three-compartment sink, which is not an approved method; staff were told to thaw food properly. Cardboard floor liner, grease buildup, a leaking drainpipe and improperly stored mop heads were also noted.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; unlabeled food containers
summary: The hand sink by the three-compartment sink had no handwashing sign. Food containers, including sugar and beans, were unlabeled. Both must be provided.

headline: Missing splash guard and allergen certificates
summary: Hand sink in the prep area needs a durable splash guard on its right side. Certified food managers were missing allergen training certificates and must be trained.

headline: Unwashed hands and bare-hand food contact
summary: A cook handled ready-to-eat food without washing hands; servers did the same. Strawberries handled bare-handed; 5 lbs discarded. Hot foods below 135F; 9 lbs discarded. Dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm until adjusted. Multiple citations issued.

headline: Dusty ceiling vents in washrooms need cleaning
summary: Ceiling ventilation covers inside the washrooms had excessive dust. Staff must detail clean them and keep them maintained.

headline: Torn cooler door gaskets on second floor
summary: Several rubber door gaskets on second-floor prep area coolers were ripped. They must be repaired or replaced so the doors seal properly.

headline: Noodles at 68.4F in walk-in; discarded
summary: Noodles in the walk-in cooler were at 68.4F, and the manager discarded 10 lbs. Citation issued. Frozen chicken, beef and pork were stored in plastic grocery bags. No food handler training proof was on record.

headline: No food handler training for any employees
summary: No food handler training was on record for employees. The manager was told to provide training for all employees who handle food or food equipment.

headline: Overflowing dumpster and gap in front door
summary: The outside dumpster was overflowing with trash, and garbage was on the ground; citation issued. Front doors had a 1/4 inch gap. Also noted low water pressure at the rear mop sink and a washroom door that does not self-close.

headline: Torn cooler gasket and heavy food residue
summary: A deli cooler had a torn gasket and heavy food residue inside. Walk-in shelving had residue and rust. Floors in the walk-in, prep areas and washrooms had food residue and debris that must be cleaned.

headline: No handwashing sink in restroom
summary: The restroom had no sink for handwashing. The person in charge was told to install and maintain one. This is a serious (priority foundation) violation.

headline: Food in grocery bags; cardboard and crates used
summary: Food was stored in grocery bags inside coolers and refrigeration. Cardboard boxes lined shelves, and milk crates were used for elevation. A leaking faucet and pipe were at the three-compartment sink. Clutter in storage must be removed.

headline: Dish machine and dish area need cleaning
summary: Dirt and food debris were on the exterior of the high-temperature dish machine and the dish area walls. Dust had built up on dish area vents. Staff were told to detail clean and maintain.

headline: Greasy hood and coolers; unlabeled containers
summary: Food storage containers must be detail cleaned and some need labels such as salt, flour and sugar. Coolers, freezers, shelves and floors have excessive grease. The kitchen hood fan does not clear smoke and makes a cranking sound; it must be fixed.

headline: Food in used boxes; detail cleaning needed
summary: Cooked chicken and fried foods were stored in used food boxes; food-grade containers are required. Bowls were used as scoops in bulk containers, wiping cloths were not in sanitizer buckets, and cutting boards and aprons were worn. Equipment, shelves, restroom and floors need detail cleaning.

headline: Expired food handler certificate; allergen proof missing
summary: Bulk foods not in original containers need common-name labels, and wiping cloths must be held in sanitizing solution. An ice scoop was stored in ice. A food handler has an expired certificate, and an earlier allergen training violation remains uncorrected; citation issued.

headline: Rust on racks; stained cutting boards; torn gaskets
summary: Wire storage racks in the walk-in cooler have rust that must be removed and the racks repainted or replaced. Stained cutting boards in the kitchen food prep areas must be resurfaced or replaced. Torn gaskets on the front prep line cooler doors must be replaced.

headline: Sink sanitizing skipped; earlier issues uncorrected
summary: No paper towels were at front and rear prep handwash sinks; citation issued. An employee washed dishes without sanitizing; the manager corrected it at once with chlorine. Food was stored in grocery bags and tin cans. Earlier unfixed violations included unlabeled bulk food and heavy hood grease.

headline: Minor repairs: faucet, drains, mop rack
summary: The hot water faucet knob at the dishwashing handsink is in poor repair and must be fixed. Floor drains at sinks need cleaning. The mop and broom drying rack at the utility sink must be replaced.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were found in basement storage, with more behind counters, freezers, and sinks; citation issued. Pest control is required before reinspection next week. No city food service manager certificate was provided. Ventilation over cooking equipment is not working; repair is scheduled.

headline: Slimy ice machines; ice must be discarded
summary: Ice machines on two floors were heavily soiled with black and gray slime dripping onto ice used for drinks. Manager must discard the ice and clean the machines; citation issued. Also missing: a handwash sign, covered trash cans, and a working paper towel holder.

headline: No certified manager; soap fixed on site
summary: No city certified food service manager was on premises; citation issued. The front prep handsink had no soap, but it was provided before inspection ended; citation issued. Iodized salt, oregano and single-use cups were stored under the handsink. Boxes are stored on crates.

headline: Oversized pots, rear door gaps, damaged floors
summary: Oversized pots cannot be submerged in the three-compartment sink and must be removed or handled with a written procedure. The rear screen door has holes and gaps that must be sealed. Also: unlabeled tortilla bowl container, cloth shelf liners, dirty and broken floor tiles, and a missing vent cover.

headline: Kitchen utensils in poor repair and soiled
summary: Kitchen utensils, including a strainer and pots, have loose handles and are soiled, so they can no longer be cleaned easily. The operator must repair or replace them and keep them clean.

headline: Clutter in rear dry storage area
summary: The rear dry storage area is cluttered. Items not in use must be removed and the area organized.

headline: Cardboard shelf liners; moldy caulking
summary: Cardboard must not be used as shelf liner throughout the facility. Food splatter is on walls in the dry bulk storage room and at the rear three-compartment sink. Blackened, moldy caulking at the kitchen two-compartment sink must be replaced.

headline: Over 20 small flies found; citation issued
summary: Over 20 small flies were found on the second floor, with fly activity in dishwashing and beverage areas; citation issued. Pest control was recommended on or after October 15, 2024. Also: openings in front doors, leaking drains, and beverage lines draining into handwash sinks.

headline: Greasy equipment, floors and walls; ice machine
summary: The ice machine interior had pink and gray buildup. The oven, fryer, prep tables, coolers and floors had thick grease, food and debris. Male employees in prep areas were not wearing hair restraints. Cutting boards are stained and grooved, and a faucet leaks.

headline: Torn gasket on prep cooler door
summary: A torn door gasket was found inside the two-door prep cooler. The operator was instructed to replace it.

headline: Live roaches in prep and dish areas; citation
summary: Two live roaches were crawling in prep and dishwashing areas, and numerous dead roaches were on glue boards. Fly strips hung in prep. Manager must call an exterminator and clean; citation issued. Food stored on floor; no hair restraints; rust in coolers.

headline: No bathroom ventilation; food handler certificate missing
summary: The employee bathroom has no ventilation, and the operator was instructed to provide it. No food handler certificate was on site and must be provided.

headline: Leaks, holes, grease; mop heads corrected
summary: A pipe leaks under the dishwashing-area handsink. Holes are in walls, ceiling tiles are water-stained, and the hood vents and cooking areas need cleaning. Mop heads stored in a handsink were removed on site. Food handler and allergen certificates must be on site.

headline: No handwashing signs at prep sinks
summary: Handwashing signs are missing at handsinks in the preparation areas. The operator must provide them.

headline: Deep cutting board creases; rusty freezer shelves
summary: Cutting boards on top of the food prep line coolers have deep creases that must be resurfaced or replaced. Shelves in the walk-in freezer are rusty and must be replaced or repainted.

headline: Coffee grounds and dirt on floors; no handwash sign
summary: A handwash sign is missing in the toilet room. Employees must wear hair restraints. Cardboard is used on shelving in the rear dish area. Floors and wall bases have coffee beans, grounds and dirt, and vents and pipes are dusty.

headline: Debris on storage racks and wall
summary: Wire storage racks in the front prep area have debris buildup and must be cleaned. The wall behind the three-compartment sink also has debris accumulation.

headline: Gap under kitchen door; floor and wall cleaning
summary: A gap of about 1/4 inch under the rear kitchen exit door must be closed to prevent pests. Dirt and small debris are on the floor in the rear prep area near the bar, and possible food splatter is on the wall near the TurboChef unit.

headline: Missing health policy and vomit cleanup kit
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site. There was also no kit or procedure for vomit and diarrhea events. The inspector left templates and instructed the operator to keep signed policies and a kit with norovirus-effective sanitizer. No citation issued. A dump sink is missing from the coffee bar.

headline: No raw-food advisory; wastewater backing up
summary: The menu lacks a disclosure for undercooked or raw items such as eggs, steak and oysters; priority violation. Employee belongings were stored with dry goods, and limes and cherries were on the bar floor. Wastewater backs up from a floor drain under the scrape sink; citation issued.

headline: Greasy fryers, leaking faucets, dirty walls
summary: Fryers in the rear deli have grease and dirt inside. Leaks were found at a one-compartment and a three-compartment sink faucet. Restroom washbowls need recaulking, and walls and ceiling tiles have dirt and dust buildup.

headline: Ammonia used as sanitizer; corrected on site
summary: The mobile food vehicle had no approved food-contact sanitizer, and the manager was using pure ammonia. The inspector instructed never to use harsh chemicals. By the end of the inspection, the manager provided chlorine bleach. Priority violation.

headline: No employee health policy; allergen proof missing
summary: No employee health policy was on site. The manager must provide a verifiable acknowledgment of reporting responsibilities to the person in charge; priority violation. A city food service manager also lacked proof of allergen training on site.

headline: Dish machine too hot; TCS food thawed unsafely
summary: Shrimp and frozen fruit were thawing at room temperature; approved thawing methods were ordered. The large dish machine's final rinse measured 195-200°F; repair ordered and citation issued. Unlabeled bulk containers and a deeply scored cutting board were also noted.

headline: Rodent droppings, unwashed hands, unsafe hot food
summary: About 60 mouse droppings were found in several areas, and more pest control is needed; citation issued. A food handler went from trash to dishes to cooler without washing hands. Meatballs at 122.3°F and Italian beef at 118.2°F were below 135°F; about 20 pounds discarded.

headline: Greasy equipment and walls; burnt-out bulbs
summary: The inside of the deep fryer oil filter unit has grease and food buildup. Cooking equipment, coolers and shelves have accumulated grease and debris. Soiled mop heads were not stored properly, walls and floors have heavy buildup, and three light bulbs are burnt out.

headline: Dead light fixtures over prep; grease trap rust
summary: Several light fixtures above the ice machine in the prep area are not working and must be replaced. The grease trap has rust that must be removed and repainted. Plastic bus trays and prep tables must be cleaned or replaced.

headline: No certified food manager while food served
summary: The person in charge lacked a valid city sanitation certificate, and no certified food manager was on site while TCS (food that must be kept hot or cold) was prepared and served; citation issued. The men's washroom faucet is dirty and the ceiling paint is peeling.

headline: Mouse droppings in kitchen and basement; citation
summary: Mouse droppings were found at the kitchen door, in basement storage, the liquor room, and under an evaporator coil, with about 10 to 20 at each spot; citation issued. Pest control must be provided before reinspection on February 6, 2025. Wall holes and unused items also need attention.

headline: Sinks, cooking equipment, and floor need cleaning
summary: Sinks and cooking equipment were found not clean and must be cleaned. Floors inside the hot water tank room were also not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Knives stored unsafely; dirty microwave interiors
summary: In-use knives were stored between countertops and cutting boards; they must be kept on a clean, sanitized surface between uses. Microwave interiors in the rear kitchen have dried food debris and must be cleaned.

headline: Dirty coolers and handsinks; towels as liners
summary: Towels are used as shelf liners and must be removed. Cooler door interiors and gaskets, handwash sink faucet handles, and walk-in cooler and freezer exteriors are dirty. The walk-in freezer has excessive ice buildup, and a wall opening and loose wall base need repair.

headline: No certified manager while pizza, beef prepared
summary: No city certified food manager was present while TCS food, including pizza and ground beef, was prepared or served; citation issued. The washroom door lacks a self-closing device, the walk-in cooler light has no shield, and a food handler lacked a certificate.

headline: Dipper well drains into handwash sink; many fixes
summary: The dipper well drain empties into a handwash sink in the front prep area and must be connected to a floor drain. Also missing: handwashing signs, consumer advisory on menus, prep cooler shelving, a backflow device, and a covered washroom trash can.

headline: No certified manager; cutting boards not replaced
summary: No city food service manager was on site while chicken, beef and fish were prepared; citation issued. No chemical test device was available for the three-compartment sink. Cutting boards from a prior report were still not replaced, and grease is buildup under cooking equipment.

headline: No dish sanitizer; machine tagged, later fixed
summary: The low-temperature dish machine had no sanitizer, and dishes were washed without sanitizing; the unit was tagged and a citation issued. Sanitizer was provided at a later visit. Also: leaking faucets, broken stoppers, missing allergen training, and earlier violations still uncorrected.

headline: Leaks, greasy hood, water-damaged ceiling tiles
summary: A three-compartment sink faucet base leaks and must be repaired. The ventilation hood and filters have excessive grease and food debris. Vents have dust, walls have peeling paint and grease, and several ceiling tiles are water-damaged.

headline: Floor tiles missing; washroom lights failing
summary: Food debris is on the exteriors of bulk holding containers in the prep area and must be cleaned. Floor tiles are missing and have voids in the prep area and must be repaired. Washroom lights do not stay on and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: 25+ rat droppings and dead rat; citation issued
summary: About 25 or more rat droppings and a dead rat were found under a staircase amid heavy clutter; citation issued. Pest service was recommended on or after February 27, 2025. Door gaps, missing food handler training, and a missing display case thermometer also need attention.

headline: No certified manager; no paper towels at sinks
summary: No city certified food manager was present while ice cream and hot dogs were prepared and served; citation issued. Paper towels were missing at an exposed prep-area handsink and the employee washroom sink; citation issued. A food handler lacked a food handler certificate.

headline: Dish machine lacks temperature indicator; citation
summary: The hot-water dish machine had no required irreversible registering temperature indicator on site. The manager was instructed to provide one. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Leaking prep handsink; floor debris
summary: A faucet at the prep area handsink leaks and must be repaired. Food debris is on floors throughout the prep area and must be detail cleaned under and between cooling and cooking equipment.

headline: Improper handwashing; no soap at sinks
summary: Food handlers were not washing hands properly, and the front and rear handwash sinks had no soap; citations issued. An ice scoop was stored in the ice, and leaks were found at a three-compartment sink. The women's restroom ventilation is broken, and the walk-in freezer has no lighting.

headline: No soap at prep sink; fixed on site
summary: Soap was missing at a preparation-area sink; citation issued, and soap was provided before the inspection ended. Bulk flour and sugar lacked labels, walk-in cooler racks were not clean, and the ice machine water line has no backflow device.

headline: Open rodent bait; dumpster lid missing
summary: Open rodent bait blocks were found in the basement and on floor corners; the manager corrected it on site, but a citation was issued. The outside dumpster has no lid and is not maintained; citation issued. The ice machine interior has debris, and a handsink leaks.

headline: Gaps under doors; floor tiles and thermometers
summary: Gaps of about 1/4 inch under the rear and basement doors to the dumpster area must be rodent-proofed. Floors behind the display cooler have missing and broken tiles. Thermometers must be provided for all cooling units.

headline: No posted sanitation certificate; cleanup kit incomplete
summary: No person with an original city sanitation certificate was posted on site; citation issued. The vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit lacked needed supplies, such as a mask, apron, disinfectant, and mop head; citation issued.

headline: Over 70 rat droppings; pest control needed
summary: More than 70 rat droppings were found in the dining area, cashier area and basement; citation issued. Licensed pest control was recommended on or after June 1, 2026. Also found: door openings, greasy outside container, stained ceiling tiles, and a food handler without training proof.

headline: Live roaches and rat droppings; manager fixed
summary: Three live roaches were found in the rear prep area and eight rat droppings near the front register; citation issued and pest control consulted. No certified manager was present when eggs, chicken and pork were cooked, but this was corrected on site before the end of the inspection.

headline: Chicken held at unsafe temperatures; discarded
summary: Chicken in the hot holding box measured 111°F, below 135°F; 6 pounds were discarded. Chicken in the prep area was at 80°F; 12 pounds were discarded. The three-compartment sink drains poorly and floods when one compartment drains. Citation issued.

headline: Door gaps; stock stored on floor
summary: A 1/4-inch gap is at the front and rear doors and must be sealed. Stock is stored on the floor and along walls in storage and walk-in cooler areas and must be raised six inches. Display shelves have dust, and rear storage baseboards are missing.

headline: Expired manager certificate; sink backs up
summary: No certified food manager with a valid city certificate was on site; the manager's original certificate expired May 1, 2025; citation issued. The three-compartment sink backs up into the rinse and sanitize compartments when draining, and must be repaired. Floors in the rear area need cleaning.

headline: No employee health policy; several fixes needed
summary: No employee health policy was on site; a signed version is required (priority violation, no citation). Handwashing signs are missing in rear customer washrooms, ventilation there is not working, and no allergen training certificates were on premises.

headline: Gaps in outer doors could let pests in
summary: No pests were seen, but several openings in the front patio and rear exit doors must be sealed. Bar handwash sinks lack handwashing signs. Basement walls and ceilings have holes and peeling paint, and wooden shelves are unsealed.

headline: No certified manager while fish was served
summary: The person in charge lacked a city food service manager certificate, and no certified manager was on site while fish was prepared and served; citations issued. Cutting boards and utensils had food debris, prep cooler gaskets were in poor repair, and food handlers lacked training proof.

headline: Standing water, wall gaps; certificates missing
summary: Standing water in the basement must be removed to prevent fly breeding; no flies were noted. Cardboard was used as floor matting, and a basement prep wall has gaps and openings. Current food handler certificates are required for all employees, including the cook, and managers need allergen proof.

headline: No certified manager for 25 minutes; wastewater spill
summary: No certified food manager was on site from 11:55 AM to 12:20 PM while chicken was prepared; citation issued. A greasy trap at the three-compartment sink failed, sending wastewater onto the prep floor; citation issued. Heavy grease and dirt were also found on walls and floors.

headline: Walk-in cooler at 79°F; dish machine off
summary: The walk-in cooler air measured 79.0°F; it must be repaired to 41°F or below. The high-temperature dish machine was off. Two handwash sinks had water at 64.4-69.0°F instead of the required hot water. A three-compartment sink pipe leaks, and the manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No sanitizer in dish machine final rinse
summary: The low-temperature dish machine had no chlorine sanitizer at its final rinse; priority violation, citation issued. Earlier violations for a greasy deep fryer and greasy walls were not corrected. Also: torn cooler gaskets, sagging ceiling tiles, and cleaning needed for prep equipment.

headline: About 70 rodent droppings; sanitizer absent
summary: About 70 rodent droppings were found behind the soda machine, under a handwash sink and elsewhere; citation issued. The bar three-compartment sink had no sanitizer, corrected on site. A bowl was used as a scoop in dry storage, and an ice scoop was stored in the ice.

headline: Egg patties and turkey at 44°F; discarded
summary: Egg patties and turkey were stored at 44°F, above the 41°F limit. The manager discarded 4 pounds of egg patties and 6 pounds of turkey, worth $35; citation issued. A service line cooler at 45°F was tagged. Stained ceiling tiles need replacing.

headline: Splashguard needed; wall openings; vent fan broken
summary: A splashguard must be installed between the exposed handsink and the three-compartment sink. Spray foam above the three-compartment sink must be removed, and wall openings in the food prep area must be sealed. The washroom ventilation fan is not working.

headline: Missing splashguard; dirty floor drain
summary: A washable splashguard must be installed between the cafe handsink and the three-compartment sink. Plates above dry storage must be inverted after sanitizing. The floor drain under the three-compartment sink has dirt and debris.

headline: Debris in soda cooler; unused equipment, clutter
summary: The interior of the soda refrigerator has accumulated debris. Old, unused equipment is in the middle prep and customer service areas. The restroom has no covered receptacle, and the basement has excessive clutter that must be elevated and organized.

headline: Missing handwash sign; items not elevated
summary: A handwash sign or poster is missing near the exposed handsink in the front food prep area. Stored items in the rear prep and storage area must be raised off the floor, and cardboard and paper shelf liners must be replaced. Dust is on a washroom vent.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: The food service sanitation manager did not have an allergen training certificate on site. The manager was instructed to meet this requirement.

headline: Grooved cutting boards; bar floor needs cleaning
summary: Large cutting boards in the rear area have dark stains and deep grooves and must be repaired or replaced. The bar area floor has dirt, debris and standing water under equipment and must be cleaned. The chef-manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Cloth liners removed; water-damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Prep area wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizing solution; management provided it. Cloth towels used as shelf liners were removed by management. Water-damaged ceiling tiles in the dining room must be replaced.

headline: No valid certified manager while preparing food
summary: A person in charge without a valid original city certificate was on site preparing TCS food, including chicken and gyros; citation issued. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables, and a two-door cooler has taped gaskets and broken handles.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; several repairs
summary: The rear exit door is not rodent-proof and must be fixed to prevent pest entry. Slicing equipment had dried food debris, the three-compartment sink faucet neck leaked, and a wall base is broken in several rooms.

headline: Missing handwash sign and several storage issues
summary: A handwash sign is missing in the basement prep area, and a hair restraint was not worn during food prep. Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables, and basement items must be raised off the floor. Covered waste receptacles and a self-closing door are required, and personal belongings are stored under food shelving.

headline: 70 rodent droppings; cold food at unsafe temps
summary: About 70 small rodent droppings were scattered across the premises; citation issued, and pest elimination is required. TCS food at 48.5-55°F was discarded, about $300 worth; a two-door cooler at 58°F was tagged. Mold-like buildup was noted in an upright cooler.

headline: Rust in ice machine; missing allergen training
summary: The interior sides of the ice machine have rust deposits that must be removed. Black crates are used to store utensils and must be replaced with easy-to-clean containers. Ceramic cups need lead-safe documentation or removal, and managers lack allergen training.

headline: Food on floor; grease buildup; training gaps
summary: Food containers and single-use items were stored on the floor and not inverted. Floors under equipment and in corners had grease and debris. Also missing: a covered feminine hygiene receptacle, cleaning of dusty vents, and an allergen certificate for the manager.

headline: Ice stored in grocery bags; duct tape repairs
summary: Ice used for people to consume was stored in plastic grocery bags and must be moved to washable or food-grade containers. Duct tape was used to repair a cooler door and a flour container lid. Other items include cardboard shelf liners and a restroom door that does not self-close.

headline: Cooler too warm; food discarded, unit tagged
summary: Meats in the front three-door cooler measured 47.5-51.4°F; about 15 pounds were discarded. The cooler was tagged and cannot be used until reinspected. No certified manager was on site while TCS food was prepared, and food handler certificates were expired.

headline: Basement floors need cleaning and raising items
summary: All basement floors must be cleaned, and items must be raised off the floor so the area can be cleaned and monitored for pests. No pests were noted in this reinspection.

headline: 500+ rodent droppings; cooler food too warm
summary: Over 500 rodent droppings and two live cockroaches were found; citation issued and pest control is needed. Cold foods were held at 53.7-60.1°F; about 5 pounds were discarded and two coolers were tagged. Handwash sinks lacked soap and paper towels.

headline: No person in charge; no certified manager on duty
summary: No person in charge was present at inspection; priority violation, no citation. No certified food manager with a city certificate was on duty while TCS food was prepared and served; the person in charge must have one by next inspection. Serving plates were not inverted, and allergen certificates were missing.

headline: No certified manager; milk too warm; drain backups
summary: No city certified food service manager was on premises; citation issued. Milk at 48.9°F was discarded and corrected on site. Wastewater backed up from the grease trap and floor drain when the three-compartment sink drained; citation issued. No chlorine test kit was available.

headline: Handsink at 70°F; frozen shrimp thawed improperly
summary: The beverage prep handsink had no hot water and measured 70°F; it must provide at least 100°F. Frozen shrimp was thawing on a shelf under a prep table. Small gaps at the rear and screen doors must be rodent-proofed. Cold units have food residue inside.

headline: No sanitizer test strip; loose cooler gasket
summary: There was no sanitizer test strip on site; a chlorine test strip must always be available; citation issued. A milk cooler has a loose door gasket that must be repaired. Ceiling fans above the three-compartment sink are dusty and dirty.

headline: No barrier to rear kitchen; non-food-grade bags
summary: The rear kitchen has no door or barrier, so customers can easily access the prep area; one must be installed. An ice cream scoop was stored in standing water at room temperature. Non-food-grade bags were used to store food in the prep cooler.

headline: Can opener grimy; grease inside fryer door
summary: A can opener attached to a prep table has food debris and a black substance and must be deep cleaned and sanitized. Grease has built up inside the fryer door and must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager while chicken prepared
summary: No certified food manager or valid certificate was on site while chicken was prepared and served; citation issued. The person in charge lacked the certificate. The rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap and is not rodent or insect proof. Hair restraints were missing, and fryers were thickly greased.

headline: Walk-in cooler at 47.6°F; meats discarded
summary: Hamburgers at 46.5°F and marinated skirt steak at 45.1°F were discarded, about 10 pounds, worth $75; citation issued. The walk-in cooler measured 47.6°F and was tagged for repair. Handwashing signs are missing, and gaskets on two coolers are torn.

headline: No certified food manager during food prep
summary: No certified food manager was on site while ham, ground beef and hot dogs were being prepared; citation issued. Also missing: a signed employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure, probe thermometer, and pest control log. Toilet-room handwash sink had no hot water.

headline: Unlabeled bulk sugar found; labeling required
summary: Bulk sugar was stored in a container without a label. The operator must provide labels. No other problems were noted in this canvass inspection.

headline: Raw-food menu disclosure missing; leaks, rust
summary: Menu lacked asterisks and disclosure for animal-derived foods served raw; priority violation, no citation. Openings at revolving door corners must be sealed. Rust is on walk-in cooler shelves, and three-compartment sink pipes leak. Ceiling tiles are stained and holes need repair.

headline: Rat droppings; food held too warm; citations
summary: Rat droppings were found by the waste oil container; citation issued. Cooked chicken held at 126.4-129°F was discarded, and about 900 pounds of cold food at 47.7-54°F was discarded. The walk-in cooler and freezer were repaired during inspection. No valid manager certificate was on site.

headline: Incomplete raw-food advisory on menus
summary: Menus lacked a complete consumer advisory about raw or undercooked foods; priority violation. A quarter-inch gap under the front door must be sealed to keep pests out. Also: a broken three-compartment sink stopper, greasy hood filters, and a food handler without a certificate.

headline: Raw wood at counter; prep area buildup
summary: Raw wood at the front service counter must be painted or sealed to be easy to clean. Food prep areas have dirt and small debris under and around equipment and must be cleaned.

headline: No certified food manager on premises
