summary: No city certified food manager or valid sanitation certificate was on premises while TCS food was handled and served; priority violation with citation. No signed employee health policy or training was on site. Earlier violations, including manager allergen training, were not corrected.

headline: Two coolers failed; tagged, not to be used
summary: An upright prep cooler held food at 48.0°F, and the walk-in cooler was not working. Both were tagged and must not be used until repaired and reinspected by the city health department. Freezers and gaskets were dirty, and the manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Mold-like substance in ice machine; sink set up
summary: A black mold-like substance was found on a panel inside the ice machine; manager must clean and sanitize it. The three-compartment sink was not set up for washing, rinsing, and sanitizing; staff set it up during inspection. Floor tiles and a faucet need repair.

headline: Pest device above sink; plastic bowls as scoops
summary: Passed. A pest control device was installed above the handwashing sink and clean equipment and must be relocated. Plastic bowls were used as scoops in bulk dry storage and must be replaced with handled utensils.

headline: Dirty self-serve drink station and restroom
summary: Complaint inspection passed. The counter at the self-serve drink station needs cleaning, as does the inside of the cabinet below. Restroom fixtures need cleaning and maintenance. Rear and walk-in cooler floors need spill and debris cleanup.

headline: Unlabeled containers; door gap and peeling paint
summary: Bulk containers in the rear prep area are unlabeled. A 1/2-inch gap at the front door bottom must be closed to prevent rodent entry. Low water pressure at the three-compartment sink, peeling paint, and clutter in dry storage also need attention.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen training; repeat violation
summary: A core violation from an earlier inspection was not corrected. Expired food handler records were on site, and certified food managers lacked allergen training. Citation issued. Staff must provide and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Small flies found in dining and kitchen areas
summary: About 15 small flies seen in the customer seating area, order area, near restrooms, and in the kitchen. Consult pest control before re-inspection. The all-gender restroom lacks a covered bin for sanitary napkins.

headline: Food handler without effective hair restraint
summary: A food handler with long braids lacked an effective hair restraint. The worker was instructed to wear one.

headline: Cardboard shelf liner in beverage cooler
summary: Passed. Cardboard was used as a shelf liner in the beverage walk-in cooler. It must be removed so the surface is smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Uncovered containers; food on floor; no hair nets
summary: Passed. Bulk containers are unlabeled and one is uncovered in prep. Food is stored on the walk-in cooler floor. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Single-service items were on the storage floor, and ceiling tiles are stained.

headline: Foil lining on cooking equipment
summary: Foil was used as a liner on cooking equipment at the front prep line. It must be removed so the surface is smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Cutting board with deep grooves and stains
summary: Passed re-inspection. The cutting board on the main cook line has deep grooves and dark stains. It must be sanded and resealed or replaced.

headline: Re-inspection: no certified food service manager
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. No certified food service manager was on site while chicken and beef were handled. The operator was instructed to obtain one. Citation issued as a priority foundation violation.

headline: Expired allergen training; leaking handsink
summary: Passed. Unsealed wood under the bar handsink, torn walk-in gaskets, and a leaking bar handsink basin need repair. Dirt and grime are under cooking equipment and on the hood. One manager has expired allergen training and another has none.

headline: Hand washing failures; hot food discarded
summary: Complaint inspection failed. A food handler handled garbage, food, and gloves without washing hands; citation issued. Handsink water was 33.8F and 40.3F; hot food at 104.3-110.1F was discarded. A restroom faucet needs repair and a freezer gasket is worn.

headline: Slow-draining handsink; no allergen certificate
summary: Passed. A handsink in the rear prep area drains slowly and must be repaired. A certified food service manager lacked an allergen training certificate on site; the operator was told to ensure training.

headline: No sanitation certificate; dumpster overflowing
summary: The person in charge has no City sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was on site while chicken wings and pizza were handled; citation issued. Dumpster overflowing with trash on the ground, a food source for rodents; citation issued.

headline: Gap under front door could let pests in
summary: A 1/4-inch gap under the front entry door needs repair to prevent pests. Cutting boards must be replaced. Walk-in cooler shelves and interior, freezer floor, and several floors need detail cleaning. Restroom needs a lidded trash can.

headline: No certified manager; food too warm; flies found
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on site while open. Hot fish and chicken at 95-100F and cold foods at 50-53F were discarded (about 35 lbs). About 12 flies were seen throughout the facility, and three sticky traps held 15 or more dead flies above prep tables.

headline: Complaint passed; dusty cooler and dirty floors
summary: Dust has built up on the condenser of a prep cooler and must be cleaned. The hot water tank room floor has dirt buildup, and pantry walls have food debris. Management must clean and maintain these areas.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets and loose sink faucet
summary: Torn gaskets were found at the bottom of a two-door reach-in cooler. A handwashing sink faucet in the juice bar is loose. Both must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Chipped kitchen paint near hot holding
summary: Passed. Chipped paint on kitchen walls near the hot holding area and cutlery pickup must be resurfaced and repainted to be smooth and cleanable.

headline: No backflow device on coffee station waterline
summary: Passed. No backflow prevention device was found on the waterline at the coffee and tea station; one must be provided and maintained. Clutter and items on the floor in the basement boiler room should be raised six inches to prevent pest harborage.

headline: No certified manager; no current pest log
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were prepared and served. Blank employee health policy copies were found. No current pest control logbook was on site. Citation issued. Bulk flour and sugar containers were unlabeled.

headline: Sink backs up; drain and plumbing problems
summary: Water backs up into two basins of the three-compartment sink; manager must repair before re-inspection (no citation). Restroom handsink drain pipe is wrapped in foil and tape. Espresso and ice machines lack backflow devices.

headline: Grocery bags used for food storage in freezer
summary: Food was stored in grocery bags in the walk-in freezer; food-grade containers are required. Grease spills on the outside of a fryer must be cleaned. A soap dispenser mounted above the three-compartment sink must be removed.

headline: Unfinished wood shelving and ceiling holes
summary: Shelving and the backs of shelving units in the front prep area are unfinished wood and must be finished. The rear utility sink needs a backflow device. Multiple holes in the restroom ceiling must be sealed.

headline: Re-inspection: torn gasket; broken urinal; no training proof
summary: Re-inspection passed. A torn gasket on the cook line two-door cooler must be replaced. A broken urinal in the washroom must be repaired or removed. Required employees lacked food handler training proof and must provide it.

headline: No certified manager; leaks, grease, and clutter
summary: No City certified food service manager was on premises; citation issued. Basement walk-in cooler has a leaking compressor and debris buildup. Grease and food debris are on kitchen floors and cooking equipment. Clutter in the basement could harbor pests.

headline: Hands not washed between tasks; citation issued
summary: Passed with conditions. A food handler did not wash hands between tasks and touched ready-to-eat fruit with a glove after handling a wiping cloth; citation issued. An ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine, and the ice shield needs cleaning.

headline: Dirty floors in prep, dish, and storage areas
summary: Floors along wall bases in prep and dish areas and in the walk-in freezer have debris buildup. Grease, food debris, and dirt are on floors under cooking equipment and in corners of prep, dish, and storage areas. Management must clean all areas.

headline: Oversized pots need written cleaning procedure
summary: Extra-large pots that cannot be fully submerged in the three-compartment sink need a written clean-in-place procedure, which the operator was told to provide. Certified food managers lack allergen training certificates and must obtain them.

headline: Dead bugs and spider webs on walls
summary: Passed. Dead bugs and spider webs were found on rear walls and must be cleaned. Cooking equipment was not under the ventilation hood and must be moved. Toilet interiors need cleaning.

headline: Public summary not posted; citation issued
summary: Passed with conditions. No inspection summary was posted for public view from the previous inspection. A new summary was left and must be posted. Citation issued.

headline: Improper hot and cold holding; food discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. BBQ chicken at 117.1F and raw pork, raw beef, and cooked sausage above 41F were discarded, about 50 lbs total. A line cooler at 47F was adjusted and its tag removed. Missing food handler certificates for all staff.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; no food handler certificates
summary: Passed with conditions. The low-temperature dish machine in the coffee prep area sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine; citation issued. No food handler certificates were on the premises. Mop sink room needs cleaning and organizing.

headline: No allergen training proof; drink menu issue
summary: Passed. No proof of allergen training was on site for a City food service manager. The children's menu lists apple juice and fountain drinks; it must offer an approved drink such as 100% juice or milk.

headline: Front door gap; walk-in and fryer filter need cleaning
summary: Passed with conditions. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the front doors must be repaired to prevent pests. Walk-in cooler floors need spill cleanup and the fryer filter needs cleaning. Allergen training remains a repeat violation.

headline: No certified manager; rear door not rodent-proof
summary: No certified food manager with a valid certificate was on site while chicken, sauce, and ham were prepared. Signed employee health policies were missing. The rear exit door is not rodent-proof and a wall hole needs sealing. Citation issued.

headline: Expired food handler certificates
summary: Passed. Food handler certificates for new employees must be updated, as some are expired.

headline: Cooked rice above 41F; 10 lbs discarded
summary: Passed with conditions after complaint. Cooked rice was at 47.8F in the walk-in cooler; manager discarded 10 lbs. Citation issued. Salt and sugar were out of labeled containers. Food on the walk-in floor must be raised; no allergen training on site.

headline: No backflow device on ice machine
summary: Passed. No backflow prevention device was found on the ice machine in the rear prep area; one must be installed. The all-gender employee restroom lacks a covered sanitary receptacle. Damaged baseboards and debris under freezers also noted.

headline: Rust spot and grease under grill
summary: Passed. A rust spot on the bottom shelf of a prep table must be removed. Grease and particles under the grill need cleaning. Floors and walls around sinks and equipment need cleaning.

headline: Mouse droppings in back storage; unapproved vacuum packing
summary: About 50 mouse droppings on the back storage floor and hallway; more pest control needed. Vacuum-packed meat was stored without a health-department-approved HACCP plan (a food-safety plan). A food handler lacked training. Drain leak under a sink needs repair.

headline: Food handler hair not restrained; clothing near food
summary: Passed. A food handler with long hair lacked a hair restraint. Employees' personal clothing was stored on a shelf with food containers and must be moved.

headline: No certified food manager on premises
summary: No City-certified food service manager was on site, and no vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies were available. Also noted: no handwashing signs, undisclosed raw or undercooked animal foods on the menu, and two nonworking restroom handsinks.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies; no sneeze guard
summary: Failed. Vomit and diarrhea procedure was on site, but cleanup materials were not. Citation issued. A toaster on the bar prep area lacks a sneeze guard to block contamination from customers.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; sink leak
summary: Passed. Bulk food containers in the kitchen are unlabeled. Soiled wiping cloths were left on prep tables. A minor leak under the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Rear storage room has clutter.

headline: No certified manager for 65 minutes; no certificates
summary: No certified manager was on site from 8:15 to 9:20 a.m. while chicken and other TCS foods were prepared. No food handler certificates or allergen training were on site. An employee ate and drank in the prep area. Citation issued.

headline: Cold foods above 41F; missing health policy and training
summary: Passed with conditions. No written employee health policy was on premises. Cold foods in prep coolers were too warm, including eggs at 57F, cheese at 56F, and chicken at 46F; citation issued. Several food handlers lacked food handler certificates.

headline: Dirty furnace room floor
summary: Floors inside the furnace room are not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Walls missing wall base in kitchen
summary: Walls throughout the front prep bar area and main kitchen lack a wall base. Management must provide and maintain bases to prevent pest harborage.

headline: One employee lacked food handler training
summary: Re-inspection passed. One employee lacked food handler training. All employees must complete training and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Rusty cooler surfaces; grease on fryers; leaks
summary: Passed. Rusted cooler floors and shelves need restoring. Fryers have encrusted grease and debris. A handsink next to the three-compartment sink leaks at the faucet. Hood filters are greasy and dusty. No food handler or allergen training proof on site.

headline: Fryers, freezers, and walls need cleaning
summary: Fryer interiors have grease, dirt, and food buildup. Freezer lower surfaces have food and dirt debris. Floors and a floor drain are soiled, rear storage walls have a mold-like substance, and the restroom trash can lacks a lid.

headline: Greasy kitchen; food debris and spills on floors
summary: Passed. Grease covers cooking equipment, walls, floors, and shelving in kitchen and prep areas. Food debris and spills are on floors throughout. Management must degrease, clean, and increase cleaning frequency.

headline: Sewage backup; prep continued until plumber fixed
summary: Waste water came out of two drains in the main prep area, and food handlers kept preparing food while tracking sewage through prep and dining areas. Citation issued. A plumber arrived and corrected the drain lines.

headline: Re-inspection: no certified manager; grease and leaks
summary: Passed re-inspection, but citation issued: no certified food manager was on site while pork, beef, and eggs were prepared. Also: grease under fryers, dusty hood, dried food debris on equipment, a leaking three-compartment sink pipe, and expired allergen certificates.

headline: Rodent droppings and dead cockroaches found
summary: About 30 to 35 rodent droppings and about 5 dead cockroaches were found in several areas, including the HVAC closet and storefront. Pest control is required. Also: no vomit and diarrhea kit, no hand soap or paper towels at a sink, and no food thermometer.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; no mop sink faucet
summary: Passed with conditions. Bulk containers in rear prep are unlabeled. The mop sink has no faucet with hot and cold water, which must be provided. The last inspection summary was not posted for public view; citation issued.

headline: Cooler too warm; tagged; sink pipe leaking
summary: Passed with conditions. A two-door cooler is at 56F and cannot hold cold food; it is tagged and must not be used until repaired and reinspected. A leak under the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Other refrigeration is in use.

headline: Dried food residue on can opener; greasy hood filters
summary: Passed. A can opener attached to a table is covered in dried food residue and must be cleaned or replaced. The microwave needs cleaning, and hood filters above cooking equipment have grease buildup.

headline: Rodent droppings; bare hands on food; failed dish machine
summary: Failed. About 75 or more mouse and rat droppings were found in the fryer cabinet, bar, basement, liquor room, and audio room. Bare-hand contact with limes; a dish machine at 0 ppm was tagged. Vacuum-packed food lacked an approved HACCP plan.

headline: Bare-hand food contact; chicken wings too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. An employee touched ready-to-eat food with bare hands, and about 15 lbs of fried wings were discarded. Two containers of chicken wings held at 48.3-53.0F; about 40 lbs discarded. Also noted: unlabeled containers and dirty microwave.

headline: Leaking handsink; food stored on cooler floor
summary: A handsink in the dishwashing area leaks during use, making it hard to access; citation issued. Food was stored on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised six inches. Milk crates are used for storage and must be replaced.

headline: Food prepared without certified manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions. The person in charge lacked proof of food safety training. Food handlers prepared TCS foods without an original certified food manager certificate on site; citation issued. A certified manager must be on site during food prep and operating hours.

headline: No sanitation certificates; burnt restroom light
summary: The person in charge and food handlers lacked City sanitation certificates while handling TCS foods such as hamburgers and eggs. Citation issued. A food handler lacked training. A burnt-out light fixture inside the restroom must be repaired.

headline: About 100 rodent droppings in storage and restrooms
summary: About 100 rodent droppings were found in the rear storage area and toilet rooms. Pest control service is recommended; citation issued. Restrooms lack covered receptacles, and wall holes in dry storage and restrooms must be sealed.

headline: Missing grout in dishwashing floor tiles
summary: Floor tiles in the dishwashing area are missing grout. Management must repair and maintain them.

headline: Dish machine leaking; food debris on equipment
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Food debris is on the outside of the dish machine, coolers, and shelves. The three-compartment sink leaks at the faucet base. Dust has built up on prep area ceiling tiles.

headline: Re-inspection passed; cutting boards and grease need work
summary: Passed re-inspection. Worn cutting boards must be replaced. Oversized pots do not fit the three-compartment sink, so a written cleaning procedure or smaller pots are required. Heavy grease in the hood, dirty coolers, and a broken restroom faucet also noted.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea kit on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No kit was on site for vomit and diarrhea cleanup; a kit with norovirus-effective sanitizer must be kept on site. Citation issued. To-go containers must be stored inverted and protected from dirt and dust.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies were on site to respond to events inside the facility. The operator was instructed to provide them. Priority foundation violation.

headline: Cold foods above safe temperature; food discarded
summary: Cooks line cooler was not holding cold: short ribs at 45F, cooked chicken at 43.8F, and raw squid at 56.5F. All food was discarded. The cooler was tagged and must not be used until repaired. Citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; leaking sink; no thermometer
summary: No certified food manager was on site; citation issued. Handwashing soap was missing at first (provided during inspection). No probe thermometer, no pest logbook, and a rear exit door that is not rodent-proof. A handwashing sink pipe leaks severely.

headline: No certified manager; repeat food handler violation
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were handled, and no employee had a certificate. Multiple food handlers lacked training. The repeat core violation was not corrected. Citation issued. A basement condensate line drips onto the floor.

headline: Wiping cloths on prep tables; rusty shelving
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were stored on food prep tables and must be kept in sanitizing solution. Rusty shelving in the walk-in cooler must be painted or replaced. Basement light shields need cleaning and burnt-out bulbs above a sink need replacing.

headline: Handwashing water too cool; cold food too warm
summary: Failed. Handwashing water was 89.6-93.4F; 100F is required. Salmon at 53.2F, milk at 45F, and half-and-half at 45.7F were discarded. A low-temperature dish machine at 0 ppm was tagged and must not be used. Two-door unit was repaired on site.

headline: Stained cutting boards; peeling kitchen floor paint
summary: Re-inspection passed. Cutting boards with dark stains and deep cuts must be refinished or replaced. Peeling paint under a rubber mat on the kitchen floor must be removed and repainted.

headline: No health policy or food handler certificates
summary: Passed with conditions. No verifiable employee health policy was on site; a template was left. A deli display cooler held food at 51F and was tagged and held for inspection. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: No manager on site; moldy pork; sewage backup
summary: No person in charge or certified manager was on site at first. Employees did not wash hands before preparing pork. Moldy pork (about 10 lbs) and eggs at 68F were discarded. Sewage backup at the three-compartment sink was corrected by a plumber. Restroom floors had standing water.

headline: Expired food handler cards
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Two food handler cards on site were expired. Employees must complete food handler training and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Ice scoop on machine; milk crates in use
summary: Re-inspection passed. An ice scoop was stored on top of the ice machine and must be kept in a clean container. Milk crates are used for elevation and must not be. Damaged wooden shelving under the rear prep table needs repair.

headline: Three-compartment sink backs up; wall damage
summary: Failed. Water backs up into the third basin when the middle basin drains; citation issued. Wall damaged around a utility box in the hall must be repaired. Clutter in the hall near the restroom must be removed.

headline: Rear door gap; dirty cooler; training proof missing
summary: The rear exit door has a 1/2-inch gap underneath and must be sealed and made rodent- and insect-proof. The interior of a reach-in cooler/freezer has dirt, stains, and ice buildup. Restroom door is not self-closing. Food handler proof missing.

headline: No thermometer in deli cooler; dim dry storage
summary: A two-door cooler in front prep holds deli meat without a thermometer and must have one. Dry storage closet lighting is inadequate and must be increased.

headline: No certified manager while pies and rolls served
summary: No City certified food manager was on premises while pies and rolls were prepared and served; citation issued. A certified manager must be present whenever TCS foods are prepared or served.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; flying insects found
summary: Dish machine was sanitizing at 0 ppm chlorine and is tagged held for inspection. About 30 live small flying insects were seen on walls, ceilings, and equipment in the bar and sushi area; pest control is needed. Citation issued.

headline: Broken stoppers at three-compartment sink
summary: Two of three built-in stoppers at the three-compartment sink are broken and cannot hold water. They must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Food stored on walk-in freezer floor
summary: Passed. Product was stored on the walk-in freezer floor and must be kept at least six inches off the floor. Cooler racks have dirt and food buildup. Restroom trash can lacks a lid; light shield and ventilation need attention.

headline: Dirty floors behind equipment
summary: Passed. Floors along wall bases and behind equipment, especially behind the front display cooler, must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Damp wiping cloths, soiled cooler, greasy floors
summary: In-use wiping cloths were left damp on counters; they must be kept in sanitizer or kept dry. Lower shelves of the deli display cooler have dried food debris. Floors around the grease trap under a sink are soiled with grease and dust.

headline: Hood lights not working above grill
summary: Lights in the exhaust hood above the rear grill are not functional and must be serviced to provide adequate lighting to the cooking area.

headline: Sink leaks, buildup, and missing backflow device
summary: Leaking faucet at the three-compartment sink and leaking drain pipe at the kitchen handwashing sink must be repaired. The utility sink has no backflow device. Sink buildup, plastic on a prep table, and missing hood filter were also noted.

headline: Food handlers lacked training; no public summary
summary: Two food employees lacked food handler training. The repeat allergen training violation was not corrected, and no public summary was posted (citation issued). Children's menu offers a fountain drink by default, which must follow state law.

headline: Dog in produce area; no hot water at sink
summary: A live dog was in the produce area, and live animals are not allowed where food is prepared; manager was told to remove it. The meat prep handsink had no hot water (74.5-81.3F; 100F required). The three-compartment sink leaks.

headline: Re-inspection: food storage and training gaps
summary: Re-inspection noted food stored in grocery bags in the walk-in freezer, a mop drying improperly, dirty overhead vents, and a certified food manager lacking an allergen training certificate.

headline: Rodent entry door; oil uncovered; repeat violations
summary: Failed. A door in the front food prep area has a small opening at the lower left and must be rodent-proofed. Plastic bowls were in a flour container and oil was uncovered. Missing allergen certificate. Repeat violations for unlabeled spices and no cleaning procedure.

headline: About 80 rat droppings in hallway and near coolers
summary: About 80 rat droppings were found under and around coolers, cooking equipment, sinks, and storage racks; pest control assistance was recommended. Citation issued. Also: staff without hair restraints, knives stored by the sink, and TCS foods in grocery bags in freezers.

headline: No certified manager; hot water failures; clogged sink
summary: No certified manager from 8:15 to 8:45 a.m. while chicken was prepared. Hot water was 72.5-78.5F at sinks; plumbers later fixed it to 113F at the three-compartment sink. Chicken at 49.2-52.4F and fish at 65-70F were held improperly. No hand soap or paper towels at sinks.

headline: Debris in warewashing area floor drains
summary: Floor drains in the warewashing area have debris and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Re-inspection passed; toilet room door not self-closing
summary: Re-inspection passed. The toilet room door has no self-closing device. Person in charge must install and maintain one.

headline: Passed with conditions; cold foods too warm; citation
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. Rice at 50°F, beans at 48°F, salsa at 48°F, and guacamole at 50°F held too warm. Front prep cooler air at 54°F. Torn cooler door gaskets; non-working washroom fan.

headline: Passed; cooler shelves, splatters, and dead light
summary: Passed. Build-up on walk-in cooler shelves, splatters on the wall near the taqueria window, and a burned-out light in the rear hot-holding unit. Management told to clean and repair.

headline: Passed with conditions; no health policy, holes in wall
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. No written employee health policy on premises. No handwashing signs at prep, dish, or server sinks. Unshielded sewer lines in garage storage. Holes in the north wall must be sealed.

headline: Failed; repeat roach evidence, gaps, leaking pipes
summary: Failed; citation issued. Repeat violation: about 30 or more live roaches in cracks at the service counter and a hole behind the reach-in freezer. Pest control required. Also: door gaps, leaking pipes, and worn gaskets.

headline: Failed; cold foods too warm; no sneeze guard
summary: Failed; citation issued. Ground pork (44.6°F) and diced chicken (50.2°F) in a display cooler were too warm; 10 lbs discarded. Reach-in prep cooler at 50°F was tagged. Pizza display lacks a sneeze guard.

headline: Passed; slimy floor drain and greasy equipment
summary: Passed. Heavy dark slime in the floor drain under the three-compartment sink. Microwave needs detailed cleaning. Dirt, grease, and food splatter on equipment sides and on floors and walls in the rear kitchen.

headline: Re-inspection passed; splash guard and rusty shelves
summary: Re-inspection passed. The bar handwashing sink lacked a left-side splash guard, which must be installed. Rust on meat locker walk-in shelving must be removed.

headline: Failed; over 100 mouse droppings found
summary: Failed; citation issued. Over 100 mouse droppings found in the bar, storage, fire pump, electrical, and utility rooms. Exterminator required. Also: food stored on floors, no food handler training, and a 1/4-inch door gap.

headline: Failed; cold food above safe temperature discarded
summary: Failed; citation issued. Cooked chicken (49.3°F), beef (48.8°F), and shrimp (56.9°F) in a prep cooler were too warm. About 30 lbs discarded, valued at $150. Also: no hair restraints and a torn cooler gasket.

headline: Failed; no certified manager during chicken prep
summary: Failed; citation issued. No certified manager on site while chicken was prepared. Handwashing sink hot water reached only 68°F (required 100-120°F). Expired food handler and allergen certificates; grocery bags used for freezing food.

headline: Re-inspection passed; no handwashing or training proof
summary: Re-inspection passed. No handwashing signs at front and rear bar sinks. Stained, deeply cut cutting boards. Greasy air fryer. Debris and branches near the enclosed refuse area. No proof of food handler training.

headline: Re-inspection passed; basement prep area issues
summary: Re-inspection passed. Basement food prep needs a handwashing sink with hot and cold water, or prep equipment must be removed. Also: cluttered outdoor stairwell area, a cracked freezer shelf, and a missing bathroom wall tile.

headline: Failed; previous wall violation not corrected
summary: Failed; citation issued. Previously cited rough, cracked brick wall in the bathroom was not fixed. It cannot be cleaned and sanitized after a bodily fluid event.

headline: Passed; dead insects in light shields, floor tiles loose
summary: Passed. Dead insects in light shields above the kitchen prep area. Unlabeled chopped peanut container, loose kitchen floor tiles, holes in the wall around the dishwashing area, and a damaged prep shelf.

headline: Passed with conditions; food too warm, no sanitizer
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. Refrigerated foods at 47-64°F, including egg whites at 64.3°F; about 32 lbs discarded. Bar dish machine had no sanitizer (0 ppm) and was taken out of use. Soap and towels were restocked during inspection.

headline: Re-inspection passed; missing ceiling tiles
summary: Re-inspection passed. Several ceiling tiles are missing throughout the facility, including the basement dish area and upstairs prep area. Management must replace them.

headline: Re-inspection passed with conditions; no manager on site
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions; citation issued. No valid manager certificate on site while hot dogs were handled. Sink basins in the second-floor prep area dirty. Missing and cracked floor tiles in the bar area.

headline: Re-inspection passed; greasy equipment, dusty ceiling
summary: Re-inspection passed. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, prep tables, and coolers. Dust and debris on front prep ceiling and attached ceiling vent covers.

headline: Passed with conditions; no original manager certificate
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. Manager certificate not on site during food preparation. Bread cut and stored unprotected on a freezer; wet wiping cloths; frozen food in plastic grocery bags; personal belongings near food.

headline: Failed; undercooked items lacked consumer advisory
summary: Failed; citation issued. Steak and ceviche could be ordered undercooked, with no consumer advisory. No handwashing sign at the front bar. Repeat violations: door gap, dirty kitchen floors, and manager without allergen training.

headline: Passed with conditions; dairy cooler too warm
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. Milk in the dairy cooler held at 53°F, above the 41°F limit; about 20 lbs discarded. Handwashing sink lacked soap and paper towels, which staff supplied during inspection.

headline: Failed; hot water too cool at restroom sink
summary: Failed; citation issued. Women's restroom hand sink hot water measured 81.7°F; required 100°F. Plumber unavailable. Also: no handwashing signs at the bar sink, no air thermometers in coolers, and unlabeled food containers.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager on duty
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. No person in charge present and no certified food manager on duty while rice, chicken, and beef were prepared and served. Cardboard shelf liners and dirty floors also noted.

headline: Passed; hole in rear door, greasy kitchen floor
summary: Passed. A hole in the lower corner of the rear exit door must be sealed. Grease and small debris under and around kitchen equipment. Grease buildup on hood filters.

headline: Passed; stained coolers, damaged wall, greasy filters
summary: Passed. Foil lining the bottom shelf of a prep table. Food stains and dirt on reach-in coolers. Badly damaged lower wall behind the mixer and sinking ceiling tiles. Grease on hood filters.

headline: Failed; greasy fryer, leaks, no pest logbook
summary: Failed. Large amounts of grease on a small fryer. No current pest control logbook. Leaks at the three-compartment sink and mop sink. Carpet in rear storage. No mechanical ventilation above the fryer. No allergen certificates.

headline: Failed; flies found; frozen food thawing in sink
summary: Failed; citation issued. About 6 large flies found. Frozen foods that must be kept cold were thawing in a sink with no running water. Also: a severe handwashing sink leak, a sink that cannot drain, and rusty prep tables.

headline: Passed with conditions; no paper towels in restroom
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. No paper towels at the men's restroom sink, though the person in charge supplied them during inspection. Ice machine interior dusty, soiled plastic wrap, and missing allergen training.

headline: Passed with conditions; no vomit cleanup supplies
summary: Passed with conditions. No procedures or supplies for responding to vomiting and diarrhea events; manager told to provide them. No waste receptacle at the basement prep handwashing sink.

headline: Passed; torn gasket and foil shelf liners
summary: Passed. A torn rubber gasket inside the prep cooler and foil lining the shelves. Inspector told staff to remove the foil and cardboard boxes to avoid pest hiding places.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager on duty
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. No certified food manager on duty while sandwiches, chopped salads, and soups were handled. Handwashing signs missing at the front prep and basement sinks.

headline: Passed; greasy dish machine and soda gun holder
summary: Passed. Greasy interior surfaces on the dish machine must be detail cleaned. The soda gun holder behind the bar must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Passed; leaking sink and dirty customer toilet
summary: Passed. Rear exterior door has a 1/4-inch gap. Middle prep handwashing sink leaks from a pipe under the basin. Customer restroom toilet covered in residue. Management told to repair and clean.

headline: Re-inspection passed; liners, gaps, missing certificates
summary: Re-inspection passed. Tin foil and plastic wrap used as shelf liners; open gaps at the dish room wall and threshold; no proof of allergen training for certified food managers.

headline: Passed; loose debris and dust on floors
summary: Passed. Loose debris, dirt, and dust buildup on floors and corners throughout the facility. Management must detail clean and increase floor cleaning frequency.

headline: Re-inspection passed; clutter and mold noted
summary: Re-inspection passed. Low water pressure at a grinder-area hand sink. Clutter in rear storage could harbor rodents. Dirt and food debris on floors and blackened mold on the second-floor sink wall.

headline: Re-inspection passed; unlabeled food, clutter, dirty floors
summary: Re-inspection passed. Unlabeled food in refrigeration units, food stored in tin cans, clutter that could hide pests, dirty floors under the stove and fryers, and food stains on walls.

headline: Failed; about 30 flies in food prep area
summary: Failed; citation issued. About 20 or more large flies and about 10 small flies found in the food prep area. Person in charge must call pest control. Rust on walk-in shelving; food stored on the freezer floor.

headline: Passed; no handwashing signs, dirty stove
summary: Passed. No handwashing signs at the hand sink in the prep area. The four-burner stove was not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Passed with conditions; no valid manager certificate
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. No valid City manager certificate on site while chicken, rice, and shrimp were prepared. Fly paper hung in dry storage must be removed. Microwave and walk-in shelves dirty.

headline: Re-inspection passed; crates, rust, and grease
summary: Re-inspection passed. Knives stored between equipment, crates used for food storage, rust on walk-in shelving, damaged cooler gaskets, and heavy grease on the wok station and coolers. Floors need grout and cleaning.

headline: Passed; unsafe scooping tools; greasy hood
summary: Passed. Handle-less bowls and to-go containers used to scoop food at the service coolers; tongs, spoons, or a ladle must be provided. Floors and hood, filters, and pipes have heavy dirt and grease.

headline: Failed; no health policy, cleanup kit, or hot water
summary: Failed; most items cited without citation. No employee health policy, no vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit, no cold-holding units, no pest logbook, and no sanitizer test strips. Restroom sink had no hot water (54.5°F).

headline: Passed; scoop in stagnant water; unlabeled flour
summary: Passed. An ice cream scoop was stored in stagnant water at the wait station; utensils must be stored in running water. Flour and cornmeal containers in the pizza prep area were unlabeled.

headline: Passed with conditions; food on floor, bowl used as scoop
summary: Passed with conditions. Packaged desserts stored on the floor; a bowl used to dispense cooked rice; food handlers without hair restraints; damaged cooler gaskets; leaking front sink faucet; missing lighting in walk-in cooler.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk containers, peeling paint
summary: Passed. Bulk containers in the prep area were unlabeled. Peeling paint on basement single-service storage walls must be repainted and sealed to be smooth and cleanable.

headline: Passed with conditions; food too warm, discarded
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. Salmon, chicken, shrimp, and steak in the prep cooler measured 44-46°F; they must be held at 41°F or below. About 20 lbs discarded, valued at $200.

headline: Passed with conditions; no written health policy
summary: Passed with conditions. No written employee health policy on the premises; a signed policy is required for each employee. Deep fryers greasy inside; certified manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: Passed with conditions; no sanitation certificate on site
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. No City of Chicago sanitation certificate on site. Walk-in cooler gasket damaged and loose. Person in charge lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: Passed; cleaning needed on cooking equipment
summary: Passed. Inspector asked for cleaning of the stove, deep fryer, convection oven, walk-in freezer floor, and grease buildup on ventilation hoods and filters.

headline: Passed with conditions; sink clogged, fixed on site
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. Handwashing sink between prep area and walk-in cooler was inaccessible and not draining. Manager cleared the drain clog during inspection. Mop improperly stored; walk-in cooler light out.

headline: Failed; no sanitizer, test kit, or probe thermometer
summary: Failed. No chemical sanitizer, sanitizer test kit, or food probe thermometer on site during the license inspection. Plastic delivery film left on equipment. No covered waste receptacle in the all-gender washroom.

headline: Passed; beard restraints and certificates missing
summary: Passed. Food handlers with beards lacked beard restraints. No food handler or allergen training certificates were on site. Milk crates were used to elevate stored items, which is not allowed.

headline: Passed; to-go desserts lack labels; leaking faucet
summary: Passed. To-go cake and pudding lacked the business name, address, and ingredient list. Deep fryers and wall-mounted vegetable slicer soiled. Rear kitchen one-compartment sink faucet leaks.

headline: Failed; no manager, food too warm, thawed in water
summary: Failed; citation issued. No certified food manager on site while preparing food. About 25 lbs rice at 53°F and other foods too warm, discarded. Beef and beans thawed in standing water. Food handler training missing for three employees.

headline: Passed with conditions; no health policy or vomit kit
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy on site; must include signed employee acknowledgement. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or written procedures on site.

headline: Passed with conditions; no manager certificate posted
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. No original City manager certificate posted and no proof of a manager on site while TCS foods were prepared, handled, and served.

headline: Passed; broken front window, unused freezer
summary: Passed. Broken front window with gaps next to the entrance must be repaired to prevent pests. Unused freezer must be removed. Littered floors under grocery racks, loose washroom wall covering, and dusty ceiling vent.

headline: Passed; cracked grease trap lid, dirty prep floors
summary: Passed. The floor grease trap has a cracked lid and must be repaired. Floors in the prep areas were dirty and must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk containers, door gap
summary: Passed. Unlabeled bulk containers in the rear. Damaged weatherstrip leaves a gap at the rear alley door. Rusty can opener on prep table. Basement storage needs organizing and items elevated six inches.

headline: Re-inspection passed; dusty employee bathroom vent
summary: Re-inspection passed. Dirty, dusty ceiling vent cover in the employee bathroom. Management was told to clean and maintain it.

headline: License re-inspection passed; signage and backflow
summary: License re-inspection passed. No handwashing signs at toilet room sinks. No backflow prevention device could be located on the ice machine, and one must be installed.

headline: Passed; damaged gasket, rust, leaking dish machine
summary: Passed. Damaged cooler door gasket, rust on walk-in cooler shelving, soap and towel dispensers placed away from the sink, and a dish machine leaking from multiple areas that needs service.

headline: Passed; no backflow device on ice machine
summary: Passed. Shelving by the dish machine and inside the walk-in cooler not clean. No backflow prevention device at the ice machine waterline; one must be provided where it can be serviced.

headline: Failed; about 200 rat droppings in basement
summary: Failed; citation issued. About 200 rat droppings on the basement storage room floor and on shelves of the liquor cabinet. About 30 live small flying insects in the basement. Additional pest control needed.

headline: Passed; aluminum foil around grease trap and pipes
summary: Passed. Aluminum foil was wrapped around the grease trap and pipes behind the griddle area. Manager was told to remove it.

headline: Passed; food stored on walk-in freezer floor
summary: Passed. Food was stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer. Staff were instructed to elevate it six inches.

headline: Failed; about 20 mouse droppings; expired training
summary: Failed; citation issued. About 20 mouse droppings on floors under the three-compartment sink, in the rear dry storage, and in the front prep and service areas. Forks and spoons not inverted. Allergen training expired for both managers.

headline: Failed; 40 to 50 live cockroaches found
summary: Failed; citation issued. About 40 to 50 live cockroaches near pipes in the water boiler and warewashing area, and about 5 on the floor under the sink and wok line. Operations ordered to stop until pest control service.

headline: Bartender handled lime wedges with bare hands
summary: Passed with conditions. A bartender touched lime wedges by hand and placed them in a customer's drink. The manager was told to stop bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food. A cup was used as an ice scoop.

headline: Re-inspection passed; signage, thermometers, door gap
summary: Re-inspection passed. Missing handwashing signs at the front sink, two coolers without internal thermometers, cooked beef covered while cooling, a gap at the rear screen door, and greasy cooking surfaces.

headline: Failed; no raw food advisory, cloths on prep tables
summary: Failed; citation issued. No consumer advisory on the menu for raw or undercooked eggs. Staff without hair restraints. Wiping cloths stored on prep tables. Torn cooler gasket. Basement clutter could harbor rodents.

headline: Re-inspection passed; restroom ventilation not working
summary: License re-inspection passed. Mechanical ventilation in the restrooms was not operating. Management must repair it.

headline: Failed; no certified manager; live flies found
summary: Failed; citation issued. No City certified food manager on premises while milk and cream were prepared. Live flies found: 5 in the prep area and 10 in rear storage. Hole above the mop sink; debris in sinks and on walls.

headline: Passed; hair and beard restraints needed
summary: Passed. A food handler wore no beard net, and another had long hair hanging out of the cap. Floors inside the walk-in cooler were not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; missing signage, thermometers, damaged gasket
summary: Passed. No handwashing signs in the prep-area toilet room, no ambient air thermometers in cold-holding units, and a damaged rubber gasket on a three-door prep cooler. Management told to fix each item.

headline: Passed; ice machine interior dirty
summary: Passed. Interior of the ice machine bin and interior guard had some dirt and were not clean. Person in charge told to detail clean and maintain.

headline: Re-inspection passed; basement ice machine backflow
summary: Re-inspection passed. No backflow prevention device on the basement storage area ice machine. Management must locate one or provide one for the ice machine water line.

headline: Passed; exposed sewer pipe from missing ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. An exposed sewer pipe is visible above the space between the prep table and cooking equipment because ceiling tiles are missing. Tiles must be replaced.

headline: Passed; slime inside ice machine, leaking drain
summary: Passed. Pink and black slime build-up inside the main prep area ice machine. Leak at the drain pipe below the three-compartment sink. Clean plates stored face up. No lid on women's trash can.

headline: Re-inspection passed; leaking faucet, no receptacle
summary: Re-inspection passed. Leaking faucet at the three-compartment sink must be repaired. No covered receptacle for sanitary products in the all-gender employee washroom in the office.

headline: Re-inspection passed; restroom door not self-closing
summary: License re-inspection passed. The restroom door does not self-close and must be repaired.

headline: Passed; food spills on floors, splatter on wall
summary: Passed. Floors throughout need cleaning to remove food spills. Wall behind the cooking equipment needs cleaning to remove splatter.

headline: Passed; ice machine interior, hand sink handle
summary: Passed. Clean the interior surfaces of the ice machine. Repair the hot water handle of the exposed hand sink in the dishwashing area. Cover and repair an opening in the wall beneath the three-compartment sink.

headline: Failed; no certified manager, soap, or pest records
summary: Failed; citations issued. No certified food manager on site while open. Front and rear prep sinks lacked soap. Pest control records dated 2022 with no current service report. Food handler certificates not on site.

headline: Re-inspection passed; mold caulking, missing ceiling tile
summary: Re-inspection passed. Blackened, moldy caulking around the front prep ice bin; dirty washbowl, shelving, floor drains, and floors; missing wall panel and ceiling tile above the walk-in cooler.

headline: Re-inspection passed; grease, residue, peeling paint
summary: Passed. Debris and residue on undersides of prep tables, peeling paint near the dish machine, and grease buildup in the kitchen hood system. Management was told to clean and repair.

headline: Passed with conditions; many cold foods too warm
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. Deli meats (49.8°F), cheese (51.3°F), soup (49.5°F), salads (48.5°F), and mozzarella (50.2°F) were too warm. Display cooler at 51.2°F. About 165 lbs discarded, valued at $3,500.

headline: Passed; mold-like growth on walk-in shelves
summary: Passed. A mold-like substance is building up on walk-in cooler shelving. Person in charge was told to detail clean and maintain.

headline: Failed; about 75 mouse droppings on display shelves
summary: Failed; citation issued. About 50 mouse droppings on chip display shelves and 25 on candy display shelves. Outside dumpster overflowing. Dust and debris on shelves, coolers, and floors; cluttered rear storage.

headline: Failed; no raw food advisory; repeat allergen violation
summary: Failed; citation issued. Menu lacked a consumer advisory for raw or undercooked animal foods. Dishwasher top, fryers, and bar sink need cleaning. Person in charge lacked allergen training; citation issued.

headline: Passed with conditions; bar sink tagged out of use
summary: Passed with conditions. Bar three-compartment sink tagged out of use because clear water drains from the floor drain and pools. A prep cooler door held shut with a rag; refuse area littered.

headline: Passed; missing thermometers, labels, expired training
summary: Passed. Thermometers must be provided for the rear and front coolers. Repackaged desserts and storage containers need labels. Missing splash guard, foil on shelves, and expired food handler and allergen training.

headline: Passed; door gap, food on floor, missing receptacles
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at front doors and food on the walk-in cooler floor. No handwashing signs, no covered washroom receptacles, and unlabeled bulk containers. Dust on the prep ceiling; no light in the basement freezer.

headline: Re-inspection passed; ice buildup, floors, paint
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food containers stored on the floor. Excess ice in the walk-in freezer and dirty reach-in coolers. Missing grout and damaged floor tiles. Stained ceiling tiles, chipped toilet room paint, and no covered receptacle in the all-gender washroom.

headline: Failed; about 55 mouse droppings found
summary: Failed; citation issued. About 55 mouse droppings found across prep, washing, storage, and cleaning areas. Additional pest control needed. Also: food stored on floors, holes in walls, and no allergen training.

headline: Re-inspection passed; dirt on ceiling and walls
summary: Re-inspection passed. Dirt and a black substance on the ceiling above the meat cutting tables. Dirt and debris on walls behind the basement juice-prep handwashing sink must be cleaned.

headline: Re-inspection passed; openings, freezer gasket, hood
summary: Re-inspection passed. Openings at the base of the rear exit door must be sealed. Damaged walk-in freezer door gasket. Hood light out and dust and grease on hood filters.

headline: Passed; rear door gap and toilet room door
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the rear exterior door, a toilet room door that does not self-close, and no covered receptacle for sanitary products. Management told to repair.

headline: Failed: moldy ice machine, food held too cool
summary: Canvass failed. Kitchenware was rinsed but not sanitized at a basement sink before air drying. Ice machine lid had pink and brown mold dripping into ice used for drinks. Pasta measured 78°F and was discarded. Several TCS foods lacked date labels.

headline: Plastic cups stored on basement floor
summary: License inspection passed. Boxes of plastic cups used for coffee were stored on the basement floor. Manager must provide shelving or store items at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Cracked floor tiles near rear exit
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Cracked and damaged floor tiles at the rear of the prep area, near the exit, must be repaired to create a smooth, easily cleaned surface.

headline: Damaged wall tiles and dusty ceiling
summary: Re-inspection passed. Damaged and missing wall tiles in the meat prep area must be replaced. Dust on ceiling tiles and vents in the prep area must be cleaned and kept clean.

headline: Foods held over 24 hours without dates; discarded
summary: Canvass with conditions. Ready-to-eat TCS foods, such as crab rangoon, cooked noodles, and rice, were held in a reach-in cooler over 24 hours without dates. The manager discarded all of these foods during inspection. No handwashing sign.

headline: Failed: over 200 mouse droppings; no handsink
summary: Canvass failed. Over 200 mouse droppings on floors, shelves, and equipment, plus two dead mice. Rear prep area has no handwashing sink. Restroom sink water measured 57°F, below the 100°F minimum. About 7 pounds of cold food were discarded.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; dish machine at 0 ppm
summary: Canvass failed. No person in charge present. Manager showed a ServSafe certificate, not a city certificate, while TCS foods were prepared. Low-temperature dish machine measured 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged. Food handler and allergen training missing.

headline: Unlabeled bulk ingredients; expired food handler cards
summary: Re-inspection passed. Bulk dry ingredients in basement and cook line containers lack common-name labels. Wiping cloths stored on cutting boards and tables. Expired food handler certificates must be renewed for all employees.

headline: No certified manager; expired food handler certificates
summary: Canvass with conditions. No valid city sanitation certificate on site during inspection. Food handler certificates expired. No covered receptacle for feminine hygiene products in restroom. Damaged wall next to three-compartment sink.

headline: Failed: greasy floors, no hair restraints
summary: Canvass failed. Female food handlers in the front prep area were not wearing hair restraints. Cooking equipment interiors had charred food and grease. Floors are greasy and slippery. The certified manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Missing health policy; summary not posted
summary: Canvass with conditions. No verifiable employee-acknowledged health policy on site. Missing handle on deep freezer. Summary report from 2/3/23 was not displayed to the public and must be visible at all times.

headline: No certificate posted; handsinks blocked
summary: Complaint with conditions. No city food sanitation certificate was posted. A certified manager must be present whenever TCS foods are prepared. Several handsinks were not accessible, including one holding bleach and cups. Allergen training proof missing.

headline: Failed: about 100 live cockroaches in basement
summary: Canvass failed. About 100 live cockroaches in a basement cabinet, plus live roaches in kitchen prep, coolers, and basement storage. Additional pest control service is needed. Also noted: missing signs, a gap under front door, and missing thermometer.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings found in five areas
summary: Canvass failed. About 20 or more mouse droppings at each of five locations in prep, dishwashing, and basement storage areas. Manager must call an exterminator and clean. Also: employee drinking open coffee, ice machine residue, and missing menu advisory.

headline: Food debris and spills under shelving
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Food debris and spills found on shelving in front prep. Must detail clean under all shelving units and remove spills, food debris, and dirt buildup at all times.

headline: Multiple temperature violations; food discarded
summary: Canvass with conditions. Cooked chicken at 121.6°F in hot-holding unit and about 35 pounds of cold foods at 45°F to 68.9°F were discarded. Several units were too warm and tagged held for inspection. Gaps under doors and missing thermometers noted.

headline: Dirty ice bin, rusty shelves, and cooler walls
summary: Re-inspection passed. Top inside of ice bin was not clean and must be cleaned and sanitized. Rust on freezer doors and cooler shelves, a gashed backsplash, a loose door handle, and dirty cooler walls were also noted.

headline: Failed: no certificate, no hot water at prep sink
summary: Canvass failed. No one on site held a posted city food sanitation certificate. No employee health policy, no hot water at prep handsink, and no metal thermometer or test kit. Food handler training proof missing. Dusty hood filters.

headline: Debris by dumpster; food under heavy equipment
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Debris around the dumpster area must be cleaned and maintained. Dried and loose food debris under and behind heavy equipment throughout must be detail cleaned.

headline: Missing soap and hot water; greasy outdoor bin
summary: Canvass with conditions. Soap missing at two handsinks, corrected on site. Dish area hot water was below 80°F and was restored before inspection ended. Greasy outside grease container, which was cleaned on the return visit. Several other upkeep issues.

headline: Missing thermometers, labels, and clutter
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Coolers need visible thermometers. Store-made desserts lacked ingredient lists. Rusty walk-in racks and worn cutting board need repair. Missing ceiling tiles over dish sink; basement clutter must be removed.

headline: Dirty floors, walls, and dishwashing area
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Prep and dishwashing floors and walls need cleaning, with debris or black substance noted. Water on dishwashing floor must be cleaned and kept dry. Cooking-area hood filters are dirty.

headline: No hair restraints; missing handwashing signs
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Employees preparing food without hair restraints. Missing handwashing signs near employee washroom sink. Wiping cloths stored on prep tables. Torn gasket on prep cooler. Certified manager lacks allergen training proof.

headline: Bare-hand contact with lettuce; missing soap
summary: Canvass with conditions. A food handler touched lettuce with bare hands; the employee washed hands and wore gloves during inspection. Two bar handsinks lacked hand-washing signs. Front handsink lacked soap and towels, corrected on site.

headline: Failed: over 200 mouse droppings and flies
summary: Complaint failed. Over 200 mouse droppings in kitchen, shelves, under sink, and storage areas. About 10 small flies at three-compartment sink and front dining area. Last pest service was March 2024. Black slime dripping from ice machine into ice.

headline: No summary posted; handwashing signs missing
summary: Re-inspection with conditions. Current inspection summary was not posted; a 2025 summary was posted instead until a new one was given. Two food handlers lacked hair restraints. No handwashing sign at rear prep sink.

headline: No mechanical ventilation in restroom
summary: License inspection passed. The restroom has no mechanical ventilation. The person in charge must provide and maintain mechanical ventilation in the restroom.

headline: Dirty cooking equipment, hood, and floors
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Cutting boards with dark stains must be resurfaced or replaced. Cooking equipment encrusted with food debris and grease. Floors and walls behind prep station need cleaning. Hood and filters must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: Complaint failed. No certified food manager on duty while fried chicken, fish, and other TCS foods were prepared. About 40 or more mouse droppings in walk-in cooler and behind food containers. No vomiting cleanup procedure. No food handler training.

headline: No handwashing sign; dusty hood; allergen gap
summary: Canvass inspection passed. No handwashing sign in washroom. Dust buildup on hood framework above pizza oven must be cleaned. Food service sanitation manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Dirty drains, fryers, and floors need cleaning
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Floor drains in prep, dishwashing, and bar areas have food debris and black or yellow buildup. Deep fryer openings need detail cleaning. Floors behind cooking equipment and under bar equipment also need cleaning.

headline: Failed: over 100 rat droppings found
summary: Complaint failed. Over 100 rat droppings on floors in storage closet, water heater closet, fryer cabinets, and prep areas. Manager must call an exterminator and clean all areas. Also: food on floors, no food handler training, leaking faucets.

headline: Failed: clogged floor drain overflowing
summary: Short-form complaint failed. A clogged rear floor drain overflowed with clear water. Hot water tank and ice machine lines drain into it. Management removed the water. Drain must be unclogged. Dusty light shields and corner floors need cleaning.

headline: Rust inside fridge; damaged basement wall
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Rust on the interior of a basement fridge near the compartment sink must be removed or the unit replaced. Damaged basement wall behind the toaster oven and microwave table must be repaired.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; no food handler proof
summary: Canvass failed. No certified sanitation manager on site while chicken nuggets and potato salad were prepared. Person in charge lacks certificate. No metal stem thermometer. No food handler training proof. Core violations from prior inspection not corrected.

headline: Leaking drain pipe and faucet need repair
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Leak found at the three-compartment sink drain pipe and at the front handwashing sink faucet head. The person in charge was instructed to repair and maintain both.

headline: No food handler or allergen training proof
summary: License re-inspection passed. No proof of food handler training for any food handler. No proof of allergen training for certified food managers. Training records must be kept on site at all times.

headline: Ice buildup on condenser in expo cooler
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Ice buildup on the condenser inside the expo cooler must be removed and kept clear.

headline: Failed: spoiled peppers, warm cooler, sewage backup
summary: Canvass failed. Red and green peppers had spoilage with white fuzzy growth; about 14 pounds discarded. Sliced tomatoes at 47°F and front cooler at 48°F, which was tagged. Mop sink does not drain properly. Rust on walk-in racks.

headline: Repeat violation: about 75 live flies found
summary: Re-inspection with conditions. Repeat violation: about 75 or more live small flies on ceilings and beams in dish and beverage areas, with some crawling under the bar counter. Manager was vacuuming them; pest control service was recommended.

headline: Torn gaskets; drip leak under sink
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Torn or worn gaskets on reach-in cooler across from cooking equipment must be replaced. Drip leak at pipe under three-compartment sink rinse and sanitizing basin must be repaired.

headline: No valid food manager certificate on site
summary: Complaint inspection. No valid City of Chicago food sanitation manager certificate was on site or posted, and the person in charge lacked one. Also found: food debris on prep-area floors and no allergen training certificate.

headline: Unlabeled food and 1/4-inch rear door gap
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Food in coolers, walk-in, and dry storage lacked name labels. A 1/4-inch gap under the rear exit door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Torn gasket on prep cooler. Expired food handler certificates.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Milk crates are used as shelving along walls in the front register area and north wall. They must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: About 300 pounds of food discarded; no HACCP plan
summary: Canvass with conditions. Raw beef, raw pork, and other TCS foods were vacuum-sealed without an approved HACCP plan. About 300 pounds discarded and equipment removed. Also noted: steak cooled covered, utensils stored improperly, and hot water problems corrected.

headline: Failed: no pest control log available
summary: Canvass failed. No pest control log book or service reports were available for inspectors to review. The unisex restroom trash receptacle has no lid. A valid, current pest control log is required on site.

headline: Missing freezer handle; loose tile; dusty vent
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Left door handle missing on two-door freezer. One loose wall tile at base of wall by reach-in cooler needs attaching. Dust inside vent above oven must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: no hot water; mouse droppings found
summary: Complaint failed. Sinks measured 63°F to 71.7°F; water heater was off and a plumber was called. About 50 mouse droppings under storage racks and chest freezer. Cooked fish at 111°F to 113°F was discarded.

headline: Water-damaged ceiling tiles above sales floor
summary: License inspection passed. Water-damaged ceiling tiles above the sales floor were found. The person in charge was instructed to repair and maintain them.

headline: No employee health policy or vomiting procedure
summary: License inspection with conditions. No employee health policy, and no written procedure or supplies for vomiting and diarrhea incidents. Front door was open without proper screening, which could let pests in. Raw wood on grill must be sealed or removed.

headline: Expired allergen certificate and several upkeep issues
summary: Canvass with conditions. Repeat violation: food allergen training certificate has expired. Also found: no handwashing sign, unlabeled bins, food stored on floor, greasy floors, a leaking faucet, and personal items stored with food.

headline: Unlabeled sliced cake; slow-draining sink
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Sliced cake in reach-in cooler lacks a common-name label. Handwashing sink in rear mop room drains slowly and needs repair.

headline: Milk crates used; heavy grease under equipment
summary: Re-inspection passed. Milk crates used to elevate food must be replaced with approved shelving. Excessive ice inside meat chest freezer must be removed. Heavy grease and dirt under and behind cooking and refrigeration units throughout the premises.

headline: Food stored on floor; burned-out light bulb
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Soda cases stored on walk-in cooler floor must be raised 6 inches. Ice scoop left uncovered on tray. Wiping cloths and knives stored improperly. Plates not inverted. Burned-out bulb at grill and fryer area.

headline: Failed: dirty equipment and cluttered walkway
summary: Canvass failed. Many items are dirty with food debris, including coolers, freezers, and dishwasher. Ceiling tiles are stained and missing. Food containers stored on walk-in floors. Clutter on rear walkway must be removed to prevent rodent harboring.

headline: Failed: no vomiting procedure or pest log
summary: License inspection failed. No procedures or supplies for vomiting and diarrheal events. No pest control log book was available; premises must be serviced by a licensed exterminator. Utility sink lacks a backflow device; washroom ventilation not operating.

headline: No certified manager during food preparation
summary: Canvass with conditions. No certified food manager with a city certificate was on duty while rice and chicken soups were prepared and served. A manager must be present whenever TCS foods are prepared. Rear bar sinks need cleaning.

headline: Dirty shelves, washroom lid, and wall cleaning
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Bottom shelves under the prep station are dirty. Washroom garbage can lid is missing. Walls behind prep table and floors along wall bases and corners need cleaning to remove spills and debris.

headline: Knives stored on prep area; cardboard liners
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Cook had no hair restraint. Knives stored between prep table and cooler. Wiping cloths not in sanitizing solution. Cardboard and tinfoil used as liners and food containers. Leaks at front handsink and under three-compartment sink.

headline: No hair restraints; leaking kitchen handsink
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Employees preparing food in the prep area had no hair restraints or other protection. Leakage at the bottom U-joint pipe of the kitchen handwash sink must be repaired.

headline: One certified manager's allergen training expired
summary: Canvass inspection passed. One of two certified food managers has an expired allergen training certificate. All certified managers must complete allergen training and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Failed: live flies, no hot water, open doors
summary: Canvass failed. About 50 small live flies were seen on walls, equipment, and in prep areas. A prep handsink had no hot or cold water during inspection. Dish machine sanitizer measured 0 ppm. Front and rear doors are not rodent-proof.

headline: No certified manager present; missing signs
summary: Canvass with conditions. No person in charge with a city certificate was present while TCS foods were handled. Missing handwashing signs at second-floor bars. Two bar dishmachines measured 0 ppm chlorine and were tagged. Gap at rear exit door.

headline: Unclean wire racks in walk-in cooler
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Wire racks inside the walk-in cooler are unclean and not smooth or easy to clean. They must be restored to a smooth, cleanable condition and maintained.

headline: Uncovered ingredient containers; wood elevation
summary: Re-inspection passed. Bulk dry ingredient containers under the rear prep table were uncovered. Sheet trays stored on floor beside walk-in cooler. Wood used to elevate containers must be sealed with food-grade paint. Debris on floors.

headline: Cardboard liners and debris by dumpster
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Ice scoop stored in ice bin. Torn cooler door gasket and cardboard used as shelf liners in prep area. Debris around dumpster and soiled mop heads not properly stored. Manager was instructed to correct these.

headline: No certified manager on site; signs missing
summary: Canvass with conditions. No person in charge with city certified manager training or original certificate was on site. No food employee with that training was present while raw chicken and sandwiches were prepared. Handsinks lack hand-washing signs.

headline: Duct tape repairs and unlabeled dry containers
summary: Re-inspection passed. Dry food containers, such as flour, must be labeled with common names. Duct tape on a two-door reach-in cooler door must be removed; the surface must be smooth. Food spills inside the reach-in freezer need cleaning.

headline: No hair restraints; greasy floors and dusty fans
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints. Grease, food debris, and dirt under cooking equipment and in corners of prep, dish, storage, and basement areas. Dust on fans, light shields, and vents.

headline: No certified manager; beef served without one
summary: Canvass with conditions. No person in charge had a valid city sanitation certificate. Beef at 148.9°F was prepared and served without a certified manager on site. Missing handwashing sign. Crates and cardboard used as shelving. No valid allergen training.

headline: Utility sink lacks backflow device
summary: Canvass inspection passed. No backflow preventer device is on the utility sink in the rear prep and dish area. The person in charge must install one so it can be located, serviced, and maintained.

headline: No hot water at handsink; food lacks dates
summary: Canvass with conditions. Rear handsink had no hot running water (76.1°F); maintenance restored it during inspection. Cheesecakes, pies, and chicken in coolers lacked date markings. Dated disposition labels are required for foods held over 24 hours.

headline: Re-inspection passed; minor upkeep issues
summary: Re-inspection passed. Unisex customer restroom lacks a covered waste receptacle for feminine hygiene products. A detached ceiling tile above the utility area must be reattached. Old food debris and spills need cleaning under soda dispenser.

headline: Sink leak, debris by dumpster, damaged ceiling
summary: License inspection passed. Leak at the three-compartment sink lower pipe connecting to the grease trap must be repaired. Debris around outside dumpster must be cleaned. Water-damaged ceiling tiles in prep areas must be replaced.

headline: Gap under rear door; greasy floors and coolers
summary: Canvass inspection passed. A half-inch gap under the rear door by the mop sink must be closed to rodent- and insect-proof it. Rubber gaskets on front coolers and freezers are in poor repair. Floors under fryers and in coolers need cleaning.

headline: Expired city certificate; rust on cooler shelves
summary: Canvass with conditions. Certificate on site was expired as of 1/14/24. A valid original certificate must be on site while open. No handwashing sign in restroom. Rust on cooler shelving near the three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Greasy equipment and floors; soiled cloths
summary: Re-inspection passed. Soiled wiping cloths were stored on prep tables. Grease and food debris found on cooking equipment, coolers, freezers, shelves, and floors. Soiled mop heads must be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Handwashing sign fixed on site; upkeep issues
summary: Missing handwashing sign at a second-floor bar sink was corrected on site. Also noted: a non-smooth basement access panel, dusty washroom vents cleaned on site, and non-working basement washroom lights that must be repaired.

headline: No three-compartment dishwashing sink installed
summary: License inspection failed. The facility has no three-compartment sink, which is required for washing, rinsing, and sanitizing equipment and utensils by hand. A sink with a grease trap must be installed.

headline: Uncovered tableware and dirty storage shelves
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Pre-set tableware was left uncovered on dining tables. Kitchenware on a storage cart had dried food debris. Liquor storage area had inadequate shelving; items must be kept at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Improper metal container storage; allergen gap
summary: Short-form complaint passed. Metal food containers were stored improperly on the drying rack and must be inverted. A certified manager on site had no allergen training completion; the manager was instructed to provide it.

headline: Weak hot water pressure at main handsink
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Weak hot water pressure at the main kitchen handwashing sink was found. The establishment was instructed to provide adequate water pressure from the city supply.

headline: Lobster bisque held too warm; soup discarded
summary: Complaint with conditions. A 20-quart container of lobster bisque measured 52.3°F after a day in the walk-in cooler. Cold foods must be held at 41°F or lower. The soup, worth $100, was discarded. Thick soup was also cooled improperly.

headline: Dirty equipment, bar floor, and missing trash lid
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Dust on prep cooler condensers, and food buildup in bar gun holders, dishmachine shelves, and reach-in coolers must be cleaned. Employee washroom lacks a covered trash receptacle. Bar floor has food debris and spills.

headline: Dirty grease traps, floors, and mold-like wall
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Dirty, greasy grease traps on dishwashing area floor need cleaning. Floors need cleaning, including standing water under three-compartment sink. Hole in ceiling above bakery dishmachine needs sealing. Mold-like substance behind deli sink.

headline: No certified person; cold food discarded
summary: Canvass with conditions. No person in charge had a valid certificate, and no certified manager was present while beef was prepared. About 30 pounds of cold food at 56°F to 57°F was discarded. Prep cooler at 57.4°F is tagged and must not be used.

headline: Failed: about 70 rodent droppings found
summary: Canvass failed. About 70 small rodent droppings found in garage, warehouse, prep areas, behind deep freezer, and in toilet room with toxic products. Droppings must be removed and pest activity eliminated. Outside grease bin lid not tight.

headline: Failed: chicken held too warm; manager discarded food
summary: Complaint failed. Cooked chicken wings and breast in the walk-in cooler measured 46.5°F to 48.7°F. The manager voluntarily discarded about 13 pounds. Also noted: no handwashing sign, no hair restraints, cloths stored on tables, and damaged ceiling tiles.
