headline: No health policy or food handler training proof
summary: Re-inspection with conditions. No written employee health policy on site. Three-compartment sink lacks stoppers in two basins. Washroom floors, walls, and vent need cleaning. No proof of food handler or allergen training.

headline: Toilet won't flush; sink stopper not working
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Left toilet in the second-floor women's staff restroom cannot flush. The three-compartment sink stopper does not work, and staff use paper towels to hold water in the basin. Manager must repair both.

headline: Failed: low sink water temperature; mold in ice
summary: Complaint failed. Restroom handwashing sink water was 81.1°F, below the 100°F minimum. Brown and black mold-like substance inside the ice machine. Utensils stored in water on counter. Cardboard egg flats used as liners.

headline: Doors have gaps needing rodent-proofing
summary: License inspection passed. All doors have 1/4-inch to 1/2-inch gaps underneath. The doors must be rodent- and insect-proofed and maintained.

headline: Failed: over 100 mouse droppings found
summary: Complaint failed. Over 100 mouse droppings on floors, shelves, cardboard boxes, hot-holding units, prep tables, and storage pallets. Manager must call an exterminator and clean all areas. Grease and food debris on equipment.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings and no manager on site
summary: Canvass failed. About 30 to 50 rodent droppings found throughout the basement. No certified manager was on site while chicken and other TCS foods (foods that must stay hot or cold) were prepared. Also noted: clogged handsink.

headline: Manager on duty lacked valid city certificate
summary: Canvass with conditions. The manager on duty did not have a valid city sanitation certificate while chicken and other TCS foods were prepared, handled, and served. A valid certified manager must be on duty and on site at all times.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; dirty floors and drains
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Bulk containers in rear prep area lack labels. Wiping cloths stored on prep tables. Floors under cooking equipment and drains are dirty. Openings around basement pipes and peeling paint. Washroom ventilation not working.

headline: Failed: no allergen training; loose handsink
summary: Complaint failed. Previous core violation not corrected: a loose handwashing sink in the rear prep area and no allergen training certificates on site. Missing handwashing signs in restrooms and no covered trash can in employee restroom. No summary posted.

headline: Gap at rear door; expired allergen certificate
summary: License inspection passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door must be rodent-proofed. Men's washroom handwash sink pipe is leaking. One food manager's allergen training certificate has expired and must be updated.

headline: Missing food handler proof; water-damaged walls
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Several food handlers lacked proof of food handler training. The certified manager's allergen training certificate is expired. Rusty, peeling cooler racks, water damage by walk-in cooler, and floors with dirt and debris.

headline: No certified manager; summary report not posted
summary: Canvass with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while hot dogs and chicken were prepared and served. The inspection summary report was not posted in public view. Ice scoop stored inside ice bin; fryers have minor grease.

headline: Improper scoops and storage; unlidded trash
summary: Disposable containers used for scooping food, and a bag of bread stored on the walk-in freezer floor. Serving plates not inverted and an ice scoop left on the bar table. Cardboard and foil lining shelves, unfinished wood shelving, and washroom trash cans without lids also noted.

headline: Cooler at 68°F tagged; no food thermometer
summary: Two-door cooler measured 68.0°F; no food was inside. Unit tagged and held for inspection; it must be repaired to hold 41°F or below. No metal-stem thermometer for checking food temperatures; citation issued. Toilet fixtures dirty; soiled mops stored improperly.

headline: Stained cutting board; no allergen training proof
summary: A kitchen cutting board has deep stains and cuts and must be resurfaced or replaced. Chest freezer top is worn. No proof of allergen training was provided for certified food managers; documentation must be provided.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; handwash sink blocked
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings found across prep, furnace, office, utility and storage areas; citation issued and an exterminator was ordered. Prep-area handwash sink was blocked by items and had no signage. Bulk containers unlabeled; a food handler lacked a hair restraint.

headline: About 20 live fruit flies found
summary: About 20 live fruit flies on the floor and wall near the high-temperature dish machine; citation issued. Staff were instructed to clean, remove the flies and inform pest control. Floor drains, floors and the area under the bar have residue and debris.

headline: Handwashing lapse; spoiled onions; dirty ice machine
summary: An employee handled raw bacon, then made toast without changing gloves or washing hands; bread discarded and citation issued. Red onions with mold were discarded. Ice machine had black buildup; citation issued. No vomit/diarrhea clean-up kit on site.

headline: Handwash sign installed; ceiling hole to seal
summary: Handwashing signage was missing in basement restrooms; the manager installed signage during the inspection. A hole in the ceiling above the basement prep handwash sink must be sealed.

headline: Missing thermometer and handwash signage
summary: Hand-washing signage missing in the toilet room. The cooler holding eggs, cheese and Polish sausages needs an internal thermometer. Clutter in rear storage near the utility sink must be organized and items raised at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: No certified manager; about 50 mouse droppings
summary: No certified food manager on site while chicken, burgers and pizza were prepared and served; citation issued. About 50 mouse droppings under dry storage racks and in rear clutter; pest control suggested. Also grease on fryer and grill, rusted shelves, and dim lighting.

headline: No certificate holder; bar sinks lack cold water
summary: No valid sanitation certificate on site; citation issued. Bar handwash sink has no cold water and hot water measured 125.9°F; bar three-compartment sink also has no cold water. Ice machine has black slime dripping into ice; citation issued.

headline: Ice machine interior to clean; hand sink leak
summary: Interior of the rear ice machine must be cleaned. Front hand sink near the cash register leaks from its drain pipe. Office and storage area very cluttered. Floor drains, floors under cooking equipment, and walls and vents need cleaning.

headline: About 50 live flying insects; no health policy
summary: About 50 live small flying insects on walls and ceilings of prep, dry storage and dishwashing areas; citation issued and more pest control needed. No written employee health policy; citation issued. No sanitizer test strips at the three-compartment sink; certified manager's allergen training expired.

headline: Missing cover on cold-hold unit
summary: The cover for the mechanical component of an upright cold-hold unit is missing. Management was instructed to repair or replace it and keep it maintained.

headline: Bar handsink lacked soap and towels; citation
summary: Exposed bar handwashing sink had no soap or paper towels; citation issued. Repeat violations from 2024 were uncorrected: no food handler or allergen training certificates on site. Two coolers lacked thermometers; heavy grease under fryers.

headline: Dish area soil and debris
summary: The dish area had soil and debris, and the manager was instructed to clean it. The re-inspection passed.

headline: Grease on floor under fryers
summary: Grease was found on the floor under the fryers. Staff were instructed to clean it.

headline: No employee health policy; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: No employee health policy was on the premises; the person in charge must provide one and document staff duty to report illness. Bulk containers unlabeled. Grease on fryers and grill, water-stained ceiling tiles, and dusty, greasy vents also noted.

headline: Kitchen washroom door not self-closing
summary: The washroom door off the kitchen does not close on its own. Management must provide and maintain a self-closing device.

headline: Food on freezer floor; no handwash signs
summary: Food containers stored on the walk-in freezer floor must be raised 6 inches. Handwash signage missing in both employee restrooms. A food handler prepared food without a hair restraint. Dusty fans and vents, a burned-out hood light, and missing allergen training noted.

headline: Torn screen door and dirty ice machine
summary: Rear kitchen door screen is torn with large holes and must be replaced to keep out flies and pests. Upper interior of the ice machine needs cleaning. Broken floor tiles and holes in the ceiling near the exit door also need repair.

headline: Cups used as scoops; mixer exterior dirty
summary: Disposable cups were being used as scoops; staff were instructed to use proper scoops. Exterior of the dough mixer and a bulk food container were not clean; staff were instructed to clean them.

headline: No backflow device at ice machine
summary: No backflow prevention device at the ice machine waterline; one must be installed. Basement floor-to-wall joints were repaired with expanding foam and rough, uneven gravel and concrete; they must be made smooth and cleanable.

headline: No certified manager; ice machine has black slime
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken and hamburgers were prepared; citation issued. Basement ice machine had black slime dripping into ice meant for consumption; citation issued. Food handler and allergen certificates were expired, and a bulk container was unlabeled.

headline: Loose door strip and several upkeep issues
summary: Loose strip at the bottom of a door must be replaced to seal small openings. Walk-in freezer floor has dirt and debris; soda machine has splatter and dust; urinal handle leaks; toilet-room waste container lacks a lid; several lights are out.

headline: Door gap, damaged cutting boards, milk crates
summary: About a 1-inch gap at the base of the basement door must be closed. Cutting boards have open seams and dark stains. Milk crates are used for elevation and must be replaced with proper shelving. Clutter, a missing wall section and a ceiling hole also noted.

headline: Handwash sinks too hot or lacking hot water
summary: Women's employee handwash sink measured 124.2°F, above the 120°F limit; men's restroom handwash sink had no hot water (84.5°F). Both listed as priority violations. High-temperature dish machine turned off and tagged. Heavy grease and food debris in kitchen.

headline: Screens missing; rear screen door has holes
summary: No screen over the food pass-out area, and the rear screen door has holes. Management was instructed to provide and maintain adequate screens. A damaged, loose ceiling surface above the three-compartment and hand sinks must be fixed.

headline: Dish machine lacks test strips; ceiling leak
summary: No chlorine test strips for the low-temperature dish machine; they must be provided by reinspection. Water drips from a small hole in the basement ceiling above dry storage. Food debris in prep coolers, greasy hood filters, and a burned-out light.

headline: Cold-held foods too warm; about 150 lbs discarded
summary: Cooked shrimp, pork, beef, chicken, beans and salsa measured 48.4–50.4°F in a small walk-in cooler; about 150 lbs discarded. Cooler tagged and not to be used until repaired and reinspected; citation issued. Raw pork was thawing at room temperature.

headline: Rodent droppings, dead roaches, unsafe food temps
summary: Over 600 rat and mouse droppings, 450 in basement storage; over 150 dead roaches in basement. Citations issued. Cold foods measured 45.6–63.5°F; 15 lbs discarded. Rear cooler at 56°F must not be used until reinspected. Ice machine has black slime; a handwash sink does not drain.

headline: No handwash sink in front prep area
summary: No handwashing sink in the front prep area; one with hot and cold water must be installed. Also no consumer advisory for undercooked breakfast eggs, no dumpster or dumpster contract, a 1/4-inch exterior door gap, and no allergen training certificate on site.

headline: About 100 mouse droppings; live flying insects
summary: About 100 mouse droppings in several areas, including around the mop sink and behind freezers, and about 20 live small flying insects in prep and basement. Citation issued; more pest control needed. No food handler certificates or allergen training on site.

headline: Dust and dirt; one light shield missing
summary: Exterior of the pop station and the shelf underneath need cleaning, as does a fan cover inside the two-door cooler. Light shields, an air vent and nearby tile have dust. One light shield is missing in the rear.

headline: Freezer too warm; 235 lbs of food discarded
summary: Walk-in freezer measured 44.0°F; raw chicken, fish, shrimp and sausage inside measured 42.8–45.8°F. About 235 lbs were discarded, and the freezer was tagged; citation issued. Dish machine and smoker exteriors dirty. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Stained cutting boards, rusted rack, dirty drain
summary: Stained cutting boards on top of prep line coolers must be resurfaced or replaced. Rust on a wire storage rack inside a prep cooler. Dirty floor drain with litter under the kitchen dish three-compartment sink must be cleaned.

headline: Door gaps; items stored in restroom
summary: Openings at the base of front entrance doors and dock doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Beverage containers, bike, ladder and heater stored in a washroom. Chemicals and boxes stored on floors; spills and food debris inside lower cabinets.

headline: Handwash sink blocked; removed on site
summary: No paper towels at the rear handwash sink; citation issued. Dishwashing-area handwash sink was blocked by containers, which employees removed during inspection. Unlabeled food in refrigerators, to-go containers used for scooping, rusty walk-in shelves, and a leaking sink faucet.

headline: Half-inch gaps at revolving door sweeps
summary: Half-inch gaps were found at the revolving door sweeps. The manager was instructed to make the sweeps rodent-proof.

headline: Dead insects found; outside food in freezer
summary: Dead insects found on the toilet room floor and a light shield in front prep. Frozen food from an adjacent restaurant was stored in the walk-in freezer and must be removed. No signed employee health policies. Crates, door gap, and leaks also noted.

headline: Two coolers too warm; ice machine buildup
summary: Two reach-in coolers in front prep measured 47.7°F to 76.0°F, above 41°F; they must be repaired or replaced. Slight buildup inside the ice machine, damaged cooler gaskets, a leaking one-compartment sink faucet, and burned-out bulbs. No citation issued.

headline: Cooked meat held at unsafe temperature; food discarded
summary: Cooked meat left 24 hours on the prep counter measured 60.5°F inside. The manager voluntarily discarded 20 lbs (about $100) of product. Citation issued. Dry goods containers were also missing food name labels.

headline: About 90 flies found; no certified manager
summary: About 50 small flies in the rear bar, 10–15 in the middle bar, and 30–40 in the front bar; citation issued. No certified food manager was on site at the start of inspection; citation issued. Chemicals stored in the walk-in were removed on site. Large leak under dish-room sink.

headline: Worn door stripping; dirty display coolers
summary: Front entrance doors have worn weather stripping at the bottom and must be repaired. Baker three-compartment sink stopper is in poor repair. Display shelving in dairy and prepackaged meat coolers is dirty; floors in storage, walk-in and prep areas need detail cleaning.

headline: Grease and debris near fryers and dish area
summary: Dirt and debris under the dishwasher and under freezer shelving. Grease, dirt and food debris beside the first-floor deep fryer and under second-floor fryers. Drains have sludge. Burnt-out hood lights on the 18th-floor and second-floor kitchens.

headline: No training for new staff; door gaps
summary: No food handler training for new employees; it must be provided and kept. Gaps around front and rear doors must be sealed. Also no hood over the rear oven, crates used for storage, worn cooler gaskets and cutting boards, and stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Raw meat stored over ready food; food discarded
summary: Raw beef was stored above prepared sauces, and raw eggs above lettuce and cilantro, in the walk-in; some eggs were cracked. Undated prepared foods were discarded. Citations issued. Food handlers lacked hair restraints; expired certificates and prior ice machine debris also noted.

headline: Mold in ice machine; shrimp held at 60°F
summary: Pink mold-like substance found inside the ice machine; citation issued. About 2 lbs of shrimp held at 60°F in the prep area; the food was discarded. Pork was thawing at room temperature, and the rear cold-hold unit had no thermometer.

headline: Hot water too cold; plumber fixed on site
summary: Hot water measured 72–77°F at hand sinks and three-compartment sinks; citation issued. A plumber arrived and the water heater recovered adequate hot water on site. Ice machine interior buildup, no food handler certificates, and missing allergen certificates also noted.

headline: One water-stained ceiling tile above prep
summary: One water-stained ceiling tile above the prep area must be replaced. No other issues were listed.

headline: Grease and food debris found; door gap to seal
summary: Grease and food debris on fryers, a prep table and walk-in shelving. Cutting board badly stained and worn. About a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom right of the door must be sealed. Floors greasy and dirty in several kitchen areas.

headline: No certified manager; hair restraints not used
summary: No certified food manager was on site while eggs, sausage and other TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. Person in charge lacked a certificate. Food handlers did not use effective hair restraints. Refrigerators lacked thermometers; restroom fixtures were dirty.

headline: Low hot water pressure; no allergen training
summary: Very low hot water pressure at the front exposed handsink; citation issued. The on-duty certified manager has no food allergen training. Fly strips were in the rear prep area. Grease and debris noted on cooking equipment, fryers, floors and walls.

headline: No vomit/diarrhea procedure; no mop sink
summary: No written procedure or supplies for vomiting and diarrhea events were on site; no citation issued. No mop or utility sink is available; handwash signage and a lidded waste container in the unisex toilet room are also required.

headline: Hot and cold foods held at unsafe temperatures
summary: Hot-held veal stock, chicken stock and gravy measured 103.9–111.4°F; cold-held pico de gallo, chicken strips and mozzarella measured 47.7–48.9°F. Staff discarded the food on site; citation issued. Milk cooler lacks a thermometer; cooler gaskets are worn.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged held
summary: Rear low-temperature dish machine was not working and its final rinse measured 0 ppm chlorine. It was tagged 'held for inspection' and the manager was told to repair it. Also a 1/4-inch front door gap, a missing splash guard, and no backflow devices at ice and coffee machines.

headline: Can opener blade needs replacing
summary: A new large can opener blade is needed. Management was instructed to obtain and maintain it.

headline: Over 130 rodent droppings; exterminator ordered
summary: Over 80 mouse droppings in bar, taqueria and prep areas, and over 50 rat droppings in basement storage; citation issued and an exterminator ordered. Also no handwash sign, unlabeled bulk containers, soiled wiping cloths, leaking sinks, and debris on floors.

headline: Rat infestation; over 100 droppings found
summary: Over 100 rat droppings in rear storage, along walls by soda and chip areas, near prep tables, canned food shelves and the front door; citation issued. Milk and soda crates used for storage. Damaged floor and ceiling tiles from a prior report were not repaired.

headline: Walk-in thermometer missing; trash piled outside
summary: A thermometer could not be found inside the walk-in cooler; management was instructed to locate it. Excessive trash on the ground in the outside receptacle area must be removed and kept clear.

headline: Live ants, rodent droppings and flies found
summary: About 45 live small ants near coolers, coffee storage and rear prep; about 7 rodent droppings in the rear cake decorating area; 7 live black flies in prep areas. Pest control was instructed and a citation issued. Food debris and hair restraint lapses also noted.

headline: Utensils stored in standing water; plumbing leaks
summary: In-use utensils at the pizza line were kept in still, room-temperature water between uses. Staff were instructed to store them on a clean, sanitized surface or under running water. Also a detached sink stopper and leaks in sink and men's room plumbing.

headline: No handwash signs; hair restraints not worn
summary: Missing handwashing signs at sinks in the prep and toilet room areas. Food handlers and employees were not wearing hair restraints. Rear closet, corners and areas under equipment are dirty; water-stained ceiling tiles. A fly strip was found in rear prep.

headline: No vomit/diarrhea kit; food stored on floors
summary: No bodily fluid spill kit or clean-up procedure on site; citation issued. Food containers stored on floors in the walk-in cooler and prep and storage areas; single-use articles stored on the basement floor. Floors are dirty throughout. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Basement floors dirty; mop heads not hung
summary: Basement dry storage room floors have debris and must be cleaned. Soiled mop heads were not properly stored; the manager was told to hang them to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Food handlers without hair restraints; upkeep issues
summary: Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints. Front bar three-compartment sink lacks stoppers; milk crates and cardboard used on basement shelving; one women's restroom stall out of order; missing ceiling tiles; a burnt-out light; a mop not stored to air-dry.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Food handler certificates were expired, and the certified manager's allergen certificates were also expired; current ones must be obtained. Pizza hot-holding case has food and dirt buildup, a leak under a front handwash sink, and a poorly lit dishwashing area.

headline: Live mouse and over 50 mouse droppings
summary: Over 20 mouse droppings along walls and corners in rear dry storage, over 30 on shelves, and one live mouse in a milk crate. Citation issued; licensed pest control recommended. Thermometers missing in meat display cooler and rotisserie unit.

headline: No certified manager on duty; no handler certificates
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while chicken tacos and beef burritos were prepared; citation issued. No food handler certificates were on site. A food handler worked without a hair restraint. Women's washroom lacks a lidded sanitary waste container.

headline: Openings at several entry doors
summary: Openings were found at the base and middle of front entrance sliding doors, main exit doors, and receiving double doors. Management was instructed to seal all outer openings to prevent pest entry.

headline: Shellfish tags with mixed harvest dates
summary: Oyster and clam containers each held tags with two different harvest dates, risking mixing before sale; citation issued. Water dripping from a pipe below the three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Soiled ice machine; allergen certificates missing
summary: Ice machine exterior and door are heavily soiled with spillage. Spray hose leaks at the three-compartment sink. Heavy food debris and trash under the dish machine and sink. Three certified managers lack allergen certificates; staff were instructed to obtain them.

headline: No food handler training; several cleanliness issues
summary: Employees have no food handler training. Also noted: no waste container at prep-area handwash sink, pans too large for the three-compartment sink, unused single-service items not inverted, and debris, spills and dust in several areas.

headline: Sink stoppers missing; no allergen training proof
summary: No stoppers for the three-compartment sink and no proof of allergen training for an employee; citation issued for prior uncorrected violations. An employee's food handler certificate is expired. Rusted walk-in racks and burnt-out lights also noted.

headline: No rear handwash sink; rat droppings by dumpster
summary: No handwashing sink in the rear prep/dish room; citation issued. Rat droppings found on the ground around an overloaded dumpster; citation issued. Undercooked hamburgers served without a consumer advisory. Ice scoop stored inside the ice machine; milk crates used for shelving.

headline: Several coolers missing thermometers
summary: Several coolers on the main coffee prep line lack internal air thermometers. Management was instructed to provide at least one visible thermometer in each cooler used to hold cold food, and to keep it working.

headline: No certified manager; no health policy
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken, beef and tuna salad were prepared and served; citation issued. No employee health policy or vomit/diarrhea procedure; citations issued. Food handlers lacked training proof. Coolers lacked thermometers; a pipe under a sink leaks.

headline: Freezer ice buildup; mold-like caulking
summary: All freezer interiors have excessive ice buildup. Black mold-like substance on the caulking at the base of the three-compartment sink. Management was instructed to remove the ice and black substance and keep areas clean.

headline: No health policy or food handler certificates
summary: No written employee health policy and no food handler certificates were on premises; citation issued. Prior violations not corrected: deli sandwiches lacked required labels and the last inspection summary was not posted. Some violations were corrected on site.

headline: Unlabeled bulk container; dirty fryers and floors
summary: A bulk ingredient container in the rear is not labeled. Fryer interiors have grease and dirt buildup. Floor drains, corners, and areas under heavy equipment have dirt, stains and debris; staff were instructed to clean them.

headline: No food manager certificate on site
summary: No City of Chicago food manager certificate was on site; the manager was instructed to provide it. No citation was issued. A hole in the wall above the utility sink must be patched.

headline: No food handler certificates; uncovered ice bin
summary: Food handler certificates could not be provided for all employees; staff were instructed to provide and keep them on site. Food service managers lack allergen training. Ice bin at coffee station is uncovered; mold-like buildup near dish machine; waste can lacks a lid.

headline: Bar dish machine at 0 ppm chlorine; food discarded
summary: Bar dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine. The manager replaced an empty chlorine container and primed the machine on site. About 35 lbs of unlabeled cooked food was discarded. Citations issued; undercooked-food advisory missing. Many upkeep issues noted.

headline: No vomit/diarrhea clean-up plan or kit
summary: No procedure or kit for vomiting and diarrhea clean-up was found; one must be provided. No citation was issued. The sanitation manager has no allergen training.

headline: Ice scoop holder not clean
summary: The bottom of the ice scoop holder was not clean. Management was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: No certified manager on site; no training proof
summary: No certified food manager was on site while eggs, sliced tomatoes and sandwich wraps were prepared; citation issued. No proof of food handler training was available for any handler. Milk crates used as shelving; dust and debris on floors.

headline: No food handler or allergen training; door gap
summary: No food handler training for employees and no allergen training for food managers; both must be provided. Gap at the bottom left of the front door; worn prep cooler gaskets taped; no backflow device on the ice machine; grease under fryer and inside oven.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure
summary: No written procedure or clean-up kit for vomiting and diarrhea events was on site; the manager was instructed to provide them. No allergen training certificate was on site; certified managers must complete the course and keep records on site.

headline: Door gap; worn cutting board; dusty coolers
summary: Rear exit door has a gap at the bottom from broken weather stripping; repair instructed. Deli cutting board has deep grooves on both sides. Walk-in cooler fan covers are dusty; floors in walk-in freezer, produce and dairy coolers need detail cleaning.

headline: Certificate missing, then corrected on site
summary: No person with a valid sanitation certificate was on site; corrected when the original certificate was delivered during inspection; citation issued. Shellfish tags lacked last-sold dates; citation issued. Bar has no prep/dump sink. Covered toilet stall and dirty dumpster area also noted.

headline: No certified food manager while open
summary: No certified food manager was on site while the restaurant was open and operating; citation issued. Also an open bag of oats was stored unprotected under the juice dispenser, thermometers were missing from buffet and storage coolers, and two food handlers worked without hair restraints.

headline: Food on floors; missing signs and thermometer
summary: Food stored on the floor in walk-in cooler and freezer must be raised 6 inches. Wiping cloths left on prep tables and ice scoops stored in the ice bin. Handwash signs and a prep-cooler thermometer are missing. Dirt, grease and damaged floor tiles also noted.

headline: No certified manager; flies; poor handwashing
summary: No valid certified manager certificate, and no manager on duty, while pasta and salads were prepared; citation issued. Employees handled dirty dishes and food without washing hands or changing gloves; citation issued. Over 30 live small flies found in dining and prep areas.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate posted
summary: Person in charge lacked a sanitation certificate and no valid certificate was posted; citation issued. Torn gasket on the rear two-door cooler. Unused coolers must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Cardboard liner under the rear cooler must be removed.

headline: No verifiable sanitation certificate on site
summary: No person in charge with sanitation manager training, and no verifiable city certificate on site during inspection; citation issued. Certified manager arrived at the end. Walk-in freezer floor is uneven, leaving a gap; grime in the rear dish-area floor drain.

headline: Ceiling above pizza oven not clean
summary: The ceiling above the pizza oven was found not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Ice machine residue; dirty prep coolers
summary: A small amount of pink residue was found in the crease of the ice machine interior panel. Food residue is built up inside prep coolers and between their gaskets. Staff were instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Missing handwash signage; sink faucet leaking
summary: Missing handwashing signage at the rear dish sink. An employee prepared food without a hair restraint. Water leaks at the base of the front three-compartment sink faucet. Dry storage and furnace room need decluttering; women's restroom ventilation must be repaired.

headline: Dusty exhaust hood and filters
summary: Dust accumulated inside the exhaust hood, on pipes and conduits, and on filter edges above cooking equipment. Management was instructed to detail clean and maintain them.

headline: Employee restroom waste container lacks cover
summary: The employee washroom has no covered receptacle for sanitary napkins; one must be provided. Clutter on the floor in rear storage must be removed to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: Wiping cloths left out; deep-cut cutting boards
summary: Wiping cloths were left on top of a prep cooler instead of in sanitizing solution. All cutting boards at the butcher station have deep cuts and stains; staff were instructed to restore or replace them.

headline: No certified manager; chicken thawed at room temperature
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food service manager was on site while chicken and beef were handled and served. A cook was seen thawing raw frozen chicken at room temperature. No probe thermometer. Three-compartment sink drains slowly and its stoppers do not hold water.

headline: Worn cooler gasket, dirty equipment, no lidded trash can
summary: No pests noted. Worn gasket on a cooler door, dirty fryer, cooking equipment, floors and prep tables, and no covered waste container in the unisex restroom. An old core violation from 2018 is still uncorrected. Allergen training and printed certificates required.

headline: Ice scoop stored in ice; sprayer sink not draining
summary: Failed. An ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine on the ice. The sprayer sink does not drain properly, and water leaks from the grease trap onto the floor; priority violation. Sprayer hangs below sink rim. Floors along walls and under equipment need cleaning.

headline: Failed: 12 live roaches; prior pest violation not fixed
summary: Failed. 12 live roaches found on site. A priority pest violation from a September 2, 2025 report was not corrected within the required time. Also soil buildup on kitchen equipment and walls throughout the facility. Citation issued.

headline: Leaking faucet; dirty rear prep floors
summary: Passed. A leak at the base of the one-compartment prep sink faucet must be repaired. Floors in the rear prep area along the wall base and in corners need cleaning to remove spills and debris.

headline: No certified sanitation manager; food handlers lack hair restraints
summary: Passed with conditions. Person in charge and no sanitation manager certificate posted while egg and milk foods were prepared and served. Citation issued. Food handlers without adequate hair restraints. Leaking pipe under hand sink. No proof of allergen training for managers.

headline: Quarter-inch gap at rear door
summary: Passed. A quarter-inch gap at the bottom left corner of the rear door. Manager was instructed to seal all outer openings to prevent pest entry.

headline: Failed: no health policy, pest log or sanitizer kit
summary: Failed. No employee health policy, no vomiting and diarrhea cleanup procedure or kit, and no pest control logbook on site. Also no probe thermometer, no sanitizer test strips, no drainboard, a potable water line without a drain valve, and a sliding door that cannot close fully.

headline: No hand soap at sink; soap supplied on site
summary: Passed with conditions. Hand soap was missing at the sushi-area hand sink; the manager supplied it immediately. Also found: unlabeled food containers, ice scoops on the ice bin, no hair restraints, wiping cloths on prep tables, rusty walk-in shelving, and dirty floors and walls. Citation issued.

headline: Failed: mice activity, no hot water, no certified manager
summary: Failed. Mice activity found: about 80 under the front sink, freezer and prep table, and about 100 in the rear around sinks and the grease trap. No hot water at any sink. No certified food manager while TCS foods were prepared. No pest control logbook. Citation issued.

headline: No food handler training certificates on site
summary: Passed. No food handler training certificates were on site. Proof of food handler training must be provided for all required employees.

headline: Improper thawing; food on floor; no hair restraints
summary: Re-inspection passed. Frozen meats thawed on a shelf at room temperature, and food packets sat in standing water; staff must thaw properly. Food stored on the floor. Two female food handlers without hair restraints. Forks and spoons not inverted.

headline: Failed: mice droppings, flies, sewage backup, toilet overflow
summary: Failed. Foods held too warm and too cold were discarded. More than 50 mouse droppings and 6–8 large flies in the prep and storage areas. Sewage backed up onto the floor; plumber repaired the drain on site. A toilet filled with feces was repaired enough to flush.

headline: Unused dish machine needs repair or out-of-order sign
summary: Passed. An unused high-temperature dish machine in the rear prep area must be repaired and maintained in good condition or marked with out-of-order signage.

headline: Dirty reach-in coolers; certified manager's allergen training expired
summary: Passed. Reach-in cooler interiors have spills and debris to clean. Freezers have ice buildup. Floors need cleaning along wall bases and in corners. Certified manager's allergen training certificate has expired and must be renewed.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; 60 lbs chicken discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager on site while open. Priority violation; citation issued. Fried chicken held at 78–87.6°F; about 60 lbs ($150) discarded. Also no thermometer in the dishwashing area refrigerator, two missing sink stoppers, and an unlocked refrigerator of food accessible to customers.

headline: No certified sanitation manager during pork service
summary: Passed with conditions. No City of Chicago food service sanitation manager or valid certificate was on site while pork and other temperature-controlled (TCS) foods were being prepared and served to the public. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Manager's allergen training certificate expired
summary: Passed. The food service sanitation manager's food allergen training certificate has expired. The manager was instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: Cooler insulation damaged; ice maker dirty
summary: Passed. Insulation lines in the main walk-in cooler are in poor repair and must be replaced. Small ice maker by the coffee station has a gray film inside and must be cleaned.

headline: Food debris on shelves, sinks and floor
summary: Re-inspection passed with cleaning required. Food debris and litter on prep area shelves and floor. Food buildup inside the prep area sinks. The manager must clean these areas and maintain them.

headline: Sink stoppers not working; pipe leaking
summary: Re-inspection passed. Drain stoppers in the three-compartment sink are not working properly, and the sink does not hold water. A leak from the bottom pipes of the sink must be repaired.

headline: Dirty ice machine; burned-out bulbs; allergen training missing
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food debris on the ice machine exterior and display cooler sliding doors. Plumbing fixtures need cleaning. Burned-out bulbs above the deli sandwich prep area. Person in charge lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Chipped paint below three-compartment sink
summary: Passed. Chipped paint on the wall below the three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: No certified manager; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid certified food manager on the premises while sandwiches were being prepared and served. Citation issued. The low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged held; the three-compartment sink must be used. Food debris and standing water on floors.

headline: Failed: foods too warm, about 100 flies found
summary: Failed. Many cold-held foods in a reach-in cooler measured 46°F to 73.3°F, above the 41°F limit; about 102 lbs discarded. About 100 or more live small flies were found in and around a towel cabinet and the basement. A pest control service was recommended.

headline: Gaps at doors could allow pests; grease and dirt buildup
summary: Passed. Gaps and missing weather stripping at the rear dock door and under a garage-side door must be sealed to prevent pests. Heavy grease on cooking equipment and shelving. Dirty walk-in coolers and a leaking three-compartment sink in the basement.

headline: No certified manager on duty; chicken thawed in sink
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were stored, prepared and served. The manager arrived about 12:35 PM. Chicken was thawed improperly in the three-compartment sink. Food stored in grocery bags. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Failed: about 40 mouse droppings; milk crates used as shelves
summary: Failed. About 40 mouse droppings on the dining area floor, behind coolers and freezer, on a hot-cooking storage rack, and near the pizza oven. Additional pest control needed. Also unlabeled food in coolers, milk crates used as shelving, unused equipment, and dirty hood filters. Citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled sugar; damaged door, wall and floor tiles
summary: Passed. Bulk sugar not labeled with its common name. Bottom of the rear exterior door is in disrepair and must be repaired to prevent pest entry. Hole in wall near restroom and damaged floor tiles at front and rear entrances.

headline: Pest entry gap, many repairs needed
summary: Re-inspection passed with many repairs. Opening at the base of the front double doors must be sealed against pests. Drinks stored on soda crates, no stoppers for the three-compartment sink, no grease trap, clutter in the dumpster enclosure, damaged counters, and a cooler with buildup on its condenser fan covers.

headline: No handwashing sink near dish area; grimy shelves
summary: Failed. No handwashing sink within reasonable distance of the dishwashing area. Food residue and grime on shelves in the west building prep area. Missing and broken walk-in cooler tiles. Grime and litter in floor drains throughout the facility.

headline: Failed: restroom doors not self-closing
summary: Failed. Men's and women's restroom doors must be self-closing. This repeat core violation from January 2023 was not corrected. All bathroom doors on premises must be self-closing. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Failed: 35 or more live roaches; pest service needed
summary: Failed. Infestation of about 35 or more live roaches in crevices and gaps at the front service counter, behind sinks, in the dry food storage closet and in the cleaning product area. Pest control service required. Also leaking pipe, pitted cutting boards and grease buildup. Citation issued.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; food on cooler floor
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs are missing in the washroom and rear prep area. Food stored on the walk-in cooler floor must be raised six inches. Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables, unpackaged meat in grocery bags, a leaking washroom faucet, and dust on light shields.

headline: Dirty ice machine, pop nozzles, fryers, floors; leaks
summary: Passed. Bulk food items lack proper labels. Ice machine interior, pop machine nozzles, filters, fryers, hot-holding interiors, and hood vents need detailed cleaning. Floors need removal of spills and buildup. Leaking faucets at the two- and three-compartment sinks.

headline: Failed: flying insects in food storage room
summary: Failed. About 40 live small flying insects on walls, ceiling and cardboard boxes in the rear food storage room. Cleaning and additional pest control service are needed. Also no handwashing signs in three restrooms, staff without hair restraints, and no covered waste container in a restroom.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; dirty ice machine guard
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign at the front prep handsink. Interior guard of the ice machine has dirt and must be cleaned. Rear storage area is cluttered with items on the floor and must be organized and elevated.

headline: Inadequate lighting in food prep areas
summary: Re-inspection passed with a condition. Lighting is inadequate in food prep areas. Management was instructed to provide adequate lighting in all areas where food is prepared.

headline: Thermometer needed; food stored on floors and crates
summary: Passed. A working thermometer is needed in the one-door prep cooler. Wiping cloth stored on a faucet. Items in rear storage must be raised six inches. Plastic crates used for storage inside the walk-in must be removed. Dirt and debris under walk-in shelving.

headline: Dirty hot-holding units, walk-in shelving, ceilings
summary: Passed. Hot-holding unit exteriors and interiors need cleaning, along with walk-in shelving. Floors and walls under and behind kitchen equipment, ceiling vents and tiles with dust and rust, washroom vents, and the walk-in cooler's inner door need cleaning.

headline: Burnt-out hood bulbs; no allergen certificates
summary: Passed. Three burnt-out bulbs in the hood over the cook line need repair. No allergen training certificates on site; certified managers must complete training and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Failed: homemade yogurt made without variance
summary: Failed. House-made yogurt was made without a variance from the Chicago Department of Public Health; about 20 lbs (valued at $60) discarded. Production must stop until a variance is granted. Also no thermometer in two-door coolers, no sanitizer test kit, slime in the ice machine.

headline: Open fly strips on ceilings; damaged gaskets and tiles
summary: Re-inspection passed. Several open fly strips on ceilings throughout the facility must be removed; a pest technician should install enclosed traps. Also worn cooler gaskets, food debris on walk-in shelving, and multiple water-damaged ceiling tiles.

headline: Cluttered basement floor
summary: Re-inspection passed. The basement floor is cluttered throughout. The manager must raise or remove the items off the floor.

headline: Dirty fryer and cooler interiors; washroom fan not working
summary: Passed with conditions. Interiors of the deep fryer, pizza prep cooler and two-door freezer need cleaning. Washroom ventilation fan does not work. Certified manager lacks allergen certificate; this core violation from 2024 was not corrected. Citation issued.

headline: Failed: ready-to-eat food lacks date marks
summary: Failed. Ready-to-eat foods such as corned beef hash in the walk-in and two-door cooler were not date-marked. Faucet does not reach all three sinks. Also soiled wiping cloths on prep tables, ice machine residue, soiled mop heads not hung, and a manager lacking allergen training.

headline: Failed: no raw-food disclosure; pest log incomplete
summary: Failed. No menu disclosure for raw or undercooked foods. Pest control logbook shows only one service visit in the past year; two are required. Grill, fryers, prep tables and basement fan need attention. Certified manager lacks allergen training certificate. Citation issued.

headline: Damaged door frame; gap by pipe; missing hot water knob
summary: Passed. Damaged vertical door frame by the back door must be repaired. Gap between a pipe and wall in the toilet room must be sealed to keep pests out. The three-compartment sink is missing its hot water knob and must be replaced.

headline: Dusty equipment, leaking sink, greasy hood, expired allergen training
summary: Passed. Dust on prep-cooler and walk-in condensers. Three-compartment sink stopper broken and two-compartment sink drain leaking. Grease and food buildup on the hood and filters. Food allergen training certificates have expired and must be updated.

headline: Failed: no sanitation manager; 30–50 rodent droppings
summary: Failed. No City sanitation manager on site while pork was being prepared. About 30–50 rodent droppings throughout the prep area. Pork at 50.3°F and shrimp at 47.0°F in the prep cooler. Pizza prep cooler at 50.2°F. Food stored on floors. Citation issued.

headline: Many repairs: leaks, damaged floors, walls and lights
summary: Re-inspection passed with many repairs. Leaky hand sink pipe, slow drains in basement locker rooms, worn cutting boards and door gaskets, damaged floor tiles, missing wall tiles, food debris, standing water, burnt-out hood lights, and no dump sink in the beverage area.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods prepared
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while beef and turkey were prepared. Priority violation; citation issued. A food handler lacked a hair restraint, wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer, and a female handler had no proof of food handler training.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink faucet
summary: Re-inspection passed. A leak from the neck of the three-compartment sink faucet must be repaired. The manager was instructed to fix it.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Re-inspection passed. Several food handlers have expired food handler training certificates, and an expired allergen certificate was found. Employees must provide current certificates. Also needed: three working drain stoppers for the three-compartment sink and cleaning inside two restroom handsink cabinets.

headline: Food residue in coolers; no allergen certificate
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food residue inside cold-hold and freezer units must be cleaned. The certified manager on duty had no allergen certificate on site; the person in charge must obtain one and keep it on site.

headline: Missing signs and thermometers; bulk food unlabeled
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign at the chicken-cutting cooler sink. No thermometer for hot-hold units. Bulk containers unlabeled. Cardboard used on bakery cooler shelves. No covered trash containers in women's restrooms. Build-up in prep floor drains.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings, live roaches, no manager certificate
summary: Failed. About 15–20 mouse droppings in the prep area, 10–15 in the toilet room, and 15–20 by cat and dog food. Three live roaches at the three-compartment sink. No valid manager certificate posted. Pest control proof due before the January 9, 2025 re-inspection. Citation issued.

headline: Cooling food covered in plastic; plastic bowls as scoops
summary: Passed. Cooked rice and pork were covered in plastic wrap while cooling in a cooler; the staff was told to cover loosely or leave uncovered. Plastic bowls are used as scoops in bulk dry storage and must be replaced. Front sink drain is slow.

headline: Failed: no sanitation certificate; handsink water too hot
summary: Failed. No valid original City sanitation certificate on site; photocopies not allowed. Hot water at the bento-room handsink measured 140.8°F with no cold water; it must be 100–120°F. Citation issued. Also a leak at the three-compartment sink and large holes in walls near the rear dock.

headline: Open drink in prep area; broken floor tiles
summary: Passed. An employee had an open beverage in the prep area and was told to use closed containers. Small leak under the two-compartment basement sink. Damaged or broken floor tiles in front of the walk-in cooler and in the basement prep area.

headline: Foil-stuffed wall hole; rough wall covering
summary: Re-inspection passed. A hole in the wall to the right of a refrigerator is stuffed with aluminum foil and must be sealed smoothly. Wooden wall covering between the rear prep handsink and utility sink must be smooth and cleanable.

headline: No certified manager on site; bar sink leaking
summary: Passed with conditions. No City certified food service manager on site, and no valid certificate posted. Priority violation; citation issued. Styrofoam trays stored face up. Grease buildup on cooking equipment and kitchen floors. Leaking faucet at the bar handsink.

headline: Failed: live insects and about 100 mouse droppings
summary: Failed. About 50 live small flying insects near the coffee area and in the basement. About 100 mouse droppings on floors, in a freezer, around the water heater and ice machine, and in storage. Additional pest control needed. Citation issued. Backflow device leaking; manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: Failed: no dumpster; no thermometers; no handwashing signs
summary: Failed. No dumpster on premises. No metal stem thermometer on site. No visible thermometers in the walk-in cooler, one-door refrigerator or two-door cold-holding unit. No handwashing signs at sinks in restrooms or the kitchen. Priority violation.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; slow deli handsink
summary: Passed. Torn gaskets inside the two-door reach-in cooler at the sandwich station must be repaired. Slow drainage at the deli handwashing sink must be repaired.

headline: Restroom trash cans lack lids; no food handler certificates
summary: Passed. Restrooms have garbage receptacles without lids; women's and unisex restrooms must have lidded trash cans. Employees lack food handler certificates; all employees must have them on site. New hires get a 30-day grace period.

headline: Missing baseboards by ice machine
summary: Re-inspection passed. Baseboards are missing along the wall across from the kitchen ice machine and must be repaired.

headline: Failed: no health policy, sink, detergent or test strips
summary: Failed. No written employee health policy. No hand sink at the coffee-station three-compartment sink. No dish detergent or sanitizer test strips. No thermometer in the milk refrigerator. No proof of food handler training for food handling employees. Priority violations.

headline: Missing floor tiles; grease; food on floors
summary: Re-inspection passed. Floors need grout and damaged or missing tiles must be repaired. Excess caulking removed; loose wall panel fixed. Grease and food debris on fryers, grill, prep tables and floors. Food stored on floors throughout. Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizer.

headline: Certified manager has no allergen training
summary: Passed. The certified food manager on duty had no food allergen training. The manager was told to comply with the requirement.

headline: No handwashing sink in front food area
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. There is no handwashing sink in the front food preparation and dispensing area. Priority foundation violation. The operator was told to provide a handwashing sink according to food code standards.

headline: Dirty ice machine, cooking equipment and floors
summary: Passed. Interior of the ice machine needs detail cleaning. Cooking equipment has food spills and grease buildup. Floors need cleaning of food spills and water buildup. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain all areas.

headline: Uncovered food on cooler floor; several training gaps
summary: Passed. Food stored uncovered on the walk-in cooler floor. Soiled wiping cloths on prep table, food debris on the front prep floor, a food handler without a hair restraint, no food handler training, and no allergen training for the certified manager on duty.

headline: Ice machine calcium buildup; soiled mop heads
summary: Passed. Ice machine bump plate has calcium buildup and must be cleaned. Fryer interiors have dried food and grease. Soiled mop heads are drying against the utility closet wall; a mop rack is needed.

headline: Dead insects in light shields; missing signs and backflow device
summary: Passed. Light shields above the prep and cooking area contain dead insects and need cleaning. Clutter in the rear outside area and basement could attract pests. Also missing handwashing sign, thermometers in coolers, and a backflow device at the mop sink.

headline: Missing signs, rear door gap, sink leak
summary: Re-inspection passed. No handwashing signs at the rear prep sink or toilet room. A small opening at the bottom of the rear exit door must be rodent-proofed. The three-compartment sink has a leak at its sanitizing basin. No garbage lid in the all-gender restroom.

headline: Person in charge lacks sanitation certificate
summary: Passed with conditions. The person in charge had no City sanitation manager certificate while handling eggs, milk and other TCS foods. Also unlabeled bulk flour and sugar, a food handler without a hair restraint, no food handler or allergen certificates, and no backflow devices on coffee machines.

headline: No prep cooler thermometer; dish machine grime
summary: Passed. No thermometer inside the prep cooler across from the flat-top grill. Heavy brown grime inside the low-temperature dish machine must be detail cleaned.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, hot water too hot
summary: Failed. No certified food manager or valid documentation on site while rice, beef and chicken were handled and prepared. Women's restroom handwashing water measured 124.1°F; the maximum allowed is 120°F. Also rusty, chipped shelving and ice buildup in the walk-in cooler; manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Failed: no menu disclosure; ice scoop handle in ice
summary: Failed. Menu lacks a disclosure that asterisked animal-derived foods may be served undercooked. An ice scoop was stored handle-down inside ice. Rusty shelving, no thermometer for dish sanitizer, burnt-out hood lights, bags and cardboard by the dumpster, and one sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Food on floors; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food stored on floors in walk-in coolers and freezer. Milk crates used for shelving must be replaced with proper shelving. Stained cutting boards, a leaking cold-hold unit, a leaking three-compartment sink, and food debris on floors and equipment.

headline: Rodent bait left uncovered; priority violation
summary: Passed with conditions. Rodent bait pellets were scattered on the floor under the washroom sink. Two uncovered boxes held rodent traps and a hamburger bun. Bait must be in a covered, tamper-resistant station. The employee discarded the bait during inspection. Citation issued.

headline: Dirty ice machine, unlabeled bulk food, no food handler training
summary: Passed. Residue found inside the ice machine. Bulk containers in the rear prep area were unlabeled. An ice scoop handle was left lying in ice. No food handler training was available; the manager was told to provide it for all employees.

headline: Failed: slime, black residue and rust in ice
summary: Failed. Black and brown substance and pink slime on ice bin surfaces and the ice chute of the fountain drink machine, and rust on the bin. Black-and-white substance on the rear ice machine touching ice used for drinks. Deep cleaning required. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Employee skipped handwashing; cold food too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. Employee swept, put on gloves, then handled frozen egg folds without washing hands; about 3 lbs discarded. Cold-held foods at 53–68°F were discarded (about 12.4 lbs, $102). Prep cooler at 68°F was tagged. No food handler training. Citation issued.

headline: Garden hose replaced with food-grade tube on site
summary: Re-inspection passed with a condition. A garden hose was used to transfer fresh water. The manager replaced it with a clear, food-grade tube during the inspection. Priority violation with no citation.

headline: Failed: no soap at hand sink; sink water backs up
summary: Failed. Hand sink in prep area had no soap; staff obtained soap during inspection. Water backs up into the other basins of the three-compartment sink and must be repaired. Trash debris outside near bins. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: No employee health policy on premises
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy was on the premises. The manager must provide one, plus documentation that employees must report illnesses that can spread through food. Priority violation. All food handlers must get required training.

headline: Slow drain and dripping faucets; missing sink stoppers
summary: Re-inspection passed. Slow drain at the toilet-room handsink and a dripping hot water faucet at the front handsink must be repaired. Three-compartment sink must be provided with stoppers.

headline: Hot foods too cool; about 15 lbs discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Bean sprouts (78°F) and cooked rice noodles (70°F and 78°F) were below the 135°F hot-holding minimum. The manager discarded about 15 lbs (valued at $50) during inspection. Ice machine had brownish residue, and its backflow device could not be found. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Fly trap by prep table; burnt-out light
summary: Passed. A fly trap hanging by the rear prep table must be removed from the prep area. A burnt-out light bulb at the ventilation hood must be replaced.

headline: Slow drain at front handsink
summary: Passed. Slow drainage at the front handwashing sink. Manager was instructed to repair and maintain the sink.

headline: No soap at sink; food not dated; no thermometer
summary: Passed with conditions. No hand soap at the rear handsink; management supplied it during inspection. About 36 lbs of food (valued at $198) discarded for missing date marks. Cooler lacks a thermometer. Gap at the rear exterior door. Cook without hair restraint. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Broken floor tiles and moldy caulking
summary: Passed. Some floor tiles in front of the bar handsink and the dishwashing room need repair and regrouting. Blackened, moldy wall caulking in the dishwashing room must be replaced.

headline: Failed: grocery bags used for freezer food storage
summary: Failed. Plastic grocery bags are being used as food containers in freezers and must be replaced. Loose faucet leaks at the three-compartment sink. Debris and standing water on floors. Ice machine lacks a backflow device; sanitation managers lack allergen training. Citation issued.

headline: Handsink blocked; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Passed with conditions. Hand sink by the grill had no paper towels and was blocked by a garbage can during food prep; both were corrected on site. Low-temperature dish machine was at 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged. Previous inspection summary was not posted for customers.

headline: Failed: about 80 rodent droppings in several areas
summary: Failed. About 80 rodent droppings beneath sinks, in chemical storage, under shelves and freezers, beside soda boxes, and by the front counter safe. Open bait must be removed. Soup cooled in walk-in with lid on. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Dirty washroom fixtures; dusty ceiling; expired certificate
summary: Passed. Washroom fixtures are dirty and must be cleaned. Dust on the menu sign and the ceiling tile above the prep area. Exterior of cooking equipment needs grease removed. A cook's food handler certificate expired and must be updated.

headline: No food handler certificates; no covered trash in restrooms
summary: Passed. Single-service items are stored on the floor and must be raised at least six inches. Both unisex bathrooms lack covered trash receptacles. No food handler certificates were present for any employee on site; proof must be kept on site.

headline: Failed: repeat core violations, unlabeled food, tape on leak
summary: Failed. Core violations from March 2024 remain uncorrected: items not elevated, milk crates used as shelving, and pest-harboring unused equipment outside. Also unlabeled bulk food, a water pitcher by the hand sink, tape used on a sink leak, water-damaged ceiling tiles. Citation issued.

headline: Re-inspection: labeling and storage fixes
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food in walk-in coolers lacked name labels; food stored on floor must be raised six inches. Utensils left on cutting board. Cardboard and milk crates used as shelving. Cooler door taped; faucet broken. No allergen training proof.

headline: Missing thermometer; grease and dust buildup
summary: 7-Up reach-in cooler at front lacks a thermometer; one is required. Food prep equipment needs cleaning, and a one-compartment faucet leaks. Grease on the outside grease container and alley must be cleaned by reinspection. Dust on ceiling tiles.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Passed with conditions. One food handler lacked a food handler training certificate. A certified food manager lacked a valid allergen training certificate from a prior report; citation issued.

headline: Rodent droppings throughout kitchen; citation issued
summary: Over 50 mouse droppings in prep, dishwashing and storage areas, plus 30 inside the boiler closet. Inspector recommends licensed pest control. Also: no allergen training certificate, and food handlers lacking training certificates.

headline: Spills in cooler; mops stored improperly
summary: Passed. Spills inside a two-door cooling unit need cleaning. Mops stored in mop sink should hang dry to prevent pest harborage. Black soiled crates must be removed; floors and drains need cleaning.

headline: Missing splash guard at dishwashing sink
summary: Passed. The handwashing sink on floor 50 in the dishwashing area has no right-side splash guard. Install one to protect food and surfaces from contamination.

headline: Rat droppings, warm food, no beverage handsink
summary: 15 or more rat droppings in liquor room; pest control service advised; citation issued. Walk-in cooler food at 46.2-55.8F discarded, about 7 lbs. Beverage prep area has no handsink. Restroom hot water only 80-89F; must reach 100F.

headline: Cold unit too warm; pest entry gap
summary: A small cold holding unit read 45.3F; it must stay at 41F or below. Corrected on site and tagged held for inspection. Opening at front door base needs sealing against pests. Also missing splash guard, damaged gaskets, backflow devices.

headline: Crates used as shelving; floor tiles missing
summary: Re-inspection passed. Crates must be removed for adequate shelving; raw wood in dish area needs sealant. Sink stoppers required for three-compartment sink. Clean dust from shelves and fan covers. Repair missing floor tiles; clean mold from walk-in ceiling.

headline: Items stored on upstairs floor
summary: Passed. Items stored on upstairs floor; person in charge must raise all items at least six inches and keep them raised.

headline: Food held at unsafe temperatures; coolers tagged
summary: Meatballs in hot holding at 110.7-112.4F were discarded. Two prep coolers could not keep temperature: one read 44.2F with beef at 46.7F, the other 55.2F; both tagged and cannot be used until repaired. Cold foods found too warm were discarded.

headline: Ice buildup in freezer; crumbs and floors
summary: Passed. Ice buildup on the walk-in freezer floor must be repaired and maintained. Milkshake mixer and service cooler need cleaning of crumbs and spills; floors along walls and under equipment need cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled salt, standing-water utensils, live plant
summary: Passed. Bulk salt was not labeled. Rice spoons were kept in standing room-temperature water. Ice scoop holder had gray water. A large live potted plant hung over open food; move it away.

headline: Handwash water far too cold; citation issued
summary: Water at both unisex restroom handwashing sinks measured 48.1F and 50.3F; must reach 100F at all times. Priority violation; citation issued and repair ordered.

headline: Dried food debris on equipment surfaces
summary: Re-inspection passed. Dried food debris was found on rolling carts, liquor wells, juicing bottles, and the juicer prep area near the walk-in cooler. Staff were ordered to clean, sanitize, and maintain these surfaces.

headline: Bar handwash sink blocked; no drying towels
summary: Citation issued. Bar handwashing sink was used as a dump sink with ice, straws and limes, and had no hand-drying supplies; paper towels were provided during inspection. Also belongings in prep sink; unlabeled containers; cracked drain cover.

headline: Rat droppings; gaps at doors; dumpster overflowing
summary: 20-30 rodent droppings in basement; clean and remove. Gaps at rear and front doors must be sealed. Soda stored on floor must be raised six inches. Dumpster lids open, trash overflowing; citation issued.

headline: Uncovered drinks in prep area; dirty equipment
summary: Passed. Staff drinks without lids were in the food prep area; covered beverages required. Warewash machine gauges had excessive debris. Small ceiling hole by three-compartment sink and dirty basement floor need repair and cleaning.

headline: Ice bin needs cleaning; chipped rear prep paint
summary: Re-inspection passed. Interior of ice bin needed cleaning; remove ice, clean, and maintain at all times. Chipped wall paint in rear prep must be resurfaced and repainted to be smooth and cleanable.

headline: No vomit cleanup plan or kit found
summary: Required procedure and cleanup supplies for vomiting and diarrhea events were missing. Must provide gloves, face masks, disposable mops, and norovirus-effective sanitizer. Washroom door also lacks a self-closing device.

headline: Missing thermometer in soft-serve cooler
summary: Passed. Refrigeration unit under soft-serve machine lacks a thermometer; provide one and maintain it.

headline: Food splatter in fridge; grease and dust
summary: Passed. Upright refrigerator had food splatter and spillage from chicken containers; clean shelves, floor, glass, and handles. Light grease on cooking equipment sides. Heavy dust and grease on hood filters; clean and maintain.

headline: Rear exit door gap; unlabeled containers
summary: Quarter-inch gap at top of rear exit door needs tight seal against pests. Food in coolers and dry storage lacked name labels. Floors and hood need cleaning. Certified manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: Thawing and sanitizing failures; pest log incomplete
summary: Frozen acai thawed at room temperature in a sink; smoothie residue in a container handle. No metal stem thermometer. Pest control log incomplete; last service listed 9-9-2025 and 1-5-2024. Front door propped open with a rat trap; citation issued.

headline: 40 rat droppings; mold in ice machine
summary: About 40 rat droppings in basement; remove and clean; citation issued. Pink and black mold in large ice machine; ice destroyed; citation issued. Handsinks in two washrooms ran 74-81F; must reach 100F. Dish machine at 10 ppm was repaired on site.

headline: Dried food debris, rusty racks, poor prep lighting
summary: Passed. Thermometer missing inside cooling unit holding bread, rice, and meat; provide one. Rear exit door not rodent-proof; repair door sweep. Rusty racks, crumbling wall base, dried food debris on floor, and inadequate lighting in prep.

headline: Improper thawing; missing food handler certificates
summary: Frozen food thawed in sink without running water; thawing method must change. Food handler lacked hair restraint. Rusty prep tabletops must be replaced. Food handler certificates missing; citation issued. Handsink leak needs repair.

headline: Clogged handwashing sink unusable; citation issued
summary: Exposed handwashing sink in the front prep area was clogged and would not drain, so staff could not use it. Repair ordered; citation issued. Also clean wire racks, shelves, prep tables, and floors in prep areas.

headline: Unknown black residue on soda and ice equipment
summary: Black specks of an unknown substance were on the soda dispenser and ice chute and came off on a napkin. Ordered cleaning and sanitizing; citation issued. Also rust, a ceiling hole, dirty floors, and missing allergen training proof.

headline: 50+ mouse droppings; citation issued
summary: Over 50 mouse droppings under front serving counter, in storage rooms and under shelves. Clean all areas and arrange pest control before reinspection next week; citation issued. Leaking ceilings and cracked tiles also need repair.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; no pest logbook
summary: Basement ice machine had black slime; cleaning and sanitizing required; citation issued. No pest control logbook on site; pest service required. Lowboy prep cooler lacks thermometer. Menu lacks raw-food consumer advisory. Missing handwashing signage.

headline: Warm noodles and chicken discarded; undated food
summary: Walk-in cooler noodles at 47.3-50.5F and chicken at 55.9F; about 50 lbs discarded; citation issued. Ready-to-eat food lacked date marks; about 15 lbs discarded. Ice machine interior and walk-in shelves need deep cleaning; slow handsink drain.

headline: No covered trash can in lower-level restroom
summary: Passed. Employee toilet room on the lower level has no covered receptacle; one must be provided.

headline: Cold food too warm; obstructed handsinks
summary: Passed with conditions. Grilled onions, anchovies, pasta, chicken and beef were 47-54F; about 35 lbs discarded; citation issued. Handsinks blocked by empty sanitizer buckets were cleared on site. Wiping cloths stored dry; several faucets leak.

headline: Dirty freezers, hood filters; expired allergen certificate
summary: Passed with conditions. Chest freezers had ice and debris; defrost and clean. Floors need cleaning around cooking equipment. Hood and filters must be cleaned. Staff must get food handler training and a valid allergen certificate; citation issued.

headline: Freezer too warm; prep cooler tagged
summary: Walk-in freezer read 51.9F; manager must repair it to 41F or below. Freezer is not in use. Prep cooler is tagged held for inspection and cannot be used until reinspected by Chicago Department of Health. No citation issued.

headline: Thermometers, loose faucet, broken self-closing door
summary: Passed. Thermometers must be visible inside all coolers. Interior of hand and three-compartment sinks needs detail cleaning. Hot faucet loose at front prep handsink. Washroom door self-closing device must be reattached. Floors and unused equipment need cleaning or removal.

headline: Paper towel dispenser above dish sink
summary: Passed. Paper towel dispenser above one-compartment sink could contaminate equipment; relocate it. Ceiling vents in restrooms are dusty; clean them.

headline: Walk-in cooler at 46F; no food handler proof
summary: Walk-in cooler measured 46F and cannot be used until reinspected. No written employee health policy, food handler proof, or allergen training. A handsink is needed for cook line and prep areas; citation issued for health policy.

headline: Unlabeled dry storage container in office
summary: Passed. Dry ingredient container stored in the office had no label. Every food storage container must be labeled with its common food name.

headline: Third-floor bar lacks required hot water
summary: Hot water at third-floor bar read 72-74F; handsinks need 100F and the three-compartment sink 110-120F. Bar must stay closed until fixed; citation issued. Missing handwashing signage, lidded restroom trash receptacles, and allergen certificate.

headline: Single-use items on floor; storage clutter
summary: Passed. Single-service items stored on floor in office and dry storage must be raised six inches. Unused equipment and broken furniture stacked in a closet, plus heavy trash and debris on the floor there. Manager ordered to clean and maintain.

headline: Utensils standing in room-temperature water
summary: Passed. Spoons kept in standing water at room temperature; inspector told staff to store them per health code. Ice scoop holder fixed to ice maker should be removable for washing.

headline: Flies in deli and meat areas; citation issued
summary: About 10-15 fruit and house flies near deli prep table and handsink; 3-5 in meat department. Clean them out and add pest service; citation issued. Also food handlers lacked hair restraints. Standing water and leaks on floors and pipes.

headline: Dirty bus station floors; dishwashing ceiling
summary: Passed. Clean debris, spills, and floor drains on second-floor bus station. Clean ceiling in first-floor dishwashing area.

headline: Low water pressure, grease, dirty cooler floors
summary: Passed. Rear handwashing sink had low water pressure; increase ordered. Rusty racks in basement walk-in cooler; reach-in coolers need cleaning. Basement cooler floors had blood spills, food, and debris; cleaning ordered.

headline: Five live roaches found; allergen certificates missing
summary: Five live roaches were on a wall in the dishwashing area; all activity must be gone by reinspection, and pest control service is advised. Coca-Cola cooler has no thermometer. Sinks have food debris. No allergen training certificates.

headline: No food manager certificate; cold food too warm
summary: No City sanitation certificate on premises while preparing eggs, sandwiches and coffee; citation issued. No cleanup supplies for vomiting or diarrhea events. Milk at 51-65F, cheese 54-59F, cut tomatoes 51F; must stay at 41F or below.

headline: Fridge at 81F; no original manager certificate
summary: Person in charge lacked the original City sanitation manager certificate; a copy was shown. Two-door refrigeration unit read 81F; it must hold 41F or below. Missing: metal stem thermometer, pest logbook, allergen training certificate.

headline: Rat droppings; no health policy or pest logbook
summary: Still 11 rat droppings in basement near hot water tank; must be cleaned and sanitized; pest service advised. No signed employee health policy or pest control logbook. Gaps at basement doors let insects in.

headline: No handwashing sink in dish prep area; citation
summary: Main commissary dishwashing prep area has no handwashing sink; one must be installed. Citation issued. Also a missing hot water knob at the three-compartment sink, and missing grout in the dish room and cook line.

headline: Greasy cooler exterior; damaged faucet handles
summary: Passed. Exterior of a one-door cooler near the grill was soiled with grease and dried food; cleaning ordered. One-compartment prep sink faucet handle is missing; handwashing sink seal is cracked but working. Repair or replace fixtures.

headline: Missing cooler thermometers; unlabeled dry storage
summary: Passed. Coolers at front prep area lack thermometers; provide and maintain. Dry storage containers lack common-name labels. Warewashing area light is missing its shield.

headline: Minor leak, missing backflow device, chipped wall
summary: Passed with minor issues. Small leak at bottom of three-compartment sink; repair ordered. Inspector could not locate a backflow device on the basement ice maker; install ordered. Chipped drywall behind rear prep table needs a smooth, durable surface.

headline: No certified manager; unsafe thawing and sink
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site while food that must be kept cold was prepared. Frozen chicken was thawed improperly. Three-compartment sink drains poorly and backs up; repair ordered; citation issued. Missing allergen certificates were repeat violations.

headline: Bulk ingredient containers lack name labels
summary: Passed. Small containers of bulk ingredients were not labeled with their common name. Person in charge was instructed to label items and keep them labeled.

headline: Greasy equipment, rust, missing grout
