summary: Re-inspection passed. Soiled wiping cloths stored on prep tables; keep them in sanitizer. Rust on prep table bottoms; grease and food debris on equipment. Leaking hose; missing drainpipe under utility sink. Missing grout and damaged floor tiles.

headline: Black caulk and missing drain cover
summary: Passed. Excessive black substance on caulk at base of three-compartment sink; remove or recaulk. Rear two-compartment sink missing drain cover; replace.

headline: No certified manager certificate; no bar handsink
summary: No original manager certificate was posted; a certified manager must be present whenever food is handled; citation issued. Bar has no handsink; a one-compartment sink serves as dump sink without hot water. Low-temperature dish machine tagged; not sanitizing.

headline: Rodent droppings, expired produce, ice machine slime
summary: About 40 mouse droppings in rear storage; clean and add pest service; citation issued. Spoiled repacked produce discarded. Ice machine had black and pink slime; ice discarded. Display cooler at 58.8-60.3F; 115 lbs discarded.

headline: Warm food and cooler; discarded product, unit tagged
summary: Egg rolls, fried wontons and beef in the display cooler were 49-51F; about 15 lbs discarded voluntarily. Reach-in prep cooler read 50F, was serviced during inspection, and tagged held for inspection. Also unlabeled containers, food on floor, and food debris.

headline: Deli cooler 50F; three-compartment sink floods
summary: Deli top cooler read 50F and was repaired before inspection ended; citation issued. Three-compartment sink floods when one compartment drains; citation issued. Food handlers lacked certificates, and an allergen certificate was expired; citation issued.

headline: Dirty ice chute; handsink lacked hot water
summary: Self-serve ice chute was unclean; cleaning ordered. Rear handsink had no hot or cold water due to a non-working battery; fixed on site by 4:05 PM. Missing ceiling vent cover. Backflow device missing at ice machine from prior report; citation issued.

headline: Dirty floors; missing food handler certificates
summary: Re-inspection passed. Floors under cooking equipment and dry storage shelving had dirt and debris; clean. Staff could not show food handler certificates on site; must provide and keep them on site. No allergen training proof for managers.

headline: Blocked handsink; untagged oysters; raw/cooked mixing
summary: Passed with conditions. Bread crates blocked a handsink; it must stay clear. Oysters lacked source tags and were discarded. Raw shrimp and beef stored with ready-to-eat foods; separate them. Also missing a basement handsink, paper towels, sink stoppers.

headline: 60+ rat droppings and unsafe food temperatures
summary: About 60 or more rat droppings in storage areas; citation issued. Shredded lettuce and diced chicken on counter at 67-69F were discarded. No employees had food handler training. Gaps under doors allow rodents in.

headline: Many black flies in garbage room
summary: Re-inspection passed. Garbage room had dirt, debris, and a large number of black flies; cleaning ordered. Floor drains in food prep area had dirt and grime; clean and maintain.

headline: Trays stored upright; dusty cooler fan guard
summary: Passed. Single-service trays stored facing up at cook line; invert them to protect from overhead contamination. Dust on meat walk-in fan guards; dairy cooler missing fan guard. Slow handsink drain behind wait station.

headline: About 20 live flying insects; no self-closing door
summary: About 20 live small flying insects on walls and shelves behind bar; more pest control needed; citation issued. Basement employee restroom lacks self-closing door. Broken floor tiles and gaps behind bar need repair.

headline: Handsink water 50-60F; dish machine failing
summary: Men's restroom handsinks ran 50-60F; minimum 100F required. One of two first-floor prep handsinks had no running hot water. Low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm; tagged held by CDPH; citation issued. Prior allergen violation not corrected.

headline: Cracked grout and walk-in ice buildup
summary: Passed. Floor tiles around three-compartment sink and dish handsink have low grout; regrout. Ice buildup on walk-in freezer floor and walls must be removed.

headline: Missing light shield at donut display
summary: Passed. Donut display shelves lack a light shield; install one.

headline: No employee health policy; low hot water
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy was on site; one must be provided at all times. Toilet-room handsinks had hot water at only 70-73F at first; an engineer raised it to 100F before inspection ended.

headline: No certified manager; greasy conveyor oven
summary: Person in charge lacked a City sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was on premises while pizza and chicken were handled; citation issued. Conveyor oven was greasy, and its filters need regular cleaning and replacement.

headline: Salmon held too warm; handwashing sinks blocked
summary: Cooked salmon in cooks-line cooler read 68.5-75F; food discarded; citation issued. Bar handwashing sinks blocked and used as dump sinks; no paper towels at dish-area sink. Also missing hair restraint, menu consumer advisories, and greasy shared grease trap.

headline: No certified manager; handsink water 63F
summary: No person in charge with valid sanitation certificate; no certified manager on duty while chicken, hamburgers and fries were prepared; citation issued. Prep handsink water was 63F; fixed to 102-105F on site. Floor debris and dust in rear storage.

headline: Dirty ice machines; damaged floors and tiles
summary: Passed. Upper parts of three basement ice machines need cleaning. Torn freezer gasket repaired with duct tape; replace. Missing floor tiles, cardboard matting, and excess grease above prep. No allergen training proof for manager.

headline: No certified manager; unsafe cold-holding temperatures
summary: No certified manager on site while open. Walk-in cooler read 55F; chicken, fish, beef, prawn and pork were 47-57F and about 60 lbs were discarded. Clams lacked shellstock tags; about 10 lbs discarded. Citations issued; allergen certificate missing.

headline: Food on floors; wastewater backs up
summary: Food stored on walk-in cooler and freezer floors; elevate six inches. Bulk containers lack lids. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Wastewater backs up through washroom floor drain during handwashing; plumber needed; citation issued. Food debris on equipment; soiled wiping cloths.

headline: Broken oven panel; grease and dust buildup
summary: Passed. Broken side panel on rear kitchen oven must be repaired. Grease under fryer needs deep cleaning. Duct tape holds sink drainpipes; that is not an allowed repair. Dust, cobwebs, and grease on ceiling and walls need cleaning.

headline: Dead fruit flies; soiled towels; greasy kitchen
summary: Passed. About 10 dead fruit flies near drink station, warewashing, and bar areas; clean and sanitize. Soiled towels outside rear door must be relocated and covered. Plates not inverted; grease buildup on equipment and floors.

headline: No food handler certificate; no vomit cleanup kit
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. One food handler lacked a certificate; proof required. No cleanup supplies for vomit or diarrhea events; provide. No metal-stem thermometer and no food prep cooler thermometer; provide. Washroom door needs self-closing device.

headline: Broken trash can lid in public restroom
summary: Passed. Broken cover on trash can in public restroom; correct it.

headline: About 50 mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: About 50 mouse droppings found in prep and storage; citation issued. No certified manager on duty while food was prepared. Kitchen cooler read 51.9F; about 25 lbs of food discarded; cooler repaired on site.

headline: No handwashing signage; food stored on floor
summary: Passed. Exposed handwashing sink by the ice machine had no signage; required. Food stored on walk-in cooler floor must be raised six inches. Cardboard used as shelf liner should be removed. Two burnt-out light bulbs over prep table.

headline: Warm cold-held food; zero sanitizer; no handsink
summary: Cold-held food at 44.4-46.5F (about 37.5 lbs) discarded; prep cooler tagged. Dish machine sanitized at 0.0 ppm; citation issued. Handsink removed from beverage area; vacuum machine lacks a nearby handsink. Missing handwashing signage.

headline: Heavy fryer grease; ice machines need cleaning
summary: Passed. Heavy grease spills inside the fryer must be cleaned and maintained. Basement ice machine and soda dispenser ice interior need cleaning and sanitizing.

headline: Rear door gap; wet wiping cloths; dirty floors
summary: Passed. 1/4-inch gap at rear exit door needs tight seal against pests. Wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces must be stored in sanitizer. Mop must hang to dry. Food debris and spills on floors and equipment need detail cleaning.

headline: No employee health policy; sewage backs up
summary: No employee health policy or vomiting and diarrhea cleanup kit on site; both must be provided. Sewage backs up from grease trap when draining three-compartment sink; service required. Also no handwashing signage, torn freezer gaskets, missing allergen certificates.

headline: Ice maker drains into handsink; reroute required
summary: Re-inspection passed. Drain line from ice maker emptied into kitchen prep handsink; re-route it to a floor drain and maintain.

headline: Rust on walk-in cooler shelves
summary: Passed. Bottom shelves in walk-in cooler have rust buildup; repair and maintain.

headline: No certified person in charge; soap missing
summary: No person in charge with valid sanitation certificate; no certified manager on site while fish was prepared and served; citation issued. Soap missing at rear prep and washroom sinks. Food handler certificates missing; repeat violation.

headline: Bulk flour and sugar lack labels
summary: Passed. Bulk food such as flour and sugar was not labeled; labels must be provided.

headline: Food stored under water lines in basement
summary: Re-inspection passed. Dry foods and food-contact items stored directly under water lines in basement. Relocate items or fully encase the water lines.

headline: Dirty ice machine guard; food stored on floor
summary: Ice machine interior guard had dirt; cleaning ordered. Boxed food stored on floor in dry storage must be raised six inches. Cooler door gasket torn. One food handler lacked a required training certificate.

headline: Broken floor tiles, unlabeled containers, allergen training missing
summary: Passed with conditions. Bulk storage container unlabeled. Floors in prep and dishwashing areas have broken and missing tiles; a kitchen light shield is cracked. Manager lacks allergen training proof; citation issued.

headline: Missing drain plugs at kitchen sink
summary: Passed. Kitchen three-compartment sink had no drain plugs; manager instructed to provide them.

headline: No certified manager while steaming milk
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food service manager on site while steaming milk, a food that needs temperature control; instructed to obtain one. Empanada hot holding unit has no thermometer; provide one.

headline: Not ready: unlabeled containers, no sink stoppers
summary: Result: not ready. Bulk and small dry-ingredient containers unlabeled; label with common food names. No sink stoppers for three-compartment sink; provide three. Water on basement floor throughout; remove it.

headline: Dirty equipment, floors; allergen certificate missing
summary: Passed with conditions. Clean cooking and cold equipment, fryer bottoms, prep tables, and carts. Clean floors and walls under equipment; replace water-stained ceiling tile; clean vents. Certified manager lacks allergen training certificate; citation issued.

headline: Salad prep cooler too warm; food discarded
summary: Chicken, hard-boiled eggs, lettuce, and blue cheese in the salad prep cooler measured 57.5 to 57.9F. About 10 lbs ($100) was discarded. The cooler, at 55.0F, was tagged and held until repaired.

headline: No covered receptacle for feminine hygiene products
summary: The unisex restroom had no covered receptacle for feminine hygiene products. The manager was instructed to provide and maintain one.

headline: Pork skins drying against wall; cutting board stained
summary: Pork skins drying on a rear storage rack were touching the wall, and a barrier that is non-porous and easy to clean is required. A kitchen cutting board had deep cuts and stains and must be restored or replaced.

headline: Suspension sign removed from window; citation issued
summary: A city license suspension sign was removed from the front window after the facility reopened. The person in charge had been told not to remove the sign, and a citation was issued.

headline: Food on basement floor; sink and signage problems
summary: Food was stored on the floor in basement dry storage, and no splashguard was between a kitchen hand sink and prep table. Handwashing signs were missing, and the three-compartment sink lacked stoppers. Cooking equipment had grease and debris.

headline: No certified food manager on site while open
summary: No certified food manager was on site while the restaurant was open, and a citation was issued. Food containers and single-service articles were on floors in prep and storage areas. Grease was spilled near the outdoor grease container, and it was cleaned by an employee.

headline: About 60 mouse droppings found in rear storage
summary: Inspector found about 60 mouse droppings in rear storage, behind a chest freezer, under shelves, and along walls. Additional pest control service was advised. No certified food manager was on duty while food was being prepared.

headline: Over 80 mouse droppings; handwashing skipped
summary: Over 80 mouse droppings were found throughout the facility, and a citation was issued. Employees handled cash and then ready-to-eat food without washing hands. Soap and paper towels were supplied on return, and the rear sink was cleared.

headline: No certified manager on duty during TCS food prep
summary: No certified manager was on duty while pizza and chicken were prepared, and no valid certificate was posted, leading to a citation. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies were on site. Storage shelves had foil and dirty areas.

headline: Unverified meat sources; $1200 discarded
summary: Unlabeled, damaged-packaged chicken and beef in a grocery freezer had no proof of approved source, and were voluntarily discarded, $1200. No vomit cleanup procedure was posted, and a citation was issued. Prior violations were not corrected.

headline: No hot water at dishwashing hand sink
summary: The dishwashing area hand sink measured 62.8F, and at least 100F is required. A citation was issued. Other notes include a leaking drain, missing stoppers, a gap under the entrance door, and prior violations not corrected.

headline: Broken handwashing sink; uncovered receptacles
summary: A basement men's restroom handwashing sink was not working and must be repaired. Handwashing signage was missing in the basement women's restroom, and covered receptacles were not provided in two restrooms. Floors and pipes need repair.

headline: Half-inch gap under rear exit door
summary: A half-inch gap was found at the bottom of the rear receiving and exit door. The notes require a tight-fitting seal to prevent rodent entry.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; cold food 50F
summary: The low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged. The kitchen refrigerator held food at 50 to 51F, and about 15 lbs ($300) was discarded. The unit was tagged, and the restaurant was instructed not to use it until reinspected.

headline: No certified manager on site; no chemical test kit
summary: No certified manager was on site while rice at 179.8F was being prepared, and a citation was issued. No chemical test kit was available for sanitizer, and a citation was issued. Food was stored on floors, and gaps at exit doors need sealing.

headline: Food stored under wastewater pipes; sink nozzle too short
summary: Basement box freezers and food-contact items were stored under wastewater piping, which is not allowed. The three-compartment sink nozzle could not reach all compartments and must be replaced. Unused wood and construction material must be removed.

headline: Missing ceiling tiles above produce prep
summary: Ceiling tiles were missing above the rear produce preparation room. The inspector instructed the restaurant to replace them.

headline: No health policy, vomit kit, or backflow devices
summary: No employee health policy was at the premises, and no vomit and diarrheal cleanup procedure or spill kit was on site. No backflow devices were on the mop sink, espresso machine, or ice machine. A sanitation manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Live roach seen; no certified manager on site
summary: A live roach was seen crawling on the wall behind the coolers and the front counter, and a citation was issued. Fly strips hung in prep and dishwashing areas. No certified manager was on site while beef at 135.1F was prepared.

headline: 12 rodent droppings under ice machine
summary: Twelve rodent droppings were found on and under the ice machine, and a citation was issued. Black slime was inside the ice machine. A bar handsink was blocked by a bucket, and oyster tags lacked a 90-day supply and dates.

headline: Handwashing signs needed; floor litter in basement
summary: Handwashing signage was needed at the bar handsink and in the women's restroom. Basement storage had litter along walls and corners, missing lightshields were above the basement prep area, and a certified food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Prep cooler too warm; food discarded
summary: Cooked ground beef, steak, and Italian beef in the front prep cooler measured 54.6 to 55.7F, above the 41F limit. About 9 lbs ($250) was ordered discarded. The cooler, at 52.7F, was tagged and held.

headline: Broken dumpster lid in garbage room
summary: A dumpster in the building garbage room had a broken lid. The inspector instructed the restaurant to repair or replace it.

headline: Beef held above 41F; 8 lbs discarded
summary: Beef and beef tongue in the front prep cold holding unit measured up to 55.4F, above the 41F limit. About 8 lbs ($50) was discarded. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables, and an employee washroom lacked a covered waste receptacle.

headline: Live rats and droppings in food areas
summary: Two live rats were seen in the food preparation area, with 50 to 100 rat droppings on food containers, floors, and the dining room. About 25 to 45 small black flies were also seen. An update noted live rats, droppings, and flies still present.

headline: Cold seafood at 46-58F; 53 lbs discarded
summary: Crab, salmon, shrimp, tuna, and sliced avocado were held at 46.4 to 58.5F. About 53 lbs ($1000) was discarded. A certified manager arrived at 3:07 PM, so the missing manager was corrected on site.

headline: Missing floor tile; dusty ceiling vents
summary: Floors had missing tile and voids, which must be repaired to be smooth and cleanable. Ceiling air vents had a dust buildup that the person in charge was instructed to clean.

headline: About 12 rat droppings found; pest service scheduled
summary: About 12 rat droppings were found on the floor by the grill and behind the grease trap, and a citation was issued. Droppings were removed, the area sanitized, and pest control service was scheduled. Floors also had loose debris and dust.

headline: Uncovered sugar and salt; missing handwashing signs
summary: Food containers with sugar, salt, and other foods were uncovered along the main kitchen line without overhead protection. Handwashing signs were missing, and nonfood-contact surfaces had dried food debris and dust. Grease hood filters were damaged.

headline: Unlabeled food containers; burned-out bulbs
summary: Food storage containers had no labels with food common names. Three burned-out light bulbs were at the ventilation hood. The inspector instructed the restaurant to label containers and replace bulbs.

headline: No health policy or vomit kit on site
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site, and a template was left for management to complete. No vomit and diarrhea kit or procedure was on site, and a one-page guide was left. No citation was issued.

headline: Wall opening under mop sink; prior violations
summary: An opening in the lower wall under the rear prep mop sink must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Prior violations were not corrected, including unlabeled squirt bottles and black buildup on the ice machine shield.

headline: Excess grease and debris in coolers and wok line
summary: Food containers were not labeled with common names, and the grease interceptor had excessive rust. Coolers, storage racks, wok line, and cooking equipment had excessive grease and debris. Toilet room sinks, toilets, and walls were soiled.

headline: Unlabeled flour and sugar; grease and dirt on floors
summary: Bulk flour and sugar containers had no labels. The handwashing sink lacked signage and had no backflow device. Floors under cooking equipment, along walls, and in corners in several areas had grease, food debris, and dirt.

headline: Torn gasket on prep line cooler
summary: A torn door gasket on the four-door prep line cooler must be replaced. The inspector instructed the restaurant to replace it and maintain it.

headline: Raw wood surfaces and cutting boards need repair
summary: Raw wood shelves and surfaces need sealing or painting to be easily cleanable. Cutting boards in the rear prep area had open seams and dark stains. The upright freezer interior needed cleaning, and a mop was not stored to dry properly.

headline: No certified manager on site; food held too warm
summary: No certified food manager was on site at arrival, and a citation was issued. Foods were held at 48 to 55F. About $700 of food was discarded, and half of a display cooler reading 46F was tagged.

headline: Floor debris under walk-in shelving
summary: Debris and spillage were on the walk-in cooler floor under shelving and must be cleaned. Dust, dirt, and debris were under and around front service equipment, and the inspector asked for cleaning to prevent pest activity.

headline: Three refrigeration units off; no cleanup kit
summary: Three of four refrigeration units were not running and had to be turned on to hold 41F or below. The restaurant also lacked a vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit, food thermometers, and a licensed commercial garbage dumpster.

headline: Dish machine rinse too cool; no certified manager
summary: No certified manager was on site while beef was being prepared, and a citation was issued. The high-temperature dish machine final rinse was 149.3F, below 180-192F, and was tagged. Eight employees lacked food handler training.

headline: Employees not wearing hair restraints
summary: Several food employees were not wearing hair restraints during inspection. Unused items were stored along a rear prep wall, food debris covered prep area floors, and employees' personal items were stored in the rear prep area.

headline: Mop stored in bucket; manager instructed
summary: A mop was stored sitting in a bucket. The manager was instructed to store mops hanging up or in a way that lets them air dry without soiling equipment.

headline: No certified food manager during TCS food prep
summary: No person in charge or certified food manager was on site while chicken and beef were being prepared and served, and a citation was issued. Floors had debris and spills around cooking equipment, and certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Door gaps and boxes stored on floors
summary: Openings at the base of the front and rear doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Boxes and equipment were stored on floors throughout the facility, and plastic wrap was covering bread and pastries on the sales floor.

headline: Sewage leaking onto prep floor; sink problems
summary: A grease trap in the cooking area was leaking sewage onto the food prep floor, a priority violation. The only handwashing sink was out of operation, and the rear prep area lacked an accessible one. No vomit cleanup kit was on site.

headline: Required handwashing sink missing
summary: The restaurant lacked a handwashing sink required for its type of operation. The manager was instructed to provide one. No citation was issued.

headline: Cracked walk-in freezer floor tiles; dirty drain
summary: Floor tiles in the walk-in freezer were cracked and must be repaired. Debris and dirty water were found inside a floor drain by the dishwashing area, and it must be cleaned.

headline: Stained and damaged tiles throughout premises
summary: Ceiling tiles, wall tiles, wall bases, and floor tiles throughout the premises were stained or damaged. The notes say they must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Splashguard needed at front counter sink
summary: An additional splashguard is needed between the front counter (bar and serving area) and the handwashing sink. The surface must be smooth, cleanable, and non-absorbent.

headline: Roach feces found in outlet box behind bar
summary: Roach feces were found in an outlet box behind the bar. The inspector instructed the restaurant to clean and maintain it. Also noted: a new handwashing sink lacked signage and a fryer was uncovered while off.

headline: Broken walk-in door gaskets; prior violation uncorrected
summary: Broken gaskets on the produce walk-in cooler door were a prior violation that was not corrected, and a citation was issued. Food storage containers lacked labels, and dirt and dust covered floors throughout the facility.

headline: Rat and mouse droppings in food prep area
summary: About 10 rat droppings were under cooking equipment in the rear prep area, plus rat and mouse droppings on the staircase to the second floor. Hot duck and pork belly held at 104-110F, and about 100 lbs of raw duck at 65F, were discarded.

headline: Missing splash guard; utensils stored over sink
summary: Inspector required a splash guard between the three-compartment sink and stored clean pots, stopped clean utensils being stored over the sink, and ordered replacement of blackened, moldy caulking at the dish machine.

headline: Items stored on basement floor; prior violation uncorrected
summary: Pots, pans, and cake tins were stored on the floor in the basement dry storage, a prior violation that was not corrected. A right-hand faucet leaked significantly, and floors below cooking equipment had food debris and grease.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; dirty floors
summary: Milk crates were being used as shelving throughout prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Floors and corners throughout the facility had loose debris, dirt, and dust.

headline: Stored items must be off the floor
summary: Single-use items stored throughout the front and rear prep areas must be raised off the floor. The inspector noted this as a required correction.

headline: No handwashing signs; prep floors not clean
summary: Handwashing sinks had no handwashing signs, and floors in the preparation area by the cooking equipment were not clean. The notes require both to be fixed.

headline: Missing thermometers in coolers holding dairy and deli meat
summary: Cooling units storing dairy and deli meat had no thermometers. Handwashing signs were missing, the back door sweep was in disrepair, and the restroom ventilation needed repair. No pests were reported.

headline: Cracked freezer lids and cooler door gap
summary: Cracked lids on the ice cream freezer at the service counter must be repaired or replaced. A gap around an under-counter cooler door in the ice cream prep area also must be repaired.

headline: Worn exit door seal; floors need cleaning
summary: An exit door in the dock and storage area had a worn weather strip, a possible entry point for pests. Floors around cooking equipment, along walls, and in storage corners had spills and debris that must be cleaned.

headline: Food handlers lacked training proof; no cooler thermometer
summary: Employees handling food had no food handler training certificates, so management was told to show proof. The walk-in cooler had no working thermometer. Grease was found on a hot holding unit and bun toaster, and dishwashing area walls needed cleaning.

headline: Cold-held chicken and eggs too warm; 15 lbs discarded
summary: Chicken breast, diced turkey ham, shelled eggs, and cooked diced potatoes in the cold-holding cooler were above safe temperatures, reaching up to 102.6F. The manager voluntarily discarded 15 lbs ($250). A citation was issued.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; prior violation uncorrected
summary: Food handler certificates for employees on site were expired, and a prior violation was not corrected. Other notes cover stored items on floors, greasy hood and coolers, dirty floors and drains, and damaged shelving.

headline: Dish machine inadequate; handwashing signage missing
summary: Handwashing signs were missing in several areas. A new low-temperature dish machine was still in its packaging, and the existing rear machine was consumer-grade and inadequate. No pest control logbook was on site, and the three-compartment sink had no drainboard.

headline: Litter behind dumpster; basement clutter
summary: Litter and debris were on the ground under and behind the dumpster. Basement storage had unnecessary chairs, tables, and unused equipment, which must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Floors and corners need cleaning.

headline: No shelving, prep tables, or food handler training
summary: No shelving units or prep tables were on site for food preparation and storage. An ice machine had no backflow device, and employees had no food handler training. The manager was instructed to correct each item.

headline: No employee health policy; no vomit cleanup kit
summary: No written employee health policy was on the premises, and a priority violation was noted. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies were on site. Food handler certificates were not on site, and a certified food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Overflowing dumpster; prior hot water violation uncorrected
summary: The outside dumpster was overflowing with lids not closed, a citation was issued. Milk crates were used for elevation and must be replaced with shelving. A prior hot water violation was not corrected, and a food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Raw meat on cooler floor; corrected on site
summary: Raw meats were stored on the walk-in cooler floor and were elevated by the manager during inspection. Handwashing signage was needed at the front prep sink, and no proof of food handler training was provided.

headline: No valid food manager certificate; no food handler proof
summary: The person in charge did not have a valid city sanitation certificate, and none was posted. Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizing solution, and no proof of food handler training was provided for required employees.

headline: Ice machine dripping black slime onto ice
summary: The kitchen ice machine had black slime dripping onto ice stored below the ice bin, and the ice is used for human consumption. The unit was tagged and must be cleaned and sanitized. Single-service items were also stored on the floor.

headline: Certified managers lacked allergen training
summary: Multiple certified food managers on site did not have allergen training. The inspector instructed all certified food managers to obtain this training and keep proof.

headline: Sewage backs up at basement grease trap
summary: The dish machine appears to be connected directly to the basement grease trap, which may not be allowed. Sewage backed up at the grease trap when the basement three-compartment sink ran. A citation was issued.

headline: Dead black flies at lobby bar insect devices
summary: Dead small black flies had built up in and around insect control devices at the lobby bar. Handwashing signage was missing at several sinks. A coffee machine drain was discharging into a bucket and must be rerouted.

headline: Employees in prep area without hair restraints
summary: Food employees in the prep area were not wearing hair restraints, and management was instructed to require them. Food debris was on floors under the pizza oven and dishwashing equipment, and dust covered restroom fan guards.

headline: No certified manager on site during food prep
summary: No certified manager was on site while pizza and wings were being prepared, and a citation was issued. A three-compartment sink faucet leaked, the grease trap area had standing water, and a wall covering near the walk-in cooler was loose.

headline: Ice scoop stored in ice; manager instructed
summary: An ice scoop was stored in ice, with its handle touching the ice. The manager was instructed to remove it and store it on a clean, non-absorbent surface.

headline: Display cooler door falls off
summary: The display cooler door is in disrepair and falls off when slid open. It must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Stained cardboard on walk-in shelves; greasy fryers
summary: Badly stained cardboard lined shelving in the walk-in cooler and was ordered removed to prevent mold. Grease and food splatter were on deep fryers and the wok station, and the walk-in freezer floor had food debris.

headline: Prep cooler at 57F; low-temp dish machine at 0 ppm
summary: A prep cooler measured 57.2F and was tagged. Eggs, liquid egg, and chicken were held above 41F and discarded. The low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm and was tagged. Hand sinks had low hot water and missing hand-drying supplies.

headline: Meat residue on walk-in cooler shelving
summary: Meat residue was found on walk-in cooler shelving, and dust covered the walk-in cooler fan. The person in charge was instructed to clean both.

headline: Prep cooler at 52.7F and beer cooler at 70F tagged
summary: A two-door prep cooler held at 52.7F and a walk-in beer cooler at 70F were tagged and cannot be used until they reach 41F and are reinspected. A hand sink leaked, and blank health policy forms were on site.

headline: Gaps at exit doors; stained ceiling tiles
summary: Openings were found at the base and middle of rear exit doors and at a front entrance door corner, and they must be sealed. The all-gender restroom door was not self-closing. Stained ceiling tiles and grease buildup were found, and one food handler lacked training proof.

headline: Moldy caulking and inverted pans used for storage
summary: Blackened, moldy caulking at the three-compartment sink must be replaced. Metal food pans were being used to elevate bulk vegetables, and the upper ice machine interior needed cleaning. Certified managers lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Missing mop sink faucet; wet, dirty floors
summary: The mop service sink was missing its faucet and needs to be restored. Floors in the bar area and around the dishwashing area were not clean, and water covered the basement floor.

headline: Dirty cutting board and prep floors
summary: A rear prep cutting board needs detail cleaning or replacement. Prep table sides had food spills, a faucet on the three-compartment sink leaked, and floors in the rear prep area needed detail cleaning.

headline: Slow-draining sink; moldy caulking at sink
summary: A handwashing sink at the rear prep dish area drained extremely slowly and must be repaired. Blackened, moldy caulking at the three-compartment sink must be replaced. Low lighting was noted inside the walk-in freezer.

headline: Plates not inverted; greasy cooking floors
summary: Plates and bowls on a kitchen rack were not inverted after sanitizing. Excess ice covered vents on a pie display cooler, and grease had built up on floors behind and under cooking equipment and fryers.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; flying insects found
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were found on floors, shelves, and pallets, and numerous flying insects were in prep, dish, and storage areas. A citation was issued. The front handwashing sink was inaccessible and draining onto the floor.

headline: Refrigerator held food at 52F; cutting board damaged
summary: A two-door kitchen refrigerator held garlic aioli at 46F and polishes at 52.1F. About 12 lbs valued at $163 was affected, and a citation was issued. A cutting board with deep cuts and stains, plus clutter in storage, were also noted.

headline: Two live roaches found in dishwashing area
summary: Two live roaches were found inside a cardboard box in the dishwashing area, and all roach activity must be removed before reinspection. Pest control service was advised. A three-compartment sink pipe was leaking.

headline: Pastries held at 67F; about 50 lbs discarded
summary: Pastries stored at 67F were discarded, including 50 lbs of cream cheese danishes, about $600 total. A citation was issued. The employee toilet sink had a missing pipe and waste was draining to the floor, so staff must use other restrooms until repaired.

headline: Greasy fryer cabinet; dusty rear dish area
summary: Grease had accumulated inside a fryer cabinet and must be cleaned. Dust covered a vent and the ceiling in the rear dish area, and the person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Unlabeled containers; front door gap
summary: Spices and rice in containers were not labeled. The front entrance door had a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom that must be sealed. Single-use soy sauce containers and grocery bags were used for food storage in freezers and the walk-in cooler.

headline: Incomplete pest logbook; no food handler proof
summary: The pest control logbook lacked required information, and a citation was issued. An employee was not wearing a hair restraint. Food handler training proof was not provided, and a prior violation about shelf elevation was not corrected.

headline: Torn gaskets on front dining area coolers
summary: Gaskets on standing two-door coolers in the front dining area were heavily torn and damaged. Management was instructed to repair or replace all damaged gaskets.

headline: Spills and debris under soda fountain
summary: Spilled liquid was found next to the soda fountain drink station, and debris was underneath it. Management was instructed to clean and maintain the area.

headline: Missing screens and handwashing signs
summary: A fan wall screen was missing, and a rear door was left open without a screen, allowing insect entry. Handwashing signs were missing, and plastic grocery bags were used for food storage. Grease and debris were on coolers and fryer cabinets.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; allergen training missing
summary: A reach-in cooler in the front prep area had a torn door gasket that must be replaced. The all-gender restroom lacked a covered sanitary napkin bin, and a certified food manager lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Torn gasket on prep cooler
summary: A torn door gasket on a one-door prep cooler under the front counter must be replaced. The inspector instructed the restaurant to replace it.

headline: Items stored outside; floor debris and burned bulbs
summary: Items stored outside in the receptacle area must be removed to avoid pest hiding spots. Broken glass and coffee spills were on the second-floor coffee prep floor. Basement prep bulbs were burned out and must be replaced.

headline: No certified manager; sink inaccessible; citation
summary: No certified manager was on site while chicken was prepared; citation issued. The rear prep handwashing sink was inaccessible because its hot water knob is stripped. Repeat burnt-out hood bulbs from 2024 were not corrected.

headline: Food on floor and no training for staff
summary: Food and single-service items were stored on floors, and soiled wiping cloths were left on prep tables. Food debris was on equipment and coolers. Some food handlers and certified managers lacked valid training, and a washroom receptacle was missing.

headline: Mops and boxes on floor; debris in storage
summary: Wet mops were stored on the floor near the rear exit. Boxes were on the floor in the rear dry storage area near the walk-in cooler, and debris was found on floors. Items must be elevated six inches.

headline: Handwashing sink blocked; citation issued
summary: Front handwashing sink near the walk-in freezer was blocked by food containers, with a faucet in poor repair; a citation was issued. Some handwashing sinks lacked signs. Corn husks were stored on the floor.

headline: Weak hot water and missing thermometer
summary: Weak hot water at the fresh meat hand sink and a missing thermometer in the fresh meat display cooler were noted. A deli worker did not have an effective hair restraint. Floors and cooler fans need cleaning.

headline: Labeling and ice machine cleaning needed
summary: Bulk food containers need proper labels. The ice machine interior needs detail cleaning, and knives on the prep line must be stored in a proper container. The hood vent needs grease removal.

headline: Holes in basement floor could hide pests
summary: Holes were found in the basement floor. Management was instructed to seal the openings to eliminate pest hiding places. No pests were noted in this report.

headline: Broken thermometer; training certificates lacking
summary: A thermometer in the two-door prep cooler is not working. A utility sink in the employee restroom lacks a backflow device, and the restroom has no covered trash receptacle. One employee lacks food handler training.

headline: Food on floor and grease buildup
summary: Food was stored on the walk-in freezer floor and must be raised six inches. Debris is around the dumpster, and food spills and grease are under and behind cooking equipment. Expired allergen training was on site.

headline: Food stored on basement floor; burned-out bulbs
summary: Food containers were stored on the basement storage floor. Manager was told to elevate them at least six inches. Two burned-out bulbs were in the hood unit and must be replaced.

headline: Rat droppings and live flies found in basement
summary: About 40 or more rat droppings were found in the basement near a hot water tank and table, plus numerous live small flies. Areas must be cleaned and sanitized, and pest control service is recommended. Also missing signed employee health policies and vomit/diarrhea cleanup procedures.

headline: No certified manager; dishwasher not sanitizing
summary: No certified food manager was on site while beans and fish were handled; citation issued. The bar hand sink had no hot or cold water. The high-temperature dishwasher reached only 142°F and is tagged out of use. Cooked beans lacked discard dates.

headline: Raw beef thawed at room temperature
summary: A full pan of raw beef was thawing at room temperature and food was stored on floors. A female food handler had no hair restraint. Wiping cloths were on equipment. Repeat violation: walk-in cooler lighting is still inadequate; citation issued.

headline: Dirt and debris under refrigeration units
summary: Dirt and debris were found on the floor under and around refrigeration units in the food preparation area. The floor must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Insect traps over sink; hair restraint lapse
summary: Insect traps were hanging over the three-compartment sink. Operator was told to remove them and allow only pest control to install traps. One male food handler lacked a hair restraint. Fryers, floors, and walls need cleaning.

headline: Pork held at 64.9°F; 10 pounds discarded
summary: About 10 pounds of shredded cooked pork was held at 64.9°F on top of the meat cooler and was discarded, valued at $50. Citation issued. Bulk flour and sugar in hot food prep was unlabeled, and several surfaces were unclean.

headline: Gap under rear door; drain water on basement floor
summary: A gap over 1/4 inch under the rear exterior door must be eliminated to keep pests out. Drain plugs at the three-compartment sink are in poor repair. Clean water drains onto the basement floor, and the front customer washroom lacks ventilation.

headline: Splash guard needed; pots too large for sink
summary: A splash guard is needed at the rear prep hand sink. Oversized pots and plastic bins cannot fully fit in the three-compartment sink, so a larger sink or smaller containers are required.

headline: No manager certificate; milk held too warm
summary: No valid food sanitation certificate was posted or provided for the manager on duty; citation issued. Milk held at 48.6 to 49°F was discarded. A small cooler at 49.7 to 50°F was tagged out of use.

headline: Slime in ice machines; citation issued
summary: Black, brown, and pink slime in basement ice machines was dripping onto stored ice used for consumption; citation issued. The manager turned off the machine and removed ice during inspection. Coffee machine backflow device could not be verified.

headline: About 35-40 mouse droppings; dishwasher at 0 ppm
summary: About 35 to 40 mouse droppings were found in prep, storage, and basement areas; citation issued. The dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine and was repaired on site. No certified manager was present while open.

headline: Undercooked menu items lack advisory; citation
summary: The menu lists raw or undercooked items, such as runny eggs, without a consumer advisory; citation issued. No thermometers are inside prep coolers, and one employee lacks food handler training. A certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Open drink, debris, and leaking sinks
summary: An open beverage cup sat on a prep table in the chicken area. Food debris was on fryers and coolers, and several sinks leak. Wall panels are damaged, holes are near the register, and allergen certificates for managers are missing.

headline: No hair restraints; broken light; allergen gap
summary: Food handlers were prepping food without hair restraints. The light housing inside the hood is broken, and a food service sanitation manager lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: Low hot water pressure; missing light shield
summary: Hot water pressure is low at the rear dishwashing handwashing sink and must be repaired. A light fixture in the front prep area is missing its shield.

headline: No hand sign; utensils and sink issues
summary: No handwashing sign at the rear prep sink. Knives stored behind a handwashing sink must be re-washed. Single-service items were not inverted, and multi-use equipment is too large for the three-compartment sink.

headline: Unlabeled bulk ingredients; no handler certificates
summary: Bulk ingredients under a prep table were not labeled with their common name. No food handler certificates were on site for food handlers, and the person in charge was told to require training and keep records.

headline: Missing lids on bar ice bins
summary: Ice bins at the bar were missing lids. Operator was instructed to provide ice bin covers.

headline: Heavy grease buildup; kids' milk calories too high
summary: Heavy grease and food debris cover equipment, shelving, fryer cabinets, and dish racks, and the dish machine must be delimed. Splatter is on walls by the mop sink. The default kids' chocolate milk at 140 calories must be 130 or less.

headline: About 60 mouse droppings; citation issued
summary: About 60 mouse droppings were found near the rear exit door and along the three-compartment sink pipe; citation issued. Droppings must be removed and areas sanitized. A fryer is greasy, the faucet leaks, and the toilet room door does not self-close.

headline: Dirty floor drains in rear prep
summary: Dirt and debris were found on floor drains in the rear prep area. The drains must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Dish machine interior and manager allergen training
summary: The interior of the high-temperature dish machine must be cleaned. The manager has been missing allergen training since 2023; citation issued and verification must be kept on site.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; repaired on site
summary: The low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine; it was repaired on site and then sanitized at 100 ppm. A citation was issued. The menu lacks an undercooked-food advisory, and the women's washroom needs covered receptacles.

headline: Dead and live roaches; flies found
summary: Dead roaches were found in prep, dining, and storage areas, and dead flies by the west dining window. A live roach was crawling on a dining table. Manager was told to call an exterminator and clean all areas; citation issued.

headline: Handwashing sink spills water onto floor
summary: Water spills from the side of the handwashing sink when it is in use and pools on the floor. Operator was instructed to repair and maintain the sink.

headline: No manager certificate posted; hot water restored
summary: No certified food manager certificate was posted while TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. No hot water was running during inspection and was restored. Leaks were found at two sinks.

headline: High-temperature dishmachine removed
summary: The high-temperature dishmachine was removed. Management must provide one with a final rinse of 180°F or higher. This is a priority violation, but no citation was issued.

headline: Unlabeled flour and sugar; dirty dishmachine
summary: A bulk food container with flour or sugar has no label. The exterior of the dishmachine is not clean.

headline: Splash guard needed at basement sink
summary: A splash guard must be installed at the basement dishwashing handwashing sink, or the clean dish shelf next to it must be removed.

headline: About 75 mouse droppings; unsafe food temperatures
summary: About 75 or more mouse droppings were found in the fryer cabinet, under shelving, and in the toilet room, with about 25 live large flies. Gyros at 78.8°F and coleslaw at 45.1 to 48.4°F were discarded. Sanitizer read 0.0 ppm; citation issued.

headline: About 30 mouse droppings; sink blocked
summary: About 30 or more mouse droppings were found behind the grease trap, on the sales floor, and by the mop sink; citation issued. The front prep handwashing sink was blocked by pans and lids. No signed health policies or vomit cleanup procedure.

headline: Restroom faucets shut off too fast; no test kit
summary: Men's restroom faucets shut off immediately and must run for at least 15 seconds. No chlorine test kit for the dish machine; priority violation and citation issued. Torn gaskets, ice machine residue, and food splatter were also noted.

headline: Hair restraint lapse and repeat violation
summary: A cook prepared food without a hair restraint, and containers in the second-floor prep area need labels. Rusty cooler shelving and peeling basement ceiling paint were noted. A repeat violation for missing allergen training was cited.

headline: Unlabeled sugar and chipped walls
summary: Bulk sugar containers were not labeled. A chipped wall behind a basement prep table needs a smooth, durable surface. Lighting in the basement walk-in cooler was inadequate.

headline: Fly screen and paper towel placement
summary: The back door fly screen must be fully attached to the frame to prevent pest entry. The paper towel dispenser above the sandwich prep cooler must be moved to prevent contamination from wet hands.

headline: Ice machine interior needs cleaning
summary: Ice machine interior needs detail cleaning to remove buildup. New cutting boards are needed in the rear prep area. Basement dry storage floor needs cleaning under stairs and in corners.

headline: Multiple sink, cleaning, and training issues
summary: No handwashing signs were posted, and the three-compartment sink leaks and lacks stoppers. Grease buildup, dirty floors, and interior of reach-in coolers need cleaning. Raw wood must be replaced and no employees have food handler certificates.

headline: Ice machine buildup; no internal thermometer
summary: Buildup was found inside the produce-area ice machine; ice is not used for consumption. The rotisserie hot food display has no internal thermometer, so an ambient air thermometer should be used. Cardboard is on dairy shelves.

headline: Food debris and dirt throughout facility
summary: Accumulated food debris was on cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, freezers, and shelving. Dirt and debris were found along baseboards and floor corners. Manager was instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Dirty shelves and floors behind cook line
summary: Shelves at the front cook line are not clean and have food debris. Floors behind the cook line have dirt and grease buildup. Operator was instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: No person in charge; no certified manager
summary: No person in charge was on site at inspection; the manager arrived at 9:10 AM. Pizza and wings were prepared without a certified manager; citation issued. A dish area handwashing sink was blocked, and wastewater drains into it.

headline: Slow drain; dishwasher not sanitizing
summary: Handwashing sink drains extremely slowly; citation issued. The three-compartment sink was only washing and rinsing utensils, not sanitizing them; citation issued. Several holes were noted in the kitchen wall base.

headline: Cardboard shelf liners and missing backflow device
summary: Cardboard was used as shelf liner throughout and must be removed. The utility sink near the three-compartment sink lacks a backflow prevention device. Debris was found on the rear storage floor.

headline: Toilet door not self-closing; allergen training missing
summary: Toilet room door in the rear food prep area does not self-close. No lidded container was on site for feminine products, and basement clutter was noted. Certified managers' allergen training certificate was not on site.

headline: Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer
summary: Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizing solution when not in use. Storage shelves, a rear cabinet, cooking equipment, and storage floors need detail cleaning. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Ice buildup in freezers; leaking sink faucet
summary: Ice buildup and debris were found inside reach-in deep freezers and must be cleaned. A three-compartment sink faucet leaks. Coolers lack working thermometers, and the hood needs debris removed. Manager's allergen certificate has expired.

headline: Detail cleaning needed in equipment and floors
summary: A large can opener needs detail cleaning. Rear prep floors need spill and buildup removal along wall bases, and hood filters need grease and dust cleaned.

headline: No service sink; mop water thrown outside
summary: Facility has no service sink, and staff throw mop water outside or into the toilet; citation issued. Milk crates are used as shelving. The three-compartment sink leaks, and no certified manager has allergen training. Documentation is required.

headline: Overflowing dumpsters; opening under rear door
summary: An opening at the bottom of the rear exit door must be sealed to prevent pests. Two outside garbage receptacles were overflowing with open lids; citation issued. Floors under cooking equipment and the dishwasher drain need cleaning.

headline: Over 100 mouse and rat droppings; milk too warm
summary: About 100 or more mouse and rat droppings were found on shelving, cat and dog food, and floors; citation issued. About 15 gallons of milk at 45.1 to 45.3°F were discarded. Gaps under front and rear doors need sealing.

headline: Dirty floors and drains; pest prevention needed
summary: Dried blood or spillage was under meat shelving in the second-floor walk-in cooler. Dirt and grease are under fryers and equipment, and dirt is on the front bar floor. Kitchen drains need cleaning to prevent pests.

headline: Rat droppings; no certified manager; citation
summary: Over 20 rat droppings were found near a freezer in the sales area and in the rear storage area; exterminator needed, and citation issued. No certified manager was present while ground beef was served. A door gap and a fly strip were also noted.

headline: Debris under dishwashing sink
summary: Dirt and debris were found on the floor under the three-compartment sink in the rear dishwashing area. The floor must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Food debris and spills throughout facility
summary: Food debris and spills were found on floors and surfaces throughout. A raw wood wall in the rear prep area must be sealed or painted. Operator was told to deep clean and increase cleaning frequency.

headline: Unlabeled spices; rust; grease on floors
summary: Spices outside their packaging at the wok station were not labeled. A cutting board has deep grooves, and walk-in cooler racks are rusty. Floors under fryers and coolers have grease, food, dirt, and droppings (type not specified). Walls and ceilings need cleaning.

headline: Slimy ice machine; repeat violation; citation
summary: Black slimy substance was found inside the ice machine and dripped onto ice; the manager was told to clean it, and a citation was issued. A dish machine data plate is still missing, a thermometer is missing, and some food handler certificates are expired.

headline: Plates not inverted; slow drain
summary: Serving plates on kitchen shelves were not inverted and risk dust accumulation. The women's restroom handwashing sink drains slowly and must be repaired.

headline: Meat thawing in plastic container
summary: Frozen meat was thawing in a plastic container in the food prep area. Food was stored on the walk-in freezer floor, and soiled mop heads were not hung to dry. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Large gap under patio door
summary: The patio exit door has a 1 to 1.5 inch opening at the bottom and must be sealed to prevent pests. Grease and food debris are inside the deep fryer and under the grill. A three-compartment faucet leaks.

headline: Over 10 mouse droppings; door gap
summary: Over 10 mouse droppings were found on the floor near the water tank; citation issued. Manager was told to call an exterminator and clean all areas. The rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap, and food was stored in grocery bags inside coolers.

headline: No bodily fluid cleanup kit; ice machine cleaned
summary: No bodily fluid cleanup kit or procedures were on site; citation issued. Black and pink slimy buildup in the ice machine was cleaned on site by an employee. One of three restrooms has a toilet that would not flush.

headline: Inoperable sink and thermometer; many repairs
summary: Rooftop men's restroom middle sink is not operable, and a hot-holding cabinet thermometer does not work. Other repairs include splash guards, worn cutting boards, grease buildup, and cleaning of floors and dishwashing walls.

headline: Debris and dust on floors throughout
summary: Loose debris, dirt, and dust were found on floors and corners throughout the facility. Detail cleaning and more frequent floor cleaning are required.

headline: No certified manager during pizza and wing service
summary: No certified food manager was present while pizzas and chicken wings were being prepared and served. Management was told a certified manager must be present at all times. Citation issued.

headline: Dumpster lids open; debris and spillage
summary: The outside dumpster lids could not close because trash was overflowing; priority violation and citation issued. Debris was found under counters and in prep cabinets. Spillage was under walk-in cooler shelving, and coffee grounds and dust lined walls.

headline: Mouse droppings found; repeat violation
summary: About 30 mouse droppings were found in the liquor storage area and 2 behind the bar freezer. Additional pest control is needed, and a citation was issued. Ice machine had thick slime dripping onto ice used for drinks.

headline: Aluminum foil lining on shelves and equipment
summary: Inspector found aluminum foil lining storage shelves, the stove top exterior, and attached piping. Management was told to remove all foil so surfaces are smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Wet wiping cloths on prep counters
summary: Wet wiping cloths were stored on rear prep counters and must be kept in sanitizing solution when not in use. Floors under and between cooking equipment need food debris removed and a detail clean.

headline: No mop sink in facility
summary: The facility has no mop sink. The manager was instructed to install one.

headline: Cooked food missing discard dates; no pest log
summary: Cooked chicken and macaroni in the walk-in and prep cooler had no discard date; cook said the food was placed four days earlier. No licensed pest control service or log book was on site.

headline: Food debris in bar sinks and floor
summary: Food debris and spills were found inside the bar three-compartment sink and gun holders. Food debris is on the bar floor, which must be cleaned and kept dry.

headline: About 70 rodent droppings; no certified manager
summary: About 70 small rodent droppings were found under chip racks in the grocery area and between shelves in prep. Pest control is recommended; citation issued. No certified manager was on site during TCS food prep, and no food handler certificates were available.

headline: No health policy or food handler certificates
summary: No employee health policy or training was on site; citation issued. Three of four kitchen handwashing sinks lacked signs. Gaskets on a reach-in cooler and freezer are torn, and floors and the handwashing sink drain need attention.

headline: Shrimp thawed on counter; handwashing aids moved
summary: Breaded shrimp was thawed on the countertop; the operator must thaw under refrigeration or cold running water. Handwashing signs, soap, and paper towel dispensers must be removed from the mop sink and prep sink.

headline: No food handler certificates provided on site
summary: Inspector found no food handler training certificates for the female and male food handlers. Operator was instructed to meet the requirement for all food handlers.

headline: No employee health policy or vomit cleanup kit
summary: No employee health policy and no vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit were on site; both are priority violations. Front door has an unsealed gap and the rear door needs a sweep. Basement and garage clutter must be removed.

headline: Repeat violations; buildup and leaks
summary: Repeat core violations from 2023 were not corrected, including leaking pipe, mold, damaged tiles, and chipping ceiling paint; citation issued. Grease and food buildup covers fryers and equipment. Allergen training for the manager is missing.

headline: Food handler training gaps; repeat violation
summary: Some food handlers lack the required training certificates. A 2022 core violation was not corrected; citation issued. Dust is on ventilation fans in both washrooms, and all managers must obtain allergen training.

headline: Missing signs, backflow device, and waste receptacle
summary: No handwashing signs at prep and dish area sinks, and no backflow device on the utility sink. A dipper well drains into a handwashing sink, and the washroom lacks a covered receptacle. Peeling floor paint and missing light shields were noted.

headline: Pizza cooler too warm; 20 pounds discarded
summary: Pizza prep cooler held food at 51.3 to 55.9°F and reached only 64.5°F; cooler was tagged and held. About 20 pounds, valued at $100, was discarded. Citation issued; other coolers must be used until repaired.

headline: No health policies; no grease trap
summary: No signed employee health policies or vomit/diarrhea cleanup items were on site; priority violations, no citation issued. The three-compartment sink pipe leaks, no grease trap is on site, and grill ventilation is inadequate. One manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Beef held at 50°F; 20 pounds discarded
summary: About 20 pounds of sliced Italian beef, valued at $150, was held at 50°F in the walk-in cooler and was discarded. A second cooler at 55°F must not be used until reinspected. Citation issued.

headline: Deli cups not air dried
summary: Deli cups were not air dried after washing and stacking. Operator was instructed to air dry all multi-use utensils.

headline: No chemical sanitizer or test strips on site
summary: No chemical sanitizer was on site to clean and sanitize dishes; this is a priority violation. No chemical test strips were available to test sanitizer in the three-compartment sink; also a priority violation.

headline: Employee touched food with contaminated gloves
summary: An employee wiped their nose while wearing gloves, then touched plated ready-to-eat food without changing gloves or washing hands; citation issued. Employees were eating and drinking in the prep area. Wiping cloths and cutting boards also need attention.

headline: Insect control device near food prep
summary: An insect control device is installed above equipment and a food prep cart near the kitchen entrance and must be moved to prevent contamination. Dry storage floor is soiled with dried spills and debris under shelving.

headline: Live flies found; clogged handwashing sink
summary: About 10 large and 10 small live flies were on the dish rack, in the bar, and on prep walls and ceilings; citation issued. The front prep handwashing sink is clogged; citation issued. Food handlers also lacked hair restraints.

headline: No covered feminine hygiene receptacle
summary: The unisex staff toilet room has no covered receptacle for feminine hygiene products. Manager was instructed to provide and maintain one.

headline: Ceiling and wall damage with dark substance
summary: A ceiling opening near the restroom had a black, slimy-looking substance on the wall, and a wall hole is near the rear exit. Both must be repaired and cleaned. Trash, debris, and gravel were found under shelving.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; no allergen certificate
summary: Bulk salt and sugar containers were not labeled. An ice scoop was stored on top of ice cubes at the bar. Deli cups were not air-dried. The food service manager had no allergen training certificate.

headline: Pest log missing; food stored on basement floors
summary: No maintained pest control logbook with recent service reports or a license number was on site. Only a September 2024 online report was available. Food boxes and equipment were on basement floors. A priority citation was issued.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate while handling food
summary: No one on site had a valid City of Chicago sanitation certificate while temperature-sensitive (TCS) foods were handled and served. A certified person must be present at all times. Refrigerator interiors need cleaning and a water leak behind the ice machine needs repair.

headline: Food stored in bags and cans; missing thermometers
summary: Food was stored in grocery bags and tin cans inside coolers. Refrigeration units lacked working thermometers. A rear two-door unit had no light. Staff were instructed to correct all three.

headline: Hot food held below safe temperatures
summary: Eggs at 120°F, sausage patties at 130°F, and sausage gravy at 120°F were held in hot holding units. Management must keep hot food above 135°F; a priority citation was issued. An outside dumpster lacked a lid.

headline: Pest gap, missing thermometers, and missing signage
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the entrance door could let pests in; none were seen. Coolers lacked thermometers, and handwashing signs, a backflow device, and covered waste bins were missing. A sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No certified manager; sink hot water too cool
summary: Food handlers prepared chicken wings, milk, and eggs without a certified manager on site (citation). Hot water at the front prep hand sink measured 69.2°F; it must be at least 100°F (citation). A prior violation for missing food handler training remains uncorrected.

headline: Unlabeled sandwiches; debris and pest-harborage issues
summary: Packaged sandwiches in the display cooler were not labeled. Single-service items were stored on the floor. The three-compartment sink has only one stopper. The utility sink lacks a backflow device, and the washroom lacks a covered receptacle.

headline: Scratched cutting boards and dirty floors
summary: Several cutting boards in the rear prep area have deep scratches and stains and must be resurfaced or replaced. Floors under dry storage shelving and the three-compartment sink are dirty. Two employees lack food handler certificates.

headline: Food on floor; no hair restraint; overflowing dumpster
summary: Chicken wings were stored on the walk-in freezer floor, and food was in grocery bags. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. The dumpster was overloaded and its lids would not close (priority citation). The certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Hand sink obstructed; no sink stoppers
summary: The prep kitchen hand sink was blocked by utensils, bags, and a table; it must stay unobstructed (priority violation). The three-compartment sink lacks stoppers. Walls behind a small prep area are not easily cleanable.

headline: Ice machine buildup and missing grease trap
summary: Slight buildup inside the upper ice machine must be cleaned. A core violation from March 2024 was not corrected: no grease trap is connected to the three-compartment sink. It must be fixed by reinspection.

headline: Grocery bags in coolers; missing trash lid
summary: Grocery bags were used for food storage in chest freezers and reach-in coolers; food-grade bags are required. An AC drain pipe drips onto the ground. The women's washroom trash can lacks a lid. No allergen certificate was on site.

headline: Cold foods too warm; cold unit tagged
summary: Ham at 48.0°F, sliced tomatoes at 44.5°F, and cheese at 46.0°F were in a small cold unit. The manager discarded 7 lbs ($35). The unit at 56.0°F was tagged and must be repaired before use. A restroom receptacle needs a cover.

headline: Door gap, dirty equipment, and ceiling damage
summary: No pests were found, but a 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door could let them in. Rusty prep tables, food debris, dust, and a water-damaged, peeling ceiling in rear storage were also noted.

headline: Damaged cooler gaskets and littered beer cooler floor
summary: Prep cooler door gaskets were ripped or damaged and must be repaired or replaced. The walk-in beer keg cooler floor, including under shelves and in corners, was littered and must be cleaned.

headline: Handwashing signs needed; items above load line
summary: The employee-area washroom needs handwashing signs. Several items were stored above the load line in reach-in coolers. Worn sponges were in the deli. The bakery dish machine needs service for a dish soap alarm.

headline: Missing handwashing signage; no drain boards
summary: Handwashing sinks in the bar, rear preparation, and communal areas lacked signage. The rear three-compartment sink had no drain boards for air-drying clean equipment.

headline: No certified manager on site while handling food
summary: The person in charge lacked a City of Chicago certified manager certificate and must obtain and post it. No certified manager was on site while milk and soft-serve mix were handled. A citation was issued.

headline: Openings in front doors; floor buildup
summary: Openings in both front double doors must be sealed. No pests were found. Boxes were on the floor, and water cases were stored on soda crates. A wet mop was stored in a bucket. Dust and dark buildup need cleaning.

headline: Mice, flies, and missing certificates and supplies
summary: About 30 to 40 mouse droppings were at front storage shelves, and 10 to 12 flies were by the water heater. No sanitation certificate, health policy, vomit cleanup kit, or stem thermometer was on site. Several citations were issued.

headline: Toilet room has no ventilation
summary: The toilet room has no ventilation. Management was instructed to provide mechanical ventilation and maintain it.

headline: Debris buildup in ice hopper and coffee cooler
summary: Dried food debris coated the ice hopper at the bar, which was not in use. The coffee cooler interior had dried food and liquid spills. A handwashing sink wall seal was in poor repair. Staff were instructed to clean.

headline: Broken freezer chest lid
summary: A basement freezer chest lid had completely broken hinges and was not attached. The manager was instructed to repair it.

headline: No certified manager while eggs and milk prepared
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager was on site while eggs and milk, which are potentially hazardous foods, were prepared and served. A citation was issued. No pest control contract was available. Debris was under shelving.

headline: Live roaches; food and cooler temperatures too warm
summary: Live roach activity and a roach carcass were found. Cold foods were held at 44 to 49°F; 10 lbs of chorizo and 5 lbs of cheese were discarded. A cooler at 52°F was tagged. The three-compartment sink floods when one side drains. Citations issued.

headline: No raw food consumer advisory on menu
summary: The menu board lacked a consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods (priority citation). Torn gaskets are on the three-door prep cooler. Storage was on the floor and in the utility area. No allergen certificate was on site since 2023.

headline: No sanitizer test strips or metal thermometer
summary: No chlorine sanitizer test strips were on site. The person in charge borrowed chlorine from a neighboring business during inspection. No metal stem thermometer was available to check food temperatures.

headline: Three live roaches found under soda dispenser
summary: Three live roaches were found under the self-serve soda dispensing machine. Roach activity must be eliminated, and pest control is recommended. A priority citation was issued.

headline: Hair restraints missing; spills and leaks
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Food spills and debris were on prep tables, shelving, coolers, and freezers. A hand sink faucet leaks, and the ice machine and utility sink lack backflow devices.

headline: Cardboard shelf liners and greasy hood
summary: Cardboard was used as a liner on wire shelving and must be removed. The hood and filters had grease and dust buildup and must be cleaned.

headline: Compressor leak; untidy receiving area
summary: A compressor in the meat processing area leaks and must be repaired. Floors in the receiving area, produce cooler, deli, and meat cooler need cleaning. The receiving area must be organized.

headline: Dirty ice machine, coolers, and restroom
summary: The ice machine interior must be cleaned. Prep cooler interiors are dirty, and walk-in cooler shelves need cleaning. The washroom needs detail cleaning. Floors, drains, and ceiling tiles are dusty or dirty.

headline: Unsafe cold food temperatures and slimy ice machine
summary: Fish at 52.2°F, beef at 47.8°F, and pork at 46.4°F were held in a prep cooler; 18 lbs were discarded ($150). Slime buildup dripped onto ice. A hand sink was blocked by chips and pepper containers. Citations issued.

headline: Slight debris inside ice machine panel
summary: Slight debris had built up on the interior panel of the ice machine. It must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: No cold water at toilet-room sink; labeling needed
summary: The toilet-room hand sink had no cold running water, and the front prep sink drains slowly. A thermometer is needed for the front prep refrigerator. Repackaged ice bags need labels. Crates must be removed from walk-in shelving.

headline: No hair restraint; soiled cloths; cardboard liners
summary: A food handler prepared food without a hair restraint. Soiled wiping cloths were stored on prep tables. Cardboard was used as shelf liner, and duct tape was used to repair a freezer. Heavy grease and food are on walls and floors.

headline: Person in charge's manager certificate expired
summary: The person in charge's City of Chicago certified food manager certificate had expired. Management must provide a valid, updated certificate. Priority foundation violation; no citation issued.

headline: Rodent droppings found throughout kitchen areas
summary: Rodent droppings were found behind cooking equipment, inside fryers, in mop sink corners, and along the bakery wall. A priority citation was issued and pest control is required. Unlabeled desserts and a missing hair restraint were also cited.

headline: One employee lacked food handler training
summary: One employee was working without food handler training. All employees must complete training, and records must be kept on site at all times.

headline: Rusted shelving near dish area
summary: Rusted shelving near the dish area must be repainted or replaced.

headline: Deep freezer needs defrosting and cleaning
summary: The deep freezer in the prep area must be defrosted and its interior cleaned.

headline: Hair restraints and sanitizer test strips missing
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. No sanitizer test strips were on site; staff were told to obtain them (priority violation). A restroom door was left open next to the prep kitchen.

headline: No certified manager while handling chicken and soup
summary: No certified manager was on site while chicken and soup were handled, and no certificate was posted (citation). The person in charge lacked a certificate. Prior violations remain: no covered restroom receptacle, nonworking ventilation, and no allergen training (citation).

headline: Dish machine sanitizing at 0 ppm
summary: The low-temperature dish machine was sanitizing at 0 ppm. It was tagged and held for Chicago Department of Public Health inspection and must not be used until re-inspected. Citation issued.

headline: No health policy, thermometer, or current pest records
summary: No written employee health policy was on the premises (citation). No metal stem thermometer was available for cold foods (citation). The pest logbook's last inspection was in 2021. The hand sink cold water handle is broken.

headline: Food handler and allergen certificates missing
summary: No food handler training certificates were on site, and those shown had expired in 2023. No allergen certificates were provided for certified managers. Sink stoppers, drain cleaning, and floor matting were also cited.

headline: Milk crates used for dish storage; no allergen certificate
summary: Milk crates were used to store clean dishes and must be removed. Drains had residue buildup. The certified manager had no allergen training certificate on site.

headline: Moldy produce discarded; dead rodent on trap
summary: Produce and hot dogs with visible mold were voluntarily discarded (citation). Salsa verde and sour cream lacked discard dates. A dead rodent was on a sticky trap in basement storage. Produce was on the floor.

headline: Leaking drainpipes under two sinks
summary: Drainpipes leaked under the handwashing sink next to the mop sink and at the three-compartment sink. Management was instructed to repair them.

headline: No paper towels; no pest logbook; low water pressure
summary: The prep-area hand sink had no paper towels (priority violation). No pest control logbook with recent service reports or license number was on site. Low water pressure at the three-compartment and hand sinks was not corrected.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink and dirty floors
