summary: The bottom of the three-compartment sink leaks and must be repaired. Floors in prep, dining, and washrooms need cleaning. To-go shelving and countertops also need cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled containers and missing allergen certificate
summary: Food storage containers lacked common-name labels. A women's restroom trash bin had no lid. A certified food manager had no allergen training certificate.

headline: Rodent droppings in hand sink; sink blocked
summary: About 30 rodent droppings were inside the customer-area hand sink. Additional pest control is needed (priority citation). The hand sink was blocked by a chest freezer and clothing. Two aerosol bug spray ccans were in prep and storage areas.

headline: Crates used for storage; wood shelves; clutter
summary: Crates used for food storage in the rear storage area, walk-in cooler, and freezer must be replaced with shelving. Wood shelves in the walk-in cooler must be sealed. Clutter in front of dish sinks must be organized. Food handlers need training.

headline: No thermometer in rear refrigerator; cardboard used
summary: No ambient air thermometer is inside the rear refrigerator by the three-compartment sink. Broken-down cardboard boxes were used behind equipment, on floors, in the toilet room, and beside cold holding units. They must be removed.

headline: No health policy, vomit kit, or pest logbook
summary: No employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit, metal stem thermometer, pest control logbook, or chemical test kit was on site. Hand sink signage is missing, and a light is burnt out over the hood.

headline: No allergen training certificate on site
summary: No proof of allergen training certificate was on site. The facility must meet requirements for all City of Chicago sanitation managers.

headline: No paper towels at kitchen hand sink
summary: The main kitchen hand-wash sink had no paper towels (priority violation). Cheese and sour cream tubs were reused as food storage containers and must be replaced with proper containers.

headline: Grease buildup on hood and filters
summary: Grease buildup on the ventilation hood and filters above cooking equipment must be cleaned.

headline: Unsafe food temperatures; product discarded
summary: Soup in a refrigerator read 127.1°F. Cold foods were 47.8 to 55.8°F, including tofu, curry soup, and beef. The manager voluntarily discarded 51 lbs (about $400). A prep cooler at 54.6°F was ordered out of use.

headline: Oversized pots cannot be washed in sink
summary: Oversized pots do not fit the three-compartment sink. A larger sink, removal of the pots, or a written washing procedure is required (priority citation). Clean linens were stored on the floor, and soiled mop heads were improperly stored.

headline: Dish machine exterior not clean
summary: The exterior of the dish machine was not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Dishware not inverted; allergen certificate missing
summary: Plates, bowls, and pans in the main prep area were not inverted after sanitizing. A certified food manager had no proof of allergen training. All managers must obtain it.

headline: No certified person in charge on premises
summary: No person in charge with a valid City of Chicago sanitation certificate was on site. One must be present during all operating hours (citation). Food debris was under a cold holding unit and inside a floor drain under a hand sink.

headline: Dirty fryers, walk-in fans, and vents
summary: Deep fryers need detail cleaning of grease and debris. Walk-in cooler fans need detail cleaning. Some rear air vents also need detail cleaning.

headline: Oversized bowl and nonworking toilet-room ventilation
summary: A mixing bowl is too large for the three-compartment sink. The person in charge must provide a written alternate washing procedure. The employee toilet room has inoperable mechanical ventilation that must be repaired.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; leaking hand sink
summary: Milk crates used as shelving in storage areas must be replaced with shelving at least six inches off the floor. The dish-area hand sink leaks heavily from its pipes. Floor tiles are missing or damaged in the rear prep and dish area.

headline: Grease and dust on hood filters
summary: Hood filters in the hot prep area had dust and grease buildup. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: No allergen training for food managers
summary: City of Chicago food managers have no allergen training. Management must complete it and keep the certificate on site.

headline: No health policy, pest logbook, or food handler certificates
summary: No verifiable employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit, pest control logbook, or sanitizer test devices were on site. A leaking grease trap drained wastewater onto the prep floor. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Unclean ice machine and missing food handler certificate
summary: Debris inside the ice machine must be removed and the machine detail cleaned. A hand sink had low water pressure. A food handler lacked a certificate. A prior door gasket violation was not fixed by the 6/24/2025 deadline.

headline: Grease on rotisserie ovens; dirty floors
summary: Grease and food debris on the top and rear ledge of the rotisserie chicken ovens must be cleaned. The floor under sandwich prep equipment and the fish department walk-in freezer also need cleaning.

headline: Ice machine interior unclean; broken baseboard
summary: The top interior of the ice machine was not clean and must be cleaned and sanitized. A broken baseboard tile and a hole covered with duct tape were near the ice machine. Two core violations were noted as corrected.

headline: Trash receptacles missing near hand sinks
summary: Trash receptacles were missing near hand sinks in prep areas where refuse is generated. The facility was instructed to provide and maintain them.

headline: Grease and debris under deep fryer and floor drain
summary: Grease and food debris were on floors and walls under and around the deep fryer at The Olive food station. The floor drain in the same prep area also needs cleaning.

headline: No food handler certificates; restroom and storage gaps
summary: No food handler certificates were on site. Bulk containers lacked common-name labels. Restrooms lacked handwashing signs and a covered receptacle. Walk-in cooler items were stored on the floor.

headline: Dust on vents; dirty cold-unit interiors
summary: Staff were instructed to clean the interiors of refrigeration units, prep tables, and bulk containers. Dust was on ceiling vents, light shields, and the washroom vent. Floors under cooking equipment and inside the walk-in cooler need cleaning.

headline: Revolving door not rodent-proof; one-inch gap
summary: The revolving entrance door has a one-inch gap at the bottom and is not rodent-proof. It must be made tight-fitting. A priority violation from a 2022 inspection remains uncorrected. No pests were found.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training; uncorrected
summary: A certified food manager has no allergen training certificate. A core violation from October 2023 was not corrected. Managers must show proof of training. A priority citation was issued.

headline: Manager lacks certification; bulbs out
summary: A manager without City of Chicago certification was on site while ice cream and cookies were prepared. A priority citation was issued. The walk-in freezer floor and facility floors need detail cleaning. Several bulbs are out.

headline: Hand sink signage missing; water only 94.1°F
summary: The prep sink had no handwashing signage. A men's room hand dryer was not working, but towels were provided on site. Hand sink water measured 94.1°F; it must reach at least 100°F (priority citation). No food handler proof was shown.

headline: Raw chicken stored above ready-to-eat foods
summary: Raw chicken and raw eggs were stored above or touching cooked beans, plantains, lettuce, and cut fruit. All affected foods were removed. A priority citation was issued. A cook lacked food handler training proof.

headline: Unused equipment and dirty floors need attention
summary: Unused fryers, refrigeration, and hot holding units must be cleaned and stored so they do not cause a pest concern. Floors under the unused equipment in the cooking area were unclean.

headline: Live roach and about 50 mouse droppings found
summary: One live roach was found in rear storage, and about 50 mouse droppings were in the rear dry storage. The affected areas must be removed, detail cleaned, and pest control called (priority citation). Hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Missing hair restraints and allergen training
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. The sanitation manager had no allergen training. Management must provide both.

headline: Door gap; damaged gaskets; dirty cooler doors
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the front entrance door must be rodent-proofed; no pests were seen. Damaged prep cooler gaskets must be repaired. Dirt and debris are inside rear prep cooler doors and hinges.

headline: Door gap and grocery bags used for storage
summary: A gap at the bottom of the outer dim sum kitchen door must be rodent-proofed; no pests were seen. Grocery bags were used for food storage in walk-in coolers and freezers. Cooler gaskets and fryers need repair and cleaning.

headline: Certified managers lack valid allergen training
summary: No valid allergen training was on file for certified managers. All certified managers must provide valid allergen training.

headline: No certified manager while handling TCS foods
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while yogurt and ice cream (TCS foods) were handled. The person was instructed to obtain one. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint.

headline: No health policy or food handler training proof
summary: No written employee health policy was verified by staff (priority citation). No food handler training proof was shown for any employee. A sink leaks into a bucket. A freezer lid and walk-in handle were repaired with duct tape.

headline: Ice buildup in display freezers; dirty floors
summary: Ice buildup inside small display freezers must be defrosted and cleaned. Washroom fixtures need cleaning. Rear storage and cooking area floors and walls need cleaning, and so does the grease trap. Hood filters have grease and debris.

headline: About 20 flies; no handwashing sink or supplies
summary: About 20 large flies were on walls and tables in the rear prep area. The front dining area lacked a handwashing sink where tortillas are made by hand. No valid certified manager, vomit cleanup supplies, or pest logbook was on site. Citations issued.

headline: No food handler training certificates on site
summary: No food handler training certificates were on site. Employee names must be provided. A salad cooler door gasket was not tight-fitting and must be fixed.

headline: Unlocked cooler in dining area; leaking pipe
summary: A two-door cold unit in the dining area had no lock or signage marking it as employees-only. Water leaks from a ceiling pipe in the downstairs prep area. The grease trap is in poor repair and wrapped in plastic. Ceiling tiles are damaged.

headline: Missing handwashing signage in employee restroom
summary: The employee restroom had no handwashing signage. Management was instructed to provide and maintain it.

headline: No self-closing washroom door; food handler certificate missing
summary: The washroom door has no self-closing device. An employee was working without a food handler certificate. The facility must show proof of training for all food handlers.

headline: Blank health policy; prep cooler at 55.1°F tagged
summary: Blank copies of the employee health policy were on site; signed copies are required. A rear prep cooler held at 55.1°F, was tagged, and must not be used until repaired and re-inspected. A faucet leaks and the ice machine lacks a backflow device.

headline: Roof leaks drip onto grill where chicken is cooked
summary: Rain from roof leaks was dripping onto the grill where chicken was being cooked. All leaks must be fixed (priority citation). Storage racks in the walk-in cooler are rusty, and the hot holding unit and bulk containers are dirty.

headline: Torn gaskets; dirty microwave, ice machine, and fryers
summary: Torn door gaskets on the two-door prep cooler by the grill must be replaced. The microwave, ice machine, and deep fryers need interior cleaning. A non-working washroom ventilation fan must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Ice machine buildup; unlabeled meat containers
summary: Buildup was found inside the right side of the ice machine and must be cleaned. Meat was stored in gray cans not marked as food grade. Debris was on the floor beside the hot water tank in the furnace room.

headline: Ice machine heavily soiled; citation issued
summary: Heavy black and gray slime was inside the basement ice machine and dripping onto ice. Ice must be discarded, and the machine cleaned and sanitized. Citation issued. Rice scoops were stored in standing water; food storage is on the floor.

headline: Sink stopper broken; manager needs allergen certificate
summary: The three-compartment sink stopper is in poor repair and cannot hold water. A food service manager lacked an allergen training certificate and must obtain one.

headline: Sink blocked by utensils; thermometers inaccurate
summary: Spatulas and spoons were placed in a prep handwashing sink, which must be kept clear. Food thermometers are inaccurate by 12 degrees and must be replaced. The ice maker lacks a backflow prevention device.

headline: Soiled linens outside; taped sink nozzle
summary: Soiled linens were kept in an open container on the patio. Raw wood was used to hold an unused soda system. The three-compartment sink nozzle was repaired with tape, which is not allowed. Unused soda system must be removed.

headline: Improper hand-washing and no hot water
summary: A food handler washed hands with gloves on; the manager was told to fix this. Some restroom sinks had no hot water, one at 48°F; hot water was restored on the third floor during inspection. Food handlers also lacked hair restraints.

headline: Ice machine debris; dirty floors; missing thermometer
summary: Slight encrusted debris was inside the ice machine and must be removed. No thermometer was in the one-door refrigerator. Dirty floors with spilled debris and coffee beans under the front counter must be cleaned.

headline: Dirty beverage nozzles; expired food handler cleanup
summary: Beverage dispenser nozzles were covered in buildup. Wiping cloths need fresher sanitizing solution. Food spills on shelves and equipment need cleaning. Prior core violations for single-service items on the floor and clutter were not corrected.

headline: No certified manager; dirty floors and walls
summary: The person in charge lacked a City of Chicago food sanitation certificate, and no certified food manager was on site while chicken, fish and beef were served. Citation issued. Floors, walls, freezers and dining tables were dirty.

headline: Rat droppings on floor; blocked handsink
summary: A rear prep handsink was blocked with condiment bottles, now removed. Over 20 rat droppings were on the second floor dry storage room floor; citation issued. Pest treatment was recommended. No paper towels at the handsink, and low water pressure.

headline: Cooler gasket torn; drain leak under sink
summary: The three-door prep cooler has a torn gasket, exposed insulation and a broken hinge. Dry food containers under the prep table need cleaning. The drain line under the dishwashing handsink leaks. Dust is on ceiling tiles above dishwashing.

headline: No vomit kit or procedure; cover receptacle; mop storage
summary: No procedure or kit for vomit and diarrhea cleanup was on site, and the person in charge was instructed to provide one. The female restroom has no covered bin. A mop was stored improperly to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Ice bin lid missing; splashguard needed
summary: The bar ice bin has no lid and must be covered. A handwashing sink in the prep area needs a left splashguard. Utensils were stored laying down and must be covered or inverted. Hood filters are dusty.

headline: Over 60 small flies; hot water wash too cool
summary: Over 60 small flies were seen in the facility, including bars, washrooms and the dishroom. Citation issued; pest control recommended. The high-temperature dish machine was at 102°F and was repaired to 164°F during inspection. A gap sits under the front door.

headline: Torn freezer gasket; missing ceiling panels
summary: A chest freezer in the rear prep area has a torn gasket that must be repaired. Two ceiling panels are missing in the rear dry storage room and must be replaced.

headline: No employee health policy; coffee debris on floors
summary: No signed employee health policies were on site, and no written vomit and diarrhea procedure was available. Floors under heavy equipment had coffee debris. Boxes and bags were ordered elevated, and a splashguard is needed.

headline: Rodent droppings and dead roaches found
summary: About 20 to 25 rodent droppings were found under unused equipment in the rear dry storage. About 5 dead cockroaches were found in an office closet. Citation issued; additional pest control service is needed. Bread shelves lacked overhead protection.

headline: Dead roaches on floors and walls; grease and drains
summary: Dead roaches were on floors and walls near the dishwashing area and window barrier. Citation not issued. Handwashing sink has no signage and drains slowly. Grease and dirt build up on cooking equipment, and trays are stored on the floor.

headline: Serving plates not inverted; dust risk
summary: Serving plates on prep kitchen shelves were not properly stored and must be inverted to prevent dust. The person in charge was told to store plates correctly.

headline: Gaps at doors and leaks at sink
summary: Front and rear doors did not fit tightly, a possible pest entry point. Leaks were found at the three-compartment sink faucet. The produce cooler walls, ceiling and fan covers need deep cleaning.

headline: Mouse droppings found; citation issued
summary: About 25 mouse droppings were found in the rear ventilation storage, front prep area and under the service counter. Citation issued; pest control is recommended. Prior core violations were not corrected, including cardboard shelf liners and heavy grease on walls.

headline: Missing handwashing signs at sinks
summary: No handwashing signs were posted at hand sinks. The facility must provide signage.

headline: Torn gasket; leaking three-compartment faucet
summary: A small prep cooler at the cooks station has a torn gasket. Black mold-like buildup is on caulking at the rinse sink. The three-compartment sink faucet in the dishwashing area leaks and must be repaired.

headline: Two-door cooler too warm; no vehicle lid
summary: A two-door cooler measured 51.1°F and must be repaired to reach 41°F. A garbage vehicle lacked a lid. Both items are priority or repair issues, with no citation issued.

headline: Food containers not stored properly
summary: Food containers were not stored inverted. The operator must store them correctly.

headline: Low water pressure; damaged ceiling; food handler training
summary: The sushi bar handsink needs more water pressure. Dust and debris are in vents and light shields, with damaged ceiling tiles above prep tables. No proof of food handler training, and citation issued. Floor drains and moldy caulk need cleaning and replacement.

headline: Pizza held too cool, discarded; multiple repairs
summary: Four cooked cheese pizza slices were at 101.7°F, below the 135°F hot-holding minimum. The manager discarded about 1.5 pounds. Citation issued. Other issues include a front gap, food handler and allergen training gaps, and debris buildup.

headline: Floral wall covering must be removed
summary: Floral decoration covered the walls, making them hard to clean. The manager was told to remove it so the walls are easily cleanable.

headline: Gap under doors; floor and grease cleanup needed
summary: Gaps under the rear and west entry doors must be sealed to prevent rodent entry. Grease and food debris must be cleaned from fryers, coolers and shelves. Rust is on walk-in shelving. Floor tiles and ceiling vents need repair and cleaning.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; restroom fan not working
summary: No handwashing signs were posted at the hand sinks. Grease trap exterior has rust. The mechanical ventilation in the toilet room is not working.

headline: No valid allergen training for managers
summary: No valid allergen training was available. All certified managers must provide allergen training.

headline: Grease in hood; basement hood not working
summary: Grease spills were found inside the ventilation hood and must be cleaned. The basement prep area ventilation hood is not operable and must be repaired.

headline: Over 60 live flies; standing water on floors
summary: About 40 live small flies were on walls at both bars and about 20 in the basement. Unused cooler held standing liquid. A mop sink drain leaks. Standing water on floors and two burned-out ceiling bulbs must be fixed. Advised to call pest control.

headline: Live roaches, rodent droppings and flies found
summary: Seven live roaches, about 4 rat and 25 mouse droppings, and small and large flies were found, including on food, the prep area and dining table. Food was stored on the floor and in an open van. Citation issued; pest control is recommended.

headline: No person in charge present; no certified manager
summary: No person in charge was present during inspection. No certified food manager was on duty while rice and chicken soups were prepared and served. Citation issued. The person in charge must hold a certificate by next inspection.

headline: Fish left open in freezer; wiping cloths on counters
summary: Open fish was not properly stored in the freezer and needs a food-grade bag or container. Wiping cloths were left on prep stations. Fan covers in reach-in coolers are dusty. Water-stained ceiling tiles and dusty vents need attention.

headline: Grease buildup and slow-draining handsink
summary: Grease covered cooking equipment, walls and floors in the kitchen prep area. A rear handsink drains slowly. Food debris was on the walk-in cooler floor, and floor drains near the ice machine were dirty. Person in charge was told to fix these.

headline: Beef stock held too warm; food discarded
summary: A 20-pound container of beef stock was held at 52.3°F in a closed tube in the walk-in cooler. All cold TCS foods must be kept at 41°F or below. The food was discarded, valued at $150.

headline: About 100 mouse droppings; citation issued
summary: About 100 mouse droppings were found on the floor and shelves of the dry storage and basement. Management must clean them, and more pest control is needed. Citation issued. A dead mouse was on the basement floor.

headline: No employee health policy; sanitizer and drain gaps
summary: No written employee health policy was on site. Vomit and diarrhea cleanup kits lacked norovirus-effective sanitizer. No metal-stem thermometer was on site. No commercial dumpster contract. Floor drains need sealing. No citations issued.

headline: Mouse droppings in utility closet; citation issued
summary: About 15 mouse droppings were found on the floor of the rear utility closet. Management must clean them, and additional pest control service is needed. Citation issued. Floors in the prep area have dirt and debris, and food handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Loose flooring and gaps in ceiling; clutter
summary: Loose floor coving was found in basement and main prep areas. Missing ceiling tiles in an office expose wall interiors, allowing pest entry. Clutter, flour and food debris were found. Staff were told to clean and organize.

headline: Missing splashguards, grease buildup and dirty floors
summary: Handwashing sinks near smoothie prep and cooking lines lack splashguards. Heavy grease was found on fryers, cooking equipment and pipes. Toilet room lacks a lidded receptacle. Floors throughout need cleaning.

headline: Dust, leaks and worn surfaces; no food-safety threat
summary: Inspector found chipped paint and rust on walk-in cooler racks, worn cutting boards, water leaks at a sink and drain, and dust on fan covers and ceiling vents. All were ordered repaired or cleaned.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; food held too warm
summary: The dish machine had no sanitizer (0 ppm) and was not used until fixed; manager called maintenance. Many foods were above 41°F and about 272 pounds were voluntarily discarded. Citations issued for cooler temperatures, grease outside, and no allergen certificate for managers.

headline: Rear door not pest-proof; rust and grime in coolers
summary: The rear door is not proofed against rodents or insects. A food handler had a long beard without a restraint. Cooler racks have rust and buildup. Food handlers lacked food handler certificates.

headline: Personal medicine stored with food supplies
summary: Employee medicine and personal care items were stored on shelves in the meat and deli prep area. Staff were told to store them separately. The restroom ventilation is in poor repair.

headline: Food handler lacks training certificate
summary: A food handler did not have a valid food handler training certificate. Management was instructed that all food handlers must provide one.

headline: Cardboard shelf liners; grease on fryers
summary: Cardboard was used as a shelf liner in prep areas and must be replaced with an easily cleaned material. Cooking and frying equipment needs detail cleaning. Mops must be hung to dry. No allergen training proof for certified managers.

headline: Leaking faucets; boxes on crates in freezer
summary: Boxes were stored on milk crates in the outside walk-in freezer and must be elevated on shelving. Leaking faucets at the prep handsink and three-compartment sink must be repaired. Grease is on fryers and walls, and hood filters need dust removed.

headline: Wall behind sink not cleanable
summary: The wall behind the three-compartment sink is not smooth and easily cleanable. The person in charge was told to repair and maintain it.

headline: No certified manager; sink backs up
summary: No certified manager was on duty while chicken, coleslaw and fries were prepared. Water backs up between three-compartment sink basins; citation issued. Food containers were on the walk-in cooler floor, and ice bin needs cleaning.

headline: Storage and trash problems; some sinks blocked
summary: A front handsink lacks a splashguard. An employee had no effective hair restraint. Single-service items were stored on the floor, and trash covered closets. One three-compartment sink was shut off and unused, and must be repaired or removed.

headline: Cold food too warm; discarded; sink water too cool
summary: Cold TCS foods were held at 46.9 to 48.2°F and must be 41°F or below. The manager discarded about 12 pounds. Citation issued. Restroom handwashing water was 95.2 to 97.9°F, below 100°F. Shellstock tags lacked dates; openings at the entrance need sealing.

headline: Dirty surfaces, cans and floors need cleaning
summary: Door handles, service carts, can opener and microwave interior need detail cleaning. The cutting board is worn and must be replaced. Reach-in cooler, leaking handsink handle, and floors and equipment need cleaning.

headline: Damaged floor tiles and peeling freezer wall
summary: Damaged floor tiles were found in the dry storage room near the soda rack. The walk-in freezer wall surface is peeling. The facility was told to repair both surfaces so they are smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Vacuum packing without variance; no paper towels
summary: Vacuum-packed TCS foods were found without a variance or HACCP plan; the operator was told to stop. No paper towels at a front prep handwashing sink. Food handler lacked hair restraint, and utensils were stored in standing room-temperature water.

headline: No certified manager; rice scoop stored in water
summary: No certified food manager was on site while fish and rice were handled. A rice scoop was stored in standing room-temperature water. The dish machine had no chlorine test strips; the manager bought some during inspection. Walk-in cooler floor is cracked.

headline: Unapproved vacuum-packed food; variance not met
summary: Cooked and cooled foods, including pasta, rice and sauces, were vacuum-packed and reheated in bags without a required variance or written procedures. Person in charge was told to meet requirements. Exposed foam caulk on walls needs repair.

headline: Leaking faucet; allergen certificate missing
summary: The three-compartment sink faucet base leaks in the rear dishwashing area and must be repaired. A certified food service manager lacked an allergen training certificate and must provide proof.

headline: Food stored on floor; grease on cooking equipment
summary: Bulk food containers were on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised six inches. Wiping cloths were left on prep surfaces. Accumulated grease and food debris covered cooking equipment and floors in the rear prep area.

headline: Cold food left at room temperature; citation issued
summary: Raw tilapia (69.8°F) and boiled eggs (54.5°F) sat at room temperature; cold food must stay at 41°F or below. Citation issued. A hot-holding unit at 128°F was corrected on site to 141°F. Shrimp, chicken and tilapia were thawed in standing water.

headline: Failed cooler temperature; no vomit cleanup kit
summary: A two-door prep cooler reached 75.5°F and was not used until fixed; it was 41°F at inspection end. No spill kit or cleanup procedure was on site. The high-temperature dish machine did not meet 180°F final rinse. No thermometers in reach-in coolers.

headline: Moldy soda racks in drink cooler
summary: Mold-like substance with black spots was on soda pop racks in the drink cooler by the register. The operator must clean or replace the racks.

headline: Broken line cooler thermometer; dirty floors
summary: The air thermometer in the central line cooler was broken and must be repaired or replaced. A plastic hose inside the cooler is hard to clean. Cooler interior and rear hallway floors have food debris buildup.

headline: Small flies found; rear door has gap
summary: About 40 live small flies were found in the rear prep area, storage room and bar. The rear exit door has a quarter-inch gap. Citation issued; manager must remove all fly activity by reinspection. Spoons and forks on tables were left uncovered.

headline: TCS food held too warm; 25 pounds discarded
summary: Chicken curry at 64.3°F and sour cream at 63.2°F were held above safe temperatures. About 25 pounds of TCS food were disposed of. Citation issued. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; tagged and held
summary: The low temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer and was tagged and held by public health officials. It cannot be used until reinspected. Citation issued. Cooked chicken and beef held over 24 hours lacked discard dates and were discarded.

headline: No certified manager on duty; cardboard liners
summary: No certified food service manager was on duty for about 20 minutes during TCS food prep, and citation was issued. Frozen meat was thawed in a plastic container. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables, and cardboard was used as shelf liner.

headline: Hot water off at south kitchen; signage missing
summary: The south kitchen had no hot water, and the water heater was off. Hot water must reach at least 110°F at the three-compartment sink and 100°F at handwashing sinks. Missing handwashing signs, bulk containers without labels, and ice machine debris were noted.

headline: Food stored on floor; rust and grease under tables
summary: Food containers were stored on the walk-in freezer floor and must be elevated. Rusty storage shelving must be repainted or replaced. Dirt and debris are under prep tables, and vent dust is in the men's washroom.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; foil lining equipment
summary: The bar handwashing sink lacked handwashing signage. Fish labeled not to be thawed in its packaging was thawed in it. Aluminum foil lined fryer and oven surfaces; it must be replaced with a smooth, cleanable barrier.

headline: Reach-in cooler too warm; no sanitizer on site
summary: No original City of Chicago sanitation certificate was on site. The reach-in cooler reached 66.3°F at the top and must be kept at 41°F or below. No sanitizer or test strips were on site. A gray waste line is not connected, and the hood and floors need cleaning.

headline: No certified food manager during food prep
summary: No certified food manager (CFM) was on site for about 30 minutes while TCS foods were being prepared. Dirty ice machine interior and food-contact surfaces were found. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Storage and cleaning issues were noted.

headline: No certified manager; cooler too warm; citation
summary: No certified manager was on site from 11:00 to 11:45am while chicken was prepared. The walk-in cooler measured 66.7 to 69.2°F and is tagged on hold until reinspected. Ice machine interior is heavily soiled, and no hand soap or paper towels at sinks.

headline: No handwashing sinks at prep and dishwashing
summary: No handwashing sinks were provided at the dishwashing and rear prep areas. No chlorine test strips were available for the three-compartment sink. Floors in restroom and storage are missing tiles. No allergen certificate for the manager.

headline: Live cockroaches and fly activity found in basement
summary: About 30 live cockroaches were found in the basement food prep, dishwashing and brewery areas, plus about 50 small flying insects and 5 house flies. Prior pest violation was not corrected. Citation issued; more pest control is needed.

headline: Dirty ice machine; grime and clutter throughout
summary: Black slimy buildup was found inside the ice machine, dripping onto ice. It was emptied, cleaned and sanitized during inspection. Cutting boards, floors, ceiling tiles and lights need repair, and milk crates must not be used as shelves.

headline: Food stored on freezer floor; rusted shelving
summary: Food items were stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer and must be elevated six inches. Rusted storage racks in the dry storage area must be made smooth and cleanable.

headline: Spoiled sauce discarded; oyster tags missing dates
summary: About 63 pounds of cooked bolognese sauce held at 48.1 to 53°F was discarded; cold food must be 41°F or below. Oyster shellstock tags lacked the last-sold date. Splashguard and backflow repairs and ceiling dust cleaning are needed.

headline: Food on floors; no food handler training records
summary: Food containers were on floors in the walk-in cooler, prep and storage areas and must be raised six inches. Foam-like caulk is on walls. Hood filters need cleaning. No proof of food handler training was provided for any food handler.

headline: No valid food manager certificate; floors need work
summary: The person in charge lacked a valid City of Chicago food manager certificate, and none was posted. Floors under fryers were dirty, and some food handler certificates were missing. Citation issued. Allergen training was not provided.

headline: Gaps, grease, broken door and missing food handler training
summary: A front entrance door has an opening at the base. Soda crates sat on the floor. Fryer and prep shelves have grease buildup. A utility sink lacks a backflow device. Some lights were out. No proof of food handler training was provided for any worker.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; grease and debris buildup
summary: A walk-in cooler had no thermometer, and a handsink drains slowly but works. Heavy grease and food debris were found under equipment and sinks. Employee bags were stored next to food. A manager's allergen certificate had expired.

headline: Person in charge lacks sanitation certificate
summary: No person in charge had a City of Chicago sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was on premises while beef and chicken were handled. Citation issued. Certificates must be provided.

headline: Raw wood shelving; cardboard lining; allergen gaps
summary: A plastic cup was used for dispensing from salsa, and raw wood crates and milk crates were used as shelving in the walk-in cooler. Cardboard and foil lined shelving; fryer exterior peels. The walk-in fan guard is missing.

headline: Heavy grime behind cook line; no summary posted
summary: Heavy grease, grime and food debris were behind the cook line. The public inspection summary was not posted, and citation issued. Leave new summary posted for public view.

headline: Gap under rear door; walk-in floor loose
summary: A quarter-inch gap under the rear door leading to the parking lot must be repaired so it fits tightly. The walk-in cooler floor is loose and must be repaired.

headline: Missing thermometer, leaks and outdated allergen records
summary: No thermometer was in the main prep cooler, and the handwashing sink lacks signage. Stained cutting boards and an ice scoop stored in the ice need fixing. A basement dishwashing sink leaks and the dish sprayer is loose. Allergen training proof was missing.

headline: Ice machine needs cleaning; wiping cloths
summary: The ice machine interior needs cleaning to remove buildup. All wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizing solution when not in use.

headline: Grease on equipment and floors; hood needs cleaning
summary: Cooking equipment sides and under the flattop need detail cleaning. Kitchen dishwashing and front bar floors need cleaning to prevent pests. The rear kitchen hood needs cleaning.

headline: Rodent activity found; thermometer missing; citation
summary: Rodent activity was found, with about 180 droppings across the front prep, sales area and back by the hot water tank. Citation issued. Cooler thermometer missing; no allergen certificates for managers. Previous violations were not corrected.

headline: No backflow device on ice machine
summary: No visible backflow prevention device was on the ice machine. A broken floor tile near the rear sink holds pooled water. A certified food manager had an expired allergen certificate.

headline: No certified manager while cooking; food handlers uncertified
summary: Person in charge had no City of Chicago food manager certificate, and none was on site while pizza, chicken and pasta were prepared. Food handlers lacked proof of training. The previous summary report was not posted. Citations issued.

headline: No food handler training; backflow device missing
summary: No food handler training was provided for employees. The ice machine lacks a backflow device, and an ice cream dipper well was missing. Missing baseboards in prep and dishwashing must be replaced. The re-inspection passed after these were noted.

headline: Ice bins uncovered; rust and no stoppers
summary: Ice bins at the first floor bar had no lids. Shellstock tags lacked the last-sold date, and mold-like buildup was in nozzle holders. Stoppers are missing from the three-compartment sink. Citation issued. Restroom receptacles and rust need attention.

headline: Gap at front door; floor cleaning needed
summary: The front door has a quarter-inch gap at the bottom and the rear exit has an opening. These must be repaired to block pests. The reach-in cooler interior and walk-in cooler floors need cleaning.

headline: No pest control logs; ice bin dirty; citation
summary: No current pest control log book was on the premises; at least two licensed pest inspections a year are required. The ice bin interior needs cleaning. No chemical test kit for sanitizer was available. Citations were issued.

headline: No certified manager for fish; garbage overflows
summary: No one on site had a City of Chicago sanitation certificate while fish and shellfish were handled. Outside waste containers were open and overflowing. Citation issued. Rear area near walk-in cooler needs cleaning.

headline: Dish sanitizer failed, lacking water; citations
summary: Dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer and was serviced during inspection to 50 ppm. Frozen pork was thawed under a wok station, and a handsink had weak water flow. A dumpster lid was open, overflowing with trash. Several other violations were listed.

headline: No certified manager; expired certificates
summary: No person in charge present during inspection, which was noted without a citation. No certified food manager on duty while coffee, pastries and chicken sandwiches were prepared. Posted certificates were expired. Citation issued.

headline: No vomit kit; no pest log; uncovered trash
summary: No vomit and diarrhea spill kit with norovirus-effective spray. No thermometers inside refrigeration units. No pest control logbook or contract on site. Washroom door not self-closing. Trash overflowing around the dumpster; citation not issued for pests.

headline: Thermometer placement; allergen training missing
summary: A refrigerator thermometer was placed in the rear of prep coolers and must be moved to the warmest part. No allergen training certificate for all certified managers. Corrections were instructed.

headline: No certificate posted; no allergen proof
summary: No City of Chicago food sanitation certificate posted, and a citation was issued. Certified managers must be present while TCS foods are prepared or served. No allergen training certificate posted on the premises.

headline: Cold foods at 50-53°F; droppings in several areas
summary: Spinach, cooked eggs, mozzarella and veggie patties were held at 50-53°F, above the 41°F limit. The PIC discarded them. About 25 rodent droppings were found in storage, prep and beverage cabinets. Citation issued.

headline: Gap at front door; canned food on floor
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the front exit door must be sealed to prevent pests. Canned food items on the floor under shelves must be raised six inches. No covered receptacles for feminine hygiene products in the women's restroom.

headline: Dust on vents above ice machine
summary: Vents above the ice machine and soda syrup area had dust buildup and must be cleaned and maintained. No pests, contamination or food safety issues were reported in this inspection.

headline: No certified manager; live mice found
summary: Re-inspection failed. No certified food manager on site while burgers, chicken and fish were prepared. Two live mice and small rodent droppings were found behind heavy equipment. Citation issued. Also no written employee health policy and greasy hood filters.

headline: Hand sink used for storage; open window
summary: A large plastic container was stored inside the hand-washing sink. The sink must be used only for hand washing and kept stocked. An open dining room window with no screen was closed until a screen is installed. Storage closet floors need cleaning.

headline: Poor hand hygiene; rear door gap
summary: Food handlers touched cell phones and put on gloves without washing hands, and one washed hands at the three-compartment sink. Both corrected through instruction, no citation. A 1/4-inch gap under the rear door needs sealing. No pests found.

headline: No health policies; raw oysters; no consumer advisory
summary: Incomplete employee health policies; priority violation. Shellfish tags not kept for 90 days; citation issued. No consumer advisory on menu for raw oysters or raw/undercooked items; citation issued. Each food handler must have training.

headline: Disposable bowl used as scoop; no allergen training
summary: A to-go disposable bowl with no handle was used to scoop food from the two-door refrigerator. Staff were told to use tongs, spoons or a ladle. Leaking three-compartment sink faucet. Certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Employee drinks on food prep table
summary: Employee open drink containers were on the food production table, and staff were told to move them. A damaged window sill behind the three-compartment sink used for utensils must be replaced with a smooth, non-absorbent surface.

headline: Leaks, open wall and missing receptacle
summary: Opening around the grease trap pipe in the rear must be sealed to prevent pests. Leaks at a three-compartment sink and a toilet room sink. Missing covered receptacle, broken wall tiles and an open wall. No pests were found.

headline: Slimy ice maker; missing thermometer
summary: Black slimy substance on interior water parts of the ice maker dripping into ice used for consumption; citation issued. No thermometer inside the two-door cooler. A food handler lacked a certificate. Broken soap dispenser lever at the rear hand sink.

headline: No hair restraints; cut cutting boards
summary: Food handler in rear prep area without hair restraint. Deeply cut and stained cutting boards at all rear prep areas must be restored or replaced. Floor drains under sinks need deep cleaning and sanitizing. No pests were reported.

headline: No paper towels at hand sinks; citation issued
summary: No paper towels at exposed hand-washing sinks in the basement prep area, employee restroom and first-floor prep area. Manager must keep paper towels stocked at all times. Citation issued under the hand-washing rule.

headline: Bare-hand contact; live roach; pests flying
summary: Dishwasher touched dirty and clean dishes with gloves, without washing hands. Staff handled ready-to-eat food bare-handed; food discarded. A live roach and about 50 small flies found. Pest service needed. Dumpster overflowing. Citations issued.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup kit
summary: No signed employee health policies and no procedures or supplies for vomiting or diarrhea cleanup. Door gaps, worn gaskets, a leaky faucet, and a missing backflow device. Missing allergen training for the food manager. Pass with conditions.

headline: Slow drain; expired food handler certificates
summary: Slow drainage at the hand-washing sink at the end of the prep line must be repaired. Food handler certificates were expired; staff must show current proof of training.

headline: Dirty ice machine; allergen training incomplete
summary: Inside of the ice machine was not cleaned; instructed to clean and sanitize. Food containers stored on the walk-in cooler floor. Rusty shelves, peeling paint, and stained ceiling tiles. Incomplete allergen training certificate was a repeat violation; citation issued.

headline: Hair restraints, leaks, stored single-use items
summary: Two food employees did not wear effective hair restraints, and one male employee had no beard restraint. Single-service items were stored in a mechanical room. Cutting boards are stained and scored. Leaks at the beverage station and sink faucet.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate posted
summary: No valid original City of Chicago certificate posted on site. Person in charge was told the certificate is required within 90 days of getting food manager training. Citation issued.

headline: Bulk food containers missing or worn labels
summary: Labels on bulk food storage containers in the deli and bakery were worn or missing. Manager instructed to label all bulk containers with the common name of the food and keep them labeled at all times.

headline: Deep-cut cutting boards; allergen certificates
summary: Cutting boards on the cook line had deep cuts and dark stains. No allergen certificates for certified food managers on site. Staff must complete online allergen training and keep certificates on premises. No pests were reported.

headline: No backflow device at ice machine
summary: No backflow prevention device found at the ice machine waterline. Device must be installed where it can be serviced. No other problems were noted in this inspection.

headline: No soap or toilet paper for customers
summary: No hand soap in the customer restroom for The Golden Diner, and no toilet paper. Both were priority violations, but no citation was issued. Manager instructed to provide and keep both stocked at all times.

headline: No certified manager; mice and flies found
summary: Manager on duty lacked a valid certificate while chicken and fish were handled. About 50 mouse droppings in the rear storage and prep area, plus 25 and 40 live flies. Manager told to remove them and call pest control. Citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled TCS foods; no soap; food debris
summary: No soap at hand-wash sinks; citation issued. Raw beef, sliced ham and egg mixture not date-marked; 5 lbs discarded, citation issued. Wiping cloths stored improperly and milk crates used for elevation. Food handler and allergen certificates missing.

headline: Rodent droppings and flies; citation issued
summary: Re-inspection failed. About 25 small rodent droppings in water heater room, rear dry storage, and office. About 30 live flies in prep and storage areas. Citation issued. Grease trap leaking onto the floor and no metal thermometer.

headline: Fire damage: spoiled produce, no hot water
summary: Prepackaged produce was smoke and chemical damaged from a fire in rear storage and the sales floor. The hot water tank was damaged, so there was no hot water. A leaky pipe under a sink, damaged walls and ceiling, and a broken light.

headline: Slime in ice machine; no allergen proof
summary: Self-serve ice machine in the dining area had black and brown slime dripping onto ice used for consumption. Rust inside the ice bin and mold-like substance on the kitchen ice machine exterior. Citation issued. Certified managers lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Raw chicken dripping; roaches on glueboard
summary: Condensation dripped on uncovered raw chicken in a prep cooler; about 10 lbs discarded, citation issued. Over 10 roaches trapped on a glueboard under the rear hand sink; employee corrected on site. Fly trap over prep table must be removed.

headline: Missing hand-wash sign; greasy fryers
summary: Hand-washing sink in the front area was missing a sign. A single-use container was used as a scoop in bulk storage. Deep fryers and wok line had encrusted grease. Floors beneath fryers were soiled; unfinished wood wall needs finishing.

headline: Openings in exit doors; grease buildup
summary: Two openings at the bottom of exit doors could let pests in and must be repaired. Heavy grease and dust on cooking equipment and hood systems. Debris in walk-in coolers. Leak at the two-compartment sink base. Floor drains had debris.

headline: Fish thawed in standing water
summary: Fish was being thawed in a bowl of water beside the three-compartment sink. Staff were told to thaw food in the refrigerator or under cold running water. Dirty can opener on the prep table and grease-laden hood filters must be cleaned.

headline: Beverage machines and floors need cleaning
summary: Spills and debris on beverage machines, prep tables and shelving. Missing grout on floor tiles near the three-compartment sink. Debris and spills on the floor behind beverage machines. Manager instructed to clean and maintain all areas.

headline: Items stored on floors; torn gasket; tin foil
summary: Single-service items stored on floors in storage and basement areas. Torn gasket on a front refrigerator door. Cardboard boxes and plastic bags used as freezer containers, and tin foil used as shelf liners. Water-damaged ceiling tiles and dust on vents.

headline: 70+ mouse droppings; no health policy
summary: Over 70 mouse droppings behind the serving counter, in storage and on the selling floor. Pest control service required before reinspection; citation issued. No employee health policy on premises; citation issued. Clutter and dirty floors need cleaning.

headline: Live and dead roaches throughout prep areas
summary: Re-inspection failed. Three live roaches seen in front and rear prep areas. Dead roaches found throughout prep areas, under hot and cold holding equipment and under stoves. Manager told to remove them and clean. Also greasy cooking equipment and damaged cutting boards.

headline: Torn gasket on rear cooler
summary: Torn gasket on the inside of a rear two-door cooler. Manager instructed to repair or replace it and keep it in good condition. No pests or food safety issues were reported.

headline: Bare-hand food contact; no hair restraints
summary: Two employees handled ready-to-eat foods with bare hands; manager told to stop. Food handlers not wearing hair restraints. Large spoons left in standing water at room temperature. Missing hand-washing sign and backflow device noted.

headline: No certified manager on site
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. No person in charge with a City of Chicago certificate present, and no certified food manager on site while rice, beef and pho soup were handled. Citation issued. A food handler lacked a food handler certificate.

headline: Live roaches and mouse droppings found
summary: Over 20 live roaches in the prep area and over 50 mouse droppings in beverage-area cabinets. Also several dead roaches, soiled wiping cloths and residue in the ice machine. Manager told to call an exterminator and clean.

headline: Cooler at 60°F held food; no pest service
summary: Refrigerator holding food for sale at 60.0°F, above the 41°F limit. Unit tagged and held until repaired and reported to CDPH. No licensed pest control operator on record. Storage room clutter needs clearing.

headline: Damaged gasket; debris in prep cooler
summary: Re-inspection passed. Prep cooler lacked an ambient air thermometer. A damaged gasket and debris were found in a prep cooler, and raw wood shelves in the basement. No lidded receptacles in the women's restroom. Clutter in basement.

headline: No sanitation certificate; food sat at unsafe temp
summary: No valid City of Chicago food sanitation certificate posted. Chicken at 78.2°F and 44.8°F in the cold holding unit, above the 41°F limit; 6 lbs discarded. No vomit cleanup kit, no thermometer, and no sanitizer test strips. Citations issued.

headline: Food debris on walk-in floors; personal items
summary: Accumulated food debris on floors in all walk-in coolers and freezers in the rear prep area must be cleaned. Employee personal items stored in the prep area; an orderly storage area is needed. No pests were reported.

headline: Dirty freezer, washroom fan and vents
summary: Freezer bottom in the rear prep area needs cleaning. Dust on the washroom ceiling fan and in hood vents over cooking equipment. These were upkeep items, and no food safety or pest issues were reported.

headline: Weak hot water pressure; missing hand-wash signs
summary: Very low hot water pressure at both hand-washing sinks. Hand-washing signs were missing in employee restrooms. Manager instructed to provide hot water at city pressure and post signs. No pests were reported.

headline: No certified food manager; slimy ice machines
summary: No certified food manager on site while TCS foods (rice, beans, beef, pork) were prepared and served. Ice machines in dish room and dining area had excess black slime. Citations issued. Floor dirt also noted.

headline: Missing thermometers; food debris on floors
summary: Thermometers could not be found inside cooling units and the walk-in cooler. Walk-in cooler floors had excessive food debris and water. Food handler certificates must be provided for all food handlers. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Prep cooler missing thermometer; labels missing
summary: The prep cooler had no thermometer, and bulk containers of sugar and salt were missing labels. Manager instructed to provide both. Inadequate lighting in the main walk-in cooler; additional fixtures were required.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; floor debris
summary: Torn gaskets inside a bar reach-in cooler, and debris on floors between the ice machine and dish machine. Manager instructed to repair and clean. No pests were reported.

headline: Hot holding display inaccurate; unit working
summary: Re-inspection passed. External temperature display on a hot holding warming box was inaccurate. The internal thermometer read over 135°F, which is proper hot holding. Manager instructed to repair the external display.

headline: Uncovered food; missing labels, sink stoppers
summary: Unlabeled food containers and uncovered food in prep areas. Wiping cloths improperly stored, milk crates used as shelving, and two sink stoppers missing. No proof of food handler training. No pests reported. Upkeep items also noted.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; burnt bulbs
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving in prep and storage areas and must be replaced with approved shelving 6 inches off the floor. Ice bin interior needs cleaning. Several burned-out hood light bulbs. Sanitation manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Floors not clean in preparation areas
summary: Floors in the preparation areas were not clean and must be cleaned. This is the only item noted in this canvass inspection. No pests, food temperature or hand-washing issues were reported.

headline: Greasy equipment; no allergen training
summary: Grease buildup on cooking equipment, walls and floors in the egg station, plus dirty interiors of reach-in coolers. No certified food manager had allergen training. Documentation must be provided. No pests reported.

headline: No hand-wash signs or pest control log
summary: Hand-washing signs missing in prep areas. No pest control log on premises, and a citation was issued. Coolers, soda machine drain pan and mop sink floor need cleaning. No pests were observed.

headline: No hand-wash signs; damaged floor tile
summary: No hand-washing signage at sinks in restrooms used by food employees. Manager instructed to post clearly visible signs. Damaged floor tile in front of a two-door refrigerator in the rear must be repaired or replaced for cleanability.

headline: No certified manager; pests; food discarded
summary: No certified food manager on site while ribs, chicken and sausages were prepared. About 100 live flies and about 90 large rat droppings. Dead rats found. Cooked chicken at 90-100°F was discarded. Hot water and thermometer missing. Citations issued.

headline: No health policy; gap at front door
summary: No written employee health policy on premises; priority violation. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the front door could let pests in. Noodle-making equipment too large for the three-compartment sink. Backflow device at bar ice machine missing.

headline: Rust, leaking faucet, dirty floors
summary: Rust on shelves in a two-door refrigerator in the rear prep area. Leaking base of a faucet at the exposed hand-washing sink. Dirty floors along walls in the rear prep area. Person in charge instructed to repair and clean. No pests reported.

headline: Cooked beef held without discard date
summary: Cooked beef held for over 24 hours without a discard date. Citation issued. Floor drains filled with black buildup must be cleaned. The manager lacked allergen training, and all managers must show proof of allergen training.

headline: Missing ceiling tiles; no certificates
summary: Water-damaged and missing ceiling tiles, plus dirt and debris under sinks and behind refrigeration units. No covered waste receptacle in one restroom. No food handler certificates on premises. Ice buildup in the rear chest freezer.

headline: No certified manager; sink blocked; hand contact
summary: No certified food manager while tacos and rice were prepared. A cook wiped hands on a dirty cloth, then handled ready-to-eat tacos. A table blocked the hand sink, and it was moved. Dishwashing sink drained into the three-compartment sink. Citations issued.

headline: Ice scoops stored improperly; utensils not inverted
summary: Ice scoops stored in an open wire rack touching the wall. Multi-use utensils not inverted during storage. Unsealed support beam covers under service counter and missing ceiling tiles above warewashing unit. Blue tape holding edging must be removed.

headline: Food stored on floors; insect devices above food
summary: Open drinks on a rear kitchen prep table. Insect control devices hung over the meat prep area, and food stored on floors in walk-in and storage areas. Styrofoam cups used as scoops. Items must be elevated and devices removed.

headline: Missing sink stoppers; damaged tiles
summary: Re-inspection passed. Three-compartment sink stoppers missing or not working, and no covered receptacle in the women's restroom. Broken wall tile near the hand sink and cracked floor tile at the fryers. Ventilation vents dusty.

headline: Torn gasket; dirty floors and ice bin
summary: Torn door gasket inside a two-door prep cooler must be replaced. Ice bin interior needs cleaning. Loose debris, dirt and dust on floors and corners throughout the facility. Plates not inverted after sanitizing.

headline: Rat droppings and dead rodents; uncorrected
summary: Over 200 rat droppings in basement storage, boiler room and behind the bar, and five dead rodents. About 20 live flying insects breed in leak tubs. Previous violations uncorrected, and a citation was issued. Pest service needed.

headline: Door sweep missing; floors need detail cleaning
summary: A door sweep was missing at the second entry door, to help prevent pests. Floors under shelving in produce and dairy walk-in coolers, plus several other areas, need detail cleaning. No pests were found.

headline: Missing hand-wash sign; rusty shelves
summary: Hand-wash sink in first floor prep area missing signage. Rusty bottom shelves on prep tables and aluminum foil wrapped around support beams in prep storage. Manager instructed to remove rust and foil and make surfaces smooth and cleanable.

headline: Dirty ice machine; dead insects; no certificates
summary: Ice machine interior top not clean; ice is used for consumption. Dead insects behind the unused fryer must be removed. Debris behind shelves. Food storage containers need labels, and no food handler or allergen training certificates on site.

headline: No health policy or training; citation issued
summary: No employee health policy or training found on site; citation issued. Raw wood shelves in the front area and dining counters are not easily cleanable. Spray foam used as sealant. Missing self-closing device on a restroom door.

headline: Food handler missing training
summary: Knives stored between the wall and the three-compartment sink. A female food handler was missing food handler training. Manager instructed to obtain training and keep proof on site. No pests were reported.

headline: No certified manager; pests and rodent openings
summary: No certified food manager on site while empanadas and tacos were prepared; citation issued. Outer openings not rodent-proof, and missing hand soap and paper towels. Stored food on floors from prior visit uncorrected. No pests were observed.

headline: Dead and live roaches throughout; citation
summary: Re-inspection failed. Dead roaches on floors, walls and doors throughout. Live roaches found on prep tables, in the sink, and in front office. Pest service needed; citation issued. Also milk and soda crates used as shelves, and a leaking mop sink faucet.

headline: Rusted walk-in cooler racks
summary: Re-inspection passed. Rusted racks in the walk-in cooler must be repainted or replaced, per the inspector. No other problems were noted in this follow-up visit.

headline: Standing water in beer cooler; faucet leak
summary: Standing water on the floor inside the beer walk-in cooler must be cleaned and kept dry. Leaking faucet at the four-compartment sink at the bar must be repaired. No pests or contamination were reported.

headline: Dirty ice machine; hot water too low
summary: Ice machine had pinkish black buildup inside; citation issued. Three-compartment sinks had a maximum hot water temperature of 100°F, below the 110°F minimum, and were fixed before the inspection ended. Rusted racks and an expired allergen certificate.

headline: No health policy; missing backflow devices
summary: No employee health policy at the premises; must be provided. No backflow prevention devices at the ice machine waterline or mop sink faucet; must be provided where they can be serviced. Sanitation manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Missing food handler training; floors; fan
summary: Re-inspection passed. Mop heads not stored properly, items in utility sink, damaged floor tiles, and debris under equipment and in corners. Ventilation fan not working in washroom. No food handler training available; manager instructed to provide it.

headline: Missing thermometer; rust and ice; dirty floors
summary: No working thermometer inside the two-door prep cooler; must be provided. Rusty bottom of prep tables, excessive ice in meat freezer, and grease on cooling equipment. Water-damaged ceiling tiles and broken floor tiles. Citation issued for lacking shielding under sewer lines.

headline: Mice, live ants, and no health policy
summary: Over 80 mouse droppings on floors and equipment throughout the facility, plus live ants. Pest control was recommended. Sink stoppers do not hold water. Dishwasher not operable. Outdoor patio structures lack hand-washing sinks and enclosure. No health policy on site.

headline: Cold foods above 41°F; cooler too warm
summary: Salads, lobster, ham, fruit, dressing and pepper mix were 44.4°F to 54°F in service coolers. Manager discarded 60 lbs. Prep-area cooler at 47.6°F must not be used until it holds 41°F or below. Citations issued. Dirty fans noted.

headline: Floors need cleaning near mop sink
summary: Floors along wall bases and under equipment around the mop sink and dish washing area must be cleaned and maintained. No other issues were noted in this inspection.

headline: Expired ready-to-eat food; open cup in prep
summary: Ready-to-eat foods held past date: stuffed beef, chicken, potato, salsa and empanadas, citation issued. Open tea cup on a cutting board was removed by an employee. Toilet room in prep area has clutter. Expired allergen certificate for one manager.

headline: Dish machine lacked sanitizer; tagged out
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer concentration, so it was tagged and held. It must not be used until it maintains at least 50 ppm and is reinspected by CDPH. Torn protective plastic and unfinished wood shelving also noted.

headline: No certified manager; condensation and dim lights
summary: No certified food manager on site while deli and chicken were handled. Condensation dripped in the walk-in cooler. No light in the walk-in freezer and poor light in the walk-in cooler. No allergen certificate for food manager.

headline: Mouse activity throughout store; citation
summary: Re-inspection failed. Mice found along wall bases, window sills, sales shelves, and in corners near washrooms, storage and check stands. Pest control was required; citation issued. Also dirty shelves, washrooms needing cleaning, and clutter.

headline: Leaking drainpipe under two sinks
summary: Re-inspection passed. Leaking drainpipe under the rear hand-washing sink and the three-compartment sink was found. Manager instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: Re-inspection passed; soiled trays and ceiling tiles
summary: Two-ounce containers used to dispense condiments; long-handled utensils required. Soiled cardboard trays on chip shelves must be replaced. Damaged and stained ceiling tiles in rear prep and storage areas must be replaced.

headline: Food stored on floors; rusty shelves, milk crates
summary: Food containers stored on floors in prep, storage and walk-in areas. Rusty shelving, milk crates and cardboard used as shelves, which can hide pests. No pests were found. Raised shelving and deep cleaning required.

headline: Hair restraints missing; foam cups as scoops
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Foam cups were used as scoops for bulk food containers. Inadequate lighting in the walk-in cooler. Staff were told to use proper scoops and add lighting.

headline: Dead roaches found; missing labels; citation
summary: About 13 dead roaches found under the three-compartment sink, in rear storage and around bar drains. TCS foods in the walk-in cooler lacked use-by labels; citation issued. Leaking three-compartment sink faucet. Grease buildup on walls and floors.

headline: No person in charge; certified manager missing
summary: No person in charge with valid City of Chicago certificate, and no certified food manager on duty while beef sandwiches, hot dogs and fries were prepared; citation issued. Food stored on the walk-in cooler floor. Grease and dirt buildup on floors.

headline: Food stored on floors; heavy grease buildup
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food stored on floors in walk-in cooler and freezer must be raised six inches. Heavy grease and food debris on cooking equipment, walls and floors. Dirty wiping cloths on prep tables. Missing allergen certificate.

headline: Thermometer needed; cabinets and receptacles
summary: A thermometer must be visible inside the display cooler. Interior cabinets under the prep counter need detail cleaning. Toilet room receptacles must have covers. No pests or contamination issues were reported.

headline: Light debris on bar floor; cleaned as instructed
summary: Light debris was found on the bar-area floor and the manager was instructed to clean it.

headline: No handwash signage; repeat violations
summary: No handwashing signage at the back preparation area. Repeat violations from a 2023 report remain uncorrected: bulk containers unlabeled and no backflow device at the mop sink. A citation was issued.

headline: No handwash sign; holes in walls
summary: No handwashing sign at the hand sink, and small holes in walls near the dish machine must be sealed.

headline: Blocked handwash sink cleared; cooler at 56°F
summary: A rear handwashing sink was blocked by boxes and supplies; the person in charge cleared it on site and a citation was issued. A front cooler measured 56.0°F; food was removed first and the cooler was tagged until repaired.

headline: Clogged handwash sink; missing pest control log
summary: The handwash sink behind the front bar is clogged and not draining; a citation was issued. No pest control log book from a licensed company was on the premises; a citation was issued. Back bar three-compartment sink backs up.

headline: Dish sink overflows onto floor; training missing
summary: The three-compartment sink in the dish area does not drain and overflowed onto the floor; it must be repaired. A priority violation was noted, but no citation was issued. One employee lacks a food handler training certificate.

headline: Home-prepared food found; no certified manager
summary: No certified food manager was on site with the original certificate while open; citation issued. Ground beef, Italian beef, and nacho cheese prepared at home were found on site; all food must be prepared on site. A stove lacks ventilation.

headline: Damaged gaskets, rust, missing backflow device
summary: Damaged gaskets on a small two-door cold unit, rust on two walk-in shelving units, and no backflow device found on the utility sink. Each must be repaired or installed.

headline: Grease and dirt on floors; walk-in leaking
summary: Grease buildup, food debris, and dirt were found on floors under equipment and in corners across several areas. Damaged and unstable floor tiles, detached baseboards, and dust on fans and vents. The walk-in cooler leaks water from its compressor.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit or written procedure
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or written procedure was on site. Grease trap has rust and chipped paint, cutting boards are stained, and the bar ice machine has no visible backflow device.

headline: No food thermometer; soiled towels on prep table
summary: No food thermometer was on site. Wet, soiled towels were left on a prep table. Greasy counters and shelves, odors from the grease trap, and condensation draining into a bucket in the walk-in cooler.

headline: Leaking backflow device; damaged floor tiles
summary: A backflow device leaks onto the floor in rear dry storage. A women's restroom faucet is loose. Floor tiles are damaged or missing grout, floors have debris and dust, and the walk-in freezer light is dim.

headline: Rodent droppings found in basement; citation
summary: Basement had pest droppings in several areas, roughly 5 to 30 per spot, including near water heaters and between walk-in units. Pest control service with proof is required before the January 28, 2025 return. Citation issued.

headline: Basement hood not operable
summary: The ventilation hood in the basement prep area is not operable and must be repaired and maintained.

headline: No sanitizer at inspection; cloths not sanitized
summary: No chemical sanitizer for warewashing was available at inspection; the person in charge obtained it on site and a citation was issued. Bulk dry containers unlabeled; wiping cloths stored without sanitizer; damaged floor tiles.

headline: Missing health policy; leaks and wall holes
summary: No employee health policies were on premises. Leaks from the utility sink pipe and a faucet knob in poor repair at the three-compartment sink. Holes in walls by the mop sink and office. Food handlers and managers need required training.

headline: Ice machine and drink dispenser heavily soiled
summary: A self-serve drink dispenser's ice-contact surfaces have white, black, and brown buildup dripping onto stored ice used for drinks. The rear ice machine has pinkish-brown residue. Ice was removed and citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; food stored on floor
summary: No person-in-charge sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was on duty while chicken, hot dogs, and pizza were prepared; citation issued. Food stored on floor in several areas. A front door gap must be sealed.

headline: Handwash water too hot; no food thermometer
summary: Handwash sink water measured 140°F, above the required 100–120°F. No food temperature device was on site, no service sink was present, and a toilet room has no mechanical ventilation.

headline: Missing catch basin at warewashing sink drain
summary: The floor-mounted drain at the 3-compartment warewashing sink has no catch basin. Operator was instructed to provide one for all sinks used to wash food, utensils, and equipment.

headline: Single-use containers not inverted; cutting board cut
summary: Single-use containers on kitchen storage racks must be stored inverted. A cutting board in the front prep area has deep cuts and must be resurfaced or replaced.

headline: Handwashing lapses; no certified manager on site
summary: No certified manager with the original certificate was on site; citation issued. Staff were seen touching surfaces and food without washing hands, and one handler washed without soap; all were rewashed on site. No food was contaminated.

headline: Ice machine debris; food stored on floor
summary: Slight debris is encrusted inside the ice machine. Thermometers are missing from two refrigerators. Stock food was stored on the floor. A torn door gasket was found, and several repeat violations from 2022 remain uncorrected.

headline: No certified manager when deli foods served
summary: No certified manager or valid certificate was on site while TCS deli sandwiches were served; certified manager arrived at 12:05 p.m.; citation issued. Food handler certificates were missing; basement floors are dirty.

headline: Floors and hood need detail cleaning
summary: Floor under and around cooking and non-cooking equipment needs detail cleaning, along with a wall near the dish machine. Greasy build-up is on the hood ventilation. One manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Personal items stored above clean dishes
summary: Employee personal care items were stored above clean equipment, dish storage, and kitchen shelves. Items must be moved below and away from food and clean utensils.

headline: Hot water too cool at sink; corrected on site
summary: Hot water at the three-compartment sink measured 106.0°F; the required minimum is above 110°F. Hot water was restored on site to 113.5°F before the inspection ended. Citation issued.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: A sanitation manager on the premises has no allergen training. The operator must provide it.

headline: Missing handwash signs; incomplete food labels
summary: No handwashing signs in employee restrooms. A grab-and-go container had incomplete food labels, a food handler lacked a hair restraint, and blender parts were not air-dried.

headline: Undercooked food disclosed on site; certificates expired
summary: Undercooked menu items were not marked or disclosed; this was corrected on site with asterisks and a menu note. Ceramic pitchers need lead documentation, a leaking faucet, rust on shelves, and expired food handler certificates for all handlers.

headline: Cups stored on floor; missing cooler thermometer
summary: Two boxes of single-use cups were on the floor of the drive-thru area and must be moved at least 6 inches up. A drawer cooler has no air thermometer. Dust and soil under shelves in rear storage.

headline: Unsafe food temperatures; about 60 lbs discarded
summary: Handwash water in restrooms was 91–92°F and was corrected by a plumber. Roast beef was 97°F and salmon 47°F; other cold foods were 44–56°F. About 10 lbs and 50 lbs of food were discarded; citation issued.

headline: Blank employee health policy forms; staff signed
summary: Employee health policy forms on site were blank. The person in charge and food handlers voluntarily signed copies. Citation issued.

headline: No food handler or allergen training proof
summary: No proof of food handler training was provided for any food handler. No proof of allergen training was provided for city-certified food service managers. Documentation must be kept on site.

headline: Steel wool at grease trap; no allergen training
summary: Steel wool is stuffed around the grease trap inlet and outlet in the rear wall and must be removed; the wall must be repaired. The certified food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Freezer ice buildup and faucet leak
summary: Chest freezer has ice buildup and food debris on its lower surface. A leak at the base of the 3-compartment faucet, and dirt and dust on a toilet room vent cover.

headline: Fly trap placed above clean glasses
summary: A fly trap was installed above the clean glass rack and must be kept away from clean glasses. An ice scoop was left on ice, and the bar ice bin is missing its cover.

headline: Missing handwash signs and cooler thermometer
summary: Handwash signs are missing near the front prep sink, and a milk cooler needs a working thermometer. Items were not elevated in the outdoor bar, low water pressure at a sink, and rusty shelving in a walk-in.

headline: No handwashing sign in women's restroom
summary: The women's restroom had no handwashing sign. The person in charge was instructed to provide and maintain one.

headline: Display cooler too warm; food discarded, cooler tagged
summary: Eggs at 54.8°F and lunchmeat at 54.5°F in a display cooler; cold foods must be 41°F or below. Manager discarded 30 lbs (about $250) of food. Cooler measured 60°F, was tagged, and cannot be used until reinspected.

headline: Handwash sinks lacked towels and soap; doors not sealed
