summary: Handwash sinks lacked paper towels and soap; staff provided them only on request, and a citation was issued. Front and side doors have gaps at the bottom. Employees lacked hair restraints, and excessive ice buildup was found in a meat freezer.

headline: Missing health policy, cleanup procedure, pest log
summary: No written employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure, or pest control log book was provided; each is a priority violation. The three-compartment sink is too small for some equipment, and a drain board is needed.

headline: Scratched cutting boards; oversized equipment for sink
summary: Pizza prep cutting boards are severely scratched and cannot be properly cleaned or sanitized; they must be resurfaced or replaced. Some equipment is too large to fully fit in the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Customers can reach food shelves; unlabeled bulk food
summary: Customers can reach food shelves on the way to the restroom and must be kept away. Bulk flour and sugar were unlabeled. Knives were wedged between a prep cooler and the wall.

headline: No allergen training proof for managers
summary: No proof of allergen training or certificates was available for any City of Chicago certified food manager. The operator must provide them.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: A food service sanitation manager lacked an allergen training certificate. The operator was instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: Freezer bottom buildup in prep area
summary: Build-up was found on the bottom of a single-door freezer in the prep area. The person in charge was instructed to clean it.

headline: No certified manager when milk served
summary: No city-certified food service manager was on site while milk (a TCS food) was served to the public; citation issued. A valid certificate must be present at all times.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; storage clutter
summary: Handwashing signs are missing at the front counter sink and employee washroom. The employee washroom needs a covered waste receptacle. Rear storage has clutter, and items must be raised off the floor.

headline: Unlabeled containers; greasy dumpster lid
summary: Food storage containers such as flour and salt must be labeled with their common names. The top of the grease dumpster in the rear outdoor garbage area has some grease buildup to clean.

headline: Basement bathroom walls need repair
summary: Basement bathroom walls must be restored to a smooth, easily cleanable surface and then maintained.

headline: Expired allergen certificates; restroom fire damage
summary: Women's restroom walls and ceiling are in poor repair from fire damage; repairs are in progress. Expired food allergen certificates were found, and managers were told to obtain valid ones.

headline: Leaking 3-compartment faucet; fryers greasy
summary: A faucet at the 3-compartment sink leaks constantly and has plastic wrapped around its neck; it must be repaired. The dish-area handwash sink drains slowly. Fryer bottoms and wheels need grease cleaning. Basement floor was cleaned on site.

headline: Cups stored under handwashing sink; leaking faucet
summary: Single-use cups and lids were stored inside the cabinet under the front handwashing sink; manager told to remove them to protect from leakage. Also noted: debris under display coolers and on the floor, and a leaking 3-compartment sink faucet.

headline: Ceramic cups need lead-safety documentation
summary: Ceramic or clay drinking cups are on site. Operator must show they are lead-free or lead-safe with documentation, or remove them.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; repaired on site
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer when checked and was not in use; it was repaired before inspection ended, and no citation was issued. Handwash signs are missing; food handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: No certified manager; food debris under equipment
summary: No City food service manager was on duty while empanadas, pastries, and sandwiches were prepared and served; citation issued. Leak at the handwash sink base. Dirt and food debris under equipment; cleaning was instructed to prevent pests.

headline: No backflow device; food handler lacks training
summary: No backflow prevention device was found on the coffee machine water line. A food handler lacked a food handler training certificate.

headline: Floors need cleaning in several areas
summary: Floors need cleaning in front prep area between heavy equipment, under the self-serve pop station, and behind the rear grease trap and 1-compartment sink.

headline: No certified manager on duty; mouse droppings found
summary: No certified food manager was on site while food that must stay hot or cold (TCS) was served; manager arrived 3:18 p.m.; citation issued. About 40 or more mouse droppings found in several areas; pest control recommended.

headline: Can opener blade and floor need cleaning
summary: The can opener blade at the prep table needs cleaning, and the area under the tabletop stove needs cleaning. Dirt on the floor next to the stove.

headline: About 170 rodent droppings in several areas
summary: Rodent droppings found: 80 by the rear coolers, 30 by the front service line, and 60 behind chest freezers in the dining area. Staff must remove them and sanitize; pest control recommended. Citation issued. Rear door not rodent-proofed.

headline: Dish machine and cooler held; milk discarded
summary: Dish machine measured 0 ppm sanitizer and was tagged; citation issued. Buffet milk measured 50.0–55.5°F; manager discarded 8 lbs (about $25). A prep cooler at 54.0°F was tagged and cannot be used until reinspected.

headline: Raw wood surface under front counter
summary: A raw wood surface under the front counter must be sealed so it is smooth and easily cleanable.

headline: Handwash sink blocked by food cart
summary: A large food cart blocked the only handwash sink in the fruit cut-up kitchen; a priority violation was noted. Slow drainage at restroom sinks, spoons stored in standing water, and unclean meat slicer behind the blade.

headline: No valid certificate; food handler training missing
summary: No person in charge had a valid Chicago food sanitation certificate, and none was posted; citation issued. Single-service articles stored on floor, food debris in coolers, no backflow device on utility sink, and employees lacked food handler training.

headline: Food stored on walk-in floor
summary: Food was stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and freezer and must be elevated 6 inches.

headline: No backflow device on ice machine; bulb out
summary: No backflow prevention device is visible on the ice machine water line. A hood light bulb is not working and must be replaced.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: No valid certified manager was on duty while TCS foods (food that must stay hot or cold) were handled and served; citation issued. Floors need cleaning, water is on the dish area floor, and it should be kept dry to prevent pests.

headline: Excessive debris in 3-compartment sink drain
summary: The floor drain under the 3-compartment sink has excessive debris and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training; ceiling paint peeling
summary: Cooler interior needs cleaning of spills and debris. Ceiling above the 3-compartment sink and serving area has peeling paint. The certified manager on duty lacked required allergen training.

headline: Grease buildup; food stored in plastic bags
summary: No handwashing signage at sinks. Grease and food debris built up inside a deep freezer and on cooking equipment, and food was stored in plastic grocery bags. Burnt-out lights and no allergen training on site.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Bulk foods and spices stored outside original containers were not labeled with product names. A sanitation manager lacks a food allergen training certificate.

headline: Heavily soiled ice machine; staff without hair restraints
summary: Ice machine interior was heavily soiled with a black substance; ice is used for drinks, and a citation was issued. Some food workers lacked hair restraints, scoops were stored with handles in food, and drains had heavy slime.

headline: Missing cooler thermometers and labels
summary: Several reach-in coolers lack air thermometers. Food storage containers in the rear storage area lack labels with common food names. The women's washroom lacks a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

headline: Dish machine not working; no sanitizer available
summary: The low-temperature dish machine is not working and has no sanitizer; it was tagged and must not be used until repaired. Also noted: porous stone bowls that cannot be sanitized, a three-compartment sink not set up properly, and sinks that drain poorly.

headline: 100 live small flies; walk-in freezer too warm
summary: Found 100 live small flies and 30 large flies on ceilings, walls, racks, and equipment; citation issued. Walk-in freezer measured 46.4°F; food was moved to the cooler. Sinks lacked soap and towels. Several earlier violations remain uncorrected.

headline: Handwash sink lacks hot water, soap, towels
summary: No certified manager certificate or employee health policy was on site. The front bar handwashing sink had no hot water, soap, or paper towels. No pest control log, food handler or allergen training certificates were available.

headline: Pest control records incomplete; sink leak
summary: Pest control log book has only one service report, dated 5/1/2024; at least two reports from the last 12 months are required. A citation was issued. A pipe leak below the front prep hand sink must be repaired.

headline: Torn gasket on prep cooler
summary: A torn door gasket inside the front three-door prep cooler must be replaced.

headline: No employee health policy; allergen training missing
summary: No employee health policy or training was on site; a priority violation was noted. Stained cutting boards need refinishing, a backflow preventer is not visible behind the basement ice machine, and an unused dish machine and stored pipes remain.

headline: Food containers on floor; greasy hood and cutting boards
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor in prep, storage, and walk-in areas and must be raised 6 inches. Knives were stored between a wall and pipe. Cutting boards have open seams and stains; hood and filters have heavy grease.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; allergen training missing
summary: Torn gaskets were found on a sushi prep cooler and a rear freezer door. Grease is built up on the cook-line hood filters. Two certified employees lack allergen training.

headline: Blocked handwash sink; raw chicken over vegetables
summary: A two-door cooler fully blocks the front handwashing sink, which must stay accessible. About 20 lbs of raw chicken was stored over raw vegetables; manager moved it on site. Refrigerator gaskets are torn.

headline: Beans held at 50°F; food discarded
summary: Beans in a display cooler measured 50°F; the manager discarded 4 lbs (about $5) and a citation was issued. Multiple holes in a basement wall must be repaired to prevent pest entry. Floors have loose debris and dust.

headline: No handwashing sink in new food prep area
summary: A newly added east-side food prep area has no handwashing sink; food handlers work there actively. Citation issued. Also noted: rusty shelves lined with plastic and foil, toilet doors not self-closing, and dirty floors and clutter.

headline: No certified manager; missing health policy and cleanup kit
summary: No city-certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were served, and a citation was issued. No written employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was available. Citations issued for each.

headline: No food thermometer; food handler lacks certificate
summary: No metal stem probe thermometer for cold foods; bread stored in cardboard; rusted walk-in racks; food handler without a valid certificate. Also noted: missing floor tiles, dirty floors and walls, and dim or unshielded lights.

headline: Loose sink handles need repair
summary: Cold water handle at the dish-area handwash sink and hot water handle at the prep-area handwash sink are loose and must be repaired.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged for inspection
summary: Low-temperature warewashing machine measured 0 ppm sanitizer; it must be repaired and was tagged and held for CDPH inspection. Citation issued. Cold unit gaskets have food grime; basement bin storage on floor.

headline: No hot holding thermometer; rusty walk-in shelves
summary: A visible, working thermometer is needed for hot holding equipment. Some wire shelves in the walk-in cooler are rusted, and the walk-in has dim lighting.

headline: Dirty caulking at 3-compartment sink
summary: Excessive black substance on caulking at the top base of the 3-compartment sink must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Doors not rodent-proofed; no vomit cleanup kit
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was on premises; a priority violation was noted. The front entrance and rear side door are not fully rodent-proofed and must be sealed or fitted with a door sweep. Unused items in basement and garage.

headline: Wall holes and peeling paint noted
summary: Holes in walls were found under the dish handsink, above the ice maker on the second floor, and near the beer cooler compressor; they must be sealed. Water-damaged and peeling paint in several storage and restroom areas.

headline: Loose release lever under sink
summary: The release lever under the 3-compartment sink in the second-floor kitchen is in poor repair and must be repaired.

headline: Flies noted; floors and walls need cleaning
summary: Floors and walls had food splatters and flies. Staff were instructed to detail clean and maintain them.

headline: Live roach found; cooler air at 47.2°F
summary: One live roach was crawling out from under a reach-in cooler and one nearly dead roach was inside it; pest control was asked to revisit. Reach-in cooler measured 47.2°F. The hot holding unit could not be tested.

headline: Live flies in prep areas; no hand towels at sinks
summary: About 10 or more large live flies and 25 or more small live flies were found in prep and dishwashing areas. Hand sinks lacked hand drying devices; a citation was issued. A rear door gap is a possible pest entry point.

headline: No certified manager on duty; ice machine slime
summary: Person in charge lacked a City sanitation certificate, and none was posted while chicken and beef were prepared; citation issued. Ice machine has pink and black slime inside, a repeat priority violation, and leaks under two sinks.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; missing thermometer
summary: A thermometer is missing from the prep cooler. Water drips into a pan inside the front prep cooler. All food handler certificates are expired, and the food service manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Damaged floor tiles; heavy grill hood buildup
summary: Damaged floor tiles and missing grout in prep and dish areas must be repaired. The ventilation hood above the grill had severe dust and charcoal buildup and needs more frequent cleaning.

headline: Shrimp stored in breading; sanitizer clipped in sink
summary: Pre-weighed breaded shrimp in brown bags was stored directly in the breading container. Staff were told to store the bags properly. A sanitizer dispenser was clipped inside a three-compartment sink basin and must be removed to prevent overdispensing.

headline: Grease and debris on equipment and floors
summary: Dirt, food debris, and splatter were found on front-area shelving and equipment. The basement floor had dirt and food debris under shelving and along the pizza oven. Heavy grease was on the hood and filters over the hot line.

headline: No handwashing signs at prep sinks
summary: No handwashing signs were posted at hand sinks in food prep areas. Management was instructed to provide them.

headline: No certified manager; ice machine slime
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on site while chicken wings and sandwiches were prepared; citation issued. Heavy black and brown slime was dripping from the ice machine into ice used for human consumption; citation issued. Also leaks and low water pressure.

headline: Gap under front entrance door
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the front entrance door must be sealed tightly to keep pests out. No insects or rodents were recorded in this inspection.

headline: Rodent droppings throughout; live roach
summary: Failed. About 45-50 rat and mouse droppings were found throughout the facility, including in a handwashing sink and under the dish machine. One live roach was found. Citation issued. Ice scoop and onions in soiled paper bags also flagged.

headline: No employee health policy on premises
summary: No employee health policy was on premises and must be provided. No handwashing signs were posted at hand sinks, and the mop sink faucet had no backflow prevention device. These must be provided.

headline: Holes in basement floor sealed
summary: Holes in the basement floor must be sealed to eliminate conditions where pests could hide. Management was instructed to seal them.

headline: Incomplete vomit kit; handsinks blocked
summary: The vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was incomplete, and a written procedure is required. A rear handsink was blocked by items, and soap and paper towels were missing at several sinks. Food on the walk-in floor must be raised six inches. Citation issued.

headline: Soiled ice machine chute; citation issued
summary: Failed. The ice machine chute and nearby surfaces were soiled with an excessive black substance. Ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned; citation issued. Also a missing cooler thermometer, torn gaskets, and excess ice in a walk-in freezer.

headline: Flying insects found; no certified manager
summary: Failed. Numerous flying insects were found in prep, dish, dining, and storage areas; manager told to call an exterminator. No certified food sanitation manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. Summary report not posted.

headline: Expired training for all staff; repeat violations
summary: Failed. Expired food handler training for all employees and expired allergen training for food managers were repeat violations not corrected; citation issued. Also food stored on the floor under shelving, worn cooler gaskets, buckets used for garbage, and a leaky faucet.

headline: Dead roaches near ice machine room
summary: Dead roaches were found on the floor and in a corner of a small room with the ice machine. Staff were instructed to remove them and clean the area.

headline: Mold in ice machine dripping onto ice
summary: Failed. Pink and black mold-like buildup inside the ice machine was dripping onto ice in the bin. The person in charge was told to remove it and sanitize; citation issued. Also rust on walk-in shelving and broken walk-in wall tiles.

headline: Food on freezer floor; greasy equipment
summary: Food was stored on the walk-in freezer floor and must be raised six inches. Grease and food debris were found on fryers, prep tables, cooking equipment, and shelving. The manager was told to clean them.

headline: Rat droppings found; rear door gap
summary: Failed. About 20 rat droppings were found: about 10 along a hallway wall under dry storage shelves and about 10 behind reach-in freezers. The rear door has a 1/2-inch gap and must be rodent-proofed. Citation issued; several prior violations not corrected.

headline: Restroom handsink hot water too cool
summary: A handwashing sink in the men's staff restroom reached only 78°F. The required minimum is 100°F. The manager must ensure hot water meets the minimum. The other sink met the standard.

headline: Dish machine too close to prep table
summary: The dish machine and prep table are too close together without protection. A splash guard must be installed to separate the two areas.

headline: Dead pests found; repeat violations uncorrected
summary: Failed. Dead pests were found in the prep area, men's restroom, and under bar shelving. Repeat violations from June 2025 were not fixed: unlabeled stored food, a non-draining handsink, and greasy floors. Citation issued.

headline: Clogged handwash sink; shrimp thawing in sink
summary: Failed. A rear prep handwashing sink was clogged and draining not at all; it must be kept usable at all times. Shrimp was thawing in a prep sink; staff discussed approved methods, and product temperature was adequate. Also dirty wiping cloths and a leaking pipe.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink faucet
summary: The three-compartment sink faucet is leaking and must be repaired. Spilled food debris on the floor along the sink walls must be cleaned.

headline: Worn sponges; grime under sink
summary: Worn sponges were used at the dish machine and must be changed often. Cutting boards had dark spots, and cooking equipment, coolers, and gaskets had food buildup. Grime is under the three-compartment sink and dish machine, and prep and storage floors need cleaning.

headline: To-go containers face-up; plastic bags used
summary: To-go containers were stored face-up on a prep shelf and must be inverted. Food in walk-in coolers and freezers was stored in plastic grocery bags; approved food-grade containers are required.

headline: Mold in ice machine; cooler door opening
summary: A pink moldlike substance was found inside the ice machine, so ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned. Also: an opening at a walk-in cooler door, a plastic sheet over pork in hot holding, cardboard liners, and expired allergen certificates.

headline: Cooler lacks thermometer; torn gaskets
summary: A two-door reach-in cooler had no thermometer. Food service items were stored on the floor in the rear storage area and must be raised six inches. Torn gaskets on another cooler and missing food handler certificates were also noted.

headline: Dirty display coolers; litter in garbage area
summary: Display coolers and the freezer were dirty inside. Litter in the enclosed garbage area must be cleaned to prevent pest hiding places. The walk-in dairy cooler floor has debris, and the walk-in freezer needs defrosting and cleaning.

headline: Basement utility room clutter
summary: The basement utility room held unused equipment and items on the floor. Staff must organize the room and raise items off the floor on suitable shelving.

headline: Cold foods too warm; $70 discarded
summary: Calamari at 47.4°F and pizza at 47.1°F were held above 41°F. The manager discarded 11 lbs ($70); citation issued. Also no vomit or diarrhea cleanup supplies (citation), missing handwash signs at three prep sinks, and unlabeled containers.

headline: Rat droppings at counter and cooler
summary: Failed. About 15 rat droppings were found: 5 at the front service counter and 10 beside a two-door cooler. Staff must remove them, clean, and call pest control. Gaps under front and rear doors need sealing. Citation issued.

headline: No dish-area handsink; undated chicken
summary: Failed. No handwashing sink in the rear dish area; priority violation. Three containers of cooked chicken in a prep cooler lacked discard dates. Several coolers had no thermometers, and food handlers were missing hair restraints.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; greasy fryers
summary: Several prep-area handsinks lacked handwashing signs. Buffet plates were not inverted, and no sign told customers to use a clean plate each trip. Deep fryers had excess grease. Foam-like caulk was exposed, and vents and pipes had dust.

headline: Cooked foods held over 24 hours undated
summary: Ready-to-eat cooked foods held over 24 hours in the walk-in cooler were not date marked; citation issued. Also unlabeled containers, missing hair restraints, missing food handler proof, three certified food managers without allergen training, and many cleaning and repair items.

headline: Rat droppings; no certified manager on site
summary: Failed. About 20 rat droppings were found behind the furnace, along equipment, and behind ovens. No pest control logbook was available, and a prior pest violation was not corrected. No certified food manager was on site while chicken wings were prepared. Exhaust hood not working.

headline: Uncovered garbage; items on basement floor
summary: Pizza prep equipment needed cleaning of dried food debris. Garbage in the women's restroom was uncovered. Alcohol and equipment on the basement floor must be shelved at least six inches off the ground to prevent pest hiding and allow cleaning.

headline: Rusted racks; hole in wall behind pizza
summary: Rusted walk-in storage racks must be restored or replaced. A hole in the wall behind the pizza station must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Corroded handsink faucet handles and expired food handler certificates were also noted.

headline: Fish thawed in sealed packaging
summary: Ice machine interior was soiled with dust and calcium buildup. Fish was thawed inside sealed packaging, contrary to the manufacturer's instructions. Also a hard-to-read dish machine thermometer, a leaking rear handsink, and a missing backflow cap.

headline: No handwashing sink in dish area
summary: Failed. There is no handwashing sink in the rear dishwashing area. The person in charge must install one with hot and cold running water; priority citation. Also food debris inside a cold holding unit and a restroom door without a self-closing device.

headline: Donuts stored on rack near drive-thru
summary: Donuts were stored on a movable rack near the drive-thru window. They must be removed or relocated.

headline: Unlabeled refrigerated food; cardboard on shelves
summary: Food items inside refrigerators were not labeled, including bulk containers. Cardboard boxes lined shelves and must be removed to prevent hiding places for pests.

headline: Hair restraint missing; ice scoops in machine
summary: An employee prepared food without a hair restraint. Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables, and ice scoops were stored inside the ice machine. A backflow device was not located at the ice machine. Water-damaged ceiling tiles need replacing.

headline: Missing food handler certificates; dirty walk-in
summary: Food handlers had no training certificates on site. Bulk food was unlabeled. Walk-in cooler racks, walls, and ceiling, plus bulk food container covers, were not clean.

headline: Rear door not sealing at bottom
summary: The rear exit door does not seal at the bottom. Weatherstripping must be replaced to prevent pest entry. An ice scoop was left lying on ice, and a freezer shelf and floors in prep and storage need cleaning.

headline: No handwashing sign; customer-area floors dirty
summary: A restroom handsink had no handwashing sign. Loose debris, dirt, and dust had built up on customer-area floors and corners. Detail cleaning and more frequent floor cleaning are required.

headline: Milk crates as shelving; hole in wall
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving, and cutting boards had open seams and stains. A 4-by-5-inch hole in the wall under a dish room handsink and a leaking hot water line need repair. Also grease, damaged floor tiles, and rusty dish machine shielding.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; tagged out
summary: The low-temperature dish machine measured 0 ppm sanitizer and is tagged out. It must not be used until it holds at least 50 ppm and is rechecked by the Chicago Department of Public Health. Also a non-self-closing door and expired allergen training.

headline: No certified manager during chicken prep
summary: No city-certified food service manager was on site while chicken and other TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. Handwashing reminder signs were missing in employee restrooms. Signs were provided and must be posted.

headline: Handwashing sign missing at sink
summary: No handwashing reminder sign was posted at a sink. The facility must provide one.

headline: Expired manager certificate; no hot water
summary: Failed. An expired city food manager certificate was on site while open; citation issued. The women's employee restroom handsink had no hot water, so staff were told to use the men's restroom until fixed. No food handler or allergen certificates were on site.

headline: Damaged walk-in floor tiles; dirty reach-ins
summary: Reach-in cooler interiors needed detail cleaning. Blistering and damaged floor tiles in all walk-in coolers must be repaired to create a smooth, cleanable surface.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged out
summary: The bar-area dish machine was not sanitizing and is tagged out. Staff posted signs and stopped use until it is repaired and rechecked. Also: leaking basement faucet, metal scoop buried in flour, and a hole in a basement wall.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; soiled caulk
summary: Downstairs customer restrooms lacked handwashing signs. Dish racks on the floor were raised during the inspection. Dirty, peeling caulk behind the sprayer must be cleaned or replaced. Cutting boards with open seams and dark stains must be refinished or replaced.

headline: No restroom handwashing sign; beard guard
summary: A toilet room had no handwashing sign. A food handler with a beard had no beard guard. A wiping cloth was stored on a cutting board. Staff were instructed to correct each item.

headline: No city food certificate posted; grease and dirt
summary: No original city food service certificate was posted. The person in charge must have one by the next inspection. Also food stored in a tin can, large pots that do not fit the dish machine, restroom trash without lids, and heavy grease in the hood and behind the stove.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; labeling needed
summary: Food handler certificates were expired and must be renewed. Bulk containers need labels, and kitchen staff lacked beard restraints. Also foil and towel liners in a cooler, dirty spice containers, cardboard floor matting, and clutter in the basement.

headline: Summary report not posted for customers
summary: The inspection summary report was not posted where customers could see it. A new copy was given to post; citation issued.

headline: 50+ mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: Failed. About 50 or more mouse droppings were found in a rear chemical closet and under shelves near the rear exit; citation issued. Pest control records were outdated, last service in 2022. No certified food manager was on site while open; citation issued.

headline: No certified manager during taco prep
summary: No city-certified food manager or certificate was on site while chicken and beef tacos were prepared; citation issued. Wiping cloths were stored on top of prep tables and must be kept in sanitizing solution.

headline: Mop sink cold water valve turned off
summary: The mop sink's cold water valve was turned off. The manager must turn it on.

headline: No valid certified manager; dish machine unsafe
summary: Failed. No valid city-certified food manager on site. A dish machine tested at 0 ppm sanitizer must not be used until rechecked. Also missing training proof, a 1/4-inch gap under the rear door, a wall hole, and leaking drains.

headline: Walk-in shelf debris; wall splatters
summary: Food debris was on walk-in cooler shelves, and splatters were on the wall behind the ice machine. The person in charge was told to clean both.

headline: No restroom handwashing sign; torn gasket
summary: The restroom handsink needs a handwashing sign. A torn gasket inside a three-door beverage cooler must be repaired.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; certificates unverified
summary: No visible thermometer was inside a cafe reach-in cooler; the person in charge provided one during the inspection. Food handler certificates could not be verified for all employees. Food manager had no allergen training proof on site.

headline: Unlabeled sugar; raw chicken on floor
summary: A bulk sugar container had no label. Boxes of raw chicken were on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised six inches. Two certified food managers lacked allergen training certificates.

headline: Gap under exit doors; leaking sink
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of rear storage exit doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. A leak under the handwashing sink in the rear chicken prep cooler must be repaired.

headline: Single-use items not inverted; greasy floors
summary: Single-use items were not inverted. Grease and food debris were found on cooking equipment, shelves, coolers, and floors. Storage walls and baseboards had cracks. Certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; tagged out
summary: Failed. Low-temperature dish machine measured 0 ppm sanitizer while in use; it is tagged out until it holds at least 50 ppm and the Chicago Department of Public Health rechecks it; citation issued. Also no test strips, food on floors, and missing thermometers.

headline: Chicken too warm in display cooler
summary: Chicken in a food display cooler measured 51.4°F, too warm for cold holding. The manager voluntarily discarded 10 lbs; citation issued. Also an ice scoop stored in ice, wet wiping cloths, a leaking drain, and a burned-out light bulb.

headline: Allergen training missing; slow drain
summary: The food service sanitation manager lacked an allergen training certificate and must meet the requirement. Also a slow-draining employee restroom handsink and debris on floors in utility and storage areas.

headline: Soiled cooler; restroom trash lacked lid
summary: A two-door prep cooler was heavily soiled with milk spillage on its bottom shelves. The restroom had no lidded trash can, but the manager bought one during the visit. The rear prep floor had dust and spill buildup.

headline: No sanitation certificate or pest log
summary: Failed. The person in charge had no city sanitation certificate or proof of enrollment. No pest control logbook was on site. Also no metal stem thermometer, missing splash guards, and a required one-compartment prep sink.

headline: No proof of food handler training
summary: The inspector found no proof of food handler training or certificates for all required employees. The facility must provide documentation.

headline: Taqueria items stored in shopping-area cooler
summary: Taqueria prep items were stored in a cooler in the customer shopping area. Staff must lock and label it as staff-only. Uncovered tamales in a rear chest freezer were touching ice and must be covered.

headline: Personal items stored on food shelves
summary: Employees' clothing and bags were stored on food shelves and must be separated. A chipped wall behind a rear prep table needs a smooth, durable surface.

headline: Frozen beef thawed improperly; corrected on site
summary: Frozen beef was thawed on the bottom shelf of a cart, which is not an approved method. The food handler was told the proper methods. The manager moved the beef into a cooler during the inspection.

headline: Soiled ice machine; open drinks above food
summary: Failed. Open employee drinks were stored above single-use items. The ice machine shield was soiled, and staff were told to discard the ice; citation issued. Also missing cooler thermometers, leaking faucets, and 2022 violations not corrected.

headline: Sandwich cooler too warm; food discarded
summary: Sandwich prep cooler held cold foods above 41°F: tuna 50.1°F, chicken 47.6°F, roast beef 49.0°F, ham 47.4°F, turkey 49.8°F. About 25 lbs were discarded on site; citation issued. A leaking sprayer hose also needs repair.

headline: No certified food manager during raw beef handling
summary: No certified food manager or posted certificate was present while raw beef and eggs were handled; citation issued. The person in charge lacked the certification. A sandwich cooler lacked a thermometer, and a mop was stored against a wall.

headline: Backflow preventers not found; allergen training
summary: Backflow preventers for the ice maker and espresso machine could not be located and must be installed where they are easy to view. The food service manager has no allergen training certificate.

headline: To-go containers used to scoop food
summary: Disposable to-go containers were used to scoop food at service prep coolers. Staff must use tongs, spoons, or ladles. Also a torn freezer gasket, a leaking faucet, loose cooler lid knots, and a non-working basement walk-in bulb.

headline: Walk-in freezer debris; damaged shelving
summary: Heavy debris, plastic trash, and broken wood pieces were scattered across the floor of the middle walk-in freezer. A heavily damaged shelf or pallet was creating debris. The manager must clean and repair or replace it.

headline: No certified manager; no pest log
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site, and no certificate was posted while deli meat and chicken were handled; priority violation. No pest control logbook or service proof was provided; the manager was told to obtain licensed pest control.

headline: Unlabeled food; plastic bags used for storage
summary: Re-packed ready-to-eat food was unlabeled. Plastic grocery bags were used as food containers, and milk crates were used for elevation. Also incomplete hair restraints, a broken walk-in freezer gasket, ice buildup, and expired allergen training.

headline: Food on floors; cutting boards stained
summary: Food containers were stored on floors in the walk-in cooler, prep, and storage areas and must be raised six inches. A meat prep handsink lacked a handwashing sign. Cutting boards with open seams and dark stains need refinishing or replacement.

headline: Grease and debris; restroom lacks lidded bin
summary: Grease and food debris were on cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, freezers, and shelving. The unisex restroom had no covered receptacle. Debris was on floors in utility and storage areas. The manager was told to clean.

headline: Food and spatulas stored in dumpster room
summary: Peanut butter and food-contact spatulas were stored in the dumpster room. The manager was instructed to remove them.

headline: No certified food manager during milk handling
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while TCS foods such as milk and heavy cream were handled; priority violation. A cloth towel was hung on the clean utensil rack and must be kept away.

headline: Cutting board by handsink; heavy grease
summary: An open cutting board sat next to a main kitchen handsink; it must be moved or a splash guard installed. The fryer and grill line had heavy grease and dried food debris, and floors under cooking equipment were heavily soiled.

headline: Plastic tarp used as ceiling repair
summary: A plastic tarp was used to repair the ceiling in the rear kitchen. Ceiling repairs must use smooth, cleanable material.

headline: Plastic bags hold food; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: Plastic grocery bags were used to store food in coolers and freezers, and bulk containers were unlabeled. A foam cup was used to dispense salsa. Food spills in basement freezers and a broken basement restroom fan also need correction.

headline: Torn freezer gasket; mops need drying
summary: A torn gasket inside a reach-in freezer must be repaired. Mops must be hung to dry when not in use.

headline: Live cockroaches found; citation issued
summary: Failed. Five live cockroaches were on a wall above the utility mop sink, and two were on a grease trap box. More pest service is required; citation issued. Also no hand soap or paper towels at a prep handsink, and cooked foods were not date marked.

headline: Frozen meats thawing on prep tables
summary: Frozen meats were thawing on prep tables. The manager was told to thaw them under cold running water, in a refrigerator, or in a microwave as part of continuous cooking. Also plastic grocery bags storing food, greasy equipment, and a minor sink leak.

headline: Food stored in non-food-grade bag
summary: Food was stored in a non-food-grade grocery bag. Staff must use food-grade storage bags.

headline: Food handlers lack training proof
summary: Some food handlers had no proof of food handler training. The facility must provide it.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup plan
summary: No written employee health policy and no vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies were on site; both must be provided. Also an unfinished wood wall, a restroom door that does not self-close, clutter, and heavy dust.

headline: Allergen training missing; repeat violation; light shield
summary: No certified food manager had allergen training, a violation not fixed since 2023; citation issued. A light fixture in the rear prep area lacks a required shield, which staff must provide.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; manager lacks allergen training
summary: The torn door gasket on an undercounter prep cooler in the basement food prep area must be replaced. The certified food manager had no allergen training certificate.

headline: Food handler certificates expired
summary: Food handler certificates were expired. Staff must complete training and keep valid certificates on site.

headline: No certified manager on premises; citation
summary: No city-certified food service manager was on premises; citation issued. Black moldlike substance was found inside the ice machine. Also leaks under the three-compartment sink, ice buildup at the walk-in freezer, dusty ceiling tiles, and missing grout.

headline: Mouse droppings found under and behind sinks
summary: Failed. About 45 mouse droppings were found: 10 behind shelving in rear storage, 30 under a sink ledge, and 5 near the dish area. A citation was issued. A faucet at the front three-compartment sink leaks. Floors and floor drains need cleaning.

headline: Dead ants, leaking door gap, and cold food discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. No vomit and diarrhea clean-up supplies or policy on site. Beans at 48F and soup at 46.4F were discarded, about 7 lbs. Dead ants were on the floor, and a quarter-inch gap is at the rear exit door. Several lights are out.

headline: Mold-like substance in ice machine; sanitizer test kit missing
summary: Failed. Beige mold-like substance in the ice machine must be cleaned and sanitized. Openings at the base of entrance doors must be sealed. Unwrapped utensils were not inverted. No quaternary ammonium test kit on site, a citation issued. Containers stored on the walk-in cooler floor.

headline: Boxed food stored on floor; raise six inches
summary: Passed. Boxed food items were stored on the floor in the rear prep area and walk-in cooler. The person in charge was instructed to elevate all food six inches off the floor on raised shelving.

headline: Gaps under doors and multi-use utensils not inverted
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Gaps were found along the bottom of front and rear doors. Paper cups are stored inside food containers, and multi-use utensils must be inverted. Grease builds up on walls, fryers and cooking equipment, and some floor tiles are broken.

headline: Restroom faucets shut off too fast; cleaning needed
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Men's restroom faucets shut off immediately; they must allow at least 15 seconds of running water. Pink residue in ice machine, a thermometer in the barista cooler is not working, and torn gaskets and food splatter need cleaning.

headline: Cracked floor tile and water-stained ceiling tiles
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Cracked floor tile in the dishwashing area must be replaced. Water-stained ceiling tiles in the rear storage area and selling floor must be replaced. Unnecessary items in the rear right storage room must be removed to avoid clutter.

headline: Dirty coolers, unlabeled bulk containers, worn thermometer
summary: Passed. Interiors of reach-in coolers and freezer need cleaning to remove food splatter. A thermometer is worn and must be replaced. Large bulk containers need labels. Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizer. Cooking equipment, floors and drains need cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled flour and rice containers; mop stored poorly
summary: Passed. Bulk storage containers for flour and rice are not labeled. Mop was stored in a way that prevents drying, and pest hiding places should be avoided. Dust, flour and grease are on floors, walls, pipes and corners throughout the premises.

headline: No hot water; hand sink lacks soap and towels
summary: Passed with conditions. Dish room hand sink had no hand soap, and was corrected on site. No hot water was found, and sink temperatures were 81 to 83F, below the required standard. Priority violation citation issued.

headline: No backflow device at ice machine water line
summary: Passed. Complaint inspection. No backflow prevention device was found at the ice machine water line. The owner must install one where it can be located and serviced.

headline: Missing thermometer; unlabeled containers; ice scoop stored in ice
summary: Passed on re-inspection. No ambient air thermometer in the refrigerator next to the ice machine. Dry ingredient containers in the rear prep area are not labeled. An ice scoop was improperly stored between the ice machine unit.

headline: Passed; wiping cloths, training and sink stoppers flagged
summary: Passed. Soiled wiping cloths were left on prep tables, and single-use items were not inverted. The three-compartment sink has no stoppers. No food handler training was shown for employees; all must obtain it.

headline: Wiping cloths on prep tables; dusty light shields
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were stored on food prep tables instead of in sanitizing solution. Tinfoil and cardboard were used inside refrigeration units and must be removed. Dust and dirt built up inside light shield covers in the front prep area.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; faucet does not reach sink
summary: Failed. Bulk containers in the rear storage area are not labeled. The three-compartment sink faucet does not reach all compartments, a citation was issued. Certified managers have no allergen training.

headline: No certified manager; no hand sink in dish area
summary: Failed. The manager on site did not have a valid city food service manager certificate. The rear dish area has no hand sink; it appears to have been removed. Leaking drain pipe at three-compartment sink. Greasy cooking equipment, a toilet door that does not self-close, and two lights out.

headline: Worn gaskets, fryer grease, and floor debris
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Worn door gaskets on a two-door prep cooler must be repaired or replaced. Grease and food debris must be cleaned from the fryer cabinets. The reach-in freezer must be defrosted. Grease and debris along floor wall bases must be cleaned.

headline: Wastewater spilling onto floor; citation issued
summary: Failed. Wastewater spilled onto the floor from drain pipes when the three-compartment sink drained. Manager was told to drain slowly until a plumber arrived and to clean the pipes to prevent backups. A priority citation was issued.

headline: Wastewater flooding; freezer chest in poor repair
summary: Passed with conditions. Wastewater disposal was inadequate; the nearby floor drain floods when the three-compartment sink drains. A technician arrived on site. Priority citation issued. A freezer chest has rust and damaged gaskets and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Gap at entrance door; one manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. Complaint inspection. A quarter-inch gap is at the front entrance door sweep and must be rodent-proofed. One food manager lacks food allergen training certificate, and all certified food managers must have one.

headline: Dust and debris on hood above cooking equipment
summary: Passed. Short form complaint. Dust and debris buildup on the ventilation hood above the cooking and frying equipment must be cleaned.

headline: Basement toilet room lacks exhaust ventilation
summary: Passed. The basement toilet room has no mechanical exhaust ventilation. The owner must install and maintain it.

headline: Cutting boards creased; rusty freezer shelves
summary: Passed. Deep creases were found in cutting boards on the prep cooler top and must be resurfaced or replaced. Rusty shelves in the walk-in freezer must be repainted or replaced. Employees with certificates must complete allergen training.

headline: Ice and debris build-up in walk-in freezer
summary: Passed. Excessive debris and ice build-up was found on the floor, walls and ceiling of the walk-in freezer and must be removed. Exposed foam-like caulk is around walls and pipes in rear prep. Toilet room exhaust vent is dirty.

headline: No certified manager with TCS food; over 20 live flies
summary: Failed. No certified city food service manager was on site while beef and rice were being handled. Over 20 live flies were found in the bar, near a utility sink and the warewashing unit. Pest control is required. Preset tableware was uncovered. Debris found in rear floor drains.

headline: Front door gap; several cleaning and plumbing items
summary: Passed. Bottom of front entrance door must be rodent-proofed. Three-compartment sink needs three working stoppers, and it leaks at the faucet neck. No grease trap was found. Broken self-closing device on washroom door. A certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: About 40 rat droppings found; dishwasher not sanitizing
summary: Failed. About 40 rat droppings were found in the basement storage area and under the stairs; extra pest control is needed. Low-temperature dishwasher sanitizer measured 0 ppm. No written employee health policy was on site.

headline: No certified manager; dirty ice machine and food on floor
summary: Failed. No city food service sanitation manager was on duty while TCS foods were stored, handled and served, a citation was issued. Ice machine had dirt and pink slime over ice. Food was stored on the walk-in cooler floor and uncovered. Leaking drain pipe under handwash sink.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; mop water disposed outdoors
summary: Passed. Milk crates are used as shelving in prep and storage areas and must be replaced. Raw wood shelves must be sealed or painted. No utility sink; mop water is dumped in an outdoor floor drain. Missing covered sanitary napkin receptacle and exposed caulk.

headline: Dirty equipment, floors, and hood; allergen training missing
summary: Passed. A large can opener in the rear prep area has dirt and grime. Floors and cooler shelves need detail cleaning. Heavy grease and food debris on cooking and food prep equipment. Hood and filters need cleaning. One employee lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Mold-like substance inside ice machine; expired certificates
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Pink and black mold-like substance was found inside the ice machine. Ice must be destroyed and the machine cleaned and sanitized. Expired food handler certificates were posted, and allergen training certificates were not provided. Stained ceiling tiles found.

headline: Improperly held hot and cold food discarded on site
summary: Passed with conditions. Grilled onions were held at 94.6F, and several cold foods were at 46 to 50F, including ground beef and rice. About 20 lbs of food was discarded on site. Chicken was cooled covered in plastic wrap. Basement cooler floor needs cleaning.

headline: Chips stored on floor; mold in washroom
summary: Passed. A box of chips was stored on the floor near the front counter, and all food must be raised six inches. Mold-like substance and missing baseboards were found along the rear washroom wall. Manager was instructed to repair and maintain.

headline: Uncovered food, soiled wiping cloths, and debris
summary: Passed. Complaint inspection. Bulk peppers and bread were uncovered in prep areas. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables. Shallow bowl used as a dispensing utensil. Employee coat stored between slicer and grinder, and food spills on floors and equipment.

headline: About 100 mouse droppings found throughout facility
summary: Failed. About 100 mouse droppings were found in the dining room, kitchen, and on food-related items. A citation was issued. A half-inch gap at the rear exit door needs sealing. Also: drink crates used as shelving, holes in walls and floors, and no allergen-trained manager.

headline: Ice machine has visible residue; cutting board damaged
summary: Failed. Ice machine interior had pink, black and brown substance on top, and ice is used for drinks and food. Citation issued. Main cook-line cutting board had deep grooves and dark stains; manager was told to resurface or replace it.

headline: Leaking hand sink pipes and water-damaged ceilings
summary: Passed. Complaint inspection. Hand sink pipes leak in the front meat prep area, meat packaging room and men's washroom, and must be repaired. Water-damaged ceiling tiles in the chilled produce area must be replaced or repaired.

headline: Frozen condensate on food; broken cooler and greasy fryers
summary: Passed. Frozen condensate was on food in the basement walk-in freezer and must be removed by defrosting. Food spills inside the chest freezer and greasy fryer interiors need cleaning. Cardboard lining must be removed. A two-door cooler and a walk-in cooler are not working.

headline: Sanitizer at 0 ppm; flies, low hot water, missing policies
summary: Failed. Dish machine sanitizer measured 0 ppm while in use; the manager fixed it to 50 ppm. Basement men's toilet hand sinks ran 41.6 to 86.3F, below the required 100F. About 30 live flies were seen near a floor drain and bar. Also: missing health policies and summary report.

headline: Greasy wok, fryers and hood need cleaning
summary: Passed. Encrusted grease on the wok station, stove and deep fryers must be cleaned. Walls around the exposed hand sink in the prep area need cleaning. Grease on ventilation hood and filters must be cleaned.

headline: License number missing from delivery banners
summary: Passed. License number is not printed on the sides of the bicycle banners. It must be at least two inches tall.

headline: Food spills on coolers and missing food handler training
summary: Passed. Food spills and debris were found on coolers, freezers and cooking equipment. There are no thermometers in the rear milk cooler and large side cooler. Self-closing device on the washroom door is in poor repair. Employees handling food need food handler training.

headline: Missing washroom signs; prior summary not displayed
summary: Passed with conditions. Women's washroom has no handwashing sign. Stained cutting boards and greasy fryer bottoms need cleaning. Broken ceiling tile and dusty vents. The previous inspection summary was not displayed, a citation was issued.

headline: Rusted dry storage racks noted
summary: Passed. Rusted storage racks in the dry storage area must be repainted or replaced.

headline: Food on floor; no food handler certificates on site
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Boxes of frozen catfish were stored on the floor in the dishwashing area and must be raised six inches. Open drinks are prohibited in prep areas. No food handler certificates on site. Mops were not stored to air dry.

headline: Greasy grease trap; no certified manager allergen training
summary: Passed. Debris and soiled towels were in the cabinet under the taco sink. The grease trap at the high-temperature dish machine has rust and grease buildup. The certified manager has no allergen training certificate on site.

headline: Slow-draining sink and standing water in basement
summary: Passed. Dishwashing hand sink drains slowly and must drain quickly. The washroom has no covered trash can. Standing water was found on the basement floor outside the walk-in cooler and in the dish storage room. Floors must be kept dry.

headline: Raw food on floor and dropped tongs corrected on site
summary: Passed with conditions. Complaint inspection. Raw shrimp was on the floor under a sink; corrected on site. A cook dropped tongs and put them back into raw chicken. About 3 lbs ($15) discarded, and this was corrected on site. Greasy fryer and cluttered washroom noted.

headline: Leaking faucets; washroom receptacles and food handler training
summary: Passed. Complaint inspection. Leaking faucets were seen on the three-compartment and utility sinks. Unisex washrooms have no covered receptacle. Some food handlers have expired food handler training and must be provided with valid training.

headline: Greasy hood and dish machine need cleaning
summary: Passed. Dried buildup inside and outside the dish machine must be detail cleaned. Grease buildup on exhaust hoods and filters above the deep fryers must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Ceiling opening, dirty floor drains and greasy floors
summary: Passed. Complaint inspection. A large opening in the ceiling around pipes near the rear electrical panel must be sealed. Dirt and debris are on floor drains, and grease builds up behind rear cooking equipment. Dusty ceiling vents in employee washrooms.

headline: Re-inspection passed; several items need correction
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Missing handwashing signs, no thermometer in walk-in cooler, and an ice scoop stored on the ice machine. Sink stoppers are missing, and a pipe under a hand sink leaks. Three burnt-out bulbs and no allergen training certificate for the food manager.

headline: No person in charge on site; no certified manager
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge was present during inspection. No certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were being prepared and served, which is a citation. Serving plates were not inverted, and food is kept in grocery bags. Managers lack allergen training.

headline: Passed; washroom storage and training required
summary: Passed. Some items were stored in the employee washroom and must be organized. Instructed that all food handlers must obtain the required food handler training.

headline: No health policies; mouse droppings and flies found
summary: Failed. Employee health policies were missing. Over 70 mouse droppings were found in the basement and dining area, and at least 8 live flies in the kitchen and dining room. Pest control serviced the establishment on June 12, 2026. Also: dirty dish machine and leaking water valve.

headline: Hair restraint missing; dirty can opener and vents
summary: Passed. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint in the prep area. The can opener has food and dirt buildup. Employee washroom vents have dust, and floor drains and floors under heavy equipment need cleaning. Mops must be hung to air dry.

headline: Aluminum foil lining equipment must be removed
summary: Passed. Aluminum foil surrounds several pieces of kitchen equipment. The manager was instructed to remove it so surfaces are smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Cast iron sewer line above food prep area
summary: Passed. A cast iron sewer line runs above the food prep area and must be enclosed.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and syrup spills
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs were missing from prep area sinks. Single-use items were stored under the front hand sink and must be removed to protect against leakage. Syrup spills under the slushie machine must be cleaned. Certified manager lacks valid allergen training.

headline: Potatoes on floor; personal medicines stored in prep area
summary: Passed. Both ice machine interiors were soiled. Personal care items such as Advil and Vicks were stored with food items in the rear prep area. A large container of sliced potatoes sat on the floor. Giardiniera was stored in trash-type containers, and a rear ice machine panel is cracked.

headline: Re-inspection passed; leaks and missing sign noted
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Front bar hand sink has no handwashing sign. Three-compartment sink stoppers do not work, and several leaks need repair. Water-stained ceiling tiles and a burnt-out bulb noted. No certified manager with allergen training; documentation required.

headline: Passed; single-use items, shelving and leaks need fixing
summary: Passed. Single-use items were not inverted to protect them from contamination, and pop crates were used as shelving. Manager was told to fix both. Also noted: a leaking rear hand sink faucet and no waste receptacle at a hand sink.

headline: Leaking pipe near mop sink and toilets
summary: Passed. Complaint inspection found a leak from piping in the mop sink area and water pooling near the toilets. Manager was instructed to repair all leaks.

headline: Live roaches, dead flies and unsafe dishwasher; failed
summary: Failed. Over 50 live roaches were found in dish and prep areas, and over 300 dead flies on food containers and floors. Dishwasher sanitizer measured 0 ppm and was tagged out. Cold food was held at 55.4F. Residential insecticide and unapproved bacon curing were found. Many citations.

headline: Food stored on floor; elevate six inches
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Containers and bins of food were on the floor in the rear dishwashing and prep area. Staff were instructed to raise all food items at least six inches off the floor.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food; priority violation
summary: Passed with conditions. A food handler picked up tomatoes, bread and cheese with bare hands while assembling food, a priority violation. Deli cups were used as scoops in a bulk container. A backflow device could not be located for the basement ice maker.

headline: Loose cooler gasket and water leak at ice machine
summary: Passed. Complaint inspection. A loose gasket was found inside the three-door prep milk cooler. A leak was found at the west ice machine water supply line. Litter in bar floors and dirty floor drains noted. Dusty ceiling vents must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager posted; bare-hand contact with food
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager with original certificate was on site while open. An employee put a garnish into a drink by hand. Several cold foods were at 48 to 58F and about 15 lbs was discarded. A prep cooler at 48.2F was tagged.

headline: Milk crate used as shelving in walk-in cooler
summary: Passed. Complaint inspection. A milk crate is used as shelving in the walk-in cooler and must be replaced with shelving at least six inches off the floor.

headline: Menu lacks raw-food advisory; multiple upkeep problems
summary: Failed. Menu does not mark raw or undercooked items or include the required consumer advisory (a priority violation). Also: bar knives stored between metal plates, stored items on floors, dirty shelving, duct tape used as plumbing repair, gaps behind employee toilet, and no allergen training proof.

headline: Cold food held too warm; mouse droppings and flies found
summary: Failed. Several cold foods were held at 55 to 66F, and about $100 (8 lbs) was discarded. Over 20 mouse droppings were found on basement pallets, and about 30 small flies in the dining and prep areas. Openings at front and rear doors and leaking drain pipe found.

headline: Unsafe thawing, unlabeled bulk foods, missing training proof
summary: Passed. Frozen shrimp was thawed in standing water, and methods were reviewed. Knives were stored between a wall and conduit. Bulk foods and spices need labels. Cook-line shelving is greasy, and no proof of food handler training was on site.

headline: No pest log, missing sneeze guard and handsink
summary: Failed on re-inspection. No current pest control log book or inspection reports were on site. Buffet lacks a sneeze guard and a hand sink. No clean-plate sign. Chipped wall paint and damaged floor tiles and grout in prep and dish areas.

headline: Missing signs and hair restraints; pest devices in use
summary: Passed. No handwashing signs at any sink. Fly strips and sticky cardboard are used for pest control and should be removed only by the licensed technician. Hair restraint not worn. Three-compartment sink missing stoppers. Floors, coolers and ceiling holes need cleaning and repair.

headline: No prep sink in banquet area; ice buildup noted
summary: Passed on re-inspection. The banquet hall prep area on the 14th floor has no prep and dump sink, which must be installed. Covered receptacle needed in the 15th floor women's employee washroom. Dusty condenser fan covers and ice buildup on the walk-in freezer condenser must be cleaned.

headline: Failed; hand sink blocked, raw-food notice missing
summary: Failed. Rear hand sink was blocked by a mop bucket and pots; staff cleared it during inspection. Menu lacks the required raw or undercooked food advisory. Frozen meat was thawed unsafely on a table. Knife stored between coolers. Earlier violations not fixed.

headline: Earlier priority violations not corrected; citation
summary: Failed on re-inspection. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer, and a walk-in freezer gasket is broken. A certified manager lacks allergen training. Earlier violations not corrected, including unlabeled containers, cardboard and foil on equipment, and greasy fryer.

headline: Gap at door bottom; greasy cooking equipment
summary: Passed. A gap was found at the bottom of double doors on the St. Louis side and must be sealed. Raw wood shelving must be painted or stained. A loose sink in the rear dish area needs resealing. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment must be cleaned.

headline: Thawing on counter; jewelry worn; damaged thermometer
summary: Passed. Complaint inspection. Frozen bacon was thawed on the counter outside refrigeration. Employees wore jewelry on their wrists. Bulk single-use items were stored on the floor of the dry storage closet. A bent wired probe thermometer and a leaking spray hose nozzle at the three-compartment sink.

headline: Leak and water pooling under rear hand sink
summary: Passed. A leak under the hand sink in the rear dishwashing and prep area caused water to pool on the floor. Manager was instructed to repair it and maintain the area.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit clean-up policy
summary: Passed with conditions. The person in charge lacks a certified food manager certificate, and none was posted while TCS foods were handled, a citation was issued. No vomit and diarrhea clean-up policy or supplies. Food handler training missing. A gap at the front door must be sealed.

headline: Missing backflow device on second-floor ice machine
summary: Passed on re-inspection. No backflow device could be located on the second-floor ice machine. The women's toilet room has no covered receptacle. Unused equipment and articles in basement storage must be removed to prevent pests. Soiled mop heads must be hung to dry.

headline: Missing backflow device on utility sink
summary: Passed. The rear utility sink has no backflow device, which prevents dirty water flowing back into the water supply. Manager was instructed to install one.

headline: Torn cooler gasket and greasy fryers
summary: Passed. A torn gasket on the pizza prep cooler must be repaired. Minor grease buildup inside the fryers must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Cold food discarded; no hand towels at bar sink
summary: Failed. No hand drying supplies at the bar hand sink. About 110 lbs (worth $1,500) of cold food held at 58 to 60F was discarded and two prep coolers were tagged. Mold-like substance was found in the ice machine, and there was no test kit at first. Menu lacks raw-food advisory asterisks.

headline: Food handler's unsafe habits; several violations corrected
summary: Passed with conditions. Complaint inspection. A food handler drank from a cup and then handled ready-to-eat food; he changed gloves and washed hands during the inspection. Some sinks were blocked by items, which were removed. Toxic chemical was in a milk container, which was removed.

headline: Clogged hand sink and missing stoppers; previous violations
summary: Passed with conditions. Main cooking area hand sink was clogged with grease and had no hot water; a plumber cleared it and hot and cold water were restored on site. The three-compartment sink has no stoppers. Earlier food handler and allergen training violations were not corrected.

headline: About 20 live flying insects in food prep area
summary: Failed. About 20 live small flying insects were seen on the ceiling, walls and stock boxes in the rear food prep area. Additional pest control service is needed. A citation was issued. Ceiling tiles in the prep area must be cleaned.

headline: Dead roaches and live-trap catches found
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Dead roaches were found behind equipment, on a grease trap, and on sticky traps under cold units. A rear exit door had a gap at the bottom. Also: missing handwashing signs, wiping cloths on a hand sink, and greasy cooking equipment.

headline: Old prepared food lacked discard dates; 50 lbs tossed
summary: Passed with conditions. Cooked chicken, lentil soup and gravy bags, prepared 11/3 to 12/5, had no discard date and were held past seven days. Held at 38.8F. About 50 lbs, worth $130, was discarded. Priority violation.

headline: Burnt-out lights and leaking drain pipe
summary: Passed on re-inspection. A splash guard is needed between the ice bin and hand sink. A torn cooler gasket, grease in fryers and hot equipment, and a leaking drain pipe under the dish area were found. Burnt-out light bulbs over the hoods.

headline: Drain buildup and greasy hood filters noted
summary: Passed. Buildup in a kitchen drain near the three-compartment sink must be cleaned. Grease buildup was found on hood system filters. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain both.

headline: Low water pressure at women's restroom hand sink
summary: Passed. Low water pressure was found at the right hand sink in the women's restroom. Manager was instructed to repair it and provide adequate running water.

headline: Raw shrimp and chicken held too warm; about $100 discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Complaint inspection. Five lbs of raw shrimp were held at 52F in the walk-in cooler, and 40 lbs of raw chicken were held at 46F for two days. Manager discarded about $100 of product. Greasy cooking equipment and moldy caulking noted.

headline: No handwashing sign; grocery bags used to freeze food
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign at the exposed hand sink in the rear near the three-compartment sink. Grocery bags were used to freeze food and must be replaced with food-grade, reusable containers.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; stopper inoperable
summary: Passed on re-inspection. A rinse basin stopper is inoperable and must be repaired. Food handler training certificates for all food handlers were expired. The manager must provide proof of valid food handler training for all handlers.

headline: Air conditioning drain line into sink basin
summary: Passed on re-inspection. The air conditioning drain line empties into the middle basin of the three-compartment sink and must be rerouted. The toilet room receptacle lacks a cover.

headline: Heavy grease in fryer; manager's allergen training expired
summary: Passed. Heavy grease was found at the bottom of the fryer and must be cleaned. Floors under and around kitchen equipment, and under rear storage shelves, need cleaning. The person in charge has an expired allergen training certificate.

headline: Thermometer must be placed where easy to see
summary: Passed. The walk-in cooler thermometer is at the back of the unit. Staff were instructed to keep it in the warmest part of the cooler, where it can be easily viewed.

headline: Mild grease buildup on cooking equipment
summary: Passed. Complaint inspection. Mild grease and food debris were found on the sides and behind cooking equipment. Staff were instructed to clean, sanitize and maintain the equipment.

headline: Passed with conditions; no manager on site, bare-hand contact
summary: No certified food manager on site while TCS foods were prepared, a priority citation. An employee washed hands without soap; the manager had them use soap. Tacos were touched with bare hands; the manager had them remade with gloves. No pests found.

headline: Passed; upkeep issues and a worker lacks food handler training
summary: A broken ceiling tile above a sink must be repaired. Dusty ceiling fixtures, food debris on the floor and wall bases, and one employee without a food handler training certificate.

headline: Failed: no sanitizer, no hand soap, no food thermometer
summary: No valid food service certificate posted, and no employee health policy. No vomit kit or procedure. No hand soap or paper towels at sinks; a hose blocked a dish-area sink. No sanitizer for dishes and no food thermometer, which led to citations. No pests were reported, but there was no current pest logbook.

headline: Passed; torn gasket, grime, and clutter
summary: A torn door gasket on the front prep cooler must be replaced. Flour, dust, and grease buildup on cooking equipment and shelving. Clutter on the rear storage floor to be removed. A burned-out light and missing shield in dry storage. No pests found.

headline: Re-inspection passed with conditions; no manager on site
summary: No certified food manager on site on arrival; a citation was issued. Milk crates used as shelving; dirty reach-in interiors; loose debris on front prep floors. Black mold-like substance on a wall near the sink, and missing or damaged floor tiles and grout in rear prep. No pests found.

headline: Passed; flour on floor and low utensil water
summary: Flour bags were stored directly on the kitchen storage floor and must be raised at least six inches. In-use utensils were kept in water at 120F; they must stay at 135F or above. No waste container in the employee restroom. No pests found.

headline: Failed: basement handsink too cold; grease buildup
summary: Basement handwashing sink water measured 65F; it must reach at least 100F, and a citation was issued. The low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm sanitizer but was not in use. Grease spills under cooking equipment and inside fryers. No pests found.

headline: Passed; missing signs, hair restraints, and storage fixes
summary: No handwashing signs at a sink, no splash guard by a handsink, and several workers without hair restraints. Single-use items and clutter stored on basement floors, and a dirty floor drain. No pests found.

headline: Passed with conditions; rat droppings outside by dumpster
summary: Over 10 rat droppings, buckets, and brooms on the ground by the outside dumpster area; the owner must clean. Pink mineral buildup inside the pop machine ice dispenser. Prior violation not corrected: no certified food manager with allergen training; citation issued.

headline: Failed: no health policy, no pest logbook, no training
summary: No employee health policy, no bodily-fluid cleanup kit, and no pest control logbook on site, which triggered a citation. A food employee had no food handler training. No pests were reported.

headline: Passed with conditions; dish machine too cool
summary: The high-temperature dish machine's final sanitizing rinse measured 140F; it must reach 180F. The machine was tagged and not used, and a citation was issued. Missing ceiling tiles in prep areas, grease in deep fryers, and unused metal racks at the stairwell to remove.

headline: Passed re-inspection; hair restraints, clutter, and dust
summary: Workers prepared food without hair restraints; wiping cloths stored on prep tables; ice scoops stored in the ice bin. Food stored on floors and clutter in the basement to remove to prevent rodent harborage. Dust on vents in unisex washrooms. No pests found.

headline: Failed: menu disclosure, foil liners, damaged wall
summary: The menu did not disclose that the burger is served cooked to order; the owner was told to add it. Foil used as shelf liners, a paper towel dispenser above a prep sink, and dust on walls. A repeat violation for a damaged wall was not corrected; a citation was issued. No pests found.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, unsafe ice storage
summary: No person in charge on site and no certified food manager while hot and cold foods were prepared. Milk and juice stored in the ice machine, and the ice used for customers. Yogurt made without a required written food-safety plan; 60 lbs discarded. Rear door not rodent-proof. No pests found.

headline: Failed: pest logbook has no recent service records
summary: The pest control logbook showed no service records; the last recorded service was August 12, 2024, a priority violation with a citation. Brown buildup inside the rear ice machine. Deeply cut and stained cutting boards. No chlorine test kit for the sanitizing sink.

headline: Passed; stained board, hair restraint, chemical on floor
summary: A stained cutting board in the front prep area must be replaced. A male food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. A chemical was stored on the floor in the rear and must be raised. No pests found.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager on duty
summary: No valid certified food manager on duty while chicken and seafood were prepared, a citation was issued. A food handler lacked a proper hair restraint. Floors and drains need detailed cleaning; two burned-out lights above cooking equipment.

headline: Passed; spice labels, storage, and a cooler hinge
summary: Spice containers lacked common names. Dry storage was kept under unshielded water lines in the basement. A prep-cooler door hinge was in poor repair. No pests found.

headline: Passed with conditions; coolers not holding temperature
summary: Two of four basement walk-in coolers were not holding 41F; both were tagged and must not be used until repaired and reinspected. A toilet was not working and was tagged; the men's bathroom vent was not working. Leaks at sinks, no dedicated food prep sink in the front bar, and a dark liquor room light.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager on site
summary: No certified food manager on site while TCS foods were being prepared, and a citation was issued. Plastic cups used as scoops, uncovered to-go containers, and leaking drawer-cooler gaskets. Food handlers lacked training certificates. No pests found.

headline: Passed; torn gasket on prep cooler
summary: A torn door gasket on the one-door prep cooler under the front counter must be replaced. No pests found.

headline: Passed with conditions; vomit cleanup kit missing
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or written procedure on site, which led to a citation. The manager ordered a kit and provided a receipt. No handwashing signs, a brown substance inside the ice machine, and wet wiping cloths on prep counters. No pests found.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings and expired ready-to-eat food
summary: About 50 mouse droppings in the basement liquor room; a priority citation was issued and pest control service needed. Ready-to-eat food past its 7-day use-by date in prep coolers; a citation issued. High-temperature dish machine reached only 153F. Habanero peppers stored in a cardboard box.

headline: Passed; missing sink stoppers and allergen training
summary: Kitchen three-compartment sink is missing its stoppers. The certified manager lacks allergen training. No pests found.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, no stem thermometer
summary: The person in charge and the manager on duty lack a valid sanitation certificate, and a citation was issued. No stem thermometer to check food temperature. Unlabeled dry food containers, a cutting board on a sink backsplash, and plastic utensils not inverted. Missing allergen training. No pests found.

headline: Failed: food on floor, leaks, and repeat violations
