summary: Food stored on the floor in rear storage; residue inside the ice machine; foil liner on a prep table; leaking drain under the three-compartment sink. Grease under fryers and debris on floors. Mops were not hung to dry, to prevent insect breeding. Prior violations for the leak and grout not corrected.

headline: Passed with conditions; no vomit cleanup procedure posted
summary: No written procedure for vomiting and diarrhea cleanup was posted; the owner must keep one on site. Spilled syrup and food debris in refrigerators, leaks at the sink, and burned-out bulbs. Unused equipment stacked outside a door could attract pests. No pests found.

headline: Passed; food stored on walk-in floor
summary: Food containers were stored on the walk-in cooler floor and had to be raised six inches. Missing handwashing sign and loose dust and debris on floors. No pests found.

headline: Passed; grease debris inside fryers
summary: Accumulated grease debris was found inside the fryers. The staff were instructed to clean them. No pests found.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings, unsafe foods, dish machine problems
summary: Over 200 mouse droppings were found in the kitchen, dish room, and dining area; a citation was issued. Raw meat stored above cooked food; about 20 lbs discarded. Cold buffet foods at 46-62F, and a walk-in cooler at 49F. The walk-in cooler and dish machine were later repaired.

headline: Failed: no vomit cleanup supplies, no sanitizer for scoop
summary: No vomit and diarrhea procedure or supplies on site, a priority violation. No sanitizer for the ice scoop, and no test strips to check sanitizer concentration. The owner must provide and maintain all three. No pests found.

headline: Failed; ice buildup, mold, and missing allergen training
summary: Ice buildup in front and rear ice cream freezers. A mold-like substance on a ceiling tile and dirt on the office floor from prior violations that were not corrected. The manager on duty lacks allergen training; a citation was issued. No pests found.

headline: Passed with conditions; food handlers lacked certificates
summary: Clean the interior of the prep cooler and the counter under the fountain machine, and remove grease on the wall behind the toaster oven. A repeat violation: several food handlers lacked food handler certificates, and a citation was issued. No pests found.

headline: Failed: flies, unsafe food temperatures, no manager
summary: No certified food manager on site while empanadas, pork, and eggs were prepared; a citation was issued. About 30 live flies in several areas; pest service required. Empanadas at 118-125F in display; about 8 lbs discarded. Cream at 53F; beef thawed on the counter. Many prior violations not corrected.

headline: Passed; door gap, sink leak, missing allergen training
summary: A one-inch gap under the front doors must be sealed to keep out pests. A leak under the three-compartment sink needs repair. The manager on duty lacks allergen training. No pests found.

headline: Passed with conditions; repeat violations, torn gaskets
summary: Plates, bowls, and pots not inverted in storage. Torn gaskets on prep cooler and walk-in; rusted shelving. Repeat violations: plastic grocery bags used for food in the freezer, and unused items on the floor in rear prep. A citation was issued. No pests found.

headline: Failed re-inspection: dead rodents on glue trap
summary: Three dead rodents were found on a glue trap in the clothing aisle. Rodent activity was still found on shelves, in rear storage, and in the men's washroom, with over 150 signs counted. A prior priority violation was not corrected; a citation was issued.

headline: Passed; self-closing doors and clutter
summary: Washroom doors are not self-closing and need closers. Unnecessary items in the basement should be removed. Coving is missing at the base of the wall behind the bar. No pests found.

headline: Failed: food held at unsafe temperatures; flies found
summary: Hot food measured 97-109F, and cold food measured 44-52F in coolers, including the walk-in cooler at 49F; the owner discarded it, and citations were issued. About 20 live flies in the basement storage and dish areas, and a 1/2-inch gap under the front doors.

headline: Passed; missing thermometer and broken sink stoppers
summary: No thermometer inside the rear prep walk-in cooler. Sink stoppers for one of two three-compartment sinks are broken. No pests found.

headline: Failed: no pest logbook for 2026; training records missing
summary: The pest control logbook showed no 2026 service reports; the latest were dated October 31, 2025. No proof of food handler training or allergen training. Heavy dust in the employee restroom vent. No pests were found.

headline: Passed re-inspection; food on freezer floor, greasy ovens
summary: Frozen soups and cheese were stored on the walk-in freezer floor and must be raised six inches. Stack ovens have encrusted grease. The certified manager lacks allergen training. No pests found.

headline: Passed; food spills between cooking equipment
summary: Floors between the cooking equipment had food spills that needed cleaning. The inspector asked the staff to clean them. No pests found.

headline: Passed; dusty ceiling tiles and dead hood light
summary: Dust on ceiling tiles above the dish area needs cleaning. The left hood light bulb was not working and must be replaced. No pests found.

headline: Passed; dirty restroom sink basins
summary: Sink basins in the toilet room were not clean. The inspector asked the staff to clean and maintain them. No pests found.

headline: Passed with conditions; several safety violations
summary: Potatoes held at 95F on the grill. Cold foods at 47-54F in the two-door cooler; the owner discarded 23 lbs ($70). Cooler adjusted to 35.8F during the visit. Toxic powder cleaned on site; consumer advisory added. Worn gaskets and grease buildup. No pests found.

headline: Passed re-inspection; cutting boards badly stained
summary: Cutting boards at the front prep area and cookline have deep stains and cuts. The inspector noted them for replacement. No pests found.

headline: Passed; detailed cleaning of hood filters needed
summary: The inspector asked the staff to detail-clean the kitchen exhaust hood filters to remove grease buildup and keep them clean. No pests found.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; cleaning and repair issues
summary: Heavy ice in a chest freezer, water-damaged ceiling tiles, peeling bathroom walls, dust in vents, grease on the hood, and food debris under cooking equipment. A certified food manager lacks allergen training. No pests found.

headline: Failed re-inspection: live roaches found in prep area
summary: About 6 live roaches were seen near the hot-hold unit and under the fryer, in grease and food debris. The inspector ordered pest elimination; no citation issued. Excess leaks at the three-compartment sink, no food handler certificates on site, and missing thermometers.

headline: Passed; manager lacks allergen training
summary: The food service manager has no allergen training certificate. The owner was told to obtain one. No pests found.

headline: Passed; front door gap and dirty hood
summary: An opening at the bottom corner of the front door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. The hood above cooking equipment is dirty and missing a filter, which must be replaced. No pests found.

headline: Passed with conditions; no sanitizer, beans too warm
summary: The low-temperature dish machine had no chlorine sanitizer at final rinse and was in use, which triggered a citation. A container of cooked beans measured 47F in the walk-in cooler; cold foods must be 41F or below. No mop sink. One manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Passed; missing sink stopper
summary: The three-compartment sink was missing its stopper. The inspector told the staff to get one. No pests found.

headline: Passed; floors need more frequent cleaning
summary: Loose debris, dirt, and dust built up on floors and in corners throughout the facility. The inspector asked for a deep clean and more frequent floor cleaning. No pests found.

headline: Passed; improper thawing and missing thermometers
summary: Frozen beef liver was thawed improperly. No thermometers visible inside coolers. Food stored on the floor; a cold water drip at a rear handsink. One food handler had an expired training certificate. Grease and dried food under cooking equipment. No pests found.

headline: Passed with conditions; no manager certificate, poor handwashing
summary: No certified food manager certificate posted while TCS foods were handled, and a citation issued. Workers used phones and touched food without washing hands; the manager had staff wash during the inspection. Leaking faucet, spilled food by the dumpster, and damaged floor tiles. No pests found.

headline: Passed; missing thermometers and unlabeled bulk bags
summary: No thermometers in reach-in coolers in the front. Bulk flour and sugar were not labeled. Food stored in plastic grocery bags in the cooler and freezer. Loose debris and dust on floors and corners. No pests found.

headline: Passed; dirty floors and standing water
summary: Dirt and debris on the bar floor and on the prep floor under equipment. Standing water under the dish machine. The staff were told to clean all these areas. No pests found.

headline: Passed; ice machine door and bar shelf need cleaning
summary: Buildup was found on the ice machine door, and food debris was on the bottom shelf of the bar. The staff were told to clean both. No pests found.

headline: Failed: about 25 mouse droppings found
summary: About 25 or more mouse droppings were found under shelving in the walk-in cooler and behind a prep cooler near the drive-thru. The owner must clean and sanitize, and a pest service visit was recommended; a citation was issued. Also a gap under a door, grease, and ice buildup.

headline: Failed: more than 25 flies found throughout facility
summary: More than 25 small flies were seen in the bar, kitchen, and staff areas; a priority citation was issued and pest service required. Walk-in cooler air measured 44F; cooler was tagged and food moved. A large kettle needs a written cleaning procedure.

headline: Passed with conditions; cheese too warm, citation issued
summary: Mozzarella at 48.5F, gruyere at 50.9F, and sauce at 49.2F in the pizza-station refrigerator; about 25 lbs ($450) at risk, and a citation was issued. Air in that unit at 56.8F. Grease on fryers, a leaking drain, and unnecessary items stored in rear areas.

headline: Passed re-inspection; ice machine residue, leaks
summary: Residue inside the ice machine panel. Cardboard on shelving in the meat cooler, walk-in, and storage areas. Chipping paint on rear storage shelving and a leaking three-compartment faucet. Unfinished wood and a rough ceiling in the basement prep area. No pests found.

headline: Failed: no certified manager on site, food held unsafely
summary: No original food service certificate on site while salads, sandwiches, and eggs were served. Raw eggs stored above ready-to-eat leafy greens; food not dated; allergen labels missing. A 3/4-inch gap at the back door. No previous inspection summary was posted; citations issued. No pests found.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager on site
summary: No certified food manager on site while eggs and sausage were handled and served; a priority citation was issued. The employee restroom has no handwashing sign. No pests found.

headline: Passed with conditions; no health policy or cleaning plan
summary: No written employee health policy and no written vomit and diarrhea cleaning procedure. Rear screen door had gaps and torn mesh. Standing liquid in the beer cooler, raw wood and missing tiles behind the bar, and no covered waste receptacle. No pests found.

headline: Failed: live roaches, raw seafood self-service, unsafe dish sanitizer
summary: Four live roaches were found in the grill area, behind the griddle, and in the dish area; dead roaches were also found. Customers served themselves raw seafood; a citation was issued. Dish machine at 0 ppm chlorine; floor cleaner was connected to the dish sanitizer line.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager at start
summary: No certified food manager on site while beef soup was prepared and served; a citation was issued. The manager arrived during the inspection. Rear storage cluttered with items on the floor and dust on a vent cover. No pests found.

headline: Failed: no health policy; unsuitable test strips
summary: No employee health policy on site. The facility had pH strips, not chlorine test strips, for the sanitizing compartment. No covered waste receptacle in the toilet room, and the toilet room vent was not working. No pests found.

headline: Passed; floor drains, stained boards, greasy hood
summary: Floor drains at the cook line need detailed cleaning. Cutting boards at both rear prep stations have dark stains and deep grooves. Hood filters and the hood system have grease and dust buildup. No pests found.

headline: Passed; missing signs, leaks, and debris
summary: Handwashing signs missing from several sinks. Fish thawed while still in reduced-oxygen packaging. Leaking faucet in the rear kitchen, dusty ice machines and coolers, and debris under cooking equipment and in storage. Unnecessary items in the waste enclosure. No pests found.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager on duty
summary: The person in charge has no valid sanitation certificate. No valid certified manager on duty while rice and chicken were handled; a citation was issued. Ice machine interior not clean; floor drains need deep cleaning to prevent pests. A food handler lacks training. No pests found.

headline: Re-inspection passed with conditions; no certified manager
summary: The person in charge has no certified food manager certificate and no certified manager was on duty while TCS foods were handled; a citation was issued. Gap at the top of the rear screen door, unlabeled squeeze bottles, leaking compressor, and damaged walls and floors. No pests found.

headline: Passed; gaps at doors and grease under equipment
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the rear door and double entrance doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Grease, food debris, and dirt under cooking equipment, along walls, and in corners of prep and storage areas. No pests found.

headline: Passed re-inspection; pest entry points and signage
summary: No handwashing signs in restrooms. The rear warehouse door is not tightly sealed at the bottom corners, which allows pest entry. A large uncovered hole in the hallway near restrooms must be covered. No pests found.

headline: Failed: no food handler training; door opening
summary: A food handler had no training certificate. A prior violation was not corrected: an opening at the bottom and side of the rear door, which must be sealed to prevent pest entry. The owner had until November 28, 2025 to comply; a citation was issued.

headline: Failed re-inspection; no current pest logbook
summary: Hot water not working at the three-compartment sink. No covered waste receptacle in the women's toilet. Prior priority violation not corrected. The pest logbook only had 2018 and 2019 service reports; a citation was issued. No pests found.

headline: Passed; boxed food on basement cooler floor
summary: Boxed food items were stored on the floor of the basement walk-in cooler. The person in charge was told to raise all food six inches on shelving. No pests found.

headline: Failed: no certified manager certificate; discarded food
summary: The person in charge had no original certified food manager certificate or ID on site; a citation issued. Mold-like substance inside the ice machine. Vacuum-packed foods were used without a required plan; about 10 lbs ($65) discarded and the machine was tagged. Gaps under the front doors; no working lights in dry storage.

headline: Passed; food and dirt under soda machine
summary: Food and dirt buildup on the floor of the drive-thru prep area under the soda machine. The staff were asked to clean the floor and keep it clean. No pests found.

headline: Passed; wall openings and missing coving
summary: Openings in the wall under the stairs need sealing. Coving is missing at the base of the wall in dry storage. No pests found.

headline: Failed: about 45 fruit flies; no cooler thermometer
summary: About 45 small fruit flies were seen on walls in the coffee and sitting areas; a priority citation was issued and pest control service is needed. Missing thermometer in the milk cooler, unlabeled containers, a worker without a hair restraint, and wiping cloths stored on equipment.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; no thermometer; training gaps
summary: No certified food manager on the premises while tacos and burritos were prepared; a citation was issued. Handwashing sink had no paper towels, and no metal-stem thermometer. Workers lacked hair restraints and wore jewelry. Expired food handler certificates. No pests found.

headline: Failed: no health policy, sanitizer test kit missing
summary: No employee health policy was available. Only one sink stopper for the three-compartment sink, and no chemical sanitizer test kit, which is a priority violation. The certified manager has no allergen training. No pests found.

headline: Passed with conditions; no soap, heavy grease
summary: No soap at the main prep handsink, a priority citation; soap was restocked during the visit. Pink mineral buildup inside the ice machine. Heavy grease near fryers, food debris under cooking equipment, and incomplete allergen training for managers. No pests found.

headline: Passed re-inspection; gap, backflow device, unlabeled desserts
summary: Packaged desserts in the prep cooler were not labeled. A 1/2-inch gap at the basement rear door needs sealing. Torn gaskets on the two-door cooler; the backflow device must be relocated. The certified manager lacks allergen training. No pests found.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager certificate
summary: The person in charge lacks a certified food manager certificate, a citation was issued. Ice machine interior, prep tables, cutting boards, and cooler interiors need cleaning. Food handlers must obtain training and keep certificates on site. Allergen training required for managers. No pests found.

headline: Passed re-inspection; leaks, grease, and flooring fixes
summary: Large grease buildup on a small fryer and debris inside reach-in coolers. Leaks at the three-compartment sink, mop-sink trap, and faucet handle. Carpet must be removed from rear storage. Ventilation is needed above the fryer. No allergen certificates on site.

headline: Passed with conditions; no vomit cleanup procedure
summary: Management could not provide a written procedure for cleaning up vomit and diarrhea. A citation was issued, and the staff were told to create one, including the needed chemicals and supplies. No pests found.

headline: Passed; rust, foil, and leaking drain
summary: Rust on shelving in the walk-in cooler and foil on a condensation pipe. Pizza sauce stored on milk crates, which must be replaced with shelving. A leaking drain under the sink, missing wall tiles, and non-working hood lights.

headline: Failed: no food manager, no thermometer, handler certificate missing
summary: No proof of food safety training for the person in charge. Food handlers prepared TCS foods without a certificate holder on site, and a citation was issued. No metal-stem food thermometer. Cutting board stained and cut, and clutter on the floor. No pests found.

headline: Passed re-inspection; gaps, food on floors, missing training
summary: Leaking pipe at the dish area handsink. Gaps under several front doors could let insects in. Food stored on walk-in freezer floor and in crates; scoops left in bulk containers. Grease buildup on equipment, debris in floor drains, and missing food handler training.

headline: Failed: no pest contractor, no vomit procedure, no test kit
summary: No licensed pest control operator or pest logbook, and no written vomit and diarrhea procedure. Hand sinks had no hot water at 77F; a technician fixed it to 102-105F. Missing paper towels, thermometers, and test kit. Unisex restroom door not self-closing.

headline: Passed; missing thermometers and ventilation
summary: No thermometers in the front reach-in coolers. No backflow device on the rear utility sink. Holes in ceiling panels above rear dry storage shelves, and no mechanical ventilation in the employee toilet room. No pests found.

headline: Passed with conditions; cold foods too warm, discarded
summary: Paneer at 50.3F, pasta at 48.7F, and rice at 48F in service coolers. The manager voluntarily discarded 36 lbs ($107), and a citation issued. Leaking faucet at the three-compartment sink. Heavy dirt and grease in the exhaust hood and filters. No pests found.

headline: Passed; food debris, dirt, and missing training
summary: Food debris on the outside of prep tables and counters, and coffee debris and dirt on prep area floors. No food handler certificates were on site at the time of inspection. The staff were told to clean and to comply with requirements.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings found in front area
summary: About 15-20 droppings under the register shelving, 10-15 near the sliding cold unit, and 15-20 under the freezer. A priority citation was issued; pest service must be done by May 9, 2025. Chicken stored in butter containers, cleavers stored unsafely, and a leaking, missing hot-water knob.

headline: Passed with conditions; dumpster area dirty
summary: No handwashing signage at preparation areas and food handlers not wearing hair restraints. No backflow devices at the espresso and coffee machines. Dumpsters overflowing with garbage, a citation was issued; management cleaned the area during the visit. No pests found.

headline: Passed with conditions; bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food
summary: A worker touched ready-to-eat vegetables and spring rolls with bare hands; about 3 lbs ($30) were discarded and a citation issued. Raw trout stored above cooked chicken, and raw eggs above ready-to-eat toppings. Leaks and wall cleaning also needed. No pests found.

headline: Passed; signage, hair restraint, training gaps
summary: Passed. Two food prep handwashing stations lacked signs. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint, floors near rear storage and the mop sink were not clean, and the sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; cracked baseboard
summary: Passed on re-inspection. A cracked tiled baseboard near the wall behind the registers in the front service area must be repaired.

headline: Missing or broken cooler thermometers
summary: Passed. Thermometers were broken or missing in several coolers, including the walk-in dairy cooler and deli display coolers. The hot-holding unit for rotisserie chicken also needs an internal thermometer.

headline: No certified manager; bare-hand food contact
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food service manager was on site while eggs, ham, and potatoes were handled. A cook assembled a sandwich with bare hands; the manager was told not to handle ready-to-eat food by hand. Grease and cardboard barriers also noted.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings and warm pico de gallo
summary: Failed. About 30 rodent droppings were under concession equipment; the operator must eliminate pest activity (citation issued). Pico de gallo at 47.5 degrees F was discarded (citation issued). A handwashing sink had no soap, and ice scoops were stored improperly at four stands.

headline: Passed; dead insects in light shield
summary: Passed. Dead insects were in a light shield above the rear kitchen and must be cleaned. Also milk crates used as shelving, a backflow device not reachable behind coffee machines, dust on a condenser cover, and dirty kitchen floors.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; cooler thermometers missing
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Two line coolers lacked working thermometers. A single-use bowl was used as a scoop in dry storage, foil lined equipment, grill and stovetop had encrusted grease, and floors under the cook line need cleaning.

headline: Passed with conditions; no hand towels at sinks
summary: Passed with conditions. The rear and front handwashing sinks had no hand-drying supplies (priority, citation issued), and the rear dish sink lacked soap. Also no thermometers in cold units, a weak sanitizer dispenser, unlidded restroom bins, and cardboard under prep tables.

headline: Failed: about 50 live flies; ice machine slime
summary: Failed. About 50 live small flying insects were on walls, ceilings, and equipment in the basement hallway, prep area, and first-floor bar; more pest control is needed (citation issued). Black slime dripped from the ice machine into ice used for drinks (citation issued).

headline: Passed on re-inspection; bulk containers unlabeled
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Bulk containers of flour, rice, cornmeal, and sugar lacked labels and must be labeled with the name of their contents.

headline: Passed; cleaning and labeling problems noted
summary: Passed. Required: detail cleaning of the ice machine interior, cooking equipment, floors, and a toilet room; labeling of large bulk containers; proper storage of wiping cloths and utensils.

headline: Failed: no food manager; over 20 flies
summary: Failed. No certified food manager certificate was posted on site (citation issued). A prior violation was not corrected: more than 20 small flies were seen throughout the facility. Floor drains had heavy soil buildup.

headline: Passed; debris inside cooler and hood filters
summary: Passed. Food debris and residue were inside a sliding two-door cooler and on cold-hold gaskets. Hood filters had dust and grease buildup. The person in charge must clean and maintain these areas.

headline: Passed with conditions; multiple temperature violations
summary: Passed with conditions. Cold food in service coolers was too warm, including chicken at 72.1 degrees F and vegetable salad at 46 degrees F; about 30 lbs was discarded (citation issued). Soup at 122.3 degrees F was discarded. Also food on floors and no paper towels at bakery sinks.

headline: Passed; clutter and missing ceiling tile
summary: Passed. Clutter in closets and storage areas must be removed and kept on shelving at least 6 inches off the ground. Dust above the oven and mop sink, and a missing ceiling tile covered with cardboard, need attention.

headline: Passed; no food handler training proof
summary: Passed. The prep sink lacks a handwashing sign, an ice scoop was stored exposed on the ice bin, duct tape was on the sink faucet, and expired product sat in a chest freezer. No proof of food handler training was provided.

headline: Failed: unlabeled food held too long
summary: Failed. Cooked foods held over 24 hours lacked date labels and were discarded (citation issued). Vacuum-sealed meats were unlabeled, and wastewater piping leaked over the spice prep area. Also no proof of food handler or allergen training.

headline: Passed; splash guards and utensil storage
summary: Passed. The second-floor bar handwashing sink needs splash guards. Utensils were stored flat in dish storage, bowls and pots were not inverted in basement storage, and an unsealed wood ceiling needs sealing.

headline: Failed: food on floor; 3-compartment sink leaks
summary: Failed. Food containers were stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler, and the 3-compartment sink divider lets water pass between compartments (citation issued). Also missing refrigerator thermometers, food in grocery bags and tin cans, and rear storage clutter.

headline: Failed: no pest log; no hot water in areas
summary: Failed. No pest control log was on site, and only one pest service report from the past year was provided (citation issued). Hot water was missing in a third-floor women's washroom, the bar, and the food prep area (citation issued). No covered waste container in that washroom.

headline: Passed with conditions; hot water problems
summary: Passed with conditions. Hot water was missing at a washroom handwashing sink and the 3-compartment sink (68 degrees F; 110 degrees F required). A dining-room sink exceeded 120 degrees F and cannot be controlled by users (citation issued). Other cleaning and repair items noted.

headline: Failed: no pest service, dumpster, or training
summary: Failed. No licensed pest control agreement or pest log, and no commercial dumpster or waste agreement, were on site. Food employees lacked food handler or manager training certificates. Also missing cold-holding thermometers and a gap at rear doors.

headline: Passed; soiled cold units and clutter
summary: Passed. Interiors of front prep cold-hold units had food debris and spillage. Missing floor tiles at a step into rear prep need repair. Garage storage is cluttered, and hood filters have grease buildup.

headline: Passed; broken restroom fan, training missing
summary: Passed. The unisex washroom exhaust fan was not working and must be repaired or replaced. The certified food manager lacks an allergen training certificate and must complete training.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing sign
summary: Passed. The front prep handwashing sink lacks a required handwashing sign.

headline: Passed; door gap and food stored on floor
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of a basement exit door needs a tight seal to keep out pests. Food stored on the floor in the basement freezer and storage must be raised six inches; floors and corners need detail cleaning.

headline: Failed: no hot water; overflowing dumpster
summary: Failed. A restroom handwashing sink had no hot water (69.8 degrees F); it must reach at least 100 degrees F. The dumpster overflowed with garbage bags on the ground, which can attract rodents (citation issued). Also no hair restraints.

headline: Passed; grease and debris on fryer and cooler
summary: Passed. Grease and food debris were on fryer cabinets and inside the front cold-hold unit where coleslaw is stored. The walk-in cooler floor has cracked, torn vinyl that must be repaired.

headline: Failed: 20+ live flies; hot water too cool
summary: Failed. About 20 or more live small flies were on walls near toilets and the soda machine; a pest control operator must service the premises (citation issued). Hot water at hand sinks was 72.3 degrees F and at the 3-compartment sink 75.2 degrees F (citation issued).

headline: Passed on re-inspection; several cleaning items
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Two fryers need replacement bottom doors, and grease under fryers needs cleaning. An employee restroom door needs a self-closing device. Also clutter, raw wood shelves to be sealed, and food handler training.

headline: Passed; minor labeling and drying issues
summary: Passed. An unlabeled bulk salt container, deli cups not air-dried after washing, and condensation dripping inside a prep cooler at the main cook line. Each was ordered corrected.

headline: Failed: cold food too warm; cooler tagged
summary: Failed. Milk at 55 degrees F and eggs at 55.1 degrees F were too warm; about 10 lbs was voluntarily discarded. A prep refrigerator at 60 degrees F was tagged and cannot be used until reinspected. Handwashing sink water was only 55 degrees F (citation issued).

headline: Passed; foil liners and damaged floor tiles
summary: Passed. Aluminum foil was used as a liner on food prep equipment and tables and must be removed. Missing and damaged floor tiles in the prep area must be repaired.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing sign
summary: Passed. The rear prep handwashing sink lacks a required handwashing sign.

headline: Dead mice and roaches found on glue boards
summary: Passed on re-inspection, but dead mice and numerous dead roaches were on glue boards in prep and storage areas. Gaps under front and rear doors need sealing. Also soiled wiping cloths, dirty surfaces, and missing food handler training.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings and leaking handwashing sink
summary: Failed. About 10 to 15 rodent droppings were found throughout rear storage. The manager must remove them and get additional pest control (citation issued). A handwashing sink leaks when used. Three certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Failed: no raw-food warning on menu
summary: Failed. The menu lacked the required advisory for raw or undercooked foods. A prior violation was not corrected: raw wood shelving and an employee without a food handler certificate. Also missing self-closing restroom doors and dirty coolers.

headline: Blocked sink; vacuum packaging halted
summary: Passed with conditions. A handwashing sink was blocked by a cutting board (priority). Vacuum-packed raw beef was held over 48 hours without required special approval, so the manager must stop vacuum packaging; about $200 of food was discarded.

headline: Heavy food debris in coolers and shelving
summary: Passed. Cooler gaskets and interiors had heavy food debris, dirt, and spillage. Shelving under prep tables and equipment had food buildup and splatter. The operator was told to clean all of it.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; door gaps need strip
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Two rear doors have large gaps at the bottom. A rodent-proof strip must be installed to close these openings.

headline: Milk too warm; cooler tagged by health department
summary: Passed with conditions. Milk was held at 49 to 55 degrees F in a reach-in cooler; about 2 gallons were voluntarily discarded (citation issued). A second cooler at 47 degrees F was tagged by the Chicago Department of Public Health until it reaches 41 degrees F or below.

headline: Passed with conditions; several items corrected
summary: Passed with conditions. The bar handwashing sink lacked paper towels and had a bucket inside; both were corrected on site. Milk and half-and-half at about 48 degrees F were discarded (citation issued), and a cooler at 54.7 degrees F was tagged.

headline: Passed; dirty wall base behind sink
summary: Passed. The wall base behind the 3-compartment sink had excessive dirt and debris and must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: rat and mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. About 40 rat droppings were found in basement storage and about 20 mouse droppings in the first-floor rear prep area (citation issued). Manager told to clean and bring in additional pest control. Also missing sink stoppers and milk crates used as shelves.

headline: Failed: missing hand-drying, thermometers, and signs
summary: Failed. Some handwashing sinks lack hand towels, the front prep area has no handwashing sink, there is no metal-stem food thermometer, and pots are too big for the 3-compartment sink. Exterior door gaps also need sealing. Leaks and missing signs noted.

headline: Failed: expired manager certificate; no dumpster
summary: Failed. An expired certified food manager certificate was on site, and no commercial dumpster was present for waste pickup (citation issued). Also no hair or beard restraints, wet cloths on prep surfaces, food in plastic grocery bags, and a dirty ice bin.

headline: Passed; rust in ice machine, door gap
summary: Passed. Rust inside the ice machine must be removed and resealed. A 1/4-inch gap at the entrance door needs a door sweep. Also an unlabeled bulk powder container, wiping cloths on prep tables, clutter, and no food handler training proof.

headline: Failed: no health policy, pest log, or garbage contract
summary: Failed. Missing signed employee health policies, a pest control log, and an outside dumpster contract, all priority items. Also door gaps, missing thermometers and handwashing signs, rust, leaks, and damaged floors and walls.

headline: No valid food sanitation certificate on site
summary: Passed with conditions. The person in charge had no valid City of Chicago sanitation certificate, and none was posted on site (citation issued). Also no allergen training on site, no lidded trash container in the women's restroom, and floor debris.

headline: Passed; mop stored in dirty water
summary: Passed. A wet mop was stored in dirty water in a closet and must be hung inverted to dry. Chipping paint above the 3-compartment sink must be repaired, and the certified food manager needs allergen training.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; grease pooling
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site while chicken, shrimp, and rice were prepared; no signed health policies were on site (citation issued). Fryers leak grease onto the floor. Prior violations remain, including heavy grease and missing allergen training.

headline: Passed; moldlike buildup inside reach-in cooler
summary: Passed. Storage racks and a condenser fan cover inside a two-door reach-in cooler in the rear prep area have moldlike buildup and must be detail cleaned.

headline: Passed; missing thermometer, torn gasket
summary: Passed. A cooler on the cooking line lacks a thermometer; refrigeration units need one in their warmest part. A torn door gasket on a rear two-door refrigerator must be replaced.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; grease buildup, expired certificates
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Heavy grease needs cleaning on fryers, walk-in shelving, prep tables, and bulk containers. Kitchen floor drains need cleaning. Food handler certificates were expired, and managers must obtain allergen training.

headline: Passed; door gaps, food on freezer floor
summary: Passed. Bottoms of two exterior doors must be rodent-proofed, and food boxes on the walk-in freezer floor must be raised six inches. Also a missing ice bin lid, dirty bar floors, failing caulk, and expired allergen training.

headline: Passed; insect devices not installed by technician
summary: Passed. Insect control devices on site were not installed by a licensed pest control technician and must be removed or replaced by one. Drain debris needs cleaning, and no food handler certificates were on site.

headline: No certified manager on duty; several violations
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on duty while tacos, burritos, and steak were prepared, and the person in charge lacked a valid certificate (citation issued). Missing paper towels were supplied during inspection. Also food on the floor and no hair restraints.

headline: No hot water; plumbers fixed on site
summary: Passed with conditions. Hot water was missing throughout; handwashing sinks read 62 to 74 degrees F and the 3-compartment sink 80 degrees F (citation issued). Plumbers arrived and fixed it; later readings were 103 to 118 degrees F. Dishwasher tagged out of use.

headline: Passed; milk crates and raw wood shelves
summary: Passed. Milk crates were used as shelving in prep and storage areas and must be replaced. Raw wood shelves near the front counter must be sealed or painted. Expired food handler training was on the premises.

headline: Passed; cleaning and repairs required
summary: Passed. Required fixes: seal raw wood shelves, repair a damaged freezer lid, clean cooler and freezer bottoms, add a backflow prevention device to the mop sink, reattach a restroom door closer, and clean the dumpster area, walls, and floors.

headline: Failed: no employee health policy on site
summary: Failed. No verifiable employee health policy was on site; a template was left and signed copies must be kept on site (citation issued). Test strips were the wrong type. Also a leaking sink, no lidded restroom container, and an improperly stored mop head.

headline: Passed; grease trap missing for sink
summary: Passed. No grease trap is connected to the 3-compartment sink; the operator was instructed to install one.

headline: Passed; many cleaning items, one light out
summary: Passed. Floors, coolers, and equipment in the coffee, deli, and bakery areas need cleaning, including under equipment and inside a freezer. A light under the rear deli hood is out and must be replaced.

headline: Passed; water on basement floor
summary: Passed. Water was on the basement floor. The operator must clean it up and keep the basement clean and dry.

headline: Passed; missing cooler thermometer
summary: Passed. The basement cream cooler needs a visible thermometer so staff can check its temperature.

headline: Failed: 50+ mouse droppings; temperature violations
summary: Failed. More than 50 mouse droppings were found in dishwashing, dry storage, the basement, and a restroom (citation issued). Hot and cold foods were out of safe range; about 16 and 45 lbs were discarded. Handwashing was improper and no food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Passed; floor and ceiling holes need repair
summary: Passed. A hole in the floor next to the 3-compartment sink and holes in the basement ceiling must be repaired.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; food debris, wall damage
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Food stored on the walk-in cooler floor must move to racks. Floors had trash, flour, grease, and pooled blood and chicken pieces. Also heavy equipment debris, damaged walls, and greasy hood filters.

headline: Failed: slimy ice machine; no food handler proof
summary: Failed. Brown and pink slime was dripping from the ice machine into ice used for drinks (citation issued). Also no food handler training proof, a prior violation not corrected, a front door gap, and dirty prep coolers and floors.

headline: No certified food manager during food prep
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while chicken and coleslaw, foods that must be kept hot or cold, were being prepared and served. Citation issued. Also a minor faucet leak and a large hole in a basement restroom wall.

headline: Passed; leaking drain and faucet
summary: Passed. A rear handwashing sink has a leaking drainpipe, and the 3-compartment sink faucet leaks. The manager was told to repair both.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; handwashing lapse
summary: Failed. No Chicago certified food manager was on site while chicken, turkey, and ham were prepared and served (citation issued). A food handler put on gloves without washing hands first (citation issued); staff were instructed to wash hands before gloving.

headline: Passed; leaking sprayer and bar floor debris
summary: Passed. The 3-compartment sink sprayer leaks when water runs and must be repaired. Soil and debris are built up under bar-area equipment and must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; food too warm
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site while rice and chicken were served. Raw chicken at 58 degrees F and raw fish at 47 degrees F were ordered discarded; a prep cooler at 54 degrees F was tagged. Also missing soap, a damaged dumpster lid, and a door gap.

headline: Passed; ice machine residue, missing food labels
summary: Passed. A slight pink substance inside the ice machine must be cleaned and sanitized. Packaged pasta salad and desserts at the counter lacked labels showing business name, address, and ingredients. The certified food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Passed with conditions; allergen training gap
summary: Passed with conditions. A slow-draining handwashing sink in front prep must be repaired, and floors under the 3-compartment sink need cleaning. A prior violation remains: certified managers still need allergen training.

headline: No valid manager; ground beef thawed unsafely
summary: Passed with conditions. The person in charge lacked a valid certified food manager certificate while beef, chicken, and pasta were served (citation issued). About 40 lbs of ground beef was thawing on prep tables and must thaw under refrigeration or running water at 70 degrees F or below.

headline: Passed; rusty shelving and floor grout repair
summary: Passed. Rusty food storage shelving inside the walk-in cooler must be repainted or replaced. Floor tiles under and around the 3-compartment sink need regrouting.

headline: Passed; fly trap hangs over prep table
summary: Passed. An electric fly trap hangs over a rear prep table and must be moved away from food. A soap dispenser above the warewashing sink must be removed. Rusty shelving, a missing ice machine backflow device, and allergen training gaps were also noted.

headline: Passed; rear door gap and leaks need repair
summary: Passed. The rear door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom and must be made rodent-proof. Also broken pipe insulation in the walk-in cooler, a leaking drain under the 3-compartment sink, and employee clothing stored on the floor.

headline: Passed; items stored on floor, leaking faucet
summary: Passed. Cutting boards were stored on the floor, and clean equipment was not inverted. Single-use utensils in prep were not inverted. A 3-compartment sink faucet leaks, and dust covers ceiling vents and light shields.

headline: No certified food manager on duty
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge with a valid certificate was on site, and no certified food manager was on duty while chicken, hamburgers, and French fries were prepared and served (citation issued). Handwashing signage was also missing.

headline: Food on floor; no allergen training
summary: Passed with conditions. Cilantro was stored on the floor and had to be moved. The ice machine lacks a backflow device, a sink leaks, personal medicine was stored near food, and the person in charge lacks allergen training. A prior violation was not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Passed; ice machine buildup, missing knob
summary: Passed. Mineral buildup inside the front prep ice machine must be cleaned. The mop sink has no hot water knob and must be repaired.

headline: No valid certified manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid sanitation manager certificate was on site, and no person in charge had valid training. A certified manager must be on site when fish and seafood are prepared (citation issued). Coolers, floors, and bar storage need cleaning.

headline: Passed; missing sign, labels, training
summary: Passed. Missing handwashing sign at the rear prep sink, unlabeled bulk containers, milk crates used as shelving, no lidded waste container in the front washroom, debris on floors, and no allergen training for the certified manager.

headline: Passed; restroom handwashing sinks not working
summary: Passed. The fourth handwashing sink in the women's restroom and the two right-side sinks in the men's restroom were not working and must be repaired.

headline: Passed with conditions; no handwashing soap
summary: Passed with conditions. The basement handwashing sink had no soap, a priority violation. Several prep coolers lacked thermometers, a rice spoon sat in room-temperature standing water, and a Styrofoam cup was used as a food scoop.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure
summary: Passed with conditions. No procedure or supplies exist for cleaning up vomit or diarrhea (citation issued). Bulk food bags were stored in a hallway and chips on a grease trap. Also unlabeled containers, a soiled apron, a leaky pipe, and floor debris.

headline: Passed; hair restraints and cleaning needed
summary: Passed. Several food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Food debris and spills were inside coolers and freezers, and the prep area floors had food debris. The operator must clean and enforce hair restraints.

headline: Passed; torn gasket and training records
summary: Passed. A torn gasket on a two-door cooler in front prep must be repaired or replaced. No allergen training certificates were on site; certified food managers must complete training and keep records on site.

headline: Blocked handwashing sink; no food handler certificates
summary: Passed with conditions. A handwashing sink was blocked by a fryer and cart, sanitizer test strips were missing, and no food handler certificates were on site. The last violation was not corrected and was cited. Also a ceiling opening and clutter.

headline: Passed; heavily soiled drain and beverage area
summary: Passed. The floor drain under the 3-compartment sink is heavily soiled and must be cleaned or replaced. The floor, walls, and beverage tubing beneath the front-area beverage machine need cleaning.

headline: Failed: dishwasher not sanitizing properly
summary: Failed. The low-temperature dishwasher's final sanitizing rinse measured 0 parts per million chlorine; a compartment sink must be used for sanitizing until fixed (citation issued). Also missing thermometers, labels, handwashing signs, and allergen training for three managers.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; splash guard needed
summary: Passed on re-inspection. A splash guard must be installed between the 3-compartment sink drainboard and the vegetable sink to prevent cross-contamination.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; labeling and storage
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Containers in prep areas lacked common-name labels, and food was stored in plastic grocery bags in coolers and freezers. Also a broken washroom door closer, broken light covers, and dirty exhaust vents.

headline: Cooler condenser dripping; peeling restroom wallpaper
summary: Passed on re-inspection. The walk-in cooler condenser drips water into a pan set on buckets and must be repaired. Restroom wallpaper is peeling and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: No certified manager; food held too cool
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on duty, and no certificate was posted, while food was prepared (citation issued). Sausage and potatoes held near 100 degrees F, below the 135 degree minimum; about 3 lbs discarded. Also no food handler training proof and a door gap.

headline: Passed; dirty curtains near restrooms
summary: Passed. Curtains hanging toward the washrooms need cleaning and maintenance.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; cleaning and ceiling hole
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Walk-in cooler doors, shelving, and prep areas need detail cleaning, including food splatter on floors and walls. A ceiling hole in the dining-area utility closet must be repaired.

headline: Missing lids on restroom trash cans
summary: Lids were missing from small garbage cans in women's restroom stalls. The operator must replace them and maintain them as required. No food, pest, or temperature issues were noted.

headline: Dish machine lacked sanitizer; ice machine slime
summary: The dish machine dispensed no sanitizer, reading 0 ppm chlorine, and was tagged out of use. Pink slime dripped from the ice machine into the ice bin. About 5 pounds of cooked pork at 46.5°F and rice at 46.9°F were discarded. Citations were issued.

headline: No sanitizer on site; cooler at 48°F tagged
summary: Food handlers prepared food without a certified manager, who arrived 20 minutes late; a citation was issued. No chemical sanitizer was on site at the time. A cold-hold unit read 48°F and was tagged out of use. Coleslaw at 46.8°F was discarded.

headline: Allergen training records missing on site
summary: On re-inspection, no allergen training certificates were on site. Employees holding city food manager certification were instructed to complete allergen training and keep records on site at all times. No pests or temperature issues were listed.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup kit
summary: No employee health policies were on site, and no procedure or cleanup kit for vomiting or diarrhea events was available. Both must be provided. No insects or rodents were noted.

headline: Leaks, missing lids and tiles, cooler puddles
summary: A bakery handwash sink knob was in poor repair, and a deli sink faucet leaked. A unisex restroom lacked a lidded receptacle, and a restroom ceiling tile was missing. Small water puddles were in the produce walk-in cooler.

headline: Cooler at 54.7°F tagged; ice maker slime
summary: The front prep cooler held chicken at 50.9°F and beef at 55.2°F, and was tagged out of use until repaired. About 20 pounds ($400) of food was discarded. Black slime was in the ice maker, which was shut off for cleaning. A citation was issued.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; dirty food areas
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were scattered in prep coolers, a handwash sink, shelving, straw boxes, and basement floors. Management was told to call an exterminator and clean all areas; a citation was issued. Employees ate in the prep area, and handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Clams without shellstock tag; 5 lb discarded
summary: Fresh clams in a prep cooler lacked the required shellstock tag. The employee voluntarily discarded about 5 pounds ($50), and a citation was issued. Grease splatter and chipping paint on the wall beside the fryers must be cleaned and repaired.

headline: Leaking sink; no handler certificates; repeat violations
summary: Water seeped between compartments of the three-compartment sink and must be sealed. No food handler training certificate was on site. Repeat violations from January 2023 remain, including missing handwash signs, milk crate shelving, holes in walls, and missing manager allergen training.

headline: Washroom trash cans lack lids
summary: Washrooms had garbage receptacles without lids. The operator was instructed to provide lidded trash cans at all women's and unisex washrooms. No food or pest issues were noted.

headline: Missing signs, leaks, and manager allergen proof
summary: A three-compartment sink faucet leaked, and a rear handwash sink drained slowly. Both all-gender restrooms lacked covered receptacles, and one lacked a handwashing sign. Proof of allergen training was missing for one manager and expired for another.

headline: Raw chicken at 58°F on counter; discarded
summary: Raw chicken on the counter measured 52.9 to 58.0°F, and about 15 pounds ($30) was discarded. The warewashing handsink lacked soap and hand towels, though both were provided during inspection; a citation was issued. Hair and beard restraints were also missing.

headline: Greasy used cooking oil container outside
summary: Grease had built up on the outside of a used cooking oil container in the rear alley. The operator was instructed to detail clean it and keep it in good condition. No food, pest, or other issues were noted.

headline: Torn freezer gasket and heavy ice buildup
summary: Re-inspection found a torn gasket on a dining room freezer and heavy ice buildup inside all freezers. The operator was instructed to correct the problems and keep the equipment in good condition. No pests were noted.

headline: Cooked chicken held at 50.8°F; discarded
summary: About 60 pounds of cooked chicken wings were held at 50.8°F in the walk-in cooler, above the 41°F limit. The chicken had been stored in a large deep container for a day and was discarded, worth about $150. A bulk flour container was unlabeled.

headline: No certified manager on duty; handler proof missing
summary: No city-certified food manager was on duty while potentially hazardous foods were stored, prepared, and served, and a citation was issued. Other issues included unlabeled containers, food stored in foil, a dirty ice bin, and no food handler training proof.

headline: Leaking sink faucet; dusty ceiling vents
summary: A one-compartment sink faucet was leaking at its base and must be repaired. Dust had built up on prep area ceiling tiles and around vent covers, which the manager was told to clean. No pests or food temperature issues were noted.

headline: Greasy floors, dusty vents, clutter in receiving
summary: Re-inspection found grease, food debris, and dirt on floors under cooking equipment and in corners of prep, dish, storage, and basement areas. Dust covered a walk-in fan, light shields, and vents. Clutter in the rear receiving area must be removed.

headline: Repeat violations; missing certificates and trash lid
summary: Repeat violations from 2023 were not corrected. The women's restroom lacked a covered receptacle, vents above a prep table were dusty, and two male employees had no food handler certificates. The manager also lacked allergen training. A citation was issued.

headline: Missing allergen training for certified manager
summary: A City of Chicago certified manager was missing allergen training. The operator was instructed to obtain the training and keep verification on site. No pests, temperature, or illness issues were listed.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; freezer ice buildup
summary: The rear patio exit door has a half-inch gap at the bottom corner and must be made rodent-proof to prevent pest entry. No pests were reported. A pizza chest freezer had excessive ice, and washroom vents were dusty.

headline: Repeat violations: no mop sink, milk crates
summary: Repeat violations from June 2022 remain. A wooden broom display container has a rough, non-cleanable surface, milk crates were used to elevate stored items, and there is no mop sink. A citation was issued for the uncorrected items.

headline: 100+ mouse droppings; flying insects; no soap
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were found on floors, shelves, and boxes in rear storage, and numerous flying insects were in prep and storage areas. The manager was told to call an exterminator, and a citation was issued. Handwash sinks lacked soap, towels, or hot water.

headline: Food handler lacked training certificate
summary: One food handling employee had no food handler training certificate. Management was instructed that all food handling employees must show proof of training. No other issues were listed.

headline: Live flies found; prior pest violation not fixed
summary: About 50 or more live small flies were on ceilings in the prep and dining areas. A prior pest violation was not corrected, and pest control was called for September 1. Uncovered trash attracted insects; grease and wall repairs are also needed.

headline: Doors and walls need sealing against rodents
summary: Restaurant double doors are not fully rodent-proofed at the bottom and center and must be fixed to prevent rodent entry. Openings beside the receiving door and exposed brick near the kitchen entrance must also be sealed. No pests were reported.

headline: Unlabeled breading and flour; greasy floors
summary: Breading and flour containers lacked labels after being moved out of original packaging. Fryers had grease inside and out, and prep and storage floors had grease and dirt. Hand washing signs were needed at three sinks, and a men's restroom floor tile was cracked.

headline: Rusted cooler shelves; greasy fryer and grill
summary: Re-inspection found rusted shelves in the walk-in cooler, which must be cleaned or replaced. The fryer and grill had grease buildup and must be cleaned inside and out. No pests or food temperature issues were noted.

headline: Mislabeled packaged food; sanitizer test kit missing
summary: Packaged cookies, brownies, and rice crispy treats lacked required labels. Food handlers lacked hair and beard restraints. No sanitizer test kit was on site, and a warewashing sink was cracked and leaking. A citation was issued.

headline: Moldlike ice machine; openings and leaks
summary: The bar ice machine had black and beige moldlike buildup, which must be cleaned. Several door openings must be sealed to prevent pest entry, though no pests were reported. Leaks, a non-working cold water knob, and a broken freezer condenser fan were also noted.

headline: Missing handwash sign; greasy hood filters
summary: Re-inspection found no handwashing sign in the all-gender restroom. The ventilation hood and filters above cooking equipment were dirty. The operator was instructed to post the sign and clean the hood at all times.

headline: Black slime dripping into ice; citation issued
summary: Black slime dripped from a white rack into the ice bin at the smoothies station, and the ice had black particles. The ice bin was unprotected. Staff must clean and sanitize it, and a citation was issued. Milk crates, stained cutting boards, and debris also need fixing.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; repair ordered
summary: Re-inspection found a torn gasket inside a two-door prep cooler near the low-temperature dish machine. The operator was instructed to repair or replace it and keep it in good condition. No pests or temperature problems were noted.

headline: Broken dumpster lids and crate shelving
summary: Black and red crates were used as shelving in prep and storage areas and must be replaced with proper shelving. The outside dumpster had broken lids, which was cited. Clutter in rear dry storage must be removed.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; loose handwash sink
summary: Torn gaskets were found on a walk-in cooler door near the cook line and on two-door prep coolers at the omelet station. A handwash sink near the utility sink was loose. The operator was instructed to repair or replace them.

headline: Live and dead flies; grease; missing training proof
summary: About 15 live small flies were in the men's restroom, and dead flies were on dining windowsills and warewashing floors. Pest control service was ordered. Floors had grease and debris, and food handler training proof and manager allergen training were missing.

headline: Leaking restroom pipe; damaged cutting boards
summary: A toilet pipe leaked inside the far-left unisex restroom and must be repaired. Damaged cutting boards at sandwich stations need repair or replacement. Caulk around sinks and debris along wall bases in prep and dish areas also need attention.

headline: No certified manager on duty; couch in prep
summary: No city-certified manager was on duty while eggs and chicken were handled, and a citation was issued. Employee toothpaste and medicine were stored improperly. A large couch in the prep area must be removed from the premises.

headline: Dusty vents, stained walls, dirty bar drains
summary: Ceiling vents in the rear dish and front prep areas were dirty and dusty. A dish area wall was dusty and stained, and bar floor drains were dirty. The operator was instructed to clean and maintain them. No pests or food issues were noted.

headline: No certified manager on site preparing food
summary: No certified food manager was on site while proteins and cooked vegetables were being prepared, and a citation was issued. Staff must provide a certified person and keep certificates displayed. A floor drain under the wok line was heavily soiled with food and grease.

headline: Mussels without shellstock tags; 4 lb discarded
summary: Mussels in bags at the seafood display cooler had no required identification tags. The manager voluntarily discarded about 4 pounds ($14), and a citation was issued. Torn gaskets on a service cooler door and a dairy walk-in need repair.

headline: Over 60 live roaches; unsafe food temperatures
summary: Over 60 live roaches were found in the dish area and food storage closet, plus over 15 small flying insects. Raw chicken sat at 75.3°F and samosas at 65.4°F; about 18 pounds were discarded. No certified manager was present when food was served.

headline: Dead insects found; dish gauge and ventilation issues
summary: Dead insects were on basement prep floors, and an insect control device sat above the soda dispenser and must be removed. The high-temperature dish gauge read only to 150°F, though 180°F was verified. Cold water failed at a sink, and cooking smoke hung in dining.

headline: Greasy shelving and equipment; leaking handsink
summary: Underside of kitchen shelving and sides of cooking equipment had grease and spatter. A fan in the produce walk-in had dust, and a rear kitchen handwash sink leaked at its cold water knob. Floors and corners need cleaning to help prevent pest activity.

headline: Utensils improperly stored; no handler certificates
summary: Knives and cooking utensils were stored between the wall and rack at the three-compartment sink. Stained walls and food debris were near the sink and behind a prep table. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: 30 live flies found; pest control advised
summary: About 30 live small flies were on walls in the prep and rear storage areas and must be removed by the reinspection. The operator was advised to call pest control. Ice machine buildup, dirty coolers, a leaking handwash faucet, and no mop sink were also noted.

headline: Mop sink lacks backflow device
summary: The mop sink had no backflow device, and one must be provided and maintained. Management was also instructed to provide and keep food handler certificates for all food handlers. No pests or temperature issues were listed.

headline: Missing thermometers, test devices, certificates
summary: The kitchen had no metal stem thermometer, no sanitizer test devices, and no irreversible thermometer. No current food handler certificates were on site. A repeat allergen training violation from 2022 was not corrected. Citations were issued.

headline: Boxed food on floor; toilet fans not working
summary: Boxed food was on the floor in the rear walk-in cooler and must be raised six inches on shelving. Ventilation fans in both toilet rooms were not working and must be repaired or replaced. No pests were noted.

headline: Rodent droppings and unsafe food; failed inspection
summary: Over 500 mouse droppings were found in food and storage areas, and rodent-gnawed chips were among stored food. Cold foods were held above 41°F, including eggs at 46°F. No employee health policy was on site.

headline: Damaged cooler floor, basement clutter, ceiling hole
summary: Inspector found a broken, lifting floor in the walk-in cooler and a lifting threshold at the basement entry, both to be repaired. The basement was cluttered and items must be raised or removed. A hole in the basement ceiling must be sealed.

headline: Cooked black beans cooled improperly
summary: Cooked black beans were cooling in a tightly covered container, which slows cooling. The inspector instructed staff to cover the beans loosely to speed the cooling process. No other issues were listed.

headline: Mold-like buildup; low hot water; dirty coolers
summary: Black moldlike buildup was found on racks in the dairy walk-in and on walls in the chicken prep walk-in. Low hot water pressure was noted at handsinks, and a container of chicken breading was unlabeled. Five reach-in coolers had non-working bulbs.

headline: Line cook lacked effective hair restraint
summary: A line cook was preparing and handling food without an effective hair restraint. The cook was instructed to wear one whenever handling food. No other issues were listed.

headline: Dusty fans in walk-in and rear
summary: The walk-in cooler fan and fan covers had dust buildup, and the rear ceiling fan needed detail cleaning above cutting surfaces. The inspector asked for cleaning to prevent contamination. No pests were noted.

headline: Clutter, missing washroom lid, dirty floors
summary: Clutter was found throughout the premises, and food must be kept six inches off the floor to help prevent pest hiding spots. Shelving needs cleaning and foil removal. The washroom needs a lidded garbage can, and floors need detail cleaning.

headline: No certified manager while serving chicken, fish
summary: No certified food manager was on site when chicken and fish were prepared and served. Employees lacked food handler training, managers lacked allergen training, and a washroom fan did not work. The washroom also lacked a covered trash container.

headline: Improper fish thawing; hair restraint lacking
summary: Fish was not being properly thawed in the three-compartment sink. Operators must thaw under running water at 70°F or below, under refrigeration, or in a microwave. A food handler lacked a hair restraint, and a cook lacked a beard restraint.

headline: Food on floor; greasy equipment; no hair restraint
summary: Food and single-use items were stored on the floor and must be raised six inches. A food handler lacked a hair restraint, and cardboard lined prep tables and shelves. Fryers and equipment had grease and debris. A utility sink faucet leaked.

headline: No paper towels; no allergen training proof
summary: The rear handwash sink lacked paper towels, and a citation was issued. Water dripped from a ventilation unit onto a display cooler at the front prep area. A certified manager had no allergen training proof, a repeat violation not corrected.

headline: Food on walk-in floor; dirty drains and walls
summary: Food items were stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and must be raised six inches. Dishwashing floors had dirt and debris, walls had food splatters, and floor drains were heavily dirty. Fans, light shields, and vents also need cleaning.

headline: Frozen shrimp in mop sink, removed on site
summary: Frozen shrimp was found under running water in a mop sink; the manager removed it during the inspection. Cooler thermometers were missing, and the grease trap and cooler interiors needed cleaning. An allergen training certificate was expired.

headline: 100+ mouse droppings; unsafe hot and cold food
summary: About 100 or more mouse droppings were found under sinks, on prep tables, and in the fryer cabinet and toilet room. Cooked steak at 83.1 to 91.6°F and birria at 45.8°F were discarded. No employee health policy or vomit cleanup procedure was on site.

headline: About 25 mouse droppings; pest control needed
summary: About 25 mouse droppings were found on a candy shelf, behind a chest freezer, along a west wall, and on a rear storage shelf. Management must clean all affected areas. Additional pest control service is needed, and a citation was issued.

headline: Expired or missing handler certificates; greasy equipment
summary: Some food handlers in the prep area lacked hair restraints. The oven and fryers were greasy, and the toilet room door did not self-close. The hood was greasy, and food handler certificates were missing or expired.

headline: Mouse droppings and missing handwash supplies
summary: About 40 to 50 mouse droppings were found along back walls in the grocery and bakery back rooms, and a citation was issued. Several handwashing sinks lacked soap and towels. Reach-in coolers lacked thermometers, and leaks needed repair.

headline: Missing floor drain cover near mop sink
summary: No floor drain cover was located near the rear mop sink, and the operator must provide one. No pests, food temperature, or illness issues were noted.

headline: Dead roaches found; expired manager certificate
summary: Dead roaches were on floors behind a fish tank, washer, and ice machine, and under the three-compartment sink. An expired food manager certificate was on site and was corrected on site, though a citation was issued. Milk crates were used as shelving.

headline: Blocked, unsupplied basement handwash sink
summary: A basement handwash sink was blocked by equipment and containers, and had no soap or paper towels; a citation was issued. Bar ice bins were uncovered, and the basement ice machine had residue. Grease and food debris were on equipment, floors, and walls.

headline: 40+ mouse droppings in several areas
summary: About 40 or more mouse droppings were found in a toilet room sink cabinet, on the basement floor, and in boxes of chips for sale. Staff must remove them and clean affected surfaces. A citation was issued. The site also lacks a mop sink.

headline: Food on floor; missing handwash signs
summary: Basement food was stored on the floor and must be raised six inches. The men's and women's restrooms lacked handwashing signs, and sinks with paper towels lacked waste receptacles. Wiping cloths were stored improperly, and an exposed ceiling above prep must be covered.

headline: Uncovered ice bin in bar area
summary: An ice bin in the bar area was uncovered. The inspector instructed staff to cover the ice to protect it from possible contamination. No other issues were listed.

headline: Mussels stored on cloths; food debris, grease
summary: Mussels in the prep walk-in were stored directly against wiping cloths. Foil was used as shelf liners. Food debris was on several floors, and the hood above the fryers had grease and dust buildup. Staff were told to correct each item.

headline: Dirty wiping cloths left on prep tables
summary: Dirty wiping cloths were found on prep tables in rear prep areas instead of being stored properly. Staff were instructed to keep all cloths in sanitizing solution, especially when not in use. No other issues were noted.

headline: No posted manager certificate; prep cooler at 49.4°F
summary: No city-certified food manager certificate was posted on site, and a citation was issued. A two-door prep cooler reached 49.4°F and was tagged out of use until repaired. Floors under fryers and ovens were greasy, and staff items were on a dry storage shelf.

headline: Milk crates used as storage shelving
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving throughout the storage areas. The operator must replace them with shelving at least six inches off the floor to allow proper cleaning. No pests, temperature, or illness issues were noted.

headline: Only one food handler certificate on site
summary: Only one current food handler certificate was on site, and one of three certified managers lacked allergen training. Handwashing signs were missing at bar, salad, and pizza sinks. A basement soap dispenser was not working, and prep-line hoods were greasy.

headline: Pork held at 50–52°F; discarded on site
summary: Two pots of cold pork were held at 50.5 to 52.3°F, above the 41°F limit. The manager discarded about 100 pounds worth $400 on site, and the food was corrected on site. A citation was issued.

headline: Missing handwash sign, trash lid, ceiling tiles
summary: The unisex restroom lacked a handwashing sign and a lidded waste can. Two ceiling tiles were missing above the soda station in the rear storage and dishwashing area. The operator was told to provide and maintain these items.

headline: Handwash water too hot; soup not date-marked
summary: Hot water at a dishwashing handwash sink measured 125.2°F, above the 100 to 120°F range. An engineer lowered it to 104.4°F, and a citation was issued. Ready-to-eat soup in the walk-in cooler was not date-marked.

headline: Food handler missing certificate; floor puddle noted
summary: A male food handler had no food handler certificate. Operators must obtain one within 30 days of hire. The inspector also found a water puddle on the floor beside the stove in food prep and instructed staff to clean it.

headline: Greasy fryers, hood, and floors; unlabeled bins
summary: Heavy grease was on fryer sides, under fryers, and in the hood and fan above the cooking line. Bulk storage containers lacked labels, and wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizer. A main prep handwash sink leaked at its trap.

headline: 300 lb chicken discarded; walk-in at 49°F
summary: Chicken was held at 46 to 51°F, and the manager discarded 300 pounds ($900). The walk-in cooler measured 49°F, and a technician was on site for repairs. No certified manager was on site when food was served. A sink faucet leaked.

headline: Damaged basement flooring near sink
summary: Damaged flooring in the basement near the three-compartment sink must be repaired to a smooth, easily cleanable surface. No pests, food temperature, or illness issues were noted.

headline: Improper thawing; severe sink leak; dirty coolers
summary: Frozen food was thawed in a three-compartment sink rinse basin with no running water. A front prep handwash sink had a severe leak that flooded the floor, and two prep tables were rusty. A food handler lacked a hair restraint.

headline: Sanitizer at 0 ppm; no certified manager on duty
summary: The three-compartment sink's sanitizer measured 0 ppm, so the sink was emptied and a citation was issued. No certified food manager was on duty while sub sandwiches were prepared. Food handler certificates and manager allergen training were also missing.

headline: Unlabeled containers; missing handler, allergen proof
summary: A personal drink without a lid was found, and dry storage containers lacked product names. Foods were stored in grocery bags in a reach-in freezer, which must be food-grade. One food handler lacked training proof, and a manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Greasy grill area, missing light shield
summary: Re-inspection found a cutting board with deep cuts and foil lining prep table shelves. Walls and floors behind the grill were greasy, and filters were dusty. A light shield above the cook line was missing, and the person in charge lacked allergen training proof.

headline: No certified manager posted; mop water issue
summary: No valid city food sanitation certificate was posted for employees, and a citation was issued. The menu lacked a required raw-food advisory. Staff were disposing of mop water outside or in toilets, and a service sink must be installed.

headline: Paper towel rolls stored in toilet room
summary: Rolls of disposable paper towels for dispenser refills were stored on top of employee lockers in the toilet room. The inspector instructed staff to relocate them and store single-use items outside prohibited areas. No other issues were listed.

headline: Walk-in at 50.1°F; no handwash sink in prep
summary: The walk-in cooler ran at 50.1°F, above the 41°F limit, and must be repaired. The rear prep area has no handwashing sink, and several sinks lacked paper towels. No employee health policy, food handler training, or manager allergen training was available.

headline: Expired manager certificate; missing cooler thermometers
summary: The food manager on site held an expired city certificate and must provide a valid one. Bar coolers had no thermometers. Cooler door gaskets were loose, the dish sink lacked stoppers, and a hot water valve leaked.

headline: Missing ceiling tile above walk-in entrance
summary: A ceiling tile was missing above the walk-in cooler entrance. The inspector instructed the operator to replace it. No other issues were listed.

headline: Missing handwashing signs
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at sinks in the rear dish and food prep area and in the toilet rooms. The operator was instructed to provide them. No other issues were listed.

headline: Two-door cooler lacks air thermometer
summary: The two-door cooler had no ambient air thermometer. The operator was instructed to provide and maintain one. No pests, illness, or other issues were listed.

headline: Missing thermometers; food handler proof lacking
summary: A cooling unit holding sauces, deli meat, and eggs had no thermometer. Clutter in the mop and hot water tank room must be removed and items raised six inches. Dried debris was under fryers, and handlers lacked training proof on site.

headline: No certified manager on site or posted
summary: No city sanitation manager was on site, and no valid certificate was posted. Copies are not accepted, and a citation was issued. Single-use articles were stored on the floor and must be raised six inches. Milk crates were used as shelving.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food
summary: Two food handlers touched ready-to-eat tomatoes, cucumbers, and other produce with bare hands while making salad. Both put on gloves at the inspector's request and were cited. Handwash soap was missing at a rear sink but was provided during inspection.

headline: General cleaning and upkeep issues, no pests
summary: Inspector asked for cleaning of shelves, the walk-in interior, and floors. A sink behind the front counter drained slowly, and standing mop water had to be disposed of. Washroom fixtures, dusty vents, and storage clutter also need attention.

headline: Rust, grease and expired food handler certificates
