summary: Rust on walk-in cooler racks. Food and dirt on reach-in coolers. Thick grease on fryers. Leaking three-compartment faucet. Dirty floor drains and hood. Some food handlers had expired certificates. Passed.

headline: Steak and chicken thawed improperly; leaks
summary: Steak and chicken thawing at room temperature on shelving. Leaking drain pipes under rear hand sink and three-compartment sink. Mop head stored on floor. Debris along walls. Inadequate lighting in walk-in freezer and staff washroom. Passed.

headline: Failed; live roaches and unsafe storage
summary: About 5 live roaches in the dish room and prep area; pest control recommended. Food stored on floor in walk-in cooler and in plastic bags. Greasy outdoor receptacle. No vomit cleanup kit or health policy. Failed.

headline: Ice machine backflow device not located
summary: Inspector could not find the backflow prevention device on the ice machine. The owner was told to locate it. Passed.

headline: Dead insects found; greasy floors
summary: Dead insects found under the front handwash sink, to be removed and cleaned. Interior of walk-in freezer must be cleaned. Grease, food spills and dirt in floor corners. Passed.

headline: No hot water; prep area closed then reopened
summary: No hot water at a food-court hand sink; prep area closed until repaired, then reopened the same day. Cold-held foods at 46-49°F discarded (about 50 lb). Dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer. Conditional pass.

headline: No backflow at mop sink; exhaust not working
summary: No mop sink with backflow prevention at the faucet. Employee restroom exhaust fan not working. Both must be provided or repaired. Passed.

headline: Knives stored improperly; no garbage lid
summary: Two knives stored between wall and prep cooler. Disposable spoons and forks not inverted. No lid on the garbage. One food handler lacked a certificate. Passed.

headline: Dirt and food debris under equipment
summary: Dirt and food debris under the sink, shelves, refrigerators and cooking equipment. Loose coving under sink. One food handler and the city-certified manager lacked training proof. Passed.

headline: Failed; live cockroaches and unsafe practices
summary: Four live cockroaches found in the basement. Kimchi fermentation plan not followed, with no daily pH or salt records. Soup stored in reused milk jugs. Vegetables washed in tubs, not a sink. Failed.

headline: Damaged screen door and dirty equipment
summary: Rear exterior screen door in poor repair. Residue on ice machine door and grime on cold hold gaskets. Light out in walk-in freezer and dusty fans. Locker room wall hole. Passed.

headline: Handsinks lack hot water; no training proof
summary: One of six handwash sinks had no hot water; another measured 71.6°F, below the required 100°F. A fifth sink had no running water. No proof of food handler training for any handler. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: No proof of food handler training
summary: No proof of current food handler training certificates found. Certificates must be provided on site at all times. Passed.

headline: Eggs left at room temperature; food discarded
summary: Fifteen dozen eggs left on the floor at 55-60°F. Kimchi and salads at 46.6-55°F with cold unit off; about 17 lb ($90) discarded. Octopus and chicken thawed at room temperature. Food stored on floors. Conditional pass.

headline: Bulk flour and sugar lack labels
summary: Bulk flour, sugar and other foods found with no labels. The owner must provide labels. Passed.

headline: Failed; black buildup inside ice machines
summary: Large black buildup at the ice chute and ice-making area of two ice machines. Ice must be removed and machines cleaned. No pest control logbook on site. No allergen or food handler certificates. Failed.

headline: Rear door propped open; leaking pipe
summary: Rear exit door was cracked open and must stay closed and tight-fitting to keep pests out. Hot rice scoop stored with handle in food. Leak under rear hand sink. Soiled mop in bucket. Passed.

headline: No handwash signs; no accessible grease trap
summary: No handwashing signs at any hand sink. The manager could not access the grease trap for the three-compartment sink, which must be made accessible for inspection. Passed.

headline: Failed; grease leaking; debris outside
summary: Grease on the ground near the grease container and leaking from the storage area. Refuse area littered with unnecessary items. Food debris and spills throughout the facility. Citation issued. Failed.

headline: Plates stored face up; greasy floor
summary: Plates in the kitchen prep area were stored face up and must be stored inverted. Minor grease spills on the floor under the fryer. Passed.

headline: Leaking sinks and missing allergen training
summary: Leaking pipes at the three-compartment sinks on several floors. Worn cooler gaskets, cracked storage lids, grease and debris on equipment and floors. Damaged floor tiles. Food managers lack allergen training. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Failed; about 50 live flies in kitchen
summary: About 50 small live black flies found in prep, dish and dry storage areas. Dish machine not sanitizing (0 ppm). No hand towels at hand sinks. No test strips. Citations issued. Failed.

headline: Failed; ice scoop touching ice; foam cup scoop
summary: Ice scoop stored in the ice machine touching ice. Foam cups used as scoops. No drain board on the three-compartment sink. A previous core violation was not corrected. Failed.

headline: Failed; employee touched rag, then sushi
summary: Employee wore gloves while touching a dirty wet rag, then rolled raw sushi without washing hands. No paper towels at hand sink (replenished on site). No approved method to test sushi rice pH. Failed.

headline: Debris outside dumpsters; some food handlers untrained
summary: Dried leaves and debris on the ground around the garbage and grease dumpsters. Two kitchen hood bulbs out. Some food handlers lacked proof of training. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Worn gaskets; oversized pots won't fit sink
summary: Worn door gaskets on a prep cooler and walk-in freezer must be repaired. Oversized pots and bins do not fit the three-compartment sink. Grease and food debris on grill tables and fryers. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Dirty prep-area microwave; slow sink drain
summary: Interior of the microwave in the food prep area was not clean and must be cleaned. The front prep hand sink drains slowly and needs repair. Passed.

headline: No sanitation certificate; handwash sinks broken
summary: No valid city food sanitation certificate posted. Two of three front prep handwashing sinks not usable, one from a water leak, one missing a drain line. No sanitizer on site for dishes. Citations issued. Conditional pass.

headline: Failed; live mouse and droppings found
summary: Live mouse found in a food container, and 10-15 mouse droppings on the floor by the steam table. Gaps at doors and in roof area. Pest control needed. Handwash signs and allergen training also missing. Failed.

headline: Failed; about 30 live flies; pest control needed
summary: About 30 live small flying insects on walls, ceilings and storage racks in prep, dish and dry storage areas. Pest control service needed. No food handler certificates. Certified manager lacked allergen training. Failed.

headline: Food spills and leaking drain under sink
summary: Food spills and debris on cooking equipment, coolers, freezers and beverage machines. Leaking drain pipe under the handwash sink. Missing floor grout and debris under equipment and in floor drains. Passed.

headline: Missing hair restraints and food handler certificates
summary: Food handlers in prep areas were not wearing hair restraints. Beverage machine nozzles needed cleaning. Dusty ceiling tiles, damaged light shields. Food handlers and the manager lacked training certificates. Passed.

headline: Grease at fryer and dusty hood vents
summary: A small amount of grease at the bottom of the fryer. Light dust on hood vents above cooking equipment. Both must be cleaned. Passed.

headline: Single-use containers stored face up
summary: Styrofoam plates, bowls and to-go containers were stored face up at the serving line. The owner was told to invert them to prevent overhead contamination. Passed.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged out of use
summary: Dish machine reached only 137°F at final rinse and was tagged not to be used, though it was in use during inspection. Bar stools blocking food prep counter were removed on site. Vacuum-packaging variance missing. Conditional pass.

headline: No certified manager; walk-in cooler too warm
summary: No certified manager on site while milk was served; manager arrived at 3:15 p.m., corrected on site. Walk-in cooler at 69.2°F, tagged and must not be used until reinspected. Allergen certificate missing. Conditional pass.

headline: Dirty ceilings, walls and vents; damaged gaskets
summary: Wiping cloths on prep tables. Damaged gaskets on a refrigerator. Dirty ceiling fans, peeling ceiling paint, and grease on walls and hood. Broken tiles, unusable restroom ventilation, and no food handler training proof. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Cold foods too warm; food discarded
summary: Ropa vieja, tuna, shrimp and eggplant held at 45-50°F; about 62 lb ($375) discarded. Shrimp thawed at room temperature. Prepared foods lacked discard dates. No paper towels at a hand sink. Conditional pass.

headline: Dirty restroom, drains and floors
summary: Toilet room needed deep cleaning. Minor debris at the waste area. Floor drains and floors under the front prep line had buildup. Cleaning required. Passed.

headline: Failed; bare hand touched food in drink
summary: Employee touched a sliced lime with bare hands and put it in a customer's drink at the bar. About 1.5 lb discarded. Black mold-like substance inside the ice machine. No probe thermometer. Failed.

headline: Failed; over 100 droppings; pest control needed
summary: More than 100 pest droppings throughout the facility, including in the pizza oven, basement, and under kitchen shelving. Unapproved pesticide stored near plates was removed on site. Pest control required. Failed.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; greasy kitchen
summary: No handwashing signs at sinks in restrooms and front prep. Leaking faucets on the three-compartment and utility sinks. Grease and food debris on equipment and floors. Dusty vents. Passed.

headline: Failed; no certified manager; cooler too warm
summary: No person in charge with a valid Chicago food sanitation certificate, and none posted. Reach-in cooler at 76°F, tagged and must not be used. No test kit, no sink stoppers, and no hot water (72°F) at multiple sinks. Failed.

headline: Dusty hood and filters
summary: Ventilation hood and filter have excessive dust buildup. The owner was instructed to clean and maintain them. Passed.

headline: Milk jugs reused for soup; basement cluttered
summary: Single-use one-gallon milk jugs were reused to hold and freeze soup. Too much clutter in the basement; items must sit at least 6 inches off the floor. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Dirt and food debris on walk-in floor
summary: Excessive dirt and food debris found on the walk-in cooler floor. Must be cleaned and kept clean. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Dark section in walk-in cooler
summary: Walk-in cooler had a dark section with inadequate lighting. The inspector instructed the owner to add lights. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Rusty prep table base; greasy floor
summary: Prep table base is rusty and not cleanable. The three-compartment sink needs drain stoppers. Grease on the floor under the stoves must be cleaned. Passed.

headline: No cooler thermometers; drinks stored with food
summary: Refrigeration units lacked thermometers to monitor ambient temperature. Employee drinks stored in the same unit as customer food. Passed.

headline: No certified manager; rice held too cool
summary: No certified food manager on premises at first; one arrived at 11:55 a.m., corrected on site. Rice held at 129.9°F, below the required 135°F; about 14 lb ($225) discarded. Loose dish unit and debris in drains. Conditional pass.

headline: Produce cooler at 47°F; 280 lb discarded
summary: Produce walk-in cooler ran at 47°F. Dressing, pasta, coleslaw, sliced tomatoes and other cold foods held at 47-61.2°F; about 280 lb ($695) discarded. Handwash sink hot water handle broken. Conditional pass.

headline: Food grime in microwave; greasy hood filters
summary: Food grime built up inside the microwave. Grease buildup on hood ventilation filters. Both must be cleaned and maintained. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Upstairs restroom door closers not working
summary: Self-closing devices on upstairs restroom doors do not work. The person in charge was told to repair them. Passed.

headline: Rusty racks, mold-like buildup, damaged floors
summary: Rusty racks in walk-in and reach-in coolers. No data plate on dish machine; no backflow device on utility sink. Sticky residue and black mold-like substance near soda machine. Damaged floors and peeling paint. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Failed; no city sanitation certificate
summary: No City of Chicago sanitation certificate; only a ServSafe certificate was on site. Warewashing machine not installed. No food thermometer. Washroom doors not self-closing; trash lacks lids; rough brick walls. Failed.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Only one of two food handler certificates on site. A city certificate holder lacked allergen training. Dust and dirt buildup in the ice cream prep vent. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Unlabeled containers and leaking sprayer
summary: Some bulk containers unlabeled. Multi-use container stored inside a utility sink. Single-service utensils not inverted. Leaking faucet and sprayer on the three-compartment sink. Debris on basement floor and stairway. Passed.

headline: Food on walk-in floor; no food handler certificates
summary: Food stored on the floor of the walk-in cooler must be raised six inches. Ice scoop left on ice in bar. Debris on floors. No food handler certificates and an allergen certificate missing. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving near cooler
summary: Milk crates are being used as shelving in the rear prep area near the walk-in cooler. They must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor. Passed.

headline: Gap under front door; kitchen floors dirty
summary: A 1/4-inch gap under the front door must be sealed to keep pests out. Single-service items stored on floor. Loose debris and dust on kitchen floors. Passed.

headline: Food handlers lack required training certificates
summary: All food handlers on site lacked food handler certificates. The inspector ordered them to obtain and keep certificates. Passed.

headline: Cooler too warm; food discarded; no certified manager
summary: No certified manager on site handling TCS foods. Upright cooler ran at 54°F; rice, tamales, eggs, milk and cheese discarded (about 15 lb). Cooler tagged and must not be used until repaired. Conditional pass.

headline: Leaking faucet; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Leaks at the three-compartment sink faucet must be repaired. The certified manager on duty lacked allergen training and was warned that citations will follow. Passed.

headline: Handwash sink blocked; staff lack training
summary: Dishwashing-area handwash sink was blocked by dirty glasses and a strainer. Citation issued. Several food handlers had no food handler certificate. Conditional pass.

headline: Failed; no hot water at employee hand sink
summary: Employee hand sink had no hot water until the manager restored it on site. Also: no sanitizer test kit, rusted racks, faucet leak, a wall hole near the pizza station, and expired food handler certificates. Failed.

headline: Failed; no raw-food advisory; uncorrected repeat issues
summary: Menu lacks the required consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods. No sanitizer test strips on site. Leaks under a hand sink. Ceiling openings. Floor debris and an unposted inspection summary. Failed.

headline: Untimed TCS foods discarded; dead cockroaches
summary: Tomatoes and lettuce at the front line were not time-marked, about 10 lb discarded. Two dead adult cockroaches under the main cook line equipment. Conditional pass.

headline: No certified manager on site; bacon discarded
summary: No certified food manager on site while open. Cooked bacon at 50-53°F past its use-by date; about 8 lb (about $55) discarded. Citations issued. Conditional pass.

headline: Bathroom door closer broken
summary: Bathroom door in the kitchen prep area has a broken self-closing device. The owner must repair or replace it. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Slow-draining sink; no waste receptacle
summary: Exposed handwash sink in the rear dishwashing area drains slowly and must be repaired. No covered waste receptacle in the unisex washroom. Passed.

headline: Melon stored on linen; no hair restraints
summary: Cut melon stored in direct contact with linen in a drawer cooler. Employees entered prep areas without hair restraints. Thick ice buildup under a reach-in freezer. Passed.

headline: Food debris on equipment and freezers
summary: Mixing equipment needed cleaning. Food debris was found on cooking equipment, display cases, shelves, prep tables and coolers. Freezers need defrosting and cleaning. Allergen certificates required. Passed.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving in basement
summary: Milk crates were used as basement shelving and must be replaced with proper shelves. Also noted: a soiled employee microwave, no lidded trash cans in restrooms, and clutter by the walk-in cooler. Passed.

headline: Ready-to-eat foods not date-marked; floor storage
summary: Cooked pasta, chicken and other ready-to-eat foods in walk-in cooler were not date-marked. Food stored on floors and in plastic grocery bags. Ice buildup on compressor. Soiled mop heads. Conditional pass.

headline: Missing handwash signs; wall opening noted
summary: Missing handwashing signs at several sinks. Unlabeled dry containers, plates not inverted, trash cans lacking lids. Large wall opening near the walk-in could let pests in. Trash behind equipment. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: No waste receptacles in restrooms
summary: Unisex restrooms on one side of the bar had no waste receptacles. The owner must provide trash cans with lids in both restrooms. Passed.

headline: Soiled interior coolers and leaking faucet
summary: Interior of reach-in coolers and freezer must be cleaned. Leak at the three-compartment sink faucet must be repaired. Floors need cleaning throughout to remove spills, debris and grease. Passed.

headline: Rust and dust buildup; wall gaps
summary: Rust on lower shelf of rear prep table. Dust on personal fan. Gaps along wall bases under the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Peeling plastic wrap, grime and water damage
summary: Peeling plastic wrap under prep tables. Food grime inside a cold-hold unit. Water-damaged restroom ceiling tiles. Grease and dust in hood filters. The person in charge was instructed to correct these. Passed.

headline: Heavy grease on pizza oven; soiled ceiling
summary: Heavily soiled pizza oven with encrusted grease. Dirty pizza assembly cooler interior. Stained ceiling tiles above the oven and dusty vents. Disposable towels used as ties on equipment. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Wiping cloths and mops stored improperly
summary: Wiping cloths left on prep tables instead of in sanitizer. Broken floor tile in dish area. Heavy grease and food debris under equipment. Mops stored improperly. Peeling caulk at a prep hand sink. Passed.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets and plastic bags used
summary: Torn gaskets on cook-line cooler doors must be replaced. Plastic grocery bags used as food containers in the walk-in freezer must be replaced. Rust inside cooler and dirty dish-area floors. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Handwash sink blocked; no food handler certificates
summary: Exposed handwash sink in dish area blocked by a garbage bag and wiping cloths. Citation issued. Greasy equipment and floors, dirty hood filters, soiled mop head. No food handler certificates on site. Conditional pass.

headline: Failed; hot food too cool; live flies
summary: About 20 lb of chicken tenders and smoked chicken held at 96-126°F and discarded. About 5 live large flies in the prep area and walk-in cooler. Male food handler with beard and no beard guard. Failed.

headline: Freezer and coolers need interior cleaning
summary: Interior of the two-door freezer and two-door coolers in the storage area must be cleaned. Passed.

headline: Soil buildup inside reach-in coolers
summary: Soil buildup found inside reach-in coolers. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain them. Passed.

headline: Missing light shields and damaged floor tiles
summary: Light shields missing in the prep and dish area. Uneven wall near the three-compartment sink and damaged floor tiles need repair. One employee lacked allergen training proof. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Ice scoop left on ice; no allergen certificate
summary: Ice scoop was kept on top of ice cubes at the front soda bin. Food service manager has no allergen certificate. Owner was told to correct both. Passed.

headline: Certificate must stay posted during open hours
summary: Certified manager and original certificate were on site, but the certificate must stay posted during all food prep and service hours. Milk crates used as shelving. Damaged floor tiles and a leak at the three-compartment sink. Conditional pass.

headline: Water dripping from pipe under sink
summary: Water was dripping from a pipe below the three-compartment sink. Repair required. Passed.

headline: Unlabeled containers; food handler untrained
summary: Unlabeled dry storage containers. Equipment stored with food-contact surfaces exposed. Damaged drain stopper at three-compartment sink. Soiled microwave, greasy walls. One food handler had no training. Passed.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers and greasy equipment
summary: Bulk storage containers had no labels. Grease on grill, fryers, prep tables and inside coolers, plus clutter in the employee washroom. Cleaning and labeling required. Passed.

headline: No food handler certificates on site
summary: No food handler certificates on site at inspection. The person in charge was instructed to meet state food handler requirements. Passed.

headline: Ice machine buildup and dusty surfaces noted
summary: Slight buildup inside upper parts of the ice machines. Dust on prep cooler condensers, sinks and shelves at the rear bar. Floor at rear bar not clean. Cleaning required. Passed.

headline: Failed re-inspection; repeat violations uncorrected
summary: Torn screen and gap at lobby door, plus a missing front door handle and lock, leave rodent entry points. Core violations from February not corrected, including no thermometer in dessert cooler and unlabeled containers. Failed.

headline: Failed; no health policy and sink missing
summary: No employee health policy on site. No exposed handwashing sink in the front prep area. No backflow device at mop sink. Uncovered trash in restroom. Clutter that can attract rodents. Damaged floor tile and peeling paint. Failed.

headline: No backflow devices at ice and mop sinks
summary: No backflow prevention devices found at the ice machine or the mop sink faucet. Owner must provide locations where they can be serviced. Passed.

headline: Cups and cutlery not inverted; loose lid knots
summary: Drinking cups and cutlery at dining tables were not inverted, risking dust buildup. Loose and missing knots on prep cooler lids must be repaired. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Foil on shelves; toilet door not closing
summary: Aluminum foil on rear storage shelves must be removed. Toilet room door in the rear storage area is not self-closing and must be corrected. Passed.

headline: Failed; mouse droppings and hygiene violations
summary: About 50 or more mouse droppings in food storage, on articles, and in a toilet-room sink. Employee changed gloves without washing hands and handled food. No employee health or vomit cleanup policy. Failed.

headline: Clutter in rear dishwashing area
summary: Clutter was on the floor and shelves in the rear dishwashing area. Staff were told to clean, organize and remove unneeded items to prevent hiding places for pests.

headline: Dirty floors in prep and grocery areas
summary: Floors in the prep area and grocery area need cleaning. The complaint inspection record ends with an incomplete instruction.

headline: Wiping cloths left around prep station
summary: Wiping cloths were lying around the prep station. They must be stored in sanitizing solution when not in use.

headline: Gaps at both front doors; dirty fryers and coolers
summary: Both front entrance and exit doors have 1/4 inch gaps at the sweeps and must be rodent-proofed. Accumulated food debris inside prep coolers, cooler door gaskets and fryers must be cleaned.

headline: Damaged gasket; peeling paint and openings
summary: Drawer cooler in the prep area has a damaged gasket and must be repaired. Peeling paint, missing baseboards and openings in walls and ceilings in prep and basement dry storage must be fixed to be smooth and cleanable.

headline: Dusty ceiling tiles; missing light shield
summary: Discolored kitchen ceiling tiles and heavy dust on the washroom vent were found; staff were told to clean. A light shield is missing above the food prep area; proof that bulbs are shatterproof must be kept on site.

headline: No certified manager while handling deli meat
summary: No certified food service manager was on site, and no certificate was posted, while deli meats and chicken were handled and served; priority violation. Employee's phone was stored on a prep table and must be kept off.

headline: Mineral buildup in ice machines; allergen gap
summary: Two ice machines have mineral buildup and need detail cleaning. A stained cutting board on the steam table must be refinished or replaced. Plastic and milk crates are used for elevation. Certified manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: No restroom sign or towels; no meat thermometer
summary: Restroom lacked a handwashing sign and hand drying supplies; priority citation issued. No metal-stem thermometer for checking cold deliveries. A 1/4 inch gap at the front door must be sealed. No toilet tissue; drywall in rear area is not smooth.

headline: Gap at rear door; greasy cooking equipment
summary: A 1/2 inch gap at the rear exit door sweep must be fixed to rodent-proof it. Grease and debris are on the stove, deep fryer and burners. Three-compartment sink water line leaks. Hood and filters need cleaning.

headline: Handwashing sinks too cold; allergen proof missing
summary: Handwashing sinks in the facility measured 72.3 to 95.5°F, below the required 100°F; staff were told to fix them. Three city-certified managers lacked proof of allergen training. Three other restroom sinks work properly.

headline: Kettles need cleaning procedure; sinks lack hot water
summary: Large kettles cannot be moved to the dish area; manager must write a clean-in-place procedure. A leak under the dish machine must be repaired. One of four restroom sinks had no water; others reached only 78°F, below 100°F.

headline: No certified manager; rodent droppings; cold foods
summary: No certified manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. About 50 mouse droppings were found on floors and behind prep areas, plus dry storage; pest control is needed. Several foods held at 44.6 to 48°F; about 20 lbs discarded.

headline: Ice scoops, mop heads, trash lid, allergen proof
summary: Ice scoops were stored on top of the ice machine and must be kept in a clean container. The washroom waste bin needs a lid. Soiled mop heads must hang upside down. Certified food managers must show allergen training proof.

headline: No hair restraints; no food handler certificates
summary: An employee without a hair restraint was in the food prep area. Stained cutting boards, food debris on floors and grease in the hood need cleaning. No food handler certificates were on site; the certified manager lacks allergen training proof.

headline: Gaps under doors; dirty coolers and walls
summary: Gaps at the bottom of the double entry doors and exit door must be closed. Walk-in coolers and deli, dairy and produce areas need debris cleaned. Holes in produce dishwashing area walls need repair; hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Hand sink blocked; no sink in rear prep area
summary: A food handler washed hands at the three-compartment sink; citation issued. The hand sink was blocked by a pitcher, now removed. No handwashing sink exists in the rear prep area, so a cashier handled reheated food without washing; citation issued.

headline: Strong garbage smell; floors need detail cleaning
summary: Shared outside garbage area has a very strong smell, though dumpsters are closed and no garbage is on the ground. The area and interior floors have food spills and buildup and need detail cleaning.

headline: No food sanitation certificate; no health policy
summary: No original City food sanitation certificate, written employee health policy, or vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was provided. Management was told to provide each. Certified managers lack allergen certificates. Walk-in cooler needs shelves.

headline: Grooved and splitting cutting boards
summary: Two or three cutting boards have deep grooves and are splitting on the surface. They must be refinished or replaced.

headline: Missing hand-wash sign; storage clutter
summary: Coffee bar handwashing sink is missing a handwashing sign and must have one. Unused equipment and clutter are on the floor in rear storage. The manager was told to remove it to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Whole fish too warm; discarded
summary: About 6 lbs of whole fish in the prep area were at 64.2°F. The person in charge discarded them ($50); citation issued. Bar three-compartment sink pipes leak; wall and ceiling tile damaged; floor tiles loose.

headline: Front doors have gaps; crates; broken floors
summary: Gap along the center of the front double doors must be tight-fitting. Crates used for food storage must be removed. Floor tiles are broken, walls have holes, and ceiling tiles are stained. Chipping paint above the rear hand sink must be scraped.

headline: Missing thermometer; torn gasket; drain leak
summary: Pizza hot-holding equipment at the front prep area needs a visible, working thermometer. Frozen food is in plastic grocery bags; food-grade storage is required. A torn cooler gasket and a drain leak under the hand sink must be fixed.

headline: Energy drink can stored in pizza cooler
summary: An open energy drink can was stored in the pizza prep cooler with exposed food. Staff were told to store personal items away from food.

headline: Dusty ventilation hood
summary: Dust has built up on the right side of the ventilation hood and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Door not rodent-proof; air conditioner drain
summary: Bottom of front entrance door must be rodent-proofed. An air conditioner drainpipe empties into a rear prep handsink and must be moved to a floor drain. No backflow device at mop faucet. Food handlers lack training proof.

headline: Damaged cutting boards; greasy grill area
summary: Cutting boards have open seams and dark stains and must be refinished or replaced. Grease is on the outside of the grill and on the floor around it. Staff were told to detail clean the cooking equipment and floors.

headline: Broken handles; greasy fryers; damaged floors
summary: A sliding reach-in cooler is missing its door handle. Cardboard is on prep table shelves and cutting boards; cutting boards are worn. Grease and food debris build up in fryers, prep tables, coolers and walls. Floor tiles and walls are damaged.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: The certified food manager named on the report must have allergen training and a certificate on site.

headline: Missing splash guards; broken sink drain
summary: Handwashing sink needs splash guards on both sides because nearby space is used to store food. The three-compartment sink drain is broken and must be repaired. Food containers need common-name labels.

headline: No lid on women's restroom trash can
summary: The trash can in the women's restroom has no lid. A lid must be provided.

headline: Dirty sides of prep tables
summary: Sides of prep tables in the rear food prep area have a small buildup of dirt and dust. Staff were told to pull them apart, clean and maintain them.

headline: Cardboard shelving; dirty floors and ceiling tiles
summary: Cardboard boxes line bakery prep shelves and must be removed to prevent pest hiding places. Floors along wall bases, especially seafood, bakery and produce areas, need cleaning. Ceiling tiles in the display area are dirty.

headline: No certificate or health policy; sink blocked
summary: No original City sanitation certificate and no written employee health policy were posted; citations issued. Rear handwashing sink was blocked by stacked stock. Wastewater backed up from a floor drain by the three-compartment sink; citation issued.

headline: Oversized mixing bowl
summary: A large mixing bowl in the rear is too big for any three-compartment sink or dish machine. The manager must write a clean-in-place procedure for cleaning it.

headline: Dirty reach-in coolers and floor corners
summary: Interiors of reach-in coolers and freezers must be cleaned of spills and debris. Floors along wall bases and in corners need debris removed.

headline: Shellstock tag date wrong; leaking spray hose
summary: A shellstock tag had an incorrect last-sold date; it was corrected on site. This is a priority foundation violation with a citation. A spray hose at the high-temperature dish machine is in poor repair and leaks; it must be repaired.

headline: Chicken too warm; unlabeled nuts; milk crates
summary: About 10 lbs of chicken at 58.9°F on the back prep table were discarded ($35); citation issued. Pine nuts and cashews were unlabeled. Cutting boards have deep open seams; milk crates are used for elevation; clutter needs removal.

headline: Dirty coolers, floors and toilet room
summary: Plates, bowls and pans on the dish rack were not inverted to dry. Food debris and dirt are inside reach-in and walk-in coolers and on storage racks. Floors under cooking equipment and in corners need detail cleaning, and the toilet room needs cleaning.

headline: Dish machine too cool; no food handler training
summary: Dish machine final rinse reached only 128°F; it must reach over 180°F, and management must repair it. No food handler training certificates were provided. Floors and dish machine areas need cleaning.

headline: Broken walk-in handle; stained floor tiles
summary: The walk-in cooler handle is broken and must be replaced. The toilet room has no trash receptacle with a lid. Floor tiles in front of the cooking equipment have orange-brown stains that must be removed.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; no food handler certificates
summary: Rear exit door has a 1/4 inch gap at the bottom and must be sealed. Soiled mop heads must hang to prevent insect breeding. No food handler certificates were on site. Manager lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: Rodent droppings found; sink and restroom issues
summary: About 85 rodent droppings were found around the grease trap, water heater, dry storage and prep area; priority citation issued. Rear handwashing sink is broken, with a stripped hot knob and missing cold knob. Toilet room lacked cleanser and towels.

headline: Thermometer placement; scoop resting on ice
summary: Cooler thermometer was placed behind food; staff were told to keep it in the warmest, easy-to-view spot. An ice scoop was resting on ice cubes in the ice maker; staff were told to keep it off the ice.

headline: Greasy hot-hold units; missing cooler thermometers
summary: Hot-hold units, pressure cookers, skillets, utensils and containers had food and grease buildup, and were instructed to be cleaned. Thermometers must be provided inside cooling units to monitor temperatures.

headline: Food debris in toasters; dirty coolers and floors
summary: Toaster ovens have food debris. Reach-in coolers are encrusted with food and dried spilled milk. Food debris and spills are on floors throughout the facility; staff were told to increase cleaning frequency.

headline: No certified manager; cold foods too warm
summary: No certified manager on site, and no food handler with certificate while eggs and sausage were prepared; priority violations. Liquid eggs at 45°F, deli turkey 63.1°F and ham 46.3°F were discarded on site. Employee ate in the pastry area.

headline: Raw wood under bar; allergen training missing
summary: Raw wood under the entire bar counter must be sealed so it is nonporous and easy to clean. City-certified managers are missing allergen training; training must be obtained and verification kept on site.

headline: Hygiene lapses; blocked hand sink; no health policy
summary: A food handler handled a hose, gloves, an orange and frozen shrimp without washing hands; citation issued. A prep-area hand sink was blocked by a garbage can and towels. No signed employee health policy, food handler or allergen training.

headline: Food above load line; dirty deli areas
summary: Food in deli reach-in coolers was above the load line, which can cause temperature problems; staff were told to keep food at the line. Buildup under the hot chicken case and dirty floors in deli and back storage need cleaning.

headline: Dirty prep tables; leaking faucet; dirty floors
summary: Bakery and deli prep tables need cleaning of food spills and buildup. Two-compartment deli sink faucet leaks and must be corrected. Floors in service and back rooms need detail cleaning.

headline: Expired food handler certificates
summary: Several food handler certificates were observed as expired. Food handlers must obtain valid certificates.

headline: Pots too large for sink; grease under equipment
summary: Pots are too large to submerge in the three-compartment sink. Staff must remove them, get a larger sink, or write a washing procedure. Minor dirt and grease are under the sink and behind cooking equipment.

headline: Missing sign; rooftop bar door gaps
summary: Rooftop handwashing sink lacks signage. The two front entrance doors and venue bar exit door have openings at the bottom and must be rodent-proofed. Grease and food buildup are on cooking equipment, fryers, and rear prep floors.

headline: Freezer ice buildup; restroom door issues
summary: Ice buildup inside a two-door freezer in front prep must be repaired. Dried food debris is inside cooling units in prep. The employee restroom door is not self-closing. Floors behind prep tables and in the office need cleaning.

headline: Hands not washed between dish tasks; cockroaches
summary: A dishwasher moved from soiled to clean dishes without washing hands, a priority violation. Several dead cockroaches were found under the front bar counter and must be removed. Walk-in cooler shelves and racks are dirty.

headline: Beef thawed in standing water; food on floor
summary: Three packs of ground beef were thawing in standing water in the sink; they must thaw under cold running water, in refrigeration, or during cooking. Food stored on floor. Food handlers lacked hair restraints and food handler training.

headline: Grease and debris under deep fryer
summary: Grease and food debris were on floors and walls under and around the deep fryer at The Olive food station, and in the floor drain in the same area. These must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Dish machine too cool; restroom and sink failures
summary: High-temperature dish machine wash measured 130°F; it must be at least 150°F; citation issued. No temperature indicator for dishes. Several toilets and a urinal do not work; a prep sink does not work; a handwashing sink measured 77.2°F.

headline: No health policy or vomit kit; broken tiles
summary: No employee health policy or training and no vomit or diarrhea procedure or kit were on site; priority violations. Broken walk-in freezer gasket. Men's restroom door does not self-close. No allergen certificates were on site.

headline: No soap at sink; cold foods discarded
summary: No soap at the dish area handwashing sink, a priority violation with citation. Pork 45.1°F, chicken 48°F, ground beef 47.7°F, rice 44.7°F and sliced tomatoes 50.3°F in coolers; manager discarded 25 lbs. Cardboard lines shelves, a pest hiding place.

headline: Leaks; blown lights; summary not posted
summary: Two leaks from the unit above the mop sink must be repaired. Blown lights are in the washroom and above the three-compartment sink. No current inspection summary was posted; a new one was posted. Citation issued.

headline: Beard restraints not worn
summary: Food handlers were not wearing beard restraints. Staff were instructed to wear them at all times while preparing food.

headline: Dead flies in sink; uncovered washroom bin
summary: About 20 dead flies were in the rear three-compartment sink basin; dead insects must be removed regularly. Loose faucet handles at coffee station sink need repair. Washroom waste receptacle was uncovered and must stay covered.

headline: Ice machine buildup; leaking faucet; allergen gap
summary: Some ice machines have buildup inside and in ice chutes, and must be cleaned. A pastry cooler door gasket is ripped. The grill-side sink faucet leaks. One food manager lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: Eggs too warm; 10 lbs discarded
summary: Eggs in the refrigerator measured 53 to 54°F; about 10 lbs were discarded ($55); priority violation with citation. Two employees lacked hair restraints. Refrigerator temperature gauge is damaged; a three-compartment sink stopper is missing.

headline: Sticky soda area; moldy keg cooler; milk crates
summary: Soda gun holder has a pink substance, and dust and stickiness are behind the bar. Beer cooler has mold-like buildup around doors. Milk crates are used for shelving in the walk-in and must be replaced by raised shelving. Some food handlers lack certificates.

headline: Three-compartment sink backs up and leaks
summary: Three-compartment sink backs up and leaks when drained; priority violation with citation; drainage must be serviced. Deep fryer oil filter has grease and food debris inside. Cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers and freezers have grease buildup.

headline: Dirty drink nozzles, oven and walls
summary: Drink dispenser nozzles and ice chute need detail cleaning. Front cooler gaskets have a black substance. Oven, toaster, and walls in rear prep area have splatter buildup. Floors along wall bases and the employee toilet room need cleaning, plus a trash lid.

headline: Unlabeled bean containers; greasy floors
summary: Bean containers in rear dry storage were not labeled and must show the food name. Food debris is between prep cooler gaskets. Grease and spilled food are behind cooking equipment and under sinks and prep tables. No allergen training proof for managers.

headline: Core violation not fixed; no mop sink
summary: A core violation from July 25, 2025 was not corrected. The facility has no mop sink and was told to install one. Core violations must be corrected. Priority foundation violation; citation issued.

headline: Salad items too warm; 24 lbs discarded
summary: Chicken at 45.2°F, chicken salad at 47.8°F and pasta salad at 47.4°F in the front salad cooler. Manager discarded 24 lbs. Salad bar cooler at 55°F was tagged for repair; citation issued. Milk crates used as shelving.

headline: Walk-in cooler lighting too dim
summary: The walk-in cooler has inadequate lighting. Staff were instructed to increase the light intensity.

headline: Missing restroom sign; greasy fryers; leaky faucets
summary: Women's restroom has no handwashing sign. Fryer interiors have grease and dirt buildup. Both faucets on the three-compartment sink leak at the base. Certified food manager has no allergen training certificate on site.

headline: Holes in kitchen ceiling
summary: Holes were found in the ceiling throughout the kitchen. Staff were instructed to seal them and keep them maintained.

headline: No certificate on site; dead flies in mop sink
summary: No certified food manager with original certificate was on site while open; a photo of the certificate is not allowed; priority citation issued. Dead small flies were in the mop sink. Cooler interiors have standing water and debris; allergen certificate missing.

headline: Customer-accessible freezers lack locks
summary: Freezers in the lobby are accessible to customers and have no locks. The manager was instructed to lock them when not in use to prevent tampering.

headline: No manager on site; no pest control logbook
summary: No person in charge or certified sanitation manager was on site while eggs and milk were prepared; citation issued. Hair restraints missing; leaks under sinks. No pest control logbook; reinspection still lacked a 2026 pest control report; citation issued.

headline: Fruit flies found; citation issued
summary: About 30 fruit flies were observed at hand sink areas in lower-level prep areas. This is a priority foundation violation with a citation; the flies must be eliminated and the pest control operator notified. Floor drains need cleaning.

headline: Food debris on wall near server station
summary: Slight food debris buildup was found on the wall near the server station. Staff were instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; dust; leaking faucets
summary: Lower gasket on salad prep cooler door is torn and coming loose; staff were told to repair it. Light dust and debris under grill and flat-top units need cleaning. Three-compartment sink faucets in rear dishwashing area are leaking.

headline: Missing hand-wash signs; allergen certificate gap
summary: Hand sink in the front prep area needs handwashing signage. Floors under and around soda syrup shelves in rear storage need cleaning. Certified food manager has no allergen training certificate; staff were told to obtain one.

headline: Front door gap; leaks; greasy walls and floors
summary: Gap at outer front door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Exposed pipe above prep area; no splash guard at sinks. Leaks at back bar sink and slow drain at front bar. Greasy floors and walls, and dim lighting in rear dining area.

headline: Greasy cooler gaskets; broken grab-and-go cooler
summary: Rubber gaskets on reach-in coolers need detail cleaning. A grab-and-go reach-in cooler is in poor repair and not in use; it must be repaired or removed. Drink dispenser nozzles need cleaning.

headline: Hand sink blocked by apples and cart
summary: Hand sink was blocked by apples inside it and a food cart in front of it; it must stay accessible. This is a priority foundation violation with a citation. Bulk food containers in dry storage were not labeled.

headline: Door gaps, grease buildup, unfixed past violations
summary: Front door has gaps at top and bottom. Grease and food debris build up on ovens, grill, fryers, coolers and shelves. Crates are used for storage and floors need repair. Violations from May 2024 were not corrected.

headline: Food debris in cooler; dirty floors
summary: Spilled food debris was found at the bottom of a sandwich prep cooler next to the oven. Floors have dirt buildup under the three-compartment sink, reach-in coolers, shelving and along wall bases. Staff were told to clean.

headline: No water pressure at restroom sink; allergen gap
summary: Employee restroom handwashing sink had no water pressure, a priority violation with a citation issued. The food service sanitation manager lacks an allergen training certificate and was told to meet the requirement.

headline: Stored items on floor in all areas
summary: Stored items in all storage areas, including unused construction materials in the HVAC room, must be raised off the floor.

headline: Door gap, stored tongs, dirty sink area
summary: Front door has a 1/4 to 1/2 inch gap and is not rodent or insect proof. Tongs used on beef were stored in stagnant water. Wiping cloths were left on the sink, and the sink interior and floors need cleaning.

headline: Grease in front grill fryers
summary: Grease has built up in the fryers at the front grill station. Staff were instructed to clean all fryers.

headline: Clutter by basement stairwell
summary: Clutter is stored on the floor along the stairwell to the basement storage area. Manager was told to remove unused articles and equipment to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Wooden shelves; dirty ice machine exterior
summary: Wooden prep shelves are treated against absorption but are not smooth or easy to clean; a smooth surface must cover them. Nonfood-contact surfaces of the basement ice machine have debris and must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager; no sanitizer in sink
summary: No certified food manager was present while coffee with milk and sandwiches were prepared; citation issued. No sanitizer or test strips at the three-compartment sink. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup supplies. Several food handlers lack certificates.

headline: Undated food held over 24 hours; rear door open
summary: Ready-to-eat foods held over 24 hours had no date marks; about 50 lbs discarded ($300); citation issued. Donut cup with open lid stored on prep shelf. Rear door was propped open near the kitchen and must stay shut.

headline: No certified manager; hands not washed properly
summary: No certified food manager was on site, and an expired certificate was posted; citation issued. A food handler rinsed hands without soap and wiped them on an apron and cloth, then rewashed after notice. Containers lack labels; no backflow device found.

headline: Dirty meat slicer; missing backflow devices
summary: Meat slicer is dirty behind the blade and housing and must be cleaned and sanitized after use. Ice maker and potato shredder have no backflow device found. Condensation line drains into the three-compartment sink and must be moved.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; citation issued
summary: Chicken, beef and shrimp in a cold-hold unit measured 48 to 51°F. Foods must be discarded and held at 41°F or below. A prep cooler read 50.2°F and was tagged for repair. Cutting boards, fryer and wok line need cleaning or replacing.

headline: No thermometer in milk refrigerator
summary: No thermometer was found inside the refrigerator holding milk and creamer. The facility was instructed to provide one.

headline: Excess water and food debris on floors
summary: Excess water and food debris were found under equipment and along walls in the deli, meat and produce areas. Dust was on ceiling vents in the deli prep area. The manager was told to clean and maintain these areas.

headline: Food stored in plastic grocery bags
summary: Various foods were stored in plastic grocery bags in the cooler and freezer. Management was told to use only food-grade storage bags and containers.

headline: Ice machine opening, grease and floors need cleaning
summary: The inside of the ice machine opening needs detail cleaning of calcium and grime. Grease on overhead piping, grill, flattop and floors near the cook line and coffee station must be cleaned to prevent pests.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; cutting boards damaged
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving in prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving raised 6 inches off the floor. Cutting boards with open seams and dark stains must be refinished or replaced.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings and live ants found
summary: Failed. About 50 mouse droppings were found in the bakery prep area, plus more in other areas. About 40 live ants were on bakery and deli floors. A citation was issued, and additional pest control service is needed. Liquor was stored in a former washroom with a foul odor.

headline: Expired food handler card; repeat violation cited
summary: A food handler had an expired certificate and must show proof of training for all staff. The certified food manager lacked allergen training proof. This previous core violation was not corrected and a citation was issued.

headline: Failed: slime in ice machine; vacuum-packed food discarded
summary: Failed. Black slime in the ice machine was dripping onto ice; staff were told to clean and sanitize it during the inspection. Vacuum packaging without a variance or HACCP plan was halted, and 150 lbs of food (about $900) was voluntarily destroyed. Other issues included a leaking walk-in cooler and grease buildup.

headline: Corn held too warm; discarded; minor repairs
summary: Roasted corn at 48.0F was discarded and a citation was issued; the manager corrected this on site. An opening at the front entrance door must be sealed. Mops must dry on a rack, and ice and dust buildup in the walk-in freezer and dish area must be cleaned.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged out of use
summary: The low-temperature dish machine was not sanitizing, with zero ppm chlorine at final rinse. A citation was issued. The machine is tagged and may not be used until the health department approves removal of the tag. Prep coolers also lack a thermometer.

headline: No cooler thermometer; no hot water in restroom
summary: The front display cooler has no thermometer, and operable thermometers are required in all coolers. The right sink in the women's washroom has no hot water and must be repaired. Rear prep and storage areas were cluttered.

headline: Failed: sanitizer, date labels and hot-holding violations
summary: Failed. Sink had no sanitizer, paper towels were missing, and soups were held too cold or too hot. About 200 lbs of prepared foods were discarded; they were in dish soap buckets, and some food lacked date labels. Hair and beard restraints, rusty shelves and floor damage must also be fixed.

headline: Failed: about 100 rat droppings in basement
summary: Failed. About 100 rat droppings were found in the basement, and a citation was issued. Food debris, flour buildup, and boxes and debris on basement floors need cleaning. Restroom ceiling vents need cleaning. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Unlabeled food containers; food stored on floors
summary: Food in coolers, the walk-in and dry storage lacked labels. Food containers were stored on floors and must be elevated 6 inches. Reach-in cooler interiors need detail cleaning, and food debris and spills were found throughout.

headline: Failed: unlabeled flour; gaps under doors
summary: Failed. Flour was stored in an unlabeled plastic bin. Half-inch gaps under the front and rear doors must be sealed to prevent pests. Rusty shelving and dirty floor drains need attention. An oven was not under a ventilation vent. A repeat floor seam violation was cited.

headline: Greasy fryers, hood and ceiling damage
summary: Heavy grease and food debris were found on deep fryer openings, cooking equipment and the hood and filters. A hole in the ceiling near the rear exit and a missing ceiling cover in front of the fryers must be repaired to prevent pests. Drips from ceiling pipe and peeling wall paint also need attention.

headline: Door gaps and wall holes must be sealed
summary: Doors have half-inch gaps at the bottom that must be sealed tightly. Holes under the bar sink and around pipes must be sealed. Unused equipment on the rear patio must be removed to prevent rodent hiding places. No pests were reported.

headline: Missing sanitation certificate; cold food too warm
summary: No valid City sanitation certificate was on site. The front handwashing station lacked soap, drying supplies and signage. Smoked salmon at 50.1F was discarded. Cleanup supplies, test strips and clear floors are required; clutter was a repeat violation.

headline: Leaks at sinks; broken restroom door closers
summary: Leaks at a hand sink and a three-compartment sink faucet must be repaired. Restroom doors that do not close on their own must be fixed. Grease buildup on cooking equipment and floors under fryers must be cleaned. Two nonworking units must be repaired or removed.

headline: Failed: no hot water; no pest service records
summary: Failed. The only kitchen handwashing sink did not work properly and must be turned on from its base valve. No hot water was on site, though it was restored before the inspection ended, and a citation was issued. No proof of two pest control services was provided. Food handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Failed: 75+ mouse droppings; food too cold
summary: Failed. About 75 or more mouse droppings and a dead mouse were found in several areas, and a citation was issued. Cut lettuce and smoothie mix were discarded, about $513 worth. A prep cooler at 48.3F was tagged. No food handler training or allergen training was provided.

headline: Greasy floor near griddle
summary: The floor near the griddle had grease buildup and was ordered cleaned by the manager.

headline: Failed: 50+ mouse droppings; food too warm
summary: Failed. Milk at 47.4F and sliced melon at 48.8F were held above the 41F limit and discarded. A reach-in prep cooler read 49.1F and was tagged. Over 50 mouse droppings were found in the second-floor storage area, and a citation was issued.

headline: Pajama pants worn; cracked tiles in basement
summary: A food handler wore pajama pants at the prep line, but corrected this on site by putting on an apron. Cracked wall tiles above the basement prep table and cracked floor tiles in the dish area must be repaired.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; stained ceiling tiles
summary: A handwashing sign is missing at the toilet room sink. Rusty storage racks in the walk-in cooler must be repaired or replaced. The toilet room trash can needs a lid. Water-stained ceiling tiles in the prep area must be replaced.

headline: No soap or towels at sinks; food on floors
summary: Some handwashing sinks lacked soap and paper towels, and a basement prep sink was missing; a citation was issued. Food containers were stored on floors and must be raised 6 inches. Ice machine lining, rusty shelves, a leak at the three-compartment sink and unlabeled food also need attention.

headline: Suspected food poisoning report; unsafe food discarded
summary: A suspected food poisoning complaint prompted this inspection. Cooked beef ribs at 75.6F in hot holding, and raw salmon at 46.7F and cut melon at 55.1F in cold holding, were discarded on site, and a citation was issued. Food stored under a condensate drip must be moved. Freezer ice buildup must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: undercooked eggs without advisory
summary: Failed. The business planned to serve undercooked eggs without a consumer advisory, and staff were told to add one. There was no sanitizer test strip kit on site. Dishwasher wastewater was draining onto the basement floor. No citation was issued today.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; rusty shelves; no allergen training
summary: A handwashing sign is missing at the preparation hand sink. Rusty shelves in the walk-in cooler must be fixed. The sanitation manager has no allergen training and must obtain it.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; no allergen training
summary: A cooling unit lacked an internal thermometer and must have one. The person in charge lacked allergen training and must provide proof on site.

headline: Moldy produce discarded; citation issued
summary: Moldy cherries, partly moldy strawberries and an orange were found in the produce cooler, about 6 lbs worth about $41. The employee discarded and denatured the food on site. A citation was issued.

headline: Failed: hot water too cool; food handlers untrained
summary: Failed. Hot water at the staff men's restroom sink reached only 87.7F; at least 100F is required, and a citation was issued. Food handlers lacked proof of training. Mixing bowls must be stored upside down, and wooden pallets and milk crates were used for storage. The walk-in freezer wiring encasement is peeling.

headline: Wet wiping cloths; leaking wall AC unit
summary: Wet wiping cloths were on several prep surfaces and must be stored in sanitizing solution. Food-encrusted storage racks and a checkered tablecloth used as a liner must be cleaned or removed. A wall air conditioner leaked excessively in the rear prep area and must be repaired.

headline: Unlabeled sugar; food stored on floor
summary: Bulk containers of sugar were unlabeled. Large pots of prepared food were stored on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised off the floor. Preset utensils on tables were uncovered and must be covered.

headline: Stained cutting board must be replaced
summary: A stained and worn cutting board was found and must be replaced.

headline: Food stored on basement floors; allergen training missing
summary: Bulk food containers were stored on the floor in basement walk-in areas and must be elevated 6 inches. Food debris covered rear prep floors, and the basement storage area was cluttered. Several certified managers lacked allergen training certificates.

headline: No handwashing sink in meat prep room
summary: The rear small meat cutting room needs a handwashing sink with hot and cold water, soap and paper towels, a citation was issued. A thermometer is needed for a new hot holding unit, and a knife holder must be installed. Milk crates, cardboard, and damaged floor tiles must be removed or repaired.

headline: Unsafe cold food discarded; slime in ice machine
summary: Beef soup at 50.1F, shrimp soup at 52.0F and cooked beans at 52.1F were discarded, about 40 lbs ($300). Cold TCS foods must stay at 41F or below. Slime was dripping from the ice machine, and a citation was issued. Greasy cooking equipment and rusty shelves also need attention.

headline: Food handlers lack certificates; dirty equipment
summary: Food handlers at the front counter were not wearing hair restraints. Food handlers lacked food handler certificates. A knife was stored between a cooler and the wall, and cutting boards were worn with deep cuts. Cooking equipment, cooler gaskets and restroom areas need detail cleaning.

headline: Salt, sugar and MSG need labels
summary: Salt, sugar and MSG kept on the cooking line must be labeled with their names.

headline: Broken prep sink; peeling wall paint
summary: The prep and dump sink in the front prep area is in poor repair, with its drain pipe removed, and must be repaired. Peeling paint on a front prep wall needs repair.

headline: Missing vomit cleanup supplies; no food handler certificates
summary: No adequate vomit or diarrhea cleanup supplies were on site, and staff were told to provide them. A restroom lacked handwashing signage and a covered waste receptacle. Grime was found under kitchen equipment, and ceiling tiles and a hole near the electrical panel need repair. Food handlers lacked certificates.

headline: Coffee dispenser nozzle needs cleaning
summary: The nozzle on the coffee dispenser had buildup and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies; citation issued
summary: No cleanup supplies for vomit or diarrhea were on the premises. Management was told to provide them, and a citation was issued. The grease trap exterior in the deli and chipped ceiling paint in the meat cooler also need attention.

headline: No certified manager while coffee prepared
summary: The person in charge lacked a City sanitation certificate, and no certified food service manager was on site while coffee with milk and cream was served. A citation was issued. Employees were not wearing hair restraints, and floors in the utility and dry storage areas need cleaning.

headline: Greasy hood and vent system
summary: Dust covered the hood ventilation system, and oil or grease ran down its side. The manager was told to clean it to prevent food contamination.

headline: Failed: ice machine buildup dripping onto ice
summary: Failed. Pink buildup inside the ice machine was dripping onto ice; the ice must be removed and the machine cleaned and sanitized. No signed employee health policies were found, and a citation was issued. Basement sink overflow and missing backflow device also cited.

headline: Soiled floors and drains under bar equipment
summary: Floors and floor drains under bar equipment had dried food debris and must be cleaned at a frequency that prevents buildup.

headline: Failed: open, overflowing garbage and greasy equipment
summary: Failed. All outside garbage containers were open, and one overflowed; a citation was issued. Cooking equipment, drink nozzles and floors needed detail cleaning. A leak at the three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Wet utensils on cloths; damaged cooler gaskets
summary: Wet utensils were placed on cloth towels, and staff were told not to dry them with cloth. A fire extinguisher was in the three-compartment sink and must be removed. Cooler door gaskets need replacing, and kitchen staff lacked food handler certificates.

headline: Rear door needs rodent-proofing; greasy equipment
summary: The rear exit door must be rodent-proofed and outer openings sealed. Ice machine interior, cutting boards, cooking equipment and cooler interiors need cleaning or replacement. Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizing solution. Floors need cleaning.

headline: Certified managers lack allergen training
summary: Serving plates were not stored upside down and must be inverted to prevent dust. A torn cooler gasket, freezer ice buildup and a leaking bar hand sink need repair. Certified food managers on duty lacked allergen training certification, which they must obtain.

headline: No health policy; no soap; certificates missing
summary: No employee health policy was on site, and a citation was issued. The basement prep area lacked soap, also cited. Milk crates were used for elevation and must be replaced with shelving. Ice buildup in the walk-in freezer must be repaired. Employees lacked food handler certificates; a 30-day grace period applies to new hires.

headline: Large pot cooking method; missing certificates
summary: A large pot used for cooking carnitas must be washed in an approved way or switched to a smaller pot that fits the three-compartment sink. A light shield is needed at the front counter. No food handler certificate was on site, and the certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Failed: live flies and small insects in food areas
summary: Failed. About 12 live house flies and 30 small flying insects were found in food prep and dry storage areas, and a citation was issued. Additional pest control service is needed. An employee had an expired food handler certificate, and the certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Reach-in coolers and floors need cleaning
summary: Reach-in cooler interiors and cabinets had food spills and debris and must be detail cleaned. Floors had food and water spills. A cooler air vent was dusty and must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager while fish was prepared
summary: No certified manager was on site while fish and other TCS foods were prepared. A citation was issued, and an employee holding a valid certificate must be on site at all times.

headline: Dead insects in basement; splashguard missing
summary: Dead insects were found in basement corners and must be cleaned. A washable splashguard is needed between the hand sink and prep table. Dry-storage scoops were stored inside their containers and must be stored properly between uses.

headline: Failed: slime in ice maker; live dogs in premises
summary: Failed. Black slime inside the ice maker was dripping into ice; the machine must be shut off, the ice removed, and the interior cleaned and sanitized. Live dogs were brought into the establishment, and management did not address it, a citation was issued. No signed health policies or sanitation certificate were posted.

headline: Basement restroom door must self-close
summary: The basement restroom door in the dry storage area does not close on its own and must be fitted with a self-closing device.

headline: Unlabeled bulk rice; hairnets missing
summary: A bulk container of rice lacked a common-name label. Employees were not wearing hats or hairnets. Wiping cloths were left on the countertop, and cardboard covered shelves. Items were stored on the floor in the rear storage area.

headline: Cooler too warm; food discarded; food handler lacks card
summary: Ham, tomatoes, sausage and greens were held above 41F, and about 8 lbs ($200) of food was discarded. The front prep cooler read 63.7F and is tagged, and it must not be used until repaired. A food handler lacked training proof. Allergen training for the manager was also missing.

headline: Broken cooler gaskets; backflow device missing
summary: Broken rubber gaskets on cooler doors must be replaced. The backflow prevention device for the first-floor ice maker could not be located and must be provided. Open sections in the basement ceiling need repair.

headline: Failed: food too warm or cold; flies found
summary: Failed. Cooked pizzas and other hot foods were below 135F and about 20 lbs were discarded. Cold foods above 41F and coolers reading 45.5F and 54.3F were tagged. About 20 or more live flies were found, and no pest logbook was kept. Health policies and food handler training are missing.

headline: Failed: dish machine not sanitizing; tagged out
summary: Failed. The low-temperature dish machine had zero ppm sanitizer and was tagged, so the three-compartment sink must be used until it is repaired. A citation was issued. Repeat violations included milk crates for storage, floor debris and a rough basement ceiling.

headline: Failed: roaches, flies, mice, ice slime; no manager
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on site while eggs, milk and sausage were served. There was no vomit cleanup procedure or kit. Ice machines had slime dripping onto ice. Droppings, five dead roaches and over 30 flying insects were found, and a citation was issued.

headline: Food on floors; grease under equipment
summary: Food containers were stored on floors in the walk-in, prep and storage areas and must be raised 6 inches. Grease, food debris and dirt were found under cooking equipment, along walls and in corners, and must be cleaned.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure; peeling ceiling paint
summary: No procedure for cleaning up vomit or diarrhea was on the premises; management was told to provide one, and no citation was issued. Soiled mop heads were not hung to dry and must be. Peeling ceiling paint and a missing light near the washroom also need attention.

headline: No posted sanitation certificate; untrained handlers found
summary: No City food sanitation certificate was posted. The inspector required a certified food manager on site whenever foods that must be kept hot or cold (TCS) are prepared or served. Several food handlers lacked training certificates. Dusty ceiling tiles also need cleaning.

headline: Worn cutting boards; dirty toaster oven
summary: Worn cutting boards with deep cuts on the front prep line must be replaced. The toaster oven interior needed cleaning of food debris, and the rear prep wall needs cleaning of food splatter.

headline: Failed: 70+ mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. Over 70 mouse droppings were found near the front ice cream freezer and in the rear storage room. A citation was issued, and a pest control company must service the premises before reinspection. A front door needs rodent-proofing and a utility sink faucet leaks.

headline: Leaks and broken stoppers at sinks
summary: Missing sink stoppers and several leaks at the three-compartment sink must be fixed. Coolers, freezers and cooking equipment need cleaning. Two unused, nonworking refrigerators and an ice machine in the sushi prep area must be repaired or removed. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Certified managers lack allergen training
summary: No food employee had proof of allergen training. All City certified food managers were instructed to obtain this certificate.

headline: Three-compartment sink pipe leaking
summary: A pipe under the middle compartment of the three-compartment sink is leaking and must be repaired and maintained.

headline: No health policy; summary not posted; cardboard in trash area
summary: No employee health policy was on the premises, and a citation was issued. The inspection summary was not posted for customers, also cited. Cooking equipment exterior and a hot holding unit were unclean. A leaky hand sink needs repair. Oil boxes were corrected on site, and wet mops must hang on the rack.

headline: Failed: no health policy; mold-like substance in cooler
summary: Failed. The person in charge did not show knowledge of food operations. No health policy, complete vomit cleanup policy, handwashing signage, or raw-food advisory was on site. A two-door cooler had a mold-like substance on its interior panels and rusty, encrusted racks; a licensed pest control operator was not in place.

headline: Failed: repeat violations not corrected
summary: Failed. Previous core violations were not corrected: stained cutting boards, no covered waste containers in unisex washrooms, and a dusty exhaust hood. A citation was issued. Floor drains need detail cleaning; corrections are due by April 21, 2025.

headline: Gap at front door; no covered waste containers
summary: An opening at the base of the front entrance door must be sealed to keep pests out. Plastic film on equipment must be removed. Some restrooms lack covered sanitary waste containers, and sink holes need sealing. Mops must dry on a rack.

headline: Worn cooler gasket; grime under bar equipment
summary: The gasket on a two-door reach-in cooler at the salad station is worn and must be repaired. Dirt and small debris were found in the front bar area under and around equipment, and corners and walls must be cleaned.

headline: Dirty floors and walls; leaking drain pipe
summary: A knife drying rack in the fish department was dirty and loose from the wall. Reach-in cooler bases, the floors and walls in the produce and meat prep areas, and walk-in floors need cleaning. A leaking drain pipe under the produce sink must be repaired, and dusty fan vents need cleaning.

headline: No health policy; missing ceiling tile
summary: No written employee health policy was on the premises, and a priority citation was issued. A backflow device must be installed at the ice maker. The women's restroom needs a covered sanitary receptacle, and missing ceiling tiles and peeling paint need repair. Basement items must be elevated.

headline: Leaks, wall holes, and missing toilet lids
summary: A leaky faucet at the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Unisex toilet rooms must have covered trash cans. Holes in walls near the rear hand sink and inside the mop sink must be sealed. A noisy ventilation unit needs repair, and a second toilet room needs ventilation.

headline: Failed: chicken thawed in sink; wastewater spilling
summary: Failed. Chicken was being thawed in a three-compartment sink, and staff were told to thaw TCS foods under cold running water, in the refrigerator or in the microwave. Wastewater spilled onto the deli prep area; a citation was issued. Floors were soiled with food debris.

headline: Hair restraints missing in prep area
summary: Food handlers in the prep area were not wearing hair restraints and must wear them. A leak at the rear three-compartment sink faucet must be fixed. Mops must be hung to air dry.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; food stored on floors
summary: A beverage can was open on a prep table near the gyro machine. Bulk containers were unlabeled, and food was stored on the floor of the walk-in freezer. A 1/4-inch gap at a side door must be sealed. Certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Donuts accessible to customers; leaks and buildup
summary: Fresh donut holes were on display where customers could touch them and must be moved behind the counter. Freezer gaskets need repair, and ice buildup must be removed. A handsink leak and floor debris also need attention. The donut fryer must sit under the hood.

headline: Failed: no working coolers; no pest service
summary: Failed. There were no working coolers, so adequate refrigeration must be provided. Other issues included no certified manager certificate, no employee health policy, no vomit cleanup kit, and no pest control service or logbook. Standing water and dirty floors were found in the dish room.

headline: Failed: 30+ mouse droppings in prep area
summary: Failed. Over 30 mouse droppings were found in the prep and dishwashing area, over 15 in electrical areas and over 20 in the rear mechanical room. A citation was issued and a licensed pest control company is recommended. Ice machine calcium buildup must also be cleaned.

headline: Stained, dirty floors in front prep area
summary: Floors in the front prep area were stained and dirty and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Rodent droppings corrected on site
summary: Rodent droppings found on an earlier visit were not present at this inspection, and this was marked as corrected. A torn gasket on a two-door prep cooler must be repaired. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment and coolers must be cleaned, and burnt-out lights need replacing.

headline: Failed: no health policy; hair restraints missing
summary: Failed. No written employee health policy was on site, and a citation was issued. Food handlers worked without hair restraints and without proof of food handler training. A repeat pest control logbook violation is now a priority item. Freezer ice buildup must be removed.

headline: Ice machine needs cleaning; pallets stored in trash area
summary: The front ice machine interior, including the ice chute, needs cleaning. Piled plastic pallets in the garbage area must be removed to prevent pests. Personal belongings in food prep areas were removed during the inspection. Floors and mop heads also need attention.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; food not date-marked
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared, and a citation was issued. Ready-to-eat TCS foods held over 24 hours lacked date marks. No food handler or allergen training certificates were on site. The ice machine buildup and a repeat ceiling tile violation also need correction.

headline: Holes in walls by freezer and ice machine
summary: Multiple holes in the walls by the large deep freezer and ice machine must be sealed to prevent pests. The walk-in freezer door does not close tightly. Leaks at the three-compartment sink and dish machine backflow device must be repaired. Dirt and coffee grounds in the bar and prep areas must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager during handling of raw meats
summary: The person in charge lacked a City certified manager certificate, and no certified manager was on site while meats were handled, a citation was issued. Pork was thawed on a counter. Meat slicer, floor drains and toilet waste receptacle need cleaning or repair.

headline: Gloves not changed between tasks; no soap
