summary: An employee handled items while wearing gloves, adjusted his hat, and kept prepping without changing gloves; management was told to change gloves between tasks. A citation was issued. No soap was at the front prep handwashing sink. Floors and the exhaust hood were heavily soiled.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; food not labeled
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on site while cooked chicken and beef were prepared, and a citation was issued. Cooked beans held over 24 hours lacked date marks. Menus lacked a raw-food advisory for items like eggs. Food handlers lacked certificates, and a service sink must be installed.

headline: Gaps under garage door; backflow device missing
summary: Half-inch gaps at the bottom of the overhead garage door need pest-proofing. The backflow prevention device for the coffee brewer was not located and must be installed where it can be serviced.

headline: Failed: 70+ mouse droppings; rear door gap
summary: Failed. Over 50 mouse droppings were found in rear dry storage and over 20 behind the front counter, and a citation was issued. The rear exit door must be rodent-proofed. A food handler lacked a valid certificate. Several previous violations were not corrected.

headline: Food handlers without hair restraints
summary: Food handlers in the omelet and smoothie prep areas were not wearing hair restraints. All food handlers in prep areas must wear them.

headline: Ice machine buildup; ceiling dust near dish area
summary: Slight buildup was found inside the ice machine and must be cleaned. The dish area hand sink's cold water handle is stripped and must be repaired. Dust on ceiling tiles and vents above the dish area must be cleaned.

headline: Raw chicken at 48.9F to 49.8F; food discarded
summary: Walk-in cooler in the outside storage room held cold foods, including raw chicken, at 48.9F to 49.8F. The manager voluntarily discarded about 51.75 lbs of food valued at $184. A cloudy drain at the bar sink must be repaired.

headline: No certified food service manager on site
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while chicken and beef were being handled and served. Management was told to obtain one.

headline: No covered washroom receptacle; cluttered storage
summary: No covered receptacle was in the washroom. Boxes and items were on floors in the hallway, storage closet and rear food storage. All items must be removed, or stored at least six inches off the ground.

headline: No certified manager; handwashing water too cold
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were served. Employee handsink hot water measured 50.1F, below the required 100F. No pest control log, no food handler certificates, and wet wiping cloths were found.

headline: Hot and cold food temperature violations; sink issues
summary: Hot TCS foods measured 103.1F to 109.2F and cold foods 46.0F to 54.2F. About 40 lbs of food was voluntarily discarded. Handwashing sinks in the B2 and B3 areas had water as low as 77F. Ice machines had black mold-like buildup.

headline: Grease on floors and vent hood grates
summary: Grease was pooled on the floor behind heavy equipment in front prep and must be removed. Ventilation hood grates had grease buildup and must be cleaned.

headline: About 20 mouse droppings under cook line sink
summary: About 20 mouse droppings were found under the cook line handsink in front of the prep area. Staff must remove and sanitize the area, and additional pest control service is recommended. Cutting boards were deeply cut and stained, and there is a hole in the wall under the handsink.

headline: Wiping cloth and broom storage issues
summary: A wiping cloth was left on a cutting board instead of in sanitizer bucket. Brooms were stored too close to open food. Staff were told to correct both on the spot.

headline: Loose front door sweep; burnt-out prep lights
summary: The door sweep at the entrance door is loose and must be fixed to keep rodents out. Light bulbs over the prep table near the three-compartment sink are out and must be replaced.

headline: Employee items above napkins; no test kit
summary: Employee personal care items were stored on a shelf above single-service articles. Bulk dry foods were unlabeled, and dry tea bags were stored on the closet floor. No chemical sanitizer test kit was available for the dishmachine.

headline: Food handlers not wearing hair restraints
summary: Food handlers in the prep area were not wearing hair restraints. Water-stained ceiling tiles in the restroom must be replaced. The certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: About 20 live large flies; no certified manager
summary: No valid certified food manager certificate was posted while TCS foods were served. About 20 or more live large flies were found. A food handler was seen handling cooked fish without washing hands. Multiple repairs are needed.

headline: Openings at rear exit door; damaged gaskets
summary: Openings at the top and right base of the rear exit door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Damaged gaskets were on a cold holding unit and chest freezer. There is no service sink and no covered restroom receptacle.

headline: Mouse carcass, ~70 lbs deli meat at unsafe temperatures
summary: A dead mouse was behind a cooler in the grocery area. About 70 lbs of deli meat was held at 47F to 65F, and the person in charge discarded $350 worth. Uncured beef was on display without an approved process, and the handsink in the deli lacked hand drying supplies.

headline: Hard-to-read dishmachine gauge; greasy hood filters
summary: The rinse gauge on the high-temperature dish machine in the second floor kitchen is hard to read and must be repaired or replaced. Grease and grime are on the hood filters over the cook line.

headline: No self-closing restroom door; no allergen training
summary: The restroom door is not self-closing and management must install a self-closing device. The certified food manager had no allergen training certificate.

headline: Reach-in coolers not clean
summary: The interior of reach-in coolers was not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Front door gap allows possible pest entry
summary: The front door has a 1/4 inch gap between its double doors. The gap must be sealed so the door is rodent and insect proof.

headline: No food sanitation certificate; hand sink lacked water
summary: No valid food service sanitation certificate was on site while ready-to-eat ham was sliced. The hand sink in the main prep area had its water turned off and was not maintained. No chlorine test strips were provided.

headline: Dirty fans inside walk-in cooler
summary: Dirty and dusty fans were found inside the walk-in cooler. Staff were told to clean and maintain them.

headline: Handwashing sink overflowing; no food handler training
summary: The rear prep handwashing sink was in poor repair, with water backing up through the floor drain onto the floor when used. Food debris and grease are on fryer cabinets and prep tables. No food handler training was available for employees.

headline: No certified food manager on site while open
summary: No certified food manager was on site while the facility was open and operating. The rear exit door was not rodent proof. Food debris and grease were found in prep areas, floors, walls and pipes. A dead insect was on storage container lids.

headline: Chicken stored in non-food-grade plastic bags
summary: Chicken stored in the walk-in cooler was in printed plastic bags. The person in charge was told to use only food-grade plastic bags.

headline: Mouse droppings and no hot water at sinks
summary: More than 70 mouse droppings were on display shelves, floors and under pallets. Handwashing sinks in the women's and men's restrooms had water at 69F, below the required 100F. The front entrance has a 1/4 inch gap. An exterminator was ordered.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; water pooling on floor
summary: Several employees had expired food handler certificates and must have valid ones. Food debris is on dishmachine trays and prep equipment. Water pools between floor tiles in the dishwashing area and needs regrouting.

headline: No grease trap for three-compartment sink
summary: There is no grease trap or interceptor for the three-compartment sink. The facility must install one and maintain it.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers and food stored on floor
summary: Unlabeled salt, sugar and other bulk containers in rear prep area, and boxed food stored on the floor of the walk-in cooler and freezer. Also rust, spills, cardboard and foil liners. Person in charge was told to fix each item.

headline: Dusty fans and cracked ceiling seal in cooler
summary: Excessive dust was on fans and a cracked seal was on the ceiling of walk-in cooler #4. Restrooms had no covered trash receptacles. This was a re-inspection, and the issues must be fixed.

headline: No employee health policy; grease and wall base issues
summary: No signed employee health policies were on site during the inspection. Restroom door is not self-closing. Grease receptacle has food debris buildup and a broken top cover. Broken or detached wall bases were found in the rear prep and dishwashing area.

headline: Dishmachine sanitizer at 0 ppm; cooler at 47F
summary: The low-temperature dish machine measured 0 ppm final sanitizer when tested, so it was tagged. No dishes were washed at the time. A two-door cooler measured 47F and was tagged. The certified food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Ice buildup on beer cooler condenser; cracked light cover
summary: Ice buildup was found on the rear of the condenser in the beer walk-in cooler and must be removed. A cracked ceiling light cover above the prep area must be replaced. Some managers lacked allergen training certificates.

headline: Raw wood shelves and plastic crates used for elevation
summary: Raw wood display shelves must be sealed or painted. Plastic soda and milk crates may not be used for elevation. Three drain stoppers are needed at the meat prep three-compartment sink, and unused items must be removed from the rear storage area.

headline: About 25 live flies found throughout premises
summary: About 25 small live flies were seen on cooling units and storage cabinets in the bar, prep, dry storage and restroom areas. Pest control service was ordered. Food handlers lacked effective hair restraints, and equipment and surfaces needed cleaning.

headline: Three-compartment sink faucet spraying sideways
summary: The three-compartment sink faucet sprays to the sides and must be repaired and maintained.

headline: No certified food manager while TCS foods served
summary: No certified food manager was on site while espresso and egg rolls were being prepared and served. Clutter was in the rear restroom and no allergen training certificate was on site. Management must have a certified manager on site at all times.

headline: Unlabeled spices and frozen meats; no utility sink
summary: Prepackaged spices on sale were not labeled, and prepackaged frozen fish, turkey and beef were not labeled. There was no utility sink for mop water disposal. Holes were found in the walls around showers.

headline: Dirty ceiling inside meat prep cooler
summary: The ceiling inside the meat preparation cooler was found not clean. It must be cleaned.

headline: No employee health policy; no handwashing sinks in prep
summary: No employee health policy was available. Handwashing sinks were missing in prep and dishwashing areas, a repeat violation. No utility sink, no grease interceptor, and no restroom receptacle were provided. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint.

headline: Poor freezer gaskets; dim rear prep lighting
summary: Rubber gaskets on the chest reach-in freezer by the front toilet rooms are in poor repair. Floors under heavy equipment have dirt and debris. Mops were stored in buckets, and the rear prep area is not bright enough. A food handler had an expired certificate.

headline: Ice machine and reach-in coolers need cleaning
summary: The interior of the ice machine needs cleaning to remove buildup. Reach-in coolers have food and drink spills inside. Floors in rear storage and dish machine area need cleaning. Bulk food items must be labeled with commodity names.

headline: Wiping cloth by sink; dust and debris under racks
summary: A wiping cloth was found on the side of the hand sink and was told to be kept in the sanitizing bucket. Dust and food debris were under donut racks near the front counter and in rear storage. Staff were told to clean.

headline: No allergen training; lots of cleaning needed
summary: No proof of allergen training was available for certified food managers. Noted no hand-wash signs, no food handler certificates, no lock on basement liquor closet, and dirty floors and walls. Compartments under fryers have encrusted grease and food debris.

headline: Utensils stored in stagnant water; raw wood shelving
summary: Utensils in the prep area were stored in stagnant water, and must be kept in running water or hot water at or above 135F. Raw wood shelving and cluttered storage areas need attention. No allergen training proof was on site for city food managers.

headline: Handwashing sink water only 87.8F
summary: The front prep handwashing sink measured 87.8F, below the required 100F. A cardboard milk crate was used to elevate boxes in rear storage and must be replaced with shelving.

headline: Ice scoop stored with exposed food-contact surface
summary: The ice scoop was stored on top of the ice bin with its food-contact surface exposed. Staff were instructed on how to store it properly between uses.

headline: Dishmachine out of order, held for inspection
summary: The warewashing machine behind the bar was out of order and tagged 'held for inspection' so it cannot be used until repaired. Food was also held at incorrect temperature in some places and several repairs were ordered.

headline: No sink stoppers; pink slime in ice machine
summary: No sink stoppers were on site for the warewashing sink. Light pink slime was in the interior of the ice machine, and dirt and grime were on the low-temperature dishmachine. Staff were instructed to detail clean.

headline: No ambient thermometers inside coolers
summary: No ambient air thermometer was inside a prep cooler or the refrigerator near the prep area entrance. Bulk dry ingredients lacked a label. A plastic cup was stored in the flour container, and the microwave interior needs cleaning.

headline: Booth storage bins not neat in lobby
summary: Booth storage bins in the lobby were not neatly maintained, with small items on the floor. Items must be decluttered and kept at least six inches off the floor to prevent pests.

headline: No certified manager; no sewage or temperature controls
summary: No certified food manager was on site and no employee health policies were signed. Hot foods were not held at 135F, and no probe thermometer was provided. No pest control log was found. Floors near the sink were flooded.

headline: Cold food too warm; spoiled food discarded on site
summary: Cold TCS foods, including cream, chicken and cheese, were held between 45.1F and 48.7F, above the 41F limit. The manager voluntarily discarded about 20 lbs of food. A cooler reading 54.1F was repaired on site to 39.6F.

headline: Clutter and broken shelf near beverage station
summary: Clutter and unused equipment near the beverage station in the rear prep area must be removed to prevent hiding places for pests. A shelf in the rear prep area is broken and must be repaired.

headline: Employee without food handler training
summary: One employee had no food handler training, and training records must be kept on site at all times. Grease was on hood filters above the cook line. The exposed handsink in the bar lacked hand-washing signage.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; ice buildup in freezer
summary: Bulk containers in the rear prep area were not labeled. Soiled wiping cloths were on a prep table. Crates were used as shelving inside the walk-in freezer, and ice buildup was inside. A beverage sink handle is in poor repair.

headline: No valid food sanitation certificate posted
summary: No valid City of Chicago food sanitation certificate was posted on the premises while TCS foods were prepared or served. The restroom door needs a self-closing device. Grease must be cleaned from the floor under cooking equipment.

headline: Clutter on floor behind front counter
summary: Clutter was on the floor behind the front counter. Staff were told to organize items and raise them at least six inches off the floor.

headline: No verifiable certified manager; dishmachine tagged
summary: No verifiable City of Chicago certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared and served. The dish machine has no data plate and no temperature devices, and it is tagged. It also lacks automatic detergent dispensing.

headline: Thick black slime in ice machine; ice machine off
summary: A thick black and slimy substance was inside the ice machine, dripping onto the ice. Management was told not to use the ice machine until it is detail cleaned and sanitized. Many other cleaning, storage and sealing issues were noted.

headline: Restroom door not self-closing; stained ceiling tile
summary: The washroom door is not self-closing and must be repaired or replaced. A stained ceiling tile is in the front serving area and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Missing handwashing signage; ice machine debris
summary: Handwashing signage was missing at bar and prep sinks. Debris was encrusted inside the ice machine and must be removed. A stained cutting board must be resurfaced or replaced. Basement storage needs clearing.

headline: Hot water at 68.7F to 70.1F in restroom sink
summary: Hot water at the women's restroom handsink measured only 68.7F to 70.1F; the required minimum is 100F. Bulk ingredient containers were unlabeled, and large pots were not inverted. Fly paper was found in prep and restroom areas.

headline: No valid food sanitation certificate; no chlorine test kit
summary: No valid City of Chicago food sanitation certificate was provided for employees, and a certified manager must be on site. No chlorine test kit was available for the dishwashing sanitizer. Food debris was found in cooler and prep areas.

headline: About 60 mouse droppings found throughout facility
summary: About 60 mouse droppings were found in utility closets, cleaning product storage, and under soda shelving. The person in charge must remove and sanitize all areas. Holes in walls, grime on the can opener and surfaces, and damaged cooler gaskets need repair.

headline: Exterior door gap; restroom door closer broken
summary: The exterior door has a half-inch gap at the bottom and must be repaired to prevent pest entry. The restroom door's self-closing device is broken and must be repaired.

headline: Ice machine buildup; dark cutting boards
summary: The interior of the ice machine needs cleaning to remove buildup. A door sweep is needed at the rear alley exit. Dark-colored cutting boards must be replaced and the employee restroom needs a covered receptacle.

headline: Handwashing sinks missing signage; backflow device needed
summary: Handwashing sinks on the first floor kitchen and second floor bar lacked signs telling workers to wash hands. A plastic bag was used as a drain cover, and a utility sink needs a backflow prevention device.

headline: Missing drain plugs; hood doesn't cover gas oven
summary: The three-compartment sink drain plugs were not working properly and must be provided. Ventilation hood systems do not fully cover the gas oven in the griddle area. Manager was told to correct both.

headline: Excessive ice buildup in chest freezers
summary: Excessive ice was found in chest freezers and must be removed and maintained.

headline: Some food managers have expired allergen training
summary: Some City of Chicago certified food managers had expired allergen training. Management was told to renew it and keep certificates on site.

headline: Heavy clutter and foil liners in basement storage
summary: Foil paper lined cabinet shelves in basement dry storage and must be removed to prevent pest hiding places. Heavy clutter is on the floor under the stairs. A leaking faucet at the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Employees lacked food handler certificates.

headline: Broken wall base and unsealed walls in prep areas
summary: Broken wall base under a handsink in the rear prep area and near registers in the front prep area. Items were stored on closet floors. Certified food managers lacked allergen training certificates.

headline: Live roaches found; no food handler training
summary: About 12 or more live roaches were crawling in cracks near the window sill and wood panels. The person in charge did not have a certified food manager certificate. Food debris, grease and dust need cleaning, and new employees lacked food handler training.

headline: Handwashing sink drain spills onto floor
summary: The front serving area handwashing sink drain pipe was not properly connected, letting water spill onto the floor. Condensate from the walk-in cooler drains into a bucket and must be routed to the proper disposal point.

headline: Ice machine buildup; reach-in cooler lacks thermometer
summary: A small dark buildup was found inside the ice machine. The dessert reach-in cooler had no thermometer for air temperature. Grease was found on cooking equipment, and several floors and surfaces need cleaning.

headline: Rusty chemical storage rack above sink
summary: A rusty wire chemical storage rack is located above the three-compartment sink. The rack must be replaced and kept rust-free.

headline: No allergen training certificate; cutting board stained
summary: No approved allergen training certificate was available. A backflow preventer was not located at the mop sink faucet. The restroom door must be self-closing, and the stained cutting board must be refinished or replaced.

headline: Combination cooler at 61.2F; garbage dumpster missing
summary: The line cooler in the main kitchen measured 61.2F and is in poor repair, but was not cited. The restroom sink lacked hand-washing signs. A gap under the exterior door could let pests in. The facility had no commercial dumpster on site.

headline: Dead roaches found in fryer, sinks and freezers
summary: Dead roaches were found in the deep fryer, sprayer sink, dishwashing equipment, walk-in freezer and an unused cooler. Staff were instructed to remove them and sanitize the areas. Handwashing sinks lacked signage and splashguards, and openings under sinks need sealing.

headline: About 75 live flies and 20 large flies found
summary: About 75 or more live small flies and about 20 large flies were found in breakroom, prep, dishwashing and packaging areas. Hand washing sink was blocked and the front sink had no soap at times. Dumpsters were overflowing and open. Pest control service is recommended.

headline: No certified manager; about 25 live flying insects
summary: No original City of Chicago certified food manager certificate was on site. Only a photocopy was shown. Around 25 small flying insects and 3 large house flies were found. Pest control service is needed. Ice machine had black slime dripping onto ice.

headline: Food handler failed to wash hands before gloves
summary: A food handler did not properly wash hands before putting on gloves and handling food. The handler was corrected and washed at the rear sink. No soap or paper towels were at the front handwash sink, and food handlers were not wearing hair restraints.

headline: Grease buildup on fryer oil filter and cooking equipment
summary: Grease buildup on the oil filtering unit under the deep fryer and on the sides of cooking equipment. A large water leak at the three-compartment sink faucet must be repaired. Dirt and debris are on rear floors.

headline: Ice scoops stored inside ice machine
summary: Two ice scoops were stored inside the ice machine. They must be removed and kept in a clean container. Hand sink lacks signage and drains slowly. Grease is inside fryers and on the hood.

headline: Raw wood needs sealing; small leak at sink
summary: Raw wood in the rear storage area needs sealing. A small leak at the prep handsink P-trap must be corrected.

headline: Leaking drainpipes; repeat greasy floors and fryers
summary: Drainpipes are leaking under the handwashing sink and the three-compartment sink. Repeat violations were not corrected, including grease in fryers and heavy grease, dirt and debris on floors, under equipment and in the walk-in cooler and freezer.

headline: No hand soap at kitchen handwashing sink
summary: The main kitchen handwashing sink had no soap. The rear exit door was not fully rodent-proof and needs a door sweep. Bulk containers lacked labels, and walls, floors and equipment needed cleaning.

headline: Ice machine buildup, leaking dishmachine backflow device
summary: Slight calcium buildup inside the ice machine, and a leaking dishmachine backflow prevention device that must be repaired. Ceiling leaks in restrooms, and a greasy, food-debris-covered ventilation hood. Manager was told to clean and repair.

headline: Handsink broken; new sink installed on site
summary: A handsink next to the three-compartment sink was not working due to a broken faucet. A brand new sink was installed by the end of the inspection. The sanitation manager had no allergen training.

headline: Pests found: flies, rodent droppings, ants
summary: About 125 live flies, about 12 rodent droppings and 10 live ants were found in prep areas. Hand sink hot water reached 146F with no cold water. Staff lacked food handler certificates. Pest control service was ordered.

headline: Small prep cooler at 48.8F
summary: A small prep cooler measured 48.8F, above the required 41F or lower. No citation was issued. It must be brought back into the safe range.

headline: Broken sink stoppers; food debris on walls
summary: Dishwashing three-compartment sink stoppers are not working and must be provided. Food debris was on walls near the mop sink. No food handler training certificates or allergen training certificates were on premises.

headline: Stained cutting boards; excess ice in freezers
summary: Cutting boards had open seams and dark stains and must be refinished or replaced. Freezers had excess debris and ice buildup. Fryers had excessive grease and dirty oil. This was a re-inspection.

headline: Food handlers without hair restraints on serving line
summary: All food handlers on the front serving line were not wearing hair restraints. Rags were not stored in sanitizer, and food containers were unlabeled. Floors, walls and ventilation dust, plus a crate used for food storage, need attention.

headline: Gap under exit door; damaged floors and walls
summary: A stripped cold water faucet handle at the front prep handsink must be repaired. A gap along the office emergency exit door must be made tight-fitting. Damaged flooring in prep and dish areas and an emergency exit wall need repair.

headline: No certified manager; food held at unsafe temperatures
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were served. Steam table food was held at 95.1F to 104.1F, and cold food at 51.1F to 55.6F, with about 30 lbs discarded. Equipment was tagged and floors need cleaning.

headline: Rodent droppings in basement; unlabeled prepped food
summary: About 20 to 50 rodent droppings were found on the basement floor and shelves. Prepped TCS foods were not labeled with discard dates, and food was stored on the walk-in cooler floor. Additional pest control is needed.

headline: No food handler training proof for employees
summary: No proof of food handler training or certificates was provided for required employees. Bulk foods were not labeled, and food preparers needed hair restraints. Chemicals in the washroom must be raised off the floor.

headline: Dead insects on basement floor; greasy fryer
summary: Dead insects were on the floor of the basement storage room and must be cleaned. Wet wiping cloths were on prep tables and must be stored in sanitizer. Grease must be cleaned from the fryer door and the wall behind cooking equipment.

headline: Wiping cloth not stored in sanitizer; dusty fans
summary: A wiping cloth was not stored properly in sanitizer when not in use. Fan covers inside the walk-in cooler had dirt and dust buildup. Floors under and around storage racks and equipment had dirt, food spills and debris.

headline: No handwashing signs at washroom sinks
summary: No handwashing signs were at the sinks in washrooms. The manager was told to add signs at all handwashing sinks used by employees.

headline: No health policy; equipment backflow and wall issues
summary: Passed with conditions. No written employee health policy was on site. Coffee maker, espresso machine and ice machine lack accessible backflow devices. Raw wood, unfinished brickwork, exposed studs, missing vent covers and missing floor tile need repair.

headline: Live roaches, flies and rodent droppings; failed
summary: Failed. Numerous dead roaches were found, and a prior priority violation remains: live roaches and over 40 live small flies were seen, plus over 50 rodent droppings in front counter cabinets. The east prep exit door is not rodent-proof. Pest control service is required.

headline: About 100 rat droppings; citation issued
summary: Failed. About 100 rat droppings were found near the rear exit door and throughout the basement storage area. A citation was issued and additional pest control was recommended. Missing handwashing signs, unlabeled containers, and a leaking 3-compartment sink faucet were also noted.

headline: Unlabeled lard; no pest control logbook
summary: Failed. Unlabeled prepackaged lard was in a sales-floor cooler and must be labeled. No pest control logbook was on the premises, with a citation issued. Also black buildup and debris on coolers, cardboard floor liners, and a non-working prep area light.

headline: Milk crates as shelving; floor debris
summary: Passed. Milk crates were used as shelving in the rear prep area and must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Food debris and spills were found on floors and surfaces throughout, and must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager on site; citation issued
summary: Failed. The person in charge lacked an original Chicago food service sanitation manager certificate, and no certified manager was on site while beef was prepared, with citations issued. Greasy fryers and filters, a non-self-closing toilet door, cluttered storage, and dirty floors were also noted.

headline: No vomit cleanup plan; rodent gap at door
summary: Passed with conditions. No cleanup procedure for vomiting and diarrhea events was found. A gap at the bottom of the rear door must be sealed to prevent rodent entry. Dust, debris, and clutter on floors and shelves need cleaning.

headline: Flies in prep areas; citation issued
summary: Failed. About 30 large and small flies were seen in the front and rear prep areas, and a citation was issued. Also a hole above the mop sink, a greasy and dusty hood, no staff food handler certificates, and no allergen certificate for the person in charge.

headline: Wet wiping cloths left on coolers
summary: Re-inspection passed. Wet wiping cloths were stored on top of prep coolers. The inspector instructed staff to keep wiping cloths in sanitizing solution when not in use.

headline: Broken cooler handle; missing training proof
summary: Re-inspection passed. A reach-in cooler has a broken door handle that must be replaced. No proof of food handler training or allergen training was available for required staff.

headline: Unlabeled foods; grease container not maintained
summary: Passed with conditions. Food items in refrigeration units were unlabeled. Serving plates were not inverted, and a prep cooler gasket is torn. Thick grease surrounded the outside grease container, with a citation issued. Floor drains at the front prep area need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager on site; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food service manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared and served, with a citation. The low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer at final rinse. A food handler with a long beard lacked a restraint, and broken floor tiles need replacement.

headline: No employee health policy; expired allergen certificate
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy was on site, which is a priority violation. The person in charge must provide documentation of the illness reporting duty. A food service manager had an expired food allergen training certificate.

headline: Food on floors; no light in walk-in coolers
summary: Passed. No thermometers were in seafood and meat display coolers. Bulk flour and seasoning were unlabeled, and food and single-service items were stored on floors. Milk crates were used as shelving, and food debris and spills were found throughout. The bakery walk-in cooler and freezer have no light.

headline: No hand soap; rodent-proof dumpster lids needed
summary: Failed. Hand soap was missing at a restroom sink, with a citation issued. Dumpster lids were damaged and must close tightly to prevent rodents. A paper towel dispenser over the 3-compartment sink drainboard was not corrected from a prior visit.

headline: Dusty washroom fans
summary: Passed. Dust was found on the ventilation fans on the washroom ceilings. The inspector instructed staff to clean them.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; dirty dairy cooler racks
summary: Passed. Bulk flour, sugar and similar containers were unlabeled and must be labeled. Racks in the dairy walk-in cooler were dirty and must be cleaned. No backflow prevention device was found at the drip coffee machine.

headline: Mouse droppings; greasy kitchen; citations
summary: Failed. Prior priority violations were not corrected, including greasy cooking equipment and kitchen floors and walls, with a citation issued. No certified manager with allergen certificates was on site. Missing handwashing signage, no backflow device on the ice machine, and a dirty garbage enclosure were also noted.

headline: Unlabeled container; leaking faucet; dirty floors
summary: Passed. A bulk storage container in the kitchen was unlabeled and its exterior needs cleaning. A leak at the one-compartment sink faucet must be repaired. Floors under basement shelves and under the fryers need cleaning, and the vent above the high-temperature dish machine needs cleaning.

headline: Inadequate lighting in walk-in cooler
summary: Passed. The walk-in cooler near the desk in the rear storage area has inadequate lighting. The manager was instructed to add lighting and maintain it.

headline: No sushi rice documentation; greasy kitchen
summary: Failed. No sushi rice analysis letter or pH test kit was on site, with a citation issued. Greasy cooking equipment and walls, a leaking sprayer, and exposed foam caulk were noted. Floors behind cooking equipment were not clean, a repeat core violation.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink faucet and pipe
summary: Re-inspection passed. The three-compartment sink faucets and the pipe underneath are leaking and must be repaired.

headline: Clean linens stored on toilet room floor
summary: Passed. Clean linens in packaging were stored on the floor of the employee toilet room. Staff were told to move them at least 6 inches off the floor and keep items out of restrooms.

headline: Flies and roach activity; no valid certificate
summary: Failed. About 25 small flies were seen near the utility sink, 3-compartment sink, staff restroom and dry storage, plus one live roach, with a citation issued. No valid food sanitation certificate was provided. Torn gaskets, a leaking toilet, damaged floors and a hole in a restroom wall were also noted.

headline: Mouse droppings; no certified manager; citations
summary: Failed. Over 30 mouse droppings were found behind soda dispensers in the prep area, and 20 were found in the office, with a citation issued. No certified manager was on site while chicken was prepared and served. No allergen training was available.

headline: Dead insects and spiders; no dumpster
summary: Failed. About 10 dead small flying insects and spiders were found along walls in dishwashing, food prep and dining areas. No outside dumpster was available, and no proof of food handler training was provided for staff.

headline: Single-use cups used as scoops; poor lighting
summary: Passed. Single-use cups were used as scoops in dry food storage and must be replaced with proper utensils. Soap and paper towels were at the utility sink, which must be used only at handwashing sinks. Front kitchen lighting is insufficient and light fixtures are in poor repair.

headline: Standing water in dish area; clean walls
summary: Re-inspection passed. Floor tiles in the dishwashing area must be regrouted to remove standing water. The walls, floor and floor drain behind the bar need cleaning.

headline: Mouse droppings and live roach; multiple citations
summary: Failed. Inspector found about 80 or more mouse droppings and 1 live roach, with citations issued. Also no certified manager on site, no probe thermometer, noodles stored outdoors (moved inside on site), and water-stained ceiling tiles.

headline: No health policy; missing dumpster lid
summary: Failed. No written employee health policy was on site, which is a priority violation. The bathroom door is not self-closing. A garbage corral receptacle is missing its lid, which is a priority violation.

headline: Cold food too warm; cooler tagged out
summary: Passed with conditions. Chicken at 48.1F and meatballs at 47.5F were held too warm, and 4 lbs were discarded. A kitchen cold-hold unit at 50.1F was tagged and must not be used until reinspected. A broken backflow device at the mop sink needs repair.

headline: Damaged ceiling panels; food debris under equipment
summary: Passed. Cardboard liners were used on shelves and must be removed. Several damaged ceiling panels need repair. Food debris was found under and behind cooking equipment, and a light shield above the three-compartment sink is missing.

headline: Gaps at entry and dock doors; sink leaks
summary: Passed. Weather stripping is missing at the front entrance door, and an opening at the rear dock platform is a possible pest entry point. Leaks were found at the three-compartment sink in the produce prep room and must be repaired.

headline: Cold food too warm; cooler tagged; flies
summary: Failed. Tilapia, tomatoes and chicken in the prep cooler were held at 49.8-52.1F and discarded, about 10 lbs. A deli prep cooler at 49.0F was tagged and not to be used. Bulk containers were unlabeled, and gaskets and hood filters were dirty.

headline: Unlabeled salt; dirty slicer and scoop holder
summary: Passed. Salt was not labeled and must be. The meat slicer was not clean behind the blade and had food debris. The ice scoop holder was dirty, with standing gray water at its base.

headline: Sanitizer missing; food too warm; citation issued
summary: Passed with conditions. The low-temperature dish machine had no sanitizer during use, but was repaired on site. Cooked chicken at 115F and other cold foods were discarded, about 50 lbs. A side door gap must be sealed. Hair restraints, wiping cloths, and rusty shelving were also noted.

headline: Grooved cutting boards; holes in basement walls
summary: Passed. Cutting boards on a prep cooler are discolored and grooved and must be repaired or replaced. Items in the basement storage area must be elevated, and holes in the basement dry storage wall must be repaired. Some food managers lack allergen training.

headline: Small leak at 3-compartment sink
summary: Re-inspection passed. A small leak near the drainpipe at the three-compartment sink was found. The manager was instructed to repair it.

headline: Cold food discarded; walk-in cooler at 51F
summary: Passed with conditions. Walk-in cooler measured 51F and was tagged until reinspected. Raw shrimp, noodles, beef, eggs and sprouts were held too warm and about $1,200 of food was discarded. Dirty floors, walls and hood, and a leaking 3-compartment sink faucet also need attention.

headline: Cold food unsafe; flies; food discarded
summary: Failed. Many cold foods were held at 47-74F, above the 41F limit, and a walk-in cooler was at 63F. Manager voluntarily discarded about 250 lbs of food worth $1,000 and the walk-in was tagged. About 30 small flies were also seen.

headline: Unapproved home-made desserts; cold food too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. About 35 unlabeled home-prepared desserts from an unapproved source were discarded, with a citation. Shrimp and rice in cold storage were at 45.7-47.8F, and 64 lbs were discarded. Employee food was kept in food areas, and managers lack allergen proof.

headline: No certified manager while eggs and sausage prepared
summary: Passed with conditions. No City of Chicago certified food manager was on premises while TCS foods such as eggs and sausage were prepared. This is a priority violation, and a certified manager must be present during preparation.

headline: Manager's allergen certificate expired
summary: Re-inspection passed. The certified food manager had an expired food allergen training certificate. The manager was instructed to meet the allergen requirement.

headline: Missing door closer; dusty basement floors
summary: Passed. The basement employee restroom has no self-closing door device and must have one. Dust and debris were found under and around equipment along basement walls and must be cleaned.

headline: No handwashing signs in employee washrooms
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs or posters were missing near the handwashing sinks in the employee washrooms. They must be provided and maintained.

headline: About 20 mouse droppings; citation issued
summary: Failed. About 20 mouse droppings were found under the three-compartment sink and along the wall near the rear exit door. Management was told to remove them and sanitize, with a citation issued.

headline: Gaps at doors; cold water too cool
summary: Re-inspection passed. Openings at the base of several doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Men's washroom handwashing sinks measured 90.9F and 93.9F and must reach at least 100F. Debris near dumpsters needs cleaning.

headline: Food debris on equipment; no toilet room ventilation
summary: Re-inspection passed. Heavy equipment, prep tables and fryer bins in the front prep area had dried food debris and sauce splatter and must be cleaned. A utility sink in the toilet room is in disrepair. The toilet room has no ventilation and must be provided with working ventilation.

headline: Dishwasher leaking and tagged out
summary: Passed with conditions. The high-temperature dishwasher leaks and was tagged 'held for inspection' and must not be used until repaired. Also no signed employee health policy, stained cutting boards, one food handler without a certificate, and a manager without allergen training.

headline: Dish machine gauges read low; flies; corrections made
summary: Passed with conditions. Two issues were corrected on site: a pan was removed from a handwashing sink and paper towels were provided. The high-temperature dish machine gauges read 100F, and it was tagged held. Openings near doors must be sealed to prevent pests.

headline: No hot water at prep sink; sanitizer failing
summary: Failed. The main prep handwashing sink had no hot water; it measured 84.5-90F, below the required 100F. The low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged out. Other items included unlabeled containers, a leak, and a broken washroom door closer.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; missing thermometers
summary: Passed. Some coolers have no thermometers. Dirt and food buildup is behind the dish machine, and the basement floor is cluttered. Food handler certificates have expired, and no food allergen certificates were on the premises.

headline: Small door opening; no allergen certificate
summary: Re-inspection passed. The front entrance door has a small opening on its lower left side and must be rodent-proofed. A food handler lacked a hair restraint in the prep area. The food manager has no allergen training certificate.

headline: Ice buildup; stained cutting boards; grease
summary: Passed. Ice buildup at the freezer condenser and door must be repaired. A cutting board is on a sink backsplash. Cutting boards are stained, milk crates are used for storage, and gaskets are broken. Cooking equipment needs grease removed and detail cleaning.

headline: Dead insects on glue board removed
summary: Passed. A glue board holding dead insects was found in the rear prep area and must be removed. Also storage shelves, washroom bowls and basement floors need cleaning.

headline: Food stored in grocery bags; trash outside
summary: Passed. Food was stored in grocery bags in the walk-in cooler and chest freezer, and food-grade storage containers are required. Trash had accumulated around the outside receptacles and must be removed.

headline: No valid certificate posted; rust and clutter
summary: Passed with conditions. The person in charge had no valid Chicago food sanitation certificate, and no valid certificate was posted, with a citation issued. Rust on a grease trap must be sealed or painted. Vent covers need cleaning, and unnecessary items must be removed from the basement.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; spills under bar
summary: Passed. Spillage and straws were found on the floor under the bar and must be cleaned. A few food handler certificates were expired. The new food service manager has no allergen training certificate.

headline: No certified manager; discarded food; citations
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on site while au jus was prepared, and au jus at 85.6F was discarded. No employee health policy was verifiable. Floor drain backs up and floods the prep area when the 3-compartment sink drains. Repeat violations for expired food handler and allergen certificates.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; buildup
summary: Passed. Pink buildup was found at the ice machine chute and must be cleaned. Food debris was found in a shelf under the cook line, and dust is on ceiling tiles near vents. Some food handler certificates have expired.

headline: Items stored under unshielded sewer lines
summary: Passed. Pots, food service items and single-service items were stored beneath unshielded sewer and wastewater lines and must be shielded or moved. Items were stored on the floor, a cutting board is cracked, and a bathroom fan is not working.

headline: Live roaches and rodent droppings; failed
summary: Failed. About 30-40 live roaches were found in the stove, dishwashing area, inside aluminum pans and on shelving. Rodent droppings were found in walk-in cooler corners and by the register. Pest control service and proof of service are required before re-inspection.

headline: Manager's allergen certificate expired
summary: Re-inspection passed. One food manager had an expired food allergen training certificate. All certified managers must maintain a valid allergen training certificate.

headline: Scoops stored in food; dirty cooler and floors
summary: Passed. Scoops were stored with handles under food in fruit containers and must be stored with handles above the food. Water and food debris were found inside a cooler, dust was on freezer condensers, and dry food debris was on the floor under shelves.

headline: Milk crates as shelving; damaged floor; holes in wall
summary: Passed. Milk crates were used as walk-in cooler shelving and must be replaced. Also noted a damaged walk-in floor, dust and debris throughout, and multiple holes in the basement wall that must be sealed to prevent pest entry.

headline: Worn door seal; broken sink handle; no allergen training
summary: Passed. Weather stripping at the rear exit door is worn and must be replaced to prevent pest entry. TCS foods were stored in grocery bags. A women's washroom sink handle is broken. The certified manager has no allergen training.

headline: Missing backflow device; washroom fan not working
summary: Re-inspection passed. Inspector found no backflow device on the utility sink and a washroom ventilation fan that was not operable. Manager was told to fix both.

headline: Soda crates as shelving; dirty coolers and restrooms
summary: Re-inspection passed. Soda crates were used as shelving and must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Cooler interiors, restrooms and areas under the beverage station and dining room need cleaning. Ventilation vents were dusty.

headline: No trash removal contract; equipment stored outside
summary: Failed. No verifiable trash removal contract was on site. Refrigeration units had dried food debris inside. Cooling units, freezers, kegs and furniture were stored on the back porch and backyard, and must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: No customer barrier at counter; citation; leaks
summary: Failed. The front counter prep area has no protective barrier from customers and must install a sneeze guard, which is a priority violation. Cutting boards have open seams and stains. Drainpipes under sinks leak, and a customer restroom toilet leaks onto the floor.

headline: Missing splash guard; food handler certificates lacking
summary: Passed. Inspector required a splash guard between a handwashing sink and the hot food prep area, and removal of milk crates used as shelving. Only 1 food handler certificate was seen for 14 employees.

headline: Frozen food thawed at room temperature
summary: Re-inspection passed. A tray of frozen beef shish kabobs was thawing at room temperature on a prep table. Management was told to thaw all TCS foods properly. Walls, floors, equipment and dry storage containers need detail cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled flour; no allergen training for manager
summary: Passed with conditions. Flour was not labeled and must be. Insulation around a walk-in cooling line was in poor repair. The high-temperature dish machine lacked heat strips and a thermometer. The food manager had no allergen training.

headline: Dead insects in cabinets; spray foam; dirty walls
summary: Passed. Dead insects were found inside rear prep room wooden cabinets and must be removed. Other items include unlabeled bulk foods, items not elevated off floors, dirty walls and shelving, and water-damaged or splattered ceiling tiles that must be replaced.

headline: No certified manager on site; citations issued
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager was on site while Italian beef and ground beef were prepared and served. An employee ate on a prep table. Ground beef was stored on the walk-in floor. Soiled wiping cloths, a leaking sink, and missing fan and light covers were also noted.

headline: Leaks, torn gasket, and sealing needed
summary: Passed. A cutting board with deep seams must be replaced, and a freezer gasket is torn. Leaks were found under a hand sink, and a women's restroom faucet is loose. Holes in the kitchen walls and baseboards must be sealed to prevent pest harborage. One food handler's proof of training had expired.

headline: Loose splashguard; dusty vent
summary: Passed. A loose splashguard at an exposed handwashing sink in the butcher room must be repaired or replaced. Dust was found on a vent in the second-floor dish area.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. The certified manager on duty had no allergen training. The manager was instructed to obtain it and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Cutting board on sink backsplash; corrected
summary: Passed. A clean cutting board was stored on the backsplash of the three-compartment sink, which is not allowed. The manager removed it during the inspection, correcting the issue on site.

headline: Sink lacks splash guard; ice scoop misuse
summary: Passed. A handwashing sink next to a food prep sink lacks a splash guard. An ice scoop was stored with its handle in the ice and must be moved to a clean surface. Raw wood cashier shelves and base coving must be sealed or replaced.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; door gap; dusty fans
summary: Passed. Bulk containers in the rear kitchen were unlabeled. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the south entrance door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Wiping cloths were not in sanitizer, and cutting boards are stained. Dust and clutter also need cleaning.

headline: Clutter around sushi containers
summary: Passed. Sushi food containers were stored in a cluttered rear storage room. The area must be cleaned, organized and maintained.

headline: Raw eggs above ready-to-eat food; sewage backup
summary: Failed. Raw eggs were stored above cooked food in a basement walk-in, with a citation issued. Sewage backed up from a floor drain when the 3-compartment sink drained, with a citation. Also no paper towels or soap at some sinks, and employees lacked hair restraints.

headline: Food held too warm; cooler at 58F; citation
summary: Passed with conditions. Chicken wings and several other cold TCS foods were held at 46-54F, above the 41F limit, with about 40 lbs of food valued at $300 involved. A prep cooler measured 58F, with a citation issued. Two fly strips were hanging over the dish area and must be removed.

headline: Milk crates as shelving; dirty floors
summary: Passed. Milk crates were used as shelving throughout prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Loose debris, dirt and dust were found on floors and corners throughout the facility.

headline: Slow-draining sink; missing backflow device
summary: Re-inspection passed. Rusted storage racks must be cleaned or replaced. The 3-compartment sink drains slowly, and the mop sink faucet has no backflow device. Handwashing sinks lack waste receptacles, and a grease trap lid has a hole.

headline: Buildup in cabinets and cooler lid
summary: Passed. Build-up was found on the bottom shelves of wooden cabinets in the front prep area. Heavy seed and debris had collected behind the lid of the prep cooler on the east wall. The inspector instructed detail cleaning.

headline: No drainboard; missing sink stoppers
summary: Passed. The 3-compartment sink has no drainboard for air-drying dishes; management agreed to install one. The premises had only one drain stopper for the three-compartment sink and must provide two more.

headline: No certified person in charge; leaks; dirt
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge with a valid certificate was on premises, with a citation issued. Missing soap at a washroom sink was corrected on site. Leaks were found at two sinks, and floors and shelves in basement areas need cleaning.

headline: Milk crates as shelving; greasy hood
summary: Re-inspection passed. Milk crates were used as shelving in the walk-in cooler, rear storage and front prep area and must be replaced with proper shelving. Grease and dust on the ventilation hood and filters must be cleaned.

headline: Bulk items in washroom; greasy kitchen
summary: Passed. Bulk shortening and single-service containers were stored in the employee washroom and must be removed. Bulk containers were unlabeled, and fly strips hung in the dish area. Grease and debris were found on equipment, walls and floors, and a certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Dishes washed without sanitizer; food too warm
summary: Failed. Dishes were washed without a sanitizer setup, and no chemical sanitizer was on site. Empanadas in hot holding were at 119-130F, below 135F, and 15 lbs were discarded. Rice at 44.6F was also discarded. Pest control records were incomplete.

headline: No certified manager with allergen training
summary: Re-inspection passed. No certified food manager with food allergen training was on site. The manager was instructed to comply with the requirements.

headline: Hair restraints missing; ice buildup in freezers
summary: Passed. Employees were not wearing hair restraints during food preparation and service. Excess ice must be removed from basement chest freezers, and water-damaged ceiling tiles in the rear food storage area need repair or replacement.

headline: Hair restraints missing; greasy fryers and racks
summary: Passed. Male employees were not wearing hair or beard restraints in the prep area. Greasy fryer interiors, dirty storage racks, and a women's restroom trash can without a lid were noted. Dirt and dust were found under equipment and on a vent.

headline: Leaking sink faucet; soot-like buildup on ceiling
summary: Passed. Hose at the wash sink must be shortened so it does not pass the sink's fill line. A leak at the rear 3-compartment sink faucet must be fixed. Soot-like dirt was found on walls and ceiling tiles, and a floor drain was stained.

headline: Live flies; no pest log; vomit kit missing; citations
summary: Failed. About 40-50 live small flies were seen under a handwash sink and near garbage containers at the bar, and more pest control is needed. No vomit cleanup procedure or kit, and no complete pest control logbook. A slimy substance was found in the ice machine, with a citation issued.

headline: Walk-in cooler at 68.5F; failed
summary: Failed. Walk-in coolers were at 68.5F, and they must hold 41F or below at all times. Restroom doors are not self-closing, and hood light bulbs are missing.

headline: Low water pressure; clutter in basement
summary: Passed. Low water pressure was noted at the hot water faucet of the kitchen handwashing sink. Vents in the kitchen prep area are dirty and dusty. Clutter in the basement dry storage area must be removed to prevent hiding places for pests.

headline: Wiping cloths not in sanitizer; leaks
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. A worn cutting board needs replacing, and cooler interiors need cleaning. Leaks were found at the three-compartment sink faucet and rear hand sink, and walls and floors need detail cleaning.

headline: Pass; floor and corner buildup to clean
summary: Canvass re-inspection pass. Buildup on floors, wall bases, and closet corners near the utility sink. Manager instructed to clean these areas.

headline: Pass; dust on vent corrected on site
summary: Complaint pass. Dust on the ceiling vent in the dry storage room. Dust was removed on site.

headline: Pass; manager lacks allergen training proof
summary: Canvass re-inspection pass. A City of Chicago food service manager on site had no proof of allergen training. Manager instructed to provide proof for all certified food service managers.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; hot food too cool
summary: Fail. No certified food manager on site at start; arrived more than 25 minutes later; citation issued. Hot TCS foods held at 118-127°F, below 135°F; about 25 lbs discarded (about $80). Ice machine had black slime; citation issued. Freezer food held at 41°F.

headline: Failed: 75-100 rat droppings; raw food over produce
summary: Fail. About 75-100 rat droppings in basement storage, prep, and behind bar; pest control service needed; citation issued. Raw shrimp and scallops stored above ready-to-eat produce; all removed. Dish room handsink blocked and lacked soap; no paper towels at two sinks.

headline: Pass; rice covered while cooling; no thermometers
summary: Pass. Large container of rice in walk-in cooler stored covered while cooling; must be uncovered or loosely covered. No thermometers in two sauce coolers. Base coving missing or in poor repair in rear prep area. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Pass; mop sink needs backflow device
summary: Pass. No backflow preventer on mop sink. Manager instructed to install one in a location where it can be found, serviced, and maintained.

headline: Pass; missing signs and trash lid
summary: Complaint re-inspection pass. Handwashing signage missing at sinks. No covered trash receptacle in female restroom. Splatters on wall in pizza prep station need cleaning.

headline: Hot and cold foods out of temperature; discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Chicken and pasta held at 110-115°F in hot holding unit; about 1 lb discarded ($50). Eggs, sausage, and liver held at 47-54°F in reach-in cooler; about 10 lbs discarded ($80). Citation issued; minimum cold holding is 41°F.

headline: Failed: no thermometer; hair restraints; unlabeled food
summary: Fail. Employees not wearing hair restraints during food prep and service. Prepackaged prepared foods lack product name, ingredients, and business details. Ice scoops stored inside ice machine; items stored on basement floor; no thermometer in upright cooler; no handwashing signs.

headline: Pass; rear door gap and food residue
summary: Pass. Gap along left side and bottom of rear exit door could let pests in; must be made tight-fitting. Ice scoop stored with handle in ice; to-go containers stored facing up; food residue in cooler gaskets; dirty floors.

headline: Pass; dirty ice machine; food stored on floor
summary: Pass. Ice machine bin and guard have dirt. Boxed food stored on floor in walk-in cooler and freezer must be raised six inches. Cardboard used as prep table liner must be removed. Damaged baseboards and food debris also noted.

headline: Pass; wiping cloth storage and cleaning needed
summary: Complaint pass. Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizing solution at all times. Multi-use utensils not stored properly on shelves. Gaskets, cooking equipment, and reach-in coolers need detail cleaning. Employees need food handler certificates.

headline: Pass; mold on ice machines; ice destroyed
summary: Pass. Moldlike substance found on shields of both basement ice machines. Manager instructed to destroy the ice, then clean and sanitize interiors to prevent contamination.

headline: Pass; rear door needs rodent-proofing
summary: Pass. Rear exit door is not rodent-proofed at sides and bottom; manager instructed to fix it. Opening along wall by the rear door must be sealed. No pests were observed.

headline: Failed: about 30 rodent droppings; no pest log
summary: Fail. About 30 rodent droppings found in rear mechanical equipment and beverage storage areas; priority citation issued. No licensed pest control agreement or logbook on site. Cups stored on floor; handsink seal needs repair.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; about 80 flies
summary: Fail. No certified food manager on premises; citation issued. About 80 small flies in prep, storage, and dish areas; more pest control needed. Handwash water 61.7-69.1°F, below the required 100°F. Dish machine rinse 126°F, below 165°F. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Failed: no hot water; missing shellstock tags
summary: Fail. Bottom-floor women's restroom had no hot water; maximum 77°F, below 100°F; citation issued. No handsink near main dish machine; must install. Only one month of shellstock tags on site, not 90 days. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Pass; cooler lacks thermometer; food on floor
summary: Pass. No thermometer in one-door milk cooler behind coffee counter. Food stored on floor inside dairy cooler must be elevated. Grease buildup in fry area; dirty floor drains and dust buildup; water-damaged ceiling tiles above cutting tables.

headline: Pass; yellow slime in ice machine
summary: Pass. Slight buildup of yellow slime inside ice machine in rear prep area. Manager instructed to detail clean and maintain the machine in good condition.

headline: Pass; several areas need cleaning
summary: Pass. Rust at basement ice machine opening; grease and debris inside fryer openings; dirt on sides of equipment; dirt under beer cooler shelving; large wooden boards by walk-in cooler to remove. Floors and drains need cleaning.

headline: Oysters lacked tags; no hot water in areas
summary: Pass with conditions. Oysters found without required tags; manager voluntarily discarded 14 lbs ($82). No hot running water in deli prep and bakery; sink temperatures of 48.3-87.1°F were too low. Plumbing called on site.

headline: Pass; unlabeled bulk food; floor storage
summary: Pass. Bulk food in basement prep and storage lacked labels. Food containers stored on floor in several areas must be raised six inches. Large mixing bowls and pots don't fit three-compartment sink; need a washing procedure or removal.

headline: Pass; rusty prep table; certificate needed
summary: Complaint re-inspection pass. Rusty prep table base in kitchen cannot be cleaned; must be smooth, cleanable, and non-absorbent. An additional food handler training certificate is required on site.

headline: Pass; dusty washroom vents to clean
summary: Pass. Dust buildup on ceiling ventilation vents inside washrooms. Manager must clean and maintain the vents.

headline: Pass; greasy kitchen; loose cooler gaskets
summary: Pass. Loose and damaged gaskets on cold holding units. Extensive food debris and grease on tables, shelves, and fryers; grime on cooler doors. Rust on bottoms of prep tables. Restroom trash can lid broken.

headline: Failed: no backflow devices on ice machine, mop sink
summary: Fail. Prior core violation not corrected: no backflow prevention devices at ice machine or mop sink. Devices must be installed where they can be serviced. Priority citation issued.

headline: Cold food too warm; pizza cooler tagged
summary: Pass with conditions. Ham at 51.8°F, pork at 52.3°F, and grilled peppers at 51.0°F in prep cooler; foods discarded; citation issued. Pizza prep cooler at 52°F tagged and may not be used. No food handler certificates; no allergen training.

headline: Failed: three-compartment sink backs up
summary: Fail. Three-compartment sink backs up when water drains from it; priority citation issued. Floor drains throughout the facility have residue buildup. Manager instructed to repair the sink and clean the drains.

headline: Pass; broken deli cooler thermometer
summary: Pass. Broken thermometer in front deli cooler where cheese and salmon are kept; working thermometer required. Flour residue under prep tables and grime in prep area corners to clean.

headline: Pass; shelving, self-closing doors, cleaning needed
summary: Pass. Walk-in freezer needs proper shelving; pallets used in place of shelves. Washroom doors need self-closing devices. Floors, walls, vents, and fryers need cleaning. Water-stained washroom ceiling tile to replace.

headline: Failed: unsafe thawing; prior violations uncorrected
summary: Fail. Frozen seafood thawed in prep sink without cold running water; priority citation issued. Plastic pallets and crates used for storage; cardboard lining; excessive ice in basement walk-in. Prior core violation (mineral buildup in bar ice machine) not corrected.

headline: Pass; floor debris and vent dust
summary: Pass. Debris on floors along walls and corners in prep and storage areas. Dust in walk-in cooler vents in deli and bakery. Manager instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Failed: no soap; no dumpster contract
summary: Fail. Employee restroom handsink had no soap and toilet had no tissue; priority items, no citation. No commercial dumpster contract found. Spider webs in ceilings noted. Water-damaged, peeling wall in employee toilet needs repainting.

headline: Blocked handsink cleared; cold food too warm
summary: Pass with conditions. Garbage can blocking kitchen handsink removed on site. Cold foods at 45.5-48.6°F, including milk and sliced mango, were discarded (about 10 lbs, $50). Service cooler at 45°F must not be used until it reaches 41°F or below.

headline: Pass; no mop sink; slow bar sink drain
summary: Canvass re-inspection pass. Exposed front bar handsink drains slowly and must be repaired. No service or mop sink on premises; one must be installed.

headline: Failed: prior violations uncorrected; uncertified staff
summary: Fail. Violations from earlier reports remain uncorrected: warped dish-area floors, water-stained ceiling tiles, dirt buildup, and clutter in rear. Food handlers lacked required certificates; priority citation issued.

headline: Pass; food handler training expired or missing
summary: Canvass re-inspection pass. Expired or missing food handler training for employees; must provide and keep records. Cups stored inside bulk food containers. Chest freezers with ice buildup and ajar lids. Grease, debris, and water under equipment.

headline: Pass; worn cutting board to replace
summary: Pass. Cutting board with deep seams on top of prep cooler in front prep and service area must be refinished or replaced.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings; no employee health policy
summary: Fail. About 7 large rodent droppings on floor and atop hot water tank in rear storage; pest activity must be eliminated; priority citation issued. No signed employee health policies. Missing cooler thermometers. Prior core violations uncorrected.

headline: Pass; leak, mold-like caulking, floor damage
summary: Pass. Leak in rear dish area with black mold-like substance on caulking must be repaired. Food debris on floors behind cooking equipment. Damaged floor tiles near dishwasher must be repaired. Wood board covering a wall hole must be removed and wall repaired.

headline: Failed: 30+ rat droppings and dead rat
summary: Fail. Over 30 rat droppings along wall bases in rear dry storage and a dead rat under chips and jerky pallet at display area. Premises must be treated by pest control company; citation issued. Damaged wall at rear meat area entry must be sealed.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; no health policy
summary: Fail. No certified food manager on site while TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. No verifiable employee health policy on site. Prep handsink clogged and disconnected; no 100°F hot water. Frozen meat thawed in prep area; no pest control logbook.

headline: Pass; soap and towels fixed on site
summary: Pass with conditions. Paper towels and soap missing at handwash sinks; both corrected on site. Soap dispensers mounted above food and equipment must move. Single-use cups stored in restroom. Stained or missing ceiling tiles and non-working dry storage light.

headline: Failed: no handwashing between dirty and clean dishes
summary: Fail. Dishwasher handled dirty dishes with bare hands, then unloaded clean dishes without washing hands; priority citation issued. Frozen turkey burgers thawed on cooks line rack at 25.1°F. No food handler training proof; several prior core violations uncorrected.

headline: Failed: 10-15 house flies; unlabeled birria
summary: Fail. About 10-15 house flies seen throughout kitchen and common area; pest control contact required. Birria meat container unlabeled. Wiping cloths stored under prep table; greasy prep table; cardboard on floor. Person in charge lacks allergen training.

headline: Pass; no food handler certificates for prep staff
summary: Pass. Handwashing signage needed at dish area sink. Leaking pipe under dish area handsink must be repaired. Wet mop stored on floor; must hang to dry. Prep employees lacked food handler certificates; must provide and keep on site.

headline: Pass; coolers need detail cleaning
summary: Pass. Reach-in coolers and freezers had excessive food debris; manager instructed to detail clean and maintain. All food service managers must hold allergen training certification.

headline: Pass; handwash signs and allergen training missing
summary: License re-inspection pass. No handwashing signage at front and rear prep handsinks. No allergen training certificate on site at time of inspection; person in charge instructed to provide one.

headline: Pass; missing thermometer and handwashing sign
summary: Pass. No handwashing sign at prep sink and no thermometer in reach-in cooler. Entrance strip damaged, which could allow pests; foil on pipes must be removed. Grease and dirt buildup on equipment and hood filters to clean.

headline: Pass; signage, gaskets, and cleaning needed
summary: Complaint pass. Handwashing signs missing; kitchenware stored improperly; handsink by dish rack needs a barrier; cooler gaskets in disrepair. Outside grease bin and surrounding trash need cleaning to prevent pests. Basement floor junctures and floor need cleaning.

headline: No employee health policy on site
summary: Pass with conditions. No employee health policy or training found on site; priority violation. Also condenser dripping inside reach-in cooler, debris around grease trap, unshielded light bulbs over prep tables, and no allergen training certificates.

headline: Failed: about 40 flies; smoking inside
summary: Fail. About 40 small flies near donut display case and handwash sink; pest control needed; citation issued. Staff smoking inside, with ashes in employee handwash sink; citation issued. Prior violations uncorrected: rear door gap, hair restraints, dirty light shields.

headline: Pass with conditions; missing health policy, kit
summary: Pass with conditions. No employee health policy and no vomiting or diarrhea response plan or kit found; both priority items. Thermometers missing in coolers; rear exit door needs rodent-proofing. Also ceiling tiles, pipe holes, and backflow device.

headline: Pass; serving plates need inverting
summary: Pass. Serving plates on kitchen prep shelves were not stored properly. Manager instructed to invert all serving plates to prevent dust buildup.

headline: Failed: 15 flies; out-of-temp foods discarded
summary: Fail. About 15 small flies near dish machine and second-floor bar; pest control needed; citation issued. Dish machines at 0 ppm chlorine, fixed to 50 ppm on site. Cold foods out of temperature discarded. Vacuum-packed meat without required variance discarded.

headline: Pass; missing handwash signs; loose rear door
summary: Pass. No handwashing signage at front and rear prep sinks. Space around rear exterior door must be closed with tight-fitting sides. Gasket buildup on deli cooler; litter and debris behind furnace and shelving.

headline: Pass; gaps under doors; handsinks broken
summary: Complaint pass. Openings at base of both entrance door sets must be sealed to prevent pests. Handsinks in women's and men's washrooms not working; other sinks work. Missing lid on covered receptacle in accessible stall.

headline: Food held 50-69°F; 116 lbs discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Chicken, hot dogs, cheese, and other TCS foods held at 50.0-68.9°F in prep and pizza coolers. Manager voluntarily discarded 116 lbs ($300). Both coolers were tagged by the Chicago Department of Public Health and must be repaired.

headline: Pass; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Pass. Ice bin interior needs cleaning. Milk crates used as shelving in prep and storage areas must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Grease buildup on cooking equipment, walls, and shelves to be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager on site while chicken served
summary: Pass with conditions. No person in charge with valid Chicago sanitation certificate; no certified food sanitation manager on site when chicken was served; citation issued. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Spills and food debris to clean.

headline: No valid certified manager certificate on site
summary: Pass with conditions. No valid City of Chicago food service sanitation certificate on site; priority citation issued. Handwashing signs missing at sinks. Storage room clutter and items on floor. New hire has no food handler certificate.

headline: Pass; prep sink misused; missing basement sink
summary: Pass. Soap and paper towel dispenser were at a food prep sink and must be removed. No splash guard by dipper well and no prep sink in basement prep area. Light shields damaged. No allergen training proof for certified employees.

headline: Pass; door gaps and damaged display glass
summary: Pass. Front and rear doors have gaps along bottom that must be closed to prevent insect entry. Damaged plexiglass on ice cream display units must be repaired. Crates used for storage in walk-in cooler and freezer must be replaced with shelving. Debris in dipping wells.

headline: Failed: many prior violations still uncorrected
summary: Fail. Prior core violations from 2024 remain uncorrected, including missing freezer thermometer, unlabeled containers, and items stored on basement floor. Also slow drains, no splash guard, worn cutting boards, and no mop hooks.

headline: Pass; several areas need detail cleaning
summary: Pass. Protective coating still on side of three wok burners. Walk-in cooler floor and walls have food spillage. Prep station side, sink seal, basement floor, and front bar need detail cleaning.

headline: Pass; cloth and mop storage; open ceiling
summary: Pass. Wiping cloths stored improperly on prep surfaces; mop stored improperly in mop sink area. Open ceiling above dish area and storage shelves must be covered or sealed.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings; freezer and coolers not working
summary: Fail. About 25 or more mouse droppings and 6-8 live flies near grill, fryer cabinets, and mop sink; pest control needed. Walk-in freezer and dessert cooler not operable; prep cooler at 65.5°F. No signed employee health policy; no hot-and-cold handsink in dish area.

headline: Pass; utensils not inverted; grooved cutting boards
summary: Pass. Multi-use utensils not inverted during storage; manager instructed to store them handle up. Cutting boards with deep, dark grooves must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Menu wrongly marked undercooked-safe; corrected on site
summary: Pass with conditions. Menu asterisks wrongly flagged dishes like garlic shrimp and baked chicken wings as allowed undercooked. Chef removed the asterisks from the menu by the end of inspection. Priority violation noted.

headline: Pass; ice scoop and hair restraint issues
summary: Pass. Ice scoop stored with handle touching ice in bar ice bucket; manager instructed to fix. Two food handlers in prep area lacked hair restraints; all handlers must wear them while in prep areas.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings; beef reheated improperly
summary: Fail. About 25 mouse droppings found in dry storage, office, and near walk-in cooler; more pest control needed. Beef reheated only to 130°F was placed in hot holding. Handsinks had no hot water; fixed on site, now 102-105°F.

headline: No employee health policy; handwash sink problems
summary: Pass with conditions. No employee health policy on site; priority citation issued. Front handwash sink lacked soap and rear sink lacked hand towels; both corrected on site. A pitcher was removed from rear sink. Caulking, toilet room, and drain need cleaning.

headline: Cooler at 51°F tagged; cold food discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Reach-in prep cooler at 51.2°F was tagged and must be repaired to 41°F or below. Fried egg and sliced tomato too warm in display cooler; 5 lbs discarded ($50). Food handlers lacked hair restraints; wiping cloths stored improperly.

headline: Pass; missing ceiling tile to replace
summary: Pass. One ceiling tile is missing above the prep area. Manager must install an additional tight-fitting ceiling tile.

headline: Dish machine and hot water fixed on site
summary: Pass with conditions. Dish machine not sanitizing and tubes unattached; connected on site, now 50 ppm. Hot water 74-75°F at fixtures; restored to 102.8-113.5°F by end. One of two women's toilet stalls out of service. Prior food handler and allergen violations uncorrected.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; moldy ice machine
