summary: Fail. No certified manager on duty while chicken and fish were served; citation issued. Pink mold-like substance found dripping onto ice in ice machine; ice discarded and bin cleaned. Bulk ingredient bins lack labels.

headline: Old food held 15-30 days; 40 lbs discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Eleven containers of cooked soup, stew, beans, gravy, and meats were stored 15 to 30 days in walk-in cooler. About 40 lbs discarded (valued at $100). Food handler lacked hair restraint; ladle left in room-temperature water.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; dish machine lacks indicators
summary: Fail. Person in charge lacked certified food manager training and certificate; no certified manager present during food service; citation issued. High-temperature dish machine lacked temperature indicators. Also open pepper flake containers at tables and a cooler without thermometer.

headline: Food held over 24 hours; no handler certificates
summary: Pass with conditions. Cooked rice and chicken soup held over 24 hours without discard dates; citation issued. No food handler certificates or allergen training proof on site. Unlabeled rice, flour, and sugar; ice scoop stored on ice.

headline: Passed re-inspection; several repairs still needed
summary: Pass. Residue in ice machine, plastic cups used as dispensers, food debris on equipment, and damaged cooler gaskets noted. Also leaking faucet, slow drains, overloaded prep cooler, and ceiling opening. Manager instructed to fix each.

headline: Pass; mold-like buildup and water pooling
summary: Complaint pass. Handwashing signage needed at second-floor employee sink. Dust and mold-like buildup on deli walk-in cooler shelving. Dust on deli display grates and light shields. Dark water pooling under bakery dish machine.

headline: Failed: about 25 mouse droppings; room-temp thawing
summary: Fail. About 25 mouse droppings on floor beneath wire storage racks next to walk-in freezer; more pest control needed; citation issued. Chili thawed at room temperature. Greasy cooking equipment and openings along wall-floor junction need attention.

headline: Pass; floor storage, freezer ice, dusty vents
summary: Pass. Items stored on basement non-food storage floor must be elevated. Excessive ice buildup in rear chest freezer must be cleaned. Dust in ceiling vents in both washrooms. One certified manager lacks allergen training proof.

headline: Pass; floor storage, rust, and grease
summary: Pass. Boxed food stored on basement dry storage floor must be raised six inches. Cutting boards deeply scratched; rusty walk-in cooler shelves; greasy cooking equipment; dirty floors under equipment and in corners.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; flying insects found
summary: Fail. No certified food manager (CFM) present while beef at 140°F was being prepared and served. About 15 live small flying insects found in dish, prep, and dining areas; more pest control needed. Allergen training proof missing.

headline: Pass; storage elevation and cleaning needed
summary: Canvass re-inspection pass. Items in rear storage must be elevated from floor. Raw wood surfaces need sealing; tinfoil and cardboard liners not allowed. Walls dirty with grease. Waste receptacle needed in employee washroom. Water-damaged ceiling tile and hole in ceiling.

headline: Pass; improper chicken thawing; blood buildup
summary: Pass. Frozen chicken thawed improperly; should be thawed in refrigerator overnight. Shelves under prep tables need cleaning. Animal blood buildup on bottoms of cold holding units. Dusty floors in dry storage and mop closets.

headline: Pass; labels and cooler cleaning; attire fixed
summary: Canvass re-inspection pass. Bulk storage containers must be labeled. Reach-in cooler interiors need detail cleaning. Food handler attire corrected on site. Steamer oven interior must be cleaned.

headline: Pass; grease bin outside needs cleaning
summary: Pass. Outside grease receptacle has grease buildup. Manager instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Pass; cooler lacks thermometer
summary: Pass. Three-door reach-in cooler has no thermometer. Light buildup on cooking equipment and dirt in corners of rear dish prep area also noted; manager instructed to clean.

headline: Pass; food in grocery bags; torn gasket
summary: Pass. Torn gasket on two-door refrigerator in kitchen prep area. Mechanical stopper at three-compartment sink in poor repair. Food items stored inside grocery bags in coolers; must use approved food-grade containers. Floors need cleaning.

headline: No cleanup procedure; no cooler thermometers
summary: Pass with conditions. No vomiting and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure; priority violation. No thermometers in reach-in or standing coolers. Basement waste lines not shielded from leaks. Trash receptacles in both toilet rooms need lids.

headline: Failed: rear handsink won't work properly
summary: Fail. Rear handwash sink could not be turned on properly; repair required; citation issued. Grab-and-go deli sandwiches lack business name and address on labels. Steady water leak in basement pipe; clutter in basement.

headline: No certified manager on site during food prep
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager on site with a posted certificate while TCS foods were prepared and served; priority citation issued. Idle slicers, hot plates, and toaster ovens dirty. No backflow device found at mop sink.

headline: Failed: coolers off while moving; no advisory
summary: Fail. Coolers were not running while the truck was in motion because the generator was off; priority violation. No consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods like steak; citation issued. Truck must show license number on both sides.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; fixed on site
summary: Pass with conditions. Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and was not sanitizing; repaired on site, now 100 ppm. Also uncovered utensils, leaking handwash drain, cold water off at basement prep sink, damaged ceiling.

headline: Pass; no dairy cooler thermometer; leaks
summary: Pass. No thermometer in dairy walk-in cooler; thermometers in basement cooler and freezer not working. Cutting boards with open seams and stains; low hot water pressure in meat room; leaking cooler fan plumbing; no covered waste bin in restroom.

headline: No vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit; citation issued
summary: Pass with conditions. No vomiting and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure on site; priority citation issued. Kit must include norovirus-effective sanitizer. Debris around dumpster. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Pass; dead roaches found; improper thawing
summary: Pass. Dead roaches and spider webs found on fuse box, outlet box, and cloths in rear prep and dish area; must be removed and surfaces sanitized. Raw chicken bones thawed on floor; food stored on floor; no cold-holding thermometers.

headline: Over 50 mouse droppings in furnace room
summary: Over 50 mouse droppings on floor along walls and corners in east furnace room. Manager told to call an exterminator and clean; citation issued. Also a 1/4-inch gap at front door bottom and no backflow device on utility sink.

headline: Not ready: food worker without hair restraint
summary: Not ready. A food handler was preparing food without a hair restraint. Management told that all food handlers must wear a hair restraint while preparing food.

headline: Missing splashguard at utility sink
summary: Re-inspection passed. No splashguard at utility sink. Manager instructed to provide and maintain one.

headline: Dishwasher not sanitizing; told not to use
summary: Low-temperature dishwasher not sanitizing; chlorine measured 0 ppm. Told not to use it until it reaches at least 50 ppm. Manager called maintenance right away; premises was not open for business during inspection. Also freezer ice buildup, wall cracks, and greasy hood.

headline: 90 mouse droppings found; no spill kit
summary: Canvass failed. About 90 mouse droppings on prep kitchen floor along walls; more pest control needed; citation issued. No bodily fluid spill kit or cleanup procedure. Food stored on floor; grease buildup; unlabeled bulk containers.

headline: Dusty fan, greasy floors, missing bulb
summary: Passed. Fan above cook line has heavy dust. Bar and dish area floors have debris; floors along cook line have grease and food buildup. One hood light bulb is missing.

headline: Complaint failed; repeat violations and missing certificates
summary: Complaint inspection failed. Earlier violations from February 2023 were not corrected, including thermometers not placed in coolers, uncovered tableware, and expired certificates. Ice machine drain emptied into a sink; summary report not posted.

headline: 100+ rat droppings found in basement
summary: About 100 or more rat droppings found under cooler platforms, along cooler wall bases, and near an unused cooler in the basement. Must remove droppings and sanitize; pest control recommended. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure; citation issued.

headline: Raw fish too warm; sushi rice unsafe
summary: Failed. Raw salmon, tuna, and yellowtail held at 47–49°F in sushi cooler; cooked sushi rice at 73°F. About 10 lbs ($100) discarded; citation issued. Expired sushi rice lab report; no variance on site.

headline: Torn gaskets; wooden fixtures by dumpster
summary: Passed. Torn gaskets on all doors of three-door refrigerator in deli prep must be repaired. Wooden fixtures and unused items stored by outside dumpster must be removed.

headline: Toilet needs repeated flushing
summary: Passed. Toilet in left-hand restroom does not flush adequately and must be flushed multiple times. Manager instructed to repair it.

headline: Uncovered food and missing handwashing signs
summary: Passed with fixes. Food in prep area stored uncovered; in-use utensils stored inside food containers; milk crates used as shelving; cooking equipment has residue; water-stained ceiling tiles; no handwashing sign at prep sink.

headline: Expired food manager allergen training
summary: Passed. Food manager's allergen training certificate was expired. Must renew it and keep certificates on site.

headline: Mouse droppings and live flies found
summary: About 30 or more mouse droppings in fryer cabinet, shelves, floor, and toilet room, plus about 10 live small flies. Rear door gap and torn screen need repair. No signed employee health policy on file. Pest control recommended.

headline: Re-inspection passed; clutter and light shield
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Unused equipment and unnecessary articles in basement storage must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Bathroom light is missing a light shield.

headline: Dusty condenser fan covers
summary: Passed. Fan covers at walk-in cooler condenser unit had dust buildup. Inspector instructed manager to detail clean and maintain them.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup plan
summary: No written plan or supplies for cleaning up vomit and diarrhea, a priority item. Manager told to provide gloves, face masks, disposable mops, and norovirus-effective sanitizer. Also worn cutting boards, worn caulking, and dishmachine cleaning needed.

headline: Complaint re-inspection failed; repeat violations
summary: Complaint re-inspection failed. Previous violations not corrected: greasy fryer cabinets, grease and dirt on walls and ceilings, and damaged window behind BBQ pit. Also chipping concrete, loose freezer panel, holes in brick walls. Citation issued.

headline: Mouse activity and no health policy
summary: Failed. Mouse activity: about 60 in front prep area and 80 along rear wall and shelves; citation issued. No food manager certificate, employee health policy, or vomit cleanup kit on site. Several plumbing leaks and missing allergen certificate also noted.

headline: Unlabeled food; broken prep table
summary: Passed. Food in coolers and dry storage lacked name labels. Splashguard needed between hand sink and clean dish rack. Broken stainless prep table and broken hood light must be repaired. No certified food manager with allergen training.

headline: Floor drain residue; items on walk-in floor
summary: Passed. Residue built up in kitchen floor drains. Items stored on walk-in cooler floor must be raised six inches. Certified manager on duty lacked proof of allergen training.

headline: Slow mop sink drain; no washroom ventilation
summary: Passed. Mop sink drains slowly and must drain quickly. Washroom has no ventilation; manager must install mechanical ventilation inside the washroom.

headline: Bar dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Bar low-temperature dish machine not sanitizing at final rinse; 0 ppm (parts per million) chlorine on test strips. Priority violation. Spoons kept in standing water at bar; utensils must be stored per code.

headline: Handwashing sink unusable from leak
summary: Failed. Handwashing sink in warewashing area was turned off and inaccessible because a pipe underneath was heavily leaking; citation issued. Ice machine cover missing.

headline: Black slimy ice machine; expired handler cards
summary: Failed. Ice machine interior had black slimy buildup; citation issued. Expired food handler certificates on site. Manager must ensure all food handler certificates are current.

headline: Dusty ceiling vents
summary: Passed. Dust built up in ceiling vents in the dining area and rear prep. Person in charge instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Handsink blocked by cooler; food debris
summary: Handsink was blocked by a cooler; furniture rearranged on site so it is accessible; no citation issued. Plates and kitchenware stored improperly. Upright cooler has spills and debris; basement and sink floors need cleaning.

headline: Certified manager absent; 70+ flies found
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager on premises; citation issued. Over 70 small flies found in customer waiting area, condiment area, prep, and rear dry storage; citation issued. High-temperature dish machine tagged out of use on site until repaired.

headline: Complaint failed; test kit missing, gaps
summary: Complaint failed. Openings at base of dumpster-area doors must be sealed. No quaternary ammonium test kit on premises; citation issued. Packaged foods unlabeled, items stored on floor, and previous violations not corrected.

headline: Rear door gap; expired food handler cards
summary: Passed. Rear exit door not fully rodent-proofed at bottom. Wet wiping cloths left on prep surfaces; grocery bags used for food; expired food handler certificates; managers need allergen training.

headline: Handwashing signs missing at several sinks
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs were missing at rear prep sinks, north employee washrooms, and northwest prep area. Inspector instructed the manager to provide and maintain them.

headline: Dirty rear floors; burnt-out hood light
summary: Passed. Rear food service floor had dirt and debris near walk-in, behind reach-in coolers, and under shelving near staff restroom. Light out under gyro station hood must be replaced.

headline: Soap dispenser and equipment placement issues
summary: Complaint passed. Soap dispenser above a sink drainboard must be moved. Equipment under a wastewater pipe must be relocated. Foil liners and soda crates must be removed. Leaking two-compartment sink faucet must be fixed.

headline: No certified manager; handler proof missing
summary: Re-inspection failed. No certified food manager on site while eggs and milk were being prepared; citation issued. Also a food handler lacked training proof, no pest control logbook, unlabeled packaged bread and pastries, and missing sink stoppers.

headline: Greasy refrigerator; allergen training missing
summary: Passed. Greasy refrigerator side with plastic liner must be cleaned and the liner removed. Food service sanitation manager has no food allergen training certificate; must meet this requirement.

headline: Dead insects by window; cleaning needed
summary: Dead insects found on window ledge behind coolers and must be removed. Milk crates used to elevate stored items must stop. Debris under and behind coolers in rear storage and dish room needs cleaning.

headline: Raw eggs at 68.9°F; unlabeled containers
summary: Raw eggs stored near cooking equipment at 68.9°F; person in charge discarded about 5 lbs; priority violation, citation issued. Unlabeled sugar, flour, salt, and spices. Uncovered food in walk-in; plates not inverted; dusty floors.

headline: Chopping in hallway; no handsink
summary: Failed. Vegetables chopped in customer hallway with no handwashing sink; citation issued. Black buildup inside ice machine; no metal-stem thermometer on site; no written clean-in-place procedure; cold-water knob at basement handsink not working.

headline: Ice machine buildup dripping onto ice
summary: Failed. Ice machine interior had excessive black and brown buildup dripping onto ice for human use; citation issued. Wiping cloths stored on prep tables. No handwashing signs near front bar sinks.

headline: Handwashing sink blocked; food on floor
summary: Only handwashing sink in rear prep was blocked by a seasoning cart; cart was moved on site; citation issued. Two bowls of food found on floor under the three-compartment sink. Employees lacked hair restraints; two male food handlers lacked certificates.

headline: No city food manager certificate posted
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. No City of Chicago food manager certificate posted on site. Manager must keep one on site at all times. Citation issued.

headline: No self-closing toilet room doors
summary: Passed. Toilet room doors lacked self-closing mechanisms. Manager instructed to install and maintain them.

headline: Single-use items on floor; food in grocery bags
summary: Passed with fixes. Single-use articles stored on basement floor must be raised six inches. Tamales stored in grocery bags in hot-holding unit. No splash guard by blender; washroom door not self-closing; overhead pipes not encased; one manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Shellfish without tags; unsafe food discarded
summary: Shellfish found without tags; about 85 lbs ($675) discarded. Several foods that must be kept cold were held at 45–60°F; about 55 lbs ($159) discarded. Prep cooler tagged out until reinspected. Citations issued. Also improper thawing and missing sink stoppers.

headline: Missing kitchen ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. Missing ceiling tile panels in kitchen prep area. Manager instructed to replace missing panels and any stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Mold-like buildup in ice machine
summary: Failed. Black and pink mold-like buildup inside ice machine; ice to be discarded and machine cleaned; citation issued. Also dripping sink pipe, missing floor tiles, and uncorrected items: unlabeled rice, greasy equipment, no covered washroom trash, wall openings.

headline: No person in charge; no certified manager
summary: Pass with conditions. No person in charge present; no citation issued. No City-certified food manager on duty; citation issued. Handsink lacked paper towels; cooler gasket torn; grease on cooler door; heavy ceiling dust; holes in dry storage walls.

headline: Urinal room needs self-closing door
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Urinal room is not enclosed by a tight-fitting, self-closing door. This is needed to control odors and keep flies and insects from moving into bar prep areas.

headline: Cardboard boxes in hallway
summary: Passed. Cardboard boxes in hallway by rear door must be removed.

headline: Floor drain cleaned on site
summary: Passed. Floor drain under the three-compartment sink in the dishwashing area needed cleaning. Corrected on site.

headline: Beard guards and hair restraints needed
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food handler and manager lacked beard guards. Inspector instructed staff to obtain beard guards and effective hair restraints for all food handlers.

headline: Rusty racks; hot water runs when off
summary: Re-inspection passed. Walk-in cooler storage racks have rust and must be cleaned of rust. Hot water at three-compartment sink runs even when turned off; must be fixed.

headline: Warm food in walk-in; 80 lbs discarded
summary: Failed. Food in walk-in held at 46–67.8°F, including eggs, sausage, cheese, milk, and greens; about 80 lbs ($250) discarded. Walk-in air at 53.9°F; tagged and not to be used. Overflowing outside trash receptacles; citation issued.

headline: Expired allergen training certificate
summary: Passed. Expired allergen training certificate on site. Must provide updated allergen training for all certified food managers.

headline: Walk-in at 65°F; no health policy
summary: Failed. Walk-in cooler air at 65°F; must hold 41°F or colder. No employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea procedure, metal-stem thermometer, or sanitizer test kit on site. Wastewater backs up at three-compartment sink.

headline: Rusty grease trap
summary: Passed. Grease trap has rust buildup. Manager instructed to repaint it.

headline: Dead roaches found under equipment
summary: Passed. Dead roaches found under all equipment at the front bar and under the rear three-compartment sink. Manager must remove them.

headline: Leaking faucet; stained and missing ceiling tiles
summary: Re-inspection passed. Utility sink faucet leaks and must be repaired. Missing floor tiles in prep area, stained ceiling tiles, and damaged basement dry-storage ceiling need fixing. Employee lacked allergen training certificate.

headline: Rear cleaning needed
summary: Passed. Rear countertops and storage shelving need spills and debris removed. Floors and floor drain in rear storage and dish area need detail cleaning.

headline: Re-inspection passed; door gap, cleaning needed
summary: Re-inspection passed. Front door gap must be sealed to keep rodents out. Slushy machine needs cleaning, a three-compartment sink P-trap leaks, washroom garbage can needs a lid, and floors need debris removed. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Ice machine dirt; door gap; ice discarded
summary: Failed. Black dirt buildup inside ice machine dripped onto ice; all ice voluntarily discarded; machine must be cleaned by reinspection. Front door gap and ripped cooler gasket need repair. Also missing sink stoppers and expired handler cards.

headline: Rear door gap; grimy handsink
summary: Passed. Gap at bottom of rear exit door must be sealed to keep pests out. Handsink fixtures have grime buildup. Dust and cobwebs in dining room corners and dust on walk-in cooler fans must be cleaned.

headline: Unlabeled pastries lacked allergen info
summary: Failed. Unlabeled pastries in display cases lacked allergen information; citation issued. Ice machine grime in seams must be cleaned. Staff mini-fridge had excessive ice buildup and must be defrosted.

headline: Missing signs; food on walk-in floor
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs missing near front prep sink. Bulk containers unlabeled; food stored on walk-in floor must be raised six inches. Rusty prep table bottom must be repainted. Water-damaged ceiling tiles also need repair.

headline: Minor sink drip; unused equipment to remove
summary: Passed. Minor water drip at the pipe below the three-compartment sink rinse basin must be repaired. Unused oven, refrigerator, prep cooler, storage rack, and grill behind dish area must be removed from premises.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat sausage
summary: Food handler used bare hands on ready-to-eat sausage; sausage discarded; citation issued. Ice machine had excessive black mold-like buildup; ice must be discarded and machine cleaned. Menu lacks undercooked-food disclosure; preset tableware uncovered.

headline: Bulk containers lacked name labels
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Bulk containers holding working ingredients, removed from original packaging, lacked common-name labels. Manager instructed to provide and maintain labels.

headline: Prep cooler at 70°F tagged out
summary: Prep cooler air temperature was 70.0°F; no foods that must stay cold were inside. Unit tagged and must not be used until repaired; must hold 41°F or colder. Also improper beef thawing, containers stored improperly, and greasy equipment to clean.

headline: Unlabeled containers; leaky drain
summary: Passed. Food storage containers need common-name labels. Leaky drainpipe under kitchen handsink must be repaired. Toilet room trash bin needs a lid. Floors need cleaning; clutter in rear side storage must be removed.

headline: Worn cutting boards need repair
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Extremely worn cutting boards at the meat display case and prep area had deep cuts, uneven surfaces, and stains. Manager told to sand and reseal them or replace them.

headline: Small leak under kitchen handsink
summary: License passed. Small leak in drain plumbing beneath kitchen handwashing sink. Must repair or replace the drain plumbing to stop the leak.

headline: Re-inspection passed; labeling and storage fixes
summary: Passed re-inspection. Unlabeled pepper, salt, and sugar found. Food stored on floor in walk-in freezer and dry storage must be raised six inches. Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables, and food in grocery bags in coolers, also noted.

headline: Live flies found; dish machine gauges broken
summary: Complaint failed. About 10 live small flies on food prep ceiling; citation issued; pest control recommended. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer; high-temperature dish machine gauges broken; some food handlers lacked hair restraints; manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: Rear door gap; expired allergen certificate
summary: Passed. 1/4-inch gap between double entrance doors on Ontario Street side must be rodent-proofed. Food manager's allergen training certificate was expired and must be updated.

headline: Trash overflowing; missing food handler training
summary: Re-inspection failed. Dumpsters overflowing with trash; lids not tight-fitting; citation issued. Also missing handwashing signs, damaged floors and baseboards, and heavy grill-hood buildup. Uncorrected clutter and missing food handler training.

headline: Repeat violations including grease and rear door gap
summary: Complaint failed. Previous core violations from June 2024 not corrected: rear door gap, damaged rack, heavy grease and food debris, and dust. Also wall holes, floor ice buildup, and non-shatterproof hood bulbs need fixing. Citation issued.

headline: Employee skipped handwashing before handling food
summary: An employee handled food and bread after touching a phone while wearing gloves, without washing hands. A dishwasher handled dirty then clean dishes without washing. Citation issued. Expired food handler and allergen certificates also noted.

headline: Re-inspection passed; labeling and cleaning
summary: Re-inspection passed. Bulk storage containers need product-name labels. Cooking equipment, refrigerators, and floors need cleaning. Expired food handler certificates must be renewed.

headline: Thermometers and cleaning fixes needed
summary: Passed with required fixes. Working thermometers needed in two front prep coolers. Greasy deep fryer interiors, a slow-draining sink in the rear dish area, and dirt and food debris on floor drains and floors also need attention.

headline: Missing signs; leaky faucet
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs needed at customer restroom and at handsink at end of cooking line. Ice machine has brown residue; schedule cleaning. Three-compartment sink faucet leaks and must be repaired.

headline: Over 15 rat droppings found
summary: Failed. Over 15 rat droppings along basement prep area wall base; citation issued; pest control consultation advised. Thick grease outside grease container; no detergent solution at three-compartment sink; bulk containers unlabeled.

headline: No certified manager certificate posted
summary: No valid City of Chicago certified food manager certificate posted on premises. Must be posted. Bar handwash sink pipe is leaking and must be repaired.

headline: Pink slime in ice machine; greasy floors
summary: Failed. Ice machine in rear prep had mold-like pink slime dripping onto ice for human use; citation issued. Heavy grease and food debris on equipment, cooling units, and floors in front prep area.

headline: Hair restraint missing; ice scoop stored badly
summary: Passed. A female food handler lacked a hair restraint. Ice scoop not stored handle-up in ice bin. Cutting board on front prep cooler is grooved and stained. Mop not stored to air dry.

headline: Upright containers; deli shelves dirty
summary: Passed. Food containers on drying racks must be stored inverted. Deli shelving units need cleaning. Burnt-out light fixture inside walk-in cooler must be repaired.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; light out
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure on site; priority violation. Handwashing signage missing at front prep sink. Burnt-out light on left side of hood.

headline: Repeat violations; no allergen training
summary: Failed. Previous core violations not corrected, including no allergen training proof, unused items on rear patio, and soiled mop heads. Also employees without hair restraints, rusty shelving, grease on hood, and debris under cooking equipment.

headline: Roaches, rodent droppings, and flies found
summary: One large live roach, 40 rodent droppings in basement, and over 200 live flies found in prep, storage, and dining areas. Manager told to eliminate pests and have pest control before 5/23/2024 reinspection. Expired food handler and allergen certificates also noted.

headline: No certified manager; door gap; menu gaps
summary: Re-inspection failed. No certified food manager on premises; citation issued. Also: rear door opening must be sealed, utility sink needs backflow device, a cooler gasket is damaged, and peeling wall paint. Menu lacks required asterisks and undercooked-food disclosure.

headline: Handwashing sign missing at bar sink
summary: Passed. No handwashing signage at the exposed handwashing sink in the bar. Inspector instructed the manager to provide it.

headline: Handwashing signs missing; sink not working
summary: Passed. Handwashing sink by the ice machine lacked signage. Walk-in cooler shelving had food debris and soil. Women's restroom metered hand sink not working; manager instructed to repair.

headline: Missing thermometer, labels, and handler training
summary: Re-inspection passed. Rear grab-and-go cooler lacks a thermometer; to-go deli salads lack labels; sink stoppers missing; restroom trash lacks lid; deli slicers need cleaning. No food handler training certificates on site.

headline: No handwashing signs; allergen training missing
summary: Passed. No handwashing signs at hand sinks; must be provided. Sanitation manager has no allergen training; must be provided.

headline: Serving plates stored upright
summary: Passed. Serving plates on kitchen prep shelves were not stored properly. Must invert them to prevent dust accumulation.

headline: No backflow device at ice machine
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. No backflow prevention device at basement ice machine. Must provide one where it can be located and serviced.

headline: No certified manager during food service
summary: No valid certified food manager on site while chicken and rice were prepared and served. Citation issued; manager must be present at all times. Also a leaking faucet base and dirty floors and walls.

headline: Rusty can opener; damaged cooler gasket
summary: Passed. Heavily rusted and grimy can opener must be replaced. Damaged gasket on pancake mix cold-hold unit must be replaced. Interior of that cold-hold unit needs cleaning.

headline: No health policy; broken thermometer
summary: Passed with conditions. No verifiable employee health policy on site; citation issued. Metal-stem food thermometer was broken; manager bought a replacement during inspection. Food on basement floor, unlabeled containers, and greasy surfaces also noted.

headline: Re-inspection failed; sewage and meat on floor
summary: Re-inspection failed. Rack of meat on sheet pan on floor. Mop sink and rear floor drain not draining; wastewater coming onto floor; citation issued. Also rust on walk-in racks, dirty toilet, wall hole, and dusty filters.

headline: Dirty storage shelves
summary: Passed. Storage shelves above prep table and steam table must be cleaned.

headline: Bowls too large for sink; allergen training missing
summary: Mixing bowls too large for the 3-compartment sink require a written clean-in-place procedure. Ceiling tiles are missing in the rear of the facility. A certified food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Leaking sink knob; dirty hood filters
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer when not in use. A leak at the base of the 3-compartment sink's cold water knob must be fixed. Hood filters had dirt, grease and dust buildup. Proof of allergen training was not on site.

headline: Grease and debris on fryers, floors, vents
summary: Grease and debris were on the bottom of fryers and prep tables. Walls, floors and pipes behind cooking equipment needed cleaning. The vents above the rear grill also needed cleaning.

headline: Food on floors; grease dripping on equipment
summary: Food was stored on walk-in cooler floors. The hood system dripped grease onto cooking equipment, and hood filters were missing. Also cited: damaged cutting boards, rusted racks, an inaccurate cooler display, broken floor tiles, and repeat floor violations.

headline: Employees eating and drinking at prep area
summary: Employees were drinking and preparing food at the kitchen prep area. Management was instructed to provide a designated eating and drinking area away from food prep.

headline: Missing sushi rice lab letter; dirty floors
summary: No laboratory pH letter was on file for sushi rice, a required record. Floors in preparation areas were not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Service sink must be relocated
summary: The service sink must be relocated to the southeast corner of the prep area. A food service sanitation manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: No certified manager; grease and debris throughout
summary: Food handlers prepared perishable food without an original city certificate or certified manager on site (priority citation). Also noted: dirty frying oil, ice buildup in freezers, grease and debris on floors, cracks and holes, and unused items stored in several areas.

headline: Restroom hand sinks lack hot water
summary: Restroom hand sinks reached only 57.6°F (men's) and 66.5°F (women's), below the 100°F minimum. The sandwich prep hand sink had no cold water and could not stay below 120°F. Frozen food was stored on the freezer floor, ovens were heavily greasy, and an allergen certificate was missing.

headline: Leaky hand sink; plastic bags plug sink
summary: A rear hand sink leaked and its hot water could not be fully shut off. The 3-compartment sink was plugged with plastic bags. The manager was told to repair the plumbing and use proper stoppers.

headline: Worn cutting boards; greasy equipment
summary: Cutting boards with deep cuts must be replaced. Cooking equipment and floors in the main prep area had heavy grease buildup and need detail cleaning. A basement hand sink P-trap leaks and must be repaired. Hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Equipment repairs and cleaning needed
summary: The ice machine gasket must be replaced and a deeply grooved meat cutting board must be replaced. Floors need detail cleaning, the rear utility sink lacks a backflow device, and walk-in vent covers are dusty.

headline: Debris on floors and drains in storage
summary: Debris built up on floors and drains along wall bases in the dry food and paper storage area and in the bar. The area must be cleaned.

headline: Food in grocery bags; grease buildup
summary: Food was stored in plastic grocery bags inside a cooler and must go in approved food-grade containers. Cardboard lined the prep floor and must be removed. Cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers and freezers had grease and food debris. A soiled mop head must be hung.

headline: Dead mouse found; floors and equipment need cleaning
summary: A dead mouse was on the floor of the basement furnace room and must be removed. Food spills and grease covered equipment and floors. Single-use items were stored on the basement floor, and unused items must be removed.

headline: Repeat hot water violation; wall holes
summary: A prior hot water violation was not corrected in time: hand sink water measured 140.8°F, and an engineer adjusted it to 109.2°F during this visit. This is now a priority violation with a citation. Also noted: ice machine buildup, a leak at the 3-compartment sink, and large wall holes.

headline: Prep area under unshielded sewer lines
summary: The food prep area is located under sewer lines that are not shielded to catch potential drips. The manager was instructed to add shielding.

headline: Pizza held at room temperature; no certified manager
summary: Pizza was held at 75–78°F without a required written procedure for using time instead of temperature for safety; about 2 lb ($35) was discarded. No valid certified manager was on site while chicken was served. The hand sink lacked soap.

headline: Live roaches and about 75 rat droppings
summary: Three live cockroaches were in wall holes in the dishwashing area. About 75 rat droppings were in the basement and under the front 3-compartment sink. Additional pest control is needed. No valid certified manager certificate was posted.

headline: No proof employees report illnesses
summary: No verification was available that food employees were told to report health symptoms that can spread through food (priority violation). Handwashing signs were missing at several sinks. Other items included a missing backflow device, holes in walls, and no allergen certificate.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: The person in charge lacked a city sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was on site while TCS foods were handled (citation). Food handlers lacked training proof. A salad cooler had grease and dried food buildup, and containers were unlabeled.

headline: Rat droppings, dead rats, bare-hand food contact
summary: About 50 or more rat droppings and 4 dead rats on glue boards were found in the kitchen, and pest control was recommended. A worker touched a ready-to-eat hamburger bare-handed, and produce was held at 45–64°F. The rear prep area has no hand sink.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; patio door openings
summary: The bar hand sink had no handwashing sign. Openings along the patio doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry.

headline: Unapproved vacuum packing; low dish machine heat
summary: Vacuum packaging was done without a city-approved food safety (HACCP) plan, and about $400 of food was discarded. The dish machine final rinse reached only 154°F, below the 160°F required. A technician serviced it during the inspection. Shellstock tags were missing.

headline: No food handler training; uncovered food on floor
summary: Employees lacked food handler training, and managers lacked allergen training. Uncovered food was stored on the prep floor, and a food handler lacked a hair restraint. Also noted: unlabeled bulk containers, crates used as shelves, and peeling basement paint.

headline: Hand sink too cool; dish machine at 0 ppm
summary: The rear prep hand sink reached only 86.4°F, but hand sinks must be at least 100°F. The low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm and was at 50 ppm after a technician arrived. Also noted: stained cutting boards, foil liners, broken floor tiles, and an uncorrected floor violation.

headline: About 40 live fruit flies in pastry kitchen
summary: About 40 live fruit flies were found in the pastry kitchen. The manager was told to eliminate them, and pest control service was recommended (priority violation). A broom and dustpan were stored too close to a food mixer.

headline: Over 40 rat droppings in basement storage
summary: Over 40 rat droppings were scattered on the floor and along walls in basement storage. The manager was told to call an exterminator and clean the area. A 1-inch gap at the front doors and other openings were also noted.

headline: Missing ingredient labels on grab-and-go foods
summary: Prepared foods in the self-service cooler, such as chicken salad, sandwiches and cake slices, had no ingredient labels. The manager was told to provide them. A soiled mop head also needed to be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: No certified food manager was on site while perishable foods were prepared and served. No food handler training proof was available. Items were stored on floors, and repeat violations included missing hair restraints and a broken freezer lid.

headline: Unlabeled spices and bulk foods
summary: Spices and bulk foods stored outside original containers were not labeled. Microwave interiors and storage shelves in the prep area need cleaning. A certified manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: Cardboard liner; allergen training required
summary: Cardboard was used as a liner in the rear two-door cooler and must be replaced with smooth, cleanable material. All certified food managers must complete allergen training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Soup too warm; corrected on site
summary: Soup measured 54°F inside the walk-in cooler. The manager voluntarily discarded 40 lb ($50) and this was corrected at the time of inspection. Large pots do not fit the 3-compartment sink, and an outdoor grease container had thick grease buildup.

headline: About 60 rat droppings in basement
summary: About 60 rat droppings were found in the basement, and more pest control is needed. No food is stored or prepared there. Also noted: no food handler certificates, an expired allergen certificate, missing hair restraints, and prior violations not corrected.

headline: Uncorrected hand sink violation; missing thermometers
summary: A prior priority violation was not corrected: no hand sink at the front coffee bar. A citation was issued. Cook-line coolers lacked visible thermometers, and there were rusted shelves, foil liners, grease, and a slow-draining hand sink.

headline: Unknown black substance inside ice machine
summary: A small amount of black, unidentified substance was found on the ice machine's food-contact surface. The manager was told to remove the ice, clean, sanitize, and maintain the area.

headline: More than 160 rodent droppings; no certified manager
summary: More than 160 rodent droppings were found in dry storage, aisles, the bread area and the office. Pest control was recommended. No certified food manager was on site while beef was prepared and sold, and food handler training proof was missing.

headline: Ventilation, floor and wall repairs needed
summary: The rear exit door has an opening that must be sealed. No backflow device was found on the ice machine. The all-gender washroom has no mechanical ventilation, and a rear light flickers. Floor tiles, a baseboard and lower wall holes need repair.

headline: Dish machine tagged; not to be used
summary: The low-temperature dish machine was not operational and was tagged. It must not be used until it holds at least 50 ppm sanitizer and is reinspected. Also noted: a roof door with gaps over 1/4 inch and a missing backflow device.

headline: No certified food manager on duty during prep
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while perishable foods were being prepared, which must be on site at all times. Also noted: missing handwashing sign, unlabeled containers, wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces, and food stored in grocery bags in coolers.

headline: Low water pressure at sinks
summary: Low water pressure was noted at the 3-compartment sink hot water and the hand sink. The manager was instructed to increase water pressure to meet city requirements.

headline: Thermometer missing; provided during inspection
summary: The 2-door prep cooler lacked a visible, working thermometer. Management provided one during the inspection. No other violations were listed.

headline: Missing food handler training; damaged floor tiles
summary: No food handler training was shown for employees, and it must be provided and maintained. Damaged floor tiles in the front prep area must be repaired or replaced.

headline: About 100 rodent droppings throughout store
summary: About 100 rodent droppings were found in the stockroom, under shelves, near registers and in other areas, and pest activity must be eliminated. Restrooms need cleaning and covered garbage cans. Ceiling tiles are missing, and items are stored on floors.

headline: About 25 live flies; no vomit cleanup supplies
summary: About 25 live small flies were on walls and flying in front and rear prep areas, and pest control was recommended. No written procedure or supplies existed for vomit and diarrhea cleanup. A thermometer was broken and a rear hand sink had a heavy leak.

headline: Leaks, missing thermometer, floors need cleaning
summary: The walk-in cooler must have a working thermometer. Leaks at the produce prep 3-compartment sink and front hand sink base must be repaired. The compactor exterior and floors behind cooking equipment and in the bakery need cleaning.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; clutter; dusty vent
summary: The front hand sink has no handwashing sign. Cardboard and foil were on shelves and tabletops, and walk-in shelving had debris. Clutter on the floor near the rear exit must be organized, and a restroom ceiling tile is water-damaged.

headline: Expired allergen training certificate
summary: An expired allergen training certificate was found for a certified food manager. Staff were instructed to provide current training. No other violations were listed.

headline: No certified manager; blocked hand sink; undated food
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared and served. A hand sink was blocked by a trash can and olive container during cooking. Ready-to-eat foods held over 24 hours were not date-marked. A dumpster lid was damaged, and prior violations were not corrected.

headline: Cold foods too warm; 94 lb discarded
summary: Self-service cold units held ham, chicken, tuna, eggs and other foods at 44–52°F; about 94 lb ($750) was discarded. A warewashing machine behind the bar is tagged and must not be used until repaired. Four washrooms need handwashing signs.

headline: Door gap needs sealing; no covered trash can
summary: A half-inch gap under the exit double doors must be sealed to keep rodents out. The employee washroom needs a covered trash receptacle.

headline: Cold foods too warm; about $500 discarded
summary: Several perishable foods were held at 47–50°F instead of 41°F or below. About $500 of eggs, milk, sausage and sandwiches was discarded. The walk-in cooler measured 47°F, and a technician arrived to repair it. A grease trap has a hole.

headline: Ashtrays found; no summary report posted
summary: A rear table and a bathroom handwashing sink were being used as ashtrays with cigarette butts. A citation was issued under the Clean Indoor Air Ordinance. The previous inspection summary was not posted, and food debris was on meat equipment.

headline: Rusty shelves; backflow device relocation needed
summary: Chipped paint and rust were on wire racks inside a cooler by the hand sink and must be repainted or replaced. The backflow device for the new ice maker must be relocated for service. Kitchen exhaust filters need detail cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; hair restraints missing
summary: No city certified food manager was on premises while milk and ham were being prepared (citation). Food handlers were not wearing effective hair restraints, and the manager was instructed to require them.

headline: Cleaning needed; backflow device missing
summary: A two-door reach-in cooler and large freezers in the rear storage area must be cleaned inside and out. A utility sink in the toilet room lacks a backflow device. Rear dry storage needs detail cleaning, and hood filters and vents need cleaning.

headline: Hand sink blocked and used for rinsing food
summary: A main prep hand sink was blocked by buckets, and a food handler was rinsing food in it. Hand sinks must be used only for handwashing (priority violation). Paper towels were missing, spoons sat in room-temperature water, and prior violations were uncorrected.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen training
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer. Floors around the hot water tank, grease traps, and sinks had dirt buildup. One food handler lacked proof of training, and the certified manager on duty lacked allergen training.

headline: Hot water at most sinks only about 77°F
summary: Hot water at many sinks measured about 77°F. Three-compartment sinks must exceed 110°F and hand sinks at least 100°F. Maintenance was notified. Thermometers were missing from hot holding towers, and the prior inspection summary was not posted.

headline: Open rodent bait, unsafe cold food, missing tags
summary: About 20 open rodent bait packages were on floors and shelves; bait must be in covered stations. Cold-held chicken, beef and eggs were 48–59°F; about $215 of food was discarded. About $155 of shellfish without tags was also discarded.

headline: Soil buildup on floors, walls, ice dispenser
summary: The exterior of the soda machine ice dispenser had soil buildup. Floors had debris and soil, and kitchen walls had soil buildup near the griddle. The manager was told to clean and maintain these areas.

headline: Leaky pipe; dirty floors behind equipment
summary: A leaky pipe under the 3-compartment sink must be repaired. Floors and walls behind cooking equipment and the dish machine are dirty. Filters above cooking equipment must be cleaned of grease and debris.

headline: Live roaches and flying insects; failed inspection
summary: Live roaches were crawling near grease containers and under the 3-compartment sink, and many flying insects were in prep and washroom areas. The manager was told to call an exterminator. Uncovered food and missing food handler training were also noted.

headline: Open drink stored in prep cooler
summary: An open drink was stored in a prep cooler. The employee was instructed to store drinks away from food prep and clean equipment.

headline: Food handler did not wash hands after sneezing
summary: A food handler sneezed, wiped his nose, then resumed preparing food without washing his hands. This was a priority violation. Also noted: no signed employee health policies on site, three food handlers without certifications, and a certified manager lacking allergen training.

headline: No certified manager on site; paper towels missing
summary: The person in charge lacked a city sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was on site while TCS foods were served (citation). Paper towels were missing at hand sinks but were provided during the inspection. Other items include a missing thermometer and floor debris.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate on site
summary: No valid city sanitation certificate was on site while rice, beans and chicken were prepared and served (citation). The person in charge lacked verifiable training. Three-compartment sink compartments were unlabeled, and some food handler certificates were expired.

headline: No hot water; missing soap and paper towels
summary: Hot water was unavailable at several sinks because a pipe burst; repair is needed. Soap and paper towels were missing at hand sinks but were supplied during the visit. Food containers were stored on the walk-in floor, and a faucet leaked.

headline: Gasket, restroom door, and dirty grill filters
summary: The rubber gasket on a reach-in freezer door is in poor repair and must be fixed. The self-closing device on the women's restroom door is also in poor repair. Filters above the flat-top grills are dirty with grease and debris.

headline: No hot water at hand sink; improper reheating
summary: A kitchen hand sink had no hot water; it must provide at least 100°F. Cold rice at 109°F was placed directly into a hot holding unit without reheating to 165°F. Dumpster lids were open with overflowing trash. A rear door gap and missing ice bin covers were noted.

headline: Missing walk-in thermometer; worn gaskets
summary: The walk-in cooler has no internal thermometer and must have one. Gaskets on a prep cooler are in poor repair and must be replaced.

headline: Dead roaches on floor and glueboards
summary: Dead cockroaches were on the floor and on glue boards in the front dishwashing area. The manager was instructed to remove them and clean. Also noted: ice buildup in the walk-in freezer, grease near fryers, a 1/4-inch wall gap, and dusty vents.

headline: Food stored on floors; debris and ice buildup
summary: Food was stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and freezer and must be raised six inches. Single-service items were not inverted, ice had built up in the freezer, and cooler and fryer surfaces had food debris.

headline: Certified manager arrived; corrected on site
summary: No person with an original city sanitation certificate was on site at first. This was corrected when the certified manager arrived at 4:07 PM. An opening at the base of the front double doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry.

headline: Clutter in office and storage areas
summary: Old equipment and tools were cluttering office and storage areas. The area must be cleaned and organized.

headline: Cooling food covered; cups stored on floor
summary: Cooked rice and chicken were covered in the walk-in cooler while cooling. They should be loosely covered or uncovered to cool. Plastic cups were stored on the floor, grease buildup was on cook-line shelves, and an unused slushie machine was noted.

headline: Door gap; floor cleaning; allergen training
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the front entry door needs correcting. Floors under shelving along walls and in the dish drying area need detail cleaning. A new manager lacked allergen training certification.

headline: About 25 live flying insects in prep areas
summary: About 25 live small flying insects were on walls, ceilings and shelves in food prep areas, and more pest control is needed (priority violation). No valid food handler certificates were provided. Also noted: plastic bags for frozen meat, leaks, grease, mold, and repeat violations.

headline: Loose faucet, floor debris, greasy hood filters
summary: The rear kitchen hand sink faucet is loose and must be repaired. Dirt and debris under bar equipment must be cleaned to prevent pests. Hood filters have grease and dirt buildup.

headline: No drainboard on 3-compartment sink
summary: The 3-compartment sink has no drainboard for drying utensils. The manager was instructed to provide one and maintain it.

headline: Dead roaches on hand-sink sign; door gap
summary: Dead roaches were stuck to tape on the handwashing sign at the rear kitchen sink, and the sign must be replaced. A rear screened door had a 1-inch gap at the bottom. Plastic grocery bags were used in freezers, and shelves had grease and rust.

headline: Dish machine sanitizer reads 0 ppm
summary: Chlorine sanitizer inside the low-temperature dish machine at the bar read 0 ppm. It must read at least 100 ppm. This was listed as a priority violation.

headline: Damaged cooler lining; dusty condenser
summary: Damaged lining in reach-in coolers below the bar kegs must be replaced with smooth, cleanable material. Dust on the prep area cooler condenser fans must be cleaned. The certified manager did not have a copy of allergen training.

headline: Eye wash on hand sink; mold-like wall
summary: A rear storage area hand sink had an eye wash setup on its faucet. The sink must be used only for handwashing, with the eye wash kept separate. A mold-like substance on the wall above the 3-compartment sink must be cleaned.

headline: Backflow device missing on basement ice machine
summary: No backflow prevention device could be located on the basement ice machine. The manager was instructed to install one where it can be serviced and maintained.

headline: No certified manager; no food handler training
summary: No valid city sanitation certificate was posted or on site, and no food handler training was available. Food was stored on walk-in floors and in grocery bags, and some handlers had no hair restraints. Fryers, hood and shelves had grease buildup.

headline: Unlabeled containers and food debris on floors
summary: Sugar, flour and rice containers in the upstairs prep area must be labeled. A salad cooler had torn gaskets. Upstairs dry storage was cluttered, and food debris was on floors and inside the walk-in cooler and freezer.

headline: No sanitizer test kit; slow drain and leak
summary: No chemical test kit was available for checking sanitizer strength (citation). The rear hand sink lacked a handwashing sign. The front hand sink drains slowly and has a leak at the bottom pipe. Bulk containers were unlabeled, and cardboard lined prep equipment.

headline: Chicken thawed on floor at room temperature
summary: Prepackaged chicken was thawing on the floor at room temperature instead of an approved method. Also noted: ice scoop handle touching ice, soiled wiping cloths on floors, knives stored unsafely, grease and debris, and uncorrected prior violations.

headline: Walk-in coolers lack thermometers
summary: No ambient air thermometers were inside the walk-in coolers. The manager was instructed to provide visible, readable thermometers inside all refrigerator units.

headline: No certified manager on duty; certificates expired
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while smoothies, chicken and salads were prepared and served (priority citation). The sanitation certificates on site were expired. The original city certificate must be on site at all times.

headline: Torn cooler gasket
summary: A torn door gasket inside the main front prep line cooler must be replaced.

headline: Dead roaches found; several cleaning issues
summary: Dead roaches were on the floor under cold holding units and must be removed. Also noted: wiping cloths stored improperly, bowls used as sink stoppers, grease and food buildup, and floors needing deep cleaning.

headline: Unsafe food temperatures; food discarded
summary: Potatoes were held at 117°F, below the 135°F minimum for hot food. Several cold foods were at 48–83°F, and about $60 of cooked chicken, rice and mashed potatoes was discarded. The prior inspection summary was not posted.

headline: Dirty ice bin; cracked cutting boards
summary: The ice bin interior was not clean and must be cleaned and sanitized. Hanging cutting boards above the 3-compartment sink had deep cuts and stains. Hood shields had grease and dust, and the ladies' washroom had no covered receptacle.

headline: Handwashing in 3-compartment sink; food on floor
summary: A food handler used the 3-compartment sink to wash hands, a priority violation with a citation. Food was stored on floors in the walk-in cooler and freezer, and some food was uncovered. TCS foods lacked date marks, and the manager lacked allergen training.

headline: No food handler training records on site
summary: No proof of food handler training was available for any food handlers. The manager must provide and maintain these training records at all times.

headline: Unlabeled containers; torn refrigerator gasket
summary: This re-inspection followed a suspected food poisoning report. Food storage containers must be labeled when food is not in its original package. A torn door gasket on a rear prep refrigerator must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Yogurt, cheese, eggs too warm; 10 lb discarded
summary: Yogurt, cheeses and shelled eggs were held at 45–50°F in a prep cooler, which should be 41°F or below. About 10 lb ($75) was discarded. The cooler air measured 45°F.

headline: Mold-like buildup inside ice machine
summary: Mold-like buildup was found inside the ice machine, which is not used for human consumption. The manager was told to clean and sanitize it.

headline: Missing thermometers and test kits; broken gauge
summary: No metal stem thermometer, chemical test kit or irreversible thermometer was on site. The high-temperature dish machine wash gauge is broken. A floor drain leaks, and the manager lacks allergen training. A citation was issued.

headline: Cooler too warm; food discarded; gap at door
summary: A rear two-door cooler measured 50.1F and was tagged held for inspection; milk and other TCS foods were at 51F to 57F, and about 15 lb was discarded. A 1-inch gap at the front entrance needs sealing. Some employees lack hair restraints and health policies.

headline: Food held too warm; many live flies found
summary: Cooked beans at 47.8F and sauce at 44.2F were in the walk-in cooler; about 69 lb was discarded. About 30 or more live small flies were found on ceilings, walls and beams in dish, beverage and bar areas, plus one dead roach. Pest service recommended.

headline: Dusty hood filters; one worker lacked certificate
summary: Hood filters above the griddle and fryer had a dust buildup, and the manager was told to clean them. One food handler had no food handler certificate. The manager was told to make sure all food handlers have one.

headline: No food handler or allergen certificates shown
summary: No food handler certificates were available for the inspector to review, and food handlers must have them on site at all times. No allergen training certificate was available for review for food service sanitation managers. This re-inspection passed.

headline: No certified manager; storage clutter
summary: No city certified food manager was on the premises while breakfast sandwiches, cheeseburgers and hot dogs were prepared and served, and a citation was issued. Beverages must be elevated, reach-in freezers need food residue cleaned, and rear storage clutter must be removed.

headline: Live roaches; no certified manager on site
summary: About 20 live roaches were found in dish area, storage rack and under sink pipes, plus black boxes near the lemonade machine. A certified manager was not on site and a citation was issued. A pest inspection is required before 01/06/2026. Grease and floor debris need cleaning.

headline: Unsigned health policies; food debris buildup
summary: No signed employee health policies were on site. Dried food debris was found on sheet pans, cooler surfaces, shelving and storage containers. Floors had grease and food debris. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks. The certified manager needs allergen training.

headline: Hot and cold food out of range; mold in ice chute
summary: Broccoli at 126.5F was on the hot line below 135F. Tuna at 46.8F and boiled eggs at 45.6F were in cold salad; these were discarded. Black mold-like substance was found in a soda machine ice chute. Hand sinks were used for pots and pans.

headline: No certified manager; eating in prep area
summary: No person in charge was present, and no certified food manager with a city certificate was on duty while TCS foods were prepared. Employees ate and drank in the prep area. Upkeep issues include milk crates used as shelves and clutter in storage.

headline: Fryers greasy; raw meat residue on slicers
summary: Fryers in the prepared foods area had excessive food and grease debris. Raw meat debris was found on meat slicers and a grinder. Floors behind cooking equipment have food, grease and dirt buildup. Missing coving must be replaced. The re-inspection passed.

headline: Extra handwashing sink required at prep station
summary: Inspector required an additional handwashing sink at the dressing and cream portioning station. The owner was instructed to install it. No pests or food temperature problems were noted.

headline: Burnt-out hood lights; broken unused refrigerator
summary: A handwashing sink in front prep lacks a sign. A broken, unused one-door refrigerator must be repaired or removed. All three hoods have burnt-out bulbs and carbon buildup on filters. These are general upkeep issues.

headline: No prep sink in pantry area
summary: The pantry area on floors 30 through 32 has no prep sink. The inspector instructed that one be provided. This is a plumbing item only.

headline: Debris on prep area floor
summary: Debris buildup was found on the floor in the main prep area. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain it. This is a general upkeep issue.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: The floor under the soda dispenser was cleaned during the inspection. Dust on the washroom ventilation fan must be cleaned. Food handler training certificates and the allergen training certificate on premises are expired and must be replaced.

headline: Unknown residue in ice machine; roaches and flies
summary: An unknown black and pink substance was found inside the ice machine, and the ice must be removed and cleaned. About 5 roaches were found in the dishwashing area and about 15 small flies at the bar. Loading dock garbage receptacles lack covers.

headline: Single-use cup used as scoop; dirty floors
summary: A single-use Styrofoam cup was used as a scoop in dry food storage and must be replaced with a multi-use utensil. Knives were stored beneath a hot-holding well and burner. The customer restroom handwashing sink seal is missing. Floors under the deep fryer are heavily soiled.

headline: Handwashing sink covered and disconnected
summary: The rear handwashing sink is covered in plastic wrap with its drain disconnected, so staff cannot use it. It must be uncovered and reconnected. No pest control logbook was kept on site. A cooler lacks an air thermometer, and a backflow device is loose.

headline: Improper handwashing and dishwashing; food misplaced
summary: A food handler washed hands while wearing gloves and wiped them on an apron; bare-hand washing was instructed. The three-compartment sink had no sanitizer basin. Baked potatoes were stored on a garbage can rim. A new inspection summary was posted on site.

headline: Unlabeled rice; wipes and mop stored improperly
summary: A food storage container holding rice had no label. Wiping cloths were improperly stored in the prep area, and a mop was improperly stored in the employee washroom. Ceiling tiles in the prep area are dirty or stained. This re-inspection passed.

headline: Unlabeled containers; debris and openings
summary: A mini cooler in the front prep area lacks an air thermometer. Basement food containers lack common-name labels. Shelving under prep tables has debris and flour. An opening in the wall under the dish machine must be sealed. Floor debris and cluttered closets were noted.

headline: Live roaches found; holes in walls
summary: About 4 live roaches were found under the three-compartment sink, near dry storage and behind a stainless steel table. A citation was issued. Holes in walls, cracked duckboards and a broken restroom exhaust fan also need repair.

headline: Live roaches and flies; sink not accessible
summary: About 5 live roaches were found on the floor behind a dirty dish rack, on a dish machine towel and on a wall. About 15 or more live small flies were in a three-compartment sink. A hand sink was blocked by a rolling rack. About 10 lb of food was discarded.

headline: About 30 live flies in upstairs mop room
summary: About 30 live small flies were found on walls and ceilings in the second floor utility mop sink room. A citation was issued and additional pest control service is recommended. An ice scoop stored inside the bar ice bin must be moved, and floor tiles need re-grouting.

headline: Cold foods above 41F; dead bugs in trap
summary: Raw pork, half-and-half and watermelon were held at 48F to 60F; about 8.5 gallons and 8 lb were discarded. Two refrigerators measured 51F and 53F and were tagged. An insect sticky trap was filled with dead bugs. Food was stored on floors, and food handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Missing cooler thermometers; freezer ice buildup
summary: Reach-in coolers need working thermometers. The rear deep freezer in the prep area has ice buildup and must be defrosted and cleaned.

headline: No employee health policy; leaking sink
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site. The dish area handwashing sink leaks during use and was inaccessible. Missing food handler certificates and allergen training were also noted. Floor debris and a torn cooler gasket need attention.

headline: No certified manager; sink and light issues
summary: No person in charge with a certified manager certificate was present, and no valid sanitation certificate was posted, a citation issue. The health policy was missing. Missing sink stoppers, a leaking drain pipe and missing light shields were noted.

headline: Dish machines not sanitizing; no vomit cleanup plan
summary: Three low-temperature dish machines measured 0 ppm chlorine, so they were not sanitizing. One was repaired on site; two still need repair. No written vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure was on site. Shellstock tags lacked sale dates.

headline: Rodent droppings, cockroaches, and flies found
summary: About 200 mouse droppings were found in a utility closet, under the front counter and in dry storage. Two live cockroaches were under a prep cooler, and house flies were in the dining room. This is a repeat violation with a citation. Fly strips must be removed.

headline: Blocked hand sink; no health policy on site
summary: No written employee health policy was on site, and a citation was issued. A front prep hand sink is blocked by equipment and has a broken faucet handle. No metal stem thermometer or sanitizer test kit was found. A rear prep sink leaks.

headline: Sushi rice too cool; about 20 lb discarded
summary: Sushi rice measured 112F and was being held under time-as-control rules, which require 135F or higher when removed from hot holding. About 20 lb was voluntarily discarded, and a citation was issued. Dusty walk-in vents and a burnt-out hood light need attention.

headline: No certified manager; 30-50 rodent droppings
summary: About 30 to 50 rodent droppings were found in the furnace and dry storage areas. No certified manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared, and no vomit cleanup kit was present. Previous violations for water pressure, handwashing and certificates were not corrected.

headline: Items on floors; broken tile and drain cover
summary: All stored items in the rear kitchen and server station must be elevated off the floor. A floor drain cover is broken and a floor tile at the kitchen entrance is broken or missing. Caulking near the sushi sink is moldy. Washroom ventilation is inoperable; light shields are missing.

headline: Food stored on floor; large pots don't fit sink
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor in prep, storage and the walk-in cooler and must be raised 6 inches. Large pots and pans do not fit the three-compartment sink for proper washing and sanitizing; a procedure or removal is required. The re-inspection passed.

headline: No certified manager on duty; hair restraints needed
summary: No certified food manager with a city certificate was on duty while rice and chicken soups were prepared, and a citation was issued. No person in charge was present. Staff ate and drank in prep areas without hair restraints. No sanitizer test strip kit was on site.

headline: Mouse droppings and live roaches in basement
summary: About 8 mouse droppings were found on a ledge and floor in the furnace room. Two live roaches were crawling under the basement hot water tank. Pest control service is recommended. No probe thermometer, signed health policies or allergen training were found.

headline: Torn gasket and unused dish machine
summary: A two-door prep cooler in the basement has a torn gasket. An unused low-temperature dish machine in the first-floor bar must be repaired or removed. These are equipment upkeep issues.

headline: No certified manager; foods held too warm
summary: No person in charge or certified food manager was on site while food was served. A worker touched ready-to-eat tortilla chips by hand. Chicken and other foods were at 45F to 51F; about 50 lb was discarded. There was no hot water.

headline: Leak behind dish machine; cleaning needed
summary: A pipe leaks along the wall behind the dish machine and must be repaired. Floor drains around the dish machine and ice machine need detail cleaning. The wall behind the deep fryers also needs cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; sanitizer and water issues
summary: No person in charge with a valid city sanitation certificate was on premises, and a citation was issued. The low-temperature bar dish machine sanitized at 10 ppm chlorine and was held for inspection. Handwashing water measured 63.9F to 66F. No food handler training proof was provided.

headline: No certified manager while handling eggs
summary: The person in charge lacks a city certified manager certificate and must obtain one. No certified manager was on site while eggs and protein shakes were handled, and a citation was issued. A small cutting board with deep grooves must be replaced.

headline: No certified manager on duty while cooking
summary: The person in charge lacks a certified manager certificate and must obtain one. No certified manager was on duty while TCS foods such as chicken, rice and beans were prepared and served, and a citation was issued. A gap in the front doors must be sealed.

headline: Ice machine needs cleaning; hair restraints needed
summary: Upper areas inside the ice machine need cleaning. An ice scoop was stored inside the ice with its handle. All food handlers must wear hair restraints. Plastic crates, cardboard and wood used for elevation must be replaced or sealed. Patio storage must be cleared.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; about 50 lb discarded
summary: Three pans of cooked brisket, shredded lamb and potato dumplings were held at 45F to 58F in the walk-in cooler. TCS foods must be held at 41F or below. About 50 lb was discarded voluntarily, costing about $500, and a citation was issued.

headline: Hood filters need detail cleaning
summary: Hood ventilation filters in the front food service and prep area need a detail cleaning. This is a general upkeep issue.

headline: Items stored on basement floor
summary: Equipment, napkins, utensils and other single-service items were stored on the floor in the basement dry storage. They must be raised at least 6 inches. The certified manager is also missing allergen training.

headline: No sink stoppers; leaking faucet
summary: Wiping cloths were soiled on prep tables and must be stored in sanitizing solution. The three-compartment sink has no stoppers and a leaking faucet. A rear cooler gasket is damaged. A dish area light shield is damaged. The certified manager lacks valid allergen training.

headline: Knife under scale; worn cutting boards
summary: A knife was stored under the scale and must be moved to a clean, sanitized location. Cutting boards are worn and discolored. The unisex washroom needs a covered waste can. Floors and the juice bar vent need cleaning.

headline: Grease and dirt on cooking area
summary: The wok station, stainless steel shelves above the steam table and the shelves above the three-compartment sink need cleaning. Grease on the wall behind the cooking equipment must also be removed. This is a general upkeep issue.

headline: Inoperable restroom ventilation; labeling needed
summary: Mechanical ventilation in both customer and employee washrooms is not working and must be repaired. Food storage containers need common-name labels. The re-inspection passed.

headline: About 60 mouse droppings in kitchen
summary: About 60 mouse droppings were found in the kitchen, beneath the three-compartment sink, on shelving and inside the roll-in cooler. The person in charge cleaned droppings during the inspection. A pest control technician is needed and a citation was issued.

headline: Paper towels added; signage and cups need fixing
summary: Customer washroom sinks had no paper towels; these were provided during the inspection. A front prep sink lacks handwashing signage. Single-use cups were used as scoops in dry storage. Utensils were stored under the paper towel dispenser. Grease hood filters are heavily soiled.

headline: Foil and cardboard liners; sink leak
summary: Aluminum foil lines the wok area, stove and shelving, and cardboard lines the ceiling above the six-burner stove. These must be removed to prevent insect harborage. A three-compartment sink faucet leaks and its drain has buildup. A light under the hood is missing.

headline: About 70 rodent droppings; food held too warm
summary: About 70 rodent droppings were found under shelving, under the sink and under steel shelving in the rear prep area. Two prep coolers at 48F and 54F were tagged. Cooked chicken at 71F and raw egg at 47F were discarded. Front hand sink hot water reached only 72.3F.

headline: Missing stoppers, damaged tiles, food debris
summary: Three-compartment sink stoppers are missing in both dish areas. A can opener blade is caked with food debris. Cutting boards have open seams. The walk-in freezer has excess ice and debris. Floor tiles are damaged and food debris is on floors and surfaces.

headline: Mildly soiled ice machine; items stored above food
summary: The ice machine's interior surfaces were mildly soiled and need regular cleaning. Employee personal care items were stored on a shelf above food in the walk-in cooler and must be moved. A certified food manager lacks allergen training and certificate.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; light bulb missing shield
summary: Torn gaskets are on the inside of prep coolers at the basement cook line and must be repaired. A light bulb in the walk-in cooler lacks a shield. This re-inspection passed.

headline: Loose handwashing sink; greasy floors and hood
summary: The prep area handwashing sink next to the dish machine is loose and needs repair. The floor under the dish stations and around the grease trap needs detail cleaning. The hood system and filters have grease and dust buildup. These are upkeep issues.

headline: Disposable utensils not protected
summary: Disposable forks and spoons were not protected from customer contamination. The inspector instructed the staff to store them in a way that protects the mouth-contact end. The inspection passed.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate; milk crates used
summary: No valid city sanitation certificate was provided for employees. A certified manager must be on site whenever TCS foods are prepared, and a citation was issued. Milk crates are used as shelving and must be replaced. Water-stained ceiling tiles need repair.

headline: Greasy fryer and dirty containers; ceiling tiles
summary: The interior of the deep fryer has grease, dirt and debris. The outside of bulk ingredient containers is soiled. Water-stained ceiling tiles in the dining area and restroom need replacing. Floors need detail cleaning. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No certified manager; no sanitizer test kits
summary: No person in charge had food manager training, and no valid city sanitation certificate was on site while food was prepared. Test kits for the dish machine and three-compartment sink were missing and a citation was issued. Other upkeep items were also noted.

headline: Untagged shellstock; unapproved pickling process
