summary: About 50 lb of oysters and mussels had no shellstock tags and were discarded, about $265. A pickling process lacked an approved plan; affected foods were discarded. Duck lacked date labels and about 30 lb was discarded. Basement ceiling tiles are damaged and trash is stored under equipment.

headline: No food thermometer; overflowing outdoor garbage
summary: No metal-stem probe thermometer was on site to check food temperatures. The outside garbage receptacle lid did not fit and the receptacle was overflowing, which can attract pests. Walls with dried food splatter need cleaning.

headline: Rusted shelving; debris in cooler
summary: Shelving above the three-compartment sink and inside the three-door cooler is rusted and must be repainted or replaced. Debris is inside the cooler and mop sink. Leaking pipe under the sink must be fixed. Holes in dining room brick walls need sealing.

headline: Undated food; unlabeled items; torn gasket
summary: Ready-to-eat TCS foods in the refrigerator were not date marked. Peppers and sugar stored outside original containers lack labels. A front cooler gasket is torn and ice buildup is on the walk-in freezer floor. Food stored in plastic grocery bags. Allergen training missing.

headline: Dispenser nozzles and floors need cleaning
summary: Drink dispenser nozzles have buildup and must be cleaned. Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. Cooking equipment sides, main prep floors, dry storage floors and hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Dead roaches throughout kitchen
summary: Dead roaches were found on floors and walls throughout the kitchen. The person in charge was instructed to remove them and sanitize areas. Rust is on walk-in shelving, and food grime is in a cook line cold unit. Walls and floors need detail cleaning, and hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Raw wood shelf in dish room
summary: A raw wood shelf in the dish room must be painted to create a smooth, easily cleaned surface. The re-inspection passed.

headline: Unlabeled flour and sugar containers
summary: Flour, sugar and other food storage containers under the prep table in the rear baking area must be labeled. Soil buildup on shelving inside the walk-in cooler must be cleaned.

headline: Torn cooler gasket
summary: The torn door gasket on the left door of the three-door prep cooler must be replaced. This re-inspection passed.

headline: No sanitizer at dish machine; live roaches found
summary: The low-temperature dish machine had no chlorine sanitizer at final rinse and must reach 100 ppm; a citation was issued. Five live roaches were found on walls, floors, bread boxes and trash bags in food prep. Ice machine has heavy slime and mold. Additional pest control is needed.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; gaps at entry doors
summary: No vomit and diarrhea procedure or cleanup kit was on premises. Small openings at the bottom of the front and rear entry doors must be closed to rodent-proof them. Raw wood shelves need sealing and the toilet room door needs a self-closing device.

headline: No certified manager on duty; expired certificates
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were prepared, and certificates on site were expired. The ice machine interior was not cleaned. To-go containers were used as serving scoops. Allergen training was missing and a citation was issued.

headline: Gap under front door could allow pests
summary: A gap about one-quarter inch wide is at the bottom of the front entrance door. The door must be made tight-fitting across the bottom to prevent pest entry. No pests were found during this re-inspection.

headline: Clogged prep sink; missing allergen training
summary: The hand sink in the prep and dishwashing area is clogged and will not drain; it must be repaired. The washroom door's self-closing device is in poor repair. The certified food service manager lacks required allergen training, or citations will follow.

headline: Front handwashing sink removed after leak
summary: The handwashing sink beside the ice machine was uninstalled due to a leak and must be reinstalled. A backup sink is about 5 feet away in rear storage. The high-temperature dish machine leaks onto the floor during washing. Floors under equipment are soiled.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate posted
summary: No valid city sanitation certificate was posted, and the certificate holder was not on site while TCS foods were prepared; a citation was issued. Floor drains and the dishwasher vent have buildup and need cleaning.

headline: Rat droppings found; cooked food too cool
summary: About 20 rat droppings were found in several areas, plus a dead rodent under an unused cooler. A pest control service is needed. Cooked food was held too cool, and about 27 lb was discarded. Hot water was not running and gaps remain at doors.

headline: Ice scoop stored inside ice machine
summary: An ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine, and staff were instructed how to store it between uses. Leaking drainpipes at the three-compartment sink and family restroom sink must be repaired. Food debris and spills under dry shelving need cleaning.

headline: No health policy; broken thermometer
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site at the time of inspection. A two-door cooler's thermometer is broken. An unused bar cooler and a leaking pipe under the three-compartment sink need attention. Three bulbs in the cook-line hood are burnt out. Food handler cards and allergen training were not on site.

headline: Scoops stored in containers; allergen certificate missing
summary: Scoops for dry storage containers were stored inside the containers and must be stored properly between uses. A city certified food manager had no proof of allergen training certificate. This re-inspection passed.

headline: Unlabeled refrigerated food; dirty hood
summary: Food items in refrigerators are unlabeled and must be labeled with product names. Serving plates must be stored upside down. Washroom trash cans need lids. Grease and dirt buildup is on the exhaust hood, filters and pipes and must be cleaned.

headline: Restroom hot water too cool; expired certificates
summary: Restroom handwashing sinks measured 61.5F to 93.2F; 100F is required. Hot water is now provided. Expired shellfish tags lacked sale dates. Food containers need common-name labels, a splash guard is needed, and some ice machine and walk-in parts need repair. Some food handler training is expired.

headline: Gaps at doors; food stored in cardboard
summary: A gap at the bottom of the front door and patio door must be repaired. Food and paper goods in the outside walk-in must be raised off the floor. Cups and bowls were stored inside bulk containers. Cardboard and foil must be removed. A door handle is missing.

headline: Leaking hot-water handles at restroom sinks
summary: Middle and right handwashing sinks in the women's first-floor restroom leak from the hot water handles while running. Repair and maintenance were instructed. This is a plumbing issue only.

headline: No hot water on site; signage and thermometers missing
summary: No hot water was on site. Sink water measured 69F to 76F, but handwashing sinks need 100F and the three-compartment sink needs 110F. Handwashing signs, cold-unit thermometers, lidded restroom receptacles and food handler certificates are missing.

headline: Trays stored upright; cooler gaskets torn
summary: Single-use black trays were stored facing up on a prep table and must be inverted to protect them from overhead contamination. Two torn gaskets on the inside of a two-door prep cooler need repair.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; cluttered storage
summary: Handwashing signs are missing at sinks in customer and employee toilet rooms. Dry storage containers lack common-name labels. Cardboard and clutter in the rear storage area must be removed so all areas can be accessed.

headline: No certified manager while handling TCS food
summary: No city sanitation manager was on premises while pizza, hot dogs and chicken wings were handled, and a citation was issued. The person in charge lacks a certificate. A food handler had no hair restraint. The three-compartment sink and walk-in shelves need cleaning.

headline: Freezer and counter cleaning needed
summary: The ice cream display freezer must be defrosted and cleaned, and display racks need cleaning. The counter under the slushie machine needs spill cleaning. Floors under the chip rack and along walls need cleaning. A food handler lacks food handler training.

headline: Torn gaskets on reach-in cooler
summary: Torn door gaskets on a reach-in cooler under the barista station must be repaired and maintained. This is a general equipment upkeep issue.

headline: Hair restraints, wiping cloths, and floor cleaning
summary: Employees in prep areas did not wear hair restraints. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer. Stained cutting boards, dirty cooking equipment and a trash receptacle without a lid were noted. Ceiling tiles are water-stained and floors need detail cleaning.

headline: Many foods held too warm; food handler certificates
summary: Ham, stew, cabbage, milk, cheese and eggs were at 46.8F to 71.8F in refrigeration units. About 12 lb was discarded. Refrigerators lack thermometers, food is unlabeled, and floors are heavily soiled. Food handler certificates were missing for workers.

headline: No health policy; overflowing dumpster
summary: No written employee health policy was on premises, and a citation was issued. The outside dumpster is overflowing and garbage is on the ground around it, which is a food source and harborage area for rodents and other pests. Several other violations were noted.

headline: Hot and cold food held at unsafe temperatures
summary: Pork sausage (118.2F) and bacon (118.9F) in the hot-hold unit were below 135F; about 5 lb was discarded. Tuna, chicken salad and sliced tomatoes at 45.7F to 51.7F were in the deli cooler; about 25 lb was discarded. Upkeep issues also noted.

headline: Plates not inverted; hole in wall
summary: Plates in the rear storage area were not stored upside down. Food debris and residue were found in a cooler gasket track. The baseboard under the compartment sink is peeling, and a hole is in the west wall behind a chest freezer.

headline: Worn vegetable slicer; leaking restroom faucet
summary: A vegetable slicer in poor repair has cloth wrapped around its hinge and must be repaired or replaced. The rear restroom handwashing sink faucet leaks but still works. The outdoor waste enclosure has excessive leaf litter.

headline: Passed; missing hand-washing sign and debris
summary: Passed. Hand-washing sign missing at middle bar sink. Debris under equipment, along walls and corners in bar, prep and storage areas. Certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Pass with conditions; manager certificate not posted
summary: Pass with conditions. No City of Chicago certified food manager certificate posted on site; citation issued. No hand-washing sign in toilet room. Cutting boards with deep scratches must be resurfaced or replaced.

headline: Passed; foil lining on prep shelves
summary: Passed. Foil paper lines prep area shelves; inspector instructed removal and cleaning to avoid hiding places for pests.

headline: Passed; backflow device leak, loose tile
summary: Passed. Backflow device above utility closet sink leaks when water runs; must be repaired. Loose floor tile in rear dining room to be resealed. Certified food managers lack allergen training certificates.

headline: Passed; missing splashguard, unlit walk-in cooler
summary: Passed. Splashguard missing between prep sink and warewashing unit. Cutting board has dark grooves. Warewashing unit exterior and discharge lines have heavy calcium and black buildup. Walk-in cooler has no light.

headline: Failed; repeat violations, no public summary
summary: Failed. Repeat violations from a previous inspection not corrected: ice machine buildup, expired food handler and allergen certificates (citation). Public inspection summary not posted. Torn cooler gasket; hand-washing sign missing; unused freezer on site.

headline: Passed; prep cooler at 55.6°F
summary: Passed. Reach-in prep cooler across from grill read 55.6°F with no food inside at start; must be repaired before use. Worn walk-in door gasket and food spillage on soda nozzles also noted.

headline: Pass with conditions; customer's dog inside
summary: Pass with conditions. Customer with pet dog inside. Live animals may not be allowed in food establishments (citation issued). Freezer chest lacks locks; ice scoop handle touched ice; calcium buildup inside ice machine; dusty griddle filters.

headline: Passed; improper sink stoppers, uninverted equipment
summary: Passed. Multi-use equipment not inverted during storage. Plastic lining on basement upright freezer door must be removed. Three-compartment sink stoppers are improper; plastic gloves were used around the stopper.

headline: Passed; backflow devices and sink needed
summary: Passed. Backflow prevention devices needed on coffee machine and ice machine water lines. One-compartment prep sink is not attached to water lines or drain. Wall tiles missing.

headline: Failed; no certified manager, missing certificates
summary: Failed. Person in charge lacked a City sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was on site while chicken, rice and fish were prepared. Paper towels added on request. No pest control log or invoices. Food handler and allergen certificates missing.

headline: Passed; ice buildup in bakery freezer
summary: Passed. Excessive ice buildup on the outside of cooling equipment and on shelves in the walk-in bakery freezer. Manager instructed to clean the area.

headline: Failed; about 20 rodent droppings found
summary: Failed. About 20 small and large rodent droppings found under a cabinet near the front counter and freezer. Must remove droppings and eliminate pest activity. No backflow device on mop sink. Storage closet cluttered, items on floor.

headline: Pass with conditions; beans and lentils too warm
summary: Pass with conditions. Cooked beans (58.6°F) and lentils (57.1°F) were too warm in a cooler; about 20 lbs ($120) discarded, citation issued. Also missing cooler thermometer, unlabeled bulk containers, a sink drain leak and a dirty floor.

headline: Failed; no commercial dumpster for trash
summary: Failed. No commercial dumpster on premises for trash removal; instructed to provide one. Items stored on floor in storage closet must be raised at least 6 inches to avoid hiding spaces for pests.

headline: Pass with conditions; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Pass with conditions. Dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer; not to be used until it sanitizes properly (citation). Pasta reached 62.4–71.6°F and marinara 54.1°F; about 6 lbs ($100) discarded. Prep cooler at 49.6°F must not be used until repaired.

headline: Failed; five dead cockroaches in basement
summary: Failed. Five dead cockroaches found in basement under equipment and shelves. Hand sink removed from dish machine area; must be restored. Cooling food covered in plastic wrap; single-use bowls used as scoops; hood lacks grease-drip protection.

headline: Pass with conditions; no health policy, cleanup kit
summary: Pass with conditions. No written employee health policy and no vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies on site; both cited. Employees not wearing hair restraints; food handler training proof missing; allergen proof missing for managers.

headline: Passed; cutting boards cut, basement clutter
summary: Passed. Cutting boards at sandwich prep line have deep cuts. Floors under rear ice machine, behind cooling unit and in basement need deep cleaning. Basement has excessive clutter; unneeded items must be removed and kept items elevated 6 inches.

headline: Passed; heavy debris in coolers and displays
summary: Passed. Heavy food debris in refrigerator drawers, donut display cases, rolling carts, coffee equipment and ice cream topping containers. Loose debris, dirt and dust on floors and corners; detail cleaning and more frequent floor cleaning required.

headline: Passed; rear door gap, dead insect, greasy surfaces
summary: Passed re-inspection. Rear door not rodent-proof at bottom, and a dead insect was found on dry storage container lids. Missing thermometers in coolers, greasy floors and walls, food debris in pipes, and no allergen certificate for a certified manager.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk items, allergen proof
summary: Passed. Bulk items moved from original packaging were stored in containers without common-name labels. Bacon and sausage patties in plastic totes must move to food-grade bags or containers. No proof of allergen training for certified managers.

headline: Failed; restroom hot water too cool
summary: Failed. Women's restroom hand sink hot water reached only 74.7°F; must be 100°F minimum (citation issued). Cook-line cooler held 44.2–46°F; tagged and must be repaired before use. Outdoor grease container overflowing; repeat allergen training violation.

headline: Passed; ice bins unlidded, no prep sink
summary: Passed. Ice bins in all three bars lack lids. Boxes stored on milk crates in dry storage; shelving at least 6 inches off floor required. No prep/dump sink in the three bars; hood lights in both prep hoods not working.

headline: Passed; milk crates used as cooler shelving
summary: Passed. Milk crates were used as shelving throughout walk-in cooler areas. They must be removed and replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor for cleaning access.

headline: Pass with conditions; no certified manager during chicken prep
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager present while chicken at 145°F was prepared and served; priority violation. Refrigerator interiors and door tracks need cleaning.

headline: Passed; rear door not rodent-proof
summary: Passed re-inspection. Rear exit door leading to the dumpster is not rodent-proof at the bottom. Electric insect control device stored above food prep table near walk-in cooler must be relocated.

headline: Failed; repeat violations, missing ceilings, no thermometers
summary: Failed. Repeat violations not corrected: missing ceiling and floor tiles, missing wall bases, items stored on floor (citation issued). Home ventilation over fryers and grill must be ducted to roof with fire suppression system. New employees lack food handler certificates.

headline: Pass with conditions; dish machine sanitizer at 0 ppm
summary: Pass with conditions. Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine sanitizer, below the 50–100 ppm required; machine tagged and held (citation issued). Torn walk-in freezer door gasket. Two of three certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Passed; leaking mop sink faucet
summary: Passed re-inspection. Mop sink faucet in mop closet leaks; inspector instructed repair and maintenance.

headline: Passed; unlabeled containers, hair restraint lapse
summary: Passed. Bulk food containers lacked labels with common name. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. Wet wiping cloths were left on prep table; inspector asked cloth in use be kept in sanitizer bucket.

headline: Passed; personal items stored above food
summary: Passed re-inspection. Employee personal care items stored above dry food containers must be relocated. Plastic cups used as scoops must be replaced with handled utensils. Rear 2-door cooler interior has dried food debris.

headline: Passed; raw wood wall needs sealing
summary: Passed re-inspection. Raw wood wall in rear prep area near hot food prep must be sealed or painted to be smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Passed; manager lacked allergen training proof
summary: Passed. Certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate. Management was told all certified managers must show proof of allergen training.

headline: Failed; no person in charge with certificate
summary: Failed re-inspection. No person in charge with a valid City sanitation certificate was present (citation issued). Repeat violations not corrected: leaking sinks, broken freezer fan and gasket, damaged floors, and no freezer light. Also stained ceiling tiles and greasy hood.

headline: Pass with conditions; cold cooked foods too warm
summary: Pass with conditions. Refried beans at 54.6°F, bean-and-rice mix at 50.9°F and cabbage salad at 46.7–47.9°F were held too warm; about 7 lbs ($100) discarded. No time-and-temperature log. Ice machine interior dirty; sink stoppers broken.

headline: Failed; dish machine not sanitizing, low hot water
summary: Failed. Spill kit on site lacked matching cleanup procedure (citation). Restroom hand sinks had 72.9°F hot water; minimum is 100°F (citation). Dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer and was tagged. Food containers stored on dry storage floor.

headline: Passed; stained ceiling tiles, uneven floor
summary: Passed re-inspection. Stained or missing ceiling tiles in rear storage room and bakery must be replaced. Uneven floor between deli hand sink and three-compartment sink needs smooth repair for cleanability.

headline: Pass with conditions; hot food below 135°F
summary: Pass with conditions. Cooked chicken and turkey in hot-holding cabinets measured 114.8–128.5°F, below the required 135°F; about 12 lbs ($21) discarded. Rear door gap is a possible pest entry point. Food stored on floors. No allergen training for food manager.

headline: Passed; freezer door left slightly open
summary: Passed. Reach-in freezer door in rear area is left slightly open, letting temperature rise; must be reorganized. ICEE cabinets need detail cleaning, and floors in the Starbucks area and under ICEE cabinet need cleaning.

headline: Pass with conditions; missing hand soap and towels
summary: Pass with conditions. No hand soap at front prep station and no paper towels at rear prep and dish area; both are required for handwashing and were to be provided.

headline: Passed; food on floors, grease, unlabeled seasonings
summary: Passed. Food stored on floors inside walk-in coolers and freezers in several areas must be elevated six inches. Grease, spills and debris on prep tables, cooler shelves and floors. Bulk seasonings unlabeled; soiled wipes and missing freezer fan cover also noted.

headline: Failed; no certified manager and pest log missing
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on duty while food was served. No pest control log on site. Dead insects found on floors. Prep hand sink lacked soap, corrected during inspection. Employee health policy copies missing.

headline: Failed; CBD additive, outdated pest log
summary: Failed. CBD honey lattes were offered; unapproved additive, cannot be served (citation). Pest control log's last inspection was from 2016 (citation). No written employee health policy, no sanitizer test strips, and several food handlers lack certificates.

headline: Passed; detail cleaning and faucet leak needed
summary: Passed. Dust on basement fan covers. Several walk-in cooler and kitchen floors need detail cleaning, including ice buildup. Leaking, loose faucet at basement produce three-compartment sink. Greasy hood system needs detail cleaning.

headline: Passed; missing thermometer, loose backflow cap
summary: Passed re-inspection. 2-door reach-in cooler on main prep line lacks internal thermometer. Utility sink backflow device has a loose cap and needs repair. No certified manager with allergen training on site.

headline: Pass with conditions; hand sink blocked, food discarded
summary: Hand sink was blocked by bread and a bucket lid; manager removed them on site. Ready-to-eat food stored over 24 hours lacked date labels; about 15 lbs ($100) discarded. Expired food handler training noted; no allergen certificate.

headline: Passed; no covered restroom receptacle
summary: Passed re-inspection. Toilet room lacks a covered receptacle. Accumulated food on floors behind equipment and in wall corners needs detail cleaning. No allergen training on premises for food managers.

headline: Pass with conditions; hand-washing and temperature violations
summary: Food handler touched cheese without washing hands. Hand sink lacked soap and was blocked by a foil pan; both fixed during inspection. About 51 lbs of cold food and 3.5 lbs of hot pizza discarded; cooler tagged at 53.6°F.

headline: Passed; blown hood light bulb
summary: Passed re-inspection. Blown light bulb in kitchen hood system must be replaced.

headline: Passed; rust, backflow device, light shield dust
summary: Passed re-inspection. Rust on bottoms of prep tables must be removed. Utility mop sink in rear prep lacks a backflow device; one must be installed. Dust and dirt inside ceiling light shields above prep tables need cleaning.

headline: Passed; soda cartridge residue, cracked tiles
summary: Passed. Residue built up on soda cartridges; must be kept clean. Cracked floor tiles in walk-in cooler need repair.

headline: Passed; unlabeled food, upkeep cleaning
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food in containers in coolers, walk-in and dry storage lacks name labels. Grease, debris and dirt on floors under equipment and in corners. Dust on fans, light shields and vents. No allergen-trained manager.

headline: Failed; live roaches and mouse droppings
summary: Failed. Two live roaches were found inside the rear hand sink's soap dispenser. About 100 or more mouse droppings found on floors, equipment, shelves and in storage. Citation issued. Dead roaches on hand sink; soap missing, bottle supplied during inspection.

headline: Passed; missing signage and backflow device
summary: Passed. Front prep hand sink lacks handwashing signage. Rear prep utility sink has no backflow device; one must be installed. All-gender restroom needs a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

headline: Passed; bar sink faucet leak
summary: Passed. Leak from the base of the front bar three-compartment sink faucet; manager instructed to repair. One basement dry storage light is unshielded and must be replaced or shielded.

headline: Passed; floor hole and allergen certificate missing
summary: Passed. Hole in floor under the bar three-compartment sink must be repaired. Aprons stored on top of plates in prep area; must move to designated area. No allergen training certificate on site for certified food managers.

headline: Pass with conditions; no certified manager on site
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager on site while beef and chicken were handled; priority violation. No hand-washing signs in restrooms. Fly traps hung above open food and clean utensils. Employee purses and shoes stored in prep area.

headline: Failed; no certified manager with certificate
summary: Failed. No certified food manager with original certificate on site while open (citation issued). No pest control logbook with required records. Damaged rear door sweep must be replaced. Wiping cloth stored inside hand sink.

headline: Passed; utensil rack needs barrier
summary: Passed. Clean utensil rack next to mop sink needs a barrier to prevent contamination. Heavy dust on ceiling vent must be cleaned.

headline: Failed; repeat violations, missing backflow devices
summary: Failed re-inspection; prior violations not corrected. Backflow devices missing on ice and coffee machines and a front hand sink. Fly strips hang from ceilings in prep areas and must be removed. Three employees lack food handler certificates; manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: Failed; over 50 mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. Over 50 mouse droppings found along walls in prep, dish and dry storage areas. Worker handled ready-to-eat pork without changing gloves after washing hands in gloves (citation issued). Soap and paper towels missing at some sinks. Rear door has 1/4-inch gap.

headline: Passed; rear door gap and upkeep repairs
summary: Passed re-inspection. Inspector saw an opening at the base of the rear exit door and asked it be sealed against pests. Also noted a leaking prep-sink drainpipe, and dust on the cooler condenser and hood filters, to be cleaned.

headline: Passed; linens on floor, backflow device repair
summary: Passed. Clean linens stored directly on floor in both bulk dry storage areas; must be at least 6 inches up. Backflow device at rear utility sink is in poor repair but works; missing deflector cover. Outdoor waste enclosure has dried debris and solidified grease.

headline: Passed; allergen certificates and restroom lid needed
summary: Passed re-inspection. Trash receptacle in the west restroom needs a cover. No allergen training certificates on site; inspector instructed that all certified food managers provide them.

headline: Failed; dirty ice machine, warm cold foods, flies
summary: Failed. Ice machine had black dirt dripping into ice; all ice discarded. Cold foods held at 45.4–54.9°F; about 47 lbs ($417) discarded. Live small flies: 100 in storage, 50 at coffee station, 100 in dish area.

headline: Pass with conditions; repeat rodent droppings cleaned
summary: Pass with conditions. Repeat violation: about 25 rodent droppings in rear basement dry storage, not corrected from prior inspection. Management removed droppings and cleaned the basement on site. Citation issued.

headline: Passed; missing ceiling tile above beverages
summary: Passed re-inspection. A ceiling tile is missing above the beverage area by the rear package room; it must be installed.

headline: Passed; soap and towels at bar dump sink
summary: Passed. Hand soap and paper towels kept at bar dump sink; must be removed and kept only at designated handwashing sinks. Signage to notify employees to wash hands missing at designated sinks.

headline: Pass with conditions; no certified manager on site
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager on site while tuna, sliced deli meat and potato salad were prepared and served (priority violation, citation issued). Missing walk-in cooler thermometer; food handler training proof not shown; burned-out lights.

headline: Failed; no hot water at hand sinks
summary: Failed. Hand sinks at grill and G8 station lacked hot water (72.5°F and 93°F); engineer arrived to fix. Three-compartment sink leaks; food containers unlabeled; grease and food debris under cooking equipment; burnt-out bulbs.

headline: Passed; ice machine and microwave cleaning
summary: Passed re-inspection. Ice machine interior needs cleaning to remove buildup. Microwave interior needs detail cleaning. Leak at basement wall must be corrected and standing water removed.

headline: Failed; broken dumpster lid, missing thermometers
summary: Failed. Dumpster outside has a broken lid (citation issued). Basement and display coolers lack air thermometers. Food handler prepped without hair restraints. Tongs stored inside corn container. Restroom door not self-closing. No allergen-trained manager on duty.

headline: Pass with conditions; no manager certificate for meat
summary: Pass with conditions. No valid City of Chicago food manager certificate on premises, required for selling fresh meat. Citation issued; must be provided and maintained.

headline: Passed; floor under equipment needs cleaning
summary: Passed re-inspection. Floor under cooking equipment needs cleaning to remove food debris and buildup. Manager on duty lacks an allergen certificate and must obtain and keep one on site.

headline: Passed; scoops stored inside dry containers
summary: Passed. Scoops for bulk dry storage containers were stored inside the containers; inspector instructed proper storage between uses.

headline: Passed; freezer gaskets and food handler training
summary: Passed re-inspection. Chest freezer door gaskets and lid need repair. Worn and discolored cutting boards must be repaired or replaced. Several employees have missing or expired food handler training.

headline: Failed; food on floor, sink backup
summary: Failed. Food stored on floors in walk-in cooler and rear storage. No sanitizer test kit available (citation issued). Wastewater backs up in two sink compartments when faucet runs. Also missing employee restroom trash lid, improperly stored mops, and floor debris.

headline: Failed; dish machine wash too cool
summary: Failed. Large high-temperature dish machine wash solution measured 120°F; must be at least 150°F (citation issued). Several hand sinks ran between 77.5°F and 90.5°F; must provide at least 100°F water. Hood filters dusty.

headline: Passed; improper thawing of frozen pork
summary: Passed. Frozen pork was thawed improperly; staff told to thaw it under 41°F refrigeration, under running water, or in a microwave, then cook immediately. Several food handlers lack training certificates. Other storage and cleaning upkeep items also noted.

headline: Passed; openings at front door, ventilation issue
summary: Passed re-inspection. Openings at base and middle of front entrance door must be sealed against pests. Spills inside cold-holding units need cleaning. Stained ceiling, non-working washroom ventilation and a non-working utility closet light noted.

headline: Passed; food stored on floor
summary: Passed. Food containers stored on floors in walk-in cooler, prep and storage areas must be elevated at least six inches. Food debris and dirt under cooking equipment, along walls and in corners need cleaning.

headline: Failed; milk too warm, small flies found
summary: Failed. Milk held at 48°F, and cooler air at 48°F; half-gallon of milk discarded and cooler tagged. Observed 15 small flies, including in dining room; pest control service recommended. Food debris on floors. Manager lacked allergen certificate.

headline: Failed; truck prep cooler not working
summary: Failed. Prep cooler was not working; cold food must stay at 41°F or below. Also missing a vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit, metal stem thermometers, sanitizer test strips, a trash receptacle, and a rear door screen.

headline: Passed; splash guard needed at dish sink
summary: Passed re-inspection. Dish room hand-washing sink must get a splash guard.

headline: Passed; hand-washing sign removed from bar sink
summary: Passed. Hand-washing sign removed from bar dump sink; soap and towels only at designated hand sinks. Broken metal stem thermometer to be discarded. Encrusted grease on main kitchen ovens and dust on basement ice machine must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; basement signage and backflow device
summary: Passed. Basement prep hand sink lacks hand-washing signage. Nonfood boxes on basement storage floors must be elevated 6 inches. Basement utility sink needs a backflow device. One certified manager lacks allergen training proof.

headline: Passed; missing signage and washroom receptacle
summary: Passed. Hand-washing signs missing at washroom sinks. Single-service articles in prep not inverted. Women's washroom lacks covered receptacle. Certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Passed; floor and drain cleaning needed
summary: Passed. Prep table legs and wheels have built-up residue. Floors under equipment and all floor drains need detail cleaning. A drain cover is missing at the walk-in cooler and must be replaced.

headline: Failed; cold foods held too warm
summary: Failed. Cold foods held at 44–68.7°F; about 100 lbs ($150) discarded. Rear cooler air reached 58.7°F, and several coolers lack thermometers. Missing date labels, hair restraints lacking, and no allergen proof for managers.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk items, water-damaged ceiling
summary: Passed. Bulk dry ingredients in small white containers lack common-name labels. Water-damaged ceiling drywall must be replaced. Grease under fryers and dust and grease on fryer hood filters need cleaning. Rusting fridge bottom and missing restroom covered receptacle noted.

headline: Passed; unfinished wood shelving
summary: Passed. Unfinished wood on shelving and the backs of shelving units in front prep must be finished to be easily cleanable.

headline: Passed; flour spills and filter cleaning
summary: Passed. Downstairs restroom needs a covered receptacle. First-floor storage room floor has flour spills to clean up. Hood filters need cleaning of built-up residue.

headline: Passed; peeling plastic and overgrown weeds
summary: Passed. Peeling plastic on ice machine and oven surfaces must be removed. Excessive weeds and shrubs along the walkway to the outdoor waste area must be cleared to prevent pest hiding spots.

headline: Passed; bakery labels and debris cleaning
summary: Passed. Frosting moved into unlabeled containers in bakery. Detail cleaning needed inside coolers, walk-ins and several areas. Minor leak at bakery sink and slow drain at chef kitchen hand sink. Floor debris along walls; bakery cooler vent dirty.

headline: Failed; hair restraints and dish machine indicator
summary: Failed. Food handlers must wear effective hair restraints. Milk crates used to elevate stored items. No temperature indicator on high-temperature dish machine (citation issued). Restroom waste bins lack lids; floors under dish machine and sink have debris and pooling liquid.

headline: Passed; cleaning under equipment and hood
summary: Passed. Clean floor beneath cooking equipment. Clean grease from ventilation hood and filters.

headline: Passed; damaged shelving paint, cracked restroom wall
summary: Passed. Front counter wooden shelves have damaged paint. Restroom stucco walls have long open cracks to seal. Dust covers restroom vent system and must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; no allergen-trained manager on site
summary: Passed re-inspection. No certified food manager on site had allergen training; manager instructed to comply.

headline: Failed; over 100 mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. Over 100 mouse droppings found on floors, walls, shelves and inside fryer cabinets and an unused walk-in cooler. Manager instructed to call an exterminator and clean and sanitize. Openings along baseboards and basement ceilings must be sealed.

headline: Handwashing signs needed; dusty cooler fans
summary: Handwashing signage must be posted at prep/dish area hand sink. Dust on outside walk-in cooler fans must be removed and cleaned. Dry food debris on floors under all kitchen equipment must be detail cleaned.

headline: Missing light switch cover
summary: Light switch along basement stairs is missing a cover. Person in charge instructed to repair and seal it.

headline: No hot water; dish machine, holding units broken
summary: No hot running water at hand sinks, dish sinks, or toilet rooms. High-temperature dish machine and hot and cold holding units not working. Grease trap overflowing; leaking hand sink line. No signed employee health policies. Revolving door has gaps.

headline: Greasy basement floor; sinking pizza cooler floor
summary: Clean basement floor and floor under fryers and cooking equipment of grease, flour, and other matter. Floor in front of pizza prep cooler is in poor repair and sinking in; must be fixed.

headline: Wiping cloths misplaced; rusted ice machine screw
summary: Wiping cloths stored on splash guard above dipper well in front prep area; must be moved to a designated area. Heavily rusted screw in ice machine must be replaced.

headline: Food residue in cold unit; items on floor
summary: Food residue built up in gaskets of cold hold unit on hot line; must be cleaned. Items stored on floor in auxiliary garage storage; must be kept at least six inches off floor.

headline: No health policy; missing handwashing signs; upkeep repairs
summary: No signed employee health policy found; must be provided. Gaps around rear door must be made tight-fitting. Missing handwashing signs; coffee machine lacks a backflow device; garden hose on sink faucet. Several upkeep repairs also required.

headline: No certified manager; rust and grease; citations
summary: No certified food manager (CFM) with valid certificate on site while ground beef, nacho cheese, and Italian beef were prepared; citation issued. No thermometers in display or walk-in coolers. Garbage receptacle missing lid; citation issued. Manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Leaking fryer and faucet; cracked floor tiles
summary: Leaking fryer causing grease and oil on floor. Leaking 3-compartment sink faucet, wrapped with tape. Cracked and missing floor tiles under fryers and by utility sink. Must repair and maintain.

headline: Cold food too warm in prep coolers
summary: Beef at 55°F, chorizo 46°F, cooked yuca 45°F, empanadas 45°F, and chicken and potato stew 47°F in 1-door prep coolers; must be kept at 41°F or below. Citation issued. Clean bottom of freezer in food prep area.

headline: About 40 rodent droppings in storage area
summary: About 40 small rodent droppings in rear storage area, on shelves, floors, near register, ATM, and under food racks. Pest control service recommended; no citation issued. Thermometers needed in 9-door cooler.

headline: Raw meat over ready food; hand sink blocked
summary: Raw meats stored over ready-to-eat foods, all removed. Rear hand sink blocked by buckets and mops; owner cleared it during inspection. Cold foods at 47–55°F and undated prepared foods discarded. Grape leaves held at 131°F; must reheat to 165°F.

headline: 40 rodent droppings on deep fryers; citation issued
summary: About 40 rodent droppings on underside of deep fryers in food prep area; pest control recommended; citation issued. Also: employee hair restraint missing, overflowing toilet room trash, water-stained ceiling tiles, and repeat violations not corrected.

headline: Dirty magnetic knife holder at sushi line
summary: Magnetic knife holder at sushi line had dirt and food debris; instructed to clean, sanitize and maintain.

headline: Chicken held over 7 days; toilets inoperable
summary: Chicken stored over 7 days, labeled with discard date of 2/18; about 2 pounds ($30) discarded; citation issued. Toilets on north side inoperable, must be repaired. Manager lacks proof of allergen training.

headline: Leaking faucets, missing backflow device, greasy equipment
summary: Leaking faucet at utility sink and 3-compartment sink; no backflow device on utility sink. Greasy cooking equipment sides; hood filters dusty. Toilet lacks a lid; wall splatter in food prep area must be cleaned.

headline: Live flies in bar, prep, and dining areas
summary: About 20 small flies and 2-3 large flies seen in basement, prep, bar, and dining areas. Flies were harboring in an opening under a bar handwashing sink. Pest control recommended; citation issued. Unlabeled containers also noted.

headline: No valid food handler certificates posted
summary: No valid food handler certificates were posted for food handling employees. Management instructed that all must show valid proof of food handler training.

headline: Door gap and no allergen certificates
summary: 1/4-inch gap at front entrance door sweep must be rodent-proofed. Slight buildup inside ice machine must be cleaned. No allergen training certificates for food managers on premises.

headline: Greasy equipment sides and dirty floors
summary: Sides of cooking and non-cooking equipment need detail cleaning to prevent possible pest or insect activity. Floors along walls behind equipment need detail cleaning.

headline: Grease buildup on fryers and cooking equipment
summary: Excess grease inside fryers; exterior of cooking equipment, meat slicer, stove, and area under grill need cleaning. Basement and kitchen floors need grease and debris removed. Sinking floor in front of pizza prep cooler must be fixed. Hood vents dirty.

headline: Flies throughout; cold food too warm; coolers tagged
summary: About 15 small and 2 large flies seen in hallway, dining room, and basement storage; pest control recommended; citation issued. Cold foods at 47.7–65.3°F discarded (80 pounds, $150). Two cold holding units at 55.5–70°F tagged; not to be used.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; missing signage
summary: Multiple food handlers have expired food handler certificates; one employee's allergen training expired. No handwashing signs at prep and dish sinks; no undercooked-food advisory on menu. Opening at rear door must be sealed. Leaks and no prep sink in bar.

headline: Bar floors need deep cleaning
summary: Bar area floors need deep cleaning under and behind equipment; instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Rat infestation: about 200 droppings
summary: Rat infestation: about 200 rat droppings across basement prep and dry storage, dining area, under equipment, inside ovens, and on a chair. About 5-6 ants seen. Pest control recommended; no citation issued. Sink missing three stoppers.

headline: Deep-seamed cutting boards; dusty coolers
summary: Deli cutting boards with deep seams must be refinished or replaced. Floors along walls and under display shelves need detail cleaning. Condenser fan covers dusty in produce and meat walk-in coolers.

headline: No menu consumer advisory; damaged floors and walls
summary: No consumer advisory disclosure on menu for raw or undercooked food; priority violation, citation issued. Damaged or missing baseboards, wall surfaces, and floor tiles in prep area; damaged bar floor tile.

headline: Pink slime in ice machine; ice discarded
summary: Pink slime buildup in first-floor ice machine dripping into ice; all ice discarded. Machine must be cleaned by reinspection date. Gaps at front and rear door sweeps must be rodent-proofed. Locker room cluttered; allergen certificates missing for managers.

headline: No certified manager; rodent droppings; citations
summary: No certified food manager while butter and cheese prepared; citation issued. About 10-20 rodent droppings in basement furnace and water heater area; more pest control needed; citation issued. Also: no sanitizer test devices or food thermometer; rear door not fully rodent-proofed.

headline: No valid food sanitation certificate on site
summary: No valid City of Chicago food service sanitation certificate for the person in charge was on site; a certified manager must be present whenever TCS foods are prepared or served. Citation issued. Reach-in cooler interiors need cleaning.

headline: Dirty ice bin; unlabeled containers; foil liner
summary: Ice bin interior needs cleaning; remove ice, clean and maintain. Food storage containers lack labels with common food names. Aluminum foil used as liner on storage racks must be removed.

headline: Greasy equipment, dirty walk-in floors, leaking faucet
summary: Lower prep shelves need detail cleaning; walk-in cooler and freezer floors too. Greasy sides of equipment and dust under 10-burner unit. Leaking water knob at dish machine sprayer. Floors under equipment need detail cleaning.

headline: Caked batter on containers; loose coving; dirty floors
summary: Chicken prep counter and food containers with caked batter need cleaning. Loose coving tiles at soda machine counter. Floors along walls, under equipment, and inside walk-in cooler are dirty; remove unused boxes.

headline: Repeat grease violation; floors dirty; citation
summary: Repeat violation: heavy grease inside deep fryer electrical unit and food debris in service cooler. Grease on fryer exterior and microwave; dirty floors under pallets. No proof of food handler or allergen training; citation issued.

headline: Unused equipment must be removed from premises
summary: Unused items found: pig roasting equipment in backyard; in basement, a bag-in-box soft drink system, ice machine, cash registers, refrigerators, workout and video game equipment. Instructed to remove from premises.

headline: Dish machine lacks sanitizer; wooden board damaged
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine in final rinse; tagged and not to be used until fixed. Wooden cutting board with open seams and splinters must be replaced. Missing light shields in serving area; sanitary napkin receptacle needed.

headline: Cooler cleaning; backflow device missing on sink
summary: Reach-in cooler and two large freezers need inside and outside cleaning; steam table sides need detail cleaning. Toilet-room utility sink lacks a backflow device. Dry storage floor needs cleaning; items must be six inches off floor. Hood filters dusty.

headline: Uncovered food, broken fixtures, plastic bag storage
summary: Food uncovered in display cooler; missing door handle on prep-area cold unit. Food stored in plastic grocery bags in freezer and display coolers. Broken toilet seat; chipped ceiling paint in basement storage area.

headline: Foil on prep shelf; damaged freezer lid
summary: Aluminum foil on bottom shelf of front prep table must be removed so surface is smooth and cleanable. Interior top panel of basement deep freezer lid is damaged and held with duct tape; must be repaired properly.

headline: Pest-proof fan covers; burnt-out bulbs
summary: Exhaust fan openings on west wall of baking prep area must be pest-proofed. Chipped paint and rust on walk-in cooler wire racks. Burnt-out bulbs in baking prep area and dry storage must be replaced.

headline: Pink slime buildup in soda machine ice dispenser
summary: Minor pink slime buildup found inside the soda machine ice dispenser. Must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Front door gap; stock placement and dirty cooler
summary: 1/4-inch gap at bottom of middle front door must be repaired. Walk-in cooler stock must be six inches off floor. Dirty walk-in shelving and fan covers; ice cream freezer needs defrosting and cleaning. Rear storage and cooler floors need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; cooler food too warm
summary: No certified food manager (CFM) on site while deli meats, meatballs and tuna were served; repeat violation. Prep line cooler held food at 44.8–51.3°F; about 10 pounds ($300) discarded. Cooler at 51.8°F tagged, not to be used until repaired.

headline: No certified manager; holes and water-damaged ceilings
summary: No person in charge with sanitation manager training; no certified food manager on premises; citation issued. Rear door has 1/4-inch gaps. Also: cardboard shelf liner, no covered restroom receptacle, damaged light switch, wall holes, water-damaged ceiling tiles.

headline: Missing display door, no sanitizer test kit
summary: No test kit or strips on site for quaternary ammonium sanitizer; priority violation. Also: missing display case door on employee access side, and dim lighting in walk-in freezer.

headline: Missing sink stoppers, rust, low water pressure
summary: Basement dish room 3-compartment sink missing stoppers. Rusty shelving in rooftop walk-in cooler must be repaired or replaced. Low water pressure at basement prep hand sink. Employee belongings stored in prep areas and rooftop bar.

headline: No certified manager on site; priority violations
summary: No certified food manager (CFM) on site, including for the person in charge, while hot or cold food like pizza, pasta and chicken was prepared. Also: heavy grease on pizza oven, soiled spray nozzle, and delivery bags stored in restroom.

headline: No certified manager; flies throughout; citations issued
summary: No certified food manager (CFM) on site while hot or cold food was prepared; citation issued. About 200 or more live small flies and 25 or more large flies, including on onions. Door gaps and food stored on floors noted.

headline: Damaged cutting boards, loose ice machine lip
summary: Large cutting boards with deep grooves and stains in basement prep; ice machine inner lip coming loose, risking ice contamination; walk-in cooler floor needs detail cleaning; dirty floors in dishwashing, prep, and bar areas.

headline: Food stored under sewer lines and on floors
summary: Vegetables stored under unshielded sewer lines in basement; potato bins on cooler floor. Manager told to shield or move food and elevate items 6 inches. Torn gasket, expired food handler certificates, and expired allergen training also noted.

headline: Freezer tagged out; sink backup; bread on floor
summary: Standing freezer not functioning; tagged and not to be used until repaired and reinspected. Bread and single-use items stored on floor. Three-compartment sink backed up with waste when hand sink used; citation issued. Plumber cleaned drains on site.

headline: Ice machine debris, rusty shelves, expired allergen training
summary: Debris encrusted on upper interior of ice machine; must be removed and detail cleaned. Chipped rust on wire shelving above kitchen prep table. Certified food manager shows expired allergen training; proof must be shown.

headline: Improper thawing; broken thermometer; stained tiles
summary: Frozen cooked chicken thawed improperly; approved thawing methods required. Broken thermometer in prep line two-door cooler; must be replaced. Three water-stained ceiling tiles and chipped paint in dishwashing area.

headline: No certified manager; food too warm; door gap
summary: Person in charge lacks certified food manager (CFM) certificate; none posted while food was served. No employee health policy, no vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit, and a handwashing sink out of service. Walk-in cooler at 63°F; food at 50–63°F discarded; cooler tagged.

headline: Faucet neck leaks at rear mop sink
summary: Faucet neck at rear mop sink leaks; instructed to repair it and maintain it.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; no hair restraints
summary: No handwashing sign in employee toilet room; must be provided and maintained. Employees in rear food prep area not wearing hair restraints; all employees in prep area must wear them.

headline: Dish machine not dispensing sanitizer; tagged
summary: Chlorine dish machine not dispensing sanitizer; 0 ppm measured after several tries. Machine tagged held for inspection; must not be used until repaired and rechecked by Chicago Department of Public Health. Staff told to use three-compartment sink.

headline: Over 20 rat droppings in electrical room
summary: Over 20 rat droppings in electrical room; exterminator required; citation issued. Also: 1/4-inch gap at rear door, soiled wiping cloths on prep tables, uncovered dumpsters, no covered restroom waste receptacle, and no handwashing signs.

headline: Low hand-sink water pressure; dirty floor drains
summary: Hand sinks in unisex employee and customer washrooms need more water pressure. Dust inside light shield covers above rear dish area. Dirt and food debris in floor drains in rear dish area and unisex washrooms must be cleaned.

headline: Over 60 flies; improper pest control; citation
summary: Over 60 small flies on walls, ceiling, and dishwashing machine in basement dish room; additional pest control needed; citation issued. No utility service sink, a repeat violation. Water-damaged ceiling tiles and unsealed wall openings also noted.

headline: About 75+ live flies throughout premises
summary: About 75+ live small flies on walls, ceilings and boxes in dining, pickup and prep areas; 8-10 large flies flying. Pest control recommended; citation issued. Also: rear door gap, expired food handler training, no allergen training, summary report not displayed.

headline: No menu advisory; leaks; restroom problems
summary: No consumer advisory disclosure on menus for raw or undercooked food. Leaking faucets at hand sink and 3-compartment sink. Bar men's restroom sink, toilet, and urinal need cleaning. Water-damaged restroom ceilings; bar women's restroom fan inoperable.

headline: Uncovered food and missing thermometers
summary: Uncovered food in display cooler and bulk containers; bulk flour and sugar unlabeled. No thermometers in reach-in and display coolers. No splash guard by hand sink; some food handlers lacked hair restraints. Scoops stored inside containers.

headline: Missing wall panel above rear exit
summary: Wall panel missing above rear exit door. Must be repaired or replaced and maintained.

headline: Repeat: food handler certificates not provided
summary: Repeat violation from 6/3/24: food handler training certificates not provided for all food handling employees. Manager told all must show proof of food handler training. Priority foundation violation; citation issued.

headline: Dirty prep coolers and basement freezers
summary: Interior of front reach-in prep coolers must be cleaned. Interior of basement deep freezers needs cleaning to remove spills and debris.

headline: Mops need hanging; basement clutter to organize
summary: Mops must be hung after use to prevent small flies. Basement clutter must be organized and stored off the floor and away from walls for pest monitoring and cleaning.

headline: Rusty storage racks; missing sink drain plugs
summary: Rear storage racks show rust; manager instructed to repaint or repair so they are smooth and cleanable. Three-compartment sink lacks drain plugs; manager must provide them.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup kit
summary: No employee health policy available; signed documentation of illness-reporting responsibility required. No procedures or supplies for vomiting and diarrhea events. No drainboard on 3-compartment sink; no mechanical ventilation in washroom.

headline: Hand sink lacked hot water; no sanitizer; citations
summary: Restroom hand sink lacked hot water; person in charge fixed it, now 100.2°F on site. No chemical sanitizer, no 3-compartment dish sink, and no test kits; repacking must stop until a sink is installed. No commercial dumpster pickup. Citations issued.

headline: No proof of garbage disposal contract
summary: No record of a contract with a waste disposal company. Manager must provide proof of contract. Priority foundation violation; no citation issued.

headline: Food on floors, improper knife storage, damaged boards
summary: Food stored on floor in rear and storage areas; must be elevated six inches. Knives improperly stored between uses in deli prep area. Cutting boards with open seams and dark stains must be refinished or replaced; cardboard shelf liners must be removed.

headline: Cardboard reused as liner; dirty fryer and floors
summary: Cardboard reused as floor liner; instructed not to reuse and keep surfaces smooth. Debris on lower prep table shelves and inside fryer. No covered receptacle in toilet rooms. Dirty floors in prep area and water heater closet.

headline: No thermometer in pizza hot-hold unit
summary: No ambient air thermometer in hot-hold unit on front counter where pizza slices are held. Person in charge instructed to maintain one.

headline: No soap at hand sink; incomplete cleanup kit
summary: Cleanup kit incomplete, missing a sanitizer effective against norovirus; citation issued. No soap at rear prep hand sink; employee supplied soap during inspection. Boxed food on floor; a food handler lacks certificate.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; grocery bags in freezer
summary: Bulk food not labeled in main kitchen; must label and maintain. Grocery bags used to store food in freezer; instructed to use proper food bags.

headline: Pork belly in plastic bags; burned-out light
summary: Frozen pork belly stored in plastic grocery bags in freezer; management told to use food-grade storage bags and containers only. Burned-out light bulb in prep hood system must be replaced.

headline: Fryer cabinet debris; no allergen certificate
summary: Food debris built up inside fryer cabinets; must be cleaned. No allergen training certificate on site for certified manager; must obtain and keep on site.

headline: Electric convection oven not under hood
summary: Electric convection oven is not under the hood. Units above 11 kW must be placed under the hood.

headline: Food on floor; dirty floors; personal items stored
summary: Boxed food stored on floor under shelves in rear prep area; must be elevated six inches. Dirt and grease behind cooking equipment; detail cleaning required. Personal items of multiple food employees stored in rear prep area. Several managers have expired allergen training.

headline: Live roaches in basement storage; improper thawing
summary: 3 live cockroaches found in basement dry storage, under a table and behind a chest freezer; glue boards held dead roaches. More pest control needed; citation issued. Raw chicken was thawed improperly; approved thawing methods required.

headline: About 65 live flies; no basement handsink
summary: About 65 small live flies in first-floor bar, on plumbing fixtures, ingredient boxes, and rooftop pizza prep; pest control required; citation issued. No handwashing sink in basement beverage prep. Outside trash overflowing. One manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No handwashing signs; no drainboard
summary: No handwashing signs at any hand sink; must provide. Three-compartment sink lacks drainboard for air drying. Water-stained ceiling tile in toilet room must be replaced.

headline: No health policy; no vomit cleanup kit
summary: No employee health policy on site; verification required for each employee. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure; priority violation. Toilet room door not self-closing. No allergen training certificates for certified managers.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; greasy fryers; leak
summary: Large bulk containers in pizza prep area lack labels. Grease and dust on fryers and walk-in cooler fan cover. Leaking faucet neck at exposed rear hand sink; loose wall coving. Expired food handler and allergen certificates.

headline: No hot water from frozen pipes; toilet inoperable
summary: Pipes frozen: no hot running water, and toilet inoperable. Missing food thermometer and chlorine test strips; missing allergen training for certified manager. Required: at least 100°F at hand sinks and 110°F at 3-compartment sink.

headline: Dirty cutting boards, cooking equipment, and coolers
summary: Cutting boards need cleaning to remove food debris. Cooking equipment has grease and spills. Reach-in and walk-in coolers, freezer, and small refrigerator need cleaning; small fridge needs defrosting. Leaking 3-compartment faucet; prep floors and hood filters dirty.

headline: No certified manager; no food handler certificates
summary: No certified food manager (CFM) on site while deli sandwiches and tuna were served; citation issued. No food handler certificates on premises. No handwashing signs; wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer. Excess water on floor by dish sink.

headline: Rodent droppings found; cold hold unit too warm
summary: About 20-30 mouse droppings found on rear storage floor; more pest control needed; citation issued. Empty cold hold unit read 51.7°F and must not be used until repaired. Hand sink has a drinking-water filter attached.

headline: Hair restraints and storage issues; cleaning needed
summary: Employees in food prep area without hair restraints. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer when not in use. Multi-use utensils not stored properly. Fryer interiors and cabinets, floor drain, and walls and ceiling tiles need cleaning.

headline: About 50 live flies; no oyster shellfish tags
summary: About 50 or more live small flies in bar, prep, dish, basement storage and laundry areas; 2-4 large flies in basement. Pest control recommended; citation issued. Also: no oyster shellfish tags and no backflow device on ice machine.

headline: Dirty vents, leaking sink, and debris under shelving
summary: Dust on walk-in cooler vent fans. Leak at bottom seal of rear hand sink. Dirt and debris under shelving and equipment in rear food area must be cleaned. Raw wood shelving in bar must be painted or stained.

headline: Reheating in hot-hold unit; hot food too cool
summary: Food reheated in a hot-holding-only unit; must be reheated rapidly to 165°F first. Ground beef at 91°F and Italian beef at 83°F held too cool; discarded. No chemical test strips on site; citations issued. Deli sandwiches unlabeled.

headline: Knives improperly stored; greasy wok line floor
summary: Knives stored between prep cooler and prep table, not in a knife rack. Storage shelves, dry storage containers, cooler interiors, and fryer cabinets have excess food debris. Floor under wok line and fryers encrusted with grease and grime; detail cleaning required.

headline: Dish machine wash too cool; tagged not for use
summary: Dish machine wash solution measured 78°F; manager must ensure a minimum wash temperature of 120°F. Machine tagged not for use. No citation issued.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; food spills and debris
summary: No handwashing signs at hand sinks used by employees; manager instructed to post them. Food spills and debris on coolers, freezers, sinks, and shelving; manager told to clean and maintain.

headline: Dead roaches on floors; grease and damaged tiles
summary: Dead roaches on the floor under equipment in rear storage and dishwashing areas; manager told to remove all dead insects. Also: ice buildup in coleslaw cooler, greasy fryers and shelves, damaged floor tiles, and food spills on floors and walls.

headline: Grease and debris on fryer area and racks
summary: Grease buildup on sides of equipment in grill and fryer area; instructed to clean. Racks in several walk-in coolers have debris buildup; manager told to clean all racks.

headline: Cold food too warm; coolers tagged; citations
summary: Cold foods held at 44–60°F; manager discarded about $3,000 of food. Walk-in cooler air at 51°F, tagged. No employee health policy on site. Repeat violation: ice machine chute had black buildup. Citations issued.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; rusty shelves
summary: Rear exit door not rodent-proof; instructed to provide rodent proofing. Excess rust on rear prep table shelves must be resurfaced. Floors in front and rear prep areas need cleaning.

headline: Over 50 live fruit flies; no certified person on site
summary: Over 50 live fruit flies in the dishwashing area; management told to eliminate them. No person on site with a posted city sanitation certificate. Ice machine mineral buildup, greasy fryer, and outdated public summary; citations issued.

headline: No thermometers in cooler holding deli meat and dairy
summary: Cooler holding prepacked cold foods such as sliced deli meat and dairy has no thermometer. Toilet room door is not self-closing. Trash around the outside receptacle and cracked, missing floor tiles in rear storage noted.

headline: Door gap, dirty floors, and missing hair restraints
summary: One-inch gap between front entrance doors could allow pests. Food handlers lacked adequate hair restraints. Floors in both prep areas very dirty. Black substance in drink machine ice slot. Missing handwashing signs, covered receptacle, and allergen certificate.

headline: Live roaches found in cooler, breaker, and hood
summary: About 40 small roaches beside the prep cooler, 2 large roaches in a circuit breaker, and about 7 large roaches in the rear hood and filter system. Additional pest control service needed. No sanitizer test kit or dish machine test strips.

headline: No cooler thermometer; one hood bulb out
summary: No working thermometer inside the walk-in cooler. One ventilation hood light bulb is not working. Manager must replace both.

headline: Wiping cloths, cutting board, and cleaning needed
summary: Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. New cutting board needed at vegetable station. Food spills on front prep counter, toilet room needs cleaning, and front floors need cleaning.

headline: No certificate and no handwash sink in dishwashing
summary: Person in charge could not show food safety certificate or class enrollment. No handwash sink in rear dishwashing area and no employee health policy. No vomit cleanup supplies or metal thermometer. Grease trap and ice machine backflow device missing.

headline: Missing signs, thermometers, labels, and torn gaskets
summary: No handwashing signs in two restrooms. Thermometers could not be found in two coolers. Unlabeled basement bulk containers, an ice scoop stored in the ice maker, torn gaskets on three units, and grease and dirt buildup.

headline: Unprotected preset silverware in dining room
summary: Knives and forks preset on dining room tables were not protected. Preset tableware must be wrapped, covered, or inverted.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: Certified food manager has no allergen training certificate on site. Management was told all certified food managers must show proof.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; leaking sink faucet
summary: Bulk food storage containers not labeled and must be. Leaking faucet base at the rear three-compartment sink. Soiled mops must be stored inverted at the utility sink.

headline: About 100 mouse droppings found throughout facility
summary: About 100 mouse droppings scattered in washroom, behind freezer, unused bar, and on kitchen shelves and containers. Person in charge must remove them, sanitize, and get pest control service. Citation issued.

headline: No backflow device on rear utility sink
summary: No backflow prevention device on the rear utility sink. Person in charge must provide one that can be serviced and maintained.

headline: Cooler held at 61.9°F; moldy ice machine panels
summary: Base cooler at 61.9°F tagged; must not be used until reinspected. Food inside, including eggs at 68.7°F, was discarded (30 lbs, $375). Ice machine panels had black and pink mold-like substance. No vomit cleanup kit; handsinks blocked.

headline: No employee health policy; clutter and missing baseboards
summary: No employee health policy available. Manager must provide signed acknowledgment of duty to report food-related illness. Clutter and outside equipment to be removed. Baseboards and outlet covers missing in storage.

headline: Cracked ice machine door, leaks, expired allergen certificates
summary: Cracked interior surface on lower ice machine door. Bar three-compartment sink faucet leaks, and ice machine drain water runs onto the floor. Stained ceiling tiles and missing floor grout noted. Allergen training certificates expired.

headline: Expired handler certificates; labeling and cleaning issues
summary: Expired food handler certificates for all food handlers. Repackaged desserts and storage containers not labeled. Plastic grocery bags used for food storage in a chest freezer. Damaged freezer lids and gaskets, and grease buildup.

headline: Rear door gap; unlabeled containers; food on floor
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the rear exit door could let pests in. Food stored in unlabeled containers in coolers, walk-in, and dry storage. Food containers on floor. Front handsink lacks a splashguard. Rusted prep table.

headline: Hair restraints missing; fryers, vents, and tiles dirty
summary: Food handlers not wearing hair or beard restraints. Torn gasket on a prep cooler. Dirty deep fryers and vent filters. Leak at three-compartment faucet and low hot water pressure at handsink. Stained ceiling tiles and dirty walls and floors.

headline: Door gaps, unlabeled containers, standing water
summary: Gaps at several doors must be repaired to keep pests out. Small bar containers unlabeled and boxes on the walk-in floor. Standing water in basement near chemical shelf. Worn cutting boards and debris in bar floor drains.

headline: Live roaches found near coolers and bar
summary: Four live roaches on a cooler wheel base and under the front bar; several dead ones on floors. Two live small flies in the basement. Pest control service recommended. Also missing food handler and allergen training, and only one restroom for 30+ people.

headline: Greasy shelving; dirty bar area; low prep lighting
summary: Grease buildup on metal shelving in food prep area. Dirt and debris under and around bar equipment. Food prep area lighting is low and must be brighter for cleaning and maintenance.

headline: Missing signs, dirty basement, clutter
summary: No handwashing signs near the basement employee washroom sink. No covered waste receptacle in that washroom. Dirt and debris on basement floors, walls, and drains. Clutter must be removed to prevent rodent harborage.

headline: Food splatter in microwave; torn cooler gaskets
summary: Food splatters inside the microwave must be cleaned. Torn gaskets on a two-door prep cooler must be sealed and repaired. Grease spills on the front of the outside oil container.

headline: Wrong inspection summary posted; no handsink soap
summary: Bar handsink had no soap. Dish machine gauge read 00°F, though its internal indicator read 160°F. Posted summary was a passing 2024 report instead of the 2025 failing one, which the inspector called deceptive. Citation issued.

headline: Mold-like substance in ice machine; ice discarded
summary: Black mold-like substance inside the ice machine touching ice. Ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned and sanitized. Also damaged cold-hold gasket, food debris in fryer cabinets, dusty fans and filters, and no women's restroom receptacle.

headline: Rear door opening; debris; dim walk-in cooler
summary: Opening at the base of the rear exit door could allow pest entry. Bug light sits above a prep table and must be moved. Crates used as shelving in walk-in, black mold-like substance under oven rack, and food debris throughout.

headline: Live roaches, flies, and blocked hand sink
summary: About 15 small flies throughout, plus live roaches including one in a dining room hand sink. Service-line hand sink was blocked, then cleared on site, and had no soap or paper towels. Dish machine rinse reached 150°F; hot water peaked at 94°F.

headline: No certified manager on site; ice machine slime
summary: No certified manager on site from 12:45 to 1:20 PM. Black slime found inside the ice machine used for ice; ice must be discarded and machine cleaned. Handwash sink made inaccessible, sink backs up, and no health policy or public summary posted.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; no pest control records
summary: No vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit on site. No pest control service or log book. Operator was instructed to obtain both.

headline: No handwash sink where bakery items prepared
summary: Bakery items were prepared in the front prep area without a handwash sink; citation not issued. Dishes not inverted. Food debris and dirt on prep trays, cutting boards, cooler interiors, and shelves. Toilet room and floors need cleaning.

headline: Cooler too warm and held; no health policy
summary: Cook-line cooler at 46.8°F (internal thermometer 50°F) was tagged and cannot be used until repaired and holding at 41°F or below. Chicken at 49.6°F and beef at 46°F discarded. No verified employee health policy on site.

headline: Sneeze guards needed; dump sink misused
summary: Soap, paper towels, and handwash signage must be removed from the one-compartment dump sink. Sneeze guards needed around front prep and cooking equipment. Milk crates and peelable plastic in cooler drawers. Construction material blocks rear walkway. No mechanical ventilation in washrooms.

headline: Live small flies on prep and dishwash walls
summary: About 20 live small flies on prep-area walls and 10 at the dishwashing area. Must be removed by reinspection; pest control service advised. Also dust on cooler condensers, food spills, and debris in prep floor drains.

headline: Dust buildup and burnt-out bulbs noted
summary: Heavy dust on ceiling vents and panels in front and rear food prep areas. Several burnt-out light bulbs above food storage shelving. Inspector ordered cleaning and bulb replacement.

headline: Rat and mouse droppings found throughout storage
summary: About 100 rat and mouse droppings in rear storage, walk-in cooler, and under shelves, plus about 20 by the rear exit. Management must remove them; more pest control needed. Overflowing dumpster and milk crates used as shelving.

headline: Ice buildup in freezer to be removed
summary: Single-door freezer interior has ice buildup. Person in charge must remove it and maintain the freezer.

headline: Hair restraints missing; leak under sink
summary: Food handlers prepping food without hair restraints. Person in charge told all food handlers must wear one. Leak under the three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Live flies found; facility placed on 2-day workaround
summary: About 200 live small flies in the garbage room and 40 in the women's employee washroom. A prior pest violation was not corrected. The city put the premises on a 2-day workaround. Expired food handler certificate and missing allergen certificates also noted.

headline: Expired allergen training for certified manager
summary: Food allergen training certificate for a certified manager has expired. Certified food managers must have updated certificates.

headline: No covered receptacle in women's washroom
summary: Women's washroom has no covered receptacle. Manager instructed to provide and maintain one.

headline: No health policy, no vomit cleanup supplies
summary: No written employee health policy on site. Vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies missing, including mop, gloves, mask, and sanitizer effective against norovirus. Grime on rear meat prep floor. No proof of food handler training.

headline: No certified manager on site; prior violation uncorrected
summary: Person in charge lacks a city sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was present while TCS foods were prepared and served. Front and side doors have about 1/4 inch gaps at the bottom. Raw or undercooked food advisory from prior inspection not corrected.

headline: No manager on site; ice machine mold-like substance
summary: No certified manager on site with the original certificate; one must be present at all times. Basement ice machine has black mold-like substance and no backflow device. No vomit cleanup procedure or kit, and missing hood filters.

headline: Unlabeled packaged foods; items stored on floor
summary: Prepackaged foods throughout the facility lack proper labels, which must show common name, ingredients, net quantity, and packager name and address. Food and drink items stored on the floor must be elevated at least 6 inches.

headline: Detail cleaning needed; leaking sink faucets
summary: Filtering equipment, drink dispenser nozzles, and hot-holding equipment need detail cleaning. Leak at three-compartment sink faucets. Floors in several areas need detail cleaning. Unnecessary items in rear storage must be removed.

headline: Cold food at 52 to 73°F; hand sink water too cool
summary: Cold TCS foods held at 52.5 to 73.2°F; corrected on site, and 95 lbs ($230) discarded. Men's room hand sink water reached only 76.6°F; must be at least 100°F. No vomit cleanup procedure or supplies. Rear door gap could let pests in.

headline: No written employee health policy on premises
summary: No written employee health policy on the premises. Management must provide a signed policy for each employee and maintain it. Priority violation.

headline: Cold food held too warm; cooler tagged
summary: Cold TCS foods (food that must stay cold) held at 60.2 to 64.3°F in the prep cooler. About 50 lbs, roughly $100, discarded. Cooler tagged and must not be used until reinspected. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedures or supplies.

headline: No certified manager at start; corrected on site
summary: No certified manager on site at the start of inspection while TCS foods were prepared and served. Corrected on site when the manager arrived at 3:05 PM; citation issued. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door could let pests in.

headline: Fresh water inlet unsecured; grease and dirt buildup
summary: Mobile food preparation vehicle (MFP) lacks required license number on its sides. Fresh water inlet not secured; a lock-equipped door is needed. Excess grease in fryers and dirt under the grill and sink. Minor leak under the wastewater tank.

headline: Uncovered food; cups used as scoops; expired allergen training
