summary: Food containers uncovered in a prep cooler. Plastic and foam cups submerged in food and used as dispensing utensils. Improper plastic wrap used as sink stoppers. Cardboard under floor mats. Manager allergen training expired.

headline: Missing thermometers and labels; hair restraint lapse
summary: No thermometers in reach-in, freezer, and display coolers. Food storage containers unlabeled. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Wet wiping cloths and utensils stored on prep surfaces, and food sits in plastic grocery bags. Two ceiling holes noted.

headline: Coolers too warm; certified manager not on site
summary: Small kitchen refrigerator air at 54.0°F; tagged and must stay out of use until repaired and reinspected. Chicken at 50.1°F, milk at 52.1°F, and soup at 55.0°F discarded. No certified manager on site while TCS foods were prepared.

headline: About 30 live flying insects; no certified manager
summary: No certified food manager on site while TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. About 30 live small flying insects on walls and ceiling tiles in dishwashing room and mop sink area; more pest control needed; citation issued.

headline: Missing food handler training for multiple employees
summary: Food stored on the floor in prep area must be elevated 6 inches. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer. Multiple food handlers are missing food handler training; verification must be kept on site.

headline: No handwash sink where food is prepared
summary: Basement prep area has no handwash sink, though a grinder, meat slicer, and sausage stuffer are used there. Sink must be installed or equipment removed. Ice scoops stored touching wall, and missing ceiling tiles.

headline: No thermometers in coolers; cleaning needed
summary: Missing handwashing signage at the front prep handsink. No thermometers visible in prep and reach-in coolers. Detail cleaning ordered for toaster oven, sinks, ice machine interior, floors, and washroom ceiling vent.

headline: No certified manager on premises while handling milk, deli
summary: Person in charge has no city sanitation manager certificate; must provide one. No city sanitation manager on premises while milk and deli meats were handled. Citation issued.

headline: Fly trap over prep table; no certified manager
summary: No certified manager on site while chicken was prepared; citation issued. Electric fly trap sits directly over a rear prep table and must be moved. Also no proof of person-in-charge food safety training, missing hair restraints, unlabeled cookies, and no allergen training.

headline: Leaky pipe under three-compartment sink
summary: Leaky pipe found under the three-compartment sink. Must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Hair restraint lapse and uncorrected prior violations
summary: Employee not wearing hair restraint during food prep. Prior violations not corrected, including a dirty ice machine interior and wiping cloths not kept in sanitizer. Also clutter, unelevated basement storage, and dust.

headline: Unapproved vacuum sealing; about 50 flies found
summary: About 50 live small black flies in bar, tasting room, prep, dishwashing, and dining areas. Pest control advised. Vacuum-sealed TCS foods had no approved plan; about $310 of food discarded and the machine held. Dish machine test strips missing.

headline: No certificate posted; dirty ice machine and floors
summary: No certified food manager certificate posted, though hamburgers and chicken wings are served; citation issued. Ice machine guard dirty. Rusty basement walk-in racks. Grease, food debris, and dirt under cooking equipment and along prep walls.

headline: Dish machine final rinse too cool at 145°F
summary: High-temperature dish machine final rinse measured 145°F; it must reach 180°F. Multi-use utensils must be washed, rinsed, and sanitized at the three-compartment sink or another properly sanitizing machine.

headline: Missing signs, thermometers, and allergen certificate
summary: No handwashing signs at toilet room or front prep handsinks. No air thermometers in refrigerators or hot-holding unit. No lidded garbage in all-gender toilet room. Certified manager has no allergen training certificate.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen training records
summary: Food handler training missing for employees, and allergen training missing for food managers. Also unlabeled containers, plastic bags used for food storage, worn gaskets, grease buildup, and burnt-out lights.

headline: Chicken and lettuce above 41°F in display cooler
summary: Chicken at 44.4°F and shredded lettuce at 45.1°F in the food display cooler. Manager voluntarily discarded 3.5 lbs, valued at $15. Citation issued.

headline: Black slime in ice maker dripping into ice
summary: Black slimy substance on the interior water components of the ice maker, dripping into ice used for consumption. Machine must be turned off, ice removed, and interior cleaned and sanitized. Citation issued.

headline: Missing handwashing signs in employee restrooms
summary: Handwashing signs missing in employee restrooms. Management must provide and maintain them.

headline: 30 to 40 ants on candy shelf; no pest logbook
summary: About 30 to 40 ants crawling on a shelf with candy. Manager told to clean and contact pest control. No current pest control logbook; last date on site is 2019. Also no paper towels or hand dryer and no vomit cleanup kit.

headline: Lead-safety documentation needed for ceramic cups
summary: Ceramic and clay drinking cups and bowls on site must be lead-free or lead-safe with documentation kept on site, or removed. Torn door gasket on an upright cooler.

headline: Leak at prep handsink pipe
summary: Leaking at the bottom pipe of the prep handwash sink. Must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Rust on freezer shelving; ceiling holes
summary: Rust found on shelving in the rear walk-in freezer. Holes in the basement dry storage room ceiling must be sealed.

headline: No posted certificate; menu lacks raw-food advisory
summary: No valid food sanitation certificate posted; a certified manager must be present while TCS foods are prepared. Menu lacked consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods. Prior violations uncorrected; citation issued.

headline: Missing signs, stoppers, receptacles, and allergen training
summary: No handwashing sign at bar handsink. Plastic trays used for rice need long-handled utensils. Plastic stoppers at bar sink. No covered receptacles in staff washrooms. Stained ceiling tiles, dusty vents, a non-working fan, and missing allergen training.

headline: No city sanitation certificate posted for employees
summary: No valid city food sanitation certificate posted for food employees. Original certificate must be posted with a certified manager on site whenever TCS foods are stored. Citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled containers and torn cooler gaskets
summary: Food storage containers in the prep area must be labeled. Two-door beverage cooler has torn gaskets that need repair.

headline: Missing base coving; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Missing base coving near the front door must be replaced. Certified manager has no food allergen training; manager instructed to comply.

headline: Wiping cloths left out; floor needs cleaning
summary: Several wet wiping cloths stored on top of prep and steam tables. Management instructed to store them in sanitizer when not in use. Floor beneath cooking equipment and prep coolers must be cleaned.

headline: Missing stopper for three-compartment sink
summary: Three-compartment sink is missing a proper stopper. Management must provide and maintain one.

headline: Three-compartment sink backs up; drainage repair needed
summary: Torn gaskets on two-door freezers and coolers in rear storage. Three-compartment sink backs up into adjacent compartments when drained; drainage system or grease trap must be serviced. Citation issued. Loose faucet noted.

headline: Missing signs; items on floor; leaks and soiling
summary: Bar and main kitchen handwash sinks lack hand-washing signage. Bulk dry containers unlabeled. Single-use articles stored on floors. Bar handsink drain leaks. Outdoor waste lid cracked. Beer walk-in and utility sink soiled.

headline: No hot water found; restored on site
summary: No hot running water found throughout the premises. Hot water reached only 49.3°F at several sinks. Owner fixed the water tank and temperature was restored to 110°F on site. Splashguards and fryer wall cleaning needed.

headline: Unlabeled containers, food on floor, no hair restraints
summary: Small and bulk food containers unlabeled in rear prep. Bin of powder containers stored on the floor. Food handlers in prep areas without hair restraints. Clutter in hot water tank closet.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit or pest logbook
summary: No vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit on site; manager instructed to provide one. No pest control logbook on site; manager instructed to provide it. Both are priority violations.

headline: Lamb held at unsafe temperature; food discarded
summary: Cooked lamb measured 79.0 to 82.7°F, and TCS foods sat in pots on the prep table. Management discarded 35 lbs, valued at $600. Also expired food handler and allergen certificates, no cooler thermometers, food boxes on floor, and rear door left open.

headline: Improper thawing; labeling and cleaning issues
summary: Frozen egg rolls thawed on a dry storage shelf at 41.9°F; food handler was told proper thawing methods. Unlabeled bulk containers, food in plastic bags, missing hair restraints, and grease and debris buildup.

headline: Cutting boards with open seams and stains
summary: Cutting boards with open seams and dark stains must be refinished or replaced and maintained.

headline: Ice scoop stored in bin; loose cooler gaskets
summary: Ice scoop improperly stored inside the ice bin; a clean container is required. Rubber gaskets on several coolers are not tight-fitting, and a dry room cooler door is loose and damaged.

headline: Greasy fryer interior; ice machine backflow device not located
summary: Interior of the fryer has grease debris and must be cleaned. Inspector could not find the backflow prevention device on the ice machine; it must be located or provided.

headline: Clutter in deli area; stained washroom ceiling tile
summary: Items stored in unused deli area and sinks; must be organized to avoid clutter. Empty cardboard boxes should go to disposal. Water-stained ceiling tile in the washroom must be replaced where needed.

headline: No certified manager on duty; allergen training missing
summary: No city certified food manager on duty while TCS foods were prepared, handled, and served; citation issued. Soiled mop heads must be hung. Food service sanitation manager lacks food allergen training certificate.

headline: Pest entry gap, unlabeled food, upkeep issues
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door could let pests in. Unlabeled frozen sausage on display; eggs and seasonings on floors. Ice buildup and missing sink stopper. Also stained ceiling tiles, damaged floors, and peeling paint.

headline: Dirty drains, grease, and dusty heat lamps
summary: Dishwashing area drains need detail cleaning. Grease and dust on the sides of main kitchen cooking equipment. Dust buildup on heating lamps over the food holding line, which could contaminate food.

headline: Meat thawed at room temperature; rear door gap
summary: Ground meat was thawing at room temperature on a wire rack in pizza prep; proper thawing methods required. Small opening at bottom of rear exit door must be rodent-proofed. Splash guard needed at pizza-area handsink.

headline: Door gap, cluttered storage, and missing public summary
summary: Gap between front entrance doors could allow pest entry. Rear storage is cluttered and stock is not elevated 6 inches. A bulb is burnt out. Last inspection summary was not posted; today's is now displayed.

headline: Missing training certificates; dirty floors, cardboard liners
summary: Only two food handler certificates shown; all food handlers need them. Certified manager lacks allergen training. Chicken blood, grease, and debris on walk-in and prep floors. Cardboard shelf liners and missing handwash signs.

headline: No allergen training; missing restroom receptacles
summary: Unisex restrooms lack covered receptacles for sanitary products. No certified food manager with allergen training was found. Documentation must be provided.

headline: Handwash sink needs repair; door not self-closing
summary: Toilet-room handwash sink would not run water without holding the mixed-water knob. It must run at least 15 seconds without reactivation. Employee locker room door is not self-closing.

headline: Failed: blocked handwash sink; overflowing dumpster
summary: Failed. Bar-area handwash sink not accessible, filled with cleaning liquid soaking a hose (citation). Missing handwash signs. Improper wiping cloth and utensil storage; plates not inverted. Dumpster lids open from overflowing trash (citation).

headline: Passed; unlabeled salt container
summary: Passed. Bulk salt container not labeled. Inspector instructed the operator to label it and maintain labeling.

headline: Failed: flies found; meat thawed improperly
summary: Failed. About 25 small flies throughout bar area (citation). Bar handwash sink lacked paper towels, supplied during inspection. Meat thawed improperly; no sanitizer test kit; sink stoppers missing; plumbing problem at rear dish area.

headline: Passed; hair restraints and wiping cloths issues
summary: Passed. Staff prepared food without hair restraints. Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables instead of in sanitizer. Excess ice in a freezer, dusty vent, floor debris, and peeling paint on walls need cleaning.

headline: Cold food held too warm; 100 lbs discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Raw meat, sausage, cheese and eggs in walk-in cooler measured 52.5–55.9°F; about 100 lbs discarded. Cooler tagged held and not to be used until reinspected. Also a damaged door gasket and leaking drain.

headline: Passed; wiping cloths on counters; greasy hood
summary: Passed. Damp wiping cloths stored on counters, not in sanitizer. Maintenance tools stored above open food containers. Ventilation hood system heavily soiled with grease and dust.

headline: Passed; door screen and grease trap needed
summary: Passed. Double side door needs a mesh screen to prevent pest entry. No grease trap for 3-compartment sink; operator instructed to provide one.

headline: Passed; pots too large for sink
summary: Passed. Pots too large for 3-compartment sink. Operator must provide a written procedure to wash, rinse and sanitize them outside the sink, or remove large pots.

headline: Certificate posted late; sink fixes made on site
summary: Pass with conditions. No person with original city sanitation certificate on site; certificate delivered and posted before inspection ended (citation). Handwash sink water 90.1°F, repaired to 106.5°F. Sanitizer at 0 ppm, refilled to 400 ppm.

headline: Failed: no hot water at staff sink; food on floor
summary: Failed. No hot water at staff washroom handwash sink (39.4°F); at least 100°F required (citation). Food and single-use items stored on floors. Leaking prep sink faucet. Only one valid food handler certificate; no manager allergen training.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk food; no handwash sign
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign at hand sink by pizza ovens. Bulk flour and sugar containers unlabeled. Dry storage racks under basement sewer pipes must be relocated.

headline: Passed re-inspection; no allergen training proof
summary: Passed. No proof of allergen training for certified food managers on site. Anyone holding the city certificate must complete training and keep documentation on site.

headline: Passed; cleaning and cooler light repairs needed
summary: Passed. Inspector required cleaning of shelving under the self-serve station, dirty restroom fixtures, and repair of non-working lights in the walk-in cooler.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing sign
summary: Passed. The rear handwash sink had no handwashing sign. Inspector told the person in charge to post signs at all handwash sinks.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; cold food at 52°F
summary: Failed. No person in charge with valid sanitation certificate. Cold TCS foods at 52.1–52.5°F discarded; prep cooler at 53.1°F tagged. Food stored on floors; handwash sinks in poor repair; no pest logbook; no allergen training.

headline: Passed; dead roaches found under sink
summary: Passed. Floors under the 3-compartment sink had dirt, grease and dead roaches. Inspector required detail cleaning of floors throughout, plus the hood, filters and pipes.

headline: Failed: unlabeled food; expired manager certificate
summary: Failed. Missing ambient air thermometers in coolers, unlabeled food containers, knives stored on prep surfaces, food in plastic grocery bags, broken washroom door closer, expired manager allergen certificate, and repeat violations.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk food, backflow gaps
summary: Passed. Bulk food such as flour and sugar unlabeled. No backflow prevention device at mop sink faucet. Dishwashing hand sink loose. Sanitation manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed; food handler lacked certificate
summary: Passed. A food handler lacked a food handler certificate. Manager instructed to keep updated certificates on premises.

headline: Passed; grease, rust and wall-tile repairs
summary: Passed. Grill, fryer and floors behind cooking equipment need cleaning. Grease receptor shows rust and peeling paint. Missing wall tile in both washrooms.

headline: No drain board and no sanitizer test strips
summary: Pass with conditions. No drain board at 3-compartment sink; no sanitizer test strips for low-temperature dish machine (priority violation). Operator instructed to install and obtain.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; bare-hand contact
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on site while handling chicken, beef and pork (citation). Worker cut ready-to-eat onions without washing hands; discarded. Another handled ready-to-eat food bare-handed. No hot water at any sink (citation).

headline: Passed re-inspection; oil stored on floor
summary: Passed. Oil and other items stored on floor; must be at least 6 inches up. Certified food manager lacked food allergen training.

headline: Milk too warm; prep cooler at 66°F
summary: Pass with conditions. Milk in service coolers measured 47–55°F; 10 lbs ($38) discarded (citation). Prep-area service cooler at 66°F; told not to use until it holds 41°F or below. Leaking hot water faucet at handwash sink.

headline: Passed; missing training certificates and stoppers
summary: Passed. No food handler training certificates on premises, and no allergen certificate for the food manager. Also a 1/4-inch rear door gap, missing 3-compartment sink stoppers, and no covered washroom trash cans.

headline: Passed; missing sink stoppers and splash guard
summary: Passed. The 3-compartment sink lacked stoppers, and no splash guard sat between the hand sink and 3-compartment sink. Operator instructed to obtain and install both.

headline: Passed; spills in drink area coolers
summary: Passed. Spillage on shelves of small coolers under the drink prep counter, and spills and residue on the outside of a portable ice bin. Person in charge instructed to clean.

headline: Passed; torn gaskets; cracked floor tiles
summary: Passed. Torn rubber gaskets on reach-in cooler behind cashier line; repair. Grout lines and cracked floor tiles near 3-compartment sink cause standing water; repair and keep dry.

headline: Passed; restroom faucet sprays; debris on floors
summary: Passed. No splashguard at handwash sink by tortilla toaster oven. Food debris on kitchen floors. Men's restroom faucet sprays water. Standing water before dish machine; failing ceiling beam supports in dish room.

headline: Passed re-inspection; no food handler training
summary: Passed. Inspector observed no food handler training for employees. Operator must provide and maintain it.

headline: Passed; unlabeled desserts; debris in coolers
summary: Passed. Some desserts in display cooler lacked labels. Food debris and buildup in cracks of display cooler and wire racks of beverage cooler; clean and maintain.

headline: Hand-washing lapses; raw fish near cooked food
summary: Pass with conditions. Worker changed gloves and cooked without washing hands; manager corrected (citation). Raw salmon stored beside cooked eggplant and beef stew; discarded. Cooked chicken, lamb, chickpeas 46–47°F; yogurt 50.8°F; about 60 lbs discarded.

headline: Failed: no certified manager on site
summary: Failed. No certified food manager with valid certificate on site while preparing empanadas, milk and pork (citation). No vomit/diarrhea cleanup procedure (citation). No hand drying at prep sink. Beef thawed on prep table; unlabeled food.

headline: Failed: 10 rat droppings; blocked handwash sink
summary: Failed. 10 rat droppings in rear food storage room along wall base (citation); pest control recommended. Food carts blocked a handwash sink. Only one handwash sink in front kitchen. Food handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Passed; doors not rodent-proof
summary: Passed. Front and rear double doors have 1/4 to 1/2 inch gaps and are not rodent- or insect-proof. Water-stained ceiling tiles in women's restroom; dusty kitchen ceiling tiles. Food handler lacked certificate.

headline: Passed; boxed food on floor; torn gaskets
summary: Passed. Boxed food on basement dry storage floor must be raised six inches. Torn gaskets on 3-door refrigerator. Clutter in basement dry storage.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk food; worn cutting boards
summary: Passed. Large bulk containers need product names. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer. Worn or discolored cutting boards. Unisex washroom needs covered garbage can. Floors and hood vents need cleaning.

headline: Passed; food handler training to be ensured
summary: Passed. Inspector told the manager to ensure all food employees have food handler training, as Illinois Department of Public Health rules require.

headline: Failed: over 50 mouse droppings near furnace
summary: Failed. Over 50 mouse droppings found on floor around the furnace. Citation issued; pest control service ordered. Also improperly stored knives and heavy grease and debris on the wok line, fryers and floors.

headline: Passed; mop bucket near ice; cardboard liners
summary: Passed. Dirty mop bucket stored next to ice machine must move. Cardboard and foil used as shelf liners. Walk-in freezer had food spillage and cardboard floor liner. Knives improperly stored; certified managers need allergen training proof.

headline: Passed; raw chicken stored uncovered in freezer
summary: Passed. Raw chicken sat in an open box in the deep freezer; staff told to use food-grade bags or containers. Deep freezers had ice buildup and prep coolers needed interior cleaning. Certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed; dust on condensers, floor spills
summary: Passed. Dust on prep area cooler condensers. Food and grease spills on floor under cooking equipment, and food dust on prep area walls. Must clean floors and walls throughout prep and dish areas.

headline: No certified manager on site; training gaps
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager or original certificate on site while TCS foods handled (citation). Handwash sink blocked, then cleared; food containers used as scoops; food handler lacked training.

headline: Failed: no health policies; no handwash cleanser
summary: Failed. No signed employee health policies on site. Rear handwash sink had no cleanser. Also rusted shelves, leaking 3-compartment faucet, no grease trap, no waste removal agreement, open ceiling over walk-in cooler, and burned-out lights.

headline: Passed; foil liners on rolling carts
summary: Passed. Aluminum foil used as liner on rolling carts in front prep area. Inspector instructed removal or replacement with smooth, easily cleanable material.

headline: Passed; prep floors need cleaning
summary: Passed. Floors in preparation areas were not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: no vomit cleanup kit; no hot water
summary: Failed. No bodily fluid cleanup kit or procedure. The 3-compartment sink had no hot water. Missing paper towels at a restroom sink, no metal stem thermometer, no pest control logbook, and no sanitizer test strips.

headline: Passed; dirty can opener and cutting board
summary: Passed. Rear prep can opener had food and dirt. Cutting board in prep area had dark grooves and stains. Water-stained ceiling tile by cooking equipment; hood filters greasy. Certified food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed; loose washroom faucet
summary: Passed. Loose sink faucet in washroom. Inspector instructed the operator to repair it.

headline: Passed re-inspection; equipment and training gaps
summary: Passed. Coolers lacked ambient air thermometers, a food handler prepped without a hair restraint, a restroom door was not self-closing, and the certified food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Failed: unsafe cold food; cooler at 47.8°F
summary: Failed. Cold-held foods (TCS) too warm: eggs 73.6°F, cheese 46°F, frosting 47.1°F, hot dog in bun 50.7°F. About 8 lbs discarded. Two-door cooler measured 47.8°F. Repeat violations: grocery bags, cardboard flooring, grease buildup, unlabeled containers.

headline: Passed; food buildup on shelves and walls
summary: Passed. Accumulated food debris on prep area shelves and food buildup on prep area walls. Inspector required cleaning and maintenance.

headline: Passed; rear door gap and leaking sink drain
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap under the rear exit door must be sealed against rodents. Also dusty cooler condensers, a leaking handwash sink drain, and a 1/2-inch wall gap by a handwash sink.

headline: Passed; food handlers lacked hair restraints
summary: Passed. Food handlers prepped food without hair restraints. Person in charge told that all must wear them.

headline: Failed: no vomit cleanup plan; no mop sink
summary: Failed. No procedure or supplies for vomiting and diarrhea events (citation). Washroom door lacks self-closing device. No mop or utility sink with hot and cold water; repeat violation (citation).

headline: Passed; dirty grease trap; lidless trash cans
summary: Passed. Dirty grease trap with grease and rust in basement food storage. Rear employee washroom trash has no lids; provide lidded cans in women's and unisex washrooms.

headline: Repeat mouse droppings found; citation issued
summary: Pass with conditions. 15 mouse droppings found in bar, dish room and liquor storage; staff removed them during inspection (citation). Repeat from earlier report. Also broken splash guard, leaking drains, and toilet doors not self-closing.

headline: Passed; rusty racks, debris, missing ceiling panels
summary: Passed. Rusty shelving in deli walk-in cooler; food debris and grease on rear prep floors; missing ceiling panels above hot water tank in second-floor break room.

headline: Failed: black and pink buildup in ice machine
summary: Failed. Heavy black and pink substance inside ice machine (citation). Purse left open on food prep table. Unlabeled food containers; knives and wiping cloths improperly stored; grease buildup; leak at dish machine sink.

headline: Passed; cooler floor and walls need cleaning
summary: Passed. Walk-in cooler shelving and floor had food spills and debris in corners. Bar floor at ice bins and private toilet room walls had splatter. Inspector instructed detail cleaning.

headline: Passed; missing labels and splashguard
summary: Passed. Prepackaged salsas, soups and desserts in retail coolers lacked ingredient labels. No splashguard between meat-prep handwash sink and 3-compartment sink. Regrout meat and carnitas prep floors where water stands.

headline: Failed: clogged handwash sink; grime throughout
summary: Failed. Prep-area handwash sink inaccessible, clogged and not draining (citation). Ice buildup in rear freezer. Food spills throughout equipment. Smoke and dust on walls; debris on floors. Certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed; chicken in printed plastic bags
summary: Passed. Chicken in walk-in cooler stored in printed plastic bags. Inspector told the person in charge to use only food-grade plastic bags.

headline: Passed; greasy floors and clutter
summary: Passed. Floors in front and rear prep areas, including near the water heater closet, had encrusted grease and food debris. Dust on wall by ice machine. Excess clutter in rear prep area; organize to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Rear door gap and broken restroom door closer
summary: Pass with conditions. 1/4-inch gap at bottom of rear exit door must be sealed. Restroom door closer broken. Filters and light shield above cooking equipment need cleaning or replacing. Allergen certificate missing (repeat).

headline: Passed; dirty floor and drain under dishwasher
summary: Passed. Floor and drain under the dish machine need detail cleaning. Inspector instructed cleaning and maintenance.

headline: Failed: 20+ knats found in prep area
summary: Failed. Pest activity: 20 or more knats on wall and ceiling of small prep area. Pest control service required before reinspection next week (citation). Also grocery bags used for food in fridges and freezers, expired food handler certificates.

headline: Passed; damaged gaskets, handles, no backflow device
summary: Passed. Ripped door gaskets on prep-area cooler. Damaged cold-water handles at handwash and 2-compartment sinks. No backflow prevention device on ice machine water line; must provide and make visible.

headline: Cold food held too warm; cooler tagged
summary: Pass with conditions. Food held at 46–55°F; walk-in cooler air at 46°F and tagged. Discarded 13 lbs beef, 25 lbs cheese, milk and 10 lbs lettuce (about $200). Citation issued.

headline: Passed; worn surfaces and cardboard matting
summary: Passed. Cook line white prep surface has exposed raw wood; repair or replace. Basement blender cracked and held with duct tape; replace. No cardboard as floor matting. Food handlers and managers need training proof.

headline: Passed; beard guard needed
summary: Passed. A male food handler lacked a beard guard. Inspector instructed him to provide one.

headline: Failed: live roaches, rodent droppings, flies
summary: Failed. Two live roaches at cook line, small rodent droppings in hall to dish room, and about 50 small flies in south utility room (citation). Pest control and sanitizing required. 1/4-inch door gap; unused equipment stored near dock.

headline: Passed re-inspection; dishwasher leak to fix
summary: Passed. Repair the source of the water leak under the dishwashing machine. Clean floors, walls and baseboards in food prep areas; keep dishwashing floor dry.

headline: Failed: no handwash sink in front prep area
summary: Failed. No handwashing sink in front prep area; must install with hot and cold water (citation). 1/4-inch exterior door gap to seal. No partition between handsink and 3-compartment sink. Restroom lacks ventilation. No manager allergen certificate.

headline: Passed; ice scoops, uncovered utensils, raw chicken bags
summary: Passed. Ice scoops stored inside ice machine and bins. Utensils uncovered on tables. Raw chicken in plastic grocery bags in walk-in freezer. Food debris on slicer and shelves. Handwash sink pipe leaking at salad line.

headline: Failed: no hot water in restrooms; no cleanup plan
summary: Failed. No hot running water in employee and customer washrooms (citation). No vomiting or diarrhea response procedure or supplies. Some coolers lacked thermometers. Weeds and litter outside. Floor, wall and ceiling tiles in poor repair.

headline: No certified manager; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Pass with conditions. No person in charge or certified manager on duty while TCS foods prepared; certificates expired (citation). Dish machine sanitizer at 0 ppm chlorine; told not to use until at least 50 ppm. Heavy freezer ice buildup.

headline: Passed; restroom trash can lacks cover
summary: Passed. The toilet room had no covered receptacle. Inspector instructed the operator to provide one.

headline: Failed: 60+ mouse droppings in prep area
summary: Failed. 60 or more mouse droppings on prep area floors and under front serving counter (citation). Clean all areas and have pest control service before reinspection next week. No hot running water at any sink (citation).

headline: Passed; raw wood shelving; clutter
summary: Passed. Raw wood shelving behind front counter and in basement must be sealed. Excessive clutter behind counter, second floor and basement; remove unnecessary items to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Passed; flies found on storage racks
summary: Passed. Two small flies, dirt and food found on rear prep storage racks. Tortilla chip scoop stored on counter. Multiple leaks under dishwasher sprayer; certified food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed; stained boards, rust, dirty floors
summary: Passed. Stained cutting board; open can food to be moved to food-grade container; rust on walk-in cooler racks; dirty floors behind chest freezer; unisex washroom exhaust fan not working.

headline: Passed; slow leak under sink
summary: Passed. Slow leak under the 3-compartment sink pipe. Operator must repair and maintain.

headline: Failed: drinks in cooler; no pest logbook
summary: Failed. Personal drinks stored in walk-in cooler; removed. Paper towels missing at two handwash sinks, supplied during inspection. No pest control logbook, no sanitizer test kit, missing sink stoppers, leaking drainpipe, and missing ceiling tiles.

headline: Passed; beard restraint needed
summary: Passed. A food handler with a long beard was not wearing a beard restraint. Inspector instructed them to wear one.

headline: Failed: mold in ice machine; no probe thermometer
summary: Failed. Excessive black mold-like buildup inside ice machine above ice used for consumption (citation). No probe thermometer for food temperatures (citation). Leaking pipe under sink, opening under sink to seal, dust and grease under hood.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; cold food unsafe
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on site while serving milk, chicken, sausage and eggs (citation). Ice machine interior with black mold and pink slime dripping into ice (citation). 70 lbs of cold food at 50–51°F discarded. No allergen certificates.

headline: Passed; grease trap odor, worn utensils replaced
summary: Passed. Worn green scrub pads discarded. Three poor-condition utensils replaced during inspection. Foul odor from grease trap; floor drain under 3-compartment sink needs detail cleaning.

headline: Failed: slimy ice maker; expired certificates
summary: Failed. Black slimy substance inside ice maker dripped into ice used for consumption (citation); machine to be turned off and cleaned. Also missing handwash signage, expired food handler certificates, and no backflow device for basement ice maker.

headline: Failed: no raw-food warning; no thermometer
summary: Failed. Menu lacks disclosure and reminder for raw or undercooked animal foods (citation). No metal stem thermometer to check food temperatures (citation). Service sink to be relocated. Manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed; no covered sanitary product bin
summary: Passed. Women's restroom had no covered receptacle for sanitary products. Inspector instructed the person in charge to provide and maintain one.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk food and bag use
summary: Passed. Rear storage bulk containers need common names like flour or sugar. Wiping cloths must be kept in sanitizer between uses. Plastic grocery bags may not hold food in coolers or freezers.

headline: Passed; dirty vent cover and filters
summary: Passed. Vent cover above hot holding area is dirty. Filters above cooking equipment are dirty with dust and debris. Must clean and maintain.

headline: Passed; burnt residue on floors
summary: Passed. Floors behind cooking equipment under hood had burnt residue. Instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Cold food too warm; about 120 lbs discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. TCS foods in walk-in cooler too warm: collard greens with turkey 54.2°F, gumbo 50.7°F, jerk soup 44.9°F. About 120 lbs ($950) discarded. Unlabeled bulk containers; two certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged held
summary: Pass with conditions. Chlorine dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm; tagged and not to be used until repaired (citation). Cardboard and plastic bags used for storage; torn gaskets; greasy floor under cook line; one washbowl lacks hot and cold water.

headline: Repeat allergen training violation not corrected
summary: Pass with conditions. Allergen training certificate still not on site from a previous inspection (citation). Manager instructed to comply and provide documentation.

headline: Passed; floor drains and cooking area need cleaning
summary: Passed. Floor drains need detail cleaning to prevent possible insect activity. Floors under walk-in shelving, under cooking surfaces, and under the 3-compartment sink also need cleaning.

headline: Passed; personal items above utensils
summary: Passed. Personal care items stored above clean utensils in front service area. Wiping cloths stored above clean equipment while drying. No backflow device at espresso machine. Broken basement ceiling; cracked floor near AC unit.

headline: Passed; fryer debris and floor repairs
summary: Passed. Excessive debris inside fryer. Floor between cooking equipment and prep cooler needs regrouting; floors throughout have minor food and dirt debris.

headline: Food debris and broken floor tiles; dumpster lids
summary: Excessive food debris covered kitchen floors, and floor tiles are broken; deep clean and repair are needed. A prior violation for broken dumpster lids was not fixed and is now a priority item; it must be corrected before re-inspection. Citation issued.

headline: Greasy fryers, leaking faucet, dirty floors
summary: Fryers, prep tables, and refrigeration units need cleaning. A leak at the three-compartment sink faucet must be repaired. Floors in the hot water tank room were cleaned on site. A small wall hole and a water-stained ceiling tile were also noted.

headline: Cluttered unused cooler; water-stained ceiling tiles
summary: An unused walk-in cooler was packed with items, creating hiding spots for pests; items must be removed. Water-stained ceiling tiles above the prep area and sales floor must be replaced. A certified food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Rat droppings found; no original sanitation certificate
summary: About 80 rat droppings were found behind an unused freezer, and about 20 more near the washroom. Pest control service is needed and affected areas must be cleaned. A photocopy of the sanitation certificate was not accepted; the original must be posted.

headline: Dishwasher lacks temperature strips; citation issued
summary: No handwashing sign was posted at the front coffee prep sink. No test strips or temperature indicators were provided for the high-temperature dish machine; citation issued. Dust was on ceiling vents and light shields, and prior violations for dirty floors and expired food handler certificates were not corrected.

headline: Blank employee health policy forms on site
summary: Blank copies of the employee health policy were on site. The facility must keep signed copies for all food employees at all times. Priority violation noted; no citation issued.

headline: Missing handwashing and thermometer; corrected
summary: The bar hand sink had no handwashing sign; the manager provided one by the end of inspection. A two-drawer reach-in cooler lacked a thermometer; one was provided by end of inspection. Ice machine bottom had mineral buildup and must be cleaned.

headline: Pork, goat, and salsa held too warm; discarded
summary: Pork and goat at 44.4°F and salsa at 45.5°F in the walk-in cooler; about 955 lbs and 20 gallons discarded. Food held over 24 hours lacked proper dating. The walk-in cooler was tagged at 50.5°F. About 40-50 small flies were found in back storage.

headline: Rodent droppings and dead mouse; no spill kit
summary: About 20 mouse droppings were found on chip cardboard and about 10 rat droppings near the rear ramp; citation issued. Pest control service is needed. A dead mouse was in a trap. No bodily fluid spill kit or cleanup procedure was on site.

headline: No compliant handwashing sink; no pest log
summary: A handwashing sink with hot and cold water, soap and a drying device must be installed in the rear dishwashing area; citation issued. No pest control logbook was on the premises. No sanitizer test strips were available, and a backflow device must be relocated.

headline: Cooked chicken held too cool; about 20 lbs discarded
summary: Cooked chicken was found at 61.1-109°F in hot holding and prep areas; about 20 lbs was discarded and citation issued. Bulk dry containers lacked labels. Greasy fryers and steam table, a slow floor drain, a dirty toilet and greasy floors also need cleaning.

headline: Faded labels; oyster sauce in open can
summary: Food storage containers had faded labels and must be relabeled with common names. Oyster sauce was in an open original can inside the reach-in cooler and must be moved to a food-grade container.

headline: Two-door cooler not keeping food cold
summary: Two-door reach-in cooler failed to hold cold temperatures; must be repaired or removed. Also noted: torn freezer door gasket, stained cutting boards, no sanitizer test kit, dirty floors, and a leaking three-compartment sink faucet.

headline: No certified manager while hamburgers prepared
summary: No certified manager was on site while hamburgers and other foods were prepared; citation issued. Partially eaten food was found in the rear prep and dish area. A cutting board has deep grooves and orange stains and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: No city sanitation manager on site; no posted summary
summary: No city foodservice manager was on site while chicken and other foods were prepared; citation issued. A trash can lacked a lid in the unisex customer restroom. No inspection summary was posted for public view; a new summary was left for posting. Citation issued.

headline: Rear door gaps; broken floor tiles and graffiti
summary: Both rear exit doors have 1/4-1/2 inch gaps and must be sealed. Fryers have grease, food and dirt buildup. Women's restroom trash cans lack lids. Walk-in cooler has a pitted floor with standing water. A certified manager's allergen training has expired.

headline: Rodent droppings found; more pest control needed
summary: About 30 mouse droppings were found on the floor of the dry storage room under wire racks. Management must clean all droppings, and additional pest control service is needed. Citation issued. Dirty prep tables, floors and walls also noted.

headline: No equipment for rapid reheating of catered food
summary: No equipment was available for rapid reheating of catered food. The manager was instructed to provide adequate reheating equipment.

headline: Inadequate lighting in basement prep and storage
summary: Lighting throughout the basement prep and storage areas was inadequate. The manager was told to provide and maintain proper lighting.

headline: Basement holes and clutter
summary: Basement floors have holes and are unfinished; they must be sealed and made smooth and easy to clean. Unused wood planks and old lamps were stored in the basement and must be removed.

headline: No sanitation manager; dishwasher at 0 ppm; flies
summary: No valid city sanitation manager certificate was on site while chicken was served; citation issued. The low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm, was tagged and must not be used. About 25 small flies were on dishwashing area walls.

headline: Dining tableware unprotected; expired allergen training
summary: Preset tableware in the dining room was not covered or wrapped. The walk-in cooler had insufficient lighting. Certified food managers had expired allergen training and must renew it and keep certificates on site.

headline: Walk-in cooler door release broken; backflow missing
summary: The release knob inside the walk-in cooler is broken, so the door cannot be opened from inside. Other repairs needed: freezer gasket, excess ice at the freezer condenser, loose hot water handle, and a broken light shield. A prior backflow device violation was not corrected.

headline: No paper towels at hand sink; door not closing
summary: The exposed hand sink in the rear prep area had no paper towels; citation issued. Open drinks are not allowed in prep areas, and employees need a designated drinking area. The washroom door does not self-close and must be repaired.

headline: Chili held too warm; citation issued
summary: Chili held at 52-56°F in the walk-in cooler was found unsafe. The manager discarded about 40 lbs. Foods must be held at 41°F or colder. Citation issued. Unlabeled bulk salt and sugar containers, stained cutting boards, and dusty vents were also noted.

headline: Doors not rodent-proof; prior violations uncorrected
summary: Previous violations were not corrected: front and overhead doors have gaps that let pests in, and must be sealed. Openings in the dishwashing area floor must be sealed and repaired. Citation issued.

headline: Sewage backup and soiled wiping cloths found
summary: Cloudy wastewater backed up from a floor drain by the three-compartment sink; citation issued. Soiled wiping cloths were left on prep tables. Also noted: damaged waiting-room ceiling, missing and cracked light shields, greasy hood filters.

headline: Ice maker backflow device needs relocation
summary: The backflow prevention device at the ice maker must be moved so it can be reached for service. Kitchen exhaust hood and filters need detail cleaning to remove heavy grease buildup.

headline: Heavy grease and food debris throughout
summary: Grease and food debris were found on cooking equipment, coolers, freezers, shelving and prep tables. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks. Stained ceiling tiles and dusty light shields and vents were also noted. The manager was told to clean and maintain.

headline: Handwashing signs missing; food handler proof lacking
summary: Handwashing signs must be posted at bar hand sinks. Food handler certificates could not be verified for food employees and must be kept on site. No proof of allergen training was provided for city food managers.

headline: Unprotected frozen fruit and food stored in cooler
summary: Frozen fruit was not protected from freezer burn, and egg rolls were stored on cooler shelving. Also noted: dirty prep cooler interior, dirty floors in storage and walk-in, and dusty hood and light shields.

headline: Soiled mop heads stored improperly
summary: Soiled mop heads were not stored properly. The manager was told to hang mop heads to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Rear door needs rodent-proofing; sink required
summary: The bottom of the rear exit door must be rodent-proofed. A one-compartment prep sink must be installed, accessible to the front coffee prep area. A floor baseboard around the rear dishwashing area is missing and must be replaced.

headline: Salmon thawing in packaging; unlabeled containers
summary: Salmon was thawing in its packaging in a reach-in cooler and must be removed from packaging while thawing. Bulk containers need commodity name labels. A cutting board is melted and deeply cut, and the three-compartment sink faucet leaks.

headline: Rust, grease, and missing food handler certificates
summary: Walk-in cooler shelves were heavily rusted. Heavy grease was found on fryers and cooking equipment. Grease, dirt and food debris covered floors under equipment. No food handler training certificates were on site.

headline: Greasy fryers and hood; missing food handler certificates
summary: Fryers and ventilation hood have grease, dirt and dust buildup. A cold water knob on the three-compartment sink leaks. Food handlers lacked valid certificates; the ones on site were expired.

headline: Rusted walk-in floor; holes; missing allergen training
summary: The walk-in cooler floor is heavily rusted and must be replaced. Holes in drywall beside the freezer must be repaired. A prior allergen training violation was not corrected; citation issued. The previous inspection summary was not posted for public view.

headline: Damaged restroom wall; greasy hood vent
summary: The wall behind the men's restroom door is damaged and covered with tape and plastic; it must be repaired and made easy to clean. A buildup of grease was found under the hood ventilation system and filters, which must be cleaned.

headline: Food and supplies on floor; dirty prep surfaces
summary: A box of chips was stored on the floor in front storage, and single-service items were stored on the floor in the catering area; both must be raised six inches. Food debris was found on prep coolers, tables and counters. Prep area floors were dirty.

headline: Washroom door closer in poor repair
summary: The self-closing device on the washroom door is in poor repair and must be repaired and maintained.

headline: No certified person in charge; gaps at doors
summary: No person in charge with a valid city sanitation certificate was present; citation issued for food prepared without a posted certificate. The rear exit doors have gaps that must be sealed. Damaged gaskets were found on coolers and freezers.

headline: Heavy clutter and peeling paint in facility
summary: Heavy clutter in the rear dishwashing area and front counter must be removed and items raised at least six inches off the floor. Peeling paint on the toilet room wall and front ceiling must be repaired. Dirty floors near sinks and prep equipment need detail cleaning.

headline: Missing and cracked ceiling tiles; hole in baseboard
summary: Missing and cracked ceiling tiles were found in the kitchen prep and rear storage areas. A hole in the baseboard near the side door in rear storage must be repaired. Repairs must make surfaces smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Cheese held at 50°F; flies found throughout
summary: Starbucks employee used a hand sink to wash dishes; citation issued. Cheese held at 50°F was discarded, 15 lbs, and a two-door cooler at 51°F was tagged. More than 20 small flies were found throughout the facility; pest control recommended. Citation issued.

headline: No sanitation manager; mold in ice machine
summary: No valid city sanitation manager certificate was on site while beef was prepared and served; citation issued. Black mold-like substance was found on the ice machine's food-contact surface. A revolving entrance door has a one-inch gap and is not rodent-proof.

headline: Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer; dirty areas
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution. Drink machines, coolers, storage shelves, floors and vents need detail cleaning. Three-compartment sink stoppers are needed. All food handlers need certificates, and an allergen certificate is needed on site.

headline: Hair restraints missing; wiping cloths on prep surfaces
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints, and wiping cloths were left on prep surfaces; both were corrected per instructions to maintain. A hot holding unit gasket is loose, and a three-compartment sink faucet leaks. Certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Uncovered trash and food debris under equipment
summary: The basement employee toilet had an uncovered garbage receptacle. Food debris was on floors under heavy equipment in the rear prep and storage area. Lighting in the bar and coffee prep space was inadequate.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; grease and dust buildup
summary: Bulk containers in rear prep and storage were not labeled and must be labeled with the common food name. Grease and food debris were on coolers, fryers, prep tables and shelving. Dust was on ceiling vents, and debris was under equipment.

headline: Ice machine not clean
summary: The ice machine in the southeast closet was not clean and must be cleaned and sanitized.

headline: Mop sink faucet lacks backflow device
summary: No backflow prevention device was found at the mop sink faucet. The owner must provide one in a location where it can be serviced.

headline: Dishwasher not sanitizing; equipment tagged
summary: The low-temperature dishwasher registered 0 ppm chlorine and was not sanitizing; it was tagged and must not be used until it reaches at least 50 ppm. Also noted: torn freezer gasket, hood and filter grease, and missing food handler proof.

headline: Missing paper towels and handwashing access issues
summary: No written employee health policy was on site. Several hand sinks lacked paper towels, and the bar hand sink was blocked by stored items until the manager removed them. A cooler at 50.5°F was tagged and must not be used until repaired.

headline: Mop sink faucet lacks backflow device
summary: No backflow prevention device was found on the mop sink faucet. The owner must provide one.

headline: Food on floor; uncovered trash; ceiling holes
summary: Food was stored on the floor in the rear butcher area and must be raised six inches. Reach-in coolers had food debris. Both all-gender toilet rooms lacked covered trash cans. Dirt buildup on floors and multiple holes in the butcher prep ceiling were noted.

headline: Inadequate lighting in basement storage
summary: Lighting in the basement storage room was inadequate. The manager was instructed to provide proper lighting.

headline: Rusted racks in basement walk-in cooler
summary: Basement walk-in cooler racks were rusted. The manager was instructed to repaint or replace them.

headline: Shellstock tags missing; foods held at unsafe temperatures
summary: Oyster and clam shellstock lacked proper tags; about 30 lbs ($450) discarded. Cooked spring rolls and egg rolls were held too cool, and duck at 56.6-58.3°F was discarded. Frozen meats thawed at room temperature. Citation issued.

headline: No current food handler training; damaged ceiling
summary: A hallway ceiling leading to the bathroom is damaged and must be repaired. Staff do not have up-to-date food handler training. A certified food manager has expired allergen training.

headline: Dirty kitchen walls and ceiling tiles
summary: Serving plates were not inverted at the dining tables. A leak at the bar hand sink's bottom pipe must be repaired. Stained ceiling tiles and dirty walls in the kitchen prep area must be cleaned. A light above the warming unit needs a protective shield.

headline: Gap under entrance door; dusty walls
summary: A 1/4-inch gap under the front entrance door must be sealed to keep out rodents. Food debris and dust were on walls in the rear packing and mop sink rooms and the front produce area. These must be cleaned.

headline: No sanitation manager on site; toilet broken
summary: No city food sanitation manager or valid certificate was on site while chicken was served and sold; citation issued. The women's employee toilet is not working and must be repaired.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure
summary: No written procedure or adequate supplies were found for vomit and diarrhea cleanup. The front entrance door lacks proper screening. Missing ceiling tiles, clutter, soiled chip racks, and a missing toilet room trash cover must be addressed.

headline: Missing health policy, sneezeguard, pest logbook
summary: No written employee health policy was on site. A hand sink with hot and cold water is needed in the front coffee area. No sneezeguard protects the front prep area. No pest control logbook was available. Basement washroom ventilation is not working.

headline: Food debris between equipment; dusty storage
summary: Food debris had built up on the sides of non-cooking equipment between the pizza and pasta lines and must be cleaned. Dirt or flour under shelving in the rear dry storage area also needs cleaning.

headline: Gaps under doors; fly strips over prep sink
summary: Two doors have 1/4-1/2 inch gaps underneath and must be made rodent and insect proof. Fly strips hanging above the three-compartment sink in the food prep area must be removed. Peeling paint on a ceiling duct must be scraped and painted. A food handler had an expired certificate.

headline: Food debris inside coolers; basement clutter
summary: Accumulated food debris was found inside cold-holding equipment in the rear prep area and must be cleaned. The basement storage area had clutter and items on the floor that must be organized and kept off the floor.

headline: Front door gap and loose restroom sink
summary: A gap at the bottom of the front entry door must be repaired to prevent pests. The hand sink in the staff restroom is loose from the wall. Dirt and food debris were found in the rear prep and dishwashing area near the grease trap.

headline: Low water pressure at hand sink
summary: The front exposed hand sink in the rear food prep area next to the coffee machine needs more water pressure. It must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Missing thermometer; expired food handler training
summary: The front upright beverage cooler had no internal thermometer. Open dry red pepper flakes at dining tables must be covered. A stainless steel wall panel in the rear kitchen is pulling away and must be repaired. One employee had expired food handler training.

headline: Unlabeled containers and missing allergen certificate
summary: Containers above the front prep cooler were not labeled and must be labeled. Spoons and forks were not inverted in the rear prep area. No allergen training certificate was on site for certified food managers.

headline: Missing thermometers; kitchenware stored upright
summary: Thermometers could not be found inside the dessert cooler or the two-door refrigerator. Kitchenware on the prep rack was stored right side up and must be inverted. Two of three certified food managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Food handler hand-washing and cross-contamination violations
summary: A food handler wore a glove while drinking, using a phone, and handling bread, without washing hands; citation issued. Prior violations not corrected include a rear door gap, no splash guard, cardboard under prep table, and debris on the walk-in freezer floor.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; cooler temperature issues
summary: Black slimy substance was dripping from the ice machine's water components into ice; the machine must be turned off, and ice removed and cleaned. Cooked lobster and cheese were held too warm and discarded. A prep cooler at 50°F was tagged. Citation issued.

headline: Dirty prep coolers; restroom vents not working
summary: Interior surfaces of prep coolers were dirty and must be cleaned. The backflow device for the coffee makers could not be located and must be exposed. Vents in both restrooms are inoperable and must be repaired.

headline: Cooked chicken held too warm; discarded
summary: Cooked chicken at 45.7-50.3°F in two prep coolers was discarded, about 10 lbs; citation issued. Drain plugs at the three-compartment sink have torn O-rings and must be repaired. Restrooms lack covered receptacles, and the walk-in freezer has inadequate lighting.

headline: Greasy used cooking oil container
summary: Grease buildup was found on the outside of the used cooking oil container in the rear garbage area. The container must be cleaned and kept in good condition.

headline: Gap under main entrance door
summary: A 1/4-inch gap was found at the bottom of the main entrance exterior door. A tight-fitting seal must be provided at all outer openings to keep out pests.

headline: Raw egg warning missing; oversized pots and clutter
summary: A cook was drinking in the food prep area. The menu does not warn that items such as ramen eggs are raw or undercooked; citation issued. Oversized pots cannot fit the three-compartment sink; citation issued. Wiping cloths and items on floors also need correction.

headline: No handwashing signs; cooling thermometers missing
summary: No handwashing sign was posted at the prep area hand sink. Thermometers could not be found inside cooling units in the prep area. A three-compartment sink faucet leaks slightly. One of three food employees lacked verified food handler training.

headline: Raw meat stored over ready-to-eat food; citation
summary: Raw chicken and beef were stored over ready-to-eat foods; citation issued. A food handler wore gloves while washing hands at the three-compartment sink; citation issued. Carrots and potatoes were left outside by the back door. Prior violations for personal food and missing signage were not fixed.

headline: Moldy ice machine parts; missing backflow device
summary: Pink and black mold-like substance was on ice machine shields in the basement and must be cleaned and sanitized. A backflow device was not found on the coffee machine. Missing covered trash cans, open ceiling holes, and dusty vents were also noted.

headline: No certified manager; cooler at 59°F; dead flies
summary: No valid city food sanitation manager certificate was on site while cheese and meats were served. Prosciutto, cheese and chorizo at 57.9-59°F were discarded, about 30 lbs. The walk-in cooler was tagged. About 30 dead small flies were in the walk-in.

headline: Debris along bar area walls and corners
summary: Debris was on the floor along walls and corners in the bar area. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain the area.

headline: Foods held at 47-59°F; some discarded
summary: Cut leafy greens, diced chicken and tomatoes held at 47-59°F were discarded, about $120 worth. Foods must be held at 41°F or below. A cooler at 48°F was tagged. Rusted walk-in racks and sticky bar floors also need attention.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; leaking faucet
summary: Plates were not inverted after sanitizing. Milk crates were used as shelving and cardboard as floor liner; both must be replaced with proper shelving and mats. The three-compartment sink faucet and a handwash sink drainpipe leak.

headline: Ice maker backflow device not accessible
summary: The backflow prevention device at the ice maker must be moved so it can be serviced. A certified food manager lacked allergen training and must complete it and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Dirty basement floor; expired allergen certificate
summary: The basement floor was not clean and must be cleaned and maintained. One food allergen training certificate has expired and must be updated.

headline: Unlabeled food containers
summary: Food removed from its original container must be labeled with its common name. This was the only violation noted at this re-inspection.

headline: Improper dish storage; detached wall coving
summary: Bowls and plates were stored improperly and must be inverted. Wall coving under the basement three-compartment sink is detached and must be repaired to prevent pest hiding spots. Gas line and fryers had grease and dirt buildup.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat cheese; citation
summary: An employee sliced ready-to-eat cheese with bare hands; citation issued. Sinks were blocked by a mop bucket and containers, which were removed on site. The three-compartment sink was set up with chlorine on site. Dumpster and grease container were overloaded and dirty.

headline: Ice machine buildup and door gap found
summary: Pink buildup inside the ice machine must be cleaned. A 1/4-inch gap under the north side door must be sealed to keep out rodents. Food debris was found in bar gun holders. No food handler or allergen training certificates were on the premises.

headline: Scoops stored in food; soiled basement floors
summary: Scoops were stored with handles touching food in storage bins and must be stored correctly. Basement floors under the soda rack and in the break area had spills and food scraps. One of two managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Stained cutting board; missing food handler certificate
summary: A stained cutting board was on a large prep table and must be resurfaced or replaced. A food handler without a food handler certificate was observed; proof of training must be shown for all food handlers.

headline: Food storage and missing utility sink issues
summary: Food in a tall reach-in cooler in the hallway to the washroom was not protected from customers. Peeling plastic, grease, and rust were noted on equipment. No utility mop sink was on the premises. Several ceiling and wall repairs were ordered.

headline: Over 40 live flies in rear prep area
summary: More than 40 live flies were found on walls, ceiling, shelving and boxes in the rear prep and dishwashing area. Citation issued. Pest control service is needed. Dirty garbage cans, hand sinks, floors, mop water, and hood and fryer areas must be cleaned.

headline: Cold food too warm; roaches and flies found
summary: Ten containers of fish, shrimp, chicken and other foods held at 48.2-52.0°F in a cooler; about 22 lbs discarded, citation issued. Dead roaches found throughout. On re-inspection, about 8 live roaches and small flies remained; pest control recommended.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; manager added them
summary: No handwashing signs were posted in the restrooms. The manager added signs during the inspection. The manager was instructed to keep them posted.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; greasy floors
summary: Black slimy substance was found on the ice maker's water components, dripping into ice. The machine must be turned off, ice removed, and interior cleaned and sanitized. Stained cutting boards, unlabeled bulk containers, greasy floors and hood were also noted.

headline: Auto parts behind building; missing ceiling tiles
summary: Accumulated automobile parts outside the rear of the building must be removed to prevent pest hiding spots. Missing ceiling tiles in the rear dry storage area must be replaced. A display cooler door gasket is torn and must be repaired.

headline: Grease buildup; leaking sink drain
summary: Re-inspection passed. Grease on prep cooler door, sink pipes and basins, stove, and fryer. Leak at three-compartment sink drain line. Heavy grease on hood and filters must be cleaned.

headline: Broken cooling unit handle hanging off
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Handle on cooling unit in front prep area is broken and hanging off. Must repair.

headline: Five live roaches; voided certificate posted
summary: Five live cockroaches found in rear prep area; citation issued. Voided photocopy of food manager certificate posted instead of original. Dirt on floors and walls, rusty shelves, and no covered receptacle in employee toilet.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, flies, missing training
summary: No certified food manager during TCS food prep (foods that must be kept hot or cold). About 40 or more small flies and 3-5 large flies seen. About 41 lbs of vacuum-packed food discarded without an approved HACCP plan.

headline: Undated pasta held over 24 hours; pest gaps
summary: Cooked pasta in walk-in cooler not date-marked and held over 24 hours; about 25 lbs discarded; citation issued. Greasy outside container is a rodent and pest food source; citation issued. Half-inch gap at front patio door must be closed.

headline: Front door gap; leaking sink faucet
summary: Re-inspection: front double doors have a half-inch gap at bottom and between doors; must install tight seal to keep pests out. Leaking faucet base at three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Peeling ceiling paint; clutter in basement
summary: Ceiling paint peeling in dining area must be repaired. Unnecessary items and clutter in basement must be moved or organized.

headline: Cold foods too warm; discarded; cooler reset
summary: Cold foods at the front line reached 47.3-51.4°F; about 5 lbs discarded. Prep coolers were 52.4-54.2°F, then reset after a power surge to 38.2-38.9°F. Employee ate in prep area.

headline: Re-inspection passed; mold and ventilation issues
summary: Re-inspection passed. Upper ice machine portions need cleaning. Dirty floors under cook line and dish machine. Black and pink mold in caulking at dish machine must be replaced. Washrooms lack mechanical ventilation.

headline: Repeat allergen violation; standing water on floors
summary: Repeat violation: certified manager's allergen training certificate is expired; citation issued. Standing water on prep and dish area floors must be cleared to avoid pest breeding. Prep and salad coolers need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; food held too warm
summary: No verifiable City-certified food manager on site on arrival. Cold foods held at 44-62°F; about 25 lbs fish and other items discarded. Cooler at 50°F tagged. Sushi rice lacks required variance. Citations issued.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; repeat sink violation
summary: No City-certified food manager on premises while beef, pork, and mac and cheese were prepared and served; citation issued. Ambient thermometer on reach-in cooler broken. Repeat violation: rear prep hand sink inoperable; citation issued.

headline: Hair restraints, jewelry, dirty floors
summary: Multiple food employees lacked hair restraints and wore dangling bracelets. Boxed food stored on floor in walk-in cooler and freezer. Dirt along walls and in corners; spills and debris on prep surfaces.

headline: Food stored in basement; surfaces need upgrades
summary: Food stored in basement. Must provide smooth, easily cleanable floors, walls, and ceilings.

headline: Cardboard boxes on floor by fryers
summary: Broken-down cardboard boxes on floor in front of deep fryers must be removed. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Missing allergen certificates; loose sink faucet
summary: Front bar hand sink lacks handwashing signage. Single-use plastic bowls used as scoops in bulk dry storage; must replace. Several managers lack allergen training certificates. Three-compartment sink faucet loose.

headline: Unlabeled containers, grease, leaking faucet
summary: No handwashing sign at rear prep sink. Bulk containers unlabeled and food stored on floor. Grease on fryers, cooking equipment, floors, and hood filters. Leaking faucet and drainpipe in washroom.

headline: No paper towels; sink leak; floors need cleaning
summary: Complaint: hand sink by prep area lacked paper towels; citation issued. Leaking pipe at hand sink by deep fryer. Floors along walls, under equipment, and in basement dry storage need cleaning.

headline: Calcium build-up inside ice machine
summary: Ice machine interior has calcium build-up. Manager instructed to clean it.

headline: Bare-hand food contact, insects, unsafe temperatures
summary: Two employees touched ready-to-eat food with bare hands; citation issued. About 30 small flying insects on walls and shelves. Mold inside two ice machines. Mashed potatoes at 126°F, cut tomatoes at 48°F, and vacuum-packed foods lacked an approved plan.

headline: Unused items in basement; no food handler certificates
summary: Re-inspection passed on license. Unused equipment and unnecessary articles in basement storage must be removed to prevent pest harborage. No food handler certificates on site; manager told to comply with IDPH (state health department) rules.

headline: Dirty floors under ice machine; clutter
summary: Floors behind and under ice machine not clean; must be cleaned. Clutter under dish machine, including toilet paper, was removed during inspection.

headline: Mouse droppings, live roach, and mold in ice machine
summary: Salt container contained a mouse dropping; about 20 lbs discarded. Found 1 live roach and about 40 mouse droppings in several prep and storage areas. Several coolers ran 45-57°F. Mold inside ice machine. Citations issued.

headline: No handwashing signs; restroom lids missing, repeat
summary: No handwashing signs in restrooms. Women's restroom receptacles have no lids, a repeat violation from May 2025; citation issued. Must comply by 5/22/2026.

headline: Ice machine residue; cooler too warm; no test strips
summary: Black and pink substance in basement ice machine used for human consumption; citation issued. Cold foods at 43.7-46.7°F; about 5 lbs discarded. Deli cooler at 46°F must not be used until reinspected. No dish machine test strips.

headline: Ice machine spillage; soiled wiping cloths; flypaper
summary: Spillage and build-up on ice machine walls; ice not used for human consumption. Fly paper hung in rear storage; a licensed pest control technician should be asked for a flying insect device. Soiled cloths left on tables and in cooler.

headline: Milk and beverages on floor; dirty floors
summary: Milk and beverages stored on floor in walk-in cooler and rear dry storage; must be elevated at least 6 inches. Floors in walk-in cooler and rear dry storage are unclean.

headline: Repairs needed: thermometer, rust, labels, floors
summary: Produce display thermometer not working. Bulk containers unlabeled. Rust on deli cooler racks, worn gaskets, and leaking pipe at meat-prep sink. Damaged flooring, stained ceiling tiles, burned-out freezer light, and hood debris.

headline: Worn fan guards; unused dish machine must go
summary: Walk-in cooler fan guards in poor repair must be replaced. Inoperable unused dish machine by the bar must be removed.

headline: Mouse droppings throughout; no certified manager
summary: Over 75 mouse droppings found in fryer, behind prep coolers, under sink, and in dry storage. No certified manager with posted certificate on site. Broken food thermometer. Areas must be cleaned and sanitized.

headline: Re-inspection passed; excess floor debris
summary: Re-inspection passed. Excessive debris found on floors under, behind, and along baseboards throughout. Must clean and maintain.

headline: Mouse droppings; no certified manager on site
summary: About 30 or more mouse droppings on floors in storage areas, under sink, and near furnace. Pest control recommended. No certified manager with original certificate on site while open. Uncovered baked goods in hallway.

headline: Repeat pest violation; garbage area not maintained
summary: Repeat violations: small flies still on storage walls and boxes; pest control must return, and moldy or rotten food removed. Outside garbage and grease containers littered and greasy; keep lids closed. Citation issued.

headline: Leaking faucet; damaged ceiling and floor tiles
summary: Leak at three-compartment sink faucet. Water-stained ceiling tiles and missing floor tiles in dish area. Clutter in storage and rear areas. Dirt and debris under heavy equipment. A food handler lacks proof of training.

headline: Failed: dirty coolers; no allergen training
summary: Coolers found not clean; must clean. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training. Repeat violation: no mop sink with vacuum breaker; citation issued; must install.

headline: Inspection summary not posted for public
summary: Inspection summary was not posted for public view. A copy was given to management, who was instructed to post it. Citation issued.

headline: Food spills, standing water, dirty floors
summary: Short-form complaint. Food spills inside salad cooler and beverage equipment, plus syrup spills in cabinet, must be removed to avoid a pest food source. Water pooling under unused dishwasher.

headline: Greasy floor; three employees lack training
summary: Complaint: grease and grime on floor under cook line must be detail cleaned. Three employees lack food handler training. All must complete training and keep records on site.

headline: Food stored on floor; plumbing and wood repairs ordered
summary: Food stored on basement floor must be raised 6 inches. Mounted equipment sits on raw wood. Basement ice machine lacks a backflow device. Leaking bar sink handle, non-self-closing restroom door, and dirty garage floor noted.

headline: Dead insects in light shield
summary: Re-inspection passed. Dead insects found inside a light shield in prep area. Manager instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: No food handler or allergen training proof
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed, but no proof of food handler training for food handlers and no allergen training proof for certified managers. Washrooms lack covered receptacles. Records must be kept on site.

headline: Leaking pipe under sink; cleaning needed
summary: Complaint: leak from pipe under kitchen one-compartment sink must be repaired. Exteriors of cooking equipment, storage containers, and garbage cans must be cleaned. Floors and walls around equipment need cleaning.

headline: Missing thermometers; burned-out lights; water pooling
summary: Short-form complaint: sales-floor coolers lack thermometers. Basement plumbing in disrepair with water pooling. Restroom garbage receptacles need covers. Multiple burned-out ceiling bulbs in warehouse storage.

headline: Hair restraint missing; food debris on prep tables
summary: One food handler lacked a hair restraint; manager told all handlers must wear one. Food debris and stains on prep table tops and in handwash sink. Slight build-up inside ice machine.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; flies and rat droppings
summary: Re-inspection failed: black slime in ice machine dripping onto ice used for consumption; citation issued. About 35 small flies near bars and prep areas. About 5 rat droppings in 2nd-floor dry storage. Pest control required.

headline: Failed: debris, food spills, repeat violations
summary: Loose debris, dirt, and food spillage in front prep cabinets. Debris, gloves, and aprons on rear patio ground. Repeat violations: no handwashing signs, and a city-certified manager lacks allergen training. Citation issued.

headline: No city sanitation certificate; missing handwashing sign
summary: Complaint: no City of Chicago sanitation certificate on site while rice, chicken, and pork were prepared and served; citation issued. Handwashing sign missing at front sink. Debris on floors and shelves.

headline: No manager on site; sink misuse and hair restraints
summary: No certified food manager while tacos and burritos were served; citation issued. Employee handwashed in three-compartment sink. Sink setup corrected on site with chlorine. Hair restraints and food handler and allergen certificates also needed.

headline: Dark residue inside coffee-station ice machine
summary: Small amount of dark residue on inside back panel of ice machine at coffee prep station. Staff instructed to detail clean it.

headline: Missing hair restraint; repairs and shelving needed
summary: Food handler prepared food without a hair restraint; all handlers must wear one. Milk crates used as shelving, a dirty freezer interior, and a burned-out light in rear dry storage must be fixed.

headline: Damaged freezer gaskets; allergen certificate missing
summary: Damaged gaskets on two-door freezer, and cooler gasket repaired with glue. Three-compartment sink lacks wash-rinse-sanitize labels. Certified manager lacks an allergen certificate.

headline: Back doors open; food on floor; sign missing
summary: Two kitchen back doors were open at inspection and must stay closed to prevent pest entry. Cutting boards and dish racks stored on floor must be raised 6 inches. Customer restroom handwashing signs missing.

headline: Re-inspection passed; unused equipment to clean
summary: Re-inspection passed. Staff instructed to clean all unused equipment in prep area.
