headline: No health policy or bodily fluid cleanup kit
summary: No verifiable employee health policy on site; template left, and signed copies must be kept. No bodily fluid cleanup kit for vomiting or diarrhea events; must provide and maintain. No citation issued.

headline: Hand sinks too cold; food debris on floors
summary: Hot water at prep hand sink measured 74.3°F and customer restroom sinks 66.9°F; must be at least 100°F. Citation issued. Food debris and spills found on floors throughout the facility.

headline: Single-use utensils not stored upside down
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Single-use utensils were not stored inverted (handle up). Staff instructed to invert them and maintain that storage.

headline: Handwashing sink water only 89°F
summary: Hand sink water measured 89°F; must be repaired. Staff instructed to use two nearby handwashing sinks that are in compliance.

headline: Eating in prep area; ceiling and floor repairs
summary: Employees drinking and preparing food in prep areas; a designated break area is required. Cracks and missing tiles in smoke room; stained ceiling tiles in dry storage. Certified managers lack allergen training certificate.

headline: Low water pressure; rust, leaks, dirty floors
summary: Low water pressure at rear hand sink by cooking equipment. Rust on basement walk-in racks and leaking three-compartment faucet. Floors with blood, food, dirt, and debris in basement walk-in and corners.

headline: Women's restroom needs covered waste receptacle
summary: Women's restroom lacks a covered waste receptacle for feminine hygiene products. Must provide one.

headline: Prep coolers too warm; mouse droppings; training gaps
summary: Pork, chicken, and beef at 51°F, tofu at 49°F, and rice at 45°F in prep coolers; a 1-door cooler at 46°F. About 40 mouse droppings in men's washroom closet; more pest control needed. Several staff lack food handler certificates.

headline: Missing handwashing sign and covered trash can
summary: Women's employee toilet room needs a handwashing sign and a covered receptacle. Both were ordered provided.

headline: Cold foods too warm; unapproved kimchi discarded
summary: Cold foods at 48-51.8°F discarded, about 63 lbs. 45 lbs of kimchi fermented on site without approval discarded. Cooler at 48.7°F tagged. Dumpster lids left open, corrected on site. Leaks and damaged freezer gasket.

headline: To-go nuts lack allergen information; torn gasket
summary: Plastic boxes of nuts sold to go lacked allergen and business contact information; must add both. Torn gasket on interior of juice cooler; must repair or replace.

headline: Pineapple left in open can; allergen certificate missing
summary: Complaint: pineapple chunks left in open can inside reach-in cooler; must move to food-grade container. Certified manager lacks allergen training certificate; manager instructed to comply.

headline: Repeat core violations: grease and food debris
summary: Repeat violations not corrected from April 2025: grease and food debris on cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, and shelves, plus food debris on walls and floors. Must be corrected by reinspection date.

headline: No thermometers; missing certificates; dump sink needed
summary: No internal air thermometers in hot- or cold-holding equipment. No dump sink in alcohol prep area; walk-in cooler light non-functional. No food handler or allergen awareness certificates on site.

headline: Items stored on utility closet floor
summary: Items stored on utility closet floor. Person in charge must store all items at least six inches off the floor.

headline: Dead roaches; several foods too warm
summary: Dead roaches under dry storage racks and near 3-compartment sink must be removed. Cut melon, yogurt, cottage cheese, and sliced chicken were too warm; 15 lbs (about $250) discarded. Loose faucet and greasy floors noted.

headline: Food stored on basement floor
summary: Short-form complaint: food containers stored on basement storage floor. Manager instructed to elevate them at least six inches on raised shelving.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; no thermometers
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine at final rinse because the sanitizer container was empty; manager told to correct. Prep coolers missing thermometers. Chipped plastic containers reused as utensils.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods served
summary: Person in charge lacks a Chicago food sanitation certificate. No certified manager on duty while cooked rice, chicken, and pork were prepared and served; citation issued. Missing handwashing signs; repairs needed.

headline: Expired allergen training for city food manager
summary: Empty boxes and clutter in rear storage near exit must be removed. Expired allergen training for a city food manager; must renew and keep certificate on site.

headline: No calibrated metal stem thermometer on site
summary: Failed: no calibrated metal stem thermometer on premises. Manager must provide one by the reinspection date.

headline: Failed: about 80 mouse droppings; no thermometer
summary: About 50 mouse droppings in rear dry storage and about 30 behind front counter storage shelves. Additional pest control needed; citation issued. No thermometer inside rear storage refrigerator; burnt-out bulb in kitchen cooler.

headline: Restroom receptacles need lids
summary: Garbage containers in all-gender restrooms lack lids. Must provide covered disposal for feminine products.

headline: Utensils stored in dry food; dirty grease trap
summary: Re-inspection passed. In-use utensils stored inside dry food containers; plates not inverted. Broken cooler door handle, grease trap buildup near dish sink, dirty floor corners, and exposed ceiling.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; about 50 lbs discarded
summary: Soup, rice, beef, and chicken in walk-in cooler measured 50.3-52.0°F; about 50 lbs discarded. Also unlabeled bulk bins, scoop handles touching food, and torn gaskets on freezer.

headline: Damaged floor tile in dish area
summary: Some floor tile in rear dishwashing area is in poor repair. Replace where needed.

headline: Re-inspection passed; cluttered closet, dirty mop sink
summary: Re-inspection passed. Dining area closet cluttered and must be organized. Mop sink, walls around it, pipes behind cooking equipment, and floors under equipment need cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled spices; upright utensils; items on floor
summary: Bar wine cooler ambient air measured 50.7°F; no citation issued. Dried spices in unlabeled containers. Plates, pots, and skillets stored right side up; must be inverted. Boxes on stairway and boiler closet floor must be elevated.

headline: Missing restroom sign; unlabeled flour; allergen certificate
summary: No handwashing sign in women's restroom. Flour container unlabeled. Rice spoon stored in standing water. Fly trap placed on food shelves; keep away from food. Manager has no allergen certificate.

headline: No written employee health policy; cooler needs cleaning
summary: No written employee health policy on premises; citation issued, and management must keep a signed policy for each employee. Interior of pizza prep cooler needs cleaning.

headline: Dirty ice machine guard; no allergen training
summary: Ice machine interior guard has dirt. One certified food manager lacks an allergen awareness certificate; must obtain one. Basement walk-in cooler has food stored on floor; elevate six inches.

headline: Re-inspection passed; heavy grease needs cleaning
summary: Re-inspection passed. Heavy grease and dirt found on shelving, prep tables, walk-in cooler walls and shelves, cooking equipment, floors, and hood filters. Staff told to clean all areas to help prevent pests.

headline: No certified manager; hand sink lacked soap, towels
summary: No person in charge with valid certificate, and no certified manager on duty while chicken, beef, and rice were handled; citation issued. Basement hand sink lacked soap and paper towels; both were obtained during inspection.

headline: Rat droppings; too little chlorine; unwashed hands
summary: At least 15 rat droppings in rear storage and dish areas, plus a gnawed food box; citation issued and pest control contacted. Low-temperature dish machine had only 10 ppm chlorine at final rinse (needs 100 ppm). Employee handled clean dishes without washing hands; corrected.

headline: Rust, missing toilet lids, dirty floors
summary: Rust on walk-in cooler shelving. Women's restroom receptacles missing lids. Dirt and debris built up along walls and under counters in the food service area. Repairs and cleaning ordered.

headline: Roach infestation and flies; pest service required
summary: Still an infestation: about 16 or more live roaches in wall voids, cabinets, and inside a reach-in freezer, plus dead roaches. About 25 or more live small flies in prep areas. Pest control required on or after 7/16/26.

headline: Oversized pots don't fit sink; hole in wall
summary: Pots too large to fully submerge in three-compartment sink; must remove them or show proper sanitizing. Residue in sliding cooler door track. Hole in wall near cooking area. Grease on hood filters.

headline: Items stored on floor in cooler and freezer
summary: Items stored on floor in walk-in cooler and freezer. Person in charge must keep all items at least six inches off the floor.

headline: Mold in ice machine; dog on site; toxic spray
summary: Black mold-like substance inside ice machine used for human consumption; citation issued. Sanitizer measured 0 ppm; sink emptied. Roach spray stored under bar sink, corrected on site. A prohibited dog was removed. Missing bar floor tiles and a 2-inch toilet room floor hole.

headline: Missing drainboard; peeling plastic; freezer floor
summary: No drainboard at three-compartment sink; must install one. Peeling plastic on shelving and sink. Peeling plastic and exposed insulation in walk-in freezer floor. Stored items on rear walkway must be removed to prevent pest harboring.

headline: House flies found; no paper towels; repeat violations
summary: Complaint: about 10 house flies in rear prep, storage, and raw chicken areas; surfaces must be sanitized. No paper towels at prep sinks. Repeat violations: missing backflow devices and women's restroom receptacle cover.

headline: Wet wiping cloths left on prep surfaces
summary: Re-inspection passed. Wet wiping cloths on several prep surfaces. Must store cloths in sanitizer solution between uses.

headline: Full uncovered garbage in prep area
summary: Garbage cans in prep areas left full and uncovered overnight. Must be emptied nightly and fitted with lids. Cans and food debris on floor near handwashing sink and in rear storage closet.

headline: No hot water at restroom handwashing sink
summary: Hot-water handle stripped off women's restroom sink, so no hot water at handwashing sink. Must repair to deliver 100-120°F; citation issued. Heavy grease on fryers and black slime behind three-compartment sink.

headline: Failed: no paper towels; cold water; raw temperatures
summary: Hand sink in dish and bar area lacked paper towels; manager supplied them on site; citation issued. Women's restroom sink water at 75°F, below 100°F. Cooked chicken at 90-100°F; about 25 lbs of food discarded.

headline: Pots stored under pipes; spoons in cabinet
summary: Pots stored under plumbing pipe and fire sprinkler lines; must shield pipe or move pots. Single-use spoons stored in cabinet under hand sink; must move to clean, dry location at least 6 inches above floor.

headline: Boxed food on floor; damaged cutting boards
summary: Boxed food stored on floor under rear dry storage shelving must be raised 6 inches. Multiple cutting boards deeply scratched and stained. Accumulated food debris on prep area floors must be detail cleaned.

headline: Failed: about 120 mouse droppings found
summary: About 120 mouse droppings were found in prep, dish, dry storage, and bar areas. Entrance and rear doors have openings that must be sealed. Also missing: a vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure, sink stoppers, and current food handler certificates.

headline: Storage, mold, and allergen training issues
summary: Wet wiping cloths at the bar were not stored in sanitizing solution. Stored items in basement and bread storage were not elevated, and milk crates were used as shelves. Black mold was on the walk-in freezer wall and door. No allergen training proof was on site.

headline: Beard restraints and greasy cook line
summary: Employees with beards in prep and serving areas lacked beard restraints. Single-serve utensils for customers must be protected or inverted. Grease and food debris were behind the cooking line, a prep table was in poor repair, and the women's washroom bin needs a cover.

headline: Missing handwash sign; slow sink leak
summary: No handwashing sign was posted at the front bar hand sink. A slow leak at the two-compartment sink faucet in the rear kitchen must be repaired. Dust was found inside light shields above second-floor prep tables.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings and handwashing lapses
summary: About 40 rodent droppings were found along a rear storage wall, and a fly strip hung in prep. Food handlers did not wash hands between gloves and phone use. Soap and paper towels were missing at prep and restroom sinks.

headline: Failed: no manager on site; missing items
summary: No person in charge or certified food manager was on site while deli meat and cheese were prepared and served. Missing: vomit cleanup kit, sink paper towels, and an incomplete pest log. The summary report was not posted for the public.

headline: Frozen food in plastic bags; missing handwash signs
summary: Frozen food was stored in plastic grocery bags, and handwashing signs were missing in the prep area. Also noted: torn refrigerator gasket, leaking sink faucet, greasy equipment, uncovered washroom trash, broken floor and ceiling tiles, and a dirty hood.

headline: Two managers' allergen training expired
summary: Two certified food service managers had expired allergen awareness training certificates. The person in charge was told to renew them.

headline: Cold foods at 44–49°F; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Ham, chicken, turkey, milk, steak, and other foods in a one-door cooler measured 44–49°F, above the 41°F limit. Management was told to keep cold foods at 41°F or below. The certified food manager also lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Failed: live flies; cooked meat above 41°F
summary: About 25 live small flies were found in the front bar and rear pizza prep. Cooked chicken (47.8°F) and pork (48.0°F) in a prep cooler were discarded, about 8 lbs ($60). Overhead sewer lines in basement storage must be enclosed.

headline: Wall damage, grime, and debris in kitchen
summary: Damage was found on the wall near a two-door cooler in the rear dish room, which must be made smooth and cleanable. Spills and splatter were on the wall by a hand sink, and grime and debris covered rear kitchen floors.

headline: Missing handwash sign; manager lacks allergen training
summary: The exposed handwashing sink had no handwashing sign. The sanitation manager had no allergen training. Both must be provided.

headline: Slow-draining sinks and missing grout
summary: Hand sinks in the front and rear prep areas drain slowly and must be repaired. The all-gender washroom had no covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. Missing floor grout in rear food prep must be repaired for cleanability.

headline: Hole in ceiling above basement cooler
summary: A hole was found in the ceiling above the basement walk-in cooler. The inspector required it to be repaired. It was the only item noted.

headline: Failed: debris, leaks, and missing dumpster lids
summary: Spills and debris were found on the beverage machine, prep tables, shelving, and cooking equipment, and on floors under equipment. Drain pipes leak under the rear handwash sink and three-compartment sink. Two dumpster lids are missing.

headline: Unlabeled bulk ingredients and damaged floors
summary: Bulk flour and sugar had no labels with contents name. The deep freezer needed cleaning. Missing and damaged floor tiles were found in rear prep areas and the walk-in cooler, and a water-damaged wall was noted in beverage prep.

headline: Failed: 70 rodent droppings and live flies
summary: About 70 rodent droppings were scattered on floors behind refrigerators, under prep tables, and near the grill and register. Live black flies were flying in prep. No pest service proof was on site, and people entered prep from the street.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: On re-inspection, the sanitation manager still had no allergen training. The manager must provide proof of it.

headline: No certificate; two roaches; food on floor
summary: No City food manager certificate was on site at arrival. Two roach carcasses were in fourth-floor banquet storage. Food was stored on the walk-in freezer floor. A three-compartment sink drain backed up onto the floor; a technician serviced it.

headline: License number missing; small floor holes
summary: The business license number was not printed on the lateral sides of the unit at least two inches tall. Small holes leading outside were found under the customer service counter and must be sealed.

headline: Missing written employee health policy
summary: No written employee health policy was on the premises. Management must have a signed employee health policy for each employee.

headline: Two certified managers lack allergen training
summary: Allergen training certificates were missing for two certified food managers, who must provide proof of training.

headline: No food handler or allergen training; wall repairs
summary: Employees had no food handler training, and the certified manager had no allergen training. Exposed brick walls and some prep and bar ceilings must be made smooth and easily cleanable.

headline: Missing handwash signs and trash covers
summary: Handwashing signs were missing near sinks in the unisex customer washroom and second-floor washroom. The second-floor unisex washroom had no covered waste receptacle. Floor drains in the rear dishwashing area had dirt and food debris.

headline: Front door gap; food debris and cloths
summary: The front door had an opening at the bottom that must be sealed to be rodent-proof. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. Food debris was found in cabinets and on storage shelves.

headline: Vacuum-packed foods lacked required approval
summary: Vacuum-packed items in the front-lobby self-serve freezer, including ravioli and marinated chicken, had no required approval (a variance). The unit and 68 lbs of food were tagged and held. Sink stoppers and a handwash sign were also missing.

headline: Leaking sinks, grease trap, and duct-tape repair
summary: Dry food in plastic containers needs common-name labels. Duct tape repairs a wall by the fryers and must be replaced with a smooth, cleanable surface. Three-compartment sink faucet leaks; its grease trap is rusted and leaking.

headline: Unsafe cold food; 40 lbs discarded
summary: Cold foods in the prep cooler under the grill were 51.9–54.8°F. About 40 lbs (worth $350) was discarded. The cooler, at 56.1°F, is held and cannot be used until it holds 41°F or below.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate; no food handler proof
summary: The person in charge lacked a valid City sanitation certificate, and none was posted. No food handler training proof was provided. Employees ate in prep, and five dirty ashtrays sat in the rear dining room.

headline: Failed: missing training proof; dumpster area repeats
summary: No proof of food handler training was provided. Openings at a dock door must be sealed, boxes stored on the ground must be elevated, and trash and liquid waste in the dumpster area was a repeat violation.

headline: Five dead roaches found; food under sewer lines
summary: Five dead cockroaches were found on basement stairs, under a bar shelf, and in a cabinet by the espresso machine. Food was stored under unshielded sewer lines. Also noted: a missing cooler thermometer, torn gaskets, and cracked, warped shelves.

headline: Failed: uncorrected violations; calcium in ice machine
summary: Violations from a February 2024 report were not corrected. The ice machine had calcium buildup, and no certified food manager had allergen training. A citation was issued.

headline: Cooler at 48°F; expired allergen certificates
summary: Air in a two-door refrigerator's upper compartments reached 48.0°F, above 41°F. Expired allergen training certificates were on premises. Also noted: unlabeled bulk items, deeply cut cutting boards, greasy fryer compartments, and hood filters.

headline: Unlabeled containers and minor repairs needed
summary: Bulk flour and sugar need labels with common names. Also noted: a loose hot-water handle at the kitchen handwashing sink, a men's restroom door that does not self-close, and unsealed floor tiles at the bar.

headline: Failed: unsafe cold food, no certified manager
summary: Cold foods at 52–56°F, above the 41°F limit, were discarded (about 25 lbs). The front reach-in cooler could not hold 41°F and was tagged out of use. No certified food manager was on site while food was prepared.

headline: Cold milk unsafe; pet dog allowed inside
summary: Milk and plant milks in both prep coolers measured 47–55°F; about 56 lbs was discarded. The coolers reached 46.8–48.9°F and were held. A customer's pet dog was inside, and staff did not ask if it was a service animal.

headline: Dried debris and dust in coolers and cabinets
summary: Display and reach-in coolers had dried food debris inside and dust on their vents and sides. Cabinets under the registers had excessive dust and trash. Staff were instructed to detail clean and maintain these areas.

headline: Failed: hot food below 135°F; low hot water
summary: Ready-to-eat hot foods such as meatballs and wings measured 114.8–132.8°F, below 135°F; about 12 lbs was discarded. The hot-holding cabinet at 118.9°F was held. Hand sink water at the coffee station was 62.1°F, and no food handler training was provided.

headline: No handwash signs; manager lacks allergen training
summary: No handwashing signage was found at hand sinks, and it must be provided. A City of Chicago sanitation manager had no allergen training and must obtain it.

headline: No certified manager during food prep; repeat gap
summary: No certified food manager or valid documentation was on site while lamb, soups, and shrimp were prepared and served. Also: unlabeled bulk containers, no hair restraint for one employee, and a repeat allergen training gap.

headline: Failed: no hot water at exposed hand sink
summary: The exposed handwashing sink had no hot water because its hot-water knob was stripped. It must deliver 100–120°F water. Also noted: a torn gasket on a basement prep cooler, and an unused dish machine in the first-floor bar.

headline: Failed: black slime in ice machine; expired training
summary: Black slime built up inside an ice machine making customer ice. Several food handlers had expired training. Also noted: a torn cooler gasket, heavy ice in an ice cream freezer, and no public summary posted.

headline: Minor drain leak under three-compartment sink
summary: A minor leak was found at the drain pipe below the three-compartment sink and must be repaired. Floors by the chicken prep line also needed cleaning.

headline: Failed: blocked hand sink; hot food too cool
summary: The rear handwashing sink was blocked by a prep table and must stay accessible. Hot-held foods were too cool, including pastries at 72–78°F and frank rolls at 128°F; they must stay at 135°F or above. A citation was issued.

headline: Torn cooler door gasket to be replaced
summary: A torn door gasket was found on the two-door prep cooler beside the hand sink in the main kitchen. The inspector instructed staff to replace it and keep it maintained.

headline: Thawing, linens on food, and missing handwash signs
summary: Fish was thawed inside sealed reduced-oxygen packaging, and clean linens were stored against ribs in a hot-holding unit. The inspector instructed staff to fix both. Also: missing handwash signs, greasy cooking equipment, and damaged base coving.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup procedure
summary: No signed employee health policy was on site. No written procedure or supplies for cleaning up vomiting and diarrhea events were available. Both must be provided and maintained.

headline: Failed: no vomit kit, thermometer, or pest log
summary: No procedure or supplies for vomiting and diarrhea events were on site. No metal stem thermometer was available. No pest control logbook or proof of pest service was on site.

headline: Ice machine residue; beard guard; cardboard liner
summary: A slight brownish substance was on the ice machine panel and must be cleaned. A male food handler with a beard lacked a beard guard. Cardboard was reused as a floor liner in the walk-in cooler and must be removed.

headline: Missing grout between dish-area floor tiles
summary: Grout was missing between floor tiles in the dishwashing area near the high-temperature dish machine. The inspector instructed staff to regrout for easier cleaning.

headline: Rat droppings and unsafe cold food found
summary: About 40 rat droppings were found under the bar's three-compartment sink, and about 35 small flies were in prep areas. Cold foods at 50–56°F, about 15 lbs, were discarded. A prep cooler at 56.7°F may not be used until reinspected.

headline: Cleaning and basement floor repairs needed
summary: Clean the interior of the pizza prep cooler, deep fryers, and cook-line freezer. Basement prep and storage floors are chipped and gouged and must be repainted. Floors under racks and spiderwebs on walls and ceilings also need cleaning.

headline: Dirty ice chute and no food handler certificate
summary: Interior of the self-serve ice chute was not clean; ice is used by people. Restroom faucet ran too briefly for handwashing (needs 15 seconds). No food handler training certificate was on site. Trash area needs upkeep.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; soap and towels missing
summary: No vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit or written procedure was on site. Soap and paper towels were missing at several handwash sinks, and toilet tissue was missing in basement washrooms. Doors were not self-closing.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; allergen certificates absent
summary: No working thermometer was in the one-door soda cooler at the front prep area. Food debris was inside the rear two-door reach-in cooler. No food allergen training certificates were on premises.

headline: Manager lacks valid sanitation certificate; training gaps
summary: The person in charge and on-duty manager lacked a valid City sanitation certificate. No food handler or allergen training certificates were on site. Also noted: a broken screen door, a leaking sink pipe, and greasy floors.

headline: Failed: 7 live flies; ice machine debris
summary: Seven live house flies were on walls, windows, and flying in front prep and dining areas. Additional pest control service was recommended. Ice machine interior had encrusted debris, and frozen food was in plastic grocery bags.

headline: Raw wood counter, dusty vent, unused cooler
summary: A raw wooden counter beside the hot-holding unit must be painted or sealed. A ceiling vent cover above the front prep ovens was dusty. An unused cooler must be removed to prevent pest harboring.

headline: Missing handwash sign; freezer and hood buildup
summary: No handwashing sign was posted at the hand sink. Heavy ice buildup was found inside chest freezers. Also noted: a leaking three-compartment sink faucet, dirty floor drains, and grease and dirt in the exhaust hood, filters, and pipes.

headline: Failed: no valid sanitation certificate on site
summary: No valid City of Chicago food service sanitation certificate was on the premises, and the pest control logbook lacked required documentation. Unused materials and a toilet on the rear walkway must be removed to prevent rodent harboring.

headline: Ice machine upper parts and ceiling tile
summary: Some upper portions of the ice machine need cleaning. A missing or damaged ceiling tile above the kitchen box freezer must be replaced.

headline: Food on floors; side door needs rodent-proofing
summary: Food containers were stored on floors in the walk-in cooler and prep areas, and the side door needs rodent-proofing. Also noted: unlabeled ingredients, ice scoop stored on bin, rust, worn cutting boards, torn gaskets, and greasy equipment and floors.

headline: Handwash sink water pressure below code
summary: Hot and cold water at the produce-prep handwash sink did not meet city pressure requirements, and a citation was issued. Torn weather stripping was on two walk-in cooler doors, and the ice cream display freezer had heavy ice buildup.

headline: Failed: gaps let pests in; repeat violations
summary: Openings at the base of the rear exit door and front entrance doors must be sealed to block pests. Repeat violations from a 2023 report were not corrected, including crates for storage. Certified manager also lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Dirty coolers, loose debris, allergen training gap
summary: Interiors of the display cooler and reach-in coolers need detail cleaning. Loose debris was found on floors and in corners throughout. The city certified food manager had no proof of allergen training.

headline: Failed: hand-washing lapses; 310 lbs cold food discarded
summary: Staff did not wash hands between tasks and misused gloves. Cold foods at 50–75°F, including sausage and eggs, were in glass coolers that read 60°F. About 310 lbs ($454) was discarded. The menu lacked a raw-food advisory.

headline: Food in tin cans; dirty floors and filters
summary: Food was stored inside tin cans in a reach-in cooler and must be moved to food-grade containers. Also noted: aprons in the walk-in cooler, ice buildup in a rear freezer, dirty floors, an improperly stored mop, and greasy filters.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; no allergen training
summary: Food handler certificates were expired, and the certified food manager had no allergen training certificate. Employees in food areas were not wearing hair restraints. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks and is held together with tape.

headline: Failed: no vomit cleanup kit or procedure
summary: No vomit and diarrhea spill kit or written cleanup procedure was on site. No chemical test kit for sanitizer was available, and a sanitation manager lacked allergen training. Basement clutter must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Ice bin, grease, leaking sink, peeling baseboards
summary: The ice bin interior needed cleaning. Grease covered cooking equipment, walls, and floors in kitchen and prep areas. The three-compartment sink leaked from its third-compartment drain, and baseboards were peeling.

headline: Failed: about 100 flies and a live roach
summary: Over 100 small flies were in the bar area, with 30–50 more in basement onion storage and the three-compartment area. One live cockroach was on the bar wall. The last pest service did not treat for flies.

headline: Uncovered food and improperly stored knives
summary: A food item was left uncovered at the front counter and must be covered. Knives were stored between surfaces such as coolers, freezers, and the three-compartment sink. Staff were instructed to store them properly.

headline: Walk-in display not working; floor and ceiling damage
summary: The walk-in cooler's external temperature display at the front door is not working. The internal thermometer read under 41°F, so the cooler was holding proper temperature. Missing floor tiles and damaged ceiling tiles also need repair.

headline: No covered sanitary-napkin bin in employee washroom
summary: The employee washroom had no covered receptacle for disposing of sanitary napkins. The inspector instructed the operator to provide one.

headline: No food thermometer; splash guard and grease issues
summary: No metal stem thermometer was on site for checking food temperatures. A splash guard was needed at the front exposed hand sink. Deep fryers needed degreasing, walk-in shelves had rust, and floors under cooking equipment needed cleaning.

headline: Improper labels, peeling paint, unused machine
summary: Frozen prepackaged arancini and meatballs in the display freezer lacked proper labels showing net contents and manufacturer address. Also: peeling paint on ductwork above the dishwasher, and an unused vacuum packaging machine to be removed.

headline: Greasy equipment sides need cleaning
summary: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment, including deep fryers, cold-holding units, and ovens, were heavily soiled with dried food debris and grease. Staff were instructed to clean them regularly.

headline: Leaking sink faucet; allergen training still missing
summary: A loose faucet leaked at the three-compartment sink and must be repaired. Sanitation managers still had no allergen training, a repeat violation from a 2023 report, and a citation was issued.

headline: Cleaning items corrected on site
summary: Particles under the grill counter in the halal kitchen were cleaned on site. Floors behind the ice machines, floor drains, and corners of the deli/salad station also needed cleaning, and those were corrected on site.

headline: Handwash signs needed at prep sinks
summary: Handwashing signs were needed at the prep area handwashing sinks. The inspector instructed staff to provide them. No other issues were listed.

headline: Employee washroom door not self-closing
summary: The employee washroom door near the kitchen had no self-closing device. The inspector instructed the operator to install one. No other issues were listed.

headline: Failed: no health policy or food handler proof
summary: No written employee health policy or vomit cleanup policy was on site. Ready-to-eat shrimp, chicken, and dumplings lacked date labels. No food handler training proof was provided. Sanitizer test kit missing and faucets leak.

headline: Items on floors, dirty drains, ceiling holes
summary: Boxed single-use items were stored on the floor in rear storage, which also had clutter. Dirty floor drains and floors under drink machines and the three-compartment sink needed cleaning. Ceiling panels had holes near the rear exit, and a light bulb was burnt out.

headline: Failed: hot food not at 135°F; many gaps
summary: Steam-table food was not held at 135°F, and no probe thermometer was available. No employee health policy, vomit cleanup policy, or menu raw-food advisory was in place. Pest control logbook missing; gaps under doors and an overflowing dumpster noted.

headline: Peeling paint behind restroom sink
summary: The wall behind the restroom washbasin had damage and peeling paint. The person in charge was instructed to repair it so it is smooth and easily cleanable.

headline: Front door opening; rusty can opener tip
summary: An opening at the base of the outer front entrance door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Rust on a can opener tip in the front prep area must be removed to prevent food contamination.

headline: Failed: hand sink water only 72°F
summary: Hot water at the employee washroom handsink measured 72°F, but all handwashing sinks must be at least 100°F. A citation was issued. Dust buildup was also found on ceiling and wall vents in prep and storage areas.

headline: Unlabeled containers; food stored on floor
summary: Food storage containers lacked labels with common food names. Food containers were stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer and must be raised at least six inches. The employee restroom lacked a covered sanitary napkin receptacle.

headline: Hot water and drain fixed on site; allergen gap
summary: A hand sink near the three-compartment sink reached only 87°F; an employee turned up the water heater, restoring hot water on site. The floor drain under that sink flooded until the manager cleared it. Rusted cooler racks were also noted.

headline: Truck missing license number on sides
summary: The license number was missing from the sides of the truck. The operator was instructed to provide it and keep it displayed.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; dead bugs in food
summary: No City certified food manager was on premises. Dead bugs were found in sugar, flour, and cornmeal containers; about 10 lbs was discarded on site. Foods held at 48.6–86.9°F were discarded. Ice machine had pink and black mold.

headline: Failed: no hot water at any sink
summary: No hot running water was available at any sink (about 60°F). Handwash sinks must reach 100–110°F, and the three-compartment sink at least 110°F. Also noted: black residue inside the ice machine and food debris on several units.

headline: Shrimp thawed at room temperature; door gap
summary: Shrimp was thawed at room temperature; staff must thaw it in the refrigerator. The front door needs a bottom seal to be rodent-proof. Also noted: plastic bags used as sink stoppers, a missing handwashing sign, and dirty floors.

headline: Failed: 15–20 rat droppings found near dishwashing
summary: About 15–20 rat droppings were found at the bar near the dish machine and sink, and in kitchen prep. Staff must clean them and get additional pest control. The ice bin interior also needed cleaning.

headline: Unused equipment, damaged toilet handle, wet mop
summary: Unused large cooking equipment and an oil removal tool near the rear exit must be removed. The men's bathroom toilet handle was damaged. A mop was soaking in a bucket and must be stored so it can dry between uses.

headline: Debris in ice machine; sink pipe leaking
summary: Debris was found inside the basement ice machine and must be removed and detail cleaned. A slow leak under the rear dishwashing sink pipe must be repaired.

headline: Debris and dirt on prep-area floors
summary: Coffee beans, food debris, and dirt were found on floors along walls, under prep stations, and in corners of prep and warewashing areas. The person in charge was instructed to clean all of them.

headline: Dusty plates, freezer ice, uncovered washroom trash
summary: Serving plates on prep-area shelves were not inverted, leaving them open to dust. Ice had built up inside a basement chest freezer. Employee washroom trash cans lacked lids.

headline: Living quarters in food storage; no pest log
summary: A bed, TV, and personal food were found in the dry storage room, where sleeping is not allowed. Also missing: pest control logbook, vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit, and waste hauling contract. Food was stored on the floor.

headline: Corrected on return; food handler training missing
summary: On a May 5, 2025 return, the vomit cleanup kit, dish machine temperature, and backed-up toilet were corrected. At inspection, most food handlers lacked training and food was stored on floors.

headline: Ceiling opening above utensils; allergen training missing
summary: Passed. An opening in the ceiling above the clean utensil rack must be covered. The food service manager has no allergen training certificate and was told to obtain one.

headline: Foil contact with meats; cold foods too warm
summary: Passed with conditions; citations issued. Aluminum foil embedded into cooked corned beef and turkey, which were discarded, about 21 pounds. Ready-to-eat chicken, turkey and corned beef measured 48-50.1F in a cooler and were discarded, about 4-5 pounds.

headline: Failed: slime in ice machine; ice discarded
summary: Failed. Black and pink slime build-up inside the ice machine was dripping into ice used for consumption. All ice was discarded and the interior must be cleaned by reinspection. Also food debris on the dish machine and coolers, a leaking sink faucet, and dusty ceiling tiles.

headline: Failed: handsink lacked hot water; food too cool
summary: Failed; citation issued. The rear handwashing sink measured 71F and had no running hot water. Chicken and steak in the hot holding unit measured 105-124F, below the required 135F. The manager voluntarily discarded about 10 pounds ($50).

headline: Beard restraint missing; grease behind cook line
summary: Passed. A cook with a beard lacked a beard restraint. Milk crates must not be used to elevate stored items. Grease and food debris built up behind the cooking line and inside and outside deep fryers. Grime on floors under the dish machine and bar counter.

headline: Hair restraints missing; dirty coolers and microwave
summary: Passed. Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints. Microwave interior was dirty. Both coolers, including two stored in a hallway closet, had food debris and splashes on their bottom interiors. Certified food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Rear door gap; wiping cloths stored improperly
summary: Passed. A gap over 1/4 inch at the rear exterior door must be sealed to keep pests out. Wiping cloths were stored in water without adequate sanitizer. A nonfunctional three-door cooler has heavy dried food debris. Damaged ceiling tiles above the grill line must be replaced.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen training
summary: Passed. Food storage containers must be labeled when food is not in its original package. Scoops must be removed from food containers, multi-use utensils inverted, and grill table debris cleaned. Employees lack food handler training and the food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Failed: handwash water above 120F
summary: Failed. Hot water measured above 120F at the customer washroom sinks. Management was instructed to keep handwashing water between 100F and 120F at all handwashing sinks. Priority foundation violation.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings found; no spill kit
summary: Failed; citations issued. About 40 mouse droppings behind the bar and 30 rat and 40 mouse droppings in rear storage; pest control needed. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door. No vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit or procedure, and no sanitizer test kit.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; debris on shelves and trays
summary: Passed. Single-service trays stored faced up on cook-line shelves must be inverted. A reach-in cooler has torn gaskets. Food debris on shelving and in a prep cooler. Dusty walk-in fan guards. A wet mop stored in its bucket must be hung to dry.

headline: Beard restraints missing; knives stored improperly
summary: Passed. Several cook-line staff lacked beard restraints. In-use knives were stored between a cutting board and a cooler surface. A handsink faucet leaks. Food debris on floors under cook-line equipment and soda storage. Outdoor waste enclosure is cluttered.

headline: To-go boxes stored under dripping oven
summary: Passed. Cardboard to-go boxes were stored beneath a drawer oven with grease dripping onto them; they must be relocated. Floors under equipment, shelving in the main kitchen and walk-in freezer had fried food debris and dried grease.

headline: Failed: 25 fruit flies at coffee station
summary: Failed; citation issued. About 25 fruit flies found at the coffee station areas. Manager must notify the pest control operator and eliminate them. Floors at the coffee station also need cleaning.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings; no certified manager
summary: Failed; multiple citations. About 25 rodent droppings in boxes of chips in the customer service area; pest control recommended. No certified manager on site while beef was served. Dumpster overflowing. Heavy leak under food prep handsink; no food handler training proof.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: Passed. The certified food manager did not have an allergen training certificate. Training is required for all employees holding a City of Chicago food sanitation certificate; they must complete it and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Failed: 80+ mouse droppings; unsafe reheating
summary: Failed; multiple citations. Approximately 80 or more mouse droppings found, including near cooking equipment, prep tables and cutting boards. Food was reheated in hot holding units and rice and peas measured 79.8F. No certified manager with the original certificate on site.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; no allergen training
summary: Passed. Milk crates used as shelving in the basement walk-in cooler and freezer must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor. Also missing a covered toilet receptacle, burnt-out bulbs, and allergen training proof for the certified food manager.

headline: Pulled chicken cooled improperly; about 23 lbs
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. About 23 pounds of cooked pulled chicken at 50.3F in a covered container in the walk-in cooler was cooled improperly. The facility's quick chill machine was used for corrective action. Also a missing thermometer (provided), dirty floor drains, and deli cooler spills.

headline: Dirty ice machine; missing allergen training proof
summary: Passed. Interior areas of the ice machine bin and chute were dirty. Water pooling from an unknown source under the west three-compartment sink must be cleaned up. A ceiling tile and a light shield are missing. Managers must provide allergen training proof.

headline: Failed: handsink blocked by ice machine tubing
summary: Failed; citation issued. Ice machine tubing drains into the front prep handsink basin, making it hard to access. No backflow prevention device at the ice machine. Excess clutter in the rear area near the three-compartment sink and back door.

headline: Missing ceiling light cover above prep area
summary: Passed. One ceiling light cover is missing above the prep area and must be provided.

headline: Failed: about 20 small flies; unscreened windows
summary: Failed. About 20 small flies were on the ceilings and flying around the vehicle; instructed to eliminate them and clean affected areas. Both top service windows lack mesh screens. The vehicle lacks its required license number on the sides.

headline: Ice machine residue; raw wood shelving
summary: Passed. Residue on the interior of the ice machine must be cleaned. Raw wood shelving in dishwashing must be sealed to make it smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Rust in ice machine; sink leak needs repair
summary: Passed. Rust found inside the ice machine; ice must be destroyed and the interior cleaned and sanitized. A leak under the three-compartment sink needs repair. Missing grout and damaged floor tiles also noted.

headline: Cracked counter; invalid food handler certificate
summary: Passed. The counter above the dish machine is cracked and has a hole sealed with cardboard and tape. The convection oven interior is dirty. A leak under the one-compartment prep sink drains into a container. The employee on site had an invalid food handler certificate.

headline: Poor walls; handsinks not secured to wall
summary: Passed. Walls in the dishwashing area are in poor repair. Handwashing sinks in prep and dishwashing areas are not secured to the wall. The manager was instructed to repair and maintain them.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup procedure
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy on premises, and no written procedure or supplies for vomiting and diarrhea events; both are priority violations with no citation. Cold holding units lack thermometers. Ceiling gaps and a missing light shield also noted.

headline: Missing handwashing sign at prep sink
summary: Passed. Handwashing signage was missing at the handwash sink in the prep area. Manager was instructed to provide the sign and maintain it.

headline: Failed: no adequate handwashing sink for prep areas
summary: Failed. The front beverage area lacks a proper handwashing sink; one must be installed for all prep, dispensing and warewashing areas. A rear prep cooler lacks an air thermometer. Damaged gasket, debris, raw wood shelving and clutter also noted.

headline: Dish machine lacked sanitizer and is tagged
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. The low-temperature dish machine in the bar had no sanitizer while in use; it is tagged and must not be used until reinspected. Major leak under the rear high-temperature dish machine. Employees lack food handler training.

headline: Dessert cooler door doesn't close properly
summary: Passed. The door hinge on the one-door dessert cooler near the drive-thru needs adjustment so the door closes properly.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea response plan or supplies
summary: Passed with conditions; citations issued. No plan or supplies for responding to vomiting and diarrhea events; manager must provide gloves, masks, disposable mops and norovirus-effective sanitizer. Clutter in the storage closet. Inspection summary was not posted.

headline: No chlorine test strips on site
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. No chlorine test strips were on site, though the manager was using chlorine packets for dishes. The manager obtained strips at the end of the inspection. Food debris and syrup built up on floor corners in the rear prep area.

headline: Soup at 54F; grease container not maintained
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. Soup in the walk-in cooler measured 54F; the manager voluntarily discarded 40 pounds ($50). Large pots don't fit in the three-compartment sink and need a washing procedure. Leak at dishwashing handsink. Outside grease container had thick grease.

headline: Failed: clogged handsink; no food handler proof
summary: Failed; citation issued. A rear handsink by the dish area is clogged and in poor repair; staff were told to use another nearby sink. A food handler lacked a training certificate and a cook lacked a hair restraint. Previous core violations listed again.

headline: Cardboard liners; dirty coolers and hood filters
summary: Passed. Ice bin interior needs cleaning. Storage containers lack common-name labels. Cardboard was used as liners on prep and beverage tables. Reach-in coolers and condiment cooler need detailed cleaning. Hood filters need cleaning. Missing and stained ceiling tiles and damaged floor laminate need repair.

headline: Failed: no sanitation certificate; potatoes too cool
summary: Failed; multiple citations. No City sanitation certificate on site while handling time- and temperature-controlled foods; provided when the owner arrived. Potatoes at 113F and 95F discarded, about 5 pounds. Three-compartment sink not set up for sanitizing. Two dumpsters overflowing.

headline: Milk crates used for storage; oven greasy
summary: Passed. Paper towel refills stored in the employee washroom must be moved out. Milk crates elevate food and equipment in the kitchen and walk-in cooler and must be replaced with equipment that allows cleaning underneath. The pizza oven exterior is heavily greasy; a 4-compartment sink faucet drips.

headline: Missing handwash signs; unlabeled to-go foods
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs missing in the prep area and toilet room. Prepackaged to-go foods lack labels with business name, address and ingredients. Rear three-compartment sink needs an adequate drainboard. Refrigeration units need cleaning. Holes, missing ceiling tiles and clutter in an unused cooler.

headline: Multiple employees have expired food handler training
summary: Passed. Multiple employees had expired food handler training. All employees must complete training and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Missing handwash sign; several leaks
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign at the rear prep handsink. A damaged gasket on a front prep reach-in cooler. The front three-compartment sink faucet leaks, and a drainpipe leaks under the rear handsink. Manager must repair and maintain.

headline: Openings in doors; missing handwash signs
summary: Passed. Openings at the base and middle of double entrance doors to storage and prep areas must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Handwashing signs are missing at employee washroom sinks. Both washrooms lack covered receptacles for sanitary products.

headline: Handsink lacked cold water; water too hot
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. The rear handsink had no cold running water, and hot water measured 133F, above the 120F maximum. Also missing raw-food consumer advisory, dish machine temperature indicator, and allergen training certificates.

headline: Bar handsink blocked; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Passed with conditions. A rack of clean glasses blocked the bar handwashing sink; it must stay accessible. The low-temperature dish machine, in use during inspection, showed 0 ppm sanitizer at final rinse. Manager must correct the sanitizer concentration.

headline: Broken soap dispenser; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. A broken soap dispenser at the rear handwashing sink must be repaired. Black slime was found inside the rear prep cooler. The manager on duty lacked current allergen training and must complete it and keep records on site.

headline: No food handler cards on site
summary: Passed. No food handler cards were on site; employees must complete training and keep records on site. Heavy grease on hood filters over the cook line; three hood bulbs are missing or not working. An unused cooler and basement clutter also need attention.

headline: Grease and debris throughout; leaking faucet
summary: Passed. Grease and food debris found on cooking equipment, holding units, shelving, coolers and freezers, and under equipment. A three-compartment sink faucet leaks. Stained ceiling tiles and dusty light shields and vents also noted.

headline: Clutter in hall near restroom
summary: Passed. Clutter in the hallway near the restroom must be removed and organized. Items not needed for the business should be removed.

headline: Door gap; crates used as shelving; expired training
summary: Passed. A gap in the front double doors must be made tight-fitting. Crates are used for food storage in prep and must be replaced. Food debris from the fryer cabinet and oven; splatter on walls. Some employees have expired food handler training.

headline: Rat droppings and flies found; corrected on site
summary: Passed with conditions; citations issued. Prior violation not fixed: over 90 rat droppings and 30+ small flies were found earlier; a 9/23/2025 reinspection found 14 rat droppings and about 10 flies. Droppings and flies were removed and cleaned on site. No certified manager on premises.

headline: Missing handwash sign; unsmooth lower-level wall
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign at bar areas. A wall in lower-level food storage is not smooth or easy to clean and must be repaired. Scrap wood and other clutter in lower-level storage must be cleared and sanitized.

headline: Failed: over 1,000 mouse droppings found
summary: Failed; multiple citations. Over 1,000 mouse droppings found on the prep area floor, under basement boxes and on pallets; the manager must remove them and call pest control. Also no employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea clean-up supplies, or test kit; leaking pipes.

headline: Mold-like buildup on racks; thermometers needed
summary: Passed. Walk-in storage racks had excessive mold-like buildup. Thermometers must be visible inside all coolers. Storage containers lacked readable labels. Floors, a floor drain with black slime, and walls with dry food spillage need detailed cleaning.

headline: Food prepared without certified manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. Food handlers prepared time- and temperature-controlled foods without a certified food manager on site; one arrived at 2:45. The person in charge lacked proof of food safety training. Frozen portions were stored in grocery bags.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; blocked handsink
summary: Failed; multiple citations. No certified manager on duty while chicken, beef and noodles were prepared and served. Prep handsink is blocked by a cooler drain pipe and tank. No current pest control log book. Food handler and allergen training certificates missing; inspection summary not posted.

headline: Cold foods above 41F; about 50 lbs discarded
summary: Passed with conditions; citations issued. Raw chicken, dairy and other cold foods measured 44.4-49.8F; about 50 pounds ($1,200) discarded. A tall refrigerator measured 50F. No valid sanitation certificate posted; no employee health policy. Several cleaning and repair items noted.

headline: Failed: rat droppings found; no certified manager
summary: Failed; citations issued. About 15 rat droppings under grocery display shelving; pest control service is needed and the area must be detail cleaned. No certified manager on site while chicken and beef were handled. A food handler lacked a certificate.

headline: Hair restraint missing; greasy, dirty floors
summary: Passed. A food handler prepared food without a hair restraint. Floors under cooking equipment, along walls and in corners were dirty with grease and food debris. Dust on light shields and vents. Basement washroom lacks a covered sanitary receptacle.

headline: Rust on shelf and grease trap
summary: Passed. Rust found on the bottom shelf and grease trap in the rear food prep area. Manager was instructed to remove the rust and make the surfaces smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Hair restraints missing; rusty walk-in shelving
summary: Passed. Employees in the food preparation area prepared food without hair restraints; they must wear them whenever food is prepared and served. Rusty shelving inside a walk-in cooler must be repainted or replaced.

headline: Cooked chili and soups lacked date marks
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. Cooked chili and soups held over 24 hours in the prep cooler were not date marked. Ice machine interior needs debris removed. Floors, mop room clutter and vent dust also need attention. No pests recorded.

headline: Failed: live roaches and mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. Found 2 live roaches, about 10-15 mouse droppings in several areas, and some flies in the dish and prep area. Pest control recommended. No vomit and diarrhea procedure or kit, no employee health policy, and managers lack allergen training.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit cleanup supplies
summary: Passed with conditions; citations issued. No certified manager on site or certificate posted while rice was prepared and served. No procedures or supplies for vomiting and diarrhea events. Floor tile grout is missing and a floor drain is dirty; certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: No certified manager; unlabeled bulk food
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. No City sanitation manager certificate on premises while burgers and chicken were handled. Bulk flour, sugar and spices lack labels. Small leak at the rear hand sink. Two disconnected ovens and a stove must be removed. Manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Missing thermometer; expired food handler certificate
summary: Passed. The garage refrigerator had no thermometer; management was instructed to provide thermometers in all refrigerators. One food handler had an expired food handler certificate and must provide a valid one.

headline: Gaps under patio and rear doors
summary: Passed. About 1/4-inch gaps at the bottom of the patio door and the rear exit door by the ice machine must be sealed to prevent pest entry. No pests were recorded.

headline: Failed: weak handsink water; overfilled dumpster
summary: Failed; citation issued. The women's restroom handwashing sink produced only a small stream, too weak for proper handwashing; manager must restore adequate water pressure. The outside dumpster is filled past capacity and its lid cannot close.

headline: Uncovered food; missing ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. Bagels stored on a shelf above the prep cooler and uncovered condiments at the cook line must be covered to protect against overhead contamination. Missing ceiling tiles above prep tables must be replaced or reattached.

headline: Failed: raw meats cross-contaminated; 40 lbs discarded
summary: Failed; citations issued. Raw chicken, pork and shrimp were stored together, with raw chicken over shrimp and pork over chicken, and juices dripping. The manager discarded about 40 pounds ($200). No working food thermometer and no sanitizer test kit on site. Dumpster has a hole.

headline: Failed: live cockroaches, flies; cold food too warm
summary: Failed; multiple citations. One live cockroach under the convection oven, plus dead cockroaches, 2 live house flies and 5 small flying insects; more pest control needed. Cheese at 55F and other cold foods at 46-51F were above 41F. Almost all food handlers have expired certificates.

headline: No allergen training proof on site
summary: Passed. No proof of allergen training was on site. Managers were instructed to meet the requirement for City of Chicago food sanitation managers.

headline: Broken toilet flush chain in staff restroom
summary: Passed. The staff toilet has a broken flush chain. The manager was instructed to repair it.

headline: Open drink on prep line; grease buildup
summary: Passed. A food handler drank from an open cup on the prep line; drinks must have a lid and straw. Grease and food debris built up on cooking equipment pipes, wok faucets, a handsink faucet and walk-in shelving. Buckets are used for trash instead of proper receptacles.

headline: Ice machine build-up; leaking handsink
summary: Passed. White build-up inside the ice machine and in cold holding unit gaskets on the hot line must be cleaned. A rear handsink near the dish machine leaks and drains slowly. Water-damaged ceiling tiles in the hallway, restrooms and dish area must be replaced.

headline: Failed: no hot water at any sink
summary: Failed. No hot water was available at any sink; this priority violation was not cited. No backflow prevention device at the ice machine waterline. A small leak below the restroom handsink must be repaired.

headline: Hot and cold foods out of temperature range
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. Cooked rice, spinach pie and potatoes were held below 135F; about 30 pounds ($150) discarded. Tzatziki and sliced tomatoes were above 41F; about 5 pounds ($20) discarded. Expired food handler certificates and missing handwash signage also noted.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup plan
summary: Passed with conditions. No written employee health policy and no plan or supplies for vomiting and diarrhea events; both are priority violations. Raw wood shelves need sealing. Unused construction materials must be removed. Certified food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No certified manager on duty while food prepared
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. No certified manager was on duty while chicken wraps, hamburgers and fries were prepared. The person in charge lacked a valid certificate. Menu lacked raw-food disclosure asterisks; the employee corrected menus during inspection. Manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No certified manager on duty; no handsink soap
summary: Passed with conditions; citations issued. No certified food manager on duty while chicken and fish were prepared. Front handsink lacked soap; employee toilet lacked hand towels. A new employee lacks food handler certification. Grease, a leaking faucet and dirty floors and walls also noted.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; pallets and milk crates used
summary: Passed. Bulk food stored on shelves was not labeled with its contents name. Pallets and milk crates used to elevate items must be replaced with proper shelving to prevent pest hiding. Ice build-up in the basement freezer and dusty walls in the rear dish area.

headline: Food handler training required for all staff
summary: Passed. The inspector instructed that all food handlers must obtain the required food handler training.

headline: No certified manager; cold foods too warm
summary: Passed with conditions; citations issued. No certified food manager was on site on arrival. Cold foods held at 44-63F were discarded, about $700 worth. A walk-in cooler measured 45F; a technician was called to service it.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; unsafe food temperatures
summary: Failed; multiple citations. No certified manager was on site at the start; marked corrected when one arrived at the end. Dish machine tagged at 0 ppm sanitizer. Asada at 120.9F, pork at 102.9F, and pineapple at 53.8F. Handsinks blocked or missing soap.

headline: Expired dry goods discarded; cardboard on prep table
summary: Passed. Expired boxed lasagna and macaroni were on shelves; the person in charge removed them and voluntarily discarded about 40 pounds ($300). Cardboard was used on the bottom of a prep table and must be removed.

headline: Pass; cleaning needed on equipment and hood
summary: Passed. Inspector required cleaning inside a cold holding unit, light shields, shelving under the flat top and grill, walls behind cooking equipment, and dirty hood filters.

headline: Failed: live rat activity found on reinspection
summary: Failed; citation issued. Live rat activity found in basement rear storage and office on reinspection; a licensed pest control company must be contacted. Also build-up inside ice machine walls, a men's room door without self-closing device, and restroom ventilation not working.

headline: Dusty fan cover in walk-in cooler
summary: Passed. Dust build-up on a walk-in cooler fan cover was noted; the manager was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Cleaning needed; no allergen training certificate
summary: Passed. Clean the interior of prep coolers, the top of the dish machine, shelving above sinks, and a floor drain. No valid allergen training certificate was on the premises; certified managers must show proof.

headline: No soap at handsink; summary not posted
summary: Passed with conditions; citations issued. Rear prep handsink lacked soap; a food handler obtained soap during inspection. No valid sanitation certificate posted. Inspection summary not posted; manager received a copy. Leaking hot water dispenser and a spinning three-compartment faucet.

headline: Failed: no proof of special packaging procedures
summary: Failed; citation issued. The facility has an approved food safety plan (HACCP) but no proof on site of procedures for modified atmosphere packaging (MAP) of beef, pasta and sauces. These procedures must be kept on site for review.

headline: Clutter, dirt under equipment; signage missing
summary: Passed. Handwashing signage missing in the staff toilet room. Dirt in the drain under the three-compartment sink, items piled behind the stairs, and dirt and debris under kitchen equipment. Plastic film on a cooler and clutter on the upper landing must be addressed.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; cold foods too warm
summary: Passed with conditions; citations issued. High-temperature dish machine reached only 106.5F at final rinse; tagged and must not be used until reinspected. Chicken, beef patties and salmon measured 48.2-51.6F; 16 pounds ($160) discarded. Under-grill cooler at 50.1F was tagged.

headline: No certified manager on site during food prep
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. Food was prepared without an original City sanitation certificate or certified manager on site; a certified manager arrived at the end. Rusted walk-in storage racks, greasy floors under equipment, and a dusty walk-in fan need cleaning.

headline: Failed: shellfish tags undated; no sanitizer test kit
summary: Failed; citations issued. Shellfish tags from July-September 2024 lacked the date the last shellfish was sold or served. No quaternary ammonium test kit on premises. Missing hot water knob on a basement sink; bar sink leaks. Consumer advisory omitted that asterisked animal foods are served raw.

headline: Failed: portable, unplumbed sinks in use
summary: Failed. A portable, non-plumbed three-compartment sink and handwashing sink were in use. They must be hard-plumbed to an approved city water source or removed. Priority violation; no citation issued.

headline: Failed; missing hand towels and health policies
summary: Failed; citations issued. No signed employee health policies on site. Handsinks lacked hand drying supplies; the person in charge provided paper towels. No sanitizer test strips. A food employee lacked a hair restraint. Previous core violations were not corrected.

headline: Missing drain plugs; leaking handsink faucet
summary: Passed. The three-compartment sink has no drain plugs; the manager was instructed to provide them. The front prep handsink sprays from the side of the faucet when run. Floor around the bar and prep area has soil and debris buildup.

headline: Cutting boards stained; pastry boxes stored upright
summary: Passed. Single-use pastry boxes were stored facing up in the pastry area and must be inverted to prevent overhead contamination. Cutting boards in the rear prep area have open seams and dark stains and must be refinished or replaced.

headline: Failed: broken three-compartment sink; door gap
summary: Failed; citation issued. The three-compartment sink does not work properly; water pools on the floor when one compartment drains. A rear door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom that must be enclosed. Coolers with deli meats had excessive spills and residue.

headline: Sewage lines over food and single-use items
summary: Sewage lines in the basement were not shielded and hung over food and single-use items. The operator must shield the lines or move the stored items. A hole in the basement storage ceiling must be sealed.

headline: Missing shellstock dates; menu fixed on site
summary: Shellstock tags from late 2024 and early 2025 lacked the date the last product was sold or served; a citation was issued. The menu lacked a raw or undercooked item asterisk, which was added on site. Other issues included a missing handwashing sign and a leaking faucet.

headline: 100+ mouse and rat droppings; pest log missing
summary: Approximately 100 or more mouse and rat droppings were found on shelving, the front counter, floors, and in the basement. No pest control log book was available. Priority citation issued, and pest control service was recommended. Multi-use utensils were not inverted.

headline: Unlabeled containers; ice drip in freezer
summary: Food storage containers lacked common-name labels. Scoops were stored inside dry storage containers, and plates were not inverted. Ice buildup and water dripped onto the floor from the walk-in freezer condenser. Dust and a burned-out bulb were also noted.

headline: Reused shopping bags used for raw meat storage
summary: Inspector found the facility reusing single-use thank-you bags to store raw meat in the reach-in freezer. Management was told to stop and use food-grade bags or containers.

headline: Peeling paint and dust; cleaning needed
summary: Dirt and debris were on walls behind the dishwashing area. Peeling paint on the front and rear kitchen ceilings and walls must be repainted. Dust was found inside light shield covers, on floors under equipment, and on washroom ventilation vents.

headline: Flying insects in dishwashing; dumpster overflowing
summary: About 30 live small flying insects were on walls in the rear dishwashing area, and a priority citation was issued. The outside dumpster was overflowing and a food source for rodents and pests. Missing handwashing signage, improperly stored wiping cloths, and no hair restraints were also noted.

headline: Employees eating and drinking at prep area
summary: Employees were drinking and eating at prep areas, and the operator was told to set up a designated break area. A torn cooler gasket was found. Milk crates were used as shelving. Managers' allergen training certificates were expired.

headline: Coolers, cooking equipment, and walls need cleaning
summary: Reach-in cooler and freezer interiors and cooking equipment exteriors had food spills that needed to be detail cleaned. Floor corners and walls had food splatter that needed cleaning.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths and mop heads
summary: Soiled wiping cloths were stored on prep tables and must be kept in sanitizing solution. Residue was found inside the ice machine. Soiled mop heads must be hung to prevent insect breeding. A sanitation manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Rear door gap could let pests in
summary: Inspector found a gap of about 1/4 inch at the bottom of the rear storage east side exit door. The operator was told to make the door tight-fitting across the bottom to prevent pest entry.

headline: Ice scoop left on ice; no backflow device
summary: An ice scoop was found lying on top of ice inside the ice machine and must be stored in a clean, sanitized container. Food debris was found inside coolers and freezers. The utility sink had no backflow device, and one certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Cold food above safe temperature; 700 lb discarded
summary: Many cold foods in the display cooler were above 41F, including sliced turkey at 55.4F and chicken at 57.7F. The manager voluntarily discarded 700 lb of product (about $15,000). A prep cooler at 62.6F was tagged out. Citations issued.

headline: Blank employee health policy form on site
summary: A blank copy of the employee health policy was on site. The facility must keep verifiable signed copies for all food employees. The dish room sink was stocked with handwashing supplies, which must be removed because it is used for food prep or wastewater.

headline: Discarded oysters and food; multiple repairs
summary: Oysters without shellstock tags were discarded (about 60 oysters, $60). Ready-to-eat TCS foods were not dated and were discarded (about 10 pounds, $30). Other issues included a missing handwashing sign, a leaking three-compartment sink faucet, dirty cooking equipment, and inadequate lighting.

headline: No certified manager for 35 minutes during egg service
summary: No certified food manager was on site from 11:55 AM to 12:30 PM while eggs were prepared and served. Eggs at 52.1F were discarded (about $50). Handsinks were blocked, and cooked potatoes were not date marked. Citation issued.

headline: Food on floor; grease and debris buildup
summary: Food items were stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and freezer and must be elevated six inches. Cardboard was used as shelf liner under prep tables. Food debris and grease were found on cooking equipment, coolers, and freezers, and in corners and under equipment.

headline: No backflow device; wall openings and cleaning
summary: The utility sink had no backflow device and one must be installed. Openings around pipes leading up to the ceiling need sealing. Floors in corners and behind equipment need cleaning. All food handlers must obtain required training.

headline: No certified manager; several repairs needed
summary: The person in charge had no certified food manager certificate. No certified manager was on duty while TCS foods were prepared and served until 12:27 PM. Citation issued. Other issues included unlabeled squeeze bottles, pre-cooked chicken in a raw chicken box, and a cooler door not closing tightly.

headline: Front door gap; floors need cleaning
summary: The front exterior door had a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom and must be repaired to prevent pest entry. Floors in the rear storage areas, prep coolers, and walk-in cooler need cleaning of spills and debris.

headline: No certified manager present; citation issued
summary: No person in charge with City of Chicago certified manager training was on site. No food employee with that training was present while deli meat and cut vegetables were handled. Priority citation issued. Cardboard was under open ceiling tiles above the walk-in cooler.

headline: Cooking equipment and floors need cleaning
summary: The exterior of cooking equipment and the wheels on prep tables had buildup and must be cleaned. Floors throughout the facility needed a detail cleaning.

headline: Food on floor and no restroom lid
summary: Food was stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and rear storage area and must be raised six inches. The employee washroom had no covered receptacle. Debris and dirt were on floors and corners in the walk-in cooler and rear storage area.

headline: Pigeon droppings at kitchen threshold; multiple fixes
summary: Excessive pigeon droppings were found on the rear kitchen exit threshold. Other issues included unlabeled food, plastic grocery bags used as food containers, cardboard shelf liners, a soiled mop head on the floor, and no proof of food handler training.

headline: Employee drinking from open container in prep area
summary: A female employee was drinking from an open beverage container in the prep area; closed containers are allowed. Rust was found on a table shelf next to the three-compartment sink, and excess black caulking needed to be removed and maintained.

headline: Dim walk-in cooler lighting; more light required
summary: Inspector found inadequate lighting in the walk-in cooler, with a dark section of food storage shelves. The operator was instructed to add more lighting.

headline: Rear door gap; dusty prep ceiling
summary: The rear exterior door had a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom and must be repaired to prevent pest entry. A cutting board with deep dark seams must be repaired or replaced. The reach-in shelving and fan cover need cleaning, and the prep area ceiling and walls are dusty.

headline: Live roaches found; treatment required
summary: Inspector observed 2 live roaches on a wall at the dishwashing area. The operator must remove roach activity by the reinspection date and was advised to call a pest control operator. Greasy cooking equipment and a grimy walk-in cooler were also noted. Priority citation issued.

headline: No paper towels at handsinks; corrected on site
summary: Five handsinks had no paper towels; the manager supplied them on site. A low-temperature dish machine had no chlorine sanitizing at the final rinse and was tagged not to use until repaired. Menus lacked a raw or undercooked food advisory. Citation issued.

headline: Dish sink water below required temperature
summary: The three-compartment sink wash solution held only 95F to 102.9F; the required minimum is 110F. A priority citation was issued. Grab-and-go desserts lacked required labels. Clutter was found in dry storage, and lighting was poor in toilet rooms and dry storage.

headline: Signage, thermometers, and floor cleaning needed
summary: Hand-washing signage was needed at the handsink behind the front bar. Thermometers must be visible in all coolers. The walk-in cooler storage racks had dried food debris, and floors along walls and in corners needed cleaning. No allergen training certificate was available.

headline: No certified manager; no hot water; many violations
summary: No certified food manager with a valid original certificate was on site. The facility had no hot running water (sinks 47F to 50F), no cooling equipment on site, and no vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure. Priority violations were noted. No citation was issued.

headline: Open pipe and ceiling gaps need sealing
summary: Inspector found openings into pipes in the basement kitchen prep area. Openings into the ceiling and floor where the syrup machine is located must also be sealed to keep the facility in good repair.

headline: No certificate posted; pest log and test strips missing
