summary: No City of Chicago food sanitation certificate was posted. A certified food manager must be present while TCS foods are prepared or served. No pest control log book was available, and no sanitizer test strips were on the premises. Priority violations were cited.

headline: Insect control devices over food; cleaning needed
summary: Insect control devices were installed above drinks near the walk-in cooler door and above clean equipment in a side hallway. They must be moved away from food and equipment. Other issues included a rusted can opener, a dirty walk-in shelf floor, and grease buildup on ceiling tiles near the hood.

headline: Missing thermometer, hair restraints, and expired allergen training
summary: A cooler by the handsink had no thermometer, and a food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizer, and tongs were stored on an oven handle. Both certified managers' allergen certificates were expired.

headline: Missing splashguard; freezer interior damaged
summary: A splashguard was missing between the utility sink and the handsink. The interior panel of a chest freezer was in disrepair, exposing insulation. Both items must be repaired or provided.

headline: Ceiling leak and damaged floor tiles
summary: Water was leaking from the ceiling at the rear bar area and must be repaired. Missing and damaged floor tiles at the men's restroom entrance must be repaired. Peeling base in the basement dish area must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Rusty storage racks; allergen training missing
summary: Wire storage racks in the walk-in cooler had chipped paint and rust and must be repaired or replaced. The certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate and must complete training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Undated cooked food; manager obtained heat strips
summary: Several cooked food containers held over 24 hours, including meat sauce, had no discard date and must be labeled. The meat slicer was not cleaned behind the blade. The manager obtained heat strips for the dish machine by the end of the inspection. A basement ice maker backflow device could not be found.

headline: Loose ceiling tiles with holes; debris noted
summary: Food was stored in grocery bags in freezers and coolers and must be moved to food-grade containers. Loose, holed ceiling tiles above the serving area and entrance must be repaired to prevent pest entry. Debris was found behind cooking equipment.

headline: Ice machine residue; cardboard liners; no restroom lid
summary: A second floor ice machine had minimal pink residue and must be cleaned. A bowl was used as a scoop in raw chicken, and linens touched vegetables. Cardboard was used as a liner on cooking equipment shelving. The second floor women's restroom had no covered waste can.

headline: Missing thermometers and food handler certificates
summary: Some prep area and display coolers had no thermometers. The operator must provide working thermometers that are visible in all coolers. Some food handlers were missing food handler certificates.

headline: Ice chute interior not clean
summary: Inspector found the top interior of the ice machine's ice chute was not clean. The operator was instructed to remove ice, then clean and sanitize all surfaces.

headline: Ice scoop stored in ice bin; greasy fryers
summary: An ice scoop was stored inside the ice bin when not in use and must be kept in a clean container. Grease was found inside the fryers and must be cleaned.

headline: Chipping paint on wall by soup prep
summary: The inspector found the wall in poor repair near the hot soup preparation area, with chipping paint. The operator must repair it.

headline: Restroom lacks covered feminine hygiene waste can
summary: The unisex employee and customer restroom had no covered waste receptacle for feminine hygiene products. The operator was instructed to provide one.

headline: Missing test strips, thermometers, hair restraints
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. The 3-compartment sink had no sanitizer test strips, and the high-temperature dish machine lacked heat strips and an irreversible thermometer. Priority violation cited. Manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink; no handsink signs
summary: The three-compartment sink was leaking when draining, and a priority citation was issued. Flour and seasoning were stored in unlabeled containers. The handsink had no hand-washing sign. Cooler interiors, cooking equipment exteriors, and floors needed cleaning.

headline: Live flies, ants, and rodent droppings; citation
summary: About 125 small live flies were flying in prep areas, on surfaces, and over produce. About 12 small rodent droppings and 40 live ants were found near the locked storage room. Pest control service was required, and a priority citation was issued.

headline: Equipment upright; clutter in basement
summary: Equipment was stored upright and must be inverted to prevent cross-contamination. Plastic coating on the basement three-compartment sink must be removed. Clutter and unused equipment in the basement must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Cold storage gaskets and freezer damage; training expired
summary: Damaged gaskets were found on a refrigerator and a walk-in freezer door, and a basement chest freezer lid and interior were damaged. Pots were stored on floors. The restrooms lacked covered waste cans, and all food handler training certificates were expired.

headline: Leaks, thermometer, and cleaning needed
summary: A thermometer in the dairy and deli reach-in needed replacement. Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizer, and sinks in the deli and fruit area leaked. Large walk-in coolers, the garbage area, and back room floors needed cleaning. A cooling vent fan was leaking.

headline: Restroom trash can lacks lid
summary: The toilet room had no covered receptacle. The operator was instructed to provide a trash can lid.

headline: No employee health policy proof; menu disclosure needed
summary: The manager provided no proof of an employee health policy. The owner said cooked-to-order eggs are served, so the menu must disclose which foods can be ordered raw or undercooked, marked with an asterisk. No citation issued.

headline: Food debris inside handwash sink
summary: Food debris was found inside the handwash sink. The operator must clean the interior of the sink and maintain it.

headline: Cooked beans held too warm; food discarded
summary: Two containers of cooked pinto beans in the walk-in cooler were at 48.0F to 51.0F. The manager discarded about 5 pounds (about $120) of food. A burned-out bulb over the rear dry storage racks and a missing allergen certificate were also noted. Citation issued.

headline: Cooler gasket and dusty shelving
summary: The door gasket inside a one-door prep cooler next to the drive-thru window must be replaced. Dust on stainless steel prep shelves above the burger station must be cleaned.

headline: Dusty fans at front display cooler
summary: Inspector found dirty and dusty fans at the front display cooler. The operator was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Paper blocked license suspension sign; citation
summary: White paper was blocking the view of the license suspension sign. The sign had been taken down when the health department returned, but a video of the blocked sign was sent to the department. The operator was previously told not to conceal it. Priority citation issued.

headline: Food debris on floors; items stored on floor
summary: Food debris was found on floors in the rear storage, under fryers, and throughout the front prep area. Items stored on the basement floor needed to be elevated at least 6 inches. Some unused equipment and a cup dispenser needed cleaning.

headline: Foil liner on prep table to be removed
summary: Inspector found aluminum foil used as a liner on a rear prep table. The operator was told to remove it and keep nonfood-contact surfaces smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Unlabeled spices; cardboard and grease debris
summary: Spices and dry food bins lacked product name labels. Wiping cloths were stored on a cutting board, not in sanitizer. Cardboard was used as a shelf liner, and foods were stored in grocery bags in the walk-in freezer. Excess grease and food debris were found at the wok station and fryers.

headline: Rodent droppings throughout; priority citation
summary: Rodent droppings were found in many areas, about 140 total, including near fryers, cooking equipment, the hot water tank, storage racks, and freezers. A fly strip hung in the prep area. Frozen shrimp was thawing in the sink. A three-compartment sink faucet leaked heavily.

headline: Coving needs repair under sink
summary: The inspector found coving in need of repair under the three-compartment sink. The operator was instructed to repair it.

headline: No proof of food handler training
summary: Inspector found no proof of food handler training for food handlers on duty. The operator was instructed to provide proof.

headline: Dead water bugs found and removed on site
summary: Dead water bugs were found on the basement floor, in corners, and under storage shelves. The inspector noted they were removed on site. Other issues included dirty walls behind the dish machine, a detail cleaning of the ice machine, and two missing floor tiles.

headline: Previous core violations not corrected; citation
summary: Core violations from a 2/1/24 inspection were not corrected. These included a gap under the front entry door that could allow rodent entry, holes in drywall in the rear storage area, and items on the floor. Citation issued.

headline: Sewage backup from floor drain; citation issued
summary: Wastewater backed up from the floor drain onto the floor when the three-compartment sink drained. Management was told to repair it. A priority violation citation was issued.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; cleaning and training needed
summary: Prep area handsinks had no hand-washing signs. Food debris and spills were found on cooking equipment, shelves, coolers, and prep tables. A washroom lacked a covered waste can, and no valid allergen training was available.

headline: Handsink and signage issues; menu disclosure needed
summary: Handsinks in the bar area had no hand-washing signs. Menu lacked a disclosure for animal foods served cooked to order. Front entrance doors had an opening to be sealed. A handsink in the rear men's washroom was not working, and one kitchen handsink had low hot water pressure.

headline: Rodent droppings, traps, and bait; citations issued
summary: About 100 mouse droppings were found throughout, including on floors, shelves, and near food. Open bait packages and open sticky traps were in use, and a dead mouse was on a trap. Raw animal foods were offered for self-service. Pest control and citations required.

headline: Debris near water heater; no food handler card
summary: Debris was on the floor in the rear area near the hot water heater and must be cleaned. Dust was on a restroom vent. A food handler on site had no food handler certificate and must get training.

headline: No employee health policy; front door gaps
summary: No written employee health policy was on site. The menu did not disclose raw or undercooked items. The front door had gaps at top and bottom, and the rear screen door was missing mesh. Shelving used zip ties for repair. A cooled unit stored outdoors must be removed to prevent pest harboring.

headline: Grease and dust on cooking equipment
summary: Cooking equipment in the prep area needed detail cleaning to remove grease and dust buildup. The floor at the large bar and the ceiling area by the cookline also needed a detail cleaning.

headline: Frozen fish thawed in standing water; gasket
summary: Frozen fish was placed in standing cold water in the three-compartment sink and must be thawed under cold running water. A damaged and missing rubber gasket on a prep cooler in the main kitchen must be replaced.

headline: Soiled grease bin; grill wall panel peeling
summary: The outdoor grease waste receptacle was soiled with baked-on grease and must be cleaned to avoid attracting insects and rodents. A stainless steel wall panel behind the main grill line was peeling and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Sneeze guard too short for customer access
summary: The sneeze guard at the front service line was too short, and customers were reaching over it and talking over open food. The manager was instructed to add an adequate food shield to protect food from contamination.

headline: Blocked handsinks and unapproved vacuum packaging machine
summary: Both main kitchen handsinks were blocked with soiled pans and food bags. A vacuum packaging machine had no variance and was tagged not to be used. No vacuumed food was found, and no citation was issued. An ice scoop was on top of bar ice.

headline: Hole in floor under freezer; grease under fryers
summary: A foot-sized hole in the floor under a two-door freezer in the kitchen exposed the floor interior and pipes and must be repaired. Excessive grease and food debris were found under the fryers and must be cleaned.

headline: Spider webs and dead insects in dry storage
summary: Spider webs and dead insects were found in the rear utility sink and dry storage area and must be removed. Many containers in coolers lacked labels. Rusted racks, dirty cutting boards, and greasy cooking equipment were also noted.

headline: No certified manager on site; citation issued
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager or valid documentation was on site while TCS foods (chicken, cut tomatoes, eggs) were prepared and served. A priority citation was issued. A torn cooler door gasket was found, and the coffee area had no sink for liquid waste.

headline: Roach carcasses found; rusted racks
summary: Several roach carcasses were found throughout the kitchen and soft drink area, and the manager was instructed to remove them. Rusted racks in the milk cooler and dry storage must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Ice machine buildup dripping onto ice; citation issued
summary: Inspector found black and white buildup inside the rear ice machine dripping onto ice used for human consumption. Ice was to be removed, the machine cleaned and sanitized. Priority citation issued. Floors under equipment and in the locker room were also greasy or grimy.

headline: Prep handsink lacks hot water; citation issued
summary: The handsink in the prep area had no hot running water. The person in charge was instructed to restore hot water. A priority violation was cited.

headline: Blocked and unstocked handsinks; corrected on site
summary: A front bar handsink was blocked by a strainer, which the manager removed on site. Another handsink lacked soap and one lacked paper towels; both were supplied on site. Unprotected sewer lines were above basement food. The summary report was missing and was provided. Priority citation issued.

headline: Cardboard on walk-in cooler floor; bulb out
summary: Cardboard was on the floor of the walk-in cooler and must be removed so floors stay smooth and easy to clean. A burned-out light bulb in the walk-in cooler must be repaired.

headline: Unlabeled bulk pasta containers; milk crates used
summary: Bulk storage containers of pasta were not labeled with their contents. Milk crates were used as shelving in the prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor.

headline: No certificate posted; rodent droppings; citation
summary: No City of Chicago food manager certificate was posted. About 40 small rodent droppings were found near bulk containers in the rear prep area, and a priority citation was issued. Food debris, grime, and unlabeled dry containers were noted. Previous core violations were not corrected.

headline: Dusty walk-in cooler shelving and fan covers
summary: The shelving inside the walk-in cooling unit was dusty and needed a detail cleaning. The fan covers and the outside of the compressor also had dust buildup that needed cleaning.

headline: Leaking sink and stained ceiling tiles
summary: The three-compartment sink leaked from the middle basin and must be repaired. Ceiling tile panels in the rear dish area were stained and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Dusty fans and floors; filters need cleaning
summary: Fan covers in the walk-in cooler were very dusty. Floors in the prep and dish areas need cleaning and should be kept dry to avoid pest breeding places. Filters above the cooking equipment must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Dumpster missing lids; food handler without hair restraint
summary: A food handler in the prep area was not wearing a hair restraint. The outside dumpster was missing lids and needs to be maintained to prevent access to food sources. Grime in the walk-in cooler and reach-ins, and a leaking three-compartment sink faucet, were also noted.

headline: Cooked foods held too warm; discarded
summary: Cooked foods in the prep cooler and basement walk-in were held above 41F, including spinach at 45F and lamb at 61.7F. About 225 pounds (about $650) was discarded. A priority citation was issued. A high-temperature dish machine lacked heat strips until a technician supplied them.

headline: One employee with expired food handler training
summary: One employee had expired food handler training. The operator was instructed that all employees must complete food handler training and keep records on site.

headline: No certified manager during soup service; citation
summary: No certified food manager with an original certificate was present while soup at 160F was served. A priority citation was issued. No food handler training certificates were provided for current employees. Some dining area wall tiles and floor tiles near the front door needed replacement.

headline: Deli handsink drains too slowly
summary: The deli handwash sink pipe was draining slowly. The manager was told the sink must drain quickly.

headline: No certified manager on site; citation issued
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods, including chicken wings and pizza, were being prepared and served. The operator was instructed to keep a certified manager on site at all times. A priority violation citation was issued.

headline: Ice machine mold; no vomit cleanup procedure; citation
summary: Black and pink mold was found on the ice machine panel, dripping onto ice for human consumption. Citation issued. No written procedure for vomit and diarrhea events was on site. Thermometers were missing from several coolers, and the walk-in cooler had no door handle.

headline: Expired allergen training for certified manager
summary: A certified food manager had an expired allergen training certificate. The operator was instructed to provide allergen training certificates for all certified food managers.

headline: Hot pizzas below safe temperature; roaches seen
summary: Pizzas in front hot-holding unit measured 68.8–80.1°F; hot food must stay at 135°F or above. No temperature logs; about 12 lbs discarded. About six live small roaches found near rear food storage and exit door.

headline: No sanitation certificate; no metal thermometers
summary: Person in charge lacks city sanitation certificate; none posted. No metal stem thermometers on premises. Walls at small bar prep area not smooth; must be sealed. Required items must be provided.

headline: No food handler or allergen training proof
summary: No proof of food handler training for food handlers, and no allergen training for certified food employees. Records must be kept on site.

headline: Packaged cakes and ice cream unlabeled
summary: Packaged cakes and ice cream in customer-area refrigerator lack labels. Must label with business name, food name, ingredients, net quantity and any allergens.

headline: Screen door not rodent-proof; cooler handles missing
summary: Rear open with a screen door that is not rodent-proof; inspector told them to provide one to prevent pest entry. Two-door cooler storing coleslaw and sauces has missing door handles.

headline: Unused items in basement; ceiling gaps
summary: Unnecessary items and unused construction material in basement must be removed. Other items to be elevated and organized. Open gaps and holes in basement ceiling piping must be sealed.

headline: No handwash signs; leaking sink stoppers
summary: No handwashing signage at right all-gender washroom sink. Opening at base of front entrance double doors must be sealed. Three-compartment sink stoppers leaking; no prep sink in prep area.

headline: Grease and food debris in fryer and prep areas
summary: Grease inside fryer cabinet and on cooking equipment sides; food and grease splatter on prep and dish walls; food debris on floors. Dust on bar vent; fryer filters greasy.

headline: Incomplete spill kit; food stored on floor
summary: Incomplete bodily fluid spill kit and no cleanup procedure for vomiting or diarrhea events (priority violation, citation issued). Personal food removed from cooler. Beverages stored on floor; mop not drying properly; ceiling panels missing.

headline: Damaged faucet sensor; grease; litter outside
summary: Damaged automatic faucet sensor in restroom to repair. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, walls and floors. Litter around dumpsters; hood and fryer filters need cleaning.

headline: Missing splash guards and backflow devices
summary: Hand sink near rear exit lacked splash guard; service sink, coffee espresso unit and water dispenser lacked backflow prevention devices. Light fixtures above rear hand sink and ovens need protective shields.

headline: Beard restraints and light shield missing
summary: Food handlers lacked beard restraints; must wear effective ones. Missing cover for toilet room receptacle. Light shield missing in walk-in cooler.

headline: Cooler too warm; quiche discarded; flies
summary: Quiche and samosas in reach-in cooler held at 48–49°F; about 3 lbs discarded. Cooler at 60°F tagged and held for Chicago Department of Public Health inspection. Two large flies in front prep and dining area; pest control recommended.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; grease and dirt
summary: Handwashing sign missing at rear dishwashing sink. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, dirt in basement walk-in freezer, dust in vents. 2023 inspection summary not posted for customers; manager told to post it.

headline: No illness-reporting verification for employees
summary: No verification that each food employee was told to report illness that can spread through food (priority violation). Ice machine interior needs cleaning; broken cooler gasket; peeling paint and broken floor tiles to repair.

headline: Bins on cooler floor; stained cutting boards
summary: Food storage bins on walk-in cooler floor; must be raised at least 6 inches. Cutting boards with dark stains and deep cuts near three-compartment sink must be refinished or replaced.

headline: Slimy ice maker; about 40 live flying insects
summary: Black slimy substance in ice maker dripping into ice; manager told to shut off machine, remove ice and clean. About 40 live small flying insects in prep, dish and dry storage areas; more pest control needed.

headline: No employee health policy; blocked hand sinks
summary: No written employee health policy on site. Front bar and rear dish hand sinks blocked by utensils, cords and wires; restrooms lacked handwashing signs. No chemical sanitizers at three-compartment sink. Earlier violations not corrected.

headline: No allergen training proof for managers
summary: Previous core violation not corrected: no proof of allergen training or certificates for certified food managers. Must provide. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Rusty shelves; expired food handler training
summary: Rusty metal prep shelves to repaint or replace. Floors along walls and behind grease box need cleaning. Food handlers with expired training must provide current certificates; no approved allergen certificate found.

headline: Hand sink too cool; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Hand sink at front coffee bar reached only 53.2°F; required 100–120°F. Dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged. Manager's allergen training expired. Missing milk cooler thermometer; torn gasket; broken sink handles.

headline: Employees eating and drinking at prep area
summary: Employees drinking and preparing food in kitchen prep area; designated eating area required. Missing handwashing signage at hand sink. Torn cooler gasket, rusty shelves. Certified managers lack allergen training certification.

headline: Heavy grease spills in fryers
summary: Heavy grease spills inside and outside cooking fryers. Must clean and maintain.

headline: No sanitation certificate; vacuum packing unapproved
summary: No valid city sanitation certificate posted; certified manager must be present when TCS food is prepared and served (citation). Two vacuum packing machines used without approved HACCP plan (food safety plan). No temperature indicator for dish machine.

headline: Missing light shields; allergen training not fixed
summary: Light shields missing above cooking equipment; must provide and maintain. Earlier allergen training violation not corrected from a previous report; more citations will follow if not fixed.

headline: Leaking sink pipe; excess outdoor trash
summary: Leaking pipe under exposed prep-area hand sink; hot water handle missing at mop sink. Excess trash around outdoor receptacle; unused two-door refrigerator near it must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Toilet leak, overflowing dumpster, unlabeled food
summary: Water leaking around a toilet in all-gender washroom #1 (citation issued). Outdoor dumpster lids not closed, trash overflowing (citation). Beverages stored on floor; wet wiping cloths left on prep surfaces; containers unlabeled.

headline: Hair restraints, leak, greasy floors
summary: Some female food handlers lacked proper hair restraints. Minor leak under rear three-compartment sink; floors have food, grease and dirt. Missing Illinois Department of Public Health approval letter for food handler training; no allergen training proof for manager.

headline: Cold foods above safe temperature; discarded
summary: Chicken, shrimp, hamburger and marinara held at 47.3–52.8°F; about 20 lbs discarded by person in charge. Three-door cooler air at 44.6°F (citation issued). Handwashing signs missing; dry seasonings unlabeled; basement clutter.

headline: Door not self-closing; debris; dirty fan
summary: Washroom door not self-closing; repair required. Debris on floors along walls and corners in storage areas. Ventilation fan in washroom needs cleaning.

headline: No certified manager on site; cold food unsafe
summary: No certified manager on site during food prep. Cold-held chicken, potatoes and cauliflower reached up to 87.8°F; 15 lbs discarded. Hand sink lacked soap and paper towels, both added during inspection. Summary report not posted.

headline: Past-date cooked meats discarded; storage issues
summary: Cooked beef (asada) and pork (pastor) in walk-in cooler were past discard dates; about 20 lbs discarded (citation). Bouillon stored on furnace room floor and food on walk-in cooler floor; must be moved to shelving.

headline: Dusty fans blowing onto food
summary: Fans with dust buildup were blowing onto food; instructed to clean and maintain fans and ventilation. No proof of allergen training for certified food manager.

headline: Dirty coffee counter and stained urinal
summary: Counter and cabinet where coffee canisters are stored need cleaning. Toilet room urinal is stained. Inspector instructed cleaning, sanitizing and maintenance.

headline: Greasy walls and floors near fryers
summary: Grease buildup on walls and floors in prep area near fryers. Person in charge told to detail clean and maintain.

headline: Cluttered storage and office floors
summary: Storage room and office floors were cluttered. Inspector required all items be raised off the floor and kept that way.

headline: No certified manager on duty during food prep
summary: No certified food manager on duty while TCS food was prepared and served (citation issued). No food handler or allergen training shown. Splash guard needed at bar hand sink; chest freezer needs defrosting; grease and dirt buildup to clean.

headline: Cooked foods held too warm; discarded
summary: Cooked foods in walk-in cooler held above the 41°F limit, up to 57.2°F; manager discarded about 141 lbs. Also: gaps under front and patio doors, leaky dish sink faucet, cracked light shield.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food
summary: Employee touched ready-to-eat food with bare hands while making sandwiches; instructed not to, priority violation with citation. Torn cooler gasket; walls, ceilings and floor tiles need cleaning and repair.

headline: Unlabeled bulk sugar and salt; paper cup scoops
summary: Bulk sugar and salt containers unlabeled; must label and maintain. Disposable paper cups used as scoops for bulk sugar; proper scoops required.

headline: No valid certified manager during hamburger prep
summary: Person in charge has no valid city sanitation certificate. No valid certified manager on duty while hamburgers were prepared, handled and served (citation issued). A valid certified manager must be on site at all times.

headline: No hot water at staff hand sinks
summary: Staff washroom hand sinks had no hot water (71.6°F and 73.4°F); citation issued. Missing handwashing signs; employee drank from open cup; food stored on walk-in floor; leaking drainpipe under dish sink.

headline: Buildup in pop gun holder, drains and hood filters
summary: Pop gun holder, drains, and floors behind reach-in coolers need cleaning. Food spills on side of cooking equipment; hood filters have grease buildup. Instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Missing prep table handles; floors need cleaning
summary: Two cold prep table lids are missing handles; repair required. Floor under shelving along the wall and in rear storage corners needs detail cleaning.

headline: Raw eggs over cooked chicken; slow cooling
summary: Raw eggs stored on top of cooked chicken; manager moved them during inspection. Cooked beef cooled at room temperature with no cooling log. Cooked shrimp at 61°F and chicken at 93°F discarded. Food stored in cardboard boxes.

headline: Self-serve utensils left exposed to customers
summary: Customers can take utensils that are unwrapped, with food and lip-contact surfaces exposed. Single-use utensils must be dispensed so contamination is prevented, or pre-wrapped utensils must be provided.

headline: Debris around hot water tank
summary: Debris in rear utility room around hot water tank. Person in charge told to clean and maintain.

headline: Knife rack by hand sink; plumbing repairs
summary: Knife rack beside bakery hand sink needs splash guard or relocation. Basement utility sink is cracked and missing backflow cover; deli three-compartment sink hot faucet handle is in poor repair and won't shut off.

headline: Cooked meats held too long; food discarded
summary: Ready-to-eat chicken and beef in coolers lacked discard dates past 24 hours; 15 lbs discarded. Vacuum-sealed cured beef had no approved HACCP plan (food safety plan); 10 lbs discarded, machine tagged and must not be used.

headline: No employee health policy; grease trap overflowed
summary: No employee health policy on site; must obtain and keep it. Grease trap overflowed at front prep sink; operator fixed it during inspection. Cold holding unit needs cleaning; toilet room door not self-closing; floors need repair.

headline: Water backs up at sink; missing signage
summary: Water backs up between three-compartment sink basins; manager told to repair before reinspection (citation). Missing handwash signage at dish sink, unlabeled food containers, and small leak at sink drainpipe.

headline: No backflow device; leaks; no allergen training
summary: Rear utility sink lacks a backflow device; small leak under rear hand sink. Toilet room self-closing door not working. A manager has no allergen training; must obtain it and keep it on site.

headline: Calcium buildup in ice machine
summary: Slight calcium buildup inside ice machine. Must clean interior and maintain.

headline: Employees without hair restraints
summary: Employees prepared and served food without hair restraints in front prep area. Wiping cloths stored on prep tables; ice scoops stored inside ice machine. Missing basement floor tiles; ice machine lacks backflow device.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food containers
summary: Bulk food containers, including flour and sugar, lacked labels. Must label.

headline: Missing handwash signs; grocery bags in freezer
summary: Handwashing signs needed at bar hand sink and four washrooms. Grocery bags used for food storage in reach-in freezer; food-grade bags required. Floors along walls and corners in bar area need detail cleaning.

headline: Live roaches and flies in basement storage
summary: Two live roaches and three small flies found in basement storage. Facility must eliminate pests and clean; licensed pest control recommended on or after 5/19/2026. Also: no barriers protecting food from customers at barbacoa and carnitas stations.

headline: Mouse droppings throughout kitchen; cooler too warm
summary: About 50 mouse droppings found across the kitchen, plus about 15 small flies in dish area. Dead rodent in trap. Walk-in cooler air at 53.1°F, unit tagged; food at 45–46°F discarded. No proof of person-in-charge food safety training.

headline: No certified manager; flies; toilet overflow
summary: No certified food manager on duty while chicken, coleslaw, fries and fish were prepared (citation). About 50 or more live small flies in mop sink, walls, toilet rooms and front prep. Toilet water pooling on floor; no sanitizer test kit.

headline: Ice scoop left in ice; leaking sink faucet
summary: Ice scoop left lying inside ice bin; manager told to store it properly. Multiple leaks at three-compartment sink faucet. Floor drains, floors, walls and ceilings with food debris and grease need detail cleaning.

headline: Mobile truck lacks soap, sanitizer and thermometer
summary: Food truck: no hand soap at exposed hand sink, no dish soap, and no sanitizer for dishes. Reach-in cooler air at 55°F; must be kept below 41°F. No working metal probe thermometer provided.

headline: No sanitation manager on site; cool restroom water
summary: No valid city sanitation manager certificate on site while chicken was prepared and served (citation). Restroom handwashing water measured 71–73°F; manager adjusted valves and must provide at least 100°F. Mold-like caulking above sinks.

headline: Utensils stored in food; stained cutting boards
summary: Bowls stored inside dry beans and ladles left down inside food in grill drawer cooler; must be removed. Stained cutting boards; cardboard on walk-in shelving; items on prep area floor to be elevated.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate; poor housekeeping
summary: Person in charge has no valid city sanitation certificate; none on site while TCS food was prepared and served (citation). Lids open on garbage and grease containers; wall holes; no food handler training proof.

headline: About 20 dead roaches in basement
summary: About 20 dead roaches found throughout basement; told to remove them and keep the facility free of dead pests. Half of to-go soup containers lacked ingredient and trace-back labels. Unused ice machine to be removed.

headline: Greasy fryers; leaking hot water knob
summary: Worn gasket on front reach-in cooler. Fryer interiors had grease, food and dirt. Leak at base of hot water knob on three-compartment sink. Basement and first-floor corners and equipment areas need cleaning.

headline: Containers not stored inverted; dirty floors
summary: Food containers found not stored inverted; must be stored inverted. Floors by dishwashing area not clean.

headline: Chicken and chili thawed at room temperature
summary: Pre-packaged cooked chicken and chili thawing on prep table at room temperature; approved thawing methods required. Vent above utility sink and chemical storage heavily dusty; must be cleaned.

headline: Fly infestation and larvae in unused freezer
summary: Small fly infestation and larvae in unused basement chest freezer. Person in charge sealed and disposed of the freezer during inspection (citation). Also: leaking overhead pipe, water-damaged ceiling, manager's allergen training expired.

headline: Door gap, open ceiling, cutting boards grooved
summary: Front entry door has about a 1/4 inch gap at bottom; inspector required repair to prevent pests. Cutting boards with deep grooves to be replaced. Ceiling open in several areas and must be covered.

headline: Rusty, dirty walk-in cooler shelves
summary: Rusty and dirty shelves in walk-in cooler at kitchen prep. Inspector instructed cleaning, repainting with non-toxic food-grade paint, or replacement.

headline: Hot and cold foods out of temperature; discarded
summary: Six chicken wings at 92°F in hot-holding unit; hot food must be 135°F or above; about 8 lbs discarded. Raw chicken feet at 61.2°F and dumpling mix at 56.2–74°F; about 13 lbs discarded. Earlier violations not corrected.

headline: Dirty floors, clutter and washroom door handle
summary: Floors under and behind coolers and equipment need detail cleaning; windowsills need cleaning. Unnecessary items and clutter must be removed to help pest control. Washroom door handle needs replacing.

headline: Exposed rodent traps; cutting boards and grease
summary: Exposed snap rodent traps found by bar hand sink and sauce shelf; encased traps required. 1/4-inch gap at rear exit door must be sealed. Also: grease buildup, rusted cooler racks, cutting boards with open seams.

headline: Over 20 mouse droppings; dish machine too cool
summary: Over 20 mouse droppings on floors, plates, boxes and equipment in second-floor areas; several flying insects in bar. Manager told to call an exterminator (citation). Dish machine final rinse 154°F; must reach 180°F and is tagged.

headline: Dish machine and equipment need detail cleaning
summary: Dishwashing machine needs detail cleaning of calcium buildup. Meat slicer's reach-in cooler and sides of cooking equipment need detail cleaning.

headline: Water-damaged ceiling tile
summary: Ceiling tile in front of prep area has brown water damage. Person in charge instructed to replace or repair.

headline: No certified manager during ice cream service
summary: No certified food service sanitation manager on site, and no posted certificate, while ice cream was prepared and served (citation issued). A certified manager must be on site whenever the facility is open.

headline: Dirty reach-in coolers; missing light shield
summary: Interior of reach-in coolers in prep area needs detail cleaning. Missing light shield above rear cook line; instructed to provide and maintain.

headline: Cooked beans too warm; ice machine debris
summary: Cooked black beans in walk-in cooler measured 44.5–45.7°F, above the 41°F limit; about 10 lbs discarded. Ice machine interior had debris. Earlier violations, including leaking drain pipe and open gaps, not corrected.

headline: No hand sink in dish area; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Dish area lacks a hand sink; one must be installed. Dish machine dispensing 0 ppm chlorine; tagged and not to be used until repaired. New menu lacks consumer advisory for raw or undercooked items. No current pest control report on site.

headline: No handwash signs; missing backflow devices
summary: No handwashing signage at bar hand sink. No backflow prevention device at ice machine water line. No dump or prep sink at bar area. Each item must be provided.

headline: Loose faucet; uncovered bin; unsealed entry door
summary: Faucet in first unisex toilet room is very loose. That room lacks a covered receptacle. Non-working prep station by oven to be repaired or removed. Opening at bottom of front entrance door not sealed; damaged wall by utility sink (citation).

headline: Ranch with milk left out at 70°F
summary: Homemade ranch with milk left on counter at 70°F; cold TCS foods must be held at 41°F or below. Manager discarded 1/4 gallon ($8). Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Mouse droppings found; failed re-inspection
summary: Over 30 mouse droppings found in rear prep and storage areas. Manager told to call an exterminator and clean. Also: overflowing dumpster attracting flies, milk crates used as shelving, stained ceiling tiles.

headline: About 20 rat droppings; no handler certificates
summary: About 20 rat droppings on basement floor by employee uniforms (citation issued). Management told to clean up and remove all droppings; more pest control needed. Also: unlabeled containers, dirty basement floors, no food handler certificates.

headline: Low hot water pressure at hand sink
summary: Hand sink had low hot running water pressure. Inspector required repair and ongoing maintenance.

headline: Personal food on prep table; dirty floors
summary: Food handlers' personal food on prep table near cookline; designated eating area required. Breakroom and storage floors not clean; front register lighting inadequate. No allergen training proof for certified managers.

headline: No sanitation certificate posted; door gap
summary: No valid city food sanitation certificate posted for food employees; certified manager must be on site with TCS food (citation issued). 1/4-inch gap under rear exit door; faucet leak; freezer ice buildup; no food handler training proof.

headline: No certified manager on site at inspection
summary: No certified person-in-charge or food employee on site at inspection; one arrived 45 minutes late with proof of enrollment (citation). Hand soap missing at sinks, supplied during inspection. Single-use articles stored on floor.

headline: Greasy, slippery prep floor; no covered waste bin
summary: Grime and grease on wood floor panels in prep area, extremely slippery; wood must be removed and rubber mats provided. Wiping cloths stored on sinks; men's employee washroom lacks covered waste bin and working ventilation.

headline: Refrigerator too warm; food discarded
summary: Kitchen refrigerator held beef at 55.3°F, eggs at 65.5°F, and fish at 57.4°F; manager discarded 40 lbs. Refrigerator measured 76.6°F and must not be used until the Chicago Department of Public Health reinspects. Gap under front door.

headline: Rodent droppings; no certificate posted
summary: No certified food manager certificate posted during food prep (citation). About 20 rodent droppings throughout, including dry storage shelves and boiler room floor (citation). Also a 1/2-inch gap under rear door.

headline: Knives misplaced; splashguard and liner issues
summary: Missing splashguard between ice bin and hand sink. Knives stored between cooler and prep table; must be stored properly. Plastic lining on warewashing unit exterior to be removed. Certified manager's allergen training expired.

headline: Ice machine mineral buildup; fish on floor
summary: Mineral buildup inside rear ice machine. Boxes of fish stored on walk-in freezer floor; food must be at least 6 inches off the floor. Grease spills by fryer on main prep line.

headline: Over 50 rat droppings; flies; citation issued
summary: Over 50 rat droppings in garage storage area used for single-use items; about 30 small flies in facility. Pest control recommended on or after 5/16/2025. Also: entry door gaps, leaking coffee machine and sink faucets, no food handler training proof.

headline: Spoons in standing water; dirty ice maker
summary: Serving spoons kept in standing water container; instructed to store per code. Deli cups not air-dried after washing. Ice maker interior and scoop holder had orange film; instructed to clean.

headline: Menu lacks raw food warning; gaps and leaks
summary: Animal-derived foods that may be served undercooked lacked asterisks and menu disclosure. Also: opening at base of rear exit door to dumpster area, damaged cooler gasket, no backflow device on utility sink, peeling paint.

headline: Over 50 mouse droppings; live roach; blocked sink
summary: Over 50 mouse droppings along walls in prep, dish, dry storage and second floor; one live roach at front bar. Hand sink blocked by boxes; no soap or paper towels at dish sink. Employees prepared food without hair restraints.

headline: Food stored under sewer lines; plants above food
summary: Food container stored under sewer lines in basement; must enclose or move it. Pottery plants stored above food production area; must be removed.

headline: Dish machine fans in disrepair; allergen training missing
summary: Passed. Employee restrooms lacked a covered receptacle for feminine hygiene products. Exhaust fans above the high-temperature dish machine were in disrepair, causing steam and smoke. No proof of allergen training was on site for city food managers.

headline: No food handler training; items on floor
summary: Passed. An employee had no food handler training, and management must provide it for all food handlers. Single-service items were stored on the floor behind the front counter, and furnace room floor debris needed cleaning.

headline: Ice machine buildup; plates stored upright
summary: Passed. Pink mineral buildup was inside the basement ice machine and must be cleaned. Plates and utensils were stored facing up and must be inverted. A handwashing sink sensor in the second-floor women's restroom was not working.

headline: Dust and dirty floors in kitchen and bar
summary: Passed. Piping over the main kitchen service line had heavy dust. Cooling units in the front bar area needed detail cleaning. Floors under and around cooking and non-cooking equipment, the front bar, and the rear prep area needed detail cleaning.

headline: Cold foods held at 45-49°F; food discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Various cold foods were held at 45-49°F, above the required 41°F. The manager discarded 2 pounds of mixed greens and 1/2 pound of cooked vegetables. Counters and the griddle area needed cleaning.

headline: No hair restraints; no food handler certificates
summary: Passed. An employee in the prep area wore no hair restraint. Food handlers had no food handler certificates on site. Also noted: rusty cooler racks, holed floor tiles, and greasy ventilation filters.

headline: No written health policy; splashguard missing
summary: Passed. No written employee health policy was on site. A handwashing sink lacked a splashguard near prep, and cutting boards had open seams and stains. Many upkeep items were also flagged.

headline: No certified manager during chicken and beef service
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food service manager was on site while chicken and beef were being handled and served. Spoons were stored in standing water, and the ice maker's backflow device could not be found.

headline: Torn rear door sweep leaves gap
summary: Passed re-inspection. The rear alley exit door sweep was torn, leaving a gap larger than 1/4 inch on the right side. Management was told to repair and pest-proof the door. No pests were noted.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; no front handsink
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site. The front prep and service area had no exposed handwashing sink, so one must be installed. No employee health policy or probe thermometer was on site.

headline: Missing health policy; food stored under pipe
summary: Pass with conditions. No verifiable employee health policy was on site; a template was left, and no citation was issued. Plates and chafing dishes were stored under a waste pipe in the basement. The basement utility sink lacked a backflow device.

headline: Soap dispenser over sink; damaged freezer gasket
summary: Passed re-inspection. A hand soap dispenser was installed above the left drainboard of the three-compartment sink and must be relocated. A freezer had a damaged door gasket, and a non-working fryer in the rear prep area must be removed.

headline: Eyewash device blocked sink; removed on site
summary: Pass with conditions. An eye wash station was installed on a handwashing sink faucet, blocking access. The manager removed it during the inspection. One food handler had an expired food handler certificate.

headline: No handwashing sign at bar sink
summary: Passed. The exposed handwashing sink at the bar, across from the bowling alley, had no handwashing sign. Management was told to provide one.

headline: Customer washroom lacks covered trash
summary: Passed. The customer washroom had no covered trash receptacle, which must be provided. One food manager's allergen training certificate was expired and must be updated.

headline: Missing thermometer; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. The hot holding unit lacked a visible, accurate thermometer. Basement dry storage needed cleaning and clutter removal to reduce potential pest harborage. The certified food manager had no allergen training certificate.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; leaks; general cleaning
summary: Passed. Bulk storage containers on the shelf had no labels. Also noted: a leaking employee hand sink, dirty floors and surfaces, uncovered floor drains, unclean vents, and non-manager food handlers needing food handler training.

headline: Handsink valve off; ham at 50°F discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. A handwashing sink was inaccessible because its hot water valve was turned off during dishwashing. Cut ham held at 50.0°F was discarded (about 2.5 pounds). Ready-to-eat foods lacked date marks, and a citation was issued.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; scoops inside food bins
summary: Passed. Food storage containers lacked labels, and scoops were left inside bulk containers. Crates were used for food storage in the basement. Mold was at the mop sink, and the hood light was burned out.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. A City of Chicago sanitation manager had no allergen training. Management was told to provide it.

headline: Failed: repeat violations for labeling and upkeep
summary: Failed. Repeat violations from a 2023 report were not fixed: packaged cookies lacked labels, washrooms had no covered waste bins, and walls had openings, peeling paint, and loose baseboards. Citation issued.

headline: Wiping cloth placement and dim cooler lighting
summary: Passed. A wiping cloth was drying on the three-compartment sink faucet and was told to dry away from food equipment. The walk-in cooler was dim, and the inspector asked for more lights.

headline: Soiled aprons on food; no handsink signs
summary: Passed. Soiled aprons were stored on food items inside the walk-in cooler, and soiled wiping cloths were left on prep tables. Handwashing sinks lacked signs and waste receptacles. Also noted: grease, food debris, a leaking handsink drain, and damaged ceilings.

headline: Cook handled ready-to-eat foods with bare hands
summary: Pass with conditions. A cook touched diced tomatoes, shredded cheese, shredded lettuce, and cooked tortillas with bare hands while assembling taco plates. Staff were told to wear gloves; a citation was issued. An ice scoop was stored in the ice bin.

headline: No thermometer in salad bar cooler
summary: Passed. The salad bar cooler had no thermometer inside. Management must provide a working thermometer.

headline: Food storage and contamination concerns; no pests
summary: Inspector saw bowls and deli cups used in bulk food containers and cooked chicken stored in used food boxes. Wiping cloths were off sanitizing buckets, and cutting boards and container lids were worn or cracked. Upkeep items were also flagged.

headline: Rice in grocery bags; dirty rear kitchen floors
summary: Passed. Rice was stored in plastic grocery bags in the freezer, and staff were told to use food grade bags or containers. Loose debris, dirt, and dust had built up on rear kitchen floors and corners.

headline: Meat slicer dirty; employee clothing on dish rack
summary: Passed. Food debris was found behind the meat slicer blade. Employee clothing was hung on a clean dish rack and must be kept away.

headline: No manager certificate posted; dirty ice bin
summary: Pass with conditions. No City certified food manager certificate was posted, though eggs, steak, turkey, and chicken were served; a citation was issued. The ice machine bin had dirt, and basement waste pipes over food storage were not shielded.

headline: No hot water at any sink
summary: Pass with conditions. No sink on the premises had running hot water. Water measured 88.9-93.0°F. Management must provide at least 110°F at the three-compartment sink and 100°F at other sinks. A priority violation was noted.

headline: Dead roaches found by hot water tank
summary: Passed, but several dead roaches were found around the hot water tank and must be removed and cleaned. Grease and food debris were on cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, and freezers. The sanitation manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Greasy ventilation hood filters need cleaning
summary: Passed. Ventilation hood filters had accumulated food and grease buildup. The facility must clean the filters and keep them maintained.

headline: Coolers have food debris; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. Cold-holding equipment in the rear prep area had accumulated food debris inside. A basement storage ceiling bulb was out and must be replaced. One food manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: Wiping cloths stored improperly; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. Rust was on top of the grease trap. A certified manager was missing allergen training.

headline: Failed: flies found; no certified manager
summary: Failed. About 12 flies flew throughout the facility, and sticky traps above prep tables held about 15 dead flies. No certified food manager was on site. A rear handsink was filled with black water.

headline: Dish unit too cool; handsink water flow short
summary: Pass with conditions. The high-temperature dish unit reached only 140-143°F and was tagged and held; the three-compartment sink must be used until it is repaired. A restroom handwash faucet could not keep water flowing for 15 seconds. Ice machine and storage issues were also noted.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving
summary: Passed. Milk crates were used as shelving throughout the prep and storage areas. They must be replaced with shelving at least six inches off the floor.

headline: Missing health policy and clean-up kit
summary: Pass with conditions. No employee health policy or vomiting and diarrhea clean-up kit was on site; no citation was issued. Also noted: equipment debris, floor tiles needing regrout, dirty closet floors, and missing manager allergen certificates.

headline: Storage, leaking sink, dust, and lighting issues
summary: Passed re-inspection. Milk crates were used to raise boxes in the freezer, and a backflow device on a utility sink was leaking. Several cleaning, storage, and upkeep items were flagged, including dust, rust, non-working lights, and greasy hood filters.

headline: Greasy floor and peeling paint near fryers
summary: Passed. The floor by the deep fryers needed detail cleaning. Peeling paint under the hood vent was flagged, since it could contaminate food prepared nearby. Staff were told to repair and clean.

headline: Sprayer hangs below sink rim
summary: Passed. The sprayer at the three-compartment sink hung below the rim of the sink. Management was told to provide a holder to keep it above the water rim.

headline: Stained cutting board; greasy equipment and floors
summary: Passed re-inspection. A long cutting board at the Thai station was badly stained with deep grooves and must be replaced. Cooking equipment sides and floors across several areas needed detail cleaning.

headline: Kitchen door gap; kettle too large to wash
summary: Passed re-inspection. A large gap at the bottom of the outside kitchen door must be sealed. A kettle too large for the sink or dish machine needs a written clean-in-place procedure for washing, rinsing, and sanitizing.

headline: Unlabeled, uncovered food; allergen training gap
summary: Passed. Some food containers lacked labels, and food in freezer and prep cooler containers was uncovered. Food was stored in plastic grocery bags in the cooler. A drainpipe under the three-compartment sink leaked. A certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Allergen training certificates missing for managers
summary: Passed re-inspection. No proof of allergen training was on site for City of Chicago food managers. Management was told managers must complete allergen training and keep certificates on site.

headline: Sushi prep cooler at 46.5°F tagged out
summary: Pass with conditions. A two-door prep cooler in the sushi area held at 46.5°F, was tagged, and must not be used until repaired. Also noted: a rear door gap, items stored on floors, a slow hand sink, and one out-of-order light.

headline: No handwashing signs at sinks
summary: Passed. No handwashing signs were posted at the hand sinks. Management must provide them.

headline: Raw chicken in grocery bags; dead insects found
summary: Failed. Raw chicken was stored in grocery bags in a freezer, and food sat on the floor in rear storage. Dead insects and food debris were found on walls and floors. Employees lacked food handler training; no sanitizer test kit.

headline: Missing toilet tank cover; dirty walls and floors
summary: Passed. The toilet tank was missing its cover. Floor and wall bases in the prep and warewashing area had excessive debris. The wall around the utility mop sink was damaged. Staff were told to fix and clean.

headline: No hair restraints; ice scoop stored in machine
summary: Passed. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. An ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine. Grime was in the bar handwash sink, and a front prep sink pipe leaked. The food manager lacked an allergen certificate.

headline: Flying insects found; repeat pest violation
summary: Pass with conditions. About 25 live small flying insects were on walls and ceilings in food service and dishwashing areas. A prior pest violation was not corrected; a citation was issued. Food handlers need training certificates. Extra pest control is needed.

headline: Failed: live cockroaches; unapproved vacuum packing
summary: Failed. Three live cockroaches were on a wall above a rear prep handwashing sink; a citation was issued. Fish was vacuum-packed on site without an approved food-safety plan, so the machine was removed.

headline: Rear door gap; hard-to-read dish gauges
summary: Passed. A gap over 1/4 inch at the rear kitchen door could let pests in and must be repaired. Dish machine gauges were hard to read, linen bags sat on the floor, and washroom faucet handles were loose.

headline: Missing health policy and clean-up kit
summary: Pass with conditions. No vomiting and diarrhea clean-up kit was on site, though the policy was posted; no citation was issued. The three-compartment sink lacked stoppers. The certified food manager had no allergen training.

headline: Food handlers lack training proof; dirty fryer
summary: Passed. Food handlers had no proof of required training, and the certified food manager lacked a valid allergen certificate. An ice scoop was stored on top of the ice machine. The fryer interior was dirty, and floors under equipment and in the walk-in had food and debris.

headline: Packaged foods lack required labels
summary: Passed re-inspection. Packaged foods, including baklava, spices, honey, and olive oil, were not properly labeled. Labels must show identity, net weight, ingredients, and business name and address. Chipped walls near the one-compartment sink need repair.

headline: Failed: no hot water; ice machine slime
summary: Failed. The front prep handwashing sink had no hot water and measured 77.5°F. The manager got it to 100.1°F before the report was written. Pink, slimy buildup inside the ice machine was dripping onto ice. A minor sink leak was also noted.

headline: Failed: sink water backs up into other basins
summary: Failed. Water backed up into the first and third basins of the three-compartment sink when the second basin drained. A citation was issued, and repair was required before re-inspection. Broken floor tiles in walk-in coolers also need repair.

headline: No certified manager while food served
summary: Pass with conditions. No City certified food manager was on premises while burgers, salads, fish, and chicken were prepared and served; a citation was issued. Dish racks sat on the floor and must be raised six inches.

headline: Failed: flying insects found in prep areas
summary: Failed. Several flying insects were found in coffee prep and dishwashing areas; management must call an exterminator. A citation was issued. Repeat violations included a hand soap dispenser and pest control device above the three-compartment sink.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, live ants found
summary: Failed. No valid certified manager on site during milk and cream prep. About 20 live ants were found in a rear restroom area, and rear doors had a half-inch bottom gap. Also noted: food residue, floor debris, and a dusty vent.

headline: No certified manager while eggs and meats served
summary: Pass with conditions. No City certified food manager was on the premises while eggs, sausage, and ham were being prepared and served. A citation was issued. Wet wiping cloths were stored on prep tables.

headline: No certified manager on site while open
summary: Pass with conditions. No City certified food manager was on site while the store was open and operating; a citation was issued. Handwashing sinks lacked signage. A pipe under the three-compartment sink was leaking.

headline: Failed: cooler at 44.7°F; greasy wastewater spill
summary: Failed. A small two-door cold-holding unit measured 44.7°F; it was corrected on site and tagged. Wastewater flowed from the grease trap onto the floor when the three-compartment sink drained and must be repaired. No barrier protected food from customers.

headline: Plastic milk crates not allowed for elevation
summary: Passed. Plastic milk crates were not to be used to elevate items. Raised shelves at least six inches off the floor are required.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings, foods held too warm
summary: Failed. About 25 or more mouse droppings were in the fryer cabinet, mop sink closet, and near the grease trap. Cooked steak at 91.4°F and turkey at 46.8°F were discarded (about 9 pounds). No signed employee health policy.

headline: Wiping cloths on counters; leaks; cobwebs
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were left on counters and prep stations rather than in sanitizing solution. Also noted: debris on walk-in cooler shelves, a leaking three-compartment sink faucet base, dirty washroom fixtures, and cobwebs in ceiling corners.

headline: No valid manager on site; handlers uncertified
summary: Pass with conditions. No city sanitation manager or valid certificate was on site while chicken was prepared and served to the public. A citation was issued. Food handlers without certificates is a repeat violation from 2023.

headline: Raw wood shelves and clutter noted
summary: Passed. Raw wood shelves in the walk-in cooler must be removed, painted, or sealed to be smooth and easily cleaned. Unnecessary items were stored in the rear storage room and under a counter near the hand sink.

headline: No splash guards at front handsinks
summary: Passed. Handwashing sinks in the front prep area had no splash guards. Cardboard was used as shelving in basement storage and must be replaced with smooth, easily cleaned material.

headline: Food handler without hair restraint
summary: Passed. A food handler handling open food was not wearing a hair restraint. Management was told to require one.

headline: Personal food in cooler; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Passed. Employees' personal food was stored in the seafood and meat walk-in cooler and on a prep table; it was removed. Milk crates were used as shelving in the seafood freezer. Food handler certificates were expired.

headline: Unlabeled food; food stored on floors
summary: Passed. Food in all coolers lacked labels. Homemade fruit fly traps were found and must be removed. Food was stored on walk-in floors and left uncovered.

headline: Missing ice machine backflow; sink wall rough
summary: Passed. No backflow prevention device was found at the ice machine water line; one must be provided where it can be serviced. The wall behind the three-compartment sink needs repair, and the sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Torn gasket; unvented gas oven; allergen training
summary: Passed re-inspection. A gas baking oven was not connected or vented and must be installed under the kitchen hood. A torn cooler gasket and rusty wire racks were also flagged. Allergen training is required for employees with a City sanitation certificate.

headline: No valid certified manager on site
summary: Pass with conditions. The person in charge lacked a valid city sanitation manager certificate, and none was on site while beef was prepared and served. Citations were issued. Also noted: a front door gap, a cluttered rear area, and food handlers without training proof.

headline: Leaking cold-water handle at sink
summary: Passed. The cold water handle on the three-compartment sink leaked. Management was told to correct and maintain it.

headline: Soiled cloths on prep surfaces; no hair restraint
summary: Passed. A food handler wore no hair restraint. Soiled wiping cloths were stored on the bar top and prep tables. Dishes were stored upright and needed inverting. Floors were dirty around cooling units, and prep lighting was inadequate.

headline: Food debris in sinks; some handler certificates expired
summary: Passed. Food debris was on the inside and outside of the three- and one-compartment sinks and must be cleaned. The rear storage floor was cluttered around a water tank. Some food handler certificates had expired and must be updated.

headline: Handwashing and glove lapses; health policy missing
summary: Pass with conditions. A food handler swept the floor, touched hot holding units, then handled fryer baskets and flatbread without washing hands. Gloves were not changed after possible contamination. No signed employee health policy was on site. Citations issued.

headline: Spilled prepackaged food; floor clutter
summary: Passed. Spillage was present in prepackaged food in a reach-in cooler and must be cleaned. Debris and dust were under sales floor display shelves. Items on the floor in rear storage and the mop sink area must be elevated, removed, or organized.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings and foods held too warm
summary: Failed. About 70 rodent droppings were found on floors, shelves, and in storage areas. Foods at 62-70°F were found in one cooler, which was corrected on site; another cooler at 69°F was tagged and held. No certified manager was on site.

headline: Dish machines not sanitizing; curing agent without variance
summary: Pass with conditions. Kitchen and bar dish machines showed 0 ppm sanitizer at the final rinse. Curing agent sodium nitrite was used without a variance, and its use must stop. Spoons were kept in standing water at room temperature.

headline: Unlabeled vacuum-packed meats from unknown source
summary: Pass with conditions. Vacuum-packed, unlabeled fish, steak, and chicken were found, and the source could not be located. Management must ensure food comes from a verifiably approved source. A priority violation citation was issued.

headline: Leaking bar sink and non-flushing toilet
summary: Passed. A handwashing sink in the first-floor bar leaked from the bottom. A second-floor men's toilet did not flush. Management was told to repair the plumbing.

headline: Repeat gaps: food handler and allergen training
summary: Pass with conditions. Repeat violations were not corrected: some food employees lacked food handler training, and no certified manager had allergen training. Chemical buckets were used for food storage, and food buckets sat on the floor. Citation issued.

headline: Failed: no pest control log; training gaps
summary: Failed. No pest control log book was on the premises; management must keep one with at least two pest service reports per year. A citation was issued. A food handler lacked training, and the certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Failed: live roaches and moldy ice machine
summary: Failed. Two live roaches were seen, one crawling across a prep table. Two dead roaches were also found. A black, moldlike substance was inside the ice machine, and the ice must be discarded. A citation was issued.

headline: Freezer ice buildup, foil wrapping, ice machine scale
summary: Passed. Heavy ice had built up inside freezers and needed defrosting. Aluminum foil wrapped around a cart and griddle area had to be removed. Calcium buildup was inside the ice machine and needed cleaning.

headline: Frozen chicken thawed in standing water
summary: Passed. Frozen chicken was thawing in a bucket of water. Staff were told to thaw under running water at 70°F or below, or in refrigeration at 41°F or below. Cardboard boxes stored outside the rear door must be removed.

headline: Failed: slime-dripping ice machine, warm cold-held foods
summary: Failed. Black, brown, and pink slime dripped from the rear ice machine onto ice; the bin was emptied and cleaned. Display cooler foods measured 45.9-51.4°F, and about 50 pounds were discarded. No metal stem thermometer was on site.

headline: No backflow device at espresso machine
summary: Passed. No backflow prevention device was found at the espresso machine. Management must provide one where it can be located and serviced.

headline: Leaking pipe and standing water near ice machine
summary: Passed. A pipe under the coffee grinder station was leaking. Standing water and food debris were found on the right side of the ice machine. Management was told to repair and clean.

headline: Failed: prior sink leak not repaired
summary: Failed re-inspection. A previous priority violation was not corrected. Water was dripping from a pipe under the left wash compartment of the three-compartment sink when draining. Repair is required, and a citation was issued.

headline: Soiled can opener; items on floor
summary: Passed. A table-attached can opener was soiled. White cold holding containers were stored on the floor in rear dry storage and must be kept at least six inches up. Also noted: a peeling men's restroom floor and grimy dishwashing floor drains.

headline: Hair restraints missing; unlabeled flour bin
summary: Passed. Multiple food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. A flour ingredient bin was unlabeled. Single-service items were stored on the floor, and employee personal items were kept in the rear prep area. Grease and debris were behind cooking equipment.

headline: Plates used as scoops; knife stored in food
summary: Passed. Plates were being used as scoops in food containers in the walk-in cooler. A knife was stored with its handle in food at the grill line cooler. A sprayer nozzle leaked, and the outside grease receptacle was soiled.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, flies found
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on premises. About 20 small flies were found in several areas, including near garbage carts and rear prep. A front door opening needs sealing. Two sink supply issues were corrected on site.

headline: Failed: about 75 rodent droppings found
summary: Failed. About 75 small rodent droppings were found in many areas, including under front counter shelving, inside an electrical box, and under a utility sink. No certified food manager was on site while beef, pork, and rice were served.

headline: Food handler lacks training; expired manager certificate
summary: Passed. A food handler lacked a valid food handler training certificate. The certified food manager's allergen training had expired. Also noted: a prep table and prep-area walls needed cleaning.

headline: Cold food held too warm; cooler tagged
summary: Steak, pasta and shrimp held above 41°F in the front prep cooler; manager discarded 16 lbs ($300). Another prep cooler ran at 52°F and was tagged. Cold food must stay at 41°F or below.

headline: No handler certificates or health policy on site
summary: No employee health policy and no vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure were on premises. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, no food handler certificates were on premises, and an ice scoop was stored on top of the ice machine.

headline: Pass; ice scoop, dumpster debris, dusty vents
summary: Passed re-inspection. Ice scoop was laid on top of ice and must be stored handle up above the ice. Debris around the dumpster, soiled mop heads not properly stored, and dust build-up on prep area and washroom vents need attention.

headline: Fail: no certified manager; ice machine slime
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on site while kabobs were prepared, and the basement ice machine had black slime. A dishwasher had no food handler training, and a repeat allergen training violation was not corrected. Summary not posted.

headline: Pass; scoop and cooling issues, greasy floors
summary: Passed. Cooked rice was covered with lids while cooling and must be loosely covered or uncovered. Single-use plastic bowls were used as scoops in bulk dry containers and must be replaced. Also flaking ice machine chute edge, cluttered tools, and greasy floors.

headline: Fail: 60 live flying insects found
summary: Failed. About 60 live small flying insects were on walls, ceiling and boxes in the rear kitchen prep area; more pest control is needed. A blocked hand sink was cleared on site; soap and paper towels were missing.

headline: Pass; no food handler certificates on site
summary: Passed re-inspection, but no food handler certificates were on site. Wet wiping cloths were left on prep surfaces, and grease had built up on cooking equipment, walls, floors and shelving; both must be fixed.

headline: Fail: cooked rice and beef held without dates
summary: Failed. Cooked rice and cooked beef were held over 24 hours without discard dates. No pest control logbook was available, and a cooler gasket was torn. Unlabeled food containers, greasy surfaces, and improperly stored mop heads were also noted.

headline: Fail: live roaches and 20 rat droppings
summary: Failed. Four live cockroaches were found in food prep, rear storage and above a handwashing sink; 20 rat droppings were in a closet behind the front counter. More pest control service is needed. Wall gaps and a splashguard also required.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food observed
summary: Employees touched ready-to-eat food with bare hands: green onion placed on fried rice, and a thumb inside a to-go container. About 3 lbs ($25) discarded. Also: slow-draining hand sink, propped-open restroom door, dirty floors and hood.

headline: Mouse droppings found; freezer drips onto food
summary: Over 50 mouse droppings were on floors along walls in prep and dry storage areas. Pest control consult and cleaning ordered. Condensation dripped onto freezer food; manager voluntarily discarded 10 lbs ($40). Employee drinks were stored with customer food.

headline: Fail: dead roaches; no pest service records
summary: Failed. Dead roaches were on a glue board and floor in front prep and must be removed. No up-to-date pest service agreement or logbook was on site. Hot water was too cool at hand and three-compartment sinks; citation issued.

headline: Fail: no handwashing sink in rear prep
summary: Failed. The rear prep and dishwashing area had no handwashing sink. A sink connected to city plumbing with hot and cold water, soap and paper towels must be provided. A mop stored inside a bucket must be hung to dry.

headline: Pass; ice machine, freezer and hood need cleaning
summary: Passed. Ice machine interior sides need cleaning. The upright freezer must be defrosted and cleaned of ice and debris, and the prep cooler cleaned of spills. Floors, shelving under grills and the greasy hood also need cleaning.

headline: Reach-in cooler too warm; 50 lbs discarded
summary: Reach-in cooler ran at 50.3°F. Milk at 57.6°F, half-and-half at 54.7°F and hummus at 48.3°F were held too warm; about 50 lbs ($55) discarded. The cooler was tagged and a citation issued.

headline: Fail: no certified manager; freezers switched off
summary: Failed. No Chicago certified food manager (CFM) or certificate was on site while temperature-controlled foods were prepared. Freezers were off, so temperatures couldn't be checked. No pest control contract or log book was on hand.

headline: Pass; hand sink faucet sprays badly
summary: Passed. The hand sink faucet in front of the dish machine is in poor repair and sprays heavily when turned on. It must be fixed and maintained.

headline: Pass; torn rear-door strip, missing signage
summary: Passed. Torn rodent-proof strip at rear door must be repaired; handwashing signs are missing; a meat slicer worker lacked a hair restraint; excess cardboard outside must be removed.

headline: Fail: repeat violations for crates and ceiling tiles
summary: Failed. Milk crates are still used as shelving and water-stained ceiling tiles remain, both repeat violations from a 6/25/25 inspection not corrected. Also a grooved cutting board and damaged sales-floor tiles.

headline: Dish machine drain backing up; machine tagged
summary: Wastewater from the low-temperature dish machine backed up through a floor drain onto the dish area floor. The machine was tagged and must not be used until drainage is fixed and the city approves it. Floor drains also need cleaning.

headline: Pass; damaged boards, leaky sink, dirty areas
summary: Passed. Cutting boards at protein and salad stations have deep grooves and stains; a two-door cooler has broken, sharp handles; a hand sink leaks; floors, equipment and hood filters on the second floor and basement need cleaning.

headline: Pass; ice machine interior needs cleaning
summary: Passed. Slight buildup was found inside the upper portion of the large ice machine; the manager must clean it and keep it clean.

headline: Pass; no manager certificate; leaking pipe
summary: The person in charge has no City food manager certificate; citation issued. Leaking pipe under the first compartment must be repaired. Also cracked and missing floor tile by the fryer, dirty fryers, walls and floors, and unnecessary items to remove.

headline: Fail: pizzas and lettuce held unsafely
summary: Failed. Cooked pizzas at 77.0–86.2°F were on the counter and shredded lettuce at 48.6°F was in a cooler; both discarded. Pizzas must stay at 135°F or above. Repeat violation: no proof of food handler training. Missing health policies and food thermometer.

headline: Fail: low hot water, fixed on site
summary: Failed. The toilet room hand sink measured 72.3°F; hand sinks must reach at least 100°F. A service technician fixed it on site, and all sinks now run 102–105°F. Also: a toilet door not self-closing and no commercial dumpster contract.

headline: Cold meats held too warm; 30 lbs discarded
