summary: Chicken, ham, beef and pork held above 41°F, reaching 59.0°F; about 30 lbs ($200) discarded. A small cold holding unit at 51.1°F was tagged. Both corrected on site. Also a leaking stopper, dirty floors and walls.

headline: Fail: ice machine slime, prep coolers too warm
summary: Failed. Black dirt and pink slime built up inside the ice machine and dripped into ice. Several prep coolers ran at 47.5–54.5°F; they must hold 41°F or below. Also: missing ice-machine backflow device, uncovered washroom trash.

headline: Pass; food stored on floors, missing certificates
summary: Passed re-inspection. Beef, pork, jars of food and beverages were stored on floors and must be at least six inches up. Inspector could not verify food handler certificates and found no allergen training proof for food managers.

headline: Pass; walk-in cooler interiors need cleaning
summary: Passed. Interiors of the walk-in coolers need detail cleaning, which was instructed.

headline: Fail: about 15 live flying insects found
summary: Failed. About 15 live small flying insects were on walls and ceiling of the food prep area; more pest control is needed. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup supplies were on site. Citations were issued.

headline: Fail: no certified manager; fries held too warm
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site on arrival. Blanched fries held at 120°F in a cooler were discarded: 20 lbs ($10). Toilet-room hand sink reached only 75°F hot water. Ice machine interior had black buildup.

headline: Pass; leaking carbonation unit and sink faucet
summary: Passed. A carbonation unit leaks next to beverage syrup boxes, and the three-compartment sink faucet leaks. Both must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Pass; peeling ceiling and floor hole
summary: Passed re-inspection. Front doors were not rodent-proof; gaps must be enclosed to stop pests. Ceiling peeling and falling onto floor must be repaired; large floor hole by utility sink must be enclosed.

headline: Pass; small leak and dirty storage floors
summary: Passed. A small leak under the three-compartment sink must be repaired, and floors in second-floor storage areas must be cleaned.

headline: Pass; food stored outdoors, no handler proof
summary: Passed re-inspection, but beans, onions and to-go containers were stored on the outdoor patio on the ground. Plastic grocery bags were used as food containers in coolers, and no proof of food handler training was shown. Cleaning and repairs ordered.

headline: Fail: about 30 small flies found
summary: Failed. About 30 small flies were found in the rear food prep and dishwashing area, on the ceiling, a box atop the ice machine, walls and shelves. Instructed to eliminate flies, clean and sanitize affected areas; citation issued.

headline: Pass; handsink leak and wet mop
summary: Passed. A leak was found at the hand sink piping in the kitchen employee restroom and must be repaired. A wet mop was stored in a bucket and must be hung to dry.

headline: Pass; no employee health policy on site
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site; a template was left, and signed copies must be kept on site. A small gap at the rear door must be repaired, and greasy equipment and dirty floors need cleaning.

headline: Pass; unlicensed pest devices, dirty areas
summary: Passed. Fly traps and rodent bait stations were in place but not provided by a pest control company; a licensed technician must place bait stations. Also: dirty wiping cloths, worn cutting boards, dirty coolers, greasy floors and unfinished concrete.

headline: Fail: food on floors; no raw-food advisory
summary: Failed. Food containers were stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler, prep and storage areas and must be raised six inches. No consumer advisory on raw or undercooked foods, and the women's restroom lacked a covered trash receptacle.

headline: Pass; floor storage and cooler lighting issues
summary: Passed. A two-door cooler had food debris and residue, and a wall near a prep table is damaged. Items stored on the floor must be raised six inches, and the cooler's lighting is out with bulbs missing.

headline: No food thermometer; brooms stored near clean utensils
summary: No food temperature probe thermometer was on site, so the inspector ordered one obtained. Brooms and dust pans were stored next to the clean utensil rack and must be kept separate.

headline: No certified manager; greasy oven and hood
summary: No City of Chicago sanitation manager was on premises while pizza and chicken were handled. Conveyor oven had excessive grease, filters need cleaning, and grease on walls and ceilings is affecting hood ventilation. Citation issued.

headline: Pass; multiple cleaning and upkeep items noted
summary: Passed. Inspector found food, dirt and grease buildup on floors, storage racks, cooking equipment and hood filters, plus dirt on food-prep walls and water-stained ceiling tiles in the waiting area. Cleaning and repairs ordered.

headline: Fail: black slime dripping into ice
summary: Failed. Ice machine's upper reservoir and ice-contact parts had excessive black slime dripping into ice used for people to consume; citation issued. Also: a leaking three-compartment faucet, a broken cooler gasket, and unlabeled basement food containers.

headline: Pass; drain and ceiling vents need cleaning
summary: Passed. Inspector found the floor drain at the three-compartment sink needed cleaning and dust on ceiling vents in the dishwashing area and between the two washrooms. Cleaning was ordered.

headline: Cold food too warm; manager absent at start
summary: Cold items in the three-door cooler were too warm, including ham at 50.2°F and eggs at 55°F; 25 lbs ($100) was discarded. No certified manager was present at start; one arrived 35 minutes later. Also clutter, unlabeled containers and cutting boards.

headline: Pass; rear door gap and cooler gasket
summary: Passed. A quarter-inch gap under the rear exit door must be rodent-proofed. A ripped door gasket on a one-door cooler must be repaired, and food and dirt on walls around the mop sink must be cleaned.

headline: Pass; dirty floors and improperly stored mop
summary: Passed. Floors under and around cooking equipment had grease and dirt, and rear storage floors had dirt and debris. A mop was not stored properly and must hang to air dry.

headline: Hot water, soap and towels fixed on site
summary: Prep sink hot water read 66°F; a technician fixed it, now 102–110°F. Hand sink in prep and employee restroom lacked soap and bar prep area lacked paper towels; both supplied during inspection. Floors and corners have loose debris and dust.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged out of use
summary: Low-temperature dish machine was not sanitizing (chemical reading 0 ppm); it is tagged and must not be used until reinspected. An employee's food handler training had expired, and a handwashing sign was missing at the front prep sink.

headline: Pass; missing thermometer and burnt-out bulbs
summary: Passed. A visible thermometer is needed in the one-door prep cooler, and a torn gasket on a freezer must be repaired. Bulbs are burnt out in rear storage. Also dirt on cooking equipment, walls and floors.

headline: Fail: live cockroaches; grease trap leaking
summary: Failed. About 4 live cockroaches were in the front prep area and no licensed pest control operator was present. Exposed hand sink lacked soap and towels. Grease trap leaked wastewater onto the prep floor; a 3-compartment sink was clogged.

headline: No certified manager on site; food uncovered
summary: No certified food manager was on site while open and operating; citation issued. An electrical insect control device was stored beside bananas and must be moved. Toppings and an ice bin were uncovered, and the ice machine had rust.

headline: Fail: moldy ice machine, warm unit tagged
summary: Failed. Black mold-like substance was throughout the ice machine and on its ice shield; it must be cleaned and sanitized. An empty refrigerator at 52.7°F was tagged, held for inspection.

headline: Pass; food on floor, missing backflow device
summary: Passed. Boxes of food and single-use items were stored on floors and must be raised six inches. No backflow device was found on the rear ice machine, and the manager could not confirm its location. Cleaning also ordered.

headline: Fail: multiple dead insects; leaking sink
summary: Failed. Multiple dead insects were found near soda storage at the rear window; clean them up. A rear hand sink drain leaks. Repeat violations for a damaged wall and missing wall tile were not corrected; citation issued.

headline: No certified manager while milk served; citation
summary: The person in charge lacked a City food manager certificate. No certified manager was on premises while milk was being served; citation issued. Spilled food debris on walk-in freezer floors must be cleaned.

headline: Fail: 45+ live flies; no food handler training
summary: Failed. About 45 or more live small flies were on ceilings, walls and inside potted plants; this repeat pest violation was cited. No food handler or allergen training was shown, and workers lacked hair restraints. Pest service recommended.

headline: No certified manager; hot water restored on site
summary: No certified food manager was present while chicken, mashed potatoes and mac and cheese were prepared and served. Hand sinks and the three-compartment sink had too-cool hot water; a plumber restored it during the inspection. Also: dirty ice machine bin, greasy equipment, damaged ceiling tiles.

headline: Pass; certified manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: Passed re-inspection. The certified food manager did not have an allergen training certificate and must show proof of training.

headline: Pass; unlabeled bulk food, uncovered restroom trash
summary: Passed. Bulk food such as sugar and spices was not labeled and must be labeled. Restroom trash cans were uncovered and must have lids.

headline: Pass; ice machine, cutting board and clutter fixes
summary: Passed. Upper areas of the ice machine need cleaning, a large cutting board has deep blackened grooves and must be replaced, and a raw wood board on a wall needs sealing. Unused items in the basement must be removed.

headline: Pass; sink stoppers, clutter, and hood not working
summary: Passed re-inspection. Sink stoppers for the three-compartment sink cannot hold water and must be repaired. Clutter in the hot water tank area and office must be removed, and the ventilation hood does nothing when switched on and must be repaired.

headline: Fail: low hand-sink hot water, overflowing dumpsters
summary: Failed. Women's restroom hand sink hot water reached only 71°F; minimum is 100°F. Outside dumpsters overflowed and would not close. Also: ice machine calcium buildup and no allergen training for the certified manager.

headline: Pass; standing water and slimy drain
summary: Passed. Standing water behind the high-temperature dish machine and a slimy substance at the drain under the ice machine must be cleaned. The hand sink faucet leaks, a wall tile is damaged, and storage floors have debris.

headline: No valid certified manager during food service
summary: No valid City of Chicago sanitation manager certificate was on site while steak, rice and beans were served and prepared; citation issued. Also: peeling paint on basement stairs wall, grime under the three-compartment sink, and greasy hood filters.

headline: Re-inspection passed; splash and cleanliness fixes
summary: Passed re-inspection. Front handwashing sink needs a splash guard to protect nearby cups and lids, and the customer toilet room had debris on floors and toilet, which must be cleaned.

headline: Fail: ice machine lacks backflow device, repeat
summary: Failed. A backflow prevention device still is not provided for the ice machine water line, a repeat violation from a 9/20/24 inspection. Citation issued; the device must be provided where it can be located and serviced.

headline: Fail: live roaches and flies found
summary: Failed. About 8 live roaches crawled on shelving above a prep table; two large flies were in the dining area; a dead roach was in a cold unit. Pest control and cleaning ordered. Expired food handler certificates and leaks noted.

headline: Pass; unapproved insect devices, cleaning needed
summary: Passed re-inspection. Unapproved insect control devices hung from ceilings in dish and prep areas must be removed. Also a stained cutting board, spilled drinks behind the soda machine, and dirty floors.

headline: Fail: chicken cooled too slowly; no certified manager
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site during the initial inspection while temperature-controlled foods were prepared. Cooked chicken held at 44.9°F had cooled too slowly; it was quick-chilled on site. Open drinking cups at two handwashing stations were removed.

headline: Fail: no dish-machine temperature test, missing signs
summary: Failed. No temperature indicator or test strips were provided for the high-temperature dish machine, and handwashing signs were missing. Also a stripped hot-water faucet handle, mold-like buildup in coolers, an uncovered restroom trash can and dirty floors.

headline: Pass; raw meat stored on freezer floor
summary: Passed. Boxes and containers of raw meat were stored on the floor of the basement walk-in freezer and must be raised six inches. Cardboard and foil liners were used on shelves, a wet mop sat in a bucket, and basement bakery floors need debris removed.

headline: Pass; greasy fryers and uncovered washroom trash
summary: Passed. Deep fryers at the halal grill, flat-top grill and main cook line need cleaning. The women's employee washroom had no covered waste receptacle. Also a wall corner needs sealing and the floor under the dishroom conveyor needs cleaning.

headline: Pass; milk crates and dirty floors need fixing
summary: Passed re-inspection. Milk crates are used for elevation in the walk-in freezer and must be replaced with proper shelving, with food stored six inches from walls. Also dirty floors under cooking equipment, unused items in storage, and soiled mop heads.

headline: Pass; cooler door won't fully close
summary: Passed. A two-door reach-in cooler door does not fully close and must be repaired. Coolers, floors and rear storage need detail cleaning, and one certified food manager had an expired allergen training certificate.

headline: Pass; door gap and sink leak to fix
summary: Passed. Inspector saw a small gap under the rear outer door that must get a rodent-proof strip to block pests, and a minor leak below the three-compartment sink that must be repaired.

headline: Pass; sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. The sanitation manager has no allergen training, which must be provided.

headline: Pass; backflow device and restroom fixes needed
summary: Passed. No backflow prevention device was found on the juice and smoothie machine water line, so one must be provided. The restroom door is not self-closing and the restroom has no exhaust vent; both must be fixed.

headline: Pass; three expired food handler certificates
summary: Passed re-inspection. Three food handler certificates were expired and must be provided and maintained. Also stained, deeply cut cutting boards in the basement kitchen, and blackened, moldy wall caulking at the dishwashing area.

headline: Pass; handwashing signs missing
summary: Passed re-inspection. No handwashing signs were posted at hand sinks throughout; the manager was instructed to provide them.

headline: Fail: no certified manager; no vomit cleanup kit
summary: Failed. No valid city sanitation certificate was shown, and a certified manager must be present whenever temperature-controlled foods are handled. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup policy or kit. No chlorine test kit available. Mold-like substance found at the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Fail: no certified manager; no hot water at sink
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on premises while hot dogs, taquitos and pizza were handled. A hand sink was blocked by drain lines, removed on site. Coffee prep sink had no hot water (61.3°F). Two employees lacked food handler certificates.

headline: Fail: three-compartment sink floods
summary: Failed. The three-compartment sink drains poorly; when one compartment drains, the others flood, and the manager must service it. A certified food manager also had no food allergen certificate.

headline: Pass; missing hand-washing signs and backflow device
summary: Passed. No hand-washing signs were posted in employee restrooms. A backflow prevention device for the ice maker and coffee machine could not be located and must be exposed so it can be serviced.

headline: Pass; oil stored on floor, no allergen certificates
summary: Passed. Oil containers were stored on the basement floor and must be elevated at least six inches on raised shelving. No allergen training certificates were on site for City food managers.

headline: Pass; pest entry gaps to seal
summary: Passed re-inspection. Openings at the base of the dock door and a double entrance outer door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Also: a missing self-closing employee washroom door, ice buildup, dirty hoods, and missing light bulbs.

headline: Fail: no certified manager; dirty ice machine
summary: Failed. No valid certified food manager on site while chicken and donuts were prepared; only a photocopy was posted. Black dirt dripped from the ice machine into ice, all of which was discarded. Ceiling, floor and hood cleaning also ordered.

headline: Pass; plates stored face-up, must invert
summary: Passed. Inspector saw plates in the kitchen stored face up; they must be stored inverted to keep them clean.

headline: Pass; missing freezer door and no handler certificate
summary: Passed. An ice cream freezer in the butcher area is missing its sliding door, though it holds proper temperature. A butcher-area employee needs a food handler certificate. Washroom door lacks a self-closing device; fan dust was corrected on site.

headline: Fail: 15+ small flies; sanitizer at zero
summary: Failed. More than 15 small flies were throughout the facility, including main, rooftop and bar kitchens; citation issued. Quat (quaternary ammonium) sanitizer in the three-compartment sink measured 0 ppm; the manager added more. No temperature indicator for the dish machine.

headline: Pass; greasy hood and missing allergen certificate
summary: Passed re-inspection. Interior of a taco prep cooler, stove and pizza oven need cleaning; basement storage floors need cleaning; hood and filters have excessive grease. Certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: Pass; broken door sweep and missing signage
summary: Passed. A broken door sweep under the front entrance must be repaired, and handwashing signs must be posted in the rear area and washroom. Also: floor under crates in the walk-in cooler and broken washroom ventilation.

headline: Pass; cracked toilet seat to replace
summary: Passed re-inspection. A cracked toilet bowl cover in the far-left toilet room must be replaced.

headline: Pass; storage, repair and cleaning problems noted
summary: Passed. Clean utensils were stored above sinks, food under wastewater pipes, and a cooler handle was repaired with wood and plastic wrap. Repairs ordered include ceiling holes, an open electrical socket and pooled basement water.

headline: Fail: unsafe cold food, unsourced meat, sanitizer lapse
summary: Failed. Chicken (50.0°F) and pork (67.1–82.2°F) were held too warm; 45 lbs discarded. About 90 lbs of meat and squid lacked proof of source and was discarded. Dishwasher sanitizer read 0 ppm; repaired on site. No vomit cleanup kit.

headline: Pass; missing handwashing sign and splash guard
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign was at the front prep handsink, which must be provided. No splash guard sits between a sink and the deli slicer; one must be provided or the slicer relocated.

headline: Pass; beard guards and splash guards needed
summary: Passed re-inspection after suspected food poisoning complaint. Splash guards are needed at server station sinks; cooks with large beards must wear beard guards; torn cooler gasket must be replaced. Unused equipment on the patio must be removed.

headline: Fail: no hot water; no certified manager
summary: Failed. No hot running water throughout; hand sinks read 40.8–62.6°F (100°F minimum), and the three-compartment sink read 60.3°F (110°F minimum). Yogurts at 50–60°F were discarded. No certified manager was on site when eggs and potatoes were served.

headline: Failed: no handsink in front prep; no sneeze guard
summary: No exposed handwashing sink was in the front food prep area; the operator must install one. No sneeze guard was at the front counter to protect food from customers. The certified manager lacked allergen training, and a slow leak was under the three-compartment sink.

headline: Residue in ice machine; no hot-holding thermometer
summary: Residue was found on the inside of the ice machine and must be cleaned. The taqueria's hot holding unit had no thermometer. Bulk containers lacked labels, and there was no splash guard between the hand sink and tamale prep table. Other items include a drain line improperly connected to a sink.

headline: Failed: about 3 live roaches in storage
summary: About 3 live roaches were found inside a box in the rear refrigeration and ice machine storage area; a citation was issued. Two sink stoppers were missing from the three-compartment sink. Garbage can lids were missing in the restrooms.

headline: Construction debris stored in rear of facility
summary: Construction debris, trash, and unused equipment were stored in the rear, which could attract pests. The operator must remove them. Ambient air thermometers are also needed inside the three-door reach-in coolers.

headline: Failed: cold food unsafe; many live flies
summary: Cooked and ready-to-eat foods held at 45 to 56 F were discarded, about 30.5 lbs. A prep cooler at 55.8 F was tagged; a new cooler now holds at 38 F. About 25 or more live small flies were found throughout prep, bar, and dish areas; a citation was issued.

headline: Leaking handwash sink drain
summary: The drainpipe and plumbers' putty around the handwash sink in the rear prep and dish area were leaking. The manager must repair and maintain them.

headline: Dirty floors and walls in prep area
summary: Accumulated dirt was found on floors and along walls in the prep area. The person in charge was told to clean and maintain them.

headline: Food debris behind sink; some staff untrained
summary: Food debris had built up on the wall behind the three-compartment sink and must be cleaned. Some food handlers did not have food handler training certificates. The manager was instructed that all food handlers must be certified.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; no allergen training
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at exposed sinks in bars and restrooms. A second-floor sink's sensor was broken, and covered trash cans were needed. Old equipment was in the basement. No allergen training certificates were on site.

headline: Missing handwashing signs
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at the handwashing sinks in the restroom and behind the hot foods section. The operator must provide them.

headline: Floor grout low; some ceiling lights out
summary: Floor tiles in the dish and prep areas were in poor repair with low grout and must be regrouted. Some ceiling light bulbs in the dish and prep areas were not working and must be replaced.

headline: Missing thermometers; no food handler certificates
summary: Thermometers could not be found inside cooling units and needed to be provided. Foil was used as shelf liner in rear prep and food debris was on front prep floors. Food handler certificates were not on site and must be kept there for review.

headline: Failed: no handwash sink; no employee health policy
summary: No signed employee health policies were on the premises. No handwashing sink was in the rear prep and dish area, and a citation was issued. Cracked ice cream freezer lids and a gap under a cooler door needed repair. Unisex toilet rooms lacked lidded garbage cans.

headline: Paper towel supplied; food in grocery bags
summary: No paper towels were in the washroom at the hand sink; the manager supplied them during the inspection and a citation was issued. Food was stored in grocery bags in the freezer. Rust and grease were at the grease trap, and some ceiling tiles were broken or stained.

headline: Food handler certificates missing for all staff
summary: Food handler certificates were missing for all employees working in the facility during the inspection. The manager was instructed to provide and maintain them.

headline: Missing thermometers; leaking faucets
summary: Prep coolers at the sauté and pantry lines were missing thermometers. Cutting boards had chipped surfaces, and caulking at the 3-compartment sink had black buildup. The 3-compartment sink faucet and warewashing sprayer leaked.

headline: Failed: 3 live roaches; food too warm
summary: Sliced tomatoes at 48 F and cooked vegetables at 52 F were discarded; a citation was issued. Three live roaches were found in the dish area; a citation was consolidated. The bar's three-compartment sink flooded when one compartment drained; a technician serviced it during the inspection.

headline: Missing thermometers and labels; door not self-closing
summary: The rear refrigerator and front mini refrigerator had no ambient air thermometers. Squirt bottles were unlabeled. The employee washroom door was not self-closing and lacked a lidded receptacle. Floors under the sink and bulk storage had debris.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea response procedures on site
summary: No written procedure or necessary items for responding to vomit and diarrhea events were available. Equipment was covered in construction dust and must be cleaned before use. No allergen training certificate was on site for the certificate holder.

headline: Plumbing leaks and standing water in basement
summary: Multiple plumbing issues were found: a leaking pipe under the front three-compartment sink, a leaking faucet base, and a broken drain pipe from the furnace. Basement floors had standing water and debris and need detail cleaning. Must bring plumbing up to code.

headline: No certified manager during hamburger and hot dog service
summary: No City-certified food manager was present while hamburgers and hot dogs were being prepared and served; a citation was issued. Floors needed cleaning around the self-serve soda machine and under the three-compartment sink.

headline: Hygiene lapses, unsafe cold holding, ice machine slime
summary: Suspected food poisoning case: a dish room employee handled dirty dishes without washing hands; the manager corrected this. Ice machine had black slimy buildup dripping into ice. Foods at 47.8 to 50.2 F were discarded, about 12 lbs. A dish machine at 0 ppm was tagged.

headline: Failed: unsafe reheating, cooling, and labeling
summary: Chili at 90.6 F and soup at 126.3 F were improperly reheated in a steam table and removed. About 80 lbs of cooked chicken wings cooled too slowly at 46.8 to 53.6 F and had no date labels; a citation was issued. Warewashing machine had no temperature indicator and was tagged.

headline: No certified manager; no pest service records
summary: No City-certified food manager was present while hot dogs were prepared and served; a citation was issued. The pest control log had no inspection reports from the past year, and a citation was issued. Broken floor tiles and a condiment cooler's interior need repair and cleaning.

headline: Cardboard liners and ice buildup; training missing
summary: Cardboard and paper liners were in walk-in and storage racks and must be removed. Three chest freezers had heavy ice buildup. Food handlers lacked food handler certificates and must show proof of training.

headline: Bar dish machine not sanitizing; floor debris
summary: The bar dish machine, not in use, had a final sanitizing rinse of 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged 'held for inspection.' The manager was told to repair it. Floor under it had litter and broken glass.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; damaged floors
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at the butcher prep sink. Milk crates were used as shelving and must be removed. Damaged floor tiles, dusty vents, debris, and standing water in a rear storage trough were noted; unused items must be removed.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; flies and unsafe temps
summary: No certified manager certificate was posted while TCS foods were prepared; a citation was issued. Hot sausage and eggs at 119 to 125 F, and liquid eggs at 55.4 F, were discarded. About 25 or more live small flies and 4 to 6 large flies were found; a citation was issued.

headline: Gap under rear door to alley
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the rear door to the alley must be fixed to keep it tight-fitting. A previous violation was not corrected: the certified food manager on duty had no allergen training. A citation was issued.

headline: Failed: slimy ice machine; food not date marked
summary: Black and pink slime was found inside the ice machine and dripping onto ice for consumption. Ready-to-eat TCS foods in the walk-in and refrigerator were not date marked. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables, and two bulbs were burnt out.

headline: Failed: prior violation not fixed; no test strips
summary: A prior priority foundation violation from a 2023 report was not corrected; a citation was issued. The low-temperature dish machine had no chemical test strips to check chlorine sanitizer levels. Management was told to provide test strips.

headline: Failed: incomplete vomit spill kit; no rear handsink
summary: The spill kit was incomplete and lacked gloves, masks, and norovirus-effective sanitizer; a citation was issued. No handwashing sink was in the rear food prep area, and a citation was issued. Other items include a leaking drainpipe, a missing splashguard, and a hole in the wall.

headline: Grease under fryers; no allergen training
summary: Minor grease spills were on the kitchen floor under the fryers and must be cleaned. No allergen training certificates were on site for certified food managers.

headline: Dirty floors, poor coving, and items on floor
summary: Rear floors had dirt and debris and needed cleaning. Coving in the toilet room was in poor repair. Items stored on the floor in the rear must be raised and organized.

headline: Rear door gap; ice buildup and dirty floors
summary: A 1/2-inch gap under the rear door meant it was not rodent or insect proof and must be fixed. No handwashing sign was at the men's restroom sink. Reach-in cooler and freezer had ice buildup, and floors under the hot water tank had dirt and debris.

headline: Failed: food debris, hole in wall, unfixed prior issue
summary: Plastic tape on the sandwich oven was not easily cleanable. Floors under the three-compartment sink, the walk-in cooler, and near soda boxes had food debris. A hole in the wall under the sink needs repair. A prior splashguard violation was not corrected; a citation was issued.

headline: Dirty cutting boards and missing ceiling tiles
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on the counter, and cutting boards had deep scratches and stains. Ceiling tiles were missing above the walk-in cooler, and grease was on hood filters. Some food employees lacked training, and the certified food manager's allergen training had expired.

headline: Tagged cooler; no health policy; washroom fans off
summary: A two-door prep cooler was tagged 'held for inspection' until repaired. Air temperature was 47 F, and no food was in it. No written employee health policy was on the premises. Other items include leaks, a missing handwashing sign, and washroom ventilation that is not working.

headline: Dead insects found in storage room
summary: Dead insects were seen on the floor of the rear storage room next to the mop sink; the operator was told to clean and remove them. Hand sink handles were loose. No food handler certificates were on the premises.

headline: Minor ice machine and soda gun buildup
summary: Minor buildup was found inside the prep area ice machine, and mineral buildup was in the bar soda gun. The ice scoop was stored in the ice and must be kept in a clean container. A minor leak at the 3-compartment sink faucet must be repaired.

headline: Washroom fan not working
summary: The ventilation fan in the washroom was not operational. Management was instructed to repair or replace it.

headline: Failed: cold rice and sushi left out too warm
summary: Cooked rice at 70 to 75 F and sushi at 71 F were left on counters, with no time or temperature log, and were discarded. Other violations included no consumer advisory, no stem thermometer, a missing food handler certificate, and a leaking condenser and cooler gaskets.

headline: Oversized containers need alternative washing method
summary: Some food containers were too large to fit in the 3-compartment sink, and the operator must provide an alternative washing and sanitizing method. A sanitation manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Candy stored on floor; food handler untrained
summary: Boxes of candy were stored on the floor of the rear prep area; management was told to keep food at least 6 inches off the floor. A food handler did not have a food handler training certificate; management was told to provide proof.

headline: Truck license number and window screens needed
summary: The food truck needs its license number on both sides, at least 2 inches tall. Screens are needed for service windows when they are not in use.

headline: Hair restraints missing; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Several food handlers were seen preparing food without hair restraints; management was told to require them. The certified food manager had no allergen training certificate on site.

headline: Failed: pest harborage risk and many cleaning issues
summary: No handwashing sign at the restroom sink, and wiping cloths were stored on prep tables. Clutter on cooler tops was noted as a potential pest harborage, but no pests were seen. Grease, dirt, and debris were found in several areas. Previous violations were not corrected; a citation was issued.

headline: Hair restraint missing; untrained food handler
summary: A food handler was working without an effective hair restraint, and one had no food handler training certificate. The prep area's heavy equipment had food debris, and walk-in freezer and cooler floors had debris. Restroom fixtures needed cleaning.

headline: Failed: leaking handsink; no allergen training
summary: The dish area handsink leaked heavily and was not accessible; a citation was issued. Soiled mop heads were not stored properly and must be hung. No allergen training was on site for certified food managers.

headline: Failed: handwashing lapse; hot water too cold
summary: A cashier handled a sandwich without washing hands after touching her apron; a citation was issued. Hot water at the restroom hand sinks was 51 to 54 F, below the required 100 F. Hand-washing signs were missing, and several cleaning and repair items were noted.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; many live flies
summary: No certified food manager was on duty or certificate posted while TCS foods were handled; a citation was issued. About 34 lbs of raw seafood and chicken held above 41 F were discarded. About 30 or more live small flies were found on walls, shelves, and in prep and dish areas; a citation was issued.

headline: No allergen training proof for food managers
summary: No proof of allergen training was provided for all certified food managers. The operator must provide and maintain documentation on site.

headline: Food stored on walk-in cooler floor
summary: Food items were stored on the floor of the walk-in cooler. The manager was told to raise all food six inches off the floor. The inspection passed.

headline: Failed: roaches, rodent droppings, and unsafe dishwashing
summary: 5 to 6 live roaches and about 20 to 30 rat and mouse droppings were found in the rear prep and dish area. The dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm and was tagged. About 300 lbs of food held above 41 F was discarded, along with unsafe ice. The unit cannot be used until repaired.

headline: Failed: 50 to 75 flies throughout facility
summary: About 50 to 75 small flies were seen in all areas, including the prep areas, bread storage hall, and employee restroom. A citation was issued and pest treatment was recommended. Other issues include unlabeled oil, wiping cloths not in sanitizer, and a missing dump sink, a prior violation not corrected.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food service
summary: No certified food sanitation manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared and served; a citation was issued. A prior violation, a new hire without a food handler certificate, was not corrected. Ceiling damage and missing allergen training were also noted.

headline: Gap under rear door; several repairs needed
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the rear exit door needed to be sealed to prevent pest entry. Torn gaskets were in the prep cooler, rust was on walk-in shelving, and the front hand sink faucet leaked.

headline: Ice machine and cutting boards need attention
summary: The ice machine interior needed cleaning to remove buildup. Cutting boards were worn and must be replaced. Cooking equipment sides, floors, and filters needed cleaning, and a toilet room waste receptacle needed a cover.

headline: Failed: raw onions chopped by hands; dish machine 0 ppm
summary: A food handler chopped raw onions for ready-to-eat guacamole without proper hand washing or gloves; the onions were discarded and a citation was issued. The front bar dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer and was tagged. Other items include grease at the waste area and an ice machine chute needing cleaning.

headline: Dirty equipment and floors; food handler without certificate
summary: Equipment and floors needed cleaning, including the meat slicer, grill, fryer, and floor under cooking equipment. The employee washroom lacked a covered waste receptacle. One food handler was preparing food without a food handler certificate.

headline: Debris and spills on equipment; no allergen training
summary: Debris and spills were found on cooking equipment, prep tables, shelves, coolers, and freezers. The washroom lacked a covered trash can and fan. The manager on duty had no allergen training.

headline: Utensils stored in food; no washroom receptacle
summary: Utensils were stored in food containers in the prep area and prep coolers and must be stored properly between uses. The employee washroom lacked a covered trash can. Mop heads were not drying upright and must be stored correctly to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Leaking faucet; dirty shelves and floors
summary: Eye wash equipment was attached to handwashing sinks and must be moved to a separate sink. A leaking faucet at the deli three-compartment sink needed repair. Rusty shelves in the deli walk-in cooler and dirty floors and vents were noted.

headline: Failed: no rear handsink; no stem thermometer
summary: A handsink was needed in the rear prep and dishwashing area; a citation was not issued. No stem thermometer was on site. Food protection was needed at the rear prep table to keep food separate from customers.

headline: Loose debris and dust on floors
summary: Loose debris, dirt, and dust were found on floors and corners throughout the facility. The operator was instructed to clean in detail and increase cleaning frequency.

headline: Single-service items on floor; grease and dust
summary: Single-service items were stored on the floor in prep and storage areas and were ordered to be inverted and raised. Grease, food debris, and dirt were found under equipment and along walls. Dust was on fans and vents.

headline: Failed: flies, live dog, unsafe equipment
summary: About 100 small black live flies were found throughout the restaurant, and a citation was issued. A customer's pet dog was in the dining room, which is prohibited; a citation was issued. No valid certified food manager was on site. Mold-like buildup was found in the soda dispenser.

headline: Mayonnaise sauces too warm; expired sauces discarded
summary: Mayonnaise-based sauces in to-go cups were held at 74.1 F and all were discarded. Bulk sauces past their expiration dates or lacking labels were also discarded. Other items to fix include unlabeled bulk foods, dirty surfaces, and a food handler's grease-trap issue.

headline: Coffee prep without certificate; dog removed
summary: Food handlers preparing coffee with dairy needed a City food service certificate; a citation was issued. A dog was roaming the facility and was removed during the inspection; a citation was issued. There was no written employee health policy or vomit cleanup procedure.

headline: Food debris and grease in fryer cabinet
summary: Food debris and grease had built up inside the fryer cabinet next to the flat-top grill in the kitchen. The operator was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Food stored on basement floor
summary: Food items were stored on the floor under the storage racks in the basement walk-in cooler and freezer. The person in charge was instructed to raise them six inches. A slow-draining handsink in the meat prep area must also be repaired.

headline: Broken dish machine; slow-draining bar sink
summary: The low-temperature dish machine at the bar was broken and not in use; it must be repaired or replaced. The bar handwashing sink drains slowly. No allergen training certificates were on site for certified managers.

headline: Missing thermometers; no allergen training for PIC
summary: Cooling units in the prep area were missing thermometers and must be provided. Burned-out bulbs in the ventilation hood must be replaced. The person in charge lacked allergen training, which must be obtained and kept on site.

headline: Basement handsink blocked; cutting boards worn
summary: A basement prep handsink was not accessible because it was filled with equipment and tools; a citation was issued. An ice scoop was stored improperly on a wire rack. Cutting boards were stained with dark grooves, and the ice machine door hinges were in poor repair.

headline: Missing thermometers; food stored on floor
summary: Front prep coolers needed working thermometers. Boxes of food were stored on the walk-in freezer floor and must be raised. Wiping cloths were on prep tables, and shelving was rusty. A 3-compartment sink faucet leaked.

headline: Cooler tagged after reaching 57.2 F
summary: The rear two-door cooler was at 57.2 F, so it was tagged and must not be used until repaired. About 60 lbs of food worth $800, including hamburgers and milk, was discarded. The ice maker had debris, and a front cooler also held food at 78 to 79 F.

headline: Dead roaches in dish area; other repairs needed
summary: Dead roaches were found stuck to a handwashing sign above the sink and on the floor under the three-compartment sink. Food was uncovered in bulk containers, and a sauce pot was on the floor. A backflow device was needed on the ice machine, and wall openings near the rear exit need repair.

headline: Employees eating and drinking at prep area
summary: Employees were drinking and preparing food at the kitchen prep area; management must designate a separate eating area. Serving plates on shelves were not properly stored and must be inverted.

headline: Broken fryer door handle and cracked utility sink
summary: The handle on the deep fryer panel door was broken, so the fryer could not be opened easily. The basement utility sink was cracked and missing plastic and must be repaired or replaced. The uncovered waste receptacle needs a lid.

headline: Failed: leaking sink, unsafe drain; training gaps
summary: A water leak under the three-compartment sink in the rear dish area must be repaired. A dehumidifier hose was draining into the sink and needed to be moved to a floor drain. Several food handlers lacked certificates. A prior violation, including handwashing signage, was not corrected.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food service
summary: No person in charge with a valid Chicago food sanitation certificate was present, and no certified manager was on duty while TCS foods were prepared; a citation was issued. Wet wiping cloths were on prep surfaces and chemical storage floors had dust and debris.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings near food prep
summary: About 50 mouse droppings were found on the floor of a basement utility closet next to the food prep area; a citation was issued and more pest control was recommended. Ice bin interior was unclean, unlabeled seasonings and bulk containers were noted, and certified food managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Failed: mold in ice machine; missing signs
summary: Black mold-like substance was found throughout the inside of the ice machine, which is used for human consumption; a citation was issued. Handwashing signs were missing in the prep areas and restroom. Plastic spoons and forks were not inverted, and a sink stopper was missing.

headline: No certified manager on site during food handling
summary: No City-certified food service manager was on site while TCS foods were being reheated and handled; a citation was issued. No written employee health policy was on the premises. Items stored on the walk-in floor must be raised; floor dirt and vent dust also need cleaning.

headline: Expired allergen training for food manager
summary: The City food manager's allergen training was expired. The operator must renew it and keep certificates on site. A light shield is also needed over a ceiling light in the pizza prep station.

headline: Unlabeled containers and debris behind equipment
summary: Food storage containers in the rear prep area must be labeled with the common name of the food. Dry food debris was on floors behind cooking and frying equipment and must be cleaned.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; food discarded
summary: The walk-in cooler was not maintained and had an air temperature of 48 F. Chicken, cooked vegetables, butter, and goat meat were held at 49.8 to 51.1 F and discarded, about 100 lbs worth $700. The cooler must be repaired and kept at 41 F or below.

headline: Failed: missing health policy and food handler training
summary: No signed employee health policy and no consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods were on site. A thermometer was missing, and many items needed cleaning or repair. Previous violations were not corrected, including a non-self-closing washroom door and no washroom ventilation.

headline: Failed: dead roaches; no certified manager on site
summary: No City-certified food service manager was on the premises; a citation was issued. Dead roaches were found on the floor, in a corner near the ice machine, and inside the sushi prep sink. Prior priority violations were not corrected, and the menu lacked a raw-food disclosure.

headline: Missing thermometers; expired food handler certificates
summary: Refrigeration units in the prep area were missing thermometers and must have them provided. Food handler certifications on site were expired and must be updated with verification kept on site.

headline: Ice machine panel and floor drain need cleaning
summary: The interior panel of the basement ice machine needed cleaning. The floor drain at the cooking station also needed cleaning. The inspection passed.

headline: Failed: prior violations not corrected
summary: Previous core violations were not corrected: no ambient air thermometers in coolers, no service sink, and no covered receptacle in the all-gender restroom. Food debris was on the floor, and the certified food manager on site had no allergen training; a citation was issued.

headline: Hot-held food too cool; about 10 lbs discarded
summary: About 10 lbs of stuffed spinach and cheese pies held at 80.6 F and 104.7 F under hot lamps were discarded. A paper towel dispenser had to be moved closer to the hand sink. Several cleaning and repair items were noted.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training on site
summary: No allergen training was on site for the certified manager. The person in charge was instructed to obtain it and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Rear door and screen not sealed; no thermometer
summary: The rear door was open and the exterior screen door was not sealed at the bottom, top, or sides, which could let pests in. The front prep cooler needs a working thermometer to monitor air temperature.

headline: Failed: fruit flies, slimy ice machine, unlabeled food
summary: About 10 to 12 live small fruit flies or gnats were found in the storage area, prep table, and employee washroom; a citation was issued. Pink slime was in the ice machine and was discarded and cleaned; a citation was issued. Food containers and condiments lacked labels, and employees lacked food handler certificates.

headline: Failed: no backflow device at mop sink
summary: A prior core violation was not corrected: the mop sink had no backflow prevention device. A citation was issued, and the operator must provide a device that can be serviced and located correctly.

headline: Splash guard, sanitizer bucket, and repairs needed
summary: A splash guard is needed between the food prep and serving counters. A sanitizer bucket and linens must be provided at the prep counter. The three-compartment sink faucet was too loose, and a hole was in the floor by the freezer.

headline: Dust and litter in cooler and vent
summary: Inside the vent and on the sides of two display coolers there was excessive dust and litter. Dust had also built up on the floor behind and beside the coolers. The operator was told to clean them in detail.

headline: Failed: mice droppings and no certified manager
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were found on shelves, floors, and under cooking equipment, and numerous flying insects were in prep, dish, and storage areas; a citation was issued. No person in charge with a valid Chicago food sanitation certificate was present, and no food handler training was available.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; cold food too warm
summary: The low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged, not to be used until reinspected. Beef, pork, and oysters were held above 41°F; about 11 lbs were discarded. A cooler at 52.1°F was tagged. Failed.

headline: Scratched cutting boards; inconsistent hot water
summary: Cutting boards have deep scratches and soil buildup and must be resurfaced or replaced. Hot water is inconsistent: sinks dropped from about 107°F and 100°F to 88°F. Handwashing sinks need at least 100°F and other sinks 110°F.

headline: Cooked rice held too warm; food discarded
summary: Cooked rice in a one-door refrigerator held at 54.9–68.8°F. The manager voluntarily discarded about 26 lbs. Cold food must stay at 41°F or below. Also missing sink stoppers and an ice machine backflow device.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; machine tagged
summary: The chemical dish machine dispensed no chlorine sanitizer (0 ppm) and was tagged out; staff must use the three-compartment sink. Duct tape was used on a cooler gasket and prep table. Wood surfaces need sealing, and walk-in lighting is too dim.

headline: Missing splash guard; unfinished shelving wood
summary: A washable splash guard must be installed between the hand sink and the three-compartment sink drainboard. Unfinished wood on front service shelving must be finished so it is smooth and cleanable. Passed.

headline: Expired food handler certificates
summary: Expired food handler training certificates were observed; current certificates must be provided. Passed.

headline: Water-stained ceiling tiles need replacing
summary: Water-stained ceiling tiles were found in the toilet room and behind the front counter. Staff were told to replace them and keep them maintained.

headline: Missing signs; food stored on floor
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at customer toilet-room sinks. Food containers were unlabeled, food was stored on walk-in floors, and wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizer. Crates and cardboard were used on shelving. Passed.

headline: Cracked ceiling tiles above basement dish area
summary: Cracked and chipping ceiling tiles above the basement dish area must be repaired or replaced. Passed.

headline: 50 rat droppings found in basement
summary: Inspector saw 50 rat droppings on the basement floor in the grease trap room. Manager must remove them before reinspection and call pest control. Also noted grease buildup near the dish sink and holes in the basement floor.

headline: Chicken held too warm; debris and crates
summary: About 15 lbs of diced chicken at 49.3–55.2°F were discarded. A slow prep sink drain must be fixed. Crates used for storage and debris buildup on equipment and floors must be removed and cleaned. Passed with conditions.

headline: No food handler certificates; no allergen training
summary: An opening at the bottom of the back door must be repaired or closed to prevent pest entry. Torn gaskets on a cooler and walk-in door must be repaired. No food handler certificates were on site, and the certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Floor drain debris and fan dust
summary: Debris inside a floor drain at the deli prep area must be cleaned. Dust on fans in the walk-in dairy cooler must be cleaned and maintained. Passed.

headline: No certified manager certificate; missing license number
summary: No Chicago certified food manager certificate was provided. The vehicle lacks its license number on both sides, which must be at least 2 inches tall. Failed.

headline: Rust on shelves; splash guard and hood issues
summary: Rust on metal shelves in the walk-in cooler must be cleaned. A prior core violation was not corrected: no splash guard at the hand sink by the meat slicer, and an inoperable hood by the prep handsink and unisex restroom. Citation issued. Failed.

headline: Cold food too warm; about 50 flies
summary: Eggs at 56°F, chicken up to 57°F, and milk up to 48°F were held too warm in prep coolers; one cooler was at 58°F. About 50 live small flying insects were seen in dishwashing, grill, and bar areas. Citations issued. Failed.

headline: No certified manager; no allergen certificates
summary: No person with an original city food sanitation certificate was posted on site; a citation was issued. Pink mineral buildup is inside the ice machine. Self-serve packaged foods lacked business name, address, and net quantity. No allergen training certificates were on site.

headline: Cooler interiors and clutter need cleaning
summary: Reach-in coolers and freezers need detailed cleaning to remove spills and buildup. Food items and debris under sales shelves must be cleared. Clutter in the back storage rooms must be organized. Passed.

headline: Dead insects in prep area
summary: Dead flying insects were found on a windowsill and on the floor by the three-compartment sink in the prep area. Staff were told to remove them, detail clean, sanitize, and maintain. Passed.

headline: Ice machine interior needs cleaning
summary: The internal surfaces of the ice machine need cleaning, and staff were told to clean them. Passed.

headline: Dirty soda nozzles and minor storage debris
summary: Pop dispenser nozzles need cleaning to remove buildup. Minor debris on the storage floor must be cleaned. Passed.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food handling
summary: No certified food manager was on duty when TCS foods were handled; the manager arrived about 9:05 AM, and a citation was issued. Dumpster lids were not closed due to overflowing trash. Food handler and manager training documentation was missing.

headline: Linens on floor; restroom ventilation not working
summary: A clean linen bag was stored on the floor in the front service area and must be moved at least 6 inches up. Restroom mechanical ventilation is in poor repair and not working, so odors and fumes are not removed. Passed.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup procedure
summary: No employee health policy was on premises; the manager must provide one. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies were on premises. Passed with conditions.

headline: Foil liners, food spills, missing allergen training
summary: Foil liner on and around the kitchen grill must be removed. Walls with dried food spillage need cleaning. A certified food manager lacked allergen training, and management was told to comply. Passed on reinspection.

headline: Lunchmeat and chicken held too warm
summary: Lunchmeat at 48.5°F and diced chicken at 61.2°F were held above 41°F in the front prep cooler; about 9 lbs were discarded. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Second-floor storage was cluttered; unused items must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: One of two employees lacked food handler training
summary: One of two food employees observed had no food handler training. Staff must complete training and keep records on site at all times. Passed.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: The certified food manager on duty had no allergen training, and a prior core violation was not corrected; a citation was issued. Flat cardboard boxes on top of the outside dumpster must be removed.

headline: Live flies, unapproved food, no certified manager
summary: No person in charge was present at the start, and no certified manager was present while beef was handled; the manager arrived at 10:05 AM. Juices, taffy grapes, and pickles lacked approved-source proof and were held. About 20 live flies were in the prep area. Failed.

headline: Raw shrimp stored with cooked; zero sanitizer
summary: Raw and cooked shrimp were stored together in a prep cooler. The dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer and no chemical sanitizer on site. Rice at 70.7°F, eggs, crab sticks, and shrimp were held too warm; about 15 lbs were discarded. Citations issued. Failed.

headline: Gaps under doors; dirty basement areas
summary: Gaps at the bottom of the rear and front doors could allow pests in and must be sealed. Basement pop syrup boxes and walk-in cooler floors and walls need cleaning. A light is out in the first-floor women's washroom. Passed with conditions.

headline: Fat stored in bags; greasy floor
summary: Single-use bags used to store fat in the deep freezer must be replaced with food-grade containers. The upstairs employee restroom trash can lacks a lid. Spilled grease under cooking equipment must be cleaned. Passed.

headline: Dry food debris under prep tables
summary: Dry food debris on floors and in corners under the front prep tables must be cleaned. Passed.

headline: Mouse droppings; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: About 75 mouse droppings in the bakery, over 100 in the basement, and 20 in the dining room. The dish machine dispensed 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged. Foods held too warm and undated were discarded. Failed; citations issued.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; manager absent initially
summary: No valid certified manager was on site until 12:30 PM; this was corrected on site. Cold foods were held at 49.8–65.3°F, and about 11 lbs were discarded. Two cold-holding units were tagged. Shellstock tags lacked dates. Failed.

headline: No certified manager and several gaps found
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared and served; a citation was issued. No handwashing sink in the rear prep area, a 1/4-inch gap under the rear exit door, and no food handler certificates were found. Failed.

headline: Grease, splatter, leaks, and wall damage
summary: The microwave, deep fryer openings, and non-cooking unit gaskets had grease, food debris, or splatter needing cleaning. A freezer handle is missing. The rear three-compartment sink and a bar sink leak. Floors are dirty, and a rear prep wall has a hole. Passed.

headline: Wall opening near mop sink needs repair
summary: An opening in the wall between the mop sink and the storage room door must be repaired. Passed on reinspection.

headline: No certified manager; sanitizer and soap missing
summary: No person in charge was present at the start, and no certified manager certificate was on site while dairy and sandwiches were handled; a citation was issued. No vomit cleanup procedure. Sanitizer, test kit, and soap were missing; some were supplied during inspection.

headline: Unlabeled cake, missing hair restraint, scoop issue
summary: Prepackaged tres leches cake lacked a full food label. Squirt bottles and shakers were unlabeled. Diced tomatoes were transferred with a bowl instead of a handled utensil. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Passed.

headline: Dirty drains, uninverted pans, greasy hood filters
summary: Sheet pans, large bowls, and hotel pans were not inverted. Food debris and grime were in kitchen floor drains, and hot-line ventilation filters had heavy soot and grease. Person in charge was told to clean and maintain.

headline: No handwashing signs; unlabeled food containers
summary: Both prep handsinks lack handwashing signs. Food in coolers and dry storage lacked name labels, and wet wiping cloths were on prep surfaces. A rusted prep table must be repaired or replaced. Passed.

headline: No dish soap or sanitizer at dish sink
summary: No dish soap or sanitizer was on site for the three-compartment sink; the person in charge provided dish soap and chlorine sanitizer during inspection. The coffee machine drains directly into the wastewater tank and needs an indirect connection.

headline: Ice machine slime and unsafe cold holding
summary: Black slime and rust in two ice machines dripped into ice used for human consumption. The machines were turned off and the ice removed. Cooked chicken at 44–48.1°F and raw beef at 48.7–53.8°F were held too warm; about 32 lbs were discarded. Failed.

headline: Coffee cups on prep tables; missing stoppers
summary: Employees' open coffee cups on prep tables must be kept away from food. The rear three-compartment sink is missing stoppers. A live pottery plant above the prep area must be removed. Kitchen and deli staff lack food handler certificates.

headline: Dirty fryer, pizza oven, and washroom walls
summary: The deep fryer, top of the pizza oven, prep coolers, freezers, and food containers need cleaning. The employee washroom lacks a covered waste receptacle and needs wall cleaning. A food handler without a certificate was observed.

headline: Torn gaskets, dirty floors, greasy hood
summary: Torn gaskets inside prep service coolers need repair or replacement. Floors along wall bases and under equipment, especially in the dish area, need cleaning. Heavy grease and dirt on the hood, filters, and pipes must be cleaned. Passed.

headline: Walk-in freezer floor needs cleaning
summary: The interior floors of the walk-in freezer must be cleaned to remove spills and debris. Passed.

headline: Sink stoppers and light shields missing
summary: Three-compartment sink stoppers do not work and must be replaced. Prep area ceiling light shields are missing end covers. Passed.

headline: Ceiling leak; some food handlers untrained
summary: A ceiling leak by the office door must be repaired. All food handlers must obtain the required food handler training. Passed.

headline: Utensils drying on cloths; plants over food
summary: Utensils were placed on cloth towels to dry; staff were told to stop. Spray bottles in the kitchen lacked labels. Live pottery plants above open food must be removed. Passed.

headline: Employee health policy and allergen training missing
summary: No employee health policy, training system, or allergen training certificates were on site. Broken screen mesh and screen door at the rear exit must be repaired, or the main door kept closed. Broken sink stoppers for the three-compartment sink must be replaced.

headline: Missing handwashing signs in restrooms
summary: Handwashing signs were missing in both the men's and women's restrooms. Staff were told to install and maintain them. No other issues were noted.

headline: Raw eggs over ready food; no certified manager
summary: No valid sanitation certificate was on site; a citation was issued. Eight dozen raw eggs were stored above uncovered ready-to-eat food, and about 100 lbs of prepared TCS food lacked date labels; all were discarded. Customer restrooms had no hot water. Failed.

headline: Unlabeled sugar, missing backflow device, plants
summary: The bulk sugar container is unlabeled. The backflow device for the basement ice maker could not be located and must be installed where it is visible. Live pottery plants above the sushi prep station must be removed. Passed.

headline: Over 100 rodent droppings; unclean floors
summary: Over 100 rodent droppings near the rear mop sink and hot water heater must be removed, and the area sanitized. Floors under equipment were unclean, and stained ceiling tiles above food prep need replacing. Failed.

headline: One employee lacked food handler training
summary: One food employee on duty had no food handler training. Staff must complete training and keep records on site at all times. Passed.

headline: Restroom hot water too cold; citation issued
summary: Restroom handwashing sink water measured 81.1°F; the owner restored hot water during inspection. A front counter worker lacked a hair restraint. A three-door cooler has a torn gasket, and hood filters have grease buildup.

headline: Sanitizer test strips do not match sanitizer
summary: No lactic acid sanitizer test strips were on site, and the quat strips available do not match the sanitizer used. A matching test kit or quat sanitizer must be provided. Soiled mop heads must be hung to prevent insect breeding. Failed.

headline: Food debris in bins; expired allergen certificate
summary: Food debris built up on flour and sugar bins, and the floor under rear shelving needs cleaning. The certified manager's allergen certificate expired; updated training must be obtained and kept on site. Passed.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers and damaged wall
summary: Bulk containers lacked labels showing the common name; the person in charge was told to label them. A damaged wall near the stand mixer must be repaired so it is smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Unlabeled containers; no sink stoppers
summary: Bulk and small dry ingredient containers were unlabeled. No sink stoppers were on site for the three-compartment sink. Water on the basement floor must be removed. Passed.

headline: No service sink; soiled mop head stored
summary: No service sink was on site; one must be installed and maintained. A soiled mop head was not stored properly, and the manager was told to hang mop heads to prevent insect breeding. Passed.

headline: No hand soap at rear prep sink
summary: No hand soap was at the rear prep handwashing sink; the person in charge supplied it during inspection. Maintenance tools were stored in a cluttered way in the rear corridor and must be reorganized for cleaning. Passed with conditions; citation issued.

headline: No backflow devices for ice machines
summary: Two ice machines lacked backflow prevention devices, which must be provided. Customer restroom doors are not self-closing. Exposed brick walls in the prep area must be made smooth and easy to clean. Passed.

headline: Cardboard shelf lining in walk-in cooler
summary: Cardboard lining the walk-in cooler shelves under food containers must be removed. Passed.

headline: No certified manager; health policy, training missing
summary: No certified manager certificate was posted while TCS foods were prepared. Signed employee health policies, hand-drying devices, and soap at sinks were missing. The outside grease container lid is not tight. The summary report was not posted. Failed; citations issued.

headline: Rodent droppings, flies, and missing pest log
summary: About 20 rodent droppings were found behind the cook line and about 20 flies near the bar cooler. No pest control log was on site, and rear door gaps were noted. Missing vomit cleanup kit and metal-stem thermometer. Citations issued. Failed.

headline: Greasy fryer bottoms and missing wall coving
summary: The bottom areas of the fryers need grease removed. The women's washroom ventilation fan has no cover, and some kitchen wall bases are not coved. Staff were told to fix each item.

headline: Women's washbowl lacks water; sprayer leaks
summary: The washbowl closest to the stalls in the women's restroom had no running water and must be supplied. The three-compartment sink sprayer leaks and must be fixed.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets and leaking prep sink drain
summary: The second lower two-door reach-in cooler has worn and torn gaskets. Sides of the cooking equipment have grease, dirt, and food splatter that should be cleaned to prevent pests. The rear prep handwashing sink drain pipe leaks.

headline: Crates, torn fan guards, debris in walk-in cooler
summary: The walk-in cooler had crates used for food storage, missing fan guard covers, debris on shelving, and debris along the floor and wall bases. Crates must be removed, fan guards repaired, and debris cleaned.

headline: Hair restraints, mop storage, prior violations
summary: Bulk flour and sugar containers lacked labels, and food handlers prepped without hair restraints. Wet wiping cloths were on prep surfaces, and a 1/4-inch gap was at the rear exit door. Prior core violations were not corrected: allergen training and food handler proof were missing.

headline: No health policy, cleanup procedure, or test kit
summary: No employee health policy, vomit cleanup procedure, or sanitizer test kit was on site. Paper towels, soap, thermometers, and a pest control log were missing. There is no utility sink, and the ice machine lacks a backflow device. Manager lacked allergen training. Failed.

headline: No test kit, no drainboard, debris on slicer
summary: No handwashing signs at prep sinks and no thermometer in a reach-in cooler. No sanitizer test kit was available; a citation was issued. No drainboard for the three-compartment sink. Damaged display cooler gaskets, ice buildup, and food debris on the meat slicer.

headline: Door gap, worn cutting boards, missing training
summary: A gap in the center of the double entry doors must be made tight-fitting to prevent insect entry. Knives were stored between coolers, and worn cutting boards need repair. Some food handler training and the food manager's allergen training are missing.

headline: Plumbing leak and caulking repairs needed
summary: A leak under the front handwashing sink must be fixed. The rear handwashing sink needs recaulking, a water-stained dining area ceiling tile needs replacing, and the walk-in cooler storage top is cluttered.

headline: Grease buildup on equipment and hood
summary: Grease and food debris were found on the sides of cooking equipment, inside the fryer cabinet, and on a two-door refrigerator. Grease also covered the hood and filters. Staff were told to clean and maintain them.

headline: No certified manager; dirty ice machine
summary: No certified manager was on premises while milk and eggs were prepared; a citation was issued. Black dirt buildup inside the ice machine was dripping into ice. All ice was discarded, and the interior must be cleaned by reinspection. Failed.

headline: Frozen chicken under prep table; dirty hood
summary: Frozen chicken was found under the prep table. The manager said it was fish, and the product was still frozen after thawing methods were discussed. Bulk containers were unlabeled, wiping cloths were left on prep tables, and the hood had heavy grease.

headline: Hot and cold foods held at unsafe temperatures
summary: Scrambled eggs at 82.6°F, pork sausage at 89.9°F, and potatoes at 87.4°F were below the required 135°F hot-hold; about 9 lbs ($150) were discarded. Cantaloupe at 62.8°F in the employee cafe cooler was discarded. Passed with conditions.

headline: Broken thermometer and food stored on floor
summary: A broken air thermometer in the dairy cold-hold unit needs repair. Food was stored on the floor and uncovered in the cooler. Milk crates are used as shelving, a drainpipe under the sinks leaks, and grease and dust have built up.

headline: Floors need cleaning under shelves
summary: Floors under storage shelves and in corners of the prep and dishwashing areas need cleaning. Passed.

headline: No health policy; hot water too low
summary: No employee health policy was on site. Three-compartment sink water measured 96–102°F; the manager raised it to 115°F during inspection. A brownish substance in the ice machine must be cleaned. A written procedure is needed for the dough mixer and sheeter.

headline: Rear door gap; dirty coolers and ceiling
summary: The rear exit door is not sealed at the bottom and must be repaired to prevent pest entry. Reach-in coolers are not clean. Dusty vents, a missing ceiling tile, and damaged ceiling tiles need attention, and floors need cleaning. Allergen training proof was not provided.

headline: Dirty walls, peeling paint, prior violations
summary: Walls in the dishwashing and storage areas are dirty, ceiling paint is peeling, and the hood is greasy. Prior core violations were not corrected, including uninverted bowls, rust, moldy sink caulking, and items on floors. Citation issued. Failed.

headline: Cold beef too warm; no hot water briefly
summary: Beef was held at 47.8°F, and the manager voluntarily discarded about 3 lbs. Hot water was initially unavailable; the three-compartment sink measured 98.8°F and was restored to 111.6°F before inspection ended. A slow-draining handsink and missing grout were also noted.

headline: Torn gaskets, low water pressure, cardboard mats
summary: A three-door prep cooler has torn gaskets. Grease must be removed from walk-in fan guards and the can opener. Water pressure is low in the bar and restrooms. Cardboard floor mats in dry storage must be replaced with cleanable flooring.

headline: Grease dumpster lid; no allergen certificate
summary: A stained cutting board on the prep cooler must be replaced or cleaned. A dry storage container is unlabeled. The grease dumpster lid does not close tightly and must be replaced. Coving is missing under sinks. The certified manager lacks allergen training. Failed.

headline: Burned-out hood light; staff told to replace
summary: A burned-out light bulb in a ventilation hood was found. Staff were instructed to replace it. This is a minor upkeep item.

headline: No health policy, handwashing sinks, or pest log
summary: No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure was available. Prep and dishwashing areas lacked handwashing sinks, and no pest control logbook was available. Several storage and equipment problems were noted. Citations issued. Failed.

headline: Over 50 mouse droppings; no certified manager
summary: Over 50 mouse droppings were found in a rear storage closet. No certified manager was on site while TCS foods were handled. Handwashing sinks lacked soap and towels. About 20 lbs of raw oysters lacked tags and were discarded. Ice machine had black mold.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings in bakery
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were found on the bakery basement floor, and droppings were also near the ovens and sandwich prep. All areas must be cleaned, and pest control service is recommended before reinspection next week. Failed; citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; flies and broken window
summary: No valid certificate was on site while TCS foods were prepared; a citation was issued. About 40 flies were concentrated in the pizza prep room, and fly paper was hanging. A restroom window is broken, and the pizza ingredient cooler has no thermometer.

headline: Wiping cloths and mop stored improperly
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution when not in use; sanitizer must be at the required strength. A mop was stored in its bucket and must be hung to air dry. Passed.

headline: Missing garbage receptacle lid
summary: A garbage receptacle in the indoor trash room lacks a lid. The manager must provide lids for all garbage receptacles at all times. Passed.

headline: Salsa splatters; peeling paint near sink
summary: Salsa containers in the two-door cooler were covered in food splatters and must be cleaned. Peeling paint on the wall near the compartment sink and rear restroom must be repaired. Passed.

headline: No certified manager while handling TCS foods
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while temperature-controlled foods (TCS, such as chicken and beef) were handled; staff were told to obtain one. Also noted trash under the bar, floor repairs, a missing catch basin cover, and a light missing its shield.

headline: Unlabeled flour, salt, and sugar containers
summary: Visible food storage containers identified by common names such as flour, salt, and sugar must be labeled. Passed.

headline: Walk-in freezer seal in poor repair
summary: The walk-in freezer seal is in poor repair and must be fixed to prevent ice buildup inside the freezer. Passed.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea policy; holes in office walls
summary: No written policy for vomit and diarrhea events was on site, and it must be provided. Handwashing signage is needed at the restroom washbowl. Thermometers are needed inside 3-door grocery coolers, and two large holes in office walls must be enclosed.

headline: Soda on floor by ice machine; basement clutter
summary: A large amount of soda sat on the floor near the ice machine and must be raised at least six inches. Clutter in the basement must be organized or removed to avoid pest harborage. Food splatter near the deep fryers must be cleaned.

headline: Dish racks stored on floor
summary: Dish racks were stored on the floor in the dishwashing area and must be raised to protect them from contamination.

headline: Deli cups stacked while wet
summary: Deli cups were not air dried after washing and were stacked while wet. Staff were told to air dry all multi-use utensils.

headline: Holes and rear door gap; repeat violations uncorrected
summary: Holes in floors, walls and ceiling in the rear boiler room and a gap under the rear door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Earlier violations were not fixed in time, so this item is now a priority violation.

headline: Rear door gap must be rodent-proofed
summary: A quarter-inch gap at the rear exit door sweep must be sealed to keep rodents out. A slow-draining prep hand sink, a floor tile area needing regrout, debris in the basement, dirty dishroom walls and light problems were also noted.

headline: Rear door gaps; expired food handler certificates
summary: The rear exit door is not completely rodent-proof, with small gaps in both corners; seal the gaps or replace the door sweep. Grease buildup on fryers and floors under fryers must be cleaned. Some food handler certificates had expired.

headline: Walk-in cooler floors dirty; some lights out
summary: Staff were told to install a splashguard at the rear hand sink to prevent contamination. Dried food debris under walk-in shelving must be removed, and burned-out light bulbs in rear storage must be replaced.

headline: Frozen chicken in grocery bags; no self-closing door
summary: Frozen chicken was stored in plastic grocery bags inside the chest freezer and must be moved to food-grade bags.
