The employee washroom needs a covered waste receptacle and a self-closing door. Excess clutter in prep and dry storage must be removed to avoid pest harborage. Re-inspection passed.

headline: No employee health policy; cooler too warm
summary: No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was on site. A reach-in cooler measured 44F inside and 56F at the top. No stem thermometer, sanitizer or test strips were on site, and the three-compartment sink has no drainboard.

headline: Side door gap; ice machine backflow device not found
summary: A half-inch gap between the side entrance doors must be closed and rodent-proofed. The backflow prevention device on the ice machine could not be located and must be provided or found. A covered receptacle is needed inside the toilet room. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Repeat violations: no splashguard or certificates
summary: Grease and food debris were found on floors, equipment and fryer cabinets, and on the hood and pipes. Repeat violations remained: no splashguard, a food handler without a certificate, and a manager without allergen training.

headline: No allergen training certificates on site
summary: No allergen training certificates were on site. All employees holding a City of Chicago foodservice manager certificate must complete allergen training and keep records on site at all times. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Cold holding unit at 52.2F; tagged held for inspection
summary: A one-door cold holding unit in the front prep area measured 52.2F and was tagged held for inspection. All cold holding units must stay at 41F or below. Also noted: rust, grease, a leaking drain pipe, and non-working restroom ventilation.

headline: No hair restraints; rusty shelving
summary: All food preparers must wear effective hair restraints. Rust on metal shelving inside the front prep two-door cooler must be removed or repainted. All stored items in the front prep area must be raised off the floor.

headline: Dirty floor drains; grime under beverage area
summary: Floor drains throughout the facility need detailed cleaning to prevent possible insect activity. Dirt, spills and small debris under the front beverage area must be cleaned. No insects were reported.

headline: No paper towels at hand sink; corrected on site
summary: The hand sink in the prep area had no paper towels. The person in charge was told paper towels must always be available, and a food handler supplied one during the inspection. A citation was issued.

headline: Storage room lights not working
summary: Lights are not working in the storage room and must be repaired with adequate lighting.

headline: Food handler did not wash hands between tasks
summary: A food handler cooked, rinsed a towel, then returned to the grill without washing hands. The employee was told to remove gloves and wash hands, and a citation was issued. Burnt-out bathroom bulbs, no training proof, and no allergen certificate were also noted.

headline: Greasy floors under fryers; dusty vents
summary: Light grease on the kitchen floor under the fryers and the floor behind the large ice machine must be cleaned. Dust on the vents above cooking equipment must be removed. All food handlers must obtain required food handler certificates.

headline: Bare-hand contact with tortillas; live cockroaches
summary: A food handler touched ready-to-eat tortillas with bare hands and was told this is not allowed; a citation was issued. About 10 live cockroaches were seen in the basement food prep, dishwashing and mechanical room areas. Additional pest control is needed.

headline: Soiled mop head stored improperly
summary: A soiled mop head was not stored properly. Staff were told to hang mop heads to prevent insect breeding. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Open seam at sink divider; food handler training
summary: A small section of the seam at the top of the sink divider was open and must be sealed. All food handlers must obtain required food handler training.

headline: Rodent droppings found; food stored on floor
summary: About 30 rodent droppings were found in a cabinet and on the floor of the employee toilet room, and additional pest control service is needed. Food was on the cooler and freezer floors. No hot water throughout; sinks at 75.7-78F.

headline: No certified manager on arrival; no hot water
summary: No certified food manager was on site at arrival and arrived about 25 minutes later; a citation was issued. Hot water maxed at 76F. Repeat violation: missing ceiling tiles near the walk-in cooler and freezer.

headline: Combo sink replaced on site by plumber
summary: A combo sink with a dump sink attached to the bar handwash sink is not accepted by the City. A plumber removed it and installed a single exposed handsink on site. The all-gender restroom door must self-close, a covered receptacle is needed, and a certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Dusty fan; no certified manager with allergen training
summary: Dust has built up on the equipment fan throughout the main bar and prep area and must be cleaned. No certified food manager had allergen training, and documentation must be provided.

headline: Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer; floor debris
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in a clean sanitizing solution when not in use and must be corrected. Floors throughout the basement prep area need cleaning to remove food debris. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Drains and fan covers need detailed cleaning
summary: Drains in the rear dishwashing area need deep cleaning to prevent possible pests. Dusty walk-in fan covers and rusty shelving, grease on cooking equipment, and a leaking faucet need attention. Stained ceiling tiles need repair, and not all managers have allergen training.

headline: Equipment too large for three-compartment sink
summary: Some equipment in the facility is too large to fit and fully submerge in the three-compartment sink. The facility must install a larger sink, use smaller equipment, or use a health-department-approved manual method.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; garbage piled outside
summary: No vomit and diarrhea procedure or cleanup kit was on site, and a foundation violation was noted. A gap at the front entrance door must be rodent-proofed, and no pest control logbook was on site. Garbage, pallets and construction equipment were piled outside without a receptacle.

headline: Slow-draining handsink; dusty vents
summary: A handsink in the washroom closet to the kitchen drains slowly and must be corrected. Dust is on the washroom ceiling fans, and the vents above cooking equipment need cleaning. Floor corners around equipment in prep and cooking areas must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager; 193 pounds of food discarded
summary: No City-certified food manager was present, and cold foods in the walk-in cooler were at 45-55F. About 193 pounds worth $215 was discarded. The walk-in cooler, at 47F air temperature, was tagged and held.

headline: Frozen meats stored in plastic grocery bags
summary: Frozen meats were stored in plastic grocery bags in the freezers. The facility must use food-grade bags or containers.

headline: Wet wiping cloths; missing cooler liner; no sign
summary: Wet wiping cloths were on prep surfaces and must be kept in sanitizing solution. The 2-door prep cooler's interior is missing and must be repaired. Milk crates are used as shelving in the walk-in, and a mop must be stored to air dry.

headline: Rodent droppings found; no metal stem thermometer
summary: About 50 mouse droppings were found near the front counter, stove and register ledge, and pest control service is needed. No metal stem thermometer was on site. Also noted: food handlers without hair restraints and leaking faucets.

headline: Dirty cooler interiors; manager allergen training missing
summary: Food and dirt built up inside unused prep coolers and cabinets. Dishwash three-compartment sink stoppers do not work, and damaged floor tiles and burnt-out bulbs need repair. Managers must have valid allergen training certificates.

headline: No handsink at basement prep station
summary: A prep table with a microwave in the basement food and dry storage area had no handwash sink, soap or paper towels. Management must install a handwash sink with soap and towels, install a prep sink, or remove the prep table. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Mold-like buildup in ice machine; unlabeled menu corrected
summary: A large ice machine had black mold-like buildup that must be cleaned to prevent ice contamination. The menu lacked a raw or undercooked food advisory, but this was corrected on site before inspection ended. A bug light above dish shelves must be moved.

headline: Dirty ice machine and cutting board; broken tiles
summary: The ice machine interior must be cleaned, and the rear cutting board needs cleaning and sanitizing. Bulk containers in the basement must be labeled. Broken floor tiles in dining and prep areas must be repaired.

headline: Improper thawing methods; no food handler certificate
summary: Raw ground beef was thawing in still water and frozen chicken was in the three-compartment sink. Staff were told to thaw food in cold holding overnight or under cold running water. No food handler certificate was on site, and bulk containers need labels.

headline: No certified manager; wash water too cool
summary: No City-certified food manager was on the premises, and a citation was issued. Dish machine wash water was at 130F, below the required 150F. Hot water was absent but restored during the visit. No metal stem thermometer or allergen training was on site.

headline: No sanitation manager certificate; toilets inoperable
summary: No City sanitation manager certificate was found while handling TCS foods, and a foundation violation was issued. Both employee restrooms were inoperable, with toilets unable to flush. Plumbers repaired them before the end of the inspection, and the toilets were untagged.

headline: Repeat violations; ice-cream freezers accessible to public
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on front prep tables and must be kept in sanitizer. Ice buildup in hallway chest freezers, a slow leak at the three-compartment faucet, and water-damaged ceiling were noted. Unlocked ice cream freezers in a public hallway are a repeat violation.

headline: Door gaps let pests in; no self-closing restroom door
summary: The side exit door has gaps at the bottom and sides, and the front door has a quarter-inch gap at the bottom; both must be sealed to block pests. The washroom door must self-close, and a lidded garbage can is needed in the washroom.

headline: No allergen training certificates; freezer ice build-up
summary: No allergen training certificates were provided on site and must be provided for all certified food service managers. Excess ice built up at the walk-in freezer condenser unit and must be repaired. Food must be labeled inside coolers.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; about 10 flies
summary: TCS foods were held at 46-49F. The manager discarded about $70 of mozzarella, tomatoes, anchovies and ranch dressing. About 10 large flies were seen in the dish room, near the beer cooler and in the prep area.

headline: Over 150 dead roaches; severe rodent droppings
summary: Over 150 dead roaches were found in the basement storage areas. Repeat rodent activity: an estimated 600-700 rat and mouse droppings throughout the facility and 450 in the basement. Rat holes were also found. Priority violation, citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled bulk sugar; cardboard and milk crates used
summary: Bulk sugar was not labeled with its common name. Milk crates and cardboard were used as shelving and floor or cooler liners, and raw wooden shelves in prep needed sealing or painting.

headline: Dish machine gauge cover broken; allergen training missing
summary: A shattered cover on a gauge of the low-temperature dish machine must be repaired. Several employees lacked allergen training certificates, and all certified food managers must complete it.

headline: No handwashing signs; ice machine buildup
summary: No handwashing signs or posters are in the unisex washrooms and must be provided. The ice machine's upper portion needs cleaning, the dishwashing area floor needs regrouting, and burned-out light bulbs above prep tables and the basement ice machine need replacement.

headline: Suspected food poisoning: unapproved cheese, warm foods
summary: Complaint visit. No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was on site. Unapproved queso cheese was tagged. Sausages and cheese were at 51F and 60F; 220 pounds, worth $1,500, was discarded and corrected on site.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; allergen training missing
summary: Milk crates are used as shelving and storage containers in the storage area and must be removed. Shelving must be six inches off the floor. A food service sanitation manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: Gaps around grease trap and missing wall tile
summary: A gap around the grease trap floor cover in the basement must be closed to make the surface smooth and cleanable. A wall tile is missing beside the basement prep handwash sink and must be replaced.

headline: Rodent droppings in dry storage; grease throughout
summary: One to two rodent droppings were found in the second floor dry storage area and must be cleaned. Torn freezer and cooler gaskets, duct tape used on coolers, grease and food debris, and a leaking handwash sink were also noted.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; rodent-free but flies
summary: The second-floor low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged. Diced chicken was at 57.6F. About 4 pounds of product was discarded. Vacuum-packaging (ROP) rules were not met, with 75 pounds discarded. About 15 small flies were seen.

headline: Rust on storage shelves; cracked toilet lid
summary: Rust has built up on shelving in the walk-in storage area and must be removed or repaired. The lid of the front restroom toilet is cracked and broken and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Broken cooler gaskets; food handler certificate required
summary: Three reach-in coolers have broken door gaskets that must be replaced. The women's restroom trash receptacle needs a cover, and a food handler training certificate is required.

headline: Serving plates not stored properly
summary: Serving plates on prep-area shelves were not stored properly. Staff were told to invert all serving plates to prevent dust buildup.

headline: Standing water and dirt in washrooms; one manager
summary: Standing water and dirt buildup were found on washroom floors, and food and dirt were on sitting-area floors. The manager must detail clean these floors and maintain them. One food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Cardboard shelf liner; ice machine not in use
summary: Cardboard lines the shelving in the walk-in beverage cooler and must be removed. Dirt, dust, spills and a pink and black buildup on the ice machine interior need cleaning. An unused ice machine near the rear exit must be repaired or removed.

headline: Front door gap; torn cooler gasket; burnt-out bulb
summary: A gap of about a quarter-inch under the front entrance door must be closed to prevent pest entry. A torn door gasket on a prep line cooler must be replaced, and a burnt-out light bulb at the exhaust hood must be replaced.

headline: 30 rodent droppings in storage; citation issued
summary: About 30 rodent droppings were found in the facility's storage area. The manager was told to service all pest-affected areas, and a citation was issued. Ice machine interior calcium buildup also needs cleaning.

headline: Food in grocery bags in freezer; greasy kitchen
summary: Various food items were stored in plastic grocery bags in the freezer and must be moved to food-grade bags or containers. Grease buildup on cooking equipment, walls, floors and shelving in the kitchen and prep areas must be degreased, cleaned and sanitized. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Unapproved fermented turnips; food tagged, held
summary: A jar of cut turnips was fermenting in water and salt at room temperature without an approved variance or HACCP plan (a written food safety plan). The jar was tagged and held, and fermentation must stop until approval. Some employees lacked hair restraints.

headline: Unscreened windows; leak; missing trash containers
summary: Windows without screens must be screened or kept closed to protect against pests. A minor leak under the food prep handwash sink must be repaired. The employee toilet room and food prep area lack covered receptacles and a garbage can.

headline: Ice machine slime dripping into ice; ice discarded
summary: Pink slime buildup inside the ice machine was dripping into ice used for drinks. The manager must clean the ice machine interior by the re-inspection date, and all ice inside was discarded. Some cooler door gaskets are ripped and need replacing.

headline: Greasy floors; no food handler training proof
summary: Grease, food debris and dirt were found on floors under cooking equipment, along walls and in corners throughout prep, dishwashing, storage and bar areas. No proof of food handler training was available, and no certified manager had allergen training.

headline: Dead roaches scattered in kitchen; repairs needed
summary: Dead roaches were found under cooking equipment, inside the deep fryer, under the ice machine and in the dishwashing area. The facility must remove them, clean and sanitize the areas, and keep the premises pest-free. Ceiling and floor tiles also need repair.

headline: Public summary not posted; citation issued
summary: The inspection summary from the previous inspection was not posted for public view. A new summary was left and staff were told to post it, and a citation was issued. Re-inspection passed with conditions.

headline: Stained cutting board; cardboard floor liner
summary: A stained cutting board by the three-compartment sink must be removed or replaced. Cardboard is used as a floor liner, and single-use containers are used to store utensils. Rust was found on dry storage refrigeration shelves.

headline: Live cockroaches found; cold foods too warm
summary: Two large live cockroaches were seen by the cooler in the rear prep area and behind the bar. Cold TCS foods at 48-55F were discarded, about $40. No basement handsink was installed for ice handling, so one must be connected to city plumbing.

headline: Cold foods too warm; about $45 discarded
summary: Milk at 47.8F and half-and-half at 47.5F in a cooler; the cooler held at 49.7F. Management discarded about 50 pounds of food. Cooler tagged and not to be used until repaired. A food handler's certificate was expired.

headline: Handwashing and rodent-proofing gaps; sink leak
summary: Handwashing signage is missing behind the bar, and the rear dish area has no handwashing sink. Front and rear doors are not rodent-proofed at the bottom, the three-compartment sink lacks stoppers, and its pipe leaks.

headline: Person in charge and certified manager absent
summary: The person in charge was not on site. No City-certified food manager was on premises as required, and a foundation violation was issued. Grease buildup on the bottom and exterior of the fryers and floors under equipment must be cleaned.

headline: Chicken thawed on counter; no cooler thermometer
summary: Chicken was thawing on a prep table; staff were told to thaw only under running water or in a refrigerator. No thermometer in a cooler, unlabeled to-go desserts, and no pest control logbook on site.

headline: Greasy floors under cooking equipment; basement clutter
summary: Floors under cooking equipment must be cleaned of grease and food particles. The basement storage area, used partly by the owner, must be organized and kept that way.

headline: Broken backflow device; cracked walk-in floor
summary: A broken backflow prevention device on the utility sink must be installed so it can be serviced. A crack in the walk-in cooler floor must be repaired, missing ceiling tiles replaced, and proof of food handler training kept on site.

headline: Grease and dust on equipment and floors
summary: Grease buildup was found on cook-line equipment wheels, shelving and interior coolers, freezers and fryers. Dust covered food storage racks and to-go containers. Floors under fryers and inside the walk-in freezer also need cleaning.

headline: Insect control device placement; ice buckets on floor
summary: An insect control device above a main kitchen prep table must be moved. Ice buckets on the floor must be kept off it. The ice maker's interior had a gray film and must be cleaned.

headline: No thermometer in hot holding unit; unlabeled bulk
summary: No ambient air thermometer is inside the front service hot holding unit and must be provided. Bulk dry ingredient containers under the rear hot holding table are unlabeled. Slight debris under the dishwashing machine must be cleaned.

headline: Standing water and dirt outside grease container
summary: Heavy dirt and standing water are on the floor around and under the outside grease container and must be cleaned. Grease buildup under the stove, fryer and along the prep wall base must be cleaned. Stained ceiling tiles above dishwashing need attention.

headline: Cockroaches, rodent droppings, flies; food discarded
summary: No hand cleanser was at the prep handsink, bar prep or restroom sink, and a citation was issued. About 7 live cockroaches, around 50 small rodent droppings and about 30 live flies were seen. Food worth about $500 at 49-75F was discarded.

headline: No backflow device at coffee machine
summary: No backflow prevention device was found on the coffee machine waterline. One must be provided where it can be located and serviced.

headline: Milk crate shelving; burned-out hood light
summary: Milk crates are being used as shelving in prep and storage areas and must be removed; shelving must sit six inches off the floor. A burned-out light bulb in the hood must be replaced. No food employee had proof of allergen training.

headline: Dirty ice machine; boxed food on floor
summary: The interior of the ice machine bin and guard was dirty and must be cleaned. Boxed food items were on the floor in the rear prep area and must be elevated six inches. Grease and food debris were on cooking equipment and surfaces. Ventilation in the employee toilet room was not working.

headline: Missing trash can; damaged wall near cooler
summary: A trash receptacle is missing at the rear hand sink. Unfinished drywall behind syrup dispensers must be finished, and a wall near the walk-in cooler door has large openings and crumbling surfaces that need repair.

headline: No certified food manager; small flies throughout
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site while TCS foods, including fried chicken, were served. A cooking-line cooler held at 50F was tagged. About 20 small flies were seen throughout the facility.

headline: Leaky pipe and standing water in prep area
summary: A rear reach-in cooler's rubber gasket is in poor repair and must be replaced. A leaking pipe under the front prep hand sink must be repaired. Standing water on the prep and rear dishwashing floors must be kept dry to prevent pests.

headline: Raw meat in grocery bags; foil on grease trap
summary: Raw meat was stored in grocery bags in freezers and must be kept in food-grade bags or containers. Aluminum foil was used as a liner on a grease trap in the prep area and must be removed.

headline: Broken floor tiles; tinfoil over ceiling vents
summary: Broken floor tiles and missing wall base in rear prep must be repaired. Tinfoil covering ceiling vents in the pizza prep area must be removed and vents cleaned. Dust is heavy on a washroom vent. Exhaust hood lights above the rear grill were not working, a repeat violation.

headline: No certified manager during Italian beef prep
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS items like Italian beef were prepared, and a citation was issued. Thermometers are needed inside two coolers. Only one allergen training certificate was on site. Microwave grime and slime in the ice machine need cleaning.

headline: Two dish machines not sanitizing; both tagged
summary: The high-temperature dish machine's final rinse was 160F, and staff were told not to use it until repaired and rinse at 180F. The bar low-temperature machine showed 0 ppm chlorine. Both were tagged.

headline: Prep cooler foods above 41F; citation issued
summary: TCS foods in prep coolers were too warm: soup at 54F, cooked rice at 50F, shrimp at 51F, eggs at 48F, chicken at 49F and steak at 48F. Management was told to keep all cold TCS foods below 41F. A citation was issued.

headline: Equipment too large for three-compartment sink
summary: Some equipment used in the sushi kitchen is too large to fit and fully submerge in the three-compartment sink. The facility must install a larger sink, use smaller equipment, or use a health-department-approved manual method.

headline: Rusted table used as shelving near dish machine
summary: A rusted table used as shelving in the dish machine area must be replaced or repainted.

headline: No health policy or cleanup kit; no thermometer
summary: No employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea procedure or cleanup supplies were on site. No metal stem thermometer or chlorine test strips were available. Handwashing signage is missing, and customer counter protection is inadequate.

headline: Handwashing signs needed; cooler thermometers missing
summary: Handwashing signage is needed at the bar hand sink and in two customer washrooms. Thermometers must be visible inside all coolers. Other items: a divider between hand sink and ice machine, rusty shelving, and sealed holes in the kitchen wall. Food handler certificates are missing.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; dusty restroom fan
summary: Handwashing signage must be posted in the customer and employee restrooms in front of the bar. Dust and debris buildup on the toilet room ventilation fan must be detail cleaned and maintained.

headline: Moldy caulking at dish machine; greasy hood
summary: Blackened, moldy wall caulking beside the dish machine must be replaced. Grease buildup in the hibachi hood system and filters needs detailed cleaning. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Grease in hood; trash cans lack lids
summary: Dirt and grease had built up inside and on edges of the exhaust hood, filters, and pipes above cooking equipment, and must be detail-cleaned. Washrooms need lidded trash cans; a refrigerator door gasket is torn.

headline: No food handler training proof; clutter, dusty vents
summary: No proof of food handler training was on site for any food handler, and the certified manager had no allergen training proof. Grease covered cooking equipment and floors, and storage and office areas were cluttered.

headline: Blocked hand sink and missing food safety paperwork
summary: Front hand sink was blocked by a dish rack and must stay usable. Also no menu raw-food advisory, no valid sushi-rice pH test, no allergen certificates, and no food handler certificates on site.

headline: No sanitation certificate posted; food not labeled
summary: No City sanitation certificate was on premises or posted, and a certified manager must be on site during operating hours (cited). Flour, cornstarch, and other dry goods were not labeled. Kitchen prep floors and walls had grease and food debris.

headline: Heavy spray-hose and sink leaks; soiled freezer
summary: A spray hose at the first-floor main kitchen prep area leaked heavily when water ran, and the bar three-compartment sink faucet also leaked. A basement chest freezer had heavy food debris. The west bathroom lacked functioning ventilation.

headline: Rusty cooler shelving; damaged base coving
summary: Deli walk-in cooler shelving had heavy rust and must be repainted or replaced. Damaged base coving near the three-compartment sink in the produce area must be repaired.

headline: Rat droppings, drinking over meat, poor handwashing
summary: About 80 or more rat droppings were found across prep, storage, and dining areas, including near the hand sink. A food handler drank from an open jar above meat. Gloves were used without proper handwashing. Standing water was in a furnace closet.

headline: No certified manager; cold food held too warm
summary: No certified food manager on duty during food prep. Chicken measured 48.5°F, yogurt 49.1°F, sliced vegetables 50.1°F (limit 41°F); 8 lbs discarded. Also unlabeled containers, wet wiping cloths, and uncorrected allergen training.

headline: Expired allergen certificates; missing backflow devices
summary: Allergen training certificates for certified food managers have expired; this was a repeat violation not corrected, and a citation was issued. No backflow prevention device was found at the ice machine or coffee drip machine.

headline: No allergen training proof; minor repairs needed
summary: No proof of allergen training for certified food managers; must be provided. Also a torn door gasket on the salad cooler and a ceiling hole in the rear kitchen to be sealed.

headline: Basement food containers need labels
summary: Food storage containers in the basement prep area, such as flour and sugar, must be labeled with the common food name.

headline: No backflow device at espresso machine
summary: The espresso machine had no backflow prevention device. One must be provided where it can be located and serviced.

headline: Handwashing sink lacks splash guards
summary: The first-floor bar handwashing sink had no splash guards on either side. Inspector instructed installation to prevent contamination.

headline: No certified manager during chicken prep
summary: No valid certified manager or sanitation certificate was on site while chicken was prepared and served (cited). Bulk containers were unlabeled, single-service items were not inverted, and an employee lacked food handler training.

headline: Ice machine lid interior needs cleaning
summary: The interior of the ice machine lid must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Live roaches; food made during license revocation
summary: Four live roaches were found on a restroom wall, in rear dry storage, and in the main prep area. Pest control consultation was advised. Food was being made during license revocation; manager discarded about 30 lbs (about $100).

headline: Ice machine mold removed; manager now on site
summary: Mold-like substance in ice machine was removed and ice destroyed. No certified manager was on premises; one was on site by 5/21/2024. Soap, paper towels, a leaking drain, and bus tubs were corrected on site. Rear door gaps need sealing.

headline: No sanitizer test strips; broken floor tiles
summary: No sanitizer solution test strip was on site; staff were told to obtain one, a priority violation. Broken floor tiles in the rear prep kitchen must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Over 200 mouse droppings found in facility
summary: Over 200 mouse droppings were found in storage, bar, prep, and dishwashing areas; citation issued and pest control recommended. Food handler training had expired for staff, and one employee lacked allergen training. Menu also lacked raw-food advisory.

headline: Missing sink stoppers; no lidded trash bin
summary: The bar three-compartment sink was missing stoppers and the unisex washroom had no covered waste receptacle. Basement mop-sink room needs clutter removed, including broken TVs, and mops elevated. Washroom ceiling vents need dust cleaning.

headline: Missing handwashing sign and hair restraint lapse
summary: No hand-washing sign was at the sandwich prep sink, and a male food handler prepped food without a hair restraint or beard guard. Both were ordered fixed. A minor leak at a walk-in cooler condenser was also noted.

headline: Seal openings around pipes under sink
summary: Openings around the pipes coming out of the wall under the three-compartment sink must be sealed.

headline: Over 150 mouse droppings; wastewater in basement
summary: Over 150 mouse droppings were found under the kitchen grill and throughout the basement, not corrected from a prior visit. Pest service required before reinspection. Wastewater was also along the basement floor by the ice machine and dry goods.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and allergen certificate
summary: Hand sinks need handwashing signs. Future employees must obtain food handler certificates. No allergen certificate was on site for sanitation certificate holders; management must obtain and maintain one.

headline: Toilet room door not self-closing
summary: The toilet room door in the rear food prep area was not self-closing. It must be made to self-close and maintained.

headline: Hand sink blocked by stock; removed on site
summary: Hand sink was blocked by a bowl of chicken stock; manager had it removed immediately. Also a rear prep sink's hot water faucet is off, and a front prep cold-water paddle is missing.

headline: Fridge too warm; cream and cheese discarded
summary: Heavy whipping cream at 56.8°F to 60.0°F and cheddar at 50.6°F were held in a refrigerator at 50.9°F; about 14 lbs ($100) was discarded and the unit was tagged. Limit is 41°F. The manager also lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: Gapped doors, missing hair restraints, ceiling damage
summary: Front and rear doors had gaps allowing possible pest entry, to be sealed. Two food employees lacked hair restraints. Also water-damaged ceiling tiles and certified managers lacked allergen training certificates.

headline: Food grime buildup on shelving
summary: Shelving had a buildup of food grime. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain the shelving.

headline: Wiping cloths, cooler interiors, small faucet leak
summary: Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizing solution when not in use. Reach-in cooler interiors had food debris to clean, and a small leak at the two-compartment sink faucet must be fixed.

headline: No thermometer in dessert cooler; door gap
summary: The dessert reach-in cooler had no thermometer and must have a working one. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door sweep must be closed to make the door rodent-proof.

headline: Mold in ice machine; ice discarded on site
summary: A panel inside the ice machine that touches ice had black and pink mold-like substance. Staff discarded the ice and cleaned and sanitized the machine during inspection. A citation was issued.

headline: About 30 flies; no food handler certificates
summary: About 30 large and small flies were found in front and rear prep areas, a prior pest violation not corrected (cited). Staff had no food handler certificates, and the person in charge lacked an allergen certificate. A hole above the mop sink also needs sealing.

headline: Repeat pest violation: live roaches, mouse droppings
summary: Repeat pest violation: 3 live cockroaches and mouse droppings, about 50 to 80 per area, in four areas. More pest control is needed. Also no hand soap at a front sink and an overflowing dumpster.

headline: No drainboard; hole in women's restroom wall
summary: No drainboard was located by the three-compartment sink and must be provided. The women's accessible stall had a hole in the lower wall and missing rubber coving; both must be repaired.

headline: Unlabeled containers; grease under cooking equipment
summary: Items out of original containers lacked product-name labels. Food and grease debris were under cooking equipment, and soiled mop heads needed hanging to prevent insect breeding. Two burnt-out bulbs and walk-in fan dust also need attention.

headline: Rodent droppings found in four areas
summary: Rodent droppings were found in four areas: 30 in the drive-through, 10 by the rear door, 10 under the mop-sink shelf, and 10 by the ice machine. Pest control was on site. Fryer and floor grease also need cleaning.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate during rice, fish prep
summary: No valid original City of Chicago sanitation certificate was on site while TCS foods, such as rice and fish, were being prepared and served. The person in charge was told to keep it on site; a citation was issued.

headline: Leaking pipe under hand sink; damaged wall
summary: A leaking pipe under the handwashing area must be repaired. Rear prep wall around the ice machine has chipping paint and broken drywall, which must be resurfaced and repainted.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: The certified food manager had no allergen training certificate on site. Management was instructed that all certified managers must show proof of allergen training.

headline: No sink stoppers; damaged floor tiles
summary: The three-compartment sink had no stoppers. Damaged and missing floor tiles in the front counter, sales, and storage areas must be replaced.

headline: 30 mouse droppings and gnawed snack bags
summary: 30 mouse droppings were scattered inside boxes of chips and popcorn, and some bags were gnawed. Pest control service is required, and a citation was issued. The cook also lacked food handler training.

headline: No food handler certificates or posted manager certificate
summary: No food handler certificates were provided for any food employee, and no certified manager sanitation certificate was posted (cited). Also no written health policy (cited), managers lacked allergen proof, and a biscuit cooler's doors didn't close fully.

headline: Pooling bus tubs, worn boards, leaking faucet
summary: Bus tubs need cleaning or drainage holes to stop pooling water. Bulk containers need labels, wiping cloths need sanitizer storage, and cutting boards are worn. A first-floor hand sink leaks; floors, walls, and basement ventilation also need repair.

headline: Deeply cut cutting boards in bagel area
summary: Deeply cut cutting boards in the front bagel prep and production areas must be restored to a smooth, cleanable surface or replaced.

headline: Ice machine buildup; many foods held too warm
summary: Eleven TCS foods in the kitchen prep cooler measured 46.8°F to 55.2°F (limit 41°F); about 100 lbs was discarded. The ice machine had pink, black, and brown buildup dripping onto ice. No vomit or diarrhea clean-up procedure existed.

headline: No certified manager on site during food prep
summary: No certified food manager was on site while cheesesteaks and wings were prepared (cited). The rear employee hand sink had no paper towels, supplied during inspection. Also no pest control log book, and hood filters have grease buildup.

headline: About 30 live flying insects found
summary: About 30 live small flying insects were on walls and ceilings in the basement prep and dish areas and behind the bar; a citation was issued and more pest control is needed. A food handler also lacked a certificate.

headline: Prep cooler too warm; steak discarded
summary: Steak held at 47.8°F in the front prep cooler; 3 lbs were discarded ($30). The prep cooler measured 48.5°F, was tagged, and must be repaired. Food handlers were also prepping food without hair restraints.

headline: Grime on floors; one manager lacks allergen training
summary: Food debris and grime covered floors in rear prep and dish areas, and hood filters had grease buildup. One of two certified managers lacked allergen training. Also a torn refrigerator gasket and unused grill and fryers in the rear garage.

headline: Leaking prep sink faucet; dusty vent
summary: The rear prep sink faucet handle is leaking and must be repaired. Dust was also found on a ceiling vent above the utility closet, which must be cleaned.

headline: Gaps at rear exit door; hood grease buildup
summary: Multiple gaps at the right side of the rear exit door must be sealed to prevent possible pest entry. Grease and dust buildup under the hood system must be cleaned to prevent contamination of food and surfaces below.

headline: Greasy vent filters and floors under cooking gear
summary: Floors under and around cooking equipment were soiled and must be cleaned. Ventilation filters had grease and buildup and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Coolers too warm; 60 lbs of food discarded
summary: Cooked beans, sliced tomatoes, beef, and grated cheese were held at 54.6°F to 57.2°F in reach-in coolers, above the 41°F limit. About 60 lbs of food was discarded ($200). That cooler was tagged. Meat prep sinks lack handwashing signs.

headline: Missing health policy, training; food on floor
summary: No signed employee health policy, and some employees lack food handler training; managers lack allergen training. Food stored on rear floor must be elevated. Also debris on cooking hood, loose wall base, and chipping toilet-room paint.

headline: Mold-like substance dripping into ice; fail
summary: Black mold-like substance inside the ice machine was dripping onto ice used for drinks; the ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned (cited). Bulk ingredient containers lacked labels, and a 1/2-inch gap at the dumpster door must be sealed.

headline: Prep cooler too warm for rice and salsa
summary: Cooked rice (50°F), chorizo (47°F), and salsa (48°F) were held above the 41°F limit in the one-door prep cooler; a citation was issued. A torn gasket on a three-door prep cooler also needs replacing.

headline: Missing handwashing sink, soap, and towels
summary: No hand sink in the rear area where a new three-compartment sink was installed (cited). The prep hand sink lacked soap and paper towels, supplied during inspection (cited). Menu lacked a raw-food advisory, and food handlers lacked training.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; food handler untrained
summary: Hand sinks throughout lacked handwashing signs. A food handler had no food handler training on site. The front door is not rodent-proof, and a large hole under the rear baseboard must be enclosed. Grease under heavy equipment needs cleaning.

headline: No certified manager during pizza and wing prep
summary: No certified manager was on site while pizza and wings were prepared (cited). Single-use containers were stored directly on the rear dry storage floor. One food employee lacked a food handler certificate. Floor near the utility sink was dusty.

headline: Missing sanitizer, dish sink, and front hand sink
summary: No three-compartment sink or approved warewashing system, no chemical sanitizer on site, and no hand sink in the front bar. Also no written employee health policy, no vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit, and no pest control log.

headline: Hair restraint, expired food handler training, and grease
summary: An employee lacked a hair restraint while handling food, and food handler training had expired for employees. Wiping cloths were not in sanitizer; grocery bags were used for food storage. Grease buildup also needs cleaning.

headline: Three-compartment sink backs up; food debris throughout
summary: The three-compartment sink drains poorly and backs up into the middle compartment, which received a citation. Food debris and spills were found throughout, plus leaks under a hand sink and the warewashing sink.

headline: No vomit cleanup plan; no mop sink
summary: No procedure or kit existed for vomiting and diarrhea events; facility must develop and keep supplies. A mop sink with hot and cold water is required, and it needs a backflow preventer. The staff washroom door needs a self-closing device.

headline: Wiping cloths misstored; prep tables need cleaning
summary: Wiping cloths and sponges need proper storage: they must air dry when not in use and sit in sanitizing solution when in use. Prep tables and shelves had food debris and buildup, and the truck floors needed cleaning.

headline: Wiping cloths stored without sanitizer
summary: Wiping cloths in the rear area were kept in a bucket with no chemical sanitizer solution. The person in charge was instructed to store them in adequate sanitizer between uses.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate; expired food handler certificates
summary: No valid City sanitation certificate or certified manager was on site, and a citation was issued. All food handler certificates were expired. The basement hand sink had no paper towels, supplied during inspection (cited). Hood filters had grease buildup.

headline: No splashguard between hand sink and dump sink
summary: No washable splashguard was between the front exposed hand sink and the dump sink in the bar prep area. One must be installed to prevent contamination.

headline: Washroom door not self-closing; greasy hood
summary: The washroom door must be self-closing at all times. The kitchen exhaust hood and filters need detail cleaning to remove hanging grease buildup.

headline: No health policy; sink backs up foul water
summary: No verifiable employee health policy and no vomit clean-up kit were on site. The rear dish area had no exposed handwashing sink. The rear three-compartment sink backs up with dark, foul-smelling water, and there was no garbage contract.

headline: Rear delivery door gap; no drainboard
summary: A gap along the bottom and center of the rear delivery door must be closed to be tight fitting. The three-compartment sink in the butcher prep area also lacks a drainboard, which must be provided.

headline: Door gaps, no hair restraints, poor cooler lighting
summary: Front and rear doors had a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom that must be sealed. Employees in food prep lacked hair restraints. Also walk-in cooler lighting was very poor, and managers lacked allergen training certificates.

headline: Items stored on floor in front area
summary: Coolers and cleaning supplies were stored on the floor in the front area. The person in charge was instructed to keep items at least six inches off the floor at all times.

headline: Unlabeled containers; dusty basement floors
summary: Food storage containers lacked labels with common food names. Basement storage floors and corners had loose debris, dirt, and dust buildup; management must detail clean and increase cleaning.

headline: Cardboard in oven, milk crates, rusted grease trap
summary: Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizer between uses in prep areas. Milk crates and cardboard were used as shelf liners or elevation, including inside the oven. A rusted grease trap and grease on the grease container also need attention.

headline: Dry storage containers and spices unlabeled
summary: Dry storage containers and spices were missing labels with their common name. Management was instructed to label them and keep them labeled.

headline: No certified manager; hand sinks lacked supplies
summary: No certified food manager on site while fish tacos, burritos and beef tacos were prepared (cited). Hand sinks lacked paper towels and soap; these were supplied during inspection. Repeat issues uncorrected: floor storage and missing food handler proof.

headline: Unlabeled containers; door not rodent-proof
summary: Dry ingredient containers and squirt bottles lacked labels. The rear storage exit door and wall had gaps and openings, not rodent-proof, that must be repaired. Also a women's toilet lacked a receptacle lid, and cooking equipment tops need cleaning.

headline: Hands not washed; soap missing at prep sink
summary: Food handlers handled cash or phones, or put on gloves, without washing hands; a citation was issued. The prep-area hand sink had no soap, and an employee was sent to buy some. A fly strip hung in the prep area and must be removed.

headline: Reused crates for food; ice machine lime buildup
summary: Ice machine had lime buildup to clean. Crates once used for cilantro were reused to store various foods; only food-grade containers are allowed. A walk-in cooler door frame is torn and taped and needs repair.

headline: Uncovered food and improper ice scooper storage
summary: Food items were stored uncovered in the kitchen and storage areas, and an ice scooper was left directly on top of the ice. Food handlers prepped without hair restraints. An outside dumpster had a broken lid, which received a citation.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink faucet base
summary: Leak at the base of the three-compartment sink faucet was noted even when water is off. Manager instructed to service the leak and keep the faucet in good repair.

headline: Leaky three-compartment sink faucet, greasy hood
summary: A three-compartment sink faucet is leaking and must be repaired. The hood and filter above cooking equipment need cleaning to remove grease and debris.

headline: Tuna salad too warm; food discarded
summary: Tuna salad held at 45.6°F to 46.7°F in a deli display case; the 4.5 lbs was discarded and a citation issued. The limit is 41°F. Also no food handler certificate was on site, and a bakery handwash sink drains slowly.

headline: Labeling, cardboard, and milk crate issues
summary: Bulk basement foods need common-name labels, and grab-and-go packaged TCS foods need business name, address, ingredients, and allergen labels. Milk crates, cardboard shelf liners, and cardboard floor matting must not be used.

headline: Restroom trash can lacks lid
summary: The only issue noted: the women's restroom needed a small garbage can with a lid. The manager was instructed to provide and maintain one.

headline: Ice machine residue; food buildup on sinks, filters
summary: Pink buildup was inside the employee cafeteria ice machine and must be cleaned. Food buildup was found on prep handwash sinks, shelves, and hood filters. No allergen training certificates were on site for food managers.

headline: Items stored under dish-area hand sink
summary: Flattened cardboard boxes and other unnecessary items were stored under the hand sink in the dishwashing area. They must be removed.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; expired allergen certificate
summary: The low-temperature dish machine, not in use, showed 0 ppm chlorine in its final sanitizing rinse; it must be repaired and maintained at 50–100 ppm. No citation was issued. One certified manager had an expired allergen training certificate.

headline: Live roaches found; widespread pest activity
summary: About 5 live roaches were found in the basement lockers, walls, and main prep area behind hot cooking equipment; dead roaches were also throughout. A leaking grease container received a citation. Food debris, spills, and wall/floor holes also noted.

headline: Food handler lacked certificate
summary: One food handling employee had no food handler certificate. Management was instructed to show proof of training for all food handling employees.

headline: Knives and single-use containers stored improperly
summary: Knives were not kept in a clean, sanitized container when not in use. Single-use containers must be inverted to prevent contamination. Floors at the rear door area also need debris removed.

headline: Grease and debris on floors; dust, damaged tiles
summary: Grease, food debris, and dirt were on floors under cooking equipment, along walls, and in corners across prep, dish, storage, and basement areas. Dust was on fans, light shields and vents; floor tiles damaged in dining entrance and toilet room.

headline: Frozen fish stored in grocery bags
summary: Frozen meats and fish were stored in plastic grocery bags in the walk-in cooler and freezer; management must use food-grade bags or containers. Also no thermometer in the refrigerator near the deep fryers, and a wall corner needs repair.

headline: Food-encrusted meat slicer; wiping cloth misstored
summary: Food was encrusted on the meat slicer in the prep area and must be washed, rinsed, and sanitized. A wet wiping cloth was to be stored in sanitizer bucket when not in use.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training proof
summary: A City of Chicago food service manager on site had no proof of allergen training. Management must provide proof for all certified food service managers.

headline: Mold in cooler; soda stored on floor
summary: A cooler had a mold buildup that must be cleaned and sanitized. Two-liter soda containers were stored on the floor and must be raised six inches. A 1/4-inch gap at the front entrance door must be sealed.

headline: Ice maker lacks backflow device; leaking sink
summary: No backflow prevention device was found for the ice maker, and a small leak was under the three-compartment sink. A mop sink next to the gas stove needs a splash guard to protect food. A fryer had grease buildup.

headline: Handwashing lapses; citation issued for hygiene
summary: A food handler used hand sanitizer instead of washing, then put on gloves. After instruction she only wet and dried her hands; a citation was issued. Other handlers lacked hair restraints, and a wiping cloth sat on the counter.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; food stored on floor
summary: The bar's low-temperature dish machine, not in use, showed 0 ppm chlorine and must sanitize at 50–100 ppm. Food on basement walk-in floor must be raised six inches. Foil liners and grease buildup also need correcting.

headline: Drain buildup and floor debris could attract pests
summary: Buildup and food debris in the three-compartment sink drain must be cleaned to prevent pests and insects. Walk-in cooler and freezer floors, and floors throughout, need cleaning. The toilet room has no covered receptacle.

headline: No backflow device on ice machine; expired certificate
summary: There is no backflow prevention device on the ice machine water line; one must be provided and made visible. Grout is in poor repair at the dishwashing area. A cracked ceiling light cover is above the prep area. One food handler certificate has expired.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; $93 discarded
summary: Cold foods, including cheeses, guacamole and hard-boiled eggs, were held at 47.3-81.0F instead of 41F or below. Corrected on site: manager voluntarily discarded 31 lbs ($93). A cold holding unit was held for inspection. Allergen training proof missing.

headline: Excess freezer ice and cracked storage tiles
summary: The freezer interior had excessive ice buildup that must be removed. Missing and cracked floor tiles in the storage area must be replaced and maintained.

headline: Food on floors and cement dust; re-inspection passed
summary: Food containers stored on walk-in and freezer floors must be elevated six inches. Wood and cardboard used as equipment liners must be removed. Breaking cement walls leave dust near prep and dish areas and must be resurfaced. Grease container needs cleaning.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; floors need cleaning
summary: Milk crates are used as shelving throughout prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving six inches off the floor. Clean behind large equipment, storage racks, and between cold units and walls.

headline: No city manager certificate; citation issued
summary: The person in charge lacked a City certified manager certificate. No certified manager was posted or on site while chicken and potatoes were handled; a citation was issued. Cracked floor tiles and worn grout in prep and warewashing areas need repair.

headline: Dusty display coolers and cluttered electrical closet
summary: All four display coolers had dust and mold-like buildup inside, and vents had dust and litter. The rear electrical closet must be reorganized to prevent pest harborage. Non-working bulbs in two beverage coolers need replacing.

headline: No raw-food advisory on menus; failed
summary: Menus, including the QR code menu, lacked a consumer advisory for undercooked items such as sushi. A footnote and disclaimer are required on all menu versions. Also a torn sushi-bar cooler gasket and a dead paper towel dispenser battery.

headline: Cold foods too warm; dumpster lid missing
summary: Cheese, chicken, ham, turkey and bacon were held at 46.8-55.4F instead of 41F or below. Corrected on site: manager discarded about 8 lbs ($75). A dumpster lid is missing, leaving an opening; citation issued. Handwash signs missing at several sinks.

headline: Missing cleaning procedures; no covered receptacle
summary: A dough roller and cheese grater in the rear prep area need written cleaning procedures for cleaning in place. The all-gender toilet room lacked a covered receptacle for feminine products; one must be provided.

headline: Dry storage floor debris
summary: Floors in the dry storage area need detail cleaning to remove debris.

headline: Hair ties, wiping cloths, and dirty equipment
summary: Long hair ponytails must be tied up. Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. Worn, discolored cutting boards need replacing. Cooking equipment and first and basement floors need detail cleaning.

headline: Utensils stored lying down; allergen certificates missing
summary: Knives, spoons and forks were stored lying down in a container near the front prep microwave; they must be inverted or covered. Single-use spoons and forks were stored the same way. Allergen training certificates are missing for two employees.

headline: Unlabeled storage and grocery bags used for food
summary: Basement storage containers need common-name labels. Grocery bags cannot hold food in freezers and coolers; food-grade bags are required. Also needed: a women's restroom trash lid, paint removal above the dish area, and an allergen training certificate on site.

headline: No hair restraint; leaking sink and greasy fryers
summary: A male food handler prepared food without a hair restraint. Fryers and reach-in freezers have thick grease, food and dirt needing detail cleaning. Hot water knobs leak on the three-compartment sink, and the walk-in entrance floor is damaged.

headline: Missing handwash signs and greasy fryers
summary: Handwashing signs are needed at food prep sinks. Fryer interiors had grease and food debris. The women's restroom lacked a covered receptacle. Walls behind cooking equipment need covering, and grease-dusty vents need cleaning.

headline: Cutting boards with open seams; no sanitary bin
summary: Cutting boards in the rear prep area had open seams and dark stains; they must be refinished or replaced. The all-gender basement washroom lacked a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; no manager proof; failed
summary: The self-serve ice machine had black slime dripping onto ice. No certified manager proof, food handler training, or vomit cleanup kit was shown. The kitchen sink gave only a trickle of hot water, and there was no sanitizer test kit. The outside dumpster lid would not close.

headline: No backflow device on utility sink line
summary: No backflow device was found on the water line to the utility sink, and the manager was told to install one. The utility sink in the washroom also needs cleaning inside and out.

headline: Syrup buildup under drink machines; stained sink
summary: Cabinets under self-serve beverage and slushee machines had excessive syrup buildup. The utility sink basin was heavily stained, and the toilet room floor had heavy stains and black debris. All must be cleaned.

headline: Expired allergen training certificate
summary: The certified food manager's allergen training certificate was expired. It must be renewed and kept on site.

headline: Missing handwash signs and splash guards
summary: Handwashing signs are missing at several sinks, and splash guards are missing at sinks in the Starbucks, restaurant and bar areas. Bulk containers are unlabeled, and milk crates are used as shelving. Leaking drainpipe and faucet. Certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Cold foods too warm; flies seen; citations issued
summary: Cold foods held above 41F, including milk at 57.7F; about 50 lbs discarded. About 30 small flies seen in several areas; a window had a chewed 3-inch hole. Also missing handwash signs and expired food handler certificates.

headline: No hair restraint; items stored on floors
summary: A food handling employee was without a hair restraint while preparing food; all must wear one. Single-service articles were stored on the floor in the restroom, prep and storage areas and must be inverted and elevated.

headline: Food on walk-in floor; milk crates; rusty shelves
summary: Food containers stored on the walk-in cooler floor must be moved to raised shelving six inches off the floor. Rusty, dirty shelves in walk-in coolers need cleaning, repainting or replacing. Milk crates used for elevation must be replaced to avoid pest hiding spots.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food service
summary: The person in charge lacked a City sanitation certificate. No certified manager was on site while hamburgers, chicken tacos and pork were served; a citation was issued. Also missing handwash signs and an allergen certificate.

headline: Dirty ice bin and greasy kitchen equipment
summary: The front prep area ice bin needs cleaning inside. Heavy grease and food debris on kitchen cooking equipment and under the fryer need a deep clean and sanitizing. Walls at the dish area three-compartment sink must be deep cleaned.

headline: Missing splash guard; food on walk-in floor
summary: A washable splash guard is missing between the handwash sink and the rear three-compartment sink drainboard. Food stored on the walk-in cooler and freezer floor must be raised six inches. The rear dry storage area has clutter on the floor.

headline: No covered receptacle in female restroom
summary: The restroom for female use lacked a covered receptacle; one must be provided in all restrooms for female use. Grease buildup on the floor near cooking equipment needs cleaning.

headline: 13 live roaches found; pest control needed
summary: Inspector found 13 live roaches in the rear prep, dish and storage areas. Management was told to clean and remove all pests from affected areas. Additional pest control service is needed to eliminate the activity. No citation issued.

headline: Missing labels, no service sink, and missing trash cover
summary: Packaged spices and beans lacked labels showing business name, address, product name and net weight. No service sink for mop water; one with hot and cold water must be provided. The toilet room trash receptacle is missing a cover.

headline: Black slime in ice maker; citation issued
summary: Black slimy substance inside the ice maker was dripping into ice for human use. Management was told to shut it off, discard the ice, and clean and sanitize it. A citation was issued. Also missing handwash signage and moldy wall caulking.

headline: Wet wiping cloths and a leaking drainpipe
summary: Wet wiping cloths were on several prep surfaces and must be stored in sanitizing solution. A drainpipe under the food prep hand sink leaks. An unused hot box needs removal, and dust on the dish room vents needs cleaning.

headline: Broken walk-in threshold and loose faucet
summary: The rear walk-in cooler has a broken threshold that must be repaired. A toilet room faucet is loose. The certified food manager had no proof of an allergen training certificate.

headline: Front door gap and hole; dirty floors and toaster
summary: The front entry door has a 1/4-inch gap and a hole where the handle is missing; it must be sealed to prevent pests. Dirty toaster reach-ins, black buildup in the rear sink drain, and dirty floors need cleaning. The front handwash sink hot knob leaks.

headline: Labeling gaps, plastic bags, and grease; failed re-inspection
summary: Handwashing signs are needed in rear prep. Repackaged desserts and bulk containers need labels, and grocery bags are used for food storage in freezers. Soiled wiping cloths, damaged cutting boards, and heavy grease are also cited. Food handler training expired.

headline: Dish machine sanitizing at 0 ppm; tagged held
summary: The low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0.0 ppm and is tagged held for inspection; it must reach at least 10 ppm. A slow drain is at the women's restroom sink. Fryer cabinets, walls, vents and floors need cleaning.

headline: No certificate posted; no hair restraint; failed
summary: No City food sanitation certificate was posted, and a certified manager must be present while food is prepared. An employee lacked a hair restraint. No sanitizer test strips. Food handler certificates could not be verified; a prior violation was not corrected.

headline: Front door gap and missing vanity door
summary: The front door has a gap along the bottom that must be made tight-fitting. Crates used for food storage must be replaced with shelving; a missing vanity door needs repair. Trash outside must be cleared. No food handler training records for employees.

headline: Rodent droppings found; failed inspection
summary: About 50 rodent droppings were found in the service counter, office, prep and dish areas. Chewed bread was discarded. Food was prepared without an original certified manager certificate on site. Dumpster lids overflowing; citations issued.

headline: Cooked steak and pork too warm; $200 discarded
summary: Cooked steak at 51.5F and pork at 51.7F were in the prep cold unit, above 41F; manager discarded 25 lbs ($200). Menus lack the raw or undercooked food advisory. Bulk containers of flour, beans, peppers and sugar are unlabeled. Citation issued.

headline: Grease and food debris throughout; no utility sink
summary: Grease buildup and food debris are on cooking equipment, holding units, shelving, prep tables, coolers and freezers. No utility sink is on site; one with hot and cold water and a backflow device must be installed for wastewater.

headline: Several employees with expired food handler training
summary: Several employees had expired food handler training. All employees must complete the training, and records must be kept on site at all times.

headline: No certified manager until 9:40 AM; citations
summary: No certified manager on premises until 9:40 AM (corrected on site). Second-floor women's sink water measured 52.0F; repaired to 110.7F on site. The menu lacked the raw or undercooked food advisory asterisk and disclosure. Citations issued.

headline: Dirty floors in storage room and washroom
summary: Floors in the rear storage room and washroom need cleaning to remove spills and debris.

headline: Rat droppings found; more pest control needed
summary: Rat droppings: about 15-20 in basement prep and 6-10 by the rear exit. The person in charge cleaned them, but more pest control is needed. An employee was eating in the prep area; milk crates are used as shelving; no food handler training records.

headline: Dirty can opener, coving, and floor tile repairs
summary: The large can opener needs cleaning to remove buildup. Coving under the two-compartment sink needs repair. Missing floor tiles at the three-compartment sink area must be corrected. Hood ventilation needs grease and dust removed.

headline: Low restroom water pressure; floors need cleaning
summary: The customer toilet room has very low water pressure, which must be increased. Floors under heavy prep equipment have food and debris to clean. The certified food manager lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: Debris under rear storage shelves
summary: Some debris is under shelves in the rear storage area on the north wall and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Dusty kitchen ceiling vents
summary: Two kitchen ceiling vents need cleaning to remove dust. Floors under and around kitchen equipment need cleaning where needed.

headline: Employee eating in kitchen; missing thermometer
summary: A food employee was seen eating in the front kitchen; a designated eating area away from food is required. The basement vegetable cooler lacked an internal thermometer. The microwave door and handle are in poor repair.

headline: Damaged dumpster lids that won't close; citation
summary: Outside dumpster lids were bent or damaged and did not close tightly, which can allow rodent harborage. Lids must be repaired or replaced and kept tight-fitting. A citation was issued.

headline: Dirty ice machine bin and prep floor
summary: Ice machine bin interior and guard were dirty and must be detail cleaned. Some dirt was also seen on the rear prep area floor. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: No certified food manager certificate posted
summary: No City of Chicago food manager certificate was posted on site. The manager was instructed to keep a certified food manager and the original certificate on site at all times. A citation was issued.

headline: Heavy grease and floor damage; re-inspection passed
summary: Heavy grease on cooking equipment, walls, floors and shelving must be degreased and sanitized. The hood drips grease onto cooking equipment. Missing or damaged floor tiles, chipped paint, a ceiling hole, and a loose hand sink need repair.

headline: Loose restroom faucet and dirty microwaves
summary: The women's restroom sink faucet is loose and has low water pressure; it must be repaired. Both microwaves had food debris and grime inside and need detail cleaning. One of two certified managers lacks allergen training.

headline: Food on floor; cardboard liner; no allergen certificate
summary: Food stored on the walk-in cooler floor must be moved. Cardboard used as a liner on a basement produce room prep table must be removed. Cutting boards with open seams need refinishing. The certified manager on duty lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: No hot water at restroom handwash sink; citation
summary: The handwashing sink in the employee toilet room had no hot water; water measured 54.5F, below the required 100F. A citation was issued. A thermometer was also missing from the refrigerator holding milk and creamer.

headline: Fly trap over prep table; dead insects found
summary: An electric fly trap hangs directly over the rear prep table and must be moved away from food. Dead insects were found in the dish and bar areas. Crates and dish racks used as shelving must be replaced with raised shelving.

headline: No thermometer in pizza prep cooler
summary: No thermometer was present in the three-door reach-in cooler in the pizza prep area; one must be provided to monitor the warmest area. A torn gasket on a salad prep cooler door must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Paper towels above mop sink; boxes under equipment
summary: Paper towels mounted above the closet mop sink must be removed. Cardboard boxes stored under cooking equipment must be removed from the premises.

headline: Loose handwash sink in south washroom
summary: The handwash sink in the south washroom is loose from the wall and must be reattached.

headline: Multiple sanitation and food-safety gaps; failed
summary: Missing handwashing signs, a dirty ice bin and can opener, and no menu advisory for raw or undercooked foods. Food stored in a patio cooler and an uncovered ice bin were noted. Many cleaning and repair items were also listed.

headline: No handwash sink in dish area; failed re-inspection
summary: No handwashing sink in the rear dish and prep area; one must be installed with hot and cold water, soap and towels. Food and paper supplies must be off the floor. Also a damaged ceiling and bulbs needing shatter-proof covers.

headline: Hot foods cooling under plastic wrap; poor lighting
summary: Cooked proteins, beans and sauces were cooling covered with plastic wrap in the walk-in; they must be loosely covered or uncovered to cool properly. A heavily soiled hood and inadequate walk-in lighting must be fixed.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; greasy fryer cabinet
summary: Milk crates used as storage and shelving next to cooking equipment must be replaced with smooth, cleanable shelving. Grease buildup inside the fryer cabinet needs degreasing.

headline: Unlabeled basement containers and greasy equipment
summary: Some basement food storage containers were unlabeled and must show product names. A fryer door is missing, grease needs cleaning under the grill, and a produce walk-in floor is rusted and must be replaced.

headline: Storage, leaks, and wall holes need repair
summary: Scoops must be stored with handles inverted, and items must be elevated, not on milk crates. A dirty cooler, rusty shelves, a leaking basement sink, and wall and ceiling holes were noted. No food handler training proof was provided.

headline: Torn prep cooler gasket
summary: A torn door gasket on one prep cooler between cooking equipment must be repaired.

headline: Basement clutter; allergen training proof missing
summary: Clutter throughout the basement, including behind a door, in a meter closet and grocery storage, must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Kept items must sit at least six inches off the ground on proper shelving. Certified managers lack allergen training proof.

headline: Boxed food stored on rear prep floor
summary: Boxed food items were on the floor in the rear prep area. The person in charge was instructed to elevate all food items six inches off the floor on raised shelving.

headline: Ice machine slime; missing health policy and cleanup kit
summary: Slimy buildup inside the ice machine dripped onto ice; it was cleaned and sanitized during the inspection. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure, no signed health policy, and staff without hair restraints. Citations issued.

headline: Food on floors; unlabeled containers; failed
summary: Food is stored on walk-in cooler and freezer floors; bulk containers are unlabeled; wiping cloths are soiled; there is no splash guard by the handwash sink. Two dumpster lids are missing (citation issued). Missing and stained ceiling tiles; hood grease buildup.

headline: Live flies found in prep and dishwashing area
summary: Inspector counted 35 live flies in the rear dishwashing and prep area. Manager was told to remove them, detail clean, and call pest control. Also noted: unlabeled bulk containers, dirty prep coolers and deep freezers, and dirty floors.

headline: No employee health policy; hot water too cool
summary: No employee health policy with signed employee acknowledgments was on site. Hot water at the handwash and three-compartment sinks could not hold proper temperatures: handwash needs at least 100F, the three-compartment sink 110F. A vehicle license number is missing on one side.

headline: Prep cooler too warm; cooler tagged; leaks
summary: The prep cooler held produce at 62.0F, not 41F or below. The cooler was tagged and held, and the manager was told not to use it. Leaking pipes under the three-compartment sink, a leaking faucet base, and a broken drain. Basement floors have standing water. Citation issued.

headline: Floors need cleaning under cooking equipment
summary: Floors need cleaning around, under and behind cooking equipment to remove spills, debris and grease.

headline: Bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food; citation
summary: A food handler touched ready-to-eat tortillas with bare hands; a citation was issued. Beef held at 70.2F was voluntarily discarded (about 20 lbs, $100). Frozen meat was thawing in the prep area; the rear door has a 1/4-inch gap that must be sealed.

headline: No service sink on site
summary: There is no service sink on site. A service sink with hot and cold running water and a backflow prevention device must be installed and maintained.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; greasy fryers and ovens
summary: Bulk storage containers in the pizza prep area had no labels and must be labeled. Also instructed to clean fryer bottoms, oven interior, prep table bottoms, a can opener blade, walls and floors around equipment, and hood vents.

headline: Missing thermometer and dusty, greasy vents
summary: A visible, working thermometer is needed in the two-door cooler by the front bar. Food storage containers need proper labels. Dust on walls and vents in the dish and prep areas, and grease on the hood and filters, must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods prepared
summary: No certified food manager was present while tuna, chicken teriyaki and eggs were prepared; a citation was issued. An electric fly trap hangs over the rear prep table and must be moved. Missing handwash sign; one employee lacks food handler training; allergen certificates expired.

headline: No hot water; no handwash sink; sanitizer at 0 ppm
summary: There was no running hot water on the premises. The dishmachine final rinse had 0 ppm chlorine, a priority violation. Missing: a handwash sink in the grill area, an outside dumpster, a food-prep sink at the beverage area, restroom ventilation, and a signed health policy.

headline: Rat droppings near dumpsters; several cleaning orders
summary: Rat droppings were scattered on the ground around the garage dumpsters. Ice machine in the basement had mineral buildup to clean. Heavy spillage under the bar mixer cooler must be cleaned. One certified food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Dishmachine not working; ceiling tiles damaged
summary: The low-temperature dishmachine is not working and must be repaired or removed. The manager said utensils will be sanitized in the three-compartment sink instead. No citation issued. Also no covered trash in the women's washroom, and water-stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Soda area splatter; deeply grooved cutting board
summary: The area under the front self-serve soda dispenser needs detail cleaning of soda and juice splatter. A large cutting board has deep grooves and stains and must be replaced. The walk-in freezer floor needs detail cleaning, and front vents are dusty.

headline: Missing drawer cooler thermometer; greasy hood and fryers
summary: The grill line drawer cooler lacks an internal air thermometer. Deep fryer interiors are heavily soiled with grease and dust. The outside grease receptacle is heavily soiled, and the hood drips grease onto food-contact surfaces. Customer washroom lighting is too dim.

headline: Dish area shelving and drains need cleaning
summary: Rear dish area shelving needs detail cleaning. Drains there have heavy buildup that can attract pests and must be cleaned. Floors and walls in the rear food prep area need deep cleaning of grease, dirt and food debris.

headline: Ice machine calcium buildup; no allergen training
summary: The ice machine interior had calcium buildup; the manager was told to clean it. Rusted, old cutting boards in the basement should be discarded. A certified food manager has no food allergen training, and the manager was told to comply.

headline: Burnt-out light fixtures in prep areas
summary: Burnt-out light fixtures were found at preparation areas and must be fixed.

headline: Flies and worm-like insects in drain; failed
summary: About 40 live small flies on walls and in a floor drain, with worm-like insects wriggling in drain water in the south toilet room. Four to five large flies flew in storage and sales areas. Pest control recommended; no vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure.

headline: Handwash sink blocked by storage; citation issued
summary: The handwashing sink behind the front prep area was blocked and used to store glassware and utensils; a citation was issued. One employee lacked a food handler certificate. Missing ceiling tiles, burnt-out bulbs, and heavy hood grease were also noted.

headline: Food on floors; no hair restraints; re-inspection passed
summary: Food and sheet trays are stored on floors in rear prep and dish areas. Food handlers were without hair restraints. Several cold-holding units lack thermometers. Grease on cooking rails and floors needs cleaning; one sink has weak cold-water pressure.

headline: Mouse evidence still found; failed re-inspection
