summary: Evidence of mice was still found in storage rooms, the walk-in cooler, kitchen floor and prep tables; all droppings must be cleaned. Detail cleaning of kitchen, dining and storage areas is needed, vents must be serviced, and food handler training proof is required.

headline: No certified manager while hot foods served; failed
summary: No certified food manager was on duty or certificate posted while foods such as taquitos and hot dogs were served. Also missing: signed employee health policies, a pest control log, and food handler training records. Citations issued.

headline: Wiping cloths, leaks, and missing food handler certificate
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution. To-go containers were not inverted. A leak under the middle prep area handwash sink must be fixed. A food handler on site had no certificate and must obtain one.

headline: Dusty display cooler vent; floor drain
summary: Dust and dirt on the display cooler ventilation unit must be cleaned. The floor drain under the espresso machine needs cleaning.

headline: Uninverted single-service items; missing tank cover
summary: Single-service containers and lids were not inverted in the front prep area. Ice buildup is inside the walk-in freezer. Spills are in cabinets under the beverage area. The women's washroom toilet tank cover is missing. A certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Rusty shelves and crumbling walls
summary: Rusty shelves in reach-in coolers, basement and outside storage must be replaced with smooth, cleanable shelving. Grease and food debris behind the cooking line must be cleaned. Walls behind freezers crumble, and the ceiling is broken above the coolers.

headline: Sink drainpipe too short; causes backsplash
summary: Passed. The drainpipe at the 3-compartment sink needs to be lengthened to prevent backsplash into the drain basket. Operator instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: About 60 live flies; no allergen certificates
summary: Failed. About 60 small black live flies found in rear dry storage, prep areas, and on the 3-compartment sink; citation issued. Soiled towels stored in toilet room. Crumbling drywall under 3-compartment sink. No allergen certificates for managers.

headline: Live flying insects; slimy ice machine; no manager
summary: Failed. About 40 live small flying insects found on basement walls and ceiling; citation issued. Ice machine interior had slimy buildup dripping into ice used for consumption. Food buckets stored on walk-in floors. No certified manager on site.

headline: Missing cleanup kit, backflow device, and ventilation
summary: Conditional pass. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site, though written procedures exist. Also: no backflow device on rear ice machine, no handwashing signs, no thermometers inside reach-in coolers, no covered waste can or working ventilation in restroom.

headline: Soap at wrong sinks; missing signs and thermometers
summary: Passed. Hand soap was at the bar 3-compartment and dump sinks; must be moved to handwashing sinks only. Handwashing signs missing at bar and kitchen sinks. Cooked wings were covered with plastic wrap while cooling. Two cold units lack thermometers.

headline: Hand sinks lacked towels; supplied during visit
summary: Conditional pass. Hand sinks in front prep and dishwashing areas had no hand drying towels; person in charge supplied paper towels during inspection. Citation issued. Also: ineffective hair restraints, food debris on oven exteriors, and dried food debris on floors.

headline: 15+ live flies; no certified manager on duty
summary: Failed. Over 15 live small flies on walls and ceiling in prep area. No certified food manager on duty while food was prepared; citation issued. Ice machine has brown-yellow buildup dripping into ice, which must be discarded.

headline: No grease trap; unused equipment piled up
summary: Passed. No grease trap at the 3-compartment sink; instructed to install one. Two 2-door refrigerators are filled with unused equipment, and large unused equipment sits between the rear wall and walk-in freezer. Remove it to prevent pest harborage.

headline: No valid food sanitation certificate on premises
summary: Conditional pass. Person in charge lacked a valid City of Chicago Food Service Sanitation Certificate, and none was posted on premises. Also: broken toilet tank top, pooling water at 3-compartment sink, and personal items stored on dry food shelving.

headline: Cleaning, clutter, and wiping cloth storage issues
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizer when unused, and soiled towels were scattered rather than kept in a container. Shelves, cooking equipment, floors under shelves, and the can opener need detail cleaning. Rear storage has clutter to remove.

headline: Black mold, cardboard repairs, and no training proof
summary: Failed. Black mold on wall behind water conditioner at dish machine. Cardboard used as repair inside front fruit cooler and raw wood under dish machine; both are prohibited. Cook-line cooler has excessive food spillage. No food handler training proof provided.

headline: No health policy, vomit procedure, or allergen certificates
summary: Conditional pass. No employee health policy found. No vomit and diarrhea procedure or spill kit on hand. No allergen training certificates found. All items must be provided.

headline: No consumer advisory on menu for raw foods
summary: Failed. Menu lacked a consumer advisory for animal foods that can be ordered raw or undercooked, such as hamburgers, steak, and mesano meso. Citation issued. Dry ingredients in unlabeled kitchen containers; must be labeled.

headline: Foods above 41°F, no certificate, no pest logbook
summary: Failed. No food sanitation certificate posted while sandwiches and coffee were served; citation issued. Ham, hummus, and cheeses at 46-49°F in prep cooler; prep cooler air 48°F. Dish machine final rinse was 161°F; must exceed 180°F. No pest control logbook on premises.

headline: Live roaches, rat droppings, and fruit flies found
summary: Failed. Found 2 live roaches on a 1st-floor prep shelf, 15-18 rat droppings in the basement, and 20-25 fruit flies at the front beverage station. Earlier cooking equipment, floor, and leak issues not corrected. Pest control instructed; citation issued.

headline: Dead insects, food on floors, non-food containers
summary: Failed. Dead insects found on floors in both boiler rooms and an unused dining area. Food containers stored on floor in walk-in cooler and prep areas. Salsa, chicken, and soup held in non-food-grade containers. Earlier mop sink hole not fixed; citation issued.

headline: Unsafe cold food discarded; handsink water too cool
summary: Failed. Tuna salad at 51°F, chipotle chicken at 49°F, and milk at 45-46°F were discarded. Hot foods prep handsink measured 74°F; must provide at least 100°F. Dish machine lacked a chlorine test kit. Men's restroom faucets shut off too quickly; must run at least 15 seconds.

headline: Hot water missing at sinks; raised on site
summary: Failed. No hot water at several sinks. Person in charge raised boiler temperature to 100°F at handsinks and 111°F at 3-compartment sink during inspection. Bar 3-compartment sink backs up; stop using it until fixed. Citation issued. Rear faucet also leaks.

headline: Gloves not changed; no soap; repeat violations
summary: Failed. Employee wore gloves while prepping and opening the walk-in cooler, then continued without changing gloves or washing hands; citation issued. No soap at dish area handsink; citation issued. Earlier violations not corrected: floor storage, dirty wiping cloths, hood grease.

headline: Missing thermometers; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: Passed. Refrigeration units in basement dry storage lack an internal thermometer. Bulk containers on kitchen prep table lack labels. Burnt-out bulbs above kitchen prep tables must be replaced.

headline: Rat droppings, live flies, no food manager present
summary: Failed. About 30 or more rat droppings and 4 live big flies found, including on floors and in dining area. No certified food manager on site while food was prepared. Handsinks had no hand towels; employee supplied paper towels.

headline: Dead roaches found; no certified manager on site
summary: Failed. About 15-20 dead cockroaches found beneath cooking equipment, beneath the coffee-bar ice hopper, and in salad bar cabinets. No certified manager on site at arrival; one arrived about 20 minutes later. Citation issued. Expired allergen certificate; floors heavily greasy.

headline: Rear screen door needs rodent-proofing
summary: Passed. Rear exit screen door is not rodent-proof while the outer door is left open for heat. Must rodent-proof it whenever the outer door is open. Also instructed to clean freezer interior, walk-in shelves, and floors and walls around equipment.

headline: Leaking faucets; greasy hot holding equipment
summary: Passed. Three-compartment sink faucets leak. Filtering equipment, drink dispenser nozzles, and hot holding equipment need detail cleaning. Missing wall tiles under the sink and floor needs regrouting. Rear storage has unnecessary items to remove.

headline: Plates stored upright; torn cooler gasket; dirty hood
summary: Passed. Serving plates on prep-area shelves were not inverted; must invert to prevent dust. Torn rubber gasket on a service prep cooler door needs repair or replacement. Exhaust hood at kitchen prep area needs cleaning.

headline: Dirty ice machine; all ice discarded
summary: Failed. Black dirt buildup inside the ice machine was dripping into ice used for consumption. All ice was voluntarily discarded; machine must be cleaned by re-inspection. Also: dusty cooler condensers, broken handsink caulking, peeling ceiling paint above prep table.

headline: Leaking 3-compartment sink drain; sealing needed
summary: Passed. Left basin drain of the 3-compartment sink leaks and cannot hold water; must be repaired or replaced. Handsink near utility sink lacks adequate seal to wall. Can opener assembly is heavily soiled and needs cleaning or replacement.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; no allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Rear toilet room needs a handwashing sign. A stained cutting board at the prep cooler must be cleaned or replaced. Rear storage floors need cleaning. No allergen training certificate was available for review.

headline: Missing handwashing sign at dishwashing sink
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign was found at the handsink in the dishwashing area. Operator must provide one.

headline: Warm food discarded; certified manager arrived late
summary: Failed. Eggs, chicken, shrimp, and rice held at 58.7-70.5°F; 75 lbs (about $315) discarded. No certified manager on site when eggs were cooking; manager arrived halfway through (citation). Frozen egg rolls thawed on dry shelf at 41.9°F.

headline: Cooler in customer path; faulty 3-compartment sink
summary: Failed. Prep cooler sits in the customer walk-through area near the ice machine; manager told to lock it to prevent contamination. The 3-compartment sink malfunctions; draining one compartment fills another. Citation issued. Toilet room floor-wall holes must be sealed.

headline: Shrimp thawed on counter; sink stoppers missing
summary: Passed. Bags of frozen shrimp were thawed on the countertop, which is not an approved method; instructed to thaw per the health code. No sink stoppers on the 3-compartment sink. Exterior of prep coolers is greasy and not clean.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths; grocery bags hold food
summary: Passed. Soiled wiping cloths were left on counters and prep tables in smoothie and rear food prep areas. Corn and beef were stored in grocery bags in coolers; only food-grade bags or containers are allowed.

headline: Missing vomit cleanup procedure and several repairs
summary: Conditional pass. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure on premises. Side exit door has a 1/2-inch gap that must be rodent-proofed. Also: torn cooler gasket, dirty cooler, broken sink stopper, wall holes, missing light covers, no allergen certificate.

headline: Cardboard liner and crate storage must be removed
summary: Passed. Cardboard was used as a liner under the 3-compartment sink; instructed to remove it. Crates were used to store chemicals; instructed to remove them and provide shelving at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: 100+ mouse droppings; no certified food manager
summary: Failed. About 100 or more mouse droppings found in several areas. No certified food manager on duty while food was prepared. Eggs held at 52-59°F and discarded. Employee touched garbage, then handled food without changing gloves or washing hands.

headline: Dirty ice machine; expired food handler certificate
summary: Passed. Ice machine bin and interior guard were dirty and must be detail cleaned. Coffee debris and spills were on front prep counters. One food handler had an expired certificate; must renew it.

headline: Bulk food in customer area; faulty sink faucet
summary: Passed. Bags of bulk food were kept where customers can access them; instructed to keep food and utensils out of customer reach. The 3-compartment sink faucet is in poor repair and does not switch properly between sprayer and sanitizer; repair instructed.

headline: Cool handsink water; repaired on site
summary: Conditional pass. Handwashing sink water measured 83.5-88°F, below the required 100°F; sinks were repaired on site to 108°F. Citation issued. Hood light replaced on site. Expired food handler certificates; no allergen training proof for certified manager.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Passed. Expired food handler training certificates were on site. Expired allergen training certificate was found for certified food managers. Current certificates must be provided.

headline: Grocery-bag food storage; unfinished wood shelves
summary: Passed. Food was stored in grocery bags in coolers and freezers; must use food-grade containers. Unfinished wood shelving must be replaced or sealed. Large pots don't fit the dishwasher; need a washing procedure or removal. Hood filters heavily greased.

headline: Ceramic cups, broken toilet lid, food debris
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Ceramic drinking cups were found; must be lead-free or lead-safe with documentation kept on site, or removed. Women's bathroom toilet tank cover is broken. Heavy food debris and loose vegetables are on the walk-in cooler floor.

headline: Shrimp thawed at room temperature; manager instructed
summary: Passed. Inspector saw shrimp thawing by being left out at room temperature, which is not an approved method. Manager was instructed to thaw it under cold running water or in a cooler.

headline: Front door sweep broken; food handler training needed
summary: Passed. Front entrance door has a broken bottom sweep; it must be replaced to rodent-proof it. Also: grease under fryers, dirty floors under cooking equipment, dusty fans and vents, water-stained ceiling tiles, and food handler training certificates must be on premises.

headline: Grease and food debris; allergen training missing
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Grease and food debris built up on cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, freezers, and shelving; manager instructed to clean. Soiled mop head must be hung to prevent insect breeding. Manager lacked allergen training certificate.

headline: Mouse droppings, rodenticide, and unsafe food temperatures
summary: Failed. Over 20 mouse droppings found, including a dead mouse on a glue board in electrical room. Over 40 open rodenticide packets were on the sales-floor floor. Hot ground beef at 108.9°F and cold deli foods at 45-50°F discarded.

headline: Peeling paint and missing wall tile
summary: Passed. Paint is peeling on the wall around the mop sink. A wall tile is missing between the walk-in freezer and handsink. Both must be repaired to be smooth and easily cleanable.

headline: Unsafe cold food; no handsink; no training
summary: Failed. About 15.5 lbs of cold foods were held at 45.7-69.8°F and discarded; a reach-in cooler at 46.8°F is tagged held for inspection. No handsink in drink prep area. No food handler or allergen training. Sanitizer test kit missing.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; rear door gap
summary: Passed on re-inspection. White bulk ingredient containers lack labels with the common name. Rear exterior door to dumpster has a 1/2-inch gap at the bottom; must be made tight-fitting.

headline: Pink residue in ice machine; soiled fan guards
summary: Passed. A small amount of pink residue was found inside the ice machine panel. White chalky soil covers fan guards in the basement walk-in cooler. Cleaning was instructed for both.

headline: Over 30 live flies; salsa held too warm
summary: Failed. Over 30 live small flies found on walls and ceiling in rear prep and warewashing areas; citation issued. Salsa held at 49-52°F in prep cooler was discarded. Cooked rice, chicken, and pork lacked discard dates.

headline: Syrup spills under bar counter
summary: Passed. Syrup spillage was found under the bar counter. Inspector instructed the operator to increase cleaning frequency to prevent pests.

headline: No certified manager on site; no training proof
summary: Conditional pass. No certified food manager was on site while perishable foods were prepared; citation issued. Person in charge lacked the certificate. No food handler training proof or allergen certificates were provided. Leaks under sink piping must be repaired.

headline: Missing prep sink; food stored on floor
summary: Passed on re-inspection. No prep sink in first-floor prep area; one must be installed. Bar handsink needs a right-side splash guard. Fish, chicken, and single-use items stored on floors; raise them 6 inches. No allergen training proof for employees.

headline: Cleaning and sanitizer issues in coolers and storage
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizer. Walk-in cooler and freezer shelves and floors need detail cleaning, including rust removal. Sales-floor reach-in coolers have food spills. Debris near the trash container and the taqueria hood vent also need cleaning.

headline: Missing thermometer, labels, and food handler proof
summary: Passed. Front prep small cooler has no thermometer. Packaged baked and chocolate goods on display lack required labels. Ice scoop stored inside ice; no proof of food handler training for required employees. Also: items not elevated off floor, cardboard fan cover.

headline: Missing signs, unlabeled bins, and dirty equipment
summary: Passed. Four handsinks lack handwashing signs. Flour and rice bins are unlabeled. Ice machine containment barrier has a large crack. Items stored on floors must be raised 6 inches. Grime on walk-in shelves. No allergen certificate for the certified manager.

headline: Leaking ice machine hose; broken walk-in base
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Employee drink without a lid was stored where chicken is prepared; a lid and designated area are required. Hose at the front ice machine is leaking. Walk-in cooler wall base is broken throughout and must be replaced.

headline: Espresso machine lacks backflow device; unshielded bulbs
summary: Passed. No backflow prevention device at the espresso machine; one must be provided where it can be serviced. Food containers were not stored inverted. Unshielded bulbs were found inside the hot holding unit and must be shielded.

headline: Expired certificates; littered alley and greasy hood
summary: Failed. Outside dumpster area and alley ground were littered with food and grease; citation issued. Food debris on prep shelves and grease on ventilation hood and filters must be cleaned. Food handler and allergen certificates have expired.

headline: Single-use items stored on floor
summary: Passed. Single-service items were stored on the floor in the storage area. Manager instructed to elevate all of them six inches off the floor.

headline: Ice machine mold; 300 lbs cold food discarded
summary: Conditional pass. Black and pink mold in ice machine; ice must be destroyed and machine cleaned. Cold foods at 44.6-73.6°F discarded (about 300 lbs, $1000). First-floor walk-in cooler at 48.6°F was tagged; corrected after repair by 8/7/2025.

headline: Beer cooler spills; food residue behind fryers
summary: Passed. Spillage was found on the interior bottoms of cold beer holding units. Food residue has built up on floors behind the fryer units. Operator instructed to clean and maintain both.

headline: No certified food manager present during food prep
summary: Conditional pass. No person in charge or food employee with certified food manager training was on site while raw chicken and sandwiches were prepared; citation issued. Ice machine panel removed, in poor repair. Employee drinks stored above clean linens.

headline: Overflowing dumpsters; food on floor
summary: Failed. Outside dumpsters were overflowing with trash so lids would not close; citation issued. Food was stored on the rear floor and must be raised 6 inches. Residue found inside the front ice machine must be cleaned.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink faucet
summary: Passed. A leak was found at the faucet of the 3-compartment sink. Operator instructed to repair it and keep it in good working order.

headline: Dusty ice hopper; insect device over supplies
summary: Passed. Stainless ice hopper at front service counter was slightly soiled with dust and needs cleaning. An insect control device hangs directly above single-service items near the rear office; it must be relocated to avoid contamination.

headline: Opening in wall under mop sink
summary: Passed. An opening in the lower wall under the rear prep area mop sink was found. Operator instructed to seal it to prevent potential pest entry.

headline: Patio door gap; ice machine backflow not located
summary: Passed. Entrance door to outdoor patio has a 1-inch gap at its base; must be made tight-fitting and rodent-proof. Backflow device on ice machine could not be located; must be provided or located. Floors need cleaning.

headline: Missing splash guard and ice bin lid
summary: Passed. Bar handsink needs a splash guard, and ice bin needs a lid. Sushi prep toaster oven interior is greasy. Basement prep has a dirty floor, water-damaged ceiling tile, and holes in wall under handsink.

headline: Greasy used-oil container outside
summary: Passed. Grease has built up on the outside of the used cooking oil container in the rear garbage area. Operator instructed to clean and maintain it in good condition.

headline: Roaches, mouse droppings, and no certified manager
summary: Failed. Five live roaches, over 50 flying insects, and over 75 mouse droppings found. No person in charge or certified food manager was present while food was prepared. Handsinks lacked soap and towels; employees did not change gloves between tasks.

headline: Door gaps, no backflow device, missing signs
summary: Passed. All doors have 1/4-1/2 inch gaps underneath and must be made rodent- and insect-proof. Mop sink in the 1st-floor bar lacks a backflow prevention device. Restroom handwashing signs are missing. Basement women's trash can has no lid.

headline: Missing backflow devices and no training certificates
summary: Failed. Repeat violations not corrected: ice and coffee machines lack backflow prevention devices. Also: mineral buildup inside front ice machine, fly strips hanging in prep areas, one of two exhaust light bulbs out, no food handler or allergen training certificates.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; raw wood floor
summary: Passed. Handwashing signage must be provided at all handwashing sinks. Raw wood floor surface behind the front counter must be sealed or painted to be smooth and easily cleanable.

headline: Over 30 live flies; dirty floor drain
summary: Failed. Over 30 live small flies found on walls, ceilings, light fixtures, and counters, including inside and crawling in a dirty floor drain under the dump sink. Floor drain must be cleaned. Pest control service recommended; citation issued.

headline: No employee health policy on site
summary: Conditional pass. No employee health policy was on site. Must provide one with a signed acknowledgment from each employee. No citation issued.

headline: Faulty cold-unit thermometers; grooved cutting boards
summary: Passed. Thermometers at both cold-holding units in the front prep area are in poor repair and must be repaired or replaced. Cutting boards with deep, dark grooves must be replaced.

headline: No hot water; 54°F dish sink; repeat violations
summary: Failed. No hot water on premises for dishwashing or handwashing; 3-compartment sink measured 54°F. Citation issued. Basement clutter and damaged stock boxes must be removed. Earlier fryer, hood, and freezer cleaning not corrected. One food handler lacked a valid certificate.

headline: Food labels, floor storage, and certificates missing
summary: Passed. Prepackaged foods in the display cooler lacked required labels. Food boxes stored on walk-in freezer floor must be 6 inches up. Grease trap exterior soiled; ice and debris on walk-in floors. Food handler certificates not provided on site.

headline: Handsink lacked hot water; fixed during inspection
summary: Conditional pass. Prep-area handsink had no hot running water, measuring 80-83.5°F. Engineer fixed it during the inspection, raising it to 104°F. All handsinks must provide water at least 100°F. Priority violation.

headline: About 10 mouse droppings; no employee health policy
summary: Failed. About 10 mouse droppings found on toilet room floor, generator, prep cooler, and behind cooking equipment. No employee health policy; citation issued. No handsink in front prep area; cold and hot holding units out of safe range.

headline: Leaking sink drain; flooded basement walls
summary: Passed. The 3-compartment sink leaks from its drain pipe onto the floor. Basement prep drywall is cut off at the bottom of walls, and the area had flooded; walls must be sealed and cleanable. Burned-out hood light must be replaced.

headline: Cold foods above 41°F; cooler at 55.5°F
summary: Conditional pass. Perishable foods held above 41°F in service coolers, including eggs, cheese, chicken, and lettuce; 10 lbs discarded. Smoothie-bar cooler at 55.5°F, not to be used until repaired. Also: cups used to scoop eggs, torn gasket, heavy hood grease.

headline: Cooling food covered; bowls stored uncovered
summary: Passed. Cooked tofu and vegetables were covered with lids while cooling in the upright cooler; must be stored loosely covered or uncovered while cooling. Bowls and lids stored uncovered and not inverted at the front counter.

headline: Certified manager lacked allergen training
summary: Passed. The certified food manager on duty did not have allergen training. Manager was told all certified managers must have it, or citations will follow.

headline: No food sanitation certificate posted; leaks
summary: Conditional pass. No valid City food sanitation certificate posted for food employees; citation issued. Ice bin interior dirty and scoop stored in ice machine. Drain pipe leaks under rear dishwashing handsink. Mop stored improperly at utility sink.

headline: Loose handsink handle in men's washroom
summary: Passed on re-inspection. The handle at the men's washroom handsink is in poor repair and loose. Operator must repair or replace it and maintain it.

headline: Handsink removed from prep line
summary: Failed. Line handsink was removed and must be reinstalled with hot and cold water. Baskin Robbins prep area has no handsink; citation issued. Boxes stored on floor must be 6 inches up. Wall holes and mop-sink opening need sealing.

headline: Beef in plastic bags; stained cutting boards
summary: Passed. Thawed beef was stored in plastic bags in a cold holding unit; must use food-grade bags or containers only. Cutting boards with open seams and dark stains must be refinished or replaced. Two hood light bulbs are burned out.

headline: Holes in rear door; missing training certificates
summary: Passed. Several small holes in the rear door allow pest access; must repair or replace. Front prep reach-in cooler has no thermometer. Food handler training certificates were not on site for non-manager employees.

headline: Broken cooler tagged; food removed before inspection
summary: Conditional pass. Rear 3-door cooler was broken and could not keep food cold. Person in charge had already removed all cold food. Cooler was tagged out. Also noted: rear door gap, wiping cloths in water, and damaged ceiling tiles.

headline: Improper food temperatures and over 20 flying insects
summary: Failed. Over 20 flying insects found at dish and bar areas. Eggs held at 44.1-69.9°F; 24 lbs discarded. Juice box stored in ice used for drinks was removed immediately. Employees drank while preparing food. Employee had no beard guard.

headline: Missing thermometer, labels, and several repairs needed
summary: Passed. Hot holding equipment needs a visible, working, accurate thermometer. Yellow bulk containers in butcher prep lack labels. Also: rust on deli cooler racks, broken 3-compartment sink stoppers, slow-draining bakery handsink, and two missing light shields over slicers.

headline: No food handler training proof
summary: Passed. No proof of food handler training was available for any food handler. Operator must provide and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Re-inspection passed; leak and cleaning issues
summary: Passed. Damp wiping cloths were left out of sanitizer at several food prep areas. A small clean-water leak was found at the 2nd-floor utility sink. Floors under cook line and warewashing equipment were soiled. Person in charge lacked allergen training.

headline: Repeat violations; missing waste lid; no training proof
summary: Failed. One of three outside waste lids missing, risking rodent harborage. Earlier violations were not corrected: no mop sink, rusted walk-in shelving, missing rear floor tiles, poor toilet-room ventilation. Also cardboard floor lining, dirty microwave, and no food handler proof.

headline: Missing handwashing sign in men's restroom
summary: Passed. The handwashing sink in the men's toilet room has no handwashing sign. Operator instructed to obtain and maintain signage.

headline: Items stored on floor; leaking handsink
summary: Passed. Plates and bowls on top kitchen shelves were uncovered; must invert or protect. Single-service items on basement stairway floor must be raised 6 inches. Handsink next to dish machine leaks from drain pipe. Basement walk-in freezer light is out.

headline: Rear door gaps; missing food handler, allergen training
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Gaps on both sides of rear door must be closed to prevent rodent entry. No food handler training or food manager allergen training was provided. Also: grease on fryers and prep tables, and a worn gasket.

headline: Pass: containers not inverted, no allergen certificate
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Food containers were not stored inverted and must be. The sanitation manager has no allergen training certificate and must provide one.

headline: Pass: many repairs, unlabeled containers, gaps
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Door gap, missing splash guard, food and single-service items stored on floor, and uncovered bulk containers. Rust, crates, cardboard liners, damaged sinks, leaking faucets, and debris on floors need repair or cleaning.

headline: Pass with conditions: hand dryers, floor drainage
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. Electric hand dryers in both restrooms were not working; the manager reset them at the panel and they now work. Front double doors have a gap. Floors need grouting and standing water removed.

headline: Pass with conditions: no manager during TCS food prep
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. No certified food manager on premises while cooked rice and chicken were prepared. Other items: missing thermometer, unlabeled bulk containers, rear door gap, torn gaskets, and a missing ice machine backflow device.

headline: Failed: no health policy, soap, or pest logbook
summary: Failed. No employee health policy on site. Several handwashing sinks lacked soap or hand drying. No pest control logbook. Also a dirty facility, uncovered dumpster, and no allergen training certificate.

headline: Pass: torn gaskets and debris; remove stored items
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Torn rubber gaskets on the bakery reach-in cooler must be replaced. Food debris is inside the bakery oven and freezer. Unnecessary items on the patio and under the stairwell must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Pass with conditions: food handler training still missing
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. A prior core violation was not corrected: a male food handler lacks proof of food handler training. Citation issued.

headline: Pass: entrance door openings must be sealed
summary: Licensed inspection passed. Openings at the base of both main entrance double doors were observed. Inspector instructed the operator to seal all outer openings to prevent pest entry.

headline: Pass with conditions: shellfish tags, unsafe coolers, sanitizer failure
summary: Passed with conditions. Shellfish tag issues led to discarded oysters and mussels; citations issued. Dish machines showed 0 ppm sanitizer; not to be used until 50 ppm. Service coolers ran 45-59F; food discarded; citations issued.

headline: Pass: all food handler cards expired
summary: Re-inspection passed. All food handler cards on site are expired. Employees must complete food handler training and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Pass with conditions: no manager during TCS food prep
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while chicken, beef, and milk were prepared and served; citation issued. Missing food handler training certificate, allergen certificate, and posted inspection summary.

headline: Pass: food truck license not visible
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The food truck's license was not posted on the sides and must be visible. Soda crates are used as shelving and must be replaced. Grease in the fryer cabinet and on floors.

headline: Pass: pink residue inside ice machine
summary: Canvass inspection passed. A small amount of light pink residue was found inside the ice machine in the rear utility area. Operator must schedule cleaning and maintain the machine.

headline: Failed: rat droppings found in basement
summary: Failed. About 50 rat droppings found in the basement, along walls, and under an opening in the rear and utility room. Operator must eliminate rat activity and remove droppings. Two customers with dogs inside; citation issued.

headline: Pass: rusted racks, stove not under hood
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Rusted storage racks in the walk-in cooler must be made smooth and cleanable. Reach-in cooler interiors need cleaning. A large one-burner stove must be moved under the exhaust hood.

headline: Failed: untagged mussels, slimy ice machine
summary: Failed. Raw mussels in a prep cooler had no shellstock tags; manager discarded them; citation issued. Black and pink slime built up inside the ice machine and dripped onto ice for consumption. Must be cleaned and sanitized.

headline: Pass with conditions: food prepared without manager
summary: Food handlers prepared TCS food without a certified manager present for 10-15 minutes. Egg mixture held at 62.0F; one quart discarded. Food stored in grocery bags. Damaged ceiling and wall near pizza oven. Citations issued.

headline: Pass: grease buildup and unused items to remove
summary: Re-inspection passed. Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables. Multi-use equipment stored in the washroom must be removed. Grease buildup on cooking equipment, coolers, and floors. Unused items to be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Failed: no pest control logbook or service contract
summary: Failed. No pest control logbook on site and no service agreement with a licensed pest control operator. The facility must provide a service agreement and keep a complete logbook available for inspector review at all times.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings near food prep
summary: Failed. About 10 rodent droppings found along the wall behind cooking equipment and on a storage container in the prepared foods area. Operator must eliminate rodent activity, clean, and contact pest control; citation issued.

headline: Pass: no food handler training, heavy clutter
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Toilet room door does not close tightly. Floor tiles under cooking equipment need repair. Massive clutter on the basement and rear hallway floor. No food handler training for employees; must be provided.

headline: Pass with conditions: expired manager certificate
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. No valid certified food manager certificate posted; the one found expired in 2021; citation issued. Other items: grease on hood, debris in bar sink, missing 3-compartment stoppers, and no allergen certificate.

headline: Pass: no restroom covered receptacles
summary: Licensed inspection passed. Missing handwashing signage at the bar sink. No covered waste receptacles inside restrooms; must be provided. Clutter in rear storage area used for to-go orders must be removed.

headline: Pass: food on floor, no handler certificates
summary: Re-inspection passed. Containers of food were stored on the floor in the second-floor storage area and must be at least 6 inches up. Food handler certifications were not provided on site.

headline: Pass: freezer ice buildup, washroom trash lids
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Ice buildup inside the basement chest freezer must be defrosted and cleaned. Employee washroom garbage receptacles lack lids. Covered trash cans must be provided in women's and unisex washrooms.

headline: Pass: cardboard liners, no food handler training proof
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Cardboard must not be used as shelf liner in the walk-in cooler. No proof of food handler training or certificates for required employees. Proof must be provided.

headline: Pass with conditions: handwashing in dish sink
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. A food handler washed hands in the three-compartment sink; citation issued. Insect sticky traps hang above food and prep areas in the butcher cooler and must be relocated. Floors near the onion storage need cleaning.

headline: Pass: kitchen floors need detail cleaning
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Inspector required detail cleaning of kitchen floors along wall bases and in corners to remove spills and debris.

headline: Failed: about 50 live flies, pest violation uncorrected
summary: Failed re-inspection. About 50 live small flies in rear prep areas above the 3-compartment sink and on walls and boxes. A prior pest violation was not corrected. Pest control service recommended.

headline: Pass: burnt-out hood light bulbs to replace
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Burnt-out light bulbs at the exhaust hood in the rear prep and dish area must be replaced to maintain adequate lighting.

headline: Pass: low water pressure in men's restroom
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Low water pressure at the men's restroom washbowl sink must be repaired or replaced. Dirt, grime, and food debris inside the microwave must be cleaned.

headline: Pass: leaking pipes under dish area sinks
summary: Re-inspection passed. Water is leaking from plumbing under the basins of the three-compartment sink in the dish area. Operator must repair the plumbing and keep it maintained.

headline: Pass: rear door gap, hood buildup
summary: Canvass inspection passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door sweep must be sealed to rodent-proof it. Food buildup on the ventilation hood and filters must be cleaned.

headline: Pass: hole in ceiling, cutting boards, no training proof
summary: Re-inspection passed. Ice machine tray needs cleaning. Wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces. Cutting boards with deep cuts and stains. Rusted grease trap lid, hole in ceiling above fryer, uneven dishroom floor, and no food handler training proof.

headline: Pass with conditions: unsafe cold food, corrected on site
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. Cold food held at 45.5-64.8F; about 61 pounds discarded; citation issued. Cold holding unit repaired on site to 39.7F. Shellstock tags lack dates; citation issued. Openings at exterior doors.

headline: Failed: no valid manager certificate, hot water too low
summary: Failed. Person in charge lacks a valid certified food manager certificate. Washroom hot water reached only 83.1F; 100F is required. Other issues include drinking from an open cup, dirty ice machine, and no food handler training proof.

headline: Pass: rear door gap, uncleaned equipment
summary: Re-inspection passed. Rear exit door not fully rodent-proofed; the 1/4-inch gap must be sealed. Equipment, coolers, and shelving have dust and grease. Broken three-compartment faucet, slow drain, and two employees with expired food handler training.

headline: Failed: restroom sink lacks hot water
summary: Restroom handwash sink water measured 55.9F, while other sinks exceeded 110F. Manager must provide at least 100F. Also a missing backflow device at the mop sink and no covered trash can in the restroom.

headline: Pass with conditions: utensils washed without sanitizer
summary: Employee washed utensils with only soap and water; the three-compartment sink was not set up with sanitizer; citation issued. After instruction, equipment was properly washed and sanitized. Other issues include foil lining and debris in drain.

headline: Pass: rear door gap and food debris
summary: Re-inspection passed. A 1/4-inch gap around the rear exit door must be sealed. Missing ice bin covers at the front bar. Plates and pots stored near hot equipment were not inverted. Food debris and spills on floors and surfaces.

headline: Pass with conditions: cooler too warm, food discarded
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. Three-door cooler measured 57.0F and was tagged out of use until repaired. About 70 pounds of TCS food at unsafe temperatures was discarded; citation issued. A rear door gap exists.

headline: Pass with conditions: torn gaskets, uncorrected advisory
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. Torn door gaskets on a freezer and refrigerator must be replaced. Damaged floor tiles, dusty vents, and dirty light shields. A prior raw food menu advisory violation was not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Failed: about 40 mouse droppings by boiler
summary: Failed. Evidence of rodent activity: about 40 mouse droppings by the boiler, 30-40 along walls and behind the cooler, and 15-20 at the main entrance. About 20 dead flies by the window. Pest control service needed.

headline: Failed: dirty ice machine, uncorrected prior violations
summary: Failed re-inspection. Dirty ice machine interior and to-go containers stored on floor. Missing ceiling tile and light shield, pooling water under the sink. Prior core violations not corrected, including soiled linens outdoors; citation issued.

headline: Pass: food stored on floor, uncleaned surfaces
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Bulk container lacked a label under the prep table. Cookies, sauces, and dips were stored on the floor and must be raised six inches. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Debris, dust, and stains.

headline: Pass: no hair restraints, dusty light shields
summary: Re-inspection passed. Employees prepared and served food without hair restraints; they must wear them at all times food is being prepared. Dust and dirt inside the second-floor prep area light shields must be cleaned.

headline: Pass: expired certificates, unlabeled to-go items
summary: Re-inspection passed. To-go clamshells lacked labels. A small gap at the screen door and grocery bags used for freezing food. Heavy grease in fryer cabinets and hood filters. Food handler and allergen certificates are expired.

headline: Pass: torn cooler door gasket to replace
summary: Canvass inspection passed. A torn door gasket was found on the two-door prep cooler under the pastry oven and register. The operator was instructed to replace it.

headline: Failed: no vomit supplies, hot water only 63F
summary: Failed. No supplies for vomit and diarrhea events; citation issued. Dish area hand sink measured 63F; must be at least 100F; citation issued. Also no sanitizer test kit and several cleaning and repair items.

headline: Pass with conditions: slimy ice machine, citation issued
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. Ice machine in prep area had black slime dripping onto ice used for consumption. The person in charge burned the ice and cleaned the ice bin during inspection; citation issued.

headline: Failed: no thermometers, damaged floors, cluttered storage
summary: Failed. No thermometers for coolers holding milk, sausages, and bacon. Missing handwashing signage, a lidless outside receptacle, broken floor tiles, cluttered rear storage, and a hole in the wall above the utility sink.

headline: Failed: over 100 flies, roaches, uncorrected priority violation
summary: Failed. Over 100 live flies and over 20 live roaches, including baby roaches, in display, prep, and dry storage areas. Numerous dead roaches found. Prior priority violation not corrected; pest control must be contacted; citation issued.

headline: Pass with conditions: roaches trapped, dishes on floor
summary: Complaint inspection passed with conditions. Hand sink blocked by stored dishes was cleared on site; citation issued. Roaches trapped on floor glue boards must be removed. Dishes on the floor, a cooler missing its lid, and cardboard used as shelving.

headline: Pass: unlabeled bulk containers, manager lacks allergen training
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Some bulk storage containers lacked product names and must be labeled. The manager on duty does not have current allergen training and must provide and maintain proof.

headline: Failed: unlabeled food, uncorrected prior violations
summary: Failed. Food in coolers and dry storage is unlabeled. Mop not positioned to dry. Expired food handler certificates. Prior core violations not corrected: pots of food on walk-in floor and greasy cooking equipment. Citation issued.

headline: Pass: broken floors in main prep area
summary: Re-inspection passed. Broken and damaged flooring was observed throughout the main prep area. Operator must repair and maintain the floors.

headline: Pass: no food handler training proof, allergen gaps
summary: Canvass inspection passed. No proof of food handler training for any handler. No certified food manager had allergen training. Documentation must be provided. A burned-out dining area light bulb must be replaced.

headline: Pass: food on floor, unlabeled containers, open door gap
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Missing thermometer in a cooler, unlabeled bulk containers, and food stored on floors. Rear door left open with a gap that could allow pests. Other issues include cracked lids and missing food handler training.

headline: Failed: rat droppings found in basement
summary: Failed. About 20 rat droppings on the basement storage floor. Ice machine has debris, and unlabeled bulk containers were found. Employee without a hair restraint, rusted racks, and a torn cooler gasket. Citation issued.

headline: Pass: wiping cloths, cutting boards, cooler debris
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizing solution. Cutting boards at the front service line need replacing. Interior of front reach-in coolers needs cleaning to remove food debris.

headline: Pass: grill grease buildup to clean
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Grease buildup was found on the lower part of the grill in the rear prep area. The operator was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Failed: flies in deli and pastry area
summary: Failed. About 3 live large flies in the deli prep area and about 3 flying inside the pastry container in customer service. Operator must eliminate flies, clean affected areas, and contact pest control; citation issued.

headline: Pass: ice buckets on floor, missing backflow device
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Ice buckets were on the floor and must be elevated. A backflow prevention device for the basement ice maker could not be located and must be installed where visible.

headline: Pass: dead roaches in basement, rear door gap
summary: Canvass inspection passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door sweep must be rodent-proofed. Dirt buildup and dead roaches on the basement floor along the walls must be detail cleaned. Food debris inside reach-in coolers.

headline: Pass with conditions: no spill kit, unlabeled containers
summary: Complaint inspection passed with conditions. No vomit spill kit; citation issued. Handwashing sign is unreadable. Flour and sugar containers unlabeled. Walk-in cooler curtains torn and partly replaced with garbage bags.

headline: Pass: frozen food thawed in sink, leaking faucet
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Packages of frozen food were thawing in the two-compartment sink. Operator must thaw with cold running water or in refrigeration. A leaking faucet at the sprayer sink must be repaired.

headline: Failed: slimy ice machines, cooler at 50F
summary: Failed. Thick black slime in all three ice machines dripped onto ice; machines must not be used until cleaned, and ice was discarded. Pizza cooler held food at 50-51.2F; 55 pounds discarded. Rear door gap found.

headline: Failed: no manager during TCS food, flying insects
summary: Failed. No certified food manager present while rice at 140F was prepared and served; citation issued. About 25 small flying insects on walls and ceiling in dish and prep areas. Several food handlers lack certificates; citation issued.

headline: Pass: damaged cooler gaskets, worn cutting boards
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Cooler door gaskets in the rear storage area are damaged or missing and must be repaired or replaced. Cutting boards throughout the kitchen have deep gouges and must be replaced.

headline: Pass: unlabeled food and food on floor corrected
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Walnuts and other items were found outside original labeled containers. Food was stored on the prep floor and must be raised six inches. Soiled mop heads were not hung. No allergen training on site.

headline: Pass: ripped cooler door gaskets
summary: Re-inspection passed. Some prep area cooler door rubber gaskets are ripped. The manager must repair or replace all damaged gaskets.

headline: Pass: rear mop sink in disrepair
summary: Re-inspection passed. The rear utility mop sink is in disrepair and must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Pass: many maintenance and labeling items
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Items include missing handwashing signage, thermometers, food labels, rusty racks, and cooler cleaning. Also a slow drain, missing trash lid, dusty vents, ceiling tiles, and expired food handler and allergen certificates.

headline: Failed: about 40 live flies, uncorrected violation
summary: Failed. About 40 live flies scattered on walls, ceiling, and boxes in the rear prep area. Operator must clean affected areas and call pest control; citation issued. Prior allergen training violation was not corrected.

headline: Pass with conditions: low pressure, uncorrected allergen training
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. Front hand sink has low pressure and must be repaired. A prior core violation was not corrected: food allergen training for managers. Citation issued.

headline: Pass: ice buildup and freezer debris
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Ice buildup on the outside of boxed food in the rear walk-in freezer must be removed. Food debris on the bottom shelf of a produce prep freezer must be cleaned.

headline: Pass: unlabeled items, missing food handler certificates
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Multiple unlabeled items, staff without hair restraints, wiping cloths on the counter, and crates on the floor. Dirty walls and floors, lighting out, and no food handler certificates for staff.

headline: Pass: fryers, grill, and floors need cleaning
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Torn gasket on the two-door prep cooler. Instructed to clean fryers, grill, prep table, cooler and freezer interiors, and floors around equipment, the washroom floor, and the washroom vent fan.

headline: Pass: floor grout, missing training proof
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Floors in the main cooking area need grout to be smooth and cleanable. No proof of food handler training or allergen training for the certified food manager was available on site.

headline: Pass: entrance door gap, cluttered sprinkler room
summary: Canvass inspection passed. No thermometer in the staff refrigerator. Front entrance doors have a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom center. No covered waste receptacle in the second-floor restroom. Sprinkler room is cluttered and must be cleaned.

headline: Pass with conditions: no vomit spill kit
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. No vomit and diarrhea spill kit with sanitizer; citation issued. Missing handwashing signs at two hand sinks. Missing fan shield and burnt light fixture in walk-in cooler. No allergen training for sanitation manager.

headline: Failed: flies, mold in ice machines, no sanitizer
summary: Failed. About 30 live small flying insects and 15 house flies found in basement and first-floor prep areas; more pest control needed. Mold-like growth in all three ice machines. Dish machine had no sanitizer. Citations issued.

headline: Pass: forks uninverted, no sink stoppers
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Forks and wooden spoons were not inverted in the rear prep area. No sink stoppers for the three-compartment sink. Unused items were stored at the rear exit door and must be removed.

headline: Failed: no health policy, sink and backflow issues
summary: Failed. No signed employee health policies. The 3-compartment sink is too small for the largest equipment. Missing backflow devices, no grease trap at the 3-compartment sink, and no food allergen training for the food manager.

headline: Pass: floor drain debris, ventilation malfunction
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Excess food debris in the dry storage floor drain must be cleaned. Mechanical ventilation in the women's restroom is malfunctioning and must be repaired.

headline: Pass: unisex restrooms need covered receptacles
summary: Licensed inspection passed. No covered receptacles were in the unisex restrooms. The person in charge was instructed to provide and maintain them.

headline: Pass: mold-like caulking, stairwell debris
summary: Re-inspection passed. Heavy black mold-like substance on caulking at the base of the warewashing unit must be replaced. Walls of the basement stairwell have debris and must be cleaned.

headline: Pass: detail cleaning and defrosting required
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Operator must detail clean coolers, shelving, counters, and bins in the front prep area, defrost and clean walk-in freezers, and clean the walk-in produce cooler.

headline: Pass: stained boards, slow drain, hood cleaning
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Stained cutting boards in front and rear prep must be resurfaced or replaced. Ice dispenser, nozzles, and drip tray at the fountain need detail cleaning. Slow-draining sink and hood interior need attention.

headline: Pass: leaking three-compartment sink
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The pipe elbow of the middle three-compartment sink and the rinse sink gasket are leaking and must be repaired. An air vent in the toilet room is hanging loose.

headline: Pass with conditions: milk shake cooler corrected on site
summary: Milk shake cold holding unit measured 65.3F and was corrected on site with a hold tag. Missing handwashing signage, an opening at the rear exit door, cardboard liners, and a pickle bucket on the walk-in floor.

headline: Pass: cutting boards need replacement, drain cleaning
summary: Licensed inspection passed. Wooden and plastic cutting boards have deep grooves and stains and must be replaced. Floor drain at the coffee station needs detail cleaning to prevent possible insect activity.

headline: Pass: weak hot water, missing thermometer
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Weak hot water pressure at the front handwash sink must be provided at adequate city pressure. A thermometer is missing from the grab-and-go cooler and must be provided.

headline: Pass: pink residue in ice machine, debris on floors
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Pink or blackish substance found inside the ice machine, which must be cleaned. Water-stained kitchen ceiling tiles must be replaced. Mop stored in bucket instead of hung. Floor corners and equipment areas need cleaning.

headline: Failed: no soap, paper towels, or health policy
summary: Failed. No employee health policy. Handwash sinks lacked soap and paper towels. Very low hot water pressure at the 3-compartment sink, a leaking drain, a 1/4-inch front door gap, and no allergen certificate.

headline: Pass: unlabeled bulk containers, dish room grime
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Bulk containers in non-original packaging lack common name labels. A rusted prep table in the bar must be repaired. Grime on the dish room floor under equipment and food debris in the floor drain must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: no vomit supplies, no sanitizer test kit
summary: Failed. No supplies for vomit and diarrhea events; citation issued. No chemical test kit for sanitizer; citation issued. Food handlers without hair restraints, soiled wiping cloths on prep table, uninverted single-service items, and a leaking drainpipe.

headline: Pass: grease buildup and dirty cooler surfaces
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Grease buildup on cooking equipment, walls, floors, and shelving. Walk-in cooler interior, fans, and vents need cleaning. Chipped, water-damaged basement ceiling paint and peeling baseboard need repair.

headline: Pass: one food handler lacks training proof
summary: Canvass inspection passed. One female food handler did not have proof of food handler training. Must meet the requirement within 90 days of hire.

headline: Pass with conditions: no handwashing, cooler temperatures
summary: Suspected food poisoning complaint. Handlers did not wash hands between tasks; citation issued. Garlic and red sauces reached 46.6-50.1F; about 30 pounds discarded. Cooler at 41.2F. Two rear doors have gaps.

headline: Passed; clutter and peeling ceiling paint
summary: Passed. Clutter in the employee washroom could attract rodents and must be removed. Paint was peeling on the ceiling above the refrigerators, and dirt and debris were under the 3-compartment and utility sinks.

headline: Conditional pass; no certified manager, no health policy
summary: Passed with conditions. No City certified food manager was on site while sliced turkey and creamed cheese were served, and a priority citation was issued. No employee health policies were on site for food handlers.

headline: Failed; about 100 mouse droppings on food surfaces
summary: Failed on re-inspection. About 100 mouse droppings were found across the facility, including on food prep tables and wrapped clean plates. No live roaches were seen. A priority citation was issued, and pest control service is recommended. Grease and dirt were also noted.

headline: Passed; food handler without hair restraint
summary: Passed. A male food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. The person in charge was instructed to wear one and maintain it.

headline: Re-inspection passed; coffee machine backflow not verified
summary: Passed on re-inspection. The coffee machine waterline could not be accessed, so the backflow prevention device could not be checked.

headline: Re-inspection passed; condensate drains into handsink
summary: Passed on re-inspection. A coffee machine drain line discharged condensate into a handwashing sink basin and must be rerouted to the sewer. Front dining area restroom ventilation was not working and must be repaired.

headline: Passed; uncovered salsas and food stored on floors
summary: Passed. Salsas were uncovered in the walk-in cooler, food containers sat on floors, Styrofoam cups were used as dipping utensils, and both rear exit doors had gaps of about 1/4 inch. No pests were reported.

headline: Failed; no health policy, cooler temperatures too warm
summary: Failed. No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure was on site, and priority citations were issued. The walk-in cooler and a bar cooler measured 55.9°F, above 41°F. Other issues include no food handler or allergen certificates and a 1/2-inch side door gap.

headline: Passed; foil shelf liners and dirty walls
summary: Passed. Foil was used as shelf liner in the front prep area and must be removed. Clutter was on the toilet room floor, and food splatter was on walls. Dirt was found on floors, walls, and corners.

headline: Passed; dirty floors and no allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Loose debris, dirt, and dust were found on floors and corners throughout the facility, and cleaning frequency must increase. No allergen training certificate was shown for the certified food manager.

headline: Passed; cold units lack thermometers, opening by rear door
summary: Passed. The cold holding units have no ambient air thermometers. An opening at the bottom right of the rear first-floor exit door must be rodent-proofed. An ice scoop was stored on a shelf, and lighting in the meat prep area is inadequate.

headline: Re-inspection passed; unlabeled bulk food, greasy equipment
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Bulk containers in prep were unlabeled, and food was stored on the floor or uncovered in prep and storage areas. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables. Grease, spills, and debris were on cooking equipment, coolers, and freezers.

headline: Passed; cardboard shelving, pink buildup in ice machine
summary: Passed. Cardboard was used as shelving in the dry goods area and must be removed. Pink buildup was found inside the ice machine and must be cleaned.

headline: Conditional pass; no certified manager while food prepared
summary: Passed with conditions. No City certified food manager was on the premises while pizza and pasta were prepared and served, and a priority citation was issued. Fan guards are dusty, and a light shield is needed above the pizza prep area.

headline: Passed; three-compartment sink not labeled
summary: Passed. The three-compartment sink was not labeled with wash, rinse, and sanitize for each compartment. The person in charge was instructed to label it.

headline: Failed; flies throughout, oysters lacked shellstock tags
summary: Failed. Fresh oysters and clams lacked shellstock tags, and a priority citation was issued. About 30 small flies were seen in the bar and first-floor prep area. The low-temperature dish machine wash water measured 106°F, below 120°F.

headline: Passed; exposed copper pipe along floor
summary: Passed. A copper utility line runs along the floor near the service window. The manager was told to keep the pipe from being exposed unnecessarily and off the floor.

headline: Conditional pass; hot handwash water too cool, now fixed
summary: Passed with conditions. Hot water at the men's restroom handsink measured 76.5°F, below the required 100°F. A hotel technician arrived during the inspection, and all sinks now measure 100-105°F.

headline: Passed; no covered restroom receptacle, floor debris
summary: Passed. The women's restroom had no covered receptacle. Debris was on the rear prep area floor beside the ice machine and rolling racks.

headline: Conditional pass; no health policy, repeat allergen violation
summary: Passed with conditions. No verifiable employee health policy was on site, and a priority citation was issued. A repeat allergen training violation from 2024 was not corrected. Clay cups without food-safe marking were used, and an unlabeled sugar container and a foul odor were noted.

headline: Passed; ice machine and gasket issues
summary: Passed. The interior top of the rear ice machine must be cleaned. A two-door refrigerator gasket is in poor repair and must be replaced. The hot water knob leaks at the base.

headline: Failed; about 60 mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. About 60 mouse droppings were found under storage racks, grocery shelves, and cabinets. A priority citation was issued, and pest control service is needed. Rust, clutter, and burnt-out bulbs were also noted.

headline: Passed; broken faucet lever, grease buildup
summary: Passed. The rear employee handwashing sink faucet has a broken lever but still works. Grease and dust were found on hood filters, nearby walls, and ceiling tiles.

headline: Passed; walk-in freezer leak and grease trap odor
summary: Passed. Ice buildup was on the condenser inside the walk-in freezer, and the leak source must be found. A grease trap odor was noted and it must be cleaned. Floors under walk-in shelving need cleaning.

headline: Failed; vomit kit missing, openings and grease
summary: Failed. Items needed for vomit and diarrhea response were not on premises, and a priority citation was issued. Menu advisories were incomplete. Openings were found at the front door, exterior dry storage, and the grease container lid. Damaged gaskets, grease, and ice buildup were also noted.

headline: Failed; dish machine wash water too cool
summary: Failed. Wash solution in the high-temperature dish machine measured 137°F, below the required 150°F, and a priority citation was issued. The men's employee handsink lacks a cold water knob, and the women's employee washroom has no covered receptacle.

headline: Passed; food buildup in coolers and cabinets
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Coolers, door gaskets, storage shelves, and cabinets under the breakfast buffet had excessive food buildup. An eye wash station was connected to a handwashing sink faucet and must be removed. Walls and drains need cleaning.

headline: Failed; about 30 mouse droppings in basement
summary: Failed. About 30 or more mouse droppings were found in the basement storage and prep area, including under the food prep table and inside the chemical storage closet. A priority citation was issued. Debris and grime were also noted.

headline: Failed; mouse droppings and live flies found
summary: Failed. About 50 mouse droppings were found on floors near the rear storage racks, and 10-12 live small flies were seen in the prep and dishwashing area. A pest control service and a citation were required. Urinals were not working.

headline: Conditional pass; no soap at dish handsink, corrected
summary: Passed with conditions. No hand soap was at the dishwashing handsink, and a priority citation was issued. Soap was provided by the end of the inspection. Food containers were not stored inverted, and the mop sink faucet lacks a backflow device.

headline: Passed; unlabeled food, clamped ceiling tile
summary: Passed. Food containers in the rear cooler and prep area lacked common-name labels. Utensils were improperly stored, and the grease trap needs cleaning. The women's washroom has no covered feminine-product receptacle, and a ceiling tile above food prep is held with clamps.

headline: Passed; no hair restraints, dirty fryers and racks
summary: Passed. Employees in food prep were not wearing hair restraints. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer in the cooking area. Fryer interiors, walk-in storage racks, and floors under cooking equipment were dirty.

headline: Passed; gap at south exit door, no receptacle
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap was found at the bottom left corner of the south exit door and must be sealed to prevent pest entry. The women's washroom has no covered receptacle.

headline: Conditional pass; no employee health policy
summary: Passed with conditions. No signed employee health policy was on site. A leaking sprayer at the 3-compartment sink must be repaired, and a backflow device must be installed on the mop sink.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing signs and unlabeled bulk food
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs were missing, bulk food containers were unlabeled, and wet wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizing solution. An ice scoop was left on ice, and grease and dirt were found under cooking equipment and in ice buildup in the walk-in freezer.

headline: Passed; fries thawed at room temperature, bad gaskets
summary: Passed. Bulk French fries were thawing at room temperature and must be thawed by an approved method. Walk-in cooler door gaskets are detached, missing in places, and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Failed; food workers lacked certificates, repeat violation
summary: Failed. Several food workers had no food handler certificate, a repeat violation from April 2024 was not corrected, and a citation was issued. A leak under the 3-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Failed; 20-30 rodent droppings in storage
summary: Failed. About 20-30 rodent droppings were found along the wall base in the rear grocery storage area. A priority citation was issued, and pest control service is needed. The rear exit door needs rodent proofing. A 3-compartment sink leaks.

headline: Conditional pass; mussels lacked shellfish tag
summary: Passed with conditions. Thirty-three pounds of fresh mussels had no shellfish tag and were discarded. Rusted grease trap lids, duct tape on a walk-in cooler door, dirty ovens, and greasy floors were also noted. A staff washroom door must self-close.

headline: Conditional pass; no employee health policy on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy or training was on site, and a priority citation was issued. Rusty racks were in a prep cooler, and a mop sink backflow device was not accessible. Toilet room doors must self-close, and no allergen certificate was on site.

headline: Passed; pots not inverted, no allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Pots and pans in basement storage were not inverted. The women's restroom has no covered receptacle. Certified managers had no allergen training certificate on site.

headline: Conditional pass; scoop with no handle used for food
summary: Passed with conditions. A bowl with no handle was used to scoop food at service prep coolers, and tongs, spoons, or a ladle must be used instead. Serving plates on buffet shelves were not stored inverted.

headline: Failed; live flies, no soap, expired food dates
summary: Failed. About 5 house flies and about 25 small flying insects were found in prep and dishwashing areas, and a priority citation was issued. Some handwashing sinks lacked soap and paper towels or were blocked. TCS foods were held past the 7-day limit.

headline: Re-inspection passed; allergen certificate needed
summary: Passed on re-inspection. An allergen certificate was needed and the business was instructed to obtain and maintain one.

headline: Passed; broken kitchen floor tiles and wall base
summary: Passed. Floor tiles and wall base in the kitchen are broken or missing and must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Passed; unlabeled food, cardboard trays, debris outside
summary: Passed. Food in coolers was not labeled. Single-service articles were not inverted and were stored on the floor in the rear storage area. Soiled cardboard trays were on chip display shelves, debris was around the dumpster, and ceiling tiles were stained.

headline: Failed; black dirt in ice machine, ice discarded
summary: Failed. Black dirt buildup inside the ice machine was dripping into ice used for consumption. The ice was voluntarily discarded, and a priority citation was issued. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door must be rodent-proofed, and food buildup was noted on sinks and walls.

headline: Passed; restroom door and receptacle issues
summary: Passed. Restroom doors lack self-closing devices. The women's restroom has no covered receptacle. Hood filters need cleaning, and the certified manager had no allergen certificate on site.

headline: Conditional pass; cold seafood held too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. Oysters, fish, and crab legs were held at about 50.2-50.6°F, above the 41°F limit, and 9 pounds were discarded. The front prep cooler at 53.0°F was tagged and must not be used until re-inspected. Floors and vents need cleaning.

headline: Passed; wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were not stored in clean sanitizing solution when not in use. The business must correct this and maintain it.

headline: Conditional pass; cold food too warm, overflowing dumpster
summary: Passed with conditions. About 14 pounds of cold TCS foods were held at 46.6-55.7°F and discarded. A cooler at 60.3°F was reset to 35.0°F. An overflowing dumpster was corrected on site, and damaged walk-in cooler flooring must be repaired.

headline: Passed; dirty floor drains in dishwashing area
summary: Passed. Dirt and debris were on the floor drains in the rear dishwashing area. They must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Passed; 3-compartment sink faucet leaks
summary: Passed. The 3-compartment sink faucet leaks at the base and must be repaired.

headline: Passed; mold on walk-in cooler walls
summary: Passed. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints while preparing food. Black and gray mold-like buildup was found on walk-in cooler walls, racks, and seams, and grease and debris were noted on equipment. Allergen certificates were expired.

headline: Failed; no certified manager, no health policy
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was present while TCS foods were prepared, and priority citations were issued. No written employee health policy or bodily fluid cleanup kit was on site. No current pest control log book was on premises, and food handler training proof was missing.

headline: Passed; damaged ice machine parts, basement debris
summary: Passed. The ice machine bin and producer are in poor repair and must be repaired or replaced. Food debris and old beer bottles in the basement near an unused ramp must be removed.

headline: Passed; greasy cooking equipment and dirty basement floor
summary: Passed. The sides of cooking equipment have grease buildup and need detailed cleaning. The basement floor under and around equipment and shelving needs detailed cleaning.

headline: Re-inspection passed; rear door gap, no certificates
summary: Passed on re-inspection. The door to the dumpster area had a one-inch gap at the bottom and must be made rodent-proof. No food handler certificates or allergen training certificates were shown at the time of inspection.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing sign
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign was posted at the handsink in the rear prep area. The person in charge was instructed to provide and maintain one.

headline: Conditional pass; cold food held too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. Sausage, chicken, and fish were held at 50.6°F, 52.5°F, and 51.4°F, above the 41°F limit. The kitchen prep cooler at 53.4°F was tagged and must not be used until re-inspected. The 3-compartment sink faucet leaks.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; cutting boards, leaking sink
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Cutting boards have open seams and stains, and a can opener has dried food debris. The three-compartment sink leaks at all three basins. Clutter in rear storage, peeling base wall paint, and food spills were also noted.

headline: Passed; cardboard shelf liners, water-stained ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. Cardboard was used as a shelf liner and must be removed. Reach-in cooler interiors need cleaning, and water-stained ceiling tiles in the rear prep and dry storage areas must be replaced.

headline: Passed; greasy floors and damaged floor tiles
summary: Passed. Grease, food debris, and dirt were under cooking equipment and in corners across several areas. Dust was on a walk-in cooler fan, light shields, and vents. Damaged floor tiles in the dry storage room must be repaired.

headline: Passed; ice buildup and plumbing leaks
summary: Passed. Two reach-in line coolers had heavy ice buildup. A backflow cap was missing at the rear mop sink, and the men's urinal leaks when flushed. Unused equipment was in the party area, and tape was used to seal fixtures to ceiling tiles.

headline: Conditional pass; no handwash soap, uncovered food
summary: Passed with conditions. The only prep handsink had no soap, and a priority citation was issued. Cold holding units lack air thermometers, a dry ingredient container lacks a label, and some food was uncovered. Two sink stoppers were missing, and floors need cleaning.

headline: Failed; leaking handsink drains into bucket
summary: Failed. A handwashing sink was in poor repair, with damaged pipes draining into a bucket, and a priority citation was issued. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. The oven door was held closed with a bucket, and many floor tiles and ceiling tiles are damaged or stained.

headline: Failed; over 150 mouse droppings, prior violation not fixed
summary: Failed on re-inspection. A previous priority pest violation was not corrected. Over 150 mouse droppings were found under the kitchen grill and in both basement sections. Droppings must be removed and pest control service must occur before re-inspection.

headline: Passed; debris around hot water tank
summary: Passed. Debris was on the floor around the hot water tank and grease trap and must be cleaned.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; dish machine needs detail cleaning
summary: Passed on re-inspection. The dish machine interior had white buildup and food debris. Food handlers must wear hair restraints. The can opener, cold holding unit exteriors, and prep area floors also need detailed cleaning.

headline: Passed; cleaning and water-stained ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. Exterior cooking equipment, fryer bottoms, and prep tables need cleaning, and the walk-in cooler floor needs cleaning to remove spillage. Water-stained ceiling tiles in the store must be replaced.

headline: Conditional pass; no health policy, no vomit kit
summary: Passed with conditions. No verifiable employee health policy was on site, and no vomit and diarrhea response kit was available. A minor 3-compartment sink leak, a missing covered receptacle, water-stained ceilings, and no allergen training on site were also noted.

headline: Failed; rodent droppings, no pest service proof
summary: Failed. About 38 small rodent droppings were found behind equipment and under shelving near the rear toilet room, and a priority citation was issued. No proof of pest control service was shown. Trash overflowed, and a handwash sink lacked drying supplies until the person in charge provided paper towels.

headline: Failed; black mold-like substance in ice machine
summary: Failed. A black mold-like substance was found on the food-contact surface of the ice machine. The manager was instructed to clean and sanitize it, and a priority citation was issued.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk ingredients and exposed insulation
summary: Passed. Bulk dry ingredients stored in the microwave lacked labels. Serviceware and carry-out containers were stored upright and must be inverted. Grease and food debris were under the fryer. Exposed insulation was found behind the bar.

headline: Passed; ice utensil storage and bar floors
