summary: Passed. An ice utensil was not stored in a clean, sanitized container when not in use. Floors in the front and rear bar need cleaning to remove debris.

headline: Failed; handwash water too hot, ice machine black buildup
summary: Failed. Water at the dishwashing area handwashing sink reached 125°F, above the 100-120°F limit, and a priority citation was issued. The cold water knob does not work. Black buildup was found inside the rear ice machine.

headline: Failed; over 60 mouse droppings in furnace room
summary: Failed. Over 60 mouse droppings were found along walls and corners in the furnace room, and a priority citation was issued. An exterminator must be called. A food handler did not wear a hair restraint, and a certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed; water-stained ceiling tile, floors
summary: Passed. Equipment exteriors need cleaning where needed. A water-stained ceiling tile must be replaced, and floors around and under kitchen equipment need cleaning.

headline: Passed; dead cockroaches found, expired certificates
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Dead cockroaches were found under the dishwashing machine, on the dishwashing area wall, and in the men's washroom. Management was instructed to clean them up. Almost all food handlers had expired certificates.

headline: Re-inspection passed; no food handler certificates
summary: Passed on re-inspection. No food handler certificates were on site for employees. The business was instructed to provide and keep them on site.

headline: Passed; floors not clean
summary: Passed. Inspectors found floors that were not clean and were instructed to clean them.

headline: Conditional pass; no certificates, unlabeled packaged food
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid City food service sanitation certificate or food handler training proof was provided. Packaged cookies, scones, danishes, and croissants lacked required labels. The ice bin and reach-in coolers need cleaning, and clutter in the HVAC closet could attract pests.

headline: Conditional pass; no food handler training proof, summary posting
summary: Passed with conditions. Bulk containers lacked labels, wiping cloths were not in sanitizer, and no proof of food handler or allergen training was shown. The public summary report was not posted, and a priority citation was issued. Mold and spray foam were also noted.

headline: Failed; live roaches and flies at dishwashing area
summary: Failed. Three live roaches were seen on the dishwashing area wall, and about 40 live small flies were on the walls. A priority citation was issued, and all pest activity must be removed by re-inspection. Food debris and dirt are on floors and walls.

headline: Passed; pink substance in ice machine, grease behind stove
summary: Passed. A slight pinkish substance was found inside the ice machine and must be cleaned and sanitized. Single-service scoops were stored in dry storage containers and must be removed. Grease and debris were behind the rear stove, and dust was on lights.

headline: Failed; mold in ice machine, temperature violations, flies
summary: Failed. Mold-like substance was found inside the ice machine, and the ice was destroyed. Cooked bacon held at 91.8°F and cold foods at 47.3-61.2°F were discarded on site. About 30 small flies were in the bar, and no hot running water was available.

headline: Re-inspection passed; ice scoop storage and no allergen training
summary: Passed on re-inspection. An ice scoop was stored on a mat behind the bar with its food-contact surface exposed, and staff were instructed on proper storage. Water-stained ceiling tiles in the women's toilet room must be replaced. No certified manager had allergen training.

headline: Passed; items on floor and no food handler proof
summary: Passed. Stored items in the walk-in cooler and storage rooms must be raised off the floor, and milk crates may not be used for shelving. Dirt and debris were on floors and drains. No proof of food handler training was shown.

headline: Passed; grime and litter around cold units
summary: Passed. Cold hold unit interiors had food residue and grime, and grime was found on the toilet and around the dumpster. A wall outlet near the deli unit lacked a cover. One food handler had no certificate, and the person in charge had no allergen certificate on site.

headline: Passed; food debris on floors
summary: Passed. Dried food debris was on the floors in the rear prep and dishwashing area. The business was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Failed; 60+ rat droppings, no certified manager
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on site while TCS foods were handled, and a priority citation was issued. Over 60 rat droppings were found by the dish machine, in the basement prep area, near the hot water tank, and on stairs. Pest control service is required before re-inspection.

headline: Passed; broken thermometer, faulty dish machine door
summary: Passed. A thermometer inside a prep cooler was broken. The high-temperature dish machine door does not fully close, and staff use a towel to seal it. One women's customer restroom faucet does not work.

headline: Passed; slow drain, leaking faucet, no allergen certificate
summary: Passed. A front handwashing sink drains slowly, and the 3-compartment sink faucet leaks. Floors along the wall base and under equipment need cleaning. Certified managers on duty lacked allergen training certification.

headline: Passed; employee drinks and cloth towel use
summary: Passed. Open employee drinks were in the prep cooler, and a cloth towel was used to dry utensils at the 3-compartment sink. Employee bags were stored on a kitchen food shelf. Instructions were given to correct each item.

headline: Failed; pests found again, no valid certificate
summary: Failed on re-inspection. No valid City food service sanitation certificate was provided. A previous pest violation was not fixed: about 25 small flies and one live roach were seen. Priority citations were issued. Plumbing, walls, and floors also need repair.

headline: Failed; TCS foods not reheated, prior violations uncorrected
summary: Failed. Staff moved TCS foods into a warming unit without reheating them to 165°F, and a priority citation was issued. Grease, a leaking sink pipe, and dirty floors were noted. A freezer lid is broken, and previous violations from 2022 were not corrected.

headline: Passed; milk crates, damaged ceilings, dusty vents
summary: Passed. Milk crates were used as shelving in storage areas. A hand sink is detached from the wall and leaks in the butcher prep area. Damaged ceiling tiles, peeling wall paint, a non-draining water fountain, and dusty vents were noted. An allergen certificate was missing.

headline: Passed; expired allergen certificates, dirty wall
summary: Passed. The wall at the end of the 3-compartment sink and behind the dry goods table must be cleaned. Expired allergen training certificates were shown for city certified food service managers, and new ones must be obtained.

headline: Passed; knives stored improperly, toilet door
summary: Passed. Knives were stored between a wall and electrical piping and must be stored properly. Debris was on the top of the prep cooler, and the toilet room door must be self-closing.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing signs, leaks, damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs were missing at the front bar and rear prep sinks. Ice scoops were stored in ice bins. A slow leak was under the rear dishwashing sink, and one women's washroom sink had low water pressure. Ceiling tiles were water damaged.

headline: Condiments under unshielded sewer lines; bent probe
summary: Condiments in original containers were stored directly under unshielded sewer lines in the basement; they must be moved or the lines shielded. A food temperature probe thermometer is bent and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: No certified food manager during TCS food service
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while deli meat and chicken were handled and served; the manager was told to obtain one. Thermometers are missing or misplaced in several prep coolers and must be placed where they can be easily seen.

headline: Reinspection passed; ice machine and fryer buildup
summary: Reinspection passed. Brown and black buildup inside the ice machine must be cleaned and sanitized. Fryer knobs have heavy grease and food debris. Floors throughout the restaurant have dust and food debris. An unused cooler used as a shelf must be cleared.

headline: No certified sanitation certificate posted on site
summary: No person on site had an original City of Chicago food sanitation certificate posted. A certified person must be on site at all times; citation issued.

headline: Cold foods over 41F discarded; prep cooler tagged
summary: Eggs at 64F, diced tomatoes, shredded cheese, and beans in a prep cooler were discarded, about 15 pounds. The prep cooler at 55.5F was tagged and must not be used until repaired. Grease on the table under the grill and a small hand sink leak need attention.

headline: Failed: incomplete vomit kit; wastewater spills
summary: Vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit held only an apron and mask; a written procedure is required. Handwashing sink was blocked by cups and utensils. Wastewater spilled from the three-compartment sink drain; citation issued. Food on walk-in floor and missing handwashing signs also noted.

headline: Handwashing signs missing; broken glass under bar
summary: All handwashing sinks need signage. Some serving dishes on the rear prep shelving were not inverted. Broken glass and debris under bar equipment must be cleaned. The inspection passed.

headline: No hair restraints; drain leak; allergen training missing
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints while preparing food; management was told to require them. A drain line leaks at the rear food prep handwashing sink and must be repaired. A certified manager lacked allergen training, a repeat violation; citation issued.

headline: Gaps in doors; cleaning and thermometers needed
summary: Hot holding units need internal thermometers. Double entry doors and an exit door have gaps that must be made tight-fitting. Walk-in coolers, freezer, prep areas, and hood filters have debris or ice buildup to clean. Holes in produce-area walls need repair.

headline: Reinspection passed; grease on hood; training proof
summary: Reinspection passed. Exhaust hood and filters need detail cleaning to remove excessive grease. Some food handlers lacked certificates; all must show proof of training.

headline: Complaint passed; restraints, leaks, allergen training
summary: Employees handled food without hair or beard restraints. Piping at the front cook-line handwashing sink leaks onto the floor when in use. Grease on the floor under fryers needs cleaning. Burned-out bulbs were in rear prep. The person in charge needs allergen training.

headline: Rusted freezer door bottom needs repair
summary: The bottom of a standing freezer door in the rear prep area is rusted and not easily cleaned. The manager must repair it and provide a smooth, cleanable surface. The inspection passed.

headline: Employee men's washroom floor not clean
summary: The employee men's washroom floor is not clean and must be cleaned and maintained. The inspection passed.

headline: Dust inside dining light shield
summary: Dust inside a light shield in the dining area must be cleaned. This short complaint inspection passed.

headline: Sink debris and leaks
summary: Food debris is on the interior and exterior of all sinks and must be cleaned. The handwashing sink drains slowly, and the three-compartment sink middle pipe leaks and must be repaired. The inspection passed.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; greasy hood
summary: The inspection passed. Several food handlers had expired certificates and must provide valid ones. Excessive grease on the ventilation hood and filters must be cleaned. Prep tables, coolers, ice machine interior, and walls need cleaning.

headline: Dish machines not sanitizing; cold holding too warm
summary: Two high-temperature dish machines had final rinse temperatures of 176F and 120F; they must be above 180F, and a citation was issued. Milk, shrimp, dressings, and other cold foods in two coolers were 44F to 53F. Coolers at 45F and 51F must be below 41F.

headline: Failed: dish machine not sanitizing; fruit flies found
summary: Low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged. About 25 fruit flies were seen at bar areas; a citation was issued. Management must notify the pest control operator and eliminate the fruit flies.

headline: Bulk containers unlabeled; instructed to label
summary: Bulk food containers, including salt and flour, were not labeled. Staff were instructed to label them. The inspection passed.

headline: Reinspection passed; backflow device and ceiling tiles
summary: Reinspection passed. No backflow prevention device was found on the utility sink; one must be installed where it can be serviced. Stained ceiling tiles throughout the rear prep area must be replaced.

headline: Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer; no handler certificates
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. Restroom trash receptacles lack lids. Damaged floor tiles, walls, and ceilings in prep and storage areas must be repaired. Two-burner cooking equipment is not under the hood. Food handlers lack certificates.

headline: Washroom doors lack self-closing devices; allergen proof
summary: Reinspection passed. Men's and women's washroom doors need self-closing devices installed. No allergen training proof was available for City of Chicago certified food service managers; proof must be provided.

headline: Failed: washbowl too cold; ice machine slime
summary: Basement employee washbowl reached only 65.1F; it must be kept between 100F and 120F, and a citation was issued. Black slime was found inside the bar ice machine; ice must be removed and the machine cleaned. The public inspection summary was not posted; a new one must be displayed.

headline: Failed: food on floor; rust; no allergen training
summary: Food stored on the floor inside a walk-in freezer must be raised six inches. Rusty mixer and shelving must be repaired or replaced. A soiled mop head was on the floor. Grout is missing and tiles are damaged. Certified managers lack allergen training; a repeat violation.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; wall hole and peeling paint
summary: Milk crates used as shelving in prep and storage areas must be replaced with shelving six inches off the floor. Food debris is on a sweet potato cutter and the reach-in coolers need detail cleaning. A hole in a dry storage wall and peeling paint need repair.

headline: Worn gaskets and cutting boards; cleaning needed
summary: A worn and torn gasket on a two-door reach-in cooler must be replaced. Cutting boards in the rear have stains and deep grooves. Walk-in fan covers, the salad prep station, and the bar floor need detail cleaning. The inspection passed.

headline: Reinspection passed; signage and food covers needed
summary: Reinspection passed. No handwashing signage at the dish-area sink. Covers are missing for shredded lettuce, cheese, and pickles in a cold unit. Debris and beige buildup on floors and in a floor drain need cleaning. Dusty ceiling vents need cleaning.

headline: Uncovered bulk containers; damaged gaskets; allergen training
summary: Bulk containers in the prep area were uncovered and must be covered. Damaged gaskets on a prep cooler and ice machine must be replaced. Food debris on cooking equipment and holding units needs cleaning. Covered receptacles are needed in washrooms. Managers need allergen training.

headline: No certified manager; blocked sinks; food held too warm
summary: No certified food manager on site while chicken and fish were prepared; citation issued. Missing health policy and vomit cleanup kit. Two handwashing sinks were blocked. Ice machine chute had black debris. Eggs at 48F and shrimp at 52.9F were discarded.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; inoperable sink
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager on premises while beef, pork, beans, and chicken were prepared and served; citation issued. Rear prep handwashing sink is inoperable and must be repaired. Ambient air thermometer on the reach-in cooler is in disrepair.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm sanitizer; floor tiles damaged
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and must reach at least 50 ppm; a technician adjusted it to 50 ppm on site. Citation issued under another inspection. Missing and damaged floor tiles in the dish room must be repaired.

headline: Failed: rat droppings found; cold foods too warm
summary: Ready-to-eat foods in a prep cooler ran at 55.4F; about 31 pounds were discarded. About 75 or more rat droppings were found in the bar area, basement, and storage areas; citation issued. Pest control service recommended. Squeeze bottles need labels.

headline: Failed: no sanitizer test kit; food training missing
summary: No chemical test kit to check sanitizer strength at the three-compartment sink; citation issued. No food handler training for employees. Crates used for storage must be replaced with shelving. Containers need labels. Debris on stove, freezer, and ceiling tiles need attention.

headline: Sanitation certificate not posted during food service
summary: No valid City of Chicago food service sanitation certificate was posted for food employees. The person in charge was told the original certificate and certified manager must be on site whenever time- and temperature-controlled (TCS) foods are served. No citation issued.

headline: Loose, leaking faucet; walk-in floor debris
summary: The base of the three-compartment sink faucet is loose and leaking and must be repaired. Floors inside the walk-in cooler have spills and debris that must be cleaned. The inspection passed.

headline: Cold foods above 41F; torn gasket; floors dirty
summary: Tofu, pork, noodles, chicken, and eggs in service coolers were above 41F. About 2 pounds were discarded. A torn gasket on a two-door prep refrigerator must be repaired or replaced. Floors along wall bases and under equipment need cleaning.

headline: Utensil storage problems; sink leak; ice machine not working
summary: Scoop handles touched food, and utensils were stored with food-contact surfaces exposed; the manager was told to correct this. Broken scoops and spatulas must be discarded. A sushi-area sink cold handle leaks. The non-working ice machine must be repaired or removed.

headline: Ceramic cups need lead-safety proof; walk-in debris
summary: Ceramic or clay drinking cups on site must be lead-free or lead-safe, with documentation kept on site, or removed. Heavy food debris and loose vegetables on the walk-in cooler floor must be cleaned. The inspection passed.

headline: Floor drain buildup in dish area
summary: Buildup in the dish-area floor drain must be cleaned and maintained. The complaint inspection passed.

headline: Rear prep area floors need cleaning
summary: Rear prep area floors need cleaning to remove spills. The inspection passed.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: No allergen training certificate was on site for the certified food manager. Allergen training must be provided for all certified food managers. The inspection passed.

headline: Insects in dry storage; no vomit cleanup procedure
summary: No written procedure or supplies for vomit or diarrhea events; supplies must include sanitizer that kills norovirus. Two dead crawling insects were found in rear dry storage and must be removed and cleaned. Raw wood shelves and walls need sealing or painting.

headline: Licensing inspection: waste bin and ceiling tiles
summary: No covered waste receptacle in the employee washroom; one must be provided. Water-damaged ceiling tiles above the rear utility sink must be repaired and maintained. The license inspection passed.

headline: Sinks blocked by supplies; faucet needs repair
summary: A prep table sat too close to the front handwashing sink, and brooms and a dustpan blocked the dish-area handwashing sink. Both must stay accessible. The three-compartment sink faucet is in poor repair and cannot fully shut off.

headline: Failed: food on floors; hair restraints; no allergen training
summary: Food stored on floors in the walk-in cooler and prep area; hair restraints not worn; bulk and packaged items unlabeled; grocery bags used for food in freezer. Garbage dumpster has no lids; citation issued. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Dirty light shields; cracked cover; greasy floor
summary: Dust and dirt are inside light shield covers in the food prep area and must be cleaned. A cracked light shield above a handwashing sink must be repaired. Dirt and grease on the floor under cooking equipment must be cleaned. The inspection passed.

headline: Improper thawing; summary not posted; loose tiles
summary: Frozen pork was thawed improperly; it must be thawed under refrigeration at 41F or less, under running water, or in a microwave. Thermometers must be visible in all coolers. No inspection summary was posted; citation issued. Loose ceiling tiles above the cooking area need repair.

headline: Food stored on floors; stoves outside exhaust hood
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor in prep, storage, and walk-in freezers and must be raised six inches. Food was stored in tin cans. Large pots do not fit the three-compartment sink; a washing procedure or removal is needed. Cooking stoves must be under the exhaust hood.

headline: Failed: manager absent; sewage on floor; no handler training
summary: Person in charge was absent, and no certified food manager or certificate was present while pork, beef, and chicken were prepared. About 3 pounds of cooked beef at 57F were discarded. A toilet would not flush and sewage was on the floor. Dumpster lids were open; citation issued.

headline: Dish machine leaks; bar floor heavily soiled
summary: A low-temperature dish machine in the bar leaks and must be repaired or replaced. The bar floor has heavy buildup of food debris, dirt, and grime that must be detail cleaned. A thermometer is missing from the market grab-and-go cooler. The inspection passed.

headline: No health policy; missing prep sink, backflow, grease trap
summary: No employee health policy was on the premises. No preparation sink at the coffee area, no backflow device on the mop sink faucet, and no grease trap for the three-compartment sink. All must be provided. No citation issued.

headline: Reinspection: wiping cloths; no handler certificates
summary: Reinspection passed. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables and must be stored in sanitizing solution. A torn gasket on a rear freezer door must be repaired. No food handler certificates on site. Food sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Failed: cold foods discarded; no raw food advisory
summary: Ceviche, ham, raw chicken legs, and fresh cheese in the butcher-area cooler were 45F to 48.7F. About 115 pounds were discarded. Raw ceviche was served without a consumer advisory. A condenser in the walk-in leaks; liquor room ceiling is broken. Citation issued.

headline: Manager lacked posted certificate; floors need cleaning
summary: A food service manager on site did not have a City of Chicago certificate posted or on them; citation issued. One employee lacks allergen training. Floors in the rear soda storage area, under the sink, and in the front service area need cleaning.

headline: Complaint passed; openings allow pest entry
summary: Openings at the dock door base, the sliding entrance doors, and the main exit were noted and must be sealed to prevent pest entry. A lower cold unit in deli prep is missing a door. Damaged reach-in cooler doors and openings in deli prep must be repaired.

headline: Failed: slime in ice machine; mouse droppings found
summary: Ice machine chute had pink and black slimy buildup likely to contaminate ice; ice must be emptied and cleaned. Over 20 mouse droppings were found along walls and under storage racks. Citation issued; pest control service recommended. Most food handlers lacked current training.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: The sanitation manager has no allergen training on record and must obtain it. The inspection passed.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; training needed for new staff
summary: Bulk storage containers on a shelf were not labeled and must be labeled. Fryer bottoms and bulk container exteriors were cleaned on site. Floor under cooking equipment and washroom fan were also cleaned on site. New employees need food handler training.

headline: Unlabeled containers; rusty racks and mold-like buildup
summary: Some kitchen food storage containers lacked name labels. Rusty metal racks in the basement liquor room need repainting or replacing. The bar ice bin needs a lid. A walk-in cooler fan cover and wall have mold-like buildup that must be cleaned.

headline: Ice machine debris led to citation; signage missing
summary: Ice machine had black and brown buildup and debris on ice used for drinks. The person in charge removed the ice, turned off the machine, and cleaned it on site; a citation was issued. Also: missing handwashing signs, a dirty lobby microwave, and unused equipment to remove.

headline: Missing cooler thermometers; loose sink drain plug
summary: Rear coolers lacked internal air thermometers, which are required in cold-holding units. An insect control device was installed over clean equipment and must be moved. The three-compartment sink drain plug is loose and in poor repair, but works.

headline: Kettle needs cleaning procedure; rusty racks
summary: A large kitchen kettle that cannot be moved needs a written clean-in-place procedure. Heavy ice buildup inside walk-in freezers must be defrosted. Dry storage racks with heavy rust must be repainted or replaced. The inspection passed.

headline: Food held over 24 hours without discard dates
summary: Cooked rice, shredded potatoes, and oatmeal were held over 24 hours without discard dates; citation issued. A cooler gasket is torn and dirty. Duct tape may not be used for repairs. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables. Debris is around the dumpster.

headline: Cold foods over safe temperature; about $300 discarded
summary: Many cold foods were held between 46.6F and 55.2F, including chicken, eggs, and cheese. Corrected on site: manager discarded about 30 pounds. A two-door prep cooler at 51.6F was tagged. Handwashing signs, lighting, and allergen training proof are also needed.

headline: No inspection summary posted on site
summary: No inspection summary was posted on site. The manager must keep the most recent summary posted at all times. This is a priority foundation violation.

headline: No handwashing signs; hair restraints not worn
summary: No handwashing signs at any sink. Bulk ingredient containers in the rear are not labeled. Employees in the food prep area were not wearing hair restraints. Food and dirt buildup in the floor drain and under equipment must be cleaned. Food handlers lack certificates.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; cooler failing; product discarded
summary: Cold foods in a service cooler were above 41F, including turkey at 58.6F and hash browns at 70F. The manager voluntarily discarded about 14 pounds. A prep-area cooler at 47.6F may not be used until it holds 41F or below. Citation issued.

headline: Failed: about 40 mouse droppings found in restaurant
summary: Evidence of rodent activity: about 40 mouse droppings were found behind a sandwich prep table, near handwashing sinks, in storage areas, and in the boiler room. Management was told to clean them up. Additional pest control service is needed. Citation issued.

headline: Food stored on floors; bulk containers uncovered
summary: Bulk salt was not covered under a prep table, and tortilla boxes were stored on the floor near washrooms. Multi-use equipment was stored on the floor. Milk crates are used as shelving, and the three-compartment sink has no stoppers. Items were to be elevated six inches off the floor.

headline: Ice machine needs cleaning; cooler gasket repaired with tape
summary: Ice machine interior needs cleaning. A cooler door gasket was repaired with tape and must be properly fixed. Foil or cardboard liners are not allowed. Managers lacked allergen training proof. Also noted: a leaking pipe, water-damaged ceiling tiles, and clutter.

headline: Reinspection passed; unlabeled items; deep cutting board
summary: Reinspection passed. Dry ingredients in the rear prep area lacked common-name labels. A cutting board at the rear pizza prep cooler has deep cuts and must be sanded and sealed or replaced.

headline: Floors under equipment need cleaning
summary: Floors along wall bases and under equipment, especially in the rear dry storage area, need cleaning and maintenance. The inspection passed.

headline: Reinspection passed; missing ceiling tiles
summary: Reinspection passed with two items. Missing and stained ceiling tiles near the ice machine must be replaced. A certified food manager lacked allergen training; the manager was told to comply.

headline: Door gaps; grease and dirt buildup in kitchen
summary: Double door gaps about one-quarter inch must be sealed to prevent possible pests. Kitchen drains need detail cleaning. A lower reach-in cooler handle is broken with a sharp edge. Grease, dirt, and food debris are on cooking equipment, floors, walls, and the hood.

headline: Failed: no hot running water on premises
summary: No hot running water was available; sink water measured 73.3F to 79.0F. Management must provide water above 110F at the three-compartment sink and at least 100F at handwashing sinks. Citation issued.

headline: Dusty, rusty ice machines; leaky faucets
summary: Interior non-food-contact surfaces of two ice machines are soiled with dust and rust and must be cleaned regularly. The warewashing area sink drains slowly, and a server station aerator is slightly clogged. Plumbing fixtures must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Rear exit door not rodent-proof; clutter removal needed
summary: Rear exit door has a half-inch gap at the bottom and must be made tight-fitting. The slow-draining front handwashing sink must be repaired. Dust on a vent and dirt in the rear hallway need cleaning. Clutter must be removed and items elevated to prevent rodent harborage.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; missing allergen training
summary: The inspection passed. No handwashing sign at the exposed bar handwashing sink. The walk-in cooler door gasket is torn and must be repaired or replaced. Two burnt-out bulbs in the cook-line hood need replacing. One certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Corrected on site: certificate, water temperatures
summary: Certificate was missing at first; corrected on site when delivered at 10:10 AM; citation issued. Handwashing water was too cool (71.6F, 91.0F); corrected to 102F and 108.1F. Metered faucets and a cold water shutoff were fixed. No allergen training proof for managers.

headline: Unlabeled containers; uncovered pizzas; washroom lacks lid
summary: Dry ingredient containers and squeeze bottles lacked common-name labels. Uncooked pizzas were not covered while proofing. Hair restraint issue noted for most food handlers. The all-gender washroom lacks a lidded receptacle. Food handler training certificates were not on site.

headline: Floors behind cooking equipment need cleaning
summary: Floors behind and around cooking equipment need cleaning to remove spills or debris. The inspection passed.

headline: Soda nozzles, toaster oven and restrooms need cleaning
summary: Soda dispenser nozzles and the toaster oven interior need cleaning. Wiping cloths and a bread knife were not stored in sanitizing solution or a clean container. Restrooms and rear prep floor with food spills also need cleaning.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: The city-certified food manager had no proof of allergen training. All certified managers must obtain this certificate. The inspection passed.

headline: Undated food held over 24 hours; food on floor
summary: Ready-to-eat TCS foods held over 24 hours in prep and walk-in coolers lacked date marks; citation issued. Food on the walk-in floor and freezer floor must be raised six inches. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables. The prep handwashing sink hot water handle does not work.

headline: Single-service items not inverted; resolved on site
summary: Single-serving items on the front counter for customers were not stored inverted. The owner resolved the issue. The inspection passed.

headline: Reinspection passed; restroom detail cleaning needed
summary: Reinspection passed. Toilet rooms need detail cleaning of lower walls and floor edges. Staff were instructed to clean and maintain these areas.

headline: No sanitation certificate; inspection summary not posted
summary: No City of Chicago sanitation certificate was posted, and a certified manager must be present whenever TCS foods are prepared or served; citation issued. Earlier training violations were not corrected. The inspection summary was not posted for public view; citation issued.

headline: Failed: grease and debris; leaks; no lids on dumpster
summary: Grease and food debris in the fryer oil filter and on heavy equipment in prep areas must be cleaned. Hand sink piping leaks in a toilet room. Outside receptacle had no lids; citation issued. Duct tape and water-stained ceiling tiles also need attention.

headline: No cooler thermometers; food stored under wastewater pipes
summary: Butcher coolers lack thermometers and must have visible ones placed in the warmest part. Food was stored under wastewater pipes in the rear hallway and must not be. The ice machine in the seafood area lacks a backflow prevention device.

headline: Salad cooler at 48.2F; chocolate milk calories too high
summary: Salad cooler at 48.2F holding TCS foods was tagged held for inspection; it must be at 41F or below once repaired; citation issued. Worn freezer gasket and grease buildup. Male employee needs a beard guard. Default chocolate milk at 140 calories must be 130 or less.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; dish machines lacked detergent
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager or original certificate on site while TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. Ice machines on two floors had blackish pink buildup. No metal stem thermometer on site. Four dish machines had no detergent; the manager replaced it on site.

headline: No hand towels; eggs too warm; missing thermometers
summary: No hand-drying supplies at a handwashing sink; citation issued. Two pounds of eggs in a rear prep cooler measured 56.7F to 57.8F and were discarded. Refrigeration units lack thermometers. Also noted: unlabeled dry goods, food in grocery bags, and a broken faucet.

headline: Food stored on floor; no handler training; clutter
summary: Reinspection passed. Food stored on the floor behind the counter and in prep areas must be elevated six inches. Single-service items were on the floor. Cooking equipment and coolers have grease and dust. No food handler training for employees was on record.

headline: Failed: slime in ice machine; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Black and pink slime was found inside an ice machine used for ice. Ice must be removed and the machine cleaned and sanitized; citation issued. Heavy grease on the used cooking oil container outside, a burnt-out hood light, and a manager without allergen training.

headline: Reinspection passed; gaps to outside need sealing
summary: Reinspection passed. Gaps about one inch wide around driver and passenger doors, plus open holes to the outside near the rear door, hot water heater, and between grill and prep cooler. Owner was told to seal them and make these areas rodent-proof.

headline: Beard guard needed; plumbing leaks to fix
summary: A food handler needs a beard guard in prep areas. Restroom washbowls need recaulking. A leak under the three-compartment sink must be fixed, and a restroom washbowl needs running water. Dirty floors in corners, around sinks, coolers and storage rooms need cleaning.

headline: Reinspection: expired training; worn cutting board
summary: Reinspection passed. A worn, pitted cutting board on a prep cooler must be repaired or replaced. Food debris on coolers and prep tables must be cleaned. Food handler training and food manager allergen training were both expired and must be renewed.

headline: No employee health policy; paper towels and sink issues
summary: No employee health policy or training on site; citation issued. No paper towels at three handwashing sinks; citation issued. Missing handwashing signs. Equipment stored under unshielded sewer lines. A basement hand sink leaks from its drain.

headline: Failed: coolers off; hot water too cool; no grease trap
summary: Women's washroom hot water reached only 85.8F; a minimum of 100F is required. Several coolers, including the cook-line cooler, were not running; all must hold 41F or below. A grease trap is missing at the bar sink. Certified managers need allergen training proof.

headline: Cooling food wrapped too tightly; plastic tubs reused
summary: Cooked skewered meat was tightly wrapped while cooling in the walk-in cooler; staff must leave it loosely covered or uncovered to cool. Single-use plastic tubs were reused for bulk salt and spices and must stop. Milk crates must be replaced with a dunnage rack.

headline: Wiping cloths stored on prep tables
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on top of prep tables. They must be kept in sanitizing solution when not in use.

headline: Re-inspection passed; labels, gaskets, tiles
summary: Bulk and squeeze-bottle food containers need labels. Food stored on walk-in cooler and freezer floors must be raised onto shelving. Worn door gaskets and broken floor tiles in main prep area.

headline: Cooked rice held too warm; undated foods
summary: 20 lbs cooked rice at 47.2–52.1°F in prep cooler; manager discarded it ($50). Ready-to-eat foods in refrigerator not date marked. No food handler certificates on site; allergen training expired.

headline: Cold food held too warm; cooler repairs needed
summary: Fish at 48.1°F and cooked greens at 50.5°F in front prep cooler; manager discarded 20 lbs (about $200). Reach-in prep cooler measured 55°F and was tagged. Reach-in coolers lack thermometers.

headline: Failed: no hand sink in coffee grinding area
summary: No hand sink in coffee processing, grinding and packaging area. Missing thermometers for small refrigerator and service-counter hot holding unit. Unlabeled containers, gap at rear door, worn cooler gaskets.

headline: Doors open; food handler training missing
summary: Front and rear doors were open; must stay closed and tight-fitting. Torn gasket on two-door cooler, cardboard liner on prep table, grease trap debris, and leaking faucet. Non-certified handlers lack food handler training.

headline: Cardboard bowls, foil liners, wet mops
summary: Cardboard bowls and lids stored faced up must be inverted to protect from overhead contamination. Aluminum foil lining cooking equipment must be removed. Wet mops must be hung to dry.

headline: No health policy; rear door gap; trash cans
summary: No written employee health policy (priority). Rear west door gap larger than 1/4 inch. Bathroom door not self-closing. No covered trash cans in three bathrooms. One of two hand dryer fans not working.

headline: Re-inspection: splash guard, plate and leak
summary: No right-side splash guard on second-floor bar handwashing sink. No data plate on basement high-temperature dish machine. Leaking drain stopper at three-compartment sink.

headline: Failed: rat droppings found; menu disclosure missing
summary: About 8 rat droppings in utility room and bar. Removal and pest control service recommended on or after 5/6/2026; citation issued. No menu disclosure for raw or undercooked animal foods. Damaged cooler gaskets; rust; missing backflow device.

headline: Restroom faucets run too briefly
summary: Restroom metered faucets run only 1–2 seconds; must provide water for at least 15 seconds. Floors and drains under drive-thru beverage machine soiled with fried food debris and spills.

headline: Re-inspection passed; sign, leak and light fixes
summary: Hand sink missing handwashing sign. Ice scoop stored on ice machine. Leak under rear three-compartment sink. Spider webs on wok hood filters and a blown-out light in walk-in freezer.

headline: Re-inspection passed; spills under prep cooler
summary: Spills and debris on bottom surfaces of prep cooler and inside cabinets under beverage area. Manager instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Greasy hood filters; no manager allergen training
summary: Grease buildup on hood filters and hood system; person in charge told to clean and maintain. Certified manager on site lacks allergen training; must obtain training and keep certificate on site.

headline: No hair restraints; leaking drainpipe
summary: Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints. Wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces. Food debris in prep cooler, leaking drainpipe under first sink compartment, and mop not positioned to air dry.

headline: Prep cooler door missing interior cover
summary: Prep cooler door is missing an interior cover, and exposed insulation is too close to open food containers. Must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Passed; ice machine residue and unlabeled sugar
summary: Minor residue inside ice machine. Sugar stored outside original container without a label. Food stored on floor in front prep area must be raised 6 inches. Ice scoop left on top of ice machine.

headline: Blocked hand sink; no soap; food discarded
summary: Hand sink in kitchen blocked by wrapped utensils and bread, and had no soap; both were fixed during inspection; citation issued. Raw chicken at 47°F, cheese and eggs at 60°F; about 15 lbs discarded ($50).

headline: Re-inspection passed; leak and cooler light fixes
summary: Milk crates used for elevation must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Leaky drainpipe under third sink compartment. Basement floors need cleaning. Burnt-out bakery cooler light; one handler lacks training.

headline: Raw shrimp and eggrolls too warm; discarded
summary: One lb raw shrimp at 50.7°F in prep cooler and 2 lbs defrosted eggrolls at 48–50°F. Manager discarded both. Also: deeply cut cutting boards, plastic grocery bags used as containers, and prior grease and caulking violations.

headline: Re-inspection passed; rear door gap, clutter
summary: Quarter-inch gap at bottom of rear exit door by dumpster must be made tight-fitting. Clutter in rear storage, hallway and water heater closet. Mops and brooms must be raised 6 inches off floor.

headline: Failed: no hot water; unplumbed coffee sink
summary: No hot running water at hand sinks; sink water 75.2–78.1°F. Hot water restored at affected sinks at 1:55 p.m. Coffee station uses a portable hand sink with no plumbing. Gap under rear door, no backflow device.

headline: Failed: shellstock tags; dish machine repaired
summary: Shellstock tags lack last-sold date. Four lower-level ice machines have black mold-like spots. Dish machine wash at 153°F was repaired on site to 180°F. Openings at revolving door; exposed preset tableware.

headline: Failed: broken cooler gaskets; dirty floors
summary: Broken gaskets on produce walk-in cooler door, uncorrected since 2023. Loose debris and dust on floors throughout. Unlabeled storage containers. Citation issued; must be corrected before reinspection.

headline: Leaking sink; greasy fryers; hair restraint lapse
summary: Leak at pipe under rear handwashing sink. Food handler in prep area did not wear hair restraint. Fryers and cooking equipment have encrusted grease and dirt; floors under cooking equipment have grease buildup.

headline: Soiled unused toaster oven must be removed
summary: Unused, soiled toaster oven in dish room must be removed from the premises to prevent pest harboring or attraction. Passed.

headline: Soiled mop heads not stored properly
summary: Soiled mop heads were not stored properly. Manager instructed to hang mop heads to prevent insect breeding. No insects were noted.

headline: Failed: no certified person, many violations
summary: No certified person on site and no valid certificate posted. No employee health policy, no vomiting procedures, no handwashing signs, soap or paper towels. No thermometers, pest logbook, food handler or allergen training.

headline: Hot and cold foods out of temperature; discarded
summary: Five lbs beef meatballs at 98.3°F in steam table; 15 lbs raw pork sausage at 50.4°F at room temperature. Both discarded, about $50 each. Employees' personal items stored in prep kitchen.

headline: Failed: ice machine, labels and prior violations
summary: Ice machine and soda dispenser interiors need cleaning. Food containers need labels. Floor drain under sink and clutter in rear areas must be addressed. Prior core violations not corrected; no allergen certificate.

headline: Re-inspection: no food handler training proof
summary: No proof of food handler training or certificates for all required employees. Documentation must be provided.

headline: Re-inspection: sink gap, floors and grease catch
summary: One-inch gap between employee restroom handwashing sink and wall, exposed to seepage. Floors under cooking and cold-holding equipment soiled. Grease drip catch missing from hood above main cook line.

headline: Failed: no refrigeration on site during inspection
summary: No refrigeration on premises during inspection (priority). No written vomiting and diarrheal procedures, no hand cleanser at toilet sink, no pest control agreement or logbook, and a toilet garbage can without a lid.

headline: Re-inspection passed; trash can needed
summary: No covered trash receptacle inside unisex employee toilet room. Manager instructed to provide and maintain one.

headline: Failed: bare-hand bread contact; black slime
summary: Food handler sliced ready-to-eat bread by hand; manager provided gloves and bread was discarded. Black slime dripping from ice machine into ice. Several prepared TCS foods past date or undated, discarded. Damaged rodent strip; 1/4-inch alley door gap.

headline: Failed: black slime in ice machine; fly traps
summary: Ice machine with black slime dripping onto stored ice. Sticky fly traps hung in rear areas. Grease, debris and dust on floors, fans and vents; clutter in receiving area. No insects were recorded.

headline: Cooler cleaning, washroom door, manager allergen training
summary: Interior of prep cooler across from grill needs cleaning. Washroom door needs a self-closing device. Certified food manager lacks an allergen training certificate and must show proof.

headline: Re-inspection: door opening and leaky faucet
summary: Opening between double front doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Leaking faucet at three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; no hot water
summary: No certified manager on duty while chicken, pot roast and short ribs were prepared. Prep sink water at 70°F; no pest control logbook; no food handler certificates. Paper towels were obtained during inspection.

headline: Moldy caulking in dish room
summary: Blackened, moldy wall caulking throughout dish room at dish machine and three-compartment sink. Instructed to replace and maintain.

headline: Re-inspection passed; wall hole needs repair
summary: Hole in wall near prep table where the slicer is stored. Person in charge told to repair the wall and keep the surface smooth and easily cleanable.

headline: Passed; front door gap and broken tiles
summary: Front entrance door has an approximately half-inch gap at the bottom. Ice scoops improperly stored in front bar. Items on basement food storage floor must be raised. Broken floor tiles in bar.

headline: Basement liquor room needs cleaning and organizing
summary: Re-inspection passed. Basement liquor storage room needs detail cleaning and organizing. Remove unnecessary items to prevent potential pest hiding places, and raise stock 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Failed: vacuum packaging without HACCP plan
summary: Vacuum packaging machine on site with no HACCP plan or variance; machine tagged and must not be used until approved. Also: utensils stored in salt, cardboard used as shelving, and prior violations and allergen training not addressed.

headline: Leaks, grease, holes and missing floor drain cover
summary: Leaks under kitchen three-compartment sink and bar sink. Excessive cardboard and stored items in basement. Greasy floors, cracked tiles, moldy caulking, an open basement wall hole, and a missing floor drain cover.

headline: Re-inspection: no food handler certificates
summary: No food handler certificates on site. All food employees must complete them and keep records on premises at all times.

headline: Re-inspection passed; cracked handle and tiles
summary: Cracked hot-water handle on front prep hand sink. Broken and cracked tiles in front serving area. Person in charge instructed to repair and keep the surface smooth and easily cleanable.

headline: Complaint passed; grease and floors need cleaning
summary: Drain at dish machine needs detail cleaning. Sides of cooking and noncooking equipment have grease, food debris and dust, which can attract pests. Floors in kitchen, prep, dish and bar need detail cleaning.

headline: Passed; cleaning and labeling corrections needed
summary: Bulk containers need relabeling where names have faded. Ice machine interior, can opener, cooking equipment and floors need cleaning. Small faucet leak at front sink and dusty cooler vent.

headline: Food spills in cooler and dispensers; water pooling
summary: Food spills inside reach-in cooler holding salads, beverage dispenser and syrup cabinet, to be removed to prevent a pest food source. Water pooled under unused dishwasher. Dining room floors need cleaning.

headline: No valid employee sanitation certificates
summary: No valid City of Chicago sanitation certificates for employees. A certified manager must be on premises at all times when TCS foods are prepared, handled or served. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; food handling lapses
summary: No valid certified manager on duty while chicken and seafood were prepared. Handlers without hair restraints, wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces, unlabeled containers and food stored on floors. Greasy floors and equipment.

headline: Vacuum-sealed meats lack approved HACCP plan
summary: Reduced-oxygen packaging used on salmon, duck, beef, pork and chicken without an approved HACCP (food safety) plan or variance. About 30 lbs tagged and held ($200). Plan must be approved by CDPH.

headline: Failed: over 100 mouse droppings found
summary: Evidence of mice: over 100 mouse droppings in coffee, bakery, prep and cooking areas. One-inch gap at side exit door; gaps at inner doors. Food on walk-in freezer floor; mold-like substance in produce cooler; leaking handsink pipe.

headline: Dog on site removed; food on floors
summary: A prohibited animal, a dog, was on site and was removed during the inspection; citation issued. Food containers stored on dry storage floors, excess debris in reach-in coolers, broken floor tiles, and clutter.

headline: Greasy outdoor dumpsters need cleaning
summary: Grease and grime built up on exterior of outdoor dumpsters. Instructed to clean and maintain them in good condition.

headline: No certified manager during pizza prep
summary: No certified manager on site while pizza and other TCS items were prepared 9:30–10:00 a.m.; citation issued. No thermometer in cream cooler. Torn gasket, broken paper towel dispenser, and no summary posted.

headline: Dirty floor drain; food handler training needed
summary: Floor drain at three-compartment sink needs cleaning. Dust on washroom ceiling vent fan must be removed. Food handlers who are not certified managers must obtain required food handler training.

headline: Failed: about 100 mouse droppings found
summary: About 100 or more mouse droppings under stove, near fryer, in cabinets, toilet room, storage office and behind freezers. Citation issued; pest service recommended. Gaps at screen and rear doors. No food handler or allergen training.

headline: Scoop stored in ice machine; cooler buildup
summary: Scoop stored inside ice machine; person in charge told to store in a clean, sanitized container between uses. Build-up on shelving in low two-door cooler. Oil splatters on prep area walls.

headline: Passed; pots on floor and wet mops
summary: Pots and cooking equipment stored on floor in dishwashing area must be raised 6 inches. Dust and food residue on prep shelving. Waste can lid needed in restroom. Wet mops stored in hallway buckets.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; missing records
summary: No certified manager on site, no employee health policy, no bodily fluid cleanup kit, no metal-stem thermometer, no test strips, no pest logbook, and no food handler certificates. Urinals not functioning.

headline: Failed: no ventilation in back bathroom
summary: Prior core violation not corrected: bathroom in rear dry storage and office has no mechanical ventilation. Manager instructed to provide sufficient ventilation. Citation issued.

headline: Push cart lacks business information
summary: Push cart is missing the business name, address and license number on its lateral sides. Operator must provide them.

headline: Failed: person in charge lacks valid certificate
summary: Person in charge has no valid City of Chicago sanitation certificate and no proof of enrollment within 90 days. Also noted: peeling duct tape on hand-sink splash guard, and prior violations not corrected.

headline: Re-inspection passed; rust and toilet room cleaning
summary: Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer. Rusty racks in walk-in cooler and rear storage. Prep carts and hand sink dirty. Toilet room needs cleaning; water-stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Revolving door gaps; soda syrup spills
summary: Quarter-inch gaps at revolving door sweeps must be rodent-proofed. Soda syrup spills on floor need cleaning. Some certified food managers lack allergen training certificates. Passed.

headline: Passed; toilets dirty, dim restroom light
summary: Several toilets have residue inside and outside. Boxes clutter the stairwell. First-floor staff toilet room has very little lighting. Manager instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Re-inspection: storage and cleaning corrections ordered
summary: Food stored on walk-in cooler floor; soiled wiping cloths left on prep tables; ice scoop left on prep table; milk crates used as shelving; torn walk-in gasket. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Mold-like buildup on racks; expired handler cards
summary: White mold-like buildup on storage racks inside walk-in cooler needs cleaning. Some food handlers have expired food handler training certificates and must have current ones.

headline: Passed; cleaning and maintenance items noted
summary: Ice machine interior needs detail cleaning. Cardboard liners on storage shelves must be removed. Coolers, prep shelves and walls need cleaning. Backflow device not located at mop sink. Litter outside; missing light shields.

headline: Undated ready-to-eat meats discarded; pests unclear
summary: Turkey, ham, roast beef and cheese lacked date marks; manager instructed to discard. Also: unlabeled packaged items, food and equipment on floors, fly strip in prep area, no hair restraint, and missing self-closing washroom door.

headline: Failed: front prep hand sink inoperable
summary: Front food prep handwashing sink was inoperable and would not turn on. Must be repaired. Citation issued.

headline: No manager certificate on site; door gaps
summary: Person in charge had no original certified food manager certificate or ID on site. Small openings at bottom of front doors must be sealed. Missing sink stopper; no working lights in rear dry storage closet. Passed with conditions.

headline: Hand sink blocked; dishwasher lacks sanitizer
summary: Dish/prep hand sink was blocked by a table; manager removed it. No paper towels. Chlorine dish machine showed 0 ppm and was tagged, not to be used. Missing ice scoop, beard guards needed, and duct tape repairs.

headline: Failed: four live roaches found on site
summary: Four live roaches found on wall and floor in prep area near rear exit and in basement near stairs. Pest control consultation recommended; citation issued. Also missing floor tiles, basement freezer ice buildup, and food debris.

headline: Undated cooked food; hair restraint lapse
summary: Cooked chicken and beans in walk-in cooler held over 24 hours without date marks. Food handler lacked hair restraint. Pooling water, no sink stoppers, missing backflow device on rear ice maker, and worn cooler gaskets.

headline: Failed: over 80 mouse droppings found
summary: Over 80 mouse droppings on floor and in cabinets in control panel room and rear storage. Manager instructed to call an exterminator and clean. No mechanical ventilation in customer washrooms; no waste receptacle at hand sink.

headline: Failed: two live roaches in prep area
summary: Two live roaches crawling on walls in prep area by hood and in dishwashing area. All live roach activity must be removed by reinspection. Grease and food debris in oven, cooler, floors and hood filters.

headline: Passed; greasy fryers and coolers
summary: Exterior of fryers greasy. Interior of prep coolers under grill, deep freezer and two-door cooler need cleaning and defrosting. Hood filters dirty above cooking equipment.

headline: Passed; floors need cleaning under equipment
summary: Floors under the bar, under the convection oven in the food prep area, and along walls need cleaning.

headline: Passed; peeling paint and dusty fan
summary: Wall next to basement stairwell has peeling paint and must be made smooth and easily cleanable. Dust built up on fan system in men's restroom. Person in charge instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Failed: peeling paint; items on floors
summary: Peeling paint on doorway to dry storage. Items stored on floors in walk-in and dry storage. Prior core violations not corrected: washroom door not self-closing, floor opening in washroom, damaged outlet cover, debris along walls.

headline: Sink use restricted; non-working deli cooler
summary: Three-compartment sink may only be used for warewashing; paper towels, soap and handwashing sign were removed. Non-operational deli cooler in prep area must be removed or repaired.

headline: Passed; missing thermometers and clutter
summary: No ambient air thermometers in front two-door prep cooler or dining refrigerator. No lidded trash in employee toilet. Unused equipment between walk-in cooler and freezer must be removed; mops not hung.

headline: Failed: no hot water; plumber not yet on site
summary: No hot running water throughout. Hand sinks at 72.5–74.3°F; three-compartment sink at 74.3°F, but must be at least 110°F. Plumber called at 4:30 p.m. but not yet on site; citation issued.

headline: No certified manager on duty while cooking
summary: No certified food manager on duty while chicken, steak and pork were prepared and served. Milk crates used as shelving and cardboard used as floor mats in prep and storage areas must be replaced.

headline: Passed; soiled mop heads; allergen training
summary: Soiled mop heads not properly stored; must be hung to prevent insect breeding. Food service sanitation manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Passed; front door gap and missing covers
summary: Half-inch gap at bottom of front door needs a rodent-proofing strip. Missing cold-water faucet knob at mop sink, and missing light switch cover in utility closet.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk containers, rear door gap
summary: Bulk rice and flour containers lack labels. Quarter-inch gap at rear exit door in rear storage must be sealed. Scoops stored inside dry containers; milk crates and grocery bags used for storage.

headline: Re-inspection: low pressure and slow drains
summary: Low water pressure at one basement men's washbowl sink. Slow-draining handwashing sink in men's employee toilet. Instructed to repair or replace and maintain in good condition.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; tomatoes past date
summary: No certified manager on site at first inspection while TCS foods were served; manager arrived about 20 minutes later. Roasted tomatoes past 7-day limit discarded. No consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods; no allergen training.

headline: Trash around outside bin; debris under equipment
summary: Excessive trash on the ground around the outside receptacle; person in charge told to remove it to prevent pest harborage. Dried food debris on floors under heavy equipment in front prep area.

headline: Hood filters need grease removal
summary: Hood filters have grease buildup and need cleaning. Instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: No employee health policy; ice maker lacks backflow
summary: No written employee health policy on premises (priority violation). Newly installed ice maker has no backflow prevention device. Burnt-out light bulbs at kitchen exhaust hood. Passed with conditions.

headline: Clean breading containers and refrigerator interior
summary: Breading storage containers and the interior of the refrigerator need cleaning. Routine upkeep items only.

headline: Re-inspection: grease, leaks and ceiling tile
summary: Grease and food debris on equipment and walk-in freezer. Leaky water line behind ice machine must be repaired. Women's garbage can needs a lid. Stained lobby ceiling tile, dusty vents and dirty floors.

headline: No certified manager; thermometer inaccurate
summary: No certified food manager on site and no certificate posted while milk was being steamed. Thermometer for front prep cooler is inaccurate. Passed with conditions.

headline: Yogurt, sandwiches and cheese too warm in cooler
summary: Display cooler air at 41.2°F; yogurt up to 48.5°F, chicken wraps up to 49.9°F, sandwiches up to 47.5°F. Management discarded 75 lbs ($646). Dust on two display cooler vents.

headline: Failed: deli meat and foods held at 51–53°F
summary: Deli meat at 52°F and shredded lettuce, tuna, chicken and cheese at 51–53°F in cold units. About 300 lbs discarded ($2,500). Prior violations not corrected, and the inspection summary was not posted.

headline: Dusty filters above griddle
summary: Passed. Filters above the griddle had dust buildup. The manager was instructed to clean them.

headline: Uncovered food and grime in fryer area
summary: Passed. Food was stored uncovered in coolers and was to be covered. Grease and food debris were inside the fryer cabinet. Spillage was on walls, shelving and prep-area floors. Staff were instructed to clean.

headline: Missing thermometer; boxes on floor
summary: Passed. Walk-in cooler needs a visible thermometer. Boxes were stored on the floor and must be raised six inches. Mop sink interior, floors under racks, and a baseboard opening next to the bread display need attention.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit on site
summary: Failed. The facility had no vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit. It also had no chemical test kit for warewashing. Mineral buildup was around ICEE and coffee dispensers, and the mop sink was heavily soiled. Citations issued.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; wall debris
summary: Passed. Some prep-area bulk containers were unlabeled and must be labeled. Food debris was on the prep wall behind the three-compartment sink and must be cleaned.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Passed with conditions. Two food handler certificates and a certified manager's allergen certificate were expired. Moldy caulking at the three-compartment sink must be replaced. Previous inspection summary was not posted. Citation issued.

headline: No sanitizer or water on truck
summary: Failed. Food truck had no chemical sanitizer and no water at the time of inspection. Priority violations were issued. A snowball prep table had four drain hoses draining into buckets; specifications were sent for approval. Sink leak and sticky floors noted.

headline: Hair restraints missing; expired allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Several food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Boxed food was stored on the walk-in cooler floor. Floor drains and floors need cleaning. Vent dust and a missing light shield must be addressed. One manager's allergen certificate is expired.

headline: Live roaches and mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. About 10 live roaches were found in several areas. About 50 mouse droppings were found in a front display cooler and shelves in the rear grocery area. Dead roaches were on floors and equipment. Citation issued.

headline: Foods and cooler held too warm; discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Several cold foods were held at 47-51F. Manager discarded about 35 pounds of pizza, yogurt and pasta salad. A cooler with 50F ambient air was tagged. Citation issued.

headline: Food debris and spills throughout facility
summary: Passed. Food debris and spills were found on floors and surfaces throughout the facility. Staff must detail clean under shelving, prep tables and cooking equipment, and clean more often.

headline: Live flies found; earlier violations not fixed
summary: Failed re-inspection. About 25 live small flies and 3 large flies were found in food prep and dining areas. A front door gap and earlier violations were not corrected. Citation issued.

headline: Summary not posted; women's restroom lights out
summary: Passed with conditions. The women's restroom lights do not work and must be repaired. The previous inspection summary was not posted for public view. Inspector left a new summary and instructed the facility to post it. Citation issued.

headline: Missing training, soap, paper towels and hot water
summary: Failed. No proof of food safety training for the person in charge, and no food handler training records. No current inspection summary was posted. Pest service report did not cover the food areas. Several sinks lacked soap, paper towels or hot water.

headline: Dishwasher bottom door will not open properly
summary: Passed. The bottom access door on the low-temperature dishwashing machine must be repaired so it opens and closes properly.

headline: Soiled prep bowls restocked; dirty floors
summary: Passed. Clear prep bowls were soiled after cleaning and stored ready to use. The person in charge was instructed to rewash them. Grease and debris are on floors, and dust is on vents and light shields. No proof of food handler training was seen.

headline: Mouse droppings and overflowing outdoor garbage
summary: Failed. Over 40 mouse droppings were found in front prep, rear prep and dishwashing areas. Outdoor garbage bags overflowed and lids would not close. Previous uncorrected violations include exposed pipe insulation and a leaking drain. Citations issued.

headline: Over 50 flies; foods held too warm
summary: Failed. Foods held at 44-48F were discarded, about 50 pounds total, valued at $300. Walk-in cooler ran at 45F and a technician serviced it. More than 50 flies were found throughout the facility, including in restrooms, kitchen and basement. Citations issued.

headline: Cleaning needed inside coolers, fryers and floors
summary: Passed. Inspector instructed cleaning of refrigeration and freezer interiors, fryers and shelving. Unused items in the rear storage area must be removed. Floors and walls under and behind equipment need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; several sink and dish machine issues
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager was on site while chicken was prepared. Bar handsink lacked soap and paper towels. Dish machine registered 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged. Restroom and prep-area repairs needed. Citations issued.

headline: Ovens outside hood; missing allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Two ovens in the prep area are not under an exhaust hood and need building department approval. No handwashing signs were posted. The sanitation manager had no allergen training certificate.

headline: Dishwasher at 0 ppm sanitizer; corrected on site
summary: Passed with conditions. Basement dish machine registered 0 ppm chlorine; the person in charge corrected it to 50 ppm on site. Hand soap was missing at a kitchen sink and supplied during inspection. Personal items were stored above food. Citation issued.

headline: Improper wiping cloth storage; lead-safety question
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer when not in use. Ceramic or clay drinking cups were on site and must be shown to be lead-safe, or removed.

headline: Dead flies in dining area; grease under equipment
summary: Passed. Dead large and small flies were found on dining-area windowsills and on the warewashing floor. A mop was not stored in a position to air-dry, which can attract pests. Grease and debris under cooking equipment must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager present during dairy service
summary: Passed with conditions. No city sanitation certificate was posted. No certified manager was on site while dairy beverages were prepared, and the manager arrived about 50 minutes later. Rear handsink was blocked and had no paper towels. Citation issued.

headline: Sugar bin and floors need relocating and cleaning
summary: Passed. A sugar bin used to refill the self-serve coffee station in the aisle must be moved to protect it. Sheet trays were stored leaning on the floor. Floors in dishwashing and prep areas need cleaning. A garbage lid was damaged.

headline: No hand soap; mislabeled bakery items
summary: Passed with conditions. Rear kitchen handsink had no soap; supplied during inspection. Citation issued. Pre-packaged baked goods lacked the manufacturer's address and common name. Styrofoam cups were used as scoops in dry food containers.

headline: No certified manager; dishwasher and handwashing problems
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were handled. Dishwasher was not dispensing sanitizer and was tagged out. Restroom sink lacked soap (supplied during inspection). Dead insects and grime were noted.

headline: Peeling paint and regrouting needed
summary: Passed. Peeling paint behind the oven must be repainted. Floor tiles in the rear kitchen prep area need regrouting.

headline: No allergen training documentation
summary: Passed. No certified food manager had allergen training. Anyone holding a city food sanitation certificate must complete training. Documentation must be provided.

headline: Oysters lack tags; foods held too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. Oysters had no shellstock tags and about 3 pounds were discarded. Cheese, fish, onions and pork fat were above 41F and about 9 pounds were discarded. Vacuum packaging lacked a required variance, and items were tagged and held.

headline: Only one customer restroom for 42 seats
summary: Failed. Only one customer washroom is accessible from the dining room. The facility must add a second customer washroom or reduce seating to no more than 30 seats. Currently 42 seats.

headline: No sanitation certificate; door gap; uncleaned equipment
summary: Passed with conditions. The person in charge had no city sanitation manager certificate while chicken and eggs were handled. Citation issued. The front door was not rodent-proofed at the bottom, the door sweep was torn, and equipment needs cleaning.

headline: Damaged rear screen; floor debris
summary: Passed. The rear screen door was in poor repair and could allow pests in. It must be repaired. Floors and floor mats need cleaning to remove debris. No pests were reported.

headline: Ice scoop stored inside ice machine
summary: Passed. An ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine and must be moved to a scoop holder. Floors along wall bases and under equipment in the front prep area need cleaning.

headline: No exposed handsink in rear prep area
summary: Failed. The rear prep and dishwashing area has no exposed handwashing sink. A sink with hot and cold water, soap and paper towels must be installed. No citation issued. Splash guards, floor grout and peeling paint also need attention.

headline: Dried food debris and trash in coolers and storage
summary: Passed. Excess dried food debris was found inside display coolers, which can attract pests. Trash and spills were on the floor of the garbage area, and debris was under shelving and in walk-in coolers. No pests were reported.

headline: Undated cooked beef; mop heads not hung
summary: Passed with conditions. Ready-to-eat cooked beef in the walk-in cooler was not date marked. Food was stored on the walk-in freezer floor. Soiled mop heads were not hung to prevent insect breeding. The sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Mouse droppings found; additional pest service needed
summary: Failed. About 20 mouse droppings were on the floor and storage rack in the side dry storage room, and about 10 at a corner shelf by the kitchen cooler. Staff must clean and remove them. More pest control service is needed. Citation issued.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food handling
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while deli meat and chicken were handled. No certificate was posted. Non-food items were stored on top of the bar ice maker and must be removed.

headline: Dusty cooler condenser; dishwashing wall debris
summary: Passed. Dust had built up on a two-door cooler condenser and must be cleaned. Debris was on the walls in the dishwashing area and must be cleaned.

headline: Milk crates used as shelves; dirty floors
summary: Passed. Milk crates were used as shelving in prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving raised six inches off the floor. Loose debris, dirt and dust are on floors and corners throughout the facility.

headline: Sink drainage backs up onto floor; repaired
summary: Passed with conditions. Water from the three-compartment sink backed onto the floor and into adjacent compartments. A technician repaired the sink on site. Unsealed wooden rice bowls, an unsealed brick wall and a broken basement cooler were also noted.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; menu disclosure missing
summary: Failed. Shredded cheese (46.6F), sour cream (46.9F), sliced tomatoes (48.9F), lettuce (53.1F) and raw eggs (56.5-58.7F) were above 41F. Manager discarded about 7 pounds. Menu lacked the raw-food warning. Citation issued.

headline: Cold foods too warm; cooler failed; dead flies
summary: Passed with conditions. Several cold foods were held at 47.9-55F. About 20 pounds were discarded. The salad line cooler was at 54.3F and was tagged out until repaired. About 5-10 dead house flies were found near rear shelves.

headline: Rear door gaps and no restroom lights
summary: Passed. The bottom of the rear exit door has openings that must be rodent-proofed. Handwashing signs were missing in restrooms. Carpet in rear storage must be removed. Toilet room and rear storage had no lights due to a power shortage.

headline: Worn cutting boards; greasy equipment and hood
summary: Passed. Worn cutting boards must be replaced. Cooking equipment has grease and dust buildup. Restroom needs cleaning. Floors under equipment, reach-in gaskets and hood vents need cleaning. Food handlers without certificates must obtain them.

headline: No covered receptacles in toilet rooms
summary: Passed. The toilet rooms have no covered trash receptacles. The facility must provide them.

headline: One certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. One certified food manager did not have an allergen training certificate. The facility must obtain training for all certified managers.

headline: Kitchen handsink runs continuously
summary: Passed. The kitchen handsink water kept running after the faucet was turned off. The manager was instructed to repair it.

headline: Dust, grease and missing handwashing signs
summary: Passed. Handwashing sign was missing near the front prep sink. Unisex washroom has no covered waste receptacle. Food debris and dirt are under cooking equipment and refrigerators. Heavy dust is on ceiling vents, and grease is on the hood and filters.

headline: No hand soap at bar sinks; cluttered basement
summary: Passed with conditions. Hand soap was missing at bar handsinks and was supplied during inspection. Wiping cloths were stored on surfaces. Floors, walk-in shelving and walls need cleaning. Basement clutter must be removed to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food
summary: Passed with conditions. No vomit clean-up supplies were on site. A food handler touched ready-to-eat sandwich ingredients with bare hands, and the manager was told to stop this. Disposable cups were used as scoops in bulk containers.

headline: Missing hair and beard guards; no food handler proof
summary: Passed. The sanitation manager prepared food without a hair net and beard guard. Cardboard was reused as shelf liner and must be removed. A male food handler lacked proof of food handler training.

headline: Unlabeled containers; dirty surfaces; expired certificate
summary: Passed. Kitchen food storage containers need common-name labels. Shelves, cooler interiors and floors need detail cleaning. The mop sink in the rear dishwashing area was removed and must be reinstalled. Certified manager's allergen training is expired.

headline: Mouse droppings on freezer; dish machine broken
summary: Failed. About 35 small rodent droppings were on a basement chest freezer and near stored equipment. Pest control service is recommended. The basement dish machine was inoperable and tagged. Shrimp was thawed on the counter. Citation issued.

headline: Rusty shelves; ice buildup in walk-in freezer
summary: Passed. Walk-in cooler shelving is rusted. Ice buildup around the walk-in freezer condenser must be defrosted. The unisex washroom needs a lidded garbage can. Ventilation above cooking equipment needs cleaning, and filters and a bulb need replacing.

headline: Dirty ice machine; ice discarded; door gaps
summary: Failed. Black dirt buildup in the large ice machine was dripping into ice. All ice was voluntarily discarded. The soda cooler has no thermometer. Half-inch gaps at revolving door sweeps must be rodent-proofed. Prep sink faucet is loose.

headline: Unattached restroom sink; dishwasher not sanitizing
summary: Failed. Restroom handsink is not attached to the wall and has no water connection, so staff cannot wash hands. Dishwasher registered 10 ppm sanitizer and was tagged. Two flats of raw eggs at 67-77F were discarded. Citations issued.

headline: Equipment too large for three-compartment sink
summary: Passed. Some multi-use equipment is too large to wash, rinse and sanitize in the three-compartment sink. The manager must install a larger sink, remove the items or use an approved alternative method.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; pest hiding risk
summary: Passed. Milk crates were used to raise items in kitchen, dish and dry storage areas. Inspector said this can hide pests and ordered proper shelving. Food must be stored 6 inches from the wall.

headline: Dirt, rust and unlabeled containers throughout
