summary: Passed. Several issues: unlabeled food containers, rusty shelving, food debris inside cooking equipment, a slow-draining sink, dust in vents and light shields, a burnt-out light and openings in rear walls near an exit.

headline: Dirty ice machines and grease throughout kitchen
summary: Failed. Pink buildup was found inside both ice machines. Grease, food debris and flour were on kitchen floors and under equipment, and the hood was greasy. Basement is cluttered. Prior core violations from 2023 were not corrected.

headline: Dusty, spilled and greasy surfaces throughout
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs were missing. Single-service items were stored on the floor and must be raised six inches. Food spills, dust on walls and ceiling tiles, and grease on floors near the grease recycling unit must be cleaned.

headline: Live German roaches; foods held too warm
summary: Failed. About 10 live German roaches were found in rear prep, under the cooking line, in the basement and in a staff toilet. Foods at 48.7-51.3F on a deep freezer were discarded (20 pounds). No sanitation certificate posted. Citations issued.

headline: Hot food too cool; mice and roaches found
summary: Failed. Hot foods were displayed at 94.8-101.5F instead of 135F or above. About 50 pounds were discarded. Over 40 mouse droppings were in rear storage. Numerous dead roaches were in prep, storage and furnace areas. Staff without hair restraints. Citations issued.

headline: Ice buildup on cooler vent; training gaps
summary: Passed. Ice buildup on the walk-in cooler vent must be corrected. Non-manager food handlers lacked food handler certificates, and the manager on duty lacked allergen training.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; repeated violations
summary: Failed. Over 100 mouse droppings were found in dry storage, near the three-compartment sink, on a furnace and in cooler bottoms. Staff must call an exterminator. Multiple earlier violations were not corrected, including unlabeled containers and a manager without allergen training.

headline: Loose debris and dust on floors
summary: Passed. Staff were told to move items off floors in the main prep area and basement. Loose debris and dust were found along walls and in corners throughout the basement and prep areas. Detail cleaning and more frequent cleaning are required.

headline: Cold-holding unit missing thermometer
summary: Passed. No thermometer was inside the cold-holding unit across from the sandwich and salad line. The facility must provide ambient air thermometers in all cold-holding units.

headline: Dead insects on basement floor; wall openings
summary: Passed. Dead insects were on the basement floor and must be cleaned. The grease trap exterior, cabinet interiors and countertops need cleaning. An opening behind the women's washroom door and separating flooring in the prep area must be repaired.

headline: Greasy outdoor oil tank container
summary: Passed. The outside oil tank container had grease on it and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Coolers too warm; multiple facility repairs needed
summary: Failed. Reach-in coolers held food at 57.2F and 65.4F; they must be kept at 41F or below. Other repairs are needed: a leaking faucet, a broken restroom door closer, missing trash receptacles, washroom ventilation and missing hood light bulbs.

headline: Items on floor; dust and peeling paint
summary: Passed. Food items at the front entrance and display area were not raised six inches off the floor. Milk crates were used for shelving. Dust is on ceilings, paint is peeling inside the produce cooler, and several light bulbs are burnt out.

headline: Pots too large for sink; stove not under hood
summary: Passed. Large pots do not fit the three-compartment sink and must be removed or a written cleaning procedure provided. Reach-in cooler interior was dirty, light fixtures inside it were burnt out, and a stove is not under an exhaust hood.

headline: Pest activity found; license suspended
summary: Failed. Doors were in poor repair, and no proof of pest control service was on file. Evidence of pest activity (about 100 noted, type not specified) was found. License suspended. Citation issued. Reopening procedures were discussed.

headline: Peeling prep-area paint; PIC lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. Peeling and damaged paint on prep-area walls must be repaired so surfaces are smooth and cleanable. The person in charge (PIC) had no allergen training, and must obtain it and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; droppings in several areas
summary: Failed. Ice and food were not protected. Black slime was in the ice machine. Over 30 droppings were in the bar area, rear dish room and liquor storage. Missing consumer advisory for undercooked food. Citations issued.

headline: Food handler certificates could not be verified
summary: Passed. Inspector could not locate or verify food handler certificates for food employees during the visit. The facility must provide and keep certificates on site.

headline: Greasy hood and dirty floors near cooking line
summary: Passed. Floors and walls near the dish machine and cook line need detail cleaning. The hood and filters have heavy grease buildup. One employee's allergen certification has expired.

headline: Scratched cutting boards; dusty vents
summary: Passed. Cutting boards in the rear prep area had deep scratches and stains and must be resurfaced or replaced. Dust on ceiling and wall vents in the prep area must be cleaned.

headline: Ready-to-eat foods held too hot; food discarded
summary: Failed. Ready-to-eat foods were held at 68-106F, below the 135F hot-holding minimum. Manager discarded about 80 pounds. Raw chicken thawed in hot water at 68.4F. Prepared foods were unlabeled. Citations issued.

headline: No certified manager during TCS handling; no date labels
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager was on site when TCS foods were handled. Citation issued. TCS foods lacked date labels in coolers. A 1/4-inch gap at the front door must be sealed. Food was uncovered and beverages were on the floor.

headline: Dusty ceiling vents in both washrooms
summary: Passed. Dust had built up on ceiling vents in both washrooms. The facility must clean and maintain them.

headline: Damaged ceiling tiles; rusty shelves; dirty drains
summary: Passed. Needed repairs: a thermometer in the salad cooler, rusty shelving in the walk-in, damaged ceiling tiles in the second-floor washroom, wall openings, regrouting and peeling paint. Floor drains had dirt and debris.

headline: Propped-open front door; missing thermometer
summary: Passed. The front door was propped open with no screen, which could let in pests. No thermometer was in the rear reach-in cooler. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. Wiping cloths were stored on cutting boards.

headline: Cold salsa and dairy mixture held too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. Green salsa (54.9F), red salsa (48.2F) and a milk mixture (48.2F) were above the 41F limit. The manager discarded about 5.3 gallons. Citation issued. Cutting boards with stains and open seams must be replaced.

headline: Missing wall bases and greasy fryer cabinets
summary: Passed. Multi-use utensils on shelves must be inverted. Grease and food debris must be cleaned from fryer cabinets and wheel bases. Missing or damaged wall bases in the prep area must be repaired. Raw wood paneling must be made smooth and cleanable.

headline: Door gap allows pest entry; torn cooler gasket
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the entrance doors must be sealed to prevent pests. A stained cutting board and torn gasket are in the prep cooler. Unisex washroom has no covered waste receptacle. Exhaust hood needs cleaning.

headline: Dirty coolers; floor tiles and sinks need repair
summary: Passed. Reach-in cooler interiors need cleaning. Dining-area handsink drains slowly. Missing and damaged floor tiles and grout were found. Cooking equipment has grease and dirt buildup, including dead insects. A two-compartment sink is leaking.

headline: Rusty shelving and openings into walls and ceilings
summary: Passed. Rusty food storage shelving in the basement prep area must be repainted or replaced. Women's washroom lacks a covered waste receptacle. Openings into the ceiling and walls in basement prep areas must be sealed.

headline: No certified manager present while cooking
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager was on site while burgers, sliced tomatoes and chicken were prepared and served. Citation issued. No thermometer was in the milk cooler. Floors and corners under fryers and rear storage need cleaning.

headline: No certificate posted; bare-hand food contact
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid city sanitation certificate was posted and no certified manager was present while TCS foods were prepared. No written employee health policy was on site. An employee touched ready-to-eat pancakes and bread with bare hands. Citations issued.

headline: Raw meat stored over ready-to-eat food
summary: Passed with conditions. Raw shrimp and salmon were stored above ready-to-eat carrots, sauces and cucumbers in the walk-in cooler. Citation issued. Ice machine had calcium buildup. Dry containers were unlabeled, and boxes and debris were outside.

headline: Open doors without screens; no handwashing signs
summary: Passed. Front and side doors were open with no screen doors, which can let pests in. Handwashing signs were missing. A prep handsink faucet was damaged. Fryers, refrigerators and floors need cleaning. No pests were reported.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Chicken (49.1F), beef (46.2F), oysters (51.0F), intestines (52.0F), tomatoes (54.7F) and eggs (52.0F) were above 41F. Manager voluntarily discarded about 15 pounds. Frozen shrimp was thawed in cold water. Hood and filters were heavily greasy.

headline: Plastic and cardboard shelf liners; leaking faucet
summary: Passed. Plastic liners on a prep-area shelf and cardboard liners in dry storage must be removed. The three-compartment sink faucet is leaking. The certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Mouse droppings, cooler too warm, many repairs
summary: Failed. Over 50 mouse droppings were found on shelves, floors, behind a toilet and in a wall opening. Hot-hold unit read 118.5-120.6F instead of 135F. Gaps under front and rear doors must be sealed. Employee health policies were not signed. Citations issued.

headline: No certified manager; dish machine at 0 ppm
summary: Passed with conditions. Food handlers prepared TCS foods without a certified manager on site. Employee-restroom handsink had no soap, supplied during inspection. Dish machine registered 0 ppm and was tagged. About 10 pounds of foods held above 41F were discarded.

headline: Missing thermometers and handwashing signs
summary: Passed. The first-floor restroom had no handwashing sign. Hot-hold and display coolers lacked thermometers. Cutting boards in deli, bakery and produce areas had open seams and dark stains and must be replaced.

headline: Frozen meat thawing in standing water
summary: Frozen turkey and sausage were thawing in water inside the walk-in cooler; the manager was told to thaw under cold running water or in refrigeration. The product was still frozen at inspection. Water on the floor under cooking equipment, and greasy floors under the stove need cleaning.

headline: Dry wall near mixer needs smooth surface
summary: Re-inspection passed. Inspector found drywall around the mixer and instructed the business to install a durable, smooth, cleanable surface there.

headline: Raw wood surfaces at front counter
summary: Raw wood surfaces at the front counter must be sealed so they are non-porous and easy to clean.

headline: Torn gasket and leaking faucet
summary: A torn gasket was inside the prep cooler door and must be repaired or replaced. The three-compartment sink faucet in the kitchen leaked and must be repaired. A dirty and dusty fan by the oven must be cleaned.

headline: Cold foods too warm; hot water too cool
summary: Prep handsink hot water was 63F and was fixed to 102-105F by a technician on site. Hand soap was missing from the bar prep handsink and was provided on site. Eggs, hamburger and bacon in the front prep cooler were held at 48-50F; 8 lbs were discarded.

headline: No vomit kit or written procedure; hairnet issue
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or written procedure was present; kit was ordered on site; citation issued. Bulk dry ingredients lacked common-name labels. An employee's hair was not properly contained in a hairnet.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; citation issued
summary: Failed complaint inspection. Over 100 mouse droppings were found throughout the business, including near a large pizza oven, inside two ovens and a fryer, in dry storage, and on basement shelves. All evidence of pest activity must be eliminated and affected areas cleaned and sanitized.

headline: Hair restraints; water-stained ceiling tiles
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints and must wear them when handling food. Food debris on walk-in cooler storage racks must be cleaned. Water-stained ceiling tiles in the toilet room and rear prep area must be replaced. A food handler lacked proof of food handler training.

headline: Dirty walls under bar and warewasher; allergen training
summary: Walls under the bar countertop and under the warewashing unit were not clean, with excessive debris and black substance; must be detail cleaned. A certified manager lacked allergen training and must obtain and keep verification on site.

headline: Food stored on walk-in freezer floor
summary: Food items were stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer and must be raised 6 inches. An inoperable thermometer on the drawer cooler must be replaced. Missing handwashing sign; no covered receptacle in the staff washroom; spills in basement storage must be cleaned.

headline: Dirt under display coolers; leaking faucet
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. Dirt and debris under display coolers and shelving units must be cleaned. A leaking faucet at the three-compartment sink must be repaired. A soiled mop head stored on the floor must be hung to dry to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Soda dispenser spills to wipe down
summary: Soda dispenser had spillage on the base and nozzles; the business was instructed to wipe down, clean and maintain it.

headline: Dish machine 0 ppm; walk-in too warm; discards
summary: Chlorine dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer; a technician serviced it on site. Cold TCS foods at 45-56F were discarded (about $250 value), including cooked pasta, lasagna, chicken and tiramisu. Dessert cooler at 50F and walk-in at 37-45F were repaired by a technician. Floors under equipment and shelving had soil and debris from a prior, unfixed violation.

headline: No vomit kit; front door not rodent-proof
summary: No vomit and diarrhea procedure or clean-up kit was on site; citation issued. The front entrance door was not rodent-proof at the bottom. Missing sink stoppers and test strips for sanitizer, a damaged cold-water knob, a dirty grill, floors and wall bases needing cleaning, and a blown light bulb.

headline: No dump sink at bar; expired allergen certificate
summary: No dump or preparation sink was at the bar and must be provided. A food allergen certificate was expired, and one food manager lacked allergen training; this was a foundation violation and a citation was issued.

headline: Grease in fryer cabinet; cracked floor tile
summary: Excessive grease and food debris were on the interior of the fryer cabinet and must be cleaned. Cracks in floor tile near the fryer must be repaired. Debris on the floor in the dry storage area with the hot water heater must be cleaned.

headline: No certified food manager during food prep
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager was on premises while chicken wings, sandwiches and fries were being prepared and served; a priority citation was issued and a manager must be present at all times. Also: food debris and dirt under the three-compartment sink and floors, and dust on a restroom fan.

headline: Unlabeled containers and ice scoop placement
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food storage containers not in original packaging must be labeled with the common product name. An ice scoop was stored on top of the ice bin and must be stored properly in a clean container.

headline: Grease under equipment and hood grates
summary: Grease pooled on the floor behind heavy equipment in the front prep area and was instructed to be removed. Ventilation hood grates had grease buildup and must be cleaned.

headline: Improperly stored ice scoop and boxes noted
summary: No pests found. Ice scoop was stored in an open wire rack touching the wall. Single-use articles were stored on the basement floor and must be raised 6 inches. Black buildup around handwash sink faucets and 3-compartment sink caulking must be cleaned. A toilet room covered receptacle was taped shut and must be made usable.

headline: Dish machine too cool; food near handsink
summary: Dish machine reached only 148.5F final rinse; the business must stop using it until repaired and reach 180F. Machine is tagged; contact CDPH before reuse. Missing handwashing signs. Shellfish and soup stock covered while cooling. Open coffee grounds and a cutting board stored next to a handsink.

headline: Front door gap; raw wood shelves
summary: Front door had about a 1/4 inch gap at the bottom and must be repaired to be tight-fitting. Raw wood storage shelves throughout must be sealed or painted. A certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate; several repairs
summary: No valid City of Chicago sanitation manager certificate was on site, which must be present at all times. Gaps in the rear exterior door and front double doors allow entry; must be rodent-proof. Also: damaged cooler gaskets, food debris on walk-in cooler and walls, a leaking restroom faucet, a broken door closer, and heavy grease in hood filters.

headline: Cluttered prep area and unused broken cooler
summary: No pests observed. Boxes and crates were in disarray in the rear prep area, and an unused, inoperable refrigeration unit was present. Inspector instructed removal of unnecessary items to prevent pest harborage and to keep the area organized.

headline: Dish machine rinse too cool; cold foods too warm
summary: Two high-temperature dish machines had final rinse temperatures of 140F and 152F; they must be repaired to reach 180F. Chicken at 51F and hamburgers at 47F in a 6-door cooler, which ran at 50F; all must be kept below 41F. No consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods. Missing light bulb and torn gasket; no allergen training for a manager, a repeat violation.

headline: No sanitizer at dish sink; corrected on site
summary: No sanitizer was available for the three-compartment sink. Manager sent an employee to buy chlorine sanitizer before the walkthrough ended. Employee then washed dishes correctly. Missing handwashing signs, utensils not inverted, and broken cardboard boxes used on the floor and shelves.

headline: Missing front handsink; fail on handwashing
summary: Failed license inspection. No handwashing sink was accessible to the front coffee and food service line; one must be installed with hot and cold water, soap and paper towels. An exposed prep handsink leaked during use and must be repaired. Several light shields were missing.

headline: Dirty soda nozzles and stained cutting boards
summary: Soda machine nozzles were encrusted with an unknown substance. All cutting boards were stained and deeply grooved. Cabinet with single-use containers had excess food debris. Leaking handsink and four-compartment sink faucet, floors under cooking equipment full of food debris, and stained ceiling tile near the hood need repair.

headline: Rat droppings in basement dry storage
summary: Over 10 rat droppings were on the floor and along the wall base of the basement dry storage area. Staff must clean, sanitize and eliminate pest activity, and consult a pest control company to treat the premises; citation issued. Also no soap at the prep handsink, no thermometers in refrigeration units, and food stored in grocery bags.

headline: Cutting boards and soda gun need cleaning
summary: Re-inspection passed. Serving plates on shelves were not inverted to prevent dust. Cutting boards with open seams and dark stains must be refinished or replaced. A slimy grey substance in the bar soda dispenser was to be cleaned and sanitized. Floors and drains need cleaning.

headline: About 40 mouse droppings; citation issued
summary: Approximately 40 mouse droppings were found scattered under shelving and between cold-holding units in dry storage. Staff must remove them, clean and sanitize the area; citation issued. Restroom window had broken glass covered with cardboard, damaged floors, a water-damaged ceiling tile, and a hole in a dry storage wall.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink motor
summary: Small leak from the motor connected to the wash compartment of the three-compartment sink; scheduled for repair later that day. Floors need cleaning under racks, shelves and fryers. All certified managers must get allergen training.

headline: Raw fish cross-contaminated with raw beef
summary: Raw beef was stored over and touching raw fish used for sushi. Beef was moved on site, and about 5.5 lbs of fish valued at $300 was discarded. Employee health policy and asterisk raw-food disclosure were corrected on site. Other issues: leaking drainpipe, missing washroom trash receptacle, non-working washroom ventilation, and no ice bin covers.

headline: Expired manager certificate; wall holes unsealed
summary: Person in charge did not hold a current City of Chicago sanitation certificate; the certified manager's certificate was expired while TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. Plastic soda and milk crates were used as shelving and must be replaced. Holes in the wall around the rear prep area need sealing and the floor under a cooler needs repair.

headline: Leaking pipe under hand sink; no waste lids
summary: A leaking pipe under the handsink must be repaired. Restroom garbage cans must have lids. A counter under the microwave needs debris removed. Working thermometers must be provided inside refrigerators.

headline: Ice machine debris; dish machine at 0 ppm
summary: Debris was encrusted in the ice machine and must be removed and serviced. The kitchen low-temperature dish machine had a 0 ppm chlorine final rinse; the manager must repair it. Many prior violations were not corrected by the 7/2/2026 deadline, including missing food handler training and expired allergen training.

headline: Wet wiping cloths and leaking faucet
summary: Wet wiping cloths were stored on handsink splash guards and must be kept in sanitizing solution when not in use. A leaking faucet at the cafe sink behind the bar must be repaired.

headline: Dirty ice machine guard and prep floors
summary: Interior guard of the ice machine had some dirt and was instructed to be detail cleaned. Coffee debris and spills were on the floor throughout the prep area and must be cleaned.

headline: Front door gap and dirty floors noted
summary: No pests found. Inspector saw a vertical gap along the front door frame and ordered repair to keep pests out. Wiping towels were hanging outside the sanitizing bucket; corrected on site. Dirt on floors and a sticky substance on the walk-in cooler handle and handsink were noted for more frequent cleaning.

headline: Scoop stored in ice; backflow device missing
summary: Ice scoop was stored in the ice bin with its handle touching the ice; staff were instructed how to store it. The backflow device on the rear mop sink was damaged or missing and must be installed. Loose debris, dirt and dust on floors and corners needs cleaning.

headline: Dish machine too cool; cold foods at 60-64F
summary: Dish machine final rinse was 156F; it was serviced on site and now reaches 180F. Milk, ranch and cocktail sauce held at 60-64F in a reach-in cooler were discarded (about 2 gallons, $40). Another cooler at 55F was discarded and replaced. A water service sink on the first floor had no hot water and must be repaired.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; no splashguard
summary: Black slimy substance was on the ice maker's interior water components and dripping into ice used for consumption; the machine must be turned off, ice removed, and the interior cleaned and sanitized; citation issued. No splashguard at the front prep handsink. Storage racks in the walk-in cooler had mold-like buildup.

headline: Dead roaches behind wall poster
summary: Dead roaches were found behind the wall poster above the three-compartment sink. Staff must remove them, clean, sanitize and maintain the area. Greasy walls around the cooking equipment and dirty floors under equipment also need cleaning.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea procedure; unlabeled foods
summary: No written procedure or supplies for vomit or diarrhea cleanup were present; citation issued. TCS foods in coolers lacked date labels; the manager added some. Bulk salt and sugar were unlabeled. Food handler had no hair restraint. Mop was not stored to dry. Missing light shield; no food handler training proof on site.

headline: Deep grooves on cutting boards; cooler gasket torn
summary: A cutting board in the rear prep area was covered in deep grooves and dark stains and must be repaired or replaced. A 2-drawer cooler under the grill had a torn gasket. Leaks from the hallway ceiling near restrooms and office and grease in fryer cabinets need repair and cleaning.

headline: Mold in basement ice machine; expired allergen cards
summary: Pink and black mold-like substance was in the upper interior of the basement ice machine; ice must be destroyed and the machine cleaned and sanitized. An opening at the front door base must be sealed. Food stored on floors and pallets. Dust on vents, buildup on hood filters, and expired or missing allergen certificates.

headline: Floors around kitchen equipment need cleaning
summary: Inspector instructed the business to clean floors around and behind equipment in the kitchen where needed.

headline: No allergen training certificate on site
summary: License re-inspection passed. No allergen training certificate was on site. The business must provide allergen training for all certified food managers.

headline: Unclean fan guards and basement ceiling hole
summary: Fan guard covers in the basement walk-in cooler were unclean and must be cleaned. A hole in the basement ceiling must be repaired.

headline: Missing sink stoppers, raw wood, and no allergen training
summary: Only one stopper was present for the three-compartment sink. Raw wood under the front counter must be sealed. Reach-in coolers lacked shelving. No covered waste receptacle was in the washroom. Openings and cracks in walls and floors need repair. Certified manager had no allergen training.

headline: No certified manager on duty; core violations
summary: No person in charge held a valid Chicago food sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was on duty while TCS foods were handled; citation issued. Ice scoop was stored in the ice machine, no grease trap was located, and there was no covered trash receptacle in the employee toilet room. Grease and dirt under equipment and dust in fans and vents.

headline: Raw wood flooring in walk-in; leaking sink
summary: Raw wood used as flooring in the walk-in cooler had heavy food debris and uneven rust-stained floors. It must be restored, deep cleaned and sealed. A three-compartment sink sanitizing basin leaked and must be repaired.

headline: Unlabeled flour; milk crates; expired allergen certs
summary: Dry food including flour must be labeled with common names. A bucket of sanitizer and linens must be at prep tables. Milk crates must not be used for elevation. Debris on shelves and broken floor tiles need attention. Allergen training certificates from 2023 were expired.

headline: Foil lining in beverage cooler; slow sink drain
summary: Re-inspection passed. Aluminum foil was used as a liner in the beverage cooler in the front wait area and must be replaced with a smooth, cleanable material. A slow-draining basement prep handsink must be repaired.

headline: Rodent-entry door gap, missing ceiling tiles, rust
summary: No pests observed, but the main entrance double door has about a 1/2 inch gap at the bottom that must be made rodent-proof. Also: missing handwashing signs, rusty shelving, a slow-draining sink, dust and dirt on vents and lights, missing ceiling tiles, and food debris on the floor.

headline: Slow drain at main kitchen handsink
summary: Main kitchen handwashing sink drained slowly and was instructed to be repaired and maintained.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; damaged faucet
summary: Missing handwash signs at all four exposed sinks must be provided. Milk crates were used as shelving in prep and storage and must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. A damaged faucet at one compartment sink must be repaired. Grease and dirt on floors and corners need cleaning.

headline: Wiping cloths left on prep tables
summary: Re-inspection passed. Wiping cloths were left on prep tables and must be stored in sanitizer solution between uses.

headline: Ice machine interior shield needs cleaning
summary: Interior shield of the ice machine was in need of cleaning and was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Black buildup over ice; cold-holding issues
summary: Black substance was above the ice in the ice machine by the meat department; it must be cleaned and sanitized; citation issued. Fish was thawed in standing water and must be thawed under running water. Food containers on floors must be raised 6 inches. Cutting boards with stains and open seams. Food service manager lacked allergen training.

headline: No valid manager certificate or food handler training
summary: No person in charge held a valid City of Chicago certificate, and no valid certificate was posted; citations issued. No vomit and diarrhea procedure or supplies; no test kit for sanitizer; no drainboard on the three-compartment sink; debris and shelving near coolers in sales area; missing light shields; no food handler training.

headline: Torn freezer gaskets and missing allergen training
summary: Torn gaskets were on the inside of a reach-in freezer in the rear and must be repaired. Food handlers lacked proof of food handler training certificates; a certified manager lacked allergen training certificate.

headline: No certified manager on site while open
summary: No certified food manager was on site while open; a photo of the certificate was shown by phone; citation issued. Raw beef was stored on the floor beside a handwashing sink. No ambient thermometer in the rear prep cooler. Grease on hood filters and no allergen certificate for the manager.

headline: Dish machine too cool; tagged out of use
summary: High-temperature dish machine did not meet the 180F final rinse requirement and was tagged; the business must not use it until reinspected by CDPH; citation issued. Damaged dry storage and dish room floor tiles must be repaired. Dirty ceiling vents in prep, dish and toilet areas.

headline: Unfinished wood bar rail and urinal plumbing
summary: Unfinished wood along the bar rail must be covered with a smooth, cleanable surface. The plumbing for the men's room wall urinal is not installed and must be.

headline: No ventilation in restrooms
summary: All restrooms lacked ventilation. Inspector instructed installation of a mechanical vent in all three.

headline: Wall gap near staff washroom
summary: Wall leading to the staff washroom was in disrepair. An opening in the wall must be closed to prevent pest entry.

headline: Dead roaches on glueboards; grease buildup
summary: Dead roaches were found on glueboards; they must be removed and affected areas cleaned and sanitized. Cardboard and foil lined shelves and fryers, rust, and worn shelves above the sink were noted. Food debris and grease buildup in cabinets, coolers and under the grill. Waste water backed up from a floor drain; a plumber repaired it during inspection.

headline: Rusty shelf base and faucet leaks
summary: Re-inspection passed. Encrusted food on a can opener blade must be cleaned. A rusty, holed shelf base by the low-temp dish machine, covered with foil, must be replaced. Both three-compartment sink faucets were wrapped in cloth due to heavy leaking. Walk-in freezer has excess ice, and ceiling tiles, fixtures and grease buildup need cleaning.

headline: Dish machine lacked temperature indicator
summary: Front handwashing sink caulk was in poor repair and must be replaced. No irreversible temperature indicator was on site for the high-temperature dish machine; the manager obtained one during inspection; citation issued. Excessive grease on exterior surfaces of pizza ovens must be cleaned.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Re-inspection passed. Some food handlers had expired food handler training certificates and must provide current ones. A certified food manager had an expired allergen training certificate. Greasy dumpster enclosure exterior needs cleaning.

headline: Improper frozen hamburger thawing; broken gaskets
summary: Frozen hamburger was thawed improperly. Thawing must be under refrigeration at 41F or below, fully under running water, or in a microwave immediately cooked. Thermometers must be visible in all prep and reach-in coolers. Broken gaskets on two reach-in coolers, mold-like buildup on metal racks, and leaves and debris behind the dumpster must be fixed.

headline: Food containers lacked common-name labels
summary: Food storage containers without labels containing common food names were observed; the business was instructed to provide labels.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup plan or kit
summary: Facility had no written procedure or kit for cleaning up vomit and diarrhea, which is a priority citation. Also: no handwashing sign at the front sink, thawing food on a rear table, a loose scoop stored on the ice machine, torn freezer gaskets, and a mop stored in a bucket.

headline: Stock too low; knife stored unsafely
summary: Stock in the rear area must be stored on racks 6 inches off the floor, with space to clean underneath. A knife was stored between the three-compartment sink and the wall and needs a proper holder. A large can opener blade, fryer sides and floors under prep tables also need cleaning.

headline: Scoops with handles in food; missing handle
summary: Scoops in dry storage bins had handles touching food and must be stored so handles do not contact food. Missing cold water handle at the men's room sink; hot water still works, and the sink can be used but must be repaired. Four bathrooms lacked handwashing signs.

headline: Raw wood surfaces and low hot water pressure
summary: Raw wood under the customer and coffee counters must be sealed. Hand-washing sink had low hot water pressure and must be increased. Raw wood coving under the three-compartment sink must be replaced with smooth, cleanable coving.

headline: Pink buildup inside ice machine
summary: Slight pink buildup was inside the upper portion of the ice machine. The manager was instructed to clean the interior and maintain it.

headline: Cracked display glass; hot water too cool
summary: A crack in the front glass food display must be repaired or replaced to avoid contamination. Hot water at the three-compartment sink was 98-100F; the engineer adjusted it on site to 110F. Certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Cutting boards, rusty racks, and dirty floors
summary: Cutting boards in the rear prep area had deep scratches and stains and must be resurfaced or replaced. Rusty storage racks in the walk-in cooler must have rust removed. Dirt on floors along walls throughout prep areas needs cleaning.

headline: Cold foods above 41F; discarded on site
summary: Burgers at 50.1F, chicken at 48.9F, sausage at 50.1F and eggs at 52.3F were in a preparation cooler. Manager voluntarily discarded about 15 lbs (valued at $75). Business must keep cold TCS foods at 41F or below. Also: no splash guard at the rear hand sink and no allergen training for managers.

headline: Hair restraint lacking; clutter near mop sink
summary: Re-inspection passed. One food handler was without a hair restraint and all handlers must wear one. Clutter near the mop sink in the rear dishwashing area must be cleared.

headline: Dirty floors in furnace room and front station
summary: Floors in the corners of the furnace room and at the front station needed cleaning to remove debris.

headline: Food debris on handsinks; dusty ceiling
summary: Food debris was on prep area handsinks around the handles and must be cleaned. Dust was on ceiling tiles and vent covers above the lower-level dish machine and must be cleaned along with walls there.

headline: Glove contamination and cold food temperatures
summary: Employee touched bread and sliced onions with gloves that had handled trash, without changing gloves; manager corrected it on site. Ready-to-eat foods including tomatoes, ham, milk, lettuce, eggs and cheese were held above 41F; about 115 lbs discarded. Walk-in cooler was at 50-52F and was turned on; later read 38.7F. Also a 1/4-1/2 inch door gap, grease and debris, a leaking faucet, a broken walk-in door, and missing food handler training certificate.

headline: Ice machine mineral buildup; greasy cooking equipment
summary: Interior of the ice machine had minor mineral buildup and must be cleaned. Grease was encrusted on the exterior of the oven, grill and fryer at the main prep line and must be cleaned.

headline: No covered waste receptacles in washrooms
summary: Covered waste receptacles were not provided in any washroom and must be provided and maintained.

headline: No certified manager; beef held at 80.4F
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while TCS foods were handled. Ten lbs of beef and rice balls were held at 80.4F on the counter and discarded (valued at $60). Cold foods must be kept at 41F or below. Also: missing labels on grab-and-go pastas and sauces, and cannoli shells stored in cardboard boxes.

headline: Manager lacked proof of allergen training
summary: Re-inspection passed. A City of Chicago food service manager on site had no proof of allergen training at the time of inspection. The business must provide proof of allergen training for all City of Chicago food service managers.

headline: Cold TCS foods too warm; $115 discarded
summary: Many ready-to-eat foods including tuna, turkey, crab, salami and meatballs were held above 41F in two prep coolers; about 22.5 lbs ($115) was discarded. Coolers were at 47.3F and 52.2F and were tagged held for inspection. Also: missing food handler training, expired and missing allergen training, and no prior summary report posted.

headline: Food stored on floor; leaking drainpipe
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and prep and storage areas and must be elevated 6 inches. Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced. Bulk flour and sugar were unlabeled. Leaking drainpipe at men's room handsink was taped and must be repaired. Missing handwashing sign.

headline: Missing hand soap and paper towels; citations
summary: Hand soap was missing at the prep handsink and was provided on site. Paper towels were missing at the exposed prep sink. No hand washing sign in the washroom. Cutting board grooved and stained, under-sink area dirty, reach-ins dirty, and no allergen training on site.

headline: Dirty mop sink; debris outside; no lid
summary: Mop sink was extremely dirty and must be cleaned. Women's and unisex washrooms lacked covered waste receptacles. Food debris (cheese and grapes) surrounded the outdoor waste container, which had no tight-fitting lid; this is a foundation violation with a citation.

headline: No employee health policy; no kit on site
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site; a template was left and copies signed by employees must be kept on site. No vomit and diarrhea kit was on site; a kit with sanitizer effective against norovirus was required. Torn gasket on the two-door prep cooler. No allergen training certificates on site.

headline: Spills on bar floor
summary: Spills were on the floor in the bar area. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Ice bin interior needs cleaning
summary: The ice bin interior needed cleaning. Staff were instructed to remove ice, clean and maintain it at all times.

headline: Unlabeled bulk foods; containers not inverted
summary: Some bulk foods, including sugar and flour, were unlabeled and must be labeled. Some food containers were not stored inverted and must be stored properly.

headline: No allergen certificates; missing lights
summary: Re-inspection passed. No allergen training certificates were on site for the certified manager. No food handler certificates were shown for all handlers. Missing lights near the three-compartment sink in the first floor prep area; excess clutter in the basement mechanical room must be removed and items raised 6 inches.

headline: No sanitizer at dish sink; corrected on site
summary: No employee health policy was on site; instructed to obtain and maintain one. No sanitizer was at the three-compartment sink; the person in charge provided chlorine sanitizer before inspection ended. No ambient air thermometers in cold holding units.

headline: Utensils stored in stagnant water
summary: Scoops and utensils were stored in stagnant water in the dipper well in the front prep area. Inspector instructed that utensils be stored in continuously running water when not in use.

headline: Coolers too warm; no thermometer or pest log
summary: License inspection failed. Three reach-in coolers were at 50 to 52°F air temperature and must stay at 41°F or below. No stem thermometer was on site, and no complete pest control logbook was available.

headline: Rodent droppings, live flies, moldy ice machine
summary: Failed. About 20 small rodent droppings were found in the office and near the hot water tank. About 15 small live flies were in the prep and dish area. Mold was on an ice machine panel dripping into ice; a priority citation was issued. Pest control is required.

headline: Patio roof holes need repair
summary: License inspection passed. Corrugated roof panels on the first-floor patio have three large holes. The facility was instructed to repair and seal them.

headline: Handwashing signs missing at hand sinks
summary: Passed. No handwashing signage was posted at hand sinks, and the facility must provide it.

headline: Kitchen floors soiled; cleaning ordered
summary: Short complaint inspection passed. Soil buildup was found on the floor throughout the kitchen. The manager was instructed to ensure floors are cleaned and maintained.

headline: Rear door gap, labeling, and upkeep fixes
summary: Passed. Inspector found a gap under the rear double doors that must be sealed tight. Also needed: labels on packaged cut fruit, a missing freezer handle, ice buildup, debris, stained ceiling tiles, and food handler training for new staff.

headline: Food stored on floor; debris on equipment
summary: Passed. Food was stored directly on the floor in the prep area and must be raised six inches. Food debris and spills were found on cooking equipment, shelves, coolers, freezers, and floors along walls and corners. Manager instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Missing food handler training; floor repairs
summary: Re-inspection passed. An employee had no food handler training and must receive it. Damaged floor tiles and loose wall base in the rear prep and dish area need repair. Grease on the hood must be cleaned.

headline: Mold in ice machine; low hot water
summary: Failed. Pink and black mold-like substance was found inside the ice machine used for ice, a priority citation. Hot water was too low: hand sinks were 80 to 90°F and the three-compartment sink 90 to 95°F. A leak under a sink and no certified allergen training were also noted.

headline: Certified manager absent; sink sanitizer not used
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager was present from 8:30 to 9:35 AM while eggs and beef were prepared; a citation was issued. A dishwasher used the three-compartment sink without sanitizer setup. Grease, debris, and no food handler certificates also noted.

headline: Pastry cooler too warm; discarded; tagged
summary: Complaint inspection passed with conditions. Pastry cooler items at 46.6 to 48.6°F were discarded, about 2 pounds ($201). Ambient air was 52.8°F, and the cooler is tagged and may not be used until reinspected. Rust was on the ice machine interior.

headline: Cold water fix; milk crates, foil liner
summary: Re-inspection passed. Aluminum foil liners on cooking equipment must be removed. Milk crates holding eggs and beer in walk-in coolers must be replaced with shelving. Cold water was not running at the three-compartment sink and must be restored.

headline: Dead flying insects; floor storage and gaps
summary: Re-inspection passed. Dead flying insects were on the front window sill and must be removed. A quarter-inch gap at the front door must be sealed. Food and boxes were stored on the floor, and freezers had excessive ice.

headline: No certified staff; cooler and dish machine failures
summary: Failed. No valid sanitation certificate was posted or on site while food was prepared and served; a citation was issued. Two coolers held food at 45 to 49.6°F and were tagged. The dish machine had under 10 ppm chlorine and was tagged. Sushi bar sink is clogged.

headline: Low hot water, blocked hand sink, expired training
summary: Failed. Hot water at a restroom hand sink was 95.2°F; it must reach 100°F. A rear prep hand sink was blocked by a lettuce strainer, removed during inspection. A cooler thermometer was broken, and food handler training had expired.

headline: Undercooked menu items lacked required advisory
summary: Failed re-inspection. Sunny-side-up eggs, smoked salmon, and burgers can be ordered undercooked, but the menu lacked the required disclosure. Also: rusted shelves, cardboard shelf liner, a detached drainboard, and a bar sink missing its faucet with no cold water.

headline: Missing cleanup kit and handwashing soap
summary: Passed with conditions. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or kit was on site; a citation was issued. Soap was missing or dispensers held water at handwashing sinks. A food handler lacked a hair restraint in the prep area.

headline: Dirty floors and mop storage
summary: License inspection passed. The floor beneath the three-compartment sink and grease trap had dust and dried food debris. A mop head was stored touching a utility closet wall and needs a hanging rack.

headline: Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer
summary: Passed. Dirty wiping cloths were on prep tables and not stored in sanitizer. Serving plates were not inverted, and torn gaskets were found on a prep cooler and a chest freezer. Rusty shelves and missing floor tiles also need repair.

headline: Missing training; repeat backflow violation
summary: Failed. Heavy grease and food debris were on foil under the grill. Several employees lacked food handler training, and no allergen certificates were on site. A repeat violation: the backflow device was not located behind the coffee machine; a citation was issued.

headline: No food handler certificates; thermometer, wall repairs
summary: Re-inspection passed. A broken ambient air thermometer in the Pepsi cooler must be replaced. A hole in the lower wall under the three-compartment sink must be sealed. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: No certified manager; one toilet for 30+
summary: Re-inspection failed. No certified food manager was on duty while ready-to-eat foods were prepared; the manager arrived at 12:47 PM and a citation was issued. Only one toilet room serves 30 or more patrons and employees. Food handler and allergen training were missing.

headline: Six live roaches in prep area; failed
summary: Failed. Six live roaches were found on the floor and walls of the prep area. The manager must remove all roach activity by re-inspection; a priority citation was issued. Also: food debris on shelves and sinks, damaged cooler gaskets, and a missing sink knob.

headline: Clean wall behind grill
summary: Passed. The wall of the food prep area behind the grill needs cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; handwashing and bare-hand violations
summary: Failed. An employee handled cash, then made a sandwich without washing hands and touched avocado bare-handed for a customer. A front hand sink was blocked. No certified manager was present during sandwich prep; a certificate was provided later.

headline: Scoop in sugar; microwave; loose sink
summary: Passed. A scoop was stored with its handle in sugar and must be moved. Debris was inside a microwave. Grout is missing at a toilet room hand sink, which appears detached from the wall.

headline: Warm rice discarded; overflowing dumpsters
summary: Failed. Rice held at 60.2 to 68.5°F in the walk-in cooler; 30 pounds was discarded. Frozen meats were thawing on prep tables. Dumpsters overflowed, preventing lids from closing; a priority citation was issued.

headline: Rodent droppings and unsafe food temperatures found
summary: Failed. About 10 rodent droppings were under the three-compartment sink and 3 outside the walk-in cooler. About 200 pounds of food held at 44 to 47°F was discarded. Walk-in cooler air was 52°F. Hand sink lacked soap, and citations were issued.

headline: Ice machine cleaning, labels, faucet repairs
summary: Passed. The bottom of the ice machine needs detail cleaning. Food containers need common-name labels. Rusty basement cooler racks need repainting, and a leaking hand sink and stripped cold faucet need repair. No approved allergen certificate was available.

headline: Two hand sinks lack water; cold food discarded
summary: Failed. No certified manager with a valid certificate was on site while food was prepared; a citation was issued. Two prep hand sinks had no hot or cold water. Cold food at 50 to 58°F, about $1,070 of it, was discarded. Slime was found on an ice machine lid.

headline: Missing backflow device, door closer, thermometer
summary: License inspection passed. The utility sink has no backflow device, and the washroom door lacks a self-closing device. A covered receptacle and a visible thermometer in the small cooler are missing. Wall holes and stored mop need fixes.

headline: Food under sewer lines; dim walk-in cooler
summary: Passed. Food containers stored in the basement under cast iron sewer lines must be moved or the pipes enclosed. Disposable cups and spoons are used in food production and should be replaced with durable utensils. The walk-in cooler needs more light.

headline: Employee items stored with dry food
summary: Passed. Employees' personal items were stored on dry food storage shelves. The facility was instructed to separate them.

headline: Dead roaches, 100+ rodent droppings, no manager
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site while potentially hazardous foods were prepared; a citation was issued. About 100 to 150 rodent droppings were found in the basement and under the furnace. Dead roaches were under meat hanging under sewer lines; 5 pounds was discarded.

headline: Floor storage, leaks, and damaged shelves
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Food and drink boxes were stored on the floor in a side closet and must be raised six inches. Two sinks have leaks. Several shelves are damaged or rusted, and personal bags were stored with single-service items.

headline: 40+ rodent droppings; no certified manager on site
summary: Failed. No person in charge or certified manager was on site while chicken, beef, and pork were prepared; a citation was issued. About 40 rodent droppings were found in the middle storage area and 20 by the three-compartment sink. A food handler touched garbage, then meat, with gloves on.

headline: Wall, floor, and counter repairs needed
summary: License inspection passed. Chipped paint in prep and service areas, an unsealed prep-area threshold, counters that are not easily cleanable, a misinstalled basement wall base, damaged wood flooring, and missing toilet room wall tile must be repaired.

headline: Ice bin dirty; outdoor cooler; no training proof
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food and equipment were stored in an outdoor patio cooler. Ice bin and can opener were dirty, and cutting boards had deep cuts. Leaking backflow device at mop sink. No proof of food handler or allergen training was on site.

headline: Dusty light shields in rear prep
summary: Passed. Dust had built up on light shields in the rear prep area. The facility was instructed to detail clean them and keep them in good condition.

headline: Broken cooler door and damaged floors
summary: Re-inspection passed. Stored items in the front prep area must be raised off the floor. A broken glass door on a tall reach-in cooler must be replaced. Floors in the prep and dish area have large divots, and dusty ceiling vents need cleaning.

headline: Rat droppings and warm fish cooler found
summary: Failed. Ceviche and raw salmon were held at unsafe cold temperatures, and the salmon was discarded. A fish display cooler ran at 49.5 to 55.8°F and is tagged, not to be used until repaired. About 40 to 50 rat droppings were found in the rear storage area.

headline: Backflow device and restroom door fixes needed
summary: License inspection passed. The utility sink in the rear storage room has no backflow device, and the washroom door has no self-closing device. The owner was instructed to install both.

headline: Hair restraint, gaskets, and leaks needed
summary: Re-inspection passed. A food handler needs an effective hair restraint. A front reach-in cooler has torn gaskets, and a rear cooler's gaskets need cleaning. Leaks were found at the three-compartment sink faucet and a proofer oven.

headline: Failed: no vomit cleanup plan; undercooked menu items
summary: Failed. No written procedure or cleanup kit for vomit or diarrhea events. Menu items such as over-easy eggs and steak were not disclosed as raw or undercooked. A cook lacked a hair restraint, and wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizer.

headline: Chicken at 75–86°F; flies found; toilets broken
summary: Failed. About 3 lb of chicken held at 75 to 86°F was discarded; a citation was issued. About 12 small flies were in prep, restroom, and dish areas. Both employee and customer toilets were inoperable. Hand soap was missing at a prep sink.

headline: Handwashing lapses; uncorrected hand sink violation
summary: Re-inspection failed. A food handler did not wash hands between tasks, handling cash and then cutting mangos while wearing a glove; a citation was issued. Kitchen ice machine was dirty. Blue wiping cloths were left on counters, and a prior hand sink violation was not corrected.

headline: 75+ mouse droppings; cold food and no manager
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on duty while chicken, rice, fish, and shrimp were prepared; a citation was issued. Over 75 mouse droppings were found in prep and storage areas. Food at 62 to 63°F was discarded, and the walk-in cooler ran at 64°F.

headline: Warm chicken salad; prep cooler tagged
summary: Complaint inspection passed with conditions. Chicken salad and sliced tomatoes at 60.3°F were discarded ($25). A prep cooler ran at 63.5°F and is tagged, not to be used. Prep cooler interiors were dirty, and floors near the ice cream drain need cleaning.

headline: Grease, debris, and floor grouting needed
summary: Re-inspection passed. Debris must be cleaned from the grill table and dish machine. Floors in the rear prep area at coolers and cooking equipment must be grouted. Filters and hood have excessive buildup.

headline: Eggs held at 79–91°F; repeat violations found
summary: Failed. Four dozen eggs on the floor were at 79 to 91°F, and cooked egg rolls were at 73°F; the person in charge discarded them. Employees lacked hair restraints. Repeat violations included missing food handler certificates and allergen training.

headline: Door gaps, unlabeled container, grease buildup
summary: License inspection passed. Two front entrance doors and the bar exit door have bottom openings and must be rodent-proofed. A bulk container in the basement lacked a label. Cutting boards were stored on the floor, and grease needs cleaning.

headline: Missing thermometer and test kit; food on floor
summary: Failed. No metal stem thermometer was on site to check cooked, delivered, and served food; a citation was issued. Food containers were stored on the floor, milk crates were used as shelves, and no sanitizer test kit was available. A three-compartment sink also leaks.

headline: Mop storage and basement clutter corrections
summary: License inspection passed. Soiled mop heads were not stored properly and must be hung to prevent insect breeding. Unused equipment and unnecessary articles in the basement storage area must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Ten live roaches found; prior issue uncorrected
summary: Failed re-inspection. Ten live roaches were found in prep, dining, waitstation, and warehouse areas, and two dead roaches were removed. A prior pest violation was not corrected; pest control service is required. Grease and soil were on equipment and pipes.

headline: Over 90 flies; dish machine tagged; food discarded
summary: Failed. Over 90 small flies were in the bar, around garbage containers and sinks, and in dish areas. Pest control service is needed. A low-temperature dish machine had no sanitizer at the final rinse and was tagged. About 24.5 pounds of food was discarded.

headline: Dust, missing light shield, burned-out bulbs
summary: License inspection passed. Dust was on the ceiling and walls near the beverage station. A light shield was missing above the three-compartment sink. Burned-out bulbs near the front line must be replaced.

headline: Cold foods at 44–49°F discarded; cooler tagged
summary: Passed with conditions. Various cold foods held at 44 to 49°F were discarded, about $55 worth; a citation was issued. A cooler's air temperature was 48°F and it is tagged. A large kettle needs a clean-in-place procedure, and shelving has soil and dust.

headline: Unlabeled containers and dirty wall bases
summary: Passed. Food storage containers must be labeled when food is not in its original container. Dirt and debris along wall bases in the rear prep and dish areas must be cleaned.

headline: No certified food manager during food prep
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site while cooked proteins and vegetables were being prepared; a citation was issued. No pest control log book was available. A dough bin and food wrap were stored wedged between walls.

headline: No cleanup kit; no backflow devices
summary: License inspection passed with conditions. No bodily fluid cleanup kit was on site. Hand sinks lacked handwashing signs, and the ice machine and coffee maker had no visible backflow device. Missing base coving was near outlets.

headline: Missing utensil surface temperature indicator
summary: Failed. The facility had no irreversible temperature indicator to check utensil surface temperature. Only water-temperature test strips were on site. The manager was instructed to provide the correct indicator. No citation was issued.

headline: Flies found; hand sink water too cool
summary: Failed. Hand sinks ran at 88 to 92.7°F, below the required 100°F. Over 25 small flies and over 10 large flies were found in several areas. Sliced tomatoes at 50.7°F were discarded. Shellstock tags lacked sale dates.

headline: Over 15 live flies in rear mop area
summary: Failed. Over 15 small live flies were on walls in the rear mop sink area; a priority citation was issued. Food containers were stored under exposed sewer pipes in the basement. Milk crates were used as shelving in three walk-in coolers.

headline: Cabinet, receptacle covers, and paint repairs
summary: Re-inspection passed. The cabinet door under the beverage station has peeling surfaces and exposed particleboard. Unisex toilet room receptacles need covers. Chipped paint in the dining area must be repaired.

headline: Dish machines tagged; fly trap over prep
summary: Passed with conditions. A low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer and a high-temperature machine did not reach 180°F; both were tagged and must not be used until reinspected. An electric fly trap is positioned over the juice and prep area and must be relocated.

headline: 30 live small flies found; failed
summary: Complaint inspection failed. Thirty live small flies were on walls outside the walk-in cooler. They must be removed before re-inspection; a priority citation was issued. Grease and food debris were under cooking equipment, and hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Pushcart lacks thermometer and license number
summary: License inspection passed. The pushcart had no ambient air thermometer. It also lacked a license number, which must appear on both sides.

headline: Peeling paint on basement wall
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Paint was peeling on the wall leading to the basement. The person in charge was instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: 200+ mouse and rat droppings; repeat violation
summary: Failed re-inspection. About 200 or more mouse and rat droppings were found in the dining area, prep, basement, and staircase. Black netting was gnawed in the basement. A pest control operator must service the premises. Food handler training was also missing.

headline: Hair restraints missing; only one food handler certificate
summary: Passed. Food prep staff were not wearing hair restraints; staff were told to wear them. Only one food handler certificate was available for all employees. Managers lacked allergen training certificates. Leaking sink valve, unlidded trash cans, and floor and rust cleaning also required.

headline: Unlabeled spices; torn gasket
summary: License inspection passed. Spice containers on a storage shelf were not labeled and need common names. A one-door refrigerator has a torn gasket, and the microwave and refrigerator interiors need detail cleaning.

headline: Rear storage clutter; elevate stock
summary: Complaint inspection passed. The rear storage area was cluttered. Stock must be raised six inches off the floor and kept away from walls, and unnecessary items must be removed.

headline: Dirty ice machine; door gap; low water
summary: Failed. A black and brown buildup in the rear ice machine was dripping onto ice; a citation was issued and a deep clean ordered. A quarter-inch gap at the kitchen rear door must be sealed. Low water pressure and a trickle at hand sinks were also found.

headline: Live flies in prep and dining areas
summary: Failed on re-inspection. About 3 live large flies were in the food prep area and about 15 in the customer dining area. The facility must eliminate the flies, clean affected areas, and contact pest control. A citation was issued.

headline: 75+ rat droppings; prep sink not usable
summary: Failed. About 75 rat droppings were found in basement dry storage and 10 to 15 at the bar. A pest service on 2-26-26 noted rodent activity. The cooks line hand sink was leaking and unusable, and no food handler training proof was provided.

headline: Missing health policy, cleanup kit, thermometer
summary: License inspection failed. There was no written employee health policy and no vomit or diarrhea cleanup supplies. No pH test was available for cooked sushi rice, and no metal stem thermometer was on site. Covered waste receptacles and allergen certificates were also missing.

headline: No certified manager; prep cooler at 62°F
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager was on site when TCS food was stored, prepared, cooked, and served until about 9:05 AM; a citation was issued. A prep cooler at 62°F is tagged. Food was uncovered in a cooler, and an allergen certificate has expired.

headline: Hot and cold foods held at unsafe temps
summary: Passed with conditions. Cooked bacon was held at 97.3°F, below the required 135°F. Cold foods including raw eggs and salmon were held at 45.7 to 75.6°F; about 15 pounds was discarded. A cold holding unit at 53.1°F is tagged. Leaking drain pipes were also noted.

headline: No food handler or allergen training proof
summary: Passed. No proof of food handler training was available for any food handler. No certified manager had proof of allergen training. Records must be kept on site at all times.

headline: Lobby cabinet debris; cleaning required
summary: Passed. The inside of a cabinet in the lobby area had debris and spillage. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Grease and debris; dish area floor
summary: Passed. Accumulated grease and food debris were on cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, freezers, and shelving. Old food debris on the dish area floor must be detail cleaned.

headline: Rusty racks, grease, and sink leak
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Walk-in cooler wire racks have chipped paint and rust and must be repainted or replaced. Grease builds up inside fryer bottom compartments. A water leak under the three-compartment sink drainpipe must be repaired.

headline: Missing hand sink and dump sink at bar
summary: License inspection failed. The three-compartment sink has no hand sink nearby and must be moved to a hand sink area; a priority violation was noted. No barrier separates the bar from public areas. The bar is missing a dump sink.

headline: One dead roach near ice machine
summary: Short complaint inspection passed. One dead roach was found near the ice machine. The manager was instructed to remove all dead insects from the facility.

headline: Dish machine and cold-holding failures; corrected
summary: Passed with conditions. The low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer and was not to be used until fixed; a vendor repaired it on site to 50 ppm. A 10-pound turkey cooled too slowly and was discarded; a cold unit was off.

headline: Unlabeled containers, missing faucet knob, debris
summary: Re-inspection passed. Two dry ingredient containers were unlabeled. The hot water knob was missing on the three-compartment sink, though hot water worked. Debris was on prep-area floors and sauce splatters were on walls.

headline: Detail cleaning and wall base repairs
summary: Re-inspection passed. Cooking equipment and dry storage shelving must be detail cleaned. Wall base in prep areas is in poor repair. Floors, floor drains, walls, and ceilings need detail cleaning.

headline: Freezer ice buildup; grease; manager training gap
summary: Passed. Excessive ice buildup inside a rear chest freezer must be removed and the interior cleaned. Dirt and debris were found under cooking equipment, a light was burned out over prep tables, and hood filters had grease. Certified managers lacked allergen training certificates.

headline: Loose faucet and missing ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. The front prep hand sink faucet is loose and must be repaired. Ceiling tiles are missing in the rear utility area. Managers lacked proof of allergen training on site.

headline: Slow-draining front hand sink
summary: Re-inspection passed. The front hand sink drains slowly. The person in charge was instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: No certified manager; meatballs held too cold
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while deli meat and meatballs were served. Five pounds of meatballs in a steam table were at 54.3°F because the steam table was off; the food was discarded. A food handler lacked a hair restraint.

headline: Ice scoop, cutting boards, and dusty vents
summary: Passed. An ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine and needs a holder. Cutting boards had open seams and dark stains. Ceiling vents were dirty, and employee belongings were stored with food on shelves.

headline: Cold chicken discarded; no certified manager
summary: Passed with conditions. The person in charge lacked a sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was on site during TCS food handling; a citation was issued. Cooked chicken at 46.9 to 50°F and lard at 60°F were discarded. Drain hoses leak onto walk-in floors.

headline: Ice machine screw, mold, and insect device placement
summary: Passed. A corroded screw inside the ice machine panel must be replaced. An insect control device over a prep table must be relocated away from food prep and dish storage. Black mold-like buildup on beer cooler shelving must be cleaned.

headline: Hand sink leak; floor detail cleaning needed
summary: Passed. A hot water knob leaked at a hand sink near the ice cream station and must be repaired. Floors under and around shelving near the waffle cone area and beside the three-compartment sink need detail cleaning to help prevent pests.

headline: Food splatter, faucets, and floor debris
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Dried food splatter on beverage and coffee equipment must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Two metered faucets did not run water for 20 seconds before reactivation. Coffee beans and debris were under equipment.

headline: No certified manager; weak hand sink water
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food service manager or certificate was present while beef and chicken were handled; a priority violation was noted and the facility was told to obtain one. Weak hot water pressure at a dish-area hand sink and an oil spill behind the cook line need correction.

headline: Debris around garbage enclosure
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Leaves and debris were on the ground under and around the garbage enclosure. The facility was instructed to clean and maintain the area.

headline: No prep sink; missing filters; training certificates
summary: Passed. A hand sink in the upstairs prep area leaks into the basement ceiling. The first-floor prep area has no dedicated prep sink. Two missing hood filters must be replaced, and food handler training certificates were missing for employees.

headline: Food handler certificates missing
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Food handlers were working without food handler certificates. The facility must provide them.

headline: Soiled mop heads; debris on floors
summary: Soiled mop heads not stored properly; staff told to hang them to prevent insect breeding. Debris on floors along walls and corners in dish and storage areas. No allergen training on site. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Live flies on walls in two prep areas
summary: About 15 live small flies on rear prep walls and 20 in the basement prep area. Manager must remove all fly activity by re-inspection and call a pest control operator. Also: food buildup on shelves and dish machine, dirty floor drains, no covered trash can. Failed.

headline: Missing sink drain plugs and backflow devices
summary: No drain plugs for the three-compartment sink, and no visible backflow prevention devices on the coffee maker or ice machine. Manager instructed to provide plugs and install devices. Passed.

headline: No handwashing sign in restroom
summary: No handwashing sign at the restroom handsink. Manager instructed to provide one. Passed.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; knives wedged
summary: Bulk salt and sugar containers are not labeled; staff told to label and maintain them. Knives were wedged between coolers and need to be kept on a clean surface. Passed.

headline: No covered trash can in women's restroom
summary: Women's toilet room has no covered receptacle. Management must provide one for sanitary reasons. Passed.

headline: Certified managers lack allergen training
summary: Certified food managers had no allergen training on record. Current allergen training must be provided for all certified food managers. Passed.

headline: Low grout on dish area floor tiles
summary: Floor tiles in the dish area have low grout; manager must regrout all low tiles at the dish machine area. Passed.

headline: Raw chicken stored above ready-to-eat foods
summary: Raw chicken was stored above ready-to-eat salad and sliced cucumber; the salad was discarded. Cooked food containers in walk-in not dated. No soap in employee restroom. Foam cups used as scoops, and damaged prep-area wall exposes gypsum. Passed with conditions.

headline: Cold food too warm; about 25 lb discarded
summary: Raw liquid eggs at 51.5°F, raw beef at 46.7°F and mashed potatoes at 45.7°F were held improperly. Person in charge discarded about 25 lb ($50) on site; citation issued. Damp wiping cloths on prep surfaces and single-service items stored on basement floor. Passed with conditions.

headline: No certified person in charge; handwashing blocked
summary: No person in charge with a sanitation certificate, and no certified manager when meatballs were served. A handsink was removed in the dough area, and another sink was used to rinse mussels. Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat pizza toppings. No food handler or allergen training. Failed.

headline: Live roach and flying insects; citation issued
summary: One live cockroach and 10 live small flying insects found; citation issued, and additional pest control service is needed. Torn gaskets on two prep coolers, no working self-closing door on employee washroom, and a dirty floor drain under the dish machine. Failed.

headline: Hair restraints missing; floors and walls soiled
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints; a bearded handler needs a beard restraint. Also a leaking faucet, toilet trash can without lid, broken floor tiles, greasy walls, and very poor prep area lighting. A food handler did not meet training requirements. Passed.

headline: Missing thermometers and no hot water
summary: Cold-holding equipment lacks internal thermometers. Food stored in basement beneath unshielded sewer lines. Facility had no hot water at inspection. No grease waste receptacle. Ceilings missing or not cleanable; holes in basement walls. No barrier between front prep area and customers. Failed.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths; restroom handsink broken
summary: Soiled wiping cloths stored on cook line prep tables and in dish area; must be kept in sanitizer when not in use. Metered handsink in 21st floor women's restroom not working. Dirt and debris under dry storage shelves and ice machines. Passed.

headline: Missing ice machine backflow; no mop hooks
summary: No backflow device on the ice machine. Garbage can in unisex restroom needs a lid. Wet mops need a hanging system to dry. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: No certified manager while eggs served
summary: No City-certified food manager on site while eggs were prepared and served; citation issued. Cook was eating in the prep area. Bar sanitizer lacked test strips. Mold on a handsink and caulking, and inadequate light in the walk-in cooler. Failed.

headline: Over 50 flies; no handwashing signs
summary: Over 50 flies throughout the facility, including the kitchen; citation issued, and the manager must service affected areas. No handwashing sign in second-floor restroom. Dirty cooler gasket. Handsink slow-draining and leaking. Failed.

headline: Raw menu items unmarked; flying insects present
summary: Several raw or undercooked menu items were not marked under the consumer advisory; citation issued. About 25 live small flying insects on walls and ceiling of dish and mezzanine prep areas; more pest control service needed. Failed.

headline: Dead roaches on unused dish machine
summary: Dead insects and roaches were on top of an unused dish machine; manager told to remove them. Other items: thermometers needed in coolers, a food handler lacked training proof, rusted racks, and plastic crates used as shelves. Passed.

headline: Bare-hand salad contact; no paper towels
summary: An employee handled salad ingredients with bare hands; citation issued and management told no bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food is allowed. Also no paper towels at the bar handsink and no temperature indicator on the dish machine. Failed.

headline: No hand soap or paper towels; food too warm
summary: No hand soap at the front handsink and no paper towels at the sandwich prep sink; citations issued. Tuna at 49.2°F and grilled chicken at 57.4°F held improperly; manager discarded 5 lb ($50). Three-compartment sink faucet still leaking. Passed with conditions.

headline: Cooler gasket in poor repair
summary: The gasket on the two-door serving cooler is in poor repair and could let the cooler drop below required temperature. Must repair or replace it. Floor corners need cleaning. Passed.

headline: Basement restroom door not self-closing
summary: The basement restroom door does not close on its own; manager instructed to install a self-closing device. Passed on complaint re-inspection.

headline: No written health policies; old pest log
summary: No verifiable written employee health policies on site for the new business. The pest control log belongs to the previous business, and no current pest agreement or garbage contract was shown. Unisex restroom door is not self-closing. Failed.

headline: Syrup buildup on soda machine
summary: Syrup buildup on soda machine cartridges and silver dispensing handles. Person in charge instructed to clean and maintain them. Passed.

headline: No thermometers; old core violations uncorrected
summary: No thermometers in cold-holding equipment in front bar and rear prep; soiled wiping cloths on prep tables; boxed items on basement floor. Previous core violations uncorrected: ice machine interior, food on walk-in floor, rusty shelves, peeling paint, ceiling holes. Citation issued. Failed.

headline: Wrong-company manager certificate; uncovered ice
summary: Manager certificate was from a different company, not the original City certificate; citation issued. Certified manager must be on site with the original certificate. Mini fridge lacks an ambient thermometer; ice container uncovered; food handlers lacked hair restraints. Passed with conditions.

headline: Menu lacks raw food consumer advisory
summary: Menu lacks the required advisory for raw or undercooked foods; citation issued. Glass rinser drain empties into the handsink and must be rerouted; a splash guard is needed. Ice machine interior and greasy hood filters need cleaning. Failed.

headline: Ice build-up in milk cooler; food debris
summary: Ice build-up behind the condenser inside the milk reach-in cooler must be removed. Food debris on walls and on the floor under cooking equipment in the rear prep area; person in charge told to detail clean. Passed.

headline: No certified manager; handwashing skipped
summary: No certified food manager on duty until 11 AM. A food handler moved from a mop to the walk-in cooler and then removed bacon with tongs without washing hands; citation issued. High-temperature dish machine final rinse gauge not working; no irreversible thermometer. Active water leak. Failed.

headline: Ceramic cups need lead safety documentation
summary: Ceramic drinking cups on site must be confirmed lead-safe with documentation kept on site, or removed from the premises. Storage room next to toilet room is cluttered and needs organizing. Passed on re-inspection.
