headline: No food handler or allergen training available
summary: No food handler training was available for employees, and no allergen training for certified managers. Openings in floors, walls and ceilings need sealing. Lighting in the basement freezer and over the grill needs repair. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Dirty dish-area handsink; untrained handlers
summary: Interior of the dish area handsink is not clean; manager instructed to clean and maintain it. Two employees lack food handler training certificates. Passed.

headline: Multiple food handlers lack training
summary: Several food handlers lacked food handler training. A certified manager on duty lacked allergen training. Staff must complete training and keep records on site at all times. Passed.

headline: 20th floor coolers off and no hot water
summary: Coolers and freezers on the 20th floor were off, and a service cooler at 77.3°F was tagged. No hot water during construction, restored at 1:45 PM. Missing soap, paper towels and handwashing signs. Backflow devices unconnected. Failed.

headline: No health policies, training or allergen certificate
summary: No signed employee health policies; citation issued. No food handler training for employees and no food allergen training for the food manager. No previous summary posted; new one given, citation issued. Gap at front door; dust on upper prep walls. Passed with conditions.

headline: No manager certificate posted; no trash lid
summary: No City certified food manager certificate posted on premises; priority violation under 7-38-012. Washroom has no covered trash receptacle. Management must provide a valid, updated certificate. Passed with conditions.

headline: Food splatter on sushi prep walls
summary: Walls throughout the front sushi prep area have food splatter. Management must clean and maintain them. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Person in charge lacks manager certification
summary: Person in charge has no City food service manager certification while the facility is open; citation issued. First unisex restroom lacks a covered receptacle. Three-door prep station near the bread oven is not working and needs repair or removal. Passed with conditions.

headline: No certified manager; sewage backup blocked handwashing
summary: No person in charge or certified food manager present while TCS foods (rice, sushi, soups) were prepared. Wastewater backed up into hand sinks, so employees could not wash hands. Partly frozen crab was thawed improperly. Citation issued.

headline: Leaky rear handsink and missing food handler training
summary: Leaky pipe at the rear dish area handsink must be repaired; excess brown putty in the drain needs replacing with food-grade putty. Wet mops need a hanging system. Employees have no food handler training. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Dead roaches found behind ice machine
summary: Dead roaches on the floor behind the ice machine and along a wall near the cashier line; staff told to remove them and clean. Dispensing spoons submerged in food and an ice scoop stored in an open wire bin. Cooking equipment, microwave, walls and vents dirty.

headline: Food handler without hair restraint
summary: A food handler without a hair restraint was in the rear prep area. Management told all employees must wear restraints in the food prep area. Passed.

headline: Cold handwashing water and food stored on floor
summary: Restroom handwashing sink measured 47.1°F, below the required 100°F; citation issued. Also found food stored on the floor, no hair restraints, grease and food debris, and a leaking drain under sinks. Previous core violation not corrected. Failed.

headline: No certified manager; no hair restraints
summary: No certified food service manager on site and no certificate posted while tuna and eggs were handled; citation issued. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Disposable cups used as ice scoops. Passed with conditions.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; ice scoop misplaced
summary: Low-temperature dish machine sanitizer read 0 ppm; unit tagged and not to be used until it sanitizes properly; no citation. Ice scoop stored on top of ice machine. Three-compartment sink stopper does not hold water; pink and black buildup inside the ice machine. Passed with conditions.

headline: Expired manager certificate; cardboard liners
summary: No current City sanitation certificate on premises; expired certificate for current manager; citation issued. Food and buttercream stored on walk-in floor; equipment stored under unshielded sewer lines. Cardboard lines floors and shelves. Backflow devices still missing from prior report.

headline: Torn gasket, leaking sink, greasy fryers
summary: No handwashing sign in the employee bathroom. Scoops were stored with handles touching food. Torn cooler door gasket. Manager removed cardboard shelf liners on site. Fryers and floors under them heavily greased; three-compartment sink leaking. Passed.

headline: No hot water in customer washrooms
summary: Customer washroom handsinks had no hot water; citation issued, and 100–120°F must be provided. No exposed handsinks at the three-compartment sinks in both food prep areas; citation issued. Several lights out in the Racine Street Grill storage area. No food handler certificates. Failed.

headline: Dishes washed without sanitizer; food too warm
summary: Dishes were washed without sanitizer, which read 0 ppm; citation issued, and the person in charge emptied the sinks. Many TCS foods held above 41°F, including watermelon at 80.8°F; about 440 lb ($2,000) discarded. Coolers tagged. Previous core violations uncorrected. Failed.

headline: No rear handsink and no thermometers
summary: No handsink in rear dishwashing room. No thermometers for ambient air or food, and no sink stoppers for the three-compartment sink. Rear washroom door lacks self-closing device. Unused equipment outside rear exit. No food handler certificates on site. Failed.

headline: Rodent bait stored unsafely; dead roaches found
summary: Rodent bait blocks stored on the floor instead of in covered, tamper-resistant stations; citation issued and bait ordered removed from unsafe areas. Several dead roaches found. Food stored on floor and in plastic bags in coolers. Passed with conditions.

headline: No health policy and no rear handsink
summary: No written employee health policy on premises, and no handwashing sink in the rear dishwashing area; citations issued. Also a torn cooler door gasket and restroom doors without self-closing devices. Failed.

headline: Pest control log outdated; citation issued
summary: Pest control log is incomplete; the last service reports are dated 2022 and 2023. Licensed pest service must happen at least twice a year; citation issued. Wire brush in poor repair, minor food spills under cooking equipment, and dusty ventilation filters. Failed.

headline: Live roaches, flies and rear door opening
summary: Three live roaches and 15–20 small flies in common and prep areas, plus dead roaches and sticky traps with roaches. Citation issued; pest control recommended. Rear exit door has a small opening. Missing sink stoppers and greasy cooking equipment. Failed.

headline: Worn or missing bulk container labels
summary: Labels on bulk food containers in the deli and bakery are worn or missing. Management must provide labels with the common name of each food and keep them in place. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Many cold foods too warm; about 300 lb discarded
summary: Chicken wings, milk, eggs and deli meats held at 46–60°F; about 300 lb ($1,500) discarded. Refrigerator at 47.8°F was adjusted by the person in charge; citation issued. Chicken thawed improperly in sink. Toilet room door not self-closing; no manager allergen training. Passed with conditions.

headline: One certified manager missing allergen certificate
summary: One certified food manager is missing an allergen training certificate. Management must complete the training and keep proof on site at all times. Passed.

headline: No certified manager during chicken prep
summary: No certified manager on duty while chicken was prepared; citation issued. Black slime on caulk around basement dish sink; black slime in basement ice machine; grease inside fryers; men's restroom hot water handle stripped. No summary posted from prior inspection; new summary left, citation issued. Passed with conditions.

headline: Dirty walls near front handsink
summary: Walls in the prep area near the front handsink have food splashes and debris. Manager instructed to clean and maintain them. Passed.

headline: No posted certificate; no discard dates
summary: No valid City sanitation certificate posted; citation issued. Cooked rice, beef and soup held over 24 hours without discard dates. Flour stored in unlabeled containers; milk crates used for elevation; residue inside ice machine; one burnt-out light bulb. Passed with conditions.

headline: Gaps at front doors and floor let insects in
summary: Gaps at the bottom and side of both front doors and in metal flooring must be sealed to prevent insect entry. No sink stoppers for three-compartment sink; worn cooler gasket; food debris on grill table; no food handler training. Passed.

headline: No certified person in charge; milk crates used
summary: No person in charge with a City sanitation certificate on premises; citation issued. Milk crates used to elevate food and nonfood items throughout basement; must provide adequate shelving. Leaking stopper under three-compartment sink; debris on floors and stained ceiling tiles. Passed with conditions.

headline: Plastic liner left on new shelf
summary: Plastic liner still attached to a new shelf at the prep line; manager told to remove it. Employee bathroom door is not self-closing and has no covered trash can. Exhaust hood light has no protective shield. Passed.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and drainboard
summary: No handwashing signs at hand sinks and no drainboard for the three-compartment sink, which is needed for drying utensils. Floor corners and areas under heavy equipment had dirt and debris. Manager instructed to correct all three. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Cup on cutting board; restroom hot water low
summary: Food employee drank from a cup placed on a cutting board, and another ate at the pizza station; citation issued. Handwashing sign missing. Restroom hot water below 100°F. High-temp dish machine still tagged (final rinse 149.6°F), not to be used until reinspected. Failed.

headline: Unlabeled containers and cardboard shelf liners
summary: Containers stored near cooking equipment were unlabeled, and broken cardboard boxes were used to line shelves under prep tables. Manager instructed to label containers and remove the cardboard. Passed.

headline: Person in charge lacked food sanitation certificate
summary: Person in charge had no City sanitation certificate, and no certified handler was on site while TCS foods were served; citation issued. Manager later showed a ServSafe certificate on 7-9-2025. No health policy, pest control log, or employee food handler training on site. Failed.

headline: Handwashing sink reached only 53.1°F
summary: Men's restroom handwashing sink reached a maximum of 53.1°F; must provide at least 100°F; citation issued. Low water pressure at staff restroom sink. Dust and debris under shelves in cooler and product storage areas. Failed.

headline: Hot and cold foods out of temperature; dead insects
summary: Fried eggs at 98°F, bacon at 69.5°F and pastries at 71–72°F held improperly and discarded; citation issued. Milk at 49.7°F; dairy cooler at 51.4°F tagged. Dead insects on basement floors, pooling water, and unused equipment. Failed.

headline: No hot water at start; ceilings damaged
summary: No hot water at start of inspection; sink temperatures ranged 65–93°F. Hot water restored at end (98–110°F at handsinks); citation issued. Basement ceiling tiles missing or in poor repair, and litter and clutter on floors and in walk-in coolers. Passed with conditions.

headline: Small rear door opening; cooler handles missing
summary: Small opening in the center of the rear exit door must be sealed to avoid rodent entry. Missing door handles on two-door cooler in chicken area. Clean walk-in handles, floors, walls and vents; clutter in storage; missing wall coving. Passed.

headline: Missing handle on restroom door
summary: Inner handle is missing from a toilet room door; management must repair it. Passed.

headline: Pest infestation; citation issued
summary: Over 30 live cockroaches, over 20 live flies, and over 40 rat droppings in prep, bar and basement areas; citation issued, and more pest control required. Black slime in ice maker used for ice; citation issued. Expired food handler certificates. Failed.

headline: No certified food manager during egg and ham service
summary: Person in charge lacks a certified food manager certificate; no certified manager on duty while eggs and ham were prepared and served; citation issued. No food handler training, missing hair restraints, and food debris on floors and equipment. Passed with conditions.

headline: Dead water bugs in basement
summary: Dead water bugs along a basement walk path; staff told to remove dead insects. Reach-in cooler has food stains, debris, and rust on shelves; cooking equipment and floor under it have grease and dust. Staff told to clean and maintain. Passed.

headline: Wiping cloths left on prep tables; dust buildup
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on food prep tables instead of in sanitizing solution. Dust on bakery ceiling and vents, dirt behind dish machines, and floor debris under storage shelves need cleaning. Passed.

headline: Worn gaskets, grout and dirty vent filters
summary: Worn door gaskets on two coolers, floors needing grout, a loose walk-in freezer threshold, and debris on both vent hood filters. Corrections required. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: No covered trash can in restroom
summary: Unisex restroom has no covered waste receptacle. Manager instructed to provide one. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: No certified manager while hot dogs served
summary: No City-certified food manager or valid documentation on premises while hot dogs and chicken were prepared and served. Citation issued; person in charge told a certified manager must be present at all times and original certificate posted.

headline: Food prepared without certified manager on site
summary: Food handlers prepared and served TCS foods without a certified food manager or original certificate on site. Certificate must stay posted and manager present during food service. Dump sink in coffee area needs repair. Passed with conditions.

headline: Openings in doors need sealing
summary: Openings found in the main entrance glass doors and rear exit door; manager instructed to seal all outer openings to prevent pest entry. No pests were observed. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Rodent droppings and roaches; food too warm
summary: No City food manager certificate posted; citation issued. Over 20 rodent droppings in basement and two live roaches; roach carcasses; torn rear screen door. Cold TCS food at 46°F; display cooler at 45°F; 6 lb custard discarded. Clutter throughout. Failed.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; trays stored face up
summary: Handwashing sign missing at the handsink at the end of the prep line. To-go trays stored face up at hot food line; staff told to invert them. Floors in pizza prep area and near fryers and grill need detail cleaning. Passed.

headline: Rear door gap lets pests in
summary: Rear exit door has an approximately 1/4 inch gap at the bottom, so it is not rodent-proof. Staff told to seal gaps to prevent pest entry. No pests were reported. Passed.

headline: Door gaps, dim lights and ceiling problems
summary: No pests were found, but the exterior metal door has a gap over an inch and does not fully close; manager told to pest-proof outer openings. Also noted: basement ceiling coverings, unshielded and dim lights, and a missing faucet handle.

headline: Unlabeled containers; exposed sewage pipes
summary: Dry ingredient containers near the wok station have no labels. Exposed sewage pipes above basement food storage and prep tables must be enclosed and maintained; citation issued. Previous core violation not corrected. Failed.

headline: Cold food too warm; about 42 lb discarded
summary: Cold TCS foods held at 46.8–52.2°F, above the 41°F limit; manager voluntarily discarded about 42 lb valued at $82 on site. Cooler at 50.5°F was tagged. Handsink water at 53.8°F, below 100°F. No pest control log, expired food handler certificates. Failed.

headline: Pink buildup in ice bin; greasy fryer compartments
summary: Slight pink buildup inside the ice bin; grime, food debris and baked-on grease in compartments under the fryers. Manager instructed to clean the ice bin and deep clean the fryer area. Passed.

headline: Rust under chemical table; furnace clutter
summary: Rust on the bottom of the table where chemicals are stored, and buildup on walk-in cooler shelves; person in charge told to clean. Clutter by the furnace must be removed. Certified manager lacks allergen training certificate. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: No proof of food handler training
summary: No proof of food handler training was provided for food handlers at the time of inspection. Management instructed to provide food handler certificates for all food handlers. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Bulk containers unlabeled; plates not inverted
summary: Bulk popcorn kernel containers had no labels; person in charge told to label all bulk and working ingredient containers. Plates were not inverted after sanitizing and air drying; staff told to invert them. Passed.

headline: Over 25 rat droppings in dining area
summary: Over 25 rat droppings found on the floor around the dining area, where children's chairs are stored, and at the bar. Staff told to consult pest control and have the premises treated; citation issued. Floors need detail cleaning. Failed.

headline: Dirty ice machine and milk too warm
summary: Ice machine interior dirty with black substance; ice to be discarded and machine cleaned; citation issued. Milk at 75.7°F in display cooler discarded; citation issued. Uncovered food, milk crates used as shelves, missing ceiling tiles, and manager lacks allergen training. Passed with conditions.

headline: Damaged floor tiles; expired training certificates
summary: Damaged floor tiles in prep area under reach-in cooler must be repaired. Food handler training certificates have expired, and certified manager's allergen training is expired. Staff told to update all. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Loose rear door; wastewater backs up
summary: Rear exterior door does not fit tightly around the frame. Wastewater backs up into the middle compartment of the three-compartment sink when other compartments drain; citation issued, and the person in charge must repair it. Failed.

headline: Chicken and beef too warm; no handler training
summary: Chicken breast at 47.5°F, cutlets at 45.1°F and beef cutlets at 46.9°F held improperly; about 5 lb chicken and 2.5 lb beef discarded; citation issued. An employee had no food handler training certification. Passed with conditions.

headline: Two managers lack allergen training
summary: One food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. Two certified food service managers have no allergen awareness training certificates; this is a previous core violation not corrected, and the person in charge was instructed to fix it. Passed with conditions.

headline: Improper thawing and greasy fryer found
summary: Frozen spinach was thawing in standing water; staff told to thaw properly. Ice scoop was stored improperly, and the fryer interior had grease and debris; staff told to clean it. Passed.

headline: Passed re-inspection; handwashing signs and thermometers missing
summary: Passed re-inspection. Handwashing signs were missing at prep area and toilet room sinks. The walk-in cooler used for juice preparation and the dairy walk-in cooler had no ambient air thermometers.

headline: Passed; handwashing signs missing, leak under sink
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs were missing at sinks in the front and rear prep areas. A splashguard is needed by a handsink near the slicer. A slight leak under the three-compartment sink caused water to pool, and cardboard was on the floor.

headline: Passed with conditions; mold in ice machine cleaned on site
summary: Passed with conditions. A large amount of black mold-like substance was found inside the ice machine. The person in charge discarded the ice and cleaned the machine during the inspection. A citation was issued. Bulk containers were unlabeled, foam cups were used as scoops, and walls were damaged.

headline: Failed: no handwash sink at dish area
summary: Failed. The rear warewashing area, where the three-compartment sink is, has no handwashing sink. Inspector required one with hot and cold running water. The city certified manager also lacked allergen training. A citation was issued for the missing handwash sink.

headline: Passed with conditions; no posted city certificate
summary: Passed with conditions. No person on site had an original City of Chicago sanitation certificate posted. A certified food manager must be on site with the certificate posted at all times. A citation was issued.

headline: Failed: cooling units at 54-60F
summary: Failed. Refrigeration units were not holding cold temperatures, with air readings from 54.3F to 60.0F. The employee health policy was missing. Food guards, a drain board, test strips, and a sink for liquid waste were also required.

headline: Failed: bare-hand contact and roaches, flies
summary: Failed. Food handlers touched ready-to-eat nopales salad and tacos with bare hands. The salad and tacos were discarded. Live roaches were found on the taqueria floor and near the hot water tank. Numerous dead roaches and live flies were also found. Pest control was required.

headline: Passed re-inspection; mold-like substance in ice machine
summary: Passed re-inspection. Black and beige mold-like substance was found inside the large kitchen ice machine. Inspector required cleaning and sanitizing to prevent ice contamination. An opening at the base of the front double door must be sealed. Women's restroom bins need lids.

headline: Passed complaint; grease and food debris found
summary: Passed. Inspector found grease and food debris on fryer sides, in a drain by fry equipment, and in a dry storage utility room. Coffee splatter was on the wall behind equipment. Paint was chipping over the ice machine, and the walk-in cooler light was dim.

headline: Passed re-inspection; handwashing signs missing
summary: Passed re-inspection. No handwashing signs were posted at the handsink. Damaged, open gaps in the basement and bar ceilings must be repaired and sealed to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: Passed; meatballs covered while cooling
summary: Passed. Meatballs were covered with plastic wrap while cooling in the walk-in cooler. Single-use plastic cups were used as scoops in sauce containers. Floors under the deep fryers were heavily soiled with grease and food debris. A shared kitchen license issue was also noted.

headline: Passed; expired certificates and storage issues
summary: Passed. Mineral buildup was found in the ice machine reservoir. Food handler and allergen training certificates were expired. Several storage and food-contact items were improper, including plastic bags used as food containers, cutting boards on the sink backsplash, and newspaper shelf liners.

headline: Passed with conditions; certified manager training missing
summary: Passed with conditions. Minor food splatters were found inside the microwave. Floors along walls and corners of the kitchen need detail cleaning to remove grease. A certified food manager lacked allergen training, which was a repeat violation, and a citation was issued.

headline: Passed with conditions; raw food stored over ready-to-eat food
summary: Passed with conditions. Raw chicken, salmon and eggs were stored over miso paste, jalapenos and broccoli in the walk-in cooler. A citation was issued. The cutting board had dark stains, cardboard was used under it, and floors had heavy black debris.

headline: Passed; hood not working, food debris in units
summary: Passed. The hood system was not operable at inspection and needs repair. Food debris was found inside cold and hot holding units. Grease and residue were on walls and hood filters. Tape was used to patch a chest freezer and must be properly repaired.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager for chicken prep
summary: Passed with conditions. Food handlers prepared chicken, a TCS food, without a City of Chicago certified manager on site. A citation was issued. No written employee health policy was on site, and there was no handwashing signage or proof of food handler training.

headline: Passed; unused items in toilet room
summary: Passed. Unnecessary items, including pizza boxes, a food rack and boxes, were stored in the toilet room. They must be removed.

headline: Passed; leaking pipe, duct tape, milk crates
summary: Passed. A pipe leaked under the three-compartment sink when sanitizer water was released. Duct tape was used on a chest freezer lid, and milk crates were used for elevation. Spray foam was used as a seal around piping, and cooler food was unlabeled.

headline: Passed re-inspection; no food handler cards on site
summary: Passed re-inspection. Cake slices and lemonade sold to go lacked trace-back and allergen information. Torn gaskets and heavy grime were found on coolers. Sinks in toilet rooms lost water intermittently, and no food handler cards were on site.

headline: Passed; mop sink and ventilation needed
summary: Passed. A mop sink with hot and cold water and a backflow device must be installed for dirty water disposal. The washroom door must be self-closing and needs ventilation. The manager must comply with food handler training and allergen training requirements.

headline: Passed with conditions; no soap or paper towels at handsink
summary: Passed with conditions. The rear handsink had no soap or paper towels, and a citation was issued. A food handler obtained soap during inspection. Milk crates were used as shelves, and food was in unlabeled containers. A certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Failed: over 100 mouse droppings, food too warm
summary: Failed. Many cold TCS foods were held between 47.3F and 60.4F, and about 15 lb was discarded. A one-door unit at 50.7F was tagged, and a citation was issued. Over 100 mouse droppings were in the facility, and pest control service was required. Food handlers lacked training certificates.

headline: Passed re-inspection; plumbing leak and repairs needed
summary: Passed re-inspection. A leaking drain pipe and low water pressure were found at the dishwashing handsink. Missing ceiling tiles, damaged baseboards, a damaged basement floor and missing light shields must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Passed; hair restraints and cleaning needed
summary: Passed. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Handsinks in preparation areas and basement storage floors were not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; missing thermometers and sanitation manager training
summary: Passed. Two reach-in coolers had no hanging thermometers inside and must have them. The sanitation manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: Failed: over 100 mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. Over 100 mouse droppings were found under cooking equipment, sinks, the dishwasher and the ice machine. Pest control service and a pest log book were not in place. The rear door had a 1/2-inch gap. No employee health policy or food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk bins, food on floor
summary: Passed. Bulk sugar and salt bins had no labels. Boxed food was stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and freezer and must be raised six inches. Grease and food debris were on cooking equipment, coolers and shelves. Employee items were stored throughout the prep area.

headline: Passed; display cooler temperature inaccurate
summary: Passed. The display cooler's external temperature readout was inaccurate, and the unit did not hold food under 41F. No internal thermometer was present, and repair is required. Floor tiles are missing or damaged throughout, and some wall bottoms are cut out.

headline: Failed: meat and chicken held too warm, no pest log
summary: Failed. Five lb of ground beef at 49.3F and three lb of chicken at 50.1F were held too warm. The manager discarded 8 lb, and a citation was issued. No current pest control log book was on site, and no chemical test kit was available. A manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed with conditions; raw eggs too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. Raw eggs at 54.3F were held too warm. The manager discarded 20 eggs, and a citation was issued. Cutting boards had open seams and dark stains, and rusted racks above the three-compartment sink must be fixed.

headline: Passed complaint; dried syrup and debris noted
summary: Passed. The ice machine was a little dirty and must be cleaned. Dried syrup spills were found on the shelving where beverage syrup is stored, which could attract pests. A prep sink was leaking and pooling water, and debris was behind slushy and ice cream machines.

headline: Passed with conditions; cooked foods held too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. Cooked chicken at 59.6F and shrimp at 49.2F were held too warm in the front prep cooler. The manager discarded about 10 lb, and a citation was issued. Several items need correction, including hair restraints, handwashing signage, leaks, and dirty equipment.

headline: Failed: cold foods too warm, rat droppings
summary: Failed. Several cold foods, including butter at 67.0F, were held too warm. The manager discarded about 5 lb, and a two-door cold holding unit was repaired on site. Twenty rat droppings were found in the basement, and rat droppings were in dry and liquor storage.

headline: Failed: dead rat in trap, food stored on floor
summary: Failed. A large dead rat was found in a trap near the rear exit and furnace room. Food and meat boxes were on the floor, and a citation was issued. There was no vomit cleanup procedure or supplies, and a manager lacked allergen training. A three-compartment sink drain leaked.

headline: Passed with conditions; no hot water, restored on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No hot running water was in the premises when inspected. A plumbing technician restored hot water during inspection. Dust and dirt were found on floors in the front prep area, rear storage and restrooms, and a citation was issued.

headline: Passed with conditions; missing health and vomit procedures
summary: Passed with conditions. No written employee health policy was on site. No written procedure or required equipment for cleaning a vomit or diarrhea event was on site. Both are priority violations and must be provided.

headline: Passed; torn gaskets and dust buildup
summary: Passed. Rubber gaskets on some prep cooler doors are ripped and must be repaired or replaced. Dust has built up on cooler condensers and around ceiling vents. Some ceiling tiles above the dishwashing area are missing or damaged.

headline: Failed: repeat violations, missing thermometers, uncovered trash
summary: Failed. Repeat core violations from an October 2023 report were not corrected. Coolers lacked thermometers, some food was stored in open cans, and food handlers lacked certificates. Trash receptacles needed covers, and the dumpster area had debris. Allergen training was missing.

headline: Passed; torn gaskets and floor debris
summary: Passed. Torn gaskets on the main three-door prep cooler must be repaired. Dust was on walk-in fan guards, and food debris was on floors along walls in the main prep area. A coffee station sink has low water pressure, and some bakery floor tiles are broken.

headline: Passed; cutting board, dumpster and training issues
summary: Passed. A stained green cutting board must be refinished or replaced. The grease dumpster's top had grease and dried food debris. Some food handlers lacked food handler training certificates, and four certified managers lacked allergen training certificates.

headline: Failed: over 50 mouse droppings, no hot water
summary: Failed. Over 50 mouse droppings were found in sales, basement storage and north storage areas. Pest control and cleaning were required, and a citation was issued. Hand, three-compartment and utility sinks had no hot water (65.3F). A citation was issued.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager during TCS food prep
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while chicken and cooked noodles were prepared and served, and a citation was issued. Utensils were stored facing up. Food spills on the main prep floor must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; beard guards and hair restraints needed
summary: Passed. A food handler and manager were not wearing beard guards. Employees must wear beard guards and effective hair restraints.

headline: Failed: food held too warm, 121 lb discarded
summary: Failed. Many TCS foods in the rear cooler were held above 41F, including lengua at 44.8F. About 121 lb was discarded, and a citation was issued. Ready-to-eat foods were not date marked, and the outside dumpster lids were not closed.

headline: Passed with conditions; blank health policy copies
summary: Passed with conditions. Blank copies of the employee health policy were on site. Handwashing signage was missing at all sinks, and the ice machine plate needed cleaning. Trash receptacles lacked covers, and food handler training proof was not provided.

headline: Passed; leak and grease buildup
summary: Passed. A leak was found at the pipe under the sanitizer compartment of the three-compartment sink. Slight grease buildup was in floor grout near the grill and steam table. Both must be repaired and cleaned.

headline: Passed with conditions; no inspection summary posted
summary: Passed with conditions. No inspection report summary was posted on the premises. A copy of the report was given to management, who was told to post it in public view. A citation was issued.

headline: Passed with conditions; no hot water, fly traps moved
summary: Passed with conditions. No hot running water was available, and water measured 75F to 81F. Dish washing requires at least 110F. Fly traps above a meat grinder must be removed from the food prep area. A splash guard was needed at a prep handsink.

headline: Passed; worn gaskets and cleaning needed
summary: Passed. A worn weather strip at the front entry leaves a gap of about 1/4 inch and must be replaced. A worn gasket on a two-door cooler must be repaired. Equipment, floors, stairs and hood filters need detail cleaning.

headline: Failed: walk-in cooler at 51F, no health policy
summary: Failed. No written employee health policy was on site. The walk-in cooler measured 51.0F and must be kept at 41F or colder. Stained cutting boards, a plumbing leak, and an uninstalled backflow device were also found. Unnecessary items must be removed to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: Passed; plastic bowls stored in dry ingredients
summary: Passed. Plastic bowls were stored inside bulk dry ingredient containers in the rear. Inspector required utensils with handles for scooping. Slight debris was under the three-door cooler.

headline: Passed; unlabeled sugar container
summary: Passed. A bulk food container of sugar had no label. Inspector required it to be labeled.

headline: Passed with conditions; cold foods held too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. Half and half, cream cheese, milk and butter were held between 47.3F and 50.5F. The manager discarded about 50 lb on site, and a citation was issued. Dispensers and an ice scoop were placed where they could contaminate food or ice.

headline: Passed with conditions; ground beef and eggs too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. Ground beef at 49F to 52F and eggs at 48F to 55F were held too warm in the two-door cooler. The manager discarded 70 lb of ground beef and nine egg trays, and a citation was issued. A refrigerator gasket in the serving area is torn.

headline: Passed; gap at rear door, damaged floors
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the rear exit door must be sealed to keep pests out. Exposed caulk, damaged floor tiles, damaged ceiling tiles, and a missing light shield also need repair.

headline: Passed re-inspection; leaks and damaged doors
summary: Passed re-inspection. Damaged and missing vinyl strip doors at most walk-in coolers must be repaired or replaced. Holes in the three-compartment sink basin leak water. Excessive ice buildup in the bakery freezer must be removed, and drainpipes leak under two sinks.

headline: Passed; leaky faucet, ceiling damage, no allergen training
summary: Passed. The three-compartment sink faucet leaked heavily. Water-stained ceiling tiles in the prep area and damage in the toilet room ceiling need repair. Floors behind coolers and equipment, and a toilet room vent, need cleaning. The certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed; no handwashing signs, leaking faucet
summary: Passed. No handwashing signage was posted at any handsink. The three-compartment sink faucet leaked at its base and elbow. A broken floor tile at the front door and water-stained ceiling tiles in the rear need repair.

headline: Passed complaint; ice bin and thermometer issues
summary: Passed. The ice bin interior needed cleaning. A broken thermometer was inside the walk-in cooler. Inspector required all refrigeration units to have accurate, working thermometers.

headline: Passed re-inspection; dead roaches throughout facility
summary: Passed re-inspection. Dead roaches were found on floors, under equipment and inside a cooler and cabinet. The rear exit door was not rodent-proof. Noodles were on the drainboard by the dish machine, and pineapples were stored on the floor. Repairs and cleaning were required.

headline: Passed re-inspection; broken cooler doors
summary: Passed re-inspection. Cooler doors at a cold holding unit in the kitchen prep area were broken and must be repaired. A drainpipe at the three-compartment sink was leaking and must also be repaired.

headline: Passed; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. The city certified food manager on duty did not have required allergen training. Rust stains on a ceiling vent, dirty light shields, and a cracked floor tile by the fryers also need attention.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings, sewage backup, no hot water
summary: Failed. Over 20 mouse droppings were found, and a citation was issued. Sewage backed up from a floor drain when a handsink ran. Ice machine slime was dripping onto ice. Hot water was 85F, and it was corrected on site. No pest log book or test kit was provided.

headline: Failed: no spill kit, low water pressure
summary: Failed. No spill kit or vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure was on site. There is no three-compartment sink, though a coffee area and slushy machine are present. Water pressure at the handsink and utility sink was very low. Trash can lacks a cover, and floors are dirty.

headline: Passed; utensils stored in food, mop on floor
summary: Passed. Serving utensils were stored directly in cheese sauce and in a pan of greens in the walk-in cooler. A mop was stored on the floor next to the utility sink. Inspector required a clean protective container and a hanging mop device.

headline: Passed with conditions; no signed health policies
summary: Passed with conditions. No signed employee health policies were observed. A citation was issued, and a policy with signed copies must be provided and maintained.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings and no certified food manager
summary: Failed. No certified food manager (CFM) was on site while TCS foods (foods that must be kept hot or cold) were prepared and served. About 20 rodent droppings were found in the kitchen, near the front entrance, and in a booth. Pest control was required. A citation was issued.

headline: Passed; expired allergen training for CFM
summary: Passed. The lower surfaces of coolers and cabinets had spills, food and dirt. Floor drains and floors under equipment and sinks need cleaning. The certified food manager's allergen training certificate has expired.

headline: Failed: inadequate cold holding equipment
summary: Failed. Cooling equipment is inadequate, with only one working small cooler. Inspector required adequate refrigeration to hold TCS foods. The basement dry storage room must be cleaned and organized, and a stained brick wall needs a smooth, durable surface.

headline: Failed: bare-hand food contact, unsafe food temperatures
summary: Failed. A food handler placed sliced tomatoes on a plate with bare hands. Cooked pork held at 128.4F and cold foods at 47.9F to 49.3F were discarded. Employees had open beverages in the prep area. Barriers, a dump sink and warewashing fixes were also required.

headline: Passed with conditions; no employee health policy
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy or training was on site. Backflow prevention devices were missing at the ice machine and prep water lines, and there was no grease trap. No allergen training certificates were provided.

headline: Passed with conditions; handsink blocked, citation issued
summary: Passed with conditions. A handsink in the rear prep area was blocked by gloves, wiping cloths and containers. A citation was issued. Food debris was on prep floors, and no food handler training certificates were on site. A sanitation manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed re-inspection; many repairs and cleaning needed
summary: Passed re-inspection. Multiple items need correction, including unlabeled storage containers, utensils not inverted, worn cooler gaskets, and grease buildup. A leaky backflow device on the dish machine, a damaged concrete floor, and a missing ceiling tile were also noted.

headline: Failed: no health policy or vomit cleanup procedure
summary: Failed. No employee health policy, no vomit and diarrhea procedure or supplies, and no updated pest control logbook were available. The three-compartment sink lacked stoppers and a long enough faucet. A test kit was missing, and a citation was issued for several items.

headline: Passed; public access to coolers and milk crates
summary: Passed. Freezers and coolers with food were unlocked in the front dining area, allowing public access. Milk crates were used for food elevation and must be removed. Employees lacked hair restraints, and basement ceiling openings must be sealed.

headline: Passed re-inspection; hair restraints and labeling needed
summary: Passed re-inspection. Several items must be fixed, including hair restraints, a handwashing sign, and labels on bulk containers. Soiled aprons, wiping cloths not in sanitizer, and plastic ware not stored upright were noted. A toilet room door was not self-closing.

headline: Passed re-inspection; missing thermometers in coolers
summary: Passed re-inspection. Several standing coolers lacked interior thermometers. Torn gaskets were found on a cooler and freezer. A rear bathroom door was left open and must be self-closing. Basement and storage areas must be kept free of unused items.

headline: Failed: food held too warm, cooler failing
summary: Failed. Chicken pot stickers and shrimp won tons were at 45.9F in a cooler that must hold food at 41F or below. The reach-in cooler's air reached 50.0F, and repair was required. A certified manager lacked allergen training. Prior core violations were not corrected.

headline: Passed with conditions; warewashing water too cool
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy form was on site, and a citation was issued. No handwashing signage, sink stoppers or vehicle license number were posted. The three-compartment sink reached only 101F, but the person in charge adjusted it to meet 110F before the end of inspection.

headline: Passed; insect control device placed over food prep
summary: Passed. No ambient air thermometer was in the hot holding unit. An electric insect control device was stored above a shelf over a food prep area and must be relocated. Animal blood buildup was on meat walk-in floors.

headline: Passed; damaged cutting boards and gasket
summary: Passed. Heavily scored and discolored cutting boards in the sandwich prep area must be resurfaced or replaced. A torn gasket on a three-door prep cooler must be replaced. Food debris and splatter on ceiling tiles in the prep area need cleaning.

headline: Passed with conditions; food handler certificates still missing
summary: Passed with conditions. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. A cutting board was in poor repair, and the small deep freezer needed defrosting. Floors need detail cleaning, and ceiling tiles need replacing. Food handler certificates were still missing from a prior inspection, and a citation was issued.

headline: Failed: live roach and mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. One live roach was found near the utility sink, and 50 or more mouse droppings were in the rear storage room. The rear exit door was not rodent-proof. A licensed pest control service was required before reinspection, and a citation was issued. Expired food handler certificates were also found.

headline: Passed; cardboard on freezer floor, floor damage
summary: Passed. Cardboard was on the freezer floor and must be removed. Some floor tiles are broken, and concrete near the hot hold unit needs repair. Food debris, grease and dust were on the kitchen floor under cooking equipment.

headline: Passed with conditions; food held too cool
summary: Passed with conditions. Smoked brisket at 108.6F and half chickens at 111.3F were below the 135F hot-holding minimum. The manager voluntarily discarded 10 lb, and a citation was issued. Restroom hot water and leaks in the basement and dish area also need correction.

headline: Passed; worn door sweeps, grease, washroom doors
summary: Passed. Worn and damaged door sweeps at both rear exit doors must be replaced to prevent rodent entry. Rusted walk-in shelves, grease on cooking equipment, and a damaged furnace room floor need attention. Washroom doors must be self-closing.

headline: Failed: black slime found in ice maker
summary: Failed. Black slimy substance was found inside the ice maker, dripping into ice used for drinks and food. Management was told to turn off the machine, remove the ice, and clean and sanitize it. A citation was issued. No food handler certificates were on the premises.

headline: Passed re-inspection; equipment too large for sink
summary: Passed re-inspection. Some equipment is too large to fully immerse in the three-compartment sink. The facility must use a larger sink, smaller equipment, or an approved alternative. Basement clutter and nonfunctional equipment must be removed.

headline: Passed re-inspection; cluttered basement storage
summary: Passed re-inspection. The basement storage area was cluttered and hard to clean. Inspector required items to be organized, unnecessary items removed, and all items raised at least 6 inches off the floor to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: Passed; worn sponges and sink leak
summary: Passed. Worn and tattered sponges were on site and must be replaced often. A leak was found at the three-compartment sink P-trap, which must be corrected.

headline: Passed; hair restraint and cloth storage issues
summary: Passed. A female food employee in the front prep area was not wearing a hair restraint. Wet wiping cloths were stored on cutting boards and counters. A torn gasket on a fruit and vegetable cooler must be repaired.

headline: Passed with conditions; gaps and missing ceiling tiles
summary: Passed with conditions. Gaps at the front and rear basement doors and openings in the crawl space could let pests in. Fly strips were above the slicer and prep table. Missing ceiling tiles and debris in basement storage were noted, and a manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed re-inspection; gap at back exit door
summary: Passed re-inspection. The exterior back exit door had an open gap at the bottom that could let pests or insects in. Inspector required the door to be self-closing, solid and tight-fitting. No pests were recorded.

headline: Failed: 45+ mouse droppings, no certified manager
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site while open. Over 45 mouse droppings were found in the toilet room, prep areas and near the grease trap. Doors were left open, and no sanitizer test kit or probe thermometer was available. A citation was issued.

headline: Passed with conditions; no person in charge or CFM
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge was on site, and no certified food manager (CFM) was present while chicken and dressings were prepared. A citation was issued. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints, and ceiling vents in the toilet room were dusty.

headline: Passed re-inspection; door gap and allergen training issues
summary: Passed re-inspection. Inspector found an opening at the base of the front double doors that could let pests in, and food debris on a can opener. No allergen training certificate was shown for the sanitation manager.

headline: Failed: overflowing dumpsters, allergen training missing
summary: Failed. Outside dumpster lids were not closed because trash was overflowing. A citation was issued. A certified food manager lacked allergen training. Inspector required tight-fitting lids and documentation of training on site.

headline: Passed with conditions; dishwasher too cool, no certified manager
summary: Passed with conditions. Food handlers prepared TCS foods without a valid City of Chicago sanitation certificate, and a citation was issued. The rear handsink lacked soap and paper towels, and a citation was issued. The high-temperature dishwasher rinsed at 124F instead of 180F and was tagged and held.

headline: Passed; hair restraints and wiping cloth storage lapses
summary: Passed. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer when not in use. A can opener had food and dirt debris, and walk-in fan covers, floor drains and hood vents were dirty.

headline: Passed complaint inspection; missing food handler certificates
summary: Passed. Food handler certificates were not on site for employees cooking and prepping. The walk-in cooler had no thermometer. Holes around a furnace pipe and a lower wall could allow pests in. Shelving, walls and ceiling tiles need cleaning or repair.

headline: Fly trap above basement prep area; insulation damage
summary: A fly trap was installed above the food prep area in the basement kitchen and must be removed. The walk-in cooler had damaged insulation causing condensation, and the inspector required repair.

headline: Cold and hot foods unsafe; no certified manager
summary: No certified food manager was on premises, and a citation was issued. Cold foods at 54.3°F to 59.4°F were discarded, about 70 pounds worth $1,100. A cooler at 59.2°F was tagged. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Cooked beef and chicken above 41°F; discarded
summary: Cooked beef in the walk-in measured 47.1°F, and chicken in a reach-in measured 45°F. About 6 pounds were discarded, and a citation was issued. Staff lacked food handler training proof, and a torn gasket kept a reach-in from closing fully.

headline: Pink buildup in ice machine; slow drain
summary: Slight pink buildup was found inside the upper portions of the ice machines and must be cleaned. The three-compartment sink pipe drained slowly. The manager was told to clean the grease trap and sink so it drains quickly.

headline: No employee health policy; no food handler certificates
summary: No employee health policy was on site, and a citation was issued. Employees had no food handler training certificates. A food worker had long hair without a restraint, and another wore bracelets while handling food. Floors were dirty.

headline: Floors need degreasing and cleaning
summary: Floors near bar drains, the breakfast serving space, and the prep area under heavy equipment needed cleaning. Food debris and grease were to be removed, and surfaces cleaned and sanitized.

headline: No hot water at handwash sinks; core violations
summary: Women's and men's washroom handwash sinks had no hot water, at 54°F and 53.6°F. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Grease and food debris covered fryers and coolers. A 1/4-inch front door gap and repeat core violations were noted.

headline: Overflowing dumpster; no hair restraints
summary: Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints. The outside dumpster was overflowing and its lids would not close, and a citation was issued. The toilet room door was not self-closing, and clutter on rear stairs needed removing.

headline: Handwash signs missing; dusty exhaust filters
summary: Two handwashing sinks lacked signs, and the manager was told to add them. A beverage cooler had no thermometer, but the manager provided one during inspection. Dust was on overhead exhaust filters in the main kitchen.

headline: Unlabeled bottles; improper knife and cloth storage
summary: Condiment bottles in the food prep area had no labels. Wiping cloths and butcher knives were stored improperly on tables, and paper plates were stored incorrectly. A cracked floor tile and a burned-out bulb were also noted.

headline: Mold in ice machine; expired allergen certificate
summary: Black, pink, and beige mold was on the ice machine shield and interior near the door. Ice must be destroyed and the machine cleaned. Also noted: leaking drain pipes at two sinks, boxes on the floor, and an expired allergen certificate.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; unit tagged out
summary: The low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged. It must not be used until reinspected. Also noted: no valid food handler training, missing manager allergen training, a gap under the rear door, and tortillas on the floor.

headline: No food thermometers; missing hair restraint
summary: The walk-in cooler had no thermometer, and there was no metal stem thermometer for food temperatures. A citation was issued for the latter. An employee in prep lacked a hair restraint. Bulk containers were unlabeled, and the exhaust hood was greasy.

headline: Worn cooler gaskets; food splatter on ceiling
summary: Gaskets on a two-door refrigerator in the rear prep area were in poor repair and needed replacing. Floors had minor food and dirt debris. Food splatters were on the ceiling above hot holding units.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; replace them
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving throughout the prep and storage areas. They must be removed and replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Over 50 mouse droppings; dish machine tagged
summary: More than 50 mouse droppings were found, over 30 in the boiler room and 20 in rear storage. A citation was issued. An unused low-temperature dish machine at 0 ppm chlorine was tagged and must not be used until repaired. Expired certificates were also noted.

headline: Live roaches found; sanitizer and cold holding failed
summary: Three live roaches were in the dish area, and a citation was issued. The dish machine's sanitizer ran empty during use, reading 0 ppm; an employee replaced it. Cold TCS foods at 45°F to 48°F were discarded, and a cooler at 45°F was serviced.

headline: Items left in three-compartment sink
summary: Unnecessary items, including a large soap bucket, were found in the three-compartment sink. The person in charge was told to keep the sink clear for proper washing.

headline: Dirty ice machine guard; food stored on floor
summary: Dirt was found on the ice machine's interior guard. Boxed food was stored on the floor in rear dry storage. Staff were told to clean the guard and raise food six inches off the floor.

headline: Moldy produce discarded; sink loose and leaking
summary: Whole lemons and jalapeños in a basement walk-in were covered in mold-like growth. About 10 pounds were discarded on site, and a citation was issued. A kitchen handwash sink was loose and leaking. Bulk containers lacked labels.

headline: Missing allergen training; hair restraints needed
summary: No proof of allergen training was provided for the certified food manager. Food handlers must wear effective hair and beard restraints. Peeling plastic on equipment and a cracked raw brick wall beside the customer toilet also need fixing.

headline: Dirty floor behind grease trap
summary: Floors under and behind the grease trap at the three-compartment sink had dirt and debris. The inspector required cleaning and ongoing maintenance.

headline: Clutter on basement storage floor
summary: Excessive clutter was on the floor of the basement rear storage room. Management was told to remove unnecessary items and store the rest off the floor.

headline: Items stored on cooler floor; damaged wall
summary: Cardboard was on walk-in cooler shelving and items were stored on the cooler floor. A wall under the dish machine was damaged. Staff were told to remove the cardboard, keep items off the floor, and repair the wall.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training on site
summary: On re-inspection, no allergen training was on site for one City of Chicago certified foodservice manager. The inspector said all such managers must obtain it and keep proof on site.

headline: Grease and food debris on equipment
summary: Accumulated grease and food debris were on prep tables, coolers, freezers, and shelving. Soiled mop heads were not stored properly and must be hung to prevent insect breeding. Hood filters had dust buildup.

headline: Peeling paint on floor behind counter
summary: Paint was peeling on the white floor behind the counter, near the coffee machine. The person in charge was told to repair and maintain it.

headline: About 50 rodent droppings found in prep area
summary: About 50 rodent droppings were under and on shelves and mobile carts in the rear prep area, and a citation was issued. No gnawed food was found. Also noted: unlabeled containers, milk crates used as shelving, and employee belongings in prep.

headline: Cooking equipment and walls need cleaning
summary: Staff were told to clean the wok station, stove, deep fryers, prep coolers and freezers, storage shelves, and prep tables in the rear prep area. Grease on the wall behind the cooking equipment also needed cleaning.

headline: No employee health policy or vomit cleanup plan
summary: No written employee health policy was on site. No written cleaning procedure or supplies were available for vomit and diarrhea events. Both are priority violations. Unused construction materials must be removed to prevent pest harboring.

headline: No allergen training during inspection
summary: No allergen training was present during the inspection. The person in charge was told that all foodservice managers must complete allergen training and keep it current at all times.

headline: No mop hangers; dim walk-in cooler lighting
summary: No mop hangers were at the mop sink area, and staff were told to install them. The walk-in cooler had inadequate lighting, and the inspector asked for more lights.

headline: About 20 live flying insects found indoors
summary: About 20 live small flying insects were on walls and ceilings in the women's washroom, dish area, and hallway storage. Management was told to eliminate them, and a citation was issued. Grease trap, dish area walls and floors, and floor drains need cleaning.

headline: Handwash supplies missing; several fixed on site
summary: Handwashing cleanser and paper towels were missing at several sinks, and the person in charge supplied them during inspection. A citation was issued. Buckets blocking a warewashing handwash sink were removed. Missing cold-unit thermometers were also noted.

headline: Flies found in several areas; pest report needed
summary: About 11 flies were in the front prep area, 5 near soiled linens and the dish area, and 4 near the rear exit. A citation was issued. The inspector asked for removal, a current pest service report, and a thermometer replacement.

headline: Missing ceiling panels in both toilet rooms
summary: Multiple ceiling panels were missing in both toilet rooms. The person in charge was told to repair them and keep them maintained.

headline: Grease and food debris throughout kitchen
summary: Grease covered cooking equipment, walls, floors, and shelving in the kitchen and prep areas and must be degreased and sanitized. Food debris and spills were found throughout, clutter was on a closet floor, and a hood light was burned out.

headline: Dock door doesn't seal; floors need cleaning
summary: The rear overhead dock door did not seal at the side and floor and must be replaced to prevent pest entry. Display shelving had spills. Floors needed cleaning in the deli prep area, dairy cooler, and customer men's washroom.

headline: No employee health policy; no vomit cleanup supplies
summary: No employee health policy and no written procedure or adequate supplies for vomit and diarrhea events were on site; both are priority violations. The front door had a 1/2-inch gap. The sanitation manager lacked allergen training.

headline: No proof of employee health policy on site
summary: The person in charge could not show an employee health policy on site. The inspector required one with signed acknowledgments from each employee. No citation was issued. The unisex employee washroom door also needs a self-closing device.

headline: Repeat missing allergen training; dirty floors
summary: Allergen training for the certified food manager was still missing, a repeat core violation not corrected, and a citation was issued. The floor under the rear soda system and inside the walk-in freezer were dirty with food debris.

headline: Hair restraints missing; dirty floors and microwave
summary: Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints. The microwave's interior and exterior were not clean. Food debris and dirt were on floors under cooking equipment and in corners, and dust was on the walk-in cooler fan and wall vents.

headline: Live cockroaches found; chicken thawed unsafely
summary: Four live cockroaches were under a handwash sink. Frozen chicken was thawed in standing water in a sink. A metal stem thermometer was missing. Paper towels and a fly ribbon were fixed during inspection. Citations were issued.

headline: Prep cooler at 54.1°F; no allergen certificate
summary: The prep area stand-up cooler measured 54.1°F and must be repaired to 41°F or below. A citation was issued. The three-compartment sink floor drain drains slowly, and hood filters had grease buildup. The food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: No food handler training certificates on site
summary: No food handler training certificates were on site. The business was told that all food handlers must be certified and that employee names must be kept on the premises.

headline: Door gap, taped gaskets, and leaking faucet
summary: A rear exterior door had a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom and must be repaired. Cold holding units had gaskets wrapped in duct tape. The three-compartment sink faucet leaked, and hood filters had grease buildup.

headline: Pre-packaged sandwiches missing business name
summary: Pre-packaged sandwiches did not show the business name and address. The inspector instructed the business to add them to the labels.

headline: No certified manager; cold foods held too warm
summary: No certified food manager was on site, and no signed employee health policy copies were available; both were cited. Cooked corn, chicken mix, and raw eggs were held at 59°F to 60°F in a drawer cooler, and about 40 pounds were discarded.

headline: Black growth on sink caulking; burned-out bulb
summary: Caulking at rear prep handwash sinks was peeling and cracked, with black substance growing on it. The inspector required resurfacing to make it smooth and cleanable. A hood light bulb was burned out and needed replacing.

headline: Uncovered food; no training proof for staff
summary: Food was uncovered in the walk-in and prep coolers, and utensils were stored inside food containers. Food was in plastic grocery bags in a cold holding unit. No food handler training proof was shown, and the on-duty manager had no allergen certificate posted.

headline: No certified manager; no soap at prep sinks
summary: No City of Chicago sanitation manager certificate was on premises while TCS foods were handled, and a citation was issued. Two prep-area handwash sinks had no soap, which was provided by the end of inspection. Bulk containers were unlabeled.

headline: Food debris on equipment and floors
summary: Food debris was found under the doughnut case and espresso machine, on cooler door gaskets, and on the floor of the front prep area. Staff were told to clean and maintain these areas.

headline: Cold food unsafe; about 20 mouse droppings
summary: Raw eggs, cream cheese, and milk-containing cake were held at 46.9°F to 57.6°F, above the 41°F limit. About 50 pounds of food was discarded. About 20 mouse droppings were found, including in basement storage. A citation was issued.

headline: Food on walk-in floor; spills and leaking drain
summary: Food was stored on the floor inside the walk-in cooler and must be raised six inches. Food spills and debris were on coolers, shelving, and prep tables. A dish area handwashing sink had a leaking drainpipe.

headline: No thermometers in cold holding units
summary: Cold holding units in the M20 storage area had no thermometers, and the person in charge was told to provide them. Cardboard was used as shelf liner in the prep area, and food debris covered the prep area floor.

headline: Ice machine mold; repeat core violations uncorrected
summary: The ice machine had a panel covered in black mold-like substance, and a citation was issued. No valid food service sanitation certificate was posted. Repeat core violations were not corrected: a mop sink was covered with wood, and allergen training was missing.

headline: Black slime on sink caulk; deli cooler failing
summary: Black slime built up on caulk around the three-compartment sink and must be removed and re-caulked. The empty deli cooler was not working and must hold 41°F or below. A steady faucet drip needed repair.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; soiled freezer bottom
summary: Torn gaskets were inside the dairy reach-in cooler in the front wait area and must be repaired. Soil and ice buildup at the bottom of the rear reach-in freezer needed defrosting and cleaning.

headline: Cutting boards grooved and seamed; replace
summary: Three cutting boards had deep grooves and open seams. The inspector instructed staff to repair or replace them.

headline: Cup used to scoop cheese; training proof missing
summary: Inspector saw a disposable cup used to scoop cheese and told staff to use a utensil. Proof of food handler training and certified managers' allergen training was missing. Ice machine discoloration and upkeep issues were also noted.

headline: No handwashing signs in washrooms
summary: Washrooms had no handwashing signs. The inspector required signs at all handwashing sinks in the facility. Soiled mop heads were not stored properly and must be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Floor under dish machine needs cleaning
summary: The floor beneath the dish machine was soiled with mineral buildup and dried food debris. Staff were told to clean it at an adequate frequency.

headline: Shared kitchen needs cleaning; grease on walls
summary: In the shared kitchen, prep tables along the cook's line needed cleaning. The floor behind the deep fryer and grill, grease on walls, and floors in three walk-in freezers also needed cleaning.

headline: No certified manager during food preparation
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager was on site while milk, chicken, sausage patties, and eggs were prepared. A citation was issued. Food containers lacked labels, the walk-in cooler was dusty, and no proof of allergen training was shown.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; spills and dust
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving throughout prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving six inches off the floor. Food debris and spills were found throughout. Ceiling tiles were missing, and dust had built up.

headline: Handwash sinks too cool; signage missing
summary: Handwashing sinks in employee washrooms measured 78.6°F to 89.2°F, below the required 100°F. Handwashing signs were missing. Wall-base buildup near the three-compartment sink was noted as corrected on site.

headline: Damaged cooler gaskets; dusty restroom vents
summary: Gaskets on the prep cooler were damaged and must be replaced. Dust had built up on restroom vents, and the person in charge was told to clean them.

headline: Peeling ceiling paint above dish machine
summary: Ceiling paint was peeling above the dish machine drain board. It must be removed, and the ceiling repainted with a smooth surface.

headline: Cold water handle needs repair at handwash sink
summary: The cold water handle for the exposed handwashing sink in the rear food prep area, next to the three-compartment sink, must be repaired.

headline: Items on floor; grease and debris buildup
summary: Containers and dish crates were stored on floors in the rear warewashing and prep area. The wiping cloth sanitizer was inadequate and was remade during inspection. Floors had grease, food debris, spills, and standing water under the dish rack.

headline: Hot foods too cool; about 40 pounds discarded
summary: Cooked chicken, salmon, chicken tenders, and rice were held at 120°F to 128°F in the hot holding unit, below the 135°F minimum. The food was discarded, about 40 pounds worth $200. A citation was issued.

headline: Grab-and-go desserts lacked required labels
summary: Prepackaged grab-and-go desserts at the front counter had no labels showing business name, business address, or ingredients. The inspector instructed the business to provide them.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: The City of Chicago food service sanitation manager did not have the required allergen training certificate. Also noted: a stained cutting board, an unlabeled dry storage container, and missing wall coving under two sinks.

headline: Tortillas on floor; ice machine needs cleaning
summary: Tortillas were stored on the floor in the main prep area and must be raised at least 6 inches. The ice machine interior had buildup. Also noted: rusty, peeling racks in the walk-in and food spills in reach-in coolers.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; damaged gasket
summary: The main kitchen prep cooler had no thermometer, and the person in charge was told to provide one. A rear double-door cooler had a damaged gasket that needed replacing.

headline: Dishwashing handwash sink at 86°F
summary: The handwashing sink in the dishwashing area had no hot water and measured 86°F. The manager was told it must reach at least 100°F. A priority violation was noted.

headline: No hot water in restroom; training certificates missing
summary: The restroom washbowl and utility mop sink had no hot water, measuring 55°F. Handwashing sinks must reach 100°F. No food handler certificates were on site, and certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Slow-draining sink; no covered trash in washroom
summary: The three-compartment sink drained slowly and had no working stoppers. The employee women's washroom had no covered trash receptacle. One food manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; sink leak
summary: The rear exit door to the outdoor garbage area was not rodent-proof at the bottom. Grease built up in the lower opening of the deep fryer. A leak under the three-compartment sink needed repair.

headline: Leaky sink pipe; walk-in floors need cleaning
summary: A leaky pipe under the first sink must be repaired. Floors inside the walk-in cooler and freezer had spills and debris and need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager during sushi preparation
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods such as sushi were prepared and served. A citation was issued. Allergen training certificates were also missing for certified managers.

headline: Dead roaches found; ice chute contamination
summary: Dead large and small roaches were in the lobby heater closet and upstairs dry storage. Black and yellow-green substance was in the ice chute, and all ice must be removed. Consumer advisory, food handler training, and allergen proof were also missing.

headline: Cold eggs and tomatoes unsafe; cooler repair needed
summary: Raw eggs at 46.5°F and sliced tomatoes at 49.8°F were discarded, $64 worth. A two-door reach-in's top ran at 46.3°F, so staff were told not to use it until repaired. A damaged lid and dusty hood filters were also noted.

headline: No certified manager on site while beef prepared
summary: No certified manager was on site while beef and other TCS items were prepared, until one arrived at 3:15 PM. A citation was issued. No vomit and diarrhea kit or food handler certificates were on site. Grease and debris were on equipment.

headline: Dish machines sanitized poorly; most repaired on site
summary: A high-temperature dish machine's final rinse was 156°F, below the 180°F minimum, and was repaired to 194°F. Two low-temperature dish machines at 0 and 10 ppm chlorine were repaired to 50 ppm on site. A cooler at 54.9°F was tagged.

headline: No certified manager; sinks lack soap and towels
summary: No certified manager was on site when beans were prepared and served, and no valid certificate was posted; a citation was issued. Prep and dish sinks lacked soap and paper towels. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables.

headline: No certified manager while chicken prepared
summary: No certified manager was on duty while TCS foods such as chicken were prepared. A citation was issued. A person with a valid City of Chicago foodservice manager certificate must be on site at all times. A torn gasket on a two-door cooler also needs repair.

headline: Leaking handwash sink faucets; floors need cleaning
summary: Hand sinks in the front servery and rear prep area leaked at the base of the faucets and must be repaired. Floors and drains around the dish machine needed cleaning to remove spills and debris.

headline: Missing handwash signs and waste bin cover
summary: Handwashing sinks in the prep and warewashing area had no signage. The female toilet room waste receptacle had no cover. The inspector required both to be provided and maintained.

headline: Food in grocery bags; managers lack allergen training
summary: Food was stored in grocery bags inside refrigerators. A handleless soup bowl was used to scoop rice. Certified managers lacked allergen training, a repeat core violation, and a citation was issued. Sink stoppers and washroom trash lids were also missing.

headline: Food handler training certificates not on site
summary: Food handlers did not have training certificates on site and were told to provide them. Toilet fixtures needed cleaning. Floors throughout the facility had excessive grease and food debris.

headline: Front door gap; floors and drains need cleaning
summary: A 1/4-inch gap between the front doors could allow pests in and must be repaired. Floors at the front bar had spills and debris. Basement food prep floor drains also need cleaning.

headline: Cold foods above 41°F; coolers at 50°F
summary: Beef, chicken, sour cream, eggs, and milk measured 47°F to 52°F. Two walk-in coolers ran at 50°F. A citation was issued. Plastic cups were used to scoop salsa, and single-use utensils were stored in a cardboard box.

headline: Silverware stored beside handwash sink
summary: Silverware was stored next to the handwash sink. The person in charge was told to install a partition between the storage shelves and the sink to prevent contamination.

headline: Rat droppings found; unlabeled cooked foods discarded
summary: About 15 to 20 rat droppings were under bulk soda racks, and 10 were in a bathroom washbowl cabinet. A citation was issued. Cooked foods held over 24 hours without date labels, about 25 pounds, were discarded. No food handler training proof was on site.

headline: Floors have debris and dust buildup
summary: Loose debris, dirt, and dust had built up on floors and in corners throughout the facility. Staff were told to detail clean and increase cleaning frequency.

headline: Food stored in grocery bags in coolers
summary: Assorted food items were stored in plastic grocery bags inside cooler units. The inspector instructed staff to store all food in approved food-grade containers.

headline: Fryer grease debris; minor sink leak
summary: Fryer interiors had dirt, food, and grease debris. A minor leak at the hot water knob of the three-compartment sink needed repair. Dirt was under and behind cooking equipment. A business license number was missing from a side panel.

headline: Live roach and about 50 droppings found
summary: One live roach was on the three-compartment sink, and about 50 roach droppings were on a wall near the knife rack. A citation was issued. A repeat violation found an employee without food handler training. Pink slime was in the ice machine.

headline: Live roach and flies; cold food unsafe
summary: About 30 small flies and one live roach were found, including a roach on a dining table. The manager killed it, and a citation was issued. Cold TCS foods at 45.5°F to 48.4°F were discarded. The dish machine was tagged after sanitizing at 0 ppm.

headline: Fail: no health policy, mold in ice machine
summary: No valid city sanitation certificate posted; person in charge lacked proof of food safety training. No written employee health policy. Basement ice machine had black and pink buildup touching ice; removal and cleaning ordered. Also: no metal stem thermometer and no covered restroom receptacle.

headline: Handwashing skipped between tasks; corrected
summary: Food handler did not wash hands between tasks: touched glasses, drained a sink, put on gloves, then prepared food. Employee washed hands after being told. Also noted: no ambient air thermometer in the hot holding unit and debris under dish equipment.

headline: Potato slicer needs cleaning
summary: Re-inspection: wall-mounted potato slicer had food debris and must be cleaned. This was the only item noted.

headline: Rice at 52°F discarded; cooler gaskets damaged
summary: Cold rice held at 52°F was corrected on site: manager discarded about 5 lbs. Also noted: damaged cooler gaskets, a garbage bag used as a box liner, milk crates used as shelves, leaking faucets, a missing self-closing door, and damaged floor tiles.

headline: Worn cutting boards; dirty soda dispenser
summary: Cutting boards worn with deep cuts need replacing. Soda dispenser needs cleaning to remove build-up. Floors under counters need cleaning of food spills. Filters on hood vent need cleaning of grease build-up.

headline: Front cooler too warm; food discarded
