summary: Front cooler held ham, chicken, eggs and other TCS foods at 45.8–49.6°F; about 40 lbs ($100) discarded. Cooler reached 56°F and was tagged; it must be serviced and reinspected. Also: low hot water at front handsink, leaking faucets, and stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Cooler and freezer interiors need cleaning
summary: Prep cooler and walk-in cooler shelving need cleaning, and the walk-in freezer must be defrosted and cleaned. Basement floors and the inside of the walk-in cooler need cleaning to remove spills and debris. No pests were found.

headline: Re-insulate cooler lines; regrout floors
summary: Walk-in cooler cooling-line insulation is in poor repair, dusty and loose-taped; must be removed and maintained. Kitchen floor tiles are missing grout, trapping dirt and wastewater; must be regrouted. Walk-in cooler needs additional lighting.

headline: Improper handwashing; hot and cold food unsafe
summary: Gloved worker rinsed hands without soap and dried them on a wiping cloth; corrected on site. Hot chicken held at 94–127°F; about 60 lbs ($550) discarded. Cold foods at 52–78°F; about 28 lbs discarded. Rear exit door has small gaps to be sealed.

headline: Cardboard liners and food splatter noted
summary: Cardboard and foil lined shelving and pipes, which can shelter insects. Standing liquid and heavy ice build-up in the rear walk-in cooler. Food splatter on rear walls. Inspector instructed cleaning and removal. No pests were found.

headline: Boxes on freezer floor, grease and leaks
summary: Boxes stored on a container in the walk-in freezer; shelving must lift food six inches off the floor. Grease buildup inside a cabinet, fryer and pita press. Water leaking from a stopper under the three-compartment sink.

headline: Re-inspection: dish machine temperature too low
summary: Dish machine final rinse gauge showed 104°F while the surface reached 160°F; must be repaired to display 180°F. Metal bowls stored in cut-fruit containers. Damaged wall cove creating an opening for insects. Mold-like substance on walls under the three-compartment sink.

headline: Grocery cooler lacks thermometer
summary: Inspector could not find a thermometer inside the grocery cooling unit; instructed to provide and maintain one. No other issues were noted.

headline: Sink leak; cardboard floor matting
summary: Leak at the three-compartment sink faucet must be repaired. Cardboard boxes used as floor matting in the walk-in cooler must be replaced with washable mats. Debris along the dining area baseboard and under rear storage shelves. Freezer light bulb needs replacing.

headline: Raw beef thawed improperly; expired certificates
summary: Raw beef stored in a bulk container on prep table shelving instead of thawing under refrigeration or running water. Food debris under heavy grill equipment. Allergen training certificates for certified managers were expired.

headline: Leaking faucets; slow bathroom drains
summary: Leaks from three-compartment sink faucets in the bar and dishwashing areas. Slow drainage at bathroom handsinks. Must be repaired and maintained.

headline: No health policy; door gap; wall openings
summary: No written employee health policy; signed copies needed for each employee. A 1/2-inch gap at the bottom of the front door needs a door sweep. Openings in walls around the three-compartment sink and HVAC unit must be sealed. All food handlers must show training proof.

headline: No meat cooler thermometer; hair restraints
summary: No thermometer in fresh meat display cooler. Food handlers in produce cutting area need hair restraints for waist-length hair. Dust and food debris under shelving on selling floors; cleaning ordered.

headline: Dead insects and trash in receiving area
summary: Dead insects in corners of rear receiving area; must be removed, detail cleaned and sanitized. Trash, dirt and debris built up under lockers and behind pallets near receiving; detail cleaning ordered.

headline: No certified manager on site during inspection
summary: No certified food manager on site; one must be present whenever open. No handwashing sign at dishwashing-area sink; a splashguard is needed by the pizza prep cooler; lower pizza cooler shelves have food buildup; allergen certificate missing for certified managers.

headline: Handsoap, towels missing; food on floor
summary: Handsinks lacked soap and paper towels; citation issued; staff supplied them during inspection. A 1/4-inch gap at rear exit door; food stored on floors in walk-in cooler and freezer. Grease buildup on fryers; leaking valve under three-compartment sink.

headline: Fail: glove contamination, sanitizer at 0 ppm
summary: Worker wiped gloves on a soiled towel after sneezing; sushi discarded. Low-temperature dish machine sanitizer measured 0 ppm; machine tagged. Mold-like slime found in the rear ice machine, dripping onto ice. No food handler certificates; PIC lacked allergen proof.

headline: Fail: no sanitation certificate; old violations
summary: No person in charge with verifiable sanitation manager training; no valid original city sanitation certificate on site while eggs were prepared; citation issued. Prior violations not corrected: broken refrigerator handle, torn freezer gaskets, no self-closing washroom door, and debris behind freezers.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: Re-inspection: sanitation manager had no allergen training and must provide proof. This was the only item noted.

headline: Re-inspection: labels, containers, grease, hood
summary: Bulk ingredients unlabeled. Food containers on floor need six-inch shelving. Scoops with disposable cups need tongs or ladles. Dirty wiping cloths, torn cooler gasket, cardboard floor liner, a hole in the basement walk-in floor, and heavy hood grease.

headline: Food handler without training records
summary: A food handler was working on site without training documentation. Records must be provided and maintained, or citations will follow.

headline: Women's restroom needs covered receptacle
summary: Women's restroom needs a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. This was the only item noted.

headline: Food on floor; bulk containers unlabeled
summary: Boxes of chicken and fish stored on walk-in cooler floor; must be moved to shelving. Bulk sugar, flour and spices must be labeled. Grease buildup on ventilation hood must be cleaned.

headline: Leak under sink; cracked front window
summary: Leak underneath the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Front passenger-side window is cracked and must be repaired.

headline: No handwashing signs; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: No handwashing sign at rear handsink; bulk containers unlabeled; unwrapped straws uncovered in front prep. No backflow device on utility sink. Damaged floor tiles in rear prep area.

headline: Fail: mold in ice machines; flies; gaps
summary: Mold-like substance on all three basement ice machines; ice must be destroyed and machines cleaned and sanitized. Over 20 small flies on walls and ceilings in several areas; pest control recommended on or after 2/19/2025. Openings at both front doors; no dish machine data plate.

headline: Fail: no working thermometer; no hot water
summary: No working metal stem thermometer on site to check TCS food temperatures; citation issued. Dry ingredients unlabeled; cutting boards stained and grooved; no hot water at mop sink; clutter in dry storage; no proof of food handler or allergen training.

headline: Hair restraints, wiping cloths, floor drains
summary: Employees not wearing hair restraints while preparing and serving TCS foods. Wiping cloths stored on prep tables instead of in sanitizing solution. Dirt and debris on floor drains throughout the premises; must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Over 25 rat droppings; coolers too warm
summary: Over 25 rat droppings found along wall bases; detail cleaning and pest treatment required. All cold holding equipment measured 50–80°F; must not be used until it holds 41°F or below. No employee health policy on site. Allergen certification missing for manager.

headline: Fryer grease; dirty floor drains
summary: Grease buildup inside deep fryers in the kitchen must be cleaned and maintained. Dirt and debris on floor drains in the rear dishwashing area must be cleaned.

headline: Fail: ice maker debris, knives, grease container
summary: Debris encrusted inside the ice maker must be detail cleaned. Knives and ice scoop stored improperly. Outside grease container excessively greasy, with spilled grease on ground; priority citation issued. Also noted: grease in fryers and on floors, unlabeled dry containers, cluttered toilet room, and no food handler certificates.

headline: No paper towels at prep handsink; grease spills
summary: No paper towels at the main prep handsink while a cook handled food; towels were replaced during inspection; citation issued. Also noted: grease spills under cooking equipment, a jacket on the meat slicer, and a repeat outside oil container violation.

headline: Bare-hand salsa prep, strong sanitizer, warm food
summary: Worker used bare hands on cilantro for salsa; manager discarded 1/4 gallon. Sanitizer measured about 3,010 ppm, far above the label limit; manager said it will be diluted. Cold foods at 45–57°F; about 30 lbs of cheese discarded. Conditional pass.

headline: Uncovered food, floor storage, allergen training gap
summary: Bulk containers were uncovered and food was stored on floors; manager told to cover and raise items six inches. Also noted: damaged cooler gasket, peeling shelf paint, dusty and greasy cooler fans and equipment, a leaking faucet, debris, and a missing light shield.

headline: Labels, ice machine, floors, and hood cleaning
summary: Bulk food containers need common-name labels. Ice machine interior needs cleaning. Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizer. Large can opener and hood filters need cleaning. A new prep table is needed at the cook line; floors under dish machine and in rear storage need cleaning.

headline: Sink backup and grease trap seepage; corrected
summary: Waste water backed up into other sink compartments and seeped from the top of the grease trap, leaking onto the floor. Citation issued; food manager corrected the problem on site. No handwashing signage in restroom.

headline: Freezer leak, slow sink, restroom issues
summary: Leaks under the condenser caused ice build-up in the walk-in freezer; service ordered. Slow-draining handsink in second-floor employee bathroom. Fifth-floor bathroom lacked a covered trash can and self-closing door. Bistro kitchen floor drain heavily soiled.

headline: Unapproved fish packing; no allergen certificate
summary: Fresh fish vacuum packed in-house, which is not in the approved food safety plan (HACCP); must stop. Bulk sugar and salt unlabeled. Ice scoops tethered with chain. Deli cups not air dried. Walk-in cooler missing insulation around cooling lines. Manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Re-inspection: no thermometer, hole, no handcards
summary: No thermometer in pizza cooler. Hole in wall under women's restroom handsink must be sealed. No food handler cards on site at inspection; all food handlers must receive training and keep records on site.

headline: Soiled cloths and mop heads; no certificates
summary: Soiled wiping cloths stored on the one-compartment sink; must be kept in sanitizing solution. Unisex restroom lacks covered receptacles and a self-closing door. Soiled mop heads must be hung to prevent insect breeding. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Cardboard shelf liners; grease and dust buildup
summary: Cardboard lining shelves in rear and front storage must be removed. Grease, food debris and spillage on equipment sides and under cooking equipment, plus heavy dust and grease on hood and filters. Cleaning ordered to prevent pests and insects.

headline: Fail: slime in ice maker; cold food too warm
summary: Black slimy substance inside ice maker dripping into ice; citation issued. Walk-in cooler air at 49.7°F; beef, beans, pork and chicken at 47.8–49.1°F; about 75 lbs ($1,500) discarded; refrigeration repair called. Three expired food handler certificates; manager's allergen training expired.

headline: Milk cooler lacks thermometer; expired training
summary: Milk cooler at front coffee bar had no thermometer and a torn interior gasket; both must be fixed. Heavy grease on the used cooking oil container outside. Manager on duty had expired allergen training.

headline: Re-inspection: dirty prep coolers and freezers
summary: Interior of prep coolers is dirty and must be cleaned and maintained. Deep freezers need defrosting and interior cleaning.

headline: Fail: brooms near trays; hair nets; gauge
summary: Brooms and dust pan kept too close to clean tray rack; food handlers with long hair not in hair nets; final rinse gauge on the bakery high-temperature dish machine is not working. Priority foundation violation.

headline: Hair restraints not worn properly
summary: Food service manager was not wearing a hair restraint, and a female food handler's long hair was not secured in her hair net. Staff instructed to wear hair restraints at all times in the food prep area.

headline: Basement floor cleaned on site
summary: Basement floor near the large tanks and corner areas needed cleaning. Corrected on site.

headline: Missing test strips; dirty slicer; poor lighting
summary: No sanitizer test strips for the low-temperature dish machine; must be obtained. Brooms stored next to clean utensil shelves. Meat slicer dirty behind the blade. Walk-in cooler lighting is inadequate, and the women's restroom vent is not working.

headline: Dead roaches, moldy pan, large rear door gap
summary: Three dead cockroaches under equipment in rear storage must be removed. Large gap at rear exterior door must be repaired. Moldy sheet pan in walk-in cooler was cleaned on site. Ice machine drain discharges off the floor drain; wall panel and cooler base detached.

headline: Dust on ceiling above sink
summary: Ceiling above the three-compartment sink needs dust removed. This was the only item noted.

headline: Fail: raw meats mixed; no hand soap
summary: Raw beef oxtails and raw chicken were thawing together, with blood mixing in the same container; raw meats must be separated; citation issued. No hand soap or paper towels at some handsinks. Also: no signed health policies, no menu advisory, and missing food handler certificates.

headline: Handsink blocked and used for drinks
summary: Beverage and salsa prep handsink was inaccessible and used for mixing drinks and washing cups; must be for handwashing only. Frozen pork thawed improperly; salsa buckets stored on floor. Missing hot water handle at basement sink. Basement clutter and food splatter noted.

headline: No health policy; no food handler certificates
summary: No verifiable employee health policy on site; a template was left. Several handsinks lack handwashing signs. Unsealed wood at rooftop employee entrance. Standing water at first-floor bar. No food handler certificates on site; training records must be kept on site at all times.

headline: Fail: no beverage handsink; missing toilets
summary: No handwashing sink in the beverage area of the retail space; one must be installed with hot and cold running water. Three second-floor restrooms are missing toilets. No citation was issued for either item.

headline: Stained cutting boards; chipped paint; bulb out
summary: Cutting boards in rear prep area have deep cuts and dark stains and must be refinished or replaced. Chipping paint on dry storeroom wall must be repainted. Burned-out bulb in walk-in cooler must be replaced.

headline: Missing splashguard; clutter; greasy hood
summary: No washable splashguard between front handsink and smoothie prep area; must be installed. Slight clutter in basement dry storage; shelving six inches off the floor needed. Dirt and grease on hood, filters and pipes must be detail cleaned.

headline: Greasy hood filters; one expired certificate
summary: Grease and grime on cook-line hood filters must be detail cleaned. One food handler certificate was expired. All employees must complete food handler training, and records must be kept on site at all times.

headline: Soiled mop heads; dusty hood; burnt bulbs
summary: Soiled mop heads not stored properly; must be hung to prevent insect breeding. Dust on the hood vent in the main prep line. Three of four walk-in cooler bulbs in the basement are burnt out and must be replaced.

headline: Eggs, butter and milk stored at 57–62°F
summary: Re-inspection: eggs, butter and milk stored at 57–62°F in cooling units; person in charge voluntarily discarded about $280 of food. A bakery cooler at 61°F was tagged and must be repaired before use. Missing thermometers, torn gaskets, a leak, water-damaged ceiling tiles, and burned-out bulbs.

headline: Unlabeled food, floor storage, ceiling openings
summary: Packaged food in display cooler unlabeled; food stored on floor; 1/4-inch gap under front door. Cardboard liners and damaged cutting boards. No stoppers on three-compartment sink and no utility sink. Ceiling openings in staff washroom; no ventilation in east staff washroom.

headline: Grease on walls, stovetops and floor
summary: Inspector noted grease on food prep area walls, a dirty food prep floor, dirty stovetops and the outside of the grease trap. Instructed to clean all of these areas. No pests were found.

headline: Cooler at 50°F; missing handwashing signs
summary: Front prep cooler at 50°F was tagged and must be repaired; no TCS foods were affected and no citation was issued. Handwashing signs missing. Electric insect control device stored on a drink machine must be relocated. Debris on cooler and freezer floors.

headline: Freezer ice build-up; slow sink
summary: Ice build-up inside the freezer cooler must be repaired and maintained. Cutting board has deep grooves and stains. Slow drainage at the three-compartment sink. Soiled mop head not stored properly. Floor debris along walls and corners.

headline: Cold food at 45–48°F; about $680 discarded
summary: Juice bar handsink was blocked with celery and must stay open. Walk-in cooler held salmon, eggs, chicken and pork at 45–48°F; about 156 lbs discarded. Cooler at 48.2°F tagged and held. Also: broken thermometer, damaged cutting boards, a non-flushing urinal, and burnt-out hood bulbs.

headline: 1/4-inch gap at rear door; cluttered basement
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door sweep must be closed so the door is rodent proof. Basement floor is cluttered; items must be elevated off the floor or removed.

headline: Deep freezers have ice build-up
summary: Deep freezers have ice build-up. They must be defrosted, cleaned and maintained.

headline: No health policy; no vomiting/diarrhea kit
summary: No verifiable employee health policy on site; a template was left and signed copies must be kept. No procedure or kit for vomiting and diarrhea events; a one-pager was left, and a kit with a norovirus-effective sanitizer is required. No citation issued.

headline: No health policy or food handler certificates
summary: No valid city sanitation certificate posted for employees; no verifiable employee health policy; food stored in plastic grocery bags in the freezer; soiled mop head; no food handler certificates on site; no allergen training. Corrective instructions given.

headline: Re-inspection: handsinks need 15-second wash
summary: Some washroom handsinks did not run for the required 15 seconds; faucets must be adjusted. No other items were noted.

headline: Frozen boxes stored on walk-in freezer floor
summary: Boxes of frozen food stored on the floor inside the walk-in freezer. Food items must be stored six inches off the floor to prevent contamination.

headline: No covered trash can in women's restroom
summary: Second-floor women's restroom had no covered trash receptacle; one must be provided. This was the only item noted.

headline: Missing soap, hair restraints, sanitizer test kit
summary: Prep handsink lacked soap; staff obtained soap during inspection; citation issued. Food handler not wearing a hair restraint. No sanitizer test kit; manager brought test strips from another location. Loose debris and dust in basement storage. Allergen training missing since 2023.

headline: Re-inspection: no hot water at two sinks
summary: Men's washroom right-side handsink has no hot water; a rear prep compartment sink also lacks hot water; both must be restored. No handwashing sign in women's washroom. Rice and pasta containers in rear prep area unlabeled.

headline: No original food sanitation certificate posted
summary: Re-inspection: no certified food manager on site; only a photocopy of the certificate was shown. Also noted: missing handwashing signs, a missing hair restraint, beverages stored on the floor, damaged cooler gaskets, a non-working toilet, and no proof of food handler training.

headline: Re-inspection: storage, grime, and posting issues
summary: Catering dishes stored on basement floor must be raised six inches. Unnecessary and nonworking items in basement storage must be removed. Cookline floors and caster wheels heavily soiled. Women's restroom faucet hard to open. Food handler certificates missing on site.

headline: Undercooked egg dishes not disclosed on menu
summary: Menu did not tell customers which items, such as ramen with undercooked eggs, are raw or undercooked. Also noted: improperly stored knives, food on floors, dirty curtains and mop sink, cardboard shelf liner, and an unused cooler by the outdoor garbage area.

headline: Fail: live roaches found; food on floor
summary: Live roach activity in dry storage and bar area; manager instructed to clean, and pest control service is needed. Handsink lacked soap; rear handsink blocked. Food stored on floor; buffet lacked protective barriers. Leaking three-compartment sink and damaged floor tiles.

headline: Fail: repeat violations not corrected
summary: Repeat core violations from a 2024 report were not corrected: bulk containers unlabeled, pots not stored inverted, torn cooler gasket beside handsink, peeling paint, and water-damaged, missing ceiling tiles in basement prep. Citation issued.

headline: Re-inspection: storage clutter and allergen training
summary: Basement storage room needs detail cleaning and organizing to prevent pest harborage; mops and brooms must be raised six inches. Employees with city sanitation certificates must complete allergen training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: No posted sanitation certificate; shellstock tags
summary: No verifiable sanitation certificate posted with certified manager; citation issued. Shellstock tags lacked sale dates; a dating system was created on site. Sewage lines over food not shielded. Milk crates used as shelves; leaks at bar handsink and dish machine drain; damaged floor tiles and missing ceiling panels.

headline: Fail: no consumer advisory; no handsink sign
summary: No handwashing sign at employee restroom sink. Menu had a footnote reminder but no asterisk disclosure marking raw or undercooked items such as raw oysters and tuna. Priority violation; disclosure and reminder must both be provided on the menu.

headline: Fail: no certificate, pest logs missing, mold
summary: No valid sanitation certificate for employee on site; no written health policy; no vomiting/diarrhea procedure; blocked rear handsink; mold-like substance on ice machine panels touching ice; pest control logs lacked 2024 reports; no food handler training proof.

headline: Greasy floors, debris, hole in prep table
summary: Dirt, grease, food splatter and debris under and around equipment and along lower walls; tea debris and standing water at bar entrance. Must be cleaned to prevent pests and insects. Large hole in bottom of rear prep table must be repaired.

headline: Milk cooler lacks thermometer; ice build-up
summary: Bar milk cooler had no thermometer; a working one must be provided. Ice build-up on the condenser must be removed. No food handler training certificate on premises, and no allergen training certificates for food managers.

headline: Live flies, bare-hand bread cutting, sewage backup
summary: About 75 or more live small flies in bar, dining, prep and dish areas. A worker cut bread with bare hands; manager discarded it. Cold potatoes at 49–53°F discarded. Sewage backed up from a floor drain; it was rodded and cleaned on site. Restroom hot water was restored.

headline: Leaking faucet; broken self-closing door
summary: Small leak at three-compartment sink faucet must be fixed. Broken self-closing device on employee washroom door must be repaired. Floors along walls and corners in basement storage need detail cleaning. Certified manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: No health policy; dishwashing sink needs sign
summary: No written employee health policy on site; one must be provided with a signed acknowledgment from each employee. Handwashing sign must be posted at the dishwashing area sink.

headline: Standing water in staff toilet room
summary: Standing water on the floor of the retail-side staff toilet room must be cleaned. This was the only item noted.

headline: Expired certificate; cold foods above 41°F
summary: Expired manager sanitation certificate; updated certificates required during operating hours; citation issued. Hot dogs, deli snack packs and cheese in front cooler at 48.9–50.1°F; about 10 lbs ($50) discarded. Cardboard shelf liner; debris and spills behind drink stations.

headline: Basement prep lacks handsink; storage problems
summary: Basement food prep area needs a handwashing sink with hot and cold water, or prep items must be removed. Also noted: chip baskets on ready-to-eat chips, no cook food handler proof, damaged freezer shelving, mold-like caulking, missing tile, and a 2024 storage violation not corrected.

headline: Re-inspection: many repairs; no food handler training
summary: Many items: slow drain, unlabeled desserts and squeeze bottles, food on floor, handler without hair restraint, damaged chest freezer lid, crates used for storage, grease and food buildup, loose wall panels and damaged floor tiles, and no food handler training for employees.

headline: Leaks, missing lighting, missing food handler cards
summary: Leaks under the dish machine and a hand sink must be repaired. Basement restroom needs a covered waste receptacle. Dish and dry storage areas need more lighting, and basement prep light shields are missing. Most food handlers lacked valid training certificates.

headline: Fail: cooling pasta covered; no dish temperature gauge
summary: Cooked pasta was covered with lids while cooling; must be loosely covered or uncovered while cooling. High-temperature dish machine had no irreversible temperature indicator; citation issued. Floor drains under equipment soiled with dried food and grease.

headline: Repeat violation: ice machine still dirty
summary: Re-inspection: self-serve drink dispenser ice machine in dining area still has white, black and brown buildup touching ice; previously cited and not corrected. Now a priority violation. Deep clean and sanitize required before re-inspection; citation issued.

headline: Re-inspection: door gaps, ceiling stain, allergen proof
summary: Openings at the bottoms of three doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Stained hallway ceiling needs repainting. Grease on hood lights must be cleaned. Proof of allergen training was not provided for an employee with a city sanitation certificate.

headline: Rear washroom ventilation not working
summary: Mechanical ventilation in the rear washroom is non-functional and in poor repair. The facility must provide working ventilation with enough capacity to remove odors and keep it working.

headline: Rat droppings and black slime in ice machine
summary: About 50-60 rat droppings were found in basement prep, storage, and under the dish machine. Pest control must service the building before reinspection next week. A basement ice machine had black slime dripping onto ice used for customers. Priority citation issued.

headline: Repeat violations: containers, grease, residue
summary: Violations from 2023 were not fixed. Salsa was made in 55-gallon garbage containers, and heavy grease and food residue covered cooking equipment and walls. Clay cups lacked lead-free documentation and were ordered removed or documented.

headline: No employee health policy or training records
summary: No employee health policy or training was on site, a priority violation. Food handler and allergen training certificates were not provided. A broken gasket on two reach-in coolers at dessert prep needs repair.

headline: Truck license number missing from sides
summary: The truck's license number must be added to both sides in a clearly visible place. White plastic covering on the sink, grill, hot holding, and cooler units must be removed. The three-compartment sink also needs wash, rinse, and sanitize labels.

headline: Re-inspection passed; minor storage fixes
summary: Re-inspection passed. A dessert sneeze guard at stand 212 is at the wrong height, ice scoops were improperly stored at four stands, and milk crates are used for storage throughout. Staff were told to correct these.

headline: Heavy grease under grill; excess prep clutter
summary: The toilet room door does not close securely and must be repaired or replaced. Floors under the grill line are heavily soiled with grease and dried food debris. Excess clutter in the rear prep area blocks cleaning and pest monitoring and must be removed.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; hard-to-reach backflow device
summary: The kitchen handwashing sink lacks a handwashing sign. A backflow device at the basement utility sink is hard to reach for service and must be relocated or made accessible. Floors and cooler line covers in the basement need cleaning.

headline: Unshielded waste pipes over basement food storage
summary: Overhead waste pipes in basement food storage are not shielded. Staff must encase them to catch drips, and food must not be stored under leaky pipes. Foil shelf liners must be removed, and a slow-draining handsink needs repair.

headline: Grease and food debris on equipment and floors
summary: Grease and food debris were found on the outside of coolers, freezers, and shelving units, and on prep area floors. The manager was told to clean and maintain these areas. No pests were recorded.

headline: Kitchen refrigerator lacks thermometer
summary: The kitchen refrigerator did not have a thermometer. Staff were instructed to provide one. No other issues or pests were listed.

headline: Toilet door not self-closing; missing hood bulbs
summary: Toilet room doors do not close themselves and must have a self-closing device. Missing light bulbs in the front prep hood need to be installed. No pests were recorded.

headline: Rusty shelves and mold-like ceiling in cooler
summary: Rusty, dirty shelves in a kitchen prep refrigerator must be cleaned and repainted with food-grade paint or replaced. A dark, mold-like substance on the basement liquor walk-in cooler ceiling must be cleaned.

headline: No handwashing sink at front food area
summary: No handwashing sink was accessible to the front food dispensing area, a priority citation issue. Open pastries were displayed unprotected, which was corrected on site. Bulk containers lacked labels, and floors under equipment and in the walk-in cooler have grease and debris.

headline: Food debris; leaking sinks; mop heads not hung
summary: Food debris covered cooking equipment, coolers, and shelving. Leaks were found under a one-compartment sink and at both three-compartment sink faucets. Mop heads were not hung to dry, which can breed insects, and grease builds up in the hood.

headline: Flood damage in basement; items on floor
summary: Flooding since the last inspection left items on the basement floor, which must be kept at least 6 inches up. Water damage has cracked and crumbled the basement ceiling, and it must be repaired to be smooth and cleanable.

headline: Backflow device hard to reach; grease in hood
summary: A stained cutting board needs resurfacing or replacement. The backflow device at the utility mop sink must be relocated for service. Construction debris and unused furniture should be removed to prevent pest harborage, and the hood needs detail cleaning.

headline: Ice machine calcium build-up; spoons left in sanitizer
summary: The ice machine interior had calcium build-up and dust and must be cleaned regularly. Spoons in use were left at room temperature in sanitizer solution. Staff must keep utensils under running water, in water at 135°F or above, or on a clean surface.

headline: Front door not rodent-proof; basement clutter
summary: The front entrance door has a large gap at the bottom and must be made rodent-proof. Basement items must be raised on approved shelving, and clutter must be removed to prevent rodent harborage. A handwashing sign is missing in the customer washroom.

headline: Faulty spray hose; dim walk-in cooler light
summary: The spray hose fixture at the 3-compartment sink is in poor repair and cannot be turned off while water runs. Walk-in cooler floors and coving have food debris, and its lighting is too weak. Repairs were ordered.

headline: Repeat cleaning and coving violations uncorrected
summary: Violations from 2020 remain: debris under the 3-compartment sink and dish machine, and missing or damaged coving. An ice machine panel had a pink substance. Also noted: an uncovered restroom receptacle and no allergen proof for a food manager. Citation issued.

headline: 40+ mouse droppings; no certified food manager
summary: Forty or more mouse droppings were found under racks, a freezer, and the service counter. Staff must remove and sanitize them, and pest control is recommended. No certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were served. Prior violations also uncorrected.

headline: Ripped cooler gaskets; uncorrected floor paint
summary: Cook line reach-in cooler door gaskets are ripped and must be repaired or replaced. A repeat violation remains: chipped and peeling paint on basement prep floors must be resurfaced and repainted before reinspection. Priority citation issued.

headline: Mouse droppings and live roaches found; citation
summary: About 50 mouse droppings and 2 live roaches were found, plus dead roaches in the basement. Droppings were under a prep table and near chemical storage. Pest control arrived during the inspection. Priority citation issued.

headline: Food prep not separated from customers
summary: Food prep areas were not separated from customer seating, dining, and restrooms. The inspector required a physical barrier. Uncovered receptacles were found in unisex toilet rooms; the instruction in the notes is incomplete.

headline: Prep coolers not working; no water at sinks
summary: Prep coolers were not working and must hold 41°F or below. No water was available for handwashing or the 3-compartment sink. Window and rear door screens are needed, and an opening to the driver area must be covered. No citation was issued.

headline: Ice scoop on dusty ice maker; poor cooler lighting
summary: An ice scoop was stored on a dusty ice maker and must be kept on a clean surface. The walk-in cooler and freezer had inadequate lighting, and the inspector ordered better lighting.

headline: Packaged foods lack required labels
summary: Packaged items, including baklava, maamoul, chocolate bars, spices, honey, and olive oil, were not properly labeled. The person in charge must label each with identity, net weight, ingredients, and business name and address.

headline: Repeat cleaning violations from 2023 uncorrected
summary: Previous cleaning violations were not corrected. Inspector ordered detail cleaning of coolers, ice machine, sinks, ovens, cabinets, and floors, including walk-in cooler floors and the dining area. Priority citation issued.

headline: Deteriorating brick wall; burned-out freezer lights
summary: The brick wall in the east rear storage area is deteriorating and must be repaired. Burned-out light bulbs were found in the deli and grocery walk-in freezers and need replacing.

headline: No certified food manager on site while cooking
summary: No certified food manager was on site while sausage, potatoes, sauces, and cheese were prepared. Food handler certificates were missing, allergen certificates were expired, and the pizza oven hood needs grease removed. Prep lighting was also inadequate.

headline: Items on floor; soiled microwave
summary: Equipment, tool boxes, and other items were stored on the floor in the rear dry storage area and must be raised at least 6 inches. The microwave on the cook line was heavily soiled inside and must be detail cleaned.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; greasy hood filters
summary: Black slime built up inside the ice machine used to make ice for customers. Staff must remove the ice and clean and sanitize the machine. Grease and debris were also found on hood filters above the cook line.

headline: Items on floor; hole in wall; missing certificate
summary: Single-service boxes were stored on the basement dry storage floor and must be raised 6 inches. A hole in the wall below shelves needs repair, and an employee bathroom fan is not working. One food employee lacked a food handler certificate.

headline: Hood, filters, and stove need cleaning
summary: The exhaust hood, hood filters, and stove were not clean and must be cleaned. No other issues were listed in the notes.

headline: Minor build-up under grills
summary: Minor build-up was found under the grills on the main prep line. Staff must clean it and keep the area maintained. No other issues or pests were recorded.

headline: Damaged floors, leaking sink, burned-out hood lights
summary: Cutting boards in the rear prep area have open seams and stains. Floor grout and tiles are missing or damaged in the rear prep and dish areas, and the 3-compartment sink leaks. A ceiling tile is missing, and hood lights are burned out or unshielded.

headline: Dead roaches in freezers; food stored on floor
summary: Dead roaches were found inside a main-prep freezer and in a basement freezer gasket. Noodles sat on the floor, and open bowls of food were stored in a parked van. Staff must stop this, and wall and floor openings need sealing.

headline: 60-70 mouse droppings found in kitchen
summary: About 60 to 70 mouse droppings were found on the kitchen floor under the three-compartment sinks and near floor mixers. Staff must clean the area, and pest control is recommended before reinspection. A priority citation was issued.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: The sanitation manager had no allergen training and must provide it. No other issues were listed.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site
summary: No kit or written procedure for vomit or diarrhea cleanup was on site. Staff must keep a kit with supplies, including a norovirus-effective sanitizer, at all times. Priority citation issued. Debris was also found on floors throughout.

headline: Fly trap over clean utensils; no test strips
summary: A fly ribbon trap hung above clean utensils in the dish room and must be removed. Several containers lacked labels, deli cups were used as scoops, and sanitizer test strips were missing. The manager bought strips before the inspection ended.

headline: Butcher handsinks lack towel waste bins
summary: Two exposed handsinks in the butcher prep area had disposable towels but no waste receptacle. The person in charge was told any handsink with disposable towels needs one and was instructed to provide it.

headline: Failed: no health policy or training proof
summary: No verified employee health policy, and no food handler or allergen training proof was on site. The walk-in cooler lacks a working thermometer. Repeat violations: food near unshielded waste lines, uncovered toilet-room trash.

headline: Rodent droppings and flies; no soap or health policy
summary: About 75 rodent droppings were found in the dish area, drink station, and fryer, plus about 135 live flies. Pest control was recommended and a citation issued. Handwashing sinks lacked soap, and no employee health policy was on site.

headline: Can opener build-up to clean
summary: A can opener had build-up and must be cleaned and maintained. No other issues or pests were recorded.

headline: Rodent droppings; no vomit cleanup supplies
summary: About 20 to 30 droppings were found under shelves and along walls in the back room; pest control was ordered. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup supplies were on site. Garbage was on the ground outside, and coolers need detail cleaning.

headline: Handsink used for drinking water; cold food discarded
summary: A buffet handwashing sink was used to fill drinking-water pitchers, which is not allowed; a citation was issued. Tuna salad, sliced ham, and chicken salad at 45.7-46.5°F were discarded. A bulk coconut was unlabeled and was corrected on site.

headline: Unlabeled containers and improper food bags
summary: Unlabeled food containers were found in prep. A food handler lacked a hair restraint, cheese was stored in plastic grocery bags, and wiping cloths were stored improperly. Mop storage and water-stained ceiling tiles also need correction.

headline: Broken probe thermometer; battery replaced on site
summary: The probe stem thermometer did not turn on, and staff must always provide a working one. The person in charge replaced the battery before the walk-through ended. No citation was issued.

headline: Dirty ice machine; missing food handler certificates
summary: The ice machine interior has build-up that needs cleaning. Cutting boards are worn, cooking equipment and prep tables need detail cleaning, and floors need cleaning. Food handlers lack certificates, and managers need allergen certificates.

headline: Food on floor; cooling and sewage pipe issues
summary: Spring rolls were cooled at room temperature, then moved to a freezer on site; none were found out of temperature. Cooked noodles sat uncovered on the floor, and exposed sewage pipes sit above food storage. A citation was issued for the missing posted report.

headline: Leaking pipes and faucet; food debris throughout
summary: Basement wastewater pipes and a 3-compartment sink faucet are leaking; repairs were ordered. Food debris and spills were found throughout, and a hole behind the 3-compartment sink must be sealed. Bar reach-in coolers need cleaning.

headline: No certified food manager; pests and warm thawing
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while chicken, rice, beans, fish, and shrimp were prepared and served. About 20 small flies were seen near the hot water heater. Frozen chicken was thawed in 80-degree water, and no current pest control log was on site.

headline: Restroom sink lacks running water; dirty vents
summary: A washbasin in the women's toilet room had no running water and must be repaired. Vents in the men's and women's toilet room have thick dirt and dust and need cleaning.

headline: Items on floor; heavily soiled sink and freezer
summary: Equipment and boxes in basement storage sit on the floor and must be raised 6 inches. The mop sink and a basement cooler's bottom shelf are heavily soiled. The women's bathroom door does not self-close, and the floor under the 3-compartment sink needs detail cleaning.

headline: Hair restraint lapses; grease and leaks
summary: Food handlers were not wearing effective hair restraints, which must be worn at all times. Also found: grease on equipment, food debris in coolers, a leaking drainline, unlabeled bulk containers, a sink without stoppers, and a broken washroom fan.

headline: Dirty coolers, floors, and crated beverages
summary: A beverage cooler and a fresh-meat display cooler need interior and exterior cleaning. Beverages in the rear prep area must come off crates and be raised at least 6 inches. Grocery floors need trash and debris removed.

headline: Dirty floors, drains, and freezer; no pests seen
summary: Inspector found grime in a floor drain, food debris in a freezer, and dirt and spillage in dry storage. Staff were told to clean these areas to prevent possible pests. No pests were recorded.

headline: Dirty coolers, litter outside, missing light shield
summary: Reach-in cooler gaskets and surfaces hold food and dirt, and the dumpster area has litter. Floors in front of walk-in units need regrouting. Walls, vents, and a grease-container light need cleaning, and a light shield is missing.

headline: Torn gaskets on prep-area coolers
summary: Gasket seals on the low reach-in coolers in the food prep area are worn and torn on all doors. Staff were instructed to repair and maintain them. No pests were recorded.

headline: No certified food manager; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while rice and chicken soups were prepared and served. The low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer and must not be used until it reaches 50 ppm. Food was also stored on freezer floors. Citations issued.

headline: Health policy on site; hair restraint issues
summary: An employee health policy was on site, but it must be kept available at all times; a citation was issued. A food handler lacked a hair restraint, and another had a beard without a guard. Black residue on the wall by the 3-compartment sink needs cleaning.

headline: Missing norovirus cleanup supplies; entrance opening
summary: No norovirus-effective disinfectant was on site for vomit or diarrhea cleanup, a priority violation. An opening at the front double doors must be sealed to keep pests out. A handwashing sink cold knob leaks, and several repairs were ordered.

headline: Still no signed employee health policies
summary: Signed employee health policies are still missing; a citation was issued. Also noted: a gap under an upper exit door that could let insects in, unlabeled food containers, crates used for storage, and no allergen training for the food manager.

headline: Labeling and freezer cleaning needed; clutter
summary: Repackaged dry food must be labeled with name, weight, and store information. Reach-in freezer interior needs cleaning of spills and debris. Clutter in rear storage must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: No certified food manager during food service
summary: No certified food manager was on site while milk and cut watermelon were prepared and served; citation issued. Food was stored on floors, containers were unlabeled, and loose ceiling tiles could let pests in.

headline: Refrigeration units lack internal thermometers
summary: Multiple refrigeration units had no internal thermometers. The facility must install conspicuous thermometers in all refrigeration units and maintain them.

headline: Missing cooler thermometers; unlabeled flour
summary: Two prep coolers lack refrigerator thermometers, and a bulk container of flour is not labeled. Staff were told to provide the thermometers and label the flour.

headline: Rear door gap; turkey stored on cooler floor
summary: A gap of about 1 inch under the rear exterior door could let rodents and insects in and must be eliminated. Turkey was stored directly on the walk-in cooler floor and must be kept at least 6 inches up. Deeply scored cutting boards need replacement.

headline: Rusted ice machines; openings at entrance doors
summary: Both large basement ice machines have rust on their shields and need interior cleaning and sanitizing to prevent ice contamination. Openings at the base of both front doors must be sealed. The dish machine lacks a data plate, and several espresso and coffee machines lack backflow devices.

headline: No certified food manager; missing discard dates
summary: No certified food manager was on site while deli meat and chicken were handled and served. Prep cooler containers lacked discard dates, the basement refrigerator had no thermometer, and the meat slicer needs cleaning. The basement ice maker lacks a backflow device.

headline: No food handler training proof; storage fixes
summary: No proof of food handler training was shown for any food handler. Other findings: exposed utensils on a hot holding unit, bowls stored upright, a dirty microwave, food in a plastic grocery bag, a soiled mop, and burned-out cooking-area lights.

headline: Greasy fryers; soda spills and dirty floors
summary: Grease and food debris had built up inside the tops of the fryers. Soda spills were at the base of the customer-area soda machine, and floors throughout had minor food, grease, and dirt. Staff were instructed to clean all of these.

headline: Items under wastewater pipes; dirty cooler gaskets
summary: Food equipment and shelving were stored in the basement below wastewater pipes that can drip onto them; items must be moved or shielded. Cooler gaskets and interiors were heavily soiled. Managers lacked allergen training certificates.

headline: About 35 rodent droppings throughout grocery store
summary: About 35 large rodent droppings were found on floors and shelves, including near candy, sauces, and pallets. Staff must contact pest control and eliminate activity. Priority citation issued. A ceiling hole is also dripping water onto a box.

headline: Wiping cloths and cups not handled properly
summary: Wiping cloths used on prep counters were not held in sanitizer and must be laundered daily. Clean cups on bar mats were cloth-dried instead of air-dried, which is not approved. Cluttered items in a second-floor storage room must be cleared.

headline: Sushi held above 41°F; about 6 lb discarded
summary: Eight sushi-bar TCS foods, including tuna and shrimp, measured 45.5-52.5°F in the cold-holding unit, above the 41°F limit. About 6 lb ($250) was discarded. Cutting boards are deeply cut, and a ceiling leak needs repair.

headline: Allergen certificates needed for sanitation holders
summary: Allergen training certificates are needed for all City sanitation certificate holders. The facility was instructed to obtain and maintain them. No other issues were listed.

headline: Missing health policy; undated cooked chicken discarded
summary: No written employee health policy was on the premises; a citation was issued. Cooked chicken held over 24 hours was not date-marked, and about 8 lb ($30) was voluntarily discarded. No food handler certificates were shown, and floors and hood need cleaning.

headline: Frozen food thawed in standing water
summary: TCS foods were thawing while sitting in water in a 1-compartment sink. Staff must thaw them under cold running water, in a cooler, or in a microwave. Deep fryers have grease and dirt build-up, and water-stained ceiling tiles need replacing.

headline: Meat slicer residue; leaking faucet
summary: Food residue was found inside the lower parts of the meat slicer and must be cleaned and sanitized. A one-compartment sink faucet leaks, and its right side moves when turned on. A floor drain between the ice machines also needs cleaning.

headline: Food debris on equipment; leaks and damage
summary: Food spills and debris were found on cooking equipment, coolers, freezers, and sinks. A 3-compartment sink leaks and lacks stoppers, cooler gaskets are damaged, and ceiling tiles and floor grout are missing. Unused items should be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Chicken and pork above 41°F; 30 lb discarded
summary: Chicken at 51.2°F and pork at 50.2°F were in the three-door cooler, above the 41°F limit. The manager immediately and voluntarily discarded 30 lb (about $145) of food. A priority citation was issued.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; greasy carts
summary: The rear exit door is not rodent-proof, so staff were told to fix it. Rolling carts in the prep area are caked with grease, and dried food debris lies under the pizza oven. No pests were recorded.

headline: Cracked floor tile; no allergen training certificate
summary: A cracked floor tile in front of the 3-compartment sink must be repaired. No allergen training certificate was on site, and one must be provided for all certified food managers.

headline: Over 50 mouse droppings; no health policy or soap
summary: Over 50 mouse droppings were found in fryer cabinets, on floors, and on shelves; an exterminator must be called. No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure was found, and bar handsinks lacked soap and paper towels.

headline: Items stored under unshielded sewer lines
summary: Equipment and utensils were stored under unshielded wastewater and sewer lines in the basement crawl space and must be shielded or moved. Knives and tongs were stored near water pipes in the walk-in cooler. A torn cooler gasket and a drain leak also need correction.

headline: Grocery bags in freezer; no allergen certificate
summary: Grocery bags were used to store food in the prep freezer, and staff were told to use food-grade bags. The food service manager lacks a current allergen training certificate and was told to obtain one.

headline: Hair restraints missing; sink stoppers broken
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Stoppers on the 3-compartment sink are broken and cannot close, so basins do not fill properly. Unfinished drywall behind the sandwich prep cooler must be finished to be smooth and cleanable.

headline: Cold-holding units failed; 320 lb food discarded
summary: Cooked chicken, raw wings, salsa, and deli cheese were found at 50-57°F, above the 41°F limit. About 320 lb ($800) was discarded on site. Two cold-holding units were tagged and cannot hold TCS foods until repaired and reinspected.

headline: 3-compartment sink not draining; citation issued
summary: The 3-compartment sink does not drain properly, and water in one basin floods another. The manager must service it, and a priority citation was issued. Handwashing signs were also missing from toilet rooms.

headline: Ice machine, oven tops, and floor drain need cleaning
summary: The ice machine interior and tops of the convection ovens need cleaning in the food prep area. Prep area walls and floor need cleaning, including the floor drain in front of the cooking equipment. No pests were recorded.

headline: Dish machine too cool; machine held from use
summary: The high-temperature dish machine rinsed at 109-119°F instead of the required 180°F. It is tagged and must not be used until reinspected by the Chicago Department of Public Health. Prior violations were not corrected; the certified food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Rodent droppings in bakery; handsink lacked supplies
summary: About 20 to 30 rodent droppings were found beneath bakery carts behind the walk-in cooler. Staff must remove them and call pest control. Soap and paper towels were missing at a bakery handsink but were supplied on site. Priority citation issued.

headline: Ice machine build-up; loose sink and greasy hood
summary: Slight build-up was found inside the ice machine, and the ice scoop is stored on top of it. The 3-compartment sink is loose from the wall, and its floor drain has food and dirt build-up. The hood and filters need cleaning.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training; must comply
summary: The City of Chicago food service sanitation manager did not have allergen training. The inspector instructed the facility to meet this requirement. No other issues or pests were listed.

headline: Unsafe food temperatures; food discarded on site
summary: Fried chicken was held at 114°F, below the 135°F minimum. Raw beef at 45.6°F and pizza sauce at 55.4°F were above the 41°F limit. All were discarded. Expired cooked meats were also discarded on site. Citations issued.

headline: Not enough indoor trash containers
summary: Only one indoor waste receptacle serves the food preparation and warewashing areas. The facility must add a receptacle or use a larger one that can hold all refuse from these areas.

headline: Clutter and dirty floor near basement ice machines
summary: Clutter under the basement stairs near the ice machine could give pests a hiding place, so the inspector ordered it cleared. The floor around the large ice machines needs detail cleaning. No pests were recorded.

headline: Conditions: unlabeled bulk containers, rear door gap
summary: Bulk ingredient containers in front prep were unlabeled. Rear exit door had a 1/4 inch gap underneath and must be made rodent and insect proof. An employee in food prep lacked a hair restraint. Earlier allergen violation uncorrected.

headline: Passed; grease and dust on equipment, hood
summary: Passed. Dust, dirt and grease built up on sides of cooking and non-cooking equipment and on the floor under and around it. Hood ventilation and filters had dust and grease. Cleaning was required to prevent possible pests.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager; cold food too warm
summary: No certified food manager on duty while rice and chicken soup were prepared and served. Chicken, eggs and shrimp in service coolers were above 41F; about 20 lbs discarded. Hand sink was blocked by a pot and had no soap. Grease buildup and clutter also noted.

headline: Passed re-inspection; food stored under sewer lines
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food service equipment, utensils and food storage bins were stored beneath unprotected wastewater and sewer lines in the northwest corner of the basement. Shielding must be added or items moved.

headline: Passed; food handler lacked hair restraint
summary: Passed. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint and must wear one.

headline: Failed: over 100 mouse droppings, flying insects
summary: Failed. Over 100 mouse droppings found on floors, shelving, coolers, outlets and equipment in prep and storage areas. Numerous flying insects in prep area. Manager told to call an exterminator and clean all areas. Earlier violations also uncorrected.

headline: Failed: 25 live roaches, unsafe cold food
summary: Failed. 25 live roaches and over 20 small flies found throughout. Cold food held at 49-52F; $500 of food discarded. Walk-in cooler air at 52F; three coolers tagged. No certified manager on site while food was prepared and served.

headline: Hot chicken too cool; sink lacked hot water
summary: Pass with conditions. Bar hand sink had only 40.0F water; repaired on site. Chicken and other hot foods held at 104.5-125.6F, below 135F; about 50 lbs discarded on site. Some plumbing fixtures in poor repair.

headline: Failed: 20+ live roaches, handwashing lapse
summary: Failed. 20+ live roaches on walk-in freezer gaskets, prep tables and serving line; dead ones inside walk-in. Food handler handled bread without washing hands after phone use (corrected on site). Sliced tomato at 45.1F discarded. Employee health policies missing.

headline: Failed: two live roaches; sink flooding
summary: Failed. Two live roaches were found in the kitchen near the 3-compartment sink; manager told to service affected areas. Wastewater did not drain properly, so one compartment flooded into another. A technician came on site to service the sink.

headline: Conditions: dish machine not sanitizing; tagged out
summary: Pass with conditions. The low-temperature dishwashing machine did not sanitize; chlorine test strips did not change color. The machine is tagged and must not be used until serviced. Dishes must be washed in the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Passed re-inspection; greasy floors, water damage
summary: Passed re-inspection. Cabinet interiors under salad bar ice bins had water damage. Floors beneath ovens, fryers and wok line, and beneath coolers in the coffee bar, were heavily soiled. Food manager's allergen awareness certificate was expired.

headline: Passed; no thermometer in employee fridge
summary: Passed. The employee refrigerator had no thermometer inside. A working thermometer must be provided.

headline: Passed; prep cooler handles missing
summary: Passed. The two-door prep cooler was missing handles at the top of the unit; they must be replaced.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; no sanitizer test strips
summary: Failed. Person in charge had no City of Chicago sanitation certificate; citation issued. No quaternary sanitizer test strips on site. Basement freezer had duct tape repair, a hole in its back wall and excess ice.

headline: Passed re-inspection; thermometers, ice, clutter
summary: Passed re-inspection. Working thermometers needed in two coolers. Items must be raised off the floor in prep, storage and basement areas. Rust on walk-in racks, paper shelf liners and excess freezer ice must be fixed. Basement clutter must be removed to prevent rodent harborage.

headline: Passed re-inspection; items stored on floor
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food, bottles and cans were stored on the floor and must be raised at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Passed re-inspection; missing utility sink, grease trap
summary: Passed re-inspection. No service or utility sink for dirty mop water. Two 3-compartment sinks, in the bar and dish/prep areas, lacked an approved grease trap. Employee toilet room door was not self-closing.

headline: Failed: sink backs up; food handler proof missing
summary: Failed. Rear 3-compartment sink drained slowly, and dirty water backed up between compartments; repair required. No proof of food handler training. Employees prepared food without hair restraints. Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables.

headline: Passed; missing hood filters and debris throughout
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs missing at prep, dish and washroom sinks. Single-service items were not inverted. Debris on equipment, coolers and floors; ventilation hood filters were missing and light shields damaged.

headline: Failed: uncertified food handler, dusty hood filters
summary: Failed. A food handler had no food handler certificate. Hood filters above griddle and fryer had dust build-up. Middle sink stopper of the 3-compartment sink was not working, and earlier core violations were not corrected.

headline: Re-inspection passed; leaks, rust and repairs ordered
summary: Passed re-inspection with repairs ordered: leaking 3-compartment sink faucet, damaged cooler gaskets, rusty freezer shelving, and unlabeled containers. Food debris under cooking and refrigeration equipment, broken floor tiles, peeling ceiling paint and dusty vents also noted.

headline: Failed: hand sink water too cool; open ceiling
summary: Failed. Prep/dish hand sink reached only 97.8F; 100F minimum required. No splash guard between prep sink and 3-compartment sink. Dish machine lacked a temperature indicator. Open ceiling above food prep and cracked brick walls by washrooms also noted.

headline: Failed: moldy ice machine, no sanitizer test kit
summary: Failed. Black mold-like substance inside ice machine dripped onto ice; all ice to be removed and machine cleaned. No chemical test kit on site for sanitizer. Freezers had ice build-up; peeling paint and torn baseboard near 3-compartment sink noted.

headline: Failed: no vomit cleanup supplies; openings to seal
summary: Failed. Vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies were missing. Openings at doors and basement stairs must be sealed against pests. Customers could reach plated food on a prep table; barriers ordered. Other repairs noted: sinks, rust, lighting, bathroom door.

headline: Passed re-inspection; basement door gap, repairs
summary: Passed re-inspection. Basement door had a gap that must be tight fitting to block insects. Unisex toilet room needs a lidded garbage can and mechanical ventilation. Floor and ceiling tiles need repair, and a burnt-out light needs replacing.

headline: Conditions: lettuce at 51.5F; salad cooler tagged
summary: Pass with conditions. 25 lbs chopped lettuce in the salad cooler measured 51.5F and was discarded; cooler tagged. Bulk flour and sugar containers were unlabeled. Basement ice machine walls, ceiling and floor need sealing and cleaning.

headline: Passed; unlabeled cheesecake, untrained food handler
summary: Passed. Prepackaged cheesecake in retail cooler had no label; prepackaged foods need manufacturer name and address, ingredients and net contents. A food handler lacked a training certificate. Broken drywall and floor tiles and greasy prep walls need repair and cleaning.

headline: Passed; repairs and storage fixes needed
summary: Passed. Cold-holding unit lid in service prep area was in poor repair with missing knobs. Serving plates on shelves were not inverted. The 3-compartment sink sprayer hangs below the sink rim. A ceiling tile behind the stove is missing.

headline: Failed: unsanitized pan, cold food too warm
summary: Failed. Pan was washed and rinsed but used without sanitizing; manager set up sanitizer. Cold foods held at 44-48F; some discarded. 2-inch rear door gap must be sealed. Outside oil container had heavy grease.

headline: Failed: no certified manager and no pest log
summary: Failed. No valid certified food manager on duty. Pest control logbook missing; licensed service needed at least twice yearly. Also missing: signed employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit, and manager allergen training.

headline: Conditions: ground beef left at unsafe temperature
summary: Pass with conditions. 108 portions of ground beef at 55.2F were left on a counter; about 10 lbs ($60) voluntarily discarded. Cold food must be held at 41F or colder. Canned goods on floor and unlidded salt bins also noted.

headline: Failed: bars lack handsinks; cold food too warm
summary: Failed. Two patio bars and the rooftop bar lacked approved handwashing sinks; a foot-pump sink is not approved. Cold foods held at 48-50F; 25 lbs ($2,050) discarded. Ice machines had black slime dripping onto stored ice.

headline: Failed: leaking hand sink, improper meat thawing
summary: Failed. Dishwashing hand sink leaked when used and was inaccessible; repair required. Frozen meat thawed in a plastic container in prep; approved thawing methods required. Cutting boards had open seams and stains. No allergen training on site.

headline: Conditions: washroom sinks too cool; fixed on site
summary: Pass with conditions. Men's and women's washroom handwashing sinks measured 66.7-79.3F; 100F minimum required. Sinks were repaired on site and reached 102.7F and 101.8F. Crates were used to elevate sauce and soda and must be replaced with shelving.

headline: Conditions: unlabeled food, rear doors not rodent-proof
summary: Pass with conditions. Rear exit doors had about 1/4 inch gaps and must be sealed against pests. Cardboard shelf liners in rear dry storage must be removed. Food in refrigerators was unlabeled, and a rear reach-in cooler had heavy debris.

headline: Passed; door gap, staff items in food storage
summary: Passed. Side door had an opening of about 1/2 inch at the bottom and must be made tight fitting to prevent pests. Utility room floor and walls had dirt and food debris. Employee personal items were stored in rear food storage and must be moved.

headline: Dish machine had no sanitizer; repaired on site
summary: Pass with conditions. Bar dish machine had 0.00 ppm chlorine sanitizer and was taken out of use; a technician repaired it on site to 100 ppm. Bar hand sinks lacked signs. Greasy fryer surfaces and soiled floors also noted.

headline: Re-inspection passed; unlocked freezer, greasy fryers
summary: Passed re-inspection. Refrigerator and deep freezer in front lobby were not locked and must be locked to protect food and ice. Deep fryers were encrusted with grease and floors under them had severe build-up. Openings near the rear exit and employee toilet must be sealed.

headline: Failed: high-temperature dish machine not hot enough
summary: Failed. Basement high-temperature dish machine's final rinse measured 143.9F; it should be 180F. Machine was tagged held for inspection. Torn cooler gasket, bulk containers without labels, and an employee without hair restraint noted. Earlier rust and allergen violations not corrected.

headline: Passed; missing signage, thermometer, allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Toilet rooms lacked handwashing signage, and the hot holding unit lacked an ambient air thermometer. A sheet tray was stored under the paper towel dispenser near chicken prep. Floors under shelves and in chicken prep needed cleaning; manager had no allergen certificate on site.

headline: Passed re-inspection; ice machine and allergen certificates
summary: Passed re-inspection. Pink mineral build-up inside the ice machine must be cleaned. Men's and women's toilet room doors must be self-closing. Certified food managers lacked allergen training certificates.

headline: Passed; cooler thermometer missing, peeling paint
summary: Passed. The basement stand-up cooler had no thermometer and one must be provided in clear view. Walls in basement dry food storage were in poor repair with peeling paint.

headline: Conditions: bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food
summary: Pass with conditions. A food handler used bare hands on ready-to-eat deli meat, bread and cheese to assemble breakfast sandwiches; manager told not to allow this. The high-temperature dish machine's final rinse reached only 152F; machine tagged out.

headline: Re-inspection passed; spiders, cobwebs, food debris
summary: Passed re-inspection. Excessive spiders and cobwebs hung from ceilings in front prep, rear prep and storage areas. Dried food debris on cabinets, cooling units, freezers and prep tables needed removal to prevent pest harborage. Some food handlers lacked training certificates.

headline: Passed; rear door gap and ceiling leak
summary: Passed. Rear outer door had a 1/2 inch gap underneath and was not rodent or insect proof; must be fixed. A ceiling leak above the rear door also needs repair.

headline: Failed: dish machine lacks temperature indicator
summary: Failed. Dish machine lacked an irreversible temperature indicator or heat test strips. Black-like substance on basement ice machine panel needed cleaning. Hand sink behind the bar lacked signage. Certified food manager's allergen certificate was expired.

headline: Passed re-inspection; workers lack training proof
summary: Passed re-inspection. Several food handling employees did not have a valid food handler certificate. All must show valid proof of training.

headline: Passed re-inspection; food handler training needed
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food handler training must be provided for all employees and maintained.

headline: Passed; expired allergen training certificate
summary: Passed. An expired allergen training certificate was on site, and allergen training must be provided for all certified food managers. Unused equipment should be removed from the kitchen.

headline: Failed: 60+ mouse droppings throughout premises
summary: Failed. About 60 or more mouse droppings found throughout, including kitchen, pizza prep, service counter and furnace room. Areas must be cleaned and sanitized; licensed pest control service required. Front door gap also noted.

headline: Failed: 130 mouse droppings; inadequate hot water
summary: Failed. About 130 mouse droppings found in several areas. Hot water measured 66.4-94.5F, below required 100F for hand sinks and 110F for 3-compartment sinks. Produce prep handsink was inaccessible. Wastewater backed up from floor drains.

headline: Failed: over 50 mouse droppings in rear prep
summary: Failed. Over 50 mouse droppings found along walls and under and behind coolers and cooking equipment in the rear prep and storage area. Employees lacked food handler certificates; manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Failed: sink water too cool; closed until reinspection
summary: Failed. Hot water at the Starbucks prep 3-compartment sink measured 94.3F; corrected on site, and the store was closed until a CDPH reinspection. Food debris and dust found under refrigerators and in prep areas. Last inspection summary was not posted for public view.

headline: Passed re-inspection; missing cooler thermometer
summary: Passed re-inspection. Cold holding units lacked an ambient air thermometer. The rear ledge on top of the prep cooler had a build-up of food debris and needed cleaning.

headline: Failed: raw meat in grocery bags, overflowing garbage
summary: Failed. Raw meat stored in grocery bags inside a cooling unit. Clothing hung next to prep table and sink. Outside garbage receptacle had wide-open lids and overflowing bags; priority citation. Earlier violations, including grease and soiled wiping cloths, were not corrected.

headline: Conditions: no vomit cleanup kit or utility sink
summary: Pass with conditions. No written procedure or vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site. Front entrance door left open without screening, which could let pests in. No utility sink with hot and cold water. Coving unfinished in customer service area.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk containers, drain leak
summary: Passed. Bulk containers in the gordita prep area were unlabeled. Large pots did not fit the 3-compartment sink and need a proper washing procedure or smaller pots. A drain pipe under that sink was leaking and must be repaired. Grease was found on fryers, grill and floors.

headline: Passed; leaking sink faucet, dirty floors and cabinets
summary: Passed. Leak at rear 3-compartment sink faucet head must be repaired. Spills and debris inside front cabinets and under and behind equipment needed cleaning to prevent possible pests.

headline: Conditions: no certified food manager on duty
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager was on site during inspection; the person on duty lacked the certificate, and a citation was issued. Walk-in cooler and kitchen floors need detailed cleaning. Food service manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Failed: no valid city sanitation certificate posted
summary: Failed. No valid city sanitation certificate posted. Rear door gap on sides and bottom must be repaired to prevent pests. Ventilation above cooking equipment had no filters and was greasy. Earlier violations also uncorrected.

headline: Passed; leaking sink valves and dirty floors
summary: Passed. Leak at valves under the sanitizing compartment of the 3-compartment sink must be repaired. Storage racks in rear walk-in cooler had stains and food debris. Floors in corners, under racks and equipment, and inside walk-in coolers and freezers had dirt and debris.

headline: Passed; worn gaskets, expired allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Gaskets on the two-door pizza dough refrigerator needed repair so it cools properly. An employee's allergen training certificate was expired and must be provided on site.

headline: Passed; wall hole and clutter, one fixed on site
summary: Passed. Small hole at base of south wall by potato chip shelves must be sealed. Rear storage behind walk-in cooler was cluttered; shelves stored in the washroom utility sink were removed, corrected on site. Non-manager food handlers need food handler training.

headline: Passed re-inspection; dead insects, unlabeled foods
summary: Passed re-inspection. Dead insects were on floors of the unused rear prep area, and an insect-killing light above meat cutting equipment must be removed. Pre-packaged prepared foods need full labels. Debris on meat slicer and display case; unused equipment must be removed.

headline: Passed; faucet leak and bed in rear room
summary: Passed. Foil was on the food prep table and must be removed. Raw wood under the 3-compartment sink needs sealing. Faucet base leak at that sink must be fixed. A bed in the rear room must be removed. A valid allergen training certificate is required.

headline: Passed; leaking hand sink supply, washroom supplies
summary: Passed. Paper towels and mop heads were stored on a shelf in the washroom, which is not allowed; they must be moved. Cold water supply at the front prep hand sink was leaking but working; repair required.

headline: Passed; grease, debris and drains need cleaning
summary: Passed. Kitchen floor drains had stains and debris that could attract insects. Heavy grease and food debris were along cooking equipment and under the deep fryers, and floors were soiled. Upstairs coffee area had debris and coffee beans.

headline: Passed; heavy grease and debris need cleaning
summary: Passed. Heavy grease and food debris on floors in the rear prep and cook line, especially along walls. Freezer gasket seals had food debris; walk-in floor needed detailed cleaning. Dust and grease under the grill top also needed cleaning.

headline: Failed: no valid certified manager; old violations
summary: Failed. No certified food manager with valid original certificate on site while pork, tomatoes and beef were prepared. Beef thawed improperly on prep table. Many earlier violations were not corrected, including grease build-up and missing allergen training.

headline: Passed; three dead roaches in sticky trap
summary: Passed. Three dead roaches were found in a sticky trap by tall speed racks and proofers; they were to be removed. Food debris and dirt between cooking equipment and dust and crumbs in prep areas needed cleaning.

headline: Passed re-inspection; food on floor, no thermometers
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food stored on floor; milk crates used as shelving. Coolers lacked thermometers and sugar containers were unlabeled. Two fusion sinks at the bar must be replaced. Water-stained ceiling tiles and dirty floors behind the bar also noted.

headline: Passed; food handler certificates not verified
summary: Passed. Food handler certificates could not be verified for all employees; they must be kept on site. A dish rack on the floor under the dish machine must be raised 6 inches. Dark residue inside the ice machine panel needed cleaning.

headline: Failed: no certified food manager during food handling
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on site when raw tuna, salmon, chicken and shrimp were handled; one arrived midway, corrected on site. Sanitizer measured 500 ppm; sink emptied. Missing food handler training proof. Prior violations uncorrected.

headline: Passed; food on freezer floor, leaking ceiling
summary: Passed. Food containers were stored on the walk-in freezer floor and must be raised 6 inches. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Water dripped from a leaking ceiling in the rear into a bucket during heavy rain; floor tiles were broken or missing throughout.

headline: Passed re-inspection; personal items near food
summary: Passed re-inspection. Employee beverage cup sat uncovered on prep table next to food; personal care item was stored above food. Dry food containers lacked adequate labels. Aluminum foil lined equipment and wall at the cook line and must be removed.

headline: Failed: rat droppings and flies; no vomit kit
summary: Failed. About 20 rat droppings in front bar and rear storage, plus about 60 small flies in toilet rooms, bar and near walk-in cooler. No pest logbook. No vomit and diarrhea response procedure or kit. Wastewater backup corrected during inspection.

headline: Passed; no hair restraints, items stored on floors
summary: Passed. Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints. Single-service items were not inverted and were stored on floors in dining, prep and storage areas. Food was kept in plastic grocery bags in the freezer. Certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings, dead roaches, no certified manager
summary: Failed. 60+ mouse droppings found under sinks, shelving and food carts. Dead roaches by cooking equipment and in a restroom. Dishwasher had 0 ppm sanitizer and was not to be used. No certified food manager on site at arrival.

headline: Passed; some food handlers lack training
