summary: Passed. Some employees were missing food handler training. The manager must provide proof and maintain it.

headline: Passed; food on floors, grease buildup
summary: Passed. Food containers stored on floors in walk-in cooler, prep and storage areas must be raised 6 inches. Single-service items were on basement floors. Cardboard liners and greasy cooking equipment, walls and shelving needed correction.

headline: Passed; mold-like buildup and grease need cleaning
summary: Passed. Mold-like buildup on walk-in cooler racks and wall must be cleaned. Handwashing signs were missing at two hand sinks. Cardboard liners were on kitchen shelves. Grease and debris were found on floors, storage racks and inside a freezer.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings, unsafe cold food, no soap
summary: Failed. 40-45 rodent droppings in rear furnace closet; no pest control proof. Shrimp, chicken and salmon held at 46-48F; about 80 lbs discarded. No soap or paper towels at hand sinks; manager filled dispensers on site. Food handler and allergen certificates missing.

headline: Non-service animal entered; old violations fixed on site
summary: Pass with conditions. A customer brought a non-service animal past security; it left the premises. No live animals are allowed except service animals. Earlier violations, including labels, crates, rust and debris, were being corrected during inspection.

headline: Passed; clutter on closet floor
summary: Passed. Clutter was stored on the floor of the front closet near the entrance. Unused articles and equipment must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Passed; uncovered restroom bins, greasy hood
summary: Passed. Women's restrooms on each level lacked covered receptacles. Floors under cooking equipment had dirt and debris, and walls near cooking equipment were heavily dusty. Heavy grease built up under the hood and filters. Loose wall tile in women's restroom must be repaired.

headline: Passed; rear door gap and missing allergen proof
summary: Passed. A 1/4 inch gap on the side of the rear exterior door must be repaired to be tight fitting. The certified manager on duty had no proof of allergen training; a certificate is required.

headline: Passed; leaky drain pipe, milk crates as shelves
summary: Passed. Leaky drainpipe under the 4-compartment sink's third compartment must be repaired. Milk crates were used as shelves in the Stan's Donuts rear storage and must be replaced with raised shelving. Dumpster area debris needs cleaning.

headline: Passed; dusty fan over sandwich line, greasy floors
summary: Passed. A dusty fan over the sandwich prep line was a possible contamination source and was to be removed. Walk-in shelving and first deep fryer needed cleaning. A unisex toilet trash receptacle was missing its lid; floor behind the cookline had grease and debris.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing signs and dusty vents
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs were missing at sinks in bars and toilet rooms. An unused basement slicer was covered in debris. Dust had built up on the ceiling and vents above the dishwashing area.

headline: Passed; wiping cloths and cleaning needed
summary: Passed with corrections. Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizing solution when not in use. Cooking equipment had food spills to clean. Floor behind the refrigerator had small debris. Inspector asked for correction and upkeep.

headline: Failed: ice machine slime, no licensed pest control
summary: Failed. Ice machine in rear dish area had black slime dripping onto stored ice; cleaning required. No licensed pest control operator in place. Hand sink lacked paper towels. No metal stem thermometer; menu lacked raw-food advisory.

headline: Passed; rear door gap and no utility sink
summary: Passed. Rear exit door had an about 1/4 inch gap at the bottom that must be repaired to be tight fitting. No utility sink on site for disposing of mop water; one with hot and cold water must be provided.

headline: Passed; handwashing signs missing in washrooms
summary: Passed. Handwashing signage was missing at hand sinks in the men's and women's washrooms; it must be provided.

headline: Conditions: no manager; improper food temperatures
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager on site at arrival; one arrived during walkthrough. Steak at 71.8F was not hot-held; about 13 lbs discarded. Refried beans (51.7F) and shredded cheese (55.8F) were too warm; about 21 lbs discarded.

headline: Failed: dirty ice machine dripping into ice
summary: Failed. Black dirt build-up inside the ice machine dripped into ice used for consumption. All ice was voluntarily discarded, and the machine interior must be cleaned by the reinspection date. Line kitchen cooler door gaskets were ripped and must be replaced.

headline: Passed; food in grocery bags, cardboard liners
summary: Passed. Food was stored in grocery bags in a chest freezer and must be moved to food-grade bags. Cardboard liners in freezers and prep shelves must be removed. A damaged gasket, buildup at the dish area, a stained ceiling tile and a non-working light also need fixing.

headline: Failed: no power; coolers at 60F
summary: Failed. No electricity on the premises. Coolers and freezers were at room temperature, 60.0F. Coolers must be running and at 41F or below, and freezers must be running and frozen.

headline: Re-inspection passed; walk-in cooler needs lighting
summary: Passed re-inspection. Lighting in the walk-in cooler was inadequate; the inspector asked for more lights.

headline: Passed; food workers lacked hair restraints
summary: Passed. Food employees were preparing food without hair restraints. Management was told all employees must wear them while preparing food.

headline: Washroom water too cool; soiled cloths
summary: Washroom hand sink water measured 71.4°F; minimum is 100°F, and a citation was issued. Soiled wiping cloths were on a prep table. Single spoons and straws were not inverted on the display case. A soiled cutting board and dust on prep area ceiling were noted.

headline: Failed: no soap, sanitizer, or cleaning agent
summary: Hand sinks lacked soap, paper towels, and handwashing signs. No cleaning agent or chemical sanitizer was on the premises, and the ice machine had old food and debris. Three cold holding units and a freezer were tagged held for temperatures of 43.9-86.2°F.

headline: Peeling plastic in prep coolers must be removed
summary: Peeling plastic on metal prep coolers must be removed. Cardboard must not be used inside coolers or freezers.

headline: Gap at basement door; ice machine not clean
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the basement door, where food is stored, must be sealed to keep out pests. Top interior of the ice machine was not clean. The delivery lobby restroom lacks a covered receptacle.

headline: Failed: cooler repair, sanitizer, pests logbook
summary: Walk-in cooler was not working; it must be repaired. Hand sinks need soap, towels, and signs. No chemical sanitizer was on site, and no complete pest control logbook. Outside garbage area needs cleaning to prevent rodent harborage. No food handler certificates.

headline: Grease and dust on cooking hoods
summary: Both hoods in the cook area had a buildup of grease and dust. The manager was instructed to detail clean and maintain them in good condition.

headline: Failed: hand sink at 159.6°F; repeat violations
summary: Rear prep hand sink hot water measured 159.6°F, above the 120°F maximum, and a citation was issued. Leaky connection behind cooking equipment, excess grease and debris, missing hood filter, and damaged floors and walls. Several prior violations were not corrected.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; broken floor tiles
summary: Signs were missing near exposed handwashing sinks in the prep and basement dishwashing areas. Several damaged and broken floor tiles in the main kitchen prep area and under a hand sink must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Failed: no manager, certificate, or food training
summary: No person in charge with foodservice manager training was on site, and no valid original sanitation certificate was posted. Three-compartment sink wastewater backed up. Restroom door lacked a self-closing device. Missing food handler and allergen certificates.

headline: Front door gaps need rodent proofing
summary: About 1/4-inch gaps at front entrance door sweeps must be sealed to rodent-proof the doors. One food manager had an expired allergen training certificate.

headline: No allergen training certificate on site
summary: No allergen training certificate was on site for the certified manager. The person in charge must obtain training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Failed: salmon and calamari held too warm
summary: Salmon held at 45°F and calamari at 50°F; about $300 of product was discarded. Expired food handler certificates and a certified manager without allergen training. Drain stoppers were broken, and prior dish pit and prep area cleaning violations were not fixed.

headline: No thermometers in coolers; grocery bags used
summary: No ambient air thermometer was in the three-door reach-in cooler or rear prep cooler; management provided thermometers on site. Single-use grocery bags stored raw pork in the freezer and must not be reused. Torn gaskets in a rear prep cooler need repair.

headline: Gaps at rear exit doors
summary: Openings at the bottom of the rear exit doors could allow pests to enter. They must be sealed.

headline: Hair restraints, boxes on floor, leaking condenser
summary: Cooks lacked effective hair restraints. Boxed to-go containers were stored on the floor. A walk-in cooler condenser was leaking, and ice built up near a freezer condenser. Stained cutting boards, a broken gasket, and plastic grocery bags used for food storage were found.

headline: Grease under grills; PIC lacks allergen training
summary: Shelving under grills and prep tables on the hot line had food debris to clean. A rear front-prep hand sink drains slowly. Floors in dish and walk-in areas need cleaning. The person in charge has no allergen training.

headline: Grease and food buildup under fryers
summary: Food and grease buildup was found on the prep area floor under the fryers. The facility must clean the floor and maintain it.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; expired food handler cards
summary: Some cooler door rubber gaskets were torn and must be repaired or replaced. Dust covered some prep cooler motors, and ice built up on a walk-in cooler motor. Some food handler certificates were expired, and one food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Hair restraint, server training, expired allergen card
summary: A cook prepared food without a hair restraint. The three-door cooler and prep coolers were dirty, with spills and debris. A server lacked required food handler training, and a certified manager's allergen certificate had expired.

headline: Failed: overflowing dumpsters; no sanitizer test
summary: Two shared outside dumpsters were overflowing, with lids open; a citation was issued. No chemical test kit was found for sanitizer at the three-compartment sink. Squeeze bottles were unlabeled. New employee and food manager lacked required training.

headline: Vacuum packaging needs state approval
summary: A vacuum packaging machine is used for foods that must be kept hot or cold, and documentation must be submitted to the Chicago Department of Public Health for approval. Cooler condensers are dusty, wall gaps need sealing, and a fan cover is missing.

headline: Sausage left out too warm; about $60 discarded
summary: Sausage left on a prep table reached 55.6°F; 5 lbs (about $60) was discarded, and a citation was issued. Thawing was improper, bulk containers were unlabeled, food was uncovered, a food handler lacked gloves, and mops were stored improperly.

headline: Greasy microwaves; no ice machine backflow device
summary: Microwaves in the rear prep area were not clean and had grease droplets. Hand sink lacked signage. No backflow device was on the rear ice machine. Indoor garbage enclosure had debris, grease trap was greasy, and a light bulb was blown out.

headline: Hand sink missing near chocolate station; moved
summary: Chocolate prep crockpots were set up in an area with no hand sink; the manager moved them to a fruit prep area with a sink, and a citation was issued. Raw meat prep sink lacked hand cleanser; the manager supplied it during the inspection.

headline: Leaking faucets; dirty rear prep drains
summary: Faucet bases leaked at two three-compartment sinks, one near the smokers and one at the dish station. Drains in the rear food prep areas had dirt and debris buildup. Staff was instructed to repair and clean.

headline: No covered bins in restrooms; dirty basement floors
summary: Employee unisex and women's basement restrooms had no covered receptacles. Loose debris, dirt, and dust covered the basement kitchen floors and corners. The facility must maintain clean floors at all times.

headline: Beverages on floor; broken hand sink knob
summary: Beverages in aisles and the walk-in cooler must be raised at least six inches off the floor or stored on more shelving. A cold water knob on the front hand sink needs repair.

headline: Front handwashing sign missing
summary: Front handwashing sink had no handwashing sign. The manager was instructed to provide signs at all sinks used by employees.

headline: Grease on hood filters
summary: Grease buildup was found on filters in the hood ventilation system above cooking equipment. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Ice machine lacks drainage; drains dirty
summary: The ice machine was in an area without drainage for runoff, and the person in charge was told to move it. Floor drains throughout the facility had debris and grime. Certified managers lacked allergen training certificates on site.

headline: Hand sink too cool; dish machine at 0 ppm
summary: First floor prep hand sink water measured 86°F; minimum is 100°F, and a citation was issued. Bar low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine and was held and tagged on site. Leaking three-compartment sink faucet; restroom lacked covered receptacle.

headline: Three employees lack food handler training
summary: Three employees lacked food handler training and must complete it with records kept on site. A torn proofer gasket needs repair, an unused refrigerator must be repaired or removed, and two hood lights were burned out.

headline: Unlabeled bulk container; no food handler certificates
summary: A bulk food container lacked a label. Fly paper was in the rear prep area and staff restroom; it must be removed and a pest control technician should supply insect control devices. Large pots were not inverted; no food handler certificates on site.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; grease buildup
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving and must be removed. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables. Grease and debris were on cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, and freezers. Mop heads were soiled, and the managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Wet wiping cloths on food surfaces; grime
summary: Wet wiping cloths were on several food-contact surfaces. Cutting boards had open seams and dark stains. Trash was behind dumpsters, and unused equipment was stored outside. Missing allergen proof for certified managers and a hole in the floor near the mop sink.

headline: Heavy dust on walk-in cooler fan guards
summary: Fan guards over condenser fans inside the walk-in coolers were unclean, with heavy dust buildup on the ceilings. The facility must clean and maintain them.

headline: No signage at dish sink; torn cooler gasket
summary: No handwashing signage was at the dish area hand sink. A torn and dirty gasket was on the front two-door cooler. Unisex washroom lacked a covered waste bin.

headline: Slime on ice machine plate; signage missing
summary: Pink and orange slime was found on the ice machine shield plate; the person in charge discarded the ice and cleaned the machine on site, and a citation was issued. Signs were missing at bar and basement sinks. A 3-inch wall opening in the alcohol storage area could let pests in.

headline: Failed: torn gaskets; prior violations uncorrected
summary: Rubber gaskets were in poor repair and must be replaced. Prior core violations from March 2023 were not corrected: spills inside the ice machine, food debris in coolers and drains, and debris on floors in prep, storage, and bar areas. A citation was issued.

headline: Failed re-inspection: many repeat violations
summary: Hand sinks lacked signs, and food was stored uncovered on the walk-in floor. No food handler training; no consumer advisory on menus. Missing or damaged floor and wall tiles, leaking sinks, grease buildup, and unlabeled bulk containers were not corrected from prior inspections.

headline: Failed: mold in ice machine dripping onto ice
summary: Mold-like substance inside the ice machine dripped onto ice used for consumption. Ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned and sanitized; a citation was issued. Drains in prep and bar areas need cleaning.

headline: Cleaning needed: fans, tiles, hood filters
summary: Items needing cleaning or repair include a can opener, dining area ceiling fans, prep area ceiling tiles, light shields, and hood vent filters. Inspector instructed the facility to clean and maintain them.

headline: Blocked hand sinks; no sanitizer in dish machine
summary: Hand sinks were blocked with cardboard, knives, and oil bottles; the person in charge removed them during inspection and a citation was issued. The low-temperature dish machine had no sanitizer and is tagged out. Food handler training proof is missing.

headline: Failed; manager arrived during inspection, corrected
summary: No certified food manager was on site while foods that must be kept hot or cold were cooked; the manager arrived about 3:15 PM and the issue was corrected on site, with a citation. Front hand sink water was 124.5°F, above the 120°F maximum.

headline: Unlabeled sink; food residue in coolers
summary: Three-compartment sink was not labeled for wash, rinse, and sanitize. Food residue was found on sliding doors of two cold holding units. Restroom doors lacked self-closing devices or hinges. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Clutter on floor; no food handler certificates
summary: Excess clutter on the floor in the rear storage closet could harbor pests, so the manager was told to remove unused items. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Gap under front door; floors under coolers
summary: A half-inch gap under the front entrance door could allow rodent entry; a door sweep must be installed. Floors under deli coolers, around, and behind equipment need cleaning.

headline: Failed: no pest log, summary, or floor storage
summary: Pest control log book was not provided, and a citation was issued. Prepackaged meals lacked facility address. Dry storage boxes sat on basement floor; they must be six inches up. Gasket torn, drain stopper missing, and summary not posted for public view.

headline: Rusty produce cooler racks need repair
summary: Rusty metal storage racks inside the rear produce walk-in cooler must be cleaned and repainted or replaced.

headline: Black grime on floors at prep line
summary: Black grime was on floors in the front station prep-line area. The facility must clean and maintain the floors.

headline: Failed re-inspection: 124°F restroom hot water
summary: Hot water in two of four toilet rooms measured 124°F; the range must be 100-120°F, and a citation was issued. The ice machine had calcium buildup and must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: no health policy, clean-up kit, or soap
summary: No employee health policy and no vomit or diarrhea clean-up kit or procedure were on site. Hand sinks and three-compartment sinks did not hold 100-110°F water. Soap, paper towels, signs, stem thermometers, and sanitizer were missing. Side door needs rodent proofing.

headline: Restroom doors lack self-closing devices
summary: Restroom doors did not have self-closing devices. The facility must provide them.

headline: Prep table under wastewater line; rust
summary: A basement prep table sits directly under a wastewater line and must be removed or the piping fully encased. Rust covers prep table and walk-in cooler shelving and must be repainted or resealed. Grease behind the fryer and rough spray foam need cleaning and smoothing.

headline: Failed: no health policy; sushi rice pH records
summary: No signed employee health policies were on site; a citation was issued. No pH meter or certified lab letter was available to verify sushi rice safety. Containers and shakers were unlabeled, a splash guard was missing at the prep hand sink, and no food handler training was provided.

headline: Failed re-inspection: hot water, handwashing, cleanliness
summary: Hand sink hot water measured 57.2°F; the required minimum is 100°F, and a citation was issued. Other problems include missing handwashing signs, no hot water at a two-compartment sink, a leaky valve, crates used for storage, and dirty floors, hoods, and coolers.

headline: No handwashing signs at prep sinks
summary: No handwashing signs were found at sinks in the preparation areas. Signs must be provided.

headline: Dead cockroaches found; wall openings to seal
summary: Dead cockroaches were found on the food prep floor, inside a freezer's protective plastic, on the dish machine, and on glue boards. Wall openings near the three-compartment sink must be sealed. A prep table with rust and holes must be replaced.

headline: Light buildup on ice machine, floors, filters
summary: Calcium buildup was found inside the ice machine. Light grease was on the outside grease receptacle, light debris on kitchen floors, and light dust and grease on filters above the griddle. The manager was told to clean each area.

headline: Insect trap on bar counter removed
summary: Inspector saw an insect trap on the bar counter and told the manager to remove it. No insects or rodents were reported as present.

headline: Milk crates shelving; burnt-out hood light
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving throughout the prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving six inches off the floor. A burned-out light bulb at the ventilation hood must be replaced.

headline: Failed: 45-50 rat droppings; food too warm
summary: Inspector counted about 45-50 rat droppings in the rear of the facility, and a citation was issued. Cooler and prep cooler foods were held at up to 77°F; about 20 lbs (about $90) discarded. Raw pork was thawed in the mop sink; food was stored on floor.

headline: Dust in hood vent; worn dish rack
summary: A metal spatula was tucked between a wall and a pipe. A can opener blade needs cleaning, and a worn dish rack above the three-compartment sink needs replacing. Dust was in the hood vent and walk-in cooler air vent.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; sushi rice too warm
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while fish and sushi rice were handled. Sushi rice at 78.4°F was discarded; hot food must be at 135°F. Missing soap, hand-drying devices, a mezzanine hand sink, and a probe thermometer. Sushi rice has no variance.

headline: Soiled mop heads; floor debris in storage
summary: Soiled mop heads were not stored properly; the manager was told to hang them to prevent insect breeding. Debris was found on floors along walls and in corners in utility and storage areas. Manager was told to clean.

headline: Failed: food too warm; mouse droppings found
summary: Walk-in cooler rice measured 46.8°F and 56.7°F and ground beef 48.7°F; about 22 lbs ($200) was discarded. Unlabeled desserts in a grab-and-go cooler were discarded (about 7 lbs). Inspector found about 20 mouse droppings under the dish room hand sink.

headline: Failed: no certificate; mold in ice machine
summary: No valid sanitation certificate was on site at start; a certified manager arrived during the inspection. Mold-like buildup was found inside the ice machine, and a citation was issued. Missing health policy, vomit clean-up supplies, handwashing signs, and food handler certificates.

headline: Plates face-up; no backflow device at mop sink
summary: Plates and utensils were facing up and must be stored inverted. No visible backflow device at the rear mop sink faucet. Water heater drain discharges into a pan. Burnt-out hood light and no allergen training certificate on site.

headline: Failed re-inspection: no certified manager during prep
summary: Food was prepared without the original city food service certificate posted or a certified manager on site, and a citation was issued. Food containers were stored on dry storage floors. An oven door seal was hanging and needs repair.

headline: Failed: no pest log book; no backflow device
summary: No pest control log book was available; the premises must be serviced by a licensed exterminator. No backflow device was on the utility sink, and no commercial dumpster was on site for the retail business.

headline: No city food manager on site during food prep
summary: No city certified food service manager was on site while chicken, beef, beans, and rice were prepared and served, and a citation was issued. Food storage containers were not labeled. A prior allergen training violation was not corrected.

headline: Failed: live roaches, mouse droppings, no sink plumbing
summary: About three live German roaches were in the beverage prep area, and about 20 mouse droppings were in the basement dry storage and behind the alcohol cooler; a citation was issued. Bar hand sink lacked plumbing, repaired on site. Missing signs, labels, and stoppers.

headline: Handwashing signs needed at prep sinks
summary: Employee handwashing signs must be provided at hand sinks in the prep area.

headline: No allergen training proof for managers
summary: No proof of allergen training was available for food service sanitation managers. The manager was instructed to provide it.

headline: West washroom hand sink drains slowly
summary: The west washroom hand sink drains slowly. The manager was told that the hand sink must drain quickly.

headline: Basement floors not clean
summary: Basement floors were not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Food storage on floor; soiled sink and drains
summary: Food storage containers were on the floor in the front prep area. Single-use boxes and bowls were stored face-up above hot holding equipment. The scoop rinse sink and two floor drains were heavily soiled. Manager was told to fix each item.

headline: Failed: broken thermometers; no pest contract
summary: Thermometers were missing or broken inside cooling units holding cold foods. No pest control contract was on site, and a citation was not issued. Outside garbage lid had a large hole. Outdoor yard was cluttered with stored equipment and trash.

headline: Missing thermometer; grease and dirty walls
summary: A thermometer is needed for the two-door prep cooler. Plastic wear and shakers were unlabeled, and wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer. Grease covered the grill, fryer, and coolers; walls and filters were dirty, and a light was burned out.

headline: Failed: live cockroaches and mouse droppings
summary: Inspector found three live cockroaches in the basement prep area, about 25 mouse droppings inside the main baking oven, and about 15 small flying insects in the basement. Dead cockroaches were on glue boards. Additional pest control service is needed; a citation was issued.

headline: Failed: black buildup in ice; food held too warm
summary: Black substance in the basement ice machine dripped onto ice. Kitchen refrigerator foods were held at 45.5-53.2°F, above the 41°F limit. About 21 lbs ($125) was discarded. Cutting board stained and cut; expired food handler certificates.

headline: Hot water at 88.5°F; no hand-wash signs
summary: Dish area hand sink hot water measured 88.5°F; minimum is 100°F, and a citation was issued. Employees ate and drank in prep areas. Signage was missing at bar and basement sinks, and a basement restroom trash can lacked a lid.

headline: No city certified manager; raw pork thawed wrongly
summary: No city certified manager was on site while shrimp and chicken were prepared, and a citation was issued. The rear dish sink lacked a handwashing sign. Raw pork was thawed at room temperature, though it did not exceed 41°F. Two food handlers lacked training proof.

headline: No certified manager on site during meat prep
summary: No certified food manager with a valid original certificate was on site while ground beef, pork, and chicken were being prepared. A citation was issued; at least one certificate holder must be on site while open.

headline: Leaking pipe under middle sink
summary: A leaky pipe was found under the middle compartment of the three-compartment sink. The manager must repair and maintain it.

headline: Wet wiping cloths on counters; wet mops
summary: Wet wiping cloths were stored on counters throughout the kitchen and prep areas; they must be kept in sanitizing solution when not in use. Wet mops must be hung to dry when not in use.

headline: Pest control log missing service reports
summary: Pest control log book lacked copies of service reports; only one receipt dated 8/12/25 was on file. Management must provide at least two service reports from the past year. A citation was issued.

headline: Leak above basement sink; unlabeled flour
summary: Bulk flour was not labeled in the storage closet. A leak came from the ceiling above the basement utility sink. A dumpster lid was slightly cracked.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; slicer not clean
summary: Several bulk food containers, including flour, salt, and sugar, were not labeled. The meat slicer was not clean behind the blade, and food debris was noted. The manager was instructed to label and clean.

headline: Knives on prep table; drains and grease buildup
summary: Knives were stored on top of the prep table under the shelf and must be stored properly. Drains had dirt and debris, and fryer openings and cooking equipment sides had grease and food spillage. Damaged wall coving and floor debris under racks need repair and cleaning.

headline: Dish machine at zero sanitizer; tagged out
summary: Low-temperature dish machine was sanitizing at 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged held; it may not be used until fixed. Brownish substance found in soda nozzle. Pipes into a floor drain under the ice machine need a backflow gap or device.

headline: No allergen training on site; mop heads unstored
summary: Soiled mop heads were not stored properly and were told to hang them to prevent insect breeding. No allergen training was on site. Employees holding certified food manager certificates must complete training and keep records on site.

headline: No thermometer in prep cooler; grocery bag storage
summary: No ambient air thermometer was in the rear prep cooler. An employee lacked a hair restraint. Grocery bags were used to store food in the freezer, and rice was stored in a grocery bag in the microwave. Microwave interior had debris.

headline: Failed: no valid manager certificate on site
summary: No valid city food service manager certificate was on site, and a citation was issued. The high-temperature dish machine lacked test strips to check final rinse temperature. Peeling paint in basement near soda dispenser needs repair.

headline: No vomit clean-up kit; fryer guards needed
summary: No vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit was on site; a procedure was provided and no citation was issued. The fry warmer needs side guards to protect fries, and large schwarma skewers need a clean-in-place procedure.

headline: Bar hand sink has no hot water
summary: Bar hand sink had no hot water. The manager was told to provide hot water with a minimum temperature of 100°F. No citation was issued.

headline: Failed: no training, sanitation certificate, or health policy
summary: Person in charge lacked food safety training; no valid city sanitation certificate was posted (citation). Scrambled eggs at 48.9-50.1°F and egg whites at 48.6°F were held too warm; 5 lbs (about $150) was discarded. Missing thermometers and a chlorine test kit.

headline: Ice scoop placed on ice cubes
summary: An ice scoop was placed on top of ice cubes. The inspector instructed staff to keep it off the cubes.

headline: Passed; leaking faucet, no covered trash receptacle
summary: No ambient air thermometers were in reach-in and display coolers; a thermometer was provided during inspection. Wet wiping cloths, a dirty microwave, and a missing sink stopper (supplied on site) were noted. A leaking faucet and an uncovered restroom trash receptacle must be fixed.

headline: Passed re-inspection; dirty hood filters, no light
summary: Ventilation hood filters needed cleaning. The rear prep and storage area had no working light. The manager was told to fix both.

headline: Failed: no pest log, dumpster overflowing
summary: No licensed pest control logbook or operator; a citation was issued. Outside dumpster overflowing with trash; citation issued. Sinks leaking when drained; no hand-washing sign in employee washroom; missing light shields and burned-out light over stove.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified food manager on site
summary: Person in charge lacked a Chicago certified food manager certificate, and none was on site while TCS foods were prepared. This drew a citation. Also noted: a pipe leak under the sink, water-stained ceiling tiles, and a dirty can opener.

headline: Passed; missing signs, ceiling leaks, drain debris
summary: No hand-washing signs at the front prep sink. Missing and stained ceiling tiles, condensation leaking from ceilings, and debris in a floor drain were also noted. No pests found.

headline: Passed; washroom door lacks self-closing device
summary: The washroom door has no self-closing device. Management was told to install one.

headline: Passed re-inspection; no food handler certificates on site
summary: No food handler certificates were on site and no allergen training was present. Other items: greasy fryer and floors under cooking equipment, a torn cooler gasket, cardboard floor liner in the walk-in, and soiled mop heads.

headline: Passed; broken freezer lid, clutter fixed on site
summary: A freezer chest had a broken lid and ice buildup; the manager was told to replace the lid and defrost it. Boxes cluttering the area near the walk-in freezer were removed by the manager on site.

headline: Passed re-inspection; utensil storage and no certificate
summary: Clean utensils were stored improperly in a container with dirty ones. No food handler certificate was on site. Other items: stained and deep-cut cutting boards, broken walls and floors, grease on the floor, and a broken light fixture.

headline: Passed with conditions; cold food too warm, corrected
summary: Cold foods measured 46.9-48.6F; about 4 lbs were discarded. A cooler at 48.7F was tagged. A missing menu disclosure was added on site. Cardboard liners, a missing allergen certificate, and a cracked floor tile were also noted.

headline: Passed with conditions; low water pressure, greasy grounds
summary: Low water pressure at kitchen prep and restroom hand sinks must be fixed. Thick grease surrounded the outside grease container, which earned a citation. Greasy floors and heavy grease in the hood also noted.

headline: Passed; freezer ice buildup and dirty floors
summary: Lower surfaces of reach-in freezers had ice buildup, food and debris. Floors under and around heavy kitchen equipment were dirty. Mops were stored in buckets rather than hung to dry.

headline: Passed re-inspection; floor debris under coolers
summary: Debris was on the floor under the deli prep coolers. The area must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Passed with conditions; no hot water, now restored
summary: Hot water was not running at sinks (84.2F); it was restored to 116.7F during inspection. A gap at the west outer door could let in rodents. Damaged floor and ceiling tiles, greasy fryer, and expired food handler training were noted.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager while cooking
summary: No person in charge with a certified manager certificate was on site while hot corn and pork sandwiches were prepared; citation issued. Also noted: missing hand-wash signage, an uncooled cooler thermometer, unlabeled bulk containers, and a loose hot-water dial.

headline: Passed; leaking pipes and dusty vent
summary: A leaky pipe under the three-compartment sink and a leak at a faucet neck must be repaired. The air vent cover in the prep area was dusty and must be cleaned.

headline: Passed re-inspection; unlabeled food, no splashguard
summary: Food stored in containers in the coolers, walk-in and dry storage lacked name labels. A splashguard was needed between the front hand sink and prep table. Milk crates were used as shelving.

headline: Failed: about 50 mouse droppings, dish machine at 0 ppm
summary: About 50 mouse droppings were found in many areas, including on top of MSG, cornstarch and rice containers. Dead roaches were also found. The dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged do-not-use.

headline: Passed; heavy trash and food debris on floors
summary: Floor behind the water heaters was heavily soiled with loose trash and debris. Food debris had built up on the floor below the wok stations. The manager was told to clean these areas.

headline: Passed with conditions; missing signage and hand drying
summary: Hand-washing signs were missing at a rear dish and prep sink and in a restroom. No hand drying supplies were at the rear sink; a citation was issued. Black mold-like substance on caulk above a sink; a food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed; thermometer, debris, and grease issues
summary: A thermometer inside a front prep cooler had to be replaced. Dried food debris was on prep shelving, grease receptacle was heavily soiled, and several floor areas needed cleaning. No pests found.

headline: Passed re-inspection; soiled linens and missing ceiling tile
summary: Soiled linens in outdoor storage must be sealed or contained. A ceiling tile above the fire suppression tank is missing. Grease covers a kitchen ceiling vent, a light shield is missing over a sink, and a plastic shield above a prep table is cracked.

headline: Passed; patio door gap and dirty areas
summary: Side patio door had a 1/4-inch gap underneath, so it was not pest-proof. A leaking faucet, a dirty cabinet under the beverage station, and a mop stored in dirty water were also noted.

headline: Failed: hand sink blocked; many prior violations uncorrected
summary: A hot-food-prep hand sink was blocked by strainers and salsa containers; a citation was issued. Other items: unlabeled containers, a leaking drain pipe, heavy grease on walls and equipment, and prior core violations not corrected.

headline: Failed: no hot water, no vomit cleanup procedure
summary: No vomit and diarrhea clean-up procedure, no hand sink in the washroom, and no running hot water on premises. No mop sink, thermometers, pest control logbook or covered trash can. No coolers or freezers were on the premises.

headline: Passed with conditions; cold foods too warm, discarded
summary: Many service-cooler foods measured 45-58.6F, including liquid eggs, cheese and sliced tomatoes; 20 lbs were discarded and a citation issued. A service prep cooler at 51F was taken out of use until repaired. Other items: a leaking faucet and dirty floors.

headline: Failed: no hot or cold running water in bar area
summary: Liquor consumption area had no hot or cold running water under city pressure. Manager was told to install adequate sinks with hot and cold water.

headline: Passed with conditions; no written employee health policy
summary: No written employee health policy was on site. The facility was told to establish one with signed copies for all food employees. No citation was issued.

headline: Passed re-inspection; dead roaches and ice-bin lid missing
summary: Dead roaches were found throughout the locker room, on floors, in corners and in lockers; they must be removed. Also noted: ice bin lacking a lid, missing splash guards, a drain leak, missing grout, ice buildup, and non-working lights.

headline: Failed: no certified manager during food prep
summary: Person in charge had no valid sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was present while TCS foods were prepared; a citation was issued. Also noted: rusty racks, greasy fryers, a walk-in freezer door that does not close fully, and water-stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Passed; door gap and draining condenser tube
summary: A rear exterior door had a 1/4-inch gap and must be repaired and fitted with a door sweep. A condenser tube from a cold-hold unit was draining into a hand sink and must be moved to a floor drain.

headline: Failed: cold food unsafe; cooler unit taken out of use
summary: Several display-cooler items measured 48.9-60.9F; about 40 lbs were discarded. A rear prep refrigerator at 58.9F must not be used until reinspected. Missing sushi rice paperwork and sanitizer test kit; grease buildup.

headline: Passed re-inspection; hair restraint and allergen training
summary: A food handling employee was not wearing a hair restraint while preparing food. The sanitation manager did not have an allergen training certificate. Both were corrected.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager while serving
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager was on the premises while sandwiches were prepared and served. This drew a citation; a certified manager must be present at all times when TCS foods are prepared or served.

headline: Failed: over 80 mouse droppings; exterminator needed
summary: Over 80 mouse droppings were found on shelves under the front counter, near electrical wires and computer equipment. Manager was told to call an exterminator and clean all areas. Also noted: food on the walk-in freezer floor and soiled wiping cloths.

headline: Failed: ice machine slime dripping into ice
summary: Black and pink slime was found inside the ice machine and dripping into ice; a citation was issued. Also noted: no backflow device at the ice machine line, a slow-draining sink, debris in all floor drains, greasy waste oil container, and missing menu wording on cook-to-order items.

headline: Passed re-inspection; duct tape and stained cutting board
summary: Duct tape was sealing a cooler gasket and must be repaired. A heavily stained cutting board needs cleaning or replacement. Cracked floor tiles in the rear dish area and cardboard used as a floor liner must be fixed.

headline: Passed; worn front door seal, floor debris
summary: The weather strip at the bottom of the front door was worn and must be replaced to keep pests out. Floors around the freezer in the rear storage area needed cleaning to remove debris.

headline: Passed; grease and debris on floors
summary: Grease and debris were on the floor between cooking equipment in the front food prep area and must be cleaned. Floors in the rear dishwashing area must be kept dry.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified food manager present
summary: No person-in-charge or food employee with City of Chicago certified food manager training was on site while TCS foods were prepared; a citation was issued. Cooked chicken and potatoes were covered while cooling; ice machine was mildly soiled.

headline: Passed; detail cleaning needed throughout
summary: Reach-in coolers, freezers, cooking equipment, floors and hood all need detail cleaning to remove food spills and buildup. Frozen meat was thawed on the counter. Wiping cloths and utensils were not stored properly; basement clutter must be removed.

headline: Passed; door gaps and dirty bakery
summary: Missing weather stripping on the front door and an opening at the rear dock platform are possible pest entry points. A leak at the produce prep three-compartment sink must be fixed. Bakery and produce cooler were dusty and dirty.

headline: Failed: over 100 mouse droppings; no hot water at first
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were found in prep, dry storage, washroom and dining areas; pest control is required. Water measured 68F; hot water was restored before inspection ended. Gaps under entry doors, stained ceiling tiles, and no food handler certificates were also noted.

headline: Failed: hot water too cool for dish washing
summary: Hot water at the warewashing unit was too cool for the wash cycle. The operator must provide at least 120F. This is a priority violation.

headline: Failed: about 40 live roaches, flies, and roach feces
summary: About 40 live roaches were found under cooking equipment, in catch pans, and behind the water heater, plus about 50 dead ones. Roach feces was found throughout the kitchen. Licensed pest control is required; a citation was issued.

headline: Failed: no hot water; raw chicken stored over produce
summary: No hot running water in prep, dish and restroom areas; water measured 51-56F. Raw chicken was stored above open containers of cilantro and parsley in a refrigerator. This drew a citation.

headline: Failed: over 100 live small flies in facility
summary: Over 100 live small flies were on walls in prep, bar and dining areas; pest control service is required. Gaps under several entry doors, damaged floor tiles, and clogged floor drains are also prior core violations not corrected.

headline: Passed; shelf buildup and broken tile
summary: Slight buildup on shelves in a two-door cooler; the person in charge was told to clean it. A broken tile around the mop sink needs repair.

headline: Passed; clutter and dirty floors noted
summary: Unused equipment and unnecessary articles in the rear storage area could attract pests, so the manager was told to remove them. Loose debris and dust on floors and corners throughout; detail cleaning required. No pests found.

headline: Failed: low hot water and sanitizer temperature
summary: Restroom hand sink measured 78.3F; maintenance raised sinks to 102-105F on site. Dish machine final rinse was below the required 180F, and a technician was called to repair it. Missing HACCP logs; 4 lbs of vacuum-sealed food discarded.

headline: Passed with conditions; hand sink blocked, citation issued
summary: A prep-area hand sink was blocked and used to store utensils; a citation was issued. Also noted: no paper towels or hand-washing signs, unlabeled bulk containers, an employee without a hair restraint, and debris on floors.

headline: Passed re-inspection; gap at front door, floor damage
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the front door is not pest-proof. Milk crates were used as shelving; missing and broken floor and ceiling tiles, exposed caulk, and a wall hole near pipes were noted. No proof of food handler training.

headline: Passed with conditions; cold foods too warm, discarded
summary: Cooked chicken and sliced tomatoes in a prep cooler measured 57F and 53F, and a three-door cooler measured 60F; these were discarded and a citation issued. No employee health policy. Hair restraints and allergen training were also needed.

headline: Failed: no hot water at rear hand sink; expired certificates
summary: Rear prep hand sink measured 75.2F, below the required 100F; a citation was issued. Also noted: ice on the walk-in freezer condenser, a leaking pipe, greasy cutting boards, and all food handler certificates expired.

headline: Passed with conditions; egg mixture discarded
summary: About 10 lbs of egg mixture held at 64.8F in prep was discarded and a citation issued; cold food must stay at 41F or below. Food residue was inside prep-line coolers. Certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed; freezer frost, broken restroom sensor
summary: Heavy frost built up inside freezers and must be corrected. A broken sensor on the women's restroom sink must be repaired. Small debris on the ground in the rear garbage room was also noted.

headline: Passed re-inspection; labeling and upkeep issues
summary: Dry storage containers lacked common-name labels; inspector told staff to label them. Excess ice on walk-in freezer door and graffiti and debris in restrooms were also noted. No pests found.

headline: Passed; food residue in hot dog cooler
summary: Food residue had built up inside a cold-hold unit in the front prep area where hot dogs are stored. The person in charge was told to clean and maintain it.

headline: Passed; no food handler certificates shown
summary: Grease was on a hot holding unit and bun toaster, and dish area walls needed cleaning. Food handling employees did not have food handler training certificates; management was told to show proof of training.

headline: Failed: no sanitizer and hot water too cool
summary: Vehicle had no sanitizer and no thermometer for cold foods. Hot water at the three-compartment sink measured 98F, below the required 110F. Grey water tank was leaking onto the ground.

headline: Passed with conditions; no vomit cleanup supplies
summary: No supplies on site to clean up vomit or diarrhea; management was told to provide them. Trash and litter were noted on the floor of the indoor garbage room.

headline: Failed: drain flies, no hot water, uncertified manager
summary: About 35-50 drain flies were found near the hand sink and three-compartment sink. No hot water in food prep; a plumber replaced a heating element and hot water was restored. Person in charge lacked a sanitation certificate; cold display cooler held food at 55-60F and was discarded.

headline: Failed: live roaches, flies, and a dog in the lobby
summary: Four live roaches were seen under the hot water tank and washer in the basement. About 6-8 large flies and 8-10 small flies were flying in work areas. A live dog was carried by a customer in the lobby; only service dogs are allowed. A citation was issued.

headline: Passed; food handlers lacked training
summary: Food handlers were working on the premises without food handler training. Training must be provided.

headline: Failed: no vomit kit; ice machine slime; smoking violation
summary: No vomit and diarrhea procedure or kit on site; one was left and must be kept. Black slime was found inside the basement ice machine and a citation issued. Ashtrays and cigarette butts found, which violates the clean indoor air rule.

headline: Passed re-inspection; rust, leak, clutter
summary: Rust was on the bottoms of prep tables in the rear prep area. A front counter hand sink had an excessive leak. Buckets and containers cluttered the area around a rear hand sink and must be organized.

headline: Failed: no trained person in charge; many violations
summary: No person in charge with verifiable sanitation training and no original sanitation certificate on site; citations issued. No metal stem thermometer or sanitizer test kit. Grimy floors, greasy hood filters, and prior violations not corrected.

headline: Passed with conditions; hand washing and temperature violations
summary: Employee washed hands in the three-compartment sink without soap. A food thermometer was not sanitized between uses. Homemade ranch held at 46-53F; about 5 lbs were discarded and a citation issued.

headline: Passed with conditions; no employee health policy
summary: No employee health policy or training on site, which drew a citation. Two cars parked in the garage alongside beer kegs and food coolers, which must be separated. Restroom receptacles and self-closing doors, and wall holes behind the bar, also need attention.

headline: Passed with conditions; no sanitation certificate on site
summary: No person with an original Chicago food sanitation certificate was on site, which drew a citation. Dusty hood filters, no food handler training certificate, and a prior core violation for missing allergen training were also noted.

headline: Passed re-inspection; unlabeled bottles, damaged floor
summary: Squeeze bottles holding food lacked common-name labels. Damaged flooring under a rug at the front service counter must be repaired.

headline: Passed; exposed pipes and ceiling in prep area
summary: Exposed ventilation, piping and utility lines above the front prep area must be enclosed or covered. A smooth, easily cleanable ceiling must be installed in that area.

headline: Failed: no vomit kit, pest log, or dumpster
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit, no paper towels at bar hand sinks, no pest control logbook, no chemical test kit, and no self-closing toilet doors. No commercial dumpster was on site.

headline: Passed; items not inverted, stained ceiling tiles
summary: Single-service articles were not inverted to protect them from contamination. Stained ceiling tiles in the sales area must be replaced.

headline: Failed: soiled linens and unused equipment outside
summary: Soiled linens were stored in an open container on the rear patio. Raw wood was used to hold an unused soda system, and tape was used to repair a sink nozzle. Prior priority violation not corrected, and unused equipment must be removed.

headline: Failed: gasoline and cement stored near food
summary: Bag of cement and gasoline were stored on a food shelving unit in the basement; a citation was issued. Also noted: unlabeled food containers, no hand-washing sign in the employee washroom, outside garbage area not clean (citation), and clutter in the basement.

headline: Passed; cutting board, leaks, and grease buildup
summary: A large cutting board by the meat slicer had deep grooves and must be replaced. A dishwasher leak, dust in the walk-in fan vent, heavy floor grease, and a heavily greased hood with filters also need attention.

headline: Passed; hand-washing signs needed
summary: Hand-washing signs must be posted at hand sinks in the prep and dishwashing areas. No other issues were listed.

headline: Passed; leaking pipe and stained ceiling tiles
summary: A prep-area hand sink pipe is leaking and must be repaired. Water-stained ceiling tiles above the dish three-compartment sink must be replaced. No allergen training certificates were on site for managers.

headline: Passed; hair restraints, leaks, and grease
summary: Employees in the food prep area were not wearing hair or beard restraints. Cutting boards had deep grooves, deep fryers were greasy, and leaks were found at the dish machine and a hand sink. Ceiling tiles and floor drains were dirty.

headline: Passed re-inspection; thermometers and labels missing
summary: No ambient air thermometers in reach-in and display coolers. Food storage containers lacked labels showing the common name of the food. Both were marked for correction.

headline: Failed: about 25 small flies near sinks
summary: About 25 small flies were noted near the dish machine, three-compartment sink, water heater and utility sink. Inspector advised consulting pest control. Also noted: pots not inverted, tortilla chips in plastic totes, and dirty freezer and coolers.

headline: Passed; soiled mop stored on floor
summary: A soiled mop head was stored on the floor and must be hung to dry to prevent insect breeding. A ventilation fan in the women's washroom needs repair. Certified manager missing allergen training.

headline: Failed: rat and mouse droppings found
summary: About 25 rat droppings on basement stairs and about 45 mouse droppings in rear music rooms. Additional pest control is needed. Also noted: unlabeled bulk containers, stained cutting boards, and soiled prep areas.

headline: Passed; missing hand sink sign and floor drain cleaning
summary: Hand-washing sign was missing at a bar hand sink. Silverware on tables must be covered or reset when seated. Prep cooler interior had grease buildup. Floor drain under the three-compartment sink must be cleaned to prevent pests. Some food handlers lacked certificates.

headline: Failed: hot food too cool; over 50 mouse droppings
summary: Hot foods measured 89.4-120.9F, below the required 135F; the manager was told to discard them. Over 50 mouse droppings were found in the rear storage and washroom, and a live roach was crawling in the dish area; a citation was issued.

headline: Failed: roaches and rodent droppings; many violations
summary: 25 live roaches were found above a sink in the bread prep area, and about 100 rodent droppings near a sink in the meat cutting room. No certified manager on site during meat prep. Multiple sink, sanitizer, date-marking, and food handler training violations.

headline: Passed re-inspection; greasy equipment and floors
summary: Hand-washing sign missing in the washroom. Cutting board had deep grooves and stains. Greasy cooking equipment, dirty floors under equipment, and debris under the three-compartment sink must be cleaned. Allergen training was not on site.

headline: Passed re-inspection; unused equipment and debris
summary: Unsealed wood at the front bar must be sealed. The basement utility sink has no backflow preventer. Broken and unused equipment, construction debris and heavy trash were noted in the basement and office.

headline: Passed; roaches under sink to be removed
summary: Roaches were seen on the floor under the three-compartment sink; the person in charge must remove dead roaches and sanitize the area. Food debris was in a cooler gasket and dust was on a restroom vent.

headline: Passed re-inspection; rust on walk-in shelves
summary: Rust had built up on metal shelves in the walk-in cooler. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Failed: bare-hand egg contact, hand-washing violations
summary: An employee washed hands in a food prep sink, and another peeled hard-boiled eggs with bare hands; the eggs were discarded. No hand sink was accessible in the rear prep area. Frozen meat was thawed improperly. Citations issued.

headline: Failed: over 100 rodent droppings; pest control required
summary: Over 100 droppings were found in the front serving area, kitchen and basement. Pest control service is required before reinspection. Also noted: no lids on bulk containers, missing discard dates on gelatin (labels attached on site), and floors with trash and food debris.

headline: Passed with conditions; ice machine slime, allergen training
summary: Excessive black and pink slimy buildup was inside the ice machine panel and dripping onto ice; a citation was issued. Certified food managers on duty lacked allergen training.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings found; hand soap missing
summary: Over 60 mouse droppings found in both kitchens, including near the deep fryer; pest control required before reinspection. No hand soap at a second-floor sink, corrected on site. Expired food handler certificates and greasy hood.

headline: Failed: 2-5 live roaches, cold food unsafe
summary: 2-5 live roaches were found in the prep area and under the three-compartment sink. About 9 lbs of cold food at 47.8F and 48.4F were discarded. A hand sink was blocked by sauce containers, which earned a citation.

headline: Failed: dish machine not sanitizing, tagged out
summary: Kitchen dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged held for inspection. Also noted: no test strips, a one-inch gap at the kitchen exit door, unlabeled bulk containers, expired food handler certificates, and prior core violations not corrected.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings and sanitizer at 0 ppm
summary: About 30 mouse droppings were found under sinks, near the rear exit and amid clutter; pest control is recommended. Sanitizer measured 0.0 ppm, and dishes were not sanitized. Missing food handler and allergen training.

headline: Passed with conditions; cold food above safe temperature
summary: Sliced turkey and tuna in the walk-in cooler and several sandwich-unit items measured 43.5-47.6F, above the 41F limit. About 10 lbs were discarded. A cutting board with deep cuts was also noted.

headline: Failed: no sanitation manager; hot water too cool
summary: No valid City of Chicago sanitation manager certificate on site while chicken was prepared and served; a citation was issued. Bar hand sink water measured 60F. Prior violations not corrected: greasy fryer, slow-draining sink, and cracked floor tile.

headline: No manager certificate; rodent droppings in basement
summary: No valid city food service sanitation manager certificate or proof of class enrollment. About 40 rodent droppings in basement storage; clean and call pest control. Menu lacks consumer advisory for undercooked items like steak and burgers.

headline: Cooked rice too warm; 16 lbs discarded
summary: Cooked rice at 50.4F inside two-door cooler; manager voluntarily discarded 16 lbs ($100). Milk crates used for shelving in back kitchen must be replaced with proper shelving. Certified food managers lack allergen training certificates.

headline: Mouse droppings in several areas; dirty shelves
summary: Mouse droppings found in rear and front store areas, by the stove and along outside walls, roughly 50-61 total. Manager told to call pest control, clean and sanitize. Shelves, reach-in coolers and hood filters need detail cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled sugar; drain board not self-draining
summary: Bulk sugar container not labeled; staff told to label it. Deli cups not air dried properly; multi-use utensils must be air dried. Three-compartment sink drain board in dish room is not self-draining and must be tilted toward the sink.

headline: Brooms hung next to clean utensil rack
summary: Brooms and dustpans hung next to the clean utensil rack. Staff instructed to install a barrier to protect utensils from contamination.

headline: Dishwashers too cool; about 200 mouse droppings
summary: Both high-temperature dishwashers failed to reach 180F final rinse, reading 78F and 117F. About 200 mouse droppings found in storage, hallways, and retail aisles; more pest control is needed. Some sinks had no hot water.

headline: Mouse droppings in beer storage; no splashguard
summary: About 20 mouse droppings in both beer storage areas; additional pest control needed. Bulk flour, rice, cornmeal and sugar lack labels. No splashguard between hot food prep, the hand sink and the cooler. Greasy outdoor waste container; citation issued.

headline: Dirty soda and slushie dispensers; floors need cleaning
summary: Dark buildup under the slushie unit and soda splatter on dispenser nozzles; staff told to clean to prevent possible contamination. Trash cabinets, floors and freezer clutter also need cleaning and clearing.

headline: Holes in basement ceiling
summary: Holes in the basement ceiling must be covered by the manager.

headline: Utensils not stored in hot water; clutter
summary: Serving utensils stored between uses without water at least 135F; staff told to store them in hot water. Excessive clutter in rear food prep and office area must be removed and items elevated 6 inches. Debris behind soda machine must be cleaned.

headline: Rear door gap; leaking faucet; cluttered premises
summary: Rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom and must be repaired to block pests. Coolers, cutting boards, cooking equipment, floors and walls need detail cleaning. Leaking faucet base at 3-compartment sink; clutter must be cleared.

headline: Three-compartment sink not labeled
summary: Three-compartment sink lacks labels for the wash, rinse and sanitize compartments. Person in charge instructed to label them and keep them maintained.

headline: Vinegar-pickled foods held without required food safety plan
summary: Cooked carrots, jalapenos and onions in vinegar were held at room temperature without an approved HACCP (written food safety) plan. About 75 pounds, worth $125, was discarded. No approved special-process variance on site; one must be obtained from CDPH.

headline: Frozen meat thawed in plastic container
summary: Frozen meat was thawing in a plastic container in the food prep area; TCS foods must be thawed under cold running water, in refrigeration, or in microwave. Stained cutting boards, cardboard shelf liners, and no covered waste receptacle in employee restroom.

headline: Ice scoop on ice machine; dirty dishmachines
summary: Metal ice scoop stored on top of the ice machine; a clean container must be provided. Food debris on dishmachine exteriors and black dirt on walls behind them. Some ceiling tiles missing and a dairy dish area floor drain cover missing.

headline: Ice machine buildup; dirty floors and dispenser
summary: Small buildup inside both ice machines; staff told to remove ice, clean and sanitize. Large can opener and a cutting board need detail cleaning or replacement. Beverage dispenser has splatter; floors and walls need deep cleaning. Worn reach-in cooler gaskets.

headline: No pest logbook; food stored on floor
summary: No maintained pest control logbook with recent service reports or company license number. Food boxes stored on kitchen floor. No food handler training certificate for a food handler, and no allergen training for any certified manager. Sanitizer test strips were provided during the inspection.

headline: Waste pipe above food storage needs covering
summary: A waste pipe above shelves holding food containers must be encased or the items relocated. Grease and food debris on walls and under the cooking line must be cleaned. Milk crates may not be used to elevate stored items.

headline: Dirty shelves, cooking equipment and floor drains
summary: Storage shelves, cooking equipment, floors under equipment and floor drains need detail cleaning. Leaks at 3-compartment sink faucets and at the mop sink. Equipment in poor repair and unnecessary clutter must be removed or corrected.

headline: Slow-draining sink; dirty floor drains
summary: Slow-draining handsink in the rear prep area near the ice machine must be repaired. Dirty floor drains under the three-compartment sink and near the ice machine need cleaning.

headline: No food manager on site during food prep
summary: No city food sanitation manager on site while eggs and chicken were prepped; manager must be present and certificate posted. No food handler or allergen training records on site. Water-damaged ceiling tiles and soiled wiping cloths also noted.

headline: No food handler training proof; no cooler thermometers
summary: No proof of food handler training for any food handler; must be provided. No visible internal thermometer in display and prep coolers; one must be placed in the warmest part of each cooler.

headline: Warewashing gauges broken; cooler leaking
summary: All warewashing temperature gauges for wash, rinse and sanitize are broken and inoperable; citation issued. Condenser line leaking at a reach-in cooler behind the wok line. Carts, piping and fryer exteriors are greasy and must be cleaned.

headline: Wiping cloths and racks; dirty floor drains
summary: Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer when not in use. Rusty walk-in cooler racks must be cleaned or replaced. Floor drains and corners dirty; mop stored in dirty water. Poor lighting in walk-in cooler; expired food handler and allergen certificates.

headline: Pest control logbook not kept up to date
summary: Pest control logbook was not maintained. The last pest inspection report was dated 12/19/2023. At least two pest inspection reports per year must be kept on file. Also noted: a leaking faucet at the dish sink and no covered waste bin in the women's washroom.

headline: Missing handwashing and food label signage
summary: Basement employee restroom needs handwashing signage. Food storage containers in the basement dry storage area must be labeled with the common name of each food.

headline: Ice machine, shelves and floors need cleaning
summary: Ice machine interior needs detail cleaning, and a leaking soda box needs repair with syrup buildup on tubes. Storage shelves, cooking equipment and floors need detail cleaning. Broken floor tiles in the rear prep area need repair.

headline: Ice machine interior dirty; no hair restraints
summary: Ice machine interior needs cleaning to remove buildup; staff instructed to clean and maintain. Food handlers were told to obtain and wear hair restraints.

headline: About 100 live cockroaches throughout premises
summary: About 100 live cockroaches found throughout food prep and dish areas, including inside the freezer and in the pest control logbook. Prep cooler was off and tagged held for inspection; it must be kept at 41F or below. Licensed pest service required.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; about 25 lbs discarded
summary: Ham at 52F and other cold foods at 51-57F, including raw chicken and sausage, held too warm; about 25 lbs ($300) discarded. Prep cooler measured 50.5F. Leak at 3-compartment sink faucets. One certified food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Dirty fan guards; wet mop in walkway
summary: White soil residue on walk-in cooler fan guards must be cleaned. A wet mop was stored in the walkway to the basement; staff instructed to hang mops to dry when not in use.

headline: Dirty ice machine; open gaps; damaged freezer
summary: Upper parts of the ice machine need cleaning. Open gaps on rear basement door to the landlord storage area must be sealed. Cracked freezer lid, greasy walls, pooling water and missing floor drain cover. No food handler training proof for required employees.

headline: Ice scoop stored on ice; no hair restraints
summary: Ice scooper needs cleaning and was stored directly on ice in the freezer; must clean and store properly. A food handler prepped without a hair restraint. To-go containers not inverted; washroom door is not self-closing.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; inaccurate thermometer
summary: Employee restrooms lacked handwashing signs; staff told to post them. The thermometer in the milk cooler was inaccurate; accurate thermometers must be provided.

headline: Greasy oven, cooler and floors need cleaning
summary: Cook line oven has excessive grease and food debris inside and out. Two-door cooler has grease on handles and food debris inside. Prep and dish area floors have food and grease buildup, and the ventilation hood and filters are greasy.

headline: No certified person in charge on site
summary: No person in charge with a valid city food sanitation certificate, and no valid certificate posted when food was prepared. Manager must designate a person in charge for all hours. Rear door gaps must be sealed to prevent pest entry.

headline: Unlabeled containers; rusty racks; debris outside
summary: Storage containers including rice, salt and cinnamon need common-name labels. Rusty racks in basement walk-in cooler and mold-like buildup in a reach-in cooler. Debris under the dumpster and a flickering bulb were also noted.

headline: Single-use containers reused; rusted shelving
summary: Single-use containers were being washed and reused; manager told to discard them after use and use only food-grade multi-use containers. Rusted shelves in a reach-in cooler, a greasy exhaust hood dripping, and stored mops also need fixing.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; leaking faucets
summary: No handwashing signs at front and rear handsinks. One-compartment sink leaks at faucet base, and a rear handsink drains slowly. Floor corners and areas under sinks have dirt and debris. Certified managers hold expired allergen certificates.

headline: Sushi counter unprotected; slimy ice machine
summary: No sneeze guard at sushi prep counter; two-day notice given to fix. Black and pink slimy buildup inside ice machine dripping onto ice; cleaned at end of inspection. No employee health policy and no allergen training. Outdoor grease container is a rodent food source.

headline: Gaps at exit doors; debris in cooler gaskets
summary: Gaps over 1/4 inch at bottom of front and rear exit doors; both must be rodent-proofed. Food debris in reach-in cooler gaskets. Both unisex bathrooms need covered trash cans. Spillage and debris under soda shelf and on front prep floor.

headline: Mouse droppings; flies; no handwashing sink nearby
summary: About 200 mouse droppings across West building kitchens and the Starbucks area; additional pest service needed. Dead fruit flies in soda cooler. Several cold hold units were tagged by CDPH as inoperable. Dishwashing area lacks a nearby handwashing sink.

headline: Over 70 mouse droppings; beef and pork held too warm
summary: Beef at 50.0F and pork at 47.8F in cold hold unit; manager voluntarily discarded 1 lb ($10). Over 70 mouse droppings found in dry storage and by the kitchen back door. Clean affected areas and consult pest control. Wiping cloths improperly stored.

headline: Low walk-in lighting; repeat pipe violation
summary: Low light in walk-in cooler; adequate lighting must be provided. Repeat violation: waste pipe above disposable paper goods such as coffee filters and cups must be encased or items moved; surface must be smooth and cleanable. Citation issued.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; leaking sink base
summary: No handwashing signs near sinks in prep, dish and bar areas. Raw unfinished wood on walk-in cooler exterior; grease inside cooking equipment; excess ice in chest freezers. Leaking faucet base at 3-compartment sink; peeling paint and dusty vents.

headline: Unlabeled dry storage; ginger on cooler floor
summary: Several dry food containers in the kitchen lack common-name labels. Ginger stored on the walk-in cooler floor must be raised 6 inches. Whetstones stored on floor under sink; drinking glasses stored beneath paper towel dispenser must be relocated.

headline: No certified food service manager present
summary: No certified food service manager was on site. Instructed to have one present during operation. Cited as a priority foundation violation under city code 7-38-012.

headline: No training proof; pest log missing 2026 reports
summary: No proof of food handler training for any food handler, and no allergen training proof for city-certified managers. Pest control logbook lacks 2026 service reports; this repeat violation must be fixed before re-inspection. Dusty washroom vent also needs cleaning.

headline: Dirty shelves, vents and dim lighting
summary: Prep table shelving and equipment under beverage station shelf need cleaning. Vents above prep tables have dirt and dust. Dim lighting in front prep and the hallway to the beverage station and dishroom must be increased.

headline: No certified manager; mouse droppings and insects found
summary: No certified food manager on site while open. Basement prep area had 50+ mouse droppings and small flies. A flour bin had 1 live and 2 dead insects. Spring rolls cooling at room temperature were moved to freezer.

headline: Rear door screen and water inlet cap needed
summary: Rear exit door needs a better screen to prevent a possible pest entry point. Manager instructed to add a cap on the fresh water inlet to prevent possible contamination. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Deli cups not air dried after washing
summary: Deli cups were not air dried after washing. Staff instructed to air dry all multi-use utensils.

headline: New employees lack food handler certificates
summary: No food handler certificate observed for new employees. Staff instructed to obtain certificates and keep them on site.

headline: No certified manager while cold foods served
summary: No certified food manager on site while quiche and other cold-held foods were prepared and served. Quiche, ham, pork and beef held at 49-50F; about 5 lbs ($100) discarded. No employee health policy, vomit cleanup kit or metal-stem thermometer found.

headline: No covered waste bin in all-gender washroom
summary: No covered waste receptacle for sanitary napkins in the all-gender washroom. Staff instructed to provide one.

headline: One-inch gap at side door; no covered trash
summary: A one-inch gap between the side entrance doors must be made tight-fitting and rodent-proofed. One of two unisex toilet rooms has no covered receptacle; staff told to provide one.

headline: Dirty ice machine; leaking buckets; rusted shelving
summary: Exterior and top interior of ice machine need cleaning. Buckets in walk-in cooler catch dripping water from the fan; the leak must be fixed. Wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces. Stained cutting boards, rusted prep-table shelves and greasy fryer area also noted.

headline: Gap at front door; no covered waste bin
summary: An opening at the base of the front entrance door must be sealed to prevent pests. The eastside all-gender washroom has no covered receptacle for sanitary products; staff told to provide one.

headline: No certified manager and no signed health policies
summary: Person in charge lacks a certified food manager certificate, and none is posted. No signed employee health policies. A leaky pipe at the 3-compartment sink must be repaired. Utensils and plastic ware need inverting, and items must be kept off the floor.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; flies on prep surfaces
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings on shelves, floors, and inside display cooler and fryer cabinets. Numerous flying insects landed on prep tables, cutting boards and sinks. Food was thawing in standing water; manager must call an exterminator.

headline: No handwashing sign at bar
summary: No handwashing sign found at bar areas. Management must provide one.

headline: Floors not clean in prep areas
summary: Floors in preparation areas were not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Chicken held too warm; no paper towels at sinks
summary: Three lbs of chicken at 47.8F and sliced vegetables at 48.5F in front prep cooler; manager discarded 6 lbs ($95). No paper towels at hand sinks, fixed during inspection. Food handlers lacked hair restraints; wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces.

headline: Cutting boards and greasy equipment in kitchen
summary: Cutting boards in the rear prep area have deep cuts and stains and must be restored or replaced. Heavy grease deposits on equipment and food debris in the rear kitchen; staff instructed to deep clean and sanitize, including floors under equipment.

headline: Inadequate cooling method; labeling and repairs needed
summary: Method of cooling pacaya is inadequate; food must be uncovered during cooling if protected from overhead contamination. Storage containers need common-name labels. Foil liners on cooking equipment must be removed, and a cooler handle is broken.

headline: Live roaches; food debris; no handler training
summary: Two live roaches found inside the prep area reach-in cooler. All roach activity must be removed by re-inspection, and a pest control service is advised. Food debris on shelves, sinks and equipment. No food handler training certificates on premises.

headline: Leaking condenser; torn gasket; slow sink
summary: Torn gasket on a salad cooler. Condenser leaking water inside a deli cooler. Black substance on warewashing unit caulking, a slow-draining deli handwash sink, and worn uneven basement floor must be repaired. Cracked light shield noted.

headline: Cold meats and tomatoes held too warm
summary: Sliced tomatoes, turkey, roast beef, pepperoni, salami and ham held at 46.4-60.7F; manager voluntarily discarded 20 lbs ($300). No proof of food handler training. Expired allergen certificate and missing allergen training for two employees. Leaking drain pipe under sink.

headline: Blocked handsink; raw meat stored above ready-to-eat food
summary: Kitchen prep handsink was blocked by a garbage can and fries; cleared during inspection. No paper towels there; provided during inspection. Raw beef and lamb stored above ready-to-eat foods; all removed. Several prepared foods lacked proper date labels.

headline: Watermelon held too warm; door gaps
