summary: Sliced watermelon held at 69.4-70.0F on the sales floor; manager voluntarily discarded 10 lbs ($20). Gaps at the bottom of rear and front exterior doors must be sealed. Person in charge must repair the gaps and keep doors tight-fitting.

headline: Ice scoop on rack; dirty walk-in storage racks
summary: Ice scoop stored on drive-thru beverage rack; must be kept in a clean bin. Walk-in cooler storage racks had food and dirt. Right faucet on rear 3-compartment sink sprays when turned on. Floors under and around fryers need cleaning.

headline: Inspection summary not posted for public
summary: Certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate. The previous inspection summary was not posted; a 2022 summary was displayed instead. Management was given today's summary and must post it in public view. Priority citation issued.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: No certified food manager on duty while chicken, coleslaw and mashed potatoes were prepared; manager arrived at 3:00 PM. No food handler training on site. Faucet in poor repair; cardboard on shelving and ice buildup must be cleared.

headline: Missing allergen certificate; bowls not inverted
summary: Bowls and plates were not inverted in the rear food prep area; staff told to invert or cover them. No allergen training certificate on site for a certified food manager. All must take the allergen course and keep records on site.

headline: Ice bin interior needs cleaning
summary: Interior of the ice bin needs cleaning. Staff instructed to remove the ice, clean the bin, and keep it clean at all times.

headline: Three live roaches; pest service required
summary: Three live roaches and several dead ones found. Pest control must service the premises before next week's re-inspection. Bulk containers unlabeled; some food handlers lacked hair restraints, corrected on site. Pipe and hot water knob leaking at sinks.

headline: Dirty floors and expired allergen certificate
summary: Dirt and debris found on floors in corners, under heavy equipment, and around sinks. Manager told to clean and maintain floors. The certified food manager's allergen training certificate has expired and must be renewed.

headline: Items on floor; leaking sink; dusty ceiling
summary: Items stored on the floor in rear prep must be elevated. Torn gasket on tall rear prep cooler. Front bar handsink drains slowly. Dust on ceiling light shields and dirt behind refrigeration units and in liquor storage must be cleaned.

headline: Grease buildup on pipe above broiler
summary: Grease buildup found on a pipe just below the hood system above the broiler. Staff instructed to clean and maintain the area.

headline: No certified manager on site; flies; sewage backup
summary: No certified food manager on site while TCS foods were prepared and served; manager arrived about 30 minutes later. About 10 small flies in bar area. Three-compartment sink floods when one side drains; citation issued.

headline: Foods held over 24 hours without date labels
summary: Salsa, cooked sweet potatoes and pumpkin were held over 24 hours without proper date marking; manager discarded 5 lbs. Repeat violations: no food handler or allergen training records on site. Some containers unlabeled; stained ceiling tiles need repair.

headline: Low-temperature dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine; it must be 50-100 ppm. Unit tagged and held for inspection and may not be used. No paper towels or hand drying device at front prep hand sink; leaking drain pipe needs repair. Food on walk-in cooler floor.

headline: Leaking faucet; customer trash bin has no lid
summary: Leak at the base of the right cold water knob on the 3-compartment sink; must be fixed. Customer restroom trash receptacle has no lid; one with a lid must be provided.

headline: Men's bathroom vent not working; manager training gaps
summary: Mechanical ventilation in men's bathroom was not working at inspection; must be serviced. Two of three managers lack allergen awareness training and must complete it and keep records.

headline: Covered waste cans needed in restrooms
summary: Covered waste cans are needed in the unisex bathrooms. Staff instructed to provide them.

headline: Bar handwashing sink removed; fix required
summary: The bar's handwashing sink was removed and replaced with a two-compartment sink. A separate handwashing sink, or two faucets with a splash guard, must be installed. Washroom placement near food prep and the walk-in cooler also needs solid barriers.

headline: Managers lack allergen training proof
summary: Certified food service sanitation managers had no proof of allergen training on site. Management instructed to meet this requirement for all managers.

headline: Prepackaged foods missing ingredient labels
summary: Prepackaged ready-to-eat salads, soups, sandwiches and meals lack ingredient labels; ingredients must be added. No written procedure for cleaning-in-place equipment such as mixing bowls, grinders and juicer; one must be provided.

headline: Missing thermometer; food stored on floor
summary: Prep cooler is missing a thermometer; one must be provided and maintained. Food containers stored on the floor in the storage area must be raised 6 inches. Floor under and behind cooking equipment has grease and debris; staff told to clean.

headline: No employee health policy; rear door not rodent-proof
summary: No employee health policy on premises; person in charge must provide documentation that employees must report transmissible illness. Rear exit door is not fully rodent-proofed; an additional door sweep must be installed from the inside.

headline: Low-temperature dish machine sanitizing at 0 ppm
summary: Low-temperature dish machine was sanitizing at 0 ppm chlorine; it must sanitize at 50-100 ppm. Priority violation cited. Left-side drain pipe at the 3-compartment sink is leaking and must be repaired.

headline: Food handler and allergen certificates missing
summary: Waitress on duty lacked her food handler certificate; citations will follow if not corrected. City-certified manager lacked allergen training. Must provide and keep proof on site at all times.

headline: No certified manager; ice machine slimy
summary: No person in charge with verifiable food manager training, and no valid certificate on site. Prep handsinks blocked by trash bins. Ice machine interior had black slimy substance; ice must be discarded and machine cleaned. Exterior door has a 1/4-inch gap.

headline: Leaking faucet base at 3-compartment sink
summary: Leaking faucet base at the 3-compartment sink in the rear dishwashing area must be repaired and maintained at all times.

headline: Broken cooler door; sink drains onto bar floor
summary: Prep cooler door does not close without a rag holding it. Torn gasket on another cooler. Bar three-compartment sink drains onto the floor and was tagged; it may not be used until fixed. Milk crates used as shelving must be removed.

headline: Grocery bags used for food storage; no food handler training
summary: Grocery bags are being used to store food in coolers and freezers; food-grade containers must be used. Small leak under a handwash sink in the main prep area. No food handler training for any handler; allergen training missing for certified managers.

headline: Inspection summary not posted for public
summary: Summary from previous inspection was not posted for public view. A new summary was left and management instructed to post it; citation issued.

headline: Brownish residue on drink dispenser; greasy debris
summary: Brownish substance found on the drink dispenser gun and holders; staff instructed to clean and sanitize. Minor food and grease debris behind cooking equipment; instructed to clean.

headline: About 30 rat droppings; more pest control needed
summary: About 30 rat droppings on the basement floor; manager must clean and remove them. Additional pest control service needed. Repeat violations include rusted walk-in shelving, cardboard floor mats and greasy walls. No food handler or allergen training proof.

headline: Walls and ceiling behind freezer need repair
summary: Walls and ceiling behind and above the basement chest freezer need repair to a smooth, cleanable surface. No certified food manager with allergen training; documentation must be provided and kept on premises.

headline: Water on floor near three-compartment sink
summary: Re-inspection passed. Inspector noted water on the floor near the three-compartment sink and asked that floors be kept clean and dry. No other violations were listed.

headline: Missing restroom handwashing signs; ice machine rust
summary: Passed. Customer restroom lacked a handwashing sign. Rust was found inside the ice machine and buildup in a two-door cold unit; both to be fixed.

headline: Hand sink at 60°F; overflowing dumpster; grease spill
summary: Failed. Kitchen prep hand sink water was only 60°F; must be at least 100°F. Employee repaired it during inspection to 101°F; citation issued. Dumpster lids would not close; grease spilled outside. Citations issued.

headline: Mouse droppings, flies; ice machine slime; blocked sink
summary: Failed. About 40 mouse droppings found at bar coolers, under the bar sink, and in rear prep, plus 35–50 small flies. Ice machine panel with black and pink slime touched ice; hand sink blocked by a container. Citations issued.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; unit tagged
summary: Dish machine final rinse reached only 146°F, below the required 180°F. Unit is tagged and may not be used; the three-compartment sink must be used. Citation issued. Also noted: stained cutting boards, torn gasket, leaking faucet.

headline: 25+ rat droppings under indoor patio trailer
summary: Failed. About 25 or more rat droppings found on the ground under the trailer in the indoor patio area; pest control service recommended and citation issued. Also: gap under front door, greasy fryer cabinets, and damaged concrete floor.

headline: Weak hot water at restroom hand sink
summary: Passed. Restroom hand sink faucet had weak hot water pressure. Operator was instructed to provide hot water under city pressure.

headline: Cooler used for hot dogs lacked a thermometer
summary: Inspector saw no thermometer inside the cooler storing hot dogs and cream cheese. Operator was instructed to provide one. No other violations were listed.

headline: 6 live roaches; handsink water only 80–82°F
summary: Failed. Six live roaches were crawling near the cold-holding prep cooler, ice cream freezer, and beverage counter, with several dead ones nearby. Staff restroom hand sinks ran only 80–82°F; 100°F is required. Citations issued; pest control recommended.

headline: Oyster tags missing dates; equipment in mechanical room
summary: Passed with conditions. Shellfish tags lacked dates for when the last oyster was sold or served; citation issued. Multi-use equipment stored in mechanical room, prohibited. Ice scoop touched ice machine exterior. Dim lighting in basement bar area.

headline: Door gap; items stored on floor
summary: Passed. About 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of front entrance doors; operator told to make doors tight-fitting to prevent pest entry. Items stored on floor near trash room and rear storage must be raised at least 6 inches.

headline: Unlabeled food containers; grease and debris buildup
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food items out of original containers lacked name labels, and cardboard lined shelving under hot cooking equipment. Grease and food debris were on cooking equipment, coolers, and shelves; dumpster area had debris.

headline: Noodles at 75–82°F in walk-in; 30 lb discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Six containers of cooked wide rice noodles in walk-in ran 75–82°F, and cooked rice was 45.5°F; about 30 lb discarded ($66). Citation issued. Also: strong odor from kitchen floor drains, and expired allergen certificates.

headline: Prep-line hood not working; rear clutter
summary: Passed. The ventilation hood over the main prep line was not working and must be repaired to prevent grease or condensation on walls and ceilings. Rear hallway had clutter and unused equipment to be removed.

headline: No self-closing washroom doors; loose floor tiles
summary: Re-inspection passed. Washroom doors lacked self-closing devices; management told to install them. Loose floor tiles in the dish area were to be repaired, and untreated drywall beside the high-temperature dish machine to be painted or covered.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge (PIC) held a valid Chicago food sanitation certificate, and no certified manager or posted certificate was on site; citation issued. Candy and chips stored on floor behind front counter.

headline: No allergen training for sanitation manager
summary: Passed. Inspector found no handwashing sign at the main kitchen sink and a sanitation manager on the premises without allergen training. Both were to be provided.

headline: Food stored on floors; bulk containers unlabeled
summary: Passed. Food containers stored on floors in walk-in, prep, and storage areas; manager told to elevate them six inches. Bulk containers lacked names; wiping cloths not kept in sanitizer. Cleaning needed throughout.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No vomit and diarrhea kit or procedure was on site; operator must keep a kit with norovirus-effective sanitizer. No service sink was on site; one must be installed or accessible nearby. Broken thermometer in a reach-in cooler.

headline: Inspection summary not posted; spices unlabeled
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. Latest inspection summary was stored under the counter, not posted for public view; citation issued. Spice containers near the wok station were unlabeled and must be labeled.

headline: Cold foods above 41°F; 5 lb discarded
summary: Service cooler held tuna, eggs, pepperoni, roast beef, cold cuts, and guacamole at 44–50°F, above the 41°F limit. Manager voluntarily discarded 5 lb (about $100). Citation issued. Also: food stored on basement floor, leaking sink faucet, dirty floors.

headline: Flies, rodent droppings found; coolers not working
summary: Failed. About 30 live large black flies were flying in prep areas; 100 small rodent droppings were found near walk-in and shelving; pest control was ordered. Several coolers not working; one still tagged. Prior violations not corrected. Citation issued.

headline: Leak under prep-area handwashing sink
summary: Passed. Re-inspection found a leak below the hand sink in the main prep area. Operator must repair it.

headline: Knife stored improperly on prep table
summary: Passed. Inspector saw a knife stored improperly on a prep table. Staff were instructed on storing utensils between uses in water at 135°F or above.

headline: 307 lb of cold food above 41°F discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Walk-in cooler air was 54.4°F and held food ran 51.4–67.6°F; prep table food also ran high. Manager discarded about 307 lb ($1,000). Citations issued. Food handler and allergen training violations from a previous inspection were not corrected.

headline: Spills and debris throughout; leaking faucet
summary: Passed. Food spills and debris were found on cooking equipment, prep tables, and shelving, plus floors and corners in prep, dish, and storage areas. A hand sink faucet in the kosher kitchen was leaking.

headline: Open drink cup in prep area; ice machine spots
summary: Passed. Open drinking cup on a prep-area table was removed by an employee during inspection. Small black spots were found inside the ice machine; food spills on kitchen floors and under cooking equipment; minor faucet leak.

headline: Hair restraints missing; ice scoop stored improperly
summary: Passed. Three food handlers worked without hair restraints. Ice scoop was stored inside the ice bin. Also noted: missing handwashing signage near front prep sink, and women's restroom timed faucets not working properly.

headline: Dirty coolers and floors; broken glass found
summary: Passed. Inspector noted dried blood on meat cooler floor, debris in other coolers, and greasy cooking equipment. Broken glass sat behind liquor-room shelving. Hole under upstairs hand sink, plus burned-out lights in women's restroom and dusty vents.

headline: 25 mouse droppings in flour storage room
summary: Failed. About 25 mouse droppings on floor and lower shelves of rear dry storage room, where flour is kept. Additional pest control service is needed; citation issued. Also: unlabeled containers and milk crates used as shelving.

headline: Ice bin, freezer interior need cleaning
summary: Passed. Ice bin interior needed cleaning; staff were told to remove ice, clean, and keep it clean. Reach-in freezer interior needed detail cleaning, and missing floor grout in dish/prep area must be repaired.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; thermometers missing
summary: Passed. Rear exit door was not rodent-proof; no thermometers were located in prep-area cooling units. Also noted: food debris on prep tables, fryers, and coolers; grease under frying equipment; dirty toilet fixtures.

headline: Dead insects in light shield; leaking sink
summary: Passed. Dead insects were in a rear-prep light shield; cleaning ordered. Milk crates used as shelving at the bar and rear prep must be replaced with raised shelving. Three-compartment sink in rear prep was leaking.

headline: Suspension sign removed from front door
summary: Failed. The license suspension sign was removed from the front door; management told not to remove or cover it, and a new sign was posted. Prior violations were not corrected: inadequate lighting and no food handler certificates. Citation issued.

headline: Items stored on floor; thermometers needed in coolers
summary: Passed. Food and nonfood items were stored on floors and must be raised six inches. Plastic and milk crates cannot be used for elevation. Operator was told to provide visible thermometers in coolers and fix a leaking drain pipe.

headline: Hand sinks lacked soap and towels; blocked sink
summary: Hand soap missing at prep and bar sinks, corrected on site. Paper towels missing at dish-area sink; a sink was blocked by a scoop and container. Cooked rice and noodles in walk-in lacked date marks. Citation issued.

headline: Debris and spills throughout; timed faucets not working
summary: Passed. Timed faucets in first- and second-floor restrooms were not working. Spills and debris were on cooking equipment, shelves, coolers, floors under equipment, and dish-area walls. Manager was told to clean.

headline: Dirty gaskets, grease filters, expired allergen training
summary: Passed. Inspector noted dirty gaskets on a prep cooler, no covered trash receptacle in the upstairs women's restroom, and grease buildup in hood filters. Certified manager's allergen training had expired; updated training was ordered.

headline: No written employee health policy; missing sink stoppers
summary: Passed with conditions. No written employee health policy was on premises; a priority violation. Exhaust fan openings must be pest-proofed. Also: missing three-compartment sink stoppers, no self-closing washroom door, and wet mops need hanging.

headline: Dog on premises; no certified manager
summary: Failed. Food was prepared without a certified manager or original certificate on site; manager arrived after inspection ended. A prohibited dog was on premises and was removed during inspection. No metal-stem thermometer and no sanitizer test kit; citations issued.

headline: Missing handsinks in two food-prep areas
summary: Passed with conditions. West-side utensil washing and food prep area and far rear fryer area lack convenient handwashing sinks. Operator must install sinks with hot and cold water, soap, and towels. Priority foundation violation.

headline: Food on floor; no food handler training proof
summary: Passed. Bags of onions and buckets of food were stored on the floor in the rear prep area. No proof of food handler training was shown, and some certified managers lacked allergen training proof. Grease buildup on hood and filters.

headline: About 50 mouse droppings; food stored on floor
summary: Failed. Approximately 50 or more mouse droppings found on service counter shelves, floors, a reach-in cooler ledge, and in the toilet room; citation issued. Also: food containers on floor, expired food handler and allergen training. Pest control service recommended.

headline: Stained cutting boards; torn gasket; rusty racks
summary: Passed. Inspector noted stained cutting boards, a torn gasket on a prep cooler, and rust on basement walk-in racks. Also: dirty floors under the dish machine, loose coving, and dusty vents in basement washrooms.

headline: Food handler certificates not provided; debris
summary: Re-inspection passed. No proof of food handler certificates was provided for required employees; must provide and maintain. Also: no ventilation in women's washroom, burnt-out bulbs, inadequate lighting in basement walk-in, and food debris under equipment.

headline: Leaking faucets; dirty floor at drink station
summary: Passed. Three-compartment sink faucet could not turn off and leaked, and the nearby hand sink dripped from its bottom pipes. Heavy soil and debris were on floors at the drink station and service line; manager told to clean.

headline: Leaking faucet base at three-compartment sink
summary: Passed. Re-inspection found a leaking faucet base at the three-compartment sink in the rear prep and dishwashing area. Operator must repair and maintain it.

headline: No certified manager; ice machine slime
summary: Failed. Food handlers handled time- and temperature-controlled foods with no certified manager or original certificate on site; citation issued. Ice machine dripped black and pink slime onto ice. Hand sink lacked soap and towels, supplied on site.

headline: Torn gaskets; liners on rusty shelves
summary: Passed. Multi-use utensils were not stored upside down. A two-door refrigerator had torn door gaskets, and storage shelves had foil and plastic liners over rust. Previous core violation was marked corrected.

headline: Small flies; dish machine held for inspection
summary: Failed. About 20 small flies found in prep, dishwashing, front storage, and bar areas; citation issued; pest control recommended. High-temperature dish machine rinse ran at 118°F; it was tagged held for inspection on site. Handwashing sinks ran 72–96°F; 100°F required.

headline: Rodent infestation: 400 mouse droppings, live roaches
summary: Failed. Rodent infestation: about 400 mouse droppings across kitchen, storage, and beverage areas, plus 4 live roaches and a dead mouse. Pest control service ordered; citation issued. Also: dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer; employee health policies not produced.

headline: No certified manager; hand sink lacked hot water
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken and rice were handled and served. Dish-room hand sink water measured 68°F; manager told to provide 100–120°F. Dish soap dispenser fed only cold water, and a sink stopper was broken.

headline: Spillage in walk-in cooler; dusty stove vents
summary: Passed. Spillage on the floor of the incubator-kitchen walk-in cooler was cleaned on site. Dust was also found on vents above the west kitchen stoves, which inspector asked to be cleaned.

headline: Previous violations not corrected; floor drains dirty
summary: Failed. Violations from the previous inspection were not corrected: wall openings, damaged baseboards, and debris in floor drains. Citation issued. Also: no allergen training for the certified food manager, no covered trash receptacle in women's restroom, gray marks on dish shelving.

headline: Prep cooler too warm; foods above 41°F
summary: Cooked foods on prep table were 48.5–61.7°F, above the 41°F limit. Employees discarded 37 lb (about $200). Prep cooler air ran 50–60°F; it is tagged and may not be used. Citation issued. Also: beard restraints missing, grease buildup.

headline: Dirty floor drain under three-compartment sink
summary: Passed. Inspector found a dirty floor drain under the three-compartment sink in the rear warewashing area. Person in charge was told to clean it and keep it maintained.

headline: Cold food above 41°F; 116 lb discarded
summary: Cold foods held at 48–62°F, above the 41°F limit, including soups, salads, eggs, and dairy. Management discarded 116 lb (about $1,236). Display cooler tagged out of use until repaired. Also noted: food stored on floors, missing hair restraint, damaged floors.

headline: Food stored on floor; hair restraints not worn
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food was stored on walk-in cooler and freezer floors; staff were told to elevate it six inches. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Also: unlabeled bulk containers, a leaking drain pipe, and debris on equipment and walls.

headline: Frozen chicken thawing in plastic container
summary: Passed. Frozen chicken was thawing in a plastic container in the prep area; manager told to thaw food under cold running water, in the refrigerator, or in the microwave. Soiled mop heads were to be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: No employee health policy; no food handler proof
summary: Passed with conditions. No written employee health policy was on premises; priority violation and citation issued. No proof of food handler training was provided. Wiping cloths sat on prep tables and coolers instead of sanitizing solution.

headline: No employee health policy; no allergen certificates
summary: No employee health policy or training was on site, a priority violation. Certified food managers also lacked allergen training certificates. Repairs ordered include walk-in freezer condenser ice, broken gaskets, leaking sinks, and a missing backflow device.

headline: Raw shrimp stored above ready-to-eat foods
summary: Raw shrimp was stored directly above ready-to-eat ceviche and vegetables. Raw shrimp and clams/mussels sat uncovered beside ready-to-eat lettuce and tomatoes. Citation issued. Food handlers lacked required training; ice machine panel had pink residue.

headline: 150–200 mouse droppings; open rodent bait on floors
summary: Failed. About 150–200 mouse droppings found throughout the facility, including food-storage and prep areas, and 4–5 small flies at the rear. Open rodent bait packages sat on floors; citations issued for pests and bait. Pest control was recommended.

headline: Warm beef in walk-in; no certified manager
summary: Passed with conditions. Two containers of beef in walk-in ran 68.9–70°F, above 41°F; manager discarded about 17 lb ($88). No certified food manager with original certificate was on site while open; citation issued. Unlabeled ingredient on rice maker.

headline: Food handler certificates not found; low lighting
summary: Passed. Inspector could not locate or verify food handler certificates and ordered them kept on site. Also noted: low lighting in basement walk-in freezer and upstairs restroom, and foil lining on a grease trap.

headline: Improper thawing; wiping cloths not stored properly
summary: Passed. Meat was thawing in standing water in two sink compartments; staff told to thaw under running water, in cooler, or microwave. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer. Also: dirty floor corners, greasy vent filters.

headline: Sewage backing up from floor drains
summary: Sewage backed up from floor drains in produce and receiving back rooms; deli and bakery drains had standing wastewater. A plumber arrived during the visit. Manager told to clean and sanitize; citation issued. Also: sink leaks, grime buildup, outside clutter.

headline: Rusty prep tables; leaking three-compartment sink
summary: Passed. Prep tables and storage racks had rust; the middle compartment of the three-compartment sink leaked at the pipe. Staff toilet vent had dirt and dust buildup. Instructed to fix and maintain.

headline: Employees didn't wash hands; hot food below 135°F
summary: Failed. Employees handled clean dishes and cutting-board cloths without washing hands or changing gloves; citation issued. Hot-holding food measured 94.6–118.9°F, below 135°F; about 2¼ lb discarded. Hot-holding unit was adjusted to 147.8°F.

headline: Low-temperature dish machine sanitizing at 0 ppm
summary: Passed with conditions. Low-temperature dish machine was sanitizing at 0 ppm chlorine. Manager must repair it so it sanitizes between 50 and 100 ppm. Priority violation noted.

headline: Leaking drink machine water line onto floor
summary: Passed. Water line to the front service-area drink machine was in poor repair and leaking clean water onto the floor. Operator was told to repair or replace it and keep all plumbing in good repair.

headline: Expired allergen training; grease buildup; worn gaskets
summary: Passed. Food manager's allergen training had expired and must be updated. Grease and food debris buildup on equipment, floors, and walls; worn door gaskets; slow drain at women's restroom hand sink; missing handwashing signs in men's restroom.

headline: Door gap, ice machine debris, missing allergen certificate
summary: Re-inspection passed. No pests found, but a 1/4-inch front-door gap could allow pest entry. Also: ice machine debris, missing bar handwashing signs, and no allergen training certificate for a certified manager.

headline: Shrimp thawed in standing water; containers need labels
summary: Passed. Two bags of shrimp were thawing in standing water; manager told to thaw under cold running water or in the walk-in cooler. Bulk containers need lids and names. Also noted: stripped faucet handle, dirty hood and floors.

headline: Rear door has 1/2-inch gap at bottom
summary: Passed. Re-inspection found the rear receiving exit door not rodent-proof, with an opening of about 1/2 inch at the bottom. The door must be made rodent-proof to prevent pest entry.

headline: Pink slime and mold in bar ice machine
summary: Failed. Ice machine in bar area had pink slime and black mold-like substance inside; person in charge told to discard ice, clean, and sanitize. Citation issued. Also: 1/4-inch gap at bar-side exterior door and peeling film on freezer.

headline: Hair restraint missing; torn refrigerator gasket
summary: Re-inspection passed. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint while preparing and serving food. Also: torn gasket on rear food-storage refrigerator, heavy ice buildup in a chest freezer, and cracked floor tiles.

headline: No certified food manager while serving eggs
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while cream cheese and eggs were being served. Operator must have a certified food manager present whenever these foods are prepared and served. Citation issued.

headline: No temperature gauge on dish machine; broken dumpster
summary: Failed. High-temperature dish machine had no temperature gauge. Outside dumpster had broken hinges and would not close. Citations issued for both. Also: no food handler training proof on site; mop positioned so it cannot dry.

headline: Expired food handler training; leaking dish machine pipe
summary: Passed. One employee had expired food handler training, and no allergen training certificates were on site. Water pipe on low-temperature dish machine leaked; wrapped in duct tape over a bowl. Also: missing signs at bar hand sinks and unused equipment.

headline: Bulk flour and sugar unlabeled; no backflow device
summary: Passed. Bulk food items such as flour and sugar were unlabeled. No backflow prevention device at mop sink faucet, and chipping paint by a hand sink in prep area.

headline: Food on floor; no handler certificates on site
summary: Passed. Boxed food on walk-in floor must be elevated six inches. No food handler certificates were on site at inspection. Also: cardboard liners, food debris in cold units, dirty floors, and a toilet-room vent not working.

headline: Non-service dog in café; citation issued
summary: Passed with conditions. A customer with a dog that was not a service animal was seated in the café. Management was told only service animals are allowed inside; citation issued.

headline: Torn gasket on produce walk-in cooler
summary: Passed. Inspector found a torn gasket on the walk-in cooler used to store produce. Operator was told to repair or replace it and keep it in good condition.

headline: Grab-and-go labels missing; sink leak, no hair restraint
summary: Failed. Grab-and-go salads and desserts lacked required labels: business name, address, ingredients, allergen warnings. Certified food manager lacked hair or beard restraint while handling pizzas. Three-compartment sink missing a nozzle and leaking; citation issued. Pizza boxes stored on floor.

headline: No hot water at employee handwashing sink
summary: Failed. Employee washroom hand sink had no hot water, reading 84.5°F; minimum is 100°F. Operator given two days to comply; citation issued. Dust was also found on washroom vent and light shields above food storage.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; food above 41°F
summary: Walk-in air was 47°F; food ran 45–75°F, including eggs, pork, chicken, and shrimp. Manager told to keep them at 41°F or below. Citations issued. Also: missing food handler certificates for several employees; expired allergen training.

headline: No certified manager on site; ice machine slime
summary: Failed. Person in charge (PIC) lacked a Chicago food sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was present while chicken at 164.1°F was prepared and served; citation issued. Pink and black slime found inside ice machine; citation issued.

headline: Missing handwashing signs at restroom sinks
summary: Passed. Inspector found no handwashing signs at restroom hand sinks throughout the facility. Operator was told to provide and maintain signs.

headline: Handwashing signs needed in lower-level restrooms
summary: Passed. Handwashing signage was required for all lower-level restrooms, for both employees and customers.

headline: Wet mop left in bucket; told to hang
summary: Passed. Inspector saw a wet mop stored in a bucket in the rear kitchen and instructed staff to hang mops to dry when not in use.

headline: No sanitizer or food thermometer on site
summary: Failed. Missing sanitizer for dishes, a food thermometer, test strips, and pest-control records. No handwashing sink near the three-compartment sink; manager instructed to install one. Citations issued for several items. Also: leaking pipe under sink, no allergen-trained manager.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; chicken left uncovered
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine, so it was not sanitizing; staff told not to use it until fixed. Four containers of cooling chicken were not fully covered, and a sauce pot sat on the floor. Citation issued.

headline: Poor lighting inside walk-in cooler
summary: Passed. Inspector found inadequate lighting inside the walk-in cooler and instructed the operator to provide adequate light and maintain it.

headline: Food debris on floors in rear prep area
summary: Passed. Food debris was on floors in the rear prep and dry storage area; operator must clean it.

headline: Mouse droppings found; cleanup kit incomplete
summary: Failed. About 30 mouse droppings in rear storage and 5 in the bathroom; rear exterior door has bottom damage allowing rodent entry. Vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit lacked absorbent powder. Citations issued for pests and kit.

headline: Missing food handler certificates; no allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Several employees lacked food handler certificates, and the certified food manager had no allergen training certificate; management was told to provide proof. Also: stained cutting board and light fixtures lacking protective shields.

headline: Utensil handles touching food in display coolers
summary: Passed. Utensils and scoops were stored with handles touching food in display coolers; manager told to store handles outside contents. A faucet at the front prep handsink leaked but the sink still worked.

headline: About 80 mouse droppings; raw sewage backing up
summary: Approximately 80 mouse droppings found in the rear storage room; citation issued. Raw sewage backed up from restroom floor drains and mop sink; citation issued. Rear door gap and damaged door sweep noted. Also: debris outside, water-damaged ceiling tiles.

headline: Prior grease violation not corrected; citation issued
summary: Failed. Grease spills on the floor under cooking equipment were a repeat violation from a prior inspection and were not corrected. Must clean and maintain; citation issued.

headline: Employee washroom door lacks self-closer
summary: No self-closing device on the employee washroom door near the kitchen. Operator instructed to install one.

headline: Pastries on floor; peeling paint near fan
summary: No handwashing sign at the front service counter sink. Two bags of pastries stored on the floor near the basement entrance; operator told not to store food on the floor. Slight debris on top of a deli prep cooler. Paint peeling around a fan in the staff toilet room.

headline: Raw wood, tinfoil liners, sink sprayer repair
summary: Mixing bowls must be stored inverted. Raw wooden pallets may not be used for elevated storage in the South Bar. Raw wood shelving must be sealed. Tape used to repair the three-compartment sink sprayer; must be repaired properly. Certified managers need allergen proof.

headline: Fly strips and hair restraints corrected on site
summary: Fly strips in the prep area; operator instructed on proper placement, corrected on site. Food handlers without hair restraints; instructed to provide and maintain them, corrected on site. Floor corners and ceiling vents need cleaning.

headline: Employee lacked food handler certificate
summary: A food handling employee had no food handler certificate. Management instructed that all food handlers must show proof of training.

headline: West bathroom has no hand sink; under review
summary: West customer bathroom has no hand sink with hot and cold water; manager is awaiting delivery. Priority violation: bathroom tagged and must stay closed until a sink is installed and rechecked by CDPH (Chicago Department of Public Health). Other upkeep items noted.

headline: Dirty cooking equipment, coolers, and toilet
summary: Cooking equipment needs cleaning to remove grease and food spills. Interior of reach-in freezers and coolers need cleaning. Toilet room fixtures dirty; toilet seat in poor repair. Unnecessary articles in the storage area must be removed.

headline: Truck missing license number on sides
summary: License number missing from both lateral sides of the truck. Operator instructed to provide and maintain it.

headline: Handsink floods; too few food handler certificates
summary: Handwashing sink unusable; running it floods the floor. Only 2 valid food handler certificates for more than 2 employees. Allergen certificate missing for the manager. Previous violations not corrected; priority violation, citation issued.

headline: Cooling failure; no health policy; no vomit kit
summary: About 30 lbs cooked chicken cooling at room temperature (85-95°F); employee discarded it. No employee health policy on site. Missing vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies, soap at a handsink, and a basement handsink. Pest control logbook missing; citation issued.

headline: Food in tin cans; dirty cooler and hood
summary: Food stored in tin cans in the walk-in cooler, and heavy ice buildup inside it. Restroom trash cans had no lids. Ceiling fans dirty, and heavy grease in exhaust hood and filters. Operator told to fix each item.

headline: Uncertified manager on site during food prep
summary: Food service manager on site without a valid City of Chicago certification while beef, chicken, rice, and other ready-to-eat foods were prepared; citation issued. Loose faucet head at the handsink next to the three-compartment sink; must be repaired.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; dirty floors
summary: Bulk flour and rice containers lack labels; must be labeled with common name. Cups, plates, and pans in rear storage not inverted after sanitizing. Food debris and dirt on floors under cooking equipment, along walls, and in corners.

headline: No pest log; door and dumpster gaps
summary: No pest control log on site. Front door has a 1-inch gap that is not rodent-proofed, and the outside dumpster is missing two lids. Citations issued. Floor under storage shelving needs cleaning.

headline: Sticks and clutter outside and in storage
summary: Piles of sticks between the gate and building, near the dumpster; must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Unused equipment and clutter in rear storage closet must be removed; kept items must sit six inches off the ground.

headline: Ice scoop stored in ice; no thermometer
summary: Ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine, touching ice. No irreversible thermometer was on site. Citation issued for the missing thermometer. Operator told to store the scoop outside the ice and provide one.

headline: Pests, unsafe food temperatures, raw meat mix-up
summary: Over 100 live fruit flies on walls of the sandwich prep room. Cooked foods held at room temperature at 45.5-108°F; about 100 lbs discarded. Raw duck and beef on the same cutting board; about 10 lbs discarded. Citations issued.

headline: Stacks of soda crates in rear storage
summary: Stacks of black soda crates in rear storage. Operator instructed to remove them to prevent space where pests or insects could harbor.

headline: No backflow devices on three machines
summary: No backflow prevention devices found at the ice machine, espresso machine, or drip coffee machine. Operator must provide them where they can be located and serviced.

headline: Front door gap; shelves and walk-ins need cleaning
summary: Front entrance door not fully rodent-proofed on the right side; operator told to seal the opening. Shelves, walk-in cooler and freezer interiors, and prep table shelves need cleaning. Walk-in floors also need cleaning.

headline: Walk-in cooler light out
summary: Light bulb out in the walk-in cooler. Operator instructed to replace it and maintain it.

headline: No health policy; gap under back door
summary: No written employee health policy on premises; priority violation, citation issued. Half-inch gap under the rear exit door; all outer openings must be sealed. Food debris in prep cooler, prep tables, and deep fryer; walls, floors, and drains need cleaning.

headline: Burnt bulbs over cook line; debris on hood
summary: No handwashing signs at two exposed handsinks. Two burnt-out bulbs in the hood over the cook line. Debris on the hood and heavy dust on a vent in the employee toilet room. Summary report not posted; a new one was left, and citation issued.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets and meat cutter debris
summary: Torn gaskets on both walk-in cooler doors and food debris on a rear meat cutter. Operator told to repair, replace, and clean.

headline: Live roaches in basement prep area; citation
summary: About 6 live roaches seen, including roach activity on the basement prep area ceiling by the handsink. Citation issued. Operator told to consult pest control before re-inspection. Unlabeled containers, food in plastic bags, and greasy kitchen surfaces also noted.

headline: Rear doors propped open; floors need repair
summary: Rear entrance and exit doors were wide open during inspection; operator told to enclose outer openings. Floors in disrepair with exposed concrete. Floors and outdoor cage area had feathers, blood, and chicken waste; cleaning required.

headline: Missing handwash sign; no cooler thermometers
summary: No handwashing sign at the to-go prep station sink; must install. Reach-in and display coolers lack ambient air thermometers. Frozen food stored in plastic grocery bags; food-grade bags and containers required.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; greasy hood filters
summary: No handwashing signage at the front bar handsink or in the guest and employee washrooms; must provide. Bulk food containers in the kitchen lack labels. Ventilation hood filters have grease buildup; increase cleaning frequency.

headline: Bar dish machine not sanitizing; citation
summary: Low-temperature dish machine in the bar washed at 101°F, below the required 120°F, and was not sanitizing properly. Operator told to repair it and use the three-compartment sink meanwhile. Citation issued. Dusty walls; one of two certified managers lacks allergen training.

headline: No soap, sanitizer test strips, or thermometer
summary: All 7 handsinks lacked soap; priority violation. Handsinks also lack handwashing signs. Dish machine had no sanitizer test chemicals; no stem thermometer or test strips on site. Raw food consumer advisory missing from the menu.

headline: About 20 live flies in butcher and prep areas
summary: About 20 large live flies found in the butcher and rear prep areas. Citation issued. Person in charge told to remove flies and request pest control service. No outside grease receptacle, and holes in a basement wall.

headline: Rodent droppings; no certified manager on site
summary: 12 rodent droppings in the basement boiler room; citation issued. Cream cheese held at 48°F, above the 41°F limit; 8 lbs discarded. No certified food manager present when food was prepared; arrived about 1 hour later. No backflow device at sink.

headline: No certified food manager during TCS food
summary: No certified food service manager on site while TCS foods were handled and served; priority foundation violation 7-38-012 noted. No sink stoppers for the three-compartment sink, a minor leak at its bottom, and a large hole in a kitchen window screen.

headline: Rust, peeling paint, and peeling duct tape
summary: Rust on shelving in the walk-in cooler and near a handwashing sink. Peeling paint on the rear prep ceiling and around the rear exit door. Peeling tape on ducts above the three-compartment sink. Operator told to fix each.

headline: Gap under back door; food near handsink
summary: 1/4-inch gap under the rear exterior door; operator told to repair. Toppings stored near the front handsink; a partition is required. Boxes stored on the floor in the front storage closet must be raised six inches.

headline: Cheese and sauce too warm; food discarded
summary: Cheese at 46.5°F and tomato sauce at 46°F in a cooler; 7 lbs ($30) voluntarily discarded. Food prep cooler at 50°F with TCS foods inside; must hold at 41°F or below. Priority violation; citation issued. Food stored in grocery bags.

headline: Mouse droppings and no sanitation certificate
summary: About 80 mouse droppings in the rear storage area, behind a freezer, on shelving, and on lids; citation issued. No valid City of Chicago sanitation certificate on site while chicken and gyro (TCS foods) were prepared; citation issued. Flour container unlabeled.

headline: Soiled wipes on prep table; greasy fryers
summary: Soiled wiping cloths stored on top of a prep table; must be kept in sanitizing solution between uses. Dried food debris inside a two-door cooling unit. Heavy grease and dried food under fryers and grill; must be removed.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; freezer ice buildup
summary: No handwashing signs near sinks in the front and rear prep areas or in both toilet rooms. Ice buildup inside the front chest freezer. Grease and food debris inside the deep fryer. Operator told to correct and maintain.

headline: Rat droppings and live roaches; citation issued
summary: Over 20 rat droppings in basement storage and 5 live cockroaches on the basement floor, plus dead insects in traps. Citation issued for an uncorrected pest violation; pest activity must be eliminated. Also plumbing leaks, a broken restroom, and grease buildup.

headline: Dish machine leaking; no food handler proof
summary: Leak from the dish machine onto the floor; must be repaired and the floor kept dry. Excessive grease on the west cook line wall. No proof of food handler training or certificates on site. No allergen proof for certified managers.

headline: No hot water at rear handsink; citation issued
summary: No hot water at the rear dish-area handsink; water measured about 40.8°F, but must be at least 100°F. Priority violation; citation issued. Also missing covered waste receptacle in the unisex washroom, and old food debris and spills under the soda dispenser.

headline: No certified food manager during TCS food
summary: No certified food service manager on site while TCS foods (foods needing hot or cold holding, such as milk) were handled and served. Operator instructed to obtain one. Priority foundation violation 7-38-012.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: Certified food manager has no food allergen training. Manager was instructed to comply with the requirement.

headline: No certified food manager during food prep
summary: No person in charge with a valid Chicago food sanitation certificate, and no certified food manager on duty while TCS foods (foods needing hot or cold holding) were prepared and served. Citation issued. Menu lacked the raw-food advisory; handout given.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies; drain leak
summary: Supplies for vomit and diarrhea cleanup, including norovirus-effective disinfectant, not on premises; priority violation. Openings at the front entrance double doors must be sealed. Water leaking from the three-compartment sink drainpipe; must repair.

headline: Roast beef and eggs too warm; discarded
summary: Roast beef at 49.7°F and eggs at 46.8°F in the sandwich prep cooler, above the 41°F limit. Person in charge discarded all improper TCS foods, about 10 lbs ($50). Three-compartment sink leaks when drained; citation issued. Soiled mop heads not stored properly.

headline: Soiled wipes, cardboard liner, grease buildup
summary: Soiled wiping cloths stored on prep tables; must be kept in sanitizing solution. Ice scoop lying on ice in the basement; handle must be stored up. Heavy grease and dirt on walls, floors, and cooking equipment; one burnt-out bulb in the prep area.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; unit tagged
summary: Walk-in cooler ran at an improper temperature; no TCS foods were inside. Unit tagged; must be repaired to 41°F or below. Use the two-door unit in main prep for TCS foods until repaired. Priority violation; citation issued. Food handler lacked a hair restraint.

headline: Repeat pest log violation; no hair restraints
summary: Food handlers prepped food without hair restraints. Prior pest control logbook violation was not corrected; now a priority item that must be fixed before re-inspection. Citation issued. Inspection summary not posted; reach-in coolers and floors need cleaning.

headline: Live cockroaches on floor and equipment
summary: About 5 live large cockroaches on prep area floor and equipment; previous pest violation not corrected. Citation issued. Pest control service recommended; pest activity must be eliminated. Also slow-draining handsink and gasket disrepair.

headline: No handwashing signs; rust in ice machine
summary: No handwashing signage in the customer restroom; required at all handsinks. Rust on interior screws of the ice machine; must be removed and replaced. Buildup inside a two-door cold holding unit in the rear; must be cleaned.

headline: About 100 live flies; citation issued
summary: About 100 live small flying insects on walls, floor, and ceiling of the basement and food prep area. Additional pest control needed; citation issued. Food handler lacked a hair restraint and a food handler certificate. Basement ceiling has spiderwebs.

headline: No health policy or food handler certificates
summary: No verifiable employee health policy or food handler certificates on site. Rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap to seal. Missing splash guard at prep handsink. No proof of a waste disposal contract. Soiled mop heads not stored properly.

headline: Food on cooler floor; tin foil liners
summary: Food containers stored on the walk-in cooler floor; must be raised at least six inches. Tin foil used as cooking equipment liner and cardboard as floor liner; both not allowed. Floors near the utility sink and under shelving need detail cleaning.

headline: Leaky pipe under three-compartment sink
summary: Leaky pipe under the three-compartment sink; must repair and maintain.

headline: Ice bin needs cleaning; cutting boards damaged
summary: Ice bin interior is not clean; must remove ice, clean, and sanitize. Cutting boards with deep cuts and stains; clean, restore, or replace. Leak at the service bar handsink; must repair. Items stored on the floor in storage areas must be elevated.

headline: Porous brick behind bar; broken washroom fan
summary: Uneven, porous raw brick behind the bar at the beer taps, with splashing stains; must be sealed. Mechanical ventilation in the south washroom is inoperable; must repair or replace.

headline: 50-60 live flies; citation issued
summary: 50-60 live small flies in rear dry storage and washroom area; must be eliminated. Priority violation; citation issued. Handwashing sinks in the dish and rear areas leak when in use. No food handler certificates on site. Soiled mop heads not stored properly.

headline: One certified manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: One certified food manager is missing an allergen training certificate. Operator instructed that all certified food managers must provide them.

headline: Employee bags stored in mop sink
summary: Employee bags stored in the mop sink. Operator instructed to store personal items in a designated area.

headline: Fly strips in prep; reused butter containers
summary: Fly strips hanging in the prep area; must remove and use proper insect control devices. Single-use butter containers reused to store food in coolers; prohibited. Missing labels, and multi-use equipment stored on the floor.

headline: Cracked floor tiles and water-stained ceiling
summary: Worn caulking around the toilet room sink. No backflow device on the mop sink. Cracked floor tiles in the front of the store. Water-stained ceiling tiles in front of the rear toilet room. Operator told to fix each item.

headline: Prep cooler door held shut with a rag
summary: Door on the main prep cooler does not close; a rag is holding it in place. Must be repaired. Small leak at the pipe below the rear handsink and a small leak at the dish machine when running; both must be repaired.

headline: Large leak and standing water in basement
summary: Large leak from a pipe and standing water throughout the basement. No food is stored there; must repair. Broken, unused non-commercial dishwasher in the prep area must be removed. Two of three food employees lacked food handler training.

headline: Over 30 rat droppings; handsink blocked
summary: Over 30 rat droppings in basement storage. Front handsink was blocked by containers and not accessible; citation issued. Employees ate in the prep area, food was stored on the floor, and hair restraints were missing. Operator told to call an exterminator.

headline: Walk-in cooler light out; mop sink cluttered
summary: Walk-in cooler light not working properly; manager must provide a working bulb inside the cooler. Mop sink interior is cluttered and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Heavy grease in exhaust hood and filters
summary: Dirt and grease buildup inside, on pipes, and at edges of the exhaust hood and filters above cooking equipment. Operator instructed to detail clean and maintain them.

headline: Black substance dripping onto ice
summary: Black substance inside the ice machine dripping onto ice used for consumption. Ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned; citation issued. Also no pest control logbook with a current service report, and no metal stem thermometer.

headline: Rusted shelves and greasy grill area
summary: Rusted shelves in the rear cold holding unit. Grease and grime on shelving, the grill table, and the grill. Excess clutter of non-essential items in the prep area. Grease buildup on filters above the grill. Person in charge told to clean, repair, or organize.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; greasy exhaust hood
summary: Torn door gaskets on the kitchen 2 stand-up cooler; operator told to replace them. Kitchen exhaust hood and filters have excessive grease buildup; operator told to detail clean and maintain.

headline: 30 live flies in storage; citation issued
summary: About 30 live flies on walls, ceiling, and boxes in rear storage; 20 more in the mop sink area; citation issued. Interior screen door has 1/4-inch gaps. Damp mops left on the floor and in buckets; must hang to air-dry.

headline: Deep freezers and floors need cleaning
summary: Interior of deep freezers in rear storage must be cleaned to remove debris. Floors need cleaning behind front kitchen cooking equipment and in the rear walk-in coolers to remove spills, debris, and grease.

headline: Black slime in ice machine used for cooling
summary: Heavy black slime inside the ice machine used only for cooling; must be detail cleaned. Grease on a used cooking oil container and the ground in the rear garbage area. Food debris in floor grates in front of the high-temperature dish machine.

headline: Food on walk-in floors; foil and cardboard liners
summary: Food items stored on walk-in cooler and freezer floors; must be elevated six inches. Foil and cardboard used as shelf liners; must be removed. Dust on washroom fan; grease and debris on floors under equipment. Unnecessary items in washroom must be removed.

headline: No handwashing sign; dirty floors; no allergen training
summary: No handwashing sign at a hand sink; must provide. Floors under the three-compartment sink area are not clean; must clean. Sanitation manager has no allergen training; must provide.

headline: Milk crates as shelving; burnt-out lights
summary: Milk crates used as shelving in the basement walk-in cooler and freezer; must replace with shelving six inches off the floor. No covered receptacle in the basement employee toilet room. Burnt-out bulbs and poor lighting noted.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proofed; dirty ice machine
summary: Rear exit door is not rodent-proofed, with light showing at the bottom. Ice machine interior needs cleaning to remove buildup. Utensils must be in a holder, not between containers. Can opener blade and rear storage floors need cleaning.

headline: Repeat violations unfixed; citation issued
summary: Continued noncompliance from 2023: no covered toilet receptacle, no allergen training certificate, and food debris on the floor around the wok station. Citation issued. Also a 1/4-inch gap under the garage overhead door; bulk containers unlabeled.

headline: Leaking drain pipe at bar sink
summary: Leak from the drainpipe of the three-compartment sink at the bar; operator told to repair it. Rust-colored staining on the kitchen floor around the grease trap of the three-compartment sink; operator told to clean.

headline: Loose debris and dust on floors
summary: Loose debris, dirt, and dust built up on floors and corners throughout the facility. Operator told to detail clean and increase floor cleaning frequency, and to keep floors clean at all times.

headline: Utensils in cold holding; foil under tables
summary: Spoons and scoops stored inside cold holding food; must be removed and sanitized when not in use. Foil under prep table bottoms must be removed; foil and cardboard not allowed on food contact surfaces. Food residue on shelving in the walk-in cooler.

headline: Cold-holding unit at 56°F; food discarded
summary: Cold-holding unit at 56.3°F; all TCS foods inside discarded and unit tagged for CDPH re-inspection. Sliced tomatoes 50.4°F, spinach 52.7°F, lettuce 51.2°F; 3 lbs ($35) discarded. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Rodent droppings and slimy ice machine
summary: About 80 mouse and 20 rat droppings in the basement prep area. More pest control needed; citation issued. Ice machine had black slime dripping onto ice for consumption. Missing paper towels and soap at sinks were obtained during inspection.

headline: Beard restraint missing; boxes on floor
summary: Male food handler was not wearing a beard restraint; operator told to provide one. Boxes of single-service utensils stored on the basement floor; operator told to elevate them off the floor.

headline: Food handler and manager lack certificates
summary: A food handler lacked a valid food handler certificate. A certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate. Management instructed that all food handlers must show valid proof of training.

headline: Rat droppings and no certified manager
summary: About 20 rat droppings behind fryers; citation issued and more pest service needed. No certified food manager on duty during TCS food prep; citation issued. Hot water at sinks was 57-59°F; corrected on site to 102-105°F. Food handler certificates missing.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; grease behind dish machine
summary: Torn gasket on a two-door prep cooler across from the dish machine; must replace. Dust, food debris, and grease on the wall behind the low-temperature dish machine and prep area; must clean.

headline: Live roaches in dish area; citation issued
summary: About 5-6 live roaches found: one over the hand sink, about 5 behind a reach-in cooler. Citation issued. Pest service required, with proof on site, before the March 12, 2025 re-inspection.

headline: Unsafe food temperatures and 10 live roaches
summary: Fried egg at 78.6°F, sliced beef at 64.5°F, and sliced tomato at 58.6°F, all above the 41°F limit for cold-held food. Manager discarded 15 lbs (about $250). About 10 live roaches in rear prep and basement. Citation issued.

headline: Missing splash guards; rusty shelving
summary: Splash guards missing between the three-compartment sink and handsink in the dish area, and at the bar handsink next to the ice bin and drainboard; must be installed. Rust on shelving in the walk-in cooler; must be removed and replaced with corrosion-resistant material.

headline: Ice maker backflow device not found
summary: Backflow prevention device for the ice maker could not be located. Operator instructed to expose it.

headline: No health policy; manager smoked in prep
summary: No employee health policy on site; citation issued. Certified food manager smoked in the food prep area; citation issued as a second offense. Handsinks lacked hand-drying supplies and soap, provided during inspection. Also unlabeled chemicals and dirty cooking equipment.

headline: No health policy; holes by sink and driver's door
summary: No employee health policy on site; priority violation. No written procedure or supplies for vomit and diarrhea events. Small holes leading outside near the handsink, and the driver's door is not tight-fitting; must be rodent-proofed.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods handled
summary: No certified food manager on site while eggs, milk, and other TCS foods were handled; citation issued. Person in charge lacks a Chicago sanitation certificate. Pest control logbook missing again, a repeat violation; citation issued. Other upkeep items noted.

headline: No hot running water; fixed during inspection
summary: No hot running water on the premises; temperatures ranged 89.2-95.2°F. Corrected on site: 120°F at the three-compartment sink and 107.2°F at the prep handsink before inspection ended. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Leaking soda drip pan; dirty sinks and floors
summary: Drip pan at the drive-thru soda machine is leaking. Person in charge says a replacement was ordered from Pepsi. Standing water in the drive-thru beverage area was corrected during inspection. Sinks, floors, and drains need cleaning.

headline: Dog allowed inside; no certified manager certificate
summary: A dog was in the facility for at least 10 minutes while a customer waited for an order; manager did not ask it to leave. Citation issued. No City of Chicago certified food manager certificate posted. No maintained pest control logbook. Citation issued.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; front door gap
summary: No cleanup procedure or supplies for vomit and diarrhea events; priority violation, must provide. Gap at the bottom of the front entry door must be made tight-fitting. Also wet mop hooks needed, plus grout, tile, and baseboard repairs.

headline: Used wet wiping cloths left on surfaces
summary: Used wet wiping cloths on cutting boards and prep tables; must be held in sanitizing solution between uses. Milk crates may not be used for elevating stored items. Broken cabinet under women's restroom handsink must be replaced.

headline: Greasy floors and burnt-out walk-in lights
summary: Buildup was found on kitchen floors under cooking equipment. Burnt-out bulbs were found in the walk-in freezer and walk-in cooler. Staff were instructed to clean and replace them. Passed.

headline: Espresso machine lacks backflow device
summary: The espresso machine in the front bar had no backflow prevention device. A basement employee bathroom door lacked a working self-closing mechanism. The manager was instructed to fix both. Passed.

headline: No hand sink in juice prep area
summary: The front juicing and drink prep area had no handwashing sink; one with hot and cold water must be installed (priority; citation issued). Food was stored in the furnace room. Utensils were not inverted, and the restroom trash can lacked a lid. Failed.

headline: Door gaps; grease and ice buildup
summary: Gaps under both front entry doors and the rear door must be sealed against rodents. Rust on grease trap lid, cardboard on grill shelf, and a worn cutting board. Grease on fryer cabinets and ice in the walk-in freezer. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; cutting board scratched
summary: No handwashing sign was posted at the exposed sink in rear prep. A cutting board had deep scratches and stains. Food debris was on the floor behind cooking equipment in rear prep. Passed.

headline: Door gaps; heavy grease on cooking equipment
summary: Rear loading door and small bar side door have about 1/4-inch gaps that need repair against pests. Heavy grease was on the stove, fryers, floor drains and under equipment. Walk-in shelving is rusting. Leaks and a missing light shield were noted. Passed.

headline: Unlabeled flour, salt and sugar containers
summary: Bulk flour, salt and sugar containers had no labels; they must be labeled with contents. The all-gender washrooms lacked covered receptacles for sanitary napkins. Passed.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and splash guard
summary: There were no handwashing signs near the front coffee-area sink. The front exposed sink had no splash guard. The rear utility mop sink had no backflow device. All must be provided and maintained. Passed.

headline: Faucet leak; unshielded lights; clutter
summary: A water leak was at the base of the right faucet at the 4-compartment sink. Rear storage needs cleaning, clutter removed, and items at least six inches off the floor. Light bulbs over the food prep area lack protective shields. Passed.

headline: No employee health policy; damaged dumpster lids
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site (priority; citation issued). The dish area had no exposed handwashing sink. Bar sinks lacked splash guards. A toilet was out of order. Dumpster lids were damaged or missing (citation issued). Failed.

headline: Handwashing sign on dump sink
summary: A handwashing sign was posted at the dump sink in the upstairs loft bar. Signs should only be posted at handwashing sinks. Passed.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; tagged out
summary: The low-temperature warewashing unit sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine and is tagged. It must not be used until repaired and reinspected; the three-compartment sink is used instead. A handwash sink needs cleaning and a basement gap needs closing. Passed with conditions.

headline: Missing employee health and vomit cleanup policies
summary: No signed employee health policy and no written procedure for vomiting or diarrhea cleanup were on site. Both were priority violations; no citation was issued. Staff were told to provide them.

headline: Dusty filters above rear stove
summary: Filters above the stove in the rear must be cleaned to remove dust and debris. Passed.

headline: Greasy stove; loose faucets
summary: The stove top and equipment sides had food debris and grease, and the business was told to clean and maintain them. Faucets are loose at the bar three-compartment sink and in the women's restroom. Passed.

headline: No certified manager; rodent droppings found
summary: No certified food manager was on site while beans were prepared (priority; citation issued). About 40 rodent droppings were in prep, under sinks and in dining areas (citation issued). A prep cooler at 48F was tagged. Failed.

headline: Mouse droppings and live flies; no hand soap
summary: About 15 mouse droppings were on shelves and floors near the electrical panel. About 30 or more live small flies were in prep and toilet rooms. Hand sinks lacked soap and drying towels. About 11 lbs of unapproved ready-to-eat food was discarded. Failed; citation issued.

headline: Unfinished wood shelf in rear prep
summary: Unfinished wood on the rear prep shelving unit must be finished so it is smooth and easy to clean. The person in charge was told to fix it. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; not to be used
summary: The dish machine did not sanitize or reach a 180F final rinse, and it may not be used until approved by CDPH (priority; no citation). A garage door has a gap, and utensils were not inverted. Sink stoppers and a temperature device were missing. Some prep lights were burnt out. Failed.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; allergen certificate
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at prep-area and toilet-room sinks. The City sanitation manager had no allergen training certificate. Both were instructed to be fixed. Passed.

headline: Handwashing supplies missing; unsafe vacuum sealing
summary: The front prep handwashing sink had no soap and no towels; towels were supplied on site. Food was vacuum-sealed beyond the 48-hour rule without an approved plan, and the product was removed. A utility sink backflow leaks and needs repair. Passed with conditions.

headline: No certified manager; cold fish unsafe
summary: No certified sanitation manager was on site while fish and chicken were prepared (citation issued). About 134 lbs of cold food at 45-49F was discarded ($1,300). A handwashing sink was blocked, and sanitizer test strips were missing. Failed.

headline: Dirty ice machine guard; basement debris
summary: The interior guard of the ice machine had dirt and was not clean. Debris lay on the floor and along the walls throughout the basement warewashing area. The person in charge was told to clean and maintain. Passed.

headline: Dirty floors, shelves, and thermometers missing
summary: The ice machine interior lip needs cleaning. Walk-in and prep cooler shelving need cleaning. Working thermometers must be provided in walk-in coolers, prep coolers and hot-holding units. Floors and drains are dirty and must be cleaned to prevent pests. Passed.

headline: Handwashing sink blocked; water shut off
summary: The rear prep handwashing sink lacked cleanser and towels; both were provided by the end of the inspection. Boxes blocked the sink and the water was off; the owner turned it on and moved the boxes (citation issued). Wiping cloths were on prep tables; pots were not inverted. Passed with conditions.

headline: No accessible handwashing sink; rust and gaps
summary: No easily accessible handwashing sink for employees at the front bar and three-compartment sink. A new sink must be installed (priority; citation issued). Rusted shelves and tables, a torn cooler gasket, a hole in the wall, and a dead exhaust light. Failed.

headline: Over 1,000 mouse droppings; cold food unsafe
summary: Over 1,000 mouse droppings were found on shelves, floors and under equipment; pest control is required (priority; citation issued). About 25 lbs of cold food at 47-61F was discarded. A refrigerator at 69.9F was tagged. Health policy and training were missing. Failed.

headline: Overflowing dumpster; no food handler certificates
summary: Outside dumpster lids were not closed because trash was overflowing (priority; citation issued). No food handler certificates were on site. The sanitation manager lacked allergen training. Coolers lacked ambient air thermometers. Failed.

headline: Black slime in ice machines; torn gaskets
summary: Black slime was found inside both basement ice machines that make ice for people (priority; citation issued). Torn gaskets were on three coolers. One hood light was burnt out. Passed with conditions.

headline: Unlabeled condiments; rear door gap
summary: Condiments were stored in unlabeled containers. The rear entrance door has a 1/4 to 1/2 inch gap at the bottom. Milk crates, cardboard matting, duct tape and foil liners are not allowed. Expired allergen certificates were replaced on site. Passed.

headline: Missing food handler training; beard restraints
summary: Multiple food handlers lacked food handler training, and proof must be kept on site. Two handlers with beards had no beard restraints. Storage cabinet, prep cooler gaskets, walk-in and dining wall need cleaning. Passed.

headline: Hot food held too cool; about 14 lb discarded
summary: Roasted chicken, nuggets and fried chicken sandwiches were held at 115-125F in an open hot-holding unit. Food must stay at 135F or above. The manager immediately discarded about 14 lb. Leaking faucet and dirty basement floors also noted. Failed; citation issued.

headline: No health policy; no dish-area hand sink
summary: No signed employee health policy was shown (citation issued). The dish area has no handwashing sink. Food handler and allergen training were missing. Previous violations were not corrected, including greasy fryers and torn cooler gaskets (citation issued). Failed.

headline: No vomit procedure; toilet sink lacks supplies
summary: No written vomit and diarrhea procedure or supplies were on site (priority). The toilet-room sink had no soap or towels and held only 73F water. No signed dumpster contract and no dumpster on site (priority). Failed.

headline: Shellstock tag missing sold-by date
summary: A 90-day shellstock tag lacked the last date sold or served (priority violation; citation issued). Algae was found in live lobster and fish tanks. Drains had grease and debris, and the wok hood had heavy grease. Failed.

headline: Missing backflow device at utility sink
summary: The utility sink in the rear prep area and the basement had no backflow prevention device. Staff were told to install one so it can be located, serviced and maintained. Passed.

headline: No food guard; basement ceiling missing
summary: There was no food guard between the popsicle maker and the three-compartment sink. A section of the basement packaging-area ceiling is missing. Both must be provided or fixed. Passed.

headline: Dead roaches and gaps under doors
summary: Two dead roaches were found near the three-compartment sink and in a bin under a prep table. Gaps under the front-left and rear doors allow rodent entry. Other issues include leaky pipe, stained ceiling tiles, and no food handler training. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Dead cockroaches; hand sink misuse; door gap
summary: A food employee rinsed utensils in the front handwashing sink (priority; citation issued). About 5 dead cockroaches were found under shelves in basement storage. A door gap over 1/4 inch sits by the outdoor waste area. Plastic cups are used as scoops. Passed with conditions.

headline: Cases stored on floor; trash bag in bread crumbs
summary: Soda and water cases were stored on the floor near the front line and in an aisle. They must be raised at least six inches. A plastic garbage bag was inside a bread crumb container. Cutting boards had open seams and stains. Passed.

headline: Loose lid knobs; washroom door not self-closing
summary: Cooler lid knobs at the kitchen prep area are loose and missing, and need repair. The rear food prep area bathroom door is not self-closing and must get a closing device. Passed.

headline: Rusty shelves; floor cracks; undercooked advisory
summary: Rusty, dirty shelves are in a two-door unit and produce walk-in. Restroom door is not self-closing. Floor cracks and fans need repair. Undercooked-food advisory violation from a prior inspection was not corrected (citation issued). Passed with conditions.

headline: Toilet room door not self-closing
summary: The toilet room door is not self-closing. It must be repaired and maintained as required. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Broken ice maker blocks handwashing sink
summary: A large broken ice maker was placed in front of the main prep handwashing sink, blocking access. The manager could not move it during the inspection. This is a priority violation. Failed.

headline: No health policy; undercooked-food advisory missing
summary: No employee health policy was provided for review (priority; citation issued). The breakfast menu lacked the required advisory for items such as sunny-side-up eggs (priority). Bulk dry storage containers lacked labels. Failed.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; small flies present
summary: The bar low-temperature dish machine had no sanitizer and was corrected on site and tagged (priority). About 20 small flies were in the facility. Pest control was recommended (citation issued). Bar sink water at 100.3F is below the required minimum. Failed.

headline: No handwashing signs; personal items on prep table
summary: The restroom had no handwashing signs; the business was told to provide them. Employees' personal items were stored on a food prep table and must be removed. Passed.

headline: Food thermometer off by 10 degrees
summary: A probe food thermometer read about 10 degrees off. The manager was told to calibrate it often (priority). Chipped plastic food containers were reused. The walk-in cooler had dark corners and needs more lights. Passed with conditions.

headline: Food debris in prep coolers; grease on hood
summary: Accumulated food debris is inside prep-area reach-in coolers, and condensers have dust. Both washrooms lack covered trash receptacles. Dry storage floor has food debris. Grease and food buildup are on the ventilation hood and filters. Passed.

headline: No certified manager; no front hand sink
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS food was prepared (citation issued). Front service area with food and money had no handwashing sink (citation issued). Sandwiches dated 06/30 to 08/30 were in a cooler; about 20 lbs ($85) discarded. Failed.

headline: No utility sink; no covered receptacle
summary: No utility sink was on site. One must be installed with hot and cold running water and a backflow device. The washroom lacked a covered receptacle, and the water heater room floor had debris. Passed.

headline: Hand sinks double as dump sinks
summary: Several handwashing sinks were also used as dump sinks, with a dump sink directly below each one. Staff must use handwashing sinks only for handwashing, and the dump sink must be removed. Priority violation; no citation. Failed.

headline: Cooked-to-order animal foods lack menu advisory
