summary: Some animal-derived foods served cooked to order were not marked with an asterisk, and the menu lacked a disclosure. Unwrapped utensils in the self-serve area were not presented by handles. Leaking drain pipes under the dish sink. Failed.

headline: Ice buildup in rear deep freezer
summary: Ice had built up inside the rear deep freezer and must be defrosted and cleaned. Storage shelving, prep tables and kitchen ledges need debris and spills removed. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Rodent droppings, live flies, undated chicken
summary: About 70 rodent droppings were found in storage rooms, equipment and prep areas. About 40 live flies moved through prep. The rear door was not rodent-proof. About 300 lbs of cooked chicken had no date labels. Failed; citation issued.

headline: Cold food at 46-49F; expired food handler cards
summary: Several cold foods were held at 46-49F, and several pounds were discarded ($200). A cooler at 51F was tagged. An outside grease container lid does not close. Some food handlers had expired certificates (citation issued). Failed.

headline: Hand-washing lapses and unsafe cold and hot holding
summary: An employee handled dirty and clean dishes without washing hands; corrected on site. Cooked rice at 89F and 96F, cooked foods at 44.5-48.7F, and cooler air at 48.9-51F were found. Food was discarded. No hot water at dish-room sink. Failed.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; unapproved vacuum sealing
summary: Handwashing sinks had no signage. The menu had no advisory for raw or undercooked foods. Vacuum sealing lacked an approved plan, and about 13 lbs of sealed food was discarded. The machine was tagged. Failed; citation issued.

headline: Dust on sushi cooler fan cover
summary: Dust had built up on the fan cover inside the two-door sushi prep cooler. It must be cleaned and maintained. Passed.

headline: Rear door gap and stored unused items
summary: The rear exit door is not fully rodent-proof. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom must be sealed. Unused equipment and unnecessary items in the storage area must be removed to prevent pest hiding places. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: No person in charge; no certified manager
summary: No person in charge was on site. No certified food manager was on site while tofu and eggs were prepared; one arrived at 2:10 PM (citation issued). No employee health policy and no vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit (citation issued). Passed with conditions.

headline: Employee eating at prep line; unlabeled food
summary: An employee was seen eating in the prep area and was told to stop. Some food was stored out of original containers without labels. Soiled wiping cloths sat on prep tables. Grease and debris were on equipment. Passed.

headline: Coolers need thermometers; cleaning needed
summary: All reach-in coolers need thermometers. Wiping cloths and utensils must be stored in sanitizer when not in use. Cutting boards, cooking equipment, cooler interiors, storage floors and hood filters need cleaning. Passed.

headline: Rusted racks; slippery floors; stained tiles
summary: Walk-in cooler racks and floors are rusted and must be restored. Floors are very slippery with food debris, and toilet-room ceiling tiles are stained. Toilet-room ventilation has heavy dust. No proof of food handler training was on site. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Dusty restroom ventilation fan
summary: The restroom's mechanical ventilation fan had heavy dust buildup. It must be cleaned and maintained. Passed.

headline: Bare-hand food contact; dead roaches
summary: A food handler touched egg rolls with bare hands after frying (priority; citation issued); about 4 lbs discarded. About 30 lbs of raw chicken were held at 49-52F and discarded. Shellstock lacked a tag. Dead roaches were found in several areas. Failed.

headline: Spills and grease behind cooking equipment
summary: The self-serve pop machine and counter need detail cleaning to remove spills and debris. Walls and pipes behind cooking equipment have grease and dust. Floors and floor drains need detail cleaning. All noted items are cleaning issues. Passed.

headline: Unlabeled bulk ingredients; greasy fryer
summary: Working ingredients removed from packaging were stored in unlabeled bulk containers. Cooling units in the prep area had food residue. The fryer had grease and food debris inside and out. Passed.

headline: No hot water at employee sinks; cold food unsafe
summary: Women's employee bathroom sinks had 66.1F water; they must provide at least 100F (priority; citation issued). Cold food at 53-56F was discarded, about 20 lbs. A prep cooler at 60.1F was tagged. Milk crates used as shelves; outside dumpster lids broken. Failed.

headline: Expired allergen certificate; repeat core violations
summary: The certified food manager's allergen certificate had expired. Earlier core violations were not corrected: plastic grocery bags were used for frozen meat, and the employee washroom lacked a covered waste receptacle and self-closing door. Citation issued. Fail.

headline: Employees eating at prep area; shellfish untagged
summary: Employees were drinking and eating at the kitchen prep area; a designated break area must be provided. Shellfish in the walk-in and prep cooler had no tags; about 10 lbs ($27) were discarded (citation issued). Hood and filters have heavy grease. Passed with conditions.

headline: Fly strips and zapper in prep areas
summary: Fly strips and a zapper must be removed from prep areas and proper monitoring devices provided. Front double door has gaps. Worn gasket on sandwich cooler, no sink stoppers, and missing food handler training. Floor tiles and walls need repair. Passed.

headline: Hair restraints, rust, leaks, and cleaning
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer. Walk-in racks are rusty. Front hand sink and a three-compartment sink leak. The toilet room needs cleaning. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Wiping cloths in weak sanitizer; cooler door
summary: Wiping cloths were stored in a bucket without adequate sanitizer. The walk-in cooler door does not properly latch. The women's restroom had no covered waste receptacle. Passed.

headline: No certified manager; sushi logs inaccurate
summary: No valid City certified food manager was on site while raw salmon was served (priority; citation issued). Sushi rice logs were filled out without monitoring critical control points (priority; citation issued). Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer. No allergen certification. Failed.

headline: Pink mold in ice machine; rusty shelves
summary: Pink mold-like buildup was found inside an ice machine. The ice is not used for people. Seafood walk-in shelving was heavily rusted. Floor tile was missing near prep thresholds. The person in charge was told to clean and repair. Passed.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit or written procedure
summary: No vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit and no written procedures were on site. The unisex restroom had no covered receptacle for feminine hygiene products. Management was instructed to provide both. Passed with conditions.

headline: Rodent droppings, flies, and sink problems
summary: About 30 rodent droppings were found in the food prep area. About 25 live small flies were near fruit prep (citation issued). One of four handwashing sinks did not run water. The dish machine's final rinse gauge reads 150-170F; manager's test showed 180F (citation issued). Failed.

headline: No mechanical ventilation in toilet room
summary: The toilet room has no mechanical ventilation. The owner must provide it. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: No pest logbook; no service sink on site
summary: No pest control logbook was available; the manager was told to provide one. There is no service sink on site, and must be installed. A soiled mop head was not hung to prevent insect breeding. Failed.

headline: Dump sink lacks cold water; undercooked-food notice missing
summary: The bar dump sink had no cold water and was missing its faucet. Leaks were found at a hose and the dish machine. Eggs, smoked salmon and burgers can be ordered undercooked, but the menu lacked the required advisory. A repeat violation. Failed.

headline: Mold-like buildup in ice machine
summary: Pink and black mold-like buildup was dripping into ice for people (citation issued). Ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned. Excess rust was above the compartment sink. The certified manager had no allergen training. Failed.

headline: Torn gaskets, grime, and vent fan not working
summary: A prep cooler door gasket is torn. Deep fryers, prep tables, grill, cooler and freezer interiors need cleaning. The basement had clutter. The hood had grease, and the washroom fan was not working. Passed.

headline: No certified manager during hamburger service
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager was present while hamburgers and hot dogs were being prepared and served (priority; citation issued). Management was told a certified manager must be present at all times while these foods are prepared or served. Passed with conditions.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; no food handler training
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were found in prep, storage, cooler and washroom areas. An exterminator was required (priority; citation issued). Two male employees had no food handler training. Also: no backflow device or hot water at the utility sink. Failed.

headline: Missing drain stoppers; grease trap not found
summary: The rear three-compartment sink needs three working drain stoppers. A grease trap for the utensil sink could not be located. Basement storage floors and walls need cleaning. A certified manager lacked allergen training. Passed.

headline: Thermometer placement; utensils in water
summary: The refrigerator thermometer is kept at the back of the cooler; staff were told to keep it in the warmest part. Spoons were kept in room-temperature water; staff were told to follow the health code. Passed.

headline: Undated cooked foods; grimy prep room
summary: Ready-to-eat cooked beef, beans and chicken in the walk-in were not date-marked (priority). Two of three compartment sinks lacked hot water (100-105F, minimum 110F); one may not be used until repaired (citation issued). Carnitas room had heavy grease and dirt. Passed with conditions.

headline: Washroom door and ceiling tile repairs needed
summary: The washroom door had no self-closing device. Drop ceiling tiles were missing in places. A small wood floor section behind the serving counter needs tile. Passed.

headline: Dirty floors behind equipment; cracked tiles
summary: Caulking around the mop sink needs replacement. Floors under and behind cooking equipment have dirt and grime. Cracked and broken floor tiles in the food prep area must be replaced. Passed.

headline: No hand sign; no food handler certificates
summary: The rear prep sink had no handwashing sign. Some coolers lacked thermometers. One food handler had no hair restraint. Raw wooden shelves need sealing, and the rear prep floor and walls need cleaning. No food handler certificates were on the premises. Passed.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm sanitizer while in use
summary: The bar low-temperature dish machine showed no sanitizer at final rinse and was still in use; the manager was told to fix it (priority). No variance or plan for vacuum-packed foods; machine tagged. Unlabeled salt and no hair restraint. Passed with conditions.

headline: No City sanitation manager certificate
summary: The person in charge had no City of Chicago sanitation manager certificate while chicken and beef were handled (citation issued). A handler lacked a hair restraint. An outside dumpster lid was missing (citation issued). The sanitation manager lacked allergen training. Failed.

headline: Prep cooler at 69.7F tagged
summary: A three-door prep cooler measured 69.7F and was tagged; it must not be used until repaired. No food was inside. Bulk containers lacked labels, and basement clutter must be removed. The certified manager had no allergen training. Passed with conditions.

headline: Improper thawing; rodent sticky trap on shelf
summary: Chicken was thawing in standing water. Raw packaged beef sat on a warewashing sink drainboard. A large rodent sticky trap was on a shelf by food prep. Soap dispenser was in poor condition. Cooking-area floors needed cleaning. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Single-use items on floor; dusty facility
summary: Single-use items were stored on the dining-area floor next to a restroom and must be elevated. Food was kept in plastic totes in the freezer. The restroom had no covered sanitary napkin receptacle. Floors had dust buildup. Passed.

headline: Uncovered food; ice drain into hand sink
summary: Food in walk-in and prep coolers was left uncovered. The ice machine drain empties into the prep-area handwashing sink and must be rerouted to city plumbing. A huge hole in the rear prep wall must be sealed. Dumpster lids were not tight (citation issued). Passed with conditions.

headline: Knives stored behind display case
summary: Knives were stored between the meat display case and the wall. Cutting boards in the meat prep area were stained with deep, dark grooves. Passed.

headline: Dish machines at 0 ppm; front door gap
summary: Two low-temperature dish machines showed 0 ppm chlorine and were tagged; both must be repaired. A 1/4-inch front door gap allows pest entry. Missing ceiling tiles, moldy caulk, and a unisex restroom lacks a trash lid. Passed with conditions.

headline: Water-damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Water-damaged ceiling tiles were found above the rear utility sink area. They must be replaced and maintained. Passed.

headline: Freezers under water pipes; wiping cloths
summary: Short complaint passed. Several basement box freezers stored under water piping; must remove freezers or properly encase piping. Cook line wiping cloths must be held in sanitizing solution between uses.

headline: Torn rodent strip; greasy fryer
summary: Canvass passed. Torn rodent-proof strip at bottom of rear door; must repair. Inside of cooking fryer has heavy grease buildup; must clean and maintain.

headline: Fail: about 50 mouse droppings
summary: Re-inspection failed. About 50 mouse droppings throughout facility, including near cold units and in the lobby; citation issued. About 15–20 dead small flies in a drink cooler. Hood not working; sink stoppers missing; clutter.

headline: Inadequate lighting in rear prep area
summary: Re-inspection passed. Lighting in the rear prep area was inadequate. Instructed to increase lighting.

headline: No certified manager during chicken, egg prep
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager on site while chicken, eggs, and cut fruit were prepared; citation issued. Rear prep hand sink blocked by trash and ingredients. Dirty wiping cloths and missing ceiling tiles.

headline: Missing hand-wash signs and cooler thermometers
summary: License inspection passed. Hand-washing signs needed at all hand sinks. Reach-in coolers need thermometers visible at all times. Person in charge instructed to install and maintain them.

headline: Grease and grime on equipment, vents, and floors
summary: Re-inspection passed. Grease and food buildup on cooking equipment, prep tables, shelving, vents, hood, and floors. Leak in a basement pipe. Manager instructed to clean and repair.

headline: Food worker without hair restraint
summary: Passed. A food employee was preparing food without a hair restraint. Management instructed that all food employees must wear one during food preparation.

headline: Fail: scoop handles in food; overhead lights, filters
summary: Canvass failed. No handwashing sign at front coffee sink. Scoop handles in contact with food in dry storage bins. Overhead lights unshielded, one out, and filters heavily soiled. Manager lacks allergen training. Several prior violations not corrected.

headline: Fail: no food service certificate posted
summary: Canvass failed. No city sanitation certificate posted or valid documentation; certified manager must be on premises when food is prepared; citation issued. No handwashing sign at hand sink; no self-closing washroom door; manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Gaps at rear door; damaged freezer gasket
summary: Failed. Openings at the base of the rear exit door could allow pest entry; instructed to seal. Also a damaged walk-in freezer door gasket, a leaking three-compartment sink, and dirty drains and hood filters.

headline: Dead roaches in basement; leaking bar sink
summary: Failed. Three-compartment sink at the bar leaks when draining; citation issued. Several dead cockroaches on the basement floor; must detail clean. Unused equipment and clutter in storage area to be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Cold food at 45°F; cooler fluctuating
summary: Pass with conditions. Food held at 45°F, above 41°F limit; manager discarded mozzarella and cooked onions. Cooler under griddle fluctuated between 45°F and 48°F; tagged; citation issued. Also taped freezer lid and no sink drain plugs.

headline: No certified manager; no backflow device
summary: Pass with conditions. Person in charge lacks city food service manager certificate; citation issued. Torn gaskets on rear two-door cooler; no backflow device at utility sink; no self-closing washroom door; dust on vents.

headline: Clogged hand sink; leaking garbage compactor
summary: Canvass failed. Hand sink at deli prep clogged, water not draining; citation issued. Outside garbage compactor leaking liquid food waste onto ground; citation issued. Torn walk-in gasket; dirty floors and display cooler vents.

headline: Fail: no handwashing signs; no test kit
summary: Canvass failed. No handwashing signage at hand sinks; no chemical test kit for sanitizer; citation issued. Debris on equipment and in seating area, a light out near hood, no covered sanitary receptacle, and a food handler without certificate.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; ice and grease buildup
summary: License inspection passed. Bulk containers in rear storage not labeled. Ice buildup in walk-in freezer; no stoppers for three-compartment sink. Food debris on carts, coolers, and freezers; grease on prep and storage floors.

headline: No irreversible temperature indicator
summary: Failed. High-temperature dish machine has no irreversible temperature indicator to measure utensil surface temperature during hot water sanitizing; must provide and maintain; citation issued.

headline: Uncovered food; soiled cloths; leaks
summary: Canvass passed. Open coffee cups in prep area; bulk containers uncovered; food on walk-in cooler floor; soiled wiping cloths; deep-grooved cutting boards; grease buildup; leaking toilet and faucets; no backflow device.

headline: Sanitizer at 0 ppm; food timing records lacking
summary: Pass with conditions. Low-temperature dish machine in use with 0 ppm sanitizer; tagged, citation issued. Sushi on conveyor belt lacked time labels and a dated log; about 10 lbs discarded. Sticky insect trap stored above liquid containers.

headline: Utensils stored with contact surfaces exposed
summary: Canvass passed. Utensils and whisks stored with food-contact surfaces exposed on rear shelf; manager told to invert them. Heavily soiled cooler with food debris and fries. Loose trash and broken boxes on alcohol closet floor.

headline: Grease buildup near deep fryer
summary: Canvass passed. Grease and food debris on the deep fryer, the prep table, and the prep cooler beside it. Grease buildup on the floor beneath the fryer. Instructed to clean.

headline: Loading dock garbage receptacle lacks cover
summary: Re-inspection passed. No cover on garbage receptacles at the loading dock. Must provide covers.

headline: Drinks stored on floor; dirty floors
summary: Canvass passed. Bulk containers need labels. Drinks stored on floor under liquor counter; must elevate. Floors need cleaning along wall bases, in corners, under dishwasher, and under drink station.

headline: No certified manager during burger, deli prep
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager on site while burgers, deli sandwiches, and sliced tomatoes were prepared; citation issued. Also a food handler without hair restraint and without training certificate, and grease buildup.

headline: Slow drains; dirty hood filters
summary: Complaint passed. Bulk containers unlabeled in basement storage. Dishmachine handwash sink drains slowly and must drain quickly. Food buildup on hood filters in first-floor dishwash room; must clean.

headline: Frozen meat stored in grocery bags
summary: Canvass passed. Frozen meat stored in plastic grocery bags in the freezer; management told to use food-grade bags and containers only. Leaking faucet at three-compartment sink; excess grease on grease trap.

headline: Stained and damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Re-inspection passed. Stained ceiling tiles with food spillage and damaged ceiling tiles. Instructed to clean and repair or replace them.

headline: No certified manager while chicken, burgers prepared
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on site while chicken and burgers, which must be kept hot or cold, were prepared; citation issued. No paper towels at hand sinks, an inaccessible dish-room hand sink, and missing training certificates.

headline: Missing hand-wash signage; worn cooler gasket
summary: Canvass passed. Hand-washing signage needed in the west-side toilet room. Worn, broken gasket on lower three-door cooler. Cooking equipment sides need detail cleaning; grease and debris on basement and cooking-area floors.

headline: Leaking hot-water faucet at three-compartment sink
summary: Passed. Hot water knob and faucet at the three-compartment sink leak and have pinholes; must repair. Floors need cleaning along wall bases and in corners to remove spills and debris.

headline: Uncovered ice bin; torn cooler gaskets
summary: Canvass passed. Ice in bar bin uncovered; must provide lid. Torn gaskets on two-door cooler in rear prep. Heavy dust on restroom vent fans. Wet mop stored in bucket; instructed to hang mops. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Fail: live roaches and cold foods too warm
summary: Failed. About 8 live roaches seen behind a freezer and on a chest freezer; pest control recommended. Cooked chicken, steak, onions, and peppers held at 77°F to 118.5°F; about 23 lbs discarded. No vomit cleanup policy or supplies.

headline: No health policy; no vomit cleanup supplies
summary: Failed. No written employee health policy, and no vomit or diarrhea procedures or supplies on site. Food handlers lack proof of training; manager lacks allergen training. Also a leaking drain and no backflow device.

headline: Missing backflow device; debris on floors
summary: Canvass passed. No backflow preventer on the rear utility sink; must install so it can be serviced. Loose debris, dirt, and dust on floors and corners throughout; instructed to detail clean and increase cleaning frequency.

headline: Fail: no signed health policy; no hand sink
summary: Failed. No signed employee health policies or written vomit and diarrhea procedure on site. No hand sink in bar prep area; must install with hot water, soap, and towels. Low-temp dish machine at 0 ppm sanitizer. Leaks and wall damage.

headline: Improperly stored mop; dirty floor corners
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Mop not stored hanging to air dry. Floor corners and areas under heavy equipment had spider webs, dirt, and debris. Instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Pink slime in ice machine; unsafe containers
summary: Failed. Pink slime buildup inside ice machine used for human ice; instructed to remove ice, clean, and sanitize; citation issued. Gravy and pancake mix stored in old sour cream containers; must use food-grade only. Broken cooler stored in warewashing area.

headline: No valid certified manager during food prep
summary: Pass with conditions. No valid certified manager on site while ground beef and cheese sauce were prepared; no valid sanitation certificate posted; citation issued. Also dirty coolers, ice buildup, damaged tiles, and untrained employee.

headline: Dirty floors at rear stairway
summary: Complaint passed. Loose debris, dirt, food stains, and dust on floors and corners at the rear stairway to the trash area. Instructed to detail clean and increase cleaning frequency.

headline: Missing food handler training certificates
summary: Complaint inspection failed. Torn gasket on prep cooler behind sushi bar. No chlorine test strips for low-temperature dish machine; citation issued. Food handler training certificates must be provided for all food handlers.

headline: Hand sink blocked; no soap or paper towels
summary: Pass with conditions. Exposed rear prep hand sink blocked by a pitcher, can opener, and other items; no soap; no paper towels; citation issued. Food debris inside deli slicer; instructed to clean.

headline: Foil liners, damaged floors, chipped paint
summary: Canvass passed. Aluminum foil used as liner on prep equipment and tables; instructed to remove. Damaged concrete floor and stairs; chipped paint; 2-inch wall hole; loose faucet; dust on fans and vents.

headline: No allergen certificate for food manager
summary: Canvass passed. Food service manager has no allergen certificate on site. Instructed to obtain one.

headline: Missing thermometers; gasket and cleaning issues
summary: Canvass passed. Thermometers needed inside reach-in coolers; broken cooler door gasket; cutting board needs replacing. Certified manager lacks allergen training. Debris around dumpster; dirty floors and drains behind cooking equipment.

headline: Missing hand-wash signs; ice scoops stored in ice
summary: Complaint passed. No hand-washing signs near front bar or restroom hand sinks; must provide. Ice scoops stored inside the ice machine; must store in a clean container to prevent contamination.

headline: No certified manager during cooked food prep
summary: Pass with conditions. Person in charge lacks certificate; no certified manager or posted certificate while cooked chicken, steak, and soups were prepared; citation issued. No written employee health policy; citation issued.

headline: Cutting board needs refinishing
summary: Canvass passed. Cutting board at the sandwich prep station must be refinished or replaced.

headline: Cold handwash water; about 80 small flies
summary: Re-inspection failed. Restroom handwash sinks at 55.2–58.6°F; must reach 100°F; corrected on site with tags. About 80 small flies in prep, storage, and dishwashing areas; citation issued. Non-working sink and leaking drain pipe.

headline: Expired allergen training for some managers
summary: Canvass passed. Expired allergen training for some City of Chicago food managers. Management instructed that all must complete allergen training.

headline: No service sink; no manager allergen training
summary: License re-inspection passed. No service sink in rear prep area; must install. Walls above three-compartment sink and restroom hand sink damaged; must repair to smooth, cleanable surfaces. No manager allergen training on site.

headline: Debris, chipped paint, and uncovered trash
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Spillage, dust, and food debris on counters, storage cabinets, and cooler vents; ice buildup in ice cream freezer. Trash cans on sales floor need lids. Chipping paint. Some food handler training missing.

headline: Missing thermometer, labels, and allergen certificate
summary: Pass with conditions. No thermometer in food prep cooling unit; no labels on condiment bottles; wiping cloth stored improperly; no light cover in public washroom; no allergen certificate posted. Repeat vent cover violation; citation issued.

headline: Door gaps, torn gasket, dim lighting
summary: Canvass passed. Gaps at bottom of front revolving door and rear storage door; must be tight to prevent pest entry. Torn gasket on prep cooler; rusted racks; dirty floors and corners; dim walk-in cooler light.

headline: Missing floor tiles and water-stained ceiling
summary: Canvass passed. Missing or damaged floor tiles in front of the Pepsi cooler, behind the front counter, and in the rear prep area. Water-stained ceiling in front of the store. Instructed to fix and maintain.

headline: Hand-washing lapse; about 20 flying insects
summary: Failed. Employee handled clean dishes after dirty ones without washing hands; manager corrected on site. Dish-room sink water measured 133.4°F, above the 100–120°F range; corrected. About 20 live small flying insects at front bar.

headline: Undated shellstock; cold foods too warm
summary: Pass with conditions. Shellstock tags from June–August 2025 lacked last-sold dates; citation issued. Cold foods held at 43.9–66.4°F, above the 41°F limit; about 256 lbs discarded. Cooler repairs confirmed on 8/15/2025 re-inspection.

headline: Fail: no hot water; wastewater spilling
summary: Canvass failed. No hot running water at front prep, rear prep, and dishwashing hand sinks; measured 89.9°F and 81.7°F; must provide at least 100°F. Wastewater spilling from drains under serving line and behind fryer; citation issued.

headline: Fail: hand sink has no water; no certificates
summary: Failed. Hand sink in front of walk-in cooler has no running water; must repair. No paper towels at front hot prep hand sink. Unlabeled food containers; soiled mop heads not hung. No food handler certificates; manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No signed employee health policies
summary: Pass with conditions. No signed employee health policies; citation issued. Also a worn cutting board, crates used for storage in coolers and freezer, food debris on shelving, a leaky sink stopper, and debris along floors and wall bases.

headline: Fish thawed in wrapper; pest devices need fixing
summary: Complaint passed. Fish was thawing in its original wrapper; instructed to remove it. Pest boxes overturned and not functioning; insect light devices need new bulbs and glue boards. Cutting boards deeply cut; floors and cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Rusty racks; unnecessary items; wall holes
summary: License inspection passed. Rusty metal racks in walk-in cooler must be cleaned, repainted, or replaced. Cutting board with deep seams on prep cooler. Remove unnecessary propane tank and table to prevent pest harborage. Seal wall holes.

headline: Dusty ceiling vents in prep areas
summary: License inspection passed. Dust buildup on ceiling vents in the front and rear prep areas. Person in charge instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Food handlers and manager lack training proof
summary: Re-inspection passed. Several food handling employees lacked food handler training certificates. Certified food manager lacked valid allergen training certificate. Management instructed that all must show valid proof.

headline: Unlabeled bottles; missing hair restraints
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Two unlabeled squirt bottles on prep cooler. Two female food handlers without hair restraints. Spoons and spatulas not inverted. Leaks under rear hand sink and three-compartment sink.

headline: Rear door gap; dead insects on prep floor
summary: Canvass passed. Quarter-inch gap at rear exit door sweep; must rodent-proof. Food debris and dead insects on prep floor under and around equipment; must detail clean. Leaking three-compartment sink faucet.

headline: Kitchen floor debris buildup
summary: Canvass passed. Floor throughout kitchen has debris buildup. Instructed to clean.

headline: Moldy fruit in cooler; discarded; citation issued
summary: Pass with conditions. About 34½ lbs of berries in produce cooler showed fuzzy white, gray, and green mold; person in charge voluntarily discarded them; citation issued. Also fish thawing in sink and missing hair restraints.

headline: Raw and cooked food held above 41°F
summary: Pass with conditions. Italian sausage (47.1°F), raw beef (51.5°F), and cooked spaghetti (51.2°F) held above 41°F in the front prep cold unit; manager discarded 18 lbs. Also wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces.

headline: Missing hand sink, soap, and towels
summary: Failed. No hand sink in the backstage washroom; sinks lack soap, paper towels, and signage. No sanitizer for dishes, no metal stem thermometer, coolers not turned on, and gaps under exit doors. No pest control log.

headline: Food debris in deli slicer; grease under oven
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Built-up food debris in the plastic area of the deli ham slicer; instructed to remove the plastic and clean and sanitize the slicer. Grease debris under oven in prepared food area; instructed to clean.

headline: Food on floors; dead insects in equipment buildup
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food stored on floors in basement walk-in and prep areas; single-service items on floor; no covered toilet room receptacles. Flour, grease, dead insects, and dirt buildup on equipment and shelving; detail clean.

headline: Fail: no sanitizer, flies, and no hot water
summary: Failed. Dish machine at 0 ppm sanitizer; corrected on site. Cold food at 46.9–64.9°F; about 31 lbs discarded. About 15 small flies in storage room; revolving door has gaps. No hot water at sinks; restored on site before inspection ended.

headline: No lidded receptacle; grease on floors
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. No lidded receptacle for feminine products in women's toilet room; must provide and maintain. Grease spillage on floors behind deep fryers; must clean.

headline: Shelves and floors need cleaning
summary: Canvass passed. Storage shelves have food spills and floors throughout have debris. Instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Dish machines not sanitizing; food too warm
summary: Failed. Two dish machines tagged: low-temp had 0 ppm sanitizer; high-temp reached only 140°F. Employee cafe foods held too warm or cold (eggs 82.6°F); about 9 lbs discarded. Also 450 lbs of vacuum-sealed food discarded for missing logs.

headline: Fail: about 75 mouse droppings, live flies
summary: Failed. About 75 mouse droppings on floors, vents, and behind refrigerators; 10 live small flies on rear storage ceiling. Additional pest control needed; citation issued. Also torn cooler gasket and loose flooring.

headline: Cold foods above 41°F; 10 lbs discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Hummus (45.3°F), pineapple (52.3°F), cheese (50.1°F), and Mediterranean salad (50.8°F) held above 41°F at front serving line; manager discarded about 10 lbs; citation issued. Managers lack allergen training.

headline: Fail: about 15 live small flies on ceiling
summary: Canvass failed. About 15 live small flies on ceilings of food prep areas. Must eliminate flies, clean and sanitize affected areas, and contact pest control. Citation issued.

headline: No food handler certificates available
summary: License inspection passed. No food handler certificates available for review; a sanitation manager lacks allergen training certificate. Also no hand-wash sign at rear sink, food debris on buckets, and clutter in utility closet.

headline: Fail: no sanitizer, cooler at 70°F, no soap
summary: Failed. No signed employee health policy or vomit cleanup supplies; no hand soap, paper towels, or dish sanitizer. Three-door prep cooler at 70°F air temperature; must repair below 41°F. Half-inch gap at rear exit door; manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Uncovered cooked food; gap at rear door
summary: Canvass passed. Cooked food uncovered in walk-in cooler; must cover. Rear door has a gap at bottom right corner; must be repaired. Black tape used to repair a chest freezer; rust on walk-in shelving.

headline: No metal thermometer; pest log incomplete
summary: Canvass failed. No metal stem thermometer on site; citation issued. Pest control log incomplete: last service August 2023, with none for 2020–2022. Pest service must occur at least twice yearly; citation issued.

headline: Food containers stored directly on floors
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Food containers stored on floors in prep, storage, and walk-in cooler and freezer areas. Must provide raised shelving so containers sit 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Hand sink used as eye wash station
summary: Failed. Eyewash station hooked to a hand sink near dishwashing, and the sink was also used for eye washing. Manager told to use it only for hand washing; citation issued. Soda and ice machine buildup, dirty kitchen floors and walls.

headline: No hand-wash sign; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Missing hand-washing sign at the bar sink. Milk crates used as shelving in prep and storage; must replace with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: No manager on site; ice machine heavily soiled
summary: Failed. No person in charge present and no sanitation certificate while handling chicken and deli meat; citation issued. No employee health policy. Ice machine interior coated in black and grey slime; citation issued.

headline: Food stored on floor; greasy equipment
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Food stored on floor in walk-in freezer; torn freezer gasket. Grime and food debris in cold holding units; grease on cooking equipment and hoods. Blankets and clothes stored on rear storage floor.

headline: Dead insects and debris on equipment and shelving
summary: Passed. Dead insects, flour, dust, grease, and dirt buildup on cooking equipment, racks, and shelving; instructed to detail clean. Also no thermometer in the dairy cooler and uncovered food in walk-in coolers.

headline: Dirty floors behind bar
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Dirt buildup on floors behind the bar area. Person in charge instructed to clean the floors and maintain them.

headline: Uncovered egg rolls; leak under sink
summary: Short complaint passed. Egg rolls uncovered in walk-in cooler; must cover. Buildup inside ice machine door. Leak under three-compartment sink piping. Peeling paint and wall damage in washroom; instructed to repair.

headline: Food debris; dirty vents; burned-out bulbs
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Food debris and spills throughout; detail clean under shelving, prep coolers, prep tables, and fryers. Three burned-out bulbs in hood. Dust and grease encrusted on mechanical vent in dish area.

headline: Gap under rear door; leaks; broken floor tiles
summary: Canvass passed. Half-inch opening at bottom of rear side door must be rodent-proofed. Ice scoops stored on ice bin and in ice machine. Boxes of liquor on floors. Leaks at sinks; broken tiles; peeling ceiling paint; basement clutter.

headline: Employee clothing on dry food shelves
summary: Passed. Employee clothing was placed on dry food storage shelves. Instructed to keep it away from food storage.

headline: Fail: slimy ice machine; torn gaskets
summary: Failed. Black slimy substance inside ice machine water parts, dripping into ice used by people; citation issued. Manager without hair restraint. Torn cooler gaskets. One food handler with expired certificate; manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Rat droppings and dead roaches; handwashing lapse
summary: Failed. Food handler rinsed hands in a sink, dried on a washcloth, and began preparing food; citation issued. About 40 rat droppings in basement prep area. Dead roaches in flour, under a sink, and in dry storage. Mussels lacked shellstock tag.

headline: Torn gasket; grime on can opener
summary: Canvass passed. Torn gasket inside two-door prep cooler by fryers; must repair or replace. Food debris and grime on can opener attached to prep table; must clean and sanitize.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup kit
summary: No employee health policy and no vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit on site. No hand sink in front prep area; one must be installed with hot and cold water, soap, and towels. Food handler training required.

headline: Ripped cooler gaskets
summary: Re-inspection passed. Ripped rubber gaskets on the three-door prep cooler; must repair and maintain.

headline: No certified manager while ground beef prepared
summary: Failed. No proof of food safety training for person in charge. Ground beef and cheese sauce prepared without a certified manager or posted certificate; citation issued. No vomit cleanup supplies or procedure. Leaking drain under three-compartment sink.

headline: Items stored on walk-in cooler floor
summary: Items stored on the walk-in cooler floor must be organized at least six inches off the floor. A quarter-inch gap at the top of a kitchen exterior door must be repaired. Soiled containers hold clean lids and utensils.

headline: No health policy; repeat violations uncorrected
summary: No verifiable employee health policy on site; citation issued. Repeat core violations from 2023 were not corrected: rear door gap, leaking faucets, no covered washroom receptacle, missing handler training, and expired allergen training.

headline: Washroom door not self-closing
summary: The washroom door was not self-closing. The person in charge was instructed to repair it so that it closes on its own.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; door gap
summary: No thermometer inside the three-door reach-in cooler at the server station. A quarter-inch gap at the front entrance door sweep must be sealed. Food debris inside prep coolers and dust on ceiling tiles.

headline: No food handler training proof for employees
summary: Re-inspection found no proof of food handler training or certificates for any employees. The business must provide them.

headline: No pest control logbook on premises
summary: No pest control logbook was on the premises. The manager must provide one from a licensed Illinois pest control operator by the reinspection date. A slurpee machine cabinet door is loose.

headline: Dirt and grease on floors and walls
summary: Dirt, food spills, and grease buildup on floors, walls, and corners, especially behind heavy cooking equipment, the ice machine, and under cold holding units. The business was instructed to detail clean the entire facility.

headline: Unlabeled food in refrigeration units
summary: Food items inside refrigeration units were not properly labeled. All items, including bulk containers, must show product names.

headline: Food stains on ceiling tiles above prep
summary: Food stains on ceiling tiles above the prep area and around the ventilation hood must be cleaned or replaced.

headline: Food containers not stored properly
summary: Food containers were not stored properly on shelving units. They must be stored inverted.

headline: Over 50 mouse droppings in rear storage
summary: Over 50 mouse droppings were on the floor along walls and in corners of the rear storage area. The manager was advised to call an exterminator and clean and sanitize all areas. Citation issued. The ice bin interior also needs cleaning.

headline: Soil and debris on floors throughout
summary: Re-inspection found soil and debris buildup on floors throughout the facility. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain the floors.

headline: Damaged ceiling tiles; dirty equipment
summary: Not-in-use equipment inside the prep area needs cleaning inside and out. A damaged, water-stained ceiling tile at the front and stained tiles at the rear must be replaced.

headline: Ventilation hood not working
summary: The ventilation hood system was not working. The person in charge was instructed to install a system that prevents grease and condensation from collecting on walls and ceilings.

headline: No certified manager during food preparation
summary: No person in charge held a valid City sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was on duty while sandwiches and coffee drinks were prepared. Broken and leaking drainpipes at the rear hand sink and three-compartment sink.

headline: Ice buildup at freezer door; worn cutting board
summary: Excessive ice buildup around the walk-in freezer door must be removed. A worn-out green vegetable cutting board with a stain must be resurfaced or replaced.

headline: Restroom hand sink runs too briefly
summary: The metered hand sink in the women's restroom does not run for at least 15 seconds, and the business was instructed to adjust it. Small pink calcium residue inside the second-floor ice machine. A wet mop was stored in a bucket.

headline: Prepackaged desserts lack ingredient labels
summary: Prepackaged desserts were not labeled with an ingredient list. They must be labeled and the labels maintained.

headline: Rear door gap; cooler interiors soiled
summary: A quarter-inch gap at the bottom of the rear door near the chip racks could allow pests in. Interior surfaces of two coolers holding deli meats and cheeses had spills and food residue.

headline: Ready-to-eat foods not date-marked
summary: Grilled chicken, chorizo, and potato salad (TCS foods) were not date-marked. The person in charge discarded about 10 pounds, valued at $50. No certified manager with allergen training proof was on site.

headline: Food debris on prep area floors
summary: Accumulated food debris was found on floors throughout the prep area. The person in charge was instructed to detail clean the floors and maintain them.

headline: Rodent infestation; bare-hand food handling
summary: Over 200 rodent droppings found in grill, dry storage, dishwashing, and dining areas; more pest control needed. An employee handled ready-to-eat food with bare hands. Citation issued. Expired food handler certificate.

headline: Meatballs too cool; debris on prep floor
summary: Meatballs held at 120.6°F in the hot-holding unit, below the required 135°F. The manager immediately discarded them. Citation issued. Debris on the food prep floor, drains, and wall bases must be cleaned.

headline: Cooling unit at 70°F; sandwich station open
summary: The upright cooling unit in the rear bakery was inoperable and measured 70°F; it must be repaired and kept at 41°F or below. The sandwich prep station was not protected from customers. The person in charge had an expired allergen certificate.

headline: Dark buildup on sink seal; dirty fryer
summary: A dark substance has built up on the seal around the three-compartment sink and must be replaced and cleaned. The reach-in cooler interior has food debris, and the deep fryer has grease buildup inside.

headline: Utensils above dish sink; wood used as shelf
summary: Clean utensils were stored directly above the dish scrapper sink, and stored items in the rear dry storage must be elevated. Raw wood blocks were used to raise equipment. A torn cooler door gasket must be replaced.

headline: Employee served food without handler certificate
summary: A food employee prepared and served food without a food handler certificate. Employees who are not certified food managers must complete required training and keep certificates on site.

headline: No certified manager while serving TCS foods
summary: No certified food manager on site while chicken, fish, and gyros were prepared; citation issued. A food handler wore gloves, then removed them and cooked without washing hands; citation issued. Rusty racks, stained ceiling tile, and manager lacked allergen certificate.

headline: Bowl used as flour scoop; soiled wiping cloths
summary: A bowl was used as a scoop in a flour container and must be replaced with a utensil with a handle. Wiping cloths were stored in water without adequate sanitizer. In-use knives were stored between the wall and hot-holding shelf.

headline: Floor cleaning needed by refrigerator
summary: The person in charge was instructed to clean the floor by the refrigerator to remove paper, and the floor in the storage closet under carts.

headline: Heavy mouse infestation; flies near food
summary: About 1,000 or more mouse droppings found along cooking equipment, sinks, and storage areas. A live mouse and about 20 live small flies were seen near food. Hand sinks lacked water, soap, or towels in some areas.

headline: Ice maker lacks backflow prevention device
summary: The inspector could not locate a backflow prevention device for the ice maker. The business was instructed to install one.

headline: Food boxes on floor; rear door gap
summary: Food boxes were stored on the walk-in freezer floor and must be six inches off the floor. The rear exit door needs a rodent-proof bottom. Missing hand-wash sign, rusty racks in the walk-in cooler, and low faucet pressure.

headline: Rust and foil on shelving; grease buildup
summary: Rust deposits on prep table bottoms and foil lining on shelving must be removed. Grease inside fryer cabinets and grill, plus food debris on beverage machines, coolers, and shelves, need cleaning. Damaged floor tiles and missing outlet covers.

headline: Dust and grease on prep-area vent filters
summary: Dust and grease built up on ventilation filters in the middle prep area. The person in charge was told to clean and maintain them.

headline: Food handlers washed hands without soap
summary: Two food handlers washed their hands without soap in the front prep and dishwashing area. Citation issued. Hands must be washed with soap and dried with proper provisions. Floors under prep tables and a shelf need cleaning.

headline: No vomit kit; leaks and gaps in toilet room
summary: No items for vomiting and diarrhea cleanup. The toilet room hand sink has no hand-wash sign and a leak. Debris inside reach-in coolers, no backflow device on the mop sink, and no ventilation in the toilet room.

headline: No hand-wash sign; ice machine residue
summary: No hand-wash sign at the prep area sink, and residue inside the ice machine. A reach-in cooler has a damaged door gasket. Unused items in prep and basement storage. The grill is not under a ventilation hood.

headline: Dairy cooler and floors need cleaning
summary: Dairy cooler interior has spills and debris, and shelving under the counter needs cleaning. Floors around cooking equipment have spills, debris, and grease. The dishwashing area floor drain also needs cleaning.

headline: Employee drinks and food near customer food
summary: Employees left open drinks on a prep table and were told to keep them away or use lids. Employee food was stored with customer food and must be kept in a designated section.

headline: Hand sink water too cold; food undated
summary: Hot water at hand sinks measured 68.3°F to 72.8°F, below the required 100°F. Citation issued. Ready-to-eat foods held over 24 hours had no discard date. Food stored on floors in prep and walk-in areas must be raised six inches.

headline: Missing hand-wash signs; utensils not inverted
summary: Hand-wash signs are missing at hand sinks in the bar and prep area. Multi-use equipment stored in the basement under unshielded sewer lines, and utensils were not stored upside down.

headline: Leaking sprayer; missing ceiling tiles
summary: Water leaks from the three-compartment sink sprayer. Missing ceiling tiles in the rear prep area and damaged floor tiles and grout. Dust on vents and hood interior. No allergen training proof for an employee with a sanitation certificate.

headline: No covered trash receptacle in restroom
summary: No covered receptacle was in the women's customer restroom. The business was instructed to provide one.

headline: Wiping cloths not kept in sanitizer
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in a clean sanitizing solution when not in use. A knife was stored between the hand sink and wall. The business was instructed to correct both and maintain.

headline: Cold food too warm; rodent droppings; flies
summary: About 40 large rodent droppings in basement prep, storage, and bar areas, and about 15 live small flies in the bar and dining area. Cold TCS foods were held at 48.5°F to 56°F in the walk-in cooler and discarded, costing $1,787. Cooler tagged.

headline: Leaking sink; damaged dish room floor tiles
summary: A front prep one-compartment sink is leaking and must be repaired. Missing and damaged floor tiles in the dish room must be repaired to create a smooth, cleanable surface. Burned-out light bulbs in the dish room must be replaced.

headline: Splashguards needed at prep hand sinks
summary: Splashguards were needed at both hand sinks in the food prep area, and the business was instructed to install them. A small leak at the three-compartment sink faucet must be repaired.

headline: Live roaches and flies; hand sink blocked
summary: 13 live roaches crawling in cracks and cabinets, plus many dead roaches, in front, basement, and dishwashing areas. About 100 or more live small flies in prep areas. Gaps under double doors, and hand sinks were blocked. Pest control service required.

headline: Debris in floor drains
summary: Debris buildup was observed in floor drains. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Unlabeled food; dead insects on windowsill
summary: Food in coolers and dry storage lacks proper name labels. Dead insects on the entrance windowsill must be removed. Soiled tableware stored in the rear warewashing area, and a mop not positioned to dry, which the inspector said could support pests.

headline: No certified manager while handling TCS foods
summary: No City-certified manager on site while milk and deli sandwiches were handled, and no certificate was posted. Food stored on walk-in freezer floor, thermometers missing from refrigeration units, and a restroom faucet that stops too soon.

headline: Three-door cooler doors need repair
summary: The sliding doors of a three-door reach-in unit are held with tape and need repair to close properly and keep food at safe temperatures. Cooking equipment sides and cooler shelving need detailed cleaning.

headline: No employee health policy on site
summary: No employee health policy was on site. The business was instructed to provide one. This is a priority foundation violation.

headline: No health policy or pest log; grease in hood
summary: No employee health policy or pest control logbook was on site. No sanitizer test strips on site. Washroom garbage cans lacked lids, and the exhaust hood and filters have heavy dirt and grease. No citation issued.

headline: Aluminum foil liner under fryers
summary: Aluminum foil was used as a shelf liner under frying equipment. It must be removed or replaced with a smooth, cleanable material. Dirt and food debris found on floors under a hand sink and behind bar equipment.

headline: Hole in wall under basement sink
summary: A hole in the wall under the three-compartment sink, behind the grease trap in the basement dish area, must be sealed. Debris on the first-floor floor under the sink should be cleaned.

headline: Grease spill outside; front door gap
summary: A quarter-inch gap at the bottom of the front exit door could let pests in. Grease was spilled on the container, building wall, and ground outside. Milk crates are used as shelving. Citation issued.

headline: Missing labels; no allergen training proof
summary: Grab-and-go prepared foods lack business name and address labels. Peeling plastic on cooler doors, damaged floor tile with pooling liquid under a prep table, and water-damaged ceiling tiles. No allergen training proof for sanitation managers.

headline: No cooler thermometer; no hair restraints
summary: No thermometer in the rear three-door cooler. Food handlers worked without hair restraints. Wiping cloths were stored on prep surfaces. Cracked wall tiles under the rear hand sink and floor tiles in the meat department must be replaced.

headline: Grease and dirt across kitchen and bar
summary: Dirt and debris on food storage shelving and inside the basement walk-in cooler. Grease and dirt on walls and floors behind cooking equipment, debris in floor drains, and heavy dust on washroom vents. Hood filters have grease buildup.

headline: No hair restraints; earlier violations uncorrected
summary: Employees prepared food without hair restraints. Allergen training certificates are needed. Earlier core violations were not corrected, including door gaps, cardboard and cloth liners, and missing washroom ventilation. Citation issued.

headline: Food stored in tin cans; leaking faucet
summary: Food items in a prep cooler were stored inside tin cans and must move to approved food-grade containers. Serving plates were not inverted, a cooler door gasket is torn, and the three-compartment sink faucet leaks.

headline: Loose door strip; greasy shelving and floors
summary: The strip on the front entry door is loose at the bottom, which could let pests in. Dirt and grease on shelving near the dish area, cardboard and foil liners, and grease and debris on floors under cooking equipment.

headline: Mineral buildup in ice machine
summary: Pink mineral buildup inside the smoothie bar ice machine must be cleaned. Grease buildup on the front of the outside oil tank also needs cleaning.

headline: Food prepared without hair restraints
summary: Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints. The rear employee restroom door is not self-closing and must have a self-closing device. A slow-draining hand sink in the rear prep area must be repaired.

headline: Spices in unlabeled containers
summary: Spices were stored outside original containers in unlabeled containers and must be labeled. Paper plates for customers were not inverted. No written procedure for cleaning large dough mixers.

headline: No hair restraints; dirty floor drains
summary: Multiple employees handled food without hair restraints. Floor drains under sinks and the ice machine are dirty, and grease is on the floor under deep fryers. The ice machine interior guard has dirt and must be detail cleaned.

headline: Ice machine buildup; wiping cloths not sanitized
summary: Buildup inside the ice machine and on blender bases. Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizing solution, and bulk containers lacked labels. Also grease on equipment and floors, pooled wastewater by the basement mop sink.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate on site
summary: No valid City sanitation manager certificate was on site. One must be on site whenever TCS foods are prepared or served. Citation issued. No covered receptacle in the restroom, and peeling paint above the three-compartment sink.

headline: Expired food handler certificates
summary: Food handler training certificates on the premises are expired, and all food handlers must obtain valid certificates. Allergen certificates are also needed for City-certified managers. Rusted shelves in the walk-in cooler need cleaning or painting.

headline: Heavy grease in hood and kitchen floors
summary: Heavy grease and dust on exhaust hood filters above the wok and fryer area. Filters had been removed from the exhaust system and must be replaced and secured. Kitchen prep and dish area floors were heavily soiled with grease and food debris.

headline: Leaking drain pipe; missing sink stoppers
summary: A men's washroom hand sink drain pipe is leaking, and the three-compartment sinks lack stoppers. Debris found inside unused prep coolers. No covered trash can in the employee washroom.

headline: Food on floor; no handler training; fly strips
summary: Food items were stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer. No food handler training for employees. Fly strips hang from the ceiling in prep and dish areas and must be removed. Food spills on walls and floors, and grease on hood filters.

headline: Leaking dish machine; no test strips
summary: A high-temperature dish machine is leaking. It gauged 180°F, but no temperature test strips were available, and this is a repeat violation. Boxes were stored on basement floors and must be raised six inches.

headline: Gaps around rear interior exit door
summary: The rear interior exit door has gaps around its top, sides, and bottom corner. It must be sealed to prevent possible pest entry points.

headline: Dust, grease, and dead insects on equipment
summary: Cooking equipment, ingredient containers, racks, and shelving have flour, dust, grease, dead insects, and dirt buildup throughout. Cleaning frequency should increase. The sanitation manager lacks a food allergen training certificate.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; no thermometers
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on the premises. No thermometers in refrigeration units. The rear exit door is not rodent-proofed at the bottom, and there is no utility sink for wastewater. The washroom fan is not working.

headline: Two live cockroaches on prep area walls
summary: Two live cockroaches were seen on walls of the food prep area. Additional pest control service is needed; citation issued. Unused equipment in basement and prep area, broken wall tile under the urinal, and the certified manager lacks allergen training proof.

headline: Greasy wall and floor by fryers
summary: Grease on the wall and floor by the fryers in the back cooking area must be cleaned. Light dust was observed on fan covers inside the walk-in cooler.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged out
summary: The low-temperature dish machine measured 0 parts per million of sanitizer at final rinse, and it was tagged as not allowed to be used. Cooked chicken held in coolers had no discard date. Bulk containers unlabeled; manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: No certified manager; cold food too warm
summary: No certified manager on site while open. TCS foods in a tagged cooler measured 55.1°F to 60.1°F; cold holding must be 41°F or below. About 12 pounds discarded. No hot water at sinks. Front door gap and no backflow device on ice machine.

headline: Torn cooler door gaskets
summary: Re-inspection found rubber gaskets ripped on some prep area cooler doors. They must be replaced or repaired.

headline: No City-certified manager; owner has ServSafe
summary: The person in charge lacks a City of Chicago food service manager certificate. The owner holds a ServSafe certificate issued June 9, 2022. Citation issued. No covered waste receptacle, and the employee washroom door is not self-closing.

headline: Food stored on floor; no hair restraints
summary: Food boxes stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and prep areas. Staff handled food without hair restraints. No proof of food handler training or allergen training was on site.

headline: Plastic cup used as dry-storage scoop
summary: A plastic cup was used as a scoop in dry storage containers, stored inside the container. The manager removed and discarded it. Milk crates are used as shelving and must be replaced with shelving six inches off the floor.

headline: No certified manager while serving TCS foods
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site while TCS foods (foods that must be kept hot or cold) were served; meatballs were held at 202.3°F. Knives stored in 84.2°F water. Hand sinks lacked paper towels, and no handler training proof was available.

headline: Peeling paint and drywall in basement prep
summary: Re-inspection found drywall and peeling paint in the basement food prep area that must be repaired.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving
summary: Milk crates are used as shelving in the sales area. The manager was instructed to provide proper shelving. No light shields on the prep area ceiling fan; shields or shatterproof bulbs are required.

headline: Employee belongings stored improperly
summary: Employee personal belongings were stored improperly and must be kept in the designated area only. Plumbing fixtures and toilet base in the restroom need detailed cleaning.

headline: Loose cooler gasket; greasy floors
summary: A loose door gasket on the two-door prep cooler at the beverage station must be repaired or replaced. Grease, food debris, and dirt are on floors under cooking equipment, along walls, and in corners of prep, dish, and storage areas.

headline: Pest log has no reports after July 2025
summary: The pest control logbook's last report is dated 07/21/2025, with no service reports after that. A logbook must include service tickets and at least two pest inspections a year. Reach-in cooler interiors need detail cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; door gap
summary: Bulk containers in the rear lack labels and must show common names like salt, sugar, or flour. A quarter-inch gap at the bottom of the rear exit door needs sealing. Food from an open can must move to food-grade containers.

headline: No certified manager while serving chicken
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken and deli meat were prepared and served. Citation issued. No employee health policy, no food handler training certificates, and no allergen training certification. A soiled mop head was not stored properly.

headline: Garbage littered around dumpsters
summary: The dumpster area floor was littered with garbage around the dumpsters and grease container. The manager must clean the area and maintain it. Priority foundation violation; citation issued.

headline: Rodent infestation; about 75 droppings
summary: About 75 mouse droppings were found under unused shelves, showing rodent infestation. Management was told to clean all droppings, and more pest control is needed. Rear prep area not protected; meat trays do not fit in the sink basins.

headline: Restroom door not self-closing
summary: The facility bathroom door was not self-closing. The manager was instructed to install a self-closing bathroom door.

headline: Wiping cloths in water without sanitizer
summary: Wiping cloths were stored in water without chemical sanitizer. A torn plastic dough bin with holes and jagged edges must be repaired or replaced. Interiors of the microwave and ice machine in the bakery area were soiled.

headline: No certified manager; flies seen in bar
summary: Food handlers prepared TCS foods without a certified manager on site, a priority violation. About 25 small black flies were seen near the beer garden door and in the bar. No written employee health policy or handler training records.

headline: Untrained food handlers; no allergen training
summary: Food handlers worked without food handler training, and a sanitation manager lacked allergen training. Racks inside the walk-in cooler are not clean. The customer restroom door is not self-closing.

headline: Passed; missing thermometers, unlabeled containers
summary: Passed. Two-door upright cooler and freezer lacked interior thermometers. Several bulk dry storage containers lacked common-name labels. Greasy pots and pans on equipment shelf needed cleaning to prevent buildup.

headline: Passed; leaking drainpipe under handsink
summary: Complaint inspection; passed. Drainpipe leaked under the handwashing sink in the warewashing area. Inspector instructed repair of the leaking drainpipe.

headline: No certified person in charge on premises
summary: Complaint re-inspection; pass with conditions. No person in charge held a City of Chicago food service sanitation certificate on premises. Inspector required one to be on premises at all times. Citation issued.

headline: Passed; no food handler certificates; labels missing
summary: Re-inspection; passed. Chicken and fish mix containers lacked labels. Employees on duty had no food handler training certificates. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Old fryer equipment must be removed; overhead vents need cleaning.

headline: Passed; missing cooler thermometers, leaks noted
summary: Passed. Coolers had missing or broken thermometers, which must be provided and maintained. Leaks under the three-compartment sink and at a faucet base in dish room. Broken dish room floor tiles and food-prep floors needed cleaning.

headline: Passed; light shields missing in coolers
summary: Passed. Basement and rear reach-in coolers lacked light shields. Inspector instructed the manager to add light shields or shatterproof bulbs inside the coolers.

headline: No hot water at handwash sinks
summary: Pass with conditions. Restroom and employee hand sinks had no hot water; reading was 48.2°F, and 100°F is the required minimum. Dumpster lid could not close because it was overloaded. Torn fridge gasket and unprotected serving plates noted.

headline: Passed; food on floors, mouthwash near food
summary: Passed. Employee mouthwash was stored on a food shelf and must be moved to a designated area. Food containers on walk-in cooler and freezer floors must be elevated. Cooler door handle had food debris. Freezer light out; cooler light shield missing.

headline: Failed; no employee health policy on premises
summary: Failed. No written employee health policy on premises. No exposed handwashing sink in the dishwashing area; one must be installed. Missing metal-stem food thermometer and sanitizer test strips. Walk-in cooler lacked storage shelves; several lights out; manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Passed; one food handler's certificate expired
summary: Re-inspection; passed. Basement prep handsink lacked signage. Rusty storage racks in basement walk-in cooler and food debris inside cold-holding equipment needed cleaning. One food handler had an expired certificate and must renew it.

headline: Passed; grease and debris buildup throughout
summary: Passed. Heavy grease on shelving near the grill and on cooking equipment, with dust and food debris on equipment and inside reach-in coolers. Floors need cleaning, storage closets need decluttering, and hood and pizza-oven area need cleaning.

headline: Passed; stained cutting boards, no covered bins
summary: Re-inspection; passed. Stained cutting boards on prep cooler tops must be resurfaced or replaced. Unisex washrooms had no covered waste receptacles. Hanging dust in exhaust hood above toaster oven needed detail cleaning.

headline: Conditions; no certified manager, no allergen training
summary: Pass with conditions. No valid certificate posted while time/temperature-controlled foods were prepared and served. No valid allergen training. Food handler lacked hair restraint. Debris and spills in prep areas and cooler gaskets.

headline: Passed; buildup on nozzles, equipment, and floors
summary: Re-inspection; passed. Drink nozzles and all cooking equipment needed detail cleaning to remove buildup and grease. Leak at the three-compartment sink needed repair. Floors throughout needed detail cleaning.

headline: Passed; basement floor under stairs unclean
summary: Complaint re-inspection; passed. Basement floor under the stairs was unclean; inspector instructed the operator to clean and maintain it.

headline: Passed; torn screen and cardboard floor liner
summary: Passed. Holes in the rear door mesh screen must be replaced. Cardboard was being reused as floor liner in the rear food prep area; inspector instructed removal, with smooth, easily cleanable surfaces required.

headline: Failed; about 280 live flies in prep areas
summary: Failed. About 200 live small flies in front prep and 80 in rear prep; manager told to eliminate them, clean affected areas, and pest control recommended. Employees handled food without hair restraints. Prior core violations uncorrected, including dirty ceiling tiles, vents, and floors.

headline: Failed; no hot water, condensation dripping on food
summary: Failed. Prep-area handsinks lacked hot water; one was blocked by kitchen items and another lacked paper towels. Freezer condensation dripped onto stored food; manager voluntarily discarded 10 lbs ($80). Certified manager also lacks allergen training.

headline: Failed; no vomit-cleanup plan or health policy
summary: Failed. No written employee health policy and no procedure or kit for vomit and diarrhea cleanup. Water leaked between three-compartment sink sections and from a drain pipe. Menu lacked raw or undercooked food advisory. Rear door had bottom gaps. Manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Failed; no certified manager, no pest logbook
summary: Failed. Person in charge lacked City sanitation manager certificate, and no valid certificate was posted. No up-to-date pest control logbook; the only receipt was from July 2024. No food handler certificates were available for review.

headline: Conditions; missing health policies, repairs needed
summary: Pass with conditions. No signed employee health policies; required hand-sink signage, slow drain repair, and food allergen training for manager. Door gaps and torn screen need repair. Also plumbing, toilet-door closer, and wall and floor repairs.

headline: Vacuum-packed chicken without approved plan
summary: Pass with conditions. Vacuum-packaging machine used on chicken without a CDPH-approved HACCP written food safety plan. Manager told to stop using it until approved. Soda nozzles and drains need cleaning; one food handler lacked valid training.

headline: Failed; 40+ mouse droppings, live flies
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on duty while food was prepared; one arrived at 9:45 AM. Found 40 or more mouse droppings and about 25 live small flies, some crawling on onions. Prior core violations also not corrected.

headline: Passed; frozen meat thawing in sink
summary: Complaint re-inspection; passed. Frozen meat was thawed in a three-compartment sink; approved thawing methods required. Ice scoop left lying on ice; mop heads not hung to dry. A prep-line light was burnt out. Manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Warm cold foods; dish machine fixed on site
summary: Pass with conditions. Many cold foods held at 55–71.6°F; about 10 lbs (valued $500) discarded. Bar dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine, repaired on site to 50 ppm. Missing handwash signs were also noted.

headline: Conditions; soap and paper towels fixed on site
summary: Pass with conditions. No soap or paper towels at dishwashing handsink; both corrected on site. Rear exit door has a base opening needing sealing. Rust, cardboard liners, unlabeled containers, and dirty floors also noted.

headline: Failed; front handsink off limits, damaged
summary: Failed. Front cashier and prep handsink was off limits due to drain damage; employees instructed to use another handsink at end of prep line until repaired. Knives and scoops stored with handles touching food. Single-use items on floor; cardboard used as shelf liner.

headline: Passed; detail cleaning needed at sink and floor
summary: Passed. Three-compartment sink drain had dark buildup needing detail cleaning. Rear storage area floor also needed detail cleaning. Inspector instructed cleaning and maintenance.

headline: Passed; food on walk-in floor, slimy soda dispenser
summary: Passed. Food containers, boxes, and large pots stored on walk-in cooler floor must be raised six inches. Slimy grey substance found inside bar soda gun dispenser must be cleaned and sanitized. Torn cooler gasket and dusty exhaust hood also noted.

headline: Passed; missing handwash sign, basement light out
summary: Passed. Bar handwash sink lacked a hand-washing sign. In basement prep area, one of two overhead fan and exhaust lights was not working. Manager instructed to provide sign and repair the light.

headline: Conditions; no handsoap and front door gap
summary: Pass with conditions. Toilet-room handsink had no soap; soap must be provided and maintained. Small opening at bottom of front entrance door must be sealed.

headline: Passed; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed re-inspection with one issue: no allergen training for the certified manager on site. Inspector instructed the manager to get the training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Passed; patio openings and door gaps
summary: License re-inspection; passed. Openings along structures and at the bottom of doors in the patio area must be sealed to prevent pest entry.

headline: Failed; cooler at 62.8°F, no cleanup procedure
summary: Failed. Four-door cooler held at 62.8°F, above 41°F; prep cooler tagged held. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or written procedure on site. Reach-in display coolers lacked thermometers. Duct tape used to repair a cooler glass door.

headline: Passed; training certificates missing on site
summary: Re-inspection; passed. No food handler training certificates were provided on site, and allergen training certificates for certified managers were missing too. Broken backflow prevention device at dish room utility sink must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Failed; two dumpster lids missing
summary: Complaint inspection; failed. Two of four outside garbage dumpster lids were missing; lids must be replaced and tight-fitting. A citation was issued.

headline: Passed; grease, debris, and expired certificates
summary: Re-inspection; passed. Heavy grease and dust on hood, filters, and nearby vents; food debris on prep table edges; standing water and debris near rear sink. Expired allergen training certificates for certified managers.

headline: Failed; cold foods too warm, pest logbook missing
summary: Failed. Cold foods at 45.9–49.5°F were discarded; a small cold unit at 48°F was tagged held. No pest control logbook and no written vomiting/diarrhea procedure. Soap and paper towels were added on site; bar hot water was later restored.

headline: No certified manager on site while serving
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified manager or posted certificate while steaming milk, a time- and temperature-controlled food. Manager instructed to obtain one. Prep-area handwash sink had weak hot water pressure.

headline: Failed; unsafe food temperatures and live insects
summary: Failed. Sausage held at 129°F, below the 135°F minimum for hot food. Eggs at 45°F and raw bacon at 54°F were above the 41°F limit for cold food. About 20 live flying insects found in dining room, washroom, and office. Ceiling leak also noted.

headline: Failed; hot food too cool and live flies found
summary: Failed. Food handler left toilet stall without washing hands. About 30 lbs cooked chicken held at 108–125°F, plus other food at 118°F, discarded during inspection. About 35 live small flies found in two prep areas. Pork thawed in standing water.

headline: Cold foods too warm; cooler repaired on site
summary: Pass with conditions. Chicken, sliced tomato, and gyro meat held at 45.7–48.6°F, above the 41°F limit; manager voluntarily discarded 8 lbs ($80). Prep cooler at 54.8°F was repaired on site and reached 41°F.

headline: Passed; door gap, leaking water line
summary: Passed. A quarter-inch gap at the rear exit door must be sealed to rodent-proof it. Copper water line leaks under dishwasher drain board, requiring repair. Employee washroom needs a covered trash receptacle. Some allergen certificates have expired.

headline: Passed; rear door gap, missing backflow devices
summary: Re-inspection; passed. Rear door had a half-inch gap at bottom and around knob; must be sealed. No visible backflow prevention device on ice machine or coffee maker. Rusted cooler racks, no sink drain plugs, and staff toilet ceiling hole also noted.

headline: Passed; food stored in bags and tin cans
summary: Complaint re-inspection; passed. Food was stored inside grocery bags and tin cans in coolers and refrigeration units; must use approved food-grade containers. To-go containers used as scoops; tongs or ladles required.

headline: Failed; live flying insects, soap missing
summary: Failed. About 25 live small flying insects on walls and ceilings in food prep, dry storage, and manager's office. Three prep handsinks lacked soap; one was blocked by a mop bucket and backpacks. No temperature indicators for high-temperature dish machine.

headline: No certified manager on site until 3 PM
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager on premises at inspection; one arrived at 3:00 PM. Three-compartment sink leaked from drain pipe. Front prep area had no prep/dump sink. Black buildup in a dishwashing-area floor drain.

headline: Passed; expired allergen certificates, missing sign
