summary: Passed. Rear prep handsink lacked handwashing signage. Torn gasket on two-door refrigerator door needs repair. Cold-holding equipment had food debris inside. Multiple certified managers had expired allergen awareness training certificates.

headline: Passed; ice machine buildup cleaned on site
summary: Passed. Ice machine interior had buildup; manager removed ice and detail cleaned the machine on site. Outdoor grease container lid needs replacing. Walk-in cooler air vent needed dust cleaning.

headline: Passed; ice maker interior needs cleaning
summary: Complaint re-inspection; passed. Slight debris encrusted inside the ice maker. Inspector required removal of debris, detail cleaning, and ongoing service and maintenance of the ice maker.

headline: Failed; 50–60 rodent droppings found
summary: Complaint inspection. About 50–60 rodent droppings found in basement and dry storage; more pest control ordered. Also no vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit, a three-compartment sink backing up, a hand sink blocked by a scooper, and grease and food debris on equipment.

headline: Conditions; bar dish machine tagged, not in use
summary: Pass with conditions. Black moldlike buildup in ice machine; ice was destroyed and machine cleaned during follow-up on 10/3/25. Bar low-temperature dish machine showed drain error and was tagged held for inspection. Three managers lacked allergen awareness training proof.

headline: Failed; 100+ rodent droppings in basement
summary: Failed. More than 100 rodent droppings found throughout the basement; pest control recommended. No certified food manager on arrival; no sanitizer test strips; wastewater backup in basement; one employee without food handler certificate. Floors and hood grease need cleaning.

headline: Hot dogs held too warm; soap missing
summary: Pass with conditions. Hot dogs held at 46.7°F in front display cooler, above the 41°F limit; manager voluntarily discarded 5 lbs (about $10). Prep handsink lacked soap; employee supplied it during inspection. Cardboard and foil used as shelf liners.

headline: Failed; no certified manager during food prep
summary: Failed. No certified food manager while time/temperature-controlled foods were prepared, until one arrived at 3:15 PM. Rear ice machine chute had black buildup; ice was removed and machine cleaned. No vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit and no current pest control logbook.

headline: Unsafe hot and cold food temperatures found
summary: Pass with conditions. Lentil soup (126.8°F) and chicken soup (102°F) were held below the 135°F hot-holding minimum and discarded. Cold foods at 50–55°F, including tomatoes, falafel mix, and eggs, must be held at 41°F or below. Handsinks lacked soap.

headline: Failed; unsafe hot and cold holding temperatures
summary: Suspected food poisoning report. Two ice machines had slimy pink-black buildup. Mashed potatoes held at 124°F were reheated to 165°F on site. Milk at 49°F was discarded. Sushi rice vinegar process lacked approval and a working pH meter.

headline: Failed; no vomit cleanup supplies or pest logbook
summary: Failed. No clean-up supplies on premises for vomit or diarrhea events; management instructed to provide a spill kit with instructions. No pest control logbook on premises; a logbook with at least two service reports yearly must be kept.

headline: Failed; mouse infestation and unsafe food temperatures
summary: Failed. Over 1,000 mouse droppings found throughout, plus small and large flies; a dead mouse was in packaged items. Cold foods held at 50–63°F; about 35 lbs ($275) discarded. Refrigerator at 67°F tagged held. No certified manager on site.

headline: Passed; leaking three-compartment sink faucet
summary: Complaint inspection; passed. Faucet base on the three-compartment sink leaked. Inspector instructed the operator to fix it and maintain it.

headline: Passed; no allergen training for certified manager
summary: Complaint re-inspection; passed. No certified food manager had allergen training. Inspector instructed anyone holding a City sanitation certificate to complete training and provide documentation.

headline: Failed; live flies found in bar and basement
summary: Failed. About 15 small black live flies found in bar, near drains, and in basement storage; pest activity must be eliminated. Side and exit doors were open. Food handlers lacked beard guards; tableware left uncovered on patio and dining tables.

headline: Passed; dead flies found in prep and dining
summary: Complaint inspection; passed. Dead flies were found near a prep-area handsink, dining room windowsills, and a garbage can ledge; inspector required removal. Also heavy grease on a freezer exterior and hood filters, and an unlabeled flour container.

headline: Passed; idle dish machine and mislabeled dispenser
summary: Passed. Employee restroom sanitizer dispenser was filled with hand soap; instructed to correct. Unused, nonfunctioning high-temperature dish machine in dish pit must be repaired or removed.

headline: Failed; no certified manager and no health policy
summary: Failed. Person in charge and assistant manager lacked valid City sanitation certificates while food was handled. No employee health policy, vomiting/diarrhea procedure, or kit found. No pest control logbook and no food handler certificates. Dry containers unlabeled.

headline: Failed; no food handler training proof, repeat issues
summary: Failed re-inspection. Food handler training proof missing for all food employees. Prior core violation not corrected: milk crates and wooden pallets used as shelving in basement, which could hide pests. Peeling freezer plastic also noted.

headline: Passed; cleaning and repairs needed throughout
summary: Passed. Ice machine interior needed cleaning and maintenance. Shelving had spills and debris. Dirty pipe behind cooking equipment needed grease cleaning. Base board repair needed in front prep. Standing water noted in dish area and walk-in cooler.

headline: Failed; unapproved vacuum-packed food, warm lamb
summary: Failed. Lamb held at 45.3–48.5°F; 72 lbs ($1,000) discarded. Packaging machine used without approved plan; 200 lbs ($1,200) of packaged food, hidden in electrical room, discarded and machine tagged. Hand sink water too cool, later corrected.

headline: Passed; openings in walls need sealing
summary: Complaint re-inspection; passed. Openings in the lower left wall by the two-door cooler in the main-floor prep area and in a staircase landing must be sealed and maintained.

headline: Passed; raw wood cutting surfaces to be sealed
summary: Passed. Raw wood cutting surfaces on steam tables and prep coolers in the front cook area must be sealed and made smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable.

headline: Passed; milk stored on floor; leaking faucet
summary: Passed. Dairy and milk items sat in milk crates directly on the floor of the walk-in cooler; they must be raised six inches. Three-compartment sink faucet leaked from loose right-side fixture; repair required.

headline: Passed; food stored on floors, debris throughout
summary: Complaint inspection; passed. Food containers were stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and prep and storage areas, risking contamination. Inspector required elevating them at least six inches. Food debris and spills throughout needed detail cleaning.

headline: Passed; cardboard liners, crates, and dirty floors
summary: Passed. Cardboard shelf liners and pop crates used for elevation must be replaced with six-inch-off-floor shelving. Slushie machine shelves and doors are dirty. Floors need detail cleaning in storage, walk-in cooler, and front prep; grease trap exterior too.

headline: Passed; floor debris and grime near drains
summary: Passed. Rear storage floor had debris and spills such as oil and salt. Grime built up around drains in the mop area. Person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Passed; rear door gap and faucet leak
summary: Passed. Rear exit door had a quarter-inch gap at bottom; repair so it fits tightly and is protected. Leak at three-compartment sink faucet must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Passed; several workers lack food handler proof
summary: Re-inspection; passed. Several food handlers lacked food handler training certificates; management was instructed to show proof. Chest freezer interior needed cleaning, and food-prep walls needed cleaning.

headline: Passed; bakery side door not rodent-proofed
summary: Complaint re-inspection; passed. Bakery side entrance door was not rodent-proof; inspector required repair. Floors under, around, and behind all equipment also needed cleaning.

headline: Passed; door gap, loose splash guard, dirty floors
summary: Passed. Side exit doors had a quarter-inch gap at bottom; repair required. Front sink splash guard loose; rusted grease trap under rear sink needs repair. Foil on kitchen shelving must be removed. Floors need cleaning; damaged floor tiles need repair.

headline: Passed; missing handwash sign and leaking sink
summary: Passed re-inspection. Dishwashing area handwash sink had no sign. Front prep handwash sink drained slowly and leaked at the drainpipe; manager instructed to repair.

headline: Failed; back door not rodent-proof, sink damaged
summary: Failed. Back door had gaps and was not rodent-proofed. Food was heated in tin cans. Three-compartment sink had a hole sealed with caulk; replacement required. No sanitizer test strips. Garbage receptacles uncovered with trash on ground. Ceiling in poor repair.

headline: Passed; ice machine buildup and rodent-proofing needed
summary: Passed. Ice machine had mineral buildup. A storage-room door needed rodent-proofing at the bottom. Also missing handwash signage, milk crates used for shelving, rusty freezer racks, and dirty floors and vents.

headline: Passed; urinal does not flush
summary: Complaint inspection; passed. One of two men's room urinals does not flush and must be repaired or replaced. Unused ROP (reduced oxygen packaging) machine in basement electrical room must be removed.

headline: Passed; live plants stored above ice cream freezers
summary: Passed. Live potted plants were stored above ice cream display freezers. Inspector instructed keeping them away from food storage.

headline: Passed; floors, vents, and light shield need work
summary: Passed re-inspection with upkeep items. Floors in prep and dish areas need grouting; food debris along wall bases needs cleaning; dust in prep area vents must be cleaned; a cracked light shield near the walk-in cooler must be replaced.

headline: Failed; no certified manager during food prep
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on site while time/temperature-controlled foods (chicken, hot dogs, pizza) were prepared and served. Person in charge lacked certificate. Prior core violations not corrected: dirty floors, water-damaged ceiling tiles, inoperable washroom ventilation. Thermometers also needed.

headline: Passed; some food handlers need required training
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food handlers who are not City of Chicago certified food managers must obtain required food handler training. Inspector gave this instruction.

headline: Passed; food stored on floor; ice machine buildup
summary: Passed. Fruit pans were stored on walk-in cooler floor, and utensils on kitchen floor; both must be moved. Ice machine panel had black buildup; hood light was burnt out. Bar handsink lacked signage, and dry containers lacked labels.

headline: Conditions; allergen training still not provided
summary: Pass with conditions. Stainless steel storage shelves in food prep area needed cleaning. Core violation from prior report not corrected: certified food manager had no allergen training certificate. Citation issued.

headline: Passed; washrooms need covered waste bins
summary: Passed. Neither facility washroom had a covered waste receptacle. Inspector instructed the operator to provide at least one covered receptacle in all washrooms and maintain it.

headline: Conditions; undated foods, food on floors
summary: Pass with conditions. Ready-to-eat foods in the prep cooler lacked date marks. Food containers stored on floors in walk-in cooler, freezer, and rear area. Dumpster lids could not close due to overflowing trash. Certified manager lacked allergen certificate.

headline: Passed; floors and drains need cleaning
summary: Complaint inspection; passed. Floors and floor drains needed cleaning to remove debris and spills. Inspector also asked that floors be kept as dry as possible to prevent pest breeding.

headline: Passed; no allergen training for certified managers
summary: Passed. Prep-area handwashing sink lacked a hand-washing sign. Debris on holding units, coolers, prep tables, and sinks needed cleaning. Certified managers had no allergen training.

headline: Passed; food stored on floor, heavy grease buildup
summary: Re-inspection; passed. Frozen fish tubs stored on floor; large containers of fish, seasonings, and greens also stored on floors. Equipment and fryers had heavy grease and food debris. Floor and wall tiles broken. Hood had thick dripping grease.

headline: Dish machines not sanitizing; no certified manager
summary: Pass with conditions. No person in charge held a valid City sanitation certificate. Two low-temperature dish machines sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine; one was repaired on site, the bar unit was tagged held. Utensils stored uncovered.

headline: Passed; missing ceiling tiles and hood light out
summary: Complaint inspection; passed. Equipment and debris under shelving needed cleaning. Missing ceiling tiles in basement prep area must be replaced. A nonworking light in the pasta-area hood must be repaired.

headline: Passed; unlabeled food containers
summary: Complaint re-inspection; passed. Food and spice items were out of original containers without common-name labels; inspector instructed labeling all such items.

headline: Passed; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Passed. Milk crates were used as shelving throughout prep and storage areas. They must be removed and replaced with shelving six inches off the floor to allow cleaning.

headline: Passed; ice machine residue, leaks, and rust
summary: Passed. Pink substance in ice machine shield needs cleaning. Dish machine final-rinse gauge not working and three-compartment sink leaking from middle nozzle; both need repair. Rusty can opener must be replaced. Unused coolers must be removed to prevent pest harboring.

headline: Failed; repeat core violations not corrected
summary: Failed. Repeat violations not corrected from a prior report: second-floor handwash sink cold water handle stripped, and no food allergen training certificates on premises. Also missing handwash signage at one bar sink; bulk containers unlabeled.

headline: Failed; food on floors and repeat core violations
summary: Failed re-inspection. Food containers stored on floors in prep, storage, and walk-in cooler; prior core violations not corrected. Milk crates and cardboard used as shelving; rear walkway items must be removed to prevent rodent harboring. Ice machine interior dirty.

headline: Passed; food handler certificates must be in vehicle
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food handlers must have required food handler training and certificates with them on the vehicle.

headline: Passed re-inspection; rear door not pest-proof
summary: Passed re-inspection. The rear exit door is not rodent-proof. Beverage storage items must be raised 6 inches to prevent pest hiding places. Floors are cracked and missing tiles, grease and debris are on the rear prep floor, and lighting is inadequate near the front handsink.

headline: Failed: slime dripping onto ice; ice removed
summary: Failed. Ice machine in prep area had black, brown and pink slime dripping onto ice used for human consumption. Manager shut it off and removed all ice during inspection; citation issued. Also food on walk-in floor and repeat violations from 2024 not corrected.

headline: Failed: restrooms out of order since Sept 5
summary: Failed. Toilet rooms were clogged and out of order since Friday, 9/5/25; staff used a plaza shoe store's restroom. Citation issued. Also peeling base boards in rear storage and a loose toilet-room faucet.

headline: Passed; open drink at prep line, expired certificate
summary: Passed. Open employee drink at the prep line; food containers on walk-in cooler floor; worn dairy containers reused; trash receptacles lacked covers; one food handler certificate expired; certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed; items on floors, dirty floors
summary: Passed re-inspection. Items in the outdoor shed, rear storage and liquor storage must be raised off the floor. Dirt and debris under the wood grill and pizza-prep handsink must be cleaned. A cracked coving tile in pizza prep needs repair.

headline: Passed; ice machine residue, no food handler certificates
summary: Passed. Pink and black substance on the ice machine interior panel. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer. No written cleaning procedure for ice cream and slushy machines. Food handlers lacked certificates. Also greasy fryers and dirty floor drains.

headline: Conditions: no certified food manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No city certified food manager was on site while cooked beef and chicken were being prepared or served. Citation issued.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, unlabeled food discarded
summary: Failed. No city sanitation manager certificate was posted; citation issued. Inspector discarded 39 pounds of prepared foods lacking date labels, valued at $100. Also no pest control log, unlabeled food in the deli cooler, and an oven not under an exhaust hood.

headline: Failed: about 70 rodent droppings found
summary: Failed. Rodent droppings found: 20 by the grease trap and under the three-compartment sink, 20 under the rear storage rack, 10 on the meat grinder and 20 under the front storage rack. Citation issued; pest control help required. Also a fly strip over the prep table.

headline: Passed; no proof of food handler or allergen training
summary: Passed. No proof of food handler training for all food handlers, and no proof of allergen training for the certified food manager. Records must be provided and kept on site.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge had sanitation manager training, and no valid city sanitation certificate was on site. A certified manager must be present whenever foods that must stay hot or cold, such as sliced tomatoes and corn, are prepared. Citation issued.

headline: Failed: ice scoops in machine, no food handler proof
summary: Failed. Ice scoops were stored inside the ice machine. Repeat violations from 2024 were not corrected, including missing food handler training proof and a grooved wood knife holder. Also missing handwash signs, leaking faucet, clutter, soiled mops and dim lighting.

headline: Passed; no food handler certificates on site
summary: Passed re-inspection. No food handler certificates were on site. Reach-in and display coolers lacked air thermometers inside. A sanitation manager lacked an allergen training certificate. Manager instructed to comply.

headline: Conditions: certified manager arrived 25+ minutes late
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager with certificate was on site at arrival. The certified manager arrived more than 25 minutes after inspection started. Citation issued; a certified manager must be on site at all times.

headline: Conditions: no allergen training certificates
summary: Passed with conditions. Previous core violation not corrected: food service managers had no allergen training certificates. Managers must obtain them. Citation issued.

headline: Failed: about 35 flies found throughout facility
summary: Failed. About five large flies and 30 small flies found, with fly activity in basement storage, hallways, a locker room and a walk-in cooler. Pest control service recommended; citation issued. Also a front entrance opening, freezer ice buildup, and an expired allergen certificate.

headline: Conditions: no certified food manager on duty
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge held a valid city sanitation certificate. No certified food manager was on duty while beef sandwiches and nachos were prepared and served; citation issued. Cooking equipment, racks and shelving need deep cleaning.

headline: Passed; upkeep issues, dim prep lighting
summary: Passed. Rusty walk-in racks, low cold-water pressure at a handsink, missing and water-stained ceiling tiles, wall and floor openings including around the grease trap, dirty floors, and unshielded lights in food prep. Prep area not well lit.

headline: Failed: no hair restraints, no sanitizer test strips
summary: Failed. Everyone entering the prep area must wear a hair restraint. Wet wiping cloths sat on cutting boards and prep tables. No quaternary sanitizer test strips on site (citation). Oil-soaked waste container outside; citation issued. Also leaking drain pipes and broken equipment parts.

headline: Passed; allergen training required for certificate holders
summary: Passed re-inspection. Allergen training is required for all employees holding a city food sanitation certificate. Facility was instructed to complete training and keep certificates on site.

headline: Conditions: waste water backing up in sink
summary: Passed with conditions. Wastewater was backing from one two-compartment sink into the other, carrying dirt and grease; repair required and citation issued. Also serving plates not inverted and stained ceiling tiles in the tea room prep area.

headline: Conditions: cold foods and cooler too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. Several cold foods held at 46-56°F; manager discarded 3 gallons of milk and 1 gallon of half-and-half. A cooler's air temperature was 58°F; cold holding must be 41°F or below. No signed employee health policy on site.

headline: Passed; missing backflow device, cluttered storage
summary: Passed re-inspection. The ice maker lacks an accessible backflow device, which must be installed. Rear storage was cluttered, creating potential pest hiding places; items must be raised 6 inches. Raw wood walls and vent dust noted; one food handler lacked a certificate.

headline: Failed: drink prep area lacks food guard
summary: Failed. Drink prep area with a bean grinder, slow drip coffee and cappuccino machine lacked a proper food guard to protect it from customer contamination. A food guard must be installed. Priority violation.

headline: Failed: shellfish tags missing, sushi rice unverified
summary: Failed. Clams in the seafood cooler had no shellfish tag, and many tags lacked sale dates. Sushi rice acidity (pH) was not verified; a lab report or pH meter is required. The menu lacked a raw-food advisory. Citations issued.

headline: Passed re-inspection; stained cutting boards, leaks noted
summary: Passed a complaint re-inspection. Inspector noted stained, open-seam cutting boards at the meat area, a leaking pipe under the three-compartment sink, a sprayer hanging below the sink rim, and washroom trash cans without lids.

headline: Passed; sugar bin in aisle, floors need cleaning
summary: Passed re-inspection. Sugar bin at the self-serve coffee station was in the aisle and must be moved to prevent contamination. Four sheet trays were stored on the floor, an outdoor garbage lid was damaged, and some floors need cleaning.

headline: Passed; grease buildup, missing ice machine backflow device
summary: Passed re-inspection. Required fixes: seal the gap under the rear delivery door, clean grease and debris from equipment and floors, install an ice machine backflow device, repair a leaky basement faucet, clean unused toilet fixtures, and repair broken floor tiles.

headline: Conditions: mixed oysters; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed with conditions. Oysters were commingled, meaning mixed improperly, in the walk-in cooler; about 5 pounds discarded and citation issued. Also a leaking handsink on the second-floor cook line, greasy hood filters, and a manager without allergen training.

headline: Passed; worn cutting boards, stained ceiling tiles
summary: Passed re-inspection. Worn or deeply grooved cutting boards in deli, meat and hot food prep must be repaired or replaced. Stained ceiling tiles in rear storage need repair or replacement.

headline: Failed: bare-hand food contact, flies, unsafe cold holding
summary: Failed. Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat blueberries; product discarded. Bar refrigerator at 50.2°F held milk; other cold foods too warm. 30 or more live small flies found in prep, dish, bar and dining areas. Restroom hot water restored on site.

headline: Passed; dish machine leak, missing backflow devices
summary: Passed. The high-temperature dish machine in the front prep area leaks and must be repaired. Espresso and coffee machines in the front prep area lack backflow prevention devices; these must be installed so they can be serviced.

headline: Passed; damaged baseboards, water-stained ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. Damaged baseboards in the rear prep area, near the office and rear exit door, need repair. Water-damaged ceiling tiles in the hallway by the restrooms need repair.

headline: Failed: over 50 mouse droppings, exterminator needed
summary: Failed. Over 50 mouse droppings on floors in the furnace room, rear storage and sales areas. Manager instructed to call an exterminator, clean and sanitize; citation issued. Also no handwashing sign, crates used as shelving, and openings around pipes.

headline: Conditions: no vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit
summary: Passed with conditions. No vomiting and diarrhea procedure or clean-up kit was on premises. Facility must have both on site; no citation issued.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager on duty
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid city certified food manager was on duty or on site while chicken, tuna and deli meats were prepared and served; citation issued. Also a dirty front cooler and ice buildup on the walk-in freezer floor.

headline: Passed; rusty freezer shelves, no allergen proof
summary: Passed re-inspection. Three walk-in freezer shelving units had rust and must be repaired or replaced. No proof of allergen awareness training was provided for employees holding city sanitation certificates.

headline: Failed: no kitchen handsink; cooler at 59°F
summary: Failed. No handsink in the kitchen or food prep area. Two-door cooler measured 59°F; cold holding must be 41°F or below. Also no employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea procedure, no stem thermometer, no undercooked-food advisory, and no allergen certificates.

headline: Passed; greasy floors and basement clutter
summary: Passed. Basement storage clutter must be cleared and items raised 6 inches to prevent rodent hiding places. Grease, food debris and dirt on floors under equipment, along walls and in corners need cleaning in prep, dish, storage and basement areas.

headline: Passed; milk crates, soiled cloths, expired certificates
summary: Passed re-inspection. Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables; milk crates used for shelving can hide pests; duct tape used as a cooler repair; food debris on equipment and shelves; soiled mop heads not hung. Some food handler certificates had expired.

headline: Passed; ice machine repair and cleaning needed
summary: Passed. Ice machine interior gasket and metal frame need repair or replacement. Food shelves need crumbs removed, and floors under food areas need detailed cleaning of spills.

headline: Passed; slicer dirty, food stored on floor
summary: Passed. Deli slicer encrusted with food debris; it must be cleaned and sanitized at least every 4 hours. Food containers stored on the walk-in floor. Also greasy surfaces, rusted racks, a hole in a rear prep wall, torn base boards, three burned-out hood lights, and no food handler training proof.

headline: Failed: handsink water too cool, no food handler certificates
summary: Failed re-inspection. One of two food prep handsinks still had hot water at 65-70°F; 100°F is required. A prep handsink leaked and was inaccessible; citation issued. No food handler certificates on site; faucets at warewashing sinks need repair.

headline: Conditions: handwashing supplies missing
summary: Passed with conditions. The bakery hand sink had no paper towels, and the employee restroom had no hand soap. Staff obtained both during inspection; citation issued for the soap. Also loose meat debris in the packaging machine and greasy floor under deli cooking equipment.

headline: Passed; excess ice in walk-in freezer
summary: Passed. Excessive ice had built up on walk-in freezer door frames. Management must remove it and maintain the freezer.

headline: Conditions: sushi cooler too warm, food discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Sushi prep cooler air measured 54°F; tuna at 44.8-48.1°F and salmon at 55°F. About 4 pounds discarded, worth $200. Cooler tagged held and must not be used until repaired. Citation issued. Also no covered women's washroom trash receptacle.

headline: Failed: small flies found; no verifiable certificate
summary: Failed re-inspection. About 15 small flies near rear prep, dish, bar and sushi areas; citation issued. No verifiable city sanitation certificate for employees. Also damaged floor tiles, a leaking sink, and dirty reach-in cooler interiors.

headline: Conditions: cold foods too warm; 40 lbs discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Many cold foods in the kitchen unit were above 41°F, including shrimp at 55°F and chopped onion at 65.9°F. 40 pounds ($500) discarded. Unit at 56°F was tagged held. Also no thermometers in bar refrigerators and a littered refuse enclosure.

headline: Conditions: multiple cold foods too warm, discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Food display cooler held several foods above 41°F, including mashed potatoes and tomato sauce at 60°F. Manager voluntarily discarded 28 pounds, worth $450, by denaturing. Citation issued.

headline: Failed: dish machine not sanitizing, 0 ppm
summary: Failed. Low-temperature dish machine was not sanitizing; chlorine measured 0 ppm (parts per million). It was tagged and must not be used until fixed. Uncovered carrots, and repeat violations from July 2025 including unlabeled containers and dirty floors. Citation issued.

headline: Passed; heavy grease on deep fryers
summary: Passed re-inspection. Heavy grease buildup on the sides and bottom of the deep fryers. Management must clean and maintain them.

headline: Passed; floor grout needs repair
summary: Passed re-inspection. Floor tiles inside the walk-in cooler and around the dish area have low grout and must be regrouted.

headline: Passed; ice machine cleaning, faucet repairs
summary: Passed. Pinkish and brownish residue in two ice machines must be cleaned and sanitized. A stripped hot-water knob at a second-floor handsink and a stripped cold-water knob at a three-compartment sink need repair. Employee toilet lacked a covered trash receptacle.

headline: Failed: about 40 mouse droppings in basement
summary: Failed. About 40 mouse droppings found behind a basement locker and inside a cluttered liquor storage room. Citation issued; additional pest control recommended. Also unlabeled salt and pepper, rusty walk-in racks, stained cutting boards, and greasy oven interiors.

headline: Failed: over 20 rat droppings, no manager present
summary: Failed. Over 20 rat droppings were on the floor along a wall in basement dry storage; citation issued and pest control treatment required. Also no person in charge or certified food manager present during food prep and service, and an uncleaned outside grease container.

headline: Passed; no handwashing sign, wet mops stored
summary: Passed. Handwashing sign missing at the handsink next to the grill. Food residue on basement walk-in shelving needs detailed cleaning. Wet mops stored in the prep area and hallway must hang to dry. Food splatter on the wall behind prep coolers needs cleaning.

headline: Failed: dish machines under-sanitizing, corrected on site
summary: Failed. Low-temperature dish machines measured 10 ppm (parts per million) of sanitizer; 50-100 ppm is required. The machine was serviced to 100 ppm during inspection. Citation issued. Also a dirty ice bin, unlabeled containers, and spilled grease outside.

headline: Failed: no hot water, sanitizer at 0 ppm
summary: Failed. Men's handsink had no hot water (62.2°F; 100°F required); citation issued. Chlorine dish machine dispensed 0 ppm (parts per million) and was tagged; dishes were being washed. Also dirty basement, cluttered storage, openings above ice machine, and missing food handler proof.

headline: Conditions: cold foods too warm; cooler held
summary: Passed with conditions. Milk, eggs, sour cream, turkey and cheese were at 47.8-49.1°F in a reach-in cooler; about 50 pounds ($100) discarded. Display cooler at 47.8°F was tagged held. No vomit and diarrhea procedure or supplies. Citations issued.

headline: Passed; plates and bowls not inverted
summary: Passed. Plates and bowls were stored without being inverted. Staff were instructed to invert them after sanitizing and air drying.

headline: Passed; broken thermometers, damaged cutting boards
summary: Passed. Several broken thermometers inside front prep coolers must be repaired or replaced. Three cutting boards had deep grooves and stains. The employee toilet room had no covered trash receptacle.

headline: Passed; rear door gap, no ice bin covers
summary: Passed. The rear exit door has a half-inch gap underneath and is not pest-proof. Also: prep staff lacked hair restraints, wiping cloths sat on the prep table, ice bins lacked covers, and the certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed; greasy floors, no allergen training
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food debris and grease on the floor in the front prep area and behind cooking equipment; more frequent cleaning was instructed to prevent pests. No allergen training was observed; staff were told to obtain it.

headline: Passed; dusty air vents need cleaning
summary: Passed. Dust had built up on the return air vent and air conditioning vents. Inspector instructed a detailed cleaning to prevent possible contamination of food and food-contact surfaces below.

headline: Passed; food debris, trash, peeling walls
summary: Passed. Dried food debris inside a condiment refrigerator and on floors throughout, including under hot-holding equipment and in rear storage. Rear storage walls where beverages are kept have chipping paint and food splatter and need cleanable surfaces.

headline: Passed; food handler lacked training proof
summary: Passed re-inspection. A food handler had no proof of food handler training. Manager instructed to ensure all food employees have valid certificates.

headline: Failed: small flies, no hot water at handsink
summary: Failed. About 15 small flies in rear prep and dish areas. The rear prep handsink had no hot water and drained HVAC condensate. Roast beef and smoked salmon lacked date labels. No employee health policy or food handler proof on site. Multiple citations issued.

headline: Passed; poorly ventilated ice maker closet
summary: Passed. The ice maker sits in a small, poorly ventilated closet; inspector instructed venting to prevent mold on surfaces. Peeling paint on the kitchen ceiling must be removed and maintained.

headline: Passed; dirty coolers, minor sink leak
summary: Passed. Interiors of coolers in the food prep area had food debris and dirt; management must clean them. A minor leak at the three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager, improper thawing
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager or city certificate was on site while pizza and chicken were prepared. Frozen chicken was thawing in standing water. Some staff lacked hair restraints. Citation issued.

headline: Passed; unlabeled food containers, greasy stove
summary: Passed. Rice and other foods were stored outside original containers without product-name labels. An ice scoop was left on top of the ice machine, and stove surfaces had grease buildup.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager; citation issued
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid city certificate was on site, and no certified manager was present while beef, beans and open-serve ice cream were prepared or served. Citation issued. Also a 1/4-inch gap under an exterior door and greasy hood filters.

headline: Passed re-inspection; broken floor tiles near ovens
summary: Passed a complaint re-inspection. Broken and missing floor tiles in front of and around convection ovens in the main kitchen prep area. Management instructed to replace them.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk containers, mixed food storage
summary: Passed. Bulk food containers, such as salt, were unlabeled. Employees' personal food was stored mixed with customers' food in a storage cooler and must be separated.

headline: Failed: repeat sink violation, oversized pots
summary: Failed re-inspection. A previous violation was not corrected: oversized kettles and pots do not fit the three-compartment sink, and no written sanitizing procedure was provided. Citation issued. Also a gap under the front door, worn cutting boards, stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Passed; certified manager lacked allergen training
summary: Passed a complaint re-inspection. The certified food manager on site had no allergen training certificate. The facility was instructed to obtain and keep a valid one.

headline: Failed: about 10 live roaches in food prep
summary: Failed re-inspection. Inspector saw 10 live roaches crawling through the rear food prep and dishwashing area, plus dead roaches in the men's restroom. Manager told to call an exterminator and clean. Also ice machine residue and stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Failed: pest infestation, mouse droppings uncountable
summary: Failed. Dead mice and droppings too numerous to count across the facility, plus dead mice on traps. No licensed pest control operator on contract; citation issued. Also blocked handsinks, raw meat thawed on the floor, and no valid certified manager certificate.

headline: Failed: hot foods held at 100-105°F
summary: Failed. Soups and grilled onions in the hot-hold unit measured 100-105°F; they must be at least 135°F. The person in charge discarded 8 pounds, valued at $50. Also no test strips for the dish machine, garbage around dumpsters, and floor drain buildup.

headline: Passed; plants stored in food prep area
summary: Passed. Potted plants were stored in the food prep area. Inspector instructed staff to keep them away from food.

headline: Failed: mold-like residue in ice machines
summary: Failed. Pink and black mold-like substance inside the kitchen and bar ice machines. Person in charge was told to discard ice and clean and sanitize; citation issued. Also food splatter in cold-hold units, debris in kitchen floor drains, and no manager allergen certificate.

headline: Passed; some food handlers missing training
summary: Passed. Aluminum foil was lining stove surfaces and must be removed. Some food handlers lacked food handler training; proof must be kept on site. The cold prep floor was wet from recent cleaning while staff worked nearby.

headline: Passed; missing handwash signs, leaking dishwasher
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs were missing from all restrooms. Some food storage containers were unlabeled. A slow leak under the low-temperature dishwasher, which still sanitizes properly. Dust on vent above ice machine; manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager; hot water restored
summary: Passed with conditions. No city certified food manager on premises; citation issued. Hot water was initially absent (75-93°F); it was restored during inspection to 110.5°F at the three-compartment sink and 101.2°F at a prep handsink. Also an opening under the front door.

headline: Passed; broken backflow device on mop sink
summary: Passed. A handwashing sign was missing at a prep-area sink, and the backflow preventer on the mop sink faucet was broken. A sanitation manager lacked an allergen training certificate. Staff instructed to repair and comply.

headline: Failed: thawing at room temperature, repeat violations
summary: Failed re-inspection. Frozen acai was thawing at room temperature in the three-compartment sink; it must thaw under 70°F water or in refrigeration. Smoothie container handle had residue. Repeat violations: no metal stem thermometer and no self-closing washroom door; citation issued.

headline: Passed; paper cups used as food scoops
summary: Passed. Staff used paper cups as scoops for bulk food containers. Inspector instructed use of proper scoops.

headline: Passed; dirty bakery sink, no backflow devices
summary: Passed. The bakery three-compartment sink was not clean. Coffee machine water lines lack backflow devices. Prep-area floors have worn grout. A sanitation manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: Passed; many repair and cleaning items
summary: Passed re-inspection with many repair items: rusted racks, raw wood, a cooler propped up with bricks, foil on the stove, stained cutting boards, missing wall and floor tiles, water-damaged drywall behind sinks and ice machine, and greasy equipment.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, no health policy
summary: Failed. No certified food manager certificate and no employee health policy on site. Also a leaking three-compartment sink faucet, unsealed raw wood, foil on the prep table, a bed in a rear room that must be removed, and no allergen training certificate.

headline: Conditions: rat droppings by dumpsters; corrected on site
summary: Passed with conditions. Rat droppings, food debris and loose garbage were on the ground in the dumpster area; the ground was cleaned before inspection ended. No norovirus-effective disinfectant was on site for vomit and diarrhea cleanup; one was delivered before inspection ended. Citations issued.

headline: Failed: about 100 mouse droppings, exposed rodent poison
summary: Failed. About 100 mouse droppings found under the front counter, on sill plates and in the basement; more pest control is needed. Rodent poison was scattered on the basement floor and must be in covered bait stations. Food stored in plastic grocery bags.

headline: Passed; basement debris and stored items
summary: Passed. The basement needs debris cleaned from under, around and along wall bases. Stored articles must be moved off the floor and away from walls.

headline: Failed: no hot water for handwashing or dishes
summary: Failed. Prep and employee restroom handsinks measured 71°F; hand sinks must be at least 100°F. The three-compartment sink measured 71°F; it must be at least 110°F. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or spill kit on site. Manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Failed: unsafe hot and cold holding temperatures
summary: Failed. Fried fish held at 94.5-105.6°F; hot foods must be at least 135°F. Octopus, ground pork and squid at 46.5-47.1°F; cold foods must be 41°F or below. A cooler at 50.1°F was tagged held. About 10 pounds discarded. Leaking grease trap and no employee health policy; citations issued.

headline: Passed; no covered sanitary napkin receptacle
summary: Passed. The all-gender washroom had no covered receptacle for sanitary napkin disposal. Facility was instructed to provide one.

headline: Passed; ice machine lining not cleaned
summary: Passed. Inner lining of the ice machine was not cleaned; staff instructed to clean and sanitize. Serving plates and bowls on kitchen prep shelves must be inverted to prevent dust.

headline: Conditions: blocked handsink, no soap, unposted report
summary: Passed with conditions. Front prep handsink was blocked by a tray and bucket; no soap at prep or dish handsinks. Staff fixed both during inspection. Broken women's restroom hand dryer. Inspection summary not posted; expired allergen certificate. Citations issued.

headline: No certified manager certificate posted; hood lights out
summary: Passed with conditions. No city certified food manager certificate was posted; citation issued. Also noted: missing handwashing sign, greasy microwave and toaster oven, two non-working exhaust hood lights, and no allergen training for managers.

headline: Failed: no hot running water; no front handsink
summary: Failed. No hot running water was on site; handsinks read 73°F and the three-compartment sink 74.9°F, which must reach 100°F and 110°F. A priority citation was issued. The front prep area also needs a handwashing sink.

headline: Passed with conditions; missing soap and towels
summary: Passed with conditions. Rear restroom and dish handwashing sinks lacked soap, and the rear restroom sink lacked paper towels; a citation was issued. Also: food scooped with disposable containers lacking handles, and uncovered restroom trash cans.

headline: Passed with conditions; home-prepared food stored
summary: Passed with conditions. Vacuum-packed home-prepared food was stored in the rear prep cooler for personal use; the person in charge was told to remove it. Only food bought from licensed suppliers may be stored. A citation was issued.

headline: Passed with conditions; cold food, hot water issues
summary: Passed with conditions. Cold food held at 46.0–62.8°F; about 20 lbs ($400) discarded. Hot water was absent but restored on site (now 118.6–124.3°F). Menu notices for undercooked foods were added on site. A cold display unit at 54.7°F was tagged.

headline: Passed; mops on floor and freezer ice buildup
summary: Passed. A handwashing sign was missing at the grill-line sink, and an employee bathroom trash can had no lid. Mops were on the floor, the walk-in freezer had heavy ice buildup, and food debris was below the three-compartment sink.

headline: Passed; written cleaning procedure needed for kettle
summary: Passed. A large kettle used for soy milk could not be submerged in the three-compartment sink; the operator must provide a written cleaning procedure for it. An old, unused soft drink system in attic storage must be removed.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager on duty
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid City-certified food manager was on duty while chicken and seafood were prepared and served; a citation was issued. Also needed: deli slicer cleaning and cleaning of rear prep floors, drains, walls and ceilings.

headline: Passed re-inspection; several cleaning and labeling issues
summary: Passed re-inspection. Ice chute and dipper well had black residue; a fly trap hung above a prep refrigerator must be moved. Some food handlers lacked hair restraints, spices lacked labels, and wet wiping cloths were left on surfaces.

headline: Passed; missing splashguard
summary: Passed. A splashguard is needed between the rear handsink and the rear prep table next to the one-compartment sink to prevent contamination.

headline: Failed: rat droppings, missing handwashing supplies
summary: Failed. About 50 or more rat droppings were on the basement floor near hot water tanks. Missing: signed employee health policies, hand soap at prep sink, hand dryers in restrooms. A hot-holding cabinet measured 111.7°F, below the 135°F minimum.

headline: Passed re-inspection; backflow device and training gaps
summary: Passed re-inspection. Ice machine had no visible backflow device and its interior needs cleaning. Sump pump lid had holes that must be sealed against rodents. A new employee needs food handler training, and managers need allergen training.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; missing handwashing supplies
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site while chicken and fish were prepared and served; citation issued. Prep-area sink lacked soap and paper towels; both were supplied during inspection. Several training gaps noted.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager present
summary: Passed with conditions. No City-certified food manager was on the premises while pizza and salads, which need temperature control, were prepared and served; a citation was issued.

headline: Passed; front door gap and stained cutting boards
summary: Passed. The front door has a quarter-inch gap and is not rodent or insect proofed. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer, and cutting boards are stained and grooved. Floors under heavy equipment need detail cleaning.

headline: Passed; greasy hood and missing allergen proof
summary: Passed. Grease was on the prep-area ventilation hood and must be cleaned. No allergen training certificate was on site for certified managers, who must provide one.

headline: No certified manager; dish machine repaired on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No City-certified food manager was on premises while pork, chicken and seafood were prepared; citation issued. Dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine; repaired on site to 50 ppm. Dead insects found on glue boards.

headline: Passed with conditions; no vomit kit on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No vomit and diarrhea response kit or procedure was on site; a one-page guide was left, and a norovirus-effective sanitizer must be kept. Also: a torn cooler gasket, a burnt-out bulb, dusty vents, and missing training certificates.

headline: Failed: roaches found; pest control recommended
summary: Failed. Dead roaches were found in several spots, including cooler door tracks and behind cooking equipment. Two live roaches were seen in the dining area and rear hallway. Clean affected areas; pest control service is recommended.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; handwash sink too cold
summary: Failed. No City-certified food manager was on site while chicken and beef, which must be kept hot or cold, were prepared and served; a citation was issued. The prep handwashing sink measured 70°F; it must reach at least 100°F.

headline: Failed: slime in ice machine; no handwashing sign
summary: Failed. Ice machine interior was heavily soiled with black and gray slime dripping onto ice used for consumption; ice was to be discarded and citation issued. Also: missing handwashing sign, leaking pipe, scoops stored in food.

headline: Passed re-inspection; food stored on floor
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food was stored on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised six inches; cardboard-lined shelves must be cleared. Worn grout near the three-compartment sink causes standing water. Certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Passed; food-encrusted sheets outside, items on floor
summary: Passed. Food-encrusted baking sheets were stored outdoors and must be moved indoors and cleaned. Stored items must be off the floor. Staff lacked proof of food handler training, and a manager's allergen certificate has expired.

headline: Passed with conditions; hot unit too cool, tagged
summary: Passed with conditions. A deli hot-holding unit reached only 102°F; it needs 135°F or above. It was tagged and is not to be used until repaired. Also noted: rust, damaged hinges, dirty sink basins, and a crowded freezer.

headline: Passed with conditions; inspection summary not posted
summary: Passed with conditions. The previous inspection summary was not in plain view for customers; the manager found it in a binder in the office. It was corrected on site, and a citation was issued.

headline: Re-inspection passed; wall holes and rust noted
summary: Passed re-inspection. Several holes in first-floor furnace-closet walls and detached wall panels in the basement walk-in cooler must be repaired. Exposed untreated wood and heavy rust on cooler shelves must be resurfaced or replaced.

headline: Failed: no pest control log; unlabeled bulk food
summary: Failed. No pest control log with current invoices was provided (last invoice dated 1-5-24); citation issued. Bulk flour and sugar lacked labels, a food guard was missing at pizza prep, and a sanitation manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Failed: roaches, mouse droppings, unsafe cold food
summary: Failed. About 40 live cockroaches were near the main cookline, and about 75 and 50 mouse droppings were found. Cold food held up to 60°F; about 15 pounds ($300) was discarded. Cooler not to be used until repaired.

headline: Passed; debris around dumpster
summary: Passed. Debris around the dumpster must be cleaned and maintained by the person in charge.

headline: Passed; expired food handler certificates
summary: Passed. Following a suspected food poisoning report, expired food handler training certificates were found on site; all employees must have valid training and keep records on site.

headline: Passed; food debris on can opener and cooler
summary: Passed. Food debris was found on a can opener and inside a prep cooler along the cookline; both must be cleaned and kept clean.

headline: Passed with conditions; no signed health policies
summary: Passed with conditions. No signed employee health policies were available for review, and handwashing signs were missing from the toilet room. Torn gaskets with dried food debris were on a three-door prep cooler. Managers need allergen training certificates on site.

headline: Passed with conditions; missing soap and towels
summary: Passed with conditions. The unisex toilet room had no hand soap; the person in charge (PIC) supplied soap at the close of inspection. Prep-area handsink lacked hand drying supplies, supplied during inspection. A food employee had no food handler training.

headline: Passed; mop must be stored to air-dry
summary: Passed. A mop was stored in a position that prevents drying, which can encourage pest hiding places. It must be mounted so it air-dries without soiling.

headline: Passed; wiping cloths left on boards
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were left on a cutting board and in a pile in a prep cooler. In-use cloths must stay in sanitizing buckets, and unused cloths must be stored away from food.

headline: Passed with conditions; unsafe cold food discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Beef, chicken and rice were held above 41°F in the prep cooler (beef up to 82.3°F); the operator discarded them during inspection. A citation was issued. Grease, a small leak, and floor debris also noted.

headline: Passed re-inspection; improper thawing, hair restraints
summary: Passed re-inspection. Prepackaged beef was thawing in a bin on the floor under a compartment sink, and food bins were stored on the walk-in floor. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Also: a handsink leak and dirty floors and walls.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings, flies, ceiling hole
summary: Failed. About 20 rodent droppings were found near the rear water heater, and 3–5 large live flies were flying around food prep areas. Rainwater dripped from a ceiling hole into a garbage can in prep. Pest control recommended.

headline: Passed; hair restraint and allergen training missing
summary: Passed. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint, and a City-certified sanitation manager had no allergen training certificate. Both must be provided.

headline: Passed with conditions; no employee health policy
summary: Passed with conditions. No written employee health policy was on premises; management must provide signed policies for each employee. No handwashing signs were posted at the employee washroom sink. No citation issued.

headline: Passed with conditions; 80 lbs cold food discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Many cold foods were held at 49.6–61.9°F; about 80 lbs ($700) was discarded. Several cold-holding units ran at 50.7–52.7°F and were tagged. Damaged gaskets, peeling duct insulation, and a non-self-closing restroom door also noted.

headline: Passed; fryer bottom and floors need cleaning
summary: Passed. Clean the bottom of the fryer and the storage area floor. Replace a water-stained kitchen ceiling tile where needed.

headline: Failed: missing hand sink; broken dish machine gauge
summary: Failed. The dishwashing prep area needs a handwashing sink (citation issued). The dish machine's temperature gauge was not working (citation issued). Milk crates were used as shelving, and food debris and spills were found on floors and surfaces.

headline: Passed with conditions; summary not posted
summary: Passed with conditions. A leaking pipe under the produce-prep three-compartment sink must be repaired. A bakery stove was not under the exhaust hood. No summary was posted for public view; a new one was left and a citation issued.

headline: Passed; greasy cooking equipment
summary: Passed. Cooking equipment had grease buildup on its exterior and must be degreased and maintained.

headline: Failed: over 200 mouse droppings, dirty ice machine
summary: Failed. Over 200 mouse droppings were found in kitchen, storage and dining areas; about 10 small flies were near the sink and serving area. Ice machine reservoir still had black slime. Repeat violations; citations issued.

headline: Passed with conditions; dish machines too cool
summary: Passed with conditions. Low-temperature dish machines in the first and second floor bars washed at 103–106°F, below the 120°F minimum; they were tagged held for inspection. An ice scoop stored by a sink was moved on site.

headline: Passed with conditions; manager absent, unsafe temperatures
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager was on site from 1:05 to 1:30 PM while chicken was prepared and served; citation issued. Dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine; corrected to 100 ppm. Cold chicken at 50.8°F was discarded.

headline: Passed; leaking sink and missing thermometers
summary: Passed. Reach-in cooling units lacked thermometers inside. A leak at the rear food service handsink must be repaired, and the floor under the front bar soda boxes needs detail cleaning to help prevent pest activity.

headline: Passed; greasy equipment; managers lack allergen proof
summary: Passed. Clean the fryer interiors, the prep table legs and wheels, the ice machine interior, and the grease on the wall behind cooking equipment. Certified managers must show proof of allergen training.

headline: Passed; worn cutting boards and detail cleaning
summary: Passed. Outer aprons must be removed before entering the restroom. Worn or discolored cutting boards need replacing, and the air-drying rack, cooking equipment, floors, and air vents need detail cleaning.

headline: Passed; dirty dispensers and restroom trash
summary: Passed. Beverage dispensers need cleaning to remove buildup. The toilet room needs covered waste cans, and grout lines at the three-compartment sink area need cleaning and regrouting.

headline: Passed; rear door gap and no hair restraints
summary: Passed. The rear door has a half-inch gap underneath and is not rodent or insect proofed; it must be sealed. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Trash and debris were around the dumpsters.

headline: Failed: dead roaches and greasy equipment
summary: Failed. Numerous dead roaches were on glue boards and equipment in prep and bar areas. Fryers, prep tables and coolers had grease and debris. No sanitizer test kit was available (citation issued).

headline: Re-inspection passed; ice and grease buildup noted
summary: Passed re-inspection. Ice buildup was found on a cooler unit holding ice cream toppings, grease and debris in a fryer compartment, and floor spills. Staff were told to clean and maintain these areas.

headline: Failed: cracked cooler ceiling, repeat violation
summary: Failed. A repeat violation from a 2023 inspection was not corrected: the walk-in cooler's ceiling is cracked and must be repaired.

headline: Passed; taped faucet and peeling paint
summary: Passed. A leaking three-compartment sink faucet was repaired with tape, which is not acceptable. Peeling paint on the utility mop closet ceiling and wall must be repaired, and debris around the ice machine must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; hole in wall needs closing
summary: Passed. A hole in the wall under the three-compartment sink area must be closed.

headline: Passed re-inspection; missing backflow device, clutter
summary: Passed re-inspection. No backflow prevention device was found on the hot water machine beside the ice machine; one must be provided where it can be serviced. Clutter, including old equipment and pallets, must be removed from the basement.

headline: Passed; food on floors and door gap
summary: Passed. Cases of water and soda were stored on the floor throughout; these must be raised six inches, and milk crates and cardboard used as shelving or flooring must be removed. A quarter-inch gap under the entrance door needs sealing.

headline: Passed; food handler lacked hair restraint, training
summary: Passed. A food handler was working without a hair restraint and without food handler training. The manager was instructed to provide both.

headline: Failed: no manager, mouse droppings, unsafe cold food
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site until 2:30 PM; corrected when one arrived. Over 50 mouse droppings were found throughout, and a citation was issued. Cold food at 46.8–54.9°F was discarded (about 7.5 lbs). Pest control was recommended.

headline: Failed: no hot restroom water, rodent droppings
summary: Failed. Restroom handwashing sinks had no hot water (52°F women's, 56°F men's; 100°F required). About 125 small rodent droppings were found across multiple areas, including near food storage and tamale prep. Pest control and cleanup required; citations issued.

headline: Failed: no sanitizer, thermometer, or service sink
summary: Failed. No sanitizer was on site for dishes, and no metal-stem food thermometer was available for checking cold food. The facility also has no service sink, which the manager was told to install.

headline: Passed re-inspection; water puddles on floor
summary: Passed re-inspection. Puddles of water on the floor near the mop sink and office must be removed and kept dry.

headline: Passed; detail cleaning and lidded trash needed
summary: Passed. Reach-in cooler doors and interiors in the prep area, plus walk-in shelving, need detail cleaning. Employee rear restroom needs a lidded trash can. A broken floor edge at dishwashing should be repaired to prevent standing water.

headline: Re-inspection passed; grease and missing training proof
summary: Passed re-inspection. Fryer and microwave exteriors had excess grease and debris; floors under pallets and the grill line were dirty. Proof of food handler and allergen training was missing for required staff and certified managers.

headline: Passed; door gaps and several upkeep repairs
summary: Passed. Front and rear doors have gaps that must be sealed to keep out pests. Also needed: handwashing sign, garbage can lid, pipe and floor repairs, stained ceiling tiles, dusty vent, mop hooks, and a burned-out light.

headline: Passed; gaps, unlabeled containers, wall damage
summary: Passed. The rear exit door has a quarter-inch gap at the bottom and must be made tight-fitting. Dry containers lack labels, equipment is stored on the floor, and the wall near the three-compartment sink needs repair. Standing water also noted.

headline: Passed re-inspection; quarter-inch gap under door
summary: Passed re-inspection. A quarter-inch gap under the entrance door to the outside must be closed with a tight-fitting door to keep out pests.

headline: Passed with conditions; sink backed up, repaired
summary: Passed with conditions. Water backed up into the three-compartment sink basins when another basin drained; a plumber repaired it during inspection; citation issued. Food containers were stored on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised six inches.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager
summary: Passed with conditions. No City-certified food manager was on the premises; the operator was told one must be present at all times. A citation was issued.

headline: Passed; meat thawed in water too warm
summary: Passed. Meat was thawing under running water at 72°F; water must be 70°F or below, or meat must thaw refrigerated at 41°F or below. Sauce containers lacked labels, fryers had minor grease, and several food handlers lacked training proof.

headline: Passed; front door not fully rodent-proof
summary: Passed. The front entrance door was not fully rodent-proofed on one side; the door sweep must be adjusted or replaced. Fryer exteriors and bottoms, the can opener blade, and floors under fryers need cleaning.

headline: Passed; nonworking lights, no training certificates
summary: Passed. Nonworking lights were noted near the three-compartment sink, exit door and hot water tank; hood filters had buildup. No food handler training certificates were on site, and allergen certificates were missing or expired.

headline: Passed; inoperable prep sink, damaged trim
summary: Passed. The prep/dump sink at the front beverage station is inoperable and must be repaired. Window frame and wall trim at the rear drive-thru window have gaps and must be repaired to be tight-fitting and cleanable.

headline: Passed; water-stained ceiling tiles and dusty vents
summary: Passed. Water-stained ceiling tiles in the prep area should be replaced where needed, and ceiling vents need cleaning. Staff who are not City-certified managers must get food handler training, and managers need allergen training.

headline: Passed; unlabeled food and tin-can storage
summary: Passed. Food items in refrigerators were unlabeled and some were stored inside tin cans; food must be labeled and kept in approved food-grade containers. Floors along walls and under equipment, especially at the rear, need cleaning.

headline: Passed; rear door gap and beard guard
summary: Passed. The rear door has a quarter-inch gap at the bottom and must be made tight-fitting and rodent-proof. A male food handler with a beard had no beard guard.

headline: Passed; dirty ice bin and cooler interiors
summary: Passed. Clean the top interior of the upstairs ice bin, grime inside cold holding units, and food debris under upstairs booths. Pizza boxes must be stored inverted, and grease on hood filters must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; rusty racks and damaged floors
summary: Passed. Rusty shelving and peeling paint in a rear reach-in cooler, a dirty soda ice chute, and damaged floor tiles and coving need repair. Floors behind the ice machine are dirty, and certified managers lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Passed re-inspection; cleaning needed throughout
summary: Passed re-inspection. Ice scoops were stored in ice containers; beverage nozzles, service-line shelves, food equipment, toilet fixtures and dining and service floors need cleaning. Wiping cloths need fresher sanitizing solution.

headline: Passed; cardboard liners and greasy equipment
summary: Passed. Cardboard was used as shelf liner in the prep area and must be removed. Cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, freezers and shelving had grease and food debris; floors need cleaning. A bulb on the main prep line is burnt out.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing sign in restroom
summary: Passed. The women's restroom had no handwashing sign; the operator was instructed to post one.

headline: Passed; missing signs, backflow device, allergen proof
summary: Passed. Restrooms lacked handwashing signs, the ice maker had no backflow device that could be located, and food service managers had no allergen training certificate. The operator was told to post signs, install the device, and obtain certificates.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings and no hot handwash water
summary: Failed. Over 40 mouse droppings were on rear storage shelves; an exterminator must be called. The front washroom handwashing sink had 51.8°F water; it must reach at least 100°F. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedures or supplies were on site.

headline: Passed; grease and potato dicer need cleaning
summary: Passed. The potato dicer on the rear prep area wall needs cleaning, and a small amount of grease on the floor under the fryer must be cleaned.

headline: Passed re-inspection; no food handler certificates on site
summary: Passed re-inspection. No food handler or allergen certificates were on site, and wiping cloths lacked sanitizing buckets. A knife was tucked behind the sink and must be cleaned and stored properly. Cooking equipment, floors and walls need detail cleaning.

headline: Complaint: sanitation managers lack allergen training
summary: Passed. Several City-certified sanitation managers had no allergen training; they must provide proof of training.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings, flies, unsafe cold holding
summary: Failed. About 100 mouse droppings were found in storage and kitchen areas, plus 30 or more flies. Eggs and cream cheese pie filling were above 57°F; 50 lbs discarded. A back-prep refrigerator at 54.3°F was tagged and held.

headline: Failed: about 60 mouse droppings in storage
summary: Failed. About 60 mouse droppings were found in the basement dry storage, and a citation was issued; the person in charge must clean, sanitize, and inform pest control. Also: missing handwashing sign, unlabeled sugar, and a blown kitchen hood light.

headline: Passed; one burned-out ceiling light
summary: Passed. One burned-out ceiling light bulb above the prep area, between the handwashing sinks, must be replaced.

headline: Failed: uncorrected restroom and ventilation issues
summary: Failed. A repeat violation from a 2024 inspection was not corrected: the restroom needs a covered trash receptacle and the mechanical ventilation needs grease cleaning. A citation was issued.

headline: Passed; scrap materials in outdoor area
summary: Passed. The enclosed rear outdoor area held scrap materials and equipment, which must be removed.

headline: Passed with conditions; blocked handwash sinks
summary: Passed with conditions. Handwashing sinks in the prep and dishwashing areas were blocked by bread trays and grease containers; a citation was issued. Also: a torn cooler gasket, a leaking three-compartment sink faucet, and employee belongings stored with food.

headline: Passed; ice machine debris and sink leak
summary: Passed. Debris was encrusted inside the ice machine and must be removed and the machine serviced. A leak under the rear prep handsink must be repaired. The front bar handsink also needs a handwashing sign.

headline: Passed with conditions; prep handwash water too cold
summary: Passed with conditions. Prep-area handwashing sink water measured 78.6°F, below the 100°F minimum; the manager repaired it during inspection, now 112.4°F. Also: no food handler or allergen certificates on site, beard restraints needed, and leaks noted.

headline: Passed; leaking faucet and damaged floors
summary: Passed. A leaking three-compartment sink faucet must be repaired. Missing wall tiles in the washroom need replacing, and loose baseboards and damaged floor grout in prep and storage areas need repair.

headline: Passed; stained cutting boards, missing allergen training
summary: Passed. Cutting boards in three areas had stains and deep cuts and must be refinished or replaced. The front microwave was unclean and missing a plate. The person in charge must complete allergen training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Passed with conditions; live dog inside
summary: Passed with conditions. A customer with a live dog was inside the establishment, and management did not address it during inspection. No live animals are allowed, and a citation was issued.

headline: Failed: dirty ice machine and uncorrected violations
summary: Failed. Ice machine lining was not cleaned, and ice buildup was found in basement chest freezers. Employees worked without food handler certificates, and managers lacked allergen training. Prior violations, including a torn gasket and cardboard shelf liners, were not corrected.

headline: No certified manager; moldy ice machines
summary: Failed. No City of Chicago certified food manager was on site or posted. Ice machines had black, mold-like buildup inside, and the ice is used for people. The manager was told to discard all ice, clean and sanitize the machines, and maintain them.

headline: No current food manager certificate
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed with conditions. No current City of Chicago food manager certificate was on site. The manager was instructed to provide one; a citation was issued.

headline: Door gap, grease, and leaking drain
summary: A 1/4-inch gap under the front entrance door must be repaired to keep pests out. The front bar handwashing sink lacked signage. Grease was found inside the deep fryer and dirt in the walk-in freezer. A three-compartment sink drain leaks, and hood filters need grease and dust removed.

headline: Mouse droppings; expired food handler cards
summary: Failed. No employee health policies were on premises; citation issued. Over 80 mouse droppings were found behind the ice machine, around cooking equipment, and in fryers. Pest control is required before reinspection. Expired food handler certificates and unlabeled bulk containers were found.

headline: Unlabeled spices by wok station
summary: Re-inspection passed. Spices were out of their original packaging and held in containers by the wok station without product name labels. Common-name labels are required for all food removed from original packaging.

headline: Rear door gap, dirty cooler, and missing labels
summary: Re-inspection passed. A rear door gap of at least 1/4 inch must be enclosed to prevent pests. A seasoning bucket lacks a label. Cardboard lines a prep table and is greasy. Cooler and freezer interiors have dried food residue. Missing self-closing door and food handler certificates.

headline: Cold food too warm; expired food handler cards
summary: Several foods that must stay cold were held at 44–63°F. The manager discarded 3 lbs of cheese, 20 lbs of chicken, and 9 gallons of milk (about $200). A cooler held air at 51°F and was tagged. Expired food handler certificates were found on site.

headline: Unlabeled storage containers; cardboard liner
summary: Food storage containers are not labeled with their common names and must be labeled. Cardboard lining the bottom of a storage shelf in the rear prep area must be removed so the surface is smooth and cleanable.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; washroom vent broken
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies were on premises; citation issued. Mechanical ventilation in the rear unisex washroom does not work and must be repaired.

headline: Food held too warm; food on floors
summary: Fried chicken at 65.5°F and rib tips at 48.7°F were held above 41°F; the manager discarded 6 lbs ($70). Food containers and single-use items were stored on the floor. No chemical test kit was available for sanitizer. Floors, fans, and vents have grease and dust.

headline: Thermometer, cutting board, and tile repairs
summary: Pizza prep cooler needs a visible thermometer. Flour container must be labeled. A cutting board with deep seams needs replacing. A hand sink in the rear prep area drains slowly. Missing wall tile in front prep area; washroom ventilation not working.

headline: Soda station and fryers need cleaning
summary: Soda machine drain board and box soda station floor drains have buildup and food debris. Fryer sides need cleaning. Storage shelves have food spills and cabinet exteriors are sticky. Dining and rear prep floors need cleaning at wall bases.

headline: Food in grocery bags; freezer ice buildup
summary: Food items were stored in grocery bags in the freezer and must be kept in food-grade containers. Ice has built up on the walk-in freezer floor and ceiling; condensation units must be repaired. Cardboard and unused items on the back prep floor must be removed.

headline: Hot beans cooled improperly
summary: Whole cooked beans at 198°F were stored covered in a deep bussing tub in the walk-in cooler to cool. The manager was instructed to break food into smaller containers and store it uncovered. Priority violation cited.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; greasy hood filters
summary: A torn door gasket on a two-door cooler must be replaced. Kitchen exhaust hood and filters need detail cleaning to remove grease buildup. The certified food manager lacks an allergen training certificate and must complete training and keep proof on site.

headline: Rodent droppings found; health policy missing
summary: Failed. No employee health policy was on site. About 25 rodent droppings were found under cooking equipment, under the three-compartment sink, inside the fryer, and between the refrigerator and prep table. Pest control was recommended. A water tank inlet door would not lock.

headline: No certified manager; chicken held too warm
summary: No certified food manager was on site at arrival; a manager from another location came in. Fried chicken was held at 80–110°F instead of 135°F or above. The manager discarded 20 lbs ($100) of chicken. Citations were issued.

headline: Employee drinking by dishes; chemicals mislabeled
summary: An employee drank from an open can in the dishwashing area and was told to drink only in a designated area. Spray bottles used for cleaner were holding lime juice and soy sauce. Oil tank grease spills, dusty fan, and an expired allergen certificate were also found.

headline: Accessible restroom toilet leaks
summary: A toilet in the women's accessible restroom leaks at the flushing handle. The person in charge must repair and maintain it.

headline: Burned oven door and debris in storage
summary: The Turbochef oven door rim is burned and peeling; repair or replace. Wrappers, tape, and debris are in the back storage and front prep areas. A hole in the front prep area floor must be repaired.

headline: Unlabeled containers and missing beard restraints
summary: Dry storage containers lack common-name labels. Male employees with beards lacked beard restraints. Wiping cloths were improperly stored. Hood system above the cooking line has excessive dust and debris. Certified managers lack allergen training verification.

headline: Undated foods discarded; cooler at 58°F tagged
summary: Failed. Prepared foods held over 24 hours lacked discard-date labels; all were discarded. A two-door prep cooler at 58°F was tagged. No metal stem thermometer was on site. The rear screened door has a 1-inch gap and duct tape repairs. No food handler proof was provided.

headline: Dish machine lacks sanitizer; tagged
summary: The low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine sanitizer; 50–100 ppm is required. It ran between 108°F and 120°F; 120°F is the minimum. The machine is tagged. Ice machine interior has mineral buildup, and heavy clutter in the rear and basement must be removed.

headline: Rear door needs rodent-proofing; mold-like racks
summary: The bottom of the rear exit door must be rodent-proofed. Storage racks inside the walk-in and display cooler have mold-like buildup. Hand sinks and the three-compartment sink need detail cleaning. Unused items in rear storage and dust on the condenser fan cover.

headline: Allergen training required for managers
summary: Re-inspection passed. All City of Chicago food service managers must obtain the required food allergen training.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; food on floor
summary: Failed. More than 100 mouse droppings were found on floors, ledges, tables, shelves, and outlets in prep, storage, and basement areas. An exterminator must be called and areas cleaned. Food was on the walk-in floor, and food handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: No handwashing signs; milk crates and leaks
