summary: No handwashing signs near the front serving sink; must be provided. Milk crates are used for elevating products and must be replaced with approved shelving. The rear three-compartment sink faucet base leaks. Basement floor drain has dirt and food debris.

headline: Cold food too warm; walk-in cooler tagged
summary: Chicken, shell eggs, and tofu in the walk-in cooler were held at 44.6–48.6°F. The manager voluntarily and immediately discarded 75 lbs ($2,050). The walk-in cooler, at 50°F, was tagged and held for city health inspection.

headline: Stained cutting boards on prep coolers
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Stained cutting boards were on top of the prep line coolers in the front prep areas. The manager was told to resurface or replace them and keep them maintained.

headline: Hair restraints missing; low floor grout
summary: Some food handlers lacked hair restraints; the manager must require hats or hairnets. Floor grout under and around the three-compartment sink is low and must be regrouted. Floor under the rear ice machine needs detail cleaning. Mop sink closet ceiling lights are not working.

headline: Greasy fryers; leaking coffee and soda machines
summary: Sides of fryers and cooking equipment need grease removal. Leaks at a coffee pot and a soda machine must be corrected. The toilet room needs a covered waste can. Floors under the three-compartment sink need cleaning to remove buildup.

headline: Many missing items; no certified manager
summary: Failed. No City of Chicago certified food manager certificate was on premises. Missing: vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit, glass and dish machines, calibrated thermometer, test strips, pest control logbook, sink stoppers, covered trash, dumpster contract, and allergen certificate. A 1/4-inch rear door gap was noted.

headline: No inspection summary posted; dusty cooler vent
summary: No current inspection summary was posted for the public, so a citation was issued. The display cooler for sandwiches and drinks had excessive dust and food buildup inside, and the manager was told to detail clean it.

headline: Undated food discarded; gaps and grease
summary: Failed. Prepared foods in the garage walk-in had no date labels and were discarded. The screened rear door has 1-inch gaps. Cardboard and tape seal a washroom door opening. Floors have heavy debris. Cooler gaskets and microwave interior are greasy. Allergen proof is missing.

headline: Bar glass washers not sanitizing
summary: Both bar glass washers showed 0 ppm chlorine sanitizer; priority violation cited. Multi-use utensils must be washed and sanitized at the three-compartment sink or high-temperature dish machine. Slight buildup inside both ice machines. Dirt in the bar floor drain.

headline: Rat droppings and live roaches; pest service ordered
summary: Failed. About 60 or more rat droppings were found on floors, under coolers, behind unused coolers, and in wall gaps, plus live roaches. Areas must be cleaned and sanitized, and a pest control operator must service the premises. Rear door gap and broken front glass also noted.

headline: Front prep sink must be installed
summary: Re-inspection passed with a required fix. A one-compartment prep sink with hot and cold running water that drains properly must be installed in the front food and beverage prep area.

headline: Leaks, standing water, and dusty vents
summary: A loose faucet and leak at the rear handsink, and a leak under the soda dispenser. Standing water behind the ice, ice cream, and slushy machines must be traced. Floors under shelving and the soda cabinet need detail cleaning. Front service area vents are dusty.

headline: Bar dish machine not sanitizing; utensils stored wet
summary: The low-temperature dish machine at the bar showed 0 ppm chlorine at final rinse; the manager must provide proper sanitizer concentration. Priority violation. Knives and spatulas were kept in room-temperature stagnant water and must be stored dry in a clean container.

headline: Roaches and rodent droppings; no certified manager
summary: Failed. No City sanitation manager was on site while chicken and shrimp were handled; citation issued. A hand sink was blocked and cleared during inspection. Pizza held at 98°F was discarded. Dead roaches, about 20 rodent droppings, and one live roach were found; pest control is recommended.

headline: Leaks, stagnant water, and expired certificate
summary: Leaks at a rear three-compartment sink faucet and under the main bar sink. A bucket of stagnant water must be discarded. Two trash cans lack lids, and ceiling tiles are stained or missing. Blown bulbs, clutter, and one food handler with an expired certificate. Previous violations were not corrected.

headline: Missing health policies, cleanup kit, and hair restraints
summary: No signed employee health policies and no vomit and diarrhea cleanup items were found. An employee ate in the prep area. Hand sink signs and better drains are needed. Dish machine needs delimed. Food handler certificates and allergen certificates for the food manager are missing.

headline: Sanitation certificate not posted; splash guard
summary: No original city sanitation certificate was posted or validly documented; copies are not accepted. The manager must post the original and keep a certified manager on site. A splash guard is needed at the one-compartment prep sink. Walk-in needs raised storage racks.

headline: Missing handwashing sign at serving area
summary: No handwashing sign was found at the hand sink in the front serving area. The business must provide one.

headline: No certified manager posted; grime in hoods
summary: Failed. No City of Chicago food service manager certificate was posted while open; citation issued. No chemical sanitizer test devices were on site. The paper towel dispenser is broken. Hood filters over cooking equipment are heavily caked with dust and grime. One employee lacked food handler training.

headline: No hot water at prep handsink
summary: The handwashing sink near the prep area lacks hot and cold running water; priority violation, no citation issued. Cardboard boxes line shelves and must be removed to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: Frozen chicken thawing on table
summary: Frozen solid chicken was thawing on a table. The inspector instructed staff to thaw chicken under refrigeration or cold running water, and to correct and maintain this practice.

headline: Splash barrier needed by mop sink
summary: The utensil rack next to the mop sink was clean. The manager was told to install a barrier to prevent splashing from the mop sink onto items.

headline: No health policy; cooler at 50°F
summary: Failed. No signed employee health policy was on site. Several hand sinks lacked hand drying supplies and hand cleanser. No consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods. An upright prep cooler is inoperable and a display cooler reads 50°F. Dusty dishwashing vent.

headline: No sanitation manager; no thermometer
summary: Failed. No City sanitation manager was on site while hot dogs and taquitos were handled; citation issued. The person in charge lacks a certificate. No stem thermometer, a food handler lacks a hair restraint, and sinks and counters are dirty. Dumpster has garbage spills.

headline: Manager absent; unlabeled cooked foods
summary: No sanitation manager was on site while food was being prepped until 11:50 AM; citation issued. Cooked rice, chicken, pork, and soups lacked discard labels; the manager corrected this on site. Food was on the walk-in floor, and soiled wiping cloths sat on prep tables.

headline: Sushi rice vinegar lacks pH verification
summary: Vinegar was added to sushi rice without a certified lab letter or a working pH meter; priority violation cited. Missing handwashing signs and an internal thermometer in the oyster bar cooler. Shrimp was tightly covered while cooling. Ice bin stored uncovered next to a handwash sink.

headline: No certified manager; roaches and dumpster overflow
summary: Failed. No City of Chicago food service manager certificate was found, and a ServSafe card was not accepted. Five live adult roaches were found in the kitchen sink and on the wall. Pest control is required before reinspection. The dumpster was overflowing.

headline: Cold foods too warm; food discarded on site
summary: Many cold foods, including shrimp, eggs, chicken, and beef, were held at 50.2–55.9°F instead of 41°F or below. The manager corrected this on site by discarding about 120 lbs ($500). A walk-in cooler held food at 52.2°F. No metal stem thermometer was on site; one was delivered before the inspection ended.

headline: Can opener rust; leaking faucet
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. The can opener blade had food debris and rust and must be smooth and cleanable. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks and is in poor repair.

headline: No certified manager; no employee health policy
summary: No certified food manager or original certificate was posted while eggs, sausage, milk, and nacho cheese were handled. No verifiable employee health policy was on site; citation issued. Prep cooler thermometers were missing, and no food handler certificates were available for review.

headline: Hot water, paper towels, and dish machine failures
summary: Failed. Hand sinks lacked hot water (at least 100°F required) in the butcher area and both toilet rooms. The dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer and was tagged. Reduced-oxygen packaging was done without a variance; 350 lbs of food tagged. Milk crates used as shelves.

headline: No hair restraints; utility sink drain problem
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. The utility sink drainpipe is not connected properly and drains water on the floor. No waste receptacles at handwashing sinks. Debris under equipment, a missing light shield, and missing food handler training.

headline: Mop stored in a non-drying position
summary: A mop was stored in a position where it could not dry properly, which can create pest hiding places. The manager must store mops after use in a mounted position that lets them air-dry without soiling.

headline: Dusty light shields and vent
summary: Light shields in the food prep area and above counters have dust buildup and must be cleaned. The vent over the handwashing sink near the prep area also needs cleaning and maintenance.

headline: No certified manager; faulty thermometer
summary: No City of Chicago certified manager was on site while protein shakes, pies, and eggs were handled, and no certificate was posted; citation issued. A refrigeration thermometer is not working. Cold water pressure is low at the three-compartment sink.

headline: Rat droppings in basement; no valid certificate
summary: Failed. No valid sanitation certificate was on site while beans, steak, and rice were prepared; citation issued. About 30 rat droppings were found on basement stairs and floor. A 1/4-inch gap is at a customer-restroom door, and flypaper is on ceilings. Leaking basement pipe.

headline: Unisex restroom trash can has no lid
summary: Complaint inspection passed. A trash can without a lid was found in the unisex restroom. The business must provide a lidded can.

headline: Rusted racks; unused cooler on premises
summary: Rust found on racks in the downstairs storage area and walk-in cooler; manager must repair or repaint them. An unused two-door cooler in the main kitchen is broken; the manager must repair or remove it.

headline: Single-service items on floor; dirty basement
summary: Single-service items in basement storage were not inverted and were stored on the floor. Loose heavy debris, dirt, and dust are built up on basement floors and corners. The manager must detail clean, increase cleaning, and maintain.

headline: Flying insects found, then eliminated on site
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. About 50 live small flying insects were found on walls and ceilings in prep, manager's office, dishwashing, and dry storage areas. Management eliminated the live pest activity during re-inspection. Floors need grouting and drains need cleaning.

headline: Leaks, gaps, and missing stoppers
summary: Slight buildup inside the upper ice machine. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door sweep must be fixed to rodent-proof the door. Bar handsink pipe and women's washroom valve leak. Three-compartment sink stoppers do not work. The certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Gaskets, slow drain, and basement clutter
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Rubber gaskets on cooling units in the prep area are in disrepair. A prep handsink drains slowly. Basement boiler and HVAC area has excessive clutter on the floor. Bar bulbs are burned out and basement lighting is inadequate.

headline: Raw wood and exposed brick in restroom
summary: Raw wood in the restroom must be painted so it is smooth and cleanable. A bathroom wall without a baseboard exposes brick and must be enclosed. Food debris behind kitchen equipment must be cleaned.

headline: Clutter, damaged floors, and vent problems
summary: Wiping cloths on prep tables must be stored in sanitizing solution. Clutter in the rear must be removed to prevent rodent hiding places. Missing and damaged floor tiles need repair. Washroom ventilation is not working, and a certified manager lacks an allergen certificate.

headline: No health policy or cleanup kit; cooling short
summary: Failed. No written employee health policy and no vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit were on site. Refrigeration is inadequate: only a two-door prep cooler and freezer; more equipment is needed to keep cold foods at 41°F or below. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Mouse droppings found; hand sink too cold
summary: Failed. More than 75 mouse droppings were found throughout the business, many near unused equipment in the rear. Pest activity must be eliminated and affected areas cleaned. A toilet-room hand sink measured 65–70°F; it must be at least 100°F.

headline: Ice scoop, grease, and drain cleaning issues
summary: Ice scoop was resting on ice in the ice machine; manager told to store it handle-up. Grease and food debris were found on cooking equipment, coolers, and shelving, and floor drains were dirty. Restroom vents were dusty. No allergen training certificate was on site.

headline: Ice machine debris; torn gaskets; mold-like racks
summary: Debris is encrusted inside the ice machine and must be detail cleaned. Prepackaged foods in the walk-in lack labels. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door must be closed. Torn gaskets on a prep cooler and mold-like buildup on walk-in storage racks. A food handler lacks a certificate.

headline: No manager on site; dumpster and ice machine issues
summary: Failed. Food was handled without a city-certified food manager until one arrived at 3:38 PM; citation issued. The top interior of the ice machine was not clean. The outside dumpster lid is open from overflow and has a hole. The grease dumpster is heavily crusted.

headline: No certified manager; low hot water temperature
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while sausage and eggs were served; citation issued. Hot water at three hand sinks was 70–72°F; the manager adjusted it to 100–101°F during inspection. Dish machine showed 10 ppm sanitizer and was serviced. Seasonings lack labels.

headline: No health verification; no vomit cleanup plan
summary: No employee health verification was available, and no vomit and diarrhea cleanup plan or supplies were found. Missing handwashing signs, thermometers in coolers, drain stoppers, mop sink, and covered washroom receptacles. Rusty shelves and cardboard liners. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Heavy ice buildup in chest freezer
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. An excessive amount of ice had built up on all interior surfaces of a standing chest freezer inside the walk-in cooler. The manager was told to remove the ice, detail clean, and maintain it.

headline: Ice scoops on counter; missing sink stoppers
summary: Ice scoops were stored on the counter behind the front bar and must be kept in a clean container. The three-compartment sink is missing stoppers. Unisex washrooms lack covered waste receptacles. Ceiling vents have excessive dust.

headline: Door gap and missing food handler training
summary: A 1/4-inch gap under the front entrance door was found, and the manager was told to install a door sweep. Not all food handlers had the required food handler training; the manager was told to obtain it.

headline: Rodent droppings; unapproved vacuum-packed cheese
summary: Failed. More than 40 rodent droppings were found in the basement, kitchen, and bar. Vacuum-packed cheese curds were on site without an approved food safety plan; 7 lbs ($20) were discarded and a citation issued. A hole in the ceiling above the pizza oven needs repair.

headline: Handwashing signs and floors need cleaning
summary: Handwashing signs are needed at all handwashing sinks. Floors under and behind equipment and in the corners of the main bar area need detail cleaning. The manager was told to get allergen training for certified food managers.

headline: Dish machine below 180°F; unlabeled bulk foods
summary: The high-temperature dish machine did not meet the 180°F hot-water final rinse; a technician came to repair it. Priority violation and citation issued. Bulk pasta and beans lack labels. Milk crates are used as shelving. Basement floors have loose debris. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No splash guard; grime at dish area
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. The four-compartment bar sink lacks a splash guard between its handwashing and warewashing compartments. Grime and dust are on the dishwashing area wall. Filters over the unused tea prep hood are covered in grime.

headline: Unlabeled bins, greasy floors, and hood filters
summary: Food bins need common-name labels. Unused broken equipment in the rear storage area must be removed to prevent pest hiding places. Floors along walls and under cooking equipment had grease and dried food. Kitchen hood filters need cleaning. The certified manager's allergen certificate has expired.

headline: Missing thermometers and utility sink
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Cooling units in the grocery store and warehouse lacked thermometers. Interiors of two-door cooling units and walk-in shelving need cleaning and sanitizing. No utility sink is on the premises; one with hot and cold water must be provided.

headline: Mouse droppings; no hot water at sinks
summary: Failed. Handsinks had water at 56–61°F instead of hot water; citation issued. Over 100 mouse droppings were found in the lounge, kitchen, furnace room, walk-in motor closet, and along kitchen walls. Pest control is recommended. Gaps and holes at doors must be sealed.

headline: Food stored on floors upstairs and in basement
summary: Re-inspection passed. Boxes of food were on the floor in the upstairs prep area, the stair storage area, and the basement walk-in cooler, including meat and produce. The manager was told to add shelving and raise all items off the floor.

headline: Cream and pepperoni too warm; cooler tagged
summary: Cream at 54.1°F and pepperoni at 55.9°F were held too warm; about 3 lbs ($75) was discarded. The coffee and pizza area prep cooler held air at 62.7°F and was tagged. Sanitizer test strips were missing, and the manager's allergen training had expired.

headline: Dust on stored containers; greasy equipment
summary: Re-inspection passed. Storage containers under a rear air vent collected dust and must be covered, inverted, or moved. Cooking equipment sides have grease. The three-compartment sink drain leaks. Two lights are out under the hood.

headline: Cooler failing; food discarded; flies found
summary: Failed. A pizza-station cooler is in poor repair; cooked chicken at 48–50°F was discarded (10 lbs, $20). The unit is tagged and may not be used until corrected and re-inspected. 10–15 flies were in the rear service area; detail cleaning and pest control required.

headline: Restroom door not self-closing
summary: Re-inspection passed. The washroom door was not self-closing, a violation of the code. The manager was told to provide and maintain a self-closing door.

headline: Rust, greasy coolers, and stained ceiling tiles
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed with repairs required. Rusted metal trim and walk-in shelving need repair or rust removal. A two-door freezer gasket is worn. Grease and food debris must be cleaned from coolers, freezers, floors, and wall bases. Stained ceiling tiles need replacing.

headline: Hole in wall base; greasy equipment bottoms
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Staff were told to clean the bottoms of cooking equipment and prep tables and the exteriors of cooking equipment. A hole at the base of the wall behind the cooking equipment must be sealed.

headline: Hand sink blocked; dish machine lacks test strips
summary: Failed. The hand sink behind the bar was blocked by liquor bottles and a garbage can; the manager was told to clear it; citation issued. The high-temperature dish machine lacked surface temperature test strips. Food spills on walls near the dish machine.

headline: Hair restraints missing; worn cutting boards
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints in the prep area. Cutting boards had deep grooves and stains and must be sanded or replaced. Floor drains, floors under equipment, and vents and walls near sinks and coolers had dirt, food, and debris.

headline: Food stored on floors; broken sushi cooler door
summary: Soy sauce buckets and various meats were stored on the floor in prep, walk-in cooler, and freezer; food must be six inches off the floor. A sliding sushi cooler door is broken and must be repaired. Plastic containers and cooking areas have grease and food debris.

headline: Short handwashing time; cloth touching kale
summary: Metered handwashing sinks in prep and dish areas ran for less than 15 seconds; they must run at least 15 seconds. Wiping cloths were in direct contact with kale and must not be. A prep cooler cutting board has open seams and dark stains and must be refinished or replaced.

headline: Greasy fryer, grill, and washroom fans
summary: Bottom areas of the fryer, grill, and prep tables need cleaning. Floors around and behind equipment need cleaning. Washroom ventilation fans have dust. Plastered washroom walls are not smooth and cleanable and need painting.

headline: No certified manager; pink slime in ice machine
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site at first inspection; one arrived about 30 minutes later. Ice machine reservoir had pink slime. About 2 lbs of expired pastor (pork) were discarded. One food handler lacked a certificate, and milk crates were used as shelving.

headline: Hair restraints missing; food stored in foil
summary: Canvass inspection failed. Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints. Utensils were stored in food containers, and plates were not inverted. Food was stored in aluminum foil in the cooler and freezer. A core violation from a prior report was not corrected, and a citation was issued.

headline: No hot water at basement sink; citation issued
summary: Complaint inspection failed. Basement three-compartment sink had no hot water because the handle was broken; a citation was issued. Employee health policy and food handler training were missing. Food was discarded after cooked chicken at 87.7F. Cooking floors and ventilation also need attention.

headline: Plastic bags used for food storage; door locks needed
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Plastic grocery bags were used to store food in chest freezers and reach-in coolers and must be replaced. A dining room cooler needs a lock. Staff restrooms lack self-closing doors, and allergen certificates were expired.

headline: No certified manager; ants and no pest log; citations
summary: Complaint inspection failed. No City-certified manager was on premises, and citations were issued. About 20 ants were crawling on the floor near the rear exit and equipment. No pest control log was on site, and food handler training proof was missing.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit, thermometers, or food handler training
summary: Complaint inspection failed. No procedures or supplies were found for vomit and diarrhea events, and a citation was issued. Thermometers are missing from coolers. Fly strips hang in dish and storage areas and must be removed. No food handler training was available.

headline: No certified manager on duty; citation
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. No valid City-certified manager was on duty while steak, chicken, and gyros were prepared and served. A citation was issued. Dirty shelving, counters, and ceiling tiles and vents need cleaning.

headline: Delivery door gap; plates not inverted
summary: License inspection passed. The delivery area entrance door is not rodent-proof, with a 1/4 inch gap at the bottom that must be sealed. Serving plates on prep shelves were not inverted.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup plan
summary: License re-inspection passed with conditions. No employee health policy or training was on site, and no plan for vomit and diarrhea events was found. Handwashing signage, thermometers in coolers, and a covered toilet room trash receptacle are also required.

headline: Chicken held too warm; discarded
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. Chicken was held at 60F; cold TCS foods must be held at 41F or below. The manager discarded 1/2 pound of chicken. A citation was issued. Black buildup on walls near the dish machine needs cleaning.

headline: No health policy; no food handler certificates; citation
summary: Complaint inspection passed with conditions. No verifiable employee health policy was on site, and a citation was issued. No food handler certificates were available for employees. Also found: no allergen training certificates, unlabeled bins, a sink drain leak, and debris in the basement.

headline: Missing signage and flour unlabeled
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Handwashing sinks lacked signage in front prep and dish areas. Flour storage was not labeled. Cardboard lined the fryer floor and must be removed. Floors by the dish area need re-grouting.

headline: Dirty ice machines; door gaskets and training missing
summary: Canvass inspection failed. Black dirt buildup was found inside ice machines dripping into ice used for drinks. All ice was voluntarily discarded. A prep cooler door gasket is torn, a hand sink handle is loose, and food handler training certificates were missing.

headline: Rodent droppings; no health policy; citation
summary: Canvass inspection failed. About 25 rodent droppings were found behind a drink cooler, under the utility sink, and on the lower shelf in the rear. No employee health policy or metal stem thermometer was on site. Citations were issued. A covered trash can is needed.

headline: Wiping cloths on prep tables; floor drains dirty
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables and must be kept in sanitizing solution. Some items were not elevated off the floor. A three-compartment sink has a slow leak, and floor drains in the dishwashing area need cleaning.

headline: Hot water too cold at sinks; corrected
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. A men's restroom sink had hot water at 66F; the minimum is 100F. A hotel technician arrived and all sinks were brought to 102-105F. Missing and water-stained ceiling tiles need repair.

headline: No certified manager on site; hair restraints missing
summary: Complaint inspection passed with conditions. No City-certified manager was on site while potatoes and sausage were handled, and no certificate was posted. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, utensils were stored upright incorrectly, and sour cream containers were reused.

headline: Missing health policy and hot-water problems; many fixes
summary: License inspection failed. Missing signed employee health policy and pest control log. Hot water is below required temperatures at several sinks, and the dish machine lacks detergent and proper final rinse temperature. Missing thermometers and consumer advisory. Many upkeep issues also listed.

headline: Doors open to pests; no toilet ventilation
summary: License re-inspection passed with conditions. No certified manager was on site with the original certificate. A big gap at the front entrance door and a small gap at the rear door must be rodent-proofed. Toilet rooms lack ventilation, and a cabinet has residue.

headline: Hand sink not maintained; paper in drain
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Inspector found a hand wash sink not maintained, with paper towel pieces in the basin drain. Staff were instructed to keep hand sinks maintained.

headline: Rodent droppings in toilet room and kitchen areas
summary: Canvass inspection failed. About 10 rodent droppings were found near the water heater, about 10 behind the ice machine, and about 5 under the three-compartment sink. Pest control was recommended and a citation was issued. Plates were stored in food containers.

headline: Cold foods too warm; discarded; citation
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. Cold TCS foods, including milk, mozzarella, and salad, were held at 46.9-50.4F; the limit is 41F or below. About 17 lbs were discarded and a citation was issued. A cold holding unit was tagged held for inspection. Ice bins lack covers.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate; citation issued
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed with conditions. No valid City sanitation certificate was on site, and a citation was issued. Unnecessary and nonfunctional equipment must be removed. A reach-in cooler is missing its compressor cover, and stained ceiling tiles and dusty vents need attention.

headline: Rear door gap needs sealing
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The rear exit door was not fully rodent-proofed. A 1/4 inch gap at the bottom of the door must be sealed.

headline: Unlabeled bulk storage; grease and debris
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. Bulk dry storage units in the basement lack labels and must be labeled. Three sink stoppers are missing. Grease is on cooking equipment, cold holding units need interior cleaning, and the basement floor has debris. The certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Dirty fryers, can opener, and floors
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Instructions included cleaning the fryer bottoms, the can opener blade, the restroom toilet and sink, and floors under and around kitchen equipment. Dust on ceiling vents and light shields should also be cleaned.

headline: Dusty vent and dirty cooler shelf
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The interior bottom shelf of an employee cafe prep cooler must be cleaned. A dusty air vent above the prep table must be cleaned. A certified manager needs allergen training.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods handled
summary: Complaint inspection passed with conditions. No certified food service manager was on site while chicken and beef were handled and served. The person in charge was told to obtain one. A priority foundation violation was noted.

headline: Flies in restroom and bar; pest control needed
summary: Complaint inspection failed. About 20 to 25 small flies were found in the men's room and at the bar handwashing sink. Pest control service is needed, and a citation was issued. No vomit cleanup kit was on site. Cutting boards and rear storage floors need attention.

headline: Clean deep fryer interior
summary: Suspected food poisoning inspection passed. Inspector asked for cleaning of the interior of the deep fryer.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; food discarded
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. Cooked beef at 57.2F, rice at 49.2F, and vegetables at 66.5-93.9F were held too warm for safety; cold foods must stay at 41F or below. No time-temperature log was provided. About 15 lbs discarded. A citation was issued.

headline: Missing thermometers; dusty vents
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Some prep coolers lacked thermometers and must be provided. Dust is on vents over the cooking equipment and in the dish machine vent system and must be cleaned. All city-certified managers must obtain allergen training.

headline: Debris under dumpster and grease trap odor
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Boxes and debris were found under the outside dumpster. Floor drains need cleaning, the grease trap has a slight odor, and the freezer floor needs cleaning. A manager was found without required allergen training.

headline: Torn gasket and leaking sink valve
summary: Canvass inspection passed. A torn rubber gasket was found on a reach-in cooler, and a slow leak was found at the handwashing sink shutoff valve. A broken floor tile by the elevator needs replacing.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit cleanup supplies; citation
summary: Canvass inspection failed. The person in charge lacked a City certificate, and no certified manager was present while TCS foods were prepared. A citation was issued. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup supplies were on site. Food handler training certificates were missing.

headline: Roaches and mouse droppings; pest control needed
summary: Complaint inspection failed. Dead roaches and insects were found in the rear warewashing area, storage, and basement. About 20 mouse droppings were on the bar floor. Additional pest control service is needed. A citation was issued. Food storage and labeling problems were also found.

headline: No vomit cleanup plan; citation issued
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. No procedure or plan for vomit and diarrhea events was found, and a citation was issued. Thermometers are needed in walk-in and prep coolers. Items must be kept off the floor, and the boiler closet needs reorganizing to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Thermometer placement and disposable cups
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The cooler thermometer was at the back and should be placed in the warmest part, easy to view. Disposable cups were used for food storage and staff were told to use proper utensils.

headline: Rusty shelving and dirty drains
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Rusty shelving in the deli walk-in cooler must be repaired or replaced. A leaking faucet base at the three-compartment sink needs repair. Dust and dirt are on floor drains in the produce cooler, and ceiling stains are in the produce cutting area.

headline: Cleaning needed for equipment, walls, and hood
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Inspector asked for cleaning of the deep fryer, freezer, prep coolers, grease trap exterior, prep tables, and soda nozzle. Grease on walls, floors, and the ventilation hood also needs cleaning.

headline: No certified manager until 9:54 a.m.; corrected
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. No City-certified manager was on site at first, and a citation was issued. The manager arrived at 9:54 a.m., which corrected the issue. Ice machine mold-like buildup, unlabeled containers, and a leak under a sink also need attention.

headline: Rat and mouse droppings; dead roaches; citation
summary: Complaint inspection failed. About 15 rat droppings and about 30 mouse droppings were found in the prep and storage areas. Dead cockroaches were found in cabinets. Additional pest control service is needed, and a citation was issued. The grease trap lid must be sealed.

headline: Ice machine door and cardboard surface need repair
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The ice machine door is in poor repair and must be replaced or repaired to be tight-fitting. Cardboard was used on a table bottom in the rear prep area and must be replaced with a smooth, cleanable surface.

headline: Gap under front door; fly strip near food
summary: Canvass inspection passed. A gap under the front door needs rodent and insect proofing. A fly strip was hanging near hot holding foods and must be removed. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Cutting boards and cooler parts need cleaning.

headline: Greasy fryers and dirty floors
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Fryers had grease and charred material. Storage racks had dirt and dust. The three-compartment sink leaks at the hot water knobs, the employee restroom trash can lacks a lid, and floors need detailed cleaning.

headline: Wet wiping cloths on counters; leaking faucet
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Wet wiping cloths were on counters and prep tables and must be kept in sanitizing solution. Plastic bowls and trays were stored face-up. A faucet at a grill station handwashing sink leaks, and grease spills are on floors.

headline: Gap at front door sweep; rodent-proof required
summary: Re-inspection passed. A 1/4 inch gap was found at the front entrance door sweeps. The outside doors must be made rodent-proof.

headline: Sink blocked by items; citation issued
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. A rear prep handwashing sink held plastic bags and soap bottles. The employee removed them on site. A citation was issued. The sink lacked a hand drying provision; paper towels were provided on site.

headline: Pink residue in ice machine; linen touching salad
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Pink slime-like residue was found inside the ice machine panel; the operator was told to schedule cleaning. A linen was touching salad in the prep cooler and was removed. Single-service trays were stored face-up and must be inverted.

headline: Dirty cutting board, fans, and hood
summary: Complaint inspection passed. A cutting board with dark stains must be cleaned and sanitized. Reach-in cooler fan covers need debris removed. The washroom door needs a self-closing device, and floors under pallets and the hood and filters need cleaning.

headline: Missing wall panel could let pests in
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Inspector found a missing wall panel exposing the wall cavity in the basement storage area. The operator was told to repair it to prevent pest entry.

headline: Front door gap; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Canvass inspection passed. A 1/4 inch gap between the front doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. The certified manager on duty lacked current allergen training.

headline: No certified manager on site; sanitizer test strips missing
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. No certified food service manager was on site while beef and chicken were handled and served. The bar three-compartment sink lacks a sanitizer test strip. The walk-in cooler needs more lighting.

headline: Loose ice machine lid; ice buildup in freezer
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The ice machine lid is loose and in poor repair and must be fixed. Ice has built up on the floor and fan unit in the sliding-door walk-in freezer and must be removed.

headline: About 50 live flies; pest control recommended
summary: Re-inspection failed. Inspector saw about 50 or more live small flies on walls and ceilings in the bar, dining, prep, and rear dish areas. A prior pest violation was not corrected. Pest control service was recommended. Several other upkeep and storage issues were also found.

headline: No certified manager on site while cooking meat
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. The person in charge lacked a City food service sanitation manager certificate, and no certified manager was on site while beef and chicken were prepared and served. A food handler also lacked proof of food handler training.

headline: Dirt behind bar
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Dirt was found on the floor, along walls, and in corners behind the bar. The person in charge was instructed to clean these areas.

headline: Ice machine upper areas need cleaning
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Upper areas of the ice machine need cleaning. Wiping cloths must be held in sanitizing solution between uses. Shelving has grease and rust, and wall and mop sink holes need sealing. Allergen certificates for all certified managers are missing.

headline: Leaking sink faucet; mop storage
summary: Canvass inspection passed. A leak was found at the three-compartment sink faucet and must be repaired. A wet mop was stored in a bucket in the utility area; staff were told to hang mops to dry.

headline: Dirty floors and vents in prep areas
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The three-compartment sink hoses must be cut to the fill line. Floor drains, floors, and storage racks in storage and prep areas have dirt and debris. Ceiling and vents in rear prep have dust buildup.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies
summary: Canvass re-inspection passed. No cleanup supplies were on the premises for vomit or diarrhea events. Management was instructed to provide them. A priority foundation violation was noted.

headline: No drainboard at sink; no training certificates
summary: License inspection passed. The three-compartment sink has no drainboard or drain shelf and one must be provided. No food handler training certificates were found on the premises and must be provided.

headline: Faucet shuts off too fast; ice machine residue
summary: License inspection passed. A metered faucet shuts off too quickly; it must run at least 15 seconds. Pink residue in the ice machine must be cleaned. Ambient air thermometers are needed. Heavy ice in the freezer and food debris on floors need attention.

headline: Missing health policy and allergen training
summary: License re-inspection passed with conditions. No employee health policy was on site. The newly installed utility sink lacks a backflow device and a fixed faucet. A hole by the basement ice machine was patched temporarily and must be fully repaired. Allergen training is missing for the certified manager.

headline: No certified manager; flies and sewage overflow; citations
summary: Complaint inspection failed. No certified manager was on site when beef was prepared and served. Numerous flying insects were found in prep, dish, and storage areas. Toilet water overflowed. Grease container and outside areas were not clean. Several citations were issued.

headline: Mouse droppings found in service and storage areas
summary: Canvass inspection failed. About 20 mouse droppings were found on the floor behind the service counter, and about 20 more in the rear storage room. These must be removed and detail cleaned. A citation was issued. Other cleanup and a broken door closer were noted.

headline: Hot dogs thawed in water too warm; corrected
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Hot dogs were thawing under running water at 72F; running water must be at 70F or below. The person on site corrected this by lowering the water temperature. Items on the ground near the dumpster were cleaned on site.

headline: Door and window seals needed to keep pests out
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Inspector asked for tight seals on several outer openings: the front entrance door, a sealed basement liquor room window, and the basement door to the building.

headline: Slime in ice maker; citation issued
summary: Canvass inspection failed. Black slimy substance was found inside the basement ice maker, dripping into ice used for drinks. Management was told to shut it off, remove the ice, and clean it. A citation was issued. Also found: a rear door gap, a missing backflow device, and moldy caulking.

headline: Mouse droppings; missing soap, towels, hot water
summary: License inspection failed. About 30 mouse droppings were found in rear storage and upstairs office. Sinks lacked soap and paper towels, and hot water was not at several sinks. Large gaps at a rear garage door need repair. A citation was issued for the sanitizer test kit.

headline: No certified manager; hot water fixed on site; citation
summary: Canvass inspection failed. No valid City-certified food service manager was available while TCS foods were handled. A citation was issued. Hot water at a juice bar sink was missing and was repaired during inspection. Also found: a rear door gap, unlabeled containers, and uncorrected prior violations.

headline: No certified manager; citation issued
summary: Complaint inspection passed with conditions. The person in charge lacked a City sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was present while dairy and other TCS foods were handled. A citation was issued. A paper towel was missing at a hand sink and was provided on site.

headline: Calcium buildup inside ice machine
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Calcium buildup was found inside the ice machine, and the manager was told to clean it.

headline: No certified manager on site; ice machine slime
summary: Canvass inspection failed. No City-certified food service manager was present while hamburgers, soups, and meats were prepared. Black slimy substance was found inside the ice machine, dripping into ice; the manager was told to shut it off and clean it. A rear door gap needs rodent-proofing.

headline: Mold-like buildup in walk-in cooler fan cover
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The front entrance door must be rodent-proofed. Milk crates were used for elevation and must be replaced with raised shelves. A condenser fan cover has mold-like buildup. Ceiling tiles are water stained and missing.

headline: Poor handwashing and food handling; citation issued
summary: Complaint inspection failed. Inspector saw poor hygiene: a dishwasher scratched both arms, then handled dishes, and a food handler used a cell phone without washing hands. The manager had staff wash hands during inspection. Also found: no raw-food advisory, oyster tag problems (discarded), door gaps, and cleanliness issues.

headline: Dirt inside ice machine; ice discarded
summary: Complaint inspection failed. Dirt buildup was found inside the ice machine, dripping into ice used for drinks. The manager voluntarily discarded all ice. The interior must be cleaned by the reinspection date. A citation was issued.

headline: No hand soap or paper towels at prep sink
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. The rear prep and dish sink had no hand cleanser or paper towels during inspection. The person in charge provided paper towels on site. About 40 lbs of tamales held at 72-90F were discarded voluntarily.

headline: Rust on shelves; dish machines lack data plates
summary: Re-inspection passed. Rust was found on shelves in a basement refrigerator and must be removed. Low-temperature dish machines in the first-floor dish area and champagne bar lack required data plates showing design and operation specifications.

headline: Flies in dish area; food held too cool; citation
summary: Canvass inspection failed. About 20 small flies were found in the dishwashing area. Oatmeal held at 117F was discarded. Missing employee health policy, no chlorine test kit, and soap and paper towel problems were found; soap and towels were corrected on site.

headline: Lighting, ceilings, and paint need repair
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables and must be kept in sanitizing solution. Milk crates must be replaced with approved shelving. Basement issues include burned-out bulbs, inadequate lighting, peeling paint, and grime behind the ice machine.

headline: Missing drain stoppers, signs, and base coving
summary: License inspection passed. Missing handwashing signage and two drain stoppers on the three-compartment sink. A slow-draining sink and no service sink were found. Base coving is missing in food areas, and no food handler training certificates were on site.

headline: Torn gasket and cardboard floor liner
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Soiled wiping cloths were stored on prep tables. A torn gasket in the prep cooler must be replaced. Cardboard lines the prep area floor and must be removed. Greasy equipment and debris need cleaning.

headline: Clean kitchen hood and filters
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. The kitchen hood and filters in the prep area need cleaning and maintenance.

headline: Missing handwashing signs in restrooms
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Handwashing signs were missing in the restrooms and must be provided and maintained.

headline: Dishes not sanitized; citation issued
summary: Short-form complaint inspection passed with conditions. Two employees rinsed utensils in a three-compartment sink without sanitizing; the sanitizer basin was empty. A citation was issued. Some food handlers were missing hair restraints.

headline: Over 50 mouse droppings; pest treatment needed
summary: Canvass inspection failed. Over 50 mouse droppings were found along the wall and under equipment in the rear prep area. Food containers were stored on the floor, and the operator was told to consult a pest control company for treatment. A citation was issued.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: Canvass inspection passed. The sanitation manager has no allergen training and must obtain it.

headline: Utensils not inverted; floor debris
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Cooking utensils, bowls, pots, and pans were not inverted in prep areas. Floors under the three-compartment sink drain board and in the dry storage closet had food and debris buildup.

headline: No paper towels at hand sinks; corrected on site
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. No paper towels were available at the dish and prep hand sinks. Management provided paper towels on site, and a citation was issued. A bowl was used as a scoop for raw meats in a cooler. Trash cans lack lids.

headline: Half-inch gap at basement door; wall holes sealed
summary: Re-inspection passed. A half-inch gap was found along the bottom of the basement door and must be sealed. Moldy, buckled liquor shelves must be replaced. Holes in basement walls and foundation must be sealed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Dusty vents and water-stained ceiling tiles
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Ceiling vents need cleaning to remove dust. Some ceiling tiles are water stained and should be replaced where needed.

headline: Buildup inside ice machine walls
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Buildup was found on the interior walls of the ice machine. The person in charge was told to clean and maintain it. The ice is not used for human consumption.

headline: Manager lacked certificate; hair restraint lapses; citation
summary: Complaint inspection passed with conditions. The manager on duty lacked a valid City food service sanitation certificate while TCS foods were handled; a citation was issued. Food handlers lacked hair restraints and training proof, and utensils and dish area needed attention.

headline: Single-service trays facing up
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Plastic trays and containers were stored face-up at the prep lines. Staff were told to invert them to protect from overhead contamination.

headline: Deep grooves in cutting board; water near drains
summary: Canvass inspection passed. A cutting board with deep dark grooves must be replaced. Water around dish machine floor drains must be kept dry to prevent pest breeding.

headline: Bulk containers unlabeled; hood light out
summary: Re-inspection passed. Bulk containers were missing labels with the common name of contents and must be labeled. A missing hood light bulb must be replaced.

headline: Black substance above sink and on wall
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Excessive black substance was found on the caulking above the three-compartment sink and on the wall behind it. Staff were told to remove it and keep the area clean.

headline: Hand sink and prep sink combined; separate them
summary: Canvass inspection passed. A two-compartment sink was used as both a hand washing sink and a prep sink. The manager was instructed to plumb them separately and install two single-basin sinks.

headline: No city food sanitation certificate posted; citation issued
summary: Canvass inspection failed. No City of Chicago food service sanitation certificate was on site, and a citation was issued. A consumer advisory disclosure for raw or undercooked foods was missing from the menu. No citation for that.

headline: Undercooked menu items lacked warnings; corrected
summary: Canvass inspection passed with conditions. Animal-derived foods that can be served undercooked had no asterisks, disclosure, or reminder on the menu. This was corrected before inspection ended. Openings at two exit doors must be sealed to keep pests out.

headline: Failed: live and dead roaches on dish machine
summary: Re-inspection failed; citations issued. Two large live cockroaches were crawling on dish machine equipment, and 45 dead cockroaches were under a drying table. No certified manager was on site. Other repairs needed in prep and basement areas.

headline: Passed; floor drains need cleaning
summary: Passed. Inspector instructed the facility to clean and maintain floor drains underneath the three-compartment sink.

headline: Passed; hair restraints and wiping cloth issues
summary: Passed. Employees prepared and served food without hair restraints. A wiping cloth was stored on prep tables. Kitchen hand sink drains slowly. Basement clutter must be removed to prevent rodent harborage.

headline: Failed: prior violation uncorrected; leaks
summary: Failed; citation issued. A prior priority violation was not corrected. Missing hand-wash signs, uncovered flatware, leaking drain pipes, espresso machine and soda dispensers lacking backflow devices, and spilled liquid under bar sinks.

headline: Passed with conditions; no cleanup procedure
summary: Passed with conditions. No written employee health policy and no vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies were on premises. Also: employees lacked hair restraints, wiping cloths were stored on prep tables, and the manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; rust and stained cutting boards
summary: Re-inspection passed. Rust was found on wire storage racks in the walk-in cooler and must be removed, then repainted or replaced. Stained cutting boards on the prep line coolers must be resurfaced or replaced.

headline: Passed; no cold water at dish hand sink
summary: Complaint passed. Grease spills were found inside fryers and must be cleaned. The dish area hand sink has no cold running water and must be repaired. Shopping carts and boxes outside the rear door must be removed.

headline: Passed with conditions; hand sinks blocked, fixed on site
summary: Passed with conditions. Both hand sinks were blocked by food and equipment; the person in charge removed the items on site. Missing paper towels at the front hand sink were provided on site. Also: open herbs, aluminum foil on grill, and soiled areas.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; leaks and gaps
summary: Re-inspection passed. A worn door gasket on a bar prep cooler must be repaired or replaced. A leaky pipe under the middle of the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Gaps under the bar counter must be sealed; floor debris needs cleaning.

headline: Passed; hair restraint and clutter
summary: Complaint passed. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint, which must be provided. Clutter, including an old deep fryer and toys, was found at the dishwashing area and must be removed.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings and ants; pest service required
summary: Failed; citation issued. About 30–45 mouse droppings were in the rear prep area and behind freezers; about 10 ants were on a wall and floor. Pest control service was required. Grease and food build-up, items on the floor, and no allergen training.

headline: Passed with conditions; no posted manager certificate
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid original city food service manager certificate was posted on site; citation issued. Pots and pans were not stored inverted. The kitchen prep hand sink drains slowly and must be repaired.

headline: Failed: garbage area and sink issues
summary: Complaint failed; priority violation. Outside garbage area had food waste bags scattered around the dumpster with lids open. Also: missing sink stoppers, a dirty prep area with grease, and an odor from the grease trap.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings, warm cooler, inaccurate logs
summary: Failed; citations issued. About 60 mouse droppings were found in rear and front storage. Pastries at 58.2–59.7°F were discarded (about 30 lbs). Cooler was at 60°F and was repaired by 1:30 p.m. Temperature logs did not match readings.

headline: Passed; unlabeled flour and sugar containers
summary: Complaint passed. Food containers holding flour, sugar, and similar items were found without labels and must be labeled.

headline: Passed with conditions; hand-washing gaps
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager on site while sweet potatoes were served; no priority citation. A food handler washed hands in the three-compartment sink. Front hand sink had no cleanser. Missing sink stopper and damaged emergency exit door sweep.

headline: Passed with conditions; no manager for 30 minutes
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. No certified manager was on site from 2:15 to 2:45 p.m. while chicken was prepared; the manager arrived at 2:45 p.m. Also: food debris and grease throughout, soiled mop head, and no food handler certificates on site.

headline: Passed; dirty floor drain
summary: Passed. A floor drain under the three-compartment sink behind the bar was dirty. Inspector instructed the person in charge to clean it and maintain it.

headline: Passed; door gaps and ceiling tile damage
summary: Passed. Front entrance door has an open 1/4-inch gap at the bottom and between the two doors; a tight seal is required. Water-damaged ceiling tiles above the utility sink and a missing hallway ceiling tile must be replaced.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager; dead bugs
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. No certified food service manager was on site. Multiple dead water bugs were found in the basement, wine room, and walk-in. The first-floor kitchen is not in use. Drains and cooking equipment need detailed cleaning.

headline: Passed; warewashing hand sink lacks signage
summary: Passed. The warewashing area hand sink was missing signage telling food employees to wash their hands. Inspector instructed the facility to post adequate signage at all hand sinks.

headline: Passed; missing backflow device, allergen training
summary: Passed. No backflow prevention device was installed at the ice machine water line and must be provided. Sanitation managers lack allergen training, which must be provided.

headline: Passed; gap at door and storage issues
summary: Passed. Opening at the base of the front door must be sealed. Other items: paper towel dispenser above dipper well, single-use forks and spoons stored lying down, items on floor, restroom door not self-closing, and loose caulk.

headline: Failed: no water; rodent droppings; sewage smell
summary: Failed. Inspector saw 10 rodent droppings in the kitchen and no water throughout the facility; the manager was told to restore water. Water pooled on the floor, and a large hole with a heavy sewage smell must be sealed.

headline: Passed; ice machine door and rusty shelves
summary: Passed. Build-up was found on the interior of the ice machine door and must be cleaned. Rust was found on shelves in a sliding two-door cooler in the prep area and must be replaced or removed.

headline: Passed with conditions; blank health policy forms
summary: Passed with conditions. Blank copies of employee health policy were on site; a priority violation. No bodily fluid spill kit or cleanup procedure. No handwashing signs in restrooms. Stoppers missing from the three-compartment sink.

headline: Passed; food handler certificates needed on site
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. No food handler certificates for new food handlers were on site. Inspector instructed the facility to keep them on site for review.

headline: Passed; cold water off at 1-compartment sink
summary: Passed. Dust build-up was on the walk-in cooler condenser and must be cleaned. The one-compartment sink's cold water was turned off and must be turned on. One food manager lacks food allergen training.

headline: Passed; dead insects found behind bar
summary: Passed. Dead insects were found under the basement bar three-compartment sink and on a sanitizing container behind the bar; the inspector instructed cleaning. Plates were not inverted, and the bar dump sink hot water knob does not turn on.

headline: Passed; rotten drainboard and training gaps
summary: Short-form complaint passed. Drainboard next to the three-compartment sink is rotten and must be replaced. Hood and filters need cleaning, a kitchen hand sink drains slowly, and food handlers lack proof of training.

headline: Passed; cleaning and storage issues noted
summary: Passed. Inspector found minor build-up inside the ice machine, worn sponges, single-use items stored less than 6 inches off the floor, and debris on basement floors. Staff were told to correct and maintain.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; no PIC present
summary: Failed; citations issued. No person in charge was present, and no certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods like empanadas and eggs were prepared. Employees ate and prepared food at the prep area; no vomit cleanup procedure; no sanitizer test kit.

headline: Passed; sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: Short-form complaint passed. The food service sanitation manager does not have a food allergen training certificate. Inspector instructed the facility to meet the requirement.

headline: Passed; missing hand-wash signs and hair restraints
summary: Passed. Hand-washing signs were missing at prep and restroom sinks. Food handlers in the prep area were not wearing hair restraints. Also noted: broken floor tiles and a hole in the wall behind the rear dishwashing area door.

headline: Passed with conditions; no certified manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions; priority violation. No certified food service manager was on site or certificate posted while beef and chicken were handled. Three-compartment sink was not clean and held unrelated items. Grease spills were behind the cook line.

headline: Passed; uncovered food and milk crate shelving
summary: Passed. Food was stored uncovered in several coolers and on the rear floor, which must be elevated. Tongs and knives were improperly stored. Milk crates were used as shelving. A drainboard is separating from the three-compartment sink.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings; smoking inside
summary: Failed; citations issued. About 15 mouse droppings were found in the kitchen and behind cooking equipment; more pest control is needed. Coleslaw lacked date marking. Smoking was observed inside, with ashes in a food container.

headline: Passed with conditions; no manager; meat thawed at room temp
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. No certified food manager was on site while open. Two packages of frozen meat were thawing at room temperature and must be thawed properly. No ambient thermometer on the hot holding unit.

headline: Passed; no food handler certificates on site
summary: Passed re-inspection. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door sweep must be rodent-proofed. No food handler training certificates were on site; manager was told all food handlers must be certified.

headline: Failed: about 20 live flying insects
summary: Failed; citation issued. About 20 live small flying insects were found on walls, ceilings, and stock boxes in the rear prep, dishwashing, and coffee bar areas. Additional pest control service is needed. Wet wiping cloths were stored on tables.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; food handler certificates
summary: License re-inspection passed. Food handlers need food handler certificates. Inspector instructed the facility to obtain and maintain them.

headline: Passed; faucet and sink repairs needed
summary: Passed. At the bar three-compartment sink, the faucet is detaching. The rear prep hand sink sprays to the side. The inspector instructed the facility to repair and maintain both.

headline: Failed: flies, hand-washing lapse, unsafe cold food
summary: Failed; citations issued. A worker wiped his nose, then handled produce without washing hands. About 50 or more live small flies were found. Cold food above 41°F, including steak at up to 50.0°F, was discarded (about 67 lbs).

headline: Passed; frozen shrimp thawed in sink
summary: Passed. Bags of frozen shrimp were thawing in the three-compartment sink; inspector instructed thawing under cool running water or in the walk-in cooler. Two bulk containers were unlabeled, and the ice machine and cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Passed with conditions; manager lacks certification
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. The manager on duty lacked a city food manager certificate. Ceiling openings above the back door and by the three-compartment sink must be sealed. Also: greasy cooking equipment, a leaking hand sink drain, and dirt on walls and floors.

headline: Passed; employee belongings near food
summary: Passed. Employee belongings were stored on shelves in the rear storage area alongside food items. Inspector instructed the facility to provide a separate area for employee belongings.

headline: Passed; ice bin and ceiling vent covers
summary: Passed. Interior of the ice bin needed cleaning; the ice was to be removed, the bin cleaned, and maintained. Three ceiling vent covers were missing near the women's restroom and must be replaced.

headline: Passed; splatter inside microwaves
summary: Passed. Food splatters were found inside all microwaves. Inspector instructed the facility to clean and maintain them.

headline: Failed: 130+ mouse droppings; pest service required
summary: Re-inspection failed; citation issued. A prior priority violation was not corrected. About 130 or more mouse droppings were found in the bar, on basement ledges, shelving, and pillars. A pest control operator must service the premises.

headline: Passed with conditions; drainboard and grout
summary: Passed with conditions. No written employee health policy was on premises; a priority violation. Shelves above the three-compartment sink do not self-drain, there is no drainboard, and floor tiles need regrouting.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; glove and sink lapses
summary: Failed; citations issued. No certified food manager was on site while chicken and beef were prepared. A food handler put on gloves without washing hands. Rear hand sink lacked soap. Sanitizer test strips were missing. Previous violations were not corrected.

headline: Passed; missing splash guard and hole in wall
summary: Passed. No splash guard was between the exposed hand sink and three-compartment sink. Floor tile and a washroom floor drain cover need repair. A hole in the wall behind the hand sink must be sealed. Hallway clutter must be removed.

headline: Passed; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Passed. Milk crates were used as shelving in the walk-in cooler and must be removed; shelving must be 6 inches off the floor. Peeling metal coating on the walk-in freezer ceiling must be repainted.

headline: Passed; cooler soiled; coffee maker lacks backflow
summary: Passed. The cooler to the right of the griddle has soil build-up inside and must be cleaned. The rear coffee maker lacks a backflow prevention device. A certified manager lacks food allergen training.

headline: Passed; food debris at dish machine
summary: Passed. Food debris was found on dish machine shelves and exterior, and must be cleaned. A cracked ceiling light cover above the dish machine room must be replaced.

headline: Passed; food debris and ceiling damage
summary: Passed. Accumulated food debris was found inside prep area reach-in coolers. Water-stained ceiling tiles and a hole above the prep area must be replaced. One food handler lacked a food handler certificate.

headline: Passed; many repairs, labeling, and cleaning items
summary: Re-inspection passed. Items include a missing prep cooler thermometer, unlabeled juice and containers, a gap at the front door, worn gaskets, missing backflow devices, grease build-up, and a double oven needing to be under the hood.

headline: Passed with conditions; bare-hand contact, empty sanitizer
summary: Passed with conditions; citations issued. A food handler removed grilled bread from the grill with bare hands and it was discarded. Dish machine showed 0.0 ppm sanitizer and was refilled. Lamb at 129.7°F and cold sauces at 50–51.4°F were discarded.

headline: Passed with conditions; no paper towels at hand sink
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. No paper towel was at the dish area hand sink; a food handler got one during the inspection. Two backflow devices at the utility sink were spraying water and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Failed: no bar hand sink paper towels or cold water
summary: Failed; citations issued. Bar hand sink had no paper towels and no cold running water. Food stored in grocery bags, an unhandled to-go bowl used to scoop food, and leaks at the three-compartment sink and bar sink. No working ventilation in an employee toilet.

headline: Passed with conditions; unapproved oxygen packaging
summary: Passed with conditions; citation issued. Sliced cured meats were packaged with reduced-oxygen methods without a required variance. About 5 lbs were discarded and the machine was removed. Also: missing hand-wash signage and a leaking backflow device.

headline: Failed: 104 lbs of cold food discarded
summary: Failed; citations issued. Deli cold foods held at 46–59.7°F were discarded (about 104 lbs). Deli cooler measured 50.0°F and was held. An unauthorized customer walked through the prep area. Expired training certificates for an employee and manager.

headline: Passed with conditions; cold food above 41°F discarded
summary: Passed with conditions; priority citation issued. Walk-in cooler held TCS foods at 45.5–65.5°F, including carnitas at 65.5°F and queso blanco at 51.0°F; all were discarded. Both three-compartment sink faucets leak and need repair.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; labeling and hood cleaning
summary: Re-inspection passed. Unlabeled containers on a rear prep shelf, worn gaskets on three-door coolers, a grill hood needing cleaning, and food handlers needing required food handler training.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; several repairs needed
summary: Passed re-inspection. Squeeze bottles need labels. A gap at the bottom of the rear garbage door must be sealed. Ice scoop stored on top of ice machine; ice machine lacks a backflow device; grease build-up and floor repairs needed.

headline: Failed: undercooked eggs, dog on site, no CFM
summary: Failed; citations issued. Scrambled eggs were held at 114.0°F and 51.8°F and discarded. No certified manager was on site while TCS foods were handled. A dog was on site and was removed. Rear hand sink was blocked.

headline: Passed; splash guard and slow-draining sinks
summary: Passed. Food and clean equipment next to the rear prep hand sink were exposed to splash; a splash guard is required. A table-mounted oven has soiled fabric belts. Both prep area hand sinks drain slowly.

headline: No employee health policy or vomit cleanup plan
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy and no procedure for vomiting or diarrhea cleanup were on site. Also missing: splashguard by hand sink, drainboard, backflow device on espresso machine, and a repair or removal of an unused cooler.

headline: Passed; beard restraints and leaking pipe
summary: Passed. An employee with a beard was not wearing a beard restraint. Basement walk-in condenser pipe is leaking and must be repaired. Milk crates are used for elevation, and floor debris under the fryer and ovens needs cleaning.

headline: Passed with conditions; no employee health policy
summary: Passed with conditions. No written employee health policy was on premises; a priority violation. Also: leaking pipe under three-compartment sink, mop sink without backflow device, wall openings, dirty floor drains, and a food manager without allergen training.

headline: Passed; stained cutting boards to replace
summary: Passed. Cutting boards with dark stains were found in the cafe serving line prep area. Inspector instructed the facility to replace and maintain clean, properly sanitized cutting surfaces.

headline: Failed: 130+ mouse droppings; pest service required
summary: Re-inspection failed; citation issued. A prior priority violation was not corrected. About 130 or more mouse droppings were found along the bar, basement ledges, stairs, and shelving. Droppings must be removed and a pest control operator must service the premises.

headline: Failed: no pest control records on site
summary: Failed; citation issued. No pest control logbook or recent pest service receipts were on site. The facility was instructed to obtain and keep these records on site at all times.

headline: Failed: live roaches and rat droppings
summary: Re-inspection failed; priority violation. Live roaches were found at a prep cooler, near a grease trap, and at a reach-in door gasket. About 12 rat droppings were in a utility closet. Five dead roaches behind the cashier must be removed.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; scoop kept in standing water
summary: Re-inspection passed. An ice cream scoop was kept in a bowl of standing water at room temperature. Inspector instructed the facility to store the scoop according to the health code.

headline: Failed: 25 live flies, no food handler training
summary: Failed; citation issued. About 25 live flies were scattered across shelving and boxes in the rear prep and dishwashing area and must be removed. Floors and drains need cleaning. Food handler training was not provided for all employees, a prior violation.

headline: Passed; ice scoop and personal items
summary: Complaint passed. An ice scoop was placed inside the ice maker between ice cubes and must be kept off the ice. Employee personal items were on a shelf above a food prep table and must be kept away.

headline: No signed employee health policies; allergen training gap
summary: Passed with conditions. No signed employee health policies were on site. Also: worn gaskets on the three-door prep cooler, no ventilation connected at cooking hood or hood filters, and no food manager allergen training.

headline: Passed; no food handler certificates on site
summary: Passed. No food handler certificates were on site; the manager was instructed to comply with the food handler requirement. The sanitation manager lacked a food allergen training certificate.

headline: Passed; kitchen cleaning and clutter
summary: Passed. Unnecessary items, tools, and old equipment are stored throughout the kitchen and must be removed. Shelves, the meat slicer, and the gyro machine need cleaning.

headline: Failed: no sanitizer at dish sink; no health policy
summary: Failed. No employee health policy, no vomit cleanup procedure, no soap at the hand sink, and no sanitizer or dishwashing solution at the three-compartment sink. Rear door has no screen, and there are no sanitizer test strips on site.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; split walk-in floor
summary: Re-inspection passed. Soiled linens were used as spray curtains at the main dish machine and must be replaced. Gaskets on a rear cooler are in poor repair. A prep line hand sink leaks, and the walk-in cooler floor is severely split.

headline: Failed: restroom hand-sink water too cool
summary: Failed; citation issued. Restroom hot water measured 82°F; hand sinks must reach at least 100°F. Also: scoops stored inside dry storage containers, a damaged backflow device, and a mop not stored to air-dry.

headline: Passed on re-inspection; burnt-out light bulbs
summary: Re-inspection passed. Burnt-out light bulbs were found throughout the rear prep and storage areas. Inspector instructed the facility to repair or replace them and maintain good lighting.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk food, allergen training gap
summary: Passed. Bulk food such as starch and flour was not labeled. The sanitation manager has no allergen training, which must be provided.

headline: Passed; utensils stored improperly
summary: Passed. Knives were stored between a cooler and food prep surface. A scoop was stored with its handle buried in flour in the dry storage area. Inspector instructed storing in-use utensils so handles are accessible without touching food.

headline: Passed; ice machine lid and wall panel repairs
summary: Passed. Ice machine lid was off its hinges and in poor repair. A paper cup was used as a splash catch at the three-compartment sink drain. A steel wall panel near the walk-in cooler was peeling, with debris behind it.

headline: Failed: droppings and fruit flies; pest service needed
summary: Failed; citation issued. About 12–15 droppings were found in the basement near electrical panels. About 20–30 fruit flies were noted in the bar service area. Pest control service with proof is required. Gaps under the sink and stored items need addressing.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; no sneeze guard
summary: Failed; citations issued. No certified manager or posted certificate while pizza and TCS foods were prepared. Dish machine had no sanitizer and was tagged. Pizza line lacked a sneeze guard. Hand sink paper towels were provided on site.

headline: Dish machine and cooler tagged out of use
summary: Passed with conditions. Dish machine showed 0 ppm final chlorine sanitizer and was tagged; it was not in use. A cooler's air measured 45°F (limit 41°F) and was tagged; no food was stored in it.

headline: Failed: about 100 mouse droppings; no manager cert
summary: Re-inspection failed; priority violations. About 100 mouse droppings were found in prep, bar, furnace, and storage areas. Live small flies and a dead roach were also seen. No certified manager certificate was posted; no signed health policies.

headline: Passed; cleaning, low water pressure, backflow
summary: Passed. Build-up was found on the bar gun holder, ice machine interior, mop sink, and rear freezer. Hot water pressure at the rear three-compartment sink is low. Mop sink lacks a backflow device. Restroom ventilation is not working.

headline: Passed; missing hand sink handle
summary: Passed. The hand sink in the dishwashing area is missing its handle, which must be provided.

headline: Passed; can opener has food build-up
summary: Passed. Accumulated food build-up was found on and in the can opener. Inspector instructed the facility to clean the can opener and maintain it.

headline: Failed: roaches, mouse droppings, food too warm
summary: Failed; citations issued. Live roaches were found at a cabinet above the sink, between walls and shelving, and on a wall; 40 mouse droppings were in storage and inside a broken oven. Cold food up to 51.2°F was discarded. The cooler was adjusted to 39.8°F on site.

headline: Passed; stained cutting board, debris under shelf
summary: Passed. A cutting board at the prep cooler has dark stains and deep cuts and must be refinished or replaced. Debris was found under a shelf in the rear storage area in front of the ice machine.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, dirty sink, undated food
summary: Failed; multiple citations. No certified manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared. Kitchen hand sink was covered and lacked soap. Dish machine had no sanitizer and was tagged. Undated cooked foods were discarded. Pests not observed.
