headline: Passed; cleaning and leak repairs
summary: Passed. Upstairs three-compartment sink drain needs detail cleaning. Walk-in fan covers have dust build-up, cooking equipment sides need cleaning, and a rear dish sink drain leaks. Floors in the kitchen and sushi bar need cleaning.

headline: Failed: sink backs up; cold units unsecured
summary: Failed; citation issued for three-compartment sink backing up. Cold holding units with food prep items in the dining area were not secured. Also: leaking sink faucet stem and greasy hood filters.

headline: Hot water too cool at all sinks
summary: Hot water measured 75-86.5°F at all sinks; 100°F is required at handwash sinks and 110°F at 3-compartment sinks. Hot water was restored by the end of inspection. Also no sanitizer test strips and a bearded worker without a beard guard.

headline: Food stored on floors; unlabeled containers
summary: Food containers were stored on floors in the cooler, prep and storage areas. Bulk containers lack names. A worker lacked a hair restraint, cutting boards are stained, racks are rusted, and cooking equipment needs detail cleaning.

headline: Missing signs; greasy fryer areas
summary: Handwashing signs are missing at hand sinks. Deep fryer areas and oven exteriors need degreasing. Walls above the 3-compartment sink have small holes that must be repaired.

headline: Missing thermometers; hood filters dirty
summary: Working thermometers are needed in all coolers. Dry storage shelves, a bulk container, floors and hood filters need cleaning. A previous allergen training violation was not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Wet wiping cloths; food in grocery bags
summary: Wet wiping cloths were left on prep surfaces instead of stored in sanitizer. Various foods were stored in plastic grocery bags in the freezer; food-grade bags or containers are required.

headline: Drain buildup and dusty vent
summary: Food debris buildup in the drain under the 3-compartment sink, and dust on a vent above the food prep area. Owner told to clean or replace and keep vents clean.

headline: No handwashing signs; no food handler training
summary: No handwashing signs at hand sinks. A raw wood prep table must be sealed. No drain board or drying rack at the 3-compartment sink, and no backflow device at the mop sink. A food handler lacks training.

headline: Black slime in ice; unplugged cooler food discarded
summary: Black slime was dripping into ice from the basement ice machine and must be cleaned. The cooks-line cooler was unplugged, holding about 62 lb of food at 52.7-54°F; all discarded. Outside grease bin overflowing; citation issued.

headline: Door gaps; cutting board and floor issues
summary: Front and rear doors have roughly 1/4-inch gaps underneath. Raw wood near the utility sink, a grooved cutting board, and dirty floors in the front food area also need attention.

headline: No sink stoppers available
summary: No sink stoppers were available at the warewashing sink. They must be provided.

headline: Missing backflow device at mop sink
summary: The inspector could not find a backflow prevention device at the rear mop sink. The owner must provide one.

headline: Floors need cleaning around heavy equipment
summary: Floors around and between heavy equipment need cleaning to remove spills, debris and grease.

headline: No certified manager; bare-hand food contact
summary: No certified manager on site while soup, chicken, beans and avocado were prepared and served. Bare-hand contact with lettuce and tacos; those items were discarded (about $55). Soiled towels improperly stored; hair restraints lacking.

headline: No warmer thermometer; floor buildup
summary: No thermometer in the prep area display warming unit; one must be provided. Food and dirt buildup on the prep floor and on walls behind mixers must be cleaned.

headline: Duct tape repairs; missing backflow device
summary: Used wiping cloths were left on cutting boards, and a freezer door was repaired with duct tape. Plastic grocery bags used for food storage, no backflow device at mop sink, corroded drain pipes, and holes in wall near prep cooler.

headline: Overflowing dumpster; broken floor tiles
summary: The outside dumpster is overflowing with trash and boxes; its lid must stay closed to prevent pests. Citation issued. Also a broken waste bin lid, broken floor tiles, a dusty vent, and no allergen training for the certified manager.

headline: Missing thermometers and labels
summary: Prep coolers are missing thermometers. Basement dry storage and spice containers lack common-name labels. Single-service items are stored under unshielded sewer lines. Holes in a dry storage wall and a black substance behind the warewashing unit.

headline: Three-compartment sink backs up
summary: Water backs up into other sink compartments when the middle one drains. Person in charge told to repair it. Also food debris inside a cooler and debris on the floor near another cooler.

headline: No sanitation certificate; cold food too warm
summary: No valid city food sanitation certificate on site. Smoked salmon held at 50.1°F was discarded (about 1/2 lb). Missing soap, hand towels, handwashing signs, vomit/diarrhea cleanup procedure, and sanitizer test kits.

headline: Spills and greasy floors throughout
summary: Spills inside the pop machine, food debris on equipment, and greasy floors near recycling units. Standing water in a utility closet. Floors in prep, storage and dining areas need cleaning.

headline: Reach-in cooler at 61°F; food discarded
summary: A two-door cooler measured 61°F inside and was in poor repair. The person in charge discarded its cold food before inspection, and the cooler was tagged until repaired. Also damp wiping cloths and greasy floors.

headline: Broken mop sink; no handwash signs
summary: The mop sink is inoperable and must be repaired. Handwash sinks lack signs. Broken tile base and damaged flooring in rear areas, holes and peeling paint in a rear storage wall, and trash and unused equipment in the back yard.

headline: Leaking drain under deli handsink
summary: A leak in the drain line beneath the exposed handwashing sink in the deli prep area must be repaired.

headline: No certified manager during sushi service
summary: No certified food manager was present while sushi held at 35°F was prepared or served. Management was told a certified manager must be present at all times while such foods are handled. Citation issued.

headline: Mouse droppings in several rear areas
summary: Mouse droppings were found in the rear garage, storage, cooler and front areas, including about 20 by the rear exit door. Pest control service is required before the 10/08/2025 re-inspection. Priority citation issued.

headline: No food handler or allergen training
summary: Employees have no food handler training, and the certified manager has no allergen training. Also no handwashing sign, inadequate sink stoppers, and no lighting inside the walk-in freezer.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and thermometer
summary: No handwashing signs in employee restrooms; they must be posted. The prep cooler lacks a thermometer, which must be placed in its warmest part.

headline: No cold-holding thermometers; torn gaskets
summary: Cold-holding units lack ambient air thermometers. Torn gaskets on a cold-hold unit by the grill need replacing. Menudo pots are too large for the sink, the mop sink leaks, and hood bulbs are out.

headline: Dish machine lacks temperature indicator
summary: The hot-water dish machine had no irreversible registering temperature indicator. Manager must provide one. Priority foundation violation; citation issued.

headline: Employee skipped handwashing between tasks
summary: An employee handled cash and changed gloves, then made a smoothie without washing hands. A closed pocket door made the handsink inaccessible to the front prep area. Priority violation.

headline: Utensil rack and deli cups misused
summary: A utensil rack next to the dish room mop sink needs a barrier or relocation. Deli cups were used as scoops for bulk food; proper scoops are required.

headline: Inadequate storage lighting
summary: Lighting in the storage area is inadequate. It must be increased for visibility during cleaning and other operations.

headline: Gap under employee entrance door
summary: About a 1/2-inch gap under the red employee entrance door. The person in charge must repair it and keep the door tight-fitting.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; dirty drains
summary: Bulk flour and sugar containers in the rear prep area must be labeled. Cardboard containers stored upright must be inverted. Spilled food debris under the sandwich cooler and dirty floor drains need cleaning.

headline: Rust and mold in ice machine
summary: Rust and black mold-like buildup in the ice machine; ice must be destroyed and the machine cleaned. The front entrance opening must be sealed. A splash guard is missing, live plants sit above single-use containers, and boxes are stored on the floor.

headline: Mold-like substance in ice; live flies
summary: A mold-like substance was dripping into ice from the ice shoot. About 12 small black live flies were found in prep areas and near fryers and the dish machine; pest control required. Citations issued.

headline: Mouse droppings; cold food too warm
summary: About 50 mouse droppings on the kitchen prep floor; pest control service needed. Fish, pork and eggs held at 49.8-70.5°F; about 9 lb discarded. Hand sink had no soap, provided during inspection. Several citations issued.

headline: Black slime in ice; no sanitizer for dishes
summary: Bar handsink lacked soap and paper towels; both were provided during inspection. Black slime was dripping onto ice from the dining-area ice machine. Dishes were washed without sanitizer in a one-compartment sink. Citations issued.

headline: Rat droppings; cold food held too warm
summary: Over 30 rat droppings on the basement floor; pest control required. Sausage, potatoes and cream cheese held at 54.9-58.2°F; about 20 lb discarded. Also leaks, a handwash sink misused for dumping, and a missing undercooked-food advisory.

headline: 11 small flies; 3-compartment sink floods
summary: 11 small flies found in the banquet kitchen dish, prep and dry storage areas; all affected areas must be serviced. Priority citation issued. The 3-compartment sink floods when one compartment drains and must be serviced.

headline: No certified manager; no health policy
summary: No certified food manager on site while time/temperature-controlled foods were prepared and served. No employee health policy on site. Also a faucet that keeps running, a dirty toilet room, a dirty grease trap and floor drain.

headline: Items on floors; peeling paint; belongings stored
summary: Stored items must be raised off the floor, and milk crates cannot be used for elevation. Peeling ceiling paint above proof boxes and missing floor tiles with pooling liquid. Employee belongings are stored on basement dry food shelving.

headline: Missing thermometers; deep-cut cutting boards
summary: Thermometers are missing in cooling units throughout the grocery store. Meat-prep cutting boards with deep cuts must be replaced. Raw meat casing and chicken prep racks need cleaning, and water-damaged ceiling tiles need replacing.

headline: 35 mouse droppings on deli floor
summary: 35 mouse droppings were found on the floor in front of the deli meat counter. The area must be cleaned and pest control called. Citation issued. Also cardboard shelf liners, a leaking faucet, dirty floors, and an expired food handler certificate.

headline: Handwash sink water too cold
summary: Grill-area handwashing sink water measured 48.4°F; it must reach at least 100°F. Openings under entry and garage doors need sealing. Also exposed preset tableware, a leaking handwash drain pipe, and proof of allergen training needed.

headline: Rear door opening sealed on site
summary: An opening at the base of the left rear exit door was found and sealed on site before the inspection ended. No pests were found.

headline: Leaking faucet; stove outside hood
summary: The 3-compartment sink faucet leaks and must be repaired. A stove in the prep area is not under the ventilation hood; all cooking equipment must fit under it.

headline: No certified manager while beef was served
summary: No certified person in charge held a valid certificate, and no certified manager was on site while beef was prepared and served. Beef thawed improperly in a sink. Foam cup used as scoop. Also leaks, debris, and a broken washroom fan.

headline: No food handler training proof
summary: No proof of food handler training was on site for the food handlers. The owner was instructed to meet this requirement for all food handlers.

headline: Flies found; no pest contract; no health policy
summary: About 15 small flies near the utility sink and dry storage; no pest control contract. Food left from a prior business in coolers must be discarded. No written health policy or vomit/diarrhea cleanup supplies.

headline: Food buildup on hood filters
summary: Food buildup found on the ventilation hood and its filters. Manager must clean the hood and filters.

headline: Hair restraint lapses; smoking near kitchen
summary: Food handlers prepped without hair restraints; one was given one during inspection. Also a dirty microwave, frozen food in grocery bags, a leaking drain, missing ceiling tiles, and cigarettes on a table near the kitchen.

headline: Floor under equipment needs cleaning
summary: The floor beneath the cooking equipment and prep coolers must be cleaned.

headline: No hair restraint while handling food
summary: A food handler had no hair restraint while handling food. The person in charge was told to make sure all food handlers wear them. Dirt buildup on the floor and wall under the rear 3-compartment sink must be detail cleaned.

headline: Flying insects; missing supplies; no posted summary
summary: About 60-65 flying insects on walls and cardboard boxes in front and rear areas; more pest control service needed. Also missing soap and paper towels at sinks (provided on request), no hair restraints, and an unposted inspection summary.

headline: Cooler at 45°F; milk discarded
summary: A cooler's ambient air measured 45°F, and milk inside held at 47°F. The manager discarded one gallon of milk (about $7). A technician was called to service the cooler. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Greasy fryers and floors
summary: Some grease at the bottom of the fryers must be cleaned. Floors under fryers and corners behind equipment need grease removed.

headline: Carpet in customer service area
summary: Carpet in the customer service area must be removed and replaced with smooth, easily cleanable flooring.

headline: Hair restraint and training lapses found
summary: Food handlers worked without hair restraints, and one lacked a valid food handler certificate. Wire racks need cleaning, and a loose wall panel in the rear prep area must be sealed.

headline: Mold in ice machine; pest entry gap
summary: Black and pink mold-like substance inside the ice machine; ice must be destroyed and the machine cleaned. An opening at the base of the front entrance door must be sealed. Leaks at sinks, no hot water at basement utility sink, and a missing backflow device.

headline: Unlabeled storage; dirty cooler and walls
summary: Dry storage containers lack common-name labels. Walk-in cooler interior, door gaskets and wire racks have food debris. A pipe leaks under the warewashing handsink, and the wall behind the 3-compartment sink needs cleaning.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; exterminator required
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings in fryer cabinets, basement storage and the electrical room. An exterminator is required, and areas must be cleaned and sanitized. Citation issued. Also ice machine residue and a door gap.

headline: Missing and stained ceiling tiles
summary: Missing ceiling tiles in the dry storage rooms and water-stained tiles in the basement women's restroom must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Ice machine lacks splash protection
summary: The ice machine sits next to a handwash sink without splash protection. Basement plumbing is wrapped in string and duct tape. A leaking sink trap and unneeded equipment in the basement must be fixed or removed.

headline: Broken handsink handle; no food handler training
summary: The hand sink handle is broken and must be repaired. The food handler on duty has no food handler training and must comply, or citations will follow.

headline: Cracked floor tiles; dirty floor drains
summary: Cracked or broken floor tiles and missing or damaged ceiling tiles in the rear area must be repaired. Floors and floor drains are dirty, and light shields need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep
summary: No city-certified manager was on site while chicken, taquitos, hot dogs and pizza were prepared and served; citation issued. Floors under the soda machine and 3-compartment sink need cleaning.

headline: Handwash water too cool; no pressure
summary: Handwashing sink water in lower-level restrooms measured 82.2-88.7°F; it must reach at least 100°F. Also no handwashing signs, no water pressure at two men's room sinks, and debris in the prep area.

headline: Drink area lacks handsink and dish sink
summary: The drink station had no handwashing sink and no three-compartment sink for glassware. Service must stop until a three-compartment sink is installed. Priority violation; no citation issued.

headline: No hand towels; small door opening
summary: No hand drying provided in restrooms; paper towels were given before inspection ended. A small opening at the lower left of the front door must be sealed. Missing lidded waste receptacle; storage closet clutter.

headline: Gap under rear exit doors; sink leak
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of rear exit doors to the dumpsters must be closed. A water leak at the drain pipe under the 3-compartment sink must be repaired. The engineer on site was informed.

headline: Gloves not changed before handling clean dishes
summary: An employee did not change gloves after handling dirty dishes before removing clean dishes from the dish machine. Priority violation; citation issued. Also plates stored upright, dirty floors, and heavy grease in the hood.

headline: Minor grease on wall
summary: Minor grease buildup on the wall near cooking equipment must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Dim rear storage room
summary: The rear storage room with a two-door refrigerator is too dim. Light intensity must be increased.

headline: Grease, dust and soil in several areas
summary: Greasy ground near the loading dock grease container, a hard-to-clean fixture in the bar, a dusty dry storage ceiling, and grease buildup by the cook line hood. Owner told to clean and repair.

headline: Gaps around rear screen door
summary: Gaps at the sides, bottom and top of the rear screen door were found. Owner told to correct them and keep outer openings tight-fitting.

headline: No certified manager; food held too warm
summary: No verifiable certified food manager on site, and the original certificate was missing. Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat tortillas; food discarded. Cold food held at 46-70°F, prep cooler at 50°F, and a hand sink used to fill pans.

headline: Torn gaskets; loose faucet
summary: Torn gaskets inside two-door freezers and coolers in the rear storage area must be repaired. A loose faucet at the 3-compartment sink in the dish area must also be repaired.

headline: Cutting boards and surfaces need deep cleaning
summary: Cutting boards need cleaning or replacing when worn or deeply cut. Food contact surfaces, shelves, cooler interiors, floors and door handles need detail cleaning. Complaint inspection passed.

headline: Over 15 flying insects in dish area
summary: Over 15 flying insects on walls, shelves, ceiling and equipment in the rear dish area. Owner told to clean, sanitize, and consult a pest control company. Wastewater backs up into a sink; leaking faucet; basement ceiling hole.

headline: Restroom fan not working
summary: The rear washroom mechanical ventilation fan is not working. Management must repair or replace it.

headline: No sanitation certificate or training proof
summary: No valid city sanitation certificate and no food handler or allergen training proof on site. A certified manager must be present whenever time/temperature-controlled food is handled. Also unlabeled containers and burned-out hood bulbs.

headline: Crates used as shelves; ceiling damage
summary: Milk and soda crates are used as shelving and must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Also food spills, clutter, missing and stained ceiling tiles, damaged floor tiles, and dusty fans and vents.

headline: Dirty cloths and greasy surfaces
summary: Dirty wiping cloths were left on prep tables, not stored in sanitizer. A stained cutting board has open seams, food was stored in non-food-grade bags in freezers, and grease covers equipment and walls. Floors need deep cleaning.

headline: Beard restraint and allergen proof missing
summary: A cook with a beard lacked a beard restraint. A sanitizer bucket is required at prep tables. Broken gaskets and handles on coolers and freezers, grease inside a fryer cabinet, and no allergen training certificate for a new manager.

headline: Small holes in prep wall
summary: Small holes in the wall at the rear prep area by the 1-compartment sink must be sealed.

headline: Small gap at front door; dusty prep area
summary: A small gap at the bottom of the front entry door must be sealed. Small debris builds up in the rear walk-in cooler, and dirt and debris are under equipment in the front prep area.

headline: No food safety training proof; no certificate on site
summary: No proof of person-in-charge food safety training. Time/temperature-controlled foods were handled without a city-certified manager on site; citation issued. Food and drinks stored in a display cooler; cracked dumpster lids.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while time/temperature-controlled foods were handled and served. Cloth towels hung to dry in the kitchen, and in-use utensils were stored in standing water at room temperature.

headline: No pest service proof; several food safety lapses
summary: No proof of two pest control services in the past year. Also employee eating on the food line, cleaner stored above a sink (moved on site), meat thawed in a sink without running water, and drain backups. Citations issued.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; mold in cooler
summary: The rear exit door is not rodent-proof and must be fixed. Front prep coolers lack thermometers, bulk containers are unlabeled, prep tables and coolers are dirty, and walk-in cooler walls have mold-like patches.

headline: Leaking warewashing handsink faucet
summary: The warewashing area handwashing sink faucet leaks but still works for handwashing. It must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Cooler drain dumping into handsink
summary: The walk-in cooler condensation drain was emptying into a hand sink and must be rerouted to a floor drain. A chipped, soiled wall behind the rice cooker needs a smooth, durable surface.

headline: Leaking faucet; dirty second toilet room
summary: The 3-compartment sink faucet leaks and must be corrected. The second toilet room needs cleaning to remove buildup, and the floor in outer areas needs debris removed.

headline: No person in charge or certified manager early
summary: No person in charge or certified manager was on site during early prep; both arrived about 9:15 AM while tortas and pork were prepared. Cold rice, cheese and milk held too warm; about 60 lb discarded. Expired certificates.

headline: Laundry baskets used for produce
summary: Laundry baskets are being used to store produce in the walk-in cooler. Food-grade containers must be used for food storage.

headline: One sink faucet lacks hot water
summary: One of two 3-compartment sink faucets had no hot water, though hot water may still reach all compartments through the sprayer. Manager told to restore it. A floor drain under the sink also needs cleaning.

headline: Dusty air vent in warewashing area
summary: An air vent in the rear warewashing area had dust buildup. Owner told to clean and maintain it.

headline: Missing handwash sign; greasy basement floor
summary: A handwashing sign is missing at the first-floor bar handsink. The basement bar floor has grease, food debris and dirt under equipment and along walls; it must be cleaned.

headline: Grease trap removed from sink
summary: A grease trap was found removed from the three-compartment sink. Person in charge told to replace it and maintain it.

headline: Failed: about 200 mouse droppings
summary: Inspection failed. No city sanitation certificate on site. About 200 mouse droppings found throughout, including storage shelves, corners and dry storage. Handsink blocked by container lids; four handsinks lacked paper towels. Rear door gaps.

headline: Slow-draining three-compartment sink
summary: Passed. Three-compartment sink in dish room drains slowly; must be repaired and maintained in good condition.

headline: Open drinks, unlabeled bulk, deli cup scoops
summary: Passed. Employee drinks in open containers on prep table; bulk sugar and salt unlabeled; food handlers lacked hair restraints; deli cups used as scoops for bulk food; sushi display cooler missing a thermometer.

headline: Ice machine backflow device not located
summary: Re-inspection passed. Inspector could not locate the backflow prevention device on the ice machine; it must be located or provided.

headline: Greasy fryer; food debris under sink
summary: Passed. Deep fryer tank had grease buildup. Food debris under sink next to first-floor dishwasher must be cleaned to prevent pests.

headline: Marinara held at 55°F; discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. About 20 gallons of marinara sauce held at 55°F; cold food must be 41°F or below. Manager voluntarily discarded it, worth $100. Wiping cloths not kept in sanitizer; grime near grease trap and dish sink.

headline: Failed: no sanitizer test kit
summary: Inspection failed. No test kit for sanitizer; priority violation issued. Scoops stored with handles in food bins; bowls and pots stored on ground. Two unisex bathrooms lacked covered trash cans. Mop sink very dirty. Manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Rear door gap; food stored on floor
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the rear exit door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Food containers were stored on the walk-in cooler floor; inspector instructed elevating them at least six inches.

headline: Backflow devices and splash guards needed
summary: Passed. Rear hand sink needs splash guards. Backflow prevention devices missing at rear utility sink, espresso unit and front water dispenser. Missing floor tiles under new handwashing sinks; some lights lack shields. Washcloths must be stored in sanitizer.

headline: Single-use cups stored on floor
summary: Passed. Single-use cups and bowls were stored directly on the rear storage floor. Restroom waste receptacles had open tops and must be covered.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; greasy hood filters
summary: Passed. All large bulk food containers need proper labels. Hood vent filters need detailed cleaning to remove grease and dust buildup.

headline: No employee health policy or illness plan
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy or training, and no plan or kit for vomiting and diarrhea cleanup. Plastic grocery bags used for food in freezers must be replaced, a wood platform removed, and ovens cleaned.

headline: Failed: flies; hot and cold food too warm
summary: Inspection failed. Food handler did not properly wash hands after handling gloves. Hot chicken 116.7 to 122.4°F (minimum 135°F); cold chicken up to 128.3°F (must be 41°F). About 40 pounds discarded. About 25 live small flies found.

headline: Rear door gap; freezer floor damaged
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Rear exterior door near the outdoor waste enclosure has a gap greater than 1/4 inch. Open food placed beside a handwashing sink needs a splash guard. Freezer floor is lifting with gaps. Utility sink backflow device cap missing.

headline: Greasy omelet station; dirty floors and drains
summary: Passed. Omelet station equipment had grease and spillage, which inspector ordered cleaned. Floors under shelving in coffee and rear dry storage areas and food prep drains had dirt and debris; cleaning ordered to prevent pests.

headline: Gap under rear door; tins and cloths misused
summary: Passed. Fly strips hung over three-compartment sink must not hang in food prep areas. Rear exit door has a 1/2-inch gap underneath and must be rodent and insect proof. Wiping cloths not in sanitizer; tongs stored in a food tin.

headline: Dirty washroom floor drains
summary: Passed. Floor drains inside washrooms had dirt and debris; must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Clutter and dirty walls behind sink
summary: Passed. Excess clutter and unnecessary items throughout front and rear areas must be removed. Walls behind rear three-compartment sink heavily soiled with dirt and debris; must be cleaned at adequate frequency.

headline: Sticky insect devices stored over food prep
summary: Passed. Sticky insect control devices were stored above mugs and straws near the rear coffee prep area; inspector instructed staff not to store them over food areas. Glass plates were not inverted in rear prep.

headline: Dead roaches; unapproved vacuum sealer; openings
summary: Passed with conditions. Vacuum sealer lacked approved plan; it was tagged and must not be used. Two dead roaches in an unused locker. Opening in lunchroom doors must be sealed; churro display case door was missing and churros were moved.

headline: Dusty ice machine; damaged cooler gaskets
summary: Re-inspection passed. Slight dust and soil buildup along bump plate of second-floor server area ice machine. Gaskets on two-door reach-in cooler at main cook line are poor, missing or damaged; repair or replacement needed.

headline: Leaks, dim lights, and prior violations uncorrected
summary: Inspection failed. Two leaks above the mop sink, blown-out lights, and prior violations not fixed: no thermometers in cold units holding cheese, milk and deli meat, a missing sink stopper, and debris under a floor mat.

headline: Failed: cold food too warm; rodent droppings
summary: Inspection failed. Ham, sliced tomato, cucumber and mozzarella held at 47°F to 56.5°F; manager voluntarily discarded 8 pounds worth $150. Reach-in prep cooler at 48°F tagged. About 7 mouse droppings and 8 small flies found; pest control needed.

headline: Clutter in rear storage room
summary: Passed. Clutter in the rear storage room. Manager instructed to declutter to avoid pest harborage.

headline: Broken gaskets; leaking sink stopper
summary: Passed. Broken rubber gasket inside reach-in cooler and at ice holder door needs repair or replacement. Leaking mechanical stopper under the three-compartment sink in the prep area.

headline: Leaking water filter plumbing; food storage bin
summary: Passed. Small leak at water filtration plumbing in rear utility sink area must be repaired. Employee food storage bin stored above food in rear upright cooler must be moved to avoid contamination.

headline: Greasy grease bin lid; dirty storage floors
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Outer lid of the grease receptacle needs cleaning. Back storage floors had dirt and food debris; inspector instructed staff to clean and maintain.

headline: Cow feet held too warm; discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Cooked cow feet held at 44.7 to 45.9°F in cooler; cold food must be 41°F or below. Manager discarded about 50 pounds, valued at $163. Tin foil and cardboard liners, greasy stove, and threaded prep-sink faucet need fixing.

headline: Managers lacked allergen training certificate
summary: Passed. Certified managers on duty lacked allergen training certification; management told to obtain it. Floors along wall base and under rear storage shelves need cleaning.

headline: Utensils stored in water below 135°F
summary: Re-inspection passed. In-use utensils were stored in water below 135°F at the steam table. They must be kept in running water or water at 135°F or above between uses.

headline: Food debris, trash, and cracked wall base
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Excessive food debris inside front prep cooling units, trash and debris on floor in receptacle space, and a cracked wall base by the rear ice machine. Inspector instructed cleaning and enclosing to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Failed: about 100 rodent droppings
summary: Inspection failed. About 100 rodent droppings found; about 100 still present at re-inspection in rear storage, office, and customer aisles. Holes in walls, uncovered toilet-room receptacles, and a prior violation not corrected.

headline: Failed: small flies; unapproved insect devices
summary: Inspection failed. About 20 small flies on upstairs mop-area wall and about 30 in downstairs dish area. Unapproved insect control devices hung from ceilings. Prior allergen certificate violation not corrected.

headline: Dirty ice chute; cracked freezer lid
summary: Passed. Ice machine chute slightly soiled. Deep freezer lid cracked with exposed insulation. Handwash sink faucets and basins had debris; wall and floor drain behind three-compartment sink needed cleaning.

headline: Failed: small flies found in several areas
summary: Inspection failed. About 7 to 10 small flies in dishwashing area, 2 in food prep, and 2 in dining area. Inspector recommended contacting pest control; citation issued.

headline: Greasy fryers; dusty vents and coolers
summary: Passed. Fryers have thick grease, dirt and food. Storage racks and coolers have food and debris; walk-in fan covers dusty. Floors under fryers greasy; rear prep ceiling vent dusty. All must be cleaned.

headline: Business license number missing on container
summary: Passed. The business license number was missing from the sides of an MFP, as named in the inspection notes. The number must be at least 2 inches high on the lateral sides.

headline: Failed: no hot water at sink
summary: Re-inspection failed. No running hot water at the three-compartment sink or washroom handsink; a priority violation was issued. Also a 1-inch gap at front entrance door bottom, no pest control logbook, and a utility faucet leaking onto the floor.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; door gap
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs missing in north restrooms and rear bar area; inspector ordered them provided. A 1/4-inch gap at the middle of the side rear exit door must be sealed to keep pests out.

headline: Beef thawed in room-temperature water
summary: Passed. Beef was thawed in room-temperature water; must thaw under running water below 70°F or under refrigeration. Food residue inside cold-hold units. Water-damaged ceiling tiles. A food handler lacked a training certificate; manager lacked allergen certificate.

headline: Failed: unlabeled containers; prior violations
summary: Re-inspection failed. Unlabeled bulk containers in kitchen prep. Prior violations not corrected: greasy deep fryer, dirty floor by chest freezer, excess grease in hood, and an employee without a food handler certificate.

headline: No health policies, pest log, or dumpster
summary: Inspection failed. No signed employee health policies, no pest control logbook, and a gap under the front door. No outside dumpster on site; trash and boxes on the ground in the garbage corral. Large gap behind mop sink.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings and roaches
summary: Inspection failed. About 100 rodent droppings in multiple rear and front prep areas. Three dead cockroaches found. Several cold-holding units lacked internal thermometers. Toilet room door does not close; greasy floors and clutter also noted.

headline: Storage, labeling, and cleaning corrections ordered
summary: Passed. Inspector ordered food labeled, stored 6 inches off the floor, and walk-in cooler racks cleaned of mold-like buildup. Also ordered a freezer drain relocated to the floor drain, and floors, walls, and cooler fan covers cleaned.

headline: No certified manager; cold food too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. No City-certified food manager on premises. Cold food held at 45.1 to 51.8°F; staff discarded 2 pounds valued at $80. Leaking handwashing sink drain and faucet; holes in walls; prior violation uncorrected.

headline: No certified manager during chicken, fish
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager on site while chicken and fish were handled; no certificate posted. Cardboard used as liners on grease trap, prep tables, shelves, and walk-in floors. Hood filters greasy.

headline: Missing thermometer; cracked light shield
summary: Passed. Small cooler near the three-compartment sink lacked a thermometer. Cracked light shield in walk-in freezer must be replaced.

headline: No certified manager during ham prep
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager on site while ham and other TCS items were prepared. Torn gasket on interior of two-door cooler in rear prep area.

headline: Failed: no raw-food advisory; crates used
summary: Inspection failed. Menu lacked consumer advisory about raw or undercooked foods. Several issues: unlabeled shakers and squeeze bottles, ice scoop stored in ice bin, crates used for storage, greasy equipment, loose wall bases, and dust buildup.

headline: Thermometers missing; door seals and floors
summary: Passed. A thermometer is needed inside coolers. Multiple doors in poor repair are not sealed at the bottom, allowing possible pest entry; weather stripping must be repaired or replaced. Dishwashing, prep and walk-in floors need cleaning.

headline: Mouse droppings; overflowing outdoor trash
summary: Inspection failed. About 40 to 50 mouse droppings under a rear storage shelf and 10 to 12 on a shelf holding product. Outside waste container open and overflowing. Bathroom sink drain in poor repair. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Hair nets, jewelry, and debris issues
summary: Passed. Handwashing sink lacked signage. Some food handlers wore dangling jewelry and no hair nets. Ice machine guard dirty. Torn cooler gaskets, rusty wire racks, and food debris on floors and under cooking equipment were noted.

headline: Failed: bare-hand contact; roaches, rat droppings
summary: Inspection failed. Employee touched toast with bare hands for a customer; food discarded. Three live roaches, several dead roaches, and four rat droppings found in kitchen and basement. Health policies unsigned; food handler training missing.

headline: Cracked floors and missing allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Uneven flooring and cracked tiles near the rear prep doorway must be repaired to be smooth and cleanable. No allergen certificate for the certified manager on duty; must obtain training and keep certificate on site.

headline: Food on floors; heavy debris buildup
summary: Passed. Food bins, flour and baking sheets stored on floor; utensils on soiled shelves. Heavy debris on prep shelves. Slow-draining hand sink, leaking faucet, uncovered restroom trash, and damaged ceiling tiles were noted.

headline: Leaking drain under sink; slow drains
summary: Passed. Drainpipe leaking under the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Both handwashing sinks drain slowly. Flour, dust, grease and dirt buildup on cooking equipment, ingredient containers, racks and shelving; more frequent cleaning recommended.

headline: Grease, damaged baseboard, dirty fry filters
summary: Passed. Grease on inside of walk-in cooler door by hand sink. Torn baseboard and damaged wall by three-compartment sink must be repaired. One rusted ceiling tile above dry storage must be replaced. Dirty filters above fryers must be cleaned.

headline: Missing grout on floor tiles
summary: Re-inspection passed. Missing grout on floor tiles in prep, dishwashing and serving areas. Manager instructed to grout tiles as needed and maintain them.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink faucet
summary: Re-inspection passed. Leaking faucet and hose connection on the three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Plates not inverted; splash guards needed
summary: Passed. Plates and bowls in front prep must be inverted to prevent contamination. Handwash sinks in front and rear prep need smooth, cleanable splash guards. Dried food debris on prep table shelves; inspector instructed cleaning.

headline: Mold-like substance in ice machine
summary: Re-inspection passed. Mold-like black substance inside rear prep ice machine; ice not used for human consumption. Grease and food debris in fryer cabinets, grime near walls, damaged faucet, and missing drip container noted.

headline: Failed: walk-in freezer too warm
summary: Inspection failed. Walk-in freezer not maintaining cold: ambient air 68.1°F; must be frozen to the touch. Gaps of 1/4 inch at front and employee entrance doors. Standing water on floor in hot water tank room and by drive-thru window.

headline: No certified manager; food handler training missing
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager with training or certificate on site. No food employee certificate while coffee and dairy were served. Missing handwashing signage, uncovered restroom trash, a gap under rear door, and missing food handler training.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; mop sink backflow
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs missing at prep and restroom sinks; manager instructed to provide and maintain them. Mop sink had no backflow prevention device; one must be provided.

headline: Missing vent cover in rear prep
summary: Re-inspection passed. A ventilation cover was missing from the ceiling of the rear food prep area. Inspector instructed staff to place a cover and maintain it.

headline: Failed: black dirt in ice machine
summary: Inspection failed. Black dirt buildup inside the ice machine was dripping into ice used for customers. All ice in the machine was voluntarily discarded. Manager must clean the machine interior by the re-inspection date.

headline: Failed: chicken held at 101.7°F
summary: Inspection failed. About 5 pounds of pre-cooked chicken measured 101.7°F in a rolling cart; hot food must be 135°F or above. Manager discarded it. Also missing labels, prior violations uncorrected, worn gaskets, rust, stained ceiling tiles, and debris on walls.

headline: Soap and sanitizer missing, later provided
summary: Passed with conditions. No proof of employee health policy on site. Handwashing soap, dishwashing soap and sanitizer were missing but provided before inspection ended. Also uncovered toilet-room trash, a damaged outdoor lid, and missing ceiling tiles.

headline: Peeling base boards; loose faucet
summary: Re-inspection passed. Base boards peeling near the rear exit door in rear storage must be repaired or replaced. A loose faucet in the toilet room must be secured.

headline: No certified manager during sushi prep
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager on site while sushi and soup were prepared. Several employees had not signed the health policy; one handler lacked hair restraint; one had an expired food handler certificate. Greasy kitchen and hood.

headline: Failed: black buildup in ice; cold food warm
summary: Inspection failed. Black, brown buildup in second-floor ice bin dripped onto customer ice. Cold foods at 47.1 to 58.1°F, about 165 pounds, discarded. Basement walk-in cooler at 49°F, not to be used until it holds 41°F. Missing handwash signage.

headline: Flies persist; pest service required
summary: Passed with conditions. About 100 or more live small flies still found on walls, ceilings and near garbage; prior violation uncorrected. Pest service required on or after 8/17/26. Also door gap, food stored in furnace room, worn cutting board.

headline: Failed: no paper towels; sink backup
summary: Inspection failed. No paper towels at two hand sinks; staff supplied them during inspection. Gray water backed up into three-compartment sink basins. Debris and dust under front soda bar floor.

headline: Rice in garbage can; foil shelf liners
summary: Passed. Rice stored in a large grey garbage can; must use labeled food-grade container. Aluminum foil and plastic used as shelf liners near fryers must be removed. Greasy fryer interiors, food debris in coolers, and hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Ice machine debris; expired allergen training
summary: Passed. Debris encrusted inside ice machine; must be cleaned and serviced. Worn cutting boards, a worn can opener, moldy-looking walk-in shelving, missing sink stoppers, and expired allergen training for the certified manager were noted.

headline: Upstairs toilet won't stop running
summary: Passed. An upstairs women's toilet will not stop running. It must be repaired or replaced and maintained in good condition.

headline: Hair restraints and greasy equipment
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food handlers lacked effective hair restraints. Cooking equipment, grease trap, and stored kitchenware had grease and food buildup. Toilet fixtures needed cleaning. Prep floors under heavy equipment needed cleaning.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid city sanitation certificate on site. Certified manager and original certificate must be present whenever meatballs and soup are prepared. Boxes stored on rear storage floor must be moved six inches up.

headline: Blank health policy copies; hair restraints
summary: Passed with conditions. Only blank employee health policy copies on site; signed copies required. No paper towels at prep handsink, dispenser broken; napkins provided. Food handlers without hair restraints; milk crates used as shelving; food debris and soda syrup spills.

headline: Food on walk-in floor; greasy drip trays
summary: Passed. Food stored on floor in walk-in cooler and freezer must be elevated 6 inches. Wok station drip trays had excess grease and debris. Vents and ceiling tiles in prep area had dust.

headline: Failed: dirty walk-in door; garbage area
summary: Inspection failed. Walk-in cooler door exterior, freezer interior, and prep fans had excessive debris. Three-compartment sink stoppers were plastic. Outside garbage area dirty; grease container lid open with grease and liquid waste on the ground. Citation issued.

headline: Dried food splatters on freezer, walls
summary: Re-inspection passed. Dried liquid food splatters on the right side of the freezer in rear prep and on walls near the freezer chest; staff instructed to deep clean and maintain.

headline: No covered trash; restroom door not closing
summary: Passed. Unisex toilet room had no covered receptacles; staff must provide them. Washroom door was not self-closing; manager must repair the self-closing device.

headline: Failed: ants and no certified person in charge
summary: Inspection failed. No person in charge with valid city sanitation certificate. About 20 ants on countertop, around a water station drain, and in rear prep. Boxes stored on floor; no food handler training proof.

headline: Greasy slicer; dusty shelves; expired certificates
summary: Passed. Food buildup on meat slicer; food and dust on first-floor prep shelves must be cleaned. Expired food allergen training certificates; staff told to update them.

headline: Sanitation manager lacked allergen training certificate
summary: Complaint inspection passed. The food service sanitation manager observed had no food allergen training certificate. The inspector instructed the facility to meet the requirement.

headline: Missing thermometer; fly traps; ice build-up
summary: Passed. Milk self-dispensing units need a thermometer. Fly glue traps above the clean utensil rack must be kept away from clean utensils and open food. Ice build-up on grill walk-in cooler unit; ice scoop left standing in stagnant water.

headline: Failed: no valid manager certificate
summary: Inspection failed. Person in charge lacked a valid city sanitation certificate; manager arrived about 20 minutes later. Black slime found in ice machine reservoir and chute dripping into ice. Missing food handler training proof, allergen certificate, and vomit/diarrhea procedure.

headline: Failed: no certified manager on site
summary: Inspection failed. No person in charge present. Manager lacked valid city food service certification while ice cream and cookies were prepared and served. No handwashing soap at front sink. Prior trash-can lid violation not corrected.

headline: Serving trays stored face-up
summary: Passed. Single-service trays were stored facing up at the serving line. Inspector instructed staff to invert them to protect them from overhead contamination.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings found
summary: Inspection failed. About 30 rodent droppings found: about 20 on a shelf in rear prep near an exterior door and about 10 beneath equipment in rear dry storage. Licensed pest control service required. Front restroom fans not working.

headline: Utility sink lacks backflow device
summary: Passed. The utility sink next to the three-compartment sink in the rear prep and warewashing area has no backflow prevention device. Person in charge must provide one that can be serviced.

headline: Failed: flying insects, ice machine debris
summary: Inspection failed. About 20 live small flying insects on walls and ceilings in kitchen prep and bar areas; more pest control needed. Ice machine debris, torn pizza cooler gasket, and stained cutting boards also noted.

headline: Greasy floors and fryer areas
summary: Passed. Spillage and debris on floors in walk-in coolers and beer cooling room. Heavy grease on fryer sides, oil-draining units, and behind fryers. Dirt and debris under basement dry storage shelving. Instructed to clean all.

headline: No certified manager; date marking; pest gap
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager on site during food prep. About 5 pounds of kimchi, valued at $50, discarded for missing date marking. Rear door had a small bottom gap. Ventilation hood not working.

headline: Grease on kitchen floors; no allergen training
summary: Passed. Food debris and grease buildup on kitchen floors must be detail cleaned under equipment and along wall bases. No allergen training on site for city food manager; must complete it and keep certificate on site.

headline: Restroom doors lack self-closing devices
summary: Passed. Restroom doors lack self-closing devices. Person in charge must install and maintain them.

headline: Unlabeled bulk ingredients; greasy cooking areas
summary: Re-inspection passed. Bulk ingredients unlabeled; spoons stored inside refrigerated food containers. Cutting boards deeply cut and stained. Grease and food debris on floors, cooking equipment, and walls; heavy grease under fryers. Basement clutter noted.

headline: Burned-out lights at sink area
summary: Passed. Two light fixtures in the three-compartment sink area had burned-out bulbs. Inspector instructed staff to replace the bulbs and maintain lighting.

headline: Low water pressure at handsink
summary: Re-inspection passed. The exposed handwashing sink next to the three-compartment sink needs additional water pressure.

headline: Cold food too warm; about 60 mouse droppings
summary: About 57 lbs of cold TCS food was discarded, including chicken and pizza puffs at 45.9–55.6F (must be 41F or below). A reach-in cooler at 55.6F was tagged held. About 60 or more mouse droppings found on the floor and near storage racks.

headline: Gloves not changed before handling clean dishes
summary: Employee wore gloves while loading dirty dishes and did not change them before removing clean dishes. Priority violation; citation issued. Serving plates on shelves must be inverted. Sprayers hang below sink rim; floors and drains need cleaning.

headline: Single-use utensils not inverted
summary: Single-service utensils were not inverted, which can expose lip-contact surfaces. Manager was instructed to invert all single-service utensils.

headline: No valid manager certificate; food handler proof missing
summary: No valid City of Chicago manager certificate posted on site while TCS foods were handled. Citation issued. Also cited: food containers without labels, grease buildup, dust on vents, mops stored improperly, and no food handler training proof.

headline: No certified manager while dumplings prepared
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager on premises while meat-stuffed dumplings were prepared and served. Citation issued. Leak under rear prep hand sink, dust on hood, and a repeat allergen training violation also noted.

headline: Leaking faucet and door handle need repair
summary: Three-compartment sink faucet leaks and splashes. Walk-in cooler door handle is in disrepair. Wet mops are on the floor in the dish area and must be hung to dry. Manager was told to fix and maintain.

headline: About 125 rodent droppings found; re-inspection failed
summary: About 125 small rodent droppings were found in many areas, including storage racks, food pallets, and tamale prep. Manager must remove droppings, sanitize, call pest control, and eliminate activity. Sink leak and broken floor tiles also cited. Citation issued.

headline: Worn door seal and leaking sink pipes
summary: Front door weather stripping is worn and must be replaced to prevent pest entry. Leaky pipe under the three-compartment sink and a faucet neck leak must be repaired. Thermometers must be provided inside reach-in coolers.

headline: Ice scoop stored inside ice bin
summary: Ice scoop was stored inside the ice bin. Person in charge was instructed on how to store the ice scoop properly between uses.

headline: Cold food at 46–56F; about 70 lbs discarded
summary: Many cold TCS foods, including shrimp, cheese, pork, and salmon, were held between 46.8F and 55.9F (must be 41F or below). About 70 lbs valued at $500 were discarded. Two-door refrigerator at 52F tagged held. Citation issued.

headline: No certified manager while eggs and milk handled
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while eggs and milk were handled. Person in charge was instructed to obtain one. Warewashing has no irreversible temperature indicator, a priority foundation violation.

headline: No sanitation manager certificate; cooler not working
summary: Person in charge has no sanitation manager certificate, and no employee health policy or vomit spill kit on premises. Walk-in cooler is not operational and must be repaired. No metal stem thermometer, no test strips, and a three-compartment sink backs up.

headline: About 60 rat droppings; hot water and pest log missing
summary: About 60 rat droppings in rear storage and furniture sales floor. No pest control logbook on premises. Hand sink water at 55.6F (must be 100F). Citations issued for pests and handwashing. Paper towels were added on site.

headline: Broken gaskets; no sink stoppers; no allergen certificates
summary: Broken gasket inside two-door reach-in coolers, and a condenser with ice buildup must be repaired. Grime on cooking equipment and grease on kitchen floors must be cleaned. Three-compartment sink lacks stoppers. No allergen training certificates on site.

headline: Missing ceiling tiles and broken floor covering
summary: Missing ceiling tiles in kitchen and dish room must be replaced. A hole in the floor covered by broken tiles must be repaired to prevent pests. Clutter in kitchen offices and outdoor storage must be removed. Missing vent covers and blown bulbs under hoods.

headline: Unlabeled ingredients and sink splash guard missing
summary: Dry ingredients on a prep shelf were not labeled with common names. The front hand sink lacks a splash guard, and food trays are stored next to it. Piled wiping cloths were on a counter instead of in sanitizing buckets.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep and service
summary: No person in charge with a valid Chicago food sanitation certificate was on site when TCS food (corn at 198.7F) was prepared and served. Citation issued. Single-service articles not inverted and no allergen training for managers.

headline: Dead insects, no vomit kit, and food handler gaps
summary: No written vomit and diarrhea procedure or supplies on site. Dead insects were found along the wall and around the water heater in dry storage. A front door gap, missing hair restraints, and missing food handler certificates were also cited. Citation issued.

headline: Hot and cold food stored too warm; pests entry gap
summary: Chili at 124.5F and soup at 123.6F in hot holding (must be 135F or above). Sliced tomatoes at 60.8F and pastrami at 57.3F on prep table. Display cooler at 49.1F tagged held. Food discarded. Citations issued.

headline: Rusty shelving and damaged restroom floor tile
summary: Excessive rust on the bottom shelving of the rear prep metal table must be removed and resealed. Damaged floor tile with exposed raw wood in the small washroom must be replaced.

headline: No certified manager while raw lamb served
summary: No certified food service manager on site, and no certificate posted, while raw lamb was handled and served. Fly traps were mounted in the food production area and must be removed.

headline: Door gaps, worn gaskets, and missing ceiling tiles
summary: Door gaps could allow rodent entry. Worn gaskets, crates used for food storage, and worn cutting boards must be repaired or replaced. Stained and missing ceiling tiles and floor holes need repair. No food handler training for new employees.

headline: Pork patty at 105F; hand soap missing; citation issued
summary: Pork patty in hot holding unit at 105.3F (must be 135F or above); 2 lbs discarded. Hand sink lacked soap; staff obtained soap during inspection. Floor tiles, wall hole, and missing cooler thermometers also cited. Citations issued.

headline: No vomit kit or procedure; no summary posted
summary: No kit or procedure on site for vomit and diarrhea events. Ice scoop stored inside ice machine. Unused equipment in rear prep area and no covered trash in employee restroom. Summary report not posted for public view. Citations issued.

headline: Mold-like residue, debris, and sink leak
summary: Black mold-like residue on caulking around the three-compartment sink must be cleaned or repaired. Spilled food debris in the pizza cooler was ordered cleaned. A leaking pipe at the front prep hand sink must be repaired.

headline: Wastewater leaking from grease trap onto floor
summary: Wastewater flowed from the grease trap base onto the floor when draining the three-compartment sink. Manager must repair the grease trap; priority violation. Opening at the front door must be sealed. Unused freezer and wall openings also noted.

headline: Grease buildup, missing labels, and missing signs
summary: Grease buildup on cooking equipment, walls, floors, and shelves in kitchen and prep areas must be cleaned. Food storage containers lack common-name labels. Plates were not inverted. Missing handwashing signs and thermometers in coolers also cited.

headline: Hot and cold food unsafe; discarded on site
summary: Cooked rice at 57F and shrimp at 76F were cooled improperly; discarded. Beef at 64F, chicken at 78F, and egg rolls at 52F were held too cool; discarded. Grease buildup on equipment. Grease at outside dumpster. Citation issued.

headline: Rusted ice machine bolt; expired allergen certificate
summary: Rusted bolt inside the ice machine must be replaced. Cardboard on basement liquor shelves must be removed. Excess clutter in basement must be organized. Burned-out hood light bulb must be replaced. Allergen certificate on site has expired.

headline: Over 200 mouse droppings; live roaches found
summary: Over 200 mouse droppings found throughout the kitchen, dining areas, and storage, still present from a prior visit. One live roach was seen by cooking equipment and another behind it. Grime in coolers and mold in ceilings also cited.

headline: Ice machine and cabinets need cleaning
summary: Ice machine interior sides must be cleaned and maintained. Inside of prep area storage cabinets must be cleaned. Garbage can in the washroom has a broken lid and must be repaired or replaced. Floors behind the counter need debris cleaned.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; floor and leaks
summary: Food handler training certificates on site are all expired. Only one of three managers has allergen training documentation. Leaking pipe under soda and ice machine must be repaired. Grime on rear hallway floor and cutting boards need replacing.

headline: Pink mold-like substance in ice machine
summary: Pink mold-like substance inside the ice machine; ice is not for human consumption. Walk-in shelves have rust buildup and must be cleaned or replaced. No covered trash receptacle in women's restroom. Wall base behind ice machine in poor repair.

headline: Waste line draining into sink; no allergen training
summary: Ice machine waste line drains inside the three-compartment sink and must be moved to a floor drain. Missing thermometer in the front drawer cooler and a non-working washroom fan. Low water pressure at the washroom hand sink. Manager has no allergen training.

headline: Missing backflow device; rodent harborage clutter
summary: Utility sink with a hose attached has no backflow device; one must be installed. A backflow device on the rear dish hand sink must be removed. Utensils in 66.5F water need proper storage. Unnecessary items on the rear walkway must be removed.

headline: No hot water at hand sink; cold and hot food unsafe
summary: No hot water at rear hand sink. Pizza slices at 99F in hot unit (must stay above 135F). Walk-in at 46F; beef, chicken, cheese, dressings at 44–63F (must be 41F or below). Also noted: garbage, grease, missing allergen certificate. Citations issued.

headline: Plates stored upright; microwave splatters
summary: Plates and bowls were stored facing up in the kitchen and must be stored inverted. Food splatters inside the microwave must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Unlabeled three-compartment sink; cardboard on floor
summary: Three-compartment sink lacks labels for wash, rinse, and sanitize compartments. Cardboard on the floor in the rear utility room must be removed. Person in charge was told to correct both items.

headline: Debris on floors and walls in warewashing area
summary: Accumulated debris on floor and along walls in the rear warewashing area. Person in charge was told to detail clean the floors and walls and maintain them.

headline: Hand sink water only 71F; no hot water running
summary: Hand sink water measured 71F, and no hot water ran when the hot knob was turned on. Minimum hot water must be 100F. Sink is in rear prep and dish area. Priority violation cited; citation issued.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged out
summary: Low-temperature dish machine was not dispensing sanitizer; only 0 ppm chlorine was measured after several attempts. Machine is tagged held and must not be used until repaired to 100 ppm. Soiled linens stored in an open bucket and broken drain pipe spilling onto floor.

headline: Door gap, clutter, and dust on vents
summary: A half-inch gap at the side entrance door could allow pests in. Ice scoops were stored on a sink. A rusty cooler and milk crates used as shelving must be fixed. Basement clutter must be removed to prevent rodent hiding spots.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site
summary: No bodily fluid cleanup kit was on site. Manager must provide one. Priority foundation violation cited, but no citation was issued.

headline: No health policy; hot water low; summary not posted
summary: No employee health policy or vomit cleanup procedure and supplies on site. Basement restroom sink water measured 77F; must be 100F (citation issued). Missing food handler proof, no covered trash in basement restroom, and no public summary posted. Citation issued.

headline: Plumbing leaks and no cold water at hand sink
summary: No cold water at a dishroom hand sink, corrected on site when cold water was restored. Several leaking drain pipes and missing backflow devices on beverage machines and ice machine. Spills on floors. Citation issued.

headline: Dish machine sanitizer at 0 ppm; out of order
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine sanitizer at inspection. Machine was marked out of order and tagged; it must not be used until repaired and sanitizes between 50–200 ppm. No pest control agreement or log on site. Bulk food on basement floor.

headline: Excess ice buildup; slow drain at hand sink
summary: Ice machine interior panel slightly soiled and should be detail cleaned. Excessive ice buildup on shelves and floor of the walk-in freezer must be removed. Hand sink in prep area drains slowly and must be repaired.

headline: No certified manager on duty while TCS food served
summary: No food service manager (person in charge) was on site as required. No City of Chicago food service manager on duty while TCS foods were handled and served. Priority foundation violation; citation issued. Dust on ceiling vents also noted.

headline: Cold food at 47–49F; walk-in at 51.6F tagged held
summary: Sour cream, milk, eggs, and whipping cream in the walk-in cooler were held at 47.9–49.4F (must be 41F or below) and discarded. Walk-in cooler at 51.6F is tagged held. Dead insects and debris on floors in prep and storage areas.

headline: Hot water not working at dish area hand sink
summary: Hot water knob still does not turn on at the dishwashing hand sink, a priority violation; citation issued. Also: summary report not posted for public view, no self-closing door on employee restroom, and unlabeled dry storage containers.

headline: Over 30 rat droppings; no paper towels at sinks
summary: Over 30 rat droppings found in rear storage closet, near the cooler, and under the three-compartment sink. Manager must clean and sanitize, and pest control is recommended. No paper towels at rear hand sinks. Citation issued.

headline: Small flies present; many repairs ordered
summary: About 20 or more live small flies were flying around the premises and crawling near the three-compartment sink, linked to debris in a floor drain. Debris must be removed. Also cited: missing allergen training, no garbage contract, and worn equipment.

headline: No metal stem thermometer; food handler without certificate
summary: No metal stem thermometer is available to check hot and cold food temperatures; priority violation. One food handler lacks a food handler training certificate. One certified manager lacks allergen training. Hole in employee restroom wall must be repaired.

headline: Containers stored improperly; missing backflow device
summary: Containers were not stored inverted on shelving. No backflow prevention device was found on a hose bibb next to the beer cooler. Manager must provide one where it can be located and serviced.

headline: About 20 live flying insects; pest service needed
summary: About 20 live small flying insects on walls and ceiling of the dishwashing area and around a floor drain in the second floor prep area. Additional pest control service is needed. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Non-smooth shelves in prep area
summary: Particle board shelves in the prep area are not smooth. Non-food contact surfaces must be corrosion-resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth. Re-inspection pass.

headline: No handwashing signs; no food handler proof
summary: No handwashing signage at any hand sinks. No proof of food handler training for any food handlers. Certified manager has no allergen training certificate. Burned-out cooler light bulb, a non-working restroom fan, and missing records also noted.

headline: Loose wall edge and damaged wall tiles
summary: A loose wall edge in the rear could harbor insects and must be repaired. Damaged wall tiles by the entry door must be repaired. Dirt in corners behind equipment must be cleaned. No food safety violations noted.

headline: Drain leak at sink; no allergen training
summary: Drainpipe leak at the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Washroom has no covered receptacle. Certified food manager has no allergen training, and the person must provide documentation. Re-inspection result: pass.

headline: Dirty coolers, debris, and broken wall tile
summary: Inside of reach-in and walk-in coolers have dust, dirt, food debris, and spillage, and some items are stored on the floor of units. Rear grease cooking area walls and floors have buildup. Broken wall tile by walk-in cooler and burned-out hood bulbs need repair.

headline: Ice machine leak and cooler thermometers needed
summary: Ice machine has minimal buildup and a water leak in the rear prep area. Thermometers must be visible inside reach-in and prep coolers. A stained cutting board needs refinishing or replacing. Garbage area and floor drains need cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled containers and cutting boards with deep cuts
summary: Food stored in containers in coolers, walk-in, and dry storage lacked name labels. Ice scoop stored inside ice machine. Cutting boards with open seams and stains must be refinished or replaced. Grease, dust, and debris cleaned; ventilation hood needs cleaning.

headline: Non-cleanable faucet adapter at prep sink
summary: A handsfree faucet adapter at the rear prep hand sink is not easily cleanable. The sink works with hot and cold water. Manager must remove the adapter and keep plumbing fixtures easily cleanable.

headline: About 100 mouse droppings; no hot water at sink
summary: About 100 or more mouse droppings were found on floors, around cold holding units, and inside a refrigerator and cabinets. No hot water at restroom sink (60F). Overflowing dumpster and missing allergen certificate also cited. Remove droppings and sanitize.

headline: Food stored on floor; burned-out light bulb
summary: Food containers stored only two inches off the floor in dry storage; must be raised six inches. Exposed brick walls need sealing. A light bulb is burned out in dry storage. Certified manager has no allergen training certificate.

headline: About five live roaches; no certified manager posted
summary: About five live roaches seen behind cold holding units in the kitchen. Priority violation for pests; citation issued. No city food service manager certificate was posted on site. Grease buildup and dirty floors under equipment also cited.

headline: Peeling ceiling tiles above prep area
summary: Some ceiling tiles above the prep area have peeling paper. The manager was told to replace the damaged tiles. No food safety violations were noted.

headline: Sprayer leaks profusely; expired food handler certificates
summary: Water leaks heavily from the three-compartment sink sprayer and must be fixed. Wall damaged behind potato and dish machine must be repaired. Mop stored in bucket instead of hanging to dry. Food handler certificates are expired.

headline: Rear door gap; no covered restroom trash
summary: Rear exit door to the alley has a half-inch gap and is not rodent-proof. Women's washroom lacks a covered waste receptacle. Broken and missing floor tiles around the grease interceptor and wall corner next to the hand sink need repair.

headline: Food stored on floors; rusted shelving
summary: Food items were stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and freezer and must be raised six inches off the floor. Plastic bags and cardboard boxes are used for food storage. Rusted shelves in a rear reach-in cooler must be replaced or restored. Leaking sink faucet also cited.

headline: Cold food too warm; prep cooler tagged out
summary: Front prep cooler held cold foods too warm, including sliced vegetables at 47.5F; manager discarded 5 lbs. Cooler at 45.1F is tagged held and cannot be used until reinspected. Ice bin interior needs cleaning. Citation issued.

headline: Improper food storage and leaking sink faucet
summary: Plastic bags, cardboard boxes, and milk crates were used for food storage or elevation and must be replaced. Grease and debris behind the cooking line need cleaning. A leaking faucet at the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Food handler training is also needed on site.

headline: No certified manager; raw chicken stored above food
summary: No certified person in charge during initial inspection; manager arrived about 40 minutes later. Raw chicken stored above fresh onions and raw eggs above vegetables; all foods removed. Hand sinks blocked by pots and pans. Dirty dishes and rust also cited.

headline: Food handlers not wearing hair restraints
summary: Food handlers were prepping food without hair restraints. The person in charge was told all food handlers must wear a hair restraint. Re-inspection item.

headline: Dirt and grime on floors throughout
summary: Dirt and grime built up on floors under the three-compartment sink and throughout the facility. Manager was told to detail clean and maintain the floors in good condition.

headline: Missing thermometers, expired allergen certificate
summary: Thermometers must be visible and accurate inside all coolers in the front prep area. A chest freezer door is in poor repair. Hot and cold faucets at sinks are leaking. One certified food manager has an expired allergen training certificate.

headline: Repeat violation: ice machines lack backflow devices
summary: Backflow prevention devices were still not provided for both ice machines, a violation from 2023 that was not corrected. Manager must provide and make visible devices for both machines. Citation issued.

headline: Missing food handler certificates and thermometers
summary: No food handler certificates on site. Reach-in and display coolers lack visible ambient air thermometers. A sanitation manager has no food allergen training certificate. Re-inspection result: pass.

headline: Eggs held at 58–63F; discarded
summary: Shelled eggs in reach-in cooler were held at 58–62.6F (must be 41F or below). Eggs were discarded. Grease buildup, dirty cooler interior, encrusted can opener blade, and a faucet spraying to the side were also noted.

headline: No certified manager; no hand sink in dish area
summary: No person in charge with a valid City of Chicago sanitation certificate, and no certificate posted, when TCS food was prepared. No hand sink in the rear dish area; one must be installed with hot and cold water. Fly strips in prep ceiling removed; items stored on floor elevated.

headline: Prepackaged fruit not labeled with facility name
summary: Prepackaged fruit stored in the prep cooler was not labeled with the facility's name and address. Management was instructed to label all prepackaged foods properly. No other issues noted.

headline: No certified manager; plumbing leaks
summary: No Chicago certified food manager on site while chicken, fish, and coleslaw were prepared. Citation issued. Leaks at mop sink and both compartment sinks must be fixed. Wall panels damaged and openings needed sealing; no allergen certificates on site.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and plumbing repairs needed
summary: Handwashing signage missing in washroom. A leaky drain pipe under the prep hand sink needs repair. A broken self-closing device on the washroom door needs fixing. Basement storage and electrical room floors need detailed cleaning.

headline: No employee health policy; no hot water at sinks
summary: No written employee health policy and no vomit cleanup supplies on premises. Front and rear prep hand sinks had no hot water (60–66.5F; must be at least 100F). Pest control logbook was incomplete. Several cleaning and repair items also noted.

headline: No employee health policy on site
summary: No employee health policy was on site at inspection. Person in charge must have verified health policy for each employee available on site at all times. Foil lining shelves must be removed; cardboard boxes removed to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: Over 50 live flies; summary not posted
summary: Over 50 live small flies in stairwell, dining area, and warewashing area on walls, ceilings, and equipment, not fixed since prior visit. Must remove flies and contact licensed pest control. Inspection summary report not posted for customers.

headline: Tamales held at 120F; discarded
summary: Tamales in a pot on milk crates were held at 120.2F (must stay at 135F or above). About 20 lbs were discarded. Chicken and pork were thawing improperly on a prep table. Clutter in dry storage corners and missing allergen training also cited.

headline: No proof of allergen training for managers
summary: No proof of allergen training was provided for the food service sanitation managers. Manager was instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: No certified manager; hand washing and cleaning issues
summary: No Chicago certified food manager on site while fish, chicken, and beef were prepared. A food handler did not wash hands before putting on gloves. Raw chicken was thawing in a sink. Several cleaning, leak, and plumbing items also cited.

headline: Missing signs, thermometer, labels, and light bulbs
summary: Handwashing signage needed behind the bar. A thermometer is needed inside the walk-in cooler. Some food containers need common-name labels. The dish machine has mineral buildup, and some kitchen light bulbs are out.

headline: Fryer debris, fresh water tank leak
summary: Fryer interiors had accumulated debris and must be cleaned. A steady minor leak at the fresh water tank must be repaired. Grease debris on a ceiling screen and a black substance near the hand sink must be cleaned or replaced.

headline: Food debris and dirt on walk-in freezer floor
summary: The walk-in freezer floor has food debris and dirt. Person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Restroom faucet and freezer gasket need repair
summary: Women's restroom hand sink faucet must be repaired to stay on longer. Worn walk-in freezer door gasket must be repaired. Frappe machine nozzles and floors under the drive-thru soda machine and grills need cleaning and grouting.

headline: No hand soap, sink, or sanitizer dispenser; gap at door
summary: No hand soap at a wine bar sink or customer restrooms. No handwashing sink at the register area where cheese is served. Gap under outside door could allow pests. Dish machine lacks a temperature indicator. Citations and fixes ordered.

headline: No allergen certificate; food handler proof missing
summary: Food storage containers lack labels with common names. Aluminum foil lining on food prep equipment must be removed. Grease buildup on cooking equipment, walls, and floors must be cleaned. No proof of food handler training for any food handlers, and no allergen training documentation.

headline: No valid manager certificate; door not rodent-proof
summary: Manager on site with no valid City of Chicago food service manager certificate while hamburgers and TCS foods were prepared. Priority violation; citation issued. Front door not rodent-proof, aluminum foil lining a shelf, and cluttered utility closet also cited.

headline: Wood wicker bread baskets in prep area
summary: Multiple wood wicker bread baskets were on storage shelving in the rear prep area. The person in charge was told to remove them, as wood and wood wicker may not be used as a food-contact surface.

headline: About 50 live flying insects; repeat violations
