summary: About 50 live small flying insects in the front bar, rear utility room, and rear food storage. Additional pest control service is needed. Repeat violations for missing food handler and allergen certificates. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Cold food held at 45–83F; food discarded
summary: Several TCS foods were held at 45–83F, far above the 41F limit. Manager discarded 5 lbs turkey clubs, 10 lbs rice, and 5 lbs cheese ($60). Repeat allergen training violation cited. Citation issued.

headline: Hair restraint missing; food debris on surfaces
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint during inspection. Food debris was on the outside of prep tables, coolers, and shelving, and coffee and food debris on prep area floors. Manager was told to clean and maintain.

headline: Inadequate vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit
summary: The cleanup kit held only hairnets, one trash bag, and bandages; a proper cleanup policy and supplies are required (priority violation, citation issued). Also: unlabeled food, milk crates as shelving, a 1/4-inch gap at the front door, a large hole in a restroom wall, and dirty floors.

headline: Ice machine and microwave need cleaning
summary: Top interior of the rear ice machine had slight black residue in corners; must be cleaned and sanitized. Food debris inside the microwave must be cleaned.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; repairs needed
summary: High-temperature dish machine final rinse measured 135°F; 180°F is required. Machine tagged and held for inspection (priority violation). Wiping cloths stored on top of equipment, rusty shelving, peeling paint, missing ceiling tiles, dirt on walls and vents, and inadequate lighting.

headline: Dish machine sanitizer fixed on site
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer and was tagged; a technician repaired it and it tested at 50 ppm before inspection ended. Tag removed. Also: missing thermometers in two coolers, scoops stored with handles in food, and spilled soap and grain on floors.

headline: No certified manager; manager arrived later
summary: No certified food manager on premises; one arrived at 2:45 PM, corrected on site (priority citation). No menu disclosure for raw or undercooked animal foods. Missing backflow device, grease trap, and self-closing door in basement restroom; no food handler or allergen training proof.

headline: Food stored under leaking wastewater pipe
summary: To-go containers were stored under waste water piping with torn, exposed insulation; food items must be moved and piping resealed. Moldy caulking at the dish sink and a dirty floor drain. No proof of food handler training or allergen training.

headline: No hair restraints; dusty hoods and clutter
summary: Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints. Employee restroom trash has no lids. Clutter inside dry storage rooms must be removed to prevent pest hiding places. Dusty and dirty hoods and vents in rear prep area need cleaning.

headline: Knife stored by mop sink; debris buildup
summary: A knife was left between the wall and a prep table next to the mop sink and must be stored properly. Flour and debris on shelving under prep tables, food debris inside a reach-in cooler, a missing service window wall covering, and items on the basement floor.

headline: Leaking faucet at three-compartment sink
summary: The three-compartment sink faucet leaked when water was run. Manager instructed to repair it.

headline: Dirty ice bin interior; allergen training missing
summary: The top interior of the ice machine bin was not clean and must be cleaned. No proof of allergen training was available for certified food managers.

headline: Missing thermometers; basement storage hazards
summary: No ambient air thermometers in reach-in coolers. Sewage lines run over food and single-use items in the basement without shielding; crumbling exposed brick and wood ceiling there must be covered. Milk crates, pallets, and cardboard used as shelving; microwave and oven not clean.

headline: Hot-holding unit door and plumbing damaged
summary: Interior door panel on an upright hot-holding unit is detached with insulation exposed; it must be repaired or replaced. A rear hand sink vibrates heavily and a utility sink backflow device is damaged. Repairs instructed.

headline: Failed: about 50 flies throughout facility
summary: About 50 small flies found in the kitchen, bar, and basement storage rooms, bread storage, walk-in cooler, and three-compartment sink (priority citation). Pest control needed. Hair restraints missing, milk crates used as shelving, grease under fryers, leaking sinks, and basement clutter.

headline: No certified manager on duty
summary: No valid certified food manager on duty while TCS foods (kept hot or cold) were handled, prepared, or served (priority citation). Reach-in cooler shelves must be cleaned of spills, and floors need cleaning along wall bases and corners in front and rear prep areas.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; dead insects found
summary: No certified food manager on site while food was served (corrected on site after arrival at 2:45 PM). No employee health policy or cleanup procedure. No pest control records. Dead insects on floors of unused rear prep area. No summary report posted; many other repairs ordered.

headline: Cracked floor tile and wall gap in restroom
summary: Cracked floor tile in the restroom must be replaced. An opening between the floor and wall base next to the toilet must be sealed. All food handlers must obtain required food handler training.

headline: No hot water; food held without discard date
summary: No hot running water throughout; sinks measured 89.7–91.8°F, below required levels (priority citation). Ready-to-eat food held over 24 hours without a discard date was discarded on site (citation). No soap or paper towels at hand sinks; no employee health policy; employees prepared food without hair restraints.

headline: Baseboard needed in rear prep area
summary: Baseboard must be installed along the wall base of the front and rear prep area.

headline: No certified manager until 2:40 PM
summary: No certified food manager on duty while chicken, tuna, and beef were prepared and served; manager arrived at 2:40 PM (citation). Food stored on the floor in the rear prep area must be raised six inches. Debris on floors in utility and storage areas. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: No valid food sanitation certificate on site
summary: Person in charge lacks a valid City of Chicago food sanitation certificate (priority citation). No soap at the front prep hand sink. Leaking three-compartment sink, dirty floors and walls, unlabeled beverage containers, and no proof of food handler certificates or expired ones.

headline: Gap at basement door; grease and clutter
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the basement exit door must be sealed. Raw wood and milk crates used as shelving; grease on fryers and cooking equipment; slow-draining basement hand sink; unfinished walls; no ventilation in basement restroom; unused items to remove.

headline: Failed: low hand sink water; beef discarded
summary: Second-floor women's hand sink measured 73.8°F; 100°F is required (priority citation). Paper towels were missing and were provided on site. About 11 lb of vacuum-sealed beef dated 8/31, valued at $781, was discarded without a required variance. Two restroom hand sinks not working.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup plan
summary: No procedures or supplies for cleaning vomit and diarrhea events. Missing handwashing signs, a leaking sprayer and low pressure at the three-compartment sink, a non-working restroom fan, and a 1/4-inch gap under the front door (must be sealed). Unused crates outside must be removed.

headline: Gnats and flies found; no certified manager
summary: No certified food manager on duty while TCS foods were handled (priority citation). About 15–20 small gnats and flies found near the rear utility sink (citation). Pest log had no service since 4/23/24. Leaking drain pipe, improperly stored mop, and no proof of food handler training.

headline: Drains into hand sinks; equipment repairs
summary: A soda gun hose and a drink dispenser drain into hand sinks, which must be used only for handwashing. Torn gasket on a cooler, ice buildup on a compressor, a leaking faucet and cracked handle in a restroom, and a cracked light shield.

headline: No valid certified manager on duty
summary: No valid City of Chicago certified manager on duty while TCS foods were prepared, stored, and served (priority citation). Food on walk-in floor, food handlers without hair restraints, cardboard mats in food prep, broken restroom sink faucet, and an overflowing dumpster with lids open (citation).

headline: Water leaking under three-compartment sink
summary: Water was leaking heavily from a pipe under the three-compartment sink in the rear prep area into a container and must be repaired. Chicken stored in a bin on the walk-in floor must be moved. No handwashing signs at prep and dish area sinks.

headline: No certified manager during sushi service
summary: No certified food manager on site while sushi and tuna were prepared and served (priority citation). Missing handwashing signs at the bar and sushi sink. Excess lime on the warewashing unit, black mold on caulking, and small holes in the wall above the three-compartment sink.

headline: Employee eating in prep; missing allergen training
summary: An employee was eating and an open coffee cup was in the front prep area; a separate break area and covered drink containers are required. Unlabeled bulk containers, food on floors, food in grocery bags in the freezer, and certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Dead insects; food handlers lack certificates
summary: Several dead insects on the dish area floor and in basement storage must be cleaned. One prep cooler lacks a working thermometer. Wet wiping cloths left on prep tables, a stained cutting board used for chicken, and torn gasket taped. Several food handlers lack certificates; no inspection summary posted.

headline: Failed: items on mechanical room floor; no summary
summary: Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints. Crumbling, holed concrete in the basement mechanical room. A prior priority violation was not corrected: items stored on the floor must be raised six inches. No current inspection summary posted (citation).

headline: One missing light bulb over cook line
summary: One light bulb is missing from the hood over the cook line. Operator instructed to install a new bulb and maintain it.

headline: Grease and debris; cardboard shelf liners
summary: Dirt, grease, and debris on lower shelving and under cooking equipment. Cardboard lining shelves in the front food area must be removed. Grease on fryers, a missing trash lid in a restroom, and the certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No paper towels; undated refrigerated food
summary: No paper towels at the rear dishwashing hand sink (priority violation). Ready-to-eat cooked beans, beef, and grilled chicken in the refrigerator lacked date marks. Stained cutting board, cardboard shelf liners, dirty refrigeration interiors, and grease on equipment.

headline: About 60 mouse droppings throughout facility
summary: About 60 mouse droppings found throughout the facility, including around cooking and dish equipment, inside a walk-in with food, and behind bar and IT room. Operator must clean and sanitize and contact pest control. Opening under patio door and sink stoppers also need repair.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; no health policy
summary: No certified food manager on site while TCS foods were prepared and served (priority citation). No employee health policy or verification; no food handler training proof; no consumer advisory on menus for raw or undercooked foods. Items on floors, loose floor tiles, and missing self-closing doors.

headline: Food on floor; grease buildup throughout
summary: Food containers stored on the walk-in floor must be raised six inches. Frozen food in plastic grocery bags. Grease buildup on cooking equipment, walls, and shelving, plus debris under equipment and in corners. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; debris in ice machine
summary: No handwashing signs at hand sinks in prep, dishwashing, and bar areas. Debris in the ice machine, unlabeled food bins, stained cutting boards, and debris in floor drains and sushi cooler. Dusty ceiling fan and tiles in dish area.

headline: Missing splash guard; leaking faucet
summary: A splash guard is needed between the dump sink and clean dish counter. Milk crates must not be used for elevation. A faucet at the rear two-compartment sink leaks. Broken and peeling walls in the employee dressing room must be repaired.

headline: Aluminum foil lining shelving
summary: Aluminum foil was wrapped around shelving and must be removed.

headline: Labeling, food storage, and cleaning fixes
summary: Missing handwashing sign in the toilet room; no thermometer in the cut fruit cooler; unlabeled cut fruit, squeeze bottles, and shakers. Front door gap, boxed food on the walk-in floor, crates used for storage, and ice buildup in freezers. Leaking pipe at the three-compartment sink; overflowing trash.

headline: No certified manager during food service
summary: No certified food manager on site while bacon, egg, and cheese sandwiches and other TCS foods were prepared and served (priority citation). Dust on ceiling vents in front and rear prep areas. No food handler certificates were provided on the premises.

headline: Sink backs up; prior violation uncorrected
summary: Broken floor tiles in walk-in coolers behind the butcher area must be repaired. A prior violation was not corrected: water backs up into the three-compartment sink basins. Manager must repair before re-inspection; citation issued.

headline: No certified food manager while serving food
summary: No certified food manager on site and no valid certificate posted while chicken, deli, and other foods that must be kept hot or cold were handled and served. Priority violation; operator instructed to obtain one.

headline: About 12 live flying insects in food areas
summary: About 12 live small flying insects were found on walls, ceilings, and shelves in the food prep area, manager's office, and dry storage. Additional pest control service is needed. Priority violation; citation issued. Dish and prep equipment cleaning also required.

headline: No hot water; plumber restored partly on site
summary: No hot water at prep, washbowl, one-compartment, or three-compartment sinks; water was 57.7°F. Plumber restored hot water to 112°F during inspection, but a priority citation was issued. Unlabeled containers, wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces, burned-out hood bulbs, and no food handler certificates.

headline: Re-inspection passed; several repairs ordered
summary: Repairs ordered: torn door gaskets on prep coolers, raw wood shelves and peeling wall base in restrooms, a leaking staff toilet, broken floor tiles, a hole in a staff restroom wall, and dirty hood filters. Restroom and hood cleaning also required.

headline: Dust and grime in walk-in cooler
summary: Dust and a black substance on walk-in cooler walls and ceiling must be cleaned. Spills at the self-serve pop station counter must be cleaned. Floor drains and grease trap also need cleaning.

headline: Rat droppings found; raw chicken too warm
summary: Raw chicken measured 48.5°F in a prep cooler (must stay at 41°F or below); manager voluntarily discarded about 10 lb. Rat droppings found: 12 behind a rear prep table and 10 behind basement freezers. Additional pest control service required.

headline: Unlabeled food; uncovered food in cooler
summary: Food without labels in all coolers must be identified with its common name. Racks of uncovered food in the walk-in cooler must be covered with food-grade lids.

headline: Expired allergen training; no manager certificate
summary: No valid City of Chicago food service manager certificate; instructed to obtain one (priority citation). An expired allergen training certificate from a prior inspection remains uncorrected and was cited.

headline: No valid certified manager on duty
summary: No valid certified food manager on duty while ground beef, cheese sauce, and Italian beef were prepared and served (priority citation). Front and rear doors not tight fitting. Spills and debris in reach-in cooler, unfinished rear walls, gaps along wall bases, and an employee without food handler training.

headline: Failed: hand sinks lack hot water
summary: Hand sinks measured 73–77°F; at least 100°F is required (priority violation). Also: no hair restraints, unlabeled bulk food, items stored on the floor, cardboard used as flooring, and no proof of food handler training. Many repairs to ceilings, floors, and walls ordered.

headline: Dispenser nozzles and ice chute need cleaning
summary: Cream and sugar dispenser nozzles, ice machine chute, and cooking equipment have buildup. Milk stored in crates on the walk-in floor must be raised. Food handlers need hair restraints. Leaking faucet at the hand sink, and restroom and floor cleaning.

headline: Small pipe leak at main kitchen sink
summary: A small leak was found at a pipe under the hand sink in the main kitchen area. The inspector noted it must be repaired.

headline: Failed: live roaches found in prep and restroom
summary: Three live roaches on a wall at the rear of the prep area and two on walls in the customer restroom. Operator must remove all roach activity by re-inspection and call pest control. Cracks in prep area walls must be sealed; a manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Dish racks on floor; damp wiping cloths
summary: Dish racks stored on the floor under the dish machine must be raised six inches. Damp wiping cloths left on counters. Cardboard used as cooler shelf liner, dusty walk-in fan guards, a loose hand sink, and food debris under the dish machine.

headline: No handwashing signs; slow sink drain
summary: No handwashing signs at any hand sink in the front or rear prep, kitchen, or dishwashing areas. A hand sink near the front coffee station drains slowly. Inspector instructed repairs and signage.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; hair restraint lacking
summary: Missing handwashing sign at the front prep hand sink; ice machine debris; a manager without a hair restraint. Prior violations uncorrected: no splash guard at the front hand sink, and food debris on the ceiling over a rear prep table. Correct by 10/15/2024.

headline: Holes in front screen door; unlabeled bulk food
summary: Holes in the front screen door mesh must be replaced, sealed, or repaired. Bulk foods not in original containers must be labeled. Stored items in the rear closet must be raised off the floor. An unused jukebox must be removed.

headline: Mouse droppings found; hand soap missing
summary: About 25 mouse droppings under kitchen prep storage racks and about 25 in an adjacent furnace closet; additional pest control needed (citation). No hand soap or drying towels at coffee-area hand sink (citation). Oysters without shellstock tags discarded; ready-to-eat foods held over 24 hours lacked date marks.

headline: Gap at front door; no food handler certificates
summary: A 1/2-inch gap at the front door sweep must be sealed to keep out rodents. Water-damaged and loose ceiling tiles in a restroom, a cluttered basement floor, and no food handler training certificates on site.

headline: Failed: no hand soap, no hot water
summary: Priority violations: no hand cleanser at prep and dishwashing hand sinks, and no hot running water (at least 100°F required) at the restroom hand sink. Soiled wiping cloths left on prep tables, grease and splatter on equipment, and pooled chicken blood in the walk-in cooler. Certified food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Missing backflow device; unused pizza oven
summary: A newly installed mop sink in the rear prep area has no backflow prevention device and must have one installed. An unused pizza oven wrapped in plastic in the rear kitchen must be removed.

headline: Failed: no manager certificate; sink not working
summary: No City of Chicago food manager certificate posted on arrival (priority citation). Three-compartment sink not working properly: water backs up and floods compartments before draining (priority citation, repair required).

headline: Cardboard shelf liner; spilled food inside cooler
summary: Cardboard on shelving in the front prep area must be removed and replaced with a smooth, cleanable surface. Buildup of spilled food inside cold hold units on the cook line must be cleaned.

headline: Grease buildup; debris; no allergen training
summary: Single-use items stored on the floor must be raised six inches. Food debris and grease on cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, and shelving. Peeling paint in prep and restroom areas. Debris under equipment. Certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Grease under cooking equipment
summary: Grease was found on the floor under cooking equipment and on the exterior area between cooking equipment. Operator instructed to clean both areas.

headline: Missing backflow devices; no allergen training
summary: No backflow prevention devices on the ice machine, espresso machine, drip coffee machine, or mop sink; each must be placed where it can be serviced. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Greasy exhaust hood and filters
summary: Exhaust hood system and filters have grease buildup and must be detail cleaned and maintained.

headline: Worn cutting boards; leaking faucet
summary: Cutting boards in poor repair must be replaced when worn. A faucet at the back bar three-compartment sink leaks. Floors in the back bar and basement storage, and the floor drain under the front bar sink, need cleaning.

headline: Milk crates used for shelving; no food handler certificates
summary: Milk crates used for elevation in dry storage must be replaced with proper shelving to prevent pest hiding places. Soiled mop head must be hung. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Dust, peeling paint, and no allergen training
summary: Heavy dust on customer washroom vents must be cleaned. Peeling paint on walls behind the basement walk-in freezer must be repainted. Certified manager on site lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Loose, leaking hot water knob
summary: The hot water knob at the dish area hand sink is loose and leaks and must be repaired. Floors under the pop syrup rack need cleaning. Filters above the cooking equipment must be cleaned. Prior allergen training violation uncorrected (citation).

headline: Labeling, storage, and cleaning issues
summary: Missing handwashing sign and no thermometers in several freezers. Unlabeled containers, food stored on floors and in grocery bags, and no splash guard at a hand sink. Clutter in the yard and basement, ceiling holes, burned-out bulbs, and dirty vents and hood filters.

headline: Worn cutting boards; food debris buildup
summary: Worn cutting boards with deep grooves must be repaired or replaced. Food debris on fryer cabinets, grill table, walk-in shelving, and fan guards must be cleaned. Broken wood flooring in dining area and debris along wall bases.

headline: Heavy buildup in floor drains and storage
summary: Floor drains with heavy organic buildup and floors under beverage-mix storage shelving must be cleaned to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: No covered trash can in women's restroom
summary: The women's restroom had no covered receptacle for disposal. Inspector instructed the operator to provide one.

headline: Missing backflow device; unused equipment
summary: No backflow prevention device on the rear utility sink; one must be installed where it can be serviced. Unused equipment and unnecessary items in the rear area must be removed to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: Failed: hand sink blocked; roach spray stored with food
summary: Rear prep hand sink blocked by a cart of cooking utensils (priority citation). Roach spray and rodent bait stored behind the bar must be removed. Water backs up at the bar's three-compartment sink; no test kit for quat sanitizer; milk crates used as shelving; melted exposed wiring in a prep hood.

headline: Hair and beard restraints needed; rusty racks
summary: A food handler lacked a hair restraint and a cook lacked a beard restraint. Rust on walk-in cooler racks, dusty butter storage rack, debris outside by the dumpster, and dusty ceiling tiles and light shields in the waiting area. Food handlers lack proof of required training.

headline: Insects in washroom light shields
summary: Light shields in employee washrooms had insects inside and must be cleaned. Water-stained ceiling tiles, dusty ceiling vents, and dirty floors in deli, bakery, and meat walk-in areas. Floor behind deli cooking equipment cleaned on site.

headline: Failed: no thermometer; no sneeze guard
summary: No stem thermometer to check food temperatures (priority citation). No sneeze guard at the self-serve station (priority citation). Employees prepared food without hair restraints. Wiping cloths on prep tables, ice scoops stored in ice, and clutter and employee belongings in basement food storage.

headline: Slight residue inside ice machine
summary: Slight residue was found on the interior panel of the ice machine. Operator instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Failed: no hand sink; washing without sanitizer
summary: No hand sink in the rear rice ball prep area (citation). Employee washed equipment with only soap and water; corrected after instruction (citation). Coffee roaster and supplies stored in the dining room; the espresso drain runs into the three-compartment sink. Ceiling exposed and ice machine plastic lining.

headline: Rust and grime around grease trap
summary: Rust and grime built up on top of the grease trap and on the floor around it. Operator instructed to clean and maintain the area.

headline: Two hood light bulbs burned out
summary: Two light bulbs in the hood were burned out. Operator instructed to replace them and keep them in working order.

headline: Failed: trash overflow; repairs; no test kit
summary: Dumpster lids could not close due to overflowing trash (priority citation). No consumer advisory on electronic menus; no sanitizer test kit; missing sink stoppers. Food debris throughout, leaking sinks and faucets, damaged floor tiles and grout, and missing hood filter. Prior rust violations uncorrected.

headline: Expired food handler training for one employee
summary: One of two employees had expired food handler training; all must complete training and keep records on site. Missing handwashing sign at an exposed rear hand sink, and an unused cooler must be removed.

headline: Failed: dumpster overflowing; thermometer missing
summary: Outside dumpster overflowing, with lid unable to close; this is a food source for rodents and pests (priority citation). Front reach-in cooler lacks a working thermometer. Low water pressure at the front coffee-area dump sink; food stored on walk-in floor; missing ceiling tiles in the rear dish area.

headline: Failed: unsafe cold holding; sink blocked
summary: Raw oysters at 53°F, shrimp at 50°F, octopus at 51°F, crab at 51°F, and cut tomatoes at 50.1°F exceeded the 41°F limit; about $100 of food was voluntarily discarded. Cold unit at 53°F tagged. Bar hand sink blocked by buckets and dishes; repeat violation.

headline: Toilet does not flush
summary: A toilet in one stall does not flush. Operator instructed to repair or replace it and keep it in good condition.

headline: Restroom door and ceiling tiles
summary: Restroom door is not self-closing and must have a closing device installed. Water-damaged ceiling tiles in the lobby must be removed and replaced.

headline: Food stored on floor; cardboard shelf liner
summary: Boxed food stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and freezer must be raised six inches. Multiple cutting boards deeply scratched and stained. Cardboard lining shelves in the prep and dry storage areas must be removed.

headline: Failed: no health policy or pest log
summary: No employee health policy or training on site. No vomit and diarrhea procedure or kit. No pest control logbook or service records. Missing temperature indicators for the high-temperature dish machine and sanitizer test strips for the three-compartment sink. Also missing backflow device and outside trash receptacle.

headline: Small black residue inside ice machine
summary: A small amount of black slime residue was found in a corner inside the ice machine. Inspector instructed a detail cleaning be scheduled.

headline: Leaking pipe and open wall holes
summary: A leaking pipe was found under the three-compartment sink. Holes around pipes in the hot water tank storage area and wall by the sink must be sealed to a smooth, cleanable surface.

headline: Gap under front and side doors
summary: A 1/4-inch gap between the front and side exit doors must be repaired to prevent pests from entering.

headline: Dirty ice machine guard; food stored on floor
summary: Dirt inside the ice machine guard must be detail cleaned. Food pots were stored on the floor under shelving and must be raised six inches. Rusty shelves in a refrigerator and food debris on the front prep floor also need attention.

headline: Failed: food held too warm; no manager certificate
summary: No City of Chicago food sanitation certificate posted (priority citation). Cold foods held at 45–64°F in prep coolers, including chicken at 50°F, beef up to 64°F, and cheese at 55°F, exceeding the 41°F limit. Hot water at 70°F, below the required 110°F for dishwashing; no summary report posted.

headline: Milk crates outside; food spills behind line
summary: Milk crates by the outside dumpster area must be removed. Minor food spills on the floor behind cooking equipment at the main prep line must be cleaned.

headline: No handwashing signs; hair restraints not worn
summary: No handwashing signs near exposed hand sinks in food prep and rear dishwashing areas; signs must be provided. Employees preparing and serving food were not wearing hair restraints, which must be worn at all times.

headline: Missing hand-washing signs; leaking faucet
summary: No hand washing signs at bar hand sinks. Rust on grease trap in prep area; leaking three-compartment sink faucet; dust buildup on walls, ceiling tiles and light shields in prep area.

headline: Unlabeled spices and food stored under garbage bags
summary: MSG, salt and sugar moved out of original containers without product-name labels. Ice scoop placed on ice in the bar. Food in coolers covered with garbage bags; food-grade containers required. One of two women's washroom hand sinks lacks hot water.

headline: Unlabeled ingredient bins, small wall holes, burned-out lights
summary: Sugar, salt and herbs stored in unlabeled clear bulk containers. Two small wall holes in the front bar area to be enclosed to prevent pest entry. Burned-out bulbs under the prep hood; lighting to be increased in the prep area.

headline: Small drip below three-compartment sink
summary: A small drip below the three-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Tofu stored on open garbage can; door opening
summary: Tofu container was stored on top of an open garbage can near cooking equipment; an employee moved it to a table. An opening at the bottom of the rear exit door must be sealed. Floors under cooking equipment and the dishwasher drain need cleaning.

headline: Pipe leak, slow drain, and allergen certificate
summary: Leaking pipe under the exposed kitchen hand sink and slow drainage must be repaired. Equipment exteriors, refrigerator interiors and prep table bottoms need cleaning. Food allergen training certificate must be kept on premises.

headline: Dead gnats; uncovered chips; no allergen certificate
summary: Dead gnats found on the toilet room floor and in the mop sink basin. Bowl of chips on the stove was uncovered and must be covered. Bulk dry storage lid has slight debris buildup. Certified food manager lacks an allergen training certificate on site.

headline: Live roaches found; undated cooked pork discarded
summary: Failed. About 7 live roaches, including babies, found under and around the three-compartment sink and near the grease trap (citation issued). Undated cooked pork foods discarded. Menu does not disclose raw or undercooked soft-boiled eggs. Rear entrance not pest-proof.

headline: Food on floors; no hair restraints
summary: Chicken thawed in standing water; 3 lbs discarded. Food stored on floor, no hair restraints, and no paper towels at a hand sink (citation issued). No food handler training proof; manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: Hot and cold foods unsafe; some discarded
summary: Tempura at 107.9°F in hot-holding unit (must be 135°F or above). Fish roe at 56.8–58.5°F in sushi cooler (must be 41°F or below); about 3 lbs discarded. Frozen imitation crab thawed in utility sink. Outdated inspection summary posted.

headline: No certified manager or sanitation certificate on site
summary: No person in charge had food service manager training, and no valid City of Chicago sanitation certificate was on site. Citation issued; both must be on site while open. Also: a missing display cooler door and dim lighting in the walk-in freezer.

headline: Repeat mouse droppings and live mice found
summary: Repeat rodent activity from prior report: many mouse droppings in prep, toilet and grocery areas, 3 live mice in the prep area, and 3 live roaches near the sinks. Pest control and citation issued. Also: leaking sink and falling ceiling tiles.

headline: Food on floor; open sauce exposed to splash
summary: Food containers sat on the walk-in cooler floor; 6 inches off the floor is required. Open sauce was exposed to splash from a hand sink. Soiled cardboard floor liners and an employee beverage on a food prep surface also noted.

headline: Stained ceiling tiles; food handler lacked restraint
summary: Food handler without an effective hair restraint (beard). Stored kitchenware with dried food debris must be cleaned to prevent pest harborage. Water-stained and missing ceiling tiles in several areas must be replaced.

headline: No allergen training proof for certified food managers
summary: No proof of allergen training for any certified food manager. Staff must complete the required training and keep documentation on site at all times.

headline: Cracked lids, rust, torn curtain; no allergen proof
summary: Cracked flour container lid, shredding pipe insulation, torn cooler curtain, rusty shelving and walls, cardboard liner, and cracked floor tiles. No proof of food handler training or allergen certificates for certified managers.

headline: Backflow devices missing on sink and ice machine
summary: Backflow prevention devices could not be located on the utility sink or ice machine. They must be installed where they can be serviced and maintained.

headline: Missing sink stoppers; no allergen training
summary: The three-compartment sink lacks proper stoppers, so water cannot be held in its basins. The City-certified manager lacks allergen training; training must be obtained and verification kept on site.

headline: Rodent infestation: about 500 droppings, flies
summary: Failed. About 500 or more rodent droppings in prep, storage, toilet and basement areas, plus about 30 flies. Pest control and cleanup required (citation issued). No hot water at a prep hand sink; no soap at toilet-room sink.

headline: Floor drain sewage backup; food stored on floor
summary: Failed. Soap, water and food debris backing up out of the rear prep floor drain; cleaning and plumbing repair required (citation issued). Food containers on walk-in floor, pizza trays dirty, and a manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Moldlike buildup in cooler; greasy hood
summary: Black moldlike buildup and grease inside a two-door reach-in cooler must be cleaned. Towel used as a liner next to the stove must be removed. Grease in the hood and pipes above cooking equipment and food spillage on a wall also need cleaning.

headline: Missing and damaged floor tiles in fryer prep area
summary: Missing and damaged floor tiles in the kitchen fryer prep area must be repaired to create a smooth, cleanable surface and maintained.

headline: Utility lines on floor under three-compartment sink
summary: Utility lines and pipes run along the floor under the three-compartment sink. Operator instructed to raise them so the floor can be properly cleaned.

headline: Cold food above 41°F; about 200 lbs discarded
summary: Cheese, lettuce, eggs, bacon and other cold foods held at 45.1–48.2°F (limit 41°F). About 200 lbs ($2,000) discarded. Walk-in cooler air at 46.5°F; cooler tagged. Also: no allergen training for certificate holders.

headline: Photocopied certificate; wrong license number
summary: Manager showed a photocopy; the original City sanitation manager certificate must be posted at all times (citation issued). Wrong business license number on the MFP; correct number 2900164 required. Stained cutting board and unlocked water inlets also noted.

headline: Cardboard shelf liner and dirty surfaces
summary: Cardboard liner on rear kitchen storage racks must be removed. Interiors and exteriors of sinks, cooking and cooling equipment need cleaning; metal wall under rear hand sink needs sealing. Certified manager has an expired allergen training certificate.

headline: Over 50 mouse droppings; no hand-drying towels
summary: Failed. Over 50 mouse droppings along basement wall base (citation issued); removal and pest service required. No hand-drying supplies at any hand sink; paper towels provided by end of inspection. Bowls used as scoops in food.

headline: Door gap, greasy fryers, expired food handler certificates
summary: A 1/4-inch gap under the front entrance door must be rodent-proofed. Fly strips over the dishwashing machine were moved on site. Some freezer food stored in grocery bags; fryer bottoms need cleaning. Some food handler certificates are expired.

headline: Ice machine heavily soiled with slime; ice discarded
summary: Failed. Interior of the ice machine in the lower-level kitchen was heavily soiled with black and pink slime dripping onto ice used for human consumption. Manager instructed to discard the ice and clean and sanitize the machine (citation issued).

headline: Food held at unsafe temperatures; about 19 lbs discarded
summary: Hot foods at 99.8–129.0°F (must be 135°F or above) and cold foods at 52°F (must be 41°F or below) were discarded, about 19 lbs total. Dishwasher sanitizer read 0 ppm; repaired before inspection ended. No food handler certificates on site; chemicals unlabeled and stored near food.

headline: Stock on floor in walk-in units
summary: Stock stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer and walk-in cooler; it must be elevated 6 inches.

headline: No certified manager while eggs, milk served
summary: No certified manager while TCS foods such as eggs and milk were served (citation issued). Walk-in freezer at 69.2°F; prep cooler tagged and cannot be used until reinspected. Soiled mop head not hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Cold foods above 41°F; 35 lbs discarded
summary: Cooked potatoes, pork, chicken, eggs and soups in the display cooler held at 44.6–59.8°F (limit 41°F). Manager discarded 35 lbs ($2,150). A door refrigerator at 51.0°F is off-limits until reinspected. Also: unlabeled flour and sugar bins, chipped paint, dirty equipment.

headline: Minor storage and hygiene issues; no allergen certificate
summary: Food handler not wearing a hair restraint. Spoons and knives kept in standing water at room temperature in the prep kitchen. Deli cups not air dried after washing. Service manager has no allergen training certificate. Instructed to correct each.

headline: About 30 lbs of unlabeled cooked food discarded
summary: About 30 lbs of cooked vegetables, meats and prepared cheese lacked date labels; all discarded (citation issued). Also: no proof of food handler training for employees, and no allergen training for certified managers. Broken cooler handle and water-damaged ceiling tiles noted.

headline: Entrance door gap; pop crates used as shelves
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom and right side of the front entrance door must be sealed to prevent pests. Pop crates used as shelving; raw wood flooring behind the counter must be sealed. Cooler spills, dumpster debris and stained ceiling tiles also noted.

headline: Slow-draining hand sink; floor debris
summary: Slow-draining hand sink next to the three-compartment sink needs repair. Dried food debris along walls and in corners of rear storage and front prep areas must be cleaned.

headline: Employee belongings stored with food
summary: Employee belongings on dry storage shelves with food items. A designated area for employees to store belongings must be provided.

headline: No certified manager; no training proof
summary: No City-certified manager on site while TCS foods were prepared and served (citation issued). No food handler or allergen training proof. Dirty bulk containers, greasy cook-line equipment, dirty and damaged floors, and items on storage room floors.

headline: Rear exit door not rodent-proof
summary: Rear exit door is not rodent-proof and must be repaired to prevent pests or rodent harborage. Flour stored in a non-food-grade container must be replaced. Food debris and grease buildup on floors, walls and corners need cleaning.

headline: Uncovered drink near chicken; repeat violations
summary: Failed. Employee beverage without a lid stored where chicken is prepared. Ice machine hose leaking; walk-in cooler wall base broken. Repeat uncorrected violations include door gap, dirty walk-in, leaks, floors and a manager lacking allergen training (citation issued).

headline: Gaps under entry doors; unused equipment stored
summary: Gap under both entry doors; door sweeps needed to prevent pest entry. Unused slicer and speed racks in dry storage must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Grease buildup, leaking faucets, bare light bulb
summary: Grease and debris inside the deep fryer oil filtering area and on cooking equipment sides must be cleaned. Leaks at the main kitchen hand sink, basement three-compartment sink and basement hand sink must be repaired. Light bulb under the hood lacks a cover.

headline: No signed employee health policy; leaks and gaps
summary: No signed employee health policies on site (priority foundation violation). Leaking pipe at restroom hand sink must be repaired. Gap under the front entry door must be sealed to prevent insect entry. Waiting-area wall tiles need grouting; a hook system is needed for wet mops.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; debris under fryers
summary: No handwashing sign at a hand sink near the three-compartment sink. Trash and food debris built up under the deep fryers. Damaged baseboard and loose tiles under the three-compartment sink. One walk-in freezer light is out.

headline: No hand towels; beef thawed in standing water
summary: Hand drying was missing at prep-area hand sinks; paper towels were supplied during inspection (citation issued). Raw beef at 35°F thawed in standing water at room temperature. Items stored on floors and heavy grease on hood filters also noted.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on site
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure on site; must be provided at all times (priority foundation violation). Missing baseboards by front and office doors with paint chipping. Cracked floor tiles inside the walk-in cooler must be repaired.

headline: Vacuum-packed meats held without approved plan
summary: Vacuum-packing machine used without an approved HACCP food-safety plan. Vacuum-packed meats held over 48 hours without production dates; all food and the machine were tagged and cannot be sold until approved by CDPH (citation issued). Storage issues also noted.

headline: Rusty racks, uncovered restroom bins, dirty floors
summary: Rusted racks in the kitchen two-door refrigerator must be repaired or replaced. Covered sanitary napkin receptacles are needed in all-gender restrooms. Floor and wall-base debris in kitchen and dining areas must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager while TCS food prepared
summary: No certified manager or person in charge present while rice and chicken soups were prepared and served (citation issued). Dishwashing sink set-up corrected on site. Also: missing soap and towels at sinks, dirty wiping cloths, and employees eating at prep areas.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings throughout facility
summary: Failed. Over 100 mouse droppings found in cabinets, shelves, outlets, storage and dining areas (citation issued). Manager told to call an exterminator. Also: food debris, a non-flushing toilet, and a certified manager without allergen training.

headline: No certified sanitation manager on premises
summary: No City of Chicago certified sanitation manager on premises (citation issued). Red moldlike substance inside the ice machine; ice must be destroyed and the machine cleaned. Rear hand sink cold-water knee pedal not working. Wall holes above the three-compartment sink need sealing.

headline: No covered receptacle for feminine hygiene products
summary: The unisex staff restroom lacked covered receptacles for feminine hygiene products. The manager was instructed to provide and maintain them.

headline: No paper towels; no sanitizer test strips
summary: Failed. No paper towels at kitchen and dishwashing hand sinks (citation issued). No sanitizer test strip kit on site (citation issued). Also: torn prep cooler gasket, serving plates not inverted, and heavy grease in the hood and filters.

headline: Repeat rodent activity: about 100 droppings
summary: Failed. Repeat violation from prior report: about 100 mouse droppings in dry storage, food prep area, freezers and fryer. Gnawed baseboard under the 3-compartment sink. Additional pest control required (citation issued). Also: clutter, burned-out lights, greasy hood filters.

headline: No sanitation manager certificate; hand sink loose
summary: No City of Chicago sanitation manager certificate for the person in charge or while TCS food was handled (citation issued). Hand sink not fastened to the wall next to the ice machine. Food handler training certificates not provided for all employees, a prior violation.

headline: Dirt, dust and clutter in basement and prep
summary: Dirt and dust on pipes, walls and floors in the food prep area must be cleaned. Clutter and items on basement floor must be removed and elevated at least 6 inches.

headline: No pest control logbook; no hair restraints
summary: Failed. No pest control logbook on site (citation issued). Food handlers in the rear prep area lacked hair restraints. Also: no handwashing signs, no ambient air thermometer on a cold holding unit, and unlabeled small dry storage containers.

headline: Cool hand-sink water; open door base; fly strips
summary: Failed. Hot water at juice bar hand sink was 71°F; must be 100°F or above (citation issued). Openings at base of rear kitchen door, fly strips hanging in juice bar, and pots not inverted. Leaking faucets, damaged fridge gaskets, and ceiling tile damage.

headline: Greasy cooking equipment
summary: Grease buildup on interior and exterior surfaces of cooking equipment. Manager instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Items on floor; low water pressure; ceiling tiles
summary: Items stored on the floor under rear dry storage shelving must be elevated. Additional water pressure needed at the salad station hand sink. Missing and water-damaged ceiling tiles near the mop sink and receiving door; dirt on floor drains.

headline: Drink cup with open lid stored near food
summary: A Dunkin cup with an opening in its lid was stored on the main prep line shelf; it must be moved away from food. Minor grease spills on the outside oil container must be cleaned.

headline: Low hot water at hand sink; food on floor
summary: Failed. Women's employee washroom hand sink water at 78.4°F; must be at least 100°F (citation issued). Food containers stored on the floor in prep and storage areas. Also: unlabeled containers, plates not inverted, uncovered washroom trash, wiping cloths stored improperly.

headline: Cardboard food containers and broken wall to repair
summary: Cardboard boxes must not be used as food containers; use washable containers or food-grade plastic bags. Broken wall under the three-compartment sink needs repair. Additional allergen training certificates are required for certified food managers.

headline: No covered trash receptacle in women's restroom
summary: The women's toilet room lacked a covered trash receptacle. The person in charge was instructed to provide one and maintain it.

headline: No valid sanitation manager certificate on site
summary: No valid City of Chicago sanitation manager certificate on site (citation issued). Utensils stored in food in a cold-hold unit. Also: no handwashing signs or covered restroom trash, a rusty prep table, and holes at the bottom of the basement stairwell wall.

headline: Live flies found; pest control recommended
summary: About 40 live small flies were found on ceilings and walls in the rear utility sink and dry storage area, and the front food prep and customer service area. Told to eliminate them, clean affected areas, and contact pest control. Citation issued.

headline: No employee health policy or training on site
summary: No employee health policy or training found on site. A signed employee health policy must be provided for each employee (priority foundation violation).

headline: Missing thermometer, door gap, damaged floors
summary: Working thermometer needed in the first reach-in cooler. Front door 1/4-inch gap to be repaired against pests. Ice cream freezer needs defrosting; leaking washroom sink pipe; washroom garbage can lacks lid; damaged ceiling tiles and floors.

headline: Dirty ice bin; menu missing raw-food disclosure
summary: Ice bin interior needs cleaning; ice must be removed, and the bin cleaned and sanitized. Menu has a footnote reminder but lacks asterisk disclosure for raw or undercooked animal foods such as eggs. Allergen training for sanitation certificate holders has expired.

headline: Missing signs, unlabeled seasonings, leaks
summary: No handwashing signs at employee hand sinks; bulk seasoning in the deli is unlabeled. Milk crates used as liquor room shelving. Food debris on equipment and surfaces; leaking sprayer, backflow device and toilet; soiled mop heads on floor.

headline: Flies throughout; no certified manager; cold food unsafe
summary: Over 30 small flies on walls and ceilings in several areas. No certified person in charge on site. Cold foods at 49.5–51.1°F (limit 41°F): 15 lbs discarded. Women's restroom hand sink water at 75.4°F, below 100°F.

headline: Dirty cooler interior; food handler certificates missing
summary: Two-door cooler holding egg rolls and chicken had excessive dried debris on interior surfaces; must be cleaned. Prep hand sink draining slowly; pipe under the 3-compartment sink leaking onto floor. Heavy grease on floors and hood; no food handler certificates on site.

headline: About 50 mouse droppings found in basement
summary: Failed. About 50 mouse droppings along basement floor walls and corners must be removed by reinspection; pest control called (citation issued). 1/2-inch gap at rear exit door sweep must be rodent-proofed. Food debris in reach-in coolers and sinks.

headline: No employee health policy; uncovered waste bin
summary: No employee health policy on premises; a signed policy is needed for each employee (priority foundation violation). Basement washroom lacks a covered waste receptacle; customer washroom lacks a self-closing door device. Peeling paint and clutter also noted.

headline: Dirt and dust on floors throughout
summary: Loose debris, dirt and dust buildup on floors and corners throughout the facility. Detail clean and maintain at all times.

headline: Greasy stained ceiling tiles in kitchen
summary: Grease-stained ceiling tiles throughout kitchen rear prep areas, near locker rooms, the dish machine and cooking equipment. Must be cleaned or replaced and maintained.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink drain
summary: Three-compartment sink drain plumbing leaks but still functions. It must be repaired or replaced and all plumbing kept in good repair.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; flies from floor hole
summary: Failed. Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer; tagged and not to be used until reinspected (citation issued). About 25 small flies came from a floor hole near it; pest control needed. Also: torn gasket, broken floors, dirty wiping cloths.

headline: TCS food prepared without certified manager present
summary: Food handlers prepared TCS food without the original City sanitation certificate or a certified manager on site (citation issued). Allergen certificates required for employees holding sanitation certificates; online training must be completed and certificates kept on site.

headline: Dirty ice machine guard; gaps and clutter
summary: Ice machine interior guard is dirty and must be detail cleaned. Gaps around piping above the hot water tank must be sealed. Unused cardboard boxes and milk crates in rear dry storage must be removed.

headline: Uncovered ice bin and no allergen certificate
summary: Ice bin behind the bar missing its lid, exposing ice. Plastic bowl stored inside a bulk dry ingredient container; plates and bowls not inverted or covered. No handwashing sign at the bar hand sink. Food manager lacks allergen training certificate on site.

headline: No certified manager on duty; cold water low
summary: No certified manager on duty while TCS foods were prepared and served (citation issued). Low cold water pressure at rear hand sink; mop sink faucet leaking into a bucket; no thermometer for the front prep cooler. Damaged floors, loose wall panels, and missing wall base.

headline: Ice machine heavily soiled with slime
summary: Failed. Ice machine's upper and main compartments heavily soiled with black and gray slime dripping onto ice used for consumption (citation issued). Front bar hand sink lacks a handwashing sign. Chlorine sanitizer test kit missing.

headline: Previous violations uncorrected; loose drain pipe
summary: Failed. Loose one-compartment sink drain pipe must be tightened. Prior violations uncorrected: cracked white panel inside self-serve ice machine and spray foam sealant inside its cabinet. Manager told these must be fixed by reinspection.

headline: Greasy burners and minor dish machine leak
summary: Encrusted grease on main cook-line stove burners must be cleaned regularly. Bar low-temperature dish machine leaks slightly during use but still works; repair or replacement of its plumbing required.

headline: No handwashing signs at front and rear prep sinks
summary: No handwashing signs or posters near hand sinks in the front and rear prep areas. They must be provided.

headline: No drainboard or grease trap at sink
summary: No drainboard attached to or above the three-compartment sink; one must be provided. No grease trap at the three-compartment sink; one must be provided and maintained.

headline: Food handler training missing; containers stored on floor
summary: Failed; citation issued for no food handler training for new employees. Containers stored on the floor and single-use items not inverted. Cooking equipment not fully under the hood. Prior violations uncorrected, including wall, floor and mop sink problems.

headline: No covered waste receptacle; missing ceiling tiles
summary: Unisex washroom lacks a covered waste receptacle. Missing ceiling tiles above liquor display shelving; dirt under basement shelving; clutter in the washroom; liquor boxes must be raised 6 inches; dust on washroom vent.

headline: Ripped cooler gasket and dusty condenser
summary: Ripped rubber door gasket on the 2-door cooler under the grill must be repaired or replaced. Dust buildup on that cooler's condenser must be cleaned.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; standing water in cooler
summary: The rear side door is not rodent-proof and must be fixed to prevent possible rodent entry. Standing water inside the three-door cooler behind the front counter must be removed. All new food handlers must obtain required food handler training.

headline: Door gap, drain line, hole, and allergen training
summary: Front door gap must be sealed to prevent insect entry. Hand sink drain line must be moved to an open floor drain. Lobby wall hole and stained ceiling tiles need repair. No allergen training for a food manager.

headline: Greasy fryer and no toilet flush lever
summary: Grease encrusted on the exterior of the fryer at the cook prep line must be cleaned. Men's toilet has no flush lever and must have one installed. Vacuum and equipment stored in the men's toilet must be removed.

headline: Cracked floor tiles near cook line
summary: Cracked and broken floor tiles on the cooking line and in front of the dish machine must be restored to a smooth, cleanable surface.

headline: Unlabeled spices and cardboard shelf liners
summary: Spices and oils out of original packaging lacked product-name labels. Cardboard reused as a shelf liner on prep tables must be removed and replaced with smooth, cleanable surfaces.

headline: No hair restraints; wiping cloths improperly stored
summary: Failed. Food handlers not wearing hair restraints. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. Also: rusty walk-in racks, leaking sinks, dirty fryers and freezer, dirty toilet room, and missing cooler coving.

headline: Door gap risks pests; no allergen certificates
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the entrance/exit door sweep on Erie Street must be rodent-proofed. No food allergen training certificates for food managers; all certified managers must have valid certificates.

headline: Frozen food thawing at room temperature
summary: Frozen soup and deli meat thawing at room temperature on the rear prep counter; must use approved thawing methods. Cabinet door under front hand sink is detached and must be repaired. Certified managers lack allergen awareness training.

headline: Gap in street-side doors; chipping paint
summary: Gap in the center of the street-side double doors must be made tight-fitting to prevent insect entry. Chipping paint on basement paper goods area walls and near a hand sink must be scraped.

headline: Rust on prep table; freezer drain into handsink
summary: Rust on bottom of the rear prep table must be removed. Freezer condensation line drains into a handsink; must drain to a floor drain. No drainage is allowed into handsinks or the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Unused two-door cooler in basement
summary: Unused stand-up two-door cooler in the basement prep area must be removed or repaired.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proofed; sink not running
summary: Left double door in the rear parking lot is not rodent or insect proofed. Lower cabinet surfaces need cleaning. Washbowl in the women's staff toilet room has no running water and must be provided and maintained.

headline: No allergen training for sanitation managers
summary: No allergen training certificates for sanitation managers were found; must be provided.

headline: Eggs and pico de gallo held too warm
summary: Eggs at 49.0-53.6°F in outdoor garage refrigerator; pico de gallo at 50.1°F at room temperature. About 17 pounds ($78) discarded; citation issued. Unlabeled dry ingredients, uninverted utensils, and a missing splash guard also noted.

headline: Missing covered trash cans and allergen certificate
summary: No covered receptacles in toilet rooms. City food service sanitation manager lacks the required allergen training certificate; instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; greasy fryer
summary: Several large containers of flour and sugar lack common food name labels; must label bulk and working containers. Grease on the outside of the fryer and floor around it; must be detail cleaned.

headline: Entry door opening and ice machine backflow device
summary: Opening at the base of the front dining room entrance door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Backflow device on the ice machine could not be located and must be installed. Cracked light shield, ice buildup on freezer line, and a non-working freezer light noted.

headline: No certified food manager during food prep
summary: No City of Chicago food sanitation manager was on site while chicken and other foods that must be kept hot or cold were prepped. Low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine; Ecolab arrived and brought it to 100 ppm. Citation issued.

headline: No health policy; broken coolers and hood lights
summary: No verifiable employee health policy on site; template left for use. Two broken and two nonfunctional coolers in the prep area, and all hood lights out. Ice cream maker stored in a toilet room. No allergen certificates on site.

headline: No spill kit; prep sink hot water too cool
summary: No spill kit or cleanup procedure for vomiting and diarrheal events. Prep-area hand sink hot water measured 66°F; after a technician arrived, sinks held 102-105°F. No commercial dumpster contract or food handler training proof. Citation issued.

headline: Exit door gaps; torn gasket; expired certificates
summary: Small gap on a side and the bottom of the exit door must be corrected. Torn gasket on refrigerator door at the serving station; one of two soap dispensers in the men's toilet room not working. Some food handler certificates expired; one manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Unlabeled plastic containers; no allergen certificates
summary: Dry food in plastic containers must be labeled with common names. Milk crates used to elevate stored items must be removed. No allergen training certificates on site for the new manager.

headline: Missing undercooked food advisory; cooler at 51°F
summary: Menu lacks a consumer advisory for undercooked foods such as eggs, hamburgers and steak. Large 2-door reach-in cooler at 51°F was tagged; must not be used until it holds 41°F or below and is inspected. No backflow device on ice machine.

headline: Milk and oat milk held above safe temperature
summary: Milk and two open oat milk containers were kept at 46-48°F in prep coolers, above the 41°F limit for cold food. Person in charge voluntarily discarded them; citation issued. Also food debris on cabinets and a prep table.

headline: 300+ mouse droppings and handwashing failures
summary: About 300 or more mouse droppings found across the premises. A worker cut a pizza without washing hands after sweeping; an employee washed hands in a food sink. No signed employee health policy. Pest control service required.

headline: No sanitation manager on premises; no allergen certificate
summary: Person in charge lacks a sanitation manager certificate. No City sanitation manager on premises while eggs and milk were handled; citation issued. Restroom trash cans lack lids. No allergen certificates or training on premises.

headline: Long sink hoses, outside debris, missing food handler proof
summary: Hoses on the 3-compartment sink are too long and rest in the water past fill lines; must be cut. Debris on the ground around outside dumpsters. Two male employees lacked proof of food handler training.

headline: Roaches and rodent droppings; no certified manager
summary: Two large live roaches near the grease trap and about 22 rodent droppings under sinks, prep tables and along a front prep wall. No certified food manager on site while food was prepared. Pest control service required; citation issued.

headline: Dusty walk-in cooler fans
summary: Walk-in cooler fans have dust buildup. Manager instructed to clean them.

headline: Detail cleaning needed; one freezer light out
summary: Walk-in freezer floor needs detail cleaning. Floors in rear storage area, around the 3-compartment sink, front service area and along walls need cleaning. Hood dusty; one LED light strip out in walk-in freezer.

headline: No certified manager on site; dish machine too cool
summary: Foods that must be kept hot or cold were handled without a certified manager on site until 1:25 p.m.; citation issued. Dish machine final rinse was 157.1°F, below 180°F; machine tagged. Hair restraints, labels and allergen proof also missing.

headline: Dish machine and refrigerators not working
summary: High-temperature dish machine in the motel bar would not turn on, and a prep-area hood did not work. Unused refrigerators and a dirty hood filter were noted. Two of three certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Ice machine door buildup; no covered receptacle
summary: Buildup on the underside of the ice machine door must be cleaned. Restroom for female use lacks a covered receptacle; one must be provided.

headline: Dish machines not sanitizing; 3-compartment sink floods
summary: Front dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged; rear low-temperature machine final rinse was 111°F. 3-compartment sink floods when one side drains; citation issued. Certified manager lacks food allergen certificate.

headline: Faucet sprays water; no covered waste receptacle
summary: Faucet at the rear exposed hand sink outside the washroom sprays water and must be repaired. Employee washroom lacks a covered waste receptacle and a self-closing door device.

headline: Dead insects in basement; pooling liquid
summary: Dead insects throughout basement floors must be removed. Pooling liquid in one basement area must be removed. Unnecessary items and unused equipment must be removed to prevent pest harboring. Hot plate used for eggs must be under mechanical ventilation.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; cleaning needed
summary: Food handler training certificates are expired; all employees must obtain valid certificates. Instructed to clean cooking equipment, refrigeration, prep tables, floors, walls, ceiling vents and washroom vents.

headline: Minor food buildup and floor debris
summary: Slight buildup under front prep food line equipment must be cleaned. Floors in rear prep area have slight debris; clean and maintain.

headline: Door gap and missing allergen training
summary: Approximately 3/4-inch opening at the bottom of the entry door must be made tight-fitting to prevent pest entry. No allergen training at time of inspection; all food service managers must have it.

headline: Flies, roach, door gap and standing water
summary: 10 live small flies at the 2nd-floor dish room, 10 at the gelato area, and one live roach on a sink. Quarter-inch gap between front entrance doors. Also rusted shelving, leaking coffee station sinks, standing water, and burned-out bulbs.

headline: Ice machine replacement; cardboard and dust
summary: Ice machine needs replacing; build-up cannot be removed. Cooking equipment exteriors need cleaning. Cardboard must be removed from storage shelves. Rear prep floors need cleaning; ceiling water-damaged; air vents dusty.

headline: Clutter, floor drain, and food handler certificate
summary: Clutter on top of walk-in cooler and freezer must be removed. Floor drain under the 3-compartment sink has a black substance on its lower surface; clean. Food handler lacks proof of training; certified manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: Handwashing lapses and no soap at sinks
summary: Employee handled the register, then made sauce cups without washing hands. No soap at any hand-washing sink. Meat thawing in water in a sink. Rear screen door not rodent or insect proof. Employees in prep area lacked hair restraints.

headline: Calcium buildup inside bar ice machine
summary: Calcium buildup found inside the ice machine in the bar area. Manager instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: No hot water at washroom hand sink
summary: Hand sink in the second all-gender washroom measured 81.0°F; must be at least 100°F. Citation issued. No handwashing signs in both washrooms; ice scoops stored on the front counter; dirt and debris on basement floor around freezers.

headline: Front prep cooler too warm; food discarded
summary: Beef, pork, salsa and cheese held at 47-49°F in the front prep cooler; about 10 pounds ($100) discarded. Cooler, at 48.0°F, was tagged and must stay out of use until repaired. Torn gaskets; single-service sour cream containers reused for food.

headline: Single-use articles: no violations recorded
summary: Inspected for storage and use of single-use and single-service articles. No violations were recorded.

headline: No certified manager on duty; insects in light shields
summary: No City of Chicago food service manager on duty as required; citation issued. Insects found inside light shields in employee washrooms. Floors in deli and bakery need cleaning; water-stained ceiling tiles. No inspection summary posted; citation issued.

headline: Bare-hand lettuce chopping; chicken too warm
summary: Employee chopped lettuce with bare hands; manager discarded 2 pounds. Chicken in cooler held at 44°F; manager discarded 7 (units not stated). Expired food handler and allergen certificates. Priority violations; citation issued.

headline: No certified manager at start; pasta too warm
summary: No certified food manager on site when TCS foods were prepared; arrived about 35 minutes into the inspection. Cooked pasta at 44-50°F; 5 pounds ($10) discarded. Rusted racks and a broken freezer chest lid also noted.

headline: Six live roaches; no certified manager on site
summary: Six live roaches crawling on walls in customer washrooms, behind the rear 3-compartment sink and behind cooking equipment; additional pest control needed. No certified food manager on site while food was prepared. Citation issued.

headline: Deep fryer and prep coolers need cleaning
summary: Interior of the deep fryer and prep coolers must be cleaned. No inspection summary was posted for the public; management received a copy and was told to post it. Citation issued.

headline: Wall and floor openings need repair
summary: Wood flooring in front of the prep cooler needs repair. Openings in walls in the rear prep area and above the 3-compartment sink must be repaired. Several food handlers lack food handler certificates; proof required.

headline: Unlabeled containers and standing water in basement
summary: Dry storage containers not labeled with common names; multi-use utensils not stored inverted; plastic lining on prep cooler exteriors must be removed. Basement floor wet with standing water under the mat; must be kept clean and dry.

headline: Dust, dirt, and debris in multiple areas
summary: Floors and vents in deli, bakery, meat and produce areas have dust, dirt and debris. Floors in all walk-in coolers and freezers need cleaning. Slow drain at bakery hand sink; missing light shield in employee washroom.

headline: Front door gap; rust and grease buildup
summary: Gap along the bottom of the front door must be made tight-fitting to prevent rodent entry. Squeeze bottles unlabeled; worn cutting boards; rust on shelves; grease and dirt on prep tables, grill, fryer cabinets and walk-in cooler shelves.

headline: Plastic ware storage; cleaning and food handler training
summary: Plastic ware with handles must be stored upright. Clean walk-in cooler shelves, floor under cooking equipment, and ventilation fan in the employee washroom. All food handlers must obtain required food handler training.

headline: Boxed food on floor; food debris throughout
summary: Multiple boxed food items stored on the walk-in cooler floor in the rear prep area; must be elevated six inches. Food debris on equipment, prep tables, coolers, freezers and shelving. Floors in front and rear prep areas need cleaning.

headline: About 30 live flies; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: About 30 small black live flies in dishwashing and prep areas; flies must be eliminated and pest control service is required. Low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine; repair required; citation issued. Food handler training certificates also missing.

headline: Food on floor, milk crates as shelving, grease buildup
summary: Food containers stored on walk-in cooler floor; milk crates used as shelving. Grease buildup on cooking equipment, walls and floors. Clutter on a closet floor, which can give pests a place to hide. Corrections instructed.

headline: Missing handwash signage; door not self-closing
summary: Missing handwash signage at an employee toilet room sink. Aluminum foil on the shelf above the stove must be removed so the surface is smooth and cleanable. Employee toilet room door is not self-closing. Instructed to correct each item.

headline: Repeat violation: undercooked hamburgers without advisory
summary: Hamburgers served raw or undercooked without a consumer advisory, a repeat from the December 14, 2023 report; citation issued. No handwashing signage in restrooms or at the bar sink; no allergen training certificates on site.

headline: Leaking backflow device; expired allergen certificates
summary: Backflow prevention device leaking under the 3-compartment dish sink; must be repaired. Some allergen training certificates have expired; all certified managers must hold valid certificates.

headline: Debris on shelves; soiled mop water
summary: Debris on shelves behind the front counter must be cleaned. Soiled water in the mop pail must be removed and the mop hung to dry to prevent insect breeding. Stained ceiling tiles in prep and sales areas noted.

headline: Blocked handwash sinks; no paper towels
summary: Rear kitchen sink blocked by a food cart; front prep sink obstructed by an empty container. Paper towels missing at two sinks; handwash signage missing. Corrected on site: sinks cleared and towels provided. Other items must be fixed.

headline: Rust on shelves; food debris in cold units
summary: Rust on storage shelves in the walk-in cooler and walk-in freezer in the rear prep area must be removed. Accumulated food debris inside cold-holding equipment must be detail cleaned.

headline: Overflowing garbage; grease and spills
summary: Outdoor garbage receptacles overflowing so lids cannot close; citation issued to prevent a pest food source. Ice buildup on cooler condenser; grease and debris in deep fryer. Liquid spillage and debris on floors in several rear areas.

headline: Hand sink water too hot; broken cold handle
summary: Hand sink water at the main kitchen measured 127°F, and a broken cold-water handle prevented mixing. Manager was told not to exceed 120°F at hand sinks. Priority foundation violation noted.

headline: Basement ice machine leak; unused equipment
summary: Leak from basement ice machine onto the floor; repair and keep floors dry. All unused basement equipment must be removed to prevent pest harboring. No proof of food handler training or certified manager allergen training was provided.

headline: Beard restraint lacking; ceiling and cleaning issues
summary: Employee washing raw chicken lacked an adequate beard restraint. Soil found inside fryers and cold-holding units; broken and missing ceiling tiles. Allergen training for city managers was not completed since a prior inspection; citation issued.

headline: Improperly cooled and held foods; citation issued
summary: Cooked rice, chicken and broth cooled improperly (49.2°F, 46.5°F, 75.2°F); ice baths made and rice moved to quick chill. About 5 pounds of chicken held at 96.6°F on an unlit stove was discarded. Citation issued.

headline: Cold food at 49-52°F; cooler tagged
summary: Gyro meat, milk, tzatziki, salsa, cheese, deli meat and sour cream held at 49-52°F in a reach-in cooler. Person in charge discarded them. Cooler, at 49.6°F, was tagged and must be repaired before use. Citation issued.

headline: Clean under and behind cooking equipment
summary: Instructed to clean under and behind hot cooking equipment, and under and behind cold-holding units placed next to it.

headline: Rodent gap at side doors; dirty cabinets
summary: A 1/4-inch gap between side door sweeps must be rodent-proofed. Food debris and spills inside all cabinets must be cleaned. Dirt and debris along walls and corners of the floor need detail cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled dry containers, rust and fryer debris
summary: Dry storage containers lacked labels with the common product name. A food handler lacked a proper hair and beard restraint. Rust on 3-door cooler shelves and minor debris inside fryers. Instructed to label, provide restraint, and clean.

headline: Roaches found; cooler too warm; curry discarded
summary: Curry sauces at 47-53°F in prep cooler were discarded. Cooler restored to 41°F during inspection after management adjusted it. Two live roaches in basement hallway, one on the stairwell, and two dead roaches on the stairwell. Citation issued.

headline: Red salsa at 51°F; no pest control log
summary: Red salsa at 51°F in walk-in cooler; cold foods must be kept below 41°F; citation issued. No pest control log on premises; must provide one with at least two service reports from the past year. Wet wiping cloths on prep tables; no manager allergen certificate.

headline: Hair restraint, signage and cleaning issues
summary: Several food employees were not wearing hair restraints. Missing handwashing signage at a front coffee sink. Rusty walk-in cooler shelves and accumulated flour on rear prep floors. Management instructed to correct each item.

headline: Missing light shield end caps
summary: Two end caps are missing from light shields in the rear food prep area; management instructed to install them.

headline: About 150 live flies found in food areas
summary: About 100 live small flies on dishwashing room walls and 50 on prep area walls. Manager must remove all flies before re-inspection; pest operator service advised. Food debris on shelves and in sinks, and dust on ceiling tiles also noted.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; no allergen training on site
summary: Torn rubber gasket on a cooler door in the rear prep area must be repaired or replaced. No allergen training on site for city-certified food managers; training and records must be kept on site.

headline: Rust, damaged gasket, and bathroom ventilation
summary: Rusted storage racks in walk-in cooler; torn gasket on rear refrigerator door; food debris and spills inside cooling equipment. Drain pipe leaks under rear hand sink; hole behind water heater. Toilet room ventilation not working. Two certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Live cockroaches in food prep area; citation issued
summary: Two live cockroaches on the floor and prep table in the rear food prep area; additional pest service needed. Frozen meat and chickpeas stored in plastic grocery bags; several food handlers lack certificates. Grease and debris throughout.

headline: Missing ceiling panels and dirty floors
summary: Missing ceiling panels in the toilet room must be repaired. Dirt on floors, along walls, and in corners throughout the establishment must be cleaned.

headline: Boxed food on floor; rust and food debris
summary: Boxed food items stored on the floor along a rear prep wall must be raised six inches. Rust on basement walk-in cooler shelves, and food debris on kitchen and warewashing floors. Person in charge instructed to correct each item.

headline: No health policy or vomit kit; propane in prep
