summary: No verifiable employee health policy, and no vomit and diarrhea kit or procedure on site. Propane tank and propane hot plates used for tea in rear prep must be removed. Turbo oven not under ventilation; one food employee lacks training.

headline: Rear door opening; washroom trash cans lack lids
summary: Opening at the bottom right corner of the rear exit door must be repaired to prevent a possible pest entry point. Women's washroom must have garbage cans with lids.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers and cleaning items
summary: Bulk containers in taqueria and kitchen unlabeled; must be labeled with common food name. Leak at milk display cooler; inadequate 3-compartment sink stoppers. Dust on ceiling vents and debris behind reach-in cooler.

headline: Missing handwash sign and unlabeled food containers
summary: Missing handwash sign at a sink in the dishwashing prep area. Food storage containers lacked labels with common food names. Food containers stored on the floor in prep and storage areas. Management instructed to correct each item.

headline: Grocery bags used for food storage; sink leak
summary: Food in walk-in cooler or freezer stored in grocery bags instead of food-grade containers. Leak at a prep sink in the rear prep area. Dish room floors need cleaning. All certificate holders need allergen training.

headline: 3-compartment sink not set up; citation issued
summary: Employee washed dishes without setting up the 3-compartment sink to wash, rinse and sanitize. Manager immediately had it set up with chlorine. Citation issued. Torn refrigeration gasket and dusty ventilation units also noted.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers and raw wood cover
summary: Bulk food containers, including flour and sugar, had no labels and must be labeled. Exterior water filter cover at the dishwashing area is raw wood and must be painted or sealed.

headline: Live worm-like insects in drain; no health policy
summary: Live worm-like insects in a toilet room floor drain and several live small flies on walls. Pest control operator service recommended. No signed employee health policy and no probe thermometer. Shared dumpsters missing lids on two of four.

headline: Rear door gap; missing floor tiles; no hood
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the rear exit door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced. Missing grout and broken floor tiles; chipped paint. No ventilation hood system installed.

headline: No health policy, hot water, or food handler certificates
summary: No written employee health policy, and no paper towels or soap at several hand sinks. Food-prep hand sinks had no hot water, measuring 57.6-58.0°F (100°F required). Also missing: pest control log, dumpster contract, and food handler certificates.

headline: No city sanitation certificate; garbage lid missing
summary: No City of Chicago sanitation certificate on premises while beef and chicken were handled; manager has ServSafe training but could not show the City certificate. Citation issued. No thermometer in walk-in cooler; leaking hot water handle; one outside lid missing.

headline: Over 12 live cockroaches throughout establishment
summary: Over 12 live cockroaches found at the bar, first-floor kitchen prep area and basement prep area. Must eliminate all pest activity and clean and sanitize affected areas. Priority foundation violation; citation issued.

headline: Blank health policy, no sanitizer, no sushi rice pH method
summary: Only a blank employee health policy was on site. No chemical sanitizer on site for utensils and equipment; priority violation. No approved method or variance for testing sushi rice pH. Sink lacks a grease trap.

headline: Cold holding unit at 51.1°F; unit tagged
summary: Refrigerator under the food-line prep tables held at 51.1°F, including sliced cheese time-stamped as a public health control. Unit tagged and must reach 41°F or below. Clutter near cooking oil tanks and missing floor grout also noted.

headline: No employee health policy; allergen training needed
summary: No verifiable employee health policy on site for food and conditional employees; must be provided and maintained. Certified managers must obtain allergen training certification and keep it on site.

headline: Washroom door not self-closing; cooler floor dirty
summary: Washroom door is not self-closing and needs a self-closing device. Floors inside the walk-in cooler need cleaning to remove spills and debris.

headline: Dish machine not operable; tagged
summary: Low-temperature dish machine in the bar area is not operable; tagged and must not be used until reinspected. Hand-washing sign missing, bulk container unlabeled, debris under bar equipment and in floor drains, and expired allergen training for a certified manager.

headline: Rusted shelves and plumbing issues
summary: Handwash signs needed at all sinks. Ice scoop needs a clean container. Rusted wire shelving in dishwashing area and cooler must be painted or replaced. Repair the sink stopper lever; clean grease under the deep fryer. Working fans needed in both washrooms.

headline: Cold food above 41°F; cooler tagged, food discarded
summary: Salmon (57.3°F), imitation crab (56.5°F), ground tuna (56.8°F) and cream cheese (58.1°F) held above 41°F. Management voluntarily discarded about 40 pounds ($450). A prep cooler at 78.9°F was tagged and must stay out of use until repaired.

headline: Heavy equipment buildup; butcher lacks food handler card
summary: Buildup on slicer and meat cutter must be detail cleaned. Bottom of restroom door damaged and needs repair. A butcher employee had no food handler certificate and must obtain training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Stored items on floor; cracked coving tile
summary: Items in the outdoor shed, rear kitchen storage room and liquor storage must be elevated from the floors. Dirt under the grill and hand sink on the pizza prep line must be cleaned. Cracked coving tile in pizza prep area must be repaired.

headline: Rust at ice machine; items stored on floor
summary: Rust buildup around the ice machine door in the rear storage area. Ice scoop not stored in a sanitary container. Items on the floor of the rear storage room must be raised six inches. Spillage on walk-in cooler and sales floor; dusty condensers.

headline: Gloves changed without handwashing; TCS food handling
summary: Food handler removed gloves, moved TCS foods into the cooler, then put on new gloves without washing hands. Citation issued. Also rusty racks, a water-stained toilet ceiling tile, dirty walk-in floors, and a manager without an allergen certificate.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; wiping cloths on tables
summary: Handwashing signs missing at front prep and bar handsinks. Wiping cloths on prep tables; items stored on floor in rear kitchen; some containers unlabeled. Low water pressure at rear handsink. Dust in light shields, broken floor tiles, and grease under cooking equipment.

headline: No employee health policy on site
summary: No employee health policy was on site. The inspector required a written policy with a signed acknowledgment from each employee.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: A certified food manager was found without allergen training. The facility must provide proof of training.

headline: Prior core violation uncorrected; manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: A prior core violation from January 2026 was not corrected. The certified manager on duty had no allergen training certificate; must obtain it and keep it on site. Citation issued.

headline: No certified sanitation manager or food handler certificates
summary: Person in charge had no city sanitation certificate; none was posted. No chemical test for the three-compartment sink. Food handlers lacked food handling certificates. Rear storage and walk-in cooler floors were dirty. Citations issued.

headline: Hair restraint lapses and unlabeled bulk containers
summary: Some kitchen food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Some food was stored on the walk-in cooler floor. Some bulk containers were unlabeled. Fryers, prep tables and refrigerator interiors needed cleaning; kitchen ceiling tiles and vents were dusty.

headline: Floor gaps under ovens; dusty ceilings
summary: Gaps in flooring under ovens in front prep area must be repaired. Dust on ceiling tiles and walls of rear prep area must be cleaned.

headline: Boxed food on walk-in cooler floor
summary: Boxed food items were on the floor of the rear walk-in cooler. The person in charge was instructed to elevate all food six inches off the floor and maintain it that way.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; unlabeled bulk food
summary: Handwashing sinks at the bar and both customer restrooms lacked hand-washing signs. Basement bulk dry food containers were unlabeled. Some utensils were warped or chipped, and a wall behind a utility sink faucet had a hole.

headline: Broken floor tiles by walk-in cooler
summary: Broken, damaged floor tiles in rear prep near side exit and walk-in cooler must be repaired and made smooth and cleanable.

headline: Debris and dust on rear storage floors
summary: Loose debris, dirt and dust on floors and corners in the rear storage area. Floors must be detail cleaned and cleaned more often.

headline: Rooftop bar ice left uncovered
summary: Ice in rooftop bar ice bins was uncovered; instructed to keep it covered. A torn gasket on an inside prep cooler at the grill station must be repaired.

headline: Sink stoppers missing; clutter on storage floors
summary: Three-compartment sink stoppers needed: left sink does not hold water, right sink missing one. Storage room floors cluttered; items must be elevated or removed. Debris along prep and dish-area floors and wall bases must be cleaned.

headline: Washrooms need ceiling exhaust fans
summary: Both washrooms lacked mechanical ventilation fans. Management was instructed to install a ceiling exhaust fan in each washroom.

headline: Ice machine, bulk rice, and wiping cloth issues
summary: Ice machine interior needs cleaning; bulk rice lacks a label. Wiping cloth bucket stored beside clean plates. Milk crates used for elevation; a cooler door handle is broken with exposed insulation. Stored items outside must be removed to prevent pests.

headline: Leaking backflow device; unused items in closets
summary: Leak from ceiling backflow device at mop sink requires repair. Hole in baseboard under low-temperature dish machine; unused equipment stored in closets; floor drains need cleaning; blown-out light bulbs above ice machine.

headline: Missing thermometers; unlabeled bulk and bagged chicken
summary: No thermometers found inside cooling units. Bulk sugar, flour and breading containers unlabeled. Frozen chicken stored in grocery bags in walk-in freezer. Unisex toilets need lidded trash cans. No food handler certificates on site; managers need allergen certificates.

headline: Unlabeled food containers and floor storage
summary: Food in coolers, walk-in and dry storage lacked name labels. Food stored on floors; dirty wiping cloths in a reach-in cooler. Milk crates used as shelving and thank-you bags used for food storage. Food debris and spills found throughout facility.

headline: No certified manager; customers can reach storage
summary: No certified food manager on site while steaming milk; citation issued. Customers can reach dry storage and clean utensils. Low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer and was tagged out of use. No pest control proof or log book.

headline: Rat droppings; greasy waste container; expired allergen training
summary: About 25 rat droppings in main prep, boiler room and attic; additional pest control needed; citation issued. Grease dripping from outdoor waste grease container; citation issued. Food manager's allergen training expired. Prior core violations uncorrected.

headline: Dish machine not set up; no cold water at bar
summary: High-temperature dishwasher not set up for inspection; maintenance set it up on site. Bar handsink has no cold water; upstairs bar handsink not draining. Missing handwashing signage, walk-in thermometers, pest logbook, and allergen certificate.

headline: Unlabeled ingredients; scooper stored in bins
summary: Unlabeled flour and sugar containers in basement prep. Scooper stored submerged in sugar and salt bins. Scratched, stained cutting boards and rusty freezer racks. Oversized mixing bowl needs a written washing procedure, since it cannot fit in the sink.

headline: Dirty reach-in interiors; leaking sink faucets
summary: Lower interiors of reach-in freezers and coolers have food and debris. Leaks at the base of both three-compartment sink faucets in rear dish area. Floors and walls around equipment and sinks have food, dirt and dust buildup.

headline: Dead roaches under shelving and equipment
summary: Dead roaches found on floors and walls under shelving, under the three-compartment sink, and behind heavy cooking equipment. Bulk flour and rice containers unlabeled. Grease, food debris and dust found under equipment and in corners.

headline: Missing backflow device on employee mop sink
summary: The service and mop sink in the employee washroom needs a backflow prevention device. It must be installed and maintained.

headline: No sanitation certificate; cold storage above load line
summary: No city sanitation certificate holder on site while TCS deli meats, cooked chicken and dairy were handled; citation issued. No working thermometer where chicken is cooked and held; citation issued. Handwashing signs needed; prior core violations uncorrected.

headline: Ongoing mouse droppings; walk-in lacks lock
summary: Ongoing pest activity: about 100 mouse droppings under the staircase and about 100 in basement and furnace room. Additional pest control needed; priority violation. Walk-in cooler and chest freezer in shared common area not secured; locks needed.

headline: Cardboard lining; rusty shelves; food on floor
summary: Gap of about 1/2 to 3/4 inch at back exit door must be sealed for pest prevention. Rusty, dirty shelves in two-door refrigerator. Cardboard boxes used to line shelves and floors. Boxes with food on walk-in freezer floor must be elevated.

headline: Some food handler certificates expired
summary: Some food handler certificates were expired; instructed to renew. Debris under shelves in rear storage area must be cleaned.

headline: No hot water at restroom handsinks; ice machine debris
summary: Restroom handwashing sinks had no hot water; temperatures 57.7-65.5F, minimum is 100F. Citation issued. Also debris encrusted inside ice machine, ice buildup in walk-in freezer, and a water leak at rear handsink drain.

headline: Leaking sink and uncorrected prior clutter violation
summary: Middle compartment of the 3-compartment sink leaks and must be repaired. A prior core violation from February 2025 was not corrected: clutter in rear hallway near restroom must be removed by reinspection.

headline: Low-temp dish machine not sanitizing; tagged
summary: Low-temperature dish machine final rinse showed 0 ppm chlorine; citation issued and machine tagged. Sanitation manager has no allergen training; must provide documentation.

headline: Cardboard liners; food debris; hole in wall
summary: Cardboard used as liner in beer cooler and reach-in cold holding units; instructed to remove. Food debris and spills throughout the facility; detail cleaning needed under shelving, in prep coolers, and on fryers. Hole in wall behind rear exit door must be sealed.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; water-damaged ceiling
summary: Handwashing signs missing at food prep, bar and coffee station sinks. Wiping cloths on prep tables; ice scoops stored on top of ice bins. Items on liquor room floor. Water-damaged ceiling tiles and an opening above basement refrigerator; wall tiles missing behind dish machine.

headline: No certified food manager during TCS food service
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods (tuna, chicken, steak) were prepared and served; citation issued. No food handler or allergen training certificates on site. Floor debris and employee belongings in prep area also noted.

headline: Employees eating in prep; leaking dish machine
summary: Employees ate food in the prep area. Leak under the dish machine drains into a bus pan. Ice machine upper areas, rusty can opener, and tile wall under kitchen handsink need cleaning or repair. Backpacks stored in dry food storage area.

headline: Smoky facility lacked ventilation hood
summary: Facility was full of smoke, with no ventilation hood system installed; person in charge instructed to install one. Certified manager has no allergen training certificate and must obtain one.

headline: Unsafe cold holding temperatures; about 30 lbs discarded
summary: Cold-holding units held raw chicken at 51.9F, raw shrimp at 65.9F, bean sprouts at 67.8F and eggs up to 53.6F; limit is 41F. About 30 lbs (about $200) discarded; citation issued. Dry storage walls and dishwashing-area ceiling tiles need cleaning.

headline: Ice scoop misplaced; unlabeled batters
summary: Ice scoop was stored on top of the ice machine; corrected on site. Sweet potato, pumpkin and cheesecake batters were unlabeled; also corrected on site. Light bulbs in employee washroom and boiler closet lacked shields.

headline: No certified manager; food stored on floors
summary: No certified food manager or certificate on site while sandwiches, pizza and salads were prepared; citation issued. Food stored directly on walk-in and dry storage floors; open dry ingredients lacked overhead protection. Food handlers lacked training.

headline: Dish racks and pans stored on floor
summary: Dish racks and cooking pans were on the floor in the dishwashing area. The facility was instructed to elevate them above the floor.

headline: Stained cutting boards; dirty floors
summary: Cutting boards with open seams and black stains at pasta prep cooler must be refinished or replaced. Dirt and debris on floors under high-temperature dish machine and liquor storage shelving must be cleaned.

headline: Door gap, torn cooler gasket, greasy hood
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the front entrance door sweep must be sealed to rodent-proof it. Torn rubber gasket on prep cooler right door. Grease and food buildup on ventilation hood and filters must be cleaned.

headline: Live roaches on food; unidentified pesticide powder
summary: Six live roaches crawled on food and walls in front prep; many dead roaches on glue boards. Unidentified pesticide powder was scattered across the premises and being vacuumed during inspection. Handsink was blocked by a bread cart, removed during inspection.

headline: About 10 dead roaches in several kitchen areas
summary: About 10 dead roaches found near the ice machine, deep fryer, under the dishwasher, under the three-compartment sink, and by the rear exit. Also stained cutting boards, uninverted plates, no covered sanitary napkin receptacle, and no proof of food handler training.

headline: Unlicensed shared kitchen user; citation issued
summary: Shared kitchen operator did not ensure users were licensed; a user was told to stop operating until licensed; citation issued. Basement prep sink leaks. Employee restrooms lacked covered receptacles; manager provided one by end of inspection.

headline: No hand drying; flies; open dumpster
summary: No paper towels or hand dryers at any handsink; citation issued. Thirty live flies in rear prep area and mop closet; pest control needed. Dumpster missing its lid. Door gaps, dirty floor drains, and prior core violations uncorrected.

headline: Clutter, water-damaged ceiling tiles, dirty floors
summary: Upright ice cream freezer had a broken door handle. Excess clutter in several areas must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Water-damaged and missing ceiling tiles, dirty floors with trash and food debris, and a manager without allergen training certificate.

headline: Cracked floor tiles in main prep area
summary: Cracked floor tiles in the middle of the main prep area must be repaired.

headline: Hot water and sanitizer failures; ice machine residue
summary: Handwash sink hot water reached only 77.0F; minimum is 100F. Warewashing unit showed 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged, not to be used until repaired. Ice machine interior had residue. Citations issued. Sealant, caulking and floor drain also need attention.

headline: Floor drain buildup; missing food handler training proof
summary: Floor drains under the three-compartment sink and bar counter had buildup inside. No proof of food handler training for any food handlers, and no proof of allergen training for the city-certified food sanitation manager.

headline: Low water pressure and leaks near dish machines
summary: Low hot and cold water pressure at the employee women's restroom handsink. Leaks from three-compartment sink drain pipes and beneath low-temperature dish machines in the basement and bar; repairs instructed.

headline: Chicken, gyro sauce, cheese held above 41F
summary: Walk-in cooler held chicken at 44F, gyro sauce at 45F and cheeses at 45-47F; limit is 41F. Citation issued; management instructed to keep cold foods below 41F.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup kit
summary: No written employee health policy or vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit and procedure on site; 90-day grace period given, no citation. Both washrooms lacked covered receptacles. Crawl spaces had dust and cobwebs; basement meters exposed; unused items need removal.

headline: No health policy; mobile unit issues
summary: No employee health policy on site; priority violation, no citation. Two-door cooler cannot be locked while vehicle is moving. Improper sanitizer test strips; wastewater and fresh water tank sizes non-compliant. Front door in disrepair.

headline: Slimy ice maker residue; gaps and unprotected food
summary: Black slimy substance inside ice maker dripped into ice; machine to be shut off, ice removed, and cleaned. Citation issued. Also a 1/4-inch front door gap, a sticky fly trap, missing cooler thermometers, and prior core violations not corrected.

headline: Gap at front door; dirty reach-in interiors
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the front door needs weather stripping to prevent pest entry. Reach-in cooler interiors need cleaning of spills and debris. Debris, dust and grease on an attached pipe and wall fixture.

headline: Missing signage; rust; clutter and dirty floor drain
summary: No handwashing signage at exposed bakery prep handsink. Rust on shelves in two-door refrigerator. Clutter and items on bakery prep floor must be elevated. Dirty floor drain under warewashing sink must be cleaned.

headline: About 60 rat droppings; no certified manager
summary: About 60 rat droppings on basement storage floor; additional pest control needed; citation issued. No certified food manager on duty while chicken, pork and fish were handled; citation issued. Grease, food debris and dust found in several areas.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; pest control required
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings found in prep, storage and office areas, and a dead mouse removed on site. Pest control needed before reinspection; citation issued. Rear baking door needs a sweep. Beverage on prep table and hair-restraint lapses corrected on site.

headline: Food held too warm; no paper towels
summary: Service cooler food held at 44.2-64F (tofu, egg rolls, shrimp, chicken); about 8 lbs discarded. Prepared food held over 24 hours without a discard date; 10 lbs discarded. No paper towels at two handwashing sinks. Citations issued.

headline: Missing covered receptacles in basement restrooms
summary: Both basement restrooms lacked covered receptacles. The facility was instructed to provide and maintain them.

headline: Deli cup used as scoop; broken gaskets
summary: Deli cups were used as scoops for bulk food; proper scoops required. Broken rubber gaskets on front prep cooler; replacement instructed.

headline: Mouse droppings and no running water
summary: No hot or cold running water, so hands and lettuce could not be washed. Food handler handled money, then put on gloves to prepare food; no water to wash hands. Over 75 mouse droppings found. Raw steak at 49.3-50.5F (30 lbs) discarded.

headline: Three-compartment sink stopper not holding water
summary: The sink stopper for the three-compartment sink does not hold water; it must be repaired for proper washing and sanitizing.

headline: Hot and cold holding failures; cooler tagged out
summary: Cooked eel held at 125F, below the 135F minimum; discarded. Spicy mayo at 53.4F (about 2 lbs) discarded. Line cooler reached only 50F; tagged and not to be used until repaired. Citations issued. Also torn gasket, dirt, and water-damaged ceiling tiles.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; openings in walls
summary: Bulk containers in storage were not labeled with the common food name; manager instructed to label them. Openings along walls and baseboards in prep and storage areas must be sealed.

headline: No certified manager while deli sandwiches served
summary: No city-certified food manager on site or valid documentation while deli sandwiches were prepared and served. Person in charge instructed that a certified manager must be on premises at all times; citation issued.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup procedure
summary: No employee health policy or vomit/diarrhea cleanup procedure and supplies on site. No food handler training for employees and no allergen training for certified managers. Handwashing signs missing; no sanitizer test kit; debris on coolers and floors.

headline: Gloves changed improperly; bacon held too warm
summary: Food handler wore the same gloves from raw hamburger patty to hot dog buns; buns and gloves discarded on site. Bacon held at 62.4F; about 1 lb discarded, corrected on site. Hair restraint missing. Citations issued.

headline: Excess dust on vents
summary: Excessive dust on bathroom vents and above the walk-in cooler; instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: No refrigeration; no hot water in washroom
summary: Premises has no refrigeration units to hold TCS foods as required; citation issued. No hot running water at washroom handsink and mop sink. No backflow device on rear mop sink.

headline: No certified manager; unsafe cold holding temperatures
summary: No city-certified food manager on site during TCS food prep; certified manager arrived at 3:55 PM. Kitchen refrigerator held catfish at 45.7F and chicken at up to 52.2F; 150 lbs discarded. Unit barred from use until reinspected. Handsink drain failing.

headline: Incomplete pest log; no raw food advisory
summary: Pest control logbook incomplete; only one 2023 report shown; citation issued. Menu lacked raw or undercooked food consumer advisory. No food handler training for any handlers; one manager lacks allergen training. Stored chemicals on floor and debris found.

headline: Cracked eggs held at 47F; discarded
summary: Cracked and beaten eggs held at 47F; limit is 41F. Manager discarded a half gallon ($12); citation issued. Grease and dirt buildup on walls throughout the facility must be cleaned.

headline: Foil-lined prep tables; leaky handsink
summary: Prep tables lined with aluminum foil must be removed for smooth, cleanable surfaces. Leaky handsink piping causing pooling water in bar prep must be repaired.

headline: Ice scoop touching wall; missing light shield
summary: Ice scoop was stored improperly, touching the wall in an open rack. A light shield was missing in the walk-in cooler. Both must be corrected.

headline: No certified manager during pizza service
summary: No certified food manager present while pizza at 140F was prepared and served; citation issued. Pest control log book not maintained; only a 2024 pest report was kept. Torn gaskets, leaking hot water valve, and summary not posted; citations issued.

headline: No partition between mop sink and handsink
summary: No partition between mop sink and handsink in prep area; a smooth, non-porous partition must be installed. Debris on floor around basement stairwell and water-damaged kitchen ceiling tiles must be replaced.

headline: Mop stored with head on wall and floor
summary: A mop was drying with its head resting on the wall and floor near the utility sink. Staff must store mops so mop heads do not contaminate floors, walls or other surfaces while drying.

headline: Splash guard, sink repair, and open wall
summary: Hand sink in rear prep needs a splash guard. Plumber's putty cannot be used to repair the prep three-compartment sink; it must be welded or replaced. Open wall behind the west bar must be sealed; spray foam must be cut smooth.

headline: Prior core violations uncorrected: signage, propane, ventilation
summary: Missing handwashing signage at rear prep sink; propane tank and hot plates used for tea must be removed; espresso machine backflow device missing; oven not under ventilation. Prior core violations uncorrected. Citation issued.

headline: Chicken at 47F; more than 15 small flies
summary: Chicken held at 47F; limit is 41F; citation issued. More than 15 small flies seen throughout the kitchen, including near coolers and the mop sink area. Citation issued for pest control.

headline: No certified manager; unsafe buffet food temperatures
summary: No certified food manager on site while TCS foods were served. Breakfast buffet boiled eggs at 60.8F, turkey at 48.8F, salami at 57.2F, prosciutto at 49.7F; 7.5 lbs discarded. Buffet food shield too high; sanitizer too concentrated; prior summary not posted.

headline: Unlabeled containers; greasy floors and vent hood
summary: Food in coolers, walk-in and dry storage lacked name labels. Used aprons, rugs, mop and cooking oil container stored near rear exit; remove. Grease, debris and dirt under cooking equipment; hood and filters need detail cleaning.

headline: Boxed food on floor; soiled cooler interiors
summary: Boxed food on walk-in cooler floor must be elevated six inches. Soiled interiors in rear prep coolers, greasy cooking equipment, and food debris on kitchen prep floors need cleaning.

headline: Wiping cloths and dust in rear prep
summary: Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizing solution when not in use; instructed to correct. Rear prep floors and ceiling need detail cleaning to remove dust and debris.

headline: Missing hair restraint; leaking washbowl
summary: Food handler without hair or beard restraint. Interior of three-compartment and rear handsink dirty. Washbowl in toilet room leaks heavily from pipe underneath. Trash around dumpsters, moldy ceiling tiles, and poor dish-area lighting.

headline: Unlabeled containers; missing sink stoppers
summary: Food storage containers lacked common-name labels. Milk crates used as shelving; shelving 6 inches off floor required. Three-compartment sink stoppers missing or not working. Grease, debris and dust under equipment and on fans and vents.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged out of use
summary: High-temperature dish machine final rinse reached only 123F (180F needed); tagged and not to be used until repaired. No written employee health policy. Leaking three-compartment sink faucet; oven not under ventilation.

headline: No certified manager on premises; sink and pest gaps
summary: No city-certified sanitation manager on premises; citation issued. Dishwashing handsink lacked soap, corrected on site. Dock door openings need sealing to keep pests out. Leaking faucet, hard-to-use hot water pedal, and no food handler training proof.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; unlabeled bulk items
summary: Handwashing signs missing at exposed handsinks. Bulk food in basement prep and dry storage not labeled; serving plates on kitchen shelves not inverted. Certified food managers on duty lacked allergen training certificates.

headline: Still no proof of food handler training
summary: Re-inspection found no proof of food handler training. The facility was instructed to provide proof for all food handlers. Result: Pass.

headline: Hygiene, ice, and cleaning gaps still needing fixes
summary: Employees without hair restraints and wiping cloths left on prep tables. Missing handwashing signs and a needed thermometer at the milk cooler. Ice buildup in basement freezers, greasy cooking equipment, leaking faucet, and rust inside walk-in cooler.

headline: Missing signage, partitions, and training records
summary: No handwashing signs at restroom and prep sinks. Hot-held food and ice cream freezer not protected from public; partitions and a closet door required. Missing covered trash can, no proof of food handler training, and no allergen-trained certified food manager.

headline: Dead insects on glue boards and floors
summary: Dead insects found on glue boards and floors in the rear storage area and basement. Inspector instructed removal to prevent possible feeding activity.

headline: Beans and rice cooled improperly; cloth contact
summary: Method for cooling beans and rice is inadequate; food must be uncovered to cool properly. Noodles stored in direct contact with a wiping cloth in a prep cooler. Slow drain at rear handsink; wet mop stored in bucket.

headline: Employee drink near equipment; missing handwashing signs
summary: Employee drank from an uncovered cup near clean utensils. Handwashing signs missing at three sinks. Dust on cold-holding compressors and vents, towels lining plumbing fixtures, and insufficient lighting in the 2nd floor walk-in freezer.

headline: Steady pipe leak and broken freezer gasket
summary: Handwashing signs missing at three sinks. Steady leak under the rear three-compartment sink, broken freezer door gasket with ice buildup, and grease in the fryer cabinet and used cooking oil container. Basement employee restroom lacked covered trash can.

headline: No certified manager while TCS food prepared
summary: No certified food manager present while tomato soup (a TCS food) was prepared. No food handler or allergen training certificates were provided. Dishwashing room has a leaking drain line; walk-in cooler lighting is inadequate.

headline: Black mold in ice machine; leaking sink; no allergen certificate
summary: Black mold-like substance on the ice machine panel above the ice; the machine is used for human consumption, and the violation was not corrected. Leak under the one-compartment dishwashing sink. No allergen certificate for certified managers on site.

headline: Black mold in ice machine; grime in floor drain
summary: Excessive black mold-like substance inside the ice machine used for drinks. Ice must be disposed of, and the machine cleaned and sanitized (priority citation). Grime built up in the floor drain under the one-compartment sink.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep
summary: No certified food manager on site while TCS foods (rice, beans, tacos, burritos) were prepared; manager arrived 45 minutes later. Person in charge lacks a sanitation certificate. Manager allergen certificate expired. Unlabeled bulk containers and missing backflow device noted.

headline: Ice machine under drain pipes; clutter at rear
summary: Basement ice machine sits under drainage piping that must be relocated or covered. Missing handwashing sign at the coffee station hand sink. Clutter, including tools and a bike, must be removed from the rear.

headline: Frozen meat stored in plastic grocery bags
summary: One food handler lacked a food handler certificate. Frozen meat was stored in plastic grocery bags; only food-grade bags or containers are allowed. Employee restroom needs a covered trash can and a self-closing door.

headline: Drinks, condiments, and straws stored in wrong places
summary: Bottled beverages were stored in a washroom; condiments and straws were stored under a hand sink. Manager was told to remove them. Paper towel dispenser sensor does not work; cabinets have debris; soda storage area has floor spills.

headline: Over 200 rat droppings in basement storage
summary: More than 200 rat droppings found in basement storage near the grease trap and water heater. Cleanup required, plus additional pest control service. Also: grease on microwave, stove, prep tables, and floors; holes in basement concrete need sealing.

headline: Food debris on floors and walls; no washroom trash can
summary: Food debris and dust on floors and walls in the rear prep and dishwashing areas must be cleaned. Washroom has no covered trash receptacle and one must be provided.

headline: Food handler certificates needed; heavy sink leak
summary: Food handlers need updated certificates; manager lacks allergen certificate. Heavy leak at a dishwashing sink. Grease and debris on prep-area pipes and floors; soiled mops stored improperly; large office ceiling hole. Thermometers missing in a cold-holding unit.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; no handsink in prep area
summary: Walk-in cooler at 48.9F, above the 41F limit; must be serviced. No handwashing sink in the water and ice prep area. Doors need locks; rusted racks and other upkeep issues also noted.

headline: No certified food manager on site during food handling
summary: No certified food service manager on site while TCS foods (foods needing hot or cold holding) were handled and served. Also: food stored on walk-in floor, unlabeled containers, staff without hair restraints, dumpster lids open from overflowing trash.

headline: No handsoap; meat held at 75-85F discarded
summary: No handsoap at butcher prep hand sink; soap was provided during inspection (citation issued). About 100 lbs of sausage and pork skin held at 75-85F was discarded. Raw meat stored in grocery bags in the walk-in cooler.

headline: Worn cutting boards and missing restroom wall tiles
summary: Meat department cutting boards have deep grooves and stains; they must be sanded or replaced. Missing wall tiles in the customer restroom need replacing. A mop stored in its bucket must hang to dry.

headline: Brooms stored near clean utensils
summary: Brooms and dust pans were stored next to the clean utensil rack and must be kept away from it.

headline: Labeling, cutting boards, and plastic bags in freezers
summary: Dry food containers in storage must have common-name labels. Wiping cloths must be kept in sanitizer buckets between uses. Cutting boards with dark stains and deep cuts must be refinished or replaced. Plastic grocery bags cannot hold food in freezers or coolers.

headline: No health policy; glue boards full of insects
summary: No employee health policy on site; manager must obtain and keep one (citation issued). Glue boards are dusty and full of insects, including spiders and flies; they must be replaced. Non-sanitation staff need food handler certificates.

headline: Rotten drainboard; slow-draining hand sink
summary: Drainboard beside the main three-compartment sink is rotten and must be replaced. Kitchen hood and filters need cleaning. Slow-draining kitchen hand sink must be repaired. Food handlers without proof of training must complete an approved program.

headline: Salt shakers left on dining tables
summary: Only a cleaning issue: salt shakers stored on all customer dining tables must be detail cleaned and kept clean.

headline: Three-compartment sink missing drainboard and stoppers
summary: The three-compartment sink has no drainboard and no sink stoppers. Management was instructed to install a drainboard and provide stoppers.

headline: One of four toilets out of order
summary: One of four toilets was out of order; the manager was instructed to repair it.

headline: Exterior door gaps; debris near chemicals
summary: Exterior doors near the hallway and dishwashing area have quarter-inch gaps and must be made tight-fitting. Bolt at the three-compartment sink needs repair. Litter in outside garbage area near the grease container. Debris on floors in dry storage and chemical storage.

headline: Handwashing signs missing at two sinks
summary: No handwashing signs at the handwashing sink in the rear bar or at the rear unisex restroom sink. Staff were told to provide them.

headline: Slight leak at upstairs hand sink
summary: A slight leak at the hand sink in the upstairs all-gender restroom must be repaired by the manager.

headline: Leaky ice machine pipe; missing baseboard
summary: A leaky pipe on the ice machine must be repaired. The baseboard behind the three-compartment sink and ice machine is missing or poorly repaired.

headline: Door gap, smoky fryer area, storage and floor issues
summary: A quarter-inch gap at the front door must be sealed. Strong smoke from the table-top chicken fryer; ventilation must be installed above it. Single-service cups on the basement floor need shelving. Floors need cleaning; food handler and allergen certificates required.

headline: Hand sinks too cold; unsafe hot and cold foods
summary: Hand sinks ran at 73-75F, not the required 100F, and one had no running water. Hot foods (98-110F) and cold foods (55-59F) were discarded, about 30 and 90 lbs. A cold holding unit at 53F was tagged and held by the health department.

headline: Dirty ice machine exterior; grocery bags for dough
summary: Ice machine exterior needs cleaning. Grocery bags were used to store prepared masa dough; only food-grade bags are allowed. Burned-out lights above the main prep cooler need replacing.

headline: Personal items above slicer; foil liner; grease buildup
summary: Employee personal care items stored above the slicer in rear prep must be relocated. Aluminum foil lines the salamander oven and must be removed. Grill and oven have encrusted grease; floor under fryers soiled. Person in charge lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: No handwashing sink in food packaging area
summary: No handwashing sink in front of the prep area where open food is packaged and served. One must be installed with hot and cold water, soap, and paper towels. Certified manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: No metal stem thermometer on site
summary: No metal stem thermometer was on site to check internal temperatures of TCS foods. The person in charge ordered one delivered to the facility during the inspection.

headline: Hair restraint missing; plastic dispensers in bulk sauce
summary: A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Plastic containers used as dispensers inside bulk sauce must be replaced with long-handled utensils. Food spills and debris on equipment and floors. Lit cigarette and ashtrays found in rear prep and office; smoking prohibited.

headline: Food debris under beverage machine; no napkin receptacle
summary: Cabinets under the fountain beverage machine had accumulated food debris and must be cleaned. Gender-neutral washroom needs a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

headline: No certified manager on site during TCS prep
summary: No City certified food service manager on site while soups, tofu, salmon, and chicken were prepared and served. Citation issued; must operate with a certified manager at all times food is prepared and served.

headline: Utensils stored over sink; prior violations not corrected
summary: Clean utensils stored above the three-compartment sink wash basin must be moved. Cardboard liner under a cooler and duct-tape cooler repairs must be fixed. Moldy sink caulking must be replaced. Prior violations not corrected: unlabeled bulk food, paper towel waste bin missing.

headline: Inaccurate cooler display; damaged floor tiles
summary: Front display cooler temperature readout is inaccurate and must be repaired; cooler lacked an internal thermometer and was not holding 41F. Missing, damaged floor tiles throughout; dry storage wall bottoms cut out. Reach-in cooler interiors need detail cleaning.

headline: Managers need food allergen training
summary: City food service managers must obtain the required food allergen training.

headline: Loose wall coving; openings need sealing
summary: Wall coving behind one men's washroom toilet was loose and must be reattached. Openings in walls, floors, and walk-in units along the wall need sealing where needed.

headline: Missing service sink; allergen certificate needed
summary: No service sink for the premises; one must be provided with hot and cold running water under city pressure. Certified manager lacks allergen training verification on site.

headline: No certified sanitation person during TCS food prep
summary: No certified sanitation person on site while hot TCS foods (taquitos, pizza) were prepared and served. Sandwich grab-and-go cooler lacks a thermometer. Washroom lacks a covered trash can and has a ventilation fan that is not working.

headline: No health policy; no vomit cleanup procedure
summary: No employee health policy on site; verification must be kept on site for each employee. Management could not provide a procedure for cleaning up vomit and diarrhea; one must be kept with chemicals and supplies. No citation issued this visit.

headline: No certified manager; cold rice unsafe; sink drains slowly
summary: No certified food service manager on site while chicken and beef were handled. Cooked rice held at 54.3F in closed bags from the previous day; 25 lbs discarded ($40). Dish room hand sink drains slowly. Bulk salt container unlabeled.

headline: Brown residue inside ice machine
summary: A small amount of brown residue is inside the ice machine panel in the rear dishwashing area. Schedule a cleaning and maintain.

headline: Cold chicken too warm; expired tamales discarded
summary: Shredded chicken held at 46.5F in prep cooler; must be 41F or below. Employee discarded about 5 lbs. Expired cooked pork tamales, some with black and green spots, were discarded (about 10 lbs). Wet wiping cloth stored on a cutting board.

headline: Broken walk-in handle; water spraying above sink
summary: Walk-in cooler handle is broken, so the door does not fully close; must be repaired. Water spraying from a line above the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Loose wall panel behind the sink. Floors and floor drains need detail cleaning.

headline: Shrimp shells in plastic bags; grease on prep table
summary: Frozen shrimp shells stored in plastic grocery bags in the freezers; only food-grade bags or containers are allowed. Grease and food debris on the prep table under the flat-top grill must be cleaned.

headline: Unused cooling and frying equipment upstairs
summary: Cooling and frying equipment in upstairs prep areas that is unused or no longer working must be removed from the building.

headline: Hands rinsed in service sink; dead roaches found
summary: Hands rinsed in service sink (citation issued). Dead roaches on floor near bulk ingredients. Dish machine sanitizer at 0 ppm; do not use until fixed. Whole duck thawed in sink water. Three-compartment sink setup corrected on site.

headline: Mouse droppings; cold foods at 44F; walk-in not safe
summary: Mouse droppings: 20 in storage closet under pop boxes, 5 in dining area. Milk, beef, chicken, and cheese at 44F in prep cooler and walk-in cooler (41F or below required). Pest control service needed.

headline: Food spills, grime, and leaking cold water handle
summary: Food spills on prep tables, reach-in cooler interiors, cooking equipment, and floors need detail cleaning. Cold water handle on the three-compartment sink needs repair. Hood ventilation has grease and food buildup.

headline: Food on walk-in floor; soiled wiping cloths on prep tables
summary: Food on the walk-in cooler floor must be raised six inches. Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables must be kept in sanitizer. Single-service items on the floor need elevating and inverting. Missing handwashing sign at bar sink; pre-set tableware also noted.

headline: Exposed piping above prep area
summary: Ventilation system, hanging chains, piping, and utility lines are exposed above the front prep area. A ceiling that is smooth and easily cleanable must be installed.

headline: No certified manager; flies and unsafe hot holding
summary: Person in charge lacks a certified manager certificate, and no certified manager was on duty. About 25 live small flies in rear prep and dish areas. Hot-held chicken at 106.5-129.9F; about 115 lbs discarded. Cabinet adjusted to 137.5F on site.

headline: Food on walk-in floor; unfinished shelving
summary: Boxed food stored on the floor in the rear walk-in cooler must be raised six inches. Unfinished wood shelving in rear dry storage must be finished to be smooth and cleanable. Dirt buildup under and behind the three-compartment sink and cooking equipment.

headline: Live flies, rodent droppings, and roaches found again
summary: Over 50 live small flies, 50 rodent droppings, and 8 live roaches found in basement and prep areas. Previous pest violation not corrected; more pest control required. Tamarind sauce stored in soap buckets was discarded.

headline: Display cooler too warm; 182 lbs of meat discarded
summary: Chicken, pork, steak, and sausage in the display cooler held at 46.6-48.7F; manager discarded 182 lbs (about $450). Display refrigerator at 54F and two-door cooler at 85F; repair person fixed the issue on site. Rusted wall and ceiling in two-door cooler.

headline: Employee restroom sink too cold; milk crates
summary: Employee washroom hand sinks had hot water at only 65F; must be at least 100F (priority citation). Milk crates used as shelving in prep and storage areas must be replaced with shelving six inches off the floor.

headline: Splashguard needed; fryer grease
summary: A splashguard must be installed on the exposed hand sink next to the deep fryer to prevent contamination. Clean grease inside fryer doors and wire racks in the pizza prep cooler.

headline: Meats on walk-in floor; allergen training missing
summary: Meats stored on the walk-in freezer floor must be elevated six inches. Stained, open-seam cutting boards need refinishing or replacement. Cardboard floor mats in front prep must be replaced. Floors under cooking equipment need cleaning; allergen training certificate missing.

headline: Unlabeled containers and burnt-out ventilation light
summary: Food storage containers not in original packaging must be labeled. A burnt-out light over cooking equipment must be replaced; intensity lighting is required at all times.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; no covered receptacles
summary: Milk crates are used as shelving and must be replaced with proper shelving. Unisex washrooms lack covered receptacles, and the kitchen hand sink has no waste receptacle.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; food handler training missing
summary: Some employees have no food handler training; must provide it. Food stored on rear floor and in a cold unit improperly. Missing handwashing signs, display cooler thermometers, and sink stoppers. Crates used as shelving; employee restroom door not self-closing.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup plan; cold foods too warm
summary: No procedure or supplies for cleaning up vomit or diarrhea; must develop one and keep it on site. Cold-held al pastor, chorizo, and sliced tomatoes at 44.4-51.8F; about 15 lbs discarded. Aluminum foil liner and missing women's restroom receptacle also noted.

headline: Catering food shared cooler; ice machine slime
summary: Catering food shared a grab-and-go cooler with customer beverages; staff moved it to a separate cooler during inspection. Ice machine had black, pink, and white slime dripping onto ice used for drinks; ice must be removed and machine cleaned. A cutting board needs repair or replacement.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food service
summary: No certified food manager on the premises while chicken, hamburgers, and hot dogs were prepared and served. A food handler lacked a hair restraint and another had an expired food handler certificate. Damaged ceiling panels and cluttered rear storage room.

headline: Missing health policies and expired food handler training
summary: No signed employee health policies on site; must provide and keep them. Expired food handler training certificates found. Missing thermometer in basement dairy cooler; unlabeled bulk ingredients; items stored on basement floors.

headline: Wastewater backs up; no employee health policy
summary: Wastewater backs up into the kitchen three-compartment sink and drains slowly; repair required. No written, signed employee health policy on site; one must be provided for each employee. Certified manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Hand sinks unsoaped and blocked; pork too warm
summary: No hand soap at the toilet-room hand sink (priority). Main prep hand sink was blocked by containers and must stay accessible. About 20 lbs of cooked pork chops at 57.8F were discarded (about $100). Pork was cooled in covered, stacked containers.

headline: Hand sinks lacked paper towels and hot water
summary: Staff restroom had no paper towels; one was provided during inspection. Front prep hand sink water reached only 86F; must be at least 100F. Black slime dripping from the ice machine onto ice; must be cleaned. Leaking backflow device in rear dry storage.

headline: Missing labels, broken gasket, plastic bags in freezers
summary: Some employees lack food handler certificates. Plastic grocery bags and tin foil are not allowed as food containers or liners. Food containers need common-name labels. Broken cooler gasket and leaking dish machine backflow device need repair.

headline: Certified managers need allergen training
summary: No allergen training for any City-certified food manager. Managers must complete it and keep certificates on site.

headline: Cold beef and chicken too warm; cooler tagged
summary: Beef and chicken held at 47.7F; food must be discarded and cold foods kept at 41F or below. Prep cooler at 70F ambient; unit tagged and held by the health department, not to be used until fixed. Women's restroom faucet loose; certified manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: Hand sink too cool; door gap; milk crates
summary: Hand sink near the ice machine reached only 90.1F; it must provide at least 100F. Opening at base of front entrance door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Milk crates elevate food and equipment; replace with shelving. Leaking three-compartment faucet and other upkeep issues also noted.

headline: Milk crates in dish room; certificates needed
summary: Milk crates must not be used to elevate stored items in the dish room prep area. Proof of food handler training and allergen training for City food managers must be provided.

headline: Milk crates as shelving; no handwashing sign
summary: No handwashing sign at the prep-area hand sink. Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Loose debris and dust on floors and corners in the rear prep area must be cleaned more often.

headline: Unsafe food temperatures; dish machine too hot
summary: Buffet sausage (124.6F) and eggs (128.8F) were below safe hot-holding temperatures. Several cold-held foods were too warm, up to 65.4F. Manager discarded about 25 lbs of food. Dish machine rinse hit 198F; do not use until fixed. Hand sink leaks.

headline: Front door gap; bar counter needs cleaning
summary: A quarter-inch gap at the front entrance door sweep must be sealed to be rodent-proof. Food spills and debris on the bar counter and gun holders must be cleaned. Slight buildup in the upper ice machine must be cleaned.

headline: Rat and mouse droppings; raw pork too warm
summary: About 30 rat and mouse droppings throughout the basement storage area and over 150 small flies in prep, dining, and basement. Raw pork (58.2F) and tofu (75.2F) too warm; about 28 lbs discarded. Sewage backed up through a basement drain.

headline: Soiled cold holding units in kitchen
summary: Interior cold holding units in the kitchen were soiled with food debris. The facility must clean and maintain them.

headline: Ice stored near raw meat; hair restraints missing
summary: Bags of ice were stored too close to raw meat in the walk-in freezer; staff were told to move them. Deli and fresh meat food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Lower shelves of meat display coolers had food debris.

headline: No certified manager; hand sink unusable; food on floor
summary: No certified manager on site while cooked meats and soup were prepared. Warewashing-area hand sink lacked cold water and was blocked; staff cleared it and added paper towels during inspection. Food stored on the walk-in cooler floor.

headline: Sticky debris at beverage station and floors
summary: Beverage station in the dining area had sticky, dried food debris and splatter inside and out. Food debris also found on floors in the rear prep and dining areas. Staff were told to clean.

headline: Missing handwashing sign at sink
summary: No handwashing sign at a handwashing sink. The manager must provide signs at all sinks used by employees.

headline: Leaking faucet at sushi prep sink
summary: The handwashing sink in the sushi prep area has a leaking faucet that must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Cracked ice scoop; slow-draining hand sink
summary: Blue plastic ice scoop cracked at the handle must be replaced. Front prep hand sink drains slowly and must drain more quickly.

headline: Some food employees lack food handler certificates
summary: Some food employees had no food handler certificate and must provide proof.

headline: Dusty cooler pipes; leaky three-compartment sink drain
summary: Heavy dust buildup on walk-in cooler cooling pipes must be cleaned. Three-compartment sink not maintained; leaky drain pipe at middle compartment must be repaired.

headline: Insect control device above clean utensils; milk crates
summary: Insect control device over clean utensils in the warewashing area must be moved to avoid contamination. Milk crates storing food containers must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor. Dry storage cabinet interior soiled with coffee grounds.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: A food service sanitation manager has no food allergen training certificate and must meet this requirement.

headline: No hair restraints; ice scoop stored inside ice
summary: Employees preparing food had no hair restraints or protection; they must wear them. Ice scoop stored inside the ice container; a scoop holder is needed. Dirty fans inside the two-door refrigeration unit by the oven must be cleaned.

headline: Ice machine buildup and torn freezer door gaskets
summary: Slight buildup inside the ice machines must be cleaned. Ripped rubber gaskets on some prep cooler doors must be repaired or replaced. Ice buildup on the walk-in freezer floor must be removed.

headline: Dirty equipment, broken floor tiles, missing light shields
summary: Several food handlers lack food handler certificates. Prep tables, fryers, stove, and dish machine need cleaning. Broken floor tiles under cooking equipment and missing light shields need replacing. Walls and ceiling tiles need cleaning.

headline: Live roaches, rat droppings, and dead rodent found
summary: Nine live roaches found in steam table, on hot water tanks, and in basement ceiling. Five rat droppings and a dead rodent behind a basement hot water tank. Pest control service required on or after 9/25/24.

headline: Heavy grease, open bait, and missing thermometer
summary: Excess grease on fryers, floors, and walls. Open bait blocks found in prep area; manager removed and discarded them. No working stem thermometer or sanitizer test strips on site. No food handler or allergen certificates on site.

headline: Cold chicken and shrimp too warm; 62 lbs discarded
summary: Chicken at 47.5F and shrimp at 48.2F in the front prep cold unit; manager discarded 62 lbs (about $160). Cold TCS food must be 41F or below; citation issued. Loose dirt and dust on floors and corners in the rear storage area must be cleaned more often.

headline: Roaches found; raw salmon over asparagus; cooler at 50F
summary: About 5 live roaches in rear prep and 2 in basement, plus about 80 dead roaches. Raw salmon stored over asparagus. Rice, tofu, and seaweed salad held at 49-82F; about 100 lbs discarded. Reach-in cooler at 50F tagged by health department.

headline: No certified manager; wastewater leaking; expired food
summary: No certified food manager present while beans (141F, a TCS food) were prepared and served. Expired salsa and pork kept past the 7-day limit in the walk-in cooler. Wastewater leaking from a broken drain under the sink. Several food handlers lack certificates.

headline: Leaking sink faucet; dumpster missing lid
summary: Leak at the base of the three-compartment sink faucet must be repaired. Outside dumpster missing its lid must be fixed to prevent pest harborage (citation issued). Washroom door needs a self-closing device. Dishwashing light not working; floors behind cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Leaking drainpipe; manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: Leaky drainpipe under the three-compartment sink in the rear prep area must be repaired. A certified food manager lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: No certified manager on duty while TCS foods served
summary: No certified manager on duty while TCS foods were served (citation issued). Floors in rear storage and washroom need cleaning; an unused hand sink and toilet in the working washroom should be removed; food handlers need training.

headline: No food handler certificates; mop sink not connected
summary: No food handler certificates were on site for employees. Mop sink is not connected to city plumbing. Wiping cloths need sanitizing buckets. Also noted: cluttered counters, dirty coolers, slow handsink drain, and dirty floors and restroom.

headline: Live flying insects; undated food; allergen training
summary: About 40 live small flying insects on walls, ceilings, and equipment in the rear kitchen prep and dish areas; more pest control needed; citation issued. Ready-to-eat TCS foods in the walk-in cooler were not date marked. Two certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Dried food debris on prep floor
summary: Dried food debris was on the prep area floor under a table and along a cooling unit. Floor must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Missing handwashing sign at rear prep sink
summary: The handwashing sink in the rear food prep area, next to cooking equipment, has no handwashing sign. Manager was instructed to provide one.

headline: Repeat violation: no food handler training; openings
summary: No food handler training for employees was a core violation not corrected from earlier inspections; citation issued. Openings along ceilings and baseboards in prep and storage areas must be sealed.

headline: Slimy ice machine; do not use until cleaned
summary: Pinkish, slimy substance inside the ice machine was dripping onto ice; manager told not to use the machine until it is detail cleaned and sanitized; citation issued. Dusty and dirty display cooler vents need cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled bulk items; restroom fan not working
summary: Bulk items in non-original containers were not labeled; person in charge must add common names. Large pots in the rear prep area were not inverted. Restroom mechanical ventilation was not working and must be repaired.

headline: No health policy; no vomit cleanup kit; allergen training
summary: No signed employee health policies were on site; priority violation, no citation issued. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies were available; instructed to provide. A ceiling drop in the front prep area is missing. Certified managers must obtain allergen training.

headline: No food handler certificates on site
summary: No food handling certificates were present for food handling employees. Management must provide proof of food handler training.

headline: Dumpster lids open; dirty interiors and equipment
summary: Outside dumpster lids were not closed because trash was overflowing; citation issued. Plates, pans, and bowls in the prep area were not inverted. Interiors of cold-hold units, freezers, ovens, and fryers need detail cleaning.

headline: Clogged drain; leaking faucets; dirty kitchen areas
summary: A floor drain behind the main bar is clogged and must be unclogged. Exposed handsink faucet in the dish area leaks, and the three-compartment sink sprayer has plastic wrap around its neck. Fans, fryers, ice machine, and kitchen vents need cleaning.

headline: No health policy or vomit cleanup procedure; equipment repairs
summary: No signed employee health policy and no vomiting and diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies were found. Also needed: worn door gaskets on three-door coolers replaced and debris cleared from the mop sink basin.

headline: Drink nozzles and equipment need cleaning
summary: Drink nozzles need detail cleaning to remove buildup. Sides of cooking equipment need cleaning. Restrooms need detail cleaning, and unnecessary clutter in the rear area must be removed.

headline: Unapproved yogurt making; no health policy
summary: Yogurt was fermented on site without an approved HACCP plan; about 5 gallons (about $30) discarded; citation issued. No written employee health policy, no handwashing signs at kitchen and bar sinks, and no food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Rust spots on walk-in cooler wall
summary: Rust spots were observed on the wall of the walk-in cooler. Instructed to remove rust and repaint.

headline: Dirty ice machine; wiping cloths; food containers
summary: Inside of the ice machine and bin were not clean; ice is used for drinks and must be cleaned and sanitized. Wiping cloths must be kept in sanitizer buckets. Plastic bags and cardboard are not allowed as freezer food containers, and milk crates cannot be used for elevation.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; dirty cutting boards
summary: Milk crates used as shelving in prep and storage must be replaced with shelving six inches off the floor. Cutting boards with open seams and stains need refinishing or replacing. Microwave is dirty inside and out; water drains slowly from the three-compartment sink.

headline: No certified manager on duty; hygiene lapse; gaps
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were served; manager arrived at 2:55 p.m.; citation issued. A food handler touched a cell phone and handled raw hamburgers without washing hands; citation issued. Gaps at two doors must be sealed.

headline: Torn gaskets in fruit cooler
summary: Torn gaskets at the bottom of the fruit reach-in cooler in the ice cream station must be repaired.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen training certificates
summary: Food handler training certificates were missing for employees; they must be provided for all current staff. No allergen training certificates were on site for certified food managers.

headline: Cooler and floor cleaning needed; some handlers untrained
summary: Small cooler in the front service area must be cleaned of spills. Prep area floors along walls and in corners, plus the walk-in cooler floor, need cleaning. A few food handlers lacked required food handler training.

headline: Black mold caulking at sink; ice chute buildup
summary: Excessive black mold-like substance on caulking at the three-compartment sink and warewashing unit must be replaced. Slight accumulation inside the ice machine chute must be cleaned.

headline: Sushi handsinks lack water; milk crates; cutting boards
summary: Handwashing sinks in the sushi prep area had no hot or cold water; priority violation, citation issued. Milk crates used for elevation must be replaced with shelving. Cutting boards with open seams and dark stains must be refinished or replaced.

headline: Minor grease spills inside fryers
summary: Minor grease spills were found inside the fryers at the 312 station. Must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Leaking sink piping; broken tiles; poor lighting
summary: Three-compartment sink piping leaks onto the rear prep floor. Broken floor tiles where pots are hung to dry need replacing and pooled water removed. Walk-in cooler lighting is inadequate; bulb needs a shield.

headline: Water-stained ceiling tiles in dining room
summary: Water-stained ceiling tiles in the customer dining room must be replaced and maintained.

headline: Door opening, spills, damaged tiles, nonworking equipment
summary: Opening at the base of exit doors must be sealed. Coffee machine backflow device could not be verified. Spills and debris in the bar area need cleaning, damaged basement floor tiles need repair, and three nonworking cold holding units must be removed.

headline: Broken toilet; handsink lacks hot water
summary: Right toilet in the left restroom is out of order and leaks when flushed; manager told to repair. One of two handsinks in that restroom has no hot water, and the other reaches only 80F; minimum is 100F. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Eggs and meats too warm; 9 lbs discarded
summary: Eggs, sliced meats, and vegetables held at 51.3F to 52.5F in the front prep cooler; manager discarded 9 lbs (about $150). Cold unit tagged for repair. Bar handsink had no paper towels, obtained during inspection; citation issued.

headline: Sauces stored on floor; leaking sink basin
summary: Boxes of sauces were stored on the floor in the dry storage closet and must be elevated six inches. Scoops with handles in contact with food must be stored out of contact between uses. Middle basin drain of the three-compartment sink leaks heavily.

headline: Moldy ice machine; sink backup; rust on wall
summary: Mold-like buildup inside the ice machine, which is not used for consumption; person in charge told to clean. Wastewater backs up into the third sink basin, and a grease trap leaks; citation issued. Rust and mold-like substance on the wall over the sink.

headline: Gap under front door; crates and clutter
summary: About 1/4 inch gap under the front entrance door must be refitted or replaced to prevent pests. Soda crates used for storage must be replaced with shelving at least six inches off the floor. Heavy clutter and soda splatter need cleaning.

headline: Handsink blocked by ice buckets; ice machine issues
summary: Bar handsink was blocked by ice buckets, removed immediately; citation issued. About 10 lbs of shellfish lacked tags and was discarded; citation issued. Walk-in freezer has heavy ice buildup, food stored on the floor, and heavy grease in the hood.

headline: No proof of food handler or allergen training
summary: No proof of food handler training was shown; employees must show proof within 30 days of hire. No allergen training proof for the certified food manager. Refrigerator door behind the bar has exposed insulation and must be restored.

headline: Sausages too cool under heat lamp; milk too warm
summary: Sausages held at 125F under a heat lamp; must stay above 135F; citation issued. Milk at 44F, cheese at 45F, and whipping cream at 46F in the basement cooler; must stay at 41F or below. A missing food handler certificate was a repeat violation; citation issued.

headline: Beer cans placed inside ice maker
summary: Five cans of beer were found inside the ice maker, contaminating ice used for customer drinks. The ice was removed and no objects may be placed in the ice maker; priority violation. Bulk sugar container is unlabeled.

headline: Cooked rice and beef held without discard dates
summary: Cooked rice and cooked beef were held over 24 hours without discard dates; citation issued. Fish batter, rice, and seasonings were in unlabeled containers. Food stored on the walk-in cooler floor. No sanitizer testing devices on site; citation issued.

headline: Ice buildup in freezer; slow sink; dusty vents
summary: Excessive ice buildup inside the ice cream freezer must be removed and the freezer cleaned. Coffee prep handwashing sink drains slowly and needs repair. Dust on ceiling vents and inside light shields needs cleaning.

headline: Live flies in deli; gaps; crates; leaks
summary: About 40 or more live small flies on walls and in the air in the deli prep and dish areas; pest control recommended; citation issued. Also a gap in the front door, slow drains, leaky sink connections, crates used for food storage, and burnt-out hood lights.

headline: About 100 mouse droppings; live roaches; blocked sinks
summary: About 100 mouse droppings were found on kitchen, storage, dining, and washroom floors, plus four live roaches in the kitchen. Pest control must service before reinspection; citation issued. Both prep handsinks were blocked and corrected on site.

headline: Ice scoop in ice bin; slow hot water; expired allergen certificate
summary: Ice scoop was stored in the ice bin and must be stored with handle up or kept in a clean container. Toilet room hot and cold water does not stay on long enough for handwashing. Certified food manager's allergen certificate is expired.

headline: Frozen chicken thawed in standing water; handlers uncertified
summary: Large bags of frozen chicken were thawing in a water-filled compartment. Inspector instructed thawing by microwave, refrigeration, or running water at 70F. Also noted: handlers without proof of training, dirty fryers, and a hole in a restroom wall.

headline: Dead roaches on stairs, floors, and wall
summary: Dead roaches were found on stairs near dry storage, the floor by stored alcohol, and a wall by a handsink. Also noted: no handwashing sign in employee restroom; grime on microwave, cooking equipment, and shelving; greasy floors and walk-in freezer debris.

headline: Person in charge lacks manager certificate; leaks
summary: Person in charge has no city food service manager certificate; citation issued. Three-compartment sink faucet and bottom compartment leak and must be repaired. Missing wall tile near the meat cutting room and sink, and a water-stained ceiling tile.

headline: Floors need cleaning of spills and debris
summary: Floors throughout the facility need cleaning to remove spills and debris.

headline: Blank health policies; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Blank employee health policy copies on site; priority violation. Low-temperature dish machine had chlorine at 0 ppm and was serviced by Ecolab during inspection. Digital menu was updated on site after a raw food reminder was missing. Bulk items are unlabeled.

headline: Dirty drains and debris under equipment
summary: Front and rear drains have dirt and grime buildup. Food debris between ice cream station units must be cleaned to prevent possible pests. Floors under and around equipment in prep, dish, and nonfood areas also need cleaning.

headline: Soiled mop head; missing food handler and allergen certificates
summary: A soiled mop head was not stored properly; manager told to hang mop heads to prevent insect breeding. Food handler certificates could not be verified on site. Sanitation manager lacked an allergen training certificate.

headline: No certified manager; food held too warm; cooler tagged
summary: No person in charge with certified manager training was on site; priority violation. Ham, salmon, noodles, and rice were out of temperature and discarded. Front line cooler at 46.5F was tagged and cannot be used. Handsink lacked cleanser and paper towels, added during inspection.

headline: Cleaning needed; some handlers lack certificates
summary: Several items need cleaning, including exteriors of freezers and stove, door handles, prep coolers, and convection oven top. Hood and filters need dust and grease removed. Several food handlers lacked food handler certificates.

headline: Handsink water too hot; missing handwashing signs
summary: A handsink reached 143.1F, above the required 100F to 120F range; citation issued. Men's and women's restrooms lack handwashing signs. Other issues: no hot water at a compartment sink and a men's sink, a front door gap, and damaged floors and walls.

headline: Freezer not working; gaps; no allergen training
summary: Freezer on premises is not working; owner ordered a new reach-in freezer. Gaps at the rear and front doors must be sealed to prevent pests. Certified manager lacks allergen training documentation. Also noted: grease on floors and dirty hood filters.

headline: Utility sink lacks backflow device
summary: Utility sink in the rear has no backflow preventer. Device must be installed so it can be located, serviced, and maintained.

headline: Undated shellstock tags; menu fixed on site
summary: Shellstock tags from early 2024 lacked dates for when the last shellfish was sold or served; citation issued. Missing menu asterisk for raw foods was corrected on site. Missing splash guards at the cookline handsink and low cold-water pressure at a handsink.

headline: Rusted walk-in cooler racks
summary: Walk-in cooler racks show rust buildup. Manager was instructed to repaint or replace the racks.

headline: No vomit kit or procedure; debris outside; ceiling hole
summary: No procedure or kit on site for vomit and diarrhea events; a norovirus-effective sanitizer must be kept on site. Pop cases stored on the shed floor, debris around the dumpster, and a ceiling hole with exposed insulation in the rear storage shed.

headline: Unlabeled containers; food stored on floor; grease buildup
summary: Food stored on the prep area floor must be raised six inches. Bulk items in unlabeled containers need labels, and cardboard floor liners must be removed. Grease and debris on cooking equipment and coolers need cleaning. Restroom trash cans need lids.

headline: No certified manager on site; no sanitizer test kit
summary: No certified food manager was on site with the original certificate posted while open; citation issued. Two employees had no hair restraints in prep. No sanitizer test strip kit was available to check the three-compartment sink; citation issued.

headline: Eggs held above safe temperature; unit tagged
summary: Eggs in front prep held at 52.0F to 57.8F; manager voluntarily discarded 1.5 lbs. A cold holding unit at 52.0F was tagged and cannot be used until reinspected. Bar sink had no paper towels, obtained during inspection; citation issued.

headline: Greasy fryer bottoms; dusty ceiling and vents
summary: Bottom areas of the fryers in the French fry area need cleaning of grease and debris. Dust on ceiling, ceiling vents, and the wall behind the ice machine needs cleaning. Floors under some kitchen equipment also need cleaning.

headline: No hot water at two sinks; dead roaches found
summary: Two handwashing sinks could not reach 100F hot water; citation issued. About 5 dead cockroaches were found under cooler and bar equipment. No pest control log or service receipts were on site; citation issued. Cooler gaskets are damaged.

headline: Black mold in ice machine dripping onto ice
summary: Black mold-like buildup inside the ice machine was dripping onto ice used for human consumption. Person in charge was told to discard the ice and clean and sanitize the machine; citation issued. Also unlabeled bulk containers and a torn cooler gasket.

headline: No dish-room handsink; no hot water; slime in ice
summary: No handwashing sink in the dish room; citation issued. Bar restrooms had no hot water. Kitchen ice machine had thick black slime dripping onto ice; citation issued. Wiping cloths were left on counters, and the bar handsink lacks signage.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink; allergen certificate missing
summary: Leaks at the three-compartment sink faucet and underneath it; a pipe is covered in tape and must be properly repaired. A city food service manager had no allergen training certificate on site, a repeat violation; citation issued.
