headline: Pizza plates and boxes stored on floor
summary: Single-service cardboard pizza plates and boxes were stored directly on the front kitchen floor. Must be stored at least six inches above the floor.

headline: No certified manager; sink backups; no test kit
summary: No person in charge with foodservice manager training and no valid certificate on site; citation issued. Three-compartment sink backs up; no sanitizer test device on site; citation issued. Restroom handsink water pressure is too high to use; holes in wall between prep areas.

headline: No certified manager; pesticide; flying insects; roaches
summary: No certified food manager was on site while eggs and sausage were present; citation issued. Store-bought pesticide of unknown source found. About 5 to 10 flying insects on walls and serving area, plus five dead cockroaches under the sink. Pest control increase recommended.

headline: Wiping cloths on prep tables; rust, torn gasket, leaks
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables and must go in sanitizing solution. Rusty prep table bottoms need repainting or replacing. A torn gasket, a leaking faucet base at the dish sink, and a large wall opening by the ice machine need repair.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; wall holes; missing baseboard
summary: Torn rubber gasket on a two-door front prep cooler must be replaced. Holes in the wall above the walk-in cooler entrance must be sealed. Missing baseboard coving at the front prep entrance and rear mop sink must be replaced. Soda cabinet interiors need cleaning.

headline: Basement handsink inaccessible; handler certificates missing
summary: Exposed handwashing sink in the basement food prep area was not accessible for use; manager instructed to repair it; citation issued. Several food handlers lacked food handler certificates, a repeat violation; citation issued.

headline: No soap at restrooms; unlabeled bulk food
summary: No hand soap was in the restrooms; citation issued, and soap was provided by the end of inspection. Handsinks in prep areas lack handwashing signs. Bulk flour and sugar are unlabeled. Storage cooler interior and main kitchen floors need cleaning.

headline: Peeling paint on kitchen and restroom doors
summary: Doors leading to the kitchen and bathrooms have peeling paint. Surfaces must be restored to a smooth, easily cleanable finish and maintained.

headline: Three-compartment sink backs up; residue buildup
summary: Three-compartment sink backs up into the first compartment when the middle basin drains; citation issued. Residue and splatters on the sink sides need cleaning.

headline: Loose sink, unlabeled bulk, grease and debris
summary: Handwashing sink near cooking equipment is loose and must be repaired. Bulk and squeeze bottle containers need common-name labels. Debris must be cleaned from an unused cooler and oven and from floors, walls, ceilings, and hood filters.

headline: Soiled floor and base coving under sink
summary: Floor and base coving beneath the three-compartment sink are soiled with dried food debris. Floors and physical facilities must be cleaned at adequate frequency.

headline: Damaged walk-in freezer flooring
summary: Damaged flooring with an open hole and seam along the baseboard in the walk-in freezer must be repaired.

headline: Rusted shelf, torn gaskets, leaking spray sink
summary: Rusted shelf in the three-door cooler needs repair or replacement. Torn protective plastic on a rear prep shelf must be removed. A torn gasket on the three-door cooler needs replacing, and the spray sink by the dish machine leaks at the nozzle base.

headline: Handwashing supplies at non-handsinks; missing thermometers
summary: Handwashing soap, towels, and signs were posted at sinks not meant for handwashing; must be removed. Prep coolers lack internal thermometers. Foil lines grill surfaces; a handsink faucet leaks; a large hole is in the ceiling above basement dry storage.

headline: Workers without hair restraints; grease buildup
summary: Multiple food handling employees were not wearing hair restraints. Accumulated grease and food debris on equipment, coolers, and shelving must be cleaned. Floors, walls, and corners in several areas need cleaning.

headline: No employee health policy; hoods not working
summary: No written employee health policy on premises; priority violation. Foam was used to repair a cold holding unit door. An unused three-door cooler must be removed from the retail area. Ceiling tiles are broken or water-stained, and exhaust hoods over the fryers and grill are not working.

headline: Drains need detail cleaning
summary: Drains in the rear food service area, basement dishwashing area, and upstairs bar need detail cleaning to help prevent possible insect activity.

headline: Food prepared without certified manager; missing records
summary: Food handlers prepared time and temperature control (TCS) foods without a certified sanitation manager on duty; citation issued. Blank employee health policy copies, no vomit and diarrhea spill kit, a handler without gloves, and no food handler training proof.

headline: Serving plates not inverted; loose cooler lid knobs
summary: Serving plates on kitchen prep shelves were not inverted and must be inverted to prevent dust. Loose and missing knobs on prep cooler lids must be repaired. Floor along walls and under equipment at the kitchen and bar needs cleaning.

headline: No food handler training; blank health policies
summary: Blank employee health policy copies on site; 90-day grace period given before citations. No food handler training was present; must train within 30 days of hire. Certified food manager lacks proof of allergen training.

headline: Mouse droppings, live ants, and moldy ice machine
summary: About 80 to 100 mouse droppings were found throughout the facility, plus 15 to 25 live ants; citation issued. Food stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler. Black mold-like substance inside the ice machine; citation issued. Clam bowl lacked a shellstock tag.

headline: Door sweep needed; food on floor; missing filter
summary: Rear exit door has a gap over 1/4 inch and needs a door sweep. Food boxes on the walk-in cooler and freezer floors must be raised six inches. Ice and coffee machines lack backflow devices. Missing exhaust filter and one of two bulbs out. No food handler or manager allergen certificates.

headline: Raw wood shelving; basement clutter; peeling paint
summary: Raw wood shelving in the rear dishwashing area must be sealed or repainted. Basement clutter must be removed to prevent rodent harborage. Cracked light shield above prep cooler and peeling paint on basement wall need repair. One certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Frozen meat in grocery bags; burnt-out cooler lights
summary: Frozen meats were stored in plastic grocery bags in the walk-in freezer; only food-grade bags or containers may be used. Burnt-out bulbs inside the walk-in cooler must be replaced.

headline: Leaking handsink faucet; burnt-out hood bulb
summary: Handsink near the front hot line and registers has a slight faucet leak; repair or replace. One burnt-out bulb in the cook line hood must be replaced.

headline: Loose basement rail; floors need detail cleaning
summary: The rail on the left wall going into the basement is very loose and hanging from the wall; instructed to repair. Floor in the front food service area needs detail cleaning under equipment along the walls.

headline: Greasy fryer wheels; dirty walls and wall bases
summary: Wheels of fryers have excessive grease buildup and must be cleaned. Lower walls and wall bases throughout have food debris and dirt buildup and must be cleaned.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure; no covered receptacle
summary: No written procedure or supplies for vomit and diarrhea events were on site; instructed to provide. No covered receptacle inside the employee toilet room. No allergen training certificate was on site for city food service sanitation managers.

headline: No certified manager while food served; unlocked coolers
summary: No certified food manager on site when TCS foods were prepared and served; manager arrived about 45 minutes after inspection began; citation issued. Service line handsink had no paper towels; citation issued. Coolers in a shared storage area were unlocked and must be locked.

headline: Restroom lacks covered receptacle; items stored on floor
summary: Dining room restroom had no covered receptacle; person in charge told to provide one. Items stored on the floor in basement dry storage and the walk-in cooler must be kept at least six inches off the floor.

headline: Splash guard needed; restroom lacks lidded receptacle
summary: Handwashing sink beside the three-compartment sink needs a smooth, cleanable splash guard to protect clean dishware. Women's restroom near prep and dining has no lidded receptacle for feminine products; manager instructed to provide one.

headline: Over 80 mouse droppings found throughout facility
summary: Over 80 mouse droppings were found inside fryer cabinets, on prep shelves, dish machine bottoms, soda dispensers, and floors in storage, electrical, furnace, and utility rooms. Manager told to call an exterminator and clean; citation issued. Grease buildup and debris also noted.

headline: No valid food handler training; food on floor
summary: Drawer cooler lacks an operable thermometer. Food in the walk-in freezer is on the floor and must be elevated six inches. A 1/4 inch gap at the rear exit door needs sealing. Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables; employees lack valid food handler training.

headline: Women's restroom handsink needs repair
summary: Handsink in the women's restroom on the left side must be repaired.

headline: Dust on vents; hood grease; fryer debris
summary: Frozen lemonade machine exterior needs cleaning. Food debris on shelves in the four-door cooler needs cleaning. Dust on vents in restrooms and grease buildup on kitchen hoods and under fryers also need cleaning.

headline: About 20 rat droppings found; milk crates used
summary: About 20 rat droppings were scattered on the floor under a storage rack in the rear lower level. Instructed to remove them, detail clean the area, and call pest control. Milk crates were also used to elevate stock.

headline: Passed re-inspection; non-food-grade containers, grease buildup
summary: Passed re-inspection. Chicken, shrimp, tofu, and vegetables stored in non-food-grade containers; must be food-grade and labeled. Basement walk-in has debris and rust. Leaking compressor drips into a pan. Grease buildup on cooking equipment, floors, and hood.

headline: Passed; gasket, rust, and washroom receptacle repairs
summary: Passed. Damaged gasket on a one-door reach-in cooler must be replaced. Rusty bottoms of prep tables must be repaired. No covered receptacle in the unisex washroom. Missing light shield in the prep area.

headline: Passed; leak under three-compartment sink
summary: Passed. A leak under the rinse basin of the three-compartment sink was found. The business was instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: Passed; expired allergen training for both managers
summary: Passed. Both certified food managers had expired allergen training. No thermometer was available to check the walk-in cooler's air temperature. A soiled mop was stored next to the utility sink.

headline: Failed: about 65 live flies, warm food discarded
summary: Failed. About 65 live black flies in sushi, prep, bakery, and dining areas; pest service required; citation issued. Hot-held hot dogs and sandwiches at 72-80F discarded. About 60 lbs of food lacked date labels. Clams and oysters lacked shellstock tags.

headline: Failed: no certificate posted, handsink blocked
summary: Failed. No valid City food sanitation certificate posted for employees; citation issued. Rear prep handsink blocked by equipment and tanks; citation issued. No metal stem thermometer, no chlorine test kit, and no food handler training records. Clutter and food debris throughout.

headline: Passed; sink seal and freezer ice repair
summary: Passed. The first compartment of the deli three-compartment sink is in poor repair; the seal must be repaired. Ice buildup in the ice cream display freezer must be defrosted and cleaned. Floors behind cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Passed re-inspection; unlabeled dry ingredient containers
summary: Passed re-inspection. Dry ingredient storage containers in the rear sandwich prep area were not labeled. Inspector instructed the business to label all food items with common names.

headline: Conditions: no food handler training or health policies
summary: Passed with conditions. No signed employee health policies; citation issued. No food handler training for employees. A gap under the rear door; food must be elevated off the floor. Stained ceiling tiles, loose wall bases, and missing thermometer for dessert cooler.

headline: Failed: no basement handsink, sushi prep unprotected
summary: Failed. No handwashing sink in the basement prep area with the ice machine and prep table; must be installed with hot and cold water, soap, and towels. Maki and sushi prep not protected from customers. Garbage receptacle in basement restroom uncovered.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, no food handler proof
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on site while eggs were prepared and served; manager arrived 30 minutes after inspection began; citation issued. No food handler training proof, no manager allergen training, and no refrigerator thermometers. Unlabeled flour and rice; rusted racks.

headline: Conditions: missing allergen training and food handler certificate
summary: Passed with conditions. Unnecessary items in the rear hot water closet must be removed; other items elevated at least 6 inches. One employee lacked a food handler certificate. Certified managers lack allergen training certificates; citation issued.

headline: Passed re-inspection; missing signs and allergen training
summary: Passed re-inspection. No handwashing signs at prep area sinks. No written procedure for cleaning ice cream and slushy machines. Greasy outside of a machine. A certified manager lacks the required allergen training certificate.

headline: Conditions: no food handler or allergen proof
summary: Passed with conditions. Heavy grease inside cooking fryers must be cleaned. Dirty, wet floors in the rear dishwashing area. Dusty hood filters. No allergen training certificates; no proof of food handler training; citation issued.

headline: Failed: handwash water too cool, dish rinse too low
summary: Failed. Handwashing sinks in cold prep and grill areas ran at 89.2F and 43.9F, below 100F. Small dish machine rinse measured 120F, below the required 165F; citation issued. Soap was supplied on site. Openings at doors and garage doors need sealing.

headline: Failed: no certificate posted, sink lacked soap
summary: Failed. No original City food sanitation certificate posted on site, and no employee health policy; citations issued. Dishwashing-area hand sink lacked soap and paper towels, supplied during inspection. Grab-and-go packaged foods not labeled; prior violation uncorrected.

headline: Failed: leaks, clutter, grease, prior violations uncorrected
summary: Failed. Grease buildup in deep frying area; leaky piping at a dishwashing sink and corn container valve; clutter in food storage. Missing and damaged floor tiles; food debris and spills; no allergen training for a certified manager; citation issued.

headline: Failed: no handwash sink, rice too cool, no summary posted
summary: Failed. Cooked rice on the steam table measured 86F; nine lbs discarded; citation issued. No handwashing sink in the rear dishwashing area, and no employee health policy, vomit/diarrhea kit, or original manager certificate. Inspection summary not posted.

headline: Passed; leaking drain and ice bin cleaning
summary: Passed. Interior of the ice bin needs cleaning; ice must be removed. The middle basin of the dish-area three-compartment sink leaks from its drain pipe. Debris built up under and along walls in front and rear prep, dry storage, and bar.

headline: Failed: no handwash sink in rear prep area
summary: Failed. No handwashing sink in the rear prep and dishwashing area; citation issued. No soap or paper towels at the front prep area handsink; the employee supplied them during inspection. Citation issued for the missing supplies.

headline: Passed; no splash guard, improper utensil storage
summary: Passed. No splash guard between the three-compartment sink, handwash sink, and utility sink in the rear prep area. Utensil handles stored on top of open condiments. Plastic stoppers used in the three-compartment sink.

headline: Passed; food stored on floor, basement clutter
summary: Passed. Items stored on the floor in the rear food storage area must be elevated. Water filtration attached to the handsink must be removed. Basement clutter must be removed to prevent pest entry. Peeling paint and dirty floors.

headline: Passed; no allergen training for managers
summary: Passed. No food allergen training for food managers; must be provided and maintained. A gap under the last overhead garage door must be made tight-fitting. Food debris on the walk-in freezer floor and north bar floor drain.

headline: Passed re-inspection; boxed food on walk-in floor
summary: Passed re-inspection. Boxed food items stored on the walk-in cooler floor in the rear prep area; must be elevated 6 inches. Multiple cutting boards have deep scratches and must be resurfaced or replaced.

headline: Conditions: food discarded, display cooler tagged
summary: Passed with conditions. Cooked eggs cooled too slowly, at 77.9F. Grab-and-go display cooler at 50.3F; mushroom and noodles at 53F and packaged soups at 48.7F discarded. Cooler tagged until repaired. A 1-inch gap at the rear door must be sealed.

headline: Conditions: no valid certified manager during TCS handling
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food service manager with a valid certificate on site while deli meats and chicken were handled and served; citation issued. Missing light shield on the deli display case light.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing signs, food in plastic bags
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs were missing near the main prep sink. Frozen meats were stored in plastic grocery bags; management must use food-grade bags. Items stored under shelving; cardboard liner; broken light shield; dusty vents and dirty wall noted.

headline: Passed; unlabeled containers, missing splash guard
summary: Passed. Food storage containers lacked labels with the common food name. No washable splash guard between the handsink and dried utensils. Plates not inverted. Mops stored improperly. One burned-out light above the fryer and grill.

headline: Passed re-inspection; certificates needed for staff
summary: Passed re-inspection. All food handlers need food handler certificates, and the food service manager needs an allergen certificate. The business was instructed to obtain and maintain them.

headline: Passed; beard restraints missing, milk crates used as shelving
summary: Passed. Food handlers were not wearing beard restraints; instructed to wear them whenever preparing food. Milk crates are being used as shelving and must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Passed; gap at front door and debris under grill
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the front exit door must be sealed. Loose debris, dirt, and dust under the kitchen grill must be detail cleaned and maintained.

headline: Passed; missing handwash signs and hair restraints
summary: Passed. Handwashing sink in the front prep area lacked signage. Food employees cooking and preparing open food lacked adequate hair restraints; they must be provided and worn.

headline: Conditions: raw seafood too warm; coolers tagged
summary: Passed with conditions. Raw shrimp held 12 hours at 52.4F and raw cod at 51.4F; about $260 of product discarded; citation issued. Both prep coolers measured 52.2-66.4F and were tagged. Cold foods must be held at 41F or below.

headline: Passed re-inspection; food handler training records missing
summary: Passed re-inspection. No proof of training for food handlers was available. The business was instructed to provide and maintain these records at all times.

headline: Passed; restroom trash receptacle missing
summary: Passed. The women's restroom had no covered receptacle. Inspector instructed the business to provide one.

headline: Passed; debris in technology closet
summary: Passed. Debris built up on the floor of the technology closet. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Passed; mop sink misuse, missing thermometers
summary: Passed. Handwashing signage and soap at the rear mop sink must be removed; use it only as a mop sink. Front and rear reach-in coolers need thermometers. Packaged food lacks common name labels. Dry food stored on a crate; no backflow device at mop sink.

headline: Conditions: dish machine tagged; no certified manager
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager on duty while TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. Low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged. Handsinks lacked soap and paper towels, supplied during visit. Food stored on floors.

headline: Failed: no certified manager while open
summary: Failed. No certified manager on site while open, including during shrimp and seafood preparation; citation issued. A two-burner stove is not under a ventilation hood (prior violation not corrected). Heavy grease and debris on fryers, floors, and walls.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager on duty
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge with sanitation manager training; no certified manager on duty while TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. Restroom lacks handwashing signage and a covered receptacle. A 1/4-inch gap under the receiving door.

headline: Conditions: no manager while slicing deli meat
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while deli meat was being sliced; citation issued. A deli worker lacked a hair restraint. No chlorine sanitizer test kit for the three-compartment sink. Minor drain leak. Deli staff had no food handler certificate.

headline: Passed; rusty shelves and dirty floors
summary: Passed. Rusty shelves in two- and three-door refrigerators must be cleaned and made smooth. Dirt on the floor under the dish machine, along walls, and in corners of dishwashing and storage areas must be cleaned.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager until 9:44 AM
summary: Passed with conditions. Person in charge lacked a food manager certificate. Certified manager arrived at 9:44 a.m. while TCS foods were being prepared; citation issued. Several handsink leaks and slow drains; crates used for food storage; multiple repairs listed.

headline: Failed: live flies, moldy-looking cheese, warm cold food
summary: Failed. About 50 live small flying insects and 4 house flies in basement and bar areas; citation issued. Cheese appeared moldy. Cold foods at 48-68F, and a prep cooler at 58F. No certified manager present while mashed potatoes at 161F were served.

headline: Passed; unlabeled containers and food handler training needed
summary: Passed. Small containers of cornmeal and flour were unlabeled. Fryers, grill, floors, walk-in cooler, and hood vents need cleaning. New employees on site must obtain required food handler training.

headline: Passed re-inspection; milk crates and grease buildup
summary: Passed re-inspection. Milk crates still used as shelving; must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor. Grease and food debris build up on equipment, walls, and floors. Leaking sprayer on the dish area one-compartment sink.

headline: Failed: about 35 mouse droppings, missing handsinks
summary: Failed. About 35 or more mice droppings in liquor and rear storage areas; citation issued. Several prep areas lack handsinks. Hot foods at 112-125F; about 69 lbs discarded. Hot holding cabinet at 129.1F tagged. Gaps at doors allow rodent entry.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, no health policy
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on site while soup and chicken were prepared and served; citation issued. No employee health policy and no vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit. Restroom hand sink water measured 130F, above the 120F limit. Food handler certificates incomplete.

headline: Failed re-inspection: flies still present in prep area
summary: Failed re-inspection. About 7-8 live large flies flying in the rear food prep area; a previous pest violation was not corrected; citation issued. Brownish substance inside ice machine; cardboard shelf liner; restroom door lacks a self-closing device.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings, dead mouse, warm food
summary: Failed. Rodent droppings found in rear food prep area and about 20 under the bar and customer area; citation issued. Dead mouse in basement. About 1 lb diced tomatoes at 58F discarded. Employees drinking in food prep areas; bearded staff lacked beard guards.

headline: Passed; food handler training proof needed
summary: Passed. Clean mixing bowls were not stored inverted; the manager corrected this on site. No proof of food handler training or certificates for all required employees; these must be provided.

headline: Failed: warm chicken received, no pest logs
summary: Failed. Chicken received at 46.6F with signs of prior temperature abuse; about 10 lbs discarded; citation issued. Frozen shrimp thawing at room temperature. Pest control logbook incomplete, with no 2025 service reports; citation issued. Utensils stored in water below 135F.

headline: Passed; certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. The certified manager on duty did not have allergen training. The business was instructed to comply, or citations will follow.

headline: Passed; peeling paint and ceiling tile repairs
summary: Passed. Peeling and chipping paint in to-go/beverage, walk-in cooler, dish, and prep areas must be repaired. Water-damaged and broken ceiling tiles in the to-go/beverage area must be replaced. Burned-out bulb in rear dry storage.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager while scooping ice cream
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager on site while ice cream was being scooped; citation issued. Grease trap under the three-compartment sink has objectionable odors. No proof of food handler training for staff.

headline: Conditions: no vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit
summary: Passed with conditions. No vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit on site; citation issued. Washroom door lacks a self-closing device. Wall coving missing at the base of the washroom wall under the sink.

headline: Conditions: dead roaches in basement, no certified manager
summary: Passed with conditions. Dead roaches found in the basement; they must be removed, and the area cleaned and sanitized. No valid City food sanitation certificate for employees; a certified manager must be on premises; citation issued.

headline: Passed re-inspection; food stored in bags and on floor
summary: Passed re-inspection. Employees were drinking and preparing food at the prep area; a designated eating area is required. Food containers stored on the walk-in freezer floor. Food stored in grocery bags and tin cans. Torn gasket on a prep cooler.

headline: Failed: no handwashing sink in dish area
summary: Failed. No handwashing sink with hot and cold water, soap, and hand drying device in the rear dishwashing area; citation issued. Washroom trash bin needs a lid.

headline: Passed re-inspection; damaged cooler flooring to repair
summary: Passed re-inspection. The liquor walk-in cooler has damaged flooring that must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Failed: missing food handler certificates, uncorrected violations
summary: Failed. Staff not wearing hair restraints; wiping cloths left on prep tables; food handler certificates missing. Previous violations not fixed, including raw meat stored on walk-in floor. Ice buildup in meat freezers. Citation issued.

headline: Failed: roaches found, raw chicken stored above ready food
summary: Failed. A large roach was crawling under the wok line, a live roach was under the three-compartment sink, and numerous dead roaches were found; citation issued. Raw chicken and eggs stored above ready-to-eat vegetables and cooked egg rolls; citation issued.

headline: Passed; minor plumbing and wall repairs
summary: Passed. The three-compartment sink drainboard is not self-draining and must be tilted toward the basin. No backflow device found for the coffee maker. Walls around the mop sink and behind prep and dish areas are not durable.

headline: Passed; leak and grease buildup near grease trap
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign in the women's restroom. Built-up rust on walk-in cooler shelving. Leak at the three-compartment sink faucet. Excessive grease and debris around the grease trap under the kitchen sink and on its lid.

headline: Passed re-inspection; several repairs and cleanings
summary: Passed re-inspection. Front door sweep is broken and must be repaired to prevent insect entry. Worn gaskets and missing handles on prep cooler. Leaky drain gasket on bar sink. Missing lidded trash can in staff toilet. Floor drain and hood debris to clean.

headline: Failed: handwash sinks inaccessible or unstocked
summary: Failed. Front prep handwash sink backs up into the floor drain when turned on, so it cannot be used; citation issued. No handwash sink in the walk-in cooler used for meat cutting. Storage-area sink lacked soap, towels, and signs. Prepared salads labeled only with ingredients.

headline: Conditions: dish machine fixed on site; signage missing
summary: Passed with conditions. Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine; repaired on site to 50 ppm; citation issued. Handwashing signs missing at several sinks. Rear bar prep/dump sink lacks hot and cold water. Boxes stored on floor in liquor cooler.

headline: Failed: expired manager certificate, warm cooler, mold
summary: Failed. Expired manager certificate on site while TCS foods were handled; citation issued. Prep cooler at 60.2F tagged until the city removes the tag. Ice machine had black mold above ice for consumption. Pest control logbook had no reports since 10/25/24.

headline: Passed; dirty ice machine water tubes to replace
summary: Passed. Plastic water tubes in the upper portion of the ice machine were not clean. Manager instructed to replace them.

headline: Passed; cleaning and leak repairs ordered
summary: Passed. Ice machine interior, grill, fryers, walk-in fan covers, and bulk containers need cleaning. A grease trap leak must be repaired. Dumpster and grease container area must be cleaned to prevent food source and harborage. Working cooler thermometers required.

headline: Passed; ice machine rust, gasket and wall repairs
summary: Passed. Rust found near ice machine screws; ice must be destroyed and the machine cleaned and sanitized. Gaps on the revolving door must be sealed. Damaged cooler gaskets, rusty shelving, missing mop rack, and one employee lacking allergen training.

headline: Passed; no food handler training on site
summary: Passed. No food handler training was on site. The business was instructed to provide food handler training for employees.

headline: Failed: cold food too warm, 10 lbs discarded
summary: Failed. Deli prep cooler held cut tomatoes, cheese, salami, and eggs at 53-56.6F, and cooked meats at 55-58F; about 10 lbs discarded, citation issued. Refrigerator at 55F tagged. Chicken thawing in standing water. No handwashing sign.

headline: Passed; broken cooling unit drain line
summary: Passed. A cooling unit's drain line is broken, and condensate wastewater is collecting in a bucket inside. Inspector instructed the business to repair it.

headline: Passed; food on floors, bags, and damaged ceiling
summary: Passed. Food containers stored on floors in walk-in, prep, and storage areas; food kept in plastic grocery bags; knives stored improperly. Missing covered receptacle in employee washroom. Water-stained, cracked ceiling tiles and wall holes need repair.

headline: Failed: slime in ice machine, meatballs too cool
summary: Failed. Excessive black slime on the ice machine's ice-contact surfaces; citation issued. Meatballs held at 120.3F and 124.8F; reheated to 165F. No written employee health policy and no food handler or allergen training proof. Cups stored next to front prep handsink.

headline: Passed; no handwashing sign at sink
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign at a handsink. The person in charge was instructed to provide and maintain one.

headline: Conditions: no certified manager while serving TCS foods
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was present while duck, chicken, and noodles were prepared and served; citation issued. Ice bin left uncovered. Prior food handler and allergen training violations were not corrected.

headline: Conditions: no employee health policy on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy or training system on site; citation issued. Food storage boxes and containers on the basement floor must be raised at least 6 inches. Torn caulking at the rear prep handsink must be repaired.

headline: Conditions: cheese at 49F discarded; cooler restored
summary: Passed with conditions. Sliced Swiss cheese held at 49F; about $5 discarded; citation issued. Service cooler air at 47F; a technician on site restored it. Cold TCS foods must be held at 41F or below.

headline: Passed; greasy fryer exterior to clean
summary: Passed. Grease on the exterior of the cooking fryers must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; food debris and spills throughout
summary: Passed. Food debris and spills on floors and surfaces throughout the facility. Instructed to detail clean under all shelving, the dish area, prep tables, and cooking equipment, and to maintain cleaning at all times.

headline: Failed: no vomit cleanup supplies, food temperatures out of range
summary: Failed. Hot bacon at 128.3F and cold shrimp and cream at 46.2-50.2F were discarded; citation issued. No vomit and diarrhea clean-up supplies. No handwash sinks in barista and banquet bar areas. Men's room handsink water measured 76.8F.

headline: Passed re-inspection; cleaning and sealing repairs
summary: Passed re-inspection. Grease inside the deep fryer and under the grill must be cleaned. Light shields and ceiling tiles need cleaning. Wall tiles behind cooking equipment need regrouting. Holes in the basement prep area must be sealed. Several lights out.

headline: Passed; no food handler certificates, hair restraint issue
summary: Passed. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint properly. Food handlers had no food handler certificates; they must be provided.

headline: Passed; coolers not working, handwashing signs missing
summary: Passed. Two bar coolers and two main line coolers are not working; they must be repaired to 41F or below or removed. Handwashing signs missing at two bar sinks. Women's restroom needs a covered trash receptacle. One hood bulb is burned out.

headline: Passed; rusty storage racks to remove
summary: Passed. Rusty wire storage racks in the rear storage area must have rust removed and be maintained.

headline: Passed re-inspection; cleaning and clutter tasks ordered
summary: Passed re-inspection. Cleaning ordered for cooking equipment, mixers, prep table bottoms, cabinets, floors, light shields, and vents. Unneeded basement items must be removed to avoid clutter and rodent harborage.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk containers, uncovered food
summary: Passed. Bulk containers in the prep area were not labeled with the common food name. Food items in a reach-in cooler were not covered. Soiled water in the mop pail; mop heads must be hung to dry to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Passed re-inspection; ceiling tiles and light shields
summary: Passed re-inspection. Toilet room door must be self-closing. Broken and stained ceiling tile panels must be repaired or replaced. Missing light shields in the bathroom ceiling light and above the stove.

headline: Conditions: warm cooler, food discarded, cooler tagged
summary: Passed with conditions. Cooked house-made items and leafy greens at 43.5-44.6F in a reach-in cooler; about 2 lbs discarded. That cooler's air measured 49F and was tagged; it may not be used until it holds 41F. Sushi bar handsink leaks.

headline: Passed; truck license number missing on one side
summary: Passed. The license number must appear on both sides of the truck. Inspector instructed the business to add it and maintain it.

headline: Passed; hair restraints not worn, water-stained ceiling
summary: Passed. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints; the manager was told all must wear them. Water-stained ceiling tiles above the rear prep and dishwashing area must be replaced.

headline: Passed; beef slicer had food debris
summary: Passed. The beef slicer in the rear prep area had an accumulation of food debris. It must be removed, detail cleaned, and sanitized after each use.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings and ice machine buildup
summary: Failed. About 20-25 mouse droppings on the floor near the dough proofers; citation issued. Black and pink buildup inside the ice machine above ice for consumption; citation issued. Also missing handwashing signs and unlabeled containers.

headline: Failed: handwash water wrong temperature, coolers warm
summary: Failed. Handwashing sinks ran at 84.2F and 135.9F; required range is at least 100F and at most 120F. Walk-in cooler at 43.5F and a small cold unit at 46F, corrected on site with hold tags. No handwashing signs; door openings and water leaks noted.

headline: Conditions: handsinks blocked or missing towels
summary: Passed with conditions. Front prep handsink had no hand drying supplies; towels provided after the violation. Rear handsink was blocked by a cart; removed during inspection. Metered faucets in both restrooms do not run 15 seconds. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Passed re-inspection; gap at door and missing tiles
summary: Passed re-inspection. A 1/2-inch gap under the rear kitchen exit door must be sealed. A splash guard is needed between the drying rack and the handwash sink. Missing wall tile at the cook line, missing ceiling tile, missing light shield, and clutter to remove.

headline: Failed: no sanitizer test kit, food on floor
summary: Failed. No chemical test kit for sanitizer; citation issued. Food items stored on floor in prep and storage areas; single-service items not inverted; paper, foil, and cardboard liners in use; no backflow device on utility sink; soiled mop heads; debris throughout.

headline: Failed: live flies, no hand sink in prep area
summary: Failed. About 7-9 small and 4-6 large live flies were flying on walls and ceiling; a pest control service is required. Main prep area has no hand sink. Hand sink water ran only 79.5-80.1F. No signed employee health policy or pest log.

headline: Gap under north kitchen door must be sealed
summary: Passed. A small opening at the bottom of the main north kitchen entrance door must be sealed and maintained.

headline: Missing handwash sign, backflow device, self-closing door
summary: Passed. No handwash sign posted in washroom; corrected on site. No backflow device at utility sink; must install. No self-closing device on washroom door; must install.

headline: Repairs needed: gasket, grease, and a drain leak
summary: Passed. Replace torn gasket on a prep cooler door, clean grease inside fryer doors, and repair a drain line leak under the Morocco Room bar hand sink.

headline: Dead roaches; bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food
summary: Passed with conditions. Several dead roaches by prep-area coolers must be removed. Employee touched a ready-to-eat tortilla bare-handed; citation issued. Certified manager and food handler certificates not on site. Employee lacked hair restraint; food stored on floor.

headline: No consumer advisory for raw or undercooked food
summary: Failed. No consumer advisory or menu disclosure for raw or undercooked beef and eggs; manager posted advisory during visit. Back door gap at bottom could let pests in. Utensils stored in stagnant water. Manager's allergen certificate expired.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; food stored on floor
summary: Failed. Over 100 mouse droppings on shelves, prep tables, floors, and in prep, storage, furnace, and dish areas. Manager told to call an exterminator and clean. Food stored on floors; grease buildup; damaged cooler gasket; managers lack allergen training.

headline: Dirty walk-in seafood cooler and sushi floor
summary: Passed. Walk-in seafood cooler floor needs detail cleaning. Floor under and around low two-door reach-in coolers in sushi area needs detail cleaning.

headline: Ice machine lip needs cleaning; missing signage
summary: Passed. Missing handwashing signs at rear toilet room and front bar station. Outer lip of ice machine needs detail cleaning. First unisex washroom lacks covered receptacle. Kitchen and bar floors need detail cleaning.

headline: Ice machine build-up and plumbing leaks; re-inspection passed
summary: Re-inspection passed. Ice machine interior needs cleaning. Leaking faucet at the three-compartment sink in room 136 and a slow-draining break-room hand sink need repair. Floor drains throughout need cleaning.

headline: Food held too warm; missing handwashing signs
summary: Passed with conditions. Pork (50.1°F) and sliced tomatoes (50.2°F) in display cooler were discarded, 10 lbs. Prep cooler at 50.1°F is tagged and held until reinspected. Handwashing signs missing in employee restrooms. Beverage boxes stored on floor.

headline: Missing health policy, cleanup kit, and certificates
summary: Failed. No employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit, or food handler certificates on site. Test kits are for quats, but bleach is used. Three-compartment sink clogged and leaking. Soiled mop heads stored improperly; washroom vents not working.

headline: No hot water at employee hand sink; repaired
summary: Passed with conditions. Employee washroom hand sink had no hot water (71.1°F). Plumber repaired it; temperature reached 102°F by inspection's end; citation issued. Also missing hair restraints, improper food storage containers, and cluttered washroom.

headline: Standing water under sink; dirty dish machine
summary: Passed. Standing water on floor under the three-compartment sink must be corrected. Heavy food debris and grime on the high-temperature dish machine exterior. Missing light bulb over cook line; dust on ceiling above dish machine.

headline: Dirty freezer and floors; dust in hood
summary: Passed. Raw meat residue in basement reach-in freezer needs cleaning. Food debris on upstairs prep, fryer, and walk-in cooler floors must be removed. Hood dust needs cleaning. One of two certified managers lacks allergen training.

headline: No certified manager; repeat allergen training violation
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager while burritos were prepared. Chicken and beef stored in old yogurt and sour cream containers. Repeat violation: allergen training from 2023 still not completed. Missing handwashing signage, burnt-out lights, and one untrained employee.

headline: 25+ rat droppings; no employee health policy
summary: Failed. About 25 or more rat droppings under dish storage shelves, mop sink, furnace room, and between clutter. Remove, clean, and sanitize; call pest control on or after 6/20/25. No signed employee health policy. Also damaged ceiling and floor tiles and plastic bags for food storage.

headline: Pink buildup in ice machine; dusty ceiling vents
summary: Passed. Slight pink buildup inside upper ice machine portion must be cleaned and maintained. Dust on ceiling vents and tiles above dishwashing area must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: about 15 rodent droppings under grill
summary: Failed. About 15 rodent droppings under the flat-top grill and panini press table. Manager must eliminate pests, clean affected areas, and call pest control. Also missing handwashing sign, hair restraints, ice machine backflow device, and posted inspection summary.

headline: No pest control service or logbook; failed
summary: Failed. No licensed pest control service or logbook. Employee clothing kept near dough mixers must be moved away. Dishwasher dried utensils with a cloth towel; must air dry. Drywall around mixer needs a durable, smooth surface.

headline: Missing thermometers; dirty floors and cove base
summary: Passed. Install working thermometers in all coolers. Clean interior shelves of walk-in and reach-in coolers and floors in prep and storage areas. Repair wall base and cove in basement and walk-in to prevent pest entry points.

headline: Missing paper towels and date labels on foods
summary: Passed with conditions. No paper towels at employee washroom hand sink; obtained during inspection; citation issued. Chicken, beef, and goat in coolers not date-marked; stored food unlabeled. Plates stored above sink not inverted. One burned-out bulb in main prep.

headline: Female food handlers lacked hair restraints
summary: Passed. Female food handlers were without proper hair restraints such as a cap or hair net; must provide.

headline: No certified manager during food prep and service
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager on site while nacho cheese, cut melon, and yogurt were prepared and served; citation issued. Stacked crates used for shelving in prep and storage must be replaced with smooth, cleanable surfaces.

headline: No certified manager; handwashing water too cool
summary: Failed. No certified food manager until 1:52 PM; corrected on site. Handwash sink lacked soap, corrected on site. Handwash water was 70.7–73.2°F; later measured 107–115°F. Dish machine wash at 119°F was converted to low-temp on site. Gap at rear door to alley.

headline: Chicken held at 48.4°F; allergen certificates missing
summary: Passed with conditions. Chicken breast held at 48.4°F; must be 41°F or below. Manager discarded 2 lbs ($15). Citation issued. Repeat violation: allergen training completed on site, but no certificates on premises.

headline: No certified manager; 30+ flying insects
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on site while eggs were prepared; one arrived about 10:45 AM. Over 30 small flying insects in bar and kitchen. Bar hand sinks lacked soap and paper towels. Oyster shells reused as serving containers; cold units soiled.

headline: Front door gap; uncovered trash in restrooms
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap between front double doors must be rodent-proofed. No covered trash receptacles in unisex washrooms; must provide.

headline: Over 50 mouse droppings; food held too cool
summary: Failed. Over 50 mouse droppings on washroom floor, behind hot water tank, near walk-in coolers, and inside fryer cabinets. Mashed potatoes in hot-holding unit at 103.8°F (135°F or above required); discarded. Food stored on floors; clutter and grime cited.

headline: Peeling ceiling above back storage rack
summary: Passed. Loose faucet handle in customer restroom must be repaired. Damaged, peeling 12 by 12-inch ceiling above back storage rack must be repaired.

headline: Clogged handwash sinks; dish machine tagged out
summary: Failed. Clogged hand sink, no paper towels, and a sink blocked by a container. Dish machine at 0 ppm chlorine was tagged out. Cooked beans at 47.8–49.7°F were discarded (10–15 lbs). Ready-to-eat foods lacked date marks. Grease and debris also cited.

headline: Dead roaches, warm food, dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Passed with conditions. Dead roaches under three-compartment sink and on dish machine. Dish machine at 0 ppm chlorine; technician arrived and it read 50 ppm. Samosa, potatoes, cauliflower, and rice in display cooler too warm; 15 lbs discarded. Hand sink lacked paper towels.

headline: Soda fountain not clean around dispensing panel
summary: Passed. Soda fountain machine is not clean around the dispensing panel; must clean and maintain.

headline: No handwash sink in new coffee area
summary: Failed. Newly built coffee prep area in dining room has no handwash sink; must install one with hot and cold water, soap, and towels. Barrier needed to keep customers out of prep area. Debris and standing water; mold above three-compartment sink.

headline: Garbage bags used as barrier; dim walk-in lighting
summary: Passed. Garbage bags were used as a barrier between clean and soiled dish racks at the three-compartment sink; a durable, cleanable barrier is required. Walk-in cooler lighting is inadequate and must be improved.

headline: Clean equipment under sewer lines; rice on floor
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Clean equipment stored under unshielded sewer lines in basement storage room; must be relocated. Large bags of rice stored on floor; must elevate at least six inches.

headline: Exposed restroom brick; missing covered receptacles
summary: Passed. Exposed brick in rear restrooms must be sealed or painted. Women's restrooms lack covered receptacles. Sanitation manager lacks food allergen training certificate.

headline: Handwashing sink blocked by pizza trays
summary: Passed with conditions. Rear handwashing sink was inaccessible; 10–15 pizza trays were stored in hand sinks. Citation issued. Food handlers lacked proof of food handler training; manager must provide it.

headline: Floors need deep cleaning under and behind equipment
summary: Passed. Kitchen floors need cleaning in corners, under and behind equipment, under rear storage shelves, and in the dishwashing area and closet.

headline: Stained cutting boards and full grease bin
summary: Passed. Dark-stained cutting boards in front prep must be refinished or replaced. Full oil receptacle in rear trash area; grease stored in buckets in rear prep. Contact oil removal service to increase frequency. Sanitation manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Reach-in cooler thermometer in poor repair
summary: Passed. Thermometer in reach-in cooler is in poor repair; must replace and maintain.

headline: Unlabeled sauce; greasy fryer; faulty washroom door closer
summary: Passed. Packaged sauce lacked required labels (business name and address, sauce name, ingredients, use-by date); inspector instructed proper labeling. Grease at bottom of fryer needs cleaning. Washroom door self-closing device needs repair.

headline: Personal food in cooler; debris on floors
summary: Passed. Personal food stored in reach-in cooler; person in charge instructed to remove it. Food debris on prep and warewashing floors and grease on hood filters must be cleaned.

headline: Moldy food and slime near ice; unsafe storage
summary: Failed. Moldy cooked steak and tomato sauce (about 2 lbs) discarded. Slime dripped from ice machine onto ice used for drinks; must be removed and machine deep cleaned. Missing hair restraints, unlabeled dry ingredients, and food in hardware-store buckets.

headline: Unverified sushi rice; torn gasket; uncovered bar
summary: Failed. Sushi rice prepared on site without a pH meter or lab letter showing it is safe without refrigeration. Torn prep cooler gasket; unreadable screen on low-temp dish machine. Outdoor bar uncovered on patio. Trash on ground in garbage area. Unused freezer.

headline: Broken lid handle on hot-holding unit
summary: Passed. Hot-holding unit lid handle is missing and has exposed screws that are hard to clean; repair or replace it.

headline: Quarter-inch gap under entry door; drains dirty
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the entry door must be sealed to prevent pests. Drains at the front service area have dirt and buildup and must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager or person in charge present
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge with a valid certificate; no certified manager on site while chicken was prepared and served; citation issued. Missing floor drain covers; soiled mop water; food debris on prep floor; no allergen training available.

headline: Re-inspection passed; upkeep repairs needed
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Required fixes: store utensils inverted, remove clean dishes from grease trap lid, replace a missing cooler handle, stop using crates for storage, fix a leaking sink pipe, and repair floors and wall trim.

headline: Unlabeled bulk foods; foil and cardboard liners
summary: Passed. Bulk containers need common-name labels; paper goods must be off floor. Foil, duct tape, or cardboard cannot line shelves or the ice machine. Missing food handler training proof and allergen training proof. Damaged ceilings and washroom vent cover.

headline: Grease needs cleaning from outside oil tank
summary: Passed. Inspector instructed cleaning grease from the front end of the outside oil tank.

headline: Repeat core violations not corrected; citation issued
summary: Failed. Repeat violations from 2023 not corrected: food debris on equipment, coolers, and floors; ice machine residue; food spills on walls. Also wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer, knife stored behind sink, and worn cutting boards.

headline: Slow sink fixed by plumber; rust cited
summary: Passed with conditions. Three-compartment sink drained slowly and was not working properly; a plumber repaired it on site. Citation issued. Rusted racks and grease trap, dusty fans in walk-in, and no certified manager with allergen training.

headline: Wiping cloths on prep tables; dusty vent
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths stored on top of prep tables in main kitchen; must store in sanitizing solution when not in use. Dust on ceiling vent in unisex employee washroom must be cleaned.

headline: Ice machine not cleaned; employees without hair restraints
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Ice machine inner compartment not cleaned; must clean and sanitize. Prep employees lacked hair restraints. Food in tin cans in refrigeration; unfinished wood at 3-compartment sink. Floors and drains need detail cleaning; wet basement dry-storage floor.

headline: Shellfish tags missing; cold-held food too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. Basement walk-in cooler at 59.9°F was tagged out. About 862 lbs ($1,720) of cold foods too warm, including mussels and cheese, were discarded. Shellfish tags improperly dated; ice machine has black and pink slime; no bar hand soap.

headline: Re-inspection passed; dead insects and grease cited
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Several dead insects on basement floor must be removed. Cited: encrusted grease inside fryer, oven, and grill; broken baseboard and floor tiles; wall corners need sealing to prevent pest hiding spots; greasy prep walls.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; exposed caulk
summary: Passed. Milk crates used as shelving throughout prep and storage must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor. Exposed foam-like caulk on walls and baseboards in rear must be resurfaced to be smooth and cleanable.

headline: Unlabeled bulk items and residue on coolers
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Bulk items in non-original containers not labeled with common name. Food residue on bulk containers and inside coolers must be cleaned.

headline: Raw meat contaminated food; dish machine too cool
summary: Passed with conditions. Raw chicken dripped onto raw beef, which sat on open greens; about 1/4 lb celery and 1/2 lb greens discarded. Bowls were rinsed but not sanitized. Dish machine reached only 150°F (160°F required). Shellfish tags kept 30 days, not 90.

headline: Peeling paint on sushi prep ceiling
summary: Re-inspection passed. A small area of peeling paint on the sushi prep ceiling must be removed.

headline: Unsafe cold holding and sanitizing; no manager
summary: No certified food manager on site. Dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine; fixed to 100 ppm during visit. Cooler foods at 47.6–49.5°F (41°F or below required); 10 lbs discarded. Food stored in plastic bags and on floors.

headline: Food too warm in cooler; hot water fixed
summary: Walk-in cooler at 48°F was tagged out. About 50 lbs raw beef, 20 lbs cheese, and 5 lbs milk were discarded. Hot water was too low; owner fixed it on site. Ice machine panel had pink residue to clean.

headline: Black slime in drip pan; no utility sink
summary: Passed. Black slime built up in drip pan under compressor of refrigerator used for olives and octopus salad; must clean. No utility sink on premises; must install per rules. Cluttered rear hallway near restroom must be cleared.

headline: Damaged basement wall behind large equipment
summary: Passed. Damage to basement wall behind large stationary equipment must be repaired and made smooth and easily cleanable.

headline: Grease trap location unknown; garbage area debris
summary: Passed. Grease trap for the three-compartment sink could not be located; must provide its location or install a grease box. Leaves and debris around garbage enclosure. Dried food debris on bar-area floors and walls.

headline: Pest control logbook missing recent service report
summary: Failed. Pest control logbook missing a recent service report; citation issued. No handwashing sign at toilet room sink; must provide and maintain.

headline: Yogurt and milk too warm; coolers tagged out
summary: Failed. Yogurt (50.9°F, 52.5°F) and milk (56.1°F) too warm; about 50 lbs ($200) discarded. Upstairs and basement prep coolers at 58.8°F and 47.8°F were tagged out. Missing metal-stem and dish machine thermometers. Loose faucet and broken trash lid.

headline: Clutter outside; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Clean and maintain rear outside area with unused chairs, tables, wood, and clutter to prevent pest hiding spots. Certified food manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Torn gaskets, slow drain, and missing light shield
summary: Passed. Repairs needed: torn gaskets on three-door front prep cooler, cracked sugar container lid, slow-draining rear three-compartment sink, and missing light shield in walk-in cooler.

headline: Greasy equipment, leaky sink, and damaged rear door
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Excess grease and food debris on holding units, prep tables, shelves, fryers, and walk-in cooler must be cleaned. Standing water under hot holding unit must be removed. Rear door sweep has bent bristles; leaking pipe at front hand sink.

headline: Food poisoning complaint; gap at front doors
summary: Passed. Suspected food poisoning complaint. Hot-holding unit needs thermometers. 1/4-inch gap between front doors must be sealed. Soda gun holder must be cleaned. Leaking pipe under dish area hand sink must be repaired.

headline: No certified manager; mold-like substance in ice machine
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on premises (citation issued). Black mold-like substance in ice machine; ice destroyed. Three-compartment sink leaks; no quaternary ammonium test kit. Repeat core violation from 2025 report not corrected.

headline: Yogurt cooling covered; hot-hold thermometers missing
summary: Passed. Yogurt and puree items were covered while cooling in the rear walk-in; must be loosely covered or uncovered while cooling. Upright and four-door hot-holding cabinets lacked internal thermometers.

headline: Missing handwashing signs at hand sinks
summary: Passed. No handwashing signs were posted at hand sinks. The facility must provide them.

headline: Failed: leaking pipe, spills, dumpster lids missing
summary: Failed. Leaking drainpipe under serving-area hand sink must be repaired. Front two lids missing from outside dumpster (citation issued). Syrup spills and dirty floor drains. Spills and debris on equipment and inside beverage cabinets.

headline: No signed employee health policy; door gaps
summary: Passed with conditions. No signed employee health policy; must provide. Gaps under front and rear doors must be sealed. Foods on walk-in cooler floor must be elevated. Food manager lacks allergen training. Also damaged ceiling, flooring, and chipping paint to repair.

headline: No certificate posted; corrected on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No person on site had an original city food sanitation certificate posted. Certificate delivered at 4:26 PM, before inspection ended. Basement cooler's non-food surfaces soiled with rust and debris. Employee items stored above covered greens.

headline: Room-temperature thawing; pink ice machine residue
summary: Failed. Octopus was thawing at room temperature. Foods must thaw under refrigeration at 41°F or below, or under running water at 70°F or below. Pink residue in ice machine. Bar ice bin uncovered. Dish machine lacked required temperature indicator.

headline: No certified manager; flypaper found throughout
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge with manager training; no valid sanitation certificate while beans, steak, and rice were prepared. Flypaper found throughout; request licensed pest control. Rear door has a 1/4-inch gap. Spilled food inside cold units.

headline: No certified manager; hot foods held at 78°F
summary: Failed. No certified manager or original certificate on site while chicken, beef, and shrimp were prepared. Empanadas and coxao held near 79°F, below 135°F required; 3 lbs discarded. Gap under rear door. Residential garbage cans used instead of commercial dumpster.

headline: Oatmeal held at 66°F; discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Oatmeal held at 66°F, above the 41°F limit for cold food; manager discarded 4 lbs ($8). Citation issued.

headline: Missing handwash signs; employees lacked hair restraints
summary: Passed. Handwash signs missing at kitchen, bar, and washroom sinks. Employees without hair restraints; corrected on site. Ice scoops stored inside ice bin. Stained cutting boards; expired food handler and allergen training certificates.

headline: Hygiene and sanitizing failures; citations issued
summary: Citations issued. A food handler touched a phone and handled food without changing gloves or washing hands. Utensils were sanitized at 0.0 ppm; a pot and skillet were rinsed and put back on the stove. Training expired.

headline: No certified manager while chicken was served
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager or valid certificate on site while chicken was prepared and served. Citation issued. A certified manager must be on site at all times food is prepared and served.

headline: Missing bar hand soap; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Passed with conditions. Bar hand sink had no soap while open. Conveyor dish machine reached only 142°F at final rinse. It is tagged and may not be used until CDPH (Chicago Department of Public Health) removes the tag.

headline: Cutting board stored on sink; washroom cover needed
summary: Passed. Clean cutting board was stored on the sink backsplash; manager removed it on site. A cover is required in the women's washroom.

headline: No valid food sanitation certificate; low hot water
summary: Failed. Person in charge had no valid city food sanitation certificate posted (citation issued). Hand sinks and three-compartment sink ran about 95°F during early prep; hot water restored after over an hour. Oversized pots and broken floor tiles also cited.

headline: Dairy cooler doors loose; gaskets failing
summary: Passed. Two-door dairy cooler in front bar area is in poor repair: doors loose with improper gasket seal. Must repair or replace the doors.

headline: About 500 lbs vacuum-sealed food discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Vacuum-sealed foods lacked required temperature records and date marks, including pickled onion, deli meat, ground pork, and marinated beef. About 500 lbs ($4,000) voluntarily discarded. No paper towels at bar hand sink; obtained during inspection.

headline: Failed: no certified manager and missing handwash sink
summary: Failed. No certified manager during hot and cold food prep; no handwash sink at front prep area. Two discards (about 8 lbs each) for date-marking problems. Pest control records last dated 1/31/24. Food handler and allergen training records missing.

headline: Utility sink lacks water and backflow device
summary: License inspection passed with required fixes. No handwashing sign at washroom sink. Utility sink had no running water and no backflow device; manager must provide hot and cold water and a backflow device.

headline: Freezer ice buildup, debris, and clutter
summary: Passed. Thick ice buildup in bag-ice and ice cream freezers must be removed. Also recaulk toilet sink top, clear debris in dumpster area, organize clutter at 3-compartment sink, clean dirty corners, and fix toilet room ventilation.

headline: Food on floor; milk crates used in cooler
summary: Passed. Food containers stored on walk-in cooler floor, and milk crates used for shelving, which can hide pests. Also dirty wiping cloths, torn cooler gasket, rusty shelves, leaking faucets, and dirty ceilings and floors.

headline: Grease buildup outside; rusty shelves
summary: Passed with conditions. Thick grease on ground and top of outside grease container; citation issued. Rusted shelves in rear dry storage; leaking sprayer faucet by dish machine; floors need cleaning along walls and under equipment.

headline: Cleaning problems; employees need food handler certificates
summary: Passed. Sponges, cutting boards, and sinks need replacing or detail cleaning. Coving needed under the three-compartment sink; new drywall needs finishing and sealing. All employees need food handler certificates.

headline: Chopped beef in grocery bags; leaking sink
summary: Passed. Chopped beef stored in grocery bags; must use food-grade bags. Basement three-compartment sink leaks and pools water on the floor near prep tables and freezers. Missing wall base and inadequate lighting in first-floor prep area.

headline: No certified manager during milk tea and yogurt prep
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was present while milk teas and yogurt (foods that must be kept hot or cold) were prepared and served. Citation issued. Two-door prep cooler has torn gaskets to repair.

headline: Over 50 live flies in food areas; failed
summary: Failed. About 50 or more live small flies in display case, menu board, walls, and mop sink area. Pest control operator recommended. Damaged floor tiles in front prep. No food handler training for employees; must provide.

headline: Soiled mop head not stored properly
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Soiled mop head stored improperly; must hang mop heads to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Food and single-use items stored on floor
summary: Passed. Food boxes stored on floor in rear pizza dough prep and next to walk-in cooler; elevate 6 inches. Pizza boxes and paper items on hallway closet floor. Heavy debris in mechanical closet. Lights out in office and walk-in cooler. Manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Food containers stored improperly; clutter and holes
summary: Food containers were not stored inverted as required. Clutter was found in bar storage areas, and small holes were noted on walls behind the dishwashing area that must be sealed. Passed.

headline: Rear doors not rodent-proofed; faucet leak fixed
summary: The rear exit doors leading to the outside disposal area are not rodent-proofed; new door sweeps must be installed. A leaking right faucet at the 3-compartment sink was corrected on site. Passed.

headline: No City-certified manager; hair restraints and clutter
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site while chicken and beef were handled and served; a priority violation was issued. A prep handwash sink leaked, and food handlers lacked hair restraints. Missing sink stoppers, clutter, and inadequate lighting in the walk-in cooler and freezer were noted. Passed with conditions.

headline: Ready-to-eat foods held without date marking
summary: Ten ready-to-eat foods held over 24 hours in a grab-and-go refrigerator, including chicken, tuna, and egg salad sandwiches, had no disposition date marked. The manager discarded about $20 of product. Passed with conditions after a complaint.

headline: No raw food advisory; leaking prep handsink
summary: No consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods was on the menu, a priority violation with no citation. A food handler lacked an effective hair restraint. Prep tables were lined with aluminum foil, and a leaky handsink in the bar prep area caused pooling water. Failed.

headline: Dirty cooler, floors, and filters; manager lacks allergen training
summary: The reach-in cooler interior had spills and debris, and floors under prep stations and along wall bases needed cleaning. All filters and the hood above cooking equipment were dirty. The on-duty certified manager lacked allergen training and was instructed to get it. Passed.

headline: Coolers lack thermometers; leaking pipe under ice chest
summary: Two prep coolers in the first-floor prep area lacked thermometers, and all TCS-item coolers must have them. A gasket on a walk-in cooler door in the basement was torn. A steady leak was seen at a pipe under the ice chest in the rear bar. Passed.

headline: No raw food advisory; over 50 mouse droppings
summary: The menu had no consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods; this was a priority violation. Over 50 mouse droppings were found in basement and rear storage areas, and a citation was issued. Milk crates, green mold-like buildup in the walk-in cooler, and an unlabeled container were also noted. Failed.

headline: Splashguard and grease cleaning needed
summary: A splashguard must be installed beside the exposed handwashing sink in the dishwashing area. Grease on the ventilation hood and filters above cooking equipment must be cleaned. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Greasy fryers, cooking equipment, and buffet dust
summary: Grease buildup and spills were on the sides of deep fryers, cooking equipment, and the hot wok station. Dried food debris was under the front grill, and dust was on the salad buffet table. Staff must detail clean and maintain. Passed on complaint re-inspection.

headline: Gap under rear door; grease trap and gasket issues
summary: A quarter-inch gap at the bottom of the exterior rear door must be repaired. Foil and cardboard were used on a freezer and shelves. A torn gasket on a juicing-area cooler, grimy gaskets, and excessive grease trap grime were noted. The certified manager lacked allergen training. Passed.

headline: Water-stained ceiling tiles above dishwashing
summary: Some water-stained ceiling tiles were found above the dishwashing area and must be replaced. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Ice machine residue, ice scoops, lighting, and dust
summary: Pink buildup was seen inside the ice machine, and ice scoops were stored on top of the ice bin. Other issues: missing handwashing signs, low water pressure at a 3-compartment sink, grease and dirt near cooking equipment, dust, and some burnt-out light bulbs. Passed.

headline: No mop sink; missing ceiling tiles; no restroom vent
summary: No mop sink or service sink for mop water was installed on site. Several ceiling tiles were missing in the rear and must be replaced. The toilet room has no mechanical ventilation and must be installed. Passed on license re-inspection.

headline: Cooked meat held over 7 days; unapproved vacuum packing
summary: Cooked beef and turkey stored up to 19 days in the walk-in cooler; 20 pounds ($150) were discarded. Vacuum packing was done without a variance; the machine was tagged and must not be used until a variance is obtained. Deli cups were not air dried. Passed with conditions.

headline: Slow-draining front prep handsink needs repair
summary: The front prep area handsink drains slowly and must be repaired and maintained. Passed.

headline: Rusted wire racks; a food handler lacks certificate
summary: Chipped paint and rust were found on wire storage racks in the walk-in cooler and must be removed, and the shelves repainted or replaced. One food handler was observed without a food handler certificate, and proof of training is required. Passed after a short-form complaint.

headline: Equipment stored under unshielded waste lines
summary: Food service equipment and other items were stored near and below waste lines in the basement near walk-in coolers, without proper shielding. The manager was instructed to shield the waste lines to catch potential drips. Passed on complaint re-inspection.

headline: Water leaks under low-temperature dish machine
summary: Water leaks under the low-temperature dish machine must be repaired. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Thermometers missing; allergen training lacking
summary: Working thermometers must be provided inside all coolers and freezers. Employees handling food must comply with state food handler requirements. The City-certified manager lacks allergen training; citations will follow if not completed. Passed.

headline: Cooler condenser leak; greasy wok line equipment
summary: A condenser line is leaking at a reach-in cooler behind the wok line and must be repaired. Rolling carts, cabinet interiors, and fryer exteriors behind the wok line had excessive food debris and grease. Passed on complaint re-inspection.

headline: About 75 to 100 mouse droppings; cilantro stored in sink
summary: Approximately 75 to 100 mouse droppings were found in the prep area, cooler, basement, and washroom. A handwash sink was blocked by stored cilantro, and the cook was removed. Raw eggs were stored above uncovered cooked beef and cilantro; the cook was removed. Failed; pest control was recommended.

headline: Beard guards needed; rice stored in grocery bags
summary: Male food handlers with beards were observed without beard guards and must be provided with them. Cooked rice was stored in grocery bags in the walk-in cooler; only food-grade containers or bags may be used. Passed.

headline: Cardboard liners in coolers; floors need cleaning
summary: Cardboard was used as a liner in the walk-in cooler and a reach-in smoothie cooler and must be removed or replaced with smooth, cleanable material. Floors throughout prep areas, customer seating, and offices must be cleaned. Passed after complaint.

headline: Pink slimy buildup in ice machine; failed
summary: Excessive pink slimy buildup was found inside the ice machine, dripping onto ice for people to eat. It must be removed, cleaned, and sanitized. Soiled wiping cloths were stored on prep tables and must be kept in sanitizing solution. Failed.

headline: Freezers under water pipes; soiled wiping cloths
summary: Several basement box freezers were stored under water piping and must be removed or the piping encased. Cooks line wiping cloths must be held in sanitizing solution between uses. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Employee handled food without handwashing; no hot water
summary: A food handler checked ready-to-eat food temperatures without washing hands first; the manager was told to ensure hand washing. No hand drying provided; rodent-proofing needed on a dining exit door. Hot water was missing in the prep and restroom areas, and the maintenance crew restored it on site. Passed with conditions.

headline: Front display cooler lacks internal thermometer
summary: The front area display cooler was missing an internal ambient air thermometer. The operator must provide at least one visible thermometer in each cold-holding unit for TCS foods. Passed.

headline: No health policy, food handler cards, or allergen training
summary: No employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea response kit, or food handler certificates were on site. No allergen training was on site. Handwash signage was missing, food containers were unlabeled, and soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables. Greasy equipment and floors were also noted. Passed with conditions.

headline: Gaps under exit door; rust and cardboard crates; failed
summary: Squeeze bottles and shakers in prep areas lacked labels. A gap at the exit door bottom must be made tight to prevent rodent entry. Bulk scoops were stored inside products, rust and crates were in several coolers, and gaskets were worn. Missing hand sinks in the meat and bakery prep areas were a previous violation. Failed.

headline: Deep-grooved cutting board; uncovered trash cans
summary: A deep-grooved cutting board on a sandwich prep cooler must be replaced. Staff and customer washrooms had no covered receptacles, and chipped wall paint in the prep area must be repaired. Passed on complaint re-inspection.

headline: Raw meats stored over other foods; citation issued
summary: Raw chicken was stored over raw beef, raw beef over shelled eggs, and raw fish over cooked beef in a basement refrigerator. The operator was instructed to store food to prevent cross-contamination; a priority citation was issued. Minor grease spills on the oven and fryer must be cleaned. Passed with conditions.

headline: Restroom handwash signs; leaking drain; greasy shelves
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at prep area and restroom sinks. A refrigeration drain tube emptied into a handsink and must go to a floor drain. Cooked rice was in non-food-grade plastic bags. Greasy shelves and a broken restroom door jamb were noted. Passed.

headline: Unlabeled flour container; out-of-order food handler
summary: A flour and seasoning container in dry storage had no label. Single-service containers were not stored properly, and a light bulb was out. An employee handled food without a food handler certificate, and a certified manager had no allergen training certificate. Passed.

headline: No certified manager certificate posted; no soap at sink
summary: No City-certified food manager certificate was posted while TCS foods were served; a citation was issued. No soap was at a rear prep handwash sink, but a food employee replenished it during inspection. Multiple employees lacked food handler certificates. Heavy grease and dirt were noted. Failed.

headline: Roaches and flies found; no certified manager at first
summary: About two live roaches were found in the lower crevices behind bulk dry ingredient containers, and about three large flies were found in the rear prep area. A certified food manager was not on site at entry but arrived before the inspection ended. Pest control was recommended. Failed.

headline: Multiple repairs: leaks, floors, pests not found
summary: Splashguard needed at prep handwash sink and a rusted can opener was noted. Food in the walk-in must be elevated. A leak under the 3-compartment sink, garbage piled in the rear hallway, missing floor tiles, water-damaged ceiling tiles, mold caulking, and a broken restroom vent were also noted. Passed.

headline: Chicken thawed in standing water; no sanitizer test kit
summary: A food handler thawed frozen chicken legs in three compartments, sitting in stagnant water; running water must be used. No metal stem thermometer was on site, and no chlorine test kit was present. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Failed.

headline: Employees eating at prep area; missing thermometers
summary: Employees were drinking and preparing food at the kitchen prep area; management must provide a separate eating area. Refrigeration units lacked thermometers. Serving plates were not stored inverted, food was stored in tin cans, and standing water was in a prep cooler. Floors need cleaning. Passed.

headline: No sanitizer test strips; employee items near utensils
