summary: No test strips were available for the 3-compartment sink sanitizer, a priority foundation violation. Employee personal items such as vitamins and a phone were stored on the clean utensil shelf and must be moved away. Passed with conditions.

headline: Ice buildup in walk-in freezer; drain backflow device
summary: Ice buildup was on the walk-in freezer door frame and storage racks and must be removed. A backflow prevention device was not located at the utility mop sink and must be installed where it can be serviced. Passed.

headline: Ice machine debris; ice scoops on bin; dust
summary: Debris was seen inside the ice machine and must be detail-cleaned and maintained. Ice scoops were stored on top of ice bins in the front bar and must be kept in a clean container. A handwash sink drains slowly, and dust is on a ceiling vent in the first-floor restroom. Passed.

headline: Duct tape, dirty cooling unit, and inadequate lighting
summary: Duct tape was found on the wall near a handsink and on bar surfaces and cooling unit handles; it must be removed and surfaces repaired. A sliding door cooling unit had brown water and food debris. Lighting was inadequate in several areas, and vents and lamp shades were dusty. Passed on complaint re-inspection.

headline: About 100 mouse droppings; failed on re-inspection
summary: About 100 or more mouse droppings were found across the sales floor, storage, cashier area, and near merchandise. The inspector required removal, cleaning, sanitizing, and pest control service. A gap under the front doors and debris on floors were also noted. Failed.

headline: Grease, dirt, and debris throughout; failed
summary: Heavy grease buildup was on cooks line equipment wheels and shelving. Grease, debris, and dust were found on hot holding equipment, coolers, fryers, and flat grills. Floors under fryers and grime on walls and vents were noted. Allergen training proof was not provided. Failed on re-inspection.

headline: No certified manager while serving scoop ice cream
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site while ice cream was being scooped, a priority foundation violation. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint and was instructed to wear one. Passed with conditions.

headline: Leaking 3-compartment sink faucet
summary: A slight leak was observed at the faucet of the 3-compartment sink in the rear prep and dish area. The operator must repair or replace it and keep it in good condition. Passed.

headline: Utility sink lacks backflow prevention device
summary: No backflow prevention device was installed on the utility sink. The operator was instructed to install one that is easy to locate and service. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Leaking faucet at basement dry storage sink
summary: A leaking faucet was noted at the 3-compartment sink in basement dry storage and must be repaired. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Handwashing sink blocked by swinging door
summary: A swinging door blocked access to a 3-compartment sink used for handwashing between tasks. Dishware too large to fully immerse in the sink. Also, the all-gender restroom lacked a covered receptacle for feminine hygiene products. Passed after a complaint inspection.

headline: Dishwasher not sanitizing multi-use utensils
summary: A dishwasher was seen washing dishes at the 3-compartment sink using only dish soap, without sanitizing. The manager was instructed to sanitize multi-use utensils when washing. This was a priority violation. Passed with conditions.

headline: Stained cutting boards; low restroom water pressure
summary: Stained cutting boards were found in the second-floor prep and dishwashing areas and must be resurfaced or replaced. Low water pressure was noted at a restroom faucet and must be repaired. Passed on complaint re-inspection.

headline: Handsink lacked soap; 60 rodent droppings; failed
summary: A prep handsink lacked hand cleanser; the person in charge provided it and a citation was issued. About 60 small and large rodent droppings were found in basement dry storage and crawl space. Pest activity must be eliminated. Thermometers were missing, and crates were stored outside near receptacles. Failed.

headline: Missing dessert labels; foil on shelves
summary: Pre-packaged desserts in the front display case lacked the name and place of business of the manufacturer or distributor. A male food handler lacked a beard restraint. Wiping cloths were improperly stored, and aluminum foil lined prep area shelves. Passed.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; not to be used
summary: The low-temperature dish machine was not sanitizing; sanitizer measured 0 ppm, and it must not be used until reinspected by the city. Basement handwashing sink was missing, and bathrooms were under construction. Clutter on the floor must be removed. Failed.

headline: About 25 live flying insects behind bar
summary: Approximately 25 live small flying insects were found behind the bar on liquor storage shelves and flying around the bar area. More pest control service is needed to eliminate the activity. Flooring and wall sections in the food prep and dishwashing area were not smooth or sealed. Failed.

headline: No hot water at sinks; faucets in poor repair
summary: No hot water was found at any sink, and temperature was 51.8F. Hot water must be provided: at least 100F at handwash sinks and 110F at the 3-compartment sink. A faucet leaks, and a second faucet is taped. The certified manager lacks allergen training. Failed.

headline: No health policy; no vomit cleanup procedure
summary: No employee health policy was on site, and a verification is required for each employee. Management could not provide a procedure for cleaning up vomit and diarrhea. Cardboard was used to line kitchen shelves and must be removed to prevent pest hiding places. Certified managers lack allergen training. Passed with conditions.

headline: No allergen training proof for certified manager
summary: No proof of allergen training was provided for the certified food manager. Anyone holding a City sanitation certificate must complete training, and documentation must be provided. Passed on license re-inspection.

headline: Discolored ham and moldy bacon displayed for sale
summary: Nine packs of center-cut ham were discolored, and one pack of slab bacon had green and white mold spots, all displayed for sale in the meat display cooler. The manager was instructed to discard them. Priority citation issued. Passed with conditions after a short-form complaint.

headline: Front doors not rodent or insect proofed
summary: The front double doors are not rodent or insect proofed and must be made tight-fitting. Cooking equipment exterior has food and dirt buildup, and floors in the front prep area need cleaning. Passed.

headline: Expired food handler certificate; debris in ice machine
summary: All food handlers lacked effective hair restraints. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution, and a bowl was used as a scoop. Missing baseboard coving, water-damaged ceiling tiles, and a broken restroom vent were noted. Previous violations were not corrected. Failed on re-inspection.

headline: Filters need cleaning; allergen training lacking
summary: Filters above cooking equipment in the rear must be cleaned to remove debris. The City-certified manager must complete allergen training, or citations will follow. Passed.

headline: Missing cold water knob; no covered sanitary receptacle
summary: The cold water knob at the men's employee washroom handsink was missing, and cold water did not run; the operator must replace the knob and restore water. Women's employee washroom lacks a covered receptacle for sanitary products. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Mold on meat; flies; spoiled meat on display
summary: Numerous meat packages were discolored with black, brown, and green patches and displayed for sale; the manager must discard them. Fly strips were in the basement produce prep area and must be removed. Meat trays were on the floor, and a leaking compressor was noted. Missing handwash signs and ceiling tiles. Passed with conditions.

headline: About 40 mouse droppings; failed
summary: About 40 mouse droppings were found along walls in dry storage and a utility closet. This is a priority foundation violation, and a citation was issued. The operator must notify a pest control operator and remove all droppings. Failed.

headline: No certified manager; insect device above food prep
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site during inspection, a priority foundation violation with a citation. An insect control device was stored above prep tables and cooking equipment and must be moved. The front door has an opening at the bottom. Passed with conditions.

headline: Blocked handwashing sinks; missing splashguard
summary: A meat/deli prep handwash sink was blocked by a trash bin and its water was turned off; this was corrected during the inspection. A citation was issued. Also needed: signage, hand drying, a splashguard, misplaced knives and cutting boards, and removal of an unused grinder. Passed with conditions.

headline: Unlabeled food containers; wiping cloths on prep tables
summary: Bulk storage containers and refrigerated items were not labeled. Wiping cloths were stored on top of prep tables and coolers. Scoops and ice scoops were stored improperly. A slow-leaking faucet, grease, dust, and clutter were noted. Passed.

headline: No City-certified manager on site; expired certificates
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site while dairy and milk products were being prepared and served, though a valid original certificate was available. This is a priority violation, and a citation was issued. Some food handler certificates were expired. Passed with conditions.

headline: Ice maker backflow device not located
summary: A backflow prevention device for the ice maker could not be located. The operator was instructed to expose it. Passed.

headline: Debris inside ice machine; stained cutting boards
summary: Debris was found encrusted inside the ice machine and must be detail-cleaned. Other items: a broken thermometer in a prep cooler, stained cutting boards, a torn cooler door gasket, frozen foods in plastic grocery bags, and grease in the hood and filters. Passed.

headline: No covered sanitary napkin receptacle in restroom
summary: The all-gender washroom has no covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. The operator was instructed to provide one. Passed.

headline: Serving plates and food in tin cans; floors
summary: Serving plates on prep area shelves were not stored inverted. Food was stored inside tin cans in refrigeration units and must be moved to approved food-grade containers. Floors along wall bases and under equipment must be cleaned. Passed.

headline: Spoiled meat on display; mold; fly strips
summary: Numerous packages of meat were discolored and spoiled with black, brown, and green patches and displayed for sale; the manager was told to discard them. Fly strips hung in the basement produce prep area must be removed. Meat trays on the floor must be raised. Passed with conditions.

headline: Rat and mice droppings in basement; failed
summary: About 25 or more rat and mice droppings were found behind a tool cabinet, under a staircase, and near plastic bins in the basement. Droppings must be removed and areas sanitized, and pest control is recommended. Gaps under all doors and missing food-grade bags were also noted. Failed.

headline: No allergen training proof for food managers
summary: No proof of allergen training was on site for City-certified food managers. Management was instructed that all managers must complete allergen training and keep the certificate on site. Passed.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen training certificates
summary: Food handler training certificates have expired and must be updated. Food allergen training certificates have also expired and must be updated. Passed.

headline: Food containers not stored inverted
summary: Food containers were not stored properly and must be stored inverted. Passed.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; corrected on site
summary: Black slime buildup was found inside the ice machine that makes ice for customers. Management detail-cleaned the machine while on site, and the inspector instructed them to keep it free of buildup. Citation issued. Passed with conditions.

headline: Hair restraints missing; wood shelving and debris
summary: Multiple food handlers were not wearing hair restraints; the manager was instructed to ensure they do. Unfinished wood shelves and wicker baskets were noted. Food debris was found in cooling equipment, and the floors in the rear prep area were dirty. Passed.

headline: Unlabeled spice containers; crates used for storage
summary: Small dry storage, spice, and condiment containers were not labeled with their common name and must be labeled. Black milk crates were used to store ready-to-eat vegetables in coolers and must be replaced with smooth, cleanable containers. Passed.

headline: Walk-in cooler thermometer broken; restroom covers needed
summary: The thermometer on the outside of the walk-in cooler is in disrepair and must be repaired. The main bar handsink drains slowly. Women's restroom waste cans must have covers for feminine hygiene products. Passed.

headline: Missing labels, broken floors, and grease on walls
summary: Food storage containers and repackaged desserts lacked required labels. A splash guard is needed at the rear hand sink, and cardboard on the storage floor must be removed. Broken and loose floor tiles, a large floor opening under the ice machine, and grease on lower walls were noted. Passed on re-inspection.

headline: Wiping cloths not in sanitizer; cooler floor dirty
summary: Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. The floor inside the basement walk-in cooler around the tanks must be cleaned. Passed.

headline: Missing employee health policy; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site. The low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer and was told to be repaired. Also noted: a leak at a 3-compartment sink, an uncovered trash can, storage clutter, and allergen training needed. Passed with conditions.

headline: Spilled food residue in prep coolers
summary: Spilled food residue was found at the bottom of prep coolers in the front prep area. The inspector instructed the operator to clean and maintain them. Passed.

headline: No written employee health policy on site
summary: No written or signed employee health policy was on site for food and conditional employees. The operator must provide and maintain one, a priority foundation violation. Passed with conditions.

headline: Food debris on prep and cooler floors; clutter
summary: Food debris was on the floors throughout the prep area and in the walk-in coolers. The rear storage area had clutter and items on the floor. The person in charge was instructed to detail clean and keep items elevated. Passed.

headline: Ice machine debris; grease, foil, and mold
summary: Slight debris was in the ice machine, including the chute, and must be cleaned. Aluminum foil lined the surface above the burners and must be removed. Rolling carts and the warewash machine had heavy debris and lime buildup. Walls around the dish machine and sink had dirt and black mold-like substance. Passed.

headline: Items stored above sink; floors and training gaps
summary: Clean containers and utensils must not be stored directly above the 3-compartment sink. Stored items in the far rear storage must be raised off the floor. Floors in several areas had dirt and food spills. No proof of allergen training was provided for certified food managers. Passed.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; cleaning needed
summary: Expired food handler training certificates were found. All employees must obtain valid certificates. Also needed: additional cleaning of mixer tops, fryer bottoms, bulk containers, and floors under cooking equipment. Passed on complaint re-inspection.

headline: Door gap, damaged walls and floors, lighting issues
summary: A gap under the front door must be sealed. Crates used for food storage on the sales floor must be removed. Other items include damaged walls and floor tiles, stained ceiling tiles, dust, boxes stored on the floor, burnt-out lights, and a missing no-smoking sign. Passed.

headline: No certified manager on site; handwashing water cold
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site while chicken, sandwiches, and salads were being prepared. Handwash sink water was 83.4F, below the required 100F; it was ordered repaired. The dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer, was repaired on site, and was tagged. Failed.

headline: Flies on beef; no certified manager; 0 ppm sanitizer
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site when TCS foods were being prepared. Two large flies were on beef in an open pan in the walk-in cooler; the manager discarded 8 pounds ($55). Eight large flies were found throughout the facility. Dish machine showed 0 ppm and was tagged. Failed.

headline: No health policy or vomit kit; summary not posted
summary: No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea procedure and kit were on site; both are priority violations. Salt and sugar lacked labels, and wiping cloths were improperly stored. Heavy debris was under cooking equipment, and hood lights were broken. The inspection summary was not visible to the public. Passed with conditions.

headline: Rear door needs rodent proofing; grease and cleaning needed
summary: The rear door needs rodent proofing, but no insects or rodents were reported as present. Other issues: shelves, cooking equipment, a leaking 3-compartment sink faucet, a dirty women's restroom toilet, and dirty floors and walls in the prep area. Passed after complaint.

headline: Leaking pipe; allergen training; previous violation
summary: A pipe under the 3-compartment sink is leaking and must be repaired. The certified manager lacks allergen training, and a previous core violation was not corrected. A citation was issued. Passed with conditions.

headline: Ice buildup and freezer burn in display case
summary: Ice buildup was found on a shelf, and freezer burn was in the corners of a display case. Staff must remove the ice and keep the door shut between uses to prevent temperature changes. Passed after complaint.

headline: No certified manager on site; no employee health policy
summary: The person in charge lacked a City sanitation manager certificate while milk and beef were served, and no certificate was posted; a citation was issued. No employee health policy or vomit response supplies were on site. Hair restraint, glove change, raw wood, and food handler certificate issues were also found. Passed with conditions.

headline: Clogged handwash sink; hot water too hot
summary: An exposed handwash sink in the front hot prep area was clogged and not draining (citation). A prior priority violation was not corrected: women's washroom sinks ran at 121-126°F because of a mixing valve problem; the required range is 100-120°F (citation).

headline: Both toilets not flushing; missing thermometer
summary: Both toilets in the facility could not flush waste water and must be repaired (priority violation). No visible backflow device was found on the utility sink. A thermometer must be placed inside the small white cooler, and chemicals in storage and the office must be raised off the floor.

headline: Spills and grease at beverage station; dirty corners
summary: Spillage and food debris were found under the frozen beverage station and must be cleaned to prevent pests and insects. A light build-up of grease and dust was on cooking equipment, and milk spillage was inside a low reach-in cooler. Dirt and debris were found in corners of the rear storage and dish areas.

headline: Door gap, damaged restroom wall, allergen certificate missing
summary: A half-inch gap was found at the bottom of a rear dining room exterior door and must be repaired. A wall behind the women's restroom sink is damaged. No allergen training certificate was on site for the certified manager.

headline: Certificate missing; blocked handsink; insecticide in prep area
summary: Food employees lacked a posted city food sanitation certificate while TCS foods were stored (citation). A rear dish area handsink was blocked by boxes (citation). A consumer insect killer was found in the prep area and must be removed (citation).

headline: Sinks shut off too fast; dish racks on floor
summary: Handwash sinks in the kitchen entry prep area and dish area ran for less than 15 seconds and must provide at least 15 seconds of running water. Dish racks and pans were stored on the floor. Loose faucets, food debris, and wet mops in buckets were also found.

headline: Food and supplies on floor; leaking handsink drains
summary: Food items and single-service articles were stored on the floor in rear storage and must be raised six inches. Leaking drainpipes under the front and rear prep handsinks must be repaired. Food debris, grease in floor drains, and missing waste receptacles at handsinks were also noted.

headline: Prep area floors need detailed cleaning
summary: Floors throughout the prep areas need detailed cleaning around, under and behind all equipment to remove debris, spills and grease.

headline: Live flying insects found; prior violation uncorrected
summary: About 20 live small flying insects were found on walls and ceilings in the second-floor bar, prep and dining areas (citation). A prior priority violation was not corrected, and more pest control service is needed. Dish machine and walls also need cleaning.

headline: Wiping cloths improperly stored; missing bathroom shielding
summary: Dirty wiping cloths were left on prep tables and racks in rear prep areas and must be stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. Protective shielding is missing in the employees' bathroom and must be provided.

headline: Grease spills on floors under cooking equipment
summary: Grease spills were found on floors under cooking equipment. The facility must clean and maintain these floors.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths; unlabeled containers; floor debris
summary: Soiled wiping cloths were left on prep tables and must be stored in sanitizing solution between uses. Food storage containers must be labeled when food is not in its original container. Debris was found on floors along walls and corners in utility and storage areas.

headline: Sanitizer test strips missing; minor sink leak
summary: No test strips were on site to check the three-compartment sanitizer solution; the manager was told to obtain them. A minor leak was also found under the three-compartment sink drain line, to be repaired.

headline: No mop sink; mop water dumped in dish sink
summary: Mop bucket waste water was being disposed of in the three-compartment sink used for washing utensils. The facility has no mop sink, and one with a floor drain must be provided. An open drink was on the prep table, and a pizza station handsink faucet is hard to operate.

headline: Food handler certificates missing; several cleaning issues
summary: Multiple food handlers lacked food handler certificates. Handwashing signage was missing, food was stored on the walk-in floor, and grease and food debris were found on equipment and shelving.

headline: Dirty garbage cans and floors; training gaps
summary: Garbage cans had dirt on their exteriors in the food prep area, and floors throughout the facility had accumulated dirt. One new hire lacked a food handler certificate. A certified food manager lacked proof of allergen training.

headline: No soap, no hot water in washroom; corrected
summary: The deli handwash sink had no soap until the inspector asked (citation). Women's washroom water was 54-57°F; the manager repaired it and water reached 100.5°F during inspection (citation). Cardboard food containers, mineral buildup in the ice machine, and clogged display drains were also noted.

headline: Salad bar foods too warm; 24 lbs discarded
summary: Eggs, tuna salad, egg salad and chicken were held at 50-53°F inside the salad bar cooler. Staff voluntarily discarded 24 lbs (about $180). The cooler's air measured 34°F. Dish area debris and wall buildup also need cleaning.

headline: Missing allergen certificates; several labeling gaps
summary: No allergen certificates were on site for food managers, a repeat core violation from 2023 (citation). Dishwashing area handsink lacks signage, and bulk flour, sugar and rice have no labels. Undercooked-food menu disclosure is not properly written, and dishwashing floor grout is low.

headline: Dead roaches under prep table; broken thermometer
summary: Several dead roaches were found under the rear prep table and must be removed. A food thermometer was broken and was ordered replaced (citation). The waffle iron is heavily soiled, and grease and debris were found on cooking equipment, coolers, and walls.

headline: Wok cooler at 48°F; 7 lbs discarded
summary: Shrimp, shrimp wonton, chopped vegetables and BBQ pork were held at 47-48°F in the wok reach-in cooler. Staff voluntarily discarded 7 lbs (about $150). The cooler's air measured 48°F and must be repaired. A prep handwash sink pipe is leaking.

headline: Damaged and missing kitchen ceiling tiles
summary: Damaged and missing ceiling tiles were observed in the kitchen. The facility must replace and maintain them.

headline: Pot blocked handwash sink at front prep line
summary: A large pot was placed in a hand wash sink basin at the front prep line, making it obstructed. The manager was instructed to keep handwash sinks free of obstructions (priority violation).

headline: Food managers lack allergen training certificates
summary: No food allergen training certificates were available for food managers. Certified food managers must have allergen training certificates on file.

headline: No soap in restroom; ice cream dipper dirty
summary: No soap was at the employee restroom handsink (citation); the manager added it. The ice cream dipper well needs detail cleaning, and wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizing solution. Worn cutting boards, worn gaskets, greasy cooking equipment, and a leaking three-compartment sink faucet need correction.

headline: Cold food too warm; no hot water, restored on site
summary: Corn, pork and soft boiled eggs were held at 45.5-56.1°F; about 10 lbs ($70) was discarded and corrected on site. Undercooked egg menu warning was added on site. No hot water was found, but it was restored before the end of inspection.

headline: No certified manager; no hot water throughout
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were prepared and served (citation). Hot water was absent throughout the establishment; sink temperatures ranged 60-74°F. Plumbers were on site but hot water was not resolved in all sinks (priority violation). No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Leaking pipes in employee toilet; greasy floors
summary: Leaking pipes were observed above the lighting in the employee toilet room and must be repaired. The shelving under the flat-top cooking equipment has grease and debris. The floor behind the deep freezer and under cooking equipment also has grease and food debris.

headline: No soap during event; raw meat stored over food
summary: No soap was available at the main prep handsink during a large event with food being served (priority violation); an employee supplied soap during inspection. Raw beef was stored over cooked beef in the walk-in, and raw salmon was over salad (citation); the employee corrected this on site.

headline: Dirty floors under equipment and shelving
summary: The floors in the front food service area and the rear storage and dish washing area have dirt, food debris and other debris under and around equipment and shelving. The facility must clean and maintain all areas.

headline: Damaged cooler gasket; grime; mops not drying
summary: A damaged gasket was found on a deli cold holding unit, with food debris and grime inside. Mops were not hanging to dry, and an area must be provided for them.

headline: Handwash sink blocked by dishes; corrected on site
summary: A kitchen handwashing sink was blocked by dishes; the manager had the employee remove them during the inspection (citation). Calcium buildup was found inside the ice machine. Restroom receptacles were uncovered, and a certified manager lacked allergen training proof.

headline: No food handler training; no certified manager on site
summary: Person in charge lacked food safety management training. TCS foods were prepared without an original city certificate or certified manager on site (citation). Repeat finding: no food handler training was available for any employee.

headline: Pest records incomplete; prior repairs not made
summary: Pest control log book was not maintained; only one pest inspection report from May 2026 was on file, and at least two per year are required (citation). Previous cooler gasket and leaking sink repairs were not made.

headline: No food handler certificates; core violations uncorrected
summary: Utensils and single-service cups were stored in the toilet room, and an outside oil receptacle had grease buildup. Previous core violations were not corrected, including a lack of food handler certificates on site.

headline: No pest log book; repeat violations uncorrected
summary: No pest control log book was on site for review (citation). Trash and debris were found around dumpsters. Previous core violations were not corrected, including missing sink stoppers and drainboard, debris build-up, and no lidded garbage can in the customer restroom.

headline: Food and supplies on floor; torn cooler gasket
summary: Boxed food and single-service articles were stored on the floor in rear prep and storage areas and must be elevated. A two-door refrigerator in the rear prep area has a torn gasket. Dirt was found on floors and in corners, and employee belongings were stored in rear prep.

headline: Cooler at 60°F; 43 lbs of food discarded
summary: Raw chicken, eggs, dairy and other TCS foods were held at 47-57°F in a three-door cooler. About 43 lbs (approx. $1,000) was discarded (citation). The cooler's air measured 60°F and was tagged held. Dishware is too large for the sink, and food handler and allergen certificates were not on site.

headline: Repeat core violations uncorrected; dirty shelves and floors
summary: Previous core violations from September 2024 were not corrected, including food debris on dish machines, missing ceiling tiles, a missing floor drain cover, and black dirt on walls. Food and dust build-up on shelves and food and dirt on floors under equipment also need cleaning.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No City of Chicago food service manager was on site as required. A certified manager must be on duty whenever TCS foods are being prepared and served (priority violation, citation issued).

headline: Two units tagged held; cold food too warm
summary: The low-temperature dish machine had zero ppm sanitizer and was tagged held for inspection. The two-door cooler air measured 51.5°F and was tagged held. Cream cheese, milk and eggs were 44.6-48.8°F; about 20 lbs ($450) was discarded. The bar handsink also lacks signage.

headline: 50+ live roaches found; pest service required
summary: About 50 or more live roaches were found around the grease trap, inside the mop sink and three-compartment sink, on walls, and inside cardboard boxes. A pest control operator must service the premises on or after 4/14/26. Chest freezers need defrosting and boxes must be lifted off the floor.

headline: Gap at hand sink; floor cleaning needed
summary: An opening between floor and wall was found under the rear prep hand sink and must be sealed. The floor along the wall and in the corners of the rear prep area on the cafe side needs cleaning and maintenance.

headline: No certified manager on site; no food handler certificates
summary: No food employee with a city certified manager certificate was on site while TCS foods were prepared and served (citation). Cardboard was used as shelf liner, and no food handler certificates were on site. The food service sanitation manager also lacks allergen training.

headline: Multiple repairs needed; missing pizza thermometer
summary: Several items must be fixed: staff toilet handwash signage and a slow drain, a thermometer for the pizza hot-holding unit, labels on food containers, a tight pickup door gap, worn gaskets, and crates replaced with shelving. Floors, walls and ceilings also need repair.

headline: Door gap, damaged restroom, dirty warewashing walls
summary: A quarter-inch gap is at the bottom of the east double exit doors and must be made tight-fitting. A missing splashguard in the venue bar, an employee restroom in poor repair, and black buildup near the warewashing unit must be addressed. Dim lighting and missing light shields were noted.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure; leaking sink pipe
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies were on premises; the manager must provide them (no citation). The mop sink lacks a visible backflow device, and the washroom handwash sink pipe is leaking and must be repaired.

headline: Toilet needed cleaning; missing cold-unit thermometer
summary: Dried bodily fluid was found on the women's toilet seat and fixtures; the facility was told to clean and maintain them. No ambient air thermometer was inside the cold holding units; one must be provided.

headline: Cold handwash water; multiple broken fixtures
summary: Handwash sink water measured 72-73°F in several kitchens, below the required 100°F (priority violation). Toilets in the women's washroom and a urinal in the men's washroom do not work. A prep sink and a three-compartment sink drain pipe leak, and two high-temperature dish machines must be removed.

headline: 20-30 mouse droppings in rear storage
summary: About 20-30 mouse droppings were found along wall bases in rear storage, and 10-12 in the front prep area (citation). The facility must clean, sanitize, and contact pest control. Cooler door tracks, cutting boards, cooking equipment and washroom fixtures also need cleaning.

headline: Scoops in standing water; no allergen certificate
summary: Ice cream scoops were kept in a container of standing water at room temperature and must be stored according to the health code. The food service manager has no allergen certification and was instructed to obtain one.

headline: Beard restraint needed; excessive freezer ice
summary: A food handler with a beard was not wearing a beard restraint. Equipment was stored on the floor in rear prep. Peeling paint was found on a door between the bakery and warewashing area, and deep freezers had excessive ice buildup.

headline: No employee health policy; thermometer missing
summary: No written employee health policy was on premises (priority violation). A visible working thermometer is required for the hot-holding equipment. Rust was found on walk-in wire racks, and light bulbs inside the hot-holding equipment must be shielded or shatter-proof.

headline: No certified manager; cold food too warm
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while food was prepared and served (citation). Lamb, fish and pasta in the cooler were 48.5-50.5°F; about 25 lbs was discarded. Cooler repair ordered. No vomit cleanup kit. Hand soap was missing, then supplied during inspection.

headline: Wastewater backs up onto floor; propane stored on site
summary: Wastewater was backing up from the grease interceptor onto the floor when the three-compartment sink drained (citation). Ice buildup was found on the meat display cooler's condenser. Propane tanks were stored on site, which is prohibited, and must be removed.

headline: Heavy plumbing leak under meat prep sink
summary: A heavy leak was found at the drain beneath the four-compartment sink in the meat and seafood prep area. A pest control report from December 2025 had already noted standing water and recommended eliminating plumbing leaks.

headline: Rusted walk-in shelving; allergen training missing
summary: Rusted shelving was found in the first-floor walk-in coolers and must be repainted or replaced. Heavy soil and debris were in a coffee shop floor drain. A certified food manager lacks allergen training, and the facility operates two restaurants.

headline: Wiping cloths, rust, and dirty floors
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored properly in the prep area and must be kept in sanitizing solution. Rust was found on walk-in storage racks, and food, dirt and grease were on racks and fryer interiors. Floors in the walk-in freezer and cooler need cleaning.

headline: Leaking washroom sink; minor floor debris
summary: A leak was found at the toilet room handwash sink and must be repaired. Minor debris was found on floors throughout the sales and food prep areas; the facility must clean and sanitize them.

headline: Over 50 rat droppings found in storage areas
summary: Over 50 rat droppings were found along wall bases in dry storage and basement equipment storage (citation). The facility must clean, sanitize and consult a pest control company for treatment. A slimy substance was also found in the soda dispenser.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; pork undated; fly traps
summary: Black slime was found above ice in the basement ice machine bin (citation). Pork in the walk-in had a prep date but no discard date (citation). Food was stored on the floor, and fly traps were mounted above food and utensils and must be removed (citation).

headline: Cooked meats too warm; 25 lbs discarded
summary: Cooked beef at 60.8°F and cooked goat at 58°F were found in a two-door refrigerator because they were improperly cooled. About 25 lbs ($380) was discarded (citation). The front entrance doors were not fully rodent-proofed and must be sealed.

headline: Mold on sauces; about 8 live cockroaches found
summary: Green and black mold-like growth was found on tzatziki sauce and relish; the items were discarded (citation). About 8 live cockroaches were found in several areas, and glue traps held many roaches. Mold was also found inside a cooler and ventilation hood grease needs cleaning.

headline: Dead and live roaches found throughout facility
summary: Dead roaches were found throughout the front and rear of the facility. Three live roaches were seen on the floor and table, and two live small flies were in the prep area (priority violation). A pest control operator must service the premises on or after 12/3/25.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving in prep areas
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving throughout the prep and storage areas. They must be removed, and shelving placed at least six inches off the floor for cleaning access.

headline: About 60 mouse droppings in multiple areas
summary: About 60 mouse droppings were found along walls and under shelves in front prep, rear storage and near the mop sink (citation). The facility must clean, sanitize and contact a licensed pest control company. Grocery bags were used in the walk-in and freezer.

headline: About 100 mouse droppings and many violations
summary: About 100 or more mouse droppings were found in the rear area, on shelving, a refrigerator, and behind the toilet room's hot water tank (priority violation). Doors have gaps, and there is no signed health policy, no handsink in the toilet room, no mop sink, and no garbage contract.

headline: Walk-in freezer not running; no health policy
summary: No written employee health policy was on premises (citation). The walk-in freezer was not running and must be repaired (citation). A half-inch gap under the front door must be closed, and washroom doors must self-close. Waste receptacles and a ceiling opening also need attention.

headline: No pest control records; no hot water at sinks
summary: No current pest control was on site; a log book and at least two pest inspections per year are required (citation). Several sinks had no hot water, with hot water measured at 47.3°F (priority violation, citation issued). A leaking pipe in the utility closet and peeling restroom paint also need repair.

headline: 40 mouse droppings found in rear storage
summary: About 40 mouse droppings were found along walls in rear storage areas (citation). The facility must remove them, clean and notify its pest control operator. Handwashing signage, dry storage cleaning and sanitation manager allergen training are also required.

headline: Ice scoops on machine; washroom needs repairs
summary: Ice scoops were stored on top of the ice machine and must be kept in a clean container. A men's washroom handwash sink drains slowly, and the unisex washroom lacks a covered waste receptacle and self-closing door. Dust, soiled mop heads, and grease on hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Cooler at 52°F tagged; dead cockroaches found
summary: The main line reach-in cooler held at 52°F and was tagged as held for inspection; it must not be used until repaired and reinspected. About five dead cockroaches were found in rear equipment storage. Other items include unlabeled bulk scoops and foil lining.

headline: Grocery bags in cooler; boiler room clutter
summary: Grocery bags were used for food storage inside a kitchen reach-in cooler and must not be. The rear boiler room floor needs detail cleaning. Clutter in rear storage and the boiler room must be removed to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: Missing grease trap and sink stoppers
summary: The three-compartment sink lacks sink stoppers. A grease trap for the facility could not be located and must be provided. Raw wood walls in the front service area used for smoothie prep must be sealed and made smooth and easily cleanable.

headline: Ice machine door and cooler gaskets need cleaning
summary: The ice machine's interior door needs cleaning. Buildup was found on the gaskets and shelving of a three-door cooler. The person in charge must clean and maintain both.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; back door ajar
summary: The back door was found cracked open and must be kept closed. Diced tomatoes were stored in direct contact with ice. Dish racks and pots were stored on the floor, and food residue and fan guard dust need cleaning. Several certificates were expired.

headline: No health policy; chicken thawed at room temperature
summary: No written employee health policy was on premises (citation). A case of chicken was thawing at room temperature in the prep area. An ashtray with cigarette butts was found in the office (citation). Salad cooler gaskets were torn, and grease was on the floor.

headline: No grease trap; dirty trap; several cleaning items
summary: No grease trap was on premises for the three-compartment sink and must be provided. A dirty grease trap was found in the basement storage area. Other items include missing handwash signs, unlabeled bulk food, a serving tong in coleslaw, and ice buildup in the walk-in freezer.

headline: Leaking sink pipe; missing signage; dirty walls
summary: Handwashing signage was missing at the sink by the smoker. The pipe under the three-compartment sink leaks, and metal panels above it are loose. Wash bowls need recaulking, and floors, walls and vents in prep and restroom areas have dirt and dust buildup.

headline: Raw meat stored near ready-to-eat food; cooler too warm
summary: Raw hamburgers were stored next to ready-to-eat tortillas, and eggs next to pickles (citation). A front cooler held TCS foods at 49.9°F; it was adjusted to 39.6°F during inspection. About 22 lbs ($100) was discarded. An overflowing outside dumpster was cited.

headline: Uncovered food; no food handler training
summary: Food was uncovered in the walk-in cooler, and employees had open beverage containers on the prep table. Food spills and debris were found on prep tables, coolers and cooking equipment. Dust, light shields and floors need cleaning, and food handler training is missing for employees.

headline: Certified manager missing; dead insects found
summary: Person in charge lacked the original city certificate while TCS foods were handled (citation). No employee health verification was available, and dead insects were found in light shields. Food handler and allergen training proof was also missing.

headline: Missing cooler thermometers; clutter and broken tiles
summary: Thermometers must be provided for coolers holding milk, polish sausage and bacon. Floor tiles are broken and missing in rear storage. Unused equipment, crates and trash were stored there and in the backyard, and a hole in a wall must be enclosed.

headline: Greasy hood, loose sink, broken door closer
summary: Walk-in cooler floors and shelving need detail cleaning, and fryers have grease buildup. The rear handwash sink is loose from the wall, and the rear toilet door's self-closing device is broken. Hood filters are greasy, and the walk-in has low lighting.

headline: Door openings could let pests in; ice buildup
summary: Several openings were found at the rear and front entrance doors and must be sealed to keep pests out. Bug lights were installed above a wrapping machine and single-use equipment, and must be moved or reinstalled. Ceiling tiles and ice buildup also need attention.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; leaking sink faucet
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at three hand sinks, including the restroom and the main prep area. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks at the base when water is turned on and must be serviced.

headline: Live flies found; cooler at 48.9°F; no certified manager
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were handled (citation). About 20 or more live small flies were found on menu boards, walls and inside a floor drain. The vegetable prep cooler held foods at 48.9°F and was tagged held (citation).

headline: Improper thawing; food on floor; no hair restraints
summary: Frozen meats were thawing on a shelf at room temperature, and packets of TCS foods sat in still water on a drainboard. Food was stored on floors. Two food handlers lacked hair restraints. Thermometers were stored inside cold units.

headline: About 25 mouse droppings and dead mice found
summary: About 25 or more mouse droppings were found at the front counter and along the west wall (citation). Two dead mice were on a glue board. A gap under the front door must be sealed. Labels, cutting boards, rust and debris also need attention.

headline: 50+ mouse droppings; no vomit cleanup kit
summary: Over 50 mouse droppings were found in rear prep and storage areas (citation). The facility must clean and have pest control service before reinspection. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was on premises. Standing water with a foul odor was found in the walk-in.

headline: No certified manager; slimy ice machine; dog on site
summary: Food handlers prepared TCS foods without a certified manager on site (citation). Pink and black slime was found in the front ice machine, dripping onto ice; it was cleaned during inspection (citation). A dog jumping on the front counter was removed during inspection (citation).

headline: Frozen chicken stored in grocery bags
summary: Frozen chicken was stored in grocery bags in the freezer. Management was instructed to use only proper food-grade storage bags and containers.

headline: Food under condensation drip; freezer ice buildup
summary: Food on shelves in the bakery walk-in was stored beneath a condensate drip and must be relocated. Heavy ice and dust buildup was observed in basement walk-in freezers and must be cleaned at adequate frequency.

headline: Cooler interiors dirty; soda station leaking
summary: Reach-in cooler interiors need cleaning to remove food spills and buildup. A leak was found at the box soda station. The outside waste area and floors under the POP station also need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager 8:15-9 AM; light fixtures
summary: No certified manager was on site from 8:15 to 9 AM while breakfast sausage was prepared (citation). An unprotected glass bulb is above the handsink, and burnt-out bulbs are in the walk-in hallway. The manager must be on site at all times.

headline: Dirty fryers, soda dispensers, and floor drains
summary: Soda dispensers have dried splatter and must be cleaned to prevent insect activity. Fryer sides and prep tables need detailed cleaning. Floor under the dishwasher, a front service drain, and ventilation vents have dirt and dust buildup.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food containers
summary: Bulk food items were stored in containers that were not properly labeled. Management was instructed to label all bulk and working ingredient containers with their contents name.

headline: Missing vomit cleanup kit, pest log, and dumpster
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit with spill supplies was found; the facility must provide one. No pest control log book was on site, no mop sink had a vacuum breaker, and no outside dumpster was on premises. Several of these must be provided.

headline: Three-compartment sink leaking; grimy rear wall
summary: The three-compartment sink faucet leaks at its base, and its right-side compartment drain pipe leaks as well. The manager must repair and maintain the sink. Food grime on the wall by the rear exit door must be cleaned.

headline: Unlabeled foods; no pest contract; no mop sink
summary: Packaged spices and frozen meats were unlabeled. The pest control book listed an old address and a contract for the current location is required (citation). No mop sink or commercial dumpster was on premises (citation); holes were found in shower walls.

headline: Pass with conditions; pizza cooler too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. Pizza cold-hold cooler measured 49F; must be repaired to 41F or below (citation issued). Cooler tagged and held by CDPH. Hole in rear window screen. No ambient air thermometer in pizza hot holding.

headline: Passed; food on floors, wet wiping cloths
summary: Passed. Food containers stored on walk-in cooler, prep, and storage floors; must be elevated at least six inches. Wet wiping cloths on several prep surfaces; must be stored in sanitizing solution between uses.

headline: Failed; about 30 rat droppings and no manager
summary: Failed. About 30 rat droppings in basement food storage room; eliminate activity and use pest control (citation issued). No certified manager on site. Cooked food held over 24 hours undated. No probe thermometer or sanitizer test device. Staff eating in prep area.

headline: Passed re-inspection; missing handwashing signs and rust
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign at a rear handsink. Rust on prep table bottoms and residue on walk-in cooler shelving. Peeling paint near the three-compartment sink. Person in charge told to fix each item.

headline: Re-inspection passed; dirty ice bin and cutting boards
summary: Passed. Top inside of ice bin not clean; food handlers lacked hair restraints. Cutting boards deeply cut and stained. Plastic bags used as sink stoppers. Grease under fryers. Clutter in basement storage rooms, including unused cooler.

headline: Passed; restroom door and sales floor debris
summary: Passed. Restroom door lacks a self-closing device. Debris on sales floor between shelves. Person in charge instructed to install the device and clean.

headline: Pass with conditions; no certificate, expired allergen proof
summary: Passed with conditions. No person on site with an original city sanitation certificate posted (citation issued). Prior core violation not corrected: no allergen training certificate on site for certified managers (citation issued).

headline: Passed; ice scoops, stored items, missing training proof
summary: Passed. Ice scoops must be kept in a clean container, not on the ice machine. Stored items must be elevated. Water-damaged washroom ceiling tiles must be replaced. No proof of food handler or manager allergen training. Tinfoil wall liner must be removed.

headline: Failed; about 25 live flying insects
summary: Failed. About 25 live small flying insects on walls and ceilings in basement dry storage, food prep, dish area, and behind the bar. Additional pest control needed (citation issued). Bar drinks and a chest freezer stored under sewage lines must be moved or wrapped.

headline: Re-inspection passed; wiping cloths and greasy floor
summary: Passed. No handwashing signs near front or rear food prep sinks. Wiping cloths stored on top of prep tables. Grease and dirt buildup on floor under and behind cooking equipment. No allergen training certificates on premises.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing signs and grease
summary: Passed. No handwashing signs near sushi prep and rear food prep handsinks. Ice scoops stored inside ice machine must be kept in a clean container. Grease buildup on floor behind cooking equipment and around pipes.

headline: Passed; greasy fryers and cloths not stored in sanitizer
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizing solution. Fryer interiors have thick grease and dirt. Reach-in coolers and freezers have food and blood spills. Faucet base leaks at three-compartment sink. Blown light bulbs in rear prep area.

headline: Passed; missing thermometer and door gap
summary: Passed. Missing thermometer at front prep cooler by handsink. Rear exit door has a gap of about 1/4 inch at top and bottom. Small leak at three-compartment sink faucet. Utility sink faucet in disrepair. Raw wood door frame needs sealing.

headline: Failed; about 30 mouse droppings in basement
summary: Failed. About 30 mouse droppings scattered in basement near chest freezers. Person in charge must remove them, sanitize, and inform pest control (citation issued). Four-compartment sink lacks splash guard. Grime on dishwashing wall.

headline: Failed; leaking and cold handsinks, dish machine held
summary: Failed. One prep handsink leaked and was out of use. Another ran at 65-70F instead of 100F (priority citation). Soap and towels were corrected on site. A low-temperature dish machine at 0 ppm sanitizer was tagged and held by CDPH.

headline: Failed; no manager, warm coolers, no training
summary: Failed. No person in charge or valid sanitation certificate (citation issued). No employee health policy. Coolers at 48.3-52.19F, above the 41F limit. No metal stem thermometer or sanitizer test kit. No food handler training. No no-smoking signs.

headline: Pass with conditions; no certified person in charge
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge with valid Chicago food sanitation certificate, and no certificate posted (citation issued). Prior core violation not corrected: no food handler training for employees (citation issued).

headline: Failed; undated food discarded, dish machine temperature
summary: Failed. Ready-to-eat TCS foods held over 24 hours without discard date; manager had them discarded (citation issued). Dish machine gauge read 150F while internal gauge read 161.5F. Grease container area thickly greasy. Holes in walls must be sealed.

headline: Passed; restroom sinks and open fryers
summary: Passed. Two of three women's restroom handsinks don't work properly; water shuts off automatically. No handwashing signs behind the bar or in rear prep area. Two deep fryers left uncovered. Ice scoop stored on ice machine. Manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Re-inspection passed; opening at entrance, condenser leak
summary: Passed. Opening at base of front entrance doors to be sealed. Coffee machine lacks a backflow prevention device. Water leaking from seafood walk-in cooler condenser must be repaired.

headline: Flies and rodent droppings found; no valid manager certificate
summary: About 30 or more flies in butcher and meat processing areas, and 40 rodent droppings on the processing room floor. Pest control service required before reinspection. No valid city food manager certificate on site. Citations issued.

headline: Passed complaint; dirty soda nozzles and dining floor
summary: Passed. Soda machine nozzles not clean. Dining room floor by the washroom not clean. Must clean both and maintain.

headline: Passed with conditions; no employee health policy
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy on site (priority violation). Missing coving under the three-compartment sink and in the utility room. Clutter in the walk-in cooler and prep area. Dirt and debris on prep and utility room floors.

headline: Passed; stained color-coded cutting boards
summary: Passed. Some color-coded cutting boards in the kitchen food prep area are stained. Staff told to resurface or replace them and maintain.

headline: Passed re-inspection; slight debris noted
summary: Passed. Slight debris in cabinets under the counter and the two-compartment sink in the food prep area. Slight debris on floors in the paper goods and mop sink closets. Staff told to clean and maintain these areas.

headline: Pass with conditions; no certified manager, heavy debris
summary: Passed with conditions. No city-certified manager on site while beef, pork, eggs, and rice were prepared (citation issued). Heavy dried food debris on equipment and cabinets. Leaks on two-compartment sink piping. Dirty toilets. Peeling, moldy ceiling attachments. Poor lighting in prep areas.

headline: Re-inspection passed; health policy and handsink signs
summary: Passed. No employee health policy on site (priority violation). Handwashing sign needed at rear dish area handsink. Backflow prevention device on ice machine could not be located. Person in charge instructed to provide or locate each item.

headline: Pass with conditions; no certified manager, cold items
summary: Passed with conditions. Person in charge lacked valid certificate while chicken and other TCS foods were handled (citation issued). Ice buildup in walk-in freezer. Steam table drain misses floor drain. Floors under equipment and in walk-in need cleaning. Manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Re-inspection passed; uncovered food and greasy floors
summary: Passed. Food containers uncovered in coolers and prep areas; manager told to cover all. Food debris, dust, and grease buildup on floors under equipment, along walls, and in corners in prep, storage, serving, and dining areas.

headline: Failed; pest control log not on site
summary: Failed. No pest control log book or required pest documentation on site. Instructed to provide the log and all required documentation (priority violation).

headline: Failed; no health policy, thermometer, or training proof
summary: Failed. No written employee health policy (citation issued). No metal stem thermometer for TCS food temperatures (citation issued). No proof of food handler training. Front bar handsink lacked hot water (citation issued). Wet wiping cloths left on prep surfaces.

headline: Failed; no certified manager, blocked handsink
summary: Failed. No certified food manager present while chicken, steak, and fish were prepared (citation issued). Lunch tray, blender, and notebooks blocked a handsink; removed during inspection. Oysters lacked shellstock tag. No sanitizer test strips. No allergen training.

headline: Passed; food handlers without hair restraints
summary: Passed. Food handlers were preparing food without hair restraints. Person in charge told all food handlers must wear them. Hood and filters above cooking equipment need cleaning of dust and grease.

headline: Failed; 100-150 live flies, no vomit cleanup kit
summary: Failed. About 100-150 live small black flying insects in the kitchen and basement, mainly dry storage and rear storage. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit (citation issued). Missing ceiling section over basement dry storage. Heavy grease under deep fryers.

headline: Failed; no certified manager and no health policy
summary: Failed. Person in charge lacked certificate and none posted while taco meat, corn, and milk were handled (citation issued). No signed employee health policy. One of two kitchen handsinks not working. No food handler training for employees.

headline: Re-inspection passed; residue and grime in coolers
summary: Passed. Residue and food debris inside reach-in coolers and bar storage cabinet. Excessive debris, food residue, and grease on floors and walls in kitchen, bar, dry storage, and chemical storage. Staff told to clean and maintain.

headline: Failed; rodent droppings and expired manager certificate
summary: Failed. About 20-30 rodent droppings behind cooking equipment in prep area; remove, add pest service (citation issued). Expired manager certificate while TCS foods prepared. Unmarked ready-to-eat food discarded. No vomit cleanup supplies and no backflow device.

headline: Passed; labeling, storage, and floor repairs
summary: Passed. Packaged foods need business name, address, ingredients, and allergen warnings. Bulk foods need common names. Scoops must not be stored submerged; utensils held in 79.3F water. Cutting board in poor repair. Missing floor coving and torn cooler gasket.

headline: Pass with conditions; no certified manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager on site while potatoes, pork, and eggs were prepared; citation issued. An employee lacked a hair restraint, and another had an expired food handler certificate. A torn cooler gasket and rusty wire shelving noted.

headline: Failed complaint; no manager on duty, hygiene lapses
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on duty while TCS foods were handled; manager arrived at 10:57 a.m. A food handler touched food and utensils without washing hands after using her phone. An active leak dripped onto stored food in rear storage. Citations issued.

headline: Re-inspection passed; broken freezer gasket
summary: Passed. Broken rubber gasket at walk-in freezer door. Foil liner on kitchen storage racks to remove. Shelves and rack need additional cleaning. Food handlers without training proof must complete an approved program. Certified manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: Passed; opening at bottom of rear door
summary: Passed. An opening at the bottom of the rear exit door. Instructed to repair and maintain.

headline: Pass with conditions; wastewater backing up at deli
summary: Passed with conditions. Wastewater backing up through a floor drain near deli handsink (priority citation issued). Leaking sprayer, leaking backflow device, and leaking toilet. Food debris on equipment, sinks, and cabinets. Mop heads stored on floor.

headline: Re-inspection passed; rear door gap and mop sink
summary: Passed. Outermost rear door has a 1/4-inch gap at bottom; install a door sweep. Mop sink not hooked up to water line. Gaps at baseboard across from mop sink. No proof of food handler training.

headline: Passed; dusty cooler condenser
summary: Passed. Accumulated dust on pizza reach-in cooler condenser. Must clean the condenser and maintain.

headline: Failed; no paper towels, hair restraints, greasy hood
summary: Failed. No paper towels at an exposed main kitchen handsink; provided by end of inspection (citation issued). Employees lacked hair restraints. Wiping cloths on prep tables. Heavy grease on hood and filters. Dirty floor drains. Prior violations not corrected.

headline: Passed license; splash guards and exposed pipes
summary: Passed. Splash guards missing at bar handsinks. Employee restroom door not self-closing. Exposed ventilation, pipes, and utility lines above prep and warewashing areas; ceilings must be smooth and easily cleanable.

headline: Passed re-inspection; expired training and grease buildup
summary: Passed. Wet wiping cloths left on prep tables and plates not inverted. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment and walls. Expired food handler certificates and no allergen training on site. Missing ceiling tiles and burnt-out hood lights.

headline: Failed; no health policy, sanitizer, or hot water
summary: Failed. No employee health policy and no pest control log book on site. Dishes washed at three-compartment sink without sanitizer. No hot running water at prep handsinks, three-compartment sink, or washrooms (priority citation). No menu consumer advisory for raw foods.

headline: Failed; raw-food advisory missing, sink leak, dirty walls
summary: Failed. Menu lacked a consumer advisory for raw or undercooked steak items (no citation issued). Splash guards missing at utility and handsinks. Leaking drainpipe under three-compartment sink. Stained ceiling tiles. Unsealed and dusty surfaces noted.

headline: Pass with conditions; cold water, unsafe food temperatures
summary: Passed with conditions. Handsinks lacked hot water (56-60F); plumber restored 100F by the end. Sausages at 50-62F, catfish at 109F, and potatoes at 104F were discarded. Sausage cooler repaired during inspection. Deli meats and cheeses lacked date marking.

headline: Pass with conditions; cold-held food too warm, units tagged
summary: Passed with conditions. Cooked beef at 72.3F, eggs at 62.3F, and chorizo at 55.4F in prep cooler; about 18 lbs ($135) discarded (citation issued). Two cold-holding units tagged and off-limits until repaired and reinspected by CDPH.

headline: Passed; holes in walls and moldy storage racks
summary: Passed. Thermometer needed in reach-in cooler under oven. Green mold-like buildup on walk-in cooler storage racks. Holes in walls around rear prep and behind mop sink need sealing. Food handlers lack proof of training certificates.

headline: Passed re-inspection; cloth storage and cardboard floors
summary: Passed. A green wiping cloth was stored on a handsink splash guard; cloths must be kept in sanitizing buckets. Broken cardboard boxes were used as floor coverings in the front prep area. Staff told to replace them with non-slip mats.

headline: Passed; leaking three-compartment sink and training gaps
summary: Passed. Rear three-compartment sink has multiple leaks and must be repaired. Interior bottom shelves of reach-in freezers need debris removed. Manager told to meet food handler training requirements or citations will follow.

headline: Passed; labeling, shelving, and restroom door fixes
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs needed in two washrooms. Food storage containers need labels such as flour and salt. Shelving should be 6 inches off the floor, with no milk crates. Beef broth must move from an open can to food-grade container. Women's restroom door needs a self-closing device.

headline: Passed; unlabeled spices and leak under prep sink
summary: Passed. Spices out of packaging lacked labels. Wiping cloths stored on cutting board. Egg rolling machine needs written cleaning procedure. Leak under rear prep handsink. No covered receptacle in toilet room. Manager lacks allergen proof.

headline: Passed; no cooler thermometer, dim lighting
summary: Passed. No thermometer inside front prep line cooler. Small unlabeled containers in rear. Torn walk-in cooler door gasket. Dishwasher needs detail cleaning inside and out. Dim lighting inside walk-in cooler.

headline: Passed complaint; dusty shelving and dirty floors
summary: Passed. Shelving throughout the facility has a buildup of dust and dirt. Floor under shelving units has dirt, dust, and debris. Staff instructed to clean and maintain all areas.

headline: Re-inspection passed; deep fryers need cleaning
summary: Passed. Inspector required cleaning of the interior and exterior of the deep fryers.

headline: Passed; peeling paint and floor coating
summary: Passed. Chipped paint and peeling wall base in dining room and dry storage. Chipping dining room floor coating. Clutter on floor in rear storage must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Passed re-inspection; hair restraints corrected on site
summary: Passed. Bulk storage containers were unlabeled. Food handlers without proper hair restraints were corrected on site. A leak under the front serving area one-compartment sink needs fixing. Cluttered storage, dirty floors, and damaged wall base also noted.

headline: Pass with conditions; missing soap and towels
summary: Passed with conditions. Soap missing at front bar handsink and paper towels missing at food prep handsinks; both were supplied on site (citation issued). Shellstock tags were off containers and reattached on site. Bulk dry containers unlabeled.

headline: Re-inspection passed; door gaps and dirty coolers
summary: Passed. Outer openings not protected and a gap at the front entrance door. Interiors of prep coolers have dirt and debris. Floor under syrup machine in rear storage is dirty. Staff told to clean and maintain.

headline: Re-inspection passed; food handler without certificate
summary: Passed. A food handler worked in the kitchen without a food handler certificate. Management instructed that all food handlers must show proof. No allergen training certificates posted for certified managers.

headline: Failed; cold-held foods at 46-68F, grease, openings
summary: Failed. Ribeye, head cheese, pork roll, and liver pate at 46-68F in prep cooler; about 40 lbs ($250) discarded (citation issued). Overflowing dumpster. Three large openings in wall under dish sink. Burnt-out hood lights. Prior labeling and allergen violations not corrected.

headline: Failed; about 50 mouse droppings and cold-holding failures
summary: Failed. About 50 mouse droppings across prep, office, and lobby floors; pest control recommended (citation issued). Cooked foods at 46-55F discarded and a prep cooler at 50F tagged. No certified manager on site. Hot water failure at employee handsink.

headline: Passed; clutter on rear storage closet floor
summary: Passed. Clutter stored on the floor in the rear storage closet. Manager instructed to remove unused articles and equipment to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Failed; no certificate posted, mold in ice machine
summary: Failed. No city food sanitation certificate posted; a certified manager must be present with it when TCS foods are handled. Mold-like growth inside the ice machine. Edamame and raw beef thawed at room temperature. No metal probe thermometer. Citations issued.

headline: Passed; no waste receptacle at handsinks
summary: Passed. No waste receptacle at handwashing sinks. Manager instructed to provide one in all areas where waste is commonly discarded.

headline: Failed re-inspection; no manager, no health policy
summary: Failed. No person in charge present and no sanitation certificate while chicken and deli meat handled (citation issued). No employee health policy or training. Heavy clutter and food debris under dish machine. Prior ice machine and allergen violations not corrected.

headline: Re-inspection passed; leaks, milk crates, damaged floors
summary: Passed. Single-service items must be inverted. Milk crates used as shelving must be removed. Debris and spills on coolers and prep tables. Leaking three-compartment sink faucet. Missing and damaged floor tiles. No light inside walk-in cooler.

headline: Re-inspection passed; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. Manager on duty lacked an allergen training certificate. Instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: Passed; corn covered tightly while cooling
summary: Passed. Corn, a food that must be kept hot or cold (TCS), was covered with a tight plastic lid while cooling in an upright freezer. Staff told to keep it loosely covered or uncovered while cooling so heat can escape.

headline: Passed license; health policy and cleanup procedure missing
summary: Passed. No employee health policy. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or spill kit. No backflow device for basement mop sink. City sanitation manager lacks allergen training. No citations issued; items must be provided.

headline: Re-inspection failed; rust inside ice machine
summary: Failed. Rust on the upper interior of the ice machine used for human consumption. Ice must be destroyed and the machine cleaned and sanitized (citation issued). Milk crates used to elevate boxes in small storage room. Stained ceiling tiles in rear prep area.

headline: Passed; missing signage and thermometers
summary: Passed. No handwashing signage in washroom. No ambient air thermometers in reach-in display cooler or walk-in cooler. Food stored in plastic grocery bags in walk-in cooler. Dirt and debris on washroom exhaust vent.

headline: Passed; ice machine buildup, no allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Slight buildup inside ice machine must be cleaned. No food allergen training certificate provided for the food manager. Certified food managers must have allergen training.

headline: Passed; greasy fryers and cracked floor tile
summary: Passed. Grease at the bottom rear of fryers. One cracked floor tile by grill with water pooling. Floors under and behind cooking equipment need cleaning. Floor drain under the salad prep sink needs cleaning.

headline: Passed; walk-in cooler lacks thermometer
summary: Passed. No thermometer provided for the walk-in cooler. Instructed to install one.

headline: Failed; about 30 flies and no allergen training
summary: Failed. About 30 small flies found near dry storage, rear storage onions, and basement sinks. Pest control consulted; citation issued. Food in coolers and dry storage lacked name labels. Dead insects in corners. No certified manager with allergen training.

headline: Passed; greasy hood, rust, and leaking urinal
summary: Passed. Hood system has grease buildup. Two-door refrigerator gaskets broken. Large opening around vent pipe above three-compartment sink; must be sealed. Rust on refrigerator shelving. Men's urinal leaks when flushed.

headline: Failed license; no hot water and no health policy
summary: Failed. No verifiable employee health policy on site (citation issued). No hand soap at prep handsink and no sanitizer test devices. Hot water measured 73.5-78.5F at handsinks, 95.7F at three-compartment sink; 100F and 110F are required. Torn freezer gasket.

headline: Passed; lead-safety cups and unsealed raw wood
summary: Passed. Ceramic drinking cups on site must be shown lead-safe or removed. Raw wood surfaces in front and rear prep areas need sealing. Unfinished wall beside utility sink needs sealing. Excess food debris in the three-compartment sink floor drain.

headline: Passed; ice machine buildup and missing sink signs
summary: Passed. Slight buildup on side of ice machine. No wash, rinse, and sanitize signage on the three-compartment sink. Grime and residue on wire shelving in walk-in cooler. Person in charge told to clean and add signage.

headline: Re-inspection passed; slight fryer grease
summary: Passed. Slight grease buildup on the side of the deep-frying unit. Instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Pass with conditions; raw food stored above produce
summary: Passed with conditions. Prep line cooler top removed and food uncovered. Raw whole fish, shrimp, and oysters stored above lettuce and avocados in walk-in cooler (citation issued). Heavily stained cutting boards. Leaking air conditioner above three-compartment sink.

headline: Passed complaint; ice buildup and torn gasket
summary: Passed. Ice buildup on the walk-in cooler floor and shelves. Staff told to repair and maintain the condensation units. A torn rubber gasket on the service prep cooler door needs repair.

headline: Re-inspection passed; drain buildup behind bar
summary: Passed. Buildup in bar area drain under the three-compartment sink. Person in charge instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Passed; food handler certificates not found
summary: Passed. Inspector could not locate or verify food handler certificates during inspection. Staff must provide and keep certificates on site.

headline: Passed; thawing, hair restraint and sink problems noted
summary: Passed. Food that must be kept cold (TCS) was thawing in standing sink water. Some female food handlers lacked hair restraints. Expired food handler certificates, a slow-draining handwashing sink, and a leaking rainwater setup were noted. Manager instructed to correct.

headline: Re-inspection passed; grease, signage, and toilet items
summary: Passed. No handwashing signage in front toilet room. Reach-in cooling units need detail cleaning. Heavy grease and food debris on cooking equipment. No covered toilet receptacles and staff toilet lacks self-closing door. Dirty floors and walls under equipment.

headline: Failed; cold foods too warm, trash overflowing
summary: Failed. Chicken teriyaki at 45.9F and other cold items at 51.3F discarded (citation issued). Prep cooler at 51.8F held for inspection. Gap under side exit door. Dumpster overflowing with trash and lids open. New employee lacks food handler training.

headline: Failed; unsafe cold-line and cooler temperatures
summary: Failed. Cold serving line items measured 44.7F to 62.2F, above the 41F limit for TCS foods. Manager discarded 51 lbs (about $300). Prep area service cooler at 69.2F must not be used. No paper towels at rear handsink (citation issued).

headline: Failed; dead and live cockroaches, prior violation uncorrected
summary: Failed. Dead cockroaches on walls and floor must be removed. A prior report found 8 live cockroaches and about 15 live fruit flies; not corrected (citation issued). Seal wall openings and clean fryers, oven, and prep tables.

headline: Passed; dusty ice maker and dish machine leak
summary: Passed. Ice scoop placed on top of a dusty ice maker; keep it in a clean container. Leak under dish machine caught in a bucket. Staff told to repair and maintain.

headline: Passed; meat thawed at room temperature
summary: Passed. Six slabs of meat were thawed at room temperature in the rear food prep area, which is not an approved method. Dry ingredient containers were not labeled. Staff instructed to provide and maintain labels.

headline: Pass with conditions; no certified manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge with food service manager training on site. Valid certificate and certified manager required whenever TCS foods are prepared and served (citation issued). Bulk containers unlabeled. Water-damaged dining room ceiling tiles.

headline: Passed; unused meat slicer stored in kitchen
summary: Passed. Unused old equipment, a meat slicer, stored in the kitchen. Instructed to remove it.

headline: Failed; rodent droppings and a live rodent in basement
summary: Failed. About 50 rodent droppings on basement floor and one live rodent on a basement pipe; pest control must eliminate them (citation issued). Pest control log not on site. Leaking pipe under handsink, no sanitizer test kit, and missing ceiling tiles.

headline: Raw beef and chicken too warm; cooler not holding temperature
summary: Raw beef at 48.1F and raw chicken at 55.4F were held too warm. About 25 lbs were discarded on site. A reach-in cooler at 58F was tagged and held. Slow-draining handsink and soiled areas near the ice machine and utility sink need attention.

headline: Unlabeled containers; no food handler or allergen proof
summary: Sugar, flour, and corn meal containers must be labeled with food names. Slow drainage was found at handsinks in the dish area and front serving line. Walk-in cooler and freezer floors need cleaning. No proof of food handler or allergen training was on site.

headline: Cardboard shelf liners, taped pipe, and spray foam
summary: Stored items must be raised off the floor, and cardboard cannot line shelves. A grease trap pipe was repaired with duct tape and must be properly fixed. Spray foam sealant and raw wooden beams need smoothing or sealing.

headline: Low water pressure at handsink; no covered trash can
