summary: The handsink in the rear employee restroom had low water pressure. The restroom also had no covered receptacle. The person in charge was told to correct and maintain both.

headline: No backflow device on coffee machine
summary: Coffee machine had no backflow prevention device. The manager must install one and maintain it.

headline: Dishwasher not sanitizing; corrected on site
summary: The low-temperature dishwasher registered 0 ppm chlorine sanitizer, below the required 50 ppm. The manager serviced the unit during inspection, and it was then sanitizing at 50 ppm. A citation was issued.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; expired food handler certificate
summary: No handwashing signage was at the exposed basement prep handsink. Rusty storage racks in the basement walk-in cooler need rust removed. Cold holding equipment had food debris. One food handler had an expired certificate.

headline: Raw and cooked chicken held too warm; cooler tagged
summary: Raw chicken at 60F, grilled chicken at 59F, and jerk chicken at 49F were held at improper temperatures in the front prep cooler. About 27 lbs were discarded. The cooler, at 60F air temperature, was tagged and held until it reaches 41F or below.

headline: Handsinks missing towels, soap, and blocked by items
summary: A coffee area handsink had no paper towels, and two handsinks had no soap; soap was stocked on site. Strainers and utensils blocked handsinks and were removed. Shellstock lacked tags, and about 20 lbs of mussels were discarded.

headline: No handwashing sink at beer and wine areas
summary: No handwashing sink was found in beer and wine service areas; one must be installed with hot and cold running water. A mop sink faucet lacked a backflow prevention device, which must be installed where it can be serviced.

headline: Leaking drains; no hot water at rear prep sink
summary: Rinse and sanitizer drain pipes of the three-compartment sink leaked. A rear prep sink had a stripped hot water knob and no hot water. Restrooms lacked covered receptacles, and a dishwashing area had black buildup on floors.

headline: Knife stored between racks; no allergen certificate
summary: A knife was stored between storage racks behind the front counter and needs a proper knife rack. A wall with dried food debris needs detail cleaning. Food handlers lacked training proof, and no approved allergen training certificate was available.

headline: Unclean ice machine and missing food handler records
summary: Top inside of the ice machine was not clean; staff were told to remove ice and clean it. Food handlers in the prep area lacked hair restraints, and no proof of food handler training was on site.

headline: Poor washroom sink repair; clutter and unused equipment
summary: Washroom handsink was in poor repair and must be fixed. Washroom fixtures, walls, and floors need detail cleaning. Floors under equipment need cleaning, unused and broken equipment and clutter need removal, and the hood needs cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled cooked food; mold-like buildup in walk-in
summary: About 4 lbs lasagna and 2.5 lbs pasta stored over 24 hours lacked labels; the person in charge voluntarily discarded them. Soiled cloths air-dried improperly. Mold-like buildup and dust were in the walk-in cooler. Core violation not corrected.

headline: No certified manager on site while open; ice machine buildup
summary: No certified food manager was on site while open and operating. Pink and black substance was built up inside the ice machine and must be cleaned. About 6.5 gallons and 8 lbs of food without date marks were discarded.

headline: Food on floor and missing bulk container lids
summary: Food items were stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and freezer and must be raised six inches. Bulk food containers lacked lids. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, wiping cloths were soiled, and cutting boards had dark stains.

headline: No certified manager present for 20 minutes; sink disconnected
summary: No certified food manager was present from 2:45 to 3:05 PM while chicken was prepared. The certificate was delivered to another person through the back door. A washroom handsink was disconnected, and no toilet tissue was available.

headline: No written employee health policy; cleaning needed
summary: No written employee health policy was on the premises, and a citation was issued. Handsink at front prep area lacked handwashing signage. Floors along walls, corners, and inside the walk-in cooler need detail cleaning.

headline: Certified food manager lacked allergen training certificate
summary: The certified food manager had no allergen training certificate on site. Management was told all certified food managers must show proof of allergen training.

headline: Gaps at entrance doors; missing wall bases; no training
summary: Openings at the base and middle of double entrance doors must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Excess grease and food splatter on walls, and missing or loose wall bases in prep and dish areas, need attention. Food handler training was not provided.

headline: No certified manager on site; corrected paper towels
summary: No certified food manager was on site while milk and sandwiches were prepared and served. Missing clean-up kit and paper towels were obtained on site during inspection. Missing thermometers and clutter also cited.

headline: No splashguard; unstored scoops and plates
summary: No splashguard was between the front exposed handsink and the three-compartment sink. Wiping cloths were on prep surfaces, scoops were stored in dry food containers, and plates at tables were not inverted. Dish area exhaust vent had dirt buildup.

headline: Broken cooler thermometer; dust buildup near cook line
summary: No handwashing sign at an exposed sink was corrected on site when management provided one. A broken thermometer in a two-door cooler must be repaired or replaced. Dust was found on vents and ceiling panels above the cook line.

headline: No certified manager on site; no food handler training
summary: No person in charge had a valid Chicago food sanitation certificate, and no certificate was posted while food was prepared and served. The three-compartment sink faucet did not reach all compartments. A washroom fan was not operable, and no food handler training was provided.

headline: Gap under front door; greasy fryer cabinets
summary: A gap along the bottom of the front door must be made tight-fitting to keep pests out. Grease and food debris must be cleaned from fryer cabinets and wheel bases. Damaged concrete flooring must be repaired.

headline: Walk-in cooler buildup; heavy grease and dust in kitchen
summary: Dust, debris, and black and white substance covered walk-in cooler walls, floor, vents, and shelving. The front handsink drains slowly. Heavy grease and food splatter were on rear prep walls and floors, and hood systems and filters had dust and grease.

headline: No pest control log book available
summary: No pest control log book was available for review. The business must maintain service with a licensed pest control company that provides a log book. No citation was issued.

headline: Roach infestation with about 100 live cockroaches
summary: About 100 large live cockroaches were crawling in the prep area, under deep fryers, and in dry storage. The person in charge lacked a valid certificate while chicken and mashed potatoes were served. Pest control is required, and a citation was issued.

headline: Food stored on floor; wet cloths on prep surfaces
summary: Food containers were stored on floors in the walk-in cooler, freezer, prep, and storage areas and must be raised six inches. Wet wiping cloths were on prep surfaces. Grease, debris, and dust were found under equipment and in corners.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; soiled cloths in handsink
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were found in prep and storage areas, and numerous flying insects were seen. An exterminator must be called. Chicken thawed in a sink, and a rear handsink was filled with soiled cloths and lacked soap.

headline: Openings at entrance doors; leaking sink faucet
summary: Openings at the base of two outer entrance doors must be sealed. A three-compartment sink faucet was leaking and must be repaired. Grout is missing between floor tiles in the front prep area. Grease is on hood filters.

headline: Missing raw food advisory asterisks; torn gaskets
summary: Menu lacked asterisks and disclosure for raw or undercooked items, such as ahi tuna poke and burgers. Torn door gasket and broken plastic curtain on walk-in cooler and freezer must be replaced.

headline: No health policy or food handler certificates on site
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site, and no food handler certificates were found. A food manager lacked allergen training. Food stored on the floor and grease on cooking equipment were noted. No public summary was posted.

headline: No certified manager on premises; sinks and records lacking
summary: Person in charge had no food manager certificate, and no certified manager was present while eggs, noodles, rice, and chicken were prepared. Restroom faucets did not run 15 seconds. Food handler certificates could not be located.

headline: Cold foods at unsafe temperatures; coolers not maintained
summary: Milk at 44-48F, burgers at 53.4F, prime rib at 57.6F, and tomatoes at 50F were held too warm in cooler units. About 75 lbs were voluntarily discarded. Coolers must be repaired to 41F or below. A hole in the wall and a damaged ceiling tile need repair.

headline: Shrimp thawed in bus tub; expired handler certificates
summary: Shrimp was thawing in a bus tub in rear prep and was corrected through instruction to thaw under cold running water or in a refrigerator. Food stored in plastic grocery bags needs food-grade containers. Two expired food handler certificates were found.

headline: Missing health policy and handsink; torn cooler gasket
summary: No written employee health policy was on the premises. A handsink with hot and cold water and soap and towels must be installed near the rear prep and dish area. A torn gasket on the prep line cooler and a missing covered trash receptacle need fixing.

headline: Mold-like buildup in ice machine; food held too warm
summary: Black mold-like substance was found on the ice machine food contact surface. Pork sausage, eggs, and cheese were held at 57-61F; about 90 lbs were voluntarily discarded. A reach-in cooler at 61F was tagged and held. Food handlers lacked training proof.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; clutter in restroom area
summary: Several handwashing sinks lacked signs telling food employees to wash hands. Hood above the main cook line was heavily soiled. Clutter and unnecessary items were in the restroom area. A person in charge lacked additional allergen training.

headline: No certified manager until 11 AM; corrected on site
summary: No certified food service manager was on premises until 11:00 AM, when one arrived and corrected the issue. Handwashing signs were missing at several sinks. Foil and towels were used as liners; rusted shelves need cleaning.

headline: No thermometers in cold holding; broken equipment on site
summary: No thermometer was in cold holding equipment and must be provided. Broken and unused equipment must be removed. Heavy dust was on washroom ventilation. No employee with proof of allergen training was found.

headline: Unlabeled containers; crates used for storage
summary: Food storage containers must be labeled with common names. Multi-use utensils must be inverted on dish shelves. Crates used for food storage in the coffee prep area must be replaced with shelving. Food debris buildup in a coffee area floor drain must be cleaned.

headline: Cutting board grooves; minor leak at hot water knob
summary: Cutting board had dark grooves and must be removed or replaced. A minor leak was found at the hot water knob at the three-compartment sink. Debris around the hot water heater under the handsink needs cleaning. Business license number was not fully visible.

headline: Debris under grill and washroom fixtures need cleaning
summary: The bottom shelf under the grill has debris that must be cleaned. Washroom fixtures must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Rodent infestation with about 500 mouse droppings
summary: About 500 mouse droppings were found across food prep, dry storage, washroom, and shelves. More pest control service is needed. Ready-to-eat foods stored over 24 hours lacked date marks. Front door has gaps.

headline: Food held too hot and too cold; small flies found
summary: Beef at 127.8F and chicken at 129.7F were held too cool on the flat-top grill, and beef at 51.8F and eggs at 44.5F were too warm in prep coolers. About 22 lbs discarded. About 40 small flies were found in the basement prep area.

headline: No written employee health policy on premises
summary: No written employee health policy was on the premises. Management was told to provide a signed health policy for each employee. This is a priority foundation violation.

headline: Broken handle at one compartment sink
summary: A compartment sink in the front prep area had a broken handle that must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Rat droppings in basement; no handwashing sign
summary: About 50 rat droppings were on basement storage floors and along walls. Management was told to clean them and that additional pest control is needed. Food handlers prepped without hair restraints, and a sanitizer manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Blocked handsink, missing soap, and greasy areas
summary: A handsink in food prep was blocked by a spice cart; the manager moved it during inspection. Soap was missing at a prep sink and was provided on site. Greasy walls and grease trap area, a loud bathroom fan, and expired core violations were noted.

headline: Hair restraints missing; leaking sink and greasy fryers
summary: Food handlers in food prep were not wearing hair restraints and were told to wear them. Wiping cloth was not stored in sanitizer, and an ice scoop was improperly stored. Deep fryers had grease and food. A leak was found at the rear sink.

headline: Gap at rear door; broken baseboard
summary: A rear storage door had a half-inch gap at the bottom and must be tightly sealed to prevent pests. Scrap wood and large items in the rear enclosed space must be removed. A broken baseboard behind a lottery machine needs repair.

headline: Items stored on basement floor; holes under sink
summary: Pots, pans, and cake tins were stored on the floor in basement dry storage and must be raised six inches. Two holes larger than one inch were found behind the baseboard under the three-compartment sink and must be sealed.

headline: No certified manager on premises; no handsink in snack area
summary: No certified food service manager was on premises. No convenient handwashing sink was in snack prep area. Pots and bowls were not inverted, and stored milk crates and stained ceiling tiles were noted. Core violations were not corrected.

headline: Plastic bags used to store chicken in freezer
summary: Plastic T-shirt bags were used to store chicken in the freezer. The person in charge was instructed to use only food-grade storage bags.

headline: Over 30 rat droppings in basement; citation issued
summary: Over 30 rat droppings were under basement shelves near single-service items and jars. The manager must clean and sanitize the area, and pest control service is recommended before reinspection. A citation was issued.

headline: Missing handwash sign; no self-closing restroom doors
summary: Handwashing sign was needed at the men's washroom handsink. Restroom doors must be self-closing. Storage containers must be labeled. Garbage area had leaves and debris, and the basement needs decluttering. No allergen certificate was available.

headline: Rust on ice machine; food handler training not shown
summary: Rust was found on the front of the ice machine and must be removed to prevent ice contamination. Walk-in cooler floors and corners need cleaning, and ice buildup and a missing wall panel were noted. No food handler training or allergen proof was shown.

headline: Food debris and spills; food stored in plastic bags
summary: Food was stored in plastic thank-you bags and must use food-grade containers. Storage racks and floors had food debris and spills. Walk-in cooler had only one working fan. Peeling paint and broken floor tiles need repair.

headline: Insect control device over prep table; dead insects
summary: An insect control device was installed above a prep table and must be removed. Dead insects were under the device and near a handsink, and they must be cleaned up. Food debris was under refrigeration and cooking units.

headline: Rodent droppings found; food held above safe temperature
summary: Soup was held at 58.7-61.6F in banquet walk-in cooler and voluntarily discarded, about 15 lbs. Mouse and rat droppings and bird feathers were found; pest control service is needed. Paper towels and soap were obtained on site.

headline: Ice maker not clean; missing backflow device
summary: Ice maker interior had light film buildup and must be cleaned. The backflow prevention device for the bar ice maker could not be found. Peeling paint and grease spills were noted.

headline: Wiping cloths in empty sanitizer; boxed items on floor
summary: Wiping cloths were in a sanitizer bucket with no sanitizer solution. Single-use plastic bowls, lids, and cups were stored directly on the floor of the rear storage hallway and must be raised six inches.

headline: Only copy of manager certificate shown; burnt bulbs
summary: No certified food manager was on site with an original certificate while eggs and lobster were handled. A photocopy was shown but is not accepted. Several burnt-out light bulbs were found in the kitchen and dishwashing areas.

headline: Chicken held at 117F; cold foods held at 46-49F
summary: Chicken held at 117F was discarded, about 10 lbs. Various cold TCS foods at 46-49F were discarded, including cream, milk, and mashed potatoes. Manager was told hot foods must be held at 135F or above and cold foods at 41F or below.

headline: No certified manager during food prep; hamburger too warm
summary: No Chicago food sanitation manager was on site while food was prepared and served. Hamburger patties at 50F were discarded, about 10 lbs. A reach-in prep cooler at 58F was tagged. No health policy was on site, and no hand soap was at a prep handsink until it was provided.

headline: Expired manager certificates; no handsink at bar
summary: Person in charge lacked a valid manager certificate; two posted certificates were expired. No employee health policy and no handsink at the employee lounge bar. Black substance was in the ice machine. No food handler or allergen certificates were presented.

headline: No paper towels at front prep handsink
summary: The front prep handsink lacked paper towels and soap and was cited. Serving plates were not inverted during storage, and floors along walls and drains need cleaning.

headline: Dried food debris on floors; uncovered vent
summary: Dried food debris was on rear prep floors and must be cleaned. A large vent near the coffee station needs enclosing to prevent pest entry. Lighting in the rear prep area was inadequate and must be increased.

headline: Small flies found; handwashing signs missing
summary: Over 20 small flies were seen on the second floor, including in the dishwashing area and bar. Multiple handwashing sinks lacked signage. Menu lacked consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods. Pest control service is recommended.

headline: No employee health policy; restroom doors not self-closing
summary: No employee health policy was on site, and verification is required for each employee. Toilet room doors, both men's and women's, lacked self-closing devices and must be installed.

headline: Pizza oven placed outside hood
summary: A pizza oven was not located under a ventilation hood. It must be removed, or the business must contact the Department of Buildings for approval.

headline: Flying insects found; no certified food manager on site
summary: No certified food manager was present while raw meat was prepared and served. About 30-50 live small flying insects were seen. Ice machine had black and pink slime dripping onto ice. Citations were issued.

headline: Crates used for storage; litter outside
summary: Plastic soda and milk crates were used for elevation and must stop. Floors along walls and corners in the rear dishwashing area and walk-in cooler need cleaning. Litter was on the ground in the rear outside area.

headline: Fryer and cooking equipment need cleaning
summary: Instruction was given to clean the bottom of the fryer and exterior surfaces of cooking equipment. Floors under and behind kitchen equipment and washroom ceiling fans with light dust also need cleaning.

headline: Over 50 rat droppings; hot water missing at sinks
summary: Over 50 rat droppings were found along walls, in storage, and inside cardboard boxes. An exterminator must be called. Several sinks had no hot water, and a reach-in cooler door did not close properly. Food handlers lacked training.

headline: No certified manager on premises; black mold-like substance
summary: No city-certified food service manager was on premises, and a citation was issued. Black mold-like substance was found inside the ice machine and in caulk near the dish machine. Floors under sinks and in walk-in areas need cleaning. Food handler certificates were missing.

headline: Ice scoop stored inside ice machine; leaking faucet
summary: Ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine and must be kept in a clean container. Dust buildup was on front prep cooler condensers. A three-compartment sink faucet in the rear prep area was leaking and must be repaired.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; soiled cloths on counters
summary: Bulk food items throughout kitchen and prep areas lacked labels with common names. Wiping cloths were left on counters and must be kept in sanitizer. Cutting boards had deep cuts and stains, and waffle maker and fryer areas had grease buildup.

headline: Rust and discoloration on prep tables; no allergen certificate
summary: All prep tables had rust and discoloration needing detail cleaning. Drain pipe must be corrected to eliminate water on the floor. Walls in the front dish prep area had chipping and peeling paint. The manager needs an allergen certificate.

headline: No handsoap or paper towels at bar sink
summary: No hand soap was available at the bar and prep handsinks, and no paper towels at the exposed bar handsink. Prep coolers held food at 53-58F and must be repaired. No food temperature thermometer was on site.

headline: Cold foods above 41F; corrected on site
summary: Cold foods held at 47-52F were discarded on site, about 6 lbs. Two-door cooler at 48.6F was tagged. Boxes on floor and handwashing sinks in restrooms at 63-72F need fixing. Allergen training proof was not found.

headline: Handwashing sign missing; employee without hair restraint
summary: No handwashing sign was posted near the front bar sink, and an employee was preparing and serving food without a hair restraint. Water pressure at the main kitchen handsink needs repair. A ceiling tile above the basement ice machine is missing.

headline: Thawing in unsafe ways; open food in freezer
summary: Frozen pizza puffs were thawing under a grill and chicken was thawing in a bucket; instruction was to thaw in a cooler or under cool running water. Food in freezer was open. Outside grease container was caked with grease, a possible pest food source.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; rust and clutter in prep
summary: No handwashing signage was at the exposed rear bakery prep handsink. Rust was on shelves in a two-door refrigerator. Clutter and items were on floors in the bakery prep area and second-floor party room. Dirty floor drain under the three-compartment sink needs cleaning.

headline: Leaking furnace system; torn cooler gasket
summary: A torn door gasket was in the one-door cooler at the front coffee prep area and must be replaced. Storage racks in the walk-in cooler needed detail cleaning. Constant water leaking from the HVAC furnace system must be repaired.

headline: Uninverted utensils, worn cutting boards, burned-out bulb
summary: Eating utensils were not inverted after sanitizing, and were corrected by instruction. Cutting boards had open seams and dark stains and must be replaced. One burned-out light bulb above cooking equipment needs replacing.

headline: No health policy, cleanup kit, or thermometer on site
summary: No employee health policy, vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit, or metal stem thermometer was on site, and each must be provided. Grease spills and loose debris were found. Core violation for lack of certified manager allergen training was not corrected.

headline: Hair restraint missing at sushi station; no sink stoppers
summary: Food handler at sushi station was not wearing an effective hair restraint. Large spoons were stored in standing water. No sink stoppers were at the three-compartment sink, and no allergen certificate was on site for the food service manager.

headline: Dust and debris buildup; no food handler training
summary: Dust and debris had built up under and behind equipment, along wall bases, and on sales floor shelves, and must be cleaned. No food handler training was shown for employees.

headline: Clutter in entryway from lobby to kitchen
summary: Clutter was in the entryway from the lobby to the kitchen. Management was told to remove unnecessary items and store kept items at least six inches off the floor.

headline: Black substance on cooler walls; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: Black substance was on the walk-in cooler walls and must be cleaned. Some bulk containers were not labeled with food names. Employee washroom door was not self-closing. Knife rack wall, light shields, and floors need cleaning.

headline: No handwashing signs at sushi prep sinks
summary: No handwashing signage was at the handsinks in sushi prep areas, and it must be provided.

headline: Leaking hot water knob at handsink
summary: A leak was seen at the base of the hot water knob at the handsink behind the front bar. It must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Mold-like buildup in beer cooler; no self-closing door
summary: Mold-like buildup and dried food debris were found inside a basement beer and wine cooler. Foil-lined shelves must be replaced. Employee restroom door was not self-closing. Only one of three allergen training certificates was on site.

headline: Damaged insulation around cold lines in walk-in
summary: Insulation covering cold lines in the walk-in cooler was in poor repair and must be replaced.

headline: Unused ice machine and coffee maker
summary: An unused ice machine in the rear dish area was not connected, and an unused coffee maker was at the front counter. These unnecessary items must be removed and kept removed.

headline: No certified manager during food prep; corrected on arrival
summary: No city-certified food service manager was on premises while food was prepared and served. A certified manager arrived at 3:30 PM, correcting the issue. Other issues included no handwashing sign, dust, and no allergen certificates.

headline: No certified manager on site; open drink and soiled cloths
summary: No person in charge held a Chicago food sanitation certificate, and no valid certificate was posted while TCS food was prepared and served. An open employee drink sat above a prep cooler. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables.

headline: Failed: hot food too cool; low hot water
summary: Failed. Chicken at 96.7°F and pork at 95.5°F in hot holding were below 135°F; about 10 lbs discarded, citation issued. Employee handsink water measured 57.1°F and was fixed on site to 102-105°F. Dock garage door not rodent-proof, a repeat violation.

headline: No certified manager; cold seafood too warm
summary: Pass with conditions. No city-certified food manager was on site and no food handler certificates were provided; citation issued. Cold foods like tuna, shrimp and cream cheese sauce were held at 48–71.6°F; manager discarded about 8 lbs.

headline: Passed; deeply cut, stained cutting board noted
summary: Passed. A cutting board attached to the deli prep cooler has deep cuts and stains. It must be sanded and resealed, or replaced.

headline: Handsink blocked; no food handler training proof
summary: Pass with conditions. A handsink near dishwashing was blocked by pots and lids, so it was not accessible for handwashing; citation issued. Food was stored uncovered, containers were unlabeled, and no food handler training proof was shown.

headline: Passed; one restroom closed for toilet leak
summary: Passed. Boxes of single-service items on the hall floor must be raised at least six inches. One of two bathrooms is marked out of order due to a toilet leak; the manager is repairing it.

headline: Passed; dirty basement floors, cardboard floor mats
summary: Passed. Dirt and debris were on floors in basement areas, inside the walk-in freezer and in storage closets; cleaning required. Cardboard used as floor mats in the walk-in freezer must be removed or replaced with smooth, cleanable flooring.

headline: Passed; rear door gap must be sealed
summary: Passed re-inspection. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the rear exit door must be sealed with a tight-fitting seal to keep pests out. No pests were recorded.

headline: Passed; peeling paint, cracked walls, lights out
summary: Passed re-inspection. Peeling and chipped paint, cracked walls and openings need repair and sealing. Several lights were out above the three-compartment sink and dry storage. A cooler door gasket and freezer fan covers also need attention.

headline: Passed; several food handlers lack certificates
summary: Passed. Several food handlers lacked a food handler certificate, and the manager must provide proof. Boxes were stored on the basement floor. Coolers, floors and a baseboard under the three-compartment sink also need cleaning or repair.

headline: Passed; pots stored upright, grease on filters
summary: Passed. Pots were stored facing upward on a lower shelf and must be inverted. Grease had accumulated on filters above the stove and must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; dirty ice bin, cut cutting boards
summary: Passed. The top interior of the ice bin needs cleaning; ice must be removed and surfaces sanitized. Cutting boards throughout the kitchen are deeply cut and stained. Washroom, dishroom and vent surfaces have excessive dust.

headline: Failed: 120 lbs cold food too warm discarded
summary: Failed. Cold foods including salmon, hummus, butter and melon were held at 45.3–54.6°F; about 120 lbs ($3,500) discarded, citation issued. A prior violation was not corrected, and catering buffets lacked portable sneeze guards.

headline: Failed: live flies, cold food too warm
summary: Failed. About 50 live small flies were in the dish area and about 50 in the front prep area; citation issued. Tomatoes at 50°F, chicken salad at 64°F and a prep cooler at 60°F were too warm; food was discarded. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup supplies or procedure.

headline: Passed; wall-base opening in dining area
summary: Passed. An opening along the wall base and floor in the dining area must be sealed to prevent pests from entering. No pests were recorded.

headline: Passed; no employee health policy; training needed
summary: Pass with conditions. No employee health policy was on site and must be provided and kept. Food handlers who are not city-certified managers must obtain required food handler training. No citation was issued for the health policy.

headline: Failed: repeat violations at three-compartment sink
summary: Failed. Violations from the August 19, 2026 report were not corrected: excessive black buildup on caulking at the three-compartment sink, and stripped cold-water faucet handles. Both must be repaired; citation issued.

headline: Passed; clutter on closet floor near restrooms
summary: Passed. Clutter was stored on the floor of a storage closet near restrooms. The manager was instructed to remove unused items to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Passed; ice machine backflow device missing
summary: Passed re-inspection. The inspector could not locate a backflow prevention device on the ice machine. The operator must install and maintain one.

headline: Passed; one restroom handsink not working
summary: Passed. One of four handsinks in the women's customer restroom was not working and must be repaired. Food storage containers in the basement prep area must be labeled with the common name of the food.

headline: Passed; handwashing signs missing at several sinks
summary: Passed re-inspection. Handwashing signs were missing at sinks in the bar, prep areas and dishwashing area. The operator must post clearly visible signs telling food employees to wash hands at all handsinks.

headline: Handsink water too cool; corrected on site
summary: Pass with conditions. Basement handsink water measured 86°F, below the 100°F minimum; adjusted on site to 104.2°F, citation issued. Paper towels were missing at basement handsinks and were provided during inspection. Bar floors need cleaning.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; no rear handsink
summary: Failed. No city-certified food manager was on site while hot dogs and cheese were handled; citation issued. The rear dish area had no handwashing sink, which must be installed, with citation. The three-compartment sink lacked stoppers.

headline: Passed; kettle needs written cleaning procedure
summary: Passed re-inspection. A large kitchen kettle that cannot be moved must be cleaned in place. The manager was instructed to write a procedure for washing, rinsing and sanitizing it.

headline: Passed; no backflow device, grease trap leak
summary: Passed. The utility sink lacked a backflow prevention device, which keeps dirty water from flowing back into clean water. A grease trap drainpipe leaked. Ice cream containers and boxes were stored on floors and must be shelved.

headline: Passed; dirty microwave, items on freezer floor
summary: Passed. The microwave in the rear prep area needs cleaning. Items on the walk-in freezer floor must be raised at least six inches.

headline: Worker served food without washing hands; citation
summary: Pass with conditions. A food handler touched her phone and supplies, then served a customer without washing hands; citation issued. Sanitizer test strips were missing but were provided on site. Leaks, greasy hood filters and dirty surfaces also noted.

headline: Passed; hygiene and upkeep issues noted
summary: Passed re-inspection. Inspector required a handwashing sign, hair restraints for all food workers, and wiping cloths stored in sanitizing solution. Also noted rust, wall openings, dust, grease, and lighting problems.

headline: Raw meat stored over ready-to-eat food; discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Raw chicken, beef and eggs were stored above cooked and ready-to-eat foods; all were removed on site. Prepared cold foods lacked date labels and were discarded. Citation issued. Storage and upkeep issues also noted.

headline: Passed; soiled storage crates and dirty cooler
summary: Passed. Soiled black crates were used for elevation in basement storage, with items stored in a corner by chest freezers. The crates must be removed and replaced with cleanable shelving. A two-door cooling unit in prep needs debris removed.

headline: Failed: dish machine not sanitizing; no bar handsink
summary: Failed. Basement dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer; repaired on site to 50 ppm; citation issued. The first-floor bar lacks an exposed handsink. An ice bin had no lid, and a hot holding unit was under a handsink in the ceviche station.

headline: Passed; leak under three-compartment sink
summary: Passed. Inspector found a leak at the P-trap (the curved drain pipe) under the three-compartment sink and instructed the operator to correct it and keep it maintained.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings, dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Failed. Over 50 mouse droppings were in the bar, plus 30 and 20 in other areas, with numerous flying insects. An exterminator is required; citation issued. The dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer and is tagged out of use until rechecked.

headline: Failed: live flies found; cooked ribs too warm
summary: Failed. About 5-7 large and 30+ small live flies were in prep, bar and dining areas; citation issued and pest control recommended. About 48 lbs ($600) of cooked short ribs at 48.6–59.5°F were discarded. Both rear doors have bottom gaps.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing, tagged out of use
summary: Pass with conditions. The low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine, so it was not sanitizing. It is tagged not to be used until the city's health department (CDPH) approves removal of the tag. Kitchen staff lacked food handler certificates.

headline: Passed; containers stored wrong; gaps to seal
summary: Passed. Food containers were not stored inverted and must be. Small gaps above the three-compartment sink area must be sealed.

headline: Failed: no food handler certificate; trash overflowing
summary: Failed. A food handler had no training certificate, a repeat violation; citation issued. The dumpster lid was not shut, trash overflowed, and the staff toilet had no toilet tissue. Also noted an open energy drink in the pizza prep cooler.

headline: Failed: slimy ice machine dripping onto ice
summary: Failed. The basement ice machine had black slime buildup dripping onto ice used for consumption; citation issued. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, and milk crates were used as shelving. Unused equipment must be removed.

headline: Failed: expired food, warm produce, dirty ice machine
summary: Failed. About 20 lbs of prepared foods past their discard dates were thrown out. Potatoes, tomatoes, greens and cucumbers in a cooler were above 41°F and discarded. The basement ice machine had black buildup touching ice; citation issued.

headline: Hot food too cool; dead roaches found
summary: Pass with conditions. Chicken, pork and ribs in a hot display unit were below 135°F, as low as 80.1°F; about 15 lbs discarded, citation issued. Dead roaches were found near freezers and in the prep area. The rear door has an opening.

headline: Passed; torn cooler door gasket
summary: Passed. The interior gasket of the two-door prep cooler opposite the flat-top grill is torn. It must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing sign
summary: Passed. The handsink at Room 185 has no handwashing sign. A sign must be provided.

headline: Failed: overflowing dumpsters; trash not secured
summary: Failed. Dumpsters were overflowing, with trash bags on the lids so they would not close. Trash must be stored inside receptacles so insects and rodents cannot get to it. Priority citation issued.

headline: Failed: cold food too warm; no food thermometer
summary: Failed. Chicken, pork and beef soup held at 46.4–48°F were above the 41°F cold-holding limit; citation issued. No metal stem thermometer on site. Food stored in grocery bags, milk crates used as shelving, and burnt-out lights noted.

headline: Failed: food held too cool; no training proof
summary: Failed. Pastries with spinach and hot dogs held at 69.4°F and 75.2°F were discarded; citation issued. Hot water was too low at some sinks until a plumber fixed it. No food handler training proof, and a required thermometer was missing.

headline: Passed; some food handler certificates expired
summary: Passed. Rubber gaskets on third-floor reach-in cooler doors along the cookline were ripped and must be repaired. Food buildup around sinks must be cleaned. A bar handsink drains slowly. Some food handler certificates have expired.

headline: Passed; poor door seals, cleaning and training gaps
summary: Passed. Front and rear exit doors are in poor repair and need weather stripping to keep pests out. Coolers, walls, ceilings and the hood need detail cleaning. The manager was told to meet food handler and allergen training rules or face citations.

headline: Passed; many cleaning and labeling fixes needed
summary: Passed. Inspector required handwashing signs, visible accurate thermometers in all coolers, and labels on food storage containers. Walk-in cooler racks had mold-like buildup. The dish machine, ceiling tiles and floors need cleaning or repair.

headline: No certified manager; only 1 of 6 trained
summary: Pass with conditions. No city-certified manager was on site while bagel sandwiches were prepared; citation issued. Only 1 of 6 employees had food handler training. Inspection summary was not posted; citation issued.

headline: Passed; meat thawed at room temperature, corrected
summary: Passed. Meat was thawing in a sink at room temperature, which is unsafe. The employee corrected it on site by running water at 60°F. Food spills inside the main-line microwave and grease on an outside oil container also need cleaning.

headline: Passed; missing restroom ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. Ceiling tiles are missing in the men's and women's restrooms that diners can access. The operator must replace them where needed.

headline: Passed; unlabeled food, food stored on floors
summary: Passed. Food in coolers, the walk-in and dry storage lacked name labels. Food stored on floors in walk-in coolers, the freezer and storage areas must be raised six inches. Clutter, floor debris and dust also need attention.

headline: Passed; dirty reach-in coolers and floors
summary: Passed. Interiors of reach-in coolers need detailed cleaning to remove buildup. Floors throughout the facility need debris removed and must be kept clean.

headline: Cardboard shelving, rusty racks, uncorrected prior violation
summary: Pass with conditions. Cardboard was used as storage shelving and racks were rusted; both must be fixed. A previous violation was not corrected: no food allergen certificates were on site. Citation issued.

headline: Sushi held too warm; 35 lbs discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Sushi, salmon and spring rolls in service coolers measured 46.2–53.4°F, above the 41°F limit. Manager discarded 35 lbs (about $350) and a citation was issued. Torn weather stripping on two walk-in cooler doors also noted.

headline: Failed: handsink hot water too cool
summary: Failed. Hot water at three handsinks measured 66.7°F, 84.1°F and 80.2°F, but must be at least 100°F; citation issued. Cooked pasta was being cooled covered and must be left uncovered during cooling. Kitchen floors had grease and food debris.

headline: Passed; sink stoppers missing, floors very dirty
summary: Passed re-inspection. Three-compartment sink stoppers were missing and must be provided. A condensate line was draining into a bucket and must drain to a floor drain. Floors under equipment and in corners had grease, food debris and dirt.

headline: Passed; no employee health policy; signage missing
summary: Pass with conditions. No employee health policy was on site; verification for each employee must be kept on site. The restroom sink lacks a handwashing sign, restroom trash cans lack lids, and rear dry storage has clutter and cracked tiles.

headline: Dish machine no sanitizer; vacuum-packed meat discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Dish machine had no sanitizer at final rinse (0 ppm); manager obtained some by end of inspection. Cooked meats vacuum-packed without approval were discarded and the machine was tagged. Basement cooler lacks a thermometer.

headline: Passed; missing handwash sign, door gaps
summary: Passed. The customer-only handwashing sink has no handwashing sign, which must be provided. The employee and customer entrance doors in the dining area have a 1/4-inch gap that must be tightened to prevent pest entry.

headline: Passed; no employee health policy on site
summary: Pass with conditions. No employee health policy was on site; the manager must keep one so staff report illnesses that spread through food. Paper towels were missing at a handsink but were provided during inspection. Dirty floors and walls noted.

headline: Passed; food on floor, scratched boards, rust
summary: Passed. Boxed food and bulk containers were stored on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised six inches. Cutting boards are deeply scratched, shelves are rusty, and holes around piping above the hot water tank must be sealed.

headline: Passed; sanitation managers lack allergen training
summary: Passed. No allergen training was found for sanitation managers. The operator must provide it. No other issues were listed.

headline: Failed: cold food and cooler too warm
summary: Failed. Cold foods including pork, chicken, cheese and sour cream were held at 47.8–53.6°F; about 5 lbs ($100) discarded, citation issued. A small cold-holding unit at 48.1°F was tagged. Cardboard liners and floor storage also noted.

headline: Passed; wet wiping cloths, items on floor
summary: Passed. Wet wiping cloths were on several prep surfaces and must be stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. Single-service items stored on the side stairwell floor must be raised off the floor.

headline: Passed; missing thermometers, door gap, freezer ice
summary: Passed. The milk cooler and walk-in freezer lacked visible thermometers. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door must be rodent-proofed. The walk-in freezer door does not close properly and has heavy ice buildup.

headline: Passed; wiping cloths and utensils stored improperly
summary: Passed re-inspection. Wet wiping cloths with dirt and food debris were stored in plain water with no sanitizer. Tongs and knives were improperly stored between uses. The operator must correct both and maintain proper storage.

headline: Passed; broken restroom door closer, damaged floors
summary: Passed. The restroom door's self-closing device was not working. Debris and clutter were near the furnace, and uneven, damaged flooring was near the hot water heater and restroom. All must be repaired and kept clean.

headline: Passed; dirty coolers and floors; allergen certificate expired
summary: Passed. Lower surfaces of reach-in coolers had spills, food and dirt. Rear floors had debris around racks, the dish machine and sinks. The certified food manager's allergen training certificate had expired and must be renewed.

headline: Failed: no soap, flies, wet wiping cloths
summary: Failed. Prep handsink lacked soap and paper towels, but staff supplied both during inspection. About 25 small flies were seen near onion storage; citation issued. Wet wiping cloths lay on prep surfaces.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing signs in restrooms
summary: Passed. Both customer restrooms lack handwashing signs or posters, which must be provided. Dust is on ceiling vents in the employee restroom and above the mop sink.

headline: Passed; leaking cold-holding unit onto floor
summary: Passed. A cold-holding unit (refrigerated equipment) in the rear was leaking water onto the prep floor. The operator was instructed to repair it and keep it maintained.

headline: Failed: black and pink build-up in ice machine
summary: Failed. Black and pink build-up was found inside the ice machine for the self-serve beverage dispenser; ice is used for consumption. Citation issued. Floors under carbon dioxide tanks had black residue, and the walk-in cooler had food debris.

headline: Passed; grocery-bag food storage, missing thermometer
summary: Passed. A sushi prep cooler lacked a thermometer, and food was stored in plastic grocery bags in a basement freezer; food-grade containers are required. Also noted rust on a prep table bottom, freezer ice buildup, dirty floor drains and burnt-out bulbs.

headline: Passed; no employee health policy on site
summary: Pass with conditions. No employee health policy was on site; a signed policy for each employee must be provided, with no citation issued. The restroom handsink drains slowly and the restroom lacks a self-closing door device. Dirt and debris were under cooking equipment.

headline: Failed: about 40 rodent droppings found
summary: Failed. About 40 rodent droppings were found in the basement and heater/AC closet; citation issued and pest control recommended. A two-door refrigerator in the dining area must be locked or moved. Manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Passed; cardboard under prep tables, stained tiles
summary: Passed re-inspection. Cardboard and foil were on the bottoms of prep tables and must be removed. Severely damaged, water-stained ceiling tiles in the rear prep-area restroom must be replaced.

headline: Passed; 1-inch rear door gap; cleaning issues
summary: Passed. The rear exit door has a 1-inch gap that must be fixed to keep pests out. A food handler had no proof of required training. Fryers, cooler racks and floors need deep cleaning, and a sink faucet leaks.

headline: Failed: fruit flies found in storage areas
summary: Failed. About 30 fruit flies were on walls in storage areas; citation issued. The operator must notify its pest control operator and eliminate the flies. Floors under the front coffee station also need cleaning.

headline: Failed: insect carcasses; sink drains poorly
summary: Failed. Insect carcasses were found in the ceiling of the dry storage and prep area; manager told to clean. The three-compartment sink drains poorly and floods; priority violation, citation issued. Ceiling tiles have holes and water stains.

headline: Failed: dish machine not sanitizing; garbage on ground
summary: Failed. Basement dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer; repaired on site to 50 ppm; citation issued. Food, garbage bags and debris lay on the ground by the dumpster, with citation issued. Several leaks, low water pressure and missing raw-food menu advisories noted.

headline: Passed; food workers need proper hair restraints
summary: Passed. All food handlers need effective hair restraints. The operator was instructed to correct and maintain this.

headline: Passed; front door needs rodent-proofing
summary: Passed. The bottom of the front entrance door must be rodent-proofed. Loose and missing floor tiles in the front area and water-stained ceiling tiles in the basement need repair or replacement.

headline: Passed; broken freezer thermometer, slow drain
summary: Passed. The thermometer on the outside of the walk-in freezer is in disrepair and must be repaired. A handsink in the front prep area drains slowly and must be repaired.

headline: Failed: rat droppings; hood not working
summary: Failed. About 20 rat droppings were under basement storage shelves; citation issued and more pest control is needed. Kitchen exhaust hood was not working. A prior violation was not corrected, including missing floor tiles and an expired food handler certificate.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; 30 live flies
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site while open, and no verifiable employee health policy was provided; citations issued. About 30 live small black flying insects were in food prep, and large black flies were in the garbage room.

headline: Passed; worn cutting boards, trash, standing water
summary: Passed. Cutting boards with dark marks and deep cuts must be replaced. A second-floor bar liquor well is sticky and must be cleaned. Trash is on the walk-in freezer and third-floor storage floors, and standing water is in the rear dishwashing area.

headline: Passed; front door gap, several repairs needed
summary: Passed. The front outer door gap must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Other issues: exposed pipe over prep, missing splash guard, no backflow device at mop sink, leaking handsink, and greasy floors and walls.

headline: Cold food too warm; about 247 lbs discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Many cold foods in two reach-in coolers were held at 47.5–67.9°F; manager discarded about 247 lbs ($1,455). A front cooler was too warm at 67.3°F and was repaired to 39.9°F during inspection. Citations issued.

headline: Passed; door gap, leaking sink, dirty toilet
summary: Passed re-inspection. The rear exterior door has a 1/4-inch gap and must be repaired. A prep-area handsink leaks from the pipe under the basin. The customer restroom toilet was covered in residue.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; cold food too warm
summary: Pass with conditions. Dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer; repaired on site to 100 ppm. Chicken and vegetables at about 67°F were discarded (6 lbs). A prep cooler at 67.2°F was serviced and reached 41°F. Citations issued.

headline: Passed; torn cooler door gasket
summary: Passed. The interior gasket of the two-door prep cooler is torn. The operator was instructed to replace it.

headline: Failed: 15 small flies, no raw-food warning
summary: Failed. About 15 small flies were seen in the rear prep and dish area; citation issued. Raw or undercooked animal foods had no consumer warning, and packaged cookies, cake and pudding were not labeled. Several plumbing and backflow items also cited.

headline: Passed; beverage station drain dirty
summary: Passed. The drain at the beverage station had dirt and food debris buildup. The operator was instructed to clean and maintain it. No other issues were listed.

headline: Failed: over 100 mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. Over 100 mouse droppings were inside cabinets under equipment in the serving and self-service beverage areas. Citation issued. The manager was told to call an exterminator and clean and sanitize all areas. Floor grout is also missing.

headline: Passed; expired food handler certificate; allergen training missing
summary: Pass with conditions. One food handler's certificate was expired. A prior violation was not corrected: the city sanitation manager had no allergen training, and it must be provided. A light on the main prep line was burnt out.

headline: Passed; wiping cloth storage and broken floor tiles
summary: Passed re-inspection. Wiping cloths in prep areas must be stored in a sanitizer bucket between uses. Broken floor tiles at the basement stairs must be replaced.

headline: Hot water too cool; fixed during inspection
summary: Pass with conditions. Hot water was too cool at handsinks (63.5°F) and the three-compartment sink (65.3°F); plumbers fixed it on site; citation issued. The front exit door has a 1/4-inch gap that must be sealed.

headline: Passed; dirty freezer, restroom door needs closer
summary: Passed. Food debris had built up in the two-door rear freezer and must be defrosted and cleaned. The restroom door lacks a self-closing device, which must be installed.

headline: Passed; manager allergen training documentation needed
summary: Passed. No certified food manager with allergen training was found. Documentation of allergen training must be provided. No other issues were listed.

headline: Passed; torn cooler gasket, debris on floor
summary: Passed. The walk-in cooler door gasket is torn and damaged and must be repaired. Restrooms lack a covered receptacle for sanitary products. Debris on the rear dish and prep room floor must be cleaned.

headline: Unlabeled desserts; low water pressure at counter
summary: Packaged desserts in a front refrigerator lacked required labels, including name, ingredients, allergens, and business details. Water pressure at the front counter area was too low and must be repaired.

headline: Grease on fryer and hood filters; re-inspection passed
summary: A re-inspection passed. The inside of the deep fryer needs cleaning, and grease has built up on the ventilation hood filters above the wok station.

headline: No certified manager for 30 minutes; citation
summary: No certified food manager was on site from 12:50 to 1:20 PM while chicken and other hot-or-cold-held foods were prepared. A citation was issued, and staff were told to keep a certified manager on site at all times.

headline: No employee health policy; no splashguards; citation
summary: No written employee health policy for sick employees was on premises, and a citation was issued. Splashguards were needed at exposed hand sinks. Several food handlers lacked certificates, and the certified manager lacked allergen training. The inspection summary was not posted, and a citation was issued.

headline: Employee restroom garbage can lacks lid
summary: The garbage can in the employee restrooms had no lids and must be provided and maintained.

headline: Over 40 flying insects; raw chicken too warm
summary: Over 40 small flying insects were found on walls, ceilings, and shelves in the rear dishwashing area, and more pest control is needed, with a citation issued. Raw chicken measured 49.7°F in a prep cooler, and about 7 pounds was discarded. Sink stoppers, lids, and a previous core violation were also noted.

headline: Soiled cooler interiors and floor; re-inspection passed
summary: A re-inspection passed. Interior cavities of reach-in drawer coolers were soiled with dried food debris. Floors under equipment in the rear warewashing area were heavily soiled, and cleaning must be done often enough to prevent build-up.

headline: Overflowing dumpster; failed inspection
summary: The outside dumpster lid was missing and trash was overflowing, and a citation was issued. Soiled mop heads were not stored properly and must be hung to prevent insect breeding. Unused equipment was found in the water heater storage area, and a burnt-out light bulb was noted.

headline: Missing hand-washing sign; re-inspection passed
summary: A re-inspection passed. Hand-washing signage was missing next to the exposed sink near the three-compartment sink. The person in charge was told to get and keep signage in place.

headline: Meat in display cooler too warm; discarded
summary: Ground beef, chicken fajitas, pork, beef fajitas, and chicken gizzards were held at 45 to 53°F in a food display cooler. About 50 pounds worth $280 was discarded. Several dry products were not labeled.

headline: No certified manager during chicken prep; meat held too warm
summary: No certified food manager was present from 8:15 to 8:50 AM while chicken and other hot-or-cold-held foods were prepared. Beef was held at 60.2°F; cold food must be kept at 41°F or below. The manager discarded 9 pounds. Grease, dirt, and debris were also found, and a citation was issued.

headline: Loose cooler door gaskets; passed
summary: The rubber gaskets on two refrigerator doors in the kitchen were loose. Staff were told to replace them to prevent cold air from escaping.

headline: Raw meat and seafood held too warm; discarded
summary: Raw shellfish, chicken, and beef were held at 46.6 to 47.8°F in the walk-in cooler, and about 35 pounds was discarded on site. Cooler thermometers were missing. Reused plastic containers and a gap at the rear door were also noted, and a citation was issued.

headline: No certified manager on site; failed inspection
summary: No certified food manager was on site while open, and a manager arrived during the report. Employee did not wash hands after coming from outside. Toilet room sink had no hot water, and the rear exit door was left open. Food handler certificates and allergen certificate were missing.

headline: Drink cup on prep cutting board
summary: A water cup with a straw and no lid was on a cutting board in the prep area. The cup must be moved away from the prep area.

headline: Hand sink misplaced; no hot water control
summary: The hand sink was placed outside the bar area instead of inside it. The bar three-compartment sink lacked a grease trap and mixing valves, and it leaked. A priority violation was noted, but no citation was issued.

headline: Hot water too cool; mold and cold food; failed
summary: Handwashing sink water measured between 73.2 and 97.2°F and must reach 100°F. A high-temperature dish machine rinse was 170°F, below the required 180°F. Cold food held at 47.6 to 58.6°F was discarded, and a citation was issued. Mold-like spots were cleaned on site.

headline: Burnt-out light and debris; allergen certificate expired
summary: The all-gender toilet room had no covered trash receptacle. Debris was on floors and along walls in the rear prep area. A light bulb over the three-compartment sink was burnt out. A certified manager's allergen certificate had expired.

headline: Failed: no health policy, coolers, and hot water
summary: No employee health policy was available. Coolers in the bar area were not working and must be repaired to 41°F or below. There was no hand-washing sign, no test kit for sanitizer strength, and no hot water at multiple sinks, with a citation issued.

headline: Ice bin needs cleaning; no hair restraints
summary: The ice bin interior needed cleaning. Food handlers were preparing food without hair restraints and were told to wear them at all times.

headline: Produce and sauces on basement floor; complaint pass
summary: Buckets of produce and sauces were stored on the floor in the basement dry storage and must be raised at least 6 inches. Scoops were stored with handles touching food in dry storage bins and must be stored correctly.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods prepared
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken, sandwiches, and mashed potatoes were prepared and served. A citation was issued. A one-compartment prep sink leaked, and the rear prep floor has large gaps that must be re-grouted.

headline: No certified manager on site; utensils misplaced
summary: No person in charge or food employee with a certified food manager certificate was on site at inspection. A citation was issued. Wiping cloths were drying on and above the rear hand sink, and knives were stored between counters and cutting boards.

headline: Ice build-up inside prep cooler; passed
summary: Ice had built up inside a prep cooler near the pizza oven. Staff were told to correct and maintain the cooler. No other problems were noted.

headline: Mouse droppings in storage; failed
summary: Inspector found 40 to 50 mouse droppings on the floor in rear storage, along the chip aisle, and near the walk-in cooler. Staff were told to clean all areas and have pest control service before re-inspection, with a citation issued. A gap at the front door and a leaking faucet were also noted.

headline: Front door needs rodent proofing; floors dirty
summary: The bottom of the front entrance door must be made rodent-proof. Floors along walls and in corners in the basement dry storage and the basement restroom need cleaning. No pests were reported.

headline: Food debris on walk-in floor; burnt-out bulb
summary: A women's employee restroom lacked a covered receptacle. Food debris was found on the walk-in cooler floor and needs cleaning. A light shield was missing in a storage room, and a burnt-out bulb was in the walk-in cooler.

headline: Wiping cloth on cutting board; re-inspection passed
summary: A re-inspection passed. A wiping cloth was on top of a cutting board in the meat department, and cutting boards had deep stains and cuts. Holes in walls where baseboard tiles are broken and water damage were noted.

headline: Damaged floor tiles in rear dish area; re-inspection passed
summary: Damaged floor tiles were found throughout the rear dish area. The manager must repair them and maintain the floor.

headline: No hand-washing sign; cleanup supplies missing
summary: There were no supplies or procedure for cleaning up vomit or diarrhea, which was listed as a priority violation with no citation. A women's restroom lacked a hand-washing sign. The ice machine lacked a backflow device, and basement clutter must be removed to prevent rodent hiding spots.

headline: Expired allergen certificate; citation issued
summary: A certified manager on duty had an expired allergen certificate, which was a repeat violation from a prior inspection. The manager must renew it, and a citation was issued.

headline: Dusty hood; lights out; missing toilet door closer
summary: Heavy dust covered the hood ventilation system and filters, and two lights were out under the hood. Food splatter and grease were on walls and floors. A hand sink by the ice machine had dark build-up. A restroom door closer was missing.

headline: Maintenance tools stored improperly; re-inspection passed
summary: A re-inspection passed. Maintenance tools were stored in the rear with single-service items and dry storage and must be kept in a designated area. Food handler training was missing for employees on site.

headline: No vomit procedure; no certified manager; failed
summary: No written procedure or supplies for vomit or diarrhea cleanup were on site. A cold holding unit was at 58.5°F and must be 41°F or below. The facility lacked a pest log and had holes, missing light shields, and no ventilation in the all-gender restroom.

headline: Low hot water pressure at dishwashing sink
summary: Hot water pressure was low at the handwashing sink in the dishwashing area. Water pressure must be increased and maintained.

headline: No certified manager present; citation
summary: No certified food manager was on duty or certificate posted while chicken, dressing, and greens were prepared and served. A citation was issued. Other problems include no food handler training, broken glass, a missing cooler handle, and grease and dirt build-up.

headline: Grease on cooking equipment; hood heavily soiled
summary: A wiping cloth was left on a prep table instead of in sanitizing solution. Grease was on the outside of cooking equipment and on the floor around it. Heavy dirt and grease built up inside the exhaust hood and filters.

headline: Uncovered food and unlabeled containers
summary: Food storage containers lacked labels with food names. Food in prep areas and coolers was uncovered and needs lids or covers. Scoops were stored inside food containers. The ice machine had a plastic covering and a missing lid. No certified manager had allergen training.

headline: Gaps, broken ceiling tiles, burnt-out lights; re-inspection
summary: A re-inspection passed. Gaps at the front door, dirty vents, and dirty dumpster areas need correction. Other issues were missing hand-wash signs, broken ceiling tiles, missing light covers and out bulbs, and no food handler training for handlers.

headline: Thawing method, broken equipment, expired training
summary: Salsa cups were thawed in a prep sink instead of under running water or in refrigeration. A hot-hold unit, a low-temperature dish machine, and a cooler gasket were not working. Several employees had expired food handler training, and the manager's allergen training was expired.

headline: Hand sink faucets not turning on
summary: Two of three hand-washing sink faucets did not turn on properly. Staff were told to repair them according to the law.

headline: Dead flies and debris; re-inspection passed
summary: A re-inspection passed, but inspector found excessive dead flies on the floor in rear storage, under unused cooking equipment, and under slot machines. Unused equipment was stored on the floor and must be raised 6 inches. Trash and food debris were under shelving and in the walk-in.

headline: No food handler certificate on site
summary: No food handler certificate was on site for a food handler employee. The person in charge was told to get the training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Torn freezer gaskets; grease build-up; re-inspection passed
summary: A re-inspection passed. Door gaskets on the walk-in freezer are torn and must be repaired. Grease and debris are under the fryer, and dust and grease are on the kitchen hood.

headline: Expired food handler training; leaking walk-in fan
summary: Several food employees had expired food handler training, and the manager on duty lacked allergen training. A fan inside the walk-in cooler was leaking and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: No certified manager; cream cheese held; failed
summary: No certified food manager was on site while cream cheese and other hot or cold foods were being prepared and served. Multiple issues include a leaking sink with mold, dirty dish machine floor, missing food handler training, and an inaccurate thermometer. A citation was issued.

headline: Mouse droppings throughout; failed inspection
summary: Inspector found 100 to 120 mouse droppings throughout the premises, including the front register area, storage shelves, prep area, and washroom. Staff were told to clean and sanitize all areas and call pest control, and a citation was issued. Hand soap was also missing, and food containers on the floor needed to be raised.

headline: Dusty ceiling vents; re-inspection passed
summary: A re-inspection passed. Ceiling vent covers above the warewashing and service line are heavily soiled with dust and debris and must be cleaned.

headline: Peeling paint in dry storage; items on floor
summary: Doorway paint in the dry storage room was peeling and must be repaired. Items were stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and dry storage and must be raised at least 6 inches. Re-inspection passed.

headline: No hot water at handwashing sinks; failed
summary: Handwashing sinks in both restrooms had no hot running water, with temperatures between 65.7 and 70°F. Water must reach at least 100°F. Also missing were an employee health policy, a vomit and diarrhea cleanup plan, a pest control logbook, and chemical test strips. A water leak and a missing backflow device were noted.

headline: Food stored on floors; debris and leaks
summary: Food was stored on floors in rear storage, the walk-in cooler, and basement and must be raised 6 inches. Bulk containers were uncovered, and dirty plastic bowls were used as serving utensils. Food debris and spills were found in several areas, and a drain leaked under a hand sink.

headline: Unlabeled salt; stained ceiling tiles; no backflow device
summary: Seasoned salt and other containers lacked common-name labels and must be labeled. A utility sink had no backflow device, which must be installed. Stained ceiling tiles throughout the facility must be replaced, and a non-working hood in the rear prep area must be repaired.

headline: Leaking faucet and slow drain at dish sink
summary: A rear three-compartment sink faucet was leaking, and one hot water faucet was broken and turned off. The sink drain was slow. Staff were told to repair all three issues.

headline: Dish machine too cool; citation; technician called
summary: The dish machine gave a final utensil temperature of 154°F, but it must reach 160°F. A technician was called to service it, and a citation was issued. Soil and debris were under and around equipment in the bar and service line.

headline: Missing floor grout and cracked tiles in prep
summary: Floor grout is missing and tiles are cracked in the prep area. The floor must be repaired to be smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Milk crates used as shelves; no self-closing doors
summary: Milk crates were being used to elevate stored items and must not be used. Both restroom doors lacked self-closing devices. A third certified food manager needs allergen training certificates.

headline: Food residue in coolers; leaking hand sink
summary: Food residue was found on walk-in shelving and inside cold-holding units. The ice machine door was dirty. A hand sink in the prep area was leaking from a lower pipe, and walls and floors around equipment need cleaning and repair.

headline: Missing hand-washing signs; ice machine door dirty
summary: Hand-washing signage was missing at hand sinks in the rear prep area. The inside of the ice machine door needs cleaning. A partition is needed to protect a cutting board next to a cold-holding unit, and stored sodas and buckets must be raised 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Missing paper towels; leaking grease trap; citation
summary: No paper towels were at the banquet dishwashing hand sink. A leaking grease trap sent wastewater onto the prep floor, which was fixed during the report. Ready-to-eat food was not date marked, and a citation was issued. Other problems were cloth, soil, and label issues.

headline: Missing hand-washing signs; debris in prep areas
summary: Hand-washing signs were missing at sinks in both front and rear prep areas. A splash guard is needed by the hand sink next to the meat slicer, and utensils must be stored upside down. Debris was found on shelves, floors, and hood tops, and some trim and wall splatter needs repair or cleaning.

headline: Grease and debris throughout; manager to clean
summary: Food debris and grease were found on cooking equipment, fryers, coolers, prep tables, and shelving. Walls, floors, ceiling tiles, and vents were dusty or greasy throughout the facility. The manager was told to clean and maintain all areas.

headline: Dirty ice machine; cold food and sanitizer issues
summary: The ice machine in the lobby needed cleaning. Three-compartment sink had no sanitizer, which was corrected on site with chlorine. Sour cream and chipotle aioli were held too warm, and about 7 pounds was discarded.

headline: Food stored on floor; leaking pipes found
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and must be raised 6 inches. Serving scoops were disposable containers without handles, and staff were told to use tongs or ladles. Leaks were found at a prep handwashing sink and under the three-compartment sink. Missing allergen training for a manager was also cited.

headline: Unlabeled sugar and missing pest log; passed with conditions
summary: An unlabeled container of sugar was corrected on site before the inspection ended. No pest control log was on the premises, and a log with licensed pest company reports was added on site. Other items were a missing covered receptacle in a restroom and some burned-out ceiling lights.

headline: No hand-washing signs; low water pressure
summary: Hand-washing signs or posters were missing near sinks in prep, dishwashing, and restroom areas. A prep cooler door gasket was torn. Water pressure was too low at the front prep hand sink. No citation was issued.

headline: Unlabeled refrigerated food; dirty walls and hood
summary: Food items inside refrigerators were not labeled with product names. Walls and ceilings in the rear dishwashing area were stained and dusty. Heavy dirt and grease built up inside the exhaust hood and filters above the cooking equipment.

headline: No certified manager while chicken served
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken and other time/temperature foods were cooked and served. A citation was issued. No allergen training proof was provided for certified food managers.

headline: No certified manager; sanitizer missing
summary: No certified food manager was present while coffee with milk was being prepared and served. The manager arrived at 10:11 AM. Chlorine sanitizer was missing and was delivered on site. A citation was issued.

headline: Ice machine slime; must be cleaned and sanitized
summary: The first-floor restaurant ice machine had heavy black and pink slime build-up dripping onto ice for people to eat. The build-up must be removed, the machine cleaned, and sanitized, and a citation was issued.

headline: Scoop handles touching food; passed
summary: Scoops stored throughout the facility had handles touching food in dry storage bins, and staff were told to store them so handles don't touch food. Single-use items were left with exposed food-contact surfaces and must be inverted. Grease build-up was found on the floor below the wok station.

headline: Dirty freezer shelf and water-damaged ceiling tile
summary: The bottom shelf of an upright freezer must be cleaned, and the walk-in cooler fan cover and ceiling need cleaning. A water-damaged ceiling tile and light shield in the paper goods room must be replaced.

headline: Rat droppings and no certified manager; failed
summary: Inspector found 7 rat droppings along walls in the dishwashing area, and staff must notify pest control and remove them. No certified sanitation manager was on premises while fish and chicken were handled, and 10 pounds of unlabeled fish was discarded. Food handler and allergen certificates were missing.

headline: Mobile food truck: no health policy; hot water low
summary: No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies were on site for the mobile food vehicle. Hot water could not reach 110°F at the three-compartment sink or 100°F at the hand sink. A priority violation was issued.

headline: Cleaning needed on equipment and vents
summary: One bulk container lacked a product name label. Equipment bottoms, refrigerator interiors, and the walk-in produce cooler need cleaning. A steamer side panel is missing, and some vents in the hood system need cleaning.

headline: Cooked beans held too warm; discarded
summary: About 30 pounds of cooked beans in the walk-in cooler were held at 54 to 55°F and were discarded. Hot-holding units lacked air thermometers. Cardboard was used as a shelf liner, and rusty shelves and protective film on baseboards were found.

headline: Unapproved beef jerky process; 50 lbs discarded
summary: The facility was making beef jerky without the required variance from the health department. The manager discarded 50 pounds of dried beef held at 74°F during the inspection, and a citation was issued. Other problems were unlabeled packaged meats, raw wood shelving, and cracks in walls.

headline: Ice build-up on cooler condenser; passed
summary: Ice has built up on the condenser of a prep-area cooler. The ice must be removed and kept clear.

headline: Re-inspection: grease, labels, and wall damage
summary: A re-inspection passed. Food storage containers need labels, and grease and debris need cleaning from equipment and shelves. A wall at the front prep entry is damaged, and filters and hood need debris removed.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; failed inspection
summary: The walk-in cooler measured 45°F, above the 41°F limit. A gasket had a 4-inch gap. The three-compartment sink was not working properly, and shelving, floors, and walls had soil build-up. No citation was issued.

headline: Flies found in dining and prep areas; failed
summary: Inspector saw about 5 large flies and 20 small flies in the front and rear prep, dishwashing and dining areas. Staff were told to remove the flies and clean affected areas, and a licensed pest control service was recommended. Expired food handler training was also found, and a citation was issued.

headline: Missing trash lid in restroom; collapsed ceiling
summary: The all-gender restroom in the rear had no covered trash receptacle. Some ceiling panels in the restroom had collapsed. Staff were told to provide and repair these items.

headline: Knife stored by sink, corrected on site
summary: A knife was stored between the handwashing sink and the wall. The manager corrected this on site by having the knife washed, rinsed, and sanitized. Cutting boards in the fresh meat area are worn with deep cuts and must be replaced.

headline: Torn gaskets on reach-in cooler
summary: Gaskets on the inside of a two-door reach-in cooler in the rear were torn. Staff were told to repair and maintain them.

headline: Cold food and cooler too warm; discarded
summary: Milk, chicken sandwiches, yogurt, and salad mix were held at 44.7 to 52°F in service coolers. The manager discarded 16 pounds. A service cooler at 54°F was ordered not to be used until it reaches 41°F or below.

headline: Raw pork and cooked food held too warm; failed
