summary: Raw pork was held at 53°F in a prep cooler. Cooked taco meat, beans, tomatoes, and sausage were held at 47 to 51°F. The cooler air was 50°F. A certified manager lacked allergen training, and no raw-egg consumer advisory was on the menu.

headline: Ice bin needs cleaning; unlabeled containers
summary: The ice bin interior needed cleaning and was to be cleaned and maintained at all times. Food storage containers lacked labels with food common names. The sanitation manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Food workers without hair restraints; re-inspection passed
summary: Food employees were found without hair restraints during a re-inspection that passed. Staff must wear hair restraints at all times.

headline: Dirty can opener; mop sink needed
summary: A large can opener needed cleaning to remove build-up. The facility must install a mop sink, which was listed as a backflow issue. No other problems were noted.

headline: Food stored on walk-in floor; cutting boards scratched
summary: Multiple pots of food were stored on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised 6 inches. Waste pipes in the basement food storage area were not shielded. Cutting boards had deep scratches and stains, and some ceiling panels above the walk-in were missing.

headline: No certified manager; stained cutting boards
summary: No certified food manager or valid documentation was on site while eggs, cheeseburgers, and chicken were being prepared and served. Staff were told to post certificates. A citation was issued, and stained cutting boards must be resurfaced or replaced.

headline: Dirty drains and fryers; leaking sink
summary: Floor drains in two kitchens need detail cleaning. Fryer openings have grease build-up, and the walk-in floor and fan covers need cleaning. Two leaks were found at the rear three-compartment sink.

headline: Frozen fish thawing issue; missing splashguard
summary: Reduced-oxygen fish marked keep-frozen was displayed refrigerated, which must be thawed under refrigeration after removal from packaging. A splashguard was missing between the hand sink and three-compartment sink. Floors were worn and uneven.

headline: Gaps in rear door; floors and cluttered areas
summary: The rear door has gaps that allow pests in and must be sealed. A partition is needed to prevent splashing from the front prep hand sink. Water-stained ceiling tiles, dirty floors, and unnecessary items in the rear dining area were also found.

headline: Undercooked food not marked on menu; failed
summary: Animal-derived foods that can be served undercooked were not marked with an asterisk, and the menu had no disclosure. Openings at several exterior doors need sealing to keep pests out. Ceramic mugs were found, and the employee fan was not working. Allergen and food handler training documents were missing.

headline: Dusty drying racks; leaking sink faucet
summary: A re-inspection passed. Utensil drying racks above the three-compartment sink were heavily soiled with dust and dried food. The sink faucet leaks and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: About 400 mouse droppings; infestation; citation
summary: Inspector found a rodent infestation with about 400 mouse droppings in the dishwashing room, storage rooms, break area, dining room, and cabinets. Additional pest control service is needed, and a citation was issued. Hand sink water reached 122°F and must stay between 100 and 120°F.

headline: Black slime in basement ice machine; citation
summary: An ice machine in the basement, used to make ice for people to eat, had black slime build-up inside. Ice must be removed, and the machine cleaned and sanitized. A citation was issued, and torn gaskets on a rear prep cooler must be repaired.

headline: Hot dog buns stored in grocery bags
summary: Hot dog buns were stored in the walk-in cooler in grocery thank-you bags. Staff were told to store buns and other food in food-grade bags or containers. A blue wall near the dishwashing hand sink was splattered with food and had chipped paint.

headline: Torn gaskets on prep cooler doors; re-inspection passed
summary: A re-inspection passed. The rubber gaskets on the three-door prep cooler were ripped and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Failed: no hot water, hand-washing violations, holes
summary: Staff were not washing hands properly and was seen handling food after touching his face and trash, with a citation issued. Dishes were not being washed correctly due to no hot water, and kitchen temperatures were around 74°F. Holes were found in ceilings and walls, and the most recent inspection summary was not posted.

headline: Floor needs grouting
summary: Floor in the prep and dish area must be grouted where needed to make it smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Gap in side door; wastewater backup
summary: Side door had a 1/4-inch gap at bottom and side. Wastewater backed up at a floor drain when prep sinks drained; a plumber arrived and drainage was restored on site (citation issued). Cold holding units and walk-in shelving were dirty; manager allergen certificate expired.

headline: Walk-in cooler door can't be opened from inside
summary: Broken release knob inside the walk-in cooler means the door cannot be opened from inside; must be replaced. Excess ice at the walk-in freezer condenser and a broken freezer door gasket. No allergen training certificates for managers.

headline: Sour cream tubs reused for broth
summary: Sour cream containers were being reused to store meat broth in the prep area. Staff were told not to reuse single-service containers and to use only food-grade storage bags or containers.

headline: Live flying insects found in prep and storage
summary: About 16 live small flying insects were found on ceilings, equipment and stock boxes in the food prep, dish, dry storage and manager's office. Additional pest control service is needed. Citation issued.

headline: Dirty fryer filter, equipment, floors, and vents
summary: Oil filter machine needs detailed cleaning to remove food and buildup. Equipment sides had food splatter. Floors and walls need cleaning. Air vents throughout have dust buildup and need detail cleaning.

headline: Grease on fryer and cooking equipment
summary: Grease buildup was on the inside of the fryer door and sides of cooking equipment. Brown substance and food debris in the drain under the 3-compartment sink. Dust and grease on floors around cooking equipment. Instructed to clean.

headline: Trash under bar and sink; dim cooler light
summary: Trash and debris were under the bar counter and the 3-compartment sink; staff were told to clean and maintain. Lighting in the rear walk-in cooler was inadequate and must be improved.

headline: No certified manager during deli prep
summary: No city certified food manager was on premises while deli sandwiches were prepared and served; citation issued. No proof of allergen training for certified managers was on site.

headline: Front door gap at bottom
summary: Left entrance door had a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom. Instructed to make the door tight-fitting and rodent proof.

headline: Ceiling hole; dirty floors; repeat violations
summary: A hole in the ceiling of the dining-area utility closet must be repaired. Dirty floors and walls in prep and storage, plus the mop sink and pipes behind cooking equipment, need cleaning. Prior violations not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Missing raw-food advisory; food stored on floor
summary: Menu lacked the required consumer advisory for raw or undercooked animal foods. Food containers stored on floors and single-service items not inverted. Food debris and spills throughout the facility. Citation issued.

headline: Rusty racks; dirty fryers; no allergen proof
summary: Basement walk-in cooler racks were rusty. Fryers and oven had food and grease buildup. Employee restroom wall was cracked; food splatter on kitchen ceiling and dirty floors. Certified manager had no allergen training certificate.

headline: No handwash signs; repeat violations; failed
summary: No handwashing signs at two front handwash stations. Dirt and food debris on floors under equipment and the coffee station. Repeat violations: openings at entrance doors, damaged gaskets, and no mechanical ventilation in employee washroom. Citation issued.

headline: No food manager certificate; water and sink failures
summary: No city food manager certificate was posted, and no employee health policy or spill kit was on site. Dish machine measured 0 ppm chlorine. Several sinks lacked soap or paper towels; one restroom sink had no water; another ran only 86°F.

headline: Loose faucet knobs; rust; floors need cleaning
summary: Rust at the bottom of a prep table in dishwashing area needs to be removed. Hot-water knob in women's restroom and cold-water knob in men's restroom are loose. Floors under and around equipment in cooking and dish areas need cleaning.

headline: No sink stoppers; greasy hood; allergen gap
summary: No working stoppers for the 3-compartment sink. Slight buildup inside the ice machine and grease buildup in the ventilation hood and filters must be cleaned. Food manager had no allergen training certificate.

headline: Cracked cooler door; broken urinal
summary: Plastic sliding door on the front line cooler is cracked and missing a piece; must be replaced. Urinal in the men's employee washroom is in poor repair and not working; must be repaired or removed. Toaster oven on site not in use.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure
summary: No written procedure or cleanup kit for vomit or diarrhea events was on site. A one-page guide was left and staff were told to keep a kit with norovirus-effective sanitizer. Employee restroom trash can had no lid.

headline: No test strip kit; food in grocery bags
summary: No sanitizer test strip kit was on site; citation issued. Serving plates on shelves were not inverted. Torn gasket on prep cooler and a 2-door refrigerator. Food stored in grocery bags in coolers. Dusty fans and greasy hood.

headline: No certified manager; hand sink water at 49°F
summary: No city certified food manager was on site while hot dogs, pizza and meats were prepared; citation issued. Rotisserie-area handsink water measured 49°F, below the required 100°F; a plumber restored 100°F on site. Also: restroom lid missing, spills near ovens.

headline: Unlabeled food; food on floor; greasy floors
summary: Food in coolers and dry storage lacked name labels. Containers, pans and racks stored on floor in rear prep. Interior of all coolers needs cleaning. Grease and dirt on floors under equipment. No allergen certificate for the certified manager.

headline: No soap; cooked food cooling too slowly
summary: No soap at the cook-line handsink and no paper towels at the dish handsink; citation issued. Cooked chicken (111.2°F) and potatoes (105°F) cooled too slowly; foods discarded. No working metal-stem thermometer on site. Open beverage in prep area.

headline: Grocery bags in freezer; expired allergen proof
summary: Some food was stored in grocery bags in the rear deep freezer; food-grade bags or containers were required. No proper sink stoppers for the 3-compartment sink. Floor corners need cleaning. Certified manager's allergen certificate was expired.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep
summary: No certified food manager was present while coffee with milk and bean breakfast tacos were prepared; citation issued. Also noted: food stored on basement floor, drips from a sewer line above beverages, a torn cooler gasket, and a missing sink stopper.

headline: No food handler training; leaking drain
summary: No valid food handler training was available, and the manager on duty had no allergen training. Leaking drainpipe under rear handsink. Debris and spills on cooking equipment, coolers, and floors. Restroom has no covered trash or ventilation fan.

headline: Missing handwashing sign at prep sink
summary: No handwashing sign was posted at the prep-area handsink. Signs are required at all handsinks used by employees.

headline: Fly strips in dish area; open screen doors
summary: Fly strips were hanging in the dish area and screen doors had large openings; manager was told to remove the strips and add 16-mesh screen. Also noted: no backflow device on utility sink, soiled mop water, and no food handler or allergen training.

headline: Floors need cleaning; no handler certificates
summary: Floors in rear prep behind heavy equipment need cleaning and food debris removal. Food handler certificates were not available for all food employees; staff were told to provide them and keep them on site.

headline: No city certified manager; employee spat in trash
summary: No city certified food manager was on site while chicken and beef were prepared; citation issued. An employee spat into a garbage can in the prep area. Rear door has a 1/2–1 inch gap and must be made rodent and insect proof. Food handlers lacked proof of training.

headline: Dish machines not sanitizing; beef too warm
summary: Two of three low-temperature dish machines sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine; one was tagged and held. Beef measured 77–86°F in the walk-in cooler; manager said it had been cooling over 2 hours. A cooling chart was required. Citations issued.

headline: Live cockroach found in basement storage
summary: One live cockroach was crawling on the floor of a basement storage room attached to the prep area; pest control was instructed. Citation issued. Torn cooler gaskets, overflowing outdoor garbage bags in open bins, and holes in the ceiling above the dish machine.

headline: No employee health policy; no backflow device
summary: No employee health policies were on premises; priority violation. No backflow device at utility sink and washroom door is not self-closing. Food handlers were instructed to obtain required food handler training.

headline: No handwash signs; dirty drain under sink
summary: No handwashing signs were at the front and rear handwash stations. Dirt and slimy buildup were found inside the 3-compartment sink drain and under it; staff were told to clean it to prevent possible insect activity. Broken refrigerator handle taped.

headline: Missing handwash signs; rear door gap
summary: No handwashing signs were posted at handsinks in bars and bussing areas; signs are required. Opening at base of the rear exit door leading to the alley must be sealed.

headline: Food spillage on equipment; light out
summary: Food spillage on sides of front service equipment and buildup inside a low-reach cooler. Dirt and debris on floors under and around equipment. Dust on A/C vents. Light out over the rear handsink.

headline: No certified manager during fish, pork, chicken
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while fish, pork and chicken were prepared, handled and served. Citation issued.

headline: Leaking pipe under 3-compartment sink
summary: A leaky pipe was noted under the 3-compartment sink. The manager was instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: Missing handwash signs; trash cover
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at toilet-room handsinks. Trash receptacle in the women's restroom had no cover. Both were instructed to be provided and maintained.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep
summary: No city certified food manager was on site while hot dogs, pizza and wings were prepared and served; citation issued. An employee had no food handler certificate, a repeat violation. Also: coffee spills, leaking pipe, and mop stored in standing water.

headline: Floor buildup under sink; dusty vent
summary: Floors under the 3-compartment sink need cleaning to remove buildup. Air vent in the front prep line has dust buildup and needs cleaning.

headline: Missing thermometer; duct-taped equipment
summary: No thermometer was found inside a 2-door cooler in front prep. Bulk ingredients lacked labels. A sliding cooler door was broken, and chest freezers were held together with duct tape. Certified manager had no allergen training proof. Citation issued.

headline: Cold food above 41°F; 15 pounds discarded
summary: Liquid eggs (48.6°F), ham (58.6°F), chicken breast (48.6°F) and other cold-held foods were above 41°F; 15 lbs ($250) discarded on site. Also: employee drank from an uncovered cup near food, sink backs up, moldy walk-in cooler, and crumbling basement brick.

headline: Over 80 mouse droppings; dish machine at 0 ppm
summary: Over 80 mouse droppings were found in storage rooms, employee washroom and dining room. Pest control was recommended and citation issued. Low-temperature dish machine at 0 ppm chlorine, tagged and held. Cold beans at 72.7°F discarded.

headline: Over 50 mouse droppings; open basement windows
summary: Over 50 mouse droppings were on a basement ledge and scattered on the floor; staff were told to remove them and call pest control. Basement windows have large screen openings and need 1/16-inch mesh or closed windows. Foil under flat top grill.

headline: Empty soap dispensers fixed on site
summary: Broken soap dispensers in two washrooms and the rear prep and dish area could not dispense soap. Manager replaced them with working dispensers and soap on site (corrected). Also: no thermometer in walk-in cooler, unlabeled containers, and dirty basement floors.

headline: Live flying insects found; sink blocked
summary: About 20 live small flying insects were found on walls in prep areas, behind the bar, and in the laundry room; more pest control is needed. A handwashing sink was blocked by buns. Several workers lacked hair restraints. Citations issued.

headline: Roach infestation and rat droppings found
summary: Live roaches found: about 40 in prep and dining areas, 4 inside prep coolers, and others. Over 30 rat droppings in a utility closet. Manager must remove roaches and droppings and call pest control. Citation issued. Also: no allergen certificate for food manager.

headline: Cardboard on shelving
summary: Cardboard was on shelving in the rear storage area. Person in charge was instructed to remove it to keep shelves smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving in prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor. Grease buildup on cooking equipment and walls; excess ice and debris in walk-in freezer and cooler.

headline: Front door gap; mold-like buildup in cooler
summary: Bottom of the front entrance door must be rodent-proofed. White mold-like buildup was found on storage racks inside the walk-in cooler and must be detail cleaned.

headline: Wiping cloths on prep tables; bowl in rice
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables instead of sanitizer. A bowl was stored inside rice, a food item, and must be replaced with a proper utensil. Food debris on cooking equipment, holding units, coolers and freezers; floor debris.

headline: Food stored on floors; unlabeled packaged items
summary: Food items were stored on the floor behind the front counter and in sales, prep, storage and walk-in areas; staff were told to elevate them six inches. Packaged cheesecake lacked proper labels. Stoppers missing for the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Cooler at 55°F; dead roaches on glue traps
summary: Grill drawer cooler measured 55°F, too warm for cold food. Food was moved to a working cooler; equipment tagged and must be repaired before use. About 50–60 dead roaches were on glue traps in basement; no live pests seen. Greasy ceiling tiles.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate posted
summary: No valid city food sanitation certificate was posted for food employees. Person in charge was told the original certificate must be posted with the certified manager on site when TCS foods are stored. Citation issued.

headline: No employee health policy; damaged cutting board
summary: No employee health policy was on site; priority violation. Cutting board was stained and grooved and must be repaired or replaced. Freezer gasket was in poor repair, held with tape.

headline: Gaskets torn; dirty equipment; improper hood
summary: Torn gaskets on a prep cooler and dirty reach-in units were noted. Floors under and behind cooking equipment need detail cleaning. The panini station has an improper ventilation system; a hood that pulls grease fumes out is required.

headline: Floor debris in prep area
summary: Debris was found on floors along walls and in corners of the prep area. Manager was instructed to clean and maintain the area.

headline: Raw egg gloves on ready-to-eat sandwich; temps
summary: Employee handled a ready-to-eat sandwich with gloves coated in raw egg; food discarded and hands washed on site. Cooked potatoes (74.5°F), milk (51.2°F) and chocolate milk (50.1°F) were discarded. No thermometer in the server-area cooler.

headline: Food debris in pizza-prep cooler
summary: Two-door refrigeration unit in pizza prep had excessive food debris and spills inside; wire shelves must be cleaned. Floors near the front pizza prep, walk-in cooler and rear storage room need trash and debris removed.

headline: Rear kitchen door left open
summary: Rear kitchen door was found open; management was told to keep exit doors to the outside closed to prevent pests. Aluminum foil was used as a liner on cooking equipment and must be removed or replaced.

headline: Beard guard needed; clutter; hood grease
summary: An employee with a long beard had no beard guard. Heavy clutter in the basement could give pests hiding places. Heavy dirt and grease in the hood, filters, and pipes must be cleaned.

headline: No visible cooler thermometer; soiled mop
summary: No visible internal thermometer was found in the cooler; one must be provided. A soiled mop was stored in a bucket at the kitchen handsink and must be moved to the utility sink or a tool closet.

headline: No certified manager during milk and cream handling
summary: No certified food manager was on site while cream and milk were being handled and served; staff were instructed to obtain one. Slow drainage at the 3-compartment sink needs repair.

headline: Food served without handsink; missing ceiling tiles
summary: Hot soup and rice were dispensed at the front server station with no handwashing sink; a sink must be installed or food moved. Missing and water-damaged ceiling tiles, broken floor tiles, and pooling water in basement. No manager allergen certificate.

headline: No cold holding units or hot water
summary: No cold holding unit was on premises for butter, half-and-half, or ice cream. No hot running water; temperatures measured 67.3–71.4°F, below required levels. Norovirus cleanup supplies missing. Opening at front entrance. Citation issued.

headline: Chicken thawed in standing water
summary: Frozen chicken was thawing in a container of standing water in the prep area. Management was told to thaw all TCS (time and temperature controlled for safety) foods properly. Also noted: wiping cloths on prep tables, greasy fryer filter, and soiled mop heads.

headline: No employee health policy on site
summary: No proof of an employee health policy was on site; citation issued. Also noted: utensils not inverted, dirty cooking and cold-holding equipment, restroom garbage without lid, dirty floors, an idle ice machine, and no manager allergen training certificate.

headline: No sanitation certificate; sink and gap issues
summary: No city sanitation certificate was on site while milk, slushy and coffee were handled; citation issued. Rear 3-compartment area needs a handwashing sink, also cited. Gap at front door, leaking drain, and no food handler certificates.

headline: Dried food debris on prep tables and coolers
summary: Prep tables and cooler interiors had dried food debris; these must be cleaned and sanitized. Floor drains had built-up organic matter. Food debris was found under plumbing fixtures and next to heavy equipment. Hood grates need cleaning.

headline: Scoops left in product; cardboard liners
summary: Small plastic cups used as scoops were left inside barbecue and hot sauce containers. Cardboard was used as shelf liner at the front counter and prep table. Men's room toilet bowl was missing its lid and had plastic covering. Instructed to correct.

headline: No food handler certificates; door won't close
summary: No food handler certificates for required employees were provided. The certified manager had no allergen training certificate. Bathroom door is not self-closing. Dirt and food debris on floor drains in the rear dishwashing area.

headline: Prep cooler too warm; fixed on site
summary: Prep cooler bottom measured 50.2°F and top 46.0°F; temperature was adjusted and met compliance during inspection. Also noted: no thermometer in the vehicle hot box, unsecured cooler doors while in motion, debris, no garbage lids, and an expired food handler certificate.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; dusty condenser
summary: Rubber gaskets on the 3-door prep cooler were ripped and must be repaired or replaced. Dust had built up on the rear of the walk-in cooler condenser and must be cleaned.

headline: Four dead insects in basement
summary: Four dead insects were found on the basement floor; staff were told to sweep them up. Some oil was on the floor beside a prep table and needed cleaning.

headline: Minor leak under 3-compartment sink
summary: A minor leak was observed at the drain pipe below the 3-compartment sink next to the dish machine. The leak must be repaired.

headline: Repeat violation: no allergen training proof
summary: Certified food manager did not have proof of valid allergen awareness training. This is a repeat of a prior violation; citation issued.

headline: Expired food handler cards; no allergen proof
summary: Two food handler cards on site were expired. No covered trash can in the restroom closest to the rear exit. Slight debris inside the ice machine. No allergen training certificates were on site for certified managers.

headline: Openings at entrance; missing handwash signs
summary: Openings were found along the single front door and at the base of the revolving door; all outer openings must be sealed. Also noted: no handwashing sign in men's restroom, missing prep sink, unlabeled espresso backflow, and cracked floor.

headline: Earlier pest-entry violation not corrected
summary: A food handler had no training certificate. A priority violation from a prior inspection was not fixed: openings at the rear exit door allow pest entry. Citation issued; correction was due by 12/5/2025.

headline: Gap under double doors
summary: A 1/4-inch gap was found between the outside double door sweeps. Doors must be rodent proofed.

headline: Broken freezer shelves; leaking drain; mold
summary: Broken shelves in the hot foods walk-in freezer were covered in ice. Drainpipe leaking under bakery 3-compartment sink. Moldy caulking around meat-packing sink. Burned-out bulb in the bakery walk-in cooler.

headline: Low-temperature handwash water; openings
summary: Men's first-floor handsinks measured 90.9°F and 93.9°F; the required minimum is 100°F. Openings at the dock door and front entrance doors must be sealed. Also noted: no handwashing sign at stove room sink, no temperature indicator, and debris around dumpsters.

headline: No soap at dish sink; overflowing trash
summary: No soap was at the dish-area handsink; citation issued. Wet wiping cloths were on sushi cutting boards, and dumpster trash overflowed so the lid could not close (citation issued). Also noted: greasy floors, plates facing up, and jackets on food racks.

headline: Sticky ice bin; debris near equipment
summary: Non-food surfaces of the in-use ice bin in front prep were sticky with buildup. Food debris was found on exterior surfaces between heavy equipment such as warmers and ovens. Instructed to clean and sanitize.

headline: Large pots don't fit sink; leak under sink
summary: Large pots could not be immersed in the 3-compartment sink. Management must provide a written alternative warewashing procedure or remove the pots. Leak at pipe under toilet-room handsink. Toilet room door closer in poor repair.

headline: No walk-in thermometer; food in grocery bags
summary: No thermometer was found inside the walk-in cooler; staff were told to provide one. Food was stored in grocery bags in the walk-in cooler and chest freezer; staff were told to stop and use food-grade bags only.

headline: Milk at 47°F discarded; no test strips
summary: Milk was held at 47°F; manager discarded 1.5 gallons ($7). No chemical sanitizer test strips were on site; manager got strips from a nearby restaurant. Citations issued for both.

headline: Torn gasket; backflow device not located
summary: Torn door gasket on the egg cooler must be replaced. Backflow prevention device was not located at the utility mop sink and must be installed where it can be serviced. Missing light shield in the kitchen prep area.

headline: No person in charge; no certified manager
summary: No person in charge held a valid Chicago sanitation certificate. No certified manager was on site while Italian beef (172.5°F) and ground beef (170.8°F) were prepared; citation issued. Also noted: debris and spills, uninverted single-use items, and grease in the hood.

headline: No sanitizer, thermometer, or test strips
summary: No sanitizer was on the premises to sanitize dishes and utensils. No metal-stem probe thermometer was available for hot and cold food, and no chemical test strips were available for the 3-compartment sink. Management was told to provide all three.

headline: Door gaps, dirty coolers, missing allergen proof
summary: Front door had a 1/4-inch gap and rear screen door had holes; a tight seal is required. Also noted: torn cooler gasket, no backflow device, dirty coolers and floors, mop not stored to dry, and no certified manager with allergen training.

headline: Dead insects on light shields above dining
summary: Light shields above the dining area had dead insects; staff were told to clean them. Also noted: unlabeled food containers, grocery bags in freezer, a cloth liner by the pots rack, and a food handler without a training certificate.

headline: Food handler without certificate; rusty racks
summary: A food handler had no valid food handler certificate; the certified manager had no allergen certificate. Employee restroom trash needs a lid. Rusty racks in walk-in cooler and heavy ice around freezer door. Rear exit door must be rodent-proofed.

headline: Dead roaches under freezer; corrected on site
summary: Dead roaches were found at the bottom of a freezer unit; area was cleaned on site (corrected). Also noted: food stored in grocery bags, food on floors in walk-in units, greasy fryer and dusty hood needing cleaning.

headline: Dead insects under coffee station
summary: Dead insects were on the bottom shelf under the coffee station and must be removed. Salad bowls stored face up over the salad prep cooler must be inverted. Food handler certificates could not be verified; no allergen proof for managers.

headline: Dirty nozzles; lights out in walk-in freezer
summary: Beverage station nozzles need cleaning. Cabinet and cooler surfaces have food and dirt. Unused toilet room is cluttered. Walk-in freezer light is out and the front prep light flickers; both must be repaired.

headline: Small holes to outside; license number not visible
summary: Small holes leading outside were found under the hand sink and by the driver's door; inspector instructed staff to seal them. Business license number above the driver-side door was not fully visible; staff were told to move it.

headline: Food not date-marked; duct tape and rust
summary: Ready-to-eat TCS foods in the refrigerator were not date marked; citation issued. Hanging fly strips were in the prep area and must be removed. Rusty shelving, duct-taped freezer, cardboard liners, and soiled mop heads were also noted.

headline: Moldy caulking at mop sink
summary: Blackened, moldy wall caulking was found at the utility mop sink. Inspector instructed that it be replaced.

headline: No certified manager; missing sinks and thermometer
summary: No certified manager or food handler certificate on site. No handwashing sink in front food prep or rear storage areas. No probe thermometer or sanitizer test strips. No food handler training. Public-accessible sink and pizza oven must be relocated.

headline: Cold food too warm; food discarded; upkeep issues
summary: Rice, grilled chicken, and mac and cheese held at 45.8–47.6°F in rear prep cooler; 22 lbs ($150) discarded. Manager corrected missing discard-date labels on site. No allergen training on site. One employee lacks food handler certificate.

headline: Clutter, peeling paint, and slow sink drain
summary: Tinfoil and cardboard shelf liners must be removed. Raw wood wall in rear dining area must be painted and sealed. Exposed hand sink drains slowly. Peeling paint in dining area; dust inside kitchen light shields. Unused equipment on rear patio must be removed.

headline: Damaged floor tiles and grout
summary: Low floor tiles and damaged tiles at prep and dishwashing areas must be repaired or regrouted. Result: pass on complaint re-inspection.

headline: No certified manager during deli meat prep
summary: No certified manager on site while deli meat and beef were prepared. About 20 rodent droppings in chip rack and rear storage. Also: no handwashing sink in food prep area, no 3-compartment sink, no thermometer, no health policy, no cleanup kit, door gaps, and no food handler certificates.

headline: Worn rear exit door weather stripping
summary: Weather stripping on rear exit door is worn and must be replaced and maintained to prevent a possible entry point. Result: pass.

headline: Dead cockroach on food container in basement
summary: Dead cockroach found on a food container stored on a basement prep rack. Employee removed the container and placed it in the 3-compartment sink. Citation issued. No allergen training on site; must be provided for certified managers.

headline: Door gap, missing lid, and cleaning needed
summary: Gap along bottom of front door must be made tight-fitting. Restroom garbage can needs a lid. Dust on liquor shelves, coolers, and walk-in cooler must be cleaned. Hand-washing sign needed. Stained ceiling tiles, floor tiles, and wall holes need repair.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No certified food manager or certified person in charge on site while time/temperature-controlled (TCS) foods such as beef, chicken, and chorizo empanadas were prepared. Also: employee without hair restraint, stored items not elevated, dusty vents, burnt-out bulbs.

headline: No pest control log; mop sink faucet leaking
summary: No current pest control log book on premises. A licensed pest control operator must provide at least two inspections a year, with reports kept in the log. Mop sink faucet leaking and must be repaired.

headline: Heavy spills in bar coolers; grease outside
summary: Heavy spills inside wine and beer sliding coolers at bar must be cleaned and maintained. Minor grease spills on outside oil container by garbage area must be cleaned. Result: pass on re-inspection.

headline: Mouse droppings; cold chicken too warm; no health policy
summary: About 20 mouse droppings behind crates, on a ladder ledge, and near hot water tank; pest control recommended. 8 lbs of raw chicken at 49.1°F in 3-door cooler discarded. No signed health policy, cleanup kit, or probe thermometer. Dumpster lids open and overflowing.

headline: Cooler too warm; about 100 lbs food discarded
summary: Two-door cooler held air at 58.7°F. Raw proteins and about 5 dozen eggs (57–61°F) were discarded, roughly 100 lbs worth $3,500. Cooler was tagged held for inspection. Also: worn cutting boards and an unshielded light bulb.

headline: Hair restraint lacking; ice scoop and milk crates
summary: Food handler prepped food without a hair restraint; instructed that restraints are required. Ice scoop stored with exposed food-contact surface; instructed on proper storage. Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Dirty drains, floors, and leaking dump sink
summary: Drain under soda dispenser needs detail cleaning to prevent pests. Walk-in cooler floor needs detail cleaning. Dump sink in rear coffee area leaks under the bottom and must be repaired. Dirt and stains on floors under freezer and cooling units. Result: pass.

headline: No allergen training certificates on site
summary: No allergen training certificates available on site for certified food service managers; must be provided. Dust buildup on ceiling vent in prep area must be cleaned.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; damaged floors and peeling paint
summary: No handwashing signs at employee or customer sinks; must be provided. Foil liner on cooking equipment must be removed. Missing ceiling tiles, peeling paint, broken floor tiles, and dirt in employee washroom need repair or cleaning. Unused cooler must be repaired or removed.

headline: Missing thermometer, damaged gaskets, dirty surfaces
summary: Starbucks prep cooler needs a thermometer. Food must be labeled and kept off the floor in banquet walk-in freezer. Scoops must be removed from bulk containers. Repairs needed: cutting boards, cooler gaskets, leaking pipe, and damaged flooring.

headline: Cleanup kit missing; hot water and sanitizer too low
summary: No vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure or kit on premises. No handwashing sink in storage room where fresh cut fruit is prepared. Restroom hot water 79.4°F (must be 100°F+). Sanitizer measured 0 ppm; sink emptied. Spiders and webs noted. Citations issued.

headline: Cold foods too warm; service cooler unsafe
summary: Suspected food poisoning complaint. Cheese, chickpeas, yogurt, and salads held at 60–70°F; 15 lbs discarded ($90). Prep-area cooler at 64.6°F; told not to use until 41°F or below. Also: wiping cloths not kept in sanitizer, boxes on floor, torn gasket.

headline: Dead roaches found; no handwashing signs
summary: About 10 dead roaches in rear warewashing and storage area; instructed to remove and clean. No handwashing signs at front or rear sinks. Floor drains and floors under heavy equipment have dirt buildup. Heavy grease in exhaust hood above fryer.

headline: No valid manager certificate; no dumpster
summary: No valid City-certified food service manager certificate on premises. Walk-in cooler air at 79.9°F; must be 41°F or below. No metal-stem thermometer. No commercial dumpster for refuse. No allergen training certificates. No written employee health policy.

headline: Unknown substance on ice machine surface
summary: Black and brown unknown substance found on food-contact surface of ice machine. Ice is used for human consumption. Must be cleaned, sanitized, and maintained. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Raw wood shelves and water-damaged ceiling
summary: Raw wood shelves in basement storage must be painted or sealed. Water-damaged ceiling section in main kitchen prep area must be repaired to be smooth and cleanable. Result: pass.

headline: Dirty cloths, broken floor tiles, heavy dust
summary: Dirty wiping cloths on prep tables not stored in sanitizer. Ice machine water drained onto floor; must route to floor drain. Broken floor tiles and missing grout in several prep areas. Heavy dust on vents; missing light shield in rear prep.

headline: Leaking pipes, greasy floors, and dusty hood filters
summary: Grease-like liquid dripping from pipes in chemical storage area; manager instructed to repair. Grease and debris on floors around equipment must be cleaned. Dust on filters above griddle must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Display foods far too warm; 50 lbs discarded
summary: Fourteen items held unsafely on front display table, including sticky rice at 87.0°F and eggrolls at 85.0°F. Cold foods must stay at 41°F or below; hot foods at 135°F or above. About 50 lbs discarded ($600). Also: grocery bags, cardboard liners, unlabeled containers.

headline: Rusty shelves; slow sink drain; peeling paint
summary: No handwashing sign near sushi prep sink; must be provided. Rusty storage shelving in rear prep area must be repainted or replaced. Slow-draining sushi prep hand sink must be repaired. Peeling paint above food storage shelving must be repainted.

headline: Food on floor; unsafe storage; hole in wall
summary: Food containers stored on floors in basement walk-in cooler and storage areas. Prep table and knife stored in closet; must move near hand sink. Rusted racks, broken floor tiles, hole behind sink, and missing light shield. Manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Mouse droppings; cold foods too warm; coolers tagged
summary: About 75 mouse droppings on rear prep floor; additional pest control needed. Pork, chicken, and fish held at 57–60°F; 30 lbs ($250) discarded. Two coolers at 54–55°F tagged. Rear hand sink water only 63°F, below the required 100°F.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; misused scoops and utensils
summary: Bulk containers in rear storage not labeled. A cup was used as a scoop in a bulk container. A scoop sat in standing water beside the self-serve rice cooker. Self-serve utensils not inverted. Fryers, racks, and coolers need detail cleaning.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen certificates
summary: No food handler training certificates on site; must be provided. No allergen training certificate on site for certified food managers; must be provided. Result: pass.

headline: Shellfish tag missing; several upkeep issues
summary: No shellfish tag on site. Tags must stay with the container and be kept 90 days. Also: no thermometer in sushi cooler, unlabeled containers, milk crates as shelving, mold-like buildup behind sink, grease and dust, and floor debris.

headline: Roach in kitchen; dish machine temperatures too low
summary: One roach crawling in kitchen; killed on site; pest control recommended. Dish machine sanitizing rinse at 142°F, must be at least 165°F. Wash solution at 138°F, must be at least 150°F. Mold-like substance inside two ice machines. Gaps at dumpster-area garage door.

headline: Foil and cardboard liners; grease and debris
summary: Foil and cardboard used as liners on shelving and prep surfaces must be removed. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, coolers, freezers, and shelving. Floors throughout prep areas need detail cleaning. Result: pass.

headline: Raw wood shelving and basement clutter
summary: Raw wood shelving where syrup bottles are stored must be sealed to be smooth and cleanable. Clutter in the basement must be removed and the area organized to prevent rodent harborage.

headline: Peeling plastic on ice machine; unused cooler to remove
summary: Ice machine exterior has peeling plastic that must be removed to prevent contamination of ice. An unused cooler in the rear storage room must be removed. Raw wood floor and shelving under refrigeration must be sealed.

headline: Broken basement freezer; milk crates used
summary: Basement chest freezer in disrepair, with broken gaskets and a cracked lid; must be repaired or replaced. Milk crates used for storage must be removed. Result: pass on re-inspection.

headline: Moldy boba teas discarded; many upkeep issues
summary: Boba teas with mold found in prep cooler; person in charge instructed to discard. Food stored on floor, utensils stored inside food, and wiping cloths stored improperly. Dumpster lids not tight. Missing handwashing signs. Food handler and allergen certificates not posted.

headline: Cooked foods held at unsafe temperatures
summary: Cooked rice at 112.6–117.4°F, below the 135°F required. Chicken and broth at 49.6–50.1°F and pork ribs at 48.7°F, above the 41°F limit. About 75 lbs discarded. Menu lacks required undercooked-food warning. No soap at one prep sink on this visit.

headline: No food handler training; grease and burnt bulb
summary: Several food employees lack food handler training; must complete training and keep records on site. Heavy grease, grime, and food debris under cooking equipment and inside microwave. Burnt-out bulb over cook line. Result: pass on re-inspection.

headline: Unlabeled sugar; greasy dish room walls
summary: Large container of sugar is not labeled; must be labeled and maintained. Dish room walls have grease, dirt, and food splatter; must be cleaned. Result: pass.

headline: Greasy fryers and gaps in rear storage wall
summary: Fryer doors and interior lower surfaces have a grease buildup; must be cleaned. Cooking equipment sides have grease and food debris. Large gaps in rear storage wall behind sushi bar must be sealed. Hood filters and vents dusty and greasy. Result: pass.

headline: Clogged hand sink; door gap; leaks
summary: Dish area hand sink clogged and not draining; repair required, citation issued. A 1/4-inch gap at south exit door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Faucet leaks at three-compartment sink. Wall openings, damaged baseboards, and debris in floor drains.

headline: Hair restraint corrected on site; training required
summary: Food handler without hair restraint; corrected on site. Floors under and around equipment must be cleaned. All food handlers must obtain required food handler training, and certified managers must obtain allergen training.

headline: Mouse droppings throughout; ground beef thawed unsafely
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings found in prep, storage, and unused areas; exterminator required. Ground beef was thawing improperly on a basement chest freezer. No food handler training for employees. Also: debris, missing splash guard, single-use items on floor.

headline: Food on floor; tamale husks under sewer lines
summary: Food stored on walk-in cooler floor must be raised 6 inches. Packaged tamale husks stored under sewer lines with worn overwrap must be moved or rewrapped. Aluminum foil lining shelves must be removed. Result: pass.

headline: No certified manager; customer's dog entered
summary: No City-certified food manager on premises; must be present at all times. Customer's dog entered; corrected on site, and citation issued. Strong smoke from table-top chicken fryer; ventilation required. Front door gap. Food handler and allergen certificates needed. Result: pass with conditions.

headline: Food on floor, soiled cloths, rust, cardboard liners
summary: Pots of food stored on floor in rear walk-in cooler; instructed to elevate. Soiled wet wiping cloths left on prep surfaces. Rusted storage racks and cardboard liners on prep surfaces. Grease, food debris, and dirt on floors and in corners.

headline: No food handler certificates; no allergen training
summary: No food handler training certificates on site; all food employees must complete training. One certified manager lacks allergen training. Also: hard-to-read dish machine gauge, grooved cutting board, leaking hand sink faucet, and burnt-out light bulbs.

headline: Chicken held over 24 hours without discard date
summary: Three pounds of chicken held over 24 hours without a discard date (about $70); manager voluntarily discarded it. Box of frozen chicken stored on walk-in freezer floor; all food must be 6 inches off the ground.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; flying insects in prep
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings on shelves, equipment, and pallets in prep and storage; numerous flying insects landing on surfaces. Exterminator required. Also: employees eating in prep area, food stored on floor in freezer, missing food handler training.

headline: Unlabeled food; plastic bags used as containers
summary: Food in butcher's display cooler lacks business name, address, and ingredients. Plastic grocery bags used as containers in freezers and coolers must be replaced. Also: broken cooler gasket, stained cutting boards, grease trap lid, and grime on floors.

headline: No certified manager; ice machine slime
summary: No City-certified food manager on premises while beef and pasta were prepared. Ice machine interior had pink slime and black dirt dripping into ice; ice voluntarily discarded; must be cleaned by re-inspection. Water-stained ceiling tiles above dish area.

headline: No hot water at handwashing sinks
summary: Water at employee restroom and prep hand sinks measured 74.5°F; must be at least 100°F. Water reached 106.5°F after inspection. Also: unlabeled bulk sugar and oatmeal, grease and debris on walls and floors, non-self-closing door, employee belongings stored with food.

headline: License number missing; cart not enclosed
summary: License number not printed on lateral sides of front storage cart; must be at least 2 inches tall. Bicycle cart not fully enclosed; must be a fully enclosed push cart to protect food. Result: pass on re-inspection.

headline: Worker lacks food handler card; repairs needed
summary: One food handler without a food handler training certificate. One certified manager lacks allergen awareness training. Hole in wall near employee restroom sink and a damaged toilet seat cover must be repaired. Result: pass on re-inspection.

headline: About 20 rodent droppings in hallway and prep
summary: About 20 rodent droppings scattered in basement hallway and food prep area; pest control service recommended. No sink stoppers for the 3-compartment sink. Grease on fryer sides; dirt on floors. Holes in wall under sink. Allergen certificate on site is expired.

headline: No handwashing signs; damaged gaskets; trash
summary: No handwashing signage at hand sinks. Gaskets on small cold-hold unit near fryers are damaged. Shelves in cold-hold units have buildup. Trash around dumpster area must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Milk crates, tape splash guard, fryer ventilation
summary: Milk crates used for elevation must be removed. Masking tape used as a splash guard at cook-line sink must be replaced with smooth, cleanable material. Dirty floor drains at kitchen sinks and dishwashers. Two-basket fryer in poor ventilation must be moved or ventilated.

headline: Small flies found; sinks lacked soap and towels
summary: About 15 small flies near rear dish machine; citation issued. Hand sinks in second-floor and basement prep areas lacked soap and paper towels; staff obtained them during inspection, citation issued. Loose debris and dust on floors.

headline: Walk-in cooler black substance and rust
summary: Walk-in cooler interior has black substance and rust on shelves, floors, walls, and ceiling; must be detail cleaned. Some ceiling tiles dirty or damaged. Washroom door needs a self-closing device. Food handlers must have training or citations will follow.

headline: Gap at side door; food stored on floors
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the side exit door must be sealed to keep pests out. Food containers stored on floors in walk-in freezer, prep, and storage areas must be elevated. No splashguard between hand sink and compartment sink.

headline: Rat droppings under bar sink; no paper towels
summary: Over 20 rat droppings under 3-compartment sink at outdoor bar; must eliminate pest activity, clean, and sanitize. No paper towels at indoor bar hand sink; employee provided them during inspection. Drips under sink and duct tape on drain.

headline: Rust, clutter, leaks, and wall repairs needed
summary: Rusted wire shelves in walk-in cooler must be repaired. Leak under employee hand sink and toilet must be fixed or lines capped. Wall openings need sealing. Clutter in storage room next to rear prep must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure; dumpsters overflowing
summary: No written procedures or supplies for vomiting or diarrheal events; supplies must include sanitizer that kills norovirus. Dumpster lids not closed due to overflowing trash. No proof of food handler training for any handler. Citations issued.

headline: Restroom sinks lacking water; dirty ceiling and vents
summary: One of three sinks in women's restroom and two of three in men's did not turn on; repair required. One stall out of order. Table in poor repair. Flour on floors, dust on vents, and food splatter on ceilings in rear prep area must be cleaned.

headline: No employee health policy or vomit cleanup procedures
summary: No written employee health policies on site; signed agreements must be provided. No written procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events. Missing thermometer in 3-door cooler. Certified food manager lacks allergen training certificate. Toilet room door not self-closing.

headline: Repeat violations: ice machine slime, no allergen training
summary: Repeat violations from a prior report: heavy black slime inside the ice machine used for ice, and certified food managers without allergen training. Inspector instructed correction and compliance. Citations issued.

headline: Missing signed employee health policies
summary: No signed employee health policies on site for food and conditional employees. Must be provided and kept on site for review. No citation issued.

headline: Unprotected buffet food removed; sneezeguards needed
summary: Breakfast buffet at the bar had no sneezeguards over cut fruit, yogurt, and granola. Management removed the unprotected food from the line and was instructed to provide sneezeguards. Citation issued. Result: pass with conditions.

headline: Soiled mop heads stored improperly; cooler shelves dirty
summary: Soiled mop heads were not stored properly; manager instructed to hang them to prevent insect breeding. Interior bottom shelves of coolers and freezers need cleaning.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No certified food manager with original City certificate was on site during inspection. A certified manager must be on site at all times while food is prepared and served. Also: debris and spills around beverage dispenser, and one burnt-out light bulb.

headline: Cutting board stained and grooved
summary: Cutting board at prep line is stained with deep, dark grooves; must be repaired or replaced. Result: pass.

headline: Leaky faucet; no food handler training proof
summary: Leak at food prep hand sink faucet; must be repaired. No proof of food handler training for any food handler; must be provided and kept on site. Result: pass.

headline: Prepackaged food lacks address; dusty fan guard
summary: Prepackaged foods in café lack a required address on label. All prepackaged foods must show common name, ingredients, net quantity, packer name and address, and allergens. Dusty fan guard in walk-in cooler must be cleaned. Result: pass on re-inspection.

headline: Dumpsters missing lids; food handler without training
summary: Several garbage dumpsters lack tight-fitting lids; priority citation issued. One food handler lacks a valid food handler training certificate. Management instructed to provide lids and proof of training.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen training
summary: No food handler training for employees and no allergen training for the food manager; both must be provided. Also: remove foil and cardboard, repair worn gaskets and a freezer door, clean heavy grease, and repair floors, walls, and ceiling near the pit.

headline: Rusted racks, foil wrap, cluttered bar and kitchen
summary: Chipped and rusted racks in two-door cooler must be repaired or repainted. Foil-wrapped equipment and shelving in kitchen must have foil removed. Clutter in bar and kitchen must be removed to avoid pest harborage. Result: pass.

headline: No certified manager while chicken and rice prepared
summary: No City sanitation certificate holder on site while chicken and rice were prepared; citation issued. Food handler training certificates missing for all employees. Elevated wood shelf below cooler must be replaced or sealed.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: Hot dogs prepared without original City of Chicago certificate or certified manager on site; only a voided photocopy was posted. Citation issued. Also: multiple workers without hair restraints, food debris on floors and walls, and expired food handler certificates.

headline: Dead insect, plastic bags, cardboard, and grease
summary: Dead insect found in hallway; must be removed. Plastic grocery bags and cardboard boxes used as food containers must be replaced. Microwave with peeling, bubbled material and exposed wire must not be used. Grease and debris on walls and cooking equipment.

headline: Slow-draining sink and greasy vent hood
summary: Dish-area hand sink drains extremely slowly; must be repaired. Grease drips from the ventilation hood above the ovens; must be cleaned and maintained. Milk crates must not be used for elevation.

headline: Incomplete ingredient labels; plumbing leaks
summary: Frozen meat and cheese pies had incomplete ingredient labels; full ingredients and type of meat required. Drain leaks at a hand sink and at the three-compartment sink. Women's washroom needs a covered waste container. Broken wall tiles and peeling paint need repair.

headline: Rodent droppings found; no sanitizer test kit
summary: About 10 mouse and 15 rat droppings on dry storage floor; must remove, clean, sanitize, and arrange pest control service. No chemical test kit for sanitizer. Reach-in coolers need detail cleaning. Priority citations issued.

headline: Raw wood under counter; excess freezer ice
summary: Raw wood surface under front prep counter must be sealed to be non-porous and cleanable. Excessive ice buildup in upright freezer near front service counter must be removed. Result: pass.

headline: No hot water, no pest log, missing certificates
summary: Employee restroom sink had no hot water (74.6°F). Plumber adjusted it to 102.3°F, meeting the 100°F minimum. No pest control log on site. Employee without hair restraint. Food handlers lacked certificates. Broken ceiling tiles and dirty vent also noted.

headline: Ineffective hair restraints; utensils not inverted
summary: Some food handlers missing hair restraints, and others have loose hair. Multi-use utensils not stored inverted. Condensation under weekend prep cooler. Heavily stained cutting board with deep grooves. Smoke stains on walls and ceiling tiles near sandwich prep and oven.

headline: Torn gaskets; stained cutting boards; floor debris
summary: Torn gaskets inside sandwich prep cooler must be repaired. All cutting boards on the line have open seams and dark stains; must be refinished or replaced. Excess food debris on floors under dish machine and cooking equipment; detail clean needed.

headline: No certified manager during initial inspection
summary: No City-certified food manager on site while food was prepared and served; manager arrived 20 minutes after a phone call; citation issued. Person in charge lacks a sanitation certificate. No allergen training proof for certified managers. Result: pass with conditions.

headline: Hand sink unusable; cold food too warm
summary: Rear hand sink turned off because water drains onto floor when it runs; must be accessible at all times (citation issued). Cold foods held at 47–93°F. Manager discarded 80 lbs chicken and 3 lbs empanadas ($600); citation issued.

headline: No prep cooler thermometers; allergen training needed
summary: No thermometers found inside cooling units in prep area; must be provided. Internal surfaces of bar cooler and rear upright cooler need cleaning. Items stored improperly behind black curtains in dry storage. Certified manager must obtain allergen training.

headline: Cold foods too warm; cold-holding units tagged
summary: Romaine, sliced tomatoes, and bean sprouts held at 51.8–57.7°F; 4 lbs ($25) discarded. Two counter-top cold-holding units at 49.8–53.2°F were tagged. Menu lacks required undercooked-food warning. Hole in wall stuffed with foil must be sealed.

headline: Live roaches found; several equipment violations
summary: Three live cockroaches under counter by bar sink. Detail cleaning and additional pest control service recommended. Also: debris in ice machine, moldy and worn shelves, worn cutting boards, missing sink stoppers, water leak, and expired allergen certificate.

headline: Handwashing signs missing at two sinks
summary: No handwashing signs at front prep hand sink or rear prep hand sink near dish area. Manager instructed to post signs at each hand sink telling employees to wash hands before returning to work. Result: pass on re-inspection.

headline: Repeat mouse droppings; no employee health policy
summary: Repeat violation: about 125 or more mouse droppings in several areas, including inside furnace unit and on food storage shelving. Pest control service required. No signed employee health policies. No food handler training. Gaps under doors and water dripping onto food equipment.

headline: No hair restraints; expired certificates
summary: Food handlers preparing food without hair restraints. Food handler certificates and the certified manager's allergen certificate are expired; must obtain current ones. Dirty fryers and racks; debris outside garbage area; floors with grease and debris.

headline: Sink floods; oil and items stored on floor
summary: Three-compartment sink does not drain properly; one compartment floods when another drains; citation issued. Oil and other items stored on floor must be at least 6 inches up. Certified food manager lacks allergen training on site.

headline: Mops must be hung to dry
summary: Mops must be hung to dry properly when not in use. This was the only item noted. Result: pass.

headline: No employee health policy or food handler training
summary: No employee health policy or training found on site; citation issued. Plates stored facing up rather than inverted. No food handler training certificates on site. No allergen training certificate found; repeat violation, citation issued.

headline: Person in charge lacks sanitation certificate
summary: The person in charge did not have a valid City of Chicago sanitation certificate while chicken, sausage and eggs were handled. Boxes of supplies and decorative items on dining room floors must be stored at least 6 inches above ground.

headline: Missing thermometer, unlabeled containers, rusty racks
summary: No metal stem thermometer was on site. Bulk containers are unlabeled, and wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution. The female certified manager was not wearing a hair restraint. Freezer racks are rusty, and walls are dirty.

headline: Dirty ceilings, leaking faucet, outdated violations
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables. The three-compartment sink faucet base leaks. Ceiling tiles are missing and framework is damaged, and previous core violations were not corrected. Allergen training and a covered waste receptacle are also needed.

headline: Rat droppings; no hot water; food held too warm
summary: About 40 rat droppings were found in the rear restroom, under freezer shelving, near ovens and on the mixer. No hot or cold water at a restroom hand sink, and knobs are missing. Hot and cold food held out of safe range was discarded (about 80 lb, $305).

headline: Leaking mop sink faucet
summary: The faucet neck at the rear mop sink leaks continuously and must be repaired. This is a short-form complaint, and it passed.

headline: Door gaps, floor tiles, cleaning and storage issues
summary: A gap at the bottom of the front door and pin holes in the rear door must be fixed. Several cleaning, storage and repair items remain, including damaged floor tiles, a hole in the toilet room wall and a damaged ceiling over the lobby trash can. This is a re-inspection, and it passed.

headline: Backflow device missing on basement ice maker
summary: The inspector could not find the backflow prevention device for the basement ice maker. Management was told to install one. Backflow devices stop dirty water from flowing back into the water supply.

headline: No original certificate; cooked chicken too warm
summary: No original City sanitation manager certificate was posted; only an old receipt was posted. About 10 lb of cooked chicken held at 59-62F was discarded. Two hand sinks lacked paper towels, which were provided. A broken faucet was in a food prep hand sink.

headline: Grease buildup on cooking equipment; blown light
summary: Grease buildup is on cooking and cold-holding equipment used as a prep table in the front area. Floors and walls need deep cleaning in several areas. A light bulb under the hood is blown out. No previous inspection summary was posted for public view; a new one was posted.

headline: Customers walked through food prep to restroom
summary: A customer walked through the food prep area to reach the restroom, which is located in the kitchen. The person in charge was told customers must not do this. A two-door cooler in prep has spilled material and must be cleaned.

headline: Dust on walls and food buildup on floors
summary: Dust is on prep area walls, and food buildup is on floors. The manager must clean walls, floors under and around equipment, and corners.

headline: 80 mouse droppings found; two live flies
summary: Two large live flies and 80 mouse droppings were found in the toilet room, behind cooking equipment, and around sinks and coolers. Droppings must be removed and the area sanitized. Floors under and around heavy equipment need cleaning.

headline: Drain leak; no covered waste receptacle; mop stored wrong
summary: A drain pipe under the three-compartment sink leaks and must be repaired. The all-gender washroom has no covered waste receptacle. A mop is stored improperly in the mop sink area and must be stored head-up.

headline: Detail cleaning needed; allergen certificate missing
summary: Cooler interiors, storage shelves and drink dispenser nozzles need detail cleaning. Rubber gaskets on reach-in cooler doors need cleaning or replacing. Floors and light shields need cleaning. The manager on duty needs an allergen certificate.

headline: Rear door gap; storage clutter; repeat pest control issue
summary: A rear door gap about 1/4 inch leads to the dumpster and needs sealing. Clutter in storage must be removed. A repeat violation from a previous inspection was not corrected: no licensed pest control logbook was on the premises.

headline: Hand sink water too hot; cooler gasket torn
summary: Hot water at the rear prep hand sink reached 135.2F because the cold water handle was not working. Staff must have hot and cold water at 100-120F. A cooler gasket is torn, and an exhaust hood light is out and needs replacing.

headline: Dirty cooking equipment; ceiling tiles water-damaged
summary: The interior and exterior of cooking equipment have dirt and food. Water-stained and damaged ceiling tiles are in the rear dishwashing area. Floors, walls, vents and ceiling tiles have food, dirt and dust buildup. The certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Ice bin needs cleaning; no hot water backflow device
summary: The ice bin interior needs cleaning. The hot water dispensing unit has no backflow device and must have one installed so it can be located and maintained. The men's toilet room door is not self-closing and must be fitted with a closing device.

headline: No certified manager on site; hand washing at wrong sink
summary: No person in charge or food handler with certified manager training or original certificate was on site. A food employee washed hands in a three-compartment sink; they then washed in a proper hand sink. Beard restraints and a thermometer in the rear cooler are also needed.

headline: No certified manager on duty; hand water too cool
summary: No certified food manager was on duty or posted while tater tots, hamburger and chicken were served. Hot water at hand sinks measured 73-94F, below the required 100F. A few sinks are not working. Worn cutting boards and a worn walk-in door gasket must be replaced.

headline: Leaking drain and faucet in prep area
summary: A drain pipe leaks under the hand sink, and the three-compartment sink faucet in the prep area leaks. Management was told to repair and maintain both.

headline: Undated food held over 24 hours; hole in wall
summary: About 275 lb of prepared TCS foods held over 24 hours had no discard date labels. The person in charge voluntarily discarded them. A large hole in the rear storage wall must be enclosed, and a light shield is missing.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; fryer floor needs cleaning
summary: The rear outer door must be made rodent-proof. The floor under the fryers on the second floor and the first-floor kitchen floor drain must be cleaned. This is a re-inspection, and it passed.

headline: Heavy dirt and grime on bar floor
summary: The bar floor has heavy buildup of dirt and grime. Management was instructed to detail clean it and keep it in good condition.

headline: Unlabeled food containers; leaking dish machine hose
summary: Food stored in containers in freezers and coolers is not labeled with the food name. Food splash is in the two-door dairy cooler. A leak at the high-temperature dish machine hose must be repaired.

headline: Over 100 rat droppings; no hot water at hand sink
summary: Over 100 rat droppings were found behind fryers, coolers and shelves, and in prep, dish and dining areas. An exterminator service is required. The front hand sink has no hot water at 51.6F and must reach 100F. A food handler lacked a hair restraint.

headline: No certified manager on site; hot food too cool
summary: No certified food manager was on site while meat was being prepared. The manager arrived after the inspection ended. A sink was blocked by a prep table, and beef and pork were held below safe hot temperatures and discarded ($15). Allergen training is missing.

headline: Food stored on floor in walk-in cooler
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler. Management was told to raise food at least six inches off the floor on raised shelving to protect it from contamination.

headline: Excessive garbage around outside dumpster
summary: Excessive garbage is on the ground around all sides of the outside dumpster in the alley. A previous violation was not corrected. Management was told to clean and maintain the outside garbage area at all times.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; unit tagged
summary: The low-temperature dish machine in use was not sanitizing. Chlorine sanitizer measured 0 ppm. The unit was tagged and must not be used until the health department reinspects it. A ceiling fan cover hangs open in the employee restroom.

headline: Cleaning needed; walk-in cooler lacks lighting
summary: Prep tables, shelving, chest freezer and storage racks must be detail cleaned. The washroom fixtures and floors need cleaning, and the hood and filter above cooking equipment are greasy. The walk-in cooler has no lighting, and several employees lack food handler training.

headline: Wiping cloths unstored; leaks and dirty floors
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. Food and dirt are on the lower surfaces of coolers and freezers. A leak is at the base of the three-compartment sink, and floors under and around cooking equipment are dirty.

headline: Flying insects in prep areas; door gaps
summary: Several flying insects were seen landing on shelves, trays and equipment in prep and utility areas. An exterminator service and cleaning of all areas were required. A 1/4 inch gap is at the rear exit door, and food is stored on the walk-in freezer floor.

headline: Dirty surfaces; leaking sink; allergen training missing
summary: Food debris and spills are on coolers, freezers, prep tables and holding units. Floors under equipment are dirty. A three-compartment sink faucet in the basement leaks. Preset tableware was not inverted, and certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Cold food too warm; cooler tagged; no summary
summary: Sliced tomatoes at 76F, shredded lettuce at 62F and sliced onion were held too warm; 6 lb ($35) was discarded. A cold unit at 62F was tagged for the health department. Floors under equipment have grease and debris, and the summary was not posted.

headline: Ice machine black buildup; no lighting in liquor cooler
summary: Black buildup in the chef's kitchen ice machine dripped onto stored ice. The person in charge removed the ice and cleaned the machine during the inspection. Black substance was found on cooler shelves, and the liquor walk-in cooler has no lighting.

headline: Dead cockroaches throughout food prep area; no hand sink
summary: Multiple dead cockroaches were found on food prep tables, storage counters, the floor and walls. A basement prep table and stand mixer lack an exposed hand sink. Spices and sauces are unlabeled, and food handler training certificates were not provided.

headline: Dirt on floors; holes in walls; training missing
summary: A cracked toilet lid must be replaced, and the three-compartment sink lacks stoppers. Holes in the wall under the sink and coving need sealing. Floors have dirt and debris, and two food handlers and one employee lack training proof. Allergen certificate is expired.

headline: No hair restraint; dirty floors; no allergen training
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. Floors behind and under equipment in the basement storage area are not clean. A sanitation manager has no allergen training.

headline: Freezer interiors, floors and walls need cleaning
summary: Reach-in freezer interiors need cleaning in front and rear prep. Food debris is on floors throughout, and paint is chipped on several walls. Baseboard is peeling in the dish and dry storage area. Management was told to clean and repair.

headline: About 150 rat droppings; pest control needed
summary: Approximately 150 rat droppings were found on floors and shelves in basement and first-floor storage. Management must clean them up, and additional pest control service is needed. Several employees lack food handler certificates, and a washroom door is not self-closing.

headline: Cooking equipment and floors need cleaning
summary: Drink dispenser nozzles need cleaning of buildup. Cooking equipment and lower grill shelves have food and grease buildup. Worn cleaning cloths and sponges must be replaced, and floors in prep and dish areas need cleaning. Air vents have dust buildup.

headline: Hand sink lacked soap and towels; ice machine slime
summary: The bar hand sink had no soap and no paper towel; staff obtained both during the inspection. The ice machine had black slime dripping onto stored ice and was cleaned during the inspection. Clutter, grease and dust were also noted.

headline: Sauces held past 7-day limit; summary not posted
summary: Made-on-site sauces and dressings were stored in the walk-in cooler past their 7-day use-by date. The high-temperature dish machine lacks a temperature indicator. The previous inspection summary was not posted in public view, and management was given a copy.

headline: Items on floor; rodent harborage; greasy floors
summary: Items in the mop closet must be raised off the floor. Equipment, construction materials and a prep table in the rear outdoor area must be removed to prevent rodents. Floors under the wok line have grease and debris, and dust covers the dish area light.

headline: No sanitation manager; dish machine sanitizing at 0 ppm
summary: No City sanitation manager or valid certificate was on site while milk was prepared and served. The low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm and was tagged for inspection by the health department. Food debris and missing hair restraints also noted.

headline: Equipment on floor; plastic lining removed on site
summary: Pots, pans and serving items were stored on the basement floor and were ordered raised. Partly torn protective plastic lining was on stainless equipment and was removed by maintenance during the inspection. One of several certified managers lacks allergen training.

headline: Rear exit door gap; not rodent-proof
summary: A 1/4 inch gap at the rear exit door sweep means the door must be made rodent-proof. This is a license inspection, and it passed.

headline: Mold-like substance in ice machine; cleaned on site
summary: The ice machine's interior panels that touch ice were filled with black and pink mold-like substance. The person in charge emptied, cleaned and sanitized the machine on site. Plates were not inverted, and grease and dirt are on the floors.

headline: No covered receptacle for feminine hygiene products
summary: There is no covered receptacle for feminine hygiene products in the unisex staff toilet room. The manager was instructed to provide and maintain one.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; unit held; stoppers missing
summary: The low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and was held for inspection by the health department. It was not in use. The three-compartment sink is missing proper stoppers. Vent systems above fryers and pizza oven have heavy dust and grease.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; sink floods; no summary
summary: The bar dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine sanitizer and was tagged. The three-compartment sink floods when one basin drains and must be repaired. No consumer advisory is on the menu, and the previous inspection summary is blocked by an older report.

headline: Food handlers lack training certificates
summary: Several food handlers did not have food handler certificates. Management must show proof of training for all food handlers. The interior of a two-door prep cooler must also be cleaned.

headline: No sanitation certificate; no health policy; leaks
summary: No person on site had an original City sanitation certificate posted. No employee health policy and no vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit were on site. There is no pest control logbook. A leak under the bar sink needs repair, and a dumpster overflowed with trash.

headline: Missing handle on cold hold unit
summary: A cold hold unit in the rear prep area is missing a handle. The person in charge was instructed to replace it and keep it maintained. This is a re-inspection, and it passed.

headline: No hair restraints; grease and debris on floors
summary: Several food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Accumulated grease is on the floor under all cooking equipment in the rear prep area, and food debris is throughout prep. No allergen training certificates were on site.

headline: Front entrance opening; leaking drain pipe
summary: An opening at the base of the front entrance outer door must be sealed to prevent pests. A drain pipe leaks under the three-compartment sink on the first floor. Peeling paint and uneven floors in the basement and walk-in cooler need smoothing and repair.

headline: Ice machine and hood need detail cleaning; leaks
summary: The ice machine, can opener, cooking equipment and prep surfaces need detail cleaning. Leaks are at the ice machine and dish machine. Floor tiles are in poor repair in several areas, and all hood vents need detail cleaning.

headline: Live cockroaches seen; pest activity must stop
summary: Three live large cockroaches were seen on the floor and walls in the prep and dishwashing areas during the inspection. Pest control service and cleaning of affected areas were recommended. Rubber gaskets on cooling units are worn, and a sink drains slowly.

headline: Light out near office space
summary: A light near the camera across from the office space is out. Management was told to repair it so the space can be properly cleaned and maintained.

headline: Rodent droppings found; rear door not rodent-proof
summary: Large rodent droppings in rear and attic storage, and small droppings in the enclosed cashier space. The rear door has a gap and needs sealing. No written employee health policy or vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit on site.

headline: No food handler certificates on site
