summary: No food handler certificates were on site during the inspection. All employees must complete food handler training and keep records on site at all times. This is a re-inspection, and it passed.

headline: Outside dumpster overflowing; lids left open
summary: The outside garbage dumpster is not maintained. Trash bags are piled above the lids, and the lids are wide open. Management was instructed to maintain the outside garbage area.

headline: Front door not rodent-proof; rust and dirty freezers
summary: The front entry door needs rodent proofing. Shelving with rust must be cleaned, removed or replaced. Freezer interiors need detail cleaning. Floors need detail cleaning under equipment and sinks, and additional lighting is needed in the walk-in cooler.

headline: Cold food held too warm; several repairs needed
summary: Beef broth at 51.8F and sliced beef at 48.7F were held too warm in a cooler. About 5 lb of broth and 1 lb of beef ($85) were discarded. Torn and rusty gaskets, shelves and cooler parts need repair, and the wok station is greasy.

headline: Unused cooler and stored items need removal
summary: Wiping cloths in the prep area must be held in sanitizing solution between uses. Items stored in the rear stairwell and washroom must be raised off the floor. An unused cooler in the rear kitchen must be removed or kept clean. This is a re-inspection, and it passed.

headline: Dish machine sanitizer undetected; unit tagged
summary: No sanitizer was detected at the final rinse of the low-temperature dish machine. The unit was tagged and must not be used until repaired. Frozen meats were stored in plastic grocery bags and must use food-grade storage bags. Hood is greasy and some bulbs are burnt out.

headline: No certified manager during cooking; food temps; corrected
summary: No certified sanitation manager was on site at the start while chicken and sausage were cooked. The certified manager arrived near the end, and this was corrected on site. Pizza was 79.9F and was discarded (45 lb, $650).

headline: Backflow devices missing on ice machine and sink
summary: No backflow prevention device was found on the ice machine's incoming water line in the rear. Management was also instructed to attach one to the rear utility sink. Both must be installed.

headline: Flies in rear area; cold food held too warm
summary: About 40 live small and large flies were seen in the rear dock, produce, prep and cooling areas; pest control and cleaning were required. Liver cheese and deli meat at 50-60F were discarded ($250). Frozen spareribs must be proven to come from an approved source. Hand sink lacked soap and paper towel.

headline: No food handler certificates; leaking faucet
summary: No food handler certificates were on site. Management must keep them on site at all times, with a 30-day grace period for new hires. A torn gasket on a two-door refrigerator and a leaking faucet at the dishwashing hand sink were also noted.

headline: Cracked floor tiles, ceiling openings, allergen proof needed
summary: Cracked or missing floor tiles in the front cashier and prep area must be replaced. Ceiling openings around pipes in the main kitchen and a crack under the dish room sink must be sealed. Proof of allergen training is needed for all certified managers. This is a re-inspection, and it passed.

headline: No sanitation certificate; dish machine not working
summary: No City sanitation certificate and no written employee health policy were on the premises. The bar dish machine could not be operated, and the two-door cooler gaskets are missing with the cooler turned off. No pest control logbook or service report was available.

headline: Sink faucets leak heavily; bathroom doors not self-closing
summary: Both faucets of the third floor three-compartment sink leak heavily, even when not in use. Bathroom doors on the second floor lack self-closing devices. Floor drain and an area behind a water heater have heavy debris and buildup.

headline: Basement floor dirty; ceiling and pipe openings
summary: Dirt and debris are on the basement floor behind the ice machine. There are openings into the ceiling and above pipes near the ice machine and rear basement. These must be sealed and kept clean. This is a re-inspection, and it passed.

headline: No proof of food handler or allergen training
summary: Damaged floor tiles in the bar, prep, dining and toilet rooms must be repaired. A burned-out light bulb is in the hood system. No food handler training proof was shown for any food handler, and no food employee had allergen training proof.

headline: Bare-hand food contact; pests; no sanitation certificate
summary: Employee handled ready-to-eat lettuce with bare hands; it was discarded, and gloves were applied on the spot. About 5 live large flies flew near food prep and about 10 small flies were on toilet room walls. The person in charge has no valid certificate.

headline: Dirty floors and cooler interior; standing water
summary: Interior surfaces of a reach-in cooler in the rear prep area must be detail cleaned. Floors along walls and under equipment need cleaning. Water pools in a corner under the front service counter and must be kept dry to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Mouse droppings; no sanitation certificate on site
summary: About 75 mouse droppings were found around the grease trap, under shelving and between chest freezers. No valid sanitation certificate was on site while chicken and shrimp were prepared. The rear door has a 1/2 inch gap that must be fixed.

headline: Kitchen hood greasy; certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: The kitchen exhaust hood and filters have excessive grease buildup and must be detail cleaned. The certified food manager does not have an allergen training certificate. Instructed to complete training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: Unlabeled salt and sugar; grease on equipment
summary: Salt and sugar stored outside original containers have no product name labels. An ice scoop was on top of ice and was ordered stored handle-up. Grease and food debris are on cooking equipment and shelving, and debris is along walls in utility and storage areas.

headline: Cooler temps too warm; food discarded (~$2,500)
summary: Cheese curds, chicken, pork belly and short rib were held at 46-52.3F in the prep cooler. About 60 lb of food worth $2,500 was discarded. The cooler's air temperature was 47F and the unit was tagged. Wiping cloths were on cooking equipment, and an ice shute needs cleaning.

headline: No certified manager on duty; sanitation kit missing
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while chicken, fries and rice and beans were prepared and served. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure was on site. Food handlers worked without hair restraints. A drive-through window is off its track and must be repaired.

headline: Bulk container of oatmeal not labeled
summary: One bulk container of oatmeal was not labeled. Management was told to label all bulk items with their common name.

headline: Cold food held too warm; prep cooler too warm
summary: Several cold TCS foods were held at 44-53F; manager discarded about $100 of tomatoes, egg whites and sausage. A prep cooler's air temperature was 46F. A technician came to service the cooler. Broken glass and heavy grime found in the bar area.

headline: Debris under equipment and in corners
summary: Debris is on floors under all equipment, along walls and in corners in prep and storage areas. Management was instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Unlabeled food containers; leaking sinks
summary: Food stored in containers in coolers, walk-in cooler and dry storage lacks labels with the food name. Tin foil and cardboard are used as liners and must be replaced with smooth, cleanable surfaces. Three-compartment sink faucet leaks, and a one-compartment sink lacks hot and cold water.

headline: Dirty freezer and walk-in cooler interior
summary: Debris is at the bottom of the deep freezer. The interior walls, ceiling and doors of the walk-in cooler are dirty. Management must clean and maintain them.

headline: Front and side doors not rodent-proof
summary: The front entrance and side doors have about 1/4 inch gaps at the bottom. The doors must be made tight-fitting to prevent pests from entering. This is a re-inspection, and it passed.

headline: Rat droppings found; no certified manager on site
summary: About 50 rat droppings found in storage and kitchen areas; more pest control service needed. No certified food manager on site while chicken wings were handled. Cooked wings held at 80.8F were discarded (about 10 lb, $100).

headline: Mice infestation with over 1,000 droppings
summary: Over 1,000 mouse droppings were found throughout the facility, including on food prep surfaces, near live fish tanks, and in the walk-in cooler with produce. Pest control is required. Frozen foods were thawing at room temperature; staff moved them to cold holding.

headline: Food containers unlabeled; clutter on shelves
summary: Flour, sugar and rice containers have no labels and must be labeled. Clutter, including tools, stationery and clothes, is on food shelving units and must be relocated or organized.

headline: Sink drain leaks; hood and filters greasy
summary: The right compartment drain pipe of the three-compartment sink is leaking and must be repaired. Food and grease buildup is on the ventilation hood and filters and must be cleaned.

headline: No written employee health policy; 90-day grace period
summary: No written employee health policy was on site. The facility was given a 90-day grace period to establish one. It must keep signed copies of employee reporting agreements on site at all times.

headline: Rear door gap; beard restraint not effective
summary: A gap of at least 1/4 inch between the rear exit door and floor must be sealed to rodent-proof it. A food handler lacked an effective hair restraint for a beard. The inspection passed.

headline: Ice machine dirty; cooler food held too warm
summary: Pink buildup inside the ice machine must be cleaned. Cream cheese, tomatoes, cheese, chicken and butter were held at 47.5-60F in coolers; about 150 lb ($280) was discarded. Cooler gaskets are torn and a sink handle is stripped. Allergen training is missing.

headline: Hand soap missing; sink water backs up
summary: Hand soap was not stocked in the prep area and employee restroom; food handlers obtained soap during the inspection. Water backs up into the first and third basins of the three-compartment sink and must be repaired. A manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No backflow device, no utility sink, no grease trap
summary: No backflow device was found at the ice machine, and there is no service or utility sink for mop water. There is no grease trap at the three-compartment sink. The toilet room door is not self-closing, and the certified manager is missing allergen training.

headline: Ice machine black buildup; cleaning and repairs needed
summary: Black buildup along the chute and inside the ice bin of the ice machine must be cleaned. Dry food is covered in aluminum foil instead of food-grade storage. A 1/4 inch gap is at the rear exit door, and ice machine drain runs into a hand sink.

headline: Damaged floor tiles and dusty vents
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables instead of in sanitizing solution. Damaged and missing floor tiles in the rear dishwashing area must be repaired and regrouted. Dust covers ceiling vents in the front dining area, and floors behind the three-compartment sink are dirty.

headline: No certified manager; no hair restraint; no test strips
summary: No person in charge or certified food manager was on site while chicken and hamburgers were being prepared. A hand sink lacked drying supplies. A handler had no hair restraint, and food handlers had no certificates. No sanitizer test strips were on site. Citations issued.

headline: No sanitizer; cold food too warm; flies found
summary: The low-temperature dish machine had no sanitizer detected and was ordered to provide 100 ppm chlorine. Cooked potatoes, lasagna, and other cold TCS foods were held at 44–50°F, and two coolers reached 48–50°F. About 50 live small flies were found. Citations issued.

headline: Flies throughout; pest control needed
summary: About 40 or more live small flies and 3–5 live large flies were found on ceilings, walls, and door frames in the rear mop sink area and dining room. A pest control operator was recommended before re-inspection. Citation issued.

headline: No person in charge or certified manager present
summary: No person in charge or certified food manager was present at the time of inspection. No food was being prepared or served at that time. No citation was issued. Hand-washing signs were missing at bar sinks. Serving plates and cooler lids need correction.

headline: Hand sink access corrected on site; no food handler certificates
summary: A pizza hot-holding oven blocked access to a hand sink. The manager moved it near the sink on site, so it was corrected. No food handler certificates were found for employees. Other items included missing covered waste cans and a mop stored on the floor.

headline: Ice machine mold; missing hot and cold water at sink
summary: A hand sink at the three-compartment sink had no hot or cold water. Ice machine panel touching ice had black mold-like buildup. Milk crates were used as shelving, and floor tiles, grout, and ceiling tiles were damaged. Citations issued.

headline: No certified manager; small flies and dead roaches
summary: No City-certified food service manager was on site while chicken was prepared and served. About 50–70 small flies were near sinks, and five dead roaches were found behind the three-compartment sink. Cardboard lined the fryer floor. Citation issued.

headline: Food containers stored on floor
summary: Food containers were on the floor in the walk-in cooler, prep, and storage areas. The inspector instructed the manager to elevate them at least six inches on raised shelving.

headline: Hallway light out at rear
summary: The rear hallway light was not working. The inspector instructed the owner to replace it. No other issues were noted.

headline: Patio doors not rodent-proof; floor debris
summary: Patio doors had a gap of more than one inch at the bottom and must be made rodent-proof. Fryers had grease and food debris. A bar hand sink did not shut off properly, and a wall hole under the sink needs repair.

headline: Dead roaches on glue boards; insect devices moved
summary: Dead roaches were found on glue boards and floors throughout the basement. Insect control devices were moved away from food prep areas and bars. A bottle of wine was removed from an ice bin. An ice machine drip plate needs cleaning.

headline: Flies in prep area; mold drips onto ice
summary: Mold-like buildup inside equipment dripped onto ice used for consumption. About 55 live small and large flies were found throughout the rear prep, dish, and dough areas. Pest control was required. Rear doors were not rodent-proof. Citations issued.

headline: Dead roaches; about 20 live roaches found previously
summary: Dead cockroaches were on basement, prep, and dry storage floors. A prior visit found about 20 live roaches in walls, prep areas, and dry storage. Additional pest control was needed. Wall openings and cleaning items were also noted. Citation issued.

headline: No mop sink; openings must be protected
summary: All openings must be protected, with doors closed and windows screened. The site had no mop sink, and the owner must provide and maintain one.

headline: Wiping cloths unsanitized; grease container buildup
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer in prep areas. The deep fryer, dish machine, and walk-in shelves need detail cleaning. An outside grease container had heavy buildup and debris, a potential pest harborage. Citation issued.

headline: Milk crates and wall holes need correction
summary: Milk crates must not be used as shelving or elevation. Holes in walls near prep areas must be sealed to prevent pest harborage. Floors and condenser covers need detail cleaning.

headline: Blocked and unsupplied hand sinks; several upkeep issues
summary: A rear hand sink was blocked by unused equipment and a second lacked soap. Both were fixed on site. Also noted: heavy grease on sandwich presses, a loose ice scoop well, and clutter. Citation issued.

headline: Dead rodent in trap; openings in boiler room ceiling
summary: A dead rodent was found inside a trap in the boiler room, and the inspector told staff to remove it. Ceiling openings in the boiler room must be sealed. Floors under shelving and in the upstairs dish area need cleaning.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; no sink sign
summary: A low-temperature dish machine showed no chlorine sanitizer and was tagged and held. The owner must repair it. Also noted: no sign at a hand sink, missing thermometer, and food debris in a cooler and grease trap.

headline: Certified manager refused entry; grease on walls
summary: The person in charge refused entry to the inspector, a priority violation, and a citation was issued. Grease was on walls behind the hand sink and cooking equipment. Allergen training certificates were not provided for City-certified food managers.

headline: Rust on racks above three-compartment sink
summary: Racks above the three-compartment sink had slight rust. The manager was instructed to repaint them.

headline: Missing signage, open front door, no test strips
summary: Hand sinks lacked signage, and frozen chicken wings were thawing at room temperature. The front door stood open during the inspection. No sanitizer test strips were on site, and there was no mop sink. Several surfaces need repair. Citation issued.

headline: No certified manager during inspection; trash lids missing
summary: The person in charge did not hold a City sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was on site while food was served. A written employee health policy was not available. Restrooms lacked lidded trash cans. Citations issued.

headline: Mineral buildup inside ice machine
summary: The ice machine had slight mineral buildup on the interior. The manager was instructed to clean it.

headline: Grease on ventilation hood and filters
summary: Food and grease buildup was on the ventilation hood and filters. The owner must clean them and keep them clean.

headline: Ice scoop in ice machine; slow sink; outdoor clutter
summary: An ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine and must be put in a clean, sanitized container. A beverage prep hand sink drained slowly. Crates and boxes were stored outside, and a shed had a damaged door.

headline: Foil lining on prep surfaces; allergen training
summary: Foil was used as a liner on prep surfaces in the rear prep area and must be removed. Scoops for dry storage containers were stored inside the containers. One certified manager lacked allergen awareness training.

headline: No certified manager or person in charge present
summary: No person in charge or certified food manager was on duty while rice and chicken soups were prepared and served. A three-compartment sink was used without sanitizer setup, and it was corrected on site. Cardboard was used to line shelves. Citation issued.

headline: Condensation at cooler lines; backflow device missing
summary: Condensation was noted at walk-in cooler cooling lines, and the inspector told the owner to insulate them. The backflow prevention device for the ice maker could not be located and must be exposed.

headline: Restroom door not self-closing; allergen training
summary: The basement employee restroom door did not self-close and needs a closing device. City-certified food managers were instructed to obtain required allergen training.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; allergen certificate missing
summary: Milk crates were used as storage shelving inside three walk-in coolers and must be replaced with shelving raised six inches off the floor. No approved allergen training certificate was found. Handwashing signage was needed at the front bar sink.

headline: Dead insects in light shields; labeling and cleaning needed
summary: Light shields above the rear prep area had dead insects and need cleaning. Grocery bags were used for food storage in a freezer, and surfaces had grease and flour buildup. Also noted: missing signage, unlabeled containers, and a burnt-out light above the dishwashing sink.

headline: Missing covered trash can; ceiling damage
summary: A unisex restroom in the grocery store's rear area had no covered receptacle. Basement ceiling drywall was missing and exposed pipes and damaged wood. A water-damaged ceiling in the taqueria men's restroom needs repair.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; sink compartments unlabeled
summary: A cold-holding unit on the cook line had a torn door gasket. The three sink compartments were not labeled for wash, rinse, and sanitize. A toilet seat was damaged. The person in charge was told to correct each item.

headline: Standing dirty water and wall repairs needed
summary: Standing dirty water was found around sinks, the dish machine, and the bakery and mop sink areas. Fryer exteriors need detailed cleaning. A wall base in the deli is broken and must be repaired. Dust was on walk-in fan covers.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proof; soiled wiping cloths
summary: The rear exit door was not rodent-proof and must be fixed. Soiled wiping cloths were stored on prep tables. Cutting boards were stained and grooved. Prepared meat was stored in garbage bags. Fryers and heavy equipment had grease and debris buildup.

headline: Cold chicken too warm; cooler tagged; 20 lbs discarded
summary: Chicken in a three-door prep cooler was at 50.4–55°F, above the 41°F limit. About 20 lbs was discarded. The cooler reached 51.5°F, was tagged, and must be repaired. A torn gasket and a leaking pipe under a hand sink were also noted.

headline: No certified manager; rusted shelves in walk-in
summary: No valid City food sanitation certificate was on the premises. Management was told a certified food manager must be present whenever TCS foods are prepared or served. Rusted wire shelves in the walk-in cooler must be repainted or replaced. Citation issued.

headline: Gap in rear doors; low hot water in one sink
summary: Rear side exit doors had a gap that must be repaired to block pests. Wiping towels were left on prep stations and must be stored in sanitizer. One men's room hand sink had low hot water pressure and must be repaired.

headline: Managers lack allergen training certificates
summary: Managers did not have allergen training certificates. The inspector instructed the owner to meet the requirement for all City-certified food service managers.

headline: Gaps at doors and damaged gaskets; re-inspection
summary: Openings near the front and rear doors must be sealed against pests. Damaged gaskets were found on two cooling units and a freezer. Greasy debris surrounds the grease container. A leaking drain pipe needs repair.

headline: No covered waste receptacle in washroom
summary: The washroom had no covered waste receptacle. The inspector told the manager to provide and maintain one.

headline: Cooler in poor repair; leaks and missing stoppers
summary: A reach-in cooler was in poor repair, tagged, and must not be used until fixed. No food was in it. A rear exit door needs sealing, a kitchen window needs a screen or closing, and a basement pipe leaks. Stoppers were missing.

headline: Glove and hand-washing lapses; shells and boards unsafe
summary: Employees handled clean dishes and food-contact items without changing gloves or washing hands. Expired-date prepared foods were discarded. Used scallop shells used as serving containers were discarded. Cutting boards were badly grooved. Multiple upkeep items and citations issued.

headline: Cardboard liner and mold-like buildup in cooler
summary: Cardboard was used as a liner under a prep and cooking table in the main kitchen and must not be used. Storage racks in the basement walk-in cooler had mold-like buildup. The cooler's walls and ceiling need cleaning.

headline: No employee health policy or vomiting procedure
summary: No employee health policy with signed employee acknowledgments was provided. No procedure or clean-up kit for vomiting and diarrheal events was on site. The inspector instructed the owner to provide both. No citation issued. A push cart's business license number was also missing.

headline: Flies, mold, and debris in cooler and prep area
summary: About flies: fly paper was in the rear prep area, and the person in charge must remove it and have a licensed pest technician address fly activity. Mold-like buildup was on cooler walls, and floor, shelving, and hood buildup need cleaning.

headline: Black substance in ice machine; date labels missing
summary: A black substance was found inside the ice machine, a priority violation. Ready-to-eat TCS foods lacked date labels, and about 55 lbs was discarded. Rodent traps were exposed near food, and a gap at the rear door needs sealing. Citation issued.

headline: No hand sink at bar; no waste can
summary: The bar had no hand sink with hot and cold running water. The manager was told to provide one, citing a priority violation. The gun holder had pink buildup, and the women's washroom needed a covered trash can.

headline: No certified person on site; food handler training lacking
summary: The person in charge did not have a City food service sanitation certificate, and none was posted. Bagged onions were stored above a sink, and food and cardboard were on floors. No food handler training was shown. Citation issued.

headline: No handwashing signs in toilet rooms
summary: No handwashing signage was posted inside toilet rooms. The owner was instructed to provide it.

headline: Unused toilet room used for storage
summary: An unused toilet room was being used as a storage area. The inspector instructed the owner to post an out-of-order sign to prevent use as a restroom.

headline: No vomiting procedure; cold food too warm
summary: No written procedure or norovirus-effective disinfectant was available for vomiting or diarrhea events. Several cold TCS foods were held at 47.8–48.4°F, and about 5 lbs was discarded. No menu warning for undercooked animal foods was posted. A non-service dog entered and was removed. Citations issued.

headline: Pink and black substance inside ice machine
summary: A pink and black-like substance was found on the interior panel above the ice inside the ice machine used to make ice for people. The owner must clean, sanitize, and maintain it. Broken cardboard boxes lay on the floor in front of deep fryers. Citation issued.

headline: Food debris between equipment and along walls
summary: Food debris had built up between cooking equipment and along prep area walls. The inspector instructed staff to clean and maintain the area.

headline: No certified manager; multiple cleaning and repair items
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while eggs, turkey, and ham were prepared. The manager arrived about 3:47 p.m. A bread cart blocked a hand sink and was moved. Splash guards, cutting boards, floors, and hood filters need correction. Citations issued.

headline: Serving plates not inverted
summary: Serving plates on kitchen prep shelves were not stored properly. The inspector instructed staff to invert them to prevent dust buildup.

headline: Moldy cooler liner; cleaning and thermometers needed
summary: A dairy storage liner in a cooler had mold-like buildup. Reach-in coolers needed thermometers. Floors under the beverage counter had syrup buildup that could attract pests, and a ceiling vent in the washroom was dusty.

headline: Missing sanitizer test strips; food stored on floor
summary: The dish machine had no sanitizer test strips on site, but management provided them before the end of the inspection. Food containers were on the walk-in freezer floor, and clutter in the basement could allow rodent hiding places. Citation issued. Allergen certificate was missing.

headline: No certified food manager; food held too warm
summary: No certified food manager was on duty, and no certificate was posted, while TCS foods were being prepared. Several pizzas under the heat lamp tested 88–105°F, below the required 135°F; about 9 lbs was discarded. Trash and food debris were found outside. Citations issued.

headline: Food spills and grease; oven door held shut
summary: A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Single-service items were stored on the floor, and food spills covered cooking equipment and shelves. The oven door was not fully attached and was held closed with a bucket. Multiple cleaning items and citation issued.

headline: No health policy, cleanup kit, or allergen training
summary: No signed employee health policy and no vomiting/diarrhea clean-up procedure were on site. Over 50 mouse droppings were found in several areas, and a pest control service was recommended. Soap and a hand sign were missing at a front sink. Citation was not issued.

headline: Hair restraints and mineral buildup in soda dispenser
summary: Two pastry staff worked without hair restraints. Plates were stored face up, and mineral buildup was found inside the soda dispenser. An open drink cup sat on a running dish machine. Each item was instructed to be corrected.

headline: Restroom door not self-closing; greasy floor
summary: The toilet room door did not self-close and needs a closing device. Grease spilled on the floor under the fryer. Peeling paint above a chest freezer needs repair.

headline: Cracked, damaged floor tiles in walk-in coolers
summary: Walk-in cooler floor tiles were bulging and damaged. The inspector told the owner to repair them to a smooth, cleanable surface. Reach-in cooler interiors needed detail cleaning.

headline: Unpermitted kimchi production halted; expired food handler cards
summary: House-made kimchi was made without a required variance. About 10 lbs was tagged and held, and the owner was told to stop making and selling it. All food handler cards on site were expired. Citation issued.

headline: Hand sink blocked by dishes; manager fixed it
summary: Dishes and a food prep table blocked access to a hand sink. The manager cleared the obstruction on site, but a citation was issued. A cutting board had deep scratches, and the lobby toilet room needed cleaning.

headline: No backflow device at ice machine; wall hole
summary: No backflow prevention device was found at the ice machine, and it must be provided where it can be serviced. A hole in the wall near dishwashing is close to the floor and must be repaired to prevent roach or mouse harborage.

headline: Over 100 rodent droppings; pest log inadequate
summary: More than 100 droppings were found on the cooking line, and about 50 in the mop room. All must be removed and areas sanitized. The pest control log was inadequate, and no current pest control license or insurance was shown. A door sweep had an opening. Citation issued.

headline: Pink buildup inside ice machine
summary: Slight pink buildup was found inside the upper portion of the ice machine. The manager was instructed to clean it.

headline: Missing splash guard and backflow device
summary: Re-inspection found no splash guard on a one-compartment prep sink next to the three-compartment sink. A coffee machine in the taco restaurant also lacked a backflow prevention device. Both were ordered to be corrected.

headline: Condiments stored over sink; grocery bags in freezers
summary: Condiment bottles and caps were stored on electrical piping above a three-compartment sink. Grocery bags were used for food storage in freezers. The inspector instructed the staff to correct both.

headline: Ice scoop stored improperly; soiled mop head
summary: An ice scoop was not properly stored between uses and must be stored correctly. A soiled mop head was not hung to dry, and the manager was instructed to hang mop heads to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Leaking cold water line and sink pipe
summary: A leaking cold water line at a hand sink must be repaired. A three-compartment sink pipe and faucet leak as well. Crates used for food storage must be eliminated, and stained ceiling tiles must be repaired or replaced.

headline: No hot water at hand sinks; corrected on site
summary: Hand sinks had no hot water, with readings as low as 77.8°F, and the minimum is 100°F. Management adjusted the water on site, and readings reached 99.8–109.1°F. Also noted: missing freezer thermometers, unlabeled containers, and no food handler or allergen certificates. Citation issued.

headline: Torn freezer door gasket
summary: A chest freezer door gasket was torn. The inspector instructed the owner to replace it.

headline: Coolers need thermometers; food stored on floor
summary: Reach-in coolers lacked thermometers. A common storage door needed rodent-proofing. Food was stored on the floor, and raw wood needed sealing. A leaking hand sink and floor buildup in the front prep area also need correction.

headline: Bulk containers unlabeled; broken coving and ceilings
summary: Bulk food containers in the basement dry storage were unlabeled. The bar ice bin lacked a lid, and duct tape was on a freezer lid. Several baseboard coverings were broken. A ceiling hole and debris need repair. The women's restroom ventilation was inoperable.

headline: Moldy produce and cooler walls; no health policy
summary: About 40 lbs strawberries and other produce were moldy or spoiled and were voluntarily discarded, costing about $200. Mold-like patches covered cooler walls and ceilings. No signed employee health policies were on site. Citation issued.

headline: Soiled ice machine and slow-draining sink
summary: Ice machine non-food-contact surfaces had food debris and rust. A central hand sink near the upright cooler drained slowly but worked. Floors and walls near a utility sink had old food debris. All items must be corrected.

headline: Managers lack allergen awareness certificates
summary: Several certified food managers had no allergen awareness training certificates on site. The person in charge was instructed to get them and keep certificates on site at all times.

headline: Missing thermometer in prep cooler
summary: A visible and working thermometer was needed inside the one-door prep cooler. The inspector required the owner to provide one.

headline: Stained cutting boards; allergen certificate missing
summary: Stained cutting boards were found in food prep areas and must be resurfaced or replaced. A certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate and was instructed to complete the training.

headline: Expired allergen training; many upkeep repairs
summary: A food manager's allergen training was expired. Multiple repairs were required, including leaky pipes, damaged floors and walls, and worn gaskets. Items were stored on the floor, and cardboard remained on a prep table shelf. Cleaning of many surfaces is needed.

headline: Flies in prep and bar; hot water and sanitizing issues
summary: About 40 live small flying insects were in the prep and bar areas, and extra pest control was needed. Hand sinks had no cold water, and a dish machine did not rinse at the required 180°F. Dumpster lid was missing and garbage overflowed. Multiple citations issued.

headline: Inaccurate thermometers and hair restraint lapse
summary: Several prep and display coolers lacked accurate thermometers. A butcher's long braids hung over cutting boards without a restraint. A fly light trap was placed near pastry prep and must be moved away from food. Standing water and drainage issues need correction.

headline: Food debris and spills on floors and drains
summary: Food debris and spills were found on floors and in floor drains throughout the facility. The inspector instructed the owner to detail clean under shelving, around the dish machine, prep tables, and cooking equipment.

headline: Cold food too warm; about 7 lbs discarded
summary: Sliced chicken at 51.7°F and cream cheese at 67.1°F were held above the 41°F limit. About 7 lbs, worth $58, was discarded. A digital insect device hung above a prep table and must be moved. Dishwasher area had standing water.

headline: No soap at kitchen hand sink; multiple repairs
summary: No soap was at the kitchen hand sink, a priority violation with a citation. Floors, equipment, and a three-compartment sink need cleaning. Multiple prior core violations were not corrected, including expired handler and allergen certificates and an unlabeled container.

headline: Inaccurate thermometer; bulk containers unlabeled
summary: The double door dairy cooler thermometer was inaccurate. Bulk food containers lacked common-name labels. Both items were noted for correction.

headline: Cold food far too warm; flies and roach found
summary: TCS foods in a reach-in cooler and prep cooler held at 44.6–54.5°F, above the required 41°F; about 36 lbs was discarded. About 15 or more live small flies and one live roach were seen. Two cooler units were tagged and held. Citations issued.

headline: Single-service items on floor; not inverted
summary: Single-service articles were not inverted and were stored on the floor in dining, prep, and basement areas. The manager was instructed to invert them and raise them off the floor.

headline: Cold food too warm; cooler tagged; food discarded
summary: Cooked chicken, raw beef, and raw chicken in a reach-in cooler were at unsafe temperatures. The cooler was 46°F and was tagged. About 30 lbs was discarded on site. Utensils were stored in standing water and a cluttered basement needed cleaning. Citations issued.

headline: Walk-in cooler at 55°F; dust-heavy food surfaces
summary: The walk-in cooler measured 55°F, above the required 41°F, and the owner was told to repair it. Food-contact equipment was heavily soiled with construction plaster dust. Floors and corners had dust and debris. Citation issued.

headline: Grease under fryers needs cleaning
summary: The inspector instructed the owner to clean grease from the surfaces and floor under the fryers.

headline: Live rats and droppings found in food prep area
summary: Two live rats were seen in the food prep area, with about 50–100 rat droppings on food containers, near rice, and in the dining room. About 25–45 small black flies were in the rear prep area. A licensed pest control company was required. Citation issued.

headline: No certified manager on site; no pest logbook
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were served. No pest control logbook was on site. A food employee had no food handler training. Citation issued for the missing manager and pest logbook.

headline: No health policy; missing hand sink; food handler certificates lacking
summary: No employee health policy was on site. There was no hand sink at the dish area, and staff used a two-compartment sink for hand washing. A grease trap odor and hood buildup were noted. Employees lacked food handler certificates. Citation issued.

headline: No handwashing signs; hair restraints not worn
summary: No handwashing signs were posted near sinks in either washroom. Employees did not wear hair restraints while preparing food. Wiping cloths were left on a counter. A hand sink drained slowly, and peeling paint and burnt-out lights were noted.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables
summary: Soiled wiping cloths were stored on prep tables. The manager was instructed to store them in sanitizing solution between uses.

headline: No certified manager; blocked handsink
summary: No person in charge with a valid city sanitation certificate, and no certified manager on duty while cakes, fruit drinks, and pastries were prepared. Rear prep handsink was blocked by utensils and a food container. Food stored on floor. Pass with conditions.

headline: Seafood held at 60F; about 6 pounds discarded
summary: About 6 pounds of seafood and vegetable mixture held at 60F in prep area; person in charge discarded it, at a cost of $75. No handwashing signage in restrooms, and broken, missing wall tiles near utility panel. Pass with conditions.

headline: Failed: basement floor littered; prior violation uncorrected
summary: Basement floor is littered with debris and dust build-up. Core violation from January 2023 inspection was not corrected. Basement floors must be cleaned and maintained. Citation issued. Failed.

headline: Cooking equipment and ceiling vents need cleaning
summary: Exterior of cooking equipment needs cleaning, and the floor behind it needs cleaning. Dusty ceiling vents and light shields also need cleaning. Passed.

headline: Front door gap; damaged cutting board; leaking drain
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the front entrance door sweep must be closed to be rodent-proof. Cutting board above the three-door reach-in has dark grooves and must be repaired or replaced. Bar handwash sink drain leaking; dish area floor tiles damaged. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Rust on walk-in shelving; food debris on floors
summary: Rust on walk-in cooler shelving in the rear prep area must be removed. Accumulated food debris on front and rear prep area floors must be detail cleaned. Passed.

headline: Dishwasher not sanitizing; stop using it
summary: Low-temperature dishwasher sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine; inspector ordered it not used until at least 50 ppm. Manager called maintenance. Also food stored on floors and a greasy outdoor grease container. Pass with conditions.

headline: No food handler training for employees on duty
summary: No food handler training for employees on duty; all employees must provide it. Also a leaking three-compartment sink faucet, food spills on rear prep walls, dirty washroom fixtures, and single-use cups stored under a handsink. Passed.

headline: Failed: no hot water at handsinks; flies found
summary: Handsinks in the 4th and 6th floor dish areas had no hot water (74.5F); at least 100F required. About 70 pounds ($1,200) of cooked beef at 55-63.5F discarded. 15-30 live fruit flies in the dish room. Three-compartment sink leaking. Failed.

headline: Failed: no pest control log book
summary: No maintained pest control log book with recent service reports or the company's Illinois Department of Public Health license number. Manager only had a December 2024 invoice; facility is inspected twice a year. Service and proof of service required before re-inspection. Failed.

headline: Failed: food too warm; live roaches found
summary: Cooked rice, pot stickers, and raw chicken held above 41F in a prep cooler; the cooler at 52.9F was tagged. About 8 pounds ($32) discarded. Two live roaches in a staircase crevice and several dead roaches in liquor storage. Failed.

headline: Frozen chicken thawed in sink; test strips missing
summary: Two bags of frozen chicken were thawing in the prep sink; inspector instructed proper thawing. No test strips for quaternary ammonium sanitizer at the dish area, and too few sink stoppers at the three-compartment sink. Pass with conditions.

headline: Floors not clean at basement
summary: Basement floors were found not clean. Complaint re-inspection passed.

headline: Excess freezer ice; allergen training proof missing
summary: Excessive ice build-up in the walk-in freezer; inspector ordered it removed and the freezer closed properly to prevent temperature abuse. No proof of allergen training for certified food managers. Passed.

headline: Dirty floors and floor drains need cleaning
summary: Floors under, around, and behind equipment need cleaning, and floor drains at sinks need cleaning. Passed.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; missing handwashing signs
summary: Multiple food employees had expired food handler certificates. Inspector also found no handwashing signs at sinks, deeply scratched cutting boards, and grease and debris under cooking equipment. Passed.

headline: No handwashing signs; insect strips removed
summary: No handwashing signs at prep and restroom sinks; manager provided signs during inspection. Insect control strips were hung; manager removed them during inspection. Also a missing hair restraint, missing covered receptacle, and clutter. Passed.

headline: Clutter near three-compartment sink
summary: Area left of the three-compartment sink has clutter; it must be organized to prevent pest harborage. Passed.

headline: Failed: live roaches found; repeated violations
summary: About 10 live roaches crawling in openings near the soda cabinet and booth, plus dead roaches inside cabinets. Prior roach violation not corrected; pest control service required on or after 5/7/26. Worn cutting boards and greasy coolers also noted. Failed.

headline: No employee health policy; grease trap not located
summary: No employee health policy verification for food employees, a priority violation. Backflow device not located behind ice machine; grease trap for three-compartment sink not located. Toilet room door not self-closing; trash cans uncovered. Pass with conditions.

headline: No soap at restroom sink; loose faucet parts
summary: No hand soap at the employee restroom handsink, a priority violation; soap must be available at all times. Also a loose hot water knob on a handsink and a missing handle on the three-compartment sink faucet. Pass with conditions.

headline: No certified manager; cooler not holding 41F
summary: No certified manager on site and no manager certificate posted while eggs, chicken, and beef were prepared and served. Expediting-line reach-in cooler did not hold 41F or below; it was tagged, and no citation was issued. Pass with conditions.

headline: No covered waste receptacle in basement restroom
summary: Unisex employee washroom in the basement lacks a covered waste receptacle; one must be provided and maintained. Passed.

headline: No certified manager; cold food and handwashing lapses
summary: No certified food manager on site while food such as raw eggs was cooked and served. Employee handled food with gloves without washing hands between tasks. Raw eggs were stored above cooked chicken and moved on site. Eggs and cooked chicken held too warm; about 3 pounds discarded. Pass with conditions.

headline: Failed: about 40 live flies; improper pest control
summary: About 40 live small flies on walls, ceiling, and floor drains in dish and front prep areas; additional pest control needed. Also missing thermometers, a missing steam table food guard (tagged), leaking faucet bases, ice build-up on freezers, and food debris on floors. Failed.

headline: No paper towels at prep station handsink
summary: No paper towels at the prep station handsink; inspector instructed staff to provide them. Priority foundation violation for handwashing supplies. Pass with conditions.

headline: Dirty walk-in shelves; old equipment clutter
summary: Shelves and walls inside the walk-in cooler are not clean and must be cleaned. Old equipment clutter in the rear hallway must be removed. Passed.

headline: Missing thermometers; no food handler certificates
summary: Thermometers could not be found inside cooling units in front prep area. Broken ice machine internal lid falling into ice. Dump sink needed. Dried food debris behind heavy equipment and on storage racks. No food handler certificates on site. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Failed: no vomit cleanup procedures; prior violations uncorrected
summary: No written vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedures or supplies, and no approved variance or company policy on site. Prior violations not corrected: front door not rodent-proof and chipping walls. Also dust, grease, food debris, and unclean toilet rooms. Failed.

headline: Broken thermometer; foil used as shelf liner
summary: Ambient air thermometer on the outside of the walk-in cooler is in disrepair. Aluminum foil used as shelf liner in rear prep area must be removed or replaced with smooth, cleanable material. Passed.

headline: Unlabeled sugar, drain leak, improperly stored mop
summary: Sugar in a container without a label. Minor drain pipe leak under three-compartment sink. Mop drying improperly in mop sink area; must be stored with mop head upright between uses. Passed.

headline: Employees eating and drinking at prep area
summary: Employees were drinking and eating at kitchen prep areas; management must provide a designated break area. Soup spoon left in cheese container; food stored in tin cans; dirty floor drain; certified managers lack allergen training. Pass.

headline: Failed: 8 live roaches found throughout facility
summary: Inspector found 8 live roaches: 4 on rear prep walls and 4 behind front prep coolers. Manager told to clean, sanitize, and eliminate roach activity; more pest control service recommended. Also debris, broken walls and floors, and missing food labels. Failed.

headline: Uncovered food in cooler; missing thermometer
summary: Food in the walk-in cooler stored uncovered; food-grade lids or covers required. Basement freezer has no ambient air thermometer. Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints. Dust on washroom exhaust vents. Passed.

headline: Ice machine build-up; cracked floor tiles; no fan
summary: Slight build-up inside the ice machine must be cleaned. Cracked floor tiles around the two-compartment sink must be repaired. Washroom ceiling fan is not working and must be replaced. Passed.

headline: No self-closing door; holes in walls
summary: Toilet room door leading to food prep has no self-closing device. Holes in walls around prep area and toilet room piping must be sealed. One of two certified managers lacks allergen training. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Failed: no paper towels, soap, or pest log
summary: Paper towels and soap were missing at sinks; staff obtained them during inspection. No current pest control log book on site; pest control arrived during inspection. Prior core violation uncorrected: dirty cardboard shelf liner and wooden pallets used as shelving. Failed.

headline: Burnt light fixture in lower prep area
summary: Burnt light fixture in the lower-level preparation area must be repaired. Passed.

headline: Shrimp held too warm; about 5 pounds discarded
summary: About 5 pounds of shrimp in the prep area held at 58F-70F, above the 41F limit. Person in charge discarded it, at a cost of about $50. Citation issued. Pass with conditions.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; frozen chicken in plastic bags
summary: Missing handwashing signs at first and second floor bar handsinks. Frozen chicken stored in plastic grocery bags; food-grade bags required. Unlabeled food storage containers. Loose debris, dirt, and dust on floors throughout the facility. Passed.

headline: Cold foods too warm; about 15 pounds discarded
summary: Tomatoes, eggs, sour cream, deli meat, beef, and other foods measured 47.7F-66.9F, above 41F. About 15 pounds ($195) discarded. Prep cooler at 45F was tagged. Electric insect control device above a prep table must be relocated; leak under dish machine drainboard. Pass with conditions.

headline: Calcium build-up inside dish machine
summary: Complaint inspection found calcium build-up inside the dish machine; manager instructed to clean it. Passed.

headline: Basement restroom doors don't close properly
summary: Self-closing devices on several basement washroom doors must be adjusted so the doors close properly. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Cutting board with deep scratches
summary: Cutting board in the front prep area has deep scratches; manager instructed to repair or replace it. Passed.

headline: Improper thawing; dirty shelves and ceiling tiles
summary: Frozen chicken thawed in standing water in a cold-hold unit; running water is required. Rusted, dirty refrigerator shelves and stained ceiling tiles. Heavy grease and dirt in the hood, filters, and pipes. Floors and walls with food dirt. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Failed: over 100 mouse droppings found
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings scattered in prep, storage, dishwashing, and dining areas, including behind freezers and under cooking equipment. Manager instructed to call an exterminator and clean and sanitize all areas. Open sauce containers on dining tables also noted. Failed.

headline: Failed: sink buildup; prior floor violation uncorrected
summary: Food buildup inside the prep area and dish sinks, especially around hot and cold water handles, must be cleaned. Core violation from March 2025 not corrected: dirt, grease, and debris along walls and under equipment. Failed.

headline: No food sanitation certificate posted
summary: No valid City of Chicago food sanitation certificate posted on premises. Management told a certified food manager must be present whenever time- and temperature-controlled foods are prepared or served. Citation issued. Pass with conditions.

headline: Non-working thermometers; dirty toilet room walls
summary: Non-working thermometers at both cold-holding display units; working ones must be provided. Toilet room walls are not clean and have debris. Passed.

headline: Gloves not changed; no handwashing between tasks
summary: Employees handled food and touched prep surfaces while wearing gloves without changing them or washing hands between tasks; discussed with management. Priority violation; citation issued. Dirty wiping cloths left on prep tables. Pass with conditions.

headline: Oven not under hood; manager lacks allergen training
summary: No handwashing sign at hand sink; one must be provided. Oven is not under an exhaust hood; a hood must be provided or approved by the Department of Buildings. Prior core violation uncorrected: certified manager has no allergen training. Pass with conditions.

headline: Storage must be raised off floor; floor tiles broken
summary: Items in the rear storage room must be elevated off the floor. Dirt and debris on walls behind cooking equipment and a handsink in the main prep area. Missing and broken floor tiles. Grease and dirt on a prep area vent. Passed.

headline: Wall openings in prep and dish areas need sealing
summary: Openings and gaps in walls of the food prep and dishwashing areas must be sealed to prevent pest harborage. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Unlabeled refrigerated food; no training certificates
summary: Packaged refrigerated foods such as meatballs and marinara lack required labels. No food handler training certificates were on site. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Handwashing sink runs too briefly
summary: Employee restroom handwashing sink runs less than 15 seconds; management instructed to adjust it to run at least 15 seconds. Passed.

headline: Mineral build-up, leaks, and ceiling holes
summary: Pink mineral build-up inside an ice machine reservoir; torn refrigerator gasket; minor leak under three-compartment sink; holes in ceiling above basement dish machine; clutter in basement dish room. All must be fixed. Passed.

headline: No covered receptacle in women's restroom
summary: Women's toilet room has no covered receptacle; inspector required one. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Women's restroom lacks covered receptacle; allergen training required
summary: No covered receptacle for feminine hygiene products in the women's restroom; one must be provided. All City of Chicago certified managers must complete allergen training and keep certificates on site. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Broken restroom door closer; dusty vents
summary: No handwashing sign at rear prep handsink. Foil covering shelves, rust on table bottoms, debris under chest freezers and tables, heavy dust on air vents, and greasy hood filters. Restroom door self-closing device broken. Passed.

headline: Failed: no handwashing sink near dish area
summary: No handwashing sink accessible to the rear dish area. Inspector required a sink with hot and cold water, soap, and paper towels at the front service line. Unlabeled spice containers also noted. Failed.

headline: Missing thermometer in prep cooler
summary: Prep cooler is missing a thermometer. Passed.

headline: Unlabeled containers; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Dry food storage containers unlabeled; must be labeled with product name. Fryers, grill, freezers, and walk-in fans need cleaning. Slow-draining handsink and water-stained ceiling tile. Person in charge lacks allergen training. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Beards without guards; greasy fryer area
summary: Male food handlers had beards without beard guards. Grease build-up under fryers and along piping behind them must be removed. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Failed: improper handwashing and bare-hand food contact
summary: Food handlers washed hands in dish water, rinsed without soap, or wiped hands on a cloth; one handled ready-to-eat pizza bare-handed. Walk-in cooler at 51F; about 85 pounds ($280) of cold foods discarded. Mold-like substance inside ice machine. Expired manager allergen training. Failed.

headline: Missing splash guard; no food handler certificates
summary: No splash guard between grease trap and ice machine at lower level. Food handling employees have no food handler training certificates. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Items on floor; missing tile under pizza oven
summary: All stored items, including plastic milk crates, must be raised off the floor. Missing floor tile under the pizza oven must be replaced. Passed.

headline: Failed: dish machine not sanitizing; roaches found
summary: Low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged; it may not be used. About 5+ live roaches in dish and sink areas, plus droppings; additional pest control required. Food stored on floor; an employee had expired food handler certificate. Failed.

headline: Failed: no certified manager during food prep
summary: Food handlers prepared time-controlled foods without the original city certificate or a certified manager on site. Unlabeled tamales, bakery, milk, and cheese were discarded. Small flies too numerous to count, no handwashing signs, and no food handler training proof. Failed.

headline: Torn door gasket; broken floor tiles
summary: Torn door gasket on the rear three-door prep cooler must be repaired or replaced. Broken and missing floor tiles in front and rear prep and dish areas must be repaired and regrouted. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Dirty walk-in floor; insufficient lighting
summary: Walk-in cooler floor soiled with dry food debris; floors must be cleaned often enough to prevent build-up. Lighting in the rear warewashing area is insufficient; fixtures must be repaired or replaced. Passed.

headline: Turkey thawing in sink; food stored on floor
summary: Ground turkey was thawing improperly in the prep sink; manager told to thaw it under refrigeration, cold running water, or as part of cooking. Fries stored on floor. Also food spills on equipment, debris in a floor drain, and missing handwashing signs. Passed.

headline: Failed: dirty ice machines and cutting boards
summary: Both rear ice machines had pink, black, and brown build-up dripping onto ice stored below; ice must be removed and machines cleaned and sanitized. Wiping cloths left on prep tables, and all cutting boards have deep cuts and stains. Failed.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; ice machine slime
summary: Food handlers prepared time-controlled foods without the original city certificate or a certified manager on site. Ice bin machine had black and pink slime; ice is used for consumption. Milk stored on floor; utensils stored inside food containers; broken dumpster lid; no food handler training proof. Failed.

headline: Complaint: dirty floors behind cook line
summary: Floors behind the cook line are not clean and have food debris. Soda fountain pipes running on the floor prevent proper cleaning and must be raised off the floor. Passed.

headline: Cold food held too warm; hair found in food
summary: Walk-in cooler held milk at 44F, chicken at 44-49F, and other cold foods above 41F; must be kept at 41F or below. A long hair was found mixed in fried chicken. Expired food handler certificates and an expired allergen certificate for the manager. Pass with conditions.

headline: Cardboard liners; expired manager allergen training
summary: Cardboard used as liner on prep tables throughout the rear prep area must be removed. Microwave and prep coolers need interior detail cleaning. Certified food manager has an expired allergen training certificate. Passed.

headline: Ice bin needs cleaning; no allergen training proof
summary: Interior of ice bin needs cleaning. Mop stored improperly in rear; mop head must be kept upright. No food employee had proof of allergen training; documentation must be provided for certified managers. Passed.

headline: Unlabeled containers; greasy fryers
summary: Brownish substance around the ice maker must be cleaned and sanitized. Some dry storage containers lack product names. Grease debris inside fryers, and dirt and food debris around cooking equipment, refrigeration, and shelves. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Hot food held too cool; food discarded
summary: Cooked rice and chicken in to-go containers held at 95.6F-118F, below the 135F hot-holding minimum, with no time log. About 53 pounds ($250) discarded. Also beard and hair restraint needs, milk crates used as shelving, and an expired allergen certificate. Pass with conditions.

headline: No certified manager; cold food too warm
summary: No certified food manager on site while chicken, tacos, and hamburgers were prepared; manager arrived during inspection. Tomatoes at 49.6F and lettuce at 50.2F; about $5 discarded. Sweet potatoes held over 24 hours without a date; $200 discarded. No paper towels at handsinks. Pass with conditions.

headline: No employee health policy or vomit cleanup kit
summary: No employee health policy and no vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on the premises; both are required. Food handlers must obtain required food handler training, and managers must obtain allergen training. Pass with conditions.

headline: Grease dripping from hood above cooking
summary: Grease dripping from the hood above cooking equipment must be cleaned and maintained. Walls behind cooking equipment need debris removed. Passed.

headline: Missing signs, unlabeled containers, leaking faucet
summary: No handwashing sign in washroom and unlabeled food storage containers. Cutting board has open seams and dark stains. Also a leaking three-compartment faucet, greasy floors and hood filters, and expired food handler and allergen certificates. Passed.

headline: Cut greens held too warm; time-control records lacking
summary: Cut leafy greens at 68.5F on the main service line. Staff used time as a public health control without written procedures or markings; about 5 pounds ($25) discarded. Insect control device above clean equipment must be relocated. Pass with conditions.

headline: Dead cockroaches on glue board; no hand soap
summary: Several dead cockroaches found on a glue board under the front service line; inspector required removal. Rear prep handsink lacked hand soap, a priority violation. Pass with conditions.

headline: Failed: handsink removed; debris and peeling paint
summary: Premises removed a handsink from the front counter area; it must be reinstalled. Debris and residue under front counter, ice build-up in all freezers, and peeling paint and a torn baseboard by the three-compartment sink. Failed; citation issued.

headline: Ice machine needs cleaning; utensils stored near mop sink
summary: Upper interior of the ice machine needs cleaning. Clean utensils must not be stored above or near the utility mop sink. Rust and peeling paint on shelving in a four-door reach-in cooler; excess grease beside gas stove. Passed.

headline: Dirty ice machine; food stored on floor
summary: Ice machine interior soiled with black substance; ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned and sanitized. Food stored on floor throughout the facility must be raised six inches. Cooler drain improperly draining into rear handwash sink. Dust on employee washroom exhaust vent. Pass with conditions.

headline: Leaking sinks, food debris, and dirty floors
summary: Three-compartment sink leaks from bottom seams; utility and three-compartment sink faucets leak. Food debris and spills found on prep tables, shelving, coolers, and freezers. Floors under equipment and in corners need cleaning. Re-inspection passed.

headline: No front screen door; toilet room lacks ventilation
summary: No screen door at the front entrance; manager told to provide one or keep the front door closed. Toilet room has no mechanical ventilation. Passed.

headline: Backflow devices not easy to locate
summary: Backflow devices could not be found on coffee machine, espresso machine, ice machine, and utility sink; they must be installed where they can be serviced. Also greasy floors under cooking equipment, debris under dish machine, and grease on hood filters. Passed.

headline: No covered feminine hygiene receptacle
summary: Unisex staff toilet room has no covered receptacle for feminine hygiene products; manager instructed to provide and maintain one. Passed.

headline: Dirty dish pit, floors, walls; no summary posted
summary: Heavy dirt, grime, and food debris on floors and walls of dish pit and prep areas; detail cleaning required. Roll-top cooler has ice build-up inside. Public inspection summary from the prior inspection was not posted; a new one was left. Pass with conditions.

headline: Food stored in grocery bags
summary: Cooked and frozen foods stored in grocery bags throughout coolers and freezers; inspector required food-grade bags only. Passed.

headline: Damaged cabinet, floor dust, items on floor
summary: Damaged cabinet door at service counter must be repaired or replaced. Items in rear storage must be raised off the floor and away from walls, and dust under the counter and in storage must be cleaned. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Missing thermometer; floor and wall repairs needed
summary: No working thermometer inside the reach-in cooler. Unfinished floor and a hole in the wall under the reach-in freezer must be repaired. Passed.

headline: Heavy dirt and debris at bars and kitchen
summary: Heavy dirt, dust, and debris under shelving, equipment, floor drains, and lower walls at both bars. Kitchen dirt under dish machine and sticky build-up on floor near soda units. Cleaning required to prevent pest and insect harborage. Passed.

headline: No certified manager; cold food too warm
summary: No certified food manager on site while time- and temperature-controlled foods were handled. Crab rangoon dip held at 48-50F; about 6 pounds ($100) discarded. Also a 1/4-inch gap at rear door and moldy caulking. Pass with conditions.

headline: Missing food handler training proof; several cleanliness issues
summary: No proof of food handler training for required employees. Also wiping cloths not kept in sanitizer, a knife stored on the bar faucet, milk crates used as shelving, a worn cutting board, and moldy caulking. Passed.

headline: Soap missing at sink; several fixes made on site
summary: Handsink had hand sanitizer in the soap dispenser; corrected on site with soap. Toilet tissue missing in stalls was corrected on site. Gaps at front and garage doors must be sealed. Cardboard liner and missing floor grout also noted. Pass with conditions.

headline: Door gaps; rust; grease and leaks
summary: Gap at bottom of man door and revolving door must be made tight-fitting. Grocery bags used for pita storage. Rust on walk-in shelving; worn cutting boards; leaky faucet; grease in cabinets; cracked light shield; dusty vents.

headline: Dish machine and floors need deep cleaning
summary: Dish machine interior had lime and grease buildup. Storage racks had dust and flour. Floors along walls and under coolers need detail cleaning. A ceiling vent in the right-side washroom was not working.

headline: Food handler certificates missing
summary: Food handler certificates could not be found or verified on site. They must be provided and kept on site. City food managers also lacked allergen training; management was instructed to complete it.

headline: Mouse droppings and gaps; citation issued
summary: About 25 mouse droppings in rear storage area; citation issued and additional pest control required. 1/4-inch gap at rear exit door. Three-compartment sink stopper not working; utility sink leaks; food debris and missing floor tiles.

headline: No thermometers; leaks; unfinished walls
summary: Cooling units in front and rear prep lacked thermometers. No protective barrier between customers and exposed food in coffee prep. Utility sink had no hot or cold water. Leaking faucet neck. Unfinished walls and a gap near garage doors.

headline: Wiping cloths left on bar; basement clutter
summary: Several wiping cloths were left on the bar surface and must be stored in sanitizer between uses. Basement clutter and items stored on the floor must be removed and placed on proper shelving to prevent pest harborage.

headline: No valid manager certificate; citation issued
summary: No person in charge with verifiable food service manager training. No valid city food sanitation certificate on site; citation issued. Floor drains in the bar area have built-up debris that must be detail cleaned.

headline: No current pest logbook; citation issued
summary: No up-to-date pest control logbook; last service record was from 2022; citation issued. Disposable towels used as ties on equipment. No sanitizer test strips. Pizza oven and ceiling tiles heavily greased and dusty.

headline: Greasy fryers and moldy unused cooler
summary: Fryer interiors greasy. Unused four-door cooler has mold and food inside. Unused refrigeration in rear prep needs cleaning. Hot water knob at rear hand sink in poor repair. Cracked floor tiles; missing hood filters.

headline: No handwashing signs; missing ceiling tile
summary: No handwashing signs at employee washroom sinks. Missing ceiling tile above proofer; missing floor grout in several prep areas; stained ceiling tile. Employee restrooms need mechanical ventilation. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Dead roaches and small openings at doors
summary: Dead roaches were on the floor and walls of the rear food prep area. Small openings at the bottom of the front and rear doors must be sealed. The ice machine in prep lacked a backflow prevention device.

headline: Broken dumpster lid; citation issued
summary: An outside dumpster was missing half its lid and was not fully intact, which can let pests in. Lid must be replaced and kept tight-fitting. Citation issued.

headline: No hand sink in cafe prep; sink too small
summary: No hand sink in the cafe preparation area; one must be provided. Equipment too large to fully submerge in the sushi kitchen three-compartment sink; must use a larger sink, smaller equipment, or an approved alternative.

headline: Pots and spices stored in garage with vehicle
summary: Pots, pans and spices were stored in a garage containing a vehicle; food items were moved during inspection. Ice machine in garage must be kept labeled and used for non-consumption ice only.

headline: Broken thermometer; damaged cutting boards
summary: Broken thermometer inside the self-service hot food unit. Cutting boards in the rear prep area have open seams and stains. Torn gasket on a prep cooler. Missing and damaged floor tiles in the seafood area.

headline: Slow-draining sink; debris behind ice machine
summary: No handwashing signs in the first employee washroom. Exposed hand sink drains slowly in rear prep. Dust in light shields and food debris behind the ice machine must be cleaned.

headline: Gap under rear door needs pest seal
summary: Inspector found a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the rear exit door. The facility must install a tight-fitting seal at all outer openings to keep pests out.

headline: No health policy or sick-event plan; cited
summary: No employee health policy or training and no procedure or kit for vomiting and diarrhea events; priority violations. Rusty shelves and prep base, stained cutting boards, and grease inside the fryer cabinet also noted.

headline: Labeling, missing knob and allergen certificates
summary: Food in plastic containers needs common-name labels. Hot holding pot is missing a knob. Hole behind sink needs sealing. More allergen training certificates are needed for certified managers. Re-inspection passed.

headline: 200+ rodent droppings; pest control required
summary: About 200 or more small rodent droppings found under equipment, sinks, in closets, storage, furnace room, walk-in coolers and office; citation issued. Pest control service required. Food handler training missing.

headline: Ice on freezer floor; blown hood bulb; grease
summary: Ice and debris built up on the freezer floor and must be cleared. A blown light bulb in the hood system must be replaced. Grease buildup on hood filters must be cleaned.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; about 150 droppings
summary: Milk, eggs, deli meat and other cold foods held at 49.8-56.2F in the walk-in cooler; about $250 discarded. About 150 droppings found in several areas. Cooler tagged; citation issued; pest control recommended.

headline: Dirty ice machine; exposed rodent trap
summary: Inside of the rear ice machine was not clean. Staff were told to remove ice and clean and sanitize it. An exposed rodent trap under storage shelves must be properly covered.

headline: No sick-event plan, soap or towels; cited
summary: No plan or kit for vomiting and diarrhea events. Restroom hand sink had no soap or paper towels. No pest control logbook, mop sink, or dumpster service. Priority violations; citations for several items.

headline: No certified manager during pork prep; cited
summary: No person in charge with a valid certificate, and no certified manager on site while pork at 167.3F was prepared and served; citation issued. Food handlers lacked hair restraints and training. Soiled mop head on floor.

headline: Many upkeep fixes; no food manager allergen training
summary: Slow drain at rear hand sink; no thermometer for coolers; unlabeled squeeze bottles; damaged floor tiles and wall bases; greasy fryer cabinets; no sink stoppers; no allergen training for food manager. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Pest entry gaps; dead flies; no food handler certificates
summary: Openings at base of rear garage door and by front entrance; front garage door left open. Over 20 dead flies in rear dry storage. No food handler certificates. Meat saw and prep table stored in area with no handsink; prior violation not corrected.

headline: Missing thermometer in front prep cooler
summary: Front prep cooler was missing a thermometer. Staff were instructed to provide one.

headline: Hand-washing lapses; 303 lb of food discarded
summary: Dishwasher handled dirty dishes without washing hands; no soap at main prep sink; a rear sink was blocked by an air-conditioner drain line. Cold foods at 57-65F; about 303 lb ($9,700) discarded. Two coolers held; citations issued.

headline: Thermometer placement, labels and storage fixes
summary: Refrigerator thermometer was placed behind food; it must be moved to the warmest visible spot. Grab-and-go salads lacked content weight labels. Brooms and dustpans were kept too close to clean utensils.

headline: Prep cooler not holding temperature; tagged
summary: Two-door front prep cooler held 46.7F on one side and 39.5F on the other. Tagged; must not be used until it holds 41F or below. No internal thermometer. Personal items hung on dry storage shelves beside food.

headline: No valid food certificate; hygiene and drain problems
summary: No valid city food sanitation certificate was posted. Shellfish tags were undated. Food handlers had no hair restraints; staff were given hats on site. Dish machine lacked test strips. Earlier violations were not corrected.

headline: Pork thawed in standing water; repeat violation
summary: Pork was thawed in standing water in the three-compartment sink, a repeat violation; citation issued. Toilet room door was not self-closing. Floors around cold units, prep tables and cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: No hot water at washroom sinks; repaired on site
summary: Restroom hand sinks had no hot water; temperature was 60F. A plumber repaired it, and it reached 101F by the end of the inspection. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Pest entry gap at front door; several repairs
summary: A small opening at the base between the front entrance doors must be sealed to prevent pests. Also noted: a damaged cooler gasket, a missing backflow device on the ice machine, and cracks and unsealed wood.

headline: Rodent infestation; citation issued
summary: About 1,000 mouse droppings found throughout food prep, dining, washrooms and storage; citation issued and additional pest control needed. No city food sanitation certificate, food handler or allergen certificates. 1/2-inch exit door gap.

headline: Handsink blocked by waste bin; cooler too warm
summary: Handwash sink blocked by a waste receptacle; person in charge moved it on site. Front vegetable cooler could not hold 41F; food was being discarded and cooler tagged. Single-service items stored under a greywater pipe.

headline: Broken floor tiles and dirty condiment cooler
summary: Interior of the condiment cooler must be cleaned. Broken floor tiles in the employee washroom, stock room and around the three-compartment sink must be replaced. Re-inspection passed.

headline: No food manager certificate posted; cited
summary: No valid city food manager certificate was posted on site; citation issued. No handwashing signs at sinks throughout the facility. No trash cover in washroom. No allergen training certificates for city food managers.

headline: No certified manager at first; flies; no hot water
summary: No certified manager on premises at first; one arrived at 12:15pm. Hand sinks 75.6-95.2F, must reach 100F. No hot running water. About 15 large flies seen. Dish machine at 0 ppm chlorine, repaired on site. Dumpster lids not tight.

headline: No health policy; door gap lets rodents in
summary: No written employee health policy on site and no handwashing signs. Rear receiving door has a 1/2-inch gap at the bottom and is not rodent proof. Also noted: slow leaks, rust, dirty floors and uncovered washroom trash cans.

headline: Grime under sink and near water heater
summary: Grime built up on the floor under the three-compartment sink and near the hot water heater. Staff were told to clean and maintain the area.

headline: No certified manager; dead mouse on glue board
summary: No certified person in charge or food manager was on site while meatballs at 175.3F were prepared and served; citation issued. Dirty floors held a glue board with a dead mouse. Food handler and allergen certificates were missing.

headline: Leaking faucet and greasy hood
summary: A three-compartment sink faucet leaks at the base and must be repaired. Grease has built up on the ventilation hood and must be cleaned.

headline: Leaking pipes; clutter; no allergen certificate
summary: Leaky piping at the dishwashing hand sink and a corn container shutoff valve must be repaired. Tools and clutter stored in the food storage area. Certified food manager lacked allergen training; prior violation uncorrected.

headline: Six dead flies in dining and kitchen areas
summary: Six dead flies were found on a dining-room windowsill and near the fry station. Staff were told to remove them, detail clean, sanitize and keep the area maintained.

headline: Dirty shelving, grooved cutting boards, leaks
