summary: Shelving and dry storage need detail cleaning to prevent pests. Long cutting boards are badly stained and grooved. Hand sink leaks at base and drain. Floors need detail cleaning. Manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Missing cooler thermometers; poor storage habits
summary: Several cold-holding units lacked internal thermometers. A knife was left resting between cooler lids. Clean plates and to-go containers were stored uncovered. A washroom ceiling vent was broken.

headline: Frozen meat stored in thin plastic wrap
summary: Frozen meat was stored in thin plastic wrap. Management was instructed to use only proper food-grade storage bags and containers.

headline: Dry storage walls not easily cleanable
summary: Walls throughout the dry storage area are not smooth and easily cleanable. Management was instructed to provide and maintain suitable surfaces.

headline: Live roaches in prep area; citation issued
summary: Live roach activity was observed in the prep area. Manager was told to call an exterminator and clean and sanitize all areas. Citation issued. Also noted: food debris, a soiled mop on the floor, and missing allergen training for managers.

headline: Unlabeled containers and worn cutting boards
summary: Bulk and small storage containers lacked common-name labels. Cutting boards were stained and deeply cut. Clutter sat on the upstairs storage room floor. Staff were told to fix each item.

headline: Hair restraints, gaskets and food handler certificates
summary: Employees in food prep were not wearing hair restraints. Wiping towels were not stored in sanitizer. Cooler gasket in poor repair. One employee had no food handler certificate. Trash can in restroom had no lid.

headline: Leaking sprayer; residue on floors and walls
summary: Slight buildup inside the Starbucks ice machine door. Leaking sprayer at the three-compartment sink in the chef's kitchen. Residue on floors under sinks and equipment and on walls near sinks. Staff told to clean and repair.

headline: Food on walk-in floor; cardboard used as mats
summary: Food was stored on the walk-in cooler floor and must be elevated. Knives not stored properly between uses. Three-compartment sink missing stoppers. Cardboard used as mats. Cutting boards have open seams. No certified manager had allergen training.

headline: Residue in coolers; debris in dry storage
summary: Residue built up on the bottom of cold-hold units. Excessive food debris was on the floor of the rear dry storage area. Person in charge was told to clean and maintain.

headline: Ready-to-eat food not date-marked; cited
summary: Prepackaged salads, rib tips and chicken held over 24 hours in several coolers had no date marks. Citation issued; disposition dates required. Broken-down cardboard boxes were found in use and stored on floors.

headline: One food manager lacked allergen training
summary: One certified food manager did not have a food allergen training certificate. Management was instructed that all city-certified food managers must have one.

headline: Low water pressure at one restroom sink
summary: Complaint inspection. One of two washbasin sinks in the customer men's restroom had low water pressure. Management was instructed to correct and maintain it.

headline: Shrimp and other cold foods too warm; cited
summary: Several TCS foods held at 58-80F; about $50 discarded, including shrimp and egg products. Mortadella, chicken, salami and cheese removed from packaging had no date marks. Citations issued; food date-marked with 7-day disposal date.

headline: Food in dish-soap containers; sewage backups
summary: Cooked food was stored in seven former dish-soap containers; about 45 lb discarded. Hand sinks lacked hot water, and one was at 132.6F. Toilets overflowed in first-floor washrooms. Several items noted as fixed on 7-29-2024.

headline: Greasy walls around dish area
summary: Food and grease were on the walls around the dishwashing area. The manager must clean the walls and keep them clean.

headline: Dirty drink nozzles; floors need cleaning
summary: Drink machine nozzles and surrounding areas need detail cleaning. Automatic dispensers at sinks need checking; nozzles are hard to use. Floors in several areas need debris removed.

headline: No city-certified food manager on site
summary: No city-certified food manager was on site, and the receipt shown was past the grace period. An outlet base was missing, leaving gaps where pests could hide. Equipment stored under common-area stairs; hood and lights did not work.

headline: No covered trash cans in upstairs restroom
summary: Upstairs women's restroom had no covered receptacles. Manager was instructed to provide them. Re-inspection passed.

headline: No hot water at front hand sink; food in bags
summary: Front prep hand sink had no hot running water; citation issued. Food stored in grocery bags and tin cans in coolers. Large pots too big for the dish machine. Clutter in hallway could hide pests. Hood heavily greased.

headline: Certified manager lacked allergen training
summary: No proof of allergen training for the certified food manager on site. City-certified food managers must obtain this certificate and keep it on site.

headline: Dirty ice machine; duct-taped bucket; leaks
summary: Ice machine interior needs cleaning. Unlabeled bulk food; plates without handles used as scoops; dishwasher lacked hair restraint. Cardboard shelf liners, duct tape on ice bucket, and a leak under three-compartment sink repaired with putty.

headline: No health policy, sick-event plan or allergen training
summary: No employee health policy or training and no plan or kit for vomiting and diarrhea events. Handwashing signs missing. Certified food managers lacked allergen training certificates. Priority violations; no citation.

headline: Still 15+ live roaches; hand sink water too cool
summary: Inspector again saw 15 or more live roaches, including near cold-holding units and freezers, plus dead ones; pest control service required. Hand-sink water was only 80-82F; must reach 100F. Cited.

headline: No manager on site; dead roaches in traps
summary: No certified food manager on site while open; citation issued. Sticky traps in the mop closet were filled with dead roaches. Lettuce stored on floor; missing hair restraints; repeat black mold in ice machine not corrected.

headline: Ice buildup in freezer; training records missing
summary: Excessive ice inside the rear chest freezer must be removed. Water-damaged ceiling tiles above dishwashing. Food handlers lacked proof of training; one of two certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving throughout the prep and storage areas. They must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Frozen pork thawed in still water
summary: Frozen pork was thawed in still water; must use running water at 70F or below. Food handlers prepared food without hair restraints. City food managers lacked allergen training certificates on site.

headline: 80 rodent droppings; handwashing and thawing issues
summary: Food handler put on gloves without washing hands after using phone; citation. About 80 large rodent droppings found around mop sink; citation. No hand dryers at sinks. Fish thawed in standing water; leaking plumbing.

headline: Food and paper stored on floor
summary: Food and paper supplies in the rear area were stored on the floor. They must be raised to prevent cross-contamination.

headline: No certified manager; sewage backup corrected
summary: No verifiable city certificate or certified manager on site while bacon, sausage and eggs were prepared; citation issued. Pink mold-like substance in the ice machine; ice discarded. Sink backup corrected by plumber during inspection.

headline: Unlabeled bulk ingredients; garbage cans hold sauce
summary: Large bulk ingredient containers were not labeled. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer. Large garbage cans were used to store sauce and must be properly washed. Leaks at two sinks; charred debris in pit.

headline: Tomato too warm; fly strip over prep; cited
summary: Sliced tomato at 58.6F in deli was discarded (3 lb, $18); citation issued. Fly strip hung directly over prep and dish area and must be removed. Three-compartment sink backs up. No proof of food handler training.

headline: Manager's allergen training expired
summary: Allergen training for the certified manager on site had expired. Person in charge was instructed to obtain updated training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: No front hand sink; no food handler certificates
summary: No handwashing sink in the front prep area; priority violation, no citation. Leaking three-compartment sink piping, two large holes in rear prep wall, restroom door not self-closing, and no food handler certificates on premises.

headline: Staff not wearing hair restraints; dirty drains
summary: Food handlers in prep areas were not wearing hair restraints and were told to start. Floor drains and floors under heavy equipment had dirt, stains and debris that must be cleaned.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; blocked utility sink
summary: Bulk containers in prep area were not labeled with common names. Utility sink was filled with items and could not be used for wastewater disposal. Certified manager on duty lacked allergen training.

headline: Broken food thermometer; milk crate shelving
summary: Food thermometer not working; battery must be replaced. Milk crates used for storing items in the walk-in freezer must be replaced. Baseboard behind juice shelf needs resealing. Floor by three-compartment sink must stay dry.

headline: No hair restraints; cardboard liners; milk crates
summary: Food handlers prepped food without hair restraints; manager provided hair nets during inspection. Cardboard used as liners on prep equipment and shelves must be removed. Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced.

headline: Staff eating and drinking at sushi prep
summary: Employees ate and drank at the sushi prep area; a designated break area is required. Serving plates stored uprightless. Torn cooler gasket, foil lining on shelves that could hide pests, leaking faucets and dirty ceiling fans.

headline: Boxes and milk crates in dumpster area
summary: Cardboard boxes and milk crates were stored in the rear dumpster area. They must be removed and the area kept clear.

headline: Cold food too warm; 30+ flies; food in toilet room
summary: Chicken at 48F and other cold foods at 48-52F; about $50 discarded. Two coolers at 50F. More than 30 small flies throughout; citation issued. Food stored in toilet room closet. No vomit cleanup kit.

headline: Cold beef and steak too warm; soap missing
summary: About 10 lb cooked ground beef and 4.5 lb cooked steak held at 50-52F; discarded. Rear hand sink had no soap and front prep lacked hand drying; citation issued. Food debris on floors; missing thermometer.

headline: Cold food too warm; ice machine slime; cited
summary: Tzatziki at 54.1F, mashed potatoes at 50.1F and other cold foods held too warm in a prep cooler; about $65 discarded. Ice machine had black slimy buildup dripping into ice. Hand sink water 84.5F; cited.

headline: Missing freezer thermometer; leaks and grease
summary: No thermometer inside the outdoor upright freezer. Leak at basement three-compartment sink near the drain. Grease buildup on upstairs prep hood filters. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Dirt and food debris; items stored on ground
summary: Dirt and food debris were found around the hot water heater, grease trap, and under shelves and cooking equipment. Frying oil and dirty equipment were stored directly on the ground. Items must be kept at least 6 inches up.

headline: No written health policy; manager lacked allergen training
summary: No written employee health policy on premises; priority violation. Certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate. Management was instructed to provide proof of both items.

headline: Hand sink too cool; cold potatoes discarded
summary: Women's washroom hand sinks at 85.6-86.7F; must reach 100F; citation issued. Potatoes at 50.2F in walk-in were discarded. Three certified managers lacked allergen training. Mold-like substance found in large ice machine.

headline: Restroom closed for toilet problem; light out
summary: One of two toilet rooms was closed after its toilet backed up. Manager was given two days to repair. Handwashing signs missing. Exhaust light not working in prep area. Manager on duty lacked allergen training.

headline: Food debris and spills throughout facility
summary: Food debris and spills were found on floors and surfaces throughout the facility. Staff were told to detail clean under shelving, prep and cooking equipment, and dish areas, and to increase cleaning frequency.

headline: No valid manager training; beer in outdoor shed
summary: No valid food safety training for the person in charge and no city sanitation certificate posted; citation issued. Beer was stored in an outside shed. Cutting boards were stained and cut. Washrooms lacked covered trash and self-closing doors.

headline: Dirty machines, coolers and floors
summary: Exteriors of coffee, shake and ice cream machines and nearby countertop need cleaning. Interior of small coolers in front prep area needs cleaning. Floors behind equipment, along wall bases and in the basement need cleaning.

headline: Side door gap; ice buildup; leaking bar faucets
summary: Side exit door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom; weather stripping must be replaced to block pests. Basement freezer has ice buildup. Leaking faucets at bar three-compartment sinks. Ceiling and light shields need cleaning.

headline: Hand sink leaks; grease and debris buildup
summary: Leaks at the base and pipe of exposed hand sinks in dish and prep areas must be repaired. Rubber gaskets on two-door coolers are in poor repair. Fryers, cooking equipment and refrigeration interiors need cleaning.

headline: Dusty washroom vent covers
summary: Pass. Vent covers in the washrooms were very dusty and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Food and hose in handsink; accessibility issue
summary: Pass with conditions. Lettuce was in the front prep handsink, and a hose draining into a basin of cut potatoes was connected at the rear. The hose was removed. Handsinks must be used only for handwashing and kept accessible. Thermometers and a splash guard were also required.

headline: Food stored on walk-in floors
summary: Pass. Food containers were stored directly on the floors of the walk-in cooler and freezer. The manager was instructed to raise them at least six inches on shelving.

headline: No certified manager; black slime in ice machine
summary: Fail. No valid City sanitation certificate was posted, a priority citation. Black slime was found on the ice machine's ice contact surfaces, a priority violation. No metal stem thermometer or sanitizer test strips were available. Pizza oven food debris and an open floor drain were also noted.

headline: Overflowing garbage; lids cannot close
summary: Fail. Garbage overflowed over both outside dumpsters so lids could not close. Management was told to keep lids closed and maintain pickup, a priority citation.

headline: Missing sign, probe thermometer, and test strips
summary: Fail. No handwashing sign was posted at the serving-area sink. No probe thermometer for food temperatures was on site. There was no sanitizer test strip and no temperature device for warewashing. The refuse area was littered with crates.

headline: No mop-water sink; holes in walls
summary: Pass. No service sink was available for disposing of mop water. Holes were found in walls under the 3-compartment sink and in the toilet room. Peeling paint was on the walk-in freezer ceiling, and rear floors had dirt and debris.

headline: Missing thermometers, unlabeled bulk food, wet cloths
summary: Pass with conditions. Coolers lacked thermometers, and bulk containers were unlabeled. A 1/4-inch gap was found at the rear exit door. Onions and tomatoes were on the floor. Wet wiping cloths were left on surfaces. Frozen chicken was in grocery bags. A prior allergen training violation was not corrected.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate posted
summary: Pass with conditions. No valid City sanitation certificate was posted or on site for the manager on duty, a priority citation. An allergen certificate had expired. A hair restraint was required in the prep area, and debris was under the sink.

headline: Soiled cardboard floor mats; grease on floor
summary: Pass. Soiled cardboard was used as floor mats, and cardboard was stored under the dish rack. Grease spills were on the floor behind cooking equipment. An expired allergen training certificate was on site.

headline: Live cockroaches found; sanitizer at zero
summary: Fail on complaint inspection. Live cockroaches were found at coolers, under sinks, and near the deep fryer, a priority citation. Pest control was advised. The dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer and was repaired during inspection. Dead roaches and leaks were also found.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; label gaps
summary: Pass. Employee restrooms had no handwashing signs, and the operator was instructed to post them. Grab-and-go sandwich and salad labels lacked ingredients and weight.

headline: One burnt-out light bulb in prep area
summary: Pass. One light bulb in the main prep light was burnt out and must be replaced.

headline: Food stored on floor in dry storage
summary: Pass. Boxed food was on the floor in the rear dry storage room and must be raised six inches. A ceiling panel was missing there. The room had clutter and items on the floor.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; repeat violations
summary: Fail on complaint re-inspection. Black slimy buildup was found in the basement ice machine, which makes ice for customers. Repeat violations included no cold-holding thermometers, food stored on the basement floor, and no backflow device on the ice machine. A citation was issued.

headline: Food on floors; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: Pass. A bulk container was unlabeled. Sliced potatoes were on the floor near a handsink, and shortening was stored in a furnace room. Single-service articles were not inverted. Food debris was on cooking equipment, and a cooler door gasket was damaged.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: Pass with conditions. The person in charge had no City food manager certificate. No certified manager was on duty while chicken was prepared and served, a priority citation. Foil lined shelving, and a food handler lacked a certificate from a prior violation.

headline: About 135 rodent droppings; cold food unsafe
summary: Fail. About 135 or more small rodent droppings were found throughout the premises, a priority citation. Cold food held at 55-103F was discarded. Handsinks lacked hand-drying supplies, and food handlers lacked hair restraints. The back door was not rodent-proof.

headline: No employee health policy; missing trainings
summary: Pass with conditions. No employee health policy was on the premises, a priority citation. A food handler and the certified food manager lacked required training certificates. The person in charge must document that employees report illness.

headline: No raw-food advisory; repeat grease and labeling issues
summary: Fail on re-inspection. The menu still lacks a consumer advisory for raw or undercooked food, a priority violation. Containers were unlabeled, and a food bucket sat on the walk-in floor. Grease and food debris covered cooking equipment, coolers, and freezers. Wet mops had no hanging system.

headline: About 20 dead cockroaches; no certified manager
summary: Fail on complaint inspection. About 20 dead cockroaches were on the basement floor, and must be cleaned up. No certified food manager was on site while cheesesteaks and wings were being prepared. A line cooler was at improper temperature, but food was removed and the unit was tagged.

headline: Certified manager arrived 35 minutes late
summary: Fail on complaint inspection. The person in charge lacked a sanitation certificate, and steamed milk was served before a certified manager arrived, a priority citation. Four dogs were in the establishment, not service animals. No metal stem thermometer or sanitizer test strips were present.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate; overflowing trash
summary: Fail. No valid sanitation certificate was on premises, a priority citation. The menu did not disclose raw or undercooked items. The outside waste receptacle was overfilled, and a cook-line sink had an open hole. Previous violations for raw wood and water damage were not corrected.

headline: Food held too cold; about 20 lbs discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Chicken at 109F, pork at 85.1F, and ribs at 89F were held at unsafe hot temperatures in the front display unit, and about 20 lbs were discarded. Handsink lacked paper towels, a priority citation. Food storage containers were unlabeled, and grease built up on cooking equipment.

headline: Food handler training certificates still missing
summary: Pass on re-inspection. The operator must provide food handler training and certificates for all required employees.

headline: No certified manager while milk and ice cream served
summary: Pass with conditions on re-inspection. No City-certified food manager was on site while TCS foods such as milk and ice cream were prepared and served, a priority citation. Milk crates were used as shelving, and loose debris and dust were on floors.

headline: Unlabeled packaged desserts; missing light cover
summary: Pass. A prep cooler lacked an air thermometer. Packaged cheesecake and cake in the display cooler lacked labels. Wiping cloths were stored dry on a prep table. A light cover was missing in the women's washroom, and certified managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Missing thermometers; hair restraint lapses
summary: Pass. Some coolers lacked thermometers. Some food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Items were stored on the basement floor outside the walk-in cooler and must be raised off the floor.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: Fail. No person in charge held a valid sanitation certificate. No certified manager was on duty while chicken, hot dogs, and noodles were prepared and served, a priority citation. Water backed up between sink basins, and a compartment sink handle was broken.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths; cutting boards stained
summary: Pass. Soiled wiping cloths were stored on prep coolers. Cutting boards had open seams and dark stains. Water leaked from a pipe under the hand sink. Expired allergen training was found for all certified managers.

headline: Uncovered food and debris; missing training
summary: Pass on complaint re-inspection. Food was uncovered in the walk-in cooler, and lids were not inverted. Food spills and debris were on surfaces. Soiled crates and boxes were in the prep area, and light shields were damaged. Food handler training was missing for employees.

headline: Uninverted pans; grimy drains and hood filters
summary: Pass. Sheetpans, bowls, and hotel pans were not inverted. Floor drains had food debris and grime. Vent filters above the hot line had heavy soot and grease buildup. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Food held too warm; dishes rewashed
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified sanitation person was on site initially, a priority citation. Dishes were washed in a prep sink, and the employee was instructed to rewash them. Eggs at 111.6F and hot dogs at 113F were discarded.

headline: Dirty floor drains; soiled mop heads
summary: Pass on re-inspection. Debris was around the dumpster. Floor drains in the bakery and dish areas had dirt and debris. Soiled mop heads were not properly stored and must be hung up.

headline: Gap at rear door; no allergen training
summary: Pass. A 1/4-inch gap was found at the bottom of the rear exit door, which must be sealed to keep pests out. Milk crates were used as shelving. No allergen training was on site for the certified food service manager.

headline: Trays facing up; training certificates missing
summary: Pass. Single-use trays at the serving line were stored facing up and must be inverted. No food handler certificates were on site for food employees who are not certified managers.

headline: Stained cutting boards; food in grocery bags
summary: Pass. Cutting boards with open seams and stains were next to a cold-hold unit. Food stored in grocery bags in the walk-in freezer must move to food-grade containers. Stained ceiling tiles and a damaged wall needed repair.

headline: Debris and unlabeled containers in several areas
summary: Pass on re-inspection. Scoops and bowls were stored inside bulk food containers. Containers were unlabeled. Debris was on lower shelves and in the walk-in cooler. The last toilet room garbage can lacked a lid.

headline: Black buildup dripping onto ice; cutting boards
summary: Fail. A black and brown substance built up in the rear ice machine and dripped onto ice, a priority violation with citation. Meat department cutting boards were deeply stained, and a wiping cloth was on a cutting board. Wall holes and broken baseboard tiles were in the meat area.

headline: Two self-serve coffee machines not working
summary: Pass. Two self-serve coffee machines at the rear of the kiosk were not working. The operator was told to repair them or remove them from the premises.

headline: Items stored on basement floor
summary: Pass. Lids and containers were stored on the basement floor. The person in charge must keep all items at least six inches off the floor.

headline: Restroom door not self-closing; ceiling damage
summary: Pass. The self-closing device on the rear employee restroom door was not connected. Damaged ceiling tiles were in the unused prep area, and water-damaged tiles were in the restroom.

headline: Torn rear screen door; no handwashing sign
summary: Pass. The torn rear screen door and open areas around it must be repaired to be rodent and insect proof. A handwashing sign was missing in the dish area. The three-compartment sink needs a faucet reaching all compartments, and a front handsink leaked. No allergen training was on site.

headline: About 40 mouse droppings; further pest control needed
summary: Fail. About 40 mouse droppings were on the floor by the front prep cooler, the prep table, and near the water heater, a priority citation. Additional pest control service is needed. Bulk seasonings lacked labels, and no allergen training proof was shown.

headline: Dusty fan guards; missing food handler certificates
summary: Pass. Dust covered the fan guards in the walk-in cooler. Food handler certificates could not be located or verified during inspection. Certified managers had no allergen training on site.

headline: Damaged front door seal; open wall gaps
summary: Pass. The front revolving door has damaged weather stripping with openings at the bottom, and must be pest-proofed. Basement openings around pipes and into the ceiling above an electrical box must be sealed.

headline: No employee health policy or vomit cleanup plan
summary: Pass with conditions. No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure was on site. The hand sink had no handwashing sign. Backflow devices were missing at the mop sink, and bare walls needed sealing. A sanitation manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Bowls and plates stored facing up
summary: Pass. Bowls and plates were stored facing up on a prep-area shelf. The person in charge was instructed to invert all equipment.

headline: Gaps in doors and sink, plus upkeep repairs
summary: Pass on re-inspection. Front doors have gaps that must be sealed, and a splash guard is needed between sinks. Stored items must be raised off floors. Also noted: peeling freezer plastic, rust, a low sprayer arm, and water-damaged ceiling tiles.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: Pass. A food service sanitation manager was observed without an allergen training certificate. The operator was instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: Rodent droppings and live roaches; food too warm
summary: Fail. About 30 rodent droppings were found in banquet dish storage, and about 6 live roaches in the employee kitchen, a priority citation. Ground beef at 52F and shredded beef without date marks were discarded. The high-temperature dish machine rinsed at 130.3F and was tagged.

headline: Water-stained ceiling tiles near window
summary: Pass. Two ceiling tiles near a window had water damage. The person in charge must replace them and maintain all ceiling tiles in prep and serving areas.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; leaking handsink
summary: Pass. A cooler gasket near the hearth area was heavily torn and loose. A hand sink drain leaked near the dish machine. The rear employee bathroom had no covered trash can, and floors below the fryer had heavy grease buildup.

headline: No certified food manager during TCS food service
summary: Pass with conditions. No City-certified food manager was on the premises while TCS foods such as tuna, roast beef, and sliced tomatoes were prepared and served. The person in charge was instructed to keep one on site at all times.

headline: Dirty ice bin; unlabeled containers
summary: Pass on re-inspection. The ice bin interior and exterior needed cleaning. Food containers lacked common-name labels. Cardboard was a liner in the walk-in cooler. Grease and dirt were on prep-area floors, and no food handler training proof was shown.

headline: No certified manager during pizza prep
summary: Fail on complaint inspection. No certified manager was on site while pizza, salad, and sandwiches were prepared, a priority citation. Repeat violations included a cooler lid in poor repair and a backflow device missing its cap. Multiple plumbing leaks and a loose drain stopper were noted.

headline: Sewage backup at toilets; no valid certificate
summary: Fail on complaint inspection. Toilets and floor drains backed up with wastewater, reaching the cook line. A plumber cleared the drains. The person in charge had no valid sanitation certificate, and no food handler training proof was available. Repeat cleaning violations were also found.

headline: Uncovered deep fryers; forks not inverted
summary: Pass on re-inspection. Deep fryers with grease were not covered when not in use. Forks and spoons were not inverted in the dishwashing area. The women's toilet room trash receptacles lacked lids, and cardboard was under prep tables.

headline: Grab-and-go desserts lack required labels
summary: Pass on re-inspection. Packaged desserts in the grab-and-go cooler lacked labels for ingredients, net weight, allergens, and business name and address. Foil was used as a liner on prep surfaces, and must be removed.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; restroom door
summary: Pass. Handwashing signs were missing at prep and restroom handsinks. The restroom door was not self-closing. Both items must be provided.

headline: Excess debris on floors; liquid on prep floor
summary: Pass. Unlabeled containers held peanuts, coconut, and sugar. Food sat on the walk-in freezer floor. Cooking equipment and coolers had dirt and debris. A minor leak was at the 3-compartment sink, and the prep floor had excess debris and liquid.

headline: No thermometers in coolers; food on floor
summary: Pass. Reach-in and display coolers lacked ambient air thermometers. Food containers were stored on the walk-in freezer floor and must be elevated six inches.

headline: Grease and debris on griddle hood filters
summary: Pass on re-inspection. Filters above the griddle had grease and debris buildup. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Cloths and utensils improperly stored
summary: Pass on re-inspection. A plastic cup was used as a flour scoop. Food sat on the walk-in cooler floor. Wiping cloths were stored outside sanitizer. Utensils sat in standing water and were not inverted on the top shelf.

headline: Rusty shelves; large ceiling hole in storage
summary: Pass. Serving plates were not inverted in the prep area. Walk-in cooler shelves were rusty and dirty. Dry storage had a large ceiling hole and cracked floor tiles that must be repaired.

headline: Pots too large for sinks; cardboard shelving
summary: Pass. Pots were too large for the dish sink and the 3-compartment sink. Cardboard and foil were used as shelving and liners. Walk-in cooler fans were dusty, and there was no grease trap for the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Food held too warm; about 47 lbs discarded
summary: Fail. Cold TCS foods, including pasta, beef, and lasagna, were held at 52-58F and discarded, about 47 lbs. A reach-in cooler was at 52.0F and was 36.5F after repair. No employee health policy was signed, and handsinks lacked hand-drying devices.

headline: Missing handwash signs and handler training proof
summary: Pass with conditions. Employee restrooms lacked handwashing signs. No proof of food handler training was available for any handler. The most recent inspection summary was not posted, a priority violation with citation.

headline: No certified food manager during food prep
summary: Fail. No City-certified food manager present while TCS foods (perishable foods that must stay hot or cold) were prepared and served. No written employee health policy, no sanitizer test strips, and no temperature indicator for the dish machine. Prior allergen training violation not corrected.

headline: Unlabeled containers, food on floor, no training proof
summary: Pass. Seasoning and bulk containers lacked labels. Food was stored on the walk-in freezer floor and uncovered in prep areas. Wet wiping cloths and utensils were improperly stored. No food handler training or certified manager allergen training proof was shown.

headline: Hood filters need grease cleaning
summary: Pass. The hood vent and filters needed cleaning to remove grease buildup. The operator was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Mouse droppings, live flies; food too warm
summary: Fail. About 100 or more mouse droppings were found in many areas, and 5-7 live flies at a handsink, a priority citation. Food held too warm, including eggs and raw chicken, was discarded, about 116 lbs. Poor handwashing by several handlers was noted.

headline: Food not elevated; repeat violations, debris
summary: Fail. Stored items were not raised off floors, and plastic soda crates were used for elevation. Cardboard and plastic liners were on shelves. Repeat violations included tongs stored above a sprinkler and food debris under the mixer and pizza ovens. A citation was issued.

headline: Small pipe leak; trash can lacks cover
summary: Pass. A small leak was found at a basement pipe. The toilet room trash receptacle was missing its cover. Both must be repaired or provided.

headline: Rust dripping into ice; no food handler training
summary: Fail. Rust was dripping from the ice machine into ice for human consumption. Ice must be discarded and the unit cleaned. Other violations included missing food handler certificates, no temperature indicator on the dish machine, and no allergen training for managers.

headline: Discarded about 200 lbs of moldy meat
summary: Fail. Moldy lids were on meat containers in the walk-in cooler, and about 200 lbs were discarded. A smoothie prep cooler at 56.7F must not be used until reinspected. A food handler did not wash hands before handling food. Vomit cleanup supplies were missing.

headline: Cracked floor tile in front prep area
summary: Pass. Floor tile in the front prep area was cracked and must be repaired to be smooth and cleanable.

headline: Unlabeled packaged food; missing thermometer
summary: Pass. A cooler was missing an internal air thermometer. Bags of on-site packaged food were labeled 'MISC.' and taken off sale until labeled. Muffins lacked the manufacturer label. Knives were stored between a wall and cutting board.

headline: Rat droppings found; missing sanitation certificate
summary: Fail on complaint inspection. About 20 rat droppings were under basement stairs, a priority citation. The person in charge lacked a sanitation manager certificate, which was not posted. Backflow devices were missing at the ice and espresso machines, and clutter was in the basement.

headline: Chicken thawed in standing water
summary: Pass on re-inspection. Frozen chicken was thawed overnight in standing water in the three-compartment sinks. Ice buildup was in the walk-in freezer, and frozen fries had spilled at the bottom of a freezer unit. Cardboard was on the floor in front of the sink.

headline: Peeling paint and wall opening in washroom
summary: Pass. Chipped and peeling paint was on the wall of the front washroom and must be removed. An opening in the wall under the exposed handsink must be sealed.

headline: Reduced-oxygen packaging without variance
summary: Fail. Reduced-oxygen packaged ground pork and steaks were on site without a City variance. About 10 lbs were discarded, and the practice must stop. Shellstock tags lacked sale dates, and the back door had a gap at the bottom.

headline: No thermometer in cooler; dirty wiping cloth
summary: Pass. The two-door reach-in cooler on the cook line had no thermometer. A dirty wiping cloth was on the cook line, and all cloths must be stored in sanitizer when not in use.

headline: Mouse droppings, dead mouse, repeat violation
summary: Fail on re-inspection. About 150 or more mouse droppings were found in many areas, plus a dead mouse. This repeats a prior priority violation, a citation was issued, and a pest control operator is required. Doors were not tight-fitting to prevent rodent entry.

headline: Food handler lacked training certificate
summary: Pass. One food handler was observed without a food handler training certificate. Management was instructed that all food handlers must show proof of training.

headline: Rust on storage racks in walk-in cooler
summary: Pass on re-inspection. Wire storage racks in the walk-in cooler had rust. The operator was told to remove the chipped paint and rust, then repaint or replace the shelves.

headline: No handsink at service line; freezer accessible
summary: Fail on re-inspection. No handsink was located at the front service line where cheese and softserve are dispensed. The operator was instructed to install one. A walk-in freezer was accessible from the parking lot and must be locked.

headline: Smoke and dust buildup; allergen training missing
summary: Pass on re-inspection. Ice had built up in the rear reach-in freezer. Food spills and debris were on equipment and shelves. Smoke and dust covered walls and ceilings, and debris was on floors. No certified manager had allergen training on site.

headline: No food thermometer; no hot water at toilet room sink
summary: Fail. No food temperature thermometer was on site, a priority violation. The toilet room handsink had no hot water, a priority violation. A food prep cart was left outside. There was no pest control logbook or proof of service, and no licensed garbage service.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food; cold unit at 50F
summary: Pass with conditions. A food handler touched sliced cheese and lunchmeat with bare hands, a priority citation. The deli cold-hold unit was at 50F and must not be used until reinspected. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, and clutter was in storage.

headline: Repeat handwashing failures; sanitizer at 0 ppm
summary: Pass with conditions. Several food handlers handled ready-to-eat food without washing hands, a priority citation. Hand-drying devices were missing in two prep areas. Sanitizer at the 3-compartment sink measured 0.0 ppm. Shellfish tags lacked a last-sold date.

headline: Cooler too warm; food discarded; no health policy
summary: Fail. No verifiable employee health policy was on site, a priority citation. A two-door cooler held turkey and hot dogs at 51.8-55.7F, and about 10 lbs was discarded. The cooler was at 56.4F and was tagged. No metal stem thermometer or food handler training was shown.

headline: No thermometers in cold-holding units
summary: Pass. Cold-holding equipment had no thermometers. A drive-thru window in the rear was missing glass. Grime and residue were found on walk-in cooler shelving, and rust on its floor. No allergen training certificate was on site for the certified manager.

headline: Revolving door gaps; wastewater disposal problem
summary: Pass on complaint re-inspection. The revolving entrance door had a one-inch gap in multiple areas and must be rodent-proofed. Wastewater was not disposed of properly under high pressure at the one-compartment sink. Basement prep floor tiles were cracked.

headline: No valid manager; fish thawed in standing water
summary: Pass with conditions. No person in charge with a valid certificate was on site, and no certified manager was present while TCS foods were prepared, a priority citation. Fish, beef, and turkey were thawed in standing water. Single-service articles were stored on the floor.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; missing food handler certificates
summary: Pass on re-inspection. A cooler door gasket was torn. Soiled mop heads were not hung up, and debris was on floors. No food handler certificates or allergen training were on site.

headline: Rust and grease buildup on equipment
summary: Pass. Rust, dried food debris, and grime were on nonfood-contact surfaces, including cold-holding equipment and ice bins. Encrusted grease was on the grill and griddle. A manager lacked allergen awareness training.

headline: Low hot water pressure; repeat violations noted
summary: Fail. Hot water pressure was low at handsinks and the 3-compartment sink, a priority violation with citation. Bulk containers were unlabeled, and an employee lacked a hair restraint. Repeat violations included a water leak, a missing splashguard, and a torn cooler gasket.

headline: Grease on hood filters; certificate lacks allergen training
summary: Pass on complaint re-inspection. Grease built up on hood filters. Stained ceiling tiles were in the dining area and women's washroom. A slow-draining kitchen handsink needs repair. A certified manager lacked allergen training, and unused equipment was stored in the rear.

headline: Employees eating at prep area; unlabeled bulk food
summary: Pass. Employees were drinking and preparing food at the prep area. Bulk items were not labeled. To-go containers were used as scoops. Torn gaskets, food in grocery bags, and no allergen training for certified managers were also noted.

headline: Missing health policies; crates and gaskets
summary: No signed employee health policies were on site. Worn gaskets, crates used for storage, and grease in coolers need repair or cleaning. A wall base is missing, and a drain line from the display cooler must go to an open floor drain.

headline: Manager lacked certification during food service
summary: A manager on site lacked a valid city food service manager certification while pastries, sandwiches, and milk were prepared and served. Debris is on floors in rear storage, dust on cooking equipment, and spilled soda bottles. Citation issued.

headline: Storage room holes; washroom doors not self-closing
summary: Holes were found in the floor and wall of the storage room near the water heater. Cracked floor tile and washroom doors lacking self-closing devices were noted. Dust is on washroom vent fans.

headline: Food debris fills floor drains
summary: Floor drains in the dishwashing and prep areas are filled with food debris. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: No certified manager; no paper towels or test kit
summary: No person with an original sanitation certificate was on site. The restroom sink lacked paper towels, and no chemical test kit was on site. The summary report has not been posted publicly since 2022. Citations were issued.

headline: Hair restraints missing; grease buildup
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints, and soiled wiping cloths were on the three-compartment sink. Grease covers fryers and grill. A covered washroom receptacle is missing, and the vent hood has grease and dust buildup.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving
summary: Milk crates are used as shelving in a small storage area behind the three-compartment sink. They must be removed and replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor.

headline: House flies, fruit flies, and mouse droppings found
summary: Five or more house flies were in the kitchen and dish area, and 20 or more fruit flies were near the rear exit. About 40–50 mouse droppings were behind the deep freezer and along the dish area wall. Pest control is needed. No hot or cold water at the dish-area hand sink.

headline: Dead roaches; no thermometers; sink leaks
summary: Dead roaches were found on floors, walls, and sink basins in rear areas; they must be removed and the area cleaned. No thermometers are in refrigeration units. Leaks cause standing water in the rear dish area. Prior core violation not corrected.

headline: Rodent droppings; no certified manager; cited
summary: About 150 mouse droppings and 100 rat droppings were found, plus 20–30 large flies. No certified manager was present while food was handled. Unknown-source food was discarded. Hand sink water was 63°F, later raised to 102–105°F.

headline: Sewage backing up in men's restroom
summary: Waste water and sewage were backing up in the men's washroom urinal and into a mop sink in the adjacent room. The manager must remove all waste water. The leaking mop sink pipe must be repaired.

headline: No employee health policy or training
summary: No employee health policy or training records were found on site. The facility must set up a policy and training system and keep verifiable documents on site.

headline: No certified manager on site; cold and hot food unsafe
summary: No certified food manager was on site while food was handled. Hot-held cheese sauce and dip read 103.6–106.5°F, and cold cheese sauce read 64.9°F; about 7 lbs were discarded. No written employee health policy or food handler proof.

headline: Labeling, crate shelving, and food handler training gaps
summary: Food storage containers and packaged sandwiches need labels. Crates must be replaced with shelving. Food debris on the stove and freezer, a cracked ceiling, and missing food handler training for all employees were noted.

headline: Grout, ceiling debris, and two hood lights out
summary: Low grout is along the cook line. Food debris is on ceiling light covers above the prep area. Two ventilation hood light bulbs are not working and must be replaced.

headline: No vomit procedure; interiors of coolers dirty
summary: No written procedure or adequate supplies for vomit and diarrhea events were on site. Reach-in cooler interiors need detail cleaning. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks, and floors and walls throughout need detail cleaning.

headline: Ice bin and walk-in cooler need cleaning
summary: The ice bin interior needs cleaning. Food-encrusted storage racks are in the rear storage and walk-in cooler, and the walk-in cooler interior needs detail cleaning.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; flies found
summary: The bar's low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer and was tagged. About 15 small flies were near the dish machine and sinks. The three-compartment sink leaks at all basins, and cutting boards are stained.

headline: No certified manager; hot rice held too cool
summary: No valid city food sanitation certificate was on the premises or on site. About 10 lbs of cooked rice held at 119.4–121.4°F in a dining room hot-holding unit were discarded. Rocks used to weight kimchi lids must be removed.

headline: Flies near dish area; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: About 30 small flies were seen near the dish machine and restrooms; more pest control advised. A low-temperature dish machine showed 0 parts per million (ppm) sanitizer and was serviced during inspection. Paper towels were missing at a hand sink, then supplied.

headline: Shellstock tags undated; cold food over temperature
summary: Shellstock tags still lack dates for when the last shellstock was sold or served. Cold foods at 56.8–60.6°F were discarded, but were stored in a previously tagged cooler still in use. Another cold unit read 48.2°F and is still in use.

headline: No certified manager; food handler proof missing
summary: The person in charge lacked a valid sanitation certificate, and none was posted during TCS food service. No food handler training proof was found. Bulk containers are unlabeled. Walls, floors, and tiles need cleaning and repair; prior violations remain.

headline: Shattered glass on pastry display cabinet
summary: A shattered glass panel at the front of the pastry display cabinet must be replaced.

headline: Unlabeled containers; repeat core violations uncorrected
summary: Storage containers lacked labels, food handlers lacked hair restraints, and scoops were stored inside containers. Raw wood and unfinished drywall in the prep area were not corrected from a prior report. This is a repeat core violation.

headline: Flying insects behind bar; dish machine lacks temperature gauge
summary: About 20 live small flying insects were seen behind the bar, resting on soda nozzles and liquor bottles. More pest control is needed. Also: no temperature indicator for the dish machine, and a certified food manager (CFM) lacked allergen training.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen training records
summary: No food handler training certificates for new and volunteer staff, and no allergen training certificates for certified managers. Also noted: slow-draining sink, debris on floors, rusty can opener, and bricks used under equipment.

headline: No hot water at hand sinks
summary: The front prep area and both restroom handwash sinks had no hot water; water read 66°F. The manager must provide hot water at 100–120°F at all hand sinks. Priority violation.

headline: No certified manager; bulk containers unlabeled
summary: The person in charge lacked a food manager certificate, and no certified manager was on premises while TCS food was handled. No allergen training. Bulk containers are unlabeled, and a women's washroom receptacle was not provided from a prior inspection.

headline: Black substance in ice machine; sink leak
summary: A black substance was on the interior panel of the ice machine and must be cleaned. The three-compartment sink has a hot water leak. Floors under cooking equipment have dirt, food, and grease buildup.

headline: No paper towels; hair restraint missing
summary: No hand-drying supplies at the rear dish-area handwash sink. Paper towels were provided during inspection and a citation was issued. A milk cooler lacks a thermometer, an employee had no hair restraint, and no summary report was posted.

headline: Missing prep sink; leaking dish-area handwash sink
summary: Small first-floor bar has no prep/dump sink, which is required in any food preparation area. Water leaks from the handwashing sink drainpipe in the dishwashing area and must be repaired. Re-inspection.

headline: Hair restraints and utensil storage needed
summary: Food handlers need hair restraints. Bulk containers need labels, and silverware and plastic ware must be stored upright. A crate is used in the walk-in freezer, and an active leak was found behind the beverage machine.

headline: Mouse droppings; cooler too warm; food discarded
summary: Cook-line cooler read 60.8°F, and chicken, salmon, and other foods were found at 51.2–55.7°F and discarded; the cooler was tagged. About 90–110 mouse droppings were found in pastry, server, and basement areas. Pest control was recommended.

headline: About 120 live flies in prep and dish areas
summary: About 120 live small flies were counted: 20 at a front prep hand sink, 60 in the dish area, 40 near the rear walk-in cooler, and 20 at the middle three-compartment sink. Pest control was recommended. Citation issued.

headline: Women's restroom lids missing; basement clutter
summary: Two stall receptacles in the women's restroom lacked lids. The basement was heavily cluttered. Manager was instructed to provide lids and remove unnecessary items.

headline: Rear door gaps; leaking three-compartment sink
summary: The rear exit door has 1/4-inch gaps at the bottom and must be repaired to block pests. The three-compartment sink faucet and pipe leak. Floors and walls in the storage and prep areas need cleaning.

headline: Food on floor; rusted racks; no splash guard
summary: Boxed food was stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and freezer. No splash guard is between the hand sink and the three-compartment sink. Racks in the walk-in cooler are rusted. Damaged ceiling panels and dirty floors are in the rear prep area.

headline: Over 100 live flies; sink not maintained
summary: Over 100 live small flies were in the rear storage room, and over 3 live house flies in the front area. The three-compartment sink must be repaired for manual washing and sanitizing. Citations were issued.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; food thawed improperly
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were found in the rear storage and prep areas. The manager was told to call an exterminator and clean all areas. Ribs were thawed in a sink and on a cart. Hair restraints were missing, and food was stored on the floor.

headline: Hot food too cool; cold food discarded
summary: Samosas, egg puffs, and other hot-held foods read 110–120.6°F; hot food must be at 135°F or above. These and pulled chicken and coleslaw were discarded. Ice chute has mineral buildup, and some gaskets are broken.

headline: Re-inspection: peeling paint, missing ventilation, sink gaps
summary: Peeling paint in the walk-in cooler and prep ceilings must be removed. Missing prep sink, backflow device, and ventilation were noted, plus a non-working hood. Allergen training certificates were not on site.

headline: Cold food held too warm; 80 lbs discarded
summary: Many cold foods, including eggs, ham, beef, and salsa, were held at 46–99.7°F; about 80 lbs were discarded. Two coolers ran at 56°F and were tagged. No written vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure was on site.

headline: Dirty chicken cooler; mildew on milk racks
summary: The chicken walk-in cooler is entirely unclean and must be cleaned and sanitized. Floors and drains in chicken and sushi prep need cleaning. Milk racks and shelves have a black mold or mildew-like substance that must be removed.

headline: Leaking condenser onto raw meat; food discarded
summary: Two prep hand sinks lacked paper towels; towels were provided on request. Water leaked from a clogged condenser onto raw beef, fish, and chicken in the butcher cooler. 89 lbs ($867 value) was discarded. Ice machine interior is dirty.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: No employees had been hired yet. New hires have 30 days from hire to obtain food handler training proof. The certified food manager had no allergen training certificate and was instructed to obtain one.

headline: No food handler or allergen training proof
summary: No proof of food handler training was provided for any employee, and no allergen training proof for the employee with a sanitation certificate. The menu lacks a consumer advisory for undercooked animal foods. Ice bin needs a lid.

headline: Slow-draining compartment sink in prep area
summary: One compartment sink in the prep area drains slowly. The manager was instructed to repair it and keep it in good repair.

headline: Food handler certificates needed; leaks
summary: All food handlers need certificates. An air conditioner drain line must be tied into the main drain. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks, and wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizer. The unisex washroom waste receptacle needs a cover.

headline: Over 15 small flies throughout facility
summary: More than 15 small flies were found throughout the facility, including the prep area and kitchen. The manager was instructed to minimize fly activity. A citation was issued.

headline: Fly paper in restroom; foil on wall
summary: Fly paper was found in the restroom. The person in charge must discard it and request licensed pest control to install an approved enclosed device. Buildup is on the ice machine door, and foil on the wall by the hot-hold corn station must be replaced.

headline: Missing light shield above dish sink
summary: A light shield is missing above the three-compartment sink in the dish area. The manager was instructed to provide one.

headline: Dead insects in light shields; worn rear screen
summary: A worn rear door screen could let insects in. Dead insects were found in vestibule light shields. Crates are used for storage, and grease buildup was found on fryers, cooking equipment, and the hood. Stained ceiling tiles need replacing.

headline: Certified manager's allergen training expired
summary: One certified manager had expired allergen training. Staff with a manager certificate must complete allergen training and keep records on site.

headline: Rust on ice machines; missing backflow devices
summary: Rust was found on shields of two basement ice machines, which must be cleaned and sanitized. Openings at the base of both front doors need sealing. The high-temperature dish machine has no data plate, and espresso and coffee machines lack backflow devices.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; door not self-closing
summary: No handwashing sign was at the exposed rear prep handwashing sink. The customer restroom door is not self-closing. The person in charge was instructed to provide both.

headline: Live flying insects at hand sink and garbage
summary: About 35 live small flying insects were on exposed handwashing and garbage containers in the front bar. The outside grease container is not maintained and has garbage on top. Women's washroom ventilation is not working. Prior core violations not corrected.

headline: Floors along walls and under equipment need cleaning
summary: Floors along wall bases and under equipment, especially at the bar, must be cleaned and kept clean. Otherwise no violations were listed.

headline: Food and single-use items stored under hand sink
summary: Condiments and single-service articles were stored in the cabinet under the front handwashing sink, where leaks could contaminate them. They must be removed. Certified manager on duty lacked allergen training.

headline: No certified manager during food service; dirty wipe used
summary: The person in charge lacked a sanitation certificate. No certified manager was on site for about 15–20 minutes while food was served. A food handler wiped a knife with a dirty cloth; the knife was removed. The summary report was not visible.

headline: Dusty vent covers in prep area
summary: Dust has built up on ceiling vent covers in the food prep area and the walk-in cooler. The manager was instructed to clean the fan covers.

headline: Re-inspection: debris in ice machine; torn gasket
summary: Slight debris is encrusted inside the ice machine and must be detail cleaned. Chipped paint and rust are on wire racks in the prep cooler, and a torn door gasket needs replacing. Grease is in the fryer, and a light shield is missing.

headline: Loose gasket; greasy cooking equipment
summary: The gasket on a two-door reach-in cooler is coming loose. Spillage stains are on the walk-in freezer floor, and grease and food are on the sides of cooking equipment. Debris is under rear storage shelving.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure; mop sink lacks backflow
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure was on the premises. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door sweep must be sealed to be rodent proof. The mop sink lacks a visible backflow prevention device.

headline: Food stored on floors; propane tanks inside
summary: Food items were stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and freezer. Pizza boxes were stored on the basement floor. Propane tanks in the basement must be removed. Handwashing signs are missing.

headline: Outdoor coolers unlocked; food exposed to public
summary: A two-door cooler with beef and a one-door cooler with TCS food sat outside on the patio, unlocked, risking contamination from the public. Locks are required. A citation was issued. Fryer filter unit and floor tile also need repair.

headline: No vomit kit; no handwashing sink at rear bar
summary: No procedure or kit for vomit and diarrhea events was on site. The rear service bar has no handwashing sink and no dump sink. No chemical sanitizer test devices or food handler certificates were on site. No garbage contract was on file.

headline: Soiled aprons; food debris in coolers
summary: Employees wore soiled aprons, and food debris was found inside and outside coolers, freezers, and prep tables. A mop head stored on the floor must be hung to dry to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Mesh gaps let flies in; no test strips
summary: Kitchen window mesh has large gaps, which let flies in; tight-fitting mesh is required on both cook-line windows. No chemical test strips were on site for wiping cloth buckets, and a citation was issued. Milk crates are used for elevation.

headline: Dish machine lacks sanitizer; insect carcasses
summary: The low-temperature dish machine had no sanitizer hooked up and was tagged. Several insect carcasses were found in wine storage, and they must be removed. The three-compartment sink floods when drained; a citation was issued.

headline: Front door gap; greasy hood; broken light covers
summary: The front entry door has about a half-inch gap at the bottom; a protective strip was instructed. The basement walk-in cooling unit needs detail cleaning. Grease is built up at the hood, and two hot-line light covers need replacing.

headline: Cooler at 47.8°F; repaired during inspection
summary: Two-door reach-in cooler by pastry prep held food at 47.8°F, above 41°F. It was tagged and held. A technician repaired it, and it read 37.1°F before the inspection ended. Other upkeep issues noted.

headline: Calcium buildup inside ice machine
summary: Light calcium buildup was found inside the ice machine. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; greasy walls near sink
summary: Walk-in cooler door has a torn interior gasket (door seal) that must be repaired. Grease and grime on walls near the three-compartment sink must be cleaned. General upkeep issues only.

headline: Stained cutting boards; leak under sink
summary: Kitchen cutting boards have deep stains and cuts and must be resurfaced or replaced. A leak was found under the sanitizing sink of the three-compartment sink and must be repaired.

headline: No vomit procedure; missing thermometers
summary: No procedure or supplies for vomit and diarrhea events, and no thermometers inside coolers. No handwashing signage in the washroom. Washroom door is not self-closing, and the unisex washroom has no covered waste receptacle.

headline: Walk-in cooler at 44°F; milk too warm
summary: Milk and the walk-in cooler air both read 44°F, above the 41°F limit. The manager must repair the cooler. Debris is on fountain soda tubing, and the floor and wall behind soda boxes need cleaning.

headline: No hair restraints; food debris in cooler
summary: Food employees were prepping without hair restraints. Food debris was found at the bottom of the sandwich reach-in cooler. The unisex employee washroom lacks a covered waste receptacle.

headline: Black buildup on floors and wall bases
summary: Black buildup on floors and wall bases under bars and cooking equipment must be cleaned. Stained ceiling tiles above the basement utility sink must be replaced. Re-inspection.

headline: Buildup inside ice machine; no training proof
summary: Brown, black, and pink buildup was found inside the rear ice machine. That ice is used for human consumption; it must be removed and cleaned. No food handler training proof, allergen training proof, or covered washroom receptacle.

headline: Cold foods above 41°F; 70 lbs discarded
summary: Shrimp, chicken, eggs, pork and other cold foods in service coolers read above 41°F, some as high as 75.2°F. The manager voluntarily discarded 70 lbs. Prep-area coolers at 55.4°F and 66.4°F were not to be used until fixed.

headline: Dish machine lost power; spoiled salad discarded
summary: The high-temperature dish machine had no power and was tagged, not in use. A cold salad at 59.2°F was discarded. Eye wash attachment removed from a hand sink during inspection. Sanitation manager lacked allergen training.

headline: No food handler certificates on premises
summary: No food handler training certificates were on the premises. The manager must provide certificates showing employee names.

headline: Slime in ice machine; ice discarded
summary: Black dirt and slime were found inside the ice machine, dripping into ice used for consumption. All ice was voluntarily discarded. The bar handwashing sink drains slowly, and dust is on the wall behind a sink.

headline: Dish machine below required temperature
summary: The high-temperature dish machine's surface read 154°F, below the required 160°F; the final rinse read 178°F. The machine must be repaired. Several food handlers had expired certificates, and no inspection summary was posted.

headline: No health policy; hot water below required temperature
summary: No employee health policy, and no vomit cleanup procedure or kit was on site. Rear prep handwashing sinks had water at 84.4°F; hot water was adjusted but still does not meet requirements. A brick wall and open gaps near the stove need sealing.

headline: Food on floor; three-compartment sink overflowing
summary: Food was stored on the floor in the front prep area. The basement three-compartment sink overflows through the grease trap onto the floor; a citation was issued. Utility sinks lack backflow devices.

headline: Large gaps under dumpster-side door
summary: The rear door to the dumpster area has large gaps at the bottom corners. The manager was instructed to provide a tight-fitting seal on all outer openings to keep pests out.

headline: Rear door gap; broken toilet handle and seat
summary: The rear exterior door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom. A freezer gasket is loose, and the staff toilet handle and seat are damaged. A water-damaged ceiling tile is in the customer restroom.

headline: No health policy; uncorrected core violations
summary: No completed employee health policy or training was on site. Equipment and cutting boards were stored on the floor, and food handler certificates were missing for all employees. No covered trash in the family bathroom. Prior core violations remain.

headline: No employee health policy; hand sink blocked
summary: No signed employee health policy was on site. A hand sink in the front prep area was blocked by a sanitizer bucket, which the inspector moved. No outside dumpster and no food handler training were found.

headline: Two cold-holding units too warm; tagged
summary: Walk-in cooler R42 and the main line cooler held TCS foods at 60.4–71.2°F. The manager discarded out-of-temperature food before inspection and tagged both units. Loose cooler handles and a basement zapper must be relocated away from clean equipment.

headline: Two unused refrigerators at west bar
summary: Two unused refrigerators were found at the west side bar. The manager was instructed to either use them or remove them from the premises.

headline: Torn gasket on cook-line cooler
summary: A two-door cooler on the cook line has a torn gasket. The manager was instructed to repair or replace it and keep it in good condition.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat bacon
summary: A food handler touched ready-to-eat cooked bacon and sausage with bare hands, which is not allowed. Two containers of raw meat were thawed on a prep table. Soiled wiping cloths were left on prep tables, and milk crates were used as shelving.

headline: Cold foods too warm; coolers tagged
summary: Rice, red salsa, eggs, and beans were held too warm in upright coolers; about 30 lbs were discarded. Both front prep coolers read 55.6°F and 59.0°F, and were tagged. A condenser leak and a missing ice machine lid were noted.

headline: Gap under back door; sink lacks splash guard
summary: A gap under the back exit door needs weather stripping to prevent pests. A handwashing sink in the rear food area lacks a splash guard. Food was stored in grocery bags. Floor tile and wall splatter need repair.

headline: No paper towels at hand sinks; greasy equipment
summary: Prep and dish-area hand sinks lacked paper towels; a citation was issued. Food and grease buildup is under cooking equipment, holding units, and prep tables. Damaged floor tiles, baseboards, and stained ceiling tiles were noted.

headline: Floors, walls, and vents need detail cleaning
summary: The two-door cooler handles in the dish area are in poor repair. Refrigeration interiors, cooking equipment exteriors, and prep tables need cleaning. Floors under equipment, the washroom vent, and clutter in the storage room need attention.

headline: No certified manager on arrival; sink blocked
summary: No current certified food manager was on site at arrival. The manager's certificate expired 5-14-2026. The rear handwashing sink was blocked by an out-of-order sign and drains poorly. Dish area floors are soiled.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods served
summary: No certified food manager was on site while deli meats, chicken salad, and soup were prepared and served. A citation was issued. Missing sink stoppers, a missing ceiling tile, and a dusty vent also need attention.

headline: Faucet reach and basement floors need cleaning
summary: A faucet must be installed so it reaches across all three compartments of the warewashing sink. The basement floor under and around equipment along the walls needs detail cleaning.

headline: Standing water near CO2 tank; allergen training
summary: Floors around the CO2 tank and rear mop sink need cleaning to remove standing water and debris, which could attract pests. The certified manager on duty lacked allergen training; citations will follow if not provided.

headline: Grease under fryers and rust in basement
summary: Accumulated grease and dirt are on the floor under the rear prep deep fryers and stove. Dirt is along walls and in corners of the basement prep area. Basement storage racks have rust and must be cleaned and made smooth.

headline: Missing cook-line handwashing sink; mold caulk
summary: A handwashing sink with hot and cold water is needed on the cook line; a citation was issued. A soap dispenser must be moved away from a prep sink. Moldy caulk, food debris, and excess grease also need attention.

headline: Ice machine debris and leaking sink drain
summary: Debris was found encrusted inside the ice machine and must be removed. A water leak under the three-compartment sink must be repaired. The front prep handwashing sink needs signage, and a ceiling vent in the restroom needs dust removed.

headline: No employee health policy; torn pizza cooler gasket
summary: No employee health policy was on site. Employees must sign an acknowledgement. The pizza cooler has a torn inside gasket that must be repaired. A priority foundation violation was cited.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; leaking sink drain
summary: Bulk kitchen containers and packaged ice cream on display lacked proper labels. The three-compartment sink lacks stoppers and is leaking. Pop crates are used as shelving. Dust covers display shelves, and ceiling tiles and floors are damaged.

headline: Certified managers need allergen certificates
summary: All City of Chicago certified food managers must obtain allergen training and keep the certificate on site for review. This re-inspection passed.

headline: Cold foods above 41F; about 5 lbs discarded
summary: Baba ganoush, cut vegetables, and cooked beans were held at 50.1–51.1F in the front cold unit. The manager discarded about 5 pounds worth $40. A single-door cooler lacks a thermometer, and utensils were exposed.

headline: Cleaning needed at hand sinks and freezer
summary: Counter tops at the hand sinks and interior shelving of the rear cake freezer need cleaning. Floors under the front prep hand sink and throughout floor drains also need cleaning.

headline: Basement sink drains poorly, floods when used
summary: The three-compartment sink in the basement does not drain properly. When one compartment drains, another floods. The manager was told to service the sink. Priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Cold food held too warm; 15 lbs discarded
summary: Rice and other foods that must be kept cold were held at 49.2–55.9F, above the 41F limit. The manager discarded 15 lbs at about $50. A citation was issued. Food handler certificates were not on site, and food was stored on the walk-in floor.

headline: Hot and cold food unsafe; flying insects found
summary: Chicken sandwiches and nuggets were held at 110–114F, below the 135F minimum. Ceviche and Caesar salad were held at 51–55F in the salad bar cooler. About 25 live small flying insects were found; a citation was issued.

headline: Sink sealant discolored; no food handler proof
summary: Silicone sealant in the rear three-compartment sink is layered at the seams and has black substance and discoloration; it must be repaired or replaced. No proof of food handler training was on site. No proof of allergen training for certified managers.

headline: Ice buildup on walk-in freezer floor
summary: Ice has built up on the floor inside the walk-in freezer. Management must remove it, clean the area, and keep it maintained.

headline: Exit doors have gaps; rodent-proofing needed
summary: Several outside exit doors have no door sweeps and a half-inch gap at the bottom and center. Management was instructed to rodent-proof all outer openings. This re-inspection passed.

headline: Food on floors; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler, prep area, and storage area. Milk crates are being used as shelving and must be replaced with shelving six inches off the floor. Unused equipment must be removed.

headline: Hand sinks blocked and used for rinsing
summary: Hand sinks at the prep and bar areas were obstructed, and a food handler was rinsing utensils and placing strainers in a hand sink. Hand sinks must be used only for handwashing. A priority foundation violation was noted.

headline: Expired food handler card; leaking faucet
summary: One food handler had an expired certificate and must obtain a current one. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks; the walk-in drain drains into a garbage can and must be routed to a floor drain.

headline: Rear exit door gap; walls, ceilings, floors damaged
summary: The rear exit door is not fully rodent-proof and must be sealed on the side gap. Repairs needed: a hole in the men's restroom wall, damaged and missing ceiling panels, a missing toilet tank lid, and damaged floor tiles behind the front bar.

headline: Hand sinks missing soap and paper towels
summary: The first floor kitchen hand sink was missing paper towels and soap; the person in charge supplied them during inspection. A citation was issued. Single-service items were stored on the floor; a sink drains slowly.

headline: New screen door has large gaps
summary: The newly installed mesh screen door at the rear exit must be rodent and insect proofed on all sides. Large open gaps were found on all sides and along the bottom threshold.

headline: No manager certificate; no sink soap or signage
summary: No City of Chicago food manager certificate was on site, and no citation was issued. Exposed hand sinks lacked soap and signs. The three-compartment sink had no stoppers. Allergen training certificates were missing, and an unused reach-in cooler must be removed.

headline: Over 200 rodent droppings; food held unsafely
summary: Over 200 mouse droppings were found in the prep, dishwashing, and storage areas, and pest control service is needed. About 10 lbs of cooked beef and chicken were discarded after holding at 60.6–109.7F. Sewage water backs up from the three-compartment sink.

headline: Unlabeled seasonings and stained cutting boards
summary: Dry seasonings on kitchen shelves and table tops were unlabeled. Cutting boards on prep coolers were deeply stained. Front and rear bar hand sinks lack signage. The women's restroom needs a covered trash receptacle, and attic items sit on the floor.

headline: Rear door propped open; greasy fryers
summary: The rear exit door was propped open with a stick; a screen door must be installed if it stays open. The fryers, grill, and area under the grill need cleaning. Walls, floors, and vents also need cleaning to remove dust.

headline: Soda nozzles and can opener need cleaning
summary: Soda machine nozzles and dispensers need detail cleaning. The large can opener needs detail cleaning. Floors in the back room need cleaning to remove dust and debris.

headline: Mops drying on floor; dirt near equipment
summary: Mops were drying on the rear prep floor and must be hung heads-up on the rack to prevent mold and small fly activity. Heavy dirt and dust accumulated along equipment in the front bar, and items beside rear equipment should be removed.

headline: No certified manager while chicken prepared
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS items such as chicken were prepared; a citation was issued. Torn gaskets on a bakery walk-in and a deli prep cooler need repair, and a basement walk-in has standing water.

headline: Dish machine too cool to sanitize; held
summary: The high-temperature dish machine reached only 145.1F, below the 160F minimum for sanitizing utensils. The machine was tagged and held for inspection; a citation was issued. Grease in the alley and standing water on the cook line also need attention.

headline: No splashguard; no hair restraints worn
summary: A washable splashguard is needed between the front exposed hand sink and the food prep counter. Food employees were prepping without hair restraints. Serving plates on shelves must be inverted to prevent dust.

headline: Display cooler too warm; 10 lbs of food discarded
summary: Pesto pasta bowls, yogurts, chicken wraps, and milk were held at 50–55F in the display cooler, above the 41F limit. About 10 pounds worth $200 was discarded. The cooler was tagged and must not be used until repaired.

headline: Hot water too cool; corrected on site
summary: A restroom hand sink measured 73.0F, below the 100F minimum; it was repaired on site and measured 108.5F afterward. The three-compartment sink measured 104.9F and must be 110F minimum. Some pantry hand sinks lack signage.

headline: Leaking pipe under three-compartment sink
summary: A pipe is leaking underneath the three-compartment sink. The manager was instructed to repair the pipe and keep it maintained.

headline: Utensils in food; leaking faucet; greasy floors
summary: Scoops and utensils had handles resting in food in prep coolers and dry bins. Items on the floor in the dry storage must be raised six inches. A leaking three-compartment sink faucet and low hot water pressure at a bar sink need repair. Floors under fryers are greasy.

headline: Repeat violation: missing light shield; expired training
