summary: A repeat violation for a missing light shield at the rear prep fixture was not corrected. A citation was issued. The certified manager's allergen training is expired, the summary was not posted, and the hood filters need degreasing.

headline: Uncovered trash cans; burned-out light bulb
summary: Trash cans in the unisex restrooms are uncovered and must be covered. A burned-out light bulb in the rear prep area must be replaced to increase lighting.

headline: Mouse droppings in storage; no pest log
summary: Mouse droppings were found on storage floors, under shelves, and on unused equipment in the rear storage area. A priority foundation violation was cited. No pest control logbook or contract was on site, and a three-door prep cooler held at 50F.

headline: Deli cold foods over 41F; 121 lbs discarded
summary: Many deli foods were held at 45–60F in the display unit, above the 41F limit. About 121 pounds worth $850 was discarded and a hold tag placed on the unit. Also no employee health policy, no probe thermometer, and no summary posted.

headline: No thermometer; dirty floor drain and vent
summary: No thermometer was in the front reach-in cooler; one must be provided for all cold-holding equipment. The employee toilet door must self-close and needs mechanical ventilation. The floor drain under the three-compartment sink is dirty, and corners need cleaning.

headline: No health policy, vomit kit, or food handler records
summary: No employee health policy, vomit cleanup kit, or food handler certificates were on site. A prep sink is missing. Handwashing signage is needed at an exposed sink. No citation was issued, but conditions must be met.

headline: Damaged floor tiles in prep and dish areas
summary: Damaged floor tiles and tiles needing grout were found in the prep and dishwashing areas. The manager was told to repair and maintain them.

headline: Dirty display floors and damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Display area floors along the wall base and in corners need cleaning to remove spills or debris. A few damaged ceiling tiles in the front display area must be replaced.

headline: Broken restroom vent; towels on sink partition
summary: An inoperable vent was found in the employee restroom and must be repaired. Rags and towels were hung on the three-compartment sink partition to dry and must be moved away from the sink.

headline: Front prep cooler too warm; tagged, not used
summary: The front prep cooler measured 58.0F, too warm to hold foods that must be kept cold. It was tagged and held for inspection and must not be used until it holds 41F or below. A walk-in door does not seal, and a sink drains slowly.

headline: No certified manager during food prep
summary: No certified food manager was on site while rice and other foods that must be kept hot or cold were prepared. A citation was issued. A freezer gasket is torn, floor tiles are cracked, and no public summary was posted.

headline: Unlabeled containers and cardboard liners
summary: Food storage containers lacked labels with common food names. Cardboard was used on the top of a chest freezer and must be removed. Food was kept in plastic totes in the freezer. A manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Debris inside ice machine must be removed
summary: A slight debris buildup encrusted the interior of the ice machine. The debris must be removed, the machine detail cleaned and serviced, and kept maintained.

headline: Mouse droppings and flies; repeat violations
summary: About 65 mouse droppings were found in the dish area, on bulk storage shelves, and on a rolling rack, along with 8 live flies. Mouse droppings must be removed and areas detail cleaned. Wiping cloths were left on counters; washroom very dirty.

headline: Certified manager absent; cold hot water; no pest log
summary: Food handlers prepared time-and-temperature foods without a certified manager until 3:45 p.m. Hand sinks lacked hot water. An ice machine had black-brown buildup. Raw-food advisory and pest-control logbook were missing. Citations issued.

headline: Food handlers lacked hair restraints
summary: Employees were observed handling food without hair restraints. The manager was instructed to provide and use hair restraints while handling food. This re-inspection passed.

headline: Grease and food debris on equipment and shelves
summary: Grease buildup and food debris were found on the interior and exterior surfaces of fryers, prep coolers, freezers, prep tables, shelving, and holding units. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Dirty floors and drain under soda bar
summary: Loose debris, dirt, and dust were found on the floor and drain under the front soda bar. The floors must be detail cleaned, cleaning must be done more often, and the area must be maintained at all times.

headline: Leaking plumbing and standing water on floors
summary: Several plumbing leaks were found, including at the hand sink and the two-compartment sink. Standing water covers floors in the dishwashing and prep areas. Milk crates are used for elevation, and clutter in the hallway could attract pests.

headline: Ice bin black slime; citation issued
summary: The front ice bin has black dirt and slime over the ice. The ice must be removed and the bin cleaned and sanitized; a citation was issued. Food containers lack labels, scoops are stored in dry containers, and an allergen-trained manager was on duty without current training.

headline: Handwashing signs missing in two places
summary: No handwashing signage was posted in the employee restroom or at the rear handwashing sink. The manager was told to provide and maintain signs.

headline: Undercooked menu items lack advisory; no test strips
summary: The menu includes undercooked egg items without a required consumer advisory; a priority violation was noted. No chemical sanitizer test devices were on site, and a citation was issued. A repeat allergen training violation was not corrected.

headline: Rear door gap; ice scoop stored on rack
summary: The rear outer door has a half-inch gap underneath, so it is not rodent or insect proof; this must be fixed. An ice scoop was stored on a rack and must be kept in a clean container. The large can opener and walk-in storage racks need cleaning.

headline: Rat droppings found; no certified manager
summary: About 25 rat droppings were found in the basement. No certified food manager was on site; one arrived at 10:25 a.m. Staff washed hands in the three-compartment sink. A thermometer could not be calibrated. Several citations issued.

headline: Excessive clutter in office and storage
summary: Office and rear storage had excessive clutter, and unused equipment was stored in the dish area. Items must be removed or stored at least six inches off the floor. A blown light bulb in the employee washroom was replaced on site.

headline: Fryer greasy; dusty ceiling vent
summary: Grease was found at the bottom of the fryer in the merchandise prep area and must be cleaned. Dust is on the ceiling vent in the third-floor bakery prep area and must be cleaned.

headline: Employee food in kitchen; floors and fans dirty
summary: Employee food and drinks were in the kitchen; the manager removed them during inspection. Food was stored on the walk-in freezer floor. Wet wiping cloths were left on prep surfaces. Grease, dirt, and dust were found throughout.

headline: Dirty refuse area, leaking steamer, broken door
summary: Leaves, mud, and debris surround the refuse area. A steamer leaks water during use. The dining room floor has food debris and sticky spots. A bathroom door is broken. The manager lacks verifiable allergen training.

headline: Walk-in cooler at 48.7F; repairs ordered
summary: The walk-in cooler measured 48.7F, above the 41F limit, and must be repaired. A slow leak from a wall pipe, rusty shelving, unused equipment, and holes in walls and ceilings also need attention. Lighting is inadequate.

headline: Only certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: The only certified food manager on duty had no allergen training. Certified managers must complete the training and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Dirty floors, rusty shelves, scratched cutting boards
summary: Rust was found on shelves in the two-door reach-in cooler. Cutting boards have deep scratches and stains. Floors, walls, and corners in prep areas need detail cleaning. One certified manager lacked allergen awareness certificate.

headline: Missing meat cooler thermometer; dirty coolers
summary: A thermometer is missing inside the meat display cooler. All meat cooling units need cleaning of dried debris. The unisex toilet door is not self-closing, and excessive debris and trash are behind the freezer chest.

headline: Live flying insects; repeat pest violation cited
summary: About 25 live small flying insects were found on walls, ceiling, and duct work in the rear storage and prep areas. Additional pest control service is needed. A torn cooler gasket and gaps in floor and wall were also noted; citations issued.

headline: Food stored on walk-in floor; debris in prep
summary: Food was stored on the floor of the rear walk-in cooler and must be raised six inches. Cardboard was used as shelf liner and must be removed. Food debris was on the rear prep floor.

headline: Broken door closer; hole in wall; dirty hood
summary: The washroom door's self-closing device is broken and must be repaired. Holes in the wall by the toilet and in the ceiling and wall of the hallway to the rear exit need repair. The hood and filters above the cooking equipment need detail cleaning.

headline: Bins too large for sink; hood filters dirty
summary: Plastic bins and buckets are too large to submerge in the three-compartment sink. Handwashing signage is needed in the rear prep area. A stained lobby ceiling tile must be fixed, and grease must be cleaned from hood filters.

headline: No employee health policy; food in prep area
summary: No written employee health policy was on site, and a citation was issued. Employees ate in the prep area. Dry food and to-go containers were stored under wastewater pipes in the basement. Rust, broken door handles, and missing food handler training proof were noted.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies; no metal thermometer
summary: No supplies for cleaning up vomit or diarrhea were on site, which is a citation. No metal stem thermometer was available to check food temperatures; also a citation. A hole in the wall at the toilet base, a missing lid, and dusty vents need attention.

headline: Missing hair restraints; dirty customer counter floor
summary: Food handlers were observed without hair caps or hairnets. The backflow device on the ice machine could not be located. Floors under the customer service counter have dirt and dust that must be cleaned.

headline: Food debris, dirt, and basement sink leak
summary: Food debris was built up between sandwich prep cabinets, which could feed insects. Dirt and debris were under shelving in the basement walk-in cooler and basement storage. The basement three-compartment sink faucet leaks.

headline: Single-service items stored on floor
summary: Single-service utensils were not inverted in the serving area, and cups were stored on the storage room floor. The manager was told to invert and elevate all single-service items.

headline: No valid certified food manager certificate
summary: No valid original City of Chicago food manager certificate was on site. The manager must ensure the original certificate is present at all times. A priority foundation violation was cited.

headline: Rat droppings and flies; chicken temps unsafe
summary: About 25 rat droppings, 8 live small flying insects, and 2 large flies were found. Chicken held at 88.8–90.1F under a heat lamp and chicken wings at 50F were discarded, about 25 lbs total. Wastewater from a hand sink drains into a bucket; a citation was issued.

headline: Live cat walked through food areas
summary: A large live cat walked through the food preparation and seating areas during inspection. The person in charge carried the cat outside. A citation was issued. Excessive clutter must be removed, and prep and dining area lighting is inadequate.

headline: Mold-like substance and rust inside ice machine
summary: Pink and black mold-like substance was found inside the ice machine, and rust on a screw inside it. Ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned and sanitized. Utensils stored uncovered at the beverage station must be inverted or covered.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; missing light shield
summary: Milk crates and plastic pallets are being used as shelving in the prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving at least six inches off the floor. A light shield is missing in front of the first-floor walk-in cooler.

headline: Dirty gasket and holes in storage wall
summary: Dirt has accumulated inside the gasket at the service cooler. Ceilings and walls in the prep and dish areas are dirty and dusty. Multiple holes are in the wall of the dry storage common area, and floors need cleaning.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; citation issued
summary: No procedure or kit for cleaning up vomit or diarrhea was on site. A citation was issued. Dry storage containers were unlabeled, an insect stick was hung above a prep table, and food handler certificates were missing.

headline: Missing dairy cooler thermometer; dirty floors
summary: A thermometer is missing inside the dairy display cooler and must be replaced. Excessive dirt and debris are under the rear dry storage shelving and around the indoor waste receptacles. Damaged baseboard inside the dairy walk-in must be repaired.

headline: Missing signage, thermometers, and damaged ceiling
summary: Handwashing signs are needed in the restrooms. Thermometers are needed inside the reach-in and prep coolers. A ceiling tile with peeling paint and exposed insulation above the rear dry storage must be replaced.

headline: Low hot water pressure; missing food handler training
summary: Low hot water pressure was found at a customer restroom hand sink and must be repaired. Missing food handler training for new employees must be provided. Several cooking-hood filters and burned-out lights need attention.

headline: No health policy; rear door gap; uncovered trash
summary: No employee health policy was on site; a copy was given at inspection. The rear alley door has a gap along its bottom from a missing sweep. The women's bathroom trash lacks a cover, and walls near the front counter are raw wood.

headline: Expired food handler training; repeat violation
summary: One food employee had expired food handler training. A repeat violation for missing allergen training for certified managers was not corrected; a citation was issued. A thermometer is missing and the fryer and hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Plastic bags for food; ceiling panels missing
summary: Plastic grocery bags were used to store food in the walk-in freezer and must be replaced with food-grade containers. The women's restroom trash lacks a cover. Several ceiling panels are missing or damaged in the rear bakery storage.

headline: No hot water; basement sewage backup, mold
summary: Hot water was not available at restroom or other hand sinks; sinks measured 66.7F. Brown and black sewage water backed up on the basement floor, with mold. Mold on basement walls and ceiling, and spider webs at the front window. A citation was issued.

headline: Deep-cut cutting boards; greasy cooking floors
summary: Cutting boards on a drying rack in the kitchen and dish room have deep cuts and stains. The compartment under the kitchen fryer has heavy grease and food debris. Floors behind and under cooking equipment need deep cleaning.

headline: No food sanitation certificate; cold soup at 51F
summary: No valid City of Chicago food sanitation certificate was posted, a citation issued. Tomato soup was held at 51F in a prep cooler, above the 41F limit. No soap or paper towels at some hand sinks. Repeat violations for food handler and allergen training.

headline: Dead bugs in washroom light; front door gaps
summary: Dead bugs were found inside a washroom light shield and must be removed. Gaps between the front doors and a quarter-inch gap at the bottom need weather stripping to prevent pests from entering.

headline: Foil used as covering; restroom trash lacks lids
summary: Foil was used as a covering in the rear prep area and must be removed or the wood painted or stained. Food debris is in lower reach-in coolers. A leak at the rear utility sink faucet and wall splatter also need fixing. Both restroom trash cans lack lids.

headline: Food on walk-in floors; worn gaskets
summary: Food must be raised off the floors of the walk-in cooler and freezer onto shelving. Worn gaskets on several coolers and a damaged freezer door panel need repair. Bulk and squeeze bottles must be labeled. Broken floor tiles need repair.

headline: CBD and THC items not allowed; sink backs up
summary: The proposed menu includes food and drinks with CBD or THC, which cannot be served or sold; a priority violation was issued. Wastewater backs up from the floor drain when the three-compartment sink drains. No grease trap and no self-closing toilet doors.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; leaking drains
summary: Handwashing signage is missing at the front prep and washroom sinks and must be added. The front prep sink drain and the three-compartment sink drain plugs are in poor repair and leaking. Exposed wood must be treated or replaced.

headline: Standing liquid on bar floor; detail cleaning
summary: Standing liquid was on the floor at the far end of the large bar and must be cleaned. The main front bar floor under equipment and along the walls needs detail cleaning.

headline: Heavy grease, food debris, and dirt found
summary: Grease buildup on cooking equipment, walls, floors and shelves, plus food debris and spills throughout. Cooler interiors and gaskets need cleaning. Basement clutter could attract pests. Management told to clean.

headline: Handsink blocked by meat; food stored on floor
summary: A meat-prep handsink was blocked by frozen meat, and it had no paper towels; citations were issued. Food was stored on the floor in the walk-in and prep areas and must be raised six inches off the floor.

headline: Ice scoops on bin; rusted basement shelving
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables, and ice scoops were on top of the ice bin; both must be stored properly. Rusted basement shelving needs repainting or replacing; floors near the ice machine and in the freezer need cleaning.

headline: Soap dispenser misplaced; toilet door not self-closing
summary: A handwash soap dispenser was above a utility sink and must be removed, with soap offered only at handwashing sinks. The toilet room door opens to the prep area and must be self-closing.

headline: Hot food covered while cooling in display cooler
summary: Hot foods with tight-fitting lids were placed in a display cooler, an improper cooling method. Staff were told to uncover hot food during cooling.

headline: Mussels lacked tags; vacuum packing unapproved
summary: Mussels had no shellstock tags; 3 lbs ($15) discarded. Vacuum-packed beef lacked an approved HACCP (food-safety) plan and variance. Bar sink paper towels were restocked on site. Frosting at 49°F discarded; manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Meat in grocery bag; allergen training missing
summary: Frozen meat in a plastic grocery bag must move to food-grade containers. Wiping cloths left on prep tables and a soiled mop head not hung up. Manager's allergen training still missing from a July 2025 inspection.

headline: Dirty fryer interiors; no covered toilet bin
summary: Fryer interiors had accumulated grease and food debris and need cleaning. The toilet room had no covered receptacle and must be provided one.

headline: Extensive grease cleaning needed at wok station
summary: Extensive cleaning is needed at the wok station, including grease removal from fryers, prep tables, reach-in coolers, freezers, sinks, and other equipment. The vent system over cooking equipment has heavy grease build-up.

headline: Heavy grease in hood; ice buildup in freezers
summary: Heavy grease in the exhaust hood and filters, and heavy ice in chest freezers and a display cooler, need cleaning. A prep table was used as a cutting board, floors need cleaning, and employee belongings were stored on shelves with food.

headline: Missing training certificates; repeat violations
summary: A food handler lacked a training certificate, and the certified manager lacked allergen training. An employee was not wearing a hair restraint, and ice scoops were stored inside the ice machine. Repeat violations from earlier inspection were not fixed.

headline: Thawing, labeling, and cutting board issues
summary: Fish was thawing in its original packaging; staff were told to remove it during thawing. Bulk bakery containers need labels, a handwashing sign is needed at the juice bar sink, and damaged cutting boards need replacing.

headline: Leaking hand sink; toilet room lacks ventilation
summary: A leaking hand-washing sink and a grease trap lid not fully covering it were found; the manager must repair both. One of two toilet rooms had no mechanical ventilation; the operator said the toilet would be removed or ventilation added.

headline: About 20 live small flies in food prep area
summary: About 20 live small flies were on walls, ceiling, and equipment in the rear food prep and dishwashing area. More pest control service is needed. Also noted: stained cutting boards, no covered waste bins in washrooms, and dirty floors.

headline: Uncovered employee drink on cold unit
summary: An employee's uncovered beverage was on a cold-holding unit in the front prep area. The inspector instructed staff to add a lid.

headline: Food stored on floor; no sanitizer test strips
summary: Food containers stored on floor in prep, storage, and walk-in areas. No sanitizer test strips were on site, and grease sat atop outside grease container. Bulk food was unlabeled, and a hole in basement walk-in floor needs repair.

headline: Cold food at 48–56°F; food discarded
summary: Several cold foods were held at 48–56°F, and 24 lbs of noodles, tofu, chicken, greens, and eggs were discarded, worth $100. Food handlers had no training, and the certified manager had no allergen training proof.

headline: No certified manager; sink hot water too low
summary: No certified food manager was on site while food was prepared and served; one arrived about 50 minutes after the inspection began. Three-compartment sink hot water peaked at 93°F and fell to 87°F; the minimum is 110°F.

headline: Roaches, mouse droppings, and contaminated food found
summary: 5 live roaches and about 45-55 mouse droppings found in food prep and storage areas, plus dead roaches. Foreign objects found in sugar and salt; about 20 lbs discarded. Oysters and clams lacked tags; about 10 lbs discarded.

headline: No food handler training proof; expired allergen certificates
summary: No proof of food handler training was provided for any food handler. Allergen awareness certificates for employees were expired. Openings at two exit doors must be sealed, and a women's washroom handsink had no cold water pressure.

headline: Thermometer placement and broom storage fixes
summary: The thermometer was at the rear of the front prep cooler; staff were told to keep it in the warmest part. Brooms and dustpans were stored too close to clean utensils and must be kept away.

headline: Blocked handsink; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: A dishwashing-room handsink was blocked by a cart and gloves; the manager cleared it. The chlorine dish machine dispensed 0 ppm and is tagged held until repaired. Test strips and a fix for a leaking prep sink are also needed.

headline: 200+ mouse droppings found throughout store
summary: Over 200 mouse droppings were found across storage areas, the selling floor, cooking and fish areas, washrooms, and dry-goods walk-ins. Pest control service was required before reinspection next week. A splash guard is needed at the fish prep handsink.

headline: Mouse droppings found near entrance; inspection failed
summary: About 40 mouse droppings found in a corner near the entrance; pest control recommended. Earlier violations, including floor clutter in the dish area, were not corrected. A worn cutting board and food debris in display shelves also noted.

headline: One food manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: One certified food manager lacked a food allergen training certificate. The inspector instructed that all City of Chicago certified food managers must have one.

headline: Leaking pipes at dish sink
summary: Water was leaking from pipes at the three-compartment dish sink. The inspector instructed the operator to repair it and keep it maintained.

headline: Several cold foods too warm; 10 lbs discarded
summary: Foods in service coolers were above 41°F, including steak at 89°F, roast beef at 57.2°F, and ham at 48.4°F. 10 lbs ($200) were discarded, and a citation was issued. Also: serving plates on shelves not inverted, and cracked floors.

headline: Rear door gap; rear sink sprays water
summary: The rear exit door has a half-inch gap and is not rodent- or insect-proof. The rear hand-washing sink is in poor repair and sprays water across the floor when turned on. Both must be fixed.

headline: No food handler training proof; ice machines dirty
summary: No proof of food handler training was provided for required employees. Both ice machines need cleaning. Stored items must be raised off the floor in all storage areas, including liquor storage, and milk crates must not be used for elevation.

headline: No certificate posted; handwash sink blocked
summary: No valid food sanitation certificate was posted. A sushi-area handsink was blocked, another had no soap, and a washroom had no paper towels. The low-temperature dish machine had no chlorine test strips. Food handlers and managers lacked training proof.

headline: Ice machine slime; sewage lines over food
summary: Ice machine in basement had black slime dripping onto ice for consumption; citation issued. Sewage lines over food and single-use items were not shielded. Grab-and-go items lacked required labels. Thermometers missing from reach-in coolers.

headline: Food stored on walk-in floor; dirty cloths
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor inside the walk-in cooler and must be on shelving six inches off the floor. Dirty wiping cloths were left on prep tables and must be kept in sanitizing solution.

headline: Ice machine buildup; unlabeled food discarded
summary: Rear ice machine had thick black and brown buildup dripping onto ice below the bin; a citation was issued. Ready-to-eat foods in a refrigerator lacked date labels; about 20 lbs were discarded. Also: dirty microwave, slow bar sink drain, clutter.

headline: Pots on floor; no allergen training for manager
summary: Pots were stored on the floor outside the rear freezer and must be kept six inches off the floor. Grease had built up on filters in the rear cooking prep area. The certified manager on duty had no allergen training.

headline: Hand sink had no water; warm food discarded
summary: Basement hand sink had no hot or cold running water during inspection. Cold foods at 48–55°F, including chicken, chorizo, and steak, were voluntarily discarded. Unlabeled bulk containers, food debris on prep equipment, and dried debris on floors also noted.

headline: Food stored on floor; shelving debris
summary: A box of chicken wings was stored on the floor under the three-compartment sink, and a strainer of food was stored on the floor nearby. Shelving near the hot water tank had food debris.

headline: Poor gaskets, dusty vent, missing allergen certificate
summary: Gaskets on the walk-in cooler and a deli prep cooler were in poor repair. Dust had built up on a vent over food in the walk-in. The certified manager had no allergen certificate on site, which must be obtained.

headline: No cold water at prep handsink
summary: The handwashing sink at the front prep area had no cold running water and must be repaired. A ceiling tile is missing in a staff toilet room, and dusty hood vents in front and rear prep areas must be cleaned.

headline: Cold food at 48–50°F; 8 lbs discarded
summary: Foods that must be kept cold (TCS) measured 48–50°F in the prep cooler, including diced tomatoes, raw hamburgers, and hot dogs; 8 lbs were discarded. Also noted: unlabeled food containers, greasy floors, and a damaged freezer lid.

headline: No employee health policy; missing allergen certificate
summary: No written employee health policy was on the premises, and handwashing signs were missing near sinks. The certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate. Missing ceiling and wall tiles also need replacing.

headline: Undated food and missing sanitizer test strips
summary: Cooked foods and deli portions lacked date markings; one item worth $50 was discarded. No sanitizer test strips for the dish machines, a food handler lacked a certificate, and the manager lacked allergen training. Bulk containers unlabeled; floor tiles broken.

headline: Hood grease, leaking faucet, dirty floors
summary: Food and grease had built up on the ventilation hood and filters, and the three-compartment sink faucet leaks at its base. Washroom walls and the prep area floor need cleaning.

headline: Expired food manager certificate; citation issued
summary: The only certificate on site had expired. Person in charge must obtain valid training and a certificate, and keep it on site. A citation was issued.

headline: No certified manager on duty; dishes washed improperly
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while chicken, beef, and tuna were prepared and served; a citation was issued. A three-compartment sink was used without being set up for sanitizing. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Walk-in freezer ice buildup; floors need cleaning
summary: Ice had built up inside the walk-in freezer on the floor and door, and the condensation units need repair. Floors along wall bases, under equipment, and in the dishwashing area must be cleaned.

headline: No hair restraints; greasy fryers; sink leak
summary: Food handlers and prep staff were not wearing hair restraints. Fryers had thick grease and dirt inside and on the doors. A leak at the three-compartment sink faucet needs repair, and floor drains and floors need cleaning.

headline: Over 100 rat droppings; raw eggs above vegetables
summary: Over 100 rat droppings were found in the rear hallway to the outdoor garbage area and around stored equipment; pest control was recommended. Raw eggs were stored directly above ready-to-eat vegetables in the walk-in cooler.

headline: No training proof for handlers or managers
summary: No proof of food handler training or allergen training was available on site. Dishes and pots were stored on the floor, and pools of water, grease, and food debris were under cooking equipment. Water-damaged restroom ceiling tiles also need replacing.

headline: Cold foods held at 48–54°F; food discarded
summary: Several foods that must be kept cold (TCS) were held at 48–54°F; lettuce, cheese, and sliced tomatoes were discarded, worth $30. The certified manager's allergen certificate had expired. A citation was issued.

headline: Sink water too hot; food too warm; cooler tagged
summary: Washroom sink water measured 133.1°F, above the 100–120°F range required. Quesadillas and beef at 47–49°F were held in a cooler running at 50.1°F; about 20 lbs discarded. The cooler is tagged and cannot be used until repaired.

headline: Cooked beef at 59.1°F; food discarded
summary: Cooked beef croquettes at 59.1°F were stored on top of the front deli display cooler; about 5 lbs ($50) discarded. Also: 1/4-inch gap under front door, leaking sink drain, and missing basement hood filters.

headline: All food handler certificates expired
summary: All food handler certificates on site had expired. Staff must complete training and keep records on site. Dust was also found on ceiling vents in first-floor washrooms and on condenser fan covers in all walk-in coolers.

headline: Mussels lacked tags; manager discarded product
summary: Mussels in the cooler had no required shellfish identification tags (shellstock tags). The manager voluntarily discarded 4 lbs ($19 value). Serving plates on shelves were not inverted to keep dust off; staff were told to fix this.

headline: Ice machine debris; missing cooler thermometer
summary: Debris had encrusted inside the ice machine and must be removed and detail cleaned. A 3-door prep cooler lacked a thermometer and a 2-door prep cooler had a torn gasket. Allergen training is required for staff with City sanitation certificates.

headline: No paper towels at handsink; food on floor
summary: The exposed handsink behind the seafood counter had no paper towels; management supplied them during inspection. Citation issued. Food was stored on the dairy cooler floor, and a thermometer was needed in the milk cooler. Grease, dirt, and dust need cleaning.

headline: Cold food too warm; prep cooler tagged out
summary: Cold food held above 41°F, including rice at 47.2°F; 10 lbs discarded. The prep cooler ran at 51.2–55.7°F; it is tagged and cannot be used until reinspected by the city. Grease buildup and food stored on the floor also noted.

headline: No pest control log book on premises
summary: No current pest control log book was on the premises. A licensed pest control company must inspect at least twice a year, and reports must be kept in the log. The operator must provide the log and reports.

headline: Grab-and-go items unlabeled; rear sink faulty
summary: Prepackaged grab-and-go items had no labels; labels must show business name, address, and ingredients. The rear hand-washing sink did not turn on properly and must be repaired. Floors front and rear had minor dirt.

headline: 5 live roaches and expired ready-to-eat food found
summary: Five live cockroaches were found under and behind the dishwasher, plus five live small flying insects in the coffee prep area; more pest control is needed. Ready-to-eat foods were kept past the 7-day limit. Several food handlers lacked training certificates.

headline: Food storage containers lacked name labels
summary: Food storage containers were not labeled with the common name of the food. The inspector instructed staff to provide labels.

headline: Freezer ice buildup; loose handsink fixture
summary: Ice had built up around the walk-in freezer door and must be defrosted. The interior of a small reach-in unit needs cleaning to remove spills. The front hand sink fixture is loose and must be repaired.

headline: Damaged prep floor; dirty stove and coolers
summary: The walk-in freezer and reach-in coolers need cleaning, and food debris had built up on the stove. The damaged floor in the prep area must be repaired to a smooth, easily cleanable surface.

headline: Torn gaskets on prep cooler and refrigerator
summary: A torn rubber gasket was found inside the prep service cooler and on the door of a three-door refrigerator. The inspector instructed the operator to repair or replace it.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; unlabeled bulk food
summary: High-temperature dish machine was not sanitizing at final rinse; maximum 142°F at the dish surface. Staff were told to fix it. Also noted: open drinks above clean utensils and unlabeled bulk sugar and salt.

headline: Grab-and-go labels; staff food in customer cooler
summary: Grab-and-go hot foods were not labeled according to the health code. Employees' personal food was stored in the customer walk-in cooler, and staff were told to separate it.

headline: No certified manager; hands not washed properly
summary: No City-certified manager was on site while chicken, beef, and fish were cooked and served. A food handler touched a phone and handled food without washing hands, and fish and chicken were thawing in water. Repeat violations also noted.

headline: No hot water at handwashing sinks; citation issued
summary: Handwashing sinks in employee and public washrooms had no hot running water; readings were 70–90°F, below the 100°F minimum. A citation was issued. A light bulb was out in the walk-in cooler and must be replaced.

headline: No handwashing sink in dish area
summary: The dish machine and three-compartment sink area has no handwashing sink. The operator must provide one and keep it maintained.

headline: Pizza cooler too warm; 27 lbs discarded
summary: Cheeses, bacon, tomatoes, and onions held at 44.2–45.1°F in the pizza cooler were discarded: 27 lbs worth $200. The cooler air measured 44°F and must be repaired to 41°F or below. Front door gap and leaking bar sink need fixing.

headline: Dish machine not dispensing detergent; tagged
summary: The dish machine was not dispensing detergent automatically. It was tagged, and the manager was instructed to ensure automatic detergent dispensing. A citation was issued.

headline: Dead insects on basement floor; cleaning needed
summary: Dead insects were found on the floor around a refrigeration unit in the basement storage area. The inspector instructed staff to clean and sanitize the area.

headline: Torn gaskets and damaged ice machine door
summary: Two torn gaskets on a two-door reach-in cooler must be repaired or replaced. The ice machine's door track is damaged. A soiled floor drain in the rear prep area held plastic and trash and must be cleaned.

headline: Food stored on floor; torn gaskets; ice buildup
summary: Buckets of food in the basement walk-in and boxes of liquor and soft drinks on the basement floor must be raised off the floor. Torn gaskets, heavy ice in a chest freezer, and openings around pipes also need attention.

headline: Manager lacks City certification while cooking
summary: A food service manager without City certification was on site while eggs, bacon, and ready-to-eat foods were prepared; a citation was issued. Heavy grease was found behind deep fryers and on nearby walls, and hood filters and vents were dusty.

headline: Mop heads stored improperly; floor debris
summary: Soiled mop heads were not stored properly and should be hung to prevent insect breeding. Debris was found on floors along walls and corners in utility and storage areas.

headline: No certified manager; about 23 flies found
summary: No City-certified food manager was on the premises, and no supplies for vomit or diarrhea cleanup were available. About 20 small and 3 large flies were found in several areas; a citation was issued. Food handlers had no training proof.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: The certified food manager did not have allergen training. The operator was instructed to obtain it and keep proof on site at all times.

headline: Dish machine over sanitizer limit; tagged out
summary: Low-temperature dish machine's final rinse measured over 200 ppm (parts per million) of sanitizer, above the 100 ppm limit. The machine is tagged and cannot be used until repaired. Also noted: cardboard liners, low hot water pressure at a men's sink, and dusty vents.

headline: Ice machine debris; unlabeled containers
summary: Debris was found inside the ice machine and must be removed and cleaned. Bulk containers in the rear prep area lacked labels, and a food handler had an expired certificate.

headline: Leaks, dirty floors, and equipment debris
summary: A leaking drain pipe under the three-compartment sink in the produce area needs repair. Dirty knife rack, cooler bases, and floors in prep, storage, and walk-in coolers also need cleaning.

headline: Missing health policy, procedures, and test strips
summary: No written employee health policy or vomit/diarrhea cleaning procedure was on site. Customers could reach a cooler holding dairy spreads; access must end. Missing metal-stem thermometer, quaternary sanitizer test strips, and no-smoking signs.

headline: 100+ mouse droppings found in basement
summary: About 100–120 droppings found in basement; about 30 more behind coffee station. Openings in basement walls and ceilings must be sealed, and pest control was required. Food debris and a manager missing allergen certification also noted.

headline: No employee health policy; leaks and storage issues
summary: No written employee health policy was on site. Dry food was stored under wastewater pipes in the basement, and a water leak was found under the dish sink. Walk-in shelving, sink stoppers, and an ice-maker backflow device also need fixing.

headline: Missing food handler proof; expired allergen certificate
summary: Food handlers had no proof of required training, and the allergen training certificate was expired. Staff in prep were not wearing hair restraints, and wiping cloths and utensils were not stored properly. Walk-in cooler floor is damaged and needs replacing.

headline: No certified food manager during prep and service
summary: No City-certified food manager was on premises while chicken, stuffing, and potatoes were being prepared and served; a citation was issued. Raw meat containers sat on the walk-in freezer floor, and a wet mop was stored in a bucket.

headline: Mold-like ice machine substance cleaned on site
summary: Black mold-like substance inside the ice machine was cleaned and sanitized on site. Other issues: no handwashing sign at a prep sink, no splash guard on the main bar handsink, and two second-floor washroom sinks not working.

headline: Rooftop and first-floor bars lack handwashing setup
summary: The first-floor bar and rooftop bar need adequate handwashing sinks with soap, hand-drying supplies, and required signs. The rooftop bar also needs a separate utility (dump) sink.

headline: Milk crates, stairs, and wall repairs needed
summary: Milk crates are used as shelving and must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Basement stairs are lifting and need repair. A hole behind a sink must be sealed, and toilet room doors must self-close.

headline: Grease and debris on equipment and floors
summary: Coffee station nozzles needed detail cleaning, and cooking equipment sides and hot-holding stations were dirty. Floors with grease and debris near the soda dispenser and behind burger stations also need cleaning.

headline: Cleaning and storage issues; door needs closing
summary: Front door needs to close to keep out flying insects. Cooler gaskets, prep tables, cooking equipment, and floors need cleaning. Wiping cloths and utensils must be stored in sanitizing solution. Weeds near dumpster to be removed.

headline: Certified manager missing allergen training
summary: The city-certified food manager did not have allergen training on record. The operator was instructed to obtain the training and keep verification on site.

headline: 20+ flies throughout facility; no vacuum-packing plan
summary: More than 20 small flies were found throughout, including in kitchens, the bar, and the brewery. A vacuum packaging machine was on site without a required HACCP (food-safety) plan or variance (approval). Manager said it was not in use.

headline: Mold-like substance in ice machine; drain fixed
summary: Mold-like substance in the ice machine must be cleaned and the ice destroyed. A slow-draining hand sink was repaired on site. Also noted: soap dispenser over sink drainboard, milk crates in meat cooler, stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Grease traps must be sealed; grease buildup
summary: Grease traps under the kitchen and bar three-compartment sinks must be fully closed and sealed to prevent pests. Grease buildup found on equipment and coolers. Wiping cloths were left on prep tables, and a cutting board was deeply grooved.

headline: No employee health policy; washroom doors
summary: No signed written employee health policy was on the premises. Three washroom doors lacked self-closing devices and must be fitted with them.

headline: Leaking drainpipe; attic clutter
summary: A drainpipe at the warewashing handsink is leaking and must be repaired. Clutter on the attic floor must be removed, elevated six inches, and unused items cleared to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Milk crates as shelving; broken cooler doors
summary: Milk crates are used as shelving and must be replaced with shelves 6 inches off the floor. Broken cooler doors and a leaking drainpipe at the three-compartment sink need repair. Furnace room floors need detail cleaning.

headline: Vaping inside store; grease and cleaning issues
summary: The person in charge was vaping inside the store, and vaping is not allowed within 15 feet of entrances; a citation was issued. Also noted: grease on the hood, filters, and wall, plus dirty floors and openings in the prep-area wall panels.

headline: Dusty vent above prep area
summary: Dust had built up on a vent in the first-floor kitchen and prep area, across from cooking equipment. The inspector instructed staff to clean it and keep it maintained.

headline: No hot water at handwash sink; certificates missing
summary: The handwashing sink by the hot prep area had no hot water; the water measured 64.5°F. Hot and cold water must run at a minimum of 100°F at all hand sinks. Two food handlers lacked certificates.

headline: About 30 mouse droppings found in facility
summary: About 30 mouse droppings were found, including in a room with a heating and AC unit. Licensed pest control service was recommended on or after 4/20/2026. Wastewater overflowed from the grease trap when the three-compartment sink drained.

headline: Failed: three-compartment sink floods; training missing
summary: The three-compartment sink did not work correctly, since draining one basin flooded another, and a citation was issued. Food employees lacked proof of food handler training, and the certified food manager had no allergen training.

headline: Clean floors and walls in small prep area
summary: The complaint asked for the floor and walls in the small food prep area to be cleaned. No other issues were listed.

headline: Missing thermometer; debris and dirt in coolers
summary: A small hot holding unit had no visible thermometer, and debris was inside a small cold holding unit. A small ice machine lacked a backflow device, and basement and walk-in cooler floors had dirt and food debris. Ceiling vents had dust buildup.

headline: Frozen shrimp thawed in bowl; unlabeled ingredients
summary: Frozen shrimp was sitting in a bowl instead of being thawed under cold running water, in the microwave, or in a cooler. Large ingredient containers were unlabeled. Cooler surfaces, floor drains, and corners had food and dirt buildup, and a server lacked a food handler certificate.

headline: Deteriorating faucets, cracked floors, leaking drain
summary: Food containers were on the walk-in cooler floor, and rack and wall cleaning was needed. Hand sink faucets were deteriorating, and floor tiles and grout were missing or damaged in prep and dish areas. A floor drain cone leaked onto the dish floor.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; no pest control logbook
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site while eggs and milk were prepared, and a citation was issued. A pest control logbook was not available, and a priority citation was issued. Labels were missing on packaged bread and pastries, and several cleaning and storage issues were noted.

headline: Grease, leaks, and unlabeled containers
summary: Food storage containers were unlabeled, and grease and debris were on dish racks, cooking equipment, and fryer cabinets. A leaky water line under the two-compartment sink needed repair. Loose wall bases, damaged floor tiles, and burnt-out lights were also noted.

headline: Live bird in dining area; failed inspection
summary: A live bird was found in the dining area, and the manager was told to schedule pest control to remove it; a citation was issued. Wet wiping cloths were also stored on top of prep coolers, and the manager was told to keep them in sanitizing solution.

headline: Failed: slimy ice machine; hand sink issues
summary: The ice machine had excessive black and pink slimy buildup touching ice, so the ice must be discarded and the machine cleaned; a citation was issued. Hand sinks were in poor repair, and handwashing signs were missing in restrooms. A three-compartment sink leaked, and cardboard was on the dish floor.

headline: Leaks, debris, clutter, and missing training
summary: Cooler and cooking equipment interiors had debris, and a three-compartment sink faucet leaked. Unused articles were stored inside and outside, and walls and ceilings had openings. Equipment was not fully under the hood, and there was no food handler or allergen training.

headline: Heavy grease in exhaust hood; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Serving plates on shelves were not inverted to prevent dust buildup. Heavy dirt and grease were found inside and around the exhaust hood, filters, and pipes, and must be detail cleaned. The certified food manager on duty had no allergen training.

headline: Failed: deli foods and cooler held too warm
summary: Deli meats at 48.9F and sliced tomato at 51.8F were discarded. A deli prep cooler reached 75.2F and was tagged out until repaired and reinspected. No metal stem thermometer was on site, and several cleaning, repair, and storage problems were also noted.

headline: Failed: live roaches; pest control needed
summary: Live cockroaches were found in the rear dish area, the water heater closet, the bar, and by the employee lockers, and a citation was issued. The re-inspection found more live roaches, including six under the rear soda cooler. The manager was told to remove evidence of pests and get additional pest control service.

headline: Failed: live flies; no certificates; pest report needed
summary: About 15 live flies were found in the rear food prep area, dish area, deep frying area, dining area, and near the mop sink. Insect control devices were stored on prep tables with food and on ceilings. No food handler certificates or certified manager allergen certificate were on site, and a new pest control report is required.

headline: No certified manager during cut melon service
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site or certificate posted while cut melon was prepared and served, and a citation was issued. No health policy or vomit cleanup kit was on site, and food handler certificates could not be found. The inspection summary was not posted, and a citation was issued.

headline: Failed: water too cold at hand sink; cold food
summary: Hand sink water measured 70.7F and was adjusted to 103.6F during inspection; a citation was issued. Cold TCS foods, including sliced tomatoes at 53.4F and rice at 48.2F, were voluntarily discarded, about 9 lbs. Shellstock tags were missing last-sold dates, corrected for September tags, and a citation was issued.

headline: Leaks, missing covers, and damaged walls and floors
summary: Issues included no splashguard by the hand sink, scoops stored inside food containers, and plates not inverted. Other problems were a leaking drain pipe, no covered trash bin in the employee washroom, cracked floor tiles, and holes in a wall and ceiling.

headline: Broken toilets covered with bags; clutter
summary: Two of four toilets in the women's restroom were not working and were covered with garbage bags, though another restroom was available. The rear kitchen by an ice machine was cluttered, and a rusty prep table needs repair. Certified managers had no allergen training certificates on site.

headline: No certified manager for TCS food; basement cleanup
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site or documented while hummus wraps and smoothies were prepared and served, and a citation was issued. The basement storage area was cluttered and stock must be raised at least six inches off the floor.

headline: Failed: no certificate posted; live flying insects
summary: No valid City food sanitation certificate was posted, and a citation was issued. About 20 live small flying insects were found in the dining, dish, and dry storage areas. Garbage and food debris were between the outside dumpsters and the building, and a citation was issued. A thermometer was missing from the walk-in cooler.

headline: Missing self-closing doors on washrooms
summary: Neither washroom door had a self-closing device. Management was instructed to install them.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; dumpster lids open
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site while open, and a citation was issued. Prep area and restroom hand sinks had no soap, but a food handler obtained some during the inspection, and a citation was issued. Food was stored on the walk-in freezer floor and dumpster lids were not closed.

headline: Dirty ice bin and clogged floor drain
summary: The ice bin interior needed cleaning, with ice removed first. The floor drain in the front prep area was encrusted with food debris and must be cleaned.

headline: Holes in wall and clutter; sealing and cleanup ordered
summary: Multiple holes were found in a wall by the kitchen stairs, which must be sealed to keep pests out. Other items were a foil lining in the basement produce cooler, unused items in the basement to clear, a hand sink not sealed to its station, and dirt and drain buildup to clean.

headline: Rodent-proofing and wall openings needed
summary: Restaurant double doors were not fully rodent-proof at the bottom and center. Openings were found in the wall by the receiving door, and exposed brick near the kitchen entrance must be sealed. Not all food handlers had food handler training.

headline: Failed: no vomit kit; no food thermometer
summary: No kit or written procedure for vomit and diarrhea cleanup was on site, and a citation was issued. The employee restroom had no hand soap, and no food temperature device or sanitizer test device was on site. Food items were stored without labels and on the prep area floor.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; coolers tagged
summary: Several TCS foods were held at 44-48F. The manager discarded 2 gallons of milk, half a gallon of cream, and 5 lbs of quiche, and a citation was issued. Two coolers at 46F and 50F were tagged, and debris was on a basement storage floor. Some food handlers had expired certificates.

headline: Failed: overflowing dumpster; door gaps
summary: The outside dumpster overflowed with trash and boxes, and its lid must stay closed to prevent pests; a citation was issued. A basement exit door had a quarter-inch gap at the bottom. Bulk containers were unlabeled, and a prep cooler gasket was torn.

headline: No certified manager on site; cooler at 60F
summary: No City-certified food manager with a valid original certificate was on site while chicken and hamburgers were prepared, and a citation was issued. A walk-in cooler measured 60F with no food inside and was tagged for health department review. Flour and pizza dough covered prep floors, and some ceiling panels were missing near the rear door.

headline: Failed: rat and mouse droppings, dead roaches
summary: About 30-45 rat droppings and 5 mouse droppings were found, including under a dry spice unit and inside a noodle boiler; the manager was told to clean and contact pest control. Dead roaches were on floors and walls near the dish area. Ice scoops, uncovered fryers, and greasy equipment were also noted.

headline: Splash guard and training needed
summary: A splash guard must be installed at the prep area counter hand sink. An employee had no food handler training, and it must be provided and maintained.

headline: No certified manager posted; no health policy
summary: No City food sanitation certificate was posted, and a citation was issued. No written employee health policy was on site, and a citation was issued. No food handler training certificates were posted, and management must show proof of training.

headline: Uncovered seasonings and missing hair restraints
summary: Seasonings were uncovered in the rear prep area, and food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables, and ice had built up inside the meat cooler. Food debris was on many surfaces, and missing light shields and a covered window in a washroom were noted.

headline: Failed: no hand sink at prep area
summary: The prep area had no hand sink with hot and cold running water, a priority citation was issued. Cutting boards were pitted and had to be repaired or replaced. The ventilation hood was not working.

headline: Open ceiling and rough walls; splashguard needed
summary: The ceiling above the food prep area was open, with water pipes and conduits showing, and must be made smooth and cleanable. Rough brick walls by the washrooms had open cracks and must be smoothed. A splashguard is needed between the prep sink and the three-compartment sink.

headline: Damaged freezer gaskets and leaking faucets
summary: A chest freezer had damaged gaskets and a lid, and its ice buildup must be defrosted. The three-compartment and mop sink faucets leaked, a wall hole and stained ceiling tiles needed repair, and wet mops needed a hanging system to dry.

headline: No cooler thermometer; dirty and damaged surfaces
summary: No thermometer was inside the Coca-Cola cooler in the middle prep area. Food spills and debris were on holding and shelving units, and walls had peeling paint. Dust covered walls, ceilings, and vents, and grease built up in the hood.

headline: Openings in utility closet walls and ceilings
summary: The utility closet had openings in its walls and ceiling, which the manager was instructed to repair and maintain.

headline: Dirty floor drain; manager missing allergen training
summary: The floor drain under the three-compartment sink was dirty and must be cleaned to avoid attracting pests. The certified food manager on duty lacked allergen training; citations will follow if it is not provided.

headline: Failed: dish machine too cool; rust on ice machines
summary: The high-temperature dish machine's final rinse measured 122.6F, below the required 180F, and a citation was issued. Rust was found on both basement ice machines, and gaps at the base of both front doors could let pests in. Espresso and coffee machines lacked backflow devices.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep; no training proof
summary: Food handlers prepared soup, meatballs, and deli meat without a City-certified food manager or original certificate on site, and a citation was issued. No proof of food handler training was shown, and the prior allergen training violation was not corrected.

headline: Black buildup around sinks; cracked floor tiles
summary: Excessive black substance was found on and around caulking above the two- and three-compartment sinks, and it must be removed. Cracked floor tiles in front of the fryers must be replaced so the surface is smooth and cleanable.

headline: No valid manager certificate posted; food on floors
summary: The person in charge lacked a posted certified food manager certificate, and a citation was issued for no manager on site while TCS foods were prepared. A rear door propped open with a gap could let pests in. Food was stored on the floor in prep and walk-in freezer areas, and food handler training was missing.

headline: Worn cooler gasket; unfinished bar walls
summary: A walk-in cooler door had a torn, worn gasket that needed service. Two wooden panel walls at the front bar were unfinished and unpainted. One exhaust hood light was out and must be serviced.

headline: Broken ventilation in restrooms
summary: Mechanical ventilation in the staff and customer restrooms was not working. The facility must repair or replace it and maintain it.

headline: Unlabeled containers and grocery bags used for storage
summary: Food storage containers lacked labels with the common food name, and frozen items were kept in plastic grocery bags. Management was told to use labeled, food-grade containers and bags.

headline: Failed: dish machine not sanitizing; blocked sink
summary: The low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine at the final rinse and is tagged not to be used until the health department approves its removal. A food strainer blocked the bar hand sink, and ice cream scoops were in standing water. An ice maker lacked a backflow device.

headline: Failed: unlabeled bread; pest logbook out of date
summary: Packaged bread was displayed without food labels. The pest control logbook was not maintained, and the last pest inspection report was dated 2/6/2023; a priority citation was issued. The washroom door lacked a self-closing device, and the unisex washroom lacked a covered waste bin.

headline: Missing hair restraints; furnace room dirty
summary: Food handlers were prepping food without hair restraints, and must wear them at all times. No covered receptacle for feminine hygiene products was in the women's toilet room. Debris and dust covered furnace room floors and corners.

headline: Failed: about 80 rat droppings; drinking over food
summary: About 80 rat droppings were found on floors in the prep, dry storage, dining, and furnace closet areas. A food handler drank from an open jar above meat. A hand sink still did not meet water rules and must be repaired by an approved date. Damaged floor tiles and standing water were noted.

headline: Failed cold holding; sink blocked; no soap or towels
summary: Roast beef, chicken, and steak in a prep cooler were 47.8-55.7F, and about 25 lbs were discarded; the sandwich cooler was tagged. A food handler washed hands with no soap, and a rear hand sink was blocked with condiment trays. The washroom had no paper towels or dryer; citations were issued.

headline: Expired manager allergen training; door gap
summary: A quarter-inch gap at the rear exterior door must be repaired to keep pests out. Black residue was on a cold holding unit's gaskets, and water-damaged brown ceiling tiles needed replacing. The certified manager on site had expired allergen training.

headline: Failed: over 75 mouse droppings in prep area
summary: Over 75 mouse droppings were scattered in the prep area, along walls, behind coolers, and in the utility storage area. The manager was told to call an exterminator and clean and sanitize; a citation was issued. Single-use articles were stored on the floor, and grease buildup was on equipment and walls.

headline: Failed: rust, greasy floors, and repeat violations
summary: Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables and ice scoops inside the ice machine. A three-compartment sink faucet leaked, grease and dirt built up under equipment, and some ceiling tiles were water-damaged. Earlier violations, including rust and food on the walk-in cooler floor, were not corrected; a citation was issued.

headline: Gaps under dining doors; missing ceiling tiles
summary: Dining room entrance and exit doors had a half-inch gap at the bottom that must be sealed. Plastic must be removed from interior metal surfaces inside drawer coolers. Women's and coed restrooms need covered waste bins, and rear kitchen and dish area ceiling tiles are missing.

headline: Food debris inside cold holding units; no food handler certificates
summary: Food debris had built up inside all cold holding units and must be cleaned. No food handler certificates were on site for employees, and the person in charge was told to direct staff to obtain training.

headline: No certified manager during TCS prep; no paper towels
summary: No City-certified food manager was on duty while rice and chicken soup were prepared and served, and a citation was issued. Paper towels were missing at hand sinks in the main prep kitchen and bakery, and a citation was issued. Dirty floors, mold-like buildup near the dish machine, and grease in the hood were also noted.

headline: Allergen training proof for three employees
summary: Proof of allergen training was shown for three employees with City food sanitation certificates. Proof must be provided for all employees with those certificates.

headline: Knives in standing water; sink stopper broken
summary: In-use knives were found stored in standing water and must be stored properly. The built-in stopper at the three-compartment sink could not hold water and must be repaired.

headline: Cardboard shelf liners and dusty knife rack
summary: Cardboard lined dish storage racks next to the three-compartment sink and was to be replaced with smooth, cleanable shelving. The knife rack had dust and grease, the drain next to the sink had grease buildup, and hallway floors were dirty. Several ceiling tiles were broken or water-stained.

headline: Sewer line above sinks and ice machine; rust on shelves
summary: A sewer line above the three-compartment sink and the basement ice machine was not shielded and must be protected from contamination. Rust was found on shelving near the kitchen prep hand sink and must be removed.

headline: High-temperature dish machine repaired; food discarded
summary: The high-temperature dish machine reached only 145F on the surface and was repaired to 180F during the inspection; a citation was issued. Sausage at 115.1F, cooked rice at 75.5F, and cold foods above 41F were discarded, about 30 lbs total. Wiping cloths were in unsanitized water, and clean linens were in a restroom.

headline: Warped cutting board; foil liners; missing receptacle lid
summary: The front prep cutting board was warped with deep dark grooves and must be replaced. Foil lined the stove and storage shelves and must be removed. A toilet room receptacle was missing its cover.

headline: Failed: no manager on duty; food held too cool
summary: The person in charge lacked a certified food manager certificate, and no certified manager was on duty while TCS foods were served, a citation was issued. Rice, dressing, and yams held at 114.6-118.8F were discarded, about 15 lbs. No internal probe thermometer or sanitizer test kit was on site, and no health policies or food handler training were on file.

headline: Rear freezer too warm; food moved; unit tagged
summary: The rear reach-in freezer measured 48.4F, and TCS foods at 40.2-41.4F were removed to other coolers. The unit was tagged and cannot be used until reinspected by the health department. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints, and leaks and greasy floors were also noted.

headline: Failed: five live roaches; areas told to close
summary: Five live roaches were found in cafeteria areas, including under griddles and near shared mop and dish areas. Management was told to stop operating in those areas, use pest control, and clean. A previous priority violation was not corrected, and a citation was issued. Grease and debris were also noted.

headline: Failed: over 100 mouse droppings; live roaches
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were found throughout the premises, and over 60 more were found on re-inspection. Two live roaches were seen during the first visit and one more on the second. Grime covered equipment, and floors had grease and litter. Previous priority violations were not corrected.

headline: Failed: no manager; cold food too warm
summary: No City-certified food manager was present while chicken at 137F was prepared and served, and a citation was issued. The dish machine had no chlorine at the final rinse. Chicken wings at 62F and other cold foods at 55-59F were found, and the prep cooler was at 58F. Fly strips hung over food areas were ordered removed.

headline: Failed: unlabeled flour; blackened caulking; leaks
summary: Bulk flour was not labeled, and plastic food baskets were used as scoops for cooked meats. Blackened, moldy caulking was at the three-compartment sink, and ceiling tiles were water-damaged. Floor tiles at the ovens were broken, and food handler training proof was missing. Previous violations including a bathroom sink leak were not corrected.

headline: Dishwasher not sanitizing; corrected during inspection
summary: The low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer during inspection, and a citation was issued. The sanitizer company serviced it during the inspection and brought it to 50 ppm. Milk crates were used as shelving, and two employee restrooms lacked covered sanitary napkin bins.

headline: No cooler thermometer; ceiling holes and broken tiles
summary: No thermometer was visible in the front bar reach-in cooler. Holes were found in the ceiling above the rear prep refrigerator, some floor tiles were broken, and floors had dirt and dust buildup.

headline: Missing towels and toilet tissue; holes and gaps
summary: No paper towels were at a washroom sink and no toilet tissue was in a first-floor toilet room; staff got supplies during the inspection. A quarter-inch gap at the rear exit door could let pests in. Missing raw-food advisory asterisks were added during inspection. Holes, missing coving, and missing vents were also noted.

headline: Greasy, debris-covered floor to basement storage
summary: Grease buildup, food debris, and dirt were found on the floor leading to the basement storage area. This was a re-inspection of an earlier canvass.

headline: Women's restroom sink lacks cold water; grease spills
summary: The hand sink in the women's restroom had no cold running water and must be fixed. Grease spills were found on the floor under cooking equipment and must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: no hand sink at bar; hot food too cool
summary: The front bar serves beer in plastic cups but has no hand sink, and a priority citation was issued. Cooked rice, mashed potatoes, and gravy were below 135F and discarded, and a hot holding unit measured 113.0F and was adjusted to 140.2F. Certified food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Unlabeled flour; dusty ceilings; burnt-out bulbs
summary: Flour was stored in an unlabeled large container. Dust was heavy on ceiling vents and ceilings in front of the food prep and rear dishwashing areas, and some light bulbs were burnt out.

headline: Failed: about 50 live fruit flies in storage
summary: About 50 live fruit flies were found in the rear storage area. The manager was told to eliminate insect activity, and pest control service was recommended; a priority citation was issued. Heavy ice buildup was also noted on the walk-in cooler cooling unit.

headline: Food on walk-in floor; ice scoop on ice machine
summary: Food items were stored on the walk-in cooler floor and must be raised six inches off the floor. An ice scoop was on top of the ice machine and must be stored handle-up. Food debris covered cooking equipment and coolers, and an employee washroom door was not self-closing.

headline: Missing thermometers and labels; rear door gap
summary: Cooling units lacked thermometers, and bulk containers on prep area shelves lacked labels. The rear exit door was not rodent-proof, and the splashguard was inadequate next to cooking stations. Working ingredients were stored in front of a hand sink, and the certified food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Failed: 40 mouse droppings; cooler temps too warm
summary: About 40 mouse droppings were on the floor by the basement walk-in cooler and in a cluttered storage room, and more pest control service is needed. Two prep line coolers ran at 44.9-48.9F. A priority citation was issued for no employee health policy, and the kitchen exit door and basement door had gaps.

headline: Failed: about 25 rat droppings in basement
summary: About 25 rat droppings were on the basement storage floor behind the walk-in cooler and under the stairwell. Management was told to clean them up and that more pest control service is needed; a citation was issued. Greasy fryers, walls, and floors were also noted, along with wall cracks and holes to seal.

headline: Dirty floors in both unisex washrooms
summary: Dirt and debris were found on the floor inside both unisex washrooms. The facility must clean and maintain them.

headline: Dishwasher at 0 ppm; food frozen in prep sink
summary: The low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer, was not to be used until fixed, and a citation was issued. Employees were eating and drinking at prep areas and chicken was thawing in a prep sink while still frozen. Floors, shelving, and the exhaust hood were dirty.

headline: Hand sink water too hot; corrected during inspection
summary: The donut room hand sink measured 130.5F, above the 100-120F required range, and a citation was issued. An engineer adjusted it to 104.3F during the inspection. Debris was on the floors in dry storage areas.

headline: Wet mop stored in bucket; training proof missing
summary: A wet mop was stored in a bucket next to the two-door cooler and must be hung to dry. Food handler certificates could not be verified during inspection. No proof of allergen training was on site for the City food manager.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training proof
summary: The City-certified food manager had no proof of allergen training. The manager was instructed to obtain the certificate.

headline: Uncovered raw food; large hole in basement baseboard
summary: Raw animal foods were uncovered in a main kitchen cold holding unit and must be covered to prevent cross-contamination. Mineral buildup was in the corners of an ice machine. A large hole in the basement baseboard by the linen storage must be repaired.

headline: Ice machine buildup; ripped gasket; leaking faucet
summary: Slight buildup was found inside the upper portions and chutes of some ice machines and must be cleaned. A pastry cooler door gasket was ripped, and a grill-side sink faucet leaked. One food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Food on floors; food scoops in standing water
summary: Food, boxes, and sauce buckets were stored on floors, and must be raised six inches. Rice scoops were in standing room-temperature water. Equipment was stored beneath exposed sewage lines in the basement, and trash and broken glass were in a basement closet. Food handler and allergen training certificates were expired.

headline: Food debris and spills throughout facility
summary: Food debris and spills were on floors and surfaces throughout the facility. The person in charge was told to detail clean under shelving, around the sink, and on prep tables and cooking equipment.

headline: No food thermometers on site; sink used for storage
summary: No food temperature measuring devices were on site, and a citation was issued. Dried utensils were stored in a basin of the three-compartment sink, which must be kept free for washing and sanitizing.

headline: Grocery bags used for food; leaking sink
summary: Grocery bags were used for food storage and must be replaced with food-grade bags. A refrigeration unit and freezer had poor gaskets, and the men's washroom sink leaked. Floors, cooler interiors, and storage areas needed cleaning.

headline: Missing hand soap and paper towels; expired certificates
summary: Hand soap and paper towels were missing at several hand sinks, a priority citation was issued. A food handler's certificate and the certified food manager's allergen training had expired. Several repairs and cleaning tasks were also ordered.

headline: No certified manager on duty during TCS prep
summary: The person in charge lacked a City food manager certificate, and no certified manager was on duty while TCS foods were prepared, so a citation was issued. Worn door gaskets, a dirty oven exterior, dusty walls, and cracked light shields and burnt-out lights were also noted.

headline: Stained cutting boards; three expired food handler cards
summary: Stained cutting boards were found in kitchen prep areas and must be resurfaced or replaced. Three food handler certificates on the premises were expired and must be renewed.

headline: No thermometers in coolers; broken ice machine lid
summary: Reach-in and display coolers lacked thermometers inside. Food handlers were preparing food without hair restraints. Milk crates were used as shelving and must be replaced with shelving raised six inches. An ice machine lid was broken.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; debris on many floors
summary: Bulk dry storage containers were not labeled with the product name. Debris was found along walls and corners in sales, prep, storage, dishwashing, and basement areas, and the manager was told to clean.

headline: Soap and towels restocked; cold food discarded
summary: A hand sink had no soap and a broken dispenser, and no paper towels were available, but maintenance and a food handler corrected both during the inspection. Ham at 50.0-52.5F and milk and cream at 44.6F were voluntarily discarded, and milk crates were being used as shelving.

headline: Failed: about 25 small flies; many repairs needed
summary: About 25 small flies were found near the dining room, bar, and rear utility sink; the manager was told to consult pest control, and a citation was issued. Core violations were not corrected, including poor kitchen walls. Other issues included damaged cutting boards, rusty racks, and a cooler held up with bricks.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings; more pest service needed
summary: About 50 mouse droppings were found behind the walk-in freezer and about 15 rat droppings by the rear exit door. Management was told to clean and that additional pest control service is needed; a citation was issued. The prep area hand sink lacked soap, and floors were greasy.

headline: Certified sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. A City of Chicago sanitation manager was found without allergen training. Training must be provided.

headline: Thermometer in reach-in cooler needs replacing
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. The thermometer in the reach-in cooler needs replacing; the operator was instructed to replace it and maintain it.

headline: Chicken thawed in sink; floors need cleaning
summary: Complaint re-inspection, passed. Chicken was observed thawing in the 3-compartment sink. Management was told to thaw TCS foods under cold running water, in a refrigerator, or in a microwave as part of continuous cooking. Floors under equipment, along walls, and in corners need cleaning.

headline: Unused articles; live plants above prep coolers
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. Unused articles and equipment in prep, storage, and walk-in cooler areas must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Live pottery plants above prep coolers were to be removed. No allergen training certificate for the food service manager; instructed to obtain.

headline: Failed: 40 small flies; repeat priority violation
summary: Complaint re-inspection, failed. Previous pest violation not corrected: about 40 small flies in the dish room, near the mop sink, and in the employee bathroom. A priority citation was issued; the violation must be corrected before re-inspection.

headline: Dish machine tagged; fries on freezer floor
summary: Complaint inspection, passed with conditions. Dish machine sanitizer at 0 ppm; tagged and not used until serviced. Staff used the 3-compartment sink. Fries stored on the walk-in freezer floor must be raised six inches. Food debris in the bottom of a reach-in freezer.

headline: Failed: no sanitation certificate; leaks
summary: Canvass inspection, failed. The person in charge lacks a City of Chicago sanitation certificate; no valid certificate posted; citation issued. No pest control logbook on site. Leaks under the 3-compartment sink and at the rear prep faucet, repaired with tape. Heavy grease on wall above prep table; previous core violation not corrected, citation issued.

headline: Burned-out lights; food splatter; damaged wall base
