summary: License inspection, passed. Dried food splatter near the registers must be cleaned. Damaged wall base behind the fryers and in the employee toilet room must be repaired. Burned-out light bulbs in the prep area; lighting must be increased.

headline: Excess rust and leak at fish cooler sink
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. Stored items must be elevated and organized. Grease trap at the fish display cooler area has excessive rust, which must be removed. Dirty rack shelving above the sink must be cleaned. A leak under the 3-compartment sink must be repaired.

headline: Failed: pests, dumpster lids open, leaks
summary: Canvass inspection, failed. About 40 dead flies in the light shields? Noted: outdoor dumpster lids open from overflow, a possible food source for pests, and a priority citation was issued. Also: deep freezer ice buildup, a 3-compartment sink leak, and a greasy hood.

headline: Cooler door, wall hole, and light shield repairs
summary: Re-inspection, passed. Repairs ordered: the left door of the 2-door prep cooler must close properly; a hole in the wall by the 1-door prep cooler and broken floor tiles behind the bar; and a light shield in the basement dishwashing area.

headline: Failed: ice machine debris; ceiling tiles stained
summary: Canvass re-inspection, failed. Debris encrusted inside the ice machine must be removed and the machine serviced. Sticky fly trap rolls hung above the prep area were to be removed. Stained ceiling tiles and dusty washroom vents. Previous core violations (torn cooler gasket and missing grill ventilation) not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings and low hot water
summary: Short-form complaint inspection, failed. Evidence of rodent activity: about 40 mouse droppings throughout the kitchen; a priority citation was issued and pest control is needed. Handsink hot water at 67F, below the 100F minimum. Dish machine lime scale, a leaking drain, and broken cooler doors.

headline: Basement liquor storage floors need cleaning
summary: License re-inspection, passed. Basement liquor storage room floors have dirt and debris and must be cleaned. Items on the floor must be elevated and organized.

headline: Food on walk-in floor; torn freezer gasket
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. Food containers stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler must be moved onto shelving 6 inches off the floor. Dirty wiping cloths on prep tables were not stored in sanitizer. A torn rubber gasket on a refrigeration unit needs repair.

headline: Wiping cloths must air-dry; floors need cleaning
summary: Canvass re-inspection, passed. Wiping cloths not in use must be air-dried; instructed to correct. Floors in the front bar area need cleaning to remove debris.

headline: Food debris on equipment; sink leaking heavily
summary: Complaint inspection, passed. Plastic pallets and milk crates used as shelving must be replaced. Food debris on and under equipment must be removed after each use. Walk-in interior needs detail cleaning. 3-compartment sink leaks; toilet room cleaning and a covered sanitary napkin bin are needed. Floors and walls need repair.

headline: Torn gaskets on all refrigeration units
summary: Canvass re-inspection, passed. All refrigeration unit gaskets are torn and must be replaced. Backflow prevention device on the espresso machine water line could not be located and must be shown to the inspector. Certified food managers must show proof of allergen training.

headline: Low hot water at handsink; hot water restored
summary: Complaint inspection, passed with conditions. Hot water at the meat-area handsink was 60F, below the 100F minimum; a priority citation was issued. Hot water was restored during inspection. No ambient air thermometers on hot food holding units. Dust and ice buildup on walk-in cooler condenser fans.

headline: Failed dishwasher, cold food, and no hand signs
summary: Canvass inspection, passed with conditions. No certified food manager on site; citation issued. Low-temperature dishwasher had 0 ppm sanitizer and was tagged; not to be used. Egg temperatures 56.8-63.5F; about 50 lbs discarded. Two bins and a pot of meat on the floor, and two handlers without hair restraints.

headline: Scoop handle issues fixed on site
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. A plastic cup was used as a scoop in the front prep ice bin; the manager provided a scoop with a handle. A scoop was stored handle-down in ice; the employee placed it handle-up during inspection.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; no operable hood
summary: Re-inspection, passed. Bulk containers were not labeled. A 1/4-inch gap at the front door bottom must be sealed to prevent pests. A reach-in cooler door does not close properly. Debris is around the dumpster. No operable ventilation hood over cooking equipment. No food handler training was provided for employees.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; men's restroom leak
summary: License inspection, passed with conditions. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit or written procedures on site; the management was told to provide them, a priority foundation violation. A faucet at the men's restroom handwashing sink leaks and must be repaired.

headline: Floors need detail cleaning to prevent pests
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. Floors under and around dishwashing machine, cooking equipment, and bar areas have dark stains, dirt, and small debris. Staff were instructed to clean all areas to prevent possible pest or insect activity.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; peeling shelf paint
summary: Complaint inspection, passed. No handwashing signs in the washroom; the person in charge was told to post them. White paint peeling on counter-area shelving; told to repair.

headline: Raw wood shelving and wall cracks to seal
summary: License re-inspection, passed. Raw wooden basement shelving must be painted and sealed to be smooth and cleanable. Open cracks and crevices in basement freezer storage walls must be sealed.

headline: No food handler training proof; wall openings
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. No proof of food handler training or certificates for required employees; proof must be provided. Dirt on dishwashing walls, peeling paint near rear exit, and a few openings behind the ice machine must be sealed.

headline: Rust on shelves; burnt-out light bulb
summary: Re-inspection, passed. Rust on wire racks in the rear cooler and stained cutting boards must be addressed. Floors along walls and corners in the basement storage room need detail cleaning. A burnt-out light bulb near the walk-in freezer and a broken light shield at the front 3-compartment sink must be fixed.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep
summary: Canvass inspection, passed with conditions. No certified manager on premises while TCS foods such as rice and beans were prepared; priority foundation violation. Bulk containers unlabeled, a leaking drain pipe at the 3-compartment sink, and no food allergen training certificates on premises.

headline: Failed: cooked chicken too warm; discarded
summary: Complaint inspection, failed. About 40 lbs of cooked chicken stored in the walk-in cooler at 68.6-78.8F was discarded; citation issued. Raw and cooked TCS foods in bags in old chicken boxes; handler without hair restraint; soiled wiping cloths. Ceiling tiles missing; dim toilet lighting. Previous core violations not corrected.

headline: Failed: handsink blocked by dish drain
summary: Canvass inspection, failed. Prep area handsink was inaccessible; a portable dish drain with cups and containers was stored on it. A priority citation was issued; the manager moved the drain during inspection. Also: unencased waste pipes, a leaking faucet, floor tile damage, and scoops without handles.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; insect device over prep
summary: Canvass re-inspection, passed. Handwashing signs were missing at prep area handsinks. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear hall exterior door must be repaired. A facility-installed insect device over the food prep area must be removed and replaced by licensed pest control service away from food.

headline: Leaking faucets; broken floor tiles
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. Working thermometer needed at the 2-door sauce cooler. Leaking faucet base at the rear 3-compartment sink must be repaired. Exposed front handsink drains slowly. Damaged and broken floor tiles in the rear prep and dishwashing area must be repaired.

headline: Failed dish machine tagged; hole in cooler floor
summary: Canvass inspection, passed with conditions. Low-temperature dish machine in the bar area had 0 ppm sanitizer, versus 50 ppm minimum; the unit was tagged and a priority citation issued. Alternative warewashing was available. A hole in the walk-in cooler floor causes water to pool; peeling paint on shelves.

headline: No sanitation certificate; cardboard on shelves
summary: Canvass inspection, passed with conditions. No valid City of Chicago sanitation certificate; a certified manager must be on site at all times TCS foods are prepared; priority citation issued. Cardboard on dry storage shelving to be removed. The 3-compartment sink needs labels. Washroom fixtures need cleaning; storage room clutter.

headline: Failed: repeat violation; missing employee health policy
summary: Canvass re-inspection, failed. Previous priority violation not corrected: no written employee health policy and an outdated pest control logbook. A citation was issued; must correct before re-inspection. Also: no handwashing signs, wiping cloths in water buckets, and cutting boards with open seams.

headline: Failed: about 40 live flies; repeat pest violation
summary: Complaint re-inspection, failed. A previous pest violation was not corrected. About 40 live small flying insects and 3 house flies were seen on walls and ceilings in several areas. Additional pest control service is needed; a citation was issued.

headline: Failed: rear handsink leaks; no paper towels
summary: Canvass inspection, failed. A rear meat department handsink leaked excessively and was rendered inaccessible; priority citation issued. No paper towels at a produce-area handsink. Food held at 47.8F and 48.4F was discarded. Dirty equipment, undated foods, and expired certification.

headline: Dish machine too cool; ice machine residue
summary: Canvass inspection, failed. Dish machine final rinse at 150F, below the 180F minimum; the operator restored it to 182F during inspection. A priority citation was issued. No splash guard at the handsink, no test kit for bleach sanitizer, and food residue on walk-in shelving.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings, moldy food, cold cooler
summary: Complaint inspection, failed. About 60 mouse droppings in several rear areas; a priority citation was issued and pest service is needed. Moldy cooked ribs were discarded. Walk-in cooler at 66F was tagged. Also: no soap at three handsinks (soap was provided on site), and outer doors were not rodent proof.

headline: Rusty racks and unclean cooler interiors
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. Silverware must be wrapped or reset when seating customers. Rusty rack in the bar cooler, a worn cutting board, and foil needing removal. Three drain stoppers needed for the bar sink. Dirty bar cooler interiors and floors need cleaning. Unused basement cooler in poor repair. Staff without food handler training must complete it.

headline: Dishwasher light bulbs out; dirty fan vents
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. Floor drains in the main kitchen need detail cleaning. A black substance around the rear 3-compartment sink seal must be resealed. The walk-in meat cooler needs detail cleaning, and fan vents in walk-in cooling units need cleaning. Two light bulbs are out under the dishwasher hood.

headline: No certified manager on duty during egg service
summary: Canvass inspection, passed with conditions. No person in charge present at inspection. No certified food manager on duty while eggs and breakfast TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. Inner lining of a machine not clean; a torn refrigeration gasket; and clutter in the storage area.

headline: Failed: dead flies, ice buildup, wall holes
summary: Re-inspection, passed. 200-300 dead small black flies throughout the basement dry storage floor and food boxes; must be removed. Cardboard and foil used as liners, food stored under wastewater pipes, a reach-in freezer with excessive ice buildup, damaged walls and ceilings, and no certified manager with allergen training.

headline: No pest control logbook; food stored on floor
summary: Complaint inspection, failed. No pest control logbook on site; a priority citation was issued and a complete logbook is required before re-inspection. Food containers stored on the walk-in freezer floor must be raised 6 inches. Milk crates used for elevation in dry storage must be replaced with proper shelving.

headline: Ice buildup in dairy walk-in; greasy hood area
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. Ice buildup on non-food-contact surfaces of the dairy walk-in freezer; told to clean. Outdoor waste receptacle soiled with food debris and grease; told to clean. Heavy grease drip near deli hood; told to maintain ventilation.

headline: Failed: no sanitation certificate; cooler too warm
summary: License inspection, failed. No valid City of Chicago sanitation certificate on site; no citation. No written employee health policy. A handsink was not maintained with hot water; no citation. A display cooler at 47.7F was tagged. A 1/2-inch gap at the rear exit door must be sealed. No proof of food handler or allergen training.

headline: No hot water at multiple sinks; citation issued
summary: Canvass re-inspection, failed. Hot water was missing in the meat department. Handsink temperatures were 73.5F and 82.5F, and the 3-compartment sink was 88.3F. Hot water must be at least 100F at handsinks and 110F at the 3-compartment sink. A plumber came, but the issue was not fully resolved. Citation issued.

headline: Damaged data plate; leaking dish sink faucet
summary: Canvass re-inspection, passed. The large low-temperature dish machine's data plate is damaged and must be replaced. The right faucet of the 3-compartment sink in the first-floor dishwashing area is leaking and must be repaired.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; no food handler training
summary: Canvass inspection, failed. No certified manager on site while hot dogs and other TCS foods were prepared; priority citation issued. Broken paper towel dispenser, no chlorine test strips on site, and neither employee had food handler training.

headline: Failed: over 30 mouse droppings; food on floor
summary: Canvass inspection, failed. Over 30 mouse droppings scattered along the wall base behind wire racks; a priority citation was issued and pest control service is needed. Food stored on walk-in floor, cardboard lining on shelves, worn grout near the sink, and certified managers without allergen training.

headline: Missing floor tiles; uncertified manager
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. Food stored in plastic grocery bags in the cooler must be moved to food-grade containers. Missing floor tiles in the prep area and walk-in cooler. Handsinks lack waste receptacles. Dirt on washroom exhaust vents. Certified manager lacks allergen training documentation.

headline: Dirty cooling units and mops improperly stored
summary: Canvass re-inspection, passed. Cooling units in the prep area need cleaning to remove dried food debris. Toilet room plumbing fixtures need cleaning. Soiled mops stored in water and beside shelving in rear prep; they should hang to dry to prevent breeding space for pests.

headline: Dirt and debris in floors and walk-in coolers
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. Dust, dirt, and debris on floors and vents in deli, bakery, meat, and produce areas. Debris on floors in all large walk-in coolers and freezers. A minor leak at the 3-compartment sink in the meat department must be repaired.

headline: No employee health policy on premises
summary: License re-inspection, passed with conditions. No employee health policies on premises; the person in charge was instructed to provide them and documentation of employee duty to report illnesses. Priority foundation violation 7-38-010.

headline: Failed: clogged handsink; food stored in cans
summary: Complaint inspection, failed. A handsink in the kitchen prep area was clogged and not draining. Another was blocked by food containers and a rice cooker; staff removed them during inspection. Heavy grease in the hood. Previous core violations not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Failed: 100+ live flies; fly strips on ceiling
summary: Canvass inspection, failed. About 100 or more live small flies and 3-5 large flies around boxes, walls, and walk-in cooler exteriors. A priority citation was issued and pest control service is recommended. Fly strips hung from prep area ceilings; an ice machine lacks a backflow device; standing water and debris need cleaning.

headline: Failed: coolers too warm; no hot water
summary: License inspection, failed. Deli meat and cheese coolers at 55F and 60F were tagged. No metal stem thermometer on site. No hot water at the washroom handsink or mop sink. No lid on the washroom waste receptacle and no self-closing toilet room door. Scrap wood and trash piled outside the rear exit.

headline: No employee health policy; leaks and disrepair
summary: License re-inspection, passed with conditions. No signed employee health policies or written vomit/diarrhea cleanup procedure on site; priority items, no citation. Leaking bar faucet and a damaged toilet. Excess items on basement floors, large holes in walls, inadequate basement lighting, and a manager without allergen training.

headline: Missing covered trash bin; storage room debris
summary: Canvass re-inspection, passed. No covered receptacle in the women's restroom; one must be provided. Debris and clutter on the floor of the rear storage room where soda bibs are kept must be cleaned.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; sink stoppers and leak
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. No handwashing signs near handsinks in the bar and packing prep areas; must be provided. Working thermometers needed in the sushi and dairy coolers. Missing sink stoppers and a leaking faucet base at the front 3-compartment sink.

headline: No splash guard; no mop drying rack
summary: License inspection, passed. No left splash guard on the front prep area handwashing sink; one must be installed. No mop drying rack was installed; one must be installed to dry mops and prevent pest breeding.

headline: Missing splashguard; no mop sink
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. No splashguard between the 3-compartment sink and the handwashing sink in the front service area; one must be installed. The establishment has no mop or utility sink; one must be installed.

headline: No certified manager; food held over 24 hours
summary: Canvass inspection, passed with conditions. No certified food service manager on site while TCS foods were handled; priority violation. Cooked food held over 24 hours without a discard date was discarded. Unapproved vacuum packaging machine was tagged; no variance. A handler lacked a hair restraint.

headline: Food handlers lack hair restraints; mop in dirty water
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. Food handlers in the food prep area did not wear hair restraints. The ice scoop was stored on the beverage station side. Fryer interiors had grease, dust, and dirt. A loose faucet handle in the women's toilet room. A mop stored in dirty water must be hung to air dry.

headline: Food stored on walk-in floor; unlabeled items
summary: Canvass re-inspection, passed. Food items stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and freezer must be raised 6 inches. Unlabeled food and spices out of original packaging. Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables. Ice scoop stored on top of ice. Unused equipment in basement storage; soiled mop heads not hung to dry.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; insect device placement
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. Handwashing signs were not posted in both restrooms; the operator was told to provide them. A non-toxic insect control device on the prep table near the biscuit oven must be moved away from food. Biscuit dough stored under a condensation line in the walk-in must be relocated.

headline: Ice on walk-in floor; grease near cooking area
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. Ice buildup on the walk-in freezer floor must be removed, cleaned, and maintained. Grease and debris around cooking equipment, floors, and walls must be cleaned. The certified manager on duty has no allergen training; instructed to comply.

headline: Failed: no raw food advisory; dish machine down
summary: Canvass inspection, failed. No consumer advisory on the menu for raw or undercooked items such as the hamburger; a priority violation, no citation. Non-functioning low-temperature dish machine at the bar must be repaired or removed. Certified manager lacks allergen training. A repeat core violation (soap dispenser above basement sink) was not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Failed: roach carcasses; 100+ rodent droppings
summary: Canvass re-inspection, failed. Roach carcasses in the kitchen; the screen door is torn and not insect-proof. Previous priority violation not corrected: more than 100 rodent droppings and 2 live roaches in the basement. A priority citation was issued. Also: no backflow device on coffee machine, toilet room door not self-closing, and clutter.

headline: Leaks at sinks; floor not easily cleanable
summary: Complaint re-inspection, passed. Leaking faucets at a sink and at the 3-compartment sink must be repaired, and a mechanical drain release under the sinks must be fixed. Floor repair in the rear prep area is not yet easily cleanable and must be made smooth.

headline: Boxed food on floors; personal items in prep
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. Boxed food stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and freezer must be raised six inches. Food debris under storage shelves and cooking oil around the deep fryers must be cleaned. Employee personal items stored in prep area. No allergen training certificates on site.

headline: Torn gaskets and leaking hot water valve
summary: Complaint re-inspection, passed. Torn door gaskets on both doors of a 2-door prep cooler must be replaced. The hot water valve at the food prep 3-compartment sink is leaking and must be repaired.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; must be replaced
summary: Re-inspection, passed. Milk crates are being used as shelving in prep and storage areas. They must be removed and replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: No handwashing soap; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Canvass inspection, passed with conditions. No hand soap at the first-floor prep sink or the second-floor bar sink; this was a priority foundation violation and a citation was issued. The certified food manager has no proof of allergen training; the operator was told to provide it.

headline: Failed: handsink water too cool; expired food handler cards
summary: Canvass inspection, failed. Prep area handsink reached only 96F before dropping to 80F; must maintain 100-120F. A priority citation was issued. The bar handsink drains slowly. Expired food handler certificates were on site.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: Complaint inspection, passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while open and operating; a priority citation was issued. No handwashing sign at dishwashing sink, black mold on sink grout, grime in floor drain, and a cracked walk-in freezer floor. Light bulb lacks protective shield above egg patties.

headline: Cutting boards deeply cut; sink faucet leaking
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizing solution when unused. Cutting boards worn with deep cuts, to be replaced. Grease buildup on cooking container sides. Leak at the 3-compartment sink faucet.

headline: Suspension sign removed; citation issued
summary: Complaint re-inspection, passed with conditions. The License Suspended sign posted at the front entrance was missing the next morning and was reposted before re-inspection. A priority citation was issued for removing the sign.

headline: Failed: restroom water too cool; gap at door
summary: Canvass inspection, failed. Restroom washbowl sinks had only 72-80F hot water; the operator was to provide 100F; priority citation issued. A gap at the bottom of the dining room exterior door must be repaired to prevent pest entry.

headline: Failed: employee sink leaking; expired allergen training
summary: Canvass inspection, failed. Employee handwashing sink leaked heavily and was inaccessible; a priority citation was issued. Soiled wiping cloths on prep tables, a foil liner in dishwashing, a torn freezer gasket, and dusty vents. Expired allergen training for certified managers.

headline: Cooler lacks thermometer; ice machine buildup
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. The reach-in cooler under the grill has no thermometer and must be provided. The ice machine has hard water and mineral buildup. A leak at the customer bathroom hot water handle and a leaking bent faucet in the rear prep area must be serviced. One walk-in freezer light is out and the other is very dim.

headline: No handwashing signs; clutter near mop sink
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. No handwashing signs at the food prep handsink or inside the washroom; the operator must provide them. The rear mop sink and storage closet must be detailed, cleaned, and organized, with unnecessary items removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Failed: no raw food advisory; pest entry gap
summary: Canvass inspection, failed. Animal-derived foods that may be undercooked lacked asterisks and a menu disclosure; a priority violation with no citation. An opening at the base of a basement stairwell exit door must be sealed. A grease trap is in poor repair; citation issued. Two food handlers lacked training certificates.

headline: Backflow device must be accessible for service
summary: License re-inspection, passed. A backflow prevention device was not located at the utility mop sink. It must be installed so it can be serviced and maintained.

headline: Failed: no hot water on truck
summary: License inspection, failed. No hot water was available on the truck at the time of inspection. Both hot and cold running water must be available at re-inspection. No citation issued.

headline: Syrup buildup on soda nozzles; ice machine mineral
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. Soda nozzles had syrup buildup on the exterior; the manager was told to clean them. The ice machine had slight mineral buildup; the manager was told to clean it.

headline: No sanitation certificate; no covered trash bin
summary: Canvass inspection, passed with conditions. No valid City of Chicago sanitation certificate posted; a certified manager must be present whenever TCS foods are prepared or served; priority foundation violation. A covered waste receptacle is needed in the 22nd-floor washroom.

headline: Ice machine mineral buildup; toilet room issues
summary: License inspection, passed. Pink mineral buildup inside the rear ice machine must be cleaned. The rear toilet room door needs a self-closing device, and the room needs a lidded trash can.

headline: Failed: cooler at 49.8F; 279 lbs discarded
summary: Complaint inspection, failed. Walk-in cooler at 49.8F; TCS foods above 41F, about 279 lbs (about $1,948) discarded; priority citation issued and unit tagged. Handsink water at 77F, below 100F; no paper towels in men's room. Gap at rear delivery door. Ice buildup and grease throughout, with broken floor tiles.

headline: No hot water at handsink; hair restraint rules
summary: Canvass inspection, passed with conditions. No hot water at the front prep handsink at inspection; hot water was turned on during inspection. A priority citation was issued. Bulk containers unlabeled, employees without hair restraints, wiping cloths stored improperly, items not elevated, and inadequate lighting in the rear storage.

headline: Failed: more than 15 crawling insects in kitchen
summary: Canvass inspection, failed. More than 15 crawling insects were seen in the kitchen; a priority citation was issued. No proof of at least two pest control services in the past year; the most recent report was from 2024; a citation was issued.

headline: Failed: cold food unsafe; no sanitation certificate
summary: Complaint inspection, passed with conditions. Chicken and cheese dressing held at unsafe temperatures; all discarded. A cooler reached 86F and was tagged. Cooked chicken and mashed potatoes held too hot and were discarded. No valid sanitation certificate or food handler training proof; no vomit/diarrhea cleanup procedure. Multiple cleaning items.

headline: Boxes stored on rear storage floor
summary: Complaint inspection, passed. Boxes stored on the floor in the rear storage area; the person in charge was told to raise all items at least six inches off the floor and maintain it.

headline: Failed: slimy ice machine; food dated late
summary: Canvass inspection, failed. Black slimy substance inside the ice machine dripping into ice; the machine must be turned off, ice removed, and cleaned; priority citation issued. Ready-to-eat TCS foods held over 24 hours were not date-marked; citation issued. Certified manager's allergen training is expired.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings, flies, no certified manager
summary: Complaint inspection, failed. No certified manager on site while TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. About 12 live flies and about 100 small rodent droppings in multiple prep and storage areas; a priority citation was issued and pest control is required. Handsinks lacked hand cleanser and were used for storage.

headline: High-temp dish machine leaks onto floor
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. The high-temperature dish machine leaks water onto the floor during the wash cycle; the operator was instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: No sanitation manager on premises with TCS foods
summary: Complaint inspection, passed with conditions. The person in charge has no sanitation manager certificate and must provide one. No City of Chicago sanitation manager was on premises while chicken, beef, and other TCS foods were handled; citation issued.

headline: Ice scoop stored on ice; missing thermometers
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. An ice scoop was stored directly on ice in the freezer and must be stored properly. Missing ambient air thermometers in the display cooler, unlabeled food storage containers, and a food handler without hair or beard restraints.

headline: Torn freezer gasket; mops not air-drying
summary: Canvass inspection, passed. Torn rubber gasket on a compact freezer door must be repaired or replaced. Mops are stored in buckets and must be placed to air dry. The certified food service manager has no allergen training.

headline: Excess trash near refuse area
summary: Passed re-inspection. Inspector found excessive trash beside the building and behind the garbage receptacle. Told to remove all of it and keep the refuse area maintained.

headline: 100+ live flies; unsafe food temperatures
summary: Failed. About 100 or more live small flies found on walls, menu boards and near the dump sink; pest control recommended. Corned beef hash (61°F, should be 135°F or hotter) and sliced turkey (45.7°F) were discarded.

headline: Failed re-inspection; repeat brick violation
summary: Failed re-inspection. Handwashing signs missing in front and rear prep areas; thermometer needed at front prep cooler holding vegetables; slow leak under rear handwashing sink; dirt under refrigeration. Repeat violation from January 2024 not fixed: crumbled brick in basement storage.

headline: Food temperatures unsafe; handwashing supplies missing
summary: Pass with conditions. Cooked chicken wings held at 81.7°F, below the 135°F minimum, and cold foods at 45.9–55.9°F were discarded. Hot holding cabinet ran at 115.9°F, since adjusted. Some sinks lacked soap and hand dryers; soap provided during visit.

headline: No certified manager on site; untrained staff
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while hot dogs and other foods that must be kept hot or cold were prepared. Citation issued. Both employees lacked food handler training. Broken paper towel dispenser also flagged.

headline: Live roaches found; chicken too warm
summary: Failed. Live roaches found: one at soda machine and three in bar area; must be eliminated and affected areas sanitized. Chicken wings at 61.4–63.6°F discarded (about 5 lbs, $65). Drain with black buildup at three-compartment sink must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager while rice, sushi prepared
summary: Pass with conditions. No City-certified manager on site while rice and sushi (foods that must be kept hot or cold) were prepared; citation issued. Also ice machine debris, mop sink lacking backflow device, leaking faucet, and repeat allergen-training violation.

headline: Missing raw-food warning; certificates lacking
summary: Pass with conditions. Menu lacks the required warning for raw or undercooked foods, though steak and eggs are served that way. Several food handlers lack certificates, managers lack allergen training, and the inspection summary isn't posted. Citation issued.

headline: Clutter in basement mop closet
summary: Pass. Clutter in basement mop sink closet; inspector instructed staff to elevate mops, brooms, and dust pans.

headline: Front door opening; handwash sink lacks hot water
summary: Pass. Opening at middle of front double doors must be sealed. Hot water to a right-side handwashing sink in the all-gender washroom was turned off; must be restored. No covered receptacles in washrooms. No allergen training proof for sanitation manager.

headline: Cold foods too warm; cooler tagged on hold
summary: Pass with conditions. Cold foods held at 49.8–55.5°F, including raw eggs and rice noodles; manager discarded about 5 lbs ($10). One-door cold unit ran at 52.2°F and was tagged on hold. Greasy cooking equipment and floors need detail cleaning.

headline: Women's restroom needs covered waste can
summary: Pass. Women's restroom must have a covered wastebasket for feminine hygiene products.

headline: No manager certificate on premises
summary: Pass with conditions. No City food service manager certificate on premises; citation issued. Also: freezer and fryer exteriors need cleaning, dust on washroom fan, and food handler and allergen training needed for new staff.

headline: Handwash water too cool; washroom receptacle missing
summary: Failed. Handwashing sink in dishwashing area provided only 83.3°F water; it must reach 100°F. Priority violation and citation issued. Women's employee washroom also needs a covered receptacle for sanitary products.

headline: Cold food too warm; drain and splashguard issues
summary: Pass with conditions. Tuna at 51.0°F and sliced tomatoes at 48.0°F in sandwich prep cooler were discarded (about 5 lbs, $50). Also: missing splashguard between handwashing sink and prep table, cardboard and foil liners to remove, slow-draining handwash sink.

headline: No certified manager; cooler temperatures unsafe
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified manager on duty while steak, pork, rice and salsa were prepared. Cold foods at 45.5–59.7°F and steak at 74.1°F discarded. Two coolers too warm (45.9°F, 60.9°F) tagged on hold. Also no signed employee health policy.

headline: Sanitizer too strong; hairs in ice machine
summary: Failed. Two hairs found inside coffee station ice machine; must be cleaned. Chlorine sanitizer measured 200 ppm (parts per million), diluted to 100 ppm; citation issued. Also no hair restraints and ceiling tiles covered with foil and tape.

headline: Re-inspection passed; shelving and wall repairs ordered
summary: Passed re-inspection. Told to stop using plastic soda and milk crates for elevation; use raised shelves 6 inches off the floor. Also told to seal wall holes around the rear prep and dishwashing area.

headline: Cold foods too warm; about 100 lbs discarded
summary: Failed. Chicken at 51°F, teriyaki chicken 50°F, sliced tomatoes 46°F, ham 55°F, cheese 57°F, turkey 54°F and beef 52°F were held above 41°F; refrigerator air 54°F. Food discarded (about 100 lbs, $1,000). Repeat violations uncorrected; summary not posted.

headline: Clutter in storage; trash can lacks lid
summary: License inspection passed. Restroom trash receptacle needs a lid; caulk needed at top of wash basin; rear storage clutter must be cleared and items raised 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; $10,000 food discarded
summary: Failed. Cold foods at 51.3–52.1°F; walk-in cooler ran at 50.1°F and is tagged off-limits until city reinspects. About $10,000 of food discarded. Also no metal-stem thermometer, uncovered bulk containers, food on freezer floor, and crates used as shelving.

headline: Wet cloths unstored; expired allergen certificate
summary: Failed. Wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces, ice scoop stored exposed on ice bin, and no handwashing sign at upstairs bar sink. Repeat violations from 2022 not fixed: no lid on women's bathroom trash can, expired allergen training. Citation issued.

headline: No backflow device at ice machine
summary: Pass. No backflow prevention device found at ice machine; one must be installed where it can be serviced and maintained.

headline: Missing sign, insect devices, damaged cooler gasket
summary: Pass. Must post handwashing signage at the dishwashing-area sink, remove hanging insect control devices from the rear prep area, and repair damaged gaskets (door seals) inside the juice prep cooler.

headline: No certified manager while cooking
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager or City certificate on site while foods that must be kept hot or cold were prepared and served. Also: items stored on floors, dirty wiping cloths, leaking faucet, managers lack allergen training.

headline: Mouse droppings found; complaint inspection failed
summary: Failed. About 40 or more mouse droppings found at the drive-thru, service counter, behind the register, above soda boxes and in the rear hallway. Rear door has a gap allowing rodent entry. Pest control service recommended. Citation issued.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; dirty ice machine; clutter
summary: Re-inspection passed. Handwashing signs missing at bar, kitchen, dish room, and both basement sinks. Basement ice machine not clean. Excess clutter in basement storage must be removed. Managers lacked allergen training proof.

headline: Raw wood surfaces; new manager lacks allergen training
summary: Re-inspection passed. Raw wood counter and three-compartment sink wood must be painted or stained. Grease and dust on food ventilation system and filters must be cleaned. New manager has no allergen training certificate on site.

headline: No thermometers inside reach-in coolers
summary: License inspection passed. Reach-in and display coolers lacked visible air thermometers. Instructed to provide easy-to-read thermometers inside all refrigerator units to monitor air temperature.

headline: Condensation dripping in walk-in coolers
summary: Pass. Condensation dripping through broken insulation onto cold lines in two walk-in coolers; repair needed. No handwashing signs in employee restrooms. Incomplete grab-and-go food labels. Food debris near fryer. Managers lack allergen training.

headline: Cardboard under fryer; grease and debris buildup
summary: Pass. Inspector found cardboard lining the floor under the deep fryer and beside a prep table, which must be removed to prevent possible insect breeding. Also found grease and dust on equipment and hood filters needing cleaning.

headline: Dead roaches on sink; door gap; missing signs
summary: Re-inspection passed. Dead roaches on rear handwashing sink must be removed and sanitized. Small gap at bottom of front door must be sealed to keep out rodents. Also leaking pipe causing a foul smell in dry storage.

headline: Food residue in microwave; greasy hood
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Microwave interior needs detail cleaning; debris under dry storage shelves in rear prep area must be cleared; hood filters have grease buildup to clean.

headline: Cold foods too warm; cooler tagged on hold
summary: License passed with conditions. Raw shrimp, tomatoes, pork, tongue, eggs, and beef in prep cooler at 49.6–51.6°F; about 30 lbs ($60) discarded. Cooler at 48.4°F tagged on hold. Also no food handler training for employees, no allergen training for managers.

headline: Overflowing outdoor garbage; no handwash signs
summary: Failed. Outdoor garbage receptacle overflowing with trash and boxes; lids cannot close. Priority citation issued. Also no handwashing signs at prep and dishwashing sinks, black bowls not inverted, and debris behind cooking equipment.

headline: Ice scoop handle touched ice; hair restraint missing
summary: Re-inspection passed. Ice scoop handle was touching ice in the downstairs front prep area ice bin; must be stored properly. One food handler lacked a hair restraint in food prep areas.

headline: Greasy cooking equipment and dirty floors
summary: Pass. Sides of cooking equipment need cleaning to remove grease and food debris. Floors around the three-compartment sink and fryers need cleaning of water and food debris. Hood vent filters need cleaning to remove grease buildup.

headline: Hair restraints missing; outdoor trash area messy
summary: Pass. Food handlers lacked effective hair restraints. Wiping cloths were improperly held and hung on sink splashguard; to-go containers and chemicals stored on floors. Duct tape used on prep oven; rust on grease trap. Outdoor area has excess debris.

headline: Rust, grease, debris, and damaged walls
summary: Re-inspection passed. Must remove rust from produce cooler shelving, clean excessive grease and debris from prep and reach-in coolers and freezers, and repair damaged walls, floors, and ceiling tiles. Dim hood lighting noted.

headline: About 30 live cockroaches; inspection failed
summary: Failed. About 30 live cockroaches found on walls and piping behind and under the three-compartment sink in the rear dishwashing area. Inspector recommended additional pest control service. Priority violation issued. Also: cutting boards scratched, gaskets torn, dirty floors.

headline: Gap at rear exit doors; slow sink drains
summary: Pass. A 1/4-inch gap at rear exit door sweeps must be rodent-proofed. Prep handwashing sink by one-compartment sink drains slowly and front prep sink hot water handle is damaged; must repair.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; torn gasket; ceiling gap
summary: Pass. Bulk containers in rear dry storage lacked labels. Utensils must be stored and inverted handles-up. Torn door gasket on two-door cooler must be replaced. Missing ceiling section over that cooler must be replaced with a smooth, cleanable surface.

headline: Grease and debris buildup; hole in prep table
summary: Re-inspection passed. Inspector found dirt, grease, food debris and standing tea water on floors and lower walls, a risk for pest harboring, and a large hole in a prep table bottom. Told to clean and repair both.

headline: Missing signage, thermometer; door not rodent-proof
summary: Passed. Issues: no handwashing sign at bar sink, missing cooler thermometer, side exit door not rodent-proof, food stored in grocery bags (must switch to food-grade bags), leaking sink faucet, and food handler certificates needed on site.

headline: Milk crates, cardboard, rust, dirty floors
summary: Re-inspection passed. Stop using milk crates to elevate items and tinfoil or cardboard as shelf liners. Shelving is dirty; rusted rack shelving in two coolers must be replaced or resurfaced. Floors under cooking equipment and prep tables need cleaning.

headline: About 30 live fruit flies; failed
summary: Failed. About 30 live fruit flies found under three-compartment sink near floor drain and by an unused ice machine. Pest treatment and removal of unused items required. Also no thermometers inside coolers and freezers. Dirt and debris on kitchen floors.

headline: Dead rodent in office trap
summary: Short-form complaint passed. Small dead rodent found in a trap along the south office wall. Inspector told staff to monitor all traps and remove and maintain them. Missing rear ceiling tiles must be replaced.

headline: No valid manager certificate; items stored in ice
summary: Pass with conditions. No valid original City manager certificate on site; photocopies not allowed. Juice and a mint bag were stored inside ice used for drinks, so that ice was discarded. Bulk rice was unlabeled. Citations issued.

headline: Flour unlabeled; utensils stored in standing water
summary: Pass. Flour unlabeled. Sewer line runs above food storage in basement kitchen; move food or enclose line. Spoons and whisks stored in standing water; disposable plastic spoons used in production; instructed to use durable utensils.

headline: Leaking faucets and drain pipe
summary: Re-inspection passed. Leaking faucets at dishwashing handwashing sink and both utility sinks, plus a leaking drain pipe at three-compartment sink rinse compartment; all must be repaired.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; cardboard shelving; dirty fixtures
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Issues: unlabeled bulk containers, dirty can opener, deeply grooved cutting board, cardboard shelf liners, items on freezer floor, dirty floor drain, and managers lacking allergen training.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; repeat allergen violation
summary: Failed. No vomit clean-up kit on site; kit must include a sanitizer effective against norovirus. No dishwasher temperature-check thermometer on site. Repeat violation: certified managers lack allergen training, flagged in a March 2025 report. Summary not posted.

headline: Brooms stored too close to utensil rack
summary: Pass. Brooms stored too close to clean utensil rack; inspector instructed staff to keep them apart.

headline: No original manager certificate; greasy kitchen
summary: Pass with conditions. Person in charge lacked the original City manager certificate while foods that must be kept hot or cold were handled; ServSafe certificate shown instead. Greasy surfaces, dirty wiping cloths, no ice machine backflow device, no allergen training.

headline: Dishwasher too cool; missing handwash signs
summary: Pass with conditions. Handwashing signs missing at all kitchen and prep hand sinks. Plates, pots, pans and bowls were not inverted after air drying. Dishwasher wash solution at 157°F, below the required 160°F. Citation issued.

headline: Expired certificates, ceiling leak, dirty kitchen
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Found unlabeled stored ingredients, dirty ovens and floors, and stained ceiling tiles suggesting a leak. Cutting boards are deeply cut and stained. Some food handler and manager certificates are expired or missing.

headline: Cardboard and milk crates used; moldy caulk
summary: Pass. Ice scoop at rear ice machine must be kept in clean container when not in use; cardboard boxes and milk crates used for food storage were removed. Paper towels and foil used as shelf liners must stop. Blackened, moldy caulk at three-compartment sink must be replaced.

headline: Dirty floor and standing water behind ice machine
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Floor under and behind the ice machine was unclean with standing water. Inspector ordered the area cleaned and maintained.

headline: No certified manager; warm chicken discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager on site while ready-to-eat foods were prepared and served; manager arrived later. Pre-cooked chicken wings at 70.9°F were discarded. Also: food stored on floors, grease buildup, and cashier lacks food handler training.

headline: Grease splatter on ceiling vents
summary: License re-inspection passed. Grease splatter on the screened ceiling vents in the area marked MFP was ordered cleaned.

headline: Utensils in standing water; damaged cooler gaskets
summary: Pass. Utensils in use were kept in standing water at room temperature; must keep them under running cold water or in a clean dry container. Damaged gaskets (seals) on prep cooler doors must be replaced.

headline: No covered trash can in women's restroom
summary: Passed. No covered receptacle inside the women's toilet room. Inspector instructed the facility to provide one.

headline: Torn cooler gasket held with tape
summary: Re-inspection passed. Torn rubber gasket on service prep cooler was held together with tape. Instructed to repair and maintain it.

headline: Moldy ice machine; over 60 flies; failed
summary: Failed. Mold-like substance inside basement ice machine; ice must be discarded and machine cleaned. Over 60 small flies seen, including in rear of first floor; pest control recommended. Exposed preset utensils on dining tables must be covered.

headline: No certified manager for 40 minutes
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified manager on site from 8:10 to 8:50 AM while chicken and other foods were prepared and served. Citation issued. Food stored on floor in walk-in cooler; no food handler training certificates on site; no allergen certificate.

headline: Clutter near dock door; pest harborage risk
summary: Pass. Clutter stored on floor near receiving dock door in rear storage area; remove unused items and equipment to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Warm baked beans; clutter; inspection failed
summary: Failed. Baked beans at 51.4°F in 2-door cooler; about 3.5 lbs discarded. Ice scoop stored exposed in basement ice bin. Clutter and unused equipment must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Also missing ceiling tiles and burnt-out bulbs.

headline: Handwash sinks too cool; failed inspection
summary: Failed. Second-floor washroom handwashing sinks ran at 93–94.5°F; must reach 100°F. Lid on a first-floor dishroom handwashing sink was removed on site. Water to a three-compartment sink's wash side was off; must be restored. Opening in entrance doors needs sealing.

headline: No manager certificate; food handlers uncertified
summary: Pass with conditions. No City-certified food manager on premises while handling foods that must be kept hot or cold (milk, ham, pastries). Citation issued. Person in charge lacks manager certificate; food handlers lack certificates; manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Loose gasket on prep cooler door
summary: Re-inspection passed. Rubber gasket on the one-door reach-in cooler in the front prep area is loose and not tight-fitting; must be made tight.

headline: Dirty kitchen floors; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Pass. Loose debris, dirt and dust on kitchen floors and corners must be detail cleaned, with cleaning frequency increased. Food service sanitation manager has no food allergen training certificate; must meet requirements.

headline: Standing water and debris; no handwashing signs
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Must remove standing water behind cooking equipment and under the beverage ice machine. Must clean debris throughout, eliminate food-storage crates, add splash guard, post signs in 3rd-floor restrooms, invert utensils, and provide allergen training for all managers.

headline: Food buildup on handwash sinks and wall
summary: Pass. Food buildup on inside and outside of handwashing sinks, especially around water handles; wall behind three-compartment dish sink needs cleaning. Must clean and maintain.

headline: Cold foods too warm; boxes stored on floor
summary: Pass with conditions. Steak, eggs, mole and ham in one-door reach-in cooler at 49.2–50.1°F; about 8 lbs ($50) voluntarily discarded. Boxes of food, cans and oil on floor must be raised 6 inches. Damaged cooler door bracket; leaking hand sink; dusty hood filters; one hood light out.

headline: Gaps in kitchen doors; fryer and vent cleaning
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Gaps of 1/2 inch at rear kitchen door and 1/4 inch at rear door by karaoke area must be sealed to prevent rodent entry. Clean fryer bottoms, floor under fryers, walk-in cooler inside, and hood vents.

headline: No food handler or allergen training proof
summary: Re-inspection passed. No food handler training provided for any food handlers, and no allergen training proof for employees with City certificates. Also rust inside two ice machines must be removed; side exit door opening must be sealed.

headline: Ice machine chute needs cleaning
summary: Passed. Interior of the ice machine chute area needs cleaning. Sponges need more frequent replacement; replace them when worn.

headline: Dipper well unconnected; washroom lacks fan
summary: License inspection passed. Dipper well must be connected to water line. Washroom needs covered trash receptacle and working mechanical fan.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: Pass with conditions. No City-certified food manager certificate on site while foods that must be kept hot or cold were prepared and served. Manager told to keep it on site at all times. Citation issued.

headline: Food stored on floor; dusty washroom vents
summary: Passed. Boxes of food were stored on the floor inside the walk-in cooler freezer and must be raised off the floor. Storage containers not in original packaging must be labeled. Dust on women's washroom vents must be cleaned.

headline: Torn gasket; broken toilets; rusted dumpsters
summary: Pass. Torn gasket on basement walk-in cooler must be repaired. One broken women's washbasin and toilet, and three broken men's urinals, must be repaired or replaced. Dumpsters rusted and cracked at bottom; dust on compressor above two-door cooler.

headline: Unlabeled bulk pasta and rice; allergen training gap
summary: Pass with conditions. Bulk pasta and rice are unlabeled and must be labeled. Repeat violation: three certified managers posted, but only one allergen training certificate on site. Citation issued.

headline: One allergen certificate expired
summary: Pass. One food allergen training certificate has expired and must be updated.

headline: Mop sink needs backflow device
summary: Pass. Mop sink has no backflow device (equipment that keeps dirty water from flowing back into clean water lines); one must be provided and maintained. Manager told to comply with state (IDPH) food handler training requirements.

headline: About 20 dead cockroaches in basement
summary: Re-inspection passed. About 20 dead cockroaches found on basement floor; must be removed and area cleaned and sanitized. Uncut tomatoes stored under stairwell must be moved; ceramic plate used as ice scoop must be replaced.

headline: Cardboard shelving; no utensil temperature device
summary: Failed. Cardboard used as shelving in dry storage must be replaced with smooth, cleanable material. Freezer chest lid broken and must be repaired or replaced. No device to check utensil temperature after sanitizing; citation issued.

headline: Gaps in entry doors; two burned-out ceiling lights
summary: Pass. Inspector found 1/4-inch gaps at both front and rear entrance doors, which must be made rodent-proof. Two burned-out ceiling light bulbs above the prep area by the pizza oven must be replaced.

headline: Grease and food debris on equipment and fryer
summary: Pass. Inspector found grease and food spillage on equipment sides and inside the deep fryer, plus food debris behind the hotline cooking area. Manager told to clean all areas to help prevent possible pests and insects.

headline: Damaged cooler gasket; food handlers lack proof
summary: Pass. Damaged door gasket on two-door meat and vegetable cooler must be repaired. Dust on washroom ceiling vents must be cleaned. Food handlers lacked proof of food handler training and must provide certification.

headline: Excessive food debris in rear prep
summary: Pass. Excessive food debris throughout the rear prep area; instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Hot water inconsistent; menudo labels missing
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Front prep sink lacks steady hot water; repair required. Small menudo containers unlabeled; labels must show identity, net weight, ingredients, business name and address. Water filter must be moved for servicing.

headline: Light rust and clutter in basement
summary: License inspection passed. Light rust on the bottom of the two-door prep cooler must be repainted. Wood, signs and old equipment stored on basement ground must be removed or kept six inches off the floor.

headline: No certified manager; drain floods prep area
summary: Failed. No certified manager on site while tamales (foods that must be kept hot or cold) were prepared; citation issued. No verifiable employee health policy. Washroom sink max 58.9°F; must reach 100–120°F. Floor drain backs up and floods rear prep when three-compartment sink drains.

headline: Slow drain at sink; no mop hangers
summary: License inspection passed. Slow drainage at the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Utility sink lacks mop hangers, which must be installed.

headline: Walk-in cooler failed; food discarded (about $500)
summary: Failed. Cold foods at 51.3–52.1°F... Walk-in cooler ran at 50.3°F; eggs (50.5°F), yogurt (50.2°F) and hummus (49.8°F) were too warm. About $500 of cold food discarded. Cooler tagged and off-limits until city reinspects. Repeat violations from a 2023 report weren't fixed.

headline: Dish machine too cool; unit on hold
summary: Pass with conditions. High-temperature dish machine sanitized at 163°F; final rinse must reach 180°F. Unit tagged on hold until the city reinspects; use three-compartment sink meanwhile. Also elevate boxed food off walk-in freezer floor; clean walk-in shelving; floor repairs needed.

headline: Cooler and sink repairs; cleaning ordered
summary: Pass. Prep cooler interior and fryer exteriors need cleaning; dishwashing-area handwashing sink drains slowly; floors under and around equipment need cleaning. All food managers must obtain allergen training.

headline: No certified manager while open; dead bugs
summary: Pass with conditions. No City-certified food manager on site while open and operating; manager arrived before inspection ended. Citation issued. Also dead bugs on floor, improperly stored cutting boards and forks, missing sink stopper, and clutter.

headline: Unlabeled spices, dirty cutting boards and surfaces
summary: Pass. Inspector found unlabeled seasonings, soiled wiping cloths on prep tables, deeply grooved cutting boards, and grease and debris on equipment, shelves and floors. Mop heads were not hung to prevent insect breeding. Manager told to correct these.

headline: Food residue in coolers; grease on hood filters
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food residue in cold-hold drawers and debris on shelving inside walk-in cooler; grease buildup on hood filters. Person in charge instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Freezer ice buildup; rusty floors
summary: Passed. Chunks of ice had built up in the walk-in freezer and must be defrosted. A lidded trash can is needed at the front line prep area near hand sinks. The walk-in cooler floor is rusty and chipped and must be repaired.

headline: Rat and roach activity; door gaps
summary: Failed. Over 60 rat droppings were found in the crawl space, front, rear, and basement areas. Over 30 mouse droppings were also found. Live roaches were in the rear prep area, and dead roaches were on floors and equipment. Citation issued.

headline: Air drying, scoops, and pipe insulation issues
summary: Passed. Deli cups were not air dried after washing and were used as bulk food scoops. Water mixed with food debris pooled in a door cooler. Cloth rags and exposed wool insulation were found around cold water pipes.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; warm guacamole
summary: Failed. The low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer and was serviced on site, now reading 100 ppm. Guacamole at 52.8°F was discarded, about 5 lbs. No chlorine test kit was available.

headline: Burned light; pest log; ice bin dirty
summary: Failed. The pest control logbook listed reports only from January, May, and November 2024, and must be provided. Food containers were stored on the walk-in and prep floors, and an ice scoop handle touched ice. The ice bin and freezer need cleaning.

headline: Health policy and pest log missing
summary: Failed. No verifiable employee health policy or pest control logbook was on site, and a citation was issued. Slime was building up inside the basement ice machine. A repeat core violation was not corrected: a certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Burnt-out light in accessible stall
summary: Passed on re-inspection. A burnt-out light in the accessible women's toilet stall must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Manager lacks certification; multiple repairs
summary: Failed. The manager on duty had no City food service manager certification, and a citation was issued. Also missing allergen training, a leaking hand sink drain, and a needed splash guard. Walk-in cooler floor and kitchen floors need detailed cleaning.

headline: Chicken held too warm; discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Chicken held at 50 to 55°F in the reach-in cooler, walk-in cooler, and prep area was too warm. The manager voluntarily discarded about 5 lbs, valued at $60. Food must be held at 41°F or below.

headline: Hot water restored; gaps and leaks
summary: Passed with conditions. The customer bathroom sink had no hot water; it was restored to 100°F during inspection, and a citation was issued. Basement exit door gaps over 1/4 inch must be rodent-proofed. Cooler condensation and sink leaks pooled on floors.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; food held warm
summary: Failed. The low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged out of use. About 75 lbs of chicken, shrimp, and fish held above 41°F were discarded. Thawing in a plastic container, food on floors, and no sanitizer test kit were also noted.

headline: Minor sink leak; mop heads
summary: Passed on re-inspection. A minor leak was found at the 3-compartment sink in the dish area and must be repaired. Soiled mop heads were not stored properly and should be hung to dry.

headline: Ice machine in garage must be labeled
summary: Passed with conditions. The ice machine in the rear garage, where a vehicle is kept, must be labeled and used only for non-consumption ice. Pots, pans, and spices stored there were moved during the inspection.

headline: Holes around pipes; greasy floor
summary: Passed. Holes were around pipes in the basement near the floor kettle, and small openings were in ceiling corners. Staff were told to seal them to prevent pests. A greasy floor near the deep fryer must be cleaned.

headline: Dishwasher leak; cleaning and clutter issues
summary: Passed. A leak under the rear dishwasher must be repaired. Clutter in the sushi area must be organized to prevent pest hiding spots, and kitchen floors around cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: Washroom waste bin uncovered; dusty vent
summary: Passed on re-inspection. The all-gender employee washroom waste receptacle was missing its cover. The vent cover above the rear utility sink was heavily soiled with dust and must be cleaned regularly.

headline: Training missing for handlers and manager
summary: Passed. Stained and damaged ceiling areas in kitchen prep were noted. Some food employees had no food handler training, and a certified food manager had no allergen training. The manager was instructed to comply.

headline: Leaks, grease, and dirty walls
summary: Passed. A prep hand sink has leaky faucets that must be repaired. Grease and debris need cleaning from fryer cabinets, freezers, and the grill table. Walls, including the toilet room, need cleaning, and a metal wall panel is in poor repair.

headline: No hot water; no health policy
summary: Failed. No employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure was on site. Hot water was not running at any sink; sinks measured 89.4°F. No door separated the prep area from the washroom, and no backflow device was at the mop sink.

headline: Cold food above safe temperature discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Raw beef at 48.7°F, veggie patty at 53.4°F, and chicken at 47.0°F were too warm. About 60 lbs of food, valued at $260, was discarded. Several certified managers lacked allergen training, and walk-in cooler door gaskets were torn.

headline: Mouse droppings; labeling and grease
summary: Failed. About 40 mouse droppings were found under a storage rack, under the dish machine, near the grease trap, and behind the boiler. Additional pest control service is needed. Containers lacked labels, and grease buildup was throughout.

headline: Moldy storage racks; allergen training
summary: Passed. Food storage racks in the walk-in cooler had mold and food debris and must be removed and deep cleaned. No proof of allergen training was available for certified food managers.

headline: Rodent droppings and holes in basement
summary: Failed. About 40 to 50 large rodent droppings were on the floor of a basement utility closet next to a hole. Holes over 1/2 inch were found in several areas. No signed employee health policies or paper towels were at hand sinks.

headline: Mouse droppings and sliming ice machine
summary: Failed. About 40 to 50 mouse droppings were found in the rear hallway storage room. Black and brown slime was dripping from the ice machine into the ice. Cream cheese, eel, and tofu held too warm were discarded, and no current pest control report was available.

headline: No certified manager during TCS food prep
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food service manager was on site while TCS foods such as chicken and beef were handled, and no certificate was posted. Knives were wedged between coolers, and containers were stored under a hand sink.

headline: No hot water at handwash sinks
summary: Passed with conditions. Hot water at employee bathroom hand sinks measured 84.5 to 93.3°F and was raised to 104 to 106°F during the report. A priority violation was noted, and hot water must be at least 100°F. One of three men's sinks had no running water.

headline: Flies found; raw-food menu advisory missing
summary: Failed. About 50 live small flying insects were on walls and ceiling of the basement prep area and employee washroom; more pest control is needed. Online menu lacked the raw or undercooked food advisory. Expired food handler certificates were not corrected from a prior visit.

headline: Drain grime; missing ceiling tile
summary: Passed. Drains by the 3-compartment sink and dishwasher had a black buildup and must be cleaned. A ceiling tile is missing and a light shield is damaged near the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Leaks, mold, and repeat violations
summary: Failed. Leaks were found from a wall faucet, soda system, and 3-compartment sink. Black mold was on the walk-in freezer wall and door. No allergen training proof was available, and several prior core violations were not corrected.

headline: Live flies and dead flies over prep
summary: Failed. Over 20 large live flies were on walls and shelves in the rear storage and warewashing area. A fly strip hung with dead flies above the warewashing area, and it must be replaced. Leaks, dust, and cracked floor tiles were also noted.

headline: Missing handwash sign in men's room
summary: Passed. A handwashing sign was missing in the men's restroom. Staff were instructed to provide and maintain one.

headline: Front door gap; missing parts
summary: Passed. A top-to-bottom opening was found in the middle of the front double doors and must be sealed to block pests. The ice machine had rust, a utility sink lacks a hot water knob, and ceiling and wall panels are missing.

headline: Broken pizza oven thermometer; wiping cloths
summary: Passed. The built-in thermometer on the pizza hot-holding unit was in poor repair and could not display the temperature. Wiping cloths were left on prep tables and must be stored in sanitizing solution.

headline: Soup and stock held too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. 35 lbs of soup and stock held at 46.8 to 48.7°F were discarded, valued at $550. The stock had been placed in the walk-in cooler a day earlier. Foil liners and wood pallets used as shelving must be removed.

headline: No certified manager; pest log gaps
summary: Failed. Food handlers prepared TCS foods without a certified manager or posted certificate, and a citation was issued. The pest control logbook held reports only through 07/2024. No metal stem thermometer was on site, and prior core violations were not corrected.

headline: Torn cooler door gasket
summary: Passed. A torn rubber gasket was on a prep area cooler door. Staff were instructed to repair or replace it.

headline: Food on floor; dusty ice machine
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Bulk dry food containers were stored directly on the floor in the front and rear areas, and must be stored at least 6 inches up. Milk crates were used to elevate equipment. Ice machine exterior surfaces were dusty.

headline: Health policy missing; plumbing and wall repairs
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy was on site. Cardboard was used as shelf liner, and no service sink was available for mop water. Cold water does not shut off properly at the 3-compartment sink, and walls need repair.

headline: Door gap; uncovered food; knife storage
summary: Passed. A gap greater than 1/4 inch was found between an exterior door and its frame near the garage doors. Cooling tomatoes were uncovered in the rear storage area, and an in-use knife was stored in cardboard between cooler lids.

headline: Rust, dumpster litter, dead lights
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Rust was on shelving in the walk-in prep cooler and must be removed or replaced. Bags and cardboard were on the ground around the dumpster, and non-working hood and dish area lights need repair.

headline: Rat droppings; no pest logs; no manager
summary: Failed. About 60 to 75 rat droppings were along basement shelving and behind the water heater. No pest control logbook or service reports were available. No certified food manager was present while TCS foods were prepared and served, and the person in charge lacked a certificate.

headline: Door sweep gap; cleaning needed
summary: Passed. A small opening at the corner of the rear exit door sweep must be fixed to make the door fully rodent-proof. Fryers, floors, pipes, and floor drains need cleaning.

headline: Many cold foods too warm; cooler tagged
summary: Failed. Cold TCS foods were held at 45.3 to 65.5°F, including quinoa salad, pork, tuna, and potatoes. About 25 lbs valued at $180 was discarded. A two-door cooler at 48.6°F was tagged and must not be used.

headline: Bulk food containers unlabeled
summary: Passed. Bulk food containers were not labeled. Staff were instructed to label and maintain labels.

headline: Dead roaches found; hair restraints
summary: Passed. Numerous dead roaches were on a glue board under a rear reach-in cooler, and staff were told to remove them. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Containers were stored inside a utility sink, and unused items must be removed.

headline: Unlabeled bulk; hair restraints; cleaning
summary: Passed. Bulk food containers need proper labels, and food handlers need hair restraints. Wiping cloths were not in sanitizing solution. A reach-in cooler gasket is damaged, and cooking equipment and floors need cleaning.

headline: Pasta cooling method inadequate
summary: Passed. The method used to cool pasta noodles in the walk-in cooler was inadequate. Food must be left uncovered during the cooling process.

headline: Detail cleaning and expired handler cards
summary: Passed. Pipes, cooking equipment, and hot line areas need detailed cleaning of food and grease buildup. Ceiling dust and hood filters need cleaning. Some food handler certificates were expired and must be renewed.

headline: Cooler off; no soap; no pest log
summary: Failed. A reach-in cooler was not turned on for inspection. No soap was at the hand sink, and no pest control log was on site. Thermometers were missing, customers were not separated from prep areas, and no outside dumpster was provided.

headline: Detail cleaning and wiping cloth storage
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. Oversized equipment, prep tables, floors, walls, and ceilings all need detailed cleaning to remove food spills, flour, and buildup.

headline: Food in plastic bags; no training records
summary: Passed. Frozen chicken, pork, beef, and shrimp were stored in plastic grocery bags in the freezer. Staff were told to use only food-grade bags and containers. No covered receptacle was in the unisex toilet, and no food handler training proof was available.

headline: Potatoes stored on floor
summary: Passed. Potatoes were stored on the floor in the storage area. Staff were told to store food at least six inches off the floor on raised shelving.

headline: Wet mop on floor; low lighting
summary: Passed. A wet mop was stored on the floor in the utility area and must be hung to dry. Lighting was very low inside the walk-in cooler and in the upstairs women's restroom.

headline: No manager; sink blocked and unsupplied
summary: Failed. No valid certified food manager was on site while eggs and chicken were prepped, and a citation was issued. An exposed front hand sink was blocked by a table and supplies, and lacked soap and paper towels. The 3-compartment sink leaked when drained.

headline: Mouse droppings and a warm display cooler
summary: Failed. About 22 small rodent droppings were in the rear storage area and under chip racks in front. Staff must remove them and eliminate the pest activity. A grocery display cooler ran above safe temperature and must be repaired to 41°F or below.

headline: Mouse droppings and spoiled deli meats
summary: Failed. Over 100 mouse droppings were found behind equipment and under shelves. About 20 lbs of deli meats and cheese with foul odor, slime, and green or black discoloration were discarded. Missing thermometer, chlorine test kit, and training records were also noted.

headline: Food stored in ice; reused grocery bags
summary: Passed. Shrimp was stored in direct contact with ice in a prep cooler, and a milk carton was stored in the ice machine. Single-use grocery bags were reused for lettuce and greens. Staff were told to stop both practices.

headline: Mouse droppings; cold food discarded
summary: Failed. Over 200 mouse droppings were found on shelves, outlets, bulk containers, and floors. Dead mice and roaches were on glue boards, and flying insects were in the men's washroom. Cold food above 41°F was discarded, and a cooler at 60.2°F was tagged out of use.

headline: Washroom lacks covered sanitary napkin bin
summary: Passed. The all-gender washroom had no covered receptacle for disposing of sanitary napkins. The facility was instructed to provide one.

headline: No certified manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No City certified food manager was on site while deli meats, cheese, and salads were prepared, and a citation was issued. Walk-in shelving is rusted, a hole under the sink must be sealed, and mops were not properly stored.

headline: Missing training certificates; cooler doors torn
summary: Passed. No food handler training certificates were on site for any employee, and the manager lacked allergen training. A reach-in cooler had torn, dislodged doors that stay propped open. Scoops were left with handles in ice, and items were stored on the basement floor.

headline: Food stored in single-use garbage bags
summary: Passed. Frozen meat was stored in single-use garbage bags in the chest freezer, and cabbage was stored the same way in the rear prep area. Staff were told to use food-grade bags or containers only.

headline: Food on floors; splashguard and cleaning needed
summary: Passed. Food was stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer, prep, and storage areas. Milk crates were used as shelving, and a splashguard was missing near the hand sink. Freezer ice buildup and floor spills need cleaning.

headline: Leaking sink pipes need repair
summary: Passed on re-inspection. The middle drain pipe under the 3-compartment sink and the pipe at the bar hand sink are both leaking. Repairs are required.

headline: Worn cutting boards and ventilation repairs
summary: Passed. Meat prep cutting boards had deep, dark grooves and must be repaired or replaced. Unused equipment outside was to be removed, and the toilet room ventilation needs repair.

headline: No valid certificate posted; no health policy
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid City food sanitation certificate was posted on site, and a citation was issued. No written employee health policy was on site. Reach-in cooler ice buildup must be cleaned, and ceiling tile panels are missing.

headline: Door gap; food debris; allergen certificate expired
summary: Passed. A gap at the bottom right of the back door to the outside must be fixed with a new door sweep. Food debris was found between cold-holding prep stations. One person's allergen certificate had expired.

headline: Time-control food too warm; discarded
summary: Failed. Several TCS foods on the front counter were at 60 to 82°F with no time-as-control records. About 30 lbs valued at $300 was discarded. Food was stored on floors, and prior core violations were not corrected.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; allergen training
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Bulk food containers, including rice and beans, had no labels and must be labeled. A sanitation manager had no allergen training and must be trained.

headline: Torn gaskets, missing ceiling panels, debris
summary: Passed. Unfinished wood shelving, torn freezer gaskets, and missing ceiling panels above the walk-in freezer were noted. Food debris was on floors under and behind cooking equipment, and unnecessary boxes and bags were stored near the office.

headline: Grill grease; slow drain; floor spill
summary: Passed. Grease and slight food debris were under the flat-top grill in the front prep area. The hand sink beside the 3-compartment sink drains slowly and needs repair. Dried spillage was on the walk-in cooler floor.

headline: Drinks on prep table; uncertified handlers
summary: Passed. Open employee drink cups were kept on a prep table. Employees' personal clothing was stored on the utensil shelf. Several food handlers lacked food handler certificates and were told to obtain them.

headline: Missing signage, holes, no washroom ventilation
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs were missing at several sinks. Holes in kitchen, basement, and wall areas need smooth repair, and both washrooms lack mechanical ventilation. Ice bins need covers, and some shelves are rusted.

headline: Leaking faucet at sink
summary: Passed. The base of the faucet at the 3-compartment sink was leaking. The manager was instructed to repair it.

headline: Rust, debris, and standing water
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Prep table shelving is rusted and must be resurfaced. Equipment and shelving in the rear prep area need cleaning of dried food debris, and standing water was under cooling units.

headline: Cold food too warm; pest log missing
