summary: Failed. Pizza prep cooler items were 47.8 to 52.8°F; about 15 lbs were discarded and the unit was tagged. No written employee health policy, and the rear prep hand sink was blocked. No pest control logbook was on site.

headline: Foil used as cooking equipment liner
summary: Passed. Aluminum foil was being used as a liner on cooking equipment in the kitchen. Staff were told to remove it so surfaces stay smooth and easy to clean.

headline: No hand sink in toilet room; sewage backup
summary: Failed. The rear toilet room had no hand sink, and a citation was issued. Sewage backed up from a floor drain under the 3-compartment sink; a plumber fixed it on site. The toilet room had no light, and no food handler certificates were on site.

headline: No backflow device on espresso machine
summary: Passed on re-inspection. No backflow prevention device was found for the espresso coffee machine at the counter areas. One must be provided where it can be located and serviced.

headline: Foil shelf liners; floor buildup
summary: Passed on complaint. Aluminum foil was used to cover prep area shelves and must be removed so surfaces stay easy to clean. Food buildup was on floors in the dining room, prep area, and storage room.

headline: Flies, rat droppings, and slime; discarded
summary: Failed. About 60 or more live small flies were in several rooms, and about 75 or more rat droppings were on basement and dish area floors. Dead roaches were found near a walk-in cooler. Pink and black slime was dripping from the ice machine onto ice.

headline: Health policy, drain backup, trash, repairs
summary: Failed. No signed employee health policies or vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure were on site. The 3-compartment sink floor drain backed up and overflowed. A large amount of trash, including tires and furniture, was outside, and no hot holding unit was for sandwich meats.

headline: No manager on site; bare-hand contact
summary: Failed. No person in charge was on site at the start, and no City certified manager was present while eggs and beef were served. A food handler sliced ready-to-eat avocado with bare hands. An overflowing dumpster and missing hand soap were also noted.

headline: Wall holes and light shields missing
summary: Passed. Holes in the wall above the 3-compartment sink must be sealed. The rear exit door frame is damaged and must be repaired. Light shields are missing above the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Rear door gap; dirty floors and vents
summary: Passed. The rear exit door was in poor repair, with a gap between the doors that must be fixed to block pest entry. Floors along walls and corners need cleaning, and vents in the front prep area were dirty.

headline: Mobile unit license number incorrect
summary: Failed. Bulk containers lacked common-name labels, and a hood light was missing. A prior core violation was not corrected: the vehicle displayed the wrong license number. The correct 4405 mobile food license number must be shown on both sides.

headline: Unapproved vacuum packaging; food tagged
summary: Passed with conditions. The business had no variance or HACCP plan for its vacuum packaging machine, which was tagged. About 10 lbs of saffron sauce, valued at $50, was found in the walk-in cooler and was also tagged. A citation was issued.

headline: Chipped paint in prep area
summary: Passed. Paint was chipped on walls in the rear prep area near the ice machine. Staff were instructed to resurface and repaint so walls are sealed and easy to clean.

headline: Knives stored behind piping
summary: Passed. Knives were stored behind electrical piping near the 3-compartment sink. Staff were instructed to store them in a knife rack.

headline: Rodent droppings and flies; food too warm
summary: Failed. Cold TCS food was held at 60°F and 47°F, and about 10 lbs of chicken and 5 lbs of lettuce were discarded. More than 20 rodent droppings were near the mop sink, and more than 20 small flies were throughout the facility.

headline: Dirty coolers; missing floor tiles
summary: Failed. Food debris was found in reach-in coolers, gaskets, and prep shelving. There was no covered trash receptacle in the women's washroom. Broken and missing floor tiles from a prior visit were not corrected, and no food handler certificate was provided.

headline: Certified manager absent during TCS food handling
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food service manager was on site while milk and other TCS foods were handled, and a priority violation was noted. Staff were told not to use cloth towels to dry utensils.

headline: Leak below 3-compartment sink
summary: Passed. Water was dripping onto the pipe below the 3-compartment sink. The leak must be repaired.

headline: Non-closing door; thermometers needed
summary: Passed. Thermometers were needed for cold-holding equipment. The toilet room door was not self-closing. A baseboard below the rear utility sink was detached, and a hole around piping must be enclosed.

headline: Flies and ants found; labels missing
summary: Failed. About 20 live small flies were on the ceiling and shelves in the dishwashing area, and about 5 live ants were in the bar area. Pest control service was recommended. Prepackaged desserts lacked required labels, and some male food handlers had beards without guards.

headline: Grease, stained cutting board, dusty vents
summary: Passed. A yellow-stained cutting board with deep grooves must be replaced. Grease and debris under the flattop and inside a cold prep cooler need detailed cleaning, and air vents throughout had heavy dust buildup.

headline: Minor cleaning and repair items; passed
summary: Passed. Caulking around the rear hand sink had excessive black buildup and was ordered cleaned. A loose floor drain cover at the rear floor drain must be secured and repaired.

headline: Crates used for elevation; litter outside
summary: Passed. Plastic soda crates and milk crates were used for elevation in the rear prep area and in the front utensil cabinet. Staff were told to stop this practice. Litter on the ground near the dumpster area must be cleaned.

headline: No manager certificate or health policy
summary: Failed. The person in charge had no certified food manager certificate, and none was posted. No signed employee health policies or vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure were on site. A gap under the front door must be sealed, and wall-to-floor gaps need sealing.

headline: Manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. One food manager did not have a food allergen training certificate. Staff were told all City certified food managers must have one.

headline: Missing handwash signs; metal tube on faucet
summary: Handwash signs are missing at toilet room sinks. A metal tube on the rear handwash sink faucet contacts hands during handwashing and must be removed. The frozen slush cabinet and whip cream cooler need cleaning, and receptacle covers are missing.

headline: No vomit procedure, pest logbook, or cooler thermometers
summary: No written vomit and diarrhea procedure or supplies were available. About four cooling units are in disrepair and not at 41°F or below. No pest control logbook or service agreement on site. Missing ceiling tiles and damaged walls.

headline: Sewer lines above food areas not shielded
summary: Sewer lines above the three-compartment sink and in the basement prep area are not shielded. Food may not be stored under them without protection. Utensils were kept in stagnant water, and a minor leak was found at the basement sink.

headline: Equipment stored on floor; leaking sprayer
summary: Food service and reheating equipment stored on the front storage floor must be elevated six inches. The three-compartment sink sprayer leaks regardless of water flow. A hole in the wall and heavy grease on the prep floor must be repaired and cleaned.

headline: Wet wiping cloths and missing allergen training proof
summary: Wet wiping cloths were left on barista station counters; staff were told to store them in sanitizer. A wet mop was stored in its bucket. No proof of allergen training for the city food manager was on site.

headline: Freezer must be locked; food stored in garbage bags
summary: A common-area freezer near the toilet rooms must be locked when not in use to prevent tampering. Food was stored in garbage bags in the freezer, and only food-grade bags are allowed. Several coolers have rusted interior racks.

headline: Ice on freezer cooling lines; missing tile grout
summary: Ice buildup was found on walk-in freezer cooling lines and must be removed. Grout is missing from first-floor kitchen tiles and must be replaced.

headline: Uncovered food on floor; leaks; flooded basement floor
summary: Food items were left uncovered and stored on the floor. A pipe leak under the three-compartment sink flooded the floor. Basement floors under the dishmachine are damaged and hold standing water. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Handwashing lapse; slimy ice machine; food at 72°F
summary: A food handler skipped handwashing before making a sandwich; citation issued. Ice machine interior had black and blue slimy buildup dripping into ice; it was held for inspection. About 20 pounds of cooked chicken at 72°F was discarded.

headline: Ice machine lacks backflow prevention device
summary: Inspector saw no backflow prevention device on the ice machine's water intake line. The restaurant must install one and keep it maintained.

headline: Opening under front door; bar floor buildup
summary: An opening at the base of the outer front entrance door must be sealed to prevent pests. Buildup on the bar floor and wall bases must be cleaned. One employee with a food sanitation certificate lacked allergen training.

headline: No employee health policy or food handler training
summary: No employee health policy or food handler training was found, and the certified manager lacked allergen training. A drain under a washroom sink leaks, and raw wood surfaces and outside debris need correction.

headline: Broken floor tiles; restrooms lack ventilation
summary: Broken floor tiles were found in the rear prep kitchen and must be repaired. Employee restrooms have no ventilation, and the owner was instructed to provide it.

headline: Missing hand sink sign; floors need deep cleaning
summary: The rear dishwashing and prep hand sink lacks a handwashing sign. The microwave interior needs cleaning, and floors throughout need deep cleaning. Hot water closet is cluttered with broken cardboard boxes on the floor.

headline: Dishmachine not sanitizing; tagged; date labels missing
summary: Low-temperature dishmachine showed 0 ppm chlorine sanitizer, so it was tagged and must not be used until repaired. Ready-to-eat TCS foods held over 24 hours lacked date marks; citation issued.

headline: Food on floors; milk crates and cardboard used
summary: Food containers were stored on floors in dish, dry storage and staff restroom areas. Milk crates are used as shelving and must be replaced with shelving six inches off the floor. Broken base tiles, damaged ceiling tiles, and food debris were noted.

headline: Front door gap; utility mop sink needed
summary: The front entrance door has a one-inch gap across the top and must be made tight-fitting to prevent pests. A utility mop sink with hot and cold water and a backflow device must be installed. The washroom door must self-close.

headline: Sink valves leak; storage racks and floors dirty
summary: A leak at the valves under the three-compartment sink's sanitizing compartment must be repaired. Walk-in cooler storage racks have stains and food debris. Floors in corners, under racks, and inside coolers have dirt and debris.

headline: Cardboard used for missing restroom ceiling tiles
summary: Cardboard is used in place of missing ceiling tiles in the customer restroom and must be replaced with proper tiles. A prep hand sink drains slowly. Grease and food debris were found behind cooking equipment and on walk-in floors.

headline: Mouse droppings found; door gaps and repairs needed
summary: About 20 or more mouse droppings found under a radiator, on a wood block, and under a display unit. Front door has a missing mail slot and gaps. Pest control service recommended. Several repairs and upkeep items also noted.

headline: No posted sanitation certificate; dishmachine at 0 ppm
summary: No valid City of Chicago food service sanitation certificate was posted on site; citation issued. The low-temperature dishmachine showed 0 ppm chlorine and was not sanitizing. It was tagged and must not be used until reinspected.

headline: Hand sink blocked; utensils stored improperly
summary: A front prep hand sink was blocked by a spice cart, dish cart and boxes of oil; citation issued. Scoops were left with handles in food, and a cooler door gasket is missing. A floor drain cover is loose.

headline: Pest logbook incomplete; drain backup floods kitchen
summary: A pest control receipt lacked the required IDPH license number, and the logbook must include all required records; citation issued. A clogged floor drain backed up and flooded the kitchen floor; citation issued. Torn freezer gasket and debris in walk-in freezer.

headline: Cooler door gap, grease trap odor, and mold noted
summary: A gap at the beer walk-in cooler's exterior door must be sealed. A foul odor from the floor grease trap must be cleaned. Also noted: unlabeled containers, mold at bar faucets, a leaking meter, and a floor hole.

headline: Worn cutting boards and greasy equipment noted
summary: Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizer when unused. Cutting boards were worn, discolored or deeply cut. Fryers, cooking equipment and cooler interiors had grease and debris. Floors and hood vents need detail cleaning.

headline: Dishmachine at 0 ppm; cooler food at 49 to 55°F
summary: The low-temperature dishmachine was not sanitizing (0 ppm) and was tagged. Food in a two-door cooler measured 49 to 55°F and was discarded. A rear prep cooling unit at 52°F was tagged. Torn chest freezer lid also noted.

headline: Undated prepared foods discarded; trash overflowing
summary: About 20 pounds of prepared TCS foods lacked date labels, including hummus, sauces, cooked lamb and chicken; all were discarded. The outside dumpster overflowed with garbage, and citation issued. Soiled linens and dirty floors also noted.

headline: Parking lot door not rodent-proof; ceiling tiles stained
summary: The parking lot door has a half-inch gap under the outer door and a half-inch gap between the inner double doors. Water-stained ceiling tiles in the prep area and a missing wall base under the sink also noted.

headline: No certified manager on duty; door gap; boxes on floor
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while fried chicken and fish were served; manager arrived at 3:10 p.m.; citation issued. Also: a gap under the front door, boxes of chicken stored on the cooler floor, a missing summary report, and an overflowing dumpster.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No certified food service manager was on site, and no certificate was posted while chicken and rice were handled and served. Priority violation; the manager was instructed to obtain one.

headline: No certified manager on duty during food prep
summary: No valid certified manager was on duty while chicken, beans and rice were prepared; citation issued. Cooking equipment needs detail cleaning, rear prep floors need regrouting, the hood vent needs cleaning, and a sink faucet leaks.

headline: Candy on floor; grease and ice machine residue
summary: Candy was stored on the floor behind the front counter and must be raised six inches. Residue was found inside the ice machine. Grease buildup is on cooking equipment, coolers and shelving. A utility sink lacks a backflow device.

headline: Rear door gap; boxes on basement floor
summary: An opening at the base of the rear exit door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Boxes and equipment stored on the basement floor must be raised at least six inches. A mop was drying in its bucket, and the manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Leaking hand sink; dusty ceiling and dirty floors
summary: The exposed hand sink in the dish area leaks and must be repaired. Heavy dust is on ceiling tiles and light shields on the selling floor. Floors in storage, dish and selling areas need cleaning, and prep coolers need interior cleaning.

headline: Dishmachine floor cleaned on site
summary: The floor under the dishmachine was cleaned on site as instructed. Light dust inside the vent above the large dishmachine must also be cleaned.

headline: Missing hair restraints and food handler training
summary: A loose wall panel outside the toilet rooms must be repaired. Debris, grease and water are on floors and drains, and hood filters need cleaning. Previous violations were not corrected, including missing hair restraints and food handler training; citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; no hot water at washroom sink
summary: No certified food sanitation manager was on site while beef was prepared and served; citation issued. The washroom hand sink lacks hot or cold water and handwashing signs are missing. A multi-use pot is stored in the washroom; floors have debris.

headline: Low water pressure; new bar sink required
summary: Low water pressure at the hand sink in the 56th floor pantry must be repaired. A bar on the 57th floor needs a handwashing sink with hot and cold water, soap and towels, plus a dump sink, before serving open liquor.

headline: Cutting boards damaged; restroom receptacles uncovered
summary: Cutting boards in the rear prep area have open seams and dark stains and must be refinished or replaced. All women's washroom receptacles lack covers. Grease, debris and dirt are on floors under equipment, and fans and vents are dusty.

headline: No certified manager; about 40 small flies
summary: No certified food service manager was on premises; citation issued. About 40 small flies were found throughout the facility, and pest control is recommended. An eastside bar ice bin lacks a cover, and a women's washroom sink is not working.

headline: No certified manager; mold in ice machine
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken, eggs and milk were prepared; citation issued. No employee health policy and no soap or paper towels at hand sinks. Mold-like substance in the ice machine; dishmachine not reaching 180°F.

headline: Open windows need screens; dirty ice machine
summary: Open windows need screens. Bulk dry goods must be stored in labeled containers, not open bags. The ice machine interior needs detail cleaning. Cutting boards have dark spots and cuts, and the hood and basement floors need deep cleaning.

headline: No health policy; overflowing waste oil container
summary: No employee health policy with signed acknowledgments was provided; citation issued. Wiping cloths on prep tables were not stored in sanitizer. The waste oil container is overflowing with trash; citation issued. Rusted racks and stained ceiling tiles also noted.

headline: Overflowing outside dumpster; rodent risk; citation issued
summary: Outside dumpster was overflowing and its lid would not close, creating harborage and a food source for rodents and other pests. Citation issued. Dirt and debris found on rear prep floor drains.

headline: Prep cooler thermometers and hood cleaning needed
summary: Working thermometers must be provided and maintained inside prep coolers. Prep area floors need cleaning of debris and spills. The hood and filters above cooking equipment need cleaning of dust and grease.

headline: No employee health policy on site
summary: No employee health policy was on site at the time of inspection. A verification of the policy for each employee must be on site at all times. No citation was issued.

headline: Torn gasket in prep cooler
summary: A torn rubber gasket was found inside the kitchen prep service cooler. The person in charge was instructed to repair or replace it.

headline: Dishmachine at 0 ppm; manager corrected sanitizer on site
summary: The low-temperature dishmachine was not sanitizing (0 ppm) because the sanitizer container was empty. The manager replaced it during inspection; citation issued. Torn gaskets, unlabeled food, and previous violations were also noted.

headline: Damaged cooler gasket and rear wall damage
summary: A loose, damaged gasket on a two-door cold holding unit in the rear prep area must be repaired. Damaged wall near the rear restroom must be repaired so it is smooth and cleanable.

headline: Cooler food at 44.8 to 45.9°F; 145 pounds discarded
summary: Potatoes, aioli, tomatoes, cheeses and other TCS foods in walk-in cooler #M held at 44.8 to 45.9°F. All were discarded, 145 pounds valued at $600. Ice machine interior has slight buildup, and hood filters need cleaning.

headline: Basement door gaps; hot water below required temperature
summary: The basement alley door has gaps at the bottom right corner that must be sealed against pests. Hot water measured 59 to 83°F, below the required 100°F at hand sinks and 110°F at the three-compartment sink.

headline: Basement hand sink cabinet in poor repair
summary: The cabinet for the basement staff restroom hand sink is in poor repair. The person in charge was told to replace or repair it.

headline: Dirt and debris behind basement freezers
summary: Buildup of dirt, dust and debris was found behind the deep freezers in the basement. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain all areas as needed.

headline: Rat droppings in basement; no certified manager
summary: About 100 or more rat droppings were found in the basement among clutter; pest control service required. No certified manager was on duty until 4:00 p.m. Hot water was absent at hand sinks and the three-compartment sink.

headline: Incomplete vomit kit; unlabeled seasonings
summary: The vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit was incomplete, and a written procedure is required. Seasonings were out of original containers without labels. Soiled wiping cloths and mop heads, and no covered receptacle in the women's restroom.

headline: Four live cockroaches found under sink
summary: Four live cockroaches were on the floor around a drain under the three-compartment sink; citation issued. The person in charge must remove them and keep the premises pest-free, and more pest control is recommended. Also noted: missing handwashing sign and dirty floors.

headline: About 25 mouse droppings in basement
summary: About 25 mouse droppings were found on the basement dry storage floor; citation issued. Additional pest control service is needed. Also noted: unlabeled containers, milk crates and cardboard used as shelving, greasy surfaces, and damaged floor tiles.

headline: Single-service items stored on floor
summary: Single-service articles were not inverted and were stored on the floor. They must be inverted and elevated. No waste receptacles are at handwashing sinks in prep and dishwashing areas.

headline: Island bar lacks handwashing sink
summary: A separate island bar area has no handwashing sink. The area is closed for the season, and the sink must be installed before it reopens. Citation issued.

headline: Missing or expired food handler and allergen training
summary: Food handler training was missing or expired for employees, and allergen training was missing or expired for food managers. Also noted: a slow drain, a damaged bulk container lid, worn cutting boards, and stained ceiling tiles.

headline: Worn gaskets and leaking faucet at dish sink
summary: Worn door gaskets on a one-door freezer and a three-door prep cooler must be repaired or replaced. The three-compartment sink faucet leaks. Multi-use utensils must be inverted, and stained ceiling tiles and a damaged lobby wall need repair.

headline: Over 30 mouse droppings; no sink test kit
summary: About 30 or more mouse droppings were found on dry food storage shelves, outlets, a wall hole near the grease trap, and the front prep floor. They must be removed and pest control is recommended. No chemical test kit at the three-compartment sink.

headline: No certified manager; hand sinks obstructed
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while TCS foods were handled; priority violation. Front and rear prep hand sinks were blocked by bags and a stool. The rear prep hand sink had no soap; the manager was instructed to provide it.

headline: Cooler food at 45 to 48°F; 30 pounds discarded
summary: Sandwiches, wraps and bites in a prep cooler held at 45 to 48°F; about 30 pounds were discarded. Shellstock tags lacked last-sold dates; citation issued. A construction dumpster holding food lacks a tight lid. Debris under prep coolers.

headline: Linens touched crab legs; scoop in stagnant water
summary: Linens were stored in direct contact with crab legs in a seafood drawer, and the employee was told to stop. An ice cream scoop was kept in stagnant water. Unlabeled containers and a worn refrigerator gasket also noted.

headline: Slimy buildup in ice machine; ice discarded
summary: Black, slimy buildup was found on ice machine food-contact surfaces. The person in charge discarded all ice and cleaned the machine during inspection. Citation issued. Also: no thermometer in a cooler; Styrofoam cups used as scoops.

headline: Ice maker has mildew-like film inside
summary: A light film of mildew-like buildup was found on interior surfaces of the ice maker. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Sink stopper won't hold water; repeat violation
summary: The built-in stopper at the three-compartment sink rinse basin cannot hold water. A previous priority violation was not corrected. The manager was instructed to comply; citation issued.

headline: Slow restroom hand sink; floor needs cleaning
summary: The restroom hand sink must be adjusted to run at least 15 to 20 seconds for proper handwashing. The floor beside the main kitchen ice machine needs detail cleaning.

headline: Food on basement floor; green standing water
summary: Food was stored on the floor of the basement walk-in cooler and must be six inches off the floor. Standing green water is under the basement sink. Heavy grease is on an electrical box. Black mold-like substance in the basement ice machine; citation issued.

headline: Food storage, splash guards and leaks need fixing
summary: Basement freezer food must be raised off the floor to prevent cross-contamination. Splash guards are needed at a drain board and loose ones at hand sinks. Ice machine panels need cleaning, and two pipes need repair.

headline: Dripping black buildup in ice machine; no health policy
summary: Black and brown buildup in the rear ice machine dripped onto ice used for drinks; staff were told to remove the ice and deep clean. No written employee health policy, menu consumer advisory missing, and citation issued.

headline: Foods too warm; mouse droppings and fruit flies found
summary: Lamb, shrimp, chicken and tomatoes were held at 56 to 80°F; 22 pounds discarded. Over 40 mouse droppings and 15 or more fruit flies found. Front door gap allows rodents. Pest service required; citation issued.

headline: No certified manager on site; leaking sinks
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken, beef and fish were prepared and served; citation issued. The dishmachine data plate is not visible. A rear prep sink faucet is in disrepair, and the three-compartment sink leaks.

headline: Floor buildup and greasy ventilation filters
summary: Buildup was found on the floor under shelving in the rear storage area and must be cleaned. Grease buildup is on the ventilation filters and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Missing paper towels; flies and live roach found
summary: Paper towels were missing at handwashing sinks; they were provided on request. About 15 small flies and one live roach were found near the three-compartment sink. Dirty wiping cloths and a broken cooler gasket also noted.

headline: Multiple burnt-out light bulbs in kitchen
summary: Multiple burnt-out light bulbs were found above the kitchen prep area. The owner was instructed to install working bulbs and maintain lighting.

headline: Beans held at 50 to 55°F; 30 pounds discarded
summary: Beans in the walk-in cooler measured 50.0 to 55.5°F; the manager discarded 30 pounds. Food containers were on the floor and must be elevated. Previous violations were not corrected, and citation issued.

headline: Mold in ice machine fixed on site; flies found
summary: Mold-like spots in the eastside ice machine were corrected on site; ice was destroyed and the machine cleaned. About 20 small flies were found in the bar and pastry prep areas; citation issued. Openings at door bases and a leaking sanitizer drain also noted.

headline: Exposed insulation, rust, and pooling water noted
summary: The basement beer cooler door has exposed insulation that must be sealed. Milk crates must not be used to elevate food. Rust, dust, missing grout with pooling water, and an unused freezer that must be removed were also noted.

headline: No certified manager on duty; walk-in needs cleaning
summary: No valid certified food manager was on duty while chicken was handled; citation issued. The walk-in cooler interior, floors around heavy equipment, and walls need detail cleaning. The manager must keep an allergen training certificate on site.

headline: Broken cooler thermometer; bowl used as scoop
summary: The pizza prep cooler thermometer is not working and must be replaced. A bowl was used as a dispensing utensil submerged in cornmeal; a proper utensil is required. The three-compartment sink is missing a stopper.

headline: Cardboard under prep table; broken faucet handle
summary: The bottom of a prep table is lined with cardboard and must be removed for a nonporous, cleanable surface. A broken faucet handle on the employee restroom hand sink must be repaired; the faucet still runs hot and cold.

headline: No employee health policy; drain board needed
summary: No employee health policy was on site and must be provided at all times. An attached drain board is required at the warewashing sink so equipment and utensils can dry properly.

headline: Bare-hand contact with egg; beef held too warm
summary: A food handler touched a fried egg with bare hands while plating a customer's order; citation issued. Beef in a prep cooler measured 47 to 54°F and was discarded. Tomatoes stored on floor; heavy grease and debris also noted.

headline: Loose faucet at three-compartment sink
summary: The three-compartment sink has a loose faucet. It must be repaired or replaced and kept in good condition.

headline: Cold-hold unit at 46°F; 45 pounds discarded
summary: Multiple TCS foods in a cold-hold unit measured 46 to 54°F; 45 pounds were discarded. The unit was tagged and held for CDPH inspection. Frozen chicken was thawed in a sink without a bag or container. Excess grease on cooking equipment.

headline: Food employees without hair restraints
summary: Several food employees were not wearing hair restraints. The manager was instructed to make sure all food employees wear them.

headline: Walk-in coolers and freezer not always working
summary: Both walk-in coolers and the walk-in freezer were not functional at times; they must hold 41°F or below. No citation issued. Consumer advisory missing for raw or undercooked burgers. Toilet room door not self-closing.

headline: About 20 large flies; no food handler training
summary: About 20 large flies were found throughout the rear prep area on walls and tables; priority violation and citation issued. No food handler training was on site. Also noted: no hand sink where tortillas are hand-prepared, and cold holding units have food residue.

headline: No cooler thermometers; gap under rear door
summary: No thermometers were inside the coolers. A quarter-inch gap is at the bottom right of the rear exit door. Bulk food containers were uncovered, and a food handler lacked a hair restraint. Worn cutting boards and greasy fryers also noted.

headline: No sushi rice letter; no backflow at bar ice machine
summary: No sushi rice pH letter was on file; citation issued and it must be provided. No backflow prevention device at the bar ice machine. Restroom trash cans are uncovered, and basement clutter must be cleaned and organized.

headline: Incomplete vomit kit; no hand sink in dough room
summary: Several items were missing from the vomit clean-up kit; priority violation. The dough sheeting room has no exposed hand sink separate from the main prep area, and one must be installed. The ice scoop was stored in the ice bin. Washroom doors lack self-closing devices.

headline: Revolving door has gaps on each side
summary: The revolving door has a one-inch gap on each side. It must be made tight-fitting and rodent proofed.

headline: No certified manager on duty; many foods too warm
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared; the manager arrived at 12:30 p.m. Ready-to-eat foods held at 45 to 55°F were discarded, about 32 pounds. Two prep coolers at 48 to 49°F were tagged.

headline: No hand drying at rear prep sink
summary: There were no hand drying devices at the rear prep and dish sink while food was being prepped. The manager provided paper towels during inspection and must keep them stocked. Citation issued.

headline: Employee washroom out of order; sink leaks
summary: The employee washroom by the dish area is not working and is locked. Staff were told to use hallway washrooms until repaired. Two leaks under the dish room sink, milk crates used as shelving, and a missing floor tile were noted.

headline: Dead flies on light shields; grease in hood
summary: Deep freezer interiors must be defrosted and cleaned. Light shields in the service area have dead flies and must be cleaned. A faucet leaks at the three-compartment sink, and grease in the hood above cooking equipment must be cleaned.

headline: Food stored on freezer floor; missing hand sink sign
summary: Food containers were stored on the floor of the walk-in freezer and must be elevated at least six inches. A handwashing sign is missing at the rear prep hand sink and must be installed.

headline: Cold foods up to 78.8°F; 100 pounds discarded
summary: Chicken wings at 78.8°F and other TCS foods in a two-door cooler were discarded. A walk-in cooler at 53.8°F was tagged and 100 pounds were discarded. The bar sink leaks, and there is no hot or cold water at an outside hand sink.

headline: Passed complaint; some handler certificates expired
summary: Passed short-form complaint. Some food handler training certificates have expired; manager must update them.

headline: Failed: about 70 fruit flies near mop storage
summary: Failed complaint inspection. About 70 fruit flies in storage area where mops are kept. Licensed pest control technician contact and cleaning and sanitizing of area instructed. Spillage and food residue inside cold-hold units. Hole in mop storage room wall.

headline: Conditional pass; allergen training not corrected
summary: Passed with conditions. Previous core violation not corrected: certified manager's allergen training expired; citation issued. No covered receptacle in basement unisex washroom. Inadequate bar lighting. Manager instructed to fix both.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; unsafe hot and cold food
summary: Failed. No certified manager on site while handling chicken and steak; no valid certificate posted. Steak held at 115°F, discarded. Several cold foods at 49.5-60°F discarded (about 30 lbs). Three refrigeration units tagged held.

headline: Passed; ice machine buildup and missing backflow device
summary: Passed. Slight pink buildup inside ice machine; cleaning ordered. Backflow prevention device not located on ice machine water line. No covered trash receptacle in employee women's washroom. Food debris on floor under walk-in cooler shelves.

headline: Failed: no hot water; flying insects; prep and storage areas
summary: Failed. Washroom handsink near kitchen entrance measured 73.2°F; 100°F required. Flying insects in cabinet under dining area soda machine and in prep and storage areas; exterminator service and cleaning instructed. Soda dispensers stored on floor.

headline: Passed; dust, debris and dirty cooler interiors
summary: Passed. Plastic used as liner in reach-in cooler; removal ordered. Interiors of reach-in and walk-in coolers need detail cleaning. Loose debris, dirt and dust on floors and corners throughout facility.

headline: Failed: cold food unsafe; hot water fixed on site
summary: Failed. Prep handsink hot water measured 63°F; technician fixed sinks to 102-105°F on site. Cold-holding items at 45-86°F discarded (15 lbs, $200). No HACCP temperature records for vacuum-sealed food. Water backs up in three-compartment sink.

headline: Failed: handler skipped handwashing; mice, roaches, flies
summary: Failed. Food handler touched cash register and handled ready-to-eat fries without washing hands; about 3 lbs discarded. About 15 mouse droppings, two live roaches and small flies found in prep and dish areas. Dead roaches on walls and floors.

headline: Conditional pass; improper thawing, cooler at 57°F
summary: Passed with conditions. Reach-in cooler at 57°F tagged held. Shrimp thawing on prep table and fish thawing in sealed packages in walk-in cooler. Unlabeled bulk containers, soiled wiping cloths and food debris. Leaking drain under front handsink.

headline: Failed re-inspection: live roaches in pastry case
summary: Failed re-inspection. Live roach activity inside pastry case. Case emptied and about 4 lbs ($125) of pastries discarded. Pest control contact recommended. Walk-in cooler condenser dripping water into a pan. Peeling wallpaper in restrooms.

headline: Passed; floors need cleaning; no allergen training
summary: Passed. Floor under equipment needs detail cleaning. One employee has no allergen training on site; training and certificate with the City food manager certificate required.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings; handsink blocked
summary: Failed. About 10 mouse droppings behind and under storage shelves and about 20 rat droppings in rear prep area and near storage exit. Management instructed to clean and remove droppings; additional pest control service needed. Handsink blocked by prep tables and racks.

headline: Failed: unresolved prior violations; drainage and stoppers
summary: Failed. Previous core violations not corrected from April 2024: dairy containers used as utensils with chips and stains, a light without a shield, and no allergen certificate. Cast-iron waste pipe above three-compartment sink needs encapsulating. Sink stoppers missing.

headline: Failed re-inspection: no backflow devices; fan guard missing
summary: Failed re-inspection. No backflow devices on equipment connected to the water supply, including soda, tea and coffee machines. Prior ice machine backflow violation not corrected. Missing fan guard inside kitchen prep cooler; repair ordered.

headline: Failed: cold food unsafe; no health policy
summary: Failed. No written employee health policy on site. Chicken at 45.5°F and shrimp at 48.7°F in food prep cold-hold unit; discarded. Pink slime in kitchen ice machine. Soda and water stored on floor. Dumpster lids broken; replacement ordered.

headline: Conditional pass; no certified manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food service manager on site while TCS foods such as hot dogs and deli items were handled and served. Certification instructed.

headline: Conditional pass; 30 lbs cold food discarded on site
summary: Passed with conditions. Cold TCS foods held at 46.9-54.7°F; manager discarded about 30 lbs ($900) on site. Soda crates used to elevate pizza boxes and soda; shelving required. Grease and dust on hood filters.

headline: Failed: cold food unsafe; 50 live flies found
summary: Failed. Front prep cooler held chicken at 61.5°F, chopped chicken at 61.3°F and ground beef at 54.3°F; 50 lbs discarded. Cooler air at 64.2°F tagged held. About 50 live flies on boxes, walls, ceiling and shelving; pest control service instructed.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; moldy lettuce; ice slime
summary: Failed. No certified person in charge or manager on duty while handling chicken and beef. About 2 lbs of moldy spring mix discarded. Excessive pink and black slime inside ice machine; ice to be discarded. Handsink lacked soap. Leaks under handsink and three-compartment sink.

headline: Conditional pass; prior allergen violation not corrected
summary: Passed with conditions. Previous core violation not corrected: certified managers lacked allergen training; citation issued. Basement items must be elevated; milk crates not allowed. Excess ice in walk-in freezer and cardboard behind outdoor cooler to be removed.

headline: Passed; door gap and broken ice machine door
summary: Passed. Small gap under rear exit door to be sealed to prevent pests. Ice machine door broken at hinges; repair ordered. Walk-in beer cooler wall panel loose. Dirt, dust and debris in storage, freezer, ice machine and prep areas; cleaning ordered.

headline: Failed: no health policy, vomit plan or pest logbook
summary: Failed. No employee health policy or vomiting and diarrhea procedure found. Sanitizer test strips missing. No pest control logbook on premises. Waste water backs up from grease box when three-compartment sink drains. Black mold-like buildup under sink.

headline: Passed complaint; manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: Passed complaint inspection. Food service sanitation manager has no food allergen training certificate; instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: Passed; fly paper covered with small flies
summary: Passed. Fly paper hanging from ceiling is covered with small flies. Person in charge instructed to inform a licensed pest control technician of the need for service.

headline: Failed: patio and rooftop bars lack approved handsinks
summary: Failed re-inspection. Outdoor patio bar relies on a portable foot-pump sink, which is not approved. No plumbed handsinks or dump sinks at patio or rooftop bars. No handwashing signs there. Can opener blade caked with dried food debris.

headline: Passed; food on floor, hair restraints missing
summary: Passed. Boxed food stored on floor in walk-in cooler and warewashing area; elevation ordered. Multiple food handlers without hair restraints. Foil used as liner on prep surfaces; unfinished wood shelving. Food debris in prep coolers; grease under fryer.

headline: Conditional pass; no person in charge; expired pork
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge during inspection. No certified food manager while tacos and chicken were prepared. Ready-to-eat pork past its 7-day date discarded (about 10 lbs). Toilet room doors not self-closing; heavy grease and broken wall tiles.

headline: Failed: over 40 live flies; no vomit procedure
summary: Failed. Over 40 small live flies in rear prep and storage area and over 5 in customer washroom; removal and pest control recommended. No vomiting and diarrhea procedure. No sanitizer test strips. Prior violations not corrected include food debris and cutting boards.

headline: Conditional pass; 105 lbs of cold food discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Front prep cooler held tuna at 77.6°F, chopped steak at 66.9°F, shredded chicken at 66.9°F and other items above 41°F. Manager discarded 105 lbs ($350). Leak under three-compartment sink; cleaning needed in freezer and floors.

headline: Passed; no handwashing signs; toilet vent not working
summary: Passed. No handwashing signage at prep and dish area handsink or in toilet room. Toilet room mechanical ventilation not in working order; repair ordered.

headline: Failed: cold food at 49-61°F; no pest logbook
summary: Failed. Missing signed employee health policies. TCS foods at 48-61°F in prep cooler; about 20 lbs ($290) discarded. Prep cooler at 49.3°F and reach-in at 58.3°F tagged held. No pest control logbook. No raw or undercooked food advisory on menu.

headline: Failed: no vomit procedure or pest logbook
summary: Failed. No clean-up procedure or supplies for vomiting and diarrhea. No pest control logbook with required documents. Damaged cabinet door at service counter. Dust under front counter and in rear storage. Items must be raised off floor in rear storage.

headline: Passed; food on floor, grease and garbage area
summary: Passed. Food stored on floor in walk-in cooler and freezer; elevation ordered. Grease and food debris on fryer oil filter, cooking equipment and coolers. Rear garbage area not clean. Excess clutter in employee restroom.

headline: Failed: two live roaches found in prep area
summary: Failed. Two live roaches found in rear prep area, one under dishwasher drainboard and one near small prep cooler. Food containers stored on floor under cooking equipment. Encrusted grease and food debris. New certified manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: Failed re-inspection: cat in basement
summary: Failed re-inspection. A cat was observed in the basement; it must be removed along with all of its items. Curtains leading to washrooms need cleaning and maintenance. No insects, rodents or droppings were recorded.

headline: Passed complaint; thawing in standing water, back door open
summary: Passed complaint inspection. Frozen goat meat thawing in standing water; instructed to thaw per code. Back door left wide open with no screen. No lights in basement food storage room.

headline: Passed complaint; cardboard floor mat, grease, raw wood
summary: Passed complaint inspection. Wiping cloths must be kept in sanitizing solution. Raw wood shelf in produce cooler to be painted or sealed. Grease on fryer and prep tables. Cardboard under mats in carnita prep area. Leak at seafood handsink drain.

headline: Conditional pass; no original manager certificate on site
summary: Passed with conditions. Certified food manager not on site with original certificate; photo not accepted. Low-temperature dish machine at 0 ppm sanitizer, not to be used until fixed. Dead small flies in mop sink. Standing water in coolers.

headline: Passed; no covered waste receptacle in washroom
summary: Passed. No covered waste receptacle in washroom; management instructed to provide one.

headline: Passed; hair restraint, grease and expired allergen certificates
summary: Passed. Food handler without hair restraint. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, prep tables and coolers. Debris on walls and floors in prep and warewashing area. Hood filters need cleaning. Expired allergen training certificates.

headline: Failed: about 80 mouse droppings in basement
summary: Failed. About 80 mouse droppings scattered in basement prep and dry storage, furnace room and beside prep table. Removal, sanitizing and pest control service required. Cardboard on shelves, no covered restroom receptacle, holes in walls and floor.

headline: Passed; dirty floors, drains and ceiling vents
summary: Passed. Floors around and behind equipment and in corners must be cleaned. Floor drains must be cleaned to prevent pest breeding. Ceiling vent covers in rear area are dirty.

headline: Passed re-inspection; no handwashing signs or receptacles
summary: Passed re-inspection. No handwashing signage at sinks in bar, prep and dish areas. No covered receptacles for sanitary products in both all-gender washrooms.

headline: Passed; dirty floors and walls behind equipment
summary: Passed. Dirty floors inside walk-in cooler under shelving, along wall bases, and in prep and dish areas. Walls behind equipment need cleaning of debris.

headline: Passed; milk crates and leaking dish machine noted
summary: Passed re-inspection. Milk crates used as shelving must be removed. Pot-and-pan dish machine leaks from pipes; repair ordered. Black mold-like substance and chipped, bubbling ceiling paint noted in dish room; repainting ordered. Covered sanitary napkin bin required.

headline: Passed re-inspection; dirt, grime and dusty vents
summary: Passed re-inspection. Heavy dirt and dust on fan over rear handsink in dish area. Cook wore very dirty clothing and was told to keep outer clothing clean. Hood, filters and vents heavily dusted. Walls and floors have dirt and food splatter.

headline: Passed re-inspection; cooking equipment needs cleaning
summary: Passed re-inspection. Cooking equipment needs cleaning to remove food spills and buildup. Floors under and around cooking equipment need detail cleaning. No allergen training certificate on site; one required.

headline: Passed complaint; three-compartment sink lacks stoppers
summary: Passed complaint inspection. Three-compartment sink is missing stoppers; a working stopper must be provided.

headline: Failed: over 60 rat droppings in basement
summary: Failed. Over 60 rat droppings on basement floor behind shelving. Cleaning and additional pest control service needed before re-inspection. Water-damaged ceiling tile, food debris and clutter in basement. Wiping cloths stored on prep tables.

headline: Passed; splatter, grease trap area, dim lights
summary: Passed. Splatter on toilet room wall must be cleaned. Floor near grease trap needs detail cleaning. Lights over three-compartment sink going out and area very dim; replacement ordered.

headline: Passed; leaking pipe under three-compartment sink
summary: Passed. Leakage at bottom pipe of three-compartment sink in dish area; repair ordered.

headline: Passed re-inspection; grease, leaks and certificates
summary: Passed re-inspection. Ice machine interior needs cleaning. Hair restraints required for all food handlers. Fryers and drink stations need cleaning. Leaks at three-compartment sink faucet and walk-in cooler dripping onto floor. Food handler certificates needed.

headline: Passed complaint; rusty shelves, leaking faucet
summary: Passed complaint inspection. Rusty, dirty shelves in walk-in cooler and basement dry storage; cleaning, repainting or replacement ordered. Leaking hot-water faucet at prep sink. Washroom trash cans lack lids. Heavy grease and dirt in hood and filters.

headline: Passed; rear door gap, cardboard in freezer
summary: Passed. Rear building door is not rodent-proof, with a gap at the bottom; sealing instructed. Cardboard used as floor mat in walk-in freezer; rubber mat required. Torn freezer gasket. Leak at two-compartment sink. Soiled mop heads not hung.

headline: Failed: chicken and eggs above 41°F; cooler at 55°F
summary: Failed. Chicken breast at 49.3°F, wings at 49.0°F and eggs at 54.8°F in walk-in cooler; operator discarded them. Walk-in cooler at 55.2°F; prep cooler tagged held. Three-compartment sink leaks. Cardboard and milk crates used. Allergen certificate missing.

headline: Passed complaint; greasy floors, expired allergen certificates
summary: Passed complaint inspection. Grease deposits on floor under prep tables and cooking equipment; deep cleaning ordered. Allergen training certificates found expired; updated certificates required on site.

headline: Conditional pass; no handwash supplies; cold food 49.5-51°F
summary: Passed with conditions. Handwash sinks lacked cleanser and paper towels; an employee left to buy towels. Cans and bottles in front handsink. Pizza prep cooler at 51°F with cheese at 49.5°F; about 15 lbs discarded and cooler tagged held.

headline: Passed; leaking toilet handle, no allergen certificates
summary: Passed. Minor leak at handle of women's toilet must be repaired. No allergen training certificates on site; training required for all certified food managers.

headline: Failed: rodent-chewed and rodent-contaminated food
summary: Failed complaint inspection. Flour, pie crusts, chips and cookies with chewed edges and rat droppings on cans and bags offered for sale. About 20 rat droppings behind and between food boxes in aisles. Pest control service recommended.

headline: Passed; cardboard on shelves, leaking handsinks
summary: Passed. No thermometer for air temperature in hot-holding unit by hot food counter. Cardboard used on shelving and floors throughout; removal ordered. Leaks at handsinks in rear hot food and raw meat prep areas. Grease behind equipment and in filters.

headline: Passed re-inspection; no handler certificates
summary: Passed re-inspection. No food handler certificates on premises; proof of training for all handlers required. Certified food manager lacks allergen training certificate. Stained cutting boards to be resurfaced or replaced.

headline: Passed; two of three fryer exhaust lights out
summary: Passed. Two of three overhead exhaust lights over rear fryers not working; repair or replacement ordered. Food handler certificates missing; manager could not find copies for employees.

headline: Passed; greasy cooking equipment, hood and sink leak
summary: Passed. Sides of cooking equipment need cleaning of grease and food buildup. Three-compartment sink faucet leaks; correction ordered. Hood vents need cleaning.

headline: Passed re-inspection; rice cooker on floor, grease
summary: Passed re-inspection. Rice cooker stored on floor while cooking in pastry prep area; staff told to refrain. Missing sink stopper for three-compartment sink. Grease on fryers and hood; dirty cold-hold units; soiled cardboard on floor and shelves.

headline: Conditional pass; no certified manager with shrimp
summary: Passed with conditions. No City of Chicago certified manager on site while TCS foods such as shrimp were handled. Manager must be on site at all times with original certificate posted. Citation issued.

headline: Failed: no hot water; rat droppings not resolved
summary: Failed re-inspection. No hot running water premises-wide after gas service was shut off for a suspected leak. Previous violation not corrected: rat droppings in dish area, under coolers, in booths and under bar counters. Pest service required.

headline: Passed; damaged cooler gasket and floor debris
summary: Passed. Gasket on interior of main sandwich cooler in disrepair; repair ordered. Food debris at bottom of reach-in beverage cooler. Floors in dishwashing and dry storage areas under sink and shelving must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: 30-40 flies; bearded workers; no allergen proof
summary: Failed. About 30 to 40 small flies at rear exit, garbage can storage and mop sink area; fly elimination and pest control service instructed. Food handlers with beards lack effective restraints. Moldy caulking at three-compartment sink. No allergen training proof for certified managers.

headline: Passed; dusty walk-in fan, expired allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Dusty fan in walk-in cooler must be cleaned. Expired allergen training certificate observed; current certificates required for all certified food managers.

headline: Passed; worn exit door seal, leaking ice machine
summary: Passed complaint inspection. Worn weather stripping on bottom of rear exit door must be replaced to prevent pest entry. Leak at bottom of ice machine; source must be found and repaired. Floors in corners and rear dry storage need cleaning.

headline: Failed: dumpster lid missing; leaks; door not self-closing
summary: Failed. Prior priority violation not corrected: outside dumpster missing its lid, a possible food source and harborage for pests. Also a leak at three-compartment sink faucet, washroom door not self-closing, and a dish area light not working.

headline: Passed; grease, food debris and dust throughout
summary: Passed. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, prep tables, coolers, freezers and shelving; cleaning ordered. Floors, walls and corners in several areas need cleaning. Dusty fans, light shields and vents to be cleaned.

headline: Passed; greasy fryers, bar floors and drains
summary: Passed. Heavy grease inside fryer doors and on floor beneath them. Dust on ice machine. Floor drain under kitchen handsink has dark buildup and debris. Bar areas have dirt and dark substance on floors and equipment. Cleaning ordered to prevent pests.

headline: Passed complaint; manager lacked hair restraint
summary: Passed complaint inspection. Food service manager had no hair restraint; instructed to wear one.

headline: Passed re-inspection; ice buildup, dirt and pooling water
summary: Passed re-inspection. Excessive ice inside ice cream freezers; removal ordered. Dirt and black substance on ceiling above meat cutting tables. Open crack in deli cooler floor. Excessive pooling water on floors in meat department and basement. Burnt-out bulbs in basement produce cooler.

headline: Passed; splashguard missing at handsink
summary: Passed. No splashguard between exposed handsink and three-compartment sink drainboard; washable splashguard must be installed.

headline: Conditional pass; no paper towels; no allergen training
summary: Passed with conditions. No paper towels at prep handsink; a food handler got one during the inspection. Broken tile in first-floor rear storage and basement stairs. No certified food manager with allergen training; documentation must be provided.

headline: Failed: black and pink slime inside ice machine
summary: Failed. Black and pink slime buildup inside ice machine used to make ice for consumption; ice to be removed, machine cleaned and sanitized. Torn gasket on interior of two-door prep cooler; repair ordered.

headline: Failed: cold food at 45-52°F; cooler still in use
summary: Failed re-inspection. Soup, chicken, hamburgers, hot dogs, mayo and cheese held at 45-52°F in two-door prep cooler. Cooler at 50°F, tagged held in 2024, still used for TCS foods. Torn gaskets, greasy hood, and a food handler without certificate.

headline: Passed; no cold water at handsink; crates used as shelving
summary: Passed. Handsink across from three-compartment sink has no cold water; repair ordered. Soda crates under sink and prep table used as shelving; appropriate shelving required.

headline: Conditional pass; dish machine held, menu asterisks added
summary: Passed with conditions. High-temperature dish machine could not run; technician said a valve must be ordered. Tagged held for inspection. Corrected on site: asterisks added to raw-or-undercooked menu items. Vacuum-sealed shrimp without approved plan discarded.

headline: Passed short-form; grease, spills and leaking faucet
summary: Passed short-form complaint. Nozzles and area around them need detail cleaning. Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizing solution. Grease and food spills under cooking equipment. Leak at front handsink faucet; coving repair ordered.

headline: Passed; damaged cabinets and dirty washroom vent
summary: Passed. Cabinets under food self-service area in disrepair and off hinges; repair ordered. Food spills inside those cabinets to be cleaned. Washroom ceiling vent unclean and hanging from ceiling.

headline: Failed: no pest logbook, metal thermometer or test kit
summary: Failed. No current pest control logbook; licensed pest service at least twice a year required. No metal-stem thermometer for food temperatures. No sanitizer test kit. No handwashing signs. No covered receptacle in gender-neutral washroom. Spill kits on site; completed clean-up policy required.

headline: Passed; ice scoop stored in bin; frozen food in totes
summary: Passed. Ice scoop stored inside ice bin; instructed on proper storage between uses. Frozen food stored in plastic totes in freezer; food-grade bags and containers only.

headline: Failed: mold-like buildup inside ice machine
summary: Failed. Mold-like buildup found inside ice machine used for human consumption; person in charge told to discard ice and clean. Food residue in refrigerator and dish area. Damaged, peeling paint on wall between kitchen and front prep area; repair ordered.

headline: Failed: no hot water, rodent droppings, unsafe sanitizer
summary: Failed with priority violations. Rear handsink had no hot water (50°F; 100°F required). Three hand sinks lacked soap. Low-temperature dish machine sanitizer at 0 ppm; inspector ordered it not used until fixed. About 8 large rodent droppings in bar. Ceiling tiles falling.

headline: Passed; chipped paint in basement dry storage
summary: Passed. Chipped paint on walls in basement dry storage; resurfacing and repainting ordered.

headline: Passed re-inspection; moldy caulking, uncertified handler
summary: Passed re-inspection. Blackened, moldy caulking above three-compartment sink must be replaced. One food handler lacked a food handler certificate; proof of training required for all handlers.

headline: Failed: cold food at 48-50°F; prior violations uncorrected
summary: Failed. Several TCS foods held at 48-50°F; about $300 of food discarded. Two coolers at 50°F and 56°F; technician repairing them. Previous core violations not corrected: ice machine buildup, uncovered receptacle, and allergen training.

headline: Passed re-inspection; food debris and grease buildup
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food debris, spills and grease on fryers, holding units, prep tables, coolers and freezers; cleaning ordered. Food debris inside floor drains and on floors in several areas.

headline: Failed: no raw-food consumer advisory
summary: Failed. Menu serves undercooked food, but no consumer advisory about raw or undercooked meat, seafood, shellfish or eggs was found. No citation issued. Milk crates used as shelving must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Passed; soup thawing at room temperature
summary: Passed. Bag of soup thawing at room temperature in rear prep sink, not under running water; must thaw under refrigeration or running water at 70°F or less. Cardboard covering soup vat drainpipe. Backflow device in inaccessible location.

headline: Passed; missing backflow device and sink stoppers
summary: Passed. Backflow prevention device not located at mop sink; one must be provided and made visible. Three-compartment sink is missing stoppers.

headline: Passed re-inspection; torn prep cooler gasket
summary: Passed re-inspection. Torn door gasket inside three-door prep cooler behind cook line; replacement ordered.

headline: Failed: no hot water, no sanitizer, missing health policy
summary: Failed with priority violations. Bar handsink has no hot water; no sanitizer on site; no food thermometer. Health policy and vomiting and diarrhea procedure missing. Window and exit doors not protected; bird nesting material in window grates. Pest logbook missing.

headline: Conditional pass; no certified manager on premises
summary: Passed with conditions. No City of Chicago certified foodservice manager on premises; one must be present at all times. Leaking drain pipe under dish area handsink; repair ordered.

headline: Conditional pass; blank employee health policy forms
summary: Passed with conditions. Blank copies of the employee health policy were found on site. Verifiable signed copies for all food employees must be kept on site.

headline: Passed re-inspection; no food handler certificates
summary: Passed re-inspection. No food handler certificates on site; manager instructed to comply with requirement. Sanitation manager lacks food allergen training certificate.

headline: About 50 rat droppings under soda dispenser
summary: Failed. About 50 rat droppings in a dining-area cabinet under the soda dispenser. Must remove, clean, sanitize, and notify pest control; citation issued. Prior violations also not corrected, including rust on shelves and debris near the dumpster.

headline: Food stored on basement floor; unlabeled containers
summary: Passed re-inspection. Unlabeled containers in coolers, food and single-use items on basement floor, ice scoop handle resting in ice, and floor debris. Mop heads and a washroom fan also need fixing. Manager instructed to correct all.

headline: Employee items stored with public bakery food
summary: Passed. Employee personal items were stored in the walk-in cooler with bakery food for the public. Personal items must be kept in a designated area.

headline: Hot water off at handsink; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Passed with conditions. Prep/dish handsink lacked hot water; manager turned it on during inspection. Low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer at final rinse; tagged out of use until CDPH clears it. Slow drain also noted.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies; no hot water
summary: Failed. No supplies on site to clean vomit or diarrhea events; instructed to provide. Greasy cooking equipment. No hot water in truck: handsink at 66.5°F and three-compartment sink 70.3°F. Priority violation; no citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled packaged treats; hair restraints lacking
summary: Passed re-inspection. Packaged cookies, brownies, and rice crispy treats were not properly labeled. Food handlers prepped without hair or beard restraints. Reach-in and walk-in coolers need detail cleaning. A three-compartment sink has a cracked basin.

headline: Wiping cloths and knives stored in coolers
summary: Passed. Reach-in coolers lack thermometers, and a pile of wiping cloths and knives were stored inside them. Bulk containers need labels and some cutting boards need replacing. Missing gaskets, greasy hood, and dusty walk-in vents.

headline: Dish machine gauge unreadable; ceiling damage
summary: Passed re-inspection. Low-temperature dish machine gauge cover in poor repair and unreadable; must repair or replace. Missing ceiling tiles and beams in basement hallway; repairs needed to keep pests out. Grease and water on floors.

headline: Food debris on equipment; leaking faucet
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food debris and splatter on hot-holding, cooling, coffee, and soda equipment; must clean to avoid attracting pests. Three-compartment sink faucet leaking. Floors under shelving and equipment need cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled containers and shared scoop; restroom covers needed
summary: Passed. Prep area food containers must be labeled with common food names. A clear plastic bowl was used as a flour scoop next to the handwashing sink; scoops with handles required. Women's restroom needs lidded feminine hygiene containers.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: Failed. No certified food manager (CFM) on site and no Chicago CFM certificate. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit on site. The person in charge must obtain the certificate, keep a manager on site at all times, and keep a cleanup kit.

headline: Undated ready-to-eat food; 10 pounds discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Ready-to-eat fried rice, noodles, chicken, and beef stored over 24 hours had no date labels. Manager discarded 10 pounds (about $200). Citation issued. Also missing handwashing signs and labels, and debris around dumpster.

headline: Live flying insects and pest activity
summary: Failed. About 25 live small flying insects on walls, ceiling, and equipment in dishwashing and dining areas. Additional pest control service needed; citation issued. Dead insects on windowsills, cardboard liners, and dirty equipment also noted.

headline: Dead mouse found in basement storage
summary: Passed re-inspection. A dead mouse was found on the floor of the west-side basement storage area; management instructed to remove all dead rodents. Fryer interior needs cleaning, and hood and filters have grease buildup.

headline: Foil liners and leaking roof in storage
summary: Passed. Aluminum foil used as liner on prep equipment; must be removed. Water leaking from roof in rear storage. Missing floor grout and damaged tiles in prep/dish area. Missing and stained ceiling tiles. Plates not inverted after sanitizing.

headline: No raw-food advisory on menu; missing allergen certificate
summary: Failed. Menu lacked the raw or undercooked food advisory. A certified food manager lacked an allergen training certificate. Wiping cloths were left on prep tables, and handwashing signs were missing. Earlier trash-can lid violation not corrected; citation issued.

headline: 30 flies on ceiling; prior violation uncorrected
summary: Failed re-inspection. About 30 small flies on ceiling at bread prep area; previous violation not corrected; citation issued. Pest control operator must be notified and flies eliminated. Floors and floor drains in bread prep area not clean.

headline: Reach-in cooler held food at 47-48°F; discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Chicken, beef burgers, and bacon held at 47–48°F in reach-in cooler #6; cold foods must be 41°F or below. About 15 pounds ($150) discarded voluntarily. Ice machine upper portion needs cleaning.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; pizza oven greasy
summary: Passed. Rear handwashing sink lacked signage; sauce squeeze bottles unlabeled at wing prep; single-service cups stored on floor. Pizza oven has encrusted grease deposits; slow-draining handsink drain.

headline: No handsink at three-compartment sink; no sanitizer
summary: Failed. No handwashing sink at three-compartment sink; no chlorine or quaternary sanitizer or test strips on premises. No grease trap. No pest control log. Outside garbage receptacle missing. Ceiling hole; restroom ventilation inoperable.

headline: No restroom water pressure; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Failed re-inspection. Employee restroom handwashing sink had no water pressure; citation issued. A food service sanitation manager lacked a food allergen training certificate and was instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: No hot water at most sinks; no paper towels
summary: Failed. No hot water at both prep handsinks, the washbowl sink, or the three-compartment sink; must correct. No paper towels at washbowl sink. One food handler lacked training proof. Dirt and dead bugs in corners.

headline: Inadequate hot water; no vomit cleanup procedure
summary: Failed. Hand sinks reached only 84.7 to 88.7°F and the three-compartment sink 89.4°F. Hand sinks must consistently reach 100°F and that sink 110°F. No written vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure. Soap and towel dispenser placed over prep tables.

headline: No dish machine temperature strips; no food handler certificates
summary: Failed. High-temperature dish machine lacked surface temperature test strips or indicators. No food handler training certificates on site. Unisex washrooms lacked covered waste containers. Previous inspection summary not displayed; citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; chicken held over 7 days
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager on site while sausage and eggs were handled; citation issued. Discarded 10 pounds of chicken wings and 5 pounds of shredded chicken held over 7 days. Food handler lacked hair restraint; deli cups not air-dried.

headline: No health policy, stem thermometer, or customer barrier
summary: Failed. No employee health policy, no stem thermometer, and no barrier between food production areas and customers. No backflow prevention device at the hot water machine. Items must be provided; no citation issued for the first three.

headline: Raw wood door in walk-in cooler
summary: Passed re-inspection. Raw wood door inside walk-in cooler. Raw wood is prohibited and must be painted or sealed so it is nonporous and easily sanitized.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed re-inspection. A sanitation manager has no allergen training; must provide.

headline: Expired ham and sausage discarded; no certificate posted
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified sanitation manager on site; citation issued. About 10 pounds of expired ham and sausage discarded. Soap missing at dish sink, replenished during inspection. Cell phones and speaker on cutting board in prep area.

headline: No backflow device on coffee machine
summary: Passed re-inspection. Coffee machine at taco restaurant lacked a backflow prevention device; instructed to install one so it can be serviced.

headline: Food handlers lack training proof; dirty floors
summary: Passed. Some food handlers lacked proof of food handler training; manager must ensure those without a City sanitation certificate complete an approved program. Floors and corners inside walk-in cooler and freezer need detail cleaning.

headline: Fly activity at dishwashing area
summary: Failed. About 30 small flies found at dishwashing areas. Pest control operator must be notified and flies eliminated; citation issued.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; no covered waste bin
summary: Passed. No handwashing signage at sinks in washroom and prep/dish area; must provide and maintain. Aluminum foil used as shelf liners in rear prep. Washroom lacks covered waste receptacle.

headline: No handwashing signs; missing cold-unit thermometers
summary: Passed re-inspection. No handwashing signage at sinks in washrooms and kitchen. Walk-in cooler, one-door refrigerator, and two-door cold unit lacked visible thermometers; instructed to provide.

headline: Front door gaps; walk-in floor needs cleaning
summary: Passed. Front doors are in poor repair, with gaps between them and at the bottom; must repair to prevent pest entry. Floors under shelving in walk-in cooler need cleaning of spills or debris.

headline: Multi-use utensils not inverted; floors need grouting
summary: Passed re-inspection. Multi-use utensils must be inverted on dish storage and prep shelving. Floors in front and rear prep and dish areas must be regrouted. Food debris buildup under and along walls throughout prep, dish, and bar areas.

headline: No food handler or allergen certificates
summary: Passed. No food handler certificates and no food allergen training certificates on premises; must provide. Middle stopper not working on three-compartment sink. Peeling paint in prep area behind steam table.

headline: Rust on walk-in cooler wire racks
summary: Passed re-inspection. Rust on wire storage racks inside walk-in cooler; must remove rust and repaint or replace shelves.

headline: Clean cooking equipment and food prep walls
summary: Passed re-inspection. Cooking equipment, prep tables, two-door freezer, stove, grease trap, and wire shelves must be cleaned. Walls and floor of food prep area also need cleaning.

headline: No metal stem thermometer; damaged cutting boards
summary: Passed. No metal stem thermometer on site for checking internal food temperatures. Cutting boards have deep grooves. Prep cart, tables, cooler interiors, and sinks need detail cleaning. Mop sink lacks backflow device.

headline: No certified manager during breakfast service
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager on site while breakfast was prepared and served; citation issued. No thermometer in yogurt and milk cooler. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Black buildup found inside the ice machine.

headline: Food and personal items stored on floor
summary: Passed. Boxed food stored on floor in rear prep; must be elevated six inches. Multiple employees not wearing hair restraints. Rusty racks in walk-in cooler; dirty floor drain under three-compartment sink; employee belongings stored in prep area.

headline: Chicken thawing in standing water; rear door gap
summary: Passed. Chicken was thawing in standing water; instructed to thaw under refrigeration, cold running water, or as part of cooking. 1/4-inch gap at bottom of rear door; outer openings must be sealed.

headline: No health policy or food handler certificates on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No verifiable employee health policy on site; template left, and signed copies must be kept on site. No food handler certificates on site. Washroom door not self-closing. Soiled mop heads not hung to dry.

headline: Floors under cooking equipment not clean
summary: Passed. Floors under and behind cooking equipment were not clean; must clean.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; employee food near customer food
summary: Passed with conditions. Bar dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and was not to be used until sanitizing at 50 ppm; maintenance called; citation issued. Employee food stored with customer food. Containers stored on floor in walk-in freezers.

headline: Frozen fish thawed improperly; no allergen training
summary: Passed. Frozen fish was thawing on top of a freezer unit rather than by approved methods; inspector instructed proper thawing. Hood has grease and dust buildup. No allergen training on site; managers must complete it.

headline: Mouse droppings; handler skipped hand-washing between tasks
summary: Failed. Handler did not wash hands between glove changes; corrected on site. About 40 to 45 mouse droppings in rear storage, near trash, mop sink, and potato storage. Citation issued; dirty fry cutter and repeat violations also noted.

headline: Revolving door gaps; backflow device and grout repairs
summary: Passed re-inspection. Revolving door has openings at its base that must be sealed to keep pests out. Coffee machine lacked a backflow prevention device. Clutter near the water heater and damaged floor grout also need correction.

headline: No certified food manager during burger service
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager on site while burgers and other TCS foods (foods that must be kept hot or cold) were prepared and served; citation issued. No food handler training certificates on site.

headline: Missing restroom handwashing sign; no allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Women's restroom lacked a handwashing sign. Fly trap on food shelves must be kept away from food. Rice spoon stored in standing water. Employee clothing on food shelves; plants in prep kitchen. Manager lacked allergen certificate.

headline: Loose restroom wall covering; debris under reach-ins
summary: Passed. Wall covering under restroom handwashing sink coming loose; must repair. Dirt and food debris under and behind lower reach-in units near meat slicer and bread oven; pull units from walls and clean to prevent pests.

headline: Toilet-room receptacle needs cover
summary: Passed re-inspection. Toilet room receptacle must have a cover.

headline: No basement toilet ventilation; labeling and gasket issues
summary: Passed. No mechanical ventilation in basement toilet room. Personal care items stored with single-service articles. Dry storage containers need labels. Torn gasket covered with duct tape. Food handler lacked beard restraint.

headline: Torn egg cooler gaskets
summary: Passed. Gaskets inside two-door egg cooler are torn and in disrepair; instructed to repair.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods served
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid City of Chicago certified manager on duty while chicken and fish (TCS, foods that must be kept hot or cold) were handled, prepared, and served; citation issued.

headline: Ice machine interior dirty; faucet leaking
summary: Passed. Interior of front counter ice machine must be cleaned and maintained. Faucet base at the three-compartment sink is leaking and must be repaired.

headline: No hair restraints; leaking rear sink
summary: Passed. Food handlers in prep areas not wearing hair restraints. Deep fryer interiors have grease, dirt, and dust. Rear handwashing sink leaks at pipes. Floor corners and areas under heavy equipment dirty; hood filters greasy.

headline: No thermometer in walk-in; restroom trash lid needed
summary: Passed. No ambient air thermometer inside walk-in cooler; must provide. Women's restroom needs a covered wastecan for feminine hygiene products.

headline: Greasy floors and dusty exhaust cover
summary: Passed. Wet wiping cloths stored on prep tables; management instructed to keep them in sanitizer. Rusted shelf in two-door refrigerator must be replaced or painted. Floors with grease and food debris; dusty exhaust cover at dish area.

headline: Worn gaskets and stained cutting boards
