summary: Passed. Worn rubber gaskets on reach-in cooler and freezer doors and double-door unit must be repaired or replaced. Cutting board with open seams and dark stains must be refinished or replaced.

headline: Worn cooler gaskets and oily equipment
summary: Passed. Reach-in coolers in the front prep area need new rubber gaskets. Equipment in the rear area has oil buildup. Manager instructed to correct, clean, and maintain.

headline: Leaking faucets; greasy equipment and floors
summary: Passed. Three-compartment sink faucet leaks; stripped handsink knob in dish area to be replaced today. Greasy fryers, stoves, prep tables, and floors need cleaning. Missing wall coving and dirty hood vents also noted.

headline: Dusty monitor and shelves above prep table
summary: Passed. Heavy dust on screen monitor and shelves above prep table; instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: No handwashing sign; no thermometers in cold units
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign at exposed handsink behind front bar; no thermometers in cold-holding equipment; no backflow device at employee toilet room utility sink; inoperable toilet-room ventilation. No allergen training certificates on site.

headline: Missing prep cooler thermometer; leaking faucet
summary: Passed. Thermometer missing in prep cooler; must provide. Ceramic cups and bowls must be lead-free or lead-safe with documentation on site, or removed. Dark-stained cutting board and leaking three-compartment sink faucet.

headline: Front door gap; broken handsink faucets
summary: Passed. 1/4-inch gap between front entry doors; must be sealed to prevent pests. Broken handsink faucets in men's and women's toilet rooms. Standing water and buildup behind ice machine and sinks; must be cleaned to prevent insect activity.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate; fly traps and rust
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid sanitation manager certificate or trained person in charge on site while chicken, beans, and rice were served; citation issued. Fly traps in prep area, rust in walk-in coolers, and burnt-out hood lights noted.

headline: No valid manager certificate; food stored on floor
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge with a valid certificate, and no certificate posted; citation issued. Food and single-use items stored on floor. Rice utensil handle stored inside the rice. Overhead basement leak. No allergen training available.

headline: Wastewater backing up into sink; standing water
summary: Passed with conditions. Wastewater backed up with dirt and food particles into another compartment when filling a three-compartment sink; citation issued (noted 08/20/2021). Standing water on dish area floor. Hole and peeling paint on basement dry storage ceiling.

headline: Rust in walk-in; no food handler or allergen training
summary: Passed re-inspection. Rust on walk-in cooler shelves and raw wood shelving in storage must be removed or sealed. No food handler training available, and no allergen training for certified managers.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit on site; instructed to obtain one. No citation issued.

headline: Mold-like substance in ice machine; chorizo too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. Pink mold-like substance inside ice machine (ice not used for consumption); must clean. About 5 pounds of chorizo held at 53.4°F, above the 41°F limit; discarded; citation issued. Expired food handler certificates.

headline: Missing handwashing sink at new bar; unlabeled bulk food
summary: Failed. New front bar, added for a new liquor license, needs a handwashing sink; the bar was not in use during inspection. Bulk food containers need labels. Hood vent filters need detail cleaning to remove grease and dust.

headline: Wiping cloths improperly stored
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were improperly stored; must be kept in sanitizing solution when not in use.

headline: About 40 dead roaches in basement
summary: Passed. About 40 dead roaches throughout basement storage area; must remove them and keep the facility free of dead pests. Old plastic containers used to store gravy; food-grade reusable containers required. Heavy grime inside cooler gaskets.

headline: No pest log; door gaps; no allergen proof
summary: Failed. No pest control log book on premises. Screen doors have gaps that could let pests in. Unidentified filled grease barrel must be removed. No proof of allergen training for certified food managers.

headline: Rear door gap; allergen certificate missing
summary: Passed with conditions. Rear exit door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom that must be repaired to prevent pest entry. Food splatter on wall behind prep stations; hood and filters need cleaning. Repeat violation: no allergen certificate for food service manager.

headline: Greasy equipment sides and prep table sides
summary: Passed. Sides of cooking and non-cooking equipment in kitchen, and sides of prep tables, need detail cleaning. Instructed to clean to prevent possible pest or insect activity.

headline: No hand sink in prep area; no vomit supplies
summary: Failed. No handwashing sink in front prep area; restroom sinks lacked soap and towels. Vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies, metal stem thermometer, and food handler and allergen certificates were missing. Water pressure very low. Several priority violations.

headline: No handwashing sign at front prep sink
summary: Passed. Front prep area handwashing sink had no sign reminding employees to wash hands. Interior of kitchen deep fryers soiled with dried food debris and grease; must clean and maintain.

headline: Expired chicken and beans discarded; no food handler proof
summary: Failed. Chicken tinga and cooked beans held beyond the 7-day limit were discarded; citation issued. No food handler training proof for required employees, and no allergen certificate for a pending certified food manager. Bathroom lacked working ventilation.

headline: Missing handwashing sign near coffee prep
summary: Passed re-inspection. No handwashing sign or poster near the handwashing sink in the front coffee prep area; must provide and maintain.

headline: Live flies and rodent droppings throughout restaurant
summary: Failed. About 13 small live flies in prep, dish, and dining areas. About 20 large rodent droppings on liquor shelving and in storage. Droppings must be removed and flies eliminated; citation issued. Also rusty carts and items stored on floor.

headline: Low hot water; no food handler training
summary: Passed with conditions. Toilet-room sink hot water measured 73.4°F, below the required 100°F; restored to 102.3°F during inspection. No signed employee health policies; citation issued. No food handler training for employees. Shaker bottle unlabeled.

headline: Food thawed in standing water; unlabeled ingredients
summary: Passed re-inspection. Beef, picadillo, and beans were thawing improperly on a prep table and in standing water in the three-compartment sink. Working ingredients lacked labels. Three employees lacked food handler training proof.

headline: Pizza cooler too warm; sausage and cheese discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Pizza prep cooler air reached 50.9°F. Sausage at 53.6°F and mozzarella at 55.9°F were discarded, about 20 pounds. Cooler tagged and held for reinspection; citation issued. Doors misaligned; raw wood shelf needs sealing.

headline: Greasy cooking equipment and food spills
summary: Passed. Cooking equipment has food and grease buildup. Storage shelves and prep tables have food spills and splatter. Toilet room receptacle needs a cover; floors and walls in prep area need cleaning.

headline: Food debris on equipment handles; wall splatter
summary: Passed. Food debris on handles of cooking and cooling equipment; must clean to prevent buildup. Handsink splashguard loose in storage area; must recaulk. Food splatter on walls at front service area and by oven.

headline: Leaking drain pipe at dish-area handsink
summary: Passed re-inspection. Handwashing sink drain pipe in the dishwashing area was leaking; instructed to repair and maintain.

headline: Ice scoop in ice bin; slow-draining sink
summary: Failed. Ice scoop stored inside the ice bin. Three-compartment sink drains very slowly. No current food handler certificates on site. Repeat violations for a rear door gap and missing allergen training; citation issued.

headline: Dirty ice machine lid and sheet pans; door gap
summary: Passed. Dirty interior lid on rear ice machine and dirty sheet pans stacked on prep floor; must clean. Rear interior door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom that must be repaired to prevent pest entry. Wiping cloths left out; walk-in dirty.

headline: No certified food manager on duty during food service
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on duty while food was prepared and served; no valid certificate for person in charge. No pest control log, vomit or diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure, or sanitizer test kit. Allergen certificate missing.

headline: Unlabeled desserts; floor and cardboard issues
summary: Passed. Packaged desserts in grab-and-go cooler lacked labels for ingredients, net weight, allergens, and business name. Cardboard used as shelf liner in walk-in cooler. Rear prep floor in poor repair. Food debris under cooking equipment.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; burnt-out hood light
summary: Passed. Exposed handwashing sink in the first-floor bar lacked a sign; management provided one during inspection. Slight debris inside ice machine used for seafood display. One burnt-out light in hood over cook line; instructed to repair.

headline: About 50 mouse droppings; no vomit cleanup procedure
summary: Failed. About 50 or more mouse droppings found on windowsill, under sinks, near the refrigerator, and on carts. Must remove, clean, and sanitize; pest control service recommended. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies. Citation issued.

headline: Food on floor; ice buildup in walk-in freezer
summary: Passed with conditions. Food containers stored on floor in prep, storage, and walk-in cooler; raised shelving six inches off floor required. Heavy ice buildup in walk-in freezer. Earlier food handler and allergen training violations not corrected.

headline: Certified manager lacked allergen training certificate
summary: Passed. A certified food manager on site lacked an allergen awareness training certificate. The person in charge must ensure all certified managers complete the training and keep certificates on site at all times.

headline: Dish sink disconnected; no soap or towels
summary: Failed. Dishwashing handsink disconnected due to leaking, so it is inaccessible; no hand soap or paper towels at sinks. Priority violations; citation issued. Ice machine interior has black and pink slimy buildup dripping onto ice.

headline: No thermometer in meat cooler; three employees lack training
summary: Passed. No thermometer in basement walk-in cooler used for meats. Three employees lacked food handler training. Torn gaskets, leaking pipe under three-compartment sink, and no covered trash in unisex employee toilet room. Greasy hood and fryers.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies or thermometer
summary: The facility had no vomit or diarrhea cleanup supplies and no metal-stem probe thermometer for checking food temperatures. Management was told to provide both, and citations were issued. Equipment cleaning and ceiling and ventilation repairs are also needed.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; floor drains
summary: Several food employees had expired food handler certificates and must renew them. Floors and floor drains in prep areas had food debris, coffee beans, and spills. Handwashing signage was missing at the front prep sink.

headline: Milk crates as shelving; no sanitary receptacle
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving throughout storage areas and must be replaced with shelving six inches off the floor. The all-gender washroom lacked a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

headline: Laundered linens stored near dry food
summary: Clean linens were stored in a dry food container with residue and condensation and were moved on site. Aluminum foil lined a salamander oven, and microwave and ice machine exteriors were soiled.

headline: No hand sink; flies found; no pest logbook
summary: Beverage prep area had no handwashing sink and must have one with hot and cold water, soap, and towels. About 12 or more live small flies were found on shelves, walls, and in the bar. No pest control logbook was on site.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; grease on hood and stove
summary: Several large containers of dry products lacked proper common-name labels. Milk crates were used as shelving, and food bags were stored inside coolers. Grease and debris were heavy on the stove and hood and filters.

headline: Cold foods above 41F; restroom water cool
summary: Food in the basement walk-in cooler measured 46.9F to 49.8F, and about 20 pounds were discarded. Hand sinks measured 74F to 79F and must reach 100F. The dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer, and a citation was issued.

headline: Paper towels exposed at sinks; no covered bins
summary: Free-standing paper towel rolls were stored at hand sinks where they were exposed to splashes and must be placed in dispensers. Unisex washrooms lacked covered receptacles. Empty cardboard boxes and an unused freezer were stored in the rear dry storage area.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; leak
summary: Several food handler certificates were expired and must be kept on site. An ice scoop was stored with its food contact surface exposed, which was corrected. A drainpipe under the rear hand sink was leaking.

headline: No written employee health policy
summary: The facility had no written employee health policy for staff. The inspector marked this as a foundation violation and required one to be provided.

headline: Rear door gap and missing door closers
summary: The rear exit door had a quarter-inch gap at the bottom, and a door sweep or seal was ordered to prevent rodent entry. Restroom doors lacked self-closing devices, and restroom fan covers were missing.

headline: Restroom sink ran under 15 seconds
summary: The metered hand sink in the women's customer restroom ran for less than 15 seconds. Management was told to repair it so water runs longer than 15 seconds for proper handwashing.

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; restroom toilet dirty
summary: Large bulk ingredient containers were not labeled with their common names. Food residue and spillage were found inside all cold hold units. The toilet base and sides needed cleaning, and no allergen training was on site for the manager.

headline: Cooler gaskets worn; burner cleaning needed
summary: Gaskets on a three-door cooler were in poor repair and must be replaced to prevent air leaks. Cooking burners and the area beneath them need cleaning. The floor under cooking equipment and under the sinks and dish machine also needs cleaning.

headline: Hand sink shut off during use; many fixes
summary: A second-floor hand sink was turned off while an employee was using the dish machine, and a citation was issued. The sink also lacked paper towels, soap, and signage, which were noted for correction. Cold holding failed, with split pea soup at 46.8F to 48.8F, and 30 pounds were discarded.

headline: Food stored on floor; hair restraint lapses
summary: Food containers and boxes were stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer and rear storage. Food handlers prepped food without hair restraints, and milk crates were used as shelving. A drainpipe leaked under the three-compartment sink, which must be repaired.

headline: Foil shelf liners; cutting boards damaged
summary: Foil was used as a liner on shelving in the rear prep area and must be removed. Cutting boards had deep scratches and stains and need to be resurfaced or replaced. Flour debris was on the floor.

headline: Hand soap missing at restroom sink
summary: The employee restroom hand sink had no soap, which was supplied on site. Milk crates were used as shelving and must be replaced. Unused slicers in the rear prep area need to be removed.

headline: Deli cooler too warm
summary: The deli and meat prep cooler measured 48.7F, above the 41F limit for cold holding. This was marked as a priority violation.

headline: Water-damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Ceiling tiles in the storage area and kitchen showed water damage. The person in charge was instructed to replace them and maintain them.

headline: Missing signs and menu warning; dead-end sealing
summary: Several hand sinks lacked handwashing signs, and the menu lacked a raw or undercooked food disclosure, which was ordered added. Uncovered utensils were noted, and an opening at the front door must be sealed. Dust and shelving issues are also listed.

headline: Bulk flour and sugar unlabeled; dim freezer
summary: Bulk flour and sugar containers were not labeled and must be labeled. Lighting in the walk-in freezer was inadequate and needed to be improved.

headline: Ice maker slime; drain line rerouted
summary: Black slimy substances were found inside the ice maker, dripping into ice used for consumption. The machine was ordered turned off and cleaned, and a citation was issued. The ice machine drain needed to be rerouted to a floor drain.

headline: Dirt and grease on floors; bar gun slime
summary: Slight pink buildup was found inside the bar gun holder and must be cleaned. Floors along walls and corners in the keg storage room had dirt, and food grease was under the basement grease trap floor.

headline: No handwashing signs; trash lid missing
summary: Handwashing sinks had no signage. The toilet room trash container lacked a lid, and floor vent covers near the three-compartment sink and cooler were missing.

headline: Grease, grime, and leaking three-compartment sink
summary: Accumulated grease and food debris was found on cooking equipment, coolers, and walls, especially along the hot food line. The three-compartment sink leaked and needed repair. Fryer oil filtering unit had buildup and was ordered cleaned.

headline: No vomit cleanup kit; no allergen certificates
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit or procedure was on site and must be provided at all times. A hood light was burnt out. No allergen training certificates were provided for certified food managers.

headline: No certified manager on site
summary: No valid City of Chicago food sanitation manager certificate was on site. A certified manager must be on site at all times, and the violation was marked as a priority foundation violation.

headline: Ice scoop stored in unclean container
summary: An ice scoop was stored in an unclean container attached to the wall. The container must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: No food manager or handler certificates on site
summary: No City of Chicago food manager certificates were on the premises, though owners held ServSafe certificates. Food handler certificates were also missing. Food containers lacked labels, and a sink pipe was leaking.

headline: Dirty drive-thru floor; cardboard liner
summary: Shelving under the soda dispensing system was dirty and must be cleaned. Cardboard liners under the soda system and deep fryer baskets are prohibited. The drive-thru window floor had dirt, debris, and food spillage.

headline: Frozen meat in plastic bags; citation issued
summary: Frozen meats were stored in plastic grocery bags in chest freezers and must use food-grade containers. A backflow device was not located at a new ice machine. A citation was issued for a greasy outside grease container dripping onto the ground.

headline: Scratched thermometer; scoops in bulk bins
summary: A probe thermometer dial was scratched and hard to read, although a digital thermometer on site was easy to read. Single-use plastic cups were used as scoops in bulk dry food containers and must be replaced with handled utensils.

headline: Ice chute slime; ice machine cleaned on site
summary: The self-serve ice machine in the dining area had thick pink and black buildup inside its ice chute. The person in charge removed the ice and cleaned the machine voluntarily. A cutting board was damaged, the grease trap smelled, and the hallway was cluttered.

headline: Hand sink water too cool; door gap noted
summary: Hand sinks in the rear toilet room measured 76F. Hand sinks must reach 100F or higher, which the inspector marked as a priority violation. Toilet room doors also need self-closing devices.

headline: Leaking faucets and ceiling tile damage
summary: Faucets and a drainpipe leaked at the bar and rear prep three-compartment sinks, and must be repaired. Stained and damaged ceiling tiles throughout the facility must be replaced. A light was out in the rear hallway, and a hood needed cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; hot food too cool
summary: No person in charge with a valid City of Chicago certificate was on the premises, and a citation was issued. Cooked bacon was held at 87.4F and was discarded. Low water pressure at hand sinks was also noted.

headline: Bare-hand food contact; ice machine slime
summary: A food handler touched ready-to-eat tortillas with bare hands, and a citation was issued. The ice machine had black and pink slime dripping onto ice used for consumption. Food was stored on floors, and food was kept in plastic grocery bags.

headline: Cooler too warm; steak and walk-in issues
summary: A steak in a cold hold unit measured 51.4F and 3 pounds were discarded. The walk-in cooler measured 49F and was serviced on site, reaching 41F afterward. Bulk containers lacked labels and cutting boards were stained.

headline: Rodent droppings still found on reinspection
summary: Over 100 rodent droppings were still found on the floor and prep tables. Priority violation issued. Cooler, freezer, and wall surfaces need cleaning, and a large hole in the wall under the prep table must be sealed.

headline: Hair restraints missing; burnt-out bulbs
summary: Food handlers in the basement prep area lacked hair restraints. Black crates were used for elevation, and dried food debris was on the floor behind bakery ovens. Burned-out bulbs and low lighting in the prep and dish areas needed fixing.

headline: Dusty serving plates; slimy soda nozzle
summary: Serving plates on shelves were not inverted and collect dust. A slimy grey substance was found inside the bar soda gun dispenser and must be cleaned and sanitized. The floor under the bar dishwasher needs cleaning.

headline: No vomit cleanup procedure or supplies
summary: There was no written procedure or adequate supplies to respond to vomit and diarrhea events. Also missing were a handwashing sign in the toilet room and an allergen training certificate for a sanitation manager.

headline: Ice machine mineral buildup; cleanup ordered
summary: Pink mineral buildup was found inside the rear ice machine and must be cleaned. Two ice scoops were stored sitting in ice. Flickering and burnt-out lights in the dish room must be repaired.

headline: Dirty coolers and hood vents
summary: Reach-in coolers, freezers, and cooking equipment had buildup. Hood vents needed grease and dust cleaning. The reinspection passed, with instructions to clean and maintain the equipment.

headline: Uncovered food and improper utensil storage
summary: Food in refrigerators and prep coolers was uncovered and must have lids or covers. An ice scoop was stored improperly on the ice, and wet wiping cloths were left on prep surfaces. A splashguard was needed by the dish sink.

headline: Single-use bowls exposed on shelf
summary: Single-use bowls and containers were stacked on a top shelf with food contact surfaces exposed. The manager was told to invert them or provide additional protection.

headline: Hand sink used for dishes; food discarded
summary: The front hand sink was used to wash dishes and was not available for handwashing, which led to a citation. Black slime was found in the ice machine. Ready-to-eat soups and beef held over 24 hours were not date-marked and were discarded.

headline: No health policy or cleanup kit
summary: There was no employee health policy and no vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit on the premises. Both were required, and the person in charge was instructed to provide them. A small ice machine needs a backflow device once it is connected.

headline: Hand sink water too hot; citation issued
summary: Prep and warewashing hand sinks measured 160F and 125F, above the 100F to 120F range required. Time-labeling procedures were not followed, and food was discarded. A three-compartment sink was too small for large onion containers.

headline: Leaking pipe and restroom door issues
summary: A pipe was leaking at the rear hand sink and must be repaired. The restroom door was not self-closing and its closer was in disrepair. Cold hold units had food grime, and the area around dumpsters had trash and grease.

headline: Flies in prep; reinspection failed
summary: More than 5 large flies flew around the produce prep area, and pest control was recommended. A citation was issued. Stained cutting boards and a black substance on a wall by the sink must be cleaned or replaced, and a previous violation was not corrected.

headline: Fryer grease and dust; cleaning ordered
summary: Fryer bottoms needed grease removal. Floors under equipment, around a hot water tank, and in all floor drains needed cleaning. Vents and light shields had dust, and a hood needed cleaning.

headline: Cooler temps high; 30 lbs discarded
summary: Raw hamburger, chicken, and eggs were held above 41F in prep coolers, and 30 pounds were discarded. Two coolers were tagged and cannot be used until reinspected. Warewashing sink water backs up, and a citation was issued.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; opening in door
summary: Handwashing sinks lacked signage in the front prep, rear prep, and dishwashing areas. An opening in the middle of the front entrance door must be sealed to prevent pests.

headline: Cooler temps too warm; 25 lbs discarded
summary: Several TCS foods in service coolers measured above 41F, including beef at 46.8F and shrimp at 44.7F. The manager voluntarily disposed of 25 pounds. Unhandled to-go containers were used for scooping food and must be replaced with proper utensils.

headline: Rodent droppings and ice machine slime
summary: About 30 mouse droppings were found in liquor storage and 2 behind a bar freezer, and extra pest control is needed. The rear ice machine had thick slime dripping onto ice. No current pest logbook was on site, and no chemical test kit was available.

headline: No manager on duty; flies and mold issues
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were prepared, and a citation was issued. About 30 or more live small flies were found in toilet and prep areas, and a citation was issued. Buckets of food were stored on the floor in walk-in units.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; pipe fixes
summary: Multiple food handlers had expired food handler certificates and must complete approved training. Other items included missing thermometers, missing signage, and a rusty rack. Backflow devices were not located at the mop sink.

headline: Over 1,000 mouse droppings; no hot water
summary: Over 1,000 mouse droppings were found in several areas, including basement and kitchen, and a citation was issued. Hot water measured 55.4F and was not available at most sinks, a priority violation. Cutting boards, plates, and a women's restroom receptacle also needed attention.

headline: Items stored outside; no mechanical vents
summary: Stored items in the rear outdoor walkway to the garbage room must be removed to prevent rodent harboring. Both washrooms need mechanical ventilation. A certified manager needs allergen training or a certificate.

headline: Mouse droppings and dead mouse; no manager
summary: About 60 or more mouse droppings were found under a deli cooler and in the rear storage area, plus a dead mouse under the deli display unit. The PIC lacked a certified food managers certificate, and no food handler training was provided. A citation was issued.

headline: Unlabeled oregano; freezer tape gasket
summary: Bulk oregano was not labeled with its common name. A two-door freezer had tape on its gasket that needs repair. Floor tiles and a ceiling tile were damaged, and buckets and boxes were stored on floors in coolers.

headline: Dish machine sanitizer at zero; citation issued
summary: The low-temperature dish machine was sanitizing at 0 ppm chlorine, but it must read at least 100 ppm. A priority citation was issued. Standing water and condensation were also found in a prep cooler.

headline: No certified manager; water too cool at sink
summary: No certified food manager was on site while eggs were prepared and served, and a citation was issued. A front prep hand sink measured 92F and must reach 100F. A citation was also issued for water temperature. Cardboard boxes at the rear door must be removed.

headline: No certified manager on site; cooler too warm
summary: No certified food manager was on site, and a citation was issued. A dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer and was serviced on site. A bar cooler measured 50F and was tagged. Several food employees lacked food handler certification.

headline: Light out in walk-in; allergen training lacking
summary: Several certified food managers lacked allergen awareness training certificates. The walk-in cooler floor had dirt and debris, and a light bulb was burned out. Cutting boards had deep scratches and stains.

headline: Hair restraints missing; cutting boards worn
summary: Food handlers in the kitchen were not wearing hair restraints. Cutting boards had deep cuts and stains and need to be restored or replaced. A microwave must be replaced, and basement boxes and items on the floor need to be elevated.

headline: Hair restraints missing; cutting board worn
summary: Food handlers were prepping food without hair restraints and must wear them at all times. A stained and worn cutting board must be replaced.

headline: Dish machine not hot enough; citation issued
summary: Dish machine sanitized at 155F, below the 160F utensil surface temperature required. A citation was issued. No irreversible temperature indicator was on site, and the certified food manager lacked allergen training. A drain leaked under the prep sink.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; citation issued
summary: Inspector saw over 100 mouse droppings in prep, storage, and basement areas, including near cooking equipment and food shelving. The manager was told to call an exterminator and clean all areas. A priority citation was issued, and prior core violations were not corrected.

headline: No original manager certificate on site
summary: The person in charge did not have an original City of Chicago sanitation certificate on site, and a citation was issued. Food boxes were stored on the floor in the basement walk-in freezer. The dish room wall and ceiling had peeling paint and mold-like buildup.

headline: Cooler temps, mice risk, and hot water failure
summary: Front counter hot holding unit held cooked chicken at 83.3F, and about 19 pounds were discarded. Hot water was unavailable throughout the premises at the start of inspection and was repaired by the end. Doors have gaps that must be rodent-proofed, and debris was found in several areas.

headline: Dust on staff washroom fan
summary: Dust buildup was found on the ventilation fan in the staff washroom. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Expired allergen training for one manager
summary: One certified manager had expired allergen training. Records of the training must be kept on site at all times.

headline: No allergen training for food manager
summary: Tortilla chips were stored under a paper towel dispenser at a hand sink and were moved. Wiping cloth buckets lacked sanitizer. The person in charge lacked allergen awareness training and certificate on site.

headline: Food held too warm; flies and cooler issues
summary: Various TCS foods were held at 45 to 50F, and about 8 pounds of ranch and other foods were discarded. Cooler air measured 46F and was tagged. More than 20 small flies were found, and a rusty rack and a women's sink with poor hot water were noted.

headline: No utility sink; installation ordered
summary: The facility had no utility sink. The manager was instructed to install one with hot and cold water and a backflow device for wastewater disposal.

headline: Trash overflow; personal items on food
summary: Outside trash overflowed and blocked the lid, creating rodent risk, but it was corrected on site. Personal items were stored on food shelves. No food handler training was available, and the last inspection summary was not posted.

headline: Missing signs, lids, and self-closing doors
summary: Extended dining area washrooms lacked handwashing signs, covered waste containers, and self-closing doors. Cutting boards in prep coolers had deep stains and cuts and must be fixed or replaced.

headline: Only one toilet room for floor
summary: Only one unisex toilet room was provided on the 33rd floor. The inspector instructed the facility to provide additional toilet rooms as required. A priority foundation violation was marked, but no citation was issued.

headline: Missing splashguard; women's restroom vent broken
summary: A splashguard must be installed between the three-compartment sink drying rack and the hand sink. The women's washroom mechanical ventilation was not working and must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Hair restraints missing; floors need cleaning
summary: A food handler on site was not wearing a hair restraint, and an instruction was given to wear one. A wiping cloth was not stored in sanitizer. Reach-in coolers and floors under equipment had food debris and dirt.

headline: No manager on site; 15 small flies found
summary: No certified food manager was on site for 27 minutes after inspection began, and a citation was issued. About 15 small flies were found in the kitchen, toilet rooms, and game room. Dumpsters were overfilled and could not close, and a citation was issued.

headline: Basement washrooms lacked handwashing signs
summary: Basement restrooms had no handwashing signs at the sinks. Grease, food debris, and dirt were found under cooking equipment and along walls and corners in several areas. The manager was told to clean them.

headline: Beverage dispenser leak; vent dust
summary: Water leaked from a beverage dispenser connection and pooled inside a two-door cabinet, and it must be repaired. Vents above the sandwich prep had dust and dirt that needed cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; dead rat found
summary: No certified manager was on site for about 20 minutes while TCS foods were prepared, and a citation was issued. A dead, decomposing rat was found at the furnace area and was ordered removed. Dumpsters were overflowing, and no employee health policy was on site.

headline: Sanitizer at zero; repairs and pest gaps noted
summary: Low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine, so it was tagged and corrected on site. An opening at the front door was found and must be sealed. Milk crates, a leaking faucet, a cool hand sink, and stained ceiling tiles were also noted.

headline: Missing signage and stoppers; bulbs out
summary: Handwashing signage was missing near the front bar sink. The three-compartment sink lacked stoppers, and a thermometer was needed inside a meat prep cooler. Leaking faucets and dirty light shields and walls need repair and cleaning.

headline: Dead mouse on glue board; mold near sink
summary: Inspector found a dead mouse on a glue board in the front ice cream prep closet, which must be removed. Stored items must be off the floor, and an ice cream scoop was left in the ice cream. Moldy caulking at the sink must be replaced.

headline: Freezer and walk-in floors need cleaning
summary: Reach-in freezer interiors needed defrosting and cleaning to remove spills and debris. Walk-in cooler floors also needed cleaning. The manager was told to provide food handler training for all staff.

headline: Mold behind dish machine; grime on units
summary: Mold was growing on the wall behind the dish machine and must be cleaned. Walls in dish and grill prep areas and the floor under the grill equipment need cleaning. Interior of a sushi cooler and deep fryers also need cleaning.

headline: Yogurt drink labels incomplete
summary: Bottles of yogurt drinks were not properly labeled with ingredients and content weight. The inspector instructed the operator to label them.

headline: Core violations repeated; pests and grime
summary: Prior core violations were not corrected, including an ice machine not maintained and an interior screen door that did not seal against pests. Open food was not covered, and floors and walls had heavy food debris. Fryers and a can opener had grease and dirt.

headline: Water too cool; backflow and drain issues
summary: The women's restroom water measured 70F, but was turned up to 107F during inspection. A hand sink lacked signage and a paper towel, which were supplied on site. Water pools from a floor drain at the warewashing sink, and a citation was issued.

headline: No manager; no HACCP plan for smoking
summary: No one on site demonstrated food safety knowledge, and no certified manager was present while food was prepared. Smoker and vacuum packaging machines were tagged and cannot be used without a HACCP plan. A hot holding unit was missing its glass panel.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: A certified food manager had no allergen training. The manager was instructed to make sure all certified food managers complete allergen training.

headline: About 20 rat droppings; citation issued
summary: About 20 rat droppings were scattered under shelving in the rear and basement dry storage areas. The person in charge was told to remove them and sanitize. Excess boxes and items on the floor must be elevated six inches. Ice machine door buildup also needs cleaning.

headline: Ice machine not clean; pest logs outdated
summary: The interior of the ice machine was not clean and must be removed, cleaned, and sanitized. Pest control logbooks had no recent service records. Excess grease and food debris was under the kitchen fryer. A citation was issued.

headline: Juice bar lacks handwashing sink
summary: A juice bar in the front service area had no access to a handwashing sink, which must be installed with hot and cold water, soap, and paper towels. A citation was issued. The service sink in the rear also lacked a backflow device.

headline: No certified manager during egg prep; training gaps
summary: No city-certified food manager was on site 8:35–10:20 AM while eggs and other TCS foods (foods that must stay hot or cold) were prepared. Only 1 of 6 workers had food handler training. Leaky faucet and slow drain noted.

headline: No manager until 9:55 AM; sanitizer fixed on site
summary: No city-certified manager was on premises while ham and potatoes were prepared and served until 9:55 AM, when one arrived. The low-temperature dish machine read 10 ppm chlorine and was repaired on site to 50 ppm. Passed with conditions.

headline: Rusted sump pump cover needs replacement
summary: The basement sump pump cover was heavily rusted and no longer easy to clean. The pump itself works fully. The person in charge was instructed to repair or replace the cover.

headline: No outside dumpster; bulk containers unlabeled; failed
summary: Bulk salt, sugar, and flour containers in the rear had no labels. No commercial outside dumpster service was provided, a priority violation with a citation. Water-stained ceiling tiles in the dining room needed replacing. Failed.

headline: Milk crate shelving and leaking sink faucet
summary: Milk crates were used for shelving and storage in the rear prep area and must be replaced with shelving 6 inches off the floor. The three-compartment sink faucet was leaking. The ceiling above the rear prep and dish area needed sealing. Passed.

headline: Dirty drains and loose dish unit
summary: Rear food service drains had dirt and food debris, and splatter was on the wall under the dish unit. The dish unit at the end of the line was coming loose from the wall. Both areas needed cleaning and resealing. Passed.

headline: Missing backflow device at coffee machine
summary: No backflow prevention device was at the coffee and espresso machine in the front cashier area. The business must install or relocate one. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; yogurt made without plan
summary: The low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine in the final rinse and was ordered repaired. Yogurt was fermented without an approved HACCP plan (a written food safety plan), and about 60 gallons was discarded. Passed with conditions.

headline: Greasy fryers and duct tape on sink sprayer
summary: Fryer interiors had thick grease, dirt, and food buildup and were told to be detail cleaned. The 3-compartment sink sprayer was held together with duct tape. Floors and hood filters needed cleaning. Passed.

headline: Soiled cloths and gloves on food surfaces
summary: Wiping cloths air-dried on prep tables and sink edges, and soiled cloth gloves were on equipment in the rear meat walk-in. Scale covers were torn, and display cooler gaskets were missing or damaged. A cracked deli floor drain grate was noted. Passed.

headline: Rat droppings and missing health procedures; failed
summary: About 25–30 rat droppings were found on dining room, storage, and mop sink floors. No employee health policy and no vomiting or diarrhea cleanup kit were on site. Missing sink stoppers, test strips, and allergen records. Failed inspection.

headline: Uneven floor in front of ice machine
summary: Complaint inspection found the floor in front of the ice machine was not smooth. The business must repair it. No other violations were listed.

headline: Missing thermometers and handwashing sink not working
summary: Thermometers were needed inside several walk-in coolers and the sushi prep cooler. A portable handwashing sink in the juice room had no hot or cold water and was tagged held for inspection. Covers and cleaning were also needed.

headline: Door gaps, garbage food storage, and rust
summary: Gaps along the bottom of the front doors must be closed to prevent rodent entry. Food was stored in garbage cans and black bags in the walk-in freezer. Worn gaskets, crates, rust, and mold on the walk-in exterior needed fixing. Passed.

headline: Restroom door and trash receptacle issues found
summary: Restroom door was not self-closing and the unisex restroom had no covered receptacle. Peeling paint above the three-compartment sink must be repaired. Inspector instructed the person in charge to fix each item.

headline: No handwashing sink in basement prep area
summary: Basement rear prep area had no exposed handwashing sink, which must be installed. Rust was found on three freezer shelving units, and no temperature indicator was available for the warewashing machine. Garbage cart exteriors needed cleaning.

headline: All food handlers need handler certificates
summary: Re-inspection found that all food handlers lacked food handler certificates. The business must provide and maintain them on site. Overall result passed.

headline: No certified manager on duty; citation issued
summary: No valid city-certified manager was on duty while chicken, beans, and coleslaw were prepared and served. Employees on duty lacked food handler training, and the inspector warned citations would follow. Walls behind the prep station were dirty.

headline: Gap at exit door; tile and wall repairs needed
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the east exit door must be repaired so outer openings are protected. Rust on the grease trap, leaks under sinks, and cracked tiles and holes in the women's restroom wall were noted.

headline: Cold foods above safe temperature; coolers tagged
summary: Yogurt, tomato salad, cooked beans, kimchi, and cut greens were held above 41°F, reaching up to 64.1°F. About 25 lbs was discarded on site. Two three-door coolers at 54.2°F and 52.3°F were tagged and removed from use until repaired.

headline: No manager certificate; handwashing supplies missing
summary: The person in charge lacked an original city manager certificate while TCS foods were prepared. Bar hand sink had no soap, and no paper towels were at washroom or prep sinks, both obtained during the inspection. A dish machine at 0 ppm was tagged.

headline: Greasy ovens; passed
summary: Ovens had an accumulation of grease. The business was instructed to clean and maintain them. No other violations were noted.

headline: Hole in basement ceiling; peeled wall base
summary: Re-inspection found a hole in the basement storage and dish area ceiling that needed sealing. The wall base under the low-temperature dish machine was missing and needed replacing. Overall result passed.

headline: About 149 lbs of moldy cheese discarded
summary: Cheese displayed for sale had mold and was past its expiration date, and about 149 lbs was discarded. Several TCS foods were not date-marked. Dead insects were found on the basement floor. Flan was not properly labeled.

headline: Storage, labeling, and cleaning fixes needed
summary: Food storage containers needed labels and food stored on the walk-in freezer floor needed to be moved. Grease and debris were found on fryers, shelving, and floors. Wet mops and brooms needed a hanging system. Several burnt-out or cracked lights.

headline: Door gaps and missing food handler certificates
summary: Multiple 1/4-inch gaps at the west rear exit door sweep must be sealed to be rodent proof. Some food handlers lacked hair restraints, and food handler certification was still missing for employees. Passed with conditions.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; no handler proof
summary: No handwashing signs were near exposed sinks in food prep, dish, and restroom areas. A thermometer was needed in the upright cooler. Sink leaks and slow drains were found. No proof of food handler training for required employees.

headline: No manager certificate; citation issued
summary: The person in charge did not have a city sanitation manager certificate, and no certified manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared. Inadequate wok lighting, grease, and rust in a refrigerator were noted. Summary report was not posted.

headline: Handwashing signage and crack repairs needed
summary: Handwashing signage was damaged or missing at some sinks. Bulk ingredients were now labeled correctly. Cardboard was on the walk-in freezer shelf, and cracks, a restroom residue buildup, and no covered receptacle were noted. Passed.

headline: Two roaches killed; no sanitizer on site
summary: Two roaches were seen in the kitchen, one on a prep table and one inside the three-compartment sink, and were killed and removed on site. Chlorine sanitizer was missing and was delivered before the inspection ended. Utility sink needed a backflow device.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and covered receptacle
summary: A handwashing sign was missing at the men's restroom sink. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables and grease buildup was on cooking equipment. The women's restroom needed a covered receptacle. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Missing handwashing sign and unlocked cooler
summary: A handwashing sign was missing in the restroom. A prep cooler in the dining area was left unlocked, risking customer contamination. The three-compartment sink was not labeled, and peeling paint was behind it. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Hair restraints, cutting boards, and no handler certificates
summary: Longer hair needed tighter restraint. Cutting boards in the deli needed replacement, and the deli case had black buildup. Floors and cooking equipment needed detail cleaning. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Missing sink stoppers and cluttered basement
summary: The bar 3-compartment sink was missing stoppers that must be provided. The basement tool room floor was cluttered, and items must be raised off the floor or removed. Passed.

headline: Two food handlers lacked training; glass in ice
summary: A glass bottle was stored in the ice machine, which must never be done for drink ice. Two employees lacked food handler training. Grease, grime, and food debris were on fryers, walls, and floors. Manager allergen training had expired.

headline: Food containers stored improperly
summary: Food containers were found stored improperly and must be stored inverted, which means upside down, to keep them clean. No other violations were noted.

headline: Detail cleaning needed across kitchen
summary: Reach-in cooler gaskets, walk-in shelves, condenser, cooking equipment, and floors all needed detail cleaning. Both 3-compartment sinks had leaking faucets, and the employee toilet needed cleaning. Passed.

headline: No hand soap; standing water near ice maker
summary: Both hand sinks in the main prep kitchen had no soap, a priority violation. Paper cups were used for storage, and the employee restroom door was not self-closing. Standing water near the ice maker must be kept dry to reduce insect breeding. Passed with conditions.

headline: Missing handler and allergen training; broken device
summary: No food handler or allergen training certificates were on site. A broken backflow device at the utility sink must be replaced. Dirty cloth curtains, an unlined foil use, and food stored on the walk-in floor were noted. A citation was issued.

headline: Expired handler certificates and greasy hood vent
summary: Some food handler training certificates had expired and employees must get valid ones. The three-compartment sink faucet neck leaked. Fryers, cooler interiors, floors, and the hood system behind the vents needed cleaning.

headline: Soil buildup on floor near dish sink
summary: Complaint inspection found soil buildup on the floor in the rear dish and mop sink area. The manager was instructed to clean and maintain the floors. No other violations were listed.

headline: Ice machine dirt; cooler foods too warm; failed
summary: Black dirt buildup in the ice machine was dripping into ice used for drinks, and the ice was discarded. Beef, tomato soup, vodka sauce, and artichokes in the walk-in were held at 45.7–50°F and discarded. Failed.

headline: About 20 ants; greasy floors; failed
summary: About 20 ants were found on floors, walls, and booths in the dining and prep areas. Dirt, grease, and spills were behind and under heavy equipment, and prep area floors were covered in grease. Pest control was required. Failed.

headline: No manager until end; mold, tomatoes too warm; failed
summary: No certified manager was on site while eggs were cooked, and one arrived at the end. Ice machine had black slime dripping onto ice. Sliced tomatoes at 44.6–48.6°F were discarded. Pest control logbook lacked 2026 reports.

headline: Live roaches and rat droppings found; failed
summary: About 7 live roaches and over 30 rat droppings were found, plus over 20 mouse droppings under the front counter and in the basement. Inspector instructed the manager to call an exterminator and clean all areas. Failed inspection.

headline: No proof of food handler training
summary: Complaint inspection found no proof of food handler training for employees. The inspector instructed the business to meet the requirement. No other violations were listed.

headline: Packaged desserts missing allergen labels
summary: Packaged cookies and cake slices were not labeled and were missing allergen information, a priority violation with a citation. Ice scoops and tongs were stored inside containers, plates were not inverted, and grease and dirt were under equipment.

headline: No certificate on site; dishwasher not sanitizing; failed
summary: No one with a city sanitation certificate was on site while TCS foods were handled. The low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged. Raw chicken and salmon at 45–46°F were in a cooler and chicken was discarded. Failed.

headline: No employee health policy on site
summary: No employee health policy or training was on site, which the business must establish and keep on site with verifiable records. No backflow prevention device was provided at the ice machine or coffee machine. Passed with conditions.

headline: Unlabeled containers and dirty cooler interior
summary: Dry storage containers were not labeled with their common name. Cooler interiors, door gaskets, and walk-in wire racks had food debris, and a leak was under the handwashing sink. The wall behind the 3-compartment sink needed cleaning.

headline: Dish machine too cool to sanitize; tagged
summary: The high-temperature dish machine in the bar area could not reach 180°F sanitizing temperature and was tagged for repair. Microwave handles were broken or missing, and ovens and fryers had encrusted grease. No citation was issued.

headline: Debris and clutter under shelving
summary: Food debris, dust, and excessive items were under shelving on the selling floor and needed cleaning. The business was instructed to clean all areas where needed. Passed.

headline: Hair restraints missing; outdoor area not clean
summary: Some food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. The outside storage and enclosed receptacle area was not clean and needed to be decluttered and organized.

headline: Over 75 rat droppings; failed inspection
summary: About 75 or more rat droppings were found on floors and bricks in the basement, under and between crates and storage racks. Droppings must be removed and areas sanitized. A pest control service was recommended. Failed inspection.

headline: Unapproved sous vide; dead ants and pest device issues
summary: Chicken was vacuum-packed for sous vide cooking without a city variance. The person in charge voluntarily removed the packaging and equipment. About 30–40 dead ants were found in basement storage, and a pest device sat above an open cloth bucket.

headline: No posted manager certificate; hood greasy
summary: Only a copy of the certified food manager certificate was on site, not the original posted. Some food handlers lacked hair restraints and no food handler certificates were on premises. Hood and filters had grease buildup.

headline: Missing thermometer; failed for no food handler proof
summary: The two-door prep cooler needed a visible, working thermometer. The 3-compartment sink had no chemical test strips to check sanitizer strength. Missing food handler training proof for required employees and open wall and pipe gaps were noted. Failed.

headline: Walk-in cooler too warm; 25 live flies; failed
summary: The walk-in cooler ran at 53°F, too warm for TCS foods, and was tagged held for inspection. About 25 live flies were on the dining room ceiling, and the rear exit door had a 1/4-inch gap. Pest control service was required. Failed.

headline: About 15 rat droppings; failed inspection
summary: About 15 rat droppings were found on floors in the dining area, rear storage, and the rear three-compartment sink area. Missing handwashing sign, sink stoppers, a vomiting kit and procedure, and allergen training were also noted. Failed.

headline: Unlabeled containers and cardboard liners
summary: A food grade container of sugar and cheese was not labeled. Cases of water were on the walk-in floor, and cardboard was used as a prep table liner. A damaged gasket and missing covered receptacle and self-closing restroom door were noted.

headline: No certified manager; leaking sink; failed
summary: No certified manager was on duty while TCS foods were handled. The prep hand sink had a leaky pipe and was not accessible. No food handler certificates were on site, a repeat violation from 2021. Failed inspection.

headline: No health policy or vomit kit; citation issued
summary: No employee health policy and no vomiting or diarrhea kit with norovirus-effective sanitizer were on site. Food in coolers was unlabeled, and grease and debris were heavy on walls, floors, and fryer filters. Citation issued.

headline: Slime in ice machines; no cooler thermometers; failed
summary: Two ice machines near the dish area had black and pink slime, and ice was stored beneath them. The warewashing machine had no working temperature gauges. Outside dumpster lids were missing and broken. Failed.

headline: Cleaning and storage issues across kitchen
summary: Worn scrub pads, an ice scoop stored outside the ice, worn cooler gaskets, and grease on fryers and grills were noted. Floors, air vents, and the hood needed detail cleaning. Hand sinks lacked waste cans for paper towels.

headline: Unlabeled containers and dumpster overflow; failed
summary: Butter and flour containers lacked labels, and wiping cloths were stored on a cart. A dumpster was overflowing with trash and cardboard, and a previous violation was not corrected. Failed inspection.

headline: Food handler without training; trash uncovered
summary: A food handler without food handler training was at the premises. Another food handler lacked a hair restraint, and the restroom trash can was uncovered. Reach-in cooler interiors behind the counter were not clean. Passed.

headline: No certified manager; sanitation and rodent gaps
summary: No city-certified manager was on premises until 10:50 AM. No food handler training was provided for any food handlers, and no written procedure supplies were on site for vomiting or diarrhea. Leaks at sinks and an opening at the exit door were noted. Failed.

headline: Live roaches, small flies, and missing sinks; failed
summary: Two live roaches and dead roaches were found under the front counter, plus live small flies near the basement wall and mop sink drain. Missing items included employee health policy, hand drying supplies, and pizza hot-holding units. Failed inspection.

headline: Salsa too warm; thawing and food handler training issues
summary: Green and red salsa on the prep cooler was held at 46–56°F and discarded. Beef tongue was thawing in a sink without running water. No food temperature thermometer was on site, and food handler training was missing. Failed.

headline: Beard guard and uncovered restroom receptacle
summary: A male food handler did not wear a beard guard, which is required for food handlers with beards. The women's restroom receptacle had no lid and must be covered. Passed.

headline: Rat droppings, hot and cold food too warm; failed
summary: Over 200 rat droppings and over 100 small flies were found in the rear storage area. Hot foods ran as low as 110°F and cold foods up to 55.9°F. About 60 lbs of hot food and 350 lbs of cold food were discarded. Failed.

headline: Missing hair restraints; no handler certificates
summary: Food handlers needed hair restraints. The front prep area had heavy grease and food splatter, two light shields were missing, and no food handler certificates or allergen training for the certified manager were on site.

headline: Hot rice scooped with a bowl; soiled cloths
summary: A small bowl was used as a scoop for hot rice in the hot holding unit, and fish was in direct contact with ice in seafood coolers. Soiled wiping cloths were on counters, and mops were stored in buckets. Passed.

headline: Handwashing signs and food debris issues
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at exposed sinks, and a soap dispenser was mounted above a two-compartment sink. Foil was used as shelf liner. Food debris was under cooking equipment. A certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Drink machine nozzles and fryer areas need cleaning
summary: Drink machine nozzles and the area around them needed detail cleaning to remove buildup. Floors around and under the fryers were greasy and had food spills. Inspector instructed the business to clean and maintain both areas.

headline: Scoops in contact with food; light and filter issues
summary: Scoops were stored with handles touching food in bins and spice containers. A cooler door was loose, a hood filter was dislodged, and one walk-in light was too dim. Allergen training was missing for all certified managers.

headline: Chicken not reheated properly; discarded
summary: Grilled chicken and tenders were held at 94–104.5°F, not reheated to 165°F first, and about 20 lbs was discarded on site. Cooling mushrooms and quinoa were covered, and line coolers lacked thermometers. Passed with conditions.

headline: Hot food too cool; expired handler certificates; failed
summary: Pre-cooked sausages at 125.6°F and gyros at 77.2°F were below 135°F and discarded. Employee food handler certifications had expired, a repeat core violation. Consumer advisory was missing on the menu. Failed.

headline: Missing handler and allergen training
summary: One certified manager lacked the required food allergen training and was instructed to obtain it. Food handlers were instructed to obtain their food handler training. No other violations were listed. Passed.

headline: No certified manager; rat droppings; failed
summary: Over 90 rat droppings and over 30 small flies were found throughout the facility. Cold foods were held at 47.8–54.9°F, and the manager discarded 0.5 lbs on site. No certified manager was present. Failed inspection.

headline: Clutter in both basements; re-inspection passed
summary: Re-inspection found clutter in both basements. The business was instructed to remove unnecessary items and organize the space. Overall result passed.

headline: No cold water at three-compartment sink
summary: The 3-compartment sink had no cold water and must be repaired. Grease built up on the outside oil tank. Expired allergen training certificates were noted for certified food managers. Passed.

headline: Missing mop hangers and dim cooler lighting
summary: No mop hangers were available at the mop sink area, and the walk-in cooler had inadequate lighting. The business was instructed to install hangers and provide better lighting.

headline: No manager on site; cooler and training issues
summary: No certified manager was on site, and Italian beef was held at 50.1°F, with about 10 lbs discarded. Multiple employees lacked food handler training, and allergen training certificates were missing. A summary report was not posted, a citation was issued.

headline: Food debris and grime on floors and walls
summary: Food debris and grime were on floors and walls in the prep and locker areas and needed to be detail cleaned. No other violations were listed. Passed.

headline: Employee eating in kitchen
summary: An employee was seen eating in the kitchen food production area. The employee was told not to eat in the kitchen. No other violations were listed.

headline: Loose door strip and dirty shelving
summary: The strip on the front entry door was loose at the bottom and must be repaired to keep pests out. Dirty shelves, cardboard and foil liners, a food-coated cooler base, and greasy floors were noted. Passed.

headline: Scoops stored in contact with food; leaks
summary: Scoops and spoons were stored with food-contact surfaces exposed near the cooking equipment and were told to invert them. A leak at the 3-compartment sink faucet and a damaged baseboard were also noted. Passed.

headline: Buffet foods too cool; food discarded
summary: Chicken wings, rice, soup, and carrots were served buffet-style without heating and were at 118–125°F, below the required 135°F. About 50 lbs was discarded. The ice machine interior and drink nozzles needed cleaning. Passed with conditions.

headline: No sanitation certificate on site until 11 AM
summary: No person with an original city sanitation certificate was on site until a manager arrived at 11:00 AM. A backflow device was missing at the ice machine, and an opening at both exit doors and black moldlike caulking were noted. Passed with conditions.

headline: Hair restraints missing; collapsed ceiling panels
summary: Several food handlers did not wear hair restraints. Dirt was on floors and walls in prep and bar areas, and multiple ceiling panels had collapsed near the rear prep sink. One food handler had an expired certificate. Passed.

headline: Can opener blade cleaned on site
summary: The can opener blade at the prep table was not clean and was cleaned on site during the inspection. No other violations were listed.

headline: Sanitizing failures and discarded TCS foods
summary: Dishes were washed with no sanitizer and the 3-compartment sink was not set up. Cooked beef at 115.6°F and eggs at 68.3°F were discarded. Food was stored on the walk-in floor, and expired food handler and allergen training were found.

headline: No certified manager; cooler too warm, food discarded
summary: No certified manager was on duty while TCS foods were prepared. Pizzas and other cold foods were held at up to 50.5°F, and 3 lbs were discarded. The front prep cooler read 50.1°F and was tagged held for inspection.

headline: No certified manager; mold on soda machine
summary: No certified manager or original certificate was on site while fried chicken and tacos were prepared. Mold-like substance was found inside the soda fountain, which the person in charge cleaned on site. Raw chicken was thawing at room temperature.

headline: Gap at back door; food stored in grocery bags
summary: An opening about 3/4 inch at the back exit door corner must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Food was stored on basement floors and inside grocery bags in freezers. Dirty fixtures and a leaking basement faucet were noted. Passed.

headline: Cleaning, plumbing, and lighting issues found
summary: Water was leaking from the water heater, and backflow devices were missing at the ice machine and coffee machine. Floors and ceiling needed detail cleaning, and the basement storage was cluttered. A burnt-out light was noted over the hood.

headline: Wiping cloth on dish machine; leaks
summary: A wiping cloth was stored on top of the dish machine instead of in sanitizing solution. The 3-compartment sink in the prep area had a leaking hot water knob. Floors behind the ice machine and cooling equipment had dirt. Passed.

headline: No handwashing signs; hair restraints needed
summary: Re-inspection found no handwashing signs at the rear prep and toilet room sinks. No ambient air thermometer was in the two-door cooler, some dry storage containers were unlabeled, and food handlers lacked hair restraints. Passed.

headline: Dead roaches on glue board under dish area
summary: Dead roaches were found on a glue board under the dish washing area and were to be removed, cleaned, and maintained. Serving plates were not stored inverted, and the sprayer at the 3-compartment sink hung below the rim. Passed.

headline: Failed: no CFM, no health policy, no sanitizer on site
summary: Person in charge had no Chicago certified food manager (CFM) certificate. Also missing: employee health policy, vomit/diarrhea supplies, sanitizer, refrigeration, food thermometer, pest control proof, and sanitizer test device. Unknown-source paletas and hand-packed ice cream were offered.

headline: Boxes on floor; hair restraints and wiping cloths issues
summary: Wine boxes were stored on the floor in the walk-in wine cooler. Food handlers prepped without hair restraints. Wet wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizer. Grease, debris and dirt were on floors and walls, and a kitchen hood light was burned out.

headline: Dirt and food debris on floors
summary: Short-form complaint passed. Dirt and food debris were found on floors throughout the prep and warewashing areas. The person in charge was told to detail clean the floors.

headline: Unlabeled containers; missing certificates
summary: Re-inspection passed. Dry ingredient containers and a squirt bottle were unlabeled. Plastic balls were used as sink stoppers. Missing: food handler and allergen certificates. Also needed: a lidded receptacle in the women's restroom and cleaning under the sink.

headline: Dead mouse found in basement; removed on site
summary: A dead mouse was found on the basement floor and removed on site, which corrected the violation. Other findings: no employee health policy, no self-closing washroom door, a non-working washroom fan, clutter, two holes to seal, and food handler training required.

headline: Residue in cold-holding unit
summary: Complaint passed. Residue was found on the interior of a two-door cold-holding unit. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: No backflow device at mop sink
summary: No backflow prevention device was found at the mop sink faucet. The inspector required one be installed where it can be serviced.

headline: Unlabeled rice, pasta and flour
summary: Rice, pasta and flour in the storage office had no labels. The inspector required labels with food names after transfer from original packaging.

headline: Uncorrected core violation; missing certificates
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions. A core violation from 9/23/2024 was not corrected, and a citation was issued. No food handler certificates were on site. One certified food manager lacked allergen training. Dry food containers needed labels.

headline: Cooked chicken at room temperature; coolers too warm
summary: Cooked chicken sat at 79°F next to the grill; about 8 lbs were discarded. Two coolers held TCS foods at 49–53°F; about 36 lbs were discarded, and two refrigerators were tagged and held. Also found: missing thermometers, sticky traps over food, grease, and an uncorrected backflow issue.

headline: No certified manager on site while serving raw fish
summary: No Chicago certified food manager (CFM) or posted certificate was present while raw fish and sushi rice were served, and a citation was issued. Also missing: consumer raw-food advisory, sushi rice pH lab records, pest control logbook, food handler and allergen certificates.

headline: Uncorrected training violations; citation issued
summary: Two food employees worked without food handler training, and the manager's allergen training was expired. Both violations were carried from a 1/9/2024 report and not corrected, and a citation was issued. Also found: yellow grime in ice machine, torn walk-in gasket, and a missing hood light.

headline: Dirty floors in rear prep and dish area
summary: Re-inspection passed. The floors in the rear food prep and dishwashing area needed cleaning, and the inspector instructed staff to clean and maintain them.

headline: Labeling and wiping cloth storage issues; leaking condenser
summary: Re-inspection passed. Dry food containers needed common-name labels. Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizer between uses. A condenser pipe leaked inside the walk-in with no food beneath it. Cardboard was used as floor matting, and allergen certificates were missing.

headline: Hot food and raw chicken out of temperature; discarded
summary: Fried chicken wings held at 87–112°F were discarded, about 10 lbs. Raw chicken in the walk-in freezer reached 59–65°F; about 20 lbs were discarded. Two hand sinks lacked hot water and were repaired on site. All food handler certificates were expired.

headline: No certified manager sign; no posted summary; citation
summary: No city food sanitation certificate was posted, and a certified food manager must be present when TCS foods are prepared, with a citation issued. No inspection summary was posted, also cited. Also: a hot water handle needed repair and a restroom fan was missing.

headline: Fly strip over food prep area; gaps at doors
summary: A fly strip was hanging directly over the rear food prep and dishwashing area and must be relocated. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door and back door needs a tight seal. A 3-compartment sink stopper was broken and milk crates were used as shelving.

headline: Missing thermometer and labels; debris and flour on shelves
summary: Re-inspection passed. A mini cooler lacked an ambient air thermometer. Basement food storage containers lacked common-name labels. Flour and debris were on shelving, an opening was found under the dishwasher drainboard, and floors had debris.

headline: Food stored on basement floor; grease and clutter
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food was stored on the floor in the basement walk-in cooler and must be kept at least 6 inches up. Also found: heavy grease on an electrical box and wall base near fryers, standing green water under a basement sink, and clutter.

headline: Missing thermometers and stoppers; torn gasket
summary: Re-inspection passed. No ambient air thermometers were inside reach-in or display coolers. A freezer door gasket in prep was torn. Sink stoppers were missing from all three compartments of the rear dish sink.

headline: No food handler or allergen certificates on premises
summary: Re-inspection passed. No food handler certificates were on premises. No allergen training certificate was on premises.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; greasy outside receptacle
summary: Complaint passed. Hand sinks in bar and kitchen prep areas had no handwashing signs; the manager was told to add them. The outside grease receptacle had light buildup.

headline: Failed: no food handler certificates; heavy grease
summary: No food handler training certificates were on site. Heavy grease was on equipment exteriors and inside a fryer. Boxes and items were stored on the basement floor. A previous priority violation for grease and dirt in the grill and fryer area was not corrected, and a citation was issued.

headline: Dead insects under rear storage shelves
summary: Complaint passed. Dead insects were under shelves in the rear dry storage area. The inspector instructed staff to clean and sanitize.

headline: Dirty fixtures, moldy caulk, missing vent cover
summary: License passed. Found: dirty soda ice chute, dirty toilet, dirty floor drain with missing cover, moldy caulk at sinks, food spills in walk-in, and a missing vent cover. Soiled mop heads and duster were stored improperly. Food handler and allergen proof were missing.

headline: Live roaches and flies; raw food too warm; citation
summary: About 7 live roaches were found near cooking equipment, an outlet and behind a pizza oven, plus about 15 live small flies. Raw chicken at 48.7°F and raw eggs at 54.1°F were in the walk-in; 5 lbs ($50) were voluntarily discarded. Citations were issued. Dead roaches were also found.

headline: Dirty ice bin interior
summary: The ice bin interior needed cleaning. The inspector instructed the staff to remove ice, clean, and maintain it.

headline: Foil on shelves; worn flooring; broken door handle
summary: Complaint passed. Aluminum foil was on front counter storage shelves. The walk-in cooler door handle was in poor repair. Unused equipment in the rear and worn, uneven flooring between the bar and service counter need attention.

headline: Food debris along back walls
summary: Food debris was along back walls and under tall rolling carts, and the inspector ordered cleaning. A broom and dustpan were stored between the dish machine and dish racks, where they could contaminate clean dishes.

headline: Failed: no sanitation certificate; no vomit kit; sink disconnected
summary: No valid city food sanitation certificate was posted, and a citation was issued. No vomit and diarrhea kit or procedure was on site. A front prep hand sink was disconnected awaiting parts, also cited. Grease, dust and debris were on equipment and floors. Two bulbs were burned out.

headline: No certified manager on site; citation issued
summary: The person in charge lacked a city sanitation certificate, and no certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared and served. A citation was issued. Plastic and milk crates were used for elevation in storage rooms, and a ceiling tile was missing above the prep area.

headline: Grease buildup; no allergen training for manager
summary: Cardboard was used as floor liner in food prep. Grease had built up on cooking equipment, along wall bases and floors. A light shield was missing, and the manager had no proof of allergen training.

headline: Employee items above sink; greasy floor by fryer
summary: Handwashing signage and paper towels were at a two-compartment sink and were to be removed. Employee personal care items were stored above clean equipment. Single-service cups were on the floor in storage. Grease buildup under the fryer and griddle needed cleaning.

headline: No vomit/diarrhea cleanup plan; backflow device missing
summary: Inspector found no written procedure or supplies for vomiting and diarrhea cleanups, including norovirus-effective sanitizer. A backflow device was not located at the mop sink. Rear storage and furnace closet were cluttered, a possible pest hiding spot.

headline: Debris in floor drains; no allergen certificate
summary: Debris and residue were found in all floor drains, which the person in charge was told to clean. No allergen training certificate was on site for the certified manager.

headline: Food on floor; hair restraint violations
summary: Re-inspection passed. Two bins and a pot of meat were stored on the floor. Two food handlers lacked hair restraints. The ice machine had pink and brown buildup. Missing handwashing signs, storage clutter, and an expired allergen certificate for the manager were also found.

headline: No certified manager on site during TCS food prep
summary: No Chicago certified food manager (CFM) was on site while TCS foods were prepared and served, and a citation was issued. A handler washed hands only after the inspector informed him, and handlers wore gloves while multitasking. Also found: fish thawing in sink water, ceiling and vent dirt, and no allergen certificate.

headline: Non-service dogs inside; no hot water
summary: Non-service dogs were brought inside, and a citation was issued. No hot running water was found; sink temperatures were about 81–83°F, below required levels. A second citation was issued. Milk crates were used for elevation inside the walk-in.

headline: Chemicals stored on floor; poor wall repairs
summary: Chemicals stored at the three-compartment sink must be raised off the floor. Drywall and raw wood were used to elevate equipment and mount hoses, which is not allowed. Caulking at the sink was cracked and bumpy and must be replaced.

headline: Leaking pipe; peeling flooring; grease buildup
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. A leaky pipe under the dish-area hand sink must be repaired. Other findings: nonworking cooler thermometers, unlabeled squeeze bottles and shakers, missing splashguards, grooved cutting boards, grease and debris in coolers, and peeling epoxy flooring.

headline: Hand washing lapses; no certified manager on site
summary: Food handlers did not wash hands when multitasking or changing gloves, a priority citation. No certified food manager (CFM) or certificate was on site while TCS foods were prepared, and a citation was issued. A handler lacked a hair restraint. Other items included ice machine buildup and expired certificates.

headline: Undated TCS food discarded; live flies throughout
summary: About 75 lbs of time/temperature-controlled (TCS) foods lacked dates and were discarded voluntarily. A citation was issued. About 35 or more small live black flies were found in bar, prep, dishwashing, breakfast and seating areas. Floors also need cleaning.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; unlabeled bulk foods
summary: No handwashing signage at the hand sink. Bulk containers of sugar, flour and similar foods were unlabeled. Food containers were not stored inverted.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; grooved cutting board
