summary: Complaint passed. A torn gasket was found on a two-door prep cooler. A rear prep cutting board had deep grooves and dark stains. Both must be repaired or replaced.

headline: No written employee health policy on premises
summary: The establishment had no written employee health policy on premises. Management was told to provide a signed health policy for each employee. This is a priority foundation violation.

headline: Crates as shelving; no mop sink; damaged floors
summary: License passed. Crates were used for storage and must be replaced with shelving. A mop sink with hot and cold water must be installed. Damaged floor tiles, stained ceiling tiles, peeling paint, weeds near the rear exit, and a slow drain were also noted.

headline: Holes in walls; food debris; ice machine backflow
summary: Re-inspection passed. Handwashing signs were missing, and a brownish substance was in the ice machine. Fryers had grease and debris. The ice machine backflow device could not be located. Holes, missing coving, stored items on ground and food debris were also noted.

headline: Fly activity corrected; doors not rodent proof
summary: Fly activity was noted as corrected after pest control service. The front and rear exit doors were not rodent proof. Thermometers were missing from all cooling units. Bulk containers in all three prep areas lacked labels, and a certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Missing splashguard; damaged cooler gaskets
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. A splashguard was needed at the front prep hand sink. A wastewater pipe in the basement ceiling must be encased. Damaged gaskets and peeling shelf paint were found. Utility sink backflow devices, a self-closing door, and a covered receptacle were also needed.

headline: Thermometer missing; floors under coolers dirty
summary: A visible thermometer was required inside a reach-in cooler. The inspector instructed the staff to detail clean the floors under and behind coolers in the kitchen.

headline: No certified manager for 1 hour; beef too warm
summary: No certified manager was on site from 8:15 to 9:20 AM while TCS foods were prepared, and a citation was issued. Ten lbs of beef at 49.7°F were held in the front cooler; 9 lbs were discarded. Grease, dirt and debris were on walls, floors and equipment.

headline: Frozen buildup above food in cooler
summary: Frozen condensation had built up on coils above food in the long cooler outside the office. The inspector required defrosting. A chest freezer lid by the office was also in disrepair.

headline: Door gap and greasy debris behind fryers
summary: The west side entrance door had a half-inch gap at the bottom and must be made tight-fitting and rodent proof. Grease debris was found behind fryers and under and around cooking equipment, and the inspector required cleaning.

headline: Roach activity noted; wood needs replacing
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Wood in the front prep area where roach activity was noted needs replacing. Other findings: grease on cooking equipment, floors under fryers needing detail cleaning, and debris around the garbage container.

headline: Missing splashguards; greasy debris; burned bulbs
summary: Two hand sinks lacked splashguards. Mozzarella cooling units and shelving had dried food debris and splatter. One hand sink in a third-floor restroom was in poor repair. Broken wall base near fryers and burned-out bulbs were also noted.

headline: Dish machine sanitizer at zero; fixed on site
summary: The low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm sanitizer and was tagged. A technician fixed it, and it tested at 100 ppm, so the tag was removed. Also found: food handler certificates missing for all employees, gaps at a cooler door, cardboard liners, and repeat violations.

headline: Failed: blocked hand sink; no sanitizing; dates missing
summary: The cook-line hand sink was blocked by a garbage can and food cart. Soap and paper towels were missing; these were provided during inspection. Dishes were washed without sanitizing and re-washed on site. About 100 lbs of TCS foods had no dates and were discarded. Citations were issued.

headline: Scoops stored in food; mops stored wet
summary: Scoops were stored in dry storage bins with handles touching food. Food debris was in hinges and crevices of a prep cooler. The office closet was disorganized. Mops were stored submerged in a bucket instead of air-drying.

headline: Missing splashguard; dish machine floor dirty
summary: A washable splashguard was needed at the right hand sink. The floor under the high-temperature dish machine needed cleaning, which the inspector ordered.

headline: Employee eating in prep area; food stored on floor
summary: A food handler ate and drank in the taqueria prep area. Food was stored on the floor at the front counter and rear sales area. Other findings: no hair restraints, no food handler training for employees, debris on floors, and no waste receptacles at hand sinks.

headline: Insect device over food prep; leaking dish machine
summary: Re-inspection passed. An electric insect control device was plugged in above a prep table in the front dishwashing area and must be relocated. A leak under the low-temperature dish machine created a pool of water. Missing thermometer and a non-self-closing restroom door also noted.

headline: Gaps and holes at doors; leak under sink
summary: Re-inspection passed. A half-inch gap was found at the bottom of the rear exit door and a 2-by-2-inch hole beside the main entrance; inspector required tight seals to keep pests out. A leak under the 3-compartment sink was also found.

headline: Trash and debris behind cooling unit and in closet
summary: Re-inspection passed. Trash and debris were stored behind clutter behind a cooling unit, under a prep table, and inside a storage closet. The inspector instructed staff to clean and maintain these areas.

headline: Hair restraint violations; drain buildup
summary: Two employees lacked hair restraints; the person in charge provided them during inspection. The men's restroom toilet needed cleaning, and buildup was found in drains under the three-compartment sink.

headline: No health policy; no allergen training proof
summary: No written employee health policy was on site, and no proof of allergen training was provided for certified managers. The espresso machine had no backflow device. A deli cutting board had deep cuts and stains. The rear prep corner was cluttered with ladders and cleaning products.

headline: Food debris on prep shelving; floors under equipment
summary: Prep table shelving where cutting boards are stored had dried food debris and was to be cleaned and sanitized. Floors under heavy cooking equipment in prep needed removal of dried food debris and grease.

headline: Over 30 small flies; citation issued
summary: Over 30 small flies were found in the facility, with small fly activity in prep, dishwashing and storage areas on the 8th floor. A priority citation was issued. The inspector required elimination of the flies and pest control service.

headline: Front doors not rodent proof; broken wall bases
summary: The front doors were not rodent proof, and the inspector required protection to keep pests out. Broken wall bases were in the front prep area and behind the three-compartment sink. Lighting in the rear dry storage area was inadequate.

headline: Dead roaches; 30 lbs of food discarded
summary: About 30 lbs of TCS foods at 45–54°F were discarded, and the front prep cooler was tagged. Dead roaches were in cabinets under steam tables. Frozen crabs were thawing on a shelf. The outside dumpster lacked lids, and a citation was issued.

headline: Missing backflow device for coffee machine
summary: License passed. A backflow prevention device must be provided for the coffee machine.

headline: No vomit kit; no pest control proof; citation
summary: No kit or procedure for vomiting and diarrhea cleanups was on site, and a citation was issued. No thermometers were visible in coolers. No pest control proof was on site; the last pest control log was dated 12/26/2022, and a citation was issued. Dust and a damaged walk-in floor were also found.

headline: Repeat allergen training violation; prep cooler thermometer missing
summary: Only one of three certified food managers (CFM) had allergen training certificates. This violation was carried over from a 12/11/23 report and not corrected, and a priority citation was issued. The prep cooler also needed a working thermometer.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat plantain
summary: An employee touched fully cooked, ready-to-eat plantain with bare hands. About 3 lbs ($50) was discarded, and a citation was issued. Also found: no thermometers in refrigeration, unlabeled sugar and salt, food on floor, no hair restraints, jewelry, damaged ceiling panels, and dirty floors.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat sushi; citation
summary: An employee served ready-to-eat crab sushi with bare hands and wiped hands on pants, a priority citation. A three-compartment sink had no stoppers, and a freezer door was taped. Heavy grease was in the hood and filters, and belongings were on shelves with food.

headline: Heavy grease and food debris throughout premises
summary: Re-inspection passed. Excessive grease and food debris were on the grill table, prep tables, fryer cabinets, meat slicer and unused coolers. The floor under and along wall bases throughout the premises also needed cleaning.

headline: Failed: no health policy; no pest control logbook
summary: No verifiable employee health policy was on site, and a citation was issued. There was no pest control logbook on site, also cited. Chicken was thawing in standing water. One employee lacked food handler training. No allergen certificates were on site.

headline: No cold-holding thermometers; hair restraint violations
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. No thermometers were visible in cold-holding equipment in the rear prep area. Several food handlers prepped without hair restraints. Unfinished wood shelving, a torn cooler gasket and food debris on floors were also found.

headline: Food on floor; hand sink lacked paper towels
summary: Food containers were stored on the walk-in freezer floor. The bar hand sink had no paper towels; one was provided during inspection, and a citation was issued. Also found: heavy grease, milk crates as shelving, cracked cutting boards, floor tile damage, and repeat uncorrected shelf cleaning.

headline: Cooked food without discard dates; ice machine slime
summary: Several cooked foods in the walk-in, including lamb, chicken and gravy, had been stored over 24 hours with no discard date. A citation was issued. Dark slime was on the ice maker interior, and the basement ice maker had no backflow device.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: A one-door prep cooler was missing a thermometer. Some bulk containers in the bagel prep room were unlabeled. The inspector required both to be fixed.

headline: Cooler too warm; unit tagged and held
summary: A reach-in cooler was off during inspection and reached 61.7°F after being switched on. It was tagged and held: do not use until it holds 41°F or below and CDPH reinspects. Also: torn gasket, greasy prep cooler and flat-top, leaking and slow-draining hand sink.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings found; citation issued
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were scattered across prep, storage, dishwashing and washroom areas, including inside fryer cabinets and on outlets. The manager was told to call an exterminator and clean and sanitize. A priority citation was issued. Also found: food spills, leaking faucet, wall cracks, debris.

headline: Dust and damaged walls in cooler and kitchen
summary: Complaint passed. The wall covering over the walk-in cooling unit was damaged and dusty. Floors in dishwashing and food service areas had dirt and debris. Return air vents had heavy dust. A new manager's allergen certification was expired.

headline: Mouse droppings; food too warm; citation issued
summary: Over 30 mouse droppings were along walls in the rear storage room, and a citation was issued. About 100 lbs of food ($2,000) was out of temperature and discarded by an employee. The walk-in cooler measured 44°F. No paper towels were at the public restroom hand sink; one was provided at end.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates; citation
summary: Expired food handler training certificates were on site. An allergen certificate issue from 10/16/2023 was not corrected, and a citation was issued. Current certificates for all certified food managers must be provided.

headline: Food containers on floor; expired certificates; citation
summary: To-go containers were stored on the floor or under shelving and must be raised. Front prep floors needed detail cleaning, and hood filters had grease buildup. The prior core violation of expired food handler and allergen certificates was not corrected, and a citation was issued.

headline: Food on floor; no allergen certificate on duty
summary: Re-inspection passed. Food containers were stored on the walk-in cooler floor. Some food containers were unlabeled, and some food handlers lacked hair and beard restraints. Utensils were stored inside food containers. No certified manager on duty had allergen training proof.

headline: No covered waste receptacle in restroom
summary: License re-inspection passed. The unisex washroom had no covered waste receptacle and one must be provided. A light shield was missing in the rear dishwashing area.

headline: Leaking pipe at dish-area hand sink
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. The inspector found a leaky pipe at the hand sink in the dishwashing area and required repair or replacement.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; leaking sink
summary: No thermometer was in the outdoor upright freezer. Large pots were not inverted, which could allow pest hiding. Rice was stored in a shopping bag. A three-compartment sink leaked, and food handler certificates were expired, with a citation for an uncorrected prior violation.

headline: Utensil rack near chemical shelves
summary: A clean utensil rack was stored next to the chemical shelves. The inspector ordered a barrier installed to prevent contamination.

headline: No handwashing signs; dirty floors and drains
summary: No handwashing signage at the rear hand sink. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Reach-in shelves were rusty, and floor drains and floors were dirty. Unfinished concrete floors need sealing, and personal items were kept in dry storage. A manager's allergen certificate was expired.

headline: No health policy; no vomit/diarrhea procedure
summary: No written employee health policy was on site. No written procedures or supplies for vomiting or diarrhea cleanups were on site, and supplies must include norovirus-effective sanitizer. Also found: crates and cardboard used as shelving, unlidded toilet waste containers, and dust on shelves.

headline: Dirty floor drain under sink; greasy cooking equipment
summary: Floor drain under the three-compartment sink needed detailed cleaning to prevent insect activity. Cooking equipment had grease, dust and debris. Floors under equipment and along walls also needed detailed cleaning.

headline: Greasy equipment; burned bulbs; allergen certificate missing
summary: Complaint passed. Accumulated grease and food debris were on cooking equipment and prep tables. Burned-out bulbs were in the main prep areas. A sanitation manager lacked a food allergen training certificate.

headline: Open cup on prep table; unlabeled bulk food
summary: An employee's open cup was on the prep table and was to be kept away from food. A bulk food container lacked a label. Disposable cups were used as scoops in bulk containers, and a light shield was cracked and missing.

headline: Food handler without hair restraint
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. The inspector instructed the handler to wear one.

headline: Grease buildup on kitchen ventilation hood
summary: Grease had built up on the kitchen ventilation hood. The inspector required cleaning and maintenance.

headline: Sticky soda residue; dirty floors and windowsills
summary: Complaint passed. A soda machine had black sticky residue between it and the counter. Soda splatter was on cup holders. Dining room and kitchen floors had food debris, and windowsills had food debris and dust.

headline: Worn and chipped cooking-line wall
summary: Passed. The west wall of the cooking line has worn surface and chipped paint. It must be repaired to a smooth, easily cleaned finish.

headline: Plates and cardboard lining shelves
summary: Passed. Serving plates on kitchen shelves are not inverted. To-go containers are uncovered, and cardboard and foil line the shelves. Cardboard must be removed to prevent hiding places for pests.

headline: Hot water too cool at sinks; failed
summary: Failed. Hot water at a warewashing sink and handsinks tested too cool (63F to 76F). Staff restored some sinks during inspection, but use is limited until re-inspection. Food lacked name labels, and no raw food advisory was posted.

headline: No splashguard and no public summary posted
summary: Pass with conditions. No splashguard between an exposed hand sink and prep table. A restroom receptacle lacks a cover, and three hood bulbs are burned out. No inspection summary was posted for the public; citation issued.

headline: Drip into sink; wall gap; lead-free check
summary: Passed. A tube from the ice machine was dripping into the three-compartment sink and must be moved to drain on the floor. Drink containers are not marked lead-free. A quarter-inch wall opening around a grease trap pipe must be sealed.

headline: No sanitizer test kit; no allergen proof
summary: Failed. No quaternary ammonium test kit on premises, and no proof of allergen training for certified managers. Food handler lacked hair restraint. Clean utensils were stored near the public washroom, and a menu asterisk was missing.

headline: Missing shelving and unused items; passed
summary: Passed. The walk-in cooler and freezer lack adequate shelving. Containers are too large for the three-compartment sink. Unused items in the outside garbage area, office and storage areas must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Rust over cutting boards; detail cleaning needed
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Rust is on shelving above cutting boards in the meat prep area. Deli cooler door tracks, walk-in dairy cooler, fan covers, areas under grills and prep-area floors need detailed cleaning.

headline: Flies near sushi and pizza; failed
summary: Failed. About 10 small flies were found in and around the sushi and rear cooking areas. A pizza station glass guard was missing, and five unprotected pizza slices were discarded. The station cannot be used until the guard is replaced.

headline: Customer restroom water too hot; failed
summary: Re-inspection failed. Hot water above 120F was found at customer washroom handsinks. Management was instructed to provide water between 100F and 120F at all handsinks. Priority citation issued.

headline: Walk-in cooler and grease need cleaning
summary: Passed. The walk-in cooling unit and old storage freezer need detailed cleaning. Grease buildup is on the sides of cooking equipment. Staff were told to clean it to prevent possible pest and insect activity.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; repaired on site
summary: Pass with conditions. A low-temperature dish machine in the bar area read 0 ppm chlorine and was not sanitizing; citation issued. Ecolab repaired it during inspection and it now reads 100 ppm. Signage is needed at the coffee station handsink.

headline: Food debris in cooler; faucet and caulking repairs
summary: Food debris was found between rubber gaskets inside a prep-area reach-in cooler. A second-floor handwashing sink's hot water handle is too hard to turn, so repair was ordered. Broken caulking at a three-compartment sink needs replacing.

headline: Slow drain and expired allergen certificate
summary: Complaint inspection passed. The front service-line handwash sink drains slowly but works, so repair was ordered. A certified food manager had an expired allergen awareness certificate and must obtain updated training.

headline: No certified manager; sink blocked by food
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified sanitation manager was on site while TCS foods were handled; citation issued. A front handwash sink was blocked by a food container. Missing handwash signs, thermometers, and lids were noted.

headline: Live roaches found; hot water failures; failed
summary: Failed. About 2 live roaches were crawling on a wall and under the dish machine, and pest control service is required. Restroom hot water is too cool, with three sinks not working. Toilets and urinal are inoperable and plumbing leaks were noted.

headline: Liquor stored in former washroom; odor
summary: Re-inspection passed. Liquor bottles are stored in a room formerly used as a washroom, which has a foul odor. Management was told to cap the toilet drain and remove the handwash sink and cap its drain.

headline: No health policy; raw food advisory missing
summary: Failed. No written employee health policy was on premises, and a citation was issued. The menu lacks a consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods. Plumbing leaks behind the bar and a slow sink need repair. A manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Expired allergen training for all managers
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Allergen training is expired or missing for all City of Chicago certified food managers. Staff must provide training and keep certificates on site.

headline: No health policy; missing signs and backflow devices
summary: Pass with conditions. No written employee health policy was on premises. Handwash signage is missing in several areas, and backflow devices are not at ice machines or the mop sink. Washroom ventilation is not working. The manager's allergen certificate expired.

headline: Cold foods above 41F; cooler too warm
summary: Pass with conditions. Many cold foods, including turkey, chicken, ham, cheese and tuna, were held at 44F to 55F. The manager voluntarily discarded 21 lbs worth $479. A prep cooler at 47.6F was ordered out of use until it holds 41F or below.

headline: Dim light in walk-in freezer
summary: Passed. The walk-in freezer has dim light, and more light intensity is required.

headline: Stained cutting boards; re-inspection passed
summary: Re-inspection passed. Stained cutting boards were found in prep areas. They must be resurfaced or replaced and maintained.

headline: Items on basement floor; hood filters greasy
summary: Passed. Items stored on basement floors in walk-in and storage areas must be raised at least six inches. Grease and dust are on hood filters and must be cleaned.

headline: Salsa, cheese and guacamole held too warm
summary: Pass with conditions. Salsa, guacamole, pico de gallo, lettuce and cheese were held above 41F in service coolers and walk-in. The manager voluntarily discarded 20 lbs worth about $60. Certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Raw wood shelving and utility sink backflow
summary: Passed. Raw wood shelving in the rear storage area must be sealed to be smooth and cleanable. The utility sink has no backflow device, and openings in the washroom ceiling must be sealed.

headline: No handwashing; no hot or cold water; failed
summary: Failed. A food employee handled raw chicken and food without washing hands, and the manager was instructed to wash. The truck had no hot or cold water. Repairs must be made before water is restored, and a citation was issued.

headline: Clogged drain and expired allergen training
summary: Passed. A hallway handwash sink lacks signage, and bulk containers are unlabeled. Food was stored on the rear walk-in freezer floor, and a tong handle lay in shredded lettuce. A floor drain is clogged, and some managers have expired allergen training.

headline: Food in grocery bags; flour spills
summary: Passed. Food was stored in grocery bags inside coolers and refrigeration units. Flour is on the pizza dough machine prep surface and floor. No certified manager with allergen training was present, and documentation is required.

headline: Unlabeled lassi drinks sold to go
summary: Inspector saw mango and rose lassi bottles sold to go from a grab-and-go cooler without labels. Owner was told to label them with ingredients and business trace-back information. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Scoop stored in chicken; strainer misused
summary: Re-inspection passed. A container used as a scoop was stored inside chicken. A food strainer was used as a floor drain strainer under the two-compartment sink. Staff were told to remove the strainer and store utensils properly.

headline: No certified manager on duty; citation
summary: Pass with conditions. No person in charge was present, and no certified manager was on duty while sandwiches and soups were prepared. Citation issued. Basement dry storage floors along walls need cleaning, and allergen training certificate is missing.

headline: No manager on site; food held too warm
summary: Pass with conditions. No person in charge or certified manager was present while food was prepared. Meat sauce was held at 109F and 79F. Food held over 24 hours was not date marked; about 40 lbs discarded. Soap and paper towels were restocked on site.

headline: Exposed insulation on prep cooler doors
summary: Re-inspection passed. Exposed insulation inside both doors of a two-door prep cooler must be covered with a smooth, easily cleaned surface.

headline: No manager certificate; slime in ice machine
summary: Failed. No original City of Chicago food manager certificate was posted. Pink slime buildup inside the ice machine was dripping into ice used for drinks. Staff voluntarily discarded all ice. Floors are littered in the walk-in, basement and prep areas.

headline: Missing handwash sign; items stored on floor
summary: Passed. The employee restroom handsink lacks a handwash sign. Single-use articles are not inverted and are stored on the floor under stairs. The all-gender washroom lacks a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

headline: No sneeze guard; food stored in restrooms
summary: Failed. No permanent sneeze guard at the front service area where food is assembled. Food containers were stored in employee restrooms, deli cups were not air-dried, and styrofoam covered food in a chest freezer. Only one customer restroom is provided.

headline: Ice machine debris and peeling plastic
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Debris is encrusted inside the ice machine and must be removed and serviced. An employee lacked a hair restraint. Peeling plastic is on ice and dish machines, and the front prep floor drain is dirty.

headline: Gap under exit door; utensils in warm water
summary: Passed. A half-inch gap at the alley exit door threshold lacks rodent-proof strip. Cook line utensils are stored in water at 78.4F. Milk crates are used for elevation, and a washroom ceiling vent is dusty.

headline: Leaking faucet and greasy cooking equipment
summary: Passed. Dish machine drain, cooking equipment sides, flattops, and a salamander need detailed cleaning to prevent insect activity. A two-compartment sink leaks at the faucet base. Rear prep air vents need cleaning.

headline: Grime on walls and damaged floor tile
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Spillage and food residue are on large equipment. Food debris and grime are on prep and dish area walls. Damaged floor tile in the prep area and restroom must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Re-inspection: door opening, clutter, filters
summary: Re-inspection passed. An opening at the base of the front door must be sealed. Boxes and equipment are stored on floors, and plastic wrap covers pork and beef trays. Restroom doors are not self-closing, and no food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Side door not rodent-proof; dim lighting
summary: Passed. The side door leading to the dumpster area is not rodent-proof, and outer openings must be enclosed to prevent pest entry. Lighting in the rear dishwashing and storage area is inadequate. Allergen training is needed.

headline: Handsink needs splashguard; allergen training
summary: Passed. The rear prep handsink sits directly next to mixing equipment and needs a smooth, easily cleaned splashguard. The person in charge lacks proof of allergen training.

headline: Grocery bags in coolers; re-inspection passed
summary: Re-inspection passed. Grocery bags were used to store food in refrigerators and freezers; staff were told to use food-grade bags. Cleaning under prep tables, equipment and in dish area vents was ordered. Several food handler certificates were expired.

headline: Restroom door, rust, and gas stove
summary: Passed. Rear restroom door is not self-closing. The walk-in cooler floor has rust. A two-burner gas stove is not under the ventilation hood and must be moved under it or removed.

headline: Dirt under food storage shelving
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Dirt and debris are on the floor under food storage shelving in the main prep area and rear storage area near the exit door. These must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Dirt and clutter on floors; passed
summary: Passed. Loose debris, dirt and dust are on floors and corners throughout the facility. Detail cleaning and more frequent floor cleaning were ordered. Clutter on the floor near the rear exit must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Missing certificates, health policy, and kit
summary: Failed. No valid City food sanitation certificate was posted, and no verifiable employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea kit was on site. Hand soap and paper towels were missing at some sinks. Food handler and allergen certificates were not available.

headline: Failed: no hand drying, sewage backup
summary: Failed. No hand-drying supplies at deli and fresh meat stations, and no handwashing signs in the employee restroom. Waste water is backing up from a floor drain and spilling onto the kitchen floor. Plumbing repair is required.

headline: Failed: missing signs, melted board, wood surfaces
summary: Failed. The rear prep handwash sink lacks signage. A cutting board near the stove is melted, and unsealed wood counters and milk-crate-supported ice machine need fixing. Peeling ceiling paint and a missing backflow device were noted.

headline: No certified manager; untagged shellfish
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager was on duty; citation issued. Mussels were stored without identification tags, and 15 lbs worth $40 was voluntarily discarded. Serving plates were stored improperly, and a kitchen handsink leaks.

headline: No food handler certificates on site
summary: Re-inspection passed. No food handler certificates were on site. The manager was instructed to comply with the Illinois Department of Public Health food handler requirements.

headline: No health policy or sickness procedure; failed
summary: Failed. No written employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea procedure and kit were on site. Coolers must hold 41F or colder, and a priority citation was issued. Leaking pipes, no food prep sink in the service area, and no commercial dumpster were found.

headline: Greasy floor and milk spills; passed
summary: Passed. A heavy layer of grease and standing water is in the deli prep area behind the ovens. Milk spillage is on the walk-in dairy cooler floor. Staff were instructed to detail clean these areas and keep them free of spills.

headline: Collapsing ceiling panels in meat cooler; failed
summary: Failed re-inspection. Ceiling panels in the meat walk-in cooler are discolored, bulging and collapsing. Food boxes sit on the freezer floor, condenser drips near meat cutting, cutting boards are badly scratched, and food handler certificates are missing.

headline: Cold foods above 41F; about 90 lbs discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Cooked chicken, turkey, soup, broccoli and peppers were held above 41F with no time-temperature log. The manager discarded about 90 lbs worth $495. Ice machine has mineral buildup and a cook lacks a beard restraint.

headline: One manager lacks allergen training
summary: Complaint inspection passed. One food manager was observed without a food allergen training certificate. All City of Chicago certified food managers must have a valid allergen training certificate.

headline: Missing thermometers and food handler certificates
summary: Re-inspection passed. Yogurt and two-door coolers lack internal thermometers. A food handler lacked an effective hair restraint. Basement items must be raised six inches off the floor, and basement lighting is inadequate. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: 80 or more mouse droppings; failed
summary: Failed. About 80 or more mouse droppings were found across the facility, including on prep floors and on cutting boards stored with clean dishware. A priority citation was issued, and pest control is recommended. Other issues include a missing handwash sign and sauce-covered container lids.

headline: Dead insects in trap; unlabeled to-go items
summary: Passed. Dead insects were found on an insect trap under the three-compartment sink and must be removed promptly. To-go items lack the business name and address. No utility sink is available, and restroom receptacles lack covers.

headline: Uncovered noodles and ceiling hole
summary: Passed. Dry noodles were uncovered on a prep shelf, and utensils were stored on the floor under the three-compartment sink. Dirty floors, food splatter, and a missing ceiling tile were noted. A ceiling hole near seating must be sealed to prevent pests.

headline: Leaks, ceiling damage, and allergen gaps
summary: Passed. Heavy ice is on a freezer, and the three-compartment sink has leaks at its faucet and drain. A restroom lacks a covered trash can. A water-damaged ceiling hole has loose debris. Both certified managers lack allergen training.

headline: Dirty coolers and garbage area; failed
summary: Failed re-inspection. Cold-holding and freezer interiors need cleaning, and the hot holding unit has food buildup. The outside garbage area had litter and food scraps, with dumpster lids left open. Water-stained ceiling tiles need replacing.

headline: Many cleaning and labeling issues; passed
summary: Short complaint inspection passed. No working thermometer in hot holding unit, and bulk containers are unlabeled. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, and spills and debris were found throughout. Hood filters were dirty or missing; manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Blocked hand sink cleared on site
summary: Pass with conditions. A hand sink in the dish and prep area was blocked by empty containers, a mixer and a fan. The manager had employees clear it immediately on site; citation issued. Floors along walls and under equipment need cleaning.

headline: No certified manager; dirty ice bin
summary: Pass with conditions. Food handlers prepared TCS foods without a certified manager on site; citation issued. The person in charge lacks food safety training proof. The ice bin top is unclean, a cutting board is stained, and a food handler lacked a hair restraint.

headline: Missing cooking logs and loose faucet
summary: Handwashing signs were removed from non-handwashing sinks in the first-floor bar. A HACCP plan was on site without required logs, which must be kept six months; citation issued. A loose faucet needs repair.

headline: Improper utensil storage and drying; passed
summary: Passed. Spoons were stored in room-temperature water. Wet utensils were placed on a cloth to dry, and deli cups were used as bulk-food scoops. Staff were instructed to correct each practice.

headline: Mold-like buildup on storage racks
summary: Passed. White and green mold-like buildup is on walk-in storage racks, especially in corners. A mop sink is missing one side, and handwash signs and thermometers are needed. Floors along walls and under racks need cleaning.

headline: Missing handwash signs and allergen training
summary: Handwash sink in prep area lacks signage. Small cups are used as dispensing utensils and stored in spices. Rust is on a prep table shelf. Certified managers lack allergen training and must obtain it. Passed.

headline: No certified manager on site; drink on prep table
summary: Complaint inspection passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were handled; priority violation issued. An employee drink was on the prep table, and a food handler was not wearing a hair restraint.

headline: Deli meats too warm; drain repair needed
summary: Pass with conditions. Roast beef was held at 48F, and sausage, ham and mortadella were held at 44F to 48F in the deli cooler. About 20 lbs worth $100 was discarded and citation issued. A slow-draining rear dish sink needs repair.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; food too warm
summary: Failed. Black slime inside the ice machine was dripping into ice. Cooked chicken, rice and fried chicken were held too warm, and about 36 lbs worth $80 was discarded. Two reach-in coolers were tagged and must not be used.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; corrected on site
summary: Failed. Sliced avocado at 52.7F and cooked bacon at 79F were held on a prep cooler counter. The manager voluntarily discarded about 5 lbs worth $85, corrected on site. Rust is on the ice machine, and no food manager allergen certificate was provided.

headline: Improper thawing and food on floors
summary: Re-inspection passed. Meat was thawing on chest freezers instead of under running water. Food was stored on floors, uncovered bulk items and cardboard liners were used, and three-compartment sink stoppers were missing. Grease buildup and holes in basement walls must be fixed.

headline: Minor grease spill under fryer
summary: Passed. Minor grease spillage is on the floor under the cooking fryer. It must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Missing handsinks and service sink; failed
summary: Failed re-inspection. A portable handwash sink was removed from the rear prep area, and no exposed handsink is in the front prep area. No service sink is installed for mop water, and no food handler certificates were provided. Citations were issued March 6, 2026.

headline: Manager arrived on site; leaking drainpipe
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified manager was on premises at first; one arrived at 9:46 AM and the issue was corrected on site. A drainpipe under the three-compartment sink leaks onto the floor. Expired food handler certificates were noted.

headline: Heavy grease and debris throughout; passed
summary: Short complaint inspection passed. Fryers, cooking equipment, coolers, beverage station and floors have excessive grease and food debris. Toilet room walls and floors are dirty, and worn grout traps debris. Allergen training is missing.

headline: No handwash signs; unlabeled bulk food
summary: Passed. No handwashing signs are posted at prep and bar sinks. Bulk items such as sugar and beans have no labels. A sanitation manager lacks allergen training. All items must be corrected.

headline: Unused cooler in basement; re-inspection passed
summary: Re-inspection passed. An unused two-door cooler is in the basement. It must be repaired and put into service or removed from the premises.

headline: Dead insects in light shields; expired certificates
summary: Passed. Dead insects were found on light shields above the rear dry storage area and must be cleaned. Handwash signs are needed at all sinks. Expired food handler certificates were noted, and some containers are unlabeled.

headline: No manager on arrival; flies and spoiled lemons
summary: Failed. No certified manager was on site until about 11 AM. Spoiled lemons were discarded, and oatmeal was held at 50F. About 15 small flies were found in the bar area, and expired food handler certificates were noted. Freezer gaskets are broken.

headline: Improper thawing and unprotected buffet; failed
summary: Failed. Frozen seafood was thawed in a prep sink without cold running water. Dessert cooler and hot buffet lack sneeze guards; citation issued. Knives are stored improperly, and stored items must be raised off the floor.

headline: Missing health policy, cleanup kit, pest log
summary: Failed. No employee health policy, vomit cleanup kit, probe thermometer, or pest control service and log book were on site. Staff were instructed to obtain each item.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; passed
summary: Re-inspection passed. Expired food handler certificates were noted. The facility must update them and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Re-inspection: wiping cloths and paperwork
summary: Re-inspection passed. Wiping cloths were stored on food trays and a paper bag. A bathroom door lacks a self-closing device, and no food handler training records were on site.

headline: Dirty ice chute and loose debris; passed
summary: Complaint inspection passed. Ice chute has buildup, and a male employee lacked a hair restraint. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer. Floors under heavy equipment have debris, and dish area vents need cleaning.

headline: Missing splashguard and exposed foam caulk
summary: A rear handsink beside a prep table lacks a splashguard. Foam-like caulk is exposed on walls and pipes in the prep area and basement. Ventilation hood filters above cooking equipment need cleaning. Passed.

headline: Greasy fryers and empty cans in prep
summary: Passed. Minor grease buildup is inside the cooking fryers and must be cleaned. Several empty metal cans in the prep area must be removed.

headline: No health policy, thermometer, or sanitizer kit
summary: Failed. No written employee health policy or vomit and diarrhea procedure was on site. Missing items include a metal food thermometer and sanitizer test kit. The unisex washroom lacks a covered receptacle, and no commercial dumpster is provided.

headline: Re-inspection: gaps, grease, expired training
summary: Re-inspection passed. Rear door has a gap that must be sealed. Hand sink needs a splashguard. Grease and debris need cleaning from fryers, ice machine and floors. Some food handler certificates are expired. Kids' milk exceeds the calorie limit.

headline: Dirty fryers, floors and ice machine
summary: Passed. Several food handlers lacked hair restraints, and an ice scoop was stored on the ice machine. Cutting boards are grooved, and fryers, ovens, coolers and floors have thick grease and food buildup. Lighting is inadequate, and the manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No certified manager and no hot water; failed
summary: Failed. No City of Chicago certified food manager certificate was on premises. The premises have no hot water, and handwash signage is missing. The women's restroom lacks a covered trash receptacle. No citation was issued.

headline: No certified manager on duty; failed
summary: Failed. No person in charge with a valid certificate was on duty while TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. Milk crates are used as shelving, and broken glass and mirror are on the ground in the refuse area. A prior splashguard violation was not corrected.

headline: To-go boxes stored facing up
summary: Passed. To-go boxes and plates were stored facing up. They must be stored inverted to protect them from contamination.

headline: Gap under rear door; rust on racks
summary: Passed. A quarter-inch gap under the rear door by the walk-in cooler is not rodent- or insect-proof. A can opener had food buildup, storage racks are rusty, and the rear handsink leaks. A food handler lacked a certificate.

headline: Re-inspection: cleaning, plumbing, and clutter
summary: Re-inspection passed. Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizer. Counters, reach-in coolers and floors need detail cleaning, and rocks hold up a shelf. A mop sink is not connected to city plumbing, and a handsink drains slowly.

headline: Menu lacks raw food consumer advisory; failed
summary: Failed. The printed menu had no disclosure or reminder for animal foods that can be ordered raw or undercooked, such as oysters and burgers. The facility must add the disclosure and reminder statement. No citation was issued.

headline: Cold food too warm; about 170 lbs discarded
summary: Cold foods in three coolers ran 44.6–49.7°F, above the 41°F limit; about 170 lbs ($1,717) were discarded. Potatoes were stored in a bucket that once held dish soap; 3 lbs discarded. Cooler air reached 59.5°F; units were tagged.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; missing sanitation supplies
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings in beverage cabinets, pallets, shelves, and rear storage; citation issued. No vomit and diarrhea procedure or supplies. No handwashing sink in the dishwashing area. Front door gaps must be sealed. Dumpster lids were missing.

headline: Blocked and unsupplied handwash sinks; unsafe rinsing
summary: Meat-prep handwash sink was unusable due to a disconnected pipe; a cart blocked the deli sink until moved during the inspection. Soap and paper towels were missing at several sinks, then provided. Cilantro was rinsed in an unclean sink. Citations issued.

headline: No cold holding units; rat droppings; repairs needed
summary: No cold holding units for milk, eggs, or lunch meat; citation issued. Four rat droppings in a small storage closet; citation issued. Also needed: self-closing door, covered trash can, holes at wall bases, stained ceiling tiles, and a burned-out bulb.

headline: Unlabeled containers; milk crates used as shelves
summary: Storage containers lacked food-name labels. Milk crates were used as shelving; replace them with shelving 6 inches off the floor. Damaged wall tiles above the three-compartment sink and dirty fryer grease containers need repair.

headline: Mouse droppings, unsafe cold food, no hot water
summary: About 45 mouse droppings in the rear food prep area. Cold foods at 44.7–49.6°F were discarded (18 lbs, $85); a refrigerator at 46°F was tagged. Men's restroom sink water was 76°F; it must reach 100°F. Citations issued.

headline: Mop improperly stored; walk-in light out
summary: A mop was improperly stored in the utility sink area and must be stored and dried properly. A walk-in cooler light bulb is out and must be replaced. Result: Pass.

headline: Missing backflow devices and broken fixtures
summary: No backflow prevention device on the rear and basement utility sinks; installation requested. Also noted: broken restroom door closer, exposed foam-like caulk on a basement stairwell wall, and holes in basement storage ceiling. All were ordered repaired.

headline: No hot water in men's restroom; door gap
summary: The left faucet in the customer men's washroom had no hot water. A front door gap of about 1/2 inch must be sealed to prevent pest entry. Dust had built up on ceiling tiles and vents in the prep area. Result: Pass.

headline: No certified manager; dirty walk-in door
summary: No valid city food service manager certificate was on the premises while rice, steak, and chicken were served; citation issued. Dirt built up on the walk-in cooler door and prep walls; cleaning frequency must increase. Result: Pass with conditions.

headline: Heavy grease in pizza oven hood
summary: Heavy dirt and grease built up inside and on edges of the exhaust hood, filters, and pipes above the pizza oven. Staff must detail clean and maintain them. Result: Pass.

headline: 20–25 rodent droppings in basement storage
summary: About 20–25 rodent droppings beneath a wall inlet in the basement single-service storage area; no other pest activity was seen. Pest control service is required. Handwashing signs were missing, walls and ceilings are yellowed, and a sink is loose. Citation issued.

headline: Stained cutting boards above prep coolers
summary: Cutting boards above the prep-line coolers are stained and pitted and must be replaced or repaired. Result: Pass.

headline: Unsafe food temperatures; no certified manager
summary: No certified manager on site while chicken and rice were served; one arrived at 1:55 PM. Raw chicken at 45.1–47.7°F was discarded (80 lbs). Wings at 114–120°F under a heat lamp were discarded (5 lbs); hot food must be 135°F or above. Citations issued.

headline: About 100 mouse droppings in rear storage
summary: About 100 mouse droppings on the floor and table bottoms in far rear storage near the rear exit. Remove them; pest control must service the premises before reinspection next week. Citation issued. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Food on floors; unlicensed shared kitchen
summary: Food containers stored directly on floors in the walk-in cooler and warewashing area must be raised 6 inches. Floors under front fryers were heavily soiled. The restaurant leases space to another business operating as a shared kitchen without the required license.

headline: Food stored under condensation; prior violations unfixed
summary: Food sat under a condensation drip in the bakery walk-in cooler. Basement freezers had heavy ice and dust. Earlier violations were not fixed: food debris and spills in walk-in coolers and freezers, and standing water near the dish machine. Citation issued.

headline: Two food handlers lacked training; backflow device worn
summary: Two food handlers lacked proof of food handler training; they must meet requirements within 30 days of hire. The backflow prevention device at the utility sink is in poor repair and must be repaired. Result: Pass.

headline: No certified manager; food too warm; sanitizer failing
summary: No certified food manager or posted certificate while chicken and lamb were served. Cooked rice at 87.3°F and hummus at 51.3°F were found; about $70 in food discarded. Dish machines measured 0 ppm sanitizer at final rinse.

headline: Single-use bags reused for food storage
summary: Grocery bags were reused to store mashed potatoes in the walk-in cooler; single-use items must not be reused. Walk-in shelving had soil buildup, and the women's restroom lacked a covered waste receptacle. Result: Pass.

headline: Door gap, no covered trash can, no training proof
summary: A quarter-inch gap at the rear door needs a door sweep to prevent pest entry. Grease under both fryers must be cleaned. The washroom lacks a covered receptacle and a self-closing door. No proof of food handler or allergen training.

headline: Raw chicken and beef too warm; cooler repair needed
summary: Raw chicken and beef in a prep cold unit held at 50.5°F and 51.7°F; cold food must stay at 41°F or below. Manager discarded about 6 lbs ($100). A prep cooler at 55°F was tagged. Also: food on walk-in floor and grease buildup.

headline: Single-use bowls used as scoops in bulk storage
summary: Single-use plastic bowls were used as scoops in basement bulk dry storage. Replace them with multi-use utensils that have handles. Result: Pass.

headline: Rust in beverage cooler; truck gaps to seal
summary: Beverage cooler interior and wire racks are rusted and must be scraped and repainted. Openings and gaps in the truck's ceiling and walls must be sealed. Result: Pass.

headline: No certified food manager while serving food
summary: No certified food manager was on site while pasta and chicken were handled and served. The food service manager also lacked a required allergen training certificate.

headline: Low water pressure, worn boards, and training gaps
summary: Bar hand sink had low hot and cold water pressure. Worn cutting boards, damaged chest freezer gaskets and lid, and missing or expired food handler training for several employees must be fixed. Complaint re-inspection result: Pass.

headline: Cleaning needed; expired allergen certificates
summary: Prep table bottoms, grill underside, ice machine panel, and walk-in shelves need cleaning. Floors inside the walk-in and under equipment, plus washroom fan dust, need attention. Expired allergen training certificates must be renewed. Result: Pass.

headline: Leaking drainpipe under three-compartment sink
summary: A drainpipe under the three-compartment sink in the rear warewashing area is leaking and must be repaired. Result: Pass.

headline: Missing hair and beard restraints in prep area
summary: A female food handler lacked a hair restraint, and a male food handler lacked a beard guard. Staff were told to provide them while working in the food prep area. Complaint inspection; result: Pass.

headline: Rat droppings, raw chicken over ready food
summary: About 75 rat droppings in basement storage; citation issued. Raw chicken was stored above ready-to-eat food. The person in charge lacked a valid certificate; a manager showed a prohibited photocopy. Hand sinks were blocked, unsupplied, or lacked hot water.

headline: No working refrigeration on site; many failures
summary: No refrigerators were working during the inspection; cold foods must stay at 41°F or below. Both dish machines were not functioning. Also cited: no employee health policy, cleanup procedure, soap, paper towels, thermometers, or toilet paper. No citations issued.

headline: No certified manager; warm food; no hot water
summary: No certified manager on duty while food was served; citation issued. Cold foods at 46.4–66.2°F were discarded (about 7 lbs). Hand sinks and sanitizing sinks ran at 74.5–75°F, below required hot water temperatures. No food handler training proof.

headline: Leaking ceiling tile over dining area
summary: A ceiling tile in the dining area had a tarp and water hose leaking into a bucket. The inspector ordered it repaired and maintained. This re-inspection listed only this item.

headline: Hot dogs and gyros too warm in prep cooler
summary: Hot dogs at 47°F and cooked gyros, gyro sauce, and sauerkraut at 46–48°F were in the prep cooler; foods must be 41°F or below. About 10 lbs ($50) was voluntarily discarded. The prep cooler's air temperature was 47°F; citation issued.

headline: Thermometer placed in rear of coolers
summary: A thermometer was placed in the rear of the coolers. The inspector asked that it be kept in the warmest part of the cooler, where it can be read. Result: Pass.

headline: Food on floors; no grease trap; missing lids
summary: Food stored on basement and walk-in floors must be raised. Scoops were stored inside bulk food. No grease trap at a first-floor three-compartment sink. The outdoor grease container lid is open with trash around it. Garbage can lids are missing.

headline: No pest control logbook; missing thermometer
summary: No pest control logbook on site; a licensed pest control provider must be hired and records kept on site. Also: no thermometer in a prep cooler, a torn cooler gasket, a burnt-out bulb, and no food handler cards on site. Citation issued.

headline: Damaged door sweep; missing allergen certificate
summary: Front entrance door sweep is damaged at the bottom right and must be repaired. Clear food storage containers were not inverted near the three-compartment sink. The manager on site lacked an allergen training certificate. Re-inspection result: Pass.

headline: Food handlers lack food handler certificates
summary: Several food handlers had no food handler certificates. The manager was told to ensure all handlers have certificates. Result: Pass.

headline: Dusty soda machine; restroom clutter
summary: The soda machine is dusty and must be cleaned. The restroom contains clutter and old ovens that must be removed. Result: Pass.

headline: Ice buildup in freezer; faulty restroom sink
summary: Rear walk-in freezer has ice buildup and must be defrosted. One women's washroom hand sink is not working properly, and a leak at the dish sink area must be repaired. Floors and walls around cooking equipment need cleaning. Result: Pass.

headline: Unlabeled containers and worn cutting boards
summary: Three large white food containers in the basement lacked common-name labels. Cutting boards are badly stained with deep grooves and must be replaced. A gap at the front door bottom must be sealed; cooler interiors and floors need cleaning.

headline: No splash guard; milk crates and torn gaskets
summary: No washable splash guard between the hand sink and prep table. Milk crates were used in the rear walk-in cooler and must be replaced; a front prep cooler has torn gaskets. Food debris on floors, dust on vents, and litter by the refuse area. Result: Pass.

headline: Roughly 100 mouse droppings and live flies found
summary: Roughly 100 or more mouse droppings on counters, prep tables, shelving, and floors, plus 5–7 live small flies in the toilet room. Pest control service recommended. Employees lack food handler training; the manager lacks allergen training. Citation issued.

headline: No spill kit; walk-in cooler at 60°F
summary: No vomit or diarrhea spill kit or cleanup procedure on site. First-floor walk-in cooler at 60°F must not be used until reinspected. Also missing: test strips for the high-temperature dish machine, handwashing signs, and a tight-fitting side door.

headline: Water-damaged ceiling tile in women's restroom
summary: A broken, water-damaged ceiling tile was found in the women's toilet room and must be repaired and maintained. Result: Pass.

headline: Cooler too warm; yogurt and chutney discarded
summary: Cilantro chutney, carrot salad, and yogurt in the two-door cooler were 48.2–52.5°F and were discarded. The cooler, at 51.4°F, is tagged and cannot be used until repaired and approved by the health department. Also: a hand sink leaks hot water; broken floor tiles.

headline: Raw wood must be sealed; dusty vent
summary: Raw wood in basement dry storage and above the mop sink must be painted or sealed to be nonabsorbent. Walls and ceilings in basement storage must be smooth and cleanable. Employee washroom ceiling vent is extremely dusty. Result: Pass.

headline: No posted certificate; missing test strips
summary: No valid city manager certificate was posted; citation issued. Thermometers were missing from cooling units, no test strips for sanitizer, and no food handler or allergen training certificates on site. Debris under heavy equipment must be cleaned to prevent pest harborage.

headline: No certified manager; rodent droppings and roaches
summary: Certified manager absent until 10:55 AM. About 50 mouse droppings and two live roaches found. Samosas held at 92.1°F, below the required 135°F for hot food. Hand sink was blocked and clogged. Sanitizer was missing; an employee bought some during the inspection.

headline: Rat droppings found; restrooms lack soap and towels
summary: About 40–50 rat droppings in the furnace room, 8–10 behind a freezer, and 30–40 in the front service area. Pest control proof must be on site by 05/11/2026. Men's restroom lacked hand soap; restrooms lacked hand-drying supplies. Citation issued.

headline: Broken grout and rough cement near sinks
summary: Broken grout around the mop sink and rough cement at a three-compartment sink corner must be made smooth and cleanable. A tabletop can opener with encrusted food debris must be cleaned after each use. Result: Pass.

headline: No certified manager; dish machine failing
summary: No person in charge with a valid city certificate, and none posted; citation issued. Low-temperature dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer; it is tagged and must not be used until rechecked by the Chicago Department of Public Health. Also: dirty surfaces and no allergen training.

headline: Dead roach found; freezer door needs repair
summary: A dead roach was found near the rear utility sink; it was ordered removed and the area cleaned. Also: a basement freezer door in disrepair, greasy cooking areas, dirty cooler interiors, and wall holes near exits. Result: Pass.

headline: Rodent droppings and live cockroaches behind coolers
summary: Over 25 rodent droppings and 5 small live cockroaches were found under and behind coolers in the rear prep area; citation issued. Menu consumer advisory is incomplete, handwashing signage is missing, and a packaged cake lacks an ingredient list.

headline: Mussels lacked tags; handwash water too cool
summary: Second-floor prep area needs an exposed handwash sink. Handwash water measured 87.8°F; repaired on site to 102.4°F. Mussels lacking shellfish tracking tags were discarded (2 lbs, $15). Menu lacks raw-food asterisk and disclosure; service bar lacks a prep sink.

headline: Missing vomit cleanup supplies; cold food discarded
summary: Vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies were missing; citation issued. Cold foods at 48.7–61.3°F were discarded (4 lbs, $30); they must be held at 41°F or below. Soap and towel dispenser above a sink was removed on site. Handwashing signs were missing.

headline: Food cooling under plastic wrap; heavy grease buildup
summary: Cooked proteins, beans, and sauces were cooling covered in plastic wrap; staff must loosen covers for proper cooling. Cooking equipment was heavily greasy, and the outdoor grease receptacle grate and utility sink were heavily soiled. Hood grease must be controlled.

headline: Dead roaches found; earlier pest violations unfixed
summary: Several dead cockroaches on toilet room and storage floors. Earlier pest violations (6 live roaches and about 25 live small flies) were not corrected. Also: leaking freezer and cold-holding units, food spills in a freezer, and dirty floors and walls. Citations issued.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; chip bags unlabeled
summary: Dish machine was not sanitizing properly and was tagged; do not use it until repaired, and use the three-compartment sink instead. Homemade potato chip bags for sale must list business name, address, and ingredients. Citation issued.

headline: Sink leaks; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Loose faucet and base leak at a one-compartment sink by the rear exit; drain pipe leak under the three-compartment sink. Splatter and debris inside low reach-in coolers, and dirt on walls. The manager on duty lacks allergen training. Result: Pass.

headline: Wet cloths, scratched boards, and grease near drains
summary: Wet wiping cloths sat on multiple prep surfaces and must be stored in sanitizing solution. Deeply scratched cutting boards need replacing. Heavy grease surrounded the basement grease container (citation issued). Dirty floor drains and food debris need cleaning.

headline: Ice machine slime, leaking sinks, broken thermometer
summary: Black and pink slime in the ice machine dripped onto ice for customers; citation issued. The metal stem food thermometer was broken. Three-compartment sinks leaked. Meat prep sink lacked soap, corrected on site. Expired food handler certificates.

headline: Scoops in sugar; no food handler training proof
summary: Scoops stored inside sugar containers must be kept in a clean container. A hand sink in the employee washroom drains slowly. Heavy dust on ceiling vents and debris on basement food storage floors. No food handler training proof on site.

headline: Many dead insects along prep area back wall
summary: Many dead insects were found along the prep area's back wall; the manager must remove equipment and detail clean. Also: cutting boards need replacing, both three-compartment sinks leak at the traps, and floors need cleaning. Result: Pass.

headline: Gaps around rear door; expired allergen certificate
summary: A yellow rear exit door had 2-inch gaps around its frame, which must be sealed to keep pests out. The certified manager's allergen training certificate had expired and must be renewed and kept on site.

headline: Live flies in front prep; prior violations unfixed
summary: About 10–12 or more live small flies on walls, menu board, and ceiling in the front prep area; pest control recommended. Uncorrected earlier violations include a door gap, a broken display lid, damaged walls, and dirty floor drains. Citation issued.

headline: Foul odor from grease receptor; fryers need cleaning
summary: A foul odor came from the grease receptor under the three-compartment sink; the receptor must be serviced. Fryer interiors and exteriors and the wok station need cleaning. Re-inspection result: Pass.

headline: No sanitizer at dish sink; employee brought some
summary: Three-compartment sink had no sanitizer during the inspection; an employee left and returned with sanitizer before the inspection ended (corrected on site). Citation issued. Serving utensils were not inverted, and debris was behind cooking equipment.

headline: Pink slime in ice machine; exit door left open
summary: Pink slime built up inside the ice machine lid and dripped onto ice for human consumption; citation issued. An exit door in the prep area was open and must be closed to keep out pests and contamination. Certified managers must obtain allergen training.

headline: Torn gasket; damaged floors and walls
summary: A torn gasket on a prep cooler and damaged wall tiles in the women's restroom must be repaired. Broken floors in several areas must be sealed. Floor drains with excessive food debris must be cleaned. Re-inspection result: Pass.

headline: No certified food manager on site early
summary: The person in charge lacked a certified food manager certificate. No certified manager was on site while hot or cold foods (ham, soup, tuna) were prepared until 1:17 PM. Staff toilet sinks lacked cold water, and earlier violations were not corrected. Citation issued.

headline: Food and equipment stored on basement floors
summary: Boxed food and equipment such as pots and pans were stored on basement floors in the walk-in cooler and dry storage. Scoops were stored with handles in dry food bins. Items must be raised 6 inches off the floor. Re-inspection result: Pass.

headline: Cooler interiors and floors need cleaning
summary: Interiors of all coolers and freezers must be cleaned and maintained. Floors along wall bases and in corners need cleaning to remove spills and debris. Result: Pass.

headline: No certified manager; handwash sink blocked by supplies
summary: No valid certified manager was on site while food was prepared and served. A rear handwash sink was blocked by cleaning supplies. Also: buckets thawing in the sink, uncovered food, and workers without hair restraints. Citations issued.

headline: Knives stored in bulk food; repairs and cleaning needed
summary: Several knives and scoops were stored in bulk food, and wiping cloths sat on prep tables. Containers need labels, and utensils must be inverted. Repairs needed: sink stoppers, a cooler handle, grout, damaged wall bases, and dust. Re-inspection result: Pass.

headline: Rodent droppings, live flies, and no certified manager
summary: About 100 rodent droppings and 50 live small flies were found. No certified food manager was on site. Cold foods at 50–60°F were discarded, and a cooling unit at 63°F was tagged out of use. Outside grease bin overflowed. Citations issued.

headline: Improper thawing; greasy fryers and soiled surfaces
summary: Chicken and fish were thawing improperly in the sink; food stayed below 30°F. Staff must thaw under refrigeration or running cold water. Also noted: soda crates used as shelving, a stained cutting board, and greasy fryers and hood filters.

headline: Front door gap; missing hair restraint
summary: A male food handler lacked a hair restraint. A 1/4-inch gap at the front door must be sealed to keep rodents out. The customer toilet room lacked a covered receptacle. Food and dirt debris between cooking equipment and refrigeration must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager; no hand-drying towels
summary: No certified food manager was on site while turkey tips, hamburgers, and spaghetti were prepared. A rear hand sink lacked a drying provision; staff supplied paper towels during the inspection. Front and rear exit doors need weather stripping. Citations issued.

headline: Grease buildup and leaks in kitchen areas
summary: Stove top, back of cooking equipment, floors, and hood vent have heavy grease. A hand sink's cold water handle leaks, and the grease trap has a small leak. Washroom needs cleaning. Cold drinks lack product labels. Result: Pass.

headline: Labeling and utensil storage problems at re-inspection
summary: Cake slices were packaged without required labels, and bulk containers lacked names, including flour, sugar, beans, sour cream, and chocolate. Wiping cloths and knives were improperly stored in prep areas. Re-inspection result: Pass.

headline: Rusty racks; manager lacks allergen certificate
summary: Rust on storage racks in the basement walk-in cooler must be removed. A certified food service manager was on site without an allergen awareness training certificate; the person in charge must ensure it is obtained and kept on site.

headline: No covered trash can; clutter in prep area
summary: The unisex restroom lacked a covered receptacle. Clutter in the rear prep area must be removed to prevent rodent hiding spots, and items must sit 6 inches off the floor. No pests were noted. Re-inspection result: Pass.

headline: No handwashing signs; leaking faucet
summary: No handwashing signs at exposed sinks or in customer and employee washrooms; they must be posted. Food storage containers lack labels. A leaking faucet base at the three-compartment sink and dust in light shields must be fixed and cleaned.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; soiled wiping cloths
summary: Soiled wiping cloths were stored on prep tables; they must be kept in sanitizing solution between uses. Milk crates were used for elevation and must be replaced with proper shelving. Floors had loose debris and dust. Missing hand-washing sign. Re-inspection result: Pass.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; ice and dust buildup
summary: Employee restrooms lacked handwashing signs. Ice buildup was on the front-line prep cooler, and dust covered a ceiling vent above a prep table. Staff were told to clean and maintain. Result: Pass.

headline: Rodent poison and unknown powder on basement floors
summary: Rodent poison bait and an unidentified white substance were scattered on basement storage floors near freezers and coolers. They must be removed and the area sanitized. Citation issued. Also: unlabeled desserts, grocery bags used for bread, and expired food handler certificates.

headline: No certified manager while food prepared
summary: No certified food manager with a city certificate was on site while rice and chicken were prepared and served. The person in charge must obtain a city certificate by next inspection. A previous allergen training violation was not corrected. Citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; restroom and cooler repairs
summary: Bulk prep containers were unlabeled. A cooler door does not close properly, a hot water tank leaks above the three-compartment sink, and a toilet does not flush properly. The certified food manager on duty lacked allergen training.

headline: Missing stopper and training certificates
summary: The right-side compartment stopper on the three-compartment sink must be replaced. No food handler training certificates or allergen training certificates were on the premises. Re-inspection result: Pass.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit kit; improper thawing
summary: No certified manager on site while open; citation issued. No vomit and diarrhea procedure or cleanup kit on premises. Chicken and shrimp were thawing in standing water in the three-compartment sink. Gaps under doors and sink leaks need repair.

headline: Beverage station nozzles dirty; ceiling tiles stained
summary: Nozzles on the beverage station and the cabinet underside had pinkish buildup and dirt. Water-stained ceiling tiles in the dining area must be replaced. Complaint inspection result: Pass.

headline: No valid certificate; no hand sink in basement
summary: Person in charge lacked a valid city sanitation certificate, and none was posted. The basement food prep area has no hand sink. Cooks had unprotected beards, and food handler training proof was missing. Prior violations were not fixed. Citations issued.

headline: No written vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure
summary: No written procedure or needed supplies for responding to vomiting and diarrhea incidents were on site. The facility was told to provide and maintain them on site. No citation was issued. Re-inspection result: Pass.

headline: Small flies present; no valid food certificate posted
summary: About 15–25 small flies were near the three-compartment sink, rear exit, and walk-in cooler. No valid city food certificate was posted. The person in charge lacked food safety training proof. Thermometer and sink stoppers were missing.

headline: Rodent droppings and no certified manager
summary: About 25 mouse droppings behind the oven, coolers, and inside the rear furnace closet; additional pest service needed. No certified food manager or documentation was present while eggs and whipped cream were handled. Citation issued.

headline: Items on closet floors; raw wood needs sealing
summary: Stored items in storage closets must be raised off the floor. Raw wood shelving and wood under the bar ice bin must be painted or sealed. A missing floor drain cover at the basement soda system must be replaced. Result: Pass.

headline: Leaks, standing water, and improperly stored tongs
summary: Tongs were stored on a pipe above the service sink and must be stored properly. A leaking pipe under the three-compartment sink must be repaired. A missing floor tile holds standing water near the grease trap. Citation issued during initial inspection.

headline: Missing handwash signs; no food handler training
summary: No handwashing sign at the rear prep hand sink; utensils not inverted; bulk containers unlabeled. No food handler training for employees and no allergen training for managers. Re-inspection result: Pass.

headline: Knives in sanitizer; hard-to-read gauges
summary: In-use knives were stored in sanitizer at the employee cafeteria prep counter; they must be on a clean, dry surface. Dish machine temperature gauges were hard to read. Bulk sugar and flour were unlabeled. A juice dispenser drip basin is cracked.

headline: Repeat food handler certificate violation
summary: Food handler certificates still not posted, a repeat violation from February 2025 (citation). Handsinks lacked soap and paper towels during cooking; manager supplied them. Food debris and spills throughout; handwashing signs missing.

headline: No health policy or illness response plan
summary: No employee health policy or training on site (priority). No procedure or kit for vomiting and diarrhea events (priority). No allergen training certificate. Backflow device not accessible behind the ice machine. Cracked wall tiles behind the dish machine.

headline: Can opener, cutting boards, and hood need cleaning
summary: The large can opener needs detail cleaning to remove buildup. Worn, discolored or cut cutting boards must be replaced. The hood vent needs cleaning of grease and dust.

headline: Cold food too warm; corrected on site
summary: Cut lettuce, Italian beef and sliced tomatoes held at 48.4–50.9°F were discarded (about 5 lbs, $19), corrected on site. A three-door cold unit ran at 54.8°F and was tagged. Also: no menu disclosure for undercooked hamburgers, foil liners, and stained ceiling tiles.

headline: No food prep sink at front service area
summary: The coffee/beverage front service area lacks a food preparation sink for preparing food, getting water, and disposing of liquid waste. The manager was instructed to provide one.

headline: Dirty floor and drain under soda machine
summary: The floor and floor drain inside cabinets under the self-service soda machine were dirty with dirt, dust and debris. They must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Insect control device over food prep area
summary: An electric insect control device hangs above glass cups, pitchers and an ice container in the front prep/service area; it must be relocated away from food prep. Clean spoons were not inverted; ice machine buildup and dusty prep ceiling tiles noted.

headline: Wiping cloths not stored in sanitizer
summary: Wiping cloths must be stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. Damaged metal wall and trim near cooking equipment, plus damaged floor and wall tiles, must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Dusty fan covers and light fixtures
summary: Walk-in cooler fan covers in the basement have dust buildup needing detail cleaning. Dust on lights over the serving line must be cleaned, since dishware sits on the top shelf below.

headline: Pet dog on premises; several violations
summary: A pet dog was on premises with a customer; pets are not allowed (citation). Also: no original sanitation certificate posted (citation), no employee health policy, no metal-stem thermometer (citation), unlabeled desserts, and a food handler without a hair restraint.

headline: Four dead cockroaches; raw chicken too warm
summary: Four dead cockroaches were found: three under the wok line and one in the rear storage closet. Raw chicken at 48.6°F was discarded (about 45 lbs, $120; citation). Also: a single-use bowl used as a scoop, heavy grease on the cook line, and dim hallway light.

headline: Rear door gap; greasy mop sink; leaks
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door sweep must be rodent-proofed. Grease and food debris are inside the mop sink. Three-compartment sink faucet leaks at its base. Wall damaged beside hot water tank; one hood filter missing.

headline: Slimy buildup in ice machine; citation issued
summary: Excessive black and pink slimy buildup inside an ice machine was dripping onto ice (priority; citation). Some dry products lacked common-name labels. Milk and cold coffee were on the walk-in cooler floor; food debris on prep and dish area floors.

headline: Ceiling hole drips water; burned-out light
summary: A small hole in the basement ceiling above dry storage drips water into a metal container; it must be repaired or sealed. A burned-out prep ceiling light and a missing light cover must be fixed. Food debris is in prep-area reach-in coolers.

headline: No hand soap; blocked handsink
summary: A prep handsink had no hand soap; a food handler obtained soap during the inspection (priority; citation). Another kitchen prep handsink was blocked by utensils and a container. Unlabeled bulk containers, food in grocery bags, and loose floor debris.

headline: Ice bin needs cleaning
summary: The interior of the ice bin needed cleaning. Remove the ice, clean, and maintain at all times.

headline: Rear door gap; backflow cap missing
summary: Rear exterior door gap over 1/4 inch must be sealed against pests. Backflow device at the rear utility sink is missing its steel cap but works. Clutter in the front storage closet must be removed to allow pest monitoring.

headline: Cold prep cooler too warm; 50 lbs discarded
summary: Chicken (45.7–48°F), cooked pork, hamburgers, fish and steak in the cooler under the grill were above 41°F; about 50 lbs ($300) discarded. Cooler air read 50.5°F and was tagged. Also: two expired food handler certificates; manager's allergen training expired.

headline: Missing hair restraints; debris on floors
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints while preparing food; the manager was told all must wear them. Floor debris along walls and corners in utility and storage areas must be cleaned.

headline: Leaking sanitizer basin pipe; trash on floor
