summary: Three-compartment sink piping attached to the sanitizer basin is leaking and must be repaired. Trash and food debris on floors under cooling and shelving units in prep and dish/storage areas must be cleaned.

headline: No food handler training; missing hood filters
summary: Employees handling food and equipment lack food handler training, and the certified manager lacks allergen training; both must be provided. Hood filters are missing, a washroom faucet is loose, and raw wood shelving must be sealed.

headline: Utensils in buildup; prior violations uncorrected
summary: Pans and utensils were stored in containers with food and flour buildup. Rust on walk-in shelving. Prior violations not corrected: dirty microwave, excess ice in the walk-in freezer, and no food handler training (citation).

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm chlorine; tagged
summary: A low-temperature dish machine behind the bar had a final rinse at 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged as held for inspection. Also: a leak under a third-floor prep handsink, two broken light shields, and two managers with expired allergen training.

headline: Dishwasher hygiene lapses; unsafe cold food
summary: A dishwasher wore gloves through dirty and clean dishes without washing hands (citation). About 25 lbs ($82) of milk, yogurt, hummus and cheesecake held at 46–61°F were discarded. Rear hand sink was blocked by garbage; now cleared.

headline: Missing bathroom vent cover; dirty vent
summary: A bathroom vent cover was missing, and the vent had debris and dirty lint. The operator must cover, clean and maintain the vent.

headline: Undercooked food menu disclosure; corrected
summary: Animal-derived foods that can be served undercooked lacked asterisks and a menu disclosure; corrected before inspection ended (priority). An opening at the west exit door must be sealed. Handsink lacks splash guards; expired food handler certificates; leaking pipe under the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Live flies found; pest control required
summary: Prior violation not corrected: about 100 or more live small flies on walls, ceilings, ducting, near garbage bins and soiled aprons. Pest control service required (citation). Catering food was stored under overhead motors. Worn cutting board and greasy fryer also noted.

headline: Cardboard shelving; dusty vents
summary: Cardboard was used on walk-in cooler shelving; it must be removed in favor of smooth, cleanable surfaces. Dust was on a restroom vent and a ceiling vent over meat prep; both must be cleaned.

headline: Thermometer needed in sushi cooler
summary: The operator was instructed to provide a thermometer visible inside the sushi prep cooler.

headline: Original sanitation certificate not posted
summary: No original City of Chicago food sanitation certificate was posted on site. It must be posted at all times. Priority foundation violation; citation issued.

headline: No health policy; cooler temperatures too high
summary: No written employee health policy (priority). Walk-in cooler (50.9°F), 2-door prep cooler (50°F) and 6-door prep cooler (55°F) are too warm; they must hold 41°F or below (priority). Waste water lines run over dishwashing and prep areas. Gaps under two doors.

headline: Hot water restored; handsinks were too cool
summary: Handsinks had no hot water; temperatures ranged 40–80°F, but 100°F is required (priority; citation). Hot water was restored during inspection. The prep handsink drains slowly and leaks underneath. Debris and spillage on basement floor by soda equipment.

headline: Soiled cloths, greasy floors, short hand-sink run
summary: A restroom hand sink ran under 15 seconds (minimum 15). Soiled wiping cloths sat on a cooler beside cooking equipment; they must be kept in sanitizer. Grease and food debris under sinks and equipment must be cleaned.

headline: Cold serving line foods too warm; citation
summary: Beef (51.8°F), eggs (52.3°F), turkey, roast beef and other cold items in the serving line were above 41°F; manager discarded about 51 lbs ($300). Display case at 55.4°F and prep cooler at 68°F; room near 89°F (priority; citation).

headline: No manager on site; dish machine at 0 ppm
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site while chicken was prepped (priority; citation). Low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged. Chicken, lentil soup and other foods at 46–49°F in a reach-in cooler were discarded (about 60 lbs, $250).

headline: Exposed caulk below sink
summary: Exposed foam-like caulk on walls below the three-compartment sink must be resurfaced to a smooth, easily cleanable surface.

headline: Coolers, freezer, and floors need cleaning
summary: Reach-in coolers and the rear prep freezer have spills and debris and need interior cleaning; the freezer also needs defrosting. Kitchen floors along walls and in corners need cleaning. Manager lacks allergen training; provide it or citations follow.

headline: Spills, grease, and food debris to clean
summary: Spillage inside the cold brew cooler must be cleaned. Food debris behind cooking equipment, the ice machine, and walk-in freezer shelving must be cleaned, as must the wall behind the large oven and the hood over the rear oven.

headline: Ice machine residue; leaking hot-water knob
summary: Residue was building up on the edge of a small ice machine's opening; it must be cleaned. A hot-water knob leaked at a food-prep handwashing sink and must be repaired.

headline: Cold food too warm; no use-by dates
summary: Tofu (47°F), whipping cream (48°F) and cut greens (48°F) sat above 41°F in a prep cooler running at 44°F. Many TCS foods lacked use-by dates. One food handler lacked a valid training certificate. Priority violations cited.

headline: Front door gap; leaking women's faucet
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the front exit door must be sealed to prevent pest entry. A leaking faucet at the women's washroom handsink must be repaired.

headline: No handwashing sign; debris in fryer
summary: No handwashing sign at the food prep handsink. Debris inside the fryer must be cleaned. The hot water handle at the bar handsink does not turn on and off properly and must be repaired.

headline: Dirty floors under sink; greasy hood filters
summary: Floors under the three-compartment sink need cleaning along wall bases to remove spills and debris. Filters above cooking equipment must be cleaned of grease and debris. The person in charge lacks allergen training.

headline: Chicken too cool to hold hot; sinks blocked
summary: Chicken at 124–127°F in the hot holding unit was below 135°F (priority; citation); about 1 lb discarded. Prep and warewashing handsinks were blocked with cups and containers, which were removed during inspection. Floors heavily stained.

headline: Mouse droppings under shelves; corrected on site
summary: Repeat violation: over 40 mouse droppings under display shelves, plus over 20 behind and over 20 near candy shelves. Corrected on site with licensed pest control (Ecolab) present and staff cleaning. Also: unsealed wall holes, dusty fan covers, dirty floors.

headline: Dirty equipment and surfaces; leaking hose hookup
summary: Utensils were stored between uses; a clean sanitized holder is required. Grease on the can opener and cooking equipment, dirty floors, and a leaking hose hookup at a mop sink were noted. Allergen certificate was missing; operator must provide it.

headline: No hot water at men's handsink
summary: The employee men's handsink had no hot water (60.2°F). Employees must use the women's washroom; a 2-day notice was given to comply (priority; citation). Also: missing handwashing signs, unlabeled bulk containers, and a slow leak under the 3-compartment sink.

headline: Missing handwashing sign; greasy floor
summary: An exposed basement prep handwashing sink had no handwashing sign. A prep cooler door gasket is torn. Grease built up on the floor under the fryers. The certified manager's allergen training certificate has expired.

headline: Stained cutting board attached to cooler
summary: A cutting board attached to the deli cooler in the prep area has deep stains and cuts. It must be sanded and resealed to a smooth, cleanable surface, or replaced.

headline: Stained, seamed cutting boards
summary: Cutting boards in the meat prep area have open seams and dark stains. They must be refinished or replaced.

headline: Floors not clean under heavy equipment
summary: Floors behind and under heavy equipment and in storage areas were not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Dirty walk-in vent; rusted, leaking faucet
summary: The walk-in cooler air vent is dirty. A rusted, leaky fixture at the rear hand sink must be repaired. Walk-in floors need cleaning along wall bases and corners, plus floors around the grease trap. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Plates and cups used as scoops in food
summary: Plates and Styrofoam cups were submerged in consommé, ceviche and dry goods and used as dispensing utensils; proper utensils are required. Food handlers lacked beard or hair restraints. An oven door was sealed shut and must be made accessible.

headline: Handsink too cool; cooler warm; door gaps
summary: Handwashing sink in the all-gender washroom ran at 82°F; it must reach 100°F (priority). An air curtain cooler at 59.4°F was tagged and corrected on site. Front entrance door has gaps to be sealed. Also: spills in cold units and repairs needed.

headline: No certified manager for 50 minutes
summary: No certified manager was on site from 11:05 to 11:55 AM while tuna was prepared (priority; citation). No vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit was on site (priority; citation). Frozen meat was thawing in a basement box; a torn freezer gasket and grease buildup were also noted.

headline: Hair restraint and allergen training missing
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. The certified manager lacked valid allergen training. Both must be corrected and maintained.

headline: No hot restroom water; dish machine at 0 ppm
summary: No hot running water at all three restroom handsinks; temperatures 74.5–83.2°F, but 100°F is required (priority; citation). Low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine; sanitizer replaced, now 75 ppm (citation). Three-compartment sink leaks while draining.

headline: Ice bin interior needs cleaning
summary: The interior of the ice bin needed cleaning. Staff must remove the ice, clean it, and maintain it at all times.

headline: Dusty ceilings in food prep area
summary: Accumulated dust and debris were on ceilings in the prepared foods prep area. Inspector instructed the operator to clean them.

headline: Cool restroom water; raw eggs stored over food
summary: Restroom hot water reached only 70.4°F (women's) and 82.2°F (men's); manager corrected during inspection (priority). Raw eggs stored above ready-to-eat food in the walk-in were removed. Also: unlabeled rice containers, oversized pots, and food stored on floors.

headline: Peeling ceiling tiles; mold-like growth
summary: Peeling ceiling tiles over food storage must be repaired to prevent contamination. Black mold-like substance on caulking above the dish machine sprayer, the wall behind the low-temperature dish machine, and the ceiling above the mop sink must be cleaned.

headline: Ice machine lime; bowls used as scoops
summary: The ice machine interior had lime and debris; clean and maintain. Bowls submerged in food containers are used as dispensers; proper utensils are required. Ceramic cups need lead-safety documentation or removal. Missing coving; standing water in furnace room.

headline: Ice machine buildup; sink water backs up
summary: Black and pink buildup inside an ice machine panel was dripping onto ice (priority; citation). Water backs up between three-compartment sink basins (citation). Grease and dust in kitchen. Missing handwashing sign, no hair restraint, unlabeled flour.

headline: Missing handwash signs; leaks; slow drains
summary: No handwashing signs at two hand sinks. A splash guard is needed at a second-floor bar hand sink. Leaking cold-water handle, slow drains, low pressure at the dump sink, and a leak under the 3-compartment sink. Heavy debris in floor drains.

headline: Ice buckets on floor; clothing on equipment
summary: Ice buckets were placed on the floor next to the ice maker; keep them off the floor. Personal clothing was placed on food equipment; keep it away from the food prep area.

headline: Reach-in coolers need detail cleaning
summary: The interior of the reach-in coolers was in need of cleaning; the inspector instructed a detail clean.

headline: Ice machine edge and fryer buildup
summary: A light dark buildup on the inside edge of the ice machine (not touching ice) must be cleaned. Grease and food debris in the lower opening of the deep fryers must be cleaned.

headline: Cold food unsafe; deli cooler tagged out
summary: About 50 lbs ($77) of cold foods at 50.1–92.4°F were discarded. Deli cooler air read 59°F; it was tagged out until it holds 41°F or below. Also: damaged cutting board, greasy grill walls, no allergen training proof.

headline: No health policies; hot water too cool
summary: No signed employee health policies (priority). Hot water is below required temperatures: 3-compartment sink 90.3°F (needs 110°F), hand sink 92.3°F (needs 100°F). Also: a leaking pipe under the 3-compartment sink, grease behind equipment.

headline: Ice scoop stored inside ice machine
summary: An ice scoop was stored inside the ice machine; it must go in a clean, separate container. Also: loose faucet at the 3-compartment sink, debris under the dumpster, syrup on the walk-in floor, and floors under ice machines to clean.

headline: Mouse droppings, live flies, no manager certificate
summary: About 60 mouse droppings in several areas, plus about 13 live black flies on prep tables, display cases and mixers. Pest control required (priority; citation). Also: no certified manager during food prep, no health policies, and no food handler certificates.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate on site
summary: No valid City sanitation certificate was on site while steak, rice and chicken were prepared and served (priority; citation). Also: missing cooler handle, grease-buildup gaskets, no food handler certificates for non-managers, and an expired allergen certificate.

headline: Missing thermometers and sanitizer test strips
summary: Some prep coolers lacked thermometers. No sanitizing test strips were on site (priority). Raw meat was held in plastic grocery bags. Slow drains, food buildup on walls, a burned-out ceiling light, and missing hood filters were also noted.

headline: Sushi handsink missing; sinks blocked
summary: No handwashing sink in the basement sushi rice prep area (priority; citation). Two hand sinks were blocked and were cleared during inspection; the prep sink lacked soap. Cooked fish at 98°F in an unpowered toaster oven was discarded (priority; citation).

headline: Fly trap over prep; rear door gap
summary: An electric fly trap hangs above sanitized equipment and a prep table in front prep; insect control devices cannot be over food prep and must be relocated. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door must be sealed. Also: broken ice scoop, milk crates as shelving.

headline: Beard and hair restraints not worn properly
summary: In the bakery prep area, a male food handler had a beard without a beard guard, and a female food handler's hair was not fully restrained. Proper restraints must be worn at all times.

headline: No employee health policy; no summary posted
summary: No employee health policies on premises (priority; citation). No inspection summary posted for customers (priority; citation). New employees lack food handler training. Handsinks drain slowly; a pipe leaks under the exposed handsink.

headline: Dead mouse on glue board; dead insects
summary: A dead mouse was on a glue board, and dead insects were on the floor along the stairway and in the basement. Manager must remove them. Also: leaking sink faucet, damaged walls and floors, no food handler training, no manager allergen training.

headline: New hires lacked food handler certificates
summary: When employees are hired, they must provide food handler certificates. Operator was instructed to correct this and maintain it.

headline: No food handler certificates; toilet out of service
summary: No current food handler certificates for any employee; proof is required. An employee toilet was covered and out of service (priority; citation). Also: torn cooler door linings, grill hood lights out, and no manager allergen training proof.

headline: Manager has only photocopy of certificate
summary: The person in charge lacks an original City food service manager's certificate; only a photocopy is on premises (priority; citation). Also: a stained cutting board used for fruit, floor and ceiling vent cleaning, and new employees needing food handler training.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; tagged
summary: Fourth-floor kitchenette's low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged; use the first-floor machine or three-compartment sink until serviced (priority; citation). Also: ice machine residue, stained cutting board, broken cold-water knob.

headline: Leaks, pooling water, torn gaskets, rust
summary: Ceiling pipe leak in the basement and a leak under the employee handsink; excessive pooling water in the basement. Torn gaskets and curtains, rust on shelving, pizza oven debris, and a missing ceiling tile and sink stoppers. Server had expired food handler certificate.

headline: Greasy hood filters
summary: Grease built up on the hood ventilation filters. The person in charge must clean and maintain them.

headline: No manager; food too warm; no pest logbook
summary: No certified manager on site while TCS foods were prepped; manager arrived later (priority; citation). Sliced fish (52.3–61.5°F) and shrimp (54°F) were discarded. No pest control logbook; last service listed as 5/17/23 (citation). Food stored on floors.

headline: No sink for barista; missing handwashing signs
summary: No handwashing signs at employee washroom sinks. No exposed handwashing sink in the barista prep area (priority). Missing ceiling tile, missing grout, and stained ceiling tile were noted. No mechanical ventilation in employee washrooms.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; no thermometer
summary: Black slime was dripping from an ice machine's internal parts into ice (priority; citation). No working metal-stem thermometer was on site to check food temperatures (priority; citation). One employee lacked food handler training proof.

headline: Grab-and-go yogurt cups lack ingredient labels
summary: Packaged yogurt cups sold grab-and-go were not labeled with ingredients. Operator was instructed to label all packaged foods.

headline: Unsafe reheating and cold storage; food discarded
summary: Grilled onions (108.5°F) and chili (124°F) on the steam table were below 165°F after reheating; about 10 lbs discarded. Raw beef (48.4°F) and grilled onions (up to 55.2°F) in the walk-in cooler were too warm; about 20 lbs discarded.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; loose sink
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at several sinks throughout the facility. A front kitchen handsink is loose from the wall and inadequately sealed; it must be repaired. Rear warewashing walls and ceilings are heavily yellowed and hard to clean.

headline: Ice scoops left on ice machine; leaky faucet
summary: Ice scoops were stored on top of the ice machine; they must go in a clean container when not in use. A dishwashing-area handwashing sink faucet leaks at its base and must be repaired.

headline: No allergen training proof on site
summary: No proof of allergen awareness training was provided for City food service sanitation managers. Valid allergen training must be provided for all employees holding City sanitation certificates.

headline: No certified manager during meat service
summary: No City-certified food manager was on site while chicken, beef and pork were prepared and served (priority; citation). Food debris buildup on prep shelves and tabletops must be cleaned.

headline: Unlabeled bulk oregano; leaking dish machine
summary: Bulk ingredient containers in the basement were unlabeled (oregano noted). Tape repair on a pizza prep cooler must be replaced with a smooth surface. Excessive dish machine leak must be fixed. Grime on prep ceiling, beer cooler floor, and vents.

headline: Cracked floor tiles and low grout
summary: Some floor tiles at the prep-area cookline are in poor repair and low on grout. The manager must repair and regrout the damaged tiles.

headline: No certified manager on site; citation issued
summary: No City-certified manager or original certificate was on site while pasta and cooked proteins were prepared (priority; citation). Also: no handwashing signs at basement sink, lasagna cooling under a lid, unlabeled dry food bins, and single-use cups used as scoops.

headline: Dish machine too cool to sanitize; citation
summary: High-temperature dish machine wash water measured 130°F; it must be at least 150°F to sanitize (priority; citation). Also: buildup on grill, ovens and walk-in racks, several toilets and a urinal not working, a broken prep sink, and a leaking drain pipe.

headline: Restroom doors lack self-closing devices
summary: Men's and women's restroom doors in the bar area do not self-close. A self-closing device must be installed and maintained at all times.

headline: No handsink at hot chocolate stand
summary: The temporary structure serving hot chocolate on Saturdays had no handwashing sink. Operator must provide one or switch to self-service. Priority foundation violation; no citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; beverages stored on floor
summary: A manager on duty lacked a valid City of Chicago certificate, and a citation was issued. Beverages were stored on the floor in the rear and storage area and must be raised 6 inches. Trash was near the dumpster, and a mop was not drying properly.

headline: Failed: food too warm; employee ate by food
summary: Pork at 51.3°F and beef at 52.0°F were found, and the manager discarded 8 pounds ($25); a citation was issued. An employee ate next to hot-held food. A repeat core violation for unclean equipment was cited.

headline: Hand soap stored out of reach at coffee bar
summary: The front coffee-bar hand sink had no soap, and the bulk soap was stored under a sink, so staff reached onto the floor for it. The person in charge provided soap at the sink during inspection, and a citation was issued.

headline: Failed: missing consumer advisory and training
summary: The menu lacked the consumer advisory for raw or undercooked foods, and a citation was issued. Handwashing signs were missing at all sinks. Grocery bags were used for food storage, and food handler training was missing for all handlers.

headline: Re-inspection: caulk and chipped paint on walls
summary: Exposed foam-like caulk was found on walls and around pipes in the rear prep and dish areas. Chipped paint was also found on walls there. Staff were told to resurface and repaint so walls are smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Failed: flies in basement and dish machine issues
summary: About 50 live small flies were on walls and ceilings in the basement prep area and mop closet, and a citation was issued. Black slime was dripping into ice made for people, and a citation was issued. A dish machine read 0 ppm sanitizer and was tagged.

headline: No certified manager; front door gap
summary: The person in charge had no valid City of Chicago certificate, and no certified manager was on site while chicken and baked beans were handled. A citation was issued. A 1/4-inch gap under the front door must be sealed, and no food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Dead insects, door gaps and no health policies
summary: Dead insects were found in an unused front cooler and must be cleaned out. The front door has a gap and pin holes that let insects in, and must be repaired. No signed employee health policies were on site. A leaking sink and a broken toilet-room vent were also noted.

headline: Re-inspection: thermometers, rear door, slow drain
summary: Prep coolers and refrigerators lacked ambient air thermometers. The lower left rear exit door is not rodent-proof and must be fixed. A rear prep hand sink drains slowly and must be repaired.

headline: Containers on floor; walk-in cooler lighting poor
summary: Disposable food containers were stored on the basement floor, and staff were told to raise them. The walk-in cooler had inadequate lighting, and staff were told to add lights.

headline: Missing signs, labels and hair restraint
summary: The first-floor prep hand sink had no handwashing signs. Bulk food containers, including flour and sugar, had no labels, and a food handler lacked a hair restraint. Staff must correct each of these issues.

headline: Complaint: ice machine and floors need cleaning
summary: The ice machine chute and sides must be cleaned and sanitized. Thermometers are needed in coolers, and bulk container labels have worn off. The front deep freezer needs defrosting, and floors and drains need cleaning. Hood filters are dirty.

headline: Failed: front door gap and overflowing dumpster
summary: The front door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom that must be sealed to prevent pests. The outside dumpster was open and overflowing, giving pests access to food, and a citation was issued. A broken hot water knob at the prep hand sink was also cited.

headline: Ice scoop, drinks and debris need correcting
summary: An ice scoop was stored inside the ice bin, and must be kept in a clean container. Soft drink cans were stored on the floor in the rear storage area and must be raised. Dirt and debris were found behind cooking equipment.

headline: Cooked vegetables held at 48°F; discarded
summary: Cooked mixed vegetables were held at 48°F, above the 41°F limit. The manager discarded about 1/8 pound. A priority violation and citation were issued.

headline: Manager still lacks allergen training; citation issued
summary: A previously cited core violation was not corrected: the certified food manager still had no allergen training. Staff were told to obtain the training and keep proof on site. A citation was issued.

headline: Blocked hand sink; missing soap and towels
summary: A dish-area hand sink was blocked by utensils and bussing tubs. Soap was missing at the coffee-bar sink, and paper towels were missing at several hand sinks. About 30 pounds of potatoes held at 62.4°F were discarded.

headline: Ice scoop on ice; ice maker backflow not located
summary: An ice scoop was stored on top of ice cubes and must be kept off them. The backflow prevention device for the ice maker could not be located, and staff were told to expose it.

headline: No certified manager on site; hair restraint missing
summary: No certified food manager was on site while milk, coffee, hot chocolate and tea were prepared, and a citation was issued. An employee handled unpackaged food without a hair restraint. Food debris built up on the floor, and duct tape covered air vents.

headline: Failed: walk-in freezer not working; no health policy
summary: The walk-in freezer compressor was out, and a repair part was ordered for next week. A priority violation was noted. No employee health policy was on the premises, and an exposed hand sink was not working properly.

headline: Complaint: dirty drains, fryers and floors
summary: Dirt, debris and a dark substance were found in floor drains under the three-compartment sink and dishwasher. Staff were told to clean them to prevent pests. Fryers, cooler doors, a freezer floor, and areas under cooking equipment also need cleaning.

headline: Door gap and no grease trap found
summary: A 1/4-inch gap under the alley door by the three-compartment sink must be repaired. No grease trap was connected to the sink, and staff were told to locate or install one. Damaged ceiling tiles in rear storage need replacing.

headline: Failed: roaches found; prior violation not corrected
summary: Live and dead roaches were found on walls, floors and a cooler door gasket. A previous roach violation was not corrected, and a citation was issued. Staff must call pest control and provide a service receipt. Grease buildup and damaged walls were also noted.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; use stopped
summary: The low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm sanitizer, and staff were told not to use it until fixed. The manager called maintenance, and a citation was issued. No splashguard was present at the hand sink, and food containers were on floors.

headline: Failed: chicken too warm; flies and rodent droppings
summary: About 150 pounds of cooked chicken at 50-100°F were discarded, and a citation was issued. About 100 live flies and about 40 rodent droppings were found, and staff were told to contact pest control. No soap or paper towels were available at sinks.

headline: Dish machines not sanitizing; portable bar closed
summary: Two low-temperature dish machines were not sanitizing at final rinse, and the bar machine was running low on sanitizer. A portable pool-deck bar with open ice bins and no hand sink was found, and the manager closed it. A priority violation was noted.

headline: Clogged deli hand sink; citation issued
summary: The deli prep hand sink was clogged and did not drain at all. The manager was told all hand sinks must be kept usable at all times, and a citation was issued.

headline: Dirty hood filters and furnace room floor
summary: Exhaust hood filters were not clean and must be cleaned. The floor inside the furnace room also must be cleaned. No other issues were noted.

headline: Handwashing signs needed; rear door strip broken
summary: Handwashing signs were needed at two hand sinks in the sushi prep area. A thermometer was needed inside a rear refrigerator, and a broken rubber strip at the rear exit door must be replaced. Shelves and floors need cleaning.

headline: Failed: no handwashing sink in front prep area
summary: The front coffee and smoothie prep area had no hand sink with hot and cold water. Staff were told to install one or remove prep equipment, and a priority violation was noted. Expired food handler and allergen certificates were found.

headline: Complaint: leaks, labels and cutting boards
summary: Bulk containers in the basement lacked labels. Cutting boards in meat and cooking areas need replacing, and leaking faucets in three areas need repair. Peeling ceiling paint and dust in air vents must be addressed.

headline: Milk too warm; cafe cooler tagged
summary: Milk at 49-57°F in the cafe reach-in cooler was discarded, valued at $10. A cafe dairy cooler at 62°F was tagged and cannot be used until re-inspected. No allergen training proof was on site for City-certified managers.

headline: Failed: about 500 pounds of food too warm
summary: Steak at 50°F and many other foods at 48-65°F were in a two-door refrigerator. About 500 pounds ($4,000) was discarded, and a citation was issued. A fly strip hanging over the prep area must be removed, and some food handler and allergen certificates were expired.

headline: Failed: no valid manager certificate on site
summary: No manager with a valid City of Chicago certificate was on site while deli meat was prepared, and a citation was issued. A previously noted core violation was not corrected: the ice machine lacked a visible backflow prevention device, and a citation was issued.

headline: Failed: raw meat stored above ready-to-eat noodles
summary: Raw chicken and pork were stored directly above ready-to-eat noodles, and all noodles were discarded. The chemical dish machine dispensed no sanitizer (0 ppm) and was tagged. Black and pink slime was dripping from the ice machine into ice.

headline: Failed: no health policy; hot water too cool
summary: No written employee health policy was on site, and a citation was issued. The bar hand sink had no paper towels, which staff supplied during inspection. Dish-area hot water measured 80.2°F, below the required 100°F, and a citation was issued.

headline: No posted manager certificate; floor drain backed up
summary: No original City of Chicago food manager certificate was posted on site, and a citation was issued. Wastewater backed up from a kitchen floor drain when the hand sink ran. A technician serviced the drain during inspection.

headline: Failed: about 200 mouse droppings throughout
summary: About 200 mouse droppings were scattered through the bar, dining, prep and dry storage areas, including on paper goods. Staff must discard contaminated paper products, clean, and inform pest control. A citation was issued. Undercooked menu items also lacked asterisks, and food handler certificates were expired.

headline: Improper thawing and no pest control service
summary: Large tubs of frozen broth were thawed at room temperature and must be thawed according to code. No pest control service or logbook was on site, which is a priority violation. A bulk salt container lacked a label, and sink stoppers were in poor repair.

headline: Re-inspection: leaking dish-area hand sink
summary: A dish-area hand sink was inaccessible and leaked during use, and a priority violation was noted. An ice scoop was left on top of ice, and mop heads were not hung to dry. Debris around the dumpster and dust on vents were also noted.

headline: Unused basement refrigerator should be removed
summary: An unused refrigerator was found in the basement. The manager was told to remove unused and unnecessary items from the facility.

headline: Pork held too warm; hand sink blocked; citations issued
summary: Pork at 50.6°F was found in the prep refrigerator, and the manager discarded 7 pounds (about $60). A hand sink was blocked by boxes, and soap and paper towels were missing; staff supplied them during inspection. A 1/4-inch door gap was noted.

headline: Re-inspection: cluttered yard and basement
summary: The outside yard had stacked items, grease buckets, trash and old equipment. The basement was cluttered, with items on the floor that must be raised 6 inches. No allergen certificates were on site for certified managers.

headline: Dirty can opener and rusted walk-in racks
summary: A can opener in prep was encrusted with food debris and must be cleaned or replaced. Aluminum foil lined equipment and prep tables and must be removed. Rusted storage racks in the walk-in cooler must be cleaned.

headline: Re-inspection: door gaps and general upkeep issues
summary: Gaps at the front entry door must be sealed. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, shelving and carts must be cleaned. Damaged floor and ceiling tiles, loose wall base, and dust in vents need attention. Food handler training was missing.

headline: Re-inspection: rodent-proofing gaps must be fixed
summary: The receiving dock garage door was not rodent-proof at the bottom. A wall opening behind the refrigerator and a gap under a storage unit holding rice and sorghum must be repaired and sealed.

headline: Dirty drawer cooler; ice maker backflow device not located
summary: Food debris was found in the bottom of a drawer cooler at the grill station, and staff were told to clean it. The backflow prevention device for the coffee-station ice maker could not be located and must be exposed.

headline: Missing thermometers; brooms stored near food
summary: Several prep coolers lacked thermometers, and staff were told to provide them. Brooms were hung too close to food containers at the sushi prep station and must be moved away.

headline: Failed: mold in ice machine; bar washer not sanitizing
summary: The ice machine had heavy black mold-like buildup, and a citation was issued. The bar warewashing unit showed 0 ppm chlorine, was tagged, and must not be used. No employee health policy was on site, and crates were used for storage.

headline: Complaint: labels, cutting boards and cleaning
summary: Bulk containers need commodity name labels, and cutting boards with deep cuts must be replaced. Cooking equipment, shelves and hood need detail cleaning. Prep floors need cleaning, and carpets in dining and bar areas need cleaning.

headline: Failed: no certified manager and no pest logbook
summary: No certified food manager was on site while mac and cheese, chicken and tilapia were prepared, and a citation was issued. No pest control logbook or service proof was provided, and a citation was issued. A food handler lacked a hair restraint.

headline: Failed: food not dated; prep cooler at 52°F
summary: Cooked foods held over 24 hours were not date-marked, and a citation was issued. A prep cooler held sauces and onions at 52°F and was tagged for repair. A cracked scoop was used on the grill, and no sanitizer test strips were on site.

headline: Missing thermometers and unlabeled dry goods
summary: Refrigeration units lacked thermometers, and large containers of rice and flour lacked common-name labels. Cutting boards with open seams and stains must be replaced. A ladies' restroom lacked a covered sanitary napkin receptacle, and food debris was on the floor.

headline: Failed: no hand sink by three-compartment sink
summary: No hand sink was found next to the rear three-compartment sink, as required in a previous violation that was not corrected. A citation was issued. Staff must install a hand sink with hot and cold water, soap and paper towels.

headline: Re-inspection: residue on three-compartment sink
summary: Residue and splatters were found on the sides of the three-compartment sink. The person in charge was told to clean and maintain it.

headline: Failed: no vomit cleanup kit; low hot water
summary: No bodily fluid spill kit or cleanup procedure was on site, which is a priority violation. Hot water at the three-compartment dish sink was 68°F, below the required 100°F, and a citation was issued. No pest control logbook and no commercial dumpster contract were found.

headline: Complaint: cluttered rear storage room
summary: The rear storage room was cluttered, with items on the floor. The person in charge was told to organize it and keep items elevated off the floor.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings found; no cold water
summary: About 60 small rodent droppings were found in rear storage, under the front counter and on the windowsill. The manager was told to clean and keep the premises free of pests, and a citation was issued. Cold water was missing at a toilet-room hand sink.

headline: Blocked hand sink and missing soap; citation issued
summary: Cleaning tools were stored inside the rear hand sink, which staff were told to clear. The front prep hand sink had no soap, and a citation was issued. Ice and food were uncovered, and milk crates were used as shelving.

headline: Trays stored facing up; low hot water pressure
summary: Single-service trays and bowls were stored facing up at the serving line and must be inverted. Ice buildup in a reach-in freezer must be defrosted. Hot water pressure in the employee restroom is low and must be repaired.

headline: Re-inspection: grease on basement floor
summary: Grease and debris buildup on the floor and wall near basement grease containers must be cleaned. Broken tile near the basement exterior doorway must be repaired.

headline: Unlabeled containers and food stored in grocery bags
summary: Food storage containers lacked common-name labels. A food handler prepared food without hair and beard restraints, and in-use utensils were stored improperly. Food was kept in plastic grocery bags in the freezer, and the washroom door is not self-closing.

headline: Items stored upright and clutter found
summary: Storage containers and bundt cake pans near the three-compartment sink were stored upright and must be inverted. Clutter was found throughout the kitchen and must be removed, and kept items must be raised 6 inches off the floor. Tape holds a sink lever in place.

headline: Failed: no health policy and missing hand sinks
summary: No employee health policy was on site, and no cleanup kit existed for vomiting or diarrhea events. Hand sinks were missing or not convenient in three areas, and signs were missing. A citation was noted for the missing sinks, and a coffee machine lacked a backflow device.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; food stored on floors
summary: No person in charge with a valid certificate was present, and no certified manager was on duty while chicken, shrimp and eggs were prepared. A citation was issued. Food and supplies were stored on floors, and grease was spilled near the grease container.

headline: No health policy; leaking faucet and peeling paint
summary: No employee health policy was on the premises. Hand-washing signs were missing in washrooms. A leaking faucet at the three-compartment sink, peeling paint, and gaps and missing floor tiles in the kitchen must be repaired.

headline: Cold foods held above safe temperature; food discarded
summary: Several cold foods were stored at 45°F to 48°F, above the 41°F limit. The manager discarded about $100 of food, including cabbage, mashed potatoes, rice and beef stew. A citation was issued.

headline: Dirty cooler interiors; items on floors
summary: Cooler interiors holding food had mold-like buildup, dirt and spills, and staff were told to clean them. Restrooms were dirty, and a cardboard box was used as a restroom trash can. Stock room products were stored on floors and must be raised 6 inches.

headline: Re-inspection: hair restraint and sink stoppers
summary: A food handler without a hair restraint was found in the front prep area. Sink stoppers on the three-compartment sink were in poor condition, and the hood above cooking equipment was missing filters.

headline: Failed: slime in ice machine; expired cards
summary: Heavy pink and black slime was found inside the ice machine used for customers' ice. Staff were told to remove ice and clean and sanitize it, and a citation was issued. Two food handler cards were expired, and allergen certificates were missing.

headline: Failed license: no health policy or pest log
summary: No employee health policy or pest control logbook was on site. A rear door had a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom. Employees lacked food handler certificates, and a manager on duty lacked allergen training. No menu was available for the consumer advisory.

headline: Bare-hand food contact; sanitizer too strong
summary: A worker touched ready-to-eat bread with bare hands, and a citation was issued. Three dozen eggs at 54-58°F were discarded. Quat sanitizer exceeded the allowed concentration, and a citation was issued. Fish was thawed in a sink, and the rear door has a 1/4-inch gap.

headline: No certified manager; thawing and hand sink problems
summary: No certified food manager was on site and no certificate was posted while eggs and sausage were handled. Frozen sausages were stored in a hand sink, and sausage was thawing at room temperature. A priority violation was noted.

headline: Re-inspection: food on floors and condensation leaks
summary: Food was stored on floors in the freezer, cooler and storage areas, and a lemonade container was in a utility sink. Staff were told to elevate food and remove the lemonade. Condensation leaked in a cooler, and leaking drains and grease buildup were found.

headline: Leaking faucet and broken A/C vent
summary: A sink faucet in the rear prep area leaked and must be repaired. Grease buildup on lower walls and piping behind cooking equipment needs cleaning. A broken A/C vent in the rear pickup area exposed the unit and must be repaired to prevent pests.

headline: Food handler lacked hair restraint
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint and must wear one.

headline: Weak water pressure at kitchen hand sink
summary: The kitchen hand sink had very weak water pressure, with water only trickling from the faucet. Water must be supplied under city pressure. A bulk salt container lacked a label.

headline: Complaint: rear door opening; cleaning needed
summary: A small opening at the bottom of the rear door must be repaired to prevent pests. Floors under and around cooking equipment, the three-compartment sink and the grease trap exterior must be cleaned. Filters above cooking equipment need grease removed.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings found in several areas
summary: About 25 rodent droppings were found by dry storage, under the customer counter, and in rear storage. Staff were told to eliminate pests, clean, and call pest control. The entrance door and concession window had 1/2-inch gaps, and a citation was issued.

headline: Failed: no hot water; food held too warm
summary: The rear prep hand sink was not accessible and produced no hot water, and a citation was issued. Beef patties at 45°F and other foods at 44-63°F were discarded, about 50 pounds ($200). A prep cooler reached 48°F, and a citation was issued.

headline: No certified manager; floors and vents need cleaning
summary: The person in charge had no City of Chicago food sanitation certificate, and a citation was issued. Floors need detail cleaning to remove spills and buildup. Walls, vents, light covers and pipes also need dust removed, and vents above the fryers need cleaning.

headline: Failed: employee did not wash hands; corrected
summary: An employee handled food with bare hands after touching non-food items without washing. The manager corrected it on site, and a citation was issued. Sinks lacked paper towels and soap, and cold foods at 45.7°F to 62.2°F were discarded.

headline: Re-inspection: slow drain and grease buildup
summary: The bar hand sink drains slowly and must be repaired. Grease and food debris must be cleaned from cooking equipment, the fryer cabinet, carts and the ice machine. Staff toilet door needs a self-closing device, and floors need grouting.

headline: Dead roaches found in sink and under counter
summary: Two dead roaches were found in the front three-compartment sink and two more under the service counter. Staff were told to remove them and clean the area. Handwashing signs and sink stoppers were missing, and some pans and cutting boards were rusted or cut.

headline: Complaint: dirty coolers, clutter and no certificates
summary: Interiors of reach-in coolers and freezers need cleaning to remove spills and buildup. Floors have dust and paper debris under shelving. Unnecessary items in back rooms must be removed, and all food handlers need food handler certificates.

headline: Complaint: floor drain under sink needs cleaning
summary: Debris must be cleaned from the floor drain under the three-compartment sink. No other issues were noted.

headline: Grease buildup and hole in floor found
summary: Grease was found on cooking equipment, walls, floors and shelving, and staff were told to degrease and sanitize. A hole in the floor by the register was patched with cardboard and tape and must be properly repaired. Clutter must be removed.

headline: Failed: buildup inside rear ice machine
summary: The rear ice machine had pink, black and brown buildup inside, and ice was in use for people. Staff were told to remove ice and deep clean, and a citation was issued. Bulk dry ingredients were unlabeled.

headline: Missing thermometers and food handler certificates
summary: Cooling units holding milk, eggs and sour cream, and both walk-in coolers, lacked thermometers. Working ingredients lacked labels, and grocery bags held meat. The toilet room door is not self-closing, and no food handler certificates were available.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings and cold foods too warm
summary: About 60 mouse droppings were found in storage, kitchen prep and the front sushi area, and a citation was issued. Staff were told to call an exterminator. Shrimp at 50.2°F and chicken at 47.8°F were discarded, about 13 pounds ($100).

headline: Trash and debris outside around corral
summary: Debris and trash were found inside and outside around the corral. Staff were told to clean and maintain the area.

headline: Sushi cooler foods too warm; unit tagged
summary: Raw salmon, raw tuna and cooked eel in the sushi cooler were at 45-46°F and were discarded. A 2-door cooler at 55°F was tagged and must not be used until repaired. About $150 of food was discarded, and a citation was issued.

headline: Ice buildup in walk-in; cutting boards stained
summary: Ice buildup was found on the ceiling inside the walk-in cooler, and staff were told to repair the condensation units. Cutting boards with open seams and dark stains at the front prep cooler must be refinished or replaced.

headline: No certified food manager during food preparation
summary: The person in charge had no City of Chicago sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was present while ground beef and Italian beef sandwiches were prepared. A citation was issued. Handwashing signs, cooler mold, and cleaning issues were also noted.

headline: To-go food labels missing; no food handler cards
summary: To-go guacamole and macaroni salad lacked ingredient and allergen labels. No food handler cards were on site, and staff must obtain and keep them. Sticky debris and grease on hood filters were also noted.

headline: Dusty washroom fan and basement debris
summary: A dusty ventilation fan in one washroom must be cleaned. Debris on the basement floor along the wall must be swept.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; no hand soap
summary: No person in charge with a valid certificate was present, and no certified manager was on duty while chicken and empanadas were prepared. A citation was issued. The employee restroom hand sink lacked soap, and a citation was issued.

headline: Failed: raw foods at 60-70°F discarded
summary: Raw eggs, chicken and beef held at 60-70°F were discarded, about 50 pounds ($200). A front prep reach-in cooler at 65°F was in poor repair, and a repair technician arrived during inspection. Cooking without ventilation in the basement must stop.

headline: Employees lacked hair restraints in prep area
summary: Employees were not wearing hair restraints in the front food prep area. They must wear them whenever food is being prepared and served.

headline: Pork and fish held too warm; food discarded
summary: Cooked pork at 55°F and fish at 76°F were not held cold enough. The manager discarded 2 pounds of pork and 7 pounds of fish (about $30), and a citation was issued. Rusted shelves, a leaking sink pipe, and a repeat allergen-training violation were also noted.

headline: Floors need cleaning near grease tank
summary: Passed. Floors around the inside grease tank and along the wall behind the bread at the rear door need cleaning.

headline: Basement washroom: no self-closing door, no vent
summary: Passed re-inspection. The basement unisex employee washroom had no self-closing door, a large ceiling opening, and no mechanical ventilation. Utility room clutter must be removed to prevent rodent hiding places.

headline: Missing handwashing sign at kitchen sink
summary: Passed re-inspection. The food kitchen handwashing sink had no handwashing sign. The operator was instructed to provide and maintain one.

headline: No manager allergen training; cooler not clean
summary: Passed with conditions. A prior violation was not corrected: the food service manager had no allergen training, and proof must be provided. Walk-in cooler walls and ceiling were not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Food on floors; no hair restraints
summary: Passed. Food containers were stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler, prep and storage areas and must be raised at least 6 inches. Food handlers worked without hair restraints. A handwashing sign was missing in the basement restroom.

headline: No employee health policy; no training certificate
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy or food handler training certificate was on site. A 1/4-inch gap under the front door could let pests in. Also cited: broken counter, holes in walls, and a dirty garbage area.

headline: Loose handsink; leaky soap dispenser
summary: Passed. The hand sink in the produce prep area was loose and must be fastened to the wall. A soap dispenser on the dish machine was leaking and must be repaired.

headline: Failed: flies, warm cold food, moldy ice machine
summary: Failed. About 20 small flies were seen in the building. Cold foods held at 45–50°F were discarded. A cold unit at 58.4°F was tagged. Mussels lacked a shellstock tag and were discarded. Mold was found in an ice machine.

headline: Failed: warm raw chicken; flies in prep area
summary: Failed. Raw chicken held at 46.9–47.3°F in the walk-in cooler (about 50 lbs, $100) was discarded. About 8–10 flies were seen at the food prep area and must be eliminated; pest control was advised. Ice machine buildup also cited.

headline: Dirty ice machine and coolers; hole in wall
summary: Passed. A slight buildup was inside the soda ice machine, and debris was in prep area cooler interiors. Both must be cleaned. A hole in the wall under the rear prep handwash sink must be sealed.

headline: 3-compartment sink stopper not working
summary: Passed. The middle compartment stopper of the 3-compartment sink did not work. A working stopper must be provided.

headline: Expired or missing food handler training
summary: Passed re-inspection. Employees had expired or missing food handler training and must provide and maintain it. Grease and food debris built up on fryers, coolers, prep tables and the ice machine interior. Walls and hood filters also need cleaning.

headline: Water leak, rust, and stained cutting boards found
summary: Passed re-inspection. Inspector found a water leak from a drainpipe under the three-compartment dishwashing sink, stained cutting boards, and rust and chipped paint on walk-in cooler shelves. Litter was around the garbage compactor area. Repairs were ordered.

headline: Six dead cockroaches found; several repairs needed
summary: Passed. About 6 dead cockroaches were found under the dishwasher and in basement corners near reach-in freezers, below windows and near mop storage. Also cited: stained cutting boards, uninverted plates, and missing floor tiles under the dishwasher.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; rodent droppings found
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site while TCS (time/temperature-controlled) foods were prepared. Over 30 rat droppings and over 20 mouse droppings were found. One worker lacked a food handler certificate. Dumpsters were open and overflowing.

headline: Food workers lacked hair restraints
summary: Passed. Employees preparing food at the prep area had no hair restraints or protection. Inspector instructed them to wear hair restraints at all times.

headline: Some food handlers lack training certificates
summary: Passed. Some food handlers did not have food handler training certificates. A front milk cooler thermometer was broken, and a 3-compartment sink stopper did not work. Ice machine upper area had pink buildup.

headline: Food debris and chipping paint need cleaning
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food debris built up on an unused drawer cooler, prep coolers, prep tables and a floor mixer. Chipping dining-area walls must be scraped smooth, and floors in prep and dishwashing areas need cleaning.

headline: Missing labels, no drainboard, summary not posted
summary: Passed with conditions. Prepacked items in the front cooler lacked ingredient labels. The three-compartment sink had no drainboard. The inspection summary was not posted for customers and must be displayed.

headline: Detergent in meat cooler; dishes washed unsanitized
summary: Passed with conditions. Chemical detergent was stored inside a walk-in cooler used for meat; food must be in approved containers. Dishes were washed without sanitizer; the manager corrected this on site. Employees drank while preparing food.

headline: No cooler thermometer; no allergen certificates
summary: Passed. The prep area syrup cooler had no working thermometer inside; one must be provided. No food allergen training certificates were on the premises, and certified managers must have them.

headline: No handwash sign; dusty floors and shelves
summary: Passed. The toilet room had no handwashing sign. Dust and small debris covered floors under the three-compartment sink, along walls, and on prep shelves, and a light bulb over the front counter was burned out.

headline: Smoky dining area; no cold water at sink
summary: Passed re-inspection. Smoky haze from cooking was in the customer dining area, and ventilation must be repaired. Cold water would not run at the left faucet of the 3-compartment sink. Food debris covered floors and drains in prep areas.

headline: Chicken held too cool; cold foods too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. Chicken held at 124°F was below the 135°F hot-holding minimum. Cold beef at 53°F and Greek yogurt at 45°F were above 41°F; about $65 of food was discarded. Ice machine interior had calcium buildup.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; dirty cooling units; ceiling damage
summary: Passed re-inspection. A cooler thermometer was missing, and a three-door cooler had torn gaskets and duct tape. Cooling units needed cleaning, floors under heavy equipment had food and grease, and ceiling fixtures had holes and water stains.

headline: Dirty ice machine, unlabeled containers, dusty vents
summary: Passed. The ice machine lining was dirty and must be cleaned. Food containers lacked labels, and floor and ceiling tiles were damaged or missing. Heavy dust covered ceiling vents and light shields.

headline: Cook lacked training; meat in shopping bags
summary: Passed. A cook on duty had no valid food handler training. Meat was frozen in plastic shopping bags in the basement freezer; only food-grade containers may be used. The prep cooler lacked a thermometer and had a torn gasket.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; slimy ice machines
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on premises while fish and oysters were prepared. Both ice machines had pink slime and black dirt dripping into ice for human consumption. All ice was discarded. Also cited: a missing light cover and greasy hood.

headline: Overflowing garbage; greasy equipment; dish machine leak
summary: Passed with conditions. A prior violation remains: two outside garbage receptacles were overflowing, with lids not tight-fitting. Drink dispenser, burger equipment and fryers had food and grease buildup. A dish machine leaked onto the rear prep floor.

headline: Failed: live roaches still active on premises
summary: Failed. Live multigenerational roaches, including adults and nymphs, were still active on the steam table, under a cutting board and on the wok line. Dead roaches were also found. An updated pest control service receipt dated after today is required.

headline: Bowl left in rice; prep area too dim
summary: Passed. A bowl was left inside a rice container in the rear cooler and must be removed; a utensil should be used. Cutting boards were stained and grooved, floors had dirt, and the prep area lacked adequate lighting.

headline: Sanitation managers lack allergen training
summary: Passed. Sanitation managers had no allergen training and must provide proof of it.

headline: Fail: about 60 rat droppings found
summary: Failed. About 60 rat droppings were found in rear storage and the sales floor, and the rear exit door had gaps that could let in pests. Also cited: missing vomit/diarrhea cleanup supplies, a microwave stored in a washroom, and floor-stored beverages. Plus general upkeep issues.

headline: Leaking 3-compartment sink faucet
summary: Passed. The base of the 3-compartment sink faucet was leaking in several spots. The operator was instructed to fix the leak and maintain good plumbing.

headline: Pest devices over food; no sanitizer test kit
summary: Failed. Pest control devices were mounted directly above open food containers in rear storage and must be moved. No test kit was available for the quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in the 3-compartment sink. Grease buildup also cited.

headline: Outside garbage area dirty; dumpsters open
summary: Failed. Dumpsters were open, with food and debris on the ground around a greasy container. A prior violation from an April 2024 report was not corrected. The manager lacks an allergen certificate. Floors under cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: No food handler training; door gap; poor cleaning
summary: Passed. No food handler training was shown for employees; all food handlers must provide it. A 1/4-inch gap at the front entrance door could let pests in. Also cited: no drainboard at the three-compartment sink, and debris on floors.

headline: Dusty wall fan; greasy surfaces above stove
summary: Passed. A kitchen prep-area wall fan had excessive dust. Grease had built up on surfaces above the stove. Both must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Missing handwash signs; wiping cloths on tables
summary: Passed. Both washrooms lacked handwashing signs. Food storage containers were unlabeled, wiping cloths sat on prep tables, and ice scoops were stored on top of the ice bin rather than in a clean container.

headline: Failed: rat droppings; food held too warm
summary: Failed. Rat droppings (about 15–20) lay on floors near dishwashing and cooking equipment. Raw pork sat in a sink with only ice. About 144 lbs ($199) of food was discarded. No certified food manager was on site. Prior violations went uncorrected.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; food stored on floor
summary: Passed. Several food workers had expired food handler certificates. Food boxes sat on the basement freezer floor, soiled wiping cloths were left on prep tables, and the ice machine guard was dirty. Floors had flour and food debris.

headline: Food stored under handsink; no manager allergen training
summary: Passed re-inspection. Crackers, condiments and single-service items were stored under a handsink, and pop was in the employee washroom; these were to be removed. The certified manager on duty had no allergen training.

headline: Mold in basement ice machine; door openings
summary: Failed. Pink, beige and black mold-like substance was in a basement ice machine and must be cleaned to protect ice. Openings at three doors must be sealed. Unlabeled containers and missing allergen training proof were also cited.

headline: No covered trash can in women's employee washroom
summary: Passed re-inspection. The employee women's washroom had no covered receptacle for sanitary products. The operator was instructed to provide one.

headline: Unapproved meat curing; floor drain backs up
summary: Failed. Meat was cured without the required city approval (a variance); about 50 lbs (about $500) was discarded. Curing must stop until granted. A meat-room floor drain backs up and floods. Also cited: broken walk-in thermometer, grooved cutting boards, and black slime on walls.

headline: Failed: prep cooler running at 46.7°F
summary: Failed. A prep cooler measured 46.7°F. Cold-holding units must stay at 41°F or below. No citation was issued.

headline: Door gaps; cluttered storage; dirty equipment
summary: Passed re-inspection. Front and rear exit doors had 1/4-inch gaps and must be made rodent-proof. Heavy equipment and rear prep tables needed cleaning, and clutter in the rear storage room must be removed and raised off the floor.

headline: Moldy bagels and warm dairy; cooler tagged
summary: Passed with conditions. One bag of moldy bagels was discarded. Yogurt, milk-based creamer and whipped cream held at 52.7–55.8°F were discarded. A drive-thru cooler at 50°F was tagged held for inspection. Faucets and drain pipes leaked. Corrected on site.

headline: Failed: warm food and sleeping quarters on site
summary: Failed. Foods held at 51°F were discarded (about $25). A cooler at 63°F was tagged. A bed was found in a room with a food sink. No pest control logbook was under the current operator's name.

headline: Loose restroom sink faucet; inspection passed
summary: Passed. The inspector saw a loose faucet at the women's restroom handsink and instructed the operator to repair it and keep it maintained.

headline: No sanitizer test strips at dish machine
summary: Failed. No chlorine test strips were on site to check dish machine sanitizer. A prior violation was not corrected: the rear restroom door does not self-close and basement restroom walls are rough brick. Debris was behind a cooler.

headline: Unlabeled food, dirty coolers, items on floor
summary: Passed. Several bags of french fries lacked labels. Single-service trays were uncovered on the sales floor, some items sat on the floor, and cooler gaskets were in disrepair. Cooler interiors had soil; unused equipment was left around the store.

headline: Door gap, milk crates as shelves, basement dirt
summary: Passed re-inspection. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of the front exit door could let pests in and must be sealed. Milk crates were used as shelving and must be replaced. Basement storage floors had loose debris and dust.

headline: Broken handsink fixture; restroom trash lid missing
summary: Passed. The kitchen handsink fixture next to the mop sink was in disrepair with missing parts. The women's restroom receptacle had no lid and must be covered.

headline: Failed: cold units off, no sanitizer
summary: Failed. Cold-holding equipment was not running, and no chemical sanitizer was on site. No food thermometer was on site, and the prep handsink lacked hand soap. No licensed pest control service or log was on site.

headline: Insect carcasses in basement; sink leaks
summary: Passed. Several dead insects were found in the basement and must be removed. The 3-compartment sink leaked from its bottom pipes, and its stopper did not seal. A certified food manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; no dish sink
summary: Failed. No valid certified food manager certificate was on site, no written employee health policy, and no vomit/diarrhea cleanup supplies. No metal-stem thermometer was on site, and there was no 3-compartment dish sink. No commercial dumpster contract was on file.

headline: Leaking handsink drain; unfinished shelves
summary: Passed. A drainpipe was leaking under the customer toilet room handsink. Unfinished wood shelves above the front prep counter must be finished, and the ice machine backflow device must be easy to find. Basement clutter must be removed.

headline: Expired food handler certificate for one worker
summary: Passed. One food handling employee had an expired food handler certificate. Management was instructed that all food handlers must show valid proof of training.

headline: Broken equipment lids; greasy floors and vents
summary: Passed. A cold-holding cooler lid in front prep was broken off, and a hot-holding lid was broken; both must be repaired. Grease, food debris and dirt covered floors under equipment and in corners. Dust was on light shields and vents.

headline: Food debris in prep coolers; dirty floors
summary: Passed. Prep coolers had accumulated food debris inside and must be cleaned. The washroom floor and hot water tank room floor had food and dirt buildup.

headline: Unlabeled dry containers; dirty meat slicer
summary: Passed. Bulk dry storage containers lacked common-name labels and must be labeled. The meat slicer's non-food-contact surfaces had excessive food residue and must be cleaned.

headline: Minor ice machine and fryer debris; passed
summary: Passed. Inspector saw minor brownish buildup inside the ice machine near the pipes and minor debris inside the fryers. Both were to be cleaned, and the ice machine sanitized.

headline: Handsinks lacked hot water; no handler training
summary: Failed re-inspection. Handsinks still ran at 91.3–91.8°F, below the required 100°F hot water. Food handler training was missing for employees. Grease, debris and broken glass were also found on floors, equipment and hood filters.

headline: No certified manager; handsinks lacked soap
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was present while fish and chicken were prepared and served. The walk-in cooler measured 69.2°F and a prep cooler was tagged. No vomit/diarrhea cleanup kit was on site. A front handsink was blocked and lacked soap.

headline: No sanitizer test kit; retail labels incomplete
summary: Failed. No chemical test kit for sanitizer was on site. A prior violation was not corrected: no proof of allergen training for certified managers. Retail salad dressings lacked required label details, and a display cooler door was falling off.

headline: Loose handsink faucet; one restroom out of order
summary: Passed. A handsink faucet in the second-floor prep kitchen was loose. One of four first-floor toilet rooms was out of order, and management said it is being repaired.

headline: Heavy dust on vents; floors need regrouting
summary: Passed re-inspection. Heavy dust covered ceiling vents throughout the premises, including washrooms, and must be cleaned. Floor grout in the front and rear food prep and dishwashing areas must be redone.

headline: Beverages on cooler floor; clutter in storage
summary: Passed. Beverages in the walk-in cooler must be raised at least 6 inches off the floor. Food residue in rear-storage reach-in freezers must be cleaned. Clutter and unneeded items throughout rear storage must be removed.

headline: Failed: rat droppings and live flies found
summary: Failed. About 10 rat droppings were on the floor by the ice machine and furnace, and 10–12 live small flies were near the dish machine. Droppings must be cleaned up. Pest control service was recommended. No food handler training was shown.

headline: Missing cooler thermometers; water pooling in basement
summary: Passed re-inspection. Several sales-floor coolers holding fish, meats, frozen meals and produce lacked thermometers. Basement plumbing was in disrepair with water pooling on the floor. Toilet rooms lacked covered trash cans, and some storage bulbs were burned out.

headline: No signed employee health policies
summary: Passed with conditions. No signed employee health policies were provided. Two handsink faucets must be adjusted to stay on longer for handwashing. A rear door had a gap. Debris and spills were in the walk-in cooler and under cooking equipment.

headline: Gloves not changed; slimy soda dispenser
summary: Passed with conditions. An employee did not change gloves before handling clean dishes; this was cited. A slimy grey substance was inside the bar soda dispenser. Plates on shelves were not inverted.

headline: Unlabeled sauce bottles; wet cloths on prep tables
summary: Passed. Sauce and oil bottles on the main prep line lacked labels. A wet wiping cloth was left on prep tables. Grease had spilled on an outside oil tank, and floors under cooking equipment need cleaning.

headline: No hot water at employee handsink
summary: Failed. The unisex employee washroom handsink had no hot water; it measured 78.9°F and must reach at least 100°F. A working thermometer was also needed in the 2-door front prep cooler. Vents had heavy dust.

headline: No food handler training for any employee
summary: Passed. No food handler training was shown for any employee; training must be provided and kept. Also cited: a hole in the basement wall, debris on floors and shelving, rust in the walk-in cooler, and a dish machine needing descaling.

headline: No certified manager; no handler training proof
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site during TCS food prep. No food handler training proof was given for any food worker, and a previous violation was not corrected. No pest control logbook was available.

headline: No hair restraints; no milk cooler thermometer
summary: Passed. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints during food prep and service. The front two-door milk cooler lacked a working thermometer. Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables, and dishwashing room walls and paint need attention.

headline: Failed: over 20 rat droppings found
summary: Failed. Over 20 rat droppings were found in sales, prep and storage areas. The manager was told to call an exterminator and clean all affected areas. Also cited: a leak under a utility sink and a handsink in the washroom.

headline: No hot water at sinks; handsoap missing
summary: Passed with conditions. No hot water was available at prep handsinks or the 3-compartment sink; it was restored during inspection but must be maintained. A prep handsink lacked soap, which staff obtained on site. Short ribs at 48.2°F were discarded.

headline: No sanitizer in dish machines; no certificate posted
summary: Passed with conditions. No chlorine sanitizer was detected at final rinse of both low-temperature dish machines; they must be repaired to 100 ppm chlorine. No certified manager certificate was posted, and prep tables and floors need cleaning.

headline: Wiping cloths left on prep tables; rusty tables
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were stored on top of prep tables in the front food prep area and must be kept in sanitizing solution when not in use. Prep tables had rust on their bottom surfaces and must be repainted or replaced.

headline: Damaged cooler gasket; leaking dump sink drain
summary: Passed re-inspection. A cold-holding unit under the espresso machine had a damaged door gasket. A dump sink drain pipe near the deli station was leaking. Both must be repaired.

headline: Greasy fryers and dusty vents; allergen training needed
summary: Passed. Inspector instructed cleaning of fryer bottoms, refrigeration interiors, prep tables, and floors under cooking equipment and in the basement. Vents above cooking equipment need cleaning. City food managers must obtain allergen training.

headline: Failed: no certified manager on site
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was on site while TCS (time/temperature-controlled) foods were handled. The person in charge had no valid training proof. The pest control logbook had no recent service records; the last was 11/29/2024.

headline: Warm cold food; cooler tagged; missing handwash signs
summary: Passed with conditions. Cold TCS foods held at 51.9–54.7°F were discarded (about $250). The prep cooler at 51.2°F was tagged held for inspection and must not be used until reinspected. Handwashing signs were missing.

headline: Expired allergen training certificate
summary: Passed. One food manager's allergen training certificate had expired, and current training must be provided for all certified food managers. Minor food splatter was inside the microwave.

headline: Food debris under coolers and in prep area
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food debris and dust were under refrigerators and freezers in rear storage. Food debris was also on floors, wall bases and corners of the Starbucks prep area, and both must be cleaned.

headline: No food handler training proof; menu fixed on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No proof of food handler training was given for any food handler. Undercooked-egg items lacked a menu asterisk and disclosure; both were added on site. Some allergen training certificates had expired.

headline: Old violations unfixed; labels and hair restraints missing
summary: Failed re-inspection. Violations from a June 2024 report were not corrected, including a hand dryer over the three-compartment sink and rust and cardboard in the walk-in cooler. Food containers lacked labels and a food handler had no hair restraint.

headline: Torn gasket, pink ice machine residue, missing bulb
summary: Passed. The low-temperature dish machine in the bar had a torn gasket and must be repaired. Slight pink residue was inside the rear prep ice machine and must be cleaned. One hood light bulb was missing.

headline: Rust on cooler shelves; broken wall tiles
summary: Passed re-inspection. Rust had built up on shelving inside the walk-in cooler and must be removed. Broken tiles along the cooler wall must be repaired to prevent pest hiding places.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; dead insects found
summary: Passed with conditions. Cold foods held at 44–61°F were discarded (about 51 lbs, $237). Ice machine interior was not clean. Dead insects were under rear storage shelves and along baseboards.

headline: Wet wiping cloths; stained cutting boards
summary: Passed. Wet wiping cloths were left on several prep surfaces and must be kept in sanitizing solution between uses. All rear-prep cutting boards had open seams and dark stains. Cooking equipment and hood vents also needed cleaning.

headline: Food in grocery bags; soiled cloths and grease
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food was stored in plastic grocery bags in coolers and must be moved to food-grade containers. Soiled wiping cloths were on prep tables. Grease and food debris built up on equipment; soiled mop heads must be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Ice buildup in freezer; slow-draining sushi handsink
summary: Passed. Items under food storage shelving were not raised off the floor and must be elevated. A vegetable chest freezer had excessive ice to remove, and the sushi-area handsink drained slowly. Debris was behind the rear ice machine.

headline: Some workers lacked hair and beard protection
summary: Passed. Some employees had no hair restraints or beard guards. Inspector instructed that they wear hair protection and beard guards at all times.

headline: No food handler training proof; signage fallen
summary: Passed. No proof of food handler training or certificates was shown for required employees; it must be provided. A handwashing sign had fallen from the wall at the rear handsink and must be replaced.

headline: Door openings; expired allergen certificates
summary: Passed re-inspection. Openings at the base of the front and rear exit doors must be sealed to keep pests out. Allergen training certificates for employees were expired. Stained ceiling tiles throughout the facility must be replaced.

headline: Failed: no handwash signs; no hair restraints
summary: Failed. Handwashing signs were missing at the dish and prep area handsinks. Two or three employees in food prep had no hair restraints. The high-temperature dish machine lacked a proper irreversible temperature indicator.

headline: Failed: 40 mouse droppings, no certified manager
summary: Failed. About 40 mouse droppings behind bar and near ATM; citation issued; pest control recommended. No certified manager on site while chicken and beef were prepared; citation issued. Food handlers lack certificates; no allergen training.

headline: Passed; food on cooler floor, foil shelf liner
summary: Passed. Containers stored on walk-in cooler floor; must be elevated six inches. Aluminum foil shelf liner must be removed. Allergen training certificate missing for one employee who holds a city sanitation certificate; proof required.

headline: Conditional pass: kittens found in storage room
summary: Passed with conditions. Three small kittens found in rear storage room; animals are not permitted inside the business. Citation issued. Also a gap under washroom door, spills in display cooler, and ice machine buildup.

headline: Passed; dead insects and grime in bakery
summary: Passed. Bakery storage containers lacked common-name labels. Flour, dust, grease, and dead insects built up on cooking equipment, racks, and shelving. Exposed foam-like caulk in restroom needs a smooth, cleanable surface.

headline: Conditional pass: hot food below 135°F
