summary: Passed with conditions. Cooked chicken at 90.6°F and cooked pork at 95.3-112.3°F held in hot-holding unit; about 20 lbs discarded; citation issued. Hot food must stay at 135°F or above. Heavy grease, dirt, and debris on walls and floors.

headline: Passed; leaking handsink, dusty floors
summary: Passed. Handsink faucet in rear prep area leaks and needs repair. Loose debris, dirt, and dust on floors and in corners throughout the facility. Floors must be detail cleaned more often.

headline: Passed; items stored on walk-in cooler floor
summary: Passed. Items stored on floor of walk-in cooler. Staff must organize items six inches from the floor at all times.

headline: Passed; slow sink drain, overflowing indoor trash
summary: Passed. Front prep handwashing sink drains slowly and needs repair. Several indoor waste containers full of food waste sat uncovered in rear storage; staff told to empty them or move refuse outdoors when full.

headline: Passed; food on floor, plastic bags, damaged freezer
summary: Passed. Food buckets on walk-in cooler floor must be elevated. Plastic grocery bags used for food in walk-in freezer; food-grade bags required. Damaged fruit freezer door, worn cooler gasket, loose wall panels, grease, and dirt.

headline: Re-inspection passed; debris on equipment and floors
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Debris on interior and exterior of holding units, prep tables, shelving, and cabinets. Debris on floors under equipment, along walls, and in corners of prep and storage areas. Manager told to clean.

headline: Passed re-inspection; torn cooler gasket
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Torn gasket on interior of two-door cooler in rear prep area. Must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Passed re-inspection; espresso machine on floor
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Espresso machine stored on rear dry storage floor; elevate six inches. Hole in upper rear storage wall and damaged baseboard in front prep area must be smoothly repaired.

headline: Passed; no hot water at washroom sinks
summary: Passed. Women's washroom sink has no hot water; men's washroom sink is inoperable. Debris on floors along walls and corners in second-floor storage area. Manager instructed to repair and clean.

headline: Conditional pass: no certified manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No person in charge with a valid city sanitation certificate, and no certified manager present while food was served. A female employee lacked food handler training. No allergen training. Leaking faucet and damaged walls.

headline: Failed: live cockroaches, no paper towels, no allergen proof
summary: Failed. Four live cockroaches found behind prep coolers in main kitchen, with many dead ones on glue boards; pest control recommended; priority violation. Prep sinks lack paper towels. Grab-and-go sandwiches unlabeled. No manager allergen certificate.

headline: Passed; expired allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Person in charge's allergen training certificate has expired. Updated copy must be provided.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk containers, upright pots
summary: Passed. Bulk containers under kitchen prep tables lack labels; provide common names such as salt, sugar, or flour. Multi-use pots and pans on storage racks should be stored inverted to prevent contamination.

headline: Failed: dripping black, pink, brown ice machine buildup
summary: Failed. Rear ice machine bin has black, pink, and brown buildup dripping onto ice used for human consumption; citation issued. Also unlabeled bulk items, wiping cloths on surfaces, stained cutting boards, and a leaking pipe near clean bins.

headline: Conditional pass: no sanitizer in sink, dish machine at 0 ppm
summary: Passed with conditions. Utensils washed in three-compartment sink with no sanitizer; manager told to maintain 200 ppm. Bar dish machine final rinse at 0 ppm; citation issued. Unlabeled bulk containers, food on freezer floor, leaking faucets.

headline: Passed; cluttered lower-level storage floor
summary: Passed. Lower-level storage room floor is cluttered. Manager must elevate items off the floor or remove them.

headline: Passed re-inspection; dead roaches, milk crates
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Some dead roach activity on main prep area floors; remove, clean, and sanitize. Milk crates used as shelving; replace with shelving six inches off floor. Food in coolers and dry storage lacks proper labels.

headline: Passed; leaking faucet, damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. Basement three-compartment sink faucet base leaks. Broken light shields with dust above prep and dish areas, damaged and missing ceiling tiles, and peeling paint behind ice and syrup machines. Outside bar sink lacks handwashing sign.

headline: Failed: blocked handsinks, sanitizer and advisory issues
summary: Failed suspected food poisoning inspection. Handsinks blocked or used as dump sinks in bars and cook line; citation issued. Two chemical dish machines not sanitizing; corrected on site. Menu omitted raw advisory for steak tartare and oysters.

headline: Passed; food additives approved and properly used
summary: Passed. Food additives were approved and properly used. No other violations noted.

headline: Conditional pass: rodent droppings, no manager on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No city-certified manager on site while beef and rice were prepared; citation issued. About 20 rodent droppings in hallway and prep area, cleaned on site; citation issued. Raw beef at 48.9-51°F discarded.

headline: Passed re-inspection; expired food handler certificates
summary: Passed on re-inspection. All food handler certificates expired; current certificates required. No proof of allergen training for certified food manager. Cracked basement freezer lid exposes insulation; loose baseboard under bar handsink.

headline: Passed; food on floor, ice buildup, greasy stove
summary: Passed. Food stored on floor of walk-in cooler and walk-in freezer; elevate six inches. Wiping cloths on prep table. Ice buildup on walk-in freezer ceiling. Grease on stove exterior and floor under fryer.

headline: Passed; missing handwashing signs
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs missing at handsinks throughout front and rear prep areas; must be provided. Small condiment cups stored under prep table should be inverted to prevent possible contamination.

headline: Failed re-inspection: warm food, repeat violations
summary: Failed re-inspection. Tofu, raw fish, spring rolls, and seasoned chicken held at 50-58°F; discarded; citation issued. Two coolers at 49-50°F must stop use. Rear exit door not rodent-proof. Several earlier violations remain uncorrected.

headline: Passed; dirty dry storage walls, floors, ceilings
summary: Passed. Rear dry storage floors and walls need deep cleaning, including dried brownish food residue behind a shelf. Dust on ceiling tiles above the food prep table in the rear dishwashing area. Staff told to clean and maintain.

headline: Failed: no manager certificate, overflowing dumpster
summary: Failed. No valid city food manager certificate posted on site. Steak on menu lacked the undercooked-food advisory; footnote and reminder required. Outside garbage receptacle overflowing; citation issued.

headline: Failed: milk crates, cardboard, repeat violations
summary: Failed. Milk crates used for elevation and cardboard lining shelves in rear kitchen; food must be stored six inches from wall. Excess ice in rear ice cream freezer. Repeat violations: wet wiping cloths, splatter, dusty vents, no allergen proof; citation issued.

headline: Passed; three-compartment sink missing cold handle
summary: Passed. Cold water handle missing on three-compartment sink; manager must provide a working handle.

headline: Failed: no hot water at sinks, cold food too warm
summary: Failed. Hot water manually shut off at all handsinks; soap and paper towels missing at prep sinks; citations issued. Orange slime inside ice machine dripping onto ice. Eggs at 55-60.3°F and chicken at 47.4°F discarded. Sanitizer over 200 ppm; dish machine tagged.

headline: Passed; bar floors unclean under equipment
summary: Passed. Bar floors are unclean under and behind equipment. Clean corners and along walls to monitor and deter pests.

headline: Conditional pass: undated deli meats, insect device
summary: Passed with conditions. Deli meats in display cooler were not date-marked; dated during inspection; citation issued. No ambient air thermometer in hot-holding unit. Electric insect control device stored above food prep. Animal blood on meat walk-in floors.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings, raw meat over sauce
summary: Failed. Raw beef patties stored above open gyros sauce in walk-in cooler; sauce discarded; citation issued. Cooked peppers at 130.1°F and chicken at 113.5-126.6°F held too cool; discarded. About 15-20 mouse droppings; citation issued.

headline: Conditional pass: no vomit cleanup supplies on site
summary: Passed with conditions. Norovirus-effective disinfectant and other vomit and diarrhea cleanup items were not on site; priority violation. Openings at revolving door base need sealing. Unsealed wood above utility sink; no mop drying rack.

headline: Conditional pass: no vomit and diarrhea procedure
summary: Passed with conditions. No written procedure or adequate supplies on site for vomit and diarrhea events; priority violation. Staff instructed to provide them.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings, missing soap and towels
summary: Failed. About 15-30 mouse droppings on floor behind water heater; contact pest control. Prep handsink had no soap; corrected on site. No paper towels at prep sink; citation issued. Soiled wiping cloths, grease, and heavy dirt in kitchen.

headline: Passed; front door not rodent-proof, missing thermometers
summary: Passed. Front door not rodent-proof; must be fixed. No backflow device on rear mop sink. Cooling units in grocery area lack thermometers. Excess clutter in employee storage and hot water tank room; elevate items six inches.

headline: Passed; cooling food covered, missing thermometer
summary: Passed. Chicken pot pie filling was tightly covered with plastic wrap while cooling; staff told to leave TCS foods loosely covered or uncovered when protected. No thermometer at upright hot-holding unit. Drink station drain wrapped in duct tape.

headline: Passed; personal items in food areas, grease buildup
summary: Passed. No handwashing signs near rear dish sink. Wiping cloths stored on prep tables. Items on floor in front prep and rear dishwashing areas. Grease on cooking equipment, walls, and floors. Employees storing personal belongings in food areas.

headline: Passed; unlabeled bulk, unsealed front doors, clutter
summary: Passed. Cooling units need thermometers. Bulk flour, cornmeal, and seasonings need labels. Front doors not rodent-proof; gap must be enclosed. Equipment and items stored improperly. Burned-out bulbs in rear and restroom; food handler training required.

headline: Passed; dirty ice machine, sink backs up
summary: Passed. Ice machine interior dirty; ice not for human consumption. Food spills, dirt, and ice buildup on walk-in freezer floors in meat department. Three-compartment sink backs up into other compartments when drained; plumber recommended.

headline: Passed; restroom lacks covered trash receptacle
summary: Passed. Unisex restroom has no covered garbage receptacle. Must be provided.

headline: Passed; greasy fryer, dirty floors
summary: Passed. Grease on sides of fryer and food holding cabinet in rear area. Floors in front bar and along rear prep wall need cleaning; clean around all drains.

headline: Conditional pass: no vomit cleanup supplies, clutter
summary: Passed with conditions. No cleanup supplies on premises for vomit or diarrhea events; priority violation. Restroom lacks covered waste receptacle and self-closing door. Broken baseboard and wall openings; clutter outside washroom must be cleared.

headline: Passed; floors and drains need cleaning
summary: Passed. Floors need cleaning along wall bases and in corners to remove debris. Floor drains also need cleaning.

headline: Passed re-inspection; dried residue, broken wall base
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Dried food residue on prep table shelving where seasonings and sauces are stored; must be cleaned to prevent pest harborage. Broken wall base in rear storage and dishwashing area; reattach or repair.

headline: Passed complaint inspection with minor upkeep items
summary: Passed. Bulk sugar lacked a common-name label. Plates not inverted in storage. Damaged cooler handles, debris in cooler door track, uncovered outlet, open restroom ceiling vent, and greasy hood filters. Staff told to correct all.

headline: Failed: no manager certificate, no sanitizer test strips
summary: Failed. No original city food manager certificate on site while food was served; citation issued. No test strips for quaternary ammonium (QAC) sanitizer; citation issued. A food handler's certificate has expired.

headline: Failed: prep cooler too warm, sink backs up
summary: Failed. Prep cooler at 46.7°F; must hold at 41°F or below. No screen on service window. Three-compartment sink backs up when rinse basin drains; repair required. Grease on floors and walls under cooking equipment.

headline: Failed: warm cold foods, insect device over food
summary: Failed. Tomatoes, cheese, and lettuce held at 54-55°F in prep cooler; about 7 lbs discarded; citation issued. Prep cooler at 61.1°F. Insect control device stored above food prep. Entry doors need rodent-proofing. Basement clutter repeat violation.

headline: Passed; front and rear doors left wide open
summary: Passed. Both front and rear doors were wide open during inspection. Staff told to keep outer doors closed to prevent pest entry.

headline: Failed: warm food, over 20 flies, sink floods
summary: Failed. Several TCS foods held at 45-55°F; peas, cheese, and chicken discarded; citation issued. More than 20 flies found in kitchens, storage, and dish areas; pest service recommended. Three-compartment sink floods when drained; citation issued.

headline: Failed: menu warning missing, pest gap, sanitation problems
summary: Failed. Menu lacked the raw or undercooked food warning. Rear door near basement stairs has a 1/4-inch gap. Salsa stored on floor. Bowls used as dispensers. Grease trap overflowing; citation issued.

headline: Conditional pass: warm milk, dish machine too cool
summary: Passed with conditions. Milk held at 44-50°F; manager discarded four gallons and a citation was issued. Dish machine wash solution reached only 96°F; 120°F required, and the machine was tagged. Common-area food cooler has no lock.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, utensils not hot enough
summary: Failed. No city-certified manager on duty while hamburgers and soups were prepared and served; citation issued. Utensil sanitizing reached only 150°F instead of 160°F; dish machine sanitizing gauge reads zero; citation issued. Dirty wiping cloths.

headline: Re-inspection passed; mop sink lacks backflow device
summary: Passed on re-inspection. No backflow prevention device at the mop sink. Staff must provide one and make it visible.

headline: Passed re-inspection; no backflow device at ice machine
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Soap dispenser at front cooking handsink not attached to wall. Ice machine stored next to mop sink; needs a splash guard, and no chemicals may be stored on or above it. No backflow device on its water line; proof required.

headline: Passed; rusty shelving, crates, greasy hood
summary: Passed. Rust building up on walk-in cooler metal shelving. Dust, dirt, spills, and food debris on food service floors. Crates used for storage in walk-in coolers; provide proper shelving. Heavy grease buildup from hood and filters.

headline: Passed; dirty ice machine, cluttered storage
summary: Passed. Ice machine not clean; staff told to remove ice and clean top interior. About 1/4-inch gap at rear door to dumpster; seal required. Clutter in hallway, kitchen, and basement; items must be on shelving six inches off the floor.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, no cleanup supplies
summary: Failed. No city-certified manager on duty while eggs and sausage were prepared and served; citation issued. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies. No metal-stem thermometer, no sanitizer test kit, and leaking sink.

headline: Conditional pass: no certified manager during food prep
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager present while smoothies and chicken wings were prepared and served; citation issued. Washroom door self-closing device needs adjusting.

headline: Passed; dirty sink, cooler shelves, pizza oven
summary: Passed. Three-compartment sink, shelves inside walk-in cooler, and exterior of pizza oven were found not clean; must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; chicken thawing in sink, dusty vents
summary: Passed. Frozen chicken was thawing in the rear three-compartment sink; manager told to thaw under cool running water or inside a cooler. Grocery bags used for food storage in freezer. Dusty vents, shelving, and walls; grease in hood.

headline: Passed; leaking faucet, debris under equipment
summary: Passed. Three-compartment sink faucet leaks; manager must service it. Debris and soil on floors around and under equipment in bar and storage areas. Manager told to clean.

headline: Passed re-inspection; front door opening needs sealing
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Opening at the base of the single front entrance door on the Michigan Avenue side. Staff instructed to seal all outer openings to prevent pest entry.

headline: Passed; fly trap, rust, grime, missing signs
summary: Passed. No handwashing signs at rear sink. A fly trap hung in the rear prep area; staff told to remove it and let the licensed pest control operator install any devices. Rust on can opener and prep table. Dirt and food on floors, walls, and cabinets.

headline: Passed; cardboard covers, rust, missing wall tiles
summary: Passed. Cardboard covers tables and equipment. Rust on walk-in and storage shelving and prep table bottoms. Missing wall tiles under sink and near walk-in cooler. Light out in front production kitchen ceiling.

headline: Failed: overflowing garbage, broken gasket, grime
summary: Failed. Outside receptacles had lids open and garbage overflowing; priority citation issued. Bulk bins unlabeled, milk crates used for elevation, broken walk-in gasket, rusty can opener, unlidded trash can, and greasy walls.

headline: Passed; no food handler certificate on site
summary: Passed. No food handler certificate on site; all food handler employees must have training and a certificate on site. Items stacked on rear floor must be kept six inches off the floor.

headline: Passed; sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. Food service sanitation manager lacked a food allergen training certificate. Staff instructed to meet the requirement.

headline: Passed; missing sign, damaged gaskets, rust
summary: Passed. No handwashing sign at rear sink. Deli cooler gaskets damaged. Three-compartment sink lacks wash, rinse, and sanitize labels. Rust on walk-in shelving. Restroom doors lack self-closing devices. Water-damaged ceiling tile and wall hole in dry storage.

headline: Passed; tongs in lemons, mop drying improperly
summary: Passed. Mini tongs stored inside a container with cut lemons; staff told to store utensils properly. Women's washroom stall lacks covered trash can. Mop stored in a position that prevents drying.

headline: Passed re-inspection; restroom door, boxes, burnt residue
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Food-prep-area restroom door is not self-closing. Boxes in rear storage and office; remove to eliminate pest harborage points. Burnt residue on floors behind cooking equipment under hood.

headline: Conditional pass: hot and cold food too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. Deli hot-hold items at 108-121°F; about 20 lbs discarded; citation issued. Ceviche at 45.5°F; about 5 lbs discarded. Smoking cigars in office violates the Clean Indoor Air Ordinance; citation issued. Also missing handsink signage and dust.

headline: Passed; cracks near back exit door
summary: Passed. Cracks under 1/4 inch along walls in back area around back exit door. Must be sealed to prevent pest entry.

headline: Passed; no covered trash, door, or allergen certificate
summary: Passed. Washroom has no covered trash receptacle and its door is not self-closing. No allergen training certificate on premises for city-certified managers.

headline: Conditional pass: repeat black slime in ice machine
summary: Passed with conditions. Repeat violation: black slime on ice bin interior dripping onto ice used for human consumption; citation issued. Ice machine was serviced on the 5-20-2025 return visit. Also: no beard restraints, improperly stored knives, expired allergen certificates.

headline: Passed; no vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies
summary: Passed with no citation. Bodily fluid cleanup kit lacked proper vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies; priority violation. Staff told to have the written procedure and required equipment on site.

headline: Conditional pass: dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Passed with conditions. High-temperature dish machine in prep area reached only 148°F in final rinse; must be repaired to sanitize. Machine tagged and held; citation issued. Dried food debris and dirty floor drains.

headline: Passed; items on floor, stained cutting boards
summary: Passed. Items stored on floor next to cold-hold unit; elevate six inches. Cutting boards with open seams and dark stains must be refinished or replaced. Grease, debris, and dirt under equipment; dust on fans, light shields, and vents.

headline: Failed: black mold in ice machines, zero sanitizer
summary: Failed. Heavy black mold inside both basement ice machines; citation issued. Rooftop dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine sanitizer; tagged and held. Loose bar handsink, standing water from leaking air conditioner, and no allergen training certificates.

headline: Conditional pass: repeat allergen training violation
summary: Passed with conditions. Repeat violation: no certified food manager with allergen training. Documentation of training must be provided. Citation issued.

headline: Passed; unlabeled containers, missing allergen training
summary: Passed. Dry storage containers lack common-name labels. Bearded employee needs a restraint. Aluminum foil lines stove in main prep area. Allergen training missing for all city-certified managers; verification required on site.

headline: Failed: no certified manager, sink lacks hot water
summary: Failed. No city-certified manager on duty while baked goods were prepared and served; citation issued. One rear handsink lacks hot running water; citation issued. Food handler without training. Debris on walk-in freezer floor.

headline: Passed re-inspection; leaking drain, no washroom vent
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Two-compartment sink drain pipe leaks, and its floor drain has red-brown buildup. Washroom lacks mechanical ventilation. No proof of allergen training for city-certified food managers.

headline: Conditional pass: chicken held at 95.5°F
summary: Passed with conditions. Chicken breast at 95.5°F in hot-holding unit; manager discarded 8 lbs; citation issued. Hot food must be 135°F or above. Clutter on storage closet floor; grease, debris, and dirt on prep area floors.

headline: Passed re-inspection; unlabeled flour and sugar
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Bulk flour and sugar containers unlabeled. Leaks at prep handsink and three-compartment sink faucets. Mop not drying properly. Dirt buildup on restroom exhaust vent.

headline: Conditional pass: no training records, door gap, dirt
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy and no food handler training for employees. 1/4-inch gap at front door. Food stored on freezer floor, soiled wiping cloths, no drainboard, dust and dirt on surfaces.

headline: Passed; dust, debris, and grease buildup
summary: Passed. Dust and dirt under soda dispenser. Food debris on walk-in cooler shelving. Light grease and food debris on cooking equipment and shelving beneath it. Floors dirty near window and under coffee station. Vents heavy with grease and dust.

headline: Passed; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. Certified food manager on site had no food allergen training; manager instructed to comply. Food additives were approved and properly used.

headline: Conditional pass: no hand drying, kabobs on floor
summary: Passed with conditions. Handwashing sink in rear prep and dishwashing area had no hand drying supplies; priority citation issued. Kabob container stored on walk-in cooler floor. Build-up under tabletop cooking equipment.

headline: Passed re-inspection; raw wood, crates on shelving
summary: Passed on re-inspection. No handwashing sign at washroom sink. Raw wood surfaces behind front counter must be sealed. Crates used as shelving in rear storage; adequate shelving required.

headline: Conditional pass: no manager on site, cold food warm
summary: Passed with conditions. No city-certified manager on site while TCS foods were prepared; citation issued. Shrimp at 51.2°F and broken eggs at 63.8°F; 30 lbs discarded. Food on walk-in freezer floor. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Passed; missing hood bulb, no manager allergen proof
summary: Passed. Light bulb missing from ventilation hood in front and rear prep areas; must be installed. Certified food manager lacks allergen training certificate; must be provided.

headline: Failed: about 60 rodent droppings found
summary: Failed. About 60 rodent droppings: 20 behind walk-in cooler, 20 beside rear reach-in cooler, 10 under three-compartment sink, 10 on lower front shelf. Citation issued; pest control advised. Hair restraints missing; expired allergen certificate.

headline: Conditional pass: cold food too warm, beef unmarked
summary: Passed with conditions. Chicken (44.2-48.9°F) and steak (46.2-46.9°F) in two-door cooler held above 41°F; manager voluntarily discarded 85 lbs. Beef stored over 24 hours without a disposition date. Unlabeled salt and pepper containers.

headline: Milk crates used to elevate storage
summary: Pass. Milk crates used to elevate equipment and bulk containers in rear dry storage. Replace with racks or legs giving at least 6 inches of clearance from the floor.

headline: Leaking sink faucet; dirty restroom and hood
summary: Pass. Three-compartment sink faucet base leaking; repair required. Restroom fixtures and floor are dirty. Filter and hood above cooking equipment must be cleaned of grease and debris.

headline: Stained cutting board on prep cooler
summary: Pass. Stained cutting board attached to prep cooler; must remove stains or replace the board.

headline: Personal phone left on cutting board
summary: Pass. A personal phone was found on a cutting board at the prep line. Personal items must be stored away from food, and equipment must be cleaned.

headline: No employee health policy on premises
summary: Pass with conditions. No employee health policy on premises; must be provided and kept. Person in charge must document employees' duty to report food-transmissible illness. Certified food managers must obtain allergen training. Priority citation issued.

headline: Failed: over 80 rat droppings in kitchen
summary: Fail. Over 80 rat droppings in kitchen along walls, under shelves and equipment; priority citation issued. Pest control required before reinspection. Middle exit door has 1/4 to 1/2-inch gaps. Missing hair restraints and trash lids.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings in dining and food areas
summary: Fail. About 20 or more mouse droppings found by dining booths, hot water tank closet, food elevator and food prep area. Priority citation issued; pest control recommended. Openings in wall and staircase must be sealed.

headline: Raw-food reminder added on site
summary: Pass with conditions. Menu lacked raw or undercooked food reminder; added before inspection ended. Opening at front door base; uncovered utensils; boxes on floor in chemical room; damaged floor tiles; one employee lacks allergen training.

headline: Deep-cut cutting boards; training proof missing
summary: Pass. Cutting boards in all kitchen prep areas have deep cuts; restore or replace. No proof of food handler or allergen training for managers or handlers; documentation must be kept on site.

headline: Failed: no thermometer; repeat core violation
summary: Fail. No metal stem thermometer available during inspection; must be kept on site. Prep-area hand sink drains very slowly. Repeat core violation: certified food manager lacks allergen training certificate. Priority citation issued.

headline: Missing ceiling tiles; food debris in cooler track
summary: Pass. Food debris in deli cooler door track must be cleaned. No covered receptacle in unisex restroom. Missing and water-damaged ceiling tiles near walk-in cooler; peeling paint in rear prep area. One food handler lacks training certificate.

headline: Dirty ice bin; unlabeled salt and sugar
summary: Pass. Interior of ice bin and guard dirty; detail clean. Salt and sugar in unlabeled containers. Boxed food on floor near walk-in cooler. Cutting boards scratched; certified manager lacks allergen awareness training.

headline: Failed: no thermometer, pest logbook, dumpster contract
summary: Fail. No metal stem thermometer to check food temperatures. Pest control receipt lacked required license number; logbook incomplete. No commercial dumpster contract. Broken, stained ceiling tiles; clutter on floors; missing light shields; restroom door not self-closing.

headline: No health policy; no vomit clean-up kit
summary: Pass. No employee health policy on site; signed acknowledgments required. No vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit or written procedure. Foil and cardboard used as cooking liners; milk crates used as shelving; torn freezer gaskets; no allergen proof.

headline: One certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: Pass. One certified food manager has no allergen training. Instructed to provide allergen training for all certified food managers.

headline: No covered receptacle; no food handler proof
summary: Pass. No covered receptacle in women's restroom; instructed to provide one. No proof of food handler training for food handlers; instructed to meet requirement.

headline: Cutting boards to be replaced; areas need cleaning
summary: Pass. Both sushi-area cutting boards are stained with deep grooves; replace. Detail cleaning needed for produce cooler floor, reach-in cooler, cooking equipment, produce area walls, and hood filters and fan covers.

headline: Failed: live roaches above hand sink
summary: Fail. Four live cockroaches on wall above exposed hand sink in rear prep area. Person in charge told to remove roaches and clean; more pest control recommended. Slow-draining sinks, damaged ceiling panels and food debris on floors. Citation issued.

headline: No handwashing signs; dirty wall above sink
summary: Pass. No handwashing signage at handsinks; must be posted. Wall behind and above three-compartment sink is not clean and in poor repair; must clean or replace.

headline: No certified manager during prep; cold food unsafe
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager on site while pork and chicken were prepped. Ribs at 47.8°F and chicken at 49.7°F discarded. Coolers at 53–57°F; prep cooler tagged. Thermometer, handwashing signs and food handler certificates missing.

headline: Failed: no hand soap, moldy ice machine, warm pork
summary: Fail. No soap at the only prep-area handwashing sink; dish detergent used instead. Pink and black mold-like substance inside ice machine. Pork at 58.0°F; about 20 lbs discarded. No probe thermometer; food handler and allergen certificates missing.

headline: Failed: torn cooler gaskets; overflowing dumpster
summary: Fail. Torn rubber door gaskets on prep-area two-door and three-door coolers must be repaired or replaced. Outside dumpster overflowing; lid cannot close. Must be maintained with lid tight by reinspection. Priority citation issued.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings and live worms found
summary: Fail. About 30 mouse droppings in rear storage room corners. About 20 live worms under drink station in drive-thru prep area. Priority violation; citation issued. Dirty drink-dispenser tubing and floor grime also noted.

headline: Staff eating in kitchen; coolers lack thermometers
summary: Pass. Employees seen eating in kitchen; told to eat outside food areas. Several prep coolers missing thermometers. Garbage bags used for food storage; use food-grade bags. Manager lacks current allergen training certificate.

headline: Cold food unsafe in sushi and salad coolers
summary: Pass with conditions. Raw fish, tuna, cooked chicken, eggs and other foods held at 47.9–69.2°F in sushi and salad coolers. About 46 lbs (about $800) discarded. Coolers at 55.5–64.5°F; one reach-in cooler tagged.

headline: No certified manager during chicken prep
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager with original certificate on site while chicken was prepared and served. Handwashing signs missing at sinks. Outdoor garbage lid has a hole; replace. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Drains and floors need detail cleaning
summary: Pass. Floor drains in dish, bakery and coffee areas need detail cleaning to prevent insect activity. Worn gasket on sushi-area cooler. Floors under equipment need cleaning. Hood filters have dust buildup.

headline: Dead insects behind grease trap; faucet not working
summary: Pass. Two dead insects found behind the kitchen grease trap; manager told to clean. Front prep sink faucet would not turn on; repair ordered. Debris on floors around equipment; manager told to clean.

headline: Improper scoop use; foil on fryer liner
summary: Pass. Bowls used as scoops in bulk containers; in-use scoops left with handle in food in bean and salsa containers. Aluminum foil lines fryer surfaces. Leaking front handwashing sink drain. Instructed to correct each.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; leaking drains
summary: Pass. Handwashing signage missing at several sinks; post at all. Flatware stored uncovered in dish room. Spillage on ice bin exterior. Leaking drain pipes at kitchen and coffee-area sinks. No backflow device found on espresso machine.

headline: Failed: raw-food disclosure and expired certificates
summary: Fail. Menu does not identify raw or undercooked items such as burgers and beef tenderloin; must disclose on printed and virtual menus. Expired food handler certificates. Rust, grease, leaks and cleaning items noted. No allergen proof for certified managers.

headline: Small gap at front door; light needs shield
summary: Pass. Small gap at the front facility door; must be repaired. Overhead light in front lobby lacks a shield or covering; must be provided.

headline: Litter behind cold units; new staff untrained
summary: Pass. Litter and debris behind cold-holding equipment; instructed to clean. No food handler training on site for new employees; they must obtain training and keep a certificate on site.

headline: Failed: eating in prep area, unlabeled bulk food
summary: Fail. Open coffee cup on baking prep shelving. Bulk containers unlabeled; no hair restraints; wiping cloths not kept in sanitizer. Earlier priority violations not corrected. No food handler certificates. Leaking hot-water handles; slow-draining sink.

headline: Broken thermometers; leaks; milk crate shelving
summary: Pass. Ambient air thermometers in aisles 11 and 12 missing or broken. Milk crates used as shelving; replace with shelving 6 inches off floor. Leaking drainpipes at produce, three-compartment and meat sinks. Food debris and spills throughout.

headline: Grease and debris buildup; missing wall base
summary: Pass. Replace damaged walk-in gasket. Clean grease and food debris from shelving, fryer cabinets, coolers, racks and dish machine. Replace missing top on backflow device at mop sink. Grout floors; replace missing wall base behind soda machine.

headline: Failed: bar lacks handwashing and dump sink
summary: Fail. Bar on 57th floor needs a handwashing sink with hot and cold water, soap and towels before serving open liquor. A dump sink with hot and cold water is also required. Priority citation issued.

headline: No health policy; no paper towels at sink
summary: Pass with conditions. No written employee health policy on site; must establish one with signed copies. No paper towels at rear prep hand sink; citation issued. Food debris under equipment; light shield left open; manager lacks allergen certificate.

headline: Items stored on floor; raw beef in grocery bags
summary: Pass. Condiments and straws stored on floor; elevate. Food handler without hair restraint. Single-use items not inverted. Raw beef kept in grocery bags; use food-grade storage. Slow-draining sink, water-damaged ceiling, and no manager allergen training.

headline: Failed: slime in ice maker; cooler at 50°F
summary: Fail. Black slimy substance inside ice maker dripping into ice used for drinks; machine to be cleaned and sanitized and ice removed. Two-door cooler at 50°F, empty of food; tagged. Chipped, rusty racks; allergen certificate missing.

headline: Missing splash guards; damaged ceiling tiles
summary: Pass. Splash guards missing on handwashing sinks in first- and second-floor bars. Damaged gaskets on refrigerator doors. No data plate on dish machine. No covered receptacle in second-floor women's restroom. Damaged ceiling tiles and holes in storage room walls.

headline: No certified manager; no handwashing supplies
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager on site while tacos, chicken and pizza puffs were prepared. Prep-area hand sink lacked cleanser and hand drying. Food handler without hair restraint. Front door left open. Grease on hood and grill.

headline: No backflow devices; food handler lacks certificate
summary: Pass. Interior of coolers, countertops and exterior of ice machine not clean. No backflow devices found at espresso machine, drip coffee or ice machine. One food handler has no food handling certificate.

headline: Missing thermometer; worn gaskets; light problems
summary: Pass. Thermometer needed for cake display coolers that are not operating. Worn door gaskets on dairy walk-in and freezer. Debris on deli oven exterior; dust on bakery walls. Cracked light shields and burnt-out lights.

headline: Duct tape used as splash guard repair
summary: Pass. Peeling duct tape used on the splash guard at the front prep hand sink. Tape must not be used as a repair; surface must be smooth and cleanable.

headline: Failed: slime in ice; holes, rust, no food handler proof
summary: Fail. Brownish-pink slime on ice machine surfaces dripping into ice; clean and sanitize. Torn gasket; grocery bags used as freezer containers. Broken urinal. Holes in walls and ceiling; rusty shelves. Repeat core violations; no food handler proof. Citation issued.

headline: Failed: no recent pest report; doors open at bottom
summary: Fail. No recent pest control service report; most recent is dated 11/03/2022. Front and rear doors not rodent-proof at bottom. No handwashing signage in rear restroom. Ice bin left uncovered. Priority citation issued.

headline: Grease buildup on hood vent and filters
summary: Pass. Hood vent and filters need cleaning to remove grease buildup. Manager instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: No paper towels; prior summary not posted
summary: Pass with conditions. No paper towels at washroom sink or rear hand sink; priority citation issued. Torn gasket on one-door cooler. Rear dry storage needs organizing. Prior inspection summary was not displayed for the public; today's is posted.

headline: Failed: no current pest control report
summary: Fail. No current pest control service report or logbook on premises; last online report dated 1/10/25. Upper ice machine areas need cleaning. Certified managers lack allergen training proof. Repeat priority violation; citation issued.

headline: Failed: repeat violations; gaps in doors
summary: Fail. Core violations from earlier report not corrected. Handwashing signs missing; doors have gaps and pin holes and must be rodent-proof. Oversized pots don't fit sink. Holes in floor and ceiling; chipped paint; burnt-out light. Citation issued.

headline: Failed: flies; dishwasher handled dishes unwashed
summary: Fail. About 50 or more live small flies in dish, chemical and mop sink areas. Dishwasher handled dirty dishes without washing hands. Hand sink water at 125.9°F, adjusted to 106.6°F by engineer. No hand sink in rear hallway prep area.

headline: Mouse droppings found; removed on site
summary: Pass with conditions. Over 80 mouse droppings in closet next to washroom; repeat violation. Droppings removed on site. Food stored on walk-in cooler floors; several food handlers lack training; water-stained ceiling tiles; kitchen cleaning needed.

headline: Failed: flies in food prep and dining areas
summary: Fail. About 50 live small flies in resident dining area and food prep and serving area, including on ceilings, cabinets and walls; pest control recommended. Women's restroom lacks covered receptacle. Earlier violation not corrected. Priority violation.

headline: Failed: no health policy; sink water too cool
summary: Fail. No written employee health policy on site. Unlabeled food; about 10 lbs discarded. Three-compartment sink water recorded at 10.57°F, below the 110°F minimum; citation issued. Leaking faucet and drainpipe. One sink lacks hot and cold water.

headline: Carpet in dry storage; ceiling grease
summary: Pass. Carpet in dry storage must be removed for a smooth, easily cleanable floor. Ceiling in main prep area needs cleaning to remove grease buildup.

headline: Scoops stored in ice; plastic crate shelving
summary: Pass. Ice scoops stored inside ice; use a clean container or inverted handle. Stored items must be elevated. Plastic crates used as shelving; dirty cooler gaskets, cloth shelf liner, rusty rack and leaking faucet also noted.

headline: Hair restraint; leaking sink; utensil storage
summary: Pass. Food handler not wearing hair restraint. Spoon left on cooked ground beef; knives stored behind electrical equipment. No drainboard on three-compartment sink; leaking basin; no backflow device on utility sink; washroom door lacks self-closing device.

headline: Missing ceiling panels; food debris; cardboard shelving
summary: Pass. Soap and towel dispenser above mop sink to be removed; handwashing only at designated sinks. Boxed food on floor; elevate. Multiple missing ceiling panels, torn cooler gasket, cardboard shelf liner and unlabeled dessert display.

headline: No paper towels; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Pass with conditions. No paper towels at bar handwashing sink; priority citation issued. Low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine (50 ppm minimum); not to be used until fixed. Manager immediately called for maintenance.

headline: Loose cooler lid; backflow devices not found
summary: Pass. Inside lid of cold prep unit is loose and hanging; repair. Backflow device could not be located on coffee or ice machine. No covered receptacle in unisex restroom. Allergen training certificate missing for food service manager.

headline: Damaged ice machine lids; missing wall panel
summary: Pass. Damaged lids and interior panel on ice machines must be repaired. Walk-in cooler door gaskets need repair. Missing wall panel in walk-in cooler must be replaced.

headline: Failed: no manager, hand-washing and handling lapses
summary: Fail. No certified food manager on site while eggs, pork and chicken were prepped. No vomit kit. Hand sink lacked soap and paper towels. Rear sink water at 158–160°F. Food handlers lacked certificates and allergen training. Priority citations issued.

headline: Failed: no manager; 50 live flies; dish machine 0 ppm
summary: Fail. Person in charge lacks food manager certificate. No certified manager on duty while salmon, ham, chicken and cut melons were prepared. Dish machine at 0 ppm, tagged. About 50 or more live flies in prep, dish and bar areas.

headline: Rear screen door gap; training proof missing
summary: Pass. Newly installed rear screen door has a 1/2-inch gap at the bottom; a tight rodent-proof strip is required. No proof of food handler training or certified manager allergen training; must be provided.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Pass. No food handler training certificate on site for one food handler; employee instructed to obtain one. Food service manager has no food allergen training certificate; instructed to obtain one.

headline: Cracked floor tiles in utility mop sink area
summary: Pass. Damaged and cracked floor tiles in the utility mop sink area of the dish area; instructed to replace or repair.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; sewage spill
summary: Fail. No certified food manager on site while chicken was prepped. No verifiable employee health policy on site. Wastewater spilled onto floor from three-compartment sink drain; pipes must be cleaned. Citations issued.

headline: Unlabeled seasoned flour; door not self-closing
summary: Pass. Bulk containers of seasoned flour lack common name labels; instructed to provide them. Unisex restroom door is not self-closing; instructed to provide a self-closing device.

headline: Hair restraint lapse; allergen certificates missing
summary: Pass. Food handler not wearing an effective hair restraint; manager instructed that all food handlers must wear one. No food allergen training certificates on premises for city-certified food managers.

headline: Failed: unsafe cold food, mice and roaches
summary: Fail. Steak, chicken, beef, pork and tomatoes held at 52–66°F; about 14 lbs discarded (about $195). Refrigerator at 53.1°F; tagged. About 20 mouse droppings and two live roaches found; priority citation issued. Squirt bottles unlabeled.

headline: Leaking faucet; no food handler proof
summary: Pass. Leaking faucet at one compartment sink; repair required. Debris on ground in dumpster enclosure must be removed and kept clean. No proof of food handler training on site; certificates required.

headline: No vomit clean-up kit; washroom door
summary: Pass with conditions. No vomit and diarrhea clean-up kit on premises; person in charge must provide and maintain one. Washroom door lacks a self-closing device; install and maintain it.

headline: Failed: pest log incomplete; dead insect
summary: Fail. Pest control logbook has only one inspection report from the past year; at least two required. Dead insect on prep table. No food handler certificates; certified manager lacks allergen certificate. Priority citation issued.

headline: Failed: soups and broth cooled too slowly
summary: Fail. Four large containers of soup, salsa and chicken broth in walk-in cooler at 54–68°F; about 120 lbs (about $200) discarded. Food stored in grocery bags; use food-grade containers. Missing vent cover over rear prep area.

headline: Failed: no health policy; sanitizer at 0 ppm
summary: Fail. No valid food sanitation certificate posted for employees; no written employee health policy. Hand sink lacked soap and paper towels; hot water at 68.7°F at men's restroom sink. Black slime in ice machine; dish machine at 0 ppm, tagged. Citations issued.

headline: Soiled walls around dish area
summary: Pass. Walls around dish area have soil buildup. Manager instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Ice buildup in coolers; sink stoppers faulty
summary: Pass. Ice buildup on walk-in cooler and front prep cooler; repair and maintain. Three-compartment sink stoppers do not hold water; repair required.

headline: Failed: no certificate posted; unsafe packaging
summary: Fail. No valid city food sanitation certificate posted. Ready-to-eat foods such as aioli and risotto lacked date marks. Vacuum-packed pork and duck without approved plan. No raw-food consumer advisory. Food debris on ceiling tiles. Citations issued.

headline: Leaking faucet; basement clutter; greasy floor
summary: Pass. Right-hand faucet leaking significantly from base; service required. Unused items cluttering basement must be removed. Food debris and grease on floor below cooking equipment on west side; detail clean.

headline: Dirty floors and drains; expired certificate
summary: Pass. Dirty floors with spillage and floor drains in front coffee prep area; instructed to clean in detail. One food handler had an expired certificate; proof of training required.

headline: Unlabeled dry food; black slime at sink caulk
summary: Pass. Dry food stored in plastic container must be labeled with its common name. Black slime on caulking around three-compartment sink must be replaced.

headline: Missing soap and hand drying at prep sinks
summary: Pass with conditions. Hibachi prep handwashing sink lacks sign; sinks lack soap and hand drying. Priority citation issued. Ice scoop stored on ice machine. Leaking pipe under three-compartment sink; spider webs on hood filters; blown-out freezer light.

headline: Construction material stored in rear
summary: Pass. Unused construction material piled in rear must be removed; other items elevated off the floor. Ceiling vent cover in employee washroom has excess dust; clean and maintain.

headline: Failed: backed-up drain in beef walk-in
summary: Fail. Floor drain in beef prep walk-in cooler not draining; water backing up. Manager stopped using that cooler until fixed; detail clean and sanitize before reopening. Priority citation issued.

headline: Door sweep damaged; no vomit procedure
summary: Pass with conditions. No written vomit and diarrhea procedure available on site; must provide. Entrance door sweep in disrepair; repair to prevent pest entry. Wall base detached in rear prep area; burned-out ceiling light.

headline: Hand-washing at prep sink; food discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Employee washed hands at butcher's prep sink, splashing soap onto 30 lbs of trippa; food discarded and owner corrected the issue. Rice pudding and milk-egg puddings at 45–51°F in soda cooler; discarded. No backflow device at ice machine.

headline: Knife and clean dishes stored improperly
summary: Pass. Knife stored between counter and cold-holding unit. Clean plates, bowls and cups stored uncovered on cook line shelf. Floors under cooking and hot-holding equipment soiled with food debris; instructed to clean.

headline: Failed: no manager, unsafe temperatures, pests
summary: Fail. No certified food manager on site while food was served. Sausage and chicken held at 120–130°F; discarded. Cold foods at 45–52°F; about $300 discarded. Chemical cleaner used as sanitizer. Over 50 small flies and roach carcasses found.

headline: Missing cooler light shield; allergen proof absent
summary: Pass. Walk-in cooler light bulb needs a shield. No proof of allergen training for city food managers on site; they must complete training and keep the certificate on site.

headline: No covered waste receptacle in washroom
summary: Pass. Employee washroom has no covered waste receptacle; instructed to provide one.

headline: Grill and storage bins need cleaning
summary: Pass. Debris on grill table and exterior of plastic storage bins must be cleaned. Food splatter on walls must be cleaned. Debris on hood filters and cooking equipment hood must be cleaned.

headline: No food handler certificates on site
summary: Pass. No food handler certificates on site. Manager instructed to comply with the state food handler requirement.

headline: Grease spills outside; restroom door gap
summary: Pass. Minor grease spills on front of outside oil tank must be cleaned. About 2-inch gap under toilet room door must be repaired.

headline: Failed: no soap, mold, about 50 live flies
summary: Fail. No soap or paper towels at exposed sinks behind second- and third-floor bars and in dish area. Black mold-like substance inside third-floor ice machine. No raw-food advisory on brunch menu. About 50 live flying insects; more pest control needed.

headline: Clean utensils stored under grill; greasy equipment
summary: Pass. Clean utensils stored under flattop grill where food debris falls on them. Cutting boards, can opener, gaskets, cooking equipment, hood and floors need detail cleaning. Three-compartment sink faucet leaking. No food handler or allergen certificates on site.

headline: Failed: chicken and shrimp held too warm
summary: Fail. Chicken at 50.1°F, shrimp at 48.3°F and egg rolls at 48.5°F in rear cold unit; 14 lbs discarded (about $150). Handwashing signs missing; unlabeled containers; no hair restraints; wet cloths not in sanitizer. Priority citation issued.

headline: Failed: about 50 live flies; repeat violations
summary: Fail. About 50 live small flying insects on walls and ceiling in prep, dish and bar areas; more pest control needed. No handwashing signage. Wood shelves in poor repair. Earlier violations not corrected: debris, leaking sink, damaged ceiling tiles, grease.

headline: Soiled walk-in floor; dim cooler light
summary: Pass. Food debris on walk-in cooler floor under shelving and along coving. Walk-in cooler light is too dim for the refrigeration unit; repair or replace the light source.

headline: Torn refrigerator gaskets; no trash lids
summary: Pass. Torn gaskets on refrigerator in rear prep area; repair. Restrooms lacked covered receptacles; provided by end of inspection. No allergen training proof for certified food manager.

headline: No vomiting and diarrhea response plan
summary: There is no procedure or kit for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events, a priority violation. The operator must provide gloves, masks, disposable mops and norovirus-killing sanitizer. Other fixes include a mop sink with hot and cold water.

headline: About 20 rodent droppings; cold storage issues
summary: About 20 rodent droppings were found in the front dry storage hallway and rear dry storage corners. Citation issued, and pest control service is required. Utensils were stored in room-temperature water, and clean equipment sat on the floor.

headline: 120+ rodent droppings; about 20 flies
summary: About 120 or more rodent droppings were found across prep shelving, storage areas and near exits. About 20 small black flies were also noted. Pest control service is required, and a citation was issued. The hand sink was blocked by cookware.

headline: Menu lacks undercooked food advisory
summary: The menu does not mark or disclose animal-derived foods served undercooked or cooked to order, a priority violation. Other items include a leaking three-compartment sink drain, no covered restroom receptacle, and rust and chemicals stored on the floor.

headline: Wiping cloths on prep tables; rust; clutter
summary: Wiping cloths were left on prep tables. Rusty shelving is in the rear food storage area. Basement clutter must be removed to prevent rodent harborage. Burnt-out bulbs are in the employee washroom.

headline: Wastewater backs up from floor drain
summary: Wastewater backed up from the floor drain onto the floor when draining the three-compartment sink. Citation issued, and repair is required. Maintenance tools were also stored with non-maintenance items.

headline: No certified manager; no probe thermometer
summary: No certified food manager was on site while deli meat and soup were handled. There was no probe thermometer on site. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. Raw wood shelving was noted in the walk-in cooler.

headline: Pink substance in ice machine
summary: A minimal amount of a pink, unknown substance was found on the inside panel of the ice machine. The operator was told to remove ice, clean, sanitize and maintain the machine.

headline: Grease buildup on grills
summary: Grease had built up on the outside of and between the flat top grills and grill. The operator was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Leaking faucet; expired allergen training
summary: The three-compartment sink faucet is leaking and must be repaired. A wet mop was stored on the floor in the rear utility area and must be hung to dry. Allergen training for city food managers has expired.

headline: Employee eating in prep; food stored under pipes
summary: An employee was eating in the rear food prep area. Food containers were stored under wastewater pipes, and a fly swatter was stored with clean utensils. Walk-in cooler walls are separating, and a priority citation was issued.

headline: No certified manager during food prep; failed
summary: No certified manager or person in charge with a sanitation certificate was present while TCS food, such as curry sauce, was being prepared. The manager arrived about 50 minutes after being called. The menu lacks raw or undercooked food warnings.

headline: Over 30 rat droppings in basement
summary: Over 30 rat droppings were found in the basement by the HVAC unit. The operator must eliminate all pest activity and clean. Citation issued. Basement equipment must be elevated 6 inches off the floor.

headline: No handwashing signs; dishes on floor
summary: Handwashing signs are missing at the prep and dish area sinks. Dishes were stored on the dish area floor and must be elevated. No proof of allergen training was provided for city food managers.

headline: Door gap; leaks; burnt-out bulbs
summary: A 1/4-inch gap is at the bottom of the rear exit door. The backflow device for the utility mop sink was not located. A leak was found under the rear hand sink, and bulbs near the cooler are burnt out. The food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Labeling gaps, floor storage, and door gap
summary: Several items need labels, including desserts and squeeze bottles. Food is stored on prep area floors and must be elevated. The front door has a gap at the bottom, and an animal cage must be removed from the premises.

headline: About 80 mouse droppings found
summary: About 80 mouse droppings were scattered through the rear prep area and restroom. Citation issued, and the person in charge was told to remove them and sanitize. Also noted: rusty, decayed shelving and no food handler certificates.

headline: No paper towels; sink inaccessible; priority
summary: Paper towels are missing at handwashing sinks in staff toilets, the meat prep area and rear dish rooms, a priority violation. The front deli prep handsink was not accessible. Packaged dates and radishes for self-service lacked labels.

headline: Garbage bags used for food storage
summary: Single-use garbage bags were being used for food storage. The operator was instructed to use food-grade containers or bags for all food storage.

headline: Plastic wrap on sprayer; multiple lights out
summary: Plastic wrap on the three-compartment sink sprayer must be removed, and the faucet must stay leak-free. Multiple lights at the service bar must be repaired.

headline: Residue on walk-in cooler shelving
summary: Residue was found on walk-in cooler shelving. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: No hand soap; prior violations uncorrected
summary: There is no hand soap at the front prep and dish area handsinks, a priority violation. Prior core violations were not corrected: wiping cloths, dirty utensils and surfaces, a water-stained ceiling tile, and missing food handler training certificates.

headline: Cold food at 44-50F; coolers at 45F
summary: Several TCS foods were held at 44-50F, above 41F, and about $150 of food was discarded. Two coolers ran at 45F air temperature and were tagged. Citation issued.

headline: Syrup residue and organic buildup on floor
summary: Syrup residue was built up inside the metal cabinet holding ICEE syrup. Organic matter had built up on the floor under and behind equipment. The person in charge was told to clean both.

headline: Ice machine residue; debris; allergen training
summary: Residue was found on the interior surfaces of the ice machine. Debris is along walls and corners in utility and storage areas. The food service sanitation manager lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: No cold water at bar sink
summary: The three-compartment sink at the bar has no cold water and must be repaired. Allergen training certificates are missing for certified food managers.

headline: Missing food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Food handler and allergen certificates were not on site, repeating a violation from a 2023 inspection. Citation issued. Also noted: an unsealed wood shelf, floor debris under dry storage shelves, and dust on the dish area ceiling.

headline: Dropped shrimp lid reused; shrimp discarded
summary: An employee dropped a container lid on the floor, put it back on, and shelved cooked shrimp, which was discarded. Also noted: no hair restraints, milk crates and cardboard used for food and flooring, and greasy cook-line floors.

headline: Dishes washed without sanitizing setup; corrected
summary: An employee washed dishes at the three-compartment sink without setting it up to sanitize, and sanitizer read 0 ppm. The manager immediately had the sink set up. Also noted: dirty wiping cloths and employee belongings beside food.

headline: Water-stained ceiling tiles in toilet room
summary: Water-stained ceiling tiles were found in the toilet room. The operator was instructed to replace them.

headline: Scoop on lid; debris; uncorrected core violation
summary: A scoop was stored on the lid of white chocolate in the basement. Debris is on the basement floor and walls. A prior core violation was not corrected, and citation issued. Stained and missing ceiling tiles were noted.

headline: Grime near cookers; expired handler training
summary: Food debris, grease and grime are built up on floors and walls near cooking equipment. A slight black slime was found inside the ice machine. Three employees had expired food handler training.

headline: Restroom doors not self-closing
summary: Restroom doors were not self-closing. The operator must provide a self-closing device.

headline: Employee drinks stored near food and equipment
summary: Employee covered beverage containers were stored under food prep tables, next to single-service articles and equipment. The operator must provide a separate designated storage area.

headline: Missing covers on restroom receptacles
summary: Receptacles in the unisex toilet rooms lacked covers. The operator must provide covers and maintain them.

headline: Over 30 live flies found; pest control ordered
summary: Over 30 live small flies were found in the front bar, service bar and warewashing areas. The operator was told to remove them, clean, and call pest control. Also noted: standing water, wall holes, and multiple burnt-out lights.

headline: Rust on walk-in cooler shelving
summary: Rust was found on shelving racks in the rear prep walk-in cooler. The person in charge was told to remove it and keep surfaces smooth and cleanable.

headline: Uncovered food, heavy grime, and ice buildup
summary: Food was stored on floors and in uncovered containers in prep areas. Ice buildup was found in the walk-in freezer, and cooking equipment, walls and floors were heavily soiled. The dish sink lacks handwashing signage.

headline: Knife stored on cooler; no garbage lid
summary: A knife was stored between the surface of a prep cooler and was ordered stored properly. The garbage vehicle had no lid and must have one.

headline: Bulk foods unlabeled; improper shelf liners
summary: Bulk foods such as sugar must be labeled. Grocery bags cannot be used as food containers. Raw wood cannot be used under prep tables, and tinfoil or cardboard cannot line shelves. Some employees lack food handler training.

headline: No thermometers in three refrigeration units
summary: Three refrigeration units in the kitchen prep area had no thermometers. The operator must provide working ones. Bulk containers were unlabeled, and the backflow device at the coffee machine was not located.

headline: Leaking drainpipe under rear prep sink
summary: A drainpipe under the two-compartment sink in the rear prep area was leaking. The manager was instructed to repair it and keep it maintained.

headline: Large can opener needs cleaning
summary: A large can opener needed cleaning to remove buildup. The operator was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Dead insects in basement and boiler room
summary: Dead insects were found in the basement and boiler room. Staff were instructed to remove them, detail clean, sanitize, and maintain the area.

headline: No backflow prevention device at mop sink
summary: No backflow prevention device was found at the mop sink faucet. The operator must show where it can be located and serviced.

headline: Leaking and loose handles; summary not posted
summary: The hot water handle at a prep sink is missing, and another handsink has a leak and a loose handle. One exhaust hood light is out. The summary report was not posted in plain view of the public. Citation issued.

headline: Over 100 live flies; leaking dumpster
summary: Over 100 live small flying insects were found on walls, ceilings and equipment near the dumpster room. Citation issued. About 35 lbs of cooked beef and hot dogs at 47-51F were discarded, valued at $400. The dumpster is leaking.

headline: Ice scoop stored in food; certificates missing
summary: An ice scoop was stored in the ice machine with its handle inside the food. The operator was told to store it handle up. Some food employees lacked handler certificates, and allergen training was not on site.

headline: Missing thermometers; rusty shelving; drain issues
summary: Thermometers are missing from all prep coolers. Rusty shelving is inside the walk-in, and a handwashing sink drains slowly. The employee washroom has no covered receptacle. Floors, walls and drains are dirty, and some tiles are cracked.

headline: Foil on shelves; dirty wall near trash
summary: Aluminum foil on storage shelves and on the rice cooker must be removed. The wall near the trash receptacle has excess food debris and must be cleaned.

headline: Soiled mop heads not stored properly
summary: Soiled mop heads were not stored properly. The manager was instructed to hang them so they do not allow insect breeding. No insects were noted.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; uncovered bakery items
summary: Bulk containers in the prep area were unlabeled and must be labeled with the common food name. Bakery items in the front display were not covered and must be covered. Some food handlers were not wearing hair restraints.

headline: Missing handwashing sink and several repairs
summary: The second-floor pasta prep area has no handwashing sink, and a handwashing sign is missing on the first floor. Also required: repairing cooler gaskets, removing storage crates, cleaning the ice machine panel, fixing floor tiles, and replacing burnt-out lights.

headline: Chicken held too warm; food discarded on site
summary: Cold chicken kabob was held at 51.2F, above the 41F limit. The manager discarded about 6 lbs ($14) of food on site. Also noted: a patio door gap, a damaged cooler gasket, and a dish machine rinse gauge reading 148F.

headline: 200-300 mouse droppings; prior violation uncorrected
summary: A prior priority violation was not corrected: about 200-300 mouse droppings were found in storage, under the sink, in the washroom, and on the sales floor. Additional pest control service is needed. A 1/4-inch gap was also found at the rear door.

headline: Rust, spills, leaks and a burnt-out bulb
summary: Rust was found on a can opener, with spills in bar coolers, a leaking two-compartment sink faucet, sticky walk-in floors, and a burnt-out walk-in freezer bulb. Grease trap lids were unlabeled, so their existence could not be verified.

headline: No posted sanitation certificate for TCS food
summary: No valid City of Chicago sanitation certificate was posted on site while TCS food was stored. Citation issued. Also noted: cardboard used as a shelf liner in the walk-in cooler and a missing light shield.

headline: Prep cooler at 60.9F; floors not cleanable
summary: A prep cooler held at 60.9F and must be repaired and kept at 41F or below. Citation issued. Floors under the three-compartment sink and in the office and washroom, and washroom and hall walls, are not smooth and easily cleanable.

headline: Juicer too close to handwashing sink
summary: A juicer was placed too close to a handwashing sink. The operator was told to keep the sink easily accessible.

headline: No covered receptacle; wall and ceiling openings
summary: The south unisex washrooms have no covered receptacle. Openings in walls and ceilings in the washroom and storage areas must be repaired.

headline: No certified manager on duty; no handler certificates
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while chicken sandwiches, hamburgers, burritos and fries were prepared and served. Citation issued. No food handler certificates were on site, and the sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No mop sink; no washroom ventilation
summary: The premises has no mop sink for wastewater disposal. It must be installed with a backflow device and hot and cold water. Also required: a grease trap at the three-compartment sink, a self-closing washroom door, and washroom ventilation.

headline: Leaking drainpipe; dirt behind equipment
summary: A drainpipe at the three-compartment sink leaks in the rear warewashing area. A mop is not stored in a way that lets it dry. Dirt and food debris are built up behind equipment and in corners.

headline: About 15 rat droppings; hot water failure
summary: About 15 rat droppings were found in the hallway storage area leading to the basement. The operator was told to eliminate rodent activity and contact pest control. Citation issued. Hot water failed at a dish area handwashing sink, also cited.

headline: Dirty cooling units and equipment; allergen training missing
summary: Cooling unit interiors, areas under heavy equipment, fryer doors and the pizza oven needed cleaning. One of two certified food managers lacked allergen training.

headline: Grease trap and prep equipment need cleaning
summary: The grease trap exterior, prep tables, prep coolers, pizza oven, grill, stove and fryers all need cleaning. The certified food manager lacks an allergen training certificate.

headline: Missing freezer handles; dirty prep tables
summary: Both handles are missing from a two-door reach-in freezer. Prep tables in the rear area need cleaning, and dried food debris is on the floors. A damaged ceiling tile and burnt-out bulbs were found. Training certificates must be on site.

headline: Milk crates used for elevation; various repairs
summary: Milk crates were used for elevation in the kitchen and dry storage, which can hide pests. Proper shelving is required. Also noted: a slow hand sink drain, uncovered employee bins, debris around the dumpster, and improperly stored mop.

headline: Over 50 rodent droppings found throughout
summary: Over 50 rodent droppings were found in the kitchen, storage, basement and behind bar walls. Citation issued, and pest service was ordered for all affected areas. Also noted: greasy fryers and coolers with debris, and a certified manager without allergen training.

headline: Spilled food inside reach-in cooler
summary: Food and gravy spillage is inside the two-door reach-in cooler in the prep area. It must be detail cleaned.

headline: Walk-in cooler bulb needs light shield
summary: A light bulb inside the walk-in cooler lacked a shield. The operator must provide one.

headline: Flies found; shrimp held hot at 85F discarded
summary: About 30-40 small flies were found in the washroom hallway, sushi bar and dish areas. Citation issued. Cooked shrimp and tempura held at 85.1F and 64.7F were discarded. No certified manager was on site while shrimp was prepared.

headline: Dish sink not set up; corrected on site
summary: An employee washed dishes at the three-compartment sink without setting it up to sanitize, and no sanitizer was used. The manager immediately had the sink set up with chlorine. This was corrected on site. Citation issued.

headline: Food handlers not wearing hair restraints
summary: Food handlers were observed not wearing hair restraints. They were instructed to wear them.

headline: No certified manager; cold food at 50F
summary: No certified manager was on duty while chicken, hamburgers and fries were handled. About 50 lbs of chicken at 50F was ordered discarded. A 49.5F prep cooler must not be used until reinspected by CDPH. Hair restraints were also missing.

headline: Ham thawed at room temperature; food on floor
summary: Frozen ham was thawing at room temperature at the slicer. The operator was told to use approved thawing methods. Dry food and bottled drinks were stored on the floor, and a cracked cheese bin was found.

headline: No certified manager and no sanitizer available
summary: No certified food service manager on site, and no certificate posted, while milk and deli foods were handled and served. No sanitizer was available for food-contact surfaces and utensils. Both are priority violations.

headline: No certified manager while TCS food served
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while TCS foods such as omelettes, chilaquiles and steak were prepared and served. Citation issued. Front and side doors have about 1/4-inch gaps at the bottom that must be tightened.

headline: Missing thermometer; greasy floors
summary: A thermometer is missing inside the front prep cooling unit by the window. Floors behind the grill and fryers and under the three-compartment sink have food and grease debris.

headline: Dirty equipment, vents, and walk-in interior
summary: The exterior and interior of hot holding units need cleaning, along with walk-in shelving and the floors and walls around equipment. Ceiling vents, tiles and pipes also need cleaning. The walk-in cooler's interior door needs cleaning.

headline: Live roaches found; cold food discarded
summary: About 5-7 live roaches were found behind a small freezer in the dish area. Pest service and proof are required by April 1, 2026. Chicken and goat held at 46-48F were discarded, about 10 lbs. Citation issued.

headline: Open drinks, cold utensil water, greasy shelving
summary: Employees had open drinks in the food prep area. Cook-line utensils were stored in water at 64.7F, below the 135F minimum. Shelving and stove areas were heavily greasy, and allergen training proof was missing.

headline: Gumbo at 45F discarded; mold in cooler
summary: Two pounds of cooked gumbo at 45F in the walk-in cooler were discarded by the manager, valued at $187. Citation issued. Also noted: missing handwashing signs, mold on beer cooler walls and ceiling, and a leaking stopper handle.

headline: No original sanitation certificate; toilet issues
summary: No original City of Chicago sanitation manager certificate was on site. Citation issued. Also noted: a dirty toilet bowl, a restroom door without a self-closing device, no covered restroom receptacle, and food items stored on the floor.

headline: Pest control records missing; door gap found
summary: The pest control logbook had no service reports since February 2024, a priority violation. The rear exterior door has a gap over 1/4 inch. Also cited: insufficient hot water pressure at all fixtures, and a greasy hood above the stove.

headline: Gap between floor and baseboard
summary: A gap between the floor and baseboard in the southwest washroom, near the toilet, must be repaired and maintained.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate while serving TCS food
summary: No valid sanitation manager certificate was on site while steak, rice and beans were prepared and served. Citation issued. Also noted: peeling paint on the basement stair wall, grime under the sink, and grease on ventilation filters.

headline: Public summary report not displayed
summary: The previous inspection report summary was not displayed for the public, a priority violation with a citation. One food handler lacked a food handler certificate, and proof of training must be shown.

headline: Hair restraint missing; unlocated backflow device
summary: A front cook line worker was not wearing a hair restraint. The ice maker's backflow device could not be located, and a garden hose was connected under the three-compartment sink. The food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: No certified manager certificate on site
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager certificate was on site while burgers, sliced tomatoes and ice cream were served. The manager was told to post it and keep it on site at all times. Citation issued.

headline: Cold food held at 48-49F; food discarded
summary: About 5 lbs of marinara sauce and cooked chicken were held at 48.5-48.9F, above 41F. The person in charge discarded the food, valued at $30. Also noted: items stored on the floor in the beer cooler.

headline: About 60 live flies in dish area
summary: About 60 live small flies were found on dish racks, ceilings and walls in the common dishwashing area. The manager was told to contact pest control. Priority violation, and citation issued.

headline: No certified manager 8:20-9:00 AM
summary: No certified manager was on site from 8:20 to 9:00 AM while the facility was open and operating. Citation issued. No allergen training certificates were on site.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; corrected on site
summary: The low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm sanitizer at inspection. The person in charge changed chemicals, and the machine then read 100 ppm. This was corrected on site. Citation issued.

headline: Loose faucet handle; condensate water pooling
summary: The coffee bar handwashing sink has a loose cold-water handle. A basement condensate line discharges onto the floor and leaves pooled water. The operator was told to repair both.

headline: Ice maker debris and greasy kitchen floors
summary: Slight encrusted debris was found inside the ice maker and must be removed. Floors in the prep and cooking areas had grease and dried food buildup along walls and under cooking equipment.

headline: Leaking faucet and dirty prep floors
summary: A faucet at the rear three-compartment sink is leaking at its base. Floors, walls and corners in the prep and dish areas are dirty. Some food handlers have expired certificates that must be renewed.

headline: Multi-use utensils not stored inverted
summary: Multi-use utensils were not stored inverted. The operator was instructed to store them handle up and maintain this.

headline: Ice scoops stored in ice machine; floor storage
summary: Ice scoops were stored inside the ice machine, and items were on the rear storage floor. A handwashing sink had weak water pressure. Prior issues not corrected: no thermometer in the customer drink cooler, uncovered restroom trash, and employee belongings near food.

headline: Gaps under front and rear doors
summary: The front and rear doors have 1/4-inch gaps at the bottom. The operator must repair them to prevent possible pest entry points.

headline: Slow-draining three-compartment sink
summary: Passed. The three-compartment sink pipe in the dishwashing area drains slowly. The manager was told it must drain quickly.

headline: Long nails, open dumpsters, weak hot water
