summary: Pass with conditions. Food handler had long fingernails (priority). Outside dumpster lids wide open and trash stacked above doors (priority). Weak hot water at front hand sink. Cooler thermometer placed in coldest back spot; must move to front.

headline: Unlabeled bulk container; cluttered coolers
summary: Passed. Bulk container in rear storage not labeled with the common food name. Coolers are cluttered and must be organized.

headline: Failed: slime in ice machine dripping onto ice
summary: Failed. Pink slime and black dirt buildup inside ice machine dripped into ice used by customers (priority; ice discarded). Manager must clean machine by re-inspection. Also: ice scoop in ice bin, dirty gun holders, food-debris walls.

headline: Slow-draining handsink; debris under sink
summary: Passed. Handwashing sink in rear prep area drains slowly and must be repaired. Debris along floor and walls under the three-compartment sink in rear dry storage must be cleaned.

headline: Broken gauge covers on dish machine
summary: Passed. Glass covers on gauges of the conveyor high-temperature dish machine are broken and cracked. They must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Leaking faucet; dim walk-in cooler light
summary: Passed. Leaking faucet base at the rear prep sink must be repaired. The basement walk-in cooler has inadequate lighting, which must be improved.

headline: Ice buildup in front prep freezer
summary: Passed. Ice buildup inside the reach-in freezer in the front prep area. It must be defrosted and maintained.

headline: Sink backup in three-compartment area
summary: Pass with conditions. Water backed up into the three-compartment sink basins when one basin drained. Building maintenance rodded the drains and the backup stopped. Citation issued.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; dirty dough cart
summary: Passed. A torn gasket inside the basement walk-in cooler must be repaired. A dough cart had dirt and food debris buildup that must be cleaned.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; freezer ice; clutter
summary: Passed. No handwashing signs near exposed sink in front bar. Excess ice in three basement chest freezers. Clutter in basement food storage. Proof of food handler training certificates for required employees must be provided.

headline: Ice machine debris; torn gasket
summary: Passed. Slight encrusted debris inside the ice machine must be removed, and the machine detail-cleaned and serviced. Torn door gasket on the front three-door prep cooler. Ceiling vent covers over the food prep area need detail cleaning.

headline: Uncovered food; misplaced utensils
summary: Passed. Food in hot holding and prep areas left uncovered; utensils left on prep table; food stored in plastic grocery bags in refrigerator. Instructed to use food-grade lids, storage bags, and proper utensil storage.

headline: Repeat allergen training violation; no signage
summary: Pass with conditions. Previous allergen training violation not corrected: no allergen course for certified food manager on site (priority; citation issued). No handwashing sign in unisex washroom; frozen meat in plastic grocery bags; slow-draining handsink.

headline: No pest control log; no allergen training
summary: Failed. No pest control log with current invoices (priority; citation issued). Sanitation manager on premises had no allergen training. Both must be provided.

headline: Expired cooked foods in walk-in cooler
summary: Pass with conditions. Several cooked foods, including chicken and yogurt, past discard dates (12/13-12/16) in walk-in cooler. Manager told to keep time/temperature-control foods no more than 7 days. Food stored on floor; ice scoop on ice machine; vent needs cleaning.

headline: No hair restraint; broken tiles; open drywall
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food handler without hair restraint while preparing food. Broken floor tiles and unsealed, unpainted drywall in food prep area; light fixtures missing end caps; no allergen training certificates for managers.

headline: No certified manager; blocked handsink
summary: Pass with conditions. Person in charge lacked City certificate. No certified manager on duty while handling sausage and eggs (priority; citation issued). Main prep handsink was blocked by equipment, since moved (citation issued). Three-compartment faucet cannot shut off.

headline: Rust, unlabeled bulk containers, missing training
summary: Passed re-inspection. Rust on basement ice machine and cook-line shelving; bulk containers unlabeled; chemical shelving rusty and raw wood; grease under fryer; no food handler training or allergen training proof (priority).

headline: Chicken thawed in standing water; failed
summary: Failed re-inspection. Frozen chicken thawed overnight in standing water in sinks; manager told to use running water. No licensed pest control operator contracted (citation issued). Also ice buildup in freezer, bicycle in dry prep area, spilled fries.

headline: Failed: dumpster area and floors dirty
summary: Failed. Outside dumpster area not clean, with garbage spillage (priority; citation issued). Floors at wok preparation area not clean. Tools and clutter on shelving must be removed.

headline: Food stored on walk-in floor
summary: Passed. Crates and boxes of food were stored on the walk-in cooler floor. The manager was instructed to elevate all items at least 6 inches off the floor.

headline: Hair restraints, cutting board, toilet room cleaning
summary: Passed. Long hair not tied back or netted; deeply cut cutting board at sandwich station to be replaced; drink dispenser nozzles need cleaning; toilet rooms need cleaning; outside area needs debris removed; floors need spill cleanup.

headline: Walls not smooth at bar prep area
summary: Passed re-inspection. Walls in the small bar prep area are not smooth or easy to clean. They must be sealed.

headline: No certified manager; no vomit kit
summary: Pass with conditions. No City-certified food manager on site while time/temperature-controlled food was prepared (priority; citation issued). No vomit or diarrhea kit. No food handler certificates or allergen training on site.

headline: Torn gaskets, raw wood, lead-risk cups
summary: Passed re-inspection. Dry storage containers unlabeled; torn gaskets on rear refrigerator; raw wood to seal; ceramic cups must be lead-free or lead-safe or removed; three-compartment sink missing stoppers and draining slowly.

headline: Bare-hand rice contact; cold food discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Food handler pressed rice into a cup with bare hands; rice discarded and practice stopped (priority; citation issued). Display cooler items at 47.8-58.9F discarded (25 lbs). Wet wiping cloths, food-encrusted racks, clutter, and floor and faucet repairs needed.

headline: Wiping cloths on prep tables
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were stored on top of prep tables. They must be stored in sanitizing solution when not in use.

headline: No food handler or allergen certificates
summary: Passed. No current food handler certificates for staff on site, and no allergen training certificate for the food service manager. Staff were instructed to obtain them.

headline: Compressor leak; floor drain odor
summary: Passed re-inspection. Walk-in cooler compressor leaking into a bucket; floor drains smell foul (repair required). Worn gaskets, cardboard and crates in storage, raw wood, and food manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Dirty basement floors; loose handsink
summary: Passed. Dirt on floor of basement walk-in cooler must be cleaned. Employee restroom handwashing sink is coming loose from the wall. Grease, dirt, and food debris on basement and upstairs food service floors.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; repeat allergen violation
summary: Pass with conditions. Several food handlers had expired food handler certificates; must show valid proof. Repeat violation: certified managers lacked allergen training certificates on premises (priority; citation issued).

headline: Front door not rodent-proof
summary: Passed. The front door was not rodent-proof. The owner was instructed to provide and maintain a rodent-proof door to prevent pest entry.

headline: Repeat allergen violation; ice machines, mold
summary: Pass with conditions. Previous core violation not corrected: one certified food manager lacked allergen training (priority; citation issued). Also: ice machines need detail cleaning, walk-in cooler mold-like buildup, drain line leaking onto floor, cooler thermometers needed.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. Certified manager on site had no allergen training certificate. The person in charge was instructed to obtain allergen training.

headline: Soup cooled covered; sink leak
summary: Passed. Soup was cooled while covered, an inadequate cooling method; the person in charge uncovered it on site. A leak from piping under the three-compartment sink in the rear dishwashing area must be repaired.

headline: Dock door openings; foil shelf liners
summary: Passed. Openings beside dock door must be sealed to prevent pests. Aluminum foil shelf liners to be removed. Also: floor repairs, wall opening, missing vent covers, and allergen training proof needed for certified staff.

headline: Single-use items not inverted
summary: Passed. Single-use articles were not inverted in prep, bar, and storage areas. The manager was instructed to invert all of them to protect from contamination.

headline: Broken thermometer; leaking faucet
summary: Passed. Ambient thermometer in walk-in beer cooler in disrepair; leaking hot water faucet at kitchen prep handsink; missing light shield in men's restroom. Each must be fixed and maintained.

headline: Shrimp in handsink; no food handler certificates
summary: Pass with conditions. Shrimp left in a handwashing sink; 5 lbs discarded ($20), citation issued. Shrimp also thawed in a handsink; must thaw in prep sinks under cold running water. No food handler certificates on site.

headline: Dirty gasket; slow-draining sink
summary: Passed re-inspection. Dirty rubber gasket on a cooler door by the dishwashing area must be cleaned. The handwashing sink in the dishwashing area drains slowly and must be repaired.

headline: About 40 flies; shellstock tags incomplete; failed
summary: Failed re-inspection. About 40 small flies found throughout facility, including bar and prep areas (citation issued). Shellstock tags lacked last sold/served dates. No prep sink in bar; one toilet unusable; debris around dumpster and floors in rear storage.

headline: Gaps, worn gaskets, missing training records
summary: Passed re-inspection with repairs required: gap at dining room door (insect entry risk), worn cooler gasket and cutting board, low cold water pressure at three-compartment sink, grease buildup, burnt-out lights, and some missing food handler training.

headline: Broken cooler handle; wood replaces glass
summary: Passed. A rear two-door cooler had a broken handle, and its glass was replaced with wood. The manager was instructed to repair or replace the cooler.

headline: Worn cutting boards; no hair restraint
summary: Passed. Rubber gaskets need food debris removed; a food handler had no hair restraint; a wiping cloth was not stored in sanitizer; worn, deeply cut cutting boards need replacing.

headline: Heavy grease in exhaust hood
summary: Passed. Heavy dirt and grease in exhaust hood, filters, pipes and conduits above cooking equipment; serving plates not inverted; women's and unisex restroom trash cans lack lids. Instructed to clean and provide lids.

headline: Person in charge lacks certificate
summary: Pass with conditions. Person in charge lacks City sanitation certificate (priority). No certified food manager on site while dairy and sandwiches were prepared and served. Thermometers needed in reach-in coolers; cleaning supplies must be stored 6 inches off floor.

headline: Failed: 40-50 rat droppings in basement
summary: Failed. 40-50 rat droppings on basement storage floor. Area must be cleaned and pest control serviced before re-inspection next week (priority; citation issued). Also: greasy fryers and floors, sinking floor in front of pizza cooler, dirty hood vents.

headline: Cold food too warm; cooler repair ordered
summary: Pass with conditions. Cold foods held at 55-62F in front prep cooler reading 64F; person in charge discarded them. Cooler must be repaired. Also: faucet leak, food handler certificate not shown for 1 of 2 employees, manager lacking allergen training.

headline: Slime in ice machine; ice scoops misstored
summary: Pass with conditions. Blackish slime in ice machine dripped onto ice; manager cleaned machine during inspection (priority; citation issued). Also: ice scoops improperly stored, torn gasket, freezer ice buildup, dirty floors, grease on hood filters.

headline: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure
summary: Pass with conditions. No procedure or cleanup supplies on premises for vomit and diarrhea events. Manager must provide a written procedure and all needed cleanup items on site (priority).

headline: Missing signage, unlabeled containers, plastic bags
summary: Passed. Missing handwashing sign at front prep sink; food storage containers unlabeled; single-use articles not inverted and stored on floor in hallway and storage areas; frozen food in plastic grocery bags in walk-in freezer.

headline: Failed: about 60 live flies
summary: Failed. About 60 small black live flies in rear prep and storage area, on food pans, containers, and cardboard. Pest control recommended (priority; citation issued). Also: grease and food debris on cooking equipment and an unused cooler.

headline: Cooked rice and greens held too warm
summary: Pass with conditions. Cooked rice, pasta, and cut leafy greens held at 61.5-69.9F underneath the cook line, not in cold holding; about 7 lbs ($15) discarded (priority; citation issued). Ice bin needs cleaning; no thermometer in refrigerator by rear sink.

headline: No certified manager; clutter blocks exit
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager with original certificate on site while food was prepared (priority; citation issued). Clutter blocks exit door; lighting inadequate; toilet room door not self-closing; food handler and allergen certificates needed.

headline: Failed: black mold in ice machine
summary: Failed. Black mold-like substance inside ice machine touching ice used for consumption; ice discarded, machine to be cleaned (priority; citation issued). Semi-frozen items on counter must be thawed under running water below 70F. Also: grease on hood filters and microwave.

headline: No person in charge with valid certificate
summary: Pass with conditions. No person in charge with valid City food sanitation certificate, and no valid certificate posted (priority foundation). Manager must designate a person in charge during all hours and post the certificate.

headline: Unlabeled to-go muffins; expired allergen training
summary: Passed re-inspection. To-go muffins were unlabeled; they must carry trace-back and allergen labels. The manager on duty had expired allergen training; all certified managers must complete it and keep records on site.

headline: No written health policy or training proof
summary: Pass with conditions. No written employee health policy (priority), no food handler training proof, and no allergen training proof for certified managers. Also: no handwashing signs; no drying racks in dish area.

headline: Temperature violations; sinks lacked supplies
summary: Pass with conditions. Hot food held too cool (chicken 99.5F, samosas 110.7F; must be 135F+) and cold food too warm (chickpeas 54.9F, potatoes 59.9F, stored on floor). All discarded. Soap and towels were missing at prep sinks, now provided.

headline: Failed: food on floor, no thermometers
summary: Failed. No thermometers in rear prep cold holding units; food stored on floor; handlers without hair restraints; wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces; food debris on floors; expired food handler certificates; no sanitizer test kit (citation issued).

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager with original City certificate on site while open (priority; citation issued). A certified manager must be present whenever open. Also: clutter under basement stairs; no allergen certificate for managers.

headline: No certified food manager on arrival
summary: Pass with conditions. No food manager with City certificate on site on arrival (priority; citation issued). Manager told to ensure a certified food manager is on site at all times. Stained dining room ceiling tiles must be replaced.

headline: Rat droppings, live roaches, food safety failures
summary: Failed. 100+ rat droppings, live and dead roaches found in kitchen and basement; pest service recommended. Also: bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food, cold food above 41F (discarded), handsinks not hot enough, backed-up three-compartment sink, missing health policy and training.

headline: Food on slicer; expired allergen certificates
summary: Passed. Food encrusted on the meat slicer in prep area must be cleaned and sanitized. Plates in prep area face up and must be stored inverted. Expired and missing allergen training certificates for certified food managers must be provided.

headline: No proper handwashing sinks; failed
summary: Failed. No exposed handwashing sink in dishwashing area, and two portable handwashing sinks in serving lines had no variance on file. Both must be replaced with fixed sinks. Also: no covered receptacles or working ventilation in both restrooms.

headline: Leaking faucet; dirty floors throughout
summary: Passed. Interior of basement walk-in cooler must be cleaned. Leak at the three-compartment sink faucet must be repaired. Floors throughout first floor and basement need cleaning, especially along walls and corners.

headline: Failed: no vomit kit, no handsink in washroom
summary: Failed. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies, and no handwashing sink in rear washroom (priority). Northside door has gap; broken floor tiles; ceiling opening; burnt-out bulbs; washroom ventilation not working.

headline: Stained cutting boards with open seams
summary: Passed. Cutting boards in prep areas had open seams and dark stains. They must be refinished or replaced.

headline: Foil trays reused; greasy floors
summary: Passed re-inspection. Used aluminum foil trays stored under the three-compartment sink and reused for food in freezer; manager told not to reuse them. Grease buildup on floors and baseboards behind cooking equipment must be cleaned.

headline: Dead insects in light shield; backflow needed
summary: Passed re-inspection. Dead insects were found inside a light shield above the kitchen prep area; it must be cleaned and missing shields replaced. A backflow device is required for the mop sink faucet.

headline: No certified manager on site, certificate not posted
summary: Pass with conditions. No person in charge with valid City sanitation certificate; no certified manager on site or posted certificate while time/temperature-controlled food was prepared (priority; citation issued). Spoon handle left in ceviche container.

headline: No prep handsink; dirty ice machine; failed
summary: Failed. No handwashing sink in front prep areas; inspector recommends one at each end of the ice cream and waffle lines. Ice machine interior not clean. Blue wiping cloths left on counters and freezer doors. Toilet room door lacks a self-closer.

headline: Screen door not proofed; food in coffee cans
summary: Passed. Rear screen door not insect- or rodent-proof. Food stored in used coffee containers in chest freezer; wiping cloths and tongs improperly stored; leaking sink knob; unlidded toilet room trash; mops not hung; dirty floors.

headline: Cleaning needed for equipment and floors
summary: Passed. Instructed to clean prep tables, fryer and cooking equipment exteriors, shelves inside refrigerators, floors under and behind equipment, standing water under the dish machine, and washroom ceiling vents with light dust.

headline: Food on floor; collapsed ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. Pots of food stored on the walk-in cooler floor must be raised 6 inches. Also: grease and food debris on cooking equipment, cardboard shelf liners, no covered toilet-room trash can, collapsed water-damaged ceiling tiles, dirty floors.

headline: Bare-hand contact with toast; warm cold food
summary: Pass with conditions. Food handler removed French toast with bare hands (discarded; citation issued); barrier required. Cold-held foods at 48.0-72.3F discarded. Gloves not used for ready-to-eat food. Damaged floor tiles and ceiling in rear prep.

headline: Failed: food unprotected from customers, pest gap
summary: Failed. Priority: no barriers stopping customers from touching food in hot and cold holding units or rear prep area. Other issues: rear door gap, no ice machine backflow device, open grease lid, no allergen training proof, floor repairs.

headline: Ice bin needed cleaning; re-inspection passed
summary: Re-inspection passed. The interior of the ice bin was dirty. Ice was to be removed, the bin cleaned, and kept clean at all times.

headline: Onions under soiled bags; rice on floor
summary: Passed re-inspection. Sliced onions covered with soiled paper bags; ice scoop left in ice; plates and bowls not inverted; raw wood shelving; black buildup in ice machine; rice on floor in dry storage. All to be corrected.

headline: Torn gasket and leaking faucet
summary: Passed. Torn rubber gasket on a two-door refrigerator and a leaking faucet at the three-compartment sink. Both must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Splash guard missing; hood and faucet issues
summary: Passed. No splash guard at handsink beside meat slicer; leaking faucet neck on three-compartment sink; ventilation hood by prep handsink and unisex toilet room inoperable. All to be repaired. Dried debris on blender also to be cleaned.

headline: No allergen certificate on site
summary: Passed re-inspection. No allergen training certificate on site. Staff were instructed to obtain one and keep it on site.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink
summary: Passed. A leak at the three-compartment sink was found. It must be repaired and maintained.

headline: Gasket buildup; wall outlet covers missing
summary: Passed re-inspection. Buildup on sliding cooler door gaskets; food debris and residue on walls and floor in rear prep. Missing wall outlet covers and gaps around kitchen windowsill must be repaired and sealed to prevent pests.

headline: No person in charge; no certified manager
summary: Pass with conditions. No person in charge present, and no City-certified food manager while time/temperature-control food was prepared (citation issued). Also: no hair restraints, missing thermometer and handwashing signs, grease, freezer ice, and floor repairs needed.

headline: Greasy fryers and leaking dishwasher pipe
summary: Passed. Grease and small food debris in deep fryer openings, which can attract pests. Cooking equipment sides greasy; leak at pipe behind dishwasher; dirt and clutter in rear dry storage and electrical room. All to be cleaned or repaired.

headline: Clutter and scrap wood by refuse area
summary: Passed. Large unused equipment and scrap wood or materials along the wall of the enclosed refuse area. Instructed to remove all clutter to prevent pest harborage.

headline: No written employee health policy
summary: Pass with conditions. No written employee health policy on premises (priority foundation; no citation). Management must keep a signed health policy on site for each employee.

headline: Failed: door gap, crates, repeat violations
summary: Failed. Front door gap; crates used for food storage; heavy grease in deli, taqueria, and cooking areas; crates piled outside. Repeat violations: low hot water, unlabeled shakers, food on floor in meat cooler, no ice machine backflow device (citation issued).

headline: Shelving, floors, and hood need cleaning
summary: Passed re-inspection. Non-food shelving, cooler and hot-holding cabinet interiors, floors throughout, and hood filters need detail cleaning. Unnecessary items in storage areas must be removed to eliminate rodent harborage.

headline: Pest control records missing after May 2025
summary: Failed. Pest control log showed reports only through 04/24/2025 and 05/29/2025; no service records after that. Log must include service tickets and the company's state health license number (priority).

headline: Potatoes too cool; long hair; cloth towels
summary: Pass with conditions. Three lbs cooked potatoes at 62.4F in a steam table that was off (priority; discarded, $10). Open employee cups in food prep; food handlers with long hair and beards without restraints; cloth towels used in dish area.

headline: Door gap; beard without guard
summary: Passed. The front entrance door has a quarter-inch gap at the bottom and must be made rodent-proof and tight-fitting. A male food handler with a beard lacked a beard guard.

headline: Rear door gap; leaking ice maker pipes
summary: Passed. Rear north door has quarter-inch gap at bottom and must be tight to prevent pest entry. Water leaking from pipes under ice maker; ceiling vent covers dusty; one certified manager lacks allergen training certificate.

headline: Grime under equipment and in rear storage
summary: Passed. Grime and debris on the floor under equipment and shelves, and in the rear storage area. Instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Dishwasher failed sanitizing; repaired on site
summary: Low-temperature dishwasher failed to sanitize (0 ppm chlorine); repaired on site, now 100 ppm. Food stored on floors in walk-in cooler and freezer; cardboard and foil shelf liners; food debris buildup; basement clutter; missing light shields.

headline: Cardboard liners; greasy equipment; dirty floors
summary: Passed. Cardboard used as shelf liner in rear and front food areas; greasy cooking and non-cooking equipment; food debris inside coolers and reach-in freezers; dirty floors and walls; soiled dishes left overnight. All to be cleaned and removed.

headline: Debris under reach-in cooler unit
summary: Passed. Dirt and food debris built up under and around the lower three-door reach-in cooler. It must be pulled from the wall, cleaned, and maintained to prevent pests.

headline: Mold inside ice machine dripping onto ice
summary: Failed. Black and pink mold-like buildup inside ice machine was dripping onto ice used for drinks. The person in charge had to discard the ice and clean and sanitize the machine (priority; citation issued).

headline: Staff hair not restrained; containers improperly stored
summary: Passed. Some food handlers did not restrain their hair effectively, with hair hanging down the sides. Containers were not stored upside down as required.

headline: Spills and debris behind prep table
summary: Passed. Floors behind the prep table and walls in the rear prep area must be cleaned to remove spills and debris.

headline: Cold foods too warm; some discarded on site
summary: Passed with conditions. Cold food held at 49.8 to 56.7°F, above the 41°F limit; the manager discarded about 24 lbs ($109) on site and a citation was issued. A banquet-prep cooler at 50.7°F was tagged and held.

headline: Bar sink tagged out; cooler door won't close
summary: Passed with conditions. The bar three-compartment sink drains onto the floor and pools water; it is tagged and must not be used until fixed. A prep cooler door stays shut only with a rag. Milk crates are used as shelving.

headline: Unlabeled bulk ingredients; scoops stored in containers
summary: Passed. The restroom lacked handwashing signage. Bulk ingredients in the rear prep area were not labeled. Scoops were stored inside bulk containers. Aluminum foil is used as a surface, and a restroom handsink is loose from the wall.

headline: Insect carcasses in light shields; minor upkeep issues
summary: Passed. Insect carcasses found in light shields in the rear prep area; the manager was told to remove them. A staff toilet handle is broken, and floors and the staff toilet need cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled bulk container; damaged floors and baseboards
summary: Passed. A bulk container in the bakery was not labeled. Single-service items were not inverted in prep. Damaged floor tiles and loose or missing baseboards need repair, and debris was found in floor drains.

headline: Sinks blocked or leaking; cold food too warm
summary: Failed. Two handwashing sinks were unusable, one leaking onto the prep floor and one clogged. Cooked beans at 52°F and beef at 46.6°F were held too warm and discarded. Some food held over 24 hours lacked discard dates; citations issued.

headline: No preparation sink; missing manager allergen training
summary: Passed. No preparation or dump sink is on site; one with hot and cold water must be provided. The city-certified manager lacks allergen training certification and must obtain it.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; no allergen training proof
summary: Passed. Torn door gaskets on the bakery reach-in cooler must be replaced. The bakery oven and freezer are dirty with food debris. Unused items stored on the rear patio and under the stairwell must be removed to prevent pest harboring.

headline: Passed; some food handler certificates expired
summary: Passed. Some food handlers' training certificates have expired; the manager must renew them. Basement three-compartment sink is missing stoppers, and the basement women's restroom needs a covered trash can.

headline: Slow-draining bar sink; dirty outdoor trash enclosure
summary: Passed. The front bar handwashing sink drains slowly and is in poor repair, though it still works. The outdoor waste enclosure is mildly soiled with debris and recyclables and must be cleaned regularly.

headline: Pet dog in facility; customer asked to leave
summary: Passed with conditions. A non-service pet dog was in the facility and climbed onto a couch with a customer. Staff asked the customer to leave with the dog before the inspection ended; citation issued.

headline: Live roaches found; no hand soap at sink
summary: Failed. Three live small roaches found on walls in prep, dishwashing, and food storage areas; additional pest control needed; citation issued. A handwashing sink lacked soap and paper towels, supplied on request. Onions were stored on the floor.

headline: Ice in meat department handwashing sink
summary: Passed. Ice cubes were in the basin of the meat department handwashing sink. Staff were told to clean it and use handwashing sinks only for handwashing.

headline: One of two employees has expired food handler card
summary: Passed. One of two food employees had an expired food handler card. Staff must complete training and keep records on site. A three-compartment sink faucet leaks and drains slowly, and a dish machine gauge is hard to read.

headline: No sanitation certificate posted; training certificates missing
summary: Passed with conditions. No City of Chicago sanitation certificate was posted; citation issued. Several food handlers lacked training certificates, a repeat violation. A half-inch gap at the rear exit door must be sealed. Leaks and greasy surfaces were noted.

headline: Cheese held at 50°F; overflowing dumpsters
summary: Failed. Cheeses at 50°F inside the wine cooler, above the 41°F limit; citation issued. Outdoor dumpsters overflowed so lids could not close; citation issued. Prepackaged fruit lacked facility label; no covered trash in employee washroom.

headline: Unsafe cold temps and slimy ice machine
summary: Failed. Black and pink slime was dripping from the ice machine onto ice for customers; citation issued. Shredded lettuce was at 52.8°F and a refrigerator at 48°F; food was discarded, and missing allergen labels led to removal of food from self-service.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; personal items above prep
summary: Passed. A standup one-door cooler in the rear prep kitchen is missing a thermometer. Employee personal items were stored on a shelf above food prep tables and must be removed.

headline: Hot water inadequate at handwash and dish sinks
summary: Failed. Hot water reached only 99°F, then dropped to 77°F, at the handwashing and three-compartment sinks. Required temperatures are 100°F and 110°F; priority violation. An unsecured refrigerator and a minor leak were also noted.

headline: 20 fruit flies; no pest control log on file
summary: Failed. About 20 fruit flies found on walls in rear prep areas; citation issued. The pest control operator must be notified. No current pest control log was on premises; citation issued. Basement ice machine piping must be relocated or covered.

headline: Manager lacks required allergen training certificate
summary: Passed on re-inspection. The sanitation manager on duty did not have the required allergen training certificate and was instructed to obtain it.

headline: Packaged foods lacked manufacturer address labels
summary: Passed. Caesar salad and yogurt parfait made at a separate licensed facility lacked labels with the original manufacturer's street address. The facility was told to add the address and maintain the labels.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate on site; citation issued
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid City of Chicago sanitation certificate was on site. The person in charge was told a valid certificate and a certified food manager must be on site at all times; citation issued.

headline: 15 live small flies; ice machine buildup
summary: Failed. Ten live small flies were on the bar wall and five at the dishwashing area. They must be removed by reinspection, and pest control was advised. Ice machine, prep cooler, and floor buildup must be cleaned.

headline: Missing handwashing signs and cooler thermometers
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Handwashing signs are missing at sinks throughout the kitchen and washrooms. Several coolers lack internal thermometers. A single-use plastic bowl was used as a flour scoop and must be replaced. Oven surfaces are greasy.

headline: Ice machine lacks required backflow device
summary: Passed on re-inspection. The ice machine in the rear prep area has no backflow preventer, a device that stops water from flowing backward. It must be installed so it can be serviced.

headline: Inspection summary not posted; citation issued
summary: Passed with conditions. The most recent inspection summary report was not posted for public view. The facility must post it at all times; citation issued.

headline: No signed health policies; many upkeep issues
summary: Passed with conditions. No signed employee health policies were on file and must be provided. Grease and food debris on floors, including the walk-in cooler and freezer, must be cleaned. Many repairs are needed, including gaskets, cutting boards, and lights.

headline: Cardboard liner, rusty shelving; no allergen training proof
summary: Passed. Cardboard was used as a liner in the rear food storage area and must be removed. Rusty storage shelving must be repainted or replaced. Dirt and debris are on the furnace room floor. No allergen training certificates were provided.

headline: No handwashing sink in dish area; expired training
summary: Failed. The dishwashing area has no handwashing sink because one was removed; citation issued. Food handler and allergen training were expired. A food handler lacked a hair restraint, and cooked rice was dispensed with a small plastic container.

headline: Clean utensils near handsink; duct-taped blenders
summary: Passed. Clean utensils were stored near the kitchen handsink and must be moved, with splash guards installed. Paper towels must be reachable at the handsink. Blenders were repaired with duct tape and must be replaced. Ceiling tiles are water-damaged.

headline: No proof of food handler training; dirty cutting board
summary: Passed. No proof of food handler training was on site. No proof of allergen training was provided by the certified food manager. A cutting board with deep grooves and stains must be replaced, and the women's restroom needs a covered trash can.

headline: Ice buildup in freezers; washroom trash lid missing
summary: Passed. Ice buildup in the front reach-in freezer and walk-in freezer must be defrosted. The front pop coolers need cleaning on the bottom shelf. The washroom garbage can is missing its lid.

headline: Ice machine buildup; cooler missing thermometer
summary: Passed. Slight buildup was found inside the upper ice machine and must be cleaned. The one-door water and drink cooler has no thermometer and must be provided with a working one.

headline: Grease and dust buildup; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. Floor drains, deep fryer areas, and beverage areas need detail cleaning to prevent possible pests. A ceiling vent has dust buildup. The certified food manager had no allergen training certificate on site.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; residue in cooler gaskets
summary: Passed. Bulk containers lacked common-name labels. Residue was found on the ice machine door and in prep cooler gaskets. The person in charge was told to clean and maintain these.

headline: Freezer ice buildup; utility room clutter
summary: Passed. Ice had built up inside a chest freezer and must be cleared. The utility room was cluttered with chairs and containers and must be kept organized.

headline: Stained cutting boards and foil liners
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Cutting boards in the rear prep area have open seams and dark stains and must be refinished or replaced. Aluminum foil used as a liner on prep equipment must be removed. The high-temperature dish machine is missing its data plate.

headline: Uncovered ice; wet cloths and racks on floor
summary: Passed. Dish racks were stored on the floor in the dishwashing area and must be raised. Ice in the bar ice bin was uncovered. Wet wiping cloths were left on prep area counters and must be stored in sanitizing solution.

headline: No certified manager on duty; expired training
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on duty until 12:20 p.m. while milk and samosas were handled; citation issued. No vomit and diarrhea clean-up procedure was provided. Food handler and allergen training were expired.

headline: Shellfish tags lack required dates; citation issued
summary: Passed with conditions. Shellfish tags lacked the date the last shellfish from each container was sold or served; citation issued in March 2025. A gap at the rear exit door must be sealed, and floor drains need cleaning.

headline: Rodent activity found; handwashing not done
summary: Failed. Rodent activity noted: 80 under the deli handwashing sink and 60 along a rear storage wall; citation issued. Food handlers touched food and gloves without washing hands; citation issued. Floors had rodent droppings.

headline: Food handlers not wearing hair restraints
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints, and the facility must provide them.

headline: Dusty floors in storage and trash areas
summary: Passed. Loose debris, dirt, and dust were on floors in the rear storage area, trash compactor area, and mop sink area. Staff were told to clean these floors more often.

headline: Unclean ice bin; deeply cut cutting boards
summary: Passed on re-inspection. The basement ice bin interior was not clean and must be emptied, cleaned, and sanitized. Cutting boards in the front prep area, bar, and kitchen have deep cuts and stains and must be restored or replaced.

headline: Holes in ceiling repaired with steel wool and tape
summary: Passed. Cardboard is used as shelf lining in the front water and soda refrigerator and must be replaced with a smooth, cleanable liner. A cook line cutting board has deep cuts and stains. Ceiling holes were repaired with steel wool and tape.

headline: No certified food manager during food prep
summary: Passed with conditions. The person in charge had no City of Chicago sanitation certificate, and no certified food manager was on site while food was prepared and served; citation issued. Ice machine had pink mold-like buildup. Food handler certificates were incomplete.

headline: Dust buildup, burnt-out lights, fryer placement
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Excess dust is on upper walls, ceilings, and vents. Burnt-out lights in the rear prep area must be replaced. A table-top fryer must be placed under the ventilation hood in the front prep area.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; unlabeled sugar
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Milk crates are used as shelving in rear prep and dishwashing areas and must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor. Sugar was stored without a label, and the ice machine interior needs cleaning.

headline: No training certificates on site; clutter in storage
summary: Passed on re-inspection. No food handler training certificates were on site, and no allergen training certificates were provided for certified managers. Unused and nonworking equipment must be removed from the basement and storage.

headline: Ice scoop stored on ice; loose faucet handle
summary: Passed on re-inspection. An ice scoop was stored on top of ice in the ice machine. A storage bin for the scoop must be provided. The hot water handle at the women's restroom handsink was loose and must be repaired.

headline: Person in charge lacks certificate; citation issued
summary: Passed with conditions. The person in charge had no City of Chicago food service manager certificate; citation issued. Food handlers and managers must obtain required training. Floors near the ice machine and soda dispenser need cleaning.

headline: Nine live cockroaches behind rear cooler
summary: Failed. Nine live cockroaches found behind a double-door cooler in the rear prep area; citation issued and pest control service recommended. Ice machine chute had mold-like buildup that must be cleaned.

headline: Buildup inside cold-holding units
summary: Passed. Buildup was found inside cold-holding units. The person in charge was told to clean them.

headline: Failed; about 100 mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. About 100 or more mouse droppings found on floors, along walls, and near cooking equipment, coolers, and the toilet room, plus a few live small flies. Citation issued; pest control service recommended.

headline: Pooling water, cardboard liners, many upkeep repairs
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Several items must be fixed, including a soiled linen container lid, missing ice bin lids, and cardboard shelf liners. Basement floors have pooling water, and stored items must be raised off the floor to prevent pest harboring.

headline: Two of three employees lack food handler training
summary: Passed. Two of three employees did not have food handler training. All employees must complete it and keep records on site at all times.

headline: About 50 dead flies under light; handwashing signs needed
summary: Passed. About 50 or more dead large flies were found under an insect light in the rear compactor area. Staff were told to clean and sanitize. Handwashing signs are also needed in customer and employee toilet rooms.

headline: Unsafe hot and cold food temps; dead mouse found
summary: Passed with conditions. Hot and cold food was held at unsafe temperatures; about $550 of food was discarded, and a display cooler was tagged. A dead mouse was found on a glue trap, and dead flies were on adhesive traps. Upkeep issues also noted.

headline: Cardboard on shelves; grease and cleaning issues
summary: Passed. Cardboard was found on storage shelves and must be removed. A large can opener needs detail cleaning, reach-in cabinet interiors need cleaning, and floors in the rear grease container area need detail cleaning.

headline: Missing paper towels; butcher lacks food handler training
summary: Passed with conditions. Handwashing sinks lacked paper towels; they were supplied during inspection and a citation was issued. The butcher had no food handler training. A quarter-inch gap is at the rear double door, and the ice machine drains into a sink.

headline: Milk crates used for storage; grease and broken floor
summary: Passed. Milk crates must not be used to elevate stored items. A hot holding unit is missing plastic handles. Grease is on the floor under cooking equipment, and a wall panel and floor under the deep fryer need repair.

headline: Missing soap and towels; cold chicken discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. Handwashing sinks lacked soap and paper towels; both were supplied during inspection. A restroom sink ran at 72°F, later fixed to 102 to 105°F. Chicken at 47.8°F was discarded; citation issued.

headline: 40 live small flies in dish and prep areas
summary: Failed. About 40 live small flies were found in the dishwashing and prep areas. They must be removed by reinspection, and pest control service was advised. Standing water on the floor around the dishwashing area must be cleared.

headline: Rust in cooler; damaged gasket; greasy equipment
summary: Passed. Heavy rust is inside a two-door reach-in cooler, and its door gasket is damaged. Shelving, prep table bottoms, and cooking equipment sides need detail cleaning. Floors in several areas need cleaning, and a handsink faucet is loose.

headline: Food debris throughout deli; several leaks
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs are missing at staff sinks. Food debris and excess water were found on floors and equipment in deli, meat, and produce areas. A prep sink sprayer, a backflow device, and a restroom toilet are leaking.

headline: Restroom door needs self-closing device
summary: Passed on re-inspection. The employee toilet room next to the prep kitchen must have a self-closing device installed.

headline: No certified manager on duty during food service
summary: Passed with conditions. The person in charge lacked a certified food manager certificate. No certified manager was on duty while Italian beef, cooked ground beef, and cheese sauce were prepared and served; citation issued.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; dirty ice machine
summary: Passed. Handwashing signs are missing in three restrooms, including the private events area. The main bar ice machine interior was not clean and must be cleaned and sanitized. A private events women's restroom needs a covered trash can.

headline: No food handler training; grime and leaking faucet
summary: Passed. No food handler training was provided, and staff were told to get it. The three-compartment faucet leaks continuously. Heavy food grime was found on cooking equipment, walls, and floors. The dishwash area lacks handwashing signage.

headline: Three-compartment sink backed up; grease trap leaking
summary: Passed with conditions. The three-compartment sink backed up into other compartments, and the grease trap leaked heavily. A technician repaired the grease trap during inspection; citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; greasy floors and equipment
summary: Passed. Bulk containers in the rear lacked labels. Aluminum foil was used as a shelf above the stove and must be removed. Prep tables, fryers, and floors with grease and dried food need detail cleaning.

headline: No health policy; no training proof on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No written employee health policy was on premises; citation issued. No proof of food handler training was on site. One employee was working without a hair restraint. Food was stored in grocery bags in freezers.

headline: No proof of manager allergen training
summary: Passed. No proof of allergen training was on site for certified food managers, and it must be provided. A kitchen cutting board has deep cuts and stains and must be restored or replaced.

headline: No test strips; staff missing hair restraints
summary: Failed. Food handlers were working without hair restraints or beard guards. No chemical test strips were on site to check sanitizer for the dish machine and three-compartment sink; citation issued.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; over 20 small flies
summary: Failed. Dish machine sanitizer read 0 ppm, and the machine was tagged out; citation issued. More than 20 small flies found in the dining room and kitchen; citation issued. Previous violations were not corrected, and waste water backs up at the sink.

headline: Food and dirt buildup behind cooking equipment
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Accumulated food and dirt was found between the wall and cooking equipment and under shelves in the food prep area. All of it must be cleaned.

headline: Over 100 rat droppings; no food handler training
summary: Failed. Over 100 rat droppings found in front and rear basement storage areas; citation issued and an exterminator was requested. A quarter-inch gap under an outside cooler door, food on the floor, and no food handler training were also noted.

headline: Front door not rodent-proof; overflowing dumpsters
summary: Failed. The front entrance door has a half-inch gap at the bottom and is not rodent-proof. Outdoor dumpsters overflowed and kept lids from closing; citation issued. A prep cooler thermometer is missing, and walls and a ceiling tile need repair.

headline: Pastry staff without hair restraints; sink fixed
summary: Passed. Pastry kitchen employees were working without hair restraints and must be provided them. A slow-draining handwashing sink in the banquet dish area was fixed by the manager during inspection.

headline: No certified manager; hair restraints not worn
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while rice and noodles were handled. Food handlers lacked hair restraints. Employee drink cups were stored above prep tables, and deli cups were used as scoops in bulk containers.

headline: Over 60 small flies; unsafe food temperatures discarded
summary: Failed. Over 60 small flies found in the kitchen, including inside food containers; citation issued. Hot food at 91 to 130°F and raw beef at 47 to 50°F were discarded. A handwashing sink was blocked by a shelf and lacked soap; both were corrected on site.

headline: No certified manager; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on site. Dish machine sanitizing at 0 ppm was tagged and must not be used until rechecked. Hot water missing at some handwashing sinks. No food handler training for employees. Multiple cleaning and upkeep issues.

headline: No certified food manager; no food handler certificates
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager was on site while deli and pizza food was handled and served; priority violation. Kitchen staff had no food handler certificate. No sanitizer test strips were on site, and bulk containers were not labeled.

headline: Minor leak under three-compartment sink
summary: Passed. A minor leak was found under the three-compartment sink in the rear retail food prep area and must be repaired.

headline: Mouse droppings found; ice machine slime
summary: Failed. About 40 mouse droppings found in a doughnut display case and rear storage; citation issued and pest control needed. Ice machine slime was dripping onto ice; citation issued. No metal stem thermometer on site for deliveries.

headline: Loose soap dispenser; beer tap leak
summary: Passed. The soap dispenser at the exposed handwashing sink on the main cook line is loose and must be repaired. A leak from beer taps in the private event room bar left a puddle on the floor.

headline: Over 40 small flies; no manager certificate posted
summary: Failed. More than 40 small flies were found throughout the facility; citation issued. No city food manager certificate was posted, and an unlabeled chemical bottle was labeled on site. Ice and soda dispensers had heavy buildup.

headline: Manager certificate missing at inspection; corrected on site
summary: Passed with conditions. No valid original certified food manager certificate was posted during inspection. The owner provided a valid certificate before the inspection ended.

headline: Holes in floors and walls; no allergen training
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Wet wiping cloths were left on prep surfaces. Cutting boards are stained and deeply cut, and coffee cooler shelves are rusted. Holes around sink pipes and a leak-stained wall and ceiling need repair. No allergen training was provided.

headline: Greasy fryers and hood; stained cutting board
summary: Passed. Lower shelving under the cook line needs detail cleaning. A front-area cutting board has stains and deep grooves and must be replaced. Walk-in floors need cleaning, and fryers and the hood system have grease buildup.

headline: Previous rodent violation not corrected; citation
summary: Failed. A January 2024 rodent violation, with 300 mouse droppings, was not corrected; citation issued. Droppings were seen again in the rear storage area and must be removed. Greasy equipment and unused freezers also need attention.

headline: Person in charge lacks certificate; citation issued
summary: Passed with conditions. The person in charge had no City of Chicago food service manager certificate; citation issued. A leak under the first sink compartment, greasy fryers, a walk-in cooler odor, and cracked floor tile also need attention.

headline: Unlabeled dry ingredient containers in kitchen
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Dry ingredients in kitchen food storage containers were not labeled. The facility must label items removed from original containers with their common name.

headline: Food residue in cold-hold units; wall hole
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Spills and food residue were found inside cold-holding units and must be cleaned. A hole in the wall of the storage room where mops are kept must be closed and made smooth.

headline: Managers lack allergen awareness training certificates
summary: Passed. Several certified food service managers lacked allergen awareness training certificates. The person in charge was told to make sure they obtain them and keep certificates on site.

headline: Broken handsink fixed on site; cleaning issues
summary: Passed with conditions. The seafood and meat handsink had no drain trap connected; a plumber fixed it during inspection and the sink may be used again; citation issued. Some meat-case thermometers are missing or broken, and deli equipment is greasy.

headline: Beef and tomatoes held too warm; discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. About 5 lbs of beef and tomatoes were held at 52 to 57°F, above the 41°F limit. The manager voluntarily discarded them for $25; citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; missing salsa thermometer
summary: Passed. Bulk containers in the rear lacked labels. The small salsa refrigerator has no thermometer. Food from an open can must move to a food-grade container.

headline: Cutting boards worn; outdoor clutter and charcoal
summary: Passed. Kitchen cutting boards have deep cuts and stains. About 10 crates of used charcoal sat on the ground near the dumpster. Outdoor clutter must be removed; unused cooler and ice machine must be repaired or removed.

headline: Peeling paint and debris in walk-in cooler
summary: Passed re-inspection. Chipped and peeling paint on rear prep area walls must be replaced with smooth, cleanable surfaces. Dried food debris on floors in the beverage/produce walk-in cooler must be removed and sanitized.

headline: Failed: no handwashing sink and no certificates
summary: Failed. No handwashing sink at the front coffee prep area, and no certified food manager certificate posted. No food handler certificates, pest control log, or sanitizer test strips were present. Women's restroom lacks a covered trash receptacle.

headline: Failed: blocked handsinks; prior violations not fixed
summary: Failed. Two handwashing sinks were blocked and cleared on site; a missing soap dispenser was installed on site. Prior core violations for unlabeled bulk containers and missing allergen training were not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Freezer gasket, ceiling tiles, and light repairs
summary: Passed re-inspection. A freezer gasket does not fit and causes condensation. Broken and loose ceiling tiles in back storage might allow pests in. Also: hole under dining window; missing light bulb and shield over serving area.

headline: Restroom and allergen training gaps found
summary: Passed. Inspector found no covered waste receptacle for sanitary napkins in the all-gender restroom, a restroom door that does not self-close, and a certified manager lacking proof of allergen training. Instructed to correct.

headline: No employee health policy; allergen training missing
summary: Passed with conditions. No written employee health policy; citation issued. Bar hand sink lacked signage. Encrusted grease and debris under the fryer and on the floor need deep cleaning. No proof of allergen training for certified managers.

headline: Failed: bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food
summary: Failed. Food handlers touched ready-to-eat tortillas, onions, and cilantro with bare hands while making tacos. Over 100 mouse droppings were found in several areas. Dish machine read 0 ppm, tagged out. Women's restroom handsink had no hot water.

headline: Failed: no current pest control log
summary: Failed. No pest control log showed licensed pest service within 12 months; the latest on-site report was from 2019. The person in charge must obtain service and keep logs on site. Citation issued.

headline: Utility sink leak; food handler training required
summary: Passed re-inspection. A valve connected to the utility sink faucet leaks and must be repaired. Floors and drains around and under equipment and sinks need cleaning. All food handlers must have food handler training.

headline: Failed: equipment stored under sewer lines
summary: Failed. Multi-use equipment stored in mechanical room and under sewer lines must be moved. Rinse temperature gauge is broken on rear warewashing unit, not in use. Also: plastic lining on a warewashing unit; tape hanging from a vent.

headline: Torn cooler gasket and greasy ovens
summary: Passed re-inspection. A rear prep cooler has a torn gasket that must be repaired or replaced. Heavy grease on the exterior of ovens in the rear prep area needs cleaning.

headline: Failed: uncorrected prior violations; leaks and rust
summary: Failed. Previous core violations from October 2024 were not corrected; citation issued. Other issues: leaking faucets and a drainpipe at three-compartment sinks, rust on walk-in shelving, stained ceiling tiles, holes in walls and ceiling, and a damaged cooler gasket.

headline: Failed: over 100 mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. Over 100 mouse droppings were found on serving area shelves, hot-holding unit bottoms, floors, and storage equipment; an exterminator and cleanup were ordered; citation issued. Also: unlabeled bulk containers, a missing dumpster lid, and grease buildup.

headline: Failed: no manager or person in charge present
summary: Failed. No person in charge was present, and no certified food manager was on duty while sushi was prepared and served. Sushi rice analysis letter or pH test kit was missing; citation issued. Remove cardboard shelf liners.

headline: Grime buildup and a sink handle repair
summary: Passed. Debris and grime on prep-area cooler gaskets and on floors behind all equipment in the rear prep area need cleaning. A hot water mixing handle on the three-compartment sink needs repair. Women's restroom wall has a hole.

headline: Failed: unsafe cold holding; no vomit cleanup supplies
summary: Failed. Ham and sliced vegetables held at 53.4°F in the pizza prep station; 15 lbs discarded. Ham in another pizza prep unit read 52.9°F; discarded, and unit tagged for repair. No vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies on site. Citation issued.

headline: Failed: no kitchen handsink; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: Failed. Kitchen and dish prep areas have no handwashing sink; citation issued. Dish machine sanitizer read 0 ppm; 100 ppm minimum required. Also missing handwashing signs, pink mineral buildup in ice machine, and expired allergen training.

headline: No certified manager on premises; citation issued
summary: Passed with conditions. No city-certified sanitation manager was on premises while chicken, mashed potatoes, and coleslaw were handled; citation issued. Ice machine, iced tea machine, and hot water dispenser lack backflow devices. Food handlers lack certificates.

headline: Grime inside coolers and freezers; passed
summary: Passed. Food debris and grime were found inside cold-holding and freezer units. Also noted: outside debris near garbage, grime behind equipment, water-damaged ceiling tiles, and greasy hood filters. Person in charge was told to clean and repair.

headline: Failed: about 50 mouse droppings; slimy ice machine
summary: Failed. About 50 mouse droppings were found in rear storage and front serving areas. Black slime was dripping from the ice machine into ice; citation issued. Staff washing hands in a three-compartment sink was corrected on site.

headline: Cold foods too warm; cat in storage area
summary: Passed with conditions. Hot dogs at 50.1°F, eggs 55.0°F, milk 60.0°F were too warm in the display cooler; 30 lbs discarded, and the cooler may not be used until reinspected. No certified manager on duty during food prep. A cat in rear storage must be removed.

headline: Missing splashguard and damaged ceiling and floor tiles
summary: Passed. Handsink needs a splashguard. Wiping cloths on prep tables must be kept in sanitizing solution. Backflow device needed at front ice machine. Stained, missing, or broken ceiling and floor tiles need repair.

headline: Faucet runs too briefly; bulk containers unlabeled
summary: Passed. A restroom metered faucet runs less than 15 seconds and must be repaired. Bulk dry food containers lack labels. A walk-in freezer fan blade hits its cover. Soiled walls and floors need cleaning.

headline: Ice machine drain; food handler without certificate
summary: Passed. Ice machine drain hose emptied into a bucket and must route to a floor drain. Rear floors around heavy equipment need cleaning. A food handler had no certificate; all employees must obtain and keep one.

headline: Debris under bar area; passed
summary: Passed. Garbage, debris, and dirt were found under the ground-floor bar area and must be cleaned.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets and missing hood filters
summary: Passed. Basement prep cooler has three torn door gaskets. Upstairs prep handsink leaks slowly. Hood is missing left-side filters. Remove unneeded equipment from the shared basement storage corner.

headline: Hair restraints missing; insect devices over food areas
summary: Passed. Employees were seen without hair restraints, and insect devices were above food prep areas; both were ordered fixed. Also noted: damaged ceiling tiles in the mop room and a walk-in freezer door handle repaired with tape.

headline: Food held too warm; oyster tag violation
summary: Passed with conditions. Beans (45.6°F), cheese (46.8°F), beet hummus (47.9°F), and eggs (48.3°F) were too warm in service coolers; 20 lbs discarded. Prep-area cooler read 47.6°F and must not be used until fixed.

headline: Defrost small refrigerator with heavy ice
summary: Passed re-inspection. A small refrigerator in the front prep and service area has heavy ice buildup and must be defrosted.

headline: Ice buildup, leaks, and unfixed allergen training
summary: Passed with conditions. Found ice buildup in the walk-in freezer, a leaking sink pipe, and ceiling vent leaks from an air-conditioner problem. Prior allergen training violation was not corrected; citation issued. Floors and a washroom door closer need repair.

headline: Cleaning and clutter removal instructed
summary: Passed. Inspector instructed cleaning of refrigerator interiors, food storage shelves, unused prep equipment, and the employee washroom. Floors under equipment on the sales floor and in the unused kitchen need cleaning. Unnecessary items behind refrigeration must be organized or removed.

headline: Failed: live roaches and no dish-area handsink
summary: Failed. About 3 live roaches were found under the three-compartment sink and on the floor, with dead roaches nearby; citation issued. Shellstock tag missing on mussels; about 5 lbs ($45) discarded. Rear dishwashing area has no handwashing sink.

headline: Food handler training required for kitchen staff
summary: Passed. A washroom needs a small lidded garbage can. Kitchen staff must comply with food handler training requirements, or citations will follow.

headline: Coolers running too warm; no food prep lighting
summary: Passed with conditions. Produce cooler (46°F), kitchen prep cooler (45°F), and 4-door meat display cooler (54°F) were too warm; all must stay at 41°F or below. No written employee health policy. Food prep area has no working lighting.

headline: Slicer near handsink; ceiling and debris repairs
summary: Passed. A slicer stored on the counter beside a front prep handsink needs a splash guard. Missing ceiling tile attachments in rear dry storage must be enclosed. Dried food debris under rear storage shelving needs cleaning.

headline: Uncovered food, open drink, and food on floor
summary: Passed. Open employee drink in prep area. Uncovered pickled peppers and bulk salt, and food stored on walk-in floors, must be covered and raised. Plastic cups used to scoop salt. Also: two leaking sinks; allergen training missing.

headline: Minor grease on grease receptacle; passed
summary: Passed. A small amount of grease was on top of the grease receptacle's exterior; it must be cleaned.

headline: Failed: over 100 mouse droppings; no hot water
summary: Failed. Over 100 mouse droppings were scattered across floors, shelves, and storage areas; an exterminator and cleanup were required, and a citation was issued. Women's restroom handsink had no hot water (64.1°F).

headline: Bar dish machine tagged out of use
summary: Passed with conditions. The low-temperature dish machine in the bar is under repair and tagged; it may not be used until repaired and inspected. Dirty sink basins in the second-floor prep area and cracked bar floor tiles need attention.

headline: Moldy ice machine interior; cups used as scoops
summary: Passed with conditions. Ice maker interior had heavy mold-like buildup; manager told to clean and maintain it (priority violation). Also: deli cups were not air-dried after washing, and disposable cups were used as scoops for bulk food.

headline: Rusted storage racks; missing restroom lids
summary: Passed. Rusted storage racks in the kitchen storage area must be cleaned or replaced. Restrooms are missing covered receptacles, which must be provided and maintained.

headline: Raw shrimp held too warm; handwashing supplies missing
summary: Passed with conditions. Five pounds of raw shrimp held at 62.3°F in a prep cooler were discarded; cold foods must stay at 41°F or below. Prep handsink lacked paper towels and the seafood prep area lacked soap. Seafood was improperly thawed.

headline: Food on walk-in floors; allergen certificate missing
summary: Passed. Food containers were stored on the floor of the walk-in cooler and freezer; they must be elevated at least six inches. The food service sanitation manager has no allergen training certificate.

headline: Greasy fryer doors and sink drains
summary: Passed. Grease has built up inside fryer doors, and drains under the three-compartment sink hold debris and grease. Clean both. A mop stored in the utility sink must be positioned to air dry.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; missing food handler certificate
summary: Passed re-inspection. A one-door pizza prep cooler has a torn door gasket that must be replaced. One food handler lacked a food handler certificate; proof of training is required for all handlers.

headline: Failed: about 90 mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. About 90 mouse droppings found, including in the office and dishwashing area; citation issued. No sanitizer was on site, but it was delivered and corrected before inspection ended. Also no test kit and a leaking faucet.

headline: Failed: many uncorrected core violations
summary: Failed. Many core violations from July 2025 were not corrected, including greasy equipment and floors, mold around a deli sink, broken floor and wall tiles, worn cutting boards, crates used for storage, and burnt-out hood lights. Citation issued.

headline: Milk crates used as shelves; several repairs
summary: Passed. Milk crates are used as shelves in two walk-in coolers and should be replaced with raised shelves six inches off the floor. Handsinks need signage and a cold-water pressure repair. Also: seal openings and clean grease, dust, and a floor drain.

headline: Failed: about 30 live flies in prep area
summary: Failed. About 30 large and small live flies were found in the rear prep area and mop sink area. The person in charge was told to contact a licensed pest control company and eliminate the activity. A citation was issued.

headline: Unlabeled rice; uncorrected clutter violation
summary: Passed with conditions. Bulk rice containers lacked labels. An old violation from 2023 was not corrected: unused equipment and articles remain in the front prep area, and a non-working cooler is used for storage; citation issued.

headline: Failed: ice machine buildup; repeat violations
summary: Failed. Ice machine chute had black and orange buildup from a prior priority violation, not corrected. Core violations from 2023 remain: greasy equipment and floors, peeling paint, water-stained ceiling tiles, and expired allergen training for the manager. Citation issued.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; door gap; dusty vents
summary: Passed. Unisex washrooms lacked handwashing signs. The front entrance door has a gap that must be sealed to prevent rodent entry. Heavy dust on ceiling vents in the rear dishwashing area and washrooms must be cleaned.

headline: Cooler gasket repair and cleaning needed
summary: Passed. Rear reach-in cooler gasket is in poor repair. Clean spills and debris from a freezer shelf and prep cooler. Dust on kitchen and rear prep walls and ceilings needs cleaning.

headline: Passed inspection with no comments noted
summary: Passed. The notes list only a hot and cold water item, with no comments or violations recorded.

headline: No certified manager on site; citation issued
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager was on site while protein shakes, pies, and eggs were handled, and no valid certificate was posted; citation issued. The person in charge also lacks a certificate.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; cold foods too warm
summary: Failed. No certified manager on duty during food prep and service; citation issued. Hot dogs, cheese, and turkey bacon held at 54.1-55.3°F, above 41°F; 9 lbs discarded. No health policy, sanitizer test kit, or food handler training records.

headline: Failed: 75 mouse droppings; no certificates
summary: Failed. 75 or more mouse droppings found in kitchen, storage, and liquor areas, plus a dead mouse in the bar; pest control required, citation issued. No certified manager certificate, health policies, food handler training, or pest log.

headline: Slow handsink drain; food handler certificates needed
summary: Passed. Handsink next to the ice machine needs a smooth, cleanable splashguard. Dried food debris inside a cooler and cold-hold unit must be cleaned. The front prep handsink drains slowly. Food handler certificates must be provided and kept on site.

headline: Failed: no certified manager during cooking
summary: Failed. No certified manager on site while eggs cooked; corrected when manager arrived midway. Employee ate and drank at a prep table. Restroom hot water measured 69.8-72.5°F, below the required 100°F. Citation issued.

headline: Failed: about 100 rodent droppings in basement
summary: Failed. About 100 rodent droppings were found throughout the basement; a citation was issued and more pest control required. Also a broken juicing machine, two non-working hood light bulbs, and one of two managers with expired allergen training.

headline: Food stored on floor; leaking handsink pipe
summary: Passed. Food stored on the walk-in cooler floor must be raised six inches. A handsink by the dish area has a leaking cold water pipe. Also worn cooler gasket, uncovered restroom trash can, water-damaged ceiling tile.

headline: Missing handwash sign; floor and ceiling repairs needed
summary: Passed re-inspection. A handwashing sign is needed at the hand sink. Repairs are needed for damaged floor tiles, including in the walk-in cooler, and a damaged ceiling tile over liquor storage. Floors and wall bases throughout need cleaning.

headline: Debris buildup in dry storage; passed
summary: Passed. Inspector found debris buildup in the dry storage area under shelving, beside the hot water tank, and on equipment sides. The person in charge was told to clean and maintain the area.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; expired certificates found
summary: Passed with conditions. The low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine; it was tagged and corrected on site and is not in use. Food handler certificates were expired for all handlers; an allergen certificate was also expired.

headline: Food stored in grocery bags; no allergen records
summary: Passed. Food stored in grocery bags inside coolers must be moved to food-grade containers. Soiled wiping cloths and a cutting board with deep grooves also need fixing. No allergen training records were on site.

headline: Failed: small flies found throughout facility
summary: Failed. About 10 small flies were seen in the facility. The operator was told to eliminate fly activity and clean affected areas, and a pest control service was recommended. A citation was issued.

headline: No soap at pizza prep handsink; citation issued
summary: Passed with conditions. Pizza prep handsink had no soap (citation issued); an employee restocked it during inspection. Also: rear restroom door is not self-closing, has no light, and the last inspection summary was not posted.

headline: Walk-in cooler needs cleaning and repairs
summary: Passed re-inspection. Walk-in cooler needs crates removed in favor of shelving, missing fan guard covers replaced, and debris cleared from shelving, floors, and wall bases.

headline: Cutting boards damaged; no mop sink; passed
summary: Passed. All cutting boards had deep cuts and stains and must be sanded, resealed, or replaced. No mop sink was on site; one must be installed. Handwashing sink lacks a splash guard next to a cooler; must install or move cooler.

headline: Improper thawing; missing hair restraints and debris
summary: Passed. Foods were thawed improperly in a three-compartment sink and on a cart in sushi prep; thaw under refrigeration or running water. Food employees lacked effective hair restraints. Floors and walls need cleaning.

headline: Cardboard shelf liners; stained ceiling tiles
summary: Passed. Cardboard boxes line shelves above the service prep cooler and must be removed. Stained ceiling tiles above the prep area need cleaning, repainting, or replacing.

headline: Missing cooler thermometers; door gap to fix
summary: Passed re-inspection. Some prep coolers lack thermometers. Containers need common-name labels. A side door gap near toilet rooms must be sealed. Worn cutting boards need repair or replacement, and walk-in floor and wall bases need cleaning.

headline: Failed: 25 live cockroaches and mouse droppings
summary: Failed. About 25 live cockroaches were on kitchen and dry storage walls and ceilings, plus about 10 mouse droppings under the bar sink. Cold food held at 50°F; no certified manager was present when rice was served. Citation issued.

headline: Failed: over 20 rat droppings and live roach
summary: Failed. Over 20 rat droppings were found in the warewashing and storage area, and a live roach in the dining room. Pest control and cleanup required; citation issued. Also: heavy grease and food debris on equipment and floors.

headline: No employee health policy or allergen certificates
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy or training was on site; priority violation issued. No allergen training certificates were provided for certified managers. A leaking cold water handle at the three-compartment sink needs repair.

headline: Failed: moldy ice machine; dead roaches found
summary: Failed. Black, slimy, mold-like substance dripped from the ice machine into ice used for smoothies. Ice must be discarded and machine cleaned. Dead roaches were found on floors between equipment. Prior core violations, including grease buildup and expired allergen training, were not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Failed: live ants and flies; no sanitizer
summary: Failed. About 15-20 live ants were on the floor by dry storage and about 5 live large flies flew around food prep. No employee health policy, vomit cleanup kit, or sanitizer was on site. Two hot and two cold holding units were off.

headline: Hot food below safe temperature; unit tagged
summary: Passed with conditions. Chicken (108.7°F), rice (104.9°F), and mixed vegetables (109°F) fell below the required 135°F; 12 lbs discarded. The hot holding unit is tagged and may not be used until reinspected. Also: missing allergen training for certified managers.

headline: No employee health policy; missing food handler training
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy was on premises; priority violation issued. Employee washroom door lacks a self-closing device. Some floor tile is in poor repair. All food handlers must obtain food handler training.

headline: Utility sink lacks backflow device
summary: Passed re-inspection. The utility sink has no backflow device, and one must be provided.

headline: Leaking sink pipe and broken window; passed
summary: Passed. Three-compartment sink pipe leaks and must be repaired. Second-floor ceiling has missing tiles; a broken window should be replaced to keep out pests. Floors under equipment and along walls, especially in dry storage, need cleaning.

headline: No sink in front prep area
summary: Passed. The front prep area has no sink for food preparation, water, or waste disposal. One sink with hot and cold running water must be provided.

headline: Missing food handler certificates; allergen proof lacking
summary: Passed. Food handler certificates could not be located and must be kept on site. No allergen training proof was on site for city food managers. Also: utensils stored improperly, mops on the floor, and a greasy exhaust hood.

headline: Failed: about 100 mouse droppings in basement
summary: Failed. About 100 mouse droppings were found in basement storage and a utility room, plus a dead mouse. Additional pest control is needed; citation issued. Also grease under cooking equipment and a loose floor tile.

headline: Grease buildup throughout prep area; passed
summary: Passed. Grease buildup on cooking equipment, walls, floors, and shelves in the prep area must be cleaned. Also: wiping cloth left out, torn cooler gasket, worn cutting boards, dirty hood vents.

headline: Gaps and holes need sealing to keep out pests
summary: Passed. Open holes in ceilings and walls, a gap and missing lock on a side door, and a hole under the three-compartment sink must be sealed to prevent pests. Greasy equipment, coolers, and fryers need cleaning.

headline: Missing toilet seat and trash can; hood filters dusty
