summary: Passed. A toilet seat and a garbage can are missing from a first-floor girls' restroom stall and must be replaced. Ice machine chute has minor buildup to clean. Cooking hood filters need dust removed.

headline: No certified manager; cold foods too warm
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified manager was on site while chicken was prepared and served; citation issued. Sour cream (63.2°F) and cheese (63.5°F) were too warm and discarded; a cold unit at 60.8°F is tagged out of use.

headline: Failed: no certified manager or health policy
summary: Failed. Person in charge has no sanitation manager certificate, and none is posted. No employee health policy or pest control log book was present. The sanitation manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Broken liquor room ceiling and walls
summary: Passed re-inspection. Broken ceiling and walls in the basement liquor room must be made smooth and easily cleanable.

headline: Food spills in cooler and beverage equipment
summary: Passed. Food and syrup spills were found inside a salad cooler, beverage dispensing equipment, and a cabinet. They must be removed to prevent pests. Water pools under an unused dishwasher, and dining room floors need cleaning.

headline: No hot water during inspection, restored by end
summary: Passed with conditions. No hot running water was available; sinks measured 79.0-82.0°F, and a citation was issued. Hot water was restored by inspection end (100°F handwash sinks, 120°F 3-compartment sink). Torn freezer gaskets need repair; food handler training is missing.

headline: Failed: cold foods too warm; live flying insects
summary: Failed. Chicken (47°F), ground beef (50°F), sausage (52°F), and ham (53°F) were too warm in the prep cooler. About 20 live small flying insects were on walls, ceiling, and equipment in prep; more pest control needed; citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; drains need cleaning
summary: Passed. A few bulk storage containers were missing labels. Walk-in cooler shelving needs cleaning of spills and debris, and floor drains throughout, especially in the basement, need cleaning.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets and a burnt-out light
summary: Passed re-inspection. Torn gaskets were found in the salad and protein prep coolers on the cook line and must be repaired or replaced. A burnt-out light in the cook-line hood must be replaced. Handwashing sign at the bar dump sink was to be removed.

headline: No certified manager present during food handling
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified sanitation manager was on premises while foods that must stay hot or cold, like chicken and milk, were handled; citation issued. Person in charge lacks a certificate; manager lacks allergen training. Floors need cleaning.

headline: Raw wood shelf over cooking area
summary: Passed. A raw wood shelf over the kitchen cooking area holds to-go containers. The wood must be sealed or painted.

headline: Failed: 150+ rodent droppings throughout liquor storage
summary: Failed. 150 or more small rodent droppings were found across liquor storage and sales areas; pest control recommended; citation issued. Also: no vomit or diarrhea cleanup procedure, floor storage, and walk-in trash.

headline: Failed: rodent gap and repeat violations
summary: Failed. A 1/4-inch gap at the front entrance door sweep must be rodent-proofed. A prep cooler door gasket is ripped and the storage room floor is cluttered. Prior core violations not corrected: ice chute buildup and expired food handler certificates.

headline: Re-inspection passed; wall base and paint
summary: Passed. A loose wall base in the vestibule and a broken concrete floor at the front entry window must be repaired. Chipping paint on the vestibule wall must be scraped smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Passed; hair restraint and cleaning needed
summary: Passed with conditions. A food handler in prep lacked a hair restraint. A cold water knob leaks at the three-compartment sink. Rubber coving is missing. Floor drains, corners, walls and ceiling need cleaning.

headline: Unlabeled beans and rice; floor storage
summary: Re-inspection passed. Beans and rice removed from original containers were unlabeled. Food on the walk-in cooler floor must be raised six inches. The washroom door is not self-closing. The sanitation manager needs allergen training.

headline: Failed: cooler at 46°F; rusted shelving
summary: Failed. A deli top cooler held at 46°F; coolers must be 41°F or below. A freezer chest lid is broken and several coolers have rusted shelving. The manager was instructed to repair or replace them.

headline: Passed; rust, stains, and mop hooks needed
summary: Passed with required cleaning. Remove cardboard and rust from shelves. Repair a worn freezer door gasket and a broken toilet door closer. Replace stained ceiling tiles. Clean food splatter and dust from vents. Provide a hook system for wet mops.

headline: Failed: outdoor storage and slow sink
summary: Failed; citation issued. Pots were stored on the outdoor patio and raw pallets used for elevation. Shelf liner is peeling, the prep handwash sink drains very slowly, and soiled mop heads were not stored inverted. No food handler training proof was provided.

headline: Complaint passed; labels and hair restraints needed
summary: Passed after complaint. Bulk ingredients need labeled containers. All food handlers need hair restraints. Wiping cloths must be kept in sanitizer. Shelves and cabinets need detail cleaning. Carpet in rear storage must be removed or covered.

headline: Burnt bulbs; no food handler certificates
summary: Passed with conditions. No food handler certificates were on site; all employees must train and keep records on site. Also burnt-out bulbs, dusty vents, and unused equipment in rear storage that can harbor pests.

headline: Food debris on prep area floors
summary: Passed. Food debris on the rear food prep area floors must be removed and cleaned.

headline: Spoons held in stagnant water
summary: Passed. In-use spoons were held in a cup of stagnant water. The inspector instructed staff to keep them in a clean, dry container.

headline: Passed; broken thermometers and leaking sink
summary: Passed. Broken air thermometers in several coolers holding hot and cold foods must be replaced. Also a leaking three-compartment sink faucet, missing handwashing signs, dirty cooling units, and a detached wall base.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings; pest control needed
summary: Failed; citation issued. About 40 mouse droppings were found: 20 on the floor under the rear dry storage rack and 20 on the grill's bottom shelf. Manager was told to clean and call pest control. Also dirty ceilings and freezer lids in poor repair.

headline: Failed: missing health policy and pest log
summary: No written employee health policy, no current pest control log, and no proof of food handler training. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door, no dumpster contract, and no splashguard at the dish sink.

headline: Cold foods at 49-51°F; $250 discarded
summary: Pass with conditions; citation issued. Cream cheese, fish eggs, crab meat and tuna held at 48.9-50.1°F in a bar cooler. Manager discarded about 10 lbs ($250). Also a leaking drain pipe and no backflow device on the kitchen utility sink.

headline: Re-inspection passed; gaps and pallets remain
summary: Passed. Gaps at the garbage and storage doors need tight seals. Food and wine boxes must be off the floor. A drain line and leaky faucets need repair. Employees need food handler training.

headline: Cooked food held at room temperature overnight
summary: Cooked rice (68.3°F) and beef stew (67.4°F) sat at room temperature overnight; about $100 of food discarded. Cold foods must stay at 41°F or below. Cooked food in the walk-in cooler lacked discard dates.

headline: Failed: slime in ice machine; ice machine tagged
summary: Failed; citation issued. Pink and black slime inside the ice machine; it was tagged and must not be used until cleaned and sanitized. Also greasy fryers, dirty walk-in cooler, and peeling paint. Prior core violations for a door gap and freezer gasket were not corrected.

headline: Complaint passed; grease and loose gaskets
summary: Passed. Food splatter under the hot lamp, loose gasket seals on a two-door cooler, and grease on hotline cooking equipment must be cleaned or repaired. The walk-in cooler floor and rear prep area floor need detail cleaning.

headline: Dusty racks and fan covers in cooler
summary: Passed. Storage racks and attached fan covers inside the pre-packaged sandwich and salad cooler must be detail cleaned to remove dust buildup.

headline: Passed; leaking pipe under sink
summary: Passed. The bottom of a reach-in cooler is dirty. A pipe under the three-compartment sink leaks and must be repaired. Debris around the sink and grease trap floor must be cleaned.

headline: Re-inspection passed; health policy and kit missing
summary: Re-inspection passed with no citations. Required items were ordered: a signed employee health policy and a vomit and diarrhea kit. Also an uncovered women's restroom trash can and dirty overhead vents.

headline: Passed; no splashguard and wood debris
summary: Passed. No washable splashguard sits between the exposed hand sink and the prep table. Wood debris on prep area floors must be cleaned.

headline: Plates and silverware not stored properly
summary: Passed. Serving plates on kitchen shelves and silverware on dining tables were not stored properly; plates must be inverted and silverware wrapped. A large mixing bowl does not fit the dish machine; a washing procedure is required.

headline: Cardboard on cooler shelves; no toilet cover
summary: Re-inspection passed. Cardboard liners must be removed from cooler shelving, which must be smooth and cleanable. The women's toilet room needs a covered receptacle. A soiled mop head must be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. The food service sanitation manager on site lacked a food allergen training certificate. The inspector instructed the operator to meet this requirement.

headline: No vomit cleanup plan; several upkeep gaps
summary: No written plan or kit for vomit and diarrhea cleanup; supplies must include gloves, masks, mops and norovirus-effective sanitizer. Also a 1-inch front door gap, missing handwashing sign, and broken floor tiles.

headline: Re-inspection passed; gap and training gap
summary: Passed. No thermometer in the basement refrigerator. A 1/2-inch gap at the basement exit door must be rodent-proofed. Crab rangoon was stored in plastic grocery bags, which are not food-grade. One employee lacked valid food handler training.

headline: Failed: no vomit cleanup supplies; repeat issues
summary: Failed; citation issued. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or supplies on site. Prior core violations not corrected: a 1/4-inch front door gap and no covered restroom receptacles. Also excessive freezer ice and dirty floors.

headline: Re-inspection passed; sprayer faucet adjust
summary: Re-inspection passed. The faucet handle on the three-compartment sprayer needs adjusting. The operator must correct and maintain it.

headline: Mouse droppings in dry storage; failed inspection
summary: About 30 mouse droppings were found along wall bases in the rear dry food storage room; pest control was recommended. Also no mop sink (mop water is dumped in the alley) and no sink stoppers.

headline: Grease traps smell; dirty cold units
summary: Re-inspection passed. Grease and debris built up around both grease traps, which smell; a service company must clean them. Also food debris inside cold holding units, no splashguard at front hand sink, and grime on walls.

headline: Damaged gasket; oversized equipment; unused items
summary: Re-inspection passed. A damaged gasket on a prep cooler door must be repaired. Equipment too large for the three-compartment sink needs an alternative cleaning method or removal. Unused items in rear and outside areas must be removed.

headline: Unlabeled containers and missing hair restraint
summary: Passed. Bulk ingredient containers were unlabeled. A food handler lacked a hair restraint. Ice and ingredient scoops were stored on bins. Fryers, floors and walls need cleaning, and a certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Bare-hand bread handling; 35 lbs discarded
summary: Passed with conditions. A food handler touched bread for food-truck sandwiches by hand; gloves or an approved method is required. About 35 lbs ($155) of product was voluntarily discarded; citation issued. An unlabeled breadcrumb container was found.

headline: Toilet room lacks covered trash can
summary: Passed. No fully covered receptacle is inside the toilet rooms. One must be provided.

headline: No certified manager; handwashing failures
summary: Failed; citations issued. No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared. Employees handled cash, then made food without washing hands. Hand sinks were blocked and one had no hot water (59.5°F). No food handler certificates were on premises.

headline: Greasy equipment; leaking faucet; dirty floors
summary: Passed. Grease and food debris on cooking equipment, coolers and freezer must be cleaned. A three-compartment sink faucet leaks. Floors, walls and corners in cooler, prep, storage and dish areas need grease and spill cleanup.

headline: Passed; clutter and grease near equipment
summary: Passed. Clutter under basement shelving could harbor pests and must be removed. Dust, grease and food spatter on cooking and non-cooking equipment must be cleaned, along with grease under cooking equipment.

headline: Failed: no manager; unsafe food temps; flies
summary: Failed; citations issued. No certified food manager was on site at arrival; one came before inspection ended. Cooked chicken held at 73°F and cold foods at 47-51°F; about 16 lbs of hot food ($68) discarded. About 20 small flies were found.

headline: Greasy fryers; leaking faucet; floor debris
summary: Passed. Rust on beverage-area shelving, greasy fryers, and a dusty freezer bottom must be cleaned or repaired. A rear hand sink faucet leaks. Grease, coins and debris on floors and walls in prep, storage and dish areas need cleaning.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; food residue in coolers
summary: Passed. The left door gasket of a two-door cooler is torn and must be repaired. Spilled food residue inside all reach-in coolers must be detail cleaned.

headline: Cold beans at 45.7-55.2°F; 26 lbs discarded
summary: Pass with conditions; citation issued. Beans mixed with cheese held at 45.7-55.2°F in a prep cold unit. Manager discarded 26 lbs (about $150). Ready-to-eat foods in a refrigerator lacked date marks. Soiled mop heads and unused equipment were found.

headline: No certified manager on duty; items on floor
summary: Pass with conditions. No person in charge held a valid sanitation certificate. No certified food manager was on duty while chicken and fish salads were prepared and served; citation issued. Single-service items stored on basement floor must be raised.

headline: Dead roach on food; rear door not rodent-proof
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. A dead roach was found on wrapped food in a freezer; the food must be discarded and dead roaches removed from floors and equipment. The rear exit door is not rodent-proof at the bottom or side.

headline: Failed: cold foods at 55-61°F; $500 discarded
summary: Failed; citation issued. Cold TCS foods in a two-door cooler held at 55-61°F; about $500 discarded. A prep cooler ran at 60°F and was tagged. A dumpster lid has a large hole. One of two food handler certificates was missing. A prior core violation was not corrected.

headline: Dish machine too cool; no dish-room handsink
summary: Failed; citations issued. Dish machine final rinse read 130°F, below the required 180-194°F, and its gauge showed 115°F. No handwashing sink near the dish area. Outside trash container lacks a tight lid. Floor flooded under the dish machine.

headline: Dead insects in basement; food on floor
summary: Passed. Dead insects in basement corners must be removed and cleaned. Food containers stored on the basement floor must be raised at least six inches. The ice bin needs cleaning and a hole in the bar floor around pipes must be sealed.

headline: Short form: dirty floors, drains, and tiles
summary: Passed with required upkeep. Clean interiors of front reach-in coolers, counters and drive-thru prep stations, and defrost the floor under the walk-in freezer rack. Clean dirty floors and drains, cracked rear floor tiles, and damaged ceiling tiles.

headline: Slow-draining front bar hand sink
summary: Passed. The front bar hand sink drains slowly. The manager was instructed to repair it.

headline: Three employees lack food handler training
summary: Passed. Three food employees lacked food handler training. Training records must be kept on site. One certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Rear door gap; expired allergen certificate
summary: Passed. The rear exterior kitchen door is not tight at the bottom; a weather strip is needed to keep pests out. Floors around the dishwasher need debris removed. The certified manager's allergen training certificate has expired.

headline: Passed; cleaning and no restroom fan
summary: Passed with conditions. Clean the dish machine exterior, the bar ice bins and the floor under both bars. The single restroom has no ventilation fan; the manager must install one.

headline: Complaint passed; food on floor; no hair restraint
summary: Passed. Food containers stored on the walk-in freezer floor must be raised to six inches. An employee at the kitchen prep area lacked a hair restraint; all employees must wear one while prepping.

headline: Re-inspection passed; dirty floor drains
summary: Re-inspection passed. Black and brown buildup inside floor drains under the three-compartment and dish area handwash sinks must be cleaned. Spillage and buildup along the walk-in cooler floor and wall bases must be cleaned.

headline: Passed; missing thermometers and signage
summary: Passed with conditions. The bar handwash sink lacks signage. Several cold-holding units lack internal thermometers. A cooler's gaskets are worn, handles are soiled with food debris, and the warewashing sink drains slowly.

headline: Plastic bags for frozen meat; greasy hood
summary: Passed. Frozen meats were stored in plastic grocery bags; only food-grade bags or containers are allowed. Clean the rear hand sink, oven, fryer, prep tables and cooler. Clean food debris from walls, replace a cracked light shield, and clean the hood.

headline: Re-inspection failed; flies and open doors
summary: Re-inspection failed; citation issued. Openings at entrance doors and a dock door base need sealing against pests. About 30 small flies found. Prior violations were not corrected. Mold-like buildup inside ice machines, a broken women's sink, and dusty ceilings.

headline: Ice scoop stored on ice cubes
summary: Passed. An ice scoop was stored on top of ice cubes. The inspector instructed staff to keep it off the cubes.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food
summary: Food handlers touched lettuce, tomatoes, bread and cheese with bare hands while assembling tacos; the manager was told to stop. Hand sinks lacked paper towels, one handler had no hair restraint, and deli cups were not air-dried.

headline: Re-inspection passed; rust, leaks, and tile
summary: Passed. A torn gasket in a two-door refrigerator and rusty shelving must be fixed. A rear hand sink drains slowly. The women's restroom door needs a self-closing device. A missing floor tile must be repaired and regrouted.

headline: Passed; slow sink and ceiling leak
summary: Passed. The bar hand sink drains slowly and a ceiling tile leaks near the meat slicer; both need repair. Debris upstairs and dust in basement and closets must be cleaned to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Front door gap; manager allergen training missing
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom right of the front door must be sealed against pests. The washroom has no covered trash receptacle and a missing ventilation fan cover. The certified manager lacks allergen awareness training.

headline: Re-inspection passed; floor storage and gaps
summary: Passed. Bulk containers in the prep area were unlabeled. Gaps at rear and front doors must be sealed against pests. Food stored on floors in the walk-in freezer, walk-in cooler and prep areas must be raised six inches.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies; several missing items
summary: Failed. No vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies on site, a priority foundation violation. Also no metal-stem thermometer, no utility sink with hot and cold water, no covered toilet trash can, and no handwashing sign.

headline: Re-inspection passed; greasy floors
summary: Passed. Thick grease, grime and food debris are on floors, especially under the dishwashing area. Food spills and dirt on the ceiling and countertops at the dishwashing area must be cleaned.

headline: Complaint passed; milk crates and leaking sinks
summary: Passed after complaint. Milk crates are used for elevation in the dairy cooler and must be replaced with shelving. Meat was found inside ventilation rails. Leaks under two meat-counter handwash sinks must be repaired. Fans and floors need cleaning.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings, flies, and no soap
summary: Failed; citations issued. About 100 or more mouse droppings in prep, dishwashing, sushi and bar areas, plus about 15 live small flies. Also no hand-sink soap or hand dryers in prep areas (soap and paper towels were supplied during inspection), eating in prep area, and cold-holding violations.

headline: Vehicle missing license number; storage unsecured
summary: Passed. The vehicle lacks its license number on the sides; a two-inch-tall number is required. Multi-use equipment and dry storage must be secured while the vehicle is moving.

headline: Failed: no manager certificate; dirty ice machine
summary: Failed; citation issued. No certified food manager certificate was posted. Pink slime and black buildup inside the ice machine dripped into ice; all ice was voluntarily discarded. Several prep coolers lack thermometers and have ripped gaskets.

headline: Re-inspection passed; training certificate missing
summary: Re-inspection passed. No food handler training certificate was on site and must be provided. Food products need labels with a common name.

headline: No certified manager on site; rear door gap
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chili and beef (foods that must be kept hot or cold) were served; one arrived at 2:45 PM. Rear alley door gap over one inch needs sealing against rodents.

headline: Vehicle missing VIN plate
summary: Failed. The vehicle lacks the plate showing its VIN number, which is needed to verify the truck. The inspector instructed the operator to locate the VIN plate on the registration.

headline: Failed: no pest control logbook provided
summary: Failed. No pest control logbook was available at inspection. All required pest control records must be provided and kept on site. Priority foundation violation; no citation issued.

headline: No certified manager; eggs thawed on counter
summary: Pass with conditions; citations issued. No certified manager's certificate was posted while raw beef and eggs were prepared. Liquid eggs were thawing at room temperature. A walk-in freezer door does not close, and food handlers lacked training.

headline: No certified manager while TCS foods prepared
summary: Re-inspection passed with conditions; citation issued. No certified food sanitation manager was on site while chicken and other TCS foods were prepared. Also heavy grease and food debris in fryer and cooking equipment, and dust on ceilings and fans.

headline: No lidded trash can in prep area
summary: Passed with conditions. The prep area has no trash can with a lid. One must be provided near the handwash sinks.

headline: Packaged foods lack business name and address
summary: Passed. Pre-packaged foods lacked the business name and address. Labeling must be provided.

headline: Failed: sink faucet and toilet doors
summary: Failed. The three-compartment sink faucet reaches only the rinse and sanitizing compartments; a faucet reaching all compartments must be installed. Toilet room doors lack self-closing devices.

headline: Damaged wall near walk-in cooler
summary: Passed. A damaged wall near the walk-in cooler must be repaired and made smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Sanitation manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed. The food service sanitation manager on site lacked a food allergen training certificate. The inspector instructed the operator to meet this requirement.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; corrected on site
summary: Pass with conditions; citation issued. The second-floor dish machine showed 0 ppm sanitizer. It was serviced during inspection to 50 ppm, corrected on site. Missing handwash signage at second-floor restroom. Clutter in the furnace closet must be removed.

headline: Passed; thermometers and cleaning needed
summary: Passed. Thermometers are needed inside all coolers. Rear toilet door must self-close. Dust and mold-like buildup in basement beer cooler racks, debris outside, and a flickering basement light must be fixed.

headline: Failed: no handwashing sign; repeat violations
summary: Failed; citation issued. The coffee prep hand sink lacks a handwashing sign. Three of four overhead exhaust lights lack shielding, one is out, and filters are dusty. The manager lacks allergen training. Prior core violations were not corrected.

headline: Open drink in prep; food on floor
summary: Pass with conditions; citation issued. An open beverage cup sat on the prep counter; closed-lid containers are required. Fry boxes were stored on the floor and single-service items were not inverted. A washroom fan cover is missing. A cook's food handler certificate had expired.

headline: Cold foods at 56-60°F; refrigerator at 62°F
summary: Pass with conditions; citation issued. Eggs, cooked steak, cheese and ranch held at 56-60°F in a prep refrigerator running at 62°F. Frozen beef cheek was thawing on a prep table. A grease trap lid is rusted with holes. One employee lacked food handler training.

headline: Broken toilet handle; burnt-out hood bulb
summary: Passed. The employee toilet has no handle and is flushed with a plastic-tape rope. A bar hand sink drains slowly. The employee restroom needs a covered trash can. A hood light is burnt out and a restroom vent is dusty.

headline: Failed: pest infestation; unsafe food temperatures
summary: Failed; citations issued. No certified food manager on site. Infestation: 50 or more live roaches and 500 or more mouse droppings on the basement and second floor, plus a dead mouse. Hot and cold foods held at unsafe temperatures; about $1,000 discarded.

headline: Cold foods at 46-51°F; coolers tagged
summary: Failed. Cold foods at 46-51°F were discarded (about $60), including yogurt, turkey and potato salad. Two coolers ran at 47 and 51°F and were tagged. The three-compartment sink drains slowly and needs service.

headline: Failed: no handwashing sink near dish area
summary: Failed. No handwashing sink is in a convenient location near the dish area. The manager must install one. Priority foundation violation; no citation issued.

headline: Clogged urinal and broken dish machine
summary: Passed. A clogged men's room urinal must be repaired. Grease and debris behind kitchen equipment must be cleaned. The kitchen dish machine is not working; the manager must repair it or discard it.

headline: Dusty bathroom ceiling; items on cooler floor
summary: Passed. A bathroom ceiling tile covered in dust and debris must be cleaned. Items stored on the walk-in cooler floor must be raised at least six inches. Washroom walls must be enclosed at the bottom.

headline: Failed: sewage backup under three-compartment sink
summary: Failed; citation issued. Wastewater with food debris backed up from a floor drain under the three-compartment sink and must be repaired. Also rusty freezer shelves, worn cutting boards, dirty floor, and burnt-out bulbs.

headline: Passed; missing hair restraint and labels
summary: Passed. Bulk containers in the rear need labels. An employee in food prep lacked a hair restraint. Washcloths must be stored in sanitizing solution. A light shield is missing over the kitchen exhaust hood.

headline: Food on walk-in floor; hood grease buildup
summary: Passed. Food containers stored on the walk-in cooler floor must be raised six inches. Dirt and grease inside the exhaust hood, on its pipes and conduits, and on its filters must be detail cleaned.

headline: Failed: no manager; flies and handwashing lapses
summary: Failed; citations issued. No certified food manager on site. Employees did not dry hands or wash after the toilet room. About 20 live small flies were found, and the pest logbook was empty. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Leaking rinse compartment on sink
summary: Passed. The rinse compartment of the three-compartment sink leaks. The inspector instructed the operator to repair it and keep it maintained.

headline: Short form: floors, grease, and food on floor
summary: Passed with citations. Food on floors must be raised six inches. Splashguards are needed between sinks, and knives were stored between the hand sink and prep table. Cutting boards are damaged. Grease and debris need cleaning, and one burnt-out hood light.

headline: Sewage lines over food; ceiling holes
summary: Passed. Sewage lines over food, single-use items and basement chest freezers were not shielded from drips; shield them or move items. Basement prep and storage ceiling has large holes from a leak two months ago. Paint peels throughout.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; not to be used
summary: Pass with conditions. The low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm sanitizer and must not be used until repaired and reinspected by CDPH. Cold-holding units lack thermometers and no food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Food handlers lack training certificates
summary: Some food handlers did not have food handler training certificates. The manager was instructed that all food handlers must be certified, with names of employees on premises. Food buildup on the wall behind the three-compartment sink needed cleaning.

headline: Cooked meats held too warm; cooler tagged out
summary: About 10 lbs of cooked chicken and pork were held at 54.3°F, above the 41°F limit, and were discarded (about $50). The front prep cooler ran at 55.3°F and was tagged not to be used. No grease trap was provided for the basement sink.

headline: Missing thermometers and backflow device on ice machine
summary: Hot and cold holding units lacked thermometers, and no handwashing signage was posted at sinks. Utensils were stored uncovered in bins. A backflow prevention device was not found on the kitchen ice machine.

headline: Summary report not posted for customers; citation
summary: The most recent summary inspection report was folded and kept with paperwork instead of being posted for customers. A priority foundation violation with citation. Ice buildup in walk-in freezer and debris under the beverage station need cleaning.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm chlorine; tagged for inspection
summary: A low-temperature chlorine dish machine at the bar read 0.0 ppm. It was tagged, and the facility must stop using it until adequate sanitizer is dispensed and the health department is notified. Thermometers were inoperable, and bulk food was unlabeled.

headline: Wet wiping cloths, unlabeled containers, and dirty floors
summary: Wet wiping cloths were left on prep surfaces instead of sanitizing solution. Food storage containers lacked labels. Single-use items were stored on floors. Clutter in dining closets and dirty floors were also noted.

headline: Food stored under wastewater pipes; walk-in wall damaged
summary: To-go food containers were stored in the basement directly under wastewater pipes and had to be moved. The walk-in cooler metal wall was separating and exposing insulation, and its plastic curtains were torn. Allergen training was missing for all certified managers.

headline: Clams and oysters without shellstock tag; 20 lbs discarded
summary: Clams and oysters in a refrigerator had no shellstock tag. About 20 lbs (around $175) was discarded, and a citation was issued. A thermometer was missing from a basement fruit refrigerator. Scoops and food-contact items needed proper storage.

headline: Dusty storage racks and fan covers in sandwich cooler
summary: The inspector instructed the facility to detail clean storage racks and attached fan covers inside the pre-packaged sandwich and salad cooler to remove dust buildup.

headline: No certified manager; dish machine at 123°F; citation
summary: No certified food manager with a valid original certificate was on site while TCS foods were prepared; a citation was issued. A high-temperature dish machine read 123°F and was tagged off. Debris was on mozzarella cooling units, and wall bases were broken.

headline: Leak under hand sink; one certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: A slight leak came from a pipe under an exposed hand sink in the front prep area. One of two certified managers had no allergen training. The inspector required records to be kept on site at all times.

headline: Coffee beans on floor; food handler lacks training
summary: A food handler had no food handler training certificate. Coffee beans were on the floor behind the milk cooler. The employee restroom had no covered waste receptacle.

headline: Over 30 live flies; hot foods held too cold; citations
summary: No certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were served; a citation was issued. Over 30 live small flies were found in dish, prep, and mop areas. Hot and cold foods were held at unsafe temperatures and discarded. A hand sink lacked towels and a splash guard was needed.

headline: Over 100 rat droppings and flying insects; citation
summary: Over 100 rat droppings were found on liquor cabinets, beer coolers, and electrical boxes. About 10 live flying insects were breeding in water-leak tubs in the basement. Additional pest control service was needed. No employee health policy or food handler training was present.

headline: Grease and food debris on cooking equipment and floors
summary: Wiping cloths were not stored in sanitizing solution when not in use. Two cutting boards had open seams and dark stains. Grease and food debris were found on cooking equipment, the fryer cabinet, and floors under and around equipment.

headline: Wall covering damaged; dirty drains; allergen training
summary: Wall covering at the drive-thru window was loose, broken, or missing. Greasy piping behind cooking equipment and dirty floor drains needed cleaning to prevent pest breeding. The certified manager on duty lacked allergen training.

headline: Dirt and debris inside light shields in dish area
summary: Dirt and debris were found inside light shield covers in the rear dishwashing area. The inspector required cleaning and maintenance.

headline: Eye wash attached to handsink; fixed on site; citation for flies
summary: An eye wash station was attached to a handwashing sink by the dish area; it was removed on site. The low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine, but was fixed on site. About 20 small flies were found, and a citation was issued.

headline: No valid certificate or person in charge; citation
summary: No person in charge with a valid Chicago food sanitation certificate was present, and no valid certificate was posted; a citation was issued. Bread was stored on floors, and single-use cups were stored on the basement floor. Sink stoppers and a leaking drain were also needed.

headline: Heavy grease and food debris on equipment and hood filters
summary: Food debris was built up in a gasket on a cold-hold unit near the grill. Grease had built up on hood system filters. The person in charge was told to clean and maintain both.

headline: No certified manager certificate posted; ripped gaskets
summary: No City of Chicago food manager certificate was posted, a priority violation. Three-door reach-in cooler gaskets were ripped and needed repair. A one-compartment sink drain was leaking, and missing or loose tiles were found. Certificates for food handlers were missing.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; tagged out; citation
summary: A low-temperature dish machine had 0 ppm chlorine during final rinse. It was tagged 'held for inspection' and must not be used until repaired. A citation was issued. Cutting boards were scratched and stained, and dust was on vents.

headline: Over 100 mice droppings; 100 lbs of chicken discarded
summary: About 100 lbs of cooked chicken was held at 45.6–55.7°F and was discarded. Over 100 mouse droppings were found throughout the facility, and a citation was issued. Food was not date-labeled, and garbage overflowed outside.

headline: Packaged foods not labeled; coffee roaster access needed
summary: Packaged cookies, cake slices, and banana pudding were not labeled with required information. Coffee roaster needed access points for cleaning verification. Wiping cloths were wet on prep surfaces, and the toilet door was not self-closing.

headline: No food handler certificates; missing grease trap; open holes
summary: No food handler certificates were on site, and the certified manager lacked allergen training. The three-compartment sink in the bar had no grease trap. Open holes in the basement rear were to be closed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Dead insects on floors throughout basement
summary: Dead insects were found on floors and in corners throughout the basement. The inspector instructed staff to clean them up.

headline: Hand sink had no soap; food stored on floors
summary: The meat prep hand sink had no soap, and a food handler got soap during inspection; a citation was issued. Food containers were stored on the walk-in cooler and freezer floors. Dust was on a walk-in cooler fan.

headline: Missing ceiling tiles; food handler certificates absent; citation
summary: Bulk containers were unlabeled, and wiping cloths were improperly stored. Single-use articles were not inverted and stored on the floor. Ceiling tiles were stained and missing, and grease built up in the hood. Certificates for food handlers were missing, and a certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Food stored on floor; no self-closing toilet doors
summary: Food and non-food items were stored on the floor in front prep and rear prep/storage. Restroom doors were not self-closing, and two need devices. Other issues included greasy walls behind the dumpster and basement floors.

headline: No thermometer in milk cooler; mop and vents need work
summary: No thermometer was found inside the cooler storing milk and almond milk. A cutting board was heavily scored. A mop was drying improperly in the utility sink, and dirty overhead vents were noted in the dining area.

headline: Prep coolers missing thermometers; no sink stoppers
summary: Prep coolers were missing thermometers, and the three-compartment sink had no stoppers for washing and sanitizing utensils. The inspector instructed the facility to provide both.

headline: No valid certified manager; no vomit cleanup supplies; citation
summary: No valid Chicago food sanitation certificate was posted for the person in charge, and a citation was issued. No supplies for vomit or diarrhea cleanup were on site, including sanitizer that kills norovirus. A citation was also issued.

headline: Three-compartment sink floods when draining; citation
summary: There were no properly fitting drain plugs for the rear three-compartment sink. Wastewater drained poorly, so one compartment flooded when another drained. This was a priority violation, and service was ordered.

headline: Plumbing leaks and stored mops
summary: A leak was found at the base of the rear three-compartment sink faucet, and a mop sink was not draining. Floors, corners, and a floor drain needed cleaning. Mops were not stored hanging up to air dry.

headline: Burned-out bulbs and drainage backup; citation
summary: Sewer water backed up at a floor drain near the mop sink and was rodded out by a plumber on site; a citation was issued. Food items were stored uncovered and in plastic bags in coolers. A 1/4-inch gap was under the rear exit door.

headline: Dish machine coating peeling; basement floor needs cleaning
summary: The protective coating on the dish machine side was peeling and could harbor insects. The basement walk-in floor under the shelving needed detail cleaning. Dust and grease were on sides of cooking and non-cooking equipment.

headline: No certified manager on site; citation issued
summary: No certified food manager was on site while open, which was a priority foundation violation with a citation. The rear hand sink lacked signage, and the prep cooler had food debris inside. Two sink stoppers were missing.

headline: Cooked rice and pasta held over 24 hours without dates; citation
summary: Cooked rice and pasta held over 24 hours in the walk-in cooler had no discard date; a citation was issued. Grease and debris were on fryer filtering unit and equipment surfaces. Unused equipment and clutter were in the patio.

headline: Leaking three-compartment sink and drain pipe
summary: The three-compartment sink faucet was leaking at the base, and the right compartment drain pipe was leaking too. The manager was instructed to repair them. Grime was on the wall by the rear exit door.

headline: Ice machine debris; sink opening and missing wall panel
summary: Debris was found in the ice machine interior and needed detail cleaning and service. A slight opening on the dishwashing three-compartment sink needed a smooth weld. Basement clutter and a missing kitchen wall panel were noted.

headline: Waste water pipe above ice maker; disposable bowl used as scoop
summary: A 4-inch cast iron waste water line above the basement ice maker needed a barrier or enclosure. A disposable bowl was being used as a scoop for bulk food. The inspector instructed staff to use proper scoops.

headline: No metal stem thermometer; sink water backs up
summary: No metal stem thermometer was available to check cold and hot food temperatures, which is a priority violation with a citation. The three-compartment sink backs up when drained, also a priority violation with a citation. Other upkeep issues were noted.

headline: No procedure or kit for vomit and diarrhea cleanup
summary: No vomit and diarrhea procedure or kit was on site. The inspector left a one-page guide and ordered a kit with a norovirus-effective sanitizer kept on site at all times. Other issues included a missing backflow device and a leaking faucet.

headline: Employee ate near knives; food thawed on prep shelf
summary: An employee ate from an open container near knives and utensils while preparing salmon. Tuna and chicken were thawed on a prep table shelf rather than under refrigeration or running water. Missing cooler thermometer and allergen certificates.

headline: Bare-hand contact with ready-to-eat food; rodent droppings found
summary: A worker touched cooked chicken wings with bare hands; a citation was issued. About 60 mouse droppings were found in basement storage and the electrical room. Additional pest control service was needed. A 3-door cooler at 65.5°F was tagged off.

headline: Labels, rust, and ice buildup in walk-in freezer
summary: Food storage containers were not labeled in the basement dry storage. Utensils were not inverted on dish shelves. Rust was on walk-in shelves, and ice buildup was on freezer walls and condenser. Ice was on the freezer floor, and hood debris needed cleaning.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths, damaged gaskets, and no valid food handler training
summary: Soiled wiping cloths were left on prep tables. Single-use containers were not inverted, and cooler door gaskets were damaged. No valid food handler training was available for any employee. Other upkeep issues included missing ceiling tile and debris by the dumpster.

headline: Pork held at 87.8°F; about 200 lbs discarded
summary: Cooked pork in a tote on the floor was 87.8°F, below the 135°F hot-hold minimum. About 200 lbs (around $450) was discarded and a citation issued. Raw pork, eggs, and chicken were also held too warm. Other issues included floor storage and dirty floors.

headline: Handwashing sinks missing, soap and towels absent; citations
summary: The bar and basement dish area had no handwashing sink. The exposed sink by the three-compartment sink lacked soap, paper towels, and signage. Shellstock tags were missing for mussels on the menu. Basement exit door gaps were also found.

headline: No norovirus-effective cleanup supplies for vomit or diarrhea
summary: The facility had a bodily fluid spill kit without sanitizer that kills norovirus. A citation was issued. Cooler thermometers were missing, food was stored on the walk-in floor, and mop heads were not drying properly.

headline: Dirty shelving, walls, and dish machine needs delime
summary: Debris had built up on front counter shelving, walk-in fan guards, shelving, and prep tables. The dish machine needed delimiting. Food splatter and dirt were on walls, and the walk-in floor had food debris. Allergen training was missing for all food managers.

headline: Dead water bugs on floors near prep and mop area
summary: Dead water bugs were found on floors near the prep table and in the room where mop buckets are held. The inspector required cleaning to remove a food source for pests. Pipes above cooking equipment had grease buildup.

headline: No certified manager while chicken prepared; citation
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken was being prepared and served; a citation was issued. A food handler lacked training, and the certified manager lacked allergen training. The fryer, grill, and prep table exteriors needed cleaning.

headline: No handwashing signs; no food handler certificate on site
summary: No handwashing signage was posted at hand sinks, and the person in charge was told to add it. One food handler had no certificate on site. A plastic wall covering near prep needed removal, and a light was out.

headline: Expired allergen training; leak under bar sink
summary: Expired allergen training was on site. Oil was held in an unlabeled container. A minor leak below the bar hand sink must be repaired.

headline: Ice machine soiled with black and pink residue; citation
summary: Ice machine interior was soiled with black substance and pink slime. Staff were instructed to discard the ice, clean, and sanitize, and a citation was issued. Food containers were on the walk-in floor, and cutting boards were stained.

headline: Standing water under dish machine; leak under dish machine
summary: Standing water was under the dish machine, and the facility must find the source and clean it to prevent insects. A leaking copper pipe was under the dish machine. Floors under cooking equipment in the rear kitchen needed detail cleaning.

headline: Unnecessary equipment in kitchen to be removed
summary: Unused items in the kitchen were to be removed from the premises.

headline: Mold in ice machine; eggs held at 90.6°F; discarded
summary: Black mold-like substance was found inside the ice machine. Management burned the ice and cleaned it on site. Eggs were held at 90.6°F and were discarded; a citation was issued. A fly trap hung over a prep table, and spider webs were in dry storage.

headline: Over 30 rat droppings and live cockroaches; citation
summary: Over 30 rat droppings were found along basement walls and corners, and two live cockroaches were on a kitchen prep table; a citation was issued. No certified food manager was on site while food was prepared and served. Pest control was recommended.

headline: Missing splash guard, floor tiles, and allergen training
summary: A splash guard was required between the hand sink and two-compartment sink in the basement. Basement equipment and wall bases needed repair. The basement held massive clutter. No allergen training was on file for the food manager.

headline: Food spills on front prep floors need cleaning
summary: Floors in the front prep area had food spills that needed detail cleaning. The inspector instructed the facility to clean and keep the floors maintained.

headline: Dirty wiping cloths and floors behind equipment
summary: Dirty wiping cloths were left on front and rear prep tables, not stored in sanitizer. Serving plates were not inverted. Trash cans in restrooms lacked lids. Floors along walls and under equipment needed cleaning.

headline: No handwashing sink in front prep; no allergen training
summary: There was no handwashing sink in the front prep and cooking area, which is a priority foundation violation without citation. The facility lacked a utility sink, and the employee restroom had no mechanical ventilation. A certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Missing thermometers; food handler training gaps; citation
summary: Thermometers were needed inside the hot-hold unit and cold-hold reach-in coolers. Some food handlers lacked training proof, and hair restraints were missing. Mold-like buildup was inside walk-in cooler fan covers. Repeat violations were cited.

headline: Slimy ice machine and foods held too warm; discarded
summary: Black slime was found inside the ice machine, dripping into ice used for people to eat, and a citation was issued. Raw chicken, raw beef, and soup were held above 41°F, and about 20 lbs (around $400) was discarded. The prep cooler was tagged off.

headline: Cutting boards and rusted racks; no restroom receptacle lid
summary: Cutting boards had open seams and dark stains. Rusted storage racks above the three-compartment sink needed to be replaced or derusted. The women's restroom had no covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

headline: Blown light bulb in hood system
summary: A blown light bulb was in the hood system. The person in charge was instructed to replace it.

headline: Walk-in cooling and handwashing sink issues
summary: Cooked chicken was cooling under lids in the walk-in, which must be loosely covered for faster cooling. Food stored beside handwashing sinks was moved. Staff rinsed dishes with soap, not as a separate step. Soiled utility room floors needed cleaning.

headline: Ice buildup in freezers and dirty cooler; door not self-closing
summary: The upright freezer in the rear had ice buildup, and the small cooler needed cleaning at the top. The employee restroom door was not self-closing. Floors along the walls and around equipment needed cleaning.

headline: Disposable cup used as scoop for bulk food
summary: A small disposable plastic cup was being used as a scoop for bulk food containers. The inspector instructed staff to use proper scoops.

headline: About 25 rodent droppings in storage; no certified manager
summary: About 25 small rodent droppings were scattered in a storage closet with chips, bread, and beverages, and by seating. A citation was issued, and pest activity must be eliminated. No certified food manager was on site during preparation and service; a citation was issued.

headline: No hair restraints; backflow devices missing on ice machines
summary: Food handlers were not wearing hair restraints. Floors behind and under heavy equipment were not clean. Backflow prevention devices were still missing from both ice machine water lines, a repeat core violation with a citation.

headline: Gaps let pests in; condensation drips onto clean dishes
summary: Openings were found in entrance doors and near a dumpster area; sealing was ordered to prevent pest entry. Condensation dripped from the ceiling onto clean equipment above the dish sink. Exposed preset knives and forks needed covering.

headline: Gaps and open doors let pests in; grease buildup
summary: Openings were found at the front entrance and rear security door, and the front door was propped open. Food boxes were on the walk-in floor. Grease and debris were on the grill, prep table legs, and grease trap. The inspector also noted dim lighting and dusty vents.

headline: Rusted grease trap threatens leaks
summary: The entire bottom of the grease trap was rusted. It must be repaired or replaced to prevent cracking or leaking of wastewater at the three-compartment sink.

headline: Dish machine lacked chlorine; more than 25 flies
summary: A chemical dish machine was not in use and had no chlorine. It was tagged as a priority violation. More than 25 small flies were found in the bar, basement, dish room, dining room, and kitchen, and a citation was issued. The dumpster was overfilled.

headline: Mildew in ice machine; basement debris and spills; citation
summary: Black and pink mildew-like substance was inside the ice machine, a priority violation. Ice machine and sodas were stored in an unfinished basement room. Old items and debris were stored with food. Leaking soda syrup and broken glass were on the basement floor.

headline: Expired allergen training for two food managers
summary: Two certified food managers had expired allergen training certificates, and the inspector required current ones. Also noted: mineral buildup inside the ice machine, a minor leak under the two-compartment sink, and missing floor tiles.

headline: Expired food handler cards; food-contact issues; citation
summary: Most food handlers had expired food handler certificates. Allergen training was not on site for certified managers. Plastic grocery bags held frozen food, and single-use utensils sat in cardboard. Greasy walls, vents, and a torn cooler gasket were also noted; a core violation citation was issued.

headline: Holes in basement grease trap room floor
summary: Holes and cracks were found in the basement floor in the grease trap room. The holes must be sealed.

headline: Some allergen training certificates expired
summary: Some food allergen training certificates had expired. The inspector required all City of Chicago certified food managers to hold valid allergen training certificates.

headline: One certified manager lacked allergen training
summary: At this complaint re-inspection, one of two certified managers on duty had no allergen training. The inspector ordered all certified managers to complete it and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Hair restraints missing; expired food handler certificate
summary: Food handlers in the prep area were not wearing hair restraints. One food handler had an expired certificate. The inspector also noted food debris under sinks and equipment, and dirty walk-in cooler storage racks.

headline: Food stored on floors; hood system not working
summary: Food containers were stored on floors in the walk-in cooler and prep areas. Knives were stored under the grill in a box with cleaning brushes. The hood system was not working and was ordered repaired. Several other violations were noted.

headline: No certified manager on site; mold in ice machines
summary: No certified food manager was on site while open, a priority foundation violation without citation. Mold-like substance was found in ice machines, and a citation was issued. Soap was added at sinks during inspection. Food handlers lacked hair restraints.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; fixed during inspection
summary: The low-temperature dish machine read 0 ppm chlorine, so it was not sanitizing. A citation was issued. Maintenance adjusted it, and it later read 50 ppm. Wet wiping cloths were also left on prep tables.

headline: Rear door gap, leaking faucet, and missing allergen certificates
summary: A rear door gap of 1/4 to 1/2 inch was found, and repair was ordered to limit pest entry. A three-compartment sink faucet was heavily leaking. No allergen training certificates were on site for certified managers.

headline: Dish machine at 0 ppm; no certified manager on site
summary: No certified food service manager was on site while deli meat and chicken were handled and served. The low-temperature dish machine was not sanitizing at final rinse, with 0 ppm chlorine, a priority violation. A food handler lacked hair restraints.

headline: Gap under dining door; trash without lid; no refrigerator thermometer
summary: A 1/2-inch gap at the bottom of the dining area door could let pests in and must be sealed. The ladies restroom trash receptacle lacked a lid. No thermometer was on the refrigerator, and dry storage floors were dirty.

headline: No pest control proof; citation
summary: No pest control agreement or proof of service was on site, a priority violation with a citation. Food debris was on ice machine exteriors and cooler doors. Restroom fixtures needed cleaning, and a burnt-out bulb was in the deli area.

headline: Several sink leaks and broken restroom door closer
summary: Leaks were found at a restroom hand sink, a hand sink outside the restroom, and a one-compartment sink by the fryer. The restroom door self-closing device was broken. The lower wall beside the three-compartment sink was damaged.

headline: No manager on duty; over 20 rat droppings found
summary: No person in charge was present, and no certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were served; a citation was issued. Over 20 rat droppings were found, and a pest control service visit was ordered. Food stored on floors and in grocery bags, plus trash and gaps.

headline: No valid certified manager while burgers served; citation
summary: No valid City of Chicago certified food manager was on premises while burgers and fries were prepared and served. A priority foundation violation with a citation. Food debris on the front cook and serving floor needed cleaning.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings found; citation issued
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were found in storage, prep, dish, and utility areas. Pest extermination and cleaning were ordered, and a citation was issued. Frozen meat was thawing on the floor, and a milk cooler had no thermometer.

headline: Shellstock tag dates missing; corrected on site
summary: Shellstock tags were kept for the past year, but the last-sold dates were missing from them. The manager organized the tags during inspection, so the issue was corrected on site. A priority foundation violation citation was issued.

headline: About 35 rodent droppings; pest control needed
summary: About 35 small rodent droppings were found behind shelving, along walls, under the three-compartment sink, and by hand sinks. Pest control was required, and a citation issued. Grocery bags were used for masa dough, and a light was burnt out.

headline: No certified manager; gaps let pests in; citation
summary: No valid certified food manager was on site or certificate posted while TCS foods were prepared and served; a citation was issued. A 1/4-inch gap in front doors could let pests in. Food handlers lacked hair restraints, and debris and grease were throughout.

headline: No health policy or food handler certificates; hand sinks lack soap
summary: No valid food sanitation certificate was posted, and no written employee health policy was on site, both priority violations. Hand sinks lacked soap and paper towels, and no hot water was at a rear hand sink. No thermometer was on site, and a citation was issued.

headline: Calcium buildup inside ice machine
summary: The inspector observed calcium buildup inside the ice machine and instructed the manager to clean it.

headline: No mop sink; water on basement floor
summary: The site has no mop sink. One must be installed, with a service sink or curbed cleaning area with a floor drain. Water on the basement floor near the left wall must be removed.

headline: Dish machine rinse too cool; repair required
summary: The dish machine's final rinse surface reached only 130°F, but above 160°F is required; the machine must be repaired. No temperature indicators were provided for the high-temperature dish machine. Broken tiles, wall openings and trash also noted.

headline: No backflow devices on espresso and ice machines
summary: The espresso machine and ice machine have no backflow prevention devices. The business must provide devices in locations where they can be serviced.

headline: About 25 rodent droppings found in office
summary: About 25 small rodent droppings were scattered across the office in the rear prep area. Pest control is needed; citation issued. Also noted: slow-draining handsink, cardboard shelf liners, dirty floors, and missing food handler certificates.

headline: No certified manager while chicken and burgers prepared
summary: No valid certified manager was on duty while chicken and hamburgers were prepared; citation issued. The ice machine interior was not clean. Leaks were found at the three-compartment and two-compartment sinks, and a stopper was not working.

headline: Torn gaskets on refrigeration units
summary: Torn gaskets were found on a two-door reach-in in the front prep area and on both coolers in the rear prep area. They must be replaced and maintained.

headline: No dish machine sanitizer; cold foods too warm
summary: Three low-temperature dish machines had no chlorine sanitizer; citation issued. Cold foods in condiment and salad coolers reached 45–51°F and must stay at 41°F or below. Several food handlers lacked valid training certificates.

headline: Food in grocery bags; heavy freezer ice
summary: Food was stored in grocery bags and tin cans inside coolers and refrigeration units; it must be kept in approved food-grade containers. Heavy ice buildup inside the upright freezer in the rear prep area must be defrosted and cleaned.

headline: Dish machine repaired on site to 50 ppm
summary: The front bar low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm. Ecolab serviced it on site, and it now sanitizes at 50 ppm. Priority violation; citation issued. A stained, grooved cutting board must be resurfaced or replaced.

headline: Self-closing devices needed on restroom doors
summary: All toilet room doors must have self-closing devices. The business must provide them.

headline: Unlabeled sugar; food stored in grocery bags
summary: Bulk sugar was unlabeled. Frozen chicken, beef and other food were stored in plastic grocery bags instead of food-grade containers. Missing sink stoppers and no proof of food handler training were also noted.

headline: Missing thermometers and food labels
summary: Cooling units were missing thermometers and must be provided. Flan in a cooling unit in the front prep area needs labels. Excess dust and dirt were on the vents above the beverage dispenser.

headline: Failed re-inspection; uncorrected priority violation
summary: A previous priority violation, missing floor grout, was still not corrected. Other upkeep issues include a slow bar handsink drain, worn cutting boards, grease buildup, and a staff restroom door without a self-closing device.

headline: Live roaches found at handsink and basement
summary: Six baby roaches came from handsink handles, one adult roach was inside the handsink frame, and two adults were in the basement. The ice machine interior was dirty. The three-compartment sink faucet does not reach all compartments; citation issued.

headline: Improper cold holding; no certified manager on site
summary: No person in charge or certified manager was on site while food was prepared and served. Salsa, ham, eggs and hash browns held at 45–54.5°F; 25 lbs discarded. Cooler at 50°F held for inspection. Summary report not posted.

headline: Live roach and 30 rodent droppings; food too warm
summary: One live roach crawled on a refrigerator handle; about 30 rodent droppings were found behind a cooler, under sinks and in rear prep. Cold foods held at 50–69°F and hot wings at 65–72°F were discarded. Pest control needed; citation issued.

headline: Grease spills outside; plates stored upright
summary: Grease spilled around the outside oil tank container and must be cleaned. Plates and bowls in the kitchen were facing up and must be stored inverted. Cardboard boxes near the three-compartment sink must be removed.

headline: No valid sanitation certificate on premises
summary: The person in charge lacked a City of Chicago sanitation certificate. No valid certificate was posted or present while food was prepared and served; citation issued. Grease and food debris were also found inside the deep fryer.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; ice must be removed
summary: Black slimy substance was found inside the ice machine, dripping into ice used for human consumption. Management must turn off the machine, remove the ice, and have it cleaned; citation issued. Other items include rust, stains and a burnt-out light.

headline: No certified manager; hot food held too cool
summary: No City certified food manager was on site at arrival; citation issued. Carne asada was held at 130°F, below the required 135°F. The manager discarded 6 lbs of carnitas.

headline: Cooler at 47°F tagged out of use
summary: One door cooler measured 47°F ambient air; it was tagged, and no food needing temperature control was stored inside. A prep cooler in the customer walkthrough area must be locked. Two coolers were not in working order.

headline: Missing splash guard; food debris under equipment
summary: A splash guard was needed at the handsink across from the deep fryers. Dirt, stains and food debris were found under and around non-cooking equipment in the prep area and must be cleaned.

headline: Damaged walls and ceilings; prior violations uncorrected
summary: Walls and ceilings in poor repair, with openings and peeling paint, were found behind soda dispensers and in basement storage. Priority and core violations from 2023 and 2024 were not corrected. Citation issued.

headline: Multiple upkeep gaps; low handwash water flow
summary: One hot-holding unit had no visible thermometer. Single-use items were stored on the garage floor outside. Low cold water flow was found at a washroom handsink, and the utility sink lacks a backflow device. Washroom doors lack self-closing devices.

headline: Widespread cleaning and maintenance needed
summary: Many items need detail cleaning, including cooking equipment, coolers, ice machine, soda nozzles, cutting boards and hood vents. Unlabeled bulk containers and a leak at the dish machine drain were also noted.

headline: Dish machine rinse at 90°F; no pest log
summary: The final rinse on the high-temperature dish machine reached 90°F, but 180–194°F is required. No pest control logbook, vomit and diarrhea cleanup kit, or original sanitation certificate was on site. Priority violations.

headline: Missing sink stoppers and worn caulking
summary: The three-compartment sink was missing proper stoppers. Worn caulking with a black substance was found on the top base of the warewash unit. Both were ordered fixed.

headline: Faulty cooler thermometer replaced on site
summary: The ambient air thermometer in the espresso bar cooler was not working properly. The manager replaced it during inspection.

headline: Ice machine door buildup; unlabeled sink
summary: Buildup was found on the ice machine door and must be cleaned. The three-compartment sink was not labeled for wash, rinse and sanitize.

headline: Unlabeled bulk ingredients; dirty floors
summary: Bulk flour, sugar and seasonings lacked common-name labels. Food debris was on cooking equipment, and the cooling unit interior needed cleaning. Chipped paint and water-damaged ceiling fixtures were found in the front prep area.

headline: Clutter on floor in rear storage
summary: Clutter was stored on the floor in the rear storage and prep area. Unused articles and equipment must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Personal items stored in food storage area
summary: Personal items were stored in the rear food storage area. The business must set aside a separate area for personal items, away from food.

headline: No certified manager; hygiene and cold food lapses
summary: No certified manager on duty while food was prepared. A worker handled fries without washing hands after sweeping; prep handsink lacked soap (provided during inspection). Coleslaw at 46.4–47.5°F discarded. Health policies and food handler training records missing.

headline: Items on basement floor
summary: Items were on the floor throughout the basement and in the basement liquor storage closet. Unnecessary items must be removed, and kept items must be raised at least six inches off the floor.

headline: Hot water too low; technician repaired on site
summary: Hot water peaked at 99°F, then dropped to 87°F. Handwashing sinks need at least 100°F and the three-compartment sink needs 110°F. A technician serviced electrical issues on site. No citation issued.

headline: Soda syrup spills on floor
summary: Soda syrup spills were found on the floor under the syrup boxes. The manager was told to clean the floor and keep it maintained.

headline: No certified sanitation certificate on site
summary: No person with an original City of Chicago food sanitation certificate was on site, and none was posted. Priority violation; citation issued. A certified person must be on site at all times.

headline: Restroom handsinks lack hot water
summary: Both restroom handsinks lacked hot water; the reading was 57°F, and 100°F is required. This is a priority violation. The prep cooler by the drive-thru window had no thermometer.

headline: Dessert labeling gaps and dirty areas
summary: Grab-and-go desserts lack labels with business name, address, ingredients and allergen warnings. Also noted dirty floors and drain, moldy caulking at the three-compartment sink, dusty ceiling vents, and misplaced equipment.

headline: Door gap and dirty prep floor
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the east side double doors must be sealed to rodent-proof them. The floor in the prep area was not clean and must be cleaned.

headline: Missing sink stoppers; expired allergen training
summary: The three-compartment sink needs stoppers. A certified manager on duty had an expired allergen training certificate and was told to renew it.

headline: Shared mop sink and unlocked storage area
summary: The rear dry and frozen food storage area has no lockable door and shares a mop sink with a neighboring business. The business was told not to share the space and to install a lockable door.

headline: Dirty ice machine; leaking sink faucets
summary: The interior back panel of the ice machine was not clean. Multiple leaks were found at the three-compartment sink faucets and bases. Working thermometers are needed in all coolers. A certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Clutter on floor; peeling wall base
summary: Clutter was stored on the floor in the rear storage area and must be removed to prevent pest harborage. The wall base near the walk-in freezer is peeling and must be repaired.

headline: Door gap, missing splash guards, broken fans
summary: A 1/4-inch gap under the rear exit door must be sealed to rodent-proof it. The bar and rear prep handsinks lack splash guards. A women's handsink drain leaks, and ceiling fans in both restrooms do not work. Some managers lack allergen training.

headline: Food debris, damaged walls, and dusty vents
summary: Food debris and splatter were on front food service shelving and inside lower reach-in coolers. The wall by the washing machine is damaged on both sides, and a wall tile is missing in the dish area. Vents above food prep have dust.

headline: About 50 live flying insects in prep area
summary: About 50 live small flying insects were on walls, ceiling and stock boxes in the food prep area. A prior pest violation was not corrected; more pest control is needed. No food handler certificates were on the premises.

headline: Improper food storage and dirty floors
summary: Plates and bowls were stored with food-contact surfaces exposed. Single-service boxes were on the basement floor. The men's restroom door was not self-closing. Floors below fryers and ovens were heavily greasy.

headline: Missing thermometers, signage, and leaking sink
summary: Handsinks in prep areas lacked hand-washing signs. Broken thermometers were found in cooling units, and curbside units had dried food debris. A three-compartment sink faucet is leaking, and a wall base under the sink is detached.

headline: Freezer and cooler repairs needed
summary: A basement chest freezer had a broken lid, and basement chest freezers had heavy frost buildup. Racks in the basement walk-in cooler have rust that must be repaired or replaced.

headline: Mineral buildup in ice machine; cluttered storage
summary: Pink mineral buildup was found inside the rear ice machine and must be cleaned. The rear storage room near the toilets was cluttered with boxes and unused equipment that must be organized or removed.

headline: No procedure for large equipment; grease buildup
summary: No written procedure exists for washing oversized equipment that does not fit in the three-compartment sink. Food debris was built up in the deli ham slicer, and grease was under the prep area oven.

headline: Food debris, dusty hood, and expired certificates
summary: Food debris was on the floor and along the wall base under a refrigerator and freezer in the rear prep area. The hood vent had dust buildup and a light was not working. Food handler certificates for all handlers were expired.

headline: No certified manager, handwashing sinks, or health policy
summary: No person in charge with a valid sanitation certificate, and no certificate posted. Prep and dish areas lack handwashing sinks. No employee health policy. The rear utility sink has no running water.

headline: Rusted walk-in racks and sticky bar floors
summary: Rusted racks inside the walk-in cooler must be repainted or replaced. Floors in the bar area were sticky and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: More than 50 small flies; dish machine not sanitizing
summary: More than 50 small flies were found in the kitchen, dry storage and dining room; citation issued. The bar dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm, but 50 ppm is required. The machine is tagged and out of use. Ice machine has calcium buildup.

headline: Scratched cutting boards; debris on floors
summary: Multiple cutting boards in the deli prep area had deep scratches and stains. Food splatter was on walls in the rear juicing room, and debris was on the produce cooler floor. Items were stored on the floor in the rear receiving area.

headline: Food on floor; gaps and debris found
summary: Food was stored on the bakery floor and must be raised six inches. Gaps were found at the overhead and front doors, and washrooms lacked hand-washing signs. Food debris and spills were found on display shelves and meat coolers.

headline: About 10 live flying insects on food truck
summary: About 10 live small flying insects were on the truck walls near the water tanks and sinks. Additional pest control is needed. The truck also lacked vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies, and grime was on the floors.

headline: Mold-like buildup dripping onto ice
summary: Pink and black mold-like buildup inside the ice machine was dripping onto ice in the bin. The person in charge must discard the ice, remove the mold, and clean and sanitize the bin; citation issued. Ice buildup in a freezer also noted.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; sewer lines over food
summary: The low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine, but at least 100 ppm is required. Exposed black sewer lines hang over food storage racks in the basement and must be covered or the racks moved.

headline: About 75 mouse droppings and live flies found
summary: About 75 or more mouse droppings and 5–7 live flies were found on shelves, floors and in storage areas, including near food items. No certified manager on duty while food was prepared. No signed employee health policies. Citations issued.

headline: Refrigerator at 52.1°F; raw food notice missing
summary: A cold-hold unit measured 52.1°F and must stay out of use until reinspected. The menu lacked the required raw or undercooked food disclosure for steak and ceviche items. Grease and debris were on the floor to basement storage.

headline: Raw food advisory corrected on site
summary: A missing consumer advisory for raw or undercooked food was corrected on site before inspection ended. Also noted: no handwashing signs, brown buildup in margarita dispensers, items stored on floors, door openings, and expired allergen training for one manager.

headline: No certified manager; no hot water at handsink
summary: No certified manager was on site while open; citation issued. The front prep handsink had no hot water (68°F). The low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm and was ordered out of use. Food was stored on the floor.

headline: No health policy or pest logbook on site
summary: No employee health policies or pest control logbook were on site. Window screens were missing. A cutting tool was stored between a pipe and wall. Cooking equipment, reach-in coolers, hood filters and walls need detail cleaning.

headline: Live roach, mouse droppings, and flies found
summary: About 20 or more small flies, one live roach in a prep cooler, and 10–15 mouse droppings under dry storage shelves were found. Pest control is recommended; citation issued. Prior violations, including greasy floors and missing cooler thermometers, remain uncorrected.

headline: Working thermometers needed in coolers
summary: The business must provide and maintain working thermometers inside all coolers and freezers.

headline: Employee eating on line; soiled utensils
summary: An employee was eating fries on the service line. Soiled knives and a sauce cup stored with clean cups were cleaned by the manager during inspection; citation issued. Broken drain stopper and soiled kitchen floors and walls also noted.

headline: Restrooms lacked hot water; citation issued
summary: Customer and employee restrooms had no hot water. Readings were 80°F to 85°F, but 100°F is required. Priority violation with citation. A city food service manager lacked proof of allergen training.

headline: Water-damaged ceiling tiles; unlabeled sink
summary: Water-damaged ceiling tiles were found in the dining area, rear prep and the area leading to the basement. The three-compartment sink was not labeled. The restroom lacked a covered waste receptacle.

headline: Frozen fries thawed at room temperature
summary: Bulk French fries were thawing at room temperature. They must be thawed under running water at 70°F or below, or under refrigeration. Walk-in cooler door gaskets were worn, detached and missing in areas.

headline: More than 20 small flies throughout facility
summary: More than 20 small flies were seen throughout the facility, including the prep and dish areas. The manager was told to minimize fly activity. Priority violation with citation issued.

headline: Rat droppings and live flying insects found
summary: About 30 rat droppings were on the basement storage floor, and about 10 live small flying insects were behind the bar. Additional pest control is needed; citation issued. Greasy fryers and stove, cracked light shields and missing allergen training also noted.

headline: Vomit cleanup supplies missing; equipment repairs
summary: Items needed for vomit and diarrhea cleanup were not on site. Damaged gaskets, a cracked freezer door, rust, peeling interiors, exposed insulation, and ice and water near the walk-in freezer also need repair.
