headline: Cleaning gaps and items stored on floor
summary: Dirt and food debris were found in the drain under the three-compartment sink. Items were stacked on the closet floor, and the toilet room door lacked a self-closing device. Food spills and grease were also noted.

headline: Dirty prep table shelf and floors
summary: The bottom shelf of a prep table was dirty and needed spills removed. Floors around the cooking equipment needed cleaning to remove spills, debris and grease.

headline: Cardboard liners; missing lid; greasy hood filters
summary: Cardboard lined the lower shelving under rear prep tables and must be removed. A bulk food container lid is missing. Pots too large for the three-compartment sink need a written procedure, and hood filters need grease removed.

headline: Coffee buildup under equipment and along walls
summary: Light buildup of coffee beans, grounds and dried coffee stains was found under equipment and along wall edges in the front service and prep area. The business was told to clean these areas.

headline: Washroom door lacks self-closing device
summary: The washroom door has no self-closing mechanism. The business was told to install one.

headline: Ice buildup in holding units; spills throughout
summary: Debris and ice buildup were found inside popsicle and ice cream holding units and must be cleaned. No backflow device on the rear utility sink. Food debris and spills were found throughout the facility. One certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Live roaches and many mouse droppings found
summary: About 3 live roaches and 40+ mouse droppings were found in prep, storage and dining areas. The women's restroom handsink had no hot water (57.7°F). Crab rangoon and cooked beef held at 48–91°F; about 15 lbs discarded. Citations issued.

headline: Uncovered food; no drain plugs for sink
summary: Uncovered sweet potatoes were found near a cooler and must be covered. The three-compartment sink lacked drain plugs. Certified food managers had no allergen training.

headline: Personal items on food shelves; leaks found
summary: Employee keys and phones were stored on food and equipment shelves. A condenser leak was causing water to collect inside the pizza prep cooler. Leaks at a faucet and black mold on walls near a utility sink were also found.

headline: No certified manager on site; thermometer fixed
summary: No person in charge or certified food employee was on site while food was prepared; citation issued. No probe thermometer was on site, so a laser gun was used instead. The person in charge got a probe from another store during inspection.

headline: Foil lining; food stored in plastic totes
summary: Hanging aluminum foil lined shelves in front of the pastry display case and must be removed. Spanakopita was stored in plastic totes in the walk-in cooler; only food-grade bags and containers may be used.

headline: Live flies found; widespread cleaning and certificate gaps
summary: Live flies, food and dirt were found on walls, vents and ceilings. Floors and floor drains had old food and debris. Food handler certificates were expired, and the certified manager lacks allergen training. Leaks were found at the two-compartment sink.

headline: Employees handled ready-to-eat food with bare hands
summary: Employees plated and served ready-to-eat and cooked food with bare hands, rubbing hands on clothing. They were told to use gloves, tongs or deli tissue; priority violation with citation. Food debris on floors and wet wiping cloths also noted.

headline: No lidded garbage can in basement restrooms
summary: The unisex restrooms in the basement had no garbage can with a lid. The business must provide one.

headline: Raw fish held too warm; 10 lbs discarded
summary: A display cooler held salmon at 58.6°F, white tuna at 49.6°F and yellowtail at 50.7°F. The manager discarded 10 lbs. A sushi display case at 60°F must stay out of use until reinspected; citation issued.

headline: No thermometer for coffee station coolers
summary: No metal stem thermometer was on site to check half-and-half held in the lobby cooler and kitchen refrigerator; priority violation with citation. Clutter, an uneven floor repaired with raw wood, and stained ceiling tiles indicating a leak were also found.

headline: Ice machine mold; no prep sink; grease trap unverified
summary: Rust and pink mold were found inside the ice machine; ice must be destroyed and the machine cleaned. No prep sink in the front prep area, and the grease trap could not be verified. An opening at the front entrance door was also noted.

headline: Missing cold water, sinks, and health policy
summary: No written employee health policy. The handsink behind the front counter lacked cold water; hot water exceeded 120°F. The basement prep area has no handsink. No metal probe thermometer. Food handler and allergen training certificates missing.

headline: Rear prep handsink lacked hot water
summary: The rear prep area handsink had no hot water; the reading was 64.5°F, and at least 100°F is required. Priority violation with citation. Holes in walls and uneven floors in the front prep area were also noted.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; certificate missing
summary: Black slimy substance was found inside the ice machine, dripping into ice; ice must be removed and the machine cleaned (citation issued). No valid city sanitation certificate posted. No health policy, vomit and diarrhea procedure, or handsink at the bar.

headline: Food on floors; uncorrected priority violation
summary: Food containers were stored on floors in the walk-in cooler, freezer and prep areas. Handlers prepped without hair restraints, and wet wiping cloths were on prep surfaces. A prior priority violation, greasy shelving, was not corrected and must be fixed before reinspection.

headline: Mop sink, grease trap, and restroom fixes needed
summary: A mop sink with hot and cold water must be installed, and a grease trap must be installed at the three-compartment sink. The toilet room door needs a self-closing device and ventilation, and liquor storage items must be raised off the floor.

headline: No certified manager at start; corrected on site
summary: No certified manager was on site at the start while shrimp, chicken, beef and rice were prepared. This was corrected when the certified manager arrived at 1:15 PM; citation issued. Broken screen, dirty floors and expired allergen training also noted.

headline: No certified manager; no paper towels at handsink
summary: Food was prepared without a certified manager on site; the manager arrived at the end of the inspection. The rear prep handsink had no paper towels, provided during inspection. Uncorrected backflow and floor-cleaning violations from prior inspection.

headline: Loose ceiling tile in prep area
summary: A ceiling tile in the prep area was not attached and must be reattached.

headline: Thawing corrected on site; cleaning needed
summary: Frozen raw meat was thawing in standing water in a sink; management corrected it on site. Bulk food containers were open and needed proper labels. Cooking equipment, shelves, cabinets, floors, and vents need detail cleaning.

headline: Shrimp thawed in standing water; kitchen cleaning needed
summary: Several bags of frozen shrimp were thawing in a prep sink with no approved method. Management was told to thaw food under cold running water. Prep tables, fryers, cooler, floors, walls, and hood also need cleaning.

headline: Gap under front door; missing sink stoppers
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the front entrance door must be closed to keep rodents out. The basement three-compartment sink was missing stoppers. Peeling ceiling paint above the sink must be removed. A previous milk crate violation was not corrected; citation issued.

headline: Fly trap placed over prep area; leaks and floor damage
summary: A fly trap was installed above the food prep area in the rear dessert station and must be moved away from food. Leaks were found at the dish machine connections in the bar area. Damaged floor tiles in the bar area expose wood and must be repaired.

headline: Milk crates used as shelving; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Milk crates were used as shelving throughout prep and storage areas and must be replaced with shelving at least 6 inches off the floor. The food service sanitation manager did not have allergen training certificate on site.

headline: No certified manager; overflowing dumpster; citation issued
summary: No certified food manager was on site while eggs and salad were being prepared; citation issued. The outside dumpster was overflowing and trash bags were stored outside it, also cited. Cardboard boxes were stored by the rear door, and allergen training certificates were missing.

headline: Food not date-marked; incomplete menu advisories
summary: Ready-to-eat TCS foods held over 24 hours were not date-marked; citation issued. Menu consumer advisories were incomplete. Large pots could not fit in the sink and had no written washing procedure. Packaged foods in the customer cooler were unlabeled.

headline: Missing soap and hand drying; faucet problems
summary: The dish room handwashing sink had no soap and no hand drying supply; a hand dryer was corrected on site, and a citation was issued for the soap and drying supplies. A three-compartment sink faucet did not run water and another faucet leaked.

headline: No sanitation certificate on site; citation issued
summary: No valid City sanitation manager certificate was on site while beef and beans were prepared; citation issued. The certified manager arrived before inspection ended. Rust was on cooler shelves, and the basement restroom had no covered receptacle or food handler certificate.

headline: Cardboard liners and wet mop storage
summary: Cardboard was used as shelf liner, on top of freezers, and on a grease trap; it must be replaced with smooth, cleanable material. A wet mop was stored in a bucket in the dish area and must be hung to dry.

headline: Re-inspection: cardboard liner and leaking drain
summary: Cardboard was used as a shelf liner in the dining room staging area and must be removed. A drain pipe next to the grease trap of the three-compartment sink was leaking and must be repaired.

headline: Mouse droppings and open bait found; citation issued
summary: About 50 to 60 mouse droppings were found in bar storage, on dining room shelves, and behind the kitchen door, and open bait was in the bar storage. Pest control is required; citation issued. Other issues include duct tape repairs, plastic bags used as food containers, and a previous violation not corrected.

headline: Dirty walk-in coolers; ice machine interior needs cleaning
summary: The ice machine interior must be cleaned and maintained. Floors, walls, and ceilings inside the walk-in coolers and freezer were dirty. A faucet base at the three-compartment sink leaked and the grease trap lid needs cleaning.

headline: Re-inspection: no training; leaks and cleaning needed
summary: Pots were too large for the three-compartment sink and an alternative method was required. No food handler training for employees and no allergen training for certified managers. Leaks, food debris, damaged tiles, and missing hood filters need repair.

headline: Live and dead roaches throughout facility; citation issued
summary: About 10 live roaches were seen in the dining area, kitchen, and customer washroom, and dead roaches were found in a cooler and on floors; citation issued. Spills were in cold holding units, a splash guard and self-closing door were needed, and allergen training was missing.

headline: Soiled wiping cloths and stained cutting boards
summary: Soiled wiping cloths were stored on prep tables and must be kept in sanitizing solution between uses. Cutting boards had dark stains and grooves. The deep fryer oil filtering unit had a buildup of grease and food debris.

headline: No sanitation certificate; cut fruit handled
summary: The person in charge had no City sanitation manager certificate, and no certified manager was on site while cut melon and fruit were handled; citation issued. The three-compartment sink and ice machine exterior were not clean, and the ice machine lacked a backflow device.

headline: Unused equipment stored outside rear door
summary: Unused cooling equipment and stacked items were outside the rear exit door. They must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Mouse droppings found; unsafe food temperatures discarded
summary: Over 30 mouse droppings were found in dry storage and on basement shelves; pest control service was required and citation issued. Steak, rice, and beans were held above safe cold temperatures and about 15 lbs were discarded. A prep cooler at 50°F was tagged.

headline: Dish machine sanitizer at 0 ppm; citation issued
summary: The low-temperature dish machine's chlorine sanitizer read 0 ppm; citation issued. A vacuum packaging machine was tagged and must not be used, because there was no CDPH-approved HACCP plan (a required food safety plan for special processes).

headline: About 20 live roaches; chicken held too warm
summary: About 20 live roaches were found in the facility, including in a cold holding unit, cooking equipment, and on pipes; citation issued. Chicken held at 52.2°F was corrected on site and about 7 lbs discarded. A cold holding unit at 63.5°F was tagged.

headline: Flies in prep area; hot water too cool; citation
summary: About 7 live large flies were in the prepared foods area; citation issued. Hot water only reached 96°F at sinks, below the required 100°F and 110°F. Previous leak and cleaning violations were not corrected, and a citation was issued.

headline: Food debris in shrimp freezer; missing ceiling tiles
summary: Food debris had built up inside the freezer where frozen shrimp and batter are stored and must be cleaned. Ceiling tiles were missing in the storage room and must be replaced.

headline: Gap under rear door could allow pests
summary: There was no written employee health policy on site. A half-inch gap under the rear exit door could allow pest entry and must be closed. Also leaks at a three-compartment sink faucet, dirty floors and walls, and damaged floor tiles.

headline: Rear handwashing sink does not turn on properly
summary: The rear handwashing sink did not turn on properly. The facility was instructed to repair it.

headline: Rice pudding discarded; gnats and flies found
summary: Rice pudding at 48°F, about 25 lbs, was discarded; citation issued. About 40 gnats were found in the kitchen, dish room, and mop sink area; citation issued and pest service recommended. Four sticky fly traps were in food areas and must be removed.

headline: Unsafe ice and drain problems; no handwashing signs
summary: Waste water backed up from a floor drain under the three-compartment sink; citation issued. Handwashing signs were missing, the menu lacked a raw food advisory, and no food thermometer was on site. The dumpster had broken lids and a certified manager needs allergen training.

headline: No certified manager while handling beef and chicken
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager was on site while beef and chicken were handled and served; citation issued. A light shield was missing in the kitchen.

headline: Cardboard reused under mats; grease on staircase
summary: Cardboard was reused under rubber mats in prep areas and must not be reused. Grease containers were stored on the ground at the basement staircase. Floors under and behind equipment had food and dirt debris.

headline: Unlabeled spices; leaks and greasy equipment
summary: Spices were in unlabeled containers and must be labeled. Plastic containers were used to scoop TCS foods from coolers. Foil lined cooking equipment and racks. Equipment, sinks, floors, and filters were greasy; a sink faucet leaked and a fly strip was hung near a handsink.

headline: No written employee health policy on site
summary: No written employee health policy was on site. Management must provide a signed health policy for each employee. No citation was issued.

headline: Missing cooler thermometer; soiled utility sink drain
summary: An upright cooler was missing an internal air thermometer. The utility sink drain and nearby surfaces were soiled with a mild odor, though the sink worked with no backup. The facility was instructed to clean at an adequate frequency.

headline: Slimy buildup in ice machine; ice removed
summary: Black slimy substance was found inside the ice machine, dripping into ice used for drinks. Management was told to turn off the machine, remove the ice, and clean it; citation issued. An employee had no hair restraint and the walk-in freezer had heavy ice buildup.

headline: Dish machine rinse too hot; citation issued
summary: The high-temperature dish machine's final rinse measured 198°F, above the required 180–194°F; citation issued. Calcium buildup was found on the low-temperature dish machine. Heavy spills were inside wine and beer coolers, and grease was outside by the garbage area.

headline: No proper handwashing sink for bread baking; citation
summary: Bread baking was done without a proper handwashing sink; a mop sink was being used. A hand sink with hot and cold water, soap, and hand drying must be installed; citation issued. Side doors were not rodent-proof, and food handler certificates were expired.

headline: Open coffee cup near food; missing training certificates
summary: An open coffee cup was on a prep table where an employee cut limes; the employee was told to store personal items away from food prep areas. A new certified manager lacked allergen training. No food handler training certificates were on site, citation issued.

headline: Sinks too cool; dish machines below required temperature
summary: Some handwashing sinks had water at 86°F and 48.7°F; the required minimum is 100°F. Dish machines in the bar and second floor ran at 90–99°F; citation issued. Shellfish served raw was missing from the menu advisory. Several washroom fans were not working.

headline: Minor issues; no allergen training certificate
summary: Refrigerator thermometers were hard to view and must be moved to an easy-to-see location. Brooms and dustpans were stored too close to food containers. Deli cups were not air-dried before stacking. No allergen training certificate was on site for the food service manager.

headline: Re-inspection: cleaning and minor repairs needed
summary: Interiors of the prep cooler, deep fryer, stove, ice machine, prep tables, and food containers must be cleaned. The employee washroom had no covered waste receptacle, and holes in the dry storage ceiling drywall need repair.

headline: Employee toilet room lacks covered receptacle
summary: The employee toilet room had no fully covered receptacle. The facility was instructed to provide one.

headline: Worn cutting boards; dusty vents
summary: Two cutting boards had deep grooves and worn edges and must be replaced. Air vents over the service line were dusty and need detail cleaning.

headline: Rice and steak held too warm; citation issued
summary: Rice at 54.2°F and steak at 55.4°F were stored in an upright cooler and cooled improperly; about 15 lbs were discarded and citation issued. Employees lacked food handler training and the manager lacked allergen training.

headline: No certified manager during food handling; citation issued
summary: No City of Chicago certified sanitation manager was on site while TCS foods (foods that must be kept hot or cold) were handled; citation issued. Also no handwashing signs, a broken hand sink handle, and a dirty dumpster area with spillage and a missing lid.

headline: Chicken and cheese held too warm; citation issued
summary: Chicken at 60°F, cheese at 58°F, and hamburgers at 60°F were in a two-door prep cooler whose air temperature was 55°F; citation issued. A food handler had no training certificate. Door gaskets need replacement.

headline: No certified manager while handling chicken and steak
summary: No person in charge or certified food manager was on site while chicken, steak, and pork were handled; citation issued. Wet wiping cloths were on prep surfaces, clutter was on the floor near storage, and a sanitation manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; unit tagged
summary: The low-temperature warewashing machine in the bar area had 0 ppm sanitizer; it was tagged and must not be used until reinspected by CDPH. No metal-stem food thermometer was on site, and a citation was issued.

headline: No health policies; gaps and cleanup items needed
summary: Signed employee health policies were not provided. A three-compartment sink had no drainboard and gaps in the walls and doors let in pests. A no-smoking sign was missing, and wet mops need a hanging system.

headline: Flies, mold, and no hot water; multiple citations
summary: About 15 small flies were found near the dish machine and storage; citation issued. Black mold-like substance touched ice in the ice machine; citation issued. No hot water was found at several sinks, restored to 100.1°F on site. Bar hand sinks lacked soap and paper towels.

headline: No vomit cleanup supplies; no pest logbook
summary: No supplies were available for vomit and diarrhea events. No pest control logbook was on site, and no chemical test kit was available to check sanitizer concentration. Washrooms lacked handwashing signs.

headline: No certified manager; held pastries too warm; citation
summary: The person in charge had no City sanitation certificate, and no certified manager was on site at the start of inspection; citation issued. Meat pastries at 78.4°F were discarded. A hand sink was blocked and had no paper towels; citation issued for both problems.

headline: Re-inspection: gasket, rust, and wall base repairs
summary: A walk-in cooler door gasket is worn and must be repaired or replaced. Rust must be removed from walk-in cooler shelving. Damaged and loose wall bases and metal trim need repair.

headline: Dirty restrooms; no food handler training verification
summary: All plumbing fixtures in both toilet rooms, including urinals, toilets, and handwash sinks, were soiled and had debris. Toilet room walls were also dirty. Verification of food handler training for all food handlers was missing.

headline: No sanitation manager certificate while serving beef and eggs
summary: The manager on duty did not have a City sanitation manager certificate while beef and eggs were prepared and served; citation issued. The women's restroom receptacle lid was half missing, and the previous inspection summary was not posted for the public; citation issued.

headline: No person in charge or certified manager on site
summary: No person in charge was on site and no City certified sanitation manager was present while eggs and milk were prepared; citation issued. No hand-drying supply at the food prep sink, and food handlers lacked hair restraints. Leaks and rust need repair.

headline: Fly glue strips hung; rust and damaged floor
summary: Fly glue strips hung from the bakery ceiling must be removed and replaced with proper insect control. Rust, stained cutting boards, and black caulking were found. A leaking pipe, damaged floor with standing water, and peeling ceiling paint also need repair.

headline: Dirty cooler interior and water-damaged ceiling tiles
summary: The interior top and bottom of a prep cooler in the waitress station area were dirty. A few ceiling tiles in the dining area were water damaged and must be replaced.

headline: Re-inspection passed; food handler certificates missing
summary: Several food handlers did not have food handler certificates. Management was told all food handlers must show proof of training. Floors, walls, and baseboards in food prep areas need grease and debris cleaned.

headline: Rat droppings found; more pest control required
summary: About 6 rat droppings were found under dry storage shelving in the rear prep area. Additional pest control is required and citation issued. No food handler certificates could be found, and no allergen training proof was on site for certified managers.

headline: Roaches, mouse droppings, and flies; multiple citations
summary: About 3 live roaches were found in a bus pan with clean dishes and on the floor behind a reach-in cooler. About 15 mouse droppings were found behind a drink cooler; citation issued. Three live small flies were near the sink. Missing health policies, paper towels, and soap.

headline: Re-inspection: no food handler certificates on site
summary: No food handler training certificates were on site and must be provided at all times. Unnecessary boxes and items stored on the basement floor must be removed.

headline: Greasy kitchen floors; wiping cloth on cutting board
summary: A green and white wiping cloth was stored on a cutting board at the cookline and must be kept in sanitizing solution between uses. Kitchen floors under cooking equipment had thick grease, food debris, and dirt, and must be deep cleaned.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Several food handler certificates on the premises were expired and must be updated. One food allergen training certificate was also expired and must be updated.

headline: Rusted racks in storage and walk-in cooler
summary: Rusted racks were found in the dry storage area and walk-in cooler. The manager was instructed to repaint or replace them.

headline: No soap or thermometer; citation issued
summary: The handwashing sink in the warewashing area had no soap; soap was provided by the end of inspection, and a citation was issued. A restroom sink had no paper towels and a broken air dryer, fixed by the end. No food temperature thermometer was on site, and a citation was issued.

headline: Cold foods held too warm; about 8 lbs discarded
summary: Chicken wings at 44.6–46.8°F, steak at 47.1°F, and salmon at 48.9°F were held in a two-drawer cooler; about 8 lbs were discarded and citation issued. Cooler thermometers were missing, and cutting boards were stained.

headline: Re-inspection: food handlers lack training certificates
summary: Food handlers at the premises had no food handler training certificates. The facility must provide them.

headline: Black mold-like substance above sink
summary: Black mold-like substance was found on caulking above the three-compartment sink. The facility was instructed to remove and replace it.

headline: Dirty freezer, ice machines, and cooking equipment
summary: Interior of a reach-in freezer and both ice machines needed detail cleaning. A large can opener and cooking equipment needed cleaning. Some cutting boards were worn and must be replaced, and a leak at the reach-in freezer needs repair.

headline: More than 25 flies; ice machine buildup; citation
summary: More than 25 flies were found throughout the facility, including in bars, kitchen, and upstairs storage; citation issued. Pinkish black buildup was found inside the ice machine, and walk-in cooler floors and drains had debris. A previous floor cleaning violation was not corrected.

headline: Raw meat held too warm; prep cooler tagged; citation
summary: Raw beef at 47.2°F and pork at 48.3°F were held in the front prep cooler; about 4 lbs were discarded; citation issued. The reach-in prep cooler at 49.5°F was tagged. Bulk containers and frozen food in plastic grocery bags need labels or food-grade containers.

headline: Minor cleaning and repair items
summary: Residue was on the inside of the ice machine door and must be cleaned. A restroom door self-closing device was damaged and must be repaired. Dust on a restroom vent must be cleaned.

headline: Dead insects in prep area; debris in freezer
summary: Multiple dead insects were found in the downstairs prep window area and must be cleaned to avoid attracting other insects. Food debris had built up inside a reach-in freezer and refrigerator. Coffee grounds were on the floor in the service area.

headline: Expired food handler certificates; utensils unprotected
summary: Expired food handler certificates were in the training binder and must be removed and replaced. Utensils on customer tables were not protected from contamination. Prep-line coolers lacked thermometers, and a kids' drink with added syrup needed healthier alternatives.

headline: Worn rear door seal; ice buildup in freezer
summary: Worn weather stripping on the rear exit door could allow pests to enter, and the manager was told to replace it. Ice buildup inside the walk-in freezer must be defrosted and cleaned. Floors need cleaning along wall bases and corners.

headline: Cleaning needed in freezer, beer cooler, and under stairs
summary: Interiors of the reach-in freezer and reach-in beer cooler needed cleaning to remove debris. The floor area under the stairs needed cleaning to remove debris. The facility was instructed to clean and maintain both.

headline: Missing soap and towels corrected; dead bugs on traps
summary: The rear meat prep handwashing sink had no paper towels or soap; both were corrected by the manager and a citation was issued. Sticky traps filled with dead bugs were on ceilings and must be removed. Missing sink stoppers and a broken floor were also noted.

headline: No certified manager; raw meat stored over cooked food
summary: No City of Chicago certified manager was present while TCS foods were prepared and served; citation issued. Raw chicken and pork were stored over bean sprouts and cooked chicken in the walk-in cooler and were rearranged on site. Also a torn cooler gasket and a leak under a handsink.

headline: No service sink and no toilet room ventilation
summary: The facility has no service sink. The toilet room has no mechanical ventilation. The manager was instructed to install both.

headline: Expired certificates and missing handwashing sign
summary: Expired food handler certificates and an expired allergen training certificate for the certified food manager were found. A handwashing sign was missing at the rear prep sink. Management was instructed to correct all three.

headline: Oysters without shellfish tag discarded; citation issued
summary: Oysters on display had no shellfish tag and were discarded (about 5 lbs, $100); citation issued. A walk-in produce cooler lacked a thermometer. Leaks and water pooling were found under sinks, and a handwashing sign was missing.

headline: Re-inspection: no food handler training for employees
summary: Employees had no food handler training. The facility must provide training and keep verification on site.

headline: Food stored on floor and dirty cutting boards
summary: Boxed food was stored on the floor in the rear walk-in cooler and must be raised six inches. Cutting boards had deep scratches and stains. Floors behind cooking equipment and in corners had dirt buildup.

headline: Rust in ice machine; food held too warm; citation
summary: Rust was found inside the ice machine used for ice; ice was destroyed and the machine cleaned, citation issued. Many cold foods, including fish, chicken, beef, and cut melon, were held at 45–57°F; about 15 lbs were discarded. Two cold holding units were tagged.

headline: Vomit cleanup supplies missing; backflow device unverified
summary: Supplies for responding to vomit and diarrhea events, including norovirus-effective disinfectant, were not on site. A backflow device on the utility sink could not be verified. An opening in the front entrance doors and missing toilet room items were also noted.

headline: Cold foods too warm; live roaches found under sink
summary: Eggs, tofu, beef, chicken, cream cheese, and whipping cream were held at 44–46°F in the walk-in cooler; citation issued. Two live cockroaches were found under the three-compartment sink; citation issued. No menu advisory for raw foods and no chlorine test strips.

headline: Grease in disposal area; citation issued
summary: Grease was on the ground and on the grease receptor in the disposal area, a citation was issued to avoid rodent harborage. Bulk containers were unlabeled and fryers, floors, and walls need cleaning. Peeling ceiling paint in the sushi area must be removed.

headline: Knives improperly stored; light out in walk-in
summary: Knives were stored between a prep table and a wall in the meat prep area and must be stored properly. Raw wood on the ceiling above the produce prep area must be sealed. A light in the meat walk-in cooler was out and must be replaced.

headline: Incomplete pest logbook; hair restraint and cleaning issues
summary: The pest control logbook did not include all required records, such as service tickets and the pest company's state license number. Food handlers prepped food without hair restraints. Reach-in cooler interiors and floor drains in dry storage need cleaning.

headline: Dirty drains, floors, and equipment; leaks
summary: Drains throughout need detail cleaning to prevent insect activity. Floors and cooking equipment have grease, dust, and debris. A leak was found under a two-compartment sink, and two hot water knobs needed repair.

headline: Bare-hand food contact; hot and cold food violations
summary: Food handlers touched ready-to-eat foods with bare hands; product was discarded and citation issued. About 22.5 lbs of cold-held foods were above 41°F and discarded. The ice machine had slimy buildup dripping into ice; it was tagged and the ice discarded. Hand sink was blocked and leaking.

headline: Three-compartment sink leaking onto prep floor; citation
summary: The three-compartment sink leaked when water drained, sending wastewater onto the prep area floor; citation issued and drainage service requested. A soiled mop head was not stored properly and must be hung to prevent insect breeding.

headline: No certified manager while handling TCS foods; citation
summary: The person in charge lacked a City certified manager certificate, and no certified manager was on site while sausage and cheese were handled; citation issued. No food thermometer or sanitizer test device was present. Several other previous violations were not corrected.

headline: No allergen certificate on site
summary: No allergen training certificate was on site during inspection. Management was told all certified food service managers must complete and keep proof of allergen training.

headline: Dusty coolers and food debris on walls
summary: Dust had built up on prep area cooler condensers and must be cleaned. Food debris was on dishwashing area walls. One food manager lacked allergen training certificate.

headline: About 25 flies found in dish area
summary: About 25 small flies were found on walls, boxes, racks, and shelving in the rear dishwashing area. The facility must clean affected areas and call pest control; citation issued.

headline: Unlabeled seasoning shakers; missing receptacle lids
summary: Dry ingredients in seasoning shakers were not labeled and must be labeled with the common food name. Toilet room receptacles had no lids. Clutter in the first floor mop sink closet must be removed.

headline: Sink blocked; wastewater backup; core violations
summary: A rear prep hand sink was covered by a cutting board; the person in charge removed it and a citation was issued. Wastewater backed up from sinks and floor drains; citation issued. Earlier violations were not corrected, including a front door with a rodent-sized gap.

headline: Hot chicken discarded; mold-like substance in several areas
summary: About 6 lbs of cooked chicken in a hot-hold cabinet was at 105.6°F and was discarded; citation issued. Black mold-like substance was found in the rear prep rooms and behind sinks. Restroom handwashing signs were missing and cardboard was used on shelving.

headline: Unlabeled dry storage containers; food stored on floor
summary: Dry storage containers were missing common name labels and must be labeled. Food containers were stored on the floor and must be raised six inches off the floor.

headline: Missing health policy and vomit cleanup procedure
summary: No written employee health policy and no written cleaning procedure for vomit or diarrhea events were on site. The coffee maker was tagged and must not be used, since there is no three-compartment sink to clean its baskets. Floor and fan dust also need cleaning.

headline: Cold food at 57-67F; 3-door cooler tagged
summary: About 15 lbs of beef, sausage, gyro meat, and other TCS foods were held at 57-67F in a three-door refrigerator, and about $2,000 of food was discarded. The unit was tagged and may not be used. Greasy cooking equipment and dirty floors were also noted.

headline: Hand washing in 3-compartment sink; raw chicken cooled warm
summary: A food handler washed hands in the 3-compartment sink after handling raw chicken wings. About 15 lbs of cooked chicken wings at 57.9-59.8F were discarded. No steam thermometer was on site, and no covered waste container was in the restroom.

headline: Missing vomit and diarrhea cleanup supplies
summary: Necessary items for responding to vomiting and diarrhea events were not on site. A splash guard was missing from the three-compartment sink. Leaking faucets and drain pipe, a damaged cooler gasket, and greasy hoods were also noted.

headline: Black residue on walk-in cooler shelving
summary: Black residue was found on shelving racks in the walk-in cooler. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Cold foods at 47-50F; cooler at 60F
summary: TCS foods were stored at 47-50F, and about $34 of tomatoes, leafy greens, and salsa was discarded. A cooler held at an ambient 60F and remains tagged and not to be used.

headline: Ice machine debris; raw wood shelves; backflow device
summary: Slight debris was encrusted inside the ice machine and must be removed and serviced. Raw wood shelves in the liquor storage area must be painted or sealed. The backflow device at the utility mop sink must be relocated so it can be serviced.

headline: Improper thawing; wiping cloths stored in water
summary: Beef stock was thawing in a sink without cool running water, and in-use wiping cloths were stored in plain water without sanitizer. Bulk dry storage was under fire suppression lines. Missing handwashing signs and damaged cooler handles were also noted.

headline: Ice machine interior and floors need cleaning
summary: The interior of the ice machine in the side service and prep area must be cleaned and maintained. Floors behind the bar, in the dish area, and inside the walk-in cooler also need cleaning. Re-inspection passed.

headline: No hot water at food prep hand sink; no pest log
summary: The hand sink in the food prep and dishwashing area had no hot water, a priority violation that was cited. No pest control logbook with required information was on site.

headline: Raw chicken and steak at 45-46F; discarded
summary: Raw chicken at 46F and steak and burgers at 45F were held in a prep cooler; about 15 lbs ($100) were discarded. Minor grease spills inside the fryer must be cleaned. Citation issued; the facility passed with conditions.

headline: Personal drinks in prep area; unlabeled salt and seasonings
summary: Employee drinks and personal belongings were found in food prep areas, and salt and seasonings lacked labels. A meat grinder had food buildup, and the deep fryer oil filter had grease. Burnt-out light and broken ceiling tiles were noted; food handler certificates were not posted.

headline: Slimy ice machine; cold food up to 53F discarded
summary: A thick black slimy substance was found inside the ice machine, and it was not to be used until detail cleaned and sanitized. Cheese, lettuce, fish, and shrimp at 44-53F were discarded (about $65). Thermometers were missing from refrigeration units.

headline: Clutter in rear gangway; regrout needed
summary: Unnecessary items, including milk crates and an unused steam table, were stored in the rear outside gangway and must be removed to prevent pest harborage. Floor tiles with deep seams in the rear cooking area must be regrouted. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Dirty overhead vents; exposed ceiling above prep
summary: Scoops were stored inside dry food containers in the rear prep area. Dirt and debris buildup were found on overhead vents in restrooms and kitchen. An exposed ceiling above the prep area must be covered and sealed. Waste receptacles were missing.

headline: Hot fryer leak; trash and debris near drains
summary: A leak on the espresso machine was spilling coffee and water into the dining room and must be repaired. Dirty plumbing fixtures, excess trash and food debris near floor drains, and thermometers missing from front prep coolers were also noted.

headline: No health policy; sanitizer not food-safe
summary: No employee health policy, vomit cleanup plan, or pest control logbook was on site. Cleaner labeled for floors and bathrooms was used at the three-compartment sink; plain chlorine bleach was provided during inspection. Missing paper towels and soap were supplied on site.

headline: No certified person in charge; raw sushi advisory missing
summary: No valid city sanitation certificate was posted or on site while TCS foods were prepared. The manager arrived about 50 minutes later. The menu lacks a raw or undercooked food advisory. Fish was thawed at room temperature.

headline: Food on floor; dead insects in dry storage
summary: Food stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler and dry storage had to be elevated six inches. Soiled wiping cloths and cardboard lining were found. Heavy grease under the cooking line and dead insects in dry storage must be cleaned.

headline: Ice machine mold-like substance; missing restroom signs
summary: A black mold-like substance was found on the interior panel of the ice machine used for customer ice; it was a priority violation. Handwashing signs were missing in the restrooms, and food debris was found inside cold holding units.

headline: Yogurt, lunch meat, and eggs at 55-58F
summary: About 15 lbs of packaged yogurt, lunch meat, and eggs were held at 55-58F and were discarded (about $300). The person in charge was instructed to keep cold foods at 41F or below.

headline: No certified manager on premises; sanitizer wrong
summary: No city-certified food service manager was on premises. The low-temperature dish machine used a quaternary ammonium sanitizer at 100 ppm not made for food-contact surfaces. Pest control log had no entries since 2022; the unwrapped knives were corrected on site.

headline: No person in charge present; no soap at bar sink
summary: No person in charge (PIC) was present at inspection, and no certified food manager with a city certificate was on duty while chicken and salads were prepared. The bar hand sink had no soap. Low cold water pressure was noted at a hand sink.

headline: Floors not clean behind and under equipment
summary: Inspector found floors behind and under equipment not clean. The manager must clean them.

headline: Dirty dust pans and standing water on floors
summary: Dust pans had food buildup and were instructed to be washed and inverted to dry. Cooking and food prep areas needed cleaning, and floors had standing water after mopping. Coving needs repair, and allergen training certificates are needed.

headline: Rodent droppings and flies; cold food above 41F
summary: About 60 small rodent droppings were found in the rear warehouse storage area and inside bins, and about 30 flies were flying in the produce area. Milk, yogurt, cheese, and other cold foods were held at 49-51F; about $500 of food was discarded.

headline: Missing food handler training; leaking pipe
summary: A male employee lacked food handler training on site. A leak was found at the pipe under the three-compartment sink, and multi-use utensils were not stored inverted.

headline: Pest control log incomplete; insect device above food
summary: The pest control log was missing many 2025 service receipts; the manager printed and added the missing receipts during inspection. An insect control device was installed above a food prep station and must be moved. Ice machine exterior and a leaking faucet were also noted.

headline: No written vomit and diarrhea procedure on site
summary: No written procedure or necessary supplies for vomiting and diarrhea events were available on site; no citation was issued. Beverages and items were stored on the grocery floor, and mops were not hung to dry.

headline: Mouse infestation; no manager certificate on site
summary: Over 300 mouse droppings were found on floors, under equipment, and in the washroom and office. The manager on duty had no original food sanitation certificate, no employee health policy was provided, and no test strips were on site.

headline: No summary report posted for public
summary: No previous inspection summary was posted for public view, a priority foundation violation. Rusted racks inside a three-door cooler and debris on griddle filters were also noted; they must be repainted or replaced and cleaned.

headline: Unlabeled containers; wet wiping cloths on cutting boards
summary: Items out of original containers near the wok station lacked product-name labels. Wet wiping cloths were stored on cutting boards and were instructed to be kept in sanitizing solution.

headline: Dusty ceiling vents
summary: Ceiling vent covers above the prep area and inside the rear washroom had dust buildup and must be cleaned and maintained.

headline: Chicken and rice at 50F; food stored on floor
summary: Chicken at 50.1F and rice at 50.5F were held in the prep cooler; about 10 lbs ($50) were discarded. A prep cooler at 55F must not be used until reinspected. Food and single-use items stored on floors, and milk crates used as shelving.

headline: Cold salads at 45F; no employee health policy
summary: About 48 lbs (about $131) of salads held at 45.3F were discarded, and the salad cooler at 45.7F was tagged; it is now 32F air temperature. Sink access was blocked by a pan. A kids' chocolate milk exceeded the 130-calorie limit.

headline: Dish machine sanitizing too cool; placed on hold
summary: The high-temperature dish machine sanitized at 92F, below the required level. It was corrected on site with a 'held for inspection' tag and must be repaired and approved by the city before use. Grease, debris, and a missing data plate were also noted.

headline: Restroom ceiling gap; base coving missing
summary: A large gap was found in the restroom ceiling and base coving was missing in the rear and restroom areas. Unused non-functional equipment was present and must be removed. Signage was missing at the rear hand sink.

headline: Hand sink blocked; hot water too cool; sewage overflow
summary: A produce prep hand sink was blocked with an out-of-order sign and tape. Hot TCS foods at 113-130F and cold foods at 46-56F were discarded (about $700). Hot water was 66-94F, and wastewater overflowed from floor drains.

headline: Storage cooler running too warm
summary: A two-door cooler in the rear storage area held only non-TCS items but ran at 50.1F. Inspector required repair or replacement so it stays at or below 41F.

headline: Rear door not rodent or insect proof
summary: The rear door was not rodent or insect proof and had a gap underneath, and the facility must make it proof. Cutting boards had deep grooves, and fryers were greasy. A food handler and the certified manager lacked proof of required training.

headline: Black slime in self-serve ice machine
summary: A self-serve ice machine in the dining area had black slime dripping onto ice cubes used for customers, plus food debris in the ice bin. Also a slow-draining utility sink, missing floor grout, and a burned-out hood light.

headline: No handwashing sink in rear; unapproved layout changes
summary: There was no handwashing sink where the meat slicer and three-compartment sink are, and walls were added without approval. Raw worn wood was used to hold display shelves. The ice machine drain was routed into a handwashing sink.

headline: About 45 mouse droppings; manager lacks allergen training
summary: About 45 mouse droppings were found in the rear food prep area, dishwashing area, and near the front hand sink and registers. The rear sink had a leak, floors had debris, and the manager had no allergen training certificate.

headline: Aluminum foil wrapped around equipment
summary: Several pieces of equipment were wrapped in aluminum foil. The manager was instructed to remove it.

headline: Live roaches and mouse droppings throughout facility
summary: Three live roaches and about 60-70 mouse droppings were found throughout, including on floors under cooking equipment, on basement shelving, and in the dishwashing area. Eggs, raw chicken, and meatballs at 53-75F were discarded (about $100).

headline: Frozen raw salmon without parasite records; no allergen certificates
summary: Raw frozen salmon was in the kitchen freezer without parasite destruction records; about 10 lbs (about $140) was discarded. No consumer advisory for raw sushi was on the menu, and no food handler training records were kept.

headline: Cold foods at 50F; cooler serviced during inspection
summary: Tomatoes, sour cream, and beef cheek were held above safe cold temperatures; about 65 lbs (about $270) were discarded. The cooler at 50F was not to be used until repaired; it was serviced and read 30F after inspection.

headline: No hot water in customer restrooms; no food handler certificates
summary: Customer restroom hand sinks had no hot water, a priority violation. The food prep and warewashing areas lacked exposed hand sinks. Grease buildup, a lighting problem in the storage area, and missing food handler certificates were also noted.

headline: No pest control logbook; no food handler certificates
summary: No pest control logbook was on premises; the manager must provide one from a licensed Illinois pest control operator by the reinspection date. No food handler certificates were on premises. This was a fail result.

headline: No city-certified food manager while TCS food prepped
summary: No city-certified food sanitation manager was on site while chicken and turkey were being prepared. Inspector required a manager on site at all times and a posted certificate in plain view of customers.

headline: Improper vacuum-packaging practices; room-temperature pickles
summary: The facility did not meet variance requirements for reduced-oxygen packaging, and no HACCP documentation was on site. About 17 lbs of pickled cabbage, ginger, and peppers held at room temperature were discarded. Paper towels and hair restraints were also missing.

headline: No certified food manager; sanitizer at 0 ppm
summary: No certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared, and the person in charge had no certificate. Sanitizer read 0 ppm at the three-compartment sink; cold food and hot food were discarded at a total of about $140.

headline: Grime buildup in drains
summary: Grime buildup was found in drains throughout the prep area and dining room. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Small hole in basement floor
summary: A small hole in the basement floor needs sealing. The inspector instructed the facility to correct and maintain it.

headline: Gaps under doors; canned goods used as shelving
summary: Inspector found 1/4-inch gaps at the bottom of the front entrance door and between side exit doors, and the manager was told to seal outer openings to prevent pest entry. Canned goods were propping up sales-area shelving; manager was told to provide proper shelving equipment.

headline: Torn cooler door gaskets
summary: Rubber door gaskets were ripped on the prep-area stand-up cooler and the reach-in cooler under the grill. They must be repaired or replaced. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Debris in ice machine; worn cutting boards
summary: Slight encrusted debris was found inside the ice machine, which must be cleaned and serviced. Worn, stained cutting boards and a worn manual can opener were noted. The certified food manager's allergen training certificate had expired.

headline: Missing handwashing signs in restrooms
summary: Handwashing signs were missing at the hand sinks in the common area women's and men's restrooms. The facility must provide them.

headline: Rear door has opening at bottom
summary: The rear exit door had a small opening at the bottom and must be rodent proofed. The ice machine door and an outside dumpster lid were also in poor repair. Expired food handler training was noted.

headline: Unlabeled spices and a missing sink splash guard
summary: Parsley, salt, and sugar were kept out of original containers without product-name labels; manager was told to label them. The rear hand sink lacks a washable splash guard, which must be installed.

headline: No certified manager on arrival; hot water over 120F
summary: No original certified food manager certificate was on site at arrival; a manager arrived about 40 minutes later, a priority foundation violation. Four kitchen hand sinks had water at 123-134F and must not exceed 120F. Sliced tomatoes at 64F were discarded.

headline: Expired allergen training for certified managers
summary: Allergen training certificates for certified food managers were expired. The inspector instructed the facility to provide current certificates.

headline: Chicken stored in plastic-lined freezers and garbage cans
summary: Plastic lining was used across the inside of chest freezers, and 55-gallon garbage cans held large amounts of chicken. Inspector required food-grade equipment of sufficient size to allow first-in, first-out rotation. Re-inspection passed.

headline: No proof of food handler or allergen training
summary: No proof of food handler training was provided for any food handlers. No proof of allergen training was provided for employees with city sanitation certificates. The facility must provide proof for all.

headline: Dead insects over dish area; missing food handler certificates
summary: Light shields with dead insects were found above the rear dishwashing and storage area and must be cleaned. Several food handlers lacked food handler certificates, and a certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Mouse droppings in dry storage and under prep station
summary: About 10 mouse droppings were found in a dry storage corner and another 10 under a prep station on the line. The inspector instructed the facility to remove them and detail clean the area. Clutter, dirty coolers, and wiping cloths on a prep table were also noted.

headline: 40-50 cockroaches on glue boards near cook line
summary: About 40-50 adult cockroaches, dead and alive, were on glue boards under a two-door cooler in the main cook line. The inspector required removing them, sanitizing, and contacting licensed pest control. Also, a leaking cold water supply at a hand sink.

headline: Foil on storage shelves; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Multi-use utensils were not stored inverted, and aluminum foil lined storage shelves. The certified manager is missing allergen training and must obtain it and keep verification on site.

headline: Bare-hand contact, glove misuse, flies, and 0 ppm sanitizer
summary: A cook touched food with a gloved hand and tasted it without washing, and a food handler bare-hand cut melon; the melon was discarded. Sanitizer read 0 ppm at a one-compartment sink. About 30 small flies were flying in several areas.

headline: Missing backflow device; broken floor tiles
summary: A backflow prevention device was not located at the bar ice maker, so it cannot be serviced. Broken floor tiles under the kitchen sink and grill, stained cutting boards, a burnt-out hood light, and grease buildup on the hood were noted.

headline: Ice machine and reach-in interior need cleaning
summary: The ice machine interior and reach-in cooler interior must be cleaned and maintained. The front prep counter and shelving need cleaning, and floors at the service counter need cleaning to remove spills and debris.

headline: Fryer grease and loose wall base at prep area
summary: Deep fryers had grease, dust, and food debris inside the bottom drain opening. A loose black wall base in the food prep area and loose floor coving near the hot line were noted. Also a loose sink knob in the men's restroom.

headline: Hand sink blocked and missing faucet
summary: A hand sink in the rear dishwashing area was missing its faucet and was blocked, so employees could not use it. This is a priority violation. Handwashing signs were missing from all sinks, and an insect control device was installed above food.

headline: Greasy sides of cooking equipment
summary: Sides of cooking equipment had a buildup of grease. The facility must clean, sanitize, and maintain them.

headline: Food stored on walk-in freezer floor
summary: Food product was stored on the floor of the walk-in freezer and must be elevated. Dust buildup on shelving, reach-ins, and window sills; missing garbage lids; stained ceiling tiles; and cluttered rear aisles were also noted.

headline: Roach and rodent infestation; cold food at 50-55F
summary: About 30 live cockroaches and about 300 rat droppings were found, plus live larvae in grains and pasta. Eggs, hamburgers, cheese, and sour cream were held at 50-55F in a prep cooler, which was tagged. Additional pest control service is needed.

headline: No signed health policy; no food handler certificate
summary: No signed employee health policy was on site, and a food employee lacked a food handler certificate. The certified food manager had no allergen training. Core violations from a prior inspection, including a non-flushing toilet and basement clutter, were not corrected.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No city-certified food manager with a valid original certificate was on site while nacho cheese, ground beef, and deli meat were prepared. There was no hand sink in the prep and dishwashing area, and no written employee health policy.

headline: No dump sink in coffee prep area
summary: The front coffee prep area has no dump sink. A dump sink with hot and cold running water connected to city plumbing must be installed.

headline: Dirty ice machine; sink blocked; food too warm
summary: The downstairs ice machine had black and brown slime dripping onto ice, and the front bar hand sink was blocked. About 15 lbs of cold foods at 44-54F were discarded (about $600). Vomit cleanup supplies were missing.

headline: Vinegar fly traps near dry storage
summary: Vinegar cups were used as fly traps on dry food storage shelves; the inspector instructed the facility to keep them away from food. Brooms and dust pans were stored too close to clean utensils.

headline: Cutting board in poor condition; missing food handler training
summary: A kitchen cutting board in extremely poor condition with deep blackened grooves must be replaced. A utility sink lacks a backflow device, and food handler training is needed for all required employees.

headline: Cooked foods not date-marked; broken thermometer
summary: Multiple containers of cooked chicken, lamb, and peas held over 24 hours in the walk-in cooler were not marked with discard dates. A broken thermometer and unlabeled bulk food were also noted. Milk jugs were being used to store mango drinks.

headline: Plastic crates and cardboard used as shelf liners
summary: Plastic crates were used to elevate stored items, and cardboard lined cooler shelves. Raw wooden framing under the prep glass shields must be sealed to be smooth and cleanable.

headline: No certified food manager; multiple sanitation violations
summary: No certified food manager (CFM) was on site while chicken, sausage, and cheese were prepared and served. Also missing metal stem thermometer, hair restraints, and sanitizer test strips. Flour and dirt buildup and several missing ceiling panels were noted.

headline: No allergen training on site for person in charge
summary: No allergen training was on site for the person in charge (PIC). Employees holding a valid city manager's certificate must obtain verification.

headline: Walk-in cooler at 48F; torn gaskets
summary: The walk-in cooler holding chicken and beef was at 48.1F ambient air and was tagged and held for inspection. It must be repaired or replaced to stay at 41F or below. Torn gaskets on a prep cooler and the walk-in were also noted.

headline: Dry ingredient containers unlabeled; no cooler thermometers
summary: Dry ingredient containers at the rear prep area lacked labels, and ambient air thermometers were missing inside prep coolers. Grease buildup on the floors under the deep fryers must be cleaned more frequently. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Cooked pork in grocery bags; rusted shelving
summary: Cooked pork was stored in grocery bags in the walk-in cooler; food-grade bags or containers are required. Rusted shelving, mold-like residue, dried food debris, and inadequate lighting were also noted. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Shellstock tags lacking sold-by dates
summary: Numerous shellstock (shellfish) tags did not have a date recorded for when the last shellfish was sold or served. This is a priority foundation violation.

headline: Dried food debris behind coffee machine
summary: Dried food debris was found on the floor behind the coffee dispensing machine. The inspector instructed the facility to clean it to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Live roaches and dead roaches found in food prep area
summary: About 6-8 live roaches were seen in the rear food prep area, including near freezers, cooking equipment, and the dish machine, plus dead roaches. Black mold-like buildup was found inside the ice machine used for ice served to customers. No probe thermometer was present.

headline: Dumpster overflowing; no food handler certificates
summary: The outside dumpster lids would not close because trash was overflowing, a priority violation cited. Food handler certificates were not on site, and a rear exterior door had a 1/2-inch gap. Floor debris under shelving was also noted.

headline: Open drink in food prep area; dirty soda ice chute
summary: A cook had an open beverage in the food prep area and it must be in a covered container outside the area. The plastic ice chute on the soda dispenser also needs cleaning.

headline: Black slime in ice machine; no working thermometer
summary: Black slimy buildup was found inside the ice machine panel, dripping onto ice for customers. The high-temperature dish machine had no working temperature gauge. Soiled wiping cloths, fryer buildup, and a 3-compartment sink leak were also noted.

headline: Food containers missing common-name labels
summary: Food storage containers lacked labels showing the common name of the food. The inspector instructed the facility to provide them. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Employee drank from open container in kitchen
summary: A food employee was seen drinking from an uncovered beverage container in the main kitchen. Cooked noodles, cooked chicken, and dumplings were held above safe cold temperatures; about 30 lbs (about $200) was discarded on site. Also a 1/4-inch gap at the front door and an unlabeled container.

headline: Torn cooler door gasket; food debris in dish area
summary: A torn gasket on the walk-in cooler door must be repaired or replaced. Light food debris and grime were found on dish area floors and walls and must be detail cleaned.

headline: Wet wiping cloths on prep surfaces; grease buildup
summary: Wet wiping cloths were left on several prep surfaces and must be stored in sanitizing solution between uses. Grease, food debris, and dirt were found on floors under cooking equipment and along walls. Dust was on fans, light shields, and vents. Re-inspection passed.

headline: Missing covered trash and paper towel waste bins
summary: A covered trash can with a lid was required inside the employee restroom. A waste receptacle for used paper towels was also required at all prep-area hand sinks.

headline: No handwashing sign in men's restroom
summary: No handwashing sign was posted in the men's toilet room. The inspector instructed the facility to provide one.

headline: No pest logbook since 2022; missing certificates
summary: No valid city food service sanitation certificate was posted; a citation was issued. The pest control logbook for 2023 was missing; the last on-site visit was 9/2022, and a citation was issued. No food handler certificates were on site. Milk crates were used as shelving, and soiled mop heads were stored improperly.

headline: Cardboard shelf liners and greasy kitchen floor
summary: Passed. Cardboard lining shelves in basement rear storage must be removed to prevent insect breeding spots. The first-floor kitchen floor had dirt, grease, and debris under and behind equipment, which must be cleaned to prevent pests.

headline: No hand-washing signs; staff without hair restraints
summary: No hand-washing signs were near exposed sinks in food prep and rear dishwashing areas; they must be posted. Employees prepared and served food without hair restraints, which are required at all times during food prep and service.

headline: Food handler certificates missing or expired
summary: Some food handlers had no certificate or an expired one and must obtain valid ones. Wiping cloths were not kept in sanitizer when not in use. Also: a leaking rear sink faucet, food buildup on walk-in cooler racks, broken floor tiles, clutter, and a dirty freezer floor.

headline: Freezer ice buildup, rusty shelving, leaking faucet
summary: Passed. Excessive ice buildup in the ice cream chest freezer must be removed and the interior cleaned. Rusty shelving was found in the walk-in cooler. A leaking faucet base at the main kitchen prep sink must be repaired. Peeling paint on walls and ceiling in a rear second-floor storage room must be repainted.

headline: Unsafe hot and cold food temperatures; food discarded
summary: Buffet food was held too warm or too cold: wings at 110–120°F, tuna salad at 47°F, ceviche at 49°F. Hot food must be 135°F or above; cold food 41°F or below. About 40 lbs was discarded. The produce-area hand sink was inaccessible with a hose on its water line. A baker wore hoop earrings.

headline: Missing cooler thermometers; toilet door not self-closing
summary: Passed. Small prep coolers were missing thermometers; the business was instructed to provide and maintain them. The toilet room door in the rear prep and warewashing area does not self-close and must be corrected.

headline: Rear door gap and food debris buildup
summary: Passed. A half-inch gap at the rear exit door must be rodent-proofed. Food debris was found on bar equipment and a slicer, with calcium in the ice machine and moldy hand-sink caulking. Unused dirty equipment in storage must be removed.

headline: No food handler certificates on premises
summary: No food handler certificates were on premises to review; they must be provided. A sink pipe leak was dripping into a bucket, and two large holes were in the wall near plumbing. Prep coolers had excessive dried food debris and lacked thermometers inside.

headline: Restroom hot water too hot; citation issued
summary: First-floor restroom handwashing sinks reached 121–126°F; the required range is 100–120°F. Users cannot control the temperature, and a citation was issued. Also stained cutting boards, grease buildup in deep fryers, damaged floor tiles, and moldy caulking in the dishwashing room.

headline: Pest control logbook had no 2025 reports
summary: The pest control logbook had no 2025 reports; a citation was issued. Food handler certificates were not posted, and the manager lacked an allergen training certificate. Coolers lacked thermometers; knives and wiping cloths were stored improperly. Also missing handwashing signs, milk-crate shelving, and a washroom light.

headline: Manager lacked allergen certificate; washroom fan broken
summary: The certified food manager had no allergen training certificate; management was told all managers must show proof. The washroom ventilation fan is not working and must be repaired or replaced. Also needing cleaning: grease trap and storage container exteriors, and the floor under the 3-compartment sink.

headline: No vomit or diarrhea cleanup; no customer barrier
summary: No clean-up procedure for vomiting or diarrhea was observed; the inspector required one. The front service line lacked protection between the prep cooler and customers; a sneeze guard was required. Also: grease spill outside, unfinished wall base, and a burned-out hood light.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings; live roach found
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings were found on floors, walls, electrical outlets, inside fryer cabinets and bottoms of coolers in prep, storage and dining areas. One live roach was in prep. Dumpster overflowing with trash and loose lids was also cited.

headline: Restroom lacked toilet tissue and paper towels
summary: Restroom had no toilet tissue (citation issued) and no paper towels at its sink. A utility sink had no running water; a handwashing sink drained slowly. Food spills and debris were on prep area walls and floors.

headline: No health policy; uncovered bins; missing certificates
summary: No employee health policy on site at inspection. Washroom garbage receptacles had no lids; lidded trash cans required in women's and unisex washrooms. Employees working without food handler certificates; one-month grace period for new hires.

headline: Cleaning needed; water leak near mop sink
summary: Clean stainless countertops around handwash sinks, prep tables, convection ovens and hot holding units. Repair water leak from wall-mounted water filtration unit near the mop sink. Clean floors in customer washroom and walk-in cooler.

headline: Mold in ice machine; unsafe food temperatures found
summary: Ice machine had black and pink mold dripping onto ice. About 10 lbs cooked tuna held at 88-112°F was discarded. About 4.5 lbs house-made sauces at 56°F were discarded. About 15 lbs raw clams were discarded over sourcing rules.

headline: No certified manager; outdated report posted
summary: No certified food manager was on site while soup, chicken, beans and avocado were prepared and served (citation issued). Posted inspection report was from 2022 and must be the most recent. Customer men's restroom lacked a handwashing sign.

headline: No certificate posted; flies throughout facility
summary: No City of Chicago food manager certificate was posted on site (citation issued). More than 20 small flies were found throughout the facility, including dry storage, prep areas and dining room. Manager told to minimize fly activity.

headline: Over 30 flying insects; treatment required
summary: Over 30 flying insects were found on walls, shelves, ceiling and equipment in front and rear food prep areas. Staff were told to clean affected areas and consult a pest control company to treat the premises (citation issued).

headline: Unlabeled bulk food; oversized pots
summary: Bulk flour, sugar and other containers had no labels. Pots were too large for the three-compartment sink; a written alternative washing and sanitizing method is required, and pots may be removed from the premises.

headline: Live flying insects; no certified manager
summary: About 25 live small flying insects were on basement ceilings and walls. No certified food manager was present while chili (180°F) was prepared and served. Chicken, Italian beef and sausage at 44-48°F in the prep cooler were above 41°F. Handwashing sink was blocked.

headline: Mouse droppings and no certified manager
summary: Over 80 mouse droppings and numerous flying insects found in prep area. No certified food manager present while food was served. About 30 lbs of cold food held above 41°F was discarded. Handwashing sink blocked; soap and paper towels missing.

headline: Cold food too warm; handwashing sink problems
summary: Lobster and chicken in the front prep cooler were 49.9°F to 78.2°F, above the 41°F limit; 23 lbs discarded. Handwashing sink lacked soap (fixed on site) and paper towels, and was blocked by a container. Ready-to-eat chicken was not date-marked.

headline: Missing handwashing sinks; dead insects found
summary: Two handwashing sinks were missing or unusable; citation issued. No soap in two washrooms. Dead insects on basement storage floors. Also: no splashguard, frozen meat in a plastic grocery bag, and cleaning and repair needs.

headline: Floors and vents need detail cleaning
summary: Floors in corners by the bread holding unit and in the prep back room need detail cleaning to remove food spills. A vent under the prep unit also needs cleaning to remove dust.

headline: Torn door gasket on prep cooler
summary: A torn door gasket inside the two-door prep cooler under the meat counter must be replaced. No other issues noted.

headline: No washroom fans; sink leaks; no allergen training
summary: Neither washroom has mechanical ventilation; ceiling exhaust fans must be installed. Two leaks at the three-compartment sink (faucet base and right basin drain). Both certified food managers lacked allergen training (citation issued).

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; eggs too warm
summary: Dish machine at the bar had 0 ppm chlorine; manager replaced the empty bottle (citation issued). Three dozen eggs at 68.5-70.5°F were held above the 41°F limit. Ice machine had black, pink slime dripping onto ice. Three-compartment sinks leak.

headline: In-use scoops in standing water; no faucet
summary: In-use scoops were stored in room-temperature water at the front condiment cooler; they must sit on a clean, sanitized surface or in water at 135°F or above. The three-compartment sink has no faucet and must get one.

headline: Door gap and overflowing dumpster cited
summary: Rear receiving door had about a 1-inch gap at the bottom. Overflowing dumpster kept its lid from closing and was cited as a food source and hiding place for rodents. Previous grease and floor violations were not corrected.

headline: Hot food held too cool; staff refused discard
summary: Cooked pork sausage (101°F) and ribs (118°F) were held too cool for hot holding and not discarded when ordered. No reheating log was shown. The operator also blocked the inspector from finishing; citation issued.

headline: No health policy, spill kit, or thermometer
summary: No written employee health policy on site and no spill kit or cleanup procedure for vomiting and diarrhea. No handwashing sink at the front bar. No backflow device at the mop sink. No commercial dumpster contract or dumpster on site.

headline: Worn cutting boards; greasy equipment; dirty floors
summary: Cutting boards need replacing when worn. Cooking equipment needs grease removed. Floors in corners, under heavy equipment, sinks and storage racks had dirt and debris. Walls around three-compartment sink had dirt and stains. Complaint inspection passed.

headline: Improper thawing; unlabeled salt and sugar
summary: Frozen meat was thawing in a plastic container in the food prep area; staff were told to thaw food under cold running water, in the refrigerator, or in the microwave as part of continuous cooking. Salt and sugar were stored without labels.

headline: Water too cool and wastewater backing up
summary: Hot water reached only 97°F; minimums are 100°F for handwash sinks and 110°F for the three-compartment sink (citation issued). Wastewater backed up from the floor drain at that sink. Screen door and rear door have holes and gaps. Ceiling tiles also damaged.

headline: Re-inspection passed; cooler records and buildup
summary: Re-inspection passed. No proof of temperature monitoring for cooling units. Shoes stored in walk-in cooler; ice buildup inside several cooling units; tape used on cooler gaskets; mold-like dirt on produce display case; trash and food debris on walk-in floors.

headline: Door gap, missing handles, worn walls
summary: A 1/4-inch gap at the bottom of front door must be sealed. Reach-in cooler missing door handles. Dust and dirt on walls, vents and floors; no covered waste bin in washroom; missing floor tiles and damaged ceiling tiles.

headline: Oven spills, leaking faucet, hair restraints
summary: A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. Interior of the oven needed cleaning to remove food spills. A leak was found at the three-compartment sink faucet. Staff were told to correct and maintain.

headline: Slime in ice machine; bird droppings noted
summary: Ice machine had excess black slime at the water reservoir and panels, and ice is used for human consumption (citation issued). Oven not under mechanical ventilation. Uncorrected earlier issues include bird droppings and unenclosed outdoor units behind the rear exit.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; torn gaskets
summary: Re-inspection passed. Exposed handwashing sinks near egg mixer, in coffee bar and meat cutting room had no signage. Torn gaskets on walk-in cooler and 3-door prep cooler must be repaired. Dust on vent in employee toilet room.

headline: Re-inspection passed; labeling and upkeep fixes
summary: Re-inspection passed. Found unlabeled BBQ and jerk sauces and equipment not stored inverted. Other items: rust, damaged refrigerator gaskets, gravel refuse area, stained ceiling tiles, and non-working lights.

headline: No person in charge or certified manager present
summary: No person in charge was present. No certified food manager was on duty while chicken, sandwiches and soups were prepared and served (no citation issued). Leaking faucet at three-compartment sink and leakage at front handwash sink. Manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Grease, food debris, and burnt-out hood bulbs
summary: Grease buildup on cooking equipment, walls, floors and shelving in kitchen and prep areas must be degreased and sanitized. Food debris and spills on floors and surfaces need detail cleaning. Burned out bulbs at the hood must be replaced.

headline: No certified manager; slime in ice machine
summary: No certified food manager on duty while chicken and french fries were prepared and served (citation issued). Black and pink slime inside ice machine dripping onto ice; manager discarded ice and cleaned the machine during inspection.

headline: Rat droppings and live flies found
summary: About 13 fresh rat droppings were on the floor in rear food storage, with 40 small live flies on walls and produce carts. More pest control is needed. A 1/4-inch gap at the front door was also noted.

headline: Mold in ice machine; damaged gaskets found
summary: Black mold-like substance inside the ice machine; ice must be destroyed and machine cleaned. Opening at base of front entrance door must be sealed. Damaged gaskets on two cold holding units; containers stored on floor; no quaternary ammonium test kit.

headline: Two food handlers lacked required certificates
summary: Re-inspection: two food handlers were working without food handler certificates. Staff were instructed to provide and maintain certificates on site.

headline: Unlabeled food; expired and missing test strips
summary: Rice, lentils and beans were unlabeled. No quaternary ammonium (quat) sanitizer test device was on site, and chlorine test strips had expired in 2023 (citation issued); manager ordered one for delivery. No food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Dead roach found in basement storage
summary: A roach carcass was found in the basement storage area. Manager was instructed to clean and maintain the area. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: Unused basement items; missing food handler certificates
