summary: Unused equipment and unnecessary articles in the basement storage area should be removed to prevent pest harborage. No food handler certificates were on site, and the certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Leaking sink drain; grease cleaning needed
summary: Drain line leaking under exposed handwashing sink next to the three-compartment sink, which also drains slowly; must be repaired. Also clean ice machine interior, deep fryer, prep table and floor grease behind stove.

headline: Insect device removed; rust and buildup noted
summary: An insect control device on the food prep counter was to be removed. Also rust on walk-in cooler shelving, ice buildup in basement freezers, soil on racks above the kitchen handwash sink, and mineral buildup inside the dish machine.

headline: Grease and debris; expired allergen certificate
summary: Food debris in small freezer used for fries, and grease on sink and equipment exteriors. Hand sink hanging from wall must be repaired. Food debris on walk-in freezer floor. Certified manager's allergen certificate is expired.

headline: Missing hand soap and paper towels
summary: Paper towels and hand drying devices were missing at prep sink (citation issued). Hand soap was missing at prep/dishwashing sink; staff supplied it during inspection. Food stored on floor in prep area; milk crates used for shelving.

headline: Peeling ice machine coating; cleaning needed
summary: Ice machine's protective coating is peeling and must be removed so it can be cleaned. Three-compartment sink drain, area under flat-top grill, and rear prep, storage and dishwashing floors need detail cleaning to prevent possible pest activity.

headline: Live flying insects found in prep area
summary: About 15 live small flying insects were on walls, ceilings and sauce containers in the rear prep and dishwashing areas. Additional pest control service is needed; citation issued. Washroom door lacked a self-closing device.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; ice scoops stored poorly
summary: No handwashing signs or posters near handwashing sinks in any washroom. Ice scoops were improperly stored in the front bar area and must be kept in a clean container to prevent contamination. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: Missing spill kit, pest log, backflow device
summary: No vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure or spill kit was on site. No pest control logbook was found. No backflow prevention device at the mop sink faucet. These must be provided; no citations were issued.

headline: Utensils stored in standing water and on towels
summary: Inspector saw in-use utensils kept in standing water between uses and wet utensils placed on cloth towels. Staff were told to follow the health code: store utensils properly and do not use cloth towels for drying.

headline: Stored supplies and clutter in rear areas
summary: Single-use items stored on the floor in rear prep area; clutter in rear storage. Manager told to raise items six inches off the floor and remove unused items to prevent pest hiding spots. No pests reported.

headline: Clean grease trap, deep fryer, prep shelves
summary: Clean the exterior of the grease trap, the deep fryer, and the bottom shelves of prep tables. Inspection passed; no other issues noted.

headline: Greasy hood filters; cleaning required
summary: Hood system filters had a buildup of grease. Person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain them. License inspection passed.

headline: No certified food manager on site
summary: No certified food service manager was on site, and no certificate was posted, while sausage and chicken were handled and served. Staff were instructed to obtain one.

headline: Mold in ice machine; expired food handler certificate
summary: Mold-like substance inside ice machine; ice had to be destroyed and machine cleaned. Also an opening at the front door, an expired food handler certificate, missing allergen training for two employees, and no chlorine test kit.

headline: Cold food too warm; prep cooler tagged out
summary: Chicken (48.1°F), cut tomatoes, cut onions and beef were above the 41°F limit; about 25 lbs were discarded. The front prep cooler could not keep 41°F, so it was tagged and cannot be used until serviced and reinspected.

headline: Leaking handwashing sinks; frozen chicken thawed in water
summary: Dishwashing and prep handwashing sinks in poor repair, with a severe leak and a broken pipe underneath (citation issued). Frozen chicken was thawing in a bucket of water; staff told to thaw properly. The certified manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Missing door closer and waste baskets at sinks
summary: Men's washroom lacked a self-closing door device. No waste baskets at the exposed handwashing sinks in the prep area. Microwave interior, prep tables and shelves above prep coolers need cleaning. Manager instructed to correct.

headline: Leaks, missing utility sink, spill supplies
summary: Spill procedure items were not on site. Gasket damaged; ice buildup in two door freezer and cold unit. Backflow device on one-compartment sink and handwash faucet leaking. No utility sink installed. Non-working unit outside rear exit must be removed.

headline: Missing sign; food debris; unused basement items
summary: No handwashing sign at kitchen handwashing sink. Food spills and debris on cooking equipment, coolers, freezers, prep tables and shelving. Unused articles and equipment in basement were to be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: No certified manager posted; sink drain leak
summary: No City of Chicago food sanitation certificate was posted while hamburgers and pizzas were cooked and served. Manager was told a certified food manager must be present at all times (citation issued). Drain line leaks under food prep handwashing sink.

headline: Broken cooler handle; burned-out hood bulbs
summary: Broken door handle on a prep cooler and burned-out light bulbs at the ventilation hood were noted; both were to be repaired or replaced. The certified food manager also lacked allergen training.

headline: Damaged caulk at prep handsink
summary: Damaged caulk left a gap between wall and rear prep handwashing sink. Must be repaired so surface is smooth and cleanable. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: No certified manager; cold food too warm
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken was being prepped. Cold food in the deli cooler was too warm: cooked rice 58.2°F, pork 59.8°F, ham 62.4°F. A handwashing sink was blocked by wiping cloths and containers.

headline: Splashguards, shelving, and wall repairs needed
summary: Splash guards needed at prep and utility sinks; knife rack and portable sneeze guards for catering buffets were required. Containers and equipment stored on floor. Backflow device missing at utility sink; holes in walls; no covered receptacle in women's washroom.

headline: About 30 live flies; missing soap and towels
summary: About 30 small live flies were on walls, ceiling, window, menu screens and near the mop sink; pest control required (citations issued). No hand soap at rear prep sink and no hand drying at front prep sinks.

headline: Splashguard needed at bar handsink
summary: Splash guards must be installed on both sides of the exposed handwashing sink behind the bar. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: Cleanup needed: ice bin, toilet room, floor drains
summary: Ice bin interior and toilet room need cleaning. Food containers were stored on walk-in cooler floor and must be elevated six inches. Loose faucet in toilet room must be repaired. Debris along floors and drains throughout facility.

headline: Grease on deep fryer side
summary: Grease was found on the side of the deep fryer and must be cleaned. No other issues noted.

headline: Ice machine buildup; damaged cabinet; boxes on floor
summary: Ice machine door and sides had buildup and must be cleaned. A front bar cabinet door was off its hinges and needs repair. Boxes were stored on the floor and must be at least six inches up.

headline: Leaking pipe; greasy drains and hood filters
summary: Grease-like residue on drains of the three-compartment sink. Leaking pipe under rear prep handwashing sink. Grease built up on hood filters. Person in charge told to clean and repair.

headline: Cold food too warm; raw food advisory missing
summary: Milk (46°F), Italian beef (44°F), gyro sauce (48°F) and cut tomatoes (47°F) were above 41°F in the prep cooler. Menu lacked a raw or undercooked food warning. Garlic bread was stored against cardboard; manager's allergen training was expired.

headline: Leaking sink faucet; allergen training missing
summary: No handwashing sign at rear sink. Cutting boards have deep, dark grooves. Leaks at base of three-compartment faucet. Mops improperly stored in rear storage. Floors in corners and under heavy equipment were dirty. Certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Live fruit flies found in storage and washroom
summary: About 30 to 50 live fruit flies were found in dry storage and the men's washroom. Pest control service recommended. Also an ice scoop was left lying on ice, debris around the dumpster, soiled mop heads, and dusty vents.

headline: Sink water too cool; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: Three-compartment sink water measured 83°F; minimum 110°F required. Hot water restored by close of inspection (citation issued). Bulk containers unlabeled; rusted shelving. Food handler certificates for all employees were not available; allergen training for certified managers missing.

headline: No certified manager; washroom ventilation broken
summary: No City of Chicago food sanitation certificate posted while chicken and beef shawarma were prepared and served (citation issued). Inoperable washroom ventilation was a repeat violation (citation issued). Torn gasket on prep cooler; wall opening in washroom; light shield missing.

headline: Re-inspection passed; cardboard and dusty vents
summary: Re-inspection passed. Cardboard was on rear storage shelving and must be removed; shelving should be smooth and easily cleanable. Dust buildup on ceiling vents in rear storage area must be cleaned.

headline: No certified manager; no spill kit; no soap
summary: No certified manager on duty while chicken and fish were handled and served (citation issued). No spill kit or cleanup procedure for vomit and diarrhea. Soap and paper towels were missing at sinks. Outside dumpster has broken lids (citation issued).

headline: Ice machine slime; missing handwashing signs
summary: Ice machine interior had black-pink slime that drips onto ice; it was cleaned and sanitized during inspection (citation issued). No handwashing signs in employee washroom. Wiping cloths left on prep tables; dusty vents and dirty floor drains.

headline: Restroom lacks mechanical ventilation
summary: The restroom has no mechanical ventilation. Operator was instructed to install it. This license inspection passed.

headline: Re-inspection passed; cleaning and splashguard needed
summary: Front bar handwashing sink needs a splashguard. Ice scoop was stored on a ledge; a clean container is needed. Equipment, liquor wells and ice bins need cleaning. Floors, drains, walls and vents also need cleaning.

headline: Re-inspection passed; cleaning and storage needed
summary: Prep tables and shelving have dried food debris, dust and dirt. Garbage containers in women's restroom have no covers. Black walls and ceilings in prep should be lightened for cleaning. Basement storage needs organizing; elevate items six inches off floor.

headline: Leak under bar sink
summary: Leak at the P-trap under the three-compartment bar sink; staff were told to correct and maintain it. Canvass inspection passed.

headline: Over 100 mouse droppings and flying insects
summary: Over 100 mouse droppings in prep, sales and storage, plus numerous flying insects and no pest log (citations issued). Mouse-soiled chips were displayed for sale. No certified manager on duty while Italian beef was served. No hot water at sinks.

headline: Mouse droppings and flies; oysters discarded
summary: Over 60 mouse droppings found in basement, bar, fryer cabinet and prep; over 30 flies. Dead mouse in utility room. Oysters lacked shellstock tags and were discarded on site (citation issued). Pest service required on or after 11/17/2026.

headline: 80 small flies found over bread prep
summary: 80 small flies were on the ceiling in bread preparation areas; pest control operator must be notified and flies eliminated (citation issued). Floors and floor drains in bread prep area need cleaning.

headline: Cold food too warm in prep cooler
summary: Beans at 45°F and green salsa at 44°F were stored in the three-door prep cooler, above the 41°F limit for cold food. Management was told to keep cold food below 41°F. A citation was issued.

headline: Food handler training required for all handlers
summary: Re-inspection: all food handlers must obtain the required food handler training. Complaint re-inspection passed.

headline: Splashguard gap; dusty cooler condensers
summary: Small gap between the splash guard and the dishwashing area handwashing sink must be reattached. Accumulated dust on reach-in cooler condensers in prep area must be cleaned.

headline: Walk-in freezer ice buildup; loose toilet
summary: Walk-in freezer had excess ice on floor, walls and ceiling; must remove ice and detail clean. Staff restroom toilet was loose and must be secured.

headline: No certified manager; warm chicken discarded
summary: No certified food manager was on site while chicken was being prepped. Thirty pounds of chicken at 52.2°F in the rear prep cooler were discarded and denatured. No paper towels at a handwashing sink. Previous violations were not corrected.

headline: Food on floor; unlabeled salt; burnt-out bulb
summary: Food was stored on the floor in dry storage and must be raised six inches. Salt was in a container without a label. One burnt-out light bulb over the cook line must be replaced.

headline: Food on floor; no basement washroom ventilation
summary: Food containers stored on floor under prep tables; elevate six inches. Staff hair restraints not worn. Ice buildup in basement ice cream freezers and dust on vents. Basement employee washroom has no mechanical ventilation; it must be provided.

headline: Fish and ribs too warm; no test devices
summary: Fish at 46.2-56.3°F and short ribs at 51.8°F in the meat prep cold unit were above 41°F; manager discarded them (citation issued). No quaternary ammonium or chlorine sanitizer test devices on site. Several food handler certificates had expired.

headline: Re-inspection: door, drains, and storage issues
summary: Re-inspection passed. Rear exit double doors were not rodent-proof; the door sweep must be replaced. Floors in all three prep areas and floor drains need cleaning, basement items must be raised six inches off the floor, and hoods need cleaning.

headline: No hot running water throughout premises
summary: No running hot water throughout the building; sinks measured 73.6°F to 83.6°F. Staff must provide at least 110°F at the three-compartment sink and 100°F at other sinks. Priority violation with citation. Food debris and dust on dishwashing area walls.

headline: Food temperatures unsafe; no certified manager
summary: No valid city food sanitation certificate on site. Empanadas at 110-125°F in the hot holding unit, below the 135°F standard. Milk, chorizo, yogurt and sausage at 45-46°F in prep coolers, plus a display cooler at 44°F.

headline: Live roaches found; food too warm; soap missing
summary: Four live small roaches were found on the basement floor near meat freezers and grease trap; more pest control is needed (citation). About 200 lbs of cold food at 46-68°F was discarded. Soap and towels were missing at one sink.

headline: Leaking sink faucet and dirty floors
summary: Leak at the three-compartment sink faucet must be corrected and maintained. Floors in front cooking area and rear storage area need cleaning to remove debris.

headline: 15 or more live flies in prep area
summary: Fifteen or more small live flies were flying through the prep area and on cooler exteriors and shelving (citation issued). Pest control service required. Prep tables and shelves had dried food, dust and dirt; no chemical test strip kit.

headline: No certified manager; expired certificate posted
summary: No certified food manager on duty while chicken and soup were prepared and served; posted certificate was expired (citation issued). Leaking cold water faucet and slow drain at front prep and dishwasher handwash sinks. Food containers stored on walk-in cooler floor.

headline: Leaking faucet, ice buildup, missing signs
summary: No handwashing signs in basement washrooms. Employees not wearing hair restraints while food was prepared and served. Excess ice in chest freezers and a leaking three-compartment sink faucet. Peeling paint, dirt under shelving, and burnt-out bulbs in walk-in cooler.

headline: Unsafe food temperatures, roaches, flies, broken equipment
summary: Failed. About 300 lbs of cold food held at 49-68F was stored in prep areas and a cooler; person in charge discarded it. About 6 live cockroaches and 25 live flies were seen, some near working ingredients. Overhead contamination risk in basement and broken equipment and thermometer were noted.

headline: Missing thermometer, pest gap, uncorrected violations
summary: Complaint inspection failed. Needed thermometer missing on 3-door prep cooler. A 1/2-inch gap at rear receiving door bottom must be sealed. Other issues include unlabeled bulk ingredients, missing food handler certificates, and a drawer cooler with unsafe cold-holding temperatures still not repaired and not in use.

headline: Freezer ice, greasy floors, dirty drains, poor lighting
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. Chest freezers in basement have excessive ice buildup. Floors have heavy grease, food debris, and meat blood in places, and floor drains are dirty. Walk-in cooler lighting is inadequate. These must be cleaned and corrected.

headline: No employee health policy; door gap lets pests in
summary: Passed with conditions. No employee health policy was on site; manager must provide one with signed employee acknowledgements. Front entrance door has a 1/4-inch gap at the bottom that must be sealed tight to keep pests out.

headline: Expired certificates; about 5-6 roaches found
summary: Failed. Food service sanitation certificate on site had expired. About 5-6 live roaches were found in basement storage. Also noted: no sanitizer test strips, soiled wiping cloths on prep tables, unlabeled food containers, expired food handler certificates, and no manager allergen training.

headline: Residue build-up on bar floor drains
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Inspector found floor drains and bar-area floor with residue build-up. Person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: No certified manager; food held too warm; flies
summary: Failed. No certified food manager was present while butter and cheese were prepared. About 300 lbs of cream cheese held at 68-75F was discarded. A prep cooler reading 54.2F is tagged out. About 20-30 live fruit flies found in dish room. Pest control recommended.

headline: Dirty dumpster area that may draw rodents
summary: Complaint inspection failed. Dumpster overflowing with garbage and grease container encrusted, which inspector said could draw rodents and pests; a priority citation was issued. Also noted: food stock on floor, dirty coolers, washroom, and hood. Food handler and allergen training were missing.

headline: Unlabeled bulk containers; door gap; allergen training missing
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Bulk containers in rear storage were unlabeled and must show common food names. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear door bottom must be sealed to block pests. Other items: missing 3-compartment sink stoppers, non-self-closing washroom door, and no valid manager allergen training.

headline: Faucet leak and weak sink water pressure
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Inspector noted a leaking faucet at the 3-compartment prep sink and a front bar handwashing sink with very low water pressure. Manager instructed to repair and maintain both.

headline: Bar dump sink lacks splash partition
summary: Complaint re-inspection passed. The bar dump sink sits beside serving areas with no partition to prevent contamination. Person in charge was told to install a smooth, easily cleaned partition.

headline: Cabinet grime, sink leak, and grease trap buildup
summary: Passed. The black cabinet interior at Tall Boy Taco had grime and debris. Leak at the bottom of the two-compartment sink. Grease traps near the dish machine and sinks have rust and residue. Cracked, damaged caulking at a hand sink.

headline: No certified manager while handling food; drain backup
summary: No certified food manager present while staff handled tamales, pork and chicken; citation issued. Drain backed up with grease and waste; plumber fixed it during inspection. Also needed: cleaning of gaskets, equipment, floors and wiping cloth storage.

headline: No certified manager; walk-in cooler too warm
summary: Fail. No certified food manager certificate on site, and no allergen training for the manager. Walk-in cooler at 46°F, above the 41°F limit. Hot and cold holding equipment was not on site. Toilet room receptacle lacks a cover. Priority violation.

headline: Calcium buildup inside ice machine
summary: Passed. Calcium buildup was found on the interior panels of the ice machine. The person in charge was instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Debris and litter in bar broom closet
summary: Passed. The broom closet in the bar area had a buildup of debris and litter. The person in charge was instructed to clean it and keep it maintained.

headline: Ice machine buildup, worn cutting board, sink leak
summary: Passed. Ice machine interior needs cleaning to remove buildup. A worn, discolored cutting board needs replacing. Leak at a hand sink drain trap. Floors and air vents need detail cleaning. Sponges should be replaced when worn or discolored.

headline: Undercooked food not marked; openings; training gaps
summary: Fail. Animal-derived foods that can be served undercooked lacked the required asterisk on both menus. Openings at front and rear doors. Some food handlers had expired or no food handler training certificates. Leaking faucets and missing hood bulbs.

headline: Debris around grease trap in rear area
summary: Passed. Debris was found around the grease trap in the rear area. The operator was instructed to clean and maintain that area.

headline: Worn sink stopper gasket; duct tape on grease interceptor
summary: Passed. The stopper gasket at the first basin of the three-compartment sink is in poor repair. Duct tape on screw covers for the floor grease interceptor must be removed, and the surface made smooth and cleanable.

headline: Allergen training proof missing for managers
summary: Passed on re-inspection. No proof of allergen training for City of Chicago certified food managers. The operator was instructed to obtain the certificate and keep it on site.

headline: Sink sprayer leak; damaged prep area floor
summary: Passed. Rubber gaskets on the margarita machine need cleaning to remove buildup. Leak at the sprayer nozzle at the three-compartment sink in the prep area. Prep area floors need regrouting and missing tiles replaced.

headline: Mouse droppings in basement; citation issued
summary: Fail. About 20 mouse droppings in the basement. A licensed pest control company must service the facility on or after 11/18/2026. Citation issued. Also: openings at the front door base, missing hand sink splash guards, rust, and burnt-out hood lights.

headline: Mouse droppings found; failed inspection
summary: Fail. About 12 mouse droppings on the floor under rear shelves. Front door has a gap at the bottom. Dumpster overflowing, so the lid will not close. Also missing handwashing sign, food probe thermometer, and pest records under the old business name.

headline: Leaking pipe at rear hand sink
summary: Passed. The rear hand-washing sink had multiple leaks at the pipe. The operator was instructed to fix the leaks and keep the plumbing in good repair.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; debris outside and inside
summary: Passed. No handwashing signs at hand sinks in the rear prep area or restroom. Crates and debris around the outside dumpster, and debris on the utility room floor. Certified manager had no allergen training certificate.

headline: Dish machine rinse too cool; ice machine mold
summary: Fail. High-temperature dish machine rinse measured 130°F, below the 180°F minimum; a hold tag was placed on site, and the machine was not in use. Black moldlike buildup inside the ice machine. Openings at front and rear doors.

headline: Repeat issues: scoops, gaskets, missing allergen proof
summary: Passed on re-inspection. Ice scoops stored on mats on equipment; cooling units with worn gaskets; prep area toilet room not self-closing; dry storage floors and basement clutter; dim prep lighting; no allergen certificate on site.

headline: Gap under restroom door; floor debris and grime
summary: Passed. A half-inch gap under the exterior restroom door needs repair. Debris on the rear storage floor near the walk-in cooler, and grime under the three-compartment sink and in storage areas, must be cleaned.

headline: Many repairs ordered; restroom and plumbing problems
summary: Passed on re-inspection, but many repairs are required. A 25th-floor toilet and urinal are not working; other restrooms work. Leaks at a compartment sink and dish machine, and no cold water at a bar sink. Grease and food buildup must be cleaned.

headline: Wall gaps and mop storage issues; passed
summary: Passed. Large gaps where walls meet and exposed brick beneath rear shelving were not sealed, which could let pests in. Damp mop heads were stored in the utility sink; the operator was told to provide a rack.

headline: Live flies found; dishwasher not sanitizing; failed
summary: Fail. About 15 small live flies throughout bar and prep areas; pest control was ordered. No certified food manager on site. Low-temperature dish machine had 0-5 ppm chlorine, needs 50-100 ppm; unit tagged and held. Overflowing garbage cans.

headline: Utensils not sanitized; no thermometer or test strips
summary: Multi-use utensils were not sanitized at the three-compartment sink. No food thermometer or sanitizer test strips were on site. Also missing handwashing signs, a hair restraint lapse, and wall repairs in the butcher area and walk-in.

headline: Missing one-compartment sink; washroom door not self-closing
summary: The waiters and bar station at the front had no one-compartment sink; the operator was instructed to install one. The basement employee bathroom door also did not self-close and needs a self-closing device.

headline: Missing grill splashguard; no hair restraint
summary: No washable splashguard was between the front exposed handsink and prep table at the grill station, and one must be installed. A food handler was prepping food without a hair restraint.

headline: Ice scoop on ice; no allergen training certificate
summary: An ice scoop was stored on top of ice cubes in the ice machine. The employee restroom lacked a handwashing sign. The food service manager had no allergen training certificate; the operator was told to obtain one.

headline: No food handler training certificates provided on site
summary: No food handler training certificates were provided for any food handlers. Also aluminum foil and plastic film used as liners, ceramic cups and bowls needing lead-safety documentation, and holes in lower walls including the prep area.

headline: Unconnected ice machine; no grease trap
summary: An ice machine behind the service counter was not connected to the city water source. The three-compartment sink had no grease trap, the washroom door did not self-close, and the city-certified manager must comply with allergen training requirements.

headline: Leaky bar handsink; porous sink faucet repair
summary: A rear bar handsink leaked from the bottom of the basin, and the three-compartment sink faucet was repaired with porous, non-cleanable material. Shipping plastic was also on the ice machine exterior. Repairs were required.

headline: Repeat violation; manager lacks allergen training proof
summary: A prior violation was not corrected, and the on-duty manager had no proof of allergen training; a citation was issued. Also an ice machine door hanging off, old soda splashes in the beverage station, a faucet that keeps running, and greasy floors under equipment.

headline: Standing water in cold holding units; dirty floors
summary: Standing water and debris were in the cold holding units. A dirty rag under a pipe must be removed to avoid a pest breeding place. Floors around cooking equipment, in the walk-in, and under the sink need cleaning.

headline: Orange film inside ice maker
summary: Interior surfaces of the ice maker had an orange film build-up. The operator was instructed to clean and maintain them.

headline: Dead mice removed on site; certificates missing
summary: Two dead mice were found in the basement and removed during the inspection; the area must be cleaned. Two food handlers had no training certificates on site. Also stained ceilings and missing front prep floor tiles.

headline: Entry gap in front door; missing hand-wash sign
summary: Inspector saw an opening at the bottom of the front entrance door that could let pests in, and no handwashing sign at the toilet room sink. Floors under sinks and around cold holding units needed deep cleaning.

headline: Washroom door lacks self-closing device
summary: The washroom door had no self-closing device. Management was instructed to install one.

headline: Failed: mouse droppings and gnawed chip bags
summary: Inspector found 15-20 scattered mouse droppings on chip display shelving and two gnawed bags of chips. The operator was told to remove droppings, discard chips, and call pest control. Citation issued; front door weatherstripping also worn.

headline: No temperature indicator for high-temp dishwasher
summary: The high-temperature dish machine had no irreversible registering temperature indicator. The operator was instructed to obtain one; this is a priority foundation violation.

headline: Cleaning needed in cooler, washroom, and counters
summary: Passed, but the inspector asked for cleaning of counters around handsinks, prep tables, ovens, hot holding units, and walk-in racks, plus the walk-in cooler and customer washroom floors.

headline: Failed: no certificate, health policy, or thermometer
summary: No City of Chicago food service sanitation certificate was on site. No employee health policies were on site, and no stem thermometer was available to measure food temperatures.

headline: No allergen-trained certified food manager observed
summary: No certified food manager with allergen training was observed. Persons holding the city sanitation certificate were instructed to complete training. Documentation must be provided.

headline: Standing water by dish area; expired allergen certificate
summary: Standing water was on the floor behind the dishwashing and prep area, which must be kept dry to prevent a pest breeding place. The on-duty manager's allergen training certificate had expired and must be renewed.

headline: Missing vomit and diarrhea cleanup procedure
summary: Inspector found no written procedure for cleaning up vomit and diarrhea events, and no spill kit. No citation was issued; the operator must provide the procedure.

headline: Failed: no sanitizer, test kit, or certificate
summary: No chemical sanitizer for equipment and utensils, and no sanitizer or warewashing test kit on site. The original food service sanitation certificate was not on site, only a voided photocopy. Also missing sink stoppers and a rusted dishroom floor drain.

headline: Failed: no prep handsink or patio water
summary: No handwashing sink in the main prep area, and no water at the outdoor patio bar due to a broken pipe. No current pest control logbook or customer menu with consumer advisory on site. Dust and debris needed cleaning before opening.

headline: Unused deep fryer in rear storage
summary: Passed. An unused deep fryer was found in the rear storage area. It must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: Failed: about 100 mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. About 100 mouse droppings were found on the floor, under, and behind equipment and on storage shelves. Pest control was recommended before reinspection; the last service was July 20, 2026. Food handler certificates were expired. Hair restraints were corrected on site.

headline: Failed: foods and cooler too warm; citations
summary: Failed. Several TCS foods were held at 44 to 52°F and discarded, about $100 worth. A cooler at 46°F ambient was tagged. Vinegar was used on sushi rice without an approved lab letter, and the dishmachine had no final-surface temperature indicator.

headline: Leaking sink pipe; missing floor drain cover
summary: Passed. The left compartment pipe of the three-compartment dishwashing sink was leaking and must be repaired. One floor drain cover was missing in the dry storage room and must be replaced.

headline: Ice scoop storage and food buildup issues
summary: Passed. Ice scoops were stored on top of the second-floor ice machine and must be kept in a clean container. Food spills and buildup were on sinks, prep tables, and shelves. Dust and debris were in floor drains and on walls.

headline: Failed: no certified manager; flies not controlled
summary: Failed. The person in charge lacked the original city food manager certificate while TCS foods were being handled. More than 25 small flies were seen at the front prep area, unresolved from a prior visit. Food stored on floors and grease buildup were also noted.

headline: Greasy outdoor grease bin needs maintenance
summary: Passed. The outside grease receptacle had grease buildup on its exterior. The manager was instructed to keep outside receptacles maintained in a way that does not attract pests.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; warm restroom sink water
summary: Passed. A torn gasket was found on a two-door prep cooler on the prep line and must be repaired or replaced. One of two men's room washbowl sinks measured 75.1°F and was flagged as improper temperature.

headline: Dead roaches found; grease and clutter throughout
summary: Passed re-inspection. Dead Oriental roaches were found in the dining room, front prep storage, water heater closet, and rear prep area, and spider webs were in the men's restroom. Grease buildup, a leaking three-compartment sink, and clutter were also noted.

headline: No food handler certificates; dirty floors and walls
summary: Passed re-inspection. No food handler certificates were on site. A digital insect control device was stored above a prep table with an open box of string cheese and pizza dough pans and must be moved. Floors and walls had stains and food crumbs.

headline: Fryers, stove, and floors need cleaning
summary: Passed. The inspector instructed cleaning of fryer bottoms, fryer and stove exteriors, and refrigeration interiors where needed. Floors under cooking and refrigeration equipment in the kitchen, and basement floors behind freezers, also need cleaning.

headline: Missing hood filters in front prep area
summary: Passed re-inspection. No filters were found in the hood above the cooking equipment in the front prep area. The operator must provide filters when the area is used for cooking again.

headline: Failed: food too warm; sink drainage floods
summary: Failed. TCS foods held at 45 to 53°F were discarded, about $600 worth, including chicken, cheeses, and batter. The three-compartment sink floods when one compartment drains; the manager was told to service the sink.

headline: Broken outdoor recycling lid; soiled utility sink
summary: Pass. The lid of the outdoor recycling receptacle was in poor repair and could not close completely. The basin of the floor-mounted utility sink in the rear prep area was heavily soiled and must be cleaned.

headline: Broken handwash sink handle; dusty ceiling vents
summary: Passed. The cold water handle on the dishwashing area handwashing sink was stripped and must be repaired. Dust had built up on ceiling tiles and ceiling vent covers above the dishwashing area.

headline: Hair restraint lapses corrected; dusty vents
summary: Passed. Some kitchen food handlers were not wearing hair restraints; this was corrected on site. The inspector also instructed cleaning of floors under and behind kitchen equipment, a storage room, and dust on washroom ceiling vents.

headline: Failed: eggs left out warm; four live roaches
summary: Failed. 78 dozen eggs left on a dining area table measured 72.6°F and were discarded, about $300. Four live roaches were found in a frame near the posted license, and pest control service was required. A crack in the rear exit door must be sealed.

headline: Inspection summary not posted
summary: Pass with conditions. No inspection summary was posted on site. The manager was instructed to keep the most recent summary posted where customers can see it, and a citation was issued.

headline: Missing handwashing sign at pantry sink
summary: Passed re-inspection. The exposed handwashing sink in the second-floor pantry had no handwashing signage. The operator was instructed to provide it.

headline: Dead roaches throughout; milk crates used as shelving
summary: Passed re-inspection. Dead roaches were found throughout the premises, including corners, under shelving and sinks, and on storage, display, and prep table shelves. Milk crates were used as shelving and must be replaced.

headline: Gaps at front and rear door bottoms
summary: Passed re-inspection. A gap was found along the bottom of the front and rear doors. The doors must be tight-fitting to prevent insect entry.

headline: Missing ice bin lids; crates and worn boards
summary: Passed re-inspection. Bar ice bins need lids. Multi-use utensils must be inverted on shelves. Crates were used for storage in the beer walk-in and must be replaced. Worn cutting boards, grease and debris, and dust on hoods were also noted.

headline: Rear door gap; manager lacks allergen training
summary: Passed re-inspection. A 1/4-inch gap at the rear exit door sweep must be fixed to rodent-proof the door. One food manager did not have a food allergen training certificate.

headline: Failed: 25+ live flies and trash outside
summary: Failed. About 25 or more live small flies were on walls, ceilings, boxes, and prep and dish areas; this was not corrected from the prior visit. Trash and debris were piled around the outside compactor. Front door openings and a missing cooler thermometer were also noted.

headline: Missing handwashing signs; unlabeled flour containers
summary: Passed. Two exposed handwashing sinks, at the first-floor bar and behind the rooftop bar, lacked handwashing signage. Bulk containers of flour and similar items were unlabeled. A dough cutter stored near the basement walk-in coolers must be moved to a prep area.

headline: Expired allergen training for both food managers
summary: Passed re-inspection. Both certified food managers had expired allergen training certificates; the operator was told to retake the courses and keep records on site. Forks and spoons were not stored inverted above the sink.

headline: Failed: food too warm; 50 live flies
summary: Failed. Kimchi, gyoza, and beef base were held at 46.2 to 46.4°F in the produce walk-in; 37 pounds were discarded, about $351. About 50 live small flies were on walls in the dry storage and dishmachine areas. The walk-in cooler ambient was 46°F.

headline: About 200 mouse droppings; prior violation uncorrected
summary: Pass with conditions. About 200 mouse droppings were found on floors, shelves, and under equipment in prep and storage areas. The previous violation was not corrected, and the manager was told to clean all droppings. A leaking hand sink and a food handler without training were also noted.

headline: To-go desserts unlabeled; leaking dish area
summary: Passed. To-go desserts were sold without ingredient, allergen, and trace-back information. Pipes leaked under the three-compartment sink and at a nonfunctioning low-temperature dishmachine. Grease and grime were on floors and walls.

headline: Some staff lack required food training
summary: Passed. Some food handlers lacked required food handler training, and some city food service managers lacked food allergen training. Also noted: a cluttered utility sink area, dusty walls, ceiling vents, and washroom fans, and dirty floors and drains.

headline: Dirty floors and unused fryer in storage
summary: Passed re-inspection. Floors behind and under refrigerators at the rear of the premises were not clean. An unused deep fryer in the rear storage area must be removed to prevent pest harborage.

headline: No posted certificates; manager arrived later
summary: Pass with conditions. No person on site had a posted city food sanitation certificate, and no food handler or allergen training certificates were on site. The certified manager arrived about 2:20 PM. A citation was issued for the posting violation.

headline: Soup cooled covered; expired handler certificates
summary: Passed. Large containers of soup were cooling covered in the produce walk-in cooler; the operator was told to use approved cooling methods. Several food handlers had expired food handler training certificates on site.

headline: Failed: dirty ice machine; ice discarded
summary: Failed. Black dirt buildup inside the ice machine was dripping into ice used for consumption; all ice was discarded. Dust was on prep cooler condensers, food buildup was inside prep coolers, and the three-compartment sink hot water handle was missing.

headline: Greasy cooking equipment; restroom repairs needed
summary: Passed. Exterior surfaces of fryers and cooking equipment had grease and food particles, and walk-in cooler shelves needed cleaning. The women's restroom had no covered receptacles. A loose wall tile and a hole in the men's restroom were noted.

headline: Expired handler certificates; black ice machine slime
summary: Passed. Two of three men's room urinals were not working. Black slime was found inside the ice machine. Two burned-out bulbs were in the cook line hood. Three employees had expired food handler training, and one of five managers lacked allergen training.

headline: No certified manager on duty; no handler certificates
summary: Pass with conditions. No certified food manager was on duty while TCS foods were prepared; the manager arrived at 1:15 PM and a citation was issued. Food was stored on the basement floor, and no food handler certificates were on site.

headline: Failed: overflowing dumpsters and greasy prep floors
summary: Failed. Outside dumpsters overflowed with garbage, lids would not close, and food and garbage lay on the alley ground. A priority violation was cited. Food debris was also in prep coolers, and grease was on the prep floor.

headline: Rear door gap; fryers and vents need cleaning
summary: Passed. The rear exit door was not completely rodent-proofed at the bottom and must be fixed. The inspector also instructed cleaning of the rear interior of the fryers and of dust on kitchen ceiling vents and walls.

headline: Hair restraint lapse and heavy floor debris
summary: Passed. A food employee was preparing food without a hair restraint; the manager was told to ensure restraints are worn. Heavy debris and soil had built up on the floor and must be cleaned.

headline: Damaged cutting board needs replacement
summary: Passed re-inspection. The prep area cutting board above the two-door cooler was pitted with deep dark gouges and must be replaced.

headline: Food storage and labeling problems; no pests
summary: Passed re-inspection. Bulk food and boxes were stored on the floor, scoops were left inside bulk containers, squeeze bottles were unlabeled, and crates were used for storage. Also noted dusty cooler ledge, dirty ice machine panel, and stained ceiling tiles.

headline: No running water at utility sink; restroom repairs
summary: Passed re-inspection. The utility sink had no running hot or cold water and must be connected under city plumbing rules. A soap dispenser was above the prep sink rather than the handwashing sink. A women's restroom had a missing floor tile and outlet cover.

headline: Bar floor debris and soil buildup
summary: Passed. The floor in the bar area had debris and soil buildup. The manager was told to clean and maintain it.

headline: Soil and debris behind equipment
summary: Passed. Soil and debris had built up behind equipment at the front counter and in the basement dry storage area. The manager was told to clean and maintain these areas.

headline: Ice machine, shelves, and floors need cleaning
summary: Passed. A slight buildup was found inside the ice machine. Food buildup was on prep shelves, and dust was on prep cooler condensers. Food debris was on the prep floor, and dust was on prep ceiling tiles. All must be cleaned.

headline: Gap at dining door; unlabeled containers, worn boards
summary: Passed re-inspection. A gap along the bottom of the north dining room door must be sealed to prevent insect entry. Squeeze bottles and shakers were unlabeled, and some door gaskets and cutting boards were worn. Grease also needed cleaning from prep equipment.

headline: Failed: rodent droppings, live roaches, food too warm
summary: Failed. Cold foods including eggs, hamburgers, and cheese were at 47 to 51°F in the walk-in cooler. About 100 mouse droppings and 5 live cockroaches were found in prep, storage, and banquet areas. More pest control is required.

headline: Unlabeled food containers, including flour
summary: Passed re-inspection. Food stored in cold-hold and dry storage containers, including flour, lacked labels showing the common food name. The person in charge was told to label them.

headline: Torn cooler gasket; dusty restroom vent
summary: Passed. A torn gasket was found inside a drawer cooler under the grill and must be repaired or replaced. Dust had built up on a vent in one of two upstairs restrooms and needed detail cleaning.

headline: Dusty ceiling tiles above dishmachine room
summary: Passed re-inspection. Dust had built up on ceiling tiles above the dishmachine room. The tiles must be cleaned.

headline: Hand sink used for prep; foods too warm
summary: Pass with conditions. A handwashing sink was used to wash and chop lettuce; the manager moved preparation to the three-compartment sink and was cited. TCS foods at 45 to 56°F were discarded, about $100 worth.

headline: Sprayer hanging below sink rim
summary: Passed. The sprayer at the main kitchen three-compartment sink hung below the rim of the sink. The operator was told to install a holder to keep it above the water.

headline: Dishmachine sanitizer at 0 ppm; allergen gap
summary: Pass with conditions. The low-temperature dishmachine was sanitizing at 0 ppm chlorine and must reach 50 to 100 ppm; a priority violation was cited. Dishes were to be washed in the three-compartment sink until fixed. Floor tiles at the bar had low grout, and one manager lacked allergen training.

headline: Fryer and pasta cooker need cleaning
summary: Passed. The exterior of the fryer and pasta cooker needed cleaning, and the bottom area of the fryer also needed cleaning. All city food service managers must obtain the required food allergen training.

headline: Food handler without hair restraint
summary: Passed. A food handler was not wearing a hair restraint. The operator must provide and wear one.

headline: Wall buildup above sink; soil under equipment
summary: Passed. Black buildup was on walls above the three-compartment sink. Soil and debris were on the floor under and around equipment throughout the kitchen. The manager was told to clean and maintain both.

headline: Wiping cloths left out; greasy equipment, cluttered basement
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were left on prep tables, not stored in sanitizing solution. Exteriors of cooking equipment, refrigeration interiors, and prep tables needed cleaning. Floors and walls needed cleaning, and some basement areas were cluttered.

headline: Expired certificates; dusty cafeteria vent
summary: Passed. Dust was on the cafeteria ceiling vent, and the floor drain behind the serving counter needed cleaning. Some food handlers had expired certificates, and some food service managers lacked food allergen training certificates.

headline: Missing hand-sink signs; unlabeled bulk containers
summary: Passed re-inspection. Several bar handwashing sinks lacked signage. Bulk dry food containers were unlabeled. Canned beverages were stored under a dripping condensation line in the basement walk-in cooler. A bar handwashing sink drain was leaking.

headline: Many cleaning and repair problems; no pests
summary: Passed. Ice buildup was in ice cream freezers, and dirt was on the ceiling above cutting meat tables. Walk-in freezers had ice, dirt, and pooling water. A large crack in the deli cooler floor must be sealed. Floor drains were dirty, and produce cooler bulbs were burned out.

headline: Floor cleaning needed; loose wall trim by stove
summary: Passed. Floors around cooking and kitchen equipment needed cleaning. A small section of wall coving at the left side of the stove had come loose from the wall and must be reattached or replaced.

headline: Ice machine buildup; dirty bar sinks
summary: Passed. Slight buildup was found inside the ice machine. A metal ice scoop was stored on top of the machine and must be kept in a clean container. The 29th-floor bar sinks and countertop were not clean.

headline: Complaint passed; rear door hole, cleaning needed
summary: Passed. No pests found. Inspector found a hole in the bottom corner of a rear kitchen door and told the operator to seal it to keep rodents out. Also noted dirty grills, fryers, walk-in shelves, dusty vents, and broken floor tiles in both kitchens.

headline: Failed: over six live roaches; food on floor
summary: Failed. Over six live roaches were found on the floor by the heating unit, under rear dry storage shelving, and on a prep table near the three-compartment sink. Employees ate in the prep area, and food containers were on the floor.

headline: Broken cooler gasket; ice machine buildup
summary: Passed. A tall cooler had a broken gasket and must be repaired. Mineral buildup was found inside the ice machine and must be cleaned.

headline: Soil buildup under walk-in cooler shelving
summary: Passed re-inspection. The floor under shelving in the walk-in cooler had soil buildup. The manager was told to clean and maintain it.

headline: Failed: 10 to 15 live roaches; eggs at 80°F
summary: Failed. About 10 to 15 live roaches were found in the dish area, and flies were in the prep area with the front door open; pest control was recommended. Eggs in the prep cooler measured 80.2°F. No certified manager was on site when food was prepared, and no food thermometer was on site.

headline: Moldy ice machines; dishmachine underheated, repaired
summary: Pass with conditions. Black and pink mold was found inside both ice machines; both were detail cleaned on site. The high-temperature dishmachine raised utensils only to 156.1°F, below the required 160°F; a technician repaired it on site.

headline: Failed: eggs unrefrigerated; dishmachine not sanitizing
summary: Failed. 20 dozen raw eggs were found in a kitchen closet and discarded; this was corrected on site. The low-temperature dishmachine read 0 ppm sanitizer and was serviced on site. Heavy buildup inside the dishmachine and missing food handler certificates were also noted.

headline: Not ready: grease, dust, missing handler certificate
summary: Not ready. Grease buildup was inside the deep fryers, and dust was on wire storage shelves in the food prep area. Grease was on the floor under cooking equipment. A food handling employee had no food handler training certificate.

headline: Mop sink lacks backflow device; manager allergen gap
summary: Pass with conditions. Prep tables and walls near the front prep area were not clean. No backflow prevention device was at the mop sink faucet. A previous core violation was not corrected: some food managers lacked food allergen training certificates.

headline: Steak held below safe hot temperature; discarded
summary: Pass with conditions. Steak in the hot-holding unit measured 123.6°F, below the required 135°F. The manager immediately and voluntarily discarded 3 pounds, about $50. The current inspection summary was not posted; a copy was given during the visit.

headline: Leaking sprayer pipe and standing water
summary: Passed. The dishwashing area sprayer pipe was leaking and must be repaired. Standing water was on the prep floor under the dishmachine. Food and dirt had built up in the floor drain and on walls.

headline: Foods at 52°F; prep cooler needs repair
summary: Pass with conditions. Kimchi, soup, chicken, and duck were held at 51.8 to 52°F; 12 pounds, about $300, was discarded. The two-door prep cooler was not maintained and must be repaired. A 1/4-inch gap at the front doors must be sealed.

headline: Unlabeled containers, crates, and greasy surfaces
summary: Passed re-inspection. Squeeze bottles and bulk containers were unlabeled. Crates were used for food storage in the walk-in cooler. Cooler gaskets and cutting boards were worn, and grease was on fryers, rolling carts, and the grease trap lid. Floor grout was missing.

headline: No food handler certificates for employees
summary: Passed. Food employees had no food handler certificates; the manager must provide them. Mineral buildup was also found on the interior of the dining room soda machine ice chute.

headline: Torn walk-in gasket; broken paper towel dispenser
summary: Passed. A torn gasket was found on the inside of the walk-in cooler and must be repaired or replaced. The wall-mounted paper towel dispenser in the rear dish area was not working.

headline: Front door gap; missing cooler thermometer
summary: Passed. A 1/4-inch gap at the front entrance door sweep must be fixed to rodent-proof the door. The grab-and-go reach-in cooler had no thermometer. Dust and food debris were on dishwashing area walls, and one allergen certificate had expired.

headline: Failed: no handwashing sink at dining bar
summary: Failed. No handwashing sink with hot and cold running water was at the dining area bar; one must be installed, and a priority violation was cited. Also noted: no dump sink at the bar, worn cooler gaskets, grease buildup on fryers and ovens, and burned-out prep lights.

headline: Wiping cloths not in sanitizer; dusty vents
summary: Passed. Wiping cloths were left on prep tables instead of in sanitizing solution. Grease and food buildup were on cooking equipment. Dust was on washroom fans and vents, and a water-stained ceiling tile was in the washrooms and storage rooms.

headline: Ice machine buildup and faulty sink stoppers
summary: Passed. Slight buildup was found in the ice machine chute and upper portion. A Coca-Cola stand-up cooler door gasket was not fitted tightly. The three-compartment sink stoppers in the dishwashing area were not working.

headline: Failed: live flies and a roach found
summary: Failed. About 40 live small flies were on prep area walls, 15 at the bar, and one live roach was on a prep area wall. The manager must remove all insect activity by reinspection; pest control was advised. Leaking water and missing ceiling tiles above the mop sink were also noted.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training certificate
summary: Pass with conditions. A previous core violation was not corrected: a certified food manager had no accredited food allergen training certificate. The manager was told to address it, and a citation was issued.

headline: Employee without hair restraint
summary: Passed. A food employee was observed without a hair restraint. The manager was told to ensure all employees wear them.

headline: Oven lacks required mechanical ventilation
summary: Passed re-inspection. An oven in the rear kitchen food preparation area was not under mechanical ventilation. The operator must provide ventilation or remove the oven from the premises.

headline: Failed: 40+ mouse droppings; no manager certificate
summary: Failed. No city food service manager certificate was on site. Over 40 mouse droppings were found behind the front counter, in the kitchen, in the furnace closet, and under the dishmachine. Pest control was required before reinspection; food handlers also lacked certificates.

headline: No food handler certificates; greasy hood
summary: Passed re-inspection. No food handler certificates were on the premises; proof of training for all food handling employees must be shown. The kitchen exhaust hood had hanging grease buildup and must be detail cleaned.

headline: Failed: 5 live German roaches; core violations uncorrected
summary: Failed. Five live German roaches were found in basement prep, rear prep near the three-compartment sink, and dessert prep. Core violations from the prior visit were not corrected, including trapped roaches in monitor traps, a leaking handsink, and holes in basement walls and ceiling.

headline: Worn cutting boards, rust, and dusty vents
summary: Passed. Cutting boards in the prep area need cleaning or resurfacing. Rust stains were on walk-in cooler shelves in the kitchen and basement. Walls, floors, light shields, and vents needed cleaning. All food handlers must get required training.

headline: Failed: 100 live flies, no certified manager
summary: Failed. No city certified food manager was on site while TCS foods were prepared. About 50 live small flies were found in the rear prep area and 50 at the bar. No food handler certificates were on site, and a food handler lacked a hair restraint.

headline: Failed: live flies and dishmachine not hot enough
summary: Failed. The 7th-floor high-temperature dishmachine sanitized at only 140°F; 180°F is required. About 40 live small flies were on walls in the banquet dishwashing area. Cafeteria self-service coolers were missing thermometers.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Passed. Dust was on the cafeteria ceiling vent, and the floor drain behind the serving counter needed cleaning. Some food handlers had expired certificates, and some food service managers lacked food allergen training certificates.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen training noted
summary: Passed. Some food handlers had expired food handler training certificates. Some city food service managers still needed food allergen training. The operator was told to obtain valid certificates.

headline: Expired food handler and allergen certificates
summary: Passed. Some food handlers had expired certificates, and some city food service managers lacked food allergen training. Light dust was on ceiling vents and tiles in the 4th-floor prep and 3rd-floor banquet kitchen. An ice machine panel had light buildup.

headline: Greasy cooking equipment; loose restroom wall tile
summary: Passed. Exterior surfaces of fryers and cooking equipment had grease and food particles, and walk-in cooler shelves needed cleaning. The women's restroom had no covered receptacles. A loose tile and a hole in men's restroom walls were noted.

headline: Debris on kitchen floors under shelving
summary: Passed. Debris was on floors underneath shelving throughout the kitchen. The manager was told to clean and maintain these areas.

headline: Floor tiles need grouting in prep areas
summary: Passed re-inspection. Floor tiles in prep and dishwashing areas need grout where needed to be smooth and easy to clean.

headline: Failed: ice contaminated; dairy and seafood too warm
summary: Failed. The ice machine had pink slime buildup dripping into ice; all ice was discarded. Milk, cream, shrimp, crab, and lobster were held at 45.5 to 55°F in two reach-in coolers; about 15 pounds were discarded. Leaking sink pipes were also noted.

headline: No certified manager, handler certificates, or posted summary
summary: Pass with conditions. The person in charge and the posted certificate lacked a city food sanitation certificate, and no food handler certificates were on site. The inspection summary was not posted. A citation was issued for the certificate and summary violations.

headline: Dust and food buildup on coolers and ceilings
summary: Ice machine interiors have slight buildup; prep cooler condensers are dusty and rubber door gaskets have food buildup. Bar equipment and tabletop have debris; dust on ceiling tiles and vents above dish area. Managers lack allergen training.

headline: Repeat cold-holding failure; cooler at 55.4°F
summary: Repeat violation: lowboy prep cooler held ready-to-eat foods at 45-50.4°F (black beans, mayonnaise dressings, quiche); manager discarded about $200 of food. The same cooler measured 55.4°F with food inside and was tagged held-for-inspection until repaired.

headline: Rodent droppings and flies found; pest log lacking
summary: About 200 mouse droppings found across prep, bar, storage and dining areas; about 15 live small flies also seen. Pest control service needed; pest log shows only one visit this year. Sushi rice lacks a current pH test.

headline: Greasy fryer and floor need cleaning
summary: Clean the bottom and exterior of the fryer, the floor under the fryer, and the can opener blade and sleeve at the prep table. Several food handler training certificates are expired; staff told to obtain valid ones.

headline: Missing thermometers in several reach-in coolers
summary: Several reach-in coolers lacked ambient air thermometers. Manager instructed to provide ambient air thermometers for all coolers.

headline: Single-use items on floor; soiled walk-in floor
summary: Cups, lids and bowls were stored directly on the rear storage floor; they must be kept at least 6 inches up. Walk-in cooler floors under shelves had dried food debris and need regular cleaning.

headline: Flies found in prep and dish areas; pest service recommended
summary: Failed. About 40 or more live small flies on walls, ceilings and in prep and dishwashing areas; pest control service recommended. Also: a gap under the north dining room door, unlabeled squeeze bottles, worn cutting boards, and peeling floors.

headline: Dusty cooler condensers; expired allergen certificates
summary: Dust buildup on some prep cooler condensers must be cleaned. Some food allergen training certificates have expired; certified managers must hold valid certificates.

headline: Employee skipped handwashing between tasks
summary: An employee handled a register transaction with gloves, changed gloves, and used them to push food into the trash without washing hands. Manager coached the employee and a citation was issued. Gloves must be changed at appropriate times.

headline: Missing handwashing sign fixed; holes and tiles noted
summary: Missing handwashing sign at kitchen hand sink was corrected on site. Also: seal two small wall holes near the three-compartment sink, replace loose washroom wall tiles, clean the floor by the ice machine, and remove dust from vents.

headline: Shrimp thawed at room temperature; sink drains poorly
summary: Shrimp was left out at room temperature to thaw; staff told to use cold running water or refrigeration. The three-compartment sink drains poorly and floods when one side drains; manager told to service it. Managers lack allergen training.

headline: No certified manager during egg and milk prep
summary: No certified food manager with a valid certificate was on premises while eggs and milk were being prepared; one must be present at all times. Also: ice machine buildup and dust on dish room ceiling tiles and vents.

headline: Storage under sewer lines; worn floor grout
summary: Single-service items were stored under unshielded sewer lines in the basement; staff told to shield the lines or move the storage. Worn floor grout in prep and warewashing areas holds food debris and moisture; re-grout and maintain.

headline: Insect carcasses throughout basement
summary: Insect carcasses were found throughout the basement. Manager instructed to clean and maintain the area.

headline: Loose handwashing sink in first-floor bar
summary: The handwashing sink in the first-floor bar is loose. Staff were instructed to repair or replace it and keep it in good condition.

headline: Leaking handwashing sink; no employee health policy
summary: Handwashing sink near front prep leaks heavily and was tagged out of order; it must be fixed. No employee illness reporting policy on site. Three-compartment sink floods when draining. Some workers lacked hair restraints; soil under walk-in shelving.

headline: Rusty, dirty walk-in cooler shelves
summary: Walk-in cooler shelves in the kitchen prep area are rusty and dirty. Staff must detail clean them and repaint with food-grade paint or replace them.

headline: No certified manager; hundreds of flies found
summary: No certified food manager on site or posted. About 200 live small flies inside garbage room and 40 in women's employee washroom. Expired food handler certificate and no allergen training certificates. Garbage room needs detail cleaning.

headline: About 20 live flying insects in dining and prep areas
summary: Failed. About 20 live small flying insects were seen on dining room walls, behind the bar, and on food prep equipment. More pest control service is needed. Also: peeling ceiling paint above prep and sink, and a dirty floor.

headline: Unvented oven; outdoor units and bird droppings
summary: Failed. Oven lacks mechanical ventilation and must be vented or removed. Prior violations not corrected: outdoor units, not fully enclosed, must move inside; bird droppings on fence and ground. Broken cooler gasket; grease inside fryer cabinet.

headline: Mineral buildup inside ice machine
summary: Mineral buildup was found inside the ice machine. Manager instructed to clean and maintain it.

headline: Live roaches and mouse droppings found
summary: Failed. Three live roaches found in basement dish area; mouse droppings on basement storage and prep floor. Staff told to clean and arrange pest control before reinspection. Also: faded container labels, wiping cloths not sanitized, missing training.

headline: Unsuitable food containers; heavy hood grease
summary: Plastic buckets, beverage bottles and single-use plates used for food storage are not made of adequate materials. Heavy grease and condensation on the main cook line hood filter must be cleaned.

headline: Stripped sink handle; dusty ceiling vents
summary: Cold water handle on the dishwashing area hand sink is stripped and must be repaired. Ice machine interior has slight buildup. Dust on dishwashing area ceiling tiles and vent covers must be cleaned.

headline: Eggs and other cold foods held too warm
summary: Three dozen eggs in the front prep cooler measured 78.2-81°F; cold foods must stay at 41°F or below. Manager discarded about 9 lbs ($95). Some ready-to-eat foods lacked date marks. Also: cardboard shelf liners, grease buildup, a damaged cooler gasket.

headline: Greasy fryers and dirty floors need cleaning
summary: Clean grease from the bottom of the fryers. Floors and walls around and behind cooking equipment need cleaning, and the basement storage floor under and behind storage needs cleaning.

headline: Milk and cream held too warm; cooler at 45°F
summary: Milk and half-and-half were stored at 44-60°F; cold foods must be held at 41°F or below. Manager discarded 8 gallons of milk and 4 of half-and-half (about $60). Cooler measured 45°F and was serviced. Syrup and debris on prep floor.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; heavy ice in cook-line freezer
summary: Torn gaskets on three coolers (coffee bar, breakfast prep, banquet walk-in) must be repaired. The freezer on the cook line has heavy ice buildup. Inspector instructed removal of handwashing signage at a coffee bar sink.

headline: Water-stained ceiling tiles in dining area
summary: Water-stained ceiling tiles in the front customer dining area must be replaced. Walls in that area also need detail cleaning.

headline: Gaps under rear overhead door; raw wood shelves
summary: Rear overhead door has about 1/4-inch gaps at the sides and must be repaired to fit tightly. Raw wood storage shelves must be sealed. One certified manager lacks allergen training.

headline: Certified manager lacks allergen training
summary: A certified food manager had no allergen training certificate. Staff were instructed to obtain one and keep records on site at all times.

headline: Glass washer sanitizer at 0 ppm
summary: Glass washer at the bar had 0 ppm final sanitizer; manager must provide at least 50 ppm. Also: unlabeled bulk containers, a 3-compartment sink without working stoppers, damaged floor tiles, burned-out prep-area lights, and no allergen training certificates for managers.

headline: Torn cooler gaskets; dusty ceiling vent
summary: Some prep area reach-in cooler door gaskets are ripped and must be repaired. Dust has built up on a ceiling vent cover above the dish area and must be cleaned.

headline: Loose locker room sink; allergen training missing
summary: One of two women's locker room sinks is loose and not working; must be repaired. Pink debris is inside the ice machine in rear prep. Two certified managers lack allergen training certificates.

headline: Fish thawing in standing water; missing thermometers
summary: Two fish were thawing in standing water; staff must use cold running water or refrigeration. Several prep coolers lack thermometers. Freezers have ice buildup, a hood light is burnt out, and one of two managers lacks allergen training.

headline: Rear door not rodent-proofed; fryers need cleaning
summary: Rear exit door is not rodent-proof; staff told to fix it to prevent possible rodent entry. No pests were observed. Also: clean fryer interiors and exteriors, and floors around, under and behind kitchen equipment and in storage areas.

headline: Repeat violations; worn boards and grease buildup
summary: Failed. Previous violations not corrected: boxes on basement floor, missing grout. Also noted: worn cutting boards, a missing cooler handle, wiping cloths not in sanitizer, grease buildup, broken glass on floors, and dirty hood filters.

headline: Damaged ceiling and wall tiles; wiping cloths misplaced
summary: Missing or damaged ceiling and wall tiles. Wiping cloths were stored on prep tables and ice scoops on the ice machine. A handwashing sign is missing, and basement employee restroom ventilation doesn't work.

headline: No certified manager while milk prepared
summary: No City of Chicago certified food manager with a valid certificate was on premises while milk and almond milk were being prepared. A certified manager must be present whenever such foods are prepared.

headline: Doors need rodent proofing; food on freezer floor
summary: Three exit doors need rodent proofing; no pests were seen. Food was stored on the walk-in freezer floor and must be raised six inches. Also: greasy fryer, dusty vents, a broken floor tile, and one manager without allergen training.

headline: No certified food manager on site while cooking
summary: No certified food manager was on site while food was prepared and served; manager told to keep one on site at all times. Also: no food handler certificates, workers without hair restraints, missing ceiling tiles, and no allergen training.

headline: No certified manager; about 50 flies found
summary: Failed. No certified food manager on site while foods that must be kept hot or cold were prepared. About 50 live small flies were found in prep and dishwashing areas. Hair restraints not worn. Prior violations not corrected, including food on floors.

headline: Rodent-proofing gaps and wall holes in warehouse
summary: Several doors have gaps up to 1/2 inch that are not rodent-proof; no pests were noted. Staff must seal all doors. Also: wall holes, leaking sink valves, dusty ceilings, and some shared-kitchen users lacking food handler training.

headline: Dead roaches on glue boards; corrected on site
summary: Dead roaches were found on glue boards and were discarded on site. Other items: clean fryer interiors and exteriors, floors around equipment and sinks, peeling ceiling paint in sushi prep, and dusty vents above cooking equipment.

headline: Plumbing leaks, trash in mop closet, missing splash guard
summary: Ice machine lacks a visible backflow device; a 3-compartment sink faucet handle is in poor repair. Trash is stored in the mop closet and needs a lidded can. Splash guard missing; food debris on floors must be cleaned.

headline: Ice machine and floor debris; missing food handler training
summary: Clean debris from the ice machine interior, walk-in shelving, and floor along wall bases under the two-compartment sink and drain. Cracked light shields in rear prep must be replaced. Some employees lack food handler training.

headline: Food prepped under unprotected overhead; grease buildup
summary: Failed. Food prepared in basement with no ceiling overhead, beneath hanging plastic with unknown liquid and a dead insect. Also: taped ice machine lid, heavy grease, gaps in wall base that could admit pests, greasy hood. Citation issued.

headline: Rodent droppings over 200; live roaches; failed
summary: Failed. More than 200 rodent droppings throughout the facility, including dining booths and prep areas. Four live cockroaches, two crawled into the handwashing sink pipe. Insect carcasses and roaches in traps. Prior pest violation not corrected; citation issued.

headline: One food handler certificate expired
summary: Passed. One food handler certificate has expired. Manager instructed to update the expired certificate. No other issues were recorded in this license inspection.

headline: Cooler at 49.8°F; no health policy or logbook
summary: Failed. Reach-in cooler in main prep area measured 49.8°F air temperature and needs repair. Also: no employee health policy, no raw-food consumer advisory on menu, incomplete pest logbook, no mop sink, and some staff lack food handler certificates.

headline: About 15 rat droppings; no thermometer; trash overflowing
summary: Failed. About 15 rat droppings on floor and rack in cluttered rear storage; more pest control needed. No metal-stem food thermometer. Outside garbage overflowing, lid not tight. Mop sink lacks backflow device. Unisex washroom trash lacks cover.

headline: Dead ants found near pizza boxes; broken napkin dispenser
summary: Passed. Dead ants found on the floor behind a prep table holding pizza boxes; area to be cleaned. Broken napkin dispenser at rear handwashing sink. Debris and dust on floors and corners throughout; detail cleaning required.

headline: Cheese buildup on surfaces; grease on ceiling tiles
summary: Canvass inspection passed. Inspector saw cheese buildup on counters and sinks, dust and grease on ceiling tiles, and soil on walls near the dish area. Manager instructed to clean and maintain.

headline: Missing certified food manager; outdated posted summary
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager (CFM) was on site at arrival; one came more than 20 minutes later. Most recent inspection summary was not posted; the 2024 summary was displayed. Citations issued for both.

headline: Greasy kitchen; food on floors; unlabeled containers
summary: Passed on re-inspection, but many conditions noted. Food stored on floors, unlabeled containers, and milk crates used as shelving. Heavy grease on cooking equipment, walls and ceiling tiles; ice and debris in walk-in freezer; dim freezer lighting.

headline: No certified manager during food prep; dead roaches
summary: Passed with conditions. No certified food manager on duty while rice and chicken soup were prepared and served. Handsink blocked by food trays; cleared immediately. Employees drank and prepared food in prep area. Dead roaches and greasy floors need cleaning.

headline: Dish machine not sanitizing; unit tagged and held
summary: Failed. Low-temperature dish machine sanitized at 0 ppm chlorine and was tagged, may not be used. Also: no health policy or illness kit on site, no pest service report, sewage drain leak in basement storage, no commercial dumpster, unlabeled containers.

headline: Failed: roaches, mouse droppings, no certified manager
summary: Failed. Three live roaches on the three-compartment sink, numerous dead roaches in prep and restroom areas, and over 60 mouse droppings in the basement. Food prepared with no certified manager present. No food handler training. Employee sleeping on prep floor.

headline: Rear outer door needs rodent-proofing
summary: Passed. Inspector found the rear outer door not rodent-proofed as required. Management instructed to rodent-proof the door and maintain it. No pests were recorded.

headline: Dish machine tagged; undated prepared cakes
summary: Failed. Main kitchen dish machine produced a final utensil surface temperature of 134.1°F; unit tagged and must not be used until reinspected. Prepared cakes not dated, held over 24 hours. Missing and stained ceiling tiles, chipped paint, two prior violations uncorrected.

headline: Handwashing lapse; sink stopper and thermometer missing
summary: Passed with conditions. A food handler skipped handwashing between tasks and washed hands once told. Rinse compartment sink stopper missing. No air thermometer in walk-in cooler. Pizza sauce container left uncovered. Food-stained walls to be cleaned.

headline: Low hot water; ice scoop buried in ice
summary: Failed. Hot water too cool at handsinks (74°F and 80°F) and three-compartment sink (90°F); 100°F and 110°F minimums required. Ice scoop buried in ice machine, a contamination risk. Pest log incomplete. Floors under cooler shelving dusty.

headline: Missing handsink; low hot water; mop sink unusable
summary: Failed. No handwashing sink near the dishwashing area; one must be installed. Three-compartment sink water reached only 104°F; 110°F minimum required. Mop sink connected to a refrigerator and cannot be turned on. Citations issued.

headline: Over 50 mouse droppings; pink ice machine lining
summary: Failed. Over 50 mouse droppings on floors in prep, dishwashing and dry storage areas; pest treatment required. Pinkish discoloration inside ice machine. Dirty wiping cloths, unlidded restroom trash, and greasy outdoor container. Prior core violations uncorrected.
